sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_qmzhang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-07-25 15:28:34.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.zqm_20240725_future_loss_login_feature PARTITION(logymd = '2026-03-30') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, active_days_7 /* 未来7日（不含当日）活跃天数（不含当日） */, active_days_14 /* 未来14日（不含当日）活跃天数（不含当日） */, active_days_21 /* 未来21日（不含当日）活跃天数（不含当日） */, active_days_30 /* 未来30日（不含当日）活跃天数（不含当日） */, CASE WHEN register_date = '2026-03-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_new /* 是否当日新增 */, CASE WHEN active_days_7 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_loss_7 /* 是否7日流失用户（未来连续1-7天未活跃） */, CASE WHEN active_days_14 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_loss_14 /* 是否14日流失用户 */, CASE WHEN active_days_21 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_loss_21 /* 是否21日流失用户 */, CASE WHEN active_days_30 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_loss_30 /* 是否30日流失用户 */, CASE WHEN active_days_31 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_loss_31 /* 是否31日流失用户 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-03-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-03-30' < '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-03-30') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, register_date) AS t2 /* 用户属性 */ ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days_7 FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-03-30', 1) AND logymd <= DATE_ADD('2026-03-30', 7) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t3 /* 未来7日活跃用户 */ ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days_14 FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-03-30', 1) AND logymd <= DATE_ADD('2026-03-30', 14) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t4 /* 未来14日活跃用户 */ ON t1.roleid = t4.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t4.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days_21 FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-03-30', 1) AND logymd <= DATE_ADD('2026-03-30', 21) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t5 /* 未来21日活跃用户 */ ON t1.roleid = t5.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t5.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days_30 FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-03-30', 1) AND logymd <= DATE_ADD('2026-03-30', 30) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t6 /* 未来30日活跃用户 */ ON t1.roleid = t6.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t6.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days_31 FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-03-30', 1) AND logymd <= DATE_ADD('2026-03-30', 31) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t7 /* 未来31日活跃用户 */ ON t1.roleid = t7.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t7.zoneid GROUP BY t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, active_days_7 /* 未来7日（不含当日）活跃天数（不含当日） */, active_days_14 /* 未来14日（不含当日）活跃天数（不含当日） */, active_days_21 /* 未来21日（不含当日）活跃天数（不含当日） */, active_days_30 /* 未来30日（不含当日）活跃天数（不含当日） */, CASE WHEN register_date = '2026-03-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END /* 是否当日新增 */, CASE WHEN active_days_7 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END /* 是否7日流失用户（未来连续1-7天未活跃） */, CASE WHEN active_days_14 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END /* 是否14日流失用户 */, CASE WHEN active_days_21 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END /* 是否21日流失用户 */, CASE WHEN active_days_30 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END /* 是否30日流失用户 */, CASE WHEN active_days_31 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END /* 是否31日流失用户 */

name: mtai.dwm_ml_behavior_recent30d_active_account_zone_di
sql_units: WITH base AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_date, his_last_active_level FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' /* 30天后，最近活跃日期依旧是'2026-05-02'，说明30天内没有活跃，查看最近活跃日期前30日的数据 */ AND his_last_active_date = '2026-05-02' AND his_last_active_level >= 5 /* 未活跃，等级不变，UA要求 */), register AS (/* 关联注册数据，剔除ai */ SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_attribute_basic_account_zone_df)) WHERE p_date = IF(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 2 * -1) > '2026-05-02', DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 2 * -1), '2026-05-02') AND zoneid < 57000 /* 剔除测试服数据 */), active AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, p_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_behavior_active_account_zone_di)) WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2026-04-03' AND '2026-05-02' /* 最近活跃往前推30日活跃 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_behavior_recent30d_active_account_zone_di)) SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.register_date, COUNT(DISTINCT c.p_date) AS rd30_active_days, MAX(c.p_date) AS rd30_last_active_date FROM register AS a JOIN base AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid JOIN active AS c ON a.accountid = c.accountid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.register_date HAVING MAX(c.p_date) = '2026-05-02'

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dm_ml_resource_hero_account_zone_rd30_v1_di)) SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.active_days, a.rd30_own_hero_change_bitmap, a.rd30_own_mksm_change_bitmap, a.rd30_own_warr_change_bitmap, a.rd30_own_mage_change_bitmap, a.rd30_own_supp_change_bitmap, a.rd30_own_tank_change_bitmap, a.rd30_own_skin_change_cnt_bitmap, a.rd30_own_hero_cnt, a.rd30_own_mksm_cnt, a.rd30_own_warr_cnt, a.rd30_own_mage_cnt, a.rd30_own_supp_cnt, a.rd30_own_assn_cnt, a.rd30_own_tank_cnt, a.rd30_own_skin_cnt, a.rd30_own_skin_gt_s_cnt, a.rd30_own_skin_gt_a_cnt, a.rd30_own_skin_gt_b_cnt, a.rd30_warr_skin_gt_s_cnt, a.rd30_mksm_skin_gt_s_cnt, a.rd30_mage_skin_gt_s_cnt, a.rd30_supp_skin_gt_s_cnt, a.rd30_assn_skin_gt_s_cnt, a.rd30_tank_skin_gt_s_cnt, b.own_hero_cnt AS rd30_last_day_own_hero_cnt /* 最后一天玩家拥有英雄总数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, b.own_mark_cnt AS rd30_last_day_own_mark_cnt /* 最后一天拥有射手英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, b.own_figh_cnt AS rd30_last_day_own_figh_cnt /* 最后一天拥有战士英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, b.own_mage_cnt AS rd30_last_day_own_mage_cnt /* 最后一天拥有法师英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, b.own_sup_cnt AS rd30_last_day_own_sup_cnt /* 最后一天拥有辅助英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, b.own_ass_cnt AS rd30_last_day_own_ass_cnt /* 最后一天拥有刺客英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, b.own_tank_cnt AS rd30_last_day_own_tank_cnt /* 最后一天拥有坦克英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, b.own_dye_skin_cnt AS BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(own_mksm_cnt_map), '2026-04-03', 30) AS rd30_own_mksm_change_bitmap /* 最近30天内拥有射手英雄数变化位图 */, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(own_warr_cnt_map), '2026-04-03', 30) AS name: mtai.dm_ml_behavior_social_account_zone_rd30_v1_di

b.daily_new_friends_cnt) END AS daily_new_friends_cnt_map, CASE WHEN b.p_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE MAP(b.p_date, b.daily_new_deleted_friends_cnt) END AS daily_new_deleted_friends_cnt_map, CASE WHEN b.p_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE MAP(b.p_date, b.daily_new_following_cnt) END AS daily_new_following_cnt_map, CASE WHEN b.p_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE MAP(b.p_date, b.daily_fans_change_num) END AS daily_fans_change_num_map, CASE WHEN b.p_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE MAP(b.p_date, b.last_game_fb_friend_cnt) END AS last_game_fb_friend_cnt_map FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_behavior_recent30d_active_account_zone_di)) LEFT JOIN STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_behavior_social_account_zone_di)) ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND b.p_date >= '2026-04-03' AND b.p_date <= '2026-05-02' WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-02') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dm_ml_behavior_social_account_zone_rd30_v1_di)) SELECT accountid_a AS accountid, zoneid_a AS zoneid, active_days, SUM(first_ol_idle_friend_cnt) / active_days AS rd30_daily_avg_first_ol_idle_friend_cnt /* 最近30天内天级平均首次空闲好友数 */, SUM(last_ol_idle_friend_cnt) / active_days AS rd30_daily_avg_last_ol_idle_friend_cnt /* 最近30天内天级平均末次空闲好友数 */, SUM(first_ol_friend_cnt) / active_days AS rd30_first_ol_friend_cnt /* 最近30天内天级平均首次在线好友数    */, SUM(last_ol_friend_cnt) / active_days AS rd30_last_ol_friend_cnt /* 最近30天内天级平均末次在线好友数 */, MAX(first_ol_friend_cnt) AS rd30_top_first_ol_frient_cnt /* 最近30天内最高首次在线好友数 */, MAX(last_ol_friend_cnt) AS rd30_top_last_ol_frient_cnt /* 最近30天内最高末次在线好友数 */, MAX(first_ol_idle_friend_cnt) AS rd30_top_first_idle_frient_cnt /* 最近30天内最高首次空闲好友数 */, MAX(last_ol_idle_friend_cnt) AS rd30_top_last_idle_frient_cnt /* 最近30天内最高末次空闲好友数 */, SUM(CASE merge_firstoverlap_date_map, 7)) / AVG(CALCULATE_SUM('2026-05-02', merge_firstoverlap_date_map, 14)) AS rd30_trend_competitive_num_avg7_avg14_ratio /* 最近7天竞品个数均值均值/最近14天竞品个数均值均值 */, SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF(pay.his_first_pay_date, dev.create_date)), 2), pay.pay_amt_info), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) WHEN dev.create_date > pay.his_first_pay_date THEN ',') AS ARRAY<DOUBLE>) WHEN dev.create_date > pay.his_first_pay_date THEN CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(CONCAT_WS(',', pay.actual_pay_amt_info), ',', DATEDIFF(dev.create_date, pay.his_first_pay_date) - SIZE(pay.actual_pay_amt_info)), ',') AS ARRAY<DOUBLE>) ELSE pay.actual_pay_amt_info END AS actual_pay_amt_info, pay.total_pay_cnt, pay.total_pay_amt, pay.total_actual_pay_amt, WHEN rev.his_first_revenue_date IS NULL THEN ARRAY('0') WHEN dev.create_date < rev.his_first_revenue_date THEN SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', rev.click_info_str), REPEAT(',0', sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jaxli@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-01-18 22:32:55.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH r AS (/* 当日30日流失回流用户 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, recurring_date, lose_days /* --------------------------------------  5 */, lose_date FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_core_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND /* AND     lose_days between 30 and 365 */ lose_days >= 30 AND zoneid < 57000 AND logymd = recurring_date), inf /* GROUP BY */ /*         r.roleid, */ /*         r.zoneid, */ /*         r.lose_days */ AS (SELECT r.roleid, r.zoneid, lose_days, logymd FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df AS i JOIN r ON r.roleid = i.roleid AND r.zoneid = i.zoneid WHERE i.logymd = GREATEST('2024-01-01', '2026-05-30')), id AS (SELECT inf.roleid, inf.zoneid, lose_days, SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(inf.logymd, '2026-05-30') + 1) AS active_info FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df AS i JOIN inf ON inf.roleid = i.roleid AND inf.zoneid = i.zoneid AND inf.logymd = i.logymd WHERE i.logymd = GREATEST('2024-01-01', '2026-05-30')), i AS (/* 位图：付费、活跃、流失次数、首日是否战斗 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, lose_days + 1, 30), 0, '')) AS `act30days_lose` /* ------------------ 2 */ FROM id), rk AS (/* 流失前段位 */ SELECT r.roleid, r.zoneid, COALESCE(rk.his_last_rank_id, '无段位') AS his_last_rank_id_lose /* 流失时的段位     ------------------- 1 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df AS rk JOIN r ON rk.roleid = r.roleid AND rk.zoneid = r.zoneid WHERE rk.logymd = '2026-05-29' AND rk.appid = 'mlbb' AND rk.pvptype = 2), b AS (/* 流失前行为特征 */ SELECT r.roleid, r.zoneid, b.his_battle_cnt /* 生涯累计战斗场次 --------------------------------4 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_feature_role_zone_df AS b JOIN r ON r.roleid = b.roleid AND r.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE b.logymd = '2026-05-29'), p AS (SELECT r.roleid, r.zoneid, MAX(is_first_afterinstall) AS is_first_afterinstall_st /* ---------------3 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_configuration AS p JOIN r ON p.accountid = r.roleid AND p.zoneid = r.zoneid WHERE p.logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY r.roleid, r.zoneid), par AS (SELECT r.roleid, r.zoneid, r.recurring_date, (r.lose_days - 109) / 111 AS lose_days, COALESCE((rk.his_last_rank_id_lose - 55.8) / 35.5, -1) AS his_last_rank_id_lose, COALESCE((p.is_first_afterinstall_st - 0.36) / 0.48, 0) AS is_first_afterinstall_st, COALESCE((b.his_battle_cnt - 924) / 1461, 0) AS his_battle_cnt, (i.act30days_lose - 6.38) / 5.9 AS act30days_lose FROM r LEFT JOIN i ON r.roleid = i.roleid AND r.zoneid = i.zoneid LEFT JOIN rk ON r.roleid = rk.roleid AND r.zoneid = rk.zoneid LEFT JOIN b ON r.roleid = b.roleid AND r.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN p ON r.roleid = p.roleid AND r.zoneid = p.zoneid), p1 AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, recurring_date, lose_days, his_last_rank_id_lose, is_first_afterinstall_st, his_battle_cnt, act30days_lose, (his_last_rank_id_lose * 0.724069 + act30days_lose * 0.507738 + is_first_afterinstall_st * -0.230521 + his_battle_cnt * 0.393073 + lose_days * -0.101387) AS pc1, (his_last_rank_id_lose * -0.071212 + act30days_lose * -0.318963 + is_first_afterinstall_st * -0.942401 + his_battle_cnt * -0.026538 + lose_days * -0.06609) AS pc2 FROM par) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jax_recur__label_roleid_zoneid_di PARTITION(recurring_date = '2026-05-30') SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN LEAST(m1, m2, m3, m4) = m1 THEN '0类' WHEN LEAST(m1, m2, m3, m4) = m2 THEN '1类' WHEN LEAST(m1, m2, m3, m4) = m3 THEN '2类' WHEN LEAST(m1, m2, m3, m4) = m4 THEN '3类' ELSE '其他' END AS class, lose_days, his_last_rank_id_lose, is_first_afterinstall_st, his_battle_cnt, act30days_lose /* recurring_date */ FROM (/* 与4类的质心聚类 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, recurring_date, lose_days, his_last_rank_id_lose, is_first_afterinstall_st, his_battle_cnt, act30days_lose, SQRT(POWER(pc1 - -1.3142, 2) + POWER(pc2 - -1.0284, 2)) AS m1, SQRT(POWER(pc1 - 1.3688, 2) + POWER(pc2 - 0.3874, 2)) AS m2, SQRT(POWER(pc1 - -0.6282, 2) + POWER(pc2 - 0.9069, 2)) AS m3, SQRT(POWER(pc1 - 0.8173, 2) + POWER(pc2 - -1.5384, 2)) AS m4 FROM p1) AS a

sql_units: /* set spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.initialPartitionNum=1000; */ /* set spark.sql.adaptive.maxNumPostShufflePartitions =1000; */ /*  代码df逻辑更新为在昨天分区基础上增加 */ WITH a1 /* 每日回流用户，流失时基础信息 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid) AS accountid, UPPER(createrole_country) AS country, param_name, CASE WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test"}' OR param_value = 'test') THEN 0 WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"control"}' OR param_value = 'control') THEN 1 ELSE -9999 END AS mod_type, CASE WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test1"}' OR param_value = 'test1') THEN '实验1' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test2"}' OR param_value = 'test2') THEN '实验2' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test"}' OR param_value = 'test') THEN '实验' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"control"}' OR param_value = 'control') THEN '对照' ELSE param_value END AS param_value, FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) AS big_zoneid, MIN(logymd) AS min_logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND UPPER(param_name) LIKE '%RETURN%' AND `level` >= 9 AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid), UPPER(createrole_country), param_name, param_value, mod_type, big_zoneid HAVING MIN(logymd) BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' /* 近30天入组用户 */ /* 5.11新增union */ UNION SELECT CONCAT(old_zoneid, '_', accountid) AS accountid, UPPER(createrole_country) AS country, param_name, CASE WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test"}' OR param_value = 'test') THEN 0 WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"control"}' OR param_value = 'control') THEN 1 ELSE -9999 END AS mod_type, CASE WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test1"}' OR param_value = 'test1') THEN '实验1' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test2"}' OR param_value = 'test2') THEN '实验2' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test"}' OR param_value = 'test') THEN '实验' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"control"}' OR param_value = 'control') THEN '对照' ELSE param_value END AS param_value, FLOOR(old_zoneid / 1000) AS big_zoneid, MIN(logymd) AS min_logymd FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag /* 新实验表 */ WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND UPPER(param_name) LIKE '%RETURN%' AND `createroel_level` >= 9 AND old_zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY CONCAT(old_zoneid, '_', accountid), UPPER(createrole_country), param_name, param_value, mod_type, big_zoneid HAVING MIN(logymd) BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' /* 近30天入组用户 */ UNION /* 新增8级以下进组玩家 */ SELECT CONCAT(old_zoneid, '_', accountid) AS accountid, UPPER(createrole_country) AS country, param_name, CASE WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test"}' OR param_value = 'test') THEN 0 WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"control"}' OR param_value = 'control') THEN 1 ELSE -9999 END AS mod_type, CASE WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test1"}' OR param_value = 'test1') THEN '实验1' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test2"}' OR param_value = 'test2') THEN '实验2' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test"}' OR param_value = 'test') THEN '实验' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"control"}' OR param_value = 'control') THEN '对照' ELSE param_value END AS param_value, FLOOR(old_zoneid / 1000) AS big_zoneid, MIN(logymd) AS min_logymd FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag /* 新实验表 */ WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND (param_name = '60.2_Returning2026_TH' OR UPPER(param_name) LIKE '%LEVEL_RETURN%') /* 限制等级实验放行 */ AND `createroel_level` < 9 AND old_zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY CONCAT(old_zoneid, '_', accountid), UPPER(createrole_country), param_name, param_value, mod_type, big_zoneid HAVING MIN(logymd) BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' /* 近30天入组用户 */), a_1d AS (/* 当天回流：更新当天信息 */ SELECT a1.accountid, a1.big_zoneid, a1.country, a1.param_name, a1.param_value, a1.mod_type, a1.min_logymd, aa1.before_lose_his_max_bigranklvl, aa1.lose_days, aa1.lose_date, aa1.lose_level, aa1.class, aa1.class_online FROM a1 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(t.zoneid, '_', t.roleid) AS accountid, UPPER(first_mt_country) AS country, lose_level, lose_days /* 流失天数 */, lose_date, t2.class, t3.class_online, t1.his_max_bigranklvl_before_lose AS before_lose_his_max_bigranklvl, t.logymd FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_core_role_zone_di AS t /* LEFT JOIN */ /*         ( */ /*             -- 流失时最大段位，会导致整体跑的比较慢 */ /*             SELECT  distinct roleid, */ /*                     zoneid, */ /*                     logymd, */ /*                     his_max_bigranklvl_before_lose */ /*             FROM    `ml_temp`.`dwm_wmz_recur_feature_role_zone_di` a */ /*             JOIN    ( */ /*                         SELECT  DISTINCT accountid */ /*                         FROM    a1 */ /*                     ) b */ /*             ON      concat(a.zoneid, '_', a.roleid) = b.accountid */ /*             WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-30' */ /*             AND     zoneid <= 57000 */ /*             and     recurring_date = logymd */ /*         ) t1 */ /* ON      t.roleid = t1.roleid */ /* AND     t.zoneid = t1.zoneid */ /* AND     t.recurring_date = t1.logymd */ LEFT JOIN (/* 流失时最大段位，会导致整体跑的比较慢 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, his_max_bigranklvl AS his_max_bigranklvl_before_lose FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT accountid FROM a1) AS b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.roleid) = b.accountid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND pvptype = 2) AS t1 ON t.roleid = t1.roleid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t.recurring_date = DATE_ADD(t1.logymd, 1) LEFT JOIN (SELECT recurring_date, CASE WHEN class = '0类' THEN '回流新手' WHEN class = '1类' THEN '回流老玩家' WHEN class = '2类' THEN '回流低活' WHEN class = '3类' THEN '回流高活' ELSE '其他' END AS class, roleid, zoneid FROM ml_temp.jax_recur__label_roleid_zoneid_di WHERE recurring_date = '2026-05-30') AS t2 ON t.roleid = t2.roleid AND t.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t.recurring_date = t2.recurring_date LEFT JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN tag_id = 1 THEN '回流低活' WHEN tag_id = 2 THEN '回流老玩家' WHEN tag_id = 3 THEN '回流新手' WHEN tag_id = 4 THEN '回流高活' ELSE '其他' END AS class_online, roleid, zoneid, logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME ASC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_returning2023_playertag WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t3 ON t.roleid = t3.roleid AND t.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND t.recurring_date = t3.logymd AND t3.rn = 1 WHERE t.logymd = '2026-05-30' AND t.recurring_date = t.logymd /* 回流日期 = 分区日期 */ AND lose_days >= 30) AS aa1 ON a1.accountid = aa1.accountid AND a1.min_logymd = aa1.logymd /* 确定进组日期为回流日期 */), a_30d AS (/* 前12~前30天回流：更新位图 */ SELECT a1.accountid, a1.big_zoneid, a1.country, a1.param_name, a1.param_value, a1.mod_type, a1.min_logymd FROM a1 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(t.zoneid, '_', t.roleid) AS accountid, UPPER(first_mt_country) AS country, lose_level, lose_days /* 流失天数 */, lose_date, t.logymd FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_core_role_zone_di AS t WHERE t.logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND t.logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND t.recurring_date = t.logymd /* 回流日期 = 分区日期 */ AND lose_days >= 30) AS aa1 ON a1.accountid = aa1.accountid AND a1.min_logymd = aa1.logymd /* 确定进组日期为回流日期 */), b /* 回流当天，基础属性 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.min_logymd, a.accountid, a.param_name, a.param_value, a.country, a.before_lose_his_max_bigranklvl, a.lose_days, a.lose_date, a.lose_level, a.class, a.class_online, b1.login_min_time, b1.login_os, b1.login_client_ver, b1.login_channel, b1.login_device, b1.login_memory, b1.login_level, b1.ret_day, act_table.act_id AS return_act_id FROM a_1d AS a /* 26.03.11新增回流活动act_id */ LEFT JOIN (/* 触发活动 */ SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid) AS accountid, act_id FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME ASC) AS rw FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_returning2023_type WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30') AS a WHERE rw = 1) AS act_table ON a.accountid = act_table.accountid LEFT JOIN (/* login表中回流当天首次登录信息 */ SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid) AS accountid, MIN(TIME) AS login_min_time /* 最早登录时间 */, SUBSTRING(MIN(TIME || os_type), 24, 999) AS login_os /* 操作系统 */, SUBSTRING(MIN(TIME || client_ver), 24, 999) AS login_client_ver /* 版本号 */, SUBSTRING(MIN(TIME || channel), 24, 999) AS login_channel /* 渠道 */, SUBSTRING(MIN(TIME || LOWER(device)), 24, 999) AS login_device /* 设备 */, MIN(client_memory + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(TIME) * 100000000) % 100000000 AS login_memory /* 内存 */, MIN(LEVEL + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(TIME) * 100000000) % 100000000 AS login_level /* 等级 */, DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) AS ret_day /* 注册天数 */, logymd FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT accountid AS accountid_filter, min_logymd AS logymd_filter FROM a_1d AS a) AS b ON CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid) = b.accountid_filter AND a.logymd = b.logymd_filter WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY accountid, ret_day, logymd) AS b1 ON a.accountid = b1.accountid AND a.min_logymd = b1.logymd), c /* 回流小热更下载完毕：只看loading阶段有3的 = 3之前没2 在loading阶段下载完增量，才能在主城看到扑脸 */ AS (SELECT b.accountid, b.min_logymd, b.param_name, MAX(c1.op_param1) AS op_param1 /* 下载耗时(98%的用户在30秒之内完成下载） */ FROM b JOIN (SELECT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', accountid) AS accountid, op_param1, logymd, TIME FROM ml_ods.reportserver_client_mini_patch_new WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND module_name = 'returning_res_2023' AND op_type = 3 /* 下载完毕 op_type = 2 在loading下载超时，进主城后下载完增量，但会错过扑脸 */) AS c1 ON b.accountid = c1.accountid AND b.min_logymd = c1.logymd AND b.login_min_time <= c1.time GROUP BY b.accountid, b.min_logymd, b.param_name), d /* 主界面引导 */ AS (SELECT -99999 AS accountid, -99999 AS min_logymd, -99999 AS param_name, -99999 AS stepid), f /* 回流引导 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.accountid, b.min_logymd, b.param_name FROM b JOIN (SELECT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', accountid) AS accountid, TIME, logymd FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_newbie_guide WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND stepid IN (2000120) /* 回流引导 */) AS f1 ON b.accountid = f1.accountid AND b.min_logymd = f1.logymd AND b.login_min_time <= f1.time), h /* 扑脸1~3 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) AS accountid, b.min_logymd, b.param_name, MAX(IF(step_id = 1, 1, 0)) AS is_welcome_1, MAX(IF(step_id = 2, 1, 0)) AS is_welcome_2, MAX(IF(step_id = 3, 1, 0)) AS is_welcome_3 FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_returning2023_welcome AS a JOIN b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) = b.accountid AND a.logymd = b.min_logymd WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND step_id IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid), b.min_logymd, b.param_name), bt_ms /* 匹配开始 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) AS accountid, b.min_logymd FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_begin AS a JOIN b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) = b.accountid AND a.logymd = b.min_logymd WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid), b.min_logymd), bt_md /* 匹配成功 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) AS accountid, b.min_logymd FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end AS a JOIN b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) = b.accountid AND a.logymd = b.min_logymd WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND success = 1 /* 匹配成功 */ GROUP BY CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid), b.min_logymd), bt_s /* 战斗开始 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) AS accountid, b.min_logymd FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_begin AS a JOIN b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) = b.accountid AND a.logymd = b.min_logymd WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid), b.min_logymd), bt_d /* 战斗场次 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) AS accountid, b.min_logymd, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battle_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) = b.accountid AND a.logymd = b.min_logymd WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid), b.min_logymd), lc /* 活跃位图 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT lc1.accountid, lc1.param_name, lc1.diff, lc1.min_logymd, SUBSTRING(lc1.active_info, 1, diff) AS active_info FROM (/* 结合进组的人第一天进组开始的活跃信息切片 */ SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.roleid) AS accountid, b.param_name /* 多个实验有可能多个进组日期 */, a.active_info, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', b.min_logymd) + 1 AS diff /* 同一天算第一天 */, b.min_logymd /* 第一次进组时间 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_retention_role_zone_df AS a JOIN a_30d AS b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.roleid) = b.accountid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-30') AS lc1), recur_pay_t AS (/* 回流后7天内付费 */ SELECT a.accountid, a.param_name, a.param_value, a.min_logymd, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.min_logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 0, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_1d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.min_logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 1, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_2d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.min_logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 2, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_3d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.min_logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 3, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_4d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.min_logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 4, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_5d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.min_logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 5, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_6d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.min_logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 6, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_7d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.min_logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 13, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_14d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.min_logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 20, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_21d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.min_logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 29, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_30d FROM a_30d AS a LEFT JOIN mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di AS t1 ON a.accountid = CONCAT(t1.zoneid, '_', t1.roleid) AND t1.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY a.accountid, a.param_name, a.param_value, a.min_logymd), result_t AS (/* 第一部分：回流当天数据 */ SELECT DISTINCT '2026-05-30' AS last_date, b.min_logymd, b.param_name, b.param_value, b.accountid /* 账户id */, lc.active_info /* 活跃位图 */, b.country /* 国家 */, CAST(b.before_lose_his_max_bigranklvl AS INT) AS before_lose_his_max_bigranklvl /* 流失前历史最高段位 */, b.lose_days /* 流失天数 */, b.lose_date, b.lose_level, b.class, b.class_online, b.login_min_time /* 登录时间 */, b.login_os /* 登录系统 */, b.login_client_ver /* 登录版本号 */, b.login_channel /* 登录渠道 */, b.login_device /* 登录设备 */, b.login_memory /* 登录内存 */, b.login_level /* 登录等级 */, b.ret_day /* 注册日期 */, c.op_param1 /* 小热更下载时长 */, IF(NOT c.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_patch /* 是否小热更 */, IF(NOT d.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_main_ui /* 是否主界面 */, IF(NOT f.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_huiliu_gd /* 是否回流引导 */, IF(NOT h.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_welcome /* 是否扑脸 */, COALESCE(h.is_welcome_1, 0) AS is_welcome_1 /* 是否扑脸 */, COALESCE(h.is_welcome_2, 0) AS is_welcome_2 /* 是否扑脸 */, COALESCE(h.is_welcome_3, 0) AS is_welcome_3 /* 是否扑脸 */, IF(NOT d.accountid IS NULL AND stepid = 2100002, 1, 0) AS is_main_ui_2100002 /* 是否主界面 */, pay_amount_recur_1d, pay_amount_recur_2d, pay_amount_recur_3d, pay_amount_recur_4d, pay_amount_recur_5d, pay_amount_recur_6d, pay_amount_recur_7d, pay_amount_recur_14d, pay_amount_recur_21d, pay_amount_recur_30d, IF(NOT bt_ms.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_match, IF(NOT bt_md.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_match_suc, IF(NOT bt_s.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_bt_begin, IF(NOT bt_d.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_bt_end, return_act_id FROM b LEFT JOIN c ON b.accountid = c.accountid AND b.param_name = c.param_name AND b.min_logymd = c.min_logymd LEFT JOIN d ON b.accountid = d.accountid AND b.param_name = d.param_name AND b.min_logymd = d.min_logymd LEFT JOIN f ON b.accountid = f.accountid AND b.param_name = f.param_name AND b.min_logymd = f.min_logymd LEFT JOIN h ON b.accountid = h.accountid AND b.param_name = h.param_name AND b.min_logymd = h.min_logymd LEFT JOIN lc ON b.accountid = lc.accountid AND b.param_name = lc.param_name AND b.min_logymd = lc.min_logymd /* 只有回流当天玩家活跃位图 */ LEFT JOIN recur_pay_t AS pt ON b.accountid = pt.accountid AND b.param_name = pt.param_name AND b.min_logymd = pt.min_logymd LEFT JOIN bt_ms ON b.accountid = bt_ms.accountid AND b.min_logymd = bt_ms.min_logymd LEFT JOIN bt_md ON b.accountid = bt_md.accountid AND b.min_logymd = bt_md.min_logymd LEFT JOIN bt_s ON b.accountid = bt_s.accountid AND b.min_logymd = bt_s.min_logymd LEFT JOIN bt_d ON b.accountid = bt_d.accountid AND b.min_logymd = bt_d.min_logymd UNION ALL /* 第二部分：前2~前30天数据更新位图和付费数据 */ SELECT DISTINCT '2026-05-30' AS last_date, a.min_logymd, a.param_name, a.param_value, a.accountid, lc.active_info, a.country, a.before_lose_his_max_bigranklvl, a.lose_days, a.lose_date, a.lose_level, a.class, a.class_online, a.login_min_time, a.login_os, a.login_client_ver, a.login_channel, a.login_device, a.login_memory, a.login_level, a.ret_day, a.op_param1, a.is_patch, a.is_main_ui, a.is_huiliu_gd, a.is_welcome, a.is_welcome_1, a.is_welcome_2, a.is_welcome_3, a.is_main_ui_2100002, pt.pay_amount_recur_1d, pt.pay_amount_recur_2d, pt.pay_amount_recur_3d, pt.pay_amount_recur_4d, pt.pay_amount_recur_5d, pt.pay_amount_recur_6d, pt.pay_amount_recur_7d, pt.pay_amount_recur_14d, pt.pay_amount_recur_21d, pt.pay_amount_recur_30d, a.is_match, a.is_match_suc, a.is_bt_begin, a.is_bt_end, a.return_act_id FROM ml_temp.ads_wmz_recur_ab_active_role_zone_df AS a LEFT JOIN lc ON a.accountid = lc.accountid AND a.min_logymd = lc.min_logymd AND a.param_name = lc.param_name LEFT JOIN recur_pay_t AS pt ON a.accountid = pt.accountid AND a.min_logymd = pt.min_logymd AND a.param_name = pt.param_name WHERE a.min_logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-29' AND a.logymd = '2026-05-29' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT a.last_date, a.min_logymd, a.param_name, a.param_value, a.accountid, a.active_info, a.country, a.before_lose_his_max_bigranklvl, a.lose_days, a.lose_date, a.lose_level, a.class, a.class_online, a.login_min_time, a.login_os, a.login_client_ver, a.login_channel, a.login_device, a.login_memory, a.login_level, a.ret_day, a.op_param1, a.is_patch, a.is_main_ui, a.is_huiliu_gd, a.is_welcome, a.is_welcome_1, a.is_welcome_2, a.is_welcome_3, a.is_main_ui_2100002, a.pay_amount_recur_1d, a.pay_amount_recur_2d, a.pay_amount_recur_3d, name: mtai.dwm_ml_behavior_recent3d_register_account_zone_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: cherylxie@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-10-24 16:43:05.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH register AS (SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_attribute_basic_account_zone_df)) WHERE p_date = IF(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 2 * -1) > '2026-05-30', DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 2 * -1), '2026-05-30') AND register_date = '2026-05-28' /* 注册满3天 */ AND zoneid < 57000 /* 剔除测试服数据 */), active AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, p_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_behavior_active_account_zone_di)) WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-28' AND '2026-05-30' /* 最近3日活跃 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_behavior_recent3d_register_account_zone_di)) SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.register_date, COUNT(DISTINCT b.p_date) AS fd3_active_days FROM register AS a LEFT JOIN active AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.register_date

name: ml_temp.tinashi_match_index_feature_day

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tinashi_match_index_feature_day PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-29') SELECT a.*, CONCAT(wincamp, '_', scorerank) AS win_rank /* --交叉维度指标 */, CONCAT(wincamp, '_', IF(wincamp = 0 AND ismvp = 1, ismvp, grade_type)) AS win_grade, CONCAT(wincamp, '_', IF(selfconfi + teamconfi > 0, 1, 0)) AS win_confi, CONCAT(wincamp, '_', a.camp) AS win_camp, kda - avgkda AS kdadiff, score - avgscore AS scorediff, rolenum, COALESCE(selfscore - opposcore, 99999) AS teamscorediff, score - selfscore AS selfscorediff, COALESCE(selfkda - oppokda, 99999) AS teamkdadiff, kda - selfkda AS selfkdadiff, NTILE(50) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN b_battlecnt <= 3 THEN 1 WHEN b_battlecnt <= 8 THEN 2 WHEN b_battlecnt <= 14 THEN 3 WHEN b_battlecnt <= 20 THEN 4 WHEN b_battlecnt <= 26 THEN 5 WHEN b_battlecnt <= 34 THEN 6 WHEN b_battlecnt <= 43 THEN 7 WHEN b_battlecnt <= 55 THEN 8 WHEN b_battlecnt <= 75 THEN 9 WHEN b_battlecnt > 75 THEN 10 ELSE -1 END ORDER BY (maxstar - rankstar) / maxstar) AS stardiffper, IF(isreport > 0, 1, 0) AS isreport, IF(isbereport > 0, 1, 0) AS isbereport, game_type, mgold, mkill, mdead, massist, mhurt, minjured, mcure, matktower, warrate, solokill, continuouskill, hurtrate, behurtrate, fightrate, towerhurtrate, dragon, tortoise, skill_hero_m, grade_type, is_surrender, black_comb, role_like_cnt, imbalance, realpower, roadind, roadscnt, COALESCE(selfteampower - oppoteampower, 99999) AS teampowerdiff, realpower - selfteampower AS selfpowerdiff, selfconfi, teamconfi, ohookcnt, obadcnt, COALESCE(jankper10min, 0) AS jankper10min, COALESCE(bigjankper10min, 0) AS bigjankper10min, use_emoji_all, use_signal_all, use_statement_all, respond_signal, quick_dead, double_kill, triple_kill, manic, savage, battery, floor_num, var_ping, move_lag, deadtime / battletime AS deadtimert, conslow_rate, tower1time, tower2time, tower3time, grade_typelist /* --序列指标 */, game_typelist, wincamplist, floornolist, avgkda, avgscore, blacknumlist, bttimelist, scoreranklist, roadindlist FROM (SELECT a.*, b_battlecnt, CASE WHEN his_max_minranklvl <= 3 THEN 3 * (his_max_minranklvl - 1) + 1 WHEN his_max_minranklvl <= 6 THEN 10 + 4 * (his_max_minranklvl - 4) WHEN his_max_minranklvl <= 10 THEN 22 + 4 * (his_max_minranklvl - 7) WHEN his_max_minranklvl <= 25 THEN 38 + 5 * (his_max_minranklvl - 11) WHEN his_max_minranklvl = 26 THEN 113 WHEN his_max_minranklvl <= 30 THEN 122 + 10 * (his_max_minranklvl - 27) ELSE 162 END AS maxstar, COALESCE(herorate, -2) AS herorate, COALESCE(battle_cnt_100total, 0) AS battle_cnt_100total, COALESCE(heromvprate, -2) AS heromvprate FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(logymd < '2026-05-29', ranked_cnt + classic_cnt, 0)) AS b_battlecnt, CAST(MAX(ARRAY(logymd, CAST(his_max_minranklvl AS STRING)))[1] AS INT) AS his_max_minranklvl, SUM(is_active_day) AS activedays FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE (logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-22' AND '2026-05-29') AND register_role_date <= '2026-05-22' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid HAVING SUM(is_active_day) >= 1) AS effect_user JOIN (SELECT zoneid, accountid, pvptype, battleid, heroid, camp, wincamp, conwin, rankstar, kda, score, ismvp, battletime, blacknum, real_road, IF(timedelay <= 60 AND stdping <= 1900, 1, 0) AS isdelay, IF(reconnectnum >= 3, 3, reconnectnum) AS reconnectnum, ishook FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND battletime > 0) AS a ON effect_user.roleid = a.accountid AND effect_user.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.roleid, mt_dwm.dwm_battle_heroes_role_zone_mi WHERE logymd IN (LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-29', -1)), LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-29', -2)), LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-29', -3))) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, hurtrate, MAX(behurtrate) AS behurtrate, MAX(fightrate) AS fightrate, MAX(towerhurtrate) AS towerhurtrate FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE battletype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 AND isbot = 0 AND hurtad <= 150000 AND hurtap <= 150000 AND hurtatk <= 150000 AND realinjured <= 250000 AND cureHero <= 150000 AND killnum <= 50 AND dead <= 50 AND assist <= 50 AND logymd = '2026-05-29' AND /* 加强过滤条件 */ NOT wartime IS NULL AND wartime <> '' AND /* 确保只包含数字和逗号，没有分号等其他字符 */ wartime RLIKE '^[0-9]+(,[0-9]+)*$' AND /* 确保没有连续逗号（如 "3642,,38060" 这种情况） */ NOT wartime RLIKE ',{2,}' AND /* 确保开头和结尾都是数字 */ wartime RLIKE '^[0-9].*[0-9]$' AND /* battle_time验证 */ NOT battle_time IS NULL AND battle_time > 0 GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, battleid, logymd) AS b ON a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.battleid = b.battleid JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, MAX(dragon) AS dragon, MAX(tortoise) AS tortoise, MAX(skill_hero_m) AS skill_hero_m FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_playerability WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid) AS m ON a.zoneid = m.zoneid AND a.accountid = m.accountid AND a.battleid = m.battleid JOIN (SELECT battle_id, zone_id, role_id, grade_type, is_surrender, black_comb, role_like_cnt, IF(camp = 1, imbalance_v1, -imbalance_v1) AS imbalance FROM mt_dm.dm_ai_feature_mlbb_role_battle_end_action_hi WHERE pvp_type IN (1, 2) AND is_ai = 0 AND p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY battle_id, zone_id, role_id, grade_type, is_surrender, black_comb, role_like_cnt, IF(camp = 1, imbalance_v1, -imbalance_v1)) AS c ON a.zoneid = c.zone_id AND a.accountid = c.role_id AND a.battleid = c.battle_id JOIN (SELECT a.battleid, roleid, zoneid, realpower, a.final_camp, MAX(IF(a.final_camp = b.final_camp, avgteampower, NULL)) AS selfteampower, MAX(IF(a.final_camp <> b.final_camp, avgteampower, NULL)) AS oppoteampower FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, realpower, final_camp, logymd FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND success = 1 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000) AS a JOIN (SELECT battleid, final_camp, logymd, AVG(realpower) AS avgteampower FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND success = 1 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY battleid, final_camp, logymd) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.logymd = b.logymd GROUP BY a.battleid, roleid, zoneid, realpower, a.final_camp) AS d ON a.zoneid = d.zoneid AND a.accountid = d.roleid AND a.battleid = d.battleid JOIN (/* --不同对象交叉    */ SELECT a.logymd, a.battleid, roleid, zoneid, SUM(rolenum) AS rolenum, MAX(IF(a.camp = b.camp, avgscore, NULL)) AS selfscore, MAX(IF(a.camp <> b.camp, avgscore, NULL)) AS opposcore, MAX(IF(a.camp = b.camp, avgkda, NULL)) AS selfkda, MAX(IF(a.camp <> b.camp, avgkda, NULL)) AS oppokda FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, camp, logymd FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000) AS a JOIN (SELECT battleid, camp, logymd, AVG(score) AS avgscore, AVG(kda) AS avgkda, SUM(1) AS rolenum FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY battleid, camp, logymd) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.logymd = b.logymd GROUP BY a.logymd, a.battleid, roleid, zoneid) AS dd ON a.zoneid = dd.zoneid AND a.accountid = dd.roleid AND a.battleid = dd.battleid JOIN (SELECT a.logymd, a.battleid, roleid, zoneid, a.camp, MAX(IF(a.real_road = b.real_road AND confictcnt > 1, 1, 0)) AS selfconfi, MAX(IF(a.real_road <> b.real_road AND confictcnt > 1, 1, 0)) AS teamconfi, SUM(hookcnt) - ishook AS ohookcnt, SUM(badcnt) - isbad AS obadcnt FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, camp, logymd, real_road, ishook, IF(killnum < 2 AND assistnum < 2 AND deadnum > 7, 1, 0) AS isbad FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000) AS a JOIN (SELECT battleid, camp, logymd, real_road, SUM(1) AS confictcnt, SUM(ishook) AS hookcnt, SUM(IF(killnum < 2 AND assistnum < 2 AND deadnum > 7, 1, 0)) AS badcnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY battleid, camp, logymd, real_road) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.camp = b.camp GROUP BY a.logymd, a.battleid, roleid, zoneid, a.camp, ishook, isbad) AS e ON a.zoneid = e.zoneid AND a.accountid = e.roleid AND a.battleid = e.battleid JOIN (SELECT logymd, zoneid, accountid, battleid, MAX(deadtime) AS deadtime, MAX(controlrate + slowrate) AS conslow_rate, MAX(tower1time) AS tower1time, MAX(tower2time) AS tower2time, MAX(tower3time) AS tower3time FROM ml_ods.connserver_battle_analysis WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND para1 IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY logymd, zoneid, accountid, battleid) AS h ON a.zoneid = h.zoneid AND a.accountid = h.accountid AND a.battleid = h.battleid JOIN (/* -aiad每个人-局为一行 */ SELECT p_date AS logymd, role_id AS accountid, zone_id AS zoneid, battle_id AS battleid, use_emoji_all, use_signal_all, use_statement_all, respond_signal, quick_dead, double_kill, triple_kill, manic, savage, battery, floor_num, var_ping, move_lag FROM mt_dwd.dwd_ai_feature_mlbb_dwd_warmbattle_battle_end_di WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-30' AND pvp_type IN (1, 2) AND zone_id < 57000 GROUP BY p_date, role_id, zone_id, battle_id, use_emoji_all, use_signal_all, use_statement_all, respond_signal, quick_dead, double_kill, triple_kill, manic, savage, battery, floor_num, var_ping, move_lag) AS k ON a.zoneid = k.zoneid AND a.accountid = k.accountid AND a.battleid = k.battleid JOIN (/* -序列特征和平均特征（Date-2到Date) */ SELECT logymd, zoneid, accountid, battleid, game_type, roadscnt, roadind, CONCAT(grade_type, '_', grade_type1, '_', grade_type2, '_', grade_type3, '_', grade_type4) AS grade_typelist, CONCAT(game_type, '_', game_type1, '_', game_type2, '_', game_type3, '_', game_type4) AS game_typelist, CONCAT(wincamp, '_', wincamp1, '_', wincamp2, '_', wincamp3, '_', wincamp4) AS wincamplist, CONCAT(floorno, '_', floorno1, '_', floorno2, '_', floorno3, '_', floorno4) AS floornolist, CONCAT(scorerank, '_', scorerank1, '_', scorerank2, '_', scorerank3, '_', scorerank4) AS scoreranklist, CONCAT(roadind, '_', roadind1, '_', roadind2, '_', roadind3, '_', roadind4) AS roadindlist, (kda + IF(kda1 > -1, kda, 0) + IF(kda2 > -1, kda2, 0) + IF(kda3 > -1, kda3, 0) + IF(kda4 > -1, kda4, 0)) / (IF(kda > -1, 1, 0) + IF(kda1 > -1, 1, 0) + IF(kda2 > -1, 1, 0) + IF(kda3 > -1, 1, 0) + IF(kda4 > -1, 1, 0)) AS avgkda, (score + score1 + score2 + score3 + score4) / (IF(score > 0, 1, 0) + IF(score1 > 0, 1, 0) + IF(score2 > 0, 1, 0) + IF(score3 > 0, 1, 0) + IF(score4 > 0, 1, 0)) AS avgscore, CONCAT(blacknum, '_', blacknum1, '_', blacknum2, '_', blacknum3, '_', blacknum4) AS blacknumlist, CONCAT(IF(INT(FLOOR(battletime / 480)) >= 3, 3, INT(FLOOR(battletime / 480))), '_', IF(INT(FLOOR(battletime1 / 480)) >= 3, 3, INT(FLOOR(battletime1 / 480))), '_', IF(INT(FLOOR(battletime2 / 480)) >= 3, 3, INT(FLOOR(battletime2 / 480))), '_', IF(INT(FLOOR(battletime3 / 480)) >= 3, 3, INT(FLOOR(battletime3 / 480))), '_', IF(INT(FLOOR(battletime4 / 480)) >= 3, 3, INT(FLOOR(battletime4 / 480)))) AS bttimelist FROM (SELECT logymd, time, zoneid, accountid, battleid, roadscnt, game_type, LAG(game_type, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS game_type1, LAG(game_type, 2, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS game_type2, LAG(game_type, 3, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS game_type3, LAG(game_type, 4, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS game_type4, grade_type, LAG(grade_type, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS grade_type1, LAG(grade_type, 2, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS grade_type2, LAG(grade_type, 3, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS grade_type3, LAG(grade_type, 4, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS grade_type4, wincamp, LAG(wincamp, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS wincamp1, LAG(wincamp, 2, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS wincamp2, LAG(wincamp, 3, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS wincamp3, LAG(wincamp, 4, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS wincamp4, floorno, LAG(floorno, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS floorno1, LAG(floorno, 2, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS floorno2, LAG(floorno, 3, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS floorno3, LAG(floorno, 4, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS floorno4, kda, LAG(kda, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS kda1, LAG(kda, 2, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS kda2, LAG(kda, 3, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS kda3, LAG(kda, 4, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS kda4, score, LAG(score, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS score1, LAG(score, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS score2, LAG(score, 3, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS score3, LAG(score, 4, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS score4, battletime, LAG(battletime, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS battletime1, LAG(battletime, 2, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS battletime2, LAG(battletime, 3, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS battletime3, LAG(battletime, 4, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS battletime4, blacknum, LAG(blacknum, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS blacknum1, LAG(blacknum, 2, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS blacknum2, LAG(blacknum, 3, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS blacknum3, LAG(blacknum, 4, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS blacknum4, roadind, LAG(roadind, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS roadind1, LAG(roadind, 2, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS roadind2, LAG(roadind, 3, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS roadind3, LAG(roadind, 4, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS roadind4, scorerank, LAG(scorerank, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS scorerank1, LAG(scorerank, 2, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS scorerank2, LAG(scorerank, 3, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS scorerank3, LAG(scorerank, 4, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS scorerank4 FROM (SELECT a.*, IF(game_type IN (1, 5), game_type, INT(game_type + IF(wincamp = 1, 0, 5))) AS game_type, grade_type, scorerank, roadscnt, CASE WHEN real_road = firstroad THEN 1 WHEN real_road = secondroad THEN 2 WHEN real_road = thirdroad THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS roadind FROM (SELECT logymd, time, zoneid, accountid, battleid, camp, wincamp, floorno, kda, score, battletime, blacknum, real_road FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-27' AND '2026-05-29' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND battletime > 0) AS a JOIN (SELECT zoneid, accountid, battleid, logymd, MAX(scorerank) AS scorerank FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE battletype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 AND hurtad <= 150000 AND hurtap <= 150000 AND hurtatk <= 150000 AND realinjured <= 250000 AND cureHero <= 150000 AND killnum <= 50 AND dead <= 50 AND assist <= 50 AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-27' AND '2026-05-29' AND LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(wartime, '\\d|,', '')) = 0 GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, battleid, logymd) AS b ON a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.battleid = b.battleid JOIN (SELECT battle_id, game_type FROM ml_temp.dwm_mlbb_battle_game_type_di_yz WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-27' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY battle_id, game_type) AS c ON a.battleid = c.battle_id JOIN (SELECT p_date, battle_id, zone_id, role_id, grade_type FROM mt_dm.dm_ai_feature_mlbb_role_battle_end_action_hi WHERE pvp_type IN (1, 2) AND is_ai = 0 AND p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-27' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY p_date, battle_id, zone_id, role_id, grade_type) AS d ON a.zoneid = d.zone_id AND a.accountid = d.role_id AND a.battleid = d.battle_id JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[4], '_')[1] = 'exp' THEN 1 WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[4], '_')[1] = 'mid' THEN 2 WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[4], '_')[1] = 'roam' THEN 3 WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[4], '_')[1] = 'jungle' THEN 4 WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[4], '_')[1] = 'coin' THEN 5 END AS firstroad, CASE WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[3], '_')[1] = 'exp' THEN 1 WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[3], '_')[1] = 'mid' THEN 2 WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[3], '_')[1] = 'roam' THEN 3 WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[3], '_')[1] = 'jungle' THEN 4 WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[3], '_')[1] = 'coin' THEN 5 END AS secondroad, CASE WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[2], '_')[1] = 'exp' THEN 1 WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[2], '_')[1] = 'mid' THEN 2 WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[2], '_')[1] = 'roam' THEN 3 WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[2], '_')[1] = 'jungle' THEN 4 WHEN SPLIT(roadlist[2], '_')[1] = 'coin' THEN 5 END AS thirdroad, CASE WHEN (SPLIT(roadlist[4], '_')[0] - SPLIT(roadlist[3], '_')[0]) / SPLIT(roadlist[4], '_')[0] > 0.2 OR SPLIT(roadlist[3], '_')[0] = 0 THEN 1 WHEN (SPLIT(roadlist[3], '_')[0] - SPLIT(roadlist[2], '_')[0]) / SPLIT(roadlist[3], '_')[0] > 0.15 OR SPLIT(roadlist[2], '_')[0] = 0 THEN 2 WHEN (SPLIT(roadlist[2], '_')[0] - SPLIT(roadlist[1], '_')[0]) / SPLIT(roadlist[2], '_')[0] > 0.1 OR SPLIT(roadlist[1], '_')[0] = 0 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS roadscnt FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, SORT_ARRAY(ARRAY(CONCAT(LPAD(a.his_exp_road_cnt - COALESCE(b.his_exp_road_cnt, 0), 10, '0'), '_exp'), CONCAT(LPAD(a.his_mid_road_cnt - COALESCE(b.his_mid_road_cnt, 0), 10, '0'), '_mid'), CONCAT(LPAD(a.his_roam_road_cnt - COALESCE(b.his_roam_road_cnt, 0), 10, '0'), '_roam'), CONCAT(LPAD(a.his_jungle_road_cnt - COALESCE(b.his_jungle_road_cnt, 0), 10, '0'), '_jungle'), CONCAT(LPAD(a.his_gold_road_cnt - COALESCE(b.his_gold_road_cnt, 0), 10, '0'), '_coin'))) AS roadlist FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_exp_road_cnt, his_mid_road_cnt, his_roam_road_cnt, his_jungle_road_cnt, his_gold_road_cnt FROM mt_dm.dm_battle_road_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-28') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_exp_road_cnt, his_mid_road_cnt, his_roam_road_cnt, his_jungle_road_cnt, his_gold_road_cnt FROM mt_dm.dm_battle_road_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-04-29') AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) AS a) AS e ON a.zoneid = e.zoneid AND a.accountid = e.roleid) AS t) AS tb) AS l ON a.zoneid = l.zoneid AND a.accountid = l.accountid AND a.battleid = l.battleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, MAX(IF(rtype = 1, 1, 0)) AS isreport, MAX(IF(rtype = 2, 1, 0)) AS isbereport FROM (SELECT logymd, reporterid AS accountid, reporterzone AS zoneid, battleid, 1 AS rtype FROM ml_ods.gameserver_report_player WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' UNION ALL SELECT logymd, bereporterid AS accountid, bereporterzone AS zoneid, battleid, 2 AS rtype FROM ml_ods.gameserver_report_player WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29') AS tb GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid) AS j ON a.zoneid = j.zoneid AND a.accountid = j.accountid AND a.battleid = j.battleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, zoneid, accountid, battleid, MAX(jankper10min) AS jankper10min, MAX(bigjankper10min) AS bigjankper10min FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY logymd, zoneid, accountid, battleid) AS f ON a.zoneid = f.zoneid AND a.accountid = f.accountid AND a.battleid = f.battleid

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: cherylxie@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-03-12 15:00:06.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH base AS (SELECT CASE WHEN country IN ('ID') THEN '印尼' WHEN country IN ('MY') THEN '马来' WHEN country IN ('PH') THEN '菲律宾' WHEN country IN ('CL', 'PE', 'BO', 'AR', 'MX') THEN '拉美五国' WHEN country IN ('BR') THEN '巴西' WHEN country IN ('SA', 'AE', 'KW', 'QA') THEN '中东海湾四国' WHEN country IN ('EG') THEN '埃及' WHEN country IN ('RU') THEN '俄罗斯' WHEN country IN ('UA', 'KZ', 'BY', 'MN', 'UZ', 'KG', 'TJ', 'RU') THEN '俄语区' WHEN country IN ('TR') THEN '土耳其' WHEN country IN ('US') THEN '美国' WHEN country IN ('AU', 'CA', 'IE') THEN '欧洲 T1' WHEN country IN ('AT', 'BE', 'CA', 'CH', 'CY', 'DE', 'DK', 'EE', 'FI', 'FR', 'GB', 'GR', 'IT', 'LU', 'LV', 'MT', 'NL', 'PL', 'SE', 'SK') THEN '欧洲 T2' WHEN country IN ('TH') THEN '泰国' WHEN country IN ('LA') THEN '老挝' WHEN country IN ('ALL') THEN 'ALL' END AS country, SUM(dau) AS dau, p_date FROM adbi.dwm_dau_di WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2026-06-29' GROUP BY CASE WHEN country IN ('ID') THEN '印尼' WHEN country IN ('MY') THEN '马来' WHEN country IN ('PH') THEN '菲律宾' WHEN country IN ('CL', 'PE', 'BO', 'AR', 'MX') THEN '拉美五国' WHEN country IN ('BR') THEN '巴西' WHEN country IN ('SA', 'AE', 'KW', 'QA') THEN '中东海湾四国' WHEN country IN ('EG') THEN '埃及' WHEN country IN ('RU') THEN '俄罗斯' WHEN country IN ('UA', 'KZ', 'BY', 'MN', 'UZ', 'KG', 'TJ', 'RU') THEN '俄语区' WHEN country IN ('TR') THEN '土耳其' WHEN country IN ('US') THEN '美国' WHEN country IN ('AU', 'CA', 'IE') THEN '欧洲 T1' WHEN country IN ('AT', 'BE', 'CA', 'CH', 'CY', 'DE', 'DK', 'EE', 'FI', 'FR', 'GB', 'GR', 'IT', 'LU', 'LV', 'MT', 'NL', 'PL', 'SE', 'SK') THEN '欧洲 T2' WHEN country IN ('TH') THEN '泰国' WHEN country IN ('LA') THEN '老挝' WHEN country IN ('ALL') THEN 'ALL' END, p_date), true_dau AS (SELECT country, dau, p_date FROM base WHERE NOT country IS NULL), pred_dau_v1 AS (/* neuralprophet */ SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_ods_predict_country_dau_df)) WHERE p_date <= '2026-05-30' AND pred_version = 'v3'), pred_dau_v2 AS (/* neuralprophet + 竞品 */ SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_ods_predict_country_dau_df)) WHERE p_date <= '2026-05-30' AND pred_version = 'v4'), pred_dau_v3 AS (/* timesfm */ SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_ods_predict_country_dau_df)) WHERE p_date <= '2026-05-30' AND pred_version = 'v5'), pred_dau_v4 AS (/* timesfm + 树模型 */ SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_ods_predict_country_dau_df)) WHERE p_date <= '2026-05-30' AND pred_version = 'v6'), pred_dau_v5 AS (/* 新Neuralprophet，仅ALL */ SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_ods_predict_country_dau_df)) WHERE p_date <= '2026-05-30' AND pred_version = 'v7'), pred_dau_v6 AS (/* jinrenzhu，仅ALL */ SELECT t1.p_date, t1.pred_date AS data_date, 'ALL' AS country, t1.pred_weekend_sensitivity_dau + t2.pred_remaining_dau + t3.pred_season_sensitivity_dau AS pred_dau FROM (SELECT * FROM mtai.dwd_dau_prediction_holiday_sensitivity_di WHERE p_date >= '2025-01-31') AS t1 JOIN (SELECT * FROM mtai.dwd_dau_prediction_remaining_di WHERE p_date >= '2025-01-31') AS t2 ON t1.p_date = t2.p_date AND t1.pred_date = t2.pred_date JOIN (SELECT * FROM mtai.dwd_dau_prediction_season_sensitivity_di WHERE p_date >= '2025-01-31') AS t3 ON t1.p_date = t3.p_date AND t1.pred_date = t3.pred_date), all_country_data AS (SELECT data_date, country, p_date AS pred_date FROM pred_dau_v1 GROUP BY data_date, country, p_date), pred_dau_v7 AS (/* timesfm + 暴力加权 */ SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_ods_predict_country_dau_df)) WHERE p_date <= '2026-05-30' AND pred_version = 'v8') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.app_predict_country_dau_df PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-30', pred_version = 'prophet') SELECT a.data_date, a.country, a0.dau AS true_dau, COALESCE(b.p_date, c.p_date, d.p_date, e.p_date, f.p_date) AS pred_date, b.pred_dau AS pred_dau_v1, c.pred_dau AS pred_dau_v2, d.pred_dau AS pred_dau_v3, e.pred_dau AS pred_dau_v4, f.pred_dau AS pred_dau_v5, g.pred_dau AS pred_dau_v6, h.pred_dau AS pred_dau_v7 FROM all_country_data AS a LEFT JOIN true_dau AS a0 ON a.data_date = a0.p_Date AND a.country = a0.country LEFT JOIN pred_dau_v1 AS b ON a.data_date = b.data_date AND a.country = b.country AND a.pred_date = b.p_date LEFT JOIN pred_dau_v2 AS c ON a.data_date = c.data_date AND a.country = c.country AND (a.pred_date = c.p_date OR a.pred_date IS NULL) LEFT JOIN pred_dau_v3 AS d ON a.data_date = d.data_date AND a.country = d.country AND (a.pred_date = d.p_date OR a.pred_date IS NULL) LEFT JOIN pred_dau_v4 AS e ON a.data_date = e.data_date AND a.country = e.country AND (a.pred_date = e.p_date OR a.pred_date IS NULL) LEFT JOIN pred_dau_v5 AS f ON a.data_date = f.data_date AND a.country = f.country AND (a.pred_date = f.p_date OR a.pred_date IS NULL) LEFT JOIN pred_dau_v6 AS g ON a.data_date = g.data_date AND a.country = g.country AND (a.pred_date = g.p_date OR a.pred_date IS NULL) LEFT JOIN pred_dau_v7 AS h ON a.data_date sql_units: /* --建表 */ /*    CREATE TABLE ml_temp.leavyliu_social_pair_v1 */ /*     ( */ /*     roleid string comment 'roleid', */ /*     zoneid string comment 'zonied', */ /*     dest_roleid string comment '右端roleid', */ /*     dest_zoneid string comment '右端zonied', */ /*     intimacy bigint comment '亲密度' */ /* ) partitioned by (logymd string) stored as parquet location 's3a://moonton-hadoop/user/leavyliu/leavyliu_social_pair_v1' */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.leavyliu_social_pair_v1 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.dest_roleid, a.dest_zoneid, CAST(COALESCE(intimacy_total, 0) AS BIGINT) AS intimacy_total FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, dest_roleid, dest_zoneid FROM ml_temp.leavyliu_social_friend_pair WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, dest_roleid, dest_zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, dest_roleid, dest_zoneid FROM ml_temp.leavyliu_social_friend_pair WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, dest_roleid, dest_zoneid) AS c ON a.roleid = c.dest_roleid AND a.zoneid = c.dest_zoneid AND a.dest_roleid = c.roleid AND a.dest_zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SPLIT(friend_inti, '[:_]')[0] AS friend_roleid, SPLIT(friend_inti, '[:_]')[1] AS friend_zoneid, SPLIT(friend_inti, ':')[1] AS intimacy_total FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pos_diff, friend_inti FROM mt_dwm.dwm_social_role_zone_df LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(SPLIT(his_last_friend_intimacy_json, ',')) t AS pos_diff, friend_inti WHERE logymd = '{DATE-1}' AND appid = 'mlbb') WHERE SPLIT(friend_inti, '[:_]')[0] > 0) AS d ON a.roleid = d.roleid AND a.zoneid = d.zoneid AND a.dest_roleid = d.friend_roleid AND a.dest_zoneid = d.friend_zoneid WHERE NOT c.roleid IS NULL

sql_units: WITH bind_table AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.channel, a.usercreateymd, a.usercreatetime, a.ip_country, b.cur_country, CASE WHEN NOT b.accountid IS NULL THEN 'bind' ELSE 'unbind' END AS bind_status, b.logymd AS bind_date, CASE WHEN NOT b.accountid IS NULL AND NOT d.roleid IS NULL AND SUBSTRING(d.his_last_active_timemlbb_accountid, 1, 10) >= DATE_ADD(b.logymd, 90 * -1) AND his_last_active_timemlbb_accountid < a.usercreatetime THEN 'mlbb活跃' WHEN NOT b.accountid IS NULL AND NOT d.roleid IS NULL AND SUBSTRING(d.his_last_active_timemlbb_accountid, 1, 10) < DATE_ADD(b.logymd, 90 * -1) AND his_last_active_timemlbb_accountid < a.usercreatetime THEN 'mlbb流失' WHEN NOT b.accountid IS NULL AND d.roleid IS NULL THEN 'mc纯新' END AS new_user_type FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime /* 账号创建时间 */, usercreateymd /* 账号创建年月日 */, os_type /* 操作系统 */, channel /* 渠道 */, os_language /* 操作系统语言 */, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS ip_country FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_create_role /* --新增 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, TIME, accountid, account_name, email, cur_country, cur_deviceid, cur_deviceunique_id, SUBSTRING(account_name, 4, 100) AS mtid FROM mcgg_ods.accountserver_account_bind WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS b ON a.roleid = b.accountid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, mt_id, bind_mt_email FROM mt_dim.dim_third_party_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS c ON b.mtid = c.mt_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, MAX(his_last_active_time) AS his_last_active_timemlbb_accountid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df /* -这张表保留了所有的分区日志 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) <> 21 /* 非MC大区 */ GROUP BY roleid, logymd) AS d ON c.roleid = d.roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.newuser_mpass_bind_and_usertype_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.usercreateymd, a.ip_country, bind_status, new_user_type FROM bind_table AS a GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.usercreateymd, a.ip_country, bind_status, new_user_type

*/, t3.battletime_5v5 /* -最近30天端内5V5战斗时长 */, t4.pvp2_his_last_bigrank /* 历史末次登录大段位5v5 */, t4.pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl /* 历史最高大段位5v5 */, t4.pvp39_his_last_bigrank /* 历史末次登录大段位自走棋 */, t4.pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl /* 历史最高大段位自走棋 */, t5.friend_cnt /* -ML端内好友数 */, CASE WHEN user_type <> 'ML活跃' THEN user_type WHEN user_type = 'ML活跃' AND bat_cnt_mc IS NULL AND bat_cnt_5v5 IS NULL THEN 'MC=0%&ML=0%' WHEN user_type = 'ML活跃' AND bat_cnt_mc IS NULL AND NOT bat_cnt_5v5 IS NULL THEN 'MC=0%&ML>0%' WHEN user_type = 'ML活跃' AND NOT bat_cnt_mc IS NULL AND bat_cnt_5v5 IS NULL THEN 'MC>=80%' NOT bat_cnt_mc IS NULL AND NOT bat_cnt_5v5 IS NULL AND battletime_mc / (battletime_mc + battletime_5v5) < 0.5 THEN 'MC(0,50%)' END AS user_mc_type FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_adidinfo_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS bat_cnt_mc, SUM(battletime) AS t3.zoneid LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN his_last_bigrank ELSE 0 END) AS pvp2_his_last_bigrank /* 历史末次登录大段位5v5 */, MAX(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN his_max_bigranklvl ELSE 0 END) AS pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl /* 历史最高大段位5v5 */, MAX(CASE WHEN pvptype = 39 THEN his_last_bigrank ELSE 0 END) AS pvp39_his_last_bigrank /* 历史末次登录大段位自走棋 */, MAX(CASE WHEN pvptype = 39 THEN his_max_bigranklvl ELSE 0 END) AS pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl /* 历史最高大段位自走棋 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_gameplay_battle_rank_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (2, 39) GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS t4 ON t1.ml_roleid = t4.roleid AND t1.ml_zoneid = t4.zoneid LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend_cnt FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, friend_cnt) AS t5 ON t1.ml_roleid = t5.roleid AND t1.ml_zoneid = t5.zoneid

name: adbi.dwm_msdk_iaa_user_revenue_df
sql_units: /* 备注：表粒度解释。 */ /* 前提：只关注user_id和device_id，后面的key暂时置为null */ /* 释义：如果数据上报用户，则粒度为用户粒度，device-id为该用户首次归因设备。如果数据未上报用户，则粒度为设备粒度，此时忽略user-id */ /* 原因：iaa数据会存在y游戏无需账号，x游戏需要账号情况。所以将两张情况做成一张表，也可以拆分为两表 */ WITH log_di_ios AS (SELECT app_id, app_name, 'ios' AS os_name, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(report_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS report_date, '' AS placement_name, IF(TRIM(idfa) = '', NULL, TRIM(idfa)) AS idfa, IF(TRIM(idfa_encrypted) = '', NULL, TRIM(idfa_encrypted)) AS idfa_encrypted, IF(TRIM(idfv) = '', NULL, TRIM(idfv)) AS idfv, IF(TRIM(idfv_encrypted) = '', NULL, TRIM(idfv_encrypted)) AS idfv_encrypted, BIGINT(COALESCE(impression, '0')) AS impression, BIGINT(COALESCE(click, '0')) AS click, ROUND(COALESCE(revenue * 100, 0), 4) AS revenue, IF(TRIM(user_id) = '', NULL, TRIM(user_id)) AS user_id, '' AS network_firm, '' AS area FROM adbi.dwa_admkt_topon_ios_device_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND COALESCE(report_date, '1900-01-01') <= '20260530' AND (app_id <> '4001' OR COALESCE(report_date, '1900-01-01') >= '20240825')), log_di_and /* ; */ /* topon 原始数据 */ AS (SELECT app_id, app_name, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(report_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS report_date, 'android' AS os_name, '' AS placement_name, IF(TRIM(android_id) = '', NULL, TRIM(android_id)) AS android_id, IF(TRIM(android_id_encrypted) = '', NULL, TRIM(android_id_encrypted)) AS android_id_encrypted, IF(TRIM(gaid) = '', NULL, TRIM(gaid)) AS gaid, IF(TRIM(gaid_encrypted) = '', NULL, TRIM(gaid_encrypted)) AS gaid_encrypted, BIGINT(COALESCE(impression, '0')) AS impression, BIGINT(COALESCE(click, '0')) AS click, ROUND(COALESCE(revenue * 100, 0), 4) AS revenue, IF(TRIM(user_id) = '', NULL, TRIM(user_id)) AS user_id, NULL AS network_firm, NULL AS area FROM adbi.dwa_admkt_topon_android_device_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND COALESCE(report_date, '1900-01-01') <= '20260530' AND (app_id <> '4001' OR COALESCE(report_date, '1900-01-01') >= '20240825')), dev_df AS (SELECT TRIM(did) AS device_id, app_id, createdate AS create_time, os, TRIM(idfa) AS idfa, TRIM(idfv) AS idfv, TRIM(gps_adid) AS gps_adid, TRIM(android_id) AS android_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(msdk_dim_dim_basic_device_df)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND createdate >= '2019-01-01'), create_device /* 注册设备信息，通过安卓、ios设备id 归因到首次 */ AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s1.device_id, s1.android_id, s1.gps_adid, 'unknown' AS idfa, 'unknown' AS idfv, s1.app_id, s1.create_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s1.app_id, s1.android_id_ra ORDER BY create_time, s1.device_id) AS and_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s1.app_id, s1.gps_adid_ra ORDER BY create_time, s1.device_id) AS gaid_rn, 0 AS idfv_rn, 0 AS idfa_rn FROM (SELECT device_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(android_id), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 10000) AS STRING), TRIM(android_id)) AS android_id_ra, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(gps_adid), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 10000) AS STRING), TRIM(gps_adid)) AS gps_adid_ra, android_id, gps_adid, create_time, app_id FROM dev_df WHERE os = 'android') AS s1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT android_id, app_id FROM log_di_and WHERE NOT android_id IS NULL GROUP BY android_id, app_id) AS s2 ON s1.android_id = s2.android_id AND s1.app_id = s2.app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT android_id_encrypted, app_id FROM log_di_and WHERE NOT android_id_encrypted IS NULL GROUP BY android_id_encrypted, app_id) AS s22 ON s1.android_id = s22.android_id_encrypted AND s1.app_id = s22.app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT gaid, app_id FROM log_di_and WHERE NOT gaid IS NULL GROUP BY gaid, app_id) AS s3 ON s1.gps_adid = s3.gaid AND s1.app_id = s3.app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT gaid_encrypted, app_id FROM log_di_and WHERE NOT gaid_encrypted IS NULL GROUP BY gaid_encrypted, app_id) AS s33 ON s1.gps_adid = s33.gaid_encrypted AND s1.app_id = s33.app_id WHERE NOT s2.android_id IS NULL OR NOT s22.android_id_encrypted IS NULL OR NOT s3.gaid IS NULL OR NOT s33.gaid_encrypted IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT s1.device_id, 'unknown' AS android_id, 'unknown' AS gps_adid, s1.idfa, s1.idfv, s1.app_id, create_time, 0 AS and_rn, 0 AS gaid_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s1.app_id, s1.idfv_ra ORDER BY create_time, s1.device_id) AS idfv_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s1.app_id, s1.idfa_ra ORDER BY create_time, s1.device_id) AS idfa_rn FROM (SELECT device_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(idfa), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 10000) AS STRING), TRIM(idfa)) AS idfa_ra, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(idfv), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 10000) AS STRING), TRIM(idfv)) AS idfv_ra, TRIM(idfa) AS idfa, TRIM(idfv) AS idfv, create_time, app_id FROM dev_df WHERE os = 'ios') AS s1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT idfv, app_id FROM log_di_ios WHERE NOT idfv IS NULL GROUP BY idfv, app_id) AS s4 ON s1.idfv = s4.idfv AND s1.app_id = s4.app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT idfv_encrypted, app_id FROM log_di_ios WHERE NOT idfv_encrypted IS NULL GROUP BY idfv_encrypted, app_id) AS s44 ON s1.idfv = s44.idfv_encrypted AND s1.app_id = s44.app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT idfa, app_id FROM log_di_ios WHERE NOT idfa IS NULL GROUP BY idfa, app_id) AS s5 ON s1.idfa = s5.idfa AND s1.app_id = s5.app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT idfa_encrypted, app_id FROM log_di_ios WHERE NOT idfa_encrypted IS NULL GROUP BY idfa_encrypted, app_id) AS s55 ON s1.idfa = s55.idfa_encrypted AND s1.app_id = s55.app_id WHERE NOT s4.idfv IS NULL OR NOT s44.idfv_encrypted IS report_date), w5_cumulative AS (SELECT app_id, is_user, key_id, device_id, report_date, impression, click, revenue, SUM(impression) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id ORDER BY report_date ROWS OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id ORDER BY report_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS revenue_info_str, LEAD(report_date, 1, DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 1)) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id ORDER BY report_date) AS next_report_date FROM w5_agg), agg_df_w5 AS (SELECT app_id, is_user, key_id, MAX(device_id) AS device_id, MIN(report_date) AS his_first_revenue_date, MAX(report_date) AS his_last_revenue_date, MAX(IF(report_date >= '2026-05-30', NULL, report_date)) AS his_before_last_revenue_date, CAST(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(report_date, '@', impression_info_str, REPEAT(CONCAT(',', impression_info_str), DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(next_report_date, 1 * -1), report_date)))), TRUE)), '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}@', ''), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS impression_info_str, FIRST_VALUE(total_impression) AS total_impression, CAST(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(report_date, '@', click_info_str, REPEAT(CONCAT(',', click_info_str), DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(next_report_date, 1 * -1), report_date)))), TRUE)), '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}@', ''), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS click_info_str, FIRST_VALUE(total_click) AS total_click, SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(report_date, '@', FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', revenue_info_str, CAST(FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', SUM(revenue)) AS DOUBLE) AS total_revenue, '2026-05-30' AS p_date FROM w5_cumulative GROUP BY app_id, is_user, key_id), res_w5 AS (SELECT app_id, is_user, '[10,14]' WHEN age_da <= 19 THEN '[15,19]' WHEN age_da <= 24 THEN '[20,24]' WHEN age_da <= 29 THEN '[25,29]' WHEN age_da <= 34 THEN '[30,34]' ELSE '[35,+∞)' END AS age, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ('女', '男')) WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_cockpit_game_userlabel_stats_df)) SELECT data_date, MAPPING('week_1st_day', 'Mon', data_date) AS data_week, SUBSTRING(data_date, 1, 7) AS data_month, SUBSTRING(data_date, 1, 4) AS data_year, NULL AS region, country, '1' AS is_gt1, gender, age, did_active_user FROM (SELECT loss_did_arr['0'] AS data_date, country, gender, age, loss_did_arr['1'] AS did_active_user FROM (SELECT country, gender, age, EXPLODE(ARRAYS_ZIP(CAST(date_seq AS ARRAY<STRING>), CAST(active_info AS ARRAY<BIGINT>))) AS loss_did_arr FROM (SELECT country, gender, age, SLICE(ARRAY_MERGE(active_info), 1, DATEDIFF('${p_date}', '${init_date}') + 1) AS active_info, ARRAY_DATE(GREATEST(MIN(create_date), '${init_date}'), '${p_date}', TRUE) AS date_seq FROM (SELECT LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(last_ad_country), '') = '', 'unknown', last_ad_country)) AS country, role_register_date AS create_date, CAST(ARRAY_ACTIVE(active_info) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS active_info, role_register_date) + 1) <= LENGTH(TRIM(active_info)) AND SUBSTRING(TRIM(active_info), 1, DATEDIFF('${p_date}', '${init_date}') + 1) LIKE '%1%') AS a JOIN user_feature_df AS b ON a.accountid = sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_exp_huiliu_result PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-30') SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid FROM (SELECT t3.roleid, t4.push_id, 999999 AS task_id, t3.push_time, t3.push_type, t3.vid FROM (SELECT *, 1 AS join_id FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_exp_user_tag_rand_hour_group_fix /* 更新为固定分流表，更新之前用的这个分流表 mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_exp_user_tag_rand_hour_group */ WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30') AS t3 JOIN (SELECT push_id, title, content, begin_time, end_time, act_id, 1 AS join_id /* FROM    mt_ai.mlbb_ai_push_material_online */ /* WHERE   logymd = '2025-04-19' and begin_time <= '2026-06-02' and end_time >= '2026-06-02' */ /* 修改：切换例行素材维护任务 */ FROM mt_ai.mlbb_ai_push_material_online_ivker WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND /* ml素材 */ material_type > 0 AND /* and not ( */ /*     push_id >= 111 and push_id <= 116 */ /* ) */ NOT act_id IS NULL AND begin_time <= '2026-06-02' AND end_time >= '2026-06-02') AS t4 ON t3.join_id = t4.join_id)
