sql_units: /* 时间分区需要前未来+3天，保证数据提前产生，运营侧当天加载当天的数据，例如：20241107零点就会去加载时间分区p_date='2024-11-7'的数据，同时我这边用login表中的zone_id控制，每次推哪几个区服 */ /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_exp_huiliu_update_count_formal_result */ /* PARTITION (p_date = '2026-06-02') */ WITH form_result_old AS (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.push_id, t1.task_id, t1.push_time, t1.push_type, t1.vid FROM (SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid FROM (SELECT roleid /* push_time也要同步向未来+3天，因为父任务已经做了+1天操作，这边只需+2，对用秒数172800，就会按push_time对应时间进行推送 */, push_id, task_id, push_time + 172800 AS push_time, push_type, vid FROM (SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY push_time, rand_num) AS rn FROM (SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid, RAND() AS rand_num FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_exp_huiliu_result WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND vid <> 11 AND vid <> 14 AND vid <> 12)) WHERE rn <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT roleid /* push_time也要同步向未来+3天，因为父任务已经做了+1天操作，这边只需+2，对用秒数172800，就会按push_time对应时间进行推送 */, push_id, task_id, push_time + 172800 AS push_time, push_type, vid FROM (SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY push_time, rand_num) AS rn FROM (SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid, RAND() AS rand_num FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_exp_huiliu_result WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND (vid = 11 OR vid = 14 OR vid = 12))) WHERE rn <= 1)) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT t3.roleid FROM (SELECT roleid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-15' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND /* AND     ((zoneid >= 59000 AND zoneid <= 59999) OR (zoneid >= 57000 AND zoneid <= 57999)) */ /* AND     ((zoneid >= 57000 AND zoneid <= 57999)) */ /* 取不在范围内的zoneid的值，保证正式服上线之前分区为空，不推送 */ /* AND     zoneid = -1 */ /* 此处限流有分组不均匀分线，后续限流在分组时一起确定 */ roleid % 9 IN (0, 1, 2, 3) AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 GROUP BY roleid) AS t3 JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM (SELECT roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT zoneid) AS count_zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2026-04-30' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' /* AND     ((zoneid >= 59000 AND zoneid <= 59999) OR (zoneid >= 57000 AND zoneid <= 57999)) */ GROUP BY roleid) /* 保证测服测试的时候不知有测服账号的roleid不会触达 */ WHERE count_zoneid = 1) AS t4 ON t3.roleid = t4.roleid) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_exp_huiliu_update_count_formal_result PARTITION(p_date = '2026-06-02') SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, new_push_time AS push_time, push_type, vid, mc_material FROM (SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, COALESCE(IF((time_match18 > 0 OR DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(top8_rand_hour * 3600 + 86400 * (FLOOR(push_time / 86400) + 1) - 8 * 3600), 'yyyy-MM-dd') <> '2026-06-02' OR /* update: 0521, vid=12,14 不覆盖推送时间变化 */ /* update: 去除v12 */ vid IN (14) OR /* 12 分两部分 */ /* 一半用户做过滤体验  (roleid % 9 in 2, 3) */ /* 一半用户不做过滤体验 (roleid % 9 in 0, 1) */ /* vid=12 mod%100 = 25 - 49 */ /* 当前mod/9 = (0,1,2,3) */ (vid = 12 AND (roleid % 9 IN (0, 1))) OR (vid = 11 AND (roleid % 9 IN (0, 1)))), push_time, top8_rand_hour * 3600 + 86400 * (FLOOR(push_time / 86400) + 1)), push_time) AS new_push_time /* part two：控体验 */ /* seconds_in_a_day = 86400 */ /* seconds_in_an_hour = 3600 */ /* # 首先将时间戳对一天的秒数取模，然后除以一小时的秒数 */ /* hour = (timestamp % seconds_in_a_day) // seconds_in_an_hour */ /* k_fold = timestamp // seconds_in_a_day */ /* timestamp = hour * seconds_in_an_hour + seconds_in_a_day * k_fold */ /* 【form】timestamp = hour * seconds_in_an_hour + seconds_in_a_day * (timestamp // seconds_in_a_day) */ /* if(time_match18 > 0, push_time,  top8_rand_hour * 3600 + 86400 * (floor(push_time / 86400)) ) as new_push_time, */, push_type, vid, top1hour, top8_rand_hour, time_match18, mc_material FROM (SELECT mat.roleid, mat.push_id, mat.task_id, mat.push_time, mat.push_type, mat.vid, mat.mc_material, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(activate_hh.hhrnk_map_str, ',', ':')[1] AS BIGINT) AS top1hour, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(activate_hh.hhrnk_map_str, ',', ':')[(FLOOR(RAND() * 8) + 1)] AS BIGINT) AS top8_rand_hour, IF(userinfo.create_role_ip_country IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MY', 'MM', 'KH', 'TH', 'SG', 'LA'), 1, 0) AS ctry_match, IF(((userinfo.create_role_ip_country IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MY', 'MM', 'KH', 'TH', 'SG', 'LA') AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(activate_hh.hhlist, CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(push_time) AS STRING), 12, 2) AS BIGINT) + 1)) OR (NOT userinfo.create_role_ip_country IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MY', 'MM', 'KH', 'TH', 'SG', 'LA'))), 1, 0) AS time_match, IF(((userinfo.create_role_ip_country IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MY', 'MM', 'KH', 'TH', 'SG', 'LA') AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(activate_hh.hhlist18, CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(push_time) AS STRING), 12, 2) AS BIGINT) + 1)) OR (NOT userinfo.create_role_ip_country IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MY', 'MM', 'KH', 'TH', 'SG', 'LA'))), 1, 0) AS time_match18, CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(push_time) AS STRING), 12, 2) AS BIGINT) AS push_hour FROM (SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid, mc_material FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY push_time DESC) AS rnk2 FROM (SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid, mc_material FROM (SELECT a.roleid, COALESCE(IF(a.vid <> 12 OR (NOT push_model_ret.valid_learn), a.push_id, push_model_ret.push_id), a.push_id) AS push_id /* COALESCE(mc_act.push_id, a.push_id) AS push_id, */, a.task_id, COALESCE(IF(a.vid <> 12 OR (NOT push_model_ret.valid_learn), a.push_time, UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-02' || ' ' || push_model_ret.push_hour || ':00-0800', 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mmZ')), a.push_time) AS push_time /* a.push_time, */, a.push_type, a.vid, 0 AS mc_material /* IF(mc_act.ml_roleid IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS mc_material, */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.push_id ORDER BY a.push_time DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT roleid /* * */ /* 0630 update: vid=14分两半，一半1-24随机选取一个小时推送，一半全部放在0点推送 */, push_id, task_id, IF((vid = 14 AND roleid % 9 IN (2, 3)), UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-02' || ' ' || CAST(FLOOR(RAND() * 24) AS INT) || ':00-0800', 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mmZ'), push_time) AS push_time, push_type, vid FROM form_result_old) AS a /* LEFT JOIN */ /* mc push素材投放 */ /*         ( */ /*             SELECT  * */ /*             FROM    mt_ai.mcgg_traffic_share_user_group_match_material */ /*             WHERE   p_date = '2026-05-30' */ /*         ) mc_act */ /* ON      a.roleid = mc_act.ml_roleid */ /* 个性化结果：分组为12 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT reta.roleid, reta.push_id, reta.push_hour, valid_learn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reta.roleid ORDER BY reta.probs DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT * FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_mt_model_infer_ret WHERE p_date = '2026-06-02') AS reta LEFT JOIN (/* 原则上： */ /* 当前素材要已经进入push业务中了 */ /* 目前的训练逻辑是一直用到t-12的样本，除去三天的delta */ /* 策略： */ /* 1. 素材开始的投放时间，应该大于当前时间7天前（未命中为随机素材择时） */ SELECT push_id, title, content, begin_time, end_time, act_id, begin_time <= '2026-05-28' AS valid_learn FROM mt_ai.mlbb_ai_push_material_online_ivker WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND /* ml素材 */ material_type > 0 AND NOT act_id IS NULL AND begin_time <= '2026-06-02' AND /* and begin_time >= '2026-05-25' */ end_time >= '2026-06-02') AS matb ON reta.push_id = matb.push_id) AS push_model_ret ON push_model_ret.rnk = 1 AND push_model_ret.roleid = a.roleid) /* 一人一素材推一次 */ WHERE rnk <= 1)) /* 一人最多两次 */ WHERE rnk2 <= 2 /* group by vid, push_id, mc_material */ GROUP BY roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid, mc_material) AS mat LEFT JOIN (/* SELECT  roleid, */ /*         ucase(MAX(createrole_country)) AS create_role_ip_country */ /* FROM    ml_ods.gameserver_login */ /* WHERE   logymd >= '2026-05-23' */ /* AND     logymd <= '2026-05-30' */ /* GROUP BY */ /*         roleid */ SELECT roleid, UPPER(MAX(create_country)) AS create_role_ip_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' GROUP BY roleid) AS userinfo ON mat.roleid = userinfo.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT createrole_country, COLLECT_SET(hh) AS hhlist, COLLECT_SET(hh * IF(rnk <= 18, 1, 0)) AS hhlist18, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(CAST(rnk AS STRING), ':', CAST(hh AS STRING)))) AS hhrnk_map_str FROM (SELECT createrole_country, IF(createrole_country IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MY', 'MM', 'KH', 'TH', 'SG', 'LA'), 1, 0) AS if_tgt_ctry, hh, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY createrole_country ORDER BY records DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT UPPER(createrole_country) AS createrole_country, CAST(HOUR(TIME) AS BIGINT) AS hh, COUNT(1) AS records FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-23' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY UPPER(createrole_country), CAST(HOUR(TIME) AS BIGINT))) GROUP BY createrole_country) AS activate_hh ON userinfo.create_role_ip_country = activate_hh.createrole_country)) WHERE NOT roleid IS NULL AND NOT new_push_time IS NULL AND NOT vid IS NULL AND NOT push_id IS NULL AND NOT task_id IS NULL GROUP BY roleid, push_id, task_id, new_push_time, push_type, vid, mc_material

WITH adid_to_did AS (SELECT a.adid, a.did FROM (/* --全量设备的各类id 与 did 映射关系 */ SELECT ad_id AS adid, did FROM adbi.dim_device_to_did_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND app_id = 1001 AND NOT ad_id IS NULL AND ad_id <> 'none' AND ad_id <> '' AND ad_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND ad_id <> '0000-0000' GROUP BY ad_id, did) AS a JOIN (/* --全量设备的各类id 与 did 映射关系 */ SELECT ad_id AS adid, COUNT(DISTINCT did) AS did_cnt FROM adbi.dim_device_to_did_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND app_id = 1001 AND NOT ad_id IS NULL AND ad_id <> 'none' AND ad_id <> '' AND ad_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND ad_id <> '0000-0000' GROUP BY ad_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT did) <= 20) AS b ON a.adid = b.adid), idfv_to_did AS (/* --全量设备的各类id 与 did 映射关系 */ SELECT a.idfv, a.did FROM (/* --全量设备的各类id 与 did 映射关系 */ SELECT idfv, did FROM adbi.dim_device_to_did_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND app_id = 1001 AND NOT idfv IS NULL AND idfv <> 'none' AND idfv <> '' AND idfv <> '0' GROUP BY idfv, did) AS a JOIN (/* --全量设备的各类id 与 did 映射关系 */ SELECT idfv, COUNT(DISTINCT did) AS did_cnt FROM adbi.dim_device_to_did_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND app_id = 1001 AND NOT idfv IS NULL AND idfv <> 'none' AND idfv <> '' AND idfv <> '0' GROUP BY idfv HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT did) <= 20) AS b ON a.idfv = b.idfv) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.yfq_device_to_last_did_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT device_id, os_type, first_adid, last_adid, first_idfv, last_idfv, first_did, last_did FROM (SELECT t1.device_id, t1.os_type, t1.first_adid, t1.last_adid, NULL AS first_idfv, NULL AS last_idfv, NULL AS first_did, t3.did AS last_did FROM (SELECT device_id, first_adid, last_adid, first_idfv, last_idfv, os_type FROM ml_temp.yfq_device_to_adid_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND (NOT first_adid IS NULL OR NOT last_adid IS NULL)) AS t1 /* left join  
        adid_to_did t2 
    on t1.first_adid = t2.adid */ LEFT JOIN adid_to_did AS t3 ON t1.last_adid = t3.adid GROUP BY t1.device_id, t1.os_type, t1.first_adid, t1.last_adid, t3.did UNION ALL SELECT t1.device_id, t1.os_type, NULL AS first_adid, NULL AS last_adid, t1.first_idfv, t1.last_idfv, NULL AS first_did, t3.did AS last_did FROM (SELECT device_id, first_adid, last_adid, first_idfv, last_idfv, os_type FROM ml_temp.yfq_device_to_adid_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND (NOT first_idfv IS NULL OR NOT last_idfv IS NULL)) AS t1 /* left join  
        idfv_to_did t2 
    on t1.first_idfv = t2.idfv */ LEFT JOIN idfv_to_did AS t3 ON t1.last_idfv = t3.idfv GROUP BY t1.device_id, t1.os_type, t1.first_idfv, t1.last_idfv, t3.did) AS a GROUP BY device_id, os_type, first_adid, last_adid, first_idfv, last_idfv, first_did, last_did

name: MC2赛季每日不掉星比例
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_sjlv@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-04-14 12:17:00.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* -赛季分日，不掉星的人次、比例、平均掉星 */ /* 拆分大区、create_country、段位（old_rank） */ WITH current_season AS (SELECT seasonid AS season_id, seasonstartymd AS season_start, seasonendymd AS season_end FROM mcgg_temp.selinasun_mcrankseason_larksheet_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-30' BETWEEN seasonstartymd AND seasonendymd), battle_detail AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, a.battleid, a.if_win, new_rank_id, old_rank_id, new_cupnum, old_cupnum, protect_item FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, CASE WHEN camprank BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_win FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND pvptype IN (39) AND /* and camprank between 5 and 8 */ fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1) AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, battleid, new_rank_id, old_rank_id, new_cupnum, old_cupnum, protect_item FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_magicchess_rank_level WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND reason IN ('battle') AND season_id IN (SELECT season_id FROM current_season)) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, a.battleid, a.if_win, new_rank_id, old_rank_id, new_cupnum, old_cupnum, protect_item UNION ALL SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, a.battleid, a.if_win, new_rank_id, old_rank_id, new_cupnum, old_cupnum, protect_item FROM (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid, t1.pvptype, CASE WHEN t2.team_rank IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_win FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, SPLIT(team_info_tagteam, ',')[0] AS team_id FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND pvptype IN (301) AND ailevel = 0 AND ai_accountid = accountid) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT battleid, SPLIT(team_info_tagteam, ',')[0] AS team_id, MAX(CASE WHEN SPLIT(team_info_tagteam, ',')[1] = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SPLIT(team_info_tagteam, ',')[1] END) AS team_rank FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND pvptype IN (301) AND ailevel = 0 AND ai_accountid = accountid GROUP BY battleid, SPLIT(team_info_tagteam, ',')[0]) AS t2 ON t1.team_id = t2.team_id AND t1.battleid = t2.battleid) AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, battleid, new_rank_id, old_rank_id, new_cupnum, old_cupnum, protect_item FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_duoplayer_rank_level WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND reason IN ('battle') AND season_id IN (SELECT season_id FROM current_season)) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, a.battleid, a.if_win, new_rank_id, old_rank_id, new_cupnum, old_cupnum, protect_item) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_daily_battle_result_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) AS zone, b.create_country, b.user_tag_active, b.season_id, b.season_start, b.season_end, b.season_day, a.pvptype, CASE WHEN a.old_rank_id <= 2 THEN '勇士' WHEN a.old_rank_id <= 5 THEN '精英' WHEN a.old_rank_id <= 9 THEN '大师' WHEN a.old_rank_id <= 16 THEN '宗师' WHEN a.old_rank_id <= 25 THEN '史诗' WHEN a.old_rank_id <= 35 THEN '传奇' WHEN a.old_rank_id = 36 THEN '神话' WHEN a.old_rank_id = 37 THEN '百战神话' WHEN a.old_rank_id = 38 THEN '荣耀神话' ELSE a.old_rank_id END AS old_rank, b.if_new, COUNT(*) AS bat_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid)) AS bat_user, COUNT(IF(if_win = 0, 1, NULL)) AS lose_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(if_win = 0, CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid), NULL)) AS lose_user, SUM(IF(if_win = 0, old_cupnum - new_cupnum, 0)) AS lose_star, COUNT(IF(if_win = 0 AND a.new_cupnum = a.old_cupnum, 1, NULL)) AS star_equal_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(if_win = 0 AND a.new_cupnum = a.old_cupnum, CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid), NULL)) AS star_equal_user FROM battle_detail AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_country, user_tag_active, CASE WHEN usercreateymd BETWEEN season_start AND season_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_new, season_id, season_start, season_end, sesaon_day AS season_day FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_season_user_battle_summary_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mcgg_temp.kyra_black_role_df AS h2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND a.roleid = h2.roleid AND a.zoneid = h2.zoneid) GROUP BY FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000), b.create_country, b.user_tag_active, b.season_id, b.season_start, b.season_end, b.season_day, b.if_new, a.pvptype, CASE WHEN a.old_rank_id <= 2 THEN '勇士' WHEN a.old_rank_id <= 5 THEN '精英' WHEN a.old_rank_id <= 9 THEN '大师' WHEN a.old_rank_id <= 16 THEN '宗师' WHEN a.old_rank_id <= 25 THEN '史诗' WHEN a.old_rank_id <= 35 THEN '传奇' WHEN a.old_rank_id = 36 THEN '神话' WHEN a.old_rank_id = 37 THEN '百战神话' WHEN a.old_rank_id = 38 THEN '荣耀神话' ELSE a.old_rank_id END

name: MLMC双端周活跃did三周流转
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_sjlv@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-03-13 14:15:57.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* 更新三周的数据，因此需要拆分两个步骤，1）更新上上周的第三周流转；2）更新上周的第二周流转。 */ /* 因此需要更新两个真实partition，并插入当日的任务执行partition */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* -处理上上周的三周流转（要把次周流转和三周流转都计算一遍） */ WITH ml_week1 AS (/* ---取ML日活did及其标签 */ SELECT did, MIN(IF(user_tag IS NULL, '其他', user_tag)) AS user_tag, MAX(IF(country IS NULL, 'unknown', country)) AS country FROM ml_temp.sjlyu_moba_did_login_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-30', 'MO'), 21 * -1) AND DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-30', 'MO'), 15 * -1) /* 上上周一到上上周日 */ GROUP BY did), mc_week1 AS (SELECT a.did, MAX(b.first_mt_country) AS country, MIN(c.user_type) AS user_tag FROM (SELECT did FROM (SELECT CONCAT(SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(logymd, 5, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(logymd, 7, sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_sjlv@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-03-14 16:23:06.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH current_season AS (/* 获取统计日所在的赛季开始时间和结束时间 */ SELECT seasonid AS season_id, seasonstartymd AS start_date, seasonendymd AS end_date FROM mcgg_temp.selinasun_mcrankseason_larksheet_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-30' BETWEEN seasonstartymd AND seasonendymd), ml_active AS (SELECT b.season_id, b.start_date, b.end_date, did, MAX(country) AS ml_country, MIN(IF(user_tag IS NULL, '其他', user_tag)) AS user_tag /* -取本赛季tag---不确定是否能执行，到了赛季末的时候数据量会过大，先执行看看不行再改df表的方式 */ FROM (SELECT 1 AS tmp, did, logymd, country, user_tag FROM ml_temp.sjlyu_moba_did_login_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-19' AND '2026-05-30') AS a JOIN (SELECT 1 AS tmp, season_id, start_date, end_date FROM current_season) AS b ON a.logymd >= b.start_date AND a.logymd <= b.end_date AND a.tmp = b.tmp GROUP BY b.season_id, b.start_date, b.end_date, did), mc_active AS (SELECT a.season_id, a.start_date, a.end_date, a.did, MAX(b.first_mt_country) AS mc_country, MIN(c.user_type) AS user_tag FROM (SELECT a.did, b.season_id, b.start_date, b.end_date FROM (SELECT CONCAT(SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(logymd, 5, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(logymd, 7, 2)) AS logymd, did, 1 AS tmp FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE logymd BETWEEN '20260219' AND '20260530' AND event = 'login' AND app_id = 4280 AND zone_id BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY logymd, did) AS a JOIN (SELECT 1 AS tmp, season_id, start_date, end_date FROM current_season) AS b ON a.logymd >= b.start_date AND a.logymd <= b.end_date AND a.tmp = b.tmp GROUP BY a.did, b.season_id, b.start_date, b.end_date) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT did, first_mt_country FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND app_id = 4280 GROUP BY did, first_mt_country) AS b ON a.did = b.did LEFT JOIN (SELECT did, user_type FROM ml_temp.kyra_mlbb_role_did_mc_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS c ON a.did = c.did GROUP BY a.season_id, a.start_date, a.end_date, a.did) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_mlmc_season_active_user_di PARTITION(start_date) SELECT COALESCE(a.season_id, b.season_id) AS season_id, COALESCE(a.end_date, b.end_date) AS end_date, COALESCE(b.mc_country, a.ml_country) AS country, COALESCE(a.user_tag, b.user_tag, '6mc纯新') AS user_tag, CASE WHEN NOT a.did IS NULL AND NOT b.did IS NULL THEN 'active_both' WHEN a.did IS NULL AND NOT b.did IS NULL THEN 'active_mc' WHEN NOT a.did IS NULL AND b.did IS NULL THEN 'active_ml' END AS active_type, COALESCE(a.did, b.did) AS did, a.did AS did_ml, b.did AS did_mc, '2026-05-30' AS update_date, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', COALESCE(a.start_date, b.start_date)) + 1 AS day_cnt, COALESCE(a.start_date, b.start_date) AS start_date FROM ml_active AS a FULL OUTER JOIN mc_active AS b ON a.did = b.did AND a.start_date = b.start_date AND a.end_date = b.end_date AND a.season_id = b.season_id

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: vickyyu2@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-03-14 14:28:24.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH new_user AS (/* 30日新增用户 */ SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.channel, t0.ip_country, t0.usercreateymd, t0.user_type_new, t0.pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, t0.last_roleid_num, CASE WHEN LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%facebook%' OR LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%unattributed%' THEN 'facebook' WHEN LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%organic%' THEN 'organic' WHEN LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%tiktok%' THEN 'tiktok' WHEN LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%google ads%' THEN 'google' WHEN LOWER(media_source) IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'others' END AS tp, CASE WHEN LOWER(media_source) IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE media_source END AS media_source, pure_new_type, param_value, param_name FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, channel, LOWER(ip_country) AS ip_country, usercreateymd, CAST(SUBSTRING(roleid, -1) AS STRING) AS last_roleid_num, pure_new_type, CASE WHEN user_type IN ('MC纯新') THEN '6MC纯新' WHEN user_type IN ('ML流失') THEN '5ML流失' WHEN user_type = 'ML活跃' AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 5 AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) >= 0.5 THEN '1MC核心' WHEN user_type = 'ML活跃' AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 0 AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 <= 5 THEN '2MC泛用户' WHEN user_type = 'ML活跃' AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 0 AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) < 0.5 THEN '2MC泛用户' WHEN user_type = 'ML活跃' AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 = 0 AND NOT pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl IS NULL AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl > 0 THEN '3ML活跃非MC-有MC经验' WHEN user_type = 'ML活跃' AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 = 0 AND (pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl IS NULL OR pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl = 0) THEN '4ML活跃非MC-无MC经验' END AS user_type_new, CASE WHEN pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl END AS pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_di AS h1 WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND /* AND     lower(ip_country) IN ('my', 'sg') */ NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mcgg_temp.kyra_black_role_df AS h2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND h1.roleid = h2.roleid AND h1.zoneid = h2.zoneid) GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, channel, ip_country, usercreateymd, user_type_new, pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, pure_new_type) AS t0 LEFT JOIN (/* 取用户归因渠道和国家 */ SELECT account_id, MAX(first_media_source) AS media_source FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND app_id = 4280 AND account_id IN (SELECT roleid FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' /* AND     lower(ip_country) IN ('my', 'sg') */ GROUP BY roleid) GROUP BY account_id) AS t5 ON t0.roleid = t5.account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT usercreateymd, zoneid, roleid, param_value, param_name, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30') AS t6 ON t0.roleid = t6.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t6.zoneid AND t0.usercreateymd = t6.logymd), daily_cnt AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, IF(b.history_cnt IS NULL, 0, b.history_cnt) AS history_cnt /* ---历史已经打了多少场 */, (100 - IF(b.history_cnt IS NULL, 0, b.history_cnt)) AS today_cnt /* ----今日还需要储存的用户的条数 */ FROM new_user AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS history_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-29' AND fake_ai = 0 AND battleid <> 0 AND battle_count >= 1 AND pvptype IN (39, 170) AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) WHERE today_cnt > 0 AND today_cnt <= 100), battle_detail AS (/* -仅抽取用户的当日 */ SELECT t0.logymd, t0.accountid, t0.zoneid, t0.battleid, t0.camprank, t0.minranklvl, (t0.bat_cnt + t1.history_cnt) AS battle_count /* ---属于前100场内的第N场 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, camprank, minranklvl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME ASC) AS bat_cnt /* -当日的第N场 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, camprank, minranklvl, time FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND fake_ai = 0 AND battleid <> 0 AND battle_count >= 1 AND pvptype IN (39, 170) AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' AND EXISTS(SELECT b.accountid, b.zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, zoneid FROM daily_cnt GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b WHERE a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, camprank, minranklvl, time)) AS t0 JOIN daily_cnt AS t1 ON t0.accountid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t0.bat_cnt <= t1.today_cnt WHERE t0.bat_cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND t0.bat_cnt <= t1.today_cnt), hero_info AS (SELECT logymd, zoneid, accountid, battleid, round, enemyaccountid, chessid, battleresult, chessmgdmg, chessprice, ailevel, chessstarlevel FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundheroinfo AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND enemyaccountid <> accountid AND ailevel = 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND accountid = ai_accountid AND EXISTS(SELECT b.roleid AS accountid, b.zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM daily_cnt GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b WHERE a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)), battleend AS (SELECT t1.*, t2.real_person_cnt, t2.matchtime, t0.channel, t0.ip_country, t0.usercreateymd, t0.user_type_new, t0.pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, t0.last_roleid_num, tp, media_source, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', t0.usercreateymd) + 1 AS reg_length, DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, t0.usercreateymd) + 1 AS bat_onwhichday, pure_new_type, param_value, param_name FROM new_user AS t0 JOIN battle_detail AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.accountid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, real_player_num AS real_person_cnt, matchtime FROM mcgg_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, real_player_num, matchtime) AS t2 ON t1.battleid = t2.battleid AND t1.accountid = t2.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid), autochess AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, battle_round /* -羁绊可以补在这里 */, CASE WHEN SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(hotlineup, '\\073')[1], ':')[1], ',')[0], '/')[1] IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(hotlineup, '\\073')[1], ':')[1], ',')[0], '/')[1] END AS top1_rel /* --凑成的最高羁绊数 */, issurrender, lineupnum /* -阵容棋子数 */, CASE WHEN battlerank = 1 THEN SPLIT(SPLIT(roundinformation, '\\073')[battle_round - 2], ',')[1] ELSE NULL END AS blood_lastround /* -战斗结束血量 */ FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' AND ailevel = 0 AND battleid <> 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND EXISTS(SELECT b.accountid, b.zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, zoneid FROM daily_cnt GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b WHERE a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, battle_round, SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(hotlineup, '\\073')[1], ':')[1], ',')[0], '/')[1], issurrender, lineupnum, CASE WHEN battlerank = 1 THEN SPLIT(SPLIT(roundinformation, '\\073')[battle_round - 2], ',')[1] ELSE NULL END), roundinfo_converge AS (SELECT logymd >= '2024-11-28' AND ailevel = 0 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, battleresult) AS t GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid), last_round AS (SELECT t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t2.media_source, t2.reg_length, t2.bat_onwhichday, t3.battle_round, t3.top1_rel /* 可能的羁绊信息 */, t3.issurrender, t3.lineupnum, t3.blood_lastround, t4.win_round, t5.max_chess_star, t5.max_chess_price, name: MLMC双端月活跃did流转
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_sjlv@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-03-19 14:16:43.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* --计算上个月的ML累计去重活跃用户 */ WITH ml_month1 AS (SELECT did, MIN(user_tag) AS user_tag, MAX(country) AS country FROM ml_temp.sjlyu_moba_did_login_di /* --更换这张表为自己的did表 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC(DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', DAYOFMONTH('2026-05-30') * -1), 'MM') AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', DAYOFMONTH('2026-05-30') * -1) /* 上个自然月 */ GROUP BY did), mc_month1 AS (SELECT a.did, MAX(b.first_mt_country) AS country, MIN(c.user_type) AS user_tag FROM (SELECT did FROM (SELECT CONCAT(SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(logymd, 5, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(logymd, 7, 2)) AS logymd, did FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE logymd BETWEEN '20260329' AND '20260530' AND event = 'login' AND app_id = 4280 AND zone_id BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY logymd, did) WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC(DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', DAYOFMONTH('2026-05-30') * -1), 'MM') AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', DAYOFMONTH('2026-05-30') * -1) /* 上个自然月 */ GROUP BY did) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT did, first_mt_country FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_df WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', DAYOFMONTH('2026-05-30') * -1) /* 上个月末 */ AND app_id = 4280) AS b ON a.did = b.did LEFT JOIN (SELECT did, user_type FROM ml_temp.kyra_mlbb_role_did_mc_df WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', DAYOFMONTH('2026-05-30') * -1) /* 上个月末 */) AS c ON a.did = c.did GROUP BY a.did), active_base AS (SELECT COALESCE(a.user_tag, b.user_tag, '6mc纯新') AS user_tag, COALESCE(b.country, a.country) AS country, COALESCE(a.did, b.did) AS did, CASE WHEN NOT a.did IS NULL AND NOT b.did IS NULL THEN 'ML&MC均活跃' WHEN NOT a.did IS NULL AND b.did IS NULL THEN '仅ML活跃' WHEN a.did IS NULL AND NOT b.did IS NULL THEN '仅MC活跃' END AS month1_tag FROM ml_month1 AS a FULL OUTER JOIN mc_month1 AS b ON a.did = b.did GROUP BY COALESCE(a.user_tag, b.user_tag, '6mc纯新'), COALESCE(b.country, a.country), COALESCE(a.did, b.did), CASE WHEN NOT a.did IS NULL AND NOT b.did IS NULL THEN 'ML&MC均活跃' WHEN NOT a.did IS NULL AND b.did IS NULL THEN '仅ML活跃' WHEN a.did IS NULL AND NOT b.did IS NULL THEN '仅MC活跃' END), ml_month2 AS (SELECT did /* --ML活跃did */ FROM ml_temp.sjlyu_moba_did_login_di /* -3月使用平台的表，后续需要切换成自己的did_login表 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC('2026-05-30', 'MM') AND '2026-05-30' /* 本自然月 */ /* and zoneid < 57000 */ GROUP BY did), mc_month2 AS (SELECT did FROM (SELECT CONCAT(SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(logymd, 5, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(logymd, 7, 2)) AS logymd, did FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE logymd BETWEEN '20260428' AND '20260530' AND event = 'login' AND app_id = 4280 AND zone_id BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY logymd, did) WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC('2026-05-30', 'MM') AND '2026-05-30' /* 本自然月 */ GROUP BY did) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_mlmc_monthly_active_retention_di PARTITION(logymd) /* 这个是真正存储数据的分区,处理上月的次月tag */ SELECT t0.country, t0.user_tag, t0.month1_tag, CASE WHEN t1.did IS NULL AND t2.did IS NULL THEN '流失' WHEN NOT t1.did IS NULL AND NOT t2.did IS NULL THEN 'ML&MC均活跃' WHEN t1.did IS NULL AND NOT t2.did IS NULL THEN '仅MC活跃' WHEN NOT t1.did IS NULL AND t2.did IS NULL THEN '仅ML活跃' END AS month2_tag, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.did) AS cnt, '2026-05-30' AS update_date, TRUNC(DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', DAYOFMONTH('2026-05-30') * -1), 'MM') AS logymd /* 活跃日期 */ FROM active_base AS t0 LEFT JOIN ml_month2 AS t1 ON t0.did = t1.did LEFT JOIN mc_month2 AS t2 ON t0.did = t2.did GROUP BY t0.country, t0.user_tag, t0.month1_tag, CASE WHEN t1.did IS NULL AND t2.did IS NULL THEN '流失' WHEN NOT t1.did IS NULL AND NOT t2.did IS NULL THEN 'ML&MC均活跃' WHEN t1.did IS NULL AND NOT t2.did IS NULL THEN '仅MC活跃' WHEN NOT t1.did IS NULL AND t2.did IS NULL THEN '仅ML活跃' END

/* -处理当日数据分区，打标 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_mlmc_monthly_active_retention_di PARTITION(logymd) /* 这只是为了建立一个分区，能让风神有依赖，即当天任务完成了 */ SELECT NULL AS country, NULL AS user_tag, NULL AS month1_tag, NULL AS month2_tag, 0 AS cnt, '2026-05-30' AS update_date, '2026-05-30' AS logymd

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-04-14 15:12:23.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE TABLE mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df_external( */ /*     roleid decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '角色id', */ /*     zoneid bigint COMMENT '服务器,key', */ /*     did string COMMENT '创角did', */ /*     adid string COMMENT '创角adid', */ /*     mpass decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '创角mpass', */ /*     ml_roleid	decimal(20, 0)  COMMENT 	'创角时匹配到ml_roleid', */ /*     ml_zoneid	bigint COMMENT 	'创角时匹配到ml_zoneid', */ /*     user_type_active  	string COMMENT	'端内MC玩家活跃标签', */ /*     user_type_ability  	string COMMENT	'端内MC玩家能力标签', */ /*     new_type string COMMENT '新增类型', */ /*     create_role_time string COMMENT '角色创建时间(时分秒)', */ /*     create_role_date string COMMENT '角色创建日期(yyyy-mm-dd)', */ /*     create_role_channel string COMMENT '创角渠道', */ /*     create_role_os_type bigint COMMENT '创角系统类型', */ /*     create_role_ip string COMMENT '创角ip', */ /*     create_role_os_language string COMMENT '创角手机渠道', */ /*     create_role_os_name string COMMENT '创角系统名称', */ /*     create_role_sex bigint COMMENT '创角性别（0：未知）', */ /*     create_role_country string COMMENT '创角城市(geoip解析)', */ /*     create_role_device string COMMENT '创角设备', */ /*     create_role_version string COMMENT '创角客户端版本', */ /*     first_media_source string COMMENT '首次归因渠道', */ /*     first_mt_country string COMMENT '首次mtcountry', */ /*     first_ad_country string COMMENT '首次归因国家', */ /*     role_type bigint COMMENT '玩家类型', */ /*     is_yl bigint COMMENT '是否游廊玩家', */ /*     ml_install bigint COMMENT '创角时是否安装mlbb', */ /*     is_first_create bigint COMMENT '是否账号下首个创角（1：是，0：否）', */ /*     is_formal string COMMENT '是否正式服(1:是，0：否)', */ /*     data_source string COMMENT '创角数据来源' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY (logymd string COMMENT '') ROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe' STORED AS parquet */ /* location 's3a://moonton-mcgg/table/mcgg_dim/dim_basic_role_zone_df_external' */ WITH ml_role_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ml_roleid_final, ml_zoneid_final FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY usercreateymd ASC) AS rn, ml_roleid_final, ml_zoleid_final AS ml_zoneid_final FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_mlaccid_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-30') WHERE rn = 1), ability_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, user_type_active, user_type_ability FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) >= 0.5 AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 5 THEN '1端内mc核心' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 >= 1 THEN '2端内mc泛玩家' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl >= 1 THEN '3ml活跃有mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '4ml活跃无mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate < DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '5ml流失' WHEN usercreateymd < '2024-11-28' THEN 'CBT注册用户' ELSE '6mc纯新' END AS user_type_active /* ------user_type_ability、user_type_active计算逻辑 */, CASE WHEN user_type IN ('MC纯新', 'ML流失') THEN user_type WHEN NOT user_type IN ('MC纯新', 'ML流失') AND (pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl IS NULL OR pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl = 0) THEN 'ML活跃-无段位' WHEN NOT user_type IN ('MC纯新', 'ML流失') AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl IN (1, 2, 3, 4) THEN 'ML活跃-菜鸟' WHEN NOT user_type IN ('MC纯新', 'ML流失') AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl IN (5) THEN 'ML活跃-会玩' WHEN NOT user_type IN ('MC纯新', 'ML流失') AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl IN (6, 7) THEN 'ML活跃-高手' END AS user_type_ability /* -本质是根据pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl分类聚合 */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY usercreateymd DESC) AS rn FROM mcgg_dim.dim_feature_role_zone_from_ba_di /* 每日mc新增表 */ WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-30') AS t WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df_external PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT base.roleid, base.zoneid, base.did, base.adid, base.mpass, ml_roleid_final, ml_zoneid_final, COALESCE(user_type_active, '6mc纯新') AS user_type_active, COALESCE(user_type_ability, 'unknown') AS user_type_ability, CASE WHEN NOT t5.mc_roleid IS NULL THEN '灰产新增' ELSE base.new_type END AS new_type, base.create_role_time, base.create_role_date, base.create_role_channel, base.create_role_os_type, base.create_role_ip, base.create_role_os_language, base.create_role_os_name, base.create_role_sex, base.create_role_country, base.create_role_device, base.create_role_version, base.first_media_source, base.first_mt_country, base.first_ad_country, base.role_type, base.is_yl, base.ml_install, base.is_first_create, base.is_formal, base.data_source FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS base LEFT JOIN ml_role_info AS t1 ON t1.roleid = base.roleid AND t1.zoneid = base.zoneid LEFT JOIN ability_info AS t2 ON t2.roleid = base.roleid AND t2.zoneid = base.zoneid LEFT OUTER JOIN (/* ---黑产 */ SELECT mc_roleid FROM db_bytedance.mt_risk__dwd_mc_abnml_user_list_di WHERE date <= '20260530' GROUP BY mc_roleid) AS t5 ON base.roleid = t5.mc_roleid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'

LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_country), '') = '', 'unknown', adjust_country)) AS country, MAPPING('media_source', network_name) AS media_source, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_id), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_name), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_name) AS campaign_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adgroup_id), '') = '', 'unknown', adgroup_id) AS adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adgroup_name), '') = '', 'unknown', adgroup_name) AS adset_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(creative_id), '') = '', 'unknown', creative_id) AS ad_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(creative_name), '') = '', 'unknown', creative_name) AS ad_name, his_first_accountid AS account_id, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, pc_device FROM adbi.dwm_sdk_device_create_account_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND create_date > '2026-05-28' AND create_date <= '2026-05-30' AND app_id IN ('1001', '2001', '3001') AND is_error = 0 UNION ALL SELECT m.app_id, m.device_id, m.data_date, n.create_time, n.data_hour, m.os, m.country, m.media_source, m.campaign_id, m.campaign_name, m.adset_id, m.adset_name, m.ad_id, m.ad_name, NULL AS account_id, m.idfa, m.idfv, m.gps_adid, m.android_id, NULL AS pc_device FROM (SELECT app_id, did AS device_id, create_date AS data_date, LOWER(os) AS os, LOWER(CASE WHEN country = 'uk' THEN 'gb' ELSE IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country) END) AS country, MAPPING('media_source', media_source) AS media_source, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_id), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_name), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_name) AS campaign_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adgroup_id), '') = '', 'unknown', adgroup_id) AS adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adgroup_name), '') = '', 'unknown', adgroup_name) AS adset_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(creative_id), '') = '', 'unknown', creative_id) AS ad_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(creative_name), '') = '', 'unknown', creative_name) AS ad_name, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id FROM adbi.dm_msdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND create_date > '2026-05-28' AND create_date <= '2026-05-30') AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.did, a.app_id, a.logymd AS data_date, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UNIXTIME(MIN(a.event_time) / 1000), 'UTC-08:00'), 'HH') AS data_hour, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UNIXTIME(MIN(a.event_time) / 1000), 'UTC-08:00'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:00:00') AS create_time FROM (SELECT did, app_id, event_time, logymd FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd > '2026-05-28' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND event IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'login', 'logout') AND app_id <> '4310' UNION ALL SELECT did, app_id, event_time, logymd FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd > '2026-05-28' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND event IN ('purchase_event') AND app_id <> '4310' UNION ALL SELECT did, '4310' AS app_id, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), 'UTC-8')) * 1000 AS event_time, logymd FROM wefly_ob_ods.login WHERE logymd > '2026-05-28' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND zoneid > 9999 UNION ALL SELECT did, '4310' AS app_id, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), 'UTC-8')) * 1000 AS event_time, logymd FROM wefly_ob_ods.charge WHERE logymd > '2026-05-28' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND zoneid > 9999 UNION ALL SELECT did, '4310' AS app_id, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), 'UTC-8')) * 1000 AS event_time, logymd FROM wefly_ob_ods.create_role WHERE logymd > '2026-05-28' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND zoneid > 9999 UNION ALL SELECT did, '4310' AS app_id, event_time, logymd FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd > '2026-05-28' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND event IN ('__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter') AND app_id = 4310 UNION ALL SELECT m__did AS did, '4310' AS app_id, m__server_time AS event_time, logymd FROM wefly_ob_ods.__install_event__ WHERE logymd > '2026-05-28' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' UNION ALL SELECT did, '4310' AS app_id, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), 'UTC-8')) * 1000 AS event_time, logymd FROM wefly_ob_ods.logout WHERE logymd > '2026-05-28' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30') AS a GROUP BY a.app_id, a.did, a.logymd) AS n ON m.app_id = n.app_id AND m.device_id = n.did AND m.data_date = n.data_date) AS a LEFT JOIN adbi.dim_campaign_name_df AS b ON b.p_date = '2026-05-30' AND a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.media_source = b.media_source AND a.campaign_id = b.campaign_id LEFT JOIN adbi.dim_ad_set_name_df AS d ON d.p_date = '2026-05-30' AND a.app_id = d.app_id AND a.media_source = d.media_source AND a.adset_id = d.adset_id LEFT JOIN adbi.dim_ad_name_df AS e ON e.p_date = '2026-05-30' AND a.app_id = e.app_id AND a.media_source = e.media_source AND a.ad_id = e.ad_id

sql_units: WITH did_df AS (SELECT a.app_id, a.create_date, a.did, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', LOWER(TRIM(country)))) AS country, os, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(app_id) OVER (PARTITION BY did)) AS app_id_group_in_all, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did ORDER BY create_date, app_id) AS rn FROM (SELECT app_id, did, SUBSTRING(did_create_time, 1, 10) AS create_date, country, os FROM adbi.dim_did_attribute_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT('{{app_ids_str_config}}', ','), app_id) UNION ALL SELECT app_id, did, create_date, country, os FROM adbi.dm_msdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT('{{app_ids_str_config}}', ','), app_id)) AS a), app_ids AS (SELECT app_id, app_id_group FROM (SELECT app_id, SPLIT(app_id_group, ',') AS app_id_group FROM (SELECT app_id, ARRAY_SUBSETS(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(app_id) OVER ()), 1, NULL) AS app_id_group_sets FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(SPLIT('{{app_ids_str_config}}', ',')) AS app_id)) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(app_id_group_sets) AS app_id_group) WHERE ARRAY_CONTAINS(app_id_group, app_id)), new_agg_first AS (SELECT a.app_id, app_id_group, create_date, country, os, did_new_user, first_did_new_user, non_first_did_new_user FROM (SELECT app_id, create_date, country, os, SUM(1) AS did_new_user, SUM(1) AS first_did_new_user, 0 AS non_first_did_new_user FROM did_df WHERE create_date >= '${start_date}' AND SIZE(app_id_group_in_all) = 1 GROUP BY app_id, create_date, country, os) AS a JOIN app_ids AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id UNION ALL SELECT app_id, app_id_group, create_date, country, os, COUNT(1) AS did_new_user, SUM(IF(app_id = app_id_first_in_all, 1, 0)) AS first_did_new_user, SUM(IF(app_id <> app_id_first_in_all, 1, 0)) AS non_first_did_new_user FROM (SELECT a.app_id, app_id_group, create_date, country, os, ARRAY_APPS_FIRST(app_id_group, app_rn_map) AS app_id_first_in_all FROM (SELECT app_id, create_date, country, os, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(app_id, rn)) OVER (PARTITION BY did)) AS app_rn_map FROM did_df WHERE SIZE(app_id_group_in_all) > 1) AS a JOIN app_ids AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id WHERE create_date >= '${start_date}') GROUP BY app_id, create_date, country, os, app_id_group), new_agg AS (SELECT app_id, IF(app_id_group = app_id, 'all', app_id_group) AS app_id_group, create_date, country, os, SUM(did_new_user) AS did_new_user, SUM(first_did_new_user) AS first_did_new_user, SUM(non_first_did_new_user) AS non_first_did_new_user FROM (SELECT app_id, CONCAT_WS(',', app_id_group) AS app_id_group, create_date, country, os, did_new_user, first_did_new_user, non_first_did_new_user FROM new_agg_first) GROUP BY app_id, create_date, country, os, app_id_group) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_cockpit_game_inside_stats_did_df)) SELECT app_id, app_id_group, data_date, MAPPING('week_1st_day', 'Mon', data_date) AS data_week, SUBSTRING(data_date, 1, 7) AS data_month, SUBSTRING(data_date, 1, 4) AS data_year, os, country, did_new_user, first_did_new_user, non_first_did_new_user, did_active_user, did_active_user_7d FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.data_date, b.data_date) AS data_date, COALESCE(a.app_id, b.app_id) AS app_id, COALESCE(a.app_id_group, b.app_id_group) AS app_id_group, COALESCE(a.country, b.country) AS country, COALESCE(a.os, b.os) AS os, did_new_user, first_did_new_user, non_first_did_new_user, did_active_user, did_active_user_7d FROM (SELECT create_date AS data_date, app_id, app_id_group, COALESCE(TRIM(LOWER(country)), 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(TRIM(LOWER(os)), 'unknown') AS os, did_new_user, first_did_new_user, non_first_did_new_user FROM new_agg) AS a FULL JOIN (SELECT p_date AS data_date, app_id, app_id_group, COALESCE(TRIM(LOWER(country)), 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(TRIM(LOWER(os)), 'unknown') AS os, did_active_user, did_active_user_7d FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_did_active_stats_di)) WHERE p_date <= '2026-05-30') AS b ON a.data_date = b.data_date AND a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.app_id_group = b.app_id_group AND a.country = b.country AND a.os = b.os)

AS roleid, zoneid, '713' AS type FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_arcademodebehavior WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2025-05-28' AND clicktype IN (100) AND pvptype = 353 AND zoneid < 57000 UNION ALL /* -承接页点击 */ SELECT logymd, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, '承接页' AS type FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_arcademodebehavior WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2025-05-28' AND pvptype = 9999 AND clicktype IN (9998, 9999) AND zoneid < 57000 UNION ALL /* --2个活动页面点击 */ SELECT logymd, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN activity_id IN (2505260340) THEN '碎片活动' WHEN activity_id IN (2505260335) THEN '皮肤活动' END AS type FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_activityblocksystem_click WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2025-05-28' AND activity_id IN (2505260340, 2505260335) AND param IN (2, 3) AND zoneid < 57000 AND click_event IN (1) UNION ALL /* --火影页面点击 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN act_id IN (2505260340) THEN '碎片活动' WHEN act_id IN (2505260335) THEN '皮肤活动' WHEN act_id IN (2505150452) THEN '火影活动' WHEN act_id IN (2504101948) THEN '6.3新活动' END AS type FROM ml_ods.gameserver_task_get_reward WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2025-05-28' AND (act_id IN (2505150452) AND taskid IN (12, 13)) AND zoneid < 57000 UNION ALL /* --新活动页面点击 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN act_id IN (2505260340) THEN '碎片活动' WHEN act_id IN (2505260335) THEN '皮肤活动' WHEN act_id IN (2505150452) THEN '火影活动' WHEN act_id IN (2504101948) THEN '6.3新活动' END AS type FROM ml_ods.gameserver_task_get_reward WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2025-06-04' AND (act_id IN (2504101948) AND taskid IN (11, 12)) AND zoneid < 57000) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, type), ml_user_tag AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.step3, a.step4, CASE WHEN b.ml_roleid IS NULL THEN '1mc未注册' WHEN NOT b.ml_roleid IS NULL AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', b.last_active) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '2mc注册且30日活跃' WHEN NOT b.ml_roleid IS NULL AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', b.last_active) > 30 THEN '3mc注册且30日流失' END AS mc_active_type, c.country FROM (SELECT aa.roleid, aa.zoneid, aa.type AS step3, bb.type AS step4 FROM step3 AS aa LEFT JOIN step4 AS bb ON aa.roleid = bb.roleid AND aa.zoneid = bb.zoneid AND aa.type = bb.type GROUP BY aa.roleid, aa.zoneid, aa.type, bb.type) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT his_last_ml_roleid AS ml_roleid, MAX(his_last_active_date) AS last_active FROM mcgg_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df_external WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY his_last_ml_roleid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.ml_roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, LOWER(createrole_country) AS country FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, LOWER(createrole_country)) AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_ml_to_mc_s2_7days_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.step3, t0.step4, t0.mc_active_type, t0.country, t1.roleid AS mc_new_roleid, t1.zoneid AS mc_new_zoneid, t2.roleid AS mc_return_roleid, t2.zoneid AS mc_return_zoneid FROM ml_user_tag AS t0 LEFT JOIN (/* -匹配新增 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, ml_roleid_final FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND NOT ml_roleid_final IS NULL) AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.ml_roleid_final LEFT JOIN (/* --匹配当日回流 */ SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.his_last_ml_roleid AS ml_roleid, b.his_last_ml_zoneid AS ml_zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_date, create_role_date, his_last_ml_roleid, his_last_ml_zoneid FROM mcgg_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df_external WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.his_last_active_date) > 30 AND DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_role_date) > 30) AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.ml_roleid GROUP BY t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.step3, t0.step4, t0.mc_active_type, t0.country, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t2.roleid, t2.zoneid

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_hjli@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-06-10 14:46:57.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH s_conf AS (SELECT seasonid, seasonstartymd AS season_start, seasonendymd AS season_end, '2026-05-30' AS logymd FROM mcgg_temp.selinasun_mcrankseason_larksheet_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-30' BETWEEN seasonstartymd AND seasonendymd), last_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, seasonid, if_new, if_return_30, if_return_90, if_return_180, seasonbeginymd, seasonendymd, loginymd FROM mcgg_temp.sj_usertype WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sj_usertype PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT roleid, zoneid, b.seasonid AS seasonid, if_new, if_return_30, if_return_90, if_return_180, b.season_start AS seasonbeginymd, b.season_end AS seasonendymd, '2026-05-30' AS loginymd FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_active_user_data_di AS a JOIN s_conf AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.logymd = '2026-05-30' WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-30' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM last_df AS c WHERE a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND b.seasonid = c.seasonid) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, seasonid, if_new, if_return_30, if_return_90, if_return_180, seasonbeginymd, seasonendymd, loginymd FROM last_df

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: ethandong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-06-23 16:54:37.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* set spark.executor.cores=2; */ /* set spark.executor.memory=6g; */ /* set spark.executor.memoryOverhead=2048; */ /* set spark.sql.shuffle.partitions=500; */ /* set spark.driver.cores=3; */ /* set spark.driver.memory=9g; */ WITH my_sg AS (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.ml_roleid_final, t1.ml_zoleid_final, t1.usercreateymd, CASE WHEN t2.battletime_5v5_recent90 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t2.battletime_5v5_recent90 END AS battletime_5v5_recent90, CASE WHEN t2.bat_cnt_39_recent90 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t2.bat_cnt_39_recent90 END AS bat_cnt_39_recent90, CASE WHEN t2.battletime_39_recent90 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t2.battletime_39_recent90 END AS battletime_39_recent90 FROM (SELECT * FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_mlaccid_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND LOWER(ip_country) IN ('my', 'sg')) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN mcgg_temp.mc_battle_snapshot_1220 AS t2 /* --玩家端内5v5和端内mc标签截止日期20241220 */ ON t1.ml_roleid_final = t2.accountid AND t1.ml_zoleid_final = t2.zoneid), six_countries AS (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.ml_roleid_final, t1.ml_zoleid_final, t1.usercreateymd, CASE WHEN t2.battletime_5v5_recent90 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t2.battletime_5v5_recent90 END AS battletime_5v5_recent90, CASE WHEN t2.bat_cnt_39_recent90 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t2.bat_cnt_39_recent90 END AS bat_cnt_39_recent90, CASE WHEN t2.battletime_39_recent90 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t2.battletime_39_recent90 END AS battletime_39_recent90 FROM (SELECT * FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_mlaccid_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND LOWER(ip_country) IN ('id', 'ph', 'mm', 'th', 'kh', 'la')) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN mcgg_temp.mc_battle_snapshot_0220 AS t2 /* --玩家端内5v5和端内mc标签截止日期20250220 */ ON t1.ml_roleid_final = t2.accountid AND t1.ml_zoleid_final = t2.zoneid), other_countries AS (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.ml_roleid_final, t1.ml_zoleid_final, t1.usercreateymd, CASE WHEN t2.battletime_5v5_recent90 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t2.battletime_5v5_recent90 END AS battletime_5v5_recent90, CASE WHEN t2.bat_cnt_39_recent90 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t2.bat_cnt_39_recent90 END AS bat_cnt_39_recent90, CASE WHEN t2.battletime_39_recent90 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t2.battletime_39_recent90 END AS battletime_39_recent90 FROM (SELECT * FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_mlaccid_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND NOT LOWER(ip_country) IN ('id', 'ph', 'my', 'mm', 'th', 'kh', 'sg', 'la')) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN mcgg_temp.mc_battle_snapshot_0527 AS t2 ON t1.ml_roleid_final = t2.accountid AND t1.ml_zoleid_final = t2.zoneid /* -ML端内活跃标签，数据截至之20250527 */), union_table AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ml_roleid_final, ml_zoleid_final, usercreateymd, battletime_5v5_recent90, bat_cnt_39_recent90, battletime_39_recent90 FROM (SELECT * FROM my_sg UNION ALL SELECT * FROM six_countries UNION ALL SELECT * FROM other_countries) AS tb) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_dim.dim_feature_role_zone_from_ba_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.usercreateymd, t1.battletime_5v5_recent90, t1.bat_cnt_39_recent90, t1.battletime_39_recent90, t2.his_last_activedate, t3.pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, CASE WHEN t1.ml_roleid_final IS NULL THEN 'MC纯新' WHEN NOT t1.ml_roleid_final IS NULL AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', t2.his_last_activedate) <= 90 THEN 'ML活跃' WHEN NOT t1.ml_roleid_final IS NULL AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', t2.his_last_activedate) > 90 THEN 'ML流失' END AS user_type FROM union_table AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT basic.roleid, basic.zoneid, COALESCE(act.his_last_active_date, '1970-01-01') AS his_last_activedate FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND is_ai = 0 AND COALESCE(create_channel, '') NOT LIKE '%and_gmfake%') AS basic LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid < 57000) AS act ON basic.roleid = act.roleid AND basic.zoneid = act.zoneid) AS t2 ON t1.ml_roleid_final = t2.roleid AND t1.ml_zoleid_final = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN pvptype = 39 THEN his_max_bigranklvl ELSE 0 END) AS pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype IN (2, 39) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t3 ON t1.ml_roleid_final = t3.roleid AND t1.ml_zoleid_final = t3.zoneid

name: 赛道去重活跃分国家0628
sql_units: WITH mc_act /* mc活跃 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid AS mc_roleid, zoneid AS mc_zoneid, logymd, CONCAT('mc_', roleid) AS new_accountid, CONCAT('mc_', zoneid) AS new_zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login /* mcgg */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 /* 正式服 */), ml_act /* mlbb活跃 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid AS ml_roleid, zoneid AS ml_zoneid, logymd, CONCAT('ml_', roleid) AS new_accountid, CONCAT('ml_', zoneid) AS new_zoneid FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di /* mlbb */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 /* 正式服 */), did_acc /* ml_mc账号映射关系 */ AS (SELECT roleid AS mc_roleid, zoneid AS mc_zoneid, ml_roleid_final, ml_zoleid_final FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df /* mcgg全量中间表 */ WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 2 * -1), DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 2 * -1), '2026-05-30')), did_act /* mc活跃中，对应的ml账号也活跃的用户（对应的ml账号，只取当天有活跃的ml账号，因为一个mc对应多个ml账号，要去掉mc活跃但是对应ml账号中不活跃的ml账号) */ AS (SELECT a.logymd /* ml活跃日期 */, b.ml_roleid_final, b.ml_zoleid_final, b.mc_roleid /* mc */, b.mc_zoneid /* mc */ FROM ml_act AS a /* mlbb活跃 */ JOIN did_acc AS b /* 账号映射表 */ ON a.ml_roleid = b.ml_roleid_final AND a.ml_zoneid = b.ml_zoleid_final), mc_ml_act /* mc活跃中，有对应的活跃ml账号输出ml，没有输出mc账号（以ml作为主账号输出） */ AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.mc_roleid, a.mc_zoneid, CASE WHEN NOT b.ml_roleid_final IS NULL AND b.ml_roleid_final > 0 THEN CONCAT('ml_', b.ml_roleid_final) ELSE CONCAT('mc_', a.mc_roleid) END AS new_accountid /* 有ml账号输出ml，没有输出mc */, CASE WHEN NOT b.ml_zoleid_final IS NULL AND b.ml_zoleid_final > 0 THEN CONCAT('ml_', b.ml_zoleid_final) ELSE CONCAT('mc_', a.mc_zoneid) END AS new_zoneid /* 有ml账号输出ml，没有输出mc */ FROM mc_act AS a /* mc 活跃 */ LEFT JOIN did_act AS b /* mc活跃中，对应的ml账号也活跃的用户 */ ON a.mc_roleid = b.mc_roleid AND a.mc_zoneid = b.mc_zoneid AND a.logymd = b.logymd), ml_mc_roleid /* 双端去重活跃roleid zoneid */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT logymd, new_accountid /* 格式 ml/mc_ +roleid */, new_zoneid FROM (SELECT logymd, new_accountid /* 格式 ml/mc_ +roleid */, new_zoneid FROM mc_ml_act /* mc活跃中，有对应的活跃ml账号输出ml，没有输出mc账号 */ UNION ALL SELECT logymd, new_accountid /* 格式 ml_ +roleid */, new_zoneid FROM ml_act /* ml活跃 */) AS aa), ml_mc_country_info /* 对应国家信息表 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT new_accountid, new_zoneid, roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country /* 首次创号国,经分观星台口径 */, create_country /* 创角国家(geoip获取) */, country, register_date, tag FROM (SELECT CONCAT('ml_', roleid) AS new_accountid, CONCAT('ml_', zoneid) AS new_zoneid, roleid, zoneid, UPPER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country /* 首次创号国,经分观星台口径 */, create_country /* 创角国家(geoip获取) */, CASE WHEN first_mt_country IS NULL OR first_mt_country = '-' OR first_mt_country = 'unknown' OR first_mt_country = 'NULL' THEN UPPER(create_country) ELSE UPPER(first_mt_country) END AS country, register_date, 'mlbb' AS tag FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('mc_', roleid) AS new_accountid, CONCAT('mc_', zoneid) AS new_zoneid, roleid, zoneid, ad_country AS first_mt_country /* 广告归因国，观星台口径 */, ip_country AS create_country /* 创角国，看板口径 */, CASE WHEN ad_country IS NULL OR ad_country = '-' OR ad_country = 'unknown' OR ad_country = 'NULL' THEN UPPER(ip_country) ELSE UPPER(ad_country) END AS country, usercreateymd AS register_date, 'mcgg' AS tag FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 2 * -1), DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 2 * -1), '2026-05-30')) AS aa), ml_mc_dau /* 双端去重dau */ AS (SELECT logymd, first_mt_country /* 首次创号国,经分观星台口径 */, create_country /* 创角国家(geoip获取) */, country, register_date, COUNT(DISTINCT a.new_accountid, a.new_zoneid) AS ml_mc_users_accountid_zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.new_accountid) AS ml_mc_users_accountid FROM ml_mc_roleid AS a /* 双端去重活跃明细 */ LEFT JOIN ml_mc_country_info AS b ON a.new_accountid = b.new_accountid AND a.new_zoneid = b.new_zoneid GROUP BY logymd, first_mt_country /* 首次创号国,经分观星台口径 */, create_country /* 创角国家(geoip获取) */, country, register_date), mlbb_dau /* 设置成敏感列 */ AS (SELECT logymd, first_mt_country /* 首次创号国,经分观星台口径 */, create_country /* 创角国家(geoip获取) */, country, register_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ml_roleid, ml_zoneid) AS ml_users_accountid_zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT ml_roleid) AS ml_users_accountid FROM ml_act AS a LEFT JOIN ml_mc_country_info AS b ON a.new_accountid = b.new_accountid AND a.new_zoneid = b.new_zoneid GROUP BY logymd, first_mt_country /* 首次创号国,经分观星台口径 */, create_country /* 创角国家(geoip获取) */, country, register_date), mcgg_dau /* 设置成敏感列 */ AS (SELECT logymd, first_mt_country /* 首次创号国,经分观星台口径 */, create_country /* 创角国家(geoip获取) */, country, register_date, COUNT(DISTINCT mc_roleid, mc_zoneid) AS mc_users_accountid_zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT mc_roleid) AS mc_users_accountid FROM mc_act AS a LEFT JOIN ml_mc_country_info AS b ON a.new_accountid = b.new_accountid AND a.new_zoneid = b.new_zoneid GROUP BY logymd, first_mt_country /* 首次创号国,经分观星台口径 */, create_country /* 创角国家(geoip获取) */, country, register_date) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.teemoyu_mlbb_mcgg_distinct_dau_by_countyr_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT DISTINCT a.first_mt_country /* 首次创号国,经分观星台口径 */, a.create_country /* 创角国家(geoip获取) */, a.country, a.register_date, a.ml_mc_users_accountid_zoneid, a.ml_mc_users_accountid, b.ml_users_accountid_zoneid, b.ml_users_accountid, c.mc_users_accountid_zoneid, c.mc_users_accountid FROM ml_mc_dau AS a LEFT JOIN mlbb_dau AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.first_mt_country = b.first_mt_country AND a.create_country = b.create_country AND a.country = b.country AND a.register_date = b.register_date LEFT JOIN mcgg_dau AS c ON a.logymd = c.logymd AND a.first_mt_country = c.first_mt_country AND a.create_country = c.create_country AND a.country = c.country AND a.register_date = c.register_date

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_abtest_cuped_input_tags_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: niangangdeng@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-07-22 20:20:35.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE mt_dm.dm_abtest_cuped_input_tags_di( */ /*     `uid`                   string COMMENT '用户唯1id', */ /*     `accountid`             decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '账号id key', */ /*     `zoneid`                bigint COMMENT '区服ID key', */ /*     `param_name`            string COMMENT '实验名 key', */ /*     `appid`                 string COMMENT 'appid', */ /*     `his_max_minranklvl`    bigint COMMENT '历史最高小段位', */ /*     `battle_cnt_7`          bigint COMMENT '近7日对战场次', */ /*     `battle_cnt_30`         bigint COMMENT '近30日对战场次', */ /*     `level`                 bigint COMMENT '等级', */ /*     `active_days_7`         bigint COMMENT '近7日活跃天数', */ /*     `active_days_30`        bigint COMMENT '近30日活跃天数', */ /*     `a_rank_skin_cnt`       bigint COMMENT '拥有A级以上皮肤数' */ /* ) COMMENT 'abtest用户用户进组映射全量表' PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dm/table/dm_abtest_cuped_input_tags_di' */ /* ; */ /* 由 全量数据 反推出 增量数据 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_abtest_cuped_input_tags_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT t1.uid, t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.param_name, t1.appid, t2.his_max_minranklvl /* 历史最高小段位 */, t3.battle_cnt_7 /* 近7日对战场次 */, t3.battle_cnt_30 /* 近30日对战场次 */, t4.level /* 等级 */, t4.active_days_7 /* 近7日活跃天数 */, t4.active_days_30 /* 近30日活跃天数 */, t5.a_rank_skin_cnt /* 拥有A级以上皮肤数 */, t1.first_entry_time, t1.is_aitest FROM (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_abtest_role_zone_mapping_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND is_aitest = 0 AND appid = 'mlbb') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT appid, roleid, zoneid, his_max_minranklvl /* 历史最高小段位 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND pvptype = 2) AS t2 ON t1.appid = t2.appid AND t1.accountid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT appid, roleid, zoneid, battle_cnt_7days AS battle_cnt_7 /* 近7日对战场次 */, battle_cnt_30days AS battle_cnt_30 /* 近30日对战场次 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_battle_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29') AS t3 ON t1.appid = t3.appid AND t1.accountid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT appid, roleid, zoneid, his_last_level AS level /* 等级 */, activedays_7days AS active_days_7 /* 近7日活跃天数 */, activedays_30days AS active_days_30 /* 近30日活跃天数 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29') AS t4 ON t1.appid = t4.appid AND t1.accountid = t4.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t4.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT appid, roleid, zoneid, own_skin_super_s_cnt + own_skin_s_cnt + own_skin_super_a_cnt + own_skin_a_cnt AS a_rank_skin_cnt /* 拥有A级以上皮肤数 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_resource_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29') AS t5 ON t1.appid = t5.appid AND t1.accountid = t5.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t5.zoneid DISTRIBUTE BY 1

name: 乱斗英雄使用收益
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: celiaye@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-08-15 14:55:46.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH luandou AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, heroid, COUNT(*) AS luandou_battlenum FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE zoneid < 57000 AND logymd = '2026-05-29' AND fake_ai = 0 AND pvptype = 4 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, heroid), before AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, heroid, SUM(today_battle_cnt) AS before_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_heroes_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-29' AND '2026-05-28' AND pvptype = 2 AND is_fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, heroid), after AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, heroid, SUM(today_battle_cnt) AS after_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_heroes_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-30' AND pvptype = 2 AND is_fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, heroid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.celiaye_luandou_hero_usetimechange PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-29') SELECT l.accountid, l.zoneid, l.heroid, COALESCE(before_cnt, 0) AS before_cnt, COALESCE(after_cnt, 0) AS after_cnt FROM luandou AS l LEFT JOIN before AS b ON l.zoneid = b.zoneid AND l.accountid = b.roleid AND l.heroid = b.heroid LEFT JOIN after AS a ON l.zoneid = a.zoneid AND l.accountid = a.roleid AND l.heroid = a.heroid

sql_units: WITH device AS (SELECT b.app_id, b.did, LOWER(b.country) AS country, LOWER(b.os) AS os, IF(SUBSTRING(b.sub_active_info_str, 1, 31) = '1000000000000000000000000000000', ARRAY(7, 30), ARRAY(7)) AS back_time_type, LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(b.sub_active_info_str), '1', 2)) - 1 AS loss_days, '${target_date}' AS device_back_date FROM (SELECT a.app_id, a.did, a.country, a.os, SUBSTRING(a.active_info_str, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', '${target_date}') + 1) AS sub_active_info_str FROM (SELECT app_id, did, country, os, CONCAT_WS('', REVERSE(active_info)) AS active_info_str FROM adbi.dm_msdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND app_id = '4280') AS a) AS b WHERE SUBSTRING(b.sub_active_info_str, 1, 8) = '10000000' UNION ALL SELECT app_id, did, country, os, back_time_type, loss_days, p_date AS device_back_date FROM adbi.dwm_msdk_back_device_reattribution_di WHERE p_date >= DATE_ADD('${target_date}', 7 * -1) AND p_date < '${target_date}'), adjust_event AS (SELECT app_id, did, CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'reattribution_reinstall' THEN '1-广告重装回流' WHEN activity_kind = 'reattribution' THEN '2-广告回流' WHEN activity_kind = 'reinstall' THEN '3-自然重装回流' END AS back_type, reattributed_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(reattributed_time - 8 * 60 * 60, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS reattributed_date, LOWER(os_name) AS os, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'organic', network_name) AS network_name, LOWER(country) AS country, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', campaign_name) AS campaign_name, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', adgroup_name) AS adgroup_name, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', creative_name) AS creative_name, fb_install_referrer, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id) AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name) AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', fb_install_referrer_campaign_id) AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_id, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', fb_install_referrer_campaign_name) AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_name, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id) AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name) AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name, msdk_adjust_logymd FROM (SELECT msdk_app_id AS app_id, msdk_did AS did, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') AS activity_kind, CASE WHEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') IN ('reattribution_reinstall', 'reattribution') THEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.reattributed_at') ELSE GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.reinstalled_at') END AS reattributed_time, os_name, network_name, country, campaign_name, adgroup_name, creative_name, COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer'), '') AS fb_install_referrer, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_id') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_name') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id') AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name') AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name, logymd AS msdk_adjust_logymd FROM msdk_ods.msdk_adjust WHERE logymd >= REPLACE(DATE_ADD('${target_date}', 15 * -1), '-', '') AND logymd <= REPLACE(DATE_ADD('${target_date}', 10), '-', '') AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') IN ('reinstall', 'reattribution', 'reattribution_reinstall') AND msdk_app_id IN ('4280')) AS k), device_Adjust AS (SELECT device.app_id, device.did, device.os, device.back_type, device.back_time_type, device.loss_days, device.device_back_date, device.network_name, device.country, IF(device.campaign_id IS NULL OR TRIM(device.campaign_id) = '', 'unknown', device.campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(device.campaign_name IS NULL OR TRIM(device.campaign_name) = '', 'unknown', device.campaign_name) AS campaign_name, IF(device.adgroup_id IS NULL OR TRIM(device.adgroup_id) = '', 'unknown', device.adgroup_id) AS adgroup_id, IF(device.adgroup_name IS NULL OR TRIM(device.adgroup_name) = '', 'unknown', device.adgroup_name) AS adgroup_name, IF(device.creative_id IS NULL OR TRIM(device.creative_id) = '', 'unknown', device.creative_id) AS creative_id, IF(device.creative_name IS NULL OR TRIM(device.creative_name) = '', 'unknown', device.creative_name) AS creative_name, device.msdk_adjust_logymd FROM (SELECT device_attribution.app_id, device_attribution.did, device_attribution.os, device_attribution.back_type, device_attribution.back_time_type, device_attribution.loss_days, device_attribution.device_back_date, IF(LOWER(device_attribution.network_name) = 'organic', 'Organic', TRIM(network_name)) AS network_name, IF((device_attribution.country IS NULL OR TRIM(device_attribution.country) IN ('', 'unknown')) AND device_attribution.os IN ('android', 'ios'), COALESCE(TRIM(device_attribution.original_country), 'unknown'), COALESCE(TRIM(device_attribution.country), 'unknown')) AS country, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN 'unknown' WHEN device_attribution.is_fb = 1 THEN device_attribution.fb_campaign_id ELSE IF(device_attribution.campaign_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', device_attribution.campaign_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(device_attribution.campaign_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS campaign_id, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN 'unknown' WHEN device_attribution.is_fb = 1 THEN device_attribution.fb_campaign_name ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(device_attribution.campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN 'unknown' WHEN device_attribution.is_fb = 1 THEN device_attribution.fb_adgroup_id ELSE IF(device_attribution.adgroup_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', device_attribution.adgroup_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(device_attribution.adgroup_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS adgroup_id, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN 'unknown' WHEN device_attribution.is_fb = 1 THEN device_attribution.fb_adgroup_name ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(device_attribution.adgroup_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS adgroup_name, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN 'unknown' WHEN device_attribution.is_fb = 1 THEN device_attribution.fb_ad_id ELSE IF(device_attribution.creative_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', device_attribution.creative_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(device_attribution.creative_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS creative_id, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN 'unknown' WHEN device_attribution.is_fb = 1 THEN device_attribution.fb_ad_name ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(device_attribution.creative_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS creative_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_attribution.device_back_date, device_attribution.app_id, device_attribution.did ORDER BY device_attribution.back_type, device_attribution.reattributed_time DESC) AS rn, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN NULL ELSE device_attribution.msdk_adjust_logymd END AS msdk_adjust_logymd FROM (SELECT device_adjust.app_id, device_adjust.did, device_adjust.os, device_adjust.back_type, device_adjust.back_time_type, device_adjust.loss_days, device_adjust.original_country, device_adjust.country, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', 1, 0) AS is_fb, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', 'Facebook Installs', device_adjust.network_name) AS network_name, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', device_adjust.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id, NULL) AS fb_campaign_id, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', device_adjust.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name, NULL) AS fb_campaign_name, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', device_adjust.fb_install_referrer_campaign_id, NULL) AS fb_adgroup_id, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', device_adjust.fb_install_referrer_campaign_name, NULL) AS fb_adgroup_name, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', device_adjust.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id, NULL) AS fb_ad_id, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', device_adjust.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name, NULL) AS fb_ad_name, device_adjust.campaign_name, device_adjust.adgroup_name, device_adjust.creative_name, device_adjust.reattributed_time, device_adjust.msdk_adjust_logymd, device_adjust.device_back_date FROM (SELECT dev.app_id, dev.did, dev.country AS original_country, dev.os, dev.back_time_type, dev.loss_days, dev.device_back_date, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.back_type ELSE '4-自然回流' END AS back_type, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.reattributed_time ELSE NULL END AS reattributed_time, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.msdk_adjust_logymd ELSE NULL END AS msdk_adjust_logymd, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.network_name ELSE 'organic' END AS network_name, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.country ELSE 'unknown' END AS country, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.campaign_name ELSE 'unknown' END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.adgroup_name ELSE 'unknown' END AS adgroup_name, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.creative_name ELSE 'unknown' END AS creative_name, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer_campaign_id ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_id, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer_campaign_name ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name FROM device AS dev LEFT JOIN adjust_event AS event1 ON dev.app_id = event1.app_id AND dev.os = event1.os AND dev.did = event1.did AND dev.did <> '' AND DATEDIFF(dev.device_back_date, event1.reattributed_date) <= 6 AND DATEDIFF(dev.device_back_date, event1.reattributed_date) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(dev.device_back_date), TO_DATE(event1.msdk_adjust_logymd, 'yyyyMMdd')) <= 8 AND DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(event1.msdk_adjust_logymd, 'yyyyMMdd'), TO_DATE(dev.device_back_date)) <= 7 AND dev.os IN ('android', 'ios', 'windows')) AS device_adjust) AS device_attribution) AS device WHERE device.rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE
