creative_id, creative_name, msdk_adjust_logymd AS att_logymd, loss_days, device_back_date AS p_date FROM device_Adjust

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_descimart_special_config_mlbb
sql_units: /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `bi_test`.`dim_descimart_special_config` PARTITION (logymd, appname, config_type) */ WITH mlbb_pay_channel AS (SELECT pay_channel_type, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel /* case */ /* when pay_channel = 'unknown' then if(pay_channel_type = 2, '端内-其他', '三方-其他') */ /* else pay_channel */ /* end as pay_channel, */, CONCAT_WS('||', pay_channel_type, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel) AS sub_pay_channel_id, bill_country, SUM(product_money) AS product_money FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%ios%' OR pay_channel LIKE '%and%' THEN 2 /* '端内渠道' */ ELSE 1 /* 三方渠道 */ END AS pay_channel_type /* 渠道类型 */, COALESCE(CASE WHEN LOWER(pay_channel) LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mobapay' ELSE pay_channel END, 'unknown') AS pay_channel, CASE WHEN COALESCE(CASE WHEN LOWER(pay_channel) LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mobapay' ELSE pay_channel END, 'unknown') = 'unknown' THEN 'unknown' ELSE COALESCE(sub_pay_channel, 'unknown') END AS sub_pay_channel, COALESCE(LOWER(country), 'unknown') AS bill_country, product_money /* ,nvl(country, 'unknown') as country */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t1 GROUP BY pay_channel_type, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel /* case */ /* when pay_channel = 'unknown' then if(pay_channel_type = 2, '端内-其他', '三方-其他') */ /* else pay_channel */ /* end, */, bill_country, CONCAT_WS('||', pay_channel_type, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel)), common_channel /* 新增渠道维度, 登录取登录渠道，新增取新增渠道 */ AS (SELECT channel, SUM(channel_cnt) AS channel_cnt FROM (SELECT TRIM(CASE WHEN create_channel IN ('and_usa', 'ios_usa', 'and_mlingp', 'and_catappult', 'and_xiaomi_getapps', 'and_taptap', 'and_huawei_ag', 'and_funtap', 'ios_usa_us', 'and_usa_us', 'and_taptap_test', 'ios_funtap', 'and_xiaomi_psv', 'ios_mlingp', 'and_usa_lite') THEN create_channel ELSE 'unknown' END) AS channel, COUNT(1) AS channel_cnt FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-01-01', '2025-01-01', '2026-05-30') GROUP BY TRIM(CASE WHEN create_channel IN ('and_usa', 'ios_usa', 'and_mlingp', 'and_catappult', 'and_xiaomi_getapps', 'and_taptap', 'and_huawei_ag', 'and_funtap', 'ios_usa_us', 'and_usa_us', 'and_taptap_test', 'ios_funtap', 'and_xiaomi_psv', 'ios_mlingp', 'and_usa_lite') THEN create_channel ELSE 'unknown' END) UNION ALL SELECT channel, SUM(register_cnt) AS channel_cnt FROM mt_ads.ads_decismart_primary_channel_di_mid WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY channel) AS t GROUP BY channel), mlbb_config AS (/* 账单国家 */ SELECT 'bill_country' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, LOWER(d1.country) AS config_id, CONCAT(d1.country_name, '(', LOWER(d1.country), ')') AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(d3.product_money, 0) DESC) AS config_order, '账单国家' AS config_desc FROM (/* SELECT  DISTINCT country, */ /*         country_name */ /* FROM    mt_dim.dim_currency_country_di */ /* WHERE   logymd IN ( */ /*             SELECT  MAX(logymd) */ /*             FROM    mt_dim.dim_currency_country_di */ /*             WHERE   logymd <= IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-09-01', '2025-09-01', '2026-05-30') */ /*         ) */ /* UNION ALL */ /* SELECT  'unknown' AS country, */ /*         '其他' AS country_name */ SELECT DISTINCT country_code AS country, CASE WHEN country_name = '台湾' THEN '中国台湾' ELSE country_name END AS country_name FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-10-11', '2025-10-11', '2026-05-30') AND NOT country_code IN ('NULL', 'zz', '-')) AS d1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT bill_country, SUM(product_money) AS product_money FROM mlbb_pay_channel GROUP BY bill_country) AS d3 ON LOWER(d1.country) = bill_country /* WHERE   d1.logymd > '0' */ UNION ALL /* 支付渠道类型 */ SELECT 'pay_channel_type' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, pay_channel_type AS config_id, CASE WHEN pay_channel_type = 1 THEN '三方渠道' WHEN pay_channel_type = 2 THEN '端内渠道' END AS config_name /*  WHEN pay_channel_type = 0 THEN '其他' */, CASE WHEN pay_channel_type = 1 THEN 1 WHEN pay_channel_type = 2 THEN 2 END AS config_order /*  WHEN pay_channel_type = 0 THEN 3 */, '支付渠道类型' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT pay_channel_type FROM mlbb_pay_channel GROUP BY pay_channel_type) UNION ALL /* 支付渠道 */ SELECT 'pay_channel_v2' AS config_type, 'pay_channel_type' AS parent_config_type, pay_channel_type AS parent_config_id, CASE WHEN pay_channel_type = 1 THEN '三方渠道' WHEN pay_channel_type = 2 THEN '端内渠道' END AS parent_config_name /*  WHEN pay_channel_type = 0 THEN '其他' */, pay_channel AS config_id, pay_channel AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pay_channel_type ORDER BY product_money DESC) AS config_order, '支付渠道' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT pay_channel_type, pay_channel, SUM(product_money) AS product_money FROM mlbb_pay_channel GROUP BY pay_channel_type, pay_channel) UNION ALL /* 支付子渠道 */ SELECT 'sub_pay_channel' AS config_type, 'pay_channel_v2' AS parent_config_type, pay_channel AS parent_config_id, pay_channel AS parent_config_name, sub_pay_channel_id AS config_id, sub_pay_channel AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pay_channel ORDER BY product_money DESC) AS config_order, '支付子渠道' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, sub_pay_channel_id, SUM(product_money) AS product_money FROM mlbb_pay_channel GROUP BY pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, sub_pay_channel_id) UNION ALL /* 一级渠道 */ SELECT 'pay_channel_type_v2' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, pay_channel_type AS config_id, CASE WHEN pay_channel_type = 'mp' THEN 'mobapay' WHEN pay_channel_type = 'other' THEN '其他' WHEN pay_channel_type = 'unknown' THEN 'unknown' ELSE pay_channel_type END AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 1) AS config_order, '一级渠道' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(pay_channel_type_list) AS pay_channel_type FROM (SELECT ARRAY('mp', 'coda', 'unipin', 'web_pag', 'ios', 'gp', 'other', 'unknown') AS pay_channel_type_list)) UNION ALL /* 用户类型 */ SELECT 'pay_user_type' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, pay_user_type AS config_id, CASE WHEN pay_user_type = 0 THEN '破冰新客' WHEN pay_user_type = 1 THEN '渠道新客' WHEN pay_user_type = 2 THEN '老客' END AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 1) AS config_order, '用户类型' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(pay_user_type_list) AS pay_user_type FROM (SELECT ARRAY(0, 1, 2) AS pay_user_type_list)) UNION ALL /* 汇率汇损配置 */ SELECT 'currency_exchange_rate_name' AS config_type, 'bill_country' AS parent_config_type, LOWER(d1.country) AS parent_config_id /* 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, */ /* 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, */, CONCAT(d1.country_name, '(', LOWER(d1.country), ')') AS parent_config_name, d1.currency AS config_id, CONCAT(d1.currency_name, '(', LOWER(d1.country), ')') AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(d3.product_money, 0) DESC) AS config_order, '汇率汇损-展示币种' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT t1.currency, t1.currency_name, COALESCE(t2.country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(t2.country_name, '其他') AS country_name FROM (SELECT currency, currency_name FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_exchange_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-09-01', '2025-09-01', '2026-05-30') AND currency <> 'unknown' GROUP BY currency, currency_name) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT currency, tp.country, tq.country_name FROM (SELECT DISTINCT currency, LOWER(country) AS country FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_country_di WHERE logymd IN (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_country_di WHERE logymd <= IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-09-01', '2025-09-01', '2026-05-30'))) AS tp LEFT JOIN (SELECT country_code AS country, CASE WHEN country_name = '台湾' THEN '中国台湾' ELSE country_name END AS country_name FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-10-11', '2025-10-11', '2026-05-30') AND NOT country_code IN ('NULL', 'zz', '-')) AS tq ON tp.country = tq.country) AS t2 ON t1.currency = t2.currency UNION ALL SELECT 'unknown' AS currency, '其他' AS currency_name, 'unknown' AS country, '其他' AS country_name) AS d1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT bill_country, SUM(product_money) AS product_money FROM mlbb_pay_channel GROUP BY bill_country) AS d3 ON LOWER(d1.country) = bill_country UNION ALL /* 渠道 */ SELECT 'event_channel' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, channel AS config_id, CASE WHEN channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 'lite包' WHEN channel = 'and_mlingp' THEN '印度新手专项包' WHEN channel = 'unknown' THEN '其他' ELSE channel END AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 99999999999999 WHEN channel = 'and_mlingp' THEN 9999999999999 WHEN channel = 'unknown' THEN -1 ELSE channel_cnt END DESC) AS config_order, '各事件渠道：新增取新增渠道,活跃取活跃,付费取付费,留存取新增,回流取回流当天首次登录' AS config_desc FROM common_channel), mlbb_personalization_item /* 个性化资源配置 */ AS (/* 历史付费等级 */ SELECT 'pay_grade' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, CAST(SPLIT(pay_grade, '_')[0] AS BIGINT) AS config_id, SPLIT(pay_grade, '_')[1] AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SPLIT(pay_grade, '_')[0] AS BIGINT)) AS config_order, '用户历史付费等级' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(ARRAY('1_0', '2_(0,2)', '3_[2,20)', '4_[20,200)', '5_[200,2000)', '6_2000及以上')) AS pay_grade) AS pay_grade_config UNION ALL /* 道具品质 */ SELECT 'item_quality' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, CAST(SPLIT(item_quality, '_')[0] AS BIGINT) AS config_id, SPLIT(item_quality, '_')[1] AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(CAST(SPLIT(item_quality, '_')[0] AS BIGINT))) AS config_order, '道具品质' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(ARRAY('1_绿', '2_蓝', '3_紫', '4_金', '5_红', '-99999_其他')) AS item_quality) AS item_quality_config UNION ALL /* 互动特效-使用场景 */ SELECT 'item_scene_type' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, CAST(SPLIT(item_scene_type, '_')[0] AS BIGINT) AS config_id, SPLIT(item_scene_type, '_')[1] AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(CAST(SPLIT(item_scene_type, '_')[0] AS BIGINT))) AS config_order, '互动特效-使用场景' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(ARRAY('1_房间队伍', '2_BP场景', '3_Loading', '-99999_其他')) AS item_scene_type) AS item_scene_type_config UNION ALL /* 礼物-赠礼入口 */ SELECT 'item_entertype' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, CAST(SPLIT(item_entertype, '_')[0] AS BIGINT) AS config_id, SPLIT(item_entertype, '_')[1] AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(CAST(SPLIT(item_entertype, '_')[0] AS BIGINT))) AS config_order, '礼物-赠礼入口' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(ARRAY('1_好友卡片', '2_好友聊天', '3_个人空间', '-99999_其他')) AS item_entertype) AS item_entertype_config), charge_basic_config AS (SELECT COALESCE(t2.pay_channel, -99999) AS receipt_type, COALESCE(CASE WHEN LOWER(t2.pay_channel_name) LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mobapay' ELSE t2.pay_channel_name END, '其他') AS receipt_type_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(CASE WHEN LOWER(t2.pay_channel_name) LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mobapay' ELSE t2.pay_channel_name END, 'unknown') = 'unknown' THEN 'unknown' ELSE COALESCE(sub_pay_channel, 'unknown') END AS sub_pay_channel, t1.product_money FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df AS t1 LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_receipt_mapping_di AS t2 ON t1.pay_channel = t2.pay_channel_name WHERE t1.logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2026-05-22', '2026-05-22', '2026-05-30') AND t2.logymd = '2026-05-30'), mlbb_monitor_config AS (SELECT 'zone_name' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, 1 AS config_id, '测服' AS config_name, 1 AS config_order, '区服类型' AS config_desc UNION ALL SELECT 'zone_name' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, 2 AS config_id, '正式服' AS config_name, 2 AS config_order, '区服类型' AS config_desc UNION ALL SELECT 'big_zoneid' AS config_type, 'zone_name' AS parent_config_type, CASE WHEN big_zoneid < 57 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS parent_config_id, CASE WHEN big_zoneid < 57 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测服' END AS parent_config_name, big_zoneid AS config_id, big_zoneid AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN big_zoneid < 57 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ORDER BY big_zoneid) AS config_order /* 测服先排序 */, '大区' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT big_zoneid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_basic_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2026-05-22', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-22') GROUP BY big_zoneid) AS t1 UNION ALL /* 操作系统 */ SELECT 'os' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, CASE WHEN os = 'ios' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS config_id, os AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN os = 'ios' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) AS config_order /* 测服先排序 */, '平台' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(ARRAY('ios', 'and')) AS os) AS t1 UNION ALL /* 国家 */ SELECT 'country' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, LOWER(d1.country) AS config_id, CONCAT(d1.country_name, '(', LOWER(d1.country), ')') AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(d3.cnt, 0) DESC) AS config_order, '国家' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT DISTINCT country_code AS country, CASE WHEN country_name = '台湾' THEN '中国台湾' ELSE country_name END AS country_name FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-10-11', '2025-10-11', '2026-05-30') AND NOT country_code IN ('NULL', 'zz', '-')) AS d1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT country, SUM(user_cnt) AS cnt FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_basic_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2026-05-22', '2026-05-22', '2026-05-30') GROUP BY country) AS d3 ON LOWER(d1.country) = d3.country UNION ALL /*    operator  STRING COMMENT '运营商', */ /* province  STRING COMMENT '州省', */ SELECT 'operator' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, operator AS config_id, operator AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS config_order, '运营商' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT operator, SUM(user_cnt) AS cnt FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_basic_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2026-05-22', '2026-05-22', '2026-05-30') GROUP BY operator) AS t1 UNION ALL /* --    operator  STRING COMMENT '运营商', */ /*     -- province  STRING COMMENT '州省', */ /*     SELECT */ /*         'province' AS config_type, */ /*         'country' AS parent_config_type, */ /*         trim(lower(split(province, '/')[0])) AS parent_config_id, */ /*         'unknown' AS parent_config_name, */ /*         province AS config_id, */ /*         province AS config_name, */ /*         row_number() OVER(order by cnt desc) AS config_order, */ /*         '州省' AS config_desc */ /*     FROM */ /*     ( */ /*         SELECT */ /*                  province */ /*                 ,sum(user_cnt) AS cnt */ /*         FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_config_df */ /*         where logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2026-05-22', '2026-05-22', '2026-05-30') */ /*         GROUP BY  province */ /*     ) t1 */ /*     UNION ALL */ SELECT 'province' AS config_type, 'country' AS parent_config_type, TRIM(LOWER(SPLIT(province, '/')[0])) AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, province AS config_id, CASE WHEN province IS NULL THEN '其他' ELSE province END AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS config_order, '州省' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT province, SUM(user_cnt) AS cnt FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_basic_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2026-05-22', '2026-05-22', '2026-05-30') /*   AND province != 'unknown' */ GROUP BY province) AS t1 UNION ALL SELECT 'channel' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, t1.channel AS config_id, CASE WHEN t1.channel = 'unknown' THEN '其他' ELSE t1.channel END AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t1.cnt, 0) DESC) AS config_order, '登录渠道' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT channel, SUM(user_cnt) AS cnt FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_basic_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2026-05-22', '2026-05-22', '2026-05-30') GROUP BY channel) AS t1 /*  ( */ /*     select channel, channel as channel_name */ /*     from mt_dim.dim_decismart_realtime_monitor_channel_config */ /*     where logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2026-05-22', '2026-05-22', '2026-05-30') */ /*     UNION ALL */ /*     SELECT 'unknown' as channel, '其他' as channel_name */ /*     ) t1 */ /*     left join */ /* on t1.channel = t2.channel */ UNION ALL SELECT 'battle_group' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, t1.battle_group AS config_id, CASE WHEN t1.battle_group = -99999 THEN '其他' ELSE battle_group END AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(t1.battle_group, 0)) DESC) AS config_order /* row_number() OVER(order by nvl(t1.cnt, 0) desc) AS config_order, */, '战斗组' AS config_desc FROM (/* SELECT */ /*      battle_group */ /*     ,sum(cnt) as cnt */ /* from */ /* ( */ SELECT COALESCE(battle_group, -99999) AS battle_group FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_realtime_monitor_battle_group_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2026-05-22', '2026-05-22', '2026-05-30')) AS t1 UNION ALL SELECT 'realpvptype_group' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, t1.realpvptype_group AS config_id, t1.realpvptype_group AS config_name, CASE WHEN realpvptype_group = '5v5' THEN 1 WHEN realpvptype_group = 'mcl' THEN 2 WHEN realpvptype_group = '其他' THEN 3 WHEN realpvptype_group = '大乱斗' THEN 4 WHEN realpvptype_group = '魔法战棋' THEN 5 END AS config_order, 'realpvptype分组' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT DISTINCT realpvptype_group realpvptype_group) AS t1 UNION ALL SELECT 'realpvptype' AS config_type, 'realpvptype_group' AS parent_config_type, realpvptype_group AS parent_config_id, realpvptype_group AS parent_config_name, realpvptype AS config_id, CASE WHEN realpvptype = -99999 THEN '其他' ELSE realpvptype END AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY realpvptype) AS config_order, 'realpvptype' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT t1.realpvptype, COALESCE(t2.realpvptype_group, '其他') AS realpvptype_group FROM (SELECT realpvptype FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2026-05-22', mt_dim.dim_decismart_realtime_monitor_realpvptype_config WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2026-05-22', '2026-05-22', '2026-05-30') GROUP BY realpvptype, realpvptype_group) AS t2 ON t1.realpvptype = t2.realpvptype) AS t3 UNION ALL SELECT 'errortype' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, errortype AS config_id, errortype AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY errortype) AS config_order, '811错误类型' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(ARRAY(811, 812, 711, 712)) AS errortype) AS t3 UNION ALL SELECT 'receipt_type_monitor' AS config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_type, 'unknown' AS parent_config_id, 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, receipt_type AS config_id, receipt_type_name AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY product_money DESC) AS config_order, '付费类型' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT receipt_type, receipt_type_name, SUM(product_money) AS product_money FROM charge_basic_config GROUP BY receipt_type, receipt_type_name) AS t3 UNION ALL /* 支付子渠道 */ SELECT 'sub_pay_channel_monitor' AS config_type, 'receipt_type_monitor' AS parent_config_type, receipt_type AS parent_config_id, receipt_type_name AS parent_config_name, sub_pay_channel AS config_id, CASE WHEN sub_pay_channel = 'unknown' THEN '其他' ELSE sub_pay_channel END AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_type ORDER BY product_money DESC) AS config_order, '支付子渠道' AS config_desc FROM (SELECT receipt_type, receipt_type_name, sub_pay_channel, SUM(product_money) AS product_money FROM charge_basic_config GROUP BY receipt_type, receipt_type_name, sub_pay_channel) AS t4) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_dim`.`dim_descimart_special_config` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30', appname = 'mlbb', NULL THEN '无品质' ELSE 'else' END AS skin_type, skin_lvl, CASE WHEN item_type = 1 THEN '1.为道具' WHEN item_type = 2 THEN '2.为装备' WHEN item_type = 3 THEN '3.为徽记' WHEN item_type = 4 THEN '4.为材料' WHEN item_type = 5 THEN '5.英雄' WHEN item_type = 6 THEN '6.皮肤' WHEN item_type = 7 THEN '7.徽记套装' WHEN item_type = 8 THEN '8.徽记套装碎片' WHEN item_type = 9 THEN '9.拼图道具' WHEN item_type = 10 THEN '10.直播礼物' WHEN item_type = 11 THEN '11.英雄打折券' WHEN item_type = 12 THEN '12.皮肤打折券' WHEN item_type = 13 THEN '13.头像框' WHEN item_type = 14 THEN '14.抽奖礼包' WHEN item_type = 15 THEN '15.万圣节糖果' WHEN item_type = 16 THEN '16.线下赛勋章' WHEN item_type = 21 THEN '21.排位保护卡' WHEN item_type = 23 THEN '23.赛季通行证徽章' WHEN item_type = 24 THEN '24.战场永久表情' WHEN item_type = 25 THEN '25.点券周卡' WHEN item_type = 26 THEN '26.点券月卡' WHEN item_type = 27 THEN '27.英雄防御塔' WHEN item_type = 28 THEN '28.染色皮肤' WHEN item_type = 29 THEN '29.抵扣券' WHEN item_type = 30 THEN '30.星光会员打折券' WHEN item_type = 31 THEN '31.门票' WHEN item_type = 32 THEN '32.塔防旗手' WHEN item_type = 35 THEN '35.指挥官' WHEN item_type = 36 THEN '36.指挥官皮肤' WHEN item_type = 37 THEN '37.塔防自走棋地图' WHEN item_type = 38 THEN '38.塔防自走棋地图皮肤' WHEN item_type = 39 THEN '39.塔防自走棋攻击特效' WHEN item_type = 40 THEN '40.个性动作' WHEN item_type = 41 THEN '41.活动特有不弹不进包' WHEN item_type = 42 THEN '42.永久聊天专属表情' WHEN item_type = 43 THEN '43.魔法战棋杯数保护卡' WHEN item_type = 45 THEN '45.小小竞技场卡牌' WHEN item_type = 46 THEN '46.双十一临时钻石' WHEN item_type = 47 THEN '47.感恩节活动道具' WHEN item_type = 48 THEN '48.年度宝藏' WHEN item_type = 49 THEN '49.新大抽奖特殊道具' WHEN item_type = 50 THEN '50.新大抽奖皮肤自选道具' WHEN item_type = 52 THEN '52.虚空模式特殊英雄' WHEN item_type = 53 THEN '53.自走棋棋手动作' WHEN item_type = 54 THEN '54.热点英雄抵扣券' WHEN item_type = 55 THEN '55.快捷语' WHEN item_type = 56 THEN '56.迷你堂模式战斗表现' WHEN item_type = 57 THEN '57.Partygame称号' WHEN item_type = 59 THEN '59.自走棋互动礼物' WHEN item_type = 58 THEN '58.聊天气泡表现' WHEN item_type = 61 THEN '61.皮肤喷绘' WHEN item_type = 62 THEN '62.战场涂鸦' WHEN item_type = 65 THEN '65.限时创造营门票' WHEN item_type = 66 THEN '66.天赋资源' WHEN item_type = 67 THEN '67.天赋体验卡' WHEN item_type = 69 THEN '69.天赋特效' WHEN item_type = 81 THEN '81.魔法棋斩杀动画' ELSE 'else' END AS shop_item_type_name, IF(NOT item_type IS NULL, item_name, '其他') AS item_name2, IF(NOT shopid IS NULL, shopid, '其他') AS shopid2, CASE WHEN his_last_charge_logymd IS NULL THEN '1、历史未付费' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', DAY('2026-05-30') * -1), his_last_charge_logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 179 THEN '2、半年内有付费' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', DAY('2026-05-30') * -1), his_last_charge_logymd) BETWEEN 180 AND 359 THEN '3、半年~1年内有付费' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', DAY('2026-05-30') * -1), his_last_charge_logymd) >= 360 THEN '4、1年内无付费' ELSE 'else' END AS his_last_charge_logymd_type, first_act_logymd /* his_last_charge_logymd, */, first_charge_logymd, IF(NOT sub2.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_sub_diamond, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS ucnt FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN his_charge_amt >= 2000 THEN '7、[2000,)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 200 THEN '6、[200,2000)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 20 THEN '5、[20,200)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 10 THEN '4、[10,20)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 5 THEN '3、[5,10)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 2 THEN '2、[2,5)' WHEN his_charge_amt > 0 THEN '1、(0,2)' ELSE '8、0' END AS his_r_label, his_last_charge_logymd, register_date, CASE WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MY', 'MM', 'RU', 'TR', 'IN', 'VN', 'TH') THEN UPPER(first_mt_country) WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('PE', 'BO') THEN UPPER(first_mt_country) WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('HK') THEN 'HK' ELSE 'else' END AS first_mt_country, DATEDIFF(SUBSTRING(a.logymd, 1, 7) || '-01', register_date) AS register_days, MIN(a.logymd) AS first_act_logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(logymd) AS his_last_charge_logymd, SUM(money / 100) AS his_charge_amt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE logymd <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', DAY('2026-05-30') * -1) /* 截止上月末的历史R级 */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND /* 20260526 剔除所有沙盒 */ /* AND     ( */ /*             pay_channel NOT IN ('and_huawei_ag', 'and_xiaomi_getapps') */ /*             OR is_sandbox = 0 */ /*         ) */ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据,因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS his_charge ON a.roleid = his_charge.roleid AND a.zoneid = his_charge.zoneid LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS bc ON a.roleid = bc.roleid AND a.zoneid = bc.zoneid AND bc.logymd = '2026-05-30' AND bc.appid = 'mlbb' WHERE SUBSTRING(a.logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-30', 1, 7) AND a.zoneid <= 57000 AND a.logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND a.is_ai = 0 GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, his_r_label, register_date, first_mt_country, register_days, his_last_charge_logymd) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(logymd) AS first_charge_logymd, MIN(TIME) AS charge_min_time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-30', 1, 7) AND a.zoneid < 57000 AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND /* 20260526 剔除所有沙盒 */ /* AND     ( */ /*             pay_channel NOT IN ('and_huawei_ag', 'and_xiaomi_getapps') */ /*             OR is_sandbox = 0 */ /*         ) */ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据,因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS charge ON a.roleid = charge.roleid AND a.zoneid = charge.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, TRIM(a.operate) AS operate, TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME ASC) AS time_rk FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid AS cg_roleid, zoneid AS cg_zoneid, MIN(TIME) AS charge_min_time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-30', 1, 7) AND a.zoneid < 57000 AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND /* 20260526 剔除所有沙盒 */ /* AND     ( */ /*             pay_channel NOT IN ('and_huawei_ag', 'and_xiaomi_getapps') */ /*             OR is_sandbox = 0 */ /*         ) */ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据,因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS charge ON a.roleid = cg_roleid AND a.zoneid = cg_zoneid AND a.time > charge_min_time WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-30', 1, 7) AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND a.zoneid < 57000 AND LOWER(operate) <> 'gm' /* 剔除gm 20260529 */) AS sub ON a.roleid = sub.roleid AND a.zoneid = sub.zoneid AND sub.time_rk = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, TIME, MIN_BY(itemid, TIME) AS itemid, MIN_BY(shopid, TIME) AS shopid, MIN_BY(gift_item_info, TIME) AS gift_item_info /* IF(buysource IN (6, 14, 1, 24, 31, 5), buysource, -9999) buysource */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_shop_buy WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-30', 1, 7) AND zoneid < 57000 AND moneytype = 301 AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, TIME) AS shop_b ON a.roleid = shop_b.roleid AND a.zoneid = shop_b.zoneid AND sub.time = shop_b.time LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS shop_cf ON IF(shop_b.itemid = 0, SPLIT(gift_item_info, ':')[0], shop_b.itemid) = shop_cf.item_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, CASE WHEN quality = 1 THEN 'B级' WHEN quality = 2 THEN 'A级' WHEN quality = 3 THEN 'A+级' WHEN quality = 4 THEN 'S级' ELSE 'else' END AS skin_lvl FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS skin_cf ON shop_cf.item_id = skin_cf.skinid LEFT JOIN (SELECT operate AS operate2, nick_name, type AS op_type FROM ml_temp.temp_operate_config WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM ml_temp.temp_operate_config WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS op_cf ON TRIM(operate) = TRIM(op_cf.operate2) LEFT JOIN (SELECT logym, skinid, skin_name, skin_type AS skin_type_cf FROM ml_temp.ads_larsheet_leap_ml_shop_newskin_config_di WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM ml_temp.ads_larsheet_leap_ml_shop_newskin_config_di WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS month_skin_type /* 根据配置表获取对应皮肤信息 */ ON item_type = 6 AND shop_cf.item_id = month_skin_type.skinid AND SUBSTRING('2026-05-30', 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(month_skin_type.logym, 1, 7) LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond AS a WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-30', 1, 7) AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND a.zoneid < 57000 AND LOWER(operate) <> 'gm' /* 剔除gm 20260529 */) AS sub2 ON a.roleid = sub2.roleid AND a.zoneid = sub2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT accountid /* 异常新增账号 */ FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-08-15' AND '2026-05-30' /* 最新日期 */ AND (os_build /* abnormal1 条件 */ LIKE '%AP1%' OR /* abnormal2 条件 */ (os_build IS NULL AND (device_name IN ('OnePlus 11', 'Galaxy S21', 'Redmi Note 12') OR app_click_id IN (56, 185))))) AS abnormal_t ON a.roleid = abnormal_t.accountid WHERE abnormal_t.accountid IS NULL GROUP BY logym, first_mt_country, his_r_label, register_days_type, age_type, pay_sub_operate, pay_sub_operate_name, pay_sub_op_type, shop_item_type, skin_type, skin_lvl, shop_item_type_name, item_name2, shopid2, his_last_charge_logymd_type, first_act_logymd, first_charge_logymd, if_sub_diamond UNION ALL SELECT logym, first_mt_country, his_r_label, register_days_type, age_type, pay_sub_operate, pay_sub_operate_name, pay_sub_op_type, shop_item_type, skin_type, skin_lvl, shop_item_type_name, item_name2, shopid2, his_last_charge_logymd_type, first_act_logymd, first_charge_logymd, if_sub_diamond, ucnt FROM ml_temp.dws_wmz_per_month_charge_rate_ana_mi WHERE logymd < SUBSTRING('2026-05-30', 1, 7))

name: 流失前行为pattern挖掘
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_ygao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-09-29 15:37:29.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH tidal_return_users AS (SELECT mc_roleid AS mc_tide_roleid, mc_zoneid AS mc_tide_zoneid, his_last_ml_roleid AS ml_roleid, his_last_ml_zoneid AS ml_zoneid, mc_second_date FROM (SELECT logymd, a.roleid AS mc_roleid, a.zoneid AS mc_zoneid, his_last_ml_roleid, his_last_ml_zoneid, his_last_active_second_date AS mc_second_date, ml_last_date FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_second_date, his_last_active_date, his_last_ml_roleid, his_last_ml_zoneid FROM mcgg_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df_external WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND his_last_active_date = '2026-05-30' AND his_last_active_second_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-04-29') AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(his_last_activedate) AS ml_last_date FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid HAVING MAX(his_last_activedate) BETWEEN '2026-05-23' AND '2026-05-29') AS b ON a.his_last_ml_roleid = b.roleid AND a.his_last_ml_zoneid = b.zoneid) AS a), post_return_mcgg_features AS (SELECT t.mc_tide_roleid, t.mc_tide_zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT b.battleid) AS post_return_battle_count, AVG(CASE WHEN camprank BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS post_return_win_rate, AVG(b.camprank) AS post_return_avg_rank, AVG(CASE WHEN camprank = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS post_return_champion_rate, AVG(CASE WHEN fetter_count >= 6 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS post_return_fetter_complete_rate, VARIANCE(hpvalue) AS post_return_health_variance, AVG(total_round) AS post_return_avg_rounds FROM tidal_return_users AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.logymd, a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.camprank FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN tidal_return_users AS b ON a.accountid = b.mc_tide_roleid AND a.zoneid = b.mc_tide_zoneid AND a.logymd = b.mc_second_date WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-04-29' AND a.camprank BETWEEN 1 AND 8) AS b ON t.mc_tide_roleid = b.accountid AND t.mc_tide_zoneid = b.zoneid AND t.mc_second_date = b.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.fetter_count, a.total_round FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_chessmode_battle_end AS a JOIN tidal_return_users AS b ON a.roleid = b.mc_tide_roleid AND a.zoneid = b.mc_tide_zoneid AND a.logymd = b.mc_second_date WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-04-29') AS c ON b.accountid = c.roleid AND b.zoneid = c.zoneid AND b.battleid = c.battleid AND b.logymd = c.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, MIN(hpvalue) AS hpvalue FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundinfo AS a JOIN tidal_return_users AS b ON a.accountid = b.mc_tide_roleid AND a.zoneid = b.mc_tide_zoneid AND a.logymd = b.mc_second_date WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-04-29' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid) AS d ON b.accountid = d.accountid AND b.zoneid = d.zoneid AND b.battleid = d.battleid AND b.logymd = d.logymd GROUP BY t.mc_tide_roleid, t.mc_tide_zoneid), sub_diamond AS (SELECT mc_tide_roleid, mc_tide_zoneid, mc_second_date, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num_sum FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond AS a JOIN tidal_return_users AS b ON a.roleid = b.mc_tide_roleid AND a.zoneid = b.mc_tide_zoneid AND a.logymd = b.mc_second_date WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-04-29' GROUP BY mc_tide_roleid, mc_tide_zoneid, mc_second_date), charge_info AS (SELECT mc_tide_roleid, mc_tide_zoneid, mc_second_date, SUM(money) / 100 AS charge_sum FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge AS a JOIN tidal_return_users AS b ON a.roleid = b.mc_tide_roleid AND a.zoneid = b.mc_tide_zoneid AND a.logymd = b.mc_second_date WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-04-29' AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') AND NOT money IN (0) AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' GROUP BY mc_tide_roleid, mc_tide_zoneid, mc_second_date), post_return_mcgg_payment AS (SELECT t.mc_tide_roleid, t.mc_tide_zoneid, charge_sum AS post_return_payment_amount, sub_num_sum AS post_return_cost_diamond FROM tidal_return_users AS t LEFT JOIN sub_diamond AS b ON t.mc_tide_roleid = b.mc_tide_roleid AND t.mc_tide_zoneid = b.mc_tide_zoneid AND t.mc_second_date = b.mc_second_date LEFT JOIN charge_info AS c ON t.mc_tide_roleid = c.mc_tide_roleid AND t.mc_tide_zoneid = c.mc_tide_zoneid AND t.mc_second_date = c.mc_second_date), post_return_ml_features AS (SELECT t.mc_tide_roleid, t.mc_tide_zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT ml.battleid) AS post_return_ml_battle_count, AVG(ml.wincamp) AS post_return_ml_win_rate, (MAX(ml.rankstar) - MIN(ml.rankstar)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ml.battleid), 0) AS post_return_ml_rank_speed FROM tidal_return_users AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT mc_tide_roleid, mc_tide_zoneid, mc_second_date, battleid, wincamp, rankstar FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN tidal_return_users AS b ON a.accountid = b.ml_roleid AND a.zoneid = b.ml_zoneid AND a.logymd = b.mc_second_date WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-04-29' AND pvptype = 2) AS ml ON t.mc_tide_roleid = ml.mc_tide_roleid sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.mc_mcgg_fake_quantity_di_v1 PARTITION(statdate, enddate) /* drop table mcgg_temp.mc_mcgg_fake_quantity_di_v1; */ /* CREATE  TABLE mcgg_temp.mc_mcgg_fake_quantity_di_v1 AS */ SELECT DISTINCT bas.roleid, bas.zoneid, first_media_source, role_type, day_num, create_role_os_language, REGEXP_REPLACE(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(create_role_device, '-')[0], ' ')[0], '&')[0], '[0-9]', '') AS create_role_device, first_ad_country, is_yl, ml_install, is_first_create, is_formal, active_flag, day_yl_active, day_dl_active, login_cnt, day_duration /* day_first_deviceid, */ /* day_last_deviceid, */, day_yl_duration, day_dl_duration, HOUR(day_first_active_time) AS day_first_active_hour, HOUR(day_last_active_time) AS day_last_active_hour, day_level_add, day_last_level, battle_cnt, friend_cnt, focus_cnt, card_num, bas.create_role_date AS statdate, '2026-05-30' AS enddate FROM (/* 注册 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_role_date, first_media_source, role_type, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', create_role_date) AS day_num, create_role_os_language, create_role_device, create_role_version, first_ad_country, is_yl, ml_install, is_first_create, is_formal FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df_external WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND create_role_date >= '2026-03-12' /* 取最近80天新增 */ AND create_role_date <= '2026-05-30') AS bas LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, 1 AS active_flag, MAX(day_yl_active) AS day_yl_active, MAX(day_dl_active) AS day_dl_active, SUM(day_login_cnt) AS login_cnt, SUM(day_online_dur) AS day_duration /* MAX(day_first_deviceid) AS day_first_deviceid, */ /* MAX(day_last_deviceid) AS day_last_deviceid, */, SUM(day_yl_online_dur) AS day_yl_duration, SUM(day_dl_online_dur) AS day_dl_duration, MIN(day_first_active_time) AS day_first_active_time, MAX(day_last_active_time) AS day_last_active_time, MAX(day_last_level - day_first_level) AS day_level_add, MAX(day_last_level) AS day_last_level FROM mcgg_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di_external WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' /* 只需查一天的活跃 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid AND bas.zoneid = act.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battle_cnt FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND /* AND     pvptype IN (39, 170) */ fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND camprank <> 0 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS battle ON bas.roleid = battle.roleid AND bas.zoneid = battle.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(gamefriendnum) AS friend_cnt, MAX(focusnum) AS focus_cnt FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' /* BETWEEN '2025-02-10' AND '2025-04-07' */ AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS frds ON bas.roleid = frds.roleid AND bas.zoneid = frds.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(card_num) AS card_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, SUBSTRING(CAST(item_id AS STRING), 1, 4) AS card_name, SUBSTRING(CAST(item_id AS STRING), -1, 1) AS card_level, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(item_id AS STRING), -1, 1) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(item_id AS STRING), -1, 1) = 2 THEN 3 WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(item_id AS STRING), -1, 1) = 3 THEN 9 END AS card_num FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND SUBSTRING(CAST(item_id AS STRING), 1, 4) IN (4504, 4505, 4506, 4507, 4510, 4511, 4512, 4514, 4515, 4516, 4517, 4518, 4519, 4520, 4521, 4522, 4523, 4524, 4525, 4526, 4701, 4702, 4703, 4704, 4705, 4706, 4707, 4708, 4709, 4711, 4712, 4713, 4714, 4715, 4716, 4717, 4718, 4719, 4720, 4800) AND NOT operate IN ('action_upgrade_commandercard', 'action_act_upgrade_byItem_commandercard', 'gm')) AS tb GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS card ON bas.roleid = card.roleid AND bas.zoneid = card.zoneid

sql_units: /* ---拼接当日用户数据&本赛季历史数据，获得最新赛季历史全量 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_sjlv@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-03-26 14:08:38.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* -以下内容，若要进行任何改动，cc@孙雪纯selinasun， 后续t+0表以来该中间表的码 */ /* -先处理一个赛季首日用户的信息（怎么处理首日的数据，先手动生成一个11/28,2/20日的数据 */ WITH current_season AS (SELECT seasonid AS season_id, seasonstartymd AS season_start_ymd, seasonendymd AS season_end_ymd, SPLIT(seasonstarttime_config, '_')[1] AS season_starttime, CAST(CONCAT(seasonstartymd, ' ', SPLIT(seasonstarttime_config, '_')[1]) AS TIMESTAMP) AS season_start_ts, CAST(CONCAT(seasonendymd, ' ', SPLIT(seasonendtime_config, '_')[1]) AS TIMESTAMP) AS season_end_ts FROM mcgg_temp.selinasun_mcrankseason_larksheet_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-30' BETWEEN seasonstartymd AND seasonendymd), history_data AS (SELECT * FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_season_user_battle_summary_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND season_id IN (SELECT season_id FROM current_season)), battle_base /* battle 明细（带时间戳） */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, battletime, camprank, blacknum, CAST(TIME AS TIMESTAMP) AS battle_ts /* TODO: 替换成真实的 battle 结束/发生时间字段 */ FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND camprank <> 0), battle_with_season /* 给每场 battle 归属 season：落到哪个区间 */ AS (SELECT b.*, s.season_id FROM battle_base AS b JOIN current_season AS s ON b.battle_ts >= s.season_start_ts AND (s.season_end_ts IS NULL OR b.battle_ts < s.season_end_ts)), daily_battle AS (SELECT season_id, roleid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS battle_cnt, SUM(battletime) AS battle_time, COUNT(IF(camprank = 1, 1, NULL)) AS rank1_cnt, COUNT(IF(camprank = 2, 1, NULL)) AS rank2_cnt, COUNT(IF(camprank = 3, 1, NULL)) AS rank3_cnt, COUNT(IF(camprank = 4, 1, NULL)) AS rank4_cnt, COUNT(IF(camprank = 5, 1, NULL)) AS rank5_cnt, COUNT(IF(camprank = 6, 1, NULL)) AS rank6_cnt, COUNT(IF(camprank = 7, 1, NULL)) AS rank7_cnt, COUNT(IF(camprank = 8, 1, NULL)) AS rank8_cnt, COUNT(IF(blacknum > 1, 1, NULL)) AS black_cnt, SUM(IF(blacknum > 1, battletime, 0)) AS black_time FROM battle_with_season GROUP BY season_id, roleid, zoneid), daily_rank39 AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, season_id, final_39_rank_id, final_39_cupnum, MAX(new_rank_id) AS max_39_rank_id, MAX(new_cupnum) AS max_39_cupnum FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, season_id, FIRST_VALUE(new_rank_id) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS final_39_rank_id, FIRST_VALUE(new_cupnum) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS final_39_cupnum, new_rank_id, new_cupnum FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_magicchess_rank_level WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND season_id IN (SELECT season_id FROM current_season)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, season_id, final_39_rank_id, final_39_cupnum), daily_rank301 AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, season_id, final_301_rank_id, final_301_cupnum, MAX(new_rank_id) AS max_301_rank_id, MAX(new_cupnum) AS max_301_cupnum FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, season_id, FIRST_VALUE(new_rank_id) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS final_301_rank_id, FIRST_VALUE(new_cupnum) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS final_301_cupnum, new_rank_id, new_cupnum FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_duoplayer_rank_level WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND season_id IN (SELECT season_id FROM current_season)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, season_id, final_301_rank_id, final_301_cupnum), daily_active AS (SELECT t0.*, t1.battle_cnt, t1.battle_time AS bttime, t1.rank1_cnt, t1.rank2_cnt, t1.rank3_cnt, t1.rank4_cnt, t1.rank5_cnt, t1.rank6_cnt, t1.rank7_cnt, t1.rank8_cnt, t1.black_cnt, t1.black_time, t2.final_39_rank_id, t2.max_39_rank_id, t2.final_39_cupnum, t2.max_39_cupnum, t3.final_301_rank_id, t3.max_301_rank_id, t3.final_301_cupnum, t3.max_301_cupnum, t4.season_id, t4.season_start_ymd AS season_start, t4.season_end_ymd AS season_end FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, create_os_type, create_channel, create_country, pure_new_type, first_mt_country, first_media_source, online_time, MAX(ml_install) AS ml_install, MIN(user_tag_active) AS user_tag_active, MAX(pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl) AS pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, MAX(pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl) AS pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, MIN(ml_roleid_final) AS ml_roleid_final, 1 AS tmp FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_active_user_data_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, create_os_type, create_channel, create_country, pure_new_type, first_mt_country, first_media_source, online_time) AS t0 LEFT JOIN daily_battle AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, 1 AS tmp FROM current_season) AS t4 ON t0.tmp = t4.tmp LEFT JOIN daily_rank39 AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t4.season_id = t2.season_id LEFT JOIN daily_rank301 AS t3 ON t0.roleid = t3.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND t4.season_id = t3.season_id), special_user AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid FROM daily_battle AS a LEFT JOIN daily_active AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE b.roleid IS NULL GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_season_user_battle_summary_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.usercreateymd, t0.create_os_type, t0.create_channel, t0.create_country, t0.pure_new_type, t0.ml_install, t0.user_tag_active, t0.pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, t0.pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, t0.ml_roleid_final, t0.first_mt_country, t0.first_media_source, 1 + COALESCE(t1.active_day_cnt, 0) AS active_day_cnt, COALESCE(t0.online_time, 0) + COALESCE(t1.online_time, 0) AS online_time, COALESCE(t0.battle_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.battle_cnt, 0) AS battle_cnt, COALESCE(t0.bttime, 0) + COALESCE(t1.battle_time, 0) AS battle_time, COALESCE(t0.rank1_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.rank1_cnt, 0) AS rank1_cnt, COALESCE(t0.rank2_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.rank2_cnt, 0) AS rank2_cnt, COALESCE(t0.rank3_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.rank3_cnt, 0) AS rank3_cnt, COALESCE(t0.rank4_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.rank4_cnt, 0) AS rank4_cnt, COALESCE(t0.rank5_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.rank5_cnt, 0) AS rank5_cnt, COALESCE(t0.rank6_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.rank6_cnt, 0) AS rank6_cnt, COALESCE(t0.rank7_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.rank7_cnt, 0) AS rank7_cnt, COALESCE(t0.rank8_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.rank8_cnt, 0) AS rank8_cnt, COALESCE(t0.black_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.black_cnt, 0) AS black_cnt, COALESCE(t0.black_time, 0) + COALESCE(t1.black_time, 0) AS black_time, COALESCE(t0.final_39_rank_id, t1.final_39_rank_id) AS final_39_rank_id, GREATEST(COALESCE(t0.max_39_rank_id, 0), COALESCE(t1.max_39_rank_id, 0)) AS max_39_rank_id, COALESCE(t0.final_39_cupnum, t1.final_39_cupnum) AS final_39_cupnum, GREATEST(COALESCE(t0.max_39_cupnum, 0), COALESCE(t1.max_39_cupnum, 0)) AS max_39_cupnum, COALESCE(t0.final_301_rank_id, t1.final_301_rank_id) AS final_301_rank_id, GREATEST(t0.max_301_rank_id, t1.max_301_rank_id) AS max_301_rank_id, COALESCE(t0.final_301_cupnum, t1.final_301_cupnum) AS final_301_cupnum, GREATEST(t0.max_301_cupnum, t1.max_301_cupnum) AS max_301_cupnum, t0.season_id, t0.season_start, t0.season_end, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', t0.season_start) + 1 AS season_day FROM daily_active AS t0 LEFT JOIN history_data AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t0.season_id = t1.season_id UNION ALL /* -单独处理一下rank_id丢的问题 */ SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, day_s FROM mcgg_temp.daily_retention_month WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), old AS (SELECT month_true, roleid, zoneid, ip_country, os_type, channel, roletype, first_date, day_s FROM mcgg_temp.daily_retention_month WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2026-05-30', 'MM'), 1 * -1) UNION ALL SELECT month_true, roleid, zoneid, ip_country, os_type, channel, roletype, first_date, day_s FROM mcgg_temp.daily_retention_month WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD(TRUNC(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2026-05-30', 'MM'), 1 * -1), 'MM'), 1 * -1)), outer1 AS (SELECT month_true, day_s, os_type, ip_country, channel, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(roletype = 3, CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid), NULL)) AS new_user, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(roletype = 2, CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid), NULL)) AS return_user, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(roletype = 1, CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid), NULL)) AS old_user, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(roletype = 3 AND first_date <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 29 * -1), CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid), NULL)) AS new_30, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(roletype = 2 AND first_date <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 29 * -1), CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid), NULL)) AS return_30, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(roletype = 3 AND first_date <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 29 * -1) AND NOT b.roleid IS NULL, CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid), NULL)) AS new_active_30, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(roletype = 2 AND first_date <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 29 * -1) AND NOT b.roleid IS NULL, CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid), NULL)) AS return_active_30, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(roletype = 1 AND first_date <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 29 * -1) AND NOT b.roleid IS NULL, CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid), NULL)) AS old_active_30, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(roletype = 1 AND first_date <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 29 * -1), CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid), NULL)) AS old_30 FROM old AS a LEFT JOIN (/* 匹配之前登录玩家的30留 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC(DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', (DAY('2026-05-30') + 31) * -1), 'MM') AND '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_vp = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND first_date = DATE_ADD(b.logymd, 29 * -1) GROUP BY month_true, day_s, os_type, ip_country, channel) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.retention30_monthly PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT month_true, day_s AS days, os_type, ip_country, channel, new_user, return_user, old_user, new_30, return_30, new_active_30, return_active_30, old_active_30, old_30 FROM outer1 UNION ALL SELECT month_true, day_s AS days, os_type, ip_country, channel, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(roletype = 3, CONCAT(roleid, zoneid), NULL)) AS new_user, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(roletype = 2, CONCAT(roleid, zoneid), NULL)) AS return_user, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(roletype = 1, CONCAT(roleid, zoneid), NULL)) AS old_user, 0 AS new_30, 0 AS return_30, NULL AS new_active_30, NULL AS return_active_30, NULL AS old_active_30, 0 AS old_30 FROM new GROUP BY month_true, day_s, os_type, ip_country, channel UNION ALL SELECT month_true, days, os_type, ip_country, channel, new_user, return_user, old_user, new_30, return_30, new_active_30, return_active_30, old_active_30, old_30 FROM mcgg_temp.retention30_monthly AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND month_true <> SUBSTRING('2026-05-30', 1, 7) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outer1 AS b WHERE a.month_true = b.month_true)

name: 赛道去重活跃0628
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: teemoyu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-07-01 17:22:33.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH mc_act /* mc活跃 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid AS mc_roleid, zoneid AS mc_zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login /* mcgg */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 /* 正式服 */), ml_act /* mlbb活跃 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid AS ml_roleid, zoneid AS ml_zoneid, logymd, CONCAT('ml_', roleid) AS new_accountid, CONCAT('ml_', zoneid) AS new_zoneid FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di /* mlbb */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 /* 正式服 */), did_acc /* 账号映射关系 */ AS (SELECT roleid AS mc_roleid, zoneid AS mc_zoneid, ml_roleid_final, ml_zoleid_final FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df /* mcgg全量中间表 */ WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 2 * -1), DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 2 * -1), '2026-05-30')), did_act /* mc活跃中，对应的ml账号也活跃的用户（对应的ml账号，只取当天有活跃的ml账号，因为一个mc对应多个ml账号，要去掉mc活跃但是对应ml账号中不活跃的ml账号) */ AS (SELECT a.logymd /* ml活跃日期 */, b.ml_roleid_final, b.ml_zoleid_final, b.mc_roleid /* mc */, b.mc_zoneid /* mc */ FROM ml_act AS a /* mlbb活跃 */ JOIN did_acc AS b /* 账号映射表 */ ON a.ml_roleid = b.ml_roleid_final AND a.ml_zoneid = b.ml_zoleid_final), mc_ml_act /* mc活跃中，有对应的活跃ml账号输出ml，没有输出mc账号 */ AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.mc_roleid, a.mc_zoneid, CASE WHEN NOT b.ml_roleid_final IS NULL AND b.ml_roleid_final > 0 THEN CONCAT('ml_', b.ml_roleid_final) ELSE CONCAT('mc_', a.mc_roleid) END AS new_accountid /* 有ml账号输出ml，没有输出mc */, CASE WHEN NOT b.ml_zoleid_final IS NULL AND b.ml_zoleid_final > 0 THEN CONCAT('ml_', b.ml_zoleid_final) ELSE CONCAT('mc_', a.mc_zoneid) END AS new_zoneid /* 有ml账号输出ml，没有输出mc */ FROM mc_act AS a /* mc 活跃 */ LEFT JOIN did_act AS b /* mc活跃中，对应的ml账号也活跃的用户 */ ON a.mc_roleid = b.mc_roleid AND a.mc_zoneid = b.mc_zoneid AND a.logymd = b.logymd), ml_mc_users_cnt AS (SELECT logymd, COUNT(DISTINCT new_accountid, new_zoneid) AS ml_mc_users_accountid_zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT new_accountid) AS ml_mc_users_accountid FROM (SELECT logymd, new_accountid /* 格式 ml/mc_ +roleid */, new_zoneid FROM mc_ml_act /* mc活跃中，有对应的活跃ml账号输出ml，没有输出mc账号 */ UNION ALL SELECT logymd, new_accountid /* 格式 ml_ +roleid */, new_zoneid FROM ml_act /* ml活跃 */) AS aa GROUP BY logymd), did_cnt /* 双端去重活跃did */ AS (SELECT logymd, COUNT(DISTINCT did) AS ml_mc_did_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tag = 'mlbb' THEN did ELSE NULL END) AS ml_did_count /* 设置成敏感列 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tag = 'mcgg' THEN did ELSE NULL END) AS mc_did_count /* 设置成敏感列 */ FROM (SELECT DISTINCT logymd, did, 'mlbb' AS tag FROM msdk_ods.moba_gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND NOT did IS NULL AND did <> '' AND did <> 'NULL' AND did <> 'null' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT '2026-05-30' AS logymd, did, 'mcgg' AS tag FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event /* mcgg的did */ WHERE logymd = '20260530' /* yymmdd格式 */ AND event = 'login' AND app_id = 4280 AND zone_id BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000) AS aa GROUP BY logymd), mlbb_dau /* 设置成敏感列 */ AS (SELECT logymd, COUNT(DISTINCT ml_roleid, ml_zoneid) AS ml_users_accountid_zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT ml_roleid) AS ml_users_accountid FROM ml_act GROUP BY logymd), mcgg_dau /* 设置成敏感列 */ AS (SELECT logymd, COUNT(DISTINCT mc_roleid, mc_zoneid) AS mc_users_accountid_zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT mc_roleid) AS mc_users_accountid FROM mc_act GROUP BY logymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.teemoyu_mlbb_mcgg_distinct_dau_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT DISTINCT a.ml_mc_users_accountid_zoneid, a.ml_mc_users_accountid, b.ml_mc_did_count, c.ml_users_accountid_zoneid /* 敏感列 */, c.ml_users_accountid /* 敏感列 */, b.ml_did_count /* 敏感列 */, d.mc_users_accountid_zoneid /* 敏感列 */, d.mc_users_accountid /* 敏感列 */, b.mc_did_count /* 敏感列 */ FROM ml_mc_users_cnt AS a LEFT JOIN did_cnt AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd LEFT JOIN mlbb_dau AS c ON a.logymd = c.logymd LEFT JOIN mcgg_dau AS d ON a.logymd = d.logymd

name: mcgg和ml双端roleid打通_更新
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: aprilgao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-02 18:15:23.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH valid_data AS (/* 基础过滤：仅保留 mlbb 和 mcgg，且 did 必须不为 NULL */ SELECT * FROM mt_dwm.dwm_did_mapping_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid IN ('mlbb', 'mcgg') AND NOT did IS NULL AND UPPER(did) <> 'NULL'), account_latest_record AS (/* ========================================== */ /* 步骤 1: 两个 app 均取每个 accountid 下 last_time 最近的一条记录 */ /* （确定每个账号最新使用的 did） */ /* ========================================== */ SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY appid, accountid ORDER BY TO_TIMESTAMP(last_time, 'yyyy/M/d H:m') DESC) AS acc_rn FROM valid_data) AS t WHERE acc_rn = 1), mcgg_base AS (/* ========================================== */ /* 步骤 2: 保留所有 mcgg 这样计算后的记录，作为主表 */ /* ========================================== */ SELECT * FROM account_latest_record WHERE appid = 'mcgg'), mlbb_did_latest_account AS (/* ========================================== */ /* 步骤 3: 如果 mlbb 的 did 有多个 accountid，再取该 did 下最近的 accountid */ /* （在步骤1的结果基础上，再做一次基于 did 的去重） */ /* ========================================== */ SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did ORDER BY TO_TIMESTAMP(last_time, 'yyyy/M/d H:m') DESC) AS did_rn FROM account_latest_record WHERE appid = 'mlbb') AS t WHERE did_rn = 1), did_link /* ========================================== */ /* 步骤 4: 用 mcgg 保留的主表 去 LEFT JOIN 处理后的 mlbb 表 */ /* ========================================== */ AS (SELECT m.accountid AS mcgg_accountid, m.zoneid AS mcgg_zoneid, m.did, m.deviceid AS mcgg_deviceid, m.first_time AS mcgg_first_time, m.last_time AS mcgg_last_time, l.accountid AS mlbb_accountid /* 关联过来的 mlbb 最新归属账号 */, l.last_time AS mlbb_last_time FROM mcgg_base AS m LEFT JOIN mlbb_did_latest_account AS l ON m.did = l.did) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc_ml_roleid_match PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT t1.*, t2.bind_mlbb_roleid AS mpass_ml_roleid, t3.did AS did_df, t3.mlbb_accountid AS did_ml_roleid, COALESCE(t2.bind_mlbb_roleid, t3.mlbb_accountid, ml_roleid_final) AS update_ml_roleid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, os_type, channel, os_language, ip_country, ad_id, did, ml_roleid_did, ml_zoneid_did, ml_lastactdate_did, ml_roleid_adid, ml_zoneid_adid, ml_lastactdate_adid, ml_roleid_mpass, ml_zoneid_mpass, ml_roleid_final, ml_zoleid_final, is_unbind, is_abnormal, is_emulator, is_pure, pure_new_type, bat_cnt_5v5_recent30, bat_cnt_5v5_recent90, bat_cnt_5v5_recent180, battletime_5v5_recent30, battletime_5v5_recent90, battletime_5v5_recent180, bat_cnt_39_recent30, bat_cnt_39_recent90, bat_cnt_39_recent180, battletime_39_recent30, battletime_39_recent90, battletime_39_recent180, media_source, tp, ad_country, gf_install, tft_install, mlbb_install, pvp2_his_last_bigrank, pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, pvp2_his_max_minranklvl, pvp39_his_last_bigrank, pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, pvp39_his_max_minranklvl, friend_cnt, his_last_activedate, activedays, classic_ranked_battledays_7days, classic_ranked_battledays_30days, his_classic_ranked_cnt, his_chess_cnt, his_charge_amt_total, gender, age, occupation, user_type, mlmc_time_type30 FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT bind_mcgg_roleid, bind_mlbb_roleid FROM mt_dim.dim_third_party_mpass_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND NOT bind_mcgg_roleid IS NULL AND NOT bind_mlbb_roleid IS NULL GROUP BY bind_mcgg_roleid, bind_mlbb_roleid) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.bind_mcgg_roleid LEFT OUTER JOIN did_link AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.mcgg_accountid AND t1.zoneid = t3.mcgg_zoneid

'2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (354, 353) GROUP BY roleid) AS e ON a.update_ml_roleid = e.roleid LEFT JOIN (/* 游廊界面354下载 */ SELECT accountid AS roleid, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS youlang_354_download_today, MAX(IF(logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 6 * -1) AND logymd <= '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS youlang_354_download_7d FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_gamemode_click_new WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 7 * -1) AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND pvptype = 354 AND next_button IN (12, 13, 14) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid) AS f ON a.update_ml_roleid = f.roleid LEFT JOIN (/* 游廊界面353下载 */ SELECT accountid AS roleid, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS youlang_353_download_today, MAX(IF(logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 6 * -1) AND logymd <= '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: crystalmei@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-09-29 14:16:48.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.mc_fake_quantity_users_total_v2 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.first_mt_country, a.statdate, first_network_name FROM (SELECT DISTINCT qt.roleid, qt.zoneid, qt.first_mt_country, qt.statdate FROM ml_temp.mc_network_role_jl_60d_result_v1 AS qt WHERE qt.statdate <= '2026-03-31' AND prob > 0.75 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, statdate FROM ml_temp.mc_network_role_jl_3d_result_v1 AS pr WHERE pr.statdate <= '2026-05-27' AND pr.statdate > '2026-05-23' AND /* AND     prediction > 0 */ prob > 0.5 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, statdate FROM ml_temp.mc_network_role_jl_7d_result_v1 AS pr7 WHERE pr7.statdate <= '2026-05-23' AND pr7.statdate > '2026-03-31' AND /* AND     prediction > 0 */ prob > 0.5) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, first_network_name FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND /* AND     register_date >= '2026-03-31' */ appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1) AS rzd ON a.roleid = rzd.roleid AND a.zoneid = rzd.zoneid AND (first_network_name NOT LIKE '%organic%' AND first_network_name NOT LIKE '%unknown%' AND first_network_name NOT LIKE '%xiaomi%' AND NOT first_network_name IS NULL)

name: 月登录玩家记录
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_hjli@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-06-26 15:55:17.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH monthly_active AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.ip_country, b.os_type, b.channel, MAX(a.if_new) AS new_tag, MAX(IF(a.if_new <> 1 AND c.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS return_tag FROM (/* 每日活跃用户 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, MAX(if_new) AS if_new FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, 0 AS if_new FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC('2025-05-30', 'MM') AND '2025-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_vp = 0 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, 1 AS if_new FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_create_role WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC('2025-05-30', 'MM') AND '2025-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_vp = 0) GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN (/* 获取其维度 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, ip_country, os_type, channel, usercreateymd FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-30') AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 历史30日是否登录，判定回流 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(TRUNC(DATE_ADD('2025-05-30', DAY('2025-05-30') * -1), 'MM'), 30 * -1) AND DATE_ADD('2025-05-30', 1 * -1) AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_vp = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND DATEDIFF(a.logymd, c.logymd) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 GROUP BY a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.ip_country, b.os_type, b.channel) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.daily_retention_month PARTITION(logymd = '2025-05-30') SELECT SUBSTRING('2025-05-30', 1, 7) AS month_true /* 任务执行月份 */, DAY('2025-05-30') AS day_s /* 当月第几天的任务 */, a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.ip_country, a.os_type, a.channel, MAX(CASE WHEN new_tag = 1 THEN 3 WHEN return_tag = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS roletype /* 3: 新增 2: 回流 1: 老用户 */, MIN(a.logymd) AS first_date /* 首次登录时间 */ FROM monthly_active AS a GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.ip_country, a.os_type, a.channel

h2.zoneid) GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN (/* 获取其维度 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, ip_country, os_type, channel, usercreateymd FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-31') AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 历史30日是否登录，判定回流 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(TRUNC(DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', DAY('2025-05-31') * -1), 'MM'), 30 * -1) AND DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', 1 * -1) AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 20000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_vp = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND DATEDIFF(a.logymd, c.logymd) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 GROUP BY a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.ip_country, b.os_type, b.channel) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_monthly_okr_new_di PARTITION(logymd = '2025-05-31') /* -拼接本月的MAU/新增/老用户等数据 */ SELECT SUBSTRING('2025-05-31', 1, 7) AS month /* 任务执行月份 */, DAY('2025-05-31') AS date /* 当月第几天的任务 */, SUBSTRING('2025-05-31', 1, 7) AS month_true /* 数据所属月份 */, t0.os_type, t0.ip_country, t0.channel, t0.monthly_dau /* 当月活跃拆分 */, t0.mau, t0.monthly_new, (t0.mau - t0.monthly_new) AS monthly_old, t0.monthly_return, (t0.mau - t0.monthly_new - t0.monthly_return) AS monthly_else, 0 AS next_new_active, 0 AS next_return_active, 0 AS next_else_active, t0.monthly_new_active AS new_active_daycnt, t0.monthly_old_active AS old_active_daycnt FROM (SELECT ip_country, os_type, channel, SUM(active_cnt) AS monthly_dau, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(roleid, zoneid)) AS mau, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(new_tag = 1, CONCAT(roleid, zoneid), NULL)) AS monthly_new, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(return_tag = 1, CONCAT(roleid, zoneid), NULL)) AS monthly_return, SUM(IF(new_tag = 1, active_cnt, 0)) AS monthly_new_active, SUM(IF(new_tag <> 1, active_cnt, 0)) AS monthly_old_active FROM (/* 当月日DAU、MAU、回流、 */ SELECT ip_country, os_type, channel, roleid, zoneid, MAX(new_tag) AS new_tag, MAX(return_tag) AS return_tag, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_cnt FROM monthly_active WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC('2025-05-31', 'MM') AND '2025-05-31' /* 计算当月数据 */ GROUP BY ip_country, os_type, channel, roleid, zoneid) GROUP BY ip_country, os_type, channel) AS t0 UNION ALL /* 上个月新增/回流/老用户的次月留存 */ SELECT SUBSTRING('2025-05-31', 1, 7) AS month /* 任务执行月份 */, DAY('2025-05-31') AS date /* 当月第几天的任务 */, SUBSTRING(DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', DAY('2025-05-31') * -1), 1, 7) AS month_true /* 数据所属月份 */, os_type, ip_country, channel, 0 AS monthly_dau /* 当月活跃拆分 */, 0 AS mau, 0 AS monthly_new, 0 AS monthly_old, 0 AS monthly_return, 0 AS monthly_else, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.new_tag = 1 AND NOT b.roleid IS NULL, CONCAT(a.zoneid, a.roleid), NULL)) AS next_new_active, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.return_tag = 1 AND NOT b.roleid IS NULL, CONCAT(a.zoneid, a.roleid), NULL)) AS next_return_active, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.return_tag <> 1 AND a.new_tag <> 1 AND NOT b.roleid IS NULL, CONCAT(a.zoneid, a.roleid), NULL)) AS next_else_active, 0 AS new_active_daycnt, 0 AS old_active_daycnt FROM (SELECT ip_country, os_type, channel, roleid, zoneid, MAX(new_tag) AS new_tag, MAX(return_tag) AS return_tag FROM monthly_active WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC(DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', DAY('2025-05-31') * -1), 'MM') AND DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', DAY('2025-05-31') * -1) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, ip_country, os_type, channel) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT zoneid, roleid FROM monthly_active WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC('2025-05-31', 'MM') AND '2025-05-31' GROUP BY zoneid, roleid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY SUBSTRING('2025-05-31', 1, 7), DAY('2025-05-31'), SUBSTRING(DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', DAY('2025-05-31') * -1), 1, 7), os_type, ip_country, channel

name: MC2月度OKR每日累计数据（多行为活跃）
output_hint: MC2月度OKR每日累计数据（多行为活跃）
sql_units:
/*
这些数据都是按月的，比如对于2025年1月的数据：
日均DAU：2025年1月1日-1月31日的DAU的平均值；
MAU:2025年1月登陆用户的去重值；
月新增用户：2025年1月1日-1月31日新增用户的求和值；
老用户MAU=MAU-月新增用户
回流MAU= 2025年1月1日-1月31日回流用户的求和值，回流按30日回流计算
非回流MAU(应当是非回流老用户MAU) = 老用户MAU-回流MAU
新增用户自然月留存= 2025年1月的新增用户在2月的MAU/ 2025年1月新增用户数
回流用户自然月留存=2025年1月的回流用户在2月的MAU/2025年1月回流MAU
非回流老用户自然月留存=2025年1月的非回流老用户在2月的MAU/2025年1月非回流老用户MAU
新增用户活跃度= 2025年1月新增用户在1月的活跃人次/1月天数/2025年1月新增用户数
老用户活跃度 = 2025年1月老用户在1月的活跃人次/1月天数/2025年1月老用户MAU
总活跃度= 2025年1月日均DAU/2025年1月MAU
累计总新增=截至2025年1月的总新增用户数
累计流失用户数 = 累计总新增- 2025年1月新增-2025年1月非回流老用户MAU
当月流失用户回流比例= 2025年1月回流用户MAU/累计流失用户数
*/ /* --每个分区存储的是 当月的最新累计数据 */ WITH monthly_active AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.ip_country, b.mt_country, b.os_type, b.channel, CASE WHEN a.logymd = b.create_role_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_new, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(c.logymd, b.create_role_date) > 30 AND DATEDIFF(c.logymd, c.his_last_active_second_date) > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_return_30 FROM (/* 每日活跃用户 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC(DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', DAY('2025-05-31') * -1), 'MM') AND '2025-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000) AS a LEFT JOIN (/* 获取用户创角维度 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_role_date, create_role_channel AS channel, UPPER(create_role_country) AS ip_country, UPPER(first_mt_country) AS mt_country, create_role_os_type AS os_type FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_second_date, logymd FROM mcgg_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC(DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', DAY('2025-05-31') * -1), 'MM') AND '2025-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND his_last_active_date = logymd /* 每日活跃的用户 */) AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.logymd = c.logymd), total_new AS (/* -CBT后累计新增及1128后累计新增 */ SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(b.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(a.create_role_channel, b.channel) AS channel, COALESCE(a.create_role_country, b.ip_country) AS ip_country, COALESCE(a.first_mt_country, b.first_mt_country) AS mt_country, COALESCE(a.create_role_os_type, b.os_type) AS os_type, COALESCE(a.create_role_date, b.usercreateymd) AS create_date FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_role_date, create_role_channel, UPPER(create_role_country) AS create_role_country, UPPER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, create_role_os_type FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000) AS a FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT t0.*, t1.first_mt_country FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, os_type, UPPER(ip_country) AS ip_country, channel FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000) AS t0 LEFT JOIN (/* 取用户首次归因渠道和国家 */ SELECT account_id, UPPER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-31' AND app_id = 4280) AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.account_id) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_monthly_okr_multiple_di PARTITION(logymd = '2025-05-31') /* -处理当月的数据 */ SELECT COALESCE(t0.month, t2.month) AS month /* -month和date用来作为维度topN的取值筛选，即选取每个月的最后一条（最新的数据） */, COALESCE(t0.date, t2.date) AS date, COALESCE(t0.month, t2.month) AS real_month /* -real_month和real_date用来作为数据所属于的月份。 */, COALESCE(t0.date, t2.date) AS real_date, COALESCE(t0.ip_country, t2.ip_country) AS ip_country, COALESCE(t0.os_type, t2.os_type) AS os_type, COALESCE(t0.channel, t2.channel) AS channel, t0.MAU, t0.new, t0.return, t0.total_active_day, t0.new_active_day, t0.return_active_day, 0 AS last_new, 0 AS last_return, 0 AS last_old, 0 AS last_new_retein, 0 AS last_return_retein, 0 AS last_old_retein, t2.register_big, t2.register_small FROM (SELECT SUBSTRING('2025-05-31', 1, 7) AS month, DAYOFMONTH('2025-05-31') AS date, ip_country, os_type, channel, COUNT(*) AS MAU, SUM(if_new) AS new, SUM(if_return_30) AS return, SUM(active_day) AS total_active_day, SUM(IF(if_new = 1, active_day, 0)) AS new_active_day, SUM(IF(if_return_30 = 1, active_day, 0)) AS return_active_day FROM (SELECT ip_country, mt_country, os_type, channel, roleid, zoneid, MAX(if_new) AS if_new, MAX(if_return_30) AS if_return_30, COUNT(*) AS active_day FROM monthly_active WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC('2025-05-31', 'MM') AND '2025-05-31' /* 当前月活跃用户 */ GROUP BY ip_country, mt_country, os_type, channel, roleid, zoneid) GROUP BY SUBSTRING('2025-05-31', 1, 7), DAYOFMONTH('2025-05-31'), ip_country, os_type, channel) AS t0 FULL OUTER JOIN (/* -拼接全量新增数据，需要CBT后累计新增以及1128后累计新增 */ SELECT SUBSTRING('2025-05-31', 1, 7) AS month, DAYOFMONTH('2025-05-31') AS date, ip_country, os_type, channel, SUM(1) AS register_big, SUM(IF(create_date >= '2024-11-28', 1, 0)) AS register_small FROM total_new GROUP BY SUBSTRING('2025-05-31', 1, 7), DAYOFMONTH('2025-05-31'), ip_country, os_type, channel) AS t2 ON t0.month = t2.month AND t0.date = t2.date AND t0.ip_country = t2.ip_country AND t2.os_type = t0.os_type AND t0.channel = t2.channel UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING('2025-05-31', 1, 7) AS month /* -month和date用来作为维度topN的取值筛选，即选取每个月的最后一条（最新的数据） */, DAYOFMONTH('2025-05-31') AS date, SUBSTRING(DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', DAYOFMONTH('2025-05-31') * -1), 1, 7) AS real_month /* -用real_month作为维度，数据所属的真实月份和真实日期 */, DAYOFMONTH(DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', DAYOFMONTH('2025-05-31') * -1)) AS real_date, ip_country, os_type, channel, 0 AS MAU, 0 AS new, 0 AS return, 0 AS total_active_day, 0 AS new_active_day, 0 AS return_active_day, t1.last_new, t1.last_return, t1.last_old, t1.last_new_retein, t1.last_return_retein, t1.last_old_retein, 0 AS register_big, 0 AS register_small FROM (SELECT ip_country, os_type, channel, SUM(IF(a.if_new = 1, 1, 0)) AS last_new, SUM(IF(a.if_return = 1, 1, 0)) AS last_return, SUM(IF(a.if_new = 0 AND a.if_return = 0, 1, 0)) AS last_old, SUM(IF(a.if_new = 1 AND NOT b.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS last_new_retein, SUM(IF(a.if_return = 1 AND NOT b.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS last_return_retein, SUM(IF(a.if_new = 0 AND a.if_return = 0 AND NOT b.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS last_old_retein FROM (/* -拼接上个月用户的留存 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, ip_country, channel, os_type, MAX(if_new) AS if_new, MAX(if_return_30) AS if_return FROM monthly_active WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC(DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', DAY('2025-05-31') * -1), 'MM') AND DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', DAYOFMONTH('2025-05-31') * -1) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, ip_country, channel, os_type) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM monthly_active WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', (DAYOFMONTH('2025-05-31') - 1) * -1) AND '2025-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY ip_country, os_type, channel) AS t1

name: mc转化每日计算
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_hjli@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-02-22 15:10:55.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH list_ AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country, MIN(user_type) AS user_type FROM ml_temp.kyra_mlbb_role_did_mc_df AS a WHERE logymd = '2025-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, first_mt_country), filter_info AS (SELECT a1.roleid, a1.first_mt_country, a1.user_type, MAX(CASE WHEN first_mt_country IN ('sg', 'my') AND his_last_active_date >= '2024-12-20' THEN 1 WHEN first_mt_country IN ('id', 'ph', 'mm', 'kh', 'la', 'th') AND his_last_active_date >= '2025-02-20' THEN 1 WHEN NOT first_mt_country IN ('sg', 'my', 'id', 'ph', 'mm', 'kh', 'la', 'th') AND his_last_active_date >= '2025-05-27' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_login, MAX(CASE WHEN first_mt_country IN ('sg', 'my') AND maxdate173 >= '2024-12-20' THEN 1 WHEN first_mt_country IN ('id', 'ph', 'mm', 'kh', 'la', 'th') AND maxdate173 >= '2025-02-20' THEN 1 WHEN NOT first_mt_country IN ('sg', 'my', 'id', 'ph', 'mm', 'kh', 'la', 'th') AND maxdate173 >= '2025-05-27' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_713, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT ml_roleid_final IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_mc FROM list_ AS a1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, MAX(his_last_active_date) AS his_last_active_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-31' GROUP BY roleid) AS a2 ON a1.roleid = a2.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, MAX(logymd) AS maxdate173 FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_arcademodebehavior WHERE clicktype IN (100, 99) AND pvptype = 353 AND logymd BETWEEN '2024-12-20' AND '2025-05-31' GROUP BY accountid) AS a3 ON IF(is_mc <> 1 AND is_login = 1, roleid, NULL)) AS logint_yes, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_mc <> 1 AND is_login = 1 AND is_713 = 1, roleid, NULL)) AS fw713 FROM filter_info GROUP BY first_mt_country, user_type

name: 696目标达人累积
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_hsu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-12-25 17:44:02.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH current_act AS (/* 取活动任务开始时间,结束时间 */ SELECT '2026-05-28' AS logymd, act_id, taskid, start_date, DATEDIFF('2026-05-28', start_date) + 1 AS day_gap FROM (SELECT * FROM mcgg_temp.susu_active_task_tmp WHERE logymd = GREATEST('2026-05-28', '2025-12-17')) WHERE '2026-05-28' BETWEEN start_date AND end_date GROUP BY '2026-05-28', act_id, taskid, start_date, day_gap), act_range AS (SELECT MIN(start_date) AS min_start_date FROM current_act), active_user AS (SELECT t0.logymd, t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, CASE WHEN t0.usercreateymd = '2026-05-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_new, COALESCE(CAST(t1.os_type AS STRING), 'unknown') AS os_type, COALESCE(CAST(t1.channel AS STRING), 'unknown') AS channel, COALESCE(CAST(t1.ip_country AS STRING), 'unknown') AS ip_country, COALESCE(CAST(t1.user_type AS STRING), 'unknown') AS user_type, COALESCE(CAST(t1.user_mc_type AS STRING), 'CBT注册用户') AS user_mc_type, COALESCE(CAST(t1.pure_new_type AS STRING), 'unknown') AS pure_new_type FROM (/* 取活跃用户 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login AS h1 CROSS JOIN act_range AS b WHERE h1.logymd BETWEEN min_start_date AND '2026-05-28' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_vp = 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mcgg_temp.kyra_black_role_df AS h2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-28' AND h1.roleid = h2.roleid AND h1.zoneid = h2.zoneid) GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd) AS t0 LEFT JOIN (/* -获取用户当日标签 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, os_type, channel, ip_country, his_last_activedate, user_type, CASE WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) >= 0.5 AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 5 THEN '1端内mc核心' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 >= 1 THEN '2端内mc泛玩家' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl >= 1 THEN '3ml活跃有mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '4ml活跃无mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate < DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '5ml流失' WHEN usercreateymd < '2024-11-28' THEN 'CBT注册用户' ELSE '6mc纯新' END AS user_mc_type, pure_new_type, pvp2_his_last_bigrank, pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, pvp39_his_last_bigrank, pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-28') AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid), dau AS (/* -拼接每个活动的详情 & 当日用户 */ SELECT act_id, start_date, taskid, day_gap, FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) AS zone, ip_country, os_type, channel, if_new, pure_new_type, user_type, user_mc_type, roleid, zoneid FROM active_user AS a CROSS JOIN current_act AS b WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN b.start_date AND '2026-05-28'), dau_cross AS (/* -活动详情 & 当日DAU */ SELECT act_id, start_date, taskid, day_gap, zone, ip_country, os_type, channel, if_new, pure_new_type, user_type, user_mc_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(roleid, zoneid)) AS DAU, 0 AS task_user FROM dau GROUP BY act_id, start_date, taskid, day_gap, zone, ip_country, os_type, channel, if_new, pure_new_type, user_type, user_mc_type), task_detail AS (/* -期间用户累计的参与任务数据 */ SELECT a.act_id, a.taskid, a.start_date, a.day_gap, FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) AS zone, b.ip_country, b.os_type, b.channel, b.if_new, b.pure_new_type, b.user_type, b.user_mc_type, 0 AS DAU, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid)) AS task_user FROM (SELECT a.act_id, a.taskid, COALESCE(CAST(t4.first_mt_country AS STRING), 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, t2.online_time, t3.bat_cnt, t3.battle_time, (t2.online_time - t3.battle_time) AS nonbat_time, t3.wincamp, timedelay, reconnectnum, ping, bat_cnt_39, battle_time_39, wincamp_39, timedelay_39, reconnectnum_39, ping_39, '2026-05-30' AS logymd_start FROM (/* 取最近一周的活跃用户 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd
