SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, os_type, channel, ip_country, his_last_activedate, user_type, CASE WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) >= 0.5 AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 5 THEN '1端内mc核心' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 >= 1 THEN '2端内mc泛玩家' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl >= 1 THEN '3ml活跃有mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '4ml活跃无mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate < DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '5ml流失' WHEN usercreateymd < '2024-11-28' THEN 'CBT注册用户' ELSE '6mc纯新' END AS user_mc_type, pure_new_type, pvp2_his_last_bigrank, pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, pvp39_his_last_bigrank, pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 取用户在线时长 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, SUM(online_time) AS online_time FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 6 * -1) AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t0.logymd = t2.logymd LEFT JOIN (/* 取用户战斗场次和战斗时长 */ SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, COUNT(battleid) AS bat_cnt, SUM(battletime) AS battle_time, AVG(wincamp) AS wincamp, AVG(timedelay) AS timedelay, AVG(reconnectnum) AS reconnectnum, AVG((ping120 + ping150 + ping200 + ping300 + ping500 + ping800) / ping_times) AS ping, COUNT(CASE WHEN pvptype = 39 THEN battleid END) AS bat_cnt_39, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 39 THEN battletime END) AS battle_time_39, AVG(CASE WHEN pvptype = 39 THEN wincamp END) AS wincamp_39, AVG(CASE WHEN pvptype = 39 THEN timedelay END) AS timedelay_39, AVG(CASE WHEN pvptype = 39 THEN reconnectnum END) AS reconnectnum_39, AVG(CASE WHEN pvptype = 39 THEN (ping120 + ping150 + ping200 + ping300 + ping500 + ping800) / ping_times END) AS ping_39 FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 6 * -1) AND '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND /* AND pvptype IN (39, 170) */ fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND camprank <> 0 GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid) AS t3 ON t0.roleid = t3.accountid AND t0.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND t0.logymd = t3.logymd LEFT JOIN (/* 取用户归因渠道和国家 */ SELECT account_id, MAX(first_media_source) AS first_media_source, MAX(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND app_id = 4280 GROUP BY account_id) AS t4 ON t0.roleid = t4.account_id

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_cumulative_data_new_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-28') SELECT COALESCE(CAST(t0.os_type AS STRING), 'unknown') AS os_type, COALESCE(CAST(t0.channel AS STRING), 'unknown') AS channel, COALESCE(CAST(t0.ip_country AS STRING), 'unknown') AS ip_country, COALESCE(CAST(t0.user_mc_type AS STRING), 'CBT注册用户') AS user_mc_type, COALESCE(CAST(t0.pure_new_type AS STRING), 'unknown') AS pure_new_type, COALESCE(CAST(t0.pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl AS STRING), 'unknown') AS pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, COALESCE(CAST(t0.pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl AS STRING), 'unknown') AS pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, COALESCE(CAST(t2.first_media_source AS STRING), 'unknown') AS first_media_source, COUNT(t0.roleid, t0.zoneid) AS register_big, SUM(t1.recharge1) / 100 AS recharge_big, COUNT(IF(t0.reg_type = 2, CONCAT(t0.roleid, t0.zoneid), NULL)) AS register_small, SUM(t1.recharge2) / 100 AS recharge_small FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, ip_country, channel, pure_new_type, CASE WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) >= 0.5 AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 5 THEN '1端内mc核心' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 >= 1 THEN '2端内mc泛玩家' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl >= 1 THEN '3ml活跃有mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '4ml活跃无mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate < DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '5ml流失' WHEN usercreateymd < '2024-11-28' THEN 'CBT注册用户' ELSE '6mc纯新' END AS user_mc_type, pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, CASE WHEN usercreateymd >= '2024-11-28' THEN 2 WHEN usercreateymd < '2024-11-28' THEN 1 END AS reg_type FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-28') AS t0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.recharge1, (a.recharge1 - b.recharge_before) AS recharge2 FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, total_amt AS recharge1 FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_user_charge_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-28') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, (total_amt - IF(last_pay_date = '2024-11-28', last_pay_amt, 0)) AS recharge_before FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_user_charge_df WHERE logymd = '2024-11-28') AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 取用户首次归因渠道和国家 */ SELECT account_id, MAX(first_media_source) AS first_media_source, MAX(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-28' AND app_id = 4280 GROUP BY account_id) AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.account_id GROUP BY COALESCE(CAST(t0.os_type AS STRING), 'unknown'), COALESCE(CAST(t0.channel AS STRING), 'unknown'), COALESCE(CAST(t0.ip_country AS STRING), 'unknown'), COALESCE(CAST(t0.user_mc_type AS STRING), 'CBT注册用户'), COALESCE(CAST(t0.pure_new_type AS STRING), 'unknown'), COALESCE(CAST(t0.pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl AS STRING), 'unknown'), COALESCE(CAST(t0.pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl AS STRING), 'unknown'), COALESCE(CAST(t2.first_media_source AS STRING), 'unknown')

name: adbi.dwm_market_google_ad_asset_conversions_df
sql_units: WITH asset_conversions AS (SELECT DISTINCT logymd AS pull_date, report_date, manager_id, account_id, app_id, os, campaign_id, adgroup_id, ad_id, asset_id, ad_network_type, SUM(IF(event_name LIKE '%pre-registration%', conversions, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, report_date, manager_id, account_id, app_id, os, campaign_id, adgroup_id, ad_id, asset_id, ad_network_type) AS pre_install, SUM(IF(event_name = 'first_open', conversions, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, report_date, manager_id, account_id, app_id, os, campaign_id, adgroup_id, ad_id, asset_id, ad_network_type) AS install, SUM(CASE WHEN event_name = 'in_app_purchase' AND app_id <> '1001' THEN IF(conversions_value > 0.0, conversions_value, all_conversions_value) WHEN event_name IN ('in_app_purchase', 'purchase') AND app_id = '1001' THEN IF(conversions_value > 0.0, conversions_value, all_conversions_value) ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, report_date, manager_id, account_id, app_id, os, campaign_id, adgroup_id, ad_id, asset_id, ad_network_type) AS conversions_value FROM (SELECT * FROM adbi.ods_market_google_adgroup_ad_asset_conversion_report WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, event_name FROM adbi.ods_market_google_conversion_action_report WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND event_name <> 'unknown' GROUP BY id, event_name) AS b ON a.conversion_id = b.id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwm_market_google_ad_asset_conversions_df PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT pull_date, report_date, manager_id, account_id, app_id, os, campaign_id, adgroup_id, ad_id, asset_id, ad_network_type, pre_install, install, conversions_value FROM asset_conversions UNION ALL SELECT pull_date, report_date, manager_id, account_id, app_id, os, campaign_id, adgroup_id, ad_id, asset_id, ad_network_type, pre_install, install, conversions_value FROM adbi.dwm_market_google_ad_asset_conversions_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30'

name: adbi.dwm_market_google_ad_asset_conversions_bitmap
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwm_market_google_ad_asset_conversions_bitmap PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT report_date, manager_id, account_id, app_id, os, campaign_id, adgroup_id, ad_id, asset_id, ad_network_type, pre_install, install, conversions_value, FILL_ARRAY(conversions_value_bitmap, report_date, '2026-05-31') AS conversions_value_bitmap FROM (SELECT report_date, manager_id, account_id, app_id, os, campaign_id, adgroup_id, ad_id, asset_id, ad_network_type, MAX(pre_install) AS pre_install, MAX(install) AS install, MAX(conversions_value) AS conversions_value, BUILD_ARRAY_INDEX(COLLECT_LIST(conversions_value_map), report_date, '30') AS conversions_value_bitmap FROM (SELECT report_date, manager_id, account_id, app_id, os, campaign_id, adgroup_id, ad_id, asset_id, ad_network_type, pre_install, install, conversions_value, MAP(pull_date, conversions_value * 100) AS conversions_value_map FROM adbi.dwm_market_google_ad_asset_conversions_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31') GROUP BY report_date, manager_id, account_id, app_id, os, campaign_id, adgroup_id, ad_id, asset_id, ad_network_type)

name: ml用户在mc中的活跃情况
sql_units: WITH ml_users AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, user_type, first_mt_country FROM ml_temp.kyra_mlbb_role_did_mc_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000), ml_activity AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(his_last_active_date) AS his_last_active_date_ml FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), transferred_users AS (SELECT ml_roleid_final, ml_zoleid_final, roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-31' AND zoneid < 50000 GROUP BY ml_roleid_final, ml_zoleid_final, roleid, zoneid), mc_activity AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(his_last_active_date) AS his_last_active_date_mc FROM mcgg_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), mc_ranks AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'a.勇士' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 'b.精英' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 6 AND 9 THEN 'c.大师' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 10 AND 16 THEN 'd.宗师' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 17 AND 25 THEN 'e.史诗' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN 'f.传奇' WHEN final_rank_id = 36 THEN 'g.神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 37 THEN 'h.百战神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 38 THEN 'i.荣耀神话' END) AS big_rank FROM mcgg_temp.daily_final_rank_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), chess_competitors AS (SELECT accountid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_competitor_account_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-31' AND LOWER(app_original_name) IN ('golden spatula', 'team fight tactics') GROUP BY accountid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.vickyyu_mlmc_label_final_df PARTITION(logymd = '2025-05-31') SELECT first_mt_country, CASE WHEN ml.his_last_active_date_ml < DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', 29 * -1) THEN 'ml流失' WHEN ml.his_last_active_date_ml >= DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', 29 * -1) THEN 'ml活跃' END AS ml_active_type, CASE WHEN a.user_type IN ('1端内mc核心', '2端内mc泛玩家', '3ml活跃有mc段位') THEN '有mc经验' ELSE '无mc经验' END AS mc_type, CASE WHEN NOT t.roleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_trans, CASE WHEN t.roleid IS NULL THEN '非转移用户' WHEN m.his_last_active_date_mc IS NULL THEN '无MC活跃记录' WHEN m.his_last_active_date_mc < DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', 29 * -1) THEN 'mc流失' WHEN m.his_last_active_date_mc >= DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', 29 * -1) THEN 'mc活跃' END AS mc_active_type, CASE WHEN r.big_rank IN ('a.勇士', 'b.精英', 'c.大师', 'd.宗师') THEN '史诗以下' WHEN r.big_rank IN ('e.史诗', 'f.传奇', 'g.神话', 'h.百战神话', 'i.荣耀神话') THEN '史诗及以上' END AS mc_rank, CASE WHEN NOT c.accountid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_chess_compet, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid)) AS user_cnt FROM ml_users AS a LEFT JOIN ml_activity AS ml ON a.roleid = ml.roleid AND a.zoneid = ml.zoneid LEFT JOIN transferred_users AS t ON a.roleid = t.ml_roleid_final AND a.zoneid = t.ml_zoleid_final LEFT JOIN mc_activity AS m ON t.roleid = m.roleid AND t.zoneid = m.zoneid LEFT JOIN mc_ranks AS r ON t.roleid = r.roleid AND t.zoneid = r.zoneid LEFT JOIN chess_competitors AS c ON a.roleid = c.accountid GROUP BY first_mt_country, CASE WHEN ml.his_last_active_date_ml < DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', 29 * -1) THEN 'ml流失' WHEN ml.his_last_active_date_ml >= DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', 29 * -1) THEN 'ml活跃' END, CASE WHEN a.user_type IN ('1端内mc核心', '2端内mc泛玩家', '3ml活跃有mc段位') THEN '有mc经验' ELSE '无mc经验' END, CASE WHEN NOT t.roleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t.roleid IS NULL THEN '非转移用户' WHEN m.his_last_active_date_mc IS NULL THEN '无MC活跃记录' WHEN m.his_last_active_date_mc < DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', 29 * -1) THEN 'mc流失' WHEN m.his_last_active_date_mc >= DATE_ADD('2025-05-31', 29 * -1) THEN 'mc活跃' END, CASE WHEN r.big_rank IN ('a.勇士', 'b.精英', 'c.大师', 'd.宗师') THEN '史诗以下' WHEN r.big_rank IN ('e.史诗', 'f.传奇', 'g.神话', 'h.百战神话', 'i.荣耀神话') THEN '史诗及以上' END, CASE WHEN NOT c.accountid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

vickyyu2@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-03-14 14:28:24.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH new_user AS (/* 30日新增用户 */ SELECT a.logymd AS return_date, a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.channel, b.ip_country, b.usercreateymd, b.user_type_new, b.pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, b.last_roleid_num, a.return_type, CASE WHEN LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%facebook%' OR LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%unattributed%' THEN 'facebook' WHEN LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%organic%' THEN 'organic' WHEN LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%tiktok%' THEN 'tiktok' WHEN LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%google ads%' THEN 'google' WHEN LOWER(media_source) IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'others' END AS tp, CASE WHEN LOWER(media_source) IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE media_source END AS media_source, pure_new_type FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, return_type FROM mcgg_temp.vickyyu_return_4tag_di /* 这张表存了每日的回流用户的tag */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-04-28' AND '2025-05-27' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND return_type <> 'e.active' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd, return_type) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, channel, LOWER(ip_country) AS ip_country, usercreateymd, CAST(SUBSTRING(roleid, -1) AS STRING) AS last_roleid_num, pure_new_type, CASE WHEN user_type IN ('MC纯新') THEN '6MC纯新' WHEN user_type IN ('ML流失') THEN '5ML流失' WHEN user_type = 'ML活跃' AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 5 AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) >= 0.5 THEN '1MC核心' WHEN user_type = 'ML活跃' AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 0 AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 <= 5 THEN '2MC泛用户' WHEN user_type = 'ML活跃' AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 0 AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) < 0.5 THEN '2MC泛用户' WHEN user_type = 'ML活跃' AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 = 0 AND NOT pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl IS NULL AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl > 0 THEN '3ML活跃非MC-有MC经验' WHEN user_type = 'ML活跃' AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 = 0 AND (pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl IS NULL OR pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl = 0) THEN '4ML活跃非MC-无MC经验' END AS user_type_new, CASE WHEN pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl END AS pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-27' /* AND     lower(ip_country) IN ('my', 'sg') */ GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, channel, ip_country, usercreateymd, user_type_new, pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, pure_new_type) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 取用户归因渠道和国家 */ SELECT account_id, MAX(first_media_source) AS media_source FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-27' AND app_id = 4280 GROUP BY account_id) AS t5 ON a.roleid = t5.account_id), daily_cnt AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.return_date, IF(COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) IS NULL, 0, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid)) AS history_cnt /* ---历史已经打了多少场 */, (100 - IF(COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) IS NULL, 0, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid))) AS today_cnt /* ----今日还需要储存的用户的条数 */ FROM new_user AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-04-28' AND '2025-05-26' AND fake_ai = 0 AND battleid <> 0 AND battle_count >= 1 AND NOT pvptype IN (6) AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND b.logymd >= a.return_date GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, return_date) WHERE today_cnt > 0 AND today_cnt <= 100), battle_detail AS (/* -仅抽取用户的当日 */ SELECT t0.logymd, t0.accountid, t0.zoneid, t0.battleid, t0.camprank, t0.minranklvl, return_date, (t0.bat_cnt + t1.history_cnt) AS battle_count /* -总场次信息 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, camprank, minranklvl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME ASC) AS bat_cnt /* -当日的第N场 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, camprank, minranklvl, TIME FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a WHERE logymd = '2025-05-27' AND fake_ai = 0 AND battleid <> 0 AND battle_count >= 1 AND NOT pvptype IN (6) AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' AND EXISTS(SELECT b.accountid, b.zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, zoneid FROM daily_cnt GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b WHERE a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, camprank, minranklvl, TIME)) AS t0 JOIN daily_cnt AS t1 ON t0.accountid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t0.bat_cnt <= t1.today_cnt WHERE t0.bat_cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND t0.bat_cnt <= t1.today_cnt), hero_info AS (SELECT logymd, zoneid, accountid, battleid, round, enemyaccountid, chessid, battleresult, chessmgdmg, chessprice, ailevel, chessstarlevel FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundheroinfo AS a WHERE logymd = '2025-05-27' AND enemyaccountid <> accountid AND ailevel = 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND accountid = ai_accountid AND EXISTS(SELECT b.roleid AS accountid, b.zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM daily_cnt GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b WHERE a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)), battleend AS (SELECT t1.*, t2.real_person_cnt, t2.matchtime, t0.channel, t0.ip_country, t0.user_type_new, t0.pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, t0.last_roleid_num, tp, media_source, return_type, DATEDIFF('2025-05-27', t1.return_date) + 1 AS reg_length, DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, t1.return_date) + 1 AS bat_onwhichday, pure_new_type FROM new_user AS t0 JOIN battle_detail AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.accountid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t0.return_date = t1.return_date JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, real_player_num AS real_person_cnt, matchtime FROM mcgg_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2025-05-27' AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, real_player_num, matchtime) AS t2 ON t1.battleid = t2.battleid AND t1.accountid = t2.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid), autochess AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, battle_round /* -羁绊可以补在这里 */, CASE WHEN SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(hotlineup, '\\073')[1], ':')[1], ',')[0], '/')[1] IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(hotlineup, '\\073')[1], ':')[1], ',')[0], '/')[1] END AS top1_rel /* --凑成的最高羁绊数 */, issurrender, lineupnum /* -阵容棋子数 */, CASE WHEN battlerank = 1 THEN SPLIT(SPLIT(roundinformation, '\\073')[battle_round - 2], ',')[1] ELSE NULL END AS blood_lastround /* -战斗结束血量 */ FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew AS a WHERE logymd = '2025-05-27' AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' AND ailevel = 0 AND battleid <> 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND EXISTS(SELECT b.accountid, b.zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, zoneid FROM daily_cnt GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b WHERE a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, battle_round, SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(hotlineup, '\\073')[1], ':')[1], ',')[0], '/')[1], issurrender, lineupnum, CASE WHEN battlerank = 1 THEN SPLIT(SPLIT(roundinformation, '\\073')[battle_round - 2], ',')[1] ELSE NULL END), roundinfo_converge AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, SUM(CASE WHEN battleresult = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_round FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, battleresult FROM hero_info WHERE logymd = '2025-05-27' AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' AND ailevel = 0 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, battleresult) AS t GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid), last_round AS (SELECT t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid, MAX(chessstarlevel) AS max_chess_star, MAX(chessprice) AS max_chess_price FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, chessid, chessstarlevel, chessprice FROM hero_info WHERE logymd = '2025-05-27' AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' AND ailevel = 0) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, MAX(round) AS last_round FROM hero_info WHERE logymd = '2025-05-27' AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' AND ailevel = 0 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid) AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t1.battleid = t2.battleid AND t1.round = t2.last_round GROUP BY t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.vickyyu_abtest_return_100_battle_today PARTITION(logymd = '2025-05-27') SELECT t2.accountid AS roleid, t2.zoneid, t2.battleid, t2.camprank, t2.minranklvl, t2.battle_count, t2.real_person_cnt, t2.matchtime, t2.channel, t2.ip_country, t2.return_date, t2.user_type_new, t2.pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, t2.last_roleid_num, t2.tp, t2.media_source, t2.reg_length, t2.bat_onwhichday, t3.battle_round, t3.top1_rel /* 可能的羁绊信息 */, t3.issurrender, t3.lineupnum, t3.blood_lastround, t4.win_round, t5.max_chess_star, t5.max_chess_price, CASE WHEN t2.camprank = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS top1_rank, CASE WHEN t2.camprank <= 4 AND t2.camprank >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS top4_rank, CASE WHEN t2.camprank = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_invalid, CASE WHEN t2.camprank = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS top8_rank, pure_new_type, return_type FROM battleend AS t2 LEFT OUTER JOIN autochess AS t3 ON t2.accountid = t3.accountid AND t2.battleid = t3.battleid AND t2.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT OUTER JOIN roundinfo_converge AS t4 ON t2.accountid = t4.accountid AND t2.zoneid = t4.zoneid AND t2.battleid = t4.battleid LEFT OUTER JOIN last_round AS t5 ON t2.accountid = t5.accountid AND t2.zoneid = t5.zoneid AND t2.battleid = t5.battleid WHERE battle_count <= 100

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: vickyyu2@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-08-27 20:26:13.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.vickyyu_back_detail_info PARTITION(logymd = '2025-05-29') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, return_type, ip_country, usercreateymd, user_type_new, pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, his_last_active_level, his_last_active_date, his_activedays, his_online_dur, his_last_bigrank_level, his_last_minrank_level, max_bigrank_level, max_minrank_level, his_last_ml_roleid, his_last_ml_zoneid, mlbb_install AS createrole_ml_install, day_ml_install AS back_ml_install FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN return_type = 'a.7-13' THEN 'a.7-13' WHEN return_type = 'b.14-29' THEN 'b.14-29' WHEN return_type IN ('c.30-59', 'd.60+') THEN 'c.30+' END AS return_type FROM mcgg_temp.vickyyu_return_4tag_di WHERE logymd = '2025-05-29' AND return_type <> 'e.active') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, channel, ip_country, usercreateymd, CASE WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) >= 0.5 AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 5 THEN '1端内mc核心' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 >= 1 THEN '2端内mc泛玩家' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl >= 1 THEN '3ml活跃有mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '4ml活跃无mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate < DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '5ml流失' WHEN usercreateymd < '2024-11-28' THEN 'CBT注册用户' ELSE '6mc纯新' END AS user_type_new, pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, pure_new_type, pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, mlbb_install FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-29' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, channel, ip_country, usercreateymd, user_type_new, pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, pure_new_type, pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, mlbb_install) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_level, his_last_active_date, his_activedays, his_online_dur, his_last_bigrank_level, his_last_minrank_level, max_bigrank_level, max_minrank_level, his_last_ml_roleid, his_last_ml_zoneid FROM mcgg_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df_external WHERE logymd = '2025-05-28') AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, day_ml_install FROM mcgg_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2025-05-29') AS t4 ON t1.roleid = t4.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t4.zoneid

name: MC2_逐季BP购买情况_带抽奖
sql_units: /* 7) Overwrite today’s partition with the union of history + current */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: selinasun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-05-29 17:04:52.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH current_bp /* 1) Determine the current Battle Pass “season” for 2025-05-28 */ AS (SELECT CASE WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2024-11-29' AND '2024-12-31' THEN '2024-12' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-25' THEN '2025-01' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-01-26' AND '2025-02-19' THEN '2025-02' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-02-20' AND '2025-03-25' THEN '2025-03' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-03-26' AND '2025-04-25' THEN '2025-04' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-04-26' AND '2025-05-26' THEN '2025-05' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-05-27' AND '2025-06-27' THEN '2025-06' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-06-28' AND '2025-07-31' THEN '2025-07' ELSE DATE_FORMAT('2025-05-28', 'yyyy-MM') END AS current_bp_season, CASE WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2024-11-29' AND '2024-12-31' THEN '2024-11-29' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-25' THEN '2025-01-01' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-01-26' AND '2025-02-19' THEN '2025-01-26' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-02-20' AND '2025-03-25' THEN '2025-02-20' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-03-26' AND '2025-04-25' THEN '2025-03-26' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-04-26' AND '2025-05-26' THEN '2025-04-26' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-05-27' AND '2025-06-27' THEN '2025-05-27' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-06-28' AND '2025-07-31' THEN '2025-06-28' ELSE DATE_FORMAT('2025-05-28', 'yyyy-MM-01') END AS current_bp_start_date), historical_data /* 2) Pull all partitions except the current one (yesterday’s snapshot) */ AS (SELECT bp_season, bp_start_date, bp_end_date, date_diff, zone_type, os_type, channel, is_new, ml_install, ip_country, pure_new_type, user_mc_type, dau, bp_normal, bp_plus, bp_upgrade, bp_lvlup, bp_draw, bp_total_diamond, bp_total_usercnt, bp_normal_usercnt, bp_plus_usercnt, draw_dau, total_draw_times, reward_collect_usercnt, first_reward_drawtimes FROM mcgg_temp.selinasun_monthly_bppurchase_starlightdraw WHERE logymd = '2025-05-27' AND bp_season <> (SELECT current_bp_season FROM current_bp)), login_data /* 3) Build “login_data”: one row per (logymd, roleid, zoneid) in the current BP window */ AS (SELECT h1.roleid AS roleid, h1.zoneid AS zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN usercreateymd >= '2026-05-13' AND usercreateymd >= DATE_ADD('2025-05-28', 24 * -1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_new /* 2026-04-30开始新手BP上线，新手BP窗口：新增后25天（包括新增当天） */, CASE WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2024-11-29' AND '2024-12-31' THEN '2024-12' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-25' THEN '2025-01' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-01-26' AND '2025-02-19' THEN '2025-02' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-02-20' AND '2025-03-25' THEN '2025-03' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-03-26' AND '2025-04-25' THEN '2025-04' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-04-26' AND '2025-05-26' THEN '2025-05' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-05-27' AND '2025-06-27' THEN '2025-06' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-06-28' AND '2025-07-31' THEN '2025-07' /* -6月BP时间窗口可能会改 */ ELSE DATE_FORMAT('2025-05-28', 'yyyy-MM') END AS bp_season /* assign the season label */, CASE WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2024-11-29' AND '2024-12-31' THEN '2024-11-29' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-25' THEN '2025-01-01' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-01-26' AND '2025-02-19' THEN '2025-01-26' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-02-20' AND '2025-03-25' THEN '2025-02-20' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-03-26' AND '2025-04-25' THEN '2025-03-26' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-04-26' AND '2025-05-26' THEN '2025-04-26' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-05-27' AND '2025-06-27' THEN '2025-05-27' WHEN '2025-05-28' BETWEEN '2025-06-28' AND '2025-07-31' THEN '2025-06-28' ELSE DATE_FORMAT('2025-05-28', 'yyyy-MM-01') END AS bp_start_date /* compute the start date of that season */, '2025-05-28' AS bp_end_date FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login AS h1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_temp.kyra_black_role_df AS h2 WHERE logymd = '2025-05-28') AS h2 ON h1.roleid = h2.roleid AND h1.zoneid = h2.zoneid WHERE logymd BETWEEN (SELECT current_bp_start_date FROM current_bp) AND '2025-05-28' AND h1.zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_vp = 0 AND h2.roleid IS NULL GROUP BY h1.roleid, h1.zoneid, bp_season, bp_start_date, bp_end_date), user_info /* 4) Pull user‐info enrichments for those same players */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(mlbb_install = 1, mlbb_install, 0) AS ml_install, ip_country, os_type, channel, pure_new_type, CASE WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) >= 0.5 AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 5 THEN '1端内mc核心' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 >= 1 THEN '2端内mc泛玩家' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl >= 1 THEN '3ml活跃有mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '4ml活跃无mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate < DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '5ml流失' WHEN usercreateymd < '2024-11-28' THEN 'CBT注册用户' ELSE '6mc纯新' END AS user_mc_type FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-27' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, IF(mlbb_install = 1, mlbb_install, 0), ip_country, os_type, channel, pure_new_type, CASE WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) >= 0.5 AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 5 THEN '1端内mc核心' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 >= 1 THEN '2端内mc泛玩家' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl >= 1 THEN '3ml活跃有mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '4ml活跃无mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate < DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '5ml流失' WHEN usercreateymd < '2024-11-28' THEN 'CBT注册用户' ELSE '6mc纯新' END UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, 0 AS ml_install, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS ip_country /* 玩家的id地址解析的国家，因为上游T+1表这时候还没有，且上游国家归因到多层匹配处理，先用这个替代 */, os_type /* 操作系统 */, channel /* 渠道 */, NULL AS pure_new_type, NULL AS user_mc_type FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_create_role /* 创角表 */ WHERE logymd = '2025-05-28' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND is_vp = 0 AND fake_ai = 0), bp_data /* 5) Gather all BP purchase events for the season window */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN usercreateymd = logymd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_new, SUM(IF(operate = 'action_act_mc2battlepass', sub_num, 0)) AS bp_normal, SUM(IF(operate = 'action_act_mc2battlepass_plus', sub_num, 0)) AS bp_plus, SUM(IF(operate = 'action_act_mc2battlepass_upgrade', sub_num, 0)) AS bp_upgrade, SUM(IF(operate = 'action_act_mc2battlepasslevelup', sub_num, 0)) AS bp_lvlup, SUM(IF(operate = 'action_act_bpstarlightdraw', sub_num, 0)) AS bp_draw, SUM(sub_num) AS bp_total_diamond FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd BETWEEN (SELECT current_bp_start_date FROM current_bp) AND '2025-05-28' AND (operate LIKE '%mc2battlepass%' OR operate LIKE '%bp%') AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), bp_active_data AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(active_type) AS final_active_type FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_mc2_battlepass_active WHERE logymd BETWEEN (SELECT current_bp_start_date FROM current_bp) AND '2025-05-28' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), bp_draw_data /* 3) Final draw‐times per user over the whole season */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(CASE WHEN reward_id IN (559, 560) THEN times ELSE NULL END) AS first_reward_drawtimes, MAX(times) AS total_draw_times FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_act_starsdraw2025 WHERE logymd BETWEEN (SELECT current_bp_start_date FROM current_bp) AND '2025-05-28' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), current_data /* 6) Aggregate today’s data into the same schema */ AS (SELECT ld.bp_season, ld.bp_start_date, ld.bp_end_date, DATEDIFF(bp_end_date, ld.bp_start_date) + 1 AS date_diff, FLOOR(ld.zoneid / 1000) AS zone_type, ui.os_type, ui.channel, MAX(ld.is_new) AS is_new, ui.ml_install, ui.ip_country, ui.pure_new_type, ui.user_mc_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(ld.roleid, '-', ld.zoneid)) AS dau, SUM(bp_normal) AS bp_normal /* BP purchase diamond */, SUM(bp_plus) AS bp_plus, SUM(bp_upgrade) AS bp_upgrade, SUM(bp_lvlup) AS bp_lvlup, SUM(bp_draw) AS bp_draw, SUM(bp_total_diamond) AS bp_total_diamond, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(bactive.roleid, '-', bactive.zoneid)) AS bp_total_usercnt /* BP final active type usercnt */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bactive.final_active_type = 1 THEN CONCAT(bactive.roleid, '-', bactive.zoneid) END) AS bp_normal_usercnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bactive.final_active_type = 2 THEN CONCAT(bactive.roleid, '-', bactive.zoneid) END) AS bp_plus_usercnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(bdraw.roleid, '-', bdraw.zoneid)) AS draw_dau /* BP draw related */, SUM(bdraw.total_draw_times) AS total_draw_times, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT first_reward_drawtimes IS NULL THEN CONCAT(bdraw.roleid, '-', bdraw.zoneid) END) AS reward_collect_usercnt, SUM(bdraw.first_reward_drawtimes) AS first_reward_drawtimes FROM login_data AS ld LEFT JOIN user_info AS ui ON ld.roleid = ui.roleid AND ld.zoneid = ui.zoneid LEFT JOIN bp_data AS bd ON ld.roleid = bd.roleid AND ld.zoneid = bd.zoneid LEFT JOIN bp_active_data AS bactive ON ld.roleid = bactive.roleid AND ld.zoneid = bactive.zoneid LEFT JOIN bp_draw_data AS bdraw ON ld.roleid = bdraw.roleid AND ld.zoneid = bdraw.zoneid WHERE ld.bp_season = (SELECT current_bp_season FROM current_bp) GROUP BY ld.bp_season, ld.bp_start_date, ld.bp_end_date, FLOOR(ld.zoneid / 1000), ui.os_type, ui.channel, ui.ml_install, ui.ip_country, ui.pure_new_type, ui.user_mc_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.selinasun_monthly_bppurchase_starlightdraw PARTITION(logymd = '2025-05-28') SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM historical_data UNION ALL SELECT * FROM current_data) AS combined_result

name: MC2每日活跃用户总况指标
output_hint: MC2每日活跃用户总况指标
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_sjlv@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-02-28 17:58:04.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH daily_active AS (SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.logymd, t0.usercreateymd, t0.channel AS day_first_channel, t0.os_type AS day_first_os_type, t0.ip_country AS day_first_country, t1.os_type AS create_os_type, t1.channel AS create_channel, t1.ip_country AS create_country, t1.pure_new_type, t1.ml_install, t1.user_tag_active, t1.pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, t1.pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, t1.ml_roleid_final, t4.first_media_source, t4.last_media_source, t4.first_mt_country FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd, channel, os_type, ip_country FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd, channel, os_type, ip_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY rk1 ASC, time ASC) AS rk FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd, channel, os_type, ip_country, rk1, MIN(time) AS time /* -预处理去除重复平台等日志 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd, channel, os_type, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS ip_country, time, 1 AS rk1 FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login AS h1 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mcgg_temp.kyra_black_role_df AS h2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND h1.roleid = h2.roleid AND h1.zoneid = h2.zoneid) UNION ALL /* -拼接付费日志，防止丢流水 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd, channel, os_type, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS ip_country, time, 2 AS rk1 FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND money > 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND is_sandbox = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd, channel, os_type, ip_country, rk1)) WHERE rk = 1 /* 取首条channel，优先取login，如果没有login日志取charge首条 */) AS t0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, channel, ip_country, pure_new_type, MAX(ml_install) AS ml_install, MIN(user_tag_active) AS user_tag_active, MAX(pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl) AS pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, MAX(pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl) AS pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, MIN(ml_roleid_final) AS ml_roleid_final FROM (/* -获取用户当日标签 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, channel, ip_country, mlbb_install AS ml_install, CASE WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) >= 0.5 AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 5 THEN '1端内mc核心' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 >= 1 THEN '2端内mc泛玩家' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl >= 1 THEN '3ml活跃有mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '4ml活跃无mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate < DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '5ml流失' WHEN usercreateymd < '2024-11-28' THEN 'CBT注册用户' ELSE '6mc纯新' END AS user_tag_active, pure_new_type, pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, ml_roleid_final FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, os_type, channel, ip_country, mlbb_install, CASE WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) >= 0.5 AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 5 THEN '1端内mc核心' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 >= 1 THEN '2端内mc泛玩家' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl >= 1 THEN '3ml活跃有mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '4ml活跃无mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate < DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '5ml流失' WHEN usercreateymd < '2024-11-28' THEN 'CBT注册用户' ELSE '6mc纯新' END, pure_new_type, pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, ml_roleid_final) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, os_type, channel, ip_country, pure_new_type) AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 取用户归因渠道和国家 */ SELECT account_id, MAX(first_media_source) AS first_media_source, MAX(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, MAX(last_media_source) AS last_media_source FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND app_id = 4280 GROUP BY account_id) AS t4 ON t0.roleid = t4.account_id), daily_data AS (SELECT t0.*, t5.online_time, t5.yl_online_time, t5.else_online_time, t6.bat_cnt, t6.battle_time, t6.yl_bat_cnt, t6.yl_battle_time, t6.else_bat_cnt, t6.else_battle_time, t8.yl_pay_amt, t7.else_pay_amt FROM daily_active AS t0 LEFT JOIN (/* 取用户当日在线时长 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(online_time) AS online_time, SUM(IF(channel IN ('and_mllobby', 'ios_mllobby'), online_time, 0)) AS yl_online_time, SUM(IF(NOT channel IN ('and_mllobby', 'ios_mllobby'), online_time, 0)) AS else_online_time FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t5 ON t0.roleid = t5.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t5.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 取用户当日战斗场次和战斗时长 */ SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(battleid) AS bat_cnt, SUM(battletime) AS battle_time, COUNT(IF(channel IN ('and_mllobby', 'ios_mllobby'), 1, NULL)) AS yl_bat_cnt, SUM(IF(channel IN ('and_mllobby', 'ios_mllobby'), battletime, 0)) AS yl_battle_time, COUNT(IF(NOT channel IN ('and_mllobby', 'ios_mllobby'), 1, NULL)) AS else_bat_cnt, SUM(IF(NOT channel IN ('and_mllobby', 'ios_mllobby'), battletime, 0)) AS else_battle_time FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, battletime, channel FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND camprank <> 0 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, battletime, channel) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS t6 ON t0.roleid = t6.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t6.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money) AS else_pay_amt FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND money > 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 /* 排除代币购买数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND is_sandbox = 0 /* 排除沙盒测试数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷苹果假冒卡 (有收入) 数据, 因为点卡的 receipt_id = 0 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* GP 礼品卡, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t7 ON t0.roleid = t7.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t7.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(cost_num) * 100 AS yl_pay_amt FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_act_mcoin_exchange WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND cost_num > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t8 ON t0.roleid = t8.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t8.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_active_user_data_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.usercreateymd, MAX(IF(a.usercreateymd = a.logymd, 1, 0)) AS if_new /* 1：当日新增, 0:非当日新增 */, 1 - MAX(IF((a.usercreateymd = a.logymd) OR (a.usercreateymd < a.logymd AND DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.logymd) BETWEEN 1 AND 30), 1, 0)) AS if_return_30 /* 1:当日30日回流，0：非30回流 */, 1 - MAX(IF((a.usercreateymd = a.logymd) OR (a.usercreateymd < a.logymd AND DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.logymd) BETWEEN 1 AND 90), 1, 0)) AS if_return_90, 1 - MAX(IF((a.usercreateymd = a.logymd) OR (a.usercreateymd < a.logymd AND DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.logymd) BETWEEN 1 AND 180), 1, 0)) AS if_return_180, a.create_os_type, a.create_channel, a.create_country, a.pure_new_type, a.ml_install, a.user_tag_active, a.pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, a.pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, a.ml_roleid_final, a.first_media_source, a.last_media_source, a.first_mt_country, a.day_first_channel, a.day_first_os_type, a.day_first_country, a.online_time, a.yl_online_time, a.else_online_time, a.bat_cnt, a.battle_time, a.yl_bat_cnt, a.yl_battle_time, a.else_bat_cnt, a.else_battle_time, a.yl_pay_amt, a.else_pay_amt FROM daily_data AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 180 * -1) AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 1 * -1) AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND logymd >= '2024-08-06' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.usercreateymd, a.create_os_type, a.create_channel, a.create_country, a.pure_new_type, a.ml_install, a.user_tag_active, a.pvp2_his_max_bigranklvl, a.pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl, a.ml_roleid_final, a.first_media_source, a.last_media_source, a.first_mt_country, a.day_first_channel, a.day_first_os_type, a.day_first_country, a.online_time, a.yl_online_time, a.else_online_time, a.bat_cnt, a.battle_time, a.yl_bat_cnt, a.yl_battle_time, a.else_bat_cnt, a.else_battle_time, a.yl_pay_amt, a.else_pay_amt

name: W5全量活跃中间表
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE wegame_temp.w5_dm_multi_active_role_temp PARTITION(logymd = '${DATE-1}') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.zone_type, a.is_init_bot, a.is_cur_bot, a.is_first_create, a.account_name, a.did, a.register_date, a.register_time, a.register_channel, a.register_sub_channel, a.first_mt_country, a.create_country, a.create_province, a.create_city, a.register_os, a.create_ip, a.first_network_name, a.last_active_os, a.last_os_language, a.last_os_version, a.last_device_id, a.last_device_model, a.last_loginclient_version, a.last_client_language, a.last_active_ip, a.last_active_channel, a.last_active_sub_channel, a.last_active_date, a.last_province, a.last_city, a.login_cnt, a.online_dur, a.online_dur_7days, a.online_dur_30days, a.online_dur_resgister_7days, a.online_dur_register_30days, a.activedays_7days, a.activedays_30days, a.activedays_register_7days, a.activedays_register_30days, a.activedays_total, a.first_charge_date, a.last_charge_date, a.charge_amt, a.charge_cnt, a.charge_amt_7days, a.charge_amt_30days, a.charge_amt_90days, a.charge_amt_register_7days, a.charge_amt_register_30days, a.charge_amt_register_90days, a.charge_cnt_7days, a.charge_cnt_30days, a.charge_cnt_register_7days, a.charge_cnt_register_30days, a.charge_cnt_total, a.charge_amt_total, a.his_last_day_charge_amt, a.war_stage, a.is_active, a.accountid, b.level AS role_level, b.player_name, start_mainstage.roleid AS day_mainstage_roleid, day_start_mainstage, day_start_mainstagenum, day_mainstagenum, day_success_mainstagenum, CASE WHEN battle.day_start_elite_mainstagenum > 0 THEN a.roleid END AS day_elite_mainstage_roleid, day_start_elite_mainstage, day_start_elite_mainstagenum, CASE WHEN battle.day_cooperationstagenum > 0 THEN a.roleid END AS day_cooperation_roleid, day_cooperationstage, day_cooperationstagenum, CASE WHEN material.day_material1_stagenum > 0 THEN a.roleid END AS day_material1_roleid, day_material1_stage, day_material1_stagenum, CASE WHEN material.day_material2_stagenum > 0 THEN a.roleid END AS day_material2_roleid, day_material2_stage, day_material2_stagenum, CASE WHEN material.day_material3_stagenum > 0 THEN a.roleid END AS day_material3_roleid, day_material3_stage, day_material3_stagenum, day_sub_energy, day_idle_sub_energy, day_sub_diamond, day_gacha_sub_diamond, day_dailyshop_sub_diamond, day_valuepackage_sub_diamond, day_add_diamond, day_act_add_diamond, day_iap_add_diamond, day_ads_click_num, day_ads_reward_num, day_iaa_charge, media_source, campaign_name, adgroup_name, equipment_list, hero_list, remain_diamonds, remain_coin, remain_energy, main_stage_hard, remain_item1, remain_item2, remain_item3, last_verify_power, armband, talent_list, main_character_skin, weapon_skin, equip_info, tool_info, object_info, armband_level, office_level, vip_info, day_101_add, day_102_add, day_gacha1_cnt, day_gacha2_cnt, day_coin_add_num, day_coin_subnum, online_dur /* 兼容处理 */ / 60 AS day_online_time, first_charge_date AS new_first_payment_date, CASE WHEN a.charge_amt > 0 THEN a.roleid END AS day_charge_roleid FROM (SELECT *, SUBSTRING(roleid, 0, 10) AS accountid FROM w5_dw.dm_multi_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND is_active = '1' AND zoneid >= 10000) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, MAX(level) AS level, MAX(total_payment) AS total_payment, MAX(player_name) AS player_name, MAX(detected_quality_level) AS detected_quality_level FROM w5_ods.login WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.logymd = b.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = '1' THEN stage_id END) AS day_start_mainstage, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_type = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_start_mainstagenum FROM w5_ods.start_challenge WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND stage_type = '1' AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS start_mainstage ON a.roleid = start_mainstage.roleid AND a.zoneid = start_mainstage.zoneid AND a.logymd = start_mainstage.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, MAX(IF(result = 1, stage_id, war_stage)) AS day_mainstage, COUNT(1) AS day_mainstagenum, SUM(IF(result = 1, 1, 0)) AS day_success_mainstagenum FROM w5_ods.finish_challenge WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND stage_type = '1' AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS mainstage ON a.roleid = mainstage.roleid AND a.zoneid = mainstage.zoneid AND a.logymd = mainstage.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = '3' THEN stage_id END) AS day_start_elite_mainstage, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_type = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_start_elite_mainstagenum, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = '5' THEN stage_id END) AS day_cooperationstage, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_type = '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_cooperationstagenum FROM w5_ods.battle_start WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND stage_type IN ('3', '5') AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS battle ON a.roleid = battle.roleid AND a.zoneid = battle.zoneid AND a.logymd = battle.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, MAX(CASE WHEN material_stage_type = '1' THEN material_stage_id END) AS day_material1_stage, SUM(CASE WHEN material_stage_type = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_material1_stagenum, MAX(CASE WHEN material_stage_type = '2' THEN material_stage_id END) AS day_material2_stage, SUM(CASE WHEN material_stage_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_material2_stagenum, MAX(CASE WHEN material_stage_type = '3' THEN material_stage_id END) AS day_material3_stage, SUM(CASE WHEN material_stage_type = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_material3_stagenum FROM w5_ods.material_stage_finish_challenge WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND material_stage_type IN ('1', '2', '3') AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS material ON a.roleid = material.roleid AND a.zoneid = material.zoneid AND a.logymd = material.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(sub_num) AS day_sub_energy, SUM(IF(operate = 'stage_patrol_reward', sub_num, 0)) AS day_idle_sub_energy FROM w5_ods.sub_energy WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS energy ON a.roleid = energy.roleid AND a.zoneid = energy.zoneid AND a.logymd = energy.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(sub_num) AS day_sub_diamond, SUM(IF(operate RLIKE 'gacha', sub_num, 0)) AS day_gacha_sub_diamond, SUM(IF(operate = 'act_dailyshop_buyitem', sub_num, 0)) AS day_dailyshop_sub_diamond, SUM(IF(operate = 'act_valuepackage_buyitem', sub_num, 0)) AS day_valuepackage_sub_diamond FROM w5_ods.sub_diamond WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS diamondsub ON a.roleid = diamondsub.roleid AND a.zoneid = diamondsub.zoneid AND a.logymd = diamondsub.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(add_num) AS day_add_diamond, SUM(CASE WHEN ispay = 0 THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_add_freediamond, SUM(CASE WHEN ispay = 1 THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_add_paydiamond, SUM(IF(operate RLIKE 'act_', add_num, 0)) AS day_act_add_diamond, SUM(IF(operate RLIKE 'iap', add_num, 0)) AS day_iap_add_diamond FROM w5_ods.add_diamond WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS diamondadd ON a.roleid = diamondadd.roleid AND a.zoneid = diamondadd.zoneid AND a.logymd = diamondadd.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(IF(ads_operation = 'click_button', 1, 0)) AS day_ads_click_num, SUM(IF(ads_operation = 'reward_success', 1, 0)) AS day_ads_reward_num FROM w5_ods.c_watch_ads_report WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS ads ON a.roleid = ads.roleid AND a.zoneid = ads.zoneid AND a.logymd = ads.logymd /* 广告收入 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(price / 1000000) AS day_iaa_charge FROM w5_ods.c_ad_income_report WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS ads_income ON a.roleid = ads_income.roleid AND a.zoneid = ads_income.zoneid AND a.logymd = ads_income.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, last_network_name AS media_source, campaign_name, adgroup_name FROM msdk_dm.dm_msdk_multi_behavior_account_df WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND appid = 4500) AS ug ON a.accountid = ug.accountid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, equipment_list, hero_list, remain_diamonds, remain_coin, remain_energy, main_stage_hard, remain_item1, remain_item2, remain_item3, last_verify_power, armband, talent_list, main_character_skin, weapon_skin, equip_info, tool_info, object_info, armband_level, office_level, vip_info FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, equipment_list, hero_list, remain_diamonds, remain_coin, remain_energy, main_stage_hard, remain_item1, remain_item2, remain_item3, last_verify_power, armband, talent_list, main_character_skin, weapon_skin, equip_info, tool_info, object_info, armband_level, office_level, vip_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, logymd ORDER BY time DESC) AS ar FROM w5_ods.logout_progress WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND zoneid >= 10000) AS p0 WHERE ar = 1) AS progress ON a.roleid = progress.roleid AND a.zoneid = progress.zoneid AND a.logymd = progress.logymd LEFT JOIN (/* 单管果汁糖/果汁糖礼盒获取个数 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 101 THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_101_add, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 102 THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_102_add FROM w5_ods.add_item WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS sugar_add ON a.roleid = sugar_add.roleid AND a.zoneid = sugar_add.zoneid AND a.logymd = sugar_add.logymd LEFT JOIN (/* 诡章抽奖 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(CASE WHEN gacha_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_gacha1_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN gacha_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_gacha2_cnt FROM w5_ods.gacha_detail WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS gacha_t ON a.roleid = gacha_t.roleid AND a.zoneid = gacha_t.zoneid AND a.logymd = gacha_t.logymd LEFT JOIN (/* 金币增加 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(add_num) AS day_coin_add_num FROM w5_ods.add_coin WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS coin_add ON a.roleid = coin_add.roleid AND a.zoneid = coin_add.zoneid AND a.logymd = coin_add.logymd LEFT JOIN (/* 金币消耗 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(sub_num) AS day_coin_subnum FROM w5_ods.sub_coin WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND zoneid >= 10000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS coin_sub ON a.roleid = coin_sub.roleid AND a.zoneid = coin_sub.zoneid AND a.logymd = coin_sub.logymd

name: adbi.dm_admkt_material_fully
sql_units: WITH material_info AS (SELECT material_id, material_name, app_id, `size` AS material_size, language, producer, creative_side, source, type, sub_type, inner_net_address, ytb_url, outer_upload_status, video_duration, tags FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY material_name ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rk FROM adbi.dim_material_info WHERE date = '20260531' AND deleted = 0) AS t WHERE rk = 1), item_info AS (SELECT item_key, MAX(CASE WHEN item_name = 'producer' THEN item_value END) AS producer_name, MAX(CASE WHEN item_name = 'creativeSide' THEN item_value END) AS creative_side_name, MAX(CASE WHEN item_name = 'source' THEN item_value END) AS source_name, MAX(CASE WHEN item_name = 'type' THEN item_value END) AS type_name, MAX(CASE WHEN item_name = 'videoSubType' THEN item_value END) AS sub_type_name, MAX(CASE WHEN item_name = 'tag' THEN item_value END) AS tag_name FROM adbi.dim_item_info WHERE date = '20260531' AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY item_key), tag_data AS (SELECT m.material_id, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(t.tag_name)) AS tags_name FROM (SELECT material_id, EXPLODE(SPLIT(tags, ',')) AS tag_key FROM material_info) AS m LEFT JOIN item_info AS t ON m.tag_key = t.item_key GROUP BY m.material_id), material_data AS (SELECT a.material_id, a.material_name, a.app_id, a.material_size, a.language, a.inner_net_address, a.ytb_url, a.video_duration, MAX(CASE WHEN a.producer = i.item_key THEN i.producer_name END) AS producer_name, MAX(CASE WHEN a.creative_side = i.item_key THEN i.creative_side_name END) AS creative_side_name, MAX(CASE WHEN a.source = i.item_key THEN i.source_name END) AS source_name, MAX(CASE WHEN a.sub_type = i.item_key THEN i.sub_type_name END) AS sub_type_name, t.tags_name FROM material_info AS a LEFT JOIN item_info AS i ON i.item_key IN (a.producer, a.creative_side, a.source, a.sub_type) LEFT JOIN tag_data AS t ON a.material_id = t.material_id GROUP BY a.material_id, a.material_name, a.app_id, a.material_size, a.language, a.inner_net_address, a.ytb_url, a.video_duration, t.tags_name), material_relation AS (SELECT ad_id, material_id, start_time AS asset_start_time, end_time AS asset_end_time, platform_type FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ad_id, material_id, end_time, platform_type ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rk FROM adbi.dim_ad_and_material_relation WHERE date = '20260531' AND deleted = 0) AS t WHERE rk = 1), material_ref AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.media_type, m.remote_type, m.account AS account_id, m.remote_id, m.material_id FROM adbi.dim_material_upload_record AS m INNER JOIN material_info AS md ON m.material_id = md.material_id WHERE m.date = '20260531' AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.remote_type = 2), account_ref AS (SELECT DISTINCT ad_account_id, app_id, ad_target FROM adbi.gms_ad_bi_ad_account_v2 WHERE date = '20260531' AND ad_platform_name = 'googleadwords_int' AND is_deleted = 0), campaign_budget AS (SELECT DISTINCT manager_id, campaign_id, amount_micros AS budget, start_time, end_time FROM adbi.dim_google_campaign WHERE date = '20260531' AND deleted = 0), country_mapping AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN app_id = '1001' AND start_date < '2024-02-04' AND campaign_name NOT LIKE 'Global%' AND campaign_name NOT LIKE '投放%' THEN SUBSTRING(campaign_name, 1, 2) WHEN app_id = '1001' AND start_date < '2024-02-04' AND campaign_name LIKE 'Global%' THEN 'GLOBAL' WHEN app_id = '1001' AND start_date < '2024-02-04' AND campaign_name LIKE '投放%' THEN SUBSTRING(campaign_name, 4, 2) WHEN app_id = '2001' AND start_date < '2024-02-04' THEN SPLIT(campaign_name, '-')[0] WHEN app_id = '3001' AND start_date < '2024-02-04' THEN SPLIT(campaign_name, '-')[1] WHEN start_date >= '2024-02-04' OR app_id IN ('4170', '4020') THEN SPLIT(campaign_name, '-')[0] ELSE 'unknown' END AS country FROM adbi.ods_market_google_adgroup_ad_asset_report WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2026-05-31'), google_base AS (SELECT report_date, manager_id, account_id, app_id, app_name, os, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_id, adgroup_name, ad_id, ad_network_type, asset_id, asset_name, asset_type, country, country AS geocountry, image_url, youtube_video_id, SUM(cost) AS cost, SUM(click) AS click, SUM(impression) AS impression FROM country_mapping GROUP BY report_date, manager_id, account_id, app_id, app_name, os, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_id, adgroup_name, ad_id, ad_network_type, asset_id, asset_name, asset_type, country, image_url, youtube_video_id), conversion_bitmap AS (SELECT * FROM adbi.dwm_market_google_ad_asset_conversions_bitmap WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31'), google AS (SELECT gb.report_date, gb.manager_id, gb.account_id, gb.app_id, gb.app_name, gb.os, gb.campaign_id, gb.campaign_name, gb.adgroup_id, gb.adgroup_name, gb.ad_id, gb.ad_network_type, gb.asset_id, gb.asset_name, gb.asset_type, gb.country, gb.geocountry, gb.image_url, gb.youtube_video_id, gb.cost, gb.click, gb.impression, COALESCE(con.pre_install, 0) AS pre_install, COALESCE(con.install, 0) AS install, con.conversions_value_bitmap AS conversion_value, ac.ad_target, cb.budget, cb.start_time, cb.end_time, md.material_id, md.material_name, md.material_size, md.language, md.producer_name, md.creative_side_name, md.source_name, md.sub_type_name, md.tags_name, md.video_duration, mr.asset_start_time, mr.asset_end_time FROM google_base AS gb LEFT JOIN material_ref AS mref ON gb.account_id = mref.account_id AND gb.asset_id = mref.remote_id LEFT JOIN material_data AS md ON mref.material_id = md.material_id LEFT JOIN account_ref AS ac ON gb.account_id = ac.ad_account_id AND gb.app_id = ac.app_id LEFT JOIN campaign_budget AS cb ON gb.campaign_id = cb.campaign_id AND gb.manager_id = cb.manager_id LEFT JOIN conversion_bitmap AS con ON gb.report_date = con.report_date AND gb.manager_id = con.manager_id AND gb.account_id = con.account_id AND gb.app_id = con.app_id AND gb.os = con.os AND gb.campaign_id = con.campaign_id AND gb.adgroup_id = con.adgroup_id AND gb.ad_id = con.ad_id AND gb.asset_id = con.asset_id AND gb.ad_network_type = con.ad_network_type LEFT JOIN (SELECT ad_id, material_id, asset_start_time, asset_end_time FROM material_relation WHERE platform_type = 1) AS mr ON md.material_id = mr.material_id AND gb.ad_id = mr.ad_id AND gb.report_date > mr.asset_start_time AND gb.report_date <= mr.asset_end_time), fb_campaign_info /* Facebook 相关维度表 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT campaign_id, budget, start_time AS campaign_start_time, stop_time AS campaign_stop_time FROM adbi.dim_facebook_campaign WHERE date = '20260531'), fb_ad_info AS (SELECT DISTINCT campaign_id, adgroup_id, ad_id, CASE WHEN ad_type = 1 THEN 'image' ELSE 'video' END AS asset_type FROM adbi.dim_facebook_ad WHERE date = '20260531' AND create_status = 0), fb_account_info AS (SELECT DISTINCT manager_id, ad_account_id AS account_id, app_id, ad_target FROM adbi.gms_ad_bi_ad_account_v2 WHERE date = '20260531' AND is_deleted = 0 AND ad_platform_name = 'Facebook Ads'), geo_mapping AS (SELECT DISTINCT app_id, TRIM(country_exploded) AS country, geo FROM adbi.dim_geo_country_mapping LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(country, ',')) exploded_country AS country_exploded WHERE logymd = '20260531'), latest_material_relation AS (SELECT ad_id, material_id FROM (SELECT ad_id, material_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ad_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC, created_at DESC) AS rn FROM adbi.dim_ad_and_material_relation WHERE date = '20260531' AND deleted = 0 AND platform_type = 2) AS t WHERE rn = 1), facebook AS (SELECT s.report_date, s.media_source, s.account_id, s.app_id, s.app_name, s.os, s.campaign_id, s.campaign_name, s.adgroup_id, s.adgroup_name, s.ad_id, s.ad_name, s.country, COALESCE(fad.asset_type, 'other') AS asset_type, COALESCE(gm.geo, 'other') AS geocountry, fac.manager_id, fac.ad_target, fc.budget, fc.campaign_start_time, fc.campaign_stop_time, lmr.material_id, md.material_name, md.material_size, md.language, md.inner_net_address, md.ytb_url, md.producer_name, md.creative_side_name, md.source_name, md.sub_type_name, md.tags_name, md.video_duration, mr.asset_start_time, mr.asset_end_time, s.cost, s.click, s.impression, s.install, s.conversions_value FROM (SELECT data_date AS report_date, 'Facebook Ads' AS media_source, ad_account_id AS account_id, app_id, app_name, os, campaign_id, campaign_name, adset_id AS adgroup_id, adset_name AS adgroup_name, ad_id, ad_name, country, cost, click, impression, did_new_user AS install, revenue_amount_1_30_interval1_list AS conversions_value FROM adbi.dm_admkt_game_ad_stats_fully WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND data_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND media_source = 'Facebook Ads') AS s LEFT JOIN fb_campaign_info AS fc ON s.campaign_id = fc.campaign_id LEFT JOIN fb_ad_info AS fad ON s.campaign_id = fad.campaign_id AND s.adgroup_id = fad.adgroup_id AND s.ad_id = fad.ad_id LEFT JOIN fb_account_info AS fac ON s.account_id = fac.account_id AND s.app_id = fac.app_id LEFT JOIN geo_mapping AS gm ON s.app_id = gm.app_id AND s.country = gm.country LEFT JOIN latest_material_relation AS lmr ON s.ad_id = lmr.ad_id LEFT JOIN material_data AS md ON lmr.material_id = md.material_id LEFT JOIN material_relation AS mr ON md.material_id = mr.material_id AND s.ad_id = mr.ad_id AND mr.platform_type = 2 AND s.report_date > mr.asset_start_time AND s.report_date <= mr.asset_end_time), combined AS (/* Google */ SELECT report_date, 'googleadwords_int' AS media_source, manager_id, account_id, ad_target, app_id, app_name, os, campaign_id, campaign_name, start_time AS campaign_start_time, end_time AS campaign_stop_time, adgroup_id, adgroup_name, asset_id, CASE WHEN asset_type = 'MARKETING_IMAGE' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(asset_name, '.jpg', ''), '.png', '') WHEN asset_type = 'YOUTUBE_VIDEO' THEN REPLACE(asset_name, '.mp4', '') ELSE asset_name END AS asset_name, CASE WHEN asset_type = 'HEADLINE' THEN 'headline' WHEN asset_type = 'DESCRIPTION' THEN 'description' WHEN asset_type = 'MARKETING_IMAGE' THEN 'image' WHEN asset_type = 'YOUTUBE_VIDEO' THEN 'video' ELSE 'other' END AS asset_type, ad_network_type, image_url, IF(asset_type = 'YOUTUBE_VIDEO', CONCAT('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=', youtube_video_id), NULL) AS video_url, material_id, material_name, material_size, language, producer_name, creative_side_name, source_name, sub_type_name, tags_name, LOWER(country) AS country, LOWER(geocountry) AS geocountry, budget, asset_start_time, asset_end_time, COALESCE(video_duration, 0) AS video_duration, cost * 1.0 / 1000000 AS cost, click, impression, pre_install, install, conversion_value AS conversions_value FROM google UNION ALL /* Facebook */ SELECT report_date, media_source, manager_id, account_id, ad_target, app_id, app_name, os, campaign_id, campaign_name, campaign_start_time, campaign_stop_time, adgroup_id, adgroup_name, ad_id AS asset_id, ad_name AS asset_name, asset_type, 'unknown' AS ad_network_type, inner_net_address AS image_url, ytb_url AS video_url, material_id, material_name, material_size, language, producer_name, creative_side_name, source_name, sub_type_name, tags_name, country, geocountry, budget, asset_start_time, asset_end_time, COALESCE(video_duration, 0) AS video_duration, cost, click, impression, 0 AS pre_install, install, conversions_value FROM facebook), enriched AS (SELECT c.*, COALESCE(c.material_id, md.material_id, 'unknown') AS final_material_id, COALESCE(c.material_name, md.material_name, 'unknown') AS final_material_name, COALESCE(c.material_size, md.material_size, 'unknown') AS final_material_size, COALESCE(c.language, md.language, 'unknown') AS final_language, COALESCE(c.producer_name, md.producer_name, 'unknown') AS final_producer_name, COALESCE(c.creative_side_name, md.creative_side_name, 'unknown') AS final_creative_side_name, COALESCE(c.source_name, md.source_name, 'unknown') AS final_source_name, COALESCE(c.sub_type_name, md.sub_type_name, 'unknown') AS final_sub_type_name, COALESCE(c.tags_name, md.tags_name, 'unknown') AS final_tags_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(COALESCE(c.material_name, md.material_name, 'unknown'), '\\]([^\\]]+)$'), ''), 'unknown') AS creative_name FROM combined AS c LEFT JOIN material_data AS md ON c.asset_name = md.material_name), custom_label AS (SELECT app_id, asset_type, material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(category_l1, ''), 'unknown') AS category_l1, COALESCE(NULLIF(category_l2, ''), 'unknown') AS category_l2, COALESCE(NULLIF(category_l3, ''), 'unknown') AS category_l3 FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, asset_type, material_name ORDER BY p_date DESC) AS rn FROM adbi.dim_custom_label_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31') AS t WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_admkt_material_fully)) SELECT e.report_date, e.media_source, e.manager_id, e.account_id, e.ad_target, e.app_id, e.app_name, e.os, e.campaign_id, e.campaign_name, e.campaign_start_time, e.campaign_stop_time, e.adgroup_id, e.adgroup_name, e.asset_id, e.asset_name, e.asset_type, e.ad_network_type, e.image_url, e.video_url, e.final_material_id AS material_id, e.final_material_name AS material_name, e.final_material_size AS material_size, e.final_language AS language, e.final_producer_name AS producer_name, e.final_creative_side_name AS creative_side_name, e.final_source_name AS source_name, e.final_sub_type_name AS sub_type_name, e.final_tags_name AS tags_name, e.country, e.geocountry, e.budget, e.asset_start_time, e.asset_end_time, e.video_duration, e.creative_name, e.cost, e.click, e.impression, e.pre_install, e.install, e.conversions_value, COALESCE(cl.category_l1, 'unknown') AS category_l1, COALESCE(cl.category_l2, 'unknown') AS category_l2, COALESCE(cl.category_l3, 'unknown') AS category_l3 FROM enriched AS e LEFT JOIN custom_label AS cl ON e.app_id = cl.app_id AND e.asset_type = cl.asset_type AND e.creative_name = cl.material_name

*/ /* create table mcgg_temp.mc_mcgg_fake_quantity_users_total as */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.mc_mcgg_fake_quantity_users_total PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.first_ad_country, a.statdate, first_media_source FROM (SELECT DISTINCT qt.roleid, qt.zoneid, qt.first_ad_country, qt.statdate FROM mcgg_temp.mc_mcgg_network_role_jl_60d_result_v1 AS qt WHERE qt.statdate <= '2026-03-31' AND prob > 0.7 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, first_ad_country, statdate FROM mcgg_temp.mc_mcgg_network_role_jl_3d_result_v1 AS pr WHERE pr.statdate <= '2026-05-27' AND pr.statdate > '2026-05-23' AND /* AND     prediction > 0 */ prob > 0.5 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, first_ad_country, statdate FROM mcgg_temp.mc_mcgg_network_role_jl_7d_result_v1 AS pr7 WHERE pr7.statdate <= '2026-05-23' AND pr7.statdate > '2026-03-31' AND /* AND     prediction > 0 */ prob > 0.5) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT qt.roleid FROM mcgg_temp.mc_mcgg_fake_quantity_features_60d AS qt WHERE logymd <= '2026-03-31' AND battle_cnt_max_60d > 1 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM mcgg_temp.mc_mcgg_fake_quantity_features_7d AS pr WHERE pr.logymd <= '2026-05-27' AND pr.logymd > '2026-05-23' AND battle_cnt_max_7d > 1 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM mcgg_temp.mc_mcgg_fake_quantity_features_3d AS pr7 WHERE pr7.logymd <= '2026-05-23' AND pr7.logymd > '2026-03-31' AND battle_cnt_max_3d > 1) AS qf ON a.roleid = qf.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, first_media_source FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df_external WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND is_first_create = 1 AND is_formal = 1 AND new_type = '纯净新增') AS rzd ON a.roleid = rzd.roleid AND a.zoneid = rzd.zoneid AND (first_media_source NOT LIKE '%organic%' AND first_media_source NOT LIKE '%unknown%' AND first_media_source NOT LIKE '%xiaomi%' AND NOT first_media_source IS NULL) WHERE qf.roleid IS NULL

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_monitor_result_group_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_monitor_result_group_di PARTITION(logymd, code) SELECT group_dim, group_id, metric_code, metric_name, upper_term, lower_term, ds, y, yhat, yhat_lower, yhat_upper, is_changepoint, weight, is_upgrade, upgrade_ds, upgrade_days, x, upper_slope, upper_const, lower_slope, lower_const, is_trend_changepoint, trend_weight, logymd, code FROM (SELECT t1.group_dim, t1.group_id, t1.metric_code, t1.metric_name, t1.upper_term, t1.lower_term, t1.ds, t2.y, t2.yhat, t2.yhat_lower, t2.yhat_upper, CASE WHEN t1.metric_code = 'download_rate' AND t3.upgrade_days = 0 AND t2.y <= 0.50 THEN -1 WHEN t1.metric_code = 'download_rate' AND t3.upgrade_days = 1 AND t2.y <= 0.69 THEN -1 WHEN t1.metric_code = 'download_rate' AND t3.upgrade_days = 2 AND t2.y <= 0.76 THEN -1 WHEN t1.metric_code = 'download_rate' AND t3.upgrade_days = 3 AND t2.y <= 0.79 THEN -1 WHEN t1.metric_code = 'download_rate' AND t3.upgrade_days = 4 AND t2.y <= 0.81 THEN -1 WHEN t1.metric_code = 'download_rate' AND t3.upgrade_days = 5 AND t2.y <= 0.83 THEN -1 WHEN t1.metric_code = 'download_rate' AND t3.upgrade_days = 6 AND t2.y <= 0.85 THEN -1 WHEN t1.metric_code = 'download_rate' AND t3.upgrade_days >= 7 AND t2.y <= 0.85 THEN -1 WHEN t1.metric_code = 'download_rate' THEN 0 ELSE t2.is_changepoint END AS is_changepoint, t2.weight, t3.is_upgrade, t3.upgrade_ds, t3.upgrade_days, t4.x, t4.upper_slope, t4.upper_const, t4.lower_slope, t4.lower_const, CASE WHEN t1.metric_code = 'download_rate' THEN 0 ELSE t4.is_trend_changepoint END AS is_trend_changepoint, t4.trend_weight, t1.logymd, t1.metric_code AS code, PMOD(HASH(t1.group_id), 40) AS fid FROM (SELECT group_dim, group_id, metric_code, metric_name, upper_term, lower_term, ds, logymd FROM mt_dm.dm_monitor_input_group_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT group_id, metric_code, metric_name, ds, y, yhat, yhat_lower, yhat_upper, is_changepoint, weight FROM mt_dm.dm_monitor_output_group_scope_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t2 ON t1.group_id = t2.group_id AND t1.metric_name = t2.metric_name AND t1.metric_code = t2.metric_code AND t1.ds = t2.ds LEFT JOIN (SELECT group_id, metric_code, metric_name, ds, y, yhat, yhat_lower, yhat_upper, is_changepoint, weight, is_upgrade, upgrade_ds, upgrade_days FROM mt_dm.dm_monitor_output_group_upgrade_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t3 ON t1.group_id = t3.group_id AND t1.metric_name = t3.metric_name AND t1.metric_code = t3.metric_code AND t1.ds = t3.ds LEFT JOIN (SELECT group_id, metric_code, metric_name, ds, y, yhat, yhat_upper, yhat_lower, is_changepoint, weight, x, upper_slope, upper_const, lower_slope, lower_const, is_trend_changepoint, trend_weight FROM mt_dm.dm_monitor_output_group_trend_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t4 ON t1.group_id = t4.group_id AND t1.metric_name = t4.metric_name AND t1.metric_code = t4.metric_code AND t1.ds = t4.ds) AS tmp DISTRIBUTE BY (logymd, code, fid)

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_monitor_output_group_upgrade_di
sql_units: WITH base AS (/* 计算版更日期，1.标记最低点的日期 */ SELECT group_id, metric_code, metric_name, ds, y, yhat, yhat_lower, yhat_upper, is_changepoint, weight, MIN(y) OVER (PARTITION BY group_id, metric_code, metric_name ORDER BY ds ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND 14 FOLLOWING) AS min_y FROM mt_dm.dm_monitor_output_group_scope_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND code = 'download_rate') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_monitor_output_group_upgrade_di PARTITION(logymd, code) /* 增量下载完成率 */ SELECT t1.group_id, t1.metric_code, t1.metric_name, t1.ds, t1.y, t1.yhat, t1.yhat_lower, t1.yhat_upper, t1.is_changepoint, t1.weight, CASE WHEN t1.ds = t2.ds THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_upgrade, t2.ds AS upgrade_ds, DATEDIFF(t1.ds, t2.ds) AS upgrade_days, '2026-05-30' AS logymd, t1.metric_code AS code FROM base AS t1 LEFT JOIN (/* 计算版更日期，1.标记版更日期 */ SELECT group_id, metric_code, metric_name, ds, LEAD(ds) OVER (PARTITION BY group_id, metric_code, metric_name ORDER BY ds) AS pre_ds FROM base WHERE is_changepoint < 0 AND min_y = y) AS t2 ON t1.group_id = t2.group_id AND t1.metric_code = t2.metric_code AND t1.metric_name = t2.metric_name AND t1.ds >= DATE_ADD(t2.ds, 3 * -1) /* 计算版更日期，提前标记n=1天的数据，减少噪声 */ AND CASE WHEN NOT t2.pre_ds IS NULL THEN t1.ds < DATE_ADD(t2.pre_ds, 3 * -1) ELSE 1 = 1 END /* 计算版更日期，提前标记n=1天的数据，减少噪声，同时最后一次版更后，无截止日期，也需要标记 */
