sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: crystalmei@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-12-29 14:21:56.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* SELECT  accountid,zoneid,deviceid,did */ /* FROM    */ /* ( */ /* select *,row_number() over(partition by accountid,zoneid order by last_time) rn */ /* from */ /* mt_dwm.dwm_did_mapping_df */ /* where logymd = '2026-05-30' */ /* and appid = 'mcgg' */ /* and substr(first_time,1,10)>='2025-01-01' */ /* ) a */ /* where rn = 1 */ /* ; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.mc_mcgg_fake_quantity_did_total PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT ut.roleid, ut.zoneid, ut.first_ad_country, md.did, ut.statdate, ut.first_media_source FROM mcgg_temp.mc_mcgg_fake_quantity_users_total AS ut LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, deviceid, did FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY last_time) AS rn FROM mt_dwm.dwm_did_mapping_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mcgg' AND SUBSTRING(first_time, 1, 10) >= '2025-01-01') AS a WHERE rn = 1) AS md ON ut.roleid = md.accountid AND ut.zoneid = md.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'

name: ml_temp.tinashi_player_social_feature_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: tinashi@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-12-31 17:48:54.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tinashi_player_social_feature_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, is_team, COALESCE(is_koc, FALSE) AS is_koc, COALESCE(pagerank, 0) AS pagerank, COALESCE(b.intimacy_friend_cnt, -1) AS intimacy_friend_cnt, blackrate_30, COALESCE(g.blackrate_7, -1) AS blackrate_7, COALESCE(battle_triangle, 0) AS battle_triangle, COALESCE(blackactiverate, 0) AS blackactiverate, COALESCE(battle_degree, 0) AS battle_degree, COALESCE(battle_degree_undirected, 0) AS battle_degree_undirected, COALESCE(battle_strength, 0) AS battle_strength, COALESCE(stablerate, 0) AS stablerate, COALESCE(b.new_focus_cnt, 0) AS new_focus_cnt, COALESCE(b.send_gift_cnt, 0) AS send_gift_cnt, COALESCE(b.get_gift_cnt, 0) AS get_gift_cnt, COALESCE(c.effectfriendcnt, 0) AS effectfriendcnt, COALESCE(d.reserve_cnt, 0) AS reserve_cnt, COALESCE(d.reserve_role_cnt, 0) AS reserve_role_cnt, COALESCE(d.bereserved_role_cnt, 0) AS bereserved_role_cnt, COALESCE(d.bereserved_cnt, 0) AS bereserved_cnt, COALESCE(d.bereserved_accept_rate, -1) AS bereserved_accept_rate, COALESCE(e.join_recruit_cnt, 0) AS join_recruit_cnt, COALESCE(e.join_recruit_role_cnt, 0) AS join_recruit_role_cnt, COALESCE(e.normal_publish_recruit_cnt, 0) AS normal_publish_recruit_cnt, COALESCE(e.allmatch_publish_recruit_cnt, 0) AS allmatch_publish_recruit_cnt, COALESCE(e.other_recruit_cnt, 0) AS other_recruit_cnt, COALESCE(f.normal_invite_cnt, 0) AS normal_invite_cnt, COALESCE(f.other_invite_cnt, 0) AS other_invite_cnt, COALESCE(f.invite_role_cnt, 0) AS invite_role_cnt, COALESCE(f.normal_beinvited_cnt, 0) AS normal_beinvited_cnt, COALESCE(f.other_beinvited_cnt, 0) AS other_beinvited_cnt, COALESCE(f.beinvited_role_cnt, 0) AS beinvited_role_cnt, COALESCE(f.beinvited_accept_rate, -1) AS beinvited_accept_rate, COALESCE(f.beinvited_accept_role_rate, -1) AS beinvited_accept_role_rate, IF(g.ttcnt IS NULL, -1, g.normal_battle_cnt / g.ttcnt) AS normal_rate_21, COALESCE(g.solocnt, 0) AS solocnt_21, COALESCE(g.doublecnt, 0) AS doublecnt_21, COALESCE(g.triplecnt, 0) AS triplecnt_21, COALESCE(g.over3cnt, 0) AS over3cnt_21, COALESCE(g.ttcnt, 0) AS ttcnt_21, COALESCE(h.chatcnt, 0) AS chatcnt_21, COALESCE(h.chatdays, 0) AS chatdays_21, COALESCE(j.gift_cnt, 0) AS gift_cnt_21, COALESCE(j.giftdays, 0) AS giftdays_21, COALESCE(k.activedays_21, 0) AS activedays_21 FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid UNION SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND is_fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, is_team, IF(battle_cnt_30days = 0, -1, black_cnt_30days / battle_cnt_30days) AS blackrate_30 FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND is_ai = 0) AS a2 ON a.roleid = a2.roleid AND a.zoneid = a2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pagerank, battle_triangle, IF(battle_strength_undirected > 0, battle_strength / battle_strength_undirected, -1) AS blackactiverate, battle_degree, battle_degree_undirected, battle_strength, battle_triangle / battle_degree_undirected AS stablerate, is_koc FROM mt_da.social_feature_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS a1 ON a.roleid = a1.roleid AND a.zoneid = a1.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(ARRAY(logymd, intimacy_friend_cnt))[1] AS intimacy_friend_cnt, SUM(new_focus_cnt) AS new_focus_cnt, SUM(send_gift_cnt) AS send_gift_cnt, SUM(get_gift_cnt) AS get_gift_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_social_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 亲密好友的定义，持续N日一起玩/聊天且累计多少亲密度/聊天次数 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF((blackdays >= 2 OR chatdays >= 2) AND (intimacy >= 6 OR chatcnt >= 4), 1, 0)) AS effectfriendcnt FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(a.friend_role_id, b.friend_role_id) AS friend_role_id, blackdays, normalblackdays, otherblackdays, intimacy, chatcnt, chatdays FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS blackdays, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(battle_type IN (1, 2), logymd, NULL)) AS normalblackdays, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(NOT battle_type IN (1, 2), logymd, NULL)) AS otherblackdays, SUM(CASE WHEN battle_type = 2 THEN 6 WHEN battle_type = 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) AS intimacy /* 亲密度功能的计算方式 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_battle_with_friend WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id) AS a FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.friend_role_id, chatcnt + COALESCE(chatcnt2, 0) AS chatcnt, chatdays FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, target AS friend_role_id, SUM(1) AS chatcnt, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS chatdays FROM ml_ods.gameserver_chat_talk_v2 WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND LENGTH(target) > 2 AND is_shield = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, target) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, target, SUM(1) AS chatcnt2 FROM ml_ods.gameserver_chat_talk_v2 WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND LENGTH(target) > 2 AND is_shield = 0 GROUP BY roleid, target) AS b ON a.roleid = friend_role_id AND a.friend_role_id = b.roleid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.friend_role_id = b.friend_role_id) AS tb GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 预约他人和被预约 */ SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(reserve_cnt, 0) AS reserve_cnt, COALESCE(reserve_role_cnt, 0) AS reserve_role_cnt, COALESCE(bereserved_role_cnt, 0) AS bereserved_role_cnt, COALESCE(bereserved_cnt, 0) AS bereserved_cnt, IF(bereserved_cnt > 0, bereserved_accept_cnt / bereserved_cnt, -1) AS bereserved_accept_rate FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(1) AS reserve_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT beinvite_roleid, beinvite_zoneid) AS reserve_role_cnt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_preinvite WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT invite_roleid, invite_zoneid) AS bereserved_role_cnt, SUM(1) AS bereserved_cnt, SUM(IF(isaccept = 1, 1, 0)) AS bereserved_accept_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_preinvited WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) AS d ON a.roleid = d.roleid AND a.zoneid = d.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 发布和加入招募(有很多全民赛的招募，超过大乱斗) operation_id=5找不到出处 */ SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(join_recruit_cnt, 0) AS join_recruit_cnt, COALESCE(join_recruit_role_cnt, 0) AS join_recruit_role_cnt, COALESCE(normal_publish_recruit_cnt, 0) AS normal_publish_recruit_cnt, COALESCE(allmatch_publish_recruit_cnt, 0) AS allmatch_publish_recruit_cnt, COALESCE(other_recruit_cnt, 0) AS other_recruit_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, SUM(1) AS join_recruit_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT team_roleid, team_zoneid) AS join_recruit_role_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_recruit_join WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND isjoin IN (1, 2) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS a FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2), 1, 0)) AS normal_publish_recruit_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype IN (164), 1, 0)) AS allmatch_publish_recruit_cnt, SUM(IF(NOT pvptype IN (1, 2, 164), 1, 0)) AS other_recruit_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_recruit_publish WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND operation_id IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) AS e ON a.roleid = e.roleid AND a.zoneid = e.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 邀请人是invite_roleid, 被邀请是accountid */ SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(normal_invite_cnt, 0) AS normal_invite_cnt, COALESCE(other_invite_cnt, 0) AS other_invite_cnt, COALESCE(invite_role_cnt, 0) AS invite_role_cnt, COALESCE(normal_beinvited_cnt, 0) AS normal_beinvited_cnt, COALESCE(other_beinvited_cnt, 0) AS other_beinvited_cnt, COALESCE(beinvited_role_cnt, 0) AS beinvited_role_cnt, IF((normal_beinvited_cnt + other_beinvited_cnt) > 0, beinvited_acceptcnt / (normal_beinvited_cnt + other_beinvited_cnt), -1) AS beinvited_accept_rate, IF(beinvited_role_cnt > 0, beinvited_accept_rolecnt / beinvited_role_cnt, -1) AS beinvited_accept_role_rate FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2), 1, 0)) AS normal_invite_cnt, SUM(IF(NOT pvptype IN (1, 2), 1, 0)) AS other_invite_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT invited_roleid, invited_zoneid) AS invite_role_cnt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_invite_room WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2), 1, 0)) AS normal_beinvited_cnt, SUM(IF(NOT pvptype IN (1, 2), 1, 0)) AS other_beinvited_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT inviter_roleid, inviter_zoneid) AS beinvited_role_cnt, SUM(IF(interact_type = 1, 1, 0)) AS beinvited_acceptcnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(interact_type = 1, CONCAT(inviter_roleid, '_', inviter_zoneid), NULL)) AS beinvited_accept_rolecnt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_accept_invite_room WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) AS f ON a.roleid = f.roleid AND a.zoneid = f.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 历史三周开黑习惯，玩什么模式, 聊天和送礼的偏好等 */ SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2), 1, 0)) AS normal_battle_cnt, SUM(1) AS ttcnt, SUM(IF(blacknum = 1, 1, 0)) AS solocnt, SUM(IF(blacknum = 2, 1, 0)) AS doublecnt, SUM(IF(blacknum = 3, 1, 0)) AS triplecnt, SUM(IF(blacknum > 3, 1, 0)) AS over3cnt, IF(SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) = 0, -1, SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND blacknum > 1, 1, 0)) / SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30', 1, 0))) AS blackrate_7 FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-10' AND '2026-05-30' AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS g ON a.roleid = g.roleid AND a.zoneid = g.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(1) AS chatcnt, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS chatdays FROM ml_ods.gameserver_chat_talk_v2 WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-10' AND '2026-05-30' AND LENGTH(target) > 2 AND is_shield = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS h ON a.roleid = h.roleid AND a.zoneid = h.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(send_gift_cnt) + SUM(get_gift_cnt) AS gift_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF((send_gift_cnt + get_gift_cnt) > 0, logymd, NULL)) AS giftdays FROM mt_dwm.dwm_social_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-10' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS j ON a.roleid = j.roleid AND a.zoneid = j.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS activedays_21 FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-10' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid UNION SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-10' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS k ON a.roleid = k.roleid AND a.zoneid = k.zoneid

sql_units: WITH user_before_7d_label /* 1. 过去7天战斗/网络特征 */ AS (SELECT s1.logymd, s1.accountid, SUM(ping_cnt) / SUM(battle_net_cnt) AS ping_7d_before, SUM(movelag) / SUM(battle_net_cnt) AS movelag_7d_before, SUM(sklag_cnt) / SUM(battle_net_cnt) AS sklag_cnt_7d_before, SUM(battle_net_ok) / SUM(battle_net_cnt) AS battle_net_ok_7d_before, SUM(small_connect) / SUM(battle_net_cnt) AS small_connect_7d_before, SUM(battleendtotalpss) / SUM(battle_cnt_performance) AS battleendtotalpss_7d_before, SUM(big_num2) / SUM(battle_net_cnt) AS big_num2_7d_before, SUM(temp_rate) / SUM(battle_net_cnt) AS temp_rate_7d_before, SUM(fps) / SUM(battle_net_cnt) AS fps_7d_before, SUM(input_delay) / SUM(battle_net_cnt) AS input_delay_7d_before, MAX(today_max_conwin) AS max_conwin_7d_before, MAX(today_max_conlose) AS max_conlose_7d_before, SUM(today_hook_cnt) / SUM(today_battle_cnt) AS hook_rate_7d_before, SUM(today_black_cnt) / SUM(today_battle_cnt) AS black_rate_7d_before, SUM(today_use_wifi_cnt) / SUM(today_battle_cnt) AS wifi_rate_7d_before, SUM(today_use_network_cnt) / SUM(today_battle_cnt) AS net_rate_7d_before, SUM(today_score_total) / SUM(today_battle_cnt) AS avg_score_7d_before, SUM(sizenum_for_speed_download) / SUM(time_for_speed_download) AS avg_spped_7d_before, SUM(battle_net_cnt) AS battle_net_cnt_7d_before, SUM(battle_cnt_performance) AS battle_cnt_performance_7d_before, SUM(today_battle_cnt) AS today_battle_cnt_7d_before FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_dau_wide_feature_join1_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY logymd, accountid) AS s1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, SUM(ping_cnt) AS ping_cnt, SUM(movelag) AS movelag, SUM(sklag_cnt) AS sklag_cnt, SUM(battle_net_ok) AS battle_net_ok, SUM(small_connect) AS small_connect, SUM(battle_net_cnt) AS battle_net_cnt, SUM(battle_cnt_performance) AS battle_cnt_performance, SUM(battleendtotalpss) AS battleendtotalpss, SUM(big_num2) AS big_num2, SUM(temp_rate) AS temp_rate, SUM(fps) AS fps, SUM(input_delay) AS input_delay, MAX(CAST(today_max_conwin AS DOUBLE)) AS today_max_conwin, MAX(CAST(today_max_conlose AS DOUBLE)) AS today_max_conlose, SUM(today_hook_cnt) AS today_hook_cnt, SUM(today_battle_cnt) AS today_battle_cnt, SUM(today_black_cnt) AS today_black_cnt, SUM(today_use_wifi_cnt) AS today_use_wifi_cnt, SUM(today_use_network_cnt) AS today_use_network_cnt, SUM(today_score_total) AS today_score_total, SUM(sizenum_for_speed_download) AS sizenum_for_speed_download, SUM(time_for_speed_download) AS time_for_speed_download FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_dau_wide_feature_join1_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-23' AND '2026-05-29' GROUP BY logymd, accountid) AS s2 ON s1.accountid = s2.accountid GROUP BY s1.logymd, s1.accountid), user_label /* 2. 设备/属性/付费特征 */ AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, FLOOR(COALESCE(config_fixed_score, 0)) AS config_fixed_score, CASE WHEN CAST(config_fixed_score AS DOUBLE) < 5.7 THEN 1 WHEN CAST(config_fixed_score AS DOUBLE) < 7.4 THEN 2 WHEN CAST(config_fixed_score AS DOUBLE) < 9.4 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS device_score_type, FLOOR(config_devicetotalmemory / 1024) AS config_devicetotalmemory, CASE WHEN COALESCE(config_devicetotalmemory, 0) = 0 THEN 'v00-未知' WHEN COALESCE(config_devicetotalmemory, 0) < 8 * 1024 THEN 'v01-8G及以下' WHEN COALESCE(config_devicetotalmemory, 0) < 16 * 1024 THEN 'v02-16G' WHEN COALESCE(config_devicetotalmemory, 0) < 32 * 1024 THEN 'v03-32G' WHEN COALESCE(config_devicetotalmemory, 0) < 64 * 1024 THEN 'v04-64G' WHEN COALESCE(config_devicetotalmemory, 0) < 128 * 1024 THEN 'v05-128G' WHEN COALESCE(config_devicetotalmemory, 0) < 256 * 1024 THEN 'v06-256G' ELSE 'v07-512G' END AS config_devicetotalmemory_type, FLOOR(config_client_memory / 1024) AS config_client_memory, CASE WHEN CEIL(config_client_memory / 1024) <= 1 THEN 'v01-1G' WHEN CEIL(config_client_memory / 1024) <= 2 THEN 'v02-1~2G' WHEN CEIL(config_client_memory / 1024) <= 4 THEN 'v03-2~4G' WHEN CEIL(config_client_memory / 1024) <= 6 THEN 'v04-4~6G' WHEN CEIL(config_client_memory / 1024) > 6 THEN 'v05-6G+' ELSE 'v00-未知' END AS config_client_memory_type, FLOOR(config_devicefreememory / 1024) AS config_devicefreememory, CASE WHEN config_devicefreememory / 1000 >= 20 THEN 20 WHEN config_devicefreememory / 1000 >= 10 THEN 10 WHEN config_devicefreememory / 1000 >= 5 THEN 5 WHEN config_devicefreememory / 1000 >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS config_devicefreememory_type, first_device, os_type, CASE WHEN FLOOR(first_activedays / 100) >= 15 THEN '15' ELSE CAST(FLOOR(first_activedays / 100) AS STRING) END AS activedays_type, CASE WHEN FLOOR(battle_cnt_30days / 10) >= 20 THEN '20' ELSE CAST(FLOOR(battle_cnt_30days / 10) AS STRING) END AS battle_cnt_30days_type, FLOOR(his_last_level / 20) AS level_type, CASE WHEN FLOOR(first_lossdays / 30) >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE FLOOR(first_lossdays / 30) END AS first_lossdays, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 1720 THEN '10_5年以上' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 1360 THEN '09_4~5年' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 1000 THEN '08_3~4年' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 720 THEN '07_2~3年' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 360 THEN '06_1~2年' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 180 THEN '05_半年~1年' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 90 THEN '04_90-179天' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 30 THEN '03_30-89天' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 1 THEN '02_1-29天(新用户)' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, name: 20260422.adbi.dwm_msdk_device_create_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_msdk_device_create_di)) SELECT bas.did, bas.package_name, bas.os, bas.os_version, bas.idfa, bas.idfv, bas.gps_adid, bas.android_id, bas.last_ad_country AS country, bas.last_media_source AS media_source, COALESCE(att.campaign_id, 'unknown') AS campaign_id, COALESCE(att.campaign_name, 'unknown') AS campaign_name, COALESCE(att.adgroup_id, 'unknown') AS adgroup_id, COALESCE(att.adgroup_name, 'unknown') AS adgroup_name, COALESCE(att.creative_id, 'unknown') AS creative_id, COALESCE(att.creative_name, 'unknown') AS creative_name, bas.client_ip AS client_ip, bas.ip_country AS ip_country, COALESCE(bas.stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, bas.createdate AS logymd, bas.app_id FROM (/* 设备全量表，最新分区logymd为历史全量数据 */ SELECT TRIM(did) AS did, app_id, createdate, package_name, os, TRIM(idfa) AS idfa, TRIM(idfv) AS idfv, TRIM(gps_adid) AS gps_adid, TRIM(android_id) AS android_id, last_ad_country, last_media_source, os_version, client_ip, ip_country, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(msdk_dim_dim_basic_device_df)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND createdate >= '2026-05-01' AND createdate <= '2026-05-30') AS bas LEFT JOIN (/* 设备归因表dim_attribution_create_device_di，分区信息logymd为设备新增日期，并且每日更新近30日分区数据 */ SELECT TRIM(did) AS did, app_id, package_name, media_source, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_id, adgroup_name, creative_id, creative_name, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(msdk_dim_dim_attribution_create_device_di)) WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30') AS att ON bas.app_id = att.app_id AND bas.last_media_source = att.media_source AND bas.did = att.did AND bas.stage_id = att.stage_id DISTRIBUTE BY bas.createdate

name: 20260422.adbi.dm_msdk_device_pay_df
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_msdk_device_pay_df_out)) SELECT did, package_name, os, his_first_pay_date, his_last_pay_date, pay_cnt_info, pay_amt_info, actual_pay_amt_info, total_pay_cnt, total_pay_amt, total_actual_pay_amt, stage_id, app_id FROM (SELECT COALESCE(df.did, di.did) AS did, COALESCE(df.app_id, di.app_id) AS app_id, COALESCE(df.os, di.os) AS os, COALESCE(df.package_name, di.package_name) AS package_name, COALESCE(df.his_first_pay_date, di.day_first_charge_date) AS his_first_pay_date /* 第二层上游表dwd_event_log_detail_di对event_time时间字段做了不为空处理，理论上后续加工字段day_first_charge_time、day_last_charge_time不会为空， */ /* 所以不用考虑his_first_pay_date、his_last_pay_date为空的情况 */, COALESCE(di.day_last_charge_date, df.his_last_pay_date) AS his_last_pay_date, COALESCE(di.stage_id, df.stage_id) AS stage_id, CASE WHEN SIZE(df.pay_cnt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.pay_cnt_info, COALESCE(df.total_pay_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_cnt, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(df.total_pay_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_cnt, 0)) END AS pay_cnt_info /* -spark2.3.4 array方法比较局限，没必要写个array append之类udf，等spark3.0之后可换个更优雅的方式 */, CASE WHEN SIZE(df.pay_amt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.pay_amt_info, COALESCE(df.total_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(df.total_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0)) END AS pay_amt_info, CASE WHEN SIZE(df.actual_pay_amt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.actual_pay_amt_info, COALESCE(df.total_actual_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(CAST(CAST(di.day_actual_charge_sum AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS DOUBLE), 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<DOUBLE>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(df.total_actual_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(CAST(CAST(di.day_actual_charge_sum AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS DOUBLE), 0)) END AS actual_pay_amt_info, COALESCE(df.total_pay_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_cnt, 0) AS total_pay_cnt, COALESCE(df.total_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0) AS total_pay_amt, COALESCE(df.total_actual_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(CAST(CAST(di.day_actual_charge_sum AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS total_actual_pay_amt FROM (/* 前一天全量支付数据 */ SELECT did, app_id, package_name, os, his_first_pay_date, his_last_pay_date, pay_cnt_info, pay_amt_info, actual_pay_amt_info, total_pay_cnt, total_pay_amt, total_actual_pay_amt, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_msdk_device_pay_df_in)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29') AS df FULL JOIN (/* 上游数据因为package_name, 可能飘在一个账号多条数据, 这里需要按照支付时间, 取每天的首次数据. */ SELECT * FROM (/* 当日新增支付数据 */ SELECT did, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, app_id, package_name, os, SUBSTRING(day_first_charge_time, 1, 10) AS day_first_charge_date /* 日期字符串截取，yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss截取出yyyy-MM-dd */, SUBSTRING(day_last_charge_time, 1, 10) AS day_last_charge_date, SUM(day_charge_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY stage_id, did, app_id) AS day_charge_cnt, SUM(day_charge_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY stage_id, did, app_id) AS day_charge_sum, SUM(CAST(COALESCE(day_actual_amt, 0) AS DOUBLE)) OVER (PARTITION BY stage_id, did, app_id) AS day_actual_charge_sum, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stage_id, did, app_id ORDER BY day_first_charge_time ASC) AS rn FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') /* union all */ /* -- 当日新增支付数据 */ /* select */ /*     did , */ /*     nvl(stage_id, '01') stage_id, */ /*     app_id , */ /*     package_name , */ /*     os , */ /*     -- 日期字符串截取，yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss截取出yyyy-MM-dd */ /*     substr(day_first_charge_time, 1, 10) as day_first_charge_date , */ /*     substr(day_last_charge_time,  1, 10) as day_last_charge_date , */ /*     sum(day_charge_cnt) over (partition by stage_id, did, app_id) as day_charge_cnt , */ /*     sum(day_charge_sum) over (partition by stage_id, did, app_id) as day_charge_sum, */ /*     sum(cast(nvl(day_actual_amt, 0) as double)) over (partition by stage_id, did, app_id) as day_actual_charge_sum, */ /*     row_number() over (partition by stage_id, did, app_id order by day_first_charge_time asc) as rn */ /* from */ /*     adbi_test.dwm_pay_device_di_test */ /* where */ /*     logymd = '2026-05-30' and logymd = '2026-05-10' */ WHERE rn = 1) AS di ON df.did = di.did AND df.app_id = di.app_id AND df.stage_id = di.stage_id) AS pay WHERE NOT did IS NULL DISTRIBUTE BY app_id

name: 20260422.adbi.dwm_msdk_iaa_user_revenue_df
sql_units: /* 备注：表粒度解释。 */ /* 前提：只关注user_id和device_id，后面的key暂时置为null */ /* 释义：如果数据上报用户，则粒度为用户粒度，device-id为该用户首次归因设备。如果数据未上报用户，则粒度为设备粒度，此时忽略user-id */ /* 原因：iaa数据会存在y游戏无需账号，x游戏需要账号情况。所以将两张情况做成一张表，也可以拆分为两表 */ WITH log_di_ios AS (SELECT app_id, app_name, 'ios' AS os_name, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(report_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS report_date, '' AS placement_name, IF(TRIM(idfa) = '', NULL, TRIM(idfa)) AS idfa, IF(TRIM(idfa_encrypted) = '', NULL, TRIM(idfa_encrypted)) AS idfa_encrypted, IF(TRIM(idfv) = '', NULL, TRIM(idfv)) AS idfv, IF(TRIM(idfv_encrypted) = '', NULL, TRIM(idfv_encrypted)) AS idfv_encrypted, BIGINT(COALESCE(impression, '0')) AS impression, BIGINT(COALESCE(click, '0')) AS click, ROUND(COALESCE(revenue * 100, 0), 4) AS revenue, IF(TRIM(user_id) = '', NULL, TRIM(user_id)) AS user_id, '' AS network_firm, '' AS area FROM adbi.dwa_admkt_topon_ios_device_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND COALESCE(report_date, '1900-01-01') <= '20260530' AND (app_id <> '4001' OR COALESCE(report_date, '1900-01-01') >= '20240825')), log_di_and /* ; */ /* topon 原始数据 */ AS (SELECT app_id, app_name, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(report_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS report_date, 'android' AS os_name, '' AS placement_name, IF(TRIM(android_id) = '', NULL, TRIM(android_id)) AS android_id, IF(TRIM(android_id_encrypted) = '', NULL, TRIM(android_id_encrypted)) AS android_id_encrypted, IF(TRIM(gaid) = '', NULL, TRIM(gaid)) AS gaid, IF(TRIM(gaid_encrypted) = '', NULL, TRIM(gaid_encrypted)) AS gaid_encrypted, BIGINT(COALESCE(impression, '0')) AS impression, BIGINT(COALESCE(click, '0')) AS click, ROUND(COALESCE(revenue * 100, 0), 4) AS revenue, IF(TRIM(user_id) = '', NULL, TRIM(user_id)) AS user_id, NULL AS network_firm, NULL AS area FROM adbi.dwa_admkt_topon_android_device_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND COALESCE(report_date, '1900-01-01') <= '20260530' AND (app_id <> '4001' OR COALESCE(report_date, '1900-01-01') >= '20240825')), dev_df AS (SELECT TRIM(did) AS device_id, app_id, createdate AS create_time, os, TRIM(idfa) AS idfa, TRIM(idfv) AS idfv, TRIM(gps_adid) AS gps_adid, TRIM(android_id) AS android_id, stage_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(msdk_dim_dim_basic_device_df)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND createdate >= '2019-01-01'), create_device /* 注册设备信息，通过安卓、ios设备id 归因到首次 */ AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s1.stage_id, s1.device_id, s1.android_id, s1.gps_adid, 'unknown' AS idfa, 'unknown' AS idfv, s1.app_id, s1.create_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s1.app_id, s1.android_id_ra ORDER BY s1.stage_id DESC, create_time, s1.device_id) AS and_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s1.app_id, s1.gps_adid_ra ORDER BY s1.stage_id DESC, create_time, s1.device_id) AS gaid_rn, 0 AS idfv_rn, 0 AS idfa_rn FROM (SELECT device_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(android_id), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 10000) AS STRING), TRIM(android_id)) AS android_id_ra, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(gps_adid), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 10000) AS STRING), TRIM(gps_adid)) AS gps_adid_ra, android_id, gps_adid, create_time, app_id, stage_id FROM dev_df WHERE os = 'android') AS s1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT android_id, app_id FROM log_di_and WHERE NOT android_id IS NULL GROUP BY android_id, app_id) AS s2 ON s1.android_id = s2.android_id AND s1.app_id = s2.app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT android_id_encrypted, app_id FROM log_di_and WHERE NOT android_id_encrypted IS NULL GROUP BY android_id_encrypted, app_id) AS s22 ON s1.android_id = s22.android_id_encrypted AND s1.app_id = s22.app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT gaid, app_id FROM log_di_and WHERE NOT gaid IS NULL GROUP BY gaid, app_id) AS s3 ON s1.gps_adid = s3.gaid AND s1.app_id = s3.app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT gaid_encrypted, app_id FROM log_di_and WHERE NOT gaid_encrypted IS NULL GROUP BY gaid_encrypted, app_id) AS s33 ON s1.gps_adid = s33.gaid_encrypted AND s1.app_id = s33.app_id WHERE NOT s2.android_id IS NULL OR NOT s22.android_id_encrypted IS NULL OR NOT s3.gaid IS NULL OR NOT s33.gaid_encrypted IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT s1.stage_id, s1.device_id, 'unknown' AS android_id, 'unknown' AS gps_adid, s1.idfa, s1.idfv, s1.app_id, create_time, 0 AS and_rn, 0 AS gaid_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s1.app_id, s1.idfv_ra ORDER BY s1.stage_id DESC, create_time, s1.device_id) AS idfv_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s1.app_id, s1.idfa_ra ORDER BY s1.stage_id DESC, create_time, s1.device_id) AS idfa_rn FROM (SELECT device_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(idfa), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 10000) AS STRING), TRIM(idfa)) AS idfa_ra, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(idfv), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 10000) AS STRING), TRIM(idfv)) AS idfv_ra, TRIM(idfa) AS idfa, TRIM(idfv) AS idfv, create_time, app_id, stage_id FROM dev_df WHERE os = 'ios') AS s1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT idfv, app_id FROM log_di_ios WHERE NOT idfv IS NULL GROUP BY idfv, app_id) AS s4 ON s1.idfv = s4.idfv AND s1.app_id = s4.app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT idfv_encrypted, app_id FROM log_di_ios WHERE NOT idfv_encrypted IS NULL GROUP BY idfv_encrypted, app_id) AS s44 ON s1.idfv = s44.idfv_encrypted AND s1.app_id = s44.app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT idfa, app_id FROM log_di_ios WHERE NOT idfa IS NULL GROUP BY idfa, app_id) AS s5 ON s1.idfa = s5.idfa AND s1.app_id = s5.app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT idfa_encrypted, app_id FROM log_di_ios WHERE NOT idfa_encrypted IS NULL GROUP BY idfa_encrypted, app_id) AS s55 ON s1.idfa = s55.idfa_encrypted AND s1.app_id = s55.app_id WHERE NOT s4.idfv IS NULL OR NOT s44.idfv_encrypted IS NULL OR NOT s5.idfa IS NULL OR NOT s55.idfa_encrypted IS NULL) AS t1 WHERE idfv_rn = 1 OR idfa_rn = 1 OR and_rn = 1 OR gaid_rn = 1), user_device /* topon 账号-设备粒度数据 */ AS (SELECT user_id, t1.android_id, t1.gaid AS gps_adid, '' AS idfa, '' AS idfv, COALESCE(t3.device_id, t33.device_id, t2.device_id, t22.device_id) AS device_id, COALESCE(t3.stage_id, t33.stage_id, t2.stage_id, t22.stage_id) AS stage_id, IF(NOT t3.device_id IS NULL, 'gps', 'android') AS ds, impression, click, revenue, report_date, t1.app_id, t1.os_name FROM log_di_and AS t1 LEFT JOIN create_device AS t2 ON t1.android_id = t2.android_id AND t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t2.and_rn = 1 AND TRIM(t2.android_id) <> '' LEFT JOIN create_device AS t22 ON t1.android_id_encrypted = t22.android_id AND t1.app_id = t22.app_id AND t22.and_rn = 1 AND TRIM(t22.android_id) <> '' LEFT JOIN create_device AS t3 ON t1.gaid = t3.gps_adid AND t1.app_id = t3.app_id AND t3.gaid_rn = 1 AND TRIM(t3.gps_adid) <> '' LEFT JOIN create_device AS t33 ON t1.gaid_encrypted = t33.gps_adid AND t1.app_id = t33.app_id AND t33.gaid_rn = 1 AND TRIM(t33.gps_adid) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT user_id, NULL AS android_id, NULL AS gps_adid, t1.idfa, t1.idfv, COALESCE(t5.device_id, t55.device_id, t4.device_id, t44.device_id) AS device_id, COALESCE(t5.stage_id, t55.stage_id, t4.stage_id, t44.stage_id) AS stage_id, IF(NOT t5.device_id IS NULL, 'idfa', 'idfv') AS ds, impression, click, revenue, report_date, t1.app_id, t1.os_name FROM log_di_ios AS t1 LEFT JOIN create_device AS t4 ON t1.idfv = t4.idfv AND t1.app_id = t4.app_id AND t4.idfv_rn = 1 AND TRIM(t4.idfv) <> '' LEFT JOIN create_device AS t44 ON t1.idfv_encrypted = t44.idfv AND t1.app_id = t44.app_id AND t44.idfv_rn = 1 AND TRIM(t44.idfv) <> '' LEFT JOIN create_device AS t5 ON t1.idfa = t5.idfa AND t1.app_id = t5.app_id AND t5.idfa_rn = 1 AND TRIM(t5.idfa) <> '' LEFT JOIN create_device AS t55 ON t1.idfa_encrypted = t55.idfa AND t1.app_id = t55.app_id AND t55.idfa_rn = 1 AND TRIM(t55.idfa) <> ''), revenue_di AS (SELECT app_id, is_user, key_id, device_id, stage_id, report_date, impression, click, revenue, SUM(impression) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id, stage_id ORDER BY report_date rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS impression_info_str, BIGINT(SUM(impression) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id, stage_id)) AS total_impression, SUM(click) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id, stage_id ORDER BY report_date rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS click_info_str, BIGINT(SUM(click) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id, stage_id)) AS total_click, SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id, stage_id ORDER BY report_date rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS revenue_info_str, LEAD(report_date, 1, DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 1)) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id, stage_id ORDER BY report_date) AS next_report_date FROM (SELECT app_id, report_date, is_user, key_id, stage_id, MAX(device_id) AS device_id, SUM(impression) AS impression, SUM(click) AS click, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM (SELECT app_id, report_date, device_id, stage_id, device_id AS key_id, impression, click, revenue, 0 AS is_user FROM user_device WHERE user_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT app_id, report_date, FIRST_VALUE(device_id) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, user_id ORDER BY report_date, IF(os_name = 'ios', COALESCE(idfa, idfv), COALESCE(gps_adid, android_id))) AS device_id, FIRST_VALUE(stage_id) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, user_id ORDER BY report_date, IF(os_name = 'ios', COALESCE(idfa, idfv), COALESCE(gps_adid, android_id))) AS stage_id, user_id AS key_id, impression, click, revenue, 1 AS is_user FROM user_device WHERE NOT user_id IS NULL) AS t1 GROUP BY app_id, report_date, key_id, is_user, stage_id) AS t2), agg_df AS (SELECT app_id, is_user, key_id, stage_id, MAX(device_id) AS device_id, MIN(report_date) AS his_first_revenue_date, MAX(report_date) AS his_last_revenue_date, MAX(IF(report_date >= '2026-05-30', NULL, report_date)) AS his_before_last_revenue_date, CAST(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(report_date, '@', impression_info_str, REPEAT(CONCAT(',', impression_info_str), DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(next_report_date, 1 * -1), report_date)))), TRUE)), '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}@', ''), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS impression_info_str, FIRST_VALUE(total_impression) AS total_impression, CAST(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(report_date, '@', click_info_str, REPEAT(CONCAT(',', click_info_str), DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(next_report_date, 1 * -1), report_date)))), TRUE)), '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}@', ''), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS click_info_str, FIRST_VALUE(total_click) AS total_click, SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(report_date, '@', FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', revenue_info_str), REPEAT(CONCAT(',', FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', revenue_info_str)), DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(next_report_date, 1 * -1), report_date)))), TRUE)), '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}@', ''), ',') AS revenue_info_str, CAST(FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', SUM(revenue)) AS DOUBLE) AS total_revenue, '2026-05-30' AS p_date FROM revenue_di GROUP BY app_id, is_user, key_id, stage_id), res AS (SELECT app_id, is_user, IF(is_user = 0, 'unknown', key_id) AS user_id, device_id, stage_id, '' AS placement_name, '' AS area, '' AS network_firm, his_first_revenue_date, his_last_revenue_date, CONCAT_WS(',', REVERSE(impression_info_str)) AS impression_info_str, CONCAT_WS(',', REVERSE(click_info_str)) AS click_info_str, CONCAT_WS(',', REVERSE(revenue_info_str)) AS revenue_info_str, total_impression, total_click, total_revenue, p_date FROM agg_df), w5_daily AS (SELECT '4500' AS app_id, 'unknown' AS user_id, TRIM(did) AS did, 0 AS is_user, 0 AS impression, 0 AS click, DOUBLE(SUM(price)) / 10000.0 AS revenue, logymd AS report_date, COALESCE(m__stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM w5_ods.c_ad_income_report WHERE logymd >= '2026-04-29' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND COALESCE(TRIM(did), '') <> '' AND NOT price IS NULL GROUP BY TRIM(did), logymd, COALESCE(m__stage_id, '01')), w5_agg AS (SELECT app_id, stage_id, is_user, CASE WHEN is_user = 1 THEN user_id ELSE did END AS key_id, MAX(did) AS device_id, report_date, SUM(impression) AS impression, SUM(click) AS click, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM w5_daily GROUP BY app_id, is_user, CASE WHEN is_user = 1 THEN user_id ELSE did END, report_date, stage_id), w5_cumulative AS (SELECT app_id, stage_id, is_user, key_id, device_id, report_date, impression, click, revenue, SUM(impression) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id ORDER BY report_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS impression_info_str, BIGINT(SUM(impression) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id)) AS total_impression, SUM(click) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id ORDER BY report_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS click_info_str, BIGINT(SUM(click) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id)) AS total_click, SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id ORDER BY report_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS revenue_info_str, LEAD(report_date, 1, DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 1)) OVER (PARTITION BY is_user, key_id, app_id ORDER BY report_date) AS next_report_date FROM w5_agg), agg_df_w5 AS (SELECT app_id, stage_id, is_user, key_id, MAX(device_id) AS device_id, MIN(report_date) AS his_first_revenue_date, MAX(report_date) AS his_last_revenue_date, MAX(IF(report_date >= '2026-05-30', NULL, report_date)) AS his_before_last_revenue_date, CAST(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(report_date, '@', impression_info_str, REPEAT(CONCAT(',', impression_info_str), DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(next_report_date, 1 * -1), report_date)))), TRUE)), '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}@', ''), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS impression_info_str, FIRST_VALUE(total_impression) AS total_impression, CAST(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(report_date, '@', click_info_str, REPEAT(CONCAT(',', click_info_str), DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(next_report_date, 1 * -1), report_date)))), TRUE)), '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}@', ''), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS click_info_str, FIRST_VALUE(total_click) AS total_click, SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(report_date, '@', FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', revenue_info_str), REPEAT(CONCAT(',', FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', revenue_info_str)), DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(next_report_date, 1 * -1), report_date)))), TRUE)), '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}@', ''), ',') AS revenue_info_str, CAST(FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', SUM(revenue)) AS DOUBLE) AS total_revenue, '2026-05-30' AS p_date FROM w5_cumulative GROUP BY app_id, is_user, key_id, stage_id), res_w5 AS (SELECT app_id, stage_id, is_user, IF(is_user = 0, 'unknown', key_id) AS user_id, device_id AS did, '' AS placement_name, '' AS area, '' AS network_firm, his_first_revenue_date, his_last_revenue_date, CONCAT_WS(',', REVERSE(impression_info_str)) AS impression_info_str, CONCAT_WS(',', REVERSE(click_info_str)) AS click_info_str, CONCAT_WS(',', REVERSE(revenue_info_str)) AS revenue_info_str, total_impression, total_click, total_revenue, p_date FROM agg_df_w5) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_msdk_iaa_user_revenue_df)) SELECT user_id, device_id AS did, is_user, '' AS placement_name, '' AS area, '' AS network_firm, his_first_revenue_date, his_last_revenue_date, impression_info_str, click_info_str, revenue_info_str, total_impression, total_click, total_revenue, stage_id, p_date, app_id FROM res UNION ALL SELECT user_id, did, is_user, '' AS placement_name, '' AS area, '' AS network_firm, his_first_revenue_date, his_last_revenue_date, impression_info_str, click_info_str, revenue_info_str, total_impression, total_click, total_revenue, stage_id, p_date, app_id FROM res_w5

name: 20260422.adbi.app_msdk_back_ad_stats_df
sql_units: WITH back_device AS (SELECT p_date AS back_date, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', p_date) + 1 AS date_diff, stage_id, did, app_id, LOWER(os) AS os, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country)) AS country, MAPPING('media_source', IF(COALESCE(TRIM(network_name), '') = '', 'unknown', TRIM(network_name))) AS media_source, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_id), '') = '' OR COALESCE(TRIM(network_name), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adgroup_id), '') = '' OR COALESCE(TRIM(network_name), '') = '', 'unknown', adgroup_id) AS adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(creative_id), '') = '' OR COALESCE(TRIM(network_name), '') = '', 'unknown', creative_id) AS ad_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_name), '') = '' OR COALESCE(TRIM(network_name), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_name) AS campaign_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adgroup_name), '') = '' OR COALESCE(TRIM(network_name), '') = '', 'unknown', adgroup_name) AS adset_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(creative_name), '') = '' OR COALESCE(TRIM(network_name), '') = '', 'unknown', creative_name) AS ad_name, back_type, IF(ARRAY_CONTAINS(a.back_time_type, 30), '2', IF(ARRAY_CONTAINS(a.back_time_type, 14), '1', '0')) AS is_30back, FIRST_VALUE(p_date, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did ORDER BY p_date ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_back_date, FIRST_VALUE(IF(ARRAY_CONTAINS(a.back_time_type, 14), p_date, NULL), TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, a.did ORDER BY p_date ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_14back_date, FIRST_VALUE(IF(ARRAY_CONTAINS(a.back_time_type, 30), p_date, NULL), TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did ORDER BY p_date ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_30back_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_msdk_back_device_reattribution_di)) WHERE a.p_date <= '2026-05-30' AND a.app_id IN ('4280')), back_pay_device AS (SELECT a.back_date, a.date_diff, a.stage_id, a.did, a.app_id, a.os, a.country, a.media_source, a.campaign_id, a.adset_id, a.ad_id, a.campaign_name, a.adset_name, a.ad_name, a.back_type, a.is_30back, ARRAY_ACTIVE_OF_INDEX(active_info, CONCAT(SEQUENCE(2, 30, 1), SEQUENCE(45, 180, 15), SEQUENCE(210, 720, 30)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', back_date) + 1, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', next_back_date) + 1) AS active_info_from_7back, ARRAY_DOUBLE_OF_INDEX(pay_amt_info, CONCAT(SEQUENCE(1, 30, 1), SEQUENCE(45, 180, 15), SEQUENCE(210, 720, 30)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', back_date) + 1, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', next_back_date) + 1) AS pay_amt_info_from_7back, ARRAY_LONG_OF_INDEX(pay_cnt_info, CONCAT(SEQUENCE(1, 30, 1), SEQUENCE(45, 180, 15), SEQUENCE(210, 720, 30)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', back_date) + 1, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', next_back_date) + 1) AS pay_cnt_info_from_7back, ARRAY_ONE_OF_INDEX(pay_cnt_info, CONCAT(SEQUENCE(1, 30, 1), SEQUENCE(45, 180, 15), SEQUENCE(210, 720, 30)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', back_date) + 1, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', next_back_date) + 1) AS pay_user_info_from_7back, ARRAY_ACTIVE_OF_INDEX(IF(a.app_id = '3001' AND is_30back IN ('1', '2'), active_info, NULL), CONCAT(SEQUENCE(2, 30, 1), SEQUENCE(45, 180, 15), SEQUENCE(210, 720, 30)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', back_date) + 1, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', next_14back_date) + 1) AS active_info_from_14back, ARRAY_DOUBLE_OF_INDEX(IF(a.app_id = '3001' AND is_30back IN ('1', '2'), pay_amt_info, NULL), CONCAT(SEQUENCE(1, 30, 1), SEQUENCE(45, 180, 15), SEQUENCE(210, 720, 30)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', back_date) + 1, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', next_14back_date) + 1) AS pay_amt_info_from_14back, ARRAY_LONG_OF_INDEX(IF(a.app_id = '3001' AND is_30back IN ('1', '2'), pay_cnt_info, NULL), CONCAT(SEQUENCE(1, 30, 1), SEQUENCE(45, 180, 15), SEQUENCE(210, 720, 30)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', back_date) + 1, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', next_14back_date) + 1) AS pay_cnt_info_from_14back, ARRAY_ONE_OF_INDEX(IF(a.app_id = '3001' AND is_30back IN ('1', '2'), pay_cnt_info, (PARTITION BY did)) AS app_id_group_in_all, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did ORDER BY create_date, app_id) AS rn FROM (SELECT app_id, did, SUBSTRING(did_create_time, 1, 10) AS create_date, country, os FROM adbi.dim_did_attribute_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT('{{app_ids_str_config}}', ','), app_id) UNION ALL SELECT a.app_id, a.did, a.create_date, a.country, a.os FROM adbi_test.dm_msdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df AS a JOIN (SELECT app_id AS app_id_dis, MAX(stage_id) AS stage_id_dis FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_msdk_app_stage_config)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND is_ob = '1' GROUP BY app_id) AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id_dis AND a.stage_id = b.stage_id_dis WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-30' AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT('{{app_ids_str_config}}', ','), a.app_id)) AS a), app_ids AS (SELECT app_id, app_id_group FROM (SELECT app_id, SPLIT(app_id_group, ',') AS app_id_group FROM (SELECT app_id, ARRAY_SUBSETS(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(app_id) OVER ()), 1, NULL) AS app_id_group_sets FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(SPLIT('{{app_ids_str_config}}', ',')) AS app_id)) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(app_id_group_sets) AS app_id_group) WHERE ARRAY_CONTAINS(app_id_group, app_id)), new_agg_first AS (SELECT a.app_id, app_id_group, create_date, country, os, did_new_user, first_did_new_user, non_first_did_new_user FROM (SELECT app_id, create_date, country, os, SUM(1) AS did_new_user, SUM(1) AS first_did_new_user, 0 AS non_first_did_new_user FROM did_df WHERE create_date >= '${start_date}' AND SIZE(app_id_group_in_all) = 1 GROUP BY app_id, create_date, country, os) AS a JOIN app_ids AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id UNION ALL SELECT app_id, app_id_group, create_date, country, os, COUNT(1) AS did_new_user, SUM(IF(app_id = app_id_first_in_all, 1, 0)) AS first_did_new_user, SUM(IF(app_id <> app_id_first_in_all, 1, 0)) AS non_first_did_new_user FROM (SELECT a.app_id, app_id_group, create_date, country, os, ARRAY_APPS_FIRST(app_id_group, app_rn_map) AS app_id_first_in_all FROM (SELECT app_id, create_date, country, os, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(app_id, rn)) OVER (PARTITION BY did)) AS app_rn_map FROM did_df WHERE SIZE(app_id_group_in_all) > 1) AS a JOIN app_ids AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id WHERE create_date >= '${start_date}') GROUP BY app_id, create_date, country, os, app_id_group), new_agg AS (SELECT app_id, IF(app_id_group = app_id, 'all', app_id_group) AS app_id_group, create_date, country, os, SUM(did_new_user) AS did_new_user, SUM(first_did_new_user) AS first_did_new_user, SUM(non_first_did_new_user) AS non_first_did_new_user FROM (SELECT app_id, CONCAT_WS(',', app_id_group) AS app_id_group, create_date, country, os, did_new_user, first_did_new_user, non_first_did_new_user FROM new_agg_first) GROUP BY app_id, create_date, country, os, app_id_group) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_cockpit_game_inside_stats_did_df)) SELECT app_id, app_id_group, data_date, MAPPING('week_1st_day', 'Mon', data_date) AS data_week, SUBSTRING(data_date, 1, 7) AS data_month, SUBSTRING(data_date, 1, 4) AS data_year, os, country, did_new_user, first_did_new_user, non_first_did_new_user, did_active_user, did_active_user_7d FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.data_date, b.data_date) AS data_date, COALESCE(a.app_id, b.app_id) AS app_id, COALESCE(a.app_id_group, b.app_id_group) AS app_id_group, COALESCE(a.country, b.country) AS country, COALESCE(a.os, b.os) AS os, did_new_user, first_did_new_user, non_first_did_new_user, did_active_user, did_active_user_7d FROM (SELECT create_date AS data_date, app_id, app_id_group, COALESCE(TRIM(LOWER(country)), 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(TRIM(LOWER(os)), 'unknown') AS os, did_new_user, first_did_new_user, non_first_did_new_user FROM new_agg) AS a FULL JOIN (SELECT p_date AS data_date, app_id, app_id_group, COALESCE(TRIM(LOWER(country)), 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(TRIM(LOWER(os)), 'unknown') AS os, did_active_user, did_active_user_7d FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_did_active_stats_di)) WHERE p_date <= '2026-05-30') AS b ON a.data_date = b.data_date AND a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.app_id_group = b.app_id_group AND a.country = b.country AND a.os = b.os)

did_loss_and_back_365p_user, SUM(did_30back) AS did_30back, SUM(IF(COALESCE(media_source, '') <> 'organic', did_30back, 0)) AS did_30back_buy, SUM(IF(COALESCE(media_source, '') <> 'organic', retention_30d_30back, 0)) AS retention_d30_30back_buy, SUM(IF(media_source = 'organic', did_30back, 0)) AS did_30back_organic, SUM(IF(media_source = 'organic', retention_30d_30back, 0)) AS retention_d30_did_30back_organic FROM (SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_cockpit_game_inside_back_account_df)) WHERE p_date = '${p_date}') GROUP BY data_date, first_mt_country, country, os, app_id) AS c ON c.data_date = COALESCE(a.data_date, b.data_date) AND c.country = COALESCE(a.country, b.country) AND c.first_mt_country = COALESCE(a.first_mt_country, b.first_mt_country) AND c.os = COALESCE(a.os, b.os) AND c.app_id = COALESCE(a.app_id, b.app_id) FULL JOIN all_month_active_df AS d ON d.data_date = COALESCE(a.data_date, b.data_date, c.data_date) AND d.country = COALESCE(a.country, b.country, c.country) AND d.first_mt_country = COALESCE(a.first_mt_country, b.first_mt_country, c.first_mt_country) AND d.os = COALESCE(a.os, b.os, c.os) AND d.app_id = COALESCE(a.app_id, b.app_id, c.app_id) FULL JOIN all_week_active_df AS f ON f.data_date = COALESCE(a.data_date, b.data_date, c.data_date, d.data_date) AND f.country = COALESCE(a.country, b.country, c.country, d.country) AND f.first_mt_country = COALESCE(a.first_mt_country, b.first_mt_country, c.first_mt_country, d.first_mt_country) AND f.os = COALESCE(a.os, b.os, c.os, d.os) AND f.app_id = COALESCE(a.app_id, b.app_id, c.app_id, d.app_id)) AS a WHERE data_date >= '${init_date}' AND data_date <= '${p_date}'

name: 20260422.adbi.dm_admkt_ad_cost_report_df
sql_units: WITH cost_report /* union all */ /* select */ /*     ad_account_id, */ /*     data_date report_date, */ /*     media_source, */ /*     campaign_id, */ /*     campaign_name, */ /*     adset_id, */ /*     adset_name, */ /*     ad_id, */ /*     ad_name, */ /*     app_id, */ /*     app_name, */ /*     os, */ /*     country, */ /*     impression, */ /*     click, */ /*     cost, */ /*     cost cost_align, */ /*     ad_target */ /* from adbi_test.dm_admkt_ad_cost_report_df_test */ /* where p_date = '2026-05-10' */ AS (/* 录入 */ SELECT NULL AS ad_account_id, report_date, MAPPING('media_source', media_source) AS media_source, '' AS campaign_id, NULL AS campaign_name, '' AS adset_id, NULL AS adset_name, '' AS ad_id, NULL AS ad_name, app_id, app_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(os), '') = '', 'unknown', os) AS os, country, NULL AS impression, NULL AS click, cost, cost AS cost_align, CASE WHEN ad_target IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE ad_target END AS ad_target FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwa_admkt_input_cost_report_fully)) WHERE date = '20260530' AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL /* 抓取 */ SELECT a.ad_account_id, a.report_date, a.media_source, a.campaign_id, a.campaign_name, a.adset_id, a.adset_name, a.ad_id, a.ad_name, a.app_id, a.app_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(a.os), '') = '', 'unknown', a.os) AS os, a.country, a.impression, a.click, a.cost, a.cost AS cost_align, b.ad_target FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwa_admkt_api_ad_cost_report_df)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.app_id, x.ad_account_id, x.ad_target, x.ad_platform_name FROM (SELECT app_id, ad_account_id, ad_target, ad_platform_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, ad_platform_name, ad_account_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rn FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_gms_ad_bi_ad_account)) WHERE date = '20260530') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1) AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.ad_account_id = b.ad_account_id AND a.media_source = b.ad_platform_name WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-30' /* 小渠道的消耗数据暂时只要6月2号之前的数据 */ UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ad_account_id, report_date, network AS media_source, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_id AS adset_id, adgroup_name AS adset_name, creative_id AS ad_id, creative_name AS ad_name, app_id, app_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(os_name), '') = '', 'unknown', os_name) AS os, country, NULL AS impression, NULL AS click, adjust_cost AS cost, adjust_cost AS cost_align, 1 AS ad_target FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_ods_adjust_cost_di)) WHERE logymd <= '2024-06-02' AND logymd >= '2023-11-06' /*  只要11月6号之后的数据 */ UNION ALL SELECT ad_account_id, report_date, media_source, campaign_id, campaign_name, adset_id, adset_name, ad_id, ad_name, app_id, app_name, os, country, NULL AS impression, NULL AS click, 0 AS cost, cost AS cost_align, ad_target FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwa_admkt_align_ad_cost_report_df)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30'), cost_report_agg AS (SELECT report_date AS data_date, app_id, MAX(ad_account_id) AS ad_account_id, MAX(ad_target) AS ad_target, LOWER(os) AS os, MAX(app_name) AS app_name, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country)) AS country, media_source, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_id), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adset_id), '') = '', 'unknown', adset_id) AS adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ad_id), '') = '', 'unknown', ad_id) AS ad_id, MAX(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_name), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_name)) AS campaign_name, MAX(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adset_name), '') = '', 'unknown', adset_name)) AS adset_name, MAX(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ad_name), '') = '', 'unknown', ad_name)) AS ad_name, SUM(impression) AS impression, SUM(click) AS click, SUM(cost) AS cost, SUM(cost_align) AS cost_align, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN impression ELSE 0 END) AS impression_new, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN click ELSE 0 END) AS click_new, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS cost_new, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN cost_align ELSE 0 END) AS cost_new_align, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 2 THEN impression ELSE 0 END) AS impression_back, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 2 THEN click ELSE 0 END) AS click_back, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 2 THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS cost_back, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 2 THEN cost_align ELSE 0 END) AS cost_back_align, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN impression ELSE 0 END) AS impression_promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN click ELSE 0 END) AS click_promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS cost_promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN cost_align ELSE 0 END) AS cost_promotion_align FROM cost_report WHERE report_date <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY report_date, app_id, LOWER(os), LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country)), media_source, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_id), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_id), IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adset_id), '') = '', 'unknown', adset_id), IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ad_id), '') = '', 'unknown', ad_id)), stage_dedup AS (SELECT app_id, stage_id, stage_dt, is_ob FROM (SELECT app_id, stage_id, is_ob, SUBSTRING(stage_create_time, 1, 10) AS stage_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, SUBSTRING(stage_create_time, 1, 10) ORDER BY stage_id DESC) AS rn FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_msdk_app_stage_config)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30') AS t WHERE rn = 1), stage_range AS (SELECT app_id AS app_id_dis, stage_id, is_ob, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id ORDER BY stage_dt) = 1 THEN '1900-01-01' ELSE stage_dt END AS start_dt, CASE WHEN LEAD(stage_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id ORDER BY stage_dt) IS NULL THEN '9999-12-31' ELSE DATE_ADD(LEAD(stage_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id ORDER BY stage_dt), 1 * -1) END AS end_dt FROM stage_dedup) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_admkt_ad_cost_report_df)) SELECT `data_date`, `ad_account_id`, `os`, `app_name`, `country`, `media_source`, `campaign_id`, `adset_id`, `ad_id`, `campaign_name`, `adset_name`, `ad_name`, `impression`, `click`, `cost`, `cost_align`, `impression_new`, `click_new`, `cost_new`, `cost_new_align`, `impression_back`, `click_back`, `cost_back`, `cost_back_align`, `impression_promotion`, `click_promotion`, `cost_promotion`, `cost_promotion_align`, `ad_target`, COALESCE(b.stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, `app_id` FROM cost_report_agg AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT app_id AS app_id_des FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_gms_ad_bi_app)) WHERE p_date = '20260530' AND is_cn = 0) AS f ON a.app_id = f.app_id_des LEFT JOIN stage_range AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id_dis AND a.data_date BETWEEN b.start_dt AND b.end_dt

sql_units: /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dm_behavior_battle_role_zone_df PARTITION (logymd = '2026-05-30', appid = 'mlbb') */ WITH his_battle_info AS (SELECT t_battle_df.roleid, t_battle_df.zoneid, his_battle_cnt /* 生涯累计战斗场次，不区分pvptype */, his_win_cnt /* 生涯累计胜利场次，不区分pvptype */, his_ranked_cnt, his_classic_cnt, his_chess_cnt /* 自走棋生涯场次 */, his_brawl_cnt /* 乱斗生涯场次 */, his_classic_ranked_cnt, his_all_battle_cnt, his_em_type_cnt /* 生涯玩过的娱乐模式的场次 */, his_match_mode_cnt /* 历史赛事模式参与次数 */, his_em_type /* 生涯玩过的娱乐模式种类 */, BIGINT(SPLIT(his_last_battle_time_fds[0], '_')[1]) AS his_last_battle_fds, CASE WHEN his_all_battle_cnt > 0 THEN COALESCE(his_ranked_cnt, 0) / his_all_battle_cnt ELSE 0 END AS ranked_rate FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(his_battle_cnt) AS his_battle_cnt, SUM(his_win_cnt) AS his_win_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN his_battle_cnt END) AS his_ranked_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 1 THEN his_battle_cnt END) AS his_classic_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 39 THEN his_battle_cnt END) AS his_chess_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 4 THEN his_battle_cnt END) AS his_brawl_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype IN (1, 2) THEN his_battle_cnt END) AS his_classic_ranked_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) THEN his_battle_cnt END) AS his_all_battle_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT pvptype IN (1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 13, 18) THEN his_battle_cnt END) AS his_em_type_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype IN (7, 10, 11, 13, 18) THEN his_battle_cnt END) AS his_match_mode_cnt, CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN NOT pvptype IN (1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 13, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '6min-', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 6min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '6-8min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 6_8min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '6-8min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 6_8min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '8-10min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 8_10min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '8-10min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 8_10min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '10-12min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 10_12min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '10-12min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 10_12min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '12-14min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 12_14min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '12-14min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 12_14min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '14-16min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 14_16min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '14-16min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 14_16min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '16-18min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 16_18min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '16-18min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 16_18min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '18-20min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 18_20min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '18-20min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 18_20min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '20min+', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 20min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '20min+', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 20min_battleid_cnt FROM (SELECT battleid, wincamp, blacknum AS if_5black /* 2026年1月22日11:59:16 更新为开黑人数（字段名不做修改） */, accountid, zoneid, heroid, runeid, new_rune_skill1, new_rune_skill2, new_rune_skill3, 1 AS battleid_cnt, wincamp AS win_battleid_cnt, CASE WHEN real_road = 5 THEN '5-金币路' WHEN real_road = 1 THEN '1-经验路' WHEN real_road = 2 THEN '2-中路' WHEN real_road = 4 THEN '4-打野' WHEN real_road = 3 THEN '3-游走' ELSE '其他' END AS real_road_std, CASE WHEN t.battletime <= 360 THEN '6min-' WHEN t.battletime >= 361 AND battletime <= 480 THEN '6-8min' WHEN t.battletime >= 481 AND battletime <= 600 THEN '8-10min' WHEN t.battletime >= 601 AND battletime <= 720 THEN '10-12min' WHEN t.battletime >= 721 AND battletime <= 840 THEN '12-14min' WHEN t.battletime >= 841 AND battletime <= 960 THEN '14-16min' WHEN t.battletime >= 961 AND battletime <= 1080 THEN '16-18min' WHEN t.battletime >= 1081 AND battletime <= 1200 THEN '18-20min' WHEN t.battletime >= 1201 THEN '20min+' ELSE 'else times' END AS battle_time_type FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS t WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (2) AND realpvptype IN (2, 59, 90) AND zoneid < 57000 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND fake_ai = 0) AS t JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battleid, icamp, accountid, zoneid, heroid, porder, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY battleid, icamp ORDER BY porder ASC) AS icamp_porder FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t1 ON t.battleid = t1.battleid AND t.accountid = t1.accountid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t.heroid = t1.heroid JOIN (SELECT battleid, MAX(rankstar) AS rankstar, MAX(bigranklvl) AS bigranklvl, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS t WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (2) AND realpvptype IN (2, 59, 90) AND zoneid < 57000 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(1) = 10) AS t2 ON t.battleid = t2.battleid JOIN (SELECT battleid, SUM(iswin) AS iswin_sum, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(1) = 10 AND SUM(iswin) = 5) AS t3 ON t.battleid = t3.battleid LEFT JOIN hero_data_t AS t4 ON t.heroid = t4.heroid GROUP BY t4.heroid, t4.hero_name, t4.heros_type, t4.position_type, CASE WHEN t2.rankstar BETWEEN 162 AND 211 THEN 8 WHEN t2.rankstar >= 212 THEN 9 ELSE t2.bigranklvl END, t.if_5black, t.runeid, t.new_rune_skill1, t.new_rune_skill2, t.new_rune_skill3, t.real_road_std, t1.icamp_porder

name: 组合英雄胜率match_hero_win_ratio_data_wmz_tmp
sql_units: /* 组合英雄胜率更新 */ WITH match_hero_t AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.heroid, t1.heroid) AS hero_match_id, t.heroid AS main_heroid, t1.heroid AS sub_heroid, t.heroid AS main_heroid_add, t1.heroid AS sub_heroid_add, CONCAT('-', CAST(t.heroid AS STRING), '-', CAST(t1.heroid AS STRING), '-') AS hero_match FROM (SELECT heroid FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 3 * -1)) AS t LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT heroid FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 3 * -1)) AS t1 ON t.heroid < t1.heroid * 10000 WHERE NOT t.heroid IS NULL AND NOT t1.heroid IS NULL), battle_hero_list_t AS (SELECT t.battleid, MAX(IF(rankstar >= 162, 8, bigranklvl)) AS bigranklvl /* 星数>162为荣耀神话 */, CASE WHEN t.battletime <= 360 THEN '6min-' WHEN t.battletime >= 361 AND battletime <= 480 THEN '6-8min' WHEN t.battletime >= 481 AND battletime <= 600 THEN '8-10min' WHEN t.battletime >= 601 AND battletime <= 720 THEN '10-12min' WHEN t.battletime >= 721 AND battletime <= 840 THEN '12-14min' WHEN t.battletime >= 841 AND battletime <= 960 THEN '14-16min' WHEN t.battletime >= 961 AND battletime <= 1080 THEN '16-18min' WHEN t.battletime >= 1081 AND battletime <= 1200 THEN '18-20min' WHEN t.battletime >= 1201 THEN '20min+' ELSE 'else times' END AS battle_time_type, COLLECT_SET(IF(wincamp = 1, heroid, NULL)) AS win_heroid_set, COLLECT_SET(IF(wincamp = 0, heroid, NULL)) AS fail_heroid_set FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS t WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (2) AND realpvptype IN (2, 59, 90) AND zoneid < 57000 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY t.battleid, battle_time_type HAVING COUNT(1) = 10 AND MAX(bigranklvl) >= 3), result_t AS (SELECT hero_match_id, bigranklvl, battle_time_type, match_type, main_heroid, sub_heroid, SUM(win_battleid_cnt) AS win_battleid_cnt, SUM(win_battleid_cnt) + SUM(fail_battleid_cnt) AS battleid_cnt FROM (/* 敌对主英雄胜利 */ SELECT t1.hero_match_id, t.bigranklvl, t.battle_time_type, '敌队' AS match_type, t1.main_heroid, t1.sub_heroid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.battleid) AS win_battleid_cnt, 0 AS fail_battleid_cnt FROM battle_hero_list_t AS t JOIN match_hero_t AS t1 ON ARRAY_CONTAINS(t.win_heroid_set, t1.main_heroid_add) AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(t.fail_heroid_set, t1.sub_heroid_add) GROUP BY t1.hero_match_id, t.bigranklvl, t.battle_time_type, t1.main_heroid, t1.sub_heroid UNION ALL /* 敌对主英雄失败 */ SELECT t1.hero_match_id, t.bigranklvl, t.battle_time_type, '敌队' AS match_type, t1.main_heroid, t1.sub_heroid, 0 AS win_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT t.battleid) AS fail_battleid_cnt FROM battle_hero_list_t AS t JOIN match_hero_t AS t1 ON ARRAY_CONTAINS(t.fail_heroid_set, t1.main_heroid_add) AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(t.win_heroid_set, t1.sub_heroid_add) GROUP BY t1.hero_match_id, t.bigranklvl, t.battle_time_type, t1.main_heroid, t1.sub_heroid UNION ALL /* 同队胜利 */ SELECT t1.hero_match_id, t.bigranklvl, t.battle_time_type, '同队' AS match_type, t1.main_heroid, t1.sub_heroid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.battleid) AS win_battleid_cnt, 0 AS fail_battleid_cnt FROM battle_hero_list_t AS t JOIN match_hero_t AS t1 ON ARRAY_CONTAINS(t.win_heroid_set, t1.main_heroid_add) AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(t.win_heroid_set, t1.sub_heroid_add) AND t1.main_heroid_add <> t1.sub_heroid_add /* 剔除两个英雄同一队的数据 */ GROUP BY t1.hero_match_id, t.bigranklvl, t.battle_time_type, t1.main_heroid, t1.sub_heroid UNION ALL /* 同队失败 */ SELECT t1.hero_match_id, t.bigranklvl, t.battle_time_type, '同队' AS match_type, t1.main_heroid, t1.sub_heroid, 0 AS win_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT t.battleid) AS fail_battleid_cnt FROM battle_hero_list_t AS t JOIN match_hero_t AS t1 ON ARRAY_CONTAINS(t.fail_heroid_set, t1.main_heroid_add) AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(t.fail_heroid_set, t1.sub_heroid_add) AND t1.main_heroid_add <> t1.sub_heroid_add /* 剔除两个英雄同一队的数据 */ GROUP BY t1.hero_match_id, t.bigranklvl, t.battle_time_type, t1.main_heroid, t1.sub_heroid) AS a GROUP BY hero_match_id, bigranklvl, battle_time_type, match_type, main_heroid, sub_heroid), real_roat_t AS (/* 英雄实际分路 */ SELECT heroid, COLLECT_LIST(real_road_std) AS real_road_std_list FROM (SELECT a.*, a.battle_cnt / b.battle_cnt AS `分路占比` FROM (SELECT heroid, CASE WHEN real_road = 5 THEN '5-金币路' WHEN real_road = 1 THEN '1-经验路' WHEN real_road = 2 THEN '2-中路' WHEN real_road = 4 THEN '4-打野' WHEN real_road = 3 THEN '3-游走' ELSE '其他' END AS real_road_std, SUM(1) AS battle_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS t WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (2) AND realpvptype IN (2, 59, 90) AND zoneid < 57000 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND fake_ai = 0 AND bigranklvl >= 5 /* 只看史诗及以上 */ GROUP BY heroid, real_road_std) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, SUM(1) AS battle_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS t WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (2) AND realpvptype IN (2, 59, 90) AND zoneid < 57000 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND fake_ai = 0 AND bigranklvl >= 5 /* 只看史诗及以上 */ GROUP BY heroid) AS b ON a.heroid = b.heroid WHERE a.battle_cnt / b.battle_cnt >= 0.05) AS t GROUP BY heroid), hero_data_t AS (SELECT a.heroid, hero_name, CASE WHEN heroes = 1 THEN '坦克' WHEN heroes = 2 THEN '战士' WHEN heroes = 3 THEN '刺客' WHEN heroes = 4 THEN '法师' WHEN heroes = 5 THEN '射手' WHEN heroes = 6 THEN '辅助' WHEN heroes = -9999 THEN '' ELSE 'else' END || ',' || CASE WHEN sub_heroes = 1 THEN '坦克' WHEN sub_heroes = 2 THEN '战士' WHEN sub_heroes = 3 THEN '刺客' WHEN sub_heroes = 4 THEN '法师' WHEN sub_heroes = 5 THEN '射手' WHEN sub_heroes = 6 THEN '辅助' WHEN sub_heroes = -9999 THEN '' ELSE 'else' END AS heros_type, CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN position = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN position = 3 THEN '游走路' WHEN position = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN position = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN position = -9999 THEN '' ELSE 'else' END || ',' || CASE WHEN sub_position = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN sub_position = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN sub_position = 3 THEN '游走路' WHEN sub_position = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN sub_position = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN sub_position = -9999 THEN '' ELSE 'else' END || ',' || COALESCE(real_road_std_list[0], '') || ',' || COALESCE(real_road_std_list[1], '') || ',' || COALESCE(real_road_std_list[2], '') || ',' || COALESCE(real_road_std_list[3], '') || ',' || COALESCE(real_road_std_list[4], '') || ',' || COALESCE(real_road_std_list[5], '') AS position_type FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df AS a LEFT JOIN real_roat_t AS b ON a.heroid = b.heroid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-28' GROUP BY a.heroid, hero_name, heros_type, position_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.match_hero_win_ratio_data_wmz_tmp PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT IF(t.bigranklvl = 8, '荣耀神话', t1.bigrank_name) AS bigrank_name, t.hero_match_id, t.match_type, t.main_heroid, t2.hero_name AS main_hero_name, t2.position_type AS main_hero_position, t.sub_heroid, t3.hero_name AS sub_hero_name, t3.position_type AS sub_hero_position, SUM(win_battleid_cnt) AS win_battleid_cnt, SUM(battleid_cnt) AS battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '6min-', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 6min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '6min-', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 6min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '6-8min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 6_8min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '6-8min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 6_8min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '8-10min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 8_10min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '8-10min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 8_10min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '10-12min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 10_12min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '10-12min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 10_12min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '12-14min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 12_14min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '12-14min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 12_14min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '14-16min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 14_16min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '14-16min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 14_16min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '16-18min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 16_18min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '16-18min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 16_18min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '18-20min', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 18_20min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '18-20min', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 18_20min_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '20min+', win_battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 20min_win_battleid_cnt, SUM(IF(battle_time_type = '20min+', battleid_cnt, 0)) AS 20min_battleid_cnt FROM result_t AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE(bigrank_name, '[I|V]', '') AS bigrank_name, bigrank FROM mt_dim.dim_ranked_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-28' GROUP BY REGEXP_REPLACE(bigrank_name, '[I|V]', ''), bigrank) AS t1 ON t.bigranklvl = t1.bigrank LEFT JOIN hero_data_t AS t2 ON t.main_heroid = t2.heroid LEFT JOIN hero_data_t AS t3 ON t.sub_heroid = t3.heroid GROUP BY IF(t.bigranklvl = 8, '荣耀神话', t1.bigrank_name), t.hero_match_id, t.match_type, t.main_heroid, t2.hero_name, t2.position_type, t.sub_heroid, t3.hero_name, t3.position_type

sql_units: /* SET spark.executor.cores=8; */ /* SET spark.executor.memory=32g; */ /* SET spark.sql.shuffle.partitions=500; */ WITH t_battle_rank AS (SELECT * FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df IF(COALESCE(his_last_active_second_date, '1970-01-01') = '1970-01-01', 0, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', his_last_active_second_date)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', his_last_active_date)) AS bf_active_date_diff FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000), t_basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM `mt_dim`.`dim_basic_role_zone_df` WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-30') AND zoneid < 57000), t_battle_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(SUBSTRING(his_last_battle_time, 1, 10)) AS his_last_battle_date, MAX(is_ai) AS is_ai FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND day_pay_amount > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_gameplay_battle_rank_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT t_battle.roleid, t_battle.zoneid, t_battle.pvptype, COALESCE(t_basic_df.register_date, '1970-01-01') AS register_date, IF(COALESCE(t_basic_df.register_date, '1970-01-01') = '1970-01-01', -99999, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', t_basic_df.register_date)) AS register_date_diff, COALESCE(t_active_df.bf_active_date_diff, -99999) AS bf_active_date_diff, COALESCE(t_active_df.is_active_day, 0) AS is_active_day, IF(t_pay_di.roleid IS NULL, 0, 1) AS is_charge_day, t_battle.is_battle_day, t_battle.his_max_rankstar, t_battle.his_max_rank_id, t_battle.his_max_minranklvl, t_battle.his_max_bigranklvl, t_battle.his_last_rankstar, t_battle.his_last_rank_id, t_battle.his_last_minrank, t_battle.his_last_bigrank, t_battle.his_last_rank_change_date, t_battle.his_last_reason FROM (SELECT t_battle_rank.roleid, t_battle_rank.zoneid, t_battle_rank.pvptype, IF(COALESCE(t_battle_df.his_last_battle_date, '1970-01-01') = '2026-05-30', 1, 0) AS is_battle_day, t_battle_rank.his_max_rankstar, t_battle_rank.his_max_rank_id, t_battle_rank.his_max_minranklvl, t_battle_rank.his_max_bigranklvl, t_battle_rank.his_last_rankstar, t_battle_rank.his_last_rank_id, t_battle_rank.his_last_minrank, t_battle_rank.his_last_bigrank, t_battle_rank.his_last_rank_change_date, t_battle_rank.his_last_reason FROM t_battle_rank LEFT JOIN t_battle_df ON t_battle_rank.roleid = t_battle_df.roleid AND t_battle_rank.zoneid = t_battle_df.zoneid WHERE COALESCE(is_ai, 0) = 0) AS t_battle LEFT JOIN t_active_df ON t_battle.roleid = t_active_df.roleid AND t_battle.zoneid = t_active_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_basic_df ON t_battle.roleid = t_basic_df.roleid AND t_battle.zoneid = t_basic_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_pay_di ON t_battle.roleid = t_pay_di.roleid AND t_battle.zoneid = t_pay_di.zoneid

name: adbi.dwm_sdk_behavior_active_user_df
