act_di.day_last_active_time, act_di.login_cnt, act_di.p_date FROM (SELECT app_id, accountid, zoneid, area, day_first_device_id, day_last_device_id, day_first_active_time, day_last_active_time, login_cnt, p_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_sdk_behavior_active_user_di)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30') AS act_di) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_sdk_behavior_active_user_df_out)) SELECT accountid, zoneid, area, NULL AS os_type, NULL AS os, NULL AS channel, NULL AS adjust_country, NULL AS adjust_network_name, NULL AS adjust_os_type, NULL AS adjust_os, NULL AS adjust_id, his_first_device_id, his_first_active_time, his_first_active_date, his_last_device_id, his_last_active_time, his_last_active_date, day_login_cnt, 0 AS day_login_duration, 0 AS level, NULL AS level_info_str, 0 AS ranklvl, NULL AS ranklvl_info_str, NULL AS login_cnt_info_str, NULL AS login_duration_info_str, active_info, 0 AS total_login_duration, 0 AS total_active_days, NULL AS create_date, NULL AS create_time, 0 AS day_pay_amount, 0 AS total_pay_amount, NULL AS avtive_type, app_id FROM (SELECT COALESCE(active_df.accountid, user_active_di.accountid) AS accountid, IF(NOT user_active_di.accountid IS NULL, user_active_di.zoneid, active_df.zoneid) AS zoneid, IF(NOT user_active_di.accountid IS NULL, user_active_di.area, active_df.area) AS area, IF(NOT active_df.accountid IS NULL, active_df.his_first_device_id, user_active_di.day_first_device_id) AS his_first_device_id, IF(NOT active_df.accountid IS NULL, active_df.his_first_active_time, user_active_di.day_first_active_time) AS his_first_active_time, IF(NOT active_df.accountid IS NULL, active_df.his_first_active_date, user_active_di.p_date) AS his_first_active_date, IF(NOT user_active_di.accountid IS NULL, user_active_di.day_last_device_id, active_df.his_last_device_id) AS his_last_device_id, IF(NOT user_active_di.accountid IS NULL, user_active_di.day_last_active_time, active_df.his_last_active_time) AS his_last_active_time, IF(NOT user_active_di.accountid IS NULL, user_active_di.p_date, active_df.his_last_active_date) AS his_last_active_date, IF(NOT user_active_di.accountid IS NULL, user_active_di.login_cnt, 0) AS day_login_cnt, IF(NOT user_active_di.accountid IS NULL, CONCAT('1', COALESCE(active_df.active_info, '')), CONCAT('0', COALESCE(active_df.active_info, ''))) AS active_info, COALESCE(active_df.app_id, user_active_di.app_id) AS app_id FROM (SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_sdk_behavior_active_user_df_in)) WHERE p_date = DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 1 * -1)) AS active_df FULL JOIN user_active_di ON active_df.accountid = user_active_di.accountid AND active_df.app_id = user_active_di.app_id) AS a DISTRIBUTE BY ABS(HASH(accountid)) % IF(app_id = '1001', 200, 20)

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_general_index_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH t_active_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(his_last_active_date = '2026-05-30', 1, 0) AS is_active_day, IF(his_last_active_date = '2026-05-30', IF(COALESCE(his_last_active_second_date, '1970-01-01') = '1970-01-01', 0, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', his_last_active_second_date)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', his_last_active_date)) AS bf_active_date_diff, IF(SUBSTRING(his_last_active_date, 1, 7) = '2026-05', 1, 0) AS is_active_mon FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000), t_basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM `mt_dim`.`dim_basic_role_zone_df` WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-30') AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_ai = 0), t_pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(IF(his_last_pay_date = '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS is_charge_day, MAX(IF(SUBSTRING(his_last_pay_date, 1, 7) = '2026-05', 1, 0)) AS is_charge_mon FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND his_pay_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_battle_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(IF(SUBSTRING(his_last_battle_time, 1, 10) = '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS is_battle_day, MAX(IF(SUBSTRING(his_last_battle_time, 1, 7) = '2026-05', 1, 0)) AS is_battle_mon FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_general_index_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT t_basic_df.roleid, t_basic_df.zoneid, IF(COALESCE(t_basic_df.register_date, '1970-01-01') = '1970-01-01', -99999, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', t_basic_df.register_date)) AS register_date_diff, COALESCE(t_active_df.bf_active_date_diff, -99999) AS bf_active_date_diff, COALESCE(t_active_df.is_active_day, 0) AS is_active_day, COALESCE(t_pay_df.is_charge_day, 0) AS is_charge_day, COALESCE(t_battle_df.is_battle_day, 0) AS is_battle_day, COALESCE(t_active_df.is_active_mon, 0) AS is_active_mon, COALESCE(t_pay_df.is_charge_mon, 0) AS is_charge_mon, COALESCE(t_battle_df.is_battle_mon, 0) AS is_battle_mon FROM t_basic_df LEFT JOIN t_active_df ON t_basic_df.roleid = t_active_df.roleid AND t_basic_df.zoneid = t_active_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_pay_df ON t_basic_df.roleid = t_pay_df.roleid AND t_basic_df.zoneid = t_pay_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_battle_df ON t_basic_df.roleid = t_battle_df.roleid AND t_basic_df.zoneid = t_battle_df.zoneid

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_social_ai_feature_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* 好友推人发起人和接收人 */ WITH focus_info AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.object_roleid, a.object_zoneid, IF(MAX(b.is_focused) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_return_focus FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, dest_roleid AS object_roleid, dest_zone AS object_zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_friend_focus_player WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2020-04-29' AND zoneid < 57000 AND roleid > 0 AND dest_roleid > 0 AND is_focused = 0 AND focus_channel = 3 AND is_delete = 0) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT dest_roleid AS roleid, dest_zone AS zoneid, roleid AS object_roleid, zoneid AS object_zoneid, is_focused FROM ml_ods.gameserver_friend_focus_player WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2020-04-29' AND zoneid < 57000 AND roleid > 0 AND dest_roleid > 0 AND is_focused = 1) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.object_roleid = b.object_roleid AND a.object_zoneid = b.object_zoneid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.object_roleid, a.object_zoneid), feature_info /* 特征信息 */ AS (SELECT uid AS roleid, zoneid, CONCAT('{', CONCAT_WS(',', CONCAT('"roleid":', uid), CONCAT('"zoneid":', zoneid), CONCAT('"tag_show":"', '"'), CONCAT('"tag":"', '"'), CONCAT('"o_c_create_role_country":"', o_c_create_role_country, '"'), CONCAT('"o_c_sex":', o_c_sex), CONCAT('"o_c_max_big_ranklvl":', o_c_max_big_ranklvl), CONCAT('"o_c_onlinetime_sum_3d":', o_c_onlinetime_sum_3d), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_exp_7d":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_exp_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_exp_7d":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_exp_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_mid_7d":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_mid_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_mid_7d":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_mid_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_coin_7d":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_coin_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_coin_7d":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_coin_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_jungle_7d":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_jungle_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_jungle_7d":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_jungle_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_roam_7d":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_roam_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_roam_7d":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_roam_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_exp_7d":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_exp_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_win_count_exp_7d":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_win_count_exp_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_mid_7d":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_mid_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_win_count_mid_7d":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_win_count_mid_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_coin_7d":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_coin_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_win_count_coin_7d":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_win_count_coin_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_jungle_7d":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_jungle_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_win_count_jungle_7d":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_win_count_jungle_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_roam_7d":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_roam_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_win_count_roam_7d":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_win_count_roam_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_max_conwin_3d":', o_c_rank_mode_max_conwin_3d), CONCAT('"o_c_is_primary_accountid":', o_c_is_primary_accountid), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_mvp_count_7d":', o_c_rank_mode_mvp_count_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_legendary_count_7d":', o_c_rank_mode_legendary_count_7d), CONCAT('"o_c_is_custom_face_image":', o_c_is_custom_face_image), CONCAT('"o_c_exp_realpower":', o_c_exp_realpower), CONCAT('"o_c_mid_realpower":', o_c_mid_realpower), CONCAT('"o_c_roam_realpower":', o_c_roam_realpower), CONCAT('"o_c_jungle_realpower":', o_c_jungle_realpower), CONCAT('"o_c_coin_realpower":', o_c_coin_realpower), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_exp_50bc":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_exp_50bc), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_mid_50bc":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_mid_50bc), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_coin_50bc":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_coin_50bc), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_jungle_50bc":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_jungle_50bc), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_roam_50bc":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_roam_50bc), CONCAT('"o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_none_50bc":', o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_none_50bc), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_exp_50bc":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_exp_50bc), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_mid_50bc":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_mid_50bc), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_coin_50bc":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_coin_50bc), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_jungle_50bc":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_jungle_50bc), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_roam_50bc":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_roam_50bc), CONCAT('"o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_none_50bc":', o_c_classic_mode_battle_count_none_50bc)), '}') AS feature_json FROM mt_dm.dm_ai_feature_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29'), focus_feature_info AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.object_roleid, a.object_zoneid, MAX(a.is_return_focus) AS is_return_focus, MAX(b.feature_json) AS role_feature_json, MAX(c.feature_json) AS object_role_feature_json FROM focus_info AS a INNER JOIN feature_info AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid INNER JOIN feature_info AS c ON a.object_roleid = c.roleid AND a.object_zoneid = c.zoneid WHERE b.feature_json <> '' AND c.feature_json <> '' GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.object_roleid, a.object_zoneid), is_invite_info /* 发起人对接收人发起邀请 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.object_roleid, a.object_zoneid, IF(MAX(b.is_invite) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_invite_player FROM focus_feature_info AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT time, accountid AS object_roleid, zoneid AS object_zoneid, invite_roleid AS roleid, invite_zoneid AS zoneid, 1 AS is_invite FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_inviteshow WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2022-10-28' AND zoneid < 57000 AND accountid > 0 GROUP BY time, accountid, zoneid, invite_roleid, invite_zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.object_roleid = b.object_roleid AND a.object_zoneid = b.object_zoneid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.object_roleid, a.object_zoneid), is_like_info /* 近7天点赞记录 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, object_roleid, object_zoneid FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, likeplayer FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_socialbehavior WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-23' AND logymd < '{$DATE}' AND logymd >= '2023-08-02' AND zoneid < 57000 AND accountid > 0 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, likeplayer) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(STR_TO_MAP(likeplayer, '\\073', '-')) t1 AS object_roleid, object_zoneid WHERE roleid <> object_roleid AND zoneid <> object_zoneid), is_like /* 发起人对接收人点赞 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.object_roleid, a.object_zoneid, IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL AND NOT b.object_roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_like_7days FROM focus_feature_info AS a LEFT JOIN is_like_info AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.object_roleid = b.object_roleid AND a.object_zoneid = b.object_zoneid), is_belike /* 发起人被接收人点赞 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.object_roleid, a.object_zoneid, IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL AND NOT b.object_roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_belike_7days FROM focus_feature_info AS a LEFT JOIN is_like_info AS b ON a.roleid = b.object_roleid AND a.zoneid = b.object_zoneid AND a.object_roleid = b.roleid AND a.object_zoneid = b.zoneid), battle_info /* 近7天战斗记录 */ /* 正常战斗就行，不排除有AI或者温暖关的数据 */ AS (SELECT logymd, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, wincamp, ismvp FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-23' AND logymd < '{$DATE}' AND zoneid < 57000 AND accountid > 0 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) /* AND realpvptype IN(1, 2) */), role_win_battle_info /* 近7天发起人战斗胜利记录 */ AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, battleid, ismvp FROM battle_info AS a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid FROM focus_feature_info AS b WHERE a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) AND wincamp = 1), object_win_battle_info /* 近7天接收人战斗胜利记录 */ AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, battleid, ismvp FROM battle_info AS a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT b.object_roleid, b.object_zoneid FROM focus_feature_info AS b WHERE b.object_roleid = a.roleid AND b.object_zoneid = a.zoneid) AND wincamp = 1), is_win /* 近7天发起人和接收人同阵营并胜利 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.roleid AS object_roleid, b.zoneid AS object_zoneid, IF(COUNT(*) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_win_7days, IF(MAX(a.ismvp) = 1, 1, 0) AS is_own_win_mvp_7days, IF(MAX(b.ismvp) = 1, 1, 0) AS is_object_win_mvp_7days FROM role_win_battle_info AS a INNER JOIN object_win_battle_info AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.logymd = b.logymd WHERE NOT a.roleid IS NULL AND NOT b.roleid IS NULL GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.roleid, b.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_social_ai_feature_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT focus_feature_info.roleid, focus_feature_info.zoneid, focus_feature_info.object_roleid, focus_feature_info.object_zoneid, CONCAT('{', CONCAT_WS(',', CONCAT('"is_return_focus":', COALESCE(MAX(focus_feature_info.is_return_focus), 0)), CONCAT('"is_invite_player":', COALESCE(MAX(is_invite_info.is_invite_player), 0)), CONCAT('"is_belike_7days":', COALESCE(MAX(is_belike.is_belike_7days), 0)), CONCAT('"is_like_7days":', COALESCE(MAX(is_like.is_like_7days), 0)), CONCAT('"is_own_win_mvp_7days":', COALESCE(MAX(is_win.is_own_win_mvp_7days), 0)), CONCAT('"is_object_win_mvp_7days":', COALESCE(MAX(is_win.is_object_win_mvp_7days), 0)), CONCAT('"is_win_7days":', COALESCE(MAX(is_win.is_win_7days), 0))), '}') AS relation_feature_json, role_feature_json, object_role_feature_json FROM focus_feature_info LEFT JOIN is_invite_info ON focus_feature_info.roleid = is_invite_info.roleid AND focus_feature_info.zoneid = is_invite_info.zoneid AND focus_feature_info.object_roleid = is_invite_info.object_roleid AND focus_feature_info.object_zoneid = is_invite_info.object_zoneid LEFT JOIN is_like ON focus_feature_info.roleid = is_like.roleid AND focus_feature_info.zoneid = is_like.zoneid AND focus_feature_info.object_roleid = is_like.object_roleid AND focus_feature_info.object_zoneid = is_like.object_zoneid LEFT JOIN is_belike ON focus_feature_info.roleid = is_belike.roleid AND focus_feature_info.zoneid = is_belike.zoneid AND focus_feature_info.object_roleid = is_belike.object_roleid AND focus_feature_info.object_zoneid = is_belike.object_zoneid LEFT JOIN is_win ON focus_feature_info.roleid = is_win.roleid AND focus_feature_info.zoneid = is_win.zoneid AND focus_feature_info.object_roleid = is_win.object_roleid AND focus_feature_info.object_zoneid = is_win.object_zoneid GROUP BY focus_feature_info.roleid, focus_feature_info.zoneid, focus_feature_info.object_roleid, focus_feature_info.object_zoneid, role_feature_json, object_role_feature_json

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_activity_participation_consumption_df
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_activity_participation_consumption_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT COALESCE(t_act_info_df.act_id, t_cons.act_id) AS act_id, COALESCE(t_act_info_df.act_type, t_cons.act_type) AS act_type, COALESCE(t_act_info_df.act_title, t_cons.act_title) AS act_title, COALESCE(t_act_info_df.start_time, t_cons.start_time) AS start_time, COALESCE(t_act_info_df.end_time, t_cons.end_time) AS end_time, COALESCE(t_act_info_df.country, t_cons.country) AS country, COALESCE(t_cons.diamond_cons_amt, 0) AS diamond_cons_amt, COALESCE(t_cons.usd_amt, 0) AS usd_amt, COALESCE(t_cons.participate_user_cnt, 0) AS participate_user_cnt, COALESCE(t_cons.participate_pay_user_cnt, 0) AS participate_pay_user_cnt, COALESCE(t_cons.aurora_crystal_cons_amt, 0) AS aurora_crystal_cons_amt, COALESCE(t_cons.aurora_crystal_user_cnt, 0) AS aurora_crystal_user_cnt /*      , COALESCE(t_cons.act_diamond_cons_amt, 0)                AS act_diamond_cons_amt */ /*      , COALESCE(t_cons.act_participate_pay_user_cnt, 0)        AS act_participate_pay_user_cnt */, COALESCE(t_cons.act_diamond_cons_amt, 0) AS act_diamond_cons_amt, COALESCE(t_cons.act_participate_pay_user_cnt, 0) AS act_participate_pay_user_cnt, COALESCE(t_act_info_df.pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(t_act_info_df.act_user_cnt, 0) AS act_user_cnt, COALESCE(t_act_info_df.act_user_cnt_total, 0) AS act_user_cnt_total FROM (SELECT act_id, act_type, act_title, start_time, end_time, country, diamond_cons_amt, usd_amt, participate_user_cnt, participate_pay_user_cnt, aurora_crystal_cons_amt, aurora_crystal_user_cnt, SUM(diamond_cons_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY act_id) AS act_diamond_cons_amt, SUM(participate_pay_user_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY act_id) AS act_participate_pay_user_cnt FROM (SELECT act_id, act_type, act_title, start_time, end_time, country, SUM(diamond_cons_amt) AS diamond_cons_amt, CAST(SUM(diamond_cons_amt) / 58 AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS usd_amt, COUNT(roleid) AS participate_user_cnt, COUNT(IF(diamond_cons_amt <> 0, roleid, NULL)) AS participate_pay_user_cnt /*              , SUM(participate_user_cnt)                          AS participate_user_cnt */ /*              , SUM(participate_pay_user_cnt)                      AS participate_pay_user_cnt */, SUM(aurora_crystal_cons_amt) AS aurora_crystal_cons_amt, COUNT(IF(aurora_crystal_cons_amt <> 0, roleid, NULL)) AS aurora_crystal_user_cnt /*              , SUM(aurora_crystal_user_cnt)                       AS aurora_crystal_user_cnt */ /*              , MAX(act_diamond_cons_amt)                          AS act_diamond_cons_amt */ /*              , MAX(act_participate_pay_user_cnt)                  AS act_participate_pay_user_cnt */ FROM mt_dm.dm_activity_diamond_consumption_role_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY act_id, act_type, act_title, start_time, end_time, country) AS t1) AS t_cons /*          LEFT JOIN (SELECT act_id */ /*                          , SUM(diamond_cons_amt)                          AS act_diamond_cons_amt */ /*                          , COUNT(IF(diamond_cons_amt != 0, roleid, NULL)) AS act_participate_pay_user_cnt */ /*                     FROM mt_dm.dm_activity_diamond_consumption_role_df */ /*                     WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' */ /*                     GROUP BY act_id) t_cons */ /*                    ON t_cons.act_id = t_cons.act_id */ FULL JOIN (SELECT t_act_df.act_id, t_act_config.act_type, t_act_config.act_title, t_act_config.start_time, t_act_config.end_time, t_act_df.country, t_act_df.pay_amt, t_act_df.act_user_cnt, t_act_df.act_user_cnt_total FROM (SELECT act_id, country, pay_amt, act_user_cnt, act_user_cnt_total FROM mt_dwm.dwm_activity_active_pay_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t_act_df JOIN (SELECT act_type, act_id, act_title, start_time, end_time FROM `mt_dim`.`dim_activity_operate_config_df` WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2023-09-06', '2023-09-06', '2026-05-30') AND is_production_server = 1 /* 过滤出正式服任务 */ AND act_type IN (359, 589, 446)) AS t_act_config ON t_act_df.act_id = t_act_config.act_id) AS t_act_info_df ON t_cons.act_id = t_act_info_df.act_id AND t_cons.country = t_act_info_df.country

name: adbi.dm_admkt_ad_roas_fully
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_admkt_ad_roas_fully)) SELECT data_date, data_week, data_month, os, country, media_source, roas_index AS num_index /* 纯数字index. 方便后续其他的格式处理 */, CONCAT('ROAS', LPAD(roas_index, 3, '0')) AS roas_index /* 便于字符串按照数字顺序排序 */, SUM(revenue_amount) AS revenue_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN app_id = '2001' AND country IN ('jp', 'kr') AND os = 'android' THEN revenue_amount * 0.63 WHEN app_id = '2001' AND country IN ('jp', 'kr') AND os = 'ios' THEN revenue_amount * 0.61 WHEN app_id = '2001' AND (NOT country IN ('jp', 'kr') OR NOT os IN ('ios', 'android')) THEN revenue_amount * 0.7 WHEN app_id = '4020' THEN revenue_amount * 0.42 WHEN app_id = '3001' THEN revenue_amount * 0.7 ELSE paid_in_revenue_amount END) AS paid_in_revenue_amount, SUM(cost) AS cost, app_id FROM (SELECT data_date, data_week, data_month, os, country, media_source, roas_index, ROUND(COALESCE(revenue_amount / 100, 0), 2) AS revenue_amount, ROUND(COALESCE(paid_in_revenue_amount / 100, 0), 2) AS paid_in_revenue_amount, cost, app_id FROM (SELECT data_date, data_week, data_month, os, country, media_source, INLINE(ARRAYS_ZIP(roas_index, revenue_amount, paid_in_revenue_amount)) AS (roas_index, revenue_amount, paid_in_revenue_amount), cost, app_id FROM (SELECT data_date, data_week, data_month, os, country, media_source, FLATTEN(ARRAY(SEQUENCE(1, 30, 1), SEQUENCE(45, 180, 15), SEQUENCE(210, 720, 30))) AS roas_index /* 1-30, 45-180, 210-720三段数组, 步长分别为1, 15,30 */, FLATTEN(ARRAY(IF(NOT revenue_amount_1_30_interval1_list IS NULL, revenue_amount_1_30_interval1_list, ARRAY_REPEAT(0, 30)), IF(NOT revenue_amount_45_180_interval15_list IS NULL, revenue_amount_45_180_interval15_list, ARRAY_REPEAT(0, 10)), IF(NOT revenue_amount_210_720_interval30_list IS NULL, revenue_amount_210_720_interval30_list, ARRAY_REPEAT(0, 18)))) AS revenue_amount /* 空值会导致后续做inline的时候数据被过滤掉, 所以需要用0填充 */, FLATTEN(ARRAY(IF(NOT paid_in_revenue_amount_1_30_interval1_list IS NULL, paid_in_revenue_amount_1_30_interval1_list, ARRAY_REPEAT(0, 30)), IF(NOT paid_in_revenue_amount_45_180_interval15_list IS NULL, paid_in_revenue_amount_45_180_interval15_list, ARRAY_REPEAT(0, 10)), IF(NOT paid_in_revenue_amount_210_720_interval30_list IS NULL, paid_in_revenue_amount_210_720_interval30_list, ARRAY_REPEAT(0, 18)))) AS paid_in_revenue_amount /* 空值会导致后续做inline的时候数据被过滤掉, 所以需要用0填充 */, cost, app_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_admkt_game_ad_stats_fully)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND data_date >= '2022-01-01'))) GROUP BY app_id, data_date, data_week, data_month, os, country, media_source, roas_index DISTRIBUTE BY CONCAT(app_id, CAST(IF(app_id = '1001', CEIL(RAND() * 10), IF(app_id = '2001', CEIL(RAND() * 4), 1)) AS STRING))

name: 回流特征di表dwm_wmz_recur_feature_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* 30天df表join r表 */ /*  30天battle_end表join r表 */ /* 回流前特征：历史付费、流失前30天活跃、历史流失次数、一年内流失次数 */ /* 回流后特征：对局数、模式、升段效率（星数diff）、付费 */ /* 再次流失前特征：最后一把对局 */ WITH r AS (/* 当日30日流失回流用户 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, recurring_date, lose_days, lose_date /* register_date, */, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', recurring_date) + 1 AS recurring_days FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_core_role_zone_di WHERE (logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' OR logymd IN ('2026-05-17', '2026-05-10', '2026-05-01')) AND lose_days >= 30 AND /* AND     zoneid < 57000 */ logymd = recurring_date), id AS (/* 取位图数据 */ SELECT r.roleid, r.zoneid, r.lose_days, r.recurring_date, r.recurring_days, i.register_date, SUBSTRING(battle_info, DATEDIFF(i.logymd, '2026-05-30') + 1) AS battle_info /* 取从'2026-05-30'开始的位图数据 */, SUBSTRING(battle_info, DATEDIFF(i.logymd, lose_date) + 1) AS battle_info_before_lose /* 流失前的战斗位图 */, SUBSTRING(charge_info, DATEDIFF(i.logymd, '2026-05-30') + 1) AS charge_info /* 充值位图 */, SLICE(charge_amt_total_array, DATEDIFF(i.logymd, '2026-05-30') + 1, 99999) AS charge_amt_total_array /* 充值金额位图 */, SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(i.logymd, '2026-05-30') + 1) AS active_info /* 活跃位图 */, SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(i.logymd, lose_date) + 1) AS active_info_before_lose /* 流失前的活跃位图 */, SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(i.logymd, '2026-05-30') + 1, r.recurring_days) AS active_info_ret /* 回流后活跃位图 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df AS i JOIN r ON r.roleid = i.roleid AND r.zoneid = i.zoneid WHERE i.logymd = GREATEST(TO_DATE('2026-05-30'), DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 3 * -1)) /* dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df表的分区只保留最近一周 */), i AS (/* 位图：付费、活跃、流失次数、首日是否战斗 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, recurring_days, LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(active_info, '0{30,}', ',')) - LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(active_info, '0{30,}', '')) AS lose_cnt_his /* 历史30日流失次数 */, LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, 365 + recurring_days - 1), '0{30,}', ',')) - LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, 365 + recurring_days - 1), '0{30,}', '')) AS lose_cnt_last_year /* 近一年30日流失次数 */, IF(LOCATE(REPEAT('0', 30), SUBSTRING(active_info_before_lose, 1, 37)) > 0, 1, 0) AS if_return_cnt_7days_before_lose /* 流失前7日是否回流(流失30日以上的） */, IF(LOCATE(REPEAT('0', 30), SUBSTRING(active_info_before_lose, 1, 60)) > 0, 1, 0) AS if_return_cnt_30days_before_lose /* 流失前30日是否回流(流失30日以上的） */, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, lose_days + recurring_days + 1, 30), 0, '')) AS act30days_before_lose /* 流失前30天活跃天数 */, COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array[recurring_days + 5], 0) AS pay_his_before_lose /* 回流前历史累计付费 */, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(charge_info, 8, 99999), 0, '')) AS his_pay_days_before_lose, IF((charge_amt_total_array[lose_days + recurring_days - 1] - charge_amt_total_array[lose_days + recurring_days + 29]) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_pay_lose_before_lose30d /* 流失前30日是否付费 */, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(battle_info_before_lose, 1, 30), 0, '')) AS battle_days_before_lose30d /* 流失前30天战斗天次 */, LENGTH(REPLACE(active_info, 0, '')) AS act_days_his /* 含回流后的活跃 */, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info_ret, -2, 1), 0, '')) AS is_active_after_recur_2d, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info_ret, -3, 1), 0, '')) AS is_active_after_recur_3d, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info_ret, -4, 1), 0, '')) AS is_active_after_recur_4d, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info_ret, -5, 1), 0, '')) AS is_active_after_recur_5d, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info_ret, -6, 1), 0, '')) AS is_active_after_recur_6d, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info_ret, -7, 1), 0, '')) AS is_active_after_recur_7d, LENGTH(REPLACE(active_info_ret, 0, '')) AS active_days_after_recur, active_info_ret AS active_info_after_recur, IF((charge_amt_total_array[0] - charge_amt_total_array[recurring_days + 5]) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_pay_after_recur /* 回流后N日是否有付费 */, COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array[0] - charge_amt_total_array[recurring_days + 5], 0) AS pay_amount_after_recur, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(battle_info, 1, 7), 0, '')) AS battle_days_after_recur /* 回流后N天战斗天次 */ FROM id), rk_b AS (/* 流失前段位 */ SELECT r.roleid, r.zoneid, COALESCE(rk.his_last_rank_id, '无段位') AS his_last_rank_id_before_lose /* 流失前的段位 */, COALESCE(rk.his_last_bigrank, '无段位') AS his_last_bigrank_before_lose /* 流失前的大段位 */, COALESCE(rk.his_max_rank_id, '无段位') AS his_max_rank_id_before_lose /* 流失前历史最高段位 */, COALESCE(rk.his_max_bigranklvl, '无段位') AS his_max_bigranklvl_before_lose /* 流失前历史最高大段位 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df AS rk RIGHT JOIN r ON rk.roleid = r.roleid AND rk.zoneid = r.zoneid WHERE rk.logymd = '2026-04-30' AND rk.appid = 'mlbb' AND rk.pvptype = 2), rk_f AS (/* 回流后N日段位 */ SELECT r.roleid, r.zoneid, COALESCE(rk.his_max_rank_id, '无段位') AS his_max_rank_id_after_recur /* 截止回流后N日生涯最高段位id */, COALESCE(rk.his_max_bigranklvl, '无段位') AS his_max_bigrank_after_recur /* 截止回流后N日生涯最高段位id */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df AS rk RIGHT JOIN r ON rk.roleid = r.roleid AND rk.zoneid = r.zoneid WHERE rk.logymd = '2026-05-30' AND rk.appid = 'mlbb' AND rk.pvptype = 2), f AS (/* -- 回流后N日行为特征 */ /* SELECT  r.roleid, */ /*         r.zoneid, */ /*         MAX(his_last_level) AS his_last_level_after_recur, -- 回流后N日等级 */ /*         MAX(f.is_up_bigranklvl) AS is_up_bigranklvl_after_recur, -- 回流后N日是否升大段位 */ /*         MAX(f.is_drop_bigranklvl) AS is_drop_bigranklvl_after_recur, -- 回流后N日是否降大段位 */ /*         MAX(f.is_up_minranklvl) AS is_up_minranklvl_after_recur, -- 回流后N日是否升小段位 */ /*         MAX(f.is_drop_minranklvl) AS is_drop_minranklvl_after_recur, -- 回流后N日是否降小段位 */ /*         MAX(f.his_battle_cnt) AS his_battle_cnt_after_recur, -- 截止回流后N日生涯累计战斗场次 */ /*         MAX(f.his_win_cnt) AS his_win_cnt_after_recur, -- 截止回流后N日生涯累计胜利场次 */ /*         SUM(f.matches_cnt) AS matches_cnt_after_recur, -- 回流后N日战斗场次 */ /*         SUM(f.black_cnt) AS black_cnt_after_recur, -- 回流后N日开黑数 */ /*         SUM(f.ranked_cnt) AS ranked_cnt_after_recur, -- 回流后N日排位次数 */ /*         SUM(round(f.ranked_win_rate_avg * f.ranked_cnt)) AS ranked_win_cnt_after_recur, -- 回流后N日排位胜利场次 */ /*         SUM(black_ranked_cnt) black_ranked_cnt_after_recur, -- 回流后N日排位开黑场次 */ /*         SUM(f.classic_cnt) AS classic_cnt_after_recur, -- 回流后N日匹配次数 */ /*         SUM(round(f.ranked_classic_win_rate_avg * (f.ranked_cnt + f.classic_cnt), 0)) AS rank_classic_win_cnt_after_recur, -- 回流后N日排位匹配胜场 */ /*         SUM(f.brawl_cnt) AS brawl_cnt_after_recur, -- 回流后N日大乱斗次数 */ /*         SUM(f.chess_cnt) AS chess_cnt_after_recur, -- 回流后N日下棋次数 */ /*         SUM(IF(f.logymd = '2026-05-30', f.friend_cnt, 0)) AS friend_cnt_after_recur, -- 当前互关数（好友数） */ /*         MAX(IF(ranked_classic_albuginea_rate_avg > 0, 1, 0)) is_albuginea_after_recur, -- 回流后N日是否白膜 */ /*         SUM(IF(f.logymd = '2026-05-30', SIZE(gameapp_name_array), 0)) gameapp_number_after_recur, -- 最新游戏竞品数 */ /*         SUM(IF(f.logymd = '2026-05-30', SIZE(socialapp_name_array), 0)) socialapp_number_after_recur -- 最新社交竞品数 */ /* FROM    mt_dm.dm_behavior_feature_role_zone_df f */ /* JOIN    ( */ /*             SELECT  DISTINCT roleid, */ /*                     zoneid */ /*             FROM    r */ /*         ) r */ /* ON      r.roleid = f.roleid */ /* AND     r.zoneid = f.zoneid */ /* WHERE   f.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' */ /* GROUP BY */ /*         r.roleid, */ /*         r.zonei */ SELECT r.roleid, r.zoneid, t.his_last_level AS his_last_level_after_recur /* 回流后N日等级 */, t.his_battle_cnt AS his_battle_cnt_after_recur /* 截止回流后N日生涯累计战斗场次 */, t.his_win_cnt AS his_win_cnt_after_recur /* 截止回流后N日生涯累计胜利场次 */, t.friend_cnt AS friend_cnt_after_recur /* 当前互关数（好友数） */, SIZE(t.gameapp_name_array) AS gameapp_number_after_recur /* 最新游戏竞品数 */, SIZE(t.socialapp_name_array) AS socialapp_number_after_recur /* 最新社交竞品数 */, COALESCE(t2.is_up_bigranklvl_after_recur, 0) AS is_up_bigranklvl_after_recur /* 回流后N日是否升大段位（某天最高最低） */, COALESCE(t2.is_drop_bigranklvl_after_recur, 0) AS is_drop_bigranklvl_after_recur /* 回流后N日是否降大段位（某天最高最低） */, COALESCE(t2.is_up_minranklvl_after_recur, 0) AS is_up_minranklvl_after_recur /* 回流后N日是否升小段位（某天最高最低） */, COALESCE(t2.is_drop_minranklvl_after_recur, 0) AS is_drop_minranklvl_after_recur /* 回流后N日是否降小段位（某天最高最低） */, COALESCE(t1.matches_cnt_after_recur, 0) AS matches_cnt_after_recur /* 回流后N日战斗场次 */, COALESCE(t1.black_cnt_after_recur, 0) AS black_cnt_after_recur /* 回流后N日开黑数 */, COALESCE(t1.ranked_cnt_after_recur, 0) AS ranked_cnt_after_recur /* 回流后N日排位次数 */, COALESCE(t1.ranked_win_cnt_after_recur, 0) AS ranked_win_cnt_after_recur /* 回流后N日排位胜利场次 */, COALESCE(t1.black_ranked_cnt_after_recur, 0) AS black_ranked_cnt_after_recur /* 回流后N日排位开黑场次 */, COALESCE(t1.classic_cnt_after_recur, 0) AS classic_cnt_after_recur /* 回流后N日匹配次数 */, COALESCE(t1.rank_classic_win_cnt_after_recur, 0) AS rank_classic_win_cnt_after_recur /* 回流后N日排位匹配胜场 */, COALESCE(t1.brawl_cnt_after_recur, 0) AS brawl_cnt_after_recur /* 回流后N日大乱斗次数 */, COALESCE(t1.chess_cnt_after_recur, 0) AS chess_cnt_after_recur /* 回流后N日下棋次数 */, COALESCE(t1.is_albuginea_after_recur, 0) AS is_albuginea_after_recur /* 回流后N日是否白膜 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_feature_role_zone_df AS t JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM r) AS r ON r.roleid = t.roleid AND r.zoneid = t.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, SUM(battle_cnt) AS matches_cnt_after_recur, SUM(b.black_cnt) AS black_cnt_after_recur, SUM(IF(b.pvptype = 2, b.battle_cnt, 0)) AS ranked_cnt_after_recur, SUM(IF(b.pvptype = 2, b.win_cnt, 0)) AS ranked_win_cnt_after_recur, SUM(IF(b.pvptype = 2, b.black_cnt, 0)) AS black_ranked_cnt_after_recur, SUM(IF(b.pvptype = 1, b.battle_cnt, 0)) AS classic_cnt_after_recur, SUM(IF(b.pvptype IN (1, 2), b.win_cnt, 0)) AS rank_classic_win_cnt_after_recur, SUM(IF(b.pvptype = 4, b.battle_cnt, 0)) AS brawl_cnt_after_recur, SUM(IF(b.pvptype = 39, b.battle_cnt, 0)) AS chess_cnt_after_recur, MAX(IF(b.pvptype IN (1, 2) AND b.battle_albuginea_cnt >= 1, 1, 0)) AS is_albuginea_after_recur FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di AS b JOIN r ON r.roleid = b.roleid AND r.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE b.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY b.roleid, b.zoneid) AS t1 ON t.roleid = t1.roleid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT rk.roleid, rk.zoneid, MAX(IF(max_bigranklvl > min_bigranklvl, 1, 0)) AS is_up_bigranklvl_after_recur /* 回流后N日是否升大段位（某天最高最低） */, MAX(IF(max_bigranklvl < min_bigranklvl, 1, 0)) AS is_drop_bigranklvl_after_recur /* 回流后N日是否降大段位（某天最高最低） */, fd3_own_hero_cnt /* fd3内拥有英雄总数 */, SUM(bought_mksm_cnt) AS fd3_own_mksm_cnt /* fd3内拥有射手总数 */, SUM(bought_warr_cnt) AS fd3_own_warr_cnt /* fd3内拥有战士总数 */, SUM(bought_mage_cnt) AS fd3_own_mage_cnt /* name: 回流AB战斗数据监测ads_wmz_recur_ab_battle_di
sql_units: /* 回流后30天战斗数据 */ WITH a1 /* 每日回流用户，流失时基础信息  */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid) AS accountid, UPPER(createrole_country) AS country, param_name, CASE WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test1"}' OR param_value = 'test1') THEN '实验1' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test2"}' OR param_value = 'test2') THEN '实验2' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test"}' OR param_value = 'test') THEN '实验' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"control"}' OR param_value = 'control') THEN '对照' ELSE param_value END AS param_value, MIN(logymd) AS min_logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE logymd >= '2023-12-20' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND UPPER(param_name) LIKE '%RETURN%' AND `level` >= 9 GROUP BY CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid), UPPER(createrole_country), param_name, param_value HAVING MIN(logymd) IN ('2026-05-01', '2026-05-10', '2026-05-17', '2026-05-21', '2026-05-24', '2026-05-26', '2026-05-28', '2026-05-30') /* 近1、3、5、7、10、14、21、30天入组用户 */ /* 5.11新增union */ UNION SELECT CONCAT(old_zoneid, '_', accountid) AS accountid, UPPER(createrole_country) AS country, param_name, CASE WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test1"}' OR param_value = 'test1') THEN '实验1' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test2"}' OR param_value = 'test2') THEN '实验2' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test"}' OR param_value = 'test') THEN '实验' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"control"}' OR param_value = 'control') THEN '对照' ELSE param_value END AS param_value, MIN(logymd) AS min_logymd FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag /* 新实验表 */ WHERE logymd >= '2023-12-20' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND UPPER(param_name) LIKE '%RETURN%' AND `createroel_level` >= 9 GROUP BY CONCAT(old_zoneid, '_', accountid), UPPER(createrole_country), param_name, param_value HAVING MIN(logymd) IN ('2026-05-01', '2026-05-10', '2026-05-17', '2026-05-21', '2026-05-24', '2026-05-26', '2026-05-28', '2026-05-30') /* 近1、3、5、7、10、14、21、30天入组用户 */ UNION SELECT CONCAT(old_zoneid, '_', accountid) AS accountid, UPPER(createrole_country) AS country, param_name, CASE WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test1"}' OR param_value = 'test1') THEN '实验1' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test2"}' OR param_value = 'test2') THEN '实验2' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"test"}' OR param_value = 'test') THEN '实验' WHEN (param_value = '{"group_tag":"control"}' OR param_value = 'control') THEN '对照' ELSE param_value END AS param_value, MIN(logymd) AS min_logymd FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag /* 新实验表 */ WHERE logymd >= '2023-12-20' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND (param_name = '60.2_Returning2026_TH' OR UPPER(param_name) LIKE '%LEVEL_RETURN%') /* 限制等级实验放行 */ AND `createroel_level` < 9 GROUP BY CONCAT(old_zoneid, '_', accountid), UPPER(createrole_country), param_name, param_value HAVING MIN(logymd) IN ('2026-05-01', '2026-05-10', '2026-05-17', '2026-05-21', '2026-05-24', '2026-05-26', '2026-05-28', '2026-05-30') /* 近1、3、5、7、10、14、21、30天入组用户 */), b2 /* 段位 */ AS (/* 取玩家首次战斗前的段位 */ SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) AS accountid, MIN(bigranklvl + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`) * 100000000) % 100000000 AS login_bigranklvl /* 最早登录时间 */, MIN(minranklvl + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`) * 100000000) % 100000000 AS login_minranklvl /* 最早登录时间 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN a1 AS b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) = b.accountid WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid)), bm /* 白膜数据 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) AS accountid, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN noresnum > 0 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS battleenddata_nores_cnt /* 白膜数量 > 0的场次 */, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battleenddata_cnt /* 总战斗场次 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata AS a JOIN a1 AS b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) = b.accountid WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid)), bat /* 战斗场次、战斗结束 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', a.accountid) AS accountid, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battleend_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN blacknum = 2 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS black2_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN blacknum = 3 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS black3_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN blacknum = 4 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS black4_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN blacknum = 5 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS black5_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN blacknum > 1 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS black_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN isvalid = 1 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS valid_battle_cnt /* 有效对局数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wincamp = 1 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS wincamp_battle_cnt /* 胜率 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pvptype = 1 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS pvptype1_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS pvptype2_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pvptype = 4 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS pvptype4_battle_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN a1 AS b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) = b.accountid WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY CONCAT(zoneid, '_', a.accountid)), act_type AS (/* 触发活动 */ SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid) AS accountid, act_id FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time ASC) AS rw FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_returning2023_type WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30') AS a WHERE rw = 1), act_login AS (/* 回归签到领取 */ SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.roleid) AS accountid, a.act_id, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(a.`days`)) AS recur_sign_day_list, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(IF(a.rewardid = 0, NULL, a.rewardid))) AS log_rewardid_list FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_returning2023_login AS a JOIN (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time ASC) AS rw FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_returning2023_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30') AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.act_id = b.act_id AND b.rw = 1 /* 只取玩家遇到的第一个act_id */ WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND a.act_status = 2 /* 任务状态(1：已完成、2：已领取） */ GROUP BY CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.roleid), a.act_id), act_battle AS (/* 战斗福利 */ SELECT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid) AS accountid, act_id, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(battlenum)) AS battlenum_list, MAX(battlenum) AS battlenum_max, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(IF(rewardid = 0, NULL, rewardid))) AS bt_rewardid_list FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_returning2023_battle WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND act_status = 2 /* 任务状态(1：已完成、2：已领取） */ GROUP BY CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid), act_id), act_herotrial AS (/* 英雄试炼任务 */ SELECT accountid, act_id, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(selected_id)) AS selected_id_list, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(selected_id || ':' || CAST(progress_id_list AS STRING))) AS progress_id_list, COLLECT_SET(selected_id || ':' || progress_id_max) AS progress_id_max_list, MAX(progress_id_max) AS progress_id_max FROM (SELECT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid) AS accountid, act_id, selected_id, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(progress_id)) AS progress_id_list, MAX(progress_id) AS progress_id_max FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_returning2023_herotrial WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' /* AND     reward_status = 2 -- 进度奖励状态（1：可领取、2：已领取） */ GROUP BY CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid), act_id, selected_id) AS a GROUP BY accountid, act_id), act_bp AS (/* 近N天最高通行证等级 */ SELECT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid) AS accountid, act_id, MAX(bp_level) AS bp_level_max FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_returning2023_bp_reward WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND reward_status = 2 /* 任务状态(1：已完成、2：已领取） */ GROUP BY CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid), act_id), act_buy_bp AS (/* 近N天是否购买通行证 */ SELECT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid) AS accountid, act_id, SUM(diamond) AS bp_cost_diamond FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_returning2023_bp_buy WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid), act_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.ads_wmz_recur_ab_battle_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT '2026-05-30' AS active_logymd, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', b.min_logymd) + 1 AS min_days /* 入组天数 */, b.min_logymd, b.accountid /* 账户id */, b.country /* 国家 */, b.param_name /* 实验名称 */, b.param_value /* 对照/实验组 */, b2.login_bigranklvl, b2.login_minranklvl, c.before_lose_his_max_bigranklvl, c.lose_days /* 流失天数 */, c.lose_date, c.lose_level, c.class, c.class_online, c.login_min_time /* 登录时间 */, c.login_os /* 登录系统 */, c.login_client_ver /* 登录版本号 */, c.login_channel /* 登录渠道 */, c.login_device /* 登录设备 */, c.login_memory /* 登录内存 */, c.login_level /* 登录等级 */, c.ret_day /* 注册日期 */, c.op_param1 /* 小热更下载时长 */, is_patch /* 是否小热更 */, is_main_ui /* 是否主界面 */, is_huiliu_gd /* 是否回流引导 */, is_welcome /* 是否扑脸 */, is_welcome_1, is_welcome_2, is_welcome_3, is_match, is_match_suc, is_bt_begin, is_bt_end, COALESCE(bm.battleenddata_nores_cnt, 0) AS battleenddata_nores_cnt /* 白膜数量 > 0的场次 */, COALESCE(bm.battleenddata_cnt, 0) AS battleenddata_cnt /* battleenddata战斗场次 */, COALESCE(bat.battleend_cnt, 0) AS battleend_cnt /* battle_end战斗场次 */, COALESCE(bat.black2_cnt, 0) AS black2_cnt, COALESCE(bat.black3_cnt, 0) AS black3_cnt, COALESCE(bat.black4_cnt, 0) AS black4_cnt, COALESCE(bat.black5_cnt, 0) AS black5_cnt, COALESCE(bat.black_cnt, 0) AS black_cnt, COALESCE(bat.valid_battle_cnt, 0) AS valid_battle_cnt, COALESCE(bat.wincamp_battle_cnt, 0) AS wincamp_battle_cnt, COALESCE(bat.pvptype1_battle_cnt, 0) AS pvptype1_battle_cnt, COALESCE(bat.pvptype2_battle_cnt, 0) AS pvptype2_battle_cnt, COALESCE(bat.pvptype4_battle_cnt, 0) AS pvptype4_battle_cnt, act_type.act_id AS recur_act_id, act_login.act_id AS login_act_id, act_login.recur_sign_day_list, act_login.log_rewardid_list, act_battle.act_id AS bt_act_id, act_battle.battlenum_list, act_battle.battlenum_max, act_battle.bt_rewardid_list, act_herotrial.act_id AS herotrial_act_id, act_herotrial.progress_id_list, act_herotrial.progress_id_max, act_herotrial.selected_id_list, act_bp.act_id AS bp_act_id, act_bp.bp_level_max, act_buy_bp.act_id AS buy_bp_act_id, act_buy_bp.bp_cost_diamond FROM a1 AS b LEFT JOIN bm ON b.accountid = bm.accountid LEFT JOIN bat ON b.accountid = bat.accountid LEFT JOIN b2 ON b.accountid = b2.accountid JOIN ml_temp.ads_wmz_recur_ab_active_role_zone_df AS c ON b.accountid = c.accountid AND b.min_logymd = c.min_logymd AND b.param_name = c.param_name AND c.logymd = GREATEST('2024-05-10', '2026-05-30') LEFT JOIN act_type ON b.accountid = act_type.accountid LEFT JOIN act_login ON b.accountid = act_login.accountid LEFT JOIN act_battle ON b.accountid = act_battle.accountid LEFT JOIN act_herotrial ON b.accountid = act_herotrial.accountid LEFT JOIN act_bp ON b.accountid = act_bp.accountid LEFT JOIN act_buy_bp ON b.accountid = act_buy_bp.accountid

name: mtai.dm_ml_attribute_churn_account_zone_df
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dm_ml_attribute_churn_account_zone_df)) SELECT z.accountid, z.zoneid, z.register_date, z.rd30_active_days, z.rd30_last_active_date, z.last_active_date, z.next_last_active_date, z.lost_details, z.gps_adid, z.active_info, z.pay_info, z.amount_info, z.his_first_pay_date, z.paid_details_after_back, z.latest_pay_date, z.back_date, z.lost_days, z.is_back, z.active_7, z.active_30, z.paid_30_days AS paid_thirty_days, z.paid_7_days AS paid_seven_days, z.paid_info, z.active_info_after_back, CASE WHEN lost7_back_index > 0 THEN DATE_ADD(z.back_date, lost7_back_index - 1) ELSE NULL END AS lost7_back_date, CASE WHEN lost14_back_index > 0 THEN DATE_ADD(z.back_date, lost14_back_index - 1) ELSE NULL END AS lost14_back_date, CASE WHEN lost21_back_index > 0 THEN DATE_ADD(z.back_date, lost21_back_index - 1) ELSE NULL END AS lost21_back_date, CASE WHEN lost30_back_index > 0 THEN DATE_ADD(z.back_date, lost30_back_index - 1) ELSE NULL END AS lost30_back_date, z.paid_360_days, z.paid_180_days, z.paid_120_days, z.paid_30_days, z.paid_7_days FROM (SELECT y.accountid, y.zoneid, y.register_date, y.rd30_active_days, y.rd30_last_active_date, y.last_active_date, y.next_last_active_date, y.lost_details, y.gps_adid, y.active_info, y.pay_info, y.amount_info, y.his_first_pay_date, y.paid_details_after_back, GETLATESTPAIDDAY(y.pay_info, y.his_first_pay_date, y.back_date, y.next_last_active_date) AS latest_pay_date, y.back_date, y.lost_days, y.is_back, CASE WHEN y.active_7 = -1 THEN NULL ELSE y.active_7 END AS active_7, CASE WHEN y.active_30 = -1 THEN NULL ELSE y.active_30 END AS active_30, CASE WHEN y.paid_details_after_back IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE y.paid_details_after_back[0] END AS paid_360_days, CASE WHEN y.paid_details_after_back IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE y.paid_details_after_back[1] END AS paid_180_days, CASE WHEN y.paid_details_after_back IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE y.paid_details_after_back[2] END AS paid_120_days, CASE WHEN y.paid_details_after_back IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE y.paid_details_after_back[3] END AS paid_30_days, CASE WHEN y.paid_details_after_back IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE y.paid_details_after_back[4] END AS paid_7_days, CASE WHEN y.paid_details_after_back IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE SLICE(y.paid_details_after_back, 6, 30) END AS paid_info, SLICE(CONCAT(ARRAY_REPEAT(-1, 30), y.active_info), -DATEDIFF(y.back_date, y.register_date) - 1 - 29, 30) AS active_info_after_back, LOCATE('10000000', REVERSE(SUBSTRING(y.active_info_str, 1, LENGTH(y.active_info_str) - DATEDIFF(y.back_date, y.register_date)))) AS lost7_back_index, LOCATE('100000000000000', REVERSE(SUBSTRING(y.active_info_str, 1, LENGTH(y.active_info_str) - DATEDIFF(y.back_date, y.register_date)))) AS lost14_back_index, LOCATE('1000000000000000000000', REVERSE(SUBSTRING(y.active_info_str, 1, LENGTH(y.active_info_str) - DATEDIFF(y.back_date, y.register_date)))) AS lost21_back_index, LOCATE('1000000000000000000000000000000', REVERSE(SUBSTRING(y.active_info_str, 1, LENGTH(y.active_info_str) - DATEDIFF(y.back_date, y.register_date)))) AS lost30_back_index FROM (SELECT x.accountid, x.zoneid, x.register_date, x.rd30_active_days, x.rd30_last_active_date, x.last_active_date, x.next_last_active_date, x.lost_details, x.gps_adid, x.active_info, x.pay_info, x.amount_info, x.his_first_pay_date, CASE WHEN CAST(SPLIT(x.last_active_info, '_')[2] AS BIGINT) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE GETPAIDAFTERBACK(x.amount_info, x.his_first_pay_date, DATE_ADD(SPLIT(x.last_active_info, '_')[0], CAST(SPLIT(x.last_active_info, '_')[1] AS INT) + 1)) END AS paid_details_after_back, CASE WHEN CAST(SPLIT(x.last_active_info, '_')[2] AS BIGINT) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE DATE_ADD(SPLIT(x.last_active_info, '_')[0], CAST(SPLIT(x.last_active_info, '_')[1] AS INT) + 1) END AS back_date, CAST(SPLIT(x.last_active_info, '_')[1] AS BIGINT) AS lost_days, CAST(SPLIT(x.last_active_info, '_')[2] AS BIGINT) AS is_back, CAST(SPLIT(x.last_active_info, '_')[3] AS BIGINT) AS active_7, CAST(SPLIT(x.last_active_info, '_')[4] AS BIGINT) AS active_30, CONCAT_WS('', x.active_info) AS active_info_str FROM (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.register_date, a.rd30_active_days, a.rd30_last_active_date, a.last_active_date, a.next_last_active_date, b.lost_details, d.gps_adid, b.active_info, c.pay_info /* 左边最小 */, c.amount_info, c.his_first_pay_date, REGEXP_EXTRACT(CONCAT_WS(',', b.lost_details), CONCAT(a.last_active_date, '_\\d+_(0|1)_(0|-1|1)_(0|-1|1)'), 0) AS last_active_info FROM (SELECT *, p_date AS last_active_date, LEAD(p_date, 1, NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY p_date ASC) AS next_last_active_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_behavior_recent30d_active_account_zone_di)) WHERE p_date <> '' AND p_date = rd30_last_active_date) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, active_info /* 左边最大 */, GETLOSTDETAILS(active_info, p_date) AS lost_details FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dm_ml_behavior_active_account_zone_df)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30') AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dm_ml_behavior_pay_account_zone_df)) ON c.p_date = '2026-05-30' AND a.accountid = c.accountid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, COLLECT_SET(gps_adid) AS gps_adid FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_account_gps_adid)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND app_id = '1001' GROUP BY accountid) AS d ON a.accountid = d.accountid) AS x) AS y) AS z

name: adbi.dm_predict_revenue_compare_fully_account
sql_units: WITH account_predict_di AS (SELECT accountid, SUM(predict_revenue_30) AS predict_pay_30, SUM(predict_revenue_90) AS predict_pay_90, SUM(predict_revenue_180) AS predict_pay_180, SUM(predict_revenue_270) AS predict_pay_270, SUM(predict_revenue_360) AS predict_pay_360 FROM adbi.dwm_revenue_predict_account_zone_di WHERE p_date <= '2026-05-24' AND p_date >= '2021-01-01' AND NOT accountid IS NULL AND app_id = '1001' GROUP BY accountid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_predict_revenue_compare_fully_account)) SELECT create_date AS data_date, country, campaign_id, campaign_name, IF(NOT b.accountid IS NULL, 'predict_users', 'game_users') AS user_type, COUNT(a.accountid) AS user_num, SUM(real_pay_30) AS rev_30, SUM(real_pay_90) AS rev_90, SUM(real_pay_180) AS rev_180, SUM(real_pay_270) AS rev_270, SUM(real_pay_360) AS rev_360, SUM(predict_pay_30) AS predict_30, SUM(predict_pay_90) AS predict_90, SUM(predict_pay_180) AS predict_180, SUM(predict_pay_270) AS predict_270, SUM(predict_pay_360) AS predict_360 FROM (SELECT accountid, create_date, country, campaign_id, campaign_name, ELEMENT_AT(pay_amt_total_array, -30) AS real_pay_30, ELEMENT_AT(pay_amt_total_array, -90) AS real_pay_90, ELEMENT_AT(pay_amt_total_array, -180) AS real_pay_180, ELEMENT_AT(pay_amt_total_array, -270) AS real_pay_270 /* Added real_pay_270 */, ELEMENT_AT(pay_amt_total_array, -360) AS real_pay_360 FROM (SELECT a.accountid, a.create_date, a.last_ad_country AS country, a.campaign_id, a.campaign_name, IF(b.accountid IS NULL, NULL, CONCAT(SPLIT(b.amount_info_str, ','), ARRAY_REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF(b.his_first_pay_date, a.create_date)))) AS pay_amt_total_array FROM (SELECT accountid, role_register_date AS create_date, last_ad_country, campaign_id, campaign_name /* Added country */ FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_behavior_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND TRIM(LOWER(last_ad_country)) IN ('kr', 'kw', 'us', 'ae', 'au', 'jp', 'sg', 'tw', 'gb', 'ca', 'sa', 'de', 'fr', 'ua', 'ru', 'tj', 'pl', 'mx', 'kg', 'tr', 'kz', 'by', 'uz', 'cl', 'pe', 'my', 'bo', 'br', 'kh', 'th', 'mn', 'vn', 'in', 'id', 'ph', 'mm')) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM adbi.dwm_sdk_pay_user_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND app_id = '1001') AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid)) AS a LEFT JOIN account_predict_di AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid GROUP BY create_date, country, campaign_id, campaign_name, IF(NOT b.accountid IS NULL, 'predict_users', 'game_users')

name: 新手主题看板_核心指标2.0df表ads_wmz_newbie_top30bt_bad_experience_df
sql_units: /* ============================================================================ */ /* 输出: STATIC + DYNAMIC（schema 与 baseline 一致） */ /* ============================================================================ */ WITH static_users /* 1. STATIC: register_date < 2026-05-01，复用昨天 partition（self-dependency） */ AS (SELECT * FROM mt_da.ads_wmz_newbie_top30bt_bad_experience_df WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 1 * -1) AND register_date < DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 29 * -1) AND register_date >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 210 * -1)), active_newbies /* 2a. 当前 30d 活跃 newbie */ /* AND     new_type = 3 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_country, register_date, new_type, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', register_date) + 1 AS register_days FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND register_date BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 29 * -1) AND '2026-05-30' AND is_ai = 0), cbe_single_data /* 2b-pre. 修单机关 time bug + 拿 scorerank fallback (CBE 单机关) */ /* 5.20战斗表替换，cbe_single_data */ AS (SELECT a.battleid, a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.time AS cbe_real_time, scorerank AS cbe_scorerank FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_newbie_role_zone_btid_di AS a /* 加scorerank字段 */ LEFT JOIN ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata AS b ON a.roleid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.battleid = b.battleid AND b.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 29 * -1) AND '2026-05-30' AND TO_DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(b.usercreateymd)) > DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 45 * -1) /* 注册时间45天以内的玩家，在过去30天内对局 */ WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 29 * -1) AND '2026-05-30' AND register_days <= 45 AND pvptype IN (1) AND LENGTH(CAST(a.battleid AS STRING)) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 /* 仅单机关 */), bt_dwm_filtered /* ——————————cbe_single_data替换前备份 */ /* cbe_single_data AS ( */ /*     SELECT  battleid, */ /*             accountid AS roleid, */ /*             zoneid, */ /*             `time` AS cbe_real_time, */ /*             scorerank AS cbe_scorerank */ /*     FROM    ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata */ /*     WHERE   logymd BETWEEN DATE_SUB('2026-05-30', 29) AND '2026-05-30' */ /*     AND     battletype IN (1) */ /*     AND     length(CAST(battleid AS STRING)) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 */ /*     AND     nvl(isbot, 0) = 0 */ /* ), */ /* —————————— */ /* 2b. dwm v7 严格筛选到 baseline BSE+CBE 等价子集，自己 ROW_NUMBER */ AS (SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, b.battleid, COALESCE(cbe.cbe_real_time, b.`time`) AS effective_time, cbe.cbe_scorerank, b.is_offline_single_battle, b.`time`, b.battletime, b.ismvp, b.heroid, LEAST(b.killnum, 50) AS killnum, LEAST(b.deadnum, 50) AS deadnum, LEAST(b.assistnum, 50) AS assistnum, b.blacknum, LEAST(CAST(b.score AS BIGINT), 3000) AS score, CASE WHEN b.is_offline_single_battle = 0 THEN LEAST(b.wincamp, 1) ELSE LEAST(COALESCE(b.iswin, 1), 1) END AS iswin /* iswin 严格对齐 baseline 100020827：BSE LEAST(wincamp,1) / CBE LEAST(NVL(iswin,1),1) */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.roleid, b.zoneid ORDER BY COALESCE(cbe.cbe_real_time, b.`time`) ASC) AS bt_rk_baseline /* ROW_NUMBER 用 effective_time（修单机关 1970 epoch bug） */, SUM(IF(CASE WHEN b.is_offline_single_battle = 0 THEN LEAST(b.wincamp, 1) ELSE LEAST(COALESCE(b.iswin, 1), 1) END = 1, 0, 1)) OVER (PARTITION BY b.roleid, b.zoneid ORDER BY COALESCE(cbe.cbe_real_time, b.`time`) ASC) AS lose_rk_baseline /* lose_rk 用对齐后的 iswin */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_newbie_role_zone_btid_di AS b INNER JOIN active_newbies AS n ON b.roleid = n.roleid AND b.zoneid = n.zoneid LEFT JOIN cbe_single_data AS cbe ON b.battleid = cbe.battleid AND b.roleid = cbe.roleid AND b.zoneid = cbe.zoneid WHERE b.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 29 * -1) AND '2026-05-30' AND b.pvptype IN (1, 2) AND ((b.is_offline_single_battle = 0 AND b.isinvalidbattle = 0) OR b.is_offline_single_battle = 1) AND COALESCE(b.fake_ai, 0) = 0), bt_full /* 2c. JOIN 外部表（game_type / education_di），加 score_rk fallback 链 */ AS (SELECT b.*, CASE WHEN ed.kill3 >= 1 OR ed.kill4 >= 1 OR ed.kill5 >= 1 THEN 1 WHEN ed.kill3 IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS if_kill345 /* if_kill345 用 ed.kill3/4/5（NULL→-1 严格对齐 baseline buggy 语义） */, COALESCE(ed.score_rk, IF(b.is_offline_single_battle = 1, b.cbe_scorerank, NULL), -1) AS score_rk /* score_rk fallback: ed.score_rk → CBE.scorerank (只对单机关) → -1 */, COALESCE(IF(gt.game_type IN (1, 5), gt.game_type, INT(gt.game_type + IF(b.iswin = 1, 0, 5))), -1) AS game_type FROM bt_dwm_filtered AS b LEFT JOIN ml_temp.dwm_mlbb_battle_game_type_di_yz AS gt ON b.battleid = gt.battle_id AND gt.p_date BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 30 * -1) AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 1) /* ed JOIN 严格按 100020827 line 352-378 拆 UNION ALL 处理（单机关跨天 dedupe） */ LEFT JOIN (/* 普通 battle: NOT BETWEEN 1e9-1e12，直接拿（不去重） */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, battleid, score_rk, kill3, kill4, kill5, 1 AS rank_time_desc FROM ml_temp.dwd_wmz_newbie_education_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 29 * -1) AND '2026-05-30' AND NOT battleid IS NULL AND NOT battleid BETWEEN 1000000000 AND 1000000000000 UNION ALL /* 新手第四关 (单机关教学): BETWEEN 1e9-1e12，ROW_NUMBER 跨天去重取最近 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, battleid, score_rk, kill3, kill4, kill5, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rank_time_desc FROM ml_temp.dwd_wmz_newbie_education_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 29 * -1) AND '2026-05-30' AND NOT battleid IS NULL AND battleid BETWEEN 1000000000 AND 1000000000000) AS ed ON b.roleid = ed.roleid AND b.zoneid = ed.zoneid AND b.battleid = ed.battleid AND ed.rank_time_desc = 1 WHERE b.bt_rk_baseline <= 50), dynamic_users /* 2d. 用户级聚合 */ AS (SELECT n.roleid, n.zoneid, n.create_country, n.register_date, n.register_days, n.new_type, c.label_1_get_days AS register_diff_date, c.label_1_new AS newbie_tag, MAX(b.bt_rk_baseline) AS bt_cnt, REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(LPAD(b.bt_rk_baseline, 2, '0') || '~' || COALESCE(CAST(b.battletime AS BIGINT), -1))) AS STRING), '([0-9]{0,2}~)|\\[|\\]', '') AS battletime_str, REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(LPAD(b.bt_rk_baseline, 2, '0') || '~' || COALESCE(b.killnum, -1))) AS STRING), '([0-9]{0,2}~)|\\[|\\]', '') AS killnum_str, REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(LPAD(b.bt_rk_baseline, 2, '0') || '~' || COALESCE(b.deadnum, -1))) AS STRING), '([0-9]{0,2}~)|\\[|\\]', '') AS deadnum_str, REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(LPAD(b.bt_rk_baseline, 2, '0') || '~' || COALESCE(b.assistnum, -1))) AS STRING), '([0-9]{0,2}~)|\\[|\\]', '') AS assistnum_str, REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(LPAD(b.bt_rk_baseline, 2, '0') || '~' || COALESCE(b.score, -1))) AS STRING), '([0-9]{0,2}~)|\\[|\\]', '') AS score_str, REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(LPAD(b.bt_rk_baseline, 2, '0') || '~' || COALESCE(b.score_rk, -1))) AS STRING), '([0-9]{0,2}~)|\\[|\\]', '') AS score_rk_str, REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(LPAD(b.bt_rk_baseline, 2, '0') || '~' || COALESCE(b.iswin, -1))) AS STRING), '([0-9]{0,2}~)|\\[|\\]', '') AS iswin_str, REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(LPAD(b.bt_rk_baseline, 2, '0') || '~' || COALESCE(b.game_type, -1))) AS STRING), '([0-9]{0,2}~)|\\[|\\]', '') AS game_type_str, REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(LPAD(b.bt_rk_baseline, 2, '0') || '~' || COALESCE(b.if_kill345, -1))) AS STRING), '([0-9]{0,2}~)|\\[|\\]', '') AS if_kill345_str, MIN(IF(b.deadnum > 0, b.bt_rk_baseline, NULL)) AS first_dead_btrk /* first_X_rk = MIN(bt_rk WHERE X 触发) 直接取（baseline 实际语义就是「最早一次」） */, MIN(IF(b.ismvp > 0, b.bt_rk_baseline, NULL)) AS first_mvp_btrk, MIN(IF(b.blacknum > 1, b.bt_rk_baseline, NULL)) AS first_black_btrk, MIN(IF(b.if_kill345 > 0, b.bt_rk_baseline, NULL)) AS first_kill345_btrk, MIN(CASE WHEN b.lose_rk_baseline = 1 THEN b.bt_rk_baseline END) AS lose1_rk_raw /* lose1/2/3_rk: 在 lose_rk_baseline 首次到达 1/2/3 那场的 bt_rk */, MIN(CASE WHEN b.lose_rk_baseline = 2 THEN b.bt_rk_baseline END) AS lose2_rk_raw, MIN(CASE WHEN b.lose_rk_baseline = 3 THEN b.bt_rk_baseline END) AS lose3_rk_raw FROM active_newbies AS n LEFT JOIN bt_full AS b ON n.roleid = b.roleid AND n.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN ml_temp.new_cluster_label_df AS c ON n.roleid = c.roleid AND n.zoneid = c.zoneid AND c.logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY n.roleid, n.zoneid, n.create_country, n.register_date, n.register_days, n.new_type, c.label_1_get_days, c.label_1_new) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_da.ads_wmz_newbie_top30bt_bad_experience_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_country, register_date, register_days, new_type, register_diff_date, newbie_tag, battletime, score, score_rk, iswin, game_type, lose1_rk, lose2_rk, lose3_rk, bt_cnt, killnum, deadnum, assistnum, if_kill345, first_kill345_rk, first_dead_rk, first_mvp_rk, first_black_rk FROM static_users UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_country, register_date, register_days, new_type, register_diff_date, newbie_tag, CAST(SPLIT(battletime_str, ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS battletime, CAST(SPLIT(score_str, ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS score, CAST(SPLIT(score_rk_str, ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS score_rk, CAST(SPLIT(iswin_str, ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS iswin, CAST(SPLIT(game_type_str, ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS game_type, COALESCE(lose1_rk_raw, -1) AS lose1_rk, COALESCE(lose2_rk_raw, -1) AS lose2_rk, COALESCE(lose3_rk_raw, -1) AS lose3_rk, bt_cnt, CAST(SPLIT(killnum_str, ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS killnum, CAST(SPLIT(deadnum_str, ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS deadnum, CAST(SPLIT(assistnum_str, ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS assistnum, CAST(SPLIT(if_kill345_str, ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS if_kill345, INT(COALESCE(first_kill345_btrk, -1)) AS first_kill345_rk, INT(COALESCE(first_dead_btrk, -1)) AS first_dead_rk, INT(COALESCE(first_mvp_btrk, -1)) AS first_mvp_rk, INT(COALESCE(first_black_btrk, -1)) AS first_black_rk FROM dynamic_users

name: 30日回流玩家后30天内战斗明细di表dwm_wmz_recur_battle_role_zone_btid_di
output_hint: 30日回流玩家后30天内战斗明细di表dwm_wmz_recur_battle_role_zone_btid_di
sql_units: WITH r AS (/* 当日30日流失回流用户 */ SELECT t.roleid, t.zoneid, t.recurring_date, t.lose_days, t.register_date, t.lose_date, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', t.recurring_date) + 1 AS recurring_days, t1.class, t2.class_online FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_core_role_zone_di AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT recurring_date, CASE WHEN class = '0类' THEN '回流新手' WHEN class = '1类' THEN '回流老玩家' WHEN class = '2类' THEN '回流低活' WHEN class = '3类' THEN '回流高活' ELSE '其他' END AS class, roleid, zoneid FROM ml_temp.jax_recur__label_roleid_zoneid_di WHERE recurring_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30') AS t1 ON t.roleid = t1.roleid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t.recurring_date = t1.recurring_date LEFT JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN tag_id = 1 THEN '回流低活' WHEN tag_id = 2 THEN '回流老玩家' WHEN tag_id = 3 THEN '回流新手' WHEN tag_id = 4 THEN '回流高活' ELSE '其他' END AS class_online, roleid, zoneid, logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME ASC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_returning2023_playertag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30') AS t2 ON t.roleid = t2.roleid AND t.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t.recurring_date = t2.logymd AND t2.rn = 1 WHERE t.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND t.lose_days >= 30 AND t.zoneid < 57000 AND t.logymd = t.recurring_date), bt AS (SELECT r.roleid, r.zoneid, r.recurring_date, r.lose_days, r.register_date, r.lose_date, r.recurring_days, r.class, r.class_online, IF(t1.battleid IS NULL, 0, 1) AS if_exist_battleend_performance, t.battleid, t.time, t.isinvalidbattle, t.isvalid, t.pvptype, t.realpvptype, t.battletime, t.battlesvrid, t.bigranklvl, t.minranklvl, t.rankstar, t.LEVEL AS level_before_battle, t.heroid, t.blacknum, t.wincamp, t.conwin, t.camp, t.score, t.killnum, t.deadnum, t.assistnum, t.getmoney, IF(t.select_road IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) AND t.select_road = t.real_road, 1, 0) AS if_pre_select_road_precise, CASE WHEN t.select_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN t.select_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN t.select_road = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN t.select_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN t.select_road = 5 THEN '金币路' ELSE '-9999' END AS select_road, CASE WHEN t.real_road = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN t.real_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN t.real_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN t.real_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN t.real_road = 1 THEN '经验路' ELSE '-9999' END AS real_road, t.ismvp, t.timedelay, t.stdping, t.movelag, t.ishook, t.gradetype, t.final_floor, t.runelevel, t.history_maxrankstar, COALESCE(t1.realpicturequality, -99999) AS realpicturequality, COALESCE(t1.isdownload, -99999) AS isdownload, COALESCE(t1.avgfps, -99999) AS avgfps, COALESCE(t1.systemmemorysize, -99999) AS systemmemorysize, COALESCE(t1.freediskspace, -99999) AS freediskspace, COALESCE(t1.islackres, -99999) AS islackres, COALESCE(t1.bigjankper10min, -99999) AS bigjankper10min FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS t JOIN r ON t.accountid = r.roleid AND t.zoneid = r.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY TIME ASC) AS bt_rk_asc /* 重复上报取第一次记录 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND LENGTH(CAST(battleid AS STRING)) >= 15) AS t1 ON t.accountid = t1.accountid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND CAST(t.battleid AS STRING) = CAST(t1.battleid AS STRING) AND t1.bt_rk_asc = 1 WHERE t.logymd = '2026-05-30' AND t.pvptype IN (1, 2) AND t.battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */), battle_real_usercnt_t AS (/* 计算本场真人数 */ SELECT a.battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.accountid, a.zoneid) AS real_players_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battleid FROM bt) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-30' AND a.battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */ AND LENGTH(a.battleid) >= 17 /* 剔除battleid长度10~12客户端温暖关 */ AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY a.battleid), battle_real_usercnt_camp_t AS (/* 计算双方真人数 */ SELECT a.battleid, a.wincamp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.accountid, a.zoneid) AS real_players_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battleid FROM bt) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-30' AND a.battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */ AND LENGTH(a.battleid) >= 17 /* 剔除battleid长度10~12客户端温暖关 */ AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY a.battleid, a.wincamp), battle_end_agg_t AS (/* 计算本场分路冲突情况 */ SELECT battleid, wincamp, if_pre_select_road_conflict, IF(select_road_unqiue_cnt = 5, 0, 1) AS if_pre_select_road_lack, if_real_road_conflict, IF(real_road_unqiue_cnt = 5, 0, 1) AS if_real_road_lack FROM (SELECT battleid, wincamp, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(select_road_std = '-9999', NULL, select_road_std)) AS select_road_unqiue_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(real_road_std = '-9999', NULL, real_road_std)) AS real_road_unqiue_cnt, LEAST(1, COUNT(IF(select_road_std = '-9999', NULL, select_road_std)) - COUNT(DISTINCT IF(select_road_std = '-9999', NULL, select_road_std))) AS if_pre_select_road_conflict /* 如果有-9999以外的重复分路为1，如无为0 */, LEAST(1, COUNT(IF(real_road_std = '-9999', NULL, real_road_std)) - COUNT(DISTINCT IF(real_road_std = '-9999', NULL, real_road_std))) AS if_real_road_conflict /* 如果有-9999以外的重复分路为1，如无为0 */ FROM (SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN select_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN select_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN select_road = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN select_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN select_road = 5 THEN '金币路' ELSE '-9999' END AS select_road_std, CASE WHEN real_road = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN real_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN real_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN real_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN real_road = 1 THEN '经验路' ELSE '-9999' END AS real_road_std FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battleid, wincamp FROM bt) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.wincamp = b.wincamp WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND a.battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */ AND LENGTH(a.battleid) >= 17 /* 剔除battleid长度10~12客户端温暖关 */) AS t1 GROUP BY battleid, wincamp) AS a) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_da.dwm_wmz_recur_battle_role_zone_btid_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT t.roleid, t.zoneid, t.recurring_date, t.lose_days, t.register_date, t.lose_date, t.recurring_days, t.class, t.class_online, t.if_exist_battleend_performance, t.battleid, t.time, t.isinvalidbattle, t.isvalid, t.pvptype, t.realpvptype, t.battletime, t.battlesvrid, t.bigranklvl, t.minranklvl, t.rankstar, t.level_before_battle, t.heroid, t.blacknum, t.wincamp, t.conwin, t.camp, t.score, t.killnum, t.deadnum, t.assistnum, t.getmoney, t.if_pre_select_road_precise, t.select_road, t.real_road, t.ismvp, t.timedelay, t.stdping, t.movelag, t.realpicturequality, t.isdownload, t.avgfps, t.systemmemorysize, name: 回流主题看板留存付费di表ads_wmz_recur_active_pay_datawind_di
sql_units: WITH a AS (SELECT t.roleid, t.zoneid, CONCAT(t.zoneid, '_', t.roleid) AS accountid, t.register_date, t.create_role_ip_country AS create_country, his_last_level_before_lose AS lose_level, t.lose_date, t.lose_days, t.recurring_date, t.recurring_days, t.his_max_bigranklvl_before_lose, t.is_pay_after_recur, t.pay_amount_after_recur, t.active_info_after_recur, t.active_days_after_recur, t1.class, t2.class_online FROM ml_temp.dwm_wmz_recur_feature_role_zone_di AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT recurring_date, CASE WHEN class = '0类' THEN '回流新手' WHEN class = '1类' THEN '回流老玩家' WHEN class = '2类' THEN '回流低活' WHEN class = '3类' THEN '回流高活' ELSE '其他' END AS class, roleid, zoneid FROM ml_temp.jax_recur__label_roleid_zoneid_di WHERE recurring_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30') AS t1 ON t.roleid = t1.roleid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t.recurring_date = t1.recurring_date LEFT JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN tag_id = 1 THEN '回流低活' WHEN tag_id = 2 THEN '回流老玩家' WHEN tag_id = 3 THEN '回流新手' WHEN tag_id = 4 THEN '回流高活' ELSE '其他' END AS class_online, roleid, zoneid, logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time` ASC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_returning2023_playertag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30') AS t2 ON t.roleid = t2.roleid AND t.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t.recurring_date = t2.logymd AND t2.rn = 1 WHERE t.logymd = '2026-05-30'), b /* 回流当天，基础属性 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.accountid, a.register_date, a.create_country, a.lose_level, a.lose_date, a.lose_days, a.recurring_date, a.recurring_days, a.his_max_bigranklvl_before_lose, a.is_pay_after_recur, a.pay_amount_after_recur, a.active_info_after_recur, a.active_days_after_recur, a.class, a.class_online, b1.login_min_time, b1.login_os, b1.login_client_ver, b1.login_channel, b1.login_device, b1.login_memory, b1.login_level, b1.ret_day FROM a LEFT JOIN (/* login表中回流当天首次登录信息 */ SELECT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid) AS accountid, MIN(`time`) AS login_min_time /* 最早登录时间 */, SUBSTRING(MIN(`time` || os_type), 24, 999) AS login_os /* 操作系统 */, SUBSTRING(MIN(`time` || client_ver), 24, 999) AS login_client_ver /* 版本号 */, SUBSTRING(MIN(`time` || channel), 24, 999) AS login_channel /* 渠道 */, SUBSTRING(MIN(`time` || LOWER(device)), 24, 999) AS login_device /* 设备 */, MIN(client_memory + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`) * 100000000) % 100000000 AS login_memory /* 内存 */, MIN(`level` + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`) * 100000000) % 100000000 AS login_level /* 等级 */, DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) AS ret_day /* 注册天数 */, logymd FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT accountid AS accountid_filter, recurring_date AS logymd_filter FROM a) AS b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.roleid) = b.accountid_filter AND a.logymd = b.logymd_filter WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-30', '2026-05-29', '2026-05-28', '2026-05-27', '2026-05-26', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-24', '2026-05-17', '2026-05-10', '2026-05-01') GROUP BY CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid), DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd), logymd) AS b1 ON a.accountid = b1.accountid AND a.recurring_date = b1.logymd), c /* 回流小热更下载完毕：只看loading阶段有3的 = 3之前没2 在loading阶段下载完增量，才能在主城看到扑脸 */ AS (SELECT b.accountid, b.recurring_date, MAX(c1.op_param1) AS op_param1 /* 下载耗时(98%的用户在30秒之内完成下载） */ FROM b JOIN (SELECT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', accountid) AS accountid, op_param1, logymd, `time` FROM ml_ods.reportserver_client_mini_patch_new WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND module_name = 'returning_res_2023' AND op_type = 3 /* 下载完毕 op_type = 2 在loading下载超时，进主城后下载完增量，但会错过扑脸 */) AS c1 ON b.accountid = c1.accountid AND b.recurring_date = c1.logymd AND b.login_min_time <= c1.time GROUP BY b.accountid, b.recurring_date), d /* 主界面引导 */ AS (SELECT -99999 AS accountid, -99999 AS recurring_date, -99999 AS stepid), f /* 回流引导 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.accountid, b.recurring_date FROM b JOIN (SELECT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', accountid) AS accountid, `time`, logymd FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_newbie_guide WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND stepid IN (2000120) /* 回流引导 */) AS f1 ON b.accountid = f1.accountid AND b.recurring_date = f1.logymd AND b.login_min_time <= f1.time), h /* 扑脸1~3 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) AS accountid, b.recurring_date, MAX(IF(step_id = 1, 1, 0)) AS is_welcome_1, MAX(IF(step_id = 2, 1, 0)) AS is_welcome_2, MAX(IF(step_id = 3, 1, 0)) AS is_welcome_3 FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_returning2023_welcome AS a JOIN b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) = b.accountid AND a.logymd = b.recurring_date WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND step_id IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid), b.recurring_date), bt_ms /* 匹配开始 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) AS accountid, b.recurring_date FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_begin AS a JOIN b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) = b.accountid AND a.logymd = b.recurring_date WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid), b.recurring_date), bt_md /* 匹配成功 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) AS accountid, b.recurring_date FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end AS a JOIN b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) = b.accountid AND a.logymd = b.recurring_date WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND success = 1 /* 匹配成功 */ GROUP BY CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid), b.recurring_date), bt_s /* 战斗开始 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) AS accountid, b.recurring_date FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_begin AS a JOIN b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) = b.accountid AND a.logymd = b.recurring_date WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid), b.recurring_date), bt_d /* 战斗场次 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) AS accountid, b.recurring_date, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(pvptype IN (1, 2) AND isinvalidbattle = 0, battleid, NULL)) AS pvp12_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN b ON CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid) = b.accountid AND a.logymd = b.recurring_date WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY CONCAT(a.zoneid, '_', a.accountid), b.recurring_date), recur_pay_t AS (/* 回流后7天内付费 */ SELECT a.accountid, a.recurring_date, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.recurring_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 0, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_1d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.recurring_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 1, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_2d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.recurring_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 2, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_3d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.recurring_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 3, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_4d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.recurring_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 4, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_5d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.recurring_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 5, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_6d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.recurring_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 6, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_7d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.recurring_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 13, t1.day_pay_amount / 100, 0)) AS pay_amount_recur_14d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, a.recurring_date) JOIN mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di AS t1 ON a.accountid = CONCAT(t1.zoneid, '_', t1.roleid) AND t1.logymd BETWEEN '2023-12-20' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY a.accountid, a.recurring_date), act_type AS (/* 回流首日触发活动 */ SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(zoneid, '_', roleid) AS accountid, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_returning2023_type WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-30', '2026-05-29', '2026-05-28', '2026-05-27', '2026-05-26', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-24', '2026-05-17', '2026-05-10', '2026-05-01')), result_t AS (/* 结果中间表1 */ SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, b.accountid, b.register_date, b.create_country, b.lose_level, b.class, b.class_online, b.login_min_time, b.login_os, b.login_client_ver, b.login_channel, b.login_device, b.login_memory, IF(b.login_level >= 9, '9级及以上', '9级以下') AS if_lvl9, b.ret_day, c.op_param1 /* 小热更下载时长 */, IF(NOT act.accountid IS NULL, '触发回流活动', '没触发') AS if_recur_act, IF(NOT c.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_patch /* 是否小热更 */, IF(NOT d.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_main_ui /* 是否主界面 */, IF(NOT f.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_huiliu_gd /* 是否回流引导 */, IF(NOT h.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_welcome /* 是否扑脸 */, COALESCE(h.is_welcome_1, 0) AS is_welcome_1 /* 是否扑脸 */, name: 数据检查任务
sql_units: WITH check_mid AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend, o_c_recall_chop_personal_value_365d, SPLIT(friend, ',')[0] AS friend_roleid, SPLIT(friend, ',')[1] AS friend_zoneid, pos_diff + 1 AS pos FROM mt_da.leavyliu_friend_back_recomm_result_online LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(SPLIT(o_c_recall_chop_lost_friendlist_365d, '\\073')) t AS pos_diff, friend WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30'), black_list AS (SELECT role_id AS roleid FROM db_bytedance.dwd_mlbb_user_fake_list_df WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM db_bytedance.dwd_mlbb_user_fake_list_df WHERE date > '20240810') AND date > '20240810' GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.leavyliu_social_data_check PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT * FROM (/* 看好友列表有没有黑产 */ SELECT '好友列表是否包含黑产账号' AS chec_item, COUNT(DISTINCT a.friend_roleid) AS right_uv, COUNT(b.roleid) AS num FROM (SELECT friend_roleid FROM check_mid GROUP BY friend_roleid) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM black_list GROUP BY roleid) AS b ON a.friend_roleid = b.roleid UNION /* 看黑产账号价值标签是否都是21 */ SELECT '黑产账号价值是否都是21' AS chec_item, o_c_recall_chop_personal_value_365d, COUNT(*) AS pv FROM (SELECT roleid, o_c_recall_chop_personal_value_365d FROM check_mid GROUP BY roleid, o_c_recall_chop_personal_value_365d) AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM black_list GROUP BY roleid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid GROUP BY o_c_recall_chop_personal_value_365d UNION SELECT '玩家最新活跃日期' AS chec_item, o_c_recall_chop_personal_value_365d, MAX(max_date) FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, o_c_recall_chop_personal_value_365d FROM check_mid GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, o_c_recall_chop_personal_value_365d) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(his_last_active_date) AS max_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY o_c_recall_chop_personal_value_365d UNION /* 推荐好友是否符合流失限制 */ SELECT '推荐好友最新活跃日期' AS chec_item, MAX(max_date), 0 AS pv FROM (SELECT friend_roleid, friend_zoneid FROM check_mid GROUP BY friend_roleid, friend_zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(his_last_active_date) AS max_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.friend_roleid = b.roleid AND a.friend_zoneid = b.zoneid UNION /* 推荐个数是否小于30个 */ SELECT '列表推荐个数分布' AS chec_item, recomm_num, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(pos) AS recomm_num FROM check_mid GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) GROUP BY recomm_num UNION /* 是否有重复好友 */ SELECT '同样关系对推荐个数-判断是否推重复好友', pv, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend, COUNT(*) AS pv FROM check_mid GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, friend) GROUP BY pv) /*         -- --建表 */ /*    CREATE TABLE ml_temp.leavyliu_social_data_check */ /*     ( */ /*     check_item string comment 'check_item', */ /*     item_value string comment 'item_value', */ /*     num bigint comment 'num' */ /* ) partitioned by (logymd string) stored as parquet location 's3a://moonton-hadoop/user/leavyliu/leavyliu_social_data_check' */
