*/ /*   `event_time` BIGINT COMMENT '最早事件时间', */ /*   `createdate_local` STRING COMMENT '-', */ /*   `stage_id` STRING COMMENT 'stage_id' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT '设备付费全量表，每日分区代表历史全量数据' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     logymd string comment '日期分区yyyy-MM-dd', */ /*     app_id string comment '应用唯一id' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/advertisement_bi/adbi/dim_account_tz_di' */ WITH install_user_reduce AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, app_id, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC, server_time ASC) AS row_num FROM (SELECT did, CAST(CASE WHEN app_id = 4500 THEN SUBSTRING(role_id, 0, 10) WHEN app_id = 4510 THEN SUBSTRING(role_id, 6, 10000000) ELSE role_id END AS BIGINT) AS account_id, package_name, is_emulator, IF(event_source = 2 AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip') <> '', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip'), client_ip) AS client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, system_language AS os_language, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS createdate, LOWER(COALESCE(TRIM(IF(event_source = 2 AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip') <> '' AND GEOIP(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip'), 1) <> '-', GEOIP(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip'), 1), IF(GEOIP(client_ip, 1) = '-', NULL, GEOIP(client_ip, 1)))), 'unknown')) AS ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_id, event_time, app_version, server_time, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(event_time / 1000 + 3600 * COALESCE(zone_offset, -8), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS createdate_local, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM adbi.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND event IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'login', 'logout', 'chargeMC') UNION ALL SELECT did, role_id AS account_id, package_name, 0 AS is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, 'unknown' adbi.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND event IN ('purchase_event')) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id AS black_id FROM adbi.timezone_appid_blacklist WHERE NOT app_id IN ('4510', '4500', '4530')) AS blk ON a.app_id = blk.black_id WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM adbi.dim_account_tz_df AS b WHERE b.logymd = '${DATE-2}' AND a.account_id = b.account_id AND a.app_id = b.app_id AND COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(package_name)), 'unknown') AS package_name, COALESCE(TRIM(is_emulator), -1) AS is_emulator, client_ip, COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(os)), 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(TRIM(model), 'unknown') AS model, COALESCE(TRIM(os_version), 'unknown') AS os_version, COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(network_type)), 'unknown') AS network_type, COALESCE(TRIM(os_language), 'unknown') AS os_language, COALESCE(TRIM(createdate), 'unknown') AS createdate, COALESCE(TRIM(ip_country), 'unknown') AS ip_country, COALESCE(TRIM(client_version), 'unknown') AS client_version, COALESCE(TRIM(sdk_version), 'unknown') AS sdk_version, COALESCE(TRIM(idfa), 'unknown') AS idfa, COALESCE(TRIM(idfv), 'unknown') AS idfv, COALESCE(TRIM(gps_adid), 'unknown') AS gps_adid, COALESCE(TRIM(android_id), 'unknown') AS android_id, COALESCE(TRIM(imei), 'unknown') AS imei, COALESCE(TRIM(oaid), 'unknown') AS oaid, COALESCE(TRIM(app_version), 'unknown') AS app_version, event_time, createdate_local, stage_id AS stage_id, ml_temp.charge_operate AS b ON a.product_id = b.product_id WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2023-01-31', 1, 7) AND logymd <= '2023-01-31' AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND /* 20260526 剔除所有沙盒 */ /* AND     ( */ /*             pay_channel NOT IN ('and_huawei_ag', 'and_xiaomi_getapps') */ /*             OR is_sandbox = 0 */ /*         ) */ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据,因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY charge_type, a.product_id, logym))), act_t AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN his_charge_amt >= 2000 THEN '7、[2000,)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 200 THEN '6、[200,2000)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 20 THEN '5、[20,200)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 10 THEN '4、[10,20)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 5 THEN '3、[5,10)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 2 THEN '2、[2,5)' WHEN his_charge_amt > 0 THEN WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('PE', 'BO') THEN UPPER(first_mt_country) WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('HK') THEN 'HK' ELSE 'else' END AS first_mt_country, DATEDIFF(SUBSTRING(a.logymd, 1, 7) || '-01', register_date) AS register_days, MIN(a.logymd) AS first_act_logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(logymd) AS his_last_charge_logymd, SUM(money / 100) AS his_charge_amt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE logymd <= DATE_ADD('2023-01-31', DAY('2023-01-31') * -1) /* 截止上月末的历史R级 */ AND logymd <= '2023-01-31' AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND /* 20260526 剔除所有沙盒 */ /* AND     ( */ /*             pay_channel NOT IN ('and_huawei_ag', 'and_xiaomi_getapps') */ /*             OR is_sandbox = 0 */ /*         ) */ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据,因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS his_charge ON a.roleid = his_charge.roleid AND a.zoneid = his_charge.zoneid LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS bc ON a.roleid = bc.roleid AND a.zoneid = bc.zoneid AND bc.logymd = '2023-01-31' AND bc.appid = 'mlbb' WHERE SUBSTRING(a.logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2023-01-31', 1, 7) AND a.zoneid <= 57000 AND a.logymd <= '2023-01-31' AND a.is_ai = 0 GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, his_r_label, register_date, first_mt_country, register_days, his_last_charge_logymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.ads_wmz_charge_type_num_mi PARTITION(logymd = '2023-01-31') SELECT * FROM (SELECT '首笔渗透率构成（充值项）' AS data_type, SUBSTRING('2023-01-31', 1, 7) AS logym, first_mt_country, his_r_label, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(register_date, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2023-01-31', 1, 7) THEN '0.本月新增' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1.1~30' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '2.31~90' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 90 AND 365 THEN '3.91~365' END AS register_days_type, CASE WHEN his_last_charge_logymd IS NULL THEN '1、历史未付费' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD('2023-01-31', DAY('2023-01-31') * -1), his_last_charge_logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 179 THEN '2、半年内有付费' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD('2023-01-31', DAY('2023-01-31') * -1), his_last_charge_logymd) BETWEEN 180 AND 359 THEN '3、半年~1年内有付费' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD('2023-01-31', DAY('2023-01-31') * -1), charge_type, COUNT(DISTINCT t.roleid, t.zoneid) AS act_ucnt, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM act_t AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN_BY(a.product_id, TIME) AS first_charge_product_id, SUBSTRING(a.logymd, 1, 7) = b.logym WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2023-01-31', 1, 7) /* 本月充值 */ AND logymd <= '2023-01-31' AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND /* 20260526 剔除所有沙盒 */ /* AND     ( */ /*             pay_channel NOT IN ('and_huawei_ag', 'and_xiaomi_getapps') */ /*             OR is_sandbox = 0 */ /*         ) */ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据,因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.zoneid < 57000 GROUP SUBSTRING('2023-01-31', 1, 7) THEN '0.本月新增' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1.1~30' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '2.31~90' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 90 AND 365 THEN '3.91~365' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 365 AND 365 * 3 THEN '4.1~3年' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 365 * 3 + 1 AND 365 * 5 THEN '5.3~5年' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 365 * 5 + 1 AND 365 * 99 THEN '6.5年+' ELSE 'else' END AS register_days_type, CASE WHEN his_last_charge_logymd IS NULL THEN '1、历史未付费' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD('2023-01-31', DAY('2023-01-31') * -1), his_last_charge_logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 179 THEN '2、半年内有付费' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD('2023-01-31', DAY('2023-01-31') * -1), his_last_charge_logymd) BETWEEN 180 AND 359 THEN '3、半年~1年内有付费' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD('2023-01-31', DAY('2023-01-31') * -1), his_last_charge_logymd) >= 360 THEN '4、1年内无付费' ELSE 'else' END AS his_last_charge_logymd_type, COALESCE(product_type, '无充值') AS product_type, COALESCE(charge_type, '无充值') AS charge_type, name: MC2_逐季BP购买情况
sql_units: /* 7) Overwrite today’s partition with the union of history + current */ /* =================================================================== */ /* Author:    selinasun@moonton.com */ /* Created:   2025-03-03 15:31:22 */ /* Description: Build monthly BP purchase report by stitching */ /*              historical and current data together */ /* =================================================================== */ WITH current_bp /* 1) Determine the current Battle Pass “season” for 2025-05-30 */ AS (SELECT CASE WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2024-11-29' AND '2024-12-31' THEN '2024-12' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-25' THEN '2025-01' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-01-26' AND '2025-02-19' THEN '2025-02' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-02-20' AND '2025-03-25' THEN '2025-03' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-03-26' AND '2025-04-25' THEN '2025-04' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-04-26' AND '2025-05-26' THEN '2025-05' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-05-27' AND '2025-06-30' THEN '2025-06' ELSE DATE_FORMAT('2025-05-30', 'yyyy-MM') END AS current_bp_season), historical_data /* 2) Pull all partitions except the current one (yesterday’s snapshot) */ AS (SELECT bp_season, bp_start_date, bp_end_date, date_diff, zone_type, os_type, channel, is_new, ml_install, ip_country, pure_new_type, user_mc_type, dau, bp_normal, bp_plus, bp_upgrade, diamond_cost FROM mcgg_temp.selinasun_monthly_bppurchase WHERE logymd = '2025-05-29' AND bp_season <> (SELECT current_bp_season FROM current_bp)), login_data /* 3) Build “login_data”: one row per (logymd, roleid, zoneid) in the current BP window */ AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN usercreateymd = logymd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new, CASE WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2024-11-29' AND '2024-12-31' THEN '2024-12' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-25' THEN '2025-01' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-01-26' AND '2025-02-19' THEN '2025-02' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-02-20' AND '2025-03-25' THEN '2025-03' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-03-26' AND '2025-04-25' THEN '2025-04' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-04-26' AND '2025-05-26' THEN '2025-05' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-05-27' AND '2025-06-30' THEN '2025-06' ELSE DATE_FORMAT('2025-05-30', 'yyyy-MM') END AS bp_season /* assign the season label */, CASE WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2024-11-29' AND '2024-12-31' THEN '2024-11-29' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-25' THEN '2025-01-01' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-01-26' AND '2025-02-19' THEN '2025-01-26' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-02-20' AND '2025-03-25' THEN '2025-02-20' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-03-26' AND '2025-04-25' THEN '2025-03-26' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-04-26' AND '2025-05-26' THEN '2025-04-26' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-05-27' AND '2025-06-30' THEN '2025-05-27' ELSE DATE_FORMAT('2025-05-30', 'yyyy-MM-01') END AS bp_start_date /* compute the start date of that season */, '2025-05-30' AS bp_end_date FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN CASE WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2024-11-29' AND '2024-12-31' THEN '2024-11-29' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-25' THEN '2025-01-01' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-01-26' AND '2025-02-19' THEN '2025-01-26' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-02-20' AND '2025-03-25' THEN '2025-02-20' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-03-26' AND '2025-04-25' THEN '2025-03-26' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-04-26' AND '2025-05-26' THEN '2025-04-26' WHEN '2025-05-30' BETWEEN '2025-05-27' AND '2025-06-30' THEN '2025-05-27' ELSE DATE_FORMAT('2025-05-30', 'yyyy-MM-01') END AND '2025-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_vp = 0 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, bp_end_date), user_info /* 4) Pull user‐info enrichments for those same players */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(mlbb_install = 1, mlbb_install, 0) AS ml_install, ip_country, os_type, channel, pure_new_type, CASE WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) >= 0.5 AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 5 THEN '1端内mc核心' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 >= 1 THEN '2端内mc泛玩家' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl >= 1 THEN '3ml活跃有mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '4ml活跃无mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate < DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '5ml流失' WHEN usercreateymd < '2024-11-28' THEN 'CBT注册用户' ELSE '6mc纯新' END AS user_mc_type FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_softlaunch_fullinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2025-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, IF(mlbb_install = 1, mlbb_install, 0), ip_country, os_type, channel, pure_new_type, CASE WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND battletime_39_recent90 / (battletime_39_recent90 + battletime_5v5_recent90) >= 0.5 AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 > 5 THEN '1端内mc核心' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND bat_cnt_39_recent90 >= 1 THEN '2端内mc泛玩家' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) AND pvp39_his_max_bigranklvl >= 1 THEN '3ml活跃有mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate >= DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '4ml活跃无mc段位' WHEN his_last_activedate < DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 89 * -1) THEN '5ml流失' WHEN usercreateymd < '2024-11-28' THEN 'CBT注册用户' ELSE '6mc纯新' END), bp_data /* 5) Gather all BP purchase events for the season window */ AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN usercreateymd = logymd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new, SUM(IF(operate = 'action_act_mc2battlepass', 1, 0)) AS bp_normal, SUM(IF(operate = 'action_act_mc2battlepass_plus', 1, 0)) AS bp_plus, SUM(IF(operate = 'action_act_mc2battlepass_upgrade', 1, 0)) AS bp_upgrade, SUM(sub_num) AS diamond_cost FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2024-11-29' AND '2025-05-30' AND operate LIKE '%mc2battlepass%' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd), current_data /* 6) Aggregate today’s data into the same schema */ AS (SELECT ld.bp_season, ld.bp_start_date, ld.bp_end_date, DATEDIFF(bp_end_date, ld.bp_start_date) + 1 AS date_diff, FLOOR(ld.zoneid / 1000) AS zone_type, ui.os_type, ui.channel, MIN(ld.is_new) AS is_new, ui.ml_install, ui.ip_country, ui.pure_new_type, ui.user_mc_type, COUNT(DISTINCT ld.roleid, ld.zoneid) AS dau, SUM(bd.bp_normal) AS bp_normal, SUM(bd.bp_plus) AS bp_plus, SUM(bd.bp_upgrade) AS bp_upgrade, SUM(bd.diamond_cost) AS diamond_cost FROM login_data AS ld LEFT JOIN user_info AS ui ON ld.roleid = ui.roleid AND ld.zoneid = ui.zoneid LEFT JOIN bp_data AS bd ON ld.roleid = bd.roleid AND ld.zoneid = bd.zoneid AND ld.logymd = bd.logymd WHERE ld.bp_season = (SELECT current_bp_season FROM current_bp) GROUP BY ld.bp_season, ld.bp_start_date, ld.bp_end_date, FLOOR(ld.zoneid / 1000), ui.os_type, ui.channel, ui.ml_install, ui.ip_country, ui.pure_new_type, ui.user_mc_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.selinasun_monthly_bppurchase PARTITION(logymd = '2025-05-30') SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM historical_data UNION ALL SELECT * FROM current_data) AS combined_result

name: 胜率曲线预测
sql_units: SELECT rn, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battlenum, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN wincamp = 1 THEN battleid END)) AS winnum FROM (SELECT b.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.accountid, b.zoneid, b.heroid ORDER BY time) AS rn FROM (SELECT battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT heroid) AS valid_num FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND pvptype = 2 AND zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999 AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31' /* and time >= '2025-08-21 06:00:00' */ GROUP BY battleid) AS t JOIN ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS b ON t.battleid = b.battleid WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT DISTINCT accountid /* 排除在之前有在排位中使用过这个英雄的玩家 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS ExceptTable WHERE pvptype = 2 AND zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999 AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-05-28' AND heroid = 133 AND ExceptTable.accountid = b.accountid) AND valid_num = 10 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND pvptype = 2 AND b.zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999 AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31' AND /* and time >= '2025-08-21 06:00:00' */ b.realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90) AND fake_ai = 0 AND b.heroid = 133) WHERE rn <= 50 GROUP BY rn

name: haishengxie_数据查询
sql_units: WITH date_d AS (SELECT logymd FROM w5_ods.c_bat_enter WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-25' UNION SELECT logymd FROM w5_ods.c_bat_exit WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-25' UNION SELECT logymd FROM w5_ods.c_bat_settle WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-25' UNION SELECT logymd FROM w5_ods.c_bat_fs_reconn WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-25' UNION SELECT logymd FROM w5_ods.c_bat_bg WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-25'), enter_d AS (SELECT logymd, COUNT(*) AS enter_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(roleid AS STRING)) AS enter_roleids, COUNT(DISTINCT fight_uid) AS enter_fights FROM w5_ods.c_bat_enter WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-25' GROUP BY logymd), settle_d AS (SELECT logymd, COUNT(*) AS settle_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(roleid AS STRING)) AS settle_roleids, COUNT(DISTINCT fight_uid) AS settle_fights, SUM(CASE WHEN is_desync = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sync_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN is_desync = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS desync_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN is_desync IS NULL OR (is_desync <> 0 AND is_desync <> 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_is_desync_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_desync = 0 THEN fight_uid ELSE NULL END) AS sync_fights, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_desync = 1 THEN fight_uid ELSE NULL END) AS desync_fights, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_desync = 0 OR is_desync = 1 THEN fight_uid ELSE NULL END) AS valid_sync_state_fights, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_desync IS NULL OR (is_desync <> 0 AND is_desync <> 1) THEN fight_uid ELSE NULL END) AS bad_is_desync_fights, ROUND(AVG(use_time_sec), 2) AS avg_use_time_sec, PERCENTILE_APPROX(use_time_sec, 0.95) AS p95_use_time_sec, ROUND(AVG(max_frame), 2) AS avg_max_frame, PERCENTILE_APPROX(max_frame, 0.95) AS p95_max_frame, ROUND(AVG(avg_fps), 2) AS avg_settle_fps, ROUND(AVG(max_jank_ms), 2) AS avg_max_jank_ms, ROUND(AVG(gc_count), 2) AS avg_gc_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT settle_hash IS NULL AND settle_hash <> '' THEN fight_uid ELSE NULL END) AS hash_fights FROM w5_ods.c_bat_settle WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-25' GROUP BY logymd), exit_d AS (SELECT logymd, COUNT(*) AS exit_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT fight_uid) AS exit_fights, SUM(CASE WHEN exit_type = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal_exit_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN exit_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manual_exit_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN exit_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disconnect_exit_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN exit_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_exit_rows FROM w5_ods.c_bat_exit WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-25' GROUP BY logymd), reconn_d AS (SELECT logymd, COUNT(*) AS reconn_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(roleid AS STRING)) AS reconn_roleids, COUNT(DISTINCT fight_uid) AS reconn_fights, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reconn_success_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reconn_fail_rows, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 2) AS avg_reconn_duration_ms, SUM(catchup_frames) AS reconn_catchup_frames, SUM(CASE WHEN reconn_type = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS small_reconn_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN reconn_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS big_reconn_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN reconn_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bg_catchup_reconn_rows FROM w5_ods.c_bat_fs_reconn WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-25' GROUP BY logymd), bg_d AS (SELECT logymd, COUNT(*) AS bg_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(roleid AS STRING)) AS bg_roleids, COUNT(DISTINCT fight_uid) AS bg_fights, SUM(bg_duration_ms) AS bg_total_ms, ROUND(AVG(bg_duration_ms), 2) AS avg_bg_duration_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN trigger_reconn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bg_trigger_reconn_rows FROM w5_ods.c_bat_bg WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-25' GROUP BY logymd) SELECT d.logymd AS `日期`, COALESCE(e.enter_roleids, 0) AS `进入战斗人数`, COALESCE(e.enter_fights, 0) AS `进入战斗场次`, COALESCE(s.settle_roleids, 0) AS `结算人数`, COALESCE(s.settle_fights, 0) AS `结算场次`, COALESCE(s.settle_rows, 0) AS `结算记录数`, CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.enter_fights, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(s.settle_fights, 0) * 100.0 / e.enter_fights, 2) END AS `结算完成率百分比`, COALESCE(s.sync_fights, 0) AS `同步场次`, COALESCE(s.desync_fights, 0) AS `不同步场次`, COALESCE(s.bad_is_desync_rows, 0) AS `同步字段异常记录数`, COALESCE(s.bad_is_desync_fights, 0) AS `同步字段异常场次`, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.valid_sync_state_fights, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(s.sync_fights, 0) * 100.0 / s.valid_sync_state_fights, 2) END AS `同步率百分比`, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.valid_sync_state_fights, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(s.desync_fights, 0) * 100.0 / s.valid_sync_state_fights, 2) END AS `不同步率百分比`, COALESCE(s.hash_fights, 0) AS `有结算哈希场次`, s.avg_use_time_sec AS `平均战斗秒数`, s.p95_use_time_sec AS `P95战斗秒数`, s.avg_max_frame AS `平均结算帧数`, s.p95_max_frame AS `P95结算帧数`, s.avg_settle_fps AS `平均结算FPS`, s.avg_max_jank_ms AS `平均最大卡顿毫秒`, s.avg_gc_count AS `平均GC次数`, COALESCE(x.exit_fights, 0) AS `退出场次`, COALESCE(x.normal_exit_rows, 0) AS `正常退出数`, COALESCE(x.manual_exit_rows, 0) AS `主动退出数`, COALESCE(x.disconnect_exit_rows, 0) AS `断线退出数`, COALESCE(x.abnormal_exit_rows, 0) AS `异常退出数`, COALESCE(r.reconn_rows, 0) AS `重连事件数`, COALESCE(r.reconn_fights, 0) AS `重连场次`, COALESCE(r.reconn_roleids, 0) AS `重连人数`, COALESCE(r.reconn_success_rows, 0) AS `重连成功数`, COALESCE(r.reconn_fail_rows, 0) AS `重连失败数`, r.avg_reconn_duration_ms AS `平均重连毫秒`, COALESCE(r.reconn_catchup_frames, 0) AS `重连追帧帧数`, COALESCE(r.small_reconn_rows, 0) AS `小重连数`, COALESCE(r.big_reconn_rows, 0) AS `大重连数`, COALESCE(r.bg_catchup_reconn_rows, 0) AS `后台补帧重连数`, COALESCE(bg.bg_rows, 0) AS `后台记录数`, COALESCE(bg.bg_fights, 0) AS `后台场次`, COALESCE(bg.bg_roleids, 0) AS `后台人数`, COALESCE(bg.bg_total_ms, 0) AS `后台总毫秒`, bg.avg_bg_duration_ms AS `平均后台毫秒`, COALESCE(bg.bg_trigger_reconn_rows, 0) AS `后台触发重连数_字段待校验` FROM date_d AS d LEFT JOIN enter_d AS e ON d.logymd = e.logymd LEFT JOIN settle_d AS s ON d.logymd = s.logymd LEFT JOIN exit_d AS x ON d.logymd = x.logymd LEFT JOIN reconn_d AS r ON d.logymd = r.logymd LEFT JOIN bg_d AS bg ON d.logymd = bg.logymd ORDER BY d.logymd

name: haishengxie_不同步查询
sql_units: WITH desync_fights /* 找出有不同步记录的 fight_uid */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT fight_uid FROM w5_ods.c_bat_settle WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND is_desync = 1) SELECT s.fight_uid AS `战场UID`, MAX(s.logymd) AS `日期`, COUNT(DISTINCT s.roleid) AS `参战角色数`, CAST(MIN(s.roleid) AS STRING) AS `角色ID_A` /* 角色 ID（A/B 取两侧极值） */, CAST(MAX(s.roleid) AS STRING) AS `角色ID_B`, CONCAT(CAST(CAST(MIN(s.roleid) / 10000 AS BIGINT) AS STRING), '_', CAST(s.fight_uid AS STRING)) AS `战报查询_A` /* 战报查询键：角色 ID 除以 10000（去掉后 4 位）+ '_' + 战场 UID */ /* 注： Hive 中 / 始终返回 DOUBLE，必须先 CAST AS BIGINT 截断小数再转字符串，否则得到科学计数法表示 */, CONCAT(CAST(CAST(MAX(s.roleid) / 10000 AS BIGINT) AS STRING), '_', CAST(s.fight_uid AS STRING)) AS `战报查询_B`, MIN(s.is_desync) AS `不同步标志_A` /* 不同步标志（0=同步 / 1=不同步） */, MAX(s.is_desync) AS `不同步标志_B`, COUNT(DISTINCT s.settle_hash) AS `不同哈希数` /* 结算哈希：不同哈希数 > 1 即确认不同步 */, MIN(s.settle_hash) AS `结算哈希_A`, MAX(s.settle_hash) AS `结算哈希_B`, MIN(s.client_version) AS `客户端版本_A` /* 客户端版本：A/B 不同说明版本不一致 */, MAX(s.client_version) AS `客户端版本_B`, MAX(s.stage_type) AS `关卡类型` /* 关卡信息（同局应一致） */, MAX(s.stage_id) AS `关卡ID` FROM w5_ods.c_bat_settle AS s INNER JOIN desync_fights AS d ON s.fight_uid = d.fight_uid WHERE s.logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND s.is_desync IN (0, 1) GROUP BY s.fight_uid ORDER BY MAX(s.logymd) DESC, s.fight_uid LIMIT 1000

sql_units: /* 插入 hero_skin_stats 数据 */ WITH output_table AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, CONCAT('{', CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(hero_json)), '}') AS skin_metric_set FROM (/* 第四层：每个heroid合成一段 { "heroid": { skinid:{}, skinid:{} } } */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, heroid, CONCAT('"', heroid, '":{', CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(skin_json)), '}') AS hero_json FROM (/* 第三层：生成单个皮肤json片段 "skinid":{...} */ SELECT accountid, heroid, skinid, zoneid, CONCAT('"', skinid, '":{', '"skin_games_30d":"', COALESCE(skin_games_30d, 0), '",', '"skin_winrate_30d":"', COALESCE(skin_winrate_30d, 0), '",', '"skin_games_7d":"', COALESCE(skin_games_7d, 0), '",', '"skin_winrate_7d":"', COALESCE(skin_winrate_7d, 0), '",', '"skin_rank_per_hero_30d":"', COALESCE(skin_rank_per_hero_30d, 0), '",', '"skin_rank_per_hero_7d":"', COALESCE(skin_rank_per_hero_7d, 0), '",', '"skin_last_played_dt":"', COALESCE(skin_last_played_dt, ''), '"', '}') AS skin_json FROM (/* 第二层：指标结果 */ SELECT accountid, heroid, skinid, zoneid, skin_games_30d, skin_winrate_30d, skin_games_7d, skin_winrate_7d, skin_rank_per_hero_30d, skin_rank_per_hero_7d, skin_last_played_dt FROM (/* 第一层：原始计算 */ SELECT accountid, heroid, zoneid, uiSkinID AS skinid, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS skin_games_30d, CAST(ROUND(SUM(IF(camp = wincamp, 1, 0)) / COUNT(*), 4) AS DOUBLE) AS skin_winrate_30d, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-01', -6) AND '2026-05-01' THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE) AS skin_games_7d, CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-01', -6) AND '2026-05-01' AND camp = wincamp THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-01', -6) AND '2026-05-01' THEN 1 END), 0), 4) AS DOUBLE) AS skin_winrate_7d, MAX(logymd) AS skin_last_played_dt, CAST(RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, heroid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS DOUBLE) AS skin_rank_per_hero_30d, CAST(RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, heroid ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-01', -6) AND '2026-05-01' THEN 1 END) DESC) AS DOUBLE) AS skin_rank_per_hero_7d FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-01', -30) AND '2026-05-01' AND isvalid = 1 AND IsInvalidBattle = 0 AND fake_ai = 0 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND uiSkinID > 0 GROUP BY accountid, heroid, zoneid, uiSkinID) AS t) AS t2) AS t3 GROUP BY accountid, heroid, zoneid) AS t4 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jaxzhong_hero_skin_stats_json_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-01') SELECT S1.accountid, s1.skin_metric_set, s1.zoneid FROM output_table AS s1 JOIN (SELECT roleid AS accountid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-01' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS s2 ON s1.accountid = s2.accountid AND s1.zoneid = s2.zoneid

DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[3]) AS `skl1:命中英雄次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[4]) AS `skl1:命中英雄个数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[5]) AS `skl1:总伤害量`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[6]) AS `skl1:对英雄总伤害量`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[7]) AS `skl1:拖拽次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[8]) AS `skl1:推拽时长`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[9]) AS `skl1:拖拽命中率`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[10]) AS `skl1:走A次数`, skillhitrate3, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[0]) AS skl3_skill_id, skl3.note AS skl3_skill_name, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[1]) AS `skl3:释放次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[2]) AS `skl3:命中次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[3]) AS `skl3:命中英雄次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[4]) AS `skl3:命中英雄个数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[5]) AS `skl3:总伤害量`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[6]) AS `skl3:对英雄总伤害量`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[7]) AS `skl3:拖拽次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[8]) AS `skl3:推拽时长`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[9]) AS `skl3:拖拽命中率`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[10]) AS `skl3:走A次数`, skillhitrate4, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[0]) AS skl4_skill_id, skl4.note AS skl4_skill_name, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[1]) AS `skl4:释放次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[2]) AS `skl4:命中次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[3]) AS `skl4:命中英雄次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[4]) AS `skl4:命中英雄个数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[5]) AS `skl4:总伤害量`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[6]) AS `skl4:对英雄总伤害量`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[7]) AS `skl4:拖拽次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[8]) AS `skl4:推拽时长`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[9]) AS `skl4:拖拽命中率`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[10]) AS `skl4:走A次数`, skillhitrate5, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[0]) AS skl5_skill_id, skl5.note AS skl5_skill_name, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[1]) AS `skl5:释放次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[2]) AS `skl5:命中次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[3]) AS `skl5:命中英雄次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[4]) AS `skl5:命中英雄个数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[5]) AS `skl5:总伤害量`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[6]) AS `skl5:对英雄总伤害量`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[7]) AS `skl5:拖拽次数`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[8]) AS `skl5:推拽时长`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[9]) AS `skl5:拖拽命中率`, DOUBLE(SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[10]) AS `skl5:走A次数` FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_hitrate_analysis AS a JOIN (SELECT battleid AS filter_battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS bt_cunt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 57000 AND pvptype = 2 AND realpvptype IN (2, 59, 90) AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) = 10 /* 仅10真人战斗 */) AS b ON a.battleid = b.filter_battleid JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN real_road = 5 THEN '5-金币路' WHEN real_road = 1 THEN '1-经验路' WHEN real_road = 2 THEN '2-中路' WHEN real_road = 4 THEN '4-打野' WHEN real_road = 3 THEN '3-游走' ELSE '其他' END AS real_road_std, battleid, accountid, heroid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 57000 AND pvptype = 2 AND realpvptype IN (2, 59, 90) AND fake_ai = 0) AS c ON a.battleid = c.battleid AND a.accountid = c.accountid AND a.heroid = c.heroid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN skill_info AS skl0 ON SPLIT(a.skillhitrate0, ',')[0] = skl0.skill_id AND a.heroid = skl0.hero_id LEFT JOIN skill_info AS skl1 ON SPLIT(a.skillhitrate1, ',')[0] = skl1.skill_id AND a.heroid = skl1.hero_id LEFT JOIN skill_info AS skl3 ON SPLIT(a.skillhitrate3, ',')[0] = skl3.skill_id AND a.heroid = skl3.hero_id LEFT JOIN skill_info AS skl4 ON SPLIT(a.skillhitrate4, ',')[0] = skl4.skill_id AND a.heroid = skl4.hero_id LEFT JOIN skill_info AS skl5 ON SPLIT(a.skillhitrate5, ',')[0] = skl5.skill_id WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31' AND a.bigranklvl >= 4 AND a.zoneid >= 57000 AND a.heroid = STRUCT(STRUCT(heroid))) SELECT CASE WHEN bigranklvl IN (4, 5) THEN '宗师+史诗' WHEN bigranklvl IN (6, 7) THEN '传奇+神话' ELSE bigranklvl END AS `段位`, real_road_std, SUM(CASE WHEN `2+1使用比例` > 0.5 THEN wincamp ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN `2+1使用比例` > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `2+1胜率`, SUM(CASE WHEN `1+2使用比例` > 0.5 THEN wincamp ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN `1+2使用比例` > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `1+2胜率`, SUM(CASE WHEN `2+1使用比例` > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `2+1使用数`, SUM(CASE WHEN `2+1使用比例` > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(1) AS `2+1使用比例`, SUM(CASE WHEN `1+2使用比例` > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `1+2使用数`, SUM(1) AS `总场次` FROM (SELECT *, `skl5:释放次数` / (`skl5:释放次数` + `skl4:释放次数`) AS `2+1使用比例`, `skl4:释放次数` / (`skl5:释放次数` + `skl4:释放次数`) AS `1+2使用比例` FROM bt_skill_detail) GROUP BY `段位`, real_road_std

name: 20260529-ph-3
sql_units: WITH user_flags AS (SELECT roleid, SUBSTRING(register_date, 1, 7) AS register_month, age_group, is_moba, is_rpg, is_strategy, is_sandbox, is_shooter, is_sports, is_casual FROM ml_temp.jianli_20260528_ph_competitor WHERE NOT logymd IS NULL AND register_date = '2025-01-01'), retention_pivot AS (/* JOIN 下推到扫表 CTE，让 Spark broadcast 小表早过滤；只取需要的 4 个 cohort */ SELECT rt.roleid, MAX(CASE WHEN rt.cohort_type = 'day2' THEN rt.is_retained ELSE 0 END) AS d2_retained, MAX(CASE WHEN rt.cohort_type = 'day30' THEN rt.is_retained ELSE 0 END) AS d30_retained, MAX(CASE WHEN rt.cohort_type = 'day90' THEN rt.is_retained ELSE 0 END) AS d90_retained, MAX(CASE WHEN rt.cohort_type = 'day360' THEN rt.is_retained ELSE 0 END) AS d360_retained FROM ml_temp.jian_li_20251124_retention AS rt JOIN user_flags AS uf ON rt.roleid = uf.roleid WHERE rt.cohort_type IN ('day2', 'day30', 'day90', 'day360') AND rt.logymd BETWEEN '2025-01-02' AND '2026-05-27' GROUP BY rt.roleid), user_full AS (SELECT uf.roleid, uf.register_month, uf.age_group, uf.is_moba, uf.is_rpg, uf.is_strategy, uf.is_sandbox, uf.is_shooter, uf.is_sports, uf.is_casual, COALESCE(rp.d2_retained, 0) AS d2_retained, COALESCE(rp.d30_retained, 0) AS d30_retained, COALESCE(rp.d90_retained, 0) AS d90_retained, COALESCE(rp.d360_retained, 0) AS d360_retained FROM user_flags AS uf LEFT JOIN retention_pivot AS rp ON uf.roleid = rp.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, SUM(day_login_duration) AS day_login_duration FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2025-01-01' GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 ON uf.roleid = t1.roleid) SELECT register_month, age_group, is_moba, is_rpg, is_strategy, is_sandbox, is_shooter, is_sports, is_casual, COUNT(roleid) AS new_user_count, SUM(d2_retained) AS d2_retained_count, SUM(d30_retained) AS d30_retained_count, SUM(d90_retained) AS d90_retained_count, SUM(d360_retained) AS d360_retained_count FROM user_full GROUP BY register_month, age_group, is_moba, is_rpg, is_strategy, is_sandbox, is_shooter, is_sports, is_casual ORDER BY register_month, age_group, is_moba DESC, is_rpg DESC, is_strategy DESC, is_sandbox DESC, is_shooter DESC, is_sports DESC, is_casual DESC

sql_units: SELECT CASE WHEN b.logymd >= '2026-04-30' THEN 'after' ELSE 'before' END AS t /*   b.logymd AS t, */ /*   date_trunc('hour', b.time) AS t, */, c.param_value, AVG(IF(smallreconnect_num / (battletime / 600) <= 1, 1, 0) + IF(b.movelag / (battletime / 600) <= 4, 1, 0) + IF((ping80 / ping_times) >= 0.95, 1, 0)) AS net_sc, COUNT(*) AS num, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS player, AVG(timedelay) AS ping, AVG(b.movelag / (battletime / 600)) AS mlag_per10min, AVG(skilllag / (battletime / 600)) AS slag_per10min /* avg(incominglagnum) as movelag2, */, SUM(IF(movelag / (battletime / 600) <= 4, 1, 0)) / COUNT(*) AS mlag_rate, AVG(smallreconnect_num / (battletime / 600)) AS small_per10min, SUM(bytesc2s / (battletime / 60)) /* avg(reconnectnum)recs, */ / COUNT(*) AS `上行每分钟字节`, SUM(bytess2c / (battletime / 60)) / COUNT(*) AS `下行每分钟字节`, SUM(packetsc2s / (battletime / 60)) / COUNT(*) AS `上行每分钟包`, SUM(packetss2c / (battletime / 60)) / COUNT(*) AS `下行每分钟包`, SUM(bytess2c) / SUM(packetss2c) AS `每个包下行大小`, SUM(bytesc2s) / SUM(packetsc2s) AS `每个包上行大小`, COUNT(IF(use_udp = 10, 1, NULL)) / COUNT(1) AS udp_per, AVG(COALESCE(lostrequestnum, 0) / (battletime / 60)) AS lostrequest_permin, AVG(COALESCE(netframelag, 0) / (battletime / 60)) AS netframelag_permin, AVG(stdping) AS stdping, AVG(reconnectnum) AS reconnectnum, AVG(bigreconnect_num) AS bigreconnect_num, AVG(operate800) AS operate800, AVG(maxdelay) AS maxdelay, (ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ((ping120 + ping150 + ping200 + ping300 + ping500 + ping800) / ping_times) <= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 3)) AS new /* avg(pingjump_15) pingjump_15, */ /* avg(pingjump_30) pingjump_30, */ /* avg(pingjump_60) pingjump_60, */ /* avg(pingjump_100) pingjump_100, */ /* avg(pingjump_200) pingjump_200, */ /* avg(pingjump_2000) pingjump_2000, */ FROM (/* 代替 QUALIFY：先算 rn，再 WHERE rn=1 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, param_value FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, param_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, param_value ORDER BY logymd, time) AS rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE logymd >= '2026-04-30' AND param_value <> '' AND /*   AND param_value <> '__MTTD_INTERNAL_LONG_OBSERVE_GROUP__' */ zoneid BETWEEN 16300 AND 17270 AND /* AND param_name = 'dev_netoptimize_2' */ param_name = '60_netoptimize_3') AS t0 WHERE rn = 1) AS c JOIN (SELECT be.accountid, be.zoneid, be.logymd, be.timedelay, be.maxdelay, be.isvalid, be.pvptype, be.battlesvrid, be.battleid, be.battletime, be.smallreconnect_num, be.movelag, be.skilllag, be.ping80, be.ping_times, be.ping120, be.ping150, be.ping200, be.ping300, be.ping500, be.ping800, be.bytesc2s, be.bytess2c, be.packetsc2s, be.packetss2c, be.time, be.stdping, be.reconnectnum, be.bigreconnect_num, be.operate800, be.use_udp, be.pingjump_15, be.pingjump_30, be.pingjump_60, be.pingjump_100, be.pingjump_200, be.pingjump_2000, nb.lostrequestnum, inc.netframelag FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS be LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, battleid, logymd, SUM(lostrequestnum) AS lostrequestnum FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battle_netbrief_info WHERE logymd >= '2026-04-01' AND zoneid BETWEEN 16300 AND 17270 GROUP BY accountid, battleid, logymd) AS nb ON be.accountid = nb.accountid AND be.battleid = nb.battleid AND be.logymd = nb.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, battleid, logymd, SUM(netframelag) AS netframelag FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_incoming WHERE logymd >= '2026-04-01' AND zoneid BETWEEN 16300 AND 17270 GROUP BY accountid, battleid, logymd) AS inc ON be.accountid = inc.accountid AND be.battleid = inc.battleid AND be.logymd = inc.logymd WHERE be.logymd >= '2026-04-01' AND be.zoneid BETWEEN 16300 AND 17270 AND be.timedelay > 0 AND be.timedelay <> 10000 AND be.timedelay < 50000 AND be.maxdelay < 50000 AND be.movelag < 10000 AND be.isvalid = 1 AND be.pvptype IN (1, 2)) AS b ON c.roleid = b.accountid AND c.zoneid = b.zoneid /* GROUP BY b.logymd, c.param_value */ GROUP BY CASE WHEN b.logymd >= '2026-04-30' THEN 'after' ELSE 'before' END /* t, */, c.param_value /* date_trunc('hour', b.time), */ ORDER BY t, c.param_value /* hour, */

name: 20260518日度模式用户表
sql_units: WITH total_dau /* S1  全服日活（正式服，排除AI，作为参与率分母） */ AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS total_dau_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2025-12-30' AND is_ai = 0 AND CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000), mode_open /* S2  当日全服开放模式 pvptype（参与率≥0.5%，过滤灰度） */ AS (SELECT b.pvptype FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di AS b WHERE b.logymd = '2025-12-30' AND b.is_fake_ai = 0 AND b.battle_cnt > 0 AND NOT b.pvptype IN (1, 2, 164, 165, 166, 168, 188) AND CAST(b.zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 GROUP BY b.pvptype HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid) * 1.0 / (SELECT total_dau_cnt FROM total_dau) >= 0.005), battle_agg /* S3  战斗聚合（当日，用户 × 区服粒度） */ AS (SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, MAX(b.register_date) AS register_date, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT m.pvptype IS NULL AND b.battle_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_mode, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT m.pvptype IS NULL THEN b.battle_duration ELSE 0 END) AS duration_mode, SUM(CASE WHEN b.pvptype IN (1, 2) THEN b.battle_duration ELSE 0 END) AS duration_5v5, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT m.pvptype IS NULL THEN b.battle_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS mode_battle_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT m.pvptype IS NULL THEN b.hook_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS mode_hook_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT m.pvptype IS NULL THEN b.hook_duration ELSE 0 END) AS mode_hook_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT m.pvptype IS NULL THEN b.report_battle_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS mode_report_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di AS b LEFT JOIN mode_open AS m ON m.pvptype = b.pvptype WHERE b.logymd = '2025-12-30' AND b.is_fake_ai = 0 AND CAST(b.zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 AND (b.pvptype IN (1, 2) OR NOT m.pvptype IS NULL) GROUP BY b.roleid, b.zoneid), active_agg /* S4  在线时长聚合（当日） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(day_login_duration) AS duration_online FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2025-12-30' AND is_ai = 0 AND CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), recur_flag /* S5  回流标记（30 日流失后当日回归） */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_30d_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2025-12-30' AND NOT recurring_date IS NULL AND lose_days >= 30) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.aruna_ads_mode_user_daily_di PARTITION(logymd = '2025-12-30') SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, CASE WHEN CAST(b.zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END AS server_type, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2025-12-30', b.register_date) < 30 THEN '新进' WHEN NOT r.roleid IS NULL THEN '回流' ELSE '其他' END AS user_type /* 用户分层：新进 > 回流 > 其他（互斥单标签） */, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2025-12-30', b.register_date) < 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new, CASE WHEN NOT r.roleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_recur, b.duration_5v5, b.duration_mode, COALESCE(a.duration_online, 0) AS duration_online, GREATEST(COALESCE(a.duration_online, 0) - b.duration_5v5 - b.duration_mode, 0) AS duration_non_battle, b.mode_battle_cnt, b.mode_hook_cnt, b.mode_report_cnt, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS mode_type_name, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS mode_type_id, b.mode_hook_duration FROM battle_agg AS b LEFT JOIN active_agg AS a ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN recur_flag AS r ON r.roleid = b.roleid AND r.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE b.has_mode = 1

name: 20260518月度模式用户表
sql_units: WITH total_dau_daily /* S1  两个统计月的全服日活（合并扫描，作为参与率分母） */ AS (SELECT logymd, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS total_dau_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), -1), 'MM') AND DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1) AND is_ai = 0 AND CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 GROUP BY logymd), mode_open_cur /* S2  当前统计月全服开放模式 pvptype（月内任意一天参与率≥0.5%） */ AS (SELECT b.pvptype FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di AS b JOIN total_dau_daily AS t ON t.logymd = b.logymd WHERE b.logymd BETWEEN TRUNC(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), 'MM') AND DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1) AND b.is_fake_ai = 0 AND b.battle_cnt > 0 AND NOT b.pvptype IN (1, 2, 164, 165, 166, 168, 188) AND CAST(b.zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 GROUP BY b.pvptype, b.logymd, t.total_dau_cnt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid) * 1.0 / t.total_dau_cnt >= 0.005), mode_open_prev /* S3  上一个统计月全服开放模式 pvptype（月内任意一天参与率≥0.5%） */ AS (SELECT b.pvptype FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di AS b JOIN total_dau_daily AS t ON t.logymd = b.logymd WHERE b.logymd BETWEEN TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), -1), 'MM') AND DATE_ADD(TRUNC(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), 'MM'), 1 * -1) AND b.is_fake_ai = 0 AND b.battle_cnt > 0 AND NOT b.pvptype IN (1, 2, 164, 165, 166, 168, 188) AND CAST(b.zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 GROUP BY b.pvptype, b.logymd, t.total_dau_cnt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid) * 1.0 / t.total_dau_cnt >= 0.005), battle_cur /* S4  当前统计月战斗聚合 */ /*     模式定义：pvptype 在 mode_open_cur 中（月内至少一天参与率≥0.5%） */ AS (SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, MAX(b.register_date) AS register_date, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT m.pvptype IS NULL AND b.battle_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_mode_mau, MAX(CASE WHEN b.pvptype IN (1, 2) AND b.battle_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_5v5_mau FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di AS b LEFT JOIN mode_open_cur AS m ON m.pvptype = b.pvptype WHERE b.logymd BETWEEN TRUNC(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), 'MM') AND DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1) AND b.is_fake_ai = 0 AND (b.pvptype IN (1, 2) OR NOT m.pvptype IS NULL) GROUP BY b.roleid, b.zoneid), battle_prev /* S5  上一个统计月战斗聚合 */ AS (SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, MAX(b.register_date) AS register_date_prev, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT m.pvptype IS NULL AND b.battle_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_mode_mau_prev, MAX(CASE WHEN b.pvptype IN (1, 2) AND b.battle_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_5v5_mau_prev FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di AS b LEFT JOIN mode_open_prev AS m ON m.pvptype = b.pvptype WHERE b.logymd BETWEEN TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), -1), 'MM') AND DATE_ADD(TRUNC(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), 'MM'), 1 * -1) AND b.is_fake_ai = 0 AND (b.pvptype IN (1, 2) OR NOT m.pvptype IS NULL) GROUP BY b.roleid, b.zoneid), login_history /* S6 登录扫描窗口：当前统计月往前 4 个月到当前统计月月末 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) AS ym FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), -4), 'MM') AND logymd <= DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1) AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7)), login_summary /* S7 登录摘要：当前统计月/上一个统计月登录标志 + 最近登录月（< 当前统计月） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN ym = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), 'yyyy-MM') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_login_mau, MAX(CASE WHEN ym = DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), -1), 'yyyy-MM') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_login_mau_prev, MAX(CASE WHEN ym < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), 'yyyy-MM') THEN ym END) AS last_login_ym FROM login_history GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), candidate_users /* S8 候选用户集：当前统计月 mode_mau ∪ 上一个统计月 mode_mau */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM battle_cur WHERE is_mode_mau = 1 UNION SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM battle_prev WHERE is_mode_mau_prev = 1), base /* S9 汇总所有标志 + 计算 login_absence_months */ AS (SELECT u.roleid, u.zoneid, bc.register_date, bp.register_date_prev, COALESCE(bc.is_mode_mau, 0) AS is_mode_mau, COALESCE(bc.is_5v5_mau, 0) AS is_5v5_mau, COALESCE(ls.is_login_mau, 0) AS is_login_mau, COALESCE(bp.is_mode_mau_prev, 0) AS is_mode_mau_prev, COALESCE(bp.is_5v5_mau_prev, 0) AS is_5v5_mau_prev, COALESCE(ls.is_login_mau_prev, 0) AS is_login_mau_prev, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bp.is_mode_mau_prev, 0) = 1 AND SUBSTRING(bp.register_date_prev, 1, 7) = DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), -1), 'yyyy-MM') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_prev, COALESCE((CAST(SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), 'yyyy-MM'), 1, 4) AS INT) * 12 + CAST(SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), 'yyyy-MM'), 6, 2) AS INT)) - (CAST(SUBSTRING(ls.last_login_ym, 1, 4) AS INT) * 12 + CAST(SUBSTRING(ls.last_login_ym, 6, 2) AS INT)) - 1, 4) AS login_absence_months FROM candidate_users AS u LEFT JOIN battle_cur AS bc ON bc.roleid = u.roleid AND bc.zoneid = u.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle_prev AS bp ON bp.roleid = u.roleid AND bp.zoneid = u.zoneid LEFT JOIN login_summary AS ls ON ls.roleid = u.roleid AND ls.zoneid = u.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.aruna_ads_mode_user_monthly_mi PARTITION(logymd = '2025-12-01') SELECT roleid, CAST(zoneid AS INT) AS zoneid, CASE WHEN CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END AS server_type, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS portrait_type, CASE WHEN is_mode_mau = 1 THEN CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(register_date, 1, 7) = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2025-12-01', 'MM'), 1 * -1), 'yyyy-MM') THEN '新增' WHEN is_mode_mau_prev = 1 AND is_new_prev = 0 THEN '留存(存量)' WHEN is_mode_mau_prev = 1 AND is_new_prev = 1 THEN '新进沉淀' WHEN is_login_mau_prev = 1 AND is_mode_mau_prev = 0 AND is_5v5_mau_prev = 1 THEN '流入(竞技转入)' WHEN is_login_mau_prev = 1 AND is_mode_mau_prev = 0 AND is_5v5_mau_prev = 0 THEN '流入(游览转入)' WHEN login_absence_months = 1 THEN '短回流' WHEN login_absence_months BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '中回流' ELSE '长回流' END ELSE CASE WHEN is_5v5_mau = 1 THEN '流出(竞技转出)' WHEN is_login_mau = 1 THEN '流出(游览转出)' ELSE '流失' END END AS monthly_status, CAST(is_mode_mau AS TINYINT) AS is_mode_mau, CAST(is_5v5_mau AS TINYINT) AS is_5v5_mau, CAST(is_login_mau AS TINYINT) AS is_login_mau, CAST(is_mode_mau_prev AS TINYINT) AS is_mode_mau_prev, CAST(is_5v5_mau_prev AS TINYINT) AS is_5v5_mau_prev, CAST(is_login_mau_prev AS TINYINT) AS is_login_mau_prev, CAST(is_new_prev AS TINYINT) AS is_new_prev, CAST(login_absence_months AS INT) AS login_absence_months, COALESCE(register_date, register_date_prev) AS register_date, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS mode_type_name, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS mode_type_id FROM base

name: 临时查询1
sql_units: WITH send_stats AS (/* 1. 统计每个用户在这 7 封邮件中的被发送次数 */ SELECT UPPER(createrole_country) AS country, roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT mailuuid) AS send_mail_cnt FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_send_mail WHERE LOGYMD >= '2026-05-01' AND LOGYMD <= '2026-06-01' AND zoneid < 57001 AND mailuuid IN (1779348890514, 1780035341828) GROUP BY UPPER(createrole_country), roleid), open_stats AS (/* 2. 统计每个用户在这 7 封邮件中的打开次数 */ SELECT roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT mailuuid) AS open_mail_cnt FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_open_mail WHERE LOGYMD >= '2026-05-01' AND LOGYMD <= '2026-06-01' AND zoneid < 57001 AND mailuuid IN (1779348890514, 1780035341828) GROUP BY roleid), user_metrics AS (/* 3. 汇总每个用户的发送与打开表现 */ SELECT s.country, s.roleid, s.send_mail_cnt, COALESCE(o.open_mail_cnt, 0) AS open_mail_cnt FROM send_stats AS s LEFT JOIN open_stats AS o ON s.roleid = o.roleid) /* ========================================================== */ /* 4. 最终输出：按国家维度统计每次都收到但从未打开的用户及占比 */ /* ========================================================== */ SELECT country, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS total_receive_users /* 收到过至少一封信的总人数（大盘覆盖） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN send_mail_cnt = 2 THEN roleid END) AS full_receive_users /* 7封信全部都收到的总人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN send_mail_cnt = 2 AND open_mail_cnt = 0 THEN roleid END) AS always_receive_never_open_users /* 每次都收到但从不打开的人数 */, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN send_mail_cnt = 2 AND open_mail_cnt = 0 THEN roleid END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN send_mail_cnt = 2 THEN roleid END), 0), 2) AS never_open_ratio_of_full_receive /* 计算占比：在【全部收到7封信】的人群中，从未打开过的人群比例 */ FROM user_metrics GROUP BY country ORDER BY country

name: teemoyu_临时03
sql_units: /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ /* 核心指标汇总（进组日粒度） */ /* 实验：s57_86_ModeChoice（新版模式界面 AB 实验） */ /* 测服：zoneid >= 57000  |  周期：2026-05-28 ~ 2026-06-05 */ /* ⚠️ 实际开始：北京时间 2026-05-29 15:00（UTC+8），logymd='2026-05-28' 仅 ~1h 进组，保留 */ /* ⚠️ pvptype=11 仅 4 条，在 battle CTE 中已过滤 */ /* ⚠️ pvptype=5/6/164/2002 中文含义待确认，注释已标记 */ /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ WITH ab_users /* ── 进组底表 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT accountid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, param_name /* 实验名称 */, param_value /* 分组名称（control / test） */, param_version /* 分组 ID（control=11515，test=11516） */, MIN(time) AS ab_time /* 进组最早时间（用于进组后行为过滤） */, MIN(logymd) AS ab_logymd /* 进组最早日期（用于每日趋势分组） */ FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-28' AND '2026-06-05' AND param_name = 's57_86_ModeChoice' AND old_zoneid >= 57000 AND param_value IN ('control', 'test') GROUP BY accountid, old_zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version), click_raw /* ── 模式界面点击明细 ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT logymd, time AS ui_click_time /* 点击时间（用于进组后过滤 & DISTINCT 去重） */, accountid, zoneid, lobby_btn /* 原始按钮标识，直接用于 total CTE 过滤 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_main_ui_click WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-28' AND '2026-06-05' AND zoneid >= 57000), battle /* ── 对局明细（排除 pvptype=11，数量仅 4 条）──────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, pvptype, battleid, time AS battle_time FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_begin WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-28' AND '2026-06-05' AND zoneid >= 57000 AND pvptype <> 11 /* 排除 pvptype=11（极少量，不纳入分析） */), total /* ── 用户粒度明细：进组后的点击次数 & 参战次数 ────────────────────── */ /* ⚠️ click × battle 双 LEFT JOIN 会产生行数膨胀（M×N 行） */ /*    通过 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ... THEN unique_id END) 消除重复计数： */ /*    · 点击：以 ui_click_time 去重（同一毫秒多次点击视为 1 次） */ /*    · 参战：以 battleid 去重（battleid 全局唯一） */ AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.param_name /* 实验名称 */, a.param_value /* 分组（control / test） */, a.param_version /* 分组 ID */, a.ab_time /* 进组最早时间 */, a.ab_logymd /* 进组最早日期 */ /* ══ 按钮点击次数（进组后，列名与 lobby_btn 保持一致）════════ */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode02' THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode02_cnt /* 排位赛点击次数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode01' THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode01_cnt /* 匹配点击次数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_ModeBasic' THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_ModeBasic_cnt /* 自定义点击次数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = '24Newbie_m_ModeCitizensLeagues' THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS 24Newbie_m_ModeCitizensLeagues_cnt /* 全民赛事点击次数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode03' THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode03_cnt /* [老]乱斗点击次数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode39' THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode39_cnt /* [老]MCGG点击次数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_Arcademode' THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_Arcademode_cnt /* [老]娱乐大厅点击次数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_RecreationalMode_BigItem' THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_RecreationalMode_BigItem_cnt /* [新]娱乐大图点击次数（MCGG/乱序争锋） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_RecreationalMode_Item' THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_RecreationalMode_Item_cnt /* [新]娱乐小图点击次数（异序乱斗/1v1） */ /* ══ 各 pvptype 参战次数（进组后）═══════════════════════════ */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 1 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp1_battle_cnt /* pvptype=1  匹配 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 2 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp2_battle_cnt /* pvptype=2  排位赛 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 4 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp4_battle_cnt /* pvptype=4  大乱斗 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 5 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp5_battle_cnt /* pvptype=5  （含义待确认） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 6 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp6_battle_cnt /* pvptype=6  （含义待确认） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 164 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp164_battle_cnt /* pvptype=164（含义待确认） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 2001 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp2001_battle_cnt /* pvptype=2001 乱序争锋 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 2002 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp2002_battle_cnt /* pvptype=2002（含义待确认） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 3030 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp3030_battle_cnt /* pvptype=3030 异序乱斗 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time THEN c.battleid END) AS total_battle_cnt /* 进组后总参战次数（不含pvptype=11） */ FROM ab_users AS a LEFT JOIN click_raw AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle AS c ON a.accountid = c.accountid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.param_name, a.param_value, a.param_version, a.ab_time, a.ab_logymd) /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ /* 最终汇总：按进组日 × 实验分组，输出各指标 */ /* 输出命名规则： */ /*   if_<lobby_btn>_cnt  = 点击该按钮的人数（CTR 分子，除以 users 即得点击率） */ /* 各pvp参战次数 */ /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ SELECT ab_logymd AS ab_logymd /* 进组日期 */, param_name AS param_name /* 实验名称 */, param_value AS param_value /* 实验分组 */ /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ /* ▸ 进组人数 */ /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid) AS users /* 进组总人数 */ /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ /* ▸ 按钮点击人数（CTR 分子）—— 全部集中 */ /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */, SUM(CASE WHEN 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode02_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode02_cnt /* 排位赛按钮点击人数（新老共同） */, SUM(CASE WHEN 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode01_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode01_cnt /* 匹配按钮点击人数（新老共同） */, SUM(CASE WHEN 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_ModeBasic_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_ModeBasic_cnt /* 自定义按钮点击人数（新老共同） */, SUM(CASE WHEN 24Newbie_m_ModeCitizensLeagues_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_24Newbie_m_ModeCitizensLeagues_cnt /* 全民赛事按钮点击人数（新老共同） */, SUM(CASE WHEN 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode03_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode03_cnt /* [老]乱斗按钮点击人数（老界面独有） */, SUM(CASE WHEN 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode39_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode39_cnt /* [老]MCGG按钮点击人数（老界面独有） */, SUM(CASE WHEN 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_Arcademode_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_Arcademode_cnt /* [老]娱乐大厅按钮点击人数（老界面独有） */, SUM(CASE WHEN 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_RecreationalMode_BigItem_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_RecreationalMode_BigItem_cnt /* [新]娱乐大图按钮点击人数（新界面独有，MCGG/乱序争锋） */, SUM(CASE WHEN 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_RecreationalMode_Item_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_RecreationalMode_Item_cnt /* [新]娱乐小图按钮点击人数（新界面独有，异序乱斗/1v1） */ /* 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode02_cnt_sum /* 排位赛按钮总点击次数（新老共同） */, SUM(24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode01_cnt) AS 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode01_cnt_sum /* 匹配按钮总点击次数（新老共同） */, 全民赛事按钮总点击次数（新老共同） */, SUM(24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode03_cnt) AS 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode03_cnt_sum /* [老]乱斗按钮总点击次数（老界面独有） */, SUM(24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode39_cnt) AS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_total_battle_cnt /* 总参战人数 */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvp1_battle_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_pvp1_battle_cnt /* pvptype=1  匹配参战人数 */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvp2_battle_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_pvp2_battle_cnt /* pvptype=2  排位赛参战人数 */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvp4_battle_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_pvp4_battle_cnt /* pvptype=4  大乱斗参战人数 */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvp5_battle_cnt > 0 THEN 1 name: 演员送分查询
sql_units: WITH abnormal_round /* -and r.accountid= */ /* -and r.enemyaccountid= */ AS (/* 1. 筛选出异常回合： */ /* round > 9 且 chessinfo 为空 */ SELECT r.accountid, r.zoneid, r.battleid, r.enemyaccountid, r.round, r.logymd FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundinfo AS r INNER JOIN mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS b ON r.accountid = b.accountid AND r.zoneid = b.zoneid AND r.battleid = b.battleid AND r.logymd = b.logymd WHERE b.pvptype = 39 AND r.round > 9 AND r.round < 21 AND r.enemyaccountid > 100 AND (r.chessinfo IS NULL OR TRIM(r.chessinfo) = '') AND r.logymd >= '{{day}}' AND b.logymd >= '{{day}}'), enemy_repeat AS (/* 2. 同一个 enemyaccountid 出现异常回合 >= 2 次 */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, enemyaccountid, COUNT(*) AS abnormal_round_count, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battle_count FROM abnormal_round GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, enemyaccountid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) > 2) /* 3. 最终结果 */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, enemyaccountid, abnormal_round_count, battle_count FROM enemy_repeat ORDER BY battle_count DESC, abnormal_round_count DESC

sql_units: WITH battle_10real /* Step 1: 候选对局 —— 仅 10 真人、模式/分区/日期过滤 */ /* and min (bigranklvl) <5 -- 10个人 */ AS (SELECT battleid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-06-24' AND '2025-07-30' AND pvptype IN (2, 1) /* 排位(2) + 匹配(1) */ AND fake_ai = 0 /* 仅真人 */ AND zoneid < 57000 AND battleid % 99 IN (1, 6, 9, 18, 39) GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(1) = 10 /* 恰好 10 人 */), battle_players /* Step 2: 对局玩家明细（含大段位用于后续过滤） */ AS (SELECT logymd, b.battleid, b.accountid AS roleid, b.zoneid, b.bigranklvl, b.pvptype, b.realpvptype, ab.param_value, ab.param_name, `是否25年5月之前注册`, IF(NOT lose.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_lose_7d, IF(2025_next_play_mode > 0, 1, 0) AS if_next_play_mode FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS b JOIN battle_10real AS t ON b.battleid = t.battleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(usercreateymd < '2025-05-01', 1, 0) AS `是否25年5月之前注册`, CASE WHEN LOWER(param_value) LIKE '%test%' THEN 'test' WHEN LOWER(param_value) LIKE '%control%' THEN 'control' ELSE 'else' END AS param_value, param_name FROM ml_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-06-23' AND '2025-07-30' AND param_name IN ('90_2025NextMapPlay')) AS ab ON b.accountid = ab.roleid AND b.zoneid = ab.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid /* 是否流失超过7天 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2025-06-23' AND lose_days >= 7) AS lose ON b.accountid = lose.roleid AND b.zoneid = lose.zoneid WHERE b.logymd BETWEEN '2025-06-24' AND '2025-07-30' AND b.pvptype IN (2, 1) AND b.fake_ai = 0 AND b.zoneid < 57000 AND b.battleid % 99 IN (1, 6, 9, 18, 39)), battle_agg /* Step 4: 对局级汇总 —— 验证全部条件 */ AS (SELECT logymd, bp.battleid, pvptype, realpvptype, MIN(bp.bigranklvl) AS min_ranklvl /* ① 10 人全部已进组，且均处于 90_2025NextMapPlay_test 组（即"必定都是新next玩法"） */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(`是否25年5月之前注册` = 1, bp.roleid || bp.zoneid, NULL)) AS `25年5月之前注册人数`, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(if_lose_7d = 1, bp.roleid || bp.zoneid, NULL)) AS cnt_lose_7d /* 7天内流失人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(bp.if_next_play_mode = 1, bp.roleid || bp.zoneid, NULL)) AS cnt_next_test /* ② 全员 test 组且开启 next 玩法的人数（=10 则满足"必定都是新next玩法"） */ /* ③ 对局前有 4080 检测记录的人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(bp.param_value = 'test', bp.roleid || bp.zoneid, NULL)) AS cnt_param_test /* 进入实验组人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(bp.param_value = 'control', bp.roleid || bp.zoneid, NULL)) AS cnt_param_control /* 进入对照组人数 */ FROM battle_players AS bp GROUP BY bp.battleid, logymd, pvptype, realpvptype) /* 最终输出，10个人都进组，增量满足、下载满足，且大段位都 >= 大师（min_ranklvl >= 3），是否全部为next玩法 */ SELECT min_ranklvl, pvptype, realpvptype, cnt_param_test, cnt_next_test, cnt_param_control, cnt_lose_7d, `25年5月之前注册人数`, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(cnt_next_test = 10, battleid, NULL)) AS battle_cnt_all_next_test FROM battle_agg GROUP BY min_ranklvl, pvptype, realpvptype, cnt_param_test, cnt_param_control, cnt_lose_7d, `25年5月之前注册人数`, cnt_next_test

name: s9
sql_units: WITH assist_t AS (SELECT 1 AS match_col, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY skinid) AS rank_hero_battle FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') SELECT a.*, hero_name AS `团战发起者`, CONCAT(FLOOR(start_time / 60), ':', ROUND(start_time % 60, 0)) AS start_times, CONCAT(FLOOR(end_time / 60), ':', ROUND(end_time % 60, 0)) AS end_times, end_time - start_time - 5 AS `团战持续时间`, CONCAT(FLOOR(battletime / 60000), ':', FLOOR(battletime / 60000) % 60) AS battle_times, fight_numa + fight_numb AS fight_nums, dead_numa + dead_numb AS dead_nums, CASE WHEN fight_numa + fight_numb = 2 THEN '单杀' WHEN fight_numa + fight_numb BETWEEN 8 AND 9 AND fight_numa >= 3 AND fight_numb >= 3 THEN '大团战' WHEN fight_numa + fight_numb BETWEEN 6 AND 7 AND fight_numa >= 3 AND fight_numb >= 3 THEN '小团战' WHEN fight_numa + fight_numb = 10 THEN '全面团战' ELSE 'gank' END AS `事件名称`, CASE WHEN dead_numa = 5 AND dead_numb < 5 THEN '蓝方团灭' WHEN dead_numa < 5 AND dead_numb = 5 THEN '红方团灭' WHEN dead_numa = 5 AND dead_numb = 5 THEN '双方团灭' WHEN dead_numa + dead_numb = 0 THEN '失败' ELSE ' ' END AS `团战结果`, CASE WHEN dead_numa < dead_numb THEN '蓝方优势' WHEN dead_numa > dead_numb THEN '红方优势' ELSE '均势' END AS `团战优势归属`, CASE WHEN dead_numa + dead_numb = 0 THEN '失败' ELSE '成功' END AS `事件结果` FROM (SELECT t.battleid, t.logymd, t.battletime, t.whichwin, maxbigranklvl, rank_hero_battle, SPLIT(t.start_hero, '\\073')[t1.rank_hero_battle - 1] AS start_hero, SPLIT(t.start_time, '\\073')[t1.rank_hero_battle - 1] AS start_time, SPLIT(t.end_time, '\\073')[t1.rank_hero_battle - 1] AS end_time, SPLIT(t.duration_time, '\\073')[t1.rank_hero_battle - 1] AS duration_time, SPLIT(t.fight_heroesa, '\\073')[t1.rank_hero_battle - 1] AS fight_heroesa, SPLIT(t.fight_heroesb, '\\073')[t1.rank_hero_battle - 1] AS fight_heroesb, SPLIT(t.fight_heronuma, '\\073')[t1.rank_hero_battle - 1] AS fight_numa, SPLIT(t.fight_heronumb, '\\073')[t1.rank_hero_battle - 1] AS fight_numb, SPLIT(t.dead_heroesa, '\\073')[t1.rank_hero_battle - 1] AS dead_heroesa, SPLIT(t.dead_heroesb, '\\073')[t1.rank_hero_battle - 1] AS dead_heroesb, SPLIT(t.dead_numa, '\\073')[t1.rank_hero_battle - 1] AS dead_numa, SPLIT(t.dead_numb, '\\073')[t1.rank_hero_battle - 1] AS dead_numb FROM (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_team_battle_event WHERE logymd = '2026-05-22' AND battleid = 769540592262723951 AND zoneid < 57000) AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.battleid, b.rank_hero_battle FROM (SELECT battleid, LENGTH(start_hero) - LENGTH(REPLACE(start_hero, '\\073', '')) AS leng, 1 AS match_col FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_team_battle_event WHERE logymd = '2026-05-22' AND zoneid < 57000) AS a LEFT JOIN assist_t AS b ON a.match_col = b.match_col AND a.leng >= b.rank_hero_battle) AS t1 ON t.battleid = t1.battleid) AS a LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_hero_config AS c ON a.start_hero = c.heroid

name: wmz_temp_SQL_Three
sql_units: /* 玩家在不同模式的战斗场次/胜场。加rankid（前N赛季、当前、历史最高） */ /* 2026年2月26日14:57:14 增加60/90/180/365天的场次和胜场 */ WITH a AS (/* 创号日期 更新 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, first_ad_country, new_type, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '${DATE}' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND roleid = 8428066 AND zoneid = 2010), c AS (/* 当前等级 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_level AS `level`, his_last_active_date, FLOOR(his_last_device_total_memory / 1024) AS his_last_device_total_memory FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df AS c WHERE c.logymd = '${DATE}' AND roleid = 8428066 AND zoneid = 2010), rank_config AS (SELECT rankid, minrank, CASE WHEN minrank = 31 THEN '荣耀神话' WHEN minrank = 26 THEN '神话V' WHEN minrank = 27 THEN '神话IV' WHEN minrank = 28 THEN '神话III' WHEN minrank = 29 THEN '神话II' WHEN minrank = 30 THEN '神话I' ELSE bigrank_name END AS mindw FROM mt_dim.dim_ranked_config_df WHERE logymd = '${DATE}' GROUP BY minrank, mindw, rankid), his_rank AS (/* 生涯最高小段位 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_max_rank_id, his_max_minranklvl AS battle_minranklvl, b.mindw AS his_max_mindw FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df AS a LEFT JOIN rank_config AS b ON a.his_max_rank_id = b.rankid WHERE logymd = '${DATE}' AND pvptype = 2 AND roleid = 8428066 AND zoneid = 2010), ss_config AS (SELECT season, IF(ss_end >= '${DATE}', '${DATE}', ss_end) AS ss_end /* 包含本赛季 */ FROM (SELECT season, SUBSTRING(season_starttime, 1, 10) AS ss_start, SUBSTRING(season_endtime, 1, 10) AS ss_end, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(season_endtime, 1, 10) DESC) AS ss_rn FROM mt_dim.dim_season_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_season_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01' AND SUBSTRING(season_starttime, 1, 10) <= '${DATE}' /* 含当天的前三个赛季 */) WHERE ss_rn <= 3), last3ss_rk AS (/* 含当赛季的近三赛季段位,聚合为数组 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(season || ':' || ss_max_rankid || ',' || ss_max_mindw)) AS last3ss_rk_info FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, '第' || cur_season || '赛季' AS season, ss_max_rankid AS ss_max_rankid, b.mindw AS ss_max_mindw FROM mt_dm.dm_season_battle_role_zone_df AS j LEFT JOIN rank_config AS b ON j.ss_max_rankid = b.rankid WHERE j.logymd IN (SELECT DISTINCT ss_end FROM ss_config UNION ALL SELECT '${DATE+9999}') AND j.logymd >= DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 250 * -1) AND roleid = 8428066 AND zoneid = 2010) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), bt AS (/* 过去14天/30天每个模式战斗场次,并且按照pvptype排序聚合为数组 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, STR_TO_MAP(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(COLLECT_LIST(pvptype || ':' || his_battle_cnt_14 || '-' || his_win_cnt_14 || '-' || his_battle_cnt_30 || '-' || his_win_cnt_30 || '-' || his_battle_cnt_60 || '-' || his_win_cnt_60 || '-' || his_battle_cnt_90 || '-' || his_win_cnt_90 || '-' || his_battle_cnt_180 || '-' || his_win_cnt_180 || '-' || his_battle_cnt_365 || '-' || his_win_cnt_365) AS STRING), '[', ''), ']', ''), ', ', ':') AS battle_info_14d_30d /* 实际也包含60/90/180/365天的场次和胜场 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, SUM(IF(logymd = '${DATE}', his_battle_cnt, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 14 * -1), his_battle_cnt, 0)) AS his_battle_cnt_14, SUM(IF(logymd = '${DATE}', his_win_cnt, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 14 * -1), his_win_cnt, 0)) AS his_win_cnt_14, SUM(IF(logymd = '${DATE}', his_battle_cnt, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 30 * -1), his_battle_cnt, 0)) AS his_battle_cnt_30, SUM(IF(logymd = '${DATE}', his_win_cnt, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 30 * -1), his_win_cnt, 0)) AS his_win_cnt_30, SUM(IF(logymd = '${DATE}', his_battle_cnt, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 60 * -1), his_battle_cnt, 0)) AS his_battle_cnt_60, SUM(IF(logymd = '${DATE}', his_win_cnt, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 60 * -1), his_win_cnt, 0)) AS his_win_cnt_60, SUM(IF(logymd = '${DATE}', his_battle_cnt, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 90 * -1), his_battle_cnt, 0)) AS his_battle_cnt_90, SUM(IF(logymd = '${DATE}', his_win_cnt, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 90 * -1), his_win_cnt, 0)) AS his_win_cnt_90, SUM(IF(logymd = '${DATE}', his_battle_cnt, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 180 * -1), his_battle_cnt, 0)) AS his_battle_cnt_180, SUM(IF(logymd = '${DATE}', his_win_cnt, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 180 * -1), his_win_cnt, 0)) AS his_win_cnt_180, SUM(IF(logymd = '${DATE}', his_battle_cnt, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 365 * -1), his_battle_cnt, 0)) AS his_battle_cnt_365, SUM(IF(logymd = '${DATE}', his_win_cnt, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 365 * -1), his_win_cnt, 0)) AS his_win_cnt_365 FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_df WHERE logymd IN (DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 14 * -1), DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 30 * -1), '${DATE}', DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 60 * -1), DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 90 * -1), DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 180 * -1), DATE_ADD('${DATE}', 365 * -1)) AND roleid = 8428066 AND zoneid = 2010 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype) AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.register_date, a.first_ad_country, a.new_type, a.logymd, his_rank.his_max_rank_id, his_rank.his_max_mindw, last3ss_rk.last3ss_rk_info, bt.battle_info_14d_30d FROM a LEFT JOIN c ON c.roleid = a.roleid AND c.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN his_rank ON a.roleid = his_rank.roleid AND a.zoneid = his_rank.zoneid LEFT JOIN last3ss_rk ON a.roleid = last3ss_rk.roleid AND a.zoneid = last3ss_rk.zoneid LEFT JOIN bt ON a.roleid = bt.roleid AND a.zoneid = bt.zoneid WHERE a.logymd = '${DATE}' AND c.his_last_active_date >= DATE_ADD('${DATE}', -540)

sql_units: WITH dim_register_ts AS (/* 今日登入的 mcgg */ SELECT h1.logymd, h1.roleid, h1.zoneid, h1.deviceid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login AS h1 WHERE h1.logymd = '${DATE}' AND h1.usercreateymd = '${DATE}' AND h1.zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND h1.fake_ai = 0 AND h1.is_vp = 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mcgg_temp.kyra_black_role_df AS h2 WHERE h2.logymd = '${DATE}' AND h2.roleid = h1.roleid AND h2.zoneid = h1.zoneid) GROUP BY h1.logymd, h1.roleid, h1.zoneid, h1.deviceid), mcgg_newplayer_source AS (/* 当天创角的 mcgg 新增 + 染色滞后分桶 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, mc_first_network_name, ml_first_dye_date_7d, CASE WHEN ml_first_dye_date_7d IS NULL THEN '未染色' WHEN DATEDIFF(mc_register_date, ml_first_dye_date_7d) <= 0 THEN '当日染色新增' WHEN DATEDIFF(mc_register_date, ml_first_dye_date_7d) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN '7日内染色新增' ELSE '7天+' END AS dye_to_create_lag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY ml_first_dye_date_7d) AS rk FROM ml_temp.yanlh_mcgg_newplayer_source WHERE logymd = '${DATE}' AND mc_register_date = '${DATE}'), classified AS (SELECT r.logymd, r.roleid, r.zoneid, r.deviceid, COALESCE(s.dye_to_create_lag, '未知') AS dye_to_create_lag, COALESCE(s.mc_first_network_name, '未知') AS mc_first_network_name, COALESCE(m.user_source, '未分类') AS user_source /* 用字典表把"渠道名"翻译成"用户来源"（自然量 / 效果广告 / ML导量 / 未分类） */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.deviceid ORDER BY s.dye_to_create_lag) AS rk FROM dim_register_ts AS r LEFT JOIN (/* 当天创角的 mcgg 新增 + 染色滞后分桶 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, mc_first_network_name, ml_first_dye_date_7d, dye_to_create_lag FROM mcgg_newplayer_source WHERE rk = 1 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, mc_first_network_name, ml_first_dye_date_7d, dye_to_create_lag) AS s ON r.roleid = s.roleid AND r.zoneid = s.zoneid LEFT JOIN ml_temp.yanlh_mcgg_source_channel_map AS m ON s.mc_first_network_name = m.media_channel) SELECT logymd, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid) AS login_uid_cnt /* ====== 用户维度（roleid + zoneid） ====== */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag IN ('当日染色新增', '7日内染色新增'), roleid || zoneid, NULL)) AS dye_total_uid /* 染色总新增(人数) */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag = '7日内染色新增', roleid || zoneid, NULL)) AS dye7_uid /* 7日内染色新增 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag = '当日染色新增', roleid || zoneid, NULL)) AS dye_today_uid /* 当日染色新增 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag = '未染色', roleid || zoneid, NULL)) AS not_dye_uid /* 其他总新增 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag = '未染色' AND user_source = '效果广告', roleid || zoneid, NULL)) AS market_paid_uid /* 市场买量新增 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag IN ('当日染色新增', '7日内染色新增') AND user_source = '效果广告', roleid || zoneid, NULL)) AS market_ml_overlap_uid /* 市场买量+ml导量重叠部分用户 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag = '未染色' AND user_source = '自然量', roleid || zoneid, NULL)) AS organic_uid /* 市场自然量新增 */, COUNT(DISTINCT deviceid) AS login_dev_cnt /* ====== 设备维度（deviceid） ====== */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag IN ('当日染色新增', '7日内染色新增') AND rk = 1, deviceid, NULL)) AS dye_total_dev, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag = '7日内染色新增' AND rk = 1, deviceid, NULL)) AS dye7_dev, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag = '当日染色新增' AND rk = 1, deviceid, NULL)) AS dye_today_dev, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag = '未染色' AND rk = 1, deviceid, NULL)) AS not_dye_dev, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag = '未染色' AND rk = 1 AND user_source = '效果广告', deviceid, NULL)) AS market_paid_dev, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag IN ('当日染色新增', '7日内染色新增') AND rk = 1 AND user_source = '效果广告', deviceid, NULL)) AS market_ml_overlap_dev, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(dye_to_create_lag = '未染色' AND rk = 1 AND user_source = '自然量', deviceid, NULL)) AS organic_dev FROM classified GROUP BY logymd

name: hutuxiao_battle_all
sql_units: SELECT b.logymd AS t, c.param_value /*   date_trunc('hour', b.time) AS t, */, AVG(IF(smallreconnect_num / (battletime / 600) <= 1, 1, 0) + IF(b.movelag / (battletime / 600) <= 4, 1, 0) + IF((ping80 / ping_times) >= 0.95, 1, 0)) AS net_sc, COUNT(*) AS num, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS player, AVG(timedelay) AS ping, AVG(b.movelag / (battletime / 600)) AS mlag_per10min, AVG(skilllag / (battletime / 600)) AS slag_per10min /* avg(incominglagnum) as movelag2, */, SUM(IF(movelag / (battletime / 600) <= 4, 1, 0)) / COUNT(*) AS mlag_rate, AVG(smallreconnect_num / (battletime / 600)) AS small_per10min, SUM(bytesc2s / (battletime / 60)) /* avg(reconnectnum)recs, */ / COUNT(*) AS `上行每分钟字节`, SUM(bytess2c / (battletime / 60)) / COUNT(*) AS `下行每分钟字节`, SUM(packetsc2s / (battletime / 60)) / COUNT(*) AS `上行每分钟包`, SUM(packetss2c / (battletime / 60)) / COUNT(*) AS `下行每分钟包`, SUM(bytess2c) / SUM(packetss2c) AS `每个包下行大小`, SUM(bytesc2s) / SUM(packetsc2s) AS `每个包上行大小`, COUNT(IF(use_udp = 10, 1, NULL)) / COUNT(1) AS udp_per, AVG(COALESCE(lostrequestnum, 0) / (battletime / 60)) AS lostrequest_permin, AVG(COALESCE(netframelag, 0) / (battletime / 60)) AS netframelag_permin, AVG(stdping) AS stdping, AVG(reconnectnum) AS reconnectnum, AVG(bigreconnect_num) AS bigreconnect_num, AVG(operate800) AS operate800 /* avg(operate350) operate350, */ /* avg(Operate450) Operate450, */, AVG(maxdelay) AS maxdelay, (ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ((ping120 + ping150 + ping200 + ping300 + ping500 + ping800) / ping_times) <= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 3)) AS new /* avg(pingjump_15) pingjump_15, */ /* avg(pingjump_30) pingjump_30, */ /* avg(pingjump_60) pingjump_60, */ /* avg(pingjump_100) pingjump_100, */ /* avg(pingjump_200) pingjump_200, */ /* avg(pingjump_2000) pingjump_2000, */ /* avg(TcpFrameNum) TcpFrameNum, */ /* avg(UdpFrameNum) UdpFrameNum, */ /* avg(normal_reconn_num) as normal_reconn_num, */ /* avg(bp_big_reconn_num) as bp_big_reconn_num, */ /* avg(bp_small_reconn_num) as bp_small_reconn_num, */ /* avg(loading_big_reconn_num) as loading_big_reconn_num, */ /* avg(loading_small_reconn_num) as loading_small_reconn_num, */ /* avg(play_big_reconn_num) as play_big_reconn_num, */ /* avg(play_small_reconn_num) as play_small_reconn_num, */ FROM (/* 代替 QUALIFY：先算 rn，再 WHERE rn=1 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, param_value FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, param_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, param_value ORDER BY logymd, time) AS rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE logymd >= '2026-04-30' AND param_value <> '' AND /*   AND param_value <> '__MTTD_INTERNAL_LONG_OBSERVE_GROUP__' */ /*   AND zoneid BETWEEN 57061 AND 57999 */ /* AND (zoneid BETWEEN 3231 AND 3850 or zoneid BETWEEN 2001 AND 2250) */ zoneid BETWEEN 16300 AND 17270 AND param_name = '60_netoptimize_3') AS t0 WHERE rn = 1) AS c JOIN (SELECT be.accountid, be.zoneid, be.logymd, be.timedelay, be.maxdelay, be.isvalid, be.pvptype, be.battlesvrid, be.battleid, be.battletime, be.smallreconnect_num, be.movelag, be.skilllag, be.ping80, be.ping_times, be.ping120, be.ping150, be.ping200, be.ping300, be.ping500, be.ping800, be.bytesc2s, be.bytess2c, be.packetsc2s, be.packetss2c, be.time, be.stdping, be.Operate350, be.Operate450, be.operate800, be.use_udp, be.reconnectnum, be.bigreconnect_num, be.normal_reconn_num, be.bp_big_reconn_num, name: BP付费对战局数
sql_units: /* 第一步：9月-11月所有登录玩家（作为基础人群） */ WITH base_all_players AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2025-11-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND NOT LOWER(createrole_country) IN ('hk', 'cn')), base_payers /* 第二步：9月-11月付费玩家及分R */ AS (SELECT roleid, SUM(money) AS total_money, CASE WHEN SUM(money) <= 100 THEN '微R' WHEN SUM(money) <= 200 THEN '小R' WHEN SUM(money) <= 2000 THEN '中小R' WHEN SUM(money) <= 10000 THEN '中R' WHEN SUM(money) <= 20000 THEN '大R' ELSE '超R' END AS r_level FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2025-11-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND NOT createrole_country IN ('HK', 'CN') AND money > 0 GROUP BY roleid), base_players /* 第三步：合并所有玩家（非R + 各R层） */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, CASE WHEN p.roleid IS NULL THEN '非R' ELSE p.r_level END AS r_level FROM base_all_players AS a LEFT JOIN base_payers AS p ON a.roleid = p.roleid), jan_active /* 第四步：1月活跃情况（是否登录） */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, 1 AS is_active FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND NOT LOWER(createrole_country) IN ('hk', 'cn')), jan_battle /* 第五步：1月对局数统计 */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battle_cnt FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND camprank <> 0 AND pvptype = '39' GROUP BY accountid), base_level_stats /* 第六步：按分层汇总 */ AS (SELECT f.r_level, COUNT(DISTINCT f.roleid) AS total_users_base, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active = 1 THEN f.roleid END) AS active_users_jan, SUM(COALESCE(b.battle_cnt, 0)) AS total_battles_jan, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(b.battle_cnt, 0)), 2) AS avg_battles_per_user FROM base_players AS f LEFT JOIN jan_active AS a ON f.roleid = a.roleid LEFT JOIN jan_battle AS b ON f.roleid = b.roleid GROUP BY f.r_level) /* 第七步：最终输出 */ SELECT r_level AS 付费分层, total_users_base AS 基准期活跃人数, active_users_jan AS 一月活跃人数, ROUND(active_users_jan * 100.0 / total_users_base, 2) AS 一月活跃率, total_battles_jan AS 一月总对局数, avg_battles_per_user AS 一月人均对局数 FROM base_level_stats ORDER BY CASE r_level WHEN '非R' THEN 1 WHEN '微R' THEN 2 WHEN '小R' THEN 3 WHEN '中小R' THEN 4 WHEN '中R' THEN 5 WHEN '大R' THEN 6 WHEN '超R' THEN 7 END
