name: 抽奖体验_不同代币连续分布
output_hint: 抽奖体验_不同代币连续分布
sql_units: /* ============================================================================ */ /* 抽奖体验监控 · 整活动连续同档代币 streak 长度分布表（5/8/10/12/15/20） */ /* 表名：ml_temp.terryyang_lottery_streak_dist_di */ /* 粒度：(activity, test_group, r_label, crest_value, streak_len) */ /* 分区：(logymd, actid) */ /* 用途：覆盖整个活动期间所有长度 ≥1 的连续「同档代币」streak 的出现分布 */ /*       监控档位：crest_value ∈ {5, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20} */ /*       streak 定义：相邻 total_draw_num 上 single_draw_crest 取值完全相同的连段 */ /*       （遇到任何与当前值不同的抽数即结束 streak，含目标档之间互相切换） */ /*       与 BI 主底表中的「截至桶末最长 streak」（按桶聚合）形成互补 */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* 输入参数（参数命名 / 含义同 lottery_user_exp_bucket_intermediate.sql）： */ /* [ */ /*     {"order": 1, "name": "activity_name",       "paramValue": "26年斋月SP抽奖",         "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 2, "name": "act_id_num",          "paramValue": "2601280303",             "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 3, "name": "user_enter_time",     "paramValue": "2026-02-18",             "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 4, "name": "activity_start_time", "paramValue": "2026-02-20",             "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 5, "name": "groups_id",           "paramValue": "3022,3023,3024,3025",    "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 6, "name": "control_group_id",    "paramValue": "3022",                   "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 7, "name": "item_id",             "paramValue": "27043",                  "type": "task_custom"} */ /* ] */ /* 2026-05-10 = 当日跑数日期，由调度系统注入 */ /* ⚠️ 与 lottery_user_exp_bucket_intermediate.sql 内的 ★ 标注同步更新： */ /*   1) ★param_name_map★    实验组 param_version → 中文名 CASE WHEN */ /*   2) ★bonus_reward_map★  抽数特殊奖励 CASE WHEN（默认全 0） */ /* 关键差异（与 BI 主底表 max_consec5_to_bucket 区分）： */ /*   主底表（按桶）：每用户每桶只统计「最长」的那条 streak */ /*   本表（按 streak）：每条 streak 都统计一次，且不分 ten_round */ /*   场景：要画「整个活动 streak 长度直方图」用本表；要监控按桶的体验趋势用主底表 */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* DDL：仅首次部署执行一次（⚠️ 相比旧版新增 crest_value 字段，需 DROP/重建） */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ml_temp.lottery_streak_dist_di ( */ /*             activity_name   STRING, */ /*             test_group      BIGINT COMMENT 'ABTest param_version', */ /*             test_group_name STRING COMMENT '实验组中文名', */ /*             is_control      INT, */ /*             r_label         STRING COMMENT '前 3 个月日均耗钻分层', */ /*             crest_value     BIGINT COMMENT '代币档位（监控值 ∈ {5,8,10,12,15,20}）', */ /*             streak_len      BIGINT COMMENT '连续同档代币 streak 长度（≥1）', */ /*             streak_count    BIGINT COMMENT '该(档位,长度)的 streak 出现次数（streak 粒度计数）', */ /*             user_count      BIGINT COMMENT '至少出现过一次该(档位,长度) streak 的用户数（用户粒度去重）' */ /*         ) */ /*         PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING, actid STRING) STORED AS parquet */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* 每日例行写入 */ /* ============================================================================ */ WITH draw_detail /* 1. 抽奖明细：每行 = 一抽事件（与中间表完全一致的口径） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, total_draw_num, logymd, (CASE WHEN total_draw_num = 160 THEN 0 WHEN total_draw_num = 190 THEN 0 ELSE 0 END /* ★bonus_reward_map★ 抽数特殊奖励（默认全 0，每期按需更新） */ + CAST(IF(reward LIKE '%{{item_id}}%', SUBSTRING(SPLIT(reward, ':')[1], 1, INT(LENGTH(SPLIT(reward, ':')[1]) - 1)), is_tranfer) AS BIGINT)) AS single_draw_crest FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_surpriselottery WHERE logymd BETWEEN '{{activity_start_time}}' AND '${DATE}' AND act_id = '{{act_id_num}}' AND zoneid < 57000 AND bonus = 0 AND draw_num > 0 AND ((CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 2001 AND 3999) OR (CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 8001 AND 19999))), ab_test /* 2. ABTest 实验组（★param_name_map★ 每期更新） */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT accountid AS roleid, param_version, CASE WHEN param_version = 3022 THEN '对照组' WHEN param_version = 3023 THEN '实时模型' WHEN param_version = 3024 THEN '实时模型+每日惊喜抽奖券' WHEN param_version = 3025 THEN '实时模型（兜底）' ELSE '其他' END AS test_group_name FROM ml_ods.abtestserver_abtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '{{user_enter_time}}' AND '${DATE}' AND param_version IN (3022, 3023, 3024, 3025)), r_label_t /* 3. 用户耗钻分层（活动前 3 个月） */ AS (SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 > 0 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 2 THEN '1.(0,2)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 2 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 5 THEN '2.[2,5)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 5 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 10 THEN '3.[5,10)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 10 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 20 THEN '4.[10,20)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 20 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 30 THEN '5.[20,30)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 30 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 50 THEN '6.[30,50)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 50 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 100 THEN '7.[50,100)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 100 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 200 THEN '8.[100,200)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 200 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 500 THEN '9.[200,500)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 500 THEN '10.[500+)' ELSE '0' END AS r_label FROM (SELECT roleid, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num_sum FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('{{activity_start_time}}', 91 * -1) AND DATE_ADD('{{activity_start_time}}', 1 * -1) AND NOT operate IN ('gm') AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid)), consec_flag /* 4. 连续同档代币 streak（监控档位 ∈ {5,8,10,12,15,20}） */ /*    起始判定：当前为目标档 且 上一抽 single_draw_crest <> 当前值（或为首抽） */ /*    这样目标档之间互相切换（如 5→8）会被切成两条 streak， */ /*    目标档与非目标档（如 5→3）切换也会切，符合「同档连续」语义 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, total_draw_num, single_draw_crest, CASE WHEN single_draw_crest IN (5, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_target, CASE WHEN single_draw_crest IN (5, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20) AND (LAG(single_draw_crest) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY total_draw_num) <> single_draw_crest OR LAG(single_draw_crest) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY total_draw_num) IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS start_flag FROM draw_detail), consec_grp AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, total_draw_num, single_draw_crest, is_target, CASE WHEN is_target = 1 THEN SUM(start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY total_draw_num) END AS grp_id FROM consec_flag), consec_streak /* 每条 streak 一行（同一 grp_id 内 single_draw_crest 必然相同，可直接 MAX） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, grp_id, MAX(single_draw_crest) AS crest_value, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM consec_grp WHERE is_target = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, grp_id), streak_with_dim /* 5. streak × 实验组 / 分层 */ /*    带 grp_id 透传，确保下游聚合不会因 (roleid,zoneid,crest_value,streak_len) 重复值被意外去重 */ AS (SELECT ab.param_version AS test_group, ab.test_group_name AS test_group_name, IF(ab.param_version = '{{control_group_id}}', 1, 0) AS is_control, COALESCE(rl.r_label, '0') AS r_label, s.roleid, s.zoneid, s.grp_id, s.crest_value, s.streak_len FROM consec_streak AS s INNER JOIN ab_test AS ab ON s.roleid = ab.roleid LEFT JOIN r_label_t AS rl ON s.roleid = rl.roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.lottery_streak_dist_di PARTITION(logymd = '${DATE}', actid = '{{act_id_num}}') /* 6. 按 (维度, crest_value, streak_len) 聚合：streak 次数 + 用户数 */ SELECT '{{activity_name}}' AS activity_name, test_group, test_group_name, is_control, r_label, crest_value, streak_len, COUNT(*) AS streak_count, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid) AS user_count FROM streak_with_dim GROUP BY test_group, test_group_name, is_control, r_label, crest_value, streak_len

sql_units: WITH battle_10real /* Step 1: 候选对局 —— 仅 10 真人、模式/分区/日期过滤 */ AS (SELECT battleid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-26' AND '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (2, 1) /* 排位(2) + 匹配(1) */ AND fake_ai = 0 /* 仅真人 */ AND zoneid >= 57000 /* 测服 */ GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(1) = 10 /* 恰好 10 人 */ AND MIN(bigranklvl) >= 3 /* 10个人都是大师及以上 */), battle_players /* Step 2: 对局玩家明细（含大段位用于后续过滤） */ AS (SELECT logymd, b.battleid, b.accountid AS roleid, b.zoneid, b.bigranklvl, b.pvptype, b.realpvptype FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS b JOIN battle_10real AS t ON b.battleid = t.battleid WHERE b.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-26' AND '2026-05-30' AND b.pvptype IN (2, 1) AND b.fake_ai = 0 AND b.zoneid >= 57000), next_with_4080 /* Step 3: next_play_mode 进组记录 */ /*   + 关联 4080 资源包检测（仅取对局开始时间之前的上报记录） */ AS (SELECT n.battleid, n.accountid AS roleid, n.zoneid, n.matchtag, n.time AS battle_start_time, ab.param_value, ab.param_name, MAX(IF(r.time < n.time AND (r.finish_module_str LIKE '%' || CHR(59) || '4080' || CHR(59) || '%' OR r.finish_module_str LIKE '4080' || CHR(59) || '%'), 1, 0)) AS has_4080_before_battle /* 对局开始前是否上报了 4080 资源包 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_next_play_mode AS n JOIN battle_10real AS t ON n.battleid = t.battleid LEFT JOIN ml_ods.connserver_client_resreport_checking AS r ON n.accountid = r.accountid AND n.zoneid = r.zoneid AND r.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-26' AND '2026-05-30' AND r.zoneid >= 57000 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, param_value, param_name FROM ml_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-30' AND param_name IN ('s57_84_2026NextMapPlay')) AS ab ON n.accountid = ab.roleid AND n.zoneid = ab.zoneid WHERE n.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-26' AND '2026-05-30' AND n.pvptype IN (2, 1) AND n.zoneid >= 57000 GROUP BY n.battleid, n.accountid, n.zoneid, n.matchtag, n.time, ab.param_value, ab.param_name) SELECT t.* FROM next_with_4080 AS t JOIN (SELECT battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid) AS player_num, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(param_value = 'test', roleid || zoneid, NULL)) AS test_player_num, MAX(IF(param_value = 'test', 1, 0)) AS if_exist_test, MAX(IF(param_value = 'control', 1, 0)) AS if_exist_control, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(matchtag = 's57_84_2026NextMapPlay_test', roleid || zoneid, NULL)) AS cnt_next_test FROM next_with_4080 GROUP BY battleid) AS t1 ON t.battleid = t1.battleid /* where t1.if_exist_test = 1 and t1.if_exist_control = 0 -- 存在test组但不存在control组的对局 */ /* and has_4080_before_battle = 1 -- 只看增量下载完毕的 */ WHERE test_player_num = 0 AND cnt_next_test = 10 ORDER BY t.battleid ASC

sql_units: WITH battle_base /* ① battle 基础信息 */ /* and pvptype=500 */ /* and zoneid= */ /* and battleid=392591752438539930 */ AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, logymd, battleid, pvptype, level, commander_id, md5error FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd >= '{{day}}' AND accountid = 3965163), round_detail /* ② round 明细 */ AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, logymd, battleid, round, enemyaccountid, roundbegingold, round_population, buildgold, chessinfo, relationinfo, roundgoldgain, roundgolduse FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundinfo WHERE logymd >= '{{day}}'), hero_stat /* ③ 每场 battle 的 3 星英雄统计 */ AS (SELECT accountid, battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN chessprice = 5 AND chessstarlevel = 3 THEN chessid END) AS three_star_5_fee, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN chessprice = 4 AND chessstarlevel = 3 THEN chessid END) AS three_star_4_fee FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundheroinfo WHERE logymd >= '{{day}}' GROUP BY accountid, battleid) /* ④ 最终结果 */ SELECT b.accountid, r.zoneid, b.logymd, b.battleid, b.pvptype, b.level, b.md5error, r.round, r.enemyaccountid, r.roundbegingold, r.round_population, COALESCE(h.three_star_4_fee, 0) AS three_star_4_fee, COALESCE(h.three_star_5_fee, 0) AS three_star_5_fee, r.roundgoldgain, r.roundgolduse, r.buildgold, r.chessinfo, r.relationinfo, b.commander_id FROM battle_base AS b LEFT JOIN round_detail AS r ON b.accountid = r.accountid AND b.battleid = r.battleid AND b.logymd = r.logymd LEFT JOIN hero_stat AS h ON b.accountid = h.accountid AND b.battleid = h.battleid ORDER BY b.accountid, b.battleid, r.round

name: 商业化_付费皮肤渗透看板数据调度

sql_units: /* 最终聚合：4维 GROUP BY；皮肤等级透视为列(拥有数/当月获取各1列) */ /* 列顺序须与 01_建表.sql 一致 */ /* 各月付费档位皮肤拥有数看板 · 聚合取数（月调度） */ /* 主表: 本月活跃用户(dm_multi_active_role_zone_di 当月日分区去重) */ /* 付费: gameserver_charge 当月有效收入，8档(左闭右开，50+封顶) */ /* 历史付费分层: 日活表 charge_amt_total，旧8档边界 */ /* 皮肤: dwm_resource_role_zone_df 永久皮快照(time_len=0)，首次获得≤月末 */ /* 输出: 4维透视宽表(付费档×历史档×注册时长×国家)，每皮肤等级2列(拥有数/当月获取) */ /* 参数: ${DATE-1} = 统计月最后一天(如 '2026-04-30')，手动选月初传入→系统自动-1天 */ WITH base AS (/* 本月活跃玩家去重，带注册时长和历史付费 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(create_date) AS create_date, MAX(create_country) AS create_country, MAX(charge_amt_total) / 100.0 AS his_charge_amt /* 美元；charge_amt_total 单位美分，取月内最大值即月末累计 */, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days /* 当月活跃天数(本月出现的不同日分区数) */ FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_active_role_zone_di WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('${DATE-1}', 1, 7) AND logymd <= '${DATE-1}' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), month_charge AS (/* 当月有效付费金额(美元)，含盗刷/礼品卡过滤 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money * 1.00 / 100) AS month_charge_amt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('${DATE-1}', 1, 7) AND logymd <= '${DATE-1}' AND zoneid < 57000 AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 /* 代币购买(2020-04-21起) */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* 排盗刷；保留点卡(receipt_id=0) */ AND money <> 0 /* 排 GP 礼品卡 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* 排 GP 礼品卡促销 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), own AS (/* 月末时点永久皮明细(首次获得日期≤月末) */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, resource_id AS skinid, SUBSTRING(CAST(his_first_get_time AS STRING), 1, 10) AS first_get_date /* yyyy-mm-dd */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_df /* WHERE  logymd         = '${DATE-1}' */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' /* -！！！！！！！！！！！先取最新的分区，后续同步换回配置 */ AND resource_type = 'skin' AND time_len = 0 AND zoneid < 57000 AND SUBSTRING(CAST(his_first_get_time AS STRING), 1, 10) <= '${DATE-1}'), lvl AS (/* 皮肤等级配置；collector/Collectoryhzg 统一为 Collector */ SELECT skinid, CASE WHEN skinlevel IN ('collector', 'Collectoryhzg') THEN 'Collector' ELSE skinlevel END AS skinlevel FROM ml_temp.leolv_skin_level_20260311_v2), detail AS (/* 玩家×皮肤明细；无皮玩家保留一行(skinid/skinlevel 为 NULL) */ SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, CASE WHEN m.month_charge_amt IS NULL OR m.month_charge_amt <= 0 THEN '0_free' WHEN m.month_charge_amt >= 50 THEN '7_50+' WHEN m.month_charge_amt >= 20 THEN '6_[20,50)' WHEN m.month_charge_amt >= 10 THEN '5_[10,20)' WHEN m.month_charge_amt >= 5 THEN '4_[5,10)' WHEN m.month_charge_amt >= 2 THEN '3_[2,5)' WHEN m.month_charge_amt >= 1 THEN '2_[1,2)' ELSE '1_[0.01,1)' END AS charge_tier /* 当月付费档位(8档，左闭右开，美元) */, CASE WHEN b.his_charge_amt IS NULL OR b.his_charge_amt <= 0 THEN '0_free' WHEN b.his_charge_amt >= 2000 THEN '7_[2000,)' WHEN b.his_charge_amt >= 200 THEN '6_[200,2000)' WHEN b.his_charge_amt >= 20 THEN '5_[20,200)' WHEN b.his_charge_amt >= 10 THEN '4_[10,20)' WHEN b.his_charge_amt >= 5 THEN '3_[5,10)' WHEN b.his_charge_amt >= 2 THEN '2_[2,5)' ELSE '1_(0,2)' END AS his_charge_tier /* 历史累计付费分层(旧8档边界，美元，来自日活表) */, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('${DATE-1}', b.create_date) >= 1720 THEN '10_5年以上' WHEN DATEDIFF('${DATE-1}', b.create_date) >= 1360 THEN '09_4~5年' WHEN DATEDIFF('${DATE-1}', b.create_date) >= 1000 THEN '08_3~4年' WHEN DATEDIFF('${DATE-1}', b.create_date) >= 720 THEN '07_2~3年' WHEN DATEDIFF('${DATE-1}', b.create_date) >= 360 THEN '06_1~2年' WHEN DATEDIFF('${DATE-1}', b.create_date) >= 180 THEN '05_半年~1年' WHEN DATEDIFF('${DATE-1}', b.create_date) >= 90 THEN '04_90-179天' WHEN DATEDIFF('${DATE-1}', b.create_date) >= 30 THEN '03_30-89天' WHEN DATEDIFF('${DATE-1}', b.create_date) >= 1 THEN '02_1-29天(新用户)' WHEN DATEDIFF('${DATE-1}', b.create_date) = 0 THEN '01_0天(当日新增)' ELSE '11_qita' END AS retention_create_type /* 注册时长分桶(11档，截至月末) */, CASE WHEN UPPER(b.create_country) IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MY', 'RU', 'JP', 'MM', 'TR', 'KH', 'SG', 'BR') THEN UPPER(b.create_country) ELSE '其他' END AS create_country /* 区域国家(保留10国，其余归"其他") */, CASE WHEN b.active_days >= 20 THEN '3_高活(20+)' WHEN b.active_days >= 10 THEN '2_中活(10-19)' ELSE '1_低活(1-9)' END AS active_level /* 当月活跃度(按当月活跃天数拆高中低活) */, o.skinid, l.skinlevel, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(o.first_get_date, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('${DATE-1}', 1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new /* 预算当月新增标志，避免最终 SELECT 中重复计算 substr 判断 */ FROM base AS b LEFT JOIN month_charge AS m ON b.roleid = m.roleid AND b.zoneid = m.zoneid LEFT JOIN own AS o ON b.roleid = o.roleid AND b.zoneid = o.zoneid LEFT JOIN lvl AS l ON o.skinid = l.skinid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.vb_pay_skin_dashboard_mi_V3 PARTITION(logymd = '${DATE-1}') SELECT charge_tier, his_charge_tier, retention_create_type, create_country, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid) AS user_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel IS NULL THEN skinid END) AS skin_null, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel IS NULL AND is_new = 1 THEN skinid END) AS skin_null_new, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'A' THEN skinid END) AS skin_a, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'A' AND is_new = 1 THEN skinid END) AS skin_a_new, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'A+' THEN skinid END) AS skin_aplus, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'A+' AND is_new = 1 THEN skinid END) AS skin_aplus_new, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'B' THEN skinid END) AS skin_b, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'B' AND is_new = 1 THEN skinid END) AS skin_b_new, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'Collector' THEN skinid END) AS skin_collector, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'Collector' AND is_new = 1 THEN skinid END) AS skin_collector_new, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'Luckybox' THEN skinid END) AS skin_luckybox, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'Luckybox' AND is_new = 1 THEN skinid END) AS skin_luckybox_new, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'S' THEN skinid END) AS skin_s, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'S' AND is_new = 1 THEN skinid END) AS skin_s_new, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'S+' THEN skinid END) AS skin_splus, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'S+' AND is_new = 1 THEN skinid END) AS skin_splus_new, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'SP' THEN skinid END) AS skin_sp, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'SP' AND is_new = 1 THEN skinid END) AS skin_sp_new, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'yearstar' THEN skinid END) AS skin_yearstar, COUNT(CASE WHEN skinlevel = 'yearstar' AND is_new = 1 THEN skinid END) AS skin_yearstar_new, active_level FROM detail GROUP BY charge_tier, his_charge_tier, retention_create_type, create_country, active_level

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: helenma@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-12-07 12:28:47.000 */ /* Description:  https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/FGJqwGhUGiKjWLk5aRdcPp1kn51 */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_ads.ads_mkt_operation_launch_redfission_online_hi */ /* ( */ /*     roleid                     DECIMAL(20, 0)     COMMENT '角色id,key', */ /*     zoneid                     BIGINT             COMMENT '服务器,key', -- 命名方式对齐沐瞳 */ /*     his_last_active_time       STRING             COMMENT '当天末次活跃时间(时分秒)', */ /*     his_last_active_ip         STRING             COMMENT '账号末次登录IP地址',  */ /*     role_register_date         STRING             COMMENT '角色注册时间', */ /*     account_register_date      STRING             COMMENT '账号注册时间', */ /*     lose_days                  BIGINT             COMMENT '流失天数', */ /*     battle_cnt                 BIGINT             COMMENT '当日战斗场次', */ /*     battle_dur                 DOUBLE              COMMENT '当日战斗时长(单位从秒换算到分钟)', */ /*     black_cnt                  BIGINT             COMMENT '当日开黑场次' */ /* ) COMMENT '在线-发行裂变-用户身份判断' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd', hour BIGINT COMMENT '小时' ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3n://mt-ads/table/ads_mkt_operation_launch_redfission_online_hi'; */ /* 设备ID 与 roleid、zoneid的映射关系 */ /* WITH  device_account_df AS ( */ /*         SELECT */ /*                 device_id,accountid */ /*         FROM  */ /*                 adbi.dim_device_account_df */ /*         WHERE   */ /*                 p_date = '2026-05-30' */ /*                 and device_id NOT IN ('','none','null','unknown','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','0000-0000','0000000000000000','00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000') */ /*                 and device_id IS NOT NULL */ /* ) */ /* 账号角色增量：创建, 可能存在有创角无创号，有创号无创角的情况 */ WITH role_zone_create_hi AS (SELECT COALESCE(t1.roleid, t2.accountid) AS roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.role_register_date, t2.logymd AS account_register_date, t2.country FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(usercreateymd) AS role_register_date FROM ml_ods.gameserver_create_role WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-31' AND '2026-06-01' /* AND   SUBSTR(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 13) <= CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 17:00:00') - 16 * 60 * 60, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH') AS STRING) */ /* (logymd >= '2026-06-01' AND HOUR(`time`) <=  17 ) */ /* OR logymd = '2026-05-31' */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, MIN(logymd) AS logymd, country FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-31' AND '2026-06-01' /* AND   SUBSTR(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 13) <= CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 17:00:00') - 16 * 60 * 60, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH') AS STRING) */ GROUP BY accountid, country) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.accountid), role_zone_basic_df_hi /* 账号角色全量：创建 */ AS (SELECT df_di.roleid, df_di.zoneid, df_di.role_register_date, COALESCE(df_di.country, df_acc.first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(df_di.account_register_date, df_acc.account_register_date) AS account_register_date FROM (SELECT COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(di.role_register_date, df.role_register_date) AS role_register_date, di.country, di.account_register_date FROM role_zone_create_hi AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date AS role_register_date /* account_register_date */ FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid GROUP BY COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid), COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid), COALESCE(di.role_register_date, df.role_register_date), di.country, di.account_register_date) AS df_di LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, MIN(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(MIN(account_register_date), MIN(register_date)) AS account_register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid) AS df_acc ON df_di.roleid = df_acc.roleid), role_zone_login_hi /* 账号角色增量：登录、流失 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN total_rn = 1 THEN client_ip END) AS last_login_ip, MAX(CASE WHEN total_rn = 1 THEN `time` END) AS last_active_time, MAX(CASE WHEN total_rn = 1 THEN level END) AS last_level, MAX(CASE WHEN logymd_rn = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(`time`, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31' THEN `time` END) AS last_1d_active_time /* 最新登录日期-前一个登录日期（同日期继续往前找，不可用同一日期） */ /* time 是时间戳类型: Leap FROM_UNIXTIME 函数是UTC-0, 需要转UTC-8 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, client_ip, level, logymd, `time`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time` DESC, client_ip, os_type, device) AS total_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, logymd ORDER BY `time` DESC, client_ip, os_type, device) AS logymd_rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-31' AND '2026-06-01') WHERE total_rn = 1 OR logymd_rn = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), role_zone_login_df_hi /* 账号角色全量：登录、流失 */ AS (SELECT COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, MAX(COALESCE(di.last_active_time, df.his_last_active_time)) AS his_last_active_time /* 算当天 */, MAX(COALESCE(di.last_1d_active_time, df.his_last_active_time)) AS his_last_1d_active_time /* 剔除当天：前一个登录日期 */, MAX(COALESCE(di.last_login_ip, df.his_last_active_ip)) AS his_last_active_ip, MAX(COALESCE(di.last_level, df.his_last_active_level)) AS his_last_active_level FROM role_zone_login_hi AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_time, his_last_active_ip, his_last_active_level FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid GROUP BY COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid), COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid)), role_zone_battle_end_hi AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battle_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(battletime, 0)) AS battle_dur, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(COALESCE(blacknum, 0) > 1, battleid, NULL)) AS black_cnt /* nvl(wincamp, 0) wincamp, */ /* nvl(ismvp, 0) ismvp, */ /* if(isinvalidbattle=0, 1 ,0) AS is_valid, */ /* nvl(killnum, 0) kill_num, */ /* nvl(deadnum, 0) dead_num, */ /* nvl(assistnum, 0) assist_num, */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-31' AND '2026-06-01' AND SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 10) = FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 17:00:00') - 16 * 60 * 60, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT pvptype IS NULL GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_mkt_operation_launch_redfission_online_hi PARTITION(logymd = '2026-06-01', hour = 17) SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, b.his_last_active_time, b.his_last_active_ip, a.role_register_date, a.account_register_date, DATEDIFF(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 17:00:00') - 16 * 60 * 60, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), b.his_last_active_time) AS lose_days, c.battle_cnt, ROUND(c.battle_dur / 60, 4) AS battle_dur, c.black_cnt, b.his_last_active_level /* first_mt_country */ /* did */ FROM role_zone_basic_df_hi AS a FULL JOIN role_zone_login_df_hi AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN role_zone_battle_end_hi AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid

sql_units: WITH fight_pos /* =========================================================================== */ /* 辅助：生成位置序号 1..N，用于多数组并行展开 */ /* =========================================================================== */ AS (SELECT 1 AS match_col, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY skinid) AS pos FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01'), base /* =========================================================================== */ /* CTE 1：基础对局数据（服务端，含 AI 行，保证阵营聚合分母完整） */ /* =========================================================================== */ AS (SELECT battleid, accountid, CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) AS zoneid, camp AS icamp, heroid, wincamp AS iswin /* 直接表示胜负 */, pvptype, realpvptype, towerhurt /* 对敌方塔输出伤害 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '${DATE}' AND CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 AND battleid = 769540592262723951), camp_tower /* CTE 2：阵营推塔伤害汇总（推塔伤害占比分母） */ AS (SELECT battleid, icamp, SUM(towerhurt) AS camp_tower_dmg FROM base GROUP BY battleid, icamp), fight_src /* =========================================================================== */ /* CTE 3：团战事件展开（connserver_client_team_battle_event） */ /* 每行 = 一波团战 */ /* \073 = ';'（Spark SQL octal 转义，避免平台把分号误判为语句分隔） */ /* =========================================================================== */ AS (SELECT battleid, 1 AS match_col, LENGTH(start_time) /* 分号数量 = 有效元素数（格式含尾部分号时成立） */ - LENGTH(REPLACE(start_time, CHR(59), '')) AS leng, fight_heronuma, fight_heronumb, fight_heroesa, fight_heroesb, dead_heroesa, dead_heroesb, start_time FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_team_battle_event WHERE logymd = '${DATE}' AND battleid = 769540592262723951), fight_events AS (SELECT t.battleid, t1.pos, CAST(SPLIT(t.fight_heronuma, '\\073')[t1.pos - 1] AS BIGINT) AS fight_numa, CAST(SPLIT(t.fight_heronumb, '\\073')[t1.pos - 1] AS BIGINT) AS fight_numb, SPLIT(t.fight_heroesa, '\\073')[t1.pos - 1] AS heroesa, SPLIT(t.fight_heroesb, '\\073')[t1.pos - 1] AS heroesb, SPLIT(t.dead_heroesa, '\\073')[t1.pos - 1] AS dead_a, SPLIT(t.dead_heroesb, '\\073')[t1.pos - 1] AS dead_b, CAST(SPLIT(t.start_time, '\\073')[t1.pos - 1] AS BIGINT) AS fight_start_sec FROM fight_src AS t LEFT JOIN fight_pos AS t1 ON t.match_col = t1.match_col AND t.leng >= t1.pos WHERE NOT SPLIT(t.start_time, '\\073')[t1.pos - 1] IS NULL AND TRIM(SPLIT(t.start_time, '\\073')[t1.pos - 1]) <> '' AND NOT CAST(SPLIT(t.fight_heronuma, '\\073')[t1.pos - 1] AS BIGINT) IS NULL), solo_events_raw /* =========================================================================== */ /* CTE 4：1v1 单杀事件（fight_numa + fight_numb = 2 且有死亡） */ /* =========================================================================== */ AS (SELECT battleid, fight_start_sec, CASE WHEN NOT dead_b IS NULL AND dead_b <> '' AND dead_b <> '0' THEN CAST(heroesa AS BIGINT) END AS killer_heroid /* B 方有死亡 → A 方英雄是击杀者 */, CASE WHEN NOT dead_b IS NULL AND dead_b <> '' AND dead_b <> '0' THEN CAST(dead_b AS BIGINT) END AS killed_heroid, CASE WHEN NOT dead_a IS NULL AND dead_a <> '' AND dead_a <> '0' THEN CAST(heroesb AS BIGINT) END AS killer_heroid_2 /* A 方有死亡 → B 方英雄是击杀者 */, CASE WHEN NOT dead_a IS NULL AND dead_a <> '' AND dead_a <> '0' THEN CAST(dead_a AS BIGINT) END AS killed_heroid_2 FROM fight_events WHERE fight_numa + fight_numb = 2), solo_events AS (SELECT battleid, fight_start_sec, killer_heroid, killed_heroid FROM solo_events_raw WHERE NOT killer_heroid IS NULL AND NOT killed_heroid IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT battleid, fight_start_sec, killer_heroid_2, killed_heroid_2 FROM solo_events_raw WHERE NOT killer_heroid_2 IS NULL AND NOT killed_heroid_2 IS NULL), solo_with_accounts /* CTE 5：heroid 关联 accountid（同一局内 heroid 唯一） */ AS (SELECT se.battleid, kb.accountid AS killer_accountid, kb.zoneid AS killer_zoneid, kd.accountid AS killed_accountid, kd.zoneid AS killed_zoneid FROM solo_events AS se JOIN base AS kb ON kb.battleid = se.battleid AND kb.heroid = se.killer_heroid JOIN base AS kd ON kd.battleid = se.battleid AND kd.heroid = se.killed_heroid), player_solo /* CTE 6：玩家单杀 / 被单杀次数 */ AS (SELECT battleid, accountid, zoneid, SUM(solokill_cnt) AS solokill_cnt, SUM(solobekill_cnt) AS solobekill_cnt FROM (SELECT battleid, killer_accountid AS accountid, killer_zoneid AS zoneid, 1 AS solokill_cnt, 0 AS solobekill_cnt FROM solo_with_accounts UNION ALL SELECT battleid, killed_accountid, killed_zoneid, 0, 1 FROM solo_with_accounts) AS x GROUP BY battleid, accountid, zoneid), camp_solo /* CTE 7：己方阵营单杀 / 被单杀总次数（分母，只统计真人） */ AS (SELECT b.battleid, b.icamp, SUM(COALESCE(ps.solokill_cnt, 0)) AS camp_solokill_total, SUM(COALESCE(ps.solobekill_cnt, 0)) AS camp_solobekill_total FROM base AS b LEFT JOIN player_solo AS ps ON ps.battleid = b.battleid AND ps.accountid = b.accountid AND ps.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE b.accountid > 100 GROUP BY b.battleid, b.icamp), fight_class /* =========================================================================== */ /* 团战规模分类 + 伤害占比 */ /* CTE 8：团战规模分类 */ /* =========================================================================== */ AS (SELECT battleid, fight_start_sec, fight_numa + fight_numb AS fight_total, CASE WHEN fight_numa + fight_numb BETWEEN 3 AND 7 THEN 'small' WHEN fight_numa + fight_numb >= 8 THEN 'large' END AS fight_type FROM fight_events WHERE fight_numa + fight_numb >= 3), fight_damage_raw /* CTE 9：玩家团战伤害（connserver_client_hero_battle_event） */ AS (SELECT battleid, accountid, CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) AS zoneid, fightstart AS fight_start_sec, CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(damage, 'total:([0-9]+)') AS DOUBLE) AS player_dmg, CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(teamdamage, 'total:([0-9]+)') AS DOUBLE) AS team_dmg FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_hero_battle_event WHERE logymd = '${DATE}' AND CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000), fight_joined /* CTE 10：关联团战规模与伤害（battleid + fight_start_sec） */ AS (SELECT fd.battleid, fd.accountid, fd.zoneid, fc.fight_type, fc.fight_start_sec, fd.player_dmg, fd.team_dmg FROM fight_damage_raw AS fd JOIN fight_class AS fc ON fc.battleid = fd.battleid AND fc.fight_start_sec = fd.fight_start_sec), player_fight /* CTE 11：玩家团战参与次数 + 伤害占比均值 */ AS (SELECT battleid, accountid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fight_type = 'small' THEN fight_start_sec END) AS small_join, AVG(CASE WHEN fight_type = 'small' AND team_dmg > 0 THEN player_dmg / team_dmg END) AS small_dmg_share_avg, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fight_type = 'large' THEN fight_start_sec END) AS large_join, AVG(CASE WHEN fight_type = 'large' AND team_dmg > 0 THEN player_dmg / team_dmg END) AS large_dmg_share_avg FROM fight_joined GROUP BY battleid, accountid, zoneid), battle_fight /* CTE 12：本局团战总次数（参与率分母） */ AS (SELECT battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fight_type = 'small' THEN fight_start_sec END) AS small_total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fight_type = 'large' THEN fight_start_sec END) AS large_total FROM fight_class GROUP BY battleid), tower_raw /* =========================================================================== */ /* 推塔参与（LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE 单列展开） */ /* CTE 13：展开 destroytowerinfo */ /* =========================================================================== */ AS (SELECT b2.battleid, b2.accountid, CAST(b2.zoneid AS BIGINT) AS zoneid, b2.heroid, CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(tower_rec, ',([0-9]+),[0-9]+$'), '') AS INT) AS tower_order, CASE WHEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(tower_rec, '^[0-9]+,[0-9]+,(.+),[0-9],[0-9],[0-9]+(?:,[0-9])?$') RLIKE CONCAT('(^|,)', CAST(b2.heroid AS STRING), '(,|$)') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_participated FROM (SELECT battleid, accountid, zoneid, heroid, destroytowerinfo FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '${DATE}' AND CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 AND NOT destroytowerinfo IS NULL AND destroytowerinfo <> '') AS b2 LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(b2.destroytowerinfo, '\\073')) lv AS tower_rec WHERE tower_rec <> ''), player_tower AS (SELECT battleid, accountid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_participated = 1 THEN tower_order END) AS tower_joined_cnt FROM tower_raw GROUP BY battleid, accountid, zoneid), battle_tower_total AS (SELECT battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT tower_order) AS total_tower_cnt FROM tower_raw GROUP BY battleid), team_end_src /* =========================================================================== */ /* 龙 / 神龟参与（LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE 单列展开） */ /* CTE 14：数据源 */ /* =========================================================================== */ AS (SELECT battleid, lordkilla, lordkillb, turtlekilla, turtlekillb FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_team_battle_end WHERE logymd = '${DATE}' AND CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000), lord_events AS (SELECT t.battleid, 1 AS kill_camp, ev FROM team_end_src AS t LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(COALESCE(t.lordkilla, ''), '\\073')) lv AS ev WHERE TRIM(ev) <> '' AND ev <> '0' UNION ALL SELECT t.battleid, 2, ev FROM team_end_src AS t LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(COALESCE(t.lordkillb, ''), '\\073')) lv AS ev WHERE TRIM(ev) <> '' AND ev <> '0'), turtle_events AS (SELECT t.battleid, 1 AS kill_camp, ev FROM team_end_src AS t LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(COALESCE(t.turtlekilla, ''), '\\073')) lv AS ev WHERE TRIM(ev) <> '' AND ev <> '0' UNION ALL SELECT t.battleid, 2, ev FROM team_end_src AS t LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(COALESCE(t.turtlekillb, ''), '\\073')) lv AS ev WHERE TRIM(ev) <> '' AND ev <> '0'), lord_battle_total AS (SELECT battleid, COUNT(1) AS lord_total_cnt FROM lord_events GROUP BY battleid), turtle_battle_total AS (SELECT battleid, COUNT(1) AS turtle_total_cnt FROM turtle_events GROUP BY battleid), lord_player /* 玩家龙参与：本方阵营击龙事件中 [...] 包含该玩家 heroid */ AS (SELECT le.battleid, b.accountid, b.zoneid, COUNT(1) AS lord_joined_cnt FROM lord_events AS le JOIN base AS b ON b.battleid = le.battleid AND b.icamp = le.kill_camp WHERE COALESCE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(le.ev, '\\[([^\\]]+)\\]'), '') RLIKE CONCAT('(^|,)', CAST(b.heroid AS STRING), '(,|$)') GROUP BY le.battleid, b.accountid, b.zoneid), turtle_player AS (SELECT te.battleid, b.accountid, b.zoneid, COUNT(1) AS turtle_joined_cnt FROM turtle_events AS te JOIN base AS b ON b.battleid = te.battleid AND b.icamp = te.kill_camp WHERE COALESCE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(te.ev, '\\[([^\\]]+)\\]'), '') RLIKE CONCAT('(^|,)', CAST(b.heroid AS STRING), '(,|$)') GROUP BY te.battleid, b.accountid, b.zoneid) /* =========================================================================== */ /* 最终输出 */ /* =========================================================================== */ SELECT b.battleid, b.accountid, b.zoneid, b.icamp, b.realpvptype, b.heroid, b.iswin, COALESCE(ps.solokill_cnt, 0) AS solokill_cnt /* ① 单杀 */, COALESCE(cs.camp_solokill_total, 0) AS camp_solokill_total, CASE WHEN COALESCE(cs.camp_solokill_total, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(COALESCE(ps.solokill_cnt, 0) AS DOUBLE) / cs.camp_solokill_total ELSE NULL END AS solokill_rate, COALESCE(ps.solobekill_cnt, 0) AS solobekill_cnt /* ② 被单杀 */, COALESCE(cs.camp_solobekill_total, 0) AS camp_solobekill_total, CASE WHEN COALESCE(cs.camp_solobekill_total, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(COALESCE(ps.solobekill_cnt, 0) AS DOUBLE) / cs.camp_solobekill_total ELSE NULL END AS solobekill_rate, COALESCE(pf.small_join, 0) AS small_fight_joined /* ③ 小团战（3-7人） */, COALESCE(bf.small_total, 0) AS small_fight_total, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bf.small_total, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(COALESCE(pf.small_join, 0) AS DOUBLE) / bf.small_total ELSE NULL END AS small_fight_rate, pf.small_dmg_share_avg, COALESCE(pf.large_join, 0) AS large_fight_joined /* ④ 大团战（8人+） */, COALESCE(bf.large_total, 0) AS large_fight_total, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bf.large_total, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(COALESCE(pf.large_join, 0) AS DOUBLE) / bf.large_total ELSE NULL END AS large_fight_rate, pf.large_dmg_share_avg, b.towerhurt AS tower_dmg_self /* ⑤ 推塔 */, ct.camp_tower_dmg, CASE WHEN ct.camp_tower_dmg > 0 THEN CAST(b.towerhurt AS DOUBLE) / ct.camp_tower_dmg ELSE NULL END AS tower_dmg_share, COALESCE(pt.tower_joined_cnt, 0) AS tower_joined_cnt, COALESCE(btt.total_tower_cnt, 0) AS total_tower_cnt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(btt.total_tower_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(COALESCE(pt.tower_joined_cnt, 0) AS DOUBLE) / btt.total_tower_cnt ELSE NULL END AS tower_participation_rate, COALESCE(lp.lord_joined_cnt, 0) AS lord_joined_cnt /* ⑥ 龙参与率（分母 = 本局双方合计击龙次数） */, COALESCE(lbt.lord_total_cnt, 0) AS lord_total_cnt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(lbt.lord_total_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(COALESCE(lp.lord_joined_cnt, 0) AS DOUBLE) / lbt.lord_total_cnt ELSE NULL END AS lord_participation_rate, COALESCE(tp.turtle_joined_cnt, 0) AS turtle_joined_cnt /* 神龟参与率 */, COALESCE(tbt.turtle_total_cnt, 0) AS turtle_total_cnt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(tbt.turtle_total_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(COALESCE(tp.turtle_joined_cnt, 0) AS DOUBLE) / tbt.turtle_total_cnt ELSE NULL END AS turtle_participation_rate FROM base AS b LEFT JOIN camp_tower AS ct ON ct.battleid = b.battleid AND ct.icamp = b.icamp LEFT JOIN player_solo AS ps ON ps.battleid = b.battleid AND ps.accountid = b.accountid AND ps.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN camp_solo AS cs ON cs.battleid = b.battleid AND cs.icamp = b.icamp LEFT JOIN player_fight AS pf ON pf.battleid = b.battleid AND pf.accountid = b.accountid AND pf.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle_fight AS bf ON bf.battleid = b.battleid LEFT JOIN player_tower AS pt ON pt.battleid = b.battleid AND pt.accountid = b.accountid AND pt.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle_tower_total AS btt ON btt.battleid = b.battleid LEFT JOIN lord_player AS lp ON lp.battleid = b.battleid AND lp.accountid = b.accountid AND lp.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN lord_battle_total AS lbt ON lbt.battleid = b.battleid LEFT JOIN turtle_player AS tp ON tp.battleid = b.battleid AND tp.accountid = b.accountid AND tp.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN turtle_battle_total AS tbt ON tbt.battleid = b.battleid LIMIT 1000 /* WHERE b.accountid > 100 */

sql_units: /* ===================================================================== */ /* ② R级 × 钻石余额 */ /* ===================================================================== */ WITH active_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000), r_label_raw AS (SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 > 0 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 2 THEN '1.(0,2)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 2 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 5 THEN '2.[2,5)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 5 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 10 THEN '3.[5,10)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 10 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 20 THEN '4.[10,20)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 20 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 30 THEN '5.[20,30)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 30 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 50 THEN '6.[30,50)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 50 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 100 THEN '7.[50,100)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 100 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 200 THEN '8.[100,200)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 200 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 500 THEN '9.[200,500)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 500 THEN '10.[500+)' END AS r_label FROM (SELECT roleid, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num_sum FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-10-02' AND '2025-12-31' AND NOT operate IN ('gm') AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid)), user_pool AS (SELECT a.roleid, COALESCE(r.r_label, '0.无消费') AS r_label FROM active_users AS a LEFT JOIN r_label_raw AS r ON a.roleid = r.roleid), balance_raw AS (/* 2026-05-25 ~ 2026-05-31 内所有钻石流水(出 + 进), 用于反查最新余额 */ SELECT roleid, time, curdiamond FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND NOT curdiamond IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT roleid, time, curdiamond FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_diamond WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND NOT curdiamond IS NULL), balance_latest AS (/* 取每个 roleid 最新一条流水的 curdiamond */ SELECT roleid, curdiamond FROM (SELECT roleid, curdiamond, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM balance_raw) WHERE rn = 1) SELECT p.r_label AS `R级`, COUNT(DISTINCT p.roleid) AS `R级用户数`, COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid) AS `有余额数据用户数`, ROUND(AVG(b.curdiamond), 2) AS `钻石余额均值`, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(b.curdiamond, 0.25), 2) AS `钻石余额p25`, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(b.curdiamond, 0.50), 2) AS `钻石余额p50`, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(b.curdiamond, 0.75), 2) AS `钻石余额p75` FROM user_pool AS p LEFT JOIN balance_latest AS b ON p.roleid = b.roleid GROUP BY p.r_label ORDER BY p.r_label

sql_units: /* 写入 */ WITH sampled_battle /* LIMIT 100 */ AS (SELECT battle_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT battle_id FROM ml_ods.battleserver_chat_talk WHERE logymd = '${DATE}' AND NOT battle_id IS NULL AND NOT content IS NULL AND FLOOR(battlesvrid / 1000) IN (55, 56, 57)) AS t ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 20000), base AS (SELECT CAST(t.battle_id AS STRING) AS battleid, t.logymd, FLOOR(battlesvrid / 1000) AS battlegroup, CONCAT('[', t.loghms, '][', CAST(t.sender AS STRING), ']: ', t.content) AS line FROM ml_ods.battleserver_chat_talk AS t INNER JOIN sampled_battle AS s ON t.battle_id = s.battle_id WHERE t.logymd = '${DATE}' AND NOT t.battle_id IS NULL AND NOT t.content IS NULL), agg AS (SELECT battleid, logymd, TO_JSON(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(line))) AS content /* sort_array(collect_list(line)) AS content, */, battlegroup FROM base GROUP BY battleid, logymd, battlegroup) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.hero_ai_battle_chat_dialogue PARTITION(logymd, env) SELECT battleid, content, logymd AS battle_logymd, logymd, IF(battlegroup IN (55, 56, 57), 'prod', 'test') AS env FROM agg /* WHERE battlegroup>=55 */ ORDER BY battle_logymd DESC

STRING          COMMENT '销售日期', */ /*     app_id                  STRING          COMMENT '应用ID', */ /*     channel                 STRING          COMMENT '销售渠道（小黑盒/steam）', */ /*     country                 STRING          COMMENT '国家/地区代码', */ /*     product_id              STRING          COMMENT '产品ID', */ /*     product_name            STRING          COMMENT '产品名称', */ /*     product_type            STRING          COMMENT '产品类型（游戏/DLC）', */ /*     gross_units_sold        BIGINT          COMMENT '当日毛销售数量', */ /*     net_units_sold          BIGINT          COMMENT '当日净销售数量', */ /*     chargeback_returns      BIGINT          COMMENT '当日退款数量', */ /*     gross_sales_usd         DOUBLE          COMMENT '当日毛销售额（USD）', */ /*     net_sales_usd           DOUBLE          COMMENT '当日净销售额（USD）', */ /*     chargeback_returns_usd  DOUBLE          COMMENT '当日退款金额（USD）', */ /*     lifetime_net_units      BIGINT          COMMENT '上线以来累计净销售数量', */ /*     lifetime_net_sales_usd  DOUBLE          COMMENT '上线以来累计净销售额（USD）' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT 'PC端（小黑盒+Steam）每日销售报表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     p_date STRING COMMENT '分区日期' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/advertisement_bi/adbi/dm_pc_game_sales_df'; */ WITH cfg AS (SELECT app_id, channel, product_id, product_name, product_type FROM adbi.dim_steam_config_df WHERE p_date = '20260531'), xhh_raw AS (SELECT o.product_id, o.country, o.net_sales, o.data_date, r.exchange_rate FROM (SELECT report_date_utc AS data_date, sku_id AS product_id, sale_price AS net_sales, 'cn' AS country, 'CNY' AS currency FROM adbi.ods_xiaoheihe_order_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-06-01') AS o LEFT JOIN (SELECT original_currency, exchange_rate FROM adbi.dim_finance_budget_exchage_rate WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND data_year = '2026' AND target_currency = 'USD' AND original_currency = 'CNY') AS r ON r.original_currency = o.currency), xhh AS (SELECT data_date, product_id, country, COUNT(1) AS gross_units_sold, COUNT(1) AS net_units_sold, 0 AS chargeback_returns, SUM(net_sales / exchange_rate) AS gross_sales_usd, SUM(net_sales / exchange_rate) AS net_sales_usd, 0.0 AS chargeback_returns_usd FROM xhh_raw GROUP BY data_date, product_id, country), steam AS (SELECT s.report_date AS data_date, s.product_id, LOWER(s.country_code) AS country, SUM(s.gross_units_sold) AS gross_units_sold, SUM(s.net_units_sold) AS net_units_sold, SUM(s.chargeback_returns) AS chargeback_returns, SUM(s.gross_steam_sales_usd) AS gross_sales_usd, SUM(s.net_steam_sales_usd) AS net_sales_usd, SUM(s.chargeback_returns_usd) AS chargeback_returns_usd FROM adbi.ods_steam_sales_di AS s WHERE s.logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY s.report_date, s.product_id, s.country_code), unioned AS (SELECT data_date, product_id, country, gross_units_sold, net_units_sold, chargeback_returns, gross_sales_usd, net_sales_usd, chargeback_returns_usd FROM xhh UNION ALL SELECT data_date, product_id, country, gross_units_sold, net_units_sold, chargeback_returns, gross_sales_usd, net_sales_usd, chargeback_returns_usd FROM steam), date_spine AS (SELECT DATE_ADD('2026-04-29', pos) AS data_date FROM (SELECT POSEXPLODE(SPLIT(REPEAT(' ', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '2026-04-29')), ' '))) AS t), all_combinations AS (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, country FROM unioned), spine AS (SELECT d.data_date, p.product_id, p.country FROM date_spine AS d LEFT JOIN all_combinations AS p ON NOT d.data_date IS NULL), filled AS (SELECT s.data_date, s.product_id, s.country, COALESCE(u.gross_units_sold, 0) AS gross_units_sold, COALESCE(u.net_units_sold, 0) AS net_units_sold, COALESCE(u.chargeback_returns, 0) AS chargeback_returns, COALESCE(u.gross_sales_usd, 0.0) AS gross_sales_usd, COALESCE(u.net_sales_usd, 0.0) AS net_sales_usd, COALESCE(u.chargeback_returns_usd, 0.0) AS chargeback_returns_usd, SUM(COALESCE(u.net_units_sold, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.product_id, s.country ORDER BY s.data_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS lifetime_net_units, SUM(COALESCE(u.net_sales_usd, 0.0)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.product_id, s.country ORDER BY s.data_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS lifetime_net_sales_usd FROM spine AS s LEFT JOIN unioned AS u ON s.data_date = u.data_date AND s.product_id = u.product_id AND s.country = u.country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dm_pc_game_sales_df PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.data_date, c.app_id, c.channel, a.country, a.product_id, c.product_name, c.product_type, a.gross_units_sold, a.net_units_sold, a.chargeback_returns, a.gross_sales_usd, a.net_sales_usd, a.chargeback_returns_usd, a.lifetime_net_units, a.lifetime_net_sales_usd FROM filled AS a LEFT JOIN cfg AS c ON a.product_id = c.product_id WHERE a.data_date <= '2026-05-31' ORDER BY a.data_date, c.app_id, a.country

sql_units: WITH ab_test AS (SELECT accountid, MAX(CASE WHEN param_value LIKE '%test%' THEN 'test' ELSE 'control' END) AS ab_group FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-20' AND '2026-06-30' AND (old_zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999) AND param_name LIKE '%dev_alive_report_74%' AND accountid > 0 GROUP BY accountid), step0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.logymd, t.identification AS trace_id, t.accountid AS roleid, ab.ab_group FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_room_trace AS t INNER JOIN ab_test AS ab ON ab.accountid = t.accountid WHERE t.logymd >= '2026-05-20' AND t.roomtype = 1 AND LENGTH(t.identification) > 15 AND t.accountid > 0 AND (t.zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999) AND t.level >= 8), step121 AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.logymd, t.room_id AS roomid, s.roleid, s.ab_group FROM ml_ods.gameserver_create_room_trace AS t INNER JOIN step0 AS s ON s.logymd = t.logymd AND s.trace_id = t.trace_id AND s.roleid = t.roleid WHERE t.logymd >= '2026-05-20' AND t.step = 7 AND t.error_code = 0 AND t.room_id > 0 AND (t.zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999) AND t.level >= 8), step611 AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.logymd, t.roomid, t.account AS roleid, s.ab_group FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_match_trace AS t INNER JOIN step121 AS s ON s.logymd = t.logymd AND s.roomid = t.roomid AND s.roleid = t.account WHERE t.logymd >= '2026-05-20' AND t.step_name = 'EnterPlay' /* BeginLoading/EnterPlay */ AND t.zone BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999), step0_cnt AS (SELECT logymd, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN ab_group = 'test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_test, SUM(CASE WHEN ab_group = 'control' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_control FROM step0 GROUP BY logymd), step611_cnt AS (SELECT logymd, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN ab_group = 'test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_test, SUM(CASE WHEN ab_group = 'control' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_control FROM step611 GROUP BY logymd) SELECT s0.logymd, s0.cnt_test AS 点创房数_test, s0.cnt_control AS 点创房数_control, COALESCE(s611.cnt_test, 0) AS 进战斗数_test, COALESCE(s611.cnt_control, 0) AS 进战斗数_control, CAST(CASE WHEN s0.cnt_test > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(s611.cnt_test, 0) * 100.0 / s0.cnt_test, 4) ELSE 0 END AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS 进战斗转化率_test, CAST(CASE WHEN s0.cnt_control > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(s611.cnt_control, 0) * 100.0 / s0.cnt_control, 4) ELSE 0 END AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS 进战斗转化率_control, CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(CASE WHEN s0.cnt_test > 0 THEN COALESCE(s611.cnt_test, 0) * 100.0 / s0.cnt_test END, 0) - COALESCE(CASE WHEN s0.cnt_control > 0 THEN COALESCE(s611.cnt_control, 0) * 100.0 / s0.cnt_control END, 0), 4) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS 转化率差 FROM step0_cnt AS s0 LEFT JOIN step611_cnt AS s611 ON s0.logymd = s611.logymd ORDER BY s0.logymd

name: 6.广场每日渗透率
sql_units: WITH date_list /* 1. 日期序列 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT logymd AS dt FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2026-02-13'), login_daily /* 2. 每日登录用户（已去重） */ AS (SELECT logymd, roleid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2026-02-13' GROUP BY logymd, roleid), park_all /* 3. 广场进入记录（包含历史，提供分区过滤） */ AS (SELECT logymd, roleid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_themepark_enter_scene WHERE logymd >= '2020-01-01' AND logymd < '2100-01-01' /* 用宽范围满足分区谓词要求 */ GROUP BY logymd, roleid), user_daily_flag /* 4. 标记每位用户每日的状态：当天是否进广场、是否有历史广场记录 */ AS (SELECT l.logymd, l.roleid, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT p.roleid IS NULL AND p.logymd = l.logymd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_park_today, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT p.roleid IS NULL AND p.logymd < l.logymd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_park_history FROM login_daily AS l LEFT JOIN park_all AS p ON l.roleid = p.roleid AND p.logymd <= l.logymd /* 关联当天及之前的广场记录 */ GROUP BY l.logymd, l.roleid) /* 5. 按天汇总三个指标 */ SELECT dl.dt, COUNT(DISTINCT u.roleid) AS login_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.is_park_today = 1 THEN u.roleid END) AS park_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.is_park_today = 0 AND u.has_park_history = 1 THEN u.roleid END) AS churn_users FROM date_list AS dl LEFT JOIN user_daily_flag AS u ON dl.dt = u.logymd GROUP BY dl.dt ORDER BY dl.dt

sql_units: /* 3. 目标用户使用签约英雄首次参加的地图ID、目标用户使用签约英雄首次游玩的战绩情况 */ WITH t0 AS (/* 进组样本（先过滤 ab，再 join 段位） */ SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT a1.param_version, a1.logymd, a1.roleid, a1.zoneid FROM (SELECT DISTINCT accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, logymd, param_version FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE param_name = '60_SeasonHeroPool_2' AND param_version IN ('10750', '10751', '10752', '10753') AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-25' AND '2026-03-31' AND old_zoneid < 57000) AS a1 LEFT JOIN (/* 长期观测名单 */ SELECT accountid, old_zoneid FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE param_value = '__MTTD_INTERNAL_LONG_OBSERVE_GROUP__' AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-04-02' AND old_zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY accountid, old_zoneid) AS a2 ON a1.roleid = a2.accountid AND a1.zoneid = a2.old_zoneid WHERE a2.accountid IS NULL AND a2.old_zoneid IS NULL) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t1 /* ,time */ /* ,logymd */ AS (SELECT MIN(time) AS sign_time /* min(logymd) as logymd, --玩家签约时间 */, roleid, zoneid, hero_id /* 签约英雄 */ /* , sign_seq --签约序号 */ /* ,sign_count --签约剩余次数 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_season_hero_pool_sign WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND season_id = 40 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, hero_id), t2 AS (SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t1.hero_id /* 签约英雄 */, t1.sign_time /* 签约日期 */ FROM t0 INNER JOIN t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid /* 玩家粒度非玩家英雄粒度 */ GROUP BY t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t1.hero_id /* 签约英雄 */, t1.sign_time /* 签约日期 */), t3 AS (SELECT time /* logymd, */, accountid, zoneid, heroid, battleid, pvptype, wincamp FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND /*   AND pvptype       IN (1, 2, 4) */ fake_ai = 0 AND isinvalidbattle = 0 GROUP BY time /* logymd, */, accountid, zoneid, heroid, battleid, pvptype, wincamp), t4 AS (SELECT t2.roleid /* t3.pvptype, */, t2.zoneid, t2.hero_id, MIN(t3.time) AS frist_use_time /* t3.wincamp, */ /* t3.battleid, */ /* case when t2.heroid is null then 0 else 1 end as is_use_hero ,--是否使用该签约英雄 */ /* row_number()over(partition by t2.roleid,t2.zoneid,t2.hero_id order by t3.time) as rn --签约后首次使用每个签约英雄的战斗场次 */ FROM t2 INNER JOIN t3 ON t2.hero_id = t3.heroid AND t2.roleid = t3.accountid AND t2.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND t3.time >= t2.sign_time GROUP BY t2.roleid, t2.zoneid, t2.hero_id), t5 /* group by */ /*         hero_id */ /*         -- ,is_use_hero */ /*         -- ,pvptype */ AS (SELECT t4.roleid, t4.zoneid, t4.hero_id, t3.accountid, t3.pvptype, t3.wincamp, t3.battleid FROM t4 INNER JOIN t3 ON t4.frist_use_time = t3.`time` AND t4.hero_id = t3.heroid AND t4.roleid = t3.accountid AND t4.zoneid = t3.zoneid) SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid, accountid, zoneid) AS battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wincamp = 1 THEN CONCAT(battleid, '-', accountid, '-', zoneid) END) AS win_cnt FROM t5 GROUP BY hero_id

name: ab对比成局率
sql_units: WITH ab_test AS (SELECT accountid, MAX(CASE WHEN param_value LIKE '%test%' THEN 'test' ELSE 'control' END) AS ab_group FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-20' AND '2026-06-30' AND old_zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999 AND param_name LIKE '%dev_alive_report_74%' AND accountid > 0 GROUP BY accountid), step320 AS (SELECT DISTINCT logymd, battleid, accountid AS roleid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battle_match_step WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-21' AND /*   AND  loghms < '23:00:00' */ accountid > 0 AND level > 8 AND battleid > 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 57000 AND 57999 AND step = 100 AND pvptype IN (1, 2)), step600 AS (SELECT DISTINCT logymd, t.battleid, t.account AS roleid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_match_trace AS t WHERE t.logymd >= '2026-05-21' AND zone BETWEEN 57000 AND 57999 AND t.step_name = 'EnterBanPick' AND t.pvptype IN (1, 2)), joined AS (SELECT s3.logymd, COALESCE(a.ab_group, 'unknown') AS ab_group, s3.battleid, s3.roleid, s6.battleid AS s6_battleid FROM step320 AS s3 LEFT JOIN ab_test AS a ON a.accountid = s3.roleid LEFT JOIN step600 AS s6 ON s6.logymd = s3.logymd AND s6.battleid = s3.battleid AND s6.roleid = s3.roleid), agg AS (SELECT logymd, SUM(CASE WHEN ab_group = 'test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_match, SUM(CASE WHEN ab_group = 'test' AND NOT s6_battleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_enter, SUM(CASE WHEN ab_group = 'control' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ctrl_match, SUM(CASE WHEN ab_group = 'control' AND NOT s6_battleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ctrl_enter FROM joined WHERE ab_group IN ('test', 'control') GROUP BY logymd) SELECT logymd AS 日期, test_match AS test_匹配成功, test_enter AS test_进入选角, ROUND(test_enter * 100.0 / NULLIF(test_match, 0), 2) AS test_成局率, ctrl_match AS control_匹配成功, ctrl_enter AS control_进入选角, ROUND(ctrl_enter * 100.0 / NULLIF(ctrl_match, 0), 2) AS control_成局率, ROUND(test_enter * 100.0 / NULLIF(test_match, 0) - ctrl_enter * 100.0 / NULLIF(ctrl_match, 0), 2) AS 成局率差值_pct FROM agg ORDER BY logymd

name: dcbughou_openui_perday
sql_units: /* ===================================================================== */ /* UI 打开内存聚合查询 */ /* 按"日期 × UI 类型 × 内存档"分组,只统计 PSS 上报有效的样本 */ /* 上报触发逻辑(UtilUIPerformanceCollect.cs): */ /*   仅以下 UI 的"打开完成 → 关闭"全周期会触发 GetOpenCompleteMemory/GetDeActiveMemory: */ /*     2002 活动 / 2037 商店 / 2072 英雄 / 2086 排位 / 2206 背包 / 2221 个人资料 */ /*     2280 战备 / 2493 邮件 / 77  排行 / 10793 星光 / 10813 日常 / 11297 收藏 */ /*   且需要服务器开关 bReportPss = true 才会写 reportpoint='modelpanel' 并填 openedpss/closedpss */ /* 单位陷阱(代码 typo,upstream 没修): */ /*   openedpss      = dic[TotalPss]        → 单位 KB        → SQL 里 / 1024 转 MB */ /*   closedpss      = dic[TotalPss] / 1024 → 单位 MB        → SQL 里直接用 */ /*   open*memory   = dic[Java|Native|...]  → 单位 KB        → SQL 里 / 1024 转 MB */ /*   closed*memory = dic[Java|Native|...]  → 单位 KB        → SQL 里 / 1024 转 MB (注意只有 PSS 这一对不一致) */ /*   beforeopenpss = 永远 0                → BeforePssMemory 字段没人赋值,占位 */ /*   open/close unity / mono / lua         → 客户端已转 MB */ /* 关于 java/native/code/stack/graphics/privateother/system/swap: */ /*   上报受 bReportMemoryDetail 开关控制(独立于 bReportPss),目前线上多数是 0 */ /*   `详细内存样本数` 列可以判断这一格里有多少行实际带细分项 */ /* ===================================================================== */ SELECT logymd AS t /* 分天 */, reportclasspoint AS ui_type /* 形如 'UI_Activity&2002' */, CASE WHEN CEIL(devicesystemmemory / 1024.0) <= 2 THEN '0G-2G' WHEN CEIL(devicesystemmemory / 1024.0) < 6 THEN '2G-6G' WHEN CEIL(devicesystemmemory / 1024.0) >= 6 THEN '6G' ELSE 'else' END AS mem, COUNT(1) AS num, ROUND(AVG(startup_time), 2) AS `启动时长`, ROUND(AVG(openedpss / 1024.0), 2) AS `打开时Pss` /* ======================== PSS(核心) ======================== */ /* openedpss 上报为 KB(注意),closedpss 上报为 MB */, ROUND(AVG(closedpss), 2) AS `关闭后Pss`, ROUND(AVG(openedpss / 1024.0) - AVG(closedpss), 2) AS `Pss开-关差` /* 关闭时已释放的内存 */, ROUND(AVG(openunity), 2) AS `打开前Unity` /* beforeopenpss 在客户端代码里没人赋值,恒为 0,跳过 */ /* ======================== Unity / Mono / Lua(客户端已转 MB) ======================== */ /* 实际是 BeforeOpenUnity */, ROUND(AVG(closeunity), 2) AS `关闭后Unity`, ROUND(AVG(openedmaxusedunity), 2) AS `打开峰值Unity`, ROUND(AVG(closeunity - openunity), 2) AS `Unity净增` /* 关闭后没释放回去的 Unity */, ROUND(AVG(beforeopenusedmono), 2) AS `打开前Mono`, ROUND(AVG(closedusedmono), 2) AS `关闭后Mono`, ROUND(AVG(closedusedmono - beforeopenusedmono), 2) AS `Mono净增`, ROUND(AVG(beforeopenlua), 2) AS `打开前Lua`, ROUND(AVG(closedlua), 2) AS `关闭后Lua`, ROUND(AVG(closedlua - beforeopenlua), 2) AS `Lua净增`, ROUND(AVG(openjavamemory / 1024.0), 2) AS `打开时java` /* ======================== Android dict 细分项(KB → MB) ======================== */ /* 受 bReportMemoryDetail 开关控制,关闭时全部为 0 */, ROUND(AVG(closedjavamemory / 1024.0), 2) AS `关闭后java`, ROUND(AVG(opennativememory / 1024.0), 2) AS `打开时native`, ROUND(AVG(closednativememory / 1024.0), 2) AS `关闭后native`, ROUND(AVG(opencodememory / 1024.0), 2) AS `打开时code`, ROUND(AVG(closedcodememory / 1024.0), 2) AS `关闭后code`, ROUND(AVG(openstackmemory / 1024.0), 2) AS `打开时stack`, ROUND(AVG(closedstackmemory / 1024.0), 2) AS `关闭后stack`, ROUND(AVG(opengraphicmemory / 1024.0), 2) AS `打开时graphics`, ROUND(AVG(closedgraphicmemory / 1024.0), 2) AS `关闭后graphics`, ROUND(AVG(openprivateothermemory / 1024.0), 2) AS `打开时privateother`, ROUND(AVG(closedprivateothermemory / 1024.0), 2) AS `关闭后privateother`, ROUND(AVG(opensystemmemory / 1024.0), 2) AS `打开时system`, ROUND(AVG(closedsystemmemory / 1024.0), 2) AS `关闭后system`, ROUND(AVG(openswapmemory / 1024.0), 2) AS `打开时swap`, ROUND(AVG(closedswapmemory / 1024.0), 2) AS `关闭后swap`, COUNT(IF(opencodememory > 0, 1, NULL)) AS `细分项样本数` /* 细分项实际有值的样本数(用 opencodememory > 0 判断,因为 java/native 可能被 hardcoded 为 0) */, ROUND(AVG(avgfps), 2) AS avgfps /* ======================== FPS / 卡顿 ======================== */, ROUND(AVG(targetframe), 2) AS targetframe, ROUND(AVG(lastforframe), 2) AS lastforframe, ROUND(AVG(jankcount), 2) AS jankcount, ROUND(AVG(bigjankcount), 2) AS bigjankcount, ROUND(AVG(outtime42count), 2) AS outtime42count, ROUND(AVG(outtime84count), 2) AS outtime84count, ROUND(AVG(outtime125count), 2) AS outtime125count, ROUND(AVG(CAST(p1 AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS `总时长ms` /* ======================== 打开耗时(ms) ======================== */ /* 上报字段顺序: p5=activeCount, p4=loadtime, p3=initViewtime, p2=activetime, p1=totaltime */, ROUND(AVG(CAST(p2 AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS `激活时长ms`, ROUND(AVG(CAST(p3 AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS `初始化时长ms`, ROUND(AVG(CAST(p4 AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS `加载时长ms`, ROUND(AVG(CAST(p5 AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS `打开次数`, ROUND(AVG(devicesystemmemory), 2) AS `设备总内存MB` /* ======================== 设备 / 画质 ======================== */, ROUND(AVG(realpicturequality), 2) AS `推荐画质`, ROUND(AVG(nowpicturequality), 2) AS `当前画质`, ROUND(AVG(isdownload), 2) AS `下载完成率`, ROUND(AVG(IF(maincitytype = '3D', 1, 0)), 2) AS `3D主界面占比` /* 主界面类型分布(2D / 3D) */ FROM name: aily2
sql_units: /* 广场用户机型分布（已满足内存≥2400MB）-- 使用英文列别名 */ SELECT CASE WHEN t.logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-13' AND '2026-03-17' THEN 'S5.0' WHEN t.logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-18' AND '2026-04-14' THEN 'S5.1' WHEN t.logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-15' AND '2026-05-12' THEN 'S5.2' WHEN t.logymd >= '2026-05-13' THEN 'S6' END AS version, COALESCE(p.realpicturequality, '0') AS device_level, COUNT(DISTINCT t.roleid) AS themepark_user_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT t.roleid) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT t.roleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN t.logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-13' AND '2026-03-17' THEN 'S5.0' WHEN t.logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-18' AND '2026-04-14' THEN 'S5.1' WHEN t.logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-15' AND '2026-05-12' THEN 'S5.2' WHEN t.logymd >= '2026-05-13' THEN 'S6' END), 4) AS percentage FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_themepark_enter_scene AS t INNER JOIN mcgg_ods.gameserver_login AS l ON t.roleid = l.roleid AND t.zoneid = l.zoneid AND t.logymd = l.logymd INNER JOIN mcgg_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance_mc AS p ON l.roleid = p.accountid AND t.logymd = p.logymd AND t.zoneid = p.zoneid WHERE t.logymd >= '2026-02-13' AND t.logymd <= '2026-05-25' AND l.logymd >= '2026-02-13' AND l.logymd <= '2026-05-25' AND p.logymd >= '2026-02-13' AND p.logymd <= '2026-05-25' AND t.zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 8999 AND p.realpicturequality IN ('1', '2', '3', '4') AND p.systemmemorysize >= 2400 AND p.level >= 12 GROUP BY CASE WHEN t.logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-13' AND '2026-03-17' THEN 'S5.0' WHEN t.logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-18' AND '2026-04-14' THEN 'S5.1' WHEN t.logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-15' AND '2026-05-12' THEN 'S5.2' WHEN t.logymd >= '2026-05-13' THEN 'S6' END, COALESCE(p.realpicturequality, '0') ORDER BY version, device_level

sql_units: SELECT COUNT(*) AS battle_num /* concat(split(battle_svr_ip,'\.')[0],'.',split(battle_svr_ip,'\.')[1],'.',split(battle_svr_ip,'\.')[2],'.','0/24')ipc, */, GEOIP(clientip, 1) AS country, GEOIP(clientip, 2) AS state, AVG(CASE WHEN (ping120 + ping150 + ping200 + ping300 + ping500 + ping800) / ping_times <= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_good, AVG(IF(smallreconnect_num / (battletime / 600) <= 1, 1, 0) + IF(movelag / (battletime / 600) <= 4, 1, 0) + IF((ping80 / ping_times) >= 0.95, 1, 0)) AS net_sc, logymd FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE timedelay > 0 AND timedelay < 50000 AND maxdelay < 500000 AND timedelay <> 10000 AND ping_times <> 0 AND movelag < 10000 AND isvalid = 1 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) <> 57 AND logymd >= '2025-02-20' AND GEOIP(clientip, 1) IN ('FR', 'DE') /* and floor(battlesvrid/1000)=147 */ GROUP BY logymd, state, country

sql_units: WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, GEOIP(create_ip, 2) AS ip_region FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND register_date <= '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND zoneid < 57000 AND first_mt_country IN ('in', 'IN') AND GEOIP(create_ip, 1) IN ('in', 'IN')), dau_by_state AS (SELECT b.logymd, a.ip_region, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid) AS DAU FROM basic AS a INNER JOIN mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE b.logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND b.appid = 'mlbb' AND b.is_ai = 0 GROUP BY b.logymd, a.ip_region) SELECT DATE(logymd) AS logymd, ip_region, DAU FROM dau_by_state ORDER BY logymd, ip_region

sql_units: WITH seg_totals AS (SELECT register_month, COUNT(*) AS cohort_size_sample FROM ml_temp.aprilgao_2022id_cohort_sample GROUP BY register_month), monthly_active AS (SELECT c.register_month, SUBSTRING(a.logymd, 1, 7) AS year_month, a.roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.logymd) AS active_days FROM ml_temp.teemoyu_dau_20240516_featrue_01 AS a INNER JOIN ml_temp.aprilgao_2022id_cohort_sample AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2026-05-25' AND a.zoneid > 0 AND a.zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY c.register_month, SUBSTRING(a.logymd, 1, 7), a.roleid) SELECT m.register_month, m.year_month, (CAST(SUBSTRING(m.year_month, 1, 4) AS INT) - CAST(SUBSTRING(m.register_month, 1, 4) AS INT)) /* 注册后第 N 个月（0 = 注册当月） */ * 12 + (CAST(SUBSTRING(m.year_month, 6, 2) AS INT) - CAST(SUBSTRING(m.register_month, 6, 2) AS INT)) AS months_since_register, s.cohort_size_sample, COUNT(DISTINCT m.roleid) AS active_users, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT m.roleid) * 100.0 / s.cohort_size_sample, 2) AS retention_pct, ROUND(SUM(m.active_days) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.roleid), 2) AS avg_active_days FROM monthly_active AS m JOIN seg_totals AS s ON m.register_month = s.register_month GROUP BY m.register_month, m.year_month, s.cohort_size_sample ORDER BY m.register_month, m.year_month

Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH tag_info AS (SELECT MIN(logymd) AS logymd, accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, param_version, param_name FROM mcgg_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND param_name LIKE '%aimatch%' AND param_version <> '' GROUP BY accountid, old_zoneid, param_version, param_name), ab_group AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.param_version, vid, param_name, big_rank, b.enter_date, CASE WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) = 57 THEN 'test' WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) < 57 THEN 'prod' END AS env FROM (SELECT t1.logymd AS enter_date, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, CASE WHEN param_version = MAX(param_version) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) THEN '实验组' WHEN param_version = MIN(param_version) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) THEN '对照组' END AS param_version, param_version AS vid, param_name, MAX(big_rank) AS big_rank FROM tag_info AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'a.勇士' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 'b.精英' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 6 AND 9 THEN 'c.大师' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 10 AND 16 THEN 'd.宗师' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 17 AND 25 THEN 'e.史诗' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN 'f.传奇' WHEN final_rank_id = 36 THEN 'g.神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 37 THEN 'h.百战神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 38 THEN 'i.荣耀神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 39 THEN 'j.至尊神话' END) AS big_rank, roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_temp.daily_final_rank_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.logymd = t2.logymd GROUP BY t1.logymd, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, param_version, param_name) AS b JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS a ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.logymd >= b.enter_date JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, param_version FROM (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.param_version, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS ttcnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(groupsel = 23, battleid, NULL)) AS battle23_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(groupsel = 23, battleid, NULL)) / COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS rate FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, groupsel, logymd, param_version FROM mcgg_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) AS a JOIN tag_info AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.param_version = b.param_version AND a.logymd >= b.logymd GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.param_version) WHERE rate >= STRUCT(STRUCT(rate))) AS c ON b.roleid = c.accountid AND b.vid = c.param_version GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.enter_date /* 进组 */, b.param_version, vid, param_name, big_rank, CASE WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) = 57 THEN 'test' WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) < 57 THEN 'prod' END), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS active_date FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_ab_activity_retention_inner PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT param_name, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.enter_date) AS day_diff, a.param_version, a.vid, a.big_rank, a.env, c.user_tag, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid) AS total_users, COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid) AS retention_count FROM ab_group AS a LEFT JOIN active AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, user_tag, p_date, param_version FROM mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_active_tag_info_gaoy WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31') AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.enter_date = c.p_date AND a.vid = c.param_version GROUP BY param_name, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.enter_date), a.param_version, a.vid, a.big_rank, a.env, c.user_tag

'10752', '10753') AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-25' AND '2026-03-31' AND old_zoneid < 57000) AS a1 LEFT JOIN (/* 长期观测名单 */ SELECT accountid, old_zoneid FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE param_value = '__MTTD_INTERNAL_LONG_OBSERVE_GROUP__' AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-04-02' AND old_zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY accountid, old_zoneid) AS a2 ON a1.roleid = a2.accountid AND a1.zoneid = a2.old_zoneid WHERE a2.accountid IS NULL AND a2.old_zoneid IS NULL) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t1 /* ,time */ /* ,logymd */ AS (SELECT MIN(time) AS sign_time /* min(logymd) as logymd, --玩家签约时间 */, roleid, zoneid, hero_id /* 签约英雄 */ /* , sign_seq --签约序号 */ /* ,sign_count --签约剩余次数 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_season_hero_pool_sign WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND season_id = 40 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, hero_id), t2 AS (SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t1.hero_id /* 签约英雄 */, t1.sign_time /* 签约日期 */ FROM t0 INNER JOIN t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid /* 玩家粒度非玩家英雄粒度 */ GROUP BY t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t1.hero_id /* 签约英雄 */, t1.sign_time /* 签约日期 */), t3 AS (SELECT time /* logymd, */, accountid, zoneid, heroid, battleid, pvptype, wincamp FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype = 2 AND /*   IN (1, 2, 4) */ fake_ai = 0 AND isinvalidbattle = 0 GROUP BY time /* logymd, */, accountid, zoneid, heroid, battleid, pvptype, wincamp) /* , */ /* t4 as */ /* --签约后首次使用签约英雄的胜率 */ /* ( */ SELECT hero_id /* 签约英雄 */, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, battleid) AS battle_cnt /* is_use_hero,--是否在1、2、4外使用该英雄 */ /* pvptype,--战斗模式 */ /* 战斗人场 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wincamp = 1 THEN CONCAT(roleid, '-', zoneid, '-', battleid) END) AS win_cnt /* 胜利人场 t3.battleid */ /* from t4  */ /* inner join t3 on t4.frist_use_time=t3.`time` and t4.hero_id=t3.heroid and t4.roleid=t3.accountid and t4.zoneid=t3.zoneid */ /* ) */ /* select    */ /*     hero_id, */ /*     count(distinct battleid,accountid,zoneid) as battle_cnt, */ /*     count(distinct case when wincamp=1 then concat(battleid,'-',accountid,'-',zoneid) end) as win_cnt */ /* from t5 */ /* group by sql_units: /* ============================================================================ */ /* 抽奖体验监控 · 按抽数轮次累积代币聚合看板 */ /* 表名：ml_temp.lottery_per_round_dashboard_di */ /* 粒度：(activity, test_group, r_label, total_draw_num) */ /*   ★ 与 bucket 看板不同：本表 X 轴是「每一抽」(1,2,3,...)，不是 10 连桶 */ /* 分区：(logymd, actid) */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* 输入参数（与 bucket 中间表一致）： */ /* [ */ /*     {"order": 1, "name": "activity_name",       "paramValue": "26年斋月SP抽奖",         "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 2, "name": "act_id_num",          "paramValue": "2601280303",             "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 3, "name": "user_enter_time",     "paramValue": "2026-02-18",             "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 4, "name": "activity_start_time", "paramValue": "2026-02-20",             "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 5, "name": "groups_id",           "paramValue": "3022,3023,3024,3025",    "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 6, "name": "control_group_id",    "paramValue": "3022",                   "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 7, "name": "item_id",             "paramValue": "27043",                  "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 8, "name": "expected_per_draw",   "paramValue": "10.70675",               "type": "task_custom"} */ /* ] */ /* 2026-05-10 = 当日跑数日期，由调度系统注入 */ /* ⚠️ 与 bucket 中间表的 ★ 标注同步： */ /*   1) ★param_name_map★    实验组 param_version → 中文名 CASE WHEN */ /*   2) ★bonus_reward_map★  抽数特殊奖励 CASE WHEN（默认全 0） */ /* 设计要点（BI 维度变换友好）： */ /*   每行只存「可加和」字段：uv（用户数）+ sum_cumulative_crest（累积代币求和） */ /*   BI 端在任意维度组合下，都用 SUM/SUM 算加权平均，结果与最细粒度一致 */ /*   expected_cumulative_crest 仅依赖 total_draw_num（必须保留为维度），是常数 */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* DDL：仅首次部署执行一次 */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ml_temp.lottery_per_round_dashboard_di ( */ /*     activity_name              STRING, */ /*     test_group                 BIGINT   COMMENT 'ABTest param_version', */ /*     test_group_name            STRING   COMMENT '实验组中文名', */ /*     is_control                 INT      COMMENT '1=对照组', */ /*     r_label                    STRING   COMMENT '前 3 个月日均耗钻分层', */ /*     total_draw_num             BIGINT   COMMENT '第 N 抽（X 轴粒度，1,2,3,...）', */ /*     uv                         BIGINT   COMMENT '该 (test_group, r_label) 下达到第 N 抽的用户数', */ /*     sum_cumulative_crest       BIGINT   COMMENT '上述用户在第 N 抽末的累积代币之和', */ /*     expected_cumulative_crest  DOUBLE   COMMENT '= total_draw_num × expected_per_draw（常数，per row）' */ /* ) */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING, actid STRING) STORED AS parquet */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* 每日例行写入 */ /* ============================================================================ */ WITH draw_detail /* 1. 抽奖明细（同 bucket 中间表口径） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, total_draw_num, (CASE WHEN total_draw_num = 160 THEN 0 WHEN total_draw_num = 190 THEN 0 ELSE 0 END /* ★bonus_reward_map★ 抽数特殊奖励（默认全 0，每期按需更新） */ + CAST(IF(reward LIKE '%27043%', SUBSTRING(SPLIT(reward, ':')[1], 1, INT(LENGTH(SPLIT(reward, ':')[1]) - 1)), is_tranfer) AS BIGINT)) AS single_draw_crest FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_surpriselottery WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-03-26' AND act_id = 2601280303 AND zoneid < 57000 AND bonus = 0 AND draw_num > 0 AND ((CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 2001 AND 3999) OR (CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 8001 AND 19999))), ab_test /* 2. ABTest 实验组（★param_name_map★ 每期更新） */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT accountid AS roleid, param_version, CASE WHEN param_version = 3022 THEN '对照组' WHEN param_version = 3023 THEN '实时模型' WHEN param_version = 3024 THEN '实时模型+每日惊喜抽奖券' WHEN param_version = 3025 THEN '实时模型（兜底）' ELSE '其他' END AS test_group_name FROM ml_ods.abtestserver_abtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-18' AND '2026-03-26' AND param_version IN (3022, 3023, 3024, 3025)), r_label_t /* 3. 用户耗钻分层 */ AS (SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 > 0 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 2 THEN '1.(0,2)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 2 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 5 THEN '2.[2,5)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 5 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 10 THEN '3.[5,10)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 10 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 20 THEN '4.[10,20)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 20 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 30 THEN '5.[20,30)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 30 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 50 THEN '6.[30,50)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 50 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 100 THEN '7.[50,100)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 100 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 200 THEN '8.[100,200)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 200 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 500 THEN '9.[200,500)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 500 THEN '10.[500+)' ELSE '0' END AS r_label FROM (SELECT roleid, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num_sum FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-02-20', 91 * -1) AND DATE_ADD('2026-02-20', 1 * -1) AND NOT operate IN ('gm') AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid)), draw_cum /* 4. 每抽累积代币（每用户每抽一行，cum_crest = 截至该抽的累积） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, total_draw_num, SUM(single_draw_crest) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY total_draw_num ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_crest FROM draw_detail) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.lottery_per_round_dashboard_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-03-26', actid = '2601280303') /* 5. 按 (test_group, r_label, total_draw_num) 聚合 */ SELECT '26年斋月SP抽奖' AS activity_name, ab.param_version AS test_group, ab.test_group_name AS test_group_name, IF(ab.param_version = 3022, 1, 0) AS is_control, COALESCE(rl.r_label, '0') AS r_label, d.total_draw_num, COUNT(*) AS uv, SUM(d.cum_crest) AS sum_cumulative_crest, d.total_draw_num * 11.84 AS expected_cumulative_crest FROM draw_cum AS d INNER JOIN ab_test AS ab ON d.roleid = ab.roleid LEFT JOIN r_label_t AS rl ON d.roleid = rl.roleid GROUP BY ab.param_version, ab.test_group_name, IF(ab.param_version = 3022, 1, 0), COALESCE(rl.r_label, '0'), d.total_draw_num
