sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: terryyang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-14 16:16:40.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* 抽奖体验监控 · 用户-轮次桶粒度中间表 */ /* 表名：ml_temp.terryyang_lottery_user_exp_bucket_di */ /* 粒度：(roleid, zoneid, ten_round) — 一个用户在一个 10 连桶里一行 */ /* 分区：(logymd, actid) */ /* 调度：每日例行，活动开启前 1 天填参数后启动 */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* 输入参数： */ /* [ */ /*     {"order": 1, "name": "activity_name",       "paramValue": "26年斋月SP抽奖",         "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 2, "name": "act_id_num",          "paramValue": "2601280303",             "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 3, "name": "user_enter_time",     "paramValue": "2026-02-18",             "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 4, "name": "activity_start_time", "paramValue": "2026-02-20",             "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 5, "name": "groups_id",           "paramValue": "3022,3023,3024,3025",    "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 6, "name": "control_group_id",    "paramValue": "3022",                   "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 7, "name": "item_id",             "paramValue": "27043",                  "type": "task_custom"} */ /* ] */ /* 2026-05-10 = 当日跑数日期，由调度系统注入 */ /* ⚠️ 每期活动新建任务时，需手工更新 SQL 内的两处映射（已用 ★ 标注）： */ /*   1) ★param_name_map★    实验组 param_version → 中文名 CASE WHEN */ /*   2) ★bonus_reward_map★  抽数特殊奖励 CASE WHEN（如第 160 抽发 100 碎片等，默认全 0） */ /* ⚠️ item_id 每期不同（斋月SP=27043 / SPD=27043 / ...），填错会让代币体验指标全 0 */ /* ⚠️ 监控代币档位：crest_value ∈ {5, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20}（如需调整请同步改下方 6 处 CASE WHEN） */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* DDL：仅首次部署执行一次（⚠️ 相比旧版新增 5 组 getNcnt / max_consecN 列，需 DROP/重建） */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ml_temp.terryyang_lottery_user_exp_bucket_di ( */ /*     activity_name             STRING   COMMENT '活动名称（参数 activity_name 透传）', */ /*     test_group                BIGINT   COMMENT 'ABTest param_version', */ /*     test_group_name           STRING   COMMENT '实验组中文名（对照组 / 实时模型 / ...）', */ /*     is_control                INT      COMMENT '1=对照组 / 0=非对照组', */ /*     roleid                    BIGINT, */ /*     zoneid                    BIGINT, */ /*     r_label                   STRING   COMMENT '前 3 个月日均耗钻分层（同 dashboard 口径）', */ /*     ten_round                 BIGINT   COMMENT '10 连抽次分桶上限：10/20/30/...（CEIL(total_draw_num/10)*10）', */ /*     cumulative_crest          BIGINT   COMMENT '截至该桶末，用户活动累计获得代币数', */ /*     crest_in_bucket           BIGINT   COMMENT '该桶内获得代币数（= SUM(single_draw_crest) within ten_round）', */ /*     get5cnt_in_bucket         BIGINT   COMMENT '该桶内出现 single_draw_crest=5 的次数', */ /*     get8cnt_in_bucket         BIGINT   COMMENT '该桶内出现 single_draw_crest=8 的次数', */ /*     get10cnt_in_bucket        BIGINT   COMMENT '该桶内出现 single_draw_crest=10 的次数', */ /*     get12cnt_in_bucket        BIGINT   COMMENT '该桶内出现 single_draw_crest=12 的次数', */ /*     get15cnt_in_bucket        BIGINT   COMMENT '该桶内出现 single_draw_crest=15 的次数', */ /*     get20cnt_in_bucket        BIGINT   COMMENT '该桶内出现 single_draw_crest=20 的次数', */ /*     max_consec5_to_bucket     BIGINT   COMMENT '截至该桶末，已结束的最长「连续 5 代币」streak 长度', */ /*     max_consec8_to_bucket     BIGINT   COMMENT '截至该桶末，已结束的最长「连续 8 代币」streak 长度', */ /*     max_consec10_to_bucket    BIGINT   COMMENT '截至该桶末，已结束的最长「连续 10 代币」streak 长度', */ /*     max_consec12_to_bucket    BIGINT   COMMENT '截至该桶末，已结束的最长「连续 12 代币」streak 长度', */ /*     max_consec15_to_bucket    BIGINT   COMMENT '截至该桶末，已结束的最长「连续 15 代币」streak 长度', */ /*     max_consec20_to_bucket    BIGINT   COMMENT '截至该桶末，已结束的最长「连续 20 代币」streak 长度', */ /*     user_draws_at_bucket_end  BIGINT   COMMENT '截至该桶末，用户的累积抽数（=MAX(total_draw_num)）', */ /*     bucket_filled             INT      COMMENT '1=该桶抽满 10 抽 / 0=尾桶未满（仅诊断，不影响聚合）', */ /*     draws_in_bucket           BIGINT   COMMENT '该桶内的抽数（≤10）', */ /*     user_total_draw           BIGINT   COMMENT '用户活动累计总抽数（诊断用）' */ /* ) */ /* USING PARQUET */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING, actid STRING); */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* 每日例行写入 */ /* ============================================================================ */ WITH draw_detail /* 1. 抽奖明细：每行 = 一抽事件 */ /*    single_draw_crest = 基础代币 + 抽数特殊奖励 */ /*      基础代币 = reward 含 item_id 时取冒号后数字；否则用 is_tranfer（重复转化兜底） */ /*      抽数特殊奖励 = ★bonus_reward_map★ 每期活动按需配置，默认全 0 */ /*        例：某活动第 160 抽发 100 碎片，第 190 抽发 180 碎片 */ /*           → 把对应 THEN 0 改为 100、180 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, total_draw_num, logymd, (CASE WHEN total_draw_num = 160 THEN 0 WHEN total_draw_num = 190 THEN 0 ELSE 0 END /* ★bonus_reward_map★ 抽数特殊奖励,即里程碑累积奖励（默认全 0，每期按需更新） */ + CAST(IF(reward LIKE '%27043%', SUBSTRING(SPLIT(reward, ':')[1], 1, INT(LENGTH(SPLIT(reward, ':')[1]) - 1)), is_tranfer) AS BIGINT) /* 基础代币 */) AS single_draw_crest FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_surpriselottery WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-03-26' AND act_id = 2601280303 AND zoneid < 57000 AND bonus = 0 /* 排除祈愿值宝箱 */ AND draw_num > 0 AND ((CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 2001 AND 3999) OR (CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 8001 AND 19999))), ab_test /* 2. ABTest 实验组（仅命中 groups_id 的 roleid） */ /*    ★param_name_map★：每期活动需更新此处的中文名 CASE WHEN,且后期要更改ABtest取数的表名 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT accountid AS roleid, param_version, CASE WHEN param_version = 3022 THEN '对照组' WHEN param_version = 3023 THEN '实时模型' WHEN param_version = 3024 THEN '实时模型+每日惊喜抽奖券' WHEN param_version = 3025 THEN '实时模型（兜底）' ELSE '其他' END AS test_group_name FROM ml_ods.abtestserver_abtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-18' AND '2026-03-26' AND param_version IN (3022, 3023, 3024, 3025)), r_label_t /* 3. 用户耗钻分层（活动前 3 个月日均，与各 dashboard 文件 d2 段一致） */ AS (SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 > 0 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 2 THEN '1.(0,2)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 2 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 5 THEN '2.[2,5)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 5 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 10 THEN '3.[5,10)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 10 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 20 THEN '4.[10,20)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 20 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 30 THEN '5.[20,30)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 30 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 50 THEN '6.[30,50)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 50 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 100 THEN '7.[50,100)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 100 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 200 THEN '8.[100,200)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 200 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 500 THEN '9.[200,500)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 500 THEN '10.[500+)' ELSE '0' END AS r_label FROM (SELECT roleid, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num_sum FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-02-20', 91 * -1) AND DATE_ADD('2026-02-20', 1 * -1) AND NOT operate IN ('gm') AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid)), draw_with_bucket /* 4. 给每抽打 ten_round 桶（10、20、30、…） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, total_draw_num, single_draw_crest, logymd, CAST(CEIL(total_draw_num / 10.0) * 10 AS BIGINT) AS ten_round FROM draw_detail), bucket_stats /* 5. 桶内统计：抽数、各档代币次数(5/8/10/12/15/20)、桶内代币、桶末累积抽数 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ten_round, COUNT(*) AS draws_in_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN single_draw_crest = 5 THEN total_draw_num END) AS get5cnt_in_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN single_draw_crest = 8 THEN total_draw_num END) AS get8cnt_in_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN single_draw_crest = 10 THEN total_draw_num END) AS get10cnt_in_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN single_draw_crest = 12 THEN total_draw_num END) AS get12cnt_in_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN single_draw_crest = 15 THEN total_draw_num END) AS get15cnt_in_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN single_draw_crest = 20 THEN total_draw_num END) AS get20cnt_in_bucket, SUM(single_draw_crest) AS crest_in_bucket, MAX(total_draw_num) AS user_draws_at_bucket_end FROM draw_with_bucket GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, ten_round), user_total_draw_t /* 6. 用户活动总抽数（诊断字段） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(total_draw_num) AS user_total_draw FROM draw_detail GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), draw_cum /* 7. 每抽累计代币 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, total_draw_num, CAST(CEIL(total_draw_num / 10.0) * 10 AS BIGINT) AS ten_round, SUM(single_draw_crest) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY total_draw_num ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_crest FROM draw_detail), bucket_cum /* 8. 取每桶最末位累计 = 用户在该桶末的累计代币 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ten_round, cum_crest AS cumulative_crest FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ten_round, total_draw_num, cum_crest, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, ten_round ORDER BY total_draw_num DESC) AS rn FROM draw_cum) WHERE rn = 1), consec_flag /* 9. 连续同档代币 streak（监控档位 ∈ {5,8,10,12,15,20}） */ /*    起始判定：当前为目标档 且 上一抽 single_draw_crest <> 当前值（或为首抽） */ /*    目标档之间互相切换（如 5→8）会被切成两条 streak；目标档与非目标档切换同样切断 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, total_draw_num, single_draw_crest, CASE WHEN single_draw_crest IN (5, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_target, CASE WHEN single_draw_crest IN (5, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20) AND (LAG(single_draw_crest) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY total_draw_num) <> single_draw_crest OR LAG(single_draw_crest) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY total_draw_num) IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS start_flag FROM draw_detail), consec_grp AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, total_draw_num, single_draw_crest, is_target, CASE WHEN is_target = 1 THEN SUM(start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY total_draw_num) END AS grp_id FROM consec_flag), consec_streak /* 每条 streak 一行，透传 crest_value（同一 grp_id 内 single_draw_crest 必然相同） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, grp_id, MAX(single_draw_crest) AS crest_value, COUNT(*) AS streak_len, MIN(total_draw_num) AS streak_start, MAX(total_draw_num) AS streak_end FROM consec_grp WHERE is_target = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, grp_id), bucket_consec /* 10. 用户在每桶末，已结束的各档最长 streak（streak_end <= ten_round） */ /*     跨桶的进行中 streak 会在它结束所在的桶被记录；按 crest_value 透视为宽列 */ AS (SELECT bs.roleid, bs.zoneid, bs.ten_round, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.crest_value = 5 THEN s.streak_len END), 0) AS max_consec5_to_bucket, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.crest_value = 8 THEN s.streak_len END), 0) AS max_consec8_to_bucket, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.crest_value = 10 THEN s.streak_len END), 0) AS max_consec10_to_bucket, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.crest_value = 12 THEN s.streak_len END), 0) AS max_consec12_to_bucket, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.crest_value = 15 THEN s.streak_len END), 0) AS max_consec15_to_bucket, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.crest_value = 20 THEN s.streak_len END), 0) AS max_consec20_to_bucket FROM bucket_stats AS bs LEFT JOIN consec_streak AS s ON bs.roleid = s.roleid AND bs.zoneid = s.zoneid AND s.streak_end <= bs.ten_round GROUP BY bs.roleid, bs.zoneid, bs.ten_round) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.lottery_user_exp_bucket_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-03-26', actid = '2601280303') /* 最终拼装 */ SELECT '26年斋月SP抽奖' AS activity_name, ab.param_version AS test_group, ab.test_group_name AS test_group_name, IF(ab.param_version = 3022, 1, 0) AS is_control, bs.roleid, bs.zoneid, COALESCE(rl.r_label, '0') AS r_label, bs.ten_round, COALESCE(bc.cumulative_crest, 0) AS cumulative_crest, COALESCE(bs.crest_in_bucket, 0) AS crest_in_bucket, COALESCE(bs.get5cnt_in_bucket, 0) AS get5cnt_in_bucket, COALESCE(bs.get8cnt_in_bucket, 0) AS get8cnt_in_bucket, COALESCE(bs.get10cnt_in_bucket, 0) AS get10cnt_in_bucket, COALESCE(bs.get12cnt_in_bucket, 0) AS get12cnt_in_bucket, COALESCE(bs.get15cnt_in_bucket, 0) AS get15cnt_in_bucket, COALESCE(bs.get20cnt_in_bucket, 0) AS get20cnt_in_bucket, COALESCE(bk.max_consec5_to_bucket, 0) AS max_consec5_to_bucket, COALESCE(bk.max_consec8_to_bucket, 0) AS max_consec8_to_bucket, COALESCE(bk.max_consec10_to_bucket, 0) AS max_consec10_to_bucket, COALESCE(bk.max_consec12_to_bucket, 0) AS max_consec12_to_bucket, COALESCE(bk.max_consec15_to_bucket, 0) AS max_consec15_to_bucket, COALESCE(bk.max_consec20_to_bucket, 0) AS max_consec20_to_bucket, bs.user_draws_at_bucket_end, IF(bs.draws_in_bucket >= 10, 1, 0) AS bucket_filled, bs.draws_in_bucket, COALESCE(ut.user_total_draw, 0) AS user_total_draw FROM bucket_stats AS bs INNER JOIN ab_test AS ab ON bs.roleid = ab.roleid /* 仅保留命中实验组的用户 */ LEFT JOIN r_label_t AS rl ON bs.roleid = rl.roleid LEFT JOIN bucket_cum AS bc ON bs.roleid = bc.roleid AND bs.zoneid = bc.zoneid AND bs.ten_round = bc.ten_round LEFT JOIN bucket_consec AS bk ON bs.roleid = bk.roleid AND bs.zoneid = bk.zoneid AND bs.ten_round = bk.ten_round LEFT JOIN user_total_draw_t AS ut ON bs.roleid = ut.roleid AND bs.zoneid = ut.zoneid

sql_units: /* ============================================================================ */ /* 抽奖体验监控 · BI 按桶聚合底表 */ /* 表名：ml_temp.terryyang_lottery_bi_dashboard_di */ /* 粒度：(activity, test_group, r_label, ten_round) × metric_kind 行 */ /* 分区：(logymd, actid) */ /* 上游：ml_temp.lottery_user_exp_bucket_di（必须先跑完） */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* 输入参数： */ /* [ */ /*     {"order": 1, "name": "act_id_num",        "paramValue": "2601280303",  "type": "task_custom"}, */ /*     {"order": 2, "name": "expected_per_draw", "paramValue": "11.84",    "type": "task_custom"} */ /* ] */ /* 2026-05-10 = 当日跑数日期，由调度系统注入 */ /* 表行格式（长格式，按 metric_kind 区分）： */ /*   metric_kind = 'AGG'             每个 (activity,test_group,r_label,ten_round) 一行，装聚合指标 */ /*   metric_kind = 'CONSEC{N}_DIST'  每个 max_consec{N}_to_bucket 取值一行，装连续 N 代币 streak 分布 */ /*   metric_kind = 'GET{N}CNT_DIST'  每个 get{N}cnt_in_bucket    取值一行，装桶内 N 代币次数分布 */ /*   ⚠️ N ∈ {5, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20}（与上游 user_exp 表 6 档列严格对应） */ /* BI 工具按 metric_kind 过滤即可切出对应图表： */ /*   ★ 用户原始 7 个指标 */ /*     指标 1 (连续N代币用户数分布)： metric_kind='CONSEC{N}_DIST'，metric_value=streak长度，row_uv=用户数 */ /*     指标 2 (10连内N代币次数分布)： metric_kind='GET{N}CNT_DIST'，metric_value=N代币次数，row_uv=用户数 */ /*                                    （N=5 即原指标 1/2，向后兼容；N=8/10/12/15/20 为新增） */ /*     指标 3 (每轮次累积代币数)：    metric_kind='AGG'，avg_cumulative_crest */ /*     指标 4 (对照组累积代币数)：    metric_kind='AGG'，control_avg_cumulative_crest */ /*     指标 5 (期望累积代币)：        metric_kind='AGG'，expected_cumulative_crest = AVG(user_draws_at_bucket_end) × expected_per_draw */ /*     指标 6 (实际vs期望差)：        metric_kind='AGG'，diff_vs_expected */ /*     指标 7 (实际vs对照差)：        metric_kind='AGG'，diff_vs_control */ /*   ★ 桶内抽均代币（新增 5 列） */ /*     指标 8  (桶内抽均代币)：           metric_kind='AGG'，avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket */ /*     指标 9  (对照组桶内抽均)：         metric_kind='AGG'，control_avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket */ /*     指标 10 (期望抽均=参数本身)：      metric_kind='AGG'，expected_per_draw_crest */ /*     指标 11 (桶内抽均vs期望差)：       metric_kind='AGG'，diff_per_draw_vs_expected */ /*     指标 12 (桶内抽均vs对照差)：       metric_kind='AGG'，diff_per_draw_vs_control */ /* ⚠️ 部分桶不过滤：用户只抽 2 抽 → 计入 ten_round=10；抽 143 抽 → 最后 3 抽计入 ten_round=150 */ /* ⚠️ 桶内抽均代币用 SUM 加权口径：avg_per_draw = SUM(crest_in_bucket) / SUM(draws_in_bucket) */ /*    （等于把每一抽都视为同等权重；与单抽期望 expected_per_draw 直接可比） */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* DDL：仅首次部署执行一次 */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ml_temp.terryyang_lottery_bi_dashboard_di ( */ /*     activity_name                          STRING, */ /*     test_group                             BIGINT   COMMENT 'ABTest param_version', */ /*     test_group_name                        STRING   COMMENT '实验组中文名', */ /*     is_control                             INT      COMMENT '1=对照组', */ /*     r_label                                STRING, */ /*     ten_round                              BIGINT, */ /*     metric_kind                            STRING   COMMENT 'AGG | CONSEC{N}_DIST | GET{N}CNT_DIST，N ∈ {5,8,10,12,15,20}', */ /*     metric_value                           BIGINT   COMMENT 'AGG=-1 / DIST=具体值', */ /*     row_uv                                 BIGINT   COMMENT 'AGG=该桶用户数 / DIST=该 metric_value 的用户数', */ /*     -- 桶末累积代币（指标 3-7） */ /*     avg_cumulative_crest                   DOUBLE   COMMENT '指标3：该桶平均累计代币数（桶末累积）', */ /*     control_avg_cumulative_crest           DOUBLE   COMMENT '指标4：对照组同 r_label×ten_round 平均累计', */ /*     expected_cumulative_crest              DOUBLE   COMMENT '指标5：AVG(user_draws_at_bucket_end) * expected_per_draw（按桶内用户实际平均抽数算期望，而非 ten_round 上限）', */ /*     diff_vs_expected                       DOUBLE   COMMENT '指标6：avg_cumulative - expected_cumulative', */ /*     diff_vs_control                        DOUBLE   COMMENT '指标7：avg_cumulative - control_avg_cumulative', */ /*     -- 桶内抽均代币（指标 8-12，新增） */ /*     avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket           DOUBLE   COMMENT '指标8：桶内抽均代币 = SUM(crest_in_bucket)/SUM(draws_in_bucket)', */ /*     control_avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket   DOUBLE   COMMENT '指标9：对照组同 r_label×ten_round 桶内抽均代币', */ /*     expected_per_draw_crest                DOUBLE   COMMENT '指标10：期望抽均代币 = expected_per_draw 参数（常数）', */ /*     diff_per_draw_vs_expected              DOUBLE   COMMENT '指标11：avg_per_draw - expected_per_draw', */ /*     diff_per_draw_vs_control               DOUBLE   COMMENT '指标12：avg_per_draw - control_avg_per_draw' */ /* ) */ /* USING PARQUET */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING, actid STRING); */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* 每日例行写入 */ /* ============================================================================ */ WITH user_exp /* 上游：当日用户-轮次桶中间表 */ /* 注意：不过滤 bucket_filled，部分尾桶也参与聚合 */ AS (SELECT * FROM ml_temp.lottery_user_exp_bucket_di WHERE logymd = '2026-03-26' AND actid = '2601280303'), agg_bucket /* 1. 各 (test_group, r_label, ten_round) 的桶末累积 + 桶内抽均 + 桶末平均抽数 */ AS (SELECT activity_name, test_group, test_group_name, is_control, r_label, ten_round, COUNT(*) AS bucket_uv, AVG(cumulative_crest) AS avg_cumulative_crest, AVG(user_draws_at_bucket_end) AS avg_user_draws_at_bucket_end /* 桶末平均抽数：用于算期望（partial 桶 ≠ ten_round 上限） */, SUM(crest_in_bucket) /* 桶内抽均：加权（每一抽同权） */ / NULLIF(SUM(draws_in_bucket), 0) AS avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket FROM user_exp GROUP BY activity_name, test_group, test_group_name, is_control, r_label, ten_round), control_avg /* 2. 对照组同 (activity, r_label, ten_round) 的桶末累积 + 桶内抽均 */ AS (SELECT activity_name, r_label, ten_round, AVG(cumulative_crest) AS control_avg_cumulative_crest, SUM(crest_in_bucket) / NULLIF(SUM(draws_in_bucket), 0) AS control_avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket FROM user_exp WHERE is_control = 1 GROUP BY activity_name, r_label, ten_round), agg_row /* 3. AGG 行（指标 3-12） */ AS (SELECT a.activity_name, a.test_group, a.test_group_name, a.is_control, a.r_label, a.ten_round, 'AGG' AS metric_kind, CAST(-1 AS BIGINT) AS metric_value, a.bucket_uv AS row_uv, a.avg_cumulative_crest AS avg_cumulative_crest /* 指标 3-7 */, c.control_avg_cumulative_crest, a.avg_user_draws_at_bucket_end * 11.84 AS expected_cumulative_crest, a.avg_cumulative_crest - a.avg_user_draws_at_bucket_end * 11.84 AS diff_vs_expected, a.avg_cumulative_crest - c.control_avg_cumulative_crest AS diff_vs_control, a.avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket /* 指标 8-12 */, c.control_avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket, CAST(11.84 AS DOUBLE) AS expected_per_draw_crest, a.avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket - 11.84 AS diff_per_draw_vs_expected, a.avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket - c.control_avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket AS diff_per_draw_vs_control FROM agg_bucket AS a LEFT JOIN control_avg AS c ON a.activity_name = c.activity_name AND a.r_label = c.r_label AND a.ten_round = c.ten_round), dist_consec /* 4. 各档连续代币最长 streak 分布行（指标 1，N ∈ {5,8,10,12,15,20}） */ /*    用 LATERAL VIEW stack 把上游的 6 个 max_consec{N}_to_bucket 宽列竖向展开为 */ /*    (metric_kind='CONSEC{N}_DIST', metric_value=streak长度) 的多行 */ AS (SELECT activity_name, test_group, test_group_name, is_control, r_label, ten_round, metric_kind, metric_value, COUNT(*) AS row_uv, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS avg_cumulative_crest, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS control_avg_cumulative_crest, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS expected_cumulative_crest, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS diff_vs_expected, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS diff_vs_control, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS control_avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS expected_per_draw_crest, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS diff_per_draw_vs_expected, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS diff_per_draw_vs_control FROM user_exp LATERAL VIEW STACK(6, 'CONSEC5_DIST', max_consec5_to_bucket, 'CONSEC8_DIST', max_consec8_to_bucket, 'CONSEC10_DIST', max_consec10_to_bucket, 'CONSEC12_DIST', max_consec12_to_bucket, 'CONSEC15_DIST', max_consec15_to_bucket, 'CONSEC20_DIST', max_consec20_to_bucket) t AS metric_kind, metric_value GROUP BY activity_name, test_group, test_group_name, is_control, r_label, ten_round, metric_kind, metric_value), dist_getcnt /* 5. 各档 10 连内代币次数分布行（指标 2，N ∈ {5,8,10,12,15,20}） */ AS (SELECT activity_name, test_group, test_group_name, is_control, r_label, ten_round, metric_kind, metric_value, COUNT(*) AS row_uv, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS avg_cumulative_crest, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS control_avg_cumulative_crest, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS expected_cumulative_crest, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS diff_vs_expected, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS diff_vs_control, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS control_avg_per_draw_crest_in_bucket, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS expected_per_draw_crest, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS diff_per_draw_vs_expected, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS diff_per_draw_vs_control FROM user_exp LATERAL VIEW STACK(6, 'GET5CNT_DIST', get5cnt_in_bucket, 'GET8CNT_DIST', get8cnt_in_bucket, 'GET10CNT_DIST', get10cnt_in_bucket, 'GET12CNT_DIST', get12cnt_in_bucket, 'GET15CNT_DIST', get15cnt_in_bucket, 'GET20CNT_DIST', get20cnt_in_bucket) t AS metric_kind, metric_value GROUP BY activity_name, test_group, test_group_name, is_control, r_label, ten_round, metric_kind, metric_value) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.lottery_bi_dashboard_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-03-26', actid = '2601280303') SELECT * FROM agg_row UNION ALL SELECT * FROM dist_consec UNION ALL SELECT * FROM dist_getcnt

sql_units: SELECT a.logymd, b.device_type, a.rolemod, COUNT(DISTINCT a.accountid), AVG(a.playerspeed) FROM (SELECT logymd, zoneid, accountid, accountid % 2 AS rolemod, SUM(download_ressize) / SUM(download_time / 1000) AS playerspeed FROM ml_ods.connserver_resreport WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 57096 AND 57199 AND downloadtype = 1 /* 排除预下载等等只保留增量下载 */ AND download_errortype = 0 /* 只看20Mb上报的行 */ AND issuccess <> '1' /* 只看20Mb上报的行 */ AND download_time > 0 /* 排脏数据 */ AND download_averagespeed BETWEEN 0 AND 1024 * 20 /* 排脏数据?? */ AND ostype = 2 /* and     level<3 */ GROUP BY logymd, zoneid, accountid, rolemod) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT logymd, zoneid, accountid, CASE WHEN CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) > 0 AND CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) < 5.7 THEN '低画质' WHEN CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) >= 5.7 AND CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) < 7.4 THEN '中画质' WHEN CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) >= 7.4 AND CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) < 9.4 THEN '高画质' WHEN CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) >= 9.4 THEN '极高画质' ELSE '未知' END AS device_type FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_configuration WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 57096 AND 57199 AND os_version = 2 GROUP BY logymd, zoneid, accountid, device_type) AS b ON a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.logymd = b.logymd GROUP BY a.logymd, b.device_type, a.rolemod ORDER BY a.logymd, b.device_type, a.rolemod

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_ygao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-08-08 18:22:12.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH tag_info AS (SELECT MIN(logymd) AS logymd, accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, param_version, param_name FROM mcgg_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND param_name LIKE '%aimatch%' AND param_version <> '' GROUP BY accountid, old_zoneid, param_version, param_name), match_end AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, groupsel, logymd, param_version, strategy_label FROM mcgg_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000), ab_group AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.param_version, vid, param_name, big_rank, b.enter_date, CASE WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) = 57 THEN 'test' WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) < 57 THEN 'prod' END AS env FROM (SELECT t1.logymd AS enter_date, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, CASE WHEN param_version = MAX(param_version) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) THEN '实验组' WHEN param_version = MIN(param_version) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) THEN '对照组' END AS param_version, param_version AS vid, param_name, MAX(big_rank) AS big_rank FROM tag_info AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'a.勇士' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 'b.精英' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 6 AND 9 THEN 'c.大师' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 10 AND 16 THEN 'd.宗师' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 17 AND 25 THEN 'e.史诗' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN 'f.传奇' WHEN final_rank_id = 36 THEN 'g.神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 37 THEN 'h.百战神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 38 THEN 'i.荣耀神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 39 THEN 'j.至尊神话' END) AS big_rank, roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_temp.daily_final_rank_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.logymd = t2.logymd GROUP BY t1.logymd, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, param_version, param_name) AS b JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS a ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.logymd >= b.enter_date JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, param_version FROM (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.param_version, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS ttcnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(groupsel = 24, battleid, NULL)) AS battle24_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(groupsel = 24, battleid, NULL)) / COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS rate FROM match_end AS a JOIN tag_info AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.param_version = b.param_version AND a.logymd >= b.logymd GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.param_version) WHERE rate >= STRUCT(STRUCT(rate))) AS c ON b.roleid = c.accountid AND b.vid = c.param_version GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.enter_date /* 进组 */, b.param_version, vid, param_name, big_rank, CASE WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) = 57 THEN 'test' WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) < 57 THEN 'prod' END), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS active_date FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd UNION ALL SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mcgg_strategy_ab_activity_retention_inner PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT param_name, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.enter_date) AS day_diff, a.param_version, a.vid, a.big_rank, a.env, strategy_label, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid) AS total_users, COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid) AS retention_count FROM ab_group AS a LEFT JOIN active AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, logymd, param_version, MAX(strategy_label) AS strategy_label FROM match_end GROUP BY accountid, logymd, param_version) AS d ON a.roleid = d.roleid AND a.enter_date = d.logymd AND a.vid = d.param_version GROUP BY param_name, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.enter_date), a.param_version, a.vid, a.big_rank, a.env, strategy_label

sql_units: /* ================================================================ */ /* 老玩家（注册>1年）× 年龄 逐日 DAU + 占比 */ /* IN × 2026-04-05~04-07 / 2025-04-05~04-08 每天 */ /* ================================================================ */ WITH active AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.logymd FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_active_role_zone_di AS a WHERE a.appid = 'mlbb' AND UPPER(a.first_mt_country) = 'IN' AND ((a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-05' AND '2026-04-07') OR (a.logymd BETWEEN '2025-04-05' AND '2025-04-08'))), dim_basic AS (SELECT roleid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE appid = 'mlbb' AND logymd = '2026-05-30' AND UPPER(first_mt_country) = 'IN'), active_dedup AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.logymd FROM active AS a INNER JOIN dim_basic AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.register_date) > 365 GROUP BY a.roleid, a.logymd), feat_age AS (SELECT roleid, MAX_BY(birthday, gt2) AS birthday, MAX(gt2) AS gt2 FROM ml_temp.teemoyu_dau_20240516_featrue_01 WHERE UPPER(first_mt_country) = 'IN' AND ((logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-05' AND '2026-04-07') OR (logymd BETWEEN '2025-04-05' AND '2025-04-08')) GROUP BY roleid), dim_dau AS (SELECT logymd, age_label, COUNT(*) AS dau FROM (SELECT a.logymd, CASE WHEN s.gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-01-24', s.birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN '[7,9]' WHEN s.gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-01-24', s.birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 10 AND 14 THEN '[10,14]' WHEN s.gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-01-24', s.birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 15 AND 19 THEN '[15,19]' WHEN s.gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-01-24', s.birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN '[20,24]' WHEN s.gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-01-24', s.birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN '[25,29]' WHEN s.gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-01-24', s.birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN '[30,34]' WHEN s.gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-01-24', s.birthday) / 365, 0) >= 35 THEN '[35,)' ELSE 'unknown' END AS age_label FROM active_dedup AS a LEFT JOIN feat_age AS s ON a.roleid = s.roleid) AS t GROUP BY logymd, age_label) SELECT logymd, age_label, dau, ROUND(dau / NULLIF(SUM(dau) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd), 0), 4) AS pct FROM dim_dau ORDER BY logymd, age_label

name: teemoyu_临时05
sql_units: /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ /* 核心指标汇总（进组日粒度） */ /* 实验：s57_86_ModeChoice（新版模式界面 AB 实验） */ /* 测服：zoneid >= 57000  |  周期：2026-05-28 ~ 2026-06-05 */ /* ⚠️ 实际开始：北京时间 2026-05-29 15:00（UTC+8），logymd='2026-05-28' 仅 ~1h 进组，保留 */ /* ⚠️ pvptype=11 仅 4 条，在 battle CTE 中已过滤 */ /* ⚠️ pvptype=5/6/164/2002 中文含义待确认，注释已标记 */ /* 按钮 mode_id 区分逻辑（_BigItem / _Item 同一 lobby_btn 下多个模式）： */ /*   _BigItem + mode_id IN (353,354) → 新界面 MCGG */ /*   _BigItem + mode_id = 2001       → 新界面 乱序争锋 */ /*   _Item   + mode_id = 3030        → 新界面 异序乱斗 */ /*   _Item   + mode_id = 2001        → 新界面 1v1 */ /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ WITH ab_users /* ── 进组底表 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT accountid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, param_name /* 实验名称 */, param_value /* 分组名称（control / test） */, param_version /* 分组 ID（control=11515，test=11516） */, MIN(time) AS ab_time /* 进组最早时间（用于进组后行为过滤） */, MIN(logymd) AS ab_logymd /* 进组最早日期（用于每日趋势分组） */ FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-28' AND '2026-06-05' AND param_name = 's57_86_ModeChoice' AND old_zoneid >= 57000 AND param_value IN ('control', 'test') GROUP BY accountid, old_zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version), click_raw /* ── 模式界面点击明细（含 mode_id，用于区分同一 lobby_btn 下的不同模式）── */ AS (SELECT logymd, time AS ui_click_time /* 点击时间（用于进组后过滤 & DISTINCT 去重） */, accountid, zoneid, lobby_btn /* 按钮标识 */, mode_id /* 模式 ID（区分 _BigItem/_Item 下的具体模式） */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_main_ui_click WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-28' AND '2026-06-05' AND zoneid >= 57000 AND lobby_btn IN ('24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode02' /* 新老共同 */ /* 排位赛 */, '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode01' /* 匹配 */, '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_ModeBasic' /* 自定义 */, '24Newbie_m_ModeCitizensLeagues' /* 全民赛事 */, '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode03' /* 乱斗（新老共同） */, '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode39' /* 老界面独有 */ /* 老界面 MCGG */, '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_Arcademode' /* 老界面 娱乐大厅 */, '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_RecreationalMode_BigItem' /* 新界面独有（需结合 mode_id 区分） */ /* MCGG(353/354) / 乱序争锋(2001) */, '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_RecreationalMode_Item' /* 异序乱斗(3030) / 1v1(2001) */)), battle /* ── 对局明细（排除 pvptype=11，数量仅 4 条）──────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, pvptype, battleid, time AS battle_time FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_begin WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-28' AND '2026-06-05' AND zoneid >= 57000 AND pvptype <> 11 /* 排除 pvptype=11（极少量，不纳入分析） */), total /* ── 用户粒度明细：进组后的点击次数 & 参战次数 ────────────────────── */ /* ⚠️ click × battle 双 LEFT JOIN 会产生行数膨胀（M×N 行） */ /*    通过 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ... THEN unique_id END) 消除重复计数： */ /*    · 点击：以 ui_click_time 去重（同一毫秒多次点击视为 1 次） */ /*    · 参战：以 battleid 去重（battleid 全局唯一） */ AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.param_name /* 实验名称 */, a.param_value /* 分组（control / test） */, a.param_version /* 分组 ID */, a.ab_time /* 进组最早时间 */, a.ab_logymd /* 进组最早日期 */ /* ══ 按钮点击次数（进组后，列名与 lobby_btn 保持一致）════════ */ /* ▸ 新老共同按钮 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode02' THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode02_cnt /* 排位赛点击次数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode01' THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode01_cnt /* 匹配点击次数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_ModeBasic' THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS 24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_ModeBasic_cnt /* 自定义点击次数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = 点击次数（mode_id=353/354） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_RecreationalMode_BigItem' AND b.mode_id = 2001 THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS BigItem_m2001_cnt /* 新界面 乱序争锋 点击次数（mode_id=2001） */ /* ▸ 新界面独有按钮：_Item 按 mode_id 拆分 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn = */ /* 新界面娱乐合计：MCGG(353/354) + 乱序争锋(BigItem_2001) + 异序乱斗(Item_3030) + 1v1(Item_2001) */, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn IN '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Button_Arcademode') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS old_recreational_any_click /* 老界面娱乐入口合计（MCGG+娱乐大厅，去重） */ /* 核心5v5玩法合计：匹配 + 排位赛 + 乱斗 */, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn IN ('24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode01' /* 匹配 */, '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode02' /* 排位赛 */, '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode03' /* 乱斗 */) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS core_5v5_any_click /* 核心5v5玩法合计（匹配+排位+乱斗，去重） */ /* 核心5v5点击次数合计（匹配+排位+乱斗三个按钮的点击总次数，不去重，用于人均） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.ui_click_time >= a.ab_time AND b.lobby_btn IN ('24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode01' /* 匹配 */, '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode02' /* 排位赛 */, '24Newbie_ModeChoice_m_Mode03' /* 乱斗 */) THEN b.ui_click_time END) AS core_5v5_click_cnt /* 核心5v5按钮总点击次数（用于计算人均点击次数） */ /* 核心5v5参战次数合计（pvp1+pvp2+pvp4，用于人均） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) THEN c.battleid END) AS core_5v5_battle_cnt /* 核心5v5总参战次数（匹配+排位+乱斗，用于计算人均场次） */ /* ══ 各 pvptype 参战次数（进组后）═══════════════════════════ */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 1 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp1_battle_cnt /* pvptype=1  匹配 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 2 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp2_battle_cnt /* pvptype=2  排位赛 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 4 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp4_battle_cnt /* pvptype=4  大乱斗 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 5 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp5_battle_cnt /* pvptype=5  （含义待确认） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 6 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp6_battle_cnt /* pvptype=6  （含义待确认） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 164 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp164_battle_cnt /* pvptype=164（含义待确认） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 2001 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp2001_battle_cnt /* pvptype=2001 乱序争锋 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 2002 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp2002_battle_cnt /* pvptype=2002（含义待确认） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time AND c.pvptype = 3030 THEN c.battleid END) AS pvp3030_battle_cnt /* pvptype=3030 异序乱斗 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.battle_time >= a.ab_time THEN c.battleid END) AS total_battle_cnt /* 进组后总参战次数（不含pvptype=11） */ FROM ab_users AS a LEFT JOIN click_raw AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle AS c ON a.accountid = c.accountid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.param_name, a.param_value, a.param_version, a.ab_time, a.ab_logymd) /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ /* sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jichun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-07-23 22:39:53.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mt_ads_pre`.`ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_di_mid`( */ /*             `date_range` STRING COMMENT '日期区间', */ /*             `country` STRING COMMENT '国家', */ /*             `network` STRING COMMENT '首次广告归因渠道', */ /*             `indicator_map` map<string,decimal(38,18)> COMMENT '指标集合' */ /*         ) COMMENT '经分首页boss看板-cube指标' */ /*         PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*             `logymd` STRING COMMENT '日期分区(yyy-MM-dd)', */ /*             `appname` STRING COMMENT '项目ID(mlbb,xgame)', */ /*             `granularity_type` STRING COMMENT '粒度类型(account,device)', */ /*             `date_type` STRING COMMENT '日期类型(daily,weekly,monthly)' */ /*         ) STORED AS parquet location 's3a://mt-ads-pre/table/ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_di_mid'; */ WITH basic_account AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(first_network_name, 'unknown') AS network, register_date, is_first_create FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-09-01', '2022-09-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, SUM(product_money) AS day_pay_amount, SUM(before_tax_usd_amt) AS day_pay_amount_exrate, SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid), active_di AS (SELECT roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days /* 活跃天数 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) /* AND     is_ai = 0 */ GROUP BY roleid), connserver_client_49ad_data AS (/* 月扑脸曝光总pv */ SELECT accountid, COUNT(*) AS exposure_pv FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_49ad_data /* 数据最早日期2020-06-16 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND logymd >= '2020-06-16' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 GROUP BY accountid), connserver_prompt_data AS (/* 月扑脸点击总pv */ SELECT accountid, COUNT(*) AS click_pv FROM ml_ods.connserver_prompt_data WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND logymd >= '2020-06-16' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 GROUP BY accountid), result_tbl AS (SELECT country, network, CAST(MAP('avg_active_cnt', avg_active_cnt, '2usd_pay_cnt', 2usd_pay_cnt, 'actual_pay_amt', actual_pay_amt, 'pay_amt', pay_amt, 'mau', mau, 'click_pv', click_pv, 'exposure_pv', exposure_pv, 'zeropointone_usd_pay_cnt', zeropointone_usd_pay_cnt, '1usd_pay_cnt', 1usd_pay_cnt, '5usd_pay_cnt', 5usd_pay_cnt, '10usd_pay_cnt', 10usd_pay_cnt, '20usd_pay_cnt', 20usd_pay_cnt, 'all_usd_pay_cnt', all_usd_pay_cnt) AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>) AS indicator_map FROM (SELECT bas.country, bas.network, COALESCE(SUM(active_days) / (DATEDIFF(LAST_DAY('2026-05-31'), DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01')) + 1), 0) AS avg_active_cnt /* 日均活跃天数 */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay.day_pay_amount >= 200, 1, 0)), 0) AS 2usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay.day_pay_amount >= 10, 1, 0)), 0) AS zeropointone_usd_pay_cnt /* 0728新增 */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay.day_pay_amount >= 100, 1, 0)), 0) AS 1usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay.day_pay_amount >= 500, 1, 0)), 0) AS 5usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay.day_pay_amount >= 1000, 1, 0)), 0) AS 10usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay.day_pay_amount >= 2000, 1, 0)), 0) AS 20usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay.day_pay_amount > 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS all_usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(pay.pay_net_receipts_usd_amt), 0) AS actual_pay_amt /* 0728新增 */, COALESCE(SUM(pay.day_pay_amount), 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid), 0) AS mau, COALESCE(SUM(cpd.click_pv), 0) AS click_pv, COALESCE(SUM(ccd.exposure_pv), 0) AS exposure_pv FROM basic_account AS bas LEFT JOIN active_di AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid LEFT JOIN pay_di AS pay ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid LEFT JOIN connserver_client_49ad_data AS ccd ON bas.roleid = ccd.accountid LEFT JOIN connserver_prompt_data AS cpd ON bas.roleid = cpd.accountid GROUP BY bas.country, bas.network)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads_pre.ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_di_mid PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'monthly') SELECT SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AS date_range, res.country, res.network, MAP_CONCAT(COALESCE(res.indicator_map, CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>))) AS indicator_map FROM result_tbl AS res

name: 20260601-ph-2
sql_units: /* 目的：基于 20260528 PH 宽表，按 (注册月 × 年龄桶 × 7 类目 vector) 统计 */ /*       d2/d30/d90/d360 留存 + "新增用户在注册当日的在线时长" */ /* 思路：宽表 user_flags(含 register_date) */ /*       → JOIN 留存表 jian_li_20251124_retention 取 4 个 cohort 留存 (保留原逻辑) */ /*       → JOIN mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di(logymd = register_date) 取注册当日在线时长 (新增) */ /*       → 桶聚合 */ /* 输出 schema： */ /*   register_month            varchar  注册月 'YYYY-MM' */ /*   age_group                 varchar  年龄分桶 '[7,9]'/'[10,14]'/.../'[35,)'/NULL */ /*   is_moba .. is_casual      int      7 个类目 0/1 flag */ /*   new_user_count            bigint   桶内 PH 新增用户数 */ /*   d2/d30/d90/d360_retained_count  bigint  桶内 dN 回流人数 */ /*   d0_online_user_count      bigint   桶内注册当日有在线记录的用户数 */ /*   d0_online_min_total       double   桶内注册当日在线总时长(分钟，保留1位) */ /*   d0_online_min_per_new     double   人均在线时长(按全部新增): total / new_user_count */ /*   d0_online_min_per_active  double   人均在线时长(按当日在线用户): total / d0_online_user_count */ /* 注： */ /*   1. cohort dayN 观测日 = register + (N-1)；留存表 cohort_type ∈ {day2,day7,day30,day90,day180,day360,day540} */ /*      留存表 ml_temp.jian_li_20251124_retention 按 logymd 分区；本次取 [2024-01-02, 2026-05-27] */ /*   2. mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di 按 logymd 分区，day_login_duration 为当日登录时长(假定单位=秒，/60 转分钟) */ /*      若实际单位为分钟则去掉 /60；该表按 (roleid, logymd) 粒度，多 zoneid 时按 roleid SUM 汇总 */ /*   3. 新增 register_date ∈ [2024-01-01, 2026-05-20]，故 dwm 分区扫描同范围(强制 logymd 谓词) */ WITH user_flags AS (SELECT roleid, register_date, SUBSTRING(register_date, 1, 7) AS register_month, age_group, is_moba, is_rpg, is_strategy, is_sandbox, is_shooter, is_sports, is_casual FROM ml_temp.jianli_20260528_ph_competitor WHERE NOT logymd IS NULL), retention_pivot AS (/* JOIN 下推到扫表 CTE，让 Spark broadcast 小表早过滤；只取需要的 4 个 cohort */ SELECT rt.roleid, MAX(CASE WHEN rt.cohort_type = 'day2' THEN rt.is_retained ELSE 0 END) AS d2_retained, MAX(CASE WHEN rt.cohort_type = 'day30' THEN rt.is_retained ELSE 0 END) AS d30_retained, MAX(CASE WHEN rt.cohort_type = 'day90' THEN rt.is_retained ELSE 0 END) AS d90_retained, MAX(CASE WHEN rt.cohort_type = 'day360' THEN rt.is_retained ELSE 0 END) AS d360_retained FROM ml_temp.jian_li_20251124_retention AS rt JOIN user_flags AS uf ON rt.roleid = uf.roleid WHERE rt.cohort_type IN ('day2', 'day30', 'day90', 'day360') AND rt.logymd BETWEEN '2024-01-02' AND '2026-05-27' GROUP BY rt.roleid), d0_online AS (/* JOIN 下推到扫表 CTE；只取注册当日(logymd = register_date)的在线时长 */ SELECT ar.roleid, SUM(ar.day_login_duration) AS online_sec FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di AS ar JOIN user_flags AS uf ON ar.roleid = uf.roleid AND ar.logymd = uf.register_date WHERE ar.logymd BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2026-05-20' GROUP BY ar.roleid), user_full AS (SELECT uf.roleid, uf.register_month, uf.age_group, uf.is_moba, uf.is_rpg, uf.is_strategy, uf.is_sandbox, uf.is_shooter, uf.is_sports, uf.is_casual, COALESCE(rp.d2_retained, 0) AS d2_retained, COALESCE(rp.d30_retained, 0) AS d30_retained, COALESCE(rp.d90_retained, 0) AS d90_retained, COALESCE(rp.d360_retained, 0) AS d360_retained, COALESCE(d0.online_sec, 0) AS d0_online_sec, CASE WHEN NOT d0.online_sec IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS d0_online_flag FROM user_flags AS uf LEFT JOIN retention_pivot AS rp ON uf.roleid = rp.roleid LEFT JOIN d0_online AS d0 ON uf.roleid = d0.roleid) SELECT register_month, age_group, is_moba, is_rpg, run_mcgg_dau_feature.py 在运行时替换 */ /* ============================================================ */ /* select * from mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_mcgg_dau_feature_country limit 1000; */ WITH user_country /* DAYOFWEEK(b.data_date) IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend, CAST(WEEKOFYEAR(b.data_date) AS INT) AS week_of_year, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(LAST_DAY(b.data_date), b.data_date) <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_month_end, 0 AS is_holiday /* 节假日（暂置空，与 MLBB 一致） */, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS holiday_type, 0 AS is_event_day1 /* 活动 / 赛季（MCGG 暂无飞书数据，置 0） */, 0 AS is_event_ongoing, 0 AS is_season_start, NULL AS season_day_index, 0 AS is_patch_day, CASE WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2024-03-11' AND '2024-04-09' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2025-03-01' AND '2025-03-30' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN is_ramadan_start /* 斋月前 3 天 */, CASE WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2024-04-07' AND '2024-04-09' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2025-03-28' AND '2025-03-30' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2026-03-17' '2029-02-14' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2030-02-02' AND '2030-02-04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_ramadan_end /* 斋月末 3 天 */, CASE WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2024-04-10' AND '2024-04-12' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2025-03-31' AND '2025-04-02' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2026-03-20' AND '2026-03-22' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2027-03-09' AND '2027-03-11' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2027-05-16' AND '2027-05-18' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2028-05-05' AND '2028-05-07' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2029-04-24' AND '2029-04-26' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2030-04-14' AND '2030-04-16' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2031-04-03' AND '2031-04-05' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date BETWEEN '2032-03-22' AND '2032-03-24' THEN 1 WHEN b.data_date dau_avg_14d, AVG(j.dau) OVER w28 AS dau_avg_28d, AVG(j.dau) OVER w56 AS dau_avg_56d, AVG(j.dau) OVER w168 AS dau_avg_168d, SUM(j.dau) OVER w3 AS dau_sum_3d /* DAU 窗口总和 */, SUM(j.dau) OVER w7 AS WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY j.country ORDER BY j.data_date), w3 AS (PARTITION BY j.country ORDER BY j.data_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w7 AS (PARTITION BY j.country ORDER BY sql_units: /* 先找出日活TOP5国家，然后看这些国家的新增数据 */ WITH active_user_stats AS (SELECT channel, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS country_code, logymd, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS daily_active_users FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND channel IN ('and_huawei_ag', 'and_catappult', 'and_taptap', 'and_xiaomi_getapps') AND NOT GEOIP(client_ip, 1) IS NULL GROUP BY channel, country_code, logymd), active_user_daily_avg AS (SELECT channel, country_code, AVG(daily_active_users) AS avg_daily_active_users FROM active_user_stats GROUP BY channel, country_code), active_user_top5 AS (SELECT channel, country_code, avg_daily_active_users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY avg_daily_active_users DESC) AS dau_rank FROM active_user_daily_avg), new_user_stats /* 获取所有新增用户数据 */ AS (SELECT channel, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS country_code, logymd, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS daily_new_users FROM ml_ods.gameserver_create_role WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND channel IN ('and_huawei_ag', 'and_catappult', 'and_taptap', 'and_xiaomi_getapps') AND NOT GEOIP(client_ip, 1) IS NULL GROUP BY channel, country_code, logymd), new_user_daily_avg AS (SELECT channel, country_code, AVG(daily_new_users) AS avg_daily_new_users FROM new_user_stats GROUP BY channel, country_code) /* 最终结果：日活TOP5国家及其新增数据 */ SELECT '日活TOP5国家新增' AS analysis_type, a.channel, a.country_code, a.avg_daily_active_users, COALESCE(n.avg_daily_new_users, 0) AS avg_daily_new_users, a.dau_rank FROM active_user_top5 AS a LEFT JOIN new_user_daily_avg AS n ON a.channel = n.channel AND a.country_code = n.country_code WHERE a.dau_rank <= 5 ORDER BY a.channel, a.dau_rank

sql_units: WITH assist_t AS (SELECT 1 AS match_col, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY skinid) AS rank_hero_battle FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') SELECT a.battleid, b.rank_hero_battle, leng, rank_hero_battle FROM (SELECT battleid, LENGTH(start_hero) - LENGTH(REPLACE(start_hero, CHR(59), '')) AS leng, 1 AS match_col FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_team_battle_event WHERE logymd = '2026-05-22' AND zoneid < 57000 AND battleid = 769540592262723951) AS a LEFT JOIN assist_t AS b ON a.match_col = b.match_col AND a.leng >= b.rank_hero_battle

sql_units: /* ===================================================================== */ /* ① R级 × 付费间隔 */ /* ===================================================================== */ WITH active_users AS (/* 用户池: 2026-05 整月在 mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di 的活跃用户 */ SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000), r_label_raw AS (/* 91 天耗钻分桶 → r_label (仅打标, 不限定用户域) */ SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 > 0 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 2 THEN '1.(0,2)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 2 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 5 THEN '2.[2,5)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 5 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 10 THEN '3.[5,10)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 10 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 20 THEN '4.[10,20)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 20 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 30 THEN '5.[20,30)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 30 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 50 THEN '6.[30,50)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 50 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 100 THEN '7.[50,100)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 100 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 200 THEN '8.[100,200)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 200 AND sub_num_sum / 58 < 500 THEN '9.[200,500)' WHEN sub_num_sum / 58 >= 500 THEN '10.[500+)' END AS r_label FROM (SELECT roleid, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num_sum FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-10-02' AND '2025-12-31' AND NOT operate IN ('gm') AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid)), user_pool AS (/* 给活跃用户打 R 级; 无耗钻 → '0.无消费' */ SELECT a.roleid, COALESCE(r.r_label, '0.无消费') AS r_label FROM active_users AS a LEFT JOIN r_label_raw AS r ON a.roleid = r.roleid), charge_raw AS (/* 分析窗口内合规充值流水, 同时承载付费日期 (去重到天) 和金额聚合两个用途 */ SELECT roleid, logymd AS pay_date, money FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') AND NOT money IN (0) AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%'), charge_days AS (/* 用户付费日期序列 (去重到天) */ SELECT DISTINCT roleid, pay_date FROM charge_raw), charge_intervals AS (/* 相邻两个付费日期天数差 */ SELECT roleid, DATEDIFF(pay_date, LAG(pay_date) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY pay_date)) AS gap_days FROM charge_days), user_avg_interval AS (/* 用户级: 付费天数, 平均相邻间隔 */ SELECT roleid, COUNT(*) AS pay_days, AVG(gap_days) AS avg_gap_days /* LAG 第一行为 NULL, AVG 自动忽略 */ FROM charge_intervals GROUP BY roleid), user_charge_sum AS (/* 用户级: 累计充值金额 (money 不除 100, 直接 SUM) */ SELECT roleid, SUM(money) AS charge_sum FROM charge_raw GROUP BY roleid) SELECT p.r_label AS `R级`, COUNT(DISTINCT p.roleid) AS `R级用户数`, COUNT(DISTINCT u.roleid) AS `付费用户数`, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT u.roleid) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.roleid), 0), 4) AS `付费率`, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.pay_days = 1 THEN u.roleid END) AS `仅付1天用户数`, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.pay_days >= 2 THEN u.roleid END) AS `多次付费用户数`, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN u.pay_days >= 2 THEN u.avg_gap_days END), 2) AS `相邻付费平均间隔天数`, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(CASE WHEN u.pay_days >= 2 THEN u.avg_gap_days END, 0.25), 2) AS `相邻付费间隔p25`, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(CASE WHEN u.pay_days >= 2 THEN u.avg_gap_days END, 0.50), 2) AS `相邻付费间隔p50`, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(CASE WHEN u.pay_days >= 2 THEN u.avg_gap_days END, 0.75), 2) AS `相邻付费间隔p75`, ROUND(AVG(s.charge_sum), 2) AS `付费用户人均充值金额`, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(s.charge_sum, 0.25), 2) AS `充值金额p25`, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(s.charge_sum, 0.50), 2) AS `充值金额p50`, ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(s.charge_sum, 0.75), 2) AS `充值金额p75` FROM user_pool AS p LEFT JOIN user_avg_interval AS u ON p.roleid = u.roleid LEFT JOIN user_charge_sum AS s ON p.roleid = s.roleid GROUP BY p.r_label ORDER BY p.r_label

name: teemoyu_临时06
sql_units: /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ /* 05. 在线时长 & 战斗时长分析 */ /* 实验：s57_86_ModeChoice  |  测服：zoneid >= 57000 */ /* 周期：2026-05-28 ~ 2026-06-05 */ /* ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* 指标说明： */ /*   在线时长：来自 mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di.day_login_duration（秒） */ /*   战斗时长：来自 ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end.battletime（秒） */ /*   两个指标分别跑，不要 JOIN 在一起（避免膨胀） */ /* ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* ⚠️ 进组后口径： */ /*   战斗时长：battle_end 有 time 字段，用 be.time >= ab.ab_time 精确过滤进组后对局 */ /*   在线时长：day_login_duration 是「天级聚合」时长，无法切分进组当天的进组前/后， */ /*             用 a.logymd >= ab.ab_logymd（进组日及之后）近似；进组当天含进组前少量时长 */ /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ WITH ab_users /* ── 进组底表 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT accountid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, param_value /* 分组（control / test） */, MIN(time) AS ab_time /* 进组最早时间 */, MIN(logymd) AS ab_logymd /* 进组最早日期 */ FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-28' AND '2026-06-05' AND param_name = 's57_86_ModeChoice' AND old_zoneid >= 57000 AND param_value IN ('control', 'test') GROUP BY accountid, old_zoneid, param_value), grp_total /* ── 各组进组总人数（公用分母）──────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT param_value, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS grp_cnt FROM ab_users GROUP BY param_value) /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ /* 5-2. 战斗时长（分组 × pvptype 粒度） */ /* 来源：ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end.battletime（秒） */ /* ⚠️ battleserver_battle_end 禁止 SELECT *（列级权限限制，会报 403） */ /*    只选需要的列：logymd, zoneid, accountid, pvptype, battleid, battletime */ /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ SELECT ab.param_value AS group_tag /* 实验分组 */, be.pvptype /* 对局模式 */, COUNT(DISTINCT be.battleid) AS battle_cnt /* 总对局场次 */, COUNT(DISTINCT be.accountid) AS battle_user_cnt /* 参战去重人数 */, SUM(be.battletime) AS total_battle_sec /* 总战斗时长（秒） */, ROUND(AVG(be.battletime) / 60.0, 2) AS avg_battle_min /* 场均战斗时长（分钟） */, ROUND(SUM(be.battletime) * 1.0 / /* 分组进组总人数（取 grp_total） */ MAX(t.grp_cnt), 2) AS avg_battle_sec_per_all_user /* 全量进组用户人均战斗时长（秒） */ FROM ab_users AS ab INNER JOIN (/* ⚠️ 显式列出字段，禁止 SELECT *，避免触发列级访问限制（403） */ SELECT logymd, zoneid, accountid, pvptype, battleid, battletime, time AS battle_time /* 对局开始时间（用于进组后过滤） */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-28' AND '2026-06-05' AND zoneid >= 57000 AND pvptype <> 11 /* 排除噪声 */ AND battletime > 0 /* 排除时长异常 */) AS be ON be.accountid = ab.accountid AND be.zoneid = ab.zoneid AND be.battle_time >= ab.ab_time /* ✅ 仅统计进组后的对局（进组后口径） */ LEFT JOIN grp_total AS t ON t.param_value = ab.param_value GROUP BY ab.param_value, be.pvptype ORDER BY ab.param_value, battle_cnt DESC

activedays FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df AS a RIGHT OUTER JOIN mh_ods.gameserver_login AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.appid = 'mla' WHERE b.logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY b.roleid, b.zoneid, a.adjust_country, a.adjust_network_name, b.os_type, b.channel) AS res1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, module_id, SUM(online_time) AS online_time FROM mh_ods.gameserver_module_log first_month_payment FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, online_time AS first_month_onlinetime, charge AS first_month_payment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn_desc a.adjust_country, a.adjust_network_name, b.os_type, b.channel) AS res1 FULL JOIN (SELECT a.roleid AS roleid, a.zoneid AS zoneid, a.time AS time, product_type, product_name, product_id, product_subid, AVG(money) AS money, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(SPLIT(itemid, ',')[0])) AS item_list FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, time, order_id, itemid, money FROM mh_ods.gameserver_charge LATERAL VIEW name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_performance_client_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* set hive.parquet.timestamp.skip.conversion=false; */ WITH per_log AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, os, is_highfps, is_download, is_broadcast, picture_quality, unityversion, pvptype, scene_name ORDER BY stat_time DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(LTRIM(operatingsystem), ' ', 1)) IN ('iphone', 'ipados', 'ios') THEN 'ios' WHEN LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(LTRIM(operatingsystem), ' ', 1)) = 'android' THEN 'android' ELSE 'unknown' END AS os, IF(COALESCE(ishighfps, -99999) IN (1, 0), ishighfps, COALESCE(ishighfps, -99999)) AS is_highfps, IF(COALESCE(isdownload, -99999) IN (1, 0), isdownload, COALESCE(isdownload, -99999)) AS is_download, IF(COALESCE(is_broadcast, -99999) IN (1, 0), is_broadcast, COALESCE(is_broadcast, -99999)) AS is_broadcast, nowpicturequality AS picture_quality, TRIM(unityversion) AS unityversion, pvptype, TRIM(scene_name) AS scene_name, `time` AS stat_time, freediskspace, level, jankper10min, bigjankper10min, keepdrop15Count, keepdrop125count, pss_load_before /* pss_load_end / if(pss_load_before = 0,1,pss_load_before) - 1) as pss_load_change_rate, */ /* pssmemory / if(pss_load_end = 0,1,pss_load_end) - 1) as pss_battle_change_rate, */ /* pss_load_before / if(systemmemorysize = 0,1,systemmemorysize)) as pss_sys_rate, */ /* 战斗loading时内存最低点时的pss内存 */, pss_load_end /* 战斗loading后的pss内存 */, pssmemory /* 战斗结束时Pss内存 */, gt_50, avgfps, minfps, freememory, systemmemorysize, freediskspace, gameusediskspace, devicetotalmemory, battletime, battleNum, IF(CAST(temperature AS DECIMAL(8, 1)) < 0, 0, CAST(temperature AS DECIMAL(8, 1))) AS temperature, battery FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(totalgcallocsize, 1) > 0 /* 战斗中gcalloc内存大小 */)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_performance_client_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid) SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.os, a.is_highfps, a.is_download, a.is_broadcast, a.picture_quality, a.unityversion, a.pvptype, a.scene_name, basic.register_date, COALESCE(account_info.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(account_info.last_ad_country, 'unknown') AS last_ad_country, COALESCE(account_info.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(account_info.last_mt_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, COALESCE(account_info.first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, COALESCE(account_info.last_network_name, 'unknown') AS last_network_name, COALESCE(account_info.area_id, 'unknown') AS area_id, client_battle_level, battle_cnt, jankper_duration, bigjankper_duration, keepdrop15_cnt, keepdrop125_cnt, pss_load_change_rate, pss_battle_change_rate, pss_sys_rate, pss_load_before /* 战斗loading时内存最低点时的pss内存 */, pss_load_end /* 战斗loading后的pss内存 */, pss_battle_end /* 战斗结束时Pss内存        */, gc_cnt, avgfps, minfps, free_memory, system_memorysize, free_diskspace, gameuse_diskspace, battle_duration, battle_num, device_temperature, device_battery, last_battle_time, last_battle_fds, last_battle_guds, last_battle_dtm, 'mlbb' AS appid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os, is_highfps, is_download, is_broadcast, picture_quality, unityversion, pvptype, scene_name, MAX(level) AS client_battle_level /* if(zoneid<57000,1,0) as offical_zone, */, COUNT(1) AS battle_cnt, ROUND(SUM(jankper10min) / 100, 2) AS jankper_duration, ROUND(SUM(bigjankper10min) / 100, 2) AS bigjankper_duration, SUM(CAST(keepdrop15Count AS DOUBLE)) AS keepdrop15_cnt, SUM(CAST(keepdrop125count AS DOUBLE)) AS keepdrop125_cnt, SUM(pss_load_end / IF(pss_load_before = 0, 1, pss_load_before) - 1) AS pss_load_change_rate, SUM(pssmemory / IF(pss_load_end = 0, 1, pss_load_end) - 1) AS pss_battle_change_rate, SUM(pss_load_before / IF(systemmemorysize = 0, 1, systemmemorysize)) AS pss_sys_rate, SUM(pss_load_before) AS pss_load_before /* 战斗loading时内存最低点时的pss内存 */, SUM(pss_load_end) AS pss_load_end /* 战斗loading后的pss内存 */, SUM(pssmemory) AS pss_battle_end /* 战斗结束时Pss内存 */, SUM(gt_50) AS gc_cnt, ROUND(SUM(avgfps) / 100, 2) AS avgfps, SUM(minfps) AS minfps, SUM(freememory) AS free_memory, SUM(systemmemorysize) AS system_memorysize, SUM(COALESCE(freediskspace, 0)) AS free_diskspace, SUM(gameusediskspace) AS gameuse_diskspace, SUM(battletime) AS battle_duration, MAX(battleNum) AS battle_num, SUM(temperature) AS device_temperature, SUM(battery) AS device_battery, MAX(IF(rn = 1, stat_time, NULL)) AS last_battle_time, COALESCE(MAX(IF(rn = 1, freediskspace, NULL)), -99999) AS last_battle_fds, COALESCE(MAX(IF(rn = 1, gameusediskspace, NULL)), -99999) AS last_battle_guds, COALESCE(MAX(IF(rn = 1, devicetotalmemory, NULL)), -99999) AS last_battle_dtm FROM per_log GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, os, is_highfps, is_download, is_broadcast, picture_quality, unityversion, pvptype, scene_name) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31')) AS basic ON a.roleid = basic.roleid AND a.zoneid = basic.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, area_id FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31') AND is_first_create = 1) AS account_info ON a.roleid = account_info.roleid /* DISTRIBUTE BY abs(hash(a.roleid,a.zoneid,a.os,a.is_highfps,a.is_download,a.is_broadcast,a.picture_quality,a.unityversion,a.pvptype,a.scene_name)) % 15 */

WITH paiwei_rank_update_log AS (/* 排位段位变化记录 */ SELECT zoneid, roleid, COALESCE(reason, 'unknown') AS reason, COALESCE(old_rank_star, 0) AS old_rank_star, COALESCE(new_rank_star, 0) AS new_rank_star, COALESCE(new_rank_id, 0) AS new_rank_id, COALESCE(old_rank_id, 0) AS old_rank_id, curbattle_points, time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_rank_level WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(reason, '000') RLIKE '^[a-zA-Z]+$'), auto_chess_rank_log AS (/* 自走棋当天等级的变更记录 */ SELECT zoneid, roleid, battleid, rankid AS new_rank_id, LAG(rankid, 1, rankid) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, roleid ORDER BY time) AS old_rank_id /* 当天第一场战斗则取当前记录的rankid作为上一场的段位 */, time FROM (/* 战斗记录去重 */ SELECT zoneid, accountid AS roleid, battleid, rankid, time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid, battleid ORDER BY time, battletime DESC, rankid DESC) AS rank_id FROM ml_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* 魔法战旗只取2020-01-24之后的数据 */ logymd >= '2020-01-24' AND COALESCE(rankid, 0) > 0 season_conf AS (/* 排位赛季配置数据 */ SELECT BIGINT(2) AS pvptype, MAX(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(season_first_starttime, 0, 10) <= '2026-05-31' THEN season_first_starttime END) AS curt_season_starttime /* 排位当前赛季的开始时间 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_season_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2023-02-03', '2023-02-03', '2026-05-31') AND SUBSTRING(season_starttime, 0, 10) <= '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2023-02-03', '2023-02-03', '2026-05-31') AND SUBSTRING(season_starttime, 0, 10) <= '2026-05-31'), rank_update_info AS (/* 段位变化数据 */ SELECT CASE WHEN rank_update_log.time > season_conf.curt_season_starttime OR rank_update_log.reason = 'seasonreset' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_cur_season /* 是否是当前赛季的段位变化记录 */, rank_update_log.pvptype, rank_update_log.new_rank_star, rank_update_log.reason_rank, rank_update_log.curbattle_points, CASE WHEN NOT old_rank_conf.bigranklvl IS NULL THEN old_rank_conf.bigranklvl WHEN rank_update_log.pvptype = 2 AND rank_update_log.old_rank_id >= 186 THEN 7 WHEN rank_update_log.pvptype = 39 AND rank_update_log.old_rank_id >= 31 THEN 7 ELSE 0 END AS old_bigranklvl, CASE WHEN NOT new_rank_conf.bigranklvl IS END AS new_bigranklvl, CASE WHEN NOT old_rank_conf.minranklvl IS NULL THEN old_rank_conf.minranklvl WHEN rank_update_log.pvptype = 2 AND rank_update_log.old_rank_id >= 186 THEN 31 WHEN rank_update_log.pvptype = 2 AND rank_update_log.new_rank_id >= 186 THEN 31 WHEN rank_update_log.pvptype = 39 AND rank_update_log.new_rank_id >= 31 THEN 31 ELSE 0 END AS new_minranklvl, CASE WHEN pvptype, is_cur_season, MIN(time) AS first_rank_change_time /* 首末次变更时间：取当前赛季更新记录+赛季重置记录的首末次时间 */, MAX(time) AS last_rank_change_time, MAX(IF(asc_rn = 1, reason, NULL)) AS first_reason /* 首末次变更原因：取当前赛季更新记录+赛季重置记录的变更原因 */, MAX(IF(desc_rn = 1, reason, NULL)) AS last_reason, MAX(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 1 AND asc_rn = 1 THEN new_rank_id WHEN asc_rn = 1 THEN old_rank_id END) AS first_rank_id /* 首末次段位：如果当天首次等级变更记录为赛季重置，则当日首次段位取new_rank_id
ew_minranklvl
ew_bigranklvl
ew_rank_star */, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_rn = 1 THEN new_rank_id END) AS last_rank_id, MAX(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 1 AND asc_rn = 1 THEN new_minranklvl WHEN asc_rn = 1 THEN old_minranklvl END) AS first_minranklvl, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_rn = 1 THEN new_minranklvl END) AS last_minranklvl, MAX(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 1 AND asc_rn = 1 THEN new_bigranklvl WHEN asc_rn = 1 THEN old_bigranklvl END) AS first_bigranklvl, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_rn = 1 THEN new_bigranklvl END) AS last_bigranklvl, MAX(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 1 AND asc_rn = 1 THEN new_rank_star WHEN asc_rn = 1 THEN old_rank_star END) AS first_rankstar, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_rn = 1 THEN new_rank_star END) AS last_rankstar, GREATEST(MAX(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 0 THEN old_rank_star END), MAX(new_rank_star)) AS max_rankstar /* 当天的最大、最小值：对变更记录的新、老段位取最大最小值。只取非赛季重置记录的老段位 */, LEAST(MIN(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 0 THEN old_rank_star END), MIN(new_rank_star)) AS min_rankstar, GREATEST(MAX(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 0 THEN old_rank_id END), MAX(new_rank_id)) AS max_rank_id, LEAST(MIN(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 0 THEN old_rank_id END), MIN(new_rank_id)) AS min_rank_id, GREATEST(MAX(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 0 THEN old_minranklvl END), MAX(new_minranklvl)) AS max_minranklvl, LEAST(MIN(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 0 THEN old_minranklvl END), MIN(new_minranklvl)) AS min_minranklvl, GREATEST(MAX(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 0 THEN old_bigranklvl END), MAX(new_bigranklvl)) AS max_bigranklvl, LEAST(MIN(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 0 THEN old_bigranklvl END), MIN(new_bigranklvl)) AS min_bigranklvl, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 0 AND old_rank_star > new_rank_star THEN 1 END) AS star_drop_cnt /* 变化次数：只取非赛季重置的段位变化记录 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 0 AND old_rank_star < new_rank_star THEN 1 END) AS star_up_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 0 AND old_minranklvl > new_minranklvl THEN 1 END) AS minrank_drop_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_seasonreset = 0 AND old_minranklvl < new_minranklvl THEN 1 END) rankid_up_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, is_cur_season, reason, old_rank_id, new_rank_id, old_rank_star, new_rank_star, old_bigranklvl, new_bigranklvl, old_minranklvl, new_minranklvl, (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype, is_cur_season ORDER BY time DESC, reason_rank, curbattle_points DESC, new_rank_id) AS desc_rn FROM rank_update_info) AS a GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype,
