AS adgroup_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.adgroup_name, a.adgroup_name) AS adgroup_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.creative_id, a.creative_id) AS creative_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.creative_name, a.creative_name) AS creative_name, a.gps_adid, a.android_id, a.idfa, a.idfv, a.gpid, a.andid, a.ia, a.iv, a.report_type, a.report_type_rn, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', 'ic', 'c') AS data_source FROM adjust_callback AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT adjust_id, country, network_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_id, adgroup_name, creative_id, creative_name FROM adjust_install WHERE adjust_rn = 1 AND COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') <> '') AS b ON a.adjust_id = b.adjust_id) AS a), tmp_account_attribution_di AS (SELECT accountid, create_time, create_date, os_type, channel, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, IF(ds = 'i', ins_add_step, COALESCE(back_add_step, 'unknown')) AS add_step /* 为空代表install和callback都没归上 */, IF(ds = 'i', ins_country, COALESCE(back_country, 'unknown')) AS adjust_country, IF(ds = 'i', ins_network_name, COALESCE(back_network_name, 'unknown')) AS network_name, IF(ds = 'i', ins_campaign_id, COALESCE(back_campaign_id, 'unknown')) AS campaign_id, IF(ds = 'i', ins_campaign_name, COALESCE(back_campaign_name, 'unknown')) AS campaign_name, IF(ds = 'i', ins_adgroup_id, COALESCE(back_adgroup_id, 'unknown')) AS adgroup_id, IF(ds = 'i', ins_adgroup_name, COALESCE(back_adgroup_name, 'unknown')) AS adgroup_name, IF(ds = 'i', ins_creative_id, COALESCE(back_creative_id, 'unknown')) AS creative_id, IF(ds = 'i', ins_creative_name, COALESCE(back_creative_name, 'unknown')) AS creative_name, IF(ds = 'i', ins_adjust_id, COALESCE(back_adjust_id, 'unknown')) AS adjust_id, IF(ds = 'i', ins_time, COALESCE(back_time, 'unknown')) AS time, source_pri FROM (SELECT act.accountid, act.create_date, act.create_time, act.os_type, act.channel, act.idfa, act.idfv, act.gps_adid, act.android_id, IF(NOT (CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.network_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.network_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.network_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.network_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.network_name END) IS NULL, 'i', 'c') AS ds /* 用于判断install中匹配上的，network_name是否为空 */, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN 3 WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN 4 WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL AND act.os_type = 1 THEN 5 WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL AND act.os_type = 2 THEN 6 END AS ins_add_step /* install */, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.time WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.time WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.time WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.time WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.time END AS ins_time, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.country WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.country WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.country WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.country WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.country END AS ins_country, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.network_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.network_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.network_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.network_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.network_name END AS ins_network_name, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.campaign_id WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.campaign_id WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.campaign_id WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.campaign_id WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.campaign_id END AS ins_campaign_id, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.campaign_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.campaign_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.campaign_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.campaign_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.campaign_name END AS ins_campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.adgroup_id WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.adgroup_id WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.adgroup_id WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.adgroup_id WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.adgroup_id END AS ins_adgroup_id, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.adgroup_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.adgroup_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.adgroup_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.adgroup_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.adgroup_name END AS ins_adgroup_name, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.creative_id WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.creative_id WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.creative_id WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.creative_id WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.creative_id END AS ins_creative_id, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.creative_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.creative_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.creative_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.creative_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.creative_name END AS ins_creative_name, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.adjust_id WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.adjust_id WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.adjust_id WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.adjust_id WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.adjust_id END AS ins_adjust_id, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN 7 WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN 8 WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN 9 WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN 10 WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL AND act.os_type = 1 THEN 11 WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL AND act.os_type = 2 THEN 12 END AS back_add_step /* -callback */, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.time WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.time WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.time WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.time WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.time END AS back_time, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.country WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.country WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.country WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.country WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.country END AS back_country, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.network_name WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.network_name WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.network_name WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.network_name WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.network_name END AS back_network_name, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.campaign_id WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.campaign_id WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.campaign_id WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.campaign_id WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.campaign_id END AS back_campaign_id, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.campaign_name WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.campaign_name WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.campaign_name WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.campaign_name WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.campaign_name END AS back_campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.adgroup_id WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.adgroup_id WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.adgroup_id WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.adgroup_id WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.adgroup_id END AS back_adgroup_id, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.adgroup_name WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.adgroup_name WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.adgroup_name WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.adgroup_name WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.adgroup_name END AS back_adgroup_name, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.creative_id WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.creative_id WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.creative_id WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.creative_id WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.creative_id END AS back_creative_id, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.creative_name WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.creative_name WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.creative_name WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.creative_name WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.creative_name END AS back_creative_name, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.adjust_id WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.adjust_id WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.adjust_id WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.adjust_id WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.adjust_id END AS back_adjust_id, act.source_pri FROM tmp_accountcreate_di AS act /* adjust_install/ios/idfa  --step1 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install AS fa ON act.idfa = fa.idfa AND fa.idfa_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 1 /* ios */ AND NOT act.idfa IS NULL AND TRIM(fa.idfa) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fa.idfa)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fa.idfa)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fa.idfa)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(fa.idfa) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(fa.idfa) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* adjust_install/ios/idfv --step2 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install AS fv ON act.idfv = fv.idfv AND fv.idfv_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 1 /* ios */ AND NOT fv.idfv IS NULL AND TRIM(fv.idfv) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fv.idfv)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fv.idfv)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fv.idfv)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(fv.idfv) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* adjust_install/android/gps_adid --step3 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install AS gps ON act.gps_adid = gps.gps_adid AND gps.gps_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 2 /* and */ AND NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(gps.gps_adid)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(gps.gps_adid)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(gps.gps_adid)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '0000-0000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* adjust_install/android/gps_adid --step4 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install AS andid ON act.android_id = andid.android_id AND andid.android_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 2 /* and */ AND NOT andid.android_id IS NULL AND TRIM(andid.android_id) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(andid.android_id)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(andid.android_id)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(andid.android_id)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(andid.android_id) <> '0000000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(andid.android_id) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* adjust_install/ios/account_id --step5 */ /* adjust_install/android/account_id --step6 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install AS acc ON act.os_type IN (1, 2) AND act.accountid = acc.account_id AND acc.account_rn = 1 AND NOT acc.account_id IS NULL AND TRIM(acc.account_id) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(acc.account_id)) <> 'none' AND LOWER(TRIM(acc.account_id)) <> 'null' AND LOWER(TRIM(acc.account_id)) <> 'unknown' /* callback/ios/idfa  --step7 */ LEFT JOIN tmp_adjust_join AS ajfa ON act.idfa = ajfa.idfa AND ajfa.idfa_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 1 /* ios */ AND NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL AND TRIM(ajfa.idfa) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfa.idfa)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfa.idfa)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfa.idfa)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(ajfa.idfa) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajfa.idfa) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* callback/ios/idfv  --step8 */ LEFT JOIN tmp_adjust_join AS ajfv ON act.idfv = ajfv.idfv AND ajfv.idfv_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 1 /* ios */ AND NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL AND TRIM(ajfv.idfv) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfv.idfv)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfv.idfv)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfv.idfv)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(ajfv.idfv) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* callback/android/gps_adid  --step9 */ LEFT JOIN tmp_adjust_join AS ajgps ON act.gps_adid = ajgps.gps_adid AND ajgps.gps_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 2 /* and */ AND NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '0000-0000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* callback/android/android_id  --step10 */ LEFT JOIN tmp_adjust_join AS ajandid ON act.android_id = ajandid.android_id AND ajandid.android_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 2 /* and */ AND NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL AND TRIM(ajandid.android_id) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajandid.android_id)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajandid.android_id)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajandid.android_id)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(ajandid.android_id) <> '0000000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajandid.android_id) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* callback/ios/accountid  --step11 */ /* callback/android/accountid  --step12 */ LEFT JOIN tmp_adjust_join AS ajacc ON act.os_type IN (1, 2) AND act.accountid = ajacc.roleid AND ajacc.role_rn = 1 AND NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL AND TRIM(ajacc.roleid) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(ajacc.roleid)) <> 'none' AND LOWER(TRIM(ajacc.roleid)) <> 'null' AND LOWER(TRIM(ajacc.roleid)) <> 'unknown')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(target_table)) SELECT accountid, TIME, os_type, gps_adid, idfa, android_id, adjust_id, adjust_country, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(network_name), '') = '' OR network_name IS NULL, 'unknown', network_name) AS adjust_network_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_name), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', campaign_name) AS adjust_campaign_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_id), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', campaign_id) AS adjust_campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adgroup_name), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', adgroup_name) AS asadjust_adset_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adgroup_id), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', adgroup_id) AS adjust_adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(creative_name), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', creative_name) AS adjust_creative_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(creative_id), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', creative_id) AS adjust_creative_id, channel AS game_channel, create_date AS createymd, add_step, idfv, source_pri, 'mla' AS appid, IF(create_date >= SUBSTRING(time, 1, 10), create_date, SUBSTRING(time, 1, 10)) AS logymd FROM tmp_account_attribution_di WHERE add_step <> 'unknown' /* 新增归因上的数据 */ UNION ALL /* 历史30天内归因上的数据 */ SELECT accountid, TIME, os_type, gps_adid, idfa, android_id, adjust_id, adjust_country, network AS adjust_network_name, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, createymd, add_step, idfv, data_source, 'mla' AS appid, logymd FROM (SELECT *, IF(adjust_network_name = '' OR adjust_network_name IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_network_name) AS network FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_di WHERE appid = 'mla' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-05-02') WHERE (createymd <= '2026-05-01' OR network <> 'unknown') /* 归因日期30天内，创号日期大于30天的，或者 归因日期30天内，已经归因上的 */

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_small_account_di_mlbb
sql_units: WITH login AS (SELECT deviceid, roleid AS accountid, MAX(activedays) AS activedays, MAX(level) AS level, MIN(usercreatetime) AS usercreatetime FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-25' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, deviceid), battle AS (SELECT accountid, COUNT(*) AS battle_count FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-25' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid), adv AS (SELECT accountid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-06', '2022-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb'), login_battle AS (SELECT deviceid, login.accountid, activedays, level, usercreatetime, COALESCE(battle_count, 0) AS battle_count FROM login LEFT JOIN battle ON login.accountid = battle.accountid), base_data AS (SELECT deviceid, login_battle.accountid, activedays, level, usercreatetime, battle_count, first_mt_country FROM adv RIGHT JOIN login_battle ON adv.accountid = login_battle.accountid), ranknum_data AS (SELECT accountid, first_mt_country, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY deviceid ORDER BY activedays DESC, level DESC, battle_count DESC, usercreatetime ASC) AS ranknum FROM base_data), small_account AS (SELECT accountid, first_mt_country, 1 AS small_account_flag FROM ranknum_data WHERE ranknum > 1 GROUP BY accountid, first_mt_country), flag_account AS (SELECT accountid, first_mt_country, 0 AS small_account_flag FROM ranknum_data AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT accountid FROM small_account AS b WHERE a.accountid = b.accountid) GROUP BY accountid, first_mt_country UNION SELECT accountid, first_mt_country, 1 AS small_account_flag FROM small_account) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_small_account_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT accountid, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, small_account_flag FROM flag_account

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_mla_battle_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH role_zone_base AS (/* role,zone全集 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_stage_clash /* 主战役 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_crystaltower /* 通天塔 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_alliance_battle_challenge /* 公会战 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_arena_fight /* 标准竞技场战斗 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_arenabattle /* 乱斗竞技场战斗 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_globalarena_challenge /* 全球竞技场战斗 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_king_arena_fight /* 荣耀竞技场战斗 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_aliance_boss_challenge /* 公会bosss */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_clickdungeon_fight /* 挑战地宫 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_start_clickdungeon_new /* 开始挑战地宫 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_clickdungeon_new /* 地宫通关 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_fate_battle_startchallenge /* 命运之战 */ UNION ALL SELECT attack_role_id AS roleid, attack_zone_id AS zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.frontlineserver_frontline_fight /* 纷争战线 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_act_seasonline_finishchallenge /* 虚境绘界 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_abyssarena_friend /* 深渊斗场帮助好友 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_hard_mode_stage /* 战斗-激斗战役 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_hard_mode_stage_event /* 激斗战役-奇遇   */) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), stage_clash AS (/* 主战役 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', stageid, cnt))) AS stages_finish_map, SUM(stage_success_cnt) AS stage_success_cnt, SUM(stage_fail_cnt) AS stage_fail_cnt, MIN(min_war_stage) AS min_war_stage, MAX(max_war_stage) AS max_war_stage FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, stageid, COUNT(1) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN score > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stage_success_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN score > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS stage_fail_cnt, MIN(CASE WHEN score > 0 THEN stageid ELSE NULL END) AS min_war_stage /* 2019年之后才启用war_stage */, MAX(CASE WHEN score > 0 THEN stageid ELSE NULL END) AS max_war_stage FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_stage_clash WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, stageid) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), crystaltower AS (/* 通天塔 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', tier, cnt))) AS crystaltower_finish_map, SUM(crystaltower_success_cnt) AS crystaltower_success_cnt, SUM(crystaltower_fail_cnt) AS crystaltower_fail_cnt, MAX(max_crystaltower_floor) AS max_crystaltower_floor FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, floor AS tier, COUNT(1) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN pass = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS crystaltower_success_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN pass = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS crystaltower_fail_cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN pass = 1 THEN floor ELSE NULL END) AS max_crystaltower_floor FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_crystaltower /* 数据在2018-11-25才开始 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, floor) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), alliance_battle /* CONCAT_WS(":",season , cnt)能够确保唯一，且每个role+zone只有一条 */ AS (/* 公会战 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(':', season, cnt) AS allianceseason_map /* 拼接season和对应的出现次数，表现形式为20210701:3 */, SUM(cnt) AS alliancebattle_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, season, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM mh_ods.gameserver_alliance_battle_challenge /* 数据在2019-10-25开始 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, season) AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(':', season, cnt)), aliance_boss AS (/* 公会BOSS参与次数 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS allicance_boss_cnt FROM mh_ods.gameserver_aliance_boss_challenge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), arena_info_agg AS (/* 竞技场 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(standard_arena_cnt) AS standard_arena_cnt, SUM(brawl_arena_cnt) AS brawl_arena_cnt, SUM(global_arena_cnt) AS global_arena_cnt, SUM(honor_arena_cnt) AS honor_arena_cnt FROM (/* 标准竞技场战斗次数 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS standard_arena_cnt, 0 AS brawl_arena_cnt, 0 AS global_arena_cnt, 0 AS honor_arena_cnt, 0 AS allicance_boss_cnt FROM mh_ods.gameserver_arena_fight WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL /* 乱斗竞技场战斗次数 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, 0 AS standard_arena_cnt, COUNT(1) AS brawl_arena_cnt, 0 AS global_arena_cnt, 0 AS honor_arena_cnt, 0 AS allicance_boss_cnt FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_arenabattle WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL /* 全球竞技场战斗次数 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, 0 AS standard_arena_cnt, 0 AS brawl_arena_cnt, COUNT(1) AS global_arena_cnt, 0 AS honor_arena_cnt, 0 AS allicance_boss_cnt FROM mh_ods.gameserver_globalarena_challenge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL /* 荣耀竞技场战斗次数 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, 0 AS standard_arena_cnt, 0 AS brawl_arena_cnt, 0 AS global_arena_cnt, COUNT(1) AS honor_arena_cnt, 0 AS allicance_boss_cnt FROM mh_ods.gameserver_king_arena_fight WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), clickdungeon AS (/* --地宫--- */ SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, IF(NOT a.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_challenge_dungeon /* 当日是否挑战地宫 */, COALESCE(b.pass_dungeon_cnt, 0) AS pass_dungeon_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_clickdungeon_fight /* 挑战地宫 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mh_ods.gameserver_start_clickdungeon_new /* 开始挑战地宫 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a FULL JOIN (/* 注：会存在有通关记录，但是没有开始挑战地宫的数据，这部分原因 */ /* ①、跨天，结束战斗和出结算界面不同步 ②、当天打了地宫后不再登录了，后期重新登录，由于地宫初始化了，会补一条finish记录   */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS pass_dungeon_cnt FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_clickdungeon_new /* 地宫通关 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid), fate_battle AS (/* 命运之战 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mh_ods.gameserver_fate_battle_startchallenge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), frontline_fight AS (/* 纷争战线 */ SELECT attack_role_id AS roleid, attack_zone_id AS zoneid FROM mh_ods.frontlineserver_frontline_fight /* 纷争战线 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY attack_role_id, attack_zone_id), seasonline AS (/* 虚境绘界 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(IF(primalzone = 'seasonline_primalzone', CONCAT_WS('_', act_id, stage_id), NULL)) AS seasonline_primalzone /* 活动id&关卡id */, MAX(IF(primalzone = 'seasonline_27mirage', CONCAT_WS('_', act_id, stage_id), NULL)) AS seasonline_27mirage, MAX(IF(primalzone = 'seasonline_103mirage', CONCAT_WS('_', act_id, stage_id), NULL)) AS seasonline_103mirage, MAX(IF(primalzone = 'seasonline_28mirage', CONCAT_WS('_', act_id, stage_id), NULL)) AS seasonline_28mirage, MAX(IF(primalzone = 'seasonline_29mirage', CONCAT_WS('_', act_id, stage_id), NULL)) AS seasonline_29mirage FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, primalzone, act_id, stage_id, score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, primalzone ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN stage_id LIKE '30%' THEN 'seasonline_primalzone' /* 原初领域 */ WHEN stage_id LIKE '27%' THEN 'seasonline_27mirage' /* 虚境绘界 27主线 */ WHEN stage_id LIKE '103%' THEN 'seasonline_103mirage' /* 虚境绘界 103主线 */ WHEN stage_id LIKE '28%' THEN 'seasonline_28mirage' /* 虚境绘界 - 28支线 */ WHEN stage_id LIKE '29%' THEN 'seasonline_29mirage' /* 虚境绘界 -破碎世界boss玩法 */ ELSE 'unknown' END AS primalzone, act_id, stage_id, score, `time` FROM mh_ods.gameserver_act_seasonline_finishchallenge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND score > 0 /* 只取挑战成功的数据 */)) WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), abyssarena_friend AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(score > 0, 1, 0)) AS abyssarena_help_cnt FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_abyssarena_friend WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), hardmodestage AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(stageid) AS hard_mode_stage FROM mh_ods.gameserver_finish_hard_mode_stage WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND score > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), hardmodeevent AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', event_type, event_id))) AS hard_mode_event FROM mh_ods.gameserver_hard_mode_stage_event WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event_status = 2 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(DW_DB))

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_battle_report_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH report_log AS (/* 对举报日志去重，相同战斗id、举报类型、举报玩家、被举报玩家只保留一条记录 */ SELECT reporterid, reporterzone, CAST(battleid AS STRING) AS battleid, reporttype, bereporterid, bereporterzone FROM ml_ods.gameserver_report_player WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND reporttype > 0 AND reporttype <= 6 GROUP BY reporterid, reporterzone, CAST(battleid AS STRING), reporttype, bereporterid, bereporterzone) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_battle_report_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT roleid, zoneid, battleid, report_type, COUNT(CASE WHEN report_tag = 1 THEN 1 END) AS report_role_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN report_tag = 0 THEN 1 END) AS bereport_role_cnt FROM (/* 举报用户 */ SELECT reporterid AS roleid, reporterzone AS zoneid, battleid AS battleid, reporttype AS report_type, BIGINT(1) AS report_tag /* 举报标记：1举报他人，0被举报 */ FROM report_log UNION ALL /* 被举报用户 */ SELECT bereporterid AS roleid, bereporterzone AS zoneid, BIGINT(battleid) AS battleid, reporttype AS report_type, BIGINT(0) AS report_tag /* 举报标记：1举报他人，0被举报 */ FROM report_log) AS a GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, battleid, report_type

name: etl.mdsk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di
sql_units: WITH event_log AS (SELECT COALESCE(TRIM(did), 'unknown') AS did /* --理论上是不会出现空值的情况 */, `event`, REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(event_desc, '\n', ''), '\r', '') AS event_desc /* --JSON格式化判断，暂时不需要处理，目前就是一个string, 目前更多需要关注事件本身      */, client_ip, COALESCE(IF(TRIM((GEOIP(client_ip, 1))) = '-', NULL, LOWER(GEOIP(client_ip, 1))), 'unknown') AS ip_country, COALESCE(event_time, 0) AS event_time /* 如果为空默认为1970-01-01T00:00:00，条件中已经过滤     */, COALESCE(server_time, 0) AS server_time, COALESCE(event_uuid, 'unknown') AS event_uuid, TRIM(COALESCE(install_uuid, 'unknown')) AS install_uuid /* --服务器回传的是字符串 */, TRIM(COALESCE(session_uuid, 'unknown')) AS session_uuid /* --服务器回传的是字符串 */, COALESCE(zone_offset, 0) AS zone_offset /* --统一默认为UTC+0 */, event_source, COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(os)), 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(TRIM(os_version), 'unknown') AS os_version, LOWER(COALESCE(TRIM(system_language), 'unknown')) AS system_language, COALESCE(TRIM(manufacturer), 'unknown') AS manufacturer, COALESCE(TRIM(brand), 'unknown') AS brand, COALESCE(TRIM(model), 'unknown') AS model, COALESCE(screen_height, 0) AS screen_height, COALESCE(screen_width, 0) AS screen_width, COALESCE(system_memory, 0) AS system_memory, COALESCE(system_disk, 0) AS system_disk, COALESCE(cpu_type, 'unknown') AS cpu_type, COALESCE(cpu_cores, 0) AS cpu_cores, LOWER(COALESCE(network_type, 'unknown')) AS network_type, COALESCE(TRIM(carrier), 'unknown') AS carrier, COALESCE(TRIM(idfa), 'unknown') AS idfa, COALESCE(TRIM(idfv), 'unknown') AS idfv, COALESCE(TRIM(android_id), 'unknown') AS android_id, COALESCE(TRIM(imei), 'unknown') AS imei, COALESCE(TRIM(build_serial), 'unknown') AS build_serial, COALESCE(TRIM(mac), 'unknown') AS mac, COALESCE(TRIM(gps_adid), 'unknown') AS gps_adid, COALESCE(TRIM(gps_asid), 'unknown') AS gps_asid, COALESCE(TRIM(oaid), 'unknown') AS oaid, COALESCE(TRIM(firebase_instance_id), 'unknown') AS firebase_instance_id, COALESCE(is_emulator, -1) AS is_emulator, COALESCE(app_name, 'unknown') AS app_name, COALESCE(app_version, 'unknown') AS app_version, LOWER(TRIM(package_name)) AS package_name, COALESCE(client_version, 'unknown') AS client_version, sdk_version, account_id, role_id, zone_id, COALESCE(level, 0) AS level, COALESCE(user_create_time, 0) AS user_create_time, COALESCE(current_diamond, 0) AS current_diamond, COALESCE(store, 'unknown') AS store, COALESCE(game_language, 'unknown') AS game_language, `environment`, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_uuid ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS row_num FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE ((logymd = '20260530' AND `hour` >= '23') /* -eg 2022-05-01号的eventtime数据会在server_time:[2022-04-30 23:00 2022-05-02 02:00]区间获取 */ OR (logymd = '20260531') OR (logymd = '20260601' AND `hour` <= '02')) AND DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8')) = DATE('2026-05-31') AND (NOT `event` IS NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(`event`)) > 1) /* event不需要为空字符或为空, 理论上在msdk上报的时候控制好了的 */ AND (NOT event_source IS NULL) /* --事件上报来源, NULL默认为未知上报 */ AND /* AND lower(`environment`) in ( {{EVN_LIST}} )  ---只要是一一拳回来的数据，都是线上真是数据，需要纳入报表计算的 */ event IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'login', 'logout', 'chargeMC', 'create_role', '__online_time__', 'charge', 't_real_os_online', 't_real_os_country_online')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT did, `event`, event_desc, client_ip, ip_country, event_time, server_time, event_uuid, install_uuid, session_uuid, zone_offset, event_source, os, os_version, system_language, manufacturer, brand, model, screen_height, screen_width, system_memory, system_disk, cpu_type, cpu_cores, network_type, REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(carrier, '\n', ''), '\r', '') AS carrier, idfa, idfv, android_id, imei, build_serial, mac, gps_adid, gps_asid, oaid, firebase_instance_id, is_emulator, app_name, app_version, package_name, client_version, sdk_version, account_id, role_id, zone_id, level, user_create_time, current_diamond, store, game_language, environment, stage_id, app_id FROM event_log WHERE row_num = 1 DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: etl.msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di
sql_units: /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS  `msdk_dim`.`dim_attribution_device_di`( */ /*     `did` string COMMENT '设备指纹, 设备唯一识别, key', */ /*     `attr_source` string COMMENT '归因属性来源', */ /*     `event_time` string COMMENT '触发事件的时间', */ /*     `attr_time` string COMMENT '归因时间', */ /*     `package_name` string COMMENT '首次安装的游戏分包名, key', */ /*     `os` string COMMENT 'mmp归因操作系统,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `ad_country` string COMMENT 'mmp归因国家,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `media_source` string COMMENT '归因广告渠道,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `campaign_id` string COMMENT '归因广告系列ID,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `adgroup_id` string COMMENT '归因广告组ID,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `creative_id` string COMMENT '归因广告创意ID,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `campaign_name` string COMMENT '归因广告系列名称,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `adgroup_name` string COMMENT '归因广告组名称,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `creative_name` string COMMENT '归因广告创意名称,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `gps_adid` string COMMENT '归因安卓设备的gps_adid,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `android_id` string COMMENT '归因安卓设备的android_id,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `oaid` string COMMENT '归因安卓设备的oaid（中国厂商）,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `idfa` string COMMENT '归因IOS设备的IDFA,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `idfv` string COMMENT '归因IOS设备的IDFV,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `mmp_id` string COMMENT '归因MMP的设备唯一ID,af_install近30天归因', */ /*     `createdate` string COMMENT '设备新增日期' */ /* ) COMMENT '设备AF归因表' PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', */ /*     `app_id` string COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key' */ /* ); */ /* -以最近30天的msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_di作为主表，关联近当天的af_install数据，取归因 */ WITH new_device_install AS (/* 1、这个需要按照logymd、app_id、package_name、did对设备唯一标志进行归因处理吗 */ /* 这个上游加工的时候会保证logymd、app_id、package_name、did的唯一，为了防止上游质量问题，容错，这边也可以加上唯一过滤 */ SELECT logymd, app_id, package_name, did, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, os, stage_id FROM (SELECT logymd, app_id, package_name, did, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, os, stage_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY logymd) AS rn FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND NOT (idfa = 'unknown' AND idfv = 'unknown' AND android_id = 'unknown' AND gps_adid = 'unknown' AND COALESCE(did, 'unknown') = 'unknown') /* fuxinwang：去除潜在的脏数据 */) WHERE rn = 1), af_install AS (/* 老数据，2024-10-31之后已经不再更新 */ SELECT package_name, msdk_app_id AS app_id, event_time AS create_time, server_time, platform AS os, country_code AS country_code, media_source AS media_source, af_c_id AS campaign_id, af_adset_id AS adgroup_id, af_ad_id AS creative_id, campaign AS campaign_name, af_adset AS adgroup_name, af_ad AS creative_name, advertising_id AS gps_adid, android_id AS android_id, country_code AS ad_country, oaid AS oaid, idfa AS idfa, idfv AS idfv, appsflyer_id AS mmp_id, NULL AS msdk_did, 0 AS click_time, '01' AS stage_id, logymd FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_msdk_appsflyer_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event_name = 'install' UNION ALL /* 新数据，2022-08-15开始 */ SELECT package_name, msdk_app_id AS app_id, event_time AS create_time, server_time, os_name AS os, country_code, IF(media_source = 'Unattributed', IF(COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', 'Facebook Installs', 'Unattributed'), media_source) AS media_source, CASE WHEN media_source_type = 1 THEN fb_campaign_id WHEN media_source_type = 2 THEN campaign_id ELSE campaign_id END AS campaign_id, CASE WHEN media_source_type = 1 THEN fb_adgroup_id WHEN media_source_type = 2 THEN NULL ELSE adgroup_id END AS adgroup_id, creative_id, CASE WHEN media_source_type = 1 THEN fb_campaign_name WHEN media_source_type = 2 THEN campaign_name ELSE campaign_name END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN media_source_type = 1 THEN fb_adgroup_name WHEN media_source_type = 2 THEN NULL ELSE adgroup_name END AS adgroup_name, creative_name, gps_adid, android_id, country_code AS ad_country, oaid AS oaid, idfa AS idfa, idfv AS idfv, adjust_id AS mmp_id, msdk_did, COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.click_time'), 0) AS click_time, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, logymd FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '' THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%applovin%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS media_source_type FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_msdk_adjust_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') IN ('install')) AS t0), af_install_idfa /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'ios' -- 已知BUG: 正确逻辑是先用os过滤，再用idfa匹配 */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, stage_id, idfa ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS idfa_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(idfa, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_idfv /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'ios' */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, stage_id, idfv ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS idfv_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(idfv, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_gps_adid /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'android' */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, stage_id, gps_adid ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS gps_adid_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(gps_adid, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_android_id /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'android' */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, stage_id, android_id ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS android_id_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(android_id, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_msdk_did AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, stage_id, msdk_did ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS msdk_did_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(msdk_did, 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AND LOWER(os) = 'windows' /* windows */), his_attr_did AS (SELECT did, APP_ID, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY did, APP_ID, COALESCE(stage_id, '01')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di PARTITION(logymd, app_id) /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di PARTITION (logymd, app_id) -- 测试表 */ SELECT t1.did, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN 'ios_1' WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN 'ios_2' WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN 'android_1' WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN 'android_2' WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN 'pc_1' END AS attr_source, COALESCE(t2.create_time, t3.create_time, t4.create_time, t5.create_time, t7.create_time) AS event_time /* 是触发事件的时间 20220606 */, COALESCE(t2.server_time, t3.server_time, t4.server_time, t5.server_time, t7.server_time) AS attr_time /* server time是归因时间 20220606 */, t1.package_name, COALESCE(t2.os, t3.os, t4.os, t5.os, t7.os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(t2.ad_country, t3.ad_country, t4.ad_country, t5.ad_country, t7.ad_country, 'unknown') AS ad_country, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN t2.media_source WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN t3.media_source WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN t4.media_source WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN t5.media_source WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN t7.media_source ELSE 'unknown' END AS media_source /* COALESCE(t2.media_source, t3.media_source, t4.media_source, t5.media_source, 'unknown') AS media_source, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.campaign_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.campaign_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.campaign_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.campaign_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.campaign_id, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS campaign_id /* COALESCE(t2.campaign_id, t3.campaign_id, t4.campaign_id, t5.campaign_id, 'unknown') AS campaign_id, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.adgroup_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.adgroup_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.adgroup_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.adgroup_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.adgroup_id, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS adgroup_id /* COALESCE(t2.adgroup_id, t3.adgroup_id, t4.adgroup_id, t5.adgroup_id, 'unknown') AS adgroup_id, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.creative_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.creative_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.creative_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.creative_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.creative_id, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS creative_id /* COALESCE(t2.creative_id, t3.creative_id, t4.creative_id, t5.creative_id, 'unknown') AS creative_id, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.campaign_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.campaign_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.campaign_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.campaign_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.campaign_name, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS campaign_name /* COALESCE( */ /*     t2.campaign_name, */ /*     t3.campaign_name, */ /*     t4.campaign_name, */ /*     t5.campaign_name, */ /*     'unknown' */ /* ) AS campaign_name, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.adgroup_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.adgroup_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.adgroup_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.adgroup_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.adgroup_name, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS adgroup_name /* COALESCE(t2.adgroup_name, t3.adgroup_name, t4.adgroup_name, t5.adgroup_name, 'unknown') AS adgroup_name, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.creative_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.creative_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.creative_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.creative_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.creative_name, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS creative_name /* COALESCE( */ /*     t2.creative_name, */ /*     t3.creative_name, */ /*     t4.creative_name, */ /*     t5.creative_name, */ /*     'unknown' */ /* ) AS creative_name, */, COALESCE(t2.gps_adid, t3.gps_adid, t4.gps_adid, t5.gps_adid, t7.gps_adid, 'unknown') AS gps_adid, COALESCE(t2.android_id, t3.android_id, t4.android_id, t5.android_id, t7.android_id, 'unknown') AS android_id, COALESCE(t2.oaid, t3.oaid, t4.oaid, t5.oaid, t7.oaid, 'unknown') AS oaid, COALESCE(t2.idfa, t3.idfa, t4.idfa, t5.idfa, t7.idfa, 'unknown') AS idfa, COALESCE(t2.idfv, t3.idfv, t4.idfv, t5.idfv, t7.idfv, 'unknown') AS idfv, COALESCE(t2.mmp_id, t3.mmp_id, t4.mmp_id, t5.mmp_id, t7.mmp_id, 'unknown') AS mmp_id, t1.logymd AS createdate /* fuxinwang：和basic df表字段对齐命名，设备创建时间统一命名createdate */, COALESCE(t1.stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, '2026-05-31' AS logymd /* COALESCE(t2.logymd, t3.logymd, t4.logymd, t5.logymd, 'unknown') AS logymd, */ /* 20220606 */, t1.app_id FROM new_device_install AS t1 /* 5、这个表应该是以归因时间分区，如果X设备一直没有归因到，应该不会放在当日分区 */ /* new_device_install 是用户基础信息增量表格，每日新增的设备会放在里面 */ LEFT JOIN af_install_idfa AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.idfa = t2.idfa AND t1.stage_id = t2.stage_id AND t2.idfa_rn = 1 AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'ios' /* ios */ AND LOWER(t2.os) = 'ios' /* ios */ LEFT JOIN af_install_idfv AS t3 ON t1.app_id = t3.app_id AND t1.idfv = t3.idfv AND t1.stage_id = t3.stage_id AND t3.idfv_rn = 1 AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'ios' /* ios */ AND LOWER(t3.os) = 'ios' /* ios */ LEFT JOIN af_install_gps_adid AS t4 ON t1.app_id = t4.app_id AND t1.gps_adid = t4.gps_adid AND t1.stage_id = t4.stage_id AND t4.gps_adid_rn = 1 AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'android' /* android */ AND LOWER(t4.os) = 'android' /* android */ LEFT JOIN af_install_android_id AS t5 ON t1.app_id = t5.app_id AND t1.android_id = t5.android_id AND t1.stage_id = t5.stage_id AND t5.android_id_rn = 1 AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'android' /* android */ AND LOWER(t5.os) = 'android' /* android */ LEFT JOIN his_attr_did AS t6 ON t1.did = t6.did AND t1.app_id = t6.app_id AND t1.stage_id = t6.stage_id LEFT JOIN af_install_msdk_did AS t7 ON t1.app_id = t7.app_id AND t1.did = t7.msdk_did AND t1.stage_id = t7.stage_id AND t7.msdk_did_rn = 1 AND LOWER(TRIM(t7.msdk_did)) <> 'unknown' AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'windows' /* windows */ AND LOWER(t7.os) = 'windows' /* windows */ WHERE COALESCE(t2.logymd, t3.logymd, t4.logymd, t5.logymd, t7.logymd, 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AND t6.did IS NULL DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di PARTITION(logymd, app_id) /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di PARTITION (logymd, app_id) */ SELECT a.did, 'callback' AS attr_source, a.event_time /* 是触发事件的时间 20220606 */, a.server_time AS attr_time /* server time是归因时间 20220606 */, a.package_name, os, country AS ad_country, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.media_source, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.media_source, 'unknown') END AS media_source, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.campaign_id, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.campaign_id, 'unknown') END AS campaign_id /* COALESCE(c.media_source, a.media_source, 'unknown') AS media_source, */, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.adgroup_id, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.adgroup_id, 'unknown') END AS adgroup_id, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.creative_id, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.creative_id, 'unknown') END AS creative_id, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.campaign_name, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.campaign_name, 'unknown') END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.adgroup_name, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.adgroup_name, 'unknown') END AS adgroup_name, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.creative_name, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.creative_name, 'unknown') END AS creative_name, a.gps_adid /* COALESCE(c.campaign_id, a.campaign_id, 'unknown') campaign_id, */ /* COALESCE(c.adgroup_id, a.adgroup_id, 'unknown') adgroup_id, */ /* COALESCE(c.creative_id, a.creative_id, 'unknown') creative_id, */ /* COALESCE(c.campaign_name, a.campaign_name, 'unknown') campaign_name, */ /* COALESCE(c.adgroup_name, a.adgroup_name, 'unknown') adgroup_name, */ /* COALESCE(c.creative_name, a.creative_name, 'unknown') creative_name, */, a.android_id, a.oaid, a.idfa, a.idfv, a.adjust_id AS mmp_id, '2026-05-31' AS createdate /* fuxinwang：和basic df表字段对齐命名，设备创建时间统一命名createdate */, COALESCE(a.stage_id, '01') AS stage_id /* COALESCE(t2.logymd, t3.logymd, t4.logymd, t5.logymd, 'unknown') AS logymd, */, '2026-05-31' AS logymd /* 20220606 */, a.app_id FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT did, app_id, package_name, event_time, server_time, os, gps_adid, android_id, oaid, idfa, idfv, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adjust_id') AS adjust_id, os, COALESCE(IF(TRIM((GEOIP(client_ip, 1))) = '-', NULL, LOWER(GEOIP(client_ip, 1))), 'unknown') AS country, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.network_name') AS media_source, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name') RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS campaign_name, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name') RLIKE '^\\\\d+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)', 2))) AS campaign_id, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name') RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS adgroup_name, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name') RLIKE '^\\\\d+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)', 2))) AS adgroup_id, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative') RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS creative_name, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative') RLIKE '^\\\\d+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)', 2))) AS creative_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') ORDER BY event_time DESC, server_time DESC) AS rn, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE event = '__adjust_callback__' AND logymd = '20260531' AND NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.network_name') IS NULL AND NOT did IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT m__did, 4460 AS app_id, m__package_name, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(m__server_time) * 1000 + 8 * 3600 * 1000, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(m__server_time) * 1000 + 8 * 3600 * 1000, LOWER(m__os_type) AS os, m__gps_adid, m__android_id, 'unknown' AS oaid, m__idfa, m__idfv, adjust_id, LOWER(m__os_type) AS os_01, COALESCE(IF(TRIM((GEOIP(m__client_ip, 1))) = '-', NULL, LOWER(GEOIP(m__client_ip, 1))), 'unknown') AS country, network_name AS media_source, IF(campaign_name RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', campaign_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS campaign_name, IF(campaign_name RLIKE '^\\\\d+$', campaign_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)', 2))) AS campaign_id, IF(adgroup_name RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', adgroup_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(adgroup_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS adgroup_name, IF(adgroup_name RLIKE '^\\\\d+$', adgroup_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(adgroup_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)', 2))) AS adgroup_id, IF(creative RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', creative, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(creative, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS creative_name, IF(creative RLIKE '^\\\\d+$', creative, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(creative, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)', 2))) AS creative_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m__did ORDER BY m__server_time DESC, m__server_time DESC) AS rn, '01' AS stage_id FROM xgame_ods.gameserver_adjust_callback WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT network_name IS NULL AND NOT m__did IS NULL) AS x WHERE rn = 1) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msdk_app_id, adjust_id, stage_id ORDER BY event_time, server_time) AS adjust_id_rn FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_msdk_adjust_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT adjust_id IS NULL AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') IN ('install')) AS x WHERE adjust_id_rn = 1) AS c ON a.adjust_id = c.adjust_id AND a.app_id = c.msdk_app_id AND a.stage_id = c.stage_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT did, APP_ID, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id /* FROM    msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di */ FROM msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di /* WHERE   logymd <=  '2026-05-30' or (attr_source<>'callback' and logymd='2026-05-31') */ WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY did, APP_ID, COALESCE(stage_id, '01')) AS d ON a.did = d.did AND a.app_id = d.app_id AND a.stage_id = d.stage_id WHERE d.did IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT * FROM msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* union all */ /* select * from bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di */ /* where logymd =  '2026-05-31' */

name: etl.msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_di
sql_units: /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_di ( */ /*     did                    STRING     COMMENT '设备指纹, 设备唯一识别, key',   */ /*     package_name           STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的游戏分包名, key', */ /*     is_emulator            INT        COMMENT 'Android平台，判断是否为模拟器，1表示模拟器，0为真实设备, 安装事件install_event首次归因', */ /*     client_ip              STRING     COMMENT '客户端IP, 安装事件install_event首次归因,统一小写', */ /*     os                     STRING     COMMENT '操作系统, 安装事件install_event首次归因,统一小写', */ /*     model                  STRING     COMMENT '设备型号, 安装事件install_event首次归因,统一小写', */ /*     os_version             STRING     COMMENT '操作系统版本, 安装事件install_event首次归因,统一小写', */ /*     network_type           STRING     COMMENT '设备网络状态, 安装事件install_event首次归因,统一小写', */ /*     os_language            STRING     COMMENT '操作系统语言, 安装事件install_event首次归因,统一小写', */ /*     createdate             STRING     COMMENT '设备创建日期, 首次归因日期, 美西时间, 格式: yyyy-MM-dd', */ /*     ip_country             STRING     COMMENT 'IP解析国家, 安装事件install_event首次归因client_ip通过geoip转化的国家 ,统一小写', */ /*     client_version         STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的热更版本（例如打补丁小版本）', */ /*     sdk_version            STRING     COMMENT '首次安装MSDK版本号', */ /*     idfa                   STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的IOS设备的IDFA', */ /*     idfv                   STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的IOS设备的IDFV', */ /*     gps_adid               STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的安卓设备的gps_adid', */ /*     android_id             STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的安卓设备的android_id', */ /*     imei                   STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的安卓设备的imei', */ /*     oaid                   STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的安卓设备的oaid（中国厂商）' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd, 美西日期', app_id INT COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key'); */ WITH install_user_reduce AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC, server_time ASC) AS row_num FROM (SELECT did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, system_language AS os_language, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_id, event_time, app_version, server_time, stage_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'login', 'logout') UNION ALL SELECT did, package_name, 0 AS is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, 'unknown' AS network_type, 'unknown' AS os_language, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS createdate, ip_country, client_version, 'unknown' AS sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_id, event_time, 'unknown' AS app_version, server_time, stage_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('purchase_event')) AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_df AS b WHERE b.logymd = '2026-05-30' AND a.did = b.did AND a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.stage_id = b.stage_id)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_version, stage_id, app_id FROM install_user_reduce WHERE row_num = 1 AND app_id <> 4310 DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

openclient_version, COALESCE(t_dim.loginclient_version, 'unknown') AS loginclient_version, first_device, last_device, first_ip, last_ip, max_level, max_vip /*  , first_login_allianceid */, t2.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(t1.new_os, t2.new_os) AS new_os, COALESCE(t1.first_login_os, t2.first_login_os) AS first_login_os, COALESCE(t2.last_login_os, t1.last_login_os) AS last_login_os, COALESCE(t1.first_ad_country, t2.first_ad_country) AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, t1.last_ad_country) AS last_ad_country, COALESCE(t1.first_create_ip, t2.first_create_ip) AS first_create_ip, COALESCE(t1.first_ip_country, t2.first_ip_country) AS first_ip_country, COALESCE(t1.os_country, t2.os_country) AS os_country, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, t2.first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t2.last_mt_country, t1.last_mt_country) AS last_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_network_name, t2.first_network_name) AS first_network_name, COALESCE(t2.last_network_name, t1.last_network_name) AS last_network_name, COALESCE(t1.role_create_channel, t2.role_create_channel) AS role_create_channel, COALESCE(t1.register_date, t2.register_date) AS register_date, COALESCE(t1.usercreateymd, t2.usercreateymd) AS usercreateymd, COALESCE(t1.os_language, t2.os_language) AS os_language, COALESCE(t1.first_device, t2.first_device) AS first_device, COALESCE(t2.last_device, t1.last_device) AS last_device, COALESCE(t1.first_ip, t2.first_ip) AS first_ip, COALESCE(t2.last_ip, t1.last_ip) AS last_ip, IF(t2.max_level IS NULL OR t2.max_level = 0, COALESCE(t1.max_level, t2.max_level), t2.max_level) AS max_level, IF(t2.max_vip IS NULL OR t2.max_vip = 0, COALESCE(t1.max_vip, t2.max_vip), t2.max_vip) AS max_vip /* 末次公会id , 传过来是0就是0，如果当天没有，则取历史信息 */, COALESCE(t2.last_login_allianceid, t1.last_login_allianceid) AS last_login_allianceid, IF(t1.first_active_time IS NULL OR t1.first_active_time = 'unknown', COALESCE(t2.first_active_time, 'unknown'), t1.first_active_time) AS first_active_time, IF(t2.last_active_time IS NULL OR t2.last_active_time = 'unknown', COALESCE(t1.last_active_time, t2.last_active_time), t2.last_active_time) AS last_active_time, COALESCE(t1.first_deviceid, t2.first_deviceid) AS first_deviceid, COALESCE(t2.last_deviceid, t1.last_deviceid) AS last_deviceid, COALESCE(t1.first_os_language, t2.first_os_language) AS first_os_language, COALESCE(t2.last_os_language, t1.last_os_language) AS last_os_language, COALESCE(t1.first_channel, t2.first_channel) AS first_channel, COALESCE(t2.last_channel, t1.last_channel) AS last_channel, COALESCE(t1.login_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t2.login_cnt, 0) AS login_cnt, COALESCE(t1.login_duration, 0) + COALESCE(t2.login_duration, 0) AS login_duration, COALESCE(t1.reconn_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t2.reconn_cnt, 0) AS reconn_cnt, COALESCE(t1.logout_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t2.logout_cnt, 0) AS logout_cnt, COALESCE(t1.first_client_language, t2.first_client_language) AS first_client_language, COALESCE(t2.last_client_language, t1.last_client_language) AS last_client_language, COALESCE(t1.first_os_version, t2.first_os_version) AS first_os_version, COALESCE(t2.last_os_version, t1.last_os_version) AS last_os_version, COALESCE(t1.first_openclient_version, t2.first_openclient_version) AS first_openclient_version, COALESCE(t2.last_openclient_version, t1.last_openclient_version) AS last_openclient_version, COALESCE(t1.first_loginclient_version, t2.first_loginclient_version) AS first_loginclient_version, COALESCE(t2.last_loginclient_version, t1.last_loginclient_version) AS last_loginclient_version, COALESCE(t1.first_packageid, t2.first_packageid) AS first_packageid, COALESCE(t2.last_packageid, t1.last_packageid) AS last_packageid, IF(t1.first_pay_time IS NULL OR t1.first_pay_time = 'unknown', COALESCE(t2.day_first_pay_time, 'unknown'), t1.first_pay_time) AS first_pay_time, IF(t2.day_last_pay_time IS NULL OR t2.day_last_pay_time = 'unknown', COALESCE(t1.last_pay_time, t2.day_last_pay_time), t2.day_last_pay_time) AS last_pay_time, COALESCE(t1.charge_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t2.charge_cnt, 0) AS charge_cnt, COALESCE(t1.charge_money, 0) + COALESCE(t2.charge_money, 0) AS charge_money, COALESCE(t1.stage_success_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t2.stage_success_cnt, 0) AS stage_success_cnt, COALESCE(t1.stage_fail_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t2.stage_fail_cnt, 0) AS stage_fail_cnt, IF(t1.min_war_stage IS NULL OR t1.min_war_stage = 0, COALESCE(t2.min_war_stage, 0), t1.min_war_stage) AS min_war_stage /* AND t1.max_war_stage IS NOT NULL 为了避免第一天出现该角色信息而给了t1.max_war_stage ，会导致出现NULL值 */ /* 或者也可以在条件一处写成 NVL(t1.max_war_stage , t2.max_war_stage) */, IF(t2.max_war_stage IS NULL OR t2.max_war_stage = 0, COALESCE(t1.max_war_stage, t2.max_war_stage), t2.max_war_stage) AS max_war_stage, COALESCE(t1.crystaltower_success_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t2.crystaltower_success_cnt, 0) AS crystaltower_success_cnt, COALESCE(t1.crystaltower_fail_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t2.crystaltower_fail_cnt, 0) AS crystaltower_fail_cnt, IF(t2.max_crystaltower_floor IS NULL OR t2.max_crystaltower_floor = 0, COALESCE(t1.max_crystaltower_floor, t2.max_crystaltower_floor), t2.max_crystaltower_floor) AS max_crystaltower_floor, COALESCE(t1.alliancebattle_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t2.alliancebattle_cnt, 0) AS alliancebattle_cnt, (IF(COALESCE(t2.login_cnt, 0) > 0, 1, 0) + COALESCE(t1.logindays, 0)) AS logindays, COALESCE(t1.acumulative_pay_amount, 0) + COALESCE(t2.charge_money, 0) AS acumulative_pay_amount, COALESCE(t1.role_create_device, t2.first_device) AS role_create_device, COALESCE(t1.role_create_deviceid, t2.first_deviceid) AS role_create_deviceid /* 是否是模拟器用户判断逻辑：历史一直是1今天2 or 历史一直是2今天1则 = 3 ， 或者历史已经成为3了则之后都为3 */, CASE WHEN (t1.is_simulator = 1 AND t2.is_simulator = 2) OR (t1.is_simulator = 2 AND t2.is_simulator = 1) OR t1.is_simulator = 3 OR t2.is_simulator = 3 THEN 3 WHEN (COALESCE(t1.is_simulator, 0) IN (0, COALESCE(t2.is_simulator, 0))) THEN COALESCE(t2.is_simulator, 0) ELSE 0 END AS is_simulator, IF(t2.activedays IS NULL OR t2.activedays = 0, COALESCE(t1.activedays, t2.activedays), t2.activedays) AS activedays FROM (/* 取昨天的历史全量用户行为信息 */ SELECT * FROM `mt_dm`.`dm_mla_multi_behavior_role_zone_df` WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mla') AS t1 FULL JOIN (/* 取今天的用户行为信息 */ SELECT * FROM `mt_dm`.`dm_mla_multi_behavior_role_zone_di` WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mla') AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid) AS t3 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, init_roleid, account_createymd, device_createymd, client_language, openclient_version, loginclient_version FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mla') AS t_dim ON t3.roleid = t_dim.roleid AND t3.zoneid = t_dim.zoneid

name: etl.msdk_dwm.dwm_active_device_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: theoguo@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-05-16 10:45:59.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* -- ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_dwm.dwm_active_device_di ( */ /*             package_name  STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名,key', */ /*             did STRING COMMENT '设备指纹,key', */ /*             os STRING COMMENT '操作系统', */ /*             is_emulator int COMMENT '是否模拟器，针对安卓设备（1是模拟器，0是手机）', */ /*             -- account_id STRING COMMENT '游戏账号ID', */ /*             -- role_id STRING COMMENT '游戏角色ID', */ /*             -- zone_id STRING COMMENT '区服ID', */ /*             login_cnt int COMMENT '登录次数', */ /*             online_time int COMMENT '在线时长', */ /*             day_first_login_time string COMMENT '当天首次活跃时间, 美西时间UTC-8, 格式： yyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', */ /*             day_last_login_time string COMMENT '当天末次活跃时间美西时间UTC-8, 格式： yyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', */ /*             day_first_client_ip STRING COMMENT '首次登录客户端IP', */ /*             day_last_client_ip STRING COMMENT '末次客户端IP', */ /*             day_first_model STRING COMMENT '首次设备型号', */ /*             day_last_model STRING COMMENT '末次设备型号', */ /*             day_first_os_version STRING COMMENT '首次登录操作系统版本', */ /*             day_last_os_version STRING COMMENT '末次登录操作系统版本', */ /*             day_first_network_type STRING COMMENT '首次登录网络', */ /*             day_last_network_type STRING COMMENT '末次登录网络', */ /*             day_first_os_language STRING COMMENT '首次登录操作系统语言', */ /*             day_last_os_language STRING COMMENT '末次登录操作系统语言', */ /*             day_first_ip_country STRING COMMENT '首次登录IP解析国家', */ /*             day_last_ip_country STRING COMMENT '末次登录IP解析国家', */ /*             day_first_client_version STRING COMMENT '首次安装的游戏客户端版本', */ /*             day_last_client_version STRING COMMENT '末次安装的游戏客户端版本', */ /*             day_first_sdk_version STRING COMMENT '首次安装的SDK客户端版本', */ /*             day_last_sdk_version STRING COMMENT '末次安装的SDK客户端版本' */ /*         ) COMMENT '设备活跃增量表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY */ /*         (logymd STRING COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', app_id INT COMMENT '应用唯一ID') STORED AS PARQUET; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm.dwm_active_device_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT event_log.package_name AS package_name, event_log.did AS did, event_log.os AS os, event_log.is_emulator AS is_emulator, COALESCE(login_cnt.login_cnt, 0), COALESCE(ol_time.online_time, 0), COALESCE(day_first_login_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:000'), COALESCE(day_last_login_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:000'), event_log.first_client_ip AS day_first_client_ip, event_log.last_client_ip AS day_last_client_ip, event_log.first_model AS day_first_model, event_log.last_model AS day_last_model, event_log.first_os_version AS day_first_os_version, event_log.last_os_version AS day_last_os_version, event_log.first_network_type AS day_first_network_type, event_log.last_network_type AS day_last_network_type, event_log.first_os_language AS day_first_os_language, event_log.last_os_language AS day_last_os_language, event_log.first_ip_country AS day_last_os_language, event_log.last_ip_country AS day_last_ip_country, event_log.first_client_version AS day_first_client_version, event_log.last_client_version AS day_last_client_version, event_log.first_sdk_version AS day_first_sdk_version, event_log.last_sdk_version AS day_last_sdk_version, COALESCE(event_log.last_level, COALESCE(level_info.role_level, -99999)) AS day_last_last_level, COALESCE(event_log.stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, COALESCE(event_log.app_id, -99999) FROM (SELECT package_name, did, os, is_emulator, account_id, role_id, zone_id, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(COALESCE((first_event_time), 0) / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS day_first_login_time, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(COALESCE((last_event_time), 0) / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS day_last_login_time, first_client_ip, last_client_ip, first_model, last_model, first_os_version, last_os_version, first_network_type, last_network_type, first_os_language, last_os_language, first_ip_country, last_ip_country, first_client_version, last_client_version, first_sdk_version, last_sdk_version, last_level, stage_id, app_id FROM (SELECT package_name, did, os, is_emulator, os_version, system_language AS os_language, account_id, role_id, zone_id, app_id, stage_id, FIRST_VALUE(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_event_time, FIRST_VALUE(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_event_time, FIRST_VALUE(client_ip) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_client_ip, FIRST_VALUE(client_ip) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_client_ip, FIRST_VALUE(model) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_model, FIRST_VALUE(model) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_model, FIRST_VALUE(os_version) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_os_version, FIRST_VALUE(os_version) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_os_version, FIRST_VALUE(network_type) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_network_type, FIRST_VALUE(network_type) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_network_type, FIRST_VALUE(system_language) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_os_language, FIRST_VALUE(system_language) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_os_language, FIRST_VALUE(ip_country) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_ip_country, FIRST_VALUE(ip_country) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_ip_country, FIRST_VALUE(client_version) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_client_version, FIRST_VALUE(client_version) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_client_version, FIRST_VALUE(sdk_version) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_sdk_version, FIRST_VALUE(sdk_version) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_sdk_version, FIRST_VALUE(level) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, stage_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT package_name, did, os, is_emulator, os_version, system_language AS os_language, account_id, role_id, zone_id, event_time, client_ip, model, network_type, system_language, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, IF(event = 'logout', level, -99999) AS level, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, app_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND `event` IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'login', 'logout') UNION ALL SELECT package_name, did, os, 0 AS is_emulator, os_version, 'unknown' AS os_language, account_id, role_id, zone_id, event_time, client_ip, model, 'unknown' AS network_type, 'unknown' AS system_language, ip_country, client_version, 'unknown' AS sdk_version, -99999 AS level, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, app_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('purchase_event')) AS a) AS evt_log WHERE rn = 1) AS event_log LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, did /* package_name, */, stage_id, SUM(COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.ol_time'), 0)) AS online_time /* os, */ FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND `event` IN ('__online_time__') GROUP BY app_id, did, stage_id) AS ol_time ON event_log.app_id = ol_time.app_id AND event_log.did = ol_time.did AND event_log.stage_id = ol_time.stage_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, did /* package_name, */, stage_id, COUNT(1) AS login_cnt /* os, */ FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND `event` IN ('__launch_event__') GROUP BY app_id, stage_id, did /* package_name, */) AS login_cnt ON event_log.app_id = login_cnt.app_id AND /* AND     event_log.package_name = login_cnt.package_name */ event_log.did = login_cnt.did AND event_log.stage_id = login_cnt.stage_id /* AND     event_log.os = login_cnt.os */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, package_name, did, os, role_level, stage_id FROM (SELECT app_id, package_name, did, os, CAST(COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.role_level'), -99999) AS INT) AS role_level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn /* row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY app_id,package_name,  did, os ORDER BY event_time DESC ) as rn */, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND `event` IN ('add_level', 'sub_level') AND app_id = 4230) WHERE rn = 1) AS level_info ON event_log.app_id = level_info.app_id AND /* AND     event_log.package_name = level_info.package_name */ event_log.did = level_info.did AND event_log.stage_id = level_info.stage_id WHERE event_log.app_id <> 4310

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_social_attribute_survey_account_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_social_attribute_survey_account_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, `time`, finish_time AS finish_duration, play_similar_mlbb, sex, born, CASE WHEN age = 0 THEN -99999 ELSE YEAR('2026-05-31') - age END AS age, `job`, job1 AS job_first_level, job2 AS job_second_level, satisfaction FROM (SELECT roleid, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS `time`, finish_time, question_1_key AS play_similar_mlbb, CASE WHEN question_3_key = 'A' THEN 'boy' WHEN question_3_key = 'B' THEN 'girl' END AS sex /* 性别 */, sub_2_key AS born, CAST(IF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(sub_2_key, '([0-9]{4})') = '', '0', REGEXP_EXTRACT(sub_2_key, '([0-9]{4})')) AS BIGINT) AS age, CASE WHEN question_4_key = 'A' THEN '小学生' WHEN question_4_key = 'B' THEN '中学生' WHEN question_4_key = 'C' THEN '高中生' WHEN question_4_key = 'D' THEN '大学生' WHEN question_4_key = 'E' THEN '农民或牧民或渔夫' WHEN question_4_key = 'F' THEN '自由职业者' WHEN question_4_key = 'G' THEN '服务业人员或工人' WHEN question_4_key = 'H' THEN '公司职员' WHEN question_4_key = 'I' THEN '事业单位或公务员' WHEN question_4_key = 'J' THEN '家庭主夫或主妇' WHEN question_4_key = 'K' THEN '个体经营或商人或雇主' WHEN question_4_key = 'L' THEN '无业或失业' WHEN question_4_key = 'M' THEN '其他' END AS `job`, CASE WHEN question_4_key IN ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D') THEN 'student' WHEN question_4_key IN ('G', 'H', 'I') THEN '公司职员服务业公务员工人' WHEN question_4_key = 'E' THEN '农民或牧民或渔夫' WHEN question_4_key = 'J' THEN '家庭主夫或主妇' WHEN question_4_key = 'K' THEN '个体经营或商人或雇主' WHEN question_4_key = 'F' THEN '自由职业者' WHEN question_4_key = 'L' THEN '无业或失业' WHEN question_4_key = 'M' THEN '其他' END AS job1, CASE WHEN question_4_key IN ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D') THEN 'student' WHEN question_4_key IN ('E', 'F', 'G', 'H', 'I', 'J', 'K', 'F') THEN 'no_student' WHEN question_4_key = 'L' THEN '无业或失业' WHEN question_4_key = 'M' THEN '其他' END AS job2, question_2_key AS satisfaction, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dwd.dwd_gameserver_act_survey_third_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND act_id = 2203020009) AS t1 WHERE t1.rn = 1

sql_units: /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm.dwm_active_device_df partition (logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) */ SELECT main_data.package_name AS package_name, main_data.did, main_data.os AS os, last_os_language, main_data.first_ip_country AS first_ip_country, main_data.last_ip_country, main_data.first_client_version AS first_client_version, main_data.last_client_version AS df.his_first_model AS first_model, COALESCE(di.day_last_model, df.his_last_model) AS last_model, df.his_first_os_version AS first_os_version, COALESCE(di.day_last_os_version, df.his_last_os_version) AS last_os_version, df.his_first_network_type AS first_network_type, COALESCE(di.day_last_network_type, df.his_last_network_type) AS last_network_type, df.his_first_os_language AS first_os_language, COALESCE(di.day_last_os_language, df.his_last_os_language) AS last_os_language, df.his_first_ip_country AS first_ip_country, COALESCE(di.day_last_ip_country, df.his_last_ip_country) AS last_ip_country, df.his_first_client_version AS first_client_version, COALESCE(di.day_last_client_version, df.his_last_client_version) AS last_client_version, df.his_first_sdk_version AS first_sdk_version, COALESCE(di.day_last_sdk_version, df.his_last_sdk_version) AS last_sdk_version, df.his_first_login_time AS first_login_time, COALESCE(di.day_last_login_time, df.his_last_login_time) AS last_login_time, df.activedays + IF(di.app_id IS NULL, 0, 1) AS activedays, CONCAT(df.active_info, IF(di.app_id IS NULL, '0', '1')) AS active_info FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_device_df AS df LEFT JOIN (SELECT di.app_id, di.package_name, di.did, di.os, di.day_last_model, di.day_last_os_version, di.day_last_client_ip, di.day_last_network_type, di.day_last_os_language, di.day_last_ip_country, di.day_last_client_version, di.day_last_sdk_version, di.day_first_login_time, di.day_last_login_time, di.stage_id FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_device_di AS di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT did IN ('cmRqaHVjb2E5ODk2MTU3OQ==')) AS di ON df.app_id = di.app_id AND df.did = di.did AND CASE WHEN df.stage_id IS NULL THEN '01' ELSE df.stage_id END = CASE WHEN di.stage_id IS NULL THEN '01' ELSE di.stage_id END WHERE df.logymd = '2026-05-30' AND NOT df.did IN ('cmRqaHVjb2E5ODk2MTU3OQ==') UNION ALL SELECT package_name, did, os, di.app_id, day_first_client_ip AS first_client_ip, day_last_client_ip AS last_client_ip, day_first_model AS first_model, day_last_model AS last_model, day_first_os_version AS first_os_version, day_last_os_version AS last_os_version, day_first_network_type AS first_network_type, day_last_network_type AS last_network_type, day_first_os_language AS first_os_language, day_last_os_language AS last_os_language, day_first_ip_country AS first_ip_country, day_last_ip_country AS last_ip_country, day_first_client_version AS first_client_version, day_last_client_version AS last_client_version, day_first_sdk_version AS first_sdk_version, day_last_sdk_version AS last_sdk_version, day_first_login_time AS first_login_time, day_last_login_time AS last_login_time, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, 1 AS activedays, '1' AS active_info FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_device_di AS di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT did IN ('cmRqaHVjb2E5ODk2MTU3OQ==') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_device_df AS df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND NOT did IN ('cmRqaHVjb2E5ODk2MTU3OQ==') AND df.app_id = di.app_id AND df.did = di.did AND CASE WHEN df.stage_id IS NULL THEN '01' ELSE df.stage_id END = CASE WHEN di.stage_id IS NULL THEN '01' ELSE di.stage_id END)) AS main_data LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, did, package_name, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, ip_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, createdate, stage_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS basic_df ON main_data.app_id = basic_df.app_id AND main_data.did = basic_df.did AND main_data.stage_id = basic_df.stage_id
