'游戏分包名, key', */ /*     os                            STRING COMMENT '操作系统, key', */ /*     his_first_os_version          STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本, 历史首次', */ /*     his_last_os_version           STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本, 历史末次', */ /*     his_first_client_version      STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 历史首次', */ /*     his_last_client_version       STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 历史末次', */ /*     createdate                    STRING COMMENT '设备创角日期,美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd', */ /*     model                         STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 归因信息', */ /*     first_media_source            STRING COMMENT '首日广告归因渠道, 归因信息', */ /*     last_media_source             STRING COMMENT '最终广告归因渠道, 归因信息', */ /*     first_ad_country              STRING COMMENT '首日广告归因国家, 归因信息', */ /*     last_ad_country               STRING COMMENT '最终广告归因国家, 归因信息', */ /*     first_mt_country              STRING COMMENT '首日归因国家（优先填充first_ad_country，ip_country作为补充）', */ /*     last_mt_country               STRING COMMENT '最终归因国家（优先填充last_ad_country，ip_country作为补充）', */ /*     day_charge_amt_info           ARRAY<BIGINT> COMMENT '每日付费金额array列表', */ /*     total_charge_amt_info         ARRAY<BIGINT> COMMENT '历史累计付费金额array列表', */ /*     total_charge_cnt              INT COMMENT '历史累计付费总次数', */ /*     total_charge_amt              BIGINT COMMENT '历史累计付费金额（美分）', */ /*     his_first_charge_time         STRING COMMENT '历史首次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     his_last_charge_time          STRING COMMENT '历史末次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss' */ /* ) COMMENT '设备付费行为全量表格' PARTITIONED BY ( logymd STRING COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', app_id INT COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key' ) STORED AS PARQUET; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT t2.did, t2.package_name, t2.os, t2.his_first_os_version, t2.his_last_os_version, t2.his_first_client_version, t2.his_last_client_version, t1.createdate /* fuxinwang：建议加上这个日期，计算ltv等付费指标需要从新增日期开始算，方便计算 */, COALESCE(t1.model, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.last_media_source, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_ad_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.last_ad_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.last_mt_country, 'unknown'), t2.day_charge_amt_info, t2.total_charge_amt_info, t2.total_charge_cnt, t2.total_charge_amt, t2.his_first_charge_time, t2.his_last_charge_time, COALESCE(t2.stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, t2.app_id AS app_id FROM (SELECT did, package_name, app_id, model, createdate, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t1 RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(his_df.did, di.did) AS did, COALESCE(his_df.app_id, di.app_id) AS app_id, COALESCE(his_df.stage_id, di.stage_id) AS stage_id, COALESCE(his_df.os, di.os) AS os, COALESCE(his_df.package_name, di.package_name) AS package_name, COALESCE(his_df.his_first_os_version, di.day_first_os_version) AS his_first_os_version, COALESCE(di.day_last_os_version, his_df.his_last_os_version) AS his_last_os_version, COALESCE(his_df.his_first_client_version, di.day_first_client_version) AS his_first_client_version, COALESCE(di.day_last_client_version, his_df.his_last_client_version) AS his_last_client_version /* model之类的 ---需要从dim_attr里面获取       */, CASE WHEN SIZE(his_df.day_charge_amt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', his_df.day_charge_amt_info), ',', COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0)) END AS day_charge_amt_info /* -SPARK2.3.4 ARRAY方法比较局限，没必要写个array append之类udf，等SPARK3.0之后可换个更优雅的方式 */, CASE WHEN SIZE(his_df.total_charge_amt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', his_df.total_charge_amt_info), ',', COALESCE(his_df.total_charge_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(his_df.total_charge_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0)) END AS total_charge_amt_info, COALESCE(his_df.total_charge_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_cnt, 0) AS total_charge_cnt, COALESCE(his_df.total_charge_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0) AS total_charge_amt, COALESCE(his_df.his_first_charge_time, di.day_first_charge_time) AS his_first_charge_time, COALESCE(di.day_last_charge_time, his_df.his_last_charge_time) AS his_last_charge_time FROM (SELECT did, app_id, package_name, os, his_first_os_version, his_last_os_version, his_first_client_version, his_last_client_version, model, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, day_charge_amt_info, total_charge_amt_info, total_charge_cnt, total_charge_amt, his_first_charge_time, his_last_charge_time, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND NOT did IS NULL) AS his_df FULL JOIN (SELECT did, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, package_name, os, day_first_os_version, day_last_os_version, day_first_client_version, day_last_client_version, day_first_charge_time, day_last_charge_time, day_charge_sum, day_charge_cnt FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS di ON his_df.did = di.did AND his_df.app_id = di.app_id AND his_df.stage_id = di.stage_id) AS t2 ON t1.did = t2.did AND t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.stage_id = t2.stage_id /* AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name */

name: etl.msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_di
sql_units: /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_di ( */ /*     did                           STRING COMMENT '应用的自定义设备指纹, key', */ /*     package_name                  STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名, key', */ /*     os                            STRING COMMENT '操作系统, key', */ /*     day_first_model               STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 首次', */ /*     day_last_model                STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 末次', */ /*     day_first_os_version          STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本,首次', */ /*     day_last_os_version           STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本, 末次', */ /*     day_first_client_version      STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 首次', */ /*     day_last_client_version       STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 末次', */ /*     day_first_charge_time         STRING COMMENT '当天首次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     day_last_charge_time          STRING COMMENT '当天末次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     day_charge_cnt                BIGINT COMMENT '当天累计付费次数', */ /*     day_charge_sum                BIGINT COMMENT '当天累计付费金额（美分）' */ /* ) COMMENT '设备付费行为增量表格' PARTITIONED BY ( logymd STRING COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', app_id INT COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key' ) STORED AS PARQUET; */ WITH pay_event_succeed AS (SELECT did, app_id, package_name, os, model, os_version, client_version, event_time, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS rec_asc, IF(logymd <= '2024-10-17' AND app_id = 4280, 1, 0) AS is_delete, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('purchase_event', '__purchase_event__', '__purchase_deliver_event__') /* 投放重构充值接口__purchase_deliver_event__ 发货 __purchase_verify_event__ 校验 __purchase_refund_event__ 退款 */ AND /*   AND purchase_type = '1' --"支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test3. Promo4. Rewarded" */ purchase_type IN ('1', '3', '4') /* "支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test 3. Promo4. Rewarded" */ AND step = 'STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER' /* "表示支付流程到了第几步：校验STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_VERIFY发货STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER,暂时只有发货的步骤" */ AND result_code IN (22000, 13000) /* 未处理result_code: 21900 已处理 22000  订单参数异常 24900 服务器逻辑异常 25900 */ AND NOT app_id IN (4280, 4310)), pay_event_succeed_mc AS (SELECT did, app_id, package_name, os, model, os_version, client_version, event_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.money') AS price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, stage_id_mc ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, stage_id_mc ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS rec_asc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, stage_id_mc, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.other_orderid') ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS order_rec, IF(logymd <= '2024-10-17' AND app_id = 4280, 1, 0) AS is_delete, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.other_orderid') AS order_id, COALESCE(stage_id_mc, '01') AS stage_id FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_uuid ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS rn, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id_mc FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE ((logymd = '20260530' AND `hour` >= '23') /* -eg 2022-05-01号的eventtime数据会在server_time:[2022-04-30 23:00 2022-05-02 02:00]区间获取 */ OR (logymd = '20260531') OR (logymd = '20260601' AND `hour` <= '02')) AND DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8')) = DATE('2026-05-31') AND (NOT `event` IS NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(`event`)) > 1) /* event不需要为空字符或为空, 理论上在msdk上报的时候控制好了的 */ AND app_id = 4280 AND event = 'chargeMC' AND NOT did IS NULL) AS A WHERE rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT t2.did AS did, app_id, package_name, os, model, os_version, client_version, event_time, t1.price AS price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.did, app_id, t2.stage_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.did, app_id, t2.stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS rec_asc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.did, app_id, t2.stage_id, t1.order_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS order_rec, is_delete, t1.order_id, COALESCE(t2.stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT role_id AS roleid, zone_id AS zoneid, did, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.money') AS price, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.other_orderid') AS order_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_uuid ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS rn, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE ((logymd = '20260530' AND `hour` >= '23') /* -eg 2022-05-01号的eventtime数据会在server_time:[2022-04-30 23:00 2022-05-02 02:00]区间获取 */ OR (logymd = '20260531') OR (logymd = '20260601' AND `hour` <= '02')) AND DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8')) = DATE('2026-05-31') AND (NOT `event` IS NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(`event`)) > 1) /* event不需要为空字符或为空, 理论上在msdk上报的时候控制好了的 */ AND app_id = 4280 AND event = 'chargeMC' AND did IS NULL) AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT did, app_id, package_name, os, model, os_version, client_version, event_time, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS rec_asc, IF(logymd <= '2024-10-17' AND app_id = 4280, 1, 0) AS is_delete, account_id AS roleid, zone_id AS zoneid, order_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('purchase_event', '__purchase_event__', '__purchase_deliver_event__') /* 投放重构充值接口__purchase_deliver_event__ 发货 __purchase_verify_event__ 校验 __purchase_refund_event__ 退款 */ AND /*   AND purchase_type = '1' --"支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test3. Promo4. Rewarded" */ purchase_type IN ('1', '3', '4') /* "支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test 3. Promo4. Rewarded" */ AND step = 'STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER' /* "表示支付流程到了第几步：校验STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_VERIFY发货STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER,暂时只有发货的步骤" */ AND result_code IN (22000, 13000) /* 未处理result_code: 21900 已处理 22000  订单参数异常 24900 服务器逻辑异常 25900 */ AND app_id = 4280) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t1.order_id = t2.order_id AND t1.stage_id = t2.stage_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT t1.did, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.day_first_model, t1.day_last_model, t1.day_first_os_version, t1.day_last_os_version, t1.day_first_client_version, t1.day_last_client_version, t1.day_first_charge_time, t1.day_last_charge_time, t2.charge_cnt, t2.charge_sum, 0 AS actual_amt, COALESCE(t1.stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, t1.app_id AS app_id FROM (SELECT did, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, package_name, NULL)) AS package_name, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os, NULL)) AS os, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_first_model, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_last_model, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_first_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_last_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_first_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_last_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), NULL)) AS day_first_charge_time, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), NULL)) AS day_last_charge_time FROM pay_event_succeed WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY did, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01')) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT did, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, COUNT(1) AS charge_cnt, SUM(price) AS charge_sum FROM pay_event_succeed GROUP BY did, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01')) AS t2 ON t1.did = t2.did AND t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.stage_id = t2.stage_id /*    AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name */ /*    AND t1.os = t2.os */ UNION ALL SELECT t1.did, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.day_first_model, t1.day_last_model, t1.day_first_os_version, t1.day_last_os_version, t1.day_first_client_version, t1.day_last_client_version, t1.day_first_charge_time, t1.day_last_charge_time, t2.charge_cnt, t2.charge_sum, t3.charge_sum AS actual_amt, COALESCE(t1.stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, t1.app_id AS app_id FROM (SELECT did, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, package_name, NULL)) AS package_name, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os, NULL)) AS os, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_first_model, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_last_model, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_first_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_last_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_first_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_last_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), NULL)) AS day_first_charge_time, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), NULL)) AS day_last_charge_time FROM pay_event_succeed_mc WHERE is_delete = 0 AND order_rec = 1 GROUP BY did, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01')) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT did, app_id, stage_id, COUNT(1) AS charge_cnt, SUM(price) AS charge_sum FROM pay_event_succeed_mc WHERE order_rec = 1 GROUP BY did, app_id, stage_id) AS t2 ON t1.did = t2.did AND t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.stage_id = t2.stage_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT did, SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS charge_sum FROM pay_event_succeed_mc AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT other_orderid, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), actual_amt, 0)) / currency_exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM mt_dwd.dwd_mcgg_charge_order_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND bill_amt > 0 AND LOWER(product_id) NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' AND (IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, bill_amt, 0) > 0 OR IF(is_sandbox <> 0, bill_amt, 0) > 0 OR IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), before_tax_amt, 0) > 0) GROUP BY other_orderid, currency_exchange_rate) AS b ON a.order_id = b.other_orderid WHERE order_rec = 1 GROUP BY did) AS t3 ON t1.did = t3.did

sql_units: /* T-2的全量设备信息union T-1的增量设备信息 */ WITH all_device /* and app_id not in (4010,4020,4080) */ AS (SELECT did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_version, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, step_action_info, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_name, adgroup_id, creative_id, creative_name, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, logymd, app_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND did <> 'unknown' /* and app_id not in (4010,4020,4080) */ UNION ALL SELECT did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_version, NULL AS first_media_source, NULL AS last_media_source, NULL AS first_ad_country, NULL AS last_ad_country, NULL AS first_mt_country, NULL AS last_mt_country, NULL AS step_action_info, NULL AS campaign_id, NULL AS campaign_name, NULL AS adgroup_name, NULL AS adgroup_id, NULL AS creative_id, NULL AS creative_name, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, logymd, app_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND did <> 'unknown'), ad_attribution /* 最新一天归因到的广告信息 */ AS (SELECT logymd, app_id, did, package_name, CASE WHEN createdate = logymd THEN ad_country END AS first_ad_country, ad_country AS last_ad_country, ad_country /* (已改)可以按照归因日期和创建日期比较小，得到first和last两个字段，media source同理，这样下面的join只保留t3，可以少一次，也就会少一次shffle */, CASE WHEN createdate = logymd THEN media_source END AS first_media_source, media_source AS last_media_source, media_source, createdate, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_name, adgroup_id, creative_id, creative_name, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di /* fuxinwang：应该改为dim_attribution_create_device_di表？都可以，如果用dim_attribution_create_device_di需要读取30天分区，用dim_attribution_device_di只用一天就行 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), step_did_info /* ,package_name */ AS (SELECT did, app_id, '01' AS stage_id, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(step_action_id)) AS step_action_info /* package_name, */ FROM (SELECT did, appid AS app_id, package_name, CONCAT(step_id, '-', action_name) AS step_action_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_step_action_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT CONCAT(step_id, '-', action_name) IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT did, app_id, package_name, step_action_id FROM all_device LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(step_action_info, ',')) a AS step_action_id WHERE NOT step_action_id IS NULL AND step_action_id <> '') AS info GROUP BY did, app_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_df PARTITION(logymd, app_id) SELECT did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, step_action_info, app_version, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_name, adgroup_id, creative_id, creative_name, stage_id, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, app_id FROM (SELECT t1.did, t1.package_name, t1.is_emulator, t1.client_ip, t1.os, t1.model, t1.os_version, t1.network_type, t1.os_language, t1.createdate, t1.ip_country, t1.client_version, t1.sdk_version, t1.idfa, t1.idfv, t1.gps_adid, t1.android_id, t1.imei, t1.oaid, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, t2.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, IF((t1.last_media_source <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.last_media_source IS NULL), t1.last_media_source, COALESCE(t2.last_media_source, 'unknown')) AS last_media_source, COALESCE(t1.first_ad_country, t2.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, IF((t1.last_ad_country <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.last_ad_country IS NULL), t1.last_ad_country, COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, 'unknown')) AS last_ad_country, IF((t1.first_mt_country <> 'unknown' OR NOT t1.first_mt_country IS NULL), t1.first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_ad_country, t2.first_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown')) AS first_mt_country, IF((t1.last_ad_country <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.last_ad_country IS NULL), t1.last_ad_country, COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown')) AS last_mt_country, t3.step_action_info /* COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, */, t1.app_version, IF((t1.campaign_id <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.campaign_id IS NULL), t1.campaign_id, COALESCE(t2.campaign_id, 'unknown')) AS campaign_id, IF((t1.campaign_name <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.campaign_name IS NULL), t1.campaign_name, COALESCE(t2.campaign_name, 'unknown')) AS campaign_name, IF((t1.adgroup_name <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.adgroup_name IS NULL), t1.adgroup_name, COALESCE(t2.adgroup_name, 'unknown')) AS adgroup_name, IF((t1.adgroup_id <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.adgroup_id IS NULL), t1.adgroup_id, COALESCE(t2.adgroup_id, 'unknown')) AS adgroup_id, IF((t1.creative_id <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.creative_id IS NULL), t1.creative_id, COALESCE(t2.creative_id, 'unknown')) AS creative_id, IF((t1.creative_name <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.creative_name IS NULL), t1.creative_name, COALESCE(t2.creative_name, 'unknown')) AS creative_name, t1.stage_id, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.app_id FROM all_device AS t1 LEFT JOIN ad_attribution AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.did = t2.did AND t1.stage_id = t2.stage_id /* AND     t1.package_name = t2.package_name */ LEFT JOIN step_did_info AS t3 ON t1.app_id = t3.app_id AND t1.did = t3.did AND t1.stage_id = t3.stage_id /* AND     t1.package_name = t3.package_name */ WHERE t1.createdate BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT t1.did, t1.package_name, t1.is_emulator, t1.client_ip, t1.os, t1.model, t1.os_version, t1.network_type, t1.os_language, t1.createdate, t1.ip_country, t1.client_version, t1.sdk_version, t1.idfa, t1.idfv, t1.gps_adid, t1.android_id, t1.imei, t1.oaid, t1.first_media_source, t1.last_media_source, t1.first_ad_country, t1.last_ad_country, t1.first_mt_country, t1.last_mt_country, t1.step_action_info, t1.app_version, t1.campaign_id, t1.campaign_name, t1.adgroup_name, t1.adgroup_id, t1.creative_id, t1.creative_name, t1.stage_id, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.app_id FROM all_device AS t1 WHERE createdate < '2026-05-02') AS x

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_core_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: fuxinwang */ /* Create by: 2022-05-23 18:14:13.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_core_role_zone_di */ /* ( */ /*    roleid                     DECIMAL(20, 0)     COMMENT '角色id,key', */ /*    zoneid                     BIGINT             COMMENT '服务器,key', */ /*    lose_os_type               BIGINT             COMMENT '流失日期当天系统平台类型', */ /*    lose_level                 BIGINT             COMMENT '流失日期当天玩家登陆最大等级', */ /*    lose_last_ip               STRING             COMMENT '流失日期当天角色id粒度下末次活跃ip', */ /*    active_days                BIGINT             COMMENT '活跃天数', */ /*    lose_date                  STRING             COMMENT '流失日期', */ /*    lose_days                  INT                COMMENT '流失天数', */ /*    lose_cnt                   INT                COMMENT '第几次流失', */ /*    recurring_date             STRING             COMMENT '回流日期', */ /*    register_date              STRING             COMMENT '角色注册日期(role+zone)' */ /*    first_ad_country           STRING             COMMENT '首次广告归因国家', */ /*    last_ad_country            STRING             COMMENT '末次广告归因国家', */ /*    first_mt_country           STRING             COMMENT '首次创号国', */ /*    last_mt_country            STRING             COMMENT '末次创号国', */ /*    first_network_name         STRING             COMMENT '首次投放归因渠道', */ /*    last_network_name          STRING             COMMENT '末次投放归因渠道', */ /*    area_id                    STRING             COMMENT '游戏区域，通过first_mt_country + 配置表' */ /* ) COMMENT '角色流失回流数据-角色粒度' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd',appid STRING COMMENT '游戏id') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dm/table/dm_lose_recurring_core_role_zone_di'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_core_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT roleid, zoneid, lose_os_type, lose_level, lose_last_ip, active_days, lose_date, lose_days, lose_cnt, recurring_date, register_date, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, area_id FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (lose_days IN (7, 30) OR NOT recurring_date IS NULL)

name: etl.msdk_ads.ads_ltv_device_df
sql_units: WITH active_info AS (SELECT package_name, app_id, did FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND did <> 'unknown' GROUP BY package_name, app_id, did), pay_info AS (SELECT charge_df.package_name, charge_df.app_id, did, SUM(COALESCE(total_charge_amt, 0)) AS total_charge_amt /* 'charge' tag, */ /* count(DISTINCT charge_df.did) metrics1, */, SUM(COALESCE(total_charge_cnt, 0)) AS total_charge_cnt FROM (SELECT did, package_name, app_id, os, total_charge_amt, total_charge_cnt FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS charge_df GROUP BY charge_df.package_name, charge_df.app_id, did), role_info AS (SELECT did, package_name, appid AS app_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND if_first_role = 1 GROUP BY did, package_name, appid), modify_data_all AS (SELECT basic.package_name, basic.app_id, basic.createdate, basic.first_mt_country, basic.first_media_source, basic.os, basic.client_version, basic.app_version, COUNT(basic.did) AS dnu, SUM(IF(NOT active_info.did IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS active_user_cnt, SUM(IF(NOT pay_info.did IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS charge_num, SUM(COALESCE(pay_info.total_charge_amt, 0)) AS total_charge_amt, SUM(COALESCE(pay_info.total_charge_cnt, 0)) AS total_charge_cnt, SUM(IF(NOT role_info.did IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS new_first_role_did_cnt FROM (SELECT package_name, app_id, did, createdate, first_mt_country, first_media_source, os, client_version, app_version FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND did <> 'unknown' AND createdate >= '2022-09-21') AS basic LEFT JOIN active_info ON basic.did = active_info.did AND /* AND     basic.package_name = active_info.package_name */ basic.app_id = active_info.app_id LEFT JOIN pay_info ON basic.did = pay_info.did AND /* AND     basic.package_name = pay_info.package_name */ basic.app_id = pay_info.app_id LEFT JOIN role_info ON basic.did = role_info.did AND /* AND     basic.package_name = role_info.package_name */ basic.app_id = role_info.app_id GROUP BY basic.package_name, basic.app_id, basic.createdate, basic.first_mt_country, basic.first_media_source, basic.os, basic.client_version, basic.app_version) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_ads.ads_ltv_device_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT COALESCE(di.package_name, df.package_name) AS package_name, COALESCE(di.createdate, df.createdate) AS createdate, COALESCE(di.first_mt_country, df.first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(di.first_media_source, df.first_media_source) AS first_media_source, COALESCE(di.os, df.os) AS os, COALESCE(di.client_version, df.client_version) AS client_version, COALESCE(di.dnu, df.dnu) AS dnu, CASE WHEN df.package_name IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.dnu) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) /* 昨日=null，表示一定是当天新增的数据，因此第一位一定等于dnu */ ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.active_info), ',', COALESCE(di.active_user_cnt, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS active_info, CASE WHEN df.package_name IS NULL AND NOT di.package_name IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.total_charge_amt) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.charge_info), ',', COALESCE(di.total_charge_amt, df.charge_info[SIZE(df.charge_info) - 1])), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS charge_info, CASE WHEN df.package_name IS NULL AND NOT di.package_name IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.charge_num) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.charge_num_info), ',', COALESCE(di.charge_num, df.charge_num_info[SIZE(df.charge_num_info) - 1])), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS charge_num_info, CASE WHEN df.package_name IS NULL AND NOT di.package_name IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.total_charge_cnt) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.charge_cnt_info), ',', COALESCE(di.total_charge_cnt, df.charge_cnt_info[SIZE(df.charge_cnt_info) - 1])), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS charge_cnt_info, COALESCE(di.new_first_role_did_cnt, COALESCE(df.new_first_role_did_cnt, 0)) AS new_first_role_did_cnt, COALESCE(di.app_version, df.app_version) AS app_version, COALESCE(df.app_id, di.app_id) AS app_id FROM modify_data_all AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT package_name, createdate, first_mt_country, first_media_source, os, client_version, dnu, active_info, charge_info, charge_num_info, charge_cnt_info, new_first_role_did_cnt, app_version, app_id FROM msdk_ads.ads_ltv_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df ON di.package_name = df.package_name AND di.createdate = df.createdate AND di.first_mt_country = df.first_mt_country AND di.first_media_source = df.first_media_source AND di.os = df.os AND di.app_id = df.app_id AND di.client_version = df.client_version AND di.app_version = df.app_version DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_solar_core_account_di.mlbb

'2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_active_30d FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', 57000, 999999) GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN t_basic ON t1.roleid = t_basic.roleid GROUP BY COALESCE(t_basic.country, 'unknown')), t_charge_new_di AS (SELECT COALESCE(t_basic.country, 'unknown') AS country, SUM(day_charge_amt) AS day_charge_amt, SUM(year_charge_amt) AS year_charge_amt, SUM(total_pay_amt) AS total_pay_amt, SUM(is_pay_td) AS paid_user_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31' AND '2026-05-31' > BY roleid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN t_basic ON t1.roleid = t_basic.roleid GROUP BY COALESCE(t_basic.country, 'unknown')), t_charge_all AS (SELECT country, SUM(day_charge_amt) AS day_charge_amt, SUM(year_charge_amt) AS year_charge_amt, SUM(total_pay_amt) AS total_pay_amt, SUM(paid_user_cnt) AS paid_user_cnt FROM (SELECT country, day_charge_amt, year_charge_amt, total_pay_amt, paid_user_cnt FROM t_charge_new_di UNION ALL SELECT country_code, pay_amt, year_pay_amt, total_pay_amt, paid_user_cnt FROM t_charge_his) AS t GROUP BY country), t_solar_temp AS (SELECT country_code, dnu, pay_extra_amt, year_pay_extra_amt, total_pay_extra_amt, duration_cnt, new_user_cnt_2d, new_user_cnt_7d, new_user_cnt_14d, new_user_cnt_30d, new_retention_2d, new_retention_7d, new_retention_14d, new_retention_30d, ltv7 FROM mt_ads.ads_solar_core_account_di_temp WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_solar_core_account_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT 6571 AS app_id, 'mlbb' AS app_name, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '2016-07-21') + 1 AS obt_date, COALESCE(t_solar_temp.country_code, t_charge_all.country, t_active.country) AS country, COALESCE(t_solar_temp.dnu, 0) AS dnu, COALESCE(t_active.dau, 0) AS dau, COALESCE(t_active.wau, 0) AS wau, COALESCE(t_active.mau, 0) AS mau, COALESCE(t_charge_all.paid_user_cnt, 0) AS paid_user_cnt, 'USD' AS currency_type, COALESCE(t_charge_all.day_charge_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(t_charge_all.year_charge_amt, 0) AS year_pay_amt, COALESCE(t_charge_all.total_pay_amt, 0) AS total_pay_amt, COALESCE(t_solar_temp.pay_extra_amt, 0) AS pay_extra_amt, COALESCE(t_solar_temp.year_pay_extra_amt, 0) AS year_pay_extra_amt, COALESCE(t_solar_temp.total_pay_extra_amt, 0) AS total_pay_extra_amt, COALESCE(t_solar_temp.duration_cnt, 0) AS duration_cnt, COALESCE(t_solar_temp.new_user_cnt_2d, 0) AS new_user_cnt_2d, name: etl.msdk_ads.ads_basic_device_di
sql_units: /* CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_ads.ads_basic_device_di ( */ /*             package_name         STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名', */ /*             os                   STRING COMMENT '操作系统', */ /*             first_mt_country     STRING COMMENT '首次归因国家', */ /*             first_media_source   STRING COMMENT '首次归因渠道', */ /*             client_version       STRING COMMENT '安装的游戏客户端版本', */ /*             day_new_did_cnt      bigint COMMENT '新增设备数', */ /*             day_active_did_cnt   bigint COMMENT '设备登录数', */ /*             week_active_did_cnt  bigint COMMENT '最近7天设备登录数', */ /*             month_active_did_cnt bigint COMMENT '最近30天设备登录数', */ /*             avg_login_cnt        DECIMAL(18,2) COMMENT '平均登录次数', */ /*             avg_online_duration  DECIMAL(18,2) COMMENT '平均登录时长', */ /*             pay_iap              bigint COMMENT '游戏内充值金额（美分）', */ /*             pay_iap_cnt          bigint COMMENT '游戏内充值订单数', */ /*             pay_iap_num          bigint COMMENT '游戏内充值设备数', */ /*             day_login_cnt        bigint COMMENT '当日登录次数', */ /*             day_online_duration  bigint COMMENT '当日登录时长', */ /*             day_new_pay_did_cnt   bigint COMMENT '新增设备中新增当日付费设备数' */ /*         ) COMMENT '设备基础指标表-增量' */ /* PARTITIONED BY */ /*         (logymd STRING COMMENT '数据日期yyyy-MM-dd', app_id STRING COMMENT '应用唯一ID') STORED AS PARQUET; */ /* 活跃DWM表(指标：活跃，在线时长，登录次数) */ WITH active_device AS (SELECT package_name, did, logymd, app_id, login_cnt, online_time, os, day_last_model, day_last_os_version, day_last_client_version FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_device_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND did <> 'unknown'), pay_device /* 付费DWM表(指标：付费设备数，付费金额，订单数) */ AS (SELECT package_name, did, logymd, app_id, day_charge_cnt, day_charge_sum, os, day_last_model, day_last_os_version, day_last_client_version FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), basic_device /* 全量设备表取扩展维度信息 */ AS (SELECT app_id, did, package_name, os, client_version, model, os_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country, createdate FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND did <> 'unknown'), active_device_30d AS (SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.logymd, t1.os, t2.first_mt_country, t2.first_media_source, t1.day_last_client_version AS client_version, t1.day_last_model AS model, t1.day_last_os_version AS os_version, t1.did, t1.login_cnt, t1.online_time, IF(t1.logymd = '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_active_td, IF(t1.logymd >= '2026-05-25' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_active_7d, IF(t1.logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_active_30d FROM active_device AS t1 LEFT JOIN basic_device AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.did = t2.did WHERE t1.logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31'), total_dim /* 主表，全量维度 */ AS (SELECT app_id, package_name, os, client_version, COALESCE(first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country FROM (SELECT app_id, package_name, os, client_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country FROM basic_device GROUP BY app_id, package_name, os, client_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country UNION ALL SELECT app_id, package_name, os, client_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country FROM active_device_30d AS t1 GROUP BY app_id, package_name, os, client_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country UNION ALL SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.day_last_client_version AS client_version, t2.first_media_source, t2.first_mt_country FROM pay_device AS t1 LEFT JOIN basic_device AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.did = t2.did WHERE t1.logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.day_last_client_version, t2.first_media_source, t2.first_mt_country) AS t1 GROUP BY app_id, package_name, os, client_version, COALESCE(first_media_source, 'unknown'), COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_ads.ads_basic_device_di PARTITION(logymd, app_id) SELECT t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, t2.day_new_did_cnt, t3.day_active_did_cnt, t4.week_active_did_cnt, t5.month_active_did_cnt, CAST(t3.day_login_cnt * 1.0 / t3.day_active_did_cnt * 1.0 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS avg_login_cnt, CAST(t3.day_online_duration * 1.0 / t3.day_active_did_cnt * 1.0 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS avg_online_duration, t6.pay_iap, t6.pay_iap_cnt, t6.pay_iap_num, t3.day_login_cnt, t3.day_online_duration, t2.day_new_pay_did_cnt, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.app_id FROM total_dim AS t1 LEFT JOIN (/* 新增设备数 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.createdate AS logymd, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t1.client_version, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.did) AS day_new_did_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.did) AS day_new_pay_did_cnt FROM basic_device AS t1 LEFT JOIN pay_device AS t2 ON t1.did = t2.did WHERE t1.createdate = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.createdate, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t1.client_version) AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.os = t2.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t2.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t2.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t2.client_version LEFT JOIN (/* 当日活跃 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t1.client_version, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.did) AS day_active_did_cnt, SUM(login_cnt) AS day_login_cnt /* fuxinwang:改为sum，avg使用范围太小，比值指标应该至少保留分子分母，online_time同理，avg可以保留 */, SUM(online_time) AS day_online_duration /* 时长的词根，可以统一为“_duration”，比如online_duration，time容易混淆，时间点也可以叫做time */ FROM active_device_30d AS t1 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t1.client_version) AS t3 ON t1.app_id = t3.app_id AND t1.package_name = t3.package_name AND t1.os = t3.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t3.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t3.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t3.client_version LEFT JOIN (/* 近7日活跃 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t1.client_version, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.did) AS week_active_did_cnt FROM (SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.did FROM active_device_30d AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd >= '2026-05-25' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.did) AS t1 GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t1.client_version) AS t4 ON t1.app_id = t4.app_id AND t1.package_name = t4.package_name AND t1.os = t4.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t4.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t4.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t4.client_version LEFT JOIN (/* 近30日活跃 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t1.client_version, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.did) AS month_active_did_cnt FROM (SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.did FROM active_device_30d AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.did) AS t1 GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t1.client_version) AS t5 ON t1.app_id = t5.app_id AND t1.package_name = t5.package_name AND t1.os = t5.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t5.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t5.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t5.client_version LEFT JOIN (/* 付费 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.logymd, t1.os, COALESCE(t2.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t2.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t1.day_last_client_version AS client_version, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.did) AS pay_iap_num, SUM(t1.day_charge_cnt) AS pay_iap_cnt, SUM(day_charge_sum) AS pay_iap FROM pay_device AS t1 LEFT JOIN basic_device AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.did = t2.did WHERE t1.logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.logymd, t1.os, COALESCE(t2.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t2.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t1.day_last_client_version) AS t6 ON t1.app_id = t6.app_id AND t1.package_name = t6.package_name AND t1.os = t6.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t6.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t6.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t6.client_version DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: etl.msdk_dim.dim_attribution_create_device_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dim.dim_attribution_create_device_di PARTITION(logymd, app_id) SELECT did /*	设备指纹, 设备唯一识别, key */, package_name /*	首次安装的游戏分包名, key */, os /*	mmp归因操作系统,af_install近30天归因 */, ad_country /*	mmp归因国家,af_install近30天归因 */, media_source /*	归因广告渠道,af_install近30天归因 */, campaign_id /*	归因广告系列ID,af_install近30天归因 */, adgroup_id /*	归因广告组ID,af_install近30天归因 */, creative_id /*	归因广告创意ID,af_install近30天归因 */, campaign_name /*	归因广告系列名称,af_install近30天归因 */, adgroup_name /*	归因广告组名称,af_install近30天归因 */, creative_name /*	归因广告创意名称,af_install近30天归因 */, gps_adid /*	归因安卓设备的gps_adid,af_install近30天归因 */, android_id /*	归因安卓设备的android_id,af_install近30天归因 */, oaid /*	归因安卓设备的oaid（中国厂商）,af_install近30天归因 */, idfa /*	归因IOS设备的IDFA,af_install近30天归因 */, idfv /*	归因IOS设备的IDFV,af_install近30天归因 */, mmp_id /*	归因MMP的设备唯一ID,af_install近30天归因 */, logymd AS attr_date /*	归因日期yyyy-MM-dd */, attr_time /* 归因时间 */, attr_source /* 归因属性来源 */, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, createdate AS logymd /*	设备新增日期 */, app_id /*	应用唯一ID, key */ FROM msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND createdate <= '2026-05-31' AND createdate >= '2026-05-02' DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df
sql_units: /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE  mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df( */ /*    accountid              decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '账号id' */ /* ) COMMENT '对字节敏感用户表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*    logymd string COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd', */ /*    appid string COMMENT '游戏id' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dim/table/dim_bd_senssitive_account_df' */ /* ; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid) SELECT accountid, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-06', '2022-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND (UPPER(first_ad_country) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') OR UPPER(last_ad_country) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') OR UPPER(os_country) IN ('AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') OR UPPER(first_ip_country) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') OR UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') OR UPPER(last_mt_country) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) DISTRIBUTE BY appid, CASE WHEN appid = 'mlbb' THEN HASH(accountid) % 5 ELSE 1 END

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_newbie_guide_role_zone_di

name: bytedance_export_connserver_client_gameskill_36
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.connserver_client_gameskill_36 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, loghms, zoneid, accountid, level, startup_time, battleid, pvptype, buyequipcount, buyequiptime, avgapm, maxapm, addskillcount, addskilltime, battletime, totalcount, destorytowerinfo, crosstowerkill, revengekill, extremebackhome, heroid, commonatkcount, addskillwrongcount, firstskillusecount, secondskillusecount, thirdskillusecount, fuorthskillusecount, battleendarea, trybackhomecount, backhomesuccessfullycount, tryrecovercount, recoversuccessfullycount, battleskillid, battleskillusecount FROM (SELECT time, loghms, zoneid, accountid, level, startup_time, battleid, pvptype, buyequipcount, buyequiptime, avgapm, maxapm, addskillcount, addskilltime, battletime, totalcount, destorytowerinfo, crosstowerkill, revengekill, extremebackhome, heroid, commonatkcount, addskillwrongcount, firstskillusecount, secondskillusecount, thirdskillusecount, fuorthskillusecount, battleendarea, trybackhomecount, backhomesuccessfullycount, tryrecovercount, recoversuccessfullycount, battleskillid, battleskillusecount, logymd FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_gameskill WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT COALESCE(UPPER(GEOIP(ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))), '') IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS main_data LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_account FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-07', '2022-05-07', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON main_data.accountid = adv_us.us_account WHERE adv_us.us_account IS NULL

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_mlbb_hero_rune_hot PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 全服16级以上 */ SELECT heroid, NULL AS `level`, SUM(IF(wincamp = 1 AND bigranklvl >= 5, 1, 0)) AS win_cnt, SUM(IF(bigranklvl >= 5, 1, 0)) AS total, new_runeid, new_rune_skill1, new_rune_skill2, new_rune_skill3, 1 AS etl_type FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE pvptype = 2 AND zoneid < 50000 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND new_runeid > 0 AND new_rune_skill1 > 0 AND new_rune_skill2 > 0 AND new_rune_skill3 > 0 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND realpvptype IN (2, 59, 90) AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY 1, 0)) AS total, new_runeid, new_rune_skill1, new_rune_skill2, new_rune_skill3, 2 AS etl_type FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE pvptype = 2 AND zoneid < 50000 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND new_runeid > 0 AND new_rune_skill1 > 0 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND realpvptype IN (2, 59, 90) AND fake_ai = 0 AND `level` >= 9 AND `level` <= 15 GROUP BY heroid, `level`, new_runeid, new_rune_skill1, new_runeid, new_rune_skill1, new_rune_skill2, new_rune_skill3, 3 AS etl_type FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE pvptype = 2 AND zoneid >= 57001 AND zoneid <= 57199 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND new_runeid > 0 AND new_rune_skill1 > 0 AND new_rune_skill2 > 0 AND new_rune_skill3 > 0 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY heroid, new_runeid, new_rune_skill1, new_rune_skill2, new_rune_skill3 UNION ALL /* 测服 9-15级 */ SELECT heroid, `level`, SUM(IF(wincamp = 1 AND bigranklvl >= 1, 1, 0)) AS win_cnt, SUM(IF(bigranklvl >= 1, 1, 0)) AS total, new_runeid, new_rune_skill1, new_rune_skill2, new_rune_skill3, 4 AS etl_type FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE pvptype = 2 AND zoneid >= 57001 AND zoneid <= 57199 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND new_runeid > 0 AND new_rune_skill1 > 0 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND fake_ai = 0 AND `level` >= 9 AND `level` <= 15 GROUP BY heroid, `level`, new_runeid, new_rune_skill1, new_rune_skill2, new_rune_skill3

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_social_attribute_account_df
sql_units: WITH t_surver_config AS (SELECT CONCAT('{', CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(IF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(',', qa_a, qa_b, qa_c, qa_d, qa_e, qa_f, qa_g, qa_h, qa_i, qa_j, qa_k, qa_l, qa_m, qa_n)) = '', NULL, CONCAT_WS(',', qa_a, qa_b, qa_c, qa_d, qa_e, qa_f, qa_g, qa_h, qa_i, qa_j, qa_k, qa_l, qa_m, qa_n)))), '}') AS qa_mapping, '2026-05-31' AS lyd FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN NOT answer_a IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_a', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_a, '"')) END AS qa_a, CASE WHEN NOT answer_b IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_b', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_b, '"')) END AS qa_b, CASE WHEN NOT answer_c IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_c', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_c, '"')) END AS qa_c, CASE WHEN NOT answer_d IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_d', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_d, '"')) END AS qa_d, CASE WHEN NOT answer_e IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_e', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_e, '"')) END AS qa_e, CASE WHEN NOT answer_f IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_f', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_f, '"')) END AS qa_f, CASE WHEN NOT answer_g IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_g', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_g, '"')) END AS qa_g, CASE WHEN NOT answer_h IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_h', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_h, '"')) END AS qa_h, CASE WHEN NOT answer_i IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_i', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_i, '"')) END AS qa_i, CASE WHEN NOT answer_j IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_j', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_j, '"')) END AS qa_j, CASE WHEN NOT answer_k IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_k', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_k, '"')) END AS qa_k, CASE WHEN NOT answer_l IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_l', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_l, '"')) END AS qa_l, CASE WHEN NOT answer_m IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_m', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_m, '"')) END AS qa_m, CASE WHEN NOT answer_n IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('"', question, '_n', '"'), ':', CONCAT('"', answer_n, '"')) END AS qa_n FROM (SELECT question, CASE WHEN question = 14 THEN 'boy' WHEN question IN (16, 355) THEN '小学生' ELSE answer_a END AS answer_a, CASE WHEN question = 14 THEN 'girl' WHEN question IN (16, 355) THEN '中学生' ELSE answer_b END AS answer_b, CASE WHEN question IN (16, 355) THEN '高中生' ELSE answer_c END AS answer_c, CASE WHEN question IN (16, 355) THEN '大学生' ELSE answer_d END AS answer_d, answer_e, answer_f, answer_g, answer_h, answer_i, answer_j, answer_k, answer_l, answer_m, answer_n FROM mt_dim.dim_act_survey_answer_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND question IN (14, 16, 355)) AS t1) AS t2), t_surver_di AS (SELECT roleid, first_q14, first_q71, CASE WHEN SPLIT(first_q16, '_')[0] > SPLIT(first_q355, '_')[0] THEN SPLIT(first_q16, '_')[1] WHEN SPLIT(first_q16, '_')[0] = SPLIT(first_q355, '_')[0] THEN CASE WHEN NOT SPLIT(first_q16, '_')[1] IS NULL THEN SPLIT(first_q16, '_')[1] ELSE SPLIT(first_q355, '_')[1] END ELSE SPLIT(first_q355, '_')[1] END AS first_q16_355, '2026-05-31' AS lyd FROM (SELECT roleid, MAX(first_q14) AS first_q14, MAX(first_q71) AS first_q71, MAX(first_q16) AS first_q16, MAX(first_q355) AS first_q355 FROM (SELECT roleid, FIRST_VALUE(question14) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY CASE WHEN NOT question14 IS NULL THEN recycling_time ELSE '1970-01-01 00:00:00' END DESC) AS first_q14, FIRST_VALUE(question71) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY CASE WHEN NOT question71 IS NULL THEN recycling_time ELSE '1970-01-01 00:00:00' END DESC) AS first_q71, FIRST_VALUE(CONCAT(COALESCE(CAST(recycling_time AS STRING), '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), '_', COALESCE(question16, 'unknown'))) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY CASE WHEN NOT question16 IS NULL THEN recycling_time ELSE '1970-01-01 00:00:00' END DESC) AS first_q16, FIRST_VALUE(CONCAT(COALESCE(CAST(recycling_time AS STRING), '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), '_', COALESCE(question355, 'unknown'))) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY CASE WHEN NOT question355 IS NULL THEN recycling_time ELSE '1970-01-01 00:00:00' END DESC) AS first_q355 /*      ,first_value(recycling_time) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY CASE WHEN question16 is not null THEN recycling_time  ELSE '1970-01-01 00:00:00' END DESC) as last_q16_rectime  --最后一次有效问题16回收时间 */ /*      ,first_value(recycling_time) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY CASE WHEN question355 is not null THEN recycling_time  ELSE '1970-01-01 00:00:00' END DESC) as last_q355_rectime  --最后一次有效问题16回收时间 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, question14, question16, question355, recycling_time, CASE WHEN question71 IN ('1980-', '2015+') OR question71 RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN question71 END AS question71 FROM mt_dwd.dwd_act_survey_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) AS t1) AS t2 GROUP BY roleid) AS t3) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_social_attribute_account_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT t_surver_di.roleid, COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(qa_mapping, CASE LOWER(first_q14) WHEN 'a' THEN '$.14_a' WHEN 'b' THEN '$.14_b' END), 'unknown') AS sex /*      , case when !first_q71 = '1980-'  then replace(first_q71,'-','/') else first_q71 end as born */, COALESCE(first_q71, '1900-01-01') AS born, COALESCE(CASE WHEN FLOOR(((YEAR('2026-05-31') - YEAR(first_q71)) * 12 + (MONTH('2026-05-31') - MONTH(first_q71))) / 12) < 0 THEN -99999 ELSE FLOOR(((YEAR('2026-05-31') - YEAR(first_q71)) * 12 + (MONTH('2026-05-31') - MONTH(first_q71))) / 12) END, -99999) AS age, COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(qa_mapping, CASE LOWER(first_q16_355) WHEN 'a' THEN '$.16_a' WHEN 'b' THEN '$.16_b' WHEN 'c' THEN '$.16_c' WHEN 'd' THEN '$.16_d' WHEN 'e' THEN '$.16_e' WHEN 'f' THEN '$.16_f' WHEN 'g' THEN '$.16_g' WHEN 'h' THEN '$.16_h' WHEN 'i' THEN '$.16_i' WHEN 'j' THEN '$.16_j' WHEN 'k' THEN '$.16_k' WHEN 'l' THEN '$.16_l' WHEN 'm' THEN '$.16_m' WHEN 'n' THEN '$.16_n' END), 'unknown') AS job, COALESCE(CASE LOWER(first_q16_355) WHEN 'a' THEN 'student' WHEN 'b' THEN 'student' WHEN 'c' THEN 'student' WHEN 'd' THEN 'student' WHEN 'e' THEN '农民或牧民或渔夫' WHEN 'f' THEN '自由职业者' WHEN 'g' THEN '公司职员服务业公务员工人' WHEN 'h' THEN '公司职员服务业公务员工人' WHEN 'i' THEN '公司职员服务业公务员工人' WHEN 'j' THEN '家庭主夫或主妇' WHEN 'k' THEN '个体经营或商人或雇主' WHEN 'l' THEN '专业人士 （医生、律师等）' WHEN 'm' THEN '无业或失业' WHEN 'n' THEN '其他' END, 'unknown') AS job_first_level, COALESCE(CASE LOWER(first_q16_355) WHEN 'a' THEN 'student' WHEN 'b' THEN 'student' WHEN 'c' THEN 'student' WHEN 'd' THEN 'student' WHEN 'e' THEN 'no_student' WHEN 'f' THEN 'no_student' WHEN 'g' THEN 'no_student' WHEN 'h' THEN 'no_student' WHEN 'i' THEN 'no_student' WHEN 'j' THEN 'no_student' WHEN 'k' THEN 'no_student' WHEN 'l' THEN 'no_student' WHEN 'm' THEN '无业或失业' WHEN 'n' THEN '其他' END, 'unknown') AS job_second_level FROM t_surver_di JOIN t_surver_config ON t_surver_di.lyd = t_surver_config.lyd

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_mla_behavior_corepaid_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH core_role AS (/* 大R表 */ SELECT roleid, MIN(register_date) AS register_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND his_last_active_vip >= 12 GROUP BY roleid), active_di AS (/* 活跃增量表 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, tmp_date AS his_last_active_date /* 历史末次活跃日期 */, IF(logymd = tmp_date, device_array, '') AS device_array /* 登录机型（当日值） */, IF(logymd = tmp_date, 1, 0) AS is_active /* 当日是否活跃 */, IF(logymd = tmp_date, alliance_active_total, 0) AS alliance_active_total /* 当日公会参与活跃度 */, IF(logymd = tmp_date, alliance_operate_array, '') AS allicance_operate_role /* 当日公会活跃方式 */, IF(logymd = tmp_date, allianceid_array, last_login_allianceid) AS allianceid_array /* 工会所在id （历史值，历史多个取末次） */, max_show_vip AS cur_show_vip /* 真实vip（历史值） */, max_vip AS cur_vip /* 展示vip(真实值) */, IF(logymd = tmp_date, login_duration, 0) AS online_dur /* 当日在线时长 */, last_channel AS his_active_channel, SUM(IF(logymd = tmp_date, 1, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd) AS activedays /* 历史累计活跃天数（历史值，累加） */, register_date /* 注册日期（历史值） */, IF(logymd = tmp_date, chat_cnt, 0) AS chat_cnt FROM (SELECT tbl.tmp AS tmp_date /* 炸裂后的相同日期 */, DATE_ADD(logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, logymd ORDER BY logymd) - 1) AS logymd /* 补全未活跃的日期数据 */, roleid, zoneid, device_array, alliance_active_total, alliance_operate_array, allianceid_array, last_login_allianceid, chat_cnt, max_show_vip, max_vip, login_duration, last_channel, register_date FROM (SELECT *, REPEAT(CONCAT(logymd, ','), DATEDIFF(lead_logymd, logymd)) AS date_arr FROM (SELECT a.*, b.register_date, LEAD(a.logymd, 1, '2026-05-31') OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.zoneid ORDER BY a.logymd) AS lead_logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_active_role_zone_di AS a JOIN core_role AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE a.logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND a.login_cnt > 0 ORDER BY a.logymd)) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(date_arr, 1, LENGTH(date_arr) - 1), ',')) tbl AS tmp)), battle_di AS (/* 战斗增量表 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, war_stage, crystal_tower /* 末次通天塔等级 */, IF(logymd = tmp_date, standard_arena_cnt, 0) AS standard_arena_cnt /* 当日标准竞技场战斗次数（当日值） */, IF(logymd = tmp_date, brawl_arena_cnt, 0) AS brawl_arena_cnt, IF(logymd = tmp_date, global_arena_cnt, 0) AS global_arena_cnt, IF(logymd = tmp_date, honor_arena_cnt, 0) AS honor_arena_cnt, IF(logymd = tmp_date, is_allicance_battle, 0) AS is_allicance_battle, IF(logymd = tmp_date, is_allicance_boss, 0) AS is_allicance_boss FROM (SELECT tbl.tmp AS tmp_date /* 炸裂后的相同日期 */, DATE_ADD(logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, logymd ORDER BY logymd) - 1) AS logymd /* 补全未活跃的日期数据 */, roleid, zoneid, war_stage, crystal_tower, standard_arena_cnt, brawl_arena_cnt, global_arena_cnt, honor_arena_cnt, IF(alliancebattle_cnt > 0, 1, 0) AS is_allicance_battle, IF(allicance_boss_cnt > 0, 1, 0) AS is_allicance_boss FROM (SELECT *, REPEAT(CONCAT(logymd, ','), DATEDIFF(lead_logymd, logymd)) AS date_arr FROM (SELECT a.*, IF(stage_success_cnt = 0, NULL, max_war_stage) AS war_stage, IF(crystaltower_success_cnt = 0, NULL, max_crystaltower_floor) AS crystal_tower, LEAD(a.logymd, 1, '2026-05-31') OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.zoneid ORDER BY a.logymd) AS lead_logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_battle_role_zone_di AS a JOIN core_role AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE a.logymd <= '2026-05-30')) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(date_arr, 1, LENGTH(date_arr) - 1), ',')) tbl AS tmp)), battle_di_2 AS (/* 补全battle_di 的 war_stage,crystal_tower 增量空值部分 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, standard_arena_cnt /* 当日标准竞技场战斗次数（当日值） */, brawl_arena_cnt, global_arena_cnt, honor_arena_cnt, is_allicance_battle, is_allicance_boss, MAX(war_stage) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, stage_tag_group ORDER BY logymd) AS cur_war_stage, MAX(crystal_tower) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, tower_tag_group ORDER BY logymd) AS crystal_tower FROM (SELECT *, SUM(stage_tag) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd) AS stage_tag_group, SUM(tower_tag) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd) AS tower_tag_group FROM (SELECT *, IF(war_stage IS NULL, 0, 1) AS stage_tag, IF(crystal_tower IS NULL, 0, 1) AS tower_tag FROM battle_di))), battle_progress AS (/* 战斗进度表 */ SELECT tbl.tmp, DATE_ADD(logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, logymd ORDER BY logymd) - 1) AS logymd /* 补全日期数据 */, roleid, zoneid, stage_chap, bounty_hunter, camp_tower, akashic, dawn_square, camp_info, hero_lvl, soul_vessel, equip_quality, equip_lvl, star_life, brave_gallery, skin_info, soul_vesselstar, gloryevolution_info, innate_tree FROM (SELECT *, REPEAT(CONCAT(logymd, ','), DATEDIFF(lead_logymd, logymd)) AS date_arr FROM (SELECT a.*, LEAD(a.logymd, 1, '2026-05-31') OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.zoneid ORDER BY a.logymd) AS lead_logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_battle_progress_role_zone_di AS a JOIN core_role AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE a.logymd <> '')) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(date_arr, 1, LENGTH(date_arr) - 1), ',')) tbl AS tmp), battle_resource AS (/* 战斗资源表 */ SELECT tbl.tmp, DATE_ADD(logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, logymd ORDER BY logymd) - 1) AS logymd /* 补全日期 */, roleid, zoneid, diamond, coin, hero_exp, step_water, skill_stone_low, skill_stone_mid, skill_stone_high, equip_coin_low, equip_coin_mid, equip_coin_high, equip_coin_legend, pay_exp, free_exp, lunomancy_cnt, senior_recruit_item, camp_recruit_item, holy_contract_scroll, soul_vessel_chip, soul_vessel_core, soul_vessel_giftbox, glory_evolution_giftbox, braveproof, worldtree_runestone FROM (SELECT *, REPEAT(CONCAT(logymd, ','), DATEDIFF(lead_logymd, logymd)) AS date_arr FROM (SELECT a.*, LEAD(a.logymd, 1, '2026-05-31') OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.zoneid ORDER BY a.logymd) AS lead_logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_battle_resource_role_zone_di AS a JOIN core_role AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE a.logymd <= '2026-05-30')) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(date_arr, 1, LENGTH(date_arr) - 1), ',')) tbl AS tmp), pay_di AS (/* 支付表 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(logymd = tmp_date, charge_money, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd) AS charge_amt_total FROM (SELECT tbl.tmp AS tmp_date /* 炸裂后的相同日期 */, DATE_ADD(logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, logymd ORDER BY logymd) - 1) AS logymd /* 补全日期 */, roleid, zoneid, charge_money FROM (SELECT *, REPEAT(CONCAT(logymd, ','), DATEDIFF(lead_logymd, logymd)) AS date_arr FROM (SELECT a.*, LEAD(a.logymd, 1, '2026-05-31') OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.zoneid ORDER BY a.logymd) AS lead_logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_pay_role_zone_di AS a JOIN core_role AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE a.logymd <= '2026-05-30')) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(date_arr, 1, LENGTH(date_arr) - 1), ',')) tbl AS tmp)), wish_di AS (/* 许愿表 */ SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(a.wish_type, ':', a.wish_cnt))) AS wish_type_map FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_wish_role_zone_di AS a JOIN core_role AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE a.logymd <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(DW_DB))

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_tqs_query_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT id, task_id, project_name, queuename, engine_type, user_name, is_da, fallback, ddl, status, start_time, end_time, duration, task_type, query, sql, sql_str, table_name, IF(table_name RLIKE '[*.*]', 1, 0) AS is_table, instance_type, instance_id, task_date, external_sub_application_id, trigger_id, tqs_id FROM (SELECT id, task_id, project_name, queuename, engine_type, user_name, is_da, fallback, ddl, status, start_time, end_time, duration, task_type, query, sql, TRIM(sql_str) AS sql_str, REGEXP_REPLACE(SPLIT(TRIM(sql_str), ' ')[0], '`|\\).*$|--.*$', '') AS table_name, IF(SPLIT(TRIM(sql_str), ' ')[0] RLIKE '[*.*]', 1, 0) AS is_table, instance_type, instance_id, task_date, external_sub_application_id, trigger_id, tqs_id FROM (SELECT id, engine_type, user_name, IF(u.department IN ('数据分析', '竞品分析'), 1, 0) AS is_da, IF(execution_info LIKE '%fallbackType%Presto%', 'fallback', 'nofallback') AS fallback, IF(LOWER(`query`) LIKE '%create % table%', 'create query', 'select') AS ddl, status, FROM_UNIXTIME(start_time + 8 * 3600) AS start_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(end_time + 8 * 3600) AS end_time, COALESCE((end_time - start_time), -1) AS duration, IF(`conf` LIKE '%dorado.task.version%-1%', 1, 0) AS task_type, SPLIT(name, '_')[2] AS task_id, STR_TO_MAP(REGEXP_REPLACE(conf, '\\{|\\}|"', ''), ',', ':')['mapreduce.job.queuename'] AS queuename, query /* 替换存储的ad-hoc查询中\n,\t,\等特殊字符 */, project_name, c.instance_type, c.instance_id, c.task_date, c.external_sub_application_id, c.trigger_id, a.tqs_id, LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(query, '[\\n]+|[\\t]+|[\\s]+', ' ')) AS sql /* spark */ /* lower(regexp_replace(query, '[\n]+|[\t]+|[\s]+', ' ')) AS sql --presto    */ FROM (SELECT id, CONCAT(id, '_spark3') AS tqs_id, app_id, assign_engine_id, engine_type, user_name, query, status, cost, max_results, result_url, log_url, start_time, end_time, result_ttl, `conf`, progress, query_log_url, priority, name, execution_info, assign_worker_address, date FROM mt_ods.dl_tqs_spark3__tqs_query_task_df WHERE date = IF('20260531' < '20220914', '20220914', '20260531') AND FROM_UNIXTIME(start_time + 8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.id AS task_id, a.name AS project_name FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__project_df AS a LEFT JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__folder_df AS b ON a.id = b.project_id JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__task_df AS t ON b.id = t.folder_id WHERE a.`date` = '20260531' AND b.`date` = '20260531' AND t.`date` = '20260531' GROUP BY t.id, a.name) AS b ON SPLIT(a.name, '_')[2] = b.task_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tqs_id ORDER BY update_time DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT SPLIT(REPLACE(external_sub_application_id, 'etl_', ''), '-')[0] AS tqs_id, a.id AS instance_id, a.task_id, a.external_sub_application_id, b.id AS trigger_id, b.type AS instance_type, FROM_UNIXTIME(a.task_time + 8 * 3600) AS task_date, a.update_time FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__instance_hi AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, type FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__instance_trigger_df WHERE date = '20260531') AS b ON a.trigger_id = b.id WHERE a.date = '20260531' AND NOT external_sub_application_id IS NULL)) WHERE rn = 1) AS c ON SPLIT(a.name, '_')[2] = c.task_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_email, department FROM mt_dim.dim_focus_user_info WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2023-03-14', '2023-03-14', '2026-05-30')) AS u ON a.user_name = u.user_email) AS a LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(sql, 'from_unixtime|from_utc_timestamp', ''), 'from')) field AS index, sql_str WHERE index <> 0) AS a

sql_units: WITH t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os AS register_os, register_date AS register_time, usercreateymd AS register_ymd, SUBSTRING(register_date, 12, 8) AS register_hms, usercreateymd = '2026-05-02'), t_active AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_max_active_level AS `register_max_level_30days`, active_days_sum AS active_days_sum, dwh_active_days_sum, his_last_active_device dwh_ol_time_avg_30days, his_last_active_ip AS last_active_ip_30days, his_last_active_alliance_id AS last_active_alliance_id_30days, his_last_active_alliance_level AS last_active_alliance_level_30days, CAST(his_last_active_show_vip AS BIGINT) = 0, his_last_active_vip, his_last_active_show_vip) AS BIGINT) AS last_active_show_vip_30days, his_last_active_vip AS last_active_vip_30days, CAST(IF(logymd <= '2019-12-22' AND CAST(his_max_show_vip AS BIGINT) = 0, his_max_active_vip, his_max_show_vip) AS BIGINT) AS max_show_vip_30days, his_max_active_vip AS max_vip_30days FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), t_battle AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, max_war_stage AS last_active_max_war_stage_30days, max_crystaltower_floor AS last_active_max_floor_tier_30days FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_battle_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), t_charge AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_charge_cnt AS register_charge_cnt_30days, his_charge_money AS charge_amt_sum_30days FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mla_newroles_firstmonth_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mla') SELECT t_basic.roleid, t_basic.zoneid, COALESCE(t_basic.register_os, 'unknown') AS register_os, COALESCE(t_basic.register_time, 'unknown') AS register_time, COALESCE(t_basic.register_ymd, 'unknown') AS register_ymd, COALESCE(t_basic.register_hms, 'unknown') AS register_hms, COALESCE(t_basic.register_channel, 'unknown') AS register_channel, COALESCE(t_basic.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(t_basic.first_ip_country, 'unknown') AS first_ip_country, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t_basic.register_os_country, 'unknown') AS register_os_country, COALESCE(t_active.register_max_level_30days, 0) AS his_max_active_level, COALESCE(t_active.active_days_sum, 0) AS active_days_sum, COALESCE(t_active.dwh_active_days_sum, 0) AS dwh_active_days_sum, COALESCE(t_active.last_active_device_30days, 'unknown') AS last_active_device_30days /* 新增字段 */, COALESCE(t_active.last_active_date_30days, '1970-01-01') AS last_active_date_30days, COALESCE(t_active.last_active_show_vip_30days, 0) AS last_active_show_vip_30days, COALESCE(t_active.last_active_vip_30days, 0) AS last_active_vip_30days, COALESCE(t_active.max_show_vip_30days, 0) AS max_show_vip_30days, COALESCE(t_active.max_vip_30days, 0) AS max_vip_30days, COALESCE(t_active.register_last_active_channel_30days, 'unknown') AS register_last_active_channel_30days, COALESCE(t_active.ol_time_avg_30days, 0) AS ol_time_avg_30days, COALESCE(t_active.dwh_ol_time_avg_30days, 0) AS dwh_ol_time_avg_30days, COALESCE(t_active.last_active_ip_30days, 'unknown') AS last_active_ip_30days, COALESCE(t_active.last_active_alliance_id_30days, 0) AS last_active_aliance_id_30days, COALESCE(t_active.last_active_alliance_level_30days, 0) AS last_active_alliance_level_30days, COALESCE(t_active.last_active_useralliance_level_30days, 0) AS last_active_useralliance_level_30days, COALESCE(t_battle.last_active_max_war_stage_30days, 0) AS last_active_max_war_stage_30days, COALESCE(t_battle.last_active_max_floor_tier_30days, 0) AS last_active_max_floor_tier_30days, COALESCE(t_charge.register_charge_cnt_30days, 0) AS register_charge_cnt_30days, COALESCE(t_charge.charge_amt_sum_30days, 0) AS charge_amt_sum_30days FROM t_basic LEFT JOIN t_active ON t_basic.roleid = t_active.roleid AND t_basic.zoneid = t_active.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_battle ON t_basic.roleid = t_battle.roleid AND t_basic.zoneid = t_battle.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_charge ON t_basic.roleid = t_charge.roleid AND t_basic.zoneid = t_charge.zoneid DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() * 1 AS INT)

name: mt_ads.ads_mlbb_exchange_rate_charge_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_mlbb_exchange_rate_charge_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT IF(local_currency IS NULL OR TRIM(local_currency) = '', 'unknown', local_currency) AS local_currency, COALESCE(SUM(local_price), 0) AS local_price, COALESCE(SUM(money), 0) AS pay_money, COALESCE(SUM(money_new), 0) AS pay_money_new, COALESCE(SUM(IF(zoneid < 57000, money, 0)), 0) AS pay_money_except_be /* 排除测服 */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(zoneid < 57000, money_new, 0)), 0) AS pay_money_new_except_be /* 汇率校准，排除测服 */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 1) = 0, money, 0)), 0) AS pay_money_except_token /* 排除代币 */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 1) = 0, money_new, 0)), 0) AS pay_money_new_except_token /* 汇率校准，排除代币 */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(zoneid < 57000 AND COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 1) = 0, money, 0)), 0) AS pay_money_except_be_token /* 排除测服和代币 */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(zoneid < 57000 AND COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 1) = 0, money_new, 0)), 0) AS pay_money_new_except_be_token /* 汇率校准，排除测服代币 */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(zoneid < 57000 AND COALESCE(receipt_type, 1) > 0, money, 0)), 0) AS pay_money_except_be_receipt /* 排除测服和点卡 */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(zoneid < 57000 AND COALESCE(receipt_type, 1) > 0, money_new, 0)), 0) AS pay_money_new_except_be_receipt /* 汇率校准，排除测服和点卡 */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(zoneid < 57000 AND COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 1) = 0 AND COALESCE(receipt_type, 1) > 0, money, 0)), 0) AS pay_money_real /* 排除测服、点卡和代币 */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(zoneid < 57000 AND COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 1) = 0 AND COALESCE(receipt_type, 1) > 0, money_new, 0)), 0) AS pay_money_new_real /* 汇率校准，排除测服、点卡和代币 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY IF(local_currency IS NULL OR TRIM(local_currency) = '', 'unknown', local_currency)
