AS rn FROM (SELECT package_name, did, os, is_emulator, os_version, system_language AS os_language, account_id, CAST(CASE WHEN app_id = 4500 THEN SUBSTRING(role_id, 0, 10) WHEN app_id = 4510 THEN SUBSTRING(role_id, 6, 10000000) ELSE role_id END AS BIGINT) AS role_id, zone_id, event_time, client_ip, model, network_type, system_language, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, IF(event = 'logout', level, -99999) AS level, app_id /* FROM    msdk_dwd{{DWH_ENV}}.dwd_event_log_detail_di */ FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT COALESCE(role_id, zone_id) IS NULL AND `event` IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'login', 'logout') AND NOT app_id IN (4400) UNION ALL SELECT package_name, did, os, is_emulator, os_version, system_language AS os_language, account_id, role_id, zone_id, event_time, client_ip, model, network_type, system_language, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, IF(event = 'logout', level, -99999) AS level, app_id /* FROM    msdk_dwd{{DWH_ENV}}.dwd_event_log_detail_di */ FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT COALESCE(role_id, zone_id) IS NULL AND `event` IN ('login') AND app_id = 4400 UNION ALL SELECT package_name, did, os, 0 AS is_emulator, os_version, 'unknown' AS os_language, account_id, role_id, zone_id, event_time, client_ip, model, 'unknown' AS network_type, 'unknown' AS system_language, ip_country, client_version, 'unknown' AS sdk_version, -99999 AS level, app_id /*    FROM  msdk_dwd{{DWH_ENV}}.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di */ FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('purchase_event') AND NOT COALESCE(role_id, zone_id) IS NULL) AS a) AS evt_log WHERE rn = 1) AS event_log LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, package_name, role_id AS roleid, zone_id AS zoneid, os, COUNT(1) AS login_cnt /* FROM    msdk_dwd{{DWH_ENV}}.dwd_event_log_detail_di */ FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND `event` IN ('role_login') GROUP BY app_id, package_name, roleid, zoneid, os) AS login_cnt ON event_log.app_id = login_cnt.app_id AND event_log.package_name = login_cnt.package_name AND event_log.roleid = login_cnt.roleid AND event_log.zoneid = login_cnt.zoneid AND event_log.os = login_cnt.os LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, package_name, role_id AS roleid, zone_id AS zoneid, os, SUM(COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.ol_time'), 0)) AS online_time FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND `event` IN ('__online_time__') GROUP BY app_id, package_name, role_id, zone_id, os) AS ol_time ON event_log.app_id = ol_time.app_id AND event_log.package_name = ol_time.package_name AND event_log.roleid = ol_time.roleid AND event_log.zoneid = ol_time.zoneid AND event_log.os = ol_time.os LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, package_name, roleid, zoneid, role_level, os FROM (SELECT app_id, package_name, role_id AS roleid, zone_id AS zoneid, os, CAST(COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.role_level'), -99999) AS INT) AS role_level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, package_name, role_id, zone_id, os ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND `event` IN ('add_level', 'sub_level') AND app_id = 4230) WHERE rn = 1) AS level_info ON event_log.app_id = level_info.app_id AND event_log.package_name = level_info.package_name AND event_log.roleid = level_info.roleid AND event_log.zoneid = level_info.zoneid AND event_log.os = level_info.os

name: etl.msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df
sql_units: /* CREATE EXTERNAL  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_dwm{{DWH_ENV}}.dwm_pay_role_zone_df ( */ /*     roleid                        STRING COMMENT '角色ID, key', */ /*     zoneid                        STRING COMMENT '角色区服ID, key', */ /*     package_name                  STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名, key', */ /*     os                            STRING COMMENT '操作系统, key', */ /*     his_first_account_id          STRING COMMENT '首次账号ID，游戏内全服唯一ID', */ /*     his_last_account_id           STRING COMMENT '末次账号ID，游戏内全服唯一ID', */ /*     createdate                    STRING COMMENT '角色创角日期', */ /*     model                         STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 归因信息', */ /*     first_media_source            STRING COMMENT '首日广告归因渠道, 归因信息', */ /*     last_media_source             STRING COMMENT '最终广告归因渠道, 归因信息', */ /*     first_ad_country              STRING COMMENT '首日广告归因国家, 归因信息', */ /*     last_ad_country               STRING COMMENT '最终广告归因国家, 归因信息', */ /*     first_mt_country              STRING COMMENT '首日归因国家（优先填充first_ad_country，ip_country作为补充）', */ /*     last_mt_country               STRING COMMENT '最终归因国家（优先填充last_ad_country，ip_country作为补充）', */ /*     his_first_did                 STRING COMMENT '首次设备指纹', */ /*     his_last_did                  STRING COMMENT '末次设备指纹', */ /*     his_first_os_version          STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本, 历史首次', */ /*     his_last_os_version           STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本, 历史末次', */ /*     his_first_client_version      STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 历史首次', */ /*     his_last_client_version       STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 历史末次', */ /*     his_first_pay_time            STRING COMMENT '历史首次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     his_last_pay_time             STRING COMMENT '历史末次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     day_pay_amt_info              ARRAY<BIGINT> COMMENT '每日付费金额array列表', */ /*     total_pay_amt_info            ARRAY<BIGINT> COMMENT '历史累计付费金额array列表', */ /*     total_pay_cnt                 INT COMMENT '历史累计付费总次数', */ /*     total_pay_amt                 BIGINT COMMENT '历史累计付费金额（美分）' */ /* ) COMMENT '角色付费全量表格' PARTITIONED BY ( logymd STRING COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', app_id INT COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key' ) STORED AS PARQUET; */ /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm{{DWH_ENV}}.dwm_pay_role_zone_df PARTITION (logymd='2026-05-31', app_id) */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT t2.roleid, t2.zoneid, t2.package_name, t2.os, t2.his_first_account_id, t2.his_last_account_id, t1.createdate, COALESCE(t1.model, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.last_media_source, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_ad_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.last_ad_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.last_mt_country, 'unknown'), t2.his_first_did, t2.his_last_did, t2.his_first_os_version, t2.his_last_os_version, t2.his_first_client_version, t2.his_last_client_version, t2.his_first_pay_time, t2.his_last_pay_time, t2.day_pay_amt_info, t2.total_pay_amt_info, t2.total_pay_cnt, t2.total_pay_amt, t2.app_id AS app_id FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, package_name, appid AS app_id, model, createdate, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country /*   FROM msdk_dim{{DWH_ENV}}.dim_basic_role_zone_df */ FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t1 RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(his_df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(his_df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(his_df.app_id, di.app_id) AS app_id, COALESCE(his_df.os, di.os) AS os, COALESCE(his_df.package_name, di.package_name) AS package_name, COALESCE(his_df.his_first_did, di.day_first_did) AS his_first_did, COALESCE(his_df.his_last_did, di.day_last_did) AS his_last_did, COALESCE(his_df.his_first_account_id, di.day_first_account_id) AS his_first_account_id, COALESCE(his_df.his_last_account_id, di.day_last_account_id) AS his_last_account_id, COALESCE(his_df.his_first_os_version, di.day_first_os_version) AS his_first_os_version, COALESCE(di.day_last_os_version, his_df.his_last_os_version) AS his_last_os_version, COALESCE(his_df.his_first_client_version, di.day_first_client_version) AS his_first_client_version, COALESCE(di.day_last_client_version, his_df.his_last_client_version) AS his_last_client_version, CASE WHEN SIZE(his_df.day_pay_amt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', his_df.day_pay_amt_info), ',', COALESCE(di.day_pay_sum, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(di.day_pay_sum, 0)) END AS day_pay_amt_info /* model之类的 ---需要从dim_attr里面获取       */, CASE WHEN SIZE(his_df.total_pay_amt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', his_df.total_pay_amt_info), ',', COALESCE(his_df.total_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_pay_sum, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(his_df.total_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_pay_sum, 0)) END AS total_pay_amt_info, COALESCE(his_df.total_pay_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_pay_cnt, 0) AS total_pay_cnt, COALESCE(his_df.total_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_pay_sum, 0) AS total_pay_amt, COALESCE(his_df.his_first_pay_time, di.day_first_pay_time) AS his_first_pay_time, COALESCE(di.day_last_pay_time, his_df.his_last_pay_time) AS his_last_pay_time FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, app_id, package_name, os, his_first_account_id, his_last_account_id, his_first_os_version, his_last_os_version, his_first_client_version, his_last_client_version, model, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, day_pay_amt_info, total_pay_amt_info, total_pay_cnt, total_pay_amt, his_first_pay_time, his_last_pay_time, his_first_did, his_last_did /*  FROM msdk_dwm{{DWH_ENV}}.dwm_pay_role_zone_df */ FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS his_df FULL JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, app_id, package_name, os, day_first_account_id, day_last_account_id, day_first_did, day_last_did, day_first_os_version, day_last_os_version, day_first_client_version, day_last_client_version, day_first_pay_time, day_last_pay_time, day_pay_sum, day_pay_cnt /*  FROM msdk_dwm{{DWH_ENV}}.dwm_pay_role_zone_di */ FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS di ON his_df.roleid = di.roleid AND his_df.zoneid = di.zoneid AND his_df.app_id = di.app_id AND his_df.package_name = di.package_name AND his_df.os = di.os) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name

name: etl.msdk_ads.ads_basic_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_ads.ads_basic_role_zone_di ( */ /*             package_name         STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名', */ /*             os                   STRING COMMENT '操作系统', */ /*             first_mt_country     STRING COMMENT '首次归因国家', */ /*             first_media_source   STRING COMMENT '首次归因渠道', */ /*             zoneid               STRING COMMENT '角色服务器ID', */ /*             client_version       STRING COMMENT '安装的游戏客户端版本', */ /*             dnu                  bigint COMMENT '新增角色数', */ /*             dau                  bigint COMMENT '活跃角色数', */ /*             wau                  bigint COMMENT '最近7天活跃角色数', */ /*             mau                  bigint COMMENT '最近一个月活跃角色数', */ /*             avg_login_cnt        decimal(18,2) COMMENT '每天平均登录次数', */ /*             pay_iap_amt          bigint COMMENT '游戏内充值金额（美分）', */ /*             pay_iap_cnt          bigint COMMENT '游戏内充值次数', */ /*             pay_role_cnt         bigint COMMENT '游戏内充值角色数', */ /*             day_login_cnt        bigint COMMENT '当日登录次数' */ /*         ) COMMENT '角色基础数据集-增量' */ /* PARTITIONED BY */ /*         (logymd STRING COMMENT '数据日期yyyy-MM-dd', app_id STRING COMMENT '应用唯一ID') STORED AS PARQUET; */ /* 活跃DWM表(指标：活跃，在线时长，登录次数) */ WITH active_role AS (SELECT package_name, roleid, zoneid, logymd, app_id, login_cnt, os, day_last_model, day_last_os_version, day_last_client_version FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND NOT COALESCE(roleid, zoneid) IS NULL), pay_role /* 付费DWM表(指标：付费设备数，付费金额，订单数) */ AS (SELECT package_name, roleid, zoneid, logymd, app_id, day_pay_cnt, day_pay_sum, os, day_last_model, day_last_os_version, day_last_client_version FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT COALESCE(roleid, zoneid) IS NULL), basic_role /* 全量设备表取扩展维度信息 */ AS (SELECT appid AS app_id, roleid, zoneid, package_name, os, client_version, model, os_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country, createdate, if_first_role FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT COALESCE(roleid, zoneid) IS NULL), active_role_30d AS (SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.logymd, t1.os, t2.first_mt_country, t2.first_media_source, t1.day_last_client_version AS client_version, t1.day_last_model AS model, t1.day_last_os_version AS os_version, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.login_cnt, IF(t1.logymd = '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_active_td, IF(t1.logymd >= '2026-05-25' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_active_7d, IF(t1.logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_active_30d FROM active_role AS t1 LEFT JOIN basic_role AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid WHERE t1.logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31'), total_dim /* 主表，全量维度 */ AS (SELECT app_id, package_name, os, client_version, zoneid, COALESCE(first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country FROM (SELECT app_id, package_name, os, client_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country, zoneid FROM basic_role GROUP BY app_id, package_name, os, client_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT app_id, package_name, os, client_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country, zoneid FROM active_role_30d AS t1 GROUP BY app_id, package_name, os, client_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.day_last_client_version AS client_version, t2.first_media_source, t2.first_mt_country, t1.zoneid FROM pay_role AS t1 LEFT JOIN basic_role AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid WHERE t1.logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.zoneid, t1.day_last_client_version, t2.first_media_source, t2.first_mt_country) AS t1 GROUP BY app_id, package_name, os, client_version, COALESCE(first_media_source, 'unknown'), COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown'), zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_ads.ads_basic_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd, app_id) SELECT t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.zoneid, t1.client_version, t2.day_new_roleid_cnt AS dnu, t3.day_active_roleid_cnt AS dau, t4.wau AS wau, t5.month_active_roleid_cnt AS mau, CAST(t3.day_login_cnt * 1.0 / t3.day_active_roleid_cnt * 1.0 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS avg_login_cnt, t6.pay_iap AS pay_iap_amt, t6.pay_iap_cnt, t6.pay_iap_num, t3.day_login_cnt, t2.day_new_first_roleid_cnt, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.app_id FROM total_dim AS t1 LEFT JOIN (/* 新增角色数 */ SELECT app_id, package_name, zoneid, createdate AS logymd, os, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, client_version, COUNT(t1.roleid) AS day_new_roleid_cnt, SUM(if_first_role) AS day_new_first_roleid_cnt FROM basic_role AS t1 WHERE t1.createdate = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY app_id, package_name, zoneid, createdate, os, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(first_media_source, 'unknown'), client_version) AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.os = t2.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t2.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t2.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t2.client_version AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 当日活跃 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.zoneid, COUNT(t1.roleid) AS day_active_roleid_cnt, SUM(login_cnt) AS day_login_cnt FROM active_role_30d AS t1 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.client_version, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t1.zoneid) AS t3 ON t1.app_id = t3.app_id AND t1.package_name = t3.package_name AND t1.os = t3.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t3.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t3.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t3.client_version AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 近7日活跃 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.zoneid, COUNT(t1.roleid) AS wau FROM (SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.zoneid, t1.roleid FROM active_role_30d AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd >= '2026-05-25' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.zoneid, t1.roleid) AS t1 GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t1.client_version, t1.zoneid) AS t4 ON t1.app_id = t4.app_id AND t1.package_name = t4.package_name AND t1.os = t4.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t4.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t4.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t4.client_version AND t1.zoneid = t4.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 近30日活跃 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.os, first_mt_country, first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.zoneid, COUNT(t1.roleid) AS month_active_roleid_cnt FROM (SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid FROM active_role_30d AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t1.client_version, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid) AS t1 GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.zoneid) AS t5 ON t1.app_id = t5.app_id AND t1.package_name = t5.package_name AND t1.os = t5.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t5.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t5.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t5.client_version AND t1.zoneid = t5.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 付费 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.logymd, t1.os, COALESCE(t2.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t2.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t1.day_last_client_version AS client_version, t1.zoneid, COUNT(t1.roleid) AS pay_iap_num, SUM(t1.day_pay_cnt) AS pay_iap_cnt, SUM(day_pay_sum) AS pay_iap FROM pay_role AS t1 LEFT JOIN basic_role AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t1.roleid = t2.roleid WHERE t1.logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.logymd, t1.os, COALESCE(t2.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t2.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t1.day_last_client_version, t1.zoneid) AS t6 ON t1.app_id = t6.app_id AND t1.package_name = t6.package_name AND t1.os = t6.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t6.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t6.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t6.client_version AND t1.zoneid = t6.zoneid DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

last_active_ip AS his_last_active_ip, last_curbattle_points AS his_last_active_own_battle_points, last_curticket AS his_last_active_own_ticket, last_curdiamond AS his_last_active_own_diamond, name: bytedance_export_mtaccountserver_account_bind_email_17
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: theoguo@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-06-21 15:27:20.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH white_role_list AS (SELECT adv_us.us_accountid FROM (SELECT accountid AS us_accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM ml_temp.yudongzhang_tmp_role_infos_02 WHERE logymd = '2026-01-13' AND info_type LIKE 'final_90d_notUSplayer_OhtermajorArea_%' GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 ON t1.roleid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE t1.roleid IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.mtaccountserver_account_bind_email_17 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, CASE WHEN account_name RLIKE '^[ios,and].*' THEN MD5(account_name) ELSE account_name END AS account_name, accountid, email, account_type, app_id, app_role_id FROM (SELECT time, account_name, accountid, email, account_type, a.app_id, a.app_role_id, logymd FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_bind_email AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS main_data LEFT JOIN white_role_list AS adv_us ON main_data.accountid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE adv_us.us_accountid IS NULL

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT roleid /* '角色ID' */, zoneid /* '服务器' */, resource_type /* '资源类型' */, resource_id /* '资源ID' */, time_len /* '资源生命周期' */, operate AS source_channel /* 资源渠道来源 --由于1级给蕾拉，2级给子龙，3级尤多拉 给统一渠道upgrade_gift */, get_time /* '获得时间' */ FROM (/* 新增角色数据(不包括1级给蕾拉，2级给子龙，3级尤多拉) */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, 'hero' AS resource_type, heroid AS resource_id, time_len AS time_len, SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 19) AS get_time, operate FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_hero WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL /* 新增皮肤数据 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, 'skin' AS resource_type, skinid AS resource_id, time_len AS time_len, SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 19) AS get_time, operate FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_skin WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t GROUP BY roleid /* '角色ID' */, zoneid /* '服务器' */, resource_type /* '资源类型' */, resource_id /* '资源ID' */, time_len /* '资源生命周期' */, operate /* 资源获取渠道 */, get_time /* '获得时间' */

name: bytedance_export_accountserver_account_create_17
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: theoguo@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-06-21 15:27:20.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH white_role_list AS (SELECT adv_us.us_accountid FROM (SELECT accountid AS us_accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM ml_temp.yudongzhang_tmp_role_infos_02 WHERE logymd = '2026-01-13' AND info_type LIKE 'final_90d_notUSplayer_OhtermajorArea_%' GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 ON t1.roleid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE t1.roleid IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.accountserver_account_create_17 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, accountid, CASE WHEN account_name RLIKE '^[ios,and]' THEN MD5(account_name) ELSE account_name END AS account_name, device_name, country, language, device_type, mt_id, pre_mt_id, appid FROM (SELECT time, accountid, account_name, device_name, country, language, a.device_type, mt_id, pre_mt_id, appid, logymd FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* and upper(ifnull(country,'')) not in ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') */ NOT UPPER(COALESCE(language, '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') AND LOCATE('gps_adid', COALESCE(language, '')) <= 0) AS main_data LEFT JOIN white_role_list AS adv_us ON main_data.accountid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE adv_us.us_accountid IS NULL

figh_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有战士S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, COALESCE(t4.mage_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t3.mage_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) AS mage_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有法师S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, COALESCE(t4.sup_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t3.sup_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) AS sup_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有辅助S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, COALESCE(t4.ass_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t3.ass_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) AS ass_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有刺客S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, COALESCE(t4.tank_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t3.tank_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) AS tank_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有坦克S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid /* 账号id */, zoneid /* 服务器 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid /* 账号id */, zoneid /* 服务器 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_resource_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.roleid /* 账号id */, t1.zoneid /* 服务器 */, SUM(hero_cnt) AS own_hero_cnt /* 玩家拥有英雄总数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, SUM(CASE WHEN hero_type = 5 THEN hero_cnt END) AS own_mark_cnt /* 拥有射手英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, SUM(CASE WHEN hero_type = 2 THEN hero_cnt END) AS own_figh_cnt /* 拥有战士英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, SUM(CASE WHEN hero_type = 4 THEN hero_cnt END) AS own_mage_cnt /* 拥有法师英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, SUM(CASE WHEN hero_type = 6 THEN hero_cnt END) AS own_sup_cnt /* 拥有辅助英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, SUM(CASE WHEN hero_type = 3 THEN hero_cnt END) AS own_ass_cnt /* 拥有刺客英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, SUM(CASE WHEN hero_type = 1 THEN hero_cnt END) AS own_tank_cnt /* 拥有坦克英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */ FROM (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t2.hero_type /* 1坦克、2战士、3刺客、4法师、5射手、6辅助 */, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.heroid) AS hero_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, resource_id AS heroid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_di WHERE time_len = 0 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND resource_id < 300 AND resource_type = 'hero') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, hero_name, heroes AS hero_type /* 1坦克、2战士、3刺客、4法师、5射手、6辅助 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config) AS t2 ON t1.heroid = t2.heroid GROUP BY t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t2.hero_type /* 1坦克、2战士、3刺客、4法师、5射手、6辅助 */) AS t1 GROUP BY t1.roleid /* 账号id */, t1.zoneid /* 服务器 */) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, SUM(skin_cnt) AS own_skin_cnt /* 拥有皮肤总数 (非体验卡，非染色皮肤） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level = 5 THEN skin_cnt END) AS own_skin_super_s_cnt /* 拥有S+级皮肤数量 (非体验卡，非染色皮肤） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level = 4 THEN skin_cnt END) AS own_skin_s_cnt /* 拥有S级皮肤数量 (非体验卡，非染色皮肤） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level = 3 THEN skin_cnt END) AS own_skin_super_a_cnt /* 拥有A+级皮肤数量 (非体验卡，非染色皮肤） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level = 2 THEN skin_cnt END) AS own_skin_a_cnt /* 拥有A级皮肤数量 (非体验卡，非染色皮肤） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level = 1 THEN skin_cnt END) AS own_skin_b_cnt /* 拥有B级皮肤数量 (非体验卡，非染色皮肤） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 5 THEN skin_cnt END) AS mark_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有射手S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡和染色皮肤） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 2 THEN skin_cnt END) AS figh_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有战士S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡和染色皮肤） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 4 THEN skin_cnt END) AS mage_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有法师S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡和染色皮肤） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 6 THEN skin_cnt END) AS sup_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有辅助S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡和染色皮肤） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 3 THEN skin_cnt END) AS ass_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有刺客S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡和染色皮肤） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 1 THEN skin_cnt END) AS tank_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有坦克S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡和染色皮肤）, */, SUM(skin_dye_cnt) AS own_dye_skin_cnt /* 拥有皮肤总数 (非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level = 5 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS own_dye_skin_super_s_cnt /* 拥有S+级皮肤数量 (非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level = 4 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS own_dye_skin_s_cnt /* 拥有S级皮肤数量 (非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level = 3 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS own_dye_skin_super_a_cnt /* 拥有A+级皮肤数量 (非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level = 2 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS own_dye_skin_a_cnt /* 拥有A级皮肤数量 (非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level = 1 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS own_dye_skin_b_cnt /* 拥有B级皮肤数量 (非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 5 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS mark_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有射手S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 2 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS figh_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有战士S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 4 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS mage_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有法师S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 6 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS sup_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有辅助S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 3 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS ass_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有刺客S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 1 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS tank_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有坦克S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */ FROM (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t2.skin_level, t3.hero_type /* 1坦克、2战士、3刺客、4法师、5射手、6辅助 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t1.skinid < 600000, t1.skinid, NULL)) AS skin_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.skinid) AS skin_dye_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, resource_id AS skinid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_di WHERE time_len = 0 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     resource_id < 60000 */ resource_type = 'skin') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT skinid, skin_name, skin_level /* 0 默认皮肤、1 B级皮肤、2 A级皮肤、3 A+皮肤、4 S级皮肤、5 S+皮肤 */, skin_heroid FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config) AS t2 ON t1.skinid = t2.skinid LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, hero_name, heroes AS hero_type /* 1坦克、2战士、3刺客、4法师、5射手、6辅助 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config) AS t3 ON t2.skin_heroid = t3.heroid GROUP BY t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t2.skin_level, t3.hero_type) AS t1 GROUP BY t1.roleid, t1.zoneid) AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, own_hero_cnt, own_mark_cnt, own_figh_cnt, own_mage_cnt, own_sup_cnt, own_ass_cnt, own_tank_cnt, own_skin_cnt, own_skin_super_s_cnt, own_skin_s_cnt, own_skin_super_a_cnt, own_skin_a_cnt, own_skin_b_cnt, mark_skin_gt_s_cnt, figh_skin_gt_s_cnt, mage_skin_gt_s_cnt, sup_skin_gt_s_cnt, ass_skin_gt_s_cnt, tank_skin_gt_s_cnt, own_dye_skin_cnt, own_dye_skin_super_s_cnt, own_dye_skin_s_cnt, own_dye_skin_super_a_cnt, own_dye_skin_a_cnt, own_dye_skin_b_cnt, mark_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, figh_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, mage_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, sup_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, ass_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, tank_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt FROM mt_dm.dm_resource_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb') AS t4 ON t1.roleid = t4.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t4.zoneid

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_violation_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH day_ban_info AS (SELECT w.zoneid, w.accountid AS roleid, 1 AS day_ban_role FROM (SELECT logymd, zoneid, SPLIT(cmd_param, ' ')[0] AS accountid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_gmcmd WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND cmd_name = 'ban_login' AND cmd_ret = 0 AND SPLIT(cmd_param, ' ')[2] IN ('1', '13') GROUP BY logymd, zoneid, accountid /* ---- 沐瞳侧每日封禁 */ UNION ALL SELECT logymd, op_zoneid AS zoneid, SPLIT(CAST(SPLIT(op_req_param, '\\073')[0] AS STRING), ':')[1] AS accountid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_bgip_command_process WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND command_name = 'PunishRole' AND SPLIT(SPLIT(op_req_param, '\\073')[1], ':')[1] = '1003' AND op_res_result = 'success' GROUP BY logymd, zoneid, accountid) AS w GROUP BY w.zoneid, w.accountid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_violation_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT COALESCE(di.roleid, df.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(di.zoneid, df.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(df.his_ban_role_total, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_ban_role, 0) AS his_ban_role_total FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_ban_role_total FROM mt_dwm.dwm_violation_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df FULL JOIN day_ban_info AS di ON df.roleid = di.roleid AND df.zoneid = di.zoneid

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_mlbb_id_mapping_di
sql_units: /* 需求文档： https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/doxcn490Gs6JPcfK7cjBbfoOrIh 第六部分设备码归并逻辑 */ /* -1. 账号创建 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_mlbb_id_mapping_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT * FROM (SELECT mapping_type, CONCAT('{', '"account_id":', COALESCE(account_id, 0), ',"device_id":', '"', COALESCE(device_id, '-'), '"', ',"gps_adid":', '"', COALESCE(gps_adid, '-'), '"', ',"android_id":', '"', COALESCE(android_id, '-'), '"', ',"mac_md5":', '"', COALESCE(mac_md5, '-'), '"', ',"idfa":', '"', COALESCE(idfa, '-'), '"', ',"idfv":', '"', COALESCE(idfv, '-'), '"', '}') AS map_ids FROM (SELECT 'account_create' AS mapping_type, accountid AS account_id, account_name AS device_id /* 在账号创建里面的account_name其实就是device_id */, gps_adid, android_id, mac_md5, idfa, idfv FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, account_name, gps_adid, android_id, mac_md5, idfa, idfv) UNION ALL /* -2. 登录 */ SELECT mapping_type, CONCAT('{', '"role_zone":', '"', COALESCE(role_zone, '-'), '"', ',"device_id":', '"', COALESCE(device_id, '-'), '"', ',"android_id":', '"', COALESCE(android_id, '-'), '"', '}') AS map_ids FROM (SELECT 'login' AS mapping_type, CONCAT(roleid, '_', zoneid) AS role_zone, deviceid AS device_id, android_id FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, device_id, android_id) UNION ALL /* -3. 账号绑定 */ SELECT mapping_type, CONCAT('{', '"account_id":', COALESCE(account_id, 0), ',"email":', '"', COALESCE(email, '-'), '"', ',"phone":', '"', COALESCE(phone, '-'), '"', ',"channel_id":', '"', COALESCE(channel_id, '-'), '"', '}') AS map_ids FROM (SELECT 'account_bind' AS mapping_type, accountid AS account_id, email, phone /* , SPLIT(account_name, '_')[1] AS channel_id */, account_name AS channel_id FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_bind WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY account_id, email, phone, channel_id) UNION ALL /* -4. 付费充值 */ SELECT mapping_type, CONCAT('{', '"role_zone":', '"', COALESCE(role_zone, '-'), '"', ',"device_id":', '"', COALESCE(device_id, '-'), '"', '}') AS map_ids FROM (SELECT 'charge' AS mapping_type, CONCAT(roleid, '_', zoneid) AS role_zone, device_id FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, device_id) UNION ALL /* -5. 登出 */ SELECT mapping_type, CONCAT('{', '"role_zone":', '"', COALESCE(role_zone, '-'), '"', ',"device_id":', '"', COALESCE(device_id, '-'), '"', '}') AS map_ids FROM (SELECT 'logout' AS mapping_type, CONCAT(roleid, '_', zoneid) AS role_zone, device_id FROM ml_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, device_id) UNION ALL /* -6. moonton账号创建 */ SELECT mapping_type, CONCAT('{', '"email":', '"', COALESCE(email, '-'), '"', ',"phone":', '"', COALESCE(phone, '-'), '"', ',"mtid":', COALESCE(mtid, 0), '}') AS map_ids FROM (SELECT 'mt_create_account' AS mapping_type, account_email AS email, account_phone AS phone, accountid AS mtid FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_create_account WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND account_type IN ('email', 'phone') GROUP BY account_email, account_phone, accountid) UNION ALL /* -7. moonton账号绑定, 只获取邮箱绑定的类型信息 */ SELECT mapping_type, CONCAT('{', '"mtid":', COALESCE(mtid, 0), ',"email":', '"', COALESCE(email, '-'), '"', '}') AS map_ids FROM (SELECT 'mt_bind_email' AS mapping_type, accountid AS mtid, email FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_bind_email WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* AND account_type = 'email'  --这个需求上没有体现出来,数据显示和打点了解之后,不需要加这个条件, 后续继续观察 */ GROUP BY accountid, email) UNION ALL /* -8. moonton账号邮箱再绑定 */ SELECT mapping_type, CONCAT('{', '"mtid":', COALESCE(mtid, 0), ',"old_email":', '"', COALESCE(old_email, '-'), '"', ',"new_email":', '"', COALESCE(new_email, '-'), '"', '}') AS map_ids FROM (SELECT 'mt_rebind_email' AS mapping_type, accountid AS mtid, old_email, new_email FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_rebind_email WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, old_email, new_email)) AS t

name: tmp_IAP_charge
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_IAP_charge PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, createrole_country, product_id, `money`, CASE WHEN pay_channel = '' THEN '未知' ELSE pay_channel END AS pay_channel FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_sandbox = 0 AND zoneid < 57000

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_competitor_account_di
sql_units:
/*
 需求文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/doxcnWZLNIr8YvU46VVlzHab3dg
 变更文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/XfzOdJCc8o9JnOxSMmjc2r18nac
 */ /*  数据从2019-06-21开始 */ WITH app_all AS (SELECT accountid, res_error AS app_original_name, IF(LOCATE('>', res_error) > 0, REGEXP_EXTRACT(res_error, '.*>(.*)'), TRIM(res_error)) AS app_config_name, 1 AS app_type /* 游戏类竞品 date < '2023-12-25' */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_resource_diff WHERE logymd = /* 2023-12-25日前,使用ml_ods.connserver_resource_diff 表 */ IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-12-25', '2026-05-31', NULL) AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 UNION ALL SELECT accountid, appname AS app_original_name, IF(LOCATE('>', appname) > 0, REGEXP_EXTRACT(appname, '.*>(.*)'), TRIM(appname)) AS app_config_name, 1 AS app_type /* 游戏类竞品 date > '2024-01-03' */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_appinstall WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' >= '2024-01-03', '2026-05-31', NULL) AND country_info = 1 /* 2024-01-03日后,换成connserver_client_appinstall表出数据，中间是空窗期 */ AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 UNION ALL SELECT accountid, appname AS app_original_name, IF(LOCATE('>', appname) > 0, REGEXP_EXTRACT(appname, '.*>(.*)'), TRIM(appname)) AS app_config_name, 2 AS app_type /* 社交类竞品 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_appinstall WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND country_info IN (0, 2) AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 /* 2024/5月后更换新打点表，ml_ods.connserver_client_appinstall 表将停用，期间取并集 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid AS accountid, appname AS app_original_name, IF(LOCATE('>', appname) > 0, REGEXP_EXTRACT(appname, '.*>(.*)'), TRIM(appname)) AS app_config_name, 1 AS app_type /* 游戏类竞品 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_app_install WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND apptype = 1 AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 UNION ALL SELECT roleid AS accountid, appname AS app_original_name, IF(LOCATE('>', appname) > 0, REGEXP_EXTRACT(appname, '.*>(.*)'), TRIM(appname)) AS app_config_name, 2 AS app_type /* 社交类竞品 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_app_install WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND apptype = 2 AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57), config AS (SELECT app_original_name, app_config_name FROM mt_dim.dim_competitor_appname_config_mlbb WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY app_original_name, app_config_name), app_all_config1 AS (/* 不包括>号,和配置匹配 */ SELECT a.accountid, a.app_original_name, a.app_type, config.app_config_name AS app_name FROM (SELECT * FROM app_all WHERE LOCATE('>', app_original_name) = 0) AS a INNER JOIN config ON LOWER(TRIM(a.app_config_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(config.app_original_name))), app_all_config2 AS (/* 包括>号,读取本身 */ SELECT app_all.accountid, app_all.app_original_name, app_all.app_type, app_all.app_config_name AS app_name FROM app_all WHERE LOCATE('>', app_original_name) > 0 AND app_original_name NOT LIKE '%BattleCamera%' AND app_original_name NOT LIKE '%DeviceID%' AND app_original_name NOT LIKE '%SignCer%' AND app_original_name NOT LIKE '%Signature2017%' AND app_original_name NOT LIKE '%?%'), app_all_config AS (/* 合并 */ SELECT accountid, app_original_name, app_type, app_name FROM app_all_config1 UNION ALL SELECT accountid, app_original_name, app_type, app_name FROM app_all_config2) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_competitor_account_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT accountid, app_original_name, app_name AS app_config_name, app_type FROM app_all_config GROUP BY accountid, app_original_name, app_config_name, app_type DISTRIBUTE BY (accountid % 10)

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_zgame_account_attribution_di
sql_units: /* 将row_number拆开，防止数据倾斜风险 */ /* 但是要注意，只能过滤 partition by的字段，不能过滤其它字段，否则就会更改归因逻辑（即使逻辑有问题，也不要随意修改！！！） */ WITH tmp_accountcreate_di AS (/* 近30日创角+（login+charge）回补 */ SELECT a.accountid, a.device_id, a.create_time, a.create_date, a.os_type, a.gps_adid, a.android_id, a.idfa, a.idfv, a.channel, a.source_pri, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(a.pc_device), '') = '', '', MD5(a.pc_device))) AS pc_device_md5 FROM (SELECT accountid, device_id, create_time, create_date, os_type, gps_adid, android_id, idfa, idfv, channel, source_pri, pc_device, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY source_pri, COALESCE(CAST(create_time AS STRING), '9999-12-31')) AS rn /* 当前新增账号优先取创角数据 */ FROM (/* 创角 */ SELECT CAST(accountid AS STRING) AS accountid, account_name AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 10) AS create_date, os_type, gps_adid, android_id, idfa, idfv, NULL AS channel, '1' AS source_pri, pc_device FROM zgame_damai_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT t1.accountid, device_id, create_time, create_date, os_type, WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.time END AS ins_time, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.country WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.country WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.country WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.country WHEN NOT pc.external_device_id_md5 IS NULL THEN pc.country WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.country END AS ins_country, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.network_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.network_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.network_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.network_name WHEN NOT pc.external_device_id_md5 IS NULL THEN pc.network_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.network_name END AS ins_network_name, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.campaign_id WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.campaign_id WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.campaign_id WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.campaign_id WHEN NOT pc.external_device_id_md5 IS NULL THEN pc.campaign_id WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.campaign_id END AS ins_campaign_id, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.campaign_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.campaign_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.campaign_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.campaign_name WHEN NOT pc.external_device_id_md5 IS NULL THEN pc.campaign_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.campaign_name END AS ins_campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.adgroup_id WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.adgroup_id WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.adgroup_id WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.adgroup_id WHEN NOT pc.external_device_id_md5 IS NULL THEN pc.adgroup_id WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.adgroup_id END AS ins_adgroup_id, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.adgroup_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.adgroup_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.adgroup_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.adgroup_name WHEN NOT pc.external_device_id_md5 IS NULL THEN pc.adgroup_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.adgroup_name END AS ins_adgroup_name, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.creative_id WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.creative_id WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.creative_id WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.creative_id WHEN NOT pc.external_device_id_md5 IS NULL THEN pc.creative_id WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.creative_id END AS ins_creative_id, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.creative_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.creative_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.creative_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.creative_name WHEN NOT pc.external_device_id_md5 IS NULL THEN pc.creative_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.creative_name END AS ins_creative_name, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.adjust_id WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.adjust_id WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.adjust_id WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.adjust_id WHEN NOT pc.external_device_id_md5 IS NULL THEN pc.adjust_id WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.adjust_id END AS ins_adjust_id, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN 7 WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN 8 WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN 9 WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN 10 WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL AND act.os_type = 1 THEN 11 WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL AND act.os_type = 2 THEN 12 WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL AND act.os_type = 4 THEN 15 END AS back_add_step /* -callback */, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.time WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.time WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.time WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.time WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.time END AS back_time, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.country WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.country WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.country WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.country WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.country END AS back_country, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.network_name WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.network_name WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.network_name WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.network_name WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.network_name END AS back_network_name, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.campaign_id WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.campaign_id WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.campaign_id WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.campaign_id WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.campaign_id END AS back_campaign_id, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.campaign_name WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.campaign_name WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.campaign_name WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.campaign_name WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.campaign_name END AS back_campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.adgroup_id WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.adgroup_id WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.adgroup_id WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.adgroup_id WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.adgroup_id END AS back_adgroup_id, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.adgroup_name WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.adgroup_name WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.adgroup_name WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.adgroup_name WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.adgroup_name END AS back_adgroup_name, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.creative_id WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.creative_id WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.creative_id WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.creative_id WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.creative_id END AS back_creative_id, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.creative_name WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.creative_name WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.creative_name WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.creative_name WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.creative_name END AS back_creative_name, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.adjust_id WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.adjust_id WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.adjust_id WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.adjust_id WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.adjust_id END AS back_adjust_id, act.source_pri FROM tmp_accountcreate_di AS act /* adjust_install/ios/idfa  --step1 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install_idfa AS fa ON act.idfa = fa.idfa AND fa.idfa_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 1 /* ios */ AND NOT act.idfa IS NULL AND TRIM(fa.idfa) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fa.idfa)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fa.idfa)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fa.idfa)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(fa.idfa) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(fa.idfa) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* adjust_install/ios/idfv --step2 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install_idfv AS fv ON act.idfv = fv.idfv AND fv.idfv_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 1 /* ios */ AND NOT fv.idfv IS NULL AND TRIM(fv.idfv) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fv.idfv)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fv.idfv)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fv.idfv)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(fv.idfv) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* adjust_install/android/gps_adid --step3 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install_gps_adid AS gps ON act.gps_adid = gps.gps_adid AND gps.gps_rn = 1 AND act.os_type IN (2, 4) /* and 模拟器 */ AND NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(gps.gps_adid)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(gps.gps_adid)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(gps.gps_adid)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '0000-0000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* adjust_install/android/gps_adid --step4 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install_android_id AS andid ON act.android_id = andid.android_id AND andid.android_rn = 1 AND act.os_type IN (2, 4) /* and 模拟器 */ AND NOT andid.android_id IS NULL AND TRIM(andid.android_id) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(andid.android_id)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(andid.android_id)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(andid.android_id)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(andid.android_id) <> '0000000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(andid.android_id) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* adjust_install/ios/account_id --step5 */ /* adjust_install/android/account_id --step6 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install_account_id AS acc ON act.os_type IN (1, 2, 4) /* ios and 模拟器 */ AND act.accountid = acc.account_id AND acc.account_rn = 1 AND NOT acc.account_id IS NULL AND TRIM(acc.account_id) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(acc.account_id)) <> 'none' AND LOWER(TRIM(acc.account_id)) <> 'null' AND LOWER(TRIM(acc.account_id)) <> 'unknown' /* callback不包含PC */ /* callback/ios/idfa  --step7 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_callback_ext_idfa AS ajfa ON act.idfa = ajfa.idfa AND ajfa.idfa_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 1 /* ios */ AND NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL AND TRIM(ajfa.idfa) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfa.idfa)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfa.idfa)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfa.idfa)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(ajfa.idfa) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajfa.idfa) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* callback/ios/idfv  --step8 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_callback_ext_idfv AS ajfv ON act.idfv = ajfv.idfv AND ajfv.idfv_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 1 /* ios */ AND NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL AND TRIM(ajfv.idfv) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfv.idfv)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfv.idfv)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfv.idfv)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(ajfv.idfv) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* callback/android/gps_adid  --step9 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_callback_ext_gps_adid AS ajgps ON act.gps_adid = ajgps.gps_adid AND ajgps.gps_rn = 1 AND act.os_type IN (2, 4) /* and 模拟器 */ AND NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '0000-0000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* callback/android/android_id  --step10 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_callback_ext_android_id AS ajandid ON act.android_id = ajandid.android_id AND ajandid.android_rn = 1 AND act.os_type IN (2, 4) /* and 模拟器 */ AND NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL AND TRIM(ajandid.android_id) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajandid.android_id)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajandid.android_id)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajandid.android_id)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(ajandid.android_id) <> '0000000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajandid.android_id) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* callback/ios/accountid  --step11 */ /* callback/android/accountid  --step12 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_callback_ext_roleid AS ajacc ON act.os_type IN (1, 2, 4) /* ios and 模拟器 */ AND act.accountid = ajacc.roleid AND ajacc.role_rn = 1 AND NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL AND TRIM(ajacc.roleid) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(ajacc.roleid)) <> 'none' AND LOWER(TRIM(ajacc.roleid)) <> 'null' AND LOWER(TRIM(ajacc.roleid)) <> 'unknown' /* callback/ios/accountid  --step11 */ /* callback/android/accountid  --step12 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install_msdk_did AS pc /* PC数据从2024-04-16开始 */ ON act.os_type IN (3) AND act.pc_device_md5 = pc.external_device_id_md5 AND pc.external_device_id_md5_rn = 1 AND NOT pc.external_device_id_md5 IS NULL AND TRIM(pc.external_device_id_md5) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(pc.external_device_id_md5)) <> 'none' AND LOWER(TRIM(pc.external_device_id_md5)) <> 'null' AND LOWER(TRIM(pc.external_device_id_md5)) <> 'unknown') AS temp) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_zgame_account_attribution_di PARTITION(logymd) SELECT accountid, time, os_type, gps_adid, idfa, android_id, adjust_id, adjust_country, adjust_network_name, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, createymd, add_step, idfv, data_source, logymd FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY time) AS rn FROM (SELECT accountid, TIME, os_type, gps_adid, idfa, android_id, adjust_id, adjust_country, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(network_name), '') = '' OR network_name IS NULL, 'unknown', network_name) AS adjust_network_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_name), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', campaign_name) AS adjust_campaign_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_id), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', campaign_id) AS adjust_campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adgroup_name), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', adgroup_name) AS adjust_adset_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adgroup_id), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', adgroup_id) AS adjust_adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(creative_name), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', creative_name) AS adjust_creative_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(creative_id), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', creative_id) AS adjust_creative_id, channel AS game_channel, create_date AS createymd, add_step, idfv, source_pri AS data_source, IF(create_date >= SUBSTRING(time, 1, 10), create_date, SUBSTRING(time, 1, 10)) AS logymd FROM tmp_account_attribution_di WHERE add_step <> 'unknown' /* 新增归因上的数据 */ UNION ALL /* 历史30天内归因上的数据 */ SELECT accountid, TIME, os_type, gps_adid, idfa, android_id, adjust_id, adjust_country, network AS adjust_network_name, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, createymd, add_step, idfv /* 上线需改 */, data_source /* 上线需改 */, logymd FROM (SELECT *, IF(adjust_network_name = '' OR adjust_network_name IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_network_name) AS network FROM mt_dwd.dwd_zgame_account_attribution_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-05-02') WHERE (createymd <= '2026-05-01' OR network <> 'unknown') /* 归因日期30天内，创号日期大于30天的，或者 归因日期30天内，已经归因上的 */) AS tmp) AS tmp WHERE rn = 1

day_first_ip_country, FIRST_VALUE(ip) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, ostype, pvptype, module, mapname ORDER BY time DESC) AS day_last_ip_country, FIRST_VALUE(device) OVER (PARTITION BY (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, ostype, pvptype, module, mapname ORDER BY time DESC) AS day_last_clientver, FIRST_VALUE(unityversion) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, ostype, pvptype, module,      last_ad_country, */ /*                     first_mt_country, */ /*                     last_mt_country, */ /*                     register_date */ /*             FROM name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_battle_heroes_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH t_bsvr_end_data AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, heroid, is_fake_ai /* 是否AI 0为真人 1为AI */, battle_end_time, battleid, ismvp, wincamp /* wincamp=1为胜利 */, killnum AS kill_cnt, deadnum AS dead_cnt, assistnum AS assist_cnt, ROUND(((COALESCE(killnum, 0) + COALESCE(assistnum, 0)) / (COALESCE(deadnum, 0) + 1)), 4) AS kda_single, uiskinid, select_road, IF(rn_asc = 1, rankstar, NULL) AS first_rankstar, IF(rn_desc = 1, rankstar, NULL) AS last_rankstar, IF(rn_asc = 1, minranklvl, NULL) AS first_minranklvl, IF(rn_desc = 1, minranklvl, NULL) AS last_minranklvl, IF(rn_asc = 1, bigranklvl, NULL) AS first_bigranklvl, IF(rn_desc = 1, bigranklvl, NULL) AS last_bigranklvl FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, heroid, is_fake_ai /* 是否AI 0为真人 1为AI */, battle_end_time, battleid, ismvp, wincamp /* wincamp=1为胜利 */, killnum, deadnum, assistnum, uiskinid, select_road, rankstar, minranklvl, bigranklvl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, mid_road_win_cnt /* 战斗中路 */, SUM(IF(t_battleenddata.roadsort = 0 AND t_bsvr_end_data.wincamp = 1, 1, 0)) AS not_road_win_cnt /* 战斗无分路 */, MAX(COALESCE(t_mmr.max_mmr, 0)) AS max_mmr /* 新增，当天最大mmr分 */ FROM t_bsvr_end_data LEFT JOIN t_gsvr_battle_end ON t_bsvr_end_data.roleid = t_gsvr_battle_end.roleid AND t_bsvr_end_data.zoneid = t_gsvr_battle_end.zoneid AND t_bsvr_end_data.battleid = t_gsvr_battle_end.battleid LEFT JOIN t_battleenddata ON t_bsvr_end_data.roleid = t_battleenddata.roleid AND t_bsvr_end_data.zoneid = t_battleenddata.zoneid AND t_bsvr_end_data.battleid = t_battleenddata.battleid LEFT JOIN t_mmr ON t_bsvr_end_data.roleid = t_mmr.roleid AND t_bsvr_end_data.zoneid = t_mmr.zoneid AND t_bsvr_end_data.heroid = t_mmr.heroid GROUP BY t_bsvr_end_data.roleid, t_bsvr_end_data.zoneid, t_bsvr_end_data.pvptype, t_bsvr_end_data.realpvptype, t_bsvr_end_data.heroid, t_bsvr_end_data.is_fake_ai, t_bsvr_end_data.uiskinid) AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, heroid, is_fake_ai) AS t_battle_info LEFT JOIN t_complex_cnt_info ON t_battle_info.roleid = t_complex_cnt_info.roleid AND t_battle_info.zoneid = t_complex_cnt_info.zoneid DISTRIBUTE BY ABS(HASH(roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, heroid, first_time, last_time)) % 30

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_behavior_charge_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH t_pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(IF(his_first_pay_date = '1970-01-01', '9999-99-99', his_first_pay_date)) AS his_first_charge_date, MAX(his_last_pay_date) AS his_last_charge_date, SUM(his_diamond_total) AS his_diamond_total, CAST(SUM(his_pay_usd_amt) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)) AS his_charge_amt_total, SUM(his_pay_cnt) AS his_charge_cnt /*                   , (SORT_ARRAY(array_union(COLLECT_SET(his_last_pay_date), COLLECT_SET(last_second_pay_date)), */ /*                                 FALSE))[1]                                                       AS his_last_seconed_charge_date */, '2026-05-31' AS logymd FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(his_first_pay_time, 1, 10) AS his_first_pay_date, SUBSTRING(his_last_pay_time, 1, 10) AS his_last_pay_date, his_get_diamond + his_get_token_diamond + his_get_sandbox_diamond AS his_diamond_total, his_pay_usd_amt, his_pay_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND his_last_pay_time <> '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_pay_di AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN charge_amt > 0 AND charge_amt < 99 THEN '0' WHEN charge_amt >= 99 AND charge_amt < 499 THEN '0.99' WHEN charge_amt >= 499 AND charge_amt < 999 THEN '4.99' WHEN charge_amt >= 999 THEN '9.99' ELSE '-1' END AS pay_grade FROM (SELECT roleid AS roleid_di, zoneid AS zoneid_di, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', pay_cnt, 0)) AS charge_cnt, CAST(SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', before_tax_usd_amt, 0)) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)) AS charge_amt, SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31', pay_cnt, 0)) AS charge_cnt_7day, CAST(SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31', before_tax_usd_amt, 0)) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)) AS charge_amt_7day, SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', pay_cnt, 0)) AS charge_cnt_30day, CAST(SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', before_tax_usd_amt, 0)) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)) AS charge_amt_30day FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t), t_diff AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid /* 求标准值 */, (date_diff - min_date_diff) / (max_date_diff - min_date_diff) AS r_standard, (his_charge_cnt - min_pay_cnt) / (max_pay_cnt - min_pay_cnt) AS f_standard, (his_charge_amt_total - min_pay_amt) / (max_pay_amt - min_pay_amt) AS m_standard, logymd FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_charge_date, his_charge_amt_total, his_charge_cnt, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', his_last_charge_date) AS date_diff /* 取需要参与计算的最大最小值 */, MAX(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', his_last_charge_date)) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd) AS max_date_diff, MIN(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', his_last_charge_date)) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd) AS min_date_diff, MAX(his_charge_amt_total) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd) AS max_pay_amt, MIN(his_charge_amt_total) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd) AS min_pay_amt, MAX(his_charge_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd) AS max_pay_cnt, MIN(his_charge_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd) AS min_pay_cnt, '2026-05-31' AS logymd FROM t_pay_df WHERE his_last_charge_date <> '1970-01-01') AS t), t_value AS (/* 求参考值 */ SELECT PERCENTILE(r_standard, 0.5) AS r_ref, PERCENTILE(f_standard, 0.5) AS f_ref, PERCENTILE(m_standard, 0.5) AS m_ref, '2026-05-31' AS lyd FROM t_diff), t_rfm /* 求RFM模型 */ AS (SELECT roleid AS rid, zoneid AS zid, CONCAT(r_model, f_model, m_model) AS his_charge_rfm_type FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(r_standard < r_ref, '1', '0') AS r_model, IF(f_standard > f_ref, '1', '0') AS f_model, IF(m_standard > m_ref, '1', '0') AS m_model FROM t_diff JOIN t_value ON t_diff.logymd = t_value.lyd) AS t), t_info /*   , t_behavior_df AS ( */ /*       SELECT MAX(logymd) AS newest_date FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd >= date_add(current_date(),-2) */ /*   ) */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN register_pay_amt > 0 AND register_pay_amt < 99 THEN '0' WHEN register_pay_amt >= 99 AND register_pay_amt < 499 THEN '0.99' WHEN register_pay_amt >= 499 AND register_pay_amt < 999 THEN '4.99' WHEN register_pay_amt >= 999 THEN '9.99' ELSE '-1' END AS register_pay_grade, his_last_second_charge_date FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid /*   , IF(LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTR(charge_info, DATEDIFF(b.newest_date, '2026-05-31') + 1), '0', '')) >= 2 */ /*         , DATE_SUB('2026-05-31' */ /*                     , (LOCATE('1', SUBSTR(charge_info, DATEDIFF(b.newest_date, '2026-05-31') + 1)) */ /*                         + LOCATE('1', SUBSTR(SUBSTR(charge_info, DATEDIFF(b.newest_date, '2026-05-31') + 1) */ /*                                             , LOCATE('1', SUBSTR(charge_info, DATEDIFF(b.newest_date, '2026-05-31') + 1)) + 1) */ /*                         ) - 1 */ /*                     ) */ /*         ) */ /*         , '1970-01-01') AS his_last_second_charge_date */, IF(LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(charge_info, 1), '0', '')) >= 2, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', (LOCATE('1', SUBSTRING(charge_info, 1)) + LOCATE('1', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(charge_info, 1), LOCATE('1', SUBSTRING(charge_info, 1)) + 1)) - 1) * -1), '1970-01-01') AS his_last_second_charge_date, before_tax_usd_amt_total_array[SIZE(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array) - 1] AS register_pay_amt FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df AS a /*  INNER JOIN t_behavior_df b */ /*  ON a.logymd = b.newest_date */ WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* >= date_add(current_date(),-2) */ SIZE(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array) <> 0 /* 排除历史未付费 */) AS t) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_behavior_charge_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT t_pay_df.roleid, t_pay_df.zoneid, COALESCE(t_pay_di.charge_cnt, 0) AS charge_cnt, COALESCE(t_pay_di.charge_amt, 0) AS charge_amt, IF(t_pay_df.his_first_charge_date = '9999-99-99', '1970-01-01', t_pay_df.his_first_charge_date) AS his_first_charge_date /* 这里需要把9999转成1970，否则后续使用会有问题 */, t_pay_df.his_last_charge_date, COALESCE(t_info.his_last_second_charge_date, '1970-01-01') AS his_last_second_charge_date, t_pay_df.his_diamond_total, t_pay_df.his_charge_cnt, t_pay_df.his_charge_amt_total, COALESCE(t_pay_di.charge_cnt_7day, 0) AS charge_cnt_7day, COALESCE(t_pay_di.charge_cnt_30day, 0) AS charge_cnt_30day, COALESCE(t_pay_di.charge_amt_7day, 0) AS charge_amt_7day, COALESCE(t_pay_di.charge_amt_30day, 0) AS charge_amt_30day, COALESCE(t_rfm.his_charge_rfm_type, 'unknown') AS his_charge_rfm_type, COALESCE(t_pay_di.pay_grade, '-1') AS pay_grade, COALESCE(t_info.register_pay_grade, '-1') AS register_pay_grade FROM t_pay_df LEFT JOIN t_rfm ON t_pay_df.roleid = t_rfm.rid AND t_pay_df.zoneid = t_rfm.zid LEFT JOIN t_pay_di ON t_pay_df.roleid = t_pay_di.roleid_di AND t_pay_df.zoneid = t_pay_di.zoneid_di LEFT JOIN t_info ON t_pay_df.roleid = t_info.roleid AND t_pay_df.zoneid = t_info.zoneid

WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-09-01', '2022-09-01', '2026-05-31') AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND is_first_create = 1 /* 取首个创角的账号 */), recurring_di_role AS (SELECT logymd, roleid FROM recurring_date = logymd GROUP BY logymd, roleid), active_new AS (/* 活跃 */ SELECT act.logymd AS logymd, act.roleid AS roleid, 1 AS player_type, bas.first_mt_country, act.day_login_duration FROM active_di AS act LEFT JOIN dim_basic AS bas ON act.roleid = bas.roleid /* 新增  */ UNION ALL SELECT bas.register_date AS logymd, bas.roleid AS roleid, 2 AS player_type /* 新增 */, bas.first_mt_country, act.day_login_duration FROM dim_basic AS bas LEFT JOIN active_di AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid AND bas.register_date = act.logymd WHERE bas.new_type <> 2 /* 排除模拟器新增 */ AND register_date IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-02') /* 30日回流 */ UNION ALL SELECT act.logymd AS logymd, act.roleid AS roleid, 3 AS player_type, bas.first_mt_country, act.day_login_duration FROM recurring_di_role AS rec LEFT JOIN active_di AS act ON rec.logymd = act.logymd AND rec.roleid = act.roleid LEFT JOIN dim_basic AS bas ON rec.roleid = bas.roleid), battle AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, MAX(day_last_bigranklvl) AS day_last_bigranklvl, MAX(battle_level) AS battle_level FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-02') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 GROUP BY logymd, roleid), behavior_info AS (SELECT roleid, BITMAP_MERGE(SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(logymd, '2026-05-31') + 1, 30)) AS active_info FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df) AND LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(logymd, '2026-05-31') + 1)) <= 30 /* 末次活跃在30天内 */ AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid), active_new_battle AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid AS accountid, a.first_mt_country, a.player_type, a.day_login_duration, b.day_last_bigranklvl, b.battle_level, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.logymd) > 0, SUBSTRING(c.active_info, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.logymd), 1), 0) AS is_active_2days, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.logymd) - 5 > 0, SUBSTRING(c.active_info, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.logymd) - 5, 1), 0) AS is_active_7days, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.logymd) - 28 > 0, SUBSTRING(c.active_info, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.logymd) - 28, 1), 0) AS is_active_30days FROM active_new AS a LEFT JOIN battle AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.logymd = b.logymd LEFT JOIN behavior_info AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid), ads_compete AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.accountid, a.first_mt_country, a.player_type, a.day_login_duration, a.day_last_bigranklvl, a.battle_level, COALESCE(b.app_type, -99999) AS app_type, b.app_name, a.is_active_2days, a.is_active_7days, a.is_active_30days FROM active_new_battle AS a LEFT JOIN app_all_config AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.logymd = b.logymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_mlbb_competitor_account_di PARTITION(logymd) SELECT app_type, app_name, first_mt_country, day_last_bigranklvl, player_type, battle_level, COALESCE(compet_day_login_duration, 0) AS compet_day_login_duration, COALESCE(compet_act_cnt, 0) AS compet_act_cnt, COALESCE(reten_cnt_2days, 0) AS reten_cnt_2days, COALESCE(reten_cnt_7days, 0) AS reten_cnt_7days, COALESCE(reten_cnt_30days, 0) AS reten_cnt_30days, logymd FROM (SELECT logymd, app_type, app_name, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(day_last_bigranklvl, -99999) AS day_last_bigranklvl, player_type, COALESCE(battle_level, -99999) AS battle_level, SUM(day_login_duration) AS compet_day_login_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS compet_act_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_active_2days = 1, accountid, NULL)) AS reten_cnt_2days, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_active_7days = 1, accountid, NULL)) AS reten_cnt_7days, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_active_30days = 1, accountid, NULL)) AS reten_cnt_30days FROM ads_compete GROUP BY logymd, app_type, app_name, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(day_last_bigranklvl, -99999), player_type, COALESCE(battle_level, -99999) UNION ALL SELECT logymd, 3 AS app_type, '大盘' AS app_name, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(day_last_bigranklvl, -99999) AS day_last_bigranklvl, player_type, COALESCE(battle_level, -99999) AS battle_level, SUM(day_login_duration) AS compet_day_login_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS compet_act_cnt, SUM(is_active_2days) AS is_active_2days, SUM(is_active_7days) AS is_active_7days, SUM(is_active_30days) AS is_active_30days FROM active_new_battle GROUP BY logymd, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(day_last_bigranklvl, -99999), player_type, COALESCE(battle_level, -99999)) AS t WHERE app_type <> -99999

name: mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_baseinfo_df
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: fuxinwang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-09-07 16:06:46.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* -- 2025.06.11 新增 table_name、output_path */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH task_info AS (SELECT a.id AS project_id, a.create_user_name AS project_create_user, a.owner_user_name AS project_owner_user, a.name AS project_name, a.`status` AS project_status, b.id AS folder_id, b.name AS folder_name, t.id AS task_id, t.name AS task_name, t.version AS task_version, t.priority AS task_priority, t.`status` AS task_status, t.template_id, t.queue, t.type AS task_type, t.type_group AS task_type_group, t.schedule_type, t.frequency, t.create_user_name AS task_create_user, t.owner_user_name AS task_owner_user, t.update_user_name AS task_update_user, t.deploy_user_name AS task_deploy_user, t.review_user_name AS task_review_user, t.create_time AS task_create_time, t.effect_time AS task_effect_time, t.expire_time AS task_expire_time, t.update_time AS task_update_time, t.update_message AS task_update_message, t.cron_expression AS cron_expression, t.code FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__project_df AS a JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__folder_df AS b ON a.id = b.project_id JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__task_df AS t ON b.id = t.folder_id WHERE a.`date` = '20260531' AND b.`date` = '20260531' AND t.`date` = '20260531' AND /* and a.id=50 -- 项目数仓 */ t.version <> -1 /* 上线任务 */), run_info AS (/* 监控 */ SELECT art.task_id, COUNT(DISTINCT art.alarm_rule_id) AS alarm_cnt, MAX(is_custom) AS is_custom, MAX(is_baseline) AS is_baseline, MAX(is_high) AS is_high, MAX(is_webhook) AS is_webhook, MAX(is_email) AS is_email, MAX(is_fail) AS is_fail, MAX(is_run_long_time) AS is_run_long_time, MAX(is_retry_fail) AS is_retry_fail, MAX(is_retry_num_fail) AS is_retry_num_fail, MAX(is_ddl_not_begin) AS is_ddl_not_begin, MAX(is_bjtime_not_success) AS is_bjtime_not_success FROM (SELECT * FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__alarm_rule_task_df WHERE `date` = '20260531') AS art JOIN (SELECT ai.alarm_rule_id, MAX(IF(source_type = 1, 1, 0)) AS is_custom, MAX(IF(source_type IN (3, 4, 5), 1, 0)) AS is_baseline, MAX(IF(alarm_type = 2, 1, 0)) AS is_high, MAX(IF(ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT(alarm_channels, ','), '3'), 1, 0)) AS is_webhook, MAX(IF(ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT(alarm_channels, ','), '5'), 1, 0)) AS is_email, MAX(IF(ai.alarm_item_type = 1, 1, 0)) AS is_fail, MAX(IF(ai.alarm_item_type = 3, 1, 0)) AS is_run_long_time, MAX(IF(ai.alarm_item_type = 4, 1, 0)) AS is_retry_fail, MAX(IF(ai.alarm_item_type = 5, 1, 0)) AS is_retry_num_fail, MAX(IF(ai.alarm_item_type = 6, 1, 0)) AS is_ddl_not_begin, MAX(IF(ai.alarm_item_type = 9, 1, 0)) AS is_bjtime_not_success FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__alarm_rule_df AS ar JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__alarm_item_df AS ai ON ar.id = ai.alarm_rule_id WHERE ar.date = '20260531' AND ai.date = '20260531' AND /* and ar.source_type in (1,2) -- 不看基线 */ ar.status = 1 /* 只看开启的监控 */ GROUP BY ai.alarm_rule_id) AS mon ON art.alarm_rule_id = mon.alarm_rule_id GROUP BY art.task_id), manta_info AS (SELECT task_id, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS manta_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(monitor_type <> 'Custom_SQL', id, NULL)) AS manta_normal_cnt, MAX(IF(monitor_type = 'Custom_SQL', 1, 0)) AS is_custom_manta, MAX(IF(monitor_type = 'Table_Lines', 1, 0)) AS is_table_lines, MAX(IF(monitor_type = 'Repeat_Value', 1, 0)) AS is_repeat, MAX(IF(monitor_type = 'Metric', 1, 0)) AS is_table_col, MAX(IF(monitor_type = 'Error_Value', 1, 0)) AS is_error_col, MAX(IF(monitor_type = 'Null_Nums', 1, 0)) AS is_null_col, MAX(IF(launch_type = 'trigger', 1, 0)) AS is_manta_high, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(IF(launch_type = 'trigger', monitor_type, NULL))) AS high_rule_info /* max(if(launch_type='glance',1,0)) as is_manta_weak, */, MAX(IF(launch_type = 'trigger', timeout, 0)) AS high_rule_timeout FROM mt_ods.manta__watcher_quality_tasks_df WHERE `date` = '20260531' AND monitor_state = 'RUNNABLE' GROUP BY task_id), task_table_info AS (SELECT task_id, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS('.', database_name, table_name))) AS table_name, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(path)) AS output_path FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__task_data_mapping AS a JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__task_data_mapping WHERE logymd > '20250601') AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd WHERE a.logymd > '20250601' GROUP BY task_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_baseinfo_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t.project_id, t.project_create_user, t.project_owner_user, t.project_name, t.project_status, t.folder_id, t.folder_name, t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_version, t.task_priority, t.task_status, t.task_type, t.task_type_group, t.schedule_type, t.frequency, t.task_create_user, t.task_owner_user, t.task_update_user, t.task_deploy_user, t.task_review_user, t.task_create_time, t.task_effect_time, t.task_expire_time, t.task_update_time, t.task_update_message, COALESCE(alarm_cnt, 0) AS alarm_cnt, COALESCE(is_custom, 0) AS is_custom, COALESCE(is_baseline, 0) AS is_baseline, COALESCE(is_high, 0) AS is_high, COALESCE(is_webhook, 0) AS is_webhook, COALESCE(is_email, 0) AS is_email, COALESCE(is_fail, 0) AS is_fail, COALESCE(is_run_long_time, 0) AS is_run_long_time, COALESCE(is_retry_fail, 0) AS is_retry_fail, COALESCE(is_retry_num_fail, 0) AS is_retry_num_fail, COALESCE(is_ddl_not_begin, 0) AS is_ddl_not_begin, COALESCE(is_bjtime_not_success, 0) AS is_bjtime_not_success, COALESCE(manta_cnt, 0) AS manta_cnt, COALESCE(manta_normal_cnt, 0) AS manta_normal_cnt, COALESCE(is_custom_manta, 0) AS is_custom_manta, COALESCE(is_table_lines, 0) AS is_table_lines, COALESCE(is_repeat, 0) AS is_repeat, COALESCE(is_table_col, 0) AS is_table_col, COALESCE(is_error_col, 0) AS is_error_col, COALESCE(is_null_col, 0) AS is_null_col, COALESCE(is_manta_high, 0) AS is_manta_high, COALESCE(high_rule_info, '') AS high_rule_info, COALESCE(high_rule_timeout, 0) AS high_rule_timeout, COALESCE(queue, '') AS queue, cron_expression, s.table_name, s.output_path, t.code FROM task_info AS t LEFT JOIN run_info AS r ON t.task_id = r.task_id LEFT JOIN manta_info AS m ON t.task_id = m.task_id LEFT JOIN task_table_info AS s ON t.task_id = s.task_id

name: mt_dwd.dwd_leap_manta_df
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: fuxinwang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-09-07 16:06:46.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_leap_manta_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t.project_id, t.project_name, t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_version, CASE WHEN t.task_priority = 0 THEN '普通(D5)' WHEN t.task_priority = 1 THEN '高优(D4)' WHEN t.task_priority = 2 THEN '超高优(D3)' WHEN t.task_priority = 3 THEN '核心(D2)' END AS task_priority, t.task_status, CASE WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mt_dim.%' THEN 'mt_dim' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mt_dwd.%' THEN 'mt_dwd' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mt_dwm.%' THEN 'mt_dwm' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mt_dm.%' THEN 'mt_dm' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mt_ads.%' THEN 'mt_ads' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.ml_ods.%' THEN 'ml_ods' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mh_ods.%' THEN 'mh_ods' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mt_ods.%' THEN 'mt_ods' ELSE '其他' END AS db_name, t.task_type, t.task_type_group, t.task_create_user, t.task_owner_user, FROM_UNIXTIME(t.task_create_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS task_create_date, FROM_UNIXTIME(t.task_update_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS task_update_date, monitor_state AS manta_state, manta.id AS manta_id, manta.monitor_name AS manta_name, manta.createtime AS manta_create_time, monitor_owner AS manta_owner, monitor_type AS manta_type, launch_type AS manta_weak, manta.tb_type AS manta_tb_type, monitor_frequency AS manta_freq, queue_conf AS manta_queue_conf, alarm_level AS manta_level, timeout AS manta_timeout FROM mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_baseinfo_df AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_ods.manta__watcher_quality_tasks_df WHERE `date` = '20260531') AS manta ON t.task_id = manta.task_id WHERE t.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND t.task_status = 2 AND t.task_type_group <> 17 AND t.schedule_type = 2
