name: mt_dwd.dwd_leap_run_monitor_df
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: fuxinwang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-09-07 16:06:46.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_leap_run_monitor_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t.project_id, t.project_name, t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_version, CASE WHEN t.task_priority = 0 THEN '普通(D5)' WHEN t.task_priority = 1 THEN '高优(D4)' WHEN t.task_priority = 2 THEN '超高优(D3)' WHEN t.task_priority = 3 THEN '核心(D2)' END AS task_priority, t.task_status, CASE WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mt_dim.%' THEN 'mt_dim' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mt_dwd.%' THEN 'mt_dwd' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mt_dwm.%' THEN 'mt_dwm' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mt_dm.%' THEN 'mt_dm' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mt_ads.%' THEN 'mt_ads' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.ml_ods.%' THEN 'ml_ods' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mh_ods.%' THEN 'mh_ods' WHEN t.task_name LIKE '%.mt_ods.%' THEN 'mt_ods' ELSE '其他' END AS db_name, t.task_type, t.task_type_group, t.task_create_user, t.task_owner_user, FROM_UNIXTIME(t.task_create_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS task_create_date, FROM_UNIXTIME(t.task_update_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS task_update_date /* 监控 */, a.id AS alarm_id /* 报警规则id */, a.name AS alarm_name, a.description AS alarm_description, a.status AS alarm_status /* 报警规则状态：0->关闭 1->开启 */, a.source_type AS alarm_source_type, a.receivers AS alarm_receivers, a.alarm_type /* 告警类型: 1->普通 2->紧急 */, a.alarm_channels, a.alarm_item_type, a.alarm_item_params, a.create_user_name AS alarm_create_user FROM mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_baseinfo_df AS t /* 监控 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT ar.id /* 报警规则id */, art.task_id, ar.status /* 报警规则状态：0->关闭 1->开启 */, ar.source_type, ar.receivers, ar.alarm_type /* 告警类型: 1->普通 2->紧急 */, ar.alarm_channels, ar.name, ar.description, ar.create_user_name, ai.alarm_item_type, ai.alarm_item_params FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__alarm_rule_task_df AS art JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__alarm_rule_df AS ar ON art.alarm_rule_id = ar.id JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__alarm_item_df AS ai ON ar.id = ai.alarm_rule_id WHERE art.`date` = '20260531' AND ar.`date` = '20260531' AND ai.`date` = '20260531' AND ar.source_type IN (1, 2) /* 不看基线 */ AND ar.status = 1) AS a ON t.task_id = a.task_id WHERE t.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND t.task_status = 2 AND t.task_type_group <> 17 AND t.schedule_type = 2

SELECT today_info.roleid, today_info.zoneid, today_info.register_time, today_info.register_date, today_info.create_os, today_info.create_country, today_info.first_ad_country, today_info.last_ad_country, today_info.first_mt_country, today_info.last_mt_country, today_info.first_network_name, today_info.last_network_name, today_info.ad_os, today_info.adjust_campaign_id, today_info.adjust_campaign_name, today_info.account_register_time, today_info.account_register_date, today_info.os_country, today_info.area_id, today_info.is_ai, today_info.is_first_create, today_info.new_type, today_info.adjust_adset_name, today_info.adjust_adset_id, today_info.adjust_creative_name, today_info.adjust_creative_id, today_info.game_channel FROM today_info LEFT JOIN sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: luckwang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-09-22 10:22:52.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH adv AS (SELECT gps_adid, accountid, adjust_network_name, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_adset_name, adjust_creative_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_country FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb'), ac AS (SELECT * FROM ml_temp.wjx_ml_ac WHERE usercreateymd_ac >= '2026-05-01' AND usercreateymd_ac <= '2026-05-30'), lr AS (SELECT * FROM ml_temp.wjx_ml_login_adid WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30'), b AS (SELECT logymd, roleid FROM ml_temp.wjx_ml_login_adid WHERE logymd >= '2026-04-01' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY logymd, roleid), a AS (SELECT ac.gps_adid, CAST(ac.os_type AS STRING) AS os_type, IF(DATEDIFF(lr.logymd, ac.usercreateymd_ac) >= 30, 'new', IF(NOT lr.adid IS NULL, 'old', 'new')) AS account_type, CAST(ac.accountid AS STRING) AS accountid, CAST(lr.roleid AS STRING) AS roleid_login, lr.logymd AS logymd_login, lr.usercreateymd_lg AS usercreateymd_role, usercreateymd_ac FROM ac LEFT JOIN lr ON ac.gps_adid = lr.adid AND ac.usercreateymd_ac > lr.usercreateymd_lg AND DATEDIFF(lr.logymd, ac.usercreateymd_ac) <= 29 AND DATEDIFF(lr.logymd, ac.usercreateymd_ac) >= 0), c AS (SELECT a.usercreateymd_ac, a.os_type, a.account_type, a.gps_adid AS adid, a.accountid, a.roleid_login, a.usercreateymd_role, a.logymd_login, IF(NOT DATEDIFF(a.logymd_login, MAX(b.logymd)) IS NULL, DATEDIFF(a.logymd_login, MAX(b.logymd)), IF(a.account_type = 'old', '31', '0')) AS lost_days FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.roleid_login = b.roleid AND b.logymd >= DATE_ADD(a.logymd_login, 30 * -1) AND b.logymd < a.logymd_login GROUP BY a.usercreateymd_ac, a.os_type, account_type, a.gps_adid, a.accountid, a.roleid_login, a.usercreateymd_role, a.logymd_login), e AS (SELECT d.adid, d.os_type, d.account_type, d.accountid, d.roleid_login, d.logymd_login, d.usercreateymd_role, d.lost_days, d.usercreateymd_ac FROM (SELECT c.usercreateymd_ac, c.os_type, c.account_type, c.adid, c.accountid, c.roleid_login, c.usercreateymd_role, c.logymd_login, c.lost_days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.usercreateymd_ac, c.os_type, c.account_type, c.adid ORDER BY c.lost_days) AS rn FROM c) AS d WHERE d.rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.wjx_ml_newold_adid_30day PARTITION(usercreateymd_ac) SELECT e.adid, e.os_type, e.account_type, e.accountid, e.roleid_login, e.logymd_login, e.usercreateymd_role, e.lost_days, IF(adv.adjust_network_name IS NULL, '', adv.adjust_network_name) AS adjust_network_name, IF(adv.adjust_campaign_id IS NULL, '', adjust_campaign_id) AS adjust_campaign_id, IF(adv.adjust_campaign_name IS NULL, '', adjust_campaign_name) AS adjust_campaign_name, IF(adv.adjust_adset_id IS NULL, '', adjust_adset_id) AS adjust_adset_id, IF(adv.adjust_adset_name IS NULL, '', adjust_adset_name) AS adjust_adset_name, IF(adv.adjust_creative_id IS NULL, '', adjust_creative_id) AS adjust_creative_id, IF(adv.adjust_creative_name IS NULL, '', adjust_creative_name) AS adjust_creative_name, IF(adv.adjust_country IS NULL, '', adjust_country) AS adjust_country, e.usercreateymd_ac FROM e LEFT JOIN adv ON e.accountid = CAST(adv.accountid AS STRING)

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: theoguo@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-09-26 16:56:48.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH white_role_list AS (SELECT adv_us.us_account FROM (SELECT accountid AS us_account FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM ml_temp.yudongzhang_tmp_role_infos_02 WHERE logymd = '2026-01-13' AND info_type LIKE 'final_90d_notUSplayer_OhtermajorArea_%' GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 ON t1.roleid = adv_us.us_account WHERE t1.roleid IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.gameserver_shark_rebind_52 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, device, client_ip, deviceid, target_accountname, target_accountid, target_zoneid, decision, decision_detail FROM (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, device, client_ip, MD5(deviceid) AS deviceid, target_accountname, target_accountid, target_zoneid, decision, decision_detail, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_shark_rebind WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS md LEFT JOIN white_role_list AS adv_us ON md.roleid = adv_us.us_account LEFT JOIN white_role_list AS adv_us1 ON md.target_accountid = adv_us1.us_account WHERE adv_us.us_account IS NULL AND adv_us1.us_account IS NULL

AND teamjointype1 <= 999 AND teamjointype2 <= 999 AND teamjointype3 <= 999 AND teamjointype4 <= 999 AND isfriend1 IN (0, 1, 999) AND isfriend2 IN (0, 1, 999) AND isfriend3 IN (0, 1, 999) AND isfriend4 '2023-02-01' AND accountid > 0 AND btntype = 1) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), ol_friend_info /* 首次/末次好友数 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(first_ol_idle_friend_cnt) AS first_ol_idle_friend_cnt, MAX(first_ol_friend_cnt) AS first_ol_friend_cnt, MAX(last_ol_idle_friend_cnt) AS last_ol_idle_friend_cnt, MAX(last_ol_friend_cnt) AS last_ol_friend_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(rn_asc = 1, online_num, 0) AS first_ol_idle_friend_cnt, IF(rn_asc = 1, not_offline_num, 0) AS first_ol_friend_cnt, IF(rn_desc = 1, online_num, 0) AS last_ol_idle_friend_cnt, IF(rn_desc = 1, not_offline_num, 0) AS last_ol_friend_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, online_num, not_offline_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time) AS rn_asc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn_desc FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login_friend_info WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2019-09-05' AND roleid > 0) AS a) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), intimacy_info_all /* 亲密关系/亲密度列表:imtimacy_type 1情侣(1)/2兄弟(4)/3闺蜜(4)/4挚友(5) */ AS (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, operate_type, imtimacy_type, CONCAT_WS('_', friend_role_id, friend_zone_id) AS friend_id FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_friend_intimacy_relation WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2021-09-06' AND roleid > 0 AND operate_type IN (6, 7) AND imtimacy_type IN (1, 2, 3, 4) GROUP BY time, roleid, zoneid, operate_type, imtimacy_type, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id), intimacy_info_lover AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS('_', rn_desc, friend_id)) AS lovers_id_array FROM (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, friend_id, operate_type, IF(operate_type = 7, 0, 1) AS rn_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, friend_id ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM intimacy_info_all WHERE imtimacy_type = 1) WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), intimacy_info_brother_all AS (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, friend_id, operate_type FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN operate_type = 6 AND next_operate_type IN (6, 7) THEN 1 /* 取最后一条 */ WHEN operate_type = 7 AND prev_operate_type = 6 THEN 1 WHEN operate_type = 7 AND next_operate_type IN (6, 7) THEN 1 /* 取最后一条 */ ELSE 0 END AS is_filter FROM (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, friend_id, operate_type, LEAD(operate_type) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, friend_id ORDER BY time) AS next_operate_type, LAG(operate_type) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, friend_id ORDER BY time) AS prev_operate_type FROM intimacy_info_all WHERE imtimacy_type = 2)) WHERE is_filter = 0), intimacy_info_brother AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_SET(brother) AS brother_id_array FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS('_', rn_desc, friend_id) AS brother FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, WHERE operate_type = 7) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), intimacy_info_sisters_all AS (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, friend_id, operate_type FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN operate_type = 6 AND next_operate_type IN (6, 7) THEN 1 /* 取最后一条 */ WHEN operate_type = 7 AND prev_operate_type = 6 THEN 1 WHEN operate_type = 7 AND next_operate_type IN (6, 7) THEN 1 /* 取最后一条 */ ELSE 0 END AS is_filter FROM (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, friend_id, operate_type, LEAD(operate_type) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, friend_id ORDER BY time) AS next_operate_type, LAG(operate_type) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, friend_id ORDER BY time) AS prev_operate_type FROM intimacy_info_all WHERE imtimacy_type = 3)) WHERE is_filter = 0), intimacy_info_sisters AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_SET(sisters) AS sisters_id_array FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS('_', rn_desc, friend_id) AS sisters FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn_desc FROM intimacy_info_sisters_all WHERE operate_type = 6) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS('_', 0, friend_id) AS sisters FROM intimacy_info_sisters_all WHERE operate_type = 7) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), intimacy_info_close_friend_all AS (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, friend_id, operate_type FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN operate_type = 6 AND next_operate_type IN (6, 7) THEN 1 /* 取最后一条 */ WHEN operate_type = 7 AND prev_operate_type = 6 THEN 1 WHEN operate_type = 7 AND next_operate_type IN (6, 7) THEN 1 /* 取最后一条 */ ELSE 0 END AS is_filter FROM (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, friend_id, SELECT time, dest_roleid AS roleid, dest_zone AS zoneid, intimacy_friend_reve AS intimacy_friend FROM friend_del_status_detail WHERE rn = 1), friend_del_status_res AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', intimacy_friend, 0))) AS friend_del_status_json FROM friend_del_status_info GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), intimacy_change_detail /* 亲密度最新变化列表(包含取关好友的值，即为0) / sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: theoguo@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-09-26 16:56:48.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH white_role_list AS (SELECT adv_us.us_account FROM (SELECT accountid AS us_account FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM ml_temp.yudongzhang_tmp_role_infos_02 WHERE logymd = '2026-01-13' AND info_type LIKE 'final_90d_notUSplayer_OhtermajorArea_%' GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 ON t1.roleid = adv_us.us_account WHERE t1.roleid IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.gameserver_shark_account_common_52 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, device, channel, client_ip, event_type, event_name, deviceid, decision, decision_detail, accountid, pre_accountid, app_id FROM (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, device, channel, client_ip, event_type, event_name, MD5(deviceid) AS deviceid, decision, decision_detail, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_shark_account_common WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS md LEFT JOIN white_role_list AS adv_us ON md.roleid = adv_us.us_account LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, app_role_id, app_zone_id, accountid, pre_accountid FROM mtpass_ods.roleserver_mt_pass_on_bind WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND app_id = 666) AS t2 ON md.roleid = t2.app_role_id AND md.zoneid = t2.app_zone_id WHERE adv_us.us_account IS NULL

sql_units: WITH social_di AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, upload_photo_cnt, comment_other_photo_cnt, lovers_id_array, brother_id_array, sisters_id_array, close_friend_id_array, friend_json FROM mt_dwm.dwm_social_role_zone_di WHERE appid = 'mlbb' AND logymd >= '2019-03-21' AND logymd = '2026-05-31'), avatar_type_info /* 当前头像类型 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, cur_avatar_type FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, avatar_type AS cur_avatar_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY t_end_date DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dwm.dwm_basic_role_zone_zipper WHERE logym = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND roleid > 0 AND t_start_date <= '2026-05-31' AND t_end_date > '2026-05-31') WHERE rn = 1), his_cnt_df AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.his_upload_photo_total, a.his_comment_photo_total, COALESCE(b.cur_avatar_type, 0) AS cur_avatar_type FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, MAX(COALESCE(a.his_upload_photo_total, 0) + COALESCE(b.upload_photo_cnt, 0)) AS his_upload_photo_total, MAX(COALESCE(a.his_comment_photo_total, 0) + COALESCE(b.comment_other_photo_cnt, 0)) AS his_comment_photo_total FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_upload_photo_total, his_comment_photo_total FROM mt_dwm.dwm_social_role_zone_df WHERE appid = 'mlbb' AND logymd = '2026-05-30') AS a FULL JOIN social_di AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid), COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid)) AS a LEFT JOIN avatar_type_info AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid), intimacy_array_df AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, lovers_id_array, brother_id_array, sisters_id_array, close_friend_id_array FROM mt_dwm.dwm_social_role_zone_df WHERE appid = 'mlbb' AND logymd = '2026-05-30' AND (SIZE(lovers_id_array) > 0 OR SIZE(brother_id_array) > 0 OR SIZE(sisters_id_array) > 0 OR SIZE(close_friend_id_array) > 0)), intimacy_array_info AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, lovers_id_array, brother_id_array, sisters_id_array, close_friend_id_array, his_last_friend_intimacy_json FROM mt_dwm.dwm_social_role_zone_df WHERE appid = 'mlbb' AND logymd = '2026-05-30' AND his_last_friend_intimacy_json <> ''), intimacy_lovers_di AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, lovers, is_del FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, lovers_id FROM social_di LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(lovers_id_array) tmpTable AS lovers_id WHERE SIZE(lovers_id_array) > 0) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(STR_TO_MAP(lovers_id, ',', '_')) tbl AS is_del, lovers), intimacy_lovers_df AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, lovers, is_del FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, lovers_id FROM intimacy_array_df LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(lovers_id_array) tmpTable AS lovers_id WHERE SIZE(lovers_id_array) > 0) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(STR_TO_MAP(lovers_id, ',', '_')) tbl AS is_del, lovers), intimacy_lovers_result AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS('_', 1, lovers)) AS lovers_id_array FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, lovers, is_del, LEAD(is_del) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd) AS del_tag FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, lovers, is_del FROM intimacy_lovers_di UNION ALL SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.lovers, a.is_del FROM intimacy_lovers_df AS a INNER JOIN intimacy_lovers_di AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)) WHERE is_del <> 0 AND del_tag IS NULL GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, lovers_id_array FROM intimacy_array_df AS a WHERE SIZE(a.lovers_id_array) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid FROM intimacy_lovers_di AS b WHERE a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)), intimacy_brother_di AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, brother, is_del FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, brother_id FROM social_di LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(brother_id_array) tmpTable AS brother_id WHERE SIZE(brother_id_array) > 0) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(STR_TO_MAP(brother_id, ',', '_')) tbl AS is_del, brother), intimacy_brother_df AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, brother, is_del FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, brother_id FROM intimacy_array_df LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(brother_id_array) tmpTable AS brother_id WHERE SIZE(brother_id_array) > 0) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(STR_TO_MAP(brother_id, ',', '_')) tbl AS is_del, brother), intimacy_brother_result AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS('_', rn_desc, brother)) AS brother_id_array FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, brother, is_del, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd DESC, is_del) AS rn_desc FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, brother, is_del, LEAD(is_del) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, brother ORDER BY logymd) AS del_tag FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, brother, is_del FROM intimacy_brother_di UNION ALL SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.brother, a.is_del FROM intimacy_brother_df AS a INNER JOIN intimacy_brother_di AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)) WHERE is_del <> 0 AND del_tag IS NULL) WHERE rn_desc <= 4 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, brother_id_array FROM intimacy_array_df AS a WHERE SIZE(a.brother_id_array) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid FROM intimacy_brother_di AS b WHERE a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)), intimacy_sisters_di AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, sisters, is_del FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, sisters_id FROM social_di LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(sisters_id_array) tmpTable AS sisters_id WHERE SIZE(sisters_id_array) > 0) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(STR_TO_MAP(sisters_id, ',', '_')) tbl AS is_del, sisters), intimacy_sisters_df AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, sisters, is_del FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, sisters_id FROM intimacy_array_df LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(sisters_id_array) tmpTable AS sisters_id WHERE SIZE(sisters_id_array) > 0) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(STR_TO_MAP(sisters_id, ',', '_')) tbl AS is_del, sisters), intimacy_sisters_result AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS('_', rn_desc, sisters)) AS sisters_id_array FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, sisters, is_del, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd DESC, is_del) AS rn_desc FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, sisters, is_del, LEAD(is_del) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, sisters ORDER BY logymd) AS del_tag FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, sisters, is_del FROM intimacy_sisters_di UNION ALL SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.sisters, a.is_del FROM intimacy_sisters_df AS a INNER JOIN intimacy_sisters_di AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)) WHERE is_del <> 0 AND del_tag IS NULL) WHERE rn_desc <= 4 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, sisters_id_array FROM intimacy_array_df AS a WHERE SIZE(a.sisters_id_array) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid FROM intimacy_sisters_di AS b WHERE a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)), intimacy_close_friend_di AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, close_friend, is_del FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, close_friend_id FROM social_di LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(close_friend_id_array) tmpTable AS close_friend_id WHERE SIZE(close_friend_id_array) > 0) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(STR_TO_MAP(close_friend_id, ',', '_')) tbl AS is_del, close_friend), intimacy_close_friend_df AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, close_friend, is_del FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, close_friend_id FROM intimacy_array_df LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(close_friend_id_array) tmpTable AS close_friend_id WHERE SIZE(close_friend_id_array) > 0) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(STR_TO_MAP(close_friend_id, ',', '_')) tbl AS is_del, close_friend), intimacy_close_friend_result AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS('_', rn_desc, close_friend)) AS close_friend_id_array FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, close_friend, is_del, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd DESC, is_del) AS rn_desc FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, close_friend, is_del, LEAD(is_del) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, close_friend ORDER BY logymd) AS del_tag FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, close_friend, is_del FROM intimacy_close_friend_di UNION ALL SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.close_friend, a.is_del FROM intimacy_close_friend_df AS a INNER JOIN intimacy_close_friend_di AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) ORDER BY roleid, zoneid, close_friend, logymd, is_del) WHERE is_del <> 0 AND del_tag IS NULL) WHERE rn_desc <= 5 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, close_friend_id_array FROM intimacy_array_df AS a WHERE SIZE(a.close_friend_id_array) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid FROM intimacy_close_friend_di AS b WHERE a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)), intimacy_friend_info /* 好友亲密度列表 */ AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, intimacy_friend, total_intimacy_num FROM social_di LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(STR_TO_MAP(friend_json, ',', ':')) tbl AS intimacy_friend, total_intimacy_num WHERE logymd >= '2021-09-29' AND friend_json <> '' AND total_intimacy_num > 0), intimacy_friend_result AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(friend_json))) AS his_last_friend_intimacy_json FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(':', intimacy_friend, total_intimacy_num) AS friend_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, intimacy_friend, total_intimacy_num, LAG(total_intimacy_num) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, intimacy_friend ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS next_total_intimacy_num FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, intimacy_friend, total_intimacy_num FROM intimacy_friend_info UNION ALL SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.intimacy_friend, a.total_intimacy_num FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, intimacy_friend, total_intimacy_num FROM intimacy_array_info LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(STR_TO_MAP(his_last_friend_intimacy_json, ',', ':')) tbl AS intimacy_friend, total_intimacy_num WHERE his_last_friend_intimacy_json <> '') AS a INNER JOIN intimacy_friend_info AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)) WHERE next_total_intimacy_num IS NULL) WHERE rn <= 300 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_friend_intimacy_json FROM intimacy_array_info AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid FROM intimacy_friend_info AS b WHERE a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_social_role_zone_df PARTITION(appid = 'mlbb', logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(his_upload_photo_total) AS his_upload_photo_total, MAX(his_comment_photo_total) AS his_comment_photo_total, MAX(lovers_id_array) AS lovers_id_array, MAX(brother_id_array) AS brother_id_array, MAX(sisters_id_array) AS sisters_id_array, MAX(close_friend_id_array) AS close_friend_id_array, MAX(his_last_friend_intimacy_json) AS his_last_friend_intimacy_json, MAX(cur_avatar_type) AS cur_avatar_type FROM (SELECT COALESCE(his_cnt_df.roleid, intimacy_friend_result.roleid, intimacy_brother_result.roleid, intimacy_lovers_result.roleid, intimacy_sisters_result.roleid, intimacy_close_friend_result.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(his_cnt_df.zoneid, intimacy_friend_result.zoneid, intimacy_brother_result.zoneid, intimacy_lovers_result.zoneid, intimacy_sisters_result.zoneid, intimacy_close_friend_result.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(his_cnt_df.his_upload_photo_total, 0) AS his_upload_photo_total, COALESCE(his_cnt_df.his_comment_photo_total, 0) AS his_comment_photo_total, COALESCE(intimacy_lovers_result.lovers_id_array, ARRAY()) AS lovers_id_array, COALESCE(SORT_ARRAY(intimacy_brother_result.brother_id_array), ARRAY()) AS brother_id_array, COALESCE(SORT_ARRAY(intimacy_sisters_result.sisters_id_array), ARRAY()) AS sisters_id_array, COALESCE(SORT_ARRAY(intimacy_close_friend_result.close_friend_id_array), ARRAY()) AS close_friend_id_array, COALESCE(intimacy_friend_result.his_last_friend_intimacy_json, '') AS his_last_friend_intimacy_json, COALESCE(his_cnt_df.cur_avatar_type, 0) AS cur_avatar_type FROM his_cnt_df FULL JOIN intimacy_friend_result ON his_cnt_df.roleid = intimacy_friend_result.roleid AND his_cnt_df.zoneid = intimacy_friend_result.zoneid FULL JOIN intimacy_brother_result ON his_cnt_df.roleid = intimacy_brother_result.roleid AND his_cnt_df.zoneid = intimacy_brother_result.zoneid FULL JOIN intimacy_lovers_result ON his_cnt_df.roleid = intimacy_lovers_result.roleid AND his_cnt_df.zoneid = intimacy_lovers_result.zoneid FULL JOIN intimacy_sisters_result ON his_cnt_df.roleid = intimacy_sisters_result.roleid AND his_cnt_df.zoneid = intimacy_sisters_result.zoneid FULL JOIN intimacy_close_friend_result ON his_cnt_df.roleid = intimacy_close_friend_result.roleid AND his_cnt_df.zoneid = intimacy_close_friend_result.zoneid) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_pay_di
sql_units: WITH pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(product_money) AS day_pay_amount, SUM(before_tax_usd_amt) AS day_pay_amount_exrate FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), active_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 /* AND     is_ai = 0 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), dim_basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, create_os AS os, first_network_name, is_first_create, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) > 0 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 30 THEN 1 WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 30 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 90 THEN 2 WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 90 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 360 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS register_days, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS channel FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-09-01', '2022-09-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0), pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(MIN(his_first_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_first_pay_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_pay_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT granularity_type, first_mt_country AS country, os, first_network_name AS network, register_days, COALESCE(pay_grade, '-1') AS pay_grade, COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate /* 字段类型存在问题，置0处理 */, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt, channel, COALESCE(pay_amt_exrate, 0) AS pay_amount_exrate, COALESCE(new_pay_cnt, 0) AS new_pay_cnt FROM (SELECT 'role' AS granularity_type, bas.first_mt_country, bas.os, bas.first_network_name, bas.register_days, pay.pay_grade, SUM(COALESCE(pay.day_pay_amount, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(COALESCE(pay.day_pay_amount_exrate, 0)) AS pay_amt_exrate, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.roleid, pay.zoneid) AS pay_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid, act.zoneid) AS active_cnt, bas.channel, SUM(IF(pay_df.roleid IS NULL AND NOT pay.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS new_pay_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM dim_basic_df WHERE zoneid < 57000) AS bas LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, CASE WHEN day_pay_amount / 100 >= 0.99 AND day_pay_amount / 100 < 4.99 THEN '0.99' WHEN day_pay_amount / 100 >= 4.99 AND day_pay_amount / 100 < 9.99 THEN '4.99' WHEN day_pay_amount / 100 >= 9.99 THEN '9.99' ELSE '0' END AS pay_grade FROM pay_di) AS pay ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid AND bas.zoneid = pay.zoneid LEFT JOIN active_di AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid AND bas.zoneid = act.zoneid LEFT JOIN pay_df ON bas.roleid = pay_df.roleid AND bas.zoneid = pay_df.zoneid GROUP BY bas.first_mt_country, bas.os, bas.first_network_name, bas.register_days, pay.pay_grade, bas.channel UNION ALL SELECT 'account' AS granularity_type, bas.first_mt_country, bas.os, bas.first_network_name, bas.register_days, pay.pay_grade, SUM(COALESCE(pay.day_pay_amount, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(COALESCE(pay.day_pay_amount_exrate, 0)) AS pay_amt_exrate, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.roleid) AS pay_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid) AS active_cnt, bas.channel, SUM(IF(pay_df.roleid IS NULL AND NOT pay.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS new_pay_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM dim_basic_df WHERE is_first_create = 1) AS bas LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, SUM(day_pay_amount) AS day_pay_amount, SUM(day_pay_amount_exrate) AS day_pay_amount_exrate, CASE WHEN SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 >= 0.99 AND SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 < 4.99 THEN '0.99' WHEN SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 >= 4.99 AND SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 < 9.99 THEN '4.99' WHEN SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 >= 9.99 THEN '9.99' ELSE '0' END AS pay_grade FROM pay_di GROUP BY roleid) AS pay ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM active_di GROUP BY roleid) AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, MIN(his_first_pay_date) AS his_first_pay_date FROM pay_df GROUP BY roleid) AS pay_df ON bas.roleid = pay_df.roleid GROUP BY bas.first_mt_country, bas.os, bas.first_network_name, bas.register_days, pay.pay_grade, bas.channel) AS t WHERE (pay_amt + pay_amt_exrate + pay_cnt + active_cnt) > 0 DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() AS INT)

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_id_mapping_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH temp_main_account_t1 AS (SELECT act.roleid, act.device_id, act.device_first_login_time, act.device_last_login_time, act.device_login_days, act.device_last_login_diff_days FROM (SELECT roleid, device_id AS device_id, his_first_role_active_time AS device_first_login_time, his_last_role_active_time AS device_last_login_time, did_activedays_total AS device_login_days, his_last_did_active_date_diff_todays AS device_last_login_diff_days, logymd, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_mapping_role_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND his_first_role_active_time <> '1970-01-01 00:00:00' AND his_last_role_active_time <> '1970-01-01 00:00:00' AND NOT device_id IS NULL AND device_id <> '' AND device_id <> 'unknown') AS act), temp_main_role_merge_all /* 以账号为key，按照设备活跃相关归一值排序 */ AS (SELECT roleid, device_id, CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_main_role FROM (SELECT roleid, device_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY (time_diff + day_diff) * diff_ratio DESC, device_first_login_time ASC, device_id) AS rn FROM (SELECT de.roleid, de.device_id, (device_last_login_time_max - de.device_last_login_diff_days) / CASE WHEN (device_last_login_time_max - device_last_login_time_min) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE (device_last_login_time_max - device_last_login_time_min) END AS time_diff, (device_login_days - device_loging_days_min) / CASE WHEN (device_loging_days_max - device_loging_days_min) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE (device_loging_days_max - device_loging_days_min) END AS day_diff, device_first_login_time, diff_ratio FROM (SELECT roleid, device_id, device_last_login_diff_days, CASE WHEN device_last_login_diff_days > 14 AND device_last_login_diff_days <= 30 THEN 0.85 WHEN device_last_login_diff_days > 30 AND device_last_login_diff_days <= 60 THEN 0.55 WHEN device_last_login_diff_days > 60 AND device_last_login_diff_days <= 90 THEN 0.4 WHEN device_last_login_diff_days > 90 THEN 0.2 ELSE 1 END AS diff_ratio, device_login_days, device_first_login_time, MAX(device_last_login_diff_days) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid) AS device_last_login_time_max, MIN(device_last_login_diff_days) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid) AS device_last_login_time_min, MIN(device_login_days) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid) AS device_loging_days_min, MAX(device_login_days) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid) AS device_loging_days_max FROM temp_main_account_t1) AS de) AS t1) AS t2), main_did /* ----------------------------------------------- */ /* -------------角色主设备判断------------------------ */ AS (SELECT device_id, roleid, zoneid, role_zone_create_time, role_zone_first_login_time, role_zone_last_login_time, role_zone_login_days, role_zone_last_login_diff_days, role_zone_90days_battle_cnt, device_first_login_time, device_last_login_time, device_login_days, device_last_login_diff_days FROM mt_dim.dim_mapping_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid > 0 AND zoneid < 57000 AND appid = 'mlbb' AND role_zone_first_login_time <> '1970-01-01 00:00:00' AND role_zone_last_login_time <> '1970-01-01 00:00:00' AND NOT device_id IS NULL AND device_id <> '' AND device_id <> 'unknown'), role_zone_device_not_one_by_one_1st_sort /* -计算每个角色的活跃归一值，并排序 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id, CASE WHEN sort_rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_main_did, time_diff, active_diff, battle_diff, role_zone_first_login_time, SUM(IF(sort_rn = 1, 1, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY 1) AS is_main_did_sum /* 按照设备统计设备上主角色的个数 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id, time_diff, active_diff, battle_diff, role_zone_first_login_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time_diff + active_diff + battle_diff DESC, role_zone_first_login_time ASC, device_id, roleid, zoneid) AS sort_rn FROM (SELECT ro.roleid, ro.zoneid, ro.device_id, (role_zone_last_login_diff_days_max - role_zone_last_login_diff_days) / CASE WHEN (role_zone_last_login_diff_days_max - role_zone_last_login_diff_days_min) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE (role_zone_last_login_diff_days_max - role_zone_last_login_diff_days_min) END AS time_diff, (role_zone_login_days - role_zone_login_days_min) / CASE WHEN (role_zone_login_days_max - role_zone_login_days_min) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE (role_zone_login_days_max - role_zone_login_days_min) END AS active_diff, (role_zone_90days_battle_cnt - role_zone_90days_battle_cnt_min) / CASE WHEN (role_zone_90days_battle_cnt_max - role_zone_90days_battle_cnt_min) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE (role_zone_90days_battle_cnt_max - role_zone_90days_battle_cnt_min) END AS battle_diff, role_zone_first_login_time FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id, role_zone_last_login_diff_days, role_zone_login_days, role_zone_90days_battle_cnt, role_zone_first_login_time, MAX(role_zone_last_login_diff_days) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid) AS role_zone_last_login_diff_days_max, MIN(role_zone_last_login_diff_days) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid) AS role_zone_last_login_diff_days_min, MIN(role_zone_login_days) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid) AS role_zone_login_days_min, MAX(role_zone_login_days) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid) AS role_zone_login_days_max, MIN(role_zone_90days_battle_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid) AS role_zone_90days_battle_cnt_min, MAX(role_zone_90days_battle_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid) AS role_zone_90days_battle_cnt_max FROM main_did) AS ro) AS t1) AS t2), role_zone_device_not_one_by_one_2st_sort_res /* 一个设备是多个角色的主设备的时候,以设备为key 按照活跃归一值重新排序 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id, CASE WHEN sort_rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_main_did FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY time_diff + active_diff + battle_diff DESC, role_zone_first_login_time ASC, device_id, roleid, zoneid) AS sort_rn FROM role_zone_device_not_one_by_one_1st_sort WHERE is_main_did_sum > 1) AS t1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_id_mapping_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT rzi.roleid, rzi.zoneid, rzi.device_id, COALESCE(ai.is_main_role, 0) AS is_main_role, rzi.is_main_did, CASE WHEN (ai.is_main_role = 1 AND rzi.is_main_did = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_main FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id, is_main_did FROM role_zone_device_not_one_by_one_1st_sort WHERE is_main_did_sum <= 1 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id, is_main_did FROM role_zone_device_not_one_by_one_2st_sort_res) AS rzi LEFT JOIN temp_main_role_merge_all AS ai ON rzi.roleid = ai.roleid AND rzi.device_id = ai.device_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND his_last_active_channel IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS br ON rzi.roleid = br.roleid AND rzi.zoneid = br.zoneid WHERE br.roleid IS NULL AND FLOOR(rzi.zoneid / 1000) < 57

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_online_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jichun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-10-28 17:55:42.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_gamebi_homepage_online_di`( */ /*             `country` STRING COMMENT '首次创号国', */ /*             `os` STRING COMMENT '系统平台', */ /*             `is_vp` BIGINT COMMENT '是否虚拟玩家（1：是，0：不是）', */ /*             `pcu` BIGINT COMMENT '最大在线人数', */ /*             `acu` BIGINT COMMENT '平均在线人数' */ /*         ) COMMENT 'MLBB经分首页在线表' */ /* ) STORED AS PARQUET location 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_gamebi_homepage_online_di'; */ WITH real_os_online AS (SELECT `TIME`, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`TIME`) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time /* 每5分钟记一次,间隔在五分钟内的，计入当前5分钟 */, zone_id, CASE WHEN os_type = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN os_type = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN os_type = 3 THEN 'emulator' ELSE 'unknown' END AS os_type, online_num /* 总在线人数 */, vp_online_num /* 虚拟玩家在线人数 */, (COALESCE(online_num, 0) - COALESCE(vp_online_num, 0)) AS real_online_num /* 真实玩家在线人数 */, logymd FROM ml_ods.connserver_t_real_os_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zone_id < 57000), real_country_online AS (SELECT `TIME`, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`TIME`) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time, LOWER(country) AS country, zone_id, online_num /* 总在线人数 */, vp_online_num /* 虚拟玩家在线人数 */, (COALESCE(online_num, 0) - COALESCE(vp_online_num, 0)) AS real_online_num /* 真实玩家在线人数 */, logymd FROM ml_ods.connserver_t_real_country_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zone_id < 57000) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_online_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT country, os_type AS os, is_vp, COALESCE(pcu, 0) AS pcu, COALESCE(acu, 0) AS acu FROM (SELECT 'all' AS country, 'all' AS os_type, is_vp, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, AVG(online_num) AS acu FROM (SELECT div_time, 0 AS is_vp /* 真实玩家 */, SUM(real_online_num) AS online_num FROM real_os_online GROUP BY div_time UNION ALL SELECT div_time, 1 AS is_vp /* 虚拟玩家 */, SUM(vp_online_num) AS online_num FROM real_os_online GROUP BY div_time) GROUP BY is_vp UNION ALL /* 分系统类型 */ SELECT 'all' AS country, os_type, is_vp, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, AVG(online_num) AS acu FROM (SELECT os_type, div_time, 0 AS is_vp /* 真实玩家 */, SUM(real_online_num) AS online_num FROM real_os_online GROUP BY os_type, div_time UNION ALL SELECT os_type, div_time, 1 AS is_vp /* 虚拟玩家 */, SUM(vp_online_num) AS online_num FROM real_os_online GROUP BY os_type, div_time) GROUP BY os_type, is_vp /* 全部 */ UNION ALL /* 分国家 */ SELECT country, 'all' AS os_type, is_vp, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, AVG(online_num) AS acu FROM (SELECT country, div_time, 0 AS is_vp /* 真实玩家 */, SUM(real_online_num) AS online_num FROM real_country_online GROUP BY country, div_time UNION ALL SELECT country, div_time, 1 AS is_vp /* 虚拟玩家 */, SUM(vp_online_num) AS online_num FROM real_country_online GROUP BY country, div_time) GROUP BY country, is_vp) DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() AS INT)

sql_units:
/*
 date               author                   desc
 2023-03-07         zhiqunwang               https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/doxcno24WI1DahhQXeuGoRhMHeh
 2024-05-21         jichun                   https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/JeiZwMrayiAY8CklpvtcYFNanwd
 */ /*
 
 CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_gamebi_homepage_create_di`(
 `granularity_type` string COMMENT '用户粒度类型(account,role)',
 `country` string COMMENT '首次创号国',
 `os` string COMMENT '创角操作系统平台',
 `network` string COMMENT '首次广告归因渠道',
 `new_type` bigint COMMENT '新增类型',
 `register_cnt` bigint COMMENT '新增人数',
 `total_register_cnt` bigint COMMENT '累计注册人数'
 ) COMMENT '经分首页——新增' PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd') 
 STORED AS parquet location 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_gamebi_homepage_create_di'
 
 alter  table mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_create_di ADD COLUMNS (zoneid bigint COMMENT '区服')
 
 */ WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country, create_os AS os, first_network_name AS network, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create, new_type, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS channel, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-09-01', '2022-09-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0), create_role AS (SELECT 'role' AS granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, -99999 AS zoneid, channel, COUNT(IF(register_date = '2026-05-31', a.roleid, NULL)) AS register_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_register_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM basic WHERE zoneid DIV 1000 < 57) AS a GROUP BY granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel), create_account AS (SELECT 'account' AS granularity_type, a.country, a.os, a.network, a.new_type, a.channel, -99999 AS zoneid, COUNT(IF(register_date = '2026-05-31', a.roleid, NULL)) AS register_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_register_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM basic WHERE is_first_create = 1 AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57) AS a GROUP BY granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_create_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, register_cnt, total_register_cnt, zoneid, channel FROM (SELECT granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel, COALESCE(register_cnt, 0) AS register_cnt, COALESCE(total_register_cnt, 0) AS total_register_cnt, zoneid FROM create_role UNION ALL SELECT granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel, COALESCE(register_cnt, 0) AS register_cnt, COALESCE(total_register_cnt, 0) AS total_register_cnt, zoneid FROM create_account) AS t WHERE (register_cnt + total_register_cnt) > 0 DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() AS INT)

 */ /*
 
 CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_gamebi_create_guide_path_di`(
 `granularity_type` string COMMENT '用户粒度类型(account,role)',

 ) COMMENT '经分——新增漏斗' PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd') 
 STORED AS parquet location 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_gamebi_create_guide_path_di'
 
 */ WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country, create_os AS os, first_network_name AS network, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-09-01', '2022-09-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0), newbie AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, stepid AS guide_path FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_newbie_guide WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND sub_stepid <> 0 AND stepid IN (10999, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 105, 1000) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, guide_path), create_role AS (SELECT 'role' AS granularity_type, a.country, a.os, a.network, b.guide_path, COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid, b.zoneid) AS guide_path_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM basic WHERE zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND register_date = '2026-05-31') AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM newbie) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY granularity_type, a.country, a.os, a.network, b.guide_path UNION ALL SELECT 'role' AS granularity_type, a.country, a.os, a.network, 0 AS guide_path, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS guide_path_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM basic WHERE zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND register_date = '2026-05-31') AS a GROUP BY granularity_type, a.country, a.os, a.network, guide_path), create_account AS (SELECT 'account' AS granularity_type, a.country, a.os, a.network, b.guide_path, COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid) AS guide_path_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM basic WHERE zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND is_first_create = 1 AND register_date = '2026-05-31') AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM newbie) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid GROUP BY granularity_type, a.country, a.os, a.network, b.guide_path UNION ALL SELECT 'account' AS granularity_type, a.country, a.os, a.network, 0 AS guide_path, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid) AS guide_path_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM basic WHERE zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND is_first_create = 1 AND register_date = '2026-05-31') AS a GROUP BY granularity_type, a.country, a.os, a.network, guide_path) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_create_guide_path_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT granularity_type, country, os, network, guide_path, guide_path_cnt FROM (SELECT granularity_type, country, os, network, guide_path, guide_path_cnt FROM create_role UNION ALL SELECT granularity_type, country, os, network, guide_path, guide_path_cnt FROM create_account) AS t DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() AS INT)

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_active_pay_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* 需求文档： https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/LUAWdUXOJorM56xZaKpc8PQwnRf */ /* 自测文档： https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/wikcnOeSdER3JiTjmrFrVs7W6yc */ /* 虚拟玩家的判断先以basic表来做判断，如果没有在basic表中出现，拿active_di里面的is_ai判断 */ /* ALTER table bi_test.dm_active_pay_role_zone_di drop partition(logymd = '2021-01-01' ,active_date_diff = 0); */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mt_dm`.`dm_active_pay_role_zone_di` */ /* ( */ /*     `roleid`              DECIMAL(20, 0) COMMENT '角色id,key', */ /*     `zoneid`              BIGINT COMMENT '服务器,key', */ /*     `active_date`         STRING COMMENT '分区下最新活跃日期,logymd+active_date_diff', */ /*     `register_date`       STRING COMMENT '角色注册时间', */ /*     `register_date_diff`  BIGINT COMMENT '角色注册距今时间差', */ /*     `bf_active_date_diff` BIGINT COMMENT '上次活跃距今时间差', */ /*     `is_active`           INT COMMENT '第N天是否有活跃', */ /*     `activedays_total`    BIGINT COMMENT '近N天(内)累计活跃天数', */ /*     `is_pay`              INT COMMENT '第N天是否有付费', */ /*     `charge_amt_total`    BIGINT COMMENT '近N天(内)累计充值金额' */ /* ) COMMENT '游戏行为-新增玩家30日段位变化-增量' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd', */ /*     `active_date_diff` BIGINT COMMENT '活跃日期距今时间差' */ /* ) STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dm/table/dm_active_pay_role_zone_di'; */ WITH t_active_df AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, '2026-05-31' AS active_date, bf_active_date_diff, (his_activedays_td - his_activedays) + 1 AS activedays_total /* 这里必须加1，因为已经过滤出来历史活跃的用户了，即使在今天历史累积活跃天数没变，但是历史那天也活跃了 */, IF(max_his_last_active_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_active, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) AS active_date_diff FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, his_activedays, IF(COALESCE(his_last_active_second_date, '1970-01-01') = '1970-01-01', 0, DATEDIFF(his_last_active_date, his_last_active_second_date)) AS bf_active_date_diff, FIRST_VALUE(his_activedays) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS his_activedays_td, MAX(his_last_active_date) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid) AS max_his_last_active_date FROM `mt_dwm`.`dwm_active_role_zone_df` WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-29', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-18', '2026-05-02', '2026-03-03', '2025-12-03') /* 取出满足diff的logymd对应的活跃用户 */ AND logymd >= '2021-01-01' AND zoneid < 57000 AND /* 这里必须要做这个判断，否则会丢掉最新的his_activedays的信息 */ his_last_active_date = IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', his_last_active_date, logymd)) AS t) AS t2 WHERE is_active = /* 确保activedays_total计算完毕后在过滤必要数据 */ IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', 1, is_active)), t_pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN logymd = '2026-05-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_pay, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd = '2026-05-31' THEN day_pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS pay_amt_d1, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-30' THEN day_pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS pay_amt_d2, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-29' THEN day_pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS pay_amt_d3, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-25' THEN day_pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS pay_amt_d7, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-18' THEN day_pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS pay_amt_d14, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-02' THEN day_pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS pay_amt_d30, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-03-03' THEN day_pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS pay_amt_d90, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2025-12-03' THEN day_pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS pay_amt_d180 FROM `mt_dwm`.`dwm_pay_role_zone_di` WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-12-03' AND '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2021-01-01' AND zoneid < 57000 AND day_pay_amount > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, is_ai FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31') AND zoneid < 57000) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_dm`.`dm_active_pay_role_zone_di` PARTITION(logymd, active_date_diff) SELECT t_active_df.roleid, t_active_df.zoneid, t_active_df.active_date, COALESCE(t_basic.register_date, '1970-01-01') AS register_date, IF(COALESCE(t_basic.register_date, '1970-01-01') = '1970-01-01', -99999, DATEDIFF(t_active_df.logymd, register_date)) AS register_date_diff, t_active_df.bf_active_date_diff, t_active_df.is_active, t_active_df.activedays_total, COALESCE(t_pay_df.is_pay, 0) AS is_pay, CASE WHEN t_active_df.logymd = '2026-05-31' THEN COALESCE(t_pay_df.pay_amt_d1, 0) WHEN t_active_df.logymd = '2026-05-30' THEN COALESCE(t_pay_df.pay_amt_d2, 0) WHEN t_active_df.logymd = '2026-05-29' THEN COALESCE(t_pay_df.pay_amt_d3, 0) WHEN t_active_df.logymd = '2026-05-25' THEN COALESCE(t_pay_df.pay_amt_d7, 0) WHEN t_active_df.logymd = '2026-05-18' THEN COALESCE(t_pay_df.pay_amt_d14, 0) WHEN t_active_df.logymd = '2026-05-02' THEN COALESCE(t_pay_df.pay_amt_d30, 0) WHEN t_active_df.logymd = '2026-03-03' THEN COALESCE(t_pay_df.pay_amt_d90, 0) WHEN t_active_df.logymd = '2025-12-03' THEN COALESCE(t_pay_df.pay_amt_d180, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pay_amt, t_active_df.logymd, t_active_df.active_date_diff FROM t_active_df LEFT JOIN t_pay_df ON t_active_df.roleid = t_pay_df.roleid AND t_active_df.zoneid = t_pay_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_basic ON t_active_df.roleid = t_basic.roleid AND t_active_df.zoneid = t_basic.zoneid WHERE COALESCE(t_basic.is_ai, 0) = 0

name: tmp_active_pay_subdiamond_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_active_pay_subdiamond_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid /* logymd, */, last_roleid, a.zoneid, register_date /* 注册日期 */, first_mt_country, country /* 首次创号国 */, geographic_subregion /* 地域 */, register_days /* 注册时长（天） */, d.operate /* 操作来源 */, operate_chinese /* 操作来源（中文） */, day_pay_amount /* 当天真实付费金额 */, is_pay /* 今日是否真实付费历史首次真实付费日期 */, his_first_pay_date /* 历史首次真实付费日期 */, his_pay_amt /* 历史真实累计付费金额 */, his_pay_cnt /* 历史真实累计付费次数 */, CASE WHEN is_his_pay IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE is_his_pay END AS is_his_pay /* 历史是否真实付费(1:真实付费，0:未真实付费) */, total_sub_num /* 当天累计钻石消耗量 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, SUBSTRING(CAST(roleid AS STRING), -1, 1) AS last_roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, register_date, DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) AS register_days /* 注册时长 */, SUM(day_pay_amount) AS day_pay_amount /* 当天真实付费金额 */, is_pay /* 今日是否真实付费 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_behavior_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_active = 1 AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, last_roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, register_date, register_days, is_pay) AS a /* 活跃玩家基础行为表 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(his_first_pay_date) AS his_first_pay_date /* 历史首次真实付费日期 */, SUM(his_pay_amt) AS his_pay_amt /* 历史真实累计付费金额 */, SUM(his_pay_cnt) AS his_pay_cnt /* 历史真实累计付费次数 */, 1 AS is_his_pay /* 历史是否真实付费 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid < 57000 AND his_pay_amt > 0 /* 筛选真实付费用户 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, is_his_pay) AS b /* 付费全量表 */ ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT lower, country, geographic_subregion FROM mt_dim.dim_national_geographic_atlas_config) AS c /* 国家地域维度表 */ ON a.first_mt_country = c.lower LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, operate_type AS operate, SUM(currency_change_num) AS total_sub_num FROM mt_dwm.dwm_currency_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND appid = 'mlbb' AND currency_type = 'diamond' AND change_reason = 'consume_diamond' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, operate_type) AS d /* 钻石消耗表 */ ON a.roleid = d.roleid AND a.zoneid = d.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT operate, operate_chinese FROM ml_temp.diamond_operate WHERE logymd = '2022-10-13') AS e /* 钻石消耗operate映射表 */ ON d.operate = e.operate

name: tmp_shopclick_rechargeclick_login
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_shopclick_rechargeclick_login PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 商城点击表 */ SELECT a.roleid /* a.logymd, */, a.zoneid, last_roleid, level, click1, first_mt_country, country, geographic_subregion, register_date, DATEDIFF(a.logymd, register_date) AS usercreatedays, 'shopclick' AS type FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country), register_date) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT lower, country, geographic_subregion FROM mt_dim.dim_national_geographic_atlas_config) AS c ON b.first_mt_country = c.lower UNION ALL /* 充值点击表 */ SELECT a.roleid /* a.logymd, */, a.zoneid, last_roleid, level, click1, first_mt_country, country, geographic_subregion, register_date, DATEDIFF(a.logymd, register_date) AS usercreatedays, 'rechargeclick' AS type FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(CAST(accountid AS STRING), -1, 1) AS last_roleid, level, click1 FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_rechargeclick WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND game_channel NOT LIKE '%and_bdvp%' AND NOT click1 IS NULL GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, last_roleid, level, click1) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31') AND zoneid < 57000 AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country), register_date) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT lower, country, geographic_subregion FROM mt_dim.dim_national_geographic_atlas_config) AS c ON b.first_mt_country = c.lower UNION ALL /* 登录表 */ SELECT roleid /* logymd, */, zoneid, last_roleid, level, NULL AS click1, first_mt_country, country, geographic_subregion, register_date, DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) AS usercreatedays, 'login' AS type FROM (SELECT logymd, logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_active = 1 AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, last_roleid, LOWER(first_mt_country), register_date) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT lower, country, name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_battle_black_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* set spark.sql.adaptive.shuffle.targetPostShuffleInputSize = 268435456; */ /* set spark.sql.hive.convertInsertingPartitionedTable=true; */ /* set spark.sql.hive.convertMetastoreParquet=true; */ /* set spark.sql.files.maxPartitionBytes= ; */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_dwm.dwm_battle_black_role_zone_di */ /* ( */ /*     roleid            DECIMAL(20, 0) COMMENT '角色id', */ /*     zoneid            BIGINT COMMENT '区服id', */ /*     pvptype           BIGINT COMMENT '对战类型', */ /*     realpvptype       BIGINT COMMENT '真实对战类型', */ /*     black_type        BIGINT COMMENT '开黑类型', */ /*     is_fake_ai        BIGINT COMMENT '是否为虚拟玩家', */ /*     is_vp             BIGINT COMMENT '是否为虚拟玩家', */ /*     first_bigranklvl  BIGINT COMMENT '当日首次战斗大段位', */ /*     first_minranklvl  BIGINT COMMENT '当日首次战斗小段位', */ /*     first_rankstar    BIGINT COMMENT '当天首次战斗的星数', */ /*     first_battle_time STRING COMMENT '当天首次战斗时间', */ /*     battle_cnt        BIGINT COMMENT '对局场次数', */ /*     invalid_cnt       BIGINT COMMENT '不合法战斗数，isvalid=0', */ /*     win_cnt           BIGINT COMMENT '胜利场次数', */ /*     mvp_cnt           BIGINT COMMENT 'MVP场次数', */ /*     hook_cnt          BIGINT COMMENT '挂机战斗场次数', */ /*     battle_dur        BIGINT COMMENT '战斗时长', */ /*     kill_cnt          BIGINT COMMENT '击杀总数', */ /*     assist_cnt        BIGINT COMMENT '助攻总数', */ /*     dead_cnt          BIGINT COMMENT '死亡总数', */ /*     kda_total         BIGINT COMMENT 'kda汇总（所有战斗加和）' */ /* ) COMMENT '战斗开黑主题表' */ /*     PARTITIONED BY ( logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd',appid STRING COMMENT '游戏id') */ /*     STORED AS PARQUET */ /*     LOCATION 's3a://mt-dwm/table/dwm_battle_black_role_zone_di'; */ WITH t_battle_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, blacknum, kill_cnt, assist_cnt, dead_cnt, kda, isvalid, wincamp, ismvp, ishook, battle_dur, `time`, is_fake_ai, is_vp, logymd, FIRST_VALUE(bigranklvl) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time`) AS first_bigranklvl, FIRST_VALUE(minranklvl) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time`) AS first_minranklvl, FIRST_VALUE(rankstar) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time`) AS first_rankstar FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, pvptype, COALESCE(realpvptype, -99999) AS realpvptype, COALESCE(blacknum, -99999) AS blacknum, channel, COALESCE(fake_ai, 0) AS is_fake_ai, IF(COALESCE(channel, 'unknown') IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test'), 1, 0) AS is_vp /* 会有channel为null的数据，主要是22年菜上报，null的暂定为真人 */, bigranklvl, minranklvl, rankstar, `time`, wincamp, isvalid, ismvp, ishook, battletime AS battle_dur, logymd, killnum AS kill_cnt, assistnum AS assist_cnt, deadnum AS dead_cnt, BIGINT((COALESCE(killnum, 0) + COALESCE(assistnum, 0)) / (COALESCE(deadnum, 0) + 1) * 100) AS kda, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY `TIME` DESC, battleresulttype) AS row_id FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT pvptype IS NULL) AS t WHERE row_id = 1 /* 去除重复上报 */), t_rank_di AS (SELECT roleid AS rid, zoneid AS zid, pvptype, first_bigranklvl, first_minranklvl, first_rankstar FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_cur_season = 1 AND pvptype = 39) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_battle_black_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT t_battle_agg.roleid, t_battle_agg.zoneid, t_battle_agg.pvptype, t_battle_agg.realpvptype, t_battle_agg.black_type, t_battle_agg.is_fake_ai, t_battle_agg.is_vp, COALESCE(t_rank_di.first_bigranklvl, t_battle_agg.first_bigranklvl) AS first_bigranklvl, COALESCE(t_rank_di.first_minranklvl, t_battle_agg.first_minranklvl) AS first_minranklvl, COALESCE(t_rank_di.first_rankstar, t_battle_agg.first_rankstar) AS first_rankstar, t_battle_agg.first_battle_time, t_battle_agg.battle_cnt, t_battle_agg.invalid_cnt, t_battle_agg.win_cnt, t_battle_agg.mvp_cnt, t_battle_agg.hook_cnt, t_battle_agg.battle_dur, t_battle_agg.kill_cnt, t_battle_agg.assist_cnt, t_battle_agg.dead_cnt, t_battle_agg.kda_total FROM (SELECT t_battle_di.roleid, t_battle_di.zoneid, t_battle_di.pvptype, t_battle_di.realpvptype, t_battle_di.blacknum AS black_type, MIN(t_battle_di.is_fake_ai) AS is_fake_ai /* AI的话一个role+zone不会同时出现两种情况，所以取MIN和MAX都一样 */, MAX(t_battle_di.is_vp) AS is_vp, MIN(t_battle_di.first_bigranklvl) AS first_bigranklvl, MIN(t_battle_di.first_minranklvl) AS first_minranklvl, MIN(t_battle_di.first_rankstar) AS first_rankstar, MIN(t_battle_di.`time`) AS first_battle_time, COUNT(1) AS battle_cnt, SUM(IF(isvalid = 0, 1, 0)) AS invalid_cnt, SUM(IF(t_battle_di.wincamp = 1, 1, 0)) AS win_cnt, SUM(IF(t_battle_di.ismvp = 1, 1, 0)) AS mvp_cnt, SUM(IF(t_battle_di.ishook = 1, 1, 0)) AS hook_cnt, SUM(t_battle_di.battle_dur) AS battle_dur, SUM(t_battle_di.kill_cnt) AS kill_cnt, SUM(t_battle_di.assist_cnt) AS assist_cnt, SUM(t_battle_di.dead_cnt) AS dead_cnt, SUM(t_battle_di.kda) AS kda_total FROM t_battle_di GROUP BY t_battle_di.roleid, t_battle_di.zoneid, t_battle_di.pvptype, t_battle_di.realpvptype, t_battle_di.blacknum) AS t_battle_agg LEFT JOIN t_rank_di ON t_battle_agg.roleid = t_rank_di.rid AND t_battle_agg.zoneid = t_rank_di.zid AND t_battle_agg.pvptype = t_rank_di.pvptype

sql_units: WITH basic AS (SELECT *, DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 7 * -1) AS week_start, DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1) AS week_end FROM mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_create_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 7 * -1) AND DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1)), register AS (SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', week_start, week_end) AS week_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel, register_cnt, 0 AS total_register_cnt FROM basic), total_register AS (SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', week_start, week_end) AS week_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel, 0 AS register_cnt, total_register_cnt FROM basic WHERE logymd = week_end) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_create_wi PARTITION(logymd) SELECT week_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, SUM(register_cnt) AS register_cnt, SUM(total_register_cnt) AS total_register_cnt, channel, DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1) AS logymd FROM (SELECT week_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel, register_cnt, total_register_cnt FROM register UNION ALL SELECT week_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel, register_cnt, total_register_cnt FROM total_register) AS t GROUP BY week_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() AS INT)

sql_units: /* 大小号排序 */ WITH is_main_role AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.dim_id_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_main = 1 AND NOT deviceid IS NULL AND deviceid <> '' AND deviceid <> 'unknown' AND NOT deviceid IN ('and_usa', 'ios_usa') AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 AND zoneid > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), device_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id, role_zone_last_login_time FROM mt_dim.dim_mapping_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND NOT device_id IS NULL AND device_id <> '' AND device_id <> 'unknown' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 AND zoneid > 0 AND NOT device_id IN ('and_usa', 'ios_usa') AND role_zone_first_login_time <> '1970-01-01 00:00:00' AND role_zone_last_login_time <> '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), is_main_role_device AS (SELECT mr.roleid, mr.zoneid, di.device_id, di.role_zone_last_login_time FROM is_main_role AS mr LEFT JOIN device_info AS di ON mr.roleid = di.roleid AND mr.zoneid = di.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_id_main_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.small_role AS small_roleid, t1.small_zone AS small_zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, small_role, small_zone FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, small_role, small_zone, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY small_role, small_zone ORDER BY ABS(time_diff) ASC, roleid ASC, zoneid ASC) AS time_diff_rn FROM (SELECT md.roleid, md.zoneid, lu.roleid AS small_role, lu.zoneid AS small_zone, ABS(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(md.role_zone_last_login_time) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(lu.role_zone_last_login_time)) AS time_diff FROM is_main_role_device AS md LEFT JOIN device_info AS lu ON md.device_id = lu.device_id /* 过滤大小号相等的数据，过滤掉zoneid为-9999的数据，过滤测服数据 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* 剔除关联产的同一设备的上的大号和小号相等的数据 */ (CASE WHEN lu.roleid = md.roleid AND lu.zoneid = md.zoneid THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END) AND md.zoneid > 0 AND lu.zoneid > 0 AND FLOOR(md.zoneid / 1000) < 57 AND FLOOR(lu.zoneid / 1000) < 57 AND NOT lu.roleid IS NULL AND NOT lu.zoneid IS NULL) AS t1) AS t2 WHERE time_diff_rn = 1) AS t1 /* 剔除关联产出的大号=小号的数据 */ LEFT JOIN is_main_role AS im ON im.roleid = t1.small_role AND im.zoneid = t1.small_zone WHERE im.roleid IS NULL

name: 用户投诉邮箱需求
sql_units: /* 看板二： */ /* 申诉【郵箱無法使用email disabled】的玩家中，绑定了沐瞳邮箱的人。 */ /* 近1个月内有/无验证码发送记录 */ /* 近1个月内有/无验证码回填记录 */ /* 近1个月指：申诉日期当天以及前30天内 */ /* 根据近一个月内有/无验证码发送/回填记录，分为以下几种标签，按天输出每种标签的人数： */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.email_complaint_label_sort PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT `是否有发送记录`, `是否有回填记录`, `deviceid去重`, `人数`, CASE WHEN `是否有发送记录` = '是' AND `是否有回填记录` = '是' AND `deviceid去重` = '>1' THEN '账号共享/被盗' WHEN `是否有发送记录` = '是' AND `是否有回填记录` = '是' AND `deviceid去重` = '=1' THEN '无效反馈' WHEN `是否有发送记录` = '是' AND `是否有回填记录` = '否' AND `deviceid去重` = '>1' THEN '账号共享/被盗/邮箱无法使用' WHEN `是否有发送记录` = '是' AND `是否有回填记录` = '否' AND `deviceid去重` = '=1' THEN '邮箱无法使用' WHEN `是否有发送记录` = '否' AND `是否有回填记录` = '否' AND `deviceid去重` IS NULL THEN '未登陆过，碰瓷' WHEN `是否有发送记录` = '否' AND `是否有回填记录` = '否' AND `deviceid去重` = '=1' THEN '知道自己邮箱无法使用' WHEN `是否有发送记录` = '否' AND `是否有回填记录` = '否' AND `deviceid去重` = '>1' THEN '账号共享/被盗风险' END AS `标签` FROM (SELECT `是否有发送记录`, `是否有回填记录`, `deviceid去重`, COUNT(DISTINCT lost_id) AS `人数` FROM (SELECT a.lost_id, bind_mt_email, if_return AS `是否有回填记录`, labels AS `deviceid去重`, IF(b.target_email IS NULL, '否', '是') AS `是否有发送记录` FROM (SELECT a.lost_id, bind_mt_email, IF(NOT target_email IS NULL, '是', '否') AS if_return FROM (/* 绑定了沐瞳邮箱的这部分客诉id */ SELECT lost_id, bind_mt_email FROM (SELECT roleid, lost_id, reason FROM (/* 申诉账号名单 */ SELECT roleid, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_data, '$.lost_acc_id') AS lost_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_data, '$.appeal_label') AS reason FROM mtwb_ods.php_events WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a WHERE reason = '郵箱無法使用email disabled' AND NOT lost_id IS NULL) AS a LEFT JOIN (/* 邮箱需求 */ SELECT DISTINCT roleid, mt_id, REVERSE(SPLIT(REVERSE(bind_mt_email), '\\073')[0]) AS bind_mt_email FROM mt_dim.dim_third_party_account_df WHERE NOT bind_mt_email IS NULL AND LENGTH(bind_mt_email) > 0 AND logymd = '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.lost_id = b.roleid WHERE NOT bind_mt_email IS NULL) AS a LEFT JOIN (/* 有回填记录的邮箱 */ SELECT DISTINCT target_email FROM ml_ods.webapiserver_enter_mail_code WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' UNION SELECT DISTINCT email FROM ml_ods.gameserver_player_email_token WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND oper_type = 'check') AS b ON a.bind_mt_email = b.target_email) AS a LEFT JOIN (/* 用户标签第一个渠道看发送记录 */ SELECT target_email, a.roleid, label FROM (/* 有发送记录的情况 */ SELECT email AS target_email, roleid, CASE WHEN nums > 1 THEN '>1' WHEN nums = 1 THEN '=1' ELSE '=0' END AS label FROM (SELECT email, roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT device) AS nums FROM ml_ods.gameserver_player_email_token WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND oper_type = 'send' GROUP BY email, roleid) AS a) AS a UNION /* 第二个渠道看发送账号状态 */ SELECT target_email, a.roleid, label FROM (SELECT target_email, roleid FROM (/* 找出系统发送记录 */ SELECT DISTINCT target_email FROM ml_ods.mailsenderserver_send_mail WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS a LEFT JOIN (/* 发送记录对应的邮箱 */ SELECT DISTINCT bind_mt_email, roleid FROM mt_dim.dim_third_party_account_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.target_email = b.bind_mt_email) AS a LEFT JOIN (/* 该id的登陆设备是否异常 */ SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN nums > 1 THEN '>1' WHEN nums = 1 THEN '=1' ELSE '=0' END AS label FROM (SELECT roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT deviceid) AS nums FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid) AS a) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid) AS b ON a.bind_mt_email = b.target_email AND a.lost_id = b.roleid LEFT JOIN (/* 该id的登陆设备是否异常 */ SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN nums > 1 THEN '>1' WHEN nums = 1 THEN '=1' ELSE '=0' END AS labels FROM (SELECT roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT deviceid) AS nums FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid) AS a) AS c ON a.lost_id = c.roleid) AS a GROUP BY `是否有发送记录`, `是否有回填记录`, `deviceid去重`) AS a

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_create_role_zone_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_create_role_hdfs PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(logymd) AS first_register_date FROM mt_dwd.dwd_create_role_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_create_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_time, register_date, create_os, create_country, create_device, create_channel, create_ip, create_sex, data_source, is_emulator, is_ai, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY register_time, zoneid) AS role_rank /* 用于判断是否是当天首次创角 */ /* is_emulator, */, his_first_active_time, deviceid AS his_first_deviceid, os_language AS his_first_os_language, os_version AS his_first_os_version, client_ver AS his_first_loginclient_version, NULL /* 只看创角，当天只要有一次创角是模拟器，则当天有创建其他角色也为模拟器 */ /* max(is_emulator) over(partition by data_source,roleid) as create_is_emulator, */, is_his_create, ori_usercreateymd, ori_usercreatetime FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os AS create_os, device AS create_device, channel AS create_channel, client_ip AS create_ip, sex AS create_sex, CAST(time AS STRING) AS register_time, logymd AS register_date, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605')))) = '-' THEN 'unknown' ELSE COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605')))), 'unknown') END AS create_country, 'create' AS data_source, IF(device LIKE '%x86%' OR device LIKE '%virtual machine%' OR device LIKE '%Tencent%' OR device LIKE '%VMH%', 1, 0) AS is_emulator, NULL AS deviceid, NULL AS client_ver, NULL AS os_language, IF(fake_ai = 0 AND roleid > 100, 0, fake_ai) AS is_ai, NULL AS his_first_active_time, NULL AS os_version, 0 AS is_his_create, NULL AS ori_usercreateymd, NULL AS ori_usercreatetime FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN os_type = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN os_type = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN os_type = 3 THEN 'emulator' ELSE 'unknown' END AS os, TRIM(device) AS device, client_ip, TRIM(channel) AS channel, sex, time, logymd, fake_ai, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time, client_ip) AS rn /* 保证角色只有一条记录，避免出现重复的脏数据 */ FROM mt_dwd.dwd_create_role_di AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid AS rid, zoneid AS zid FROM bi_test.dim_create_role_hdfs WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND first_register_date = '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.roleid = b.rid AND a.zoneid = b.zid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid AS rid2, zoneid AS zid2 FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = /* 活跃df表历史不保存全量数据 */ IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-06-01', '2023-06-01', '2026-05-30') AND his_first_active_date <= '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb') AS x GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS c ON a.roleid = c.rid2 AND a.zoneid = c.zid2 WHERE rn = 1 AND c.rid2 IS NULL /* 历史存在活跃or付费记录，但是在当天有新增创角的数据（活跃早于创角）， */ /* 这种玩家的创角数据需要剔除掉，需要从活跃or付费的历史数据来回补，也即是要保证取的是玩家历史首次的创角， */ /* 剔除后，剩下的就是真正意义上首次create role的记录，确保拿到create role玩家真正意义上的首次创角记录 */ UNION ALL /* 其他行为回补创角记录 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, os AS create_os, device AS create_device, channel AS create_channel, client_ip AS create_ip, sex AS create_sex, usercreatetime AS register_time, IF(LENGTH(usercreateymd) < 10, SUBSTRING(usercreatetime, 1, 10), usercreateymd) AS register_date, CASE WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(createrole_country, '-')) >= 2 THEN createrole_country WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(createrole_country, '-')) < 2 AND LOWER(TRIM(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605')))) = '-' THEN 'unknown' ELSE COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605')))), 'unknown') END AS create_country, data_source, IF(device LIKE '%x86%' OR device LIKE '%virtual machine%' OR device LIKE '%Tencent%' OR device LIKE '%VMH%', 1, 0) AS is_emulator, deviceid, client_ver, os_language, CASE WHEN logymd < '2022-06-30' THEN IF(channel IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test'), 2, 0) WHEN logymd >= '2022-06-30' AND fake_ai IN (0, 1, 2) THEN fake_ai WHEN logymd >= '2022-06-30' AND NOT COALESCE(fake_ai, -1) IN (0, 1, 2) THEN IF(channel IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test'), 2, 0) END AS is_ai /* if(channel in ('and_bdvp','and_bdvp_test'),1,0) as is_ai, */, time AS createrole_country /* usercreatetime, */ /* usercreateymd, */, data_source, deviceid, client_ver, os_language, os_version, fake_ai, logymd, usercreateymd AS ori_usercreateymd /* 记录原始上报的创角日期 */, usercreatetime AS ori_usercreatetime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY rnd, time, reconn, os_type, device, channel, sex, client_ip, createrole_country) AS rn /* TRIM(channel) AS channel, sex, time, COALESCE(usercreatetime, time) AS usercreatetime, COALESCE(usercreateymd, logymd) AS usercreateymd, LOWER(createrole_country) AS createrole_country, 'login' AS data_source, 1 AS rnd, IF(reconn = 0, 0, 1) AS reconn, deviceid, client_ver, os_language, os_version, logymd, fake_ai FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(os_type, -99999) AS os_type, TRIM(device) AS device, client_ip, channel, sex, time, COALESCE(usercreatetime, time) AS usercreatetime, COALESCE(usercreateymd, logymd) AS usercreateymd, LOWER(createrole_country) AS createrole_country, 'charge' AS data_source, 2 AS rnd, 0 AS reconn, device_id AS deviceid, NULL AS client_ver, NULL AS os_language, NULL AS os_version, logymd, 0 AS fake_ai FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS bk LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid AS rid, zoneid AS zid FROM (/* select roleid,zoneid */ /*  from  mt_dwd.dwd_create_role_di */ /* WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /* union all */ /* select roleid,zoneid  */ /* from bi_test.dim_basic_role_hdfs */ /* where logymd = '2026-05-30' */ SELECT roleid, zoneid /* 排除历史创过角的玩家 */ FROM bi_test.dim_create_role_hdfs WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-06-01', '2023-06-01', '2026-05-30') AND his_first_active_date <= '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb') AS a GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS cre ON bk.roleid = cre.rid AND bk.zoneid = cre.zid WHERE cre.rid IS NULL /* 排除以上数据，剩余的就是当天历史首次活跃、付费的，且没有创角记录的玩家 */) AS lc WHERE rn = 1) AS a

*/ /* init */ /* insert overwrite table {{adbi_dim_ad_account_id_df_out}} partition(p_date = '2026-05-30') */ /* select */ /*     a.app_id */ /*     ,a.media_source */ /*     ,a.campaign_id */ /*     ,a.ad_account_id */ /*     ,a.p_date as pull_date */ /*     ,a.report_date */ /*     ,b.ad_target */ /* from */ /* ( */ /*     select * */ /*     from ( */ /*         select */ /*             app_id */ /*             ,media_source */ /*             ,campaign_id */ /*             ,ad_account_id */ /*             ,p_date */ /*             ,report_date */ /*             ,row_number() over(partition by app_id,media_source,campaign_id order by p_date desc,report_date desc) as rn */ /*         from */ /*             adbi.dwa_admkt_api_ad_cost_report_df */ /*         where */ /*             p_date <= '2026-05-30' and */ /*             app_id not in ('unknown','') and app_id is not null and */ /*             lower(media_source) not in ('unknown','','organic') and media_source is not null and */ /*             campaign_id not in ('unknown','') and campaign_id is not null and */ /*             ad_account_id not in ('unknown','') and ad_account_id is not null */ /*     ) */ /*     where rn = 1 */ /* ) a */ /* left join */ /* ( */ /*     select */ /*         x.app_id,x.ad_account_id,x.ad_target,x.ad_platform_name */ /*     from */ /*     ( */ /*         select */ /*             app_id,ad_account_id,ad_target,ad_platform_name,row_number() over(partition by app_id,ad_platform_name,ad_account_id order by updated_at desc) as rn */ /*         from */ /*             {{adbi_gms_ad_bi_ad_account}} */ /*         where date = '20260531' */ /*     ) x where x.rn = 1 */ /* ) b */ /* on a.app_id = b.app_id and a.ad_account_id = b.ad_account_id and a.media_source = b.ad_platform_name */ /* ;
