name: tmp_hero_use_role
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_qmzhang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-02-13 19:20:19.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 角色向英雄使用率、胜率&禁用率 */ WITH battle_a AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.heroid, a.wincamp, a.banhero, a.pvptype /* 战斗类型 */, c.country /* 首次创号国 */, CASE WHEN a.isinvalidbattle = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_invalidbattle /* 是否流局(看板内置筛选项默认非流局) */, CASE WHEN a.minranklvl BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '勇士' WHEN a.minranklvl BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '精英' WHEN a.minranklvl BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN '大师' WHEN a.minranklvl BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '宗师' WHEN a.minranklvl BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN '史诗' WHEN a.minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN a.minranklvl = 26 THEN '神话V' WHEN a.minranklvl = 27 THEN '神话IV' WHEN a.minranklvl = 28 THEN '神话III' WHEN a.minranklvl = 29 THEN '神话II' WHEN a.minranklvl = 30 THEN '神话I' WHEN a.minranklvl = 31 THEN '荣耀神话' ELSE '无信息' END AS role_ranklvl /* 角色段位 */, CASE WHEN a.realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90) THEN '真人对局' WHEN a.realpvptype IN (30, 31, 37, 38, 51, 57, 58, 85, 86, 87, 92, 101, 103) THEN '温暖关' ELSE '其他' END AS real_pvptype /* 真实匹配类型 */ FROM (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) /* 排位&匹配 */ AND fake_ai = 0 /* 排除AI */) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' < '2023-04-26', '2023-04-26', '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country)) AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT lower, country FROM mt_dim.dim_national_geographic_atlas_config) AS c ON b.first_mt_country = c.lower GROUP BY a.logymd, a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.heroid, a.wincamp, a.banhero, a.pvptype, c.country, is_invalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype), battle_b /* 从battle_end表筛选连表需要的数据（对accountid+zoneid+battleid去重） */ AS (SELECT battleid, hero_num, CASE WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '勇士' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '精英' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN '大师' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '宗师' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN '史诗' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN max_minranklvl = 26 THEN '神话V' WHEN max_minranklvl = 27 THEN '神话IV' WHEN max_minranklvl = 28 THEN '神话III' WHEN max_minranklvl = 29 THEN '神话II' WHEN max_minranklvl = 30 THEN '神话I' WHEN max_minranklvl = 31 THEN '荣耀神话' ELSE '无信息' END AS game_ranklvl /* 对局段位 */ FROM (SELECT battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT heroid) AS hero_num, MAX(minranklvl) AS max_minranklvl /* 对局段位 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) /* 排位&匹配 */ GROUP BY battleid) AS t GROUP BY battleid, hero_num, game_ranklvl), hero_config /* 计算对局中不同英雄数量和对局段位 */ AS (SELECT heroid, hero_name /* 英雄中文名称 */, CASE WHEN sub_heroes = -9999 THEN heroes ELSE CONCAT(heroes, '\\073', sub_heroes) END AS heroes /* 英雄职业（主定位+次定位） */ FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' < '2023-04-26', '2023-04-26', '2026-05-30')), hero_use_win /* 英雄配置表 */ AS (SELECT logymd, heroid, pvptype, country, is_invalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, CASE WHEN hero_num = 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_repeat_hero /* 对局英雄是否重复（看板搭建时作为筛选项） */, COUNT(CASE WHEN wincamp = 1 THEN 1 END) AS hero_victory_battlecnt /* 角色使用指定英雄战斗胜利总次数（角色英雄胜率） */, COUNT(1) AS hero_battlecnt /* 角色使用指定英雄战斗总次数&角色使用指定皮肤对应英雄战斗总次数（角色英雄胜率、角色英雄使用率、角色皮肤使用率） */ FROM battle_a AS a LEFT JOIN battle_b AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY logymd, heroid, pvptype, country, is_invalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, is_repeat_hero), total_hero /* 英雄使用率和胜率 */ AS (SELECT logymd, pvptype, country, is_invalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, CASE WHEN hero_num = 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_repeat_hero, COUNT(1) AS hero_total_battlecnt /* 角色使用任意英雄战斗总次数（角色英雄使用率） */ FROM battle_a AS a LEFT JOIN battle_b AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY logymd, pvptype, country, is_invalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, is_repeat_hero), banhero /* 角色使用任意英雄战斗总次数 */ AS (SELECT logymd, banhero, pvptype, country, is_invalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, CASE WHEN hero_num = 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_repeat_hero, COUNT(1) AS banhero_cnt /* 角色Ban指定英雄总次数（角色英雄禁用率） */ FROM (SELECT * FROM battle_a WHERE banhero <> 0) AS a LEFT JOIN battle_b AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY logymd, banhero, pvptype, country, is_invalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, is_repeat_hero), total_banhero /* 英雄禁用率 */ AS (SELECT logymd, pvptype, country, is_invalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, CASE WHEN hero_num = 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_repeat_hero, COUNT(1) AS banhero_total_cnt /* 角色Ban任意英雄总次数（角色英雄禁用率） */ FROM (SELECT * FROM battle_a WHERE banhero <> 0) AS a LEFT JOIN battle_b AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY logymd, pvptype, country, is_invalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, is_repeat_hero) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_hero_use_role PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT t.heroid, hero_name, heroes, t.pvptype, t.real_pvptype, t.is_invalidbattle, t.role_ranklvl, t.game_ranklvl, t.is_repeat_hero, t.country, hero_victory_battlecnt /* 角色使用指定英雄战斗胜利总次数 */, hero_battlecnt /* 角色使用指定英雄战斗总次数&角色使用指定皮肤对应英雄战斗总次数 */, hero_total_battlecnt /* 角色使用任意英雄战斗总次数 */, banhero_cnt /* 角色Ban指定英雄总次数 */, banhero_total_cnt /* 角色Ban任意英雄总次数 */ FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.logymd, b.logymd) AS logymd, COALESCE(a.heroid, b.banhero) AS heroid, COALESCE(a.pvptype, b.pvptype) AS pvptype, COALESCE(a.is_invalidbattle, b.is_invalidbattle) AS is_invalidbattle, COALESCE(a.role_ranklvl, b.role_ranklvl) AS role_ranklvl, COALESCE(a.real_pvptype, b.real_pvptype) AS real_pvptype, COALESCE(a.game_ranklvl, b.game_ranklvl) AS game_ranklvl, COALESCE(a.is_repeat_hero, b.is_repeat_hero) AS is_repeat_hero, COALESCE(a.country, b.country) AS country, hero_victory_battlecnt, hero_battlecnt, banhero_cnt FROM hero_use_win AS a FULL JOIN banhero AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.heroid = b.banhero AND a.pvptype = b.pvptype AND a.is_invalidbattle = b.is_invalidbattle AND a.role_ranklvl = b.role_ranklvl AND a.real_pvptype = b.real_pvptype AND a.game_ranklvl = b.game_ranklvl AND a.is_repeat_hero = b.is_repeat_hero AND a.country = b.country) AS t LEFT JOIN total_hero AS c ON t.logymd = c.logymd AND t.pvptype = c.pvptype AND t.is_invalidbattle = c.is_invalidbattle AND t.role_ranklvl = c.role_ranklvl AND t.real_pvptype = c.real_pvptype AND t.game_ranklvl = c.game_ranklvl AND t.is_repeat_hero = c.is_repeat_hero AND t.country = c.country LEFT JOIN total_banhero AS d ON t.logymd = d.logymd AND t.pvptype = d.pvptype AND t.is_invalidbattle = d.is_invalidbattle AND t.role_ranklvl = d.role_ranklvl AND t.real_pvptype = d.real_pvptype AND t.game_ranklvl = d.game_ranklvl AND t.is_repeat_hero = d.is_repeat_hero AND t.country = d.country LEFT JOIN hero_config AS e ON t.heroid = e.heroid GROUP BY t.heroid, hero_name, heroes, t.pvptype, t.real_pvptype, t.is_invalidbattle, t.role_ranklvl, t.game_ranklvl, t.is_repeat_hero, t.country, hero_victory_battlecnt, hero_battlecnt, hero_total_battlecnt, banhero_cnt, banhero_total_cnt

name: 3_adbi.dm_msdk_device_active_df
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_msdk_device_active_df_out)) SELECT did, package_name, os, his_first_active_date, active_info, total_active_days, app_id FROM (SELECT COALESCE(df.did, di.did) AS did, COALESCE(df.app_id, di.app_id) AS app_id, COALESCE(df.os, di.os) AS os, COALESCE(df.package_name, di.package_name) AS package_name, COALESCE(df.his_first_active_date, di.day_first_active_date) AS his_first_active_date /* 第二层上游表上游表dwd_event_log_detail_di对event_time时间字段做了不为空处理，理论上后续加工字段day_first_login_time不会为空，所以不用考虑his_first_active_date为空的情况 */, CASE WHEN SIZE(df.active_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.active_info, IF(di.app_id IS NULL, '0', '1')), ',') AS ARRAY<INT>) ELSE ARRAY(1) END AS active_info /* -spark2.3.4 array方法比较局限，没必要写个array append之类udf，等spark3.0之后可换个更优雅的方式 */, COALESCE(df.total_active_days, 0) + IF(di.app_id IS NULL, 0, 1) AS total_active_days FROM (/* 前一天历史全量活跃数据 */ SELECT did, app_id, package_name, os, his_first_active_date, active_info, total_active_days FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_msdk_device_active_df_in)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df FULL JOIN (/* 上游数据因为package_name, 可能飘在一个账号多条数据, 这里需要按照活跃时间, 取每天的首次数据. */ SELECT * FROM (/* 当日新增活跃数据 */ SELECT did, app_id, package_name, os, SUBSTRING(day_first_login_time, 1, 10) AS day_first_active_date /* 日期字符串截取，yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss截取出yyyy-MM-dd */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id ORDER BY day_first_login_time) AS rn FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') WHERE rn = 1) AS di ON df.did = di.did AND df.app_id = di.app_id) AS act

name: 2_adbi.dm_sdk_device_pay_df
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_sdk_device_pay_df_out)) SELECT COALESCE(a.device_id, b.device_id) AS device_id, CASE WHEN NOT a.device_id IS NULL THEN CONCAT((a.total_pay_cnt + COALESCE(b.day_pay_cnt, 0)), ',', a.count_info) ELSE b.day_pay_cnt END AS count_info, CASE WHEN NOT a.device_id IS NULL THEN CONCAT(FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', (a.total_pay_amt + COALESCE(b.day_pay_amt, 0.0))), ',', a.amount_info) ELSE FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', b.day_pay_amt) END AS amount_info, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.app_id, b.app_id) <> '1001' THEN '' WHEN NOT a.device_id IS NULL THEN CONCAT(FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', (a.total_actual_pay_amt * 100 + COALESCE(b.day_actual_pay_amt, 0))), ',', a.actual_amount_info) ELSE FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', b.day_actual_pay_amt) END AS actual_amount_info, CASE WHEN NOT a.device_id IS NULL THEN a.total_pay_cnt + COALESCE(b.day_pay_cnt, 0) ELSE b.day_pay_cnt END AS total_pay_cnt, CASE WHEN NOT a.device_id IS NULL THEN DOUBLE(FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', a.total_pay_amt + COALESCE(b.day_pay_amt, 0))) ELSE DOUBLE(FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', b.day_pay_amt)) END AS total_pay_amt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.app_id, b.app_id) <> '1001' THEN 0 WHEN NOT a.device_id IS NULL THEN a.total_actual_pay_amt + COALESCE(b.day_actual_pay_amt, 0) / 100 ELSE b.day_actual_pay_amt / 100 END AS total_actual_pay_amt, CASE WHEN NOT a.device_id IS NULL THEN a.his_first_pay_date ELSE '2026-05-31' END AS his_first_pay_date, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.app_id, b.app_id) <> '1001' THEN '' WHEN NOT a.device_id IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CAST(SPLIT(a.product_money_info, ',')[0] AS BIGINT) + COALESCE(b.day_product_money, 0), ',', a.product_money_info) ELSE b.day_product_money END AS product_money_info, COALESCE(a.app_id, b.app_id) AS app_id FROM (SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_sdk_device_pay_df_in)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND NOT his_first_pay_date IS NULL) AS a FULL JOIN (SELECT b.device_id, SUM(a.day_pay_cnt) AS day_pay_cnt, SUM(a.day_pay_amt) AS day_pay_amt, SUM(a.day_actual_pay_amt) AS day_actual_pay_amt, SUM(a.day_product_money) AS day_product_money, a.app_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_sdk_pay_user_di)) INNER JOIN STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_device_account_df)) ON b.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.accountid = b.accountid WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY a.app_id, b.device_id) AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.device_id = b.device_id

name: mt_dwd.dwd_query_using_detail_di
sql_units: WITH impala_query AS (SELECT 'impala' AS source, tool_source, task_id, query_id, task_type, user AS user_name /* null as leap_task_id, */, CASE WHEN user = '%ops_hadoop%' THEN 'ops' WHEN user = '%impala%' THEN '经分' WHEN user LIKE '%wind_hadoop%' THEN 'wind' WHEN user LIKE '%svc_%' THEN 'svc' WHEN user LIKE '%vng_%' THEN 'vng' WHEN user IN ('fireyangshen' /* 数据组 */, 'irishuang', 'koshinmeng', 'zhiqunwang', 'theoguo', 'franklinhuang', 'huiyaoye', 'hengweiyan', 'haoma', 'weidai', 'jichun', 'changlv', 'yvonnezhang', 'jancheng', 'fuxinwang', 'bd_binhe', 'manningyang', 'lancega', 'maxwell' /* 发行 */, 'sapserchen', 'lwzxluo', 'jiangding', 'dylandu', 'rambohu1', 'chengjiang', 'cherylxie', 'xinbokang', 'mingjunli', 'nelsonliu', 'kurokyma', 'stormtian', 'candytian', 'leowan', 'wilsonwang1', 'willemwang', 'titoxu', 'kurokyma', 'mingye', 'mlxgzhang', 'kurokyma', 'miaozheng', 'eliozheng', 'odysseusxu', 'marcuschen', 'arixiong') THEN 'de' WHEN u.department IN ('数据分析', '竞品分析') THEN 'da' ELSE 'user' END AS user_type, table_name AS ori_table_name /* null AS leap_proj, */ /* logymd, */, CASE WHEN SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[0] = 'ml_leap' AND SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[1] LIKE '%dwd%' THEN CONCAT('mt_dwd\\.', SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[1]) WHEN SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[0] = 'ml_leap' AND SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[1] LIKE '%dwm%' THEN CONCAT('mt_dwm\\.', SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[1]) WHEN SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[0] = 'ml_leap' AND SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[1] LIKE '%dm%' THEN CONCAT('mt_dm\\.', SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[1]) WHEN SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[0] = 'ml_leap' AND SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[1] LIKE '%dim%' THEN CONCAT('mt_dim\\.', SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[1]) WHEN SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[0] = 'ml_leap' AND SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[1] LIKE '%ads%' THEN CONCAT('mt_ads\\.', SPLIT(table_name, '\\.')[1]) ELSE table_name END AS act_table_name, CASE WHEN table_name LIKE '%ml_leap%' OR /* or table_name like '%persona_mlbb%' */ /* or table_name like '%ml_datacleaning%' */ /* or table_name like '%ml_basic.login_metrics%' */ /* or table_name like '%ml_basic.login_metrics_57%' */ table_name LIKE '%ml_basic.adv_install_detail_new%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df%' /* 历史记录 */ OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_di%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df_transfer%' THEN 'is_mid' WHEN table_name LIKE '%db_etl.mh%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_etl%' OR table_name LIKE '%persona_mlbb%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_datacleaning%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_basic.lose_user_30%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_basic.recurring_user_30%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_basic.lose_user_7%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_basic.recurring_user_7%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_basic.login_metrics%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_basic.login_metrics_57%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dim%' OR (table_name LIKE '%mt_dwd%' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df%' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_di%' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df_transfer%') OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dm%' THEN 'is_old_mid' WHEN table_name LIKE '%mt_ads%' THEN 'is_ads' WHEN table_name LIKE '%ml_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%mh_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%mh_basic%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_basic%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_charge%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_battle%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_activity%' OR table_name LIKE '%zgame_damai_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%mtwb_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%ngame_basic%' OR table_name LIKE '%zg_basic%' OR table_name LIKE '%mtbi_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_behavior%' THEN 'is_ods' WHEN table_name LIKE '%ml_tempdb%' THEN 'is_ub' ELSE 'unknown' END AS table_type /* 区分ods还是中间表 */, CASE WHEN ((table_name LIKE '%ml_leap%' OR table_name LIKE '%persona_mlbb%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_datacleaning%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dim%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dwd%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dm%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dwm%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_ads%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_basic%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_charge%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_battle%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_tempdb%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_behavior%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_activity%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_etl%') AND table_name NOT LIKE '%mla%' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%mh%' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%zgame%') THEN 'MLBB' WHEN table_name LIKE '%msdk%' THEN 'MSDK' WHEN table_name LIKE '%mh_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%mla%' OR table_name LIKE '%mh%' OR table_name LIKE '%mh_basic%' THEN 'MLA' /* WHEN table_name like '%bi_test%' or table_name like '%mtbi_ods%' THEN '项目数仓' */ WHEN table_name LIKE '%zgame%' OR table_name LIKE '%zg_basic%' THEN 'ZGAME' WHEN table_name LIKE '%ngame%' THEN 'NGAME' WHEN table_name LIKE '%mtbi_ods%' THEN 'MTBI' ELSE 'unknown' END AS appid /* ,logymd */ FROM (SELECT query_id, table_name, user, 'impala' AS tool_source, 1 AS task_type, NULL AS task_id FROM mt_dwd.dwd_impala_query_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* and logymd <= '2022-11-16' */ AND is_table = 1 UNION ALL SELECT task_id, table_name, SPLIT(owner_email_prefix, '@')[0] AS user, 'wind' AS tool_source, 1 AS task_type, task_id FROM mt_dwd.dwd_datawind_query_info WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-02-15', '2023-02-15', '2026-05-31') AND is_table = 1 AND data_type = 'impala' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%undefined-db%') AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, department FROM mt_dim.dim_focus_user_info WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-03-14', '2023-03-14', '2026-05-31')) AS u ON t.user = u.user_id), leap_query AS (SELECT 'leap' AS source, tool_source, task_id, id AS tqs_id, task_type, SPLIT(t.user_name, '@')[0] AS user_name /* if(task_type = 1, null, task_id) as leap_task_id, --1代表临时查询 */, CASE WHEN SPLIT(t.user_name, '@')[0] IN ('fireyangshen' /* 数据组 */, 'irishuang', 'koshinmeng', 'zhiqunwang', 'theoguo', 'franklinhuang', 'huiyaoye', 'hengweiyan', 'haoma', 'weidai', 'jichun', 'changlv', 'yvonnezhang', 'jancheng', 'fuxinwang', 'bd_binhe', 'manningyang', 'lancega', 'maxwell' /* 发行 */, 'sapserchen', 'lwzxluo', 'jiangding', 'dylandu', 'rambohu1', 'chengjiang', 'cherylxie', 'xinbokang', 'mingjunli', 'nelsonliu', 'kurokyma', 'stormtian', 'candytian', 'leowan', 'wilsonwang1', 'willemwang', 'titoxu', 'kurokyma', 'mingye', 'mlxgzhang', 'kurokyma', 'miaozheng', 'eliozheng', 'odysseusxu', 'marcuschen', 'arixiong') THEN 'de' WHEN u.department IN ('数据分析', '竞品分析') THEN 'da' ELSE 'user' END AS user_type, table_name AS ori_table_name /* CASE */ /*     WHEN project_name IN ('Ad Hoc_MLBB', 'MLBB') THEN 'MLBB' */ /*     WHEN project_name IN ('MSDK数仓', 'Ad Hoc_OPM') THEN 'MSDK' */ /*     WHEN project_name = 'Ad Hoc_MLA' THEN 'MLA' */ /*     WHEN project_name = 'Ad Hoc_ZGAME' THEN 'ZGAME' */ /*     WHEN project_name = '项目数仓' THEN '项目数仓' */ /*     ELSE 'unknown' */ /* END AS leap_proj, */, table_name AS act_table_name, CASE WHEN table_name LIKE '%mt_dwd.dwd_lose_user_30_ml%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dwd.dwd_recurring_user_30_ml%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dwd.datacleaning_login_metrics%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dwd.int_feature%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dwd.dwd_appinstall_all_di' THEN 'is_old_mid' WHEN table_name LIKE '%mt_dwm%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dim%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dwd%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dm%' OR table_name LIKE '%msdk_dwm%' OR table_name LIKE '%msdk_dm%' OR table_name LIKE '%msdk_dwd%' OR table_name LIKE '%msdk_dim%' THEN 'is_mid' WHEN table_name LIKE '%mt_ads%' OR table_name LIKE '%msdk_ads%' THEN 'is_ads' WHEN table_name LIKE '%ml_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%mh_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%msdk_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%mtbi_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%zgame_damai_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%mtwb_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_ods%' THEN 'is_ods' WHEN table_name LIKE '%ml_temp%' OR table_name LIKE '%mh_temp%' THEN 'is_ub' WHEN table_name LIKE '%bi_test%' THEN 'is_test' ELSE 'unknown' END AS table_type /* 区分ods还是中间表 */, CASE WHEN ((table_name LIKE '%mt_dwm%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dim%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dwd%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_dm%' OR table_name LIKE '%ml_temp%' OR table_name LIKE '%mt_ads%' OR table_name LIKE '%mtwb_ods%' OR table_name LIKE '%mlbb%') AND table_name NOT LIKE '%mla%' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%zgame%') THEN 'MLBB' WHEN table_name LIKE '%msdk%' THEN 'MSDK' WHEN table_name LIKE '%mh%' OR table_name LIKE '%mla%' OR table_name LIKE '%mh_temp%' THEN 'MLA' /* WHEN table_name like '%bi_test%' or table_name like '%mtbi_ods%' THEN '项目数仓' */ WHEN table_name LIKE '%zgame%' THEN 'ZGAME' /* WHEN table_name like '%ngame%' THEN 'NGMAE' */ ELSE 'unknown' END AS appid /* ,logymd */ FROM (SELECT id, table_name, user_name, 'leap' AS tool_source, task_type, task_id FROM mt_dwd.dwd_tqs_query_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_table = 1 AND engine_type <> 'Hive' AND project_name IN ('项目数仓', 'Ad Hoc_ZGAME', 'Ad Hoc_MLBB', 'MLBB', 'Ad Hoc_MLA' /* 'Ad Hoc_NGAME' */) UNION ALL SELECT task_id, table_name, owner_email_prefix AS user, 'wind' AS tool_source, 1 AS task_type, task_id FROM mt_dwd.dwd_datawind_query_info WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-02-15', '2023-02-15', '2026-05-31') AND is_table = 1 AND data_type = 'hive' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%hive_sql-db%') AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_email AS user_name, department FROM mt_dim.dim_focus_user_info WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-03-14', '2023-03-14', '2026-05-31')) AS u ON t.user_name = u.user_name) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_query_using_detail_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT source, tool_source, CAST(task_id AS STRING) AS task_id, CAST(query_id AS STRING) AS query_id, task_type, user_name /* STRING(leap_task_id) AS leap_task_id, */, user_type, t1.ori_table_name /* leap_proj, */, COALESCE(t2.ods_name, t1.act_table_name) AS act_table_name, table_type, appid FROM (SELECT * FROM impala_query UNION ALL SELECT * FROM leap_query) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_impala_table_mapping_df) AS t2 ON t1.act_table_name = t2.view_name

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_performance_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH t_login AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, active_device, active_screen_ratio, active_client_cpu, active_client_memory FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device AS active_device, screen_ratio AS active_screen_ratio, client_cpu AS active_client_cpu, client_memory AS active_client_memory, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND reconn <> 1) AS t /* 排除重连用户 */ WHERE rn = 1), t_login_auth AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, package_type AS ranked_classic_last_pad FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zone_id AS zoneid, package_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zone_id ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.loginserver_login_auth WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t WHERE rn = 1), t_battle AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ranked_classic_use_wifi_cnt, 0) > COALESCE(ranked_classic_use_network_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(ranked_classic_use_wifi_cnt, 0) > COALESCE(ranked_classic_use_wifi_dual_cnt, 0) THEN 'wifi' WHEN COALESCE(ranked_classic_use_network_cnt, 0) > COALESCE(ranked_classic_use_wifi_cnt, 0) AND COALESCE(ranked_classic_use_network_cnt, 0) > COALESCE(ranked_classic_use_wifi_dual_cnt, 0) THEN 'network' ELSE 'wifi_dual' END AS ranked_classic_prefer_nettype FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN `time` END) AS ranked_classic_end_time, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN `stdping` END) AS ranked_classic_stdping, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN `timedelay` END) AS ranked_classic_timedelay_avg, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN `maxdelay` END) AS ranked_classic_delay_max, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN `battletime` END) AS ranked_classic_battle_dur, SUM(ping80) AS ranked_classic_ping80_cnt, SUM(ping100) AS ranked_classic_ping100_cnt, SUM(ping120) AS ranked_classic_ping120_cnt, SUM(ping150) AS ranked_classic_ping150_cnt, SUM(ping200) AS ranked_classic_ping200_cnt, SUM(ping300) AS ranked_classic_ping300_cnt, SUM(ping500) AS ranked_classic_ping500_cnt, SUM(ping800) AS ranked_classic_ping800_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN wifi = 'True' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ranked_classic_use_wifi_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN wifi = 'False' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ranked_classic_use_network_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN wifi = 'Dual' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ranked_classic_use_wifi_dual_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN use_udp = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ranked_classic_use_udp_unknown_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN use_udp = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ranked_classic_use_tcp_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN use_udp = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ranked_classic_use_udp_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN use_udp = 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ranked_classic_use_udp_change_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN timedelay <= 110 AND timedelay > 0 AND movelag <= 4 AND incomingping100ms < 50000 AND isvalid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ranked_classic_netdelay_110_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN timedelay <= 60 AND timedelay > 0 AND movelag <= 4 AND incomingping100ms < 50000 AND isvalid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ranked_classic_netdelay_60_cnt, MIN(minfps) AS ranked_classic_minfps, SUM(avefps) AS ranked_classic_total_avgfps, COUNT(CASE WHEN stdping > 1500 THEN 1 END) AS ranked_classic_stdping_gt_1500_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN stdping <= 1500 THEN 1 END) AS ranked_classic_stdping_le_1000_cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN an = 1 THEN channel END) AS ranked_classic_day_first_channel, MAX(CASE WHEN an = 1 THEN unityversion END) AS ranked_classic_day_first_unityversion, MAX(CASE WHEN an = 1 THEN clientversion END) AS ranked_classic_day_first_clientversion, ROUND(AVG(timedelay), 2) AS ranked_classic_timedelay_total_avg, ROUND(AVG(avefps), 2) AS ranked_classic_avgfps_total_avg, ROUND(POWER(STDDEV_POP(timedelay), 2), 2) AS ranked_classic_timedelay_total_var, ROUND(POWER(STDDEV_POP(avefps), 2), 2) AS ranked_classic_avgfps_total_var FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, `time`, stdping, timedelay, maxdelay, battletime, ping80, ping100, ping120, ping150, ping200, ping300, ping500, ping800, wifi, use_udp, incomingping100ms, isvalid, movelag, minfps, avefps, channel, unityversion, clientversion, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn /* 取战斗相关末次信息 */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY `time`) AS an /* 取战斗相关首次信息 */ FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, `time`, stdping, timedelay, maxdelay, battletime, battleid, ping80, ping100, ping120, ping150, ping200, ping300, ping500, ping800, wifi, use_udp, incomingping100ms, isvalid, movelag, minfps, avefps, channel, unityversion, clientversion, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY `time` DESC, battleresulttype) AS row_id FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2)) AS t WHERE row_id = 1) AS t2 /* 过滤掉重复数据 */ GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS t3), t_performance AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ranked_classic_startup_dur, ranked_classic_devicemodel, ranked_classic_realpicturequality, ranked_classic_is_download, ranked_classic_picturequality, ranked_classic_is_highfps, ranked_classic_fps_variance, ranked_classic_fps_media, ranked_classic_fps_min, ranked_classic_fps_unity_avg, ranked_classic_fps_datetime_avg, ranked_classic_gameusediskspace, ranked_classic_freediskspace, ranked_classic_end_pssmemory, ranked_classic_end_unitymemory, ranked_classic_systemmemorysize, ranked_classic_freememory, ranked_classic_jankper_10min, ranked_classic_bigjankper_10min, ranked_classic_jankper_10min_total, ranked_classic_bigjankper_10min_total, ranked_classic_temperature, ranked_classic_nowpicturequality, ranked_classic_last_is_host, ranked_classic_bigcaton_cnt, ranked_classic_mincaton_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, startup_time AS ranked_classic_startup_dur, devicemodel AS ranked_classic_devicemodel, realpicturequality AS ranked_classic_realpicturequality, isdownload AS ranked_classic_is_download, nowpicturequality AS ranked_classic_picturequality, ishighfps AS ranked_classic_is_highfps, fps_variance AS ranked_classic_fps_variance, medianfps AS ranked_classic_fps_media, minfps AS ranked_classic_fps_min, avgfps_unity AS ranked_classic_fps_unity_avg, avgfps_datetime AS ranked_classic_fps_datetime_avg, gameusediskspace AS ranked_classic_gameusediskspace, freediskspace AS ranked_classic_freediskspace, pssmemory AS ranked_classic_end_pssmemory, unitymemory AS ranked_classic_end_unitymemory, systemmemorysize AS ranked_classic_systemmemorysize, freememory AS ranked_classic_freememory, jankper10min AS ranked_classic_jankper_10min, bigjankper10min AS ranked_classic_bigjankper_10min, jankper10mintime AS ranked_classic_jankper_10min_total, bigjankper10mintime AS ranked_classic_bigjankper_10min_total, temperature AS ranked_classic_temperature, IF(nowpicturequality < 5, nowpicturequality, nowpicturequality - 5) AS ranked_classic_nowpicturequality, CASE WHEN p20 <> '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ranked_classic_last_is_host /*   , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY accountid,zoneid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn */, SUM(bigjankper10min) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid) AS ranked_classic_bigcaton_cnt, SUM(jankper10min) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid) AS ranked_classic_mincaton_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance /* logymd=2019-03-24开始有数据 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2)) AS t WHERE rn = 1), t_battleend /* WHERE rn = 1 */ /* 去3张战斗表分别的最后一场战斗信息，然后拿role+zone进行关联 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid /*  , SUM(bigjankper10min) AS ranked_classic_bigcaton_cnt */ /*  , SUM(jankper10min) AS ranked_classic_mincaton_cnt */, MAX(CASE WHEN row_id = 1 THEN ranked_classic_start_batterylevel END) AS ranked_classic_start_batterylevel, MAX(CASE WHEN row_id = 1 THEN ranked_classic_end_batterylevel END) AS ranked_classic_end_batterylevel, SUM(CASE WHEN row_id = 1 AND noresnum > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ranked_classic_battle_albuginea_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, battleid, ranked_classic_start_batterylevel, ranked_classic_end_batterylevel, noresnum /*   , bigjankper10min */ /*   , jankper10min */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS row_id FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, `time`, battleid, ibattlestartbatterylevel AS ranked_classic_start_batterylevel, ibattleendtbatterylevel AS ranked_classic_end_batterylevel /*    , bigjankper10min */ /*    , jankper10min */, MAX(noresnum) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid) AS noresnum, SIZE(COLLECT_SET(medal_type) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid)) AS medal_type_cnt /* 对medal_type去重 */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata /* logymd=2018-01-10开始有数据 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battletype IN (1, 2) AND COALESCE(isbot, 0) = 0) AS t WHERE rn = 1 AND medal_type_cnt = 1 /* 过滤掉出现了多种奖牌的battleid，为异常数据 */) AS t2 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_battle_info AS (SELECT createdate, COALESCE(df.createtime, di.first_event_time) AS createtime, COALESCE(di.last_event_date, df.recent_active_date) AS recent_active_date, COALESCE(di.last_event_time, df.recent_active_time) AS recent_active_time, COALESCE(df.store, di.first_store) AS store, COALESCE(di.last_store, df.recent_store) AS recent_store, COALESCE(df.ip_country, di.first_ip_country) AS ip_country, COALESCE(di.last_ip_country, df.recent_ip_country) AS recent_ip_country, COALESCE(df.client_version, di.first_client_version) AS client_version, COALESCE(di.last_client_version, df.recent_client_version) AS recent_client_version, COALESCE(df.sdk_version, di.first_sdk_version) AS sdk_version, COALESCE(di.last_sdk_version, df.recent_sdk_version) AS recent_sdk_version, COALESCE(df.appid, di.app_id) AS appid FROM df FULL JOIN di ON df.account_id = di.account_id AND df.appid = di.app_id

name: adbi.dwm_sdk_back_device_reattribution_di
sql_units: WITH mlbb_account_create AS (SELECT z.accountid, z.account_name FROM (SELECT x.accountid, x.account_name FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create AS x LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS y ON y.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND y.appid = 'mlbb' AND y.is_ai IN ('2', '1') AND x.accountid = y.roleid AND SUBSTRING(CAST(x.time AS STRING), 1, 10) = y.register_date WHERE x.logymd < '2023-08-22' AND y.roleid IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT accountid, account_name FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd >= '2023-08-22' AND channel <> 'and_gmfake') AS z GROUP BY z.accountid, z.account_name), device_unAdjust /* 待归因设备 */ AS (SELECT device_union.app_id, CASE WHEN device_union.app_id = '1001' THEN account.accountid WHEN device_union.app_id = '2001' THEN account_mh.accountid ELSE account_zg.accountid END AS account_id, device_union.device_id, device_union.country, device_union.idfa, device_union.idfv, device_union.gps_adid, device_union.android_id, device_union.pc_device, device_union.os, device_union.first_device, device_union.second_device, device_union.back_time_type, device_union.loss_days, device_union.p_date AS device_back_date FROM (/* 当日回流设备 */ SELECT app_id, device_id, country, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, CASE WHEN app_id = '3001' THEN IF(COALESCE(TRIM(pc_device), '') = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(pc_device)) IN ('unknown', 'none', 'null'), 'unknown', MD5(TRIM(pc_device))) ELSE NULL END AS pc_device, os, CASE WHEN os = 'ios' THEN idfa WHEN os = 'android' THEN gps_adid ELSE NULL END AS first_device, CASE WHEN os = 'ios' THEN idfv WHEN os = 'android' THEN android_id ELSE NULL END AS second_device, CASE WHEN app_id <> '3001' THEN IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, 31) = '1000000000000000000000000000000', ARRAY(7, 30), ARRAY(7)) ELSE IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, 31) = '1000000000000000000000000000000', ARRAY(7, 14, 30), IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, 15) = '100000000000000', ARRAY(7, 14), ARRAY(7))) END AS back_time_type, LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(active_info), '1', 2)) - 1 AS loss_days, p_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND ((app_id = '2001' AND create_date >= '2019-01-01') OR app_id = '1001' OR app_id = '3001') AND SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, 8) = '10000000' /* 最近7日自然归因设备 */ UNION ALL SELECT app_id, device_id, country, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, pc_device, os, CASE WHEN os = 'ios' THEN idfa WHEN os = 'android' THEN gps_adid ELSE NULL END AS first_device, CASE WHEN os = 'ios' THEN idfv WHEN os = 'android' THEN android_id ELSE NULL END AS second_device, back_time_type, loss_days, p_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_sdk_back_device_reattribution_di_in)) WHERE p_date >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 7 * -1) AND p_date < '2026-05-31') AS device_union LEFT JOIN mlbb_account_create AS account ON device_union.app_id = '1001' AND device_union.device_id = account.account_name AND account.account_name <> '' LEFT JOIN mh_ods.accountserver_account_create AS account_mh ON device_union.app_id = '2001' AND device_union.device_id = account_mh.account_name AND account_mh.account_name <> '' AND account_mh.logymd > '0000-00-00' LEFT JOIN zgame_damai_ods.accountserver_account_create AS account_zg ON device_union.app_id = '3001' AND device_union.device_id = account_zg.account_name AND account_zg.account_name <> '' AND account_zg.logymd > '0000-00-00'), adjust_event /* 归因事件 */ AS (SELECT app_id, CASE WHEN activity_kind = 'reattribution_reinstall' THEN '1-广告重装回流' WHEN activity_kind = 'reattribution' THEN '2-广告回流' WHEN activity_kind = 'reinstall' THEN '3-自然重装回流' END AS back_type, reattributed_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(reattributed_time - 8 * 60 * 60, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS reattributed_date, os_name AS os, CASE WHEN os_name = 'ios' THEN idfa WHEN os_name = 'android' THEN gps_adid ELSE NULL END AS first_device, CASE WHEN os_name = 'ios' THEN idfv WHEN os_name = 'android' THEN android_id ELSE NULL END AS second_device, CASE WHEN app_id = '3001' AND os_name = 'windows' THEN pc_device ELSE NULL END AS pc_device, account_id, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'organic', network_name) AS network_name, country, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', campaign_name) AS campaign_name, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', adgroup_name) AS adgroup_name, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', creative_name) AS creative_name, fb_install_referrer, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id) AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name) AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', fb_install_referrer_campaign_id) AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_id, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', fb_install_referrer_campaign_name) AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_name, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id) AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id, IF(activity_kind = 'reinstall', 'unknown', fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name) AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name, msdk_adjust_logymd FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN msdk_app_id = '4040' THEN '1001' WHEN msdk_app_id = '4050' THEN '2001' ELSE '3001' END AS app_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') AS activity_kind, CASE WHEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') IN ('reattribution_reinstall', 'reattribution') THEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.reattributed_at') ELSE GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.reinstalled_at') END AS reattributed_time, os_name, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.account_id') AS account_id, network_name, country, campaign_name, adgroup_name, creative_name, COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer'), '') AS fb_install_referrer, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_id') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_name') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id') AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name') AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name, CASE WHEN msdk_app_id = '4030' THEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.external_device_id_md5') ELSE NULL END AS pc_device, logymd AS msdk_adjust_logymd FROM msdk_ods.msdk_adjust WHERE logymd >= REPLACE(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 15 * -1), '-', '') AND logymd <= REPLACE(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 10), '-', '') AND logymd >= '20221209' AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') IN ('reinstall', 'reattribution', 'reattribution_reinstall') AND msdk_app_id IN ('4040', '4050', '4030')) AS k), device_Adjust /* 设备归因 */ AS (SELECT device.app_id, device.device_id, device.idfa, device.idfv, device.gps_adid, device.android_id, device.pc_device, device.os, device.back_type, device.back_time_type, device.loss_days, device.device_back_date, device.network_name, device.country, IF(device.campaign_id IS NULL OR TRIM(device.campaign_id) = '', 'unknown', device.campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(device.campaign_name IS NULL OR TRIM(device.campaign_name) = '', 'unknown', device.campaign_name) AS campaign_name, IF(device.adgroup_id IS NULL OR TRIM(device.adgroup_id) = '', 'unknown', device.adgroup_id) AS adgroup_id, IF(device.adgroup_name IS NULL OR TRIM(device.adgroup_name) = '', 'unknown', device.adgroup_name) AS adgroup_name, IF(device.creative_id IS NULL OR TRIM(device.creative_id) = '', 'unknown', device.creative_id) AS creative_id, IF(device.creative_name IS NULL OR TRIM(device.creative_name) = '', 'unknown', device.creative_name) AS creative_name, device.msdk_adjust_logymd FROM (SELECT device_attribution.app_id, device_attribution.device_id, device_attribution.idfa, device_attribution.idfv, device_attribution.gps_adid, device_attribution.android_id, device_attribution.pc_device, device_attribution.os, device_attribution.back_type, device_attribution.back_time_type, device_attribution.loss_days, device_attribution.device_back_date, IF(LOWER(device_attribution.network_name) = 'organic', 'Organic', TRIM(network_name)) AS network_name, IF((device_attribution.country IS NULL OR TRIM(device_attribution.country) IN ('', 'unknown')) AND device_attribution.os IN ('android', 'ios'), COALESCE(TRIM(device_attribution.original_country), 'unknown'), COALESCE(TRIM(device_attribution.country), 'unknown')) AS country, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN 'unknown' WHEN device_attribution.is_fb = 1 THEN device_attribution.fb_campaign_id ELSE IF(device_attribution.campaign_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', device_attribution.campaign_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(device_attribution.campaign_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS campaign_id, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN 'unknown' WHEN device_attribution.is_fb = 1 THEN device_attribution.fb_campaign_name ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(device_attribution.campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN 'unknown' WHEN device_attribution.is_fb = 1 THEN device_attribution.fb_adgroup_id ELSE IF(device_attribution.adgroup_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', device_attribution.adgroup_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(device_attribution.adgroup_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS adgroup_id, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN 'unknown' WHEN device_attribution.is_fb = 1 THEN device_attribution.fb_adgroup_name ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(device_attribution.adgroup_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS adgroup_name, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN 'unknown' WHEN device_attribution.is_fb = 1 THEN device_attribution.fb_ad_id ELSE IF(device_attribution.creative_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', device_attribution.creative_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(device_attribution.creative_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS creative_id, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN 'unknown' WHEN device_attribution.is_fb = 1 THEN device_attribution.fb_ad_name ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(device_attribution.creative_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS creative_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_attribution.device_back_date, device_attribution.app_id, device_attribution.device_id ORDER BY device_attribution.back_type, device_attribution.reattributed_time DESC) AS rn, CASE WHEN NOT device_attribution.back_type IN ('1-广告重装回流', '2-广告回流') THEN NULL ELSE device_attribution.msdk_adjust_logymd END AS msdk_adjust_logymd FROM (SELECT device_adjust.app_id, device_adjust.account_id, device_adjust.device_id, device_adjust.idfa, device_adjust.idfv, device_adjust.gps_adid, device_adjust.android_id, device_adjust.pc_device, device_adjust.os, device_adjust.back_type, device_adjust.back_time_type, device_adjust.loss_days, device_adjust.original_country, device_adjust.country, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', 1, 0) AS is_fb, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', 'Facebook Installs', device_adjust.network_name) AS network_name, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', device_adjust.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id, NULL) AS fb_campaign_id, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', device_adjust.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name, NULL) AS fb_campaign_name, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', device_adjust.fb_install_referrer_campaign_id, NULL) AS fb_adgroup_id, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', device_adjust.fb_install_referrer_campaign_name, NULL) AS fb_adgroup_name, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', device_adjust.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id, NULL) AS fb_ad_id, IF(LOWER(device_adjust.network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_adjust.fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', device_adjust.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name, NULL) AS fb_ad_name, device_adjust.campaign_name, device_adjust.adgroup_name, device_adjust.creative_name, device_adjust.reattributed_time, device_adjust.msdk_adjust_logymd, device_adjust.device_back_date FROM (SELECT device.app_id, device.account_id, device.device_id, device.country AS original_country, device.idfa, device.idfv, device.gps_adid, device.android_id, device.pc_device, device.os, device.back_time_type, device.loss_days, device.device_back_date, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.back_type WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.back_type WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.back_type WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.back_type ELSE '4-自然回流' END AS back_type, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.reattributed_time WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.reattributed_time WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.reattributed_time WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.reattributed_time ELSE NULL END AS reattributed_time, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.msdk_adjust_logymd WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.msdk_adjust_logymd WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.msdk_adjust_logymd WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.msdk_adjust_logymd ELSE NULL END AS msdk_adjust_logymd, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.network_name WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.network_name WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.network_name WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.network_name ELSE 'organic' END AS network_name, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.country WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.country WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.country WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.country ELSE 'unknown' END AS country, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.campaign_name WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.campaign_name WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.campaign_name WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.campaign_name ELSE 'unknown' END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.adgroup_name WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.adgroup_name WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.adgroup_name WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.adgroup_name ELSE 'unknown' END AS adgroup_name, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.creative_name WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.creative_name WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.creative_name WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.creative_name ELSE 'unknown' END AS creative_name, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.fb_install_referrer WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.fb_install_referrer WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.fb_install_referrer ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer_campaign_id WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.fb_install_referrer_campaign_id WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.fb_install_referrer_campaign_id WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.fb_install_referrer_campaign_id ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_id, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer_campaign_name WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.fb_install_referrer_campaign_name WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.fb_install_referrer_campaign_name WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.fb_install_referrer_campaign_name ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id, CASE WHEN NOT event1.back_type IS NULL THEN event1.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name WHEN NOT event2.back_type IS NULL THEN event2.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name WHEN NOT event3.back_type IS NULL THEN event3.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name WHEN NOT event4.back_type IS NULL THEN event4.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name ELSE 'unknown' END AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name FROM device_unAdjust AS device LEFT JOIN adjust_event AS event1 ON device.app_id = event1.app_id AND device.os = event1.os AND device.first_device = event1.first_device AND event1.first_device <> '' AND DATEDIFF(device.device_back_date, event1.reattributed_date) <= 6 AND DATEDIFF(device.device_back_date, event1.reattributed_date) >= 0 AND device.os IN ('android', 'ios') LEFT JOIN adjust_event AS event2 ON device.app_id = event2.app_id AND device.os = event2.os AND device.second_device = event2.second_device AND event2.second_device <> '' AND DATEDIFF(device.device_back_date, event2.reattributed_date) <= 6 AND DATEDIFF(device.device_back_date, event2.reattributed_date) >= 0 AND device.os IN ('android', 'ios') LEFT JOIN adjust_event AS event3 ON device.app_id = event3.app_id AND device.account_id = event3.account_id AND DATEDIFF(device.device_back_date, event3.reattributed_date) <= 6 AND DATEDIFF(device.device_back_date, event3.reattributed_date) >= 0 AND device.os IN ('android', 'ios') LEFT JOIN adjust_event AS event4 ON device.app_id = event4.app_id AND device.os = event4.os AND device.pc_device = event4.pc_device AND DATEDIFF(device.device_back_date, event4.reattributed_date) <= 6 AND DATEDIFF(device.device_back_date, event4.reattributed_date) >= 0 AND device.os IN ('windows')) AS device_adjust) AS device_attribution) AS device WHERE device.rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_sdk_back_device_reattribution_di_out)) SELECT * FROM (SELECT device_id, os, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, back_type, back_time_type, country, network_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_id, adgroup_name, creative_id, creative_name, msdk_adjust_logymd AS att_logymd, loss_days, pc_device, device_back_date AS p_date, app_id FROM device_Adjust) AS k DISTRIBUTE BY k.p_date, k.app_id

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_battle_info_di
sql_units: /* battleid+camp粒度基础表 */ WITH battle_base AS (SELECT battleid, camp, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT_WS(',', heroid, accountid, zoneid, uiskinid))) AS heroid, MIN(TIME) AS battle_end_time, MIN(battletime) AS battle_time, MIN(pvptype) AS pvptype, MIN(realpvptype) AS realpvptype, MAX(bigranklvl) AS bigranklvl, MAX(wincamp) AS is_wincamp, MIN(isvalid) AS is_valid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND Pvptype IN (1, 2) AND md5error = 0 GROUP BY battleid, camp), team_detail AS (SELECT battleid, golda, goldb, expa, expb, lordkillb, lordkilla, turtlekilla, turtlekillb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY battleid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_team_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND Pvptype IN (1, 2)), team_info AS (SELECT battleid, 1 AS camp, CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY_ACCUMULATE(CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(golda, 1, LENGTH(golda) - 1), '\\073') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>))) AS gold, CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY_ACCUMULATE(CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(expa, 1, LENGTH(expa) - 1), '\\073') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>))) AS exp, lordkilla AS lordkill, turtlekilla AS turtlekill FROM team_detail WHERE rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT battleid, 2 AS camp, CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY_ACCUMULATE(CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(goldb, 1, LENGTH(goldb) - 1), '\\073') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>))) AS gold, CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY_ACCUMULATE(CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(expb, 1, LENGTH(expb) - 1), '\\073') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>))) AS exp, lordkillb AS lordkill, turtlekillb AS turtlekill FROM team_detail WHERE rn = 1), stage_start_info AS (SELECT battleid, 0 AS early_time, CASE WHEN NOT first_tower IS NULL THEN first_tower END AS mid_time, CASE WHEN NOT third_tower IS NULL AND NOT second_tower IS NULL THEN second_tower END AS late_time, CASE WHEN NOT third_tower IS NULL THEN third_tower END AS big_late_time, CASE WHEN min_tree_des_time <> third_tower AND min_tree_des_time <> 9999 THEN min_tree_des_time ELSE -99999 END AS last_time FROM (SELECT battleid, SUM(CASE WHEN tower_label = '1塔' THEN min_des_time END) AS first_tower, SUM(CASE WHEN tower_label = '2塔' THEN min_des_time END) AS second_tower, SUM(CASE WHEN tower_label = '3塔' THEN min_des_time END) AS third_tower, SUM(CASE WHEN tower_label = '基地' THEN min_des_time END) AS base, MIN(min_tree_des_time) AS min_tree_des_time FROM (SELECT battleid, tower_label, MIN(destroy_time) AS min_des_time, MIN(three_time) AS min_tree_des_time FROM (SELECT battleid, CASE WHEN SPLIT(destroy_tower_info, ',')[1] IN (1007, 1807, 1008, 1808) THEN '1塔' WHEN SPLIT(destroy_tower_info, ',')[1] IN (1009, 1809, 1010, 1810) THEN '基地' WHEN SPLIT(destroy_tower_info, ',')[1] IN (1013, 1813, 1014, 1814) THEN '2塔' WHEN SPLIT(destroy_tower_info, ',')[1] IN (1015, 1815, 1016, 1816) THEN '3塔' END AS tower_label, CAST(SPLIT(destroy_tower_info, ',')[0] AS BIGINT) AS destroy_time, times AS three_time FROM (SELECT battleid, destroytowerinfo, IF(baseonlytime IN (0, 1, 2), 9999, baseonlytime) AS times FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND destroytowerinfo <> '' AND NOT battleid IS NULL AND COALESCE(isbot, 0) = 0 GROUP BY battleid, destroytowerinfo, IF(baseonlytime IN (0, 1, 2), 9999, baseonlytime)) AS a LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(destroytowerinfo, '\\073')) tbl AS destroy_tower_info) AS tower_time GROUP BY battleid, tower_label) AS b GROUP BY battleid) AS c), destorytowerinfo AS (SELECT battleid, icamp AS camp, MAX(destroytowerinfo) AS destroytowerinfo, MAX(team_dmg) AS team_dmg_total, MAX(team_hurt) AS team_hurt_total, MAX(team_atktower) AS team_atktower_total, SUM(deadnumbytower) AS dead_bytower_num, SUM(hurtad) AS hurtad_total, SUM(hurtap) AS hurtap_total, SUM(injuredad) AS injuredad_total, SUM(injuredap) AS injuredap_total, SUM(hurtatk) AS hurtatk_total, SUM(curehero) AS curehero_total, SUM(total_equip_value) AS equip_value_total, SUM(killover) AS killover_num, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(heroid, ',', hurtrate))) AS hurtrate, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(heroid, ',', behurtrate))) AS behurtrate, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(heroid, ',', fightrate))) AS fightrate, SUM(item1005_num) AS item1005_num, SUM(item1105_num) AS item1105_num, SUM(item1205_num) AS item1205_num, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(heroid, ',', porder))) AS pick_hero_list FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(isbot, 0) = 0 GROUP BY battleid, icamp), death_info_d AS (SELECT battleid, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT_WS(',', death_time, people_cnts_camp_1, people_cnts_camp_2, kill_cnts_camp_1, kill_cnts_camp_2))) AS death_info FROM (SELECT battleid, death_time, SIZE(ARRAY_DISTINCT(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS('/', COLLECT_SET(ass_id)), '/'))) /* 参与人数 */ - 1 AS people_cnts_camp_2, SIZE(ARRAY_DISTINCT(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS('/', COLLECT_SET(heroid)), '/'))) - 1 AS people_cnts_camp_1, SIZE(ARRAY_DISTINCT(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS('/', COLLECT_SET(IF(camp = 1, heroid, NULL))), '/'))) /* 我方死亡人数 */ - 1 AS kill_cnts_camp_1, SIZE(ARRAY_DISTINCT(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS('/', COLLECT_SET(IF(camp = 2, ass_id, NULL))), '/'))) - 1 AS kill_cnts_camp_2 FROM (SELECT battleid, camp, ROUND(SPLIT(death_info, ',')[0] / 10, 0) * 10 AS death_time, IF(camp = 2, CONCAT(heroid, '/'), CONCAT_WS('/', SPLIT(death_info, ',')[3], SPLIT(death_info, ',')[4])) AS ass_id, IF(camp = 1, CONCAT(heroid, '/'), CONCAT_WS('/', SPLIT(death_info, ',')[3], SPLIT(death_info, ',')[4])) AS heroid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battle_deathheatmap LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(deathinfo, '\\073')) tbl AS death_info WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND Pvptype IN (1, 2) AND deathinfo <> '') AS a WHERE NOT death_time IS NULL GROUP BY battleid, death_time ORDER BY death_time) AS b GROUP BY battleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_battle_info_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dwm_battle_info_di PARTITION (logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') */ SELECT base.battleid, base.camp, base.battle_end_time, base.heroid, base.battle_time, base.pvptype, base.realpvptype, base.is_wincamp, base.bigranklvl, team.gold, team.`exp` AS exp_col, des_info.destroytowerinfo, team.lordkill, team.turtlekill, death_info_d.death_info, CONCAT_WS(',', early_time, mid_time, late_time, big_late_time, last_time) AS battle_stage_start_time, base.is_valid, des_info.team_dmg_total, des_info.team_hurt_total, des_info.team_atktower_total, des_info.dead_bytower_num, des_info.hurtad_total, des_info.hurtap_total, des_info.injuredad_total, des_info.injuredap_total, des_info.hurtatk_total, des_info.curehero_total, des_info.equip_value_total, des_info.killover_num, des_info.hurtrate, des_info.behurtrate, des_info.fightrate, des_info.item1005_num, des_info.item1105_num, des_info.item1205_num, des_info.pick_hero_list FROM battle_base AS base LEFT JOIN team_info AS team ON base.battleid = team.battleid AND base.camp = team.camp LEFT JOIN destorytowerinfo AS des_info ON base.battleid = des_info.battleid AND base.camp = des_info.camp LEFT JOIN death_info_d ON base.battleid = death_info_d.battleid LEFT JOIN stage_start_info AS s_info ON base.battleid = s_info.battleid
