name: tmp_hero_branch
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_qmzhang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-02-27 12:18:22.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH battle_a AS (SELECT a.logymd, accountid, zoneid, a.battleid, heroid, roadsort, battletype /* 战斗类型 */, CASE WHEN is_invalidbattle = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isinvalidbattle /* 是否流局 */, CASE WHEN minranklevel BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '勇士' WHEN minranklevel BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '精英' WHEN minranklevel BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN '大师' WHEN minranklevel BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '宗师' WHEN minranklevel BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN '史诗' WHEN minranklevel BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN minranklevel = 26 THEN '神话V' WHEN minranklevel = 27 THEN '神话IV' WHEN minranklevel = 28 THEN '神话III' WHEN minranklevel = 29 THEN '神话II' WHEN minranklevel = 30 THEN '神话I' WHEN minranklevel = 31 THEN '荣耀神话' ELSE '无信息' END AS role_ranklvl /* 角色段位 */, CASE WHEN realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90) THEN '真人对局' WHEN realpvptype IN (30, 31, 37, 38, 51, 57, 58, 85, 86, 87, 92, 101, 103) THEN '温暖关' ELSE '其他' END AS real_pvptype /* 真实匹配类型 */ FROM (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata AS t WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND battletype IN (1, 2) AND roadsort IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 101, 105, 3000, 3001, 3002, 3003, 3004, 3005, 3101, 3105) /* 去除脏数据 */ AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT accountid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS b WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND fake_ai <> 0 AND t.accountid = b.accountid AND t.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) /* 排除AI玩家 */) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, battleid, CASE WHEN isinvalidbattle = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_invalidbattle FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) GROUP BY logymd, battleid, is_invalidbattle) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.logymd = b.logymd GROUP BY a.logymd, accountid, zoneid, a.battleid, heroid, roadsort, battletype, isinvalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype), battle_b /* 从battle_end表筛选连表需要的数据（对accountid+zoneid+battleid去重） */ AS (SELECT battleid, CASE WHEN hero_num = 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_repeat_hero, CASE WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '勇士' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '精英' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN '大师' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '宗师' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN '史诗' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN max_minranklvl = 26 THEN '神话V' WHEN max_minranklvl = 27 THEN '神话IV' WHEN max_minranklvl = 28 THEN '神话III' WHEN max_minranklvl = 29 THEN '神话II' WHEN max_minranklvl = 30 THEN '神话I' WHEN max_minranklvl = 31 THEN '荣耀神话' ELSE '无信息' END AS game_ranklvl /* 对局段位 */ FROM (SELECT battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT heroid) AS hero_num, MAX(minranklevel) AS max_minranklvl /* 对局段位 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND battletype IN (1, 2) /* 排位&匹配 */ GROUP BY battleid) AS t GROUP BY battleid, is_repeat_hero, game_ranklvl), hero_config /* 计算对局中不同英雄数量和对局段位 */ AS (SELECT heroid, hero_name /* 英雄中文名称 */, CASE WHEN sub_heroes = -9999 THEN heroes ELSE CONCAT(heroes, '\\073', sub_heroes) END AS heroes /* 英雄职业（主定位+次定位） */ FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2023-01-14', '2023-01-14', '2026-05-31')), branch /* 英雄配置表 */ AS (SELECT logymd, heroid, battletype, isinvalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, is_repeat_hero, COUNT(CASE WHEN roadsort IN (1, 5) THEN 1 END) AS branch_cnt_1 /* 角色使用指定英雄选择金币路的次数 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN roadsort = 2 THEN 1 END) AS branch_cnt_2 /* 角色使用指定英雄选择中路的次数 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN roadsort IN (3, 3000, 3001, 3002, 3003, 3004, 3005, 3101, 3105) THEN 1 END) AS branch_cnt_3 /* 角色使用指定英雄选择游走的次数 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN roadsort = 4 THEN 1 END) AS branch_cnt_4 /* 角色使用指定英雄选择打野的次数 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN roadsort IN (101, 105) THEN 1 END) AS branch_cnt_5 /* 角色使用指定英雄选择经验路的次数 */ FROM battle_a AS a LEFT JOIN battle_b AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY logymd, heroid, battletype, isinvalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, is_repeat_hero), hero_use /* 英雄使用 */ /* 英雄分路选择 */ AS (SELECT logymd, heroid, battletype, isinvalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, is_repeat_hero, COUNT(1) AS hero_battlecnt /* 角色使用指定英雄战斗总次数 */ FROM battle_a AS a LEFT JOIN battle_b AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY logymd, heroid, battletype, isinvalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, is_repeat_hero) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_hero_branch PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.heroid /* a.logymd, */, hero_name, heroes, a.battletype, a.real_pvptype, a.isinvalidbattle, a.role_ranklvl, a.game_ranklvl, a.is_repeat_hero, branch_cnt_1, branch_cnt_2, branch_cnt_3, branch_cnt_4, branch_cnt_5, hero_battlecnt /* 角色使用指定英雄战斗总次数 */ FROM branch AS a LEFT JOIN hero_use AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.heroid = b.heroid AND a.battletype = b.battletype AND a.isinvalidbattle = b.isinvalidbattle AND a.role_ranklvl = b.role_ranklvl AND a.real_pvptype = b.real_pvptype AND a.game_ranklvl = b.game_ranklvl AND a.is_repeat_hero = b.is_repeat_hero LEFT JOIN hero_config AS c ON a.heroid = c.heroid

name: adbi.dwm_sdk_pay_user_df
sql_units: WITH role_pay_di AS (SELECT pay_di.app_id, pay_di.accountid, pay_di.zoneid, pay_di.area, pay_di.day_first_device_id, pay_di.day_first_pay_time, pay_di.day_last_device_id, pay_di.day_last_pay_time, pay_di.day_pay_cnt, pay_di.day_pay_amt, pay_di.day_actual_pay_amt, pay_di.day_product_money, p_date FROM (SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_sdk_pay_user_di)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31') AS pay_di), pay_df AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, area, his_first_device_id, his_first_pay_time, his_first_pay_date, his_last_device_id, his_last_pay_time, his_last_pay_date, pay_info, count_info_str, amount_info_str, total_pay_cnt, total_pay_amt, actual_amount_info_str, total_actual_pay_amt, product_money_info_str, app_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_sdk_pay_user_df_in)) WHERE p_date = DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_sdk_pay_user_df_out)) SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, NULL AS os_type, NULL AS os, NULL AS channel, NULL AS pay_channel, a.area, NULL AS adjust_country, NULL AS adjust_network_name, NULL AS adjust_os_type, NULL AS adjust_os, NULL AS adjust_id, his_first_device_id, his_first_pay_time, his_first_pay_date, his_last_device_id, his_last_pay_time, his_last_pay_date, NULL AS create_time, NULL AS create_date, NULL AS level, NULL AS level_info_str, pay_info, count_info AS count_info_str, amount_info AS amount_info_str, NULL AS amount_new_info_str, total_pay_cnt, total_pay_amt, 0 AS total_pay_amt_new, NULL AS purchase_type, actual_amount_info_str AS actual_amount_info_str, total_actual_pay_amt AS total_actual_pay_amt, product_money_info AS product_money_info_str, a.app_id FROM (SELECT COALESCE(pay_df.accountid, role_pay_di.accountid) AS accountid, COALESCE(pay_df.zoneid, role_pay_di.zoneid) AS zoneid, IF(NOT pay_df.accountid IS NULL, pay_df.area, role_pay_di.area) AS area, IF(NOT pay_df.accountid IS NULL, pay_df.his_first_device_id, role_pay_di.day_first_device_id) AS his_first_device_id, IF(NOT role_pay_di.accountid IS NULL, role_pay_di.day_last_device_id, pay_df.his_last_device_id) AS his_last_device_id, IF(NOT pay_df.accountid IS NULL, pay_df.his_first_pay_time, role_pay_di.day_first_pay_time) AS his_first_pay_time, IF(NOT pay_df.accountid IS NULL, pay_df.his_first_pay_date, role_pay_di.p_date) AS his_first_pay_date, IF(NOT role_pay_di.accountid IS NULL, role_pay_di.day_last_pay_time, pay_df.his_last_pay_time) AS his_last_pay_time, IF(NOT role_pay_di.accountid IS NULL, role_pay_di.p_date, pay_df.his_last_pay_date) AS his_last_pay_date, IF(NOT role_pay_di.accountid IS NULL, CONCAT('1', COALESCE(pay_df.pay_info, '')), CONCAT('0', pay_df.pay_info)) AS pay_info, IF(NOT pay_df.accountid IS NULL, CONCAT_WS(',', CAST(COALESCE(role_pay_di.day_pay_cnt, 0) + BIGINT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pay_df.count_info_str, ',', 1)) AS STRING), pay_df.count_info_str), CAST(role_pay_di.day_pay_cnt AS STRING)) AS count_info, IF(NOT pay_df.accountid IS NULL, CONCAT_WS(',', FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', COALESCE(role_pay_di.day_pay_amt, 0) + DOUBLE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pay_df.amount_info_str, ',', 1))), pay_df.amount_info_str), FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', role_pay_di.day_pay_amt)) AS amount_info, IF(NOT pay_df.accountid IS NULL, CONCAT_WS(',', FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', COALESCE(role_pay_di.day_actual_pay_amt, 0) + DOUBLE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pay_df.actual_amount_info_str, ',', 1))), pay_df.actual_amount_info_str), FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', role_pay_di.day_actual_pay_amt)) AS actual_amount_info_str, BIGINT(COALESCE(role_pay_di.day_pay_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(pay_df.total_pay_cnt, 0)) AS total_pay_cnt, DOUBLE(FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', COALESCE(role_pay_di.day_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(pay_df.total_pay_amt, 0))) AS total_pay_amt /* , role_pay_di.p_date */, DOUBLE(FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', COALESCE(role_pay_di.day_actual_pay_amt, 0.0) + COALESCE(pay_df.total_actual_pay_amt, 0.0))) AS total_actual_pay_amt, IF(COALESCE(pay_df.app_id, role_pay_di.app_id) <> '1001', NULL, IF(NOT pay_df.accountid IS NULL, CONCAT_WS(',', CAST(COALESCE(role_pay_di.day_product_money, 0) + BIGINT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pay_df.product_money_info_str, ',', 1)) AS STRING), pay_df.product_money_info_str), CAST(role_pay_di.day_product_money AS STRING))) AS product_money_info, COALESCE(pay_df.app_id, role_pay_di.app_id) AS app_id FROM pay_df FULL JOIN role_pay_di ON pay_df.app_id = role_pay_di.app_id AND pay_df.accountid = role_pay_di.accountid) AS a DISTRIBUTE BY ABS(HASH(accountid, app_id) % IF(app_id = '1001', 200, 20))

name: adbi.dwm_sdk_account_create_user_df
sql_units: /* 通过accountcreate_di获取每天新增的创角账号 */ /* ods的创角表每天每个项目每个账号只会出现一次 */ WITH accontcreate_di AS (SELECT CAST(accountid AS STRING) AS atid, account_name AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 10) AS create_date, app, os_type, MAPPING('os_name', '1001', os_type) AS os, gps_adid, android_id, gps_asid, idfa, idfv, channel, os_version, '1001' AS app_id, 'unknown' AS ip_country, 'unknown' AS ip_state, 'unknown' AS ip_city, NULL AS pc_device, CASE WHEN os_build LIKE '%AP1%' AND logymd BETWEEN '2025-03-18' AND '2025-04-30' THEN 1 /* 这种情况下，账号对应的设备均为异常新增设备 */ WHEN logymd >= '2025-10-22' AND (os_build LIKE '%AP1%' OR (os_build IS NULL AND (device_name IN ('OnePlus 11', 'Galaxy S21', 'Redmi Note 12') OR app_click_id IN ('56', '185')))) THEN 1 /* 这种情况下，设备的异常情况与首次设备出现的异常情况一致 */ ELSE 0 END AS is_error FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(accountid AS STRING) AS atid, account_name AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 10) AS create_date, app, os_type, MAPPING('os_name', '2001', os_type) AS os, gps_adid, android_id, gps_asid, idfa, idfv, channel, os_version, '2001' AS app_id, 'unknown' AS ip_country, 'unknown' AS ip_state, 'unknown' AS ip_city, NULL AS pc_device, 0 AS is_error FROM mh_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT a.atid, a.device_id, a.create_time, a.create_date, a.app, a.os_type, a.os, a.gps_adid, a.android_id, a.gps_asid, a.idfa, a.idfv, a.channel, a.os_version, a.app_id, IF(TRIM(a.ip_parse[0]) IN ('-'), 'unknown', TRIM(a.ip_parse[0])) AS ip_country, IF(TRIM(a.ip_parse[1]) IN ('-'), 'unknown', TRIM(a.ip_parse[1])) AS ip_state, IF(TRIM(a.ip_parse[2]) IN ('-'), 'unknown', TRIM(a.ip_parse[2])) AS ip_city, pc_device, 0 AS is_error FROM (SELECT CAST(accountid AS STRING) AS atid, account_name AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 10) AS create_date, app, os_type, MAPPING('os_name', '3001', os_type) AS os, gps_adid, android_id, gps_asid, idfa, idfv, NULL AS channel, NULL AS os_version, '3001' AS app_id, SPLIT(GEOIP(ip, 3, SUBSTRING('20260430', 0, 6)), '/') AS ip_parse, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(pc_device), '') = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(pc_device)) IN ('unknown', 'none', 'null'), 'unknown', MD5(TRIM(pc_device))) AS pc_device FROM zgame_damai_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ('2026-05-31' >= '2023-09-07' OR '2026-05-31' <= '2023-07-16') UNION ALL SELECT x.atid, x.device_id, x.create_time, x.create_date, x.app, x.os_type, x.os, x.gps_adid, x.android_id, x.gps_asid, CASE WHEN NOT y.idfa IS NULL THEN y.idfa ELSE x.idfa END AS idfa, CASE WHEN NOT y.idfv IS NULL THEN y.idfv ELSE x.idfv END AS idfv, x.channel, x.os_version, x.app_id, x.ip_parse, pc_device FROM (SELECT CAST(accountid AS STRING) AS atid, account_name AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 10) AS create_date, app, os_type, MAPPING('os_name', '3001', os_type) AS os, gps_adid, android_id, gps_asid, idfa, idfv, NULL AS channel, NULL AS os_version, '3001' AS app_id, SPLIT(GEOIP(ip, 3, SUBSTRING('20260430', 0, 6)), '/') AS ip_parse, NULL AS pc_device FROM zgame_damai_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd < '2023-09-07' AND logymd > '2023-07-16') AS x LEFT JOIN (SELECT deviceid, MIN(CASE WHEN idfa IN ('', 'null', 'none', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') THEN NULL ELSE idfa END) AS idfa, MIN(CASE WHEN x.rn = 1 THEN idfv ELSE NULL END) AS idfv FROM (SELECT deviceid, idfa, idfv, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY deviceid ORDER BY time ASC) AS rn FROM zgame_damai_ods.watcherofrealms_event WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND os_type = 1 AND event = '__install_event__') AS x GROUP BY x.deviceid) AS y ON SUBSTRING(x.device_id, 5) = y.deviceid AND x.os_type = 1) AS a), login_and_charge_di AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.device_id, a.create_time, a.create_date, a.app, a.os_type, a.os, a.gps_adid, a.android_id, a.gps_asid, a.idfa, a.idfv, a.channel, a.os_version, a.app_id, IF(TRIM(a.ip_parse[0]) IN ('-'), 'unknown', TRIM(a.ip_parse[0])) AS ip_country, IF(TRIM(a.ip_parse[1]) IN ('-'), 'unknown', TRIM(a.ip_parse[1])) AS ip_state, IF(TRIM(a.ip_parse[2]) IN ('-'), 'unknown', TRIM(a.ip_parse[2])) AS ip_city, NULL AS pc_device FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, deviceid AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 10) AS create_date, 'MOBA' AS app, os_type, MAPPING('os_name', '1001', os_type) AS os, ad_id AS gps_adid, android_id, gps_asid, idfa, idfv, channel, os_version, '1001' AS app_id, SPLIT(GEOIP(client_ip, 3, SUBSTRING('20260430', 0, 6)), '/') AS ip_parse FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.reconn = 0 AND COALESCE(TRIM(deviceid), '') <> '' UNION ALL SELECT roleid AS accountid, device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 10) AS create_date, 'MOBA' AS app, os_type, MAPPING('os_name', '1001', os_type) AS os, gps_adid, android_id, gps_asid, idfa, idfv, channel, NULL AS os_version, '1001' AS app_id, SPLIT(GEOIP(client_ip, 3, SUBSTRING('20260430', 0, 6)), '/') AS ip_parse FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_id), '') <> '') AS a UNION ALL SELECT roleid AS accountid, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(device_account_name), '') <> '', device_account_name, device_id) AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 10) AS create_date, 'IDLE' AS app, os_type, MAPPING('os_name', '2001', os_type) AS os, NULL AS gps_adid, NULL AS android_id, NULL AS gps_asid, idfa, NULL AS idfv, channel, client_version AS os_version, '2001' AS app_id, 'unknown' AS ip_country, 'unknown' AS ip_state, 'unknown' AS ip_city, NULL AS pc_device FROM mh_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND reconn = 0 AND ((NOT device_account_name IS NULL AND TRIM(device_account_name) <> '') OR (NOT device_id IS NULL AND TRIM(device_id) <> '')) UNION ALL SELECT roleid AS accountid, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(device_account_name), '') <> '', device_account_name, device_id) AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 10) AS create_date, 'IDLE' AS app, os_type, MAPPING('os_name', '2001', os_type) AS os, gps_adid, android_id, gps_asid, idfa, idfv, channel, NULL AS os_version, '2001' AS app_id, 'unknown' AS ip_country, 'unknown' AS ip_state, 'unknown' AS ip_city, NULL AS pc_device FROM mh_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((NOT device_account_name IS NULL AND TRIM(device_account_name) <> '') OR (NOT device_id IS NULL AND TRIM(device_id) <> '')) UNION ALL SELECT a.accountid, a.device_id, a.create_time, a.create_date, a.app, a.os_type, a.os, a.gps_adid, a.android_id, a.gps_asid, a.idfa, a.idfv, a.channel, a.os_version, a.app_id, IF(TRIM(a.ip_parse[0]) IN ('-'), 'unknown', TRIM(a.ip_parse[0])) AS ip_country, IF(TRIM(a.ip_parse[1]) IN ('-'), 'unknown', TRIM(a.ip_parse[1])) AS ip_state, IF(TRIM(a.ip_parse[2]) IN ('-'), 'unknown', TRIM(a.ip_parse[2])) AS ip_city, pc_device FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 10) AS create_date, 'ZG' AS app, os_type, MAPPING('os_name', '3001', os_type) AS os, gps_adid, android_id, NULL AS gps_asid, idfa, NULL AS idfv, NULL AS channel, NULL AS os_version, '3001' AS app_id, SPLIT(GEOIP(ip, 3, SUBSTRING('20260430', 0, 6)), '/') AS ip_parse, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(pc_device), '') = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(pc_device)) IN ('unknown', 'none', 'null'), 'unknown', MD5(TRIM(pc_device))) AS pc_device FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.reconn = 0 AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_id), '') <> '' UNION ALL SELECT roleid AS accountid, device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, SUBSTRING(CAST(`time` AS STRING), 1, 10) AS create_date, 'ZG' AS app, os_type, MAPPING('os_name', '3001', os_type) AS os, gps_adid, android_id, gps_asid, idfa, idfv, NULL AS channel, NULL AS os_version, '3001' AS app_id, SPLIT(GEOIP(ip, 3, SUBSTRING('20260430', 0, 6)), '/') AS ip_parse, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(pc_device), '') = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(pc_device)) IN ('unknown', 'none', 'null'), 'unknown', MD5(TRIM(pc_device))) AS pc_device FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_id), '') <> '') AS a), log_di AS (SELECT atid, day_first_device_id, create_time, create_date, app, os_type, os, gps_adid, android_id, gps_asid, idfa, idfv, channel, os_version, app_id, CASE WHEN app_id = '1001' THEN first_ip_country ELSE ip_country END AS ip_country /* 1001取首个登陆或者支付数据的ip, 其他项目(3001)仍然取当前日志中的ip */, CASE WHEN app_id = '1001' THEN first_ip_state ELSE ip_state END AS ip_state, CASE WHEN app_id = '1001' THEN first_ip_city ELSE ip_city END AS ip_city, pc_device, is_error FROM (SELECT atid, device_id AS day_first_device_id, create_time, create_date, app, os_type, os, gps_adid, android_id, gps_asid, idfa, idfv, channel, os_version, app_id, ip_country, ip_state, ip_city, FIRST_VALUE(ip_country) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, atid ORDER BY pri) AS first_ip_country, FIRST_VALUE(ip_state) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, atid ORDER BY pri) AS first_ip_state, FIRST_VALUE(ip_city) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, atid ORDER BY pri) AS first_ip_city, pc_device, is_error, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, atid ORDER BY source_pri, COALESCE(CAST(create_time AS STRING), '9999-12-31')) AS rn /* 当前新增账号优先取创角数据 */ FROM (SELECT atid, TRIM(device_id) AS device_id, create_time, create_date, app, os_type, os, TRIM(gps_adid) AS gps_adid, TRIM(android_id) AS android_id, TRIM(gps_asid) AS gps_asid, TRIM(idfa) AS idfa, TRIM(idfv) AS idfv, channel, os_version, app_id, ip_country, ip_state, ip_city, pc_device, is_error, '9999' AS pri, '1' AS source_pri FROM accontcreate_di UNION ALL SELECT accountid, TRIM(device_id) AS device_id, create_time, create_date, app, os_type, os, TRIM(gps_adid) AS gps_adid, TRIM(android_id) AS android_id, TRIM(gps_asid) AS gps_asid, TRIM(idfa) AS idfa, TRIM(idfv) AS idfv, channel, os_version, app_id, ip_country, ip_state, ip_city, pc_device, 0 AS is_error, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, accountid ORDER BY COALESCE(CAST(create_time AS STRING), '9999-12-31')) AS pri /* 1001的创角日志没有ip字段, 这里采用登陆和支付的首次ip */, '2' AS source_pri FROM login_and_charge_di)) WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_sdk_account_create_user_df_out)) SELECT IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.accountid, di.atid) AS accountid, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.his_first_device_id, di.day_first_device_id) AS his_first_device_id, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.create_time, di.create_time) AS create_time, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.create_date, di.create_date) AS create_date, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.os_type, di.os_type) AS os_type, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.os, di.os) AS os, NULL AS country, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.channel, di.channel) AS channel, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.app, di.app) AS app, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, 0, 1) AS is_new, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.idfa, di.idfa) AS idfa, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.idfv, di.idfv) AS idfv, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.gps_adid, di.gps_adid) AS gps_adid, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.android_id, di.android_id) AS android_id, NULL AS cpu_type, NULL AS device_manufacturer, NULL AS device_name, NULL AS device_type, NULL AS mcc, NULL AS mnc, NULL AS network_type, NULL AS language, NULL AS os_build, NULL AS os_name, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.os_version, di.os_version) AS os_version, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.ip_country, di.ip_country) AS ip_country, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.ip_state, di.ip_state) AS ip_state, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.ip_city, di.ip_city) AS ip_city, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.is_ai, di.is_ai) AS is_ai, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.pc_device, di.pc_device) AS pc_device, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.is_error, di.is_error) AS is_error, IF(NOT df.accountid IS NULL, df.gps_asid, di.gps_asid) AS gps_asid, COALESCE(df.app_id, di.app_id) AS app_id FROM (SELECT x.*, CASE WHEN (x.create_date >= '2023-08-22' AND x.channel = 'and_gmfake' AND x.app_id = '1001') OR (x.create_date < '2023-08-22' AND NOT y.roleid IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_ai FROM log_di AS x LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd < '2023-08-22' /* 20230822后换用新的逻辑判断AI，之前还是使用老逻辑 */ AND register_date = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai IN ('2', '1')) AS y ON x.app_id = '1001' AND x.atid = y.roleid) AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_sdk_account_create_user_df_in)) WHERE p_date = DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1)) AS df ON di.app_id = df.app_id AND di.atid = df.accountid

name: adbi.dim_adjust_attribution_di

COALESCE(TRIM(a.country), 'unknown') AS country, IF(LOWER(a.network_name) = 'organic', 'Organic', REPLACE(TRIM(a.network_name), '%20', ' ')) AS network_name, CASE WHEN LOWER(a.network_name) LIKE '%applovin%' THEN IF(a.campaign_name RLIKE '^[a-z0-9]{32}$', a.campaign_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.campaign_name, '.*?\\\\(([a-z0-9]+)\\\\)')) WHEN LOWER(a.network_name) LIKE '%unity%' THEN IF(a.campaign_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', a.campaign_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.campaign_name, '.*?\\\\(([a-z0-9]+)\\\\)')) WHEN a.network_name = 'Snapchat Installs' THEN IF(a.campaign_name RLIKE '^[a-z0-9-]+$', a.campaign_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.campaign_name, '.*?\\\\(([a-z0-9-]+)\\\\)')) ELSE IF(a.campaign_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', a.campaign_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.campaign_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS campaign_id, CASE WHEN a.network_name = 'Snapchat Installs' THEN IF(a.adgroup_name RLIKE '^[a-z0-9-]+$', a.adgroup_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.adgroup_name, '.*?\\\\(([a-z0-9-]+)\\\\)')) ELSE IF(a.adgroup_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', a.adgroup_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.adgroup_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS adgroup_id, CASE WHEN a.network_name = 'Snapchat Installs' THEN IF(a.creative RLIKE '^[a-z0-9-]+$', a.creative, REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.creative, '.*?\\\\(([a-z0-9-]+)\\\\)')) WHEN LOWER(a.network_name) LIKE '%unity%' THEN IF(a.creative RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', a.creative, REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.creative, '.*?\\\\(([a-z0-9]+)\\\\)')) ELSE IF(a.creative RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', a.creative, REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.creative, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS creative_id, CASE WHEN LOWER(a.network_name) LIKE '%applovin%' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\(([a-z0-9]+)\\\\)')) WHEN LOWER(a.network_name) LIKE '%unity%' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\(([a-z0-9]+)\\\\)')) WHEN a.network_name = 'Snapchat Installs' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\(([a-z0-9-]+)\\\\)')) ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN a.network_name = 'Snapchat Installs' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.adgroup_name, '(.*?)\\\\(([a-z0-9-]+)\\\\)')) ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.adgroup_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS adgroup_name, CASE WHEN a.network_name = 'Snapchat Installs' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.creative, '(.*?)\\\\(([a-z0-9-]+)\\\\)')) WHEN LOWER(a.network_name) LIKE '%unity%' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.creative, '(.*?)\\\\(([a-z0-9]+)\\\\)')) ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.creative, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS creative_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(google_adid), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(google_adid)) AS google_adid, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(android_id), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(android_id)) AS android_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ios_idfa), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(ios_idfa)) AS ios_idfa, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(idfv), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(idfv)) AS idfv, google_adid AS gpid, android_id AS andid, ios_idfa AS ia, idfv AS iv, a.report_type, a.report_type_rn, a.event_logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.app_id, a.adjust_adid ORDER BY report_type_rn, `time`) AS rn FROM (SELECT '1001' AS app_id, roleid, TRIM(adjust_adid) AS ajid, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_adid), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(adjust_adid)) AS adjust_adid, os_type, country, network_name, campaign_name, adgroup_name, creative, TRIM(google_adid) AS google_adid, TRIM(android_id) AS android_id, TRIM(ios_idfa) AS ios_idfa, TRIM(idfv) AS idfv, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS `time`, report_type, CASE WHEN report_type = 'Attribution' THEN '1' WHEN report_type = 'Event' THEN '2' WHEN report_type = 'Session' THEN '3' ELSE CONCAT('4', '-', COALESCE(TRIM(report_type), 'zzzzz')) END AS report_type_rn, logymd AS event_logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_adjust_callback WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT '2001' AS app_id, roleid, TRIM(adjust_adid) AS ajid, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_adid), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 10000) AS STRING), TRIM(adjust_adid)) AS adjust_adid, os_type, country, network_name, campaign_name, adgroup_name, creative, TRIM(google_adid) AS google_adid, TRIM(android_id) AS android_id, TRIM(ios_idfa) AS ios_idfa, 'unknown' AS idfv, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS `time`, report_type, CASE WHEN report_type = 'Attribution' THEN '1' WHEN report_type = 'Event' THEN '2' WHEN report_type = 'Session' THEN '3' ELSE CONCAT('4', '-', COALESCE(TRIM(report_type), 'zzzzz')) END AS report_type_rn, logymd AS event_logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_adjust_callback WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT '3001' AS app_id, roleid, TRIM(SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_desc, 'adid=(.*)'), '&')[0]) AS ajid, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_desc, 'adid=(.*)'), '&')[0]), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 1000) AS STRING), TRIM(SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_desc, 'adid=(.*)'), '&')[0])) AS adjust_adid, os_type, country, SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_desc, 'network=(.*)'), '&')[0] AS network_name, SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_desc, 'campaign=(.*)'), '&')[0] AS campaign_name, SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_desc, 'adgroup=(.*)'), '&')[0] AS adgroup_name, SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_desc, 'creative=(.*)'), '&')[0] AS creative, TRIM(gps_adid) AS google_adid, TRIM(android_id) AS android_id, TRIM(idfa) AS ios_idfa, TRIM(idfv) AS idfv, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS `time`, SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_desc, 'callbackEvent=(.*)'), '&')[0] AS report_type, CASE WHEN SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_desc, 'callbackEvent=(.*)'), '&')[0] = 'onAttributionChanged' THEN '1' WHEN SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_desc, 'callbackEvent=(.*)'), '&')[0] = 'onEventTrackingSucceeded' THEN '2' WHEN SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_desc, 'callbackEvent=(.*)'), '&')[0] = 'onSessionTrackingSucceeded' THEN '3' END AS report_type_rn, logymd AS event_logymd FROM adbi.trackserver_event WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((appid = 'watcherofrealms' AND event = '__adjust_callback__') OR (logymd >= '2023-11-23' AND appid = 'watcherofrealms_ap' AND event = '__adjust_callback__')) AND SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_desc, 'callbackEvent=(.*)'), '&')[0] IN ('onAttributionChanged', 'onEventTrackingSucceeded', 'onSessionTrackingSucceeded')) AS a) AS b WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(b.adjust_adid), '') = '' OR b.rn = 1), tmp_adjust_join AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, idfa ORDER BY IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') = '', 1, 0), report_type_rn, `time`) AS idfa_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, idfv ORDER BY IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') = '', 1, 0), report_type_rn, `time`) AS idfv_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, gps_adid ORDER BY IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') = '', 1, 0), report_type_rn, `time`) AS gps_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, android_id ORDER BY IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') = '', 1, 0), report_type_rn, `time`) AS android_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, roleid ORDER BY IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') = '', 1, 0), report_type_rn, `time`) AS role_rn FROM (SELECT a.app_id, a.adjust_adid AS adjust_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.network_name, a.network_name) AS network_name, a.roleid, a.`time`, a.os_type, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.country, a.country) AS country, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.campaign_id, a.campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.campaign_name, a.campaign_name) AS campaign_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.adgroup_id, a.adgroup_id) AS adgroup_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.adgroup_name, a.adgroup_name) AS adgroup_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.creative_id, a.creative_id) AS creative_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.creative_name, a.creative_name) AS creative_name, a.google_adid AS gps_adid, a.android_id, a.ios_idfa AS idfa, a.idfv, a.gpid, a.andid, a.ia, a.iv, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', 'ic', 'c') AS data_source, a.report_type, a.report_type_rn, a.event_logymd FROM tmp_attri AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, adjust_id, country, network_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_id, adgroup_name, creative_id, creative_name FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_msdk_install_di)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND adjust_rn = 1 AND COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') <> '') AS b ON a.adjust_adid = b.adjust_id AND a.app_id = b.app_id) AS c) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_adjust_attribution_di)) SELECT adjust_id, CAST(roleid AS STRING) AS roleid, data_source, `time`, os_type, IF(country = '', NULL, country) AS country, IF(network_name = '', NULL, network_name) AS network_name, IF(campaign_id = '', NULL, campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(campaign_name = '', NULL, campaign_name) AS campaign_name, IF(adgroup_id = '', NULL, adgroup_id) AS adgroup_id, IF(adgroup_name = '', NULL, adgroup_name) AS adgroup_name, IF(creative_id = '', NULL, creative_id) AS creative_id, IF(creative_name = '', NULL, creative_name) AS creative_name, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, report_type, idfa_rn, idfv_rn, gps_rn, android_rn, role_rn, event_logymd, app_id FROM (SELECT adjust_id, roleid, data_source, `time`, os_type, country, network_name, TRIM(campaign_id) AS campaign_id, TRIM(campaign_name) AS campaign_name, TRIM(adgroup_id) AS adgroup_id, TRIM(adgroup_name) AS adgroup_name, TRIM(creative_id) AS creative_id, TRIM(creative_name) AS creative_name, gpid AS gps_adid, andid AS android_id, ia AS idfa, iv AS idfv, report_type, idfa_rn, idfv_rn, gps_rn, android_rn, role_rn, event_logymd, app_id FROM tmp_adjust_join) AS a

name: etl.mdsk_dw_pre.dwd_event_log_detail_di
sql_units: WITH event_log /* AND lower(`environment`) in ( {{EVN_LIST}} )  ---只要是一一拳回来的数据，都是线上真是数据，需要纳入报表计算的 */ AS (SELECT COALESCE(TRIM(did), 'unknown') AS did /* --理论上是不会出现空值的情况 */, `event`, event_desc /* --JSON格式化判断，暂时不需要处理，目前就是一个string, 目前更多需要关注事件本身      */, client_ip, COALESCE(IF(TRIM((GEOIP(client_ip, 1))) = '-', NULL, LOWER(GEOIP(client_ip, 1))), 'unknown') AS ip_country, COALESCE(event_time, 0) AS event_time /* 如果为空默认为1970-01-01T00:00:00，条件中已经过滤     */, COALESCE(server_time, 0) AS server_time, COALESCE(event_uuid, 'unknown') AS event_uuid, TRIM(COALESCE(install_uuid, 'unknown')) AS install_uuid /* --服务器回传的是字符串 */, TRIM(COALESCE(session_uuid, 'unknown')) AS session_uuid /* --服务器回传的是字符串 */, COALESCE(zone_offset, 0) AS zone_offset /* --统一默认为UTC+0 */, event_source, COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(os)), 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(TRIM(os_version), 'unknown') AS os_version, LOWER(COALESCE(TRIM(system_language), 'unknown')) AS system_language, COALESCE(TRIM(manufacturer), 'unknown') AS manufacturer, COALESCE(TRIM(brand), 'unknown') AS brand, COALESCE(TRIM(model), 'unknown') AS model, COALESCE(screen_height, 0) AS screen_height, COALESCE(screen_width, 0) AS screen_width, COALESCE(system_memory, 0) AS system_memory, COALESCE(system_disk, 0) AS system_disk, COALESCE(cpu_type, 'unknown') AS cpu_type, COALESCE(cpu_cores, 0) AS cpu_cores, LOWER(COALESCE(network_type, 'unknown')) AS network_type, COALESCE(TRIM(carrier), 'unknown') AS carrier, COALESCE(TRIM(idfa), 'unknown') AS idfa, COALESCE(TRIM(idfv), 'unknown') AS idfv, COALESCE(TRIM(android_id), 'unknown') AS android_id, COALESCE(TRIM(imei), 'unknown') AS imei, COALESCE(TRIM(build_serial), 'unknown') AS build_serial, COALESCE(TRIM(mac), 'unknown') AS mac, COALESCE(TRIM(gps_adid), 'unknown') AS gps_adid, COALESCE(TRIM(gps_asid), 'unknown') AS gps_asid, COALESCE(TRIM(oaid), 'unknown') AS oaid, COALESCE(TRIM(firebase_instance_id), 'unknown') AS firebase_instance_id, COALESCE(is_emulator, -1) AS is_emulator, COALESCE(app_name, 'unknown') AS app_name, COALESCE(app_version, 'unknown') AS app_version, LOWER(TRIM(package_name)) AS package_name, COALESCE(client_version, 'unknown') AS client_version, sdk_version, account_id, role_id, zone_id, COALESCE(level, 0) AS level, COALESCE(user_create_time, 0) AS user_create_time, COALESCE(current_diamond, 0) AS current_diamond, COALESCE(store, 'unknown') AS store, COALESCE(game_language, 'unknown') AS game_language, `environment`, app_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_uuid ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS row_num FROM msdk_ods_test.msdk_event WHERE ((logymd = '20260530' AND `hour` >= '23') /* -eg 2022-05-01号的eventtime数据会在server_time:[2022-04-30 23:00 2022-05-02 02:00]区间获取 */ OR (logymd = '20260531') OR (logymd = '20260601' AND `hour` <= '02')) AND DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8')) = DATE('2026-05-31') AND (NOT `event` IS NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(`event`)) > 1) /* event不需要为空字符或为空, 理论上在msdk上报的时候控制好了的 */ AND (NOT event_source IS NULL) /* --事件上报来源, NULL默认为未知上报 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dw_pre.dwd_event_log_detail_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT did, `event`, event_desc, client_ip, ip_country, event_time, server_time, event_uuid, install_uuid, session_uuid, zone_offset, event_source, os, os_version, system_language, manufacturer, brand, model, screen_height, screen_width, system_memory, system_disk, cpu_type, cpu_cores, network_type, REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(carrier, '\n', ''), '\r', '') AS carrier, idfa, idfv, android_id, imei, build_serial, mac, gps_adid, gps_asid, oaid, firebase_instance_id, is_emulator, app_name, app_version, package_name, client_version, sdk_version, account_id, role_id, zone_id, level, user_create_time, current_diamond, store, game_language, environment, app_id FROM event_log WHERE row_num = 1 AND environment = 'pre' DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: export_bytedance.gameserver_login_deviceidunique_id
sql_units: /* set spark.sql.shuffle.partitionSize=1024*1024; */ WITH white_role_list AS (SELECT adv_us.us_accountid FROM (SELECT accountid AS us_accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM ml_temp.yudongzhang_tmp_role_infos_02 WHERE logymd = '2026-01-13' AND info_type LIKE 'final_90d_notUSplayer_OhtermajorArea_%' GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 ON t1.roleid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE t1.roleid IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.dwd_gameserver_login_deviceuique_id PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, main_data.roleid, main_data.zoneid, MD5(deviceid) AS deviceid, IF(deviceid RLIKE '^ios.*', NULL, MD5(SUBSTRING(deviceid, 1, 36))) AS deviceunique_id, IF(deviceid RLIKE '^ios.*', NULL, MD5(android_id)) AS android_id, IF(deviceid RLIKE '^ios.*', NULL, MD5(ad_id)) AS ad_id, t2.accountid AS mt_id, t2.pre_accountid AS pre_mt_id, t2.app_id AS appid, os_type, MD5(idfa) FROM (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, deviceid, android_id, ad_id, os_type, idfa FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(client_ip, 1), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS main_data LEFT JOIN white_role_list AS adv_us ON main_data.roleid = adv_us.us_accountid LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, app_role_id, app_zone_id, accountid, pre_accountid FROM mtpass_ods.roleserver_mt_pass_on_bind WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND app_id = 666) AS t2 ON main_data.roleid = t2.app_role_id AND main_data.zoneid = t2.app_zone_id WHERE adv_us.us_accountid IS NULL

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_finance_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: hengweiyan@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-03-30 14:54:03.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH currency_exchange AS (SELECT currency, AVG(exchange_rate) AS exchange_rate FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_exchange_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-30' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY currency) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_finance_role_zone_di PARTITION(appid, logymd) SELECT roleid, zoneid, t1.first_mt_country, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, bill_country, currency, his_first_pay_date, product_money, pay_amt, pay_usd_amt, before_tax_amt, before_tax_usd_amt, after_tax_amt, after_tax_usd_amt, tax_amt, tax_usd_amt, back_tax_amt, back_tax_usd_amt, share_amt, share_usd_amt, fee_amt, fee_usd_amt, pay_net_receipts_amt, pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, pay_cnt, get_diamond, 'ml' AS appid, logymd FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, bill_country, currency, MIN(his_first_pay_date) AS his_first_pay_date, COALESCE(SUM(product_money), 0) AS product_money, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt), 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_usd_amt), 0) AS pay_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(before_tax_amt), 0) AS before_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(before_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS before_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_amt), 0) AS after_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS after_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(tax_amt), 0) AS tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(tax_usd_amt), 0) AS tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(back_tax_amt), 0) AS back_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(back_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS back_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(share_amt), 0) AS share_amt, COALESCE(SUM(share_usd_amt), 0) AS share_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(fee_amt), 0) AS fee_amt /* 不使用渠道手续费币种,转换为支付币种 */, COALESCE(SUM(fee_usd_amt), 0) AS fee_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_net_receipts_amt), 0) AS pay_net_receipts_amt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt), 0) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_cnt), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(get_diamond), 0) AS get_diamond, logymd FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.first_mt_country, a.pay_channel, a.sub_pay_channel, a.country AS bill_country, a.currency, a.product_money, a.pay_amt, a.pay_usd_amt, a.before_tax_amt, a.before_tax_usd_amt, a.after_tax_amt, a.after_tax_usd_amt, a.tax_amt, a.tax_usd_amt, a.back_tax_amt, a.back_tax_usd_amt, a.share_amt, a.share_usd_amt, a.fee_usd_amt, a.pay_net_receipts_amt, a.pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, a.pay_cnt, a.get_diamond, a.logymd, DATE_FORMAT(c.his_first_pay_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS his_first_pay_date, CASE WHEN a.fee_currency = 'USD' THEN 1 WHEN d.exchange_rate IS NULL AND a.fee_currency = 'BAM' THEN 1 / 0.558454 WHEN d.exchange_rate IS NULL AND a.fee_currency = 'SLE' THEN 1 / 0.046681 WHEN d.exchange_rate IS NULL AND a.fee_currency = 'HKR' THEN 1 / 0.143622 ELSE d.exchange_rate END * a.fee_usd_amt AS fee_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di AS a LEFT JOIN currency_exchange AS d ON a.fee_currency = d.currency LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS b ON b.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND b.appid = 'mlbb' AND a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid /* LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df b */ /* ON b.logymd = '{DATE}' AND b.appid = 'mlbb' AND a.roleid = b.accountid */ LEFT JOIN mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df AS c ON c.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.pay_channel = c.pay_channel AND a.sub_pay_channel = c.sub_pay_channel AND a.country = c.country AND a.currency = c.currency AND a.fee_currency = c.his_fee_currency WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.pay_amt > 0) AS z GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, bill_country, currency) AS t1

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_autochessai_battle_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: yukiyi@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-07-06 15:29:20.000 */ /* Description: */ /* -- 需求文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/WqtLdLTtRooFVzx7gqociISfnuh */ /* -- 自测文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/YOTsdPHCuo7WQzxqgftcUNOBn0I */ /* ---- Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mt_dwd`.`dwd_autochessai_battle_di` ( */ /*             `roleid` DECIMAL(20, 0) COMMENT '角色ID', */ /*             `zoneid` BIGINT COMMENT '分区ID', */ /*             `fake_ai` BIGINT COMMENT 'AI类型', */ /*             `battleid` DECIMAL(20, 0) COMMENT '对局ID', */ /*             `pvptype` BIGINT COMMENT '对战类型', */ /*             `realpvptype` BIGINT COMMENT '真实对战类型', */ /*             `battle_type` BIGINT COMMENT '对局模式', */ /*             `battleai_num` BIGINT COMMENT '对局内AI人数', */ /*             `chessid` BIGINT COMMENT '棋手ID', */ /*             `skillid` BIGINT COMMENT '棋手技能ID', */ /*             `battlerank` BIGINT COMMENT '战斗名次', */ /*             `ailevel_max` BIGINT COMMENT '战斗内最高AI难度', */ /*             `is_black` BIGINT COMMENT '是否参与组队', */ /*             `battle_dur` BIGINT COMMENT '战斗时长', */ /*             `md5error` BIGINT COMMENT 'md5错误', */ /*             `matchtime` BIGINT COMMENT '战斗匹配时长' */ /*         ) COMMENT 'ML-自走棋战斗明细表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd') STORED AS PARQUET location 's3a://mt-dwd/table/dwd_autochessai_battle_di' */ WITH battle_info AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, fake_ai, battleid, pvptype, realpvptype, IF(blacknum > 1, 1, 0) AS is_black, battletime, md5error, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, fake_ai, battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 39) AS a WHERE rn = 1), match_info AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, matchtime FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 39), autochess_info AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid AS chessid, skillid, battlerank, ailevel, IF(COUNT(IF(ailevel <> 0, 1, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY battleid) = 0, 0, COUNT(IF(ailevel <> 0, 1, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY battleid, accountid, zoneid)) AS ai_num, MAX(ailevel) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid) AS ailevel_max, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a WHERE ailevel = 0 AND rn = 1), ai_info /* 让autochess表里同一场战斗的battleai_num一致 */ AS (SELECT battle_info.accountid AS accountid, battle_info.zoneid AS zoneid, battle_info.battleid AS battleid, MAX(autochess_info.ai_num) OVER (PARTITION BY battle_info.battleid) AS ai_num FROM battle_info LEFT JOIN autochess_info ON battle_info.accountid = autochess_info.accountid AND battle_info.zoneid = autochess_info.zoneid AND battle_info.battleid = autochess_info.battleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_autochessai_battle_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT battle_info.accountid, battle_info.zoneid, battle_info.fake_ai, battle_info.battleid, battle_info.pvptype, battle_info.realpvptype, IF(battle_info.realpvptype <> 39, IF(battle_info.realpvptype IN (42, 41, 152, 151, 40), 1, -99999), IF(ai_info.ai_num = 0, 0, 2)) AS battle_type, IF(NOT battle_info.realpvptype IN (39, 42, 41, 152, 151, 40), 9, ai_info.ai_num), COALESCE(autochess_info.chessid, -99999), COALESCE(autochess_info.skillid, -99999), COALESCE(autochess_info.battlerank, -99999), COALESCE(autochess_info.ailevel_max, -99999), COALESCE(battle_info.is_black, -99999), COALESCE(battle_info.battletime, -99999), COALESCE(battle_info.md5error, -99999), COALESCE(match_info.matchtime, -99999) FROM battle_info LEFT JOIN autochess_info ON battle_info.accountid = autochess_info.accountid AND battle_info.zoneid = autochess_info.zoneid AND battle_info.battleid = autochess_info.battleid LEFT JOIN ai_info ON battle_info.accountid = ai_info.accountid AND battle_info.zoneid = ai_info.zoneid AND battle_info.battleid = ai_info.battleid LEFT JOIN match_info ON battle_info.accountid = match_info.accountid AND battle_info.zoneid = match_info.zoneid AND battle_info.battleid = match_info.battleid

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: hengweiyan@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-03-10 16:17:30.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH raw_dwd AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.sub_pay_channel, a.bill_country, a.bill_currency, a.money, IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(a.`time`, 'yyyyMMddHHmmss'), '-', a.device_id), NULL) AS time_device_id, COALESCE(a.is_iap_token_buy, 0) AS is_iap_token_buy, COALESCE(a.is_sandbox, 0) AS is_sandbox, a.receipt_id, a.`time`, a.bill_amt, a.before_tax_amt, a.after_tax_amt, a.tax_amt, a.back_tax_amt, a.share_amt, a.fee_currency, a.fee_amt, a.actual_amt, a.base_diamond, a.extra_diamond, a.logymd, a.pay_channel, IF(pay_channel = 0, 'cashcard', a.game_pay_channel) AS pay_channel_name, a.currency_exchange_rate AS exchange_rate, a.fee_exchange_rate FROM (SELECT * FROM mt_dwd.dwd_charge_order_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND bill_amt > 0 AND LOWER(product_id) NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%') AS a) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd) SELECT * FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pay_channel_name AS pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, bill_country AS country, bill_currency AS currency, COALESCE(MIN(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), time, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS first_pay_time, COALESCE(MAX(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), time, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_pay_time, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), bill_amt, 0)), 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), bill_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), before_tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS before_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), before_tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS before_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), after_tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS after_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), after_tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS after_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), back_tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS back_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), back_tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS back_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), share_amt, 0)), 0) AS share_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), share_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS share_usd_amt, COALESCE(fee_currency, 'unknown') AS fee_currency, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), fee_amt, 0)), 0) AS fee_amt, IF(fee_exchange_rate = 0, 0, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), fee_amt, 0)) / fee_exchange_rate, 0)) AS fee_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), actual_amt, 0)), 0) AS actual_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), actual_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), base_diamond, 0)), 0) AS pay_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS free_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), base_diamond + extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS get_diamond, COALESCE(MIN(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, time, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS first_token_time, COALESCE(MAX(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, time, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_token_time, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, bill_amt, 0)), 0) AS pay_token_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, bill_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_token_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_token_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, base_diamond, 0)), 0) AS pay_token_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS free_token_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, base_diamond + extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS get_token_diamond, COALESCE(MIN(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, time, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS first_sandbox_time, COALESCE(MAX(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, time, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_sandbox_time, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, bill_amt, 0)), 0) AS pay_sandbox_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, bill_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_sandbox_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_sandbox_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, base_diamond, 0)), 0) AS pay_sandbox_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS free_sandbox_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, base_diamond + extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS get_sandbox_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), money, 0)), 0) AS product_money, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, money, 0)), 0) AS product_token_money, COALESCE(SPLIT(MIN(time_device_id), '-')[1], 'unknown') AS first_pay_device_id, COALESCE(SPLIT(MAX(time_device_id), '-')[1], 'unknown') AS last_pay_device_id, logymd FROM raw_dwd GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pay_channel_name, sub_pay_channel, bill_country, bill_currency, logymd, exchange_rate, fee_exchange_rate, fee_currency, pay_channel) AS t WHERE before_tax_usd_amt > 0 OR pay_token_amt > 0 OR pay_sandbox_amt > 0

name: mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_df
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, resource_type, resource_id, time_len, source_channel, his_first_get_time, his_last_get_time FROM bi_test.dwm_resource_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '1970-01-01' AND 1 > 1

WITH resource_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, resource_type, resource_id, time_len, source_channel, MIN(get_time) AS his_first_get_time, MAX(get_time) AS his_last_get_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND time_len = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, resource_type, resource_id, time_len, source_channel), resource_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, resource_type, resource_id, time_len, source_channel, his_first_get_time, his_last_get_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') INSERT INTO mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(resource_di.roleid, resource_df.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(resource_di.zoneid, resource_df.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(resource_di.resource_type, resource_df.resource_type) AS resource_type, COALESCE(resource_di.resource_id, resource_df.resource_id) AS resource_id, COALESCE(resource_di.time_len, resource_df.time_len) AS time_len, COALESCE(resource_di.source_channel, resource_df.source_channel) AS source_channel, COALESCE(resource_df.his_first_get_time, resource_di.his_first_get_time) AS his_first_get_time, COALESCE(resource_di.his_last_get_time, resource_df.his_last_get_time) AS his_last_get_time FROM resource_di FULL JOIN resource_df ON resource_di.roleid = resource_df.roleid AND resource_di.zoneid = resource_df.zoneid AND resource_di.resource_type = resource_df.resource_type AND resource_di.resource_id = resource_df.resource_id AND resource_di.time_len = resource_df.time_len AND resource_di.source_channel = resource_df.source_channel

/* SET spark.sql.hive.convertMetastoreParquet=FALSE; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-24') SELECT roleid, zoneid, resource_type, resource_id, time_len, source_channel, his_first_get_time, his_last_get_time FROM bi_test.dwm_resource_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '1970-01-01' AND 1 > 1

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_returning_user_detail_mla
新手分析主题表di
sql_units: WITH `role` AS (/* 每日新增 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_country, create_os, first_ad_country, CASE WHEN register_date = DATE_ADD(a.logymd, 29 * -1) THEN 30 WHEN register_date = DATE_ADD(a.logymd, 13 * -1) THEN 14 WHEN register_date = DATE_ADD(a.logymd, 6 * -1) THEN 7 WHEN register_date = DATE_ADD(a.logymd, 5 * -1) THEN 6 WHEN register_date = DATE_ADD(a.logymd, 4 * -1) THEN 5 WHEN register_date = DATE_ADD(a.logymd, 3 * -1) THEN 4 WHEN register_date = DATE_ADD(a.logymd, 2 * -1) THEN 3 WHEN register_date = DATE_ADD(a.logymd, 1 * -1) THEN 2 WHEN register_date = DATE_ADD(a.logymd, 0 * -1) THEN 1 END AS register_days, last_network_name, game_channel, adjust_creative_name FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS a /* ml_leap.dim_basic_role_zone_df a */ WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND register_date IN (DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1), DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 13 * -1), DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1), DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 5 * -1), DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 4 * -1), DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 3 * -1), DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 2 * -1), DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1), '2026-05-31') AND is_ai = 0), NEW AS (/* 每日新增及活跃 */ SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.create_country, b.create_os, a.first_ad_country, a.last_ad_country, a.new_type, a.register_date, a.active_info, a.logymd, a.level, register_days, b.last_network_name, b.game_channel, b.adjust_creative_name FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_retention_role_zone_df AS a /* ml_leap.dm_behavior_retention_role_zone_df a */ JOIN `role` AS b ON b.roleid = a.roleid AND b.zoneid = a.zoneid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' /* AND     a.register_date = '2026-05-31' */), lvl AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(`LEVEL`) AS max_level FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_level AS lvl WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), newbie AS (/* 7天内新手关表现 */ SELECT a.accountid AS `roleid`, a.zoneid, a.heroid, CASE WHEN guidetype = 3 THEN '第一关' WHEN guidetype = 1 THEN '第二关' WHEN guidetype = 2 THEN '第三关' END AS guidetype_new, guidetype, battletime, IF(a.killnum <= 50, a.killnum, 50) AS killnum, IF(a.assistnum <= 50, a.assistnum, 50) AS assistnum, IF(a.deadnum <= 50, a.deadnum, 50) AS deadnum, `time`, a.logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, guidetype ORDER BY `time`) AS rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_warmbattle AS a /* ml_battle.warmbattle a */ JOIN NEW AS b ON b.roleid = a.accountid AND b.zoneid = a.zoneid AND b.register_date <= DATE_ADD(a.logymd, 6) AND a.guidetype IN (1, 2, 3) WHERE a.logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND a.logymd <= '2026-05-31'), newbie_agg AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, MAX(a.heroid) AS heroid, guidetype_new, AVG(battletime) AS battletime_avg, SUM(killnum) AS killnum, SUM(assistnum) AS assistnum, SUM(deadnum) AS deadnum, COUNT(1) AS newbie_cnt, MIN(logymd) AS first_newbie_logymd FROM newbie AS a WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, guidetype_new), battleenddata /* battleenddata AS ( */ /*     -- 当日/7日内客户端温暖关 */ /*     SELECT  a.accountid AS `roleid`, */ /*             a.zoneid, */ /*             a.level, */ /*             a.score, */ /*             a.killnum, */ /*             a.dead, */ /*             a.assist, */ /*             a.gold, */ /*             a.`time`, */ /*             a.heroid */ /*     FROM    ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata a -- ml_battle.battleenddata a */ /*     JOIN    NEW */ /*     ON      new.roleid = a.accountid */ /*     AND     new.zoneid = a.zoneid */ /*     WHERE   a.logymd >= DATE_SUB('2026-05-31', 6) */ /*     AND     a.logymd <= '2026-05-31' */ /*     AND     a.logymd >= new.register_date */ /*     AND     a.logymd <= DATE_ADD(new.register_date, 6) */ /*     AND     battleid > 1000000000 */ /*     AND     battleid < 1000000000000 */ /*     AND     battletype = 1 */ /* ), */ AS (/* 30日内客户端温暖关 */ SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, `time`, CASE WHEN battleid > 1000000000 AND battleid < 1000000000000 AND pvptype IN (1, 188) THEN 1 END AS is_single, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.zoneid ORDER BY a.`time`) AS rn, IF(a.iswin = 1, 1, 0) AS iswin, IF(a.score <= 2000, a.score, 2000) AS score, ROUND((a.killnum + assistnum) / (deadnum + 1), 0) AS kda, a.heroid, a.logymd, IF(a.killnum <= 50, a.killnum, 50) AS killnum, IF(a.assistnum <= 50, a.assistnum, 50) AS assist, IF(a.deadnum <= 50, a.deadnum, 50) AS dead FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_newbie_role_zone_btid_di AS a JOIN NEW ON new.roleid = a.roleid AND new.zoneid = a.zoneid WHERE a.logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND a.logymd >= new.register_date AND a.logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND a.logymd <= DATE_ADD(new.register_date, 29) AND a.register_days <= 45 AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 188)), battleenddata_agg /* ——————————battleenddata替换前备份 */ /* battleenddata AS ( */ /*     -- 30日内客户端温暖关 */ /*     SELECT  a.accountid AS `roleid`, */ /*             a.zoneid, */ /*             `time`, */ /*             CASE WHEN battleid > 1000000000 AND battleid < 1000000000000 AND battletype IN (1, 188) THEN 1 */ /*             END AS is_single, */ /*             row_number() OVER( */ /*                 PARTITION BY */ /*                         a.accountid, */ /*                         a.zoneid */ /*                 ORDER BY */ /*                         a.`time` */ /*             ) rn, */ /*             IF(a.iswin = 1, 1, 0) iswin, */ /*             IF(a.score <= 2000, a.score, 2000) score, */ /*             round((a.killnum + assist) / (dead + 1), 0) kda, */ /*             a.heroid, */ /*             a.logymd, */ /*             IF(a.killnum <= 50, a.killnum, 50) killnum, */ /*             IF(a.assist <= 50, a.assist, 50) assist, */ /*             IF(a.dead <= 50, a.dead, 50) dead */ /*     FROM    ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata a -- ml_battle.battleenddata a */ /*     JOIN    NEW */ /*     ON      new.roleid = a.accountid */ /*     AND     new.zoneid = a.zoneid */ /*     WHERE   a.logymd <= '2026-05-31' */ /*     AND     a.logymd >= new.register_date */ /*     AND     a.logymd >= DATE_SUB('2026-05-31', 29) */ /*     AND     a.logymd <= DATE_ADD(new.register_date, 29) */ /*     AND     battletype IN (1, 2, 188) */ /*     AND     nvl(isbot, 0) = 0 */ /*     AND     TO_DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(usercreateymd)) BETWEEN DATE_SUB('2026-05-31', 35) AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 35) */ /* ), */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, PMOD(MIN(heroid + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`) * 100000000), 100000000) AS first_heroid, COUNT(*) AS battle_cnt /* 客户端温暖关第一次选用的英雄 */, AVG(kda) AS single_kda_avg, MIN(logymd) AS first_single_logymd /* 完成第一个客户端温暖关日期 */ FROM battleenddata AS a /* ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end */ WHERE is_single = 1 GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid), battleenddata_top15 AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN heroid END) AS hero_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN heroid END) AS hero_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN heroid END) AS hero_3, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN heroid END) AS hero_4, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 5 THEN heroid END) AS hero_5, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 6 THEN heroid END) AS hero_6, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 7 THEN heroid END) AS hero_7, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 8 THEN heroid END) AS hero_8, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 9 THEN heroid END) AS hero_9, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 10 THEN heroid END) AS hero_10, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 11 THEN heroid END) AS hero_11, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 12 THEN heroid END) AS sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-04-17 15:29:23.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /*  需求文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/QPhLdGjYWojb63x8gbDce8vFnFf */ /*  自测文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/wikcnjwRjHRrHMC9MxlJPkoEKIb */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_ads.ads_gamebi_active_lose_di ( */ /*             granularity_type string COMMENT '用户粒度类型(role),key', */ /*             country string COMMENT '首次创号国,key', -- 命名方式对齐沐瞳 */ /*             zoneid BIGINT COMMENT '服务器,key', */ /*             os string COMMENT '平台,key', */ /*             network string COMMENT '首次广告归因渠道,key', */ /*             lose_cnt_7ds BIGINT COMMENT '7日流失用户数', */ /*             active_cnt_7ds BIGINT COMMENT '7日前活跃用户', */ /*             lose_cnt_30ds BIGINT COMMENT '30日流失用户数', */ /*             active_cnt_30ds BIGINT COMMENT '30日前活跃用户数' */ /*         ) COMMENT '活跃专题-流失用户情况表' */ /*         PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd', appid STRING COMMENT '游戏id') STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3n://mt-ads/table/ads_gamebi_active_lose_di'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_active_lose_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT 'role' AS granularity_type, basic.first_mt_country AS country, basic.zoneid, basic.os, basic.first_network_name AS network, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(lose_days = 7, lose.roleid, NULL)) AS lose_cnt_7ds, SUM(IF(active_info.logymd = '2026-05-24', 1, 0)) AS active_cnt_7ds, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(lose_days = 30, lose.roleid, NULL)) AS lose_cnt_30ds, SUM(IF(active_info.logymd = '2026-05-01', 1, 0)) AS active_cnt_30ds FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_os AS os, first_network_name, first_mt_country, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-05-06', '2022-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND is_ai = 0) AS basic LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, lose_days FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND lose_days IN (7, 30) AND recurring_date IS NULL GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, lose_days) AS lose ON lose.roleid = basic.roleid AND lose.zoneid = basic.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-24', '2026-05-01') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS active_info ON active_info.roleid = basic.roleid AND active_info.zoneid = basic.zoneid GROUP BY basic.os, basic.first_network_name, basic.logymd, basic.zoneid, basic.first_mt_country

sql_units: WITH mode_list_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(COLLECT_LIST(conbat_battle) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS mode_combat_info FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, is_win, battle_type, battleai_type, battle_end_time, CONCAT_WS('', pvptype_define, battle_type_define, battleai_type_define, is_win) AS conbat_battle FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, is_win, battle_type, battleai_type, battle_end_time, pvptype AS pvptype_define, CASE WHEN battle_type = -99999 THEN 9 ELSE battle_type END AS battle_type_define, CASE WHEN battleai_type = -99999 THEN 9 ELSE battleai_type END AS battleai_type_define FROM mt_dwd.dwd_mode_list_battle_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND roleid > 100 /* 小于100为非真人账号，排除 */ AND is_win <> -99999 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_invalid = 0 /* 只取正常对局 */ AND is_md5error = 0 /* 排除md5异常数据 */) ORDER BY roleid, zoneid, battle_end_time DESC) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), season_config_df AS (SELECT season FROM mt_dim.dim_season_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-10', '2023-05-10', '2026-05-31') AND SUBSTRING(season_starttime, 1, 10) <= '2026-05-31' AND SUBSTRING(season_endtime, 1, 10) >= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY season), mode_combat_sf AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, season, mode_combat_info, logymd FROM mt_dwd.dwd_mode_combat_role_zone_sf WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND season = (SELECT season FROM season_config_df)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_mode_combat_role_zone_sf PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(mde.roleid, com.roleid), COALESCE(mde.zoneid, com.zoneid), sea.season, CONCAT(COALESCE(mde.mode_combat_info, ARRAY()), COALESCE(com.mode_combat_info, ARRAY())) AS mode_combat_info FROM mode_list_di AS mde FULL JOIN mode_combat_sf AS com ON mde.roleid = com.roleid AND mde.zoneid = com.zoneid FULL JOIN season_config_df AS sea ON 1 = 1
