name: export_bytedance.gameserver_login_deviceidunique
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.dwd_gameserver_login_deviceuique PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, MD5(deviceid) AS deviceid FROM (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, deviceid, android_id, ad_id FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(client_ip, 1), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(createrole_country, '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS main_data LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-07', '2022-05-07', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON main_data.roleid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE adv_us.us_accountid IS NULL

name: export_bytedance.gameserver_act_lootbox_task
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.gameserver_act_lootbox_task PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, level, act_id, record_type, draw_type, draw_times, already_draw_times, total_draw_limit, cost, reward, origin_reward, exchange_skin_id, count_draw_times FROM (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, level, act_id, record_type, draw_type, draw_times, already_draw_times, total_draw_limit, cost, reward, origin_reward, exchange_skin_id, count_draw_times, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_lootbox_task WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(createrole_country, '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS md LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_account FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-07', '2022-05-07', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON md.roleid = adv_us.us_account WHERE adv_us.us_account IS NULL

name: etl.dim_gamebi_active_pay_di_role
sql_units: WITH basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, create_os, first_network_name, is_first_create, new_type, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-20', '2023-05-20', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000), active_di_role AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid), pay_role /* SELECT  roleid, */ /*         zoneid */ /* FROM    mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df */ /* WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /* AND     appid = 'mlbb' */ /* AND     zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 */ /* AND     his_pay_amt > 0 */ /* GROUP BY */ /*         roleid, */ /*         zoneid */ /* SELECT  roleid, */ /*         zoneid, */ /*         CASE WHEN length( */ /*                  replace(substr(charge_info, datediff(logymd, '2026-05-31') + 1, length(charge_info)), '0') */ /*              ) > 0 THEN 1 */ /*              ELSE 0 */ /*         END AS is_pay */ /* FROM    mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df */ /* WHERE   logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -6), DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -6), '2026-05-31') */ /* AND     zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), active_pay_role AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL AND NOT b.zoneid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_pay /* 历史是否付费 */ FROM active_di_role AS a LEFT JOIN pay_role AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, is_pay), recurring_di_role AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND lose_days >= 30 /* 代表30日回流用户 */ AND recurring_date = logymd), id_df_role AS (/* SELECT  roleid, */ /*         zoneid, */ /*         MAX(is_main) AS is_main -- 大小号 */ /* FROM    mt_dim.dim_id_mapping_role_zone_df */ /* WHERE   logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-20', '2023-05-20', '2026-05-31') */ /* AND     appid = 'mlbb' */ /* AND     zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 */ /* GROUP BY */ /*         roleid, */ /*         zoneid */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(is_main) AS is_main /* 大小号 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_main_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), active_di_30d AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(IF(logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-05-17', 1, 0)) AS is_1_14d, MAX(IF(logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-05-01', 1, 0)) AS is_1_30d, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-05-24', logymd, NULL)) AS active_days FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), active_info AS (/* INSTR('010101', '1') = 2 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(LOCATE('1', active_info) > 0, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', LOCATE('1', active_info) * -1), '1970-01-01') AS last_active_date /* 除当天外的末次活跃日期 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(logymd, '2026-05-31') + 2, 180) AS active_info /* T~T-181位 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df) AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57) AS a) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_gamebi_active_pay_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', granularity_type = 'role') SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(network, 'unknown') AS network, COALESCE(is_main, -1) AS is_main, COALESCE(user_type, -1) AS user_type, COALESCE(is_pay, -1) AS is_pay, COALESCE(active_label, -1) AS active_label, COALESCE(is_recurring_14days, 0) AS is_recurring_14days FROM (SELECT active_role.roleid AS roleid, active_role.zoneid AS zoneid, basic_df.first_mt_country AS country, basic_df.create_os AS os, basic_df.first_network_name AS network, id_df.is_main, CASE WHEN NOT recurring.roleid IS NULL AND NOT recurring.zoneid IS NULL THEN 'lose30d' /* 优先级：回流>新老 */ WHEN recurring.roleid IS NULL AND recurring.zoneid IS NULL AND NOT active_role.roleid IS NULL AND NOT active_role.zoneid IS NULL AND DATEDIFF(active_role.logymd, basic_df.register_date) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(active_role.logymd, basic_df.register_date) < 30 THEN 'new' ELSE 'old' END AS user_type, active_role.is_pay, CASE WHEN basic_df.register_date = '2026-05-31' THEN 0 /* 当日新增 */ WHEN act_30d.active_days BETWEEN 1 AND 2 OR (basic_df.register_date >= '2026-05-24' AND act_info.last_active_date = '1970-01-01') THEN 1 /* 在T-1~T-7期间活跃天数1~2：周低活  存在极少量最近7天新的的用户，但是没有活跃，归为周地活 */ WHEN act_30d.active_days BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 2 /* 在T-1~T-7期间活跃天数3~5：周中活 */ WHEN act_30d.active_days BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN 3 /* 在T-1~T-7期间活跃天数6~7：周高活 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_date BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-23' THEN 4 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-8~T-14天内：7~14日回流 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-16' THEN 5 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-15~T-30天内：14~30日回流 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' THEN 6 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-31~T-60天内：30~60日回流 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2026-03-31' THEN 7 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-61~T-180天内：60~180日回流 */ ELSE 8 END AS active_label /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-181及以上：半年以上回流 */, IF(DATEDIFF(active_role.logymd, basic_df.register_date) > 14 AND (act_30d.is_1_14d IS NULL OR act_30d.is_1_14d = 0), 1, 0) AS is_recurring_14days FROM active_pay_role AS active_role LEFT JOIN basic_df ON active_role.roleid = basic_df.roleid AND active_role.zoneid = basic_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN recurring_di_role AS recurring ON active_role.roleid = recurring.roleid AND active_role.zoneid = recurring.zoneid LEFT JOIN id_df_role AS id_df ON active_role.roleid = id_df.roleid AND active_role.zoneid = id_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN active_info AS act_info ON active_role.roleid = act_info.roleid AND active_role.zoneid = act_info.zoneid LEFT JOIN active_di_30d AS act_30d ON active_role.roleid = act_30d.roleid AND active_role.zoneid = act_30d.zoneid) AS t

name: etl.dim_gamebi_active_pay_di_account
sql_units: WITH basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, create_os, first_network_name, is_first_create, new_type, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-20', '2023-05-20', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND is_first_create = 1), active_di_acc AS (SELECT logymd, roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 /* AND     is_ai = 0 */ GROUP BY logymd, roleid), pay_acc /* SELECT  roleid, */ /*         MAX(is_pay) is_pay */ /* FROM    ( */ /*             SELECT  roleid, */ /*                     zoneid, */ /*                     --截取位图信息 */ /*                     CASE WHEN length( */ /*                              replace(substr(charge_info, datediff(logymd, '2026-05-31') + 1, length(charge_info)), '0') */ /*                          ) > 0 THEN 1 */ /*                          ELSE 0 */ /*                     END AS is_pay */ /*             FROM    mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df */ /*             WHERE   logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -6), DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -6), '2026-05-31') */ /*             AND     zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 */ /*         ) a */ /* GROUP BY */ /*         roleid */ AS (/* SELECT  roleid */ /* FROM    mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df */ /* WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /* AND     appid = 'mlbb' */ /* AND     zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 */ /* AND     his_pay_amt > 0 */ /* GROUP BY */ /*         roleid */ /* 更改付费口径 */ SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid), active_pay_acc AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_pay /* 历史是否付费 */ FROM active_di_acc AS a LEFT JOIN pay_acc AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid GROUP BY a.logymd, a.roleid, is_pay), id_df_acc AS (/* SELECT  roleid, */ /*         MAX(is_main) AS is_main -- 大小号 */ /* FROM    mt_dim.dim_id_mapping_role_zone_df */ /* WHERE   logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-20', '2023-05-20', '2026-05-31') */ /* AND     appid = 'mlbb' */ /* AND     zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 */ /* GROUP BY */ /*         roleid */ SELECT roleid, MAX(is_main) AS is_main /* 大小号 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_main_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid), active_info AS (/* INSTR('010101', '1') = 2 */ SELECT roleid, MAX(IF(logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-05-17', 1, 0)) AS is_1_14d, MAX(IF(logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-05-01', 1, 0)) AS is_1_30d, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-05-24', logymd, NULL)) AS active_days, MAX(logymd) AS last_active_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= '2025-12-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_gamebi_active_pay_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', granularity_type = 'account') SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(network, 'unknown') AS network, COALESCE(is_main, -1) AS is_main, COALESCE(user_type, -1) AS user_type, COALESCE(is_pay, -1) AS is_pay, COALESCE(active_label, -1) AS active_label, COALESCE(is_recurring_14days, 0) AS is_recurring_14days FROM (SELECT active_acc.roleid AS roleid, -99999 AS zoneid, basic_df.first_mt_country AS country, basic_df.create_os AS os, basic_df.first_network_name AS network, id_df.is_main, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(active_acc.logymd, basic_df.register_date) > 30 AND (act_info.is_1_30d IS NULL OR act_info.is_1_30d = 0) THEN 'lose30d' /* -当日活跃，切过去T-1~T-30日未活跃的玩家，回流玩家，且非T~T-30 新增玩家 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(active_acc.logymd, basic_df.register_date) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(active_acc.logymd, basic_df.register_date) < 30 THEN 'new' ELSE 'old' END AS user_type, active_acc.is_pay /* 历史是否付费 */, CASE WHEN basic_df.register_date = '2026-05-31' THEN 0 /* 当日新增 */ WHEN act_info.active_days BETWEEN 1 AND 2 OR (basic_df.register_date >= '2026-05-24' AND act_info.last_active_date IS NULL) THEN 1 /* 在T-1~T-7期间活跃天数1~2：周低活  存在极少量最近7天新的的用户，但是没有活跃，归为周地活 */ WHEN act_info.active_days BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 2 /* 在T-1~T-7期间活跃天数3~5：周中活 */ WHEN act_info.active_days BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN 3 /* 在T-1~T-7期间活跃天数6~7：周高活 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_date BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-23' THEN 4 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-8~T-14天内：7~14日回流 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-16' THEN 5 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-15~T-30天内：14~30日回流 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' THEN 6 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-31~T-60天内：30~60日回流 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2026-03-31' THEN 7 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-61~T-180天内：60~180日回流 */ ELSE 8 END AS active_label /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-181及以上：半年以上回流 */, IF(DATEDIFF(active_acc.logymd, basic_df.register_date) > 14 AND (act_info.is_1_14d IS NULL OR act_info.is_1_14d = 0), 1, 0) AS is_recurring_14days FROM active_pay_acc AS active_acc JOIN basic_df ON active_acc.roleid = basic_df.roleid LEFT JOIN id_df_acc AS id_df ON active_acc.roleid = id_df.roleid LEFT JOIN active_info AS act_info ON active_acc.roleid = act_info.roleid) AS t

name: mt_ads.ads_gamebi_create_pay_change30d_df_account
sql_units: WITH basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, create_os, first_network_name, is_first_create, new_type, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-20', '2023-05-20', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1 AND zoneid < 57000 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31'), info_df_acc AS (SELECT roleid, COALESCE(IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) < 30, charge_amt_total_array[0], charge_amt_total_array[SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) - 30]), 0) AS charge_amt_30d /* 30日付费金额 */, COALESCE(IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) < 30, charge_cnt_total_array[0], charge_cnt_total_array[SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) - 30]), 0) AS charge_cnt_30d /* 30日付费次数 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, ARRAY_MERGE(charge_amt_total_array) AS charge_amt_total_array, ARRAY_MERGE(charge_cnt_total_array) AS charge_cnt_total_array FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df /* WHERE   logymd = IF('{dt}' <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -6), DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -6), '{dt}')   */ WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid /* account维度 */) AS t) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_create_pay_change30d_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', granularity_type = 'account') SELECT register_date, first_mt_country AS country, -99999 AS zoneid, create_os AS os, first_network_name AS network, new_type, pay_grade_30d, cnt_grade_30d, COUNT(*) AS register_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(charge_amt_30d, 0)) AS pay_amt FROM (SELECT bsc.roleid, bsc.register_date, bsc.first_mt_country, bsc.create_os, bsc.first_network_name, bsc.new_type, charge_amt_30d, CASE WHEN charge_amt_30d / 100 > 0 AND charge_amt_30d / 100 < 0.99 THEN '0' WHEN charge_amt_30d / 100 >= 0.99 AND charge_amt_30d / 100 < 4.99 THEN '0.99' WHEN charge_amt_30d / 100 >= 4.99 AND charge_amt_30d / 100 < 9.99 THEN '4.99' WHEN charge_amt_30d / 100 >= 9.99 THEN '9.99' ELSE '-1' END AS pay_grade_30d, CASE WHEN charge_cnt_30d >= 1 AND charge_cnt_30d < 3 THEN '1' WHEN charge_cnt_30d >= 3 AND charge_cnt_30d < 5 THEN '2' WHEN charge_cnt_30d >= 5 THEN '3' ELSE '0' END AS cnt_grade_30d FROM basic_df AS bsc LEFT JOIN info_df_acc AS ifo ON bsc.roleid = ifo.roleid) AS t1 GROUP BY register_date, first_mt_country, create_os, first_network_name, new_type, pay_grade_30d, cnt_grade_30d

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_pay_di
sql_units: WITH dim_basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country, create_os AS os, first_network_name AS network, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) > 0 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 30 THEN 1 WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 30 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 90 THEN 2 WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 90 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 360 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS register_days FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-20', '2023-05-20', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0), active_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, product_money, before_tax_usd_amt, pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000), pay_role AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 /* 历史有付费 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), pay_account AS (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 /* 历史有付费 */ GROUP BY roleid), pay_di_role AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, IF(b.roleid IS NULL AND b.zoneid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_first_pay /* 是否首次充值 */, SUM(product_money) AS product_money, SUM(before_tax_usd_amt) AS before_tax_usd_amt, SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, product_money, before_tax_usd_amt, pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM pay_di) AS a LEFT JOIN pay_role AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, is_first_pay), pay_di_acc AS (SELECT a.roleid, IF(b.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_first_pay /* 是否首次充值 */, SUM(product_money) AS product_money, SUM(before_tax_usd_amt) AS before_tax_usd_amt, SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, product_money, before_tax_usd_amt, pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM pay_di) AS a LEFT JOIN pay_account AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid GROUP BY a.roleid, is_first_pay) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_pay_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT granularity_type, country, zoneid, os, network, register_days, COALESCE(is_first_pay, -1) AS is_first_pay, COALESCE(pay_level, -1) AS pay_level, COALESCE(pay_exrate_level, -1) AS pay_exrate_level, COALESCE(pay_net_receipts_level, -1) AS pay_net_receipts_level, pay_cnt, active_cnt, pay_amt, pay_amount_exrate, pay_net_receipts_amt FROM (SELECT 'role' AS granularity_type, bsc.country, bsc.zoneid, bsc.os, bsc.network, bsc.register_days, pay.is_first_pay, pay.pay_level, pay.pay_exrate_level, pay.pay_net_receipts_level, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN before_tax_usd_amt > 0 THEN CONCAT(pay.roleid, '_', pay.zoneid) END) AS pay_cnt /* 取今日存在付费的人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid, act.zoneid) AS active_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(pay.product_money, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(COALESCE(pay.before_tax_usd_amt, 0)) AS pay_amount_exrate, SUM(COALESCE(pay.pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, 0)) AS pay_net_receipts_amt FROM (SELECT * FROM dim_basic_df WHERE zoneid < 57000) AS bsc LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, CASE WHEN product_money / 100 <= 0 THEN 0 WHEN product_money / 100 > 0 AND product_money / 100 <= 0.3 THEN 1 WHEN product_money / 100 > 0.3 AND product_money / 100 <= 0.8 THEN 2 WHEN product_money / 100 > 0.8 AND product_money / 100 <= 1.5 THEN 3 WHEN product_money / 100 > 1.5 AND product_money / 100 <= 5 THEN 4 WHEN product_money / 100 > 5 AND product_money / 100 <= 10 THEN 5 WHEN product_money / 100 > 10 AND product_money / 100 <= 20 THEN 6 ELSE 7 END AS pay_level, CASE WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 0 THEN 0 WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 > 0 AND before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 0.3 THEN 1 WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 > 0.3 AND before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 0.8 THEN 2 WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 > 0.8 AND before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 1.5 THEN 3 WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 > 1.5 AND before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 5 THEN 4 WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 > 5 AND before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 10 THEN 5 WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 > 10 AND before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 20 THEN 6 ELSE 7 END AS pay_exrate_level, CASE WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt <= 0 THEN 0 WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 > 0 AND pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 <= 0.3 THEN 1 WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 > 0.3 AND pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 <= 0.8 THEN 2 WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 > 0.8 AND pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 <= 1.5 THEN 3 WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 > 1.5 AND pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 <= 5 THEN 4 WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 > 5 AND pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 <= 10 THEN 5 WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 > 10 AND pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 <= 20 THEN 6 ELSE 7 END AS pay_net_receipts_level FROM pay_di_role) AS pay ON bsc.roleid = pay.roleid AND bsc.zoneid = pay.zoneid LEFT JOIN active_di AS act ON bsc.roleid = act.roleid AND bsc.zoneid = act.zoneid GROUP BY bsc.country, bsc.zoneid, bsc.os, bsc.network, bsc.register_days, pay.is_first_pay, pay.pay_level, pay.pay_exrate_level, pay.pay_net_receipts_level UNION ALL SELECT 'account' AS granularity_type, bsc.country, -99999 AS zoneid, bsc.os, bsc.network, bsc.register_days, pay.is_first_pay, pay.pay_level, pay.pay_exrate_level, pay.pay_net_receipts_level, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN before_tax_usd_amt > 0 THEN pay.roleid END) AS pay_cnt /* 取今日存在付费的人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid) AS active_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(pay.product_money, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(COALESCE(pay.before_tax_usd_amt, 0)) AS pay_amount_exrate, SUM(COALESCE(pay.pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, 0)) AS pay_net_receipts_amt FROM (SELECT * FROM dim_basic_df WHERE is_first_create = 1) AS bsc LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, CASE WHEN product_money / 100 <= 0 THEN 0 WHEN product_money / 100 > 0 AND product_money / 100 <= 0.3 THEN 1 WHEN product_money / 100 > 0.3 AND product_money / 100 <= 0.8 THEN 2 WHEN product_money / 100 > 0.8 AND product_money / 100 <= 1.5 THEN 3 WHEN product_money / 100 > 1.5 AND product_money / 100 <= 5 THEN 4 WHEN product_money / 100 > 5 AND product_money / 100 <= 10 THEN 5 WHEN product_money / 100 > 10 AND product_money / 100 <= 20 THEN 6 ELSE 7 END AS pay_level, CASE WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 0 THEN 0 WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 > 0 AND before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 0.3 THEN 1 WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 > 0.3 AND before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 0.8 THEN 2 WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 > 0.8 AND before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 1.5 THEN 3 WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 > 1.5 AND before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 5 THEN 4 WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 > 5 AND before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 10 THEN 5 WHEN before_tax_usd_amt / 100 > 10 AND before_tax_usd_amt / 100 <= 20 THEN 6 ELSE 7 END AS pay_exrate_level, CASE WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt <= 0 THEN 0 WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 > 0 AND pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 <= 0.3 THEN 1 WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 > 0.3 AND pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 <= 0.8 THEN 2 WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 > 0.8 AND pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 <= 1.5 THEN 3 WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 > 1.5 AND pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 <= 5 THEN 4 WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 > 5 AND pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 <= 10 THEN 5 WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 > 10 AND pay_net_receipts_usd_amt / 100 <= 20 THEN 6 ELSE 7 END AS pay_net_receipts_level FROM pay_di_acc) AS pay ON bsc.roleid = pay.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM active_di GROUP BY roleid) AS act ON bsc.roleid = act.roleid GROUP BY bsc.country, bsc.os, bsc.network, bsc.register_days, pay.is_first_pay, pay.pay_level, pay.pay_exrate_level, pay.pay_net_receipts_level) AS t

mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), add_level_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, level AS commanders_level FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_add_level WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t WHERE rn = 1), t_client_performance AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, quality_category_default, system_memory_size FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, quality_category_default, system_memory_size, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time`) AS rn FROM zgame_damai_ods.t_client_performance_systeminfo WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31') AS t /* 客户端打点早于服务端，所以多加一天数据防止数据丢失 */ WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_active_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'zgame') SELECT COALESCE(act_di.roleid, act_df.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(act_di.zoneid, act_df.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(act_df.his_first_login_os, act_di.first_login_os) AS his_first_login_os, COALESCE(act_di.last_login_os, act_df.his_last_login_os) AS his_last_login_os, COALESCE(act_df.his_first_device, act_di.first_device) AS his_first_device, COALESCE(act_di.last_device, act_df.his_last_device) AS his_last_device, COALESCE(act_df.his_first_ip, act_di.first_ip) AS his_first_ip, COALESCE(act_di.last_ip, act_df.his_last_ip) AS his_last_ip, COALESCE(act_df.his_first_deviceid, act_di.first_deviceid) AS his_first_deviceid, COALESCE(act_di.last_deviceid, act_df.his_last_deviceid) AS his_last_deviceid, COALESCE(act_df.his_first_active_time, act_di.first_active_time) AS his_first_active_time, COALESCE(act_di.last_active_time, act_df.his_last_active_time) AS his_last_active_time, COALESCE(act_df.activedays, 0) + IF(act_di.roleid IS NULL, 0, 1) AS activedays, COALESCE(act_df.active_dur, 0) + COALESCE(act_di.active_dur, 0) AS active_dur, COALESCE(add_level_di.commanders_level, act_df.commanders_level, 0) AS commanders_level, COALESCE(act_df.his_first_quality_category, t_client_performance.quality_category_default, -99999) AS his_first_quality_category, COALESCE(act_df.his_first_system_memory_size, t_client_performance.system_memory_size, -99999) AS his_first_system_memory_size FROM active_di AS act_di FULL JOIN active_df AS act_df ON act_di.roleid = act_df.roleid AND act_di.zoneid = act_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN add_level_di ON COALESCE(act_di.roleid, act_df.roleid) = add_level_di.roleid AND COALESCE(act_di.zoneid, act_df.zoneid) = add_level_di.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_client_performance ON COALESCE(act_di.roleid, act_df.roleid) = t_client_performance.roleid AND COALESCE(act_di.zoneid, act_df.zoneid) = t_client_performance.zoneid DISTRIBUTE BY (CASE WHEN '2026-05-31' <= '2021-12-31' THEN CAST(RAND() * 1 AS INT) WHEN '2026-05-31' BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' THEN CAST(RAND() * 2 AS INT) WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2023-01-01' THEN CAST(RAND() * 4 AS INT) ELSE CAST(RAND() * 6 AS INT) END)

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_pay_lose_di
sql_units:
/* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: yukiyi@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-06-05 11:03:56.000 */ /* Description: */ /* -- 需求文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/QPhLdGjYWojb63x8gbDce8vFnFf */ /* -- 自测文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/SUVedwG9Ko02wAxqFAQc1WFGnac */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mt_ads`.`ads_gamebi_pay_lose_di`( */ /*     `granularity_type` string COMMENT '用户粒度类型', */ /*     `country` string COMMENT '首次创号国', */ /*     `zoneid` bigint COMMENT '服务器', */ /*     `os` string COMMENT '平台', */ /*     `network` string COMMENT '首次广告归因渠道', */ /*     `lose_cnt_7ds` bigint COMMENT '7日流失付费用户数', */ /*     `pay_cnt_7ds` bigint COMMENT '7日前付费用户数', */ /*     `lose_cnt_14ds` bigint COMMENT '14日流失付费用户数', */ /*     `pay_cnt_14ds` bigint COMMENT '14日前付费用户数', */ /*     `recurring_cnt_7ds` bigint COMMENT '7日回流付费用户数', */ /*     `recurring_cnt_14ds` bigint COMMENT '14日回流付费用户数', */ /*     `pay_cnt` bigint COMMENT '今日付费人数' */ /* ) COMMENT '收入专题-收入流失' PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd', */ /*     `appid` string COMMENT '应用ID' */ /* ) STORED AS PARQUET location 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_gamebi_pay_lose_di' */ /* 排除AI和测服角色 */ WITH basic_info AS (SELECT first_mt_country AS country, roleid, zoneid, create_os AS os, first_network_name AS network FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND zoneid < 57000), pay_di /* 当日存在付费的角色信息 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), pay_df /* 历史存在付费的角色信息 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS log_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-24', '2026-05-17') AND zoneid < 57000 AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0), pay_info /*
 flag值含义：
 - 0: 当日存在付费行为
 - 1: 当日及之前存在付费行为
 - 2: 7日及之前存在付费行为
 - 3: 14日及之前存在付费行为
 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, 0 AS flag FROM pay_di UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, 1 AS flag FROM pay_df WHERE log_date = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, 2 AS flag FROM pay_df WHERE log_date = '2026-05-24' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, 3 AS flag FROM pay_df WHERE log_date = '2026-05-17'), lose_info /* 流失时长 >= 7 的用户信息 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, lose_days, CASE WHEN NOT recurring_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_recurring FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_role_zone_di WHERE lose_days >= 7 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000), active_info /* 7/14日前活跃用户信息 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS active_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-24', '2026-05-17')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_pay_lose_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT 'role' AS granularity_type, bsc.country, bsc.zoneid, bsc.os, bsc.network, COUNT(DISTINCT (IF(los.lose_days = 7 AND los.is_recurring = 0 AND pay.flag = 2, bsc.roleid, NULL))) AS lose_cnt_7ds, COUNT(DISTINCT (IF(act.active_date = '2026-05-24' AND pay.flag = 2, bsc.roleid, NULL))) AS pay_cnt_7ds, COUNT(DISTINCT (IF(los.lose_days = 14 AND los.is_recurring = 0 AND pay.flag = 3, bsc.roleid, NULL))) AS lose_cnt_14ds, COUNT(DISTINCT (IF(act.active_date = '2026-05-17' AND pay.flag = 3, bsc.roleid, NULL))) AS pay_cnt_14ds, COUNT(DISTINCT (IF(los.lose_days >= 7 AND los.is_recurring = 1 AND pay.flag = 1, bsc.roleid, NULL))) AS recurring_cnt_7ds, COUNT(DISTINCT (IF(los.lose_days >= 14 AND los.is_recurring = 1 AND pay.flag = 1, bsc.roleid, NULL))) AS recurring_cnt_14ds, COUNT(DISTINCT (IF(pay.flag = 0, bsc.roleid, NULL))) AS pay_cnt FROM basic_info AS bsc LEFT JOIN pay_info AS pay ON bsc.roleid = pay.roleid AND bsc.zoneid = pay.zoneid LEFT JOIN lose_info AS los ON bsc.roleid = los.roleid AND bsc.zoneid = los.zoneid LEFT JOIN active_info AS act ON bsc.roleid = act.roleid AND bsc.zoneid = act.zoneid GROUP BY bsc.country, bsc.zoneid, bsc.os, bsc.network

   MAX(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt */ /*     FROM    ( */ /*                 SELECT  logymd, */ /*                         roleid, */ /*                         zoneid, */ /* AS battle7_fuyong_user_cnt, -9999 AS battle8_fuyong_user_cnt, -9999 AS battle9_fuyong_user_cnt, -9999 AS battle10_fuyong_user_cnt, -9999 AS battle11_fuyong_user_cnt, -9999 AS battle12_fuyong_user_cnt, -9999 AS battle13_fuyong_user_cnt, -9999 AS battle14_fuyong_user_cnt, -9999 AS battle15_fuyong_user_cnt, SUM(t1.iswin) AS iswin, SUM(t1.score) AS score, SUM(t1.killnum) AS killnum, SUM(t1.assist) AS assist, SUM(t1.dead) AS dead FROM (SELECT *, '新手第三关英雄' AS data_type FROM dm_jax_newbie_di AS t UNION ALL SELECT *, '第一把排位英雄' AS data_type FROM dm_jax_newbie_di AS t UNION ALL SELECT *, '0-3段位首次使用英雄' AS data_type FROM dm_jax_newbie_di AS t) AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM third_hero_t UNION ALL SELECT * FROM first_rank_hero_t UNION ALL SELECT * FROM first_hero_0_3rank_t) AS t1 ON t.roleid = t1.roleid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t.data_type = t1.data_type LEFT JOIN mt_dm.dm_behavior_retention_role_zone_df AS t2 ON t.roleid = t2.roleid AND t.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t2.logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY t.data_type, t.logymd, t.register_date, t.new_type, t.newbie_tag, t.zoneid, is_odd, t.newbie_1_heroid, CASE WHEN t.newbie_1_heroid = 423 THEN 18 WHEN t.newbie_1_heroid = 446 THEN 18 WHEN t.newbie_1_heroid = 964 THEN 28 WHEN t.newbie_1_heroid = 968 THEN 38 ELSE t.newbie_1_heroid END, t.create_country, COALESCE(t1.heroid, -9999)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_wmz_ads_datawindbi_newbie_hero_use_data_t PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-28') SELECT t.data_type, t.active_logymd, t.register_date, t.new_type, t.kmeans, is_odd, FLOOR(t.zoneid / 1000) AS zoneid /* 20240522修改，zoneid改为大区服 */, t.newbie_1_heroid, t.newbie_1_heroid_std, t.create_country, t.use_heroid, t.if_battle_15cnt, t.user_cnt, t.ciliu_user_cnt, t.3liu_user_cnt, t.battle1_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle2_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle3_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle4_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle5_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle6_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle7_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle8_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle9_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle10_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle11_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle12_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle13_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle14_fuyong_user_cnt, t.battle15_fuyong_user_cnt, t.iswin, t.score, t.killnum, t.assist, t.dead, t1.hero_name FROM (SELECT * FROM battle15_fuyong_t UNION ALL SELECT * FROM third_hero_first_rank_hero_first_hero_0_3rank_t) AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT heroid, hero_name FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS t1 ON t.use_heroid = t1.heroid

name: etl.msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_di
sql_units: /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_di ( */ /*     account_id                    STRING COMMENT '账号id, key', */ /*     did                           STRING COMMENT '应用的自定义设备指纹', */ /*     package_name                  STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名, key', */ /*     os                            STRING COMMENT '操作系统', */ /*     day_first_model               STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 首次', */ /*     day_last_model                STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 末次', */ /*     day_first_os_version          STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本,首次', */ /*     day_last_os_version           STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本, 末次', */ /*     day_first_client_version      STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 首次', */ /*     day_last_client_version       STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 末次', */ /*     day_first_charge_time         STRING COMMENT '当天首次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     day_last_charge_time          STRING COMMENT '当天末次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     day_charge_cnt                BIGINT COMMENT '当天累计付费次数', */ /*     day_charge_sum                BIGINT COMMENT '当天累计付费金额（美分）' */ /* ) COMMENT '设备付费行为增量表格' PARTITIONED BY ( logymd STRING COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', app_id INT COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key' ) STORED AS PARQUET; */ WITH pay_event_succeed AS (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN app_id = 4500 THEN SUBSTRING(role_id, 0, 10) ELSE role_id END AS BIGINT) AS account_id, did, app_id, package_name, os, model, os_version, client_version, event_time, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY role_id, app_id, stage_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY role_id, app_id, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS rec_asc, IF(logymd <= '2024-10-17' AND app_id = 4280, 1, 0) AS is_delete, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('purchase_event', '__purchase_event__', '__purchase_deliver_event__') /* 投放重构充值接口__purchase_deliver_event__ 发货 __purchase_verify_event__ 校验 __purchase_refund_event__ 退款 */ AND /*   AND purchase_type = '1' --"支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test3. Promo4. Rewarded" */ purchase_type IN ('1', '3', '4') /* "支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test 3. Promo4. Rewarded" */ AND step = 'STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER' /* "表示支付流程到了第几步：校验STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_VERIFY发货STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER,暂时只有发货的步骤" */ AND result_code IN (22000, 13000) /* 未处理result_code: 21900 已处理 22000  订单参数异常 24900 服务器逻辑异常 25900 */ AND NOT app_id IN (4280, 4310)), pay_event_succeed_mc AS (SELECT role_id AS account_id, did, app_id, package_name, os, model, os_version, client_version, event_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.money') AS price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY role_id, app_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY role_id, app_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS rec_asc, IF(logymd <= '2024-10-17' AND app_id = 4280, 1, 0) AS is_delete, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_uuid ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS rn FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE ((logymd = '20260530' AND `hour` >= '23') /* -eg 2022-05-01号的eventtime数据会在server_time:[2022-04-30 23:00 2022-05-02 02:00]区间获取 */ OR (logymd = '20260531') OR (logymd = '20260601' AND `hour` <= '02')) AND DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8')) = DATE('2026-05-31') AND (NOT `event` IS NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(`event`)) > 1) /* event不需要为空字符或为空, 理论上在msdk上报的时候控制好了的 */ AND app_id = 4280 AND event = 'chargeMC') AS T WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT TRIM(t1.account_id), TRIM(t1.did) AS did, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.day_first_model, t1.day_last_model, t1.day_first_os_version, t1.day_last_os_version, t1.day_first_client_version, t1.day_last_client_version, t1.day_first_charge_time, t1.day_last_charge_time, t2.charge_cnt, t2.charge_sum, 0 AS actual_amt, t1.stage_id, t1.app_id AS app_id FROM (SELECT MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, did, NULL)) AS did, account_id, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, package_name, NULL)) AS package_name, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os, NULL)) AS os, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_first_model, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_last_model, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_first_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_last_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_first_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_last_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), NULL)) AS day_first_charge_time, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), NULL)) AS day_last_charge_time FROM pay_event_succeed WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY account_id, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01')) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT account_id, app_id, stage_id, COUNT(1) AS charge_cnt, SUM(price) AS charge_sum FROM pay_event_succeed GROUP BY account_id, app_id, stage_id) AS t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.stage_id = t2.stage_id UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(t1.account_id), TRIM(t1.did) AS did, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.day_first_model, t1.day_last_model, t1.day_first_os_version, t1.day_last_os_version, t1.day_first_client_version, t1.day_last_client_version, t1.day_first_charge_time, t1.day_last_charge_time, t2.charge_cnt, t2.charge_sum, t3.pay_net_receipts_usd_amt AS actual_amt, t1.stage_id, t1.app_id AS app_id FROM (SELECT MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, did, NULL)) AS did, account_id, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, package_name, NULL)) AS package_name, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os, NULL)) AS os, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_first_model, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_last_model, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_first_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_last_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_first_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_last_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), NULL)) AS day_first_charge_time, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), NULL)) AS day_last_charge_time FROM pay_event_succeed_mc WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY account_id, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01')) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT account_id, app_id, stage_id, COUNT(1) AS charge_cnt, SUM(price) AS charge_sum FROM pay_event_succeed_mc GROUP BY account_id, app_id, stage_id) AS t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.stage_id = t2.stage_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, SUM(COALESCE(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, 0)) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), actual_amt, 0)) / currency_exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM mt_dwd.dwd_mcgg_charge_order_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND bill_amt > 0 AND LOWER(product_id) NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' AND (IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, bill_amt, 0) > 0 OR IF(is_sandbox <> 0, bill_amt, 0) > 0 OR IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), before_tax_amt, 0) > 0) GROUP BY roleid, currency_exchange_rate) AS x GROUP BY roleid) AS t3 ON TRIM(t1.account_id) = t3.roleid

name: etl.msdk_ads.ads_basic_account_di
sql_units: /* CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_ads.ads_basic_account_di ( */ /*             package_name         STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名', */ /*             os                   STRING COMMENT '操作系统', */ /*             first_mt_country     STRING COMMENT '首次归因国家', */ /*             first_media_source   STRING COMMENT '首次归因渠道', */ /*             client_version       STRING COMMENT '安装的游戏客户端版本', */ /*             day_new_account_cnt      bigint COMMENT '新增设备数', */ /*             day_active_account_cnt   bigint COMMENT '设备登录数', */ /*             week_active_account_cnt  bigint COMMENT '最近7天设备登录数', */ /*             month_active_account_cnt bigint COMMENT '最近30天设备登录数', */ /*             avg_login_cnt        DECIMAL(18,2) COMMENT '平均登录次数', */ /*             avg_online_duration  DECIMAL(18,2) COMMENT '平均登录时长', */ /*             pay_iap              bigint COMMENT '游戏内充值金额（美分）', */ /*             pay_iap_cnt          bigint COMMENT '游戏内充值订单数', */ /*             pay_iap_num          bigint COMMENT '游戏内充值设备数', */ /*             day_login_cnt        bigint COMMENT '当日登录次数', */ /*             day_online_duration  bigint COMMENT '当日登录时长', */ /*             day_new_pay_account_cnt   bigint COMMENT '新增设备中新增当日付费设备数' */ /*         ) COMMENT '账号基础指标表-增量' */ /* PARTITIONED BY */ /*         (logymd STRING COMMENT '数据日期yyyy-MM-dd', app_id STRING COMMENT '应用唯一ID') STORED AS PARQUET; */ /* 活跃DWM表(指标：活跃，在线时长，登录次数) */ WITH active_device AS (SELECT package_name, account_id, logymd, app_id, login_cnt, online_time, os, day_last_model, day_last_os_version, day_last_client_version FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_account_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND account_id <> 'unknown'), pay_device /* 付费DWM表(指标：付费设备数，付费金额，订单数) */ AS (SELECT package_name, account_id, logymd, app_id, day_charge_cnt, day_charge_sum, os, day_last_model, day_last_os_version, day_last_client_version FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), basic_device /* 全量设备表取扩展维度信息 */ AS (SELECT app_id, account_id, package_name, os, client_version, model, os_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country, createdate FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND account_id <> 'unknown'), active_device_30d AS (SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.logymd, t1.os, t2.first_mt_country, t2.first_media_source, t1.day_last_client_version AS client_version, t1.day_last_model AS model, t1.day_last_os_version AS os_version, t1.account_id, t1.login_cnt, t1.online_time, IF(t1.logymd = '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_active_td, IF(t1.logymd >= '2026-05-25' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_active_7d, IF(t1.logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_active_30d FROM active_device AS t1 LEFT JOIN basic_device AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.account_id = t2.account_id WHERE t1.logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31'), total_dim /* 主表，全量维度 */ AS (SELECT app_id, package_name, os, client_version, COALESCE(first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country FROM (SELECT app_id, package_name, os, client_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country FROM basic_device GROUP BY app_id, package_name, os, client_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country UNION ALL SELECT app_id, package_name, os, client_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country FROM active_device_30d AS t1 GROUP BY app_id, package_name, os, client_version, first_media_source, first_mt_country UNION ALL SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t2.client_version, t2.first_media_source, t2.first_mt_country FROM pay_device AS t1 LEFT JOIN basic_device AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.account_id = t2.account_id WHERE t1.logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t2.client_version, t2.first_media_source, t2.first_mt_country) AS t1 GROUP BY app_id, package_name, os, client_version, COALESCE(first_media_source, 'unknown'), COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_ads.ads_basic_account_di PARTITION(logymd, app_id) SELECT t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, t2.day_new_account_cnt, t3.day_active_account_cnt, t4.week_active_account_cnt, t5.month_active_account_cnt, CAST(t3.day_login_cnt * 1.0 / t3.day_active_account_cnt * 1.0 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS avg_login_cnt, CAST(t3.day_online_duration * 1.0 / t3.day_active_account_cnt * 1.0 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS avg_online_duration, t6.pay_iap, t6.pay_iap_cnt, t6.pay_iap_num, t3.day_login_cnt, t3.day_online_duration, t2.day_new_pay_account_cnt, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.app_id FROM total_dim AS t1 LEFT JOIN (/* 新增设备数 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.createdate AS logymd, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t1.client_version, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.account_id) AS day_new_account_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.account_id) AS day_new_pay_account_cnt FROM basic_device AS t1 LEFT JOIN pay_device AS t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id WHERE t1.createdate = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.createdate, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t1.client_version) AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.os = t2.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t2.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t2.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t2.client_version LEFT JOIN (/* 当日活跃 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t1.client_version, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.account_id) AS day_active_account_cnt, SUM(login_cnt) AS day_login_cnt /* fuxinwang:改为sum，avg使用范围太小，比值指标应该至少保留分子分母，online_time同理，avg可以保留 */, SUM(online_time) AS day_online_duration /* 时长的词根，可以统一为“_duration”，比如online_duration，time容易混淆，时间点也可以叫做time */ FROM active_device_30d AS t1 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t1.client_version) AS t3 ON t1.app_id = t3.app_id AND t1.package_name = t3.package_name AND t1.os = t3.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t3.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t3.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t3.client_version LEFT JOIN (/* 近7日活跃 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t1.client_version, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.account_id) AS week_active_account_cnt FROM (SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.account_id FROM active_device_30d AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd >= '2026-05-25' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.account_id) AS t1 GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t1.client_version) AS t4 ON t1.app_id = t4.app_id AND t1.package_name = t4.package_name AND t1.os = t4.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t4.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t4.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t4.client_version LEFT JOIN (/* 近30日活跃 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t1.client_version, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.account_id) AS month_active_account_cnt FROM (SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.account_id FROM active_device_30d AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, t1.account_id) AS t1 GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.os, COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t1.client_version) AS t5 ON t1.app_id = t5.app_id AND t1.package_name = t5.package_name AND t1.os = t5.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t5.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t5.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t5.client_version LEFT JOIN (/* 付费 */ SELECT t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.logymd, t1.os, COALESCE(t2.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(t2.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, t2.client_version, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.account_id) AS pay_iap_num, SUM(t1.day_charge_cnt) AS pay_iap_cnt, SUM(day_charge_sum) AS pay_iap FROM pay_device AS t1 LEFT JOIN basic_device AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.account_id = t2.account_id WHERE t1.logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.app_id, t1.package_name, t1.logymd, t1.os, COALESCE(t2.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t2.first_media_source, 'unknown'), t2.client_version) AS t6 ON t1.app_id = t6.app_id AND t1.package_name = t6.package_name AND t1.os = t6.os AND t1.first_mt_country = t6.first_mt_country AND t1.first_media_source = t6.first_media_source AND t1.client_version = t6.client_version DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

sql_units: WITH wk_diamond AS (SELECT roleid, '-' AS pay_channel /* 弃用该维度 */, before_tax_amt, currency_exchange_rate, logymd FROM mt_dwd.dwd_wk_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND (product_id LIKE '%weekly_diamond%' OR product_id = 'com.moonton.diamond_vng_one_time_wk_diamond')), basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country AS country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-20', '2023-05-20', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid GROUP BY a.roleid, pay_channel, country, logymd), a AS (/* 历史首次新增用户 */ SELECT 'day' AS date_type, '2026-05-31' AS date_detail, country, pay_channel, 0 AS first_reten_pay_role_cnt_mon, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.roleid) AS his_first_pay_role_cnt, 0 AS first_return_pay_role_cnt_mon, 0 AS pay_role_cnt, 0 AS pay_cnt, 0 AS pay_role_cnt_mon, 0 AS pay_cnt_mon, 0 AS pay_cnt_1, 0 AS pay_cnt_2, 0 AS pay_cnt_3, 0 AS pay_cnt_4, 0 AS pay_cnt_5, 0 AS pay_cnt_6, 0 AS pay_cnt_7, 0 AS pay_cnt_8, 0 AS pay_cnt_9, 0 AS pay_cnt_10, 0 AS pay_cnt_11, 0 AS pay_cnt_12, 0 AS pay_cnt_13, 0 AS pay_cnt_14, 0 AS pay_cnt_15, 0 AS pay_cnt_15_add FROM (SELECT roleid, pay_channel, country, pay_cnt, before_tax_usd_amt FROM wk_diamond_all WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t1 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT roleid FROM wk_diamond_all AS t2 WHERE logymd < '2026-05-31' AND t1.roleid = t2.roleid) GROUP BY country, pay_channel), b AS (/* 当日用户数和购买份数 */ SELECT 'day' AS date_type, '2026-05-31' AS date_detail, country, pay_channel, 0 AS first_reten_pay_role_cnt_mon, 0 AS his_first_pay_role_cnt, 0 AS first_return_pay_role_cnt_mon, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS pay_role_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_cnt), 0) AS pay_cnt, 0 AS pay_role_cnt_mon, 0 AS pay_cnt_mon, 0 AS pay_cnt_1, 0 AS pay_cnt_2, 0 AS pay_cnt_3, 0 AS pay_cnt_4, 0 AS pay_cnt_5, 0 AS pay_cnt_6, 0 AS pay_cnt_7, 0 AS pay_cnt_8, 0 AS pay_cnt_9, 0 AS pay_cnt_10, 0 AS pay_cnt_11, 0 AS pay_cnt_12, 0 AS pay_cnt_13, 0 AS pay_cnt_14, 0 AS pay_cnt_15, 0 AS pay_cnt_15_add FROM wk_diamond_all WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY country, pay_channel), c /* c AS ( */ /*     -- 本月用户数和购买份数 */ /*     SELECT  */ /*             'month' as date_type, */ /*             substr('2026-05-31',1,7) as date_detail, */ /*             country, */ /*             pay_channel, */ /*             0 AS first_reten_pay_role_cnt_mon, */ /*             0 AS his_first_pay_role_cnt, */ /*             0 AS first_return_pay_role_cnt_mon, */ /*             0 AS pay_role_cnt, */ /*             0 AS pay_cnt, */ /*             count(DISTINCT roleid) AS pay_role_cnt_mon, */ /*             nvl(SUM(pay_cnt), 0) AS pay_cnt_mon */ /*     FROM    wk_diamond_all */ /*     WHERE   logymd BETWEEN date_format('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND last_day('2026-05-31') */ /*     GROUP BY */ /*             country, */ /*             pay_channel */ /* ), */ AS (/* 本月用户数和购买份数 */ SELECT date_type, date_detail, country, pay_channel, 0 AS first_reten_pay_role_cnt_mon, 0 AS his_first_pay_role_cnt, 0 AS first_return_pay_role_cnt_mon, 0 AS pay_role_cnt, 0 AS pay_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS pay_role_cnt_mon, COALESCE(SUM(pay_cnt1), 0) AS pay_cnt_mon, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 <= 1 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_1, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 2 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_2, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 3 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_3, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 4 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_4, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 5 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_5, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 6 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_6, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 7 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_7, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 8 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_8, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 9 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_9, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 10 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_10, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 11 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_11, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 12 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_12, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 13 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_13, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 14 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_14, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 = 15 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_15, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN pay_cnt1 > 15 THEN roleid ELSE NULL END)) AS pay_cnt_15_add FROM (SELECT roleid, 'month' AS date_type, SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) AS date_detail, country, pay_channel, SUM(pay_cnt) AS pay_cnt1 FROM wk_diamond_all WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, date_detail, country, pay_channel) AS t GROUP BY date_type, date_detail, country, pay_channel), d AS (/* 本月度续费(连续两月购买，只记录当月首次) */ SELECT 'day' AS date_type, '2026-05-31' AS date_detail, country, pay_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.roleid) AS first_reten_pay_role_cnt_mon, 0 AS his_first_pay_role_cnt, 0 AS first_return_pay_role_cnt_mon, 0 AS pay_role_cnt, 0 AS pay_cnt, 0 AS pay_role_cnt_mon, 0 AS pay_cnt_mon, 0 AS pay_cnt_1, 0 AS pay_cnt_2, 0 AS pay_cnt_3, 0 AS pay_cnt_4, 0 AS pay_cnt_5, 0 AS pay_cnt_6, 0 AS pay_cnt_7, 0 AS pay_cnt_8, 0 AS pay_cnt_9, 0 AS pay_cnt_10, 0 AS pay_cnt_11, 0 AS pay_cnt_12, 0 AS pay_cnt_13, 0 AS pay_cnt_14, 0 AS pay_cnt_15, 0 AS pay_cnt_15_add FROM (SELECT roleid, pay_channel, country, pay_cnt, before_tax_usd_amt FROM wk_diamond_all WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31')) AS t1 WHERE EXISTS(/* 连续两月 */ SELECT roleid FROM wk_diamond_all AS t2 WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01'), 1 * -1), 'yyyy-MM-01') AND DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01'), 1 * -1) AND t1.roleid = t2.roleid) AND NOT EXISTS(/* 当月首次 */ SELECT roleid FROM wk_diamond_all AS t3 WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND '2026-05-30' AND t1.roleid = t3.roleid) GROUP BY country, pay_channel), f AS (/* 月度复购(历史购买，上月未购买，当月购买，只记录当月首次) */ SELECT 'day' AS date_type, '2026-05-31' AS date_detail, country, pay_channel, 0 AS first_reten_pay_role_cnt_mon, 0 AS his_first_pay_role_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.roleid) AS first_return_pay_role_cnt_mon, 0 AS pay_role_cnt, 0 AS pay_cnt, 0 AS pay_role_cnt_mon, 0 AS pay_cnt_mon, 0 AS pay_cnt_1, 0 AS pay_cnt_2, 0 AS pay_cnt_3, 0 AS pay_cnt_4, 0 AS pay_cnt_5, 0 AS pay_cnt_6, 0 AS pay_cnt_7, 0 AS pay_cnt_8, 0 AS pay_cnt_9, 0 AS pay_cnt_10, 0 AS pay_cnt_11, 0 AS pay_cnt_12, 0 AS pay_cnt_13, 0 AS pay_cnt_14, 0 AS pay_cnt_15, 0 AS pay_cnt_15_add FROM (SELECT roleid, pay_channel, country, pay_cnt, before_tax_usd_amt FROM wk_diamond_all WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31')) AS t1 WHERE NOT EXISTS(/* 上月未购买 */ SELECT roleid FROM wk_diamond_all AS t2 WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01'), 1 * -1), 'yyyy-MM-01') AND DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01'), 1 * -1) AND t1.roleid = t2.roleid) AND EXISTS(/* 历史购买 */ SELECT roleid FROM wk_diamond_all AS t3 WHERE logymd < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01'), 1 * -1), 'yyyy-MM-01') AND t1.roleid = t3.roleid) AND NOT EXISTS(/* 当月首次 */ SELECT roleid FROM wk_diamond_all AS t4 WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND '2026-05-30' AND t1.roleid = t4.roleid) GROUP BY country, pay_channel) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_wk_diamond_1_2_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT date_type, date_detail, COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, pay_channel, SUM(first_reten_pay_role_cnt_mon) AS first_reten_pay_role_cnt_mon, SUM(his_first_pay_role_cnt) AS his_first_pay_role_cnt, SUM(first_return_pay_role_cnt_mon) AS first_return_pay_role_cnt_mon, SUM(pay_role_cnt) AS pay_role_cnt, SUM(pay_cnt) AS pay_cnt, SUM(pay_role_cnt_mon) AS pay_role_cnt_mon, SUM(pay_cnt_mon) AS pay_cnt_mon, SUM(pay_cnt_1) AS pay_cnt_1, SUM(pay_cnt_2) AS pay_cnt_2, SUM(pay_cnt_3) AS pay_cnt_3, SUM(pay_cnt_4) AS pay_cnt_4, SUM(pay_cnt_5) AS pay_cnt_5, SUM(pay_cnt_6) AS pay_cnt_6, SUM(pay_cnt_7) AS pay_cnt_7, SUM(pay_cnt_8) AS pay_cnt_8, SUM(pay_cnt_9) AS pay_cnt_9, SUM(pay_cnt_10) AS pay_cnt_10, SUM(pay_cnt_11) AS pay_cnt_11, SUM(pay_cnt_12) AS pay_cnt_12, SUM(pay_cnt_13) AS pay_cnt_13, SUM(pay_cnt_14) AS pay_cnt_14, SUM(pay_cnt_15) AS pay_cnt_15, SUM(pay_cnt_15_add) AS pay_cnt_15_add FROM (SELECT date_type, date_detail, country, pay_channel, first_reten_pay_role_cnt_mon, his_first_pay_role_cnt, first_return_pay_role_cnt_mon, pay_role_cnt, pay_cnt, pay_role_cnt_mon, pay_cnt_mon, pay_cnt_1, pay_cnt_2, pay_cnt_3, pay_cnt_4, pay_cnt_5, pay_cnt_6, pay_cnt_7, pay_cnt_8, pay_cnt_9, pay_cnt_10, pay_cnt_11, pay_cnt_12, pay_cnt_13, pay_cnt_14, pay_cnt_15, pay_cnt_15_add FROM (SELECT * FROM a UNION ALL SELECT * FROM b UNION ALL SELECT * FROM c UNION ALL SELECT * FROM d UNION ALL SELECT * FROM f) AS t1) AS t GROUP BY date_type, date_detail, country, pay_channel

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_road_info_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH battle_end AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, IF(wincamp = 1, 1, 0) AS wincamp, `time`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY SUBSTRING(`time`, 1, 19) DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND (battleresulttype = 0 OR battleresulttype IS NULL)) WHERE rn = 1), battleenddata AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid /*	账号ID */, zoneid /*	分区ID */, battleid, MAX(roadsort) AS roadsort FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(isbot, 0) = 0 GROUP BY accountid /*	账号ID */, zoneid /*	分区ID */, battleid), battle_res AS (SELECT b.roleid /*	账号ID */, b.zoneid, b.pvptype, CASE WHEN a.roadsort IN (1, 5) THEN 5 /* 战斗金币路 */ WHEN a.roadsort IN (101, 105) THEN 1 /* 战斗经验数 */ WHEN a.roadsort = 2 THEN 2 /* 战斗中路 */ WHEN a.roadsort IN (3, 3000, 3001, 3002, 3004, 3005, 3101, 3105) THEN 3 /* 战斗游走位 */ WHEN a.roadsort = 4 THEN 4 /* 战斗打野位 */ ELSE 0 END AS roadsort, b.wincamp, b.`time` FROM battleenddata AS a JOIN battle_end AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.battleid = b.battleid ORDER BY b.roleid /*	账号ID */, b.zoneid, b.pvptype, b.`time` DESC) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_road_info_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, IF(SIZE(battleroad_info) > 50, SUBARRAY(battleroad_info, 0, 50), battleroad_info) AS battleroad_info FROM (SELECT COALESCE(td.roleid, yd.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(td.zoneid, yd.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(td.pvptype, yd.pvptype) AS pvptype, CONCAT(COALESCE(td.battleroad_info, ARRAY()), COALESCE(yd.battleroad_info, ARRAY())) AS battleroad_info FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(roadsort, wincamp)) AS battleroad_info FROM battle_res GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype) AS td FULL JOIN (SELECT roleid /*	角色ID */, zoneid /*	分区ID */, pvptype /*	战斗类型 */, battleroad_info /*	近50场战斗位图 */, logymd /*	分区日期YYYY-MM-DD */ FROM mt_dwd.dwd_road_info_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS yd ON td.roleid = yd.roleid AND td.zoneid = yd.zoneid AND td.pvptype = yd.pvptype)

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_pay_role_zone_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_pay_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, receipt_type, sub_pay_channel, MIN(first_pay_time) AS first_pay_time, MAX(last_pay_time) AS last_pay_time, SUM(pay_amt) AS pay_amt, SUM(pay_cnt) AS pay_cnt, SUM(pay_amt_official) AS pay_amt_official, SUM(pay_amt_particular) AS pay_amt_particular, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(product_type, ':', pay_amt))), ',', ':') AS pay_type_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, receipt_type, sub_pay_channel, product_type, MIN(`time`) AS first_pay_time, MAX(`time`) AS last_pay_time, SUM(money) AS pay_amt, COUNT(1) AS pay_cnt, SUM(pay_amt_official) AS pay_amt_official, SUM(pay_amt_particular) AS pay_amt_particular FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(receipt_type, -99999) AS receipt_type, COALESCE(TRIM(sub_pay_channel), '') AS sub_pay_channel /* 有空字符串存在，所以如果出现null都统一归到空字符串 */, COALESCE(TRIM(product_type), '') AS product_type /* 有空字符串存在，所以如果出现null都统一归到空字符串 */, money, `time`, CASE WHEN platform = 'moonton' AND product_type <> 'W币' THEN money ELSE 0 END AS pay_amt_official, CASE WHEN NOT (platform = 'moonton' AND product_type <> 'W币') OR platform IS NULL OR product_type IS NULL THEN money ELSE 0 END AS pay_amt_particular /* 如果有空无法判断则归到非官方上 */ FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND money > 0) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, receipt_type, sub_pay_channel, product_type) AS t2 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, receipt_type, sub_pay_channel

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_active_role_zone_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_active_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t_login.roleid, t_login.zoneid, t_login.first_login_os, t_login.last_login_os, t_login.first_device, t_login.last_device, t_login.first_ip, t_login.last_ip, t_login.first_deviceid, t_login.last_deviceid, t_login.first_active_time, t_login.last_active_time, COALESCE(t_logout.active_dur, 0) AS active_dur FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN login_os END) AS first_login_os, MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN login_os END) AS last_login_os, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN device END) AS first_device, MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN device END) AS last_device, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN ip END) AS first_ip, MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN ip END) AS last_ip, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN device_id END) AS first_deviceid, MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN device_id END) AS last_deviceid, MIN(active_time) AS first_active_time, MAX(active_time) AS last_active_time FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN os_type = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN os_type = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN os_type = 3 THEN 'pc' WHEN os_type = 4 THEN 'emulator' ELSE 'unknown' END AS login_os, COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device, COALESCE(ip, 'unknown') AS ip, COALESCE(device_id, 'unknown') AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS active_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time`) AS rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn_desc FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t_login LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(online_time) AS active_dur FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t_logout ON t_login.roleid = t_logout.roleid AND t_login.zoneid = t_logout.zoneid

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_active_di
sql_units: WITH date_list AS (/* 计算需要回刷的日期 */ SELECT p_date, DATE_ADD(p_date, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p_date ORDER BY p_date) - 1) * -1) AS logymd FROM (SELECT p_date FROM (SELECT REPEAT(CONCAT('2026-05-31', ','), 30) AS rep_date) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(rep_date, ',')) tbl AS p_date) WHERE p_date <> '') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_active_di PARTITION(logymd) SELECT 'device' AS granularity_type, country, os, network, register_days, is_pay, COALESCE(SUM(is_active), 0) AS active_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(is_active_7days), 0) AS active_cnt_7days, COALESCE(SUM(is_active_14days), 0) AS active_cnt_14days, COALESCE(SUM(is_active_30days), 0) AS active_cnt_30days, user_type, COALESCE(SUM(lose_cnt_7ds), 0) AS lose_cnt_7ds, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt_7ds), 0) AS active_cnt_7ds, COALESCE(SUM(lose_cnt_30ds), 0) AS lose_cnt_30ds, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt_30ds), 0) AS active_cnt_30ds, logymd FROM (SELECT LOWER(IF(TRIM(t1.country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', TRIM(t1.country))) AS country /* 首次创号国 */, LOWER(TRIM(t1.os)) AS os, LOWER(TRIM(t1.network_name)) AS network, t1.create_date, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, t1.create_date) = 0 THEN '0' WHEN DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, t1.create_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 29 THEN '1-29' WHEN DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, t1.create_date) BETWEEN 30 AND 89 THEN '30-89' WHEN DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, t1.create_date) BETWEEN 90 AND 359 THEN '90-359' ELSE '360+' END AS register_days, IF(t1.pay_amt_info[diffdays] > 0, 1, 0) AS is_pay, IF(SUBSTRING(t1.active_info, 1 + diffdays, 1) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_active, IF(LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(t1.active_info, 1 + diffdays, 7)) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_active_7days, IF(LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(t1.active_info, 1 + diffdays, 14)) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_active_14days, IF(LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(t1.active_info, 1 + diffdays, 30)) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_active_30days, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, t1.create_date) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, t1.create_date) <= 29 THEN '1' /* 新增30日用户 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, t1.create_date) >= 30 AND SUBSTRING(t1.active_info, 1 + diffdays, 1) > 0 AND LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(t1.active_info, 2 + diffdays, 30)) = 0 THEN '2' /* 30日回流用户 */ ELSE '3' END AS user_type, t1.logymd, IF(SUBSTRING(t1.active_info, 1 + diffdays + 7, 1) = 1 AND LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(t1.active_info, 1 + diffdays, 7)) = 0, 1, 0) AS lose_cnt_7ds /* 7日流失用户数 */, IF(SUBSTRING(t1.active_info, 1 + diffdays + 7, 1) = 1, 1, 0) AS active_cnt_7ds /* 7日前活跃用户数 */, IF(SUBSTRING(t1.active_info, 1 + diffdays + 30, 1) = 1 AND LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(t1.active_info, 1 + diffdays, 30)) = 0, 1, 0) AS lose_cnt_30ds /* 30日流失用户数 */, IF(SUBSTRING(t1.active_info, 1 + diffdays + 30, 1) = 1, 1, 0) AS active_cnt_30ds /* 30日前活跃用户数                    */ FROM (SELECT a.device_id, a.country, a.os, a.network_name, a.create_date, a.pay_amt_info, SUBSTRING(a.active_info, 1, 60) AS active_info /* 截取59位 */, c.logymd, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', c.logymd) AS diffdays /* 数据日期与业务日期相差天数 */ FROM adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df AS a LEFT JOIN date_list AS c ON a.p_date = c.p_date WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND a.app_id = '1001' AND LOCATE(1, a.active_info) <= 60 AND a.create_date <= c.logymd) AS t1) GROUP BY country, os, network, register_days, is_pay, user_type, logymd

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_create_moni
sql_units: WITH date_list AS (/* 计算需要回刷的日期 */ SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-31' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -1)) AS logymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_create_moni PARTITION(logymd) SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', DATE_FORMAT(t2.logymd, 'yyyy-MM-01'), t2.logymd) AS month_range /* BROADCAST(t2) */, 'device' AS granularity_type, t1.country, t1.os, t1.network, t1.new_type, COALESCE(SUM(IF(t1.create_date BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(t2.logymd, 'yyyy-MM-01') AND t2.logymd, 1, 0)), 0) AS register_cnt, COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS total_register_cnt /*	累计注册人数     */, t2.logymd FROM (SELECT muti.country, muti.os, muti.network, COALESCE(bas.new_type, -1) AS new_type, '2026-05-31' AS p_date /* muti.p_date, */, muti.create_date FROM (SELECT device_id, LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', TRIM(country))) AS country /* 首次创号国 */, LOWER(TRIM(os)) AS os, LOWER(TRIM(network_name)) AS network, create_date, p_date FROM adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df /* 上游表只保留7天数据，每次获取最大分区数据 */ WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND app_id = '1001') AS muti LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT device_id, create_time, his_first_accountid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY create_time) AS rn FROM adbi.dim_device_account_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND app_id = '1001') WHERE rn = 1) AS dev ON muti.device_id = dev.device_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, new_type FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-09-01', '2022-09-01', '2023-07-23') AND is_first_create = 1) AS bas ON dev.his_first_accountid = bas.roleid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN date_list AS t2 ON t1.p_date = t2.p_date WHERE t1.create_date <= t2.logymd GROUP BY t1.country, t1.os, t1.network, t1.new_type, t2.logymd

 ) COMMENT '各种product_id的上游表' PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd')

sql_units: WITH date_list AS (/* 计算需要回刷的日期 */ SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-31' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-24' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-17' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-10' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-03' AS logymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_pay_wi PARTITION(logymd) SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', DATE_ADD(logymd, 6 * -1), logymd) AS week_range, 'device' AS granularity_type, country, os, network, register_days, pay_grade, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt), 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay_amt > 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(is_active), 0) AS active_cnt, logymd FROM (SELECT LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', TRIM(country))) AS country /* 首次创号国 */, LOWER(TRIM(os)) AS os, LOWER(TRIM(network_name)) AS network, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) = 0 THEN '0' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 29 THEN '1-29' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) BETWEEN 30 AND 89 THEN '30-89' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) BETWEEN 90 AND 359 THEN '90-359' ELSE '360+' END AS register_days, CASE WHEN (pay_amt_info[diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[7 + diffdays], 0)) / 100 >= 0.99 AND (pay_amt_info[diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[7 + diffdays], 0)) / 100 < 4.99 THEN '0.99' WHEN (pay_amt_info[diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[7 + diffdays], 0)) / 100 >= 4.99 AND (pay_amt_info[diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[7 + diffdays], 0)) / 100 < 9.99 THEN '4.99' WHEN (pay_amt_info[diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[7 + diffdays], 0)) / 100 >= 9.99 THEN '9.99' ELSE '0' END AS pay_grade, pay_amt_info[diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[7 + diffdays], 0) AS pay_amt, IF(LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(active_info, 1 + diffdays, 7)) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_active, logymd FROM (SELECT a.country, a.os, a.network_name, a.create_date, a.pay_amt_info, SUBSTRING(a.active_info, 1, 35) AS active_info /* 截取35位 */, b.logymd, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', b.logymd) AS diffdays /* 数据日期与业务日期相差天数 */ FROM adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df AS a LEFT JOIN date_list AS b ON a.p_date = b.p_date WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND a.app_id = '1001' AND a.create_date <= b.logymd)) GROUP BY country, os, network, register_days, pay_grade, logymd

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_wk_diamond_2_3_di

${filter_sql}, 1, 0)) AS is_pay_his_not_last_2mn /* 是否前月之前有过付费 */, MAX(IF(SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) < SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -3), 1, 7) AND ${filter_sql}, 1, 0)) AS is_pay_his_not_last_3mn SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -13), 1, 7) AND ${filter_sql}, 1, 0)) AS is_pay_last_year_last_mn /* 是否上年上个月有过付费 */, MAX(IF(SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -14), 1, 7) AND ${filter_sql}, 1, 0)) AS is_pay_last_year_before_last_mn /* 是否上年前月有过付费 */ /*              , MAX(IF(SUBSTR(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -15), 1, 7) AND ${filter_sql}, 1, */ /*                       0))                                   AS is_pay_last_year_last_3mn --是否上年大前月有过付费 */, MAX(IF(SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) < SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -13), 1, 7) AND ${filter_sql}, 1, 0)) AS is_pay_last_year_not_last_mn /* 是否上年上月之前有过付费 */, MAX(IF(SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) <= SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -13), 1, 7) AND ${filter_sql}, 1, 0)) AS is_pay_his_last_year_mn /* 是否上年本月之前有过付费 */, MAX(IF(SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) <= SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -15), 1, 7) AND ${filter_sql}, 1, 0)) AS is_pay_his_last_year_not_2mn /* 是否上年前月之前有过付费 */, MAX(IF(rn = 1 AND logymd BETWEEN TRUNC('2026-05-31', 'MM') AND '2026-05-31' AND ${filter_sql}, 1, 0)) AS is_first_pay_mn /* 是否历史首次付费在本月且首次充值为购买月卡 */, MAX(IF(rn = 1 AND SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -1), 1, 7) AND ${filter_sql}, 1, 0)) AS is_first_pay_last_mn /* 是否历史首次付费在上月且首次充值为购买月卡 */, MAX(IF(rn = 1 AND SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -2), 1, 7) AND ${filter_sql}, 1, 0)) AS is_first_pay_last_2mn /* 是否历史首次付费在前月且首次充值为购买月卡 */, MAX(IF(rn = 1 AND SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -12), 1, 7) AND ${filter_sql}, 1, 0)) AS is_first_pay_last_year_mn /* 是否历史首次付费在上年同月且首次充值为购买月卡 */, MAX(IF(rn = 1 AND SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -13), 1, 7) AND ${filter_sql}, 1, 0)) AS is_first_pay_last_year_last_mn /* 是否历史首次付费在上年上月且首次充值为购买月卡 */, MIN(CASE WHEN ${filter_sql} THEN logymd END) AS first_pay_wk_diamond_lyd FROM (SELECT roleid, product_id, logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY `time`) AS rn FROM mt_dwd.dwd_wk_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_wk_diamond_2_3_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT first_reten_pay_role_cnt_mon, (first_reten_pay_role_cnt_mon - first_reten_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom) / first_reten_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom AS first_reten_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom, (first_reten_pay_role_cnt_mon - first_reten_pay_role_cnt_last_year_yoy) / first_return_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom) / first_return_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom AS first_return_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom, (first_return_pay_role_cnt_mon - first_return_pay_role_cnt_last_year_yoy) / / first_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom AS first_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom, (first_pay_role_cnt_mon - first_pay_role_cnt_last_year_yoy) / first_pay_role_cnt_last_year_yoy AS first_pay_role_cnt_last_year_yoy, first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_mon, (first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_mon - first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_mon_mom) / first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_mon_mom AS first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_mon_mom, (first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_mon - first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_year_yoy) / first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_year_yoy AS first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_year_yoy, first_reten_pay_role_cnt_last_mon /* 上月留存续费用户数 */, (first_reten_pay_role_cnt_last_mon - last_mon_first_reten_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom) / last_mon_first_reten_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom AS last_mon_first_reten_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom /* 上月续费用户数的上月环比 */, 上月续费用户数的上年同比 */, pay_role_cnt_bf_last_mon /* 上月的上月付费用户数（M-2） */, first_return_pay_role_cnt_last_mon /* 上月回流复购用户数 */, (first_return_pay_role_cnt_last_mon - AS first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_mon /* 上月历史首次购买钻石周卡,且之前未充值过的用户-付费破冰 */, (first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_mon_mom - last_mon_first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_mon_mom) / last_mon_first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_mon_mom AS last_mon_first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_mon_mom /* 上月付费破冰上月环比 */, (first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_mon_mom - last_mon_first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_year_yoy) / last_mon_first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_year_yoy AS last_mon_first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_year_yoy /* 上月付费破冰上年同比 */ FROM (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN is_pay_mn = 1 AND is_pay_last_mn = 1 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS first_reten_pay_role_cnt_mon /* 本月留存续费用户数 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_pay_last_mn = 1 AND
