is_pay_last_year_mn = 1 AND is_pay_last_year_last_mn = 0 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS first_return_pay_role_cnt_last_year_yoy /* 复购用户数上年同比 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_pay_before_last_mn = 1 AND is_pay_last_mn = 0 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS notpay_bf_mon_not_newpay_mon_cnt /* 前月付费过，且上个月未付费也非新增的用户数 */, COUNT(IF(first_pay_wk_diamond_lyd BETWEEN TRUNC('2026-05-31', 'MM') AND '2026-05-31', roleid, NULL)) AS first_pay_role_cnt_mon, COUNT(IF(SUBSTRING(first_pay_wk_diamond_lyd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -1), 1, 7), roleid, NULL)) AS first_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom, COUNT(IF(SUBSTRING(first_pay_wk_diamond_lyd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -12), 1, 7), roleid, NULL)) AS first_pay_role_cnt_last_year_yoy /*      , count(if(first_pay_wk_diamond_lyd BETWEEN TRUNC('2026-05-31', 'MM') AND '2026-05-31' then roleid end)) as first_pay_role_cnt_last_year_yoy */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_first_pay_mn = 1 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_mon /* 本月历史首次购买钻石周卡,且之前未充值过的用户-付费破冰 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_first_pay_last_mn = 1 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_mon_mom /* 付费破冰上月环比 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_first_pay_last_year_mn = 1 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_year_yoy /* 付费破冰上年同比 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_first_pay_last_2mn = 1 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS last_mon_first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_mon_mom /* 上月付费破冰上月环比 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_first_pay_last_year_last_mn = 1 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS last_mon_first_pay_role_cnt_mon_his_notpay_bf_last_year_yoy /* 上月付费破冰上年同比 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_pay_last_mn = 1 AND is_pay_before_last_mn = 1 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS first_reten_pay_role_cnt_last_mon /* 上月续费用户数 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_pay_before_last_mn = 1 AND is_pay_last_3mn = 1 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS last_mon_first_reten_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom /* 前月续费用户数 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_pay_last_year_last_mn = 1 AND is_pay_last_year_before_last_mn = 1 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS last_mon_first_reten_pay_role_cnt_last_year_yoy /* 上年上月续费用户数 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_pay_before_last_mn = 1 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS pay_role_cnt_bf_last_mon /* 前月付费用户数 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_pay_before_last_mn = 0 AND is_pay_last_mn = 1 AND is_pay_his_not_last_2mn = 1 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS first_return_pay_role_cnt_last_mon /* 上月回流复购用户数 */ /* 前月有，大前月无， 大前月之前有 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_pay_before_last_mn = 1 AND is_pay_last_3mn = 0 AND is_pay_his_not_last_3mn = 1 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS last_mon_first_return_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom /* 上月复购用户数的上月环比 */ /* 上年前月之前有， 前月没有， 上月有 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_pay_his_last_year_not_2mn = 1 AND is_pay_last_year_before_last_mn = 0 AND is_pay_last_year_last_mn = 1 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS last_mon_first_return_pay_role_cnt_last_year_yoy /* 上月复购用户数的上年同比 */, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_pay_last_3mn = 1 AND is_pay_before_last_mn = 0 THEN t_charge.roleid END) AS notpay_bf_mon_not_newpay_last_mon_cnt /* 上月的前月付费过，且上月的上个月未付费也非新增的用户数 */ /*      ,                      AS first_pay_role_cnt_last_mon        --上月历史首次购买钻石周卡的用户数-功能破冰 */, COUNT(IF(SUBSTRING(first_pay_wk_diamond_lyd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -2), 1, 7), roleid, NULL)) AS last_mon_first_pay_role_cnt_last_mon_mom /* 上月功能破冰上月环比 */, COUNT(IF(SUBSTRING(first_pay_wk_diamond_lyd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -12), 1, 7), roleid, NULL)) AS last_mon_first_pay_role_cnt_last_year_yoy /* 上月功能破冰上年同比 */ FROM t_charge) AS t

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_wk_diamond_3_1_df
sql_units: /* 玩家国家属性 */ WITH role_basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_first_create = 1), wk_charge /* 周卡总用户，钻石周卡周期为每年1月25号开始计算，起始日期为2023-01-25 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.country, b.logymd FROM role_basic AS a INNER JOIN mt_dwd.dwd_wk_role_zone_di AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE b.logymd >= '2023-01-25' AND b.logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND b.zoneid < 57000 AND (product_id LIKE '%weekly_diamond%' OR product_id = 'com.moonton.diamond_vng_one_time_wk_diamond') GROUP BY a.roleid, a.country, b.logymd), wk_role_cnt /*  月度购买钻石周卡总用户数（历史所有月份的月度用户数） */ AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) AS date_detail, country, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS pay_role_mon_cnt FROM wk_charge GROUP BY country, date_detail), month_index_map /* 玩家月度位图坐标 */ AS (SELECT roleid, country, date_detail, curr_date, month_end, month_start, DATEDIFF(curr_date, month_end) + 1 AS active_map_start, DATEDIFF(month_end, month_start) + 1 AS active_map_step FROM (SELECT roleid, country, date_detail, CONCAT(date_detail, '-01') AS month_start, IF(date_detail = '2026-05', '2026-05-31', DATE_ADD(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(DATE_ADD(CONCAT(date_detail, '-01'), 32), 1, 7), '-01'), -1)) AS month_end, IF('2026-05-31' < '2023-08-28', '2023-08-28', '2026-05-31') AS curr_date FROM (SELECT roleid, country, SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) AS date_detail FROM wk_charge GROUP BY roleid, country, date_detail))), wk_active_info /* 月度钻石周卡用户总活跃位图 */ AS (SELECT b.roleid, b.country, MAX(a.active_info) AS active_info FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df AS a INNER JOIN wk_charge AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE a.logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, -2)) AND a.logymd >= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, -2) GROUP BY b.roleid, b.country), wk_acitve_day_cnt /* 月度钻石周卡用户总活跃天数（历史所有月份的月度天数） active_info是按照register_date偏移的位图，左侧为最新日期，右侧为注册日期 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.country, b.date_detail, SUM(LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(SUBSTRING(a.active_info, b.active_map_start, b.active_map_step), '0', ''))) AS pay_role_active_cnt, MAX(DATEDIFF(b.month_end, b.month_start) + 1) AS month_day_cnt FROM wk_active_info AS a LEFT JOIN month_index_map AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.country = b.country GROUP BY a.roleid, a.country, b.date_detail) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_wk_diamond_3_1_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(a.country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(SUM(a.pay_role_active_cnt), 0) AS pay_role_active_cnt, COALESCE(MAX(b.pay_role_mon_cnt), 0) AS pay_role_mon_cnt, MAX(month_day_cnt) AS month_day_cnt, 'month' AS date_type, a.date_detail FROM wk_acitve_day_cnt AS a INNER JOIN wk_role_cnt AS b ON a.country = b.country AND a.date_detail = b.date_detail GROUP BY a.country, a.date_detail

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_mla_multi_behavior_account_df
sql_units: WITH dim_basic AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, init_roleid, usercreateymd, first_ad_country /*	首次归因国家 */, last_ad_country /*	末次归因国家 */, os_country /*	设备创号国 */, first_mt_country /*	首次创号国 */, last_mt_country /*	末次创号国 */, usercreateymd, role_create_channel AS game_channel, os, CASE WHEN os = 'ios' THEN 1 WHEN os = 'android' THEN 2 WHEN os = 'emulator' THEN 3 ELSE 'unknown' END AS os_type, first_network_name, last_network_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY register_date) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT zoneid BETWEEN 9000 AND 9999 /* 过滤测试服数据 */) WHERE rn = 1), dim_attr AS (SELECT accountid /*	账号id(key) */, account_register_time /*	首次创建账号时间 */, account_register_date /*	首次创建账号日期 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mla'), active_df AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, his_first_active_device_id, SUBSTRING(his_first_active_time, 1, 10) AS his_first_active_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY his_first_active_time) AS rn FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') WHERE rn = 1), charge_df AS (SELECT roleid AS accountid, SUBSTRING(MIN(his_first_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_first_pay_date, SUM(his_charge_money) AS pay_amt_total, SUM(his_charge_cnt) AS pay_cnt_total FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid), info_df AS (SELECT accountid, register_date, IF(LENGTH(active_info) > 0 AND '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(active_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(active_info))), COALESCE(active_info, '')) AS active_info, IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_cnt_total_array, CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)), 2), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>)), COALESCE(charge_cnt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS pay_cnt_total_array, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_amt_total_array, CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)), 2), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>)), COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS pay_amt_total_array FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, MIN(register_date) AS register_date, BITMAP_MERGE(active_info) AS active_info, ARRAY_MERGE(charge_cnt_total_array) AS charge_cnt_total_array, ARRAY_MERGE(charge_amt_total_array) AS charge_amt_total_array FROM mt_dm.dm_mla_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid)), attribution_df AS (SELECT accountid, IF(adjust_network_name = '' OR adjust_network_name IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_network_name) AS adjust_network_name, IF(adjust_campaign_name = '' OR adjust_campaign_name IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_campaign_name) AS adjust_campaign_name, IF(adjust_campaign_id = '' OR adjust_campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_campaign_id) AS adjust_campaign_id, IF(adjust_adset_name = '' OR adjust_adset_name IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_adset_name) AS adjust_adgroup_name, IF(adjust_adset_id = '' OR adjust_adset_id IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_adset_id) AS adjust_adgroup_id, IF(adjust_creative_name = '' OR adjust_creative_name IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_creative_name) AS adjust_creative_name, IF(adjust_creative_id = '' OR adjust_creative_id IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_creative_id) AS adjust_creative_id FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mla') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mla_multi_behavior_account_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT bas.accountid, bas.init_roleid, COALESCE(bas.os_type, -99999) AS os_type, COALESCE(bas.os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(bas.game_channel, 'unknown') AS game_channel, COALESCE(bas.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(bas.last_ad_country, 'unknown') AS last_ad_country, COALESCE(bas.os_country, 'unknown') AS os_country, COALESCE(bas.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(bas.last_mt_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, COALESCE(bas.first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_network_name, 'unknown') AS last_network_name, COALESCE(atr.account_register_date, 'unknown') AS account_register_date, COALESCE(atr.account_register_time, 'unknown') AS account_register_time, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_campaign_id, 'unknown') AS campaign_id, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_campaign_name, 'unknown') AS campaign_name, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_adgroup_id, 'unknown') AS adgroup_id, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_adgroup_name, 'unknown') AS adgroup_name, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_creative_id, 'unknown') AS creative_id, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_creative_name, 'unknown') AS creative_name, COALESCE(act.his_first_active_device_id, 'unknown') AS his_first_deviceid, COALESCE(act.his_first_active_date, 'unknown') AS his_first_active_date, COALESCE(ifo.active_info, 'unknown') AS active_info, COALESCE(chg.his_first_pay_date, 'unknown') AS his_first_pay_date, COALESCE(chg.pay_amt_total, 0) AS pay_amt_total, COALESCE(chg.pay_cnt_total, 0) AS pay_cnt_total, COALESCE(ifo.pay_amt_total_array, ARRAY()) AS pay_amt_total_array, COALESCE(ifo.pay_cnt_total_array, ARRAY()) AS pay_cnt_total_array, COALESCE(bas.usercreateymd, 'unknown') AS role_register_date FROM dim_basic AS bas LEFT JOIN dim_attr AS atr ON bas.accountid = atr.accountid LEFT JOIN active_df AS act ON bas.accountid = act.accountid LEFT JOIN charge_df AS chg ON bas.accountid = chg.accountid LEFT JOIN info_df AS ifo ON bas.accountid = ifo.accountid LEFT JOIN attribution_df AS atibut ON bas.accountid = atibut.accountid

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_wk_diamond_3_2_df
sql_units: /* 玩家国家属性 */ WITH role_basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_first_create = 1), wk_charge /* 周卡总用户，钻石周卡周期为每年1月25号开始计算，起始日期为2023-01-25 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.country, b.logymd, SUM(b.before_tax_amt / b.currency_exchange_rate) / 100 AS before_tax_usd_amt, IF('2026-05-31' >= '2026-01-25', '2026-01-25', '2025-01-25') AS start_day, '2026-05-31' AS end_day, IF('2025-05-31' >= '2025-01-25', '2025-01-25', '2024-01-25') AS last_start_day, '2025-05-31' AS last_end_day FROM role_basic AS a INNER JOIN mt_dwd.dwd_wk_role_zone_di AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE b.logymd >= '2023-01-25' AND b.logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND b.zoneid < 57000 AND (product_id LIKE '%weekly_diamond%' OR product_id = 'com.moonton.diamond_vng_one_time_wk_diamond') GROUP BY a.roleid, a.country, b.logymd), wk_new_role /* 钻石周卡新增用户 */ AS (SELECT country, roleid, start_day, end_day, last_start_day, last_end_day, MIN(logymd) AS create_day FROM wk_charge GROUP BY country, roleid, start_day, end_day, last_start_day, last_end_day), wk_new_role_cnt AS (SELECT country, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS his_first_pay_role_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT last_roleid) AS his_first_pay_role_cnt_last_year FROM (SELECT country, IF(create_day >= start_day AND create_day <= end_day, roleid, NULL) AS roleid, IF(create_day >= last_start_day AND create_day <= last_end_day, roleid, NULL) AS last_roleid FROM wk_new_role) GROUP BY country), wk_pay_amt_total_array /* 钻石周卡用户累计充值金额数组 */ AS (SELECT country, ARRAY(CAST(SUM(ltv0) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv1) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv2) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv3) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv4) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv5) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv6) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv7) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv8) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv9) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv10) AS DECIMAL(38, 2))) AS charge_amt_total_array, ARRAY(CAST(SUM(ltv00) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv01) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv02) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv03) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv04) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv05) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv06) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv07) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv08) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv09) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv010) AS DECIMAL(38, 2))) AS charge_amt_total_array_last_year FROM (SELECT a.country, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 30 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv0, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 30 AND b.create_day >= a.last_start_day AND b.create_day <= a.last_end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv00, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 60 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv1, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 60 AND b.create_day >= a.last_start_day AND b.create_day <= a.last_end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv01, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 90 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv2, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 90 AND b.create_day >= a.last_start_day AND b.create_day <= a.last_end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv02, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 120 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv3, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 120 AND b.create_day >= a.last_start_day AND b.create_day <= a.last_end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv03, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 150 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv4, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 150 AND b.create_day >= a.last_start_day AND b.create_day <= a.last_end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv04, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 180 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv5, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 180 AND b.create_day >= a.last_start_day AND b.create_day <= a.last_end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv05, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 210 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv6, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 210 AND b.create_day >= a.last_start_day AND b.create_day <= a.last_end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv06, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 240 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv7, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 240 AND b.create_day >= a.last_start_day AND b.create_day <= a.last_end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv07, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 270 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv8, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 270 AND b.create_day >= a.last_start_day AND b.create_day <= a.last_end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv08, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 300 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv9, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 300 AND b.create_day >= a.last_start_day AND b.create_day <= a.last_end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv09, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 330 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv10, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 330 AND b.create_day >= a.last_start_day AND b.create_day <= a.last_end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv010 FROM wk_charge AS a INNER JOIN wk_new_role AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.country = b.country WHERE a.logymd >= b.create_day) GROUP BY country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_wk_diamond_3_2_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(a.country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(a.his_first_pay_role_cnt, 0) AS his_first_pay_role_cnt, COALESCE(b.charge_amt_total_array, ARRAY()) AS charge_amt_total_array, COALESCE(a.his_first_pay_role_cnt_last_year, 0) AS his_first_pay_role_cnt_last_year, COALESCE(b.charge_amt_total_array_last_year, ARRAY()) AS charge_amt_total_array_last_year FROM wk_new_role_cnt AS a INNER JOIN wk_pay_amt_total_array AS b ON a.country = b.country

first_network_type, COALESCE(di.day_last_network_type, df.his_last_network_type) AS last_network_type, df.his_first_os_language AS first_os_language, COALESCE(di.day_last_os_language, df.his_last_os_language) AS last_os_language, df.his_first_ip_country AS first_ip_country, COALESCE(di.day_last_ip_country, df.his_last_ip_country) AS last_ip_country, df.his_first_client_version AS first_client_version, COALESCE(di.day_last_client_version, df.his_last_client_version) AS last_client_version, df.his_first_sdk_version AS first_sdk_version, COALESCE(di.day_last_sdk_version, df.his_last_sdk_version) AS last_sdk_version, df.his_first_login_time AS first_login_time, COALESCE(di.day_last_login_time, df.his_last_login_time) AS last_login_time, df.activedays + IF(di.app_id IS NULL, 0, 1) AS activedays, CONCAT(IF(di.app_id IS NULL, '0', '1'), df.active_info) AS active_info, COALESCE(df.stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_account_df AS df LEFT JOIN (SELECT di.app_id, di.package_name, di.account_id, di.os, di.day_last_model, di.day_last_os_version, di.day_last_client_ip, di.day_last_network_type, di.day_last_os_language, di.day_last_ip_country, di.day_last_client_version, di.day_last_sdk_version, di.day_first_login_time, di.day_last_login_time, di.stage_id FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_account_di AS di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS di ON df.app_id = di.app_id AND df.account_id = di.account_id AND CASE WHEN df.stage_id IS NULL THEN '01' ELSE df.stage_id END = CASE WHEN di.stage_id IS NULL THEN '01' ELSE di.stage_id END WHERE df.logymd = '2026-05-30' UNION ALL SELECT package_name, account_id, os, di.app_id, day_first_client_ip AS first_client_ip, day_last_client_ip AS last_client_ip, day_first_model AS first_model, day_last_model AS last_model, day_first_os_version AS first_os_version, day_last_os_version AS last_os_version, day_first_network_type AS first_network_type, day_last_network_type AS last_network_type, day_first_os_language AS first_os_language, day_last_os_language AS last_os_language, day_first_ip_country AS first_ip_country, day_last_ip_country AS last_ip_country, day_first_client_version AS first_client_version, day_last_client_version AS last_client_version, day_first_sdk_version AS first_sdk_version, day_last_sdk_version AS last_sdk_version, day_first_login_time AS first_login_time, day_last_login_time AS last_login_time, 1 AS activedays, '1' AS active_info, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_account_di AS di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT account_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_account_df AS df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND df.app_id = di.app_id AND df.account_id = di.account_id AND CASE WHEN df.stage_id IS NULL THEN '01' ELSE df.stage_id END = CASE WHEN di.stage_id IS NULL THEN '01' ELSE di.stage_id END)) AS main_data LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, account_id, os, package_name, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, ip_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, createdate, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS basic_df ON main_data.app_id = basic_df.app_id AND main_data.account_id = basic_df.account_id AND main_data.stage_id = basic_df.stage_id

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_wk_diamond_3_4_df
sql_units: /* 玩家国家属性 */ WITH role_basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_first_create = 1), wk_charge /* 周卡总用户，钻石周卡周期为每年1月25号开始计算，起始日期为2023-01-25 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.country, b.logymd, SUM(b.before_tax_amt / b.currency_exchange_rate) / 100 AS before_tax_usd_amt, IF('2026-05-31' >= '2026-01-25', '2026-01-25', '2025-01-25') AS start_day, '2026-05-31' AS end_day, IF('2025-05-31' >= '2025-01-25', '2025-01-25', '2024-01-25') AS last_start_day, '2025-05-31' AS last_end_day FROM role_basic AS a INNER JOIN mt_dwd.dwd_wk_role_zone_di AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE b.logymd >= '2023-01-25' AND b.logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND b.zoneid < 57000 AND (product_id LIKE '%weekly_diamond%' OR product_id = 'com.moonton.diamond_vng_one_time_wk_diamond') GROUP BY a.roleid, a.country, b.logymd), wk_new_role /* 钻石周卡新增用户 */ AS (SELECT country, roleid, start_day, end_day, last_start_day, last_end_day, MIN(logymd) AS create_day FROM wk_charge GROUP BY country, roleid, start_day, end_day, last_start_day, last_end_day), wk_new_role_cnt AS (SELECT country, create_day AS his_first_pay_wk_date, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS his_first_pay_role_cnt FROM (SELECT country, create_day, IF(create_day >= start_day AND create_day <= end_day, roleid, NULL) AS roleid FROM wk_new_role) GROUP BY country, create_day), wk_pay_amt_total_array /* 钻石周卡用户累计充值金额数组 */ AS (SELECT country, his_first_pay_wk_date, ARRAY(CAST(SUM(ltv0) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv1) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv2) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv3) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv4) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv5) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv6) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv7) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv8) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv9) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)), CAST(SUM(ltv10) AS DECIMAL(38, 2))) AS charge_amt_total_array FROM (SELECT a.country, b.create_day AS his_first_pay_wk_date, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 30 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv0, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 60 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv1, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 90 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv2, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 120 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv3, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 150 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv4, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 180 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv5, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 210 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv6, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 240 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv7, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 270 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv8, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 300 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv9, IF(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.create_day) < 330 AND b.create_day >= a.start_day AND b.create_day <= a.end_day, a.before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS ltv10 FROM wk_charge AS a INNER JOIN wk_new_role AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.country = b.country WHERE a.logymd >= b.create_day) GROUP BY country, his_first_pay_wk_date) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_wk_diamond_3_4_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(a.country, 'unknown') AS country, a.his_first_pay_wk_date, COALESCE(a.his_first_pay_role_cnt, 0) AS his_first_pay_role_cnt, COALESCE(b.charge_amt_total_array, ARRAY()) AS charge_amt_total_array FROM wk_new_role_cnt AS a INNER JOIN wk_pay_amt_total_array AS b ON a.country = b.country AND a.his_first_pay_wk_date = b.his_first_pay_wk_date

name: export_bytedance.ml_ods.mailsenderserver_send_mail
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.mailsenderserver_send_mail PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, target_email, template_name, lang, mail_server, success, cost_time, accountid FROM (SELECT time, target_email, template_name, lang, mail_server, success, cost_time, accountid, logymd FROM ml_ods.mailsenderserver_send_mail WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(lang, '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS md LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_account FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-07', '2022-05-07', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON md.accountid = adv_us.us_account WHERE adv_us.us_account IS NULL

name: 排位英雄数据分析
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: banishyuan@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-09-18 11:10:14.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH tb_win_rate AS (SELECT heroid, (CASE WHEN skillid = 20020 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS isjungle /* 是否是打野 */, COUNT(1) AS usenum, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN minranklvl > 15 AND wincamp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN minranklvl > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS total_win_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 16 AND 20 AND wincamp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS epic_win_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 AND wincamp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS legend_win_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 26 AND 27 AND wincamp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 26 AND 27 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS myth_0_19_win_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 28 AND 30 AND wincamp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 28 AND 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS myth_20_49_win_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN minranklvl >= 31 AND wincamp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN minranklvl >= 31 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS myth_50_win_rate FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2 AND zoneid < 50000 AND skillid > 0 AND minranklvl > 15 GROUP BY heroid, (CASE WHEN skillid = 20020 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.table_mlbb_hero_win_rate PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT b.hero_id, b.hero_name, b.road_type, b.damage_type, b.career_type, a.total_win_rate, a.epic_win_rate, a.legend_win_rate, a.myth_0_19_win_rate, a.myth_20_49_win_rate, a.myth_50_win_rate, a.isjungle, a.usenum FROM tb_win_rate AS a INNER JOIN ml_temp.table_mlbb_hero_info AS b ON a.heroid = b.hero_id ORDER BY heroid, isjungle

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_zgame_multi_behavior_account_df
sql_units: WITH dim_basic AS (SELECT roleid AS accountid /*	账号id,key */, account_create_os AS os /*	创角操作系统平台（ios:os_type=1，android:os_type=2，emulator:os_type=3，unknown:os_type=其他） */, CASE WHEN account_create_os = 'ios' THEN 1 WHEN account_create_os = 'android' THEN 2 WHEN account_create_os = 'pc' THEN 3 WHEN account_create_os = 'emulator' THEN 4 ELSE -99999 END AS os_type, create_channel AS game_channel /*	创角渠道 */, register_time /*	角色创建时间 */, register_date /*	角色创建日期 */, create_ip /*	创角IP */, LOWER(create_country) AS create_country /*	创角国家（来源:zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_create_role. createrole_country） */, first_ad_country /*	首次adjust归因国家 */, last_ad_country /*	末次adjust归因国家 */, first_mt_country /*	首次创号国 */, last_mt_country /*	末次创号国 */, first_network_name /*	首次adjust归因广告渠道 */, last_network_name /*	末次adjust归因广告渠道 */, account_register_time /*	首次创建账号时间 */, account_register_date /*	首次创建账号日期 */, account_create_os /*	创号操作系统平台（ios:os_type=1，android:os_type=2，emulator:os_type=3，unknown:os_type=其他） */ FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY register_time) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') WHERE rn = 1), info_df AS (SELECT roleid AS accountid, active_info, pay_info, pay_cnt_total_array, pay_amt_total_array, pay_cnt_total_array[0] AS pay_cnt_total /* 总付费次数 */, pay_amt_total_array[0] AS pay_amt_total /* 总付费金额 */, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', LENGTH(TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM pay_info)) * -1) AS his_first_pay_date /* 历史首次付费日期 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, IF(SIZE(pay_cnt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(pay_cnt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(pay_cnt_total_array, CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(pay_cnt_total_array)), 2), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>)), COALESCE(pay_cnt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS pay_cnt_total_array, IF(SIZE(pay_amt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(pay_amt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(pay_amt_total_array, CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(pay_amt_total_array)), 2), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>)), COALESCE(pay_amt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS pay_amt_total_array, IF(LENGTH(active_info) > 0 AND '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(active_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(active_info))), COALESCE(active_info, '')) AS active_info, IF(LENGTH(pay_info) > 0 AND '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(pay_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(pay_info))), COALESCE(pay_info, '')) AS pay_info FROM (SELECT roleid, MIN(register_date) AS register_date, BITMAP_MERGE(active_info) AS active_info, BITMAP_MERGE(pay_info) AS pay_info, ARRAY_MERGE(pay_cnt_total_array) AS pay_cnt_total_array, ARRAY_MERGE(pay_amt_total_array) AS pay_amt_total_array FROM mt_dm.dm_zgame_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid))), active_df AS (SELECT roleid AS accountid, zoneid, his_first_login_os, his_last_login_os, his_first_device, his_last_device, his_first_ip, his_last_ip, his_first_deviceid, his_last_deviceid, his_first_active_time, his_last_active_time FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY his_first_active_time) AS rn FROM mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'zgame') WHERE rn = 1), attribution_df AS (SELECT accountid, IF(adjust_network_name = '' OR adjust_network_name IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_network_name) AS adjust_network_name, IF(adjust_campaign_name = '' OR adjust_campaign_name IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_campaign_name) AS adjust_campaign_name, IF(adjust_campaign_id = '' OR adjust_campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_campaign_id) AS adjust_campaign_id, IF(adjust_adset_name = '' OR adjust_adset_name IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_adset_name) AS adjust_adgroup_name, IF(adjust_adset_id = '' OR adjust_adset_id IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_adset_id) AS adjust_adgroup_id, IF(adjust_creative_name = '' OR adjust_creative_name IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_creative_name) AS adjust_creative_name, IF(adjust_creative_id = '' OR adjust_creative_id IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_creative_id) AS adjust_creative_id FROM mt_dwd.dwd_zgame_account_attribution_df WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_zgame_multi_behavior_account_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT bas.accountid, COALESCE(bas.os_type, -99999) AS os_type, COALESCE(bas.os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(bas.game_channel, 'unknown') AS game_channel, COALESCE(bas.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(bas.last_ad_country, 'unknown') AS last_ad_country, COALESCE(bas.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(bas.last_mt_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, COALESCE(bas.first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_network_name, 'unknown') AS last_network_name, COALESCE(bas.account_register_date, 'unknown') AS account_register_date, COALESCE(bas.account_register_time, 'unknown') AS account_register_time, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_campaign_id, 'unknown') AS campaign_id, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_campaign_name, 'unknown') AS campaign_name, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_adgroup_id, 'unknown') AS adgroup_id, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_adgroup_name, 'unknown') AS adgroup_name, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_creative_id, 'unknown') AS creative_id, COALESCE(atibut.adjust_creative_name, 'unknown') AS creative_name, IF(act.his_first_deviceid IS NULL OR act.his_first_deviceid = '', 'unknown', act.his_first_deviceid) AS his_first_deviceid, COALESCE(SUBSTRING(act.his_first_active_time, 1, 10), '1970-01-01') AS his_first_active_date, COALESCE(ifo.active_info, '') AS active_info, COALESCE(ifo.his_first_pay_date, '1970-01-01') AS his_first_pay_date, COALESCE(ifo.pay_amt_total, 0) AS pay_amt_total, COALESCE(ifo.pay_cnt_total, 0) AS pay_cnt_total, COALESCE(ifo.pay_amt_total_array, ARRAY()) AS pay_amt_total_array, COALESCE(ifo.pay_cnt_total_array, ARRAY()) AS pay_cnt_total_array, register_date AS role_register_date FROM dim_basic AS bas LEFT JOIN active_df AS act ON bas.accountid = act.accountid LEFT JOIN info_df AS ifo ON bas.accountid = ifo.accountid LEFT JOIN attribution_df AS atibut ON bas.accountid = atibut.accountid

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_zgame_pay_lottery_di
sql_units: /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_ads.ads_zgame_pay_lottery_di( */ /*     `cumlpmt_label` STRING COMMENT '付费分段', */ /*     `active_role_num` INT COMMENT '活跃人数', */ /*     `lottery_role_num` INT COMMENT '抽奖人数', */ /*     `blue_lottery_role_num` INT COMMENT '蓝色抽奖人数', */ /*     `gold_lottery_role_num` INT COMMENT '金色抽奖人数', */ /*     `boss_lottery_role_num` INT COMMENT 'boss抽奖人数', */ /*     `blue_lottery_cnt` INT COMMENT '蓝色抽奖计数', */ /*     `gold_lottery_cnt` INT COMMENT '金色抽奖计数', */ /*     `boss_lottery_cnt` INT COMMENT 'boss抽奖计数' */ /* )COMMENT 'zgame-每日抽卡表-付费分段' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '统计日期YYYY-MM-DD') STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_zgame_pay_lottery_di'; */ WITH role_info AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 = 1 THEN '0_当天新增' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '1_2-3天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN '2_4-7天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN '3_8-14天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 15 AND 21 THEN '4_15-21天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 22 AND 28 THEN '5_22-28天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 > 28 THEN '6_28天以上' END AS regday_label FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_inner_account_info_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE b.roleid IS NULL), charge_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN daily_pmt_cuml = 0 THEN '0_0$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 0 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 50 THEN '1_0-50$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 50 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 100 THEN '2_50-100$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 100 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 200 THEN '3_100-200$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 200 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 500 THEN '4_200-500$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 500 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 1000 THEN '5_500-1000$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 1000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 2000 THEN '6_1000-2000$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 2000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 5000 THEN '7_2000-5000$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 5000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 10000 THEN '8_5000-1w$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 10000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 20000 THEN '9_1w-2w$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 20000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 30000 THEN '91_2w-3w$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 30000 THEN '92_>3w$' END AS cumlpmt_label FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money) / 100 AS daily_pmt_cuml FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a), active_info AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001), lottery_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(CAST(pool_id AS STRING), 1, 1) AS type, SUM(COALESCE(is_ten, 0)) AS cnt FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_lottery WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(CAST(pool_id AS STRING), 1, 1)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_zgame_pay_lottery_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(cumlpmt_label, '0_0$') AS cumlpmt_label, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS active_role_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT l.roleid, l.zoneid) AS lottery_role_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(type = '2', CONCAT(l.roleid, '_', l.zoneid), NULL)) AS blue_lottery_role_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(type = '3', CONCAT(l.roleid, '_', l.zoneid), NULL)) AS gold_lottery_role_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(type = '4', CONCAT(l.roleid, '_', l.zoneid), NULL)) AS boss_lottery_role_cnt, SUM(IF(type = '2', cnt, 0)) AS blue_lottery_cnt, SUM(IF(type = '3', cnt, 0)) AS gold_lottery_cnt, SUM(IF(type = '4', cnt, 0)) AS boss_lottery_cnt FROM role_info AS r LEFT JOIN charge_info AS c ON r.roleid = c.roleid AND r.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN active_info AS a ON r.roleid = a.roleid AND r.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN lottery_info AS l ON r.roleid = l.roleid AND r.zoneid = l.zoneid GROUP BY COALESCE(cumlpmt_label, '0_0$')

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-10-09 14:18:57.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_ads.ads_zgame_pay_resource_inventory_di( */ /*     `cumlpmt_label` STRING COMMENT '付费分段', */ /*     `active_role_num` INT COMMENT '活跃人数', */ /*     `add_diamond_total` INT COMMENT '总钻石增加', */ /*     `add_pay_diamond` INT COMMENT '付费钻石增加', */ /*     `add_free_diamond` INT COMMENT '免费钻石增加', */ /*     `decrease_diamond` INT COMMENT '钻石减少', */ /*     `add_blue_stone_total` INT COMMENT '总蓝石增加', */ /*     `add_pay_blue_stone` INT COMMENT '付费蓝石增加', */ /*     `add_free_blue_stone` INT COMMENT '免费蓝石增加', */ /*     `decrease_blue_stone` INT COMMENT '蓝石减少', */ /*     `add_gold_stone_total` INT COMMENT '总金石增加', */ /*     `add_pay_gold_stone` INT COMMENT '付费金石增加', */ /*     `add_free_gold_stone` INT COMMENT '免费金石增加', */ /*     `decrease_gold_stone` INT COMMENT '金石减少', */ /*     `stock_diamond` INT COMMENT '钻石库存', */ /*     `stock_blue_stone` INT COMMENT '蓝石库存', */ /*     `stock_gold_stone` INT COMMENT '金石库存' */ /* ) COMMENT 'zgame-资源库存-付费分段' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '统计日期YYYY-MM-DD') STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_zgame_pay_resource_inventory_di'; */ WITH role_info AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 = 1 THEN '0_当天新增' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '1_2-3天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN '2_4-7天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN '3_8-14天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 15 AND 21 THEN '4_15-21天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 22 AND 28 THEN '5_22-28天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 > 28 THEN '6_28天以上' END AS regday_label FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_inner_account_info_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE b.roleid IS NULL), charge_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN daily_pmt_cuml = 0 THEN '0_0$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 0 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 50 THEN '1_0-50$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 50 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 100 THEN '2_50-100$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 100 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 200 THEN '3_100-200$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 200 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 500 THEN '4_200-500$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 500 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 1000 THEN '5_500-1000$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 1000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 2000 THEN '6_1000-2000$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 2000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 5000 THEN '7_2000-5000$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 5000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 10000 THEN '8_5000-1w$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 10000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 20000 THEN '9_1w-2w$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 20000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 30000 THEN '91_2w-3w$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 30000 THEN '92_>3w$' END AS cumlpmt_label FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money / 100) AS daily_pmt_cuml FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a), active_info AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001), add_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(item_id = 4, add_num, 0)) AS add_diamond_total, SUM(IF(item_id = 4 AND op IN ('IAP_DeliverItem', 'StoreBuyWithTokens'), add_num, 0)) AS add_pay_diamond, SUM(IF(item_id = 4 AND NOT op IN ('IAP_DeliverItem', 'StoreBuyWithTokens'), add_num, 0)) AS add_free_diamond, SUM(IF(item_id = 8, add_num, 0)) AS add_blue_stone_total, SUM(IF(item_id = 8 AND op IN ('IAP_DeliverItem', 'StoreBuyWithTokens'), add_num, 0)) AS add_pay_blue_stone, SUM(IF(item_id = 8 AND NOT op IN ('IAP_DeliverItem', 'StoreBuyWithTokens'), add_num, 0)) AS add_free_blue_stone, SUM(IF(item_id IN (31, 22), add_num, 0)) AS add_gold_stone_total, SUM(IF(item_id = 31, add_num, 0)) AS add_pay_gold_stone, SUM(IF(item_id = 22, add_num, 0)) AS add_free_gold_stone FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001 AND item_id IN (4, 8, 22, 31) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), sub_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(item_id = 4, sub_num, 0)) AS decrease_diamond, SUM(IF(item_id = 8, sub_num, 0)) AS decrease_blue_stone, SUM(IF(item_id IN (31, 22), sub_num, 0)) AS decrease_gold_stone FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_sub_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001 AND item_id IN (4, 8, 22, 31) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), logout_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(item_id = 4, item_num, 0)) AS stock_diamond, SUM(IF(item_id = 8, item_num, 0)) AS stock_blue_stone, SUM(IF(item_id IN (22, 31), item_num, 0)) AS stock_gold_stone FROM (SELECT zoneid, logymd, roleid, TIME, CAST(SPLIT(item_info, '-')[0] AS INT) AS item_id, CAST(SPLIT(item_info, '-')[1] AS INT) AS item_num FROM (SELECT a.* FROM (SELECT zoneid, logymd, roleid, item_list, TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, logymd, roleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_logout_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001) AS a WHERE a.rn = 1) AS logout_item_last_record LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(item_list, '\\073')) AS item_info) AS a WHERE item_id IN (4, 8, 22, 31) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_zgame_pay_resource_inventory_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(cumlpmt_label, '0_0$') AS cumlpmt_label, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS active_cnt, SUM(ai.add_diamond_total) AS add_diamond_total, SUM(ai.add_pay_diamond) AS add_pay_diamond, SUM(ai.add_free_diamond) AS add_free_diamond, SUM(s.decrease_diamond) AS decrease_diamond, SUM(ai.add_blue_stone_total) AS add_blue_stone_total, SUM(ai.add_pay_blue_stone) AS add_pay_blue_stone, SUM(ai.add_free_blue_stone) AS add_free_blue_stone, SUM(s.decrease_blue_stone) AS decrease_blue_stone, SUM(ai.add_gold_stone_total) AS add_gold_stone_total, SUM(ai.add_pay_gold_stone) AS add_pay_gold_stone, SUM(ai.add_free_gold_stone) AS add_free_gold_stone, SUM(s.decrease_gold_stone) AS decrease_gold_stone, SUM(stock_diamond) AS stock_diamond, SUM(stock_blue_stone) AS stock_blue_stone, SUM(stock_gold_stone) AS stock_gold_stone FROM role_info AS r LEFT JOIN charge_info AS c ON r.roleid = c.roleid AND r.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN add_info AS ai ON r.roleid = ai.roleid AND r.zoneid = ai.zoneid LEFT JOIN active_info AS a ON r.roleid = a.roleid AND r.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN sub_info AS s ON r.roleid = s.roleid AND r.zoneid = s.zoneid LEFT JOIN logout_info AS l ON r.roleid = l.roleid AND r.zoneid = l.zoneid GROUP BY COALESCE(cumlpmt_label, '0_0$')

sql_units: /* set unregister_flag = 0; */ WITH register AS (SELECT CAST(accountid AS STRING) AS accountid, CAST(zoneid AS STRING) AS zoneid, register_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_attribute_basic_account_zone_df)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     register_date >=  '2021-01-01' */ zoneid < 57000 /* 剔除测试服数据 */), age_info AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, gt1, gt2, IF(gt1 = 1, gender, NULL) AS gt1_gender, IF(gt2 = 1, gender, NULL) AS gt2_gender, IF(gt1 = 1, IF(bir_len = 10, age, CONCAT(age, bir_suffix)), NULL) AS gt1_age, IF(gt2 = 1, IF(bir_len = 10, age, CONCAT(age, bir_suffix)), NULL) AS gt2_age, IF(gt1 = 1, age_group, NULL) AS gt1_age_group, IF(gt2 = 1, age_group, NULL) AS gt2_age_group, age_group, age, birthday FROM (SELECT CAST(roleid AS STRING) AS accountid, CAST(zoneid AS STRING) AS zoneid, gt1, gt2, gender, birthday, 2026 - CAST(SUBSTRING(birthday, 0, 4) AS INT) AS age, LENGTH(birthday) AS bir_len, SUBSTRING(birthday, 4, 1) AS bir_suffix, CASE WHEN (2026 - CAST(SUBSTRING(birthday, 0, 4) AS INT)) BETWEEN 0 AND 9 THEN '0-9' WHEN (2026 - CAST(SUBSTRING(birthday, 0, 4) AS INT)) BETWEEN 10 AND 14 THEN '10-14' WHEN (2026 - CAST(SUBSTRING(birthday, 0, 4) AS INT)) BETWEEN 15 AND 19 THEN '15-19' WHEN (2026 - CAST(SUBSTRING(birthday, 0, 4) AS INT)) BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN '20-24' WHEN (2026 - CAST(SUBSTRING(birthday, 0, 4) AS INT)) BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN '25-29' WHEN (2026 - CAST(SUBSTRING(birthday, 0, 4) AS INT)) BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN '30-34' WHEN (2026 - CAST(SUBSTRING(birthday, 0, 4) AS INT)) >= 35 THEN '35+' ELSE NULL END AS age_group FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(ml_temp_tmp_guanzi_gt1_gt2_role)) WHERE logymd = '2023-10-29')), rfm_tags AS (SELECT CAST(roleid AS STRING) AS accountid, CAST(zoneid AS STRING) AS zoneid, commercialized_rfm_tags FROM mt_dm.dm_commercialized_rfm_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), active_tb AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, his_first_active_date, active_info FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dm_ml_behavior_active_account_zone_df)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31'), pay_tb AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, his_first_pay_date /* , pay_info */, amount_info /* , count_info */, actual_amount_info FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dm_ml_behavior_pay_account_zone_df)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dm_ml_attribute_tags_account_zone_df)) SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.register_date, IF(his_first_active_date >= register_date, his_first_active_date, DATE_ADD(register_date, CAST((ARRAY_POSITION(REVERSE(SLICE(active_info, 1, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1)), 1) - 1) AS INT))) AS first_active_date, a.his_first_pay_date AS first_pay_date, DATEDIFF(a.his_first_pay_date, a.register_date) AS first_pay_until_create_days, first_amount AS first_day_pay_amt, first_actual_amount AS first_day_actual_pay_amt, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 1), 0) AS d1_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 3), 0) AS d7_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 4), 0) AS d30_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 5), 0) AS d60_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 6), 0) AS d90_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 7), 0) AS d120_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 8), 0) AS d150_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 9), 0) AS d180_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 10), 0) AS d210_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 11), 0) AS d240_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 12), 0) AS d270_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 13), 0) AS d300_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 14), 0) AS d330_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 15), 0) AS d360_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 1), 0) AS d1_ltv_actual_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 3), 0) AS d7_ltv_actual_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 4), 0) AS d30_ltv_actual_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 5), 0) AS d60_ltv_actual_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 6), 0) AS d90_ltv_actual_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 7), 0) AS d120_ltv_actual_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 8), 0) AS d150_ltv_actual_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 9), 0) AS d180_ltv_actual_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 10), 0) AS d210_ltv_actual_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 11), 0) AS d240_ltv_actual_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 12), 0) AS d270_ltv_actual_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 13), 0) AS d300_ltv_actual_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 14), 0) AS d330_ltv_actual_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 15), 0) AS d360_ltv_actual_pay, gt1, gt2, gt1_gender, gt2_gender, gt1_age, gt2_age, gt1_age_group, gt2_age_group, ARRAY_LOSS_OR_BACK(active_info, 30, 999999, FALSE, register_date, his_first_active_date, '${init_date}', '2026-05-31') AS is_lost30, ARRAY_LOSS_OR_BACK(active_info, 30, 999999, TRUE, register_date, his_first_active_date, '${init_date}', '2026-05-31') AS is_back30, commercialized_rfm_tags /* 用户RFM价值类型 */, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(amount_ltv_info, 2), 0) AS d3_ltv_pay, COALESCE(ELEMENT_AT(actual_amount_ltv_info, 2), 0) AS d3_ltv_actual_pay FROM (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, register_date, his_first_pay_date /* , cast(case */ /*     when b.accountid is null then array_repeat(0, datediff('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1) */ /*     when register_date > his_first_pay_date then slice(pay_info, datediff(register_date, his_first_pay_date) + 1 ,size(pay_info) - 2) */ /*     when register_date < his_first_pay_date then flatten(array(array_repeat(0, datediff(his_first_pay_date, register_date)), pay_info)) */ /* else pay_info end as array<int>) as pay_info */ /* , cast(case */ /*     when b.accountid is null then array(0) */ /*     when register_date > his_first_pay_date then array_sum_by_zip(slice(count_info, datediff(register_date, his_first_pay_date) + 1 ,size(count_info) - 2), array(count_info[datediff(register_date, his_first_pay_date) - 1] * -1)) */ /*     when register_date < his_first_pay_date then flatten(array(array_repeat(0, datediff(his_first_pay_date, register_date)), count_info)) */ /* else count_info end as array<bigint>) as count_info */, ARRAY_BIGINT_SUIT(amount_info, register_date, his_first_pay_date, ARRAY(1, 3, 7, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240, 270, 300, 330, 360)) AS amount_ltv_info, ARRAY_DOUBLE_SUIT(actual_amount_info, register_date, his_first_pay_date, ARRAY(1, 3, 7, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240, 270, 300, 330, 360)) AS actual_amount_ltv_info, amount_info[0] AS first_amount, actual_amount_info[0] AS first_actual_amount FROM register AS a LEFT JOIN pay_tb AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN age_info AS c ON a.accountid = c.accountid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_loginauth_funnel_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: helenma@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-10-27 17:58:37.000 */ /* Description: spark任务 转 etl任务 */ /* Update: 新增字段 client_version */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_loginauth_funnel_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, `time`, ip, device, login_cnt, CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(CONCAT(REPEAT('1,', last_rank), REPEAT('0,', (30 - last_rank))), 1, 59), ',') AS ARRAY<INT>) AS login_step_arry, client_version FROM (SELECT t2.accountid AS roleid, COALESCE(t2.zone_id, -99999) AS zoneid, COALESCE(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(t2.login_time) AS STRING), '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS `time`, t2.ip, t2.device, t2.login_num AS login_cnt, t2.new_step AS last_rank, t2.client_version, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.accountid, t2.zone_id, t2.login_num, t2.device, t2.client_version ORDER BY t2.new_step DESC, t2.login_time DESC) AS rn /* MAX(new_step) last_rank */ FROM (SELECT ip /* logymd, */ /* region, */, zone_id, accountid, login_time, event_desc, loading_time, is_30, device, SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[0] AS login_num, SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] AS step, CASE WHEN is_30 = 'y' THEN 30 ELSE step_rank END AS new_step, client_version /* ,row_number() over(partition by accountid,zoneid,split(event_desc,'\073')[1] order by `time` desc) as rn */ FROM (SELECT zone_id /* a.logymd, */ /* region, */, ip, a.accountid, login_time, event_desc, loading_time, is_30, device, SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[0] AS login_num, SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] AS step, CASE WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '67' THEN 1 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '68' THEN 2 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '6' THEN 3 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '86' THEN 4 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '7' THEN 5 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '72' THEN 6 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '18' THEN 7 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '12' THEN 8 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '14' THEN 9 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '23' THEN 10 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '39' THEN 11 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '19' THEN 12 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '21' THEN 13 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '26' THEN 14 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '27' THEN 15 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '28' THEN 16 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '29' THEN 17 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '58' THEN 18 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '55' THEN 19 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '60' THEN 20 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '84' THEN 21 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '85' THEN 22 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '76' THEN 23 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '77' THEN 24 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '61' THEN 25 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '62' THEN 26 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '64' THEN 27 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '63' THEN 28 WHEN SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] = '36' THEN 29 ELSE NULL END AS step_rank, client_version FROM (SELECT FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) AS zone_id, accountid, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`) AS login_time, event_desc, ip, device, client_version /* row_number() over(partition by accountid,zoneid,split(event_desc,'\073')[1] order by `time` desc) as rn */ /* MAX( */ /* -登录漏斗表 report上报 分step上报 取分国家 大区 */ FROM ml_ods.reportserver_report_event_data WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     zoneid < 57000 */ SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[0] RLIKE '^\\\\d+$' AND NOT SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[0] IS NULL GROUP BY accountid, ip, device, zone_id, login_time, event_desc, client_version) AS a LEFT JOIN (/* -登录表，game上报 补充登录漏斗漏报 */ SELECT logymd, accountid, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`) AS loading_time, 'y' AS is_30 FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_loginloading_game WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     zoneid < 57000 */ backinfo1 LIKE '%36%' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`)) AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND b.loading_time BETWEEN a.login_time AND a.login_time + 60 LEFT JOIN (/* - 剔除大重连没有最后一步的玩家 */ SELECT logymd, accountid, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`) AS reconnect_time FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_big_reconnect_data WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /*     AND     zoneid < 57000 */ GROUP BY logymd, accountid, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`)) AS c ON a.accountid = c.accountid AND c.reconnect_time BETWEEN a.login_time AND a.login_time + 60 WHERE c.accountid IS NULL) AS t1) AS t2 LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[0] AS login_num FROM ml_ods.reportserver_report_event_data WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /*             ---剔除版本错误、外挂、封号、冻结、apk更新 */ ((SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[2] IN ('7001', '7002', '7003', '7004', '7005') AND SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[0] RLIKE '^\\\\d+$' AND NOT SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[0] IS NULL) OR (SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[1] IN ('37') AND SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[0] RLIKE '^\\\\d+$' AND NOT SPLIT(event_desc, '\\073')[0] IS NULL)) GROUP BY logymd, accountid, login_num) AS t5 ON t2.accountid = t5.accountid AND t2.login_num = t5.login_num WHERE NOT t2.new_step IS NULL AND t5.accountid IS NULL) AS tp WHERE rn = 1

name: mtai.dwm_ml_social_questionnaire_account_df

sql_units: /* 基本active */ WITH LAST AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, day_last_ip, day_last_active_time, day_last_deviceid, day_last_os_language, day_last_channel, last_loginclient_version, last_os_version, last_login_teamid, last_client_language, last_sex_game, last_curbattle_points, last_curticket, last_curdiamond, last_pad, last_unity_version, last_active_client_real_ver, last_active_ip FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, day_last_ip, day_last_active_time, day_last_deviceid, day_last_os_language, day_last_channel, last_loginclient_version, last_os_version, last_login_teamid, last_client_language, IF(day_last_deviceid IS NULL OR day_last_deviceid = '', 0, 1) + IF(day_last_os_language IS NULL OR day_last_os_language = '', 0, 1) + IF(day_last_channel IS NULL OR day_last_channel = '', 0, 1) + IF(last_loginclient_version IS NULL OR last_loginclient_version = '', 0, 1) + IF(last_os_version IS NULL OR last_os_version = '', 0, 1) + IF(last_login_teamid IS NULL OR last_login_teamid = '', 0, 1) + IF(last_client_language IS NULL OR last_client_language = '', 0, 1) + IF(last_sex_game IS NULL OR last_sex_game = '', 0, 1) + IF(last_curbattle_points IS NULL, 0, 1) + IF(last_curticket IS NULL, 0, 1) + IF(last_curdiamond IS NULL, 0, 1) + IF(last_pad IS NULL, 0, 1) + IF(last_unity_version IS NULL OR last_os_version = '', 0, 1) + IF(last_active_client_real_ver IS NULL OR last_os_version = '', 0, 1) + IF(last_active_ip IS NULL OR last_os_version = '', 0, 1)) AS null_cnt /* 上报时间一样的取非空值多的数据 */ FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mt_dwm_dwm_active_role_zone_di)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb') AS t) AS p WHERE p.rk = 1), FIRST AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, day_first_ip, day_first_active_time, day_first_deviceid, day_first_os_language, day_first_channel, first_loginclient_version, first_os_version, first_login_teamid, first_client_language, first_unity_version FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, day_first_ip, day_first_active_time, day_first_deviceid, day_first_os_language, day_first_channel, first_loginclient_version, first_os_version, first_login_teamid, first_client_language, first_unity_version, or_ts, null_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY or_ts ASC, null_cnt DESC) AS rk FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, day_first_ip, day_first_active_time, day_first_deviceid, day_first_os_language, day_first_channel, first_loginclient_version, first_os_version, first_login_teamid, first_client_language, first_unity_version, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(day_first_active_time) AS or_ts, (IF(day_first_ip IS NULL, 0, 1) + IF(day_first_active_time IS NULL OR day_first_active_time = '', 0, 1) + IF(day_first_deviceid IS NULL OR day_first_deviceid = '', 0, 1) + IF(day_first_os_language IS NULL OR day_first_os_language = '', 0, 1) + IF(day_first_channel IS NULL OR day_first_channel = '', 0, 1) + IF(first_loginclient_version IS NULL OR first_loginclient_version = '', 0, 1) + IF(first_os_version IS NULL OR first_os_version = '', 0, 1) + IF(first_login_teamid IS NULL OR first_login_teamid = '', 0, 1) + IF(first_client_language IS NULL OR first_client_language = '', 0, 1) + IF(first_unity_version IS NULL OR first_unity_version = '', 0, 1)) AS null_cnt FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mt_dwm_dwm_active_role_zone_di)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb') AS t) AS p WHERE p.rk = 1), other_agg AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(is_ai) AS is_ai, SUM(chargediamond) AS chargediamond, MAX(LEVEL) AS LEVEL, SUM(day_login_cnt) AS day_login_cnt, SUM(day_login_duration) AS day_login_duration, SUM(giftskin_cnt) AS giftskin_cnt, MIN(min_level) AS min_level FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mt_dwm_dwm_active_role_zone_di)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), other_cnt AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT os) AS os_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_country) AS ip_country_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT device) AS device_cnt FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mt_dwm_dwm_active_role_zone_di)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), device_agg AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS('\\0xx00', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(device, '\\0x0000x', day_login_duration))), '\\0xx00', '\\0x0000x') AS per_device_duration, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS('\\0xx00', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(device, '\\0x0000x', cnt))), '\\0xx00', '\\0x0000x') AS per_device_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device, SUM(day_login_duration) AS day_login_duration, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mt_dwm_dwm_active_role_zone_di)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, device) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), base AS (SELECT other_cnt.roleid, other_cnt.zoneid, os_cnt, ip_country_cnt, device_cnt, is_ai, day_first_ip, day_last_ip, IF(day_first_ip = day_last_ip, 1, 0) AS is_eq_first_last_ip, chargediamond, LEVEL, day_first_active_time, day_last_active_time, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(day_last_active_time) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(day_first_active_time) AS gap_of_first_last_active_time, day_first_deviceid, day_last_deviceid, IF(day_first_deviceid = day_last_deviceid, 1, 0) AS is_eq_first_last_deviceid, day_first_os_language, day_last_os_language, IF(day_first_os_language = day_last_os_language, 1, 0) AS is_eq_first_last_os_language, day_first_channel, day_last_channel, IF(day_first_channel = day_last_channel, 1, 0) AS is_eq_first_last_channel, day_login_cnt, day_login_duration, last_sex_game, first_loginclient_version, last_loginclient_version, IF(first_loginclient_version = last_loginclient_version, 1, 0) AS is_eq_first_last_loginclient_version, first_os_version, last_os_version, IF(first_os_version = last_os_version, 1, 0) AS is_eq_first_last_os_version, first_login_teamid, last_login_teamid, IF(last_login_teamid = first_login_teamid, 1, 0) AS is_eq_first_last_login_teamid, first_client_language, last_client_language, IF(first_client_language = last_client_language, 1, 0) AS is_eq_first_last_client_language, last_curbattle_points, last_curticket, last_curdiamond, giftskin_cnt, last_pad, min_level, first_unity_version, last_unity_version, IF(first_unity_version = last_unity_version, 1, 0) AS is_eq_first_last_unity_version, last_active_client_real_ver, last_active_ip FROM other_cnt LEFT JOIN FIRST ON other_cnt.roleid = FIRST.roleid AND other_cnt.zoneid = FIRST.zoneid LEFT JOIN LAST ON other_cnt.roleid = LAST.roleid AND other_cnt.zoneid = LAST.zoneid LEFT JOIN other_agg ON other_cnt.roleid = other_agg.roleid AND other_cnt.zoneid = other_agg.zoneid), first_charge_click /* 点击首充 */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(SUM(first_open), 0) AS first_charge_open_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(firct_click), 0) AS first_charge_click_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(second_open), 0) AS second_charge_open_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(second_click), 0) AS second_charge_click_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(second_more), 0) AS second_charge_more_cnt FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(ml_ods_connserver_cilent_firstcharge_click)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), click_diff_zoneid_friend /* 点击同区和不同区 */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(item_cnt[TRUE], 0) AS click_same_zone_friend_cnt, COALESCE(item_cnt[FALSE], 0) AS click_diff_zone_friend_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(is_same_zone, '-', cnt))), ',', '-') AS item_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, is_same_zone, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, zoneid = target_zoneid AS is_same_zone FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(ml_ods_connserver_client_friendlist_click)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, is_same_zone) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS t), click_diff_pos_friend /* 点击不同位置的对象 */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(item_cnt[1], 0) AS click_friend_cnt, COALESCE(item_cnt[2], 0) AS click_findout_cnt, COALESCE(item_cnt[3], 0) AS click_recent_play_cnt, COALESCE(item_cnt[4], 0) AS click_nearby_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(target_source, '-', cnt))), ',', '-') AS item_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, target_source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(ml_ods_connserver_client_friendlist_click)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, target_source) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS t), report_clicks /* connserver_interfacereport //付费用户的点击情况 ， 有偏 */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, SUM(charge_click_num) AS click_charge_cnt, SUM(chat_click_num) AS click_chat_cnt FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(ml_ods_connserver_interfacereport)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), shop_tabclick AS (SELECT tt1.roleid, tt1.zoneid, click_shop_cnt, COALESCE(click_shop_heroes_cnt, 0) AS click_shop_heroes_cnt, COALESCE(click_shop_skins_cnt, 0) AS click_shop_skins_cnt, COALESCE(click_shop_fagments_cnt, 0) AS click_shop_fagments_cnt, COALESCE(click_shop_sale_cnt, 0) AS click_shop_sale_cnt, COALESCE(click_shop_luckyspin_cnt, 0) AS click_shop_luckyspin_cnt, COALESCE(click_shop_magicwheel_cnt, 0) AS click_shop_magicwheel_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS click_shop_cnt /* 总共点了多少tab页都算商城点击 */ FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(ml_ods_connserver_client_shop_tabclick)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS tt1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS click_shop_heroes_cnt /* tabid=1是英雄 */ FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(ml_ods_connserver_client_shop_tabclick)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND tabid = 1 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS tt2 ON tt1.zoneid = tt2.zoneid AND tt1.roleid = tt2.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS click_shop_skins_cnt /* tabid=2是皮肤 */ FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(ml_ods_connserver_client_shop_tabclick)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND tabid = 2 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS tt3 ON tt1.zoneid = tt3.zoneid AND tt1.roleid = tt3.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS click_shop_fagments_cnt /* tabid=5 是碎片 */ FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(ml_ods_connserver_client_shop_tabclick)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND tabid = 5 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS tt4 ON tt1.zoneid = tt4.zoneid AND tt1.roleid = tt4.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS click_shop_sale_cnt /* tabid=10 是折扣 */ FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(ml_ods_connserver_client_shop_tabclick)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND tabid = 10 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS tt5 ON tt1.zoneid = tt5.zoneid AND tt1.roleid = tt5.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS click_shop_luckyspin_cnt /* tabid=8 是好运抽奖 */ FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(ml_ods_connserver_client_shop_tabclick)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND tabid = 8 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS tt6 ON tt1.zoneid = tt6.zoneid AND tt1.roleid = tt6.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS click_shop_magicwheel_cnt /* tabid=9 是魔力论 */ FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(ml_ods_connserver_client_shop_tabclick)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND tabid = 9 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS tt7 ON tt1.zoneid = tt7.zoneid AND tt1.roleid = tt7.roleid), ranklist_click /* ranklist click */ /* ranklist click */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, SUM(herorankclick) AS click_herorank_cnt, SUM(herostreetclick) AS click_herostreet_cnt FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(ml_ods_connserver_client_ranklistclick)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), changed AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ip_changed, device_changed, os_language_changed, channel_changed, loginclient_version_changed, os_version_changed, teamid_changed, client_language_changed, unity_version_changed FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(SIZE((COLLECT_SET(ip) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid))) = 1, 0, 1) AS ip_changed, IF(SIZE((COLLECT_SET(device) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid))) = 1, 0, 1) AS device_changed, IF(SIZE((COLLECT_SET(os_language) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid))) = 1, 0, 1) AS os_language_changed, IF(SIZE((COLLECT_SET(channel) OVER (PARTITION BY name: mtai.dwm_ml_resource_hero_role_zone_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_resource_hero_role_zone_di)) SELECT t1.roleid AS accountid /* 账号id */, t1.zoneid /* 服务器 */, COALESCE(t2.own_hero_cnt, 0) AS bought_hero_cnt /* 玩家拥有英雄总数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, COALESCE(t2.own_mark_cnt, 0) AS bought_mksm_cnt /* 拥有射手英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, COALESCE(t2.own_figh_cnt, 0) AS bought_warr_cnt /* 拥有战士英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, COALESCE(t2.own_mage_cnt, 0) AS bought_mage_cnt /* 拥有法师英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, COALESCE(t2.own_sup_cnt, 0) AS bought_supp_cnt /* 拥有辅助英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, COALESCE(t2.own_ass_cnt, 0) AS bought_assn_cnt /* 拥有刺客英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, COALESCE(t2.own_tank_cnt, 0) AS bought_tank_cnt /* 拥有坦克英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, COALESCE(t3.own_dye_skin_cnt, 0) AS bought_skin_cnt /* 拥有皮肤总数 (非体验卡） */, COALESCE(t3.own_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) AS bought_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有S级以上皮肤数量 (非体验卡） */, COALESCE(t3.own_dye_skin_gt_a_cnt, 0) AS bought_skin_gt_a_cnt /* 拥有A级以上皮肤数量 (非体验卡） */, COALESCE(t3.own_dye_skin_b_cnt, 0) AS bought_skin_b_cnt /* 拥有B级皮肤数量 (非体验卡） */, COALESCE(t3.mark_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) AS bought_mksm_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有射手S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, COALESCE(t3.figh_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) AS bought_warr_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有战士S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, COALESCE(t3.mage_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) AS bought_mage_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有法师S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, COALESCE(t3.sup_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) AS bought_supp_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有辅助S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, COALESCE(t3.ass_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) AS bought_assn_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有刺客S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, COALESCE(t3.tank_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt, 0) AS bought_tank_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有坦克S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid /* 账号id */, zoneid /* 服务器 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.roleid /* 账号id */, t1.zoneid /* 服务器 */, SUM(hero_cnt) AS own_hero_cnt /* 玩家拥有英雄总数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, SUM(CASE WHEN hero_type = 5 THEN hero_cnt END) AS own_mark_cnt /* 拥有射手英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, SUM(CASE WHEN hero_type = 2 THEN hero_cnt END) AS own_figh_cnt /* 拥有战士英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, SUM(CASE WHEN hero_type = 4 THEN hero_cnt END) AS own_mage_cnt /* 拥有法师英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, SUM(CASE WHEN hero_type = 6 THEN hero_cnt END) AS own_sup_cnt /* 拥有辅助英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, SUM(CASE WHEN hero_type = 3 THEN hero_cnt END) AS own_ass_cnt /* 拥有刺客英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */, SUM(CASE WHEN hero_type = 1 THEN hero_cnt END) AS own_tank_cnt /* 拥有坦克英雄数 (非体验卡，非自走棋英雄） */ FROM (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t2.hero_type /* 1坦克、2战士、3刺客、4法师、5射手、6辅助 */, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.heroid) AS hero_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, resource_id AS heroid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_di WHERE time_len = 0 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND resource_id < 300 AND resource_type = 'hero') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, hero_name, heroes AS hero_type /* 1坦克、2战士、3刺客、4法师、5射手、6辅助 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config) AS t2 ON t1.heroid = t2.heroid GROUP BY t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t2.hero_type /* 1坦克、2战士、3刺客、4法师、5射手、6辅助 */) AS t1 GROUP BY t1.roleid /* 账号id */, t1.zoneid /* 服务器 */) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, SUM(skin_dye_cnt) AS own_dye_skin_cnt /* 拥有皮肤总数 (非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (5, 4) THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS own_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有S级以上皮肤数量 (非体验卡) */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (3, 2) THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS own_dye_skin_gt_a_cnt /* 拥有A级以上皮肤数量 (非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level = 1 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS own_dye_skin_b_cnt /* 拥有B级皮肤数量 (非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 5 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS mark_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有射手S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 2 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS figh_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有战士S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 4 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS mage_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有法师S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 6 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS sup_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有辅助S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 3 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS ass_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有刺客S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_level IN (4, 5) AND hero_type = 1 THEN skin_dye_cnt END) AS tank_dye_skin_gt_s_cnt /* 拥有坦克S级以上皮肤数量（永久英雄且非体验卡） */ FROM (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t2.skin_level, t3.hero_type /* 1坦克、2战士、3刺客、4法师、5射手、6辅助 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t1.skinid < 600000, t1.skinid, NULL)) AS skin_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.skinid) AS skin_dye_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, resource_id AS skinid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_di WHERE time_len = 0 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     resource_id < 60000 */ resource_type = 'skin') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT skinid, skin_name, skin_level /* 0 默认皮肤、1 B级皮肤、2 A级皮肤、3 A+皮肤、4 S级皮肤、5 S+皮肤 */, skin_heroid FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config) AS t2 ON t1.skinid = t2.skinid LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, hero_name, heroes AS hero_type /* 1坦克、2战士、3刺客、4法师、5射手、6辅助 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config) AS t3 ON t2.skin_heroid = t3.heroid GROUP BY t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t2.skin_level, t3.hero_type) AS t1 GROUP BY t1.roleid, t1.zoneid) AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: cherylxie@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-10-24 16:43:05.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH register AS (SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_attribute_basic_account_zone_df)) WHERE p_date = IF(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 2 * -1) > '2026-05-31', DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 2 * -1), '2026-05-31') AND register_date = '2026-05-25' /* 注册满7天 */ AND zoneid < 57000 /* 剔除测试服数据 */), active AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, p_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_behavior_active_account_zone_di)) WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' /* 最近7日活跃 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_behavior_recent7d_register_account_zone_di)) SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.register_date, COUNT(DISTINCT b.p_date) AS fd7_active_days FROM register AS a LEFT JOIN active AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.register_date

SUM(battle_dur) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype, hero_job) AS hero_job_battle_time FROM hero_base AS a LEFT JOIN hero_job AS b ON a.heroid = b.heroid), heros AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_SET(STRUCT(heroid, hero_battle_cnt))) AS hero_battle_cnt_map, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_SET(STRUCT(heroid, hero_win_cnt))) AS hero_win_cnt_map, herojob_win_cnt_map FROM heros_step1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_behavior_battle_hero_account_zone_di)) SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.hero_battle_cnt_map AS hero_battle_cnt_map, a.hero_win_cnt_map AS hero_win_cnt_map, a.hero_battle_time_map AS hero_battle_time_map, a.herojob_battle_cnt_map AS herojob_battle_cnt_map, a.herojob_battle_time_map AS herojob_battle_time_map, a.herojob_win_cnt_map AS herojob_win_cnt_map, b.hero_battle_cnt_map AS match_hero_battle_cnt_map, b.hero_win_cnt_map AS match_hero_win_cnt_map, b.hero_battle_time_map AS match_hero_battle_time_map, b.herojob_battle_cnt_map AS match_herojob_battle_cnt_map, b.herojob_battle_time_map AS match_herojob_battle_time_map, b.herojob_win_cnt_map AS match_herojob_win_cnt_map, c.hero_battle_cnt_map AS rank_hero_battle_cnt_map, c.hero_win_cnt_map AS rank_hero_win_cnt_map, c.hero_battle_time_map AS rank_hero_battle_time_map, c.herojob_battle_cnt_map AS rank_herojob_battle_cnt_map, c.herojob_battle_time_map AS rank_herojob_battle_time_map, c.herojob_win_cnt_map AS rank_herojob_win_cnt_map FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, LONG_MERGE_MAP(COLLECT_LIST(hero_battle_cnt_map), -1) AS hero_battle_cnt_map, LONG_MERGE_MAP(COLLECT_LIST(hero_win_cnt_map), -1) AS hero_win_cnt_map, LONG_MERGE_MAP(COLLECT_LIST(hero_battle_time_map), LONG_MERGE_MAP(COLLECT_LIST(herojob_win_cnt_map), -1) AS herojob_win_cnt_map FROM heros GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN (/* match */ SELECT * FROM heros WHERE pvptype = 1) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* rank */ SELECT * FROM heros WHERE pvptype = 2) AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid

a.create_device, a.create_channel, a.create_ip, a.create_sex, a.is_first_create, a.is_mini, a.is_emulator, a.is_bind, a.is_small, a.hist_first_active_time, a.hist_first_deviceid, a.hist_first_os_language, a.hist_first_os_version, a.hist_first_client_version, b.account_register_time, b.account_register_date, b.his_first_deviceid, b.role_register_date, b.first_create_ip, b.first_ad_country, b.last_ad_country, b.os_country, b.first_ip_country, b.first_mt_country, b.last_mt_country, b.first_network_name, b.last_network_name, b.os_type, b.os, b.ad_os, b.attr_logymd, b.adjust_campaign_id, b.adjust_campaign_name, b.area_id, b.adjust_adset_name, b.adjust_adset_id, b.adjust_creative_name, b.adjust_creative_id, b.game_channel, b.create_device AS create_device_account, b.role_create_device, b.is_pure, c.merge_m AS holiday_map, d.merge_m AS activate_map, a.register_date AS p_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_attribute_basic_account_zone_df)) LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df AS b ON b.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND b.appid = 'mlbb' AND a.accountid = b.accountid LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.country_id, MERGE_MAP(COLLECT_LIST(x.m)) AS merge_m FROM (SELECT country_id, MAP(name, 1) AS m FROM adbi.global_holiday_infor WHERE h_date >= '2026-05-25' AND h_date <= '2026-05-31' AND p_year IN (YEAR('2026-05-25'), YEAR('2026-05-31')) AND p_date = '9999-99-99'
