AS register_date, MERGE_MAP(COLLECT_LIST(x.m)) AS merge_m FROM (SELECT MAP(actv_type, COUNT(1)) AS m FROM ml_temp.lark2hive_mlbb_biz_actv_ls WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND server_date >= '2026-05-25' AND server_date <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY actv_type) AS x) AS d ON a.register_date = d.register_date WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND (a.register_date = '2026-05-25' OR a.register_date = '2026-05-29')

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_resource_cons_obtain_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH t_add_diamond AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(add_num) AS get_diamond FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_add_diamond WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_sub_diamond AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(sub_num) AS consume_diamond FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_add_item AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 3 THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS get_energy, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 8 THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS get_blue_debris, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 22 THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS get_free_golden_shard, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 31 THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS get_paid_golden_shard, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 37 THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS get_paid_red_debris FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_sub_item AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 3 THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS consume_energy, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 8 THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS consume_blue_debris, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 22 THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS consume_free_golden_shard, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 31 THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS consume_paid_golden_shard, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 37 THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS consume_paid_red_debris FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_sub_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_add_coin AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(add_num) AS get_coin FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_add_coin WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_sub_coin AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(sub_num) AS consume_coin FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_sub_coin WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_diamond AS (SELECT COALESCE(t_add_diamond.roleid, t_sub_diamond.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(t_add_diamond.zoneid, t_sub_diamond.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(t_add_diamond.get_diamond, 0) AS get_diamond, COALESCE(t_sub_diamond.consume_diamond, 0) AS consume_diamond FROM t_add_diamond FULL JOIN t_sub_diamond ON t_add_diamond.roleid = t_sub_diamond.roleid AND t_add_diamond.zoneid = t_sub_diamond.zoneid), t_item AS (SELECT COALESCE(t_add_item.roleid, t_sub_item.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(t_add_item.zoneid, t_sub_item.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(t_add_item.get_energy, 0) AS get_energy, COALESCE(t_sub_item.consume_energy, 0) AS consume_energy, COALESCE(t_add_item.get_blue_debris, 0) AS get_blue_debris, COALESCE(t_sub_item.consume_blue_debris, 0) AS consume_blue_debris, COALESCE(t_add_item.get_free_golden_shard, 0) AS get_free_golden_shard, COALESCE(t_sub_item.consume_free_golden_shard, 0) AS consume_free_golden_shard, COALESCE(t_add_item.get_paid_golden_shard, 0) AS get_paid_golden_shard, COALESCE(t_sub_item.consume_paid_golden_shard, 0) AS consume_paid_golden_shard, COALESCE(t_add_item.get_paid_red_debris, 0) AS get_paid_red_debris, COALESCE(t_sub_item.consume_paid_red_debris, 0) AS consume_paid_red_debris FROM t_add_item FULL JOIN t_sub_item ON t_add_item.roleid = t_sub_item.roleid AND t_add_item.zoneid = t_sub_item.zoneid), t_coin AS (SELECT COALESCE(t_add_coin.roleid, t_sub_coin.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(t_add_coin.zoneid, t_sub_coin.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(t_add_coin.get_coin, 0) AS get_coin, COALESCE(t_sub_coin.consume_coin, 0) AS consume_coin FROM t_add_coin FULL JOIN t_sub_coin ON t_add_coin.roleid = t_sub_coin.roleid AND t_add_coin.zoneid = t_sub_coin.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_resource_cons_obtain_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(t_diamond.roleid, t_item.roleid, t_coin.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(t_diamond.zoneid, t_item.zoneid, t_coin.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(t_diamond.get_diamond, 0) AS get_diamond, COALESCE(t_diamond.consume_diamond, 0) AS consume_diamond, COALESCE(t_item.get_energy, 0) AS get_energy, COALESCE(t_item.consume_energy, 0) AS consume_energy, COALESCE(t_item.get_blue_debris, 0) AS get_blue_debris, COALESCE(t_item.consume_blue_debris, 0) AS consume_blue_debris, COALESCE(t_item.get_free_golden_shard, 0) AS get_free_golden_shard, COALESCE(t_item.consume_free_golden_shard, 0) AS consume_free_golden_shard, COALESCE(t_item.get_paid_golden_shard, 0) AS get_paid_golden_shard, COALESCE(t_item.consume_paid_golden_shard, 0) AS consume_paid_golden_shard, COALESCE(t_item.get_paid_red_debris, 0) AS get_paid_red_debris, COALESCE(t_item.consume_paid_red_debris, 0) AS consume_paid_red_debris, COALESCE(t_coin.get_coin, 0) AS get_coin, COALESCE(t_coin.consume_coin, 0) AS consume_coin FROM t_diamond FULL JOIN t_item ON t_diamond.roleid = t_item.roleid AND t_diamond.zoneid = t_item.zoneid FULL JOIN t_coin ON COALESCE(t_diamond.roleid, t_item.roleid) = t_coin.roleid AND COALESCE(t_diamond.zoneid, t_item.zoneid) = t_coin.zoneid

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_social_relationship_role_zone_di_event_2
sql_units: /* 2首页推人曝光样本 */ WITH event_type_2 AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, showplayer_accountid AS object_roleid, showplayer_zoneid AS object_zoneid, player_action FROM ml_ods.connserver_social_recommendlistrecord WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND player_action < 5), battle_info_mid AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, ismvp, camp FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd < '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-24' AND wincamp = 1 AND pvptype IN (1, 2)), battle_info AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(b.roleid, '_', b.zoneid)) AS account_array_ismvp /* 与之对局是mvp 的玩家列表 */, COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(c.roleid, '_', c.zoneid)) AS account_array_iswin /* 与之对局是胜场的对局玩家列表 */ FROM battle_info_mid AS a LEFT JOIN battle_info_mid AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.ismvp = 1 LEFT JOIN battle_info_mid AS c ON a.battleid = c.battleid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid), focus_back_info /* 关注回关 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, dest_roleid, dest_zone, 1 AS is_focus_back FROM ml_ods.gameserver_friend_focus_player WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_focused = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, dest_roleid, dest_zone), accept_invite_info /* 接受邀请 */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, invite_roleid, invite_zoneid, 1 AS is_invite_accept FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_inviteshow WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND isaccept = 'accept' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, invite_roleid, invite_zoneid), relations AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, like_roleid, like_zoneid FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, SPLIT(exploded_like_player, '-')[0] AS like_roleid, SPLIT(exploded_like_player, '-')[1] AS like_zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_socialbehavior LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(likeplayer, '\\073')) exploded_table AS exploded_like_player WHERE logymd < '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-24') AS t1 WHERE NOT like_zoneid IS NULL GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, like_roleid, like_zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_social_relationship_role_zone_di PARTITION(appid = 'mlbb', logymd = '2026-05-31', event_type = 2) SELECT roleid, zoneid, object_roleid, object_zoneid, CONCAT('{', '"is_belike_7days":', COALESCE(is_belike_7days, 0), ',', '"is_like_7days":', COALESCE(is_like_7days, 0), ',', '"is_own_win_mvp_7days":', COALESCE(is_own_win_mvp_7days, 0), ',', '"is_object_win_mvp_7days":', COALESCE(is_object_win_mvp_7days, 0), ',', '"is_win_7days":', COALESCE(is_win_7days, 0), ',', '"is_portrait_click":', COALESCE(is_portrait_click, 0), ',', '"is_focus":', COALESCE(is_focus, 0), ',', '"is_focus_back":', COALESCE(is_focus_back, 0), ',', '"is_invite_accept":', COALESCE(is_invite_accept, 0), ',', '"is_invite":', COALESCE(is_invite, 0), '}') AS relation_feature_json FROM (SELECT tp2.roleid, tp2.zoneid, tp2.object_roleid, tp2.object_zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT ral.like_roleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_belike_7days /* 近7天发起人是否被接受人点过赞 */, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT ral1.like_roleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_like_7days /* 近7天发起人是否给接受人点过赞  */, MAX(CASE WHEN tp2.player_action = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_portrait_click, MAX(CASE WHEN tp2.player_action = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_focus, MAX(CASE WHEN tp2.player_action = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_invite, MAX(fbif.is_focus_back) AS is_focus_back /* 对应玩家今日是否有回关 */, MAX(aiif.is_invite_accept) AS is_invite_accept, MAX(CASE WHEN ARRAY_CONTAINS(baif.account_array_ismvp, CONCAT(tp2.object_roleid, '_', tp2.object_zoneid)) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS is_own_win_mvp_7days /* -近7天发起人是否跟接受人同阵营战斗并胜利，且发起人获得MVP，其他玩家就非mvp */, MAX(CASE WHEN ARRAY_CONTAINS(baif2.account_array_ismvp, CONCAT(tp2.roleid, '_', tp2.zoneid)) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS is_object_win_mvp_7days /* -近7天发起人是否跟接受人同阵营战斗并胜利，且接受人获得MVP,其他玩家就非mvp */, MAX(CASE WHEN ARRAY_CONTAINS(baif.account_array_ismvp, CONCAT(tp2.object_roleid, '_', tp2.object_zoneid)) OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(baif.account_array_iswin, CONCAT(tp2.object_roleid, '_', tp2.object_zoneid)) OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(baif2.account_array_ismvp, CONCAT(tp2.roleid, '_', tp2.zoneid)) OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(baif2.account_array_iswin, CONCAT(tp2.roleid, '_', tp2.zoneid)) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS is_win_7days /* 近7天发起人是否跟接受人同阵营战斗并胜利   */ FROM event_type_2 AS tp2 LEFT JOIN focus_back_info AS fbif ON tp2.object_roleid = fbif.roleid AND tp2.object_zoneid = fbif.zoneid AND tp2.roleid = fbif.dest_roleid AND tp2.zoneid = fbif.dest_zone LEFT JOIN accept_invite_info AS aiif /* 发起人邀请接受人 */ ON tp2.object_roleid = aiif.roleid AND tp2.object_zoneid = aiif.zoneid AND tp2.roleid = aiif.invite_roleid AND tp2.zoneid = aiif.invite_zoneid /* 发起人被被发起人点赞 */ LEFT JOIN relations AS ral ON tp2.object_roleid = ral.roleid AND tp2.object_zoneid = ral.zoneid AND tp2.roleid = ral.like_roleid AND tp2.zoneid = ral.like_zoneid /* 发起人点赞被发起人  */ LEFT JOIN relations AS ral1 ON tp2.roleid = ral1.roleid AND tp2.zoneid = ral1.zoneid AND tp2.object_roleid = ral1.like_roleid AND tp2.object_zoneid = ral1.like_zoneid /* 发起人战斗信息  */ LEFT JOIN battle_info AS baif ON tp2.roleid = baif.roleid AND tp2.zoneid = baif.zoneid /* 接受人战斗信息 */ LEFT JOIN battle_info AS baif2 ON tp2.object_roleid = baif2.roleid AND tp2.object_zoneid = baif2.zoneid GROUP BY tp2.roleid, tp2.zoneid, tp2.object_roleid, tp2.object_zoneid) AS t1

name: export_bytedance.gameserver_team_kick_member
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.gameserver_team_kick_member PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, level, createrole_country, teamid, teamname, memzoneid, memroleuid FROM (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, level, createrole_country, teamid, teamname, memzoneid, memroleuid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_team_kick_member WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(createrole_country, '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS md LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_account FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-07', '2022-05-07', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON md.roleid = adv_us.us_account WHERE adv_us.us_account IS NULL

STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_behavior_recent7d_register_account_zone_di)) LEFT JOIN STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dwm_ml_client_configuration_account_zone_di)) ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND b.p_date >= '2026-05-25' AND b.p_date <= '2026-05-31' WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-25') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dm_ml_client_configuration_account_zone_fd7_v1_di)) SELECT accountid_a AS accountid, zoneid_a AS zoneid, active_days, register_date, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT defaultishighfps_dist_map['1'] IS NULL OR NOT defaultishighfps_dist_map['2'] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fd7_has_device_default_is_high_fps /* fd7内是否有设备默认高帧率 */, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT ishighfps_dist_map['1'] IS NULL OR NOT ishighfps_dist_map['2'] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fd7_has_device_is_high_fps /* fd7内是否有设备开启高帧数 */, MAP_UTIL(MAP_NULL_DEFAULT(defaulpicturequality_dist_map, CAST(0 AS BIGINT))).`merge_map` AS fd7_defult_pircture_quality_map /* fd7内默认画质设备分布 */, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT ishd_dist_map['2'] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fd7_has_device_is_hd /* fd7内是否有设备开启高清显示 */, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT isoptimizefps_dist_map['2'] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fd7_hsa_device_optimize_fps /* fd7内是否有设备开启战场优化 */, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT iscolorbindfilter_dist_map['2'] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fd7_has_device_is_color_bind_filtter /* fd7内是否有设备开启色盲显示 */, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT isdamagetext_dist_map['2'] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fd7_has_device_is_damage_text /* fd7内是否有设备开启伤害飘字 */, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT isshadow_dist_map['2'] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fd7_has_device_is_shadow /* fd7内是否有设备开启阴影开关 */, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT isskillvibration_dist_map['2'] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fd7_has_device_is_skill_vibration /* fd7内是否有设备开启镜头震动 */, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT iscameraheight_dist_map['2'] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fd7_has_device_is_camera_height /* fd7内是否有设备开启相机高度 */, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT isoutlines_dist_map['2'] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fd7_has_device_is_outlines /* fd7内是否有设备开启角色描边 */, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT ischaracterhalo_dist_map['2'] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fd7_has_device_is_character_halo /* fd7内是否有设备开启角色光晕 */, MAP_UTIL(MAP_NULL_DEFAULT(realpicturequality_dist_map, CAST(0 AS BIGINT))).`merge_map` AS fd7_real_picture_quality_map /* fd7内默认机型高中低分布 */, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT ultrachoose_dist_map['2'] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fd7_has_device_ultra_choose /* fd7内是否有设备开启极高画质 */, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(min_devicefreememory_map), register_date) AS fd7_min_device_free_memory_bitmap /* fd7内设备最小剩余空间位图 */, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(avg_devicefreememory_map), register_date) AS fd7_avg_device_free_memory_bitmap /* fd7内设备平均剩余空间位图 */, AVG(isudp_cnt) AS fd7_daily_avg_is_udp_cnt /* fd7内天级平均udp使用次数 */, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(avg_ping_variance_map), register_date) AS fd7_avg_ping_variance_sd_bitmap /* fd7内战斗ping值波动方差位图 */, AVG(avg_ping_variance) AS fd7_daily_avg_ping_variance_sd_bitmap /* fd7内天级平均战斗ping值波动方差 */, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(medianfps_map), register_date) AS fd7_median_fps_bitmap /* fd7内所有战斗fps中位数位图 */, AVG(medianfps) AS fd7_daily_avg_median_fsp /* fd7内天级平均战斗fps中位数 */, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(minfps_map), register_date) AS fd7_min_fps_bitmap /* fd7内战斗最低fps位图 */, AVG(minfps) AS fd7_daily_avg_min_fps /* fd7内天级平均战斗最低fps */, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(avg_netchange_map), register_date) AS fd7_avg_net_change_bitmap /* fd7内比赛网络平均切换次数位图 */, AVG(avg_netchange) AS fd7_daily_avg_net_change /* fd7内天级平均比赛网络切换次数 */ FROM behavior GROUP BY accountid_a, zoneid_a, active_days, register_date

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_ai_feature_battleid_role_zone_rank_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: helenma@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-01-09 13:19:29.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_ai_feature_battleid_role_zone_rank_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, last_bigranklvl AS settlement_big_rank_level, last_minranklvl AS settlement_small_rank_level, last_rankstar AS settlement_rank_star, his_last_bigrank AS history_big_rank_level, his_last_minrank AS history_small_rank_level, his_last_rankstar AS history_rank_star, his_last_rank_change_date FROM (SELECT logymd, zoneid, roleid, pvptype, MAX(last_bigranklvl) AS last_bigranklvl, MAX(last_minranklvl) AS last_minranklvl, MAX(last_rankstar) AS last_rankstar FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2 AND is_cur_season = 1 GROUP BY logymd, zoneid, roleid, pvptype) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, zoneid, roleid, pvptype, MAX(his_last_rank_change_date) AS his_last_rank_change_date, MAX(his_last_bigrank) AS his_last_bigrank, MAX(his_last_minrank) AS his_last_minrank, MAX(his_last_rankstar) AS his_last_rankstar FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype = 2 GROUP BY logymd, zoneid, roleid, pvptype) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.logymd = DATE_ADD(b.logymd, -1 * -1) AND a.pvptype = b.pvptype

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.gameserver_friend_focus_player PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, level, createrole_country, dest_roleid, dest_zone, is_focused, is_delete FROM (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, level, createrole_country, dest_roleid, dest_zone, is_focused, is_delete FROM ml_ods.gameserver_friend_focus_player WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(createrole_country, '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS md LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_account FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-07', '2022-05-07', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON md.roleid = adv_us.us_account WHERE adv_us.us_account IS NULL

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_login_role_device_hours_di.zgame
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_login_role_device_hours_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'zgame') SELECT roleid, COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device, COALESCE(HOUR(time), 0) AS login_hour, COUNT(1) AS login_cnt FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* 剔除测试服 */ (zoneid IN (1) OR zoneid >= 19001) GROUP BY roleid, device, HOUR(time)

'_', b.zoneid)) AS account_array_ismvp /* 与之对局是mvp 的玩家列表 */, COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(c.roleid, '_', c.zoneid)) AS account_array_iswin /* 与之对局是胜场的对局玩家列表 */ FROM battle_info_mid AS a LEFT JOIN battle_info_mid AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.ismvp = 1 LEFT JOIN battle_info_mid AS c ON a.battleid = c.battleid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid), focus_back_info /* 关注回关 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, dest_roleid, dest_zone, 1 AS is_focus_back FROM ml_ods.gameserver_friend_focus_player WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_focused = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, dest_roleid, dest_zone), accept_invite_info /* 接受邀请 */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, invite_roleid, invite_zoneid, 1 AS is_invite_accept FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_inviteshow WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND isaccept = 'accept' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, invite_roleid, invite_zoneid), relations AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, like_roleid, like_zoneid FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, SPLIT(exploded_like_player, '-')[0] AS like_roleid, SPLIT(exploded_like_player, '-')[1] AS like_zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_socialbehavior LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(likeplayer, '\\073')) exploded_table AS exploded_like_player WHERE logymd < '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-24') AS t1 WHERE NOT like_zoneid IS NULL GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, like_roleid, like_zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.dm_social_relationship_role_zone_flatten_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', event_type = 2) SELECT roleid, zoneid, object_roleid, object_zoneid, COALESCE(is_belike_7days, 0) AS is_belike_7days, COALESCE(is_like_7days, 0) AS is_like_7days, COALESCE(is_own_win_mvp_7days, 0) AS is_own_win_mvp_7days, COALESCE(is_object_win_mvp_7days, 0) AS is_object_win_mvp_7days, COALESCE(is_win_7days, 0) AS is_win_7days, COALESCE(is_portrait_click, 0) AS is_portrait_click, COALESCE(is_focus, 0) AS is_focus, COALESCE(is_focus_back, 0) AS is_focus_back, COALESCE(is_invite_accept, 0) AS is_invite_accept, COALESCE(is_invite, 0) AS is_invite FROM (SELECT tp2.roleid, tp2.zoneid, tp2.object_roleid, tp2.object_zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT ral.like_roleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_belike_7days /* 近7天发起人是否被接受人点过赞 */, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT ral1.like_roleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_like_7days /* 近7天发起人是否给接受人点过赞  */, MAX(CASE WHEN tp2.player_action = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_portrait_click, MAX(CASE WHEN tp2.player_action = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_focus, MAX(CASE WHEN tp2.player_action = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_invite, MAX(fbif.is_focus_back) AS is_focus_back /* 对应玩家今日是否有回关 */, MAX(aiif.is_invite_accept) AS is_invite_accept, MAX(CASE WHEN ARRAY_CONTAINS(baif.account_array_ismvp, CONCAT(tp2.object_roleid, '_', tp2.object_zoneid)) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS is_own_win_mvp_7days /* -近7天发起人是否跟接受人同阵营战斗并胜利，且发起人获得MVP，其他玩家就非mvp */, MAX(CASE WHEN ARRAY_CONTAINS(baif2.account_array_ismvp, CONCAT(tp2.roleid, '_', tp2.zoneid)) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS is_object_win_mvp_7days /* -近7天发起人是否跟接受人同阵营战斗并胜利，且接受人获得MVP,其他玩家就非mvp */, MAX(CASE WHEN ARRAY_CONTAINS(baif.account_array_ismvp, CONCAT(tp2.object_roleid, '_', tp2.object_zoneid)) OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(baif.account_array_iswin, CONCAT(tp2.object_roleid, '_', tp2.object_zoneid)) OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(baif2.account_array_ismvp, CONCAT(tp2.roleid, '_', tp2.zoneid)) OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(baif2.account_array_iswin, CONCAT(tp2.roleid, '_', tp2.zoneid)) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS is_win_7days /* 近7天发起人是否跟接受人同阵营战斗并胜利   */ FROM event_type_2 AS tp2 LEFT JOIN focus_back_info AS fbif ON tp2.object_roleid = fbif.roleid AND tp2.object_zoneid = fbif.zoneid AND tp2.roleid = fbif.dest_roleid AND tp2.zoneid = fbif.dest_zone LEFT JOIN accept_invite_info AS aiif /* 发起人邀请接受人 */ ON tp2.object_roleid = aiif.roleid AND tp2.object_zoneid = aiif.zoneid AND tp2.roleid = aiif.invite_roleid AND tp2.zoneid = aiif.invite_zoneid /* 发起人被被发起人点赞 */ LEFT JOIN relations AS ral ON tp2.object_roleid = ral.roleid AND tp2.object_zoneid = ral.zoneid AND tp2.roleid = ral.like_roleid AND tp2.zoneid = ral.like_zoneid /* 发起人点赞被发起人  */ LEFT JOIN relations AS ral1 ON tp2.roleid = ral1.roleid AND tp2.zoneid = ral1.zoneid AND tp2.object_roleid = ral1.like_roleid AND tp2.object_zoneid = ral1.like_zoneid /* 发起人战斗信息  */ LEFT JOIN battle_info AS baif ON tp2.roleid = baif.roleid AND tp2.zoneid = baif.zoneid /* 接受人战斗信息 */ LEFT JOIN battle_info AS baif2 ON tp2.object_roleid = baif2.roleid AND tp2.object_zoneid = baif2.zoneid GROUP BY tp2.roleid, tp2.zoneid, tp2.object_roleid, tp2.object_zoneid) AS t1

sql_units: WITH base AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(register_date, 1, 7) AS register_month, GET_ACTIVE(active_info /* 活跃位图，日期从右往左递增 */, register_date /* 位图最右侧对应日期 */, '2026-05-01' /* 统计区间的开始日期 */, '2026-05-31' /* 统计区间的结束日期 */, 'total_active_days' /* 统计期间内的总活跃天数 */) AS total_active_days FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_retention_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2023-11-22' AND register_date <= '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi_test.dwm_mau_retention_mi PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT register_month, COUNT(IF(total_active_days > 0, 1, NULL)) AS active_users, COUNT(IF(total_active_days = 0, 1, NULL)) AS non_active_users FROM base GROUP BY register_month

name: etl.mt_ai.dwm_social_relationship_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH t1 /* 邀请请弹窗上报 */ AS (SELECT invite_roleid AS roleid, invite_zoneid AS zoneid, accountid AS object_roleid, zoneid AS object_zoneid, 1 AS is_invite_accept FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_inviteshow WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND isaccept = 'accept' GROUP BY invite_roleid, invite_zoneid, accountid, zoneid), t2 /* 关注弹窗上报 */ AS (SELECT roleid_source AS roleid, zoneid_source AS zoneid, accountid AS object_roleid, zoneid AS object_zoneid, 1 AS is_focus_back FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_friend_focus_bubble WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND do_type IN (1, 4) /* 0=start阶段上报,01=点击回关按钮,2=点击关闭按钮,3=倒计时结束面板自动关闭,4=点击爱心按钮跳转粉丝列表,5=进入选角 */ GROUP BY roleid_source, zoneid_source, accountid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.dwm_social_relationship_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT IF(t3.zoneid < 57000, 'prd', 'test') AS experiment_mode, t3.scoring_type /* 打分类型,0:规则打分,1:规则随机打分,2:模型打分 */, t3.roleid, t3.zoneid, t3.object_roleid, t3.object_zoneid, 1 AS is_expo /* 由于曝光埋点不全，防止曝光次数=0,但是点击次数>0的情况出现 */, MAX(CASE WHEN t3.player_action = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_portrait_click, MAX(CASE WHEN t3.player_action = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_invite, MAX(CASE WHEN t3.player_action = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_focus, MAX(CASE WHEN t1.is_invite_accept > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_invite_accept, MAX(CASE WHEN t2.is_focus_back > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_focus_back FROM mt_ai.dwd_social_relationship_role_zone_di AS t3 LEFT JOIN t1 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND t1.object_roleid = t3.object_roleid AND t1.object_zoneid = t3.object_zoneid LEFT JOIN t2 ON t2.roleid = t3.roleid AND t2.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND t2.object_roleid = t3.object_roleid AND t2.object_zoneid = t3.object_zoneid WHERE t3.logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t3.scoring_type, t3.roleid, t3.zoneid, t3.object_roleid, t3.object_zoneid

COALESCE(storage_class, 'STANDARD') AS storage_class, REPLACE(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), SUBSTRING_INDEX(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/', -1), '') AS path_name, IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1]) AS table_name, IF(SIZE(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')) >= 4, SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], NULL) AS first_par_name, IF(SIZE(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')) >= 5, SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[3], NULL) AS sec_par_name, IF(SIZE(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')) >= 6, SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[4], NULL) AS third_par_name, IF(SIZE(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')) >= 7, SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[5], NULL) AS fourth_par_name, CAST(SUM(size) / 1024 / 1024 AS DECIMAL(30, 4)) AS size, MAX(last_modified_date) AS last_modified_date, IF(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[0] = 'table', 'table', 'path') AS type FROM mt_dwd.dwd_s3_storage_size_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY bucket_name, COALESCE(storage_class, 'STANDARD'), IF(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[0] = 'table', 'table', 'path'), IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1]), REPLACE(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), SUBSTRING_INDEX(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/', -1), ''), IF(SIZE(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')) >= 4, SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], NULL), IF(SIZE(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')) >= 5, SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[3], NULL), IF(SIZE(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')) >= 6, SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[4], NULL), IF(SIZE(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')) >= 7, SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[5], AS table_name, task_owner_user, task_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SPLIT(task_name, '\\.')[1], SPLIT(task_name, '\\.')[2] ORDER BY task_name) AS rn FROM mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_baseinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND project_name = '项目数仓' AND SPLIT(task_name, '\\.')[0] = 'etl' AND schedule_type = 2) AS t1 WHERE rn = 1) AS task_info ON s3_info.table_name = task_info.table_name AND IF(s3_info.bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', 'ml_ods', REPLACE(s3_info.bucket_name, '-', '_')) = task_info.db_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT email, user_name, dp_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY email, user_name ORDER BY dp_name DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_mt_user_info WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a WHERE rn = 1) AS user_info ON task_info.task_owner_user = user_info.email LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT SPLIT(ods_table_name, '\\.')[1] AS table_name, development_owner, development_department, business_owner, business_department, mlbb_dep FROM mt_dim.dim_ods_traceability_config WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS ods_info ON s3_info.table_name = ods_info.table_name

sql_units: /* 分路战力2023-11-07之前取road_powe_battleend 之后取road_powe_battleend */ WITH power_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, matchpower, realpower, exp_road_power, mid_road_power, roam_road_power, jungle_road_power, coin_road_power, pvptype FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, TIME, matchpower, realpower, exp_road_power, mid_road_power, roam_road_power, jungle_road_power, coin_road_power, 2 AS pvptype, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, TIME, matchpower, realpower, exp_road_power, mid_road_power, roam_road_power, jungle_road_power, coin_road_power FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2023-11-07' AND /* 剔除部分异常上报(success=0,matchpower 会上报异常) */ success <> 0 AND pvptype = 2 AND /* 剔除异常战力值 */ matchpower >= 0 AND matchpower <= 20000 AND realpower >= 0 AND realpower <= 20000 AND exp_road_power >= 0 AND exp_road_power <= 20000 AND mid_road_power >= 0 AND mid_road_power <= 20000 AND roam_road_power >= 0 AND roam_road_power <= 20000 AND jungle_road_power >= 0 AND jungle_road_power <= 20000 AND coin_road_power >= 0 AND coin_road_power <= 20000 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, TIME, NULL AS matchpower, NULL AS realpower, exp_road_power, mid_road_power, roam_road_power, jungle_road_power, coin_road_power FROM ml_ods.gameserver_road_powe_battleend WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* 2023-11-07 后分路战力值切换到ml_ods.matchserver_match_end */ logymd < '2023-11-07' AND /* 剔除异常战力值 */ exp_road_power >= 0 AND exp_road_power <= 20000 AND mid_road_power >= 0 AND mid_road_power <= 20000 AND roam_road_power >= 0 AND roam_road_power <= 20000 AND jungle_road_power >= 0 AND jungle_road_power <= 20000 AND coin_road_power >= 0 AND coin_road_power <= 20000) AS t1) AS t2 WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_dwm`.`dwm_battle_road_power_role_zone_di` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, matchpower AS day_last_match_power, realpower AS day_last_real_power, coin_road_power AS day_last_gold_road_real_power, exp_road_power AS day_last_exp_road_real_power, mid_road_power AS day_last_mid_road_real_power, jungle_road_power AS day_last_jungle_road_real_power, roam_road_power AS day_last_roam_road_real_power FROM power_info

'{{START_DATE}}' , '2026-05-31'), 1) */ /* ) */ /* , merge_df as */ /* ( */ /*     select  accountid */ /*             , zoneid */ /*             , first_value(his_first_pay_date) over (partition by accountid, zoneid order by source) as his_first_pay_date */ /*             , pay_info */ /*             , count_info */ /*             , amount_info */ /*             , actual_amount_info */ /*             , total_pay_cnt */ /*             , total_pay_amt */ /*             , total_actual_pay_amt */ /*             , source */ /*     from */ /*     ( */ /*         select * from */ /*         -- union all */ /*         -- select * from old_pay_df */ /*     ) */ /* ) */ /* , add_merge_df as */ /* ( */ /*     select  accountid */ /*             , zoneid */ /*             , his_first_pay_date */ /*             , pay_info */ /*             , count_info */ /*             , amount_info */ /*             , actual_amount_info */ /*             , total_pay_cnt */ /*             , total_pay_amt */ /*             , total_actual_pay_amt */ /*     from new_pay_df */ /* ) */ /* , res as ( */ /*     select  accountid */ /*             , zoneid */ /*             , min(his_first_pay_date) as his_first_pay_date */ /*             , array_merge(pay_info) as pay_info */ /*             , array_merge(count_info) as count_info */ /*             , array_merge(amount_info) as amount_info */ /*             , array_merge(actual_amount_info) as actual_amount_info */ /*             , sum(total_pay_cnt) as total_pay_cnt */ /*             , sum(total_pay_amt) as total_pay_amt */ /*             , cast(format_string('%.6f', sum(total_actual_pay_amt)) as double) as total_actual_pay_amt */ /*     from add_merge_df */ /*     group by accountid, zoneid */ /* ) */ WITH role_pay_di AS (SELECT CAST(roleid AS STRING) AS accountid, CAST(zoneid AS STRING) AS zoneid, SUM(pay_cnt) AS day_pay_cnt, CAST(ROUND(SUM(before_tax_usd_amt)) AS BIGINT) AS day_pay_amt, CAST(SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS DOUBLE) AS day_actual_pay_amt, logymd AS p_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND /* logymd between '2026-01-01' and '2026-12-31' */ before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid), new_pay_df AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, FIRST_VALUE(his_first_pay_date) AS his_first_pay_date, CAST(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(p_date, '@1', REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(next_date, 1 * -1), p_date)))))), '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}@', ''), ',') AS ARRAY<INT>) AS pay_info, CAST(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(p_date, '@', count_info, REPEAT(CONCAT(',', count_info), DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(next_date, 1 * -1), p_date)))))), '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}@', ''), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS count_info, CAST(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(p_date, '@', amount_info, REPEAT(CONCAT(',', amount_info), DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(next_date, 1 * -1), p_date)))))), '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}@', ''), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS amount_info, CAST(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(p_date, '@', FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', actual_amount_info), REPEAT(CONCAT(',', FORMAT_STRING('%.6f', actual_amount_info)), DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(next_date, 1 * -1), p_date)))))), '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}@', ''), ',') AS ARRAY<DOUBLE>) AS actual_amount_info, SUM(day_pay_cnt) AS total_pay_cnt, SUM(day_pay_amt) AS total_pay_amt, SUM(day_actual_pay_amt) AS total_actual_pay_amt, 1 AS source FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, day_pay_cnt, day_pay_amt, day_actual_pay_amt, p_date, FIRST_VALUE(p_date) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY p_date) AS his_first_pay_date, SUM(day_pay_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY p_date rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS count_info, SUM(day_pay_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY p_date rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_info, SUM(day_actual_pay_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY p_date rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS actual_amount_info, LEAD(p_date, 1, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1)) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY p_date) AS next_date FROM role_pay_di) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(mtai_dm_ml_behavior_pay_account_zone_df_out)) SELECT accountid, zoneid, his_first_pay_date, pay_info, count_info, amount_info, actual_amount_info, total_pay_cnt, total_pay_amt, total_actual_pay_amt FROM new_pay_df AS a

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_table_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-12-27 11:35:23.000 */ /* Description: 需求文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/VfnQwSKUViLoWXkaayUcuF3vngb */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_table_di( */ /*             `bucket_name` string COMMENT '桶名称', */ /*             `table_name` string COMMENT '路径名称', */ /*             `total_size` decimal(30,4) COMMENT '表名称（只针对规范路径可解析）', */ /*             `day_size` decimal(30,4) COMMENT '分区字段', */ /*             `partition_nums` bigint COMMENT '分区字段', */ /*             `latest_partition` string COMMENT '分区字段', */ /*             `earliest_partition` string COMMENT '分区字段', */ /*             `is_select` int COMMENT '大小（聚合到最后一层分区）', */ /*             `storage_class` string COMMENT '最后更新时间', */ /*             `LEVEL` string COMMENT '类型（无法解析表名的直接，直接记录路径名）', */ /*             `development_owner` string COMMENT '最后更新时间', */ /*             `development_department` string COMMENT '类型（无法解析表名的直接，直接记录路径名）', */ /*             `business_owner` string COMMENT '最后更新时间', */ /*             `business_department` string COMMENT '类型（无法解析表名的直接，直接记录路径名）', */ /*             `last_modified_date` string COMMENT '最后更新时间' */ /*         ) */ /*         PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '统计日期YYYY-MM-DD') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://mt-dwm/table/dwm_data_governance_table_di' */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_table_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT s3_info.bucket_name, s3_info.table_name, SIZE AS total_size, day_size, partition_nums, latest_partition, earliest_partition, COALESCE(is_select, 0) AS is_select, storage_class, NULL AS LEVEL, IF(s3_info.bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', COALESCE(development_owner, c_ods_info.user_name, create_nick), user_info.user_name) AS development_owner, IF(s3_info.bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', COALESCE(development_department, c_ods_info.dp_name), user_info.dp_name) AS development_department, IF(s3_info.bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', COALESCE(business_owner, c_ods_info.user_name, create_nick), user_info.user_name) AS business_owner, IF(s3_info.bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', COALESCE(business_department, c_ods_info.dp_name), user_info.dp_name) AS business_department, last_modified_date FROM (SELECT bucket_name, MAX(COALESCE(storage_class, 'STANDARD')) AS storage_class, IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], IF(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1] = 'bi', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1])) AS table_name, CAST(SUM(SIZE) / 1024 / 1024 AS DECIMAL(30, 4)) AS SIZE, MAX(last_modified_date) AS last_modified_date FROM mt_dwd.dwd_s3_storage_size_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((bucket_name = 'moonton-ml' AND is_latest = 'true') OR (bucket_name IN ('mt-dwm', 'mt-dim', 'mt-dm', 'mt-dwd', 'mt-ads'))) AND SPLIT(REPLACE(REPLACE(key, '%253D', '='), '%3D', '='), '/')[0] = 'table' GROUP BY IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], IF(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1] = 'bi', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1])), bucket_name) AS s3_info LEFT JOIN (SELECT db_name, table_name, task_owner_user, task_name FROM (SELECT SPLIT(task_name, '\\.')[1] AS db_name, COALESCE(SPLIT(task_name, '\\.')[2], SPLIT(task_name, '\\.')[1]) AS table_name, task_owner_user, task_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SPLIT(task_name, '\\.')[1], SPLIT(task_name, '\\.')[2] ORDER BY task_name) AS rn FROM mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_baseinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND project_name = '项目数仓' AND SPLIT(task_name, '\\.')[0] = 'etl' AND schedule_type = 2) AS t1 WHERE rn = 1) AS task_info ON s3_info.table_name = task_info.table_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT email, user_name, dp_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY email, user_name ORDER BY dp_name DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_mt_user_info WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a WHERE rn = 1) AS user_info ON task_info.task_owner_user = user_info.email LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT SPLIT(ods_table_name, '\\.')[1] AS table_name, development_owner, development_department, business_owner, business_department FROM mt_dim.dim_ods_traceability_config WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS ods_info ON s3_info.table_name = ods_info.table_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT bucket_name, table_name, SUM(IF(SPLIT(par_name, '=')[1] = '2026-05-29', par_size, 0)) AS day_size, COUNT(DISTINCT par_name) AS partition_nums, MAX(IF(LENGTH(SPLIT(par_name, '=')[1]) = 10, SPLIT(par_name, '=')[1], NULL)) AS latest_partition, MIN(IF(LENGTH(SPLIT(par_name, '=')[1]) = 10, SPLIT(par_name, '=')[1], NULL)) AS earliest_partition FROM (SELECT bucket_name, IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], IF(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1] = 'bi', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1])) AS table_name, IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[3], IF(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1] = 'bi', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[3], SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2])) AS par_name, CAST(SUM(SIZE) / 1024 / 1024 AS DECIMAL(30, 4)) AS par_size FROM mt_dwd.dwd_s3_storage_size_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((bucket_name = 'moonton-ml' AND is_latest = 'true') OR (bucket_name IN ('mt-dwm', 'mt-dim', 'mt-dm', 'mt-dwd', 'mt-ads'))) AND SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[0] = 'table' GROUP BY bucket_name, IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], IF(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1] = 'bi', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1])), IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[3], IF(SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1] = 'bi', SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[3], SPLIT(REPLACE(key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2]))) AS t1 GROUP BY table_name, bucket_name) AS par_info ON s3_info.table_name = par_info.table_name AND s3_info.bucket_name = par_info.bucket_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT bucket_name, IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', SPLIT(REPLACE(secret_key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], IF(SPLIT(REPLACE(secret_key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1] = 'bi', SPLIT(REPLACE(secret_key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], SPLIT(REPLACE(secret_key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1])) AS table_name, IF(COUNT(1) > 1, 1, 0) AS is_select FROM mt_ods.moonton_s3log WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND bucket_name IN ('moonton-ml', 'mt-dwm', 'mt-dim', 'mt-dm', 'mt-dwd', 'mt-ads') AND SPLIT(REPLACE(secret_key, '%3D', '='), '/')[0] = 'table' GROUP BY bucket_name, IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', SPLIT(REPLACE(secret_key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], IF(SPLIT(REPLACE(secret_key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1] = 'bi', SPLIT(REPLACE(secret_key, '%3D', '='), '/')[2], SPLIT(REPLACE(secret_key, '%3D', '='), '/')[1]))) AS select_info ON s3_info.table_name = select_info.table_name AND s3_info.bucket_name = select_info.bucket_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CONCAT('connserver_', LOWER(GET_JSON_OBJECT(data, '$.name'))) AS table_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(fields, '$.creator') AS create_nick, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CONCAT('connserver_', LOWER(GET_JSON_OBJECT(data, '$.name'))) ORDER BY updatedat DESC) AS rn FROM mt_ods.mlbb_ods_client_config WHERE date = '2026-05-31' AND NOT CONCAT('connserver_', LOWER(GET_JSON_OBJECT(data, '$.name'))) IS NULL) AS b LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT nick, user_name, dp_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nick ORDER BY dp_name DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_mt_user_info WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a WHERE rn = 1) AS c ON b.create_nick = c.nick WHERE b.rn = 1) AS c_ods_info ON s3_info.table_name = c_ods_info.table_name

name: adbi.dwm_mau_role_zone_retention_mi
sql_units: /* 2023.5.1日跑业务日期为2023.4.30的数据，实际分区为2023-03 */ WITH country_code AS (SELECT UPPER(country_code) AS country_code FROM mt_dim.config_country), MAU_info AS (SELECT a.year_month /* 月份 */, a.roleid /* 用户roleid */, a.usercreateymd /* 创角日期 */, a.active_days_mau /* 本月活跃天数 */, CASE WHEN a.usercreateymd >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC('2026-06-01', 'MM'), -1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_user_mau /* 创角日期在本月，则是本月新增 */, COALESCE(UPPER(b.adjust_country), 'ZZ') AS adjust_country /* 国家 */, b.adjust_network_name /* 渠道 */ FROM (SELECT SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) AS YEAR_MONTH /* 月份 */, roleid /* 用户roleid */, MIN(usercreateymd) AS usercreateymd /* 最小创角日期，以判断是否为本月新用户 */, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days_mau /* 本月活跃天数 */ FROM mt_dwd.datacleaning_login_metrics /* 登录中间小表 */ WHERE logymd >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC('2026-06-01', 'MM'), -1) /* 本月 */ AND logymd < TRUNC('2026-06-01', 'MM') AND zoneid < 57000 /* 排除测试服 */ GROUP BY YEAR_MONTH, roleid) AS a /* MAU的创角日期和活跃天数 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, CASE WHEN adjust_country IS NULL THEN 'ZZ' WHEN adjust_country = '-' THEN 'ZZ' ELSE adjust_country END AS adjust_country, adjust_network_name FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df WHERE appid = 'mlbb') AS b /* 用户的国家和渠道 */ ON a.roleid = b.accountid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_mau_role_zone_retention_mi)) SELECT roleid, usercreateymd, adjust_country, CASE WHEN (adjust_network_name <> 'Organic' OR adjust_network_name IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_organic, new_user_mau, active_days_mau, ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC('2026-06-01', 'MM'), -1) AS p_date FROM MAU_info

name: 新手标签df表ml_temp.dm_wmz_newbie_label_roleid_zoneid_df
sql_units: WITH first_battle_t AS (SELECT a.zoneid, a.accountid, MIN(DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.register_date) + 1) AS register_diff_date /* 取第一次数据 */, b.register_date, PMOD(MIN(a.heroid + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.`time`) * 100000000), 100000000) AS heroid, PMOD(MIN((a.killnum + a.assist) / (a.dead + 1) * 10000 + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.`time`) * 1000000000), 100000000) / 10000 AS kda, PMOD(MIN(a.towerhurtrate + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.`time`) * 1000000000), 100000000) AS towerhurtrate, PMOD(MIN(a.fightrate + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.`time`) * 1000000000), 100000000) AS fightrate, PMOD(MIN(c.maxapm + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.`time`) * 1000000000), 100000000) AS maxapm, PMOD(MIN(c.addskilltime / addskillcount + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.`time`) * 1000000000), 100000000) AS add_skill_latency, PMOD(MIN(c.buyequiptime / buyequipcount + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.`time`) * 1000000000), 100000000) AS buy_equip_latency, PMOD(MIN(a.total_equip_value + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.`time`) * 1000000000), 100000000) AS total_equip_value FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata AS a JOIN (/* 只保留新增新玩家 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, new_type FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS t WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND register_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN ml_ods.connserver_client_gameskill AS c ON a.accountid = c.accountid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.battleid = c.battleid AND a.logymd = c.logymd LEFT JOIN ml_temp.dm_wmz_newbie_label_roleid_zoneid_df AS d ON a.accountid = d.roleid AND a.zoneid = d.zoneid AND d.logymd = '2026-05-30' WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' /* 取无标签玩家的7天战斗 */ AND a.LEVEL = 3 /* 新手第四关等级为3 */ AND a.battleid BETWEEN 1000000000 AND 1000000000000 /* 新手第四关 */ AND a.battletype IN (1, 188) /* 新手第四关,20240923增加快捷模式数据 */ AND a.battle_time > 40 /* 新手第四关剔除短时间异常对局 */ AND c.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' /* 取无标签玩家的7天战斗 */ AND d.roleid IS NULL /* 剔除昨天分区的数据 */ AND a.heroid IN (85, 18, 1, 16, 60, 28, 77, 2, 5, 38) /* 只保留这10个英雄 */ GROUP BY a.zoneid, a.accountid, b.register_date), hero_feature_avg_std AS (/* 每个英雄不同特征平均数和标准差 */ SELECT heroid, AVG(kda) AS kda_avg, STD(kda) AS kda_std, AVG(towerhurtrate) AS towerhurtrate_avg, STD(towerhurtrate) AS towerhurtrate_std, AVG(fightrate) AS fightrate_avg, STD(fightrate) AS fightrate_std, AVG(maxapm) AS maxapm_avg, STD(maxapm) AS maxapm_std, AVG(add_skill_latency) AS add_skill_latency_avg, STD(add_skill_latency) AS add_skill_latency_std, AVG(buy_equip_latency) AS buy_equip_latency_avg, STD(buy_equip_latency) AS buy_equip_latency_std, AVG(total_equip_value) AS total_equip_value_avg, STD(total_equip_value) AS total_equip_value_std FROM ml_temp.t_tmp_wmz_newbie_label_solidify_20230601_20231227_battledata_30w_20231228_alter_7feature_2 GROUP BY heroid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.dm_wmz_newbie_label_roleid_zoneid_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, register_date, register_diff_date, heroid, centroid_k, centroid_diff, kda, towerhurtrate, fightrate, maxapm, add_skill_latency, buy_equip_latency, total_equip_value FROM (/* 找到距离最近的质心 */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, register_date, register_diff_date, heroid, centroid_k, centroid_diff, kda, towerhurtrate, fightrate, maxapm, add_skill_latency, buy_equip_latency, total_equip_value, MIN(centroid_diff) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, register_date, heroid) AS centroid_diff_min, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, register_date, heroid ORDER BY centroid_diff ASC) AS centroid_diff_rank FROM (/* 计算测试样本z分数离质心的距离 */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, register_date, register_diff_date, t.heroid, centroid_k, kda, towerhurtrate, fightrate, maxapm, add_skill_latency, buy_equip_latency, total_equip_value, SUM(POWER((kda - kda_avg) / kda_std - kda_std_score_avg, 2) + POWER((towerhurtrate - towerhurtrate_avg) / towerhurtrate_std - towerhurtrate_std_score_avg, 2) + POWER((fightrate - fightrate_avg) / fightrate_std - fightrate_std_score_avg, 2) + POWER((maxapm - maxapm_avg) / maxapm_std - maxapm_std_score_avg, 2) + POWER((add_skill_latency - add_skill_latency_avg) / add_skill_latency_std - add_skill_latency_std_score_avg, 2) + POWER((buy_equip_latency - buy_equip_latency_avg) / buy_equip_latency_std - buy_equip_latency_std_score_avg, 2) + POWER((total_equip_value - total_equip_value_avg) / total_equip_value_std - total_equip_value_std_score_avg, 2)) AS centroid_diff FROM first_battle_t AS t LEFT JOIN (/* 计算每个heroid每个类型的质心 */ SELECT t.heroid, t.k AS centroid_k, AVG((kda - kda_avg) / kda_std) AS kda_std_score_avg, AVG((towerhurtrate - towerhurtrate_avg) / towerhurtrate_std) AS towerhurtrate_std_score_avg, AVG((fightrate - fightrate_avg) / fightrate_std) AS fightrate_std_score_avg, AVG((maxapm - maxapm_avg) / maxapm_std) AS maxapm_std_score_avg, AVG((add_skill_latency - WHEN ad_target IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE ad_target END AS ad_target FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwa_admkt_input_cost_report_fully)) WHERE date = '20260531' AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL /* 抓取 */ SELECT a.ad_account_id, a.report_date, a.media_source, a.campaign_id, a.campaign_name, a.adset_id, a.adset_name, a.ad_id, a.ad_name, a.app_id, a.app_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(a.os), '') = '', 'unknown', a.os) AS os, a.country, a.impression, a.click, a.cost, a.cost AS cost_align, b.ad_target FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwa_admkt_api_ad_cost_report_df)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.app_id, x.ad_account_id, x.ad_target, x.ad_platform_name FROM (SELECT app_id, ad_account_id, ad_target, ad_platform_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, ad_platform_name, ad_account_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rn FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_gms_ad_bi_ad_account)) WHERE date = '20260531') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1) AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.ad_account_id = b.ad_account_id AND a.media_source = b.ad_platform_name WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-31' /* 小渠道的消耗数据暂时只要6月2号之前的数据 */ UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ad_account_id, report_date, network AS media_source, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_id AS adset_id, adgroup_name AS cost, adjust_cost AS cost_align, 1 AS ad_target FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_ods_adjust_cost_di)) WHERE logymd <= '2024-06-02' AND logymd >= '2023-11-06' /*  只要11月6号之后的数据 */ UNION ALL SELECT ad_account_id, '', 'unknown', campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adset_id), '') = '', 'unknown', adset_id) AS adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ad_id), '') = '', 'unknown', ad_id) AS ad_id, = 1 THEN impression ELSE 0 END) AS impression_new, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN click ELSE 0 END) AS click_new, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS cost_new, SUM(CASE WHEN scene_name STRING COMMENT '场景名称', */ /*             battle_num BIGINT COMMENT '战斗人数', */ /*             battle_cnt BIGINT COMMENT '战斗次数', */ /*             crash_num BIGINT COMMENT '闪退人数', */ /*             crash_cnt BIGINT COMMENT '闪退次数', */ /*             memory_warn_num BIGINT COMMENT '内存告警人数', */ /*             memory_warn_num BIGINT COMMENT '内存告警次数' */ /*         ) COMMENT '性能明细表小时表' */ /*         PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd',logh STRING COMMENT '小时分区') STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_performance_monitoring_hi'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_performance_monitoring_hi PARTITION(logymd, logh) SELECT IF(CEIL(memorysize / 1024) <= 1, '1G', IF(CEIL(memorysize / 1024) <= 2 AND CEIL(memorysize / 1024) > 1, '1G~2G', IF(CEIL(memorysize / 1024) < 6 AND CEIL(memorysize / 1024) > 2, '2G-6G', IF(CEIL(memorysize / 1024) >= 6, '>=6G', 'else')))) AS memory_type, IF(battle_num <= 7, battle_num, 8) AS battle_num_type, FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) AS zoneid, IF(SUBSTRING(os, 1, 3) = 'iOS', 'iOS', 'Android') AS os, IF(pvptype IN (1, 2), '5v5', IF(pvptype IN (39), 'chess', 'others')) AS pvptype, heroid, device_model, Internal_unity_ver, scene_name, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS battle_num, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_crash = 1, roleid, NULL)) AS crash_num, SUM(IF(is_crash = 1, 1, 0)) AS crash_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_warn = 1, roleid, NULL)) AS memory_warn_num, SUM(IF(is_warn = 1, 1, 0)) AS memory_warn_cnt, SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 21:00:00') - 17 * 3600) AS STRING), 1, 10) AS logymd, SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 21:00:00') - 17 * 3600) AS STRING), 12, 2) AS logh FROM mt_dwd.dwd_performance_battleid_hi WHERE logymd = SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 21:00:00') - 17 * 3600) AS STRING), 1, 10) AND logh = SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 21:00:00') - 17 * 3600) AS STRING), 12, 2) AND os <> 'Emulator' AND unity_ver IN ('UI20_32', 'UI20_64', 'UI20_ios', 'UI20_32_2019', 'UI20_64_2019', 'UI20_ios_2019') GROUP BY IF(CEIL(memorysize / 1024) <= 1, '1G', IF(CEIL(memorysize / 1024) <= 2 AND CEIL(memorysize / 1024) > 1, '1G~2G', IF(CEIL(memorysize / 1024) < 6 AND CEIL(memorysize / 1024) > 2, '2G-6G', IF(CEIL(memorysize / 1024) >= 6, '>=6G', 'else')))), IF(battle_num <= 7, battle_num, 8), FLOOR(zoneid / 1000), IF(SUBSTRING(os, 1, 3) = 'iOS', 'iOS', 'Android'), IF(pvptype IN (1, 2), '5v5', IF(pvptype IN (39), 'chess', 'others')), heroid, device_model, Internal_unity_ver, scene_name

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_battle_friend_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jichun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-01-31 21:00:17.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 2025-12-15       jichun               增加ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata isbot的逻辑 https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/Eaosws3oAiSrbWkagBIcphspn4e?from=from_copylink */ WITH gameserver_battle_with_friend AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, battleid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id, is_win, battle_type, TIME FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id, battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_battle_with_friend WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') WHERE rn = 1), battleserver_battle_end AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, battletime AS battle_dur /* 战斗时长 */, kda, wincamp AS is_win FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC, battleresulttype) AS rn FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') WHERE rn = 1), connserver_battleenddata AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, `TIME` AS battle_end_time, battle_time AS battle_dur, iswin AS is_win, killnum, assist, dead, FLOOR((killnum + assist) / (dead + 1) * 100) AS kda FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY `TIME` DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(isbot, 0) = 0) WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_dwd`.`dwd_battle_friend_role_zone_di` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT bef.roleid AS roleid, bef.zoneid AS zoneid, bef.friend_role_id AS friend_role_id, bef.friend_zone_id AS friend_zone_id, bef.battleid AS battleid, bef.battle_type AS pvptype, COALESCE(bet.battle_dur, con.battle_dur, 0) AS battle_dur, COALESCE(bet.kda, con.kda, 0) AS kda, COALESCE(bef.is_win, bet.is_win, con.is_win, -99999) AS is_win, bef.time FROM gameserver_battle_with_friend AS bef LEFT JOIN battleserver_battle_end AS bet ON bef.friend_role_id = bet.roleid AND bef.friend_zone_id = bet.zoneid AND bef.battleid = bet.battleid LEFT JOIN connserver_battleenddata AS con ON bef.friend_role_id = con.roleid AND bef.friend_zone_id = con.zoneid AND bef.battleid = con.battleid

name: 回流系统英雄推荐
sql_units: WITH battle_a AS (/* 原数据 */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, wincamp, banhero, bigranklvl FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-18' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype = 2 /* 排位 */ AND fake_ai = 0 /* 排除AI */ AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90) AND isinvalidbattle = 0 AND bigranklvl >= 4 AND a.wincamp IN (0, 1) GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.heroid, a.wincamp, a.banhero, bigranklvl), battle_b AS (SELECT battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT heroid) AS hero_num, MAX(bigranklvl) AS game_ranklvl /* 对局段位 */ FROM battle_a AS a GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT heroid) = 10 AND game_ranklvl > 4), hero_use_win /* 计算对局中不同英雄数量和对局段位 */ AS (SELECT heroid, game_ranklvl, COUNT(CASE WHEN wincamp = 1 THEN 1 END) AS hero_victory_battlecnt /* 角色使用指定英雄战斗胜利总次数（角色英雄胜率） */, COUNT(1) AS hero_battlecnt /* 角色使用指定英雄战斗总次数&角色使用指定皮肤对应英雄战斗总次数（角色英雄胜率、角色英雄使用率、角色皮肤使用率） */ FROM battle_a AS a JOIN battle_b AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY heroid, game_ranklvl), total_hero /* 英雄使用率和胜率 */ AS (SELECT game_ranklvl, COUNT(1) AS hero_total_battlecnt /* 角色使用任意英雄战斗总次数（角色英雄使用率） */ FROM battle_a AS a JOIN battle_b AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY game_ranklvl), banhero /* 角色使用任意英雄战斗总次数 */ AS (SELECT banhero, game_ranklvl, COUNT(1) AS banhero_cnt /* 角色Ban指定英雄总次数（角色英雄禁用率） */ FROM (SELECT * FROM battle_a WHERE banhero <> 0) AS a JOIN battle_b AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY banhero, game_ranklvl), total_banhero /* 英雄禁用率 */ AS (SELECT game_ranklvl, COUNT(1) AS banhero_total_cnt /* 角色Ban任意英雄总次数（角色英雄禁用率） */ FROM (SELECT * FROM battle_a WHERE banhero <> 0) AS a JOIN battle_b AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY game_ranklvl), hero_config AS (/* 英雄配置表 */ SELECT hf.heroid, hf.hero_name, hf.position, hf.heroes FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df AS hf WHERE hf.logymd = '2026-05-31'), UN AS (SELECT t.heroid, t.game_ranklvl, hero_victory_battlecnt, hero_battlecnt, hero_total_battlecnt, banhero_cnt, banhero_total_cnt, hero_victory_battlecnt / hero_battlecnt AS win_rate, hero_battlecnt / hero_total_battlecnt AS pick_rate, banhero_cnt / banhero_total_cnt AS ban_rate, (hero_battlecnt / hero_total_battlecnt) * 4 + (banhero_cnt / banhero_total_cnt) * 2 + (hero_victory_battlecnt / hero_battlecnt) AS recommend_rate FROM (SELECT a.heroid, a.game_ranklvl, a.hero_victory_battlecnt, a.hero_battlecnt, b.banhero_cnt FROM hero_use_win AS a JOIN banhero AS b ON a.heroid = b.banhero AND a.game_ranklvl = b.game_ranklvl) AS t LEFT JOIN total_hero AS c ON t.game_ranklvl = c.game_ranklvl LEFT JOIN total_banhero AS d ON t.game_ranklvl = d.game_ranklvl WHERE t.game_ranklvl > 4 GROUP BY t.heroid, t.game_ranklvl, hero_victory_battlecnt, hero_battlecnt, hero_total_battlecnt, banhero_cnt, banhero_total_cnt UNION ALL SELECT t.heroid, 99 AS game_ranklvl, t.hero_victory_battlecnt, t.hero_battlecnt, c.hero_total_battlecnt, t.banhero_cnt, d.banhero_total_cnt, hero_victory_battlecnt / hero_battlecnt AS win_rate, hero_battlecnt / hero_total_battlecnt AS pick_rate, banhero_cnt / banhero_total_cnt AS ban_rate, (hero_battlecnt / hero_total_battlecnt) * 4 + (banhero_cnt / banhero_total_cnt) * 2 + (hero_victory_battlecnt / hero_battlecnt) AS recommend_rate FROM (SELECT a.heroid, SUM(a.hero_victory_battlecnt) AS hero_victory_battlecnt, SUM(a.hero_battlecnt) AS hero_battlecnt, SUM(b.banhero_cnt) AS banhero_cnt, 'cs' AS join_tag FROM hero_use_win AS a LEFT JOIN banhero AS b ON a.heroid = b.banhero AND a.game_ranklvl = b.game_ranklvl GROUP BY a.heroid) AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(hero_total_battlecnt) AS hero_total_battlecnt, 'cs' AS join_tag FROM total_hero GROUP BY join_tag) AS c ON c.join_tag = t.join_tag LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(banhero_total_cnt) AS banhero_total_cnt, 'cs' AS join_tag FROM total_banhero GROUP BY join_tag) AS d ON d.join_tag = t.join_tag GROUP BY t.heroid, t.hero_victory_battlecnt, t.hero_battlecnt, c.hero_total_battlecnt, t.banhero_cnt, d.banhero_total_cnt) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_mlbb_battle_heros_info_df SELECT un.heroid, hf.hero_name, un.game_ranklvl, un.hero_victory_battlecnt, un.hero_battlecnt, un.hero_total_battlecnt, un.banhero_cnt, un.banhero_total_cnt, un.win_rate, un.pick_rate, un.ban_rate, un.recommend_rate, hf.position, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY game_ranklvl, hf.position ORDER BY recommend_rate DESC) AS recommend_rank FROM un JOIN hero_config AS hf ON hf.heroid = un.heroid ORDER BY recommend_rank, hf.position, game_ranklvl

name: 用户教育AB监测核心指标di表ads_wmz_education_abtest_core_di
sql_units: /* 用户教育看板_核心数据 2026-05-31 */ WITH a1 /* 进组新手信息 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, roleid % 2 AS if_roleid_odd, createrole_country, param_name, MAX(`level`) AS `level`, CASE WHEN LOCATE('test1', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验1' WHEN LOCATE('test2', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验2' WHEN LOCATE('test3', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验3' WHEN LOCATE('test4', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验4' WHEN LOCATE('test5', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验5' WHEN LOCATE('test6', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验6' WHEN LOCATE('test7', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验7' WHEN LOCATE('test8', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验8' WHEN LOCATE('test9', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验9' WHEN LOCATE('test10', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验10' WHEN LOCATE('test', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验' WHEN LOCATE('control', param_value) <> 0 THEN '对照' ELSE '其他' END AS param_value, MIN(logymd) AS min_logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE logymd >= '2023-12-01' /* 数据监测开始时间 */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     zoneid <= 57000 */ (LOCATE('TECH', UPPER(param_name)) <> 0 OR LOCATE('MLBBKNOWLEDGE', UPPER(param_name)) <> 0 OR LOCATE('HEROPRICE', UPPER(param_name)) <> 0 OR LOCATE('NEWBIE', UPPER(param_name)) <> 0 OR LOCATE('NEW', UPPER(param_name)) <> 0) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, if_roleid_odd, createrole_country, param_name, CASE WHEN LOCATE('test1', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验1' WHEN LOCATE('test2', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验2' WHEN LOCATE('test3', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验3' WHEN LOCATE('test4', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验4' WHEN LOCATE('test5', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验5' WHEN LOCATE('test6', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验6' WHEN LOCATE('test7', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验7' WHEN LOCATE('test8', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验8' WHEN LOCATE('test9', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验9' WHEN LOCATE('test10', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验10' WHEN LOCATE('test', param_value) <> 0 THEN '实验' WHEN LOCATE('control', param_value) <> 0 THEN '对照' ELSE '其他' END), edu_activity_t /* 跳转关卡 */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_LIST(activityid) AS activityid, COLLECT_LIST(activityid || ':' || CAST(`time` AS STRING)) AS activityid_time, COLLECT_LIST(activityid || ':' || CAST(`level` AS STRING)) AS activityid_level FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, activityid ORDER BY time ASC) AS row_number_time_asc FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_guideproposal WHERE logymd >= '2023-12-01' /* 数据监测开始时间 */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND `skip` = 1) AS t WHERE row_number_time_asc = 1 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), reach_edu_activity_t /* 触达关卡 */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_LIST(activityid) AS reach_activityid, COLLECT_LIST(activityid || ':' || CAST(`time` AS STRING)) AS reach_activityid_time, COLLECT_LIST(activityid || ':' || CAST(`level` AS STRING)) AS reach_activityid_level FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, activityid ORDER BY time ASC) AS row_number_time_asc FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_guideproposal WHERE logymd >= '2023-12-01' /* 数据监测开始时间 */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-31') AS t WHERE row_number_time_asc = 1 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), newbie_info_t /* AND     t.zoneid <= 57000 */ AS (SELECT t.roleid, t.zoneid, t5.create_country, t1.min_logymd, t.register_date, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', t.register_date) + 1 AS register_days /* 已入组天数/对于新玩家是注册天数 */, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', min_logymd) + 1 AS join_ab_days /* 已入组天数/对于新玩家是注册天数 */, SUBSTRING(t.active_info, 1, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', min_logymd) + 1) AS active_info /* 入组以后得活跃位图 */, COALESCE(t2.max_level, t1.`level`) AS `level`, t.new_type, t4.newbie_1_heroid, t3.label_1_new AS newbie_tag, t1.if_roleid_odd, t1.createrole_country, t1.param_name, t1.param_value, t6.his_activedays, t6.his_ol_dur FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_retention_role_zone_df AS t JOIN a1 AS t1 ON t.roleid = t1.roleid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND (t1.min_logymd /* 新用户做注册日期=入组日期筛选 */ = t.register_date OR min_logymd >= DATE_ADD(t.register_date, 29)) AND min_logymd IN ('2026-05-31' /* 仅仅保留1、2、3、4、5、6、7、14、30天前入组数据 */, '2026-05-30', '2026-05-29', '2026-05-28', '2026-05-27', '2026-05-26', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-18', '2026-05-02') LEFT JOIN (/* 近30天有等级变化的最大等级 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(`level`) AS max_level FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_level WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t2 ON t.roleid = t2.roleid AND t.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN ml_temp.new_cluster_label_df AS t3 /* 4.24修改 */ ON t.roleid = t3.roleid AND t.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND t3.logymd = '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN ml_temp.dm_jax_newbie_di AS t4 /* 取三选一英雄信息 */ ON t.roleid = t4.roleid AND t.zoneid = t4.zoneid AND t1.min_logymd = t4.register_date AND t4.logymd = '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN (/* 取创角国 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t5 ON t.roleid = t5.roleid AND t.zoneid = t5.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 取注册至今活跃天数，累计在线时长 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_activedays, his_ol_dur FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t6 ON t.roleid = t6.roleid AND t.zoneid = t6.zoneid WHERE t.logymd = '2026-05-31'), newbie_battle_t AS (SELECT t.roleid, t.zoneid, MAX(t.his_max_rank_id) AS his_max_rank_id, MAX(t.his_max_minranklvl) AS his_max_minranklvl, MAX(t.his_max_bigranklvl) AS his_max_bigranklvl, MAX(t.his_first_achieve3_time_bigranklvl) AS his_first_achieve3_bigranklvl_time, MAX(t.his_first_achieve4_time_bigranklvl) AS his_first_achieve4_bigranklvl_time, MAX(t.his_first_achieve5_time_bigranklvl) AS his_first_achieve5_bigranklvl_time, COUNT(DISTINCT t.battleid) AS pvp12_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype IN (1, 188), t.battleid, NULL)) AS pvp1_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype = 2, t.battleid, NULL)) AS pvp2_battle_cnt, SUM(t.battle_time) AS pvp12_battl_time, SUM(IF(t.pvptype IN (1, 188), LEAST(t.battle_time, t3.pvp1_battle_time_99), 0)) AS pvp1_battle_time, SUM(IF(t.pvptype = 2, LEAST(t.battle_time, t4.pvp2_battle_time_99), 0)) AS pvp2_battle_time, SUM(IF(t.pvptype IN (1, 188), LEAST(t.killnum, t3.pvp1_killnum_99), 0)) AS pvp1_killnum, SUM(IF(t.pvptype = 2, LEAST(t.killnum, t4.pvp2_killnum_99), 0)) AS pvp2_killnum, SUM(IF(t.pvptype IN (1, 188), LEAST(t.dead, t3.pvp1_dead_99), 0)) AS pvp1_dead, SUM(IF(t.pvptype = 2, LEAST(t.dead, t4.pvp2_dead_99), 0)) AS pvp2_dead, SUM(IF(t.pvptype IN (1, 188), LEAST(t.assist, t3.pvp1_assist_99), 0)) AS pvp1_assist, SUM(IF(t.pvptype = 2, LEAST(t.assist, t4.pvp2_assist_99), 0)) AS pvp2_assist, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype IN (1, 188) AND t.iswin = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS pvp1_win_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype = 2 AND t.iswin = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS pvp2_win_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype IN (1, 188) AND if_exist_battle_end_data = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS pvp1_roaddata_battle_cnt /* 计算分路冲突率（分路数据）时所用战斗场次 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype = 2 AND if_exist_battle_end_data = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS pvp2_roaddata_battle_cnt /* 计算分路冲突率（分路数据）时所用战斗场次 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype = 2 AND if_exist_battle_end_data = 1 AND camp_real_players_cnt = 5, t.battleid, NULL)) AS real5_pvp2_roaddata_battle_cnt /* 计算分路冲突率（分路数据）时所用战斗场次(己方5真人排位) */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype IN (1, 188) AND t.if_pre_select_road_precise = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS pvp1_pickroad_precise_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype = 2 AND t.if_pre_select_road_precise = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS pvp2_pickroad_precise_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype IN (1, 188) AND t.if_pre_select_road_conflict = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS pvp1_pickroad_conflict_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype = 2 AND t.if_pre_select_road_conflict = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS pvp2_pickroad_conflict_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype IN (1, 188) AND t.if_pre_select_road_lack = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS pvp1_pickroad_lack_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype = 2 AND t.if_pre_select_road_lack = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS pvp2_pickroad_lack_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype IN (1, 188) AND t.if_real_road_conflict = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS pvp1_realroad_conflict_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.pvptype = 2 AND name: adbi.dm_cockpit_game_competition_stats_df
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_cockpit_game_competition_stats_df)) SELECT data_date, MAPPING('week_1st_day', 'Mon', data_date) AS data_week /* , date_sub(data_date,pmod(datediff(data_date,'1900-01-07'),7)) as data_week */, SUBSTRING(data_date, 1, 7) AS data_month, SUBSTRING(data_date, 1, 4) AS data_year, area_code AS region, COALESCE(c.country, 'unknown') AS country, tournament_name, average_ccv, peak_viewers, hours_watched FROM (SELECT data_date, country_name, IF(TRIM(country_name) IN ('APAC', 'Africa', 'Americas', 'Asia', 'CIS', 'EMEA', 'East Asia', 'Europe', 'Latin America', 'MENA (Middle East)', 'SEA', 'South America', 'West Asia'), TRIM(country_name), NULL) AS area_code, tournament_name, SUM(average_ccv) AS average_ccv, SUM(peak_viewers) AS peak_viewers, SUM(hours_watched) AS hours_watched FROM (SELECT country AS country_name, tournament_name, average_ccv, peak_viewers, hours_watched, EXPLODE(date_seq) AS data_date FROM (SELECT country, tournament_name, average_ccv, peak_viewers, hours_watched, ARRAY_DATE(CAST(TO_DATE(start_date, 'dd.MM.yyyy') AS STRING), CAST(TO_DATE(end_date, 'dd.MM.yyyy') AS STRING), FALSE) AS date_seq FROM adbi.ods_esports_chart_di WHERE logymd IN (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM adbi.ods_esports_chart_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('${p_date}', -60) AND DATE_ADD('${p_date}', 1) HAVING COUNT(1) > 0) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('${p_date}', -60) AND DATE_ADD('${p_date}', 1) AND TO_DATE(end_date, 'dd.MM.yyyy') >= '${init_date}')) GROUP BY data_date, country_name, tournament_name) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(LOWER(code)) AS country, name_en AS country_en, name AS area_name FROM adbi.gms_ad_bi_countries WHERE p_date = '${pdate}') AS c ON a.country_name = c.country_en

t1.birthday_new) / 365, 0) AS age /* 生日折算年龄（不可直接用logymd，因logymd为写死的日期，凡小于写死日期的都一样） */, t1.occupation /* 职业 */, t1.gt1, t1.gt2 FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, gender, birthday, gt1, gt2, CASE WHEN birthday IN ('2015+', '1980-') THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(birthday, 1, 4), '-', '01', '-', '01') ELSE birthday END AS birthday_new, occupation FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.logymd, b.logymd) AS logymd, COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(a.gt1, 0) AS gt1 /* 是否是高准低覆（1-是，0-否） */, COALESCE(b.gt2, 0) AS gt2 /* 是否是中准中覆（1-是，0-否） */, COALESCE(a.gender, zoneid, 1 AS gt2, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer14, '$.2205230026') AS gender, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer71, '$.2205230026') AS birthday FROM mt_dm.dm_act_survey_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: teemoyu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-03-06 01:21:43.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH log_t /* 补充好友数据 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(last_online_friend) AS last_online_friend /* 末次登陆时当日在线好友数(roleid+zoneid粒度） */, MAX(social_friendnum) AS social_friendnum /* 当天玩家好友数量(以末次登陆为准) */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di /* 每天18点产生新数据 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), client_friend_login /* 好友登录数据 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT accountid, zoneid, onlinefriendsnum /* 在线好友数 */, friendsnum /* 好友数 */, lovernum /* 情侣数量 */, bronum /* 兄弟数量 */, gfnum /* 闺蜜数量 */, bestfriendnum /* 挚友数量 */, intimacy_num /* 总亲密关系数量 */ FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, onlinefriendsnum /* 在线好友数 */, friendsnum /* 好友数 */, lovernum /* 情侣数量 */, bronum /* 兄弟数量 */, gfnum /* 闺蜜数量 */, bestfriendnum /* 挚友数量 */, lovernum + bronum + bestfriendnum + gfnum AS intimacy_num /* 总亲密关系数量 */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, logymd ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_friend_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS aa WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.teemoyu_20240305_mc_social_01 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT DISTINCT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.onlinefriendsnum /* 在线好友数 */, a.friendsnum /* 好友数 */, a.lovernum /* 情侣数量 */, a.bronum /* 兄弟数量 */, a.gfnum /* 闺蜜数量 */, a.bestfriendnum /* 挚友数量 */, a.intimacy_num /* 总亲密关系数量 */, b.last_online_friend /* 末次登陆时当日在线好友数(roleid+zoneid粒度） */, b.social_friendnum /* 当天玩家好友数量(以末次登陆为准) */ FROM client_friend_login AS a LEFT JOIN log_t AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid

+ ping150 + ping200 + ping300 + ping500 + ping800) / ping_times) <= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype2_ping_times, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 4 AND ((ping120 + ping150 + ping200 + ping300 + ping500 + ping800) / ping_times) <= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype4_ping_times /* (ROUND(SUM(case when ((ping120+ping150+ping200+ping300+ping500+ping800)/ping_times) <=0.05 then 1 else 0 end)/COUNT(*),3)) new */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND timedelay > 0 AND timedelay <> 10000 AND timedelay < 50000 AND maxdelay < 50000 AND movelag < 10000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 4 AND blacknum > 0 AND wincamp = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype4_black_win_cnt /* 乱斗开黑胜利次数：乱斗模式下，开黑且玩家所在阵营胜利的场次 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 AND real_road BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN real_road ELSE NULL END) AS pvp2_road_cnt /* 排位分路使用数量：排位模式下使用的不同分路数量（去重计数） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 AND NOT heroid IS NULL THEN heroid ELSE NULL END) AS pvp2_hero_cnt /* 排位英雄使用数量：排位模式下使用的不同英雄数量（去重计数） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pvptype = 1 AND real_road BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN real_road ELSE NULL END) AS pvp1_road_cnt /* 匹配分路使用数量 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pvptype = 1 AND NOT heroid IS NULL THEN heroid ELSE NULL END) AS pvp1_hero_cnt /* 匹配英雄使用数量 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pvptype = 4 AND real_road BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN real_road ELSE NULL END) AS pvp4_road_cnt /* 乱斗分路使用数量 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pvptype = 4 AND NOT heroid IS NULL THEN heroid ELSE NULL END) AS pvp4_hero_cnt /* 乱斗英雄使用数量 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) /* 匹配、排位、乱斗模式的数据 */ GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), battle2 AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN a.zoneid > 57000 THEN 'test' ELSE 'official' END AS zoneid_type /* 大区类型（正式服/测试服） */, FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) AS zoneid_area_type, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 1 THEN battle_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype1_battle_cnt /* 匹配场次 */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN battle_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype2_battle_cnt /* 排位场次 */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 4 THEN battle_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype4_battle_cnt /* 大乱斗场次 */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 39 THEN battle_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype39_battle_cnt /* 魔法战棋场次 */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 1 THEN win_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype1_win_battle_cnt /* 匹配胜利次数 */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN win_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype2_win_battle_cnt /* 排位胜利次数 */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 4 THEN win_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype4_win_battle_cnt /* 大乱斗胜利次数 */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 39 THEN win_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype39_win_battle_cnt /* 魔法战棋胜利次数 */, SUM(black_cnt) AS black_cnt /* 开黑次数 */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN black_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype2_black_cnt /* 排位开黑次数 */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 1 THEN battle_duration ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype4_battle_duration /* 大乱斗模式战斗时长(分)      */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 39 THEN battle_duration ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype39_battle_duration /* 魔法战棋战斗时长(分) */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN kill_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype2_kill_cnt /* 排位模式kill_cnt */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN dead_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype2_dead_cnt /* 排位模式dead_cnt */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN assist_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype2_assist_cnt /* 排位模式assist_cnt */, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN gold_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS pvptype2_gold_cnt /* 排位模式gold_cnt */, MAX(CASE WHEN pvptype IN (1, 2,
