BETWEEN 41 AND 50 THEN '[41,50]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 51 AND 60 THEN '[51,60]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 61 AND 70 THEN '[61,70]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 71 AND 80 THEN '[71,80]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 81 AND 90 THEN '[81,90]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 91 AND 100 THEN '[91,100]' WHEN day_max_level >= 101 THEN '[101,)' ELSE '无信息' END AS day_max_level, CASE WHEN country IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE country END AS country, new_type, user_period, create_os, first_network_name, CASE WHEN active_days = 0 THEN '0' WHEN active_days BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '[1,2]' WHEN active_days BETWEEN 3 AND 8 THEN '[3,8]' WHEN active_days BETWEEN 9 AND 17 THEN '[9,17]' WHEN active_days BETWEEN 18 AND 25 THEN '[18,25]' WHEN active_days BETWEEN 26 AND 30 THEN '[26,30]' ELSE '无信息' END AS active_days /* 前30天活跃天数分层 */, SUM(charge_amt_total) AS amount /* [logymd,logymd + active_date_diff]，区间内总付费（美分） */, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid) AS usercnt /* 角色数 */ FROM (SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.day_max_level, d.country, c.new_type, a.is_active, a.charge_amt_total, a.user_period, a.active_date_diff, c.create_os, c.first_network_name, (COALESCE(e.his_activedays_before_1, 0) - COALESCE(f.his_activedays_before_31, 0)) AS active_days FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, is_active, charge_amt_total, logymd, CASE WHEN register_date_diff < 0 THEN '无信息' WHEN register_date_diff = 0 THEN '0' WHEN register_date_diff <= 6 THEN '[1,6]' WHEN register_date_diff <= 29 THEN '[7,29]' WHEN register_date_diff <= 89 THEN '[30,89]' WHEN register_date_diff <= 179 THEN '[90,179]' WHEN register_date_diff <= 359 THEN '[180,359]' WHEN register_date_diff <= 719 THEN '[360,719]' WHEN register_date_diff >= 720 THEN '[720,)' ELSE '无信息' END AS user_period, active_date_diff FROM mt_dm.dm_active_pay_role_zone_di WHERE active_date = '2026-05-30' AND logymd IN ('2026-05-30', '2026-05-29', '2026-05-28', '2026-05-24', '2026-05-17', '2026-05-01', '2026-03-02') AND active_date_diff IN (0, 1, 2, 6, 13, 29, 89)) AS a /* --------------活跃用户及其留存和付费数据 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, MAX(LEVEL) AS day_max_level FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE zoneid < 57000 AND is_ai = 0 AND logymd IN ('2026-05-30', '2026-05-29', '2026-05-28', '2026-05-24', '2026-05-17', '2026-05-01', '2026-03-02') AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS b /* -------------匹配角色当天最大等级 */ ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.logymd = b.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, create_os, first_network_name, CASE WHEN new_type = 1 THEN '小号回流新增' WHEN new_type = 2 THEN '模拟器新增' WHEN new_type = 3 THEN '纯净新增' WHEN new_type = 4 THEN '切换设备换绑' WHEN new_type = 5 THEN '小号新增' ELSE '无信息' END AS new_type FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' < '2023-01-01', '2023-01-01', '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country), create_os, first_network_name, CASE WHEN new_type = 1 THEN '小号回流新增' WHEN new_type = 2 THEN '模拟器新增' WHEN new_type = 3 THEN '纯净新增' WHEN new_type = 4 THEN '切换设备换绑' WHEN new_type = 5 THEN '小号新增' ELSE '无信息' END) AS c /* ---------------匹配角色国家、新增类型 */ ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT lower, country FROM mt_dim.dim_national_geographic_atlas_config) AS d ON c.first_mt_country = d.lower LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, his_activedays AS his_activedays_before_1 FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-29', '2026-05-28', '2026-05-27', '2026-05-23', '2026-05-16', '2026-04-30', '2026-03-01') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, his_activedays_before_1) AS e ON a.roleid = e.roleid AND a.zoneid = e.zoneid AND a.logymd = DATE_ADD(e.logymd, 1) /* -------------匹配业务日期前1天历史累计活跃天数 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, his_activedays AS his_activedays_before_31 FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd IN ('2026-04-29', '2026-04-28', '2026-04-27', '2026-04-23', '2026-04-16', '2026-03-31', '2026-01-30') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, his_activedays_before_31) AS f ON a.roleid = f.roleid AND a.zoneid = f.zoneid AND a.logymd = DATE_ADD(f.logymd, 31) /* -------------匹配业务日期前31天历史累计活跃天数 */ GROUP BY a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.day_max_level, d.country, c.new_type, a.is_active, a.charge_amt_total, a.user_period, a.active_date_diff, c.create_os, c.first_network_name, active_days) AS a GROUP BY logymd, active_date_diff, is_active, CASE WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN '[1,10]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '[11,20]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '[21,30]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN '[31,40]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 41 AND 50 THEN '[41,50]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 51 AND 60 THEN '[51,60]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 61 AND 70 THEN '[61,70]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 71 AND 80 THEN '[71,80]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 81 AND 90 THEN '[81,90]' WHEN day_max_level BETWEEN 91 AND 100 THEN '[91,100]' WHEN day_max_level >= 101 THEN '[101,)' ELSE '无信息' END, CASE WHEN country IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE country END, new_type, user_period, create_os, first_network_name, CASE WHEN active_days = 0 THEN '0' WHEN active_days BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '[1,2]' WHEN active_days BETWEEN 3 AND 8 THEN '[3,8]' WHEN active_days BETWEEN 9 AND 17 THEN '[9,17]' WHEN active_days BETWEEN 18 AND 25 THEN '[18,25]' WHEN active_days BETWEEN 26 AND 30 THEN '[26,30]' ELSE '无信息' END

name: ml_temp.all_battle_index_info_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.all_battle_index_info_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT a.pvptype, a.battlegroup, btcnt, satisfycnt, timedelay, overcnt, matchtime_withcancel, matchcnt, smatchcnt, matchtime_onlysuccess, battlecnt, bacnt, bigranklvl_list_like_cnt, bigranklvl_judge_same_cnt, minranklvl_list_like_cnt, minranklvl_judge_same_cnt, playercnt FROM (/* -网络指标 */ SELECT logymd, pvptype, FLOOR(battlesvrid / 1000) AS battlegroup, SUM(1) AS btcnt, SUM(CASE WHEN timedelay <= 60 AND stdping <= 1900 THEN 1 END) AS satisfycnt, SUM(timedelay) AS timedelay, SUM(IF(timedelay >= 110, 1, 0)) AS overcnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 AND logymd = '2026-05-30' AND timedelay > 0 AND timedelay <> 10000 AND timedelay < 50000 AND maxdelay < 50000 AND movelag < 10000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 GROUP BY logymd, pvptype, FLOOR(battlesvrid / 1000)) AS a JOIN (/* -匹配成功率和平均匹配时长（包含取消匹配） */ SELECT logymd, pvptype, groupnew, SUM(matchtime) AS matchtime_withcancel, SUM(1) AS matchcnt, SUM(success) AS smatchcnt FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(real_battle_group_detail, ',')) tb AS groupnew WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY logymd, pvptype, groupnew) AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.pvptype = b.pvptype AND a.battlegroup = b.groupnew JOIN (/* 平均匹配时长（不包含取消匹配） 有groupsel必定匹配成功 */ SELECT logymd, pvptype, groupsel, SUM(matchtime) AS matchtime_onlysuccess FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY logymd, pvptype, groupsel) AS c ON a.logymd = c.logymd AND a.pvptype = c.pvptype AND a.battlegroup = c.groupsel JOIN (/* -大小段位相似率和仲裁段位相等率 */ SELECT t1.logymd, pvptype, groupsel, SUM(bigranklvl_list_like) AS bigranklvl_list_like_cnt, SUM(bigranklvl_judge_same) AS bigranklvl_judge_same_cnt, SUM(minranklvl_list_like) AS minranklvl_list_like_cnt, SUM(minranklvl_judge_same) AS minranklvl_judge_same_cnt, COUNT(1) AS playercnt FROM (SELECT logymd, pvptype, groupsel, battleid, accountid, wincamp, IF(selfteam_bigranklvl_list[0] = otherteam_bigranklvl_list[0] AND selfteam_bigranklvl_list[1] = otherteam_bigranklvl_list[1] AND selfteam_bigranklvl_list[2] = otherteam_bigranklvl_list[2] AND selfteam_bigranklvl_list[3] = otherteam_bigranklvl_list[3] AND selfteam_bigranklvl_list[4] = otherteam_bigranklvl_list[4], 1, 0) AS bigranklvl_list_like, IF(selfteam_minranklvl_list[0] = otherteam_minranklvl_list[0] AND selfteam_minranklvl_list[1] = otherteam_minranklvl_list[1] AND selfteam_minranklvl_list[2] = otherteam_minranklvl_list[2] AND selfteam_minranklvl_list[3] = otherteam_minranklvl_list[3] AND selfteam_minranklvl_list[4] = otherteam_minranklvl_list[4], 1, 0) AS minranklvl_list_like, IF(selftroom_bigranklvl_max = MAX(selftroom_bigranklvl_max) OVER (PARTITION BY battleid) AND selftroom_bigranklvl_max = MIN(selftroom_bigranklvl_max) OVER (PARTITION BY battleid), 1, 0) AS bigranklvl_judge_same, IF(selfroom_minranklvl_max = MAX(selfroom_minranklvl_max) OVER (PARTITION BY battleid) AND selfroom_minranklvl_max = MIN(selfroom_minranklvl_max) OVER (PARTITION BY battleid), 1, 0) AS minranklvl_judge_same FROM (SELECT MAX(be.bigranklvl) OVER (PARTITION BY be.roomid, be.battleid) AS selftroom_bigranklvl_max, MAX(be.minranklvl) OVER (PARTITION BY be.roomid, be.battleid) AS selfroom_minranklvl_max, IF(wincamp = 1, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(IF(be.wincamp = 1, be.bigranklvl, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY be.battleid)), SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(IF(be.wincamp = 0, be.bigranklvl, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY be.battleid))) AS selfteam_bigranklvl_list, IF(wincamp = 1, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(IF(be.wincamp = 0, be.bigranklvl, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY be.battleid)), SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(IF(be.wincamp = 1, be.bigranklvl, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY be.battleid))) AS otherteam_bigranklvl_list, IF(wincamp = 1, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(IF(be.wincamp = 1, be.minranklvl, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY be.battleid)), SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(IF(be.wincamp = 0, be.minranklvl, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY be.battleid))) AS selfteam_minranklvl_list, IF(wincamp = 1, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(IF(be.wincamp = 0, be.minranklvl, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY be.battleid)), SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(IF(be.wincamp = 1, be.minranklvl, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY be.battleid))) AS otherteam_minranklvl_list, be.logymd, be.pvptype, FLOOR(be.battlesvrid / 1000) AS groupsel, be.accountid, be.roomid, be.battleid, be.wincamp, COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY be.wincamp, be.battleid) AS selfteamcnt, COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY be.battleid) - COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY be.wincamp, be.battleid) AS otherteamcnt FROM (SELECT accountid, battleid, wincamp, fake_ai, logymd, battlesvrid, minranklvl, pvptype, realpvptype, roomid, blacknum, rankstar, CASE WHEN bigranklvl < 7 THEN bigranklvl WHEN rankstar BETWEEN 112 AND 136 THEN 7 WHEN rankstar BETWEEN 137 AND 161 THEN 8 WHEN rankstar BETWEEN 162 AND 211 THEN 9 WHEN rankstar >= 212 THEN 10 ELSE -1 END AS bigranklvl FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 22, 59, 90, 96, 97)) AS be LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND realmatchtype IN (1, 2, 22, 59, 90, 96, 97)) AS me ON be.accountid = me.accountid AND be.battleid = me.battleid AND be.logymd BETWEEN me.logymd AND DATE_ADD(me.logymd, 1)) AS a1 WHERE a1.selfteamcnt = 5 AND a1.otherteamcnt = 5 AND a1.selfteamcnt = a1.otherteamcnt) AS t1 GROUP BY t1.logymd, pvptype, groupsel) AS e ON a.logymd = e.logymd AND a.pvptype = e.pvptype AND a.battlegroup = e.groupsel JOIN (/* 均衡局比例变化 */ SELECT a.logymd, pvptype, battlegroup, SUM(1) AS battlecnt, SUM(IF(b.game_type = 3 OR b.game_type IS NULL, 0, 1)) AS bacnt FROM (SELECT logymd, pvptype, battleid, FLOOR(battlesvrid / 1000) AS battlegroup FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 GROUP BY logymd, pvptype, battleid, FLOOR(battlesvrid / 1000)) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT p_date AS logymd, battle_id, game_type FROM ml_temp.dwm_mlbb_battle_game_type_di_yz WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.battleid = b.battle_id AND a.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(b.logymd, 1 * -1) AND b.logymd GROUP BY a.logymd, pvptype, battlegroup) AS d ON a.logymd = d.logymd AND a.pvptype = d.pvptype AND a.battlegroup = d.battlegroup

name: 付费破冰中间表0614_180
sql_units: /* 破冰档位（0.01/1/2/5/10/20/30/50/100/200/500） */ /* insert overwrite table ml_temp.leavliu_pay_break_result */ /* partition(logymd='2026-05-31')   */ /* 当日付费	比历史档位高	破冰 */ /* 当日付费	和历史档位一样	唤醒 */ /* 当日付费	比历史档位低	唤醒对照 */ /* 当日不付费	历史付费	唤醒对照 */ /* 当日不付费	历史不付费	破冰对照 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: leavyliu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-06-14 22:52:16.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: leavyliu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-05-20 14:31:28.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH pay_day_his AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, (CASE WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 0.01 AND before_pay_day_max < 1 THEN 0.01 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 1 AND before_pay_day_max < 2 THEN 1 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 2 AND before_pay_day_max < 5 THEN 2 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 5 AND before_pay_day_max < 10 THEN 5 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 10 AND before_pay_day_max < 20 THEN 10 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 20 AND before_pay_day_max < 30 THEN 20 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 30 AND before_pay_day_max < 50 THEN 30 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 50 AND before_pay_day_max < 100 THEN 50 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 100 AND before_pay_day_max < 200 THEN 100 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 200 AND before_pay_day_max < 500 THEN 200 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 500 THEN 500 ELSE -1 END) AS pay_level FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(money) / 100 AS before_pay_day_max FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd < '2026-05-31' /* 消费统计周期的前1日 */ AND zoneid <= 57000 AND /* AND     is_iap_token_buy = 0 --排除虚拟代币数据，没收入 */ IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND is_sandbox = 0 /* 排除沙盒测试数据，没收入 */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据，因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd)), pay_day_today AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(money) / 100 AS money_sum FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 消费统计周期的前1日 */ AND zoneid <= 57000 AND /* AND     is_iap_token_buy = 0 --排除虚拟代币数据，没收入 */ IF('2026-05-31' < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND is_sandbox = 0 /* 排除沙盒测试数据，没收入 */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据，因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.leavliu_pay_break_result_0614_180 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT active.roleid, active.zoneid, (CASE WHEN before_break_level > 0 AND a.roleid IS NULL THEN before_break_level ELSE break_level END) AS break_level, (CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) > 30 AND a.roleid IS NULL AND b.roleid IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN NOT a.roleid IS NULL AND break_level > COALESCE(before_break_level, 0.0) THEN 1 WHEN NOT a.roleid IS NULL AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', max_date) > 180 AND break_level = before_break_level THEN 2 WHEN before_break_level > 0 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', max_date) > 180 AND COALESCE(break_level, 0.0) < before_break_level THEN 3 ELSE -1 END) AS pobing_or_double FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE zoneid <= 57000 AND appid = 'mlbb' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS active LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2024-06-12' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, register_date) AS reg ON active.roleid = reg.roleid AND active.zoneid = reg.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, (CASE WHEN money_sum >= 0.01 AND money_sum < 1 THEN 0.01 WHEN money_sum >= 1 AND money_sum < 2 THEN 1 WHEN money_sum >= 2 AND money_sum < 5 THEN 2 WHEN money_sum >= 5 AND money_sum < 10 THEN 5 WHEN money_sum >= 10 AND money_sum < 20 THEN 10 WHEN money_sum >= 20 AND money_sum < 30 THEN 20 WHEN money_sum >= 30 AND money_sum < 50 THEN 30 WHEN money_sum >= 50 AND money_sum < 100 THEN 50 WHEN money_sum >= 100 AND money_sum < 200 THEN 100 WHEN money_sum >= 200 AND money_sum < 500 THEN 200 WHEN money_sum >= 500 THEN 500 ELSE -1 END) AS break_level FROM pay_day_today WHERE money_sum > 0) AS a ON active.roleid = a.roleid AND active.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS max_date, pay_level AS before_break_level FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, pay_level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY pay_level DESC, logymd DESC) AS RANK FROM pay_day_his) WHERE RANK = 1) AS b ON active.roleid = b.roleid AND active.zoneid = b.zoneid /* --建表 */ /*    CREATE TABLE ml_temp.leavliu_pay_break_result_0614_180 */ /*     ( */ /*     roleid string comment 'roleid', */ /*     zoneid string comment 'zoneid', */ /*     break_level string comment '档位', */ /*     pobing_or_double string comment '标签' */ /* ) partitioned by (logymd string) stored as parquet location 's3a://moonton-hadoop/user/leavyliu/leavliu_pay_break_result_0614_180' */

******************************************************************** */ /* Author: leavyliu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-05-20 14:31:28.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH pay_day_his AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, (CASE WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 0.01 AND before_pay_day_max < 1 THEN 0.01 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 1 AND before_pay_day_max < 2 THEN 1 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 2 AND before_pay_day_max < 5 THEN 2 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 5 AND before_pay_day_max < 10 THEN 5 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 10 AND before_pay_day_max < 20 THEN 10 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 20 AND before_pay_day_max < 30 THEN 20 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 30 AND before_pay_day_max < 50 THEN 30 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 50 AND before_pay_day_max < 100 THEN 50 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 100 AND before_pay_day_max < 200 THEN 100 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 200 AND before_pay_day_max < 500 THEN 200 WHEN before_pay_day_max >= 500 THEN 500 ELSE -1 END) AS pay_level FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(money) / 100 AS before_pay_day_max FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd < '2026-05-31' /* 消费统计周期的前1日 */ AND zoneid <= 57000 AND /* AND     is_iap_token_buy = 0 --排除虚拟代币数据，没收入 */ IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND is_sandbox = 0 /* 排除沙盒测试数据，没收入 */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据，因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd)), pay_day_today AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(money) / 100 AS money_sum FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 消费统计周期的前1日 */ AND zoneid <= 57000 AND /* AND     is_iap_token_buy = 0 --排除虚拟代币数据，没收入 */ IF('2026-05-31' < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND is_sandbox = 0 /* 排除沙盒测试数据，没收入 */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据，因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.leavliu_pay_break_result_0614_90 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT active.roleid, active.zoneid, (CASE WHEN before_break_level > 0 AND a.roleid IS NULL THEN before_break_level ELSE break_level END) AS break_level, (CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) > 30 AND a.roleid IS NULL AND b.roleid IS NULL THEN 0 /* 破冰对照 */ WHEN NOT a.roleid IS NULL AND break_level > COALESCE(before_break_level, 0.0) THEN 1 /* 破冰 */ WHEN NOT a.roleid IS NULL AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', max_date) > 90 AND break_level = before_break_level THEN 2 /* 90天唤醒 */ WHEN before_break_level > 0 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', max_date) > 90 AND COALESCE(break_level, 0.0) < before_break_level THEN 3 /* 90天唤醒对照 */ ELSE -1 END) AS pobing_or_double FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE zoneid <= 57000 AND appid = 'mlbb' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS active LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, register_date) AS reg ON active.roleid = reg.roleid AND active.zoneid = reg.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, (CASE WHEN money_sum >= 0.01 AND money_sum < 1 THEN 0.01 WHEN money_sum >= 1 AND money_sum < 2 THEN 1 WHEN money_sum >= 2 AND money_sum < 5 THEN 2 WHEN money_sum >= 5 AND money_sum < 10 THEN 5 WHEN money_sum >= 10 AND money_sum < 20 THEN 10 WHEN money_sum >= 20 AND money_sum < 30 THEN 20 WHEN money_sum >= 30 AND money_sum < 50 THEN 30 WHEN money_sum >= 50 AND money_sum < 100 THEN 50 WHEN money_sum >= 100 AND money_sum < 200 THEN 100 WHEN money_sum >= 200 AND money_sum < 500 THEN 200 WHEN money_sum >= 500 THEN 500 ELSE -1 END) AS break_level FROM pay_day_today WHERE money_sum > 0) AS a ON active.roleid = a.roleid AND active.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS max_date, pay_level AS before_break_level FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, pay_level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY pay_level DESC, logymd DESC) AS RANK FROM pay_day_his) WHERE RANK = 1) AS b ON active.roleid = b.roleid AND active.zoneid = b.zoneid /* --建表 */ /*    CREATE TABLE ml_temp.leavliu_pay_xxxxxxx */ /*     ( */ /*     roleid string comment 'roleid', */ /*     zoneid string comment 'zoneid', */ /*     break_level string comment '档位', */ /*     pobing_or_double string comment '标签' */ /* ) partitioned by (logymd string) stored as parquet location 's3a://moonton-hadoop/user/leavyliu/leavliu_pay_xxxxxxx' */

name: adbi.app_pay_stats_df
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: dylandu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-06-17 15:28:21.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE TABLE `adbi`.`app_device_pay_stats_df` ( */ /*   `pay_date` STRING, */ /*   `device_create_date` STRING, */ /*   `os` STRING, */ /*   `country` STRING, */ /*   `media_source` STRING, */ /*   `ad_account_id` STRING, */ /*   `ad_account_name` STRING, */ /*   `campaign_id` STRING, */ /*   `campaign_name` STRING, */ /*   `adset_id` STRING, */ /*   `adset_name` STRING, */ /*   `ad_id` STRING, */ /*   `ad_name` STRING, */ /*   `device_cnt` BIGINT, */ /*   `pay_total` BIGINT */ /* ) */ /* PARTITIONED BY (p_date STRING, app_id STRING) */ /* Stored as parquet */ /* LOCATION 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/advertisement_bi/adbi/app_device_pay_stats_df'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `adbi`.`app_device_pay_stats_df` PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT a.pay_date, a.device_create_date, a.os, a.country, a.media_source, COALESCE(e.ad_account_id, 'unknown') AS ad_account_id, COALESCE(h.ad_account_name, 'unknown') AS ad_account_name, a.campaign_id, COALESCE(d.campaign_name, 'unknown') AS campaign_name, a.adset_id, COALESCE(f.adset_name, 'unknown') AS adset_name, a.ad_id, COALESCE(g.ad_name, 'unknown') AS ad_name, a.device_cnt, a.pay_total, a.app_id FROM (SELECT p_date AS pay_date /* 支付日期 */, device_create_date /* 设备创建日期 */, os /* 操作系统 */, country, media_source, campaign_id, adset_id, ad_id, app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS device_cnt, SUM(day_pay_amt) AS pay_total FROM adbi.dwm_sdk_pay_with_deviceAttribute_di WHERE p_date <= '2026-05-31' AND p_date > '2026-03-02' GROUP BY p_date /* 支付日期 */, device_create_date /* 设备创建日期 */, os /* 操作系统 */, country, media_source, campaign_id, adset_id, ad_id, app_id) AS a LEFT JOIN adbi.dim_campaign_name_df AS d ON d.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND d.app_id = '3001' AND a.media_source = d.media_source AND a.campaign_id = d.campaign_id LEFT JOIN adbi.dim_ad_account_id_df AS e ON e.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND e.app_id = '3001' AND a.media_source = e.media_source AND a.campaign_id = e.campaign_id LEFT JOIN adbi.dim_ad_set_name_df AS f ON f.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND f.app_id = '3001' AND a.media_source = f.media_source AND a.adset_id = f.adset_id LEFT JOIN adbi.dim_ad_name_df AS g ON g.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND g.app_id = '3001' AND a.media_source = g.media_source AND a.ad_id = g.ad_id LEFT JOIN adbi.gms_ad_bi_ad_account AS h ON h.date = '20260531' AND h.app_id = '3001' AND h.is_deleted = 0 AND e.ad_account_id = h.ad_account_id

name: adbi.dm_monitor_crowdpack_summary
sql_units: WITH crowdpack_base AS (/* 去重，得到每个 crowdpack 的 account 列表 */ SELECT roleid AS account_id, crowdpack_id, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_crowdpack_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND NOT crowdpack_id IN (1372, 1370, 1373) GROUP BY roleid, crowdpack_id, logymd), crowdpack_total AS (/* 单独算 total_account_cnt，小表 */ SELECT crowdpack_id, logymd, COUNT(1) AS total_account_cnt FROM crowdpack_base GROUP BY crowdpack_id, logymd), account_data AS (SELECT accountid, p_date, os_type, COUNT(DISTINCT gps_adid) AS gps_adid_cnt FROM adbi.dim_account_gps_adid WHERE p_date IN ('2026-05-30_unnormal', '2026-05-30') AND app_id = '1001' GROUP BY accountid, p_date, os_type), joined_detail /* 核心改动：先 JOIN 得到明细，再聚合 */ /* 避免大量数据 shuffle 到同一 partition */ AS (SELECT a.crowdpack_id, a.logymd, b.p_date, b.os_type, COALESCE(b.gps_adid_cnt, 0) AS gps_adid_cnt /* 每行就是一个 account_id，b 已预聚合 */, CASE WHEN NOT b.p_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_matched FROM crowdpack_base AS a LEFT JOIN account_data AS b ON a.account_id = b.accountid), joined_agg /* 分两步聚合，先按更细粒度聚合减少数据量 */ AS (SELECT crowdpack_id, logymd, p_date, os_type, SUM(gps_adid_cnt) AS gps_adid_cnt, SUM(is_matched) AS accountid_cnt, COUNT(1) AS a_account_cnt FROM joined_detail GROUP BY crowdpack_id, logymd, p_date, os_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dm_monitor_crowdpack_summary PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-30') SELECT crowdpack_id, logymd AS version, ios_account_cnt, total_account_cnt, matched_normal_gaid_cnt, ROUND(unmatched_account_cnt / total_account_cnt * 100, 4) AS unmatched_account_ratio, ROUND(ios_account_cnt / total_account_cnt * 100, 4) AS ios_account_ratio, ROUND(abnormal_account_cnt / total_account_cnt * 100, 4) AS abnormal_account_ratio, ROUND(other_os_account_cnt / total_account_cnt * 100, 4) AS other_os_account_ratio, ROUND(matched_normal_gaid_cnt / total_account_cnt * 100, 4) AS matched_normal_ratio, ROUND(matched_normal_gaid_cnt / NULLIF(total_account_cnt - ios_account_cnt, 0) * 100, 4) AS no_ios_matched_normal_ratio, ROUND((matched_normal_account_cnt - matched_normal_gaid_cnt) / NULLIF(matched_normal_account_cnt, 0) * 100, 4) AS gaid_to_account_ratio FROM (SELECT a.crowdpack_id, a.logymd, t.total_account_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.p_date IS NULL THEN a.a_account_cnt END) AS unmatched_account_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.p_date = '2026-05-30_unnormal' AND a.os_type = 1 THEN a.accountid_cnt END) AS ios_account_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.p_date = '2026-05-30_unnormal' AND a.os_type = 2 THEN a.accountid_cnt END) AS abnormal_account_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.p_date = '2026-05-30_unnormal' AND NOT a.os_type IN (1, 2) THEN a.accountid_cnt END) AS other_os_account_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.p_date = '2026-05-30' THEN a.accountid_cnt END) AS matched_normal_account_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN a.p_date = '2026-05-30' THEN a.gps_adid_cnt END) AS matched_normal_gaid_cnt FROM joined_agg AS a LEFT JOIN crowdpack_total AS t ON a.crowdpack_id = t.crowdpack_id AND a.logymd = t.logymd GROUP BY a.crowdpack_id, a.logymd, t.total_account_cnt)

name: adbi.dwm_cockpit_game_pgc_detail_df_twitter
sql_units: WITH media_config AS (SELECT *, EXPLODE(ARRAY_DATE('${init_date}', '${p_date}', FALSE)) AS data_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_kol_page_id)) WHERE p_date = '${p_date}' AND platform = 'twitter'), detail_di AS (SELECT data_date, region, country, platform, page_id, page_name, app_id, page_type, COALESCE(followers_count, 0) AS followers_count /* , if(a.app_id is null or b.app_id is null, 0, a.followers_count - b.followers_count) as new_followers_count */ FROM (SELECT b.data_date, a.id AS page_id, b.page_name, b.platform, b.region, b.country, b.app_id, b.page_type, COALESCE(a.followers_count, 0) AS followers_count FROM (SELECT DATE_ADD(logymd, -1) AS data_date, account_id AS id, account_name AS name, MAX(followers_count) AS followers_count FROM adbi.ods_kol_twitter_account_info WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('${init_date}', 1) AND DATE_ADD('${p_date}', 1) GROUP BY account_id, account_name, logymd) AS a RIGHT JOIN media_config AS b ON a.name = b.id AND a.data_date = b.data_date) AS a), detail_df AS (SELECT data_date, region, country, platform, page_id, page_name, app_id, page_type, followers_count, LAG(data_date, 1, NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, platform, IF(platform = 'twitter', page_name, page_id) ORDER BY data_date) AS last_data_date, LAG(followers_count, 1, NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, platform, IF(platform = 'twitter', page_name, page_id) ORDER BY data_date) AS last_followers_count FROM detail_di) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_cockpit_game_pgc_detail_df)) SELECT a.data_date, MAPPING('week_1st_day', 'Mon', a.data_date) AS data_week /* , date_sub(a.data_date,pmod(datediff(a.data_date,'1900-01-08'),7)) as data_week */, SUBSTRING(a.data_date, 1, 7) AS data_month, SUBSTRING(a.data_date, 1, 4) AS data_year, a.region, a.country, a.page_id, a.page_name, a.app_id, a.followers_count, a.followers_count_change, 0 AS impression, 0 AS reaction, page_type FROM (SELECT data_date, region, country, platform, page_id, page_name, app_id, page_type, followers_count, last_data_date, IF(DATEDIFF(data_date, last_data_date) <> 1 OR last_data_date IS NULL, 0, followers_count - last_followers_count) AS followers_count_change FROM detail_df) AS a

detail_di), post_detail_df AS (SELECT page_id, platform, post_id, data_date, IF(last_data_date IS NULL, impression, IF(impression = 0, 0, impression - COALESCE(last_impression, 0))) AS impression, STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_app_kol_post_stats_filter_df)) WHERE p_date = '${p_date}' AND platform = 'instagram'))))), post_df AS (SELECT data_date, page_id, platform, SUM(impression) AS impression, sql_units: WITH base AS (SELECT roleid, usercreateymd, adjust_country, is_organic, new_user_mau, active_days_mau, p_date, CASE WHEN adjust_country IN ('ID') THEN '印尼' WHEN adjust_country IN ('MY') THEN '马来' WHEN adjust_country IN ('PH') THEN '菲律宾' WHEN adjust_country IN ('CL', 'PE', 'BO', 'AR', 'MX') THEN '拉美五国' WHEN adjust_country IN ('BR') THEN '巴西' WHEN adjust_country IN ('SA', 'AE', 'KW', 'QA') THEN '中东海湾四国' WHEN adjust_country IN ('EG') THEN '埃及' WHEN adjust_country IN ('RU') THEN '俄罗斯' WHEN adjust_country IN ('UA', 'KZ', 'BY', 'MN', 'UZ', 'KG', 'TJ') THEN '俄语区' WHEN adjust_country IN ('TR') THEN '土耳其' WHEN adjust_country IN ('US') THEN '美国' WHEN adjust_country IN ('AU', 'CA', 'IE') THEN '欧洲 T1' WHEN adjust_country IN ('AT', 'BE', 'CA', 'CH', 'CY', 'DE', 'DK', 'EE', 'FI', 'FR', 'GB', 'GR', 'IT', 'LU', 'LV', 'MT', 'NL', 'PL', 'SE', 'SK') THEN '欧洲 T2' END AS adjust_country1 FROM adbi.dwm_mau_role_zone_retention_mi WHERE p_date <= CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), '-01')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwm_mau_mi PARTITION(p_date) SELECT register_month, adjust_country1 AS country, active_user_num, new_user_active_num, monthly_avg_dau, month_day, organic_new_user_active_num, non_organic_new_user_active_num, total_register_num, p_date FROM (SELECT a.*, total_register_num FROM (SELECT p_date, SUBSTRING(usercreateymd, 1, 7) AS register_month, adjust_country1, COUNT(1) AS active_user_num, SUM(new_user_mau) AS new_user_active_num, SUM(active_days_mau) / DAY(TO_DATE(DATE_ADD(TRUNC(DATE_ADD(p_date, 32), 'MM'), 1 * -1))) AS monthly_avg_dau, DAY(TO_DATE(DATE_ADD(TRUNC(DATE_ADD(p_date, 32), 'MM'), 1 * -1))) AS month_day, SUM(is_organic * new_user_mau) AS organic_new_user_active_num, SUM(new_user_mau) - SUM(is_organic * new_user_mau) AS non_organic_new_user_active_num FROM base WHERE NOT adjust_country1 IS NULL GROUP BY SUBSTRING(usercreateymd, 1, 7), adjust_country1, p_date) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUBSTRING(usercreateymd, 1, 7) AS register_month, adjust_country1, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS total_register_num FROM base WHERE NOT adjust_country1 IS NULL GROUP BY SUBSTRING(usercreateymd, 1, 7), adjust_country1) AS b ON a.register_month = b.register_month AND a.adjust_country1 = b.adjust_country1 UNION ALL SELECT a.*, total_register_num FROM (SELECT p_date, SUBSTRING(usercreateymd, 1, 7) AS register_month, 'ALL' AS adjust_country1, COUNT(1) AS active_user_num, SUM(new_user_mau) AS new_user_active_num, SUM(active_days_mau) / DAY(TO_DATE(DATE_ADD(TRUNC(DATE_ADD(p_date, 32), 'MM'), 1 * -1))) AS monthly_avg_dau, DAY(TO_DATE(DATE_ADD(TRUNC(DATE_ADD(p_date, 32), 'MM'), 1 * -1))) AS month_day, SUM(is_organic * new_user_mau) AS organic_new_user_active_num, SUM(new_user_mau) - SUM(is_organic * new_user_mau) AS non_organic_new_user_active_num FROM base GROUP BY SUBSTRING(usercreateymd, 1, 7), p_date) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUBSTRING(usercreateymd, 1, 7) AS register_month, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS total_register_num FROM base GROUP BY SUBSTRING(usercreateymd, 1, 7)) AS b ON a.register_month = b.register_month) AS a DISTRIBUTE BY p_date SORT BY p_date

name: tmp_hero_battle_performance
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.temp_hero_battle_performance PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT t4.heroid, t5.hero_name, t5.heroes, t4.pvptype, t4.zone_type, t4.country, t4.is_invalidbattle, t4.role_ranklvl, t4.real_pvptype, t4.game_ranklvl, t4.is_repeat_hero, t4.role_battle_cnt /* 角色对局总场次 */, t4.kill_role_battle_cnt /* 击杀的角色对局总场次 */, t4.dead_role_battle_cnt /* 死亡的角色对局总场次 */, t4.assist_role_battle_cnt /* 助攻的角色对局总场次 */, t4.herohurt_role_battle_cnt /* 免伤后伤害的角色对局总场次 */, t4.behourt_role_battle_cnt /* 免伤前承伤的角色对局总场次 */, t4.curehero_role_battle_cnt /* 治疗所有英雄的角色对局总场次 */, t4.cureotherhero_role_battle_cnt /* 治疗其他英雄的角色对局总场次 */, t4.`6mingold_role_battle_cnt` /* 6分钟内获得金钱数的角色对局总场次 */, t4.`12mingold_role_battle_cnt` /* 12分钟内获得金钱数的角色对局总场次 */, t4.`level6min_role_battle_cnt` /* 6分钟时等级的角色对局总场次 */, t4.`level12min_role_battle_cnt` /* 12分钟时等级的角色对局总场次 */, t4.suffercontrolrate_role_battle_cnt /* 被硬控的角色对局总场次 */, t4.controlrate_role_battle_cnt /* 控制（硬控）的角色对局总场次 */, t4.killnum /* 击杀英雄次数 */, t4.deadnum /* 死亡次数 */, t4.assistnum /* 助攻次数 */, t4.herohurt /* 对英雄伤害值（免伤后） */, t4.behourt /* 承伤值（免伤前） */, t4.curehero /* 治疗值（对所有英雄包括自己） */, t4.cure_otherhero /* 治疗值（对其他英雄） */, t4.`6mingold` /* 6分钟内获取的总金钱数 */, t4.`12mingold` /* 12分钟内获取的总金钱数 */, t4.`level6min` /* 6分钟时英雄等级 */, t4.`level12min` /* 12分钟时英雄等级 */, t4.suffercontrol_duration /* 被硬控总时长（秒） */, t4.control_duration /* 控制（硬控）时长（秒） */ FROM (SELECT t1.logymd, t1.heroid, t1.pvptype, t1.zone_type, t1.country, t1.is_invalidbattle, t1.role_ranklvl, t1.real_pvptype, t2.game_ranklvl, t2.is_repeat_hero, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) AS role_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.killnum >= 0 THEN CONCAT(t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) END) AS kill_role_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.deadnum >= 0 THEN CONCAT(t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) END) AS dead_role_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.assistnum >= 0 THEN CONCAT(t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) END) AS assist_role_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.herohurt >= 0 THEN CONCAT(t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) END) AS herohurt_role_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.behourt >= 0 THEN CONCAT(t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) END) AS behourt_role_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t3.curehero >= 0 THEN CONCAT(t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) END) AS curehero_role_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t3.cure_otherhero >= 0 THEN CONCAT(t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) END) AS cureotherhero_role_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t3.`6mingold` >= 0 THEN CONCAT(t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) END) AS `6mingold_role_battle_cnt`, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t3.`12mingold` >= 0 THEN CONCAT(t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) END) AS `12mingold_role_battle_cnt`, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t3.`level6min` >= 0 THEN CONCAT(t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) END) AS `level6min_role_battle_cnt`, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t3.`level12min` >= 0 THEN CONCAT(t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) END) AS `level12min_role_battle_cnt`, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t3.suffercontrolrate >= 0 THEN CONCAT(t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) END) AS suffercontrolrate_role_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t4.controlrate >= 0 THEN CONCAT(t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid) END) AS controlrate_role_battle_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.killnum >= 0 THEN t1.killnum END) AS killnum, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.deadnum >= 0 THEN t1.deadnum END) AS deadnum, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.assistnum >= 0 THEN t1.assistnum END) AS assistnum, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.herohurt >= 0 THEN t1.herohurt END) AS herohurt, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.behourt >= 0 THEN t1.behourt END) AS behourt, SUM(CASE WHEN t3.curehero >= 0 THEN t3.curehero END) AS curehero, SUM(CASE WHEN t3.cure_otherhero >= 0 THEN t3.cure_otherhero END) AS cure_otherhero, SUM(CASE WHEN t3.`6mingold` >= 0 THEN t3.`6mingold` END) AS `6mingold`, SUM(CASE WHEN t3.`12mingold` >= 0 THEN t3.`12mingold` END) AS `12mingold`, SUM(CASE WHEN t3.`level6min` >= 0 THEN t3.`level6min` END) AS `level6min`, SUM(CASE WHEN t3.`level12min` >= 0 THEN t3.`level12min` END) AS `level12min`, SUM(CASE WHEN t3.suffercontrolrate >= 0 THEN t3.suffercontrolrate END) / 1000 AS suffercontrol_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN t4.controlrate >= 0 THEN t4.controlrate END) / 1000 AS control_duration FROM (SELECT a.logymd, a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.heroid, a.pvptype /* 战斗类型 */, a.killnum /* 击杀英雄数 */, a.deadnum /* 死亡次数 */, a.assistnum /* 助攻次数 */, a.herohurt /* 对英雄伤害值（免伤后） */, a.behourt /* 承伤值（免伤前） */, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测服' END AS zone_type, c.country /* 首次创号国 */, CASE WHEN a.isinvalidbattle = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_invalidbattle /* 是否流局 */, CASE WHEN a.minranklvl BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '勇士' WHEN a.minranklvl BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '精英' WHEN a.minranklvl BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN '大师' WHEN a.minranklvl BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '宗师' WHEN a.minranklvl BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN '史诗' WHEN a.minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN a.minranklvl = 26 THEN '神话V' WHEN a.minranklvl = 27 THEN '神话IV' WHEN a.minranklvl = 28 THEN '神话III' WHEN a.minranklvl = 29 THEN '神话II' WHEN a.minranklvl = 30 THEN '神话I' WHEN a.minranklvl = 31 THEN '荣耀神话' ELSE '无信息' END AS role_ranklvl /* 角色段位 */, CASE WHEN a.realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90) THEN '真人对局' WHEN a.realpvptype IN (30, 31, 37, 38, 51, 57, 58, 85, 86, 87, 92, 101, 103) THEN '温暖关' ELSE '其他' END AS real_pvptype /* 真实匹配类型 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, pvptype, CASE WHEN killnum > 50 THEN -9999 ELSE killnum END AS killnum, CASE WHEN deadnum > 50 THEN -9999 ELSE deadnum END AS deadnum, CASE WHEN assistnum > 50 THEN -9999 ELSE assistnum END AS assistnum, CASE WHEN herohurt > 200000 THEN -9999 ELSE herohurt END AS herohurt, CASE WHEN behourt > 300000 THEN -9999 ELSE behourt END AS behourt, isinvalidbattle, minranklvl, realpvptype FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) /* 排位&匹配 */ GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, pvptype, CASE WHEN killnum > 50 THEN -9999 ELSE killnum END, CASE WHEN deadnum > 50 THEN -9999 ELSE deadnum END, CASE WHEN assistnum > 50 THEN -9999 ELSE assistnum END, CASE WHEN herohurt > 200000 THEN -9999 ELSE herohurt END, CASE WHEN behourt > 300000 THEN -9999 ELSE behourt END, isinvalidbattle, minranklvl, realpvptype) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' < '2023-04-26', '2023-04-26', '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country)) AS b /* 角色基础信息 */ ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT lower, country FROM mt_dim.dim_national_geographic_atlas_config) AS c /* 国家信息 */ ON b.first_mt_country = c.lower LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' < '2023-07-10', '2023-07-10', '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS d /* 真实玩家 */ ON a.accountid = d.roleid AND a.zoneid = d.zoneid WHERE NOT d.roleid IS NULL GROUP BY a.logymd, a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.heroid, a.pvptype, a.killnum, a.deadnum, a.assistnum, a.herohurt, a.behourt, zone_type, c.country, is_invalidbattle, role_ranklvl, real_pvptype) AS t1 /* 服务器战斗表 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT battleid, CASE WHEN hero_num = 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_repeat_hero, CASE WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '勇士' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '精英' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN '大师' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '宗师' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN '史诗' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN max_minranklvl = 26 THEN '神话V' WHEN max_minranklvl = 27 THEN '神话IV' WHEN max_minranklvl = 28 THEN '神话III' WHEN max_minranklvl = 29 THEN '神话II' WHEN max_minranklvl = 30 THEN '神话I' WHEN max_minranklvl = 31 THEN '荣耀神话' ELSE '无信息' END AS game_ranklvl /* 对局段位 */ FROM (SELECT battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT heroid) AS hero_num, MAX(minranklvl) AS max_minranklvl /* 对局段位 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) /* 排位&匹配 */ GROUP BY battleid) AS t GROUP BY battleid, is_repeat_hero, game_ranklvl) AS t2 /* 每场战斗是否有重复英雄&对局段位 */ ON t1.battleid = t2.battleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, CASE WHEN curehero > 150000 THEN -9999 ELSE curehero END AS curehero, CASE WHEN (curehero - cureself) > 150000 THEN -9999 ELSE (curehero - cureself) END AS cure_otherhero, CASE WHEN `6mingold` > 20000 THEN -9999 ELSE `6mingold` END AS `6mingold`, CASE WHEN `12mingold` > 20000 THEN -9999 ELSE `12mingold` END AS `12mingold`, `level6min`, `level12min`, suffercontrolrate /* 受到的硬控总时长（毫秒） */ FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, battleid, accountid, zoneid, heroid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND battletype IN (1, 2)) AS t4 WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, CASE WHEN curehero > 150000 THEN -9999 ELSE curehero END, CASE WHEN (curehero - cureself) > 150000 THEN -9999 ELSE (curehero - cureself) END, CASE WHEN `6mingold` > 20000 THEN -9999 ELSE `6mingold` END, CASE WHEN `12mingold` > 20000 THEN -9999 ELSE `12mingold` END, `level6min`, `level12min`, suffercontrolrate /* 受到的硬控总时长（毫秒） */) AS t3 /* 客户端战斗表（补充服务器战斗表中没有的字段） */ ON t1.battleid = t3.battleid AND t1.accountid = t3.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND t1.heroid = t3.heroid LEFT JOIN (SELECT battleid, accountid, zoneid, heroid, controlrate /* 控制（硬控）时长，毫秒 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_battle_analysis WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND para1 IN (1, 2) GROUP BY battleid, accountid, zoneid, heroid, controlrate) AS t4 ON t1.battleid = t4.battleid AND t1.accountid = t4.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t4.zoneid AND t1.heroid = t4.heroid GROUP BY t1.logymd, t1.heroid, t1.pvptype, t1.zone_type, t1.country, t1.is_invalidbattle, t1.role_ranklvl, t1.real_pvptype, t2.game_ranklvl, t2.is_repeat_hero) AS t4 LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, hero_name /* 英雄中文名称 */, CASE WHEN sub_heroes = -9999 THEN heroes ELSE CONCAT(heroes, '\\073', sub_heroes) END AS heroes /* 英雄职业（主定位+次定位） */ FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' < '2023-04-26', '2023-04-26', '2026-05-30')) AS t5 /* 英雄配置表 */ ON t4.heroid = t5.heroid

name: etl.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mlbb_device_daily
sql_units: WITH date_list AS (/* 计算需要回刷的日期 */ SELECT p_date, DATE_ADD(p_date, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p_date ORDER BY p_date) - 1) * -1) AS logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p_date ORDER BY p_date) /* diffdays = datediff('2026-05-31', logymd) */ - 1 AS diffdays FROM (SELECT p_date FROM (SELECT REPEAT(CONCAT('2026-05-31', ','), 30) AS rep_date) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(rep_date, ',')) tbl AS p_date) WHERE p_date <> ''), dm_sdk_device_df AS (SELECT LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', TRIM(country))) AS country /* 首次创号国 */, LOWER(TRIM(os)) AS os, LOWER(TRIM(network_name)) AS network, create_date, IF(product_money_info[diffdays] - COALESCE(product_money_info[diffdays + 1], 0) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_pay, IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1 + diffdays, 1) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_active, IF(LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(active_info, 1 + diffdays, 30)) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_active_30days, COALESCE(product_money_info[diffdays], 0) - COALESCE(product_money_info[1 + diffdays], 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(pay_amt_info[diffdays], 0) - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + diffdays], 0) AS pay_amt_exrate, logymd, IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1 + diffdays, 1) = 1 AND DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) = 29 AND COALESCE(product_money_info[diffdays], 0) - COALESCE(product_money_info[30 + diffdays], 0) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_active_register_pay_30d, IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1 + diffdays, 1) = 1 AND DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) = 29, 1, 0) AS is_active_register_30d, IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1 + diffdays, 1) = 1 AND COALESCE(product_money_info[diffdays], 0) - COALESCE(product_money_info[30 + diffdays], 0) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_active_pay_30d, IF(LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(active_info, 2 + diffdays, 30)) = 0 /* T-30~T-1期间未登录玩家 */ AND /* 且非T-30~T-1期间新增玩家 */ DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) > 30, 1, 0) AS is_nologin_30days FROM (SELECT a.device_id, a.country, a.os, a.network_name, a.create_date, a.pay_amt_info, a.product_money_info, SUBSTRING(a.active_info, 1, 60) AS active_info /* 截取59位 */, c.logymd, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', c.logymd) AS diffdays /* 数据日期与业务日期相差天数 */ FROM adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df AS a LEFT JOIN date_list AS c ON a.p_date = c.p_date WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND a.app_id = '1001' AND a.create_date <= c.logymd) AS t1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT date_range /*	日期区间 */, country /*	国家 */, os /*	创角平台 */, network /*	首次广告归因渠道 */, register_cnt /*	新增玩家数 */, pure_register_cnt /*	纯净新增玩家数 */, active_cnt /*	活跃玩家数 */, active_cnt_30days /*	近30日活跃玩家数 */, pay_cnt /*	付费玩家数 */, pay_amt /*	付费金额(美分) */, active_pay_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且最近30天内充值过的玩家 */, active_register_pay_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且新增第30天且30天内充值过的玩家 */, active_register_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且新增第30天的玩家 */, recurring_cnt_30days /*	30日回流玩家数 */, nologin_cnt_30days /*	30日未登录玩家数 */, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 0 THEN SUBARRAY(register_reten_cnt, 0, 1) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 1 THEN SUBARRAY(register_reten_cnt, 0, 2) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN SUBARRAY(register_reten_cnt, 0, 3) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 6 AND 12 THEN SUBARRAY(register_reten_cnt, 0, 4) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 13 AND 28 THEN SUBARRAY(register_reten_cnt, 0, 5) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 29 THEN SUBARRAY(register_reten_cnt, 0, 6) ELSE ARRAY(0) END AS register_reten_cnt /*	新增留存数组<1,2,3,7,14,30> */, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 0 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_reten_cnt, 0, 1) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 1 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_reten_cnt, 0, 2) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_reten_cnt, 0, 3) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 6 AND 12 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_reten_cnt, 0, 4) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 13 AND 28 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_reten_cnt, 0, 5) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 29 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_reten_cnt, 0, 6) ELSE ARRAY(0) END AS recurring_reten_cnt /*	回流留存数组<1,2,3,7,14,30> */, pay_amt_exrate /*	汇率校准付费金额 */, ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) AS pure_reten_cnt, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 0 THEN SUBARRAY(old_reten_cnt, 0, 1) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 1 THEN SUBARRAY(old_reten_cnt, 0, 2) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 2 AND 5 SUBARRAY(old_reten_cnt, 0, 5) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 29 THEN SUBARRAY(old_reten_cnt, 0, 6) ELSE ARRAY(0) END AS old_reten_cnt /*	回流留存数组<1,2,3,7,14,30> */, active_cnt AS sql_units: /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE `adbi`.`dim_kol_media_post_info`( */ /*     `media_type` int COMMENT '媒体类型:1-fb,2-ins,3-youtube,4-tiktok,5-twitter', */ /*     `source` string COMMENT '来源', */ /* '20260531' AND b.date = '20260531' AND c.date = '20260531' AND d.date = '20260531' AND post_id <> ''), video AS (SELECT source, page_id, post_id, video_id FROM (SELECT source, page_id, post_id, video_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY page_id, post_id ORDER BY post_created_time DESC, source) AS rn FROM (SELECT 'comment' AS source, ins_page_id AS page_id, media_id AS post_id, SUBSTRING(media_timestamp, 1, 19) AS post_created_time, COALESCE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink, '(reel|p)/([^/]+)', 2), REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink, '/([0-9]+)[/?]*$')) AS video_id FROM adbi.ods_kol_instagram_comment WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' UNION ALL SELECT 'stats' AS source, ins_page_id AS page_id, media_id AS post_id, SUBSTRING(post_created_time, 1, 19) AS post_created_time, COALESCE(IF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink, '(tv|reel|p)/([^/]+)', 2) = '', NULL, REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink, '(tv|reel|p)/([^/]+)', 2)), IF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink, '/([0-9]+)[/?]*$') = '', NULL, REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink, '/([0-9]+)[/?]*$')), '-') AS video_id FROM adbi.ods_kol_instagram_stats WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT 'stats' AS source, page_id, SPLIT(post_id, '_')[1] AS post_id, SUBSTRING(post_created_time, 1, 19) AS post_created_time, IF(video_id = '' OR video_id IS NULL, COALESCE(IF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink_url, 'videos/([0-9]+)$') = '', NULL, REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink_url, 'videos/([0-9]+)$')), IF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink_url, '(reel)/([^/]+)', 2) = '', NULL, REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink_url, '(reel)/([^/]+)', 2)), '-'), video_id) AS video_id FROM adbi.ods_kol_facebook_stats WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT 'comment' AS source, page_id, post_id, SUBSTRING(post_created_time, 1, 19) AS post_created_time, COALESCE(IF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink_url, 'videos/([0-9]+)$') = '', NULL, REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink_url, 'videos/([0-9]+)$')), IF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink_url, '(reel)/([^/]+)', 2) = '', NULL, REGEXP_EXTRACT(permalink_url, '(reel)/([^/]+)', 2)), '-') AS video_id FROM adbi.ods_kol_facebook_comment WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01') WHERE NOT video_id IS NULL AND video_id <> '') WHERE rn = 1), di AS (SELECT media_type, source, page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, post_created_time, post_url FROM (SELECT media_type, source, IF(page_id = '', NULL, page_id) AS page_id, IF(page_name = '', 'comment' AS source, channel_id AS page_id, channel_title AS page_name, video_id AS post_id, CONCAT(video_title, '\n', video_description) AS post_message, REGEXP_REPLACE(video_published_at, 'Z$', '') AS post_created_time, CONCAT('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=', video_id) AS post_url, logymd FROM adbi.ods_kol_youtube_comment WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS media_type, 'stats' post_created_time, CONCAT('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=', video_id) AS post_url, logymd FROM adbi.ods_kol_youtube_stats WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS media_type, 'comment' AS permalink_url AS post_url, logymd FROM adbi.ods_kol_facebook_stats WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND post_created_time <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS media_type, 'comment' AS source, page_id, page_title AS page_name, video_id AS post_id, video_desc AS post_message, FROM_UNIXTIME(video_create_time) AS post_created_time, video_url AS post_url, logymd FROM adbi.ods_kol_tiktok_comment WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS media_type, 'stats' AS source, page_id, page_name, id AS post_id, video_description AS post_message, create_time AS post_created_time, share_url AS post_url, logymd FROM adbi.ods_kol_tiktok_stats WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT 5 AS media_type, 'comment' AS source, page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, post_created_time, permalink_url AS video.page_id AND di.post_id = video.post_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dim_kol_media_post_info PARTITION(p_date = '2026-06-01') SELECT a.media_type, a.source, a.page_id, IF(b.page_name IS NULL, a.page_name, b.page_name) AS page_name, b.page_type, a.post_id, a.post_message, a.post_created_time, a.post_url, COALESCE(b.app_id, '-') AS app_id, dim.campaign, location_id, location_name, sql_units: WITH real_country_online AS (SELECT div_time, country, SUM(real_online_num) AS online_num FROM (SELECT `TIME`, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`TIME`) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time, LOWER(country) AS country, zone_id, (COALESCE(online_num, 0) - COALESCE(vp_online_num, 0)) AS real_online_num /* 真实玩家在线人数 */, logymd FROM ml_ods.connserver_t_real_country_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     zone_id < 57000 */ zone_id < IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03', 57000, 999999)) GROUP BY div_time, country), real_os_online AS (SELECT `TIME`, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`TIME`) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time /* 每5分钟记一次,间隔在五分钟内的，计入当前5分钟 */, zone_id, CASE WHEN os_type = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN os_type = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN os_type = 3 THEN 'emulator' ELSE 'unknown' END AS os_type, (COALESCE(online_num, 0) - COALESCE(vp_online_num, 0)) AS online_num /* 真实玩家在线人数 */, logymd FROM ml_ods.connserver_t_real_os_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     zone_id < 57000 */ zone_id < IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03', 57000, 999999)), dim_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 1 AS region_type, act_geo_continent AS region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 0 AS region_type, region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */), online_cube AS (/* 分国家和区域 */ SELECT region_type, region, country, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, AVG(online_num) AS acu FROM (SELECT con.region_type, con.region, lin.country, lin.div_time, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_country_online AS lin LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con ON lin.country = con.country_code GROUP BY con.region_type, con.region, lin.country, lin.div_time, GROUPING SETS ((con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region, lin.country), (con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region), (con.region_type, lin.div_time, lin.country))) GROUP BY region_type, region, country /* ----总况 */ UNION ALL SELECT region_type AS region_type, NULL AS region, NULL AS country, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, AVG(online_num) AS acu FROM (SELECT lin.div_time, 0 AS region_type, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_os_online AS lin GROUP BY lin.div_time UNION ALL SELECT lin.div_time, 1 AS region_type, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_os_online AS lin GROUP BY lin.div_time) GROUP BY region_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, 'all' AS network, COALESCE(pcu, 0) AS pcu, COALESCE(acu, 0) AS acu, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, 'mlbb' AS appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'daily' AS date_type FROM online_cube

sql_units: WITH basic_account AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(first_network_name, 'unknown') AS network, register_date, is_first_create FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-09-01', '2022-09-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, SUM(product_money) AS day_pay_amount, SUM(before_tax_usd_amt) AS day_pay_amount_exrate, SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid), active_di AS (SELECT roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days /* 活跃天数 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) /* AND     is_ai = 0 */ GROUP BY roleid), connserver_client_49ad_data AS (/* 月扑脸曝光总pv */ SELECT accountid, COUNT(*) AS exposure_pv FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_49ad_data /* 数据最早日期2020-06-16 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND logymd >= '2020-06-16' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 GROUP BY accountid), connserver_prompt_data AS (/* 月扑脸点击总pv */ SELECT accountid, COUNT(*) AS click_pv FROM ml_ods.connserver_prompt_data WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND logymd >= '2020-06-16' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 GROUP BY accountid), result_tbl AS (SELECT country, network, CAST(MAP('avg_active_cnt', avg_active_cnt, '2usd_pay_cnt', 2usd_pay_cnt, 'actual_pay_amt', actual_pay_amt, 'pay_amt', pay_amt, 'mau', mau, 'click_pv', click_pv, 'exposure_pv', exposure_pv) AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>) AS indicator_map FROM (SELECT bas.country, bas.network, COALESCE(SUM(active_days) / (DATEDIFF(LAST_DAY('2026-05-31'), DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01')) + 1), 0) AS avg_active_cnt /* 日均活跃天数 */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay.day_pay_amount >= 200, 1, 0)), 0) AS 2usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(pay.pay_net_receipts_usd_amt), 0) AS actual_pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(pay.day_pay_amount), 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid), 0) AS mau, COALESCE(SUM(cpd.click_pv), 0) AS click_pv, COALESCE(SUM(ccd.exposure_pv), 0) AS exposure_pv FROM basic_account AS bas LEFT JOIN active_di AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid LEFT JOIN pay_di AS pay ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid LEFT JOIN connserver_client_49ad_data AS ccd ON bas.roleid = ccd.accountid LEFT JOIN connserver_prompt_data AS cpd ON bas.roleid = cpd.accountid GROUP BY bas.country, bas.network)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_di_mid PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'monthly') SELECT SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AS date_range, res.country, res.network, MAP_CONCAT(COALESCE(res.indicator_map, CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>))) AS indicator_map, NULL AS os, NULL AS channel, NULL AS user_type FROM result_tbl AS res

Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.leavyliu_hero_use_feature2 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(hero1_pv / pv_sum, 0.0) AS heros1, COALESCE(hero2_pv / pv_sum, 0.0) AS heros2, COALESCE(hero3_pv / pv_sum, 0.0) AS heros3, COALESCE(hero4_pv / pv_sum, 0.0) AS heros4, COALESCE(hero5_pv / pv_sum, 0.0) AS heros5, COALESCE(hero6_pv / pv_sum, 0.0) AS heros6, COALESCE(hero1_diff, 0.0) AS hero1_diff, COALESCE(hero2_diff, 0.0) AS hero2_diff, COALESCE(hero3_diff, 0.0) AS hero3_diff, COALESCE(hero4_diff, 0.0) AS hero4_diff, COALESCE(hero5_diff, 0.0) AS hero5_diff, COALESCE(hero6_diff, 0.0) AS hero6_diff FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(use_pv) AS pv_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN heroes = 1 THEN use_pv ELSE 0 END) AS hero1_pv, SUM(CASE WHEN heroes = 2 THEN use_pv ELSE 0 END) AS hero2_pv, SUM(CASE WHEN heroes = 3 THEN use_pv ELSE 0 END) AS hero3_pv, SUM(CASE WHEN heroes = 4 THEN use_pv ELSE 0 END) AS hero4_pv, SUM(CASE WHEN heroes = 5 THEN use_pv ELSE 0 END) AS hero5_pv, SUM(CASE WHEN heroes = 6 THEN use_pv ELSE 0 END) AS hero6_pv, AVG(CASE WHEN heroes = 1 THEN heroic_difficulty ELSE NULL END) AS hero1_diff, AVG(CASE WHEN heroes = 2 THEN heroic_difficulty ELSE NULL END) AS hero2_diff, AVG(CASE WHEN heroes = 3 THEN heroic_difficulty ELSE NULL END) AS hero3_diff, AVG(CASE WHEN heroes = 4 THEN heroic_difficulty ELSE NULL END) AS hero4_diff, AVG(CASE WHEN heroes = 5 THEN heroic_difficulty ELSE NULL END) AS hero5_diff, AVG(CASE WHEN heroes = 6 THEN heroic_difficulty ELSE NULL END) AS hero6_diff FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, heroid, COUNT(*) AS use_pv FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 30 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND usercreateymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 30 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) <= 30 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, heroid) AS battle LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, hero_name, hero_en_name, heroes, heroic_difficulty FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS hero_config ON battle.heroid = hero_config.heroid GROUP BY roleid, zoneid)

sql_units: /* select cluster_id,cc.hero_name,count(distinct aa.roleid,aa.zoneid),sum(use_pv) as use_pv_sum */ /* from */ /* ( */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: leavyliu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-07-30 19:56:43.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 预测 */ /* 筛选前30天新注册用户 */ WITH p1 AS (SELECT '20240724' AS logymd, roleid, zoneid, heros1, heros2, heros3, heros4, heros5, heros6, hero1_diff / 70 AS hero1_diff, hero2_diff / 80 AS hero2_diff, hero3_diff / 100 AS hero3_diff, hero4_diff / 90 AS hero4_diff, hero5_diff / 90 AS hero5_diff, hero6_diff / 70 AS hero6_diff FROM ml_temp.leavyliu_hero_use_feature2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), p2 AS (SELECT * FROM ml_temp.leavyliu_hero_cluster_center_v1 WHERE logymd = '20240724' AND k = 9), p3 AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd AS register_date FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE usercreateymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 30 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 30 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' /* and zoneid < 57000 */ /* and is_pure = 1 */ /* and is_ai = 0 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.leavyliu_newplayer_cluster_predict PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT aa.roleid, aa.zoneid, COALESCE(bb.cluster_id + 1, 0) AS cluster_id FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM p3 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS aa LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, cluster_id FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, cluster_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY distance ASC) AS rank FROM (SELECT p1.roleid, p1.zoneid, p2.cluster_id, SQRT(POWER(p1.heros1 - p2.heros1, 2) + POWER(p1.heros2 - p2.heros2, 2) + POWER(p1.heros3 - p2.heros3, 2) + POWER(p1.heros4 - p2.heros4, 2) + POWER(p1.heros5 - p2.heros5, 2) + POWER(p1.heros6 - p2.heros6, 2) + POWER(p1.hero1_diff - p2.hero1_diff, 2) + POWER(p1.hero2_diff - p2.hero2_diff, 2) + POWER(p1.hero3_diff - p2.hero3_diff, 2) + POWER(p1.hero4_diff - p2.hero4_diff, 2) + POWER(p1.hero5_diff - p2.hero5_diff, 2) + POWER(p1.hero6_diff - p2.hero6_diff, 2)) AS distance FROM (SELECT * FROM p1) AS p1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM p2) AS p2 ON p1.logymd = p2.logymd)) WHERE rank = 1) AS bb ON aa.roleid = bb.roleid AND aa.zoneid = bb.zoneid /* --建表 */ /*    CREATE TABLE ml_temp.leavyliu_newplayer_cluster_predict */ /*     ( */ /*     roleid string comment 'roleid', */ /*     zoneid string comment 'zonied', */ /*     cluster_id string comment '类型' */ /* ) partitioned by (logymd string) stored as parquet location 's3a://moonton-hadoop/user/leavyliu/leavyliu_newplayer_cluster_predict' */

(1, 2, 59, 90), 1, 0) AS if_real_battle, FLOOR(t1.battlesvrid / 1000) AS battle_group, t1.heroid, t3.hero_name, t.newbie_1_heroid, CASE WHEN t.newbie_1_heroid = 423 THEN 18 WHEN t.newbie_1_heroid = 446 THEN 18 WHEN t.newbie_1_heroid = 964 THEN 28 WHEN t.newbie_1_heroid = 968 THEN 38 ELSE newbie_1_heroid END AS newbie_1_heroid_std, CASE WHEN t1.select_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN t1.select_road = 2 if_exist_personal_score, IF(t4.matchtime IS NULL, 0, 1) AS if_exist_matchtime, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t.logymd, t.register_date) = 2, SUBSTRING(active_info, t.register_days - 1, 1), 0)) AS ciliu_user_cnt, battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t1.blacknum > 1, t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS black_battle_cnt, SUM(t1.ismvp) AS mvp_cnt, SUM(t1.score) AS score, SUM(t1.killnum) AS kill_cnt, SUM(t1.assistnum) t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS select_road_precise_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t5.if_pre_select_road_lack = 1, t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS select_road_lack_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t5.if_pre_select_road_conflict = 1, t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS select_road_conflict_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t5.if_real_road_lack = 1, t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS real_road_lack_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t5.if_real_road_conflict = 1, t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS real_road_conflict_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(INT(t6.game_type + IF(t1.wincamp = 1, 0, 5)) IN (1, 6), t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS game_type1 /* `跌宕局数` */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(INT(t6.game_type + IF(t1.wincamp = 1, 0, 5)) IN (5, 10), t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS game_type5 /* `均衡局数` */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(INT(t6.game_type + IF(t1.wincamp = 1, 0, 5)) = 2, t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS game_type2 /* `翻盘局数` */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(INT(t6.game_type + IF(t1.wincamp = 1, 0, 5)) = 3, t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS game_type3 /* `碾压局数` */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(INT(t6.game_type + IF(t1.wincamp = 1, 0, 5)) = 4, t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS game_type4 /* `小优局数` */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(INT(t6.game_type + IF(t1.wincamp = 1, 0, 5)) = 7, t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS game_type7 /* `被翻盘数` */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(INT(t6.game_type + IF(t1.wincamp = 1, 0, 5)) = 8, t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS game_type8 /* `被碾压数` */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(INT(t6.game_type + IF(t1.wincamp = 1, 0, 5)) = 9, t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS game_type9 /* `小劣局数` */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t6.game_type IS NULL, t1.battleid || t1.accountid, NULL)) AS null_game_type /* `无类型局数` */ FROM dm_jax_newbie_di2 AS t JOIN ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS t1 ON t.roleid = t1.accountid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t1.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND (NOT (t1.killnum >= 50 AND db_bytedance.mlbb_dwd_impact_value a */ /* JOIN    dm_jax_newbie_di2 b */ /* ON      a.role_id = b.roleid */ /* WHERE   a.p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-30'  -- 胜率贡献分分区p_date部分战斗与战斗分区相差一天 */ /* GROUP BY */ /*         role_id, */ /*         battle_id */ SELECT -99999 AS battle_id, -99999 AS role_id, -99999 AS personal_score_adjusted) AS t2 ON t.roleid = t2.role_id AND t1.battleid = '2000-01-01') AS t3 ON t1.heroid = t3.heroid LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.matchtime FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end AS a JOIN dm_jax_newbie_di2 AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-29' AND '2026-05-31' /* 部分对局匹配与战斗结束日期存在一天误差 */ AND a.usercreateymd BETWEEN '2026-04-28' AND '2026-05-31' AND a.success = 1) AS t4 ON t.roleid = t4.accountid AND t.zoneid = t4.zoneid AND t1.battleid = t4.battleid LEFT JOIN ml_temp.dwd_wmz_newbie_education_di AS t5 ON t1.accountid = t5.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t5.zoneid AND t1.battleid t6.battle_id AND t6.p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-06-01' GROUP BY t.logymd, t.register_date, t.new_type, t.newbie_tag, is_odd, FLOOR(t.zoneid / 1000) * 1000, t.create_country, t1.pvptype, IF(t1.realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90), 1, 0), battle_group, t1.heroid, t3.hero_name, t.newbie_1_heroid, if_exist_personal_score, if_exist_matchtime, t1.select_road, t1.real_road) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE name: etl.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di_msdk_account_daily
sql_units: WITH real_country_online AS (SELECT event_time, appname, ad.app_id, stagename, FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(event_time / 1000 AS BIGINT) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time, LOWER(IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.country') = '-', 'unknown', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.country'))) AS country, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.os_type') AS os_type, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.online_num') AS online_num, logymd FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event AS ad JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(appname) AS appname, stagename, CAST(stageid AS INT) AS app_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_app_info WHERE logymd = IF('20260531' <= '20250106', '20250106', '20260531') AND is_online = 1 AND NOT LOWER(appname) IN ('mlbb', 'mla', 'zgame', 'nova', 'xgame')) AS ap ON ap.app_id = ad.app_id WHERE logymd = '20260531' AND event IN ('t_real_os_country_online', 't_real_os_online') AND FROM_UNIXTIME(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.time') - 8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31'), dim_country AS (SELECT country_code AS country, definition_type AS region_type, region, appname FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_country) /* 取最新 */ AND startdate <= '2026-05-31' AND NOT appname IN ('mlbb', 'zgame', 'mla', 'nova', 'mcgg_v2', 'xgame', 'mlbb_v2')), online_cube AS (/* 分国家和区域 */ SELECT appname, region_type, region, country, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, ROUND(SUM(online_num) / 288) AS acu FROM (SELECT con.appname, con.region_type, con.region, con.country, lin.div_time, COALESCE(SUM(online_num), 0) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM dim_country AS con LEFT JOIN real_country_online AS lin ON con.country = lin.country AND con.appname = lin.appname GROUP BY con.appname, con.region_type, con.region, con.country, lin.div_time, GROUPING SETS ((con.appname, con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region, con.country), (con.appname, con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region), (con.appname, con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.country))) GROUP BY appname, region_type, region, country /* ----总况 */ UNION ALL SELECT a.appname, a.region_type AS region_type, NULL AS region, NULL AS country, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, ROUND(SUM(online_num) / 288) AS acu FROM (SELECT DISTINCT appname, region_type FROM dim_country) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT lin.appname, lin.div_time, 0 AS region_type, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_country_online AS lin GROUP BY lin.appname, lin.div_time UNION ALL SELECT lin.appname, lin.div_time, 1 AS region_type, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_country_online AS lin GROUP BY lin.appname, lin.div_time) AS b ON a.appname = b.appname AND a.region_type = b.region_type GROUP BY a.appname, a.region_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, 'all' AS network, COALESCE(pcu, 0) AS pcu, COALESCE(acu, 0) AS acu, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'daily' AS date_type FROM online_cube

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-03-11 16:25:36.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_ads.ads_online_num_di ( */ /*     stagename string COMMENT '所处阶段名称', */ /*     country STRING COMMENT '归因国', */ /*     os STRING COMMENT '平台', */ /*     day_point int COMMENT '时间点', */ /*     online_num double COMMENT '最大在线人数' */ /* ) COMMENT '在线表' PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     logymd STRING COMMENT '数据日期yyyy-MM-dd', */ /*     appname STRING COMMENT '项目ID-分区字段', */ /*     stageid bigint COMMENT '所处阶段-分区字段' */ /* ) STORED AS PARQUET */ WITH real_country_online AS (SELECT event_time, appname, ad.app_id AS stageid, stagename, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.day_point') AS day_point, LOWER(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.country')) AS country, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.os_type') AS os_type, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.online_num') AS real_online_num, logymd FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event AS ad JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT appname, stagename, CAST(stageid AS INT) AS app_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_app_info WHERE logymd = '20260531' AND is_online = 1) AS ap ON ap.app_id = ad.app_id WHERE logymd = '20260531' AND event IN ('t_real_os_country_online', 't_real_os_online')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_ads.ads_online_num_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname, stageid) SELECT stagename, country, IF(os_type = '1', 'ios', 'android') AS os, day_point, SUM(IF(real_online_num = '' OR real_online_num IS NULL, 0, real_online_num)) AS online_num, appname, stageid FROM real_country_online GROUP BY stagename, appname, stageid, country, IF(os_type = '1', 'ios', 'android'), day_point

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: haowang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-08-27 16:24:39.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.limited_dimension_focud SELECT country, state, isp, asn, logymd FROM (SELECT a.country, a.state, a.isp, a.asn, '2026-05-31' AS logymd FROM (SELECT GEOIP(clientip, 1) AS country, GEOIP(clientip, 2) AS state, GEOIP(clientip, 5) AS isp, GEOIP(clientip, 10) AS asn FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) GROUP BY country, state, isp, asn) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT GEOIP(clientip, 1) AS country FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 50) AS b ON a.country = b.country INNER JOIN (SELECT GEOIP(clientip, 5) AS isp, GEOIP(clientip, 10) AS asn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY GEOIP(clientip, 5) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS num FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND GEOIP(clientip, 10) NOT LIKE '%AS0%' GROUP BY isp, asn) AS c ON a.isp = c.isp AND a.asn = c.asn INNER JOIN (SELECT GEOIP(clientip, 1) AS country, GEOIP(clientip, 5) AS isp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY GEOIP(clientip, 1) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS num FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) GROUP BY country, isp) AS d ON a.country = d.country AND a.isp = d.isp WHERE d.num <= 50 AND c.num <= 3)

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.mlbb_impala_v2_pay_dau PARTITION(logymd, date_type, stat_range) SELECT IF(m.os_type = 1, 'ios', 'and') AS platform, COALESCE(LOWER(adjust_country), 'noCountry') AS country, IF(channel IS NULL OR LOWER(channel) = '', 'and_usa', LOWER(channel)) AS game_channel, COALESCE(LOWER(adjust_network_name), 'noChannel') AS network_name, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS pay_dau_natural, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, 'mon' AS date_type, CONCAT_WS('~', DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01'), LAST_DAY('2026-05-31')) AS stat_range FROM (SELECT accountid, adjust_country, adjust_network_name FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df WHERE appid = 'mlbb') AS n RIGHT JOIN (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.channel, a.os_type FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd <= LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND (zoneid DIV 1000) < 57) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND (a.zoneid DIV 1000) < 57 AND NOT channel IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test')) AS m ON n.accountid = m.roleid GROUP BY platform, country, game_channel, network_name

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.mlbb_impala_v2_pay_account PARTITION(logymd, date_type, stat_range) SELECT platform, country, game_channel, network_name, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS pay_kpi99_account_natural, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, 'mon' AS date_type, CONCAT_WS('~', DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01'), LAST_DAY('2026-05-31')) AS stat_range FROM (SELECT IF(a.os_type = 1, 'ios', 'and') AS platform, COALESCE(LOWER(adjust_country), 'noCountry') AS country, IF(channel IS NULL OR LOWER(channel) = '', 'and_usa', LOWER(channel)) AS game_channel, COALESCE(LOWER(adjust_network_name), 'noChannel') AS network_name, a.roleid AS roleid FROM (SELECT accountid, adjust_country, adjust_network_name FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df WHERE appid = 'mlbb') AS b RIGHT JOIN ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a ON a.roleid = b.accountid WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND (zoneid DIV 1000) < 57 GROUP BY platform, country, game_channel, network_name, a.roleid HAVING SUM(a.money) >= 99) AS res GROUP BY platform, country, game_channel, network_name

name: v2_returnning_30
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.mlbb_impala_v2_returnning_30 PARTITION(logymd, date_type, stat_range) SELECT IF(a.os_type = 1, 'ios', 'and') AS platform, COALESCE(LOWER(adjust_country), 'noCountry') AS country, IF(channel IS NULL OR LOWER(channel) = '', 'and_usa', LOWER(channel)) AS game_channel, COALESCE(LOWER(adjust_network_name), 'noChannel') AS network_name, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS returnning_30_natural, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, 'mon' AS date_type, CONCAT_WS('~', DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01'), LAST_DAY('2026-05-31')) AS stat_range FROM (SELECT accountid, adjust_country, adjust_network_name FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df WHERE appid = 'mlbb') AS b RIGHT JOIN (SELECT roleid, os_type, zoneid, channel FROM mt_dwd.datacleaning_returnning_user_details WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND user_flag = 'day30' AND NOT channel IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test')) AS a ON b.accountid = a.roleid GROUP BY platform, country, game_channel, network_name
