w0.active_days >= 6 THEN '高活' WHEN w0.active_days >= 3 THEN '中活' WHEN w0.active_days >= 1 THEN '低活' ELSE '无活跃' /* 上周无活跃本周活跃用户 */ END AS user_type_lastweek /* 上周活跃用户分层 */, CASE WHEN w1.active_days >= 6 THEN '高活' WHEN w1.active_days >= 3 THEN '中活' WHEN w1.active_days >= 1 THEN '低活' ELSE '无活跃' /* 上周活跃本周流失用户 */ END AS user_type_curweek /* 本周活跃用户分层 */, new_this_week /* 是否本周新增 */ FROM w0 FULL JOIN w1 ON w0.roleid = w1.roleid), c AS (SELECT roleid, UPPER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country /* 首次创号国 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31') GROUP BY roleid, first_mt_country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.pan_20241119_weekly_tag_convert_by_country PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 本周日 */ /* 上周周低活流转 */ SELECT first_mt_country /* 首次创号国 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '低活' THEN w.roleid END) AS low_users /* 上周低活人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '低活' AND user_type_curweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '低活' THEN w.roleid END) AS low_to_loss_rate /* 周低活→周流失占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '低活' AND user_type_curweek = '低活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '低活' THEN w.roleid END) AS low_to_low_rate /* 周低活→周低活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '低活' AND user_type_curweek = '中活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '低活' THEN w.roleid END) AS low_to_mid_rate /* 周低活→周中活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '低活' AND user_type_curweek = '高活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '低活' THEN w.roleid END) AS low_to_high_rate /* 周低活→周高活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '中活' THEN w.roleid END) AS mid_users /* 上周周中活流转 */ /* 上周中活人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '中活' AND user_type_curweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '中活' THEN w.roleid END) AS mid_to_loss_rate /* 周中活→周流失占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '中活' AND user_type_curweek = '低活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '中活' THEN w.roleid END) AS mid_to_low_rate /* 周中活→周低活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '中活' AND user_type_curweek = '中活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '中活' THEN w.roleid END) AS mid_to_mid_rate /* 周中活→周中活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '中活' AND user_type_curweek = '高活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '中活' THEN w.roleid END) AS mid_to_high_rate /* 周中活→周高活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '高活' THEN w.roleid END) AS high_users /* 上周周高活流转 */ /* 上周高活人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '高活' AND user_type_curweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '高活' THEN w.roleid END) AS high_to_loss_rate /* 周高活→周流失占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '高活' AND user_type_curweek = '低活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '高活' THEN w.roleid END) AS high_to_low_rate /* 周高活→周低活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '高活' AND user_type_curweek = '中活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '高活' THEN w.roleid END) AS high_to_mid_rate /* 周高活→周中活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '高活' AND user_type_curweek = '高活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '高活' THEN w.roleid END) AS high_to_high_rate /* 周高活→周高活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) AS inactive_users /* 上周无活跃流转（上周不存在，本周新增也在里面） */ /* 上周无活跃人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' AND user_type_curweek = '低活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) AS inactive_to_low_rate /* 周无活跃→周低活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' AND user_type_curweek = '中活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) AS inactive_to_mid_rate /* 周无活跃→周中活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' AND user_type_curweek = '高活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) AS inactive_to_high_rate /* 周无活跃→周高活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 1 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) AS new_users /* 本周新增对应本周高中低活 */ /* 本周新增人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 1 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' AND user_type_curweek = '低活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 1 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) AS low_in_new_rate /* 本周新增中周低活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 1 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' AND user_type_curweek = '中活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 1 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) AS mid_in_new_rate /* 本周新增中周中活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 1 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' AND user_type_curweek = '高活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 1 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) AS high_in_new_rate /* 本周新增中周高活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 0 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) AS return_users /* 上周流失、本周回流对应本周高中低活 */ /* 本周回流人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 0 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' AND user_type_curweek = '低活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 0 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) AS return_to_low_rate /* 上周流失→本周低活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 0 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' AND user_type_curweek = '中活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 0 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) AS return_to_mid_rate /* 上周流失→本周中活占比 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 0 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' AND user_type_curweek = '高活' THEN w.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_this_week = 0 AND user_type_lastweek = '无活跃' THEN w.roleid END) AS return_to_high_rate /* 上周流失→本周高活占比 */, sunday_lastweek /* 上周日 */ FROM w INNER JOIN c ON w.roleid = c.roleid GROUP BY first_mt_country, sunday_lastweek /* 上周日 */

name: 2_koc_pool_w_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: achingzhu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-11-20 15:14:28.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH pagerank AS (SELECT SPLIT(id, '-')[0] AS roleid, SPLIT(id, '-')[1] AS zoneid, pagerank FROM mt_da.social_kol_role_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pagerank > 2 /* ≈ avg + 1 * std */), battle_degree AS (SELECT * FROM mt_da.social_healthy_role_zone_wi WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), ranked_balck AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT friend_role_id, friend_zone_id) AS ranked_balck_role_cnt_7d FROM ml_ods.gameserver_battle_with_friend WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31' AND battle_type = 2 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_da.social_koc_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, battle_degree, battle_strength, battle_triangle, gift_degree, gift_strength, gift_triangle, pagerank FROM pagerank AS a INNER JOIN battle_degree AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid INNER JOIN ranked_balck AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid WHERE NOT FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) IN (1, 57) AND battle_degree >= 8 /* koc / battle_dau <= 5% */ AND ranked_balck_role_cnt_7d >= 8 /* rank only */ UNION ALL SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, battle_degree, battle_strength, battle_triangle, gift_degree, gift_strength, gift_triangle, pagerank FROM pagerank AS a INNER JOIN battle_degree AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid INNER JOIN ranked_balck AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid WHERE FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) IN (1, 57) /* 巴西 / 测服 */ AND battle_degree >= 4 /* koc / battle_dau <= 5% */ AND ranked_balck_role_cnt_7d >= 4 /* rank only */

name: etl.ads_decismart_network_cube_di_mid
sql_units: WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, create_os AS os, COALESCE(first_network_name, 'unknown') AS network, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create, new_type, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS channel, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), dim_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 1 AS region_type, act_geo_continent AS region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 0 AS region_type, region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */), dim_basic_country AS (SELECT bas.roleid, bas.zoneid, bas.country, bas.network, COALESCE(con.region_type, 'unknwon') AS region_type, COALESCE(con.region, 'unknwon') AS region FROM basic AS bas LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con ON bas.country = con.country_code), battleserver_battle_end /* 网络满足率/平均ping值/断线重连/断线重连发生率 */ AS (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT zone IS NULL, 'zone', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(zone, '-10000') AS zone, stdping_cnt AS network_stdping_cnt, ping_total, reconnect_cnt, reconnect_battle_cnt, battle_cnt FROM (SELECT region_type, region, country, CASE WHEN bat.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, SUM(CASE WHEN ((ping120 + ping150 + ping200 + ping300 + ping500 + ping800) / ping_times) <= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stdping_cnt, SUM(timedelay) AS ping_total, SUM(reconnectnum) AS reconnect_cnt, SUM(IF(reconnectnum > 0, 1, 0)) AS reconnect_battle_cnt, COUNT(*) AS battle_cnt FROM dim_basic_country AS bas JOIN ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS bat ON bas.roleid = bat.accountid WHERE bat.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     zoneid < 57000 */ timedelay > 0 AND timedelay <> 10000 AND timedelay < 50000 AND maxdelay < 50000 AND movelag < 10000 AND isvalid = 1 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) GROUP BY region_type, CUBE (region, country, CASE WHEN bat.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS t3), begin_info AS (/* 开局成功率 */ SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT zone IS NULL, 'zone', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(zone, '-10000') AS zone, match_suc_cnt, battle_begin_cnt, match_trace_cnt FROM (SELECT region_type, region, country, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, COUNT(DISTINCT a.battleid, a.accountid) AS match_suc_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT b.battleid, b.accountid) AS battle_begin_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT c.battleid, c.account) AS match_trace_cnt FROM dim_basic_country AS bas JOIN (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end AS a WHERE success = 1 AND LENGTH(battleid) > 10 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND /* and groupsel in (45,75,98) and geoip(a.clientip,1) in (""PH"",""IN"") */ change_client_battle = 0 AND mapid <> 188 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2017-03-10') AS a ON bas.roleid = a.accountid LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_begin WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND LENGTH(battleid) > 10) AS B ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.battleid = b.battleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_match_trace WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND LENGTH(battleid) > 10 AND step_name = 'OpenMatchOKUI' AND logymd >= '2023-07-10') AS c ON a.accountid = c.account AND a.zoneid = c.zone AND a.battleid = c.battleid GROUP BY region_type, CUBE (region, country, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS t4), match_info AS (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT zone IS NULL, 'zone', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, definition_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(zone, '-10000') AS zone, login_auth_cnt, login_sucess_cnt FROM (SELECT region_type AS definition_type, region, country, zone, COUNT(DISTINCT s_accountid) AS login_auth_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e_roleid) AS login_sucess_cnt FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.region_type, 'unknown') AS region_type, COALESCE(region, 'unknown') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, a.accountid AS s_accountid, b.roleid AS e_roleid /* a.zoneid AS s_zoneid, */ /* b.zoneid AS e_zoneid */ /* count(DISTINCT b.roleid, b.zoneid) / count(DISTINCT a.accountid, a.zoneid) rate_num */ FROM (SELECT DISTINCT logymd, accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, 0 AS region_type FROM ml_ods.reportserver_client_loginv2_start AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2024-05-24' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT logymd, account_id FROM ml_ods.accountserver_login_acc_token_check_result AS b WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_block_check_fail = 1 AND real_ret <> 0 AND a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.accountid = b.account_id) /* AND     zoneid < 57000\ */ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT logymd, accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, 1 AS region_type FROM ml_ods.reportserver_client_loginv2_start AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2024-05-24' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT logymd, account_id FROM ml_ods.accountserver_login_acc_token_check_result AS b WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_block_check_fail = 1 AND real_ret <> 0 AND a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.accountid = b.account_id)) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT logymd, roleid, CASE WHEN zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone FROM ml_ods.gameserver_loginv2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2024-08-17') AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zone = b.zone LEFT JOIN dim_basic_country AS bas ON bas.roleid = a.accountid AND bas.zoneid = a.zoneid AND bas.region_type = a.region_type) AS k GROUP BY region_type, CUBE (region, country, zone)) AS t8), logintime_info AS (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT zone IS NULL, 'zone', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(zone, '-10000') AS zone, logintime_cnt, logintime_total_cnt FROM (SELECT region_type, region, country, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, SUM(a.logintime / 1000) AS logintime_cnt, COUNT(*) AS logintime_total_cnt FROM dim_basic_country AS bas JOIN (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.reportserver_client_loginv2_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2024-05-24' AND /* AND     ifupdate = 0 */ /* AND     ifbackend = 0 */ /* AND     zoneid >= 57061 */ /* AND     zoneid <= 57080 */ logintime BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000 AND cclass >= 1 AND ifupdate = 0) AS a ON bas.roleid = a.accountid /* INNER JOIN */ /*         ( */ /*             SELECT  CASE WHEN CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) > 0 AND CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) < 5.7 THEN 1 */ /*                          WHEN CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) >= 5.7 AND CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) < 7.4 THEN 2 */ /*                          WHEN CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) >= 7.4 AND CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) < 9.4 THEN 3 */ /*                          WHEN CAST(fixed_score AS DOUBLE) >= 9.4 THEN 4 */ /*                          ELSE 0 */ /*                     END device_type, */ /*                     accountid, */ /*                     zoneid, */ /*                     TIME */ /*             FROM    ml_ods.connserver_client_configuration */ /*             WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /*             AND     logymd >= '2020-07-15' */ /*             GROUP BY */ /*                     device_type, */ /*                     accountid, */ /*                     zoneid, */ /*                     TIME */ /*         ) b */ /* ON      a.accountid = b.accountid */ /* AND     a.zoneid = b.zoneid */ /* AND     abs(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.time) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(b.time)) <= 180 */ /* WHERE   b.device_type = 1 */ GROUP BY region_type, CUBE (region, country, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS t7), loading_info AS (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT zone IS NULL, 'zone', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(zone, '-10000') AS zone, loading_total_cnt, loading_cnt FROM (SELECT region_type, region, country, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, COUNT(1) AS loading_total_cnt, SUM(IF(flag <> 3, 1, 0)) AS loading_cnt /* -卡loading */ FROM dim_basic_country AS bas JOIN ml_ods.connserver_battle_loading_choke AS a ON bas.roleid = a.accountid /* --9.28号全量了新battle loading因此大盘都可以用这个口径统计loading时长和卡loading率 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battleid > 10000000 AND game_channel NOT LIKE '%ios_%' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) /* -所以模式都可以用，只是这里限定匹配排位 */ GROUP BY region_type, CUBE (region, country, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS x) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_decismart_network_cube_di_mid PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT COALESCE(t3.date_range, t4.date_range, t7.date_range) AS date_range, COALESCE(t3.grouping_name, t4.grouping_name, t7.grouping_name) AS grouping_name, COALESCE(t3.definition_type, t4.definition_type, t7.definition_type) AS definition_type, COALESCE(t3.region, t4.region, t7.region) AS region, COALESCE(t3.country, t4.country, t7.country) AS country, COALESCE(t3.zone, t4.zone, t7.zone) AS zone, IF('2026-05-31' < '2016-10-18', NULL, COALESCE(network_stdping_cnt, 0)) AS network_stdping_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2016-10-18', NULL, COALESCE(ping_total, 0)) AS ping_total, IF('2026-05-31' < '2016-10-18', NULL, COALESCE(reconnect_cnt, 0)) AS reconnect_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2016-10-18', NULL, COALESCE(reconnect_battle_cnt, 0)) AS reconnect_battle_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2016-10-18', NULL, COALESCE(battle_cnt, 0)) AS network_battle_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2017-03-10', NULL, COALESCE(match_suc_cnt, 0)) AS match_suc_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2017-03-10', NULL, COALESCE(battle_begin_cnt, 0)) AS battle_begin_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2023-07-10', NULL, COALESCE(match_trace_cnt, 0)) AS match_trace_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-05-24', NULL, COALESCE(login_auth_cnt, 0)) AS login_auth_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-08-17', NULL, COALESCE(login_sucess_cnt, 0)) AS login_sucess_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-05-24', NULL, COALESCE(logintime_cnt, 0)) AS logintime_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-05-24', NULL, COALESCE(logintime_total_cnt, 0)) AS logintime_total_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-05-24', NULL, COALESCE(loading_total_cnt, 0)) AS loading_total_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-05-24', NULL, COALESCE(loading_cnt, 0)) AS loading_cnt FROM (SELECT COALESCE(t1.date_range, t2.date_range) AS date_range, COALESCE(t1.grouping_name, t2.grouping_name) AS grouping_name, COALESCE(t1.definition_type, t2.definition_type) AS definition_type, COALESCE(t1.region, t2.region) AS region, COALESCE(t1.country, t2.country) AS country, COALESCE(t1.zone, t2.zone) AS zone, network_stdping_cnt, ping_total, reconnect_cnt, reconnect_battle_cnt, battle_cnt, match_suc_cnt, battle_begin_cnt, match_trace_cnt FROM (SELECT date_range, grouping_name, definition_type, region, country, zone, network_stdping_cnt, ping_total, reconnect_cnt, reconnect_battle_cnt, battle_cnt FROM battleserver_battle_end) AS t1 FULL JOIN (SELECT date_range, grouping_name, definition_type, region, country, zone, match_suc_cnt, battle_begin_cnt, match_trace_cnt FROM begin_info) AS t2 ON t1.date_range = t2.date_range AND t1.grouping_name = t2.grouping_name AND t1.definition_type = t2.definition_type AND t1.country = t2.country AND t1.REGION = t2.REGION AND t1.zone = t2.zone) AS t3 FULL JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(t5.date_range, t6.date_range) AS date_range, COALESCE(t5.grouping_name, t6.grouping_name) AS grouping_name, COALESCE(t5.definition_type, t6.definition_type) AS definition_type, COALESCE(t5.region, t6.region) AS region, COALESCE(t5.country, t6.country) AS country, COALESCE(t5.zone, t6.zone) AS zone, login_auth_cnt, login_sucess_cnt, logintime_cnt, logintime_total_cnt FROM (SELECT date_range, grouping_name, definition_type, region, country, zone, login_auth_cnt, login_sucess_cnt FROM match_info) AS t5 FULL JOIN (SELECT date_range, grouping_name, definition_type, region, country, zone, logintime_cnt, logintime_total_cnt FROM logintime_info) AS t6 ON t5.date_range = t6.date_range AND t5.grouping_name = t6.grouping_name AND t5.definition_type = t6.definition_type AND t5.country = t6.country AND t5.REGION = t6.REGION AND t5.zone = t6.zone) AS t4 ON t3.date_range = t4.date_range AND t3.grouping_name = t4.grouping_name AND t3.definition_type = t4.definition_type AND t3.country = t4.country AND t3.REGION = t4.REGION AND t3.zone = t4.zone FULL JOIN (SELECT date_range, grouping_name, definition_type, region, country, zone, loading_total_cnt, loading_cnt FROM loading_info) AS t7 ON t4.date_range = t7.date_range AND t4.grouping_name = t7.grouping_name AND t4.definition_type = t7.definition_type AND t4.country = t7.country AND t4.REGION = t7.REGION AND t4.zone = t7.zone

name: banlist生成测试服
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: dukezhang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-11-20 11:47:36.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH base_table AS (SELECT FLOOR(battlesvrid / 1000) AS battlegroup, bigranklvl, banhero, COUNT(1) AS num FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd > '2026-05-24' AND accountid > 100 AND fake_ai = 0 AND banhero > 0 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 22, 59, 90, 96, 97) GROUP BY FLOOR(battlesvrid / 1000), bigranklvl, banhero), grouped_table AS (SELECT base_table.battlegroup, base_table.bigranklvl, base_table.banhero, base_table.num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY base_table.bigranklvl, base_table.battlegroup ORDER BY base_table.num DESC) AS toprank FROM base_table), base_table_all AS (SELECT b.bigranklvl, b.banhero, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.bigranklvl ORDER BY b.num DESC) AS toprank, b.num FROM (SELECT bigranklvl, banhero, COUNT(1) AS num FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND accountid > 100 AND fake_ai = 0 AND banhero > 0 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 22, 59, 90, 96, 97) AND FLOOR(battlesvrid / 1000) IN (55, 56, 57, 59) GROUP BY bigranklvl, banhero) AS b GROUP BY b.bigranklvl, b.banhero, b.num), final_table_all AS (SELECT 'all' AS battlegroup, bigranklvl, COLLECT_LIST(banhero) AS coll_list, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(banhero)) AS o_c_battlegroup_bigranklvl_banpicklist_7d FROM base_table_all WHERE toprank <= 25 GROUP BY bigranklvl), final_battlegroup_table AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST(battlegroup AS STRING) AS battlegroup, bigranklvl, COLLECT_LIST(banhero) AS coll_list, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(banhero)) AS o_c_battlegroup_bigranklvl_banpicklist_7d FROM grouped_table WHERE toprank < 25 AND num > 1000 GROUP BY bigranklvl, battlegroup) WHERE SIZE(coll_list) > 20) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.aihero_ban_list_allenv_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', env = 'test') SELECT battlegroup, bigranklvl, CAST(o_c_battlegroup_bigranklvl_banpicklist_7d AS STRING) AS o_c_battlegroup_bigranklvl_banpicklist_7d FROM final_table_all UNION SELECT battlegroup, bigranklvl, CAST(o_c_battlegroup_bigranklvl_banpicklist_7d AS STRING) AS o_c_battlegroup_bigranklvl_banpicklist_7d FROM final_battlegroup_table

name: etl.ads_decismart_package_cube_di_mid
sql_units: WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, create_os AS os, COALESCE(first_network_name, 'unknown') AS network, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create, new_type, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS channel, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), dim_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 1 AS region_type, act_geo_continent AS region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 0 AS region_type, region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */), dim_basic_country AS (SELECT bas.roleid, bas.zoneid, bas.country, bas.network, register_date, COALESCE(con.region_type, 'unknwon') AS region_type, COALESCE(con.region, 'unknwon') AS region FROM basic AS bas LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con ON bas.country = con.country_code), downloadprocess /* 增量下载完成率 */ AS (SELECT tb4.logymd, tb4.accountid AS roleid, tb4.zoneid, CASE WHEN tb4.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, MAX(CASE WHEN (tb4.download_flag = 0 AND tb4.first_login_downloadprocess = 1) OR tb4.download_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_complete FROM (SELECT tb1.logymd, tb1.accountid, tb1.zoneid, tb1.download_flag, tb3.first_login_downloadprocess FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, MAX(downloadprocess) AS download_flag FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_loginloading_game WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND logymd >= '2021-04-14' /* AND     zoneid < 57000 */ GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid) AS tb1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT tb2.accountid, tb2.zoneid, tb2.first_login_downloadprocess FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, FIRST_VALUE(downloadprocess) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY `time`) AS first_login_downloadprocess FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_loginloading_game WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' /* 往后匹配2天 */) AS tb2 /* 玩家在匹配的2天内首次登录时的数据 */ WHERE first_login_downloadprocess = 1 /* 首次登录时增量下载完成 */ GROUP BY tb2.accountid, tb2.zoneid, tb2.first_login_downloadprocess) AS tb3 /* 在匹配的2天内首次登录时增量下载已完成的玩家 */ ON tb1.accountid = tb3.accountid AND tb1.zoneid = tb3.zoneid GROUP BY tb1.logymd, tb1.accountid, tb1.zoneid, tb1.download_flag, tb3.first_login_downloadprocess) AS tb4 GROUP BY tb4.logymd, tb4.accountid, tb4.zoneid, CASE WHEN tb4.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), download_info AS (SELECT '2026-05-29' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT zone IS NULL, 'zone', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(zone, '-10000') AS zone, CAST(MAP('user_download_login_cnt_1', user_download_login_cnt_1, 'user_download_login_cnt_2', user_download_login_cnt_2) AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>) AS user_download_login_cnt, CAST(MAP('user_storage_download_complete_cnt_1', user_storage_download_complete_cnt_1, 'user_storage_download_complete_cnt_2', user_storage_download_complete_cnt_2) AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>) AS user_storage_download_complete_cnt FROM (SELECT region_type, region, country, zone, SUM(user_download_login_cnt_1) AS user_download_login_cnt_1, SUM(user_download_login_cnt_2) AS user_download_login_cnt_2, SUM(user_storage_download_complete_cnt_1) AS user_storage_download_complete_cnt_1, SUM(user_storage_download_complete_cnt_2) AS user_storage_download_complete_cnt_2 FROM (SELECT dow1.region_type, COALESCE(region, 'unknown') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(zone, 'unknown') AS zone, IF(DATEDIFF(dow1.logymd, bas.register_date) <= 29 OR bas.register_date IS NULL, 1, 0) AS user_download_login_cnt_1, IF(DATEDIFF(dow1.logymd, bas.register_date) > 29, 1, 0) AS user_download_login_cnt_2, IF(DATEDIFF(dow1.logymd, bas.register_date) <= 29, is_complete, 0) AS user_storage_download_complete_cnt_1, IF(DATEDIFF(dow1.logymd, bas.register_date) > 29, is_complete, 0) AS user_storage_download_complete_cnt_2 FROM (SELECT 1 AS region_type, dow.logymd, roleid, zone, is_complete FROM downloadprocess AS dow UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS region_type, dow.logymd, roleid, zone, is_complete FROM downloadprocess AS dow) AS dow1 LEFT JOIN dim_basic_country AS bas ON bas.roleid = dow1.roleid AND bas.region_type = dow1.region_type) AS t1 GROUP BY region_type, CUBE (region, country, zone))), update_info AS (/* 更新耗时 */ SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT zone IS NULL, 'zone', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(zone, '-10000') AS zone, step40, step44 FROM (SELECT region_type, region, country, CASE WHEN b.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(max_step >= 40, (app_uuids, app_clickid), NULL)) AS step40, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(max_step >= 44, (app_uuids, app_clickid), NULL)) AS step44 FROM dim_basic_country AS bas JOIN (/* t, */ SELECT IF(app_uuid <> '', app_uuid, CONCAT(accountid, '_', zoneid, '_', ip)) AS app_uuids, app_clickid, accountid, zoneid, MAX(step_rank) AS max_step FROM (SELECT SPLIT(step_desc, '\\073')[1] AS step, CASE WHEN SPLIT(step_desc, '\\073')[1] = '1194' THEN 40 /* 下一步就是更新 */ WHEN SPLIT(step_desc, '\\073')[1] = '1020' THEN 41 WHEN SPLIT(step_desc, '\\073')[1] = '1021' THEN 42 WHEN SPLIT(step_desc, '\\073')[1] = '1022' THEN 43 WHEN SPLIT(step_desc, '\\073')[1] = '1074' THEN 44 ELSE NULL END AS step_rank, accountid, app_clickid, app_uuid, device_id AS deviceid, zoneid, ip FROM ml_ods.reportserver_client_loginv2_data WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2024-05-24') AS a WHERE NOT step_rank IS NULL GROUP BY app_uuids, app_clickid, accountid, zoneid) AS b ON bas.roleid = b.accountid GROUP BY region_type, CUBE (region, country, CASE WHEN b.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS t6), check_info AS (/* 检测时长 */ SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT zone IS NULL, 'zone', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(zone, '-10000') AS zone, check_duration_mid, check_duration_75 FROM (SELECT region_type, region, country, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, PERCENTILE(do_type, 0.5) AS check_duration_mid /* 增量检测时长中位数 */, PERCENTILE(do_type, 0.75) AS check_duration_75 /* 增量检测时长75分位数 */ FROM dim_basic_country AS bas JOIN ml_ods.connserver_client_resreport_checking AS a ON bas.roleid = a.accountid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2020-10-22' AND do_type <> 0 /* 排除异常值 */ GROUP BY region_type, CUBE (region, country, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS t8), check_info_new AS (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT zone IS NULL, 'zone', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(zone, '-10000') AS zone, cost_time_1 AS checking_step_1, cost_time_2 AS checking_step_2, cost_time_3 AS checking_step_3 FROM (SELECT zone /* -正式服测试服 */, country, region, region_type, AVG(IF(checking_step = 1, cost_time, NULL)) AS cost_time_1 /* checking_step, ---五步 */ /* 每个人每天可能多次检测 */, AVG(IF(checking_step = 2, cost_time, NULL)) AS cost_time_2, AVG(IF(checking_step = 3, cost_time, NULL)) AS cost_time_3 FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, country, region_type, region, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, checking_step, AVG(cost_time) AS cost_time FROM dim_basic_country AS bas JOIN ml_ods.connserver_client_reschecking AS a ON bas.roleid = a.accountid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND cost_time < 300000 /* 脏数据 */ AND ostype IN (1, 2) AND checking_status = 2 AND is_update_checking = 1 AND checking_step IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY logymd, accountid, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, checking_step, country, region_type, region) AS a GROUP BY region_type, CUBE (region, country, zone)) AS b), white_info AS (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT zone IS NULL, 'zone', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(zone, '-10000') AS zone, noreslv_num AS noreslv_cnt, num AS noreslv_total_cnt FROM (SELECT region_type, region, country, CASE WHEN c1.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c1.noresnum <> 0 THEN c1.accountid END) AS noreslv_num /* 统计遭遇白膜场次为0的用户 */, COUNT(DISTINCT c1.accountid) AS num FROM dim_basic_country AS bas JOIN (SELECT a1.accountid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.noresnum > 0 THEN a1.battleid END) AS noresnum /* -计算白膜的遭遇场次 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata AS a1 WHERE a1.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a1.logymd >= '2018-01-10' AND battleid > 100000000000 AND COALESCE(isbot, 0) = 0 GROUP BY a1.accountid, zoneid) AS c1 ON bas.roleid = c1.accountid GROUP BY region_type, CUBE (region, country, CASE WHEN c1.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS t5) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_decismart_package_cube_di_mid PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT COALESCE(t3.date_range, t4.date_range) AS date_range, COALESCE(t3.grouping_name, t4.grouping_name) AS grouping_name, COALESCE(t3.definition_type, t4.definition_type) AS definition_type, COALESCE(t3.region, t4.region) AS region, COALESCE(t3.country, t4.country) AS country, COALESCE(t3.zone, t4.zone) AS zone, IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-05-24', NULL, COALESCE(step40, 0)) AS step40_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-05-24', NULL, COALESCE(step44, 0)) AS step44_cnt, IF('2026-05-29' < '2021-04-14', NULL, COALESCE(user_download_login_cnt, CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>))) AS user_download_login_cnt, IF('2026-05-29' < '2021-04-14', NULL, COALESCE(user_storage_download_complete_cnt, CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>))) AS user_storage_download_complete_cnt, IF('2026-05-29' < '2021-04-14', NULL, COALESCE(storage_download_login_cnt, CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>))) AS storage_download_login_cnt, IF('2026-05-29' < '2021-04-14', NULL, COALESCE(storage_download_complete_cnt, CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>))) AS storage_download_complete_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2020-10-22', NULL, COALESCE(check_duration_mid, 0)) AS check_duration_mid, IF('2026-05-31' < '2020-10-22', NULL, COALESCE(check_duration_75, 0)) AS check_duration_75, IF('2026-05-31' < '2018-01-10', NULL, COALESCE(noreslv_cnt, 0)) AS noreslv_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2018-01-10', NULL, COALESCE(noreslv_total_cnt, 0)) AS noreslv_total_cnt, IF('2026-05-31' < '2018-01-10', NULL, COALESCE(checking_step_1, 0)) AS checking_step_1, IF('2026-05-31' < '2018-01-10', NULL, COALESCE(checking_step_2, 0)) AS checking_step_2, IF('2026-05-31' < '2018-01-10', NULL, COALESCE(checking_step_3, 0)) AS checking_step_3 FROM (SELECT COALESCE(t1.date_range, t2.date_range) AS date_range, COALESCE(t1.grouping_name, t2.grouping_name) AS grouping_name, COALESCE(t1.definition_type, t2.definition_type) AS definition_type, COALESCE(t1.region, t2.region) AS region, COALESCE(t1.country, t2.country) AS country, COALESCE(t1.zone, t2.zone) AS zone, step40, step44, user_download_login_cnt, user_storage_download_complete_cnt, storage_download_login_cnt, storage_download_complete_cnt FROM (SELECT date_range, grouping_name, definition_type, region, country, zone, step40, step44 FROM update_info) AS t1 FULL JOIN (SELECT date_range, grouping_name, definition_type, region, country, zone, user_download_login_cnt, user_storage_download_complete_cnt, NULL AS storage_download_login_cnt, NULL AS storage_download_complete_cnt FROM download_info) AS t2 ON t1.date_range = t2.date_range AND t1.grouping_name = t2.grouping_name AND t1.definition_type = t2.definition_type AND t1.country = t2.country AND t1.region = t2.region AND t1.zone = t2.zone) AS t3 FULL JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(t5.date_range, t6.date_range) AS date_range, COALESCE(t5.grouping_name, t6.grouping_name) AS grouping_name, COALESCE(t5.definition_type, t6.definition_type) AS definition_type, COALESCE(t5.region, t6.region) AS region, COALESCE(t5.country, t6.country) AS country, COALESCE(t5.zone, t6.zone) AS zone, NULL AS check_duration_mid, NULL AS check_duration_75, noreslv_cnt, noreslv_total_cnt, checking_step_1, checking_step_2, checking_step_3 FROM (SELECT date_range, grouping_name, definition_type, region, country, zone, checking_step_1, checking_step_2, checking_step_3 FROM check_info_new) AS t5 FULL JOIN (SELECT date_range, grouping_name, definition_type, region, country, zone, noreslv_cnt, noreslv_total_cnt FROM white_info) AS t6 ON t5.date_range = t6.date_range AND t5.grouping_name = t6.grouping_name AND t5.definition_type = t6.definition_type AND t5.country = t6.country AND t5.REGION = t6.REGION AND t5.zone = t6.zone) AS t4 ON t3.date_range = t4.date_range AND t3.grouping_name = t4.grouping_name AND t3.definition_type = t4.definition_type AND t3.country = t4.country AND t3.REGION = t4.REGION AND t3.zone = t4.zone

name: app_kol_trends_df
sql_units: WITH base AS (SELECT COUNT(1) AS num, COUNT(DISTINCT video_id) AS video_cnt, MAX(kol_name) AS kol_name, platform, MAX(kol_agent_name) AS kol_agent_name, MAX(nickname) AS nickname, MAX(country) AS country, MAX(creator_id) AS creator_id, MAX(creator_name) AS creator_name, account, business_area_id, MAX(business_area) AS business_area, MAX(cost) * COUNT(DISTINCT video_id) AS cost, SUBSTRING(publish_date, 1, 7) AS report_month, SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS(publish_date, 1), 1, 7) AS next_month, MAX(publish_date) AS last_publish_video_date, SUM(SUM_ARRAY(views_1_30_interval1_list)) AS monthly_published_video_views, SUM(cost / SUM_ARRAY(views_1_30_interval1_list) * 1000) AS video_cpm, MAX(cost) * COUNT(DISTINCT video_id) / SUM(SUM_ARRAY(views_1_30_interval1_list)) * 1000 AS cpm, MAX(kol_id) AS kol_id, MAX(kol_agent_id) AS kol_agent_id, MAX(kol_tag) AS kol_tag, app_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_ods_tubular_video_report_df)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND is_auto_pull = 1 AND cost > 0 /* 没有cost下面的档位信息不可计算，默认本月没有本月的数据 */ GROUP BY platform, account, business_area_id, SUBSTRING(publish_date, 1, 7), SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS(publish_date, 1), 1, 7), app_id), total_views AS (SELECT data_month, country, platform, CASE WHEN country = 'id' THEN 'ID 印尼' WHEN country = 'mm' THEN 'MM 缅甸' WHEN country = 'my' THEN 'MY 马来' WHEN country = 'ph' THEN 'PH 菲律宾' WHEN country = 'vn' THEN 'VN 越南' END AS business_area, CASE WHEN country = 'id' THEN 2 WHEN country = 'mm' THEN 4 WHEN country = 'my' THEN 3 WHEN country = 'ph' THEN 5 WHEN country = 'vn' THEN 31 END AS business_area_id, SUM(CASE WHEN game_id = '57955d280211a6718a000002' THEN total_views ELSE 0 END) AS total_monthly_views /* MLBB汇总数据 */, SUM(total_views) AS game_market_views /* 游戏大盘数据 */, '1001' AS app_id FROM adbi.dm_cockpit_game_sensortower_stats_new_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND data_month < SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) /* 剔除当月数据 */ AND country IN ('id', 'mm', 'my', 'ph', 'vn') AND NOT platform IS NULL GROUP BY data_month, country, platform), kol_30d_views AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(data_date, 1, 7) AS data_month, account, platform, business_area_id, SUM(`views`) AS monthly_views, app_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_app_kol_video_stats_df)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND is_auto_pull = 1 GROUP BY SUBSTRING(data_date, 1, 7), account, platform, business_area_id, app_id), tier AS (SELECT GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[0]'), '$.leftOperator') AS tier1_left_operator, DOUBLE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[0]'), '$.leftValue')) AS tier1_left_value, GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[0]'), '$.rightOperator') AS tier1_right_operator, DOUBLE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[0]'), '$.rightValue')) AS tier1_right_value, GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[1]'), '$.leftOperator') AS tier2_left_operator, DOUBLE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[1]'), '$.leftValue')) AS tier2_left_value, GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[1]'), '$.rightOperator') AS tier2_right_operator, DOUBLE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[1]'), '$.rightValue')) AS tier2_right_value, GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[2]'), '$.leftOperator') AS tier3_left_operator, DOUBLE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[2]'), '$.leftValue')) AS tier3_left_value, GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[2]'), '$.rightOperator') AS tier3_right_operator, DOUBLE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[2]'), '$.rightValue')) AS tier3_right_value, GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[3]'), '$.leftOperator') AS tier4_left_operator, DOUBLE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(tier_info, '$[3]'), '$.leftValue')) AS tier4_left_value, * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_ods_kol_tier_df)) WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' AND is_deleted = 0), kol_monthly_cost AS (SELECT account, platform, app_id, parsed.startDate, parsed.endDate, parsed.monthlyCost FROM (SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_ods_kol_creator_df)) WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' AND is_deleted = 0) AS t LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(FROM_JSON(t.past_monthly_cost, 'array<struct<startDate:string,endDate:string,monthlyCost:double>>')) e AS parsed) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_app_kol_trends_df)) SELECT a.kol_id, a.kol_name, a.platform, a.kol_agent_name, a.kol_agent_id, nickname, a.country, creator_id, creator_name, a.account, a.business_area, a.business_area_id, e.monthlyCost, a.monthly_published_video_views, c.monthly_views, b.total_monthly_views, a.video_cnt, a.video_cpm, a.cpm, a.last_publish_video_date, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.last_publish_video_date) >= 29, 1, 0) AS is_30d_published /* 0-29,30d */, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.last_publish_video_date) < 29 OR d.app_id IS NULL, 'Default' /* 不满足时间条件或者没关联上 */, CASE WHEN tier1_right_operator = '<' AND a.cpm < tier1_right_value THEN 'Tier1' WHEN tier1_right_operator = '<=' AND a.cpm <= tier1_right_value THEN 'Tier1' WHEN tier2_right_operator = '<' AND a.cpm < tier2_right_value THEN 'Tier2' WHEN tier2_right_operator = '<=' AND a.cpm <= tier2_right_value THEN 'Tier2' WHEN tier3_right_operator = '<' AND a.cpm < tier3_right_value THEN 'Tier3' WHEN tier3_right_operator = '<=' AND a.cpm <= tier3_right_value THEN 'Tier3' WHEN tier4_left_operator = '>' AND a.cpm > tier4_left_value THEN 'Tier4' WHEN tier4_left_operator = '>=' AND a.cpm >= tier4_left_value THEN 'Tier4' ELSE 'ERROR' END /* 满足时间条件，那一定会满足 */) AS tier, a.report_month, a.next_month, a.app_id, TO_JSON(a.kol_tag) AS kol_tag, b.game_market_views FROM base AS a JOIN kol_monthly_cost AS e ON a.app_id = e.app_id AND a.platform = e.platform AND a.account = e.account AND a.report_month >= e.startDate AND a.report_month <= e.endDate LEFT JOIN total_views AS b ON a.report_month = b.data_month AND a.business_area_id = b.business_area_id AND a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.platform = b.platform LEFT JOIN kol_30d_views AS c ON a.report_month = c.data_month AND a.business_area_id = c.business_area_id AND a.app_id = c.app_id AND a.platform = c.platform AND a.account = c.account LEFT JOIN tier AS d ON a.app_id = d.app_id AND a.platform = LOWER(d.platform) AND a.business_area_id = d.business_area_id AND a.report_month = d.effective_month UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS kol_id, '' AS kol_name, platform, '' AS kol_agent_name, 0 AS kol_agent_id, '' AS nickname, country, '' AS creator_id, '' AS creator_name, '' AS account, business_area, business_area_id, 0 AS cost, 0 AS monthly_published_video_views, 0 AS monthly_views, total_monthly_views, 0 AS video_cnt, 0 AS video_cpm, 0 AS cpm, '' AS last_publish_video_date, 1 AS is_30d_published, '' AS tier, data_month AS report_month, SUBSTRING(ADD_MONTHS(CONCAT(data_month, '-01'), 1), 1, 7) AS next_month, app_id, '' AS kol_tag, game_market_views FROM total_views WHERE NOT platform IN ('instagram', 'twitch', 'twitter')

name: 全民赛事6期夺冠留存周
output_hint: 全民赛事6期夺冠留存周
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.michaelhe_ap_remain PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* ---t+1留存人数 */ SELECT a1.weeks, single_level, losecnt, CASE WHEN b.roleid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_win /* t+1留存周 */, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.roleid, a2.zoneid) AS remain_users, COUNT(DISTINCT a1.roleid, a1.zoneid) AS users /* 留存人数 */ FROM (/* 实验组对照组 list */ SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, IF(param_value = '{"group_tag":"control"}', 'control', 'test') AS label, logymd, WEEKOFYEAR(logymd) AS weeks FROM ml_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE param_name = '20_AllPlayer_6' AND param_version IN ('1260', '1261') /* AND logymd BETWEEN '2024-08-12' AND '2024-05-18' */ AND logymd BETWEEN '2024-10-09' AND '2024-10-12') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT WEEKOFYEAR(logymd) AS weeks, roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN iswin = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losecnt, MIN(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(team_info, CONCAT(roleid, ':', zoneid, ':'))[1], ':')[1], '\\073')[0]) AS single_level FROM ml_ods.gameserver_allplayer_single_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-18' AND '2026-05-24' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY WEEKOFYEAR(logymd), roleid, zoneid) AS a1 ON a.roleid = a1.roleid AND a.zoneid = a1.zoneid AND a1.weeks >= a.weeks LEFT JOIN (SELECT WEEKOFYEAR(logymd) AS weeks, roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_allplayer_single_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY WEEKOFYEAR(logymd), roleid, zoneid) AS a2 ON a1.roleid = a2.roleid AND a1.zoneid = a2.zoneid AND a1.weeks + 1 = a2.weeks LEFT JOIN (SELECT WEEKOFYEAR(logymd) AS weeks, roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_allplayer_single_champion WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-18' AND '2026-05-24' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY WEEKOFYEAR(logymd), roleid, zoneid) AS b ON b.roleid = a1.roleid AND b.zoneid = a1.zoneid GROUP BY a1.weeks, single_level, losecnt, CASE WHEN b.roleid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

name: koc推荐规则召回一阶段
sql_units: WITH feature AS (SELECT *, IF(zoneid < 57000, 1, 0) AS env FROM mt_da.social_koc_rec_recall_feature_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), koc /* 每类提前过滤top20 */ /* WHERE   rn <= 20 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, env, bigranklvl, first_real_road, second_real_road, first_active_hour, second_active_hour, first_battle_group, second_battle_group, `level` FROM (SELECT x.roleid, x.zoneid, env, bigranklvl, first_real_road, second_real_road, first_active_hour, second_active_hour, first_battle_group, second_battle_group, `level` /* row_number() OVER( */ /*     PARTITION BY */ /*             env, */ /*             bigranklvl, */ /*             first_real_road, */ /*             nvl(second_real_road, -1), */ /*             first_active_hour, */ /*             nvl(second_active_hour, -1), */ /*             first_battle_group, */ /*             nvl(second_battle_group, -1) */ /*     ORDER BY */ /*             `level` DESC */ /* ) rn */ FROM feature AS x INNER JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_da.social_koc_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS y ON x.roleid = y.roleid AND x.zoneid = y.zoneid WHERE x.headtype = 1)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_da.social_koc_rec_recall_step_1 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, koc_roleid, koc_zoneid, koc_order FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.roleid AS koc_roleid, b.zoneid AS koc_zoneid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.zoneid ORDER BY b.level DESC) AS koc_order FROM feature AS a LEFT JOIN koc AS b ON a.roleid <> b.roleid AND a.env = b.env AND a.bigranklvl = b.bigranklvl AND a.first_real_road <> b.first_real_road AND a.first_real_road <> COALESCE(b.second_real_road, -1) AND COALESCE(a.second_real_road, -1) <> b.first_real_road AND COALESCE(a.second_real_road, -1) <> COALESCE(b.second_real_road, -2) /* 可以同时为null */ AND a.first_active_hour = b.first_active_hour AND COALESCE(a.second_active_hour, -1) = COALESCE(b.second_active_hour, -1) AND a.first_battle_group = b.first_battle_group AND COALESCE(a.second_battle_group, -1) = COALESCE(b.second_battle_group, -1) AND /* 根据一期数据实际等级分布和koc被推次数上限控制 */ /* AND     a.level >= b.level - 10 */ a.level BETWEEN 0.886849645 * b.level AND 1.921257066 * b.level) WHERE NOT koc_roleid IS NULL AND koc_order <= 20

name: adbi.dim_crowdpack_gaid_alg_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: willemwang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-11-14 15:33:23.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adbi.dim_crowdpack_gaid_alg_di ( */ /*     gaid STRING */ /* ) */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     crowdpack_id STRING, */ /*     `p_date` STRING */ /* ) */ /* ROW FORMAT DELIMITED */ /* FIELDS TERMINATED BY ',' */ /* STORED AS TEXTFILE */ /* LOCATION 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/advertisement_bi/adbi/dim_crowdpack_gaid_alg_di'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dim_crowdpack_gaid_alg_di PARTITION(crowdpack_id, p_date) SELECT a.gps_adid AS gaid, b.crowdpack_id, '2026-05-30' AS p_date FROM adbi.dim_account_gps_adid AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT accountid AS account_id, crowdpack_id FROM adbi.dim_crowdpack_account_zone_alg_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND channel = 'ace' GROUP BY accountid, crowdpack_id) AS b ON a.accountid = b.account_id WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-30' AND app_id = '1001' GROUP BY a.gps_adid, b.crowdpack_id

Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* ---沐瞳 to 字节di表 */ WITH new_user AS (SELECT TO_DATE(logymd, 'yyyyMMdd') AS logymd, did, role_id AS roleid, zone_id AS zoneid FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE logymd = '20260531' AND app_id = 4280 AND event = 'create_role'), mpass_bind /* ---通行证绑定 */ AS (SELECT logymd, SUBSTRING(TIME, 1, 19) AS TIME, accountid, account_name, email, cur_country, cur_deviceid, cur_deviceunique_id, SUBSTRING(account_name, 4, 100) AS mtid FROM mcgg_ods.accountserver_account_bind WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), did_roles /* -------did是否多开 */ AS (SELECT CAST(logymd AS STRING) AS usercreateymd, CAST(role_id AS INT) AS role_id, CAST(zone_id AS INT) AS zone_id, cnt_type FROM (SELECT TO_DATE(a1.logymd, 'yyyyMMdd') AS logymd, a1.did, CASE WHEN cnt = 1 THEN 1 WHEN cnt = 2 THEN 2 WHEN cnt > 2 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS cnt_type, a1.role_id, a1.zone_id FROM (SELECT logymd, did, role_id, zone_id FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE logymd = '20260531' AND app_id = 4280 AND event = 'create_role') AS a1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, did, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(role_id, zone_id)) AS cnt FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE logymd = '20260531' AND app_id = 4280 AND event = 'create_role' GROUP BY logymd, did) AS a2 ON a1.logymd = a2.logymd AND a1.did = a2.did) AS b1), first_battle_begin AS (SELECT 'bettle_begin_1' AS guide_mode, '1000_1' AS step_key /* 引导步骤唯一识别码 */, zoneid, accountid AS roleid, '1000' AS stepid, '1' AS substepid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_begin /* ---第一场battle_begin */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 20000 AND pvptype = 39 AND usercreateymd = logymd /* 创角当天 */ /* -AND     battle_count = 1 */ GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid), first_battle_end AS (SELECT 'bettle_end_1' AS guide_mode, '1000_2' AS step_key /* 引导步骤唯一识别码 */, zoneid, accountid AS roleid, '1000' AS stepid, '2' AS substepid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end /* ---第一场battle_end */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 20000 AND pvptype = 39 AND usercreateymd = logymd /* 创角当天 */ /* -AND     battle_count = 1 */ GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid), bind_info AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(MIN(TIME), 1, 19) AS TIME, ml_asset_detail, coin_detail, CASE WHEN mlroleid = 0 THEN mlzoneid ELSE mlroleid END AS mlroleid, mlzoneid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_asset_transfer_bind_complete WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, ml_asset_detail, coin_detail, logymd, mlroleid, mlzoneid), user_full_info AS (SELECT t1.logymd AS usercreateymd, t1.roleid AS mc_roleid, t1.zoneid AS mc_zoneid, IF(NOT t3.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_bind, t3.time AS bind_time, t4.cnt_type, t7.mlroleid AS ml_roleid, t7.mlzoneid AS ml_zoneid FROM new_user AS t1 LEFT JOIN mpass_bind AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.accountid AND t1.logymd = t3.logymd LEFT JOIN did_roles AS t4 ON t1.roleid = t4.role_id AND t1.zoneid = t4.zone_id AND t1.logymd = t4.usercreateymd LEFT JOIN first_battle_begin AS t5 ON t1.roleid = t5.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t5.zoneid AND t1.logymd = t5.logymd LEFT JOIN first_battle_end AS t6 ON t1.roleid = t6.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t6.zoneid AND t1.logymd = t6.logymd LEFT JOIN bind_info AS t7 ON t1.roleid = t7.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t7.zoneid AND t1.logymd = t7.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, mt_id, bind_mt_email, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_third_party_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS c /* --mlroleid */ ON t3.mtid = c.mt_id WHERE NOT t3.accountid IS NULL AND t5.roleid IS NULL AND t6.roleid IS NULL AND NOT t7.mlroleid IS NULL GROUP BY t1.logymd, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, IF(NOT t3.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0), t3.time, t4.cnt_type, t7.mlroleid, t7.mlzoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.mc2_abnml_newuser_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT usercreateymd, mc_roleid, mc_zoneid, ml_roleid, ml_zoneid, bind_time FROM user_full_info

8 * 3600 * 1000) / 1000 AS BIGINT) DIV 300 * 300)              AS div_time */, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.day_point') AS day_point, IF(LOWER(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.country')) = '-', 'unknown', LOWER(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.country'))) AS country, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.online_num') AS online_num, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.vp_online_num') AS vp_online_num, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.time') AS time, FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST((GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.time') - 8 * 3600) AS BIGINT) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time /*  , CAST(NVL((GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.online_num'),0) - */ /*          GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.vp_online_num')) AS INT)                                   AS real_online_num */, CAST(COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.online_num'), 0) - COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.vp_online_num'), 0) AS BIGINT) AS real_online_num, FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST((GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.time') - 8 * 3600) AS BIGINT), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS logymd, app_id /* FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event ad */ FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* BETWEEN REPLACE(date_sub('2026-05-31',1), '-', '') AND REPLACE(date_add('2026-05-31',1), '-', '') */ ((app_id IN (4280, 4310) AND event IN ('t_real_os_country_online')) OR /* AND ( */ /*         (app_id in (4300) AND event IN ('t_real_os_online')  */ /*                 AND  ( */ /*                         ('2026-05-31' >= '2025-03-27' and cast(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') as bigint) NOT BETWEEN 9995 AND 9999 AND cast(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') as bigint) NOT BETWEEN  29995 AND 29999)) */ /*                     OR  ('2026-05-31' between  '2024-09-18' AND '2024-11-01' and cast(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') as bigint) != 10005) */ /*                     OR  ('2026-05-31' between  '2024-11-02' AND '2025-03-26') */ /* AND cast(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') as bigint) NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 */ /* AND cast(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') as bigint) NOT BETWEEN 29000 AND 29999 */ /* ) */ /* OR  (app_id = 4200 AND event IN ('t_real_os_online') AND */ /*         FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST((GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.time') - 8 * 3600) AS BIGINT), 'yyyy-MM-dd') < '2025-01-21' */ /*     ) */ /* OR  (app_id = 4200 AND event IN ('t_real_os_country_online') AND */ /*         FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST((GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.time') - 8 * 3600) AS BIGINT), 'yyyy-MM-dd') >= '2025-01-21' */ /*     ) */ /* nova上线后会切换appid, 对应的事件是t_real_os_online */ (app_id = 4400 AND event IN ('t_real_os_online') AND FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST((GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.time') - 8 * 3600) AS BIGINT), 'yyyy-MM-dd') >= '2025-06-25' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST((GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.time') - 8 * 3600) AS BIGINT), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31' AND (GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 /* 亚太 */ OR GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 /* 亚太 */ OR GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 /* 欧洲 */ OR GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 /* 美国 */)))) AS t), t_base AS (SELECT app_id, logymd, IF(TRIM(country) = '', 'unknown', TRIM(country)) AS country, CAST(point AS INT) AS point, SUM(real_online_num) AS online_num FROM t_online_info WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-31' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY CAST(point AS INT), logymd, IF(TRIM(country) = '', 'unknown', TRIM(country)), app_id), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03', '2025-01-03', '2026-05-31') AND (appid IN (4200, 4280, 4310) OR ('2026-05-31' >= '2025-06-25' AND appid = 4400 /* ob之后有正式数据 */))) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_msdk_realtime_online` PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT point, country, '' AS network, 'country' AS grouping_name, online_num /* 分区 */, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'daily' AS date_type FROM (SELECT t_incr.point /*   t_incr.logymd */, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_base.online_num, 0) AS online_num, t_incr.appname FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_base ON t_base.point = t_incr.point AND t_base.country = t_incr.country AND t_base.app_id = t_incr.appid) AS t1

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_realtime_charge_daily_msdk
sql_units: /* ALTER table `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_msdk_realtime_charge` drop IF EXISTS PARTITION (logymd='2026-05-31'); */ WITH t_basic AS (SELECT app_id, account_id, first_mt_country FROM (SELECT app_id, account_id, LOWER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY createtime) AS rn FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-10-14', '2024-10-14', '2026-05-31') AND app_id IN (4200, 4280, 4310)) AS t WHERE rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT app_id, account_id, first_mt_country FROM (SELECT appid AS app_id, roleid AS account_id, LOWER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY appid, roleid ORDER BY createtime) AS rn FROM (SELECT appid, roleid, first_mt_country, createtime FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-06-25', '2025-06-25', '2026-05-31') AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND createdate >= '2025-06-25' AND appid = 4400 /* nova ob appid */ AND (zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 /* 亚太 */ OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 /* 亚太 */ OR zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 /* 欧洲 */ OR zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 /* 美国 */) UNION ALL SELECT app_id, roleid AS account_id, 'unknown' AS first_mt_country, '9999-99-99' AS createtime FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND /* AND     (zoneid NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 */ /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 29000 AND 29999 */ /* AND     app_id in (4110,4210,4300,4260)) */ (app_id = 4400 AND (zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999))) AS t1) AS t2 WHERE rn = 1), t_pay AS (SELECT logymd, point, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, t2.app_id, SUM(price) AS point_amt FROM (SELECT *, LEAST(287, (HOUR(`time`) * 3600 + MINUTE(`time`) * 60 + SECOND(`time`)) DIV 300) AS point FROM (SELECT role_id, event_time, event, logymd, server_time, price, FROM_UNIXTIME((event_time - 8 * 3600 * 1000) / 1000) AS time, app_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('purchase_event', '__purchase_event__', '__purchase_deliver_event__') /* 投放重构充值接口__purchase_deliver_event__ 发货 __purchase_verify_event__ 校验 __purchase_refund_event__ 退款 */ AND purchase_type IN ('1', '3', '4') /* "支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test 3. Promo4. Rewarded" */ AND step = 'STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER' /* "表示支付流程到了第几步：校验STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_VERIFY发货STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER,暂时只有发货的步骤" */ AND result_code IN (22000, 13000) AND /* AND (app_id in (4200,4310) */ /*         OR (app_id = 4300 AND (zone_id NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 AND zone_id NOT BETWEEN  29000 AND 29999)) */ /*     ) */ (app_id IN (4200, 4310) OR /* OR  ( */ /*     app_id = 4300 AND ('2026-05-31' >= '2025-03-27' and zone_id NOT BETWEEN 9995 AND 9999 AND zone_id NOT BETWEEN  29995 AND 29999) */ /*     ) */ /* OR ( */ /*     app_id = 4300 AND ('2026-05-31' between  '2024-09-18' AND '2024-11-01' and zone_id != 10005) */ /*     ) */ /* OR  ( */ /*     app_id = 4300 AND ('2026-05-31' between  '2024-11-02' AND '2025-03-26') */ /*     ) */ (app_id = 4400 AND ('2026-05-31' >= '2025-06-25') /* nova_ob */ AND (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 /* 亚太 */ OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 /* 亚太 */ OR zone_id BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 /* 欧洲 */ OR zone_id BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 /* 美国 */) /* 限制区服 */)) UNION ALL SELECT role_id, event_time, event, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, server_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.money') AS price, FROM_UNIXTIME((event_time - 8 * 3600 * 1000) / 1000) AS time, app_id FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE ((logymd = '20260530' AND `hour` >= '23') /* -eg 2022-05-01号的eventtime数据会在server_time:[2022-04-30 23:00 2022-05-02 02:00]区间获取 */ OR (logymd = '20260531') OR (logymd = '20260601' AND `hour` <= '02')) AND DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8')) = DATE('2026-05-31') AND (NOT `event` IS NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(`event`)) > 1) /* event不需要为空字符或为空, 理论上在msdk上报的时候控制好了的 */ AND app_id = 4280 AND event = 'chargeMC') AS t) AS t2 LEFT JOIN t_basic ON t2.role_id = t_basic.account_id AND t2.app_id = t_basic.app_id WHERE (NOT t2.app_id IN (4400) OR (t2.app_id IN (4400) AND NOT t_basic.account_id IS NULL)) GROUP BY logymd, point, t2.app_id, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') HAVING point_amt > 0), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid, '2026-05-31' AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-04', '2025-01-04', '2026-05-31') AND /*   AND appid in (4200,4280,4310,4300) */ (appid IN (4200, 4280, 4310) OR ('2026-05-31' >= '2025-06-25' AND appid = 4400 /* ob之后有正式数据 */))) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_decismart_msdk_realtime_charge PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT point, country, '' AS network, point_cnt, SUM(point_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, country, appname ORDER BY point) AS day_cnt, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'daily' AS date_type FROM (SELECT t_incr.logymd, t_incr.point, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_pay.point_amt, 0) AS point_cnt /*   , COALESCE(t_login_base.day_cnt, 0)              AS day_cnt */, t_incr.appname /*  FROM t_login_base */ /*           FULL JOIN t_incr */ FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_pay ON t_incr.country = t_pay.country AND t_incr.point = t_pay.point AND t_incr.appid = t_pay.app_id) AS t1 /* order by logymd, point, point_cnt descappid */
