sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: achingzhu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-12-10 17:17:07.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH new_koc AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_da.social_koc_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), old_koc AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_da.social_koc_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), new_single AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_da.social_solo_player_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), old_single AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_da.social_solo_player_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_da.social_koc_single_player_tag_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, 1 AS o_u_is_koc, 0 AS o_u_is_single_player FROM new_koc UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, 0 AS o_u_is_koc, 1 AS o_u_is_single_player FROM new_single UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, 0 AS o_u_is_koc, 0 AS o_u_is_single_player FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM old_koc EXCEPT SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM new_koc) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, 0 AS o_u_is_koc, 0 AS o_u_is_single_player FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM old_single EXCEPT SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM new_single)

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_qdes_role_zone_df
sql_units: /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `mt_dwd`.`dwd_qdes_role_zone_df`( */ /*     `roleid` decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '角色ID', */ /*     `zoneid` bigint COMMENT '分区ID', */ /*     `project_id` string COMMENT '问卷ID', */ /*     `created_dt` string COMMENT '问卷创建时间', */ /*     `account_register_date` string COMMENT '账号创建日期', */ /*     `register_date` string COMMENT '角色创建日期', */ /*     `answer_single` string COMMENT '单选答案', */ /*     `answer_multiple` string COMMENT '多选答案', */ /*     `finish_time` string COMMENT '问卷填答时间', */ /*     `answer_duration` bigint COMMENT '问卷填答时长' */ /* ) COMMENT '问卷答案明细df' */ /* PARTITIONED BY(`appid` string COMMENT '项目id', `logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区yyyy-MM-dd') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dwd/table/dwd_qdes_role_zone_df' */ /* set spark.sql.mapKeyDedupPolicy=LAST_WIN; */ WITH qdes_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, project_id, created_dt, account_register_date, register_date, answer_single, answer_multiple, finish_time, answer_duration, appid, updated_dt, seq FROM mt_dwd.dwd_qdes_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'ml'), qdes_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, project_id, created_dt, account_register_date, register_date, answer_single, answer_multiple, finish_time, answer_duration, appid, updated_dt, seq FROM mt_dwd.dwd_qdes_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'ml'), qdes_all AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY appid, project_id, roleid, zoneid ORDER BY created_dt ASC, updated_dt ASC) AS rn_asc FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, project_id, created_dt, account_register_date, register_date, answer_single, answer_multiple, finish_time, answer_duration, appid, updated_dt, seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY appid, project_id, roleid, zoneid, seq ORDER BY created_dt DESC, updated_dt DESC) AS rn_desc FROM (SELECT * FROM qdes_df UNION ALL SELECT * FROM qdes_di) AS x) AS tmp WHERE rn_desc = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_qdes_role_zone_df PARTITION(appid = 'ml', logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.project_id, created_dt, account_register_date, register_date, answer_single, answer_multiple, finish_time, answer_duration, updated_dt, seq /* seq_cnt, */ /* rn_desc, */ /* rn_asc, */ /* IF((nvl(seq_cnt,0) = 1 AND nvl(rn_desc,0) = 1) OR (nvl(seq_cnt,0) > 1 AND nvl(rn_asc,0) = 1), 1, 0) AS flag */ FROM qdes_all AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT appid, roleid, zoneid, project_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(project_id, CAST(seq AS STRING))) AS seq_cnt FROM qdes_all GROUP BY appid, roleid, zoneid, project_id) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.project_id = b.project_id AND a.appid = b.appid WHERE IF((COALESCE(seq_cnt, 0) = 1 AND COALESCE(rn_desc, 0) = 1) OR (COALESCE(seq_cnt, 0) > 1 AND COALESCE(rn_asc, 0) = 1), 1, 0) = 1

name: 每日推荐阵容判断_role_battle
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_hjli@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-12-10 15:59:35.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH hero /*  join */ /* (select max(logymd) as logymd from mcgg_temp.mcgg_recomd_hero_map_dim  where logymd between '20260528' and '20260531' ) b on a.logymd =b.logymd */ /* and a.logymd >'20260528' */ AS (SELECT recommend_id, SPLIT(hero_id_list, ',') AS hero_list_rec FROM mcgg_temp.mcgg_recomd_hero_map_dim AS a WHERE logymd BETWEEN '20260530' AND '20260531' GROUP BY recommend_id, SPLIT(hero_id_list, ',')), battleinfo AS (/* ---取最后一次使用的推荐阵容 */ SELECT a.logymd, accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.battlerank, a.time, userecommendline, SUBSTRING_INDEX(userecommendline, '/', -1) AS recmdid, hero_list_rec, chessinfo, REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(REPLACE(chessinfo, '\\073', '~'), '(^|~)(\\d+),', 2) AS heroid, rankid, bigranklv, a.level, a.battle_round FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew AS a LEFT JOIN hero AS b ON SUBSTRING_INDEX(userecommendline, '/', -1) = b.recommend_id LEFT JOIN mcgg_ods.gameserver_chessmode_warm_v2_battle_end AS c ON a.accountid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30') AND c.logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30') AND a.battleid = c.battleid WHERE a.logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30') AND ailevel = 0 AND (c.warm_score IS NULL OR (a.battle_count > 3 AND c.warm_score > 6000)) GROUP BY a.logymd, accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.time, a.battlerank, userecommendline, SUBSTRING_INDEX(userecommendline, '/', -1), hero_list_rec, chessinfo, rankid, bigranklv, a.level, a.battle_round), battle AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, battlerank, time, userecommendline, recmdid, hero_list_rec, chessinfo, heroid, ARRAY_INTERSECT(heroid, hero_list_rec) AS intersect_hero, IF((SIZE(ARRAY_INTERSECT(heroid, hero_list_rec)) / SIZE(heroid)) > 0.66, 1, 0) AS if_recomd, LAG(CASE WHEN userecommendline <> '0' THEN recmdid END) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time ASC) AS last_recmdid /* ,lag(time) over(PARTITION BY accountid,zoneid ORDER BY time asc ) as last_time */, rankid, bigranklv, level, battle_round FROM battleinfo) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.mcgg_recomd_hero_map PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, userecommendline, recmdid, hero_list_rec, heroid, intersect_hero, if_recomd, last_recmdid, battlerank, battle_round, rankid, bigranklv, level, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) AS time_stamp, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM time) AS time_hour, CASE WHEN userecommendline = '0' THEN 'no_use' WHEN recmdid = '0' THEN 'user_defined' ELSE recmdid END AS recomd_type FROM battle WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_mgbi_primary_cube_di_account_mlbb_daily
sql_units: WITH account_basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, zoneid DIV 1000 AS big_zone, first_mt_country AS country, create_os AS os, IF(LOWER(first_network_name) = 'organic', 1, 2) AS network_group, first_network_name AS network, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create, new_type /* new_type = 3  纯净新增 */, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS channel, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), register_account AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1 AND IF(register_date <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0)), active_all_account AS (SELECT roleid, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_td, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_7d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-18' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_14d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_30d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS is_1_7d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS is_1_30d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', day_login_duration, 0)) AS online_dur, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-24', 1, 0)) AS is_7ds /* 7日前是否活跃 */, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-01', 1, 0)) AS is_30ds /* 30日前是否活跃 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid), account_pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, SUM(product_money) AS pay_amt, SUM(before_tax_usd_amt) AS pay_amt_exrate FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid), account_pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, MIN(logymd) AS his_first_pay_date, MAX(logymd) AS his_last_pay_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid), role_basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, zoneid DIV 1000 AS big_zone, first_mt_country AS country, create_os AS os, IF(LOWER(first_network_name) = 'organic', 1, 2) AS network_group, first_network_name AS network, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create, new_type /* new_type = 3  纯净新增 */, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS channel, logymd FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid DIV 1000, roleid ORDER BY register_date) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0) WHERE rn = 1 /* 取大区内首个角色的属性 */), register_role AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, zoneid DIV 1000 AS big_zone, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1 AND IF(register_date <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0)), active_all_role AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid DIV 1000 AS big_zone, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_td, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_7d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-18' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_14d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_30d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS is_1_7d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS is_1_30d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', day_login_duration, 0)) AS online_dur, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-24', 1, 0)) AS is_7ds /* 7日前是否活跃 */, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-01', 1, 0)) AS is_30ds /* 30日前是否活跃 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid DIV 1000), role_pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid DIV 1000 AS big_zone, SUM(product_money) AS pay_amt, SUM(before_tax_usd_amt) AS pay_amt_exrate FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid DIV 1000), role_pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid DIV 1000 AS big_zone, MIN(logymd) AS his_first_pay_date, MAX(logymd) AS his_last_pay_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid DIV 1000) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_mgbi_primary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range /*	日期区间 */, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT big_zone IS NULL, 'big_zone', NULL), IF(NOT channel IS NULL, 'channel', NULL), IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT network IS NULL, 'network', NULL), IF(NOT os IS NULL, 'os', NULL)) /* IF(region IS NOT NULL, 'region', NULL) */, ')') AS grouping_name /*	cube唯一键 */, 1 AS definition_type, 'all' AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country /*	国家 */, COALESCE(os, 'all') AS os /*	创角平台 */, -10000 AS network_group, COALESCE(network, 'all') AS network /*	首次广告归因渠道 */, COALESCE(big_zone, -10000) AS big_zone /*	大区 */, COALESCE(channel, 'all') AS channel /*	登录渠道 */, COALESCE(register_cnt, 0) AS register_cnt /*	新增玩家数 */, COALESCE(organic_register_cnt, 0) AS organic_register_cnt /*	自然新增玩家数 */, COALESCE(register_cnt_total, 0) AS register_cnt_total /*	累计新增人数 */, COALESCE(pure_register_cnt, 0) AS pure_register_cnt /*	纯净新增玩家数 */, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt /*	活跃玩家数 */, COALESCE(online_dur, 0) AS online_dur /*	在线时长 */, COALESCE(active_cnt_7days, 0) AS active_cnt_7days /*	近7日活跃玩家数 */, COALESCE(active_cnt_14days, 0) AS active_cnt_14days /*	近14日活跃玩家数 */, COALESCE(active_cnt_30days, 0) AS active_cnt_30days /*	近30日活跃玩家数 */, COALESCE(new_active_cnt, 0) AS new_active_cnt /*	新用户活跃玩家数 */, COALESCE(old_active_cnt, 0) AS old_active_cnt, COALESCE(pay_active_cnt, 0) AS pay_active_cnt /*	付费活跃玩家数 */, COALESCE(new_pay_cnt, 0) AS new_pay_cnt /*	新增付费玩家数 */, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt /*	付费玩家数 */, COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt /*	付费金额(美分) */, COALESCE(pay_cnt_1usd_amt, 0) AS pay_cnt_1usd_amt /*	大于1美金付费人数 */, COALESCE(pay_cnt_1usd_exrate, 0) AS pay_cnt_1usd_exrate /*	大于1美金付费人数(税率校准金额) */, COALESCE(pay_amt_exrate, 0) AS pay_amt_exrate /*	汇率校准付费金额 */, COALESCE(recurring_cnt_30days, 0) AS recurring_cnt_30days /*	30日回流玩家数 */, COALESCE(nologin_cnt_30days, 0) AS nologin_cnt_30days /*	30日未登录玩家数 */, COALESCE(recurring_cnt_7days, 0) AS recurring_cnt_7days /*	7日回流玩家数 */, COALESCE(nologin_cnt_7days, 0) AS nologin_cnt_7days /*	7日未登录玩家数 */, COALESCE(active_pay_30d_cnt, 0) AS active_pay_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且最近30天内充值过的玩家 */, COALESCE(active_register_pay_30d_cnt, 0) AS active_register_pay_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且新增第30天且30天内充值过的玩家 */, COALESCE(active_register_30d_cnt, 0) AS active_register_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且新增第30天的玩家 */, COALESCE(lose_cnt_7ds, 0) AS lose_cnt_7ds /*	7日流失玩家数 */, COALESCE(active_cnt_7ds, 0) AS active_cnt_7ds /*	7日前DAU */, COALESCE(lose_cnt_30ds, 0) AS lose_cnt_30ds /*	30日流失玩家数 */, COALESCE(active_cnt_30ds, 0) AS active_cnt_30ds /*	30日前DAU  */, COALESCE(register_cnt, 0) AS register_cnt_include57 /*	新增玩家数 */, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt_include57 /*	活跃玩家数 */, COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt_include57 /*	付费金额(美分) */, COALESCE(pay_amt_exrate, 0) AS pay_exrate_include57 /*	汇率校准付费金额 */, COALESCE(recurring_cnt_30days, 0) AS recurring_cnt_30days_include57 /*	30日回流玩家数  */, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt_period, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt_period FROM (SELECT bas.country, bas.os, bas.network, NULL AS big_zone, bas.channel, SUM(IF(reg.register_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS register_cnt /* 新增玩家数 */, SUM(IF(reg.register_date = '2026-05-31' AND network = 'organic', 1, 0)) AS organic_register_cnt /* 自然新增玩家数 */, COUNT(*) AS register_cnt_total /* 总注册人数 */, SUM(IF(reg.register_date = '2026-05-31' AND bas.new_type = 3, 1, 0)) AS pure_register_cnt /* 纯净新增玩家数 */, SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1, 1, 0)) AS active_cnt /* dau */, SUM(IF(act.is_7d = 1, 1, 0)) AS active_cnt_7days, SUM(IF(act.is_14d = 1, 1, 0)) AS active_cnt_14days, SUM(IF(act.is_30d = 1, 1, 0)) AS active_cnt_30days, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt > 0, 1, 0)) AS pay_cnt /* 付费玩家数 */, SUM(IF(NOT pay_df.roleid IS NULL AND act.is_td = 1, 1, 0)) AS pay_active_cnt /* 付费活跃玩家数 */, SUM(IF(pay_df.his_first_pay_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS new_pay_cnt /* -新增付费玩家数 */, SUM(pay_di.pay_amt) AS pay_amt, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 99, 1, 0)) AS pay_cnt_1usd_amt, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt_exrate >= 99, 1, 0)) AS pay_cnt_1usd_exrate, SUM(pay_di.pay_amt_exrate) AS pay_amt_exrate, SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1 AND act.is_1_30d <> 1 AND bas.register_date < '2026-05-01', 1, 0)) AS recurring_cnt_30days, SUM(IF(bas.register_date <= '2026-04-30' AND COALESCE(act.is_1_30d, 0) = 0, 1, 0)) AS nologin_cnt_30days, SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1 AND act.is_1_7d <> 1 AND bas.register_date < '2026-05-24', 1, 0)) AS recurring_cnt_7days, SUM(IF(bas.register_date <= '2026-05-24' AND COALESCE(act.is_1_7d, 0) = 0, 1, 0)) AS nologin_cnt_7days, SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1 AND pay_df.his_last_pay_date BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS active_pay_30d_cnt, SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1 AND bas.register_date = '2026-05-02' AND pay_df.his_last_pay_date BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS active_register_pay_30d_cnt, SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1 AND bas.register_date = '2026-05-02', 1, 0)) AS active_register_30d_cnt, SUM(IF(bas.register_date >= '2026-05-02' AND bas.register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND act.is_td = 1, 1, 0)) AS new_active_cnt, SUM(IF(bas.register_date <= '2026-05-01' AND act.is_td = 1, 1, 0)) AS old_active_cnt, SUM(act.online_dur) AS online_dur, SUM(IF(act.is_7ds = 1 AND act.is_7d = 0, 1, 0)) AS lose_cnt_7ds, SUM(IF(act.is_7ds = 1, 1, 0)) AS active_cnt_7ds, SUM(IF(act.is_30ds = 1 AND act.is_30d = 0, 1, 0)) AS lose_cnt_30ds, SUM(IF(act.is_30ds = 1, 1, 0)) AS active_cnt_30ds FROM account_basic AS bas LEFT JOIN register_account AS reg ON bas.roleid = reg.roleid LEFT JOIN active_all_account AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid LEFT JOIN account_pay_di AS pay_di ON bas.roleid = pay_di.roleid LEFT JOIN account_pay_df AS pay_df ON bas.roleid = pay_df.roleid GROUP BY bas.country, bas.os, bas.network, bas.channel WITH CUBE UNION ALL SELECT bas.country, bas.os, bas.network, bas.big_zone, bas.channel, SUM(IF(reg.register_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS register_cnt /* 新增玩家数 */, SUM(IF(reg.register_date = '2026-05-31' AND network = 'organic', 1, 0)) AS organic_register_cnt, COUNT(*) AS register_cnt_total /* 总注册人数 */, SUM(IF(reg.register_date = '2026-05-31' AND bas.new_type = 3, 1, 0)) AS pure_register_cnt /* 纯净新增玩家数 */, SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1, 1, 0)) AS active_cnt /* dau */, SUM(IF(act.is_7d = 1, 1, 0)) AS active_cnt_7days, SUM(IF(act.is_14d = 1, 1, 0)) AS active_cnt_14days, SUM(IF(act.is_30d = 1, 1, 0)) AS active_cnt_30days, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt > 0, 1, 0)) AS pay_cnt /* 付费玩家数 */, SUM(IF(NOT pay_df.roleid IS NULL AND act.is_td = 1, 1, 0)) AS pay_active_cnt /* 付费活跃玩家数 */, SUM(IF(pay_df.his_first_pay_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS new_pay_cnt /* -新增付费玩家数 */, SUM(pay_di.pay_amt) AS pay_amt, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 99, 1, 0)) AS pay_cnt_1usd_amt, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt_exrate >= 99, 1, 0)) AS pay_cnt_1usd_exrate, SUM(pay_di.pay_amt_exrate) AS pay_amt_exrate, SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1 AND act.is_1_30d <> 1 AND bas.register_date <= '2026-05-01', 1, 0)) AS recurring_cnt_30days, SUM(IF(bas.register_date <= '2026-04-30' AND COALESCE(act.is_1_30d, 0) = 0, 1, 0)) AS nologin_cnt_30days, SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1 AND act.is_1_7d <> 1 AND bas.register_date <= '2026-05-24', 1, 0)) AS recurring_cnt_7days, SUM(IF(bas.register_date <= '2026-05-24' AND COALESCE(act.is_1_7d, 0) = 0, 1, 0)) AS nologin_cnt_7days, SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1 AND pay_df.his_last_pay_date BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS active_pay_30d_cnt, SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1 AND bas.register_date = '2026-05-02' AND pay_df.his_last_pay_date BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS active_register_pay_30d_cnt, SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1 AND bas.register_date = '2026-05-02', 1, 0)) AS active_register_30d_cnt, SUM(IF(bas.register_date >= '2026-05-02' AND bas.register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND act.is_td = 1, 1, 0)) AS new_active_cnt, SUM(IF(bas.register_date <= '2026-05-01' AND act.is_td = 1, 1, 0)) AS old_active_cnt, SUM(act.online_dur) AS online_dur, SUM(IF(act.is_7ds = 1 AND act.is_7d = 0, 1, 0)) AS lose_cnt_7ds, SUM(IF(act.is_7ds = 1, 1, 0)) AS active_cnt_7ds, SUM(IF(act.is_30ds = 1 AND act.is_30d = 0, 1, 0)) AS lose_cnt_30ds, SUM(IF(act.is_30ds = 1, 1, 0)) AS active_cnt_30ds FROM role_basic AS bas LEFT JOIN register_role AS reg ON bas.roleid = reg.roleid AND bas.big_zone = reg.big_zone LEFT JOIN active_all_role AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid AND bas.big_zone = act.big_zone LEFT JOIN role_pay_di AS pay_di ON bas.roleid = pay_di.roleid AND bas.big_zone = pay_di.big_zone LEFT JOIN role_pay_df AS pay_df ON bas.roleid = pay_df.roleid AND bas.big_zone = pay_df.big_zone GROUP BY bas.big_zone, CUBE (bas.country, bas.os, bas.network, bas.channel))

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_battle_exp_socre_role_zone_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_battle_exp_score_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT matchid, battlegroup /* t1.accountid roleid, */ /* t1.zoneid, */, bigranklvl, minranklvl, active_type, zonetype, blacknum, pvptype, realpvptype, COALESCE(t2.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, rolenum, SUM(exp_score_withactive) AS score_with, SUM(exp_score_withoutactive) AS score_without, SUM(1) AS rolecnt FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, battleid, exp_score_withactive, exp_score_withoutactive FROM ml_temp.secondary_index_values_for_match WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29') AS t1 JOIN (SELECT roleid AS accountid, zoneid, active_type, first_mt_country FROM mt_dm.dm_aimatch_activity_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29') AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) AS zonetype, FLOOR(battlesvrid / 1000) AS battlegroup, pvptype, realpvptype, bigranklvl, minranklvl, blacknum FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND zoneid < 57000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND battletime > 0) AS t3 ON t1.accountid = t3.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND t1.battleid = t3.battleid JOIN (SELECT battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS rolenum FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND zoneid < 57000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND battletime > 0 GROUP BY battleid) AS t4 ON t1.battleid = t4.battleid JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, matchid, battleid FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND zoneid < 57000 AND success = 1) AS t5 ON t1.accountid = t5.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t5.zoneid AND t1.battleid = t5.battleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT `upper`, country FROM mt_dim.dim_national_geographic_atlas_config) AS t6 ON t2.first_mt_country = t6.`upper` GROUP BY matchid, battlegroup, bigranklvl, minranklvl, active_type, zonetype, blacknum, pvptype, realpvptype, rolenum, t2.first_mt_country /* t1.accountid, */ /* t1.zoneid, */

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_battle_exp_quality_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_battle_exp_quality_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT SUM(IF(imba <= 0.32, 1, 0)) AS bacnt, SUM(IF(imba > 0.32, 1, 0)) AS imbacnt, SUM(IF(imba >= 0.55, 1, 0)) AS overimbacnt, SUM(IF(bltype = '1', 1, 0)) AS `跌宕局场次`, SUM(IF(bltype = '2', 1, 0)) AS `翻盘局场次`, SUM(IF(bltype = '3', 1, 0)) AS `碾压局场次`, SUM(IF(bltype = '4', 1, 0)) AS `小优局场次`, SUM(IF(bltype = '5', 1, 0)) AS `均衡局场次`, SUM(IF(bltype IN ('1', '2', '4', '5'), 1, 0)) AS `非碾压局场次`, SUM(IF(bltype IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5'), 1, 0)) AS `带局势总场次`, COUNT(1) AS `总场次`, roomtype, pvptype, mapid, realpvptype, matchid, groupsel, bigranklvl, minranklvl, fake_ai, fake_ai_num, blacknum, hero_name, heroes AS `英雄主定位`, sub_heroes AS `英雄次定位`, position AS `英雄主分路`, sub_position AS `英雄次分路`, season, days_index, t1.first_mt_country FROM (SELECT battleid, accountid, zoneid, camp, heroid, fake_ai, pvptype, mapid, realpvptype, blacknum, bigranklvl, minranklvl, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(blacknum) OVER (PARTITION BY battleid, camp), FALSE) AS roomtype, logymd FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND heroid > 0 /* 为了去除观战的 */ AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battleid, matchid, groupsel, fake_ai_num FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-30') AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battle_id, game_type AS bltype FROM ml_temp.dwm_mlbb_battle_game_type_di_yz WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31') AS c ON a.battleid = c.battle_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battle_id, ABS(imbalance_v1) AS imba FROM mt_dm.dm_ai_feature_mlbb_battle_imbalance_di WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31') AS g ON a.battleid = g.battle_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-30' AS logymd, season, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', SUBSTRING(season_starttime, 1, 10)) + 1 AS days_index FROM mt_dim.dim_season_config WHERE '2026-05-30' >= SUBSTRING(season_starttime, 1, 10) AND '2026-05-30' <= SUBSTRING(season_endtime, 1, 10) GROUP BY logymd, season, days_index) AS d ON a.logymd = d.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, hero_name, heroes, sub_heroes, position, sub_position FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config) AS f ON a.heroid = f.heroid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_first_create = 1) AS t1 ON t1.roleid = a.accountid AND t1.zoneid = a.zoneid GROUP BY roomtype, pvptype, mapid, realpvptype, matchid, groupsel, bigranklvl, minranklvl, fake_ai, fake_ai_num, blacknum, hero_name, heroes, sub_heroes, position, sub_position, a.logymd, season, days_index, t1.first_mt_country

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_decismart_endmatch_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_decismart_endmatch_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT 'matchbegin' AS stepname, pvptype, matchid, t1.first_mt_country, -1 AS groupsel, FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) AS zone, UPPER(createrole_country) AS create_country, UPPER(login_country) AS login_country, COUNT(1) AS stepcnt, CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-05-31 00:00:00')) AS STRING) AS loghour FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_begin AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, createrole_country, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS login_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time`) AS timerank FROM ml_ods.gameserver_first_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31' AND fake_ai = 0) AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND b.timerank = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31')) AS t1 ON a.accountid = t1.roleid AND a.zoneid = t1.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) GROUP BY stepname, pvptype, matchid, groupsel, FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000), UPPER(createrole_country), UPPER(login_country), loghour, t1.first_mt_country UNION SELECT 'matchendsuc' AS stepname, pvptype, matchid, t1.first_mt_country, groupsel, FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) AS zone, UPPER(b.createrole_country) AS create_country, UPPER(login_country) AS login_country, COUNT(1) AS stepcnt, CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-05-31 00:00:00')) AS STRING) AS loghour FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, createrole_country, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS login_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time`) AS timerank FROM ml_ods.gameserver_first_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31' AND fake_ai = 0) AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND b.timerank = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31')) AS t1 ON a.accountid = t1.roleid AND a.zoneid = t1.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND sql_units: /* 插入/覆盖目标表 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: zibohong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-12-17 21:52:03.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 提取当天活跃的版本号 */ WITH new_versions_bassic AS (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(clientversion, '.', 4), '.', -1) AS test_version, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battle_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 替换为当天日期 */ AND zoneid BETWEEN 57000 AND 57999 AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90) GROUP BY test_version), new_versions AS (SELECT test_version FROM new_versions_bassic WHERE battle_cnt > 3000 /* 去掉琐碎的版本 */), existing_versions /* 提取昨日已有的版本号 */ AS (SELECT test_version, start_time, over_time FROM ml_temp.zibohong_test_version WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' /* 替换为昨天的日期 */), merged_versions /* 合并新版本和旧版本 */ AS (SELECT COALESCE(nv.test_version, ev.test_version) AS test_version, CASE WHEN ev.test_version IS NULL THEN '2026-05-31' /* 新版本，start_time 为当天 */ ELSE ev.start_time /* 旧版本保留原始 start_time */ END AS start_time, CASE WHEN NOT nv.test_version IS NULL THEN '2026-05-31' /* 活跃版本，更新 over_time 为当天 */ ELSE ev.over_time /* 旧版本保留原始 over_time */ END AS over_time FROM new_versions AS nv FULL OUTER JOIN existing_versions AS ev ON nv.test_version = ev.test_version) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.zibohong_test_version PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 替换为当天日期 */ SELECT test_version, start_time, over_time FROM merged_versions

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_account_df
sql_units: WITH basic_df AS (/* 基础信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), active_di AS (/* 活跃信息 */ SELECT roleid, MAX(SUBSTRING(day_last_active_time, 1, 10)) AS active_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid), pay_di AS (/* 支付信息 */ /* SELECT  roleid, */ /*         zoneid, */ /*         SUM(day_pay_cnt) AS pay_cnt, */ /*         SUM(day_pay_amount) AS pay_amt, */ /*         MAX(substr(day_last_pay_time, 1, 10)) AS pay_date */ /* FROM    mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di */ /* WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /* AND     day_pay_cnt > 0 */ /* GROUP BY */ /*         roleid, */ /*         zoneid */ SELECT roleid, SUM(pay_cnt) AS pay_cnt, SUM(product_money) AS pay_amt, MAX(SUBSTRING(last_pay_time, 1, 10)) AS pay_date, SUM(before_tax_usd_amt) AS before_tax_usd_amt, SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid), pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, SUM(his_before_tax_usd_amt) AS his_before_tax_usd_amt, SUM(his_pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS his_pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, his_before_tax_usd_amt, his_pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 /* 全量表只取正式服数据 */ /* 增量表从'2025-01-04'开始取测服数据 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, before_tax_usd_amt AS his_before_tax_usd_amt, pay_net_receipts_usd_amt AS his_pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd > '2025-01-03' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 AND zoneid >= 57000 /* 01-03号后加入测服 */) GROUP BY roleid), behavior_df AS (/* 前一日 */ SELECT accountid AS roleid, register_date, charge_info, charge_cnt_total_array, charge_amt_total_array, active_info, before_tax_usd_amt_total_array, pay_actual_amt_total_array FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_account_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, register_date, charge_info, charge_cnt_total_array, charge_amt_total_array, active_info, before_tax_usd_amt_total_array, pay_actual_amt_total_array FROM (SELECT roleid, COALESCE(register_date, '1970-01-01') AS register_date /* 无注册日期给默认值 */, IF(LENGTH(charge_info) > 0 AND /* 只补齐有位图的，并且当日日期大于注册日期的 */ '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(charge_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(charge_info))), COALESCE(charge_info, '') /* 可能存在有位图没有注册日期的， */) AS charge_info, IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_cnt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_cnt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS charge_cnt_total_array, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_amt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS charge_amt_total_array, IF(LENGTH(active_info) > 0 AND '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(active_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(active_info))), COALESCE(active_info, '')) AS active_info, IF(SIZE(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS before_tax_usd_amt_total_array, IF(SIZE(pay_actual_amt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(pay_actual_amt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(pay_actual_amt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(pay_actual_amt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(pay_actual_amt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS pay_actual_amt_total_array FROM (SELECT COALESCE(td.roleid, ld.roleid) AS roleid, td.register_date, IF(td.pay_date = '2026-05-31', CONCAT('1', COALESCE(ld.charge_info, '')), IF(LENGTH(ld.charge_info) > 0, CONCAT('0', charge_info), '')) AS charge_info, IF(td.pay_date /* 两种情况补充位图 */ /* ①、历史无位图  当日有付费  --首次 */ /* ②、历史有位图  当日有付费或者无付费 */ = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_cnt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_cnt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(pay_cnt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_cnt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.pay_cnt, 0) + ld.charge_cnt_total_array[0])), ld.charge_cnt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_cnt_total_array, IF(td.pay_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_amt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_amt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(pay_amt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_amt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.pay_amt, 0) + ld.charge_amt_total_array[0])), ld.charge_amt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_amt_total_array, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31', CONCAT('1', COALESCE(ld.active_info, '')), IF(LENGTH(ld.active_info) > 0, CONCAT('0', ld.active_info), '')) AS active_info, IF(td.pay_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.before_tax_usd_amt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.before_tax_usd_amt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(ROUND(td.before_tax_usd_amt, 2)), IF(SIZE(ld.before_tax_usd_amt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(ROUND(his_before_tax_usd_amt, 2)), ld.before_tax_usd_amt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS before_tax_usd_amt_total_array, IF(td.pay_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.pay_actual_amt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.pay_actual_amt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(ROUND(td.pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, 2)), IF(SIZE(ld.pay_actual_amt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(ROUND(his_pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, 2)), ld.pay_actual_amt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS pay_actual_amt_total_array FROM (SELECT COALESCE(data_di.roleid, bas.roleid) AS roleid, data_di.active_date, data_di.pay_cnt, data_di.pay_amt, data_di.pay_date, data_di.before_tax_usd_amt, data_di.pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, bas.register_date, pay_df.his_before_tax_usd_amt, pay_df.his_pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM (/* 当日 */ SELECT COALESCE(act.roleid, pay.roleid) AS roleid, act.active_date, pay.pay_cnt, pay.pay_amt, pay.pay_date, pay.before_tax_usd_amt, pay.pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM active_di AS act /* 活跃 */ FULL JOIN pay_di AS pay /* 支付 */ ON act.roleid = pay.roleid) AS data_di FULL JOIN (/* 获取基础信息 */ SELECT roleid, register_date FROM basic_df) AS bas ON data_di.roleid = bas.roleid FULL JOIN (/* 获取历史付费信息 */ SELECT roleid, his_before_tax_usd_amt, his_pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM pay_df) AS pay_df ON COALESCE(data_di.roleid, bas.roleid) = pay_df.roleid) AS td FULL JOIN (/* 前一日数据 */ SELECT * FROM behavior_df) AS ld ON td.roleid = ld.roleid) AS ifo LEFT JOIN (/* 剔除2025-03-18~2025-04-30异常新增账号数据 */ SELECT DISTINCT /* logymd, */ accountid /* 异常账号 */ /* account_name --异常设备 */ FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd >= '2025-03-18' AND logymd <= '2025-04-30' AND os_build LIKE '%AP1%') AS bb ON ifo.roleid = bb.accountid WHERE bb.accountid IS NULL)

name: etl.bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df
sql_units: /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df PARTITION (logymd = '2026-05-31') */ WITH os_info AS (SELECT roleid, logymd FROM zgame_damai_ods.t_client_performance_systeminfo WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd <= '2023-08-04' GROUP BY roleid, logymd HAVING MIN_BY(mulator, TIME) = 1), pve_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_id IN (1001061, 1001062) THEN 1001006 WHEN stage_id IN (1001091, 1001092) THEN 1001009 ELSE stage_id END) AS normal_campaign_init FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_fight_pve WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND (FLOOR(stage_id / 100000) = 10 AND NOT stage_id IN (1002006, 1003007, 1004004, 1005004, 1006004, 1007008, 1008004, 1009017, 1010008, 1011008)) AND score > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), charge_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(his_pay_amt) AS his_pay_amt, MAX(SUBSTRING(his_first_pay_time, 0, 10)) AS his_first_pay_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), active_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_device, last_os_type FROM bi_test.dwm_zgame_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df_tmp PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.create_os, t1.create_channel, t1.register_time, t1.register_date, t1.create_ip, t1.create_country, t1.first_ip_country, t1.first_ad_country, t1.last_ad_country, t1.first_mt_country, t1.last_mt_country, t1.first_network_name, t1.last_network_name, t1.account_register_time, t1.account_register_date, t1.account_create_os, t1.adjust_campaign_id, t1.adjust_campaign_name, t1.adjust_adset_id, t1.adjust_adset_name, t1.adjust_creative_id, t1.adjust_creative_name, t1.data_source, t1.create_role_os_type, t1.create_role_device, t1.bind_roleid, t1.bind_zoneid, t1.bind_logymd, t1.level, t1.normal_campaign_init, t1.role_name, t1.deviceid, t1.client_version, COALESCE(t2.is_init_bot, t1.is_cur_bot) AS is_init_bot, t1.is_cur_bot FROM (SELECT main_data.roleid, main_data.zoneid, COALESCE(main_data.create_os, 'unknown') AS create_os, COALESCE(main_data.create_channel, 'unknown') AS create_channel, COALESCE(IF(main_data.zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999, GREATEST('2023-07-13 00:00:00', main_data.register_time), IF(main_data.zoneid >= 70001, GREATEST('2024-03-27 00:00:00', main_data.register_time), main_data.register_time)), '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS register_time, COALESCE(IF(main_data.zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999, GREATEST('2023-07-13', main_data.register_date), IF(main_data.zoneid >= 70001, GREATEST('2024-03-27', main_data.register_date), main_data.register_date)), '1970-01-01') AS register_date, COALESCE(main_data.create_ip, login_auth.ip, 'unknown') AS create_ip, COALESCE(main_data.create_country, login_auth.ip_country, 'unknown') AS create_country, COALESCE(main_data.first_ip_country, adj.first_ip_country, login_auth.ip_country, 'unknown') AS first_ip_country /* adjust的可能会有未归因到的，null 值处理下 */, COALESCE(adj.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(adj.last_ad_country, 'unknown') AS last_ad_country, COALESCE(adj.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(adj.last_mt_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, COALESCE(adj.first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, COALESCE(adj.last_network_name, 'unknown') AS last_network_name, COALESCE(adj.account_register_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS account_register_time, COALESCE(adj.account_register_date, '1970-01-01') AS account_register_date, COALESCE(adj.os, 'unknown') AS account_create_os, COALESCE(adj.adjust_campaign_id, 'unknown') AS adjust_campaign_id, COALESCE(adj.adjust_campaign_name, 'unknown') AS adjust_campaign_name, COALESCE(adj.adjust_adset_id, 'unknown') AS adjust_adset_id, COALESCE(adj.adjust_adset_name, 'unknown') AS adjust_adset_name, COALESCE(adj.adjust_creative_id, 'unknown') AS adjust_creative_id, COALESCE(adj.adjust_creative_name, 'unknown') AS adjust_creative_name, main_data.data_source, COALESCE(main_data.create_role_os_type, login_auth.os_type, 'unknown') AS create_role_os_type, COALESCE(main_data.create_role_device, login_auth.device, 'unknown') AS create_role_device, COALESCE(bind_info.bind_role_id, 'unknown') AS bind_roleid, COALESCE(bind_info.bind_zone_id, 'unknown') AS bind_zoneid, COALESCE(bind_info.logymd, 'unknown') AS bind_logymd, COALESCE(level_info.max_level, 0) AS LEVEL, normal_campaign_init, COALESCE(role_name, 'unknown') AS role_name, COALESCE(main_data.deviceid, login_auth.account_name, 'unknown') AS deviceid, COALESCE(main_data.client_version, login_auth.client_version, 'unknown') AS client_version, CASE WHEN (main_data.zoneid = 1 OR main_data.zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 69999) AND COALESCE(t2.his_pay_amt, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(first_ad_country, 'unknown') = 'unknown' AND his_last_device IN ('iPhone8,4', 'iPhone10,1', 'iPhone10,4') THEN 1 WHEN main_data.zoneid >= 70001 AND COALESCE(t2.his_pay_amt, 0) = 0 AND first_ad_country = 'unknown' AND his_last_device IN ('iPhone8,4', 'iPhone10,1', 'iPhone10,4', 'samsung SCG01', 'samsung SCV41', 'samsung SCV45') THEN 1 WHEN main_data.zoneid >= 70001 AND COALESCE(t2.his_pay_amt, 0) = 0 AND first_ad_country = 'unknown' AND last_os_type = 4 AND his_last_device IN ('samsung SM-G977N', 'samsung SM-A805N', 'samsung SM-S908N', 'samsung SM-G970N', 'samsung SM-N976N', 'samsung SM-G975N', 'samsung SM-G973N', 'samsung SM-N960N', 'samsung SM-S901N', 'samsung SM-S906N', 'asus ASUS_Z01QD', 'samsung SM-N971N', 'samsung SM-A908N', 'samsung SM-G960N', 'samsung SM-G965N', 'samsung SM-G9880') THEN 1 WHEN main_data.zoneid >= 70001 AND COALESCE(t2.his_pay_amt, 0) = 0 AND first_ad_country <> 'unknown' AND his_last_device IN ('samsung SCG01', 'samsung SCV41', 'samsung SCV45') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_cur_bot FROM (SELECT new_role.roleid, new_role.zoneid, CASE WHEN IF(NOT t.roleid IS NULL, 4, new_role.os_type) = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN IF(NOT t.roleid IS NULL, 4, new_role.os_type) = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN IF(NOT t.roleid IS NULL, 4, new_role.os_type) = 3 THEN 'pc' WHEN IF(NOT t.roleid IS NULL, 4, new_role.os_type) = 4 THEN 'emulator' ELSE 'unknown' END AS create_os, new_role.ip AS create_ip, new_role.channel AS create_channel, LOWER(IF(TRIM(GEOIP(new_role.ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))) = '-', NULL, TRIM(GEOIP(new_role.ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))))) AS create_country, new_role.usercreateymd AS register_date, new_role.usercreatetime AS register_time, data_source, IF(NOT t.roleid IS NULL, 4, new_role.os_type) AS create_role_os_type, device AS create_role_device, COALESCE(normal_campaign_init, 0) AS normal_campaign_init, 0 AS is_init_bot, 1 AS new_type, NULL AS first_ip_country, NULL AS client_version, NULL AS deviceid FROM (/* 创角表 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, ip, channel, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, createrole_country, device, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, roleid ORDER BY `time` ASC) AS rn, 'create' AS data_source /* 来源表 */ FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_create_role AS new_role WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df_tmp AS b WHERE new_role.roleid = b.roleid AND new_role.zoneid = b.zoneid AND logymd = '2026-05-30') /* 创角丢失部分 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, ip, channel, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, createrole_country, device, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, roleid ORDER BY rk_tb, `time` ASC) AS rn /* 优先取login的数据 */, data_source /* 来源表 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, ip, channel, device, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, `time`, createrole_country, 'login' AS data_source /* 来源哪个表 */, 1 AS rk_tb /* 表的排序 */ FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, ip, channel, device, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, `time`, createrole_country, 'charge' AS data_source, 2 AS rk_tb FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, 'unknown' AS ip, 'unknown' AS channel, device, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, `time`, 'unknown' AS createrole_country, 'charge' AS data_source, 2 AS rk_tb FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_fight_pve WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001))) AS new_role WHERE NOT EXISTS(/* 排除历史和今日创角部分 */ SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df_tmp WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_create_role WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001))) AS b WHERE new_role.roleid = b.roleid AND new_role.zoneid = b.zoneid)) AS new_role LEFT JOIN os_info AS t ON new_role.roleid = t.roleid LEFT JOIN pve_info AS k ON k.roleid = new_role.roleid AND k.zoneid = new_role.zoneid WHERE new_role.rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT his.roleid, his.zoneid, IF(his.create_os = 'unknown', NULL, his.create_os) AS create_os, IF(his.create_ip = 'unknown', NULL, his.create_ip) AS create_ip, IF(his.create_channel = 'unknown', NULL, his.create_channel) AS create_channel, IF(his.create_country = 'unknown', NULL, his.create_country) AS create_country, IF(his.register_date = '1970-01-01', NULL, his.register_date) AS register_date, IF(his.register_time = '1970-01-01 00:00:00', NULL, his.register_time) AS register_date, data_source, IF(his.create_role_os_type = 'unknown', NULL, his.create_role_os_type) AS create_role_os_type, IF(his.create_role_device = 'unknown', NULL, his.create_role_device) AS create_role_device, normal_campaign_init, 1 AS is_init_bot, 1 AS new_type, IF(his.first_ip_country = 'unknown', NULL, his.first_ip_country) AS first_ip_country, IF(his.client_version = 'unknown', NULL, his.client_version) AS client_version, IF(his.deviceid = 'unknown', NULL, his.deviceid) AS deviceid /* FROM    mt_dim.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df his */ FROM bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df_tmp AS his WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS main_data LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, account_register_time, account_register_date, os_type, os, his_first_deviceid, role_register_date, first_create_ip, first_ip_country, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, ad_os_type, attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_adset_name, adjust_creative_id, adjust_creative_name, logymd FROM bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2023-08-01', '2023-08-01', '2026-05-31')) AS adj ON main_data.roleid = adj.accountid LEFT JOIN charge_info AS t2 ON t2.roleid = main_data.roleid AND t2.zoneid = main_data.zoneid LEFT JOIN active_info AS t3 ON t3.roleid = main_data.roleid AND t3.zoneid = main_data.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, bind_role_id, bind_zone_id, logymd FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, bind_role_id, bind_zone_id, logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME) AS rn FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_friend_invite_bind WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001))) AS a WHERE rn = 1) AS bind_info ON main_data.roleid = bind_info.roleid AND main_data.zoneid = bind_info.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(LEVEL) AS max_level FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_add_level WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS level_info ON main_data.roleid = level_info.roleid AND main_data.zoneid = level_info.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX_BY(cur_name, TIME) AS role_name FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_change_name WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS name_info ON main_data.roleid = name_info.roleid AND main_data.zoneid = name_info.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, channel, region_id, os_type, account_name, device, ip, client_version, ip_country FROM (SELECT accountid, channel, FLOOR(zoneid / 10000) AS region_id, zoneid, os_type, account_name, device, ip, LOWER(IF(TRIM(GEOIP(ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))) = '-', NULL, TRIM(GEOIP(ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))))) AS ip_country, client_version, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY `time`) AS rn FROM zgame_damai_ods.loginserver_login_auth WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001))) AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS login_auth ON main_data.roleid = login_auth.roleid AND main_data.zoneid = login_auth.zoneid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df_tmp WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid

name: 地图持有情况_role_daily
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_hjli@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-01-07 14:54:26.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 棋盘数据持有量 */ WITH daily AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, MAX(CASE operate WHEN 'shop_buy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_buy, a.mapid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_individual_add_map AS a WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' /* and mapid BETWEEN 9001 and 9999  -- 当前的itemid范围为9001-9100，保险起见范围给到9999  */ GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.mapid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.map_daily_record_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.mapid, a.if_buy, '2026-05-31' AS getdate FROM daily AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mcgg_temp.map_daily_record_df AS b WHERE a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.mapid = b.mapid AND b.logymd = '2026-05-30') UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, mapid, if_buy, getdate FROM mcgg_temp.map_daily_record_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_qdes_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* set  dorado.dependency.parse.skip = true; */ WITH project AS (SELECT qdes_id, qdes_context_cn, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_qdes_project_config WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 1 * -1)), question AS (SELECT qdes_question_id, qdes_type, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_qdes_question_config WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 1 * -1)), answer AS (SELECT qdes_question_id, qdes_answer_id, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_qdes_answer_config WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 1 * -1)), project_info AS (SELECT a.qdes_question_id, a.qdes_type, c.qdes_answer_id, b.qdes_id FROM question AS a FULL JOIN project AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd LEFT JOIN answer AS c ON a.qdes_question_id = c.qdes_question_id), qdes_detail /* 问卷填答时间数据 */ AS (SELECT LOWER(a.project_id) AS project_id, a.begin_time, a.finish_time, a.id, b.qdes_question_id, b.qdes_type FROM adbi_ods.ods_xm_survey_respondent0 AS a INNER JOIN project_info AS b ON LOWER(a.project_id) = LOWER(b.qdes_id) WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY a.project_id, a.begin_time, a.finish_time, a.id, b.qdes_question_id, b.qdes_type), qdes_answer_info /* 问卷问题答案数据 */ AS (SELECT project_id, answers, roleid, zoneid, rid, created_dt, updated_dt, seq FROM mt_dwd.dwd_survey_qdes_project_seq_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND LENGTH(answers) > 2), qdes_detail_all AS (SELECT a.project_id, a.begin_time, a.finish_time, a.qdes_question_id, a.qdes_type, JSON_TUPLE(b.answers, COALESCE(a.qdes_question_id, 0)) AS (question_info), b.created_dt, b.roleid, b.zoneid, b.updated_dt, b.seq FROM qdes_detail AS a JOIN (SELECT * FROM qdes_answer_info) AS b ON a.id = b.rid), qdes_answers_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, project_id, created_dt, begin_time, finish_time, qdes_question_id, qdes_type, question_info, updated_dt, seq, IF(qdes_type = 'single', FROM_JSON(question_info, 'array<bigint>'), NULL) AS single_int, IF(qdes_type = 'single', FROM_JSON(question_info, 'array<string>'), NULL) AS single_str, IF(qdes_type = 'multiple', ARRAY_EXCEPT(FLATTEN(FROM_JSON(question_info, 'array<array<bigint>>')), ARRAY(NULL)), NULL) AS multiple_int, IF(qdes_type = 'multiple', ARRAY_EXCEPT(FLATTEN(FROM_JSON(question_info, 'array<array<string>>')), ARRAY(NULL)), NULL) AS multiple_str, IF(qdes_type = 'multiple', SIZE(ARRAY_EXCEPT(FLATTEN(FROM_JSON(question_info, 'array<array<string>>')), ARRAY(NULL))), NULL) AS multiple_len FROM qdes_detail_all), qdes_answers AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, project_id, created_dt, begin_time, finish_time, qdes_question_id, qdes_type, question_info, updated_dt, seq, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(finish_time) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(begin_time) AS answer_duration, CASE WHEN qdes_type = 'single' AND NOT single_int IS NULL AND NOT single_str[0] IS NULL THEN MAP(single_str[0], '') WHEN qdes_type = 'single' AND single_int IS NULL AND NOT single_str[0] IS NULL AND NOT single_str[1] IS NULL THEN MAP(single_str[0], single_str[1]) ELSE NULL END AS single_map, CASE WHEN qdes_type = 'multiple' AND NOT multiple_int IS NULL THEN MAP_FROM_ARRAYS(multiple_str, ARRAY_REPEAT('', multiple_len)) WHEN qdes_type = 'multiple' AND multiple_int IS NULL AND NOT multiple_str IS NULL AND NOT SLICE(multiple_str, -2, 2)[0] IS NULL AND NOT SLICE(multiple_str, -2, 2)[1] IS NULL THEN MAP_CONCAT(MAP_FROM_ARRAYS(SLICE(multiple_str, 1, multiple_len - 2), ARRAY_REPEAT('', multiple_len - 2)), MAP(SLICE(multiple_str, -2, 2)[0], SLICE(multiple_str, -2, 2)[1])) ELSE NULL END AS multiple_map FROM qdes_answers_info), qdes_union AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, project_id, created_dt, begin_time, finish_time, answer_duration, updated_dt, seq, IF(qdes_type = 'single' AND NOT qdes_question_id IS NULL, TO_JSON(MAP(CAST(qdes_question_id AS STRING), single_map)), NULL) AS answer_single_map, IF(qdes_type = 'multiple' AND NOT qdes_question_id IS NULL, TO_JSON(MAP(CAST(qdes_question_id AS STRING), multiple_map)), NULL) AS answer_multiple_map FROM qdes_answers), qdes_res AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, project_id, created_dt, begin_time, finish_time, answer_duration, updated_dt, seq, COLLECT_SET(answer_single_map) AS answer_single, COLLECT_SET(answer_multiple_map) AS answer_multiple FROM qdes_union GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, project_id, created_dt, begin_time, finish_time, answer_duration, updated_dt, seq ORDER BY roleid, zoneid, project_id), role_basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_register_date, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_qdes_role_zone_di PARTITION(appid = 'ml', logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.project_id, a.created_dt, a.account_register_date, a.register_date, a.answer_single, a.answer_multiple, a.finish_time, name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_pay_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH t_pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money) AS cum_charge_amount, MIN(`time`) AS his_first_pay_time, MAX(`time`) AS his_last_pay_time, MAX(IF(logymd < '2026-05-31', DATE(time), '1970-01-01')) AS last_charge_logymd, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', money, 0)) AS charge_amount, COUNT(1) AS his_pay_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN platform = 'moonton' AND product_type <> 'W币' THEN money ELSE 0 END) AS his_pay_amt_official, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (platform = 'moonton' AND product_type <> 'W币') OR platform IS NULL OR product_type IS NULL THEN money ELSE 0 END) AS his_pay_amt_particular FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND money > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_pay_30_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(COALESCE(money, 0)) AS his_30_pay_amt FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND money > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_180_30_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(COALESCE(charge_amount_in_past_30_days, 0)) AS max_30_days_charge_amount_in_past_180_days FROM mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd >= '2025-12-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_pay_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, NULL, NULL, his_first_pay_time, his_last_pay_time, cum_charge_amount AS his_pay_amt, his_pay_cnt, his_pay_amt_official, his_pay_amt_particular, MAP() AS his_pay_type_amt_map, last_charge_logymd, COALESCE(t2.his_30_pay_amt, 0) AS charge_amount_in_past_30_days, COALESCE(max_30_days_charge_amount_in_past_180_days, 0) FROM t_pay_df AS t1 LEFT JOIN t_pay_30_di AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_180_30_info AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid

*/ WITH t_lottery_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, hero_cnt_2star, hero_cnt_3star, hero_cnt_4star, hero_cnt_5star, lottery_total, cum_blue_lottery, cum_gold_lottery, cum_red_lottery FROM mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_lottery_info_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), t_lottery_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_hero_cnt_2star, his_hero_cnt_3star, his_hero_cnt_4star, his_hero_cnt_5star, his_lottery_total, his_cum_blue_lottery, his_cum_gold_lottery, his_cum_red_lottery FROM mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_lottery_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_lottery_info_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(t_lottery_di.roleid, t_lottery_df.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(t_lottery_di.zoneid, t_lottery_df.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(t_lottery_di.hero_cnt_2star, 0) + COALESCE(t_lottery_df.his_hero_cnt_2star, 0) AS his_hero_cnt_2star, COALESCE(t_lottery_di.hero_cnt_3star, 0) + COALESCE(t_lottery_df.his_hero_cnt_3star, 0) AS his_hero_cnt_3star, COALESCE(t_lottery_di.hero_cnt_4star, 0) + COALESCE(t_lottery_df.his_hero_cnt_4star, 0) AS his_hero_cnt_4star, COALESCE(t_lottery_di.hero_cnt_5star, 0) + COALESCE(t_lottery_df.his_hero_cnt_5star, 0) AS his_hero_cnt_5star, COALESCE(t_lottery_di.lottery_total, 0) + COALESCE(t_lottery_df.his_lottery_total, 0) AS his_lottery_total, COALESCE(t_lottery_di.cum_blue_lottery, 0) + COALESCE(t_lottery_df.his_cum_blue_lottery, 0) AS his_cum_blue_lottery, COALESCE(t_lottery_di.cum_gold_lottery, 0) + COALESCE(t_lottery_df.his_cum_gold_lottery, 0) AS his_cum_gold_lottery, COALESCE(t_lottery_di.cum_red_lottery, 0) + COALESCE(t_lottery_df.his_cum_red_lottery, 0) AS his_cum_red_lottery FROM t_lottery_di FULL JOIN t_lottery_df ON t_lottery_di.roleid = t_lottery_df.roleid AND t_lottery_di.zoneid = t_lottery_df.zoneid

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_resource_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH hero_legend_gallery AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.baseid, a.hero_quality, COALESCE(awakening_star, 0) AS awakening_star FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, baseid, hero_quality FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_hero_add WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND hero_quality IN (4, 5) AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND operate <> 'Hero_HeroReset' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, baseid, hero_quality) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, hero_basid, MAX(cur_unlock_num) AS awakening_star FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_add_hero_awakening WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, hero_basid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.baseid = b.hero_basid), soldier_info AS (SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(a.soldier_id, b.soldier_id) AS soldier_id, COALESCE(a.max_level, 1) AS max_level FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, soldier_id, MAX(cur_level) AS max_level FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_soldier_up_level WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) /* and soldier_id is not null */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, soldier_id) AS a FULL JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(soldier_id AS BIGINT) AS soldier_id FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, soldier_id FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_add_soldier LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(soldier_list, ',')) AS soldier_id WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001))) AS b_1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, soldier_id) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.soldier_id = b.soldier_id WHERE NOT COALESCE(a.soldier_id, b.soldier_id) IS NULL), role_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAP_MERGE(day_item_add) AS item_balance_end FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, day_item_add FROM mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_resource_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_balance_end FROM mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_resource_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS a GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_resource_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, hero_legend_gallery, hero_eipc_gallery, item_balance_end, demon_soldier_gallery FROM role_info AS t0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', baseid, awakening_star))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS hero_eipc_gallery FROM hero_legend_gallery WHERE hero_quality = 4 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 ON t1.roleid = t0.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t0.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', baseid, awakening_star))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS hero_legend_gallery FROM hero_legend_gallery WHERE hero_quality = 5 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t2 ON t2.roleid = t0.roleid AND t2.zoneid = t0.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', soldier_id, COALESCE(max_level, 0)))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS demon_soldier_gallery FROM soldier_info GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t3 ON t3.roleid = t0.roleid AND t3.zoneid = t0.zoneid

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_union_role_zone_df
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-12-23 11:57:04.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `mt_dwm`.`dwm_zgame_union_role_zone_df`( */ /*     `roleid` decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '账号id,key', */ /*     `zoneid` bigint COMMENT '区服id,key', */ /*     `union_id` decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '所在公会id', */ /*     `union_level` bigint COMMENT '所在公会的公会等级', */ /*     `union_division` bigint COMMENT '所在公会的公会战段位', */ /*     `union_name` string COMMENT '所在公会名' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` string COMMENT '日期,yyyy-MM-dd') */ /*     STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dwm/table/dwm_zgame_union_role_zone_df'; */ WITH union_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX_BY(region_id, TIME) AS region_id, MAX_BY(union_id, TIME) AS union_id, MAX_BY(union_name, time) AS union_name FROM (SELECT logymd, TIME, union_id, union_name, region_id, SPLIT(joinner, '-')[1] AS roleid, SPLIT(joinner, '-')[0] AS zoneid FROM zgame_damai_ods.unionserver_union_join WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND NOT (CAST(SPLIT(joinner, '-')[0] AS BIGINT) >= 70001 AND logymd < '2024-03-27') UNION ALL SELECT logymd, TIME, NULL AS union_id, NULL AS union_name, region_id, SPLIT(quiter, '-')[1] AS roleid, SPLIT(quiter, '-')[0] AS zoneid FROM zgame_damai_ods.unionserver_union_quit WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND NOT (CAST(SPLIT(quiter, '-')[0] AS BIGINT) >= 70001 AND logymd < '2024-03-27')) AS a GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), level_info AS (SELECT union_id, region_id, MAX_BY(union_level, TIME) AS union_level FROM zgame_damai_ods.unionserver_union_recal WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY union_id, region_id), division_info AS (SELECT union_id, region_id, MAX_BY(division, TIME) AS union_division FROM zgame_damai_ods.unionserver_gvg_match_settle WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY union_id, region_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_union_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, t0.union_id, union_level, union_division, union_name, t0.region_id AS union_region_id FROM union_info AS t0 LEFT JOIN level_info AS t1 ON t0.union_id = t1.union_id AND t0.region_id = t1.region_id LEFT JOIN division_info AS t2 ON t0.union_id = t2.union_id AND t0.region_id = t2.region_id

name: adbi.retention_level_df
sql_units: WITH input_cost AS (SELECT report_date, MAPPING('media_source', media_source) AS media_source, LOWER(os) AS os, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country)) AS country, 'unknown' AS campaign_id, 'unknown' AS adset_id, 'unknown' AS ad_id, 'unknown' AS ad_account_id, CASE WHEN MAX(ad_target) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE MAX(ad_target) END AS ad_target, SUM(cost) AS cost FROM adbi.dwa_admkt_input_cost_report_fully WHERE date = '20260531' AND is_deleted = 0 AND app_id = '1001' GROUP BY report_date, MAPPING('media_source', media_source), LOWER(os), LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country))), api_cost AS (SELECT a.report_date, MAPPING('media_source', a.media_source) AS media_source, LOWER(a.os) AS os, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(a.country), '') = '', 'unknown', a.country)) AS country, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(a.campaign_id), '') = '', 'unknown', a.campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(a.adset_id), '') = '', 'unknown', a.adset_id) AS adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(a.ad_id), '') = '', 'unknown', a.ad_id) AS ad_id, a.ad_account_id, b.ad_target, a.cost FROM adbi.dwa_admkt_api_ad_cost_report_df AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.app_id, x.ad_account_id, x.ad_target, x.ad_platform_name FROM (SELECT app_id, ad_account_id, ad_target, ad_platform_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, ad_platform_name, ad_account_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rn FROM adbi.gms_ad_bi_ad_account WHERE date = '20260531') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1) AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.ad_account_id = b.ad_account_id AND a.media_source = b.ad_platform_name WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND a.app_id = '1001' UNION ALL SELECT report_date, MAPPING('media_source', network) AS media_source, LOWER(os_name) AS os, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country)) AS country, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_id), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adgroup_id), '') = '', 'unknown', adgroup_id) AS adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(creative_id), '') = '', 'unknown', creative_id) AS ad_id, 'unknown' AS ad_account_id, 1 AS ad_target, adjust_cost AS cost FROM adbi.ods_adjust_cost_di WHERE logymd <= '2024-06-02' AND logymd >= '2023-11-06' AND app_id = '1001'), final_cost AS (SELECT report_date, media_source, os, country, campaign_id, adset_id, ad_id, ad_account_id, ad_target, cost FROM input_cost UNION ALL SELECT a.report_date, a.media_source, a.os, a.country, a.campaign_id, a.adset_id, a.ad_id, MAX(a.ad_account_id) AS ad_account_id, MAX(a.ad_target) AS ad_target, SUM(a.cost) AS cost FROM api_cost AS a LEFT JOIN input_cost AS b ON a.report_date = b.report_date AND a.media_source = b.media_source AND a.os = b.os AND a.country = b.country WHERE b.report_date IS NULL GROUP BY a.report_date, a.media_source, a.os, a.country, a.campaign_id, a.adset_id, a.ad_id), reattribution AS (SELECT c.device_id, c.network_name, c.create_date, c.his_first_active_date, c.active_info, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(c.campaign_id), '') = '', 'unknown', c.campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(c.adset_id), '') = '', 'unknown', c.adset_id) AS adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(c.ad_id), '') = '', 'unknown', c.ad_id) AS ad_id, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(c.country), '') = '', 'unknown', c.country)) AS country, LOWER(c.os) AS os FROM (SELECT a.device_id, a.network_name, a.create_date, a.his_first_active_date, a.active_info, CASE WHEN b.report_date IS NULL THEN a.campaign_id ELSE b.campaign_id END AS campaign_id, CASE WHEN b.report_date IS NULL THEN a.adgroup_id ELSE b.adset_id END AS adset_id, CASE WHEN b.report_date IS NULL THEN a.creative_id ELSE b.ad_id END AS ad_id, a.country, a.os FROM adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df AS a LEFT JOIN input_cost AS b ON a.create_date = b.report_date AND MAPPING('media_source', a.network_name) = b.media_source AND LOWER(a.os) = b.os AND LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(a.country), '') = '', 'unknown', a.country)) = b.country WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND a.app_id = '1001') AS c), device AS (SELECT d.device_id, d.his_last_active_level, d.create_date, d.network_name, d.country, d.os, d.campaign_id, d.adset_id, d.ad_id, COUNT(d.device_id) OVER (PARTITION BY d.create_date, d.network_name, d.country, d.os, d.campaign_id, d.adset_id, d.ad_id) AS device_cnt, d.is_active FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.his_last_active_level, c.device_id, c.create_date /* 注册 */, c.his_first_active_date, c.active_info, MAPPING('media_source', c.network_name) AS network_name /* 渠道 */, c.campaign_id, c.adset_id, c.ad_id, LOWER(c.country) AS country /* 地区 */, LOWER(c.os) AS os /* 激活平台 */, ARRAY_EXCEPT(ARRAY(IF(SUBSTRING(c.active_info, -2, 1) = '1', 'd1', NULL), IF(SUBSTRING(c.active_info, -4, 1) = '1', 'd3', NULL), IF(SUBSTRING(c.active_info, -8, 1) = '1', 'd7', NULL), IF(SUBSTRING(c.active_info, -15, 1) = '1', 'd14', NULL), IF(SUBSTRING(c.active_info, -31, 1) = '1', 'd30', NULL), IF(SUBSTRING(c.active_info, -61, 1) = '1', 'd60', NULL), IF(SUBSTRING(c.active_info, -91, 1) = '1', 'd90', NULL), IF(SUBSTRING(c.active_info, -181, 1) = '1', 'd180', NULL)), ARRAY(NULL)) AS is_active /* 留存 */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.device_id ORDER BY a.his_last_active_level DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT roleid, MAX(his_last_active_level) AS his_last_active_level FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid) AS a INNER JOIN ml_ods.accountserver_account_create AS b ON a.roleid = b.accountid AND NOT b.logymd IS NULL INNER JOIN reattribution AS c ON b.account_name = c.device_id) AS d WHERE d.rn = 1), res_active AS (SELECT e.create_date, e.network_name, e.country, e.os, e.campaign_id, e.adset_id, e.ad_id, e.is_active, MAX(e.device_cnt) AS device_cnt, COUNT(e.device_id) AS device_cnt_in_is_active, COUNT(CASE WHEN e.his_last_active_level = 1 THEN device_id ELSE NULL END) AS lv1_device, COUNT(CASE WHEN e.his_last_active_level >= 2 AND e.his_last_active_level <= 5 THEN device_id ELSE NULL END) AS lv2_5_device, COUNT(CASE WHEN e.his_last_active_level >= 6 AND e.his_last_active_level <= 10 THEN device_id ELSE NULL END) AS lv6_10_device, COUNT(CASE WHEN e.his_last_active_level >= 11 AND e.his_last_active_level <= 20 THEN device_id ELSE NULL END) AS lv11_20_device, COUNT(CASE WHEN e.his_last_active_level >= 21 THEN device_id ELSE NULL END) AS lv21_device FROM (SELECT device_id, his_last_active_level, create_date, network_name, country, os, campaign_id, adset_id, ad_id, device_cnt, EXPLODE(is_active) AS is_active FROM device) AS e GROUP BY e.create_date, e.network_name, e.country, e.os, e.campaign_id, e.adset_id, e.ad_id, e.is_active), res_total AS (SELECT e.create_date, e.network_name, e.country, e.os, e.campaign_id, e.adset_id, e.ad_id, e.is_active, MAX(e.device_cnt) AS device_cnt, 0 AS device_cnt_in_is_active, 0 AS lv1_device, 0 AS lv2_5_device, 0 AS lv6_10_device, 0 AS lv11_20_device, 0 AS lv21_device FROM (SELECT device_id, his_last_active_level, create_date, network_name, country, os, campaign_id, adset_id, ad_id, device_cnt, EXPLODE(ARRAY('d1', 'd3', 'd7', 'd14', 'd30', 'd60', 'd90', 'd180')) AS is_active FROM device) AS e GROUP BY e.create_date, e.network_name, e.country, e.os, e.campaign_id, e.adset_id, e.ad_id, e.is_active) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.retention_level_df PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31', app_id = '1001') SELECT m.create_date, m.network_name, m.country, m.os, m.campaign_id, m.adset_id, m.ad_id, COALESCE(n.ad_account_id, 'unknown') AS ad_account_id, COALESCE(CAST(n.ad_target AS STRING), 'unknown') AS ad_target, m.is_active, m.device_cnt /* 不包含is_active维度下的当天新增设备 */, m.device_cnt_in_is_active /* 包含is_active维度下的当天新增设备 */, m.lv1_device, m.lv2_5_device, m.lv6_10_device, m.lv11_20_device, m.lv21_device, n.cost, '' AS battle_cnt FROM (SELECT COALESCE(b.create_date, a.create_date) AS create_date, COALESCE(b.network_name, a.network_name) AS network_name, COALESCE(b.country, a.country) AS country, COALESCE(b.os, a.os) AS os, COALESCE(b.campaign_id, a.campaign_id) AS campaign_id, COALESCE(b.adset_id, a.adset_id) AS adset_id, COALESCE(b.ad_id, a.ad_id) AS ad_id, COALESCE(b.is_active, a.is_active) AS is_active, COALESCE(b.device_cnt, a.device_cnt) AS device_cnt, COALESCE(b.device_cnt_in_is_active, a.device_cnt_in_is_active) AS device_cnt_in_is_active, COALESCE(b.lv1_device, a.lv1_device) AS lv1_device, COALESCE(b.lv2_5_device, a.lv2_5_device) AS lv2_5_device, COALESCE(b.lv6_10_device, a.lv6_10_device) AS lv6_10_device, COALESCE(b.lv11_20_device, a.lv11_20_device) AS lv11_20_device, COALESCE(b.lv21_device, a.lv21_device) AS lv21_device FROM res_total AS a FULL JOIN res_active AS b ON a.create_date = b.create_date AND a.network_name = b.network_name AND a.country = b.country AND a.os = b.os AND a.campaign_id = b.campaign_id AND a.adset_id = b.adset_id AND a.ad_id = b.ad_id AND a.is_active = b.is_active) AS m LEFT JOIN final_cost AS n ON m.create_date = n.report_date AND m.network_name = n.media_source AND m.os = n.os AND m.country = n.country AND m.campaign_id = n.campaign_id AND m.adset_id = n.adset_id AND m.ad_id = n.ad_id
