name: mt_ads.mlbb_inside_publish_country
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: fireyangshen@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-02-06 16:49:56.000 */ /* Description: 内宣总况 https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/UyUzdzmIYobI7cx2oXzcCzCtnVc */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_ads.mlbb_inside_publish_country ( */ /*             rod_location STRING COMMENT '通路位置:23.广告精选,6.主城小轮播', */ /*             content STRING COMMENT '内容', */ /*             content_type STRING COMMENT '内容类型', */ /*             country STRING COMMENT '国家', */ /*             language STRING COMMENT '语言', */ /*             impression_cnt BIGINT COMMENT '曝光数', */ /*             reach_cnt BIGINT COMMENT '覆盖人数', */ /*             click_cnt BIGINT COMMENT '点击数', */ /*             click_uniq_cnt BIGINT COMMENT '点击人数', */ /*             ad_position BIGINT COMMENT '广告位置', */ /*             redpoint_type BIGINT COMMENT '红点' */ /*         ) COMMENT '内宣图表和总况' */ /*         PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd') STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://mt-ads/table/mlbb_inside_publish_country'; */ /* -主城小轮播（6）---- */ WITH promp_data1 AS (SELECT COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[1], '') AS content, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[2], '') AS content_type, COALESCE(LOWER(GEOIP(ip, 1)), 'noCountry') AS country, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[3], '[.]')[0], '') AS language /* regexp_replace(split(split(split(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[3], '[.]')[0], '[[:punct:]]', '') AS language, */, accountid FROM ml_ods.connserver_shop_data WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND entry = '1'), promp_data AS (SELECT content, content_type, country, language, COUNT(accountid) AS e3, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e4 FROM promp_data1 GROUP BY content, content_type, country, language), login_tbl1 AS (SELECT COALESCE(SPLIT(ad_picture, '-')[1], '') AS content, COALESCE(SPLIT(ad_picture, '-')[2], '') AS content_type, COALESCE(LOWER(GEOIP(ip, 1)), 'noCountry') AS country, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '-')[3], '[.]')[0], '') AS language, ad_count, accountid FROM ml_ods.connserver_ad_data WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND ad_type = 6), login_tbl AS (SELECT content, content_type, country, language, SUM(ad_count) AS e1, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e2 FROM login_tbl1 GROUP BY content, content_type, country, LANGUAGE) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.mlbb_inside_publish_country PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT '6' AS rod_location, b.content, b.content_type, b.country, b.LANGUAGE, COALESCE(SUM(e1), 0) AS impression_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(e2), 0) AS reach_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(e3), 0) AS click_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(e4), 0) AS click_uniq_cnt, 0 AS ad_position, 0 AS redpoint_type FROM promp_data AS b LEFT OUTER JOIN login_tbl AS a ON a.content = b.content AND a.content_type = b.content_type AND a.LANGUAGE = b.LANGUAGE AND a.country = b.country WHERE NOT b.content IS NULL AND NOT b.country IS NULL GROUP BY b.content, b.content_type, b.country, b.LANGUAGE

/* 登录扑脸广告（49）---- */ WITH promp_data1 AS (SELECT COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[1], '') AS content, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[2], '') AS content_type, COALESCE(LOWER(GEOIP(ip, 1)), 'noCountry') AS country, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[3], '[.]')[0], '') AS language, accountid FROM ml_ods.connserver_prompt_data WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), promp_data AS (SELECT content, content_type, country, language, COUNT(accountid) AS e3, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e4 FROM promp_data1 GROUP BY content, content_type, country, language), login_tbl1 AS (SELECT COALESCE(SPLIT(ad_picture, '-')[1], '') AS content, COALESCE(SPLIT(ad_picture, '-')[2], '') AS content_type, COALESCE(LOWER(GEOIP(ip, 1)), 'noCountry') AS country, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '-')[3], '[.]')[0], '') AS language, ad_count, accountid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_49ad_data WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), login_tbl AS (SELECT content, content_type, country, language, SUM(ad_count) AS e1, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e2 FROM login_tbl1 GROUP BY content, content_type, country, language) INSERT INTO mt_ads.mlbb_inside_publish_country PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT '49' AS rod_location, b.content, b.content_type, b.country, b.LANGUAGE, COALESCE(SUM(e1), 0) AS impression_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(e2), 0) AS reach_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(e3), 0) AS click_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(e4), 0) AS click_uniq_cnt, 0 AS ad_position, 0 AS redpoint_type FROM login_tbl AS b LEFT OUTER JOIN promp_data AS a ON a.content = b.content AND a.content_type = b.content_type AND a.language = b.language AND a.country = b.country WHERE NOT b.content IS NULL AND NOT b.country IS NULL GROUP BY b.content, b.content_type, b.country, b.language

/* 商城长图（6b）-- */ WITH tbl1 AS (SELECT accountid, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[1], '') AS content, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[2], '') AS content_type, COALESCE(LOWER(GEOIP(ip, 1)), 'noCountry') AS country, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[3], '[.]')[0], '') AS language, do_type, ad_count FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_act_shop WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), tbl2 AS (SELECT content, content_type, country, LANGUAGE, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e4 FROM tbl1 WHERE do_type = 1 GROUP BY content, content_type, country, LANGUAGE), tbl3 AS (SELECT content, content_type, country, LANGUAGE, SUM(ad_count) AS e1, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e2, SUM(CASE WHEN do_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS e3 FROM tbl1 GROUP BY content, content_type, country, LANGUAGE) INSERT INTO mt_ads.mlbb_inside_publish_country PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT '6b' AS rod_location, tbl3.content, tbl3.content_type, tbl3.country, tbl3.LANGUAGE AS LANGUAGE, COALESCE(tbl3.e1, 0) AS impression_cnt, COALESCE(tbl3.e2, 0) AS reach_cnt, COALESCE(tbl3.e3, 0) AS click_cnt, COALESCE(tbl2.e4, 0) AS click_uniq_cnt, 0 AS ad_position, 0 AS redpoint_type FROM tbl3 LEFT JOIN tbl2 ON tbl3.content_type = tbl2.content_type AND tbl3.content = tbl2.content AND tbl3.LANGUAGE = tbl2.LANGUAGE AND tbl3.country = tbl2.country WHERE NOT tbl3.content IS NULL AND NOT tbl3.country IS NULL

/* 广告精选（23）-- */ WITH tbl1 AS (SELECT redpoint_type, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(eventpicid, '/')[5], '-')[1], '') AS content, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(eventpicid, '/')[5], '-')[2], '') AS content_type, COALESCE(LOWER(GEOIP(ip, 1)), 'noCountry') AS country, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(eventpicid, '/')[5], '-')[3], '[.]')[0], '') AS language, accountid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_new_eventhallrecord WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND controller_typeid = 0 AND content_type < 5), tbl AS (SELECT redpoint_type, content, content_type, country, language, COUNT(accountid) AS e1, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e2 FROM tbl1 GROUP BY content, content_type, country, LANGUAGE, redpoint_type), login_tbl_raw AS (SELECT COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(eventpicid, '/')[5], '-')[1], '') AS content, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(eventpicid, '/')[5], '-')[2], '') AS content_type, COALESCE(LOWER(GEOIP(ip, 1)), 'noCountry') AS country, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(eventpicid, '/')[5], '-')[3], '[.]')[0], '') AS language, redpoint_type, accountid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_new_eventhallrecord WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND controller_typeid = 1), login_tbl AS (SELECT content, content_type, country, language, redpoint_type, COUNT(accountid) AS e3, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e4 FROM login_tbl_raw GROUP BY content, content_type, country, language, redpoint_type) INSERT INTO mt_ads.mlbb_inside_publish_country PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT '23' AS rod_location, content, content_type, country, language, COALESCE(MAX(e1), 0) AS impression_cnt, COALESCE(MAX(e2), 0) AS reach_cnt, COALESCE(MAX(e3), 0) AS click_cnt, COALESCE(MAX(e4), 0) AS click_uniq_cnt, MIN(ad_position) AS ad_position, redpoint_type FROM (SELECT t.content, t.content_type, t.country, t.language, t.e1, t.e2, t1.e3, t1.e4, 0 AS ad_position, t.redpoint_type FROM tbl AS t LEFT JOIN login_tbl AS t1 ON t.content = t1.content AND t.content_type = t1.content_type AND t.language = t1.language AND t.country = t1.country AND t.redpoint_type = t1.redpoint_type) AS f WHERE NOT content IS NULL AND NOT country IS NULL GROUP BY content, content_type, country, language, redpoint_type

/* 特殊热点活动（108） -- */ WITH tbl1 AS (SELECT accountid, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[1], '') AS content, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[2], '') AS content_type, COALESCE(LOWER(GEOIP(ip, 1)), 'noCountry') AS country, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[3], '[.]')[0], '') AS language, do_type FROM ml_ods.connserver_activity108_report WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), tbl2 AS (SELECT content, content_type, country, language, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e4 FROM tbl1 WHERE do_type = 1 GROUP BY content, content_type, country, language), tbl3 AS (SELECT content, content_type, country, language, COUNT(accountid) AS e1, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e2, SUM(CASE WHEN do_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS e3 FROM tbl1 WHERE LENGTH(content_type) < 5 GROUP BY content, content_type, country, language) INSERT INTO mt_ads.mlbb_inside_publish_country PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT '108' AS rod_location, tbl3.content, tbl3.content_type, tbl3.country, tbl3.language AS language, COALESCE(tbl3.e1, 0) AS impression_cnt, COALESCE(tbl3.e2, 0) AS reach_cnt, COALESCE(tbl3.e3, 0) AS click_cnt, COALESCE(tbl2.e4, 0) AS click_uniq_cnt, 0 AS ad_position, 0 AS redpoint_type FROM tbl3 LEFT JOIN tbl2 ON tbl3.content_type = tbl2.content_type AND tbl3.content = tbl2.content AND tbl3.country = tbl2.country AND tbl3.language = tbl2.language WHERE NOT tbl3.content IS NULL AND NOT tbl3.country IS NULL

/*  文本图片广告（128） --- */ WITH tbl1 AS (SELECT COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[1], '') AS content, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[2], '') AS content_type, COALESCE(LOWER(GEOIP(ip, 1)), 'noCountry') AS country, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(ad_picture, '/')[5], '-')[3], '[.]')[0], '') AS language, accountid, isjump, redpoint_type FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_act_noticeads WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), tbl2 AS (SELECT content, content_type, country, language, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e4 FROM tbl1 WHERE isjump = 1 GROUP BY content, content_type, country, language), tbl3 AS (SELECT content, redpoint_type, content_type, country, language, COUNT(accountid) AS e1, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e2, SUM(CASE WHEN isjump = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS e3 FROM tbl1 GROUP BY content, content_type, country, language, redpoint_type) INSERT INTO mt_ads.mlbb_inside_publish_country PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT '128' AS rod_location, tbl3.content, tbl3.content_type, tbl3.country, tbl3.language, COALESCE(tbl3.e1, 0) AS impression_cnt, COALESCE(tbl3.e2, 0) AS reach_cnt, COALESCE(tbl3.e3, 0) AS click_cnt, COALESCE(tbl2.e4, 0) AS click_uniq_cnt, 0 AS ad_position, COALESCE(redpoint_type, 0) AS redpoint_type FROM tbl3 LEFT JOIN tbl2 ON tbl3.content_type = tbl2.content_type AND tbl3.content = tbl2.content AND tbl3.country = tbl2.country AND tbl3.language = tbl2.language WHERE NOT tbl3.content IS NULL AND NOT tbl3.country IS NULL

/* #  288-1:魔法战棋,288-2:塔防迷棋  . action_type 0是曝光和覆盖, 1是点击 -- */ WITH tbl1 AS (SELECT accountid, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(pic_name, '/')[5], '-')[1], '') AS content, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(pic_name, '/')[5], '-')[2], '') AS content_type, COALESCE(LOWER(GEOIP(ip, 1)), '-') AS country, COALESCE(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(pic_name, '/')[5], '-')[3], '[.]')[0], '') AS language, do_type, action_type FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_chest_data WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND do_type IN (1, 2)), tbl2 AS (SELECT do_type, content, content_type, country, language, COUNT(accountid) AS e1, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e2 FROM tbl1 WHERE action_type = 0 GROUP BY do_type, content, content_type, country, language), tbl3 AS (SELECT do_type, content, content_type, country, language, COUNT(accountid) AS e3, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS e4 FROM tbl1 WHERE action_type = 1 GROUP BY do_type, content, content_type, country, LANGUAGE) INSERT INTO mt_ads.mlbb_inside_publish_country PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT CASE WHEN tbl2.do_type = 1 THEN '228-1' ELSE '228-2' END AS rod_location, tbl2.content, tbl2.content_type, tbl2.country, tbl2.language AS language, COALESCE(tbl2.e1, 0) AS impression_cnt, COALESCE(tbl2.e2, 0) AS reach_cnt, COALESCE(tbl3.e3, 0) AS click_cnt, COALESCE(tbl3.e4, 0) AS click_uniq_cnt, 0 AS ad_position, 0 AS redpoint_type FROM tbl2 LEFT JOIN tbl3 ON tbl2.content_type = tbl3.content_type AND tbl2.do_type = tbl3.do_type AND tbl2.content = tbl3.content AND tbl2.country = tbl3.country AND tbl2.language = tbl3.language WHERE NOT tbl2.content IS NULL AND NOT tbl2.country IS NULL

name: bytedance_export.mtwb_ods.webreportserver_track_event_new
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.webreportserver_track_event_new PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, loghms, ip, did, project, meta_event, properties, body, uuid FROM mtwb_ods.webreportserver_track_event WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* and  get_json_object(properties,'$.event_name') in ('visit','page_enter','download') */ NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')

name: 商业化破冰_付费渗透监控数据ads_datawind_wmz_income_pobing_act_data_mi
output_hint: 商业化破冰_付费渗透监控数据ads_datawind_wmz_income_pobing_act_data_mi
sql_units: /*         -- mi数据 */ WITH his_charge_t AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN ROUND(money_sum, 2) >= 99.99 THEN 99.99 WHEN ROUND(money_sum, 2) >= 49.99 THEN 49.99 WHEN ROUND(money_sum, 2) >= 19.99 THEN 19.99 WHEN ROUND(money_sum, 2) >= 9.99 THEN 9.99 WHEN ROUND(money_sum, 2) >= 4.99 THEN 4.99 WHEN ROUND(money_sum, 2) >= 1.99 THEN 1.99 WHEN ROUND(money_sum, 2) >= 0.99 THEN 0.99 WHEN ROUND(money_sum, 2) >= 0.01 THEN 0.01 ELSE -1 END AS charge_lvl FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', '当天', '历史') AS logymd_type, SUM(money) / 100 AS money_sum FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' /* 消费统计周期的前1日 */ AND zoneid <= 57000 AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND is_sandbox = 0 /* 排除沙盒测试数据，没收入 */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据，因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS a), sup_col_t AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY item_id) AS index_num, 1 AS sup_col FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01'), charge_result AS (/* 历史付费情况 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, CASE WHEN charge_lvl = his_max_charge_lvl AND DATEDIFF(logymd, his_max_charge_logymd) > 90 THEN '付费唤醒' WHEN charge_lvl > his_max_charge_lvl OR his_max_charge_lvl IS NULL THEN '生涯破冰' ELSE '其他' END AS his_charge_type, charge_lvl AS charge_lvl, his_max_charge_lvl, CASE WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 99.99 THEN 99.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 49.99 THEN 49.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 19.99 THEN 19.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 9.99 THEN 9.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 4.99 THEN 4.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 1.99 THEN 1.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 0.99 THEN 0.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 0.01 THEN 0.01 ELSE -1 END AS his_charge_lvl FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.charge_lvl, a.logymd, MAX(ARRAY(b.charge_lvl, b.logymd))[1] AS his_max_charge_logymd, MAX(b.charge_lvl) AS his_max_charge_lvl, SUM(b.money_sum) + AVG(a.money_sum) AS his_money_sum /* 含当日累计充值 */ FROM his_charge_t AS a LEFT JOIN his_charge_t AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.logymd > b.logymd WHERE SUBSTRING(a.logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.charge_lvl, a.logymd) AS a), act AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_ai = 0), month_charge_t AS (/* 每个人每天历史累计/月累计付费 */ SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.logymd, SUM(COALESCE(money_sum, 0)) AS his_money_sum /* 历史至今付费情况 */, SUM(IF(SUBSTRING(c.logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), money_sum, 0)) AS month_money_sum /* 当月至今付费 */, SUM(IF(SUBSTRING(c.logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND c.logymd < a.logymd, money_sum, 0)) AS month_money_sum_last_day /* 当月至昨天付费 */, SUM(IF(c.logymd = a.logymd, money_sum, 0)) AS day_money_sum /* 当天付费 */ FROM act AS a LEFT JOIN his_charge_t AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.logymd >= c.logymd /* 截止这天历史付费 */ GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.logymd), month_acc_act AS (SELECT min_logymd, user_cnt, SUM(user_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY min_logymd) AS acc_user_cnt FROM (SELECT min_logymd, COUNT(1) AS user_cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, MIN(logymd) AS min_logymd FROM act GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a GROUP BY min_logymd) AS t), month_acc_charge AS (SELECT month_pobing, logymd, pay_cnt, SUM(pay_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY month_pobing ORDER BY logymd) AS pay_cnt_acc FROM (SELECT IF(b.month_lvl BETWEEN month_charge_lvl_last_day AND month_charge_lvl AND month_charge_lvl > month_charge_lvl_last_day AND month_lvl > month_charge_lvl_last_day, b.month_lvl, -1) AS month_pobing, logymd, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid) AS pay_cnt FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum, 2) >= 99.99 THEN 99.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum, 2) >= 49.99 THEN 49.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum, 2) >= 19.99 THEN 19.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum, 2) >= 9.99 THEN 9.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum, 2) >= 4.99 THEN 4.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum, 2) >= 1.99 THEN 1.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum, 2) >= 0.99 THEN 0.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum, 2) >= 0.01 THEN 0.01 ELSE -1 END AS month_charge_lvl, CASE WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum_last_day, 2) >= 99.99 THEN 99.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum_last_day, 2) >= 49.99 THEN 49.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum_last_day, 2) >= 19.99 THEN 19.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum_last_day, 2) >= 9.99 THEN 9.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum_last_day, 2) >= 4.99 THEN 4.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum_last_day, 2) >= 1.99 THEN 1.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum_last_day, 2) >= 0.99 THEN 0.99 WHEN ROUND(month_money_sum_last_day, 2) >= 0.01 THEN 0.01 ELSE -1 END AS month_charge_lvl_last_day, 1 AS sup_col, * FROM month_charge_t AS a WHERE month_money_sum > 0 /* 限制有付费 */) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT 99.99 AS month_lvl, 1 AS sup_col UNION ALL SELECT 49.99 AS month_lvl, 1 AS sup_col UNION ALL SELECT 19.99 AS month_lvl, 1 AS sup_col UNION ALL SELECT 9.99 AS month_lvl, 1 AS sup_col UNION ALL SELECT 4.99 AS month_lvl, 1 AS sup_col UNION ALL SELECT 1.99 AS month_lvl, 1 AS sup_col UNION ALL SELECT 0.99 AS month_lvl, 1 AS sup_col UNION ALL SELECT 0.01 AS month_lvl, 1 AS sup_col UNION ALL SELECT -1 AS month_lvl, 1 AS sup_col) AS b ON a.sup_col = b.sup_col GROUP BY month_pobing, logymd)), result_t AS (SELECT his_charge_type AS data_type /* 数据类型:'生涯破冰', '付费唤醒' */, a.logymd, CAST(charge_lvl AS STRING) AS data_type2 /* 充值档位，是否DAU/MAU */, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS ucnt FROM charge_result AS a JOIN act AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.logymd = b.logymd WHERE his_charge_type IN ('生涯破冰', '付费唤醒') GROUP BY his_charge_type, a.logymd, data_type2 UNION ALL SELECT '历史付费DAU' AS data_type /* 数据类型 */, a.logymd, CAST(CASE WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 99.99 THEN 99.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 49.99 THEN 49.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 19.99 THEN 19.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 9.99 THEN 9.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 4.99 THEN 4.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 1.99 THEN 1.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 0.99 THEN 0.99 WHEN ROUND(his_money_sum, 2) >= 0.01 THEN 0.01 ELSE -1 END AS STRING) AS data_type2 /* 充值档位，是否DAU/MAU */, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS ucnt FROM act AS a JOIN month_charge_t AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.logymd = b.logymd WHERE his_money_sum > 0 /* 限制历史付费 */ GROUP BY data_type, a.logymd, data_type2 UNION ALL SELECT '历史付费DAU' AS data_type /* 数据类型 */, logymd, '当日DAU' AS data_type2 /* 充值档位，是否DAU/MAU */, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid) AS ucnt FROM act GROUP BY data_type, logymd, data_type2 UNION ALL SELECT sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: vickyyu2@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-03-17 16:14:32.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH a AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS h1 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mcgg_temp.kyra_black_role_df AS h2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND h1.roleid = h2.roleid AND h1.zoneid = h2.zoneid) GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid), b AS (/* -当天最终段位id */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, season_id, final_rank_id FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(season_id, 0) AS season_id, FIRST_VALUE(new_rank_id) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(season_id, 0) ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS final_rank_id FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_duoplayer_rank_level WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS b GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, season_id, final_rank_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.daily_duoplayer_final_rank_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* --1个did可能对应多个roleid */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, season_id, final_rank_id FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, season_id, FIRST_VALUE(final_rank_id) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(season_id, 0) ORDER BY tag DESC) AS final_rank_id FROM (SELECT tag, roleid, zoneid, season_id, final_rank_id FROM (/* --先算出dau的最新段位，如果当天有段位变化就取当天最终，当天没有就取昨天的df记录 */ SELECT 2 AS tag, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.season_id, CASE WHEN NOT t1.final_rank_id IS NULL THEN t1.final_rank_id ELSE t2.final_rank_id END AS final_rank_id FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN (b.season_id > 0 OR NOT b.season_id IS NULL) THEN b.season_id ELSE b2.season_id END AS season_id, final_rank_id FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, zoneid, MAX(season_id) AS season_id FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_duoplayer_rank_level WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, zoneid) AS b2 ON a.logymd = b2.logymd AND a.zoneid = b2.zoneid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN (b.season_id > 0 OR NOT b.season_id IS NULL) THEN b.season_id ELSE b2.season_id END, final_rank_id) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, season_id, final_rank_id FROM mcgg_temp.daily_duoplayer_final_rank_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t1.season_id = t2.season_id) UNION ALL (SELECT 1 AS tag, roleid, zoneid, season_id, final_rank_id FROM mcgg_temp.daily_duoplayer_final_rank_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30')) AS a) AS a GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, season_id, final_rank_id
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.daily_duoplayer_final_rank_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-03-02') SELECT NULL AS roleid, NULL AS zoneid, NULL AS season_id, NULL AS final_rank_id

name: dujie失败次数嵌套累加表
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_lidw@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-02-19 19:48:09.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH table1 AS (SELECT accountid, dujie_rank, COUNT(1) AS dujie_count FROM (SELECT accountid, logymd, time, battleid, bigranklvl, CASE WHEN bigranklvl = 1 AND rankstar = 9 AND wincamp = 0 THEN 1 /* 渡劫状态筛选 */ WHEN bigranklvl = 2 AND rankstar = 21 AND wincamp = 0 THEN 2 WHEN bigranklvl = 3 AND rankstar = 37 AND wincamp = 0 THEN 3 WHEN bigranklvl = 4 AND rankstar = 62 AND wincamp = 0 THEN 4 WHEN bigranklvl = 5 AND rankstar = 87 AND wincamp = 0 THEN 5 WHEN bigranklvl = 6 AND rankstar = 112 AND wincamp = 0 THEN 6 WHEN bigranklvl = 7 AND rankstar = 136 AND wincamp = 0 THEN 7 WHEN bigranklvl = 7 AND rankstar = 161 AND wincamp = 0 THEN 8 WHEN bigranklvl = 7 AND rankstar = 211 AND wincamp = 0 THEN 9 ELSE 0 END AS dujie_rank FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype = 2 AND fake_ai = 0) WHERE dujie_rank <> 0 GROUP BY accountid, dujie_rank) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.sdw_dujie_count_table1 SELECT COALESCE(a.accountid, b.accountid) AS accountid, COALESCE(a.dujie_rank, b.dujie_rank) AS dujie_rank, COALESCE(a.dujie_count, 0) + COALESCE(b.dujie_count, 0) AS dujie_count FROM ml_temp.sdw_dujie_count_table1 AS a FULL OUTER JOIN table1 AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.dujie_rank = b.dujie_rank

name: 分路占比和排序
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: zibohong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-02-20 22:42:35.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH basic AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, real_road, COUNT(*) AS road_count FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC(CAST('2026-05-31' AS DATE), 'MM') AND LAST_DAY(CAST('2026-05-31' AS DATE)) AND zoneid < 57000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND pvptype = 2 AND bigranklvl > 4 AND real_road IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) /*  AND     ( */ /*             (accountid = 996962377 AND zoneid = 11457) */ /*             OR (accountid = 996954908 AND zoneid = 10978) */ /*             OR (accountid = 996953448 AND zoneid = 10962) */ /*             OR (accountid = 997082360 AND zoneid = 12982) */ /*         ) */ GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, real_road), require_road_stats /* 计算每个玩家的最大单一路战数和总战斗场次 */ AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, MAX(road_count) AS single_max, SUM(road_count) AS total_cnt, CASE WHEN SUM(road_count) > 5 AND MAX(road_count) > 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_require FROM basic GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), road_stats AS (SELECT b.accountid, b.zoneid, b.real_road, b.road_count, CASE WHEN b.road_count <= 3 THEN 0.01 ELSE b.road_count END AS adj_road_count FROM basic AS b), total_games AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, SUM(adj_road_count) AS adj_total_count FROM road_stats GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), lane_ratios AS (SELECT r.accountid, r.zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN r.real_road = 1 THEN r.adj_road_count * 1.0 / t.adj_total_count ELSE 0 END) AS exp_lane_ratio, SUM(CASE WHEN r.real_road = 2 THEN r.adj_road_count * 1.0 / t.adj_total_count ELSE 0 END) AS mid_lane_ratio, SUM(CASE WHEN r.real_road = 3 THEN r.adj_road_count * 1.0 / t.adj_total_count ELSE 0 END) AS support_lane_ratio, SUM(CASE WHEN r.real_road = 4 THEN r.adj_road_count * 1.0 / t.adj_total_count ELSE 0 END) AS jungle_ratio, SUM(CASE WHEN r.real_road = 5 THEN r.adj_road_count * 1.0 / t.adj_total_count ELSE 0 END) AS gold_lane_ratio FROM road_stats AS r JOIN total_games AS t ON r.accountid = t.accountid AND r.zoneid = t.zoneid GROUP BY r.accountid, r.zoneid), lane_unpivot AS (SELECT r.accountid, r.zoneid, r.real_road AS lane, r.adj_road_count * 1.0 / t.adj_total_count AS ratio FROM road_stats AS r JOIN total_games AS t ON r.accountid = t.accountid AND r.zoneid = t.zoneid), lane_ranked AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, lane, ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY ratio DESC) AS RANK FROM lane_unpivot), sort AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN RANK = 1 THEN ratio END) AS max_ratio, MAX(CASE WHEN RANK = 2 THEN ratio END) AS second_ratio, MAX(CASE WHEN RANK = 3 THEN ratio END) AS third_ratio, MAX(CASE WHEN RANK = 4 THEN ratio END) AS fourth_ratio, MAX(CASE WHEN RANK = 5 THEN ratio END) AS fifth_ratio FROM lane_ranked GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), lane_counts /* 计算原始分路场次（未调整过的 road_count） */ AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN real_road = 1 THEN road_count ELSE 0 END) AS exp_count, SUM(CASE WHEN real_road = 2 THEN road_count ELSE 0 END) AS mid_count, SUM(CASE WHEN real_road = 3 THEN road_count ELSE 0 END) AS sup_count, SUM(CASE WHEN real_road = 4 THEN road_count ELSE 0 END) AS jungle_count, SUM(CASE WHEN real_road = 5 THEN road_count ELSE 0 END) AS gold_count FROM basic GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), ranked AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, real_road, road_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY road_count DESC) AS RANK FROM basic), road_chinese AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, real_road, road_count, RANK, CASE WHEN real_road = 1 THEN '经验' WHEN real_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN real_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN real_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN real_road = 5 THEN '金币' ELSE '未知' END AS road_chinese FROM ranked), tbale_one AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN RANK = 1 THEN road_chinese END) AS first_road, MAX(CASE WHEN RANK = 2 THEN road_chinese END) AS second_road FROM road_chinese GROUP BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY accountid, zoneid), table_two AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, exp_lane_ratio, mid_lane_ratio, support_lane_ratio, jungle_ratio, gold_lane_ratio, max_ratio, second_ratio, third_ratio, fourth_ratio, fifth_ratio, rrs.if_require, rrs.total_cnt, lc.exp_count, lc.mid_count, lc.sup_count, lc.jungle_count, lc.gold_count, CASE WHEN rrs.if_require = 1 THEN CASE WHEN (third_ratio + fourth_ratio + fifth_ratio) > 0.4 THEN '多面手' WHEN max_ratio / second_ratio <= 3 THEN '双分路' ELSE '单一分路' END ELSE 'unrequired' /* --被过滤掉的 */ END AS category FROM lane_ratios AS a JOIN sort AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid JOIN require_road_stats AS rrs ON a.accountid = rrs.accountid AND a.zoneid = rrs.zoneid JOIN lane_counts AS lc ON a.accountid = lc.accountid AND a.zoneid = lc.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.zibo_hong_mounth_player_road_tag_v3 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT mv.accountid, mv.zoneid, total_cnt, exp_count, mid_count, sup_count, jungle_count, gold_count, category, first_road, second_road, CASE WHEN category = '双分路' THEN CONCAT(first_road, '/', second_road) /* 拼接 first_road 和 second_road */ WHEN category = '单一分路' THEN CONCAT(first_road, '') /* 只取 first_road */ WHEN category = '多面手' THEN '多面手' /* 多面手 */ ELSE 'unrequired' /* --被过滤掉的 */ END AS road_tag FROM table_two AS mv JOIN tbale_one AS co ON mv.accountid = co.accountid AND mv.zoneid = co.zoneid

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_mcgg_charge_order_di
sql_units: /* 渠道id Mapping */ WITH receipt_mapping AS (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_type, CAST(pay_channel AS BIGINT) AS pay_channel, TRIM(LOWER(pay_channel_name)) AS pay_channel_name FROM mt_dim.dim_receipt_mapping_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_receipt_mapping_di WHERE logymd > '0' AND appid = 'mcgg') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE appid = 'mcgg' AND CAST(pay_channel AS BIGINT) <> 0 AND d1.logymd > '0'), currency_exchange /* 月度平均汇率: 跨游戏项目通用, 来源XE网站数据：https://xecdapi.xe.com */ AS (SELECT currency, AVG(exchange_rate) AS exchange_rate FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_exchange_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-30' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY currency), currency_country_mapping /* 国家货币 Mapping: 跨游戏项目通用, 人工运维 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT currency, country, country_name FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_country_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_country_di WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0'), dim_charge_calibration_df /* 充值校准配置表: ML的表mt_dim.dim_charge_calibration_df 无APPID, 需要看是否做新表 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(LOWER(pay_channel)) AS pay_channel /* game_pay_channel */, TRIM(LOWER(sub_pay_channel)) AS sub_pay_channel, country_type, country, currency_type, TRIM(LOWER(single_currency_muti_country_type)) AS single_currency_muti_country_type, is_orderid_match /* 单币种多国家处理逻辑 */, TRIM(IF(single_currency_muti_country_type <> '-', SPLIT(LOWER(single_currency_muti_country_type), '\\+')[0], '-')) AS scmc_currency /* 单币种多国家的货币类型 */, TRIM(IF(single_currency_muti_country_type <> '-', SPLIT(LOWER(single_currency_muti_country_type), '\\+')[1], '-')) AS scmc_country /* 单币种多国家的国家校准方式 */, TRIM(IF(single_currency_muti_country_type <> '-', SPLIT(LOWER(single_currency_muti_country_type), '\\+')[2], '-')) AS scmc_prcie /* 单币种多国家的货币校准方式   */, SPLIT(LOWER(currency), '\\+')[0] AS currency_desc /* 非单币种多国家的货币校准方式 */, SPLIT(LOWER(currency), '\\+')[1] AS price_desc /* 非单币种多国家的货币金额 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_mcgg_charge_calibration_df AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_mcgg_charge_calibration_df WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0'), paychannel_rate /* 渠道税率：跨游戏项目不通用, 人工运维 */ AS (/* -- 正式表 */ /* SELECT */ /*     DISTINCT */ /*     start_day, country, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, rate, share, is_tax, is_pay_tax, is_back_tax, is_fuzzy_match, has_share_tax */ /*     , LEAD(start_day, 1, CURRENT_DATE()) OVER(PARTITION BY country, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel ORDER BY start_day) AS end_day */ /* FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_rate_di d1 */ /* WHERE  logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2025-03-03', '2025-03-03', '2026-05-31') */ /* AND   TRIM(LOWER(appid)) = 'mcgg' */ /* 上线前回刷 */ SELECT DISTINCT start_day, TRIM(LOWER(country)) AS country, TRIM(LOWER(pay_channel)) AS pay_channel, TRIM(LOWER(sub_pay_channel)) AS sub_pay_channel, rate, share, is_tax, is_pay_tax, is_back_tax, is_fuzzy_match, has_share_tax, LEAD(TRIM(start_day), 1, '9999-12-31') OVER (PARTITION BY TRIM(LOWER(country)), TRIM(LOWER(pay_channel)), TRIM(LOWER(sub_pay_channel)) ORDER BY TRIM(start_day)) AS end_day FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_rate_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_rate_di WHERE logymd > '0' AND appid = 'mcgg') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0' AND appid = 'mcgg'), paychannel_fee /* 渠道手续费: 跨游戏项目不通用, 人工运维 */ AS (/* -- 正式表 */ /* SELECT country, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, fee_currency, fee_amt */ /* FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_fee_di */ /* WHERE appid = 'mcgg' AND logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2025-03-03', '2025-03-03', '2026-05-31') */ /* 上线前回刷 */ SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(LOWER(country)) AS country, TRIM(LOWER(pay_channel)) AS pay_channel, TRIM(LOWER(sub_pay_channel)) AS sub_pay_channel, TRIM(UPPER(fee_currency)) AS fee_currency, fee_amt FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_fee_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_fee_di WHERE logymd > '0' AND appid = 'mcgg') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0' AND appid = 'mcgg'), productmoney_change /* 商品价格调整配置： */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, country, ip_country, product_id, currency, original_amt, change_amt, start_date, end_date FROM mt_dim.dim_productmoney_change_new_df WHERE logymd > '0' AND logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_productmoney_change_new_df WHERE logymd > '0' AND TRIM(LOWER(appid)) = 'mcgg') AND TRIM(LOWER(appid)) = 'mcgg'), no_price_product /* 商品的价格和货币: MCGG GP无定价商品 receipt_type = 80 做信息补全, 暂时无该业务留作备用 */ AS (SELECT product_id, localprice, currency FROM (SELECT t1.product_id, t1.localprice, t1.currency, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.product_id ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT time, product_id, localprice, currency FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd >= '2026-04-30' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND receipt_type = 80 AND COALESCE(localprice, 0) > 0) AS t1 LEFT SEMI JOIN (/* 无定价数据 */ SELECT product_id FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND receipt_type = 80 AND COALESCE(localprice, 0) = 0 GROUP BY product_id) AS t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id) AS t WHERE rn = 1), ods_charge_disticnt /* charge 日志去重 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT `time`, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, sex, device, os_type, createrole_country, client_ip, channel, product_id, base_diamond, chargediamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_id, receipt_type, product, device_id, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, is_iap_token_buy, operator, interfacetype, currency, CASE WHEN receipt_type IN (77, 74) AND logymd <= '2025-03-25' THEN localprice * 100 WHEN receipt_type = 50 AND `time` < CAST('2025-02-07 02:32:47' AS TIMESTAMP) THEN localprice * 100 ELSE localprice END AS localprice, money, local_currency, local_price, money_new, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), charge_all /* charge 标准化数据 */ AS (SELECT `time`, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, sex, device, os_type, createrole_country, client_ip, channel, product_id, base_diamond, chargediamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_id, receipt_type, product, device_id, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, is_iap_token_buy, operator, interfacetype, localprice, money, local_price, money_new, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, logymd /* 土耳其错误货币缩写纠正 / 塞拉利昂更换货币缩写 */, CASE WHEN UPPER(currency) IN ('TRI', 'TRY') THEN 'TRY' WHEN UPPER(currency) IN ('SLE', 'SLL') THEN 'SLE' ELSE UPPER(currency) END AS currency, CASE WHEN UPPER(local_currency) IN ('TRI', 'TRY') THEN 'TRY' WHEN UPPER(local_currency) IN ('SLE', 'SLL') THEN 'SLE' ELSE UPPER(local_currency) END AS local_currency FROM (/* 有定价的数据 */ SELECT `time`, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, sex, device, os_type, createrole_country, client_ip, channel, product_id, base_diamond, chargediamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_id, receipt_type, product, device_id, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, is_iap_token_buy, operator, interfacetype, currency, localprice, money, local_currency, local_price, money_new, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, logymd FROM ods_charge_disticnt WHERE (receipt_type <> 80 OR COALESCE(localprice, 0) > 0) UNION ALL /* GP 规范无定价商品: 补全价格和货币 */ SELECT `time`, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, sex, device, os_type, createrole_country, client_ip, channel, a.product_id, base_diamond, sql_units: WITH base_info AS (SELECT roleid, event, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, `TIME`, 'login' AS event FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, `TIME`, 'logout' AS event FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, `TIME`, 'charge' AS event FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, `TIME`, 'pve' AS event FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_fight_pve WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) /* 先锋服 */ OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) /* 欧美 */ OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001) /* 亚太 */) AND (zoneid DIV 1000) <> 9 /* 排除内部测试用户 */) AS t GROUP BY roleid, event, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300)), t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country FROM bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df_tmp WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-02-23', '2025-02-23', '2026-05-31') GROUP BY roleid, first_mt_country), t_basic_active AS (SELECT t_basic.roleid, t_basic.first_mt_country AS country, base_info.point, base_info.event FROM t_basic JOIN base_info ON t_basic.roleid = base_info.roleid), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-02-01', '2025-02-01', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'zgame_synclog'), t_login_base AS (SELECT point, country, SUM(point_cnt) AS point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT point, country, point_cnt, ct AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT point, country, 0 AS point_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS ct FROM (SELECT roleid, country, MIN(point) AS point FROM t_basic_active GROUP BY roleid, country) AS t GROUP BY point, country) AS t3 UNION ALL SELECT point, country, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS point_cnt, 0 AS day_cnt FROM t_basic_active WHERE event = 'login' GROUP BY point, country) AS t GROUP BY point, country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_login` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'zgame', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country, '' AS network, point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname ORDER BY point) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_login_base.point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt, COALESCE(t_login_base.day_cnt, 0) AS day_cnt, t_incr.appname FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_login_base ON t_incr.country = t_login_base.country AND t_incr.point = t_login_base.point) AS t1

name: etl.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di_zgame_account_daily
sql_units: WITH real_country_online AS (SELECT div_time, IF(country = '' OR country IS NULL OR country = '-', 'unknown', country) AS country, SUM(real_online_num) AS online_num FROM (SELECT `TIME`, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`TIME`) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time, LOWER(country_type) AS country, zone_id, COALESCE(online_num, 0) AS real_online_num /* 真实玩家在线人数 */, logymd FROM zgame_damai_ods.connserver_t_real_country_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zone_id = 1 OR zone_id BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zone_id BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zone_id >= 70001))) GROUP BY div_time, IF(country = '' OR country IS NULL OR country = '-', 'unknown', country)), dim_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 1 AS region_type, act_geo_continent AS region FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_country) /* 取最新 */ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 0 AS region_type, region FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_country) /* 取最新 */), online_cube AS (/* 分国家和区域 */ SELECT region_type, region, country, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, AVG(online_num) AS acu FROM (SELECT con.region_type, con.region, lin.country, lin.div_time, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_country_online AS lin LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con ON lin.country = con.country_code GROUP BY con.region_type, con.region, lin.country, lin.div_time, GROUPING SETS ((con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region, lin.country), (con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region), (con.region_type, lin.div_time, lin.country), (con.region_type, lin.div_time))) GROUP BY region_type, region, country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, 'all' AS network, COALESCE(ROUND(pcu, 0), 0) AS pcu, COALESCE(ROUND(acu, 0), 0) AS acu, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, 'zgame' AS appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'daily' AS date_type FROM online_cube

's3a://mt-dwm/table/dwm_charge_role_zone_product_di'; */ WITH currency_dbexchage AS (SELECT DISTINCT currency, currency_ch, CAST(db_exchage AS DOUBLE) AS db_exchange_rate FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_currency_dbexchage AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_currency_dbexchage WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0'), dwd_payment_raw AS (SELECT d1.* FROM mt_dwd.dwd_payment_charge_order_df AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dwd.dwd_payment_charge_order_df WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0' AND merchant_type = 2 AND d1.app_id = 100000 AND d1.zoneid <> 0 AND pdate_utc8 = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(before_tax_amt, 0) > 0), dwd_charge_role_zone_product AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.first_mt_country /* 用户注册国家 */, bill_country AS country /* 充值国家 */, before_tax_currency AS currency /* 充值货币 */, IF(pay_channel = 0, 'cashcard', game_pay_channel) AS pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, 0 AS is_merchant, 0 AS merchant_tax_share, product_id, base_diamond, money AS usd_price /* 商品美金定价 */, local_price, tax_rate, share_ratio, currency_exchange_rate, c.db_exchange_rate, SUM(IF(COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 0) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), 1, 0)) AS pay_cnt, SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), before_tax_amt, 0)) AS before_tax_amt, SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), before_tax_amt, 0)) / currency_exchange_rate AS before_tax_usd_amt, SUM(IF(COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 0) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), actual_amt, 0)) AS actual_amt, SUM(IF(COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 0) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), actual_amt, 0)) / currency_exchange_rate AS actual_usd_amt, SUM(IF(COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 0) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), actual_amt, 0)) / currency_exchange_rate / SUM(IF(COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 0) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), a.money, 0)) AS actual_ratio, SUM(IF(COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 0) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), share_amt, 0)) AS share_amt, SUM(IF(COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 0) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), share_amt, 0)) / currency_exchange_rate AS share_usd_amt, SUM(IF(COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 0) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), tax_amt, 0)) AS tax_amt, SUM(IF(COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 0) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), tax_amt, 0)) / currency_exchange_rate AS tax_usd_amt, SUM(IF(COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 0) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), money, 0)) AS product_money FROM mt_dwd.dwd_charge_order_di AS a LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS b ON b.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND b.appid = 'mlbb' AND a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN currency_dbexchage AS c ON UPPER(a.before_tax_currency) = UPPER(c.currency) WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(bill_amt, 0) > 0 AND LOWER(product_id) NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.first_mt_country /* 用户注册国家 */, bill_country /* 充值国家 */, before_tax_currency /* 充值货币 */, IF(pay_channel = 0, 'cashcard', game_pay_channel), sub_pay_channel, product_id, base_diamond, local_price, money, tax_rate, share_ratio, currency_exchange_rate, c.db_exchange_rate HAVING COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), before_tax_amt, 0)), 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(SUM(IF(COALESCE(is_iap_token_buy, 0) = 1, bill_amt, 0)), 0) > 0 /* 排除虚拟代币数据，没收入 */ OR COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, bill_amt, 0)), 0) > 0 /* 排除沙盒测试数据，没收入 */), dwd_payment_role_zone_product AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, LOWER(COALESCE(b.first_mt_country, IF(a.first_mt_country = '' OR a.first_mt_country IS NULL, 'unknown', a.first_mt_country))) AS first_mt_country /* 用户注册国家 */, country /* 充值国家 */, currency /* 充值货币 */, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, IF(merchant_type = 2, 1, 0) AS is_merchant, IF(merchant_type = 2, share_amt, 0) AS merchant_tax_share, product_id, base_diamond, usd_price /* 商品美金定价 */, local_price, 0 AS tax_rate, share_ratio, currency_exchange_rate, db_exchange_rate, COUNT(1) AS pay_cnt, SUM(before_tax_amt) AS before_tax_amt, SUM(before_tax_amt) / currency_exchange_rate AS before_tax_usd_amt, SUM(actual_amt) AS actual_amt, SUM(actual_amt) / currency_exchange_rate AS actual_usd_amt, SUM(actual_amt) / currency_exchange_rate / SUM(usd_price) AS actual_ratio, SUM(share_amt) AS share_amt, SUM(share_amt) / currency_exchange_rate AS share_usd_amt, SUM(tax_amt) AS tax_amt, SUM(tax_amt) / currency_exchange_rate AS tax_usd_amt, SUM(usd_price) AS product_money FROM dwd_payment_raw AS a LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS b ON b.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND b.appid = 'mlbb' AND a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, LOWER(COALESCE(b.first_mt_country, IF(a.first_mt_country = '' OR a.first_mt_country IS NULL, 'unknown', a.first_mt_country))), country /* 充值国家 */, currency /* 充值货币 */, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, IF(merchant_type = 2, 1, 0), IF(merchant_type = 2, share_amt, 0), product_id, base_diamond, usd_price /* 商品美金定价 */, local_price, share_ratio, currency_exchange_rate, db_exchange_rate) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_product_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb', source) SELECT *, 'charge' AS source FROM dwd_charge_role_zone_product UNION ALL SELECT sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: helenma@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-03-12 21:50:14.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mt_dwd`.`dwd_payment_charge_order_df`( */ /* 		trans_number string COMMENT '交易流水号ID', */ /* 		pay_order_id string COMMENT '支付订单ID', */ /* 		pay_method bigint COMMENT '支付方式ID', */ /* 		pay_status bigint COMMENT '支付订单状态', */ /* 		roleid decimal(20,0) COMMENT '角色ID', */ /* 		zoneid bigint COMMENT '分区ID', */ /* 		first_mt_country string COMMENT '注册国家', */ /* 		country string COMMENT '充值国家', */ /* 		currency string COMMENT '充值货币', */ /* 		pay_channel string COMMENT '支付渠道', */ /* 		sub_pay_channel string COMMENT '子支付渠道', */ /* 		product_id string COMMENT '商品ID', */ /* 		base_diamond bigint COMMENT '钻石档位:0', */ /* 		usd_price bigint COMMENT '美金定价 (money)', */ /* 		local_price bigint COMMENT '本地定价', */ /* 		currency_exchange_rate decimal(38,18) COMMENT '当前汇率', */ /* 		db_exchange_rate decimal(38,18) COMMENT '数据库汇率', */ /* 		trade_id string COMMENT '外部的业务id', */ /* 		mtpp_id bigint COMMENT '用户ID', */ /* 		merchant_id bigint COMMENT '渠道商ID', */ /* 		merchant_type bigint COMMENT '渠道商类型', */ /* 		merchant_goods_id bigint COMMENT '渠道下单商品', */ /* 		merchant_pay_channel_id bigint COMMENT '', */ /* 		merchant_tax_share decimal(38,18) COMMENT '分销商的税率和分成', */ /* 		before_tax_amt decimal(38,18) COMMENT '定价流水金额 (单位: 本币)', */ /* 		actual_amt decimal(38,18) COMMENT '实收金额 (单位: 本币)', */ /* 		tax_amt decimal(38,18) COMMENT '渠道税金金额: 0 (单位: 本币)', */ /* 		share_ratio decimal(38,18) COMMENT '渠道分成比例', */ /* 		share_amt decimal(38,18) COMMENT '渠道分成金额 (单位: 本币)', */ /* 		app_id bigint COMMENT '应用ID', */ /* 		trans_time_utc0 timestamp COMMENT '交易日志时间UTC-0时区', */ /* 		trans_time_utc8 timestamp COMMENT '交易日志时间UTC-8时区', */ /* 		pdate_utc8   string COMMENT '日期分区(UTC-8)', */ /* 		time_offset   bigint COMMENT '账单子渠道时区 (对比UTC-8时区)', */ /* 		trans_local_time timestamp COMMENT '根据账单子渠道时区', */ /* 		pdate_local  string COMMENT '日期分区(账单子渠道时区)' */ /* ) COMMENT 'pay_method全量交易流水表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` string COMMENT '日期') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dwd/table/dwd_payment_charge_order_df'; */ /* 数据库配置汇率: 人工运维 mt_dim.dim_mlbb_currency_dbexchage */ WITH currency_dbexchage AS (SELECT DISTINCT currency, currency_ch, CAST(db_exchage AS DOUBLE) AS db_exchange_rate FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_currency_dbexchage AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_currency_dbexchage WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0'), currency_exchange /* 月度平均汇率，来源XE网站数据：https://xecdapi.xe.com */ AS (SELECT currency, AVG(exchange_rate) AS currency_exchange_rate FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_exchange_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-30' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY currency), timezone_mapping /* 时区 Mapping */ AS (SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 1, 1) = '-' THEN (CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 2, 2) AS INT) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 5, 2) AS INT) * 60) ELSE -1 * ((CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 1, 2) AS INT) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 4, 2) AS INT) * 60)) END AS timeoffset FROM mt_dim.dim_payment_channel_timezone_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_payment_channel_timezone_di WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0'), payment_order_detail /* mobapay 订单明细 */ AS (SELECT t1.number, t1.pay_order_id, t1.direct_channel_id, t1.status, t1.user_id, t1.server_id, t1.trade_id, t1.app_id, t1.product_id, t1.merchant_goods_id, t1.country_code, t1.currency_code, t1.create_time, t1.merchant_id, t1.merchant_type, t1.merchant_pay_channel_id, t1.pay_channel_code, t1.merchant_price_cent, t1.pay_price_cent, t1.mtpp_id, t2.order_id, t2.user_reg_country, t2.merchant_req_country, t2.merchant_req_currency, t2.merchant_pay_code, t2.delivery_success_time, t2.pay_channel_id, t2.pay_channel_sub_id, t2.game_revenue_cent, t2.moonton_revenue_cent, t2.local_price_cent, t2.usd_price_cent, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(create_time)) AS create_time_utc0, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(create_time) - 8 * 3600) AS create_time_utc8, SUBSTRING(create_time, 1, 10) AS create_pdate_utc0, SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(create_time) - 8 * 3600) AS STRING), 1, 10) AS create_pdate_utc8 FROM mt_ods.db_payment_order_payment_order AS t1 LEFT JOIN mt_ods.db_payment_order_payment_order_detail AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.order_id), payment_order_detail_channel AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN pay_channel = sub_pay_channel_raw THEN sub_pay_channel_raw WHEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(sub_pay_channel_raw, pay_channel, 0) <> '' AND pay_channel = 'razer' THEN SUBSTRING(sub_pay_channel_raw, LENGTH('mt_razer') + 2, LENGTH(sub_pay_channel_raw) - LENGTH('mt_razer') - 1) WHEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(sub_pay_channel_raw, pay_channel, 0) <> '' AND pay_channel <> 'razer' THEN SUBSTRING(sub_pay_channel_raw, LENGTH(pay_channel) + 2, LENGTH(sub_pay_channel_raw) - LENGTH(pay_channel) - 1) ELSE sub_pay_channel_raw END AS sub_pay_channel FROM (SELECT t1.*, t2.shop_name, TRIM(LOWER(t3.code)) AS pay_channel, TRIM(LOWER(t4.cus_code)) AS sub_pay_channel_raw FROM payment_order_detail AS t1 LEFT JOIN mt_ods.db_payment_base_distribution_shop AS t2 ON t1.merchant_id = t2.merchant_id LEFT JOIN mt_ods.db_payment_pay_pay_channel AS t3 ON t1.pay_channel_id = t3.id LEFT JOIN mt_ods.db_payment_pay_pay_channel_sub AS t4 ON t1.pay_channel_sub_id = t4.id) AS tmp) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_payment_charge_order_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT number AS trans_number, pay_order_id /* order_id, */, direct_channel_id AS pay_method, status AS pay_status, a.user_id AS roleid, a.server_id AS zoneid, user_reg_country AS first_mt_country /* b.first_mt_country, */, country_code AS country /* 充值国家, */, currency_code AS currency /* 充值货币, */, a.pay_channel, a.sub_pay_channel, product_id, 0 AS base_diamond, usd_price_cent AS usd_price /* 商品美金定价 */, local_price_cent AS local_price /* 商品本地定价 */, CAST(c1.currency_exchange_rate AS DOUBLE) AS currency_exchange_rate, CAST(c2.db_exchange_rate AS DOUBLE) AS db_exchange_rate, trade_id, mtpp_id, merchant_id, merchant_type, merchant_goods_id, merchant_pay_channel_id, IF(merchant_type = 2, pay_price_cent - moonton_revenue_cent, 0) AS merchant_tax_share, pay_price_cent AS before_tax_amt, moonton_revenue_cent AS actual_amt, 0 AS tax_amt, 0 AS share_ratio, IF(merchant_type = 2, pay_price_cent - moonton_revenue_cent, 0) AS share_amt, app_id, create_time_utc0 AS trans_time_utc0, create_time_utc8 AS trans_time_utc8, create_pdate_utc8 AS pdate_utc8, CAST(c.timeoffset AS BIGINT) AS timeoffset, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(create_time_utc8) + COALESCE(c.timeoffset, 0)) AS trans_local_time, SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(create_time_utc8) + COALESCE(c.timeoffset, 0)) AS STRING), 1, 10) AS pdate_local FROM payment_order_detail_channel AS a LEFT JOIN timezone_mapping AS c ON LOWER(a.pay_channel) = LOWER(c.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(c.sub_pay_channel) LEFT JOIN currency_exchange AS c1 ON UPPER(a.currency_code) = UPPER(c1.currency) LEFT JOIN currency_dbexchage AS c2 ON UPPER(a.currency_code) = UPPER(c2.currency)

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_realtime_retention_daily_msdk
sql_units: /* location 'tos://mt-data-warehouse/mt-ads/table/ads_decismart_mlbb_realtime_retention'; */ WITH t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-10', '2025-01-10', '2026-05-31') AND appid IN (4400, 4280, 4200, 4310)), t AS (SELECT account_id /* ,createtime */, first_mt_country AS country, createdate, app_id AS appid /* ,LEAST(287, (HOUR(register_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(register_time) * 60 + SECOND(register_time)) DIV 300) as point */ FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-01-10', '2025-01-10', '2026-05-30') AND createdate IN ('2026-05-30', '2026-05-25') AND NOT app_id IN (4110, 4210, 4300, 4260, 4400) /* 排除NOVA */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, createdate, appid FROM (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country, createtime, appid, createdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, appid ORDER BY createtime) AS rn FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-06-25', '2025-06-25', '2026-05-31') AND createdate >= '2025-06-25' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND appid IN (4400) AND (zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 /* 亚太 */ OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 /* 亚太 */ OR zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 /* 欧洲 */ OR zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 /* 美国 */)) AS t WHERE rn = 1 AND createdate IN ('2026-05-30', '2026-05-25')), t_login AS (SELECT app_id AS appid, account_id, LEAST(287, (HOUR(day_first_login_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(day_first_login_time) * 60 + SECOND(day_first_login_time)) DIV 300) AS point FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_account_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT app_id IN (4110, 4210, 4260, 4300, 4400) UNION ALL SELECT app_id AS appid, roleid AS account_id, MIN(LEAST(287, (HOUR(day_first_login_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(day_first_login_time) * 60 + SECOND(day_first_login_time)) DIV 300)) AS point FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND app_id IN (4400) AND (zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 /* 亚太 */ OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 /* 亚太 */ OR zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 /* 欧洲 */ OR zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 /* 美国 */) /*   AND app_id  IN  (4110, 4210, 4300, 4260)  --nova */ /*   AND zoneid NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 */ /*   AND zoneid NOT BETWEEN 29000 AND 29999 */ GROUP BY app_id, roleid), t_register /*  GROUP BY case when appid   IN  (4110, 4210, 4300, 4260) then 4300 else appid end,country */ AS (SELECT appid /*  case when appid   IN  (4110, 4210, 4300, 4260) then 4300 else appid end as appid */, country, SUM(register_cnt) AS register_cnt, SUM(register_cnt_7d) AS register_cnt_7d FROM (SELECT appid, country,  `first_mt_country`  string COMMENT '创角来源', */ /*     `activedays`        bigint COMMENT '累计登陆天数', */ /*     `item_category`     string COMMENT '商品品类', */ /*     `item_id`           bigint COMMENT sql_units: WITH real_country_online AS (SELECT div_time, country, SUM(real_online_num) AS online_num FROM (SELECT `TIME`, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`TIME`) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time, LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', country)) AS country, zone_id, COALESCE(online_num, 0) AS real_online_num /* 真实玩家在线人数 */, logymd FROM mh_ods.connserver_t_real_os_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') GROUP BY div_time, country), dim_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 1 AS region_type, act_geo_continent AS region FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_country) /* 取最新 */ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 0 AS region_type, region FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_country) /* 取最新 */), online_cube AS (/* 分国家和区域 */ SELECT region_type, region, country, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, AVG(online_num) AS acu FROM (SELECT con.region_type, con.region, lin.country, lin.div_time, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_country_online AS lin LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con ON lin.country = con.country_code GROUP BY con.region_type, con.region, lin.country, lin.div_time, GROUPING SETS ((con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region, lin.country), (con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region), (con.region_type, lin.div_time, lin.country), (con.region_type, lin.div_time))) GROUP BY region_type, region, country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mla', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, 'all' AS network, COALESCE(ROUND(pcu, 0), 0) AS pcu, COALESCE(ROUND(acu, 0), 0) AS acu FROM online_cube

COALESCE(a.dau, 0) AS dau /*	统计日去重活跃帐号数(登录到游戏内) */, COALESCE(a.wau, 0) AS wau /*	统计周去重活跃帐号数(登录到游戏内) */, COALESCE(a.mau, 0) AS mau /*	统计月去重活跃帐号数(登录到游戏内) */, COALESCE(a.paid_user_cnt, 0) AS paid_user_cnt /*	统计日有付费行为的去重帐号数 */, 'USD' AS currency_type /*	本条数据中金额的币种 */, COALESCE(a.pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt /*	统计日累计付费金额(单位:美分) */, COALESCE(a.year_pay_amt, 0) AS year_pay_amt COALESCE(a.year_pay_extra_amt, 0) AS year_pay_extra_amt /*	统计日汇率校准年初累计至今付费总金额(单位:美分) */, COALESCE(a.total_pay_extra_amt, 0) AS total_pay_extra_amt /*	游戏上线累计至统计日汇率校准付费总金额(单位:美分) */, COALESCE(a.duration_cnt, 0) AS duration_cnt /*	统计日期所有用户的总在线时长 */, COALESCE(a.new_user_cnt_2d, 0) AS new_user_cnt_2d /*	昨日新增的用户数 */, COALESCE(a.new_user_cnt_7d, 0) AS new_user_cnt_7d /*	统计日期前第六天新增的用户数 */, COALESCE(a.new_user_cnt_14d, 0) AS new_user_cnt_14d /*	统计日期前第十三天新增的用户数 */, COALESCE(a.new_user_cnt_30d, 0) AS new_user_cnt_30d /*	统计日期前第二十九天新增的用户数 */, COALESCE(b.new_retention_2d, 0) AS new_retention_2d /*	统计日当天活跃用户在前一天的活跃人数（统计日算第一天） */, COALESCE(b.new_retention_7d, 0) AS new_retention_7d /*	统计日当天活跃用户在前第七天的活跃人数（统计日算第一天） */, COALESCE(b.new_retention_14d, 0) AS new_retention_14d /*	统计日当天活跃用户在前第十四天的活跃人数（统计日算第一天） */, COALESCE(b.new_retention_30d, 0) AS new_retention_30d /*	统计日当天活跃用户在前第三十天的活跃人数（统计日算第一天） */, COALESCE(b.ltv7, 0) AS ltv7 /*	统计日当天活跃用户在前第七天的总付费金额（统计日算第一天） */ FROM (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd, country, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', register_cnt, 0)) AS dnu, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', active_cnt, 0)) AS dau, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', active_cnt_7days, 0)) AS wau /* 新加字段 */, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', active_cnt_30days, 0)) AS mau, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', pay_cnt, 0)) AS paid_user_cnt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', pay_amt, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', year_pay_amt, 0)) AS year_pay_amt /* 新加字段 */, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', his_pay_amt, 0)) AS total_pay_amt /* 新加字段 */, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', pay_amt_exrate, 0)) AS pay_extra_amt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', year_before_tax_usd_amt, 0)) AS year_pay_extra_amt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', his_before_tax_usd_amt, 0)) AS total_pay_extra_amt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', online_dur, 0)) AS duration_cnt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-30', register_cnt, 0)) AS new_user_cnt_2d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-25', register_cnt, 0)) AS new_user_cnt_7d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-18', register_cnt, 0)) AS new_user_cnt_14d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-02', register_cnt, 0)) AS new_user_cnt_30d FROM mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND appname = 'mlbb' AND granularity_type = 'account' AND date_type = 'daily' GROUP BY country) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd, country, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-30', register_reten_cnt[1], 0)) AS new_retention_2d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-25', register_reten_cnt[6], 0)) AS new_retention_7d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-18', register_reten_cnt[13], 0)) AS new_retention_14d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-02', register_reten_cnt[29], 0)) AS new_retention_30d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-25', register_charge_amt[6], 0)) AS ltv7 FROM mt_ads.ads_decismart_reten_ltv_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND appname = 'mlbb' AND granularity_type = 'account' AND date_type = 'daily' GROUP BY country) AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.country = b.country

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: celiaye@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-03-24 19:56:52.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.celiaye_road_contribution_rawdata PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT bigranklvl, battleid, wincamp, kda / 10 AS kda, score / 100 AS score, getmoney * 60 / battletime AS moneypermin, CASE WHEN real_road = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN real_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN real_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN real_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN real_road = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN real_road = 0 THEN '未知' END AS real_road FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT battleid FROM (SELECT battleid, COUNT(1) AS valid_num FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND pvptype = 2 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND logymd BETWEEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), '-01') AND '2026-05-31' AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY battleid) AS b WHERE a.battleid = b.battleid) AND pvptype = 2 AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90) AND logymd BETWEEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), '-01') AND '2026-05-31' /* -时间窗口 */ AND fake_ai = 0 AND bigranklvl >= 5 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1

sql_units: WITH base_info AS (SELECT roleid, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point FROM (/* 本表所有的ods role zone 全集，一般情况下login和logout等于全集，为防止遗漏，拼接上所有表 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, TIME FROM mh_ods.gameserver_login /* 登录 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND reconn = 0) AS t GROUP BY roleid, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300)), t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-02-23', '2025-02-23', '2026-05-31') GROUP BY roleid, first_mt_country), t_basic_active AS (SELECT t_basic.roleid, t_basic.first_mt_country AS country, base_info.point FROM t_basic JOIN base_info ON t_basic.roleid = base_info.roleid), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-03-23', '2025-03-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mla_synclog'), t_login_base AS (SELECT point, country, SUM(point_cnt) AS point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT point, country, point_cnt, ct AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT point, country, 0 AS point_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS ct FROM (SELECT roleid, country, MIN(point) AS point FROM t_basic_active GROUP BY roleid, country) AS t GROUP BY point, country) AS t3 UNION ALL SELECT point, country, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS point_cnt, 0 AS day_cnt FROM t_basic_active GROUP BY point, country) AS t GROUP BY point, country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_login` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mla', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country, '' AS network, point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname ORDER BY point) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_login_base.point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt, COALESCE(t_login_base.day_cnt, 0) AS day_cnt, t_incr.appname FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_login_base ON t_incr.country = t_login_base.country AND t_incr.point = t_login_base.point) AS t1

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_mla_realtime_charge_daily
sql_units: WITH base_info AS (SELECT roleid, point, SUM(money) AS point_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, money, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point FROM mh_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND money > 0) AS t GROUP BY roleid, point), t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-03-23', '2025-03-23', '2026-05-31') GROUP BY roleid, first_mt_country), t_basic_pay AS (SELECT country, point, SUM(point_amt) AS point_amt FROM (SELECT t_basic.roleid, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, base_info.point, base_info.point_amt FROM base_info LEFT JOIN t_basic ON t_basic.roleid = base_info.roleid) AS t GROUP BY country, point), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-03-23', '2025-03-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mla_synclog') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_charge` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mla', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country, '' AS network, point_amt, SUM(point_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY point) AS day_amt FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_basic_pay.point_amt, 0) AS point_amt FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_basic_pay ON t_incr.country = t_basic_pay.country AND t_incr.point = t_basic_pay.point) AS t1
