name: ml_temp.test_group_collection_caowl
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_caowl@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-03-31 16:22:11.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH group_feature AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN activedays_7days = 0 THEN '00.0天' WHEN activedays_7days BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '01.1-2' WHEN activedays_7days BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '02.3-5' WHEN activedays_7days BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN '03.6-7' ELSE '其他' END AS activedays_7days, CASE WHEN his_charge_amt_total IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN his_charge_amt_total = 0 THEN '00.0充值' WHEN his_charge_amt_total / 100 < 2 THEN '01.(0,2]' WHEN his_charge_amt_total / 100 < 20 THEN '02.[2,20)' WHEN his_charge_amt_total / 100 < 200 THEN '03.[20,200)' WHEN his_charge_amt_total / 100 < 2000 THEN '04.[200,2000)' ELSE '05.2000+' END AS charge_type FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2025-03-21' AND zoneid < 57000), info_level AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(INT(CEIL(info_level / 5))) AS big_l FROM ml_ods.gameserver_collection_info WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-03-21' AND '2025-03-24' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.test_group_collection_caowl PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT activedays_7days /* 活跃天数 */, charge_type /* 付费R级 */, big_l /* 藏品等级 */, a.logymd AS zhuce_day /* 进组日期 */, b.logymd AS ret_day, DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) AS n_ret /* 进组第几天 */, label /* 实验组对照组 */, SUM(charge_dollars) AS charge_dollar, SUM(sub_num_diamond) AS sub_diamond_num FROM (/* 灰度信息 */ SELECT DISTINCT logymd, roleid, zoneid, IF(param_value = '{"group_tag":"control"}', 'control', 'test') AS label FROM ml_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE param_name = '64_Collection2' AND param_version IN ('1774', '1775') AND logymd BETWEEN '2025-03-22' AND '2025-03-24') AS a LEFT JOIN group_feature ON a.roleid = group_feature.roleid AND a.zoneid = group_feature.zoneid LEFT JOIN info_level ON a.roleid = info_level.roleid AND a.zoneid = info_level.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, SUM(online_time) AS login_dur FROM ml_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 累计付费 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, SUM(money) / 100 AS charge_dollars FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 /* 排除代币购买数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND /*        AND is_sandbox = 0 -- 排除沙盒测试数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) AND /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷苹果假冒卡 (有收入) 数据, 因为点卡的 receipt_id = 0 */ NOT money IN (0) /* GP 礼品卡, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* GP 礼品卡, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS p ON b.logymd = p.logymd AND b.roleid = p.roleid AND b.zoneid = p.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 钻石消耗 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num_diamond FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 记得改最新日期 */ AND NOT operate IN ('gm') AND zoneid < 57000 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_diamond AS b WHERE b.logymd BETWEEN '2025-01-15' AND '2026-05-31' AND a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND b.operate IN ('receive_mail_attach') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) /* 把福利名单去了 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS q ON b.logymd = q.logymd AND b.roleid = q.roleid AND b.zoneid = q.zoneid WHERE DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) >= 0 GROUP BY activedays_7days, charge_type, big_l, a.logymd, b.logymd, DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd), label

name: 每日表现载入zbh_skill_behaviour_by_day
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: zibohong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-04-02 20:35:07.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 正式服当前版本号 */ WITH official_version AS (SELECT official_version FROM (SELECT official_version, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY start_time DESC) AS rn FROM ml_temp.zibohong_official_version WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t WHERE rn IN (1, 2)), test_version /* 测试服当前版本号 */ AS (SELECT test_version FROM (SELECT test_version, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY start_time DESC) AS rn FROM ml_temp.zibohong_test_version WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t WHERE rn IN (1, 2)), require_version AS (SELECT official_version AS version FROM official_version UNION ALL SELECT test_version AS version FROM test_version), battle_info /* 找到符合标准的battleid，和筛选信息 */ AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, realpvptype, real_road, minranklvl, rankstar, CASE WHEN rankstar <= 9 THEN '勇士' WHEN rankstar <= 21 THEN '精英' WHEN rankstar <= 37 THEN '大师' WHEN rankstar <= 62 THEN '宗师' WHEN rankstar <= 87 THEN '史诗' WHEN rankstar <= 112 AND minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN rankstar < 137 THEN '神话0-24星' WHEN rankstar < 162 THEN '神话25-49星' WHEN rankstar <= 212 THEN '神话50-100星' WHEN rankstar > 212 THEN '神话100星以上' ELSE 'none' END AS personal_lvl /* 新增字段：个人段位 */, CASE WHEN zoneid < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END AS zone_type, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(clientversion, '.', 4), '.', -1) AS version FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND killnum <= 50 AND deadnum <= 50 AND assistnum <= 50 AND herohurt <= 150000 AND behourt <= 150000 AND real_road <> 0 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND elo > 11 AND fake_ai = 0 AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90, 30, 31, 37, 38, 51, 57, 58, 85, 86, 87, 92, 101, 103) AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(clientversion, '.', 4), '.', -1) IN (SELECT version FROM require_version)), ganerank_information AS (/* --对局段位 */ SELECT battleid, CASE WHEN max_rankstar <= 9 THEN '勇士' WHEN max_rankstar <= 21 THEN '精英' WHEN max_rankstar <= 37 THEN '大师' WHEN max_rankstar <= 62 THEN '宗师' WHEN max_rankstar <= 87 THEN '史诗' WHEN max_rankstar <= 112 AND support_lvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN max_rankstar < 137 THEN '神话0-24星' WHEN max_rankstar < 162 THEN '神话25-49星' WHEN max_rankstar <= 212 THEN '神话50-100星' WHEN max_rankstar > 212 THEN '神话100星以上' ELSE 'none' END AS game_ranklvl /* 对局段位 */ FROM (SELECT battleid, MAX(rankstar) AS max_rankstar /* 对局星数 */, MAX(minranklvl) AS support_lvl FROM battle_info GROUP BY battleid) AS t GROUP BY battleid, game_ranklvl), judge_if_10_real_people /* 是否10真人 */ AS (SELECT battleid, CASE WHEN real_players = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ten_true /* 是否全是真人，1是全真人，0不是 */ FROM (SELECT battleid, SUM(CASE WHEN fake_ai = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS real_players /* 对局中真人玩家数 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90, 30, 31, 37, 38, 51, 57, 58, 85, 86, 87, 92, 101, 103) AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 /* 排除掉流局 */ GROUP BY battleid)), hero_hitrate /* 提取英雄命中数据 + 筛选信息 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.*, b.zone_type, b.version, b.personal_lvl, b.realpvptype, b.real_road, c.ten_true, d.game_ranklvl FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_hitrate_analysis WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a JOIN battle_info AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid JOIN judge_if_10_real_people AS c ON a.battleid = c.battleid JOIN ganerank_information AS d ON a.battleid = d.battleid WHERE rn = 1 AND a.heroid <> 0), final_combo /* 主查询 */ AS (SELECT logymd, zone_type, version, realpvptype, personal_lvl, game_ranklvl, ten_true, t1.heroid, real_road, CASE WHEN t1.heroid >= 4000 THEN CONCAT(hero_name, '（翻新）') ELSE hero_name END AS hero_name /* 英雄中文名称(带翻新) */, heroes, ski_id, note AS skill_name, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid, battleid) AS role_battlecnt, SUM(battletime) / 60000 AS battletime, SUM(ski_release_cnt) AS ski_release_cnt, SUM(ski_hit_cnt) AS ski_hit_cnt, SUM(ski_hithero_cnt) AS ski_hithero_cnt, SUM(ski_hit_herocnt) AS ski_hit_herocnt, SUM(ski_hithurt) AS ski_hithurt, SUM(ski_hithurt_hero) AS ski_hithurt_hero FROM (/* 技能字段按位拆分 */ SELECT DISTINCT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, real_road, battletime, zone_type, version, personal_lvl, realpvptype, ten_true, game_ranklvl, SPLIT(skillhitrate0, ',')[0] AS ski_id, SPLIT(skillhitrate0, ',')[1] AS ski_release_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate0, ',')[2] AS ski_hit_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate0, ',')[3] AS ski_hithero_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate0, ',')[4] AS ski_hit_herocnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate0, ',')[5] AS ski_hithurt, SPLIT(skillhitrate0, ',')[6] AS ski_hithurt_hero FROM hero_hitrate UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, real_road, battletime, zone_type, version, personal_lvl, realpvptype, ten_true, game_ranklvl, SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[0] AS ski_id, SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[1] AS ski_release_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[2] AS ski_hit_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[3] AS ski_hithero_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[4] AS ski_hit_herocnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[5] AS ski_hithurt, SPLIT(skillhitrate1, ',')[6] AS ski_hithurt_hero FROM hero_hitrate UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, real_road, battletime, zone_type, version, personal_lvl, realpvptype, ten_true, game_ranklvl, SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[0] AS ski_id, SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[1] AS ski_release_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[2] AS ski_hit_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[3] AS ski_hithero_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[4] AS ski_hit_herocnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[5] AS ski_hithurt, SPLIT(skillhitrate3, ',')[6] AS ski_hithurt_hero FROM hero_hitrate UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, real_road, battletime, zone_type, version, personal_lvl, realpvptype, ten_true, game_ranklvl, SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[0] AS ski_id, SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[1] AS ski_release_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[2] AS ski_hit_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[3] AS ski_hithero_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[4] AS ski_hit_herocnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[5] AS ski_hithurt, SPLIT(skillhitrate4, ',')[6] AS ski_hithurt_hero FROM hero_hitrate UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, real_road, battletime, zone_type, version, personal_lvl, realpvptype, ten_true, game_ranklvl, SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[0] AS ski_id, SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[1] AS ski_release_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[2] AS ski_hit_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[3] AS ski_hithero_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[4] AS ski_hit_herocnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[5] AS ski_hithurt, SPLIT(skillhitrate5, ',')[6] AS ski_hithurt_hero FROM hero_hitrate UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, real_road, battletime, zone_type, version, personal_lvl, realpvptype, ten_true, game_ranklvl, SPLIT(skillhitrate6, ',')[0] AS ski_id, SPLIT(skillhitrate6, ',')[1] AS ski_release_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate6, ',')[2] AS ski_hit_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate6, ',')[3] AS ski_hithero_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate6, ',')[4] AS ski_hit_herocnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate6, ',')[5] AS ski_hithurt, SPLIT(skillhitrate6, ',')[6] AS ski_hithurt_hero FROM hero_hitrate UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, real_road, battletime, zone_type, version, personal_lvl, realpvptype, ten_true, game_ranklvl, SPLIT(skillhitrate7, ',')[0] AS ski_id, SPLIT(skillhitrate7, ',')[1] AS ski_release_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate7, ',')[2] AS ski_hit_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate7, ',')[3] AS ski_hithero_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate7, ',')[4] AS ski_hit_herocnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate7, ',')[5] AS ski_hithurt, SPLIT(skillhitrate7, ',')[6] AS ski_hithurt_hero FROM hero_hitrate UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, real_road, battletime, zone_type, version, personal_lvl, realpvptype, ten_true, game_ranklvl, SPLIT(skillhitrate8, ',')[0] AS ski_id, SPLIT(skillhitrate8, ',')[1] AS ski_release_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate8, ',')[2] AS ski_hit_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate8, ',')[3] AS ski_hithero_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate8, ',')[4] AS ski_hit_herocnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate8, ',')[5] AS ski_hithurt, SPLIT(skillhitrate8, ',')[6] AS ski_hithurt_hero FROM hero_hitrate UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, real_road, battletime, zone_type, version, personal_lvl, realpvptype, ten_true, game_ranklvl, SPLIT(skillhitrate9, ',')[0] AS ski_id, SPLIT(skillhitrate9, ',')[1] AS ski_release_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate9, ',')[2] AS ski_hit_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate9, ',')[3] AS ski_hithero_cnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate9, ',')[4] AS ski_hit_herocnt, SPLIT(skillhitrate9, ',')[5] AS ski_hithurt, SPLIT(skillhitrate9, ',')[6] AS ski_hithurt_hero FROM hero_hitrate) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, hero_name, heroes FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2023-04-26', '2023-04-26', '2026-05-31')) AS t2 ON (CASE WHEN t1.heroid >= 4000 THEN t1.heroid - 4000 ELSE t1.heroid END) = t2.heroid LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, skill_id, note FROM mt_dim.dim_hitrate_analysis_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2023-12-03', '2023-12-03', '2026-05-31')) AS t3 ON t1.heroid = t3.hero_id AND t1.ski_id = t3.skill_id GROUP BY logymd, zone_type, version, realpvptype, personal_lvl, game_ranklvl, ten_true, t1.heroid, real_road, hero_name, heroes, ski_id, note) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.zbh_skill_behaviour_by_day PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT zone_type, version, realpvptype, ten_true, game_ranklvl, heroid, personal_lvl, hero_name, heroes, real_road, ski_id /* -技能id */, skill_name /* 技能名称及备注 */, role_battlecnt /* 角色战斗场次 */, battletime /* 战斗时长（分钟） */, ski_release_cnt /* -技能释放次数 */, ski_hit_cnt /* 技能命中次数 */, ski_hithero_cnt /* 技能命中英雄次数 */, ski_hit_herocnt /* 技能命中英雄个数 */, ski_hithurt /* 技能伤害量 */, ski_hithurt_hero /* 技能对英雄伤害量 */ FROM final_combo

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_low_activate_push_top_hour_mview2 PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_LIST(login_hour || '@' || rn) AS login_hour_list, 'overall' AS ranktype FROM (/* 按照整体全量活跃情况看，最常见的小时是哪个 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, login_hour, SUM(login_in_count) AS login_in_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY SUM(login_in_count) DESC) AS rn FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_his_activate_hour_multiview_opt2 WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, login_hour) WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_LIST(login_hour || '@' || rn) AS login_hour_list, 'month_period' AS ranktype FROM (/* 过滤当前时令的数据 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, login_hour, SUM(login_in_count) AS login_in_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY SUM(login_in_count) DESC) AS rn FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_his_activate_hour_multiview_opt2 WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND period_of_month = (CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(p_date, 9, 2) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'up' WHEN SUBSTRING(p_date, 9, 2) BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'down' END) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, login_hour) WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_LIST(login_hour || '@' || rn) AS login_hour_list, 'quaters' AS ranktype FROM (/* 过滤当前季度的数据 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, login_hour, SUM(login_in_count) AS login_in_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY SUM(login_in_count) DESC) AS rn FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_his_activate_hour_multiview_opt2 WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND quaters = (CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(p_date, 6, 2) <= 3 THEN 'q1' WHEN SUBSTRING(p_date, 6, 2) <= 6 THEN 'q2' WHEN SUBSTRING(p_date, 6, 2) <= 9 THEN 'q3' ELSE 'q4' END) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, login_hour) WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid /* dm_ai_mlbb_uf_his_activate_hour_multiview_opt weekday */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_LIST(login_hour || '@' || rn) AS login_hour_list, 'dayofweek' AS ranktype FROM (/* 过滤当前季度的数据 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, login_hour, SUM(login_in_count) AS login_in_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY SUM(login_in_count) DESC) AS rn FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_his_activate_hour_multiview_opt2 WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND week_day = (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(p_date) <= 5 THEN 'mid_week' ELSE 'week_end' END) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, login_hour) WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid

name: push_低活实验阶段回流用户计算推荐结果_推荐条数更新
output_hint: push_低活实验阶段回流用户计算推荐结果_推荐条数更新
sql_units: /* 时间分区需要前未来+3天，保证数据提前产生，运营侧当天加载当天的数据，例如：20241107零点就会去加载时间分区p_date='2024-11-7'的数据，同时我这边用login表中的zone_id控制，每次推哪几个区服 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_exp_low_activate_update_count_formal_result2 PARTITION(p_date = '2026-06-03') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.push_id, t1.task_id, t1.push_time, t1.push_type, t1.vid, t1.ranktype FROM (SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid, ranktype FROM (SELECT roleid /* push_time也要同步向未来+3天，因为父任务已经做了+1天操作，这边只需+2，对用秒数172800，就会按push_time对应时间进行推送 */, push_id, task_id, push_time + 172800 AS push_time, push_type, vid, ranktype FROM (SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid, ranktype, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, ranktype ORDER BY push_time, rand_num) AS rn FROM (SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid, ranktype, RAND() AS rand_num FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_exp_low_activate_result2 WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND /* and ranktype='overall' */ /* 触达策略(11触达1条，12触达2条，13策略优化1条，15规则1条) */ vid <> 11 AND vid <> 13 AND vid <> 15)) WHERE rn <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT roleid /* push_time也要同步向未来+3天，因为父任务已经做了+1天操作，这边只需+2，对用秒数172800，就会按push_time对应时间进行推送 */, push_id, task_id, push_time + 172800 AS push_time, push_type, vid, ranktype FROM (SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid, ranktype, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, ranktype ORDER BY push_time, rand_num) AS rn FROM (SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid, ranktype, RAND() AS rand_num FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_exp_low_activate_result2 WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND /* -- 触达策略(11触达1条，12触达2条，13策略优化1条，15规则1条) */ (vid = 11 OR vid = 13 OR vid = 15))) WHERE rn <= 1)) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT t3.roleid FROM (SELECT roleid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-16' AND /* AND     ((zoneid >= 59000 AND zoneid <= 59999) OR (zoneid >= 57000 AND zoneid <= 57999)) */ /* AND     ((zoneid >= 57000 AND zoneid <= 57999)) */ /* 取不在范围内的zoneid的值，保证正式服上线之前分区为空，不推送 */ /* AND     zoneid = -1 */ roleid % 9 IN (0, 1, 2, 3) AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 GROUP BY roleid) AS t3 JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM (SELECT roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT zoneid) AS count_zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' /* AND     ((zoneid >= 59000 AND zoneid <= 59999) OR (zoneid >= 57000 AND zoneid <= 57999)) */ GROUP BY roleid) /* 保证测服测试的时候不知有测服账号的roleid不会触达 */ WHERE count_zoneid = 1) AS t4 ON t3.roleid = t4.roleid) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid

name: push_低活实验阶段回流用户计算推荐结果_优化
output_hint: push_低活实验阶段回流用户计算推荐结果_优化
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_exp_low_activate_result_opt PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, push_id, task_id, push_time, push_type, vid, ranktype FROM (SELECT t3.roleid, t4.push_id, 999999 AS task_id, t3.push_time, t3.push_type, t3.vid, t3.ranktype, t3.bucket_id, t3.bucket_id2, IF(t3.bucket_id = t3.bucket_id2, 1, 0) AS fail_match, t3.ma_id, t3.mi_id FROM (SELECT _ta.*, CAST((RAND() * (_tb.ma_id - _tb.mi_id) + _tb.mi_id) AS BIGINT) AS bucket_id, CAST(((RAND() + RAND()) / 6 * (_tb.ma_id - _tb.mi_id) + _tb.mi_id) AS BIGINT) AS bucket_id2, _tb.ma_id, _tb.mi_id FROM (SELECT *, 1 AS join_id FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_low_activate_exp_tag_rand_hour_group2 WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31') AS _ta JOIN (SELECT 1 AS join_id, MAX(push_id) AS ma_id, MIN(push_id) AS mi_id FROM mt_ai.mlbb_ai_push_material_online WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_ai.mlbb_ai_push_material_online WHERE logymd <> '') AND act_id <> '' AND begin_time <= '2026-06-03' AND end_time >= '2026-06-03') AS _tb ON _ta.join_id = _tb.join_id) AS t3 JOIN (SELECT push_id, title, content, begin_time, end_time, act_id, 1 AS join_id FROM mt_ai.mlbb_ai_push_material_online WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_ai.mlbb_ai_push_material_online WHERE logymd <> '') AND act_id <> '' AND begin_time <= '2026-06-03' AND end_time >= '2026-06-03') AS t4 ON t3.bucket_id = t4.push_id OR (t3.vid = 12 AND IF(t3.bucket_id /* 如果选到了相同素材 */ = t3.bucket_id2, IF(t3.bucket_id2 + 1 <= t3.ma_id, t3.bucket_id2 + 1, t3.mi_id), t3.bucket_id2) = t4.push_id))

<= 5 THEN 2 WHEN day_max_minrank_level <= 9 THEN 3 WHEN day_max_minrank_level <= 16 THEN 4 WHEN day_max_minrank_level <= 25 THEN 5 WHEN day_max_minrank_level <= 35 THEN 6 ELSE day_max_minrank_level - 29 END AS day_max_bigrank_level, day_max_minrank_level, day_yl_active, day_dl_active, day_first_yl_active_time, day_last_yl_active_time, day_first_dl_active_time, day_last_dl_active_time, IF(NOT t1.logymd = t2.logymd_max LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(IF(NOT lineage_task_id IS NULL, SPLIT(lineage_task_id, ','), ARRAY(''))) a AS b WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND db_name = 'ml_ods' GROUP BY ods_table_name, lineage_table_name) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN bucket_name = 'moonton-ml' THEN CONCAT('ml_ods.', table_name) ELSE CONCAT(REGEXP_REPLACE(bucket_name, '-', '_'), '.', table_name) END AS table_name, MAX(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2025-12-02' THEN is_select ELSE 0 END) AS is_select180, MAX(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2025-05-31' THEN is_select ELSE 0 END) AS is_select1year, MAX(is_select) AS is_select3year FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_table_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2023-06-01' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN bucket_name = 'moonton-ml' THEN CONCAT('ml_ods.', table_name) ELSE CONCAT(REGEXP_REPLACE(bucket_name, '-', '_'), '.', table_name) END) AS t2 ON t1.lineage_table_name = t2.table_name AND t2.table_name NOT LIKE 'ml_ods%' UNION ALL /* ods s3存储热度 */ SELECT t1.ods_table_name, t2.is_select180, t2.is_select1year, t2.is_select3year FROM (SELECT CONCAT(db_name, '.', table_name) AS ods_table_name FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_lineage_df AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd_max FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_lineage_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd_max WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND db_name = 'ml_ods' GROUP BY ods_table_name) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN bucket_name = 'moonton-ml' THEN CONCAT('ml_ods.', table_name) ELSE CONCAT(REGEXP_REPLACE(bucket_name, '-', '_'), '.', table_name) END AS table_name, MAX(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2025-12-02' THEN is_select ELSE 0 END) AS is_select180, MAX(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2025-05-31' THEN is_select ELSE 0 END) AS is_select1year, MAX(is_select) AS is_select3year FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_table_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2023-06-01' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN bucket_name = 'moonton-ml' THEN CONCAT('ml_ods.', table_name) ELSE CONCAT(REGEXP_REPLACE(bucket_name, '-', '_'), '.', table_name) END) AS t2 ON t1.ods_table_name = t2.table_name AND t2.table_name LIKE 'ml_ods%') GROUP BY ods_table_name) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_mlbb_ods_level_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT base.ods_table_name AS table_name, t1.table_desc, COALESCE(t1.table_level /* 人工标记 */, CASE WHEN COALESCE(baseline.is_baseline, 0) = 1 THEN 'P1' /* 基线染色 */ ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(datawind_table.is_datawind, 0) = 1 AND COALESCE(datawind_table.schedule_type, -1) = 1 THEN 'P2' /* 风神(自动) */ WHEN COALESCE(qry_cnt.query7, 0) >= 20 THEN 'P2' /* 中高热度 */ ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(base.etl_cnt, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(qry_cnt.query1year, 0) > 0 OR (COALESCE(datawind_table.is_datawind, 0) = 1 AND COALESCE(datawind_table.schedule_type, -1) = 0) THEN 'P3-1' /* 风神(手动)+有etl+低热度 */ WHEN COALESCE(pt.latest_partition, '2026-05-31') >= '2025-05-31' THEN CASE WHEN (COALESCE(base.etl_cnt, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(qry_cnt.query1year, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(qry_cnt.query3year, 0) > 0) OR (tb.create_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '{DATE}') OR COALESCE(s3.is_select3year, 0) = 1 THEN 'P3-2' ELSE NULL END /* 低热度 */ ELSE NULL END, 'P3-3') AS table_level, CASE WHEN COALESCE(baseline.is_baseline, 0) = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS is_baseline, CASE WHEN COALESCE(datawind_table.is_datawind, 0) = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS is_datawind, COALESCE(qry_cnt.query180, 0) AS query180, COALESCE(qry_cnt.query1year, 0) AS query1year, COALESCE(qry_cnt.query3year, 0) AS query3year, baseline.alarm_name_list, datawind_table.dataset_name_list AS dataset_list, base.etl_cnt, COALESCE(datawind_table.schedule_type, -1) AS datawind_type, COALESCE(s3.is_select180, 0) AS is_select180, COALESCE(s3.is_select1year, 0) AS is_select1year, COALESCE(s3.is_select3year, 0) AS is_select3year, COALESCE(qry_cnt.query30, 0) AS query30, COALESCE(qry_cnt.query60, 0) AS query60, COALESCE(qry_cnt.query90, 0) AS query90, COALESCE(qry_cnt.query7, 0) AS query7, tb.create_date, pt.latest_partition FROM base LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_mlbb_p0_ods_list_df_upload AS t1 ON base.ods_table_name = t1.table_name AND t1.logymd = '20260531' LEFT JOIN baseline ON base.ods_table_name = baseline.ods_table_name LEFT JOIN datawind_table ON base.ods_table_name = datawind_table.ods_table_name LEFT JOIN qry_cnt ON base.ods_table_name = qry_cnt.ods_table_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT CONCAT(db_name, '.', table_name) AS ods_table_name, FROM_UNIXTIME(GET_JSON_OBJECT(detail, '$.sourceCreateTime') / 1000 + 8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS create_date FROM mt_dwm.hive_table_info AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd_max FROM mt_dwm.hive_table_info WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd_max WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND db_name = 'ml_ods') AS tb ON base.ods_table_name = tb.ods_table_name LEFT JOIN s3 ON base.ods_table_name = s3.ods_table_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT CONCAT('ml_ods.', table_name) AS ods_table_name, MAX(latest_partition) AS latest_partition FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_table_di AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd_max FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_table_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd_max WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND bucket_name = 'moonton-ml' GROUP BY ods_table_name) AS pt ON base.ods_table_name = pt.ods_table_name

name: 57测服合并热修
sql_units: /* 插入/覆盖目标表 */ /* 1. 加上前一个版本的 over_time 和 duration */ WITH version_base AS (SELECT *, DATEDIFF(over_time, start_time) AS duration, LAG(over_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS prev_over, LAG(DATEDIFF(over_time, start_time)) OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS prev_duration FROM ml_temp.zibohong_test_version WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND test_version >= 1034), mark_group /* 2. 判断是否是新的合并段（不连续或前一个不是短版本） */ AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_over IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN prev_over <> start_time THEN 1 WHEN prev_duration >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_group FROM version_base), grouped_versions /* 3. 给每个段编号：累加每次 is_new_group = 1 */ AS (SELECT *, SUM(is_new_group) OVER (ORDER BY start_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS group_id FROM mark_group), group_summary /* 4. 每组聚合合并版本信息 */ AS (SELECT group_id, MIN(start_time) AS start_time, MAX(over_time) AS over_time, COLLECT_LIST(CAST(test_version AS STRING)) AS version_list FROM grouped_versions GROUP BY group_id), final_result /* 5. 展开每组 original_version */ AS (SELECT CONCAT_WS('&', version_list) AS merged_version, start_time, over_time, version AS original_version FROM group_summary LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(version_list) AS version) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.zbh_modify_test_version PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT merged_version, start_time, over_time, original_version FROM final_result ORDER BY start_time

sql_units: /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */ WITH need_version AS (SELECT test_version, start_time, over_time, rn FROM (SELECT test_version, start_time, over_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY start_time DESC) AS rn FROM ml_temp.zibohong_test_version WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') /* --n = 1 为最新一条记录，rn = 2 次新 */ WHERE rn IN (1, 2)), t_hero_config AS (SELECT heroid, hero_name /* 英雄中文名称 */, heroes /* 英雄职业 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' < '2023-04-26', '2023-04-26', '2026-05-30')), version_data_basic AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(clientversion, '.', 4), '.', -1) AS test_version, real_road, minranklvl, rankstar, heroid, battleid, banhero, IF(wincamp = 1, 1, 0) AS is_win, realpvptype FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd <= SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 17 * 60 * 60) AS STRING), 1, 10) /* 当前时间'logymd' */ AND logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND logymd >= (SELECT start_time FROM need_version WHERE rn = 2) /* 大于等于2个版本的时间 */ AND CAST(TIME AS TIMESTAMP) < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 17 * 60 * 60) AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90, 30, 31, 37, 38, 51, 57, 58, 85, 86, 87, 92, 101, 103) AND /* 真人对局：realpvptype in (1,2,59,90) */ /* 温暖关：realpvptype in (30,31,37,38,51,57,58,85,86,87,92,101,103) */ isinvalidbattle <> 1 /* 排除掉流局 */ AND fake_ai = 0 /* =去掉ai */ AND zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999 AND real_road <> 0), judge_if_10_real_people AS (SELECT battleid, CASE WHEN real_players = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ten_true /* 是否全是真人 */ FROM (SELECT battleid, SUM(CASE WHEN fake_ai = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS real_players /* 对局中真人玩家数 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd <= SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 17 * 60 * 60) AS STRING), 1, 10) AND logymd >= (SELECT start_time FROM need_version WHERE rn = 2) AND logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND CAST(TIME AS TIMESTAMP) < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 17 * 60 * 60) AND zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999 AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90, 30, 31, 37, 38, 51, 57, 58, 85, 86, 87, 92, 101, 103) AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 /* 排除掉流局 */ GROUP BY battleid)), version_data AS (SELECT vdb.*, rp.ten_true FROM version_data_basic AS vdb JOIN judge_if_10_real_people AS rp ON vdb.battleid = rp.battleid), ganerank_information AS (SELECT battleid, CASE WHEN max_rankstar <= 9 THEN '勇士' WHEN max_rankstar <= 21 THEN '精英' WHEN max_rankstar <= 37 THEN '大师' WHEN max_rankstar <= 62 THEN '宗师' WHEN max_rankstar <= 87 THEN '史诗' WHEN max_rankstar <= 112 AND support_lvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN max_rankstar < 137 THEN '神话0-24星' WHEN max_rankstar < 162 THEN '神话25-49星' WHEN max_rankstar <= 212 THEN '神话50-100星' WHEN max_rankstar > 212 THEN '神话100星以上' ELSE 'none' END AS game_ranklvl /* 新增字段：对局段位 */ FROM (SELECT battleid, MAX(rankstar) AS max_rankstar /* 对局星数 */, MAX(minranklvl) AS support_lvl FROM version_data GROUP BY battleid) AS t GROUP BY battleid, game_ranklvl), now_version_combine AS (SELECT test_version, heroid, realpvptype, real_road, CASE WHEN rankstar <= 9 THEN '勇士' WHEN rankstar <= 21 THEN '精英' WHEN rankstar <= 37 THEN '大师' WHEN rankstar <= 62 THEN '宗师' WHEN rankstar <= 87 THEN '史诗' WHEN rankstar <= 112 AND minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN rankstar < 137 THEN '神话0-24星' WHEN rankstar < 162 THEN '神话25-49星' WHEN rankstar <= 212 THEN '神话50-100星' WHEN rankstar > 212 THEN '神话100星以上' ELSE 'none' END AS personal_lvl /* 新增字段：个人段位 */, gi.game_ranklvl, ten_true, SUM(is_win) AS win_cnt, COUNT(vd.battleid) AS battle_cnt FROM version_data AS vd JOIN ganerank_information AS gi ON vd.battleid = gi.battleid GROUP BY test_version, heroid, realpvptype, real_road, personal_lvl, game_ranklvl, ten_true), ban_hero_battle /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */ AS (SELECT vd.test_version, vd.banhero, vd.realpvptype, vd.real_road, vd.ten_true, CASE WHEN rankstar <= 9 THEN '勇士' WHEN rankstar <= 21 THEN '精英' WHEN rankstar <= 37 THEN '大师' WHEN rankstar <= 62 THEN '宗师' WHEN rankstar <= 87 THEN '史诗' WHEN rankstar <= 112 AND minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN rankstar < 137 THEN '神话0-24星' WHEN rankstar < 162 THEN '神话25-49星' WHEN rankstar <= 212 THEN '神话50-100星' WHEN rankstar > 212 THEN '神话100星以上' ELSE 'none' END AS personal_lvl, game_ranklvl, vd.battleid FROM version_data AS vd JOIN ganerank_information AS gi ON vd.battleid = gi.battleid), total_cnt_by_group AS (SELECT test_version, realpvptype, ten_true, personal_lvl, game_ranklvl, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS total_cnt_with_choose FROM ban_hero_battle GROUP BY test_version, realpvptype, ten_true, personal_lvl, game_ranklvl), ban_count_by_heroid AS (SELECT tcg.test_version, bh.banhero, tcg.realpvptype, tcg.ten_true, tcg.personal_lvl, tcg.game_ranklvl, total_cnt_with_choose, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS ban_count FROM total_cnt_by_group AS tcg LEFT JOIN ban_hero_battle AS bh ON bh.test_version = tcg.test_version AND bh.realpvptype = tcg.realpvptype AND bh.ten_true = tcg.ten_true AND bh.personal_lvl = tcg.personal_lvl AND bh.game_ranklvl = tcg.game_ranklvl GROUP BY tcg.test_version, bh.banhero, tcg.realpvptype, tcg.ten_true, tcg.personal_lvl, tcg.game_ranklvl, total_cnt_with_choose), last_result AS (SELECT vd.test_version, vd.heroid, vd.realpvptype, vd.real_road, vd.personal_lvl, vd.game_ranklvl, vd.ten_true, vd.win_cnt, vd.battle_cnt, total_cnt_with_choose, ban_count FROM now_version_combine AS vd LEFT JOIN ban_count_by_heroid AS bh ON vd.test_version = bh.test_version AND vd.heroid = bh.banhero AND vd.realpvptype = bh.realpvptype AND vd.personal_lvl = bh.personal_lvl AND vd.game_ranklvl = bh.game_ranklvl AND vd.ten_true = bh.ten_true) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.zibo_hong_test_version_winrate_10 SELECT nv.heroid /* -heroID */, CASE WHEN nv.heroid >= 4000 THEN CONCAT(hc.hero_name, '（翻新）') ELSE hc.hero_name END AS hero_name /* 英雄中文名称(带翻新) */, hc.heroes /* 主职业 */, nv.realpvptype /* 真实对局类型 */, nv.real_road /* 战斗重走的分路 */, nv.personal_lvl /* 新增字段：个人段位 */, nv.game_ranklvl /* 对局段位 */, nv.ten_true /* 是否10真人 */, nv.win_cnt, nv.battle_cnt, total_cnt_with_choose, ban_count, nv.test_version FROM last_result AS nv JOIN need_version AS n ON nv.test_version = n.test_version LEFT JOIN t_hero_config AS hc ON (CASE WHEN nv.heroid >= 4000 THEN nv.heroid - 4000 ELSE nv.heroid END) = hc.heroid

name: 20250417_dau_all_country
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jianli@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-04-17 16:46:14.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH adjust /* adjust归因国家与渠道 */ AS (/*     SELECT  accountid, */ /*             lower(adjust_country) AS adjust_country, */ /*             lower(adjust_network_name) AS adjust_network_name */ /*     FROM    mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df */ /*     WHERE   appid = 'mlbb' */ SELECT roleid AS accountid, LOWER(first_mt_country) AS adjust_country, LOWER(first_network_name) AS adjust_network_name FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb'), adjust_network AS (SELECT a.accountid AS roleid FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create AS a WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2025-03-20' AND '2025-04-30' AND a.os_build LIKE '%AP1%' GROUP BY a.accountid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jianli_all_dau_country PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') /* os_type, --系统类型，已删除 */ SELECT adjust_country /* 末次归因国 */, recur_dau /* 29日流失用户数 */, new_dau /* 新增用户数 */, org_new_dau /* 自然新增用户数 */, put_new_dau /* 投放新增用户数 */, active_dau /* 日活跃用户数 */, recur_dau_org /* 自然回流玩家数 */, recur_dau_ad /* 投放回流玩家数 */ FROM (SELECT COALESCE(t1.logymd, t2.logymd, t3.logymd) AS logymd /* 观测日 */, COALESCE(t1.adjust_country, t2.adjust_country, t3.adjust_country) AS adjust_country /* COALESCE(t2.os_type, t3.os_type) AS os_type, --系统类型 */ /* 末次归因国 */, COALESCE(recur_dau, 0) AS recur_dau /* 29日流失用户数 */, COALESCE(recur_dau_org, 0) AS recur_dau_org /* 自然回流玩家数 */, COALESCE(recur_dau_ad, 0) AS recur_dau_ad /* 投放回流玩家数 */, COALESCE(new_dau, 0) AS new_dau /* 新增用户数 */, COALESCE(org_new_dau, 0) AS org_new_dau /* 自然新增用户数 */, COALESCE(put_new_dau, 0) AS put_new_dau /* 投放新增用户数 */, COALESCE(active_dau, 0) AS active_dau /* 日活跃用户数 */ FROM (SELECT p_date AS logymd, country AS adjust_country, SUM(did_30back) AS recur_dau, SUM(did_30back_organic) AS recur_dau_org /* -自然回流玩家数 */, SUM(did_30back_buy) AS recur_dau_ad /* -投放回流玩家数 */ FROM adbi.dm_cockpit_game_inside_stats_os_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND data_date = '2026-05-30' AND app_id = '1001' GROUP BY logymd, adjust_country) AS t1 /* 29日回流玩家数 */ FULL JOIN (SELECT logymd, COALESCE(adjust_country, 'noCountry') AS adjust_country, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.roleid) AS new_dau /* IF(os_type = 1, 'ios', 'and') AS os_type, */ /* 新增玩家数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN adjust_network_name = 'organic' THEN t1.roleid END) AS org_new_dau /* 自然新增玩家数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(adjust_network_name, 'unknown') <> 'organic' THEN t1.roleid END) AS put_new_dau /* 投放新增玩家数 */ FROM (SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_create_role WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS a LEFT JOIN adjust_network AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE b.roleid IS NULL) AS t1 /* 创角 */ LEFT JOIN adjust AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.accountid GROUP BY logymd, COALESCE(adjust_country, 'noCountry')) AS t2 /* 新增玩家&自然新增 */ ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd AND t1.adjust_country = t2.adjust_country /* AND     t1.os_type = t2.os_type */ FULL JOIN (SELECT logymd, COALESCE(adjust_country, 'noCountry') AS adjust_country /* os_type, */, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.roleid) AS active_dau FROM (SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid /* IF(os_type = 1, 'ios', 'and') AS os_type */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND /* AND     channel NOT IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test') */ /* AND     (zoneid DIV 1000) < 57 */ is_ai = 0 GROUP BY logymd, roleid) AS a LEFT JOIN adjust_network AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE b.roleid IS NULL) AS t1 /* 活跃 */ LEFT JOIN adjust AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.accountid GROUP BY logymd, COALESCE(adjust_country, 'noCountry') /* os_type, */) AS t3 /* 日活跃玩家 */ ON t1.logymd = t3.logymd AND t1.adjust_country = t3.adjust_country) /* AND     t1.os_type = t3.os_type */ WHERE adjust_country <> 'noCountry' GROUP BY adjust_country /* 末次归因国 */, recur_dau /* 29日流失用户数 */, new_dau /* 新增用户数 */, org_new_dau /* 自然新增用户数 */, put_new_dau /* 投放新增用户数 */, active_dau /* 日活跃用户数 */, recur_dau_org /* 自然回流玩家数 */, recur_dau_ad /* 投放回流玩家数 */

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_push_low_activate_exp_user_tag_fix2 PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, push_time, push_time_str, rand_num, rn, IF(vid IN (11, 12, 13, 15), 1, 0) AS push_type, vid, ranktype FROM (SELECT roleid, push_time, push_time_str, rand_num, ranktype, rn, IF(rn <= 10000000, 1, 0) AS push_type, (CASE WHEN (roleid_now >= 0 AND roleid_now < 20) THEN 11 /* 智能择时触达1条用户 */ WHEN (roleid_now >= 20 AND roleid_now < 40) THEN 12 /* 智能择时触达2条用户 */ WHEN (roleid_now >= 40 AND roleid_now < 60) THEN 13 /* 智能择时触达1条用户 策略优化版本 */ WHEN (roleid_now >= 60 AND roleid_now < 80) THEN 14 /* 不触达用户   等同于push_type = 0用户 */ WHEN (roleid_now >= 80 AND roleid_now < 100) THEN 15 /* 规则触达，0小时统一推送 */ END) AS vid FROM (SELECT roleid, push_time, push_time_str, rand_num, ranktype, roleid % 9 AS roleid_new, roleid % 100 AS roleid_now, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rand_num) AS rn FROM (SELECT roleid, push_time, push_time_str, ranktype, RAND() AS rand_num FROM (SELECT roleid, push_time, push_time_str, ranktype FROM (SELECT roleid, UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01' || ' ' || login_hour || ':00-0800', 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mmZ') AS push_time, '2026-06-01' || ' ' || login_hour || ':00-0800' AS push_time_str, ranktype FROM (SELECT t1.roleid, SPLIT((CASE WHEN ((t1.roleid % 100) >= 40 AND (t1.roleid % 100) < 60) THEN COALESCE(t4.login_hour_list, t2.login_hour_list, ARRAY('0@0')) ELSE COALESCE(t2.login_hour_list, ARRAY('0@0')) /* 其他策略，全局活跃信息 */ END)[0], '@')[0] AS login_hour /* 参考优先级洞察：quaters > month_of_period */ /* https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/Xw9awJhxhivFp7kzNGfcQ3YXnKd */ /* t4 t5 t3 t2: quaters dayofweek month_period overall */, CASE WHEN (t1.roleid % 100 >= 40 AND t1.roleid % 100 < 60) THEN COALESCE(IF(SIZE(t4.login_hour_list) > 0, t4.ranktype, NULL), IF(SIZE(t2.login_hour_list) > 0, t2.ranktype, NULL), 'defalut') ELSE COALESCE(IF(SIZE(t2.login_hour_list) > 0, t2.ranktype, NULL), 'defalut') END AS ranktype FROM (SELECT roleid FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_low_activate_user WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND /* 低活用户 */ activate_days <= 2 GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT roleid, ranktype, MAX(login_hour_list) AS login_hour_list FROM MAX(login_hour_list) AS login_hour_list FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mlbb_uf_low_activate_push_top_hour_mview2 WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND ranktype = 'quaters' GROUP BY roleid, ranktype) AS t4 ON t1.roleid = t4.roleid))))) WHERE rn <= 20000000)

name: MC2局内获取A星B费英雄
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_sjlv@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-04-21 19:30:28.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* -每日跑,需要模式 */ WITH hero_info AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, bigranklv, star, quality, COUNT(*) AS chess_count FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, bigranklv, SPLIT(info, ',')[0] AS chessid, SPLIT(info, ',')[1] AS star FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(chessinfo, '\\073')) AS info WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND accountid = ai_accountid AND ailevel = 0 AND battle_round > 0 AND NOT SPLIT(info, ',')[0] IS NULL AND SPLIT(info, ',')[0] <> '') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, quality FROM mt_dim.dim_mchero_mcgg_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-04-07', '2025-04-07', '2026-05-31') AND servertype = 1 /* 筛选正式服 */) AS b ON a.chessid = b.id WHERE star BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND quality BETWEEN 1 AND 5 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, bigranklv, star, quality) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_monthly_mission_chess_get_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, pvptype, star, quality, SUM(chess_count) AS chess_cnt FROM hero_info GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, pvptype, star, quality

Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* mlbb海外中间表集合 */ WITH base AS (SELECT table_name, user_names, ji FROM (SELECT table_name, user_names, ji, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY table_name ORDER BY user_names DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT CONCAT(t1.db_name, '.', t1.table_name) AS table_name, t1.user_names, 1 AS ji FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_lineage_df AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd_max FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_lineage_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd_max WHERE t1.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND NOT t1.db_name IN ('ml_ods', 'mcgg_ods', 'zgame_damai_ods') GROUP BY CONCAT(t1.db_name, '.', t1.table_name), t1.user_names UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-hadoop', 'ml_temp', REPLACE(bucket_name, '-', '_')), '.', table_name) AS table_name, NULL AS user_names, 1 AS ji FROM mt_dwd.dwd_health_score_storage_metrics_di AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd_max FROM mt_dwd.dwd_health_score_storage_metrics_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd_max WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND bucket_name <> 'moonton-ml' GROUP BY CONCAT(IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-hadoop', 'ml_temp', REPLACE(bucket_name, '-', '_')), '.', table_name))) WHERE rn = 1), tb_upstream /* 表上游依赖 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(t1.db_name, '.', t1.table_name) AS table_name, t1.lineage_table_name FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_lineage_df AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd_max FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_lineage_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd_max WHERE t1.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND t1.db_name <> 'ml_ods' AND t1.lineage_type LIKE '%上游%' GROUP BY CONCAT(t1.db_name, '.', t1.table_name), t1.lineage_table_name), tb_down_task /* 表下游任务 */ AS (SELECT CONCAT(t1.db_name, '.', t1.table_name) AS table_name, t1.lineage_task_id FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_lineage_df AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd_max FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_lineage_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd_max WHERE t1.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND t1.db_name <> 'ml_ods' AND t1.lineage_type LIKE '%下游%' GROUP BY CONCAT(t1.db_name, '.', t1.table_name), t1.lineage_task_id), tb_task /* 表和任务关系 */ AS (SELECT lineage_table_name, task_id FROM (SELECT t1.lineage_table_name, t1.lineage_task_id, EXPLODE(IF(NOT t1.lineage_task_id IS NULL, SPLIT(t1.lineage_task_id, ','), ARRAY(''))) AS task_id FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_lineage_df AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd_max FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_lineage_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd_max WHERE t1.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') GROUP BY lineage_table_name, task_id), baseline_task /* 基线和任务关系 */ AS (SELECT name, priority, task_id FROM (SELECT name, priority, task_ids, EXPLODE(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(task_ids, '\\]|\\[', ''), ',')) AS task_id FROM mt_ods.dp_dorado__baseline_df WHERE logymd = '20260531' AND status = 1 AND task_ids <> '[]') GROUP BY name, priority, task_id), datawind_tb /* 风神数据集和表关系 */ AS (SELECT t1.dataset_id, t1.dataset_name, t1.table_name, t2.schedule_type, t2.dataset_priority, SUM(pv_td) AS dataset_pv_td, SUM(pv_7d) AS dataset_pv_7d, SUM(pv_14d) AS dataset_pv_14d, SUM(pv_30d) AS dataset_pv_30d FROM (SELECT dataset_id, dataset_name, EXPLODE(t1.dep_table_list) AS table_name /* 解析准确率99% */ FROM mt_dim.dim_datawind_lineage_mapping_df AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd_max FROM mt_dim.dim_datawind_lineage_mapping_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd_max WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT dataset_id, schedule_type, dataset_priority, pv_td /* pv数据有丢失，原因上游元数据表没有产出 */, pv_7d, pv_14d, pv_30d FROM mt_dwd.dwd_datawind_dataset_info_df AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd_max FROM mt_dwd.dwd_datawind_dataset_info_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd_max WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND dataset_status = 0) AS t2 ON t1.dataset_id = t2.dataset_id GROUP BY t1.dataset_id, t1.dataset_name, t1.table_name, t2.schedule_type, t2.dataset_priority), table_query_cnt AS (SELECT table_name, user_name, query_id, logymd FROM (SELECT logymd, id AS query_id, task_owner_user AS user_name, EXPLODE(dep_table_list) AS table_name FROM mt_dwd.dwd_leap_instance_parse_table_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-05-31' AND '2026-05-31') GROUP BY table_name, user_name, query_id, logymd), s3_query_data AS (SELECT CASE WHEN bucket_name = 'moonton-ml' THEN CONCAT('ml_ods.', table_name) ELSE CONCAT(REGEXP_REPLACE(bucket_name, '-', '_'), '.', table_name) END AS table_name, MAX(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2025-12-02' THEN is_select ELSE 0 END) AS is_select180, MAX(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2025-05-31' THEN is_select ELSE 0 END) AS is_select1year, MAX(is_select) AS is_select3year FROM mt_dwm.dwm_data_governance_table_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-05-31' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN bucket_name = 'moonton-ml' THEN CONCAT('ml_ods.', table_name) ELSE CONCAT(REGEXP_REPLACE(bucket_name, '-', '_'), '.', table_name) END), sla_dqc AS (SELECT t1.task_id, t1.is_associate_sla, t1.is_dqc_monitor, t1.is_run_monitor FROM mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_monitor_standard_info_df AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd_max FROM mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_monitor_standard_info_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd_max WHERE t1.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31'), t_mt_user AS (SELECT dp_name, email, nick, user_name FROM (SELECT dp_name, email, nick, user_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY email ORDER BY dp_name) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_mt_user_info WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-03-11', '2024-03-11', '2026-05-31')) AS t WHERE rn = 1 /* 对部门重复的人取唯一值 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_mlbb_dw_table_level_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT table_name, table_desc, CASE WHEN table_name LIKE 'ml_temp%' AND table_level IN ('P1', 'P0') THEN 'P0' WHEN table_name LIKE 'ml_temp%' AND table_level = 'P2' THEN 'P1' WHEN table_name LIKE 'ml_temp%' AND table_level = 'P3-1' THEN 'P2' WHEN table_name LIKE 'ml_temp%' AND table_level = 'P3-2' THEN 'P3-1' WHEN table_name LIKE 'ml_temp%' AND table_level = 'P3-3' THEN 'P3-2' ELSE table_level END AS table_level, is_baseline, alarm_name_list, is_datawind, schedule_type, dataset_name_list, etl_cnt, query7, query30, query60, query90, query180, query1year, query3year, is_select180, is_select1year, is_select3year, create_date, latest_partition, baseline_priority, dataset_pv_td, dataset_pv_7d, dataset_pv_14d, dataset_pv_30d, query270, is_associate_sla, is_dqc_monitor, is_run_monitor, is_out_dw, out_task_name, user90, avg_user_query_cnt90, dp_name, user_names, hot_score, dataset_priority, CASE WHEN table_name LIKE 'ml_temp%' THEN '数分' ELSE '数仓' END AS table_type, table_level AS table_level_origin FROM (SELECT table_name, table_desc, COALESCE(CASE WHEN t3_is_baseline = 1 AND t3_priority = 10 THEN 'P0' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN (t3_is_baseline = 1 AND t3_priority = 1) OR (t7_is_out_dw = 1) OR (is_datawind = 1 AND t4_dataset_priority IN (0, 1)) OR hot_score >= 80 THEN 'P1' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN (is_datawind = 1 AND t4_dataset_priority IN (2, 3)) OR (hot_score >= 70 AND hot_score < 80) THEN 'P2' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN hot_score > 60 AND hot_score < 70 THEN 'P3-1' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN query1year = 0 THEN 'P3-3' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN hot_score = 60 THEN 'P3-2' ELSE NULL END) AS table_level, is_baseline, alarm_name_list, is_datawind, schedule_type, dataset_name_list, etl_cnt, query7, query30, query60, query90, query180, query1year, query3year, is_select180, is_select1year, is_select3year, create_date, latest_partition, baseline_priority, dataset_pv_td, dataset_pv_7d, dataset_pv_14d, dataset_pv_30d, query270, is_associate_sla, is_dqc_monitor, is_run_monitor, is_out_dw, out_task_name, user90, avg_user_query_cnt90, dp_name, user_names, hot_score, dataset_priority FROM (SELECT base.table_name, NULL AS table_desc, t3.is_baseline AS t3_is_baseline, t3.priority AS t3_priority, t7.is_out_dw AS t7_is_out_dw, t4.dataset_priority AS t4_dataset_priority, NULL AS table_level, CASE WHEN t3.is_baseline = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_baseline, t3.alarm_name_list, CASE WHEN NOT t4.table_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_datawind, t4.schedule_type, t4.dataset_name AS dataset_name_list, NULL AS etl_cnt, COALESCE(t5.query7, 0) AS query7, COALESCE(t5.query30, 0) AS query30, COALESCE(t5.query60, 0) AS query60, COALESCE(t5.query90, 0) AS query90, COALESCE(t5.query180, 0) AS query180, COALESCE(t5.query1year, 0) AS query1year, NULL AS query3year, NULL AS is_select180, NULL AS is_select1year, NULL AS is_select3year, NULL AS create_date, NULL AS latest_partition, CASE WHEN t3.priority = 10 THEN '紧急' WHEN t3.priority = 1 THEN '普通' END AS baseline_priority, COALESCE(t4.dataset_pv_td, 0) AS dataset_pv_td, COALESCE(t4.dataset_pv_7d) AS dataset_pv_7d, COALESCE(t4.dataset_pv_14d) AS dataset_pv_14d, COALESCE(t4.dataset_pv_30d) AS dataset_pv_30d, COALESCE(t5.query270, 0) AS query270, COALESCE(t6.is_associate_sla, 0) AS is_associate_sla, COALESCE(t6.is_dqc_monitor, 0) AS is_dqc_monitor, COALESCE(t6.is_run_monitor, 0) AS is_run_monitor, COALESCE(t7.is_out_dw, 0) AS is_out_dw, t7.out_task_name, COALESCE(t5.user90, 0) AS user90, COALESCE(t5.avg_user_query_cnt90, 0) AS avg_user_query_cnt90, COALESCE(t8.dp_name, CASE WHEN base.table_name LIKE 'ml_temp%' THEN '竞技项目中心-赛道运营-数据运营-数据分析一组' WHEN base.table_name LIKE 'mt_%' THEN '中台-数据-数据仓库' ELSE NULL END) AS dp_name, base.user_names, (((LN(COALESCE(t5.query90, 0) + 1) - LN(1)) / (t9.query90_max_ln - LN(1))) * 0.6 + ((LN(COALESCE(t5.user90, 0) + 1) - LN(1)) / (t9.user90_max_ln - LN(1))) * 0.4) * 40 + 60 AS hot_score, t4.dataset_priority FROM base /* 基线染色 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT lineage_table_name, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_baseline, COLLECT_SET(name) AS alarm_name_list, MAX(priority) AS priority FROM (/* 基线绑定的表 */ SELECT t1.lineage_table_name, t2.name, t2.priority FROM tb_task AS t1 /* 表和任务 */ LEFT JOIN baseline_task AS t2 /* 任务和基线 */ ON t1.task_id = t2.task_id UNION ALL /* 基线染色的表 */ SELECT t1.lineage_table_name, t3.name, t3.priority FROM tb_upstream AS t1 /* 表和上游 */ LEFT JOIN tb_task AS t2 /* 表和任务 */ ON t1.table_name = t2.lineage_table_name LEFT JOIN baseline_task AS t3 /* 任务和基线 */ ON t2.task_id = t3.task_id UNION ALL /* 基线运行实例染色的表 */ SELECT t2.lineage_table_name, t1.baseline_name AS name, t1.baseline_priority AS priority FROM mt_dwm.dwm_baseline_relate_task_instance_di AS t1 /* 基线运行实例 */ INNER JOIN tb_task AS t2 /* 表和任务 */ ON t1.task_id = t2.task_id WHERE t1.logymd = '2026-05-31') GROUP BY lineage_table_name) AS t3 ON base.table_name = t3.lineage_table_name /* 出仓染色 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.table_name, 1 AS is_out_dw, COLLECT_SET(t4.task_name) AS out_task_name FROM tb_down_task AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT t2.task_id, t2.task_name FROM mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_baseinfo_df AS t2 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd_max FROM mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_baseinfo_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31') AS t3 ON t2.logymd = t3.logymd_max WHERE t2.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31' AND t2.task_status = 2 AND t2.schedule_type = 2 AND LOWER(t2.task_name) RLIKE 'leap2sr|hive2sr|leap2ch|hive2ch|leap2|hive2' AND LOWER(t2.task_name) NOT LIKE '%_test' GROUP BY t2.task_id, t2.task_name) AS t4 ON t1.lineage_task_id = t4.task_id GROUP BY t1.table_name, is_out_dw) AS t7 ON base.table_name = t7.table_name /* 风神染色 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT table_name, MAX(schedule_type) AS schedule_type, MIN(CASE WHEN dataset_priority = 'super_high' THEN 0 WHEN dataset_priority = 'high' THEN 1 WHEN dataset_priority = 'normal' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) AS dataset_priority, COLLECT_SET(dataset_name) AS dataset_name, SUM(dataset_pv_td) AS dataset_pv_td, SUM(dataset_pv_7d) AS dataset_pv_7d, SUM(dataset_pv_14d) AS dataset_pv_14d, SUM(dataset_pv_30d) AS dataset_pv_30d FROM (/* 风神绑定的表 */ SELECT table_name, dataset_name, schedule_type, dataset_priority, dataset_pv_td, dataset_pv_7d, dataset_pv_14d, dataset_pv_30d FROM datawind_tb UNION ALL /* 风神染色的表 */ SELECT t2.lineage_table_name AS table_name, t1.dataset_name, t1.schedule_type, t1.dataset_priority, dataset_pv_td, dataset_pv_7d, dataset_pv_14d, dataset_pv_30d FROM datawind_tb AS t1 INNER JOIN tb_upstream AS t2 /* 表和上游 */ ON t1.table_name = t2.table_name) GROUP BY table_name) AS t4 ON base.table_name = t4.table_name /* ad热度 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT table_name, NULL AS query7, NULL AS query30, NULL AS query60, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-02' AND '2026-05-31' THEN query_id ELSE NULL END) AS query90, NULL AS query180, NULL AS query270, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN '2025-05-31' AND '2026-05-31' THEN query_id ELSE NULL END) AS query1year, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-02' AND '2026-05-31' THEN user_name ELSE NULL END) AS user90, NULL AS avg_user_query_cnt90 FROM (SELECT table_name, user_name, query_id, logymd FROM table_query_cnt UNION ALL SELECT t2.lineage_table_name AS table_name, t1.user_name, t1.query_id, t1.logymd FROM table_query_cnt AS t1 INNER JOIN tb_upstream AS t2 /* 表和上游 */ ON t1.table_name = t2.table_name) GROUP BY table_name) AS t5 ON base.table_name = t5.table_name /* sla_dqc标签 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.lineage_table_name, MAX(t2.is_associate_sla) AS is_associate_sla, MAX(t2.is_dqc_monitor) AS is_dqc_monitor, MAX(t2.is_run_monitor) AS is_run_monitor FROM tb_task AS t1 LEFT JOIN sla_dqc AS t2 ON t1.task_id = t2.task_id GROUP BY t1.lineage_table_name) AS t6 ON base.table_name = t6.lineage_table_name LEFT JOIN t_mt_user AS t8 ON (base.user_names = t8.email OR SPLIT(base.user_names, '@')[0] = t8.nick) /* 热度最大值 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT LN(MAX(query90) + 1) AS query90_max_ln, LN(MAX(user90) + 1) AS user90_max_ln, 1 AS ji FROM (SELECT m.table_name, m.query90, m.user90 FROM base INNER JOIN (SELECT table_name, NULL AS query7, NULL AS query30, NULL AS query60, COUNT(DISTINCT query_id) AS query90, NULL AS query180, NULL AS query270, NULL AS query1year, COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) AS user90 FROM (SELECT table_name, user_name, query_id FROM table_query_cnt WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-02' AND '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT t2.lineage_table_name AS table_name, t1.user_name, t1.query_id FROM table_query_cnt AS t1 INNER JOIN tb_upstream AS t2 /* 表和上游 */ ON t1.table_name = t2.table_name WHERE t1.logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-02' AND '2026-05-31') GROUP BY table_name) AS m ON base.table_name = m.table_name)) AS t9 ON base.ji = t9.ji))

name: MC2局内指挥官等级
sql_units: /* 指挥官等级 >= X 级的场次 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_sjlv@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-04-22 15:19:29.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH level_detail AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, pvptype, battle_level, COUNT(*) AS battle_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, battle_level FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND accountid = ai_accountid AND ailevel = 0 AND battle_round > 0 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, battle_level) AS a GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, pvptype, battle_level), level_distinct AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, b.battle_level FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, 1 AS tmp FROM level_detail GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype) AS a JOIN (SELECT battle_level, COUNT(*) AS cnt, 1 AS tmp FROM level_detail GROUP BY battle_level HAVING cnt >= 10 /* -抛掉异常数据，某个维度至少出现过10次 */) AS b ON a.tmp = b.tmp ORDER BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, b.battle_level), level_sumover AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, battle_level, SUM(battle_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype ORDER BY battle_level DESC) AS bat_cnt FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, a.battle_level, COALESCE(b.battle_cnt, 0) AS battle_cnt FROM level_distinct AS a LEFT JOIN level_detail AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.pvptype = b.pvptype AND a.battle_level = b.battle_level)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_monthly_mission_battle_level_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, battle_level, bat_cnt FROM level_sumover

name: MC2局内ID为X的羁绊达到N层
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_sjlv@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-04-22 16:10:12.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH jiban_detail AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, pvptype, relation_id, b.mrelationattach, relation_num, COUNT(*) AS battle_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, pvptype, battleid, SPLIT(info, ':')[0] AS relation_id, CAST(SPLIT(info, ':')[1] AS INT) AS relation_num FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(reachdefencerelation, '\\073')) AS info WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND ailevel = 0 AND accountid = ai_accountid AND NOT SPLIT(info, ':')[0] IS NULL AND SPLIT(info, ':')[0] <> '' AND SPLIT(info, ':')[0] <> '0' AND NOT SPLIT(info, ':')[1] IS NULL) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT relationid, mrelationattach FROM mt_dim.dim_relationskilltip_mcgg_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-04-07', '2025-04-07', '2026-05-31') AND servertype = 1 /* -取正是区服的 */) AS b ON a.relation_id = b.relationid GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, pvptype, relation_id, b.mrelationattach, relation_num), jiban_dis AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, a.relation_id, a.mrelationattach, b.relation_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, relation_id, mrelationattach FROM jiban_detail GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype, relation_id, mrelationattach) AS a JOIN (SELECT relation_id, mrelationattach, relation_num, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM jiban_detail GROUP BY relation_id, mrelationattach, relation_num HAVING cnt >= 10 /* -排除异常的维度 */) AS b ON a.relation_id = b.relation_id AND a.mrelationattach = b.mrelationattach), jiban_sumover AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, relation_id, mrelationattach, relation_num, SUM(bat_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype, relation_id, mrelationattach ORDER BY relation_num DESC) AS battle_cnt FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, a.relation_id, a.mrelationattach, a.relation_num, COALESCE(b.battle_cnt, 0) AS bat_cnt FROM jiban_dis AS a LEFT JOIN jiban_detail AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.pvptype = b.pvptype AND a.relation_id = b.relation_id AND a.mrelationattach = b.mrelationattach AND a.relation_num = b.relation_num)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_monthly_mission_relation_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, relation_id, mrelationattach, relation_num, battle_cnt FROM jiban_sumover WHERE battle_cnt > 0

name: MC2局内任意羁绊达到N层
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_sjlv@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-04-22 17:02:34.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH jiban_info AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, pvptype, battleid, MAX(relation_num) AS max_rel_num FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, pvptype, battleid, SPLIT(info, ':')[0] AS relation_id, CAST(SPLIT(info, ':')[1] AS INT) AS relation_num FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(reachdefencerelation, '\\073')) AS info WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND ailevel = 0 AND accountid = ai_accountid AND NOT SPLIT(info, ':')[0] IS NULL AND SPLIT(info, ':')[0] <> '' AND SPLIT(info, ':')[0] <> '0' AND NOT SPLIT(info, ':')[1] IS NULL) AS a GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, pvptype, battleid), battle_info AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, pvptype, sql_units: WITH t_basic /* GROUP BY roleid */ AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country /*              , MAX(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country */ FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-04-20', '2025-04-20', '2026-05-31') AND /*   AND zoneid < IF( '2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03',  57000 , 999999) */ /*   AND is_ai = 0 */ is_first_create = 1), t_pay AS (SELECT t.logymd, t.point, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, SUM(t.money) AS point_amt FROM (SELECT logymd, money, roleid, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /*    AND zoneid < IF( '2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03',  57000 , 999999) */ is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR receipt_type = 0) AND money <> 0 AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%') AS t RIGHT JOIN t_basic ON t.roleid = t_basic.roleid GROUP BY t.logymd, t.point, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') HAVING point_amt > 0), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-04-23', '2025-04-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mcgg_v2_synclog') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_charge` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mcgg_v2', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country, '' AS network, point_cnt, SUM(point_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname ORDER BY point) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_pay.point_amt, 0) AS point_cnt, t_incr.appname FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_pay ON t_incr.country = t_pay.country AND t_incr.point = t_pay.point) AS t1

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_mcgg_v2_realtime_create_daily
sql_units: WITH t_create AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT roleid AS account_id, first_mt_country AS country, register_date AS logymd, LEAST(287, (HOUR(register_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(register_time) * 60 + SECOND(register_time)) DIV 300) AS point FROM (SELECT roleid, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country /*    , account_register_time */ /*    , account_register_date */, create_role_date AS register_date, create_role_time AS register_time FROM `mcgg_dim`.`dim_basic_role_zone_df` WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-04-20', '2025-04-20', '2026-05-31') AND /* AND     zoneid < 57000 */ /* AND     appid = 'mlbb' */ /* AND zoneid < IF( '2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03',  57000 , 999999) */ /* AND     is_ai = 0 */ is_first_create = 1 AND create_role_date = '2026-05-31') AS t2) AS t), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-04-23', '2025-04-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mcgg_v2_synclog') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_create` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mcgg_v2', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, '' AS network, COALESCE(t2.point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(t2.point_cnt, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS day_cnt FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN (SELECT point, country, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS point_cnt FROM t_create GROUP BY logymd, point, country HAVING point_cnt > 0) AS t2 ON t2.point = t_incr.point AND t2.country = t_incr.country

DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 1360 THEN '9_4~5年' /* 4~5年 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 1000 THEN '8_3~4年' /* 3~4年 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 720 THEN '7_2~3年' /* 2~3年 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 360 THEN '6_1~2年' /* 1~2年 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 180 THEN '5_半年~1年' /* 半年~1年 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 90 THEN register_date) = 0 THEN '1_0天(当日新增)' /* 当日新增 */ ELSE '11_qita' END AS retention_create_type /* 用户注册时长 */, CASE WHEN b.money_1_sum > 0 AND money_all_sum - money_1_sum > 0 THEN money_all_sum - > 0 THEN money_30_sum_1 ELSE 0 END AS money_30_sum_1 /* 30日付费 */ FROM dau AS a LEFT JOIN rlabel_1 AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN rlabel_30 AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('RU', 'ID', 'PH', 'MY', 'SG') THEN first_mt_country ELSE '其他' END, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 1720 THEN '10_5年以上' /* 5年以上 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 1360 THEN '9_4~5年' /* 4~5年 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 1000 THEN '8_3~4年' /* 3~4年 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 720 THEN '7_2~3年' /* 2~3年 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 360 THEN '6_1~2年' /* 1~2年 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 180 THEN '5_半年~1年' /* 半年~1年 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 90 THEN '4_90-179天' /* 90~179天 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 30 THEN '3_30-89天' /* 30~89天 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 1 THEN '2_1-29天(新用户)' /* 1~29天 新用户 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) = 0 THEN '1_0天(当日新增)' /* 当日新增 */ ELSE '11_qita' END, CASE WHEN b.money_1_sum > 0 AND money_all_sum - money_1_sum > 0 THEN money_all_sum - money_1_sum /* 生涯充值含当日去掉当日数据 */ WHEN b.money_1_sum > 0 AND money_all_sum - money_1_sum <= 0 THEN 0 /* 排除对不上的账 */ ELSE money_all_sum /* 空值/没充，就不用减去 */ END, CASE WHEN c.money_30_sum_1 > 0 THEN money_30_sum_1 ELSE 0 END), sub_diamond_totay /* 当日耗钻 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN operate IN ('shop_buy', 'action_act_doubleelevendraw', 'activity_snk_draw', 'gift_buy', 'action_act_ikidraw_ps', 'action_act_novicedraw', 'action_act_ikidraw_pj', 'activity_constellation_draw', 'action_act_goddesscarddraw', 'activity_loot_box', 'activity_luckydraw', 'action_act_ikidraw_pz', 'activity_smalldraw') THEN operate ELSE '其他' END AS operate, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_diamond_today FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND NOT operate IN ('gm') AND operate IN ('action_act_transfomerbingo_gas') /* gas 24.10.5~11.5 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN operate IN ('shop_buy', 'action_act_doubleelevendraw', 'activity_snk_draw', 'gift_buy', 'action_act_themelottery ', 'action_act_themeraffle', 'action_act_twodimensiondraw2021', 'action_act_advancedraw', 'action_act_ikidraw_yks', 'activity_magicdraw', 'action_act_ikidraw', 'action_act_commondraw2023', 'action_act_ikidraw_pq', 'action_act_mpldraw', 'action_act_ikidraw_wof', 'action_act_starwarsdraw', 'action_act_24yaspass', 'activity_luckydraw', 'action_act_ikidraw_pz', 'activity_smalldraw') THEN operate ELSE '其他' END) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.teemoyu_ru_diamond_operate_result_one_20250426_02 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', operate_tag = 'all') SELECT first_mt_country, retention_create_type /* 用户注册时长 */, CASE WHEN money_all_sum_1 / 100 >= 2000 THEN '[2000,+)' WHEN money_all_sum_1 / 100 >= 200 THEN '[200,2000)' WHEN money_all_sum_1 / 100 >= 20 THEN '[20,200)' WHEN money_all_sum_1 / 100 >= 2 THEN '[2,20)' WHEN money_all_sum_1 / 100 > 0 THEN '(0,2)' ELSE '0' END AS money_all_sum_type /* 付费层级划分，单位美元 生涯r级(不含当日) */, CASE WHEN money_30_sum_1 / 100 >= 200 THEN '[200,+)' WHEN money_30_sum_1 / 100 >= 50 THEN '[50,200)' WHEN money_30_sum_1 / 100 >= 10 THEN '[10,50)' WHEN money_30_sum_1 / 100 '&')[1] AS client_version, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(client_ip AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS ip, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(channel AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS channel, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(os_type AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS os_type, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS client_country, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(zoneid AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS zone_id, MIN('none') AS device_id, MIN(time) AS time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_loginv2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, CASE WHEN clickid IS NULL OR COALESCE(clickid, 'none') IN ('', 'none') THEN 'none' ELSE clickid END), loginv2_start AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, CASE WHEN app_clickid IS NULL OR COALESCE(app_clickid, 'none') IN ('', 'none') THEN 'none' ELSE app_clickid END AS app_clickid, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(client_version AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS client_version, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(ip AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS ip, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(channel AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS channel, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(op_type AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS os_type, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(GEOIP(ip, 1) AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS client_country, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(zoneid AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS zone_id, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(device_id AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS device_id, MIN(time) ELSE app_clickid END), main_user AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, app_clickid, MIN_BY(client_version, time) AS client_version, MIN_BY(ip, time) AS ip, MIN_BY(channel, time) AS channel, MIN_BY(os_type, gameserver_loginv2_pv, total_start_pv, device_id, app_clickid, loginv2_start_time, login_auth_time, gameserver_login_time, gameserver_loginv2_time FROM user_login_funnel

COALESCE(SUM(pay_di.pay_amt_exrate), 0) AS pay_amt_exrate, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt_period, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt > 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_cnt_period, COALESCE(SUM(act.online_dur), 0) AS online_dur, COALESCE(SUM(IF(bas.register_date >= '2026-05-02' AND bas.register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND act.is_td = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS new_active_cnt, COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS register_cnt_total, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act.is_7ds = 1 AND act.is_7d = 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS lose_cnt_7ds, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act.is_7ds = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt_7ds, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act.is_30ds = 1 AND act.is_30d = 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS lose_cnt_30ds, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act.is_30ds = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt_30ds, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act.is_7d = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt_7days, COALESCE(SUM(pay_di.year_pay_amt), 0) AS year_pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_di.year_before_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS year_before_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_df.his_pay_amt), 0) AS his_pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_df.his_before_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS his_before_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1 AND act.is_1_14d <> 1 AND bas.register_date < '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-31' >= DATE_ADD('2024-11-28', 14), 1, 0)), 0) AS recurring_cnt_14days, COALESCE(SUM(IF(bas.register_date <= '2026-05-16' AND COALESCE(act.is_1_14d, 0) = 0 AND '2026-05-31' >= DATE_ADD('2024-11-28', 14), 1, 0)), 0) AS nologin_cnt_14days, COALESCE(SUM(pay_di.actual_pay_amt), 0) AS actual_pay_amt, 2 AS user_type, NULL AS channel, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act.is_90d = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt_90days, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1 AND (act.activedays_7days >= 2 OR pay_amt_7days > 0), 1, 0)), 0) AS vaild_user_cnt, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(IF(act.is_td = 1 AND (act.activedays_7days >= 2 OR pay_amt_7days > 0), act.online_dur_7days, 0)) / LEAST(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '2024-11-28') + 1, 7), 0), 0) AS vaild_user_online_dur FROM basic AS bas LEFT JOIN active_all_account AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid LEFT JOIN account_pay_di AS pay_di ON bas.roleid = pay_di.roleid LEFT JOIN account_pay_df AS pay_df ON bas.roleid = pay_df.roleid GROUP BY COALESCE(bas.country, 'unknown')

online_dur /*	当日玩家总在线时长(单位：s) */, NULL AS new_active_cnt /*	新用户活跃玩家数 */, COALESCE(register_cnt_total, 0) AS register_cnt_total /*	历史总注册玩家数 */, COALESCE(lose_cnt_7ds, 0) AS lose_cnt_7ds /*	7日流失玩家数 */, active_cnt_7days, SUM(COALESCE(act_di.is_30d, 0)) AS active_cnt_30days, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act_di.is_7ds = 1 AND act_di.is_7d = 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS lose_cnt_7ds, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act_di.is_7ds = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt_7ds, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act_di.is_30ds = 1 AND act_di.is_30d = 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS lose_cnt_30ds, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act_di.is_30ds = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt_30ds, name: jaxzhong_用户战斗性能和网络表
output_hint: jaxzhong_用户战斗性能和网络表
sql_units: WITH users AS (SELECT logymd, roleid AS accountid, zoneid FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid), battle_performance AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, MAX(ram) AS ram, MAX(digItal) AS digital, MAX(is_download) AS is_download, MAX(device_score) AS device_score, SUM(battle_cnt_performance) AS battle_cnt_performance, SUM(battleendtotalpss) AS battleendtotalpss, SUM(big_num2) AS big_num2, SUM(swap_std_rate) AS swap_std_rate, SUM(temp_rate) AS temp_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN is_battery_clean_data = 1 THEN current_avg END) AS current_avg, SUM(fps) AS fps, SUM(input_delay) AS input_delay, SUM(CASE WHEN is_battery_clean_data = 1 THEN battle_cnt_performance END) AS battle_cnt_current FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_battle_performance_channel_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_quality_recommend = 1 AND is_pvptype_match = 1 AND is_performance1_clean_data = 1 AND /* and is_fps_match=1   ----现在不再只关注目标帧率<60的数据，所有数据都要监控 */ is_nodownload_process = 1 /* and zoneid<57000 */ GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid), battle_net AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS battle_net_cnt, SUM(IF(use_udp = 10, 1, 0)) AS udp_ok_cnt /* -udp ok的场次 */, SUM(timedelay) AS ping_cnt /* -用户总战斗延迟,ping值中位数 */, SUM(movelag) AS movelag /* -用户移动延迟次数 */, SUM(skilllag) AS sklag_cnt /* -用户技能延迟次数 */, SUM(operate800 / 100) AS stdping_cnt /* --用户所有场次stdping */, SUM(battletime) AS battletime_net /* -网络表下的战斗时长 */, SUM(smallreconnect_num) AS small_connect /* -所有战斗的小重连次数 */, SUM(bytesc2s) AS up_byte /* -用户所有场次上行字节 */, SUM(bytess2c) AS down_byte /* -用户所有场次下行字节 */, SUM(packetsc2s) AS up_packet /* -用户所有场次上行包, */, SUM(packetss2c) AS down_packet /* -用户所有场次下行包, */, SUM(CASE WHEN (ping120 + ping150 + ping200 + ping300 + ping500 + ping800) / ping_times <= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS battle_net_ok /* -网络满足战斗场次 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND timedelay > 0 AND timedelay <> 10000 AND timedelay < 50000 AND maxdelay < 50000 AND movelag < 10000 AND zoneid < 57000 AND isvalid = 1 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), output_table AS (SELECT s1.accountid, s1.zoneid, s2.ram, s2.digital /* -32位还是64位 */, s2.device_score /* --设备评分 */, s2.battle_cnt_performance, s2.battleendtotalpss /* -结束战斗时的占用内存总值 */, s2.big_num2 /* -大卡顿的战斗场次总数，注意他成了100防止有小数上报不了，实际200就是指一场战斗卡顿次数<=2次的就是表明满足，这场战斗没有大卡顿 */, s2.swap_std_rate /* 渲染出帧稳定性 */, s2.temp_rate /* 发热情况满足率,每10分钟发热小于0.6度即为战斗满足 */, s2.current_avg /* -平均电流 */, s2.input_delay, s2.fps, s2.battle_cnt_current, S3.battle_net_cnt, S3.udp_ok_cnt, S3.ping_cnt, S3.sklag_cnt, S3.stdping_cnt, S3.battletime_net, S3.small_connect, S3.up_byte, S3.down_byte, S3.up_packet, S3.down_packet, S3.battle_net_ok, s3.movelag FROM users AS s1 LEFT JOIN battle_performance AS s2 ON s1.accountid = s2.accountid AND s1.zoneid = s2.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle_net AS s3 ON s1.accountid = s3.accountid AND s1.zoneid = s3.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jaxzhong_dau_wide_battle_perf_net_internal1_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 覆盖写入 */ SELECT CAST(accountid AS STRING), CAST(zoneid AS STRING), digital, device_score, battle_cnt_performance, battleendtotalpss, big_num2, swap_std_rate, temp_rate, current_avg, battle_net_cnt, udp_ok_cnt, ping_cnt, sklag_cnt, stdping_cnt, battletime_net, small_connect, up_byte, down_byte, up_packet, down_packet, battle_net_ok, fps, input_delay, ram, movelag, battle_cnt_current FROM output_table

name: jaxzhong_用户创角信息
