xxx1.logymd, xxx1.roleid AS accountid, xxx1.zoneid, register_date, create_country, first_network_name AS create_media_source, create_os, create_device, create_channel, create_ip, create_sex, first_ad_country AS create_ad_country, first_mt_country AS create_mt_country, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, account_register_time, area_id AS create_area_id, new_type, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel AS adjust_game_channel, his_first_deviceid AS create_device_id, his_first_os_language AS CREATE_os_language, his_first_os_version AS CREATE_os_version, his_first_loginclient_version AS create_client_version, data_source AS create_data_source, is_small AS create_is_small FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS xxx1 JOIN users AS xxx2 ON xxx1.roleid = xxx2.accountid AND xxx1.zoneid = xxx2.zoneid WHERE xxx1.logymd = '2026-05-30'), last_30days_charge AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, CONCAT('{', '"last_pay_day":"', COALESCE(last_pay_day, 'none'), '",', '"last30d_pay_cnt":"', COALESCE(last30d_pay_cnt, 'none'), '",', '"last30d_pay_amount":"', COALESCE(last30d_pay_amount, 'none'), '",', '"last7d_pay_cnt":"', COALESCE(last7d_pay_cnt, 'none'), '",', '"last7d_pay_amount":"', COALESCE(last7d_pay_amount, 'none'), '"', '}') AS last_30days_pay_json FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, zoneid, COALESCE(SUM(money), 0) AS last30d_pay_amount /* -不含当日 */, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 0) AS last30d_pay_cnt, COALESCE(MAX(logymd), 'none') AS last_pay_day, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-23' AND '2026-05-29' THEN receipt_id END), 0) AS last7d_pay_cnt /* -不含当日 */, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-23' AND '2026-05-29' THEN money END), 0) AS last7d_pay_amount FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-29' AND is_sandbox = 0 AND money > 0 AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS xxx2), output_table AS (SELECT s1.accountid, s1.zoneid, s2.last_30days_pay_json, s3.register_date, s3.create_country, s3.create_media_source, s3.create_os, s3.create_device, s3.create_channel, s3.create_ip, s3.create_sex, s3.create_ad_country, s3.create_mt_country, s3.adjust_campaign_id, s3.adjust_campaign_name, s3.account_register_time, s3.create_area_id, s3.new_type, s3.adjust_adset_name, s3.adjust_adset_id, s3.adjust_creative_name, s3.adjust_creative_id, s3.adjust_game_channel, s3.create_device_id, s3.CREATE_os_language, s3.CREATE_os_version, s3.create_client_version, s3.create_data_source, s3.create_is_small FROM users AS s1 LEFT JOIN last_30days_charge AS s2 ON s1.accountid = s2.accountid AND s1.zoneid = s2.zoneid LEFT JOIN basic_info AS s3 ON s1.accountid = s3.accountid AND s1.zoneid = s3.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jaxzhong_dau_wide_last_30days_charge1_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') /* 覆盖写入 */ SELECT CAST(accountid AS STRING), CAST(zoneid AS STRING), last_30days_pay_json, register_date, create_country, create_media_source, create_os, create_device, create_channel, create_ip, create_sex, create_ad_country, create_mt_country, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, account_register_time, create_area_id, new_type, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, adjust_game_channel, create_device_id, CREATE_os_language, CREATE_os_version, create_client_version, create_data_source, create_is_small FROM output_table

name: MC2局内至尊神明装备出装及使用
output_hint: MC2局内至尊神明装备出装及使用
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_sjlv@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-04-28 20:45:04.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* -每天起一个表，统计每个用户当日战斗里，出的第1~3件神明装备（不足的补null 或者 0），带上羁绊层数 */ WITH total_battle AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN a.zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS servertype, a.battleid, a.pvptype, a.bigranklvl, a.camprank, CASE WHEN c.real_player_num = 8 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS if_ai FROM (/* 获取对局类型和大段位 */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, bigranklvl, camprank FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND camprank <> 0 AND pvptype IN (39, 170) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, bigranklvl, camprank) AS a JOIN (/* -获取真实对战人数 */ SELECT battleid, accountid, zoneid, real_player_num FROM mcgg_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (39, 170) AND success = 1 GROUP BY battleid, accountid, zoneid, real_player_num) AS c ON a.battleid = c.battleid AND a.accountid = c.accountid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid), jiban_info AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, SPLIT(info, ':')[0] AS relation_id, CAST(SPLIT(info, ':')[1] AS INT) AS relation_num FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew AS a LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(reachdefencerelation, '\\073')) AS info WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-06-01' AND ailevel = 0 AND ai_accountid = accountid AND EXISTS(SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid FROM total_battle AS b WHERE a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.battleid = b.battleid) AND NOT info IS NULL AND info <> '' AND SPLIT(info, ':')[0] = '56'), round_info AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, SPLIT(info, ',')[0] AS id, CAST(SPLIT(info, ',')[1] AS INT) AS num FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundinfo AS a LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(godlevel, '\\073')) AS info WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-06-01' /* -防止丢round信息，拼接两天的round数据 */ AND ailevel = 0 AND ai_accountid = accountid AND EXISTS(SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid FROM total_battle AS b WHERE a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.battleid = b.battleid) AND NOT godlevel IS NULL AND godlevel <> '' AND NOT SPLIT(info, ',')[0] IS NULL AND SPLIT(info, ',')[0] <> ''), shenming_info AS (/* -每个用户单局中，某个神明装备出场的顺序,根据出现的回合数排序；回合数相同则层数更高的装备作为首个 */ SELECT accountid, name: MC2局内获取B费英雄
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_sjlv@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-05-06 15:45:22.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* --局内获取>=B费英雄的个数 */ WITH price_dis AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, b.price FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, 1 AS tmp FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_monthly_mission_chess_get_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT pvptype, price, COUNT(*) AS cnt, 1 AS tmp FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_monthly_mission_chess_get_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY pvptype, price HAVING cnt >= 10) AS b ON a.tmp = b.tmp AND a.pvptype = b.pvptype), price_sumover AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, price, SUM(chess_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype ORDER BY price DESC) AS cnt FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, CAST(a.price AS INT) AS price, COALESCE(b.chess_cnt, 0) AS chess_cnt FROM price_dis AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, price, SUM(chess_cnt) AS chess_cnt FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_monthly_mission_chess_get_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype, price) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.price = b.price AND a.pvptype = b.pvptype)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_monthly_mission_chess_price_get_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, price, cnt FROM price_sumover WHERE cnt > 0

name: export_bytedance.gameserver_report_player_now_2024_hi
sql_units: WITH filter_user AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SPLIT(infos, '_')[1] AS target_country FROM ml_temp.yudongzhang_tmp_role_infos_02 WHERE logymd = '2026-01-13' AND info_type LIKE 'final_90d_notUSplayer_OhtermajorArea_%'), adv_us_us AS (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND UPPER(COALESCE(create_country, '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') GROUP BY roleid), filter_finnal AS (SELECT a.roleid AS us_user FROM adv_us_us AS a LEFT JOIN filter_user AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE b.roleid IS NULL GROUP BY a.roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.gameserver_report_player_now_2024_hi PARTITION(logymd = '2026-06-01', hour = '05') SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, battleid, rankid, iswin, reported_roleid, reported_iswin, report01, report02, report03, report04, report05, report06, report07, report_zoneid FROM (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, battleid, rankid, iswin, reported_roleid, reported_iswin, report01, report02, report03, report04, report05, report06, report07, report_zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_report_player_now_2024 WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) <> 35) AS t1 LEFT JOIN filter_finnal AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.us_user LEFT JOIN filter_finnal AS t3 ON t1.reported_roleid = t3.us_user WHERE t2.us_user IS NULL AND t3.us_user IS NULL

t1.endTime, task_id, COALESCE(t2.task_name, t6.task_name), COALESCE(is_completed, 0), COALESCE(t3.nick, t4.nick, t6.nick) AS user_name, COALESCE(t3.dp_name, t4.dp_name, t6.dp_name) AS dp_name, DECIMAL(18, 2)), CAST(memory_minute AS DECIMAL(18, 2)), COALESCE(CAST(shuffleReadGB AS DECIMAL(18, 2)), 0.0), COALESCE(CAST(shuffleWriteGB AS DECIMAL(18, 2)), 0), COALESCE(CAST(shuffleWriteTime AS DECIMAL(18, 2)), 0), COALESCE(CAST(shuffleFetchWaitTime AS DECIMAL(18, 2)), 0), COALESCE(output_files_num, 0), COALESCE(CAST(output_files_size AS DECIMAL(18, 2)), 0), COALESCE(executor_memory, 0) AS sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: haochuanfeng@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-05-15 11:15:25.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 活跃账号及未进游账号 */ WITH valid_data AS (SELECT m.accountid, create_account_date, region_id, create_account_os_type, first_mt_country, create_device_level, active_arr, charge_arr, COALESCE(normal_campaign_init, 0) AS normal_campaign_init, CASE WHEN first_mt_country IN ('us') THEN 'US' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('nz', 'sg', 'au') THEN 'T1' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('ca', 'gb', 'de', 'fr', 'gr', 'tr', 'cy', 'se', 'lu', 'hr', 'me', 'dk', 'is', 'bg', 'it', 'es', 'si', 'rs', 'pt', 'mt', 'xk', 'nl', 'ba', 'be', 'ie', 'hu', 'sk', 'ch', 'no', 'ro', 'cz', 'fi', 'pl', 'at', 'al') THEN 'EU' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('pr', 'mq', 'aw', 'kh', 'mm', 'la', 'bn', 'id', 'ph', 'my', 'th', 'cw', 'cu', 'ht', 'vg', 've', 'tc', 'lc', 'ni', 'ms', 'gy', 'co', 'do', 'bm', 'py', 'ag', 'jm', 'gt', 'sr', 'kn', 'mx', 'ky', 'gd', 'ec', 'bz', 'br', 'bs', 'ai', 'cl', 'uy', 'tt', 'vc', 'sv', 'pe', 'hn', 'cr', 'dm', 'bo', 'pa', 'bb', 'ar', 'sa', 'qa', 'kw', 'il', 'ae', 'om', 'bh') THEN 'T3' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('lt', 'md', 'ee', 'lv', 'tm', 'az', 'ge', 'by', 'ua', 'tj', 'kg', 'kz', 'ru') THEN 'RU' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('kr') THEN 'KR' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('jp') THEN 'JP' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('hk', 'mo', 'tw') THEN 'THM' ELSE 'Others' END AS publish_country, CASE first_mt_country WHEN 'us' THEN '美国' WHEN 'jp' THEN '日本' WHEN 'kr' THEN '韩国' WHEN 'gb' THEN '英国' WHEN 'ru' THEN '俄罗斯' WHEN 'fr' THEN '法国' WHEN 'de' THEN '德国' WHEN 'ca' THEN '加拿大' WHEN 'hk' THEN '香港' WHEN 'tw' THEN '台湾' WHEN 'sg' THEN '新加坡' WHEN 'my' THEN '马来西亚' WHEN 'th' THEN '泰国' WHEN 'br' THEN '巴西' ELSE '其他' END AS country FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT accountid, normal_campaign_init, create_account_date, region_id, create_account_os_type, LOWER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, create_device_level, active_arr, charge_arr, cum_charge_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY create_account_time, create_role_time) AS rn FROM zgame_dm.dm_zgame_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a WHERE rn = 1) AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid FROM zg_temp.bot_user_detection WHERE create_account_date <= '2026-05-31' AND deter = 0 GROUP BY accountid) AS n ON m.accountid = n.accountid WHERE NOT (n.accountid IS NULL AND cum_charge_amount = 0)), active_info /* 活跃数据 */ AS (SELECT create_account_date, region_id, create_account_os_type, create_device_level, publish_country, country, normal_campaign_init, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', create_account_date) - day_ind + 1 AS user_life_day FROM (SELECT create_account_date, region_id, create_account_os_type, create_device_level, COALESCE(normal_campaign_init, 0) AS normal_campaign_init, publish_country, country, day_ind, is_active_exploded FROM valid_data LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(active_arr) tmp AS day_ind, is_active_exploded WHERE SIZE(active_arr) > 0) AS a WHERE is_active_exploded = 1), cum_charge_info /* 总累计付费数据 */ AS (SELECT create_account_date, region_id, create_account_os_type, create_device_level, publish_country, country, normal_campaign_init, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', create_account_date) - day_ind + 1 AS user_life_day, charge_amount_exploded AS charge_amount FROM (SELECT create_account_date, region_id, create_account_os_type, create_device_level, COALESCE(normal_campaign_init, 0) AS normal_campaign_init, publish_country, country, day_ind, charge_amount_exploded FROM valid_data LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(charge_arr) t AS day_ind, charge_amount_exploded WHERE SIZE(active_arr) > 0) AS a WHERE charge_amount_exploded > 0) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE zg_temp.wor_ltv_retention_history SELECT *, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', create_account_date) + 1 AS life_span FROM (SELECT a.*, b.user_life_day, DATE_ADD(a.create_account_date, b.user_life_day - 1) AS logymd, COALESCE(active_num, 0) AS active_num, COALESCE(total_charge_amount, 0) AS total_charge_amount, LAG(COALESCE(active_num, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY a.create_account_date, a.region_id, a.create_account_os_type, a.create_device_level, a.normal_campaign_init, a.publish_country, a.country ORDER BY b.user_life_day) AS last_active_num, SUM(COALESCE(total_charge_amount, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY a.create_account_date, a.region_id, a.create_account_os_type, a.create_device_level, a.normal_campaign_init, a.publish_country, a.country ORDER BY b.user_life_day rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_charge_amount FROM (SELECT create_account_date, region_id, create_account_os_type, create_device_level, normal_campaign_init, publish_country, country, COUNT(*) AS init_num FROM valid_data GROUP BY create_account_date, region_id, create_account_os_type, create_device_level, normal_campaign_init, publish_country, country) AS a /* 填充不活跃日 */ JOIN (SELECT create_account_date, user_life_day FROM active_info GROUP BY create_account_date, user_life_day) AS b ON a.create_account_date = b.create_account_date LEFT JOIN (SELECT create_account_date, region_id, create_account_os_type, create_device_level, normal_campaign_init, publish_country, country, user_life_day, COUNT(*) AS active_num FROM active_info GROUP BY create_account_date, region_id, create_account_os_type, create_device_level, normal_campaign_init, publish_country, country, user_life_day) AS c ON a.create_account_date = c.create_account_date AND a.region_id = c.region_id AND a.create_account_os_type = c.create_account_os_type AND a.create_device_level = c.create_device_level AND a.normal_campaign_init = c.normal_campaign_init AND a.publish_country = c.publish_country AND a.country = c.country AND b.user_life_day = c.user_life_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT create_account_date, region_id, create_account_os_type, create_device_level, normal_campaign_init, publish_country, country, user_life_day, SUM(charge_amount) AS total_charge_amount FROM cum_charge_info GROUP BY create_account_date, region_id, create_account_os_type, create_device_level, normal_campaign_init, publish_country, country, user_life_day) AS d ON a.create_account_date = d.create_account_date AND a.region_id = d.region_id AND a.create_account_os_type = d.create_account_os_type AND a.create_device_level = d.create_device_level AND a.normal_campaign_init = d.normal_campaign_init AND a.publish_country = d.publish_country AND a.country = d.country AND b.user_life_day = d.user_life_day) AS m WHERE (user_life_day BETWEEN 1 AND 30 OR user_life_day % 30 = 0)

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.mcgg_ods_battleserver_battle_end PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT md.time, md.loghms, md.accountid, md.zoneid, md.os_type, md.level, md.battle_count, md.battleid, md.battletime, md.pvptype, md.realpvptype, md.battleresulttype FROM (SELECT time, loghms, accountid, zoneid, os_type, level, battle_count, battleid, battletime, pvptype, realpvptype, battleresulttype FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(clientip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS md LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-01', '2025-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 4280 AND (UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') OR UPPER(ip_country) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') OR UPPER(last_ad_country) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') OR UPPER(first_ad_country) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') OR UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') OR UPPER(last_mt_country) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI'))) AS bd ON md.accountid = bd.roleid AND md.zoneid = bd.zoneid WHERE bd.roleid IS NULL

name: etl.ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_cube_di_mcgg_v2_account_daily
sql_units: /* -不同步率 */ WITH md5error_tbl AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.battleid, a.md5error FROM (SELECT logymd, md5error, battleid FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end /* -此处根据各项目实际库表名称更换 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND isvalid = 1 AND zoneid < 57000 /* -------根据每个项目实际情况，此处剔除测服数据 */ AND pvptype IN (39) /* -此处根据各项目实际进行限制，剔除自定义/单机/教学关等非正式模式 */ GROUP BY logymd, md5error, battleid) AS a JOIN (SELECT logymd, battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS usercnt FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_begin WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 /* -------根据每个项目实际情况，此处剔除测服数据 */ AND pvptype IN (39) /* -此处根据各项目实际进行限制，剔除自定义/单机/教学关等非正式模式 */ GROUP BY logymd, battleid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) > 1 /* -如果一局只有1个真人那么不会发生不同步 */) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.logymd = b.logymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mcgg_v2', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT date_range, grouping_name, definition_type, region, country, network, indicator_map FROM (/* 不同步率 */ SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, '()' AS grouping_name, 1 AS definition_type, 'all' AS region, 'all' AS country, 'all' AS network, CAST(MAP('md5error_cnt', md5error_cnt, 'md5error_battle_cnt', md5error_battle_cnt) AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>) AS indicator_map FROM (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN err.md5error > 0 THEN err.battleid END), 0) AS md5error_cnt, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT err.battleid), 0) AS md5error_battle_cnt FROM md5error_tbl AS err) UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, '()' AS grouping_name, 0 AS definition_type, 'all' AS region, 'all' AS country, 'all' AS network, CAST(MAP('md5error_cnt', md5error_cnt, 'md5error_battle_cnt', md5error_battle_cnt) AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>) AS indicator_map FROM (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN err.md5error > 0 THEN err.battleid END), 0) AS md5error_cnt, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT err.battleid), 0) AS md5error_battle_cnt FROM md5error_tbl AS err))

name: 回流数据导入
sql_units: WITH dm_zgame_behavior_feature_role_zone_df AS (SELECT * FROM mt_dm.dm_zgame_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-24' AND logymd <= '2026-01-20' AND is_active = 1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM zgame_dm.dm_zgame_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-24' AND logymd > '2026-01-20' AND is_active = 1), gameserver_quest_accept AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_quest_accept WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-30', '2026-05-29', '2026-05-28', '2026-05-24') AND (((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) AND logymd <= '2026-01-20') OR (zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 70000 AND logymd BETWEEN '2023-07-13' AND '2026-01-20') OR (zoneid >= 70001 AND logymd >= '2024-03-27')) AND questid = 610128 UNION ALL SELECT CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.logymd') AS STRING) AS logymd, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.roleid') AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) AS roleid, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.zoneid') AS BIGINT) AS zoneid FROM zgame_dwd.dwd_zgame_events_di WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-30', '2026-05-29', '2026-05-28', '2026-05-24') AND logymd > '2026-01-20' AND event = 'gameserver_quest_accept' AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.questid') = '610128' AND (CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.zoneid') AS BIGINT) = 1 OR CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.zoneid') AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 19001 AND 69999)), backflow_user AS (SELECT a.*, IF(NOT c.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_accept FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN zoneid >= 70001 THEN '亚太服' WHEN zoneid >= 50001 THEN '正式服' ELSE '先锋服' END AS zonetype, CASE WHEN first_mt_country IN ('us') THEN 'US' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('nz', 'sg', 'au') THEN 'T1' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('ca', 'gb', 'de', 'fr', 'gr', 'tr', 'cy', 'se', 'lu', 'hr', 'me', 'dk', 'is', 'bg', 'it', 'es', 'si', 'rs', 'pt', 'mt', 'xk', 'nl', 'ba', 'be', 'ie', 'hu', 'sk', 'ch', 'no', 'ro', 'cz', 'fi', 'pl', 'at', 'al') THEN 'EU' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('pr', 'mq', 'aw', 'kh', 'mm', 'la', 'bn', 'id', 'ph', 'my', 'th', 'cw', 'cu', 'ht', 'vg', 've', 'tc', 'lc', 'ni', 'ms', 'gy', 'co', 'do', 'bm', 'py', 'ag', 'jm', 'gt', 'sr', 'kn', 'mx', 'ky', 'gd', 'ec', 'bz', 'br', 'bs', 'ai', 'cl', 'uy', 'tt', 'vc', 'sv', 'pe', 'hn', 'cr', 'dm', 'bo', 'pa', 'bb', 'ar', 'sa', 'qa', 'kw', 'il', 'ae', 'om', 'bh') THEN 'T3' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('lt', 'md', 'ee', 'lv', 'tm', 'az', 'ge', 'by', 'ua', 'tj', 'kg', 'kz', 'ru') THEN 'RU' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('kr') THEN 'KR' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('jp') THEN 'JP' WHEN first_mt_country IN ('hk', 'mo', 'tw') THEN 'THM' ELSE 'Others' END AS publish_country, CASE first_mt_country WHEN 'us' THEN '美国' WHEN 'jp' THEN '日本' WHEN 'kr' THEN '韩国' WHEN 'gb' THEN '英国' WHEN 'ru' THEN '俄罗斯' WHEN 'fr' THEN '法国' WHEN 'de' THEN '德国' WHEN 'ca' THEN '加拿大' WHEN 'hk' THEN '香港' WHEN 'tw' THEN '台湾' ELSE '其他' END AS country, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_role_date) <= 30 THEN '00_0~1月' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_role_date) <= 60 THEN '01_1~2月' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_role_date) <= 120 THEN '02_3~4月' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_role_date) <= 180 THEN '03_5~6月' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_role_date) <= 270 THEN '04_7~9月' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_role_date) <= 360 THEN '05_10~12月' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_role_date) <= 450 THEN '06_13~15月' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_role_date) <= 540 THEN '07_16~18月' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_role_date) <= 630 THEN '08_19~21月' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_role_date) <= 720 THEN '09_22~24月' ELSE '10_25~月' END AS user_life_day, CASE WHEN min_gear_raid <= 5 THEN '00~05' WHEN min_gear_raid <= 9 THEN '06~09' WHEN min_gear_raid <= 12 THEN '10~12' WHEN min_gear_raid <= 15 THEN '13~15' WHEN min_gear_raid <= 18 THEN '16~18' WHEN min_gear_raid <= 20 THEN '19~20' ELSE CAST(min_gear_raid AS STRING) END AS min_gear_raid, CASE WHEN cum_charge_amount = 0 THEN '00' WHEN cum_charge_amount <= 20000 THEN '01_1~200' WHEN cum_charge_amount <= 100000 THEN '02_201~1k' WHEN cum_charge_amount <= 500000 THEN '03_1k~5k' WHEN cum_charge_amount <= 2000000 THEN '04_5k~2w' ELSE '05_2w~' END AS cum_charge_amount, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, last_login_date) <= 14 THEN '01_08-14' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, last_login_date) <= 30 THEN '02_15-30' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, last_login_date) <= 90 THEN '03_2~3月' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, last_login_date) <= 180 THEN '04_4~6月' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, last_login_date) <= 360 THEN '05_7~12月' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, last_login_date) <= 540 THEN '06_13~18月' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, last_login_date) <= 720 THEN '07_19~24月' ELSE '08_25~月' END AS churn_day, normal_campaign FROM dm_zgame_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-30', '2026-05-29', '2026-05-28', '2026-05-24') AND /* where logymd between '2024-06-25' and '2026-05-30' */ DATEDIFF(logymd, last_login_date) > 7) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid FROM zg_temp.bot_user_detection WHERE create_account_date <= '2026-05-30' AND deter = 0 GROUP BY accountid) AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid LEFT JOIN gameserver_quest_accept AS c ON a.accountid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.logymd = c.logymd WHERE IF(NOT (b.accountid IS NULL AND a.cum_charge_amount = '00' AND a.normal_campaign < 1005001), 0, 1) = 0) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE zg_temp.backflow_ltv_retention_history PARTITION(logymd) SELECT a.zonetype, publish_country, country, user_life_day, min_gear_raid, cum_charge_amount, churn_day, is_accept, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) = 0, 1, 0)) AS num, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) = 1, 1, 0)) AS ret_2_num, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) = 2, 1, 0)) AS ret_3_num, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) = 6, 1, 0)) AS ret_7_num, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) = 0, charge_amount, 0)) AS ltv_1, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) <= 1, charge_amount, 0)) AS ltv_2, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) <= 2, charge_amount, 0)) AS ltv_3, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) <= 6, charge_amount, 0)) AS ltv_7, a.logymd FROM backflow_user AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, charge_amount FROM dm_zgame_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-24' AND /* where logymd >= '2024-06-25' */ DATEDIFF(logymd, create_role_date) >= 8) AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND (DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) BETWEEN 0 AND 6) GROUP BY a.logymd, a.zonetype, publish_country, country, user_life_day, min_gear_raid, cum_charge_amount, churn_day, is_accept

name: dau问题研究
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.leavliu_temp_dau_202505 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT first_mt_country, reg_year /* active_label, */ /* new_label, */ /* return_label2, */, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd1, register_date) < 30 THEN 1 WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd1, register_date) BETWEEN 30 AND 90 THEN 2 WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd1, register_date) BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 3 ELSE FLOOR(DATEDIFF(logymd1, register_date) / 365) + 4 END AS retention_create_type /* 用户注册时长, */, gender, CASE WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(register_date, birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 9 THEN '[0,9]' WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(register_date, birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 10 AND 14 THEN '[10,14]' WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(register_date, birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 15 AND 19 THEN '[15,19]' WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(register_date, birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN '[20,24]' WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(register_date, birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN '[25,29]' WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(register_date, birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN '[30,34]' WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(register_date, birthday) / 365, 0) >= 35 THEN '[35,)' ELSE NULL END AS age_group_register /* 年龄段(中准中覆） 7岁以下很离谱，不看, */, CASE WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(logymd1, birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 9 THEN '[0,9]' WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(logymd1, birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 10 AND 14 THEN '[10,14]' WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(logymd1, birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 15 AND 19 THEN '[15,19]' WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(logymd1, birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN '[20,24]' WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(logymd1, birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN '[25,29]' WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(logymd1, birthday) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN '[30,34]' WHEN gt2 = 1 AND ROUND(DATEDIFF(logymd1, birthday) / 365, 0) >= 35 THEN '[35,)' ELSE NULL END AS age_group_now /* 年龄段(中准中覆） 7岁以下很离谱，不看, */, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid) AS uv, SUM(active_days) / 7 AS dau_contribution FROM (SELECT a.logymd1, a.roleid, a.zoneid, first_mt_country, birthday, gender, register_date, gt2, a.active_days, YEAR(country.register_date) AS reg_year /* case when label2.reg_date between '2023-10-23' and '2024-03-03' then 1 else 0 end new_label, */ /* nvl(return_label,0) as return_label2, */ /* b.active_days, --过去7日活跃天数（不含当日） */ /* CASE WHEN register_date between '2025-02-22' and '2025-03-29' THEN 'new' --当日新增 */ /* case when datediff(min_date,register_date)<=30 then -1 --30日新增 */ /* -- CASE WHEN register_date between '2025-02-24' and '2026-05-31'  THEN -1 --当日新增 */ /*      WHEN bb.active_days_7 >= 6 THEN 0 --周高活 */ /*      WHEN bb.active_days_7 >= 3 THEN 1 --周中活 */ /*      WHEN bb.active_days_7 >=1 THEN 2 --周低活 */ /*      WHEN bb.roleid IS NULL AND e.roleid IS NOT NULL THEN 3 --7-30回流 */ /*      WHEN bb.roleid IS NULL AND e.roleid IS NULL THEN 5 --6 */ /*      ELSE 6 */ /* END AS active_label */ FROM (SELECT logymd1, a1.roleid, a1.zoneid, active_days FROM (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd1, roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days, MIN(logymd) AS min_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid /* 异常账号 */, account_name /* 异常设备 */ FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd >= '2025-03-20' AND (os_build LIKE '%AP1%' OR (os_build IS NULL AND account_name LIKE '%mt%'))) AS a2 ON a1.roleid = a2.accountid WHERE a2.accountid IS NULL) AS a LEFT JOIN (/* 过去7日活跃 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days_7 FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-25', 7 * -1) AND logymd < '2026-05-25' /* 不含当日活跃 */ /* AND     zoneid < 57000 2025年1月10日修改为包含57测服 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS bb ON a.roleid = bb.roleid AND a.zoneid = bb.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-25', 30 * -1) AND logymd < DATE_ADD('2026-05-25', 7 * -1) /* AND     zoneid < 57000 2025年1月10日修改为包含57测服 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS e ON a.roleid = e.roleid AND a.zoneid = e.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = GREATEST('2026-05-31', '2025-05-20') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, register_date) AS country ON a.roleid = country.roleid AND a.zoneid = country.zoneid /* LEFT JOIN */ /*         ( */ /*             SELECT  roleid, */ /*                     zoneid, */ /*            min(register_date) as reg_date, */ /*            max(if_return30) as return_label */ /* from ml_temp.teemoyu_dau_20240516_featrue_01 */ /* where logymd between  '2023-10-23' and '2024-03-03' */ /* and first_mt_country='ID' */ /*             GROUP BY */ /*                     roleid, */ /*                     zoneid */ /*         ) label2 */ /* ON      a.roleid = label2.roleid */ /* AND     a.zoneid = label2.zoneid */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, gender /* 性别 */, birthday /* 生日（年龄单独换算） */, occupation /* 职业(跨度久的不具备参考性） */, gt1 /* 是否是高准低覆（1-是，0-否） */, gt2 /* 是否是中准中覆（1-是，0-否） */ FROM ml_temp.teemoyu_20240305_mc_guangzi_01 WHERE logymd = GREATEST('2026-05-31', '2025-05-20') GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, gender /* 性别 */, birthday /* 生日（年龄单独换算） */, occupation /* 职业(跨度久的不具备参考性） */, gt1 /* 是否是高准低覆（1-是，0-否） */, gt2 /* 是否是中准中覆（1-是，0-否） */) AS social_status ON a.roleid = social_status.roleid AND a.zoneid = social_status.zoneid) GROUP BY logymd1, first_mt_country, age_group_register, age_group_now, gender, retention_create_type, reg_year /* active_label */ /* ,new_label */

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_realtime_retention_daily_zgame
sql_units: /* location 'tos://mt-data-warehouse/mt-ads/table/ads_decismart_mlbb_realtime_retention'; */ WITH t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-03-23', '2025-03-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'zgame_synclog'), t AS (SELECT account_id, country, createdate AS logymd, createdate FROM (SELECT roleid AS account_id, register_date AS createdate, IF(TRIM(COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown')) IN ('', '-'), 'unknown', TRIM(COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown'))) AS country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY register_time) AS rn FROM bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df_tmp WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-02-23', '2025-02-23', '2026-05-31')) AS t1 WHERE createdate IN ('2026-05-30', '2026-05-25') AND rn = 1), t_login AS (SELECT roleid AS account_id, MIN_BY(LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300), `time`) AS point FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, `TIME` FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, `TIME` FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, `TIME` FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) /* 本表所有的ods role zone 全集，一般情况下login和logout等于全集，为防止遗漏，拼接上所有表 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, `TIME` FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_fight_pve WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) /* 先锋服 */ OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) /* 欧美 */ OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001) /* 亚太 */) AND (zoneid DIV 1000) <> 9 /* 排除内部测试用户 */) AS t GROUP BY roleid), t_register AS (SELECT country, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-30', account_id, NULL)) AS register_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-25', account_id, NULL)) AS register_cnt_7d FROM t GROUP BY country), t_create_base AS (SELECT point, country, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-30', t.account_id, NULL)) AS login_point_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-25', t.account_id, NULL)) AS login_point_cnt_7d FROM t JOIN t_login ON t.account_id = t_login.account_id GROUP BY point, country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_retention` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'zgame', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country, 0 AS create_role_point_cnt, 0 AS login_point_cnt, register_cnt AS create_role_point_cnt, SUM(login_point_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname ORDER BY point) AS login_day_cnt, register_cnt_7d AS create_role_point_cnt_7d, SUM(login_point_cnt_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname ORDER BY point) AS login_day_cnt_7d FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_create_base.login_point_cnt, 0) AS login_point_cnt, COALESCE(t_create_base.login_point_cnt_7d, 0) AS login_point_cnt_7d, COALESCE(t_register.register_cnt, 0) AS register_cnt, COALESCE(t_register.register_cnt_7d, 0) AS register_cnt_7d, t_incr.appname FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_create_base ON t_incr.country = t_create_base.country AND t_incr.point = t_create_base.point LEFT JOIN t_register ON t_incr.country = t_register.country) AS t1

name: etl.ml_temp.country_timezone_push

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_realtime_create_daily_mlbb

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_realtime_charge_daily_mlbb
sql_units: WITH t_basic /* GROUP BY roleid */ AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country /*              , MAX(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country */ FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-06', '2023-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND /*   AND zoneid < IF( '2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03',  57000 , 999999) */ is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), t_pay AS (SELECT t.logymd, t.point, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, SUM(t.money) AS point_amt FROM (SELECT logymd, money, roleid, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03', 57000, 999999) AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR receipt_type = 0) AND money <> 0 AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%') AS t RIGHT JOIN t_basic ON t.roleid = t_basic.roleid GROUP BY t.logymd, t.point, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') HAVING point_amt > 0), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-12-23', '2024-12-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mlbb_synclog') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_charge` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country, network, COALESCE(point_amt, 0) AS point_amt, COALESCE(day_amt, 0) AS day_amt FROM (SELECT point, country, '' AS network, point_amt, SUM(point_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname ORDER BY point) AS day_amt FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_pay.point_amt, 0) AS point_amt, t_incr.appname FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_pay ON t_incr.country = t_pay.country AND t_incr.point = t_pay.point) AS t1 UNION ALL SELECT point, country, network, day_amt - last_day_amt AS point_amt, day_amt FROM (SELECT point, 'us_compliance' AS country, '' AS network /* ,if(point_cnt < 500, null, point_amt) as point_amt */, IF(day_cnt < 500, NULL, day_amt) AS day_amt, LAG(IF(day_cnt < 500, NULL, day_amt)) OVER (ORDER BY point ASC) AS last_day_amt FROM `mt_ads`.`ads_realtime_charge_us` WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-01-16' AND appname = 'mlbb') AS tk) AS t2

name: 新手1到3天特征信息
sql_units: /* -注： 0 - 3天的玩家最近7天的活跃时长、玩家最近7天的战斗场复用玩家活跃时长及玩家战斗场次数， 但之后记得更改！！！！ */ /* VN放量 */ /* -- 玩家活跃时长 */ /* -- 玩家好友数量 */ WITH rz AS (SELECT rz.roleid, rz.zoneid, register_date, SUM(day_login_duration) AS active_duration, MAX(social_friendnum) AS social_friendnum FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE register_date BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, register_date) AS rz LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, day_login_duration, social_friendnum, logymd, LEVEL FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31') AS f ON f.roleid = rz.roleid AND f.zoneid = rz.zoneid AND f.logymd BETWEEN rz.register_date AND DATE_ADD(rz.register_date, 2) WHERE rz.register_date <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 2 * -1) GROUP BY rz.roleid, rz.zoneid, register_date HAVING MAX(LEVEL) >= 5), charge_base AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, logymd, money, usercreateymd FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, money, usercreateymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd BETWEEN usercreateymd AND DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 2) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') AND money <> 0 AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%') AS a JOIN rz ON a.roleid = rz.roleid AND a.zoneid = rz.zoneid), charge_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS charge_cnt, SUM(money) / 100 AS charge_sum, MAX(money) / 100 AS charge_max FROM charge_base GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), diamond_use /* 充值次数 */ /* 累计充值金额 */ /* 每次充值单次付费金额 */ /* 最高单次充值金额 */ /* 玩家最近充值日的日付费金额 */ /* 耗钻大表 */ AS (SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, operate, sub_num, TIME FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, sub_num, operate, TIME FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd BETWEEN usercreateymd AND DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 2) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND NOT operate IN ('gm')) AS f JOIN rz ON f.roleid = rz.roleid AND f.zoneid = rz.zoneid), purchase_by_shop AS (SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN shop_cf.item_type = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shop_buy_skin_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN shop_cf.item_type = 6 THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS skin_num, SUM(CASE WHEN shop_cf.item_type = 5 THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS hero_num FROM diamond_use AS b JOIN ml_ods.gameserver_shop_buy AS shop ON b.roleid = shop.roleid AND b.zoneid = shop.zoneid AND b.time = shop.time AND shop.logymd BETWEEN shop.usercreateymd AND DATE_ADD(shop.usercreateymd, 2) AND shop.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS shop_cf ON IF(shop.itemid = 0, SPLIT(gift_item_info, ':')[0], shop.itemid) = shop_cf.item_id WHERE NOT shop.time IS NULL AND shop_cf.item_type <> 10 GROUP BY b.roleid, b.zoneid), shop_buy /* - 玩家消耗钻石明细 */ /* - 玩家商城直购获得的皮肤数 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, gift_buy_num, star_num, skin_num, hero_num, draw_cost, sub_num, shop_buy_skin_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN operate = 'gift_buy' THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS gift_buy_num, SUM(CASE WHEN operate = 'action_act_newplayerstarvip' OR operate = 'action_act_starlightvip' THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS star_num, SUM(CASE WHEN operate LIKE '%draw%' THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS draw_cost, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num FROM diamond_use GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN purchase_by_shop AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid), fake_diamond_get /* -- 玩家拥有的假钻数量 */ AS (SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, SUM(add_num) AS fk_diamond FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, add_num, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd BETWEEN usercreateymd AND DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 2) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND NOT operate IN ('gm') AND item_id = 30109) AS f JOIN rz ON f.roleid = rz.roleid AND f.zoneid = rz.zoneid GROUP BY f.roleid, f.zoneid), skin_have /* - 玩家获得的永久皮肤数 */ /* - 玩家拥有永久A+皮个数 */ AS (SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, COUNT(skinid) AS skin_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_quality = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS a_plus_skin_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, skinid, logymd, skin_quality FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_skin WHERE time_len = 0 AND logymd BETWEEN usercreateymd AND DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 2) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31') AS f JOIN rz ON f.roleid = rz.roleid AND f.zoneid = rz.zoneid GROUP BY f.roleid, f.zoneid), battle_info /* -- 玩家战斗场次数 */ /* -- 玩家组队场次数 */ AS (SELECT rz.roleid, rz.zoneid, COUNT(1) AS battle_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN blacknum > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS black_battle_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, blacknum, logymd FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN usercreateymd AND DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 2) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2)) AS f JOIN rz ON f.accountid = rz.roleid AND f.zoneid = rz.zoneid GROUP BY rz.roleid, rz.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.richardguo_vn_0_3_player PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT rz.roleid, rz.zoneid, COALESCE(charge_cnt, 0) AS charge_cnt /* 充值次数 */, COALESCE(charge_sum, 0) AS charge_sum /* 累计充值金额 */, COALESCE(charge_max, 0) AS charge_max /* 最高单次充值金额 */, COALESCE(sub_num, 0) AS sub_num /* 消耗钻石数 */, COALESCE(draw_cost, 0) AS draw_cost /* 抽奖消耗钻石数 */, COALESCE(active_duration, 0) AS active_duration /* 活跃时长 */, COALESCE(social_friendnum, 0) AS social_friendnum /* 好友数量 */, COALESCE(battle_cnt, 0) AS battle_cnt /* 战斗场次数 */, COALESCE(black_battle_cnt, 0) AS black_battle_cnt /* 组队场次数 */, COALESCE(shop_buy_skin_cnt, 0) AS shop_buy_skin_cnt /* 商城直购获得皮肤数 */, COALESCE(skin_cnt, 0) AS skin_cnt /* 获得的永久皮肤数 */, COALESCE(a_plus_skin_cnt, 0) AS a_plus_skin_cnt /* 永久A+皮肤数 */, COALESCE(fk_diamond, 0) AS fk_diamond /* 拥有的假钻数量 */, COALESCE(gift_buy_num, 0) AS gift_buy_num /* 礼包消耗钻石数 */, COALESCE(star_num, 0) AS star_num /* 星光消耗钻石数 */, COALESCE(skin_num, 0) AS skin_num /* 直购皮肤消耗钻石数 */, COALESCE(hero_num, 0) AS hero_num /* 英雄购买消耗钻石数 */ FROM rz LEFT JOIN charge_info AS a ON rz.roleid = a.roleid AND rz.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN shop_buy AS b ON rz.roleid = b.roleid AND rz.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN fake_diamond_get AS c ON rz.roleid = c.roleid AND rz.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN skin_have AS d ON rz.roleid = d.roleid AND rz.zoneid = d.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle_info AS f ON rz.roleid = f.roleid AND rz.zoneid = f.zoneid

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df.zgame
sql_units: /* 关联取玩家全局排序 */ /* 初始日期为2025-05-27 */ WITH his_data AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, uid FROM mt_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-05-27', '2025-05-27', '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'zgame'), new_user /* 取出新增用户并排序 */ AS (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY roleid, zoneid) AS rn_sort, '2026-05-31' AS max_key FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.accountid) AS roleid, a.zoneid AS zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df_tmp WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a FULL JOIN (SELECT accountid FROM bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND account_register_date <= '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.roleid = b.accountid) AS a LEFT JOIN his_data AS hd ON a.roleid = hd.roleid AND COALESCE(a.zoneid, -1) = COALESCE(hd.zoneid, -1) WHERE hd.roleid IS NULL GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS t1), max_uid /* 取出历史最大uid */ AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(uid), 0) AS max_uid, '2026-05-31' AS max_key FROM his_data) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'zgame') SELECT roleid, zoneid, uid FROM his_data UNION ALL SELECT nu.roleid, nu.zoneid, mu.max_uid + nu.rn_sort FROM new_user AS nu LEFT JOIN max_uid AS mu ON nu.max_key = mu.max_key

region_id, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.union_id') AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) AS union_id, SPLIT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.joinner'), '-')[1] AS roleid, SPLIT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.joinner'), '-')[0] zgame_damai_ods.unionserver_union_quit WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND ((logymd BETWEEN '2023-07-13' AND '2026-01-20' AND region_id IN (5, 6)) OR (logymd <= '2026-01-20' AND region_id IN (9002, 9004)) (5, 6, 9002, 9004)), unionserver_gvg_match_settle AS (SELECT region_id, union_id, division, time FROM zgame_damai_ods.unionserver_gvg_match_settle WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND ((logymd BETWEEN sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-05-30 12:34:27.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_dim.dim_zgame_item_num_df */ /* ( */ /*     roleid                       DECIMAL(20, 0) COMMENT '角色id', */ /*     zoneid                       BIGINT COMMENT '分区id', */ /* item_id BIGINT COMMENT 'itemid', */ /* cur_num BIGINT COMMENT '当前数量' */ /* ) */ /*     PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd' ) */ /*     STORED AS PARQUET */ /*     LOCATION 's3a://mt-dim/table/dim_zgame_item_num_df'; */ WITH data_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, MAX_BY(cur_num, TIME) AS cur_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, TIME, COALESCE(cur_num, 0) AS cur_num FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND (item_id IN (1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 13, 17, 22, 31, 37, 1001, 2001, 3001, 13001, 14001, 15001, 13002, 14002, 15002, 18, 5001, 15017, 15018, 16001, 16002, 16003, 16100, 16101, 16102, 10004, 3502, 3508, 6057, 6056, 6055, 6054, 10001, 10002, 31011, 14, 10005, 28, 15, 25, 26, 4011, 4021, 213, 10006, 10007, 16007, 52)) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, TIME, COALESCE(cur_num, 0) AS cur_num FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_sub_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND item_id IN (1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 13, 17, 22, 31, 37, 1001, 2001, 3001, 13001, 14001, 15001, 13002, 14002, 15002, 18, 5001, 15017, 15018, 16001, 16002, 16003, 16100, 16101, 16102, 10004, 3502, 3508, 6057, 6056, 6055, 6054, 10001, 10002, 31011, 14, 10005, 28, 15, 25, 26, 4011, 4021, 213, 10006, 10007, 16007, 52)) AS t0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_zgame_item_num_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(di.roleid, df.roleid), COALESCE(di.zoneid, df.zoneid), COALESCE(di.item_id, df.item_id), COALESCE(di.cur_num, df.cur_num) FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, cur_num FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_item_num_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df FULL JOIN data_info AS di ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid AND di.item_id = df.item_id

name: 英雄白膜
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: amandapiao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-05-30 15:18:36.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ml_temp.amandapiao_noresheroid; */ /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ml_temp.amandapiao_noresheroid ( */ /*             `accountid` STRING COMMENT '账号id', */ /*             `zoneid` STRING COMMENT '服务区id', */ /*             `battleid` STRING COMMENT 'battleid', */ /*             `skinid` STRING COMMENT '皮肤', */ /*             `heroid` STRING COMMENT '白膜英雄', */ /*             `hero_name` STRING COMMENT '白膜英雄(中文)' */ /*         ) */ /*         PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` STRING COMMENT '日期') STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://moonton-hadoop/user/amandapiao/amandapiao_noresheroid'; */ WITH noresheroid AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, CAST(heroid AS INT) AS heroid, battleid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_bankres LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(ARRAY(heroskinid1, heroskinid2, heroskinid3, heroskinid4, heroskinid5, heroskinid6, heroskinid7, heroskinid8, heroskinid9, heroskinid10)) exploded_table AS heroid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND heroid <> '0' AND NOT heroid IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.amandapiao_noresheroid PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, a.skinid, c.heroid, c.hero_name FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid AS skinid FROM noresheroid /* 发生白膜的时间人和皮肤id */) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT skinid, skin_heroid FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config GROUP BY skinid, skin_heroid) AS b ON a.skinid = b.skinid LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, hero_name FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY heroid, hero_name) AS c ON b.skin_heroid = c.heroid

name: 灰度一期_样本逻辑
sql_units: WITH event_log AS (SELECT accountid AS r1, zoneid AS z1, showplayer_accountid AS r2, showplayer_zoneid AS z2, logymd, player_action, time, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) AS ts, lineid, patchid, sequenceid2 AS seqid, is_highligh AS hightag, showtaglist1 AS tag1, showtaglist2 AS tag2, showtaglist3 AS tag3, SUBSTRING(loghms, 0, 2) AS hh /* lbs 权限申请中 */ /* geoip(ip, 1) */ /* 交互时间信息 */, SUBSTRING(logymd, 6, 2) AS mm, CASE WHEN DAYOFMONTH(time) < 10 THEN 'up' WHEN DAYOFMONTH(time) < 20 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'tail' END AS month_period, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(loghms, 0, 2) < 12 THEN 'break' WHEN SUBSTRING(loghms, 0, 2) < 18 THEN 'noon' ELSE 'even' END AS day_period, GEOIP(ip, 1) AS country, GEOIP(ip, 1) AS states, GEOIP(ip, 3) AS city FROM ml_ods.connserver_social_recommendlistrecord WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-05-18' AND '2025-05-31' AND /* AND     zoneid < 57000 */ NOT player_action IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mlbb_social_rec_v1_grey_sample_track PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT time /* traffic.*, conf.score */, r1, z1, r2, z2, player_action, if_img_head_clk, if_follow, if_blk_shop, hightag, hh, mm, month_period, day_period, country, states, city, SUM(CAST(conf.score AS DOUBLE)) AS final_score, COLLECT_LIST(conf.tagname) AS tagname_list, COLLECT_LIST(conf.tagid) AS tagid_list FROM (SELECT show.time, show.r1, show.z1, show.r2, show.z2, show.player_action, IF(NOT img_clk.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_img_head_clk, IF(NOT follow.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_follow, IF(NOT blk_shop.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_blk_shop, show.hightag, show.tag1, show.tag2, show.tag3, show.hh, show.mm, show.month_period, show.day_period, show.country, show.states, show.city, 1 AS joinid FROM (SELECT * FROM event_log WHERE player_action IN (1, 5, 6)) AS show LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM event_log WHERE player_action = 2) AS img_clk ON show.r1 = img_clk.r1 AND show.z1 = img_clk.z1 AND show.time <= img_clk.time AND /* and img_clk.ts - show.ts <= 3600 */ show.seqid = img_clk.seqid LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM event_log WHERE player_action = 3) AS follow ON show.r1 = follow.r1 AND show.z1 = follow.z1 AND show.time <= follow.time AND /* and follow.ts - show.ts <= 3600 */ show.seqid = follow.seqid LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM event_log WHERE player_action = 4) AS blk_shop ON show.r1 = blk_shop.r1 AND show.z1 = blk_shop.z1 AND show.time <= blk_shop.time AND /* and blk_shop.ts - show.ts <= 3600 */ show.seqid = blk_shop.seqid) AS traffic JOIN (SELECT *, 1 AS joinid FROM mt_ai.social_ai_activate_config WHERE p_date = (SELECT MAX(p_date) FROM mt_ai.social_ai_activate_config WHERE NOT p_date IS NULL AND NOT act_id IS NULL) AND NOT act_id IS NULL AND stype = 'value') AS conf ON traffic.joinid = conf.joinid AND (traffic.tag1 = conf.tagid OR traffic.tag2 = conf.tagid OR traffic.tag3 = conf.tagid) GROUP BY time, r1, z1, r2, z2, player_action, if_img_head_clk, if_follow, if_blk_shop, hightag, hh, mm, month_period, day_period, country, states, city

name: 新手8到15天特征信息
sql_units: WITH rz AS (SELECT rz.roleid, rz.zoneid, register_date, SUM(day_login_duration) AS active_duration, MAX(social_friendnum) AS social_friendnum FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE register_date BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, register_date) AS rz LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, day_login_duration, social_friendnum, logymd, LEVEL FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31') AS f ON f.roleid = rz.roleid AND f.zoneid = rz.zoneid AND f.logymd BETWEEN rz.register_date AND DATE_ADD(rz.register_date, 14) WHERE rz.register_date <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 14 * -1) GROUP BY rz.roleid, rz.zoneid, register_date HAVING MAX(LEVEL) >= 5), charge_base AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, logymd, money, usercreateymd FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, money, usercreateymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 7) AND DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 14) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') AND money <> 0 AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%') AS a JOIN rz ON a.roleid = rz.roleid AND a.zoneid = rz.zoneid), charge_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS charge_cnt, SUM(money) / 100 AS charge_sum, MAX(money) / 100 AS charge_max FROM charge_base GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), diamond_use /* 充值次数 */ /* 累计充值金额 */ /* 每次充值单次付费金额 */ /* 最高单次充值金额 */ /* 玩家最近充值日的日付费金额 */ /* 耗钻大表 */ AS (SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, operate, sub_num, TIME FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, sub_num, operate, TIME FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 7) AND DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 14) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND NOT operate IN ('gm')) AS f JOIN rz ON f.roleid = rz.roleid AND f.zoneid = rz.zoneid), purchase_by_shop AS (SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN shop_cf.item_type = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shop_buy_skin_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN shop_cf.item_type = 6 THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS skin_num, SUM(CASE WHEN shop_cf.item_type = 5 THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS hero_num FROM diamond_use AS b JOIN ml_ods.gameserver_shop_buy AS shop ON b.roleid = shop.roleid AND b.zoneid = shop.zoneid AND b.time = shop.time AND shop.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(shop.usercreateymd, 7) AND DATE_ADD(shop.usercreateymd, 14) AND shop.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS shop_cf ON IF(shop.itemid = 0, SPLIT(gift_item_info, ':')[0], shop.itemid) = shop_cf.item_id WHERE NOT shop.time IS NULL AND shop_cf.item_type <> 10 GROUP BY b.roleid, b.zoneid), shop_buy /* - 玩家消耗钻石明细 */ /* - 玩家商城直购获得的皮肤数 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, gift_buy_num, star_num, skin_num, hero_num, draw_cost, sub_num, shop_buy_skin_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN operate = 'gift_buy' THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS gift_buy_num, SUM(CASE WHEN operate = 'action_act_newplayerstarvip' OR operate = 'action_act_starlightvip' THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS star_num, SUM(CASE WHEN operate LIKE '%draw%' THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS draw_cost, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num FROM diamond_use GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN purchase_by_shop AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid), fake_diamond_get /* -- 玩家拥有的假钻数量 */ AS (SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, SUM(add_num) AS fk_diamond FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, add_num, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 7) AND DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 14) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND NOT operate IN ('gm') AND item_id = 30109) AS f JOIN rz ON f.roleid = rz.roleid AND f.zoneid = rz.zoneid GROUP BY f.roleid, f.zoneid), skin_have /* - 玩家获得的永久皮肤数 */ /* - 玩家拥有永久A+皮个数 */ AS (SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, COUNT(skinid) AS skin_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_quality = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS a_plus_skin_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, skinid, logymd, skin_quality FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_skin WHERE time_len = 0 AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 7) AND sql_units: WITH TASK_INFO AS (SELECT bucket_name, table_name, user_name, department_name, is_increment, AVG(CASE metric_name WHEN '数据总量' THEN IF(total_size <= threshold_green, 100, IF(total_size >= threshold_red, 0, IF(total_size > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 - ((total_size - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 + ((threshold_ye - total_size) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green)))))) WHEN '当日增量数据' THEN IF(day_size <= threshold_green, 100, IF(day_size >= threshold_red, 0, IF(day_size > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 - ((day_size - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 + ((threshold_ye - day_size) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green)))))) WHEN '小文件数比例' THEN IF(little_rate <= threshold_green, 100, IF(little_rate >= threshold_red, 0, IF(little_rate > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 + ((little_rate - threshold_ye) * (40 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 - ((threshold_ye - little_rate) * (60 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green)))))) WHEN '分区数' THEN IF(partition_nums <= threshold_green, 100, IF(partition_nums >= threshold_red, 0, IF(partition_nums > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 + ((partition_nums - threshold_ye) * (40 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 - ((threshold_ye - partition_nums) * (60 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green)))))) WHEN '生命周期' THEN IF(COALESCE(lifecycle, 0) > 1, 100, 60) WHEN '最后更新日期' THEN IF(IF(last_modified_date IS NULL, 0, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', last_modified_date)) <= threshold_green, 100, IF(IF(last_modified_date IS NULL, 0, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', last_modified_date)) >= threshold_red, 0, IF(IF(last_modified_date IS NULL, 0, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', last_modified_date)) > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 + ((IF(last_modified_date IS NULL, 0, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', last_modified_date)) - threshold_ye) * (40 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 - ((threshold_ye - IF(last_modified_date IS NULL, 0, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', last_modified_date))) * (60 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green)))))) WHEN '是否溯源' THEN IF(user_name IS NULL OR user_name = '', 0, 100) ELSE 0 END) AS health_score, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(CASE metric_name WHEN '数据总量' THEN IF(total_size <= threshold_green, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), IF(total_size >= threshold_red, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, IF(total_size > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 - ((total_size - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 + ((threshold_ye - total_size) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green))))))) WHEN '当日增量数据' THEN IF(day_size <= threshold_green, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), IF(day_size >= threshold_red, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, IF(day_size > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 - ((day_size - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 + ((threshold_ye - day_size) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green))))))) WHEN '小文件数比例' THEN IF(little_rate <= threshold_green, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), IF(little_rate >= threshold_red, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, IF(little_rate > CAST(threshold_ye AS DECIMAL(18, 4)), 60 + ((little_rate - threshold_ye) * (40 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 - ((threshold_ye - little_rate) * (60 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green))))))) WHEN '分区数' THEN IF(partition_nums <= threshold_green, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), IF(partition_nums >= threshold_red, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, IF(partition_nums > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 + ((partition_nums - threshold_ye) * (40 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 - ((threshold_ye - partition_nums) * (60 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green))))))) WHEN '生命周期' THEN IF(COALESCE(lifecycle, 0) > 1, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60)) WHEN '最后更新日期' THEN IF(IF(last_modified_date IS NULL, 0, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', last_modified_date)) <= threshold_green, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), IF(IF(last_modified_date IS NULL, 0, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', last_modified_date)) >= threshold_red, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 + ((IF(last_modified_date IS NULL, 0, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', last_modified_date)) - threshold_green) * (40 / (threshold_red - threshold_green)))))) WHEN '是否溯源' THEN IF(user_name IS NULL OR user_name = '', CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100)) ELSE 0 END)), ',', ':') AS metric_info, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(CASE metric_name WHEN '数据总量' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, COALESCE(total_size, 0)) WHEN '当日增量数据' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, COALESCE(day_size, 0)) WHEN '小文件数比例' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, COALESCE(little_rate, 0)) WHEN '分区数' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, COALESCE(partition_nums, 0)) WHEN '生命周期' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, COALESCE(lifecycle, 0)) WHEN '最后更新日期' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, IF(last_modified_date IS NULL, 0, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', last_modified_date))) WHEN '是否溯源' THEN IF(user_name IS NULL OR user_name = '', CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 1)) ELSE NULL END)), ',', ':') AS metric_detail FROM (SELECT bucket_name, table_name, user_name, department_name, is_increment, day_size, total_size, day_data_lines, lifecycle, day_little_files_cnt, day_files_cnt, total_files_cnt, last_modified_date, partition_nums, IF(day_files_cnt > 0, CAST(day_little_files_cnt * 1.0 / day_files_cnt AS DECIMAL(18, 4)), 0) AS little_rate FROM mt_dwd.dwd_health_score_storage_metrics_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_health_score_config_storage WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS b GROUP BY bucket_name, table_name, user_name, department_name, is_increment) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_health_score_storage_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.*, c.output_path, b.table_level FROM (SELECT bucket_name, table_name, user_name, department_name, is_increment, health_score, 1 AS type, metric_info, metric_detail, CONCAT(IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-ml', 'ml_ods', IF(bucket_name = 'moonton-hadoop', 'ml_temp', REPLACE(bucket_name, '-', '_'))), '.', table_name) AS hive_table_name FROM TASK_INFO AS t1) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT table_name, table_level FROM (SELECT table_name, table_level FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_ods_level_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT table_name, table_level FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_dw_table_level_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS tmp) AS b ON a.hive_table_name = b.table_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT table_name, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(output_path)) AS output_path FROM mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_baseinfo_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY table_name) AS c ON b.table_name = c.table_name
