FROM_UNIXTIME(m__server_time / 1000 - 8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= '2026-05-31' AND (m__zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 /* 亚太 */ OR m__zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 /* 亚太   */ OR m__zone_id BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 /* 欧洲 */ OR m__zone_id BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 /* 美国 */)) AS creates LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money / 100) AS money_RMB, 1 AS charge_role, COUNT(1) AS charge_num FROM nova_ob_ods.charge WHERE logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND (m__zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 /* 亚太 */ OR m__zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 /* 亚太   */ OR m__zone_id BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 /* 欧洲 */ OR m__zone_id BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 /* 美国 */) AND FROM_UNIXTIME(m__server_time / 1000 - 8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY `roleid`, `zoneid`) AS c ON creates.roleid = c.roleid AND creates.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(white_ip) AS ip FROM mt_dim.dim_nova_white_list_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS d ON creates.ip = d.ip GROUP BY creates.roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df_timezone PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id = 4400, region) SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.did, t0.is_emulator, t0.login_ip, t0.os, t0.model, t0.os_version, t0.network_type, t0.os_language, t0.createdate, t0.createrole_country, t0.ip_country, t0.client_version, t0.event_time /* t0.app_id, */, t0.createtime, COALESCE(t1.is_cur_bot, t0.is_cur_bot) AS is_cur_bot, COALESCE(t0.is_init_bot, t1.is_cur_bot) AS is_init_bot, COALESCE(t2.is_acc_cur_bot, t0.is_acc_cur_bot) AS is_acc_cur_bot, COALESCE(t0.is_acc_init_bot, t2.is_acc_cur_bot) AS is_acc_init_bot, t0.region FROM (SELECT COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(df.did, di.did) AS did, COALESCE(df.is_emulator, di.is_emulator) AS is_emulator, COALESCE(df.login_ip, di.login_ip) AS login_ip, COALESCE(df.os, di.os) AS os, COALESCE(df.model, di.model) AS model, COALESCE(df.os_version, di.os_version) AS os_version, COALESCE(df.network_type, di.network_type) AS network_type, COALESCE(df.os_language, di.os_language) AS os_language, COALESCE(df.createdate, di.createdate) AS createdate, COALESCE(df.createrole_country, di.createrole_country) AS createrole_country, COALESCE(df.ip_country, di.ip_country) AS ip_country, COALESCE(df.client_version, di.client_version) AS client_version, COALESCE(df.event_time, di.event_time) AS event_time /* ,COALESCE(df.app_id,di.app_id) as app_id */, COALESCE(df.createtime, di.createtime) AS createtime, df.is_cur_bot, df.is_init_bot, df.is_acc_cur_bot, df.is_acc_init_bot, COALESCE(df.region, di.region) AS region FROM (SELECT * FROM df_yd WHERE region IN ('us', 'eu')) AS df FULL JOIN (SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.did, t0.is_emulator, t0.login_ip, t0.os, t0.model, t0.os_version, t0.network_type, t0.os_language, t0.createdate, t0.createrole_country, t0.ip_country, t0.client_version, t0.event_time, t0.createtime, t0.region FROM install_user_reduce_us AS t0) AS di ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid) AS t0 LEFT JOIN bot_info_us AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN account_bot_info_us AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.roleid UNION ALL SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.did, t0.is_emulator, t0.login_ip, t0.os, t0.model, t0.os_version, t0.network_type, t0.os_language, t0.createdate, t0.createrole_country, t0.ip_country, t0.client_version, t0.event_time /* t0.app_id, */, t0.createtime, COALESCE(t1.is_cur_bot, t0.is_cur_bot) AS is_cur_bot, COALESCE(t0.is_init_bot, t1.is_cur_bot) AS is_init_bot, COALESCE(t2.is_acc_cur_bot, t0.is_acc_cur_bot) AS is_acc_cur_bot, COALESCE(t0.is_acc_init_bot, t2.is_acc_cur_bot) AS is_acc_init_bot, t0.region FROM (SELECT COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(df.did, di.did) AS did, COALESCE(df.is_emulator, di.is_emulator) AS is_emulator, COALESCE(df.login_ip, di.login_ip) AS login_ip, COALESCE(df.os, di.os) AS os, COALESCE(df.model, di.model) AS model, COALESCE(df.os_version, di.os_version) AS os_version, COALESCE(df.network_type, di.network_type) AS network_type, COALESCE(df.os_language, di.os_language) AS os_language, COALESCE(df.createdate, di.createdate) AS createdate, COALESCE(df.createrole_country, di.createrole_country) AS createrole_country, COALESCE(df.ip_country, di.ip_country) AS ip_country, COALESCE(df.client_version, di.client_version) AS client_version, COALESCE(df.event_time, di.event_time) AS event_time /* ,COALESCE(df.app_id,di.app_id) as app_id */, COALESCE(df.createtime, di.createtime) AS createtime, df.is_cur_bot, df.is_init_bot, df.is_acc_cur_bot, df.is_acc_init_bot, COALESCE(df.region, di.region) AS region FROM (SELECT * FROM df_yd WHERE region IN ('all')) AS df FULL JOIN (SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.did, t0.is_emulator, t0.login_ip, t0.os, t0.model, t0.os_version, t0.network_type, t0.os_language, t0.createdate, t0.createrole_country, t0.ip_country, t0.client_version, t0.event_time, t0.createtime, t0.region FROM install_user_reduce_all AS t0) AS di ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid) AS t0 LEFT JOIN bot_info_all AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN account_bot_info_all AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.roleid

name: etl.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid_nova_account_timezone_daily
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid_timezone PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'nova', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads_pre.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid PARTITION (logymd = '2026-05-31',appname = 'nova',granularity_type = 'account',date_type = 'daily') */ SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, COALESCE(a.country, b.country) AS country, COALESCE(b.os, 'NULL') AS os, COALESCE(b.network, 'NULL') AS network, COALESCE(register_cnt, 0) AS register_cnt, 0 AS pure_register_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt_30days, 0) AS active_cnt_30days, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS active_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_30d_cnt, 0 AS recurring_cnt_30days, 0 AS nologin_cnt_30days, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt_period, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt_period, COALESCE(day_login_duration, 0) AS online_dur /*	当日玩家总在线时长(单位：s) */, 0 AS new_active_cnt /*	新用户活跃玩家数 */, COALESCE(register_cnt_total, 0) AS register_cnt_total /*	历史总注册玩家数 */, 0 AS lose_cnt_7ds /*	7日流失玩家数 */, 0 AS active_cnt_7ds /*	7日前DAU */, 0 AS lose_cnt_30ds /*	30日流失玩家数 */, 0 AS active_cnt_30ds /*	30日前DAU */, COALESCE(active_cnt_7days, 0) AS active_cnt_7days, COALESCE(year_pay_amt, 0) AS year_pay_amt, 0 AS year_before_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(total_pay_amt, 0) AS his_pay_amt, 0 AS his_before_tax_usd_amt, 0 AS recurring_cnt_14days, 0 AS nologin_cnt_14days, 0 AS actual_pay_amt, 'all' AS region, is_acc_cur_bot AS is_acc_cur_bot, COALESCE(active_cnt_90days, 0) AS active_cnt_90days, COALESCE(vaild_user_cnt, 0) AS vaild_user_cnt, COALESCE(vaild_user_online_dur, 0) AS vaild_user_online_dur FROM (SELECT country_code AS country, appname FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_country) /* 取最新 */ AND startdate <= '2026-05-31' AND appname = 'nova' AND is_online = 1 AND definition_type = 0 GROUP BY country_code, appname) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(network, 'unknown') AS network, COALESCE(SUM(register_cnt), 0) AS register_cnt, 0 AS pure_register_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt), 0) AS active_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt_30days), 0) AS active_cnt_30days, COALESCE(SUM(pay_cnt), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt), 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt_7days), 0) AS active_cnt_7days, COALESCE(SUM(total_pay_amt), 0) AS total_pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(year_pay_amt), 0) AS year_pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(day_login_duration), 0) AS day_login_duration, COALESCE(is_acc_cur_bot, 0) AS is_acc_cur_bot, COALESCE(SUM(register_cnt_total), 0) AS register_cnt_total, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt_90days), 0) AS active_cnt_90days, COALESCE(SUM(vaild_user_cnt), 0) AS vaild_user_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(vaild_user_online_dur), 0) AS vaild_user_online_dur, logymd, appname FROM (SELECT bd.app_id, ap.appname, COALESCE(LOWER(first_mt_country), 'unknown') AS country, bd.os, COALESCE(is_acc_cur_bot, 0) AS is_acc_cur_bot, COALESCE(LOWER(first_network_name), 'unknown') AS network, SUM(IF(createdate = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS register_cnt, SUM(is_td) AS active_cnt, SUM(is_30d) AS active_cnt_30days, SUM(pay_cnt) AS pay_cnt /* 付费人数 */, SUM(day_pay_amt) AS pay_amt, SUM(is_7d) AS active_cnt_7days, SUM(total_pay_amt) AS total_pay_amt, SUM(year_pay_amt) AS year_pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(online_time), 0) AS day_login_duration, COALESCE(SUM(IF(createdate <> 'unknown', 1, 0)), 0) AS register_cnt_total, COALESCE(SUM(IF(ad.is_90d = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt_90days, COALESCE(SUM(IF(ad.is_td = 1 AND (ad.active_days_7days >= 2 OR pay.pay_amt_7days > 0), 1, 0)), 0) AS vaild_user_cnt, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(IF(ad.is_td = 1 AND (ad.active_days_7days >= 2 OR pay.pay_amt_7days > 0), on_t.online_time_7days, 0)) / LEAST(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '2025-06-25') + 1, 7), 0), 0) AS vaild_user_online_dur, '2026-05-31' AS logymd FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT app_id, account_id, first_mt_country, os, first_network_name, createdate, createtime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY tag ASC, createtime ASC) AS rn FROM (SELECT appid AS app_id, roleid AS account_id, first_mt_country, os, first_media_source AS first_network_name, createdate, createtime, 1 AS tag FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND createdate >= '2025-06-25' AND /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 */ /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 29000 AND 29999 */ /* AND     appid in (4110,4210,4300,4260) */ (appid = 4400 AND (zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999)) UNION ALL SELECT app_id, roleid AS account_id, sql_units: WITH real_country_online AS (SELECT 'nova' AS appname, 4400 AS app_id, 'nova' AS stagename, FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(revise_server_time AS BIGINT) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time, country, os_type, online_num, os_type, CASE WHEN (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999) AND LOWER(country) IN ('hk', 'id', 'jp', 'kh', 'kr', 'mm', 'mo', 'my', 'ph', 'sg', 'th', 'tw', 'vn') THEN LOWER(country) WHEN (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999) THEN 'apac_unknown' WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 AND LOWER(country) IN ('us') THEN LOWER(country) WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 THEN 'us_unknown' WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 AND LOWER(country) IN ('de', 'es', 'fr', 'gb', 'it', 'pt') THEN LOWER(country) WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 THEN 'eu_unknown' END AS country, CASE WHEN (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999) THEN m__event_time / 1000 + 9 * 3600 ELSE m__event_time / 1000 - 8 * 3600 END AS revise_server_time, CASE WHEN (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999) THEN '+9' ELSE '-8' END AS timezone, m__zone_offset FROM nova_ob_ods.t_real_os_online WHERE logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' AND (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 /* 亚太 */ OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 /* 亚太   */ OR zone_id BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 /* 美国 */ OR zone_id BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 /* 欧洲 */)) AS t1 WHERE SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(revise_server_time AS BIGINT) DIV 300 * 300), 1, 10) = '2026-05-31'), dim_country AS (SELECT country_code AS country, definition_type AS region_type, CONCAT(region, '(UTC', timezone, ')') AS region /* region, */, appname FROM `mt_dim`.`dim_decismart_app_zone_country_df` WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM `mt_dim`.`dim_decismart_app_zone_country_df`) /* 取最新 */ AND startdate <= '2026-05-31' AND appname = 'nova' AND definition_type = 0 /* 业务定义 */), online_cube AS (/* 分国家和区域 */ SELECT appname, region_type, region, country, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, ROUND(SUM(online_num) / 288) AS acu FROM (SELECT con.appname, con.region_type, con.region, con.country, lin.div_time, COALESCE(SUM(online_num), 0) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM dim_country AS con LEFT JOIN real_country_online AS lin ON con.country = lin.country AND con.appname = lin.appname GROUP BY con.appname, con.region_type, con.region, con.country, lin.div_time, GROUPING SETS ((con.appname, con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region, con.country), (con.appname, con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region), (con.appname, con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.country))) GROUP BY appname, region_type, region, country /* ----总况 */ UNION ALL SELECT a.appname, a.region_type AS region_type, NULL AS region, NULL AS country, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, ROUND(SUM(online_num) / 288) AS acu FROM (SELECT DISTINCT appname, region_type FROM dim_country) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT lin.appname, lin.div_time, 0 AS region_type, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_country_online AS lin GROUP BY lin.appname, lin.div_time UNION ALL SELECT lin.appname, lin.div_time, 1 AS region_type, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_country_online AS lin GROUP BY lin.appname, lin.div_time) AS b ON a.appname = b.appname AND a.region_type = b.region_type GROUP BY a.appname, a.region_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, 'all' AS network, COALESCE(pcu, 0) AS pcu, COALESCE(acu, 0) AS acu, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, 'nova' AS appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'timezone' AS date_type FROM online_cube

(SELECT `after`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.id') ORDER BY `ts_ms` DESC) AS `rn` FROM payment_raw_orders) AS tmp WHERE tmp.rn = 1), payment_orders AS (SELECT CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.id') AS BIGINT) AS id, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.app_id') AS BIGINT) AS app_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.product_id') AS product_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.number') AS number, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.trade_id') AS trade_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.merchant_id') AS merchant_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.merchant_pay_channel_id') AS merchant_pay_channel_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.direct_channel_id') AS direct_channel_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.country_code') AS country_code, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.currency_code') AS currency_code, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.user_id') AS user_id, FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.create_time') AS BIGINT)) AS create_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.server_id') AS server_id FROM payment_available_orders), pay_order_raw AS (SELECT `after`, ts_ms FROM mt_ods.mobapay_cdc WHERE mobapay_cdc.source = 'db_payment_pay.pay_order' AND mobapay_cdc.logymd > '0' AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.is_deleted') = 0), pay_order_available AS (SELECT `after` FROM (SELECT `after`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.id') ORDER BY `ts_ms` DESC) AS DECIMAL(20, 8)) AS tax_price_cent, CAST(b.pay_commission_fee_local AS DECIMAL(20, 8)) AS pay_commission_fee_local, CAST(b.game_revenue_cent AS DECIMAL(20, 8)) AS game_revenue_cent, nation, GEOIP(client_ip, 5) AS campany, COUNT(roleid) AS num FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY nation, campany)) WHERE rk <= 10) INSERT INTO ml_temp.longterm_net_day7 INNER JOIN (SELECT FLOOR(battles / 5) * 5 AS bts, CASE WHEN max_star >= 63 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_old, a.accountid, a.zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT na) AS nas, COUNT(DISTINCT pr) AS prs, COUNT(DISTINCT ca) AS tl, z.accountid, zoneid, DATEDIFF(z.logymd, z.usercreateymd) AS lifetimes, IF(smallreconnect_num / (battletime / 600) <= 1, 1, 0) + IF(movelag / (battletime / 600) <= 4, 1, 0) + IF((ping80 / ping_times) >= 0.95, 1, 0) AS self_net_score, GEOIP(z.clientip, 1) AS na, GEOIP(z.clientip, 2) AS pr, GEOIP(z.clientip, 5) AS ca FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS z WHERE z.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-23' AND '2026-05-29' AND z.timedelay > 0 AND z.fake_ai = 0) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT z.accountid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS battles, MAX(history_maxrankstar) AS max_star FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS z WHERE z.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-23' AND '2026-05-29' AND z.timedelay > 0 AND z.fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY z.accountid, zoneid) AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND sql_units: WITH battle_end_log AS (/* 日志清洗，排除重复上报日志 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, os, pvptype, COALESCE(realpvptype, -99999) AS realpvptype, LOWER(COALESCE(IF(TRIM(GEOIP(clientip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))) = '-', NULL, TRIM(GEOIP(clientip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605')))), 'unknown')) AS ip_country, battleid, fake_ai, level, bigranklvl, minranklvl, rankstar, ishook, isvalid, killnum, deadnum, assistnum, movelag, timedelay, skilllag, battletime, conwin, wincamp, ismvp, blacknum, ping80, ping100, ping120, ping150, ping200, ping300, ping500, ping800, wifi, incomingping100ms, battlesvrid, reconnectnum, bigreconnect_num, smallreconnect_num, use_udp, heroid, banhero, mapid, minfps, avefps, stdping, kda, time, isinvalidbattle, issurrender, channel, unityversion, clientversion, real_road FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN os_type = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN os_type = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN os_type = 3 THEN 'emulator' ELSE 'unknown' END AS os, pvptype, realpvptype, clientip, battleid, CASE WHEN logymd < '2021-04-01' THEN IF(channel IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test'), 'ai_1', 'ai_0') WHEN logymd >= '2021-04-01' AND fake_ai = 0 THEN 'ai_0' WHEN logymd >= '2021-04-01' AND fake_ai = 1 THEN 'ai_2' WHEN logymd >= '2021-04-01' AND fake_ai = 2 THEN 'ai_1' WHEN logymd >= '2021-04-01' AND NOT COALESCE(fake_ai, -1) IN (0, 1, 2) THEN IF(channel IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test'), 'ai_1', 'ai_0') END AS fake_ai /* nvl(fake_ai,0) as fake_ai, */, level /* if(nvl(channel,'') IN ('and_bdvp','and_bdvp_test'),1,0) as fake_ai, --20221201修改，https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/PZL8dkfOLo6Q8gxUy70c23nrnOh */, bigranklvl, minranklvl, rankstar, COALESCE(ishook, 0) AS ishook, COALESCE(isvalid, 0) AS isvalid, COALESCE(killnum, 0) AS killnum, COALESCE(deadnum, 0) AS deadnum, COALESCE(assistnum, 0) AS assistnum, movelag, timedelay, skilllag, battletime, CASE WHEN conwin >= 0 AND COALESCE(wincamp, 0) = 1 THEN 1 + conwin WHEN conwin >= 0 AND COALESCE(wincamp, 0) = 0 THEN -1 WHEN conwin < 0 AND COALESCE(wincamp, 0) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN conwin < 0 AND COALESCE(wincamp, 0) = 0 THEN -1 + conwin ELSE 0 END AS conwin /* conwin值为上一场战斗的连胜次数，根据当前战斗的胜负对conwin处理 */ /* --conwin为正，表示玩家上一把战斗结束后连胜n场 */ /* ----wincamp为正，表示当前战斗胜利，则当前这场结束后连胜场次为n+1 */, COALESCE(ismvp, 0) AS ismvp, blacknum, ping80, ping100, ping120, ping150, ping200, ping300, ping500, ping800, wifi, incomingping100ms, battlesvrid, reconnectnum, bigreconnect_num, smallreconnect_num, use_udp, heroid, banhero, mapid, minfps, avefps, (COALESCE(killnum, 0) + COALESCE(assistnum, 0)) / (COALESCE(deadnum, 0) + 1) AS kda, time, COALESCE(wincamp, 0) AS wincamp, stdping, COALESCE(isinvalidbattle, 0) AS isinvalidbattle, COALESCE(issurrender, 0) AS issurrender, channel, unityversion, clientversion, real_road /* 2025-07-23 新增战斗分路相关 */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY time DESC, battleresulttype) AS row_id FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT pvptype IS NULL) AS t WHERE row_id = 1), battle_stat AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, os, pvptype, realpvptype, ip_country, CASE WHEN MAX(fake_ai) = 'ai_2' THEN 1 WHEN MAX(fake_ai) = 'ai_1' THEN 2 WHEN MAX(fake_ai) = 'ai_0' THEN 0 END AS is_fake_ai, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.real_road = 1 THEN a.battleid ELSE NULL END) AS day_battle_exp_cnt /* 新增战斗分路相关 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.real_road = 2 THEN a.battleid ELSE NULL END) AS day_battle_mid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.real_road = 3 THEN a.battleid ELSE NULL END) AS day_battle_roam_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.real_road = 4 THEN a.battleid ELSE NULL END) AS day_battle_jugle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.real_road = 5 THEN a.battleid ELSE NULL END) AS COALESCE(battle_stat.day_battle_roam_cnt, 0) AS day_battle_roam_cnt, COALESCE(battle_stat.day_battle_jugle_cnt, 0) AS day_battle_jugle_cnt, COALESCE(battle_stat.day_battle_coin_cnt, 0) AS day_battle_coin_cnt FROM battle_stat

sql_units: WITH login_start AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(client_version AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS client_version, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(ip AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS ip, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(channel AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS channel, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(op_type AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS os_type, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(GEOIP(ip, 1) AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS client_country, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(zoneid AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS zone_id, SPLIT(MIN(CONCAT(time, '&', CAST(device_id AS STRING))), '&')[1] AS device_id, MIN_BY(app_clickid, time) AS app_clickid, MIN(time) AS time FROM ml_ods.reportserver_client_loginv2_start WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, accountid), gameserver_loginv2 AS (SELECT logymd, roleid AS accountid, time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_loginv2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, time), main_user AS (SELECT s1.accountid, s1.client_version, s1.ip, s1.channel, s1.os_type, s1.client_country, s1.zone_id, s1.device_id, CASE WHEN s1.app_clickid IS NULL OR COALESCE(s1.app_clickid, 'none') IN ('', 'none') THEN 'none' ELSE s1.app_clickid END AS app_clickid, s1.time AS first_login_auth_time, MIN(s2.time) AS first_gameserver_login_time FROM login_start AS s1 LEFT JOIN gameserver_loginv2 AS s2 ON s1.accountid = s2.accountid AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s2.time) - name: 战略月日均dau分os_country
sql_units: /* create  TABLE t_join_data */ /*  as */ /* ( */ /*      select */ /*         t_act.logymd */ /*        , t1.os */ /*        , t1.country */ /*        ,t_act.roleid */ /* from t1 join t_act */ /*     on t1.roleid = t_act.roleid */ /* ) */ WITH t1 AS (SELECT roleid, create_os AS os, first_mt_country AS country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2025-06-30' AND register_date <= LAST_DAY('2026-05-01') AND is_first_create = 1 AND is_ai = 0), t_act AS (SELECT logymd, roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN IF('2026' = '2016' AND '05' = '07', '2016-07-21', '2026-05-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-01') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND logymd >= '2016-07-21' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY logymd, roleid), t_join_data AS (SELECT t_act.logymd, t1.os, t1.country, t_act.roleid FROM t1 JOIN t_act ON t1.roleid = t_act.roleid), dim_os AS (SELECT 'ios' AS os UNION ALL SELECT 'android' AS os UNION ALL SELECT 'unknown' AS os), dim_country AS (SELECT country FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = '2025-07-25' AND appname = 'mla_synclog' AND point = 287) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_mau_avg_dau_dim PARTITION(logymd, active_month, granularity_type) SELECT NULL AS country, dim_os.os, COALESCE(avg_dau, 0) AS avg_dau, '2025-07-25' AS logymd, '2026-05' AS active_month, 'os' AS granularity_type FROM dim_os LEFT JOIN (SELECT os, BIGINT(SUM(dau) / (DATEDIFF(LAST_DAY('2026-05-01'), IF('2026' = '2016' AND '05' = '07', '2016-07-21', '2026-05-01')) + 1)) AS avg_dau FROM (SELECT logymd, CASE WHEN os IN ('ios', 'android') THEN os ELSE 'unknown' END AS os, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS dau FROM t_join_data GROUP BY logymd, CASE WHEN os IN ('ios', 'android') THEN os ELSE 'unknown' END) AS t1 GROUP BY os) AS t_os ON dim_os.os = t_os.os UNION ALL SELECT dim_country.country, NULL AS os, COALESCE(avg_dau, 0) AS avg_dau, '2025-07-25' AS logymd, '2026-05' AS active_month, 'country' AS granularity_type FROM dim_country LEFT JOIN (SELECT country, BIGINT(SUM(dau) / (DATEDIFF(LAST_DAY('2026-05-01'), IF('2026' = '2016' AND '05' = '07', '2016-07-21', '2026-05-01')) + 1)) AS avg_dau FROM (SELECT logymd, country, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS dau FROM t_join_data GROUP BY logymd, country) AS t1 GROUP BY country) AS t_country ON dim_country.country = t_country.country

name: 战略mau
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_mau_avg_dau PARTITION(logymd, active_month) SELECT SUM(avg_dau) AS avg_dau, SUM(mau) AS mau, SUM(avg_online_time) AS avg_online_time, '2025-07-25' AS logymd, active_month FROM (SELECT active_month, SUM(dau) / (DATEDIFF(LAST_DAY('2026-05-01'), IF('2026' = '2016' AND '05' = '07', '2016-07-21', '2026-05-01')) + 1) AS avg_dau, 0 AS mau, SUM(avg_online_time) / (DATEDIFF(LAST_DAY('2026-05-01'), IF('2026' = '2016' AND '05' = '07', '2016-07-21', '2026-05-01')) + 1) AS avg_online_time /* 月均在线时长 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, active_month, COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid) AS dau, SUM(day_login_duration) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid) AS avg_online_time FROM (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2025-06-30' AND register_date <= LAST_DAY('2026-05-01') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1) AS a JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, SUM(day_login_duration) AS day_login_duration, '2026-05' AS active_month FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN IF('2026' = '2016' AND '05' = '07', '2016-07-21', '2026-05-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-01') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND logymd >= '2016-07-21' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY logymd, roleid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid GROUP BY active_month, logymd) AS t1 GROUP BY active_month UNION ALL SELECT active_month, 0 AS avg_dau, COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid) AS mau, 0 AS avg_online_time FROM (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2025-06-30' AND register_date <= LAST_DAY('2026-05-01') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1) AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid, '2026-05' AS active_month FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN IF('2026' = '2016' AND '05' = '07', '2016-07-21', '2026-05-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-01') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND logymd >= '2016-07-21' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid GROUP BY active_month) AS t GROUP BY active_month

'organic', 1, 2) AS network_group, account_register_date, register_date, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 720 THEN 7 /* '720以上' */ WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 360 THEN 6 /* '[360,720)' */ WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 180 THEN 5 /* '[180,360)' */ WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 90 THEN 4 /* '[90,180)' */ WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 60 THEN 3 /* '[60,90)' */ WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 30 THEN 2 /* '[30,60)' */ ELSE 1 /* '[0,30)' */ END AS register_dur /* 注册时长 */, is_first_create, new_type /* new_type = 3  纯净新增 */, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS channel, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), account_pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN pay_amt / 100 >= 2000 THEN 6 /* '2000以上' */ WHEN pay_amt / 100 >= 200 THEN 5 /* '[200,2000)' */ WHEN pay_amt / 100 >= 20 THEN 4 /* '[20,200)' */ WHEN pay_amt / 100 >= 2 THEN 3 /* '[2,20)' */ WHEN pay_amt / 100 > 0 THEN 2 /* '(0,2)' */ ELSE 1 END AS pay_grade, pay_amt /* 历史付费金额 */, his_first_pay_date, his_last_pay_date FROM (SELECT roleid, SUM(his_before_tax_usd_amt) AS pay_amt /* SUM(product_money) AS pay_amt, */, SUBSTRING(MIN(his_first_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_first_pay_date, SUBSTRING(MAX(his_last_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_last_pay_date FROM (SELECT roleid, product_money, his_before_tax_usd_amt, his_first_pay_time, his_last_pay_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 /* 正式服 */ AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, product_money, before_tax_usd_amt, first_pay_time, last_pay_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd > '2025-01-03' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 AND zoneid >= 57000 /* 01-03号后加入测服 */) GROUP BY roleid)), dim_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 1 AS region_type, act_geo_continent AS region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 0 AS region_type, region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */), dim_basic_country AS (SELECT bas.roleid, bas.zoneid, bas.country, bas.network_group, bas.register_dur, bas.register_date, COALESCE(con.region_type, 'unknwon') AS region_type, COALESCE(con.region, 'unknwon') AS region, COALESCE(pay_df.pay_grade, 1) AS pay_grade, pay_df.his_first_pay_date, pay_df.his_last_pay_date FROM basic AS bas LEFT JOIN account_pay_df AS pay_df ON bas.roleid = pay_df.roleid LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con ON bas.country = con.country_code), active_all_account AS (SELECT roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) /* AND     is_ai = 0 */ GROUP BY roleid), WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads_pre.ads_decismart_pay_cube_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type, amt_type) SELECT SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT network_group IS NULL, 'network_group', NULL), IF(NOT pay_grade IS NULL, 'pay_grade', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT register_dur IS NULL, 'register_dur', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(network_group, -10000) AS network_group, COALESCE(register_dur, -10000) AS register_dur, COALESCE(pay_grade, -10000) AS pay_grade, COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(actual_pay_amt, 0) AS actual_pay_amt, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt, 0 AS first_pay_cnt, COALESCE(2usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 2usd_pay_cnt, 0 AS active_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_30d_cnt, 0 AS his_pay_active_cnt, 0 AS add_diamond_amt, 0 AS add_diamond_email_amt, 0 AS sub_diamond_amt, 0 AS sub_diamond_cnt, ARRAY() AS pay_channel_cnt, ARRAY() AS pay_channel_amt, ARRAY() AS pay_iap_cnt, ARRAY() AS pay_iap_amt, ARRAY() AS sub_diamond_operate_cnt, ARRAY() AS sub_diamond_operate_amt, COALESCE(1usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 1usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(5usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 5usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(10usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 10usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(20usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 20usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(zeropointone_usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS zeropointone_usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt_period, 0) AS active_cnt_period, '2026-05-31' AS logymd /*	日期分区(yyy-MM-dd) */, 'mlbb' AS appname /*	项目ID(mlbb,xgame) */, 'account' AS granularity_type /*	粒度类型(account,device) */, 'monthly' AS date_type /*	日期类型(daily,weekly,monthly) */, 'before_tax_amt' AS amt_type /*	金额类型(money,before_tax_amt) */ FROM (SELECT basc.region_type, basc.region, basc.country, basc.network_group, basc.register_dur, basc.pay_grade, SUM(pay_di.pay_amt) AS pay_amt /* 付费金额 */, SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS actual_pay_amt /* 实收金额 */, SUM(IF(NOT pay_di.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS pay_cnt /* 充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 200, 1, 0)) AS 2usd_pay_cnt /* 2美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 10, 1, 0)) AS zeropointone_usd_pay_cnt /* 0.1美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 100, 1, 0)) AS 1usd_pay_cnt /* 1美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 500, 1, 0)) AS 5usd_pay_cnt /* 5美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 1000, 1, 0)) AS 10usd_pay_cnt /* 10美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 2000, 1, 0)) AS 20usd_pay_cnt /* 20美金充值人数 */, SUM(active_days) AS active_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid) AS active_cnt_period FROM dim_basic_country AS basc LEFT JOIN active_all_account AS act ON basc.roleid = act.roleid LEFT JOIN account_pay_di AS pay_di ON basc.roleid = pay_di.roleid GROUP BY basc.region_type, CUBE (basc.region, basc.country, basc.network_group, basc.register_dur, basc.pay_grade))

-10000) AS network_group, COALESCE(register_dur, -10000) AS register_dur, COALESCE(pay_grade, -10000) AS pay_grade, COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(actual_pay_amt, 0) AS actual_pay_amt, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt, 0 AS first_pay_cnt, COALESCE(2usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 2usd_pay_cnt, 0 AS active_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_30d_cnt, 0 AS his_pay_active_cnt, 0 AS add_diamond_amt, 0 AS add_diamond_email_amt, 0 AS sub_diamond_amt, 0 AS sub_diamond_cnt, ARRAY() AS pay_channel_cnt, ARRAY() AS pay_channel_amt, ARRAY() AS pay_iap_cnt, ARRAY() AS pay_iap_amt, ARRAY() AS sub_diamond_operate_cnt, ARRAY() AS sub_diamond_operate_amt, COALESCE(1usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 1usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(5usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 5usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(10usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 10usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(20usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 20usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(zeropointone_usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS zeropointone_usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt_period, 0) AS active_cnt_period, '2026-05-31' AS logymd /*	日期分区(yyy-MM-dd) */, 'mlbb' AS appname /*	项目ID(mlbb,xgame) */, 'account' AS granularity_type /*	粒度类型(account,device) */, 'monthly' AS date_type /*	日期类型(daily,weekly,monthly) */, 'money' AS amt_type /*	金额类型(money,before_tax_amt) */ FROM (SELECT basc.region_type, basc.region, basc.country, basc.network_group, basc.register_dur, basc.pay_grade, SUM(pay_di.pay_amt) AS pay_amt /* 付费金额 */, SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS actual_pay_amt /* 实收金额 */, SUM(IF(NOT pay_di.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS pay_cnt /* 充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 200, 1, 0)) AS 2usd_pay_cnt /* 2美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 10, 1, 0)) AS zeropointone_usd_pay_cnt /* 0.1美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 100, 1, 0)) AS 1usd_pay_cnt /* 1美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 500, 1, 0)) AS 5usd_pay_cnt /* 5美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 1000, 1, 0)) AS 10usd_pay_cnt /* 10美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 2000, 1, 0)) AS 20usd_pay_cnt /* 20美金充值人数 */, SUM(active_days) AS active_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid) AS active_cnt_period FROM dim_basic_country AS basc LEFT JOIN active_all_account AS act ON basc.roleid = act.roleid LEFT JOIN account_pay_di AS pay_di ON basc.roleid = pay_di.roleid GROUP BY basc.region_type, CUBE (basc.region, basc.country, basc.network_group, basc.register_dur, basc.pay_grade))

name: 平均星数收益
sql_units: WITH tag_info AS (SELECT MIN(logymd) AS logymd, accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, param_version, param_name FROM mcgg_ods.abtestserver_abtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND param_name LIKE '%aimatch%' AND param_version <> '' GROUP BY accountid, old_zoneid, param_version, param_name), all_player AS (SELECT c.param_name, c.param_version, c.vid, a.zoneid, a.roleid, a.logymd, min_logymd, maxbigranklvl, real_match_type, SUM(sumcupnumchange) AS sumcupnumchange, SUM(std_sumcupnumchange) AS std_sumcupnumchange, SUM(batcnt) AS batcnt FROM (/* 主表 */ SELECT * FROM mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_ab_stars_num_gaoy WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND real_match_type IN (171, 172, 173, 174, 175, 176, 177, 178, 182, 183, 51, 59, 90)) AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN param_version = MAX(param_version) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) THEN '实验组' WHEN param_version = MIN(param_version) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) THEN '对照组' END AS param_version, param_version AS vid, param_name, MIN(logymd) AS min_logymd FROM (SELECT DISTINCT logymd, roleid, zoneid, param_version, param_name FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND param_name LIKE '%aimatch%' AND param_version <> '' /* 0625实验存在空值 */ AND zoneid < 57000 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT logymd, roleid, zoneid, param_version, param_name FROM tag_info) AS a GROUP BY roleid, param_version, param_name) AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.logymd >= c.min_logymd JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, param_version FROM (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.param_version, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS ttcnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(groupsel = 23, battleid, NULL)) AS battle23_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(groupsel = 23, battleid, NULL)) / COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS rate FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, groupsel, logymd, param_version FROM mcgg_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) AS a JOIN tag_info AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.param_version = b.param_version AND a.logymd >= b.logymd GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.param_version) WHERE rate >= STRUCT(STRUCT(rate))) AS d ON c.roleid = d.accountid AND c.vid = d.param_version GROUP BY c.param_name, c.param_version, c.vid, a.zoneid, a.roleid, a.logymd, min_logymd, maxbigranklvl, real_match_type), active_battle AS (SELECT vid, a.roleid, SUM(sumcupnumchange) AS sumcupnumchange, SUM(std_sumcupnumchange) AS std_sumcupnumchange, SUM(batcnt) AS batcnt FROM all_player AS a GROUP BY a.roleid, vid), active_battle_14d_ago /* 同一个人分到了不同的实验组 */ AS (SELECT vid, a.roleid, SUM(sumcupnumchange) AS sumcupnumchange_14d_ago, SUM(std_sumcupnumchange) AS std_sumcupnumchange_14d_ago, SUM(batcnt) AS batcnt_14d_ago FROM (SELECT vid, zoneid, roleid, min_logymd FROM all_player GROUP BY vid, roleid, zoneid, min_logymd) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, zoneid, roleid, real_match_type, SUM(sumcupnumchange) AS sumcupnumchange, SUM(std_sumcupnumchange) AS std_sumcupnumchange, SUM(batcnt) AS batcnt FROM mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_ab_stars_num_gaoy WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-06' AND '2026-05-31' AND real_match_type IN (171, 172, 173, 174, 175, 176, 177, 178, 182, 183, 51, 59, 90) GROUP BY logymd, zoneid, roleid, real_match_type) AS b ON a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE b.logymd >= DATE_ADD(min_logymd, 14 * -1) AND b.logymd < min_logymd GROUP BY vid, a.roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_ab_starr_statistics_gaoy PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.vid, param_name, param_version, b.sumcupnumchange, b.batcnt, COALESCE(sumcupnumchange_14d_ago, 0) AS sumcupnumchange_14d_ago, COALESCE(batcnt_14d_ago, 0) AS batcnt_14d_ago, COALESCE(std_sumcupnumchange, 0) AS std_sumcupnumchange_14d_ago, COALESCE(std_sumcupnumchange_14d_ago, 0) AS std_sumcupnumchange_14d_ago FROM (SELECT roleid, vid, param_name, param_version FROM all_player GROUP BY roleid, vid, param_name, param_version) AS a LEFT JOIN active_battle AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.vid = b.vid LEFT JOIN active_battle_14d_ago AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.vid = c.vid

'当日末次活跃时间', */ /*     login_cnt bigint comment '当日登录次数', */ /*     online_dur bigint comment '登录时长(单位：秒)', */ /*     first_active_os string comment '当日首次登录操作系统', */ /*     last_active_os string string comment '分区日期', appid string comment '项目ID') */ /* stored as parquet */ /* location 's3a://wefly-dw/table/dwm_active_role_zone_di' */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE wefly_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'wefly') SELECT lg.roleid, lg.zoneid, CASE WHEN lg.zoneid BETWEEN 0 AND 9999 THEN 0 WHEN lg.zoneid > 9999 THEN 1 END AS zone_type, COALESCE(lg.first_active_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS first_active_time, COALESCE(lg.last_active_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS last_active_time, COALESCE(lg.login_cnt, 0) AS login_cnt, COALESCE(lt.online_dur, 0) AS online_dur, COALESCE(lg.first_os_type, -99999) AS first_os_type, COALESCE(lg.first_os_name, 'unknown') AS first_os_name, COALESCE(lg.last_os_type, -99999) AS last_os_type, COALESCE(lg.last_os_name, 'unknown') AS last_os_name, COALESCE(lg.first_channel, 'unknown') AS first_channel, COALESCE(lg.last_channel, 'unknown') AS last_channel, COALESCE(lg.first_login_ip, 'unknown') AS first_login_ip, COALESCE(lg.last_login_ip, 'unknown') AS last_login_ip, COALESCE(lg.first_ip_country, 'unknown') AS first_ip_country, COALESCE(lg.last_ip_country, 'unknown') AS last_ip_country, COALESCE(lg.last_os_language, 'unknown') AS last_os_language, COALESCE(lg.last_os_version, 'unknown') AS last_os_version, COALESCE(lg.last_device_model, 'unknown') AS last_device_model, COALESCE(lg.last_device_id, 'unknown') AS last_device_id, COALESCE(lg.last_client_language, -99999) AS last_client_language, COALESCE(lg.activedays, 0) AS activedays, COALESCE(lg.war_stage, -99999) AS war_stage, COALESCE(lg.role_level, -99999) AS role_level, COALESCE(lg.last_client_version, 'unknown') AS last_client_version FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, `TIME`, NULL)) AS first_active_time, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, `TIME`, NULL)) AS last_active_time, COUNT(1) AS login_cnt, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, login_os_type, NULL)) AS first_os_type, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, login_os_name, NULL)) AS first_os_name, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, login_os_type, NULL)) AS last_os_type, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, login_os_name, NULL)) AS last_os_name, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, login_channel, NULL)) AS first_channel, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, login_channel, NULL)) AS last_channel, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, login_sub_channel, NULL)) AS first_sub_channel, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, login_sub_channel, NULL)) AS last_sub_channel, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, login_ip, NULL)) AS first_login_ip, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, login_ip, NULL)) AS last_login_ip, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, os_language, NULL)) AS last_os_language, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, client_os_version, NULL)) AS last_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, device_id, NULL)) AS last_device_id, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, device, NULL)) AS last_device_model, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, client_language, NULL)) AS last_client_language, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, activedays, NULL)) AS activedays, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, war_stage, NULL)) AS war_stage, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, role_level, NULL)) AS role_level, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS last_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202508', '202508', '202605'))), 'unknown')) AS first_ip_country, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202508', '202508', '202605'))), 'unknown')) AS last_ip_country FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, `TIME`, login_os_type, CASE WHEN login_os_type = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN login_os_type = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN login_os_type = 3 THEN 'other' ELSE 'unknown' END AS login_os_name, LOWER(login_channel) AS login_channel, LOWER(login_sub_channel) AS login_sub_channel, login_ip, device, device_id, os_language, client_os_version, client_language, client_version, war_stage, activedays, role_level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `TIME` DESC) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `TIME` ASC) AS rec_asc FROM wefly_ob_ods.login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS lg LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(online_time) AS online_dur FROM wefly_ob_ods.logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS lt ON lg.roleid = lt.roleid AND lg.zoneid = lt.zoneid

Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH tt AS (SELECT accountid, MAX(TIME) AS tt_bind_time FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_bind WHERE a.zoneid = b.zoneid */ WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31' AND a.appid = 'mlbb' AND b.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND b.appid = 'mlbb' AND b.is_ai = 0 GROUP BY a.roleid, b.first_mt_country), new_user AS (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE appid = 'mlbb' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1 AND register_date BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid), return_user AS (SELECT roleid FROM ml_temp.jianli_20250303_30recur WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jianli_20250805_tt_country PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT first_mt_country AS country, user_type, COUNT(*) AS dau, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT roleid_tt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dau_tt FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.first_mt_country, b.roleid AS roleid_tt, CASE WHEN NOT c.roleid IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN NOT d.roleid IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS user_type FROM active_users AS a LEFT JOIN tt_users AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid LEFT JOIN new_user AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid LEFT JOIN return_user AS d ON a.roleid = d.roleid) GROUP BY country, user_type

sql_units: /* 回流用户 */ WITH come_back_user AS (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2026-03-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid WHERE t2.roleid IS NULL AND t2.zoneid IS NULL), week_active_user AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS week_active_day_count FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-24' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.dm_ai_mcgg_huoyue_day_tag PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.roleid, t2.zoneid, CASE WHEN NOT t2.roleid IS NULL AND NOT t2.zoneid IS NULL THEN '回流用户' WHEN NOT t3.roleid IS NULL AND NOT t3.zoneid IS NULL AND week_active_day_count <= 2 THEN '低活跃用户' WHEN NOT t3.roleid IS NULL AND NOT t3.zoneid IS NULL AND week_active_day_count >= 3 AND week_active_day_count <= 5 THEN '中活跃用户' WHEN NOT t3.roleid IS NULL AND NOT t3.zoneid IS NULL AND week_active_day_count >= 6 THEN '高活跃用户' ELSE 'other' END AS huoyue_tag FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN come_back_user AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT OUTER JOIN week_active_user AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid

name: jaxzhong_整包版本号集合
sql_units: WITH output_table AS (SELECT s1.client_version, s1.os_type, s1.loginstart, s1.first_time, s1.version1, s1.version2, s2.version_pre3num, s2.version_last2num, s2.formal_start_date, s2.big_version FROM (SELECT client_version, os_type /* ,concat(split(client_version,'\.')[0],'.',split(client_version,'\.')[1],'.',split(client_version,'\.')[2]) as version1   ---整包版本号   ---presto语法 */ /* ,concat(split(client_version,'\.')[3],'.',split(client_version,'\.')[4]) as version2  ---资源版本号  ---presto语法 */, CONCAT(SPLIT(client_version, '\\.')[0], '.', SPLIT(client_version, '\\.')[1], '.', SPLIT(client_version, '\\.')[2]) AS version1 /* -整包版本号，spark语法 */, CONCAT(SPLIT(client_version, '\\.')[3], '.', SPLIT(client_version, '\\.')[4]) AS version2 /* -资源版本号，spark语法 */, loginstart, sup, first_time FROM (SELECT version AS client_version, CASE WHEN op_type = '1' THEN 'IOS' WHEN op_type = '2' THEN '安卓' ELSE '其他' END AS os_type, COUNT(1) AS loginstart, MAX(1) AS sup, MIN(time) AS first_time FROM ml_ods.reportserver_client_loginv2_start WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND op_type IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000 /* -排掉测服版本 */ GROUP BY version, CASE WHEN op_type = '1' THEN 'IOS' WHEN op_type = '2' THEN '安卓' ELSE '其他' END)) AS s1 JOIN (SELECT os_type, MIN_BY(client_version, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', formal_start_date)) AS big_version, MIN_BY(version_pre3num, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', formal_start_date)) AS version_pre3num, MIN_BY(version_last2num, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', formal_start_date)) AS version_last2num, MAX(1) AS sup, MAX(formal_start_date) AS formal_start_date FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_full_update_version_list WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND formal_start_date <= '2026-05-31' /* -距离数据日期最近的版本日期 */ GROUP BY os_type) AS s2 ON s1.sup = s2.sup AND s1.os_type = s2.os_type WHERE s1.version1 >= s2.version_pre3num /* --整包版本号大于全服发布的整包版本号，才是这个版本期间发布的整包版本 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jaxzhong_full_update_version_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 覆盖写入 */ SELECT client_version, os_type, loginstart, first_time, version1, version2, version_pre3num, version_last2num, formal_start_date, big_version FROM output_table

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jichun@moonton.com */ /* CreateTime: 2025-08-11 21:22:51 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH dim_basic AS (SELECT roleid /*	角色id */, zoneid /*	服务器id */, account_name /*	sdk账号或设备id */, did /*	did */, register_time /*	角色创建时间 */, register_date /*	角色创建日期 */, create_ip /*	创角ip */, create_channel /*	创角渠道 */, create_sub_channel /*	创角子渠道 */, os_type /*	创角系统类型 */, os_name /*	角色id */, create_country /*	创角国家 */, create_ip_country /*	首次ip国家 */, first_mt_country /*	首次创角国家 */, first_network_name /*	首次广告渠道 */, is_first_create /*	是否账号下首个创角 */, data_source /*	创角数据来源 */, zone_type /*	区服类型 */, is_cur_bot /*	当前是否刷号 */, is_init_bot /*	创角时是否刷号 */, is_formal_first_create /*	是否账号下正式服首个创角 */ FROM wefly_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly'), active_df AS (SELECT roleid /*	角色ID */, zoneid /*	服务器key */, zone_type /*	区服类型 */, his_first_active_time /*	历史首次活跃时间 */, his_last_active_time /*	历史末次活跃时间 */, his_login_cnt /*	历史累计登录次数 */, his_online_dur /*	历史累计登录时长(单位:秒) */, his_last_os_type /*	历史末次登录系统类型 */, his_last_os_name /*	历史末次登录系统类型名称 */, his_last_channel /*	历史末次登录渠道 */, his_last_login_ip /*	历史末次登录ip */, his_last_ip_country /*	历史末次登录国家 */, his_last_os_language /*	历史末次系统语言 */, his_last_os_version /*	历史末次登录系统版本 */, his_last_device_model /*	历史末次登录设备型号 */, his_last_device_id /*	历史末次登录设备id */, his_last_client_language /*	历史末次登录客户端语言 */, activedays /*	累计活跃天数(取自login activedays末次) */, cur_war_stage /*	当前战役进度 */, cur_role_level /*		当前玩家等级 */ FROM wefly_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly'), charge_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_first_pay_time, his_last_pay_time, his_pay_amt FROM wefly_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly'), role_zone_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, charge_info, charge_cnt_total_array, charge_amt_total_array, charge_amt_array, ol_dur_array, active_info, active_days_array FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_decismart_info_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appname = 'wefly' AND granularity_type = 'role') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE wefly_dw.dm_info_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT bas.roleid /*	账号id,key */, bas.zoneid /*	服务器,key */, bas.zone_type /*	区分类型(1:正式服， 0：测服) */, bas.register_date /*	注册日期（yyyy-mm-dd） */, bas.os_name AS register_os /*	创角时系统类型（ios,android,other） */, bas.is_init_bot /*	创角时是否刷号（1：正常玩家，0：刷号） */, bas.is_cur_bot /*	当前是否刷号（1：正常玩家，0：刷号） */, bas.is_first_create /*	是否账号下首次创角 */, bas.first_mt_country, bas.first_network_name, bas.create_country, bas.create_channel /*	创角渠道 */, act_df.cur_war_stage /*	当前战役进度 */, act_df.activedays AS activedays_total /*	累计活跃天数 */, act_df.his_last_channel AS last_active_channel /*	末次活跃渠道 */, SUBSTRING(act_df.his_last_active_time, 1, 10) AS last_active_date /*	末次活跃日期 */, COALESCE(chg_df.his_pay_amt, 0) AS charge_amt_total /*	累计付费金额 */, COALESCE(SUBSTRING(chg_df.his_first_pay_time, 1, 10), '') AS first_charge_date /*	首次付费日期 */, COALESCE(SUBSTRING(chg_df.his_last_pay_time, 1, 10), '') AS last_charge_date /*	末次付费日期 */, ifo.charge_info /*	付费：充值位图，充值：1，未充值：0，左侧是最近日期，右侧是注册日期 */, ifo.charge_cnt_total_array /*	付费：累计充值次数位图，从左到右，左侧是最近日期累计总充值次数，右侧是注册日期，未充值补0 */, ifo.charge_amt_total_array /*	付费：累计充值金额位图，从左到右，左侧是最近日期累计总充值金额，右侧是注册日期，未充值补0 */, ifo.charge_amt_array /*	付费金额位图，从左到右，左侧是最近日期累计总充值金额，右侧是注册日期，未充值补0 */, ifo.ol_dur_array /*	活跃：在线时长位图，从左到右，左侧是最近日期在线时长，右侧是注册日期，未登录补0 */, ifo.active_info /*	活跃：活跃位图，活跃：1，未活跃：0，左侧是最近日期，右侧是注册日期 */, ifo.active_days_array /*	活跃：活跃天数累计位图：从左到右，左侧是最近日期，右侧是注册日期 */, bas.account_name, bas.did FROM dim_basic AS bas LEFT JOIN active_df AS act_df ON bas.roleid = act_df.roleid AND bas.zoneid = act_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN charge_df AS chg_df ON bas.roleid = chg_df.roleid AND bas.zoneid = chg_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN role_zone_df AS ifo ON bas.roleid = ifo.roleid AND bas.zoneid = ifo.zoneid

/*	是否账号下正式服首个创角 */ FROM wefly_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly'), active_di AS (SELECT roleid /*	角色ID */, zoneid /*	服务器key */, login_cnt /*	当日登录次数 */, online_dur /*	登录时长(单位：秒) */ FROM wefly_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly'), active_df AS (SELECT roleid /*	角色ID */, zoneid /*	服务器key */, zone_type /*	区服类型 */, his_first_active_time /*	历史首次活跃时间 */, his_last_active_time /*	历史末次活跃时间 */, his_login_cnt /*	历史累计登录次数 */, his_online_dur /*	历史累计登录时长(单位:秒) */, his_last_os_type /*	历史末次登录系统类型 */, his_last_os_name /*	历史末次登录系统类型名称 */, his_last_channel /*	历史末次登录渠道 */, his_last_login_ip /*	历史末次登录ip */, his_last_ip_country /*	历史末次登录国家 */, his_last_os_language /*	历史末次系统语言 */, his_last_os_version /*	历史末次登录系统版本 */, his_last_device_model /*	历史末次登录设备型号 */, his_last_device_id /*	历史末次登录设备id */, his_last_client_language /*	历史末次登录客户端语言 */, activedays /*	累计活跃天数(取自login activedays末次) */, cur_war_stage /*	当前战役进度 */, cur_role_level /*		当前玩家等级 */, his_last_client_version FROM wefly_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly'), charge_di AS (SELECT roleid /*	角色ID */, zoneid /*	服务器key */, zone_type /*	区服类型 */, first_pay_time /*	当天首次付费时间 */, last_pay_time /*	当天末次付费时间 */, pay_amt /*	付费金额(分) */, pay_cnt /*	付费次数 */ FROM wefly_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly'), charge_df AS (SELECT roleid /*	角色ID */, zoneid /*	服务器key */, zone_type /*	区服类型 */, his_first_pay_time /*	历史首次付费时间 */, his_last_pay_time /*	历史末次付费时间 */, his_pay_amt /*	历史累计付费金额(分) */, his_pay_cnt /*	历史累计付费次数 */ FROM wefly_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly'), role_zone_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ol_dur_array, active_info, charge_info, charge_cnt_total_array, charge_amt_total_array, SUM_ARRAY(ol_dur_array, 0, 6) AS online_dur_7days /* 近7天在线时长 */, SUM_ARRAY(ol_dur_array, 0, 29) AS online_dur_30days, IF(SIZE(ol_dur_array) <= 7, SUM_ARRAY(ol_dur_array, 0, SIZE(ol_dur_array)), SUM_ARRAY(ol_dur_array, SIZE(ol_dur_array) - 7, SIZE(ol_dur_array) - 1)) AS online_dur_resgister_7days /* 注册后7天在线时长 */, IF(SIZE(ol_dur_array) <= 30, SUM_ARRAY(ol_dur_array, 0, 29), SUM_ARRAY(ol_dur_array, SIZE(ol_dur_array) - 30, SIZE(ol_dur_array) - 1)) AS online_dur_register_30days, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, 0, 7), '0', '')) AS activedays_7days /* 最近7天活跃天数 */, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, 0, 30), '0', '')) AS activedays_30days, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, -7, 7), '0', '')) AS activedays_register_7days /* 注册后7天活跃天数 */, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, -30, 30), '0', '')) AS activedays_register_30days, (charge_cnt_total_array[0] - COALESCE(charge_cnt_total_array[7], 0)) AS charge_cnt_7days /* 最近7天付费次数 */, (charge_cnt_total_array[0] - COALESCE(charge_cnt_total_array[30], 0)) AS charge_cnt_30days, IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) <= 7, charge_cnt_total_array[0], charge_cnt_total_array[SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) - 7]) AS charge_cnt_register_7days /* 注册后前7天充值次数 */, IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) <= 30, charge_cnt_total_array[0], charge_cnt_total_array[SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) - 30]) AS charge_cnt_register_30days, (charge_amt_total_array[0] - COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array[7], 0)) AS charge_amt_7days /* 最近7天付费金额 */, (charge_amt_total_array[0] - COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array[30], 0)) AS charge_amt_30days, (charge_amt_total_array[0] - COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array[90], 0)) AS charge_amt_90days /* 最近90天付费金额 */, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) <= 7, charge_amt_total_array[0], charge_amt_total_array[SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) - 7]) AS charge_amt_register_7days /* 注册后前7天充值金额 */, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) <= 30, charge_amt_total_array[0], charge_amt_total_array[SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) - 30]) AS charge_amt_register_30days, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) <= 90, charge_amt_total_array[0], charge_amt_total_array[SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) - 90]) AS charge_amt_register_90days /* 注册后90天内付费金额 */, IF(LENGTH(active_info) <= 1, '', DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', IF(LOCATE('1', CONCAT('0', SUBSTRING(active_info, 2))) = 0, 0, LOCATE('1', CONCAT('0', SUBSTRING(active_info, 2))) - 1) * -1)) AS last_active_date_diffday /* 最后一次活跃日期(不含当日) */, IF(first_charge_date = '2026-05-31' OR charge_info = '', '', DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', (LOCATE('1', CONCAT('0', SUBSTRING(charge_info, 2))) - 1) * -1)) AS last_charge_date_diffday /* 最近一次付费日期(不含当日) */, IF(first_charge_date = '2026-05-31' OR charge_amt_total_array = ARRAY(), 0, charge_amt_total_array[LOCATE('1', CONCAT('0', SUBSTRING(charge_info, 2))) - 1] - COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array[LOCATE('1', CONCAT('0', SUBSTRING(charge_info, 2)))], 0)) AS last_chargeday_charge_amt_diffday /* 最后一个付费日付费金额(不含当日) */ FROM wefly_dw.dm_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), t_logout_last AS (/* 宠物和纹章信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, pet AS cur_pet, armband AS cur_armband FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, pet, armband, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn FROM wefly_ob_ods.logout_progress WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31') AS t WHERE rn = 1), t_pet_list /* 2. pet_list（S级73开头，SS级74开头；累计值取截止当天最大等级） */ AS (/* 宠物id和最大等级 */ SELECT t.roleid, t.zoneid, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(CAST(t.pet_id AS STRING), ':', CAST(COALESCE(u.max_lv, 1) AS STRING)))) AS cur_pet_list FROM (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, pet_id FROM wefly_ob_ods.pet_add WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND (CAST(pet_id AS STRING) LIKE '73%' OR CAST(pet_id AS STRING) LIKE '74%')) AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pet_id, MAX(new_lv) AS max_lv FROM wefly_ob_ods.pet_skillnodeupgrade WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pet_id) AS u ON t.roleid = u.roleid AND t.zoneid = u.zoneid AND t.pet_id = u.pet_id GROUP BY t.roleid, t.zoneid), t_pet_gacha /* 3. day_pet_gacha（当日普通+高级招募次数） */ /* 普通招募：lottery_times_type=1 每行*10，lottery_times_type=2 每行*100 */ /* 高级招募：act_pet_draw_advanced_lottery 每行*1 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(normal_cnt) AS day_pet_gacha_normal_num, SUM(advanced_cnt) AS day_pet_gacha_advanced_num, SUM(up_cnt) AS day_pet_gacha_up_num FROM (/* 普通招募：10连*10，100连*100 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN lottery_times_type = 1 THEN 10 WHEN lottery_times_type = 2 THEN 100 ELSE 0 END AS normal_cnt, 0 AS advanced_cnt, 0 AS up_cnt FROM wefly_ob_ods.act_pet_draw_normal_lottery WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL /* 高级招募：单抽，行数即次数 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, 0 AS normal_cnt, 1 AS advanced_cnt, 0 AS up_cnt FROM wefly_ob_ods.act_pet_draw_advanced_lottery WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL /* 奇巧八音招募：SUM(lottery_times_type)，单抽=1，10抽=10 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, 0 AS normal_cnt, 0 AS advanced_cnt, lottery_times_type AS up_cnt FROM wefly_ob_ods.act_pet_draw_up_lottery WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS x GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_armband_gacha /* 4. day_armband_gacha（精品之匣/奇珍之匣各自次数） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN gacha_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_armband_gacha_premium /* 精品之匣 */, SUM(CASE WHEN gacha_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_armband_gacha_rare /* 奇珍之匣 */ FROM wefly_ob_ods.gacha_detail WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_bounty /* 5. day_bounty_num（赏金拍档参与次数） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS day_bounty_num FROM wefly_ob_ods.act_detective_mode_battle_result WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), res_table AS (SELECT bas.roleid /*	角色ID */, bas.zoneid /*	服务器key */, bas.zone_type, bas.is_init_bot /*	创角时是否刷号 */, bas.is_cur_bot /*	当前是否刷号 */, bas.is_first_create /*	是否账号下首个创角 */, bas.account_name /*	sdk账号或设备id */, bas.did /*	msdk的设备id */, bas.register_date /*	注册日期 */, bas.register_time /*	注册日期 */, bas.os_name AS register_os /*	创角时系统类型（ios,android,other） */, bas.create_ip, bas.create_channel /*	创角渠道 */, bas.first_mt_country, bas.first_network_name, bas.create_country, act_df.his_last_os_name AS last_active_os /*	登录属性：历史末次登录系统类型 */, act_df.his_last_os_language AS last_os_language /*	登录属性：历史末次系统语言 */, act_df.his_last_os_version AS last_os_version /*	登录属性：历史末次登录系统版本 */, act_df.his_last_channel AS last_active_channel /*	登录属性：历史末次登录渠道 */, act_df.his_last_login_ip online_dur_30days /*	活跃：近30天在线时长（单位：秒） */, COALESCE(ifo.online_dur_resgister_7days, 0) AS online_dur_resgister_7days /*	活跃：注册后7天在线时长（单位：秒） */, COALESCE(ifo.online_dur_register_30days, 0) AS */ WITH wefly_pay AS (SELECT did, m__app_id AS app_id, COALESCE(LOWER(m__package_name), 'unknown') AS package_name, COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(m__os)), 'unknown') AS os, m__model AS model, m__os_version AS os_version, m__client_version AS client_version, m__event_time, money AS price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, m__app_id ORDER BY time DESC) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, m__app_id ORDER BY time ASC) AS rec_asc, 0 AS is_delete, time FROM wefly_ob_ods.charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid > 9999 AND logymd > '2025-08-26') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id = 4310) SELECT t1.did, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.day_first_model, t1.day_last_model, t1.day_first_os_version, t1.day_last_os_version, t1.day_first_client_version, t1.day_last_client_version, t1.day_first_charge_time, t1.day_last_charge_time, t2.charge_cnt, t2.charge_sum, 0 AS actual_amt, '01' AS stage_id FROM (SELECT did, app_id, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, package_name, NULL)) AS package_name, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os, NULL)) AS os, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_first_model, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_last_model, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_first_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_last_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_first_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_last_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, time, NULL)) AS day_first_charge_time, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, time, NULL)) AS day_last_charge_time FROM wefly_pay WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY did, app_id) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT did, app_id, COUNT(1) AS charge_cnt, SUM(price) AS charge_sum FROM wefly_pay GROUP BY did, app_id) AS t2 ON t1.did = t2.did AND t1.app_id = t2.app_id

600) <= 1, 1, 0) + IF(movelag / (battletime / 600) <= 4, 1, 0) + IF((ping80 / ping_times) >= 0.95, 1, 0) AS self_net_score FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-23' AND '2026-05-30' AND timedelay > 0 AND fake_ai = 0), base_data2 AS (SELECT accountid, PERCENTILE(CASE WHEN battle_range = 'q1' THEN self_net_score END, 0.5) AS score1, PERCENTILE(CASE WHEN battle_range = 'q2' THEN self_net_score END, 0.5) AS score2, PERCENTILE(CASE WHEN battle_range = 'q3' THEN self_net_score END, 0.5) AS score3, PERCENTILE(CASE WHEN battle_range = 'q4' THEN self_net_score END, 0.5) AS score4, COUNT(1) AS total_battle FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN rk <= border THEN 'q1' WHEN rk > border AND rk <= 2 * border THEN 'q2' WHEN rk > 2 * border AND rk <= 3 * border THEN 'q3' WHEN rk > 3 * border AND rk <= 4 * border THEN 'q4' END AS battle_range FROM (SELECT *, total / 4 AS border FROM base_data1) AS s1) AS s2 GROUP BY accountid), output_table AS (SELECT x1.*, CEIL(x2.score1) AS score1, CEIL(x2.score2) AS score2, CEIL(x2.score3) AS score3, CEIL(x2.score4) AS score4, x2.total_battle FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zone_id AS zoneid, MIN_BY(client_version, time) AS ml_temp.jaxzhong_user_login_funnel1_all_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zone_id) AS x1 LEFT JOIN base_data2 AS x2 ON x1.accountid = x2.accountid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jaxzhong_user_last_7d_net_score_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT accountid, zoneid, client_version, ip, channel, os_type, client_country, device_id, loginv2_start, login_auth, OVERWRITE TABLE wefly_dw.dwd_event_core_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-06-01') SELECT a.time, a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.usercreateymd, a.usercreatetime, a.ip, a.createrole_channel, a.device_account_name, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, usercreatetime, ip, createrole_channel, device_account_name, last_payment_date, deep_link, login_channel, android_id, last_login_date, payment_times, activedays, logymd, login_ip, device, role_level, ostype_login, accountcreateymd, client_os_version, login_type, client_version, alibattle_power FROM (SELECT time, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, usercreatetime, ip, createrole_channel, device_account_name, last_payment_date, deep_link, login_channel, android_id, last_login_date, payment_times, activedays, logymd, login_ip, device, role_level, ostype_login, accountcreateymd, client_os_version, login_type, client_version, alibattle_power, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, logymd ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS sn FROM wefly_ob_ods.login WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01') AS a0 WHERE sn = 1) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, MAX_BY(sub_channel, time) AS sub_channel FROM wefly_ob_ods.login WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' AND login_type = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.usercreateymd = b.usercreateymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, SUM(money / 100) AS money_USD, SUM(china_price) AS money_RMB, 1 AS charge_role, COUNT(1) AS charge_num FROM wefly_ob_ods.charge WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd) AS c ON a.logymd = c.logymd AND a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.usercreateymd = c.usercreateymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, MAX(stage_id) AS cur_stage FROM wefly_ob_ods.finish_challenge WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' AND stage_type IN (99, 1) GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd) AS d ON a.logymd = d.logymd AND a.roleid = d.roleid AND a.zoneid = d.zoneid AND a.usercreateymd = d.usercreateymd sql_units: /* T-2的全量设备信息union T-1的增量设备信息 */ WITH all_account AS (SELECT account_id, did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_version, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, step_action_info, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_name, adgroup_id, creative_id, creative_name, event_time, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, logymd, app_id FROM adbi.dim_account_tz_df WHERE logymd = '${DATE-2}' AND account_id <> 'unknown' UNION ALL SELECT account_id, did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, ARRAY(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT+0'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT+8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT+9'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_version, NULL AS first_media_source, NULL AS last_media_source, NULL AS first_ad_country, NULL AS last_ad_country, NULL AS first_mt_country, NULL AS last_mt_country, NULL AS step_action_info, NULL AS campaign_id, NULL AS campaign_name, NULL AS adgroup_name, NULL AS adgroup_id, NULL AS creative_id, NULL AS creative_name, event_time, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, logymd, app_id FROM adbi.dim_account_tz_di WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}' AND account_id <> 'unknown'), ad_attribution /* 最新一天归因到的广告信息 */ /* and app_id in ('4310') */ AS (SELECT logymd, app_id, did, package_name, CASE WHEN createdate = logymd THEN ad_country END AS first_ad_country, ad_country AS last_ad_country, ad_country /* (已改)可以按照归因日期和创建日期比较小，得到first和last两个字段，media source同理，这样下面的join只保留t3，可以少一次，也就会少一次shffle */, CASE WHEN createdate = logymd THEN media_source END AS first_media_source, media_source AS last_media_source, media_source, createdate, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_name, adgroup_id, creative_id, creative_name, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM adbi.dim_attribution_device_di /* fuxinwang：应该改为dim_attribution_create_device_di表？都可以，如果用dim_attribution_create_device_di需要读取30天分区，用dim_attribution_device_di只用一天就行 */ WHERE logymd = '${DATE-1}') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dim_account_tz_df PARTITION(logymd, app_id) SELECT account_id, did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, step_action_info, app_version, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_name, adgroup_id, creative_id, creative_name, event_time, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') ELSE '1970-01-01 00:00:00' END AS createtime, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, '${DATE-1}' AS logymd, app_id FROM (SELECT t1.account_id, t1.did, t1.package_name, t1.is_emulator, t1.client_ip, t1.os, t1.model, t1.os_version, t1.network_type, t1.os_language, t1.createdate, t1.ip_country, t1.client_version, t1.sdk_version, t1.idfa, t1.idfv, t1.gps_adid, t1.android_id, t1.imei, t1.oaid, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, t2.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, IF((t1.last_media_source <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.last_media_source IS NULL), t1.last_media_source, COALESCE(t2.last_media_source, 'unknown')) AS last_media_source, COALESCE(t1.first_ad_country, t2.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, IF((t1.last_ad_country <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.last_ad_country IS NULL), t1.last_ad_country, COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, 'unknown')) AS last_ad_country, IF((t1.first_mt_country <> 'unknown' OR NOT t1.first_mt_country IS NULL), t1.first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_ad_country, t2.first_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown')) AS first_mt_country, IF((t1.last_ad_country <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.last_ad_country IS NULL), t1.last_ad_country, COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown')) AS last_mt_country, NULL AS step_action_info /* COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, */, t1.app_version, IF((t1.campaign_id <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.campaign_id IS NULL), t1.campaign_id, COALESCE(t2.campaign_id, 'unknown')) AS campaign_id, IF((t1.campaign_name <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.campaign_name IS NULL), t1.campaign_name, COALESCE(t2.campaign_name, 'unknown')) AS campaign_name, IF((t1.adgroup_name <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.adgroup_name IS NULL), t1.adgroup_name, COALESCE(t2.adgroup_name, 'unknown')) AS adgroup_name, IF((t1.adgroup_id <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.adgroup_id IS NULL), t1.adgroup_id, COALESCE(t2.adgroup_id, 'unknown')) AS adgroup_id, IF((t1.creative_id <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.creative_id IS NULL), t1.creative_id, COALESCE(t2.creative_id, 'unknown')) AS creative_id, IF((t1.creative_name <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.creative_name IS NULL), t1.creative_name, COALESCE(t2.creative_name, 'unknown')) AS creative_name, t1.event_time, t1.stage_id, '${DATE-1}' AS logymd, t1.app_id FROM all_account AS t1 LEFT JOIN ad_attribution AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.did = t2.did AND t1.stage_id = t2.stage_id /* AND     t1.package_name = t2.package_name */ WHERE t1.createdate[0] BETWEEN '${DATE-30}' AND '${DATE-1}' UNION ALL SELECT t1.account_id, t1.did, t1.package_name, t1.is_emulator, t1.client_ip, t1.os, t1.model, t1.os_version, t1.network_type, t1.os_language, t1.createdate, t1.ip_country, t1.client_version, t1.sdk_version, t1.idfa, t1.idfv, t1.gps_adid, t1.android_id, t1.imei, t1.oaid, t1.first_media_source, t1.last_media_source, t1.first_ad_country, t1.last_ad_country, t1.first_mt_country, t1.last_mt_country, t1.step_action_info, t1.app_version, t1.campaign_id, t1.campaign_name, t1.adgroup_name, t1.adgroup_id, t1.creative_id, t1.creative_name, t1.event_time, t1.stage_id, '${DATE-1}' AS logymd, t1.app_id FROM all_account AS t1 WHERE createdate[0] < '${DATE-30}') AS x

name: battle_end_场次留存漏斗分析
sql_units: /* ============================================================ */ /* AuctionMode 完整三级留存漏斗（单条 SQL，已验证可运行） */ /* L0: gameserver_create_room pvptype=4030 （进入模式房间） */ /* L1: bidbattleserver_auctionmode_battle_end （开始第一局） */ /* L2+: 场次留存漏斗 */ /* 兼容性说明：用 dummy=1 的 JOIN 引入单行统计量，绕过本版本 */ /*   Presto 不支持标量子查询和无条件 CROSS JOIN 的限制 */ /* ============================================================ */ SELECT f.sort_key, f.funnel_node, f.players_reached, f.players_stopped, ROUND(100.0 * f.players_reached / l0.l0_cnt, 1) AS retention_vs_l0_pct, ROUND(100.0 * f.players_reached / l1.l1_cnt, 1) AS retention_vs_l1_pct FROM (/* L0 */ SELECT 0 AS sort_key, 'L0_进入模式房间' AS funnel_node, l0_cnt AS players_reached, NULL AS players_stopped, 1 AS dummy FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS l0_cnt FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_create_room WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' /* 修改起始日期 */ AND zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999 AND pvptype = 4030) AS x UNION ALL /* L1 */ SELECT 1, 'L1_开始第一局', l1_cnt, l1_cnt, 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS l1_cnt FROM mcgg_ods.bidbattleserver_auctionmode_battle_end WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' /* 与上方保持一致 */ AND zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999) AS x UNION ALL /* L2+ 场次留存漏斗 */ SELECT bucket_order + 1, CONCAT('L2_', bucket), players_reached, players_stopped_here, 1 FROM (SELECT bucket, bucket_order, players_stopped_here, SUM(players_stopped_here) OVER (ORDER BY bucket_order DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS players_reached FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN total_battles = 1 THEN '01局' WHEN total_battles = 2 THEN '02局' WHEN total_battles = 3 THEN '03局' WHEN total_battles = 4 THEN '04局' WHEN total_battles = 5 THEN '05局' WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '06-10局' WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '11-15局' WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN '16-20局' WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '21-30局' WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 31 AND 50 THEN '31-50局' WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 51 AND 100 THEN '51-100局' ELSE '100局以上' END AS bucket, CASE WHEN total_battles = 1 THEN 1 WHEN total_battles = 2 THEN 2 WHEN total_battles = 3 THEN 3 WHEN total_battles = 4 THEN 4 WHEN total_battles = 5 THEN 5 WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 6 WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN 11 WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN 16 WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN 21 WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 31 AND 50 THEN 31 WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 51 AND 100 THEN 51 ELSE 101 END AS bucket_order, COUNT(*) AS players_stopped_here FROM (SELECT accountid, COUNT(*) AS total_battles FROM mcgg_ods.bidbattleserver_auctionmode_battle_end WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999 GROUP BY accountid LIMIT 100000) AS p GROUP BY CASE WHEN total_battles = 1 THEN '01局' WHEN total_battles = 2 THEN '02局' WHEN total_battles = 3 THEN '03局' WHEN total_battles = 4 THEN '04局' WHEN total_battles = 5 THEN '05局' WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '06-10局' WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '11-15局' WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN '16-20局' WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '21-30局' WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 31 AND 50 THEN '31-50局' WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 51 AND 100 THEN '51-100局' ELSE '100局以上' END, CASE WHEN total_battles = 1 THEN 1 WHEN total_battles = 2 THEN 2 WHEN total_battles = 3 THEN 3 WHEN total_battles = 4 THEN 4 WHEN total_battles = 5 THEN 5 WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 6 WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN 11 WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN 16 WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN 21 WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 31 AND 50 THEN 31 WHEN total_battles BETWEEN 51 AND 100 THEN 51 ELSE 101 END) AS inner_b)) AS f JOIN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS l0_cnt, 1 AS dummy FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_create_room WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999 AND pvptype = 4030) AS l0 ON f.dummy = l0.dummy JOIN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS l1_cnt, 1 AS dummy FROM mcgg_ods.bidbattleserver_auctionmode_battle_end WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999) AS l1 ON f.dummy = l1.dummy ORDER BY f.sort_key

name: 0522活动站内信数据1
sql_units: WITH mail_base AS (/* 1. 抓取这两封邮件的发送记录，保留邮件 ID 维度 */ SELECT mailuuid, UPPER(createrole_country) AS country, roleid, 1 AS is_sent, 0 AS is_opened FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_send_mail WHERE LOGYMD >= '2026-05-22' AND LOGYMD <= '2026-06-05' AND zoneid < 57001 AND mailuuid IN (1779348999742, 1779348890514, 1779348828626, 1779678241003, 1780035341828, 1780035424514, 1780035515366) UNION ALL /* 2. 抓取这两封邮件的打开记录，保留邮件 ID 维度 */ SELECT mailuuid, UPPER(createrole_country) AS country, roleid, 0 AS is_sent, 1 AS is_opened FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_open_mail WHERE LOGYMD >= '2026-05-22' AND LOGYMD <= '2026-06-05' AND zoneid < 57001 AND mailuuid IN (1779348999742, 1779348890514, 1779348828626, 1779678241003, 1780035341828, 1780035424514, 1780035515366)), mail_agg AS (/* 3. 按邮件 ID + 用户去重聚合 */ SELECT mailuuid, country, roleid, MAX(is_sent) AS sent_flag, MAX(is_opened) AS open_flag FROM mail_base GROUP BY mailuuid, country, roleid) /* ========================================================== */ /* 4. 最终输出：按邮件 ID 和国家拆分统计 */ /* ========================================================== */ SELECT mailuuid AS `邮件ID`, country AS `国家`, SUM(sent_flag) AS `去重发送人数`, SUM(open_flag) AS `去重打开人数`, ROUND(SUM(open_flag) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sent_flag), 0), 2) AS `打开率(%)` FROM mail_agg WHERE country IN ('RU', 'ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'TR') GROUP BY mailuuid, country ORDER BY mailuuid, country
