sql_units: WITH 付费玩家 AS (/* 历史付费玩家（2025-05-28 至 2026-05-30 期间有付费） */ SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-05-28' AND '2026-05-30' AND (createrole_country IS NULL OR NOT createrole_country IN ('HK', 'CN')) AND zoneid < 57000 AND chargediamond > 0) SELECT w.logymd AS 日期, COUNT(DISTINCT w.accountid) AS 充值界面周卡打开人数 FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_weekly_diamond_pageview AS w INNER JOIN 付费玩家 AS p ON w.accountid = p.roleid WHERE w.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND w.zoneid < 57000 AND w.clicksource = 6 /* 充值界面 */ GROUP BY w.logymd ORDER BY w.logymd

name: v2_ml精准导量260420
sql_units: /* 所有特征组合在一起，按照未来1年付费情况 group by */ /* 原始需求文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/TTMEd91zGoG4fExmD3WcgFSCnuc */ WITH ml_users /* ml活跃用户 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT first_mt_country, create_country, roleid AS ml_roleid, zoneid AS ml_zoneid, CONCAT(roleid, '_', zoneid) AS ml_account, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS activedays_30days, MAX(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_ml_new_30days, MAX(is_recurring_30days) AS if_ml_return_30days, MAX(charge_amt_total) AS money_all_sum /* 历史总充值金额（含当日，单位：美分） */ FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_active_role_zone_di /* 数仓表 每日22:00产出 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY first_mt_country, create_country, roleid, zoneid), return14 /* 近期回流日期 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid AS ml_roleid, zoneid AS ml_zoneid FROM ml_temp.teemoyu_20240305_mc_ifreturn_01 WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-16' AND '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000), mc_accountid /* mc账号 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.update_ml_roleid AS mc_ml_roleid /* 最新匹配到的ml_id 包含后续变更的也会记录 */ FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc_ml_roleid_match AS a /* mc数分新洗的表 每天凌晨5:30更新  受到上游影响这个表最近一个分区是26.5.27 ，等上游回溯完再改回来，依赖也要添加回来 */ WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-27'), feature_df /* 其他标签补充 */ /* 其他标签补充 */ AS (SELECT roleid AS ml_roleid, zoneid AS ml_zoneid, is_active_day /* 分区当天是否活跃过 */, last_minranklvl /* 当日最后段位（小段位） */, his_max_minranklvl /* 生涯最高段位（小段位） */, his_chess_max_bigrank /* 自走棋历史最高大段位 */, his_chess_cnt /* 自走棋生涯场次 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_feature_role_zone_df /* 每天凌晨1:30 产生分区 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), total AS (SELECT a.first_mt_country, a.create_country, a.ml_roleid, a.ml_zoneid, a.ml_account, a.money_all_sum /* 历史总充值金额（含当日，单位：美分）  */, a.activedays_30days, a.if_ml_new_30days, a.if_ml_return_30days /* 是否是30天内的回流 */, CASE WHEN NOT b.ml_roleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_ml_return_14days /* 是否是14天内的回流 */, CASE WHEN NOT c.mc_ml_roleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_mc_accountid /* 是否在mc有账号 */, is_active_day /* 分区当天是否活跃过 */, last_minranklvl /* 当日最后段位（小段位） */, his_max_minranklvl /* 生涯最高段位（小段位） */, his_chess_max_bigrank /* 自走棋历史最高大段位 */, his_chess_cnt /* 自走棋生涯场次 */, CASE WHEN money_all_sum / 100 >= 2000 THEN '1.[2000,)' WHEN money_all_sum / 100 >= 200 THEN '2.[200,2000)' WHEN money_all_sum / 100 >= 20 THEN '3.[20,200)' WHEN money_all_sum / 100 >= 10 THEN '4.[10,20)' WHEN money_all_sum / 100 >= 5 THEN '5.[5,10)' WHEN money_all_sum / 100 >= 2 THEN '6.[2,5)' WHEN money_all_sum / 100 > 0 THEN '7.(0,2)' ELSE '8.(0)' END AS money_all_sum_type /* ========================================================================================分组 */ /* 付费层级划分，单位美元 */, CASE WHEN his_max_minranklvl >= 26 THEN '1.神话' WHEN his_max_minranklvl >= 21 THEN '2.传奇' WHEN his_max_minranklvl >= 16 THEN '3.史诗' WHEN his_max_minranklvl >= 11 THEN '4.宗师' WHEN his_max_minranklvl >= 7 THEN '5.大师' WHEN his_max_minranklvl >= 4 THEN '6.精英' WHEN his_max_minranklvl >= 1 THEN '7.勇士' ELSE '8.其他' END AS his_max_minranklvl_type /* 生涯最高段位 */, CASE WHEN his_chess_cnt >= 500 THEN 500 WHEN his_chess_cnt >= 400 THEN 400 WHEN his_chess_cnt >= 300 THEN 300 WHEN his_chess_cnt >= 200 THEN 200 WHEN his_chess_cnt >= 100 THEN 100 WHEN his_chess_cnt >= 50 THEN 50 WHEN his_chess_cnt >= 10 THEN 10 WHEN his_chess_cnt >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS his_chess_cnt_type /* 自走棋生涯场次 */, CASE WHEN activedays_30days >= 28 THEN 28 WHEN activedays_30days >= 24 THEN 24 WHEN activedays_30days >= 20 THEN 20 WHEN activedays_30days >= 16 THEN 16 WHEN activedays_30days >= 12 THEN 12 WHEN activedays_30days >= 9 THEN 9 WHEN activedays_30days >= 6 THEN 6 WHEN activedays_30days >= 4 THEN 4 ELSE activedays_30days END AS activedays_30days_type, CASE WHEN money_all_sum / 100 >= 2000 THEN 10 WHEN money_all_sum / 100 >= 200 THEN 9 WHEN money_all_sum / 100 >= 20 THEN 8 WHEN money_all_sum / 100 >= 10 THEN 7 WHEN money_all_sum / 100 >= 5 THEN 6 WHEN money_all_sum / 100 >= 2 THEN 5 WHEN money_all_sum / 100 > 0 THEN 4 WHEN money_all_sum = 0 AND his_chess_cnt <> 0 THEN 3 WHEN money_all_sum = 0 AND his_chess_cnt = 0 AND activedays_30days BETWEEN 25 AND 30 THEN 2 /* 无付费，无战棋经历，高活跃  */ WHEN money_all_sum = 0 AND his_chess_cnt = 0 AND activedays_30days BETWEEN 13 AND 24 THEN 1 /* 无付费，无战棋经历，中活跃  */ WHEN money_all_sum = 0 AND his_chess_cnt = 0 AND activedays_30days BETWEEN 0 AND 12 THEN 0 /* 无付费，无战棋经历，低活跃  */ ELSE 999 END AS rn_tag FROM ml_users AS a LEFT JOIN return14 AS b ON a.ml_roleid = b.ml_roleid AND a.ml_zoneid = b.ml_zoneid LEFT JOIN mc_accountid AS c ON a.ml_roleid = c.mc_ml_roleid LEFT JOIN feature_df AS d ON a.ml_roleid = d.ml_roleid AND a.ml_zoneid = d.ml_zoneid), total2 /* 能导的用户池子 */ AS (SELECT first_mt_country, create_country, ml_roleid, ml_zoneid, ml_account, money_all_sum /* 历史总充值金额（含当日，单位：美分）  */, activedays_30days, if_ml_new_30days, if_ml_return_30days /* 是否是30天内的回流 */, if_ml_return_14days /* 是否是14天内的回流 */, if_mc_accountid /* 是否在mc有账号 */, is_active_day /* 分区当天是否活跃过 */, last_minranklvl /* 当日最后段位（小段位） */, his_max_minranklvl /* 生涯最高段位（小段位） */, his_chess_max_bigrank /* 自走棋历史最高大段位 */, his_chess_cnt /* 自走棋生涯场次 */, money_all_sum_type /* ========================================================================================分组 */ /* 付费层级划分，单位美元 */, his_max_minranklvl_type /* 生涯最高段位 */, his_chess_cnt_type /* 自走棋生涯场次 */, activedays_30days_type, rn_tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rn_tag ORDER BY money_all_sum ASC, activedays_30days ASC, ml_account ASC) AS rn FROM total WHERE if_ml_return_14days = 0 /* 非14日内回流 */ AND if_ml_new_30days = 0 /* 非30日内新增 */ AND if_mc_accountid = 0 /* 没有在mc创角 */ AND money_all_sum / 100 < 20 /* 生涯付费小于20美刀 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.teemoyu_ml_mc_divert_roleid_df_20260421_01 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT DISTINCT ml_roleid AS roleid, ml_zoneid AS zoneid, CASE WHEN rn_tag = 0 THEN INT(FLOOR(rn / 500000)) + 10 WHEN rn_tag = 1 THEN INT(FLOOR(rn / 500000)) + 100 WHEN rn_tag = 2 THEN INT(FLOOR(rn / 500000)) + 200 WHEN rn_tag = 3 THEN INT(FLOOR(rn / 500000)) + 300 WHEN rn_tag = 4 THEN INT(FLOOR(rn / 500000)) + 400 WHEN rn_tag = 5 THEN INT(FLOOR(rn / 500000)) + 500 WHEN rn_tag = 6 THEN INT(FLOOR(rn / 500000)) + 600 WHEN rn_tag = 7 THEN INT(FLOOR(rn / 500000)) + 700 WHEN rn_tag = 8 THEN INT(FLOOR(rn / 500000)) + 800 WHEN rn_tag = 9 THEN INT(FLOOR(rn / 500000)) + 900 WHEN rn_tag = 10 THEN INT(FLOOR(rn / 500000)) + 1000 ELSE NULL END AS user_tag FROM total2 UNION ALL SELECT 277805, 22004, 1 UNION ALL SELECT 277808, 22004, 1 UNION ALL SELECT 302427, name: mt_ads.ads_realtime_batch_data_di_retention_push
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-08-18 19:43:41.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `mt_ads_pre`.`ads_realtime_batch_data_di` ( */ /*   `date_range` string COMMENT '数据日期', */ /*   `country` string COMMENT '注册国家', */ /*   `user_type` bigint COMMENT '用户类型', */ /*   `point` bigint COMMENT '时间点', */ /*   `point_cnt` bigint COMMENT '分时数值', */ /*   `day_cnt` bigint COMMENT '累计数值', */ /*   `point_arr` array < bigint > COMMENT '分时数组', */ /*   `day_arr` array < bigint > COMMENT '累计数组' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*   `logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区(yyy-MM-dd)', */ /*   `appname` string COMMENT '项目ID(mlcn)', */ /*   `granularity_type` string COMMENT '粒度类型(account,device)', */ /*   `date_type` string COMMENT '日期类型(daily,weekly,monthly)', */ /*   `event` string COMMENT '事件: login, charge, charge_cnt, create, retention' */ /* ) */ WITH install_user_reduce AS (SELECT roleid, SUBSTRING(register_time, 0, 10) AS register_date, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS logymd FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, register_date ORDER BY source_order ASC, register_time ASC, zoneid ASC /* 同一时间创角的取区分小的 */) AS row_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS register_date, `time` AS register_time, LOWER(createrole_country) AS create_country, 1 AS source_order FROM wefly_ob_ods.create_role WHERE logymd <= '2026-06-01' AND logymd >= '2025-08-27' AND zoneid > 9999 AND logymd >= '2026-05-26' AND CAST(`time` AS STRING) < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 15 * 3600))) WHERE row_num = 1), active_info AS (SELECT roleid, logymd FROM wefly_ob_ods.login WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' AND zoneid > 9999 AND CAST(TIME AS STRING) < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 15 * 3600) AND logymd >= '2025-08-27' GROUP BY roleid, logymd), bot_info AS (SELECT roleid, MAX(is_acc_init_bot) AS is_acc_init_bot FROM wefly_dw.dim_role_zone_bot_info_hf WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' GROUP BY roleid), retention_arr AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT create_base_info.roleid) AS register_cnt, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 1, 1, 0)) AS reten_2d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 2, 1, 0)) AS reten_3d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 3, 1, 0)) AS reten_4d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 4, 1, 0)) AS reten_5d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 5, 1, 0)) AS reten_6d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 6, 1, 0)) AS reten_7d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(create_base_info.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 1, 1, 0)) AS register_2d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(create_base_info.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 2, 1, 0)) AS register_3d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(create_base_info.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 3, 1, 0)) AS register_4d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(create_base_info.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 4, 1, 0)) AS register_5d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(create_base_info.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 5, 1, 0)) AS register_6d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(create_base_info.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 6, 1, 0)) AS register_7d FROM install_user_reduce AS create_base_info LEFT JOIN active_info AS t_login ON create_base_info.roleid = t_login.roleid LEFT JOIN bot_info ON create_base_info.roleid = bot_info.roleid WHERE COALESCE(is_acc_init_bot, 0) = 0) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_realtime_batch_data_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type, event, user_type) SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600) AS date_range, NULL AS country, LEAST(23, (HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600)) * 3600 + MINUTE(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600)) * 60 + SECOND(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600))) DIV 3600) AS point, NULL AS point_cnt, NULL AS day_cnt, NULL AS point_arr, CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', register_cnt, reten_2d, reten_3d, reten_4d, reten_5d, reten_6d, reten_7d, register_2d, register_3d, register_4d, register_5d, register_6d, register_7d), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS day_reten_arr, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS logymd, 'wegame' AS appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH')) AS date_type, 'retention_push' AS event, 2 AS user_type FROM retention_arr

online_time > 0 AND zoneid > 9999) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, logymd, country, hour_point), bot_info AS (SELECT roleid, MAX(is_acc_cur_bot) AS is_acc_cur_bot FROM wefly_dw.dim_role_zone_bot_info_hf WHERE day_online_time), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS day_arr FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_online_base.point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(t_online_base.day_cnt, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS day_cnt /* COALESCE(t_online_base.day_cnt, 0) AS day_cnt, */, SUM(COALESCE(t_online_base.online_dur, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS day_online_time FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_online_base ON t_incr.country = t_online_base.country AND t_incr.point = t_online_base.point) AS t1

07:00:00; */ WITH charge_info AS (SELECT roleid, country, logymd, hour_point, point, SUM(COALESCE(pay_amt, 0)) AS pay_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, FIRST_VALUE(LOWER(IF(createrole_country IS NULL OR createrole_country = '-', 'unknown', createrole_country))) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY time ASC) AS country, logymd, LEAST(23, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 3600) AS hour_point, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point, COALESCE(money, 0) AS pay_amt FROM bi_test.wegame_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' AND CAST(TIME AS STRING) < '2026-06-01 07:00:00' AND SUBSTRING(CAST(TIME AS STRING), 1, 10) = '2026-06-01' AND zoneid > 9999 AND money > 0) GROUP BY roleid, country, logymd, hour_point, point), bot_info AS (SELECT roleid, MAX(is_acc_cur_bot) AS is_acc_cur_bot FROM bi_test.dim_account_info_hf_wegame WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' GROUP BY roleid), base_info AS (SELECT charge_info.roleid AS accountid, hour_point, point, COALESCE(charge_info.country, 'unknown') AS country, pay_amt FROM charge_info LEFT JOIN bot_info ON charge_info.roleid = bot_info.roleid WHERE COALESCE(is_acc_cur_bot, 0) = 0), t_charge_base AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT point, country, 'charge_cnt' AS event, SUM(point_cnt) AS point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT point, country, point_cnt, ct AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT point, country, 0 AS point_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS ct FROM (SELECT accountid, country, MIN(point) AS point FROM base_info GROUP BY accountid, country) AS t GROUP BY point, country) AS t3 UNION ALL SELECT point, country, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS point_cnt, 0 AS day_cnt FROM base_info GROUP BY country, point) AS t GROUP BY point, country) AS t1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT point, country, 'charge_cnt_hour' AS event, SUM(point_cnt) AS point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT point, country, point_cnt, ct AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT point, country, 0 AS point_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS ct FROM (SELECT accountid, country, MIN(hour_point) AS point FROM base_info GROUP BY country, accountid) AS t GROUP BY point, country) AS t3 UNION ALL SELECT hour_point AS point, country, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS point_cnt, 0 AS day_cnt FROM base_info GROUP BY accountid, country, hour_point) AS t GROUP BY point, country) AS t2 UNION ALL SELECT hour_point AS point, country, 'charge_hour' AS event, SUM(pay_amt) AS point_cnt, SUM(pay_amt) AS day_cnt FROM base_info GROUP BY hour_point, country UNION ALL SELECT point, country, 'charge' AS event, SUM(pay_amt) AS point_cnt, SUM(pay_amt) AS day_cnt FROM base_info GROUP BY point, country), sample_data AS (SELECT COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, t2.point, t2.event, SUM(point_cnt) AS point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) AS day_cnt FROM t_charge_base AS t2 GROUP BY COALESCE(country, 'unknown'), t2.point, t2.event), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid, 'charge_cnt' AS event FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2024-12-23', '2024-12-23', '2026-05-30') AND appname = 'mlbb_synclog' AND FLOOR(point / 12) <= (HOUR('${real_time}') * 3600 + MINUTE('${real_time}') * 60 + SECOND('${real_time}')) DIV 3600 /* LEAST( */ /*             287, */ /*             ( */ /*                 HOUR('${real_time}') * 3600 + MINUTE('${real_time}') * 60 + SECOND('${real_time}') */ /*             ) DIV 300 */ /*         ) */ UNION ALL SELECT point, country, appname, appid, 'charge_cnt_hour' AS event FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2024-12-23', '2024-12-23', '2026-05-30') AND appname = 'mlbb_synclog' AND point <= LEAST(287, (HOUR('${real_time}') * 3600 + MINUTE('${real_time}') * 60 + SECOND('${real_time}')) DIV 3600) UNION ALL SELECT point, country, appname, appid, 'charge' AS event FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2024-12-23', '2024-12-23', '2026-05-30') AND appname = 'mlbb_synclog' AND FLOOR(point / 12) <= LEAST(287, (HOUR('${real_time}') * 3600 + MINUTE('${real_time}') * 60 + SECOND('${real_time}')) DIV 3600) UNION ALL SELECT point, country, appname, appid, 'charge_hour' AS event FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2024-12-23', '2024-12-23', '2026-05-30') AND appname = 'mlbb_synclog' AND point <= LEAST(287, (HOUR('${real_time}') * 3600 + MINUTE('${real_time}') * 60 + SECOND('${real_time}')) DIV 3600)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads_pre.ads_realtime_batch_data_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type, event, user_type) SELECT '2026-06-01' AS date_range, country, point, point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY country, event ORDER BY point) AS day_cnt, NULL AS point_arr, NULL AS day_arr, '2026-06-01' AS logymd, 'wegame' AS appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'daily' AS date_type, event, 2 AS user_type FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, t_incr.event, COALESCE(t_charge_base.point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt, COALESCE(t_charge_base.day_cnt, 0) AS day_cnt FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_charge_base ON t_incr.country = t_charge_base.country AND t_incr.point = t_charge_base.point AND t_incr.event = t_charge_base.event) AS t1

name: mt_ads_pre.ads_realtime_batch_data_di_retention_push
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-08-18 19:43:41.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `mt_ads_pre`.`ads_realtime_batch_data_di` ( */ /*   `date_range` string COMMENT '数据日期', */ /*   `country` string COMMENT '注册国家', */ /*   `user_type` bigint COMMENT '用户类型', */ /*   `point` bigint COMMENT '时间点', */ /*   `point_cnt` bigint COMMENT '分时数值', */ /*   `day_cnt` bigint COMMENT '累计数值', */ /*   `point_arr` array < bigint > COMMENT '分时数组', */ /*   `day_arr` array < bigint > COMMENT '累计数组' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*   `logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区(yyy-MM-dd)', */ /*   `appname` string COMMENT '项目ID(mlcn)', */ /*   `granularity_type` string COMMENT '粒度类型(account,device)', */ /*   `date_type` string COMMENT '日期类型(daily,weekly,monthly)', */ /*   `event` string COMMENT '事件: login, charge, charge_cnt, create, retention' */ /* ) */ WITH install_user_reduce AS (SELECT roleid, SUBSTRING(register_time, 0, 10) AS register_date, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS logymd FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, register_date ORDER BY source_order ASC, register_time ASC, zoneid ASC /* 同一时间创角的取区分小的 */) AS row_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS register_date, `time` AS register_time, LOWER(createrole_country) AS create_country, 1 AS source_order FROM bi_test.wegame_create WHERE logymd <= '2026-06-01' AND logymd >= '2025-08-20' AND zoneid > 9999 AND logymd >= '2026-05-26' AND CAST(`time` AS STRING) < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 15 * 3600))) WHERE row_num = 1), active_info AS (SELECT roleid, logymd FROM bi_test.wegame_login WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' AND zoneid > 9999 AND CAST(TIME AS STRING) < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 15 * 3600) AND logymd >= '2025-08-20' GROUP BY roleid, logymd), bot_info AS (SELECT roleid, MAX(is_acc_init_bot) AS is_acc_init_bot FROM bi_test.dim_account_info_hf_wegame WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' GROUP BY roleid), retention_arr AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT create_base_info.roleid) AS register_cnt, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 1, 1, 0)) AS reten_2d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 2, 1, 0)) AS reten_3d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 3, 1, 0)) AS reten_4d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 4, 1, 0)) AS reten_5d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 5, 1, 0)) AS reten_6d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 6, 1, 0)) AS reten_7d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(create_base_info.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 1, 1, 0)) AS register_2d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(create_base_info.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 2, 1, 0)) AS register_3d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(create_base_info.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 3, 1, 0)) AS register_4d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(create_base_info.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 4, 1, 0)) AS register_5d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(create_base_info.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 5, 1, 0)) AS register_6d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(create_base_info.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 6, 1, 0)) AS register_7d FROM install_user_reduce AS create_base_info LEFT JOIN active_info AS t_login ON create_base_info.roleid = t_login.roleid LEFT JOIN bot_info ON create_base_info.roleid = bot_info.roleid WHERE COALESCE(is_acc_init_bot, 0) = 0) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads_pre.ads_realtime_batch_data_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type, event, user_type) SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600) AS date_range, NULL AS country, LEAST(23, (HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600)) * 3600 + MINUTE(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600)) * 60 + SECOND(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600))) DIV 3600) AS point, NULL AS point_cnt, NULL AS day_cnt, NULL AS point_arr, CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', register_cnt, reten_2d, reten_3d, reten_4d, reten_5d, reten_6d, reten_7d, register_2d, register_3d, register_4d, register_5d, register_6d, register_7d), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS day_reten_arr, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS logymd, 'wegame' AS appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 22:00:00') - 16 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH')) AS date_type, 'retention_push' AS event, 2 AS user_type FROM retention_arr

name: mt_ads_pre.ads_realtime_batch_data_di_retention
sql_units: WITH install_user_reduce AS (SELECT roleid, register_time, register_date, create_country, LEAST(23, (HOUR(register_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(register_time) * 60 + SECOND(register_time)) DIV 3600) AS hour_point, LEAST(287, (HOUR(register_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(register_time) * 60 + SECOND(register_time)) DIV 300) AS point, IF(zoneid > 9999, 1, 0) AS zone_type FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, register_date ORDER BY source_order ASC, register_time ASC, zoneid ASC /* 同一时间创角的取区分小的 */) AS row_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS register_date, TIME AS register_time, LOWER(IF(TRIM(COALESCE(createrole_country, 'unknown')) IN ('', '-'), 'unknown', TRIM(COALESCE(createrole_country, 'unknown')))) AS create_country /* lower(createrole_country) AS create_country, */, 1 AS source_order FROM bi_test.wegame_create WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-26' AND '2026-06-01' AND SUBSTRING(CAST(TIME AS STRING), 1, 10) = logymd AND logymd >= '2025-08-20' AND zoneid > 9999 AND CAST(TIME AS STRING) < '2026-06-01 07:00:00') /* AND     CAST(TIME AS STRING) < '2026-05-31 07:00:00' */) WHERE row_num = 1), active_info AS (SELECT roleid, logymd FROM bi_test.wegame_login /* WHERE   logymd = '2026-06-01' */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-27' AND '2026-06-01' AND SUBSTRING(CAST(TIME AS STRING), 1, 10) = logymd AND CAST(TIME AS STRING) < '2026-06-01 07:00:00' AND logymd >= '2025-08-20' AND zoneid > 9999 GROUP BY roleid, logymd), bot_info AS (SELECT roleid, MAX(is_acc_init_bot) AS is_acc_init_bot FROM bi_test.dim_account_info_hf_wegame WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' GROUP BY roleid), retention_arr AS (SELECT create_base_info.create_country AS country, create_base_info.register_date AS register_date, COUNT(DISTINCT create_base_info.roleid) AS register_cnt, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 1, 1, 0)) AS reten_2d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 2, 1, 0)) AS reten_3d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 3, 1, 0)) AS reten_4d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 4, 1, 0)) AS reten_5d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 5, 1, 0)) AS reten_6d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 6, 1, 0)) AS reten_7d FROM install_user_reduce AS create_base_info LEFT JOIN active_info AS t_login ON create_base_info.roleid = t_login.roleid LEFT JOIN bot_info ON create_base_info.roleid = bot_info.roleid WHERE COALESCE(is_acc_init_bot, 0) = 0 GROUP BY create_base_info.create_country, create_base_info.register_date), result_info AS (SELECT COALESCE(t1.country, 'unknown') AS country, t1.register_date AS date_range, SUM(COALESCE(register_cnt, 0)) AS register_cnt /* count(DISTINCT t2.roleid) AS dau, */, SUM(COALESCE(reten_2d, 0)) AS reten_2d /* SUM(charge_amt) AS charge_amt, */, SUM(COALESCE(reten_3d, 0)) AS reten_3d, SUM(COALESCE(reten_4d, 0)) AS reten_4d, SUM(COALESCE(reten_5d, 0)) AS reten_5d, SUM(COALESCE(reten_6d, 0)) AS reten_6d, SUM(COALESCE(reten_7d, 0)) AS reten_7d FROM retention_arr AS t1 GROUP BY COALESCE(t1.country, 'unknown'), t1.register_date) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads_pre.ads_realtime_batch_data_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-06-01', appname = 'wegame', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily', event = 'retention', user_type = 2) SELECT date_range, country, LEAST(23, (HOUR('${real_time}') * 3600 + MINUTE('${real_time}') * 60 + SECOND('${real_time}')) DIV 3600) AS point, NULL AS point_cnt, NULL AS day_cnt, NULL AS point_arr, CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', register_cnt, retention_2d, retention_3d, retention_4d, retention_5d, retention_6d, retention_7d), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS day_reten_arr FROM (SELECT date_range, register_cnt, country, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', date_range) >= 1, reten_2d, NULL) AS retention_2d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', date_range) >= 2, reten_3d, NULL) AS retention_3d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', date_range) >= 3, reten_4d, NULL) AS retention_4d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', date_range) >= 4, reten_5d, NULL) AS retention_5d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', date_range) >= 5, reten_6d, NULL) AS retention_6d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', date_range) >= 6, reten_7d, NULL) AS retention_7d FROM result_info) AS t1

name: mt_ads.ads_realtime_batch_data_di_point_retention
sql_units: WITH create_base_info AS (SELECT t1.* FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, SUBSTRING(register_time, 0, 10) AS register_date, country, LEAST(23, (HOUR(register_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(register_time) * 60 + SECOND(register_time)) DIV 3600) AS hour_point, LEAST(287, (HOUR(register_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(register_time) * 60 + SECOND(register_time)) DIV 300) AS point FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS register_date, `time` AS register_time, LOWER(IF(TRIM(COALESCE(createrole_country, 'unknown')) IN ('', '-'), 'unknown', TRIM(COALESCE(createrole_country, 'unknown')))) AS country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY `time` ASC, zoneid ASC) AS row_num /* 同一时间创角的取区分小的 */ FROM wefly_ob_ods.create_role WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-26' AND '2026-06-01' AND SUBSTRING(CAST(TIME AS STRING), 1, 10) = logymd AND logymd >= '2025-08-27' AND /*    AND m__zone_id > 9999 */ zoneid > 9999 AND CAST(TIME AS STRING) < '2026-06-01 07:00:00') AS tk WHERE row_num = 1) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, MAX(is_acc_init_bot) AS is_acc_init_bot FROM wefly_dw.dim_role_zone_bot_info_hf WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' GROUP BY roleid) AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.roleid WHERE COALESCE(is_acc_init_bot, 0) = 0), t_create_base AS (SELECT register_date, country, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS register_cnt FROM create_base_info GROUP BY country, register_date), sample_data AS (SELECT t_login.point, create_base_info.register_date, create_base_info.country, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 1, 1, 0)) AS reten_2d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 2, 1, 0)) AS reten_3d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 3, 1, 0)) AS reten_4d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 4, 1, 0)) AS reten_5d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 5, 1, 0)) AS reten_6d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 6, 1, 0)) AS reten_7d FROM create_base_info JOIN (SELECT roleid, logymd, MIN(LEAST(287, (HOUR(`time`) * 3600 + MINUTE(`time`) * 60 + SECOND(`time`) DIV 300))) AS point FROM wefly_ob_ods.login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-27' AND '2026-06-01' AND SUBSTRING(CAST(TIME AS STRING), 1, 10) = logymd AND CAST(TIME AS STRING) < '2026-06-01 07:00:00' AND logymd >= '2025-08-27' AND /*  AND m__zone_id > 9999 */ zoneid > 9999 GROUP BY roleid, logymd) AS t_login ON create_base_info.accountid = t_login.roleid GROUP BY t_login.point, create_base_info.register_date, create_base_info.country), date_seq /*  ) t2 */ /*  where dt >= '2025-08-20' */ AS (/* select */ /*     * */ /* from ( */ SELECT DATE_ADD(IF('2026-05-26' <= '2025-08-27', '2025-08-27', '2026-05-26'), pos) AS dt, 1 AS join_key FROM (SELECT POSEXPLODE(SEQUENCE(0, DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', IF('2026-05-26' <= '2025-08-27', '2025-08-27', '2026-05-26')))) AS (pos, _)) AS t1), t_incr /*  AND date_seq.dt >= '2025-08-20' */ AS (SELECT t1.*, date_seq.dt AS register_date FROM (SELECT point, country, 1 AS join_key FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2024-12-23', '2024-12-23', '2026-05-30') AND appname = 'mlbb_synclog' AND country IN (SELECT DISTINCT country FROM t_create_base)) AS t1 /*               AND FLOOR(point / 12) <= (HOUR('${real_time}') * 3600 + MINUTE('${real_time}') * 60 + SECOND('${real_time}')) DIV 3600 */ JOIN date_seq ON t1.join_key = date_seq.join_key WHERE FLOOR(point / 12) <= CASE WHEN dt < '2026-06-01' THEN 23 ELSE (HOUR('${real_time}') * 3600 + MINUTE('${real_time}') * 60 + SECOND('${real_time}')) DIV 3600 END) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_realtime_batch_data_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-06-01', appname = 'wegame', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily', event = 'retention_point', user_type = 2) SELECT tp.register_date AS date_range, tp.country, point, NULL AS point_cnt, NULL AS day_cnt, NULL AS point_arr, CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', COALESCE(t_create_base.register_cnt, 0), retention_2d, retention_3d, retention_4d, retention_5d, retention_6d, retention_7d), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS day_reten_arr FROM (SELECT register_date, country, point, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', register_date) >= 1, point_2d_cnt, NULL) AS retention_2d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', register_date) >= 2, point_3d_cnt, NULL) AS retention_3d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', register_date) >= 3, point_4d_cnt, NULL) AS retention_4d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', register_date) >= 4, point_5d_cnt, NULL) AS retention_5d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', register_date) >= 5, point_6d_cnt, NULL) AS retention_6d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', register_date) >= 6, point_7d_cnt, NULL) AS retention_7d FROM (SELECT t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country, t_incr.point, SUM(COALESCE(reten_2d, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS point_2d_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(reten_3d, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS point_3d_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(reten_4d, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS point_4d_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(reten_5d, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS point_5d_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(reten_6d, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS point_6d_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(reten_7d, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS point_7d_cnt FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN sample_data ON t_incr.register_date = sample_data.register_date AND t_incr.country = sample_data.country AND t_incr.point = sample_data.point) AS tk) AS tp LEFT JOIN t_create_base ON t_create_base.register_date = tp.register_date AND t_create_base.country = tp.country

name: mt_ads_pre.ads_realtime_batch_data_di_login
sql_units: WITH active_info AS (SELECT roleid, country, logymd, hour_point, point FROM (SELECT roleid, FIRST_VALUE(LOWER(IF(createrole_country IS NULL OR createrole_country = '-', 'unknown', MINUTE(register_time) * 60 + SECOND(register_time)) DIV 3600) AS hour_point, LEAST(287, (HOUR(register_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(register_time) * 60 + SECOND(register_time)) DIV 300) AS point FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS register_date, `time` AS register_time, LOWER(IF(TRIM(COALESCE(createrole_country, 'unknown')) IN ('', '-'), 'unknown', TRIM(COALESCE(createrole_country, 'unknown')))) AS country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY `time` ASC, zoneid ASC) AS row_num /* 同一时间创角的取区分小的 */ FROM bi_test.wegame_create WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-26' AND '2026-06-01' AND SUBSTRING(CAST(TIME AS STRING), 1, 10) = logymd AND logymd >= '2025-08-20' AND /*    AND m__zone_id > 9999 */ zoneid > 9999 AND CAST(TIME AS STRING) < '2026-06-01 07:00:00') AS tk WHERE row_num = 1) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, MAX(is_acc_init_bot) AS is_acc_init_bot FROM bi_test.dim_account_info_hf_wegame WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' GROUP BY roleid) AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.roleid WHERE COALESCE(is_acc_init_bot, 0) = 0), t_create_base AS (SELECT register_date, country, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS register_cnt FROM create_base_info GROUP BY country, register_date), sample_data AS (SELECT t_login.point, create_base_info.register_date, create_base_info.country, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 1, 1, 0)) AS reten_2d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 2, 1, 0)) AS reten_3d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 3, 1, 0)) AS reten_4d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 4, 1, 0)) AS reten_5d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 5, 1, 0)) AS reten_6d, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(t_login.logymd, create_base_info.register_date) = 6, 1, 0)) AS reten_7d FROM create_base_info JOIN (SELECT roleid, logymd, MIN(LEAST(287, (HOUR(`time`) * 3600 + MINUTE(`time`) * 60 + SECOND(`time`) DIV 300))) AS point FROM bi_test.wegame_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-27' AND '2026-06-01' AND SUBSTRING(CAST(TIME AS STRING), 1, 10) = logymd AND CAST(TIME AS STRING) < '2026-06-01 07:00:00' AND logymd >= '2025-08-20' AND /*  AND m__zone_id > 9999 */ zoneid > 9999 GROUP BY roleid, logymd) AS t_login ON create_base_info.accountid = t_login.roleid GROUP BY t_login.point, create_base_info.register_date, create_base_info.country), date_seq /*  ) t2 */ /*  where dt >= '2025-08-20' */ AS (/* select */ /*     * */ /* from ( */ SELECT DATE_ADD(IF('2026-05-26' <= '2025-08-20', '2025-08-20', '2026-05-26'), pos) AS dt, 1 AS join_key FROM (SELECT POSEXPLODE(SEQUENCE(0, DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', IF('2026-05-26' <= '2025-08-20', '2025-08-20', '2026-05-26')))) AS (pos, _)) AS t1), t_incr /*  AND date_seq.dt >= '2025-08-20' */ AS (SELECT t1.*, date_seq.dt AS register_date FROM (SELECT point, country, 1 AS join_key FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2024-12-23', '2024-12-23', '2026-05-30') AND appname = 'mlbb_synclog' AND country IN (SELECT DISTINCT country FROM t_create_base)) AS t1 /*               AND FLOOR(point / 12) <= (HOUR('${real_time}') * 3600 + MINUTE('${real_time}') * 60 + SECOND('${real_time}')) DIV 3600 */ JOIN date_seq ON t1.join_key = date_seq.join_key WHERE FLOOR(point / 12) <= CASE PARTITION(logymd = '2026-06-01', appname = 'wegame', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily', event = 'retention_point', user_type = 2) SELECT tp.register_date AS date_range, tp.country, point, NULL AS point_cnt, NULL AS day_cnt, NULL AS point_arr, CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', COALESCE(t_create_base.register_cnt, 0), retention_2d, retention_3d, retention_4d, retention_5d, retention_6d, retention_7d), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS day_reten_arr FROM (SELECT register_date, country, point, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', register_date) >= 1, point_2d_cnt, NULL) AS retention_2d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', register_date) >= 2, point_3d_cnt, NULL) AS retention_3d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', register_date) >= 3, point_4d_cnt, NULL) AS retention_4d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', register_date) >= 4, point_5d_cnt, NULL) AS retention_5d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', register_date) >= 5, point_6d_cnt, NULL) AS retention_6d, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', register_date) >= 6, point_7d_cnt, NULL) AS retention_7d FROM (SELECT t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country, t_incr.point, SUM(COALESCE(reten_2d, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS point_2d_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(reten_3d, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS point_3d_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(reten_4d, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS point_4d_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(reten_5d, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS point_5d_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(reten_6d, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS point_6d_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(reten_7d, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.register_date, t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS point_7d_cnt FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN sample_data ON t_incr.register_date = sample_data.register_date AND t_incr.country = sample_data.country AND t_incr.point = sample_data.point) AS tk) AS tp LEFT JOIN t_create_base ON t_create_base.register_date = tp.register_date AND t_create_base.country = tp.country

sql_units: WITH event_log /* and event='__purchase_event__' 这张表中都是付费相关的 */ AS (SELECT `event`, event_time, event_uuid, client_ip, server_time, event_source, app_name, package_name, role_id, zone_id, account_id, `level`, user_create_time, current_diamond, store, product_id, sub_product_id, flow_id, order_id, add_time, verify_time, deliver_time, verify_retries, deliver_retries, receipt_type, price, currency, local_price, is_subscription, start_time, expire_time, step, queue_id, result_code, result_message, pay_channel, pay_channel_sub, purchase_type, environment, os, os_version, idfa, idfv, android_id, imei, build_serial, mac, gps_adid, gps_asid, oaid, model, client_version, did, logymd, `hour`, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_uuid, order_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS row_num FROM msdk_ods.msdk_charge WHERE ((logymd = '20260530' AND `hour` >= '23') OR (logymd = '20260531') OR (logymd = '20260601' AND `hour` <= '02')) AND DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8')) = DATE('2026-05-31') AND (NOT `event` IS NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(`event`)) > 1) /* event不需要为空字符或为空, 理论上在msdk上报的时候控制好了的 */ AND NOT event_source IS NULL /* --事件上报来源, NULL默认为未知上报 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT `event`, event_time, event_uuid, COALESCE(client_ip, 'unknown') AS client_ip, COALESCE(IF(TRIM((GEOIP(client_ip, 1))) = '-', NULL, LOWER(GEOIP(client_ip, 1))), 'unknown') AS ip_country, COALESCE(server_time, 0) AS server_time, COALESCE(event_source, 'unknown') AS event_source, COALESCE(app_name, 'unknown') AS app_name, COALESCE(package_name, 'unknown') AS package_name, CAST(role_id AS STRING) AS role_id, CAST(zone_id AS STRING) AS zone_id, CAST(account_id AS STRING) AS account_id, COALESCE(`level`, 0), COALESCE(user_create_time, 0) AS user_create_time, COALESCE(current_diamond, 0) AS current_diamond, COALESCE(store, 'unknown') AS store, COALESCE(product_id, 'unknown') AS product_id, COALESCE(sub_product_id, 'unknown'), COALESCE(flow_id, 'unknown'), COALESCE(order_id, 'unknown'), COALESCE(add_time, 0) AS add_time, COALESCE(verify_time, 0) AS verify_time, COALESCE(deliver_time, 0) AS deliver_time, COALESCE(verify_retries, 0) AS verify_retries, COALESCE(deliver_retries, 0) AS deliver_retries, COALESCE(receipt_type, 0) AS receipt_type, COALESCE(price, 0) AS price, currency, COALESCE(local_price, '0') AS local_price, COALESCE(is_subscription, 0) AS is_subscription, COALESCE(start_time, 0) AS start_time, COALESCE(expire_time, 0) AS expire_time, COALESCE(step, 'unknown') AS step, COALESCE(queue_id, -99999) AS queue_id, COALESCE(result_code, -99999) AS result_code, COALESCE(result_message, 'unknown') AS result_message, COALESCE(LOWER(pay_channel), 'unknown') AS pay_channel, COALESCE(LOWER(pay_channel_sub), 'unknown') AS pay_channel_sub, COALESCE(purchase_type, 'unknown') AS purchase_type, COALESCE(environment, 'unknown') AS environment, COALESCE(LOWER(os), 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(os_version, 'unknown') AS os_version, COALESCE(idfa, 'unknown') AS idfa, COALESCE(idfv, 'unknown') AS idfv, COALESCE(android_id, 'unknown') AS android_id, COALESCE(imei, 'unknown') AS imei, COALESCE(build_serial, 'unknown') AS build_serial, COALESCE(mac, 'unknown') AS mac, COALESCE(gps_adid, 'unknown') AS gps_adid, COALESCE(gps_asid, 'unknown') AS gps_asid, COALESCE(oaid, 'unknown') AS oaid, COALESCE(model, 'unknown') AS model, COALESCE(client_version, 'unknown') AS client_version, COALESCE(did, 'unknown') AS did, stage_id, app_id FROM event_log WHERE row_num = 1 DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_solar_core_account_di.mla
sql_units: /* Solar驾驶舱 MLA部分 */ /* 获取创号信息 */ WITH account_create AS (SELECT appid, first_mt_country, account_register_date, accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-06', '2022-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mla'), basic_info AS (SELECT roleid AS rid, zoneid AS zid, first_mt_country, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mla'), active_info_di /* 获取当天活跃用户的信息，主要为了获取当天登录时长login_duration */ AS (SELECT roleid AS rid, SUM(login_duration) AS day_login_duration FROM mt_dm.dm_mla_multi_behavior_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mla' AND is_active = 1 AND /* 排除测服数据 */ (zoneid DIV 1000) <> 9 GROUP BY roleid), active_info /* 获取历史活跃信息，取日、周、月活和登录时长等活跃信息 */ AS (SELECT 7042 AS app_id, first_mt_country, COUNT(IF(is_active = 1, 1, NULL)) AS dau, COUNT(IF(is_active_7d = 1, 1, NULL)) AS wau, COUNT(IF(is_active_30d = 1, 1, NULL)) AS mau, SUM(COALESCE(day_login_duration, 0)) AS duration_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, t1.first_mt_country, MAX(IF(SUBSTRING(last_active_time, 1, 10) = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_active, MAX(IF(SUBSTRING(last_active_time, 1, 10) >= '2026-05-25', 1, 0)) AS is_active_7d, MAX(IF(SUBSTRING(last_active_time, 1, 10) >= '2026-05-02', 1, 0)) AS is_active_30d FROM mt_dm.dm_mla_multi_behavior_role_zone_df AS t1 /* join account_create on t1.roleid = account_create.accountid */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* 最近30天活跃过的 */ (SUBSTRING(last_active_time, 1, 10) >= '2026-05-02' AND SUBSTRING(last_active_time, 1, 10) <= '2026-05-31') AND /* 排除测服数据 */ (zoneid DIV 1000) <> 9 GROUP BY roleid, t1.first_mt_country) AS multi_df LEFT JOIN active_info_di ON multi_df.roleid = active_info_di.rid GROUP BY first_mt_country), pay_info /* 获取支付信息，MLA不分没有汇率校准数据，因此校准后信息和校准前保持一致 */ /* first_mt_country从basic表取，可能存在role相同，zone不想同，且第一次某个role关联不到归因信息造成的first_mt_country赋予'unknown'的情况，此时该role+zone的支付算'unknown'国家 */ AS (SELECT t_behavior.first_mt_country /* 这里有可能不同国家有相同的roleid，大多情况是因为异常数据造成的（first_mt_country=unknown），但这种用户一般是少量的，依然归到unknown或者其后归因上的国家，不做去重 */, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31' AND SUBSTRING(last_pay_time, 1, 10) = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS paid_user_cnt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', charge_money, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-30', charge_money, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', charge_money, 0)) - SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2026-05-31', 'YY'), -1), charge_money, 0)) AS year_pay_amt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', charge_money, 0)) AS total_pay_amt, SUM(IF(NOT accountid IS NULL AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND account_register_date = '2026-05-25', charge_money, 0)) AS ltv7 FROM mt_dm.dm_mla_multi_behavior_role_zone_df AS t_behavior LEFT JOIN account_create ON t_behavior.roleid = account_create.accountid /* 去今天，昨天，去年最后一天日期用来做差值 */ WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', DATE_ADD(TRUNC('2026-05-31', 'YY'), -1), '2026-05-30') AND /* 排除测服数据 */ (zoneid DIV 1000) <> 9 GROUP BY t_behavior.first_mt_country), retention_info AS (SELECT 7042 AS app_id, first_mt_country, MAX(CASE WHEN account_register_date = '2026-05-31' THEN new_role_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS dnu, MAX(CASE WHEN account_register_date = '2026-05-30' THEN new_role_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS new_role_cnt_2d, MAX(CASE WHEN account_register_date = '2026-05-25' THEN new_role_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS new_role_cnt_7d, MAX(CASE WHEN account_register_date = '2026-05-18' THEN new_role_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS new_role_cnt_14d, MAX(CASE WHEN account_register_date = '2026-05-02' THEN new_role_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS new_role_cnt_30d, MAX(CASE WHEN account_register_date = '2026-05-30' THEN retention_role_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS retention_2d, MAX(CASE WHEN account_register_date = '2026-05-25' THEN retention_role_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS retention_7d, MAX(CASE WHEN account_register_date = '2026-05-18' THEN retention_role_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS retention_14d, MAX(CASE WHEN account_register_date = '2026-05-02' THEN retention_role_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS retention_30d FROM (SELECT first_mt_country, account_register_date, COUNT(1) AS new_role_cnt, COUNT(rid) AS retention_role_cnt FROM (SELECT rid, first_mt_country, account_register_date FROM active_info_di RIGHT JOIN account_create ON active_info_di.rid = account_create.accountid WHERE account_register_date IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-18', '2026-05-02')) AS t GROUP BY first_mt_country, account_register_date) AS t2 GROUP BY first_mt_country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_solar_core_account_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mla') SELECT 7042 AS app_id, 'mla' AS app_name, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '2019-02-28') + 1 AS obt_date /* 这里要先取pay_info 或者 active_info的country,理由同105行注释 */, COALESCE(pay_info.first_mt_country, active_info.first_mt_country, retention_info.first_mt_country) AS country_code, COALESCE(retention_info.dnu, 0) AS dnu, COALESCE(active_info.dau, 0) AS dau, COALESCE(active_info.wau, 0) AS wau, COALESCE(active_info.mau, 0) AS mau, COALESCE(pay_info.paid_user_cnt, 0) AS paid_user_cnt, 'USD' AS currency_type, COALESCE(pay_info.pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(pay_info.year_pay_amt, 0) AS year_pay_amt, COALESCE(pay_info.total_pay_amt, 0) AS total_pay_amt, COALESCE(pay_info.pay_amt, 0) AS pay_extra_amt, COALESCE(pay_info.year_pay_amt, 0) AS year_pay_extra_amt, COALESCE(pay_info.total_pay_amt, 0) AS total_pay_extra_amt, COALESCE(active_info.duration_cnt, 0) AS duration_cnt, COALESCE(retention_info.new_role_cnt_2d, 0) AS new_role_cnt_2d, COALESCE(retention_info.new_role_cnt_7d, 0) AS new_role_cnt_7d, COALESCE(retention_info.new_role_cnt_14d, 0) AS new_role_cnt_14d, COALESCE(retention_info.new_role_cnt_30d, 0) AS new_role_cnt_30d, COALESCE(retention_info.retention_2d, 0) AS new_retention_2d, COALESCE(retention_info.retention_7d, 0) AS new_retention_7d, COALESCE(retention_info.retention_14d, 0) AS new_retention_14d, COALESCE(retention_info.retention_30d, 0) AS new_retention_30d, COALESCE(ltv7, 0) AS ltv7 FROM retention_info FULL JOIN active_info ON retention_info.first_mt_country = active_info.first_mt_country FULL JOIN pay_info ON COALESCE(active_info.first_mt_country, retention_info.first_mt_country) = pay_info.first_mt_country

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_di_mlbb
sql_units: WITH tmp_accountcreate_di AS (/* 近30日创角+（login+charge）回补 */ SELECT a.accountid, a.device_id, a.register_time AS create_time, a.register_date AS create_date, a.os_type, a.gps_adid, a.android_id, a.idfa, a.idfv, a.channel, a.data_source AS source_pri FROM (SELECT * FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_create_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND register_date BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND '2026-05-31') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid FROM (/* 近30天归因数据 */ SELECT accountid, createymd, IF(adjust_network_name = '' OR adjust_network_name IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_network_name) AS network FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND appid = 'mlbb') /* 创号日期超过30天 或者 创号日期在30天内且network!='unknown'，这部分需要排除掉 */ WHERE (createymd <= '2026-05-01' OR network <> 'unknown') UNION ALL SELECT accountid FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-01' AND appid = 'mlbb') AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid WHERE b.accountid IS NULL), adjust_install AS (SELECT adjust_id, account_id, `time`, os_type, os_name, country, IF(network_name = '', NULL, network_name) AS network_name, IF(campaign_id = '', NULL, campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(campaign_name = '', NULL, campaign_name) AS campaign_name, IF(adgroup_id = '', NULL, adgroup_id) AS adgroup_id, IF(adgroup_name = '', NULL, adgroup_name) AS adgroup_name, IF(creative_id = '', NULL, creative_id) AS creative_id, IF(creative_name = '', NULL, creative_name) AS creative_name, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, adjust_rn, idfa_rn, idfv_rn, gps_rn, android_rn, account_rn FROM (SELECT ajid AS adjust_id, CAST(accountid AS STRING) AS account_id, IF(os_name = 'ios', 1, 2) AS os_type, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS `time`, os_name, IF(TRIM(country) IS NULL OR TRIM(country) = '', 'unknown', TRIM(country)) AS country, IF(LOWER(network_name) = 'organic', 'Organic', TRIM(network_name)) AS network_name, CASE WHEN is_fb = 1 THEN fb_campaign_id ELSE IF(campaign_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', campaign_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(campaign_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS campaign_id, CASE WHEN is_fb = 1 THEN fb_campaign_name ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN is_fb = 1 THEN fb_adgroup_id ELSE IF(adgroup_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', adgroup_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(adgroup_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS adgroup_id, CASE WHEN is_fb = 1 THEN fb_adgroup_name ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(adgroup_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS adgroup_name, CASE WHEN is_fb = 1 THEN fb_ad_id ELSE IF(creative_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', creative_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(creative_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS creative_id, CASE WHEN is_fb = 1 THEN fb_ad_name ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(creative_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) END AS creative_name, ia AS idfa, iv AS idfv, gpid AS gps_adid, andid AS android_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY adjust_id ORDER BY `time`) AS adjust_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY idfa ORDER BY `time`) AS idfa_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY idfv ORDER BY `time`) AS idfv_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gps_adid ORDER BY `time`) AS gps_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY android_id ORDER BY `time`) AS android_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY `time`) AS account_rn FROM (SELECT IF(NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.account_id') IS NULL AND TRIM(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.account_id')) <> '', TRIM(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.account_id')), NULL) AS accountid, FROM_UNIXTIME(BIGINT(msdk_server_time / 1000) - 8 * 60 * 60) AS `time` /* `time` */, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(adjust_id)) AS adjust_id, adjust_id AS ajid, os_name, country, IF(LOWER(network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer')), '') <> '', 1, 0) AS is_fb, IF(LOWER(network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer')), '') <> '', 'Facebook Installs', CASE WHEN logymd >= '2022-05-08' AND logymd <= '2022-05-16' AND NOT LOWER(network_name) IN ('organic', 'unattributed', 'untrusted devices', 'xiaomi preload 210629', 'zucks ad network-0915') AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.clicktime') IS NULL THEN 'organic' ELSE network_name END) AS network_name, IF(LOWER(network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer')), '') <> '', GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id'), NULL) AS fb_campaign_id, IF(LOWER(network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer')), '') <> '', GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name'), NULL) AS fb_campaign_name, IF(LOWER(network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer')), '') <> '', GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_id'), NULL) AS fb_adgroup_id, IF(LOWER(network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer')), '') <> '', GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_name'), NULL) AS fb_adgroup_name, IF(LOWER(network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer')), '') <> '', GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id'), NULL) AS fb_ad_id, IF(LOWER(network_name) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer')), '') <> '', GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name'), NULL) AS fb_ad_name, CASE WHEN logymd >= '2022-05-08' AND logymd <= '2022-05-16' AND NOT LOWER(network_name) IN ('organic', 'unattributed', 'untrusted devices', 'xiaomi preload 210629', 'zucks ad network-0915') AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.clicktime') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE campaign_name END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN logymd >= '2022-05-08' AND logymd <= '2022-05-16' AND NOT LOWER(network_name) IN ('organic', 'unattributed', 'untrusted devices', 'xiaomi preload 210629', 'zucks ad network-0915') AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.clicktime') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE adgroup_name END AS adgroup_name, CASE WHEN logymd >= '2022-05-08' AND logymd <= '2022-05-16' AND NOT LOWER(network_name) IN ('organic', 'unattributed', 'untrusted devices', 'xiaomi preload 210629', 'zucks ad network-0915') AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.clicktime') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE creative_name END AS creative_name, gps_adid AS gpid, android_id AS andid, idfa AS ia, idfv AS iv, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(gps_adid), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(gps_adid)) AS gps_adid, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(android_id), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(android_id)) AS android_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(idfa), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(idfa)) AS idfa, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(idfv), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(idfv)) AS idfv /* FROM    ml_ods.reportserver_adjust_install */ /* WHERE   logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' */ FROM msdk_ods.msdk_adjust WHERE logymd >= '20260502' AND logymd <= '20260531' AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') = 'install' AND msdk_app_id = '4040' /* MLBB */))), adjust_callback AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.adjust_id, `time`, IF(a.os_type = 1, 1, 2) AS os_type, IF(TRIM(country) IS NULL OR TRIM(country) = '' OR HEX(country) = 00, 'unknown', TRIM(country)) AS country, IF(LOWER(a.network_name) = 'organic', 'Organic', TRIM(a.network_name)) AS network_name, IF(a.campaign_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', a.campaign_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.campaign_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) AS campaign_id, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) AS campaign_name, IF(a.adgroup_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', a.adgroup_name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.adgroup_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) AS adgroup_id, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.adgroup_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) AS adgroup_name, IF(a.creative RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', a.creative, REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.creative, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) AS creative_id, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(a.creative, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)')) AS creative_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(google_adid), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(google_adid)) AS gps_adid, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(android_id), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(android_id)) AS android_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ios_idfa), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(ios_idfa)) AS idfa, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(idfv), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(idfv)) AS idfv, google_adid AS gpid, android_id AS andid, ios_idfa AS ia, idfv AS iv, a.report_type, a.report_type_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.adjust_id, a.roleid ORDER BY report_type_rn, `time`) AS rn FROM (SELECT roleid, adjust_adid AS adjust_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_adid), '') = '', CAST(CEIL(RAND() * 100000) AS STRING), TRIM(adjust_adid)) AS adjust_adid, os_type, country, network_name, campaign_name, adgroup_name, creative, google_adid, android_id, ios_idfa, idfv, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS `time`, report_type, CASE WHEN report_type = 'Attribution' THEN '1' WHEN report_type = 'Event' THEN '2' WHEN report_type = 'Session' THEN '3' ELSE CONCAT('4', '-', COALESCE(TRIM(report_type), 'zzzzz')) END AS report_type_rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_adjust_callback WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31') AS a) AS b WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') = '' OR rn = 1), tmp_adjust_join AS (SELECT roleid, adjust_id, `time`, network_name, country, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_id, adgroup_name, creative_id, creative_name, gpid AS gps_adid, andid AS android_id, ia AS idfa, iv AS idfv, report_type, report_type_rn, data_source, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY idfa ORDER BY IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') = '', 1, 0), report_type_rn, `time`) AS idfa_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY idfv ORDER BY IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') = '', 1, 0), report_type_rn, `time`) AS idfv_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gps_adid ORDER BY IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') = '', 1, 0), report_type_rn, `time`) AS gps_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY android_id ORDER BY IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') = '', 1, 0), report_type_rn, `time`) AS android_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') = '', 1, 0), report_type_rn, `time`) AS role_rn FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.adjust_id, a.`time`, a.os_type, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.network_name, a.network_name) AS network_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.country, a.country) AS country, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.campaign_id, a.campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.campaign_name, a.campaign_name) AS campaign_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.adgroup_id, a.adgroup_id) AS adgroup_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.adgroup_name, a.adgroup_name) AS adgroup_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.creative_id, a.creative_id) AS creative_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', b.creative_name, a.creative_name) AS creative_name, a.gps_adid, a.android_id, a.idfa, a.idfv, a.gpid, a.andid, a.ia, a.iv, a.report_type, a.report_type_rn, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(b.network_name), '') <> '', 'ic', 'c') AS data_source FROM adjust_callback AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT adjust_id, country, network_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_id, adgroup_name, creative_id, creative_name FROM adjust_install WHERE adjust_rn = 1 AND COALESCE(TRIM(adjust_id), '') <> '') AS b ON a.adjust_id = b.adjust_id) AS a), tmp_account_attribution_di AS (SELECT accountid, create_time, create_date, os_type, channel, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, IF(ds = 'i', ins_add_step, COALESCE(back_add_step, 'unknown')) AS add_step /* 为空代表install和callback都没归上 */, IF(ds = 'i', ins_country, COALESCE(back_country, 'unknown')) AS adjust_country, IF(ds = 'i', ins_network_name, COALESCE(back_network_name, 'unknown')) AS network_name, IF(ds = 'i', ins_campaign_id, COALESCE(back_campaign_id, 'unknown')) AS campaign_id, IF(ds = 'i', ins_campaign_name, COALESCE(back_campaign_name, 'unknown')) AS campaign_name, IF(ds = 'i', ins_adgroup_id, COALESCE(back_adgroup_id, 'unknown')) AS adgroup_id, IF(ds = 'i', ins_adgroup_name, COALESCE(back_adgroup_name, 'unknown')) AS adgroup_name, IF(ds = 'i', ins_creative_id, COALESCE(back_creative_id, 'unknown')) AS creative_id, IF(ds = 'i', ins_creative_name, COALESCE(back_creative_name, 'unknown')) AS creative_name, IF(ds = 'i', ins_adjust_id, COALESCE(back_adjust_id, 'unknown')) AS adjust_id, IF(ds = 'i', ins_time, COALESCE(back_time, 'unknown')) AS time, source_pri FROM (SELECT act.accountid, act.create_date, act.create_time, act.os_type, act.channel, act.idfa, act.idfv, act.gps_adid, act.android_id, IF(NOT (CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.network_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.network_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.network_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.network_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.network_name END) IS NULL, 'i', 'c') AS ds /* 用于判断install中匹配上的，network_name是否为空 */, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN 3 WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN 4 WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL AND act.os_type = 1 THEN 5 WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL AND act.os_type = 2 THEN 6 END AS ins_add_step /* install */, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.time WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.time WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.time WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.time WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.time END AS ins_time, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.country WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.country WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.country WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.country WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.country END AS ins_country, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.network_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.network_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.network_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.network_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.network_name END AS ins_network_name, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.campaign_id WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.campaign_id WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.campaign_id WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.campaign_id WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.campaign_id END AS ins_campaign_id, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.campaign_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.campaign_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.campaign_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.campaign_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.campaign_name END AS ins_campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.adgroup_id WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.adgroup_id WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.adgroup_id WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.adgroup_id WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.adgroup_id END AS ins_adgroup_id, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.adgroup_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.adgroup_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.adgroup_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.adgroup_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.adgroup_name END AS ins_adgroup_name, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.creative_id WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.creative_id WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.creative_id WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.creative_id WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.creative_id END AS ins_creative_id, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.creative_name WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.creative_name WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.creative_name WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.creative_name WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.creative_name END AS ins_creative_name, CASE WHEN NOT fa.idfa IS NULL THEN fa.adjust_id WHEN NOT fv.idfv IS NULL THEN fv.adjust_id WHEN NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN gps.adjust_id WHEN NOT andid.android_id IS NULL THEN andid.adjust_id WHEN NOT acc.account_id IS NULL THEN acc.adjust_id END AS ins_adjust_id, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN 7 WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN 8 WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN 9 WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN 10 WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL AND act.os_type = 1 THEN 11 WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL AND act.os_type = 2 THEN 12 END AS back_add_step /* -callback */, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.time WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.time WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.time WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.time WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.time END AS back_time, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.country WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.country WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.country WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.country WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.country END AS back_country, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.network_name WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.network_name WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.network_name WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.network_name WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.network_name END AS back_network_name, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.campaign_id WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.campaign_id WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.campaign_id WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.campaign_id WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.campaign_id END AS back_campaign_id, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.campaign_name WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.campaign_name WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.campaign_name WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.campaign_name WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.campaign_name END AS back_campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.adgroup_id WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.adgroup_id WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.adgroup_id WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.adgroup_id WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.adgroup_id END AS back_adgroup_id, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.adgroup_name WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.adgroup_name WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.adgroup_name WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.adgroup_name WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.adgroup_name END AS back_adgroup_name, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.creative_id WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.creative_id WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.creative_id WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.creative_id WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.creative_id END AS back_creative_id, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.creative_name WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.creative_name WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.creative_name WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.creative_name WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.creative_name END AS back_creative_name, CASE WHEN NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL THEN ajfa.adjust_id WHEN NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL THEN ajfv.adjust_id WHEN NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL THEN ajgps.adjust_id WHEN NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL THEN ajandid.adjust_id WHEN NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL THEN ajacc.adjust_id END AS back_adjust_id, act.source_pri FROM tmp_accountcreate_di AS act /* adjust_install/ios/idfa  --step1 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install AS fa ON act.idfa = fa.idfa AND fa.idfa_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 1 /* ios */ AND NOT act.idfa IS NULL AND TRIM(fa.idfa) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fa.idfa)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fa.idfa)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fa.idfa)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(fa.idfa) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(fa.idfa) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* adjust_install/ios/idfv --step2 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install AS fv ON act.idfv = fv.idfv AND fv.idfv_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 1 /* ios */ AND NOT fv.idfv IS NULL AND TRIM(fv.idfv) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fv.idfv)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fv.idfv)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(fv.idfv)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(fv.idfv) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* adjust_install/android/gps_adid --step3 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install AS gps ON act.gps_adid = gps.gps_adid AND gps.gps_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 2 /* and */ AND NOT gps.gps_adid IS NULL AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(gps.gps_adid)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(gps.gps_adid)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(gps.gps_adid)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '0000-0000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(gps.gps_adid) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* adjust_install/android/gps_adid --step4 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install AS andid ON act.android_id = andid.android_id AND andid.android_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 2 /* and */ AND NOT andid.android_id IS NULL AND TRIM(andid.android_id) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(andid.android_id)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(andid.android_id)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(andid.android_id)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(andid.android_id) <> '0000000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(andid.android_id) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* adjust_install/ios/account_id --step5 */ /* adjust_install/android/account_id --step6 */ LEFT JOIN adjust_install AS acc ON act.os_type IN (1, 2) AND act.accountid = acc.account_id AND acc.account_rn = 1 AND NOT acc.account_id IS NULL AND TRIM(acc.account_id) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(acc.account_id)) <> 'none' AND LOWER(TRIM(acc.account_id)) <> 'null' AND LOWER(TRIM(acc.account_id)) <> 'unknown' /* callback/ios/idfa  --step7 */ LEFT JOIN tmp_adjust_join AS ajfa ON act.idfa = ajfa.idfa AND ajfa.idfa_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 1 /* ios */ AND NOT ajfa.idfa IS NULL AND TRIM(ajfa.idfa) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfa.idfa)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfa.idfa)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfa.idfa)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(ajfa.idfa) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajfa.idfa) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* callback/ios/idfv  --step8 */ LEFT JOIN tmp_adjust_join AS ajfv ON act.idfv = ajfv.idfv AND ajfv.idfv_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 1 /* ios */ AND NOT ajfv.idfv IS NULL AND TRIM(ajfv.idfv) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfv.idfv)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfv.idfv)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajfv.idfv)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(ajfv.idfv) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* callback/android/gps_adid  --step9 */ LEFT JOIN tmp_adjust_join AS ajgps ON act.gps_adid = ajgps.gps_adid AND ajgps.gps_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 2 /* and */ AND NOT ajgps.gps_adid IS NULL AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '0000-0000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajgps.gps_adid) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* callback/android/android_id  --step10 */ LEFT JOIN tmp_adjust_join AS ajandid ON act.android_id = ajandid.android_id AND ajandid.android_rn = 1 AND act.os_type = 2 /* and */ AND NOT ajandid.android_id IS NULL AND TRIM(ajandid.android_id) <> '' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajandid.android_id)) <> 'none' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajandid.android_id)) <> 'null' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND LOWER(TRIM(ajandid.android_id)) <> 'unknown' /* 修改，增加lower处理 */ AND TRIM(ajandid.android_id) <> '0000000000000000' /* 新增 */ AND TRIM(ajandid.android_id) <> '0' /* 新增 */ /* callback/ios/accountid  --step11 */ /* callback/android/accountid  --step12 */ LEFT JOIN tmp_adjust_join AS ajacc ON act.os_type IN (1, 2) AND act.accountid = ajacc.roleid AND ajacc.role_rn = 1 AND NOT ajacc.roleid IS NULL AND TRIM(ajacc.roleid) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(ajacc.roleid)) <> 'none' AND LOWER(TRIM(ajacc.roleid)) <> 'null' AND LOWER(TRIM(ajacc.roleid)) <> 'unknown')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(target_table)) SELECT accountid, TIME, os_type, gps_adid, idfa, android_id, adjust_id, adjust_country, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(network_name), '') = '' OR network_name IS NULL, 'unknown', network_name) AS adjust_network_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_name), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', campaign_name) AS adjust_campaign_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_id), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', campaign_id) AS adjust_campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adgroup_name), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', adgroup_name) AS asadjust_adset_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adgroup_id), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', adgroup_id) AS adjust_adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(creative_name), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', creative_name) AS adjust_creative_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(creative_id), '') = '' OR campaign_id IS NULL, 'unknown', creative_id) AS adjust_creative_id, channel AS game_channel, create_date AS createymd, add_step, idfv, source_pri, 'mlbb' AS appid, IF(create_date >= SUBSTRING(time, 1, 10), create_date, SUBSTRING(time, 1, 10)) AS logymd FROM tmp_account_attribution_di WHERE add_step <> 'unknown' /* 新增归因上的数据 */ UNION ALL /* 历史30天内归因上的数据 */ SELECT accountid, TIME, os_type, gps_adid, idfa, android_id, adjust_id, adjust_country, network AS adjust_network_name, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, createymd, add_step, idfv /* 上线需更改 */, data_source, 'mlbb' AS appid, logymd FROM (SELECT *, IF(adjust_network_name = '' OR adjust_network_name IS NULL, 'unknown', adjust_network_name) AS network FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_di WHERE appid = 'mlbb' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-05-02') WHERE (createymd <= '2026-05-01' OR network <> 'unknown') /* 归因日期30天内，创号日期大于30天的，或者 归因日期30天内，已经归因上的 */

first_unity_version, last_unity_version, last_active_client_real_ver FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS act FULL JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os, appid, device, ip_country /* ,os_type             */, MIN(day_first_pay_time) AS day_first_pay_time, MAX(day_last_pay_time) AS day_last_pay_time, SUM(day_pay_amount) AS day_pay_amount, SUM(day_pay_cnt) AS day_pay_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, os, appid, device, ip_country HAVING SUM(day_pay_cnt) > 0) AS pay ON act.roleid = pay.roleid AND act.zoneid = pay.zoneid AND /* and act.os_type=pay.os_type */ act.os = pay.os AND act.appid = pay.appid AND act.device = pay.device AND act.ip_country = pay.ip_country FULL JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, create_country, create_device, create_os, create_ip, create_channel, create_sex, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31') AND register_date = '2026-05-31') AS basic ON COALESCE(act.roleid, pay.roleid) = basic.roleid AND COALESCE(act.zoneid, pay.zoneid) = basic.zoneid AND COALESCE(act.appid, pay.appid) = basic.appid AND COALESCE(act.os, pay.os) = basic.create_os AND COALESCE(act.device, pay.device) = basic.create_device AND COALESCE(act.ip_country, pay.ip_country) = basic.create_country LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date /*    ,create_country */ /*    ,create_device */ /*    ,create_os */, create_ip, create_channel, create_sex, is_bind, is_mini, is_emulator, is_pure, new_type, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31')) AS reg ON COALESCE(act.roleid, pay.roleid, basic.roleid) = reg.roleid AND COALESCE(act.zoneid, pay.zoneid, basic.zoneid) = reg.zoneid AND COALESCE(act.appid, pay.appid, basic.appid) = reg.appid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, account_register_date, os_country, area_id, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-08',
