name: etl.msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm{{DWH_ENV}}.dwm_pay_role_zone_di PARTITION (logymd='2026-05-31', app_id) */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_dwm{{DWH_ENV}}.dwm_pay_role_zone_di ( */ /*     roleid                        STRING COMMENT '角色ID, key', */ /*     zoneid                        STRING COMMENT '角色区服ID, key', */ /*     package_name                  STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名, key', */ /*     os                            STRING COMMENT '操作系统, key', */ /*     day_first_account_id          STRING COMMENT '当天首次账号ID，游戏内全服唯一ID, 首次', */ /*     day_last_account_id           STRING COMMENT '当天末次账号ID，游戏内全服唯一ID, 末次', */ /*     day_first_did                 STRING COMMENT '设备指纹, 首次', */ /*     day_last_did                  STRING COMMENT '设备指纹, 末次', */ /*     day_first_model               STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 首次', */ /*     day_last_model                STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 末次',  */ /*     day_first_os_version          STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本,首次', */ /*     day_last_os_version           STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本, 末次', */ /*     day_first_client_version      STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 首次', */ /*     day_last_client_version       STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 末次', */ /*     day_first_pay_time            STRING COMMENT '当天首次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     day_last_pay_time             STRING COMMENT '当天末次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     day_pay_cnt                   BIGINT COMMENT '当天累计付费次数', */ /*     day_pay_sum                   BIGINT COMMENT '当天累计付费金额（美分）' */ /* ) COMMENT '设备付费行为增量表格' PARTITIONED BY ( logymd STRING COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', app_id INT COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key' ) STORED AS PARQUET; */ WITH pay_event_succeed AS (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN app_id = 4500 THEN SUBSTRING(role_id, 0, 10) ELSE role_id END AS BIGINT) AS roleid, zone_id AS zoneid, app_id, package_name, os, account_id, did, model, os_version, client_version, event_time, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY role_id, zone_id, app_id, package_name, os ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY role_id, zone_id, app_id, package_name, os ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS rec_asc, IF(logymd <= '2024-10-17' AND app_id = 4280, 1, 0) AS is_delete FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('purchase_event', '__purchase_event__', '__purchase_deliver_event__') /* 投放重构充值接口__purchase_deliver_event__ 发货 __purchase_verify_event__ 校验 __purchase_refund_event__ 退款 */ AND /*   AND purchase_type = '1' --"支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test3. Promo4. Rewarded" */ purchase_type IN ('1', '3', '4') /* "支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test 3. Promo4. Rewarded" */ AND step = 'STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER' /* "表示支付流程到了第几步：校验STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_VERIFY发货STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER,暂时只有发货的步骤" */ AND result_code IN (22000, 13000) /* 未处理result_code: 21900 已处理 22000  订单参数异常 24900 服务器逻辑异常 25900 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.day_first_account_id, t1.day_last_account_id, t1.day_first_did, t1.day_last_did, t1.day_first_model, t1.day_last_model, t1.day_first_os_version, t1.day_last_os_version, t1.day_first_client_version, t1.day_last_client_version, t1.day_first_pay_time, t1.day_last_pay_time, t2.pay_cnt, t2.pay_sum, t1.app_id AS app_id FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, app_id, package_name, os, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, account_id, NULL)) AS day_first_account_id, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, account_id, NULL)) AS day_last_account_id, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, did, NULL)) AS day_first_did, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, did, NULL)) AS day_last_did, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_first_model, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_last_model, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_first_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_last_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_first_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_last_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), NULL)) AS day_first_pay_time, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), NULL)) AS day_last_pay_time FROM pay_event_succeed WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, app_id, os, package_name, os) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, app_id, package_name, os, COUNT(1) AS pay_cnt, SUM(price) AS pay_sum FROM pay_event_succeed GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, app_id, package_name, os) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.os = t2.os

sql_units: WITH charge AS (SELECT chg.roleid, chg.zoneid, chg.`time`, chg.`money`, IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-04-30', pro.product_type, chg.product_type) AS product_type FROM (SELECT * FROM mh_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND `money` > 0) AS chg LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, product_subid, product_name, product_type FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_product_type_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_product_type_df)) AS pro ON chg.product_id = pro.product_id AND chg.product_subid = pro.product_subid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_mla_pay_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mla') SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(day_first_pay_time) AS day_first_pay_time, MAX(day_last_pay_time) AS day_last_pay_time, SUM(charge_cnt) AS charge_cnt, SUM(charge_money) AS charge_money, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', product_type_1, charge_money))), ',', ':') AS product_type_amt_map FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(product_type = '' OR product_type IS NULL, 'unknown', product_type) AS product_type_1 /* '其他'大类,代表一种付费类型，保留 */, MIN(`time`) AS day_first_pay_time, MAX(`time`) AS day_last_pay_time, COUNT(1) AS charge_cnt, SUM(money) AS charge_money FROM charge GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, product_type_1) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid

first_rankstar_30d */, COALESCE(b.last_rankstar_30d, -99999) AS last_rankstar_30d, 'mlbb' AS appid FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_behavior_role_zone_di AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT appid, roleid, zoneid, MIN(IF(drn = 1, last_rank_id, NULL)) AS last_rank_id_30d /* min(if(rn=1,first_rank_id,null)) as first_rank_id_30d, */, MIN(IF(drn = 1, last_minranklvl, NULL)) AS last_minranklvl_30d /* min(if(rn=1,first_minranklvl,null)) as first_minranklvl_30d, */, MIN(IF(drn = 1, last_bigranklvl, NULL)) AS last_bigranklvl_30d /* min(if(rn=1,first_bigranklvl,null)) as first_bigranklvl_30d, */, MIN(IF(drn = 1, last_rankstar, NULL)) AS last_rankstar_30d /* min(if(rn=1,first_rankstar,null)) as first_rankstar_30d, */ FROM (SELECT roleid, appid, zoneid, last_rank_id /* first_rank_id, */, last_minranklvl /* first_minranklvl, */, last_bigranklvl /* first_bigranklvl, */, last_rankstar /* first_rankstar, */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY last_rank_change_time DESC) AS drn /* row_number() over(PARTITION BY roleid,zoneid order by first_rank_change_time) rn, */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND pvptype = 2) AS a GROUP BY appid, roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.appid = b.appid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-02' AND /* and register_date='2026-05-02' */ a.appid = 'mlbb' AND is_new = 1 DISTRIBUTE BY ABS(HASH(a.roleid, a.zoneid)) % 2

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df.mlbb
sql_units: /* CREATE  TEMPORARY function geoip AS 'com.moonton.spark.hive.GeoUDF' USING   jar 'hdfs://vpc-minibase/dp/dorado/udf/100000087/100000087.jar'; */ WITH user_di AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.logymd, a.appid, a.deviceid, a.os_type, a.device_name, CASE WHEN a.os_type = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN a.os_type = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN a.os_type = 3 THEN 'emulator' ELSE 'unknown' END AS os, LOWER(b.country_code) AS os_country, a.`time` FROM (SELECT aa.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY appid, aa.accountid ORDER BY `time`, COALESCE(country, 'unknown')) AS rn /* 增加country排序，保证非随机获取，避免回溯数据变化 */ FROM (SELECT accountid, logymd, 'mlbb' AS appid, TRIM(account_name) AS deviceid, COALESCE(TRIM(device_name), 'unknown') AS device_name, os_type, LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('', '-'), NULL, TRIM(country))) AS country, `time` FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create AS a WHERE logymd = /* 2025-11-30号前取账号ods表，日期之后取回补后的新表mt_dwd.dwd_account_create_df数据 */ IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-11-30', '2026-05-31', '9999-12-31') UNION ALL SELECT accountid, logymd, 'mlbb' AS appid, TRIM(device_id) AS deviceid, NULL AS device_name, os_type, LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('', '-'), NULL, TRIM(country))) AS country, register_time AS `time` FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_create_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' >= '2025-12-01', '2026-05-31', '9999-12-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND register_date = '2026-05-31') AS aa LEFT JOIN (/* 剔除异常账号的创角 */ SELECT accountid /* 异常账号 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_abnormal_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-10-20', '2025-10-20', '2026-05-31') AND create_date = '2026-05-31') AS bb ON aa.accountid = bb.accountid WHERE bb.accountid IS NULL) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.config_country) AS b ON a.country = b.country_code WHERE a.rn = 1), bind AS (SELECT accountid AS aid, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_bind_account_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY accountid, logymd), role_di AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'mlbb' AS appid, roleid, create_ip AS client_ip, create_country AS ip_country, register_date AS role_register_date, COALESCE(create_device, 'unknown') AS create_device, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY register_time, zoneid) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_create_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND role_rank = 1) WHERE rn = 1 /* 只要在当日创建的首个角色 */ AND role_register_date = '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_attr_mlbb_hdfs PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* ,user_df as ( */ SELECT accountid, account_register_time /* appid, */, account_register_date, his_first_deviceid, role_register_date, first_create_ip, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, os_country, first_ip_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, os_type, os, ad_os, attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, create_device, role_create_device, IF(account_register_date = role_register_date, first_ip_country, NULL) AS account_role_ip_country /* 只取账号创建日期=账号首次创角日期的first_ip_country，保证多次回溯时国家不变，背景：https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/doxcnDtbME4gjQ4XlzzTEuJVRFe#doxcnaawWuQgUO0kosvOLAztOUf */, IF(NOT os_country IN ('us', 'gb'), os_country, NULL) AS mt_os_country /* 当os_country用户为us和gb时，mt_country不参考该字段的归因，直接进入第三优先级:ip来判定，背景：https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/doxcnDtbME4gjQ4XlzzTEuJVRFe#doxcnaawWuQgUO0kosvOLAztOUf */, CASE WHEN is_pure = 1 THEN 1 /* 已经判定为纯净新增账号，则不需在处理，保证不变 */ WHEN is_pure = 0 AND NOT role_register_date IN ('1970-01-01', '2026-05-31') THEN 0 /* 0有2种情况，历史有过创角且判定为非纯净新增&历史没有创过角没法明确的，对于已经判定为非纯净新增的，仍保持不变，记作0 */ WHEN is_pure = 0 AND role_register_date = '2026-05-31' /* 对于没有创过角没法明确的，那么如果在当天创角，且满足以下条件，则判定为纯净新增 */ AND COALESCE(role_create_device, 'unknown') NOT LIKE '%x86%' /* 非模拟器 */ AND COALESCE(role_create_device, 'unknown') NOT LIKE '%virtual machine%' AND COALESCE(role_create_device, 'unknown') NOT LIKE '%Tencent%' AND COALESCE(role_create_device, 'unknown') NOT LIKE '%VMH%' AND account_register_date <= role_register_date /* 创号需要在创角之前，如果有反过来的数据，判定为非纯净新增 */ AND bind.aid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 /* 对于当日仍旧没有创过角的，记作0，表示没法明确 */ END AS is_pure FROM (SELECT COALESCE(di.accountid, df.accountid) AS accountid, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.account_register_date ELSE di.logymd END AS account_register_date /* coalesce(di.appid,df.appid) as appid, */, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.account_register_time ELSE di.`time` END AS account_register_time, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.his_first_deviceid ELSE di.deviceid END AS his_first_deviceid, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.os_country ELSE di.os_country END AS os_country, COALESCE(df.role_register_date, role_di.role_register_date, '1970-01-01') AS role_register_date, CASE WHEN NOT df.role_register_date IS NULL THEN df.first_create_ip ELSE role_di.client_ip END AS first_create_ip, CASE WHEN NOT df.role_register_date IS NULL THEN df.first_ip_country ELSE role_di.ip_country END AS first_ip_country, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.os_type ELSE di.os_type END AS os_type, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.os ELSE di.os END AS os, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, ad_os, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.create_device ELSE di.device_name END AS create_device, CASE WHEN NOT df.role_register_date IS NULL THEN df.role_create_device ELSE role_di.create_device END AS role_create_device, COALESCE(df.is_pure, 0) AS is_pure FROM user_di AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT accountid, account_register_date /* appid, */, account_register_time, his_first_deviceid, IF(os_country = 'unknown', NULL, os_country) AS os_country, os_type, os, IF(role_register_date = '1970-01-01', NULL, role_register_date) AS role_register_date, first_create_ip, IF(first_ip_country = 'unknown', NULL, first_ip_country) AS first_ip_country, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, ad_os, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, create_device, role_create_device, is_pure FROM mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb') AS df ON di.accountid = df.accountid /*  and di.appid = df.appid */ LEFT JOIN role_di ON COALESCE(di.accountid, df.accountid) = role_di.roleid) AS a LEFT JOIN bind ON a.accountid = bind.aid AND a.role_register_date = bind.logymd /* 账号对应首次创角时，存在切换账号行为，因为切换账号必须要在创角后才可进行 */ /* ) */

WITH adv AS (SELECT appid, accountid, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, ad_os, NULL) AS ad_os, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, attr_logymd, NULL) AS attr_logymd, IF(logymd = attr_logymd, adjust_country, NULL) AS first_ad_country, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_country, NULL) AS last_ad_country, IF(logymd = attr_logymd, adjust_network_name, NULL) AS first_network_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_network_name, NULL) AS last_network_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, NULL) AS adjust_campaign_id, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_name, NULL) AS adjust_campaign_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_adset_name, NULL) AS adjust_adset_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_adset_id, NULL) AS adjust_adset_id, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_creative_name, NULL) AS adjust_creative_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_creative_id, NULL) AS adjust_creative_id, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, game_channel, NULL) AS game_channel FROM (SELECT appid, accountid, logymd, attr_logymd, os_type AS ad_os, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, LOWER(IF(TRIM(adjust_country) IN ('-', ''), NULL, TRIM(adjust_country))) AS adjust_country, LOWER(IF(TRIM(adjust_network_name) IN ('-', ''), NULL, TRIM(adjust_network_name))) AS adjust_network_name FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND appid = 'mlbb') AS a), config AS (SELECT country, MAX(area) AS area FROM mt_dwd.config_country_area GROUP BY country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT accountid, account_register_time, account_register_date, TRIM(his_first_deviceid) AS his_first_deviceid, role_register_date, first_create_ip, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, os_country, first_ip_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, os_type, os, COALESCE(ad_os, -99999) AS ad_os, attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, config.area AS area_id, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, create_device, role_create_device, is_pure FROM (SELECT a.accountid, a.account_register_time, a.account_register_date, a.his_first_deviceid, a.role_register_date, a.first_create_ip, COALESCE(a.first_ad_country, adv.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(adv.last_ad_country, 'unknown') AS last_ad_country, COALESCE(a.os_country, 'unknown') AS os_country, COALESCE(a.first_ip_country, 'unknown') AS first_ip_country, COALESCE(a.first_mt_country, adv.first_ad_country, a.mt_os_country, a.account_role_ip_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(adv.last_ad_country, a.mt_os_country, a.first_ip_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, COALESCE(a.first_network_name, adv.first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, COALESCE(adv.last_network_name, 'unknown') AS last_network_name, a.os_type, a.os, adv.ad_os, COALESCE(a.attr_logymd, adv.attr_logymd) AS attr_logymd, adv.adjust_campaign_id, adv.adjust_campaign_name, adv.adjust_adset_name, adv.adjust_adset_id, adv.adjust_creative_name, adv.adjust_creative_id, adv.game_channel, a.create_device, COALESCE(a.role_create_device, 'unknown') AS role_create_device, a.is_pure /* a.appid */ FROM (SELECT * FROM bi_test.dim_attr_mlbb_hdfs WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* from user_df */ account_register_date >= '2026-05-02' /* 归因更新近30天创号的，这里也是更新近30天创号 */ AND account_register_date <= '2026-05-31') AS a LEFT JOIN adv ON a.accountid = adv.accountid UNION ALL SELECT accountid, account_register_time, account_register_date, his_first_deviceid, role_register_date, first_create_ip, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, COALESCE(os_country, 'unknown') AS his_first_active_time, his_first_deviceid, his_first_os_language, his_first_os_version, his_first_loginclient_version, is_first_create, is_bind, is_mini, is_pure, CASE WHEN is_his_create = 1 THEN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_time, register_date, create_os, create_country, create_device, create_channel, create_ip, create_sex, data_source, CASE WHEN mini_accountid IS NULL AND is_emulator = 1 = 1 THEN -99999 WHEN is_his_create <> 1 AND NOT mini_accountid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_mini, CASE WHEN is_his_create = 1 THEN -99999 WHEN is_his_create <> 1 AND mini_accountid IS NULL AND (is_first_create <> 1 OR COALESCE(is_pure, 0) <> 1) AND NOT bind_accountid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_bind, CASE WHEN is_his_create = 1 THEN -99999 WHEN is_his_create <> 1 AND mini_accountid IS NULL AND is_emulator = 0 AND (is_first_create <> 1 OR COALESCE(is_pure, 0) <> 1) AND bind_accountid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_small, is_his_create FROM (SELECT new.roleid, new.zoneid, new.register_time, new.register_date, new.create_os, new.create_country, new.create_device, new.create_channel, new.create_ip, new.create_sex, new.data_source, new.is_ai, new.is_emulator, END AS is_first_create, new.is_his_create, mini.accountid AS mini_accountid, attr.is_pure, bind.accountid AS bind_accountid FROM (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_create_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS new LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df /* bi_test.dim_basic_hdfs */ /* bi_test.dim_basic_role_zone_df */ WHERE is_first_create = 1 AND logymd = '2026-05-30') AS his ON new.roleid = his.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_bind_account_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY accountid) AS bind ON new.roleid = bind.accountid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, new_zoneid FROM ml_ods.loginserver_login_mini_return WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, new_zoneid) AS mini ON new.roleid = mini.accountid AND new.zoneid = mini.new_zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, is_pure, a.account_register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df AS a WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.appid = 'mlbb') AS attr ON new.roleid = attr.accountid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df /* bi_test.dim_basic_hdfs */ /* bi_test.dim_basic_role_zone_df */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND data_source <> 'create') AS act ON new.roleid = act.roleid AND new.zoneid = act.zoneid WHERE act.roleid IS NULL /* 去除其他行为回补的创角信息 */) AS a) AS b

WITH attr_info AS (SELECT accountid, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, ad_os, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, account_register_time, account_register_date, os_country, area_id, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel FROM mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-06', '2022-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb'), active_info /* ,bind as ( */ /*     SELECT */ /*         accountid */ /*     FROM */ /*         mt_dim.dim_basic_bind_account_di */ /*     WHERE */ /*         logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /*         AND appid = 'mlbb' */ /*     GROUP BY */ /*         accountid */ /* ) */ /* ,mini as ( */ /*     SELECT */ /*         accountid */ /*     FROM */ /*         ml_ods.loginserver_login_mini_return */ /*     WHERE */ /*         logymd <= '2026-05-31' */ /*     GROUP BY */ /*         accountid */ /* ), */ AS (/* 当天首次活跃数据 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, is_ai, day_first_deviceid /* case when is_ai=0 then 'ai_0' */ /*      when is_ai=1 then 'ai_2' */ /*      when is_ai=2 then 'ai_1' */ /* end is_ai, */, day_first_os_language, first_os_version, first_loginclient_version, day_first_active_time FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, is_ai, day_first_deviceid, day_first_os_language, first_os_version, first_loginclient_version, day_first_active_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY day_first_active_time, os, ip_country, device) AS row_id FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t WHERE row_id = 1), battle_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN MAX(fake_ai) = 'ai_2' THEN 1 WHEN MAX(fake_ai) = 'ai_1' THEN 2 WHEN MAX(fake_ai) = 'ai_0' THEN 0 END AS is_ai FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN logymd < '2021-04-01' THEN IF(channel IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test'), 'ai_1', 'ai_0') WHEN logymd >= '2021-04-01' AND fake_ai = 0 THEN 'ai_0' WHEN logymd >= '2021-04-01' AND fake_ai = 1 THEN 'ai_2' WHEN logymd >= '2021-04-01' AND fake_ai = 2 THEN 'ai_1' WHEN logymd >= '2021-04-01' AND NOT COALESCE(fake_ai, -1) IN (0, 1, 2) THEN IF(channel IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test'), 'ai_1', 'ai_0') END AS fake_ai, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY time DESC, battleresulttype) AS row_id FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT pvptype IS NULL) WHERE row_id = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_basic_role_zone_df PARTITION (logymd='2026-05-31', appid='mlbb') */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_time, register_date, create_os /* data_source, */, create_country, create_device, create_channel, create_ip, create_sex, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, ad_os, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, account_register_time, account_register_date, os_country, area_id, is_ai, is_first_create /* case when is_ai='ai_2' then 1 */ /*  when is_ai='ai_1' then 2 */ /*  when is_ai='ai_0' then 0 */ /* end AS is_ai, */, is_bind, is_mini, is_emulator, is_pure, new_type, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, his_first_active_time, his_first_deviceid, his_first_os_language, his_first_os_version, his_first_loginclient_version, data_source, is_small FROM (SELECT createrole.roleid, createrole.zoneid, createrole.register_time, createrole.register_date, createrole.data_source, createrole.create_os, createrole.create_country, createrole.create_device, createrole.create_channel, createrole.create_ip, createrole.create_sex, createrole.is_first_create, createrole.is_emulator, COALESCE(attr.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(attr.last_ad_country, 'unknown') AS last_ad_country, COALESCE(attr.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(attr.last_mt_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, COALESCE(attr.first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, COALESCE(attr.last_network_name, 'unknown') AS last_network_name, COALESCE(attr.ad_os, -99999) AS ad_os, attr.adjust_campaign_id AS adjust_campaign_id, attr.adjust_campaign_name AS adjust_campaign_name, attr.account_register_time AS account_register_time, attr.account_register_date AS account_register_date, COALESCE(attr.os_country, 'unknown') AS os_country, COALESCE(attr.area_id, 'unknown') AS area_id, is_bind, is_mini, is_pure, new_type, attr.adjust_adset_name, attr.adjust_adset_id, attr.adjust_creative_name, attr.adjust_creative_id, attr.game_channel, is_ai /* his_first_active_time, */ /* his_first_deviceid, */ /* his_first_os_language, */ /* his_first_os_version, */ /* his_first_loginclient_version, */ /* is_small */, his_first_active_time /* if(createrole.his_first_active_time is not null ,createrole.is_ai,nvl(act_info.is_ai,0)) as is_ai, */, his_first_deviceid, his_first_os_language, his_first_os_version, his_first_loginclient_version, createrole.is_small FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.register_time, a.register_date, a.create_os, a.create_country, a.create_device, a.create_channel, a.create_ip, a.create_sex, a.is_first_create, a.data_source, a.is_emulator, a.is_bind, a.is_mini, a.is_pure, a.new_type, CASE WHEN data_source = 'login' THEN a.is_ai WHEN data_source <> 'login' AND a.register_date <> '2026-05-31' THEN a.is_ai WHEN '2026-05-31' BETWEEN '2021-04-01' AND '2022-06-29' AND act_info.is_ai IS NULL AND a.create_channel IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test') THEN 2 ELSE COALESCE(act_info.is_ai, a.is_ai, 0) END AS is_ai /* coalesce(avtive_info.is_ai,0) AS is_ai, */, COALESCE(act_info.day_first_active_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS his_first_active_time, act_info.day_first_deviceid AS his_first_deviceid, act_info.day_first_os_language AS his_first_os_language, act_info.first_os_version AS his_first_os_version, act_info.first_loginclient_version AS his_first_loginclient_version, a.is_small FROM bi_test.dim_role_df_hdfs AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(act.roleid, bat.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(act.zoneid, bat.zoneid) AS zoneid, CASE WHEN '2026-05-31' < '2021-04-01' THEN 0 WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2021-04-01' AND '2026-05-31' <= '2022-06-29' THEN bat.is_ai WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2022-06-30' THEN COALESCE(bat.is_ai, act.is_ai) END AS is_ai, act.day_first_deviceid, act.day_first_os_language, act.first_os_version, act.first_loginclient_version, act.day_first_active_time FROM active_info AS act FULL JOIN battle_info AS bat ON act.roleid = bat.roleid AND act.zoneid = bat.zoneid) AS act_info ON a.roleid = act_info.roleid AND a.zoneid = act_info.zoneid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.his_first_active_time IS NULL /* is ai需要更新的范围，涵盖在his_first_active_time is null的范围 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_time, register_date, create_os, create_country, create_device, create_channel, create_ip, create_sex, is_first_create, data_source, is_emulator, is_bind, is_mini, is_pure, new_type, is_ai, his_first_active_time, his_first_deviceid, his_first_os_language, his_first_os_version, his_first_loginclient_version, is_small FROM bi_test.dim_role_df_hdfs AS a WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT a.his_first_active_time IS NULL) AS createrole LEFT JOIN attr_info AS attr ON createrole.roleid = attr.accountid) AS a

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_bi_parq_monitor
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_bi_parq_monitor PARTITION(appid, logymd) SELECT `key`, `file`, file_count, file_size, row_count, host, summary, upload_time, root_path, appid, new_logymd AS logymd FROM (SELECT `key`, `file`, file_count, file_size, row_count, host, summary, REPLACE(`time`, 'T', ' ') AS upload_time, `root` AS root_path, appid, IF(`root` IS NULL, SUBSTRING(`file`, LOCATE('logymd=', `file`) + 7, 10), SUBSTRING(`root`, LOCATE('logymd=', `root`) + 7, 10)) AS new_logymd FROM mt_ods.synclog_parq_ods WHERE logymd >= '20260530' AND logymd <= '20260601') AS t WHERE new_logymd = '2026-05-31' DISTRIBUTE BY 1

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH lose_active_info AS (/* roleid+zoneid粒度活跃数据 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN rank_id = 1 THEN os_type END) AS os_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rank_id = 1 THEN level END) AS level, MAX(CASE WHEN rank_id = 1 THEN his_last_ip END) AS his_last_ip, MAX(CASE WHEN rank_id = 1 THEN register_date END) AS register_date, MAX(first_ad_country) AS first_ad_country, MAX(last_ad_country) AS last_ad_country, MAX(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, MAX(last_mt_country) AS last_mt_country, MAX(first_network_name) AS first_network_name, MAX(last_network_name) AS last_network_name, MAX(area_id) AS area_id, BITMAP_MERGE(active_info) AS active_info FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, level, his_last_ip, register_date, active_info, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, area_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY his_last_active_time DESC, total_login_cnt DESC, day_login_cnt DESC, os, ip_country) AS rank_id FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_behavior_role_zone_df WHERE logymd /* 取前一天的数据，因为os_type、level、his_last_ip需要取流失时的状态，如果取2026-05-31则会导致这些字段的值为最新的状态 */ = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb') AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), active AS (/* 活跃位图中添加当天的数据 */ /* -因为lose_active_info取的2026-05-30,所以需要在位图上加上2026-05-31的数据 */ SELECT lose_active_info.roleid, lose_active_info.zoneid, lose_active_info.os_type, lose_active_info.level, lose_active_info.his_last_ip, lose_active_info.register_date, lose_active_info.first_ad_country, lose_active_info.last_ad_country, lose_active_info.first_mt_country, lose_active_info.last_mt_country, lose_active_info.first_network_name, lose_active_info.last_network_name, lose_active_info.area_id, COALESCE(LENGTH(TRANSLATE(lose_active_info.active_info, '0', '')), 0) + IF(NOT active_di.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS active_days, CASE WHEN NOT active_di.roleid IS NULL THEN CONCAT('1', active_info) ELSE CONCAT('0', active_info) END AS active_info /* 当天活跃则位图+1，当天不活跃则位图+0 */ FROM lose_active_info LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS active_di ON lose_active_info.roleid = active_di.roleid AND lose_active_info.zoneid = active_di.zoneid), lose_info AS (/* 目前还处于流失状态+当天回流的用户 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, level, his_last_ip, register_date, active_days, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, area_id, SPLIT(active_info, '[0]{7,}') AS lose_cnt_array /* 以全部为0且长度大于等于7的字符串分割字符串， */ /* --例如：active_info=100000000010000000101 则 lose_cnt_array=[1,1,101] */ /* --例如：active_info=00000000010000000101 则 lose_cnt_array=[,1,101] */, IF(SUBSTRING(lose_info, 0, 1) = '1', 1, 0) AS is_recurring, LENGTH(lose_info) AS lose_info_length FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, level, his_last_ip, register_date, active_days, active_info, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, area_id, REGEXP_EXTRACT(active_info, '((^[1][0]{7,}1)|(^[0]{6,}1))') AS lose_info /* 提取当天是流失状态或者回流的用户的位图数据 */ /* --当天回流的用户=(^[1][0]{7,}1) */ /* ----active_info=10000000011001，则 lose_info=1000000001 */ /* ----active_info=100011001，则 lose_info='' */ /* --当天是流失状态的用户=(^[0]{6,}1) */ /* ----active_info=00000000011001，则 lose_info=0000000001 */ /* ----active_info=000011001，则 lose_info='' */ FROM active) AS t WHERE LENGTH(lose_info) >= 8) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type AS lose_os_type, level AS lose_level, his_last_ip AS lose_last_ip, active_days, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', (lose_info_length - 1) * -1) AS lose_date /* 当天日期向天推N天得到流失日期 */ /* --如果用户是流失M天的流失用户，则N=M=lose_info_length - 1 */ /* --如果用户是流失M天的回流用户，则N=M+1=lose_info_length - 1 */, lose_info_length /* 如果用户是流失M天的流失用户，则M=lose_info_length - 1   -- -1是减去lose_info结尾的1，比如：lose_info=0000000001 */ /* --此时(2-if(is_recurring=1,0,1))=1 */ /* 如果用户是流失M天的回流用户，则M=lose_info_length - 2   -- -2是减去lose_info首尾的1，比如：lose_info=10000000001 */ /* --此时(2-if(is_recurring=1,0,1))=2 */ - (2 - IF(is_recurring = 1, 0, 1)) AS lose_days, SIZE(lose_cnt_array) /* lose_cnt_array是按照 连续7个0及以上的字符串 分割active_info的数组，所以流失次数=数组长度-1 */ /* --流失1次的时候  例如 active_info =00000000100001，则lose_cnt_array=['','100001'] */ /* --             例如 active_info =100000000100001，则lose_cnt_array=['1','100001'] */ /* --流失2次的时候  例如 active_info =000000000000001100000000100001，则lose_cnt_array=['','11','100001'] */ /* --             例如 active_info =1000000000000001100000000100001，则lose_cnt_array=['1','11','100001'] */ /* 表里的用户都是流失用户，所以不存在 size(lose_cnt_array) < 2的情况 */ - 1 AS lose_cnt, CASE WHEN is_recurring = 1 THEN '2026-05-31' END AS recurring_date /* 如果用户是回流用户则，recurring_date为当天，否则为null */, register_date, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, area_id FROM lose_info WHERE IF(is_recurring = 1, 0, 1) + lose_info_length - 2 <= 365 OR (is_recurring = 1 AND level > 5) /* 等级小于等于5的不算回流用户，因为小于等于五的都被算作回流新增了 */

sql_units: /* CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_dwd.dwd_msdk_appsflyer_di ( */ /*             server_time STRING COMMENT '日志时间，回调接口收到归因数据时间', */ /*             event_time STRING COMMENT '事件发生时间', */ /*             event_source STRING COMMENT '事件来源', */ /*             reporter_ip STRING COMMENT '上报IP', */ /*             msdk_store STRING COMMENT 'msdk的商店', */ /*             msdk_environment STRING COMMENT 'msdk的环境', */ /*             package_name STRING COMMENT 'msdk包名', */ /*             af_ad STRING COMMENT '广告名称', */ /*             af_ad_id STRING COMMENT '广告ID', */ /*             af_adset_id STRING COMMENT '广告组ID', */ /*             af_adset STRING COMMENT '广告组名称', */ /*             campaign STRING COMMENT '广告系列名称', */ /*             af_c_id STRING COMMENT '广告系列ID', */ /*             country_code STRING COMMENT '国家代码', */ /*             platform STRING COMMENT '设备系统', */ /*             media_source STRING COMMENT '获得归因的媒体渠道', */ /*             android_id STRING COMMENT 'android唯一ID', */ /*             advertising_id STRING COMMENT '用户可重置的设备ID,又称GAID', */ /*             idfa STRING COMMENT 'IOS设备上的可重置广告ID', */ /*             idfv STRING COMMENT 'IOS提供的应用开发者标识符', */ /*             appsflyer_id STRING COMMENT '用户在其设备上安装应用时，由SDK生成的非重ID', */ /*             oaid STRING COMMENT '一些安卓设备上的用户可重置ID，通常作为GAID的替代', */ /*             others STRING COMMENT 'JOSN字符串', */ /*             event_name STRING COMMENT '事件名称' */ /*         ) */ /* PARTITIONED BY */ /*         ( */ /*             logymd STRING COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', */ /*             msdk_app_id STRING COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key' */ /*         ); */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwd.dwd_msdk_appsflyer_di PARTITION(logymd, msdk_app_id) SELECT server_time, event_time, event_source, reporter_ip, msdk_store, msdk_environment, package_name, af_ad, af_ad_id, af_adset_id, af_adset, campaign, af_c_id, country_code, platform, media_source, IF(android_id IN ('', '0000000000000000'), NULL, android_id) AS android_id, IF(advertising_id IN ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', '0000-0000', 'none', '00000000-4000-8000-0000-000000000000'), NULL, advertising_id) AS advertising_id, IF(idfa IN ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', ''), NULL, idfa) AS idfa, IF(idfv IN (''), NULL, idfv) AS idfv, appsflyer_id, oaid, others, event_name, logymd, msdk_app_id FROM (SELECT msdk_server_time AS server_time, event_time, event_source, msdk_reporter_ip AS reporter_ip, msdk_store, msdk_environment, msdk_package_name AS package_name, af_ad, af_ad_id, af_adset_id, af_adset, campaign, af_c_id, LOWER(country_code) AS country_code, LOWER(platform) AS platform, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.media_source') AS media_source, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.android_id') AS android_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.advertising_id') AS advertising_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.idfa') AS idfa, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.idfv') AS idfv, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.appsflyer_id') AS appsflyer_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.oaid') AS oaid, others, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.event_name') AS event_name, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, msdk_app_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msdk_message_md5 ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS rn FROM msdk_ods.msdk_appsflyer WHERE logymd = '20260531') WHERE rn = 1 DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_third_party_account_df
sql_units:
/*
 需求文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/doxcn0rvqsNWKw1kqGts54a5sJL
 bind表相对于account来说会严重延后，比如账号611870956在2020-01-10创建，但在2022-06-12才在绑定表产生
 */ WITH bind1 AS (SELECT accountid AS mt_id, account_name AS bind_mt_name, account_phone, account_email, time, account_type FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_create_account WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31'), bind2 AS (SELECT accountid, account_name, CASE WHEN LOWER(account_name) RLIKE '^mt' THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(account_name, '.*_(\\d+)$') ELSE NULL END AS mt_id, phone, email, `time` FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_bind WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31'), mt_name_phone_email AS (SELECT mt_id, IF(bind_mt_name = '', NULL, bind_mt_name) AS bind_mt_name, IF(account_type = 'phone', IF(account_phone = '', NULL, account_phone), NULL) AS phone, IF(account_type = 'email', IF(account_email = '', NULL, account_email), NULL) AS email, time FROM bind1 UNION ALL SELECT accountid AS mt_id, NULL AS bind_mt_name, IF(account_phone = '', NULL, account_phone) AS phone, NULL AS email, `time` FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_bind_phone WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT accountid AS mt_id, NULL AS bind_mt_name, IF(new_phone = '', NULL, new_phone) AS phone, NULL AS email, `time` FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_rebind_phone WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT accountid AS mt_id, NULL AS bind_mt_name, NULL AS phone, IF(email = '', NULL, email) AS email, `time` FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_bind_email WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT accountid AS mt_id, NULL AS bind_mt_name, NULL AS phone, IF(new_email = '', NULL, new_email) AS email, `time` FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_rebind_email WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31'), mt_name_phone_email1 AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.mt_id, mt_name_phone_email.bind_mt_name, mt_name_phone_email.phone, mt_name_phone_email.email, a.time AS time1, mt_name_phone_email.time AS time2 FROM (SELECT accountid, mt_id, phone, email, time FROM bind2 WHERE NOT mt_id IS NULL) AS a LEFT JOIN mt_name_phone_email ON a.mt_id = mt_name_phone_email.mt_id), mt_name_phone_email2 AS (SELECT accountid, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_LIST(IF(rn0 = 1, mt_id, NULL))) AS mt_id, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_LIST(IF(rn1 = 1, bind_mt_name, NULL))) AS bind_mt_name, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_LIST(IF(rn2 = 1, phone, NULL))) AS bind_mt_phone, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_LIST(IF(rn3 = 1, email, NULL))) AS bind_mt_email FROM (SELECT accountid, mt_id, bind_mt_name, phone, email, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, mt_id ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn0, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, bind_mt_name ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, phone ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, email ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn3 FROM (SELECT accountid, mt_id, bind_mt_name, phone, email, IF(time1 >= time2, time1, time2) AS time FROM mt_name_phone_email1 GROUP BY accountid, mt_id, bind_mt_name, phone, email, time) AS a DISTRIBUTE BY accountid SORT BY time DESC) AS b GROUP BY accountid), bind_email AS (SELECT accountid, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_LIST(IF(rn2 = 1, bind_fb_email, NULL))) AS bind_fb_email, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_LIST(IF(rn3 = 1, bind_gp_email, NULL))) AS bind_gp_email, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_LIST(IF(rn4 = 1, bind_gc_email, NULL))) AS bind_gc_email, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_LIST(IF(rn5 = 1, bind_apple_email, NULL))) AS bind_apple_email, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_LIST(IF(rn6 = 1, bind_tiktok_email, NULL))) AS bind_tiktok_email, CONCAT_WS('\\073', COLLECT_LIST(IF(rn7 = 1, bind_vk_email, NULL))) AS bind_vk_email FROM (SELECT accountid, bind_fb_email, bind_gp_email, bind_gc_email, bind_apple_email, bind_tiktok_email, bind_vk_email, rn2, rn3, rn4, rn5, rn6, rn7 FROM (SELECT accountid, bind_fb_email /* bind_mt_email, */, bind_gp_email, bind_gc_email, bind_apple_email, bind_tiktok_email, bind_vk_email, time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, bind_fb_email ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn2 /* row_number() OVER( */ /*     PARTITION BY */ /*             accountid, */ /*             bind_mt_email */ /*     ORDER BY */ /*             time desc */ /* ) AS rn1, */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, bind_gp_email ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn3, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, bind_gc_email ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn4, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, bind_apple_email ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn5, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, bind_tiktok_email ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn6, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, bind_vk_email ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn7 FROM (SELECT accountid, CASE WHEN account_name RLIKE '^fb' AND email RLIKE '^\\w+.*@\\w+.*\\w+$' THEN email ELSE NULL END AS bind_fb_email /* CASE WHEN account_name REGEXP '^mt' AND email REGEXP '^\\w+.*@\\w+.*\\w+$' THEN email */ /*      ELSE NULL */ /* END AS bind_mt_email, */, CASE WHEN account_name RLIKE '^gg' AND email RLIKE '^\\w+.*@\\w+.*\\w+$' THEN email ELSE NULL END AS bind_gp_email, CASE WHEN account_name RLIKE '^gc' AND email RLIKE '^\\w+.*@\\w+.*\\w+$' THEN email ELSE NULL END AS bind_gc_email, CASE WHEN account_name RLIKE '^ap' AND email RLIKE '^\\w+.*@\\w+.*\\w+$' THEN email ELSE NULL END AS bind_apple_email, CASE WHEN account_name RLIKE '^tt' AND email RLIKE '^\\w+.*@\\w+.*\\w+$' THEN email ELSE NULL END AS bind_tiktok_email, CASE WHEN account_name RLIKE '^vk' AND email RLIKE '^\\w+.*@\\w+.*\\w+$' THEN email ELSE NULL END AS bind_vk_email, time FROM bind2) AS n) AS m DISTRIBUTE BY accountid SORT BY time DESC) AS t GROUP BY accountid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_third_party_account_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT COALESCE(mt_name_phone_email2.accountid, bind_email.accountid) AS roleid, CAST(mt_name_phone_email2.mt_id AS STRING) AS mt_id, mt_name_phone_email2.bind_mt_name, mt_name_phone_email2.bind_mt_phone, mt_name_phone_email2.bind_mt_email, bind_email.bind_fb_email, bind_email.bind_gp_email, bind_email.bind_gc_email, bind_email.bind_apple_email, bind_email.bind_tiktok_email, bind_email.bind_vk_email FROM mt_name_phone_email2 FULL JOIN bind_email ON mt_name_phone_email2.accountid = bind_email.accountid DISTRIBUTE BY roleid % 40

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_reattribution_adjust_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: irishuang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-06-17 16:32:51.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_dwd.dwd_reattribution_adjust_di( */ /*     time                     STRING               COMMENT '日志时间, 美西时间, 格式yyyy-MM-dd' */ /*    ,idfa                     STRING               COMMENT 'IOS设备的IDFA' */ /*    ,idfv                     STRING               COMMENT 'IOS设备的IDFV' */ /*    ,store                    STRING               COMMENT '商店' */ /*    ,adjust_network_name      STRING               COMMENT 'adjust广告渠道' */ /*    ,adjust_campaign_name     STRING               COMMENT 'adjust广告组名称' */ /*    ,adjust_campaign_id       STRING               COMMENT 'adjust广告组ID' */ /*    ,adjust_adgroup_name      STRING               COMMENT 'adjust广告计划名称' */ /*    ,adjust_adgroup_id        STRING               COMMENT 'adjust广告计划ID' */ /*    ,adjust_creative_name     STRING               COMMENT 'adjust广告创意名称' */ /*    ,adjust_creative_id       STRING               COMMENT 'adjust广告创意ID' */ /*    ,adjust_country           STRING               COMMENT 'adjust广告归因国家' */ /*    ,android_id               STRING               COMMENT '安卓设备的android_id' */ /*    ,gps_adid                 STRING               COMMENT '安卓设备的gps_adid' */ /*    ,mac_md5                  STRING               COMMENT 'mac地址' */ /*    ,adjust_id                STRING               COMMENT 'adjust回传唯一ID' */ /*    ,accountid                DECIMAL(20, 0)       COMMENT '账号id' */ /*    ,oaid                     STRING               COMMENT '中国安卓设备ID' */ /*    ,re_attr_source           STRING               COMMENT '回流归因表格来源,reattribution：表示数据来自reportserver_adjust_reattribution， reattribution_reinstall表示数据来自reportserver_adjust_reattribution_reinstall' */ /*    ,re_attr_priority         STRING               COMMENT '回流归因来源优先顺序,reattribution， 优先顺序为2, reattribution_reinstall， 优先顺序为1' */ /*    ,reattributed_at          STRING               COMMENT 'Adjust回流归因日期,美西时间, 格式yyyy-MM-dd' */ /* ) COMMENT 'Adjust回流归因合并增量表格' */ /* PARTITIONED BY */ /*         (appid STRING COMMENT '应用唯一ID', logymd STRING COMMENT '日志日期（yyyy-MM-dd' ) STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://mt-dwd/table/dwd_reattribution_adjust_di'; */ WITH adjust_logs AS (/* --MLBB Adjust 日志 */ SELECT 'mlbb' AS appid, 'reattribution' AS re_attr_source, '2' AS re_attr_priority, time, idfa, idfv, store, network_name, campaign_name, adgroup_name, creative_name, country, android_id, gps_adid, mac_md5, adjust_id, account_id, oaid, reattributed_at, fb_install_referrer, fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id AS fb_campaign_id, fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name AS fb_campaign_name, fb_install_referrer_campaign_id AS fb_adgroup_id, fb_install_referrer_campaign_id AS fb_adgroup_name, fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id AS fb_creative_id, fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name AS fb_creative_name FROM ml_ods.reportserver_adjust_reattribution WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT 'mlbb' AS appid, 'reattribution_reinstall' AS re_attr_source, '1' AS re_attr_priority, time, idfa, idfv, store, network_name, campaign_name, adgroup_name, creative_name, country, android_id, gps_adid, mac_md5, adjust_id, account_id, oaid, reattributed_at, fb_install_referrer, fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id AS fb_campaign_id, fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name AS fb_campaign_name, fb_install_referrer_campaign_id AS fb_adgroup_id, fb_install_referrer_campaign_id AS fb_adgroup_name, fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id AS fb_creative_id, fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name AS fb_creative_name FROM ml_ods.reportserver_adjust_reattribution_reinstall WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* --MLA Adjust 日志 */ UNION ALL SELECT 'mla' AS appid, 'reattribution' AS re_attr_source, '2' AS re_attr_priority, time, idfa, idfv, store, network_name, campaign_name, adgroup_name, creative_name, country, android_id, gps_adid, mac_md5, adjust_id, account_id, NULL AS oaid /* 表格不存在oaid 和 fb相关的column */, reattributed_at, NULL AS fb_install_referrer, NULL AS fb_campaign_id, NULL AS fb_campaign_name, NULL AS fb_adgroup_id, NULL AS fb_adgroup_name, NULL AS fb_creative_id, NULL AS fb_creative_name FROM mtbi_ods.trackserver_adjust_reattribution WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid IN ('mgame') /* -mtbi_ods这两个表格包括了其他以下项目的数据， mgame是mla早期名字 */ UNION ALL SELECT 'mla' AS appid, 'reattribution_reinstall' AS re_attr_source, '1' AS re_attr_priority, time, idfa, idfv, store, network_name, campaign_name, adgroup_name, creative_name, country, android_id, gps_adid, mac_md5, adjust_id, account_id, NULL AS oaid, reattributed_at, NULL AS fb_install_referrer, NULL AS fb_campaign_id, NULL AS fb_campaign_name, NULL AS fb_adgroup_id, NULL AS fb_adgroup_name, NULL AS fb_creative_id, NULL AS fb_creative_name FROM mtbi_ods.trackserver_adjust_reattribution_reinstall WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid IN ('mgame')), 7days_adjust_id AS (SELECT appid, adjust_id, re_attr_priority FROM mt_dwd.dwd_reattribution_adjust_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-24' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_reattribution_adjust_di PARTITION(appid, logymd) SELECT time, idfa, idfv, store, IF(network_name = 'Unattributed' AND NOT fb_install_referrer IS NULL, 'Facebook Installs', network_name) AS network_name /* 对于未被归因到渠道数据，而且FB相关信息不为空，需要特殊处理 */ /* campaign, adgroup, creative数据必须符合格式 .*?(\d+)才可以会解析出来正常的数值，否则直接抛弃数据解析数据（跟MLBB + MLA逻辑） */, IF(network_name = 'Unattributed' AND NOT fb_install_referrer IS NULL, fb_campaign_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(campaign_name, '(.*?)\\((\\d+)\\)'))) AS campaign_name, IF(network_name = 'Unattributed' AND NOT fb_install_referrer IS NULL, fb_campaign_id, REGEXP_EXTRACT(campaign_name, '.*?\\((\\d+)\\)')) AS campaign_id, IF(network_name = 'Unattributed' AND NOT fb_install_referrer IS NULL, fb_adgroup_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(adgroup_name, '(.*?)\\((\\d+)\\)'))) AS adgroup_name, IF(network_name = 'Unattributed' AND NOT fb_install_referrer IS NULL, fb_adgroup_id, REGEXP_EXTRACT(adgroup_name, '.*?\\((\\d+)\\)')) AS adgroup_id, IF(network_name = 'Unattributed' AND NOT fb_install_referrer IS NULL, fb_creative_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(creative_name, '(.*?)\\((\\d+)\\)'))) AS creative_name, IF(network_name = 'Unattributed' AND NOT fb_install_referrer IS NULL, fb_creative_id, REGEXP_EXTRACT(creative_name, '.*?\\((\\d+)\\)')) AS creative_id, LOWER(country) AS country, android_id, gps_adid, mac_md5, adjust_id, account_id, oaid, re_attr_source, re_attr_priority, reattributed_at, appid, '2026-05-31' AS logymd FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY appid, re_attr_priority, adjust_id ORDER BY time ASC) AS r_asc FROM adjust_logs) AS t1 WHERE r_asc = 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM 7days_adjust_id AS t2 WHERE t1.appid = t1.appid AND t1.adjust_id = t2.adjust_id AND t1.re_attr_priority = t2.re_attr_priority)

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_competition_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH competition_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_compguessing_bet WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_newguess WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid UNION SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_main_ui_click WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid UNION SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_race_live_popup WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_competition_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid) SELECT info.roleid, info.zoneid, COALESCE(compguessing.matches_prizes_cnt, 0) AS matches_prizes_cnt, COALESCE(compguessing.prizes_topic_cnt, 0) AS prizes_topic_cnt, COALESCE(newguess.matches_subscribe_races_cnt, 0) AS matches_subscribe_races_cnt, COALESCE(newguess.view_matchdata_cnt, 0) AS view_matchdata_cnt, COALESCE(newguess.view_teaminfo_cnt, 0) AS view_teaminfo_cnt, COALESCE(click.competition_interface_cnt, 0) AS competition_interface_cnt, COALESCE(popup.go_liveroom_cnt, 0) AS go_liveroom_cnt, 'mlbb' AS appid FROM competition_info AS info LEFT JOIN (/* 竞猜相关 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT guessing_id) AS matches_prizes_cnt /* 一场比赛可能有多道竞猜题 */, COUNT(question_id) AS prizes_topic_cnt /* question_id每场比赛从1开始自增 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_compguessing_bet WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS compguessing ON info.roleid = compguessing.roleid AND info.zoneid = compguessing.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 订阅 */ SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(changeList >= 201 AND changelist <= 209, changelist, NULL)) AS matches_subscribe_races_cnt, COUNT(IF(TabList = 3, 1, NULL)) AS view_matchdata_cnt, COUNT(IF(TabList = 2, 1, NULL)) AS view_teaminfo_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_newguess WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (TabList IN (2, 3) OR (changeList >= 201 AND changelist <= 209)) /* 201=M,202=MSC,203=PH,204=ID,205=MY,206=SG,207=KH,208=BR，209=MID */ GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS newguess ON info.roleid = newguess.roleid AND info.zoneid = newguess.zoneid /* 进入赛事界面 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS competition_interface_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_main_ui_click WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND lobby_btn = 'Race' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS click ON info.roleid = click.roleid AND info.zoneid = click.zoneid /* 今日61内嵌播放器点击“前往直播间观赛”的次数 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS go_liveroom_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_race_live_popup WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND step_popup = 1 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS popup ON info.roleid = popup.roleid AND info.zoneid = popup.zoneid

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_risk_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH role_zone_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_hero_mmr_cheat_punish WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_report_player WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid UNION SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_bushheatmap WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid UNION SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid UNION SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_voice_using WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid UNION SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_server_resource_diff WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_luaadd_report WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid UNION SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_match_box WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid UNION SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(isbot, 0) = 0 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid UNION SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_gameserver_basicdata_check_md5 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS A WHERE FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 58 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), battle_info AS (SELECT battleid, pvptype FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE realpvptype IN (1, 2) /* 匹配 排位 使用realpvptype   原字段pvptype不准 */ AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 58 GROUP BY battleid, pvptype) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_risk_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT * FROM (SELECT info.roleid, info.zoneid, COALESCE(is_refreshscore, 0) AS is_refreshscore, COALESCE(report_cnt, 0) AS report_cnt, COALESCE(report5_cnt, 0) AS report5_cnt, COALESCE(matches_battle_cnt, 0) AS matches_battle_cnt, COALESCE(isgg_cnt, 0) AS isgg_cnt, COALESCE(sizeerror_cnt, 0) AS sizeerror_cnt, COALESCE(bigmap_dummy_cnt, 0) AS bigmap_dummy_cnt, COALESCE(smallmap_dummy_cnt, 0) AS smallmap_dummy_cnt, COALESCE(bigmap_plcs_cnt, 0) AS bigmap_plcs_cnt, COALESCE(smallmap_plcs_cnt, 0) AS smallmap_plcs_cnt, COALESCE(stackdetails_cnt, 0) AS stackdetails_cnt, COALESCE(siteanalysis_cnt, 0) AS siteanalysis_cnt, COALESCE(window_cnt, 0) AS window_cnt, COALESCE(nullrepot_cnt, 0) AS nullrepot_cnt, COALESCE(esp_cnt, 0) AS esp_cnt, COALESCE(cd_cnt, 0) AS cd_cnt, COALESCE(followicon_cnt, 0) AS followicon_cnt, COALESCE(retribution_cnt, 0) AS retribution_cnt, COALESCE(autoaim_cnt, 0) AS autoaim_cnt, COALESCE(sign_cnt, 0) AS sign_cnt, COALESCE(protocol_cnt, 0) AS protocol_cnt FROM role_zone_info AS info LEFT JOIN (/* 当天是否刷分 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, 1 AS is_refreshscore FROM ml_ods.gameserver_hero_mmr_cheat_punish WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 58 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, is_refreshscore) AS a ON info.roleid = a.roleid AND info.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 当天被举报次数 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(report_cnt) AS report_cnt, SUM(IF(report_cnt >= 5, 1, 0)) AS report5_cnt FROM (SELECT bereporterid AS roleid, a.bereporterzone AS zoneid, a.battleid, COUNT(1) AS report_cnt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_report_player AS a INNER JOIN battle_info AS b ON b.battleid = a.battleid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) < 58 AND reporttype = 3 /* 因作弊被举报 */ AND plugintype = 2 GROUP BY a.bereporterid, a.bereporterzone, a.battleid) AS b_1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b ON info.roleid = b.roleid AND info.zoneid = b.zoneid /* 战斗场次 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS matches_battle_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE pvptype IN (1, 2) AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 58 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS c ON info.roleid = c.roleid AND info.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 当日检测到内存修改的次数 */ SELECT a.zoneid, a.accountid AS roleid, COUNT(1) AS isgg_cnt FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, battleid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_bushheatmap WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 58 AND /* AND     pvptype IN(1, 2)--这个字段不准确 使用battleserver_battle_end 中的realpvp字段 */ isgg = 1 /* 使用内存修改 注意回溯时间logymd>='2021-08-24' */) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT battleid FROM battle_info) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battleid, accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 58 AND devicemodel IN ('asus ASUS_I001DA')) AS c ON a.battleid = c.battleid AND a.accountid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND c.battleid IS NULL GROUP BY a.zoneid, a.accountid) AS d ON info.roleid = d.roleid AND info.zoneid = d.zoneid /* 当日检测到首包大小异常的次数 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(battletime <> 0 AND /* 注意回溯时间logymd>='2021-10-26' */ (CAST(voice_using_time_per AS BIGINT) / voice_using_time / battletime / 1024 >= 180), 1, 0)) AS sizeerror_cnt, SUM(IF(voice_using_time_per = '0' AND battletime = 0, 1, 0)) AS siteanalysis_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_voice_using WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 58 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS e ON info.roleid = e.roleid AND info.zoneid = e.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 当日大地图透视常规检测异常的累计次数 （数据没有查到） */ SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF((res_error LIKE 'CEnt-CS-%') AND CAST(SPLIT(res_error, '\\.')[1] AS BIGINT) >= 24, 1, 0)) AS bigmap_dummy_cnt, SUM(IF((res_error LIKE 'CEnt-CS-%') AND CAST(SPLIT(SPLIT(res_error, '-')[2], '\\.')[0] AS BIGINT) >= 24, 1, 0)) AS smallmap_dummy_cnt, SUM(IF((res_error LIKE '0.21-%') AND CAST(SPLIT(res_error, ',')[9] AS BIGINT) >= 24 AND CAST(SPLIT(res_error, ',')[10] AS FLOAT) >= 0.8, 1, 0)) AS bigmap_plcs_cnt, SUM(IF((res_error LIKE '0.21-%') AND CAST(SPLIT(res_error, ',')[1] AS BIGINT) >= 24 AND CAST(SPLIT(res_error, ',')[2] AS FLOAT) >= 0.8, 1, 0)) AS smallmap_plcs_cnt FROM (SELECT res_error, battleid, roleid AS accountid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_server_resource_diff WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 58 AND ((res_error LIKE '0.21-%') OR (res_error LIKE 'CEnt-CS-%'))) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT battleid FROM battle_info) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS f ON info.roleid = f.roleid AND info.zoneid = f.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 当日程序库文件名称检测异常的累计次数 */ SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS stackdetails_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, stackdetails, logymd FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_luaadd_report WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 58) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd, stackdetails FROM (SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE(version_date, '\\"', '') AS version_start_date, LEAD(REGEXP_REPLACE(version_date, '\\"', ''), 1, '9999-12-30') OVER (ORDER BY REGEXP_REPLACE(version_date, '\\"', '') ASC) AS version_end_date, `version`, stackdetails, logymd FROM mt_ods.risk_stackdetails_conf_mlbb_df WHERE logymd = /* 飞书同步日期是yyyy-MM-dd */ IF('20260531' <= '20220809', '20220809', '20260531')) AS x WHERE '2026-05-31' >= version_start_date AND '2026-05-31' <= version_end_date) AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd WHERE a.stackdetails = b.stackdetails GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS g ON info.roleid = g.roleid AND info.zoneid = g.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 当日获取悬浮窗权限检测的累计次数 logymd>='2022-05-24' */ SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS window_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_match_box WHERE client_ip = 1 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 58 GROUP BY zoneid, accountid) AS i ON info.roleid = i.roleid AND info.zoneid = i.zoneid /* 当日战斗结束空上报的累计次数  数据比较少 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT zoneid, accountid AS roleid, COUNT(1) AS nullrepot_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 58 AND TRIM(visible_info) = '' AND CAST(camera_type AS BIGINT) > 1 AND battletype IN (1, 2) AND heroid <> 0 AND a.battleid IN (SELECT battleid FROM battle_info) AND COALESCE(isbot, 0) = 0 GROUP BY zoneid, accountid) AS j ON info.roleid = j.roleid AND info.zoneid = j.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(col_name = 'esp_cnt', 1, 0)) AS esp_cnt, SUM(IF(col_name = 'cd_cnt', 1, 0)) AS cd_cnt, SUM(IF(col_name = 'followicon_cnt', 1, 0)) AS followicon_cnt, SUM(IF(col_name = 'retribution_cnt', 1, 0)) AS retribution_cnt, SUM(IF(col_name = 'autoaim_cnt', 1, 0)) AS autoaim_cnt, SUM(IF(col_name = 'protocol_cnt', 1, 0)) AS protocol_cnt, SUM(IF(col_name = 'sign_cnt', 1, 0)) AS sign_cnt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_gameserver_basicdata_check_md5 AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT check_type, col_name, REGEXP_REPLACE(excluded_value, '\\"', '') AS excluded_value FROM mt_ods.risk_conf_list_mlbb_df AS k WHERE logymd = IF('20260531' <= '20220809', '20220809', '20260531')) AS b ON a.check_type = b.check_type WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) < 58 AND a.client_value <> b.excluded_value GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS k ON info.roleid = k.roleid AND info.zoneid = k.zoneid) AS t1 WHERE (is_refreshscore + report_cnt + report5_cnt + matches_battle_cnt + isgg_cnt + sizeerror_cnt + bigmap_dummy_cnt + smallmap_dummy_cnt + bigmap_plcs_cnt + smallmap_plcs_cnt + stackdetails_cnt + siteanalysis_cnt + window_cnt + nullrepot_cnt + esp_cnt + cd_cnt + followicon_cnt + retribution_cnt + autoaim_cnt + sign_cnt + protocol_cnt) <> 0

name: bytedance_export_connserver_resource_diff_22
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: theoguo@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-06-21 15:27:20.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.connserver_resource_diff_22 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, loghms, NULL AS ip, zoneid, accountid, NULL AS level, NULL AS startup_time, res_error, NULL AS client_version, NULL AS client_real_version, NULL AS deviceid, NULL AS deviceinfo, NULL AS unity_version, NULL AS battleid, NULL AS bigranklvl, NULL AS picturequality, NULL AS chargecou FROM (SELECT time, loghms, accountid, zoneid, res_error FROM ml_ods.connserver_resource_diff AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT res_error RLIKE 'HACK_APP|reportDropData|Logic|=|\\073:|AppName|Install|-EndBattle-|-CS-|logic|Device|Signature|ResDiff|Sign|CheckValid|-lua-' AND res_error NOT LIKE ':%' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS main_data LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON main_data.accountid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE adv_us.us_accountid IS NULL

name: bytedance_export_accountserver_account_bind_17
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: theoguo@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-06-21 15:27:20.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH white_role_list AS (SELECT adv_us.us_accountid FROM (SELECT accountid AS us_accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM ml_temp.yudongzhang_tmp_role_infos_02 WHERE logymd = '2026-01-13' AND info_type LIKE 'final_90d_notUSplayer_OhtermajorArea_%' GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 ON t1.roleid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE t1.roleid IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.accountserver_account_bind_17 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, accountid, CASE WHEN account_name RLIKE '^[ios,and]' THEN MD5(account_name) ELSE account_name END AS account_name, email, name, sex, phone, mt_id, pre_mt_id, appid FROM (SELECT time, account_name, email, sex, accountid, name, phone, a.mt_id, a.pre_mt_id, a.appid FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_bind AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS main_data LEFT JOIN white_role_list AS adv_us ON main_data.accountid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE adv_us.us_accountid IS NULL

name: bytedance_export_gameserver_give_gift_17
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: theoguo@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-06-21 16:34:48.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.gameserver_give_gift_17 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, giveid, recvid, recv_zone, gift_type, gift_id, cost_diamond, item_id, MD5(device_id) AS device_id FROM (SELECT cost_diamond, usercreatehms, channel, chargediamond, curticket, usercreatetime, device, time, gift_type, os_type, level, usercreateymd, createrole_country, item_id, recvid, zoneid, sex, recv_zone, device_id, curdiamond, client_ip, activedays, roleid, curbattle_points, giveid, gift_id, loghms FROM ml_ods.gameserver_give_gift AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') AND NOT UPPER(createrole_country) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS main_data LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON main_data.roleid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE adv_us.us_accountid IS NULL

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_active_transform_role_wi
sql_units: WITH dm_behavior_df AS (/* 获取全量行为数据 */ SELECT roleid, active_info /* 活跃位图 */, SUBSTRING(active_info, 8, 7) AS active_info_2week /* 上上周活跃位图 */, SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(logymd, '2026-05-31') + 1, 7) AS active_info_week /* datediff(logymd,'2026-05-31') :调度日期小于'2021-01-01' 位图需要往后截取 */ /* 上周活跃位图 */, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(logymd, '2026-05-31') + 8, 7), '0', '')) AS active_days_2week /* 上上周活跃天数 */, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(logymd, '2026-05-31') + 1, 7), '0', '')) AS active_days_week /* 上周活跃天数 */ FROM (/* SELECT  roleid, */ /*         bitmap_merge(active_info) AS active_info, */ /*         logymd */ /* FROM    mt_dm.dm_multi_behavior_role_zone_df */ /* WHERE   logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2021-01-01', '2021-01-01', '2026-05-31') */ /* AND     zoneid < 57000 */ /* AND     appid = 'mlbb' */ /* GROUP BY */ /*         roleid, */ /*         logymd */ SELECT roleid, BITMAP_MERGE(active_info) AS active_info, logymd FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, logymd) AS t1 WHERE LOCATE('1', SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(logymd, '2026-05-31') + 8, 7)) > 0 /* 只取上上周有活跃的用户 */), dim_basic AS (SELECT roleid, create_os /* 创建时的系统 */, register_date /* 角色创建日期 */, first_mt_country, area_id /* 地区 */, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) = 0 THEN '0' WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) > 0 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 30 THEN '1-29' WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 30 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 90 THEN '30-89' WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 90 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 360 THEN '90-359' WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 360 THEN '360+' ELSE 'unknown' END AS register_days FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_first_create = 1), dm_small_account AS (/* 获取大小号标记 */ SELECT accountid, small_account_flag /* 大小号标记（1表示小号，0表示大号） */ FROM mt_dm.dm_small_account_di WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) /* 业务逻辑：获取上周末账号是否为大小号 */ AND appid = 'mlbb'), dim_social_attribute AS (/* 获取职业年龄、性别 */ SELECT accountid, job, born /* 出生日期 */, sex, age /* 年龄 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_social_attribute_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-03-10', '2022-03-10', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_active_transform_role_wi PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT COALESCE(bas.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(bas.area_id, 'unknown') AS area_id, COALESCE(bas.create_os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(sma.small_account_flag, -99999) AS small_account_flag /* --大小号标记，1表示小号，0表示大号 */, COALESCE(bas.register_days, -99999) AS register_days /* 注册天数 */, COALESCE(att.job, 'unknown') AS job, COALESCE(att.age, -99999) AS age /* 年龄 */, COALESCE(att.sex, 'unknown') AS sex /* 性别 */, mbf.active_days_2week /* 上上周活跃天数 */, COUNT(*) AS active_cnt_2week /* 活跃人数 */, SUM(IF(mbf.active_days_week = 0, 1, 0)) AS lost_cnt /* 流失人数 */, SUM(IF(mbf.active_days_week = 1, 1, 0)) AS active_1days_cnt /* 上周活跃1天人数 */, SUM(IF(mbf.active_days_week = 2, 1, 0)) AS active_2days_cnt /* 上周活跃2天人数 */, SUM(IF(mbf.active_days_week = 3, 1, 0)) AS active_3days_cnt /* 上周活跃3天人数 */, SUM(IF(mbf.active_days_week = 4, 1, 0)) AS active_4days_cnt /* 上周活跃4天人数 */, SUM(IF(mbf.active_days_week = 5, 1, 0)) AS active_5days_cnt /* 上周活跃5天人数 */, SUM(IF(mbf.active_days_week = 6, 1, 0)) AS active_6days_cnt /* 上周活跃6天人数 */, SUM(IF(mbf.active_days_week = 7, 1, 0)) AS active_7days_cnt /* 上周活跃7天人数 */ FROM dm_behavior_df AS mbf LEFT JOIN dim_basic AS bas ON mbf.roleid = bas.roleid LEFT JOIN dm_small_account AS sma ON mbf.roleid = sma.accountid LEFT JOIN dim_social_attribute AS att ON mbf.roleid = att.accountid GROUP BY COALESCE(bas.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(bas.area_id, 'unknown'), COALESCE(bas.create_os, 'unknown'), COALESCE(bas.register_days, -99999) /* 注册天数 */, COALESCE(sma.small_account_flag, -99999) /* --大小号标记，1表示小号，0表示大号 */, COALESCE(att.job, 'unknown'), COALESCE(att.age, -99999) /* 年龄 */, COALESCE(att.sex, 'unknown') /* 性别 */, mbf.active_days_2week /* 两周前活跃天数 */
