name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_performance_download_role_zone_di
sql_units:
/* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jichun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-07-20 11:33:55.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `mt_dwm`.`dwm_performance_download_role_zone_di`( */ /*     `roleid` decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '角色id key', */ /*     `zoneid` bigint COMMENT '服务器 key', */ /*     `os` string COMMENT '系统平台（ios:os_type=1，android:os_type=2，emulator:os_type=3，unknown:os_type=其他）', */ /*     `version_col` string COMMENT '版本', */ /*     `device` string COMMENT '下载设备', */ /*     `download_type` bigint COMMENT '下载类型（1:正常下载，2:预下载，4：皮肤资源，6：PAD增量）', */ /*     `package_type` bigint COMMENT '包体类型（1-轻量包 ，2-中量包，0-正常版本）', */ /*     `download_kbsize` bigint COMMENT '下载资源总大小（单位kb）', */ /*     `wifi_download_kbsize` bigint COMMENT 'wifi下载资源总大小（单位kb）', */ /*     `download_dur` bigint COMMENT '下载时长(单位：秒)', */ /*     `predownload_kbsize` bigint COMMENT '预下载资源大小(单位kb)', */ /*     `resreport_cnt` bigint COMMENT '下载上报次数', */ /*     `wifi_resreport_cnt` bigint COMMENT 'wifi下载上报次数', */ /*     `start_download_time` string COMMENT '当日开始下载时间', */ /*     `end_download_time` string COMMENT '当日结束下载时间', */ /*     `start_download_per` decimal(20, 6) COMMENT '当日开始下载进度', */ /*     `end_download_per` decimal(20, 6) COMMENT '当日结束下载进度' */ /* ) COMMENT '游戏资源下载增量表' PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '日期(yyyy-MM-dd)', */ /*     `appid` string COMMENT '游戏id' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* location 's3a://mt-dwm/table/dwm_performance_download_role_zone_di' */ /* *
 downtype = 1 
 download_errortype = 7 开始下载
 issuccess = '1' or download_errortype = 6 下载完成
 downtype = 2
 load_per = 0.0% 开始下载
 load_per = 100% 下载完成
 
 downtype = 4  无法通过标识区分开始下载时间
 issuccess = '1'  下载完成
 load_per : 0_False_L%   标识下载失败
 
 downtype = 6  无法通过标识区分开始下载时间
 issuccess = '1'  下载完成
 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_performance_download_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(ostype, 'unknown') AS os /* 操作系统 */, COALESCE(patch_name, 'unknown') AS version /* 版本 */, COALESCE(devicemodel, 'unknown') AS device /* 设备 */, COALESCE(downloadtype, -99999) AS download_type /* 增量下载类型 */, COALESCE(reslevel, -99999) AS package_type /* 包体类型 */, SUM(IF(download_dur < 1000000, download_kbsize, 0)) AS download_kbsize /* 下载资源总大小（单位kb） */, SUM(IF(is_wifi = 'True' AND download_dur < 1000000, download_kbsize, 0)) AS wifi_download_kbsize /* wifi下载资源总大小（单位kb） */, SUM(IF(download_dur < 1000000, download_dur, 0)) AS download_dur /* 下载总秒数 */, SUM(IF(download_dur < 1000000, predownload_kbsize, 0)) AS predownload_kbsize /* 预下载合并量 */, SUM(IF(download_dur < 1000000, 1, 0)) AS resreport_cnt /* 当日下载上报次数 */, SUM(IF(is_wifi = 'True' AND download_dur < 1000000, 1, 0)) AS wifi_resreport_cnt, COALESCE(MIN(download_time), '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS start_download_time /* 当日开始下载时间 */, COALESCE(MAX(download_time), '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS end_download_time /* 当日结束下载时间 */, MIN(load_percent) AS start_load_per /* 注：当前进度与最大值比较，取最小值 */, MAX(load_percent) AS end_load_per /* 注：当前进度与最小值比较，取最大值 */ FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, patch_name, CASE WHEN ostype = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN ostype = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN ostype = 3 THEN 'emulator' ELSE 'unknown' END AS ostype, devicemodel, downloadtype, reslevel, download_kbsize /* 大于1000000为异常下载数据，置为0，不做统计 */, download_time AS download_dur, predownload_kbsize, download_errortype, issuccess, CASE WHEN download_time > 1000000 THEN NULL /* 下载时间超过1000000， 进度置为NULL */ WHEN download_errortype = 6 OR issuccess = '1' OR load_per = '100%' THEN 1 /* 下载完成   --存在load_per = '0.0%' 并且 issuccess = '1'的下载记录,记为成功 */ WHEN download_errortype = 7 OR load_per = '0.0%' THEN 0 /* 开始下载 */ WHEN load_per RLIKE '^0_False_L' THEN NULL /* 上报失败，进度置为null */ WHEN load_per RLIKE '%$' THEN REPLACE(load_per, '%', '') / 100 /* 下载进度：downtype = 2 */ WHEN load_per RLIKE '^0.' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(load_per, '_', 1) /* 下载进度：downtype = 1,2,6 */ ELSE NULL END AS load_percent /* -注意case when 顺序不可更改 */, load_per, is_wifi, SUBSTRING(TIME, 1, 19) AS download_time FROM ml_ods.connserver_resreport WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, COALESCE(patch_name, 'unknown'), COALESCE(ostype, 'unknown'), COALESCE(devicemodel, 'unknown'), COALESCE(downloadtype, -99999), COALESCE(reslevel, -99999)

name: bytedance_export_accountserver_account_unbind_17
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: theoguo@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-06-21 15:27:20.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH white_role_list AS (SELECT adv_us.us_accountid FROM (SELECT accountid AS us_accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM ml_temp.yudongzhang_tmp_role_infos_02 WHERE logymd = '2026-01-13' AND info_type LIKE 'final_90d_notUSplayer_OhtermajorArea_%' GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 ON t1.roleid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE t1.roleid IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.accountserver_account_unbind_17 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, accountid, CASE WHEN account_name RLIKE '^[ios,and].*' THEN MD5(account_name) ELSE account_name END AS account_name, bindnum, email, name, sex, mt_id, pre_mt_id, appid FROM (SELECT time, accountid, account_name, bindnum, email, name, sex, a.mt_id, a.pre_mt_id, a.appid, logymd FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_unbind AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS main_data LEFT JOIN white_role_list AS adv_us ON main_data.accountid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE adv_us.us_accountid IS NULL

name: bytedance_export_mtaccountserver_account_rebind_email_17
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: theoguo@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-06-21 15:27:20.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH white_role_list AS (SELECT adv_us.us_accountid FROM (SELECT accountid AS us_accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM ml_temp.yudongzhang_tmp_role_infos_02 WHERE logymd = '2026-01-13' AND info_type LIKE 'final_90d_notUSplayer_OhtermajorArea_%' GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 ON t1.roleid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE t1.roleid IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.mtaccountserver_account_rebind_email_17 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, CASE WHEN account_name RLIKE '^[ios,and].*' THEN MD5(account_name) ELSE account_name END AS account_name, old_email, accountid, new_email FROM (SELECT time, account_name, old_email, accountid, new_email, logymd FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_rebind_email AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS main_data LEFT JOIN white_role_list AS adv_us ON main_data.accountid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE adv_us.us_accountid IS NULL

name: etl.msdk_ads.ads_ltv_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH active_info AS (SELECT package_name, app_id, roleid, zoneid FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT COALESCE(roleid, zoneid) IS NULL GROUP BY package_name, app_id, roleid, zoneid), pay_info AS (SELECT pay_df.package_name, pay_df.app_id, roleid, zoneid, SUM(COALESCE(total_pay_amt, 0)) AS total_pay_amt, SUM(COALESCE(total_pay_cnt, 0)) AS total_pay_cnt FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df AS pay_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY pay_df.package_name, pay_df.app_id, roleid, zoneid), modify_data_all AS (SELECT basic.package_name, basic.app_id, basic.createdate, COALESCE(basic.first_mt_country, 'unkonwn') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(basic.first_media_source, 'unkonwn') AS first_media_source, basic.os, basic.client_version, COALESCE(basic.zoneid, 'unkonwn') AS zoneid, COUNT(basic.roleid) AS dnu, SUM(IF(NOT active_info.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS active_user_cnt, SUM(IF(NOT pay_info.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS pay_num, SUM(COALESCE(pay_info.total_pay_amt, 0)) AS total_pay_amt, SUM(COALESCE(pay_info.total_pay_cnt, 0)) AS total_pay_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(basic.if_first_role, 0)) AS first_role_cnt FROM (SELECT package_name, appid AS app_id, roleid, zoneid, createdate, first_mt_country, first_media_source, os, client_version, if_first_role FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT COALESCE(roleid, zoneid) IS NULL) AS basic LEFT JOIN active_info ON basic.roleid = active_info.roleid AND basic.zoneid = active_info.zoneid AND basic.package_name = active_info.package_name AND basic.app_id = active_info.app_id LEFT JOIN pay_info ON basic.roleid = pay_info.roleid AND basic.zoneid = pay_info.zoneid AND basic.package_name = pay_info.package_name AND basic.app_id = pay_info.app_id GROUP BY basic.package_name, basic.app_id, basic.createdate, basic.first_mt_country, basic.first_media_source, basic.os, basic.client_version, basic.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_ads.ads_ltv_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT COALESCE(di.package_name, df.package_name) AS package_name, COALESCE(di.os, df.os) AS os, COALESCE(di.createdate, df.createdate) AS createdate, COALESCE(di.first_mt_country, df.first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(di.first_media_source, df.first_media_source) AS first_media_source, COALESCE(di.client_version, df.client_version) AS client_version, COALESCE(di.zoneid, df.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(di.dnu, df.dnu) AS dnu, CASE WHEN df.package_name IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.dnu) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) /* 昨日=null，表示一定是当天新增的数据，因此第一位一定等于dnu */ ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.active_num_info), ',', COALESCE(di.active_user_cnt, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS active_num_info, CASE WHEN df.package_name IS NULL AND NOT di.package_name IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.total_pay_amt) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.pay_amt_info), ',', COALESCE(di.total_pay_amt, df.pay_amt_info[SIZE(df.pay_amt_info) - 1])), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS pay_amt_info, CASE WHEN df.package_name IS NULL AND NOT di.package_name IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.pay_num) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.pay_num_info), ',', COALESCE(di.pay_num, df.pay_num_info[SIZE(df.pay_num_info) - 1])), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS pay_num_info, CASE WHEN df.package_name IS NULL AND NOT di.package_name IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.total_pay_cnt) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.pay_cnt_info), ',', COALESCE(di.total_pay_cnt, df.pay_cnt_info[SIZE(df.pay_cnt_info) - 1])), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS pay_cnt_info, COALESCE(di.first_role_cnt, COALESCE(df.new_first_role_cnt, 0)) AS new_first_role_cnt, COALESCE(df.app_id, di.app_id) AS app_id FROM modify_data_all AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT package_name, createdate, zoneid, first_mt_country, first_media_source, os, client_version, dnu, active_num_info, pay_amt_info, pay_num_info, pay_cnt_info, new_first_role_cnt, app_id FROM msdk_ads.ads_ltv_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df ON di.package_name = df.package_name AND di.createdate = df.createdate AND di.first_mt_country = df.first_mt_country AND di.first_media_source = df.first_media_source AND di.os = df.os AND di.app_id = df.app_id AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid AND di.client_version = df.client_version DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: bytedance_export_connserver_client_gameskill_18
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.connserver_client_gameskill_18 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, loghms, ip, zoneid, accountid, level, startup_time, battleid, pvptype, buyequipcount, buyequiptime, avgapm, maxapm, addskillcount, addskilltime, battletime, totalcount FROM (SELECT time, loghms, ip, zoneid, accountid, level, startup_time, battleid, pvptype, buyequipcount, buyequiptime, avgapm, maxapm, addskillcount, addskilltime, battletime, totalcount FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_gameskill AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS main_data LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' < FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('{{EXCEPT_DATE}}', 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON main_data.accountid = adv_us.us_accountid WHERE adv_us.us_accountid IS NULL

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_df
sql_units: /* 角色战斗性能表上报是客户端上报，完结在战斗结算之前退出，则不会上报 */ /* 这种情况会导致玩家有战斗，没有剩余磁盘空间数 */ /* 因此需要玩家相同pvptype 中末次战斗剩余磁盘空间数进行兜底 */ /* set spark.sql.hive.convertInsertingPartitionedTable=true; */ /* set spark.sql.hive.convertMetastoreParquet=true; */ /* set spark.hadoop.validateOutputSpecs=false; */ WITH battle_his AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, battle_info, is_ai, his_battle_cnt, his_win_cnt, his_first_battle_time, his_last_battle_time, NULL AS battle_cnt_info, NULL AS black_cnt_info, NULL AS black2_cnt_info, NULL AS black3_cnt_info, NULL AS black4_cnt_info, NULL AS black5_cnt_info, NULL AS battle_dur_info, NULL AS black_dur_info, NULL AS kda_total_info, his_last_battle_fds, NULL AS win_cnt_info, his_battle_dur, his_battle_exp_cnt /* 新增分路相关的 */, his_battle_mid_cnt, his_battle_roam_cnt, his_battle_jungle_cnt, his_battle_coin_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb'), performace AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, last_battle_fds FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, last_battle_time, last_battle_fds, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype ORDER BY last_battle_time DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dwm.dwm_performance_client_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb') AS performace_mid WHERE rn = 1), battle_data_now AS (SELECT bn.roleid, bn.zoneid, bn.pvptype, bn.realpvptype, MAX(bn.last_battle_time) AS last_battle_time, MIN(bn.first_battle_time) AS first_battle_time, MIN(bn.is_ai) AS is_ai, SUM(bn.battle_cnt) AS battle_cnt, SUM(bn.win_cnt) AS win_cnt, COALESCE(pe.last_battle_fds, -99999) AS last_battle_fds, SUM(battle_duration) AS battle_duration, SUM(battle_exp_cnt) AS battle_exp_cnt, SUM(battle_mid_cnt) AS battle_mid_cnt, SUM(battle_roam_cnt) AS battle_roam_cnt, SUM(battle_jungle_cnt) AS battle_jungle_cnt, SUM(battle_coin_cnt) AS battle_coin_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, MAX(day_last_battle_time) AS last_battle_time, MIN(day_first_battle_time) AS first_battle_time, MIN(COALESCE(is_fake_ai, 0)) AS is_ai, SUM(battle_cnt) AS battle_cnt, SUM(win_cnt) AS win_cnt, SUM(battle_duration) AS battle_duration, 0 AS battle_exp_cnt, 0 AS battle_mid_cnt, 0 AS battle_roam_cnt, 0 AS battle_jungle_cnt, 0 AS battle_coin_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, NULL AS last_battle_time, NULL AS first_battle_time, MIN(COALESCE(is_fake_ai, 0)) AS is_ai, 0 AS battle_cnt, 0 AS win_cnt, 0 AS battle_duration, SUM(day_battle_exp_cnt) AS battle_exp_cnt, SUM(day_battle_mid_cnt) AS battle_mid_cnt, SUM(day_battle_roam_cnt) AS battle_roam_cnt, SUM(day_battle_jungle_cnt) AS battle_jungle_cnt, SUM(day_battle_coin_cnt) AS battle_coin_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_player_common_battle_feature_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype) AS bn LEFT JOIN performace AS pe ON pe.roleid = bn.roleid AND pe.zoneid = bn.zoneid AND pe.pvptype = bn.pvptype GROUP BY bn.roleid, bn.zoneid, bn.pvptype, bn.realpvptype, COALESCE(pe.last_battle_fds, -99999)), main_data AS (SELECT COALESCE(bn.roleid, bh.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(bn.zoneid, bh.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(bn.pvptype, bh.pvptype) AS pvptype, COALESCE(bn.realpvptype, bh.realpvptype) AS realpvptype, COALESCE(bn.is_ai, bh.is_ai) AS is_ai, COALESCE(bh.his_battle_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(bn.battle_cnt, 0) AS his_battle_cnt, COALESCE(bh.his_win_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(bn.win_cnt, 0) AS his_win_cnt, COALESCE(bh.his_first_battle_time, bn.first_battle_time) AS his_first_battle_time, COALESCE(bn.last_battle_time, bh.his_last_battle_time) AS his_last_battle_time, COALESCE(bn.last_battle_fds, bh.his_last_battle_fds, -99999) AS his_last_battle_fds, COALESCE(bn.battle_duration, 0) + COALESCE(bh.his_battle_dur, 0) AS his_battle_dur, COALESCE(bn.battle_exp_cnt, 0) /* 新增分路相关 */ + COALESCE(bh.his_battle_exp_cnt, 0) AS his_battle_exp_cnt, COALESCE(bn.battle_mid_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(bh.his_battle_mid_cnt, 0) AS his_battle_mid_cnt, sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jichun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-08-04 15:47:49.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 建表语句 */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `mt_dwd`.`dwd_zgame_account_attribution_df`( */ /*     `accountid` decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '账号id', */ /*     `time` timestamp COMMENT 'adjust归因时间', */ /*     `os_type` int COMMENT 'adjust归因os_type', */ /*     `gps_adid` string COMMENT 'adjust归因gps_adid', */ /*     `idfa` string COMMENT 'adjust归因idfa', */ /*     `android_id` string COMMENT 'adjust归因android_id', */ /*     `adjust_id` string COMMENT 'adjust归因adjust_id', */ /*     `adjust_country` string COMMENT 'adjust归因国家', */ /*     `adjust_network_name` string COMMENT 'adjust归因渠道', */ /*     `adjust_campaign_name` string COMMENT 'adjust归因Campaign名字', */ /*     `adjust_campaign_id` string COMMENT 'adjust归因Campaign的ID', */ /*     `adjust_adset_name` string COMMENT 'adjust归因Adset名字', */ /*     `adjust_adset_id` string COMMENT 'adjust归因Adset的ID', */ /*     `adjust_creative_name` string COMMENT 'adjust归因Creative的名字', */ /*     `adjust_creative_id` string COMMENT 'adjust归因Creative的ID', */ /*     `game_channel` string COMMENT 'adjust归因登录渠道', */ /*     `attr_logymd` string COMMENT 'adjust归因日期' */ /* ) COMMENT '账户-adjust用户归因信息（创号日期分区）' PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '分区日期（账号创建日期）yyyy-MM-dd' */ /* ) STORED AS PARQUET */ /* location 's3a://mt-dwd/table/dwd_zgame_account_attribution_df' */ /* set spark.hadoop.hive.exec.dynamic.partition.mode=nonstrict; */ /* set spark.sql.sources.partitionOverwriteMode = dynamic; */ /* 回刷历史数据 */ /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_zgame_account_attribution_df PARTITION (logymd) */ /* SELECT  accountid, */ /*         `time`, */ /*         os_type, */ /*         gps_adid, */ /*         idfa, */ /*         android_id, */ /*         adjust_id, */ /*         adjust_country, */ /*         adjust_network_name, */ /*         adjust_campaign_name, */ /*         adjust_campaign_id, */ /*         adjust_adset_name, */ /*         adjust_adset_id, */ /*         adjust_creative_name, */ /*         adjust_creative_id, */ /*         game_channel, */ /*         COALESCE(logymd, createymd) AS attr_logymd, -- 归因日期 */ /*         COALESCE(createymd, logymd) AS logymd */ /* FROM ( */ /*         SELECT  *, row_number() over(PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY `time`) rn */ /*         FROM    mt_dwd.dwd_zgame_account_attribution_di */ /*         where   logymd>='2020-01-01' */ /*         and     COALESCE(createymd, logymd)>='2024-03-01' */ /*         AND     COALESCE(createymd, logymd)<='2025-06-11' */ /* ) tmp */ /* WHERE rn=1 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_zgame_account_attribution_df PARTITION(logymd) SELECT accountid, `time`, os_type, gps_adid, idfa, android_id, adjust_id, adjust_country, adjust_network_name, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, COALESCE(logymd, createymd) AS attr_logymd /* 归因日期 */, COALESCE(createymd, logymd) AS logymd FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY `time`) AS rn FROM mt_dwd.dwd_zgame_account_attribution_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND /* di logymd为每日新增的数量， df为合并后的adv_install */ /* 2022-06-30 前的di表， createymd 字段为空 */ ((createymd <= '2026-05-31' AND createymd >= '2026-05-02') OR createymd IS NULL)) AS tmp WHERE rn = 1 DISTRIBUTE BY (logymd, 1)

       RIGHT(active_info, 14) reg_active_14days, */ /*                         --裁剪active_info ,由于依赖关系，任务执行时间始终小于或者等于位图表中的时间 */ /*                         substr(active_info, datediff(logymd, /* 位图表里面只存放最近三天的数据 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, reg_active_30days, reg_active_14days, CASE WHEN LENGTH(active_info) < 37 THEN 0 WHEN CONV(SUBSTRING(reg.active_info, 8, 30), 2, 10) <= 0 AND -99999) AS his_active_first_moment_cnt, COALESCE(IF(ad.active_moment_array[ARRAY_SORT_INDEX(ad.active_moment_array)[1]] = 0, ARRAY_SORT_INDEX(ad.active_moment_array)[0], ARRAY_SORT_INDEX(ad.active_moment_array)[1]), -99999) AS his_active_seconed_moment_cnt /* 如果第二次登录小时对应的值为0则取第一个登录小时 */, ad.his_last_active_client_ver AS his_last_client_ver, ad.his_last_active_channel AS his_last_channel, ad.his_last_active_pad AS his_last_pad, COALESCE(ri.is_refreshscore, 0) AS is_rescore, COALESCE(ad.his_last_active_own_battle_points, 0) AS battle_point_amt, COALESCE(ad.his_last_active_own_ticket, 0) AS point_roll_amt, COALESCE(ad.his_last_active_own_diamond, 0) AS diamond_amt, COALESCE(ad.his_last_active_friend_cnt, 0) AS friend_cnt, COALESCE(ad.his_last_active_ol_friend_cnt, 0) AS ol_friend_cnt, COALESCE(ad.his_last_active_fans_cnt, 0) AS fans_cnt, CASE WHEN ad.his_last_active_team_id = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_team, COALESCE(reg.return_cnt_7days, 0) AS return_cnt_7days /* 7天之前30天内完全没有登录，7天之内有登录判断为7天回流 */ /* 30天之内有登录，30天到60天之内完全没有登录判断为30日回流 */, COALESCE(reg.return_cnt_30days, 0) AS return_cnt_30days, COALESCE(reg.is_return, 0) AS is_return, COALESCE(CAST(COALESCE(adr.day_login_duration_day30, 0) / COALESCE(adr.active_days30, 0) AS BIGINT), 0) AS ol_dur_avg_30days, COALESCE(CAST(COALESCE(adr.day_login_duration_day7, 0) / COALESCE(adr.active_days7, 0) AS BIGINT), 0) AS ol_dur_avg_7days, COALESCE(adr.share_cnt_day7, 0) AS share_cnt_7days, COALESCE(adr.share_cnt_day30, 0) AS share_cnt_30days, COALESCE(ad.his_gift_skin_total, 0) AS his_giftskin_cnt, COALESCE(adr.active_days7, 0) AS activedays_7days /* 替换几个1就是有几天活跃 */, COALESCE(adr.active_days30, 0) AS activedays_30days, ad.his_last_active_level AS his_last_level, ad.his_last_active_ip AS his_last_ip, ad.his_last_active_second_date AS his_last_second_activedate, ad.his_last_active_date AS his_last_active_date, COALESCE(ad.his_activedays, 0) AS activedays, his_first_device_total_memory, his_last_device_total_memory FROM active_df AS ad LEFT JOIN social_attribute AS sa ON sa.accountid = ad.roleid LEFT JOIN risk_di AS ri ON ri.roleid = ad.roleid AND ri.zoneid = ad.zoneid LEFT JOIN register_active_info AS reg ON reg.roleid = ad.roleid AND reg.zoneid = ad.zoneid LEFT JOIN active_di_recent_30days AS adr ON adr.roleid = ad.roleid AND adr.zoneid = ad.zoneid

name: export_bytedance_gameserver_gmcmd_26
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.gameserver_gmcmd_26 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.time, a.loghms, a.zoneid, a.operator_name, a.cmd_name, a.cmd_param, a.cmd_ret FROM (SELECT time, loghms, CAST(SPLIT(cmd_param, ' ')[0] AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) AS roleid, zoneid, operator_name, cmd_name, cmd_param, cmd_ret, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_gmcmd WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND cmd_name = 'ban_login' AND cmd_ret = 0 AND CAST(SPLIT(cmd_param, ' ')[2] AS BIGINT) = 1) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-07', '2022-05-07', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS b ON a.roleid = b.accountid WHERE b.accountid IS NULL

name: unity_卡loading率
sql_units: WITH a /* 战斗加载表 */ AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN unityversion LIKE '%2019%' THEN '2019' WHEN unityversion LIKE '%2017%' THEN '2017' ELSE 'qita' END AS unity_type, clientver, game_channel, ostype, pic_quality, LOWER(device) AS device, SUM(CASE WHEN Module = 'StartLoad0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS StartLoad0 /* 开始加载次数 */, SUM(CASE WHEN Module = 'EndLoad0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EndLoad0 /* 结束加载次数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT battleID) AS battlenum FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleload_report WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 改时间 */ AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND NOT FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) IN (50, 57) /* 去除测试服 */ GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN unityversion LIKE '%2019%' THEN '2019' WHEN unityversion LIKE '%2017%' THEN '2017' ELSE 'qita' END, clientver, game_channel, ostype, pic_quality, device), b AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.logymd, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) = 0 AND is_pure = 1 THEN '0' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) > 0 AND DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) < 30 THEN '1~29' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 30 AND DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) < 90 THEN '30~89' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 90 THEN '90+' END AS retention_lif, ip_country AS country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.zoneid ORDER BY day_login_duration DESC) AS rna FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_behavior_role_zone_di AS a WHERE NOT FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) IN (50, 57) AND a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.appid = 'mlbb') AS t1 WHERE rna = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.troylu_20220822_unity_loading PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT b.retention_lif, b.country, a.unity_type, a.clientver, a.game_channel, a.ostype, a.pic_quality, a.device, CASE WHEN a.StartLoad0 > a.EndLoad0 THEN '卡顿' ELSE '不卡' END AS batlv /* 是否卡loading */, COUNT(DISTINCT a.accountid, a.zoneid) AS cnt /* 人数 */, SUM(a.battlenum) AS battlenum /* 场次数 */ FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY b.retention_lif, b.country, a.unity_type, a.clientver, a.game_channel, a.ostype, a.pic_quality, a.device, CASE WHEN a.StartLoad0 > a.EndLoad0 THEN '卡顿' ELSE '不卡' END

name: tmp_charge_month
sql_units: WITH active AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(logymd, 'yyyy-MM') AS logym, LOWER(first_ad_country) AS country, roleid FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_behavior_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC('2026-05-31', 'MM') AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_active = 1 /* 表示当天活跃过 */ AND appid = 'mlbb' AND create_channel NOT LIKE 'and_bdvp%' /* 排除虚拟玩家 */ GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(logymd, 'yyyy-MM'), LOWER(first_ad_country), roleid), charge AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(logymd, 'yyyy-MM') AS logym, LOWER(createrole_country) AS country, roleid, SUM(`money`) / 100 AS dollar FROM ml_temp.tmp_IAP_charge WHERE logymd BETWEEN TRUNC('2026-05-31', 'MM') AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(logymd, 'yyyy-MM'), LOWER(createrole_country), roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_charge_month PARTITION(logym) SELECT t.country, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar = 0 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `0`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar > 0 AND dollar < 1 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `(0,1)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 1 AND dollar < 2 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[1,2)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 2 AND dollar < 3 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[2,3)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 3 AND dollar < 4 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[3,4)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 4 AND dollar < 5 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[4,5)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 5 AND dollar < 6 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[5,6)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 6 AND dollar < 7 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[6,7)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 7 AND dollar < 8 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[7,8)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 8 AND dollar < 9 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[8,9)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 9 AND dollar < 10 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[9,10)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 10 AND dollar < 20 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[10,20)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 20 AND dollar < 30 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[20,30)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 30 AND dollar < 50 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[30,50)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 50 AND dollar < 100 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[50,100)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 100 AND dollar < 200 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[100,200)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 200 AND dollar < 500 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[200,500)`, COUNT(CASE WHEN dollar >= 500 THEN t.roleid ELSE NULL END) AS `[500,)`, a.total, t.logym FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.country, c.country) AS country, COALESCE(a.roleid, c.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(dollar, 0) AS dollar, COALESCE(a.logym, c.logym) AS logym FROM active AS a FULL JOIN charge AS c ON a.logym = c.logym AND a.country = c.country AND a.roleid = c.roleid) AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT logym, country, COUNT(roleid) AS total FROM active GROUP BY logym, country) AS a ON a.logym = t.logym AND a.country = t.country GROUP BY t.country, a.total, t.logym

name: etl.msdk_ads.ads_pay_device_retention_df
sql_units: /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_ads.ads_pay_device_retention_df ( */ /*             did         STRING COMMENT '设备id',    */ /*             package_name         STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名', */ /*             os                   STRING COMMENT '操作系统', */ /*             createdate           STRING COMMENT '新增设备时间', */ /*             first_mt_country     STRING COMMENT '首次归因国家', */ /*             first_media_source   STRING COMMENT '首次归因渠道', */ /*             client_version       STRING COMMENT '安装的游戏客户端版本', */ /*             is_pay_device        int    COMMENT '是否付费设备', */ /*             active_info          STRING COMMENT '活跃位图' */ /*         ) COMMENT '设备付费活跃全量表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY */ /*         (logymd STRING COMMENT '数据日期yyyy-MM-dd', app_id STRING COMMENT '应用唯一ID') STORED AS PARQUET; */ /* 活跃DWM表(指标：活跃，在线时长，登录次数) */ WITH active_device AS (SELECT package_name, did, app_id, active_info FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND did <> 'unknown'), pay_device /* 付费DWM表(指标：付费设备数，付费金额，订单数) */ AS (SELECT package_name, did, app_id FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY package_name, did, app_id), basic AS (SELECT package_name, app_id, did, createdate, first_mt_country, first_media_source, os, client_version FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND did <> 'unknown') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_ads.ads_pay_device_retention_df PARTITION(logymd, app_id) SELECT t1.did, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.createdate, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, IF(t2.did IS NULL, 0, 1) AS is_pay_device, t3.active_info, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.app_id FROM basic AS t1 LEFT JOIN pay_device AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.did = t2.did AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name LEFT JOIN active_device AS t3 ON t1.app_id = t3.app_id AND t1.did = t3.did AND t1.package_name = t3.package_name DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

sql_units: /* SET spark.sql.shuffle.partitions=10; */ WITH main_data AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os, device, MIN(is_ai) AS is_ai, MAX(LEVEL) AS LEVEL, MIN(first_moment_cnt) AS first_moment_cnt, MIN(second_moment_cnt) AS second_moment_cnt, MAX(chargediamond) AS chargediamond, SUM(day_login_cnt) AS day_login_cnt, SUM(day_login_duration) AS day_login_duration, SUM(giftskin_cnt) AS giftskin_cnt, SUM(share_cnt) AS share_cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN asc_id = 1 THEN is_first_active END) AS is_first_active, MAX(CASE WHEN asc_id = 1 THEN day_first_ip END) AS day_first_ip, MAX(CASE WHEN asc_id = 1 THEN day_first_active_time END) AS day_first_active_time, MAX(CASE WHEN asc_id = 1 THEN day_first_deviceid END) AS day_first_deviceid, MAX(CASE WHEN asc_id = 1 THEN day_first_channel END) AS day_first_channel, MAX(CASE WHEN asc_id = 1 THEN first_social_fansnum END) AS first_social_fansnum, MAX(CASE WHEN asc_id = 1 THEN first_social_friendnum END) AS first_social_friendnum, MAX(CASE WHEN asc_id = 1 THEN first_loginclient_version END) AS first_loginclient_version, MAX(CASE WHEN asc_id = 1 THEN first_os_version END) AS first_os_version, MAX(CASE WHEN asc_id = 1 THEN first_login_teamid END) AS first_login_teamid, MAX(CASE WHEN asc_id = 1 THEN first_client_language END) AS first_client_language, MAX(CASE WHEN asc_id = 1 THEN first_online_friend END) AS first_online_friend, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN is_last_active END) AS is_last_active, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN day_last_ip END) AS day_last_ip, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN day_last_active_time END) AS day_last_active_time, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN day_last_deviceid END) AS day_last_deviceid, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN day_last_channel END) AS day_last_channel, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN social_focusnum END) AS social_focusnum, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN social_fansnum END) AS social_fansnum, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN social_friendnum END) AS social_friendnum, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_sex_game END) AS last_sex_game, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_loginclient_version END) AS last_loginclient_version, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_os_version END) AS last_os_version, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_login_teamid END) AS last_login_teamid, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_client_language END) AS last_client_language, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_curbattle_points END) AS last_curbattle_points, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_curticket END) AS last_curticket, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_curdiamond END) AS last_curdiamond, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_pad END) AS last_pad, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_online_friend END) AS last_online_friend FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os, device, is_ai, LEVEL, first_moment_cnt, second_moment_cnt, chargediamond, day_login_cnt, day_login_duration, giftskin_cnt, share_cnt, is_first_active, day_first_ip, day_first_active_time, day_first_deviceid, day_first_channel, first_social_fansnum, first_social_friendnum, first_loginclient_version, first_os_version, first_login_teamid, first_client_language, first_online_friend, is_last_active, day_last_ip, day_last_active_time, day_last_deviceid, day_last_channel, social_focusnum, social_fansnum, social_friendnum, last_sex_game, last_loginclient_version, last_os_version, last_login_teamid, last_client_language, last_curbattle_points, last_curticket, last_curdiamond, last_pad, last_online_friend, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, os, device ORDER BY day_first_active_time ASC, day_login_cnt DESC, ip_country) AS asc_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, os, device ORDER BY day_last_active_time DESC, day_login_cnt DESC, ip_country) AS desc_id FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb') AS first_data GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, os, device) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.dwm_active_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT md.roleid, md.zoneid, md.os, md.device, md.is_first_active, md.is_last_active, md.is_ai, md.day_first_ip, md.day_last_ip, md.chargediamond, md.level, md.day_first_active_time, md.day_last_active_time, md.day_first_deviceid, md.day_last_deviceid, md.day_first_channel, md.day_last_channel, md.social_focusnum, md.first_social_fansnum, md.social_fansnum, md.first_social_friendnum, md.social_friendnum, md.day_login_cnt, md.day_login_duration, md.last_sex_game, md.first_loginclient_version, md.last_loginclient_version, md.first_os_version, md.last_os_version, md.first_login_teamid, md.last_login_teamid, md.first_client_language, md.last_client_language, md.first_moment_cnt, md.second_moment_cnt, md.last_curbattle_points, md.last_curticket, md.last_curdiamond, md.giftskin_cnt, md.last_pad, md.first_online_friend, md.last_online_friend, md.share_cnt FROM main_data AS md LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_account FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-07', '2022-05-07', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON md.roleid = adv_us.us_account WHERE adv_us.us_account IS NULL

sql_units: WITH t_module AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, module_name, online_dur, enter_cnt, logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_module_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31'), t_active_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, max_vip_level FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(BIGINT(his_max_active_vip)) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid) AS max_vip_level FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mla') AS t WHERE max_vip_level >= 12) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mla_behavior_corepaid_module_role_zone_df PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT t_module.logymd, t_active_df.roleid, t_active_df.zoneid, COALESCE(t_module.module_name, 'unknown') AS module_name, COALESCE(t_module.online_dur, 0) AS online_dur, COALESCE(t_module.enter_cnt, 0) AS enter_cnt FROM t_active_df JOIN t_module ON t_active_df.roleid = t_module.roleid AND t_active_df.zoneid = t_module.zoneid DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() * 3 AS INT)

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH today_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, SUBSTRING(MAX(last_rank_change_time), 1, 10) AS last_rank_change_date, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_reason END) AS last_reason, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_rankstar END) AS last_rankstar, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_rank_id END) AS last_rank_id, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_minranklvl END) AS last_minranklvl, MAX(CASE WHEN desc_id = 1 THEN last_bigranklvl END) AS last_bigranklvl, MAX(max_rankstar) AS max_rankstar, MAX(max_rank_id) AS max_rank_id, MAX(max_minranklvl) AS max_minranklvl, MAX(max_bigranklvl) AS max_bigranklvl FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, last_rank_change_time, last_reason, last_rankstar, last_rank_id, last_minranklvl, last_bigranklvl, max_rankstar, max_rank_id, max_minranklvl, max_bigranklvl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype ORDER BY logymd DESC, last_rank_change_time DESC) AS desc_id FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype), his_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, his_max_rankstar, his_max_rank_id, his_max_minranklvl, his_max_bigranklvl, his_last_rankstar, his_last_rank_id, his_last_minrank, his_last_bigrank, his_last_rank_change_date, his_last_reason FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT COALESCE(his_info.roleid, today_info.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(his_info.zoneid, today_info.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(his_info.pvptype, today_info.pvptype) AS pvptype, GREATEST(his_info.his_max_rankstar, today_info.max_rankstar) AS his_max_rankstar, GREATEST(his_info.his_max_rank_id, today_info.max_rank_id) AS his_max_rank_id, GREATEST(his_info.his_max_minranklvl, today_info.max_minranklvl) AS his_max_minranklvl, GREATEST(his_info.his_max_bigranklvl, today_info.max_bigranklvl) AS his_max_bigranklvl, COALESCE(today_info.last_rankstar, his_info.his_last_rankstar) AS his_last_rankstar, COALESCE(today_info.last_rank_id, his_info.his_last_rank_id) AS his_last_rank_id, COALESCE(today_info.last_minranklvl, his_info.his_last_minrank) AS his_last_minrank, COALESCE(today_info.last_bigranklvl, his_info.his_last_bigrank) AS his_last_bigrank, COALESCE(today_info.last_rank_change_date, his_info.his_last_rank_change_date) AS his_last_rank_change_date, COALESCE(today_info.last_reason, his_info.his_last_reason) AS his_last_reason FROM today_info FULL JOIN his_info ON today_info.roleid = his_info.roleid AND today_info.zoneid = his_info.zoneid AND today_info.pvptype = his_info.pvptype

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_mapping_role_df
sql_units: WITH cur_day_mapping AS (SELECT roleid, device_id FROM (SELECT roleid, device_id, MAX(CASE WHEN device_id = 'unknown' THEN NULL ELSE device_id END) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid) AS max_device_id FROM (SELECT roleid, device_id FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_id_mapping_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND NOT roleid IS NULL GROUP BY roleid, device_id) AS t_today_df) AS t_active /* 保留只有account_bind造成的deviceid=unknown的并且要排除有role+deviceid但deviceid为unknown */ WHERE (max_device_id IS NULL) OR (NOT max_device_id IS NULL AND device_id <> 'unknown')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_mapping_role_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT t_today_df.roleid, t_today_df.device_id, COALESCE(CASE WHEN t_his.his_first_role_active_time = '1970-01-01 00:00:00' THEN NULL ELSE t_his.his_first_role_active_time END, t_login.device_first_login_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS his_first_role_active_time, COALESCE(t_login.device_last_login_time, name: etl.mt_dim.dim_mapping_device_df
sql_units: /* SET spark.dynamicAllocation.minExecutors=20; */ /* SET spark.sql.hive.convertInsertingPartitionedTable	=true; */ WITH cur_day_mapping AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id, MAX(CASE WHEN zoneid = -99999 THEN NULL ELSE zoneid END) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid) AS max_zone_id FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_id_mapping_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND device_id <> 'unknown') AS t_today_df) AS t_login /* 保留只有account造成的zoneid=-99999的并且要排除有role+zone但zoneid为-99999 */ WHERE (max_zone_id IS NULL) OR (NOT max_zone_id IS NULL AND zoneid <> -99999)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_mapping_device_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT t_today_df.device_id, t_today_df.roleid, t_today_df.zoneid, '' AS role_zone_create_time, COALESCE(CASE WHEN t_his.role_zone_first_login_time = '1970-01-01 00:00:00' THEN NULL ELSE t_his.role_zone_first_login_time END, t_login.role_zone_first_login_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS role_zone_first_login_time, COALESCE(t_login.role_zone_last_login_time, t_his.role_zone_last_login_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS role_zone_last_login_time, COALESCE(t_login.role_zone_login_days, 0) + COALESCE(t_his.role_zone_login_days, 0) AS role_zone_login_days, CASE WHEN COALESCE(t_login.role_zone_last_login_time, t_his.role_zone_last_login_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') = '1970-01-01 00:00:00' THEN -99999 ELSE DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', SUBSTRING(COALESCE(t_login.role_zone_last_login_time, t_his.role_zone_last_login_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), 1, 10)) + 1 END AS role_zone_last_login_diff_days, COALESCE(t_battle_map.role_zone_90days_battle_cnt, 0) AS role_zone_90days_battle_cnt, '' AS device_first_login_time, '' AS device_last_login_time, -99999 AS device_login_days, -99999 AS device_last_login_diff_days FROM cur_day_mapping AS t_today_df LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id, role_zone_first_login_time, role_zone_last_login_time, role_zone_login_days, role_zone_last_login_diff_days, device_first_login_time, device_last_login_time, logymd, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_mapping_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb') AS t_his ON t_today_df.roleid = t_his.roleid AND t_today_df.zoneid = t_his.zoneid AND t_today_df.device_id = t_his.device_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id, SUM(battle_cnt / deviceid_cnt) AS role_zone_90days_battle_cnt FROM mt_dwd.dwd_battle_mapping_device_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-03' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, device_id) AS t_battle_map ON t_today_df.roleid = t_battle_map.roleid AND t_today_df.zoneid = t_battle_map.zoneid AND t_today_df.device_id = t_battle_map.device_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(deviceid, 'unknown') AS device_id, MAX(SUBSTRING(`time`, 1, 19)) AS role_zone_last_login_time, MIN(SUBSTRING(`time`, 1, 19)) AS role_zone_first_login_time, 1 AS role_zone_login_days FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(deviceid, 'unknown')) AS t_login ON t_today_df.device_id = t_login.device_id AND t_today_df.roleid = t_login.roleid AND t_today_df.zoneid = t_login.zoneid

Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_leap_task_core_info_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT project_id, project_name, task_owner_user, CASE WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mt_dim.%' THEN 'mt_dim' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mt_dwd.%' THEN 'mt_dwd' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mt_dwm.%' THEN 'mt_dwm' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mt_dm.%' THEN 'mt_dm' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mt_ads.%' THEN 'mt_ads' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.ml_ods.%' THEN 'ml_ods' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mh_ods.%' THEN 'mh_ods' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mt_ods.%' THEN 'mt_ods' ELSE '其他' END AS db_name, FROM_UNIXTIME(task_create_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS task_create_date, CASE WHEN task_priority = 0 THEN '普通(D5)' WHEN task_priority = 1 THEN '高优(D4)' WHEN task_priority = 2 THEN '超高优(D3)' WHEN task_priority = 3 THEN '核心(D2)' END AS task_priority, IF(is_custom = 1 OR is_baseline = 1, '是', '否') AS is_custom, IF(is_high = 1, '是', '否') AS is_high /* 运行监控中是否有紧急报警`, */, IF(is_run_long_time = 1, '是', '否') AS is_run_long_time /* `是否有[运行耗时]运行监控报警`, */, IF(is_ddl_not_begin = 1, '是', '否') AS is_ddl_not_begin /* `是否有[设定时间内未开始]运行监控报警`, */, IF(is_bjtime_not_success = 1, '是', '否') AS is_bjtime_not_success /* `是否有[截止北京时间未开始]运行监控报警`, */, IF(is_manta_normal = 1, '是', '否') AS is_manta_normal, IF(is_table_lines = 1, '是', '否') AS is_table_lines, IF(is_repeat = 1, '是', '否') AS is_repeat, IF(is_manta_high = 1, '是', '否') AS is_manta_high, COUNT(*) AS task_cnt, SUM(IF(alarm_cnt > 0, 1, 0)) AS alarm_task_cnt, SUM(is_high) AS high_task_cnt, SUM(IF(manta_cnt > 0, 1, 0)) AS manta_task_cnt, SUM(IF(manta_normal_cnt > 0, 1, 0)) AS manta_normal_task_cnt, SUM(alarm_cnt) AS alarm_cnt, SUM(IF(is_custom + COALESCE(is_baseline, 0) > 1, 1, is_custom + COALESCE(is_baseline, 0))) AS alarm_custom_cnt, SUM(manta_cnt) AS manta_cnt, SUM(manta_normal_cnt) AS manta_normal_cnt, SUM(is_manta_high) AS manta_high_cnt FROM (SELECT *, IF(manta_normal_cnt > 0, 1, 0) AS is_manta_normal FROM mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_baseinfo_df AS a WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.task_status = 2 /* 开启的任务 */ AND task_type_group <> 17 AND a.schedule_type = 2) AS a GROUP BY project_id, project_name, task_owner_user, CASE WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mt_dim.%' THEN 'mt_dim' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mt_dwd.%' THEN 'mt_dwd' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mt_dwm.%' THEN 'mt_dwm' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mt_dm.%' THEN 'mt_dm' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mt_ads.%' THEN 'mt_ads' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.ml_ods.%' THEN 'ml_ods' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mh_ods.%' THEN 'mh_ods' WHEN task_name LIKE '%.mt_ods.%' THEN 'mt_ods' ELSE '其他' END, FROM_UNIXTIME(task_create_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), CASE WHEN task_priority = 0 THEN '普通(D5)' WHEN task_priority = 1 THEN '高优(D4)' WHEN task_priority = 2 THEN '超高优(D3)' WHEN task_priority = 3 THEN '核心(D2)' END, IF(is_custom = 1 OR is_baseline = 1, '是', '否'), IF(is_high = 1, '是', '否'), IF(is_run_long_time = 1, '是', '否'), IF(is_ddl_not_begin = 1, '是', '否'), IF(is_bjtime_not_success = 1, '是', '否'), IF(is_manta_normal = 1, '是', '否'), IF(is_table_lines = 1, '是', '否'), IF(is_repeat = 1, '是', '否'), IF(is_manta_high = 1, '是', '否')

name: etl.msdk_dwm.dwm_stage_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-09-19 18:47:08.000 */ /* Description: */ /* 需求文档:https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/wikcnX7upcQ4QEHYXykVhlZksbd */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_dwm.dwm_stage_role_zone_di ( */ /*     roleid                   STRING         COMMENT '角色id,key', */ /*     zoneid                   STRING         COMMENT '服务器,key', */ /*     package_name             STRING         COMMENT '首次安装的游戏分包名', */ /*     stagename                STRING         COMMENT '关卡名称', */ /*     stageid                  STRING         COMMENT '关卡id', */ /*     detail                   STRING         COMMENT '明细' */ /* ) COMMENT '角色关卡驻留明细表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd', appid INT COMMENT '游戏id') */ WITH all_user AS (SELECT role_id AS roleid, zone_id AS zoneid, package_name, app_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.stagename') AS stagename, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.stageid') AS stageid, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.detail') AS detail, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY role_id, zone_id, app_id, package_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.stagename'), GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.stageid'), GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.detail') ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS row_num FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('log_point') AND NOT COALESCE(role_id, zone_id) IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm.dwm_stage_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid) SELECT roleid, zoneid, package_name, stagename, stageid, detail, app_id FROM all_user WHERE row_num = 1

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_gameusediskspace_grading PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT zone_type, CASE WHEN gradingid IN (0, 5) THEN '全量包' WHEN gradingid = 1 THEN '1档包' WHEN gradingid = 2 THEN '2档包' WHEN gradingid = 3 THEN '3档包' WHEN gradingid = 4 THEN '4档包' ELSE '无信息' END AS grading_type /* 分档包类型 */, PERCENTILE(gameusediskspace, 0.5) AS mid_space, PERCENTILE(gameusediskspace, 0.75) AS 75_space FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, gameusediskspace, CASE WHEN zoneid < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END AS zone_type FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND gameusediskspace <> 0 /* 0是因为ios接口问题，取不到数 */) AS a /* 战斗结束性能打点表 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, gradingid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_grading_userinfo WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND gradingid <= 5 /* 去除脏数据 */ GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, gradingid) AS b /* 分档功能打点表（最早日期2022-09-14） */ ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY zone_type, grading_type

sql_units: /* CREATE TABLE `msdk_dwd`.`dwd_msdk_adjust_di_test`( */ /*     `server_time` string COMMENT '日志时间，回调接口收到归因数据时间', */ /*     `event_time` bigint COMMENT '事件发生时间', */ /*     `event_source` string COMMENT '事件来源', */ /*     `reporter_ip` string COMMENT '上报IP', */ /*     `msdk_store` string COMMENT 'msdk的商店', */ /*     `msdk_environment` string COMMENT 'msdk的环境', */ /*     `package_name` string COMMENT 'msdk包名', */ /*     `country_code` string COMMENT '国家代码', */ /*     `platform` string COMMENT '设备系统', */ /*     `media_source` string COMMENT '获得归因的媒体渠道', */ /*     `android_id` string COMMENT 'android唯一ID', */ /*     `gps_adid` string COMMENT '用户可重置的设备ID,又称GAID', */ /*     `idfa` string COMMENT 'IOS设备上的可重置广告ID', */ /*     `idfv` string COMMENT 'IOS提供的应用开发者标识符', */ /*     `adjust_id` string COMMENT '用户在其设备上安装应用时，由SDK生成的非重ID', */ /*     `oaid` string COMMENT '一些安卓设备上的用户可重置ID，通常作为GAID的替代', */ /*     `campaign_name` string COMMENT '广告系列名称', */ /*     `campaign_id` string COMMENT '广告系列id', */ /*     `adgroup_name` string COMMENT 'adgroup name', */ /*     `adgroup_id` string COMMENT 'adgroup id', */ /*     `others` string COMMENT 'JOSN字符串', */ /*     `event_name` string COMMENT '事件名称', */ /*     `os_name` string COMMENT '系统名称', */ /*     `creative_name` string COMMENT '-', */ /*     `creative_id` string COMMENT '-' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', */ /*     `msdk_app_id` string COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key' */ /* ) stored as parquet location 's3a://moonton-msdk/dwd/dwd_msdk_adjust_di' */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwd.dwd_msdk_adjust_di PARTITION(logymd, msdk_app_id) SELECT server_time, event_time, event_source, reporter_ip, msdk_store, msdk_environment, package_name, country_code, platform, media_source, IF(android_id IN ('', '0000000000000000'), NULL, android_id) AS android_id, IF(gps_adid IN ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', '0000-0000', 'none', '00000000-4000-8000-0000-000000000000'), NULL, gps_adid) AS gps_adid, IF(idfa IN ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', ''), NULL, idfa) AS idfa, IF(idfv IN (''), NULL, idfv) AS idfv, adjust_id, oaid, IF(campaign_name = '', NULL, campaign_name) AS campaign_name, IF(campaign_id = '', NULL, campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(adgroup_name = '', NULL, adgroup_name) AS adgroup_name, IF(adgroup_id = '', NULL, adgroup_id) AS adgroup_id, others, event_name, os_name, IF(LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name, IF(creative_name = '', NULL, creative_name)) AS creative_name, IF(LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id, IF(creative_id = '', NULL, creative_id)) AS creative_id, IF(LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name, NULL) AS fb_campaign_name, IF(LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id, NULL) AS fb_campaign_id, IF(LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', fb_install_referrer_campaign_name, NULL) AS fb_adgroup_name, IF(LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', fb_install_referrer_campaign_id, NULL) AS fb_adgroup_id, IF(fb_install_referrer = '', NULL, fb_install_referrer) AS fb_install_referrer, msdk_did, stage_id, logymd, msdk_app_id FROM (SELECT msdk_server_time AS server_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.created_at') AS event_time, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.is_s2s') = '0', 'SDK', 'S2S') AS event_source, msdk_reporter_ip AS reporter_ip, msdk_store, msdk_environment, msdk_package_name AS package_name, network_name AS media_source, COALESCE(TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(creative_name, '(.*?)\\\\(([a-z0-9-]+)\\\\)')), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(creative_name, '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS creative_name, IF(creative_name /* creative_name REGEXP '^\\\d+$', */ RLIKE '^[0-9]+$' OR creative_name RLIKE '^[a-z0-9-]+$', creative_name, COALESCE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(creative_name, '.*?\\\\(([a-z0-9-]+)\\\\)'), REGEXP_EXTRACT(creative_name, '.*?\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS creative_id, LOWER(country) AS country_code, LOWER(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.platform')) AS platform, android_id, gps_adid, idfa, idfv, IF(campaign_name RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', campaign_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\((.*?)\\\\)'))) AS campaign_name, IF(campaign_name RLIKE '^\\\\d+$' OR campaign_name RLIKE '^[a-z0-9]{32}$', campaign_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\((.*?)\\\\)', 2))) AS campaign_id, IF(adgroup_name RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', adgroup_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(adgroup_name, '(.*?)\\\\((.*?)\\\\)'))) AS adgroup_name, IF(adgroup_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', adgroup_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(adgroup_name, '(.*?)\\\\((.*?)\\\\)', 2))) AS adgroup_id, adjust_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.oaid') AS oaid /* 测试数据木有,但是文档上有 */, others, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.event_name') AS event_name, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, msdk_app_id, os_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer') AS fb_install_referrer, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_id') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_name') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name') AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id') AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id, msdk_did, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msdk_message_md5 ORDER BY GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.created_at') ASC) AS rn, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_ods.msdk_adjust WHERE logymd = '20260531') WHERE rn = 1 DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: mt_ads.ads_mlbb_eventhallrecord_account_di
sql_units: WITH t_43ad AS (SELECT t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.last_ip, t1.level, t1.ad_position, t1.ad_picture, IF(NOT t2.accountid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_jump, -99999 AS is_drag, '49ad' AS ad_type FROM (SELECT t.accountid, t.zoneid, t.last_ip, MAX(t.level) AS level, t.ad_position, t.ad_picture FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, FIRST_VALUE(`ip`) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, SPLIT(ad_picture, '-')[1] ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS last_ip, level, ad_position, SPLIT(ad_picture, '-')[1] AS ad_picture FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_49ad_data WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, ad_picture, last_ip, ad_position) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, ad_position, SPLIT(ad_picture, '-')[1] AS ad_picture FROM ml_ods.connserver_prompt_data WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, SPLIT(ad_picture, '-')[1], ad_position) AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t1.ad_position = t2.ad_position AND t1.ad_picture = t2.ad_picture), t_23ad AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, last_ip, MAX(level) AS level, ad_position, ad_picture, MAX(IF(controller_typeid <> 0, 1, 0)) AS is_jump, -99999 AS is_drag, '23ad' AS ad_type FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, FIRST_VALUE(ip) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, SPLIT(eventpicid, '-')[1] ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS last_ip, level, ad_position, SPLIT(eventpicid, '-')[1] AS ad_picture, COALESCE(controller_typeid, 0) AS controller_typeid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_new_eventhallrecord WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, ad_picture, last_ip, ad_position), t_128ad AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, last_ip, MAX(level) AS level, ad_position, ad_picture, MAX(IF(is_jump <> 0, 1, 0)) AS is_jump, MAX(IF(isdrag <> 0, 1, 0)) AS isdrag, '128ad' AS ad_type FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, FIRST_VALUE(ip) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, SPLIT(ad_picture, '-')[1] ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS last_ip, level, ad_position, SPLIT(ad_picture, '-')[1] AS ad_picture, COALESCE(isdrag, 0) AS isdrag, COALESCE(isjump, 0) AS is_jump FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_act_noticeads WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, ad_picture, last_ip, ad_position) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_mlbb_eventhallrecord_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM t_43ad UNION ALL SELECT * FROM t_23ad UNION ALL SELECT * FROM t_128ad) AS t

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_battle_mapping_device_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_battle_mapping_device_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT roleid, zoneid, device, deviceid, MAX(battle_cnt) AS battle_cnt, MAX(deviceid_cnt) AS deviceid_cnt, is_active /* BIGINT(MAX(battle_cnt) / MAX(deviceid_cnt)) AS battle_cnt, */ FROM (SELECT t_battle.roleid, t_battle.zoneid, t_battle.device, t_battle.battle_cnt, COALESCE(t_login.deviceid, 'unknown') AS deviceid, COALESCE(t_login.deviceid_cnt, 1) AS deviceid_cnt /* 如果login表没匹配上，就算unknown打的场次 */ /* ,SUM(t_battle.battle_cnt) / max(deviceid_cnt) AS battle_cnt_avg */, IF(t_login.deviceid IS NULL, 0, 1) AS is_active /* 这里用于区分deviceid是因为没匹配上还是原本就是unknown */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device, COUNT(1) AS battle_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(clientdevice, 'unkonwn') AS device, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY SUBSTRING(`time`, 1, 19) DESC, battleresulttype) AS rn FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end /* key : accountid,zoneid,battleid,battleresulttype */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4)) AS t1 WHERE t1.rn = 1 /* 去除重复上报 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, device) AS t_battle LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, device, deviceid, COUNT(deviceid) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, device) AS deviceid_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device, COALESCE(deviceid, 'unknown') AS deviceid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 /* AND channel not in  ("and_bdvp", "and_bdvp_test") */ /* AND is_vp = 0   该字段3月份开始有问题 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'), COALESCE(deviceid, 'unknown')) AS t) AS t_login ON t_battle.roleid = t_login.roleid AND t_battle.zoneid = t_login.zoneid AND t_battle.device = t_login.device) AS t_info GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, device, deviceid, is_active

sql_units: /* 获取近30天所有key和战斗相关指标 */ WITH t_battle_black_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, black_type, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', battle_cnt, 0)) AS battle_cnt_day0, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', invalid_cnt, 0)) AS invalid_cnt_day0, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', win_cnt, 0)) AS win_cnt_day0, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', mvp_cnt, 0)) AS mvp_cnt_day0, SUM(IF(logymd = DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1)) AND logymd >= '2021-01-01' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd), t_rank_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, logymd, his_max_bigranklvl, ('2026-05-31', DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1), DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 2 * -1), DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1), DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 13 * -1), DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1)) AND logymd >= COALESCE(t_battle_black_di.realpvptype, -99999) AS realpvptype, COALESCE(t_battle_black_di.black_type, -99999) AS black_type, register_date_diff, is_battle_day AS is_battle, CASE WHEN active_date_diff = 0 THEN battle_cnt_day0 WHEN active_date_diff = 1 THEN battle_cnt_day1 WHEN active_date_diff = 2 THEN battle_cnt_day2 WHEN active_date_diff = 6 THEN battle_cnt_day6 WHEN active_date_diff = 13 THEN battle_cnt_day13 WHEN active_date_diff = 29 THEN battle_cnt_day29 END AS battle_cnt, CASE WHEN active_date_diff = 0 THEN win_cnt_day0 WHEN active_date_diff = 1 THEN win_cnt_day1 WHEN active_date_diff = 2 THEN win_cnt_day2 WHEN active_date_diff = 6 THEN win_cnt_day6 WHEN active_date_diff = 13 THEN win_cnt_day13 WHEN active_date_diff = 29 THEN win_cnt_day29 END AS win_cnt, CASE WHEN active_date_diff = 0 THEN invalid_cnt_day0 WHEN active_date_diff = 1 THEN invalid_cnt_day1 WHEN active_date_diff = 2 THEN invalid_cnt_day2 WHEN active_date_diff = 6 THEN invalid_cnt_day6 WHEN active_date_diff = 13 THEN invalid_cnt_day13 WHEN active_date_diff = 29 THEN invalid_cnt_day29 END AS invalid_cnt, CASE WHEN active_date_diff = 0 THEN mvp_cnt_day0 WHEN active_date_diff = 1 THEN mvp_cnt_day1 WHEN active_date_diff = 0 THEN hook_cnt_day0 WHEN active_date_diff = 1 THEN hook_cnt_day1 WHEN active_date_diff = 2 THEN hook_cnt_day2 WHEN active_date_diff = 6 THEN hook_cnt_day6 WHEN active_date_diff = 13 THEN hook_cnt_day13 WHEN active_date_diff = 29 THEN hook_cnt_day29 END AS hook_cnt, CASE WHEN active_date_diff = 0 THEN kda_total_day0 WHEN active_date_diff = 1 THEN kda_total_day1 WHEN active_date_diff = 2 THEN kda_total_day2 WHEN active_date_diff = 6 THEN kda_total_day6 WHEN active_date_diff = 13 THEN kda_total_day13 WHEN active_date_diff = 29 THEN kda_total_day29 END AS kda_total, CASE WHEN active_date_diff = 0 THEN battle_dur_day0 WHEN active_date_diff = 1 THEN battle_dur_day1 WHEN active_date_diff = 2 THEN battle_dur_day2 WHEN active_date_diff = 6 THEN battle_dur_day6 WHEN active_date_diff = 13 THEN battle_dur_day13 WHEN active_date_diff = 29 THEN battle_dur_day29 END AS battle_dur, CASE WHEN active_date_diff = 0 THEN battledays_day0 WHEN active_date_diff = 1 THEN battledays_day1 WHEN active_date_diff = 2 THEN battledays_day2 WHEN active_date_diff = 6 THEN battledays_day6 WHEN active_date_diff = 13 THEN battledays_day13 WHEN active_date_diff = 29 THEN battledays_day29 END AS battledays, t_active.logymd, t_active.active_date_diff FROM (SELECT t_active_di.roleid, t_active_di.zoneid, t_active_di.logymd, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', t_active_di.logymd) AS active_date_diff, IF(COALESCE(t_basic.register_date, '1970-01-01') = '1970-01-01', -99999, DATEDIFF(t_active_di.logymd, t_basic.register_date)) AS register_date_diff FROM t_active_di LEFT JOIN t_basic ON t_active_di.roleid = t_basic.roleid AND t_active_di.zoneid = t_basic.zoneid WHERE COALESCE(t_basic.is_ai, t_active_di.is_ai) = 0) AS t_active /* 这里没有先在basic表里排除ai是为了这里判断：先以t_basic.is_ai来看，如果没有的再看t_active_di.is_ai */ LEFT JOIN t_battle_black_di ON t_active.roleid = t_battle_black_di.roleid AND t_active.zoneid = t_battle_black_di.zoneid WHERE CASE WHEN active_date_diff = 0 THEN battledays_day0 WHEN active_date_diff = 1 THEN battledays_day1 WHEN active_date_diff = 2 THEN battledays_day2 WHEN active_date_diff = 6 THEN battledays_day6 WHEN active_date_diff = 13 THEN battledays_day13 WHEN active_date_diff = 29 THEN battledays_day29 END > 0) AS t_act_battle LEFT JOIN t_rank_df ON t_act_battle.roleid = t_rank_df.roleid AND t_act_battle.zoneid = t_rank_df.zoneid AND t_act_battle.logymd = t_rank_df.logymd LEFT JOIN t_act_info ON t_act_battle.roleid = t_act_info.roleid AND t_act_battle.zoneid = t_act_info.zoneid AND t_act_battle.logymd = t_act_info.logymd

sql_units: /* WITH basic AS ( */ /*     SELECT  *, */ /*             DATE_SUB(next_day('2026-05-31', 'SUN'), 6) AS week_start, */ /*             next_day('2026-05-31', 'SUN') AS week_end */ /*     FROM    mt_ads.ads_gamebi_create_guide_path_di */ /*     WHERE   logymd BETWEEN DATE_SUB(next_day('2026-05-31', 'SUN'), 6) AND next_day('2026-05-31', 'SUN') */ /* ) */ WITH basic AS (SELECT *, DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 7 * -1) AS week_start, DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1) AS week_end FROM mt_ads.ads_gamebi_create_guide_path_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 7 * -1) AND DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_create_guide_path_wi PARTITION(logymd) SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', week_start, week_end) AS week_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, guide_path, SUM(guide_path_cnt) AS guide_path_cnt, DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1) AS logymd FROM basic GROUP BY week_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, guide_path DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() AS INT)
