name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_create_guide_path_moni
sql_units: WITH basic AS (SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AS month_start, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS month_end FROM mt_ads.ads_gamebi_create_guide_path_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_create_guide_path_moni PARTITION(logymd) SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', month_start, month_end) AS month_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, guide_path, SUM(guide_path_cnt) AS guide_path_cnt, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS logymd FROM basic GROUP BY month_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, guide_path DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() AS INT)

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_create_moni
sql_units: WITH basic AS (SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AS month_start, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS month_end FROM mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_create_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31')), register AS (SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', month_start, month_end) AS month_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel, register_cnt, 0 AS total_register_cnt FROM basic), total_register AS (SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', month_start, month_end) AS month_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel, 0 AS register_cnt, total_register_cnt FROM basic WHERE logymd = month_end) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_create_moni PARTITION(logymd) SELECT month_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, SUM(register_cnt) AS register_cnt, SUM(total_register_cnt) AS total_register_cnt, channel, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS logymd FROM (SELECT month_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel, register_cnt, total_register_cnt FROM register UNION ALL SELECT month_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel, register_cnt, total_register_cnt FROM total_register) AS t GROUP BY month_range, granularity_type, country, os, network, new_type, channel DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() AS INT)

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_pay_moni
sql_units: WITH pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(product_money) AS day_pay_amount, SUM(before_tax_usd_amt) AS day_pay_amount_exrate FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND zoneid < 57000 AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), active_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND zoneid < 57000 /* AND     is_ai = 0 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), dim_basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, create_os AS os, first_network_name, is_first_create, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS channel, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) > 0 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 30 THEN 1 WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 30 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 90 THEN 2 WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 90 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 360 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS register_days, DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AS month_start, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS month_end FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF(LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') <= '2022-09-01', '2022-09-01', LAST_DAY('2026-05-31')) AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0), pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(MIN(his_first_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_first_pay_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -1)) AND zoneid < 57000 AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_pay_moni PARTITION(logymd) SELECT month_range, granularity_type, first_mt_country AS country, os, first_network_name AS network, register_days, COALESCE(pay_grade, '-1') AS pay_grade, COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt, channel, COALESCE(pay_amt_exrate, 0) AS pay_amount_exrate, COALESCE(new_pay_cnt, 0) AS new_pay_cnt, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS logymd FROM (SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', month_start, month_end) AS month_range, 'role' AS granularity_type, bas.first_mt_country, bas.os, bas.first_network_name, bas.register_days, pay.pay_grade, SUM(COALESCE(pay.day_pay_amount, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(COALESCE(pay.day_pay_amount_exrate, 0)) AS pay_amt_exrate, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.roleid, pay.zoneid) AS pay_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid, act.zoneid) AS active_cnt, bas.channel, SUM(IF(pay_df.roleid IS NULL AND NOT pay.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS new_pay_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM dim_basic_df WHERE zoneid < 57000) AS bas LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, CASE WHEN day_pay_amount / 100 >= 0.99 AND day_pay_amount / 100 < 4.99 THEN '0.99' WHEN day_pay_amount / 100 >= 4.99 AND day_pay_amount / 100 < 9.99 THEN '4.99' WHEN day_pay_amount / 100 >= 9.99 THEN '9.99' ELSE '0' END AS pay_grade FROM pay_di) AS pay ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid AND bas.zoneid = pay.zoneid LEFT JOIN active_di AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid AND bas.zoneid = act.zoneid LEFT JOIN pay_df ON bas.roleid = pay_df.roleid AND bas.zoneid = pay_df.zoneid GROUP BY month_range, bas.first_mt_country, bas.os, bas.first_network_name, bas.register_days, pay.pay_grade, bas.channel UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', month_start, month_end) AS month_range, 'account' AS granularity_type, bas.first_mt_country, bas.os, bas.first_network_name, bas.register_days, pay.pay_grade, SUM(COALESCE(pay.day_pay_amount, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(COALESCE(pay.day_pay_amount_exrate, 0)) AS pay_amt_exrate, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.roleid) AS pay_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid) AS active_cnt, bas.channel, SUM(IF(pay_df.roleid IS NULL AND NOT pay.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS new_pay_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM dim_basic_df WHERE is_first_create = 1) AS bas LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, SUM(day_pay_amount) AS day_pay_amount, SUM(day_pay_amount_exrate) AS day_pay_amount_exrate, CASE WHEN SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 >= 0.99 AND SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 < 4.99 THEN '0.99' WHEN SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 >= 4.99 AND SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 < 9.99 THEN '4.99' WHEN SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 >= 9.99 THEN '9.99' ELSE '0' END AS pay_grade FROM pay_di GROUP BY roleid) AS pay ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM active_di GROUP BY roleid) AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, MIN(his_first_pay_date) AS his_first_pay_date FROM pay_df GROUP BY roleid) AS pay_df ON bas.roleid = pay_df.roleid GROUP BY month_range, bas.first_mt_country, bas.os, bas.first_network_name, bas.register_days, pay.pay_grade, bas.channel) AS t WHERE (pay_amt + pay_amt_exrate + pay_cnt + active_cnt) > 0 DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() AS INT)

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_online_wi
sql_units: WITH online_all AS (SELECT *, DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 7 * -1) AS week_start, DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1) AS week_end FROM mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_online_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 7 * -1) AND DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_online_wi PARTITION(logymd) SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', week_start, week_end) AS week_range, country, os, is_vp, MAX(pcu) AS pcu, ROUND(AVG(acu), 0) AS acu, DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1) AS logymd FROM online_all GROUP BY week_range, country, os, is_vp DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() AS INT)

name: tmp_hero_battles
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_qmzhang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-03-15 18:07:47.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_hero_battles PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT a.heroid /* a.logymd, */, d.hero_name, d.heroes, b.country, c.country, a.pvptype, a.ishavehero, a.is_invalidbattle, a.role_ranklvl /* 角色段位 */, a.game_ranklvl /* 对局段位 */, a.is_repeat_hero, CASE WHEN a.battle_cnt = 1 THEN 1 WHEN a.battle_cnt = 2 THEN 2 WHEN a.battle_cnt = 3 THEN 3 WHEN a.battle_cnt = 4 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS battles, COUNT(DISTINCT a.accountid, a.zoneid) AS user_cnt /* 角色数 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, heroid, pvptype, ishavehero, role_ranklvl, is_invalidbattle, CASE WHEN hero_num = 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_repeat_hero /* 对局英雄是否重复 */, CASE WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '勇士' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '精英' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN '大师' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '宗师' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN '史诗' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN max_minranklvl = 26 THEN '神话V' WHEN max_minranklvl = 27 THEN '神话IV' WHEN max_minranklvl = 28 THEN '神话III' WHEN max_minranklvl = 29 THEN '神话II' WHEN max_minranklvl = 30 THEN '神话I' WHEN max_minranklvl = 31 THEN '荣耀神话' ELSE '无信息' END AS game_ranklvl /* 对局段位 */, COUNT(DISTINCT t.battleid) AS battle_cnt /* 角色使用该英雄战斗的场次 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, heroid, battleid, pvptype, ishavehero, CASE WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '勇士' WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '精英' WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN '大师' WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '宗师' WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN '史诗' WHEN minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN minranklvl = 26 THEN '神话V' WHEN minranklvl = 27 THEN '神话IV' WHEN minranklvl = 28 THEN '神话III' WHEN minranklvl = 29 THEN '神话II' WHEN minranklvl = 30 THEN '神话I' WHEN minranklvl = 31 THEN '荣耀神话' ELSE '无信息' END AS role_ranklvl /* 角色段位 */, CASE WHEN isinvalidbattle = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_invalidbattle /* 是否是流局 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND fake_ai = 0 AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, heroid, battleid, pvptype, ishavehero, role_ranklvl, is_invalidbattle) AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT heroid) AS hero_num, MAX(minranklvl) AS max_minranklvl FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND fake_ai = 0 AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) /* 排位&匹配 */ GROUP BY battleid) AS t1 ON t.battleid = t1.battleid GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, heroid, pvptype, ishavehero, role_ranklvl, is_invalidbattle, is_repeat_hero, game_ranklvl) AS a /* 玩家使用英雄战斗表 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country) AS country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' < '2023-03-14', '2023-03-14', '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, country) AS b /* 玩家维度 */ ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT lower, country FROM mt_dim.dim_national_geographic_atlas_config) AS c /* 国家匹配表 */ ON b.country = c.lower LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, hero_name /* 英雄中文名称 */, CASE WHEN sub_heroes = -9999 THEN heroes ELSE CONCAT(heroes, '\\073', sub_heroes) END AS heroes /* 英雄职业（主定位+次定位） */ FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' < '2023-03-14', '2023-03-14', '2026-05-30')) AS d /* 英雄配置表 */ ON a.heroid = d.heroid GROUP BY a.heroid /* a.logymd, */, d.hero_name, d.heroes, b.country, c.country, a.pvptype, a.ishavehero, a.is_invalidbattle, a.role_ranklvl, a.game_ranklvl, a.is_repeat_hero, battles

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_online_moni
sql_units: WITH online_all AS (SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AS month_start, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS month_end FROM mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_online_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_online_moni PARTITION(logymd) SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', month_start, month_end) AS month_range, country, os, is_vp, MAX(pcu) AS pcu, ROUND(AVG(acu), 0) AS acu, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS logymd FROM online_all GROUP BY month_range, country, os, is_vp DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() AS INT)

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_pay_wi
sql_units: WITH pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(product_money) AS day_pay_amount, SUM(before_tax_usd_amt) AS day_pay_amount_exrate FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 7 * -1) AND DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1) AND zoneid < 57000 AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), active_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 7 * -1) AND DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1) AND zoneid < 57000 /* AND     is_ai = 0 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), dim_basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, create_os AS os, first_network_name, is_first_create, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS channel, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) > 0 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 30 THEN 1 WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 30 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 90 THEN 2 WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) >= 90 AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 360 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS register_days, DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 7 * -1) AS week_start, DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1) AS week_end FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF(DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1) <= '2022-09-01', '2022-09-01', DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1)) AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0), pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(MIN(his_first_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_first_pay_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-24' AND zoneid < 57000 AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_pay_wi PARTITION(logymd) SELECT week_range, granularity_type, first_mt_country AS country, os, first_network_name AS network, register_days, COALESCE(pay_grade, '-1') AS pay_grade, COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt, channel, COALESCE(pay_amt_exrate, 0) AS pay_amount_exrate, COALESCE(new_pay_cnt, 0) AS new_pay_cnt, DATE_ADD(NEXT_DAY('2026-05-31', 'MO'), 1 * -1) AS logymd FROM (SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', week_start, week_end) AS week_range, 'role' AS granularity_type, bas.first_mt_country, bas.os, bas.first_network_name, bas.register_days, pay.pay_grade, SUM(COALESCE(pay.day_pay_amount, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(COALESCE(pay.day_pay_amount_exrate, 0)) AS pay_amt_exrate, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.roleid, pay.zoneid) AS pay_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid, act.zoneid) AS active_cnt, bas.channel, SUM(IF(pay_df.roleid IS NULL AND NOT pay.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS new_pay_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM dim_basic_df WHERE zoneid < 57000) AS bas LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, CASE WHEN day_pay_amount / 100 >= 0.99 AND day_pay_amount / 100 < 4.99 THEN '0.99' WHEN day_pay_amount / 100 >= 4.99 AND day_pay_amount / 100 < 9.99 THEN '4.99' WHEN day_pay_amount / 100 >= 9.99 THEN '9.99' ELSE '0' END AS pay_grade FROM pay_di) AS pay ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid AND bas.zoneid = pay.zoneid LEFT JOIN active_di AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid AND bas.zoneid = act.zoneid LEFT JOIN pay_df ON bas.roleid = pay_df.roleid AND bas.zoneid = pay_df.zoneid GROUP BY week_range, bas.first_mt_country, bas.os, bas.first_network_name, bas.register_days, pay.pay_grade, bas.channel UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', week_start, week_end) AS week_range, 'account' AS granularity_type, bas.first_mt_country, bas.os, bas.first_network_name, bas.register_days, pay.pay_grade, SUM(COALESCE(pay.day_pay_amount, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(COALESCE(pay.day_pay_amount_exrate, 0)) AS pay_amt_exrate, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.roleid) AS pay_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid) AS active_cnt, bas.channel, SUM(IF(pay_df.roleid IS NULL AND NOT pay.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS new_pay_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM dim_basic_df WHERE is_first_create = 1) AS bas LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, SUM(day_pay_amount) AS day_pay_amount, SUM(day_pay_amount_exrate) AS day_pay_amount_exrate, CASE WHEN SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 >= 0.99 AND SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 < 4.99 THEN '0.99' WHEN SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 >= 4.99 AND SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 < 9.99 THEN '4.99' WHEN SUM(day_pay_amount) / 100 >= 9.99 THEN '9.99' ELSE '0' END AS pay_grade FROM pay_di GROUP BY roleid) AS pay ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM active_di GROUP BY roleid) AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, MIN(his_first_pay_date) AS his_first_pay_date FROM pay_df GROUP BY roleid) AS pay_df ON bas.roleid = pay_df.roleid GROUP BY week_range, bas.first_mt_country, bas.os, bas.first_network_name, bas.register_days, pay.pay_grade, bas.channel) AS t WHERE (pay_amt + pay_amt_exrate + pay_cnt + active_cnt) > 0 DISTRIBUTE BY CAST(RAND() AS INT)

name: etl.msdk_ads.ads_role_zone_retention_df
sql_units: /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_ads.ads_pay_role_zone_retention_df ( */ /*             roleid STRING COMMENT '游戏角色ID', */ /*             zoneid STRING COMMENT '区服ID', */ /*             package_name         STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名', */ /*             os                   STRING COMMENT '操作系统', */ /*             createdate           STRING COMMENT '新增设备时间', */ /*             first_mt_country     STRING COMMENT '首次归因国家', */ /*             first_media_source   STRING COMMENT '首次归因渠道', */ /*             client_version       STRING COMMENT '安装的游戏客户端版本', */ /*             is_pay_device        int    COMMENT '是否付费设备', */ /*             active_info          STRING COMMENT '活跃位图' */ /*         ) COMMENT '设备付费活跃全量表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY */ /*         (logymd STRING COMMENT '数据日期yyyy-MM-dd', app_id STRING COMMENT '应用唯一ID') STORED AS PARQUET; */ /* 活跃DWM表(指标：活跃，在线时长，登录次数) */ WITH active_role_zone AS (SELECT package_name, roleid, zoneid, app_id, active_info, os FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT COALESCE(roleid, zoneid) IS NULL), pay_role_zone /* 付费DWM表(指标：付费设备数，付费金额，订单数) */ AS (SELECT package_name, roleid, zoneid, app_id, os FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT COALESCE(roleid, zoneid) IS NULL GROUP BY package_name, roleid, zoneid, app_id, os), basic AS (SELECT package_name, appid AS app_id, roleid, zoneid, createdate, first_mt_country, first_media_source, os, client_version FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT COALESCE(roleid, zoneid) IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_ads.ads_pay_role_zone_retention_df PARTITION(logymd, app_id) SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.createdate, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source, t1.client_version, IF(t2.roleid IS NULL, 0, 1) AS is_pay_device, t3.active_info, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.app_id FROM basic AS t1 LEFT JOIN pay_role_zone AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t1.package_name = t2.package_name AND t1.os = t2.os LEFT JOIN active_role_zone AS t3 ON t1.app_id = t3.app_id AND t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND t1.package_name = t3.package_name AND t1.os = t3.os DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: export_bytedance.db_bytedance.gameserver_m4_chest_draw
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.gameserver_m4_chest_draw PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, level, activityid, drawnum, quality, reward_id, reward_num, curticket, curbattle_points, curdiamond, chargediamond FROM (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, level, activityid, drawnum, quality, reward_id, reward_num, curticket, curbattle_points, curdiamond, chargediamond, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_m4_chest_draw WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(createrole_country, '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS md LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_account FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-07', '2022-05-07', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON md.roleid = adv_us.us_account WHERE adv_us.us_account IS NULL

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_mla_resource_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH main_data AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(type_name = 'diamond_get_cnt', type_value, 0)) AS diamond_get_cnt, SUM(IF(type_name = 'diamond_consume_cnt', type_value, 0)) AS diamond_consume_cnt, SUM(IF(type_name = 'coin_get_cnt', type_value, 0)) AS coin_get_cnt, SUM(IF(type_name = 'coin_consume_cnt', type_value, 0)) AS coin_consume_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, 'diamond_get_cnt' AS type_name, SUM(add_num) AS type_value FROM mh_ods.gameserver_add_diamond WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, 'diamond_consume_cnt' AS type_name, SUM(sub_num) AS type_value FROM mh_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, 'coin_get_cnt' AS type_name, SUM(add_num) AS type_value FROM mh_ods.gameserver_add_coin WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, 'coin_consume_cnt' AS type_name, SUM(sub_num) AS type_vlaue FROM mh_ods.gameserver_sub_coin WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), item_get AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(item_id, ':', add_num))), ',', ':') AS item_get_cnt_map FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, SUM(add_num) AS add_num FROM mh_ods.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), item_sub AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(item_id, ':', sub_num))), ',', ':') AS item_consume_cnt_map FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num FROM mh_ods.gameserver_sub_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), all_user AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM main_data UNION SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM item_get UNION SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM item_sub) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_mla_resource_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT au.roleid, au.zoneid, COALESCE(md.diamond_get_cnt, 0) AS diamond_get_cnt, COALESCE(md.diamond_consume_cnt, 0) AS diamond_consume_cnt, COALESCE(md.coin_get_cnt, 0) AS coin_get_cnt, COALESCE(md.coin_consume_cnt, 0) AS coin_consume_cnt, COALESCE(CAST(ig.item_get_cnt_map AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>), CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>)) AS item_get_cnt_map, COALESCE(CAST(its.item_consume_cnt_map AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>), CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>)) AS item_consume_cnt_map FROM all_user AS au LEFT JOIN main_data AS md ON au.roleid = md.roleid AND au.zoneid = md.zoneid LEFT JOIN item_get AS ig ON au.roleid = ig.roleid AND au.zoneid = ig.zoneid LEFT JOIN item_sub AS its ON au.roleid = its.roleid AND au.zoneid = its.zoneid

name: etl.msdk_dim.dim_step_action_device_di
sql_units: WITH all_user AS (SELECT did, package_name, app_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.setp') AS step_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.action') AS action_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.setp'), GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.action') ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS row_num FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('create_filter') AND NOT did IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dim.dim_step_action_device_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid) SELECT did, package_name, step_id, action_name, app_id FROM all_user WHERE row_num = 1 DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_main_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH t_main_acct AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(is_main) AS is_main FROM mt_dim.dim_id_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_act AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, 1 AS is_act FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_pay AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, 1 AS is_pay FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(register_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_register FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31') AND zoneid < 57000) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_dim`.`dim_main_role_zone_df` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT t_main_acct.roleid, t_main_acct.zoneid, t_main_acct.is_main, COALESCE(t_act.is_act, 0) AS is_act, COALESCE(t_pay.is_pay, 0) AS is_pay, COALESCE(t_basic.is_register, 0) AS is_register FROM t_main_acct LEFT JOIN t_act ON t_main_acct.roleid = t_act.roleid AND t_main_acct.zoneid = t_act.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_pay ON t_main_acct.roleid = t_pay.roleid AND t_main_acct.zoneid = t_pay.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_basic ON t_main_acct.roleid = t_basic.roleid AND t_main_acct.zoneid = t_basic.zoneid

AS adv_us ON main_data.roleid = adv_us.us_account WHERE adv_us.us_account IS NULL

name: tmp_gameusediskspace_aggregated
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_gameusediskspace_aggregated PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT zone_type, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) = 0 THEN '新增用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) <= 29 THEN '新用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) >= 30 THEN '老用户' ELSE '无信息' END AS user_type /* 用户类型 */, PERCENTILE(gameusediskspace, 0.5) AS mid_space, PERCENTILE(gameusediskspace, 0.75) AS 75_space FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, gameusediskspace, CASE WHEN zoneid < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END AS zone_type FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND gameusediskspace <> 0 /* 0是因为ios接口问题，取不到数 */) AS a /* 战斗结束性能打点表 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, register_date) AS b /* 玩家属性表 */ ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY zone_type, user_type

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_active_resource_social_di_role
sql_units: /* -大小号-99999 */ /* 资源，亲密关系用0兜底，其他-99999 */ /* 但在实际计算人数/收入时，不对57服的角色进行计入 */ /* 剔除没有活跃用户的数据 */ WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country, create_os AS os, first_network_name AS network, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-05-06', '2022-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 AND is_ai = 0), resource_info /* 资源分级 */ /* (0；[1:3)；[3-7)；[7-10)；[10: ) ) */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN ri.skin_num <= 0 OR ri.skin_num IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN ri.skin_num >= 1 AND ri.skin_num < 3 THEN 1 WHEN ri.skin_num >= 3 AND ri.skin_num < 7 THEN 2 WHEN ri.skin_num >= 7 AND ri.skin_num < 10 THEN 3 WHEN ri.skin_num >= 10 THEN 4 END AS skin_cnt_grade, CASE WHEN ri.hero_num <= 0 OR ri.hero_num IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN ri.hero_num >= 1 AND ri.hero_num < 3 THEN 1 WHEN ri.hero_num >= 3 AND ri.hero_num < 7 THEN 2 WHEN ri.hero_num >= 7 AND ri.hero_num < 10 THEN 3 WHEN ri.hero_num >= 10 THEN 4 END AS hero_cnt_grade FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(CASE WHEN resource_type = 'skin' THEN resource_id ELSE NULL END) AS skin_num, COUNT(CASE WHEN resource_type = 'hero' THEN resource_id ELSE NULL END) AS hero_num FROM mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS ri), pay_info /* 位图只有一周的数据 */ /* 有付费的玩家需要判断下任务日期内玩家的付费情况 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, 1 AS is_pay FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(his_pay_amt) AS pay_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 AND his_pay_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 WHERE pay_amt > 0), social_info /* 亲密关系分级 */ /* (0；[1:3)；[3-7)；[7-10)；[10: ) ) */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN si.friend_num <= 0 OR si.friend_num IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN si.friend_num >= 1 AND si.friend_num < 5 THEN 1 WHEN si.friend_num >= 5 AND si.friend_num < 10 THEN 2 WHEN si.friend_num >= 10 AND si.friend_num < 20 THEN 3 WHEN si.friend_num >= 20 AND si.friend_num < 30 THEN 4 WHEN si.friend_num >= 30 AND si.friend_num < 40 THEN 5 WHEN si.friend_num >= 40 AND si.friend_num < 50 THEN 6 WHEN si.friend_num >= 50 AND si.friend_num < 60 THEN 7 WHEN si.friend_num >= 60 AND si.friend_num < 70 THEN 8 WHEN si.friend_num >= 70 THEN 9 END AS friend_cnt_grade, si.love_num AS lovers_cnt_grade, si.brother_num AS brother_cnt_grade, si.sister_num AS sisters_cnt_grade, si.close_num AS close_friend_cnt_grade FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SIZE(SPLIT(his_last_friend_intimacy_json, ',')) AS friend_num, SIZE(lovers_id_array) AS love_num, SIZE(brother_id_array) AS brother_num, SIZE(sisters_id_array) AS sister_num, SIZE(close_friend_id_array) AS close_num FROM mt_dwm.dwm_social_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2021-09-28', '2021-09-28', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57) AS si), is_main AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(is_main) AS is_main FROM mt_dim.dim_id_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), lose_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, lose_days FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 AND /* 7，30流失 ，且当天回流 */ recurring_date = '2026-05-31' AND lose_days >= 30), active_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_active_resource_social_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'role') SELECT country, zoneid, os, network, is_main, new_type, is_pay, skin_cnt_grade, hero_cnt_grade, friend_cnt_grade, lovers_cnt_grade, brother_cnt_grade, sisters_cnt_grade, close_friend_cnt_grade, active_cnt FROM (SELECT country, zoneid, os, network, is_main, new_type, is_pay, skin_cnt_grade, hero_cnt_grade, friend_cnt_grade, lovers_cnt_grade, brother_cnt_grade, sisters_cnt_grade, close_friend_cnt_grade, COUNT(DISTINCT active_role, active_zone) AS active_cnt FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, ai.roleid AS active_role, ai.zoneid AS active_zone, a.country, a.os, a.network, COALESCE(im.is_main, -99999) AS is_main, CASE WHEN NOT li.roleid IS NULL AND lose_days >= 30 THEN 'lose30d' WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) <= 30 THEN 'new' ELSE 'old' END AS new_type /* 流失玩家分类 */, COALESCE(py.is_pay, -99999) AS is_pay, COALESCE(ri.skin_cnt_grade, 0) AS skin_cnt_grade, COALESCE(ri.hero_cnt_grade, 0) AS hero_cnt_grade, COALESCE(si.friend_cnt_grade, 0) AS friend_cnt_grade, COALESCE(si.lovers_cnt_grade, 0) AS lovers_cnt_grade, COALESCE(si.brother_cnt_grade, 0) AS brother_cnt_grade, COALESCE(si.sisters_cnt_grade, 0) AS sisters_cnt_grade, COALESCE(si.close_friend_cnt_grade, 0) AS close_friend_cnt_grade FROM basic AS a LEFT JOIN active_info AS ai ON a.roleid = ai.roleid AND a.zoneid = ai.zoneid LEFT JOIN resource_info AS ri ON a.roleid = ri.roleid AND a.zoneid = ri.zoneid LEFT JOIN pay_info AS py ON a.roleid = py.roleid AND a.zoneid = py.zoneid LEFT JOIN social_info AS si ON a.roleid = si.roleid AND a.zoneid = si.zoneid LEFT JOIN is_main AS im ON a.roleid = im.roleid AND a.zoneid = im.zoneid LEFT JOIN lose_info AS li ON a.roleid = li.roleid AND a.zoneid = li.zoneid) AS t1 GROUP BY country, zoneid, os, network, new_type, is_main, is_pay, skin_cnt_grade, hero_cnt_grade, friend_cnt_grade, lovers_cnt_grade, brother_cnt_grade, sisters_cnt_grade, close_friend_cnt_grade) AS t2 WHERE active_cnt > 0

name: tmp_download_completerate_user
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_download_completerate_user PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-29') SELECT tb4.zone_type, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(tb4.logymd, tb5.register_date) = 0 THEN '新增用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(tb4.logymd, tb5.register_date) <= 29 THEN '新用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(tb4.logymd, tb5.register_date) >= 30 THEN '老用户' ELSE '无信息' END AS user_type /* 用户类型 */, COUNT(DISTINCT tb4.accountid, tb4.zoneid) AS user_cnt /* 每日登录人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (tb4.download_flag = 0 AND tb4.first_login_downloadprocess = 1) OR tb4.download_flag = 1 THEN CONCAT(tb4.accountid, tb4.zoneid) END) AS complete_user_cnt /* 每日增量下载完成人数 */ FROM (SELECT tb1.logymd, tb1.accountid, tb1.zoneid, tb1.zone_type, tb1.download_flag, tb3.first_login_downloadprocess FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN zoneid < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END AS zone_type, MAX(downloadprocess) AS download_flag FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_loginloading_game WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, zone_type) AS tb1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT tb2.accountid, tb2.zoneid, tb2.first_login_downloadprocess FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, FIRST_VALUE(downloadprocess) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY `time`) AS first_login_downloadprocess FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_loginloading_game WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' /* 往后匹配2天 */) AS tb2 /* 玩家在匹配的2天内首次登录时的数据 */ WHERE first_login_downloadprocess = 1 /* 首次登录时增量下载完成 */ GROUP BY tb2.accountid, tb2.zoneid, tb2.first_login_downloadprocess) AS tb3 /* 在匹配的2天内首次登录时增量下载已完成的玩家 */ ON tb1.accountid = tb3.accountid AND tb1.zoneid = tb3.zoneid GROUP BY tb1.logymd, tb1.accountid, tb1.zoneid, tb1.zone_type, tb1.download_flag, tb3.first_login_downloadprocess) AS tb4 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-29' <= '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-29') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, register_date) AS tb5 ON tb4.accountid = tb5.roleid AND tb4.zoneid = tb5.zoneid GROUP BY tb4.zone_type, user_type

name: tmp_download_completerate_grading
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_download_completerate_grading PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-29') SELECT tb4.zone_type, CASE WHEN tb5.gradingid IN (0, 5) THEN '全量包' WHEN tb5.gradingid = 1 THEN '1档包' WHEN tb5.gradingid = 2 THEN '2档包' WHEN tb5.gradingid = 3 THEN '3档包' WHEN tb5.gradingid = 4 THEN '4档包' ELSE '无信息' END AS grading_type /* 分档包类型 */, COUNT(DISTINCT tb4.accountid, tb4.zoneid) AS user_cnt /* 每日登录人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (tb4.download_flag = 0 AND tb4.first_login_downloadprocess = 1) OR tb4.download_flag = 1 THEN CONCAT(tb4.accountid, tb4.zoneid) END) AS complete_user_cnt /* 每日增量下载完成人数 */ FROM (SELECT tb1.logymd, tb1.accountid, tb1.zoneid, tb1.zone_type, tb1.download_flag, tb2.first_login_downloadprocess FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN zoneid < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END AS zone_type, MAX(downloadprocess) AS download_flag FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_loginloading_game WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, zone_type) AS tb1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT tb3.accountid, tb3.zoneid, tb3.first_login_downloadprocess FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, FIRST_VALUE(downloadprocess) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY `time`) AS first_login_downloadprocess FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_loginloading_game WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' /* 往后匹配2天 */) AS tb3 /* 玩家在匹配的2天内首次登录时的数据 */ WHERE first_login_downloadprocess = 1 /* 首次登录时增量下载完成 */ GROUP BY tb3.accountid, tb3.zoneid, tb3.first_login_downloadprocess) AS tb2 /* 在匹配的2天内首次登录时增量下载已完成的玩家 */ ON tb1.accountid = tb2.accountid AND tb1.zoneid = tb2.zoneid GROUP BY tb1.logymd, tb1.accountid, tb1.zoneid, tb1.zone_type, tb1.download_flag, tb2.first_login_downloadprocess) AS tb4 LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, gradingid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_grading_userinfo WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29' AND gradingid <= 5 /* 去除脏数据 */ GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, gradingid) AS tb5 /* 分档功能打点表（最早日期分区2022-09-13） */ ON tb4.accountid = tb5.accountid AND tb4.zoneid = tb5.zoneid GROUP BY tb4.zone_type, grading_type

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df.mla
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: fuxinwang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-02-13 00:00:00.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* time             owner                 comment */ /* 20230607         fuxinwang             修正attr_logymd处理逻辑 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  TABLE mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df( */ /*    accountid              decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '账号id', */ /*    account_register_time  string         COMMENT '首次创建账号时间', */ /*    account_register_date  string         COMMENT '首次创建账号日期', */ /*    his_first_deviceid     string         COMMENT '首次创建账号设备id', */ /*    role_register_date     string         COMMENT '首次创建角色日期', */ /*    first_create_ip        string         COMMENT '首次创角IP', */ /*    first_ad_country       string         COMMENT '首次归因国家', */ /*    last_ad_country        string         COMMENT '末次归因国家', */ /*    os_country             string         COMMENT '设备创号国', */ /*    first_ip_country       string         COMMENT '首次创角IP国', */ /*    first_mt_country       string         COMMENT '首次创号国', */ /*    last_mt_country        string         COMMENT '末次创号国', */ /*    first_network_name     string         COMMENT '首次广告渠道', */ /*    last_network_name      string         COMMENT '末次广告渠道', */ /*    os_type                int            COMMENT '首次创建账号操作系统类型', */ /*    os                     string         COMMENT '首次创建账号操作系统名称（ios:os_type=1，android:os_type=2，emulator:os_type=3，unknown:os_type=其他）', */ /*    ad_os                  int            COMMENT 'adjust归因平台', */ /*    attr_logymd            string         COMMENT 'adjust归因日期', */ /*    adjust_campaign_id     string         COMMENT '广告计划id', */ /*    adjust_campaign_name   string         COMMENT '广告计划名称', */ /*    area_id                string         COMMENT '区域', */ /*    adjust_adset_name      string         COMMENT 'adjust归因Adset名字', */ /*    adjust_adset_id        string         COMMENT 'adjust归因Adset的ID', */ /*    adjust_creative_name   string         COMMENT 'adjust归因Creative的名字', */ /*    adjust_creative_id     string         COMMENT 'adjust归因Creative的ID', */ /*    game_channel           string         COMMENT 'adjust归因登录渠道', */ /*    create_device          string         COMMENT '首次创建账号对应设备型号', */ /*    role_create_device     string         COMMENT '创建首服角色对应设备型号', */ /*    is_pure                string         COMMENT '账号纯净新增，1是0否' */ /* ) COMMENT '账户归因数据' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*    logymd string COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd', */ /*    appid string COMMENT '游戏id' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dim/table/dim_attr_account_df' */ /* ; */ /* CREATE  TEMPORARY function geoip AS 'com.moonton.spark.hive.GeoUDF' USING   jar 'hdfs://vpc-minibase/dp/dorado/udf/100000087/100000087.jar'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_attr_df_mla_hdfs PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT accountid, account_register_time /* appid, */, account_register_date, his_first_deviceid, role_register_date, first_create_ip, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, os_country, first_ip_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, os_type, os, ad_os, attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, create_device FROM mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mla'

WITH user_di AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.logymd, a.appid, a.deviceid, a.device_name, a.os_type, CASE WHEN a.os_type = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN a.os_type = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN a.os_type = 3 THEN 'emulator' ELSE 'unknown' END AS os, LOWER(b.country_code) AS os_country, a.`time` FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY appid, accountid ORDER BY `time`, COALESCE(country, 'unknown')) AS rn /* 增加country排序，保证非随机获取，避免回溯数据变化 */ FROM (SELECT accountid, logymd, 'mla' AS appid, TRIM(account_name) AS deviceid, COALESCE(TRIM(device_name), 'unknown') AS device_name, os_type, LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('', '-'), NULL, TRIM(country))) AS country, `time` FROM mh_ods.accountserver_account_create AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS aa) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.config_country) AS b ON a.country = b.country_code WHERE a.rn = 1), role_df AS (SELECT roleid AS rid, zoneid AS zid, MIN(logymd) FROM mh_ods.gameserver_create_role WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid HAVING MIN(logymd) = '2026-05-31'), role_di AS (SELECT appid, roleid, client_ip, ip_country, role_register_date FROM (SELECT appid, roleid, client_ip, logymd AS role_register_date, LOWER(IF(TRIM(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))) = '-', NULL, TRIM(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))))) AS ip_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY `time`, zoneid, client_ip) AS rn FROM (SELECT 'mla' AS appid, roleid, IF(`ip` IN ('-', ''), NULL, `ip`) AS client_ip, `time`, zoneid, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_create_role AS a JOIN role_df AS b ON a.roleid = b.rid AND a.zoneid = b.zid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t) AS tt WHERE rn = 1), user_df AS (SELECT *, IF(account_register_date = role_register_date, first_ip_country, NULL) AS account_role_ip_country /* 账号创建日期=账号创建首个日期，保证回溯时国家不变 */, IF(NOT os_country IN ('us', 'gb'), os_country, NULL) AS mt_os_country /* 当os_country用户为us和gb时，mt_country不参考该字段的归因，直接进入第三优先级ip来判定 */ FROM (SELECT COALESCE(di.accountid, df.accountid) AS accountid, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.account_register_date ELSE di.logymd END AS account_register_date /* coalesce(di.appid,df.appid) as appid, */, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.account_register_time ELSE di.`time` END AS account_register_time, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.his_first_deviceid ELSE di.deviceid END AS his_first_deviceid, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.os_country ELSE di.os_country END AS os_country, COALESCE(df.role_register_date, role_di.role_register_date) AS role_register_date, CASE WHEN NOT df.role_register_date IS NULL THEN df.first_create_ip ELSE role_di.client_ip END AS first_create_ip, CASE WHEN NOT df.role_register_date IS NULL THEN df.first_ip_country ELSE role_di.ip_country END AS first_ip_country, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.os_type ELSE di.os_type END AS os_type, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.os ELSE di.os END AS os, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.create_device ELSE di.device_name END AS create_device, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, ad_os, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel FROM user_di AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT accountid, account_register_date /* appid, */, account_register_time, his_first_deviceid, IF(os_country = 'unknown', NULL, os_country) AS os_country, os_type, os, IF(role_register_date = '1970-01-01', NULL, role_register_date) AS role_register_date, first_create_ip, IF(first_ip_country = 'unknown', NULL, first_ip_country) AS first_ip_country, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, ad_os, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, create_device FROM bi_test.dim_attr_df_mla_hdfs WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df ON di.accountid = df.accountid LEFT JOIN role_di ON COALESCE(di.accountid, df.accountid) = role_di.roleid) AS a), adv AS (SELECT appid, accountid, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, ad_os, NULL) AS ad_os, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, attr_logymd, NULL) AS attr_logymd, IF(logymd = attr_logymd, adjust_country, NULL) AS first_ad_country, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_country, NULL) AS last_ad_country, IF(logymd = attr_logymd, adjust_network_name, NULL) AS first_network_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_network_name, NULL) AS last_network_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, NULL) AS adjust_campaign_id, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_name, NULL) AS adjust_campaign_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_adset_name, NULL) AS adjust_adset_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_adset_id, NULL) AS adjust_adset_id, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_creative_name, NULL) AS adjust_creative_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_creative_id, NULL) AS adjust_creative_id, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, game_channel, NULL) AS game_channel FROM (SELECT appid, accountid, logymd, attr_logymd, os_type AS ad_os, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, game_channel, LOWER(IF(TRIM(adjust_country) IN ('-', ''), NULL, TRIM(adjust_country))) AS adjust_country, LOWER(IF(TRIM(adjust_network_name) IN ('-', ''), NULL, TRIM(adjust_network_name))) AS adjust_network_name FROM mt_dwd.dwd_account_attribution_df WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND appid = 'mla') AS a), result_info AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.account_register_time, a.account_register_date, a.his_first_deviceid, COALESCE(a.role_register_date, '1970-01-01') AS role_register_date, a.first_create_ip, COALESCE(a.first_ad_country, adv.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(adv.last_ad_country, 'unknown') AS last_ad_country, COALESCE(a.os_country, 'unknown') AS os_country, COALESCE(a.first_ip_country, 'unknown') AS first_ip_country, COALESCE(a.first_mt_country, adv.first_ad_country, a.mt_os_country, a.account_role_ip_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(adv.last_ad_country, a.mt_os_country, a.first_ip_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, report_date */ /* from adbi.dim_ad_set_name_df where p_date = '2026-04-13' */ /* and lower(media_source) not like '%applovin%' */ /* and lower(media_source) not like '%unity%' */ /* and lower(media_source) not like '%mintegral%' */ /* union all */ /* select */ /* app_id, */ /* media_source, */ /* campaign_id as adset_id, */ /* campaign_name as adset_name, */ /* pull_date, */ /* report_date */ /* from adbi.dim_campaign_name_df where p_date = '2026-04-13' */ /* and (lower(media_source) like '%applovin%' */ /* or lower(media_source) like '%unity%' */ /* or lower(media_source) like '%mintegral%') */ WITH cost_table AS (SELECT app_id, media_source, adset_id, adset_name, p_date AS pull_date, report_date FROM (SELECT app_id, media_source, adset_id, adset_name, p_date, report_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, media_source, adset_id ORDER BY p_date DESC, report_date DESC) AS rn FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwa_admkt_api_ad_cost_report_df)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND NOT app_id IN ('unknown', '') AND NOT app_id IS NULL AND NOT LOWER(media_source) IN ('unknown', '', 'organic') AND NOT media_source IS NULL AND NOT adset_id IN ('unknown', '') AND NOT adset_id IS NULL AND NOT adset_name IN ('unknown', '') AND NOT adset_name IS NULL) WHERE rn = 1), attrib_table AS (SELECT t.app_id, t.media_source, t.adset_id, t.adset_name, t.pull_date, t.report_date FROM (SELECT k.app_id, k.media_source, k.adset_id, k.adset_name, k.p_date AS pull_date, k.report_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k.app_id, k.media_source, k.adset_id ORDER BY k.p_date DESC, report_date DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT app_id, MAPPING('media_source', network_name) AS media_source, adgroup_id AS adset_id, adgroup_name AS adset_name, p_date, TIME AS report_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_adjust_attribution_di)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND p_date = DATE(TIME) AND NOT app_id IN ('unknown', '') AND NOT app_id IS NULL AND NOT LOWER(network_name) IN ('unknown', '', 'organic') AND NOT network_name IS NULL AND NOT adgroup_id IN ('unknown', '') AND NOT adgroup_id IS NULL AND NOT adgroup_name IN ('unknown', '') AND NOT adgroup_name IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT app_id, MAPPING('media_source', network_name) AS media_source, adgroup_id AS adset_id, adgroup_name AS adset_name, p_date, TIME AS report_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_msdk_install_di)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND p_date = SUBSTRING(time, 1, 10) AND NOT app_id IN ('unknown', '') AND NOT app_id IS NULL AND NOT LOWER(network_name) IN ('unknown', '', 'organic') AND NOT network_name IS NULL AND NOT adgroup_id IN ('unknown', '') AND NOT adgroup_id IS NULL AND NOT adgroup_name IN ('unknown', '') AND NOT adgroup_name IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT app_id, MAPPING('media_source', media_source) AS media_source, adgroup_id AS adset_id, adgroup_name AS adset_name, logymd AS p_date, FROM_UNIXTIME(attr_time / 1000) AS report_date FROM msdk_dim.dim_attribution_create_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd = FROM_UNIXTIME(attr_time / 1000, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT app_id IN ('unknown', '') AND NOT app_id IS NULL AND NOT LOWER(media_source) IN ('unknown', '', 'organic') AND NOT media_source IS NULL AND NOT adgroup_id IN ('unknown', '') AND NOT adgroup_id IS NULL AND NOT adgroup_name IN ('unknown', '') AND NOT adgroup_name IS NULL) AS k) AS t WHERE t.rn = 1), coalesce_table AS (SELECT COALESCE(a.app_id, b.app_id) AS app_id, COALESCE(a.media_source, b.media_source) AS media_source, COALESCE(a.adset_id, b.adset_id) AS adset_id, COALESCE(a.adset_name, b.adset_name) AS adset_name, COALESCE(a.pull_date, b.pull_date) AS pull_date, COALESCE(a.report_date, b.report_date) AS report_date FROM cost_table AS a FULL OUTER JOIN attrib_table AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.media_source = b.media_source AND a.adset_id = b.adset_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_ad_set_name_df_out)) SELECT COALESCE(b.app_id, a.app_id) AS app_id, COALESCE(b.media_source, a.media_source) AS media_source, COALESCE(b.adset_id, a.adset_id) AS adset_id, COALESCE(b.adset_name, a.adset_name) AS adset_name, COALESCE(b.pull_date, a.pull_date) AS pull_date, COALESCE(b.report_date, a.report_date) AS report_date FROM (SELECT c.app_id, c.media_source, c.adset_id, c.adset_name, c.pull_date, c.report_date FROM (SELECT app_id, MAPPING('media_source', media_source) AS media_source, adset_id, adset_name, pull_date, report_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, MAPPING('media_source', media_source), adset_id ORDER BY pull_date DESC, report_date DESC) AS rn FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_ad_set_name_df_in)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30') AS c WHERE c.rn = 1) AS a FULL OUTER JOIN coalesce_table AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.media_source = b.media_source AND a.adset_id = b.adset_id

name: 1_adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df
sql_units: WITH dm_predict_revenue_df AS (SELECT t1.app_id, t1.device_id, IF(t1.is_predict_date = 1, ARRAY(FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', t1.predict_revenue_30), FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', t1.predict_revenue_60), FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', t1.predict_revenue_90), FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', t1.predict_revenue_120), FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', t1.predict_revenue_150), FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', t1.predict_revenue_180), FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', t1.predict_revenue_210), FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', t1.predict_revenue_240), FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', t1.predict_revenue_270), FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', t1.predict_revenue_300), FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', t1.predict_revenue_330), FORMAT_STRING('%.4f', t1.predict_revenue_360)), NULL) AS predict_revenue_amount_30_360_interval30_list FROM (SELECT a.app_id AS app_id, a.device_id AS device_id, IF(NOT c.predict_date IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_predict_date, SUM(COALESCE(predict_revenue_30, 0.0)) AS predict_revenue_30, SUM(COALESCE(predict_revenue_60, 0.0)) AS predict_revenue_60, SUM(COALESCE(predict_revenue_90, 0.0)) AS predict_revenue_90, SUM(COALESCE(predict_revenue_120, 0.0)) AS predict_revenue_120, SUM(COALESCE(predict_revenue_150, 0.0)) AS predict_revenue_150, SUM(COALESCE(predict_revenue_180, 0.0)) AS predict_revenue_180, SUM(COALESCE(predict_revenue_210, 0.0)) AS predict_revenue_210, SUM(COALESCE(predict_revenue_240, 0.0)) AS predict_revenue_240, SUM(COALESCE(predict_revenue_270, 0.0)) AS predict_revenue_270, SUM(COALESCE(predict_revenue_300, 0.0)) AS predict_revenue_300, SUM(COALESCE(predict_revenue_330, 0.0)) AS predict_revenue_330, SUM(COALESCE(predict_revenue_360, 0.0)) AS predict_revenue_360 FROM (SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_device_account_df)) WHERE app_id = '1001' AND p_date = '2026-05-31' AND is_error_device = 0) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY p_date DESC) AS rn FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_revenue_predict_account_zone_di)) WHERE p_date <= '2026-05-25' AND p_date >= '2021-01-01' AND NOT accountid IS NULL AND app_id = '1001') AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND b.rn = 1 AND a.accountid = b.accountid LEFT JOIN (SELECT p_date AS predict_date FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_revenue_predict_account_zone_di)) WHERE p_date <= '2026-05-25' AND p_date >= '2021-01-01' AND NOT accountid IS NULL AND app_id = '1001' GROUP BY p_date) AS c ON a.create_date = c.predict_date GROUP BY a.app_id, a.device_id, IF(NOT c.predict_date IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS t1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df)) SELECT new_device_df.device_id, new_device_df.create_time, new_device_df.create_date, new_device_df.app, NULL AS app_name, new_device_df.os_type, new_device_df.os, new_device_df.os_version, new_device_df.adjust_country AS country, new_device_df.channel, new_device_df.idfa, new_device_df.idfv, new_device_df.gps_adid, new_device_df.android_id, new_device_df.adjust_country, new_device_df.network_name, new_device_df.campaign_id, new_device_df.campaign_name, new_device_df.adgroup_id, new_device_df.adgroup_name, new_device_df.creative_id, new_device_df.creative_name, new_device_df.adjust_id, his_first_active_date, CASE WHEN his_first_active_date < new_device_df.create_date THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, LENGTH(active_info) - DATEDIFF(new_device_df.create_date, his_first_active_date)), '0{1}$', '1') WHEN his_first_active_date > new_device_df.create_date THEN CONCAT(active_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF(his_first_active_date, new_device_df.create_date) - 1), '1') WHEN his_first_active_date IS NULL THEN CONCAT(REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', new_device_df.create_date)), '1') ELSE active_info END AS active_info, user_pay_device.his_first_pay_date, CASE WHEN user_pay_device.his_first_pay_date IS NULL THEN ARRAY('0') WHEN new_device_df.create_date < user_pay_device.his_first_pay_date THEN SPLIT(CONCAT(user_pay_device.count_info, REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF(his_first_pay_date, new_device_df.create_date))), ',') WHEN new_device_df.create_date > user_pay_device.his_first_pay_date THEN SPLIT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(user_pay_device.count_info, ',', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', new_device_df.create_date) + 1), ',') ELSE SPLIT(user_pay_device.count_info, ',') END AS pay_cnt_info, CASE WHEN user_pay_device.his_first_pay_date IS NULL THEN ARRAY('0') WHEN new_device_df.create_date < user_pay_device.his_first_pay_date THEN SPLIT(CONCAT(user_pay_device.amount_info, REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF(his_first_pay_date, new_device_df.create_date))), ',') WHEN new_device_df.create_date > user_pay_device.his_first_pay_date THEN SPLIT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(user_pay_device.amount_info, ',', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', new_device_df.create_date) + 1), ',') ELSE SPLIT(user_pay_device.amount_info, ',') END AS amount_info, user_pay_device.total_pay_amt, user_pay_device.total_pay_cnt AS total_pay_cnt, NULL AS his_first_revenue_date, ARRAY('0') AS iaa_impression_info, ARRAY('0') AS iaa_click_info, ARRAY('0') AS iaa_revenue_info, NULL AS total_iaa_impression, NULL AS total_iaa_click, NULL AS total_iaa_revenue, CASE WHEN new_device_df.app_id <> '1001' THEN ARRAY('0') WHEN user_pay_device.his_first_pay_date IS NULL THEN ARRAY('0') WHEN new_device_df.create_date < user_pay_device.his_first_pay_date THEN SPLIT(CONCAT(user_pay_device.actual_amount_info, REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF(his_first_pay_date, new_device_df.create_date))), ',') WHEN new_device_df.create_date > user_pay_device.his_first_pay_date THEN SPLIT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(user_pay_device.actual_amount_info, ',', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', new_device_df.create_date) + 1), ',') ELSE SPLIT(user_pay_device.actual_amount_info, ',') END AS actual_amount_info, user_pay_device.total_actual_pay_amt, new_device_df.ip_country, new_device_df.ip_state, new_device_df.ip_city, predict_revenue_device.predict_revenue_amount_30_360_interval30_list, new_device_df.pc_device, CASE WHEN new_device_df.app_id <> '1001' THEN ARRAY('0') WHEN user_pay_device.his_first_pay_date IS NULL THEN ARRAY('0') WHEN new_device_df.create_date < user_pay_device.his_first_pay_date THEN SPLIT(CONCAT(user_pay_device.product_money_info, REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF(his_first_pay_date, new_device_df.create_date))), ',') WHEN new_device_df.create_date > user_pay_device.his_first_pay_date THEN SPLIT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(user_pay_device.product_money_info, ',', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', new_device_df.create_date) + 1), ',') ELSE SPLIT(user_pay_device.product_money_info, ',') END AS product_money_info, new_device_df.gps_asid, new_device_df.app_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_sdk_device_create_account_df)) LEFT JOIN STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_sdk_device_active_df)) ON active_user_df.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND new_device_df.app_id = active_user_df.app_id AND new_device_df.device_id = active_user_df.device_id LEFT JOIN STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_sdk_device_pay_df)) ON user_pay_device.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND new_device_df.app_id = user_pay_device.app_id AND new_device_df.device_id = user_pay_device.device_id LEFT JOIN dm_predict_revenue_df AS predict_revenue_device ON new_device_df.app_id = '1001' AND new_device_df.app_id = predict_revenue_device.app_id AND new_device_df.device_id = predict_revenue_device.device_id WHERE new_device_df.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND (new_device_df.app_id = '1001' OR (new_device_df.app_id <> '1001' AND new_device_df.create_date >= '2019-01-01')) AND new_device_df.is_error = 0

next_back_date) + 1) AS pay_cnt_info_from_7back, ARRAY_ONE_OF_INDEX(pay_cnt_info, CONCAT(SEQUENCE(1, 30, 1), SEQUENCE(45, 180, 15), SEQUENCE(210, 720, 30)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', back_date) + 1, SEQUENCE(45, 180, 15), SEQUENCE(210, 720, 30)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', back_date) + 1, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', next_14back_date) + 1) AS active_info_from_14back, ARRAY_DOUBLE_OF_INDEX(IF(a.app_id = SEQUENCE(210, 720, 30)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', back_date) + 1, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', next_14back_date) + 1) AS pay_cnt_info_from_14back, ARRAY_ONE_OF_INDEX(IF(a.app_id = '3001' AND is_30back IN ('1', '2'), pay_cnt_info, NULL), CONCAT(SEQUENCE(1, 30, 1), SEQUENCE(45, 180, 15), SEQUENCE(210, 720, 30)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', back_date) + 1, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', next_14back_date) + 1) AS name: etl.mt_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df
sql_units: /* 关联取玩家全局排序 */ /* 初始日期为2023-01-01 */ WITH his_data AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, uid FROM mt_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-08-15', '2025-08-15', '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'mlbb'), new_user /* 取出新增用户并排序 */ AS (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.register_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY '2026-05-31' ORDER BY roleid, zoneid) AS rn_sort, '2026-05-31' AS max_key FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.register_time FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(register_time) AS register_time FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_time FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' UNION ALL SELECT accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, time AS register_time FROM ml_ods.abtestserver_abtest_tag WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND old_zoneid > 0 UNION ALL SELECT accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, time AS register_time FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND old_zoneid > 0) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN his_data AS hd ON a.roleid = hd.roleid AND a.zoneid = hd.zoneid WHERE hd.roleid IS NULL) AS t1), max_uid /* 取出历史最大uid */ AS (SELECT MAX(uid) AS max_uid, '2026-05-31' AS max_key FROM his_data) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT roleid, zoneid, uid FROM his_data UNION ALL SELECT nu.roleid, nu.zoneid, mu.max_uid + nu.rn_sort FROM new_user AS nu LEFT JOIN max_uid AS mu ON nu.max_key = mu.max_key

name: 2_adbi.dm_msdk_device_pay_df
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_msdk_device_pay_df_out)) SELECT did, package_name, os, his_first_pay_date, his_last_pay_date, pay_cnt_info, pay_amt_info, actual_pay_amt_info, total_pay_cnt, total_pay_amt, total_actual_pay_amt, app_id FROM (SELECT COALESCE(df.did, di.did) AS did, COALESCE(df.app_id, di.app_id) AS app_id, COALESCE(df.os, di.os) AS os, COALESCE(df.package_name, di.package_name) AS package_name, COALESCE(df.his_first_pay_date, di.day_first_charge_date) AS his_first_pay_date /* 第二层上游表dwd_event_log_detail_di对event_time时间字段做了不为空处理，理论上后续加工字段day_first_charge_time、day_last_charge_time不会为空， */ /* 所以不用考虑his_first_pay_date、his_last_pay_date为空的情况 */, COALESCE(di.day_last_charge_date, df.his_last_pay_date) AS his_last_pay_date, CASE WHEN SIZE(df.pay_cnt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.pay_cnt_info, COALESCE(df.total_pay_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_cnt, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(df.total_pay_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_cnt, 0)) END AS pay_cnt_info /* -spark2.3.4 array方法比较局限，没必要写个array append之类udf，等spark3.0之后可换个更优雅的方式 */, CASE WHEN SIZE(df.pay_amt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.pay_amt_info, COALESCE(df.total_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(df.total_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0)) END AS pay_amt_info, CASE WHEN SIZE(df.actual_pay_amt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.actual_pay_amt_info, COALESCE(df.total_actual_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(CAST(CAST(di.day_actual_charge_sum AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS DOUBLE), 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<DOUBLE>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(df.total_actual_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(CAST(CAST(di.day_actual_charge_sum AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS DOUBLE), 0)) END AS actual_pay_amt_info, COALESCE(df.total_pay_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_cnt, 0) AS total_pay_cnt, COALESCE(df.total_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0) AS total_pay_amt, COALESCE(df.total_actual_pay_amt, 0) + COALESCE(CAST(CAST(di.day_actual_charge_sum AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS total_actual_pay_amt FROM (/* 前一天全量支付数据 */ SELECT did, app_id, package_name, os, his_first_pay_date, his_last_pay_date, pay_cnt_info, pay_amt_info, actual_pay_amt_info, total_pay_cnt, total_pay_amt, total_actual_pay_amt FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_msdk_device_pay_df_in)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df FULL JOIN (/* 上游数据因为package_name, 可能飘在一个账号多条数据, 这里需要按照支付时间, 取每天的首次数据. */ SELECT * FROM (/* 当日新增支付数据 */ SELECT did, app_id, package_name, os, SUBSTRING(day_first_charge_time, 1, 10) AS day_first_charge_date /* 日期字符串截取，yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss截取出yyyy-MM-dd */, SUBSTRING(day_last_charge_time, 1, 10) AS day_last_charge_date, SUM(day_charge_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id) AS day_charge_cnt, SUM(day_charge_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id) AS day_charge_sum, SUM(CAST(COALESCE(day_actual_amt, 0) AS DOUBLE)) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id) AS day_actual_charge_sum, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id ORDER BY day_first_charge_time ASC) AS rn FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') WHERE rn = 1) AS di ON df.did = di.did AND df.app_id = di.app_id) AS pay WHERE NOT did IS NULL DISTRIBUTE BY app_id

name: tmp_hero_use_game
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_qmzhang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-02-16 15:17:17.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH battle_a AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, wincamp, banhero, pvptype /* 战斗类型 */, CASE WHEN isinvalidbattle = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_invalidbattle /* 是否流局(看板内置筛选项默认非流局) */, CASE WHEN realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90) THEN '真人对局' WHEN realpvptype IN (30, 31, 37, 38, 51, 57, 58, 85, 86, 87, 92, 101, 103) THEN '温暖关' ELSE '其他' END AS real_pvptype /* 真实匹配类型 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) /* 排位&匹配 */ GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, wincamp, banhero, pvptype, is_invalidbattle, real_pvptype), battle_b /* 从battle_end表筛选连表需要的数据（对accountid+zoneid+battleid去重） */ AS (SELECT battleid, hero_num, CASE WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '勇士' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '精英' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN '大师' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '宗师' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN '史诗' WHEN max_minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN max_minranklvl = 26 THEN '神话V' WHEN max_minranklvl = 27 THEN '神话IV' WHEN max_minranklvl = 28 THEN '神话III' WHEN max_minranklvl = 29 THEN '神话II' WHEN max_minranklvl = 30 THEN '神话I' WHEN max_minranklvl = 31 THEN '荣耀神话' ELSE '无信息' END AS game_ranklvl /* 对局段位 */ FROM (SELECT battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT heroid) AS hero_num, MAX(minranklvl) AS max_minranklvl /* 对局段位 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) /* 排位&匹配 */ GROUP BY battleid) AS t), hero_config /* 计算对局中不同英雄数量和对局段位 */ AS (SELECT heroid, hero_name /* 英雄中文名称 */, CASE WHEN sub_heroes = -9999 THEN heroes ELSE CONCAT(heroes, '\\073', sub_heroes) END AS heroes /* 英雄职业（主定位+次定位） */ FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2023-02-16', '2023-02-16', '2026-05-31')), hero_game /* 英雄配置表 */ AS (SELECT logymd, heroid, pvptype, is_invalidbattle, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, CASE WHEN hero_num = 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_repeat_hero /* 对局英雄是否重复（看板搭建时作为筛选项） */, COUNT(DISTINCT a.battleid) AS hero_game_cnt /* 角色使用指定英雄战斗的总场次（对局英雄出场率） */ FROM battle_a AS a LEFT JOIN battle_b AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY logymd, heroid, pvptype, is_invalidbattle, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, is_repeat_hero), total_hero AS (SELECT logymd, pvptype, is_invalidbattle, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, CASE WHEN hero_num = 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_repeat_hero, COUNT(DISTINCT a.battleid) AS game_cnt /* 对局总场次（对局英雄出场率） */ FROM battle_a AS a LEFT JOIN battle_b AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY logymd, pvptype, is_invalidbattle, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, is_repeat_hero), banhero AS (SELECT logymd, banhero, pvptype, is_invalidbattle, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, CASE WHEN hero_num = 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_repeat_hero, COUNT(DISTINCT a.battleid) AS banhero_game_cnt /* 指定英雄被Ban总场次（对局英雄禁用率） */ FROM (SELECT * FROM battle_a WHERE banhero <> 0) AS a LEFT JOIN battle_b AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY logymd, banhero, pvptype, is_invalidbattle, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, is_repeat_hero), total_banhero AS (SELECT logymd, pvptype, is_invalidbattle, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, CASE WHEN hero_num = 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_repeat_hero, COUNT(DISTINCT a.battleid) AS bangame_cnt /* Ban对局总场次 */ FROM battle_a AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM battle_b WHERE game_ranklvl IN ('史诗', '传奇', '神话V', '神话IV', '神话III', '神话II', '神话I', '荣耀神话')) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY logymd, pvptype, is_invalidbattle, real_pvptype, game_ranklvl, is_repeat_hero) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_hero_use_game PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t.heroid, hero_name, heroes, t.pvptype, t.real_pvptype, t.is_invalidbattle, t.game_ranklvl, t.is_repeat_hero, hero_game_cnt /* 角色使用指定英雄战斗的总场次 */, game_cnt /* 对局总场次 */, banhero_game_cnt /* 指定英雄被Ban总场次 */, bangame_cnt /* Ban对局总场次 */ FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.logymd, b.logymd) AS logymd, COALESCE(a.heroid, b.banhero) AS heroid, COALESCE(a.pvptype, b.pvptype) AS pvptype, COALESCE(a.is_invalidbattle, b.is_invalidbattle) AS is_invalidbattle, COALESCE(a.real_pvptype, b.real_pvptype) AS real_pvptype, COALESCE(a.game_ranklvl, b.game_ranklvl) AS game_ranklvl, COALESCE(a.is_repeat_hero, b.is_repeat_hero) AS is_repeat_hero, hero_game_cnt, banhero_game_cnt FROM hero_game AS a FULL JOIN banhero AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.heroid = b.banhero AND a.pvptype = b.pvptype AND a.is_invalidbattle = b.is_invalidbattle AND a.real_pvptype = b.real_pvptype AND a.game_ranklvl = b.game_ranklvl AND a.is_repeat_hero = b.is_repeat_hero) AS t LEFT JOIN total_hero AS c ON t.logymd = c.logymd AND t.pvptype = c.pvptype AND t.is_invalidbattle = c.is_invalidbattle AND t.real_pvptype = c.real_pvptype AND t.game_ranklvl = c.game_ranklvl AND t.is_repeat_hero = c.is_repeat_hero LEFT JOIN total_banhero AS d ON t.logymd = d.logymd AND t.pvptype = d.pvptype AND t.is_invalidbattle = d.is_invalidbattle AND t.real_pvptype = d.real_pvptype AND t.game_ranklvl = d.game_ranklvl AND t.is_repeat_hero = d.is_repeat_hero LEFT JOIN hero_config AS e ON t.heroid = e.heroid

name: adbi.dwm_sdk_pay_user_di
sql_units: WITH log_di AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT app_id, CAST(roleid AS STRING) AS roleid, zoneid, `time`, device_id, SUM(pay_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, app_id, roleid) AS day_pay_cnt, SUM(money) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, app_id, roleid) AS day_pay_amt, SUM(actual_money) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, app_id, roleid) AS day_actual_pay_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, app_id, roleid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn, FIRST_VALUE(device_id) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, app_id, roleid ORDER BY `time`) AS day_first_device_id, MIN(`time`) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, app_id, roleid) AS day_first_pay_time, SUM(product_money) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, app_id, roleid) AS day_product_money, logymd FROM (SELECT '1001' AS app_id, CAST(zipped['2'] AS STRING) AS `time`, roleid, zoneid, zipped['0'] AS money, zipped['1'] * 100 AS actual_money, zipped['4'] AS pay_cnt, zipped['3'] AS device_id, zipped['5'] AS product_money, logymd FROM (/*      有效充值数据条件：is_iap_token_buy=0 and is_sandbox=0 and receipt_id>100 且 不是礼品卡充值 */ /*      礼品卡充值的条件：money=0的product_id为com.moonton.%promotion%格式的数据 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, EXPLODE(ARRAYS_ZIP(ARRAY(0.0, before_tax_usd_amt), ARRAY(0.0, pay_net_receipts_usd_amt), ARRAY(first_pay_time, last_pay_time), ARRAY(first_pay_device_id, last_pay_device_id), ARRAY(0, pay_cnt), ARRAY(0, product_money))) AS zipped, logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* logymd between '2026-01-01' and '2026-12-31' */ before_tax_usd_amt > 0) UNION ALL SELECT '2001' AS app_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS `time`, roleid, zoneid, money, 0.0 AS actual_money, 1 AS pay_cnt, device_id, NULL AS product_money, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* logymd between '2026-01-01' and '2026-12-31' */ NOT zoneid BETWEEN 9000 AND 9999 /* 测试服收入 */ UNION ALL SELECT '3001' AS app_id /* ,'watcherofrealms'  as app_name */, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS `time`, roleid, zoneid, money, 0.0 AS actual_money, 1 AS pay_cnt, device_id, NULL AS product_money, logymd FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* logymd between '2026-01-01' and '2026-12-31' */ NOT zoneid BETWEEN 9000 AND 9999 /* 测试服收入 */ AND money > 0) AS a) AS b WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_sdk_pay_user_di)) SELECT roleid AS accountid, CAST(zoneid AS STRING) AS zoneid, NULL AS os_type, NULL AS os, NULL AS channel, NULL AS pay_channel, CAST((zoneid DIV 1000) AS STRING) AS area, NULL AS adjust_country, NULL AS adjust_network_name, NULL AS adjust_os_type, NULL AS adjust_os, NULL AS adjust_id, day_first_pay_time, `time` AS day_last_pay_time, day_first_device_id, device_id AS day_last_device_id, NULL AS level, day_pay_cnt, day_pay_amt, 0 AS day_pay_amt_new, COALESCE(day_actual_pay_amt, 0) AS day_actual_pay_amt, COALESCE(day_product_money, 0) AS day_product_money, logymd, app_id FROM log_di DISTRIBUTE BY ABS(HASH(accountid, app_id) % 10)

1, sex, NULL)) AS last_sex, MAX(IF(drn = 1, x, NULL)) AS last_longitude, MAX(IF(drn = 1, y, NULL)) AS last_latitude /* ,max(if(drn=1,country,null)) as last_country */, MAX(IF(drn = 1, pos, NULL)) AS name: mt_dwd.dwd_datawind_query_info
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: franklinhuang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-02-17 18:13:01.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mt_dwd`.`dwd_datawind_query_info`( */ /*     `task_id` bigint COMMENT 'ETL任务id', */ /*     `task_name` string COMMENT '任务名', */ /*     `owner_email_prefix` string COMMENT '用户邮箱', */ /*     `task_source` bigint COMMENT '任务来源，0表示页面手动创建任务,1代表可视化建模', */ /*     `data_set_name` string COMMENT '数据集名称', */ /*     `data_type` string COMMENT '数据源类型', */ /*     `sql_str_ori` string COMMENT '原始sql', */ /*     `sql_str_slice` string COMMENT '分段sql', */ /*     `table_name` string COMMENT '表名', */ /*     `is_table` bigint COMMENT '是否是正常表名' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` string COMMENT '') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET ; */ WITH wind_basic_info AS (SELECT prep_task_id, prep_task_name, COALESCE(owner_email_prefix, prep_owner_email_prefix) AS owner_email_prefix, prep_task_source, prep_node_type, COALESCE(data_set_name, act_prep_data_set_name) AS act_data_set_name, db_name, table_name, node_conf, data_type, act_prep_data_set_name FROM (SELECT t7.*, MAX(prep_data_set_name) OVER (PARTITION BY prep_task_id) AS act_prep_data_set_name, MAX(prep_owner_email_prefix) OVER (PARTITION BY prep_task_id) AS act_prep_owner_email_prefix FROM (SELECT t5.prep_task_source, t5.type AS prep_node_type, t5.data_set_name, t5.prep_task_id, t5.prep_task_name, t5.table_name, t5.db_name, t5.data_type, t5.owner_email_prefix, COALESCE(t6.name, '') AS prep_data_set_name, COALESCE(t6.owner_email_prefix, t5.prep_owner, '') AS prep_owner_email_prefix, t5.node_conf FROM (SELECT t4.task_source AS prep_task_source /* 用来区分是否是可视化建模，0不是，1是 */, t4.id AS prep_task_id, t4.name AS prep_task_name, t4.owner_email_prefix AS prep_owner /* 可视化建模可能没有保存结果到数据集，这个是为了获取可视化建模任务的owner */, t3.* FROM (SELECT t2.name AS data_set_name, t2.owner_email_prefix, t1.* FROM (SELECT * /* FROM    mt_dwd.dwd_datawind_prep_node */ FROM mt_ods.aeolus_db__prep_node_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-02-15', '2023-02-15', '2026-05-31') AND status <> 1 AND data_type IN ('hive', 'impala')) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_ods.aeolus_db__aeolus_data_set_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-02-15', '2023-02-15', '2026-05-31') AND status IN (0, 11)) AS t2 ON t1.task_id = t2.task_id) AS t3 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_ods.aeolus_db__prep_task_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-02-15', '2023-02-15', '2026-05-31')) AS t4 ON t3.task_id = t4.id) AS t5 LEFT JOIN (/* 获取可视化建模里的数据集信息 */ SELECT * FROM mt_ods.aeolus_db__prep_data_set_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-02-15', '2023-02-15', '2026-05-31') AND status IN (0, 11)) AS t6 ON t5.data_set_ids = t6.id) AS t7) AS t8 WHERE prep_node_type = 'Read') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_dwd`.`dwd_datawind_query_info` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t5.*, IF(table_name RLIKE '[*.*]', 1, 0) AS is_table FROM (SELECT prep_task_id, prep_task_name, owner_email_prefix, prep_task_source, data_set_name, data_type, sql_str_ori, sql_str_slice, IF(parse_table_name IS NULL OR TRIM(parse_table_name) = '', CONCAT(db_name, '\\.', table_name), parse_table_name) AS table_name FROM (SELECT prep_task_source, owner_email_prefix, act_data_set_name AS data_set_name /* prep_node_type, */, prep_task_id, prep_task_name, data_type, db_name, table_name, sqlstr AS sql_str_ori /* node_conf, */ /* 原始sql */, sql_str AS sql_str_slice /* 分段sql */, REGEXP_REPLACE(SPLIT(TRIM(sql_str), ' ')[0], '`|\\).*$|--.*$', '') AS parse_table_name FROM (SELECT prep_task_source, prep_node_type, act_data_set_name, prep_task_id, prep_task_name, db_name, table_name, node_conf, data_type, owner_email_prefix, LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(sqlstr, '[\\n]+|[\\t]+|[\\s]+', ' ')) AS sqlstr FROM (SELECT prep_task_source, prep_node_type, act_data_set_name, prep_task_id, prep_task_name, db_name, table_name, node_conf, data_type, owner_email_prefix, IF(sqlstr LIKE '%base64%', DECODE(UNBASE64(SUBSTRING(sqlstr, 8)), 'UTF-8'), sqlstr) AS sqlstr FROM (SELECT *, GET_JSON_OBJECT(node_conf, '$.connection.sql') AS sqlstr FROM wind_basic_info) AS t) AS t2) AS t3 LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(sqlstr, 'from_unixtime|from_utc_timestamp', ''), 'from')) field AS index, sql_str WHERE index <> 0 OR NOT table_name IS NULL) AS t4) AS t5

`time`, logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, app_id, roleid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS last_rn, device_id FROM (SELECT '2001' AS app_id, CAST(roleid AS STRING) AS roleid, zoneid, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS `time`, device_id, logymd FROM mh_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT '3001' AS app_id, CAST(roleid AS STRING) AS roleid, zoneid, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS `time`, device_id AS device_id, logymd FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT '4001' AS app_id, CAST(roleid AS STRING) AS roleid, zoneid, CAST(`time` AS CAST((login.zoneid DIV 1000) AS STRING) AS area, NULL AS adjust_country, NULL AS adjust_network_name, NULL AS adjust_os_type, NULL AS adjust_os, NULL AS adjust_id, NULL AS day_first_device_id, NULL AS day_first_active_time, day_last_device_id, day_last_active_time, 0 AS level, 0 AS ranklvl, login_cnt, 0 AS login_duration, 0 AS total_active_days, 0 AS pay_amount, login.logymd, login.app_id FROM login DISTRIBUTE BY ABS(HASH(accountid, app_id) % IF(login.app_id = '1001', 30, 2))
