COALESCE(a.back_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS back_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(a.share_amt, 0) AS share_amt, COALESCE(a.share_usd_amt, 0) AS share_usd_amt, COALESCE(a.fee_usd_amt, 0) AS fee_usd_amt, COALESCE(a.before_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, 0) AS before_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, COALESCE(a.before_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, 0) AS before_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, COALESCE(a.after_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, 0) AS after_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, COALESCE(a.after_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, 0) AS after_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, COALESCE(a.before_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, 0) AS before_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, COALESCE(a.after_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, 0) AS after_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, COALESCE(b.active_cnt, 0) AS active_role_cnt, COALESCE(b.pay_active_cnt, 0) AS active_pay_role_cnt, COALESCE(a.log_type, b.log_type) AS log_type FROM (SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, first_mt_country, bill_country, currency, CONCAT(log_range_start, '~', log_range_end) AS log_range, COUNT(*) AS pay_user_cnt, SUM(IF(SUBSTRING(his_first_pay_date, 0, 10) >= log_range_start AND SUBSTRING(his_first_pay_date, 0, 10) <= log_range_end, 1, 0)) AS his_first_pay_user_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(get_diamond), 0) AS get_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(pay_cnt), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(product_money), 0) AS product_money, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt), 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_usd_amt), 0) AS pay_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(before_tax_amt), 0) AS before_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(before_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS before_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_amt), 0) AS after_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS after_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(tax_amt), 0) AS tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(tax_usd_amt), 0) AS tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(back_tax_amt), 0) AS back_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(back_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS back_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(share_amt), 0) AS share_amt, COALESCE(SUM(share_usd_amt), 0) AS share_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(fee_usd_amt), 0) AS fee_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_amt), 0) AS before_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_usd_amt - share_usd_amt - fee_usd_amt), 0) AS before_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_amt - back_tax_amt), 0) AS after_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_usd_amt - share_usd_amt - fee_usd_amt - back_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS after_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_usd_amt - share_usd_amt - fee_usd_amt) / SUM(pay_usd_amt), 0) AS before_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_usd_amt - share_usd_amt - fee_usd_amt - back_tax_usd_amt) / SUM(pay_usd_amt), 0) AS after_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, log_type FROM (SELECT *, '2026-05-31' AS log_range_start, '2026-05-31' AS log_range_end, 'day' AS log_type FROM dwd_raw WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT *, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', WEEKDAY('2026-05-31') * -1) AS log_range_start, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', (WEEKDAY('2026-05-31') - 6) * -1) AS log_range_end, 'week' AS log_type FROM dwd_raw WHERE cur_week UNION ALL SELECT *, CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 0, 7), '-01') AS log_range_start, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS log_range_end, 'month' AS log_type FROM dwd_raw WHERE cur_month) AS tmp GROUP BY pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, first_mt_country, bill_country, currency, log_range_start, log_range_end, log_type) AS a FULL JOIN (SELECT first_mt_country, active_cnt, pay_active_cnt, CONCAT('2026-05-31', '~', '2026-05-31') AS log_range, 'day' AS log_type FROM day_active UNION ALL SELECT first_mt_country, active_cnt, pay_active_cnt, CONCAT(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', WEEKDAY('2026-05-31') * -1), '~', DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', (WEEKDAY('2026-05-31') - 6) * -1)) AS log_range, 'week' AS log_type FROM week_active UNION ALL SELECT first_mt_country, active_cnt, pay_active_cnt, CONCAT(CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 0, 7), '-01'), '~', LAST_DAY('2026-05-31')) AS log_range, 'month' AS log_type FROM month_active) AS b ON a.log_type = b.log_type AND a.first_mt_country = b.first_mt_country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.temp_ads_finance_di PARTITION(appid = 'ml', logymd = '2026-05-31', log_type) SELECT * FROM res

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_finance_di PARTITION(appid = 'ml', logymd = '2026-05-31', log_type = 'day') SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, first_mt_country, bill_country, currency, log_range, pay_role_cnt, his_first_pay_user_cnt, get_diamond, pay_cnt, product_money, pay_amt, pay_usd_amt, before_tax_amt, before_tax_usd_amt, after_tax_amt, after_tax_usd_amt, tax_amt, tax_usd_amt, back_tax_amt, back_tax_usd_amt, share_amt, share_usd_amt, fee_usd_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, after_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, after_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, after_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, active_role_cnt, active_pay_role_cnt FROM ml_temp.temp_ads_finance_di WHERE appid = 'ml' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND log_type = 'day'

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_finance_di PARTITION(appid = 'ml', logymd = '2026-05-31', log_type = 'week') SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, first_mt_country, bill_country, currency, log_range, pay_role_cnt, his_first_pay_user_cnt, get_diamond, pay_cnt, product_money, pay_amt, pay_usd_amt, before_tax_amt, before_tax_usd_amt, after_tax_amt, after_tax_usd_amt, tax_amt, tax_usd_amt, back_tax_amt, back_tax_usd_amt, share_amt, share_usd_amt, fee_usd_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, after_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, after_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, after_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, active_role_cnt, active_pay_role_cnt FROM ml_temp.temp_ads_finance_di WHERE appid = 'ml' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND log_type = 'week'

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_finance_di PARTITION(appid = 'ml', logymd = '2026-05-31', log_type = 'month') SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, first_mt_country, bill_country, currency, log_range, pay_role_cnt, his_first_pay_user_cnt, get_diamond, pay_cnt, product_money, pay_amt, pay_usd_amt, before_tax_amt, before_tax_usd_amt, after_tax_amt, after_tax_usd_amt, tax_amt, tax_usd_amt, back_tax_amt, back_tax_usd_amt, share_amt, share_usd_amt, fee_usd_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, after_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, after_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, after_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, active_role_cnt, active_pay_role_cnt FROM ml_temp.temp_ads_finance_di WHERE appid = 'ml' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND log_type = 'month'

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_own_permanent_hero_skin_df
sql_units: WITH t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', register_date) AS register_date_diff FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-30') AND is_ai = 0 AND zoneid < 57000), t_active_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(his_last_active_date = '2026-05-30', 1, 0) AS is_active_day, IF(his_last_active_date = '2026-05-30', IF(COALESCE(his_last_active_second_date, '1970-01-01') = '1970-01-01', 0, DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', his_last_active_second_date)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-30', his_last_active_date)) AS bf_active_date_diff FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000), t_pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND day_pay_amount > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_battle_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_resource_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(TRIM(permanent_hero_str) <> '', STR_TO_MAP(permanent_hero_str, ',', ':'), CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, STRING>)) AS permanent_hero_json, IF(TRIM(permanent_skin_str) <> '', STR_TO_MAP(permanent_skin_str, ',', ':'), CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, STRING>)) AS permanent_skin_json FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(IF(resource_type = 'hero', CONCAT_WS(':', CAST(resource_id AS STRING), his_first_get_time), NULL))) AS permanent_hero_str, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(IF(resource_type = 'skin', CONCAT_WS(':', CAST(resource_id AS STRING), his_first_get_time), NULL))) AS permanent_skin_str FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, resource_type, resource_id, MIN(his_first_get_time) AS his_first_get_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, resource_type, resource_id) AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t2) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_own_permanent_hero_skin_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT t_basic.roleid, t_basic.zoneid, t_basic.register_date_diff, COALESCE(t_active_df.bf_active_date_diff, -99999) AS bf_active_date_diff, COALESCE(t_active_df.is_active_day, 0) AS is_active_day, IF(t_pay_di.roleid IS NULL, 0, 1) AS is_charge_day, IF(t_battle_di.roleid IS NULL, 0, 1) AS is_battle_day, COALESCE(t_resource_df.permanent_hero_json, CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, STRING>)) AS permanent_hero_json, COALESCE(t_resource_df.permanent_skin_json, CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, STRING>)) AS permanent_skin_json FROM t_basic LEFT JOIN t_active_df ON t_basic.roleid = t_active_df.roleid AND t_basic.zoneid = t_active_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_pay_di ON t_basic.roleid = t_pay_di.roleid AND t_basic.zoneid = t_pay_di.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_battle_di ON t_basic.roleid = t_battle_di.roleid AND t_basic.zoneid = t_battle_di.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_resource_df ON t_basic.roleid = t_resource_df.roleid AND t_basic.zoneid = t_resource_df.zoneid

/* 生命周期为7天，7天后进行分区的删除 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_own_permanent_hero_skin_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-23') SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date_diff, bf_active_date_diff, is_active_day, is_charge_day, is_battle_day, permanent_hero_json, permanent_skin_json FROM mt_dm.dm_own_permanent_hero_skin_df WHERE logymd = '1970-01-01'

name: etl.mt_finance.dwd_charge_order_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: hengweiyan@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-02-15 11:09:03.000 */ /* DESCription: */ /* Update: Task Update DESCription */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 2025-12-15      jichun      增加is_real_charge是否真实付费字段，用于获取真实付费明细，数据回溯通过手动脚本etl.mt_finance.dwd_charge_order_di_jichun回溯 */ /* GP 无定价数据 */ WITH charge_gp_no_price AS (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND receipt_type = 2 AND COALESCE(localprice, 0) = 0), charge_all /* charge 标准化数据 */ AS (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_type, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype /* 土耳其错误货币缩写纠正 / 塞拉利昂更换货币缩写 */, CASE WHEN UPPER(currency) IN ('TRI', 'TRY') THEN 'TRY' WHEN UPPER(currency) IN ('SLE', 'SLL') THEN 'SLE' ELSE UPPER(currency) END AS currency, CASE WHEN UPPER(local_currency) IN ('TRI', 'TRY') THEN 'TRY' WHEN UPPER(local_currency) IN ('SLE', 'SLL') THEN 'SLE' ELSE UPPER(local_currency) END AS local_currency, localprice, pay_channel, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, logymd FROM (/* 有定价的数据 */ SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_type, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, currency, localprice, pay_channel, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (receipt_type <> 2 OR COALESCE(localprice, 0) > 0) UNION ALL /* GP 规范无定价商品的价格和货币 */ SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, a.product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_type, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, COALESCE(b.currency, a.currency) AS currency, COALESCE(b.localprice, a.localprice) AS localprice, pay_channel, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, logymd FROM charge_gp_no_price AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, localprice, currency FROM (SELECT t1.product_id, t1.localprice, t1.currency, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.product_id ORDER BY time DESC, t1.currency ASC) AS rn FROM (SELECT time, product_id, localprice, currency FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd >= '2026-04-30' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND receipt_type = 2 AND COALESCE(localprice, 0) > 0) AS t1 LEFT SEMI JOIN charge_gp_no_price AS t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id) AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS b ON a.product_id = b.product_id)), dim_charge_calibration_df /* 充值校准 start */ AS (SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, country_type, country, currency_type, currency, single_currency_muti_country_type, is_orderid_match FROM mt_dim.dim_charge_calibration_df AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_charge_calibration_df WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0'), receipt_mapping /* 渠道id Mapping */ AS (SELECT receipt_type, pay_channel, pay_channel_name FROM mt_dim.dim_receipt_mapping_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_receipt_mapping_di WHERE logymd > '0' AND appid = 'ml') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE appid = 'ml'), charge_raw AS (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel AS login_channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, COALESCE(flowid, 'unknown') AS flowid, a.receipt_type AS pay_channel, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, is_iap_token_buy, receipt_id, money, COALESCE(money_new, 0) AS money_new, device_id, product, COALESCE(operator, 'unknown') AS operator, COALESCE(interfacetype, 'unknown') AS interfacetype, a.logymd, IF(a.sub_pay_channel IS NULL OR a.sub_pay_channel = '', '-', a.sub_pay_channel) AS sub_pay_channel /* 默认本地价格和币种 */, IF(COALESCE(a.localprice, 0) > 0, a.currency, IF(COALESCE(local_price, 0) = 0, 'USD', COALESCE(local_currency, 'USD'))) AS currency, IF(COALESCE(a.localprice, 0) > 0, a.localprice, IF(COALESCE(local_price, 0) = 0, money, local_price)) AS localprice, IF(COALESCE(a.local_price, 0) > 0, a.local_currency, IF(COALESCE(localprice, 0) = 0, 'USD', COALESCE(a.currency, 'USD'))) AS local_currency, IF(COALESCE(a.local_price, 0) > 0, a.local_price, IF(COALESCE(localprice, 0) = 0, money, localprice)) AS local_price, COALESCE(first_channel_charge, 0) AS first_channel_charge, COALESCE(other_orderid, 'unknown') AS other_orderid, COALESCE(other_pay_orderid, 'unknown') AS other_pay_orderid, COALESCE(a.pay_channel, 'unknown') AS mix_pay_channel, COALESCE(b.pay_channel, 'unknown') AS calibration_pay_channel, COALESCE(b.pay_channel_name, 'unknown') AS pay_channel_name /* 渠道校准规则 */, COALESCE(c.single_currency_muti_country_type, d.single_currency_muti_country_type) AS single_currency_muti_country_type, COALESCE(c.sub_pay_channel, d.sub_pay_channel) AS calibration_sub_pay_channel, COALESCE(c.country_type, d.country_type) AS country_type, COALESCE(c.country, d.country) AS country_desc, COALESCE(c.currency_type, d.currency_type) AS currency_type, COALESCE(c.currency, d.currency) AS currency_desc FROM charge_all AS a LEFT JOIN receipt_mapping AS b ON a.receipt_type = b.pay_channel AND b.pay_channel <> 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM dim_charge_calibration_df WHERE sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS c ON LOWER(b.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(c.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(c.sub_pay_channel) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM dim_charge_calibration_df WHERE sub_pay_channel = '-') AS d ON LOWER(b.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(d.pay_channel)), currency_country_mapping /* 国家货币 Mapping */ AS (SELECT currency, country, country_name FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_country_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_country_di WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0' AND (currency <> 'EUR' OR (currency = 'EUR' AND country <> 'IT'))), charge_country_calibrated AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bill_country_tmp, '-') <> '-' THEN bill_country_tmp WHEN COALESCE(currency_country, '-') <> '-' THEN currency_country WHEN COALESCE(ip_country, '-') <> '-' THEN ip_country WHEN COALESCE(last_mt_country, '-') <> '-' THEN last_mt_country END AS bill_country FROM (SELECT a.* /* 不属于调整口径的渠道使用支付时的ip转换的国家作为支付国，货币与金额使用表中local_currency和local_price字段进行替换。 */, CASE WHEN a.logymd < '2021-12-01' THEN GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') WHEN country_type IS NULL THEN GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') WHEN single_currency_muti_country_type <> '-' AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT(UPPER(SPLIT(single_currency_muti_country_type, '\\+')[1]), ','), a.currency) AND LOWER(SPLIT(single_currency_muti_country_type, '\\+')[0]) = 'mt' THEN c.last_mt_country WHEN single_currency_muti_country_type <> '-' AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT(UPPER(SPLIT(single_currency_muti_country_type, '\\+')[1]), ','), a.currency) AND LOWER(SPLIT(single_currency_muti_country_type, '\\+')[0]) = 'ip' THEN GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') WHEN LOWER(country_type) = 'currency' THEN b.country WHEN LOWER(country_type) = 'clientip' THEN GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') ELSE LOWER(country_type) END AS bill_country_tmp, b.country AS currency_country, GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') AS ip_country, c.last_mt_country AS last_mt_country FROM charge_raw AS a LEFT JOIN currency_country_mapping AS b ON IF(UPPER(COALESCE(a.currency, '')) IN ('', 'APPC'), UPPER(a.local_currency), UPPER(a.currency)) = UPPER(b.currency) LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS c ON c.logymd = '{DATE}' AND c.appid = 'mlbb' AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.roleid = c.roleid)), timezone_mapping /* 时区 Mapping */ AS (SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 1, 1) = '-' THEN (CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 2, 2) AS INT) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 5, 2) AS INT) * 60) ELSE -1 * ((CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 1, 2) AS INT) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 4, 2) AS INT) * 60)) END AS timeoffset FROM mt_dim.dim_payment_channel_timezone_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_payment_channel_timezone_di WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0'), charge_calibrated AS (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, login_channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, a.pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, a.currency, localprice, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, a.sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, mix_pay_channel, logymd, LOWER(bill_country) AS bill_country, LOWER(ip_country) AS ip_country, pay_channel_name, CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN '2020-10-21' AND '2020-12-14' THEN 'USD' WHEN a.currency = 'APPC' THEN 'USD' WHEN logymd < '2021-12-01' THEN a.local_currency WHEN currency_type IS NULL THEN a.local_currency WHEN LOWER(currency_type) = 'currency' THEN a.currency WHEN LOWER(currency_type) = 'country' THEN COALESCE(b.currency, a.currency) ELSE UPPER(currency_type) END AS bill_currency, CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN '2020-10-21' AND '2020-12-14' THEN money WHEN a.currency = 'APPC' THEN IF(logymd < '2021-12-01', local_price, localprice) * 0.01 WHEN currency_type IS NULL THEN a.local_price ELSE IF(logymd < '2021-12-01', local_price, localprice) END AS bill_amt /* 当 timeoffset 匹配不到的时候 null 或 '' 或 -, 需要按照默认服务器时间处理: 需要再处理下 */, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.time) + COALESCE(c.timeoffset, 0)) AS local_time, c.timeoffset FROM charge_country_calibrated AS a LEFT JOIN currency_country_mapping AS b ON LOWER(a.bill_country) = LOWER(b.country) LEFT JOIN timezone_mapping AS c ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(c.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(c.sub_pay_channel)), charge_final /* 充值校准 end */ AS (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, login_channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, a.product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, a.pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, a.currency, localprice, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, a.sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, a.mix_pay_channel, a.logymd, a.bill_country, a.ip_country, pay_channel_name, bill_currency, COALESCE(b.change_amt, a.bill_amt) AS bill_amt, a.local_time FROM charge_calibrated AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_productmoney_change_df WHERE logymd > '0' AND logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_productmoney_change_df WHERE logymd > '0')) AS b ON a.local_time >= b.start_date AND a.local_time < b.end_date AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(TRIM(b.pay_channel)) AND LOWER(IF(COALESCE(a.sub_pay_channel, '') = '', '-', a.sub_pay_channel)) = LOWER(TRIM(b.sub_pay_channel)) AND LOWER(a.bill_country) = LOWER(TRIM(b.country)) AND LOWER(a.product_id) = LOWER(TRIM(b.product_id)) AND LOWER(a.bill_currency) = LOWER(TRIM(b.currency))), paychannel_rate /* 税率 */ AS (/* 如果出现重复，随机1条的结束日期置为当前日期，另一条为2016-01-01，而end_day为2016-01-01的那条不参与计算 */ /* 会通过charge.logymd<dim.end_day的方式剔除掉重复值 */ SELECT start_day, country, pay_channel, UPPER(sub_pay_channel) AS sub_pay_channel, rate, share, is_tax, is_pay_tax, is_back_tax, is_fuzzy_match, has_share_tax, LEAD(start_day, 1, '9999-12-31') OVER (PARTITION BY country, pay_channel, UPPER(sub_pay_channel) ORDER BY start_day) AS end_day FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_rate_di WHERE appid = 'ml' AND logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-08-01', '2024-08-01', '2026-05-31')), paychannel_fee /* 手续费 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT country, pay_channel, UPPER(sub_pay_channel) AS sub_pay_channel, fee_currency, fee_amt FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_fee_di WHERE appid = 'ml' AND logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-08-01', '2024-08-01', '2026-05-31')), currency_exchange /* 月度平均汇率，来源XE网站数据：https://xecdapi.xe.com */ AS (SELECT currency, AVG(exchange_rate) AS exchange_rate FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_exchange_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-30' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY currency) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_charge_order_di PARTITION(logymd) SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, login_channel, chargediamond, LOWER(createrole_country) AS createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, IF(COALESCE(operator, '') = '', 'unknown', operator) AS operator, IF(COALESCE(interfacetype, '') = '', 'unknown', interfacetype) AS interfacetype, currency, localprice, COALESCE(IF(DATE_FORMAT(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') <= '2020-04-10 03:52:39', 0, is_sandbox), 0) AS is_sandbox, iap_product_type, sub_pay_channel, COALESCE(IF(DATE_FORMAT(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') <= '2017-06-13 02:44:26', 0, is_iap_token_buy), 0) AS is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, bill_country, UPPER(bill_currency) AS bill_currency, COALESCE(exchange_rate, 0) AS currency_exchange_rate, bill_amt, before_tax_currency, COALESCE(before_tax_amt, 0) AS before_tax_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(after_tax_currency, 'unknown')) AS after_tax_currency, COALESCE(after_tax_amt, 0) AS after_tax_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(actual_currency, 'unknown')) AS actual_currency, COALESCE(actual_amt, 0) AS actual_amt, COALESCE(tax_rate, 0) AS tax_rate, UPPER(COALESCE(tax_currency, 'unknown')) AS tax_currency, IF(COALESCE(is_pay_tax, '否') = '是', plat_tax_amt, 0) AS tax_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(back_tax_currency, 'unknown')) AS back_tax_currency, IF(COALESCE(is_back_tax, '否') = '是', plat_tax_amt, 0) AS back_tax_amt, COALESCE(share_ratio, 0) AS share_ratio, UPPER(COALESCE(share_currency, 'unknown')) AS share_currency, COALESCE(share_amt, 0) AS share_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(fee_currency, 'unknown')) AS fee_currency, COALESCE(fee_amt, 0) AS fee_amt, COALESCE(fee_exchange_rate, 0) AS fee_exchange_rate, pay_channel_name AS game_pay_channel, mix_pay_channel, IF(COALESCE(IF(DATE_FORMAT(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') <= '2017-06-13 02:44:26', 0, is_iap_token_buy), 0) = 0 /* 排除虚拟代币数据，没收入（一定要排除）目前正式服不存在，条件可不加 */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入（一定要排除） */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%', 1, 0) AS is_real_charge, logymd FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN has_share_tax = '不含税' THEN after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate WHEN has_share_tax = '含税' THEN before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate WHEN has_share_tax = '净额' THEN (before_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate) / (1 + tax_rate) ELSE after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate END AS actual_amt /* 实收 */ FROM (SELECT *, before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt AS after_tax_amt /* 税后 */, CASE WHEN has_share_tax = '不含税' THEN (before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt) * share_ratio WHEN has_share_tax IN ('含税', '净额') THEN before_tax_amt * share_ratio ELSE (before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt) * share_ratio END AS share_amt /* 分成 */ FROM (SELECT *, COALESCE(fee_amt / fee_exchange_rate, 0) AS fee_usd_amt /* 手续费 */, CASE WHEN has_share_tax IN ('不含税', '含税') THEN COALESCE(before_tax_amt / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate, 0) WHEN has_share_tax = '净额' THEN COALESCE(((before_tax_amt * (1 - share_ratio) - COALESCE(fee_amt / fee_exchange_rate, 0) * exchange_rate) / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate), 0) ELSE COALESCE(before_tax_amt / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate, 0) END AS plat_tax_amt /* 税金 */ FROM (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, login_channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, a.pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, a.currency, localprice, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, a.sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, a.logymd, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, mix_pay_channel, bill_currency, bill_country, bill_amt, pay_channel_name, IF(bill_currency = 'USD', CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)), CASE WHEN b.exchange_rate IS NULL AND bill_currency = 'BAM' THEN CAST(1 / 0.558454 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) WHEN b.exchange_rate IS NULL AND bill_currency = 'SLE' THEN CAST(1 / 0.0466810 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) WHEN b.exchange_rate IS NULL AND bill_currency = 'HKR' THEN CAST(1 / 0.143622 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) ELSE CAST(b.exchange_rate AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) END) AS exchange_rate, IF(COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency, '') = 'USD', CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)), CASE WHEN k.exchange_rate IS NULL AND COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency, '') = 'BAM' THEN CAST(1 / 0.558454 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) WHEN k.exchange_rate IS NULL AND COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency, '') = 'SLE' THEN CAST(1 / 0.0466810 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) WHEN k.exchange_rate IS NULL AND COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency, '') = 'HKR' THEN CAST(1 / 0.143622 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) ELSE CAST(k.exchange_rate AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) END) AS fee_exchange_rate, CAST(COALESCE(c.rate, d.rate, e.rate, f.rate, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) AS tax_rate, CAST(COALESCE(c.share, d.share, e.share, f.share, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) AS share_ratio, COALESCE(c.is_tax, d.is_tax, e.is_tax, f.is_tax) AS is_tax, COALESCE(c.is_pay_tax, d.is_pay_tax, e.is_pay_tax, f.is_pay_tax) AS is_pay_tax, COALESCE(c.is_back_tax, d.is_back_tax, e.is_back_tax, f.is_back_tax) AS is_back_tax, COALESCE(c.has_share_tax, d.has_share_tax, e.has_share_tax, f.has_share_tax) AS has_share_tax, COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency) AS fee_currency, IF(LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = 'ph_dragonpay_gcash' AND LOWER(a.product_id) IN ('diamond_codashopphp_dragonpay_gcash_10'), 0, CAST(COALESCE(g.fee_amt, h.fee_amt, i.fee_amt, j.fee_amt, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) * 100) AS fee_amt, bill_currency AS before_tax_currency, bill_currency AS after_tax_currency, bill_currency AS actual_currency, bill_currency AS tax_currency, bill_currency AS back_tax_currency, bill_currency AS share_currency /* 税前 */, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.is_tax, d.is_tax, e.is_tax, f.is_tax) = '是' THEN CAST(bill_amt AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) ELSE CAST(bill_amt AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) * (1 + CAST(COALESCE(c.rate, d.rate, e.rate, f.rate, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18))) END AS before_tax_amt FROM charge_final AS a LEFT JOIN currency_exchange AS b ON UPPER(a.bill_currency) = UPPER(b.currency) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_rate WHERE country <> '-' AND sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS c ON a.bill_country = LOWER(c.country) AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(c.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(c.sub_pay_channel) AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) >= c.start_day AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) < c.end_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_rate WHERE country = '-' AND sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS d ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(d.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(d.sub_pay_channel) AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) >= d.start_day AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) < d.end_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_rate WHERE country <> '-' AND sub_pay_channel = '-') AS e ON a.bill_country = LOWER(e.country) AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(e.pay_channel) AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) >= e.start_day AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) < e.end_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_rate WHERE country = '-' AND sub_pay_channel = '-') AS f ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(f.pay_channel) AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) >= f.start_day AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) < f.end_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_fee WHERE country <> '-' AND sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS g ON a.bill_country = LOWER(g.country) AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(g.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(g.sub_pay_channel) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_fee WHERE country = '-' AND sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS h ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(h.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(h.sub_pay_channel) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_fee WHERE country <> '-' AND sub_pay_channel = '-') AS i ON a.bill_country = LOWER(i.country) AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(i.pay_channel) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_fee WHERE country = '-' AND sub_pay_channel = '-') AS j ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(j.pay_channel) LEFT JOIN currency_exchange AS k ON UPPER(COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency)) = UPPER(k.currency)) AS t) AS t1) AS t2) AS t3

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_battleai_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH mode_list AS (/* ai战斗模式表 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, battleid, fake_ai, pvptype, realpvptype, heroid, battle_end_time, battle_dur, is_win, aiscene_type, aihook_dur, treehook_dur, battle_type, battleai_type, CASE WHEN aihook_dur > 300 THEN 1 WHEN aihook_dur > 0 AND aihook_dur <= 300 THEN 0 ELSE -99999 END AS is_successtake FROM mt_dwd.dwd_mode_list_battle_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4)), battle_end AS (/* 战斗记录表 */ SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, fake_ai, battleid, heroid, `time` AS battle_end_time, battletime AS battle_dur, wincamp AS is_win, killnum, assistnum, deadnum, ismvp, issurrender, isvalid, isinvalidbattle, score, (COALESCE(killnum, 0) + COALESCE(assistnum, 0)) / (COALESCE(deadnum, 0) + 1) AS kda, bigranklvl, minranklvl FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC, battleresulttype) AS rn FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4)) WHERE rn = 1), battleai_end AS (/* ai表 */ SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, realpvptype, heroid, battletime AS battle_dur, aihooktime AS aihook_dur, treehooktime AS treehook_dur, `TIME` AS battle_end_time, iswin AS is_win, fake_ai, aiscene, aicompany, killnum, assistnum, deadnum, (COALESCE(killnum, 0) + COALESCE(assistnum, 0)) / (COALESCE(deadnum, 0) + 1) AS kda, score, hasreport, bigranklvl, minranklvl FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY `TIME` DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battleai_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') WHERE rn = 1), battleenddata AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, `TIME` AS battle_end_time, battle_time AS battle_dur, iswin AS is_win, battletype AS pvptype, realpvptype, killnum, assist, dead, score, (COALESCE(killnum, 0) + COALESCE(assist, 0)) / (COALESCE(dead, 0) + 1) AS kda, bigranklevel, minranklevel FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY `TIME` DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(isbot, 0) = 0) WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_battleai_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT mde.roleid, mde.zoneid, mde.fake_ai, mde.pvptype, mde.realpvptype, mde.battle_type, mde.battleai_type, mde.is_successtake, mde.aiscene_type, COALESCE(bai.aicompany, -99999) AS aicompany_type, mde.heroid, MAX(COALESCE(btt.bigranklvl, bai.bigranklvl, bda.bigranklevel)) AS max_bigranklvl, MIN(COALESCE(btt.bigranklvl, bai.bigranklvl, bda.bigranklevel)) AS min_bigranklvl, MAX(COALESCE(btt.minranklvl, bai.minranklvl, bda.minranklevel)) AS max_minranklvl, MIN(COALESCE(btt.minranklvl, bai.minranklvl, bda.minranklevel)) AS min_minranklvl, SUM(COALESCE(btt.battle_dur, bai.battle_dur, bda.battle_dur, 0)) AS battle_dur, SUM(COALESCE(btt.killnum, bai.killnum, bda.killnum, 0)) AS kill_cnt /* 击杀数 */, SUM(COALESCE(btt.assistnum, bai.assistnum, bda.assist, 0)) AS assist_cnt /* 助攻数 */, SUM(COALESCE(btt.deadnum, bai.deadnum, bda.dead, 0)) AS dead_cnt /* 死亡数 */, COUNT(*) AS battle_cnt /* 战斗场次 */, SUM(IF(mde.is_win = 1, 1, 0)) AS win_cnt /* 胜利场次 */, SUM(COALESCE(btt.kda, bai.kda, bda.kda, 0)) AS kda_total /* kda */, SUM(mde.aihook_dur) AS aihook_dur /* 深度AI接管时长 */, SUM(mde.treehook_dur) AS treehook_dur /* 行为树接管时长 */, SUM(IF(btt.ismvp = 1, 1, 0)) AS mvp_cnt, SUM(IF(btt.issurrender = 1, 1, 0)) AS surrender_cnt, SUM(IF(btt.isvalid = 1, 1, 0)) AS invalid_cnt, SUM(IF(btt.isinvalidbattle = 1, 1, 0)) AS invalidbattle_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(btt.score, bai.score, bda.score, 0)) AS score_total, SUM(IF(bai.hasreport = 1, 1, 0)) AS hasreport_cnt FROM mode_list AS mde LEFT JOIN battle_end AS btt ON mde.roleid = btt.roleid AND mde.zoneid = btt.zoneid AND mde.battleid = btt.battleid LEFT JOIN battleai_end AS bai ON mde.roleid = bai.roleid AND mde.zoneid = bai.zoneid AND mde.battleid = bai.battleid LEFT JOIN battleenddata AS bda ON mde.roleid = bda.roleid AND mde.zoneid = bda.zoneid AND mde.battleid = bda.battleid GROUP BY mde.roleid, mde.zoneid, mde.fake_ai, mde.pvptype, mde.realpvptype, mde.battle_type, mde.battleai_type, mde.is_successtake, mde.aiscene_type, COALESCE(bai.aicompany, -99999), mde.heroid

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_create_di
sql_units: WITH date_list AS (/* 计算需要回刷的日期 */ SELECT p_date, DATE_ADD(p_date, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p_date ORDER BY p_date) - 1) * -1) AS logymd FROM (SELECT p_date FROM (SELECT REPEAT(CONCAT('2026-05-31', ','), 30) AS rep_date) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(rep_date, ',')) tbl AS p_date) WHERE p_date <> '') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_create_di PARTITION(logymd) SELECT 'device' AS granularity_type /* BROADCAST(t2) */, t1.country, t1.os, t1.network, t1.new_type, COALESCE(SUM(IF(t1.create_date = t2.logymd, 1, 0)), 0) AS register_cnt, COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS total_register_cnt /*	累计注册人数 */, IF(t1.create_date = t2.logymd, t1.is_pay, -99999) AS is_pay, IF(t1.create_date = t2.logymd, t1.pay_grade, 'unknown') AS pay_grade, COALESCE(SUM(IF(t1.create_date = t2.logymd, first_ol_dur, 0)), 0) AS first_ol_dur, t2.logymd AS logymd FROM (SELECT muti.country, muti.os, muti.network, COALESCE(bas.new_type, -1) AS new_type, muti.p_date, muti.create_date, IF(muti.first_pay_amt > 0, 1, 0) AS is_pay /* 是否付费 */, CASE WHEN muti.first_pay_amt / 100 > 0 AND muti.first_pay_amt / 100 < 0.99 THEN '0' WHEN muti.first_pay_amt / 100 >= 0.99 AND muti.first_pay_amt / 100 < 4.99 THEN '0.99' WHEN muti.first_pay_amt / 100 >= 4.99 AND muti.first_pay_amt / 100 < 9.99 THEN '4.99' WHEN muti.first_pay_amt / 100 >= 9.99 THEN '9.99' ELSE '-1' END AS pay_grade /* 付费等级 */, ifo.first_ol_dur /* 首日在线时长 */ FROM (SELECT device_id, LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', TRIM(country))) AS country /* 首次创号国 */, LOWER(TRIM(os)) AS os, LOWER(TRIM(network_name)) AS network, create_date, p_date, pay_amt_info[SIZE(pay_amt_info) - 1] AS first_pay_amt FROM adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df /* 上游表只保留7天数据，每次获取最大分区数据 */ WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND app_id = '1001') AS muti LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT device_id, create_time, his_first_accountid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY create_time) AS rn FROM adbi.dim_device_account_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND app_id = '1001') WHERE rn = 1) AS dev ON muti.device_id = dev.device_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, new_type FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-09-01', '2022-09-01', '2026-05-31') AND is_first_create = 1) AS bas ON dev.his_first_accountid = bas.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, MAX(register_ol_dur_array[SIZE(register_ol_dur_array) - 1]) AS first_ol_dur FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid) AS ifo ON dev.his_first_accountid = ifo.roleid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN date_list AS t2 ON t1.p_date = t2.p_date WHERE t1.create_date <= t2.logymd GROUP BY t1.country, t1.os, t1.network, t1.new_type, IF(t1.create_date = t2.logymd, t1.is_pay, -99999), IF(t1.create_date = t2.logymd, t1.pay_grade, 'unknown'), t2.logymd

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_active_resource_social_di_account
sql_units: /* 账号粒度区服-99999 */ /* -大小号-99999 */ /* 1、活跃表，account粒度下，取is_first_create=1的用于取最早的roleid下的os_type等一系列维度信息 */ /* 2、活跃表，account粒度下维度信息不排除测服，为了服务于「用户在57服创号且首服，后续在其他区服创角」的场景， */ /*     ads需取到该用户首服的os_type等维度信息作为账户粒度下的维度信息；但在实际计算人数/收入时，不对57服的角色进行计入 */ /* 剔除没有活跃用户的数据 */ WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country, create_os AS os, first_network_name AS network, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-05-06', '2022-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_first_create = 1 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND /* and floor(zoneid/1000)<57 */ is_ai = 0), resource_info /* 账号粒度取最大 */ /* 资源分层(0；[1:3)；[3-7)；[7-10)；[10: ) )，0，1，2，3，4 */ AS (SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN ri.skin_num <= 0 OR ri.skin_num IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN ri.skin_num >= 1 AND ri.skin_num < 3 THEN 1 WHEN ri.skin_num >= 3 AND ri.skin_num < 7 THEN 2 WHEN ri.skin_num >= 7 AND ri.skin_num < 10 THEN 3 WHEN ri.skin_num >= 10 THEN 4 END AS skin_cnt_grade, CASE WHEN ri.hero_num <= 0 OR ri.hero_num IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN ri.hero_num >= 1 AND ri.hero_num < 3 THEN 1 WHEN ri.hero_num >= 3 AND ri.hero_num < 7 THEN 2 WHEN ri.hero_num >= 7 AND ri.hero_num < 10 THEN 3 WHEN ri.hero_num >= 10 THEN 4 END AS hero_cnt_grade FROM (SELECT roleid, MAX(skin_num) AS skin_num, MAX(hero_num) AS hero_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(CASE WHEN resource_type = 'skin' THEN resource_id ELSE NULL END) AS skin_num, COUNT(CASE WHEN resource_type = 'hero' THEN resource_id ELSE NULL END) AS hero_num FROM mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid) AS ri), pay_info /* 位图只有一周的数据 */ /* 有付费的玩家需要判断下任务日期内玩家的付费情况 */ AS (SELECT roleid, 1 AS is_pay FROM (SELECT roleid, SUM(his_pay_amt) AS pay_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 AND his_pay_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 WHERE pay_amt > 0), social_info /* 亲密关系分层(0；[1:3)；[3-7)；[7-10)；[10: ) ) */ AS (SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN si.friend_num <= 0 OR si.friend_num IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN si.friend_num >= 1 AND si.friend_num < 5 THEN 1 WHEN si.friend_num >= 5 AND si.friend_num < 10 THEN 2 WHEN si.friend_num >= 10 AND si.friend_num < 20 THEN 3 WHEN si.friend_num >= 20 AND si.friend_num < 30 THEN 4 WHEN si.friend_num >= 30 AND si.friend_num < 40 THEN 5 WHEN si.friend_num >= 40 AND si.friend_num < 50 THEN 6 WHEN si.friend_num >= 50 AND si.friend_num < 60 THEN 7 WHEN si.friend_num >= 60 AND si.friend_num < 70 THEN 8 WHEN si.friend_num >= 70 THEN 9 END AS friend_cnt_grade, si.love_num AS lovers_cnt_grade, si.brother_num AS brother_cnt_grade, si.sister_num AS sisters_cnt_grade, si.close_num AS close_friend_cnt_grade FROM (SELECT roleid, MAX(SIZE(SPLIT(his_last_friend_intimacy_json, ','))) AS friend_num, MAX(SIZE(lovers_id_array)) AS love_num, MAX(SIZE(brother_id_array)) AS brother_num, MAX(SIZE(sisters_id_array)) AS sister_num, MAX(SIZE(close_friend_id_array)) AS close_num FROM mt_dwm.dwm_social_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2021-09-28', '2021-09-28', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 GROUP BY roleid) AS si), active_info AS (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_active_resource_social_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account') SELECT country, zoneid, os, network, is_main, new_type, is_pay, skin_cnt_grade, hero_cnt_grade, friend_cnt_grade, lovers_cnt_grade, brother_cnt_grade, sisters_cnt_grade, close_friend_cnt_grade, active_cnt FROM (SELECT country, -99999 AS zoneid, os, network, is_main, new_type, is_pay, skin_cnt_grade, hero_cnt_grade, friend_cnt_grade, lovers_cnt_grade, brother_cnt_grade, sisters_cnt_grade, close_friend_cnt_grade, COUNT(DISTINCT active_role) AS active_cnt FROM (SELECT a.roleid, ai.roleid AS active_role, a.country /* a.zoneid, */, a.os, a.network, -99999 AS is_main, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) <= 30 THEN 'new' ELSE 'old' END AS new_type /* 账号粒度没有回流 */, COALESCE(py.is_pay, -99999) AS is_pay, COALESCE(ri.skin_cnt_grade, 0) AS skin_cnt_grade, COALESCE(ri.hero_cnt_grade, 0) AS hero_cnt_grade, COALESCE(si.friend_cnt_grade, 0) AS friend_cnt_grade, COALESCE(si.lovers_cnt_grade, 0) AS lovers_cnt_grade, COALESCE(si.brother_cnt_grade, 0) AS brother_cnt_grade, COALESCE(si.sisters_cnt_grade, 0) AS sisters_cnt_grade, COALESCE(si.close_friend_cnt_grade, 0) AS close_friend_cnt_grade FROM basic AS a LEFT JOIN active_info AS ai ON a.roleid = ai.roleid LEFT JOIN resource_info AS ri ON a.roleid = ri.roleid LEFT JOIN pay_info AS py ON a.roleid = py.roleid LEFT JOIN social_info AS si ON a.roleid = si.roleid) AS t1 GROUP BY country, zoneid, os, network, new_type, is_main, is_pay, skin_cnt_grade, hero_cnt_grade, friend_cnt_grade, lovers_cnt_grade, brother_cnt_grade, sisters_cnt_grade, close_friend_cnt_grade) AS t1 WHERE t1.active_cnt > 0

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_active_battle_di_role
sql_units: /* 玩家基本信息取dim_basic_role_zone_df， */ /* 流失，付费，战斗统计以活跃di表为主, */ /* 剔除没有活跃用户的数据 */ WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country, create_os AS os, first_network_name AS network, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-05-06', '2022-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND is_ai = 0), pay_info /* 位图只有一周的数据 */ /* 有付费的玩家需要判断下任务日期内玩家的付费情况 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, 1 AS is_pay FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(his_pay_amt) AS pay_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 AND his_pay_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 WHERE pay_amt > 0), is_main AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(is_main) AS is_main FROM mt_dim.dim_id_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), lose_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, lose_days FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND /* 30流失回流 */ lose_days >= 30 AND recurring_date = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57), battle_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, is_black, CASE WHEN win_rate = 0 THEN 1 WHEN win_rate > 0 AND win_rate < 0.5 THEN 2 WHEN win_rate = 0.5 THEN 3 WHEN win_rate > 0.5 AND win_rate < 1 THEN 4 WHEN win_rate = 1 THEN 5 END AS win_rate_grade FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN pvptype IN (1, 2, 4, 39) THEN pvptype ELSE -1 END AS pvptype /* pvptype(1记1，2记2，39记39，4记4；剩下的统一记为other（-1)） */, IF(black_cnt > 0, 1, 0) AS is_black, SUM(win_cnt) / SUM(battle_cnt) AS win_rate FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, IF(black_cnt > 0, 1, 0), CASE WHEN pvptype IN (1, 2, 4, 39) THEN pvptype ELSE -1 END) AS t1), active_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_active_battle_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'role') SELECT country, zoneid, os, network, is_main, new_type, is_pay, pvptype, win_rate_grade, is_black, active_cnt FROM (SELECT a.country, a.zoneid, a.os, a.network, COALESCE(im.is_main, -99999) AS is_main, CASE WHEN NOT li.roleid IS NULL AND lose_days >= 30 THEN 'lose30d' WHEN li.roleid IS NULL AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) <= 30 THEN 'new' ELSE 'old' END AS new_type, COALESCE(py.is_pay, -99999) AS is_pay, COALESCE(bi.pvptype, -99999) AS pvptype, COALESCE(bi.win_rate_grade, -99999) AS win_rate_grade, COALESCE(bi.is_black, -99999) AS is_black, COUNT(DISTINCT ai.roleid, ai.zoneid) AS active_cnt FROM basic AS a LEFT JOIN active_info AS ai ON a.roleid = ai.roleid AND a.zoneid = ai.zoneid LEFT JOIN pay_info AS py ON a.roleid = py.roleid AND a.zoneid = py.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle_info AS bi ON a.roleid = bi.roleid AND a.zoneid = bi.zoneid LEFT JOIN is_main AS im ON a.roleid = im.roleid AND a.zoneid = im.zoneid LEFT JOIN lose_info AS li ON a.roleid = li.roleid AND a.zoneid = li.zoneid GROUP BY a.country, a.zoneid, a.os, a.network, COALESCE(im.is_main, -99999), CASE WHEN NOT li.roleid IS NULL AND lose_days >= 30 THEN 'lose30d' WHEN li.roleid IS NULL AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) <= 30 THEN 'new' ELSE 'old' END, COALESCE(py.is_pay, -99999), COALESCE(bi.pvptype, -99999), COALESCE(bi.win_rate_grade, -99999), COALESCE(bi.is_black, -99999)) AS t1 WHERE active_cnt > 0

mt_dwd.dwd_query_spark_application_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), t_wind AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT task_id, instance_id, yarn_app_id, input_table_name AS table_name_arr, app_id AS wind_app_id /* user_name_ch, COALESCE(CASE WHEN t_instance.project_name IN ('项目数仓', 'MSDK数仓') THEN '中台-数据-技术' WHEN t_instance.project_name IN ('投放BI') THEN '发行中心-技术支撑-技术' ELSE t_user_info.dp_name END, '其他') AS name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_active_battle_di_account
sql_units: /* 1、活跃表，account粒度下，取is_first_create=1的用于取最早的roleid下的os_type等一系列维度信息 */ /* 2、活跃表，account粒度下维度信息不排除测服，为了服务于「用户在57服创号且首服，后续在其他区服创角」的场景， */ /*     ads需取到该用户首服的os_type等维度信息作为账户粒度下的维度信息；但在实际计算人数/收入时，不对57服的角色进行计入 */ /* 剔除没有活跃的用户 */ WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country, create_os AS os, first_network_name AS network, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-05-06', '2022-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_first_create = 1 AND /* and floor(zoneid/1000)<57 */ register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND is_ai = 0), pay_info AS (SELECT roleid, 1 AS is_pay FROM (SELECT roleid, SUM(his_pay_amt) AS pay_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 AND his_pay_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 WHERE pay_amt > 0), battle_info /* pvptype(1记1，2记2，39记39，4记4；剩下的统一记为other（-1)） */ AS (SELECT roleid, pvptype, IF(is_black > 0, 1, 0) AS is_black, CASE WHEN win_rate = 0 THEN 1 WHEN win_rate > 0 AND win_rate < 0.5 THEN 2 WHEN win_rate = 0.5 THEN 3 WHEN win_rate > 0.5 AND win_rate < 1 THEN 4 WHEN win_rate = 1 THEN 5 END AS win_rate_grade FROM (SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN pvptype IN (1, 2, 4, 39) THEN pvptype ELSE -1 END AS pvptype, MAX(black_cnt) AS is_black, MAX(win_cnt / battle_cnt) AS win_rate FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 GROUP BY roleid, CASE WHEN pvptype IN (1, 2, 4, 39) THEN pvptype ELSE -1 END) AS t1), active_info AS (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_active_battle_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account') SELECT country, zoneid, os, network, is_main, new_type, is_pay, pvptype, win_rate_grade, is_black, active_cnt FROM (SELECT a.country, -99999 AS zoneid, a.os, a.network, -99999 AS is_main, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) <= 30 THEN 'new' ELSE 'old' END AS new_type /* 账号粒度无流失 */, COALESCE(py.is_pay, -99999) AS is_pay, COALESCE(bi.pvptype, -99999) AS pvptype, COALESCE(bi.win_rate_grade, -99999) AS win_rate_grade, COALESCE(bi.is_black, -99999) AS is_black, COUNT(DISTINCT ai.roleid) AS active_cnt FROM basic AS a LEFT JOIN active_info AS ai ON a.roleid = ai.roleid LEFT JOIN pay_info AS py ON a.roleid = py.roleid LEFT JOIN battle_info AS bi ON a.roleid = bi.roleid GROUP BY a.country, a.os, a.network, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) <= 30 THEN 'new' ELSE 'old' END, COALESCE(py.is_pay, -99999), COALESCE(bi.pvptype, -99999), COALESCE(bi.win_rate_grade, -99999), COALESCE(bi.is_black, -99999)) AS t1 WHERE active_cnt > 0

name: online_schedule_skin_channel_onlineday
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jessicazhu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-04-20 16:03:41.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mh_temp.mla_skin_onlineday PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(w2.product_subid, w1.product_subid) AS product_subid, COALESCE(w2.skin_id, w1.skin_id) AS skin_id, COALESCE(w2.skin_name, w1.skin_name) AS skin_name, COALESCE(w2.channel_country, w1.channel_country) AS channel_country, COALESCE(w2.hero_baseid, w1.hero_baseid) AS hero_baseid, COALESCE(w2.hero_name, w1.hero_name) AS hero_name, COALESCE(w2.onlineday, w1.logymd0) AS onlineday FROM (/* 当日增量 */ SELECT product_subid, COALESCE(skin_id, item0, 0) AS skin_id, skin_name, channel_country, hero_id AS hero_baseid, hero_name, logymd0 FROM (SELECT product_subid, CAST(SPLIT(item, ',')[0] AS INT) AS item0, MIN(logymd) AS logymd0, SPLIT(channel, '_')[1] AS channel_country FROM mh_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid % 10000 <= 9000 AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) <> 9 AND (product_subid BETWEEN 63000 AND 64000) AND product_id LIKE '%limit%' GROUP BY product_subid, item, channel_country) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT skin_id /*	皮肤ID */, skin_name /*	皮肤中文名 */, hero_id /*	皮肤对应英雄的ID */, hero_name /*	皮肤对应英雄的中文名 */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY skin_id, hero_id ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS ar FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_skin_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31') AS b0 WHERE ar = 1) AS b ON a.item0 = b.skin_id) AS w1 FULL JOIN (/* 全量数据(为避免日出现问题这里用一周数据) */ SELECT product_subid, skin_id, skin_name, channel_country, hero_baseid, hero_name, onlineday FROM mh_temp.mla_skin_onlineday WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY product_subid, skin_id, skin_name, channel_country, hero_baseid, hero_name, onlineday) AS w2 ON w1.product_subid = w2.product_subid AND w1.skin_id = w2.skin_id AND w1.channel_country = w2.channel_country AND w1.hero_baseid = w2.hero_baseid

获取ck表的大小和表名信息 */, data_table_line_num AS table_line_num, data_table_status, data_table_source_id FROM dw_aeolus.tb_39ca5f35f88e0b19ea4b409da67925f9 /* 风神资产明细数据 */ WHERE p_date = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-06-19', '2025-06-19', '2026-05-31') AND resource_type = '数据集' AND resource_id > 0), t_aeolus_data_set AS (/* SELECT  name AS dataset_name, */ /*         id AS dataset_id, */ /*         task_id a ON b.dataset_id = a.id WHERE NOT b.data_table_create_time IS NULL), t_customer AS (/* 获取非可视化建模信息 */ SELECT t_aeolus_data_set.dataset_id, t_aeolus_data_set.dataset_name, t_aeolus_data_set.owner_email_prefix, t_aeolus_data_set.dataset_status, t_aeolus_data_set.ctime, t_aeolus_data_set.task_id /* ,t_prep_node_read.task_id */, t_aeolus_data_set.data_table_id, FROM t_aeolus_data_set LEFT JOIN (/* mysql迁移暂停 */ /* join */ SELECT task_id, min_status, MAX(CASE WHEN status = min_status AND type = 'Read' THEN data_type END) AS input_data_type, MAX(CASE WHEN status = min_status AND type = 'Load' THEN data_type END) AS output_data_type, CONCAT_ELE('*****', COLLECT_SET(IF(TRIM(sqlstr) <> '', sqlstr, NULL))) AS sqlstr_his /* 包含历史所有的node的sql */, CONCAT_ELE('*****', COLLECT_SET(IF(status = min_status AND TRIM(sqlstr) <> '', sqlstr, NULL))) AS sqlstr /* 包含历史最新的sql,即使节点被删了也会有 */, COLLECT_SET(IF(table_name NOT LIKE '%hive_sql-table%' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%undefined-table%' AND type = 'Read', CONCAT(db_name, '\\.', table_name), NULL)) AS table_info_his, COLLECT_SET(IF(status = min_status AND table_name NOT LIKE '%hive_sql-table%' AND table_name NOT LIKE '%undefined-table%' AND type = 'Read', CONCAT(db_name, '\\.', table_name), NULL)) AS table_info FROM (SELECT task_id /* ,task_name */, data_type, db_name, table_name, status, type, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(node_conf, '$.connection.sql') LIKE '%base64%', DECODE(UNBASE64(SUBSTRING(GET_JSON_OBJECT(node_conf, '$.connection.sql'), 8)), 'UTF-8'), GET_JSON_OBJECT(node_conf, '$.connection.sql')) AS sqlstr, MIN(status) OVER (PARTITION BY task_id) AS min_status FROM t_prep_node) AS t GROUP BY task_id, min_status) AS t_prep_node_read ON t_aeolus_data_set.task_id = t_prep_node_read.task_id), t_prep_data_set_visualization AS (/* 8719 + */ SELECT DISTINCT app_id, app_name, resource_name AS dataset_name, resource_id AS dataset_id, resource_owner AS owner_email_prefix /* NULL AS task_id, */, resource_status AS dataset_status, dataset_ttl /* NULL AS data_table_id, */, data_table_ttl, data_table_create_time, data_table_table_size AS table_size /* 获取ck表的大小和表名信息 */, data_table_line_num AS table_line_num, data_table_status, data_table_source_id /* row_number() OVER( */ /*                 PARTITION BY */ /*                         resource_id */ /*             ) AS rn */ FROM dw_aeolus.tb_39ca5f35f88e0b19ea4b409da67925f9 /* 风神资产明细数据 */ WHERE p_date = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-06-19', '2025-06-19', '2026-05-31') AND resource_type = '可视化建模'), ,owner_email_prefix */ /*             ,ttl */ /*             ,row_number() over(partition by abi_data_set_id order by mtime desc) as rn */ /*     FROM    mt_ods.aeolus_db__prep_data_set_df */ /*     WHERE   logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-04-16',  '2023-04-16' , '2026-05-31') )t */ /*     where rn = 1 */ SELECT COALESCE(a.dataset_id, b.abi_data_set_id) AS abi_data_set_id, COALESCE(a.dataset_name, b.name) AS name, COALESCE(a.owner_email_prefix, b.owner_email_prefix) AS owner_email_prefix, COALESCE(a.app_id, b.app_id) AS app_id, b.id AS id, COALESCE(a.dataset_ttl, b.ttl) AS ttl, COALESCE(a.dataset_status, b.status) AS status FROM t_prep_data_set_visualization AS a FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM (/* 获取可视化建模里的数据集信息 */ SELECT id, abi_data_set_id, app_id, name, status, owner_email_prefix, ttl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abi_data_set_id ORDER BY mtime DESC) AS rn FROM mt_ods.aeolus_db__prep_data_set_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-04-16', '2023-04-16', '2026-05-31')) WHERE rn = 1) AS b ON a.dataset_id = b.abi_data_set_id WHERE COALESCE(a.dataset_id, b.abi_data_set_id) > 0), t_visualization_load AS (/* 输出的节点应该不包含sql的信息 */ SELECT t_aeolus_data_set.dataset_id, t_aeolus_data_set.dataset_name, t_aeolus_data_set.ctime /* ,t_aeolus_data_set.ttl */, t_prep_data_set.ttl, t_prep_data_set.owner_email_prefix, NULL, 1, 0) AS is_visual_output, t_prep_node_load.min_status AS prep_node_status, t_prep_node_load.output_data_type, t_prep_node_load.data_set_ids FROM t_prep_data_set LEFT JOIN (/* mysql迁移暂停 */ /* JOIN */ SELECT task_id, data_set_ids, min_status, COLLECT_SET(IF(TRIM(table_name) <> '' AND type = 'Load', CONCAT(db_name, '\\.', table_name), NULL)) AS output_table_info_his, COLLECT_SET(IF(status = min_status AND TRIM(table_name) <> '' AND type = 'Load', CONCAT(db_name, '\\.', table_name), NULL)) AS output_table_info /* 输出的表的信息，包含可视化建模的信息 */, MAX(CASE WHEN status = min_status THEN data_type END) AS output_data_type FROM (SELECT task_id, data_type, db_name, table_name, status, type, data_set_ids /* 可视化建模可能一个任务有多个数据集输出 */, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(node_conf, '$.connection.sql') LIKE '%base64%',
