MAX(app_id) AS app_id, MAX(table_size) AS table_size, MAX(table_line_num) AS table_line_num FROM (SELECT COALESCE(t_customer.dataset_id, t_visualization.dataset_id) AS dataset_id, COALESCE(t_customer.dataset_name, t_visualization.dataset_name) AS dataset_name, COALESCE(t_customer.input_data_type, t_visualization.input_data_type) AS input_data_type, COALESCE(t_customer.output_data_type, t_visualization.output_data_type) AS output_data_type, COALESCE(t_customer.owner_email_prefix, t_visualization.owner_email_prefix) AS owner_email_prefix, COALESCE(t_customer.dataset_status, t_visualization.dataset_status) AS dataset_status, COALESCE(t_customer.ctime, t_visualization.ctime) AS dataset_ctime, COALESCE(t_customer.task_id, t_visualization.task_id) AS task_id, COALESCE(t_customer.data_table_id, t_visualization.data_table_id) AS data_table_id, t_customer.table_size, t_customer.table_line_num, IF(COALESCE(is_visual_output, 0) = 1, t_visualization.sqlstr_his, t_customer.sqlstr_his) AS sqlstr_his, IF(COALESCE(is_visual_output, 0) = 1, t_visualization.sqlstr, t_customer.sqlstr) AS sqlstr, IF(COALESCE(is_visual_output, 0) = 1, t_visualization.table_info_his, t_customer.table_info_his) AS table_info_his, IF(COALESCE(is_visual_output, 0) = 1, t_visualization.table_info, t_customer.table_info) AS table_info, COALESCE(t_customer.prep_node_status, t_visualization.prep_node_status) AS prep_node_status, t_visualization.data_set_ids AS data_set_ids, COALESCE(t_customer.ttl, t_visualization.ttl) AS dataset_ttl, t_customer.app_id AS app_id /* ,t_visualization.is_visual_output */ FROM t_customer LEFT JOIN t_visualization ON t_customer.task_id = t_visualization.task_id UNION ALL /* 合并实时数据集信息: 数据源切换 */ SELECT id AS dataset_id, name AS dataset_name, NULL, NULL, owner_email_prefix, status AS dataset_status, ctime AS dataset_ctime, task_id, data_table_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, ttl AS dataset_ttl, app_id FROM mt_ods.aeolus_db__aeolus_data_set_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-04-16', '2023-04-16', '2026-05-31') AND sync_type = 3 AND status = 0) AS tmp GROUP BY dataset_id, dataset_name), t_prep_sub_task /* having ct4>1 */ AS (SELECT task_id /*  count(task_id) as ct */ /* ,count(distinct task_id) as ct2 */ /* ,count(distinct task_id,schedule_task_id) as ct3 */, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN status = min_status THEN schedule_task_id END)) AS schedule_task_id, MAX(CASE WHEN status = min_status THEN schedule_type END) AS schedule_type, MAX(CASE WHEN status = min_status THEN scheduletime_type END) AS scheduletime_type, MAX(CASE WHEN status = min_status THEN schedule_frequency END) AS schedule_frequency /* ,count(distinct scheduletype,scheduletime_type,schedule_frequency) as ct4 */ FROM (SELECT task_id /* key */, status, schedule_task_id /* key */, schedule_conf, GET_JSON_OBJECT(schedule_conf, '$.scheduleType') AS schedule_type, GET_JSON_OBJECT(schedule_conf, '$.scheduleTimeType') AS scheduletime_type, GET_JSON_OBJECT(schedule_conf, '$.scheduleFrequency') AS schedule_frequency /* 部分任务为手动的可能该字段为null */, MIN(status) OVER (PARTITION BY task_id) AS min_status FROM mt_ods.aeolus_db__prep_sub_task_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-04-16', '2023-04-16', '2026-05-31')) AS t GROUP BY task_id), t_prep_task AS (SELECT id, app_id, name, task_source, GET_JSON_OBJECT(sub_task_conf, '$.confList[0].scheduleConf.priority') AS dataset_priority FROM mt_ods.aeolus_db__prep_task_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-04-16', '2023-04-16', '2026-05-31')), t_pv AS (SELECT pl_data_set_id, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-31' THEN pv ELSE 0 END) AS pv_td, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-31' THEN `user` END) AS uv_td, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-25' THEN pv ELSE 0 END) AS pv_7d, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-25' THEN `user` END) AS uv_7d, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-18' THEN pv ELSE 0 END) AS pv_14d, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-18' THEN `user` END) AS uv_14d, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-02' THEN pv ELSE 0 END) AS pv_30d, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-02' THEN `user` END) AS uv_30d, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-04-02' THEN pv ELSE 0 END) AS pv_60d, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-04-02' THEN `user` END) AS uv_60d, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-03-03' THEN pv ELSE 0 END) AS pv_90d, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-03-03' THEN `user` END) AS uv_90d, SUM(pv) AS pv_180d, COUNT(DISTINCT `user`) AS uv_180d, COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN logymd = '2026-05-31' THEN `user` END) AS access_user_td, COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-25' THEN `user` END) AS access_user_7d, COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-18' THEN `user` END) AS access_user_14d, COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-02' THEN `user` END) AS access_user_30d FROM (SELECT logymd, pl_data_set_id, user, SUM(pv) AS pv FROM (SELECT pl_data_set_id, pdate AS logymd, `user`, pv /* FROM  mt_ods.aeolus_db__eventhub_event_di */ FROM dw_aeolus.tb_66edd9063556546edf668103bbb634f6 WHERE pdate BETWEEN IF('2025-12-03' > '2024-01-31', '2025-12-03', '1970-01-01') AND IF('2026-05-31' > DATE_ADD('2024-01-31', 179), '2026-05-31', '1970-01-01') AND /* AND channel = 'aeolus_access' */ /* AND title IN ('query_report', 'query_report_adhoc') */ /* AND channel = 'aeolus_access' */ NOT pl_app_id IS NULL AND NOT pl_resource_id IS NULL AND title IN ('query_report', 'query_report_adhoc', 'query_dashboard') AND NOT `user` IS NULL AND COALESCE(pv, 0) > 0) AS t WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-12-03' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, pl_data_set_id, user) AS t GROUP BY pl_data_set_id), t_user_info AS (SELECT COALESCE(t2.real_dp_name, t1.dp_name) AS dp_name, t1.nick, t1.email, t1.user_name, t1.logymd FROM (SELECT dp_name, nick, email, user_name, logymd FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY email ORDER BY logymd DESC, dp_name DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_mt_user_info WHERE logymd <= IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-06-20', '2023-06-20', '2026-05-31')) AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, FIRST_VALUE(dp_name) OVER (PARTITION BY group_id ORDER BY BIGINT(is_active) DESC) AS real_dp_name FROM mt_dim.dim_dp_change_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-09-05', '2024-09-05', '2026-05-31')) AS t2 ON t1.dp_name = t2.dp_name), t_dataset AS (SELECT COALESCE(t_prep_task.app_id, t_dataset_info.app_id) AS app_id, t_app.app_name, t_dataset_info.dataset_id, t_dataset_info.dataset_name, t_dataset_info.owner_email_prefix, t_dataset_info.dataset_status, t_dataset_info.dataset_ttl /* ,t_dataset_info.dataset_ctime */, FROM_UNIXTIME(t_dataset_info.dataset_ctime + 8 * 3600) AS dataset_ctime, t_prep_sub_task.schedule_type, t_prep_sub_task.scheduletime_type, t_prep_sub_task.schedule_frequency, t_dataset_info.task_id /* wind任务id */, t_prep_task.name AS task_name /* wind任务name */, t_prep_sub_task.schedule_task_id /* 调度任务task_id */, t_dataset_info.table_size AS table_size, t_dataset_info.table_line_num AS table_line_num, CONCAT_ELE(',', t_dataset_info.table_info) AS input_table_name, CONCAT(t_data_table.db_name, '\\.', t_data_table.table_name) AS output_table_name, t_dataset_info.input_data_type, t_dataset_info.output_data_type, t_dataset_info.sqlstr, t_dataset_info.sqlstr_his, t_dataset_info.prep_node_status, t_dataset_info.data_set_ids, t_prep_task.task_source, IF(task_source = 0, 1, 0) AS is_visual /* 判断是否是可视化建模 */, COALESCE(t_pv.pv_td, 0) AS pv_td, COALESCE(t_pv.uv_td, 0) AS uv_td, COALESCE(t_pv.pv_7d, 0) AS pv_7d, COALESCE(t_pv.uv_7d, 0) AS uv_7d, COALESCE(t_pv.pv_14d, 0) AS pv_14d, COALESCE(t_pv.uv_14d, 0) AS uv_14d, COALESCE(t_pv.pv_30d, 0) AS pv_30d, COALESCE(t_pv.uv_30d, 0) AS uv_30d, CONCAT('https://datawind.bi.moonton.net/bi#/dataManage/detail/', t_dataset_info.dataset_id, '?appId=', t_app.app_id) AS dataset_url, IF(task_source = 0, CONCAT('https://datawind.bi.moonton.net/bi#/prep/dataPrep/detail/', t_dataset_info.task_id, '?appId=', t_app.app_id), NULL) AS visual_task_url, t_user_info.dp_name, t_user_info.nick, t_user_info.user_name, COALESCE(t_pv.access_user_td, ARRAY()) AS access_user_td, COALESCE(t_pv.access_user_7d, ARRAY()) AS access_user_7d, COALESCE(t_pv.access_user_14d, ARRAY()) AS access_user_14d, COALESCE(t_pv.access_user_30d, ARRAY()) AS access_user_30d, t_prep_task.dataset_priority, COALESCE(t_pv.pv_180d, 0) AS pv_180d, COALESCE(t_pv.uv_180d, 0) AS uv_180d, COALESCE(t_pv.pv_90d, 0) AS pv_90d, COALESCE(t_pv.uv_90d, 0) AS uv_90d, COALESCE(t_pv.pv_60d, 0) AS pv_60d, COALESCE(t_pv.uv_60d, 0) AS uv_60d FROM t_dataset_info LEFT JOIN t_data_table ON t_dataset_info.data_table_id = t_data_table.id AND t_dataset_info.owner_email_prefix = t_data_table.owner_email_prefix LEFT JOIN t_prep_task ON t_dataset_info.task_id = t_prep_task.id LEFT JOIN t_prep_sub_task ON t_dataset_info.task_id = t_prep_sub_task.task_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT app_id, app_name FROM t_aeolus_data_set_new) AS t_app ON COALESCE(t_prep_task.app_id, t_dataset_info.app_id) = t_app.app_id LEFT JOIN t_pv ON t_dataset_info.dataset_id = t_pv.pl_data_set_id LEFT JOIN t_user_info ON (t_dataset_info.owner_email_prefix = t_user_info.email OR SPLIT(t_dataset_info.owner_email_prefix, '@')[0] = t_user_info.nick)), t_data_source AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT data_set_id, data_source_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY data_set_id, data_source_id ORDER BY mtime) AS rn FROM mt_ods.aeolus_db__aeolus_data_source_table_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND data_source_type = 'data_set') AS t1 WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_dwd`.`dwd_datawind_dataset_info_df` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t_dataset.*, IF(NOT data_source_id IS NULL AND (max_pv_td = 0 OR max_pv_td IS NULL), t3.max_pv_td, pv_td) AS fixed_pv_td, IF(NOT data_source_id IS NULL AND (max_pv_7d = 0 OR max_pv_7d IS NULL), t3.max_pv_7d, pv_7d) AS fixed_pv_7d, IF(NOT data_source_id IS NULL AND (max_pv_30d = 0 OR max_pv_30d IS NULL), t3.max_pv_30d, pv_30d) AS fixed_pv_30d, IF(NOT data_source_id IS NULL AND (max_pv_90d = 0 OR max_pv_90d IS NULL), t3.max_pv_90d, pv_90d) AS fixed_pv_90d FROM t_dataset LEFT JOIN (SELECT data_source_id, max_pv_td, max_pv_7d, max_pv_30d, max_pv_90d FROM (SELECT data_source_id, dataset_id, MAX(pv_td) OVER (PARTITION BY data_source_id) AS max_pv_td, MAX(pv_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY data_source_id) AS max_pv_7d, MAX(pv_30d) OVER (PARTITION BY data_source_id) AS max_pv_30d, MAX(pv_90d) OVER (PARTITION BY data_source_id) AS max_pv_90d FROM (SELECT t_data_source.data_source_id /* 上游数据集id */, t_dataset.dataset_id /* 当前数据集id */, t_dataset.pv_90d /* 当前数据集pv */, t_dataset.pv_7d, t_dataset.pv_30d, t_dataset.pv_td FROM t_data_source LEFT JOIN t_dataset ON t_data_source.data_set_id = t_dataset.dataset_id) AS t1) AS t2 GROUP BY data_source_id, max_pv_td, max_pv_7d, max_pv_30d, max_pv_90d) AS t3 ON t_dataset.dataset_id = t3.data_source_id

name: export_bytedance.gameserver_act_as2023_raphael
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.gameserver_act_as2023_raphael PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, reward_id, inject_note_cnt, chargediamond, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket FROM (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, reward_id, inject_note_cnt, chargediamond, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_as2023_raphael WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(createrole_country, '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS md LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_account FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-07', '2022-05-07', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON md.roleid = adv_us.us_account WHERE adv_us.us_account IS NULL

name: mt_ads.ads_gamebi_create_pay_change30d_df_role
sql_units: WITH basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, create_os, first_network_name, is_first_create, new_type, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-20', '2023-05-20', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND zoneid < 57000 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31'), info_df_role AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) < 30, charge_amt_total_array[0], charge_amt_total_array[SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) - 30]), 0) AS charge_amt_30d /* 30日付费金额 */, COALESCE(IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) < 30, charge_cnt_total_array[0], charge_cnt_total_array[SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) - 30]), 0) AS charge_cnt_30d /* 30日付费次数 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df /* WHERE   logymd = IF('{dt}' <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -6), DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -6), '{dt}')   */ WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df) AND zoneid < 57000) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_create_pay_change30d_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', granularity_type = 'role') SELECT register_date, first_mt_country AS country, zoneid, create_os AS os, first_network_name AS network, new_type, pay_grade_30d, cnt_grade_30d, COUNT(*) AS register_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(charge_amt_30d, 0)) AS pay_amt FROM (SELECT bsc.roleid, bsc.register_date, bsc.first_mt_country, bsc.zoneid, bsc.create_os, bsc.first_network_name, bsc.new_type, charge_amt_30d, CASE WHEN charge_amt_30d / 100 > 0 AND charge_amt_30d / 100 < 0.99 THEN '0' WHEN charge_amt_30d / 100 >= 0.99 AND charge_amt_30d / 100 < 4.99 THEN '0.99' WHEN charge_amt_30d / 100 >= 4.99 AND charge_amt_30d / 100 < 9.99 THEN '4.99' WHEN charge_amt_30d / 100 >= 9.99 THEN '9.99' ELSE '-1' END AS pay_grade_30d, CASE WHEN charge_cnt_30d >= 1 AND charge_cnt_30d < 3 THEN '1' WHEN charge_cnt_30d >= 3 AND charge_cnt_30d < 5 THEN '2' WHEN charge_cnt_30d >= 5 THEN '3' ELSE '0' END AS cnt_grade_30d FROM basic_df AS bsc LEFT JOIN info_df_role AS ifo ON bsc.roleid = ifo.roleid AND bsc.zoneid = ifo.zoneid) AS t1 GROUP BY register_date, first_mt_country, zoneid, create_os, first_network_name, new_type, pay_grade_30d, cnt_grade_30d

name: tmp_hero_retain_df
sql_units: WITH role_cnt AS (SELECT t1.logymd, CASE WHEN t3.country IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t3.country END AS country, CASE WHEN t4.his_last_bigrank IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t4.his_last_bigrank END AS his_last_bigrank, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_active_day = 1 THEN CONCAT(t1.roleid, t1.zoneid) END) AS active_usercnt /* 活跃角色数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_charge_day = 1 THEN CONCAT(t1.roleid, t1.zoneid) END) AS pay_usercnt /* 付费角色数 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, is_active_day, is_charge_day FROM mt_dm.dm_own_permanent_hero_skin_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, is_active_day, is_charge_day) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' < '2023-05-03', '2023-05-03', '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_ai = 0) AS t2 /* 角色基础信息 */ ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT lower, country FROM mt_dim.dim_national_geographic_atlas_config) AS t3 /* 国家或地区 */ ON t2.first_mt_country = t3.lower LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_bigrank FROM mt_dm.dm_gameplay_battle_rank_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype = 2 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, his_last_bigrank) AS t4 /* 角色段位 */ ON t1.roleid = t4.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t4.zoneid GROUP BY t1.logymd, CASE WHEN t3.country IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t3.country END, CASE WHEN t4.his_last_bigrank IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t4.his_last_bigrank END) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tmp_hero_retain_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT t6.heroid, t6.hero_name, t6.heroes, t6.country, t6.his_last_bigrank, t6.user_cnt /* 保有英雄的角色数 */, t6.hero_active_usercnt /* 保有指定英雄的活跃角色数（统计活跃角色保有英雄率） */, t7.active_usercnt /* 活跃角色数（统计活跃角色保有英雄率） */, t6.hero_pay_usercnt /* 保有指定英雄的付费角色数（统计付费角色保有英雄率） */, t7.pay_usercnt /* 付费角色数（统计付费角色保有英雄率） */ FROM (SELECT t1.logymd, CASE WHEN t1.heroid IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t1.heroid END AS heroid, CASE WHEN t4.hero_name IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t4.hero_name END AS hero_name, CASE WHEN t4.heroes IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t4.heroes END AS heroes, CASE WHEN t3.country IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t3.country END AS country, CASE WHEN t5.his_last_bigrank IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t5.his_last_bigrank END AS his_last_bigrank, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid) AS user_cnt /* 保有英雄的角色数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.is_active_day = 1 THEN CONCAT(t1.roleid, t1.zoneid) END) AS hero_active_usercnt /* 保有指定英雄的活跃角色数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.is_charge_day = 1 THEN CONCAT(t1.roleid, t1.zoneid) END) AS hero_pay_usercnt /* 保有指定英雄的付费角色数 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, is_active_day, is_charge_day, a.heroid, a.first_get_time FROM mt_dm.dm_own_permanent_hero_skin_df LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(permanent_hero_json) a AS heroid, first_get_time WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t1 /* 英雄获取信息 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' < '2023-05-03', '2023-05-03', '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_ai = 0) AS t2 /* 角色基础信息 */ ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT lower, country FROM mt_dim.dim_national_geographic_atlas_config) AS t3 /* 国家或地区 */ ON t2.first_mt_country = t3.lower LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, hero_name /* 英雄中文名称 */, CASE WHEN sub_heroes = -9999 THEN heroes ELSE CONCAT(heroes, '\\073', sub_heroes) END AS heroes /* 英雄职业（主定位+次定位） */ FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' < '2023-05-03', '2023-05-03', '2026-05-30')) AS t4 /* 英雄属性 */ ON t1.heroid = t4.heroid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_bigrank FROM mt_dm.dm_gameplay_battle_rank_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype = 2 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, his_last_bigrank) AS t5 /* 角色段位 */ ON t1.roleid = t5.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t5.zoneid GROUP BY t1.logymd, CASE WHEN t1.heroid IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t1.heroid END, CASE WHEN t4.hero_name IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t4.hero_name END, CASE WHEN t4.heroes IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t4.heroes END, CASE WHEN t3.country IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t3.country END, CASE WHEN t5.his_last_bigrank IS NULL THEN '无信息' ELSE t5.his_last_bigrank END) AS t6 LEFT JOIN role_cnt AS t7 /* 计算角色数 */ ON t6.logymd = t7.logymd AND t6.country = t7.country AND t6.his_last_bigrank = t7.his_last_bigrank GROUP BY t6.heroid, t6.hero_name, t6.heroes, t6.country, t6.his_last_bigrank, t6.user_cnt /* 保有英雄的角色数 */, t6.hero_active_usercnt /* 保有指定英雄的活跃角色数（统计活跃角色保有英雄率） */, t7.active_usercnt /* 活跃角色数（统计活跃角色保有英雄率） */, t6.hero_pay_usercnt /* 保有指定英雄的付费角色数（统计付费角色保有英雄率） */, t7.pay_usercnt /* 付费角色数（统计付费角色保有英雄率） */

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_pay_channel_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: yukiyi@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-05-15 14:49:48.000 */ /* Description: */ /* -- 需求文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/QPhLdGjYWojb63x8gbDce8vFnFf */ /* -- 自测文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/YdhDdyUDboggBjxijspcNpCRnjc */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mt_ads`.`ads_gamebi_pay_channel_di`( */ /*     `granularity_type` string COMMENT '用户粒度类型', */ /*     `country` string COMMENT '首次创号国', */ /*     `zoneid` bigint COMMENT '服务器', */ /*     `os` string COMMENT '平台', */ /*     `network` string COMMENT '首次广告归因渠道', */ /*     `pay_channel` string COMMENT '支付渠道', */ /*     `sub_pay_channel` string COMMENT '支付子渠道', */ /*     `currency` string COMMENT '支付币种', */ /*     `pay_amt` decimal(38,18) COMMENT '充值金额（美分）', */ /*     `pay_amount_exrate` decimal(38,18) COMMENT '汇率校准后充值金额（美分）', */ /*     `pay_net_receipts_amt` decimal(38,18) COMMENT '实收（美分）' */ /* ) COMMENT '收入专题-分渠道充值金额分布' PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd', */ /*     `appid` string COMMENT '应用ID' */ /* ) STORED AS PARQUET location 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_gamebi_pay_channel_di' */ WITH basic_info AS (SELECT first_mt_country AS country, roleid, zoneid, is_first_create, create_os AS os, first_network_name AS network FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0), charge_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, currency, product_money AS pay_amt, before_tax_usd_amt AS pay_amount_exrate, pay_net_receipts_usd_amt AS pay_net_receipts_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_pay_channel_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT 'role' AS granularity_type, t1.country, t1.zoneid, t1.os, t1.network, COALESCE(t2.pay_channel, 'unknown') AS pay_channel, COALESCE(t2.sub_pay_channel, 'unknown') AS sub_pay_channel, COALESCE(t2.currency, 'unknown') AS currency, SUM(COALESCE(t2.pay_amt, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(COALESCE(t2.pay_amount_exrate, 0)) AS pay_amount_exrate, SUM(COALESCE(t2.pay_net_receipts_amt, 0)) AS pay_net_receipts_amt FROM (SELECT * FROM basic_info WHERE zoneid < 57000) AS t1 LEFT JOIN charge_info AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid GROUP BY t1.zoneid, t1.country, t1.os, t1.network, COALESCE(t2.pay_channel, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t2.sub_pay_channel, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t2.currency, 'unknown') UNION ALL SELECT 'account' AS granularity_type, t1.country, -99999 AS zoneid, t1.os, t1.network, COALESCE(t2.pay_channel, 'unknown') AS pay_channel, COALESCE(t2.sub_pay_channel, 'unknown') AS sub_pay_channel, COALESCE(t2.currency, 'unknown') AS currency, SUM(COALESCE(t2.pay_amt, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(COALESCE(t2.pay_amount_exrate, 0)) AS pay_amount_exrate, SUM(COALESCE(t2.pay_net_receipts_amt, 0)) AS pay_net_receipts_amt FROM (SELECT * FROM basic_info WHERE is_first_create = 1) AS t1 LEFT JOIN charge_info AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid GROUP BY t1.country, t1.os, t1.network, COALESCE(t2.pay_channel, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t2.sub_pay_channel, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t2.currency, 'unknown')

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_commercialized_rfm_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH t_basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM `mt_dim`.`dim_basic_role_zone_df` WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31') AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_ai = 0 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31'), t_active_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_date, IF(his_last_active_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_active_day, IF(his_last_active_date = '2026-05-31', IF(COALESCE(his_last_active_second_date, '1970-01-01') = '1970-01-01', 0, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', his_last_active_second_date)), DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', his_last_active_date)) AS bf_active_date_diff, his_last_active_own_diamond AS diamond_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000), t_pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pay_amt_30_days, pay_amt_90_days, pay_amt_1095_days, CASE WHEN pay_amt_1095_days > 8200 AND pay_amt_90_days > 700 AND pay_amt_30_days > 0 THEN 1 WHEN pay_amt_1095_days > 8200 AND pay_amt_90_days > 700 AND pay_amt_30_days = 0 THEN 2 WHEN pay_amt_1095_days > 8200 AND pay_amt_90_days <= 700 AND pay_amt_30_days > 0 THEN 3 WHEN pay_amt_1095_days > 8200 AND pay_amt_90_days <= 700 AND pay_amt_30_days = 0 THEN 4 WHEN pay_amt_1095_days <= 8200 AND pay_amt_90_days > 700 AND pay_amt_30_days > 0 THEN 5 WHEN pay_amt_1095_days <= 8200 AND pay_amt_90_days > 700 AND pay_amt_30_days = 0 THEN 6 WHEN pay_amt_1095_days <= 8200 AND pay_amt_90_days <= 700 AND pay_amt_30_days > 0 THEN 7 WHEN pay_amt_1095_days <= 8200 AND pay_amt_90_days <= 700 AND pay_amt_30_days = 0 THEN 8 END AS commercialized_rfm_tags, his_before_tax_usd_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN logymd = '2026-05-31' THEN his_before_tax_usd_amt ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN logymd = '2026-05-01' THEN his_before_tax_usd_amt ELSE 0 END)) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)) AS pay_amt_30_days, CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN logymd = '2026-05-31' THEN his_before_tax_usd_amt ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN logymd = '2026-03-02' THEN his_before_tax_usd_amt ELSE 0 END)) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)) AS pay_amt_90_days, CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN logymd = '2026-05-31' THEN his_before_tax_usd_amt ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN logymd = '2023-06-01' THEN his_before_tax_usd_amt ELSE 0 END)) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)) AS pay_amt_1095_days, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN logymd = '2026-05-31' THEN his_before_tax_usd_amt ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(38, 2)) AS his_before_tax_usd_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(his_before_tax_usd_amt) AS his_before_tax_usd_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd IN ('2023-06-01', '2026-03-02', '2026-05-01', '2026-05-31') /* 求近N日的付费金额，用df作差 */ AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t2) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_commercialized_rfm_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t_basic_df.roleid, t_basic_df.zoneid, t_basic_df.register_date, IF(COALESCE(t_basic_df.register_date, '1970-01-01') = '1970-01-01', -99999, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', t_basic_df.register_date)) AS register_date_diff, COALESCE(t_active_df.bf_active_date_diff, -99999) AS bf_active_date_diff, COALESCE(t_active_df.his_last_active_date, '1970-01-01') AS his_last_active_date, IF(SUBSTRING(COALESCE(t_active_df.his_last_active_date, '1970-01-01'), 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), 1, 0) AS is_active_mon, COALESCE(t_pay_df.pay_amt_30_days, 0) AS pay_amt_30_days, COALESCE(t_pay_df.pay_amt_90_days, 0) AS pay_amt_90_days, COALESCE(t_pay_df.pay_amt_1095_days, 0) AS pay_amt_1095_days, COALESCE(t_pay_df.commercialized_rfm_tags, 8) AS commercialized_rfm_tags, COALESCE(t_pay_df.his_before_tax_usd_amt, 0) AS his_pay_amt, COALESCE(t_active_df.diamond_amt, 0) AS diamond_amt FROM t_basic_df LEFT JOIN t_active_df ON t_basic_df.roleid = t_active_df.roleid AND t_basic_df.zoneid = t_active_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_pay_df ON t_basic_df.roleid = t_pay_df.roleid AND t_basic_df.zoneid = t_pay_df.zoneid

name: base_gps_adid_info
sql_units: /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adbi_test.base_gps_adid_info ( */ /*     app_id STRING, */ /*     `device_id` STRING, */ /*     os STRING, */ /*     day2_retention bigint, */ /*     day3_retention bigint, */ /*     day7_retention bigint, */ /*     day14_retention bigint, */ /*     day1_revenue bigint, */ /*     day3_revenue bigint, */ /*     day7_revenue bigint, */ /*     day14_revenue bigint, */ /*     day30_revenue bigint, */ /*     day1_revenue_users bigint, */ /*     day3_revenue_users bigint, */ /*     day7_revenue_users bigint, */ /*     day14_revenue_users bigint, */ /*     day30_revenue_users bigint */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY (`p_date` STRING) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/advertisement_bi/adbi_test/base_gps_adid_info'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi_test.base_gps_adid_info PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT app_id, app_name, gps_adid, os, create_date, network_name, did_new_user, IF(day2_retention IS NULL, 0, day2_retention) AS day2_retention, IF(day3_retention IS NULL, 0, day3_retention) AS day3_retention, IF(day7_retention IS NULL, 0, day7_retention) AS day7_retention, IF(day14_retention IS NULL, 0, day14_retention) AS day14_retention, IF(day1_revenue IS NULL, 0, day1_revenue) AS day1_revenue, IF(day3_revenue IS NULL, 0, day3_revenue) AS day3_revenue, IF(day7_revenue IS NULL, 0, day7_revenue) AS day7_revenue, IF(day14_revenue IS NULL, 0, day14_revenue) AS day14_revenue, IF(day30_revenue IS NULL, 0, day30_revenue) AS day30_revenue, IF(day1_revenue_users IS NULL, 0, day1_revenue_users) AS day1_revenue_users, IF(day3_revenue_users IS NULL, 0, day3_revenue_users) AS day3_revenue_users, IF(day7_revenue_users IS NULL, 0, day7_revenue_users) AS day7_revenue_users, IF(day14_revenue_users IS NULL, 0, day14_revenue_users) AS day14_revenue_users, IF(day30_revenue_users IS NULL, 0, day30_revenue_users) AS day30_revenue_users FROM (SELECT a.app_id, b.app_name, gps_adid, os, create_date, network_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS did_new_user, SUM(CAST(SUBSTRING(active_info, -2, 1) AS BIGINT)) AS day2_retention, SUM(CAST(SUBSTRING(active_info, -3, 1) AS BIGINT)) AS day3_retention, SUM(CAST(SUBSTRING(active_info, -7, 1) AS BIGINT)) AS day7_retention, SUM(CAST(SUBSTRING(active_info, -14, 1) AS BIGINT)) AS day14_retention, SUM(IF(SIZE(pay_amt_info) - 1 >= 0, CAST(pay_amt_info[SIZE(pay_amt_info) - 1] AS BIGINT), NULL)) AS day1_revenue, SUM(IF(SIZE(pay_amt_info) - 3 >= 0, CAST(pay_amt_info[SIZE(pay_amt_info) - 3] AS BIGINT), NULL)) AS day3_revenue, SUM(IF(SIZE(pay_amt_info) - 7 >= 0, CAST(pay_amt_info[SIZE(pay_amt_info) - 7] AS BIGINT), NULL)) AS day7_revenue, SUM(IF(SIZE(pay_amt_info) - 14 >= 0, CAST(pay_amt_info[SIZE(pay_amt_info) - 14] AS BIGINT), NULL)) AS day14_revenue, SUM(IF(SIZE(pay_amt_info) - 30 >= 0, CAST(pay_amt_info[SIZE(pay_amt_info) - 30] AS BIGINT), NULL)) AS day30_revenue, COUNT(IF(SIZE(pay_cnt_info) - 1 >= 0, IF(pay_cnt_info[SIZE(pay_cnt_info) - 1] > 0, device_id, NULL), NULL)) AS day1_revenue_users, COUNT(IF(SIZE(pay_cnt_info) - 3 >= 0, IF(pay_cnt_info[SIZE(pay_cnt_info) - 3] > 0, device_id, NULL), NULL)) AS day3_revenue_users, COUNT(IF(SIZE(pay_cnt_info) - 7 >= 0, IF(pay_cnt_info[SIZE(pay_cnt_info) - 7] > 0, device_id, NULL), NULL)) AS day7_revenue_users, COUNT(IF(SIZE(pay_cnt_info) - 14 >= 0, IF(pay_cnt_info[SIZE(pay_cnt_info) - 14] > 0, device_id, NULL), NULL)) AS day14_revenue_users, COUNT(IF(SIZE(pay_cnt_info) - 30 >= 0, IF(pay_cnt_info[SIZE(pay_cnt_info) - 30] > 0, device_id, NULL), NULL)) AS day30_revenue_users FROM adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, app_name FROM adbi.gms_ad_bi_app WHERE p_date = '20260531' GROUP BY app_id, app_name) AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND create_date >= '2023-05-01' AND NOT gps_adid IN ('', 'none', 'unknown') AND NOT gps_adid IS NULL AND network_name IN ('Google Ads (unknown)', 'Google (unknown)', 'Google Ads ACE', 'Google Ads ACI', 'Google Ads Display', 'Google Ads Search', 'Google Ads Shopping', 'Google Ads UAC', 'Google Ads UAC Re-engagement', 'Google Ads Video', 'Google Ads Organic Search', 'Google Universal App Campaign', 'Google_Admob', 'Google_RMT', 'Google_Search', 'Adwords (unknown)', 'Adwords Dispaly Installs', 'Adwords Installs', 'Adwords Search Installs', 'Adwords Shopping Installs', 'Adwords UAC Installs', 'Adwords UAC Re-engagements', 'Adwords Video Installs') GROUP BY a.app_id, b.app_name, gps_adid, os, create_date, network_name)

name: adbi.dwm_userprofile_msdk_device_active_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: cherylxie@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-05-06 15:57:32.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE TABLE if not exists `adbi`.`dwm_userprofile_msdk_device_active_di`( */ /*     `did` string COMMENT 'did', */ /*     `account_id` string COMMENT 'account_id', */ /*     `package_name` string COMMENT 'package_name', */ /*     `store` string COMMENT 'store', */ /*     `login_cnt` int COMMENT '登录次数', */ /*     `log_duration` int COMMENT '登录时长', */ /*     `active_hour_cnt` array < int > COMMENT '小时级活跃信息,active_hour_cnt[0]代表hour=0下的活跃次数', */ /*     `is_emulator` int COMMENT 'is_emulator', */ /*     `is_active` int COMMENT '当天是否活跃（有可能出现当天有下线操作，会返回online_time，但是不满足活跃条件的）', */ /*     `first_login_time` string COMMENT '当天首次登录时间', */ /*     `last_login_time` string COMMENT '当天末次登录时间' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `p_date` string COMMENT 'p_date', */ /*     `app_id` string COMMENT 'app_id' */ /* )    stored as parquet; */ /* 初始化 */ WITH base AS (SELECT app_id, did, COALESCE(account_id, '') AS account_id, event, event_desc, package_name, store, is_emulator, event_time, logymd FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (app_id <> '4080' /* 剔除4080中and开头的脏数据 */ OR did NOT LIKE 'and_%') AND did <> 'unknown'), online_time AS (SELECT did, account_id, package_name, MAX(is_emulator) AS is_emulator, app_id, logymd, store, SUM(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.ol_time')) AS online_time FROM base WHERE event = '__online_time__' GROUP BY did, account_id, app_id, logymd, package_name, store), login_cnt AS (SELECT app_id, did, account_id, package_name, store, MAX(is_emulator) AS is_emulator, logymd, COUNT(IF(event = '__launch_event__', 1, NULL)) AS login_cnt, MIN(event_time) AS min_login_time, MAX(event_time) AS max_login_time FROM base WHERE event IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'purchase_event', 'login', 'logout') GROUP BY app_id, did, account_id, logymd, package_name, store), active_hour_cnt AS (SELECT did, account_id, package_name, store, MAX(is_emulator) AS is_emulator, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 0, 1, NULL)) AS active_0, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 1, 1, NULL)) AS active_1, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 2, 1, NULL)) AS active_2, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 3, 1, NULL)) AS active_3, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 4, 1, NULL)) AS active_4, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 5, 1, NULL)) AS active_5, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 6, 1, NULL)) AS active_6, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 7, 1, NULL)) AS active_7, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 8, 1, NULL)) AS active_8, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 9, 1, NULL)) AS active_9, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 10, 1, NULL)) AS active_10, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 11, 1, NULL)) AS active_11, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 12, 1, NULL)) AS active_12, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 13, 1, NULL)) AS active_13, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 14, 1, NULL)) AS active_14, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 15, 1, NULL)) AS active_15, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 16, 1, NULL)) AS active_16, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 17, 1, NULL)) AS active_17, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 18, 1, NULL)) AS active_18, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 19, 1, NULL)) AS active_19, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 20, 1, NULL)) AS active_20, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 21, 1, NULL)) AS active_21, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 22, 1, NULL)) AS active_22, COUNT(IF(`hour` = 23, 1, NULL)) AS active_23 FROM (SELECT did, account_id, FROM_UNIXTIME(SUBSTRING(event_time, 1, 10), 'H') AS hour, logymd, package_name, MAX(is_emulator) AS is_emulator, store FROM base WHERE event IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'purchase_event', 'login', 'logout') GROUP BY did, account_id, package_name, store, FROM_UNIXTIME(SUBSTRING(event_time, 1, 10), 'H'), logymd) GROUP BY did, account_id, package_name, store), login_info AS (SELECT COALESCE(a.app_id, b.app_id) AS app_id, COALESCE(a.logymd, b.logymd) AS logymd, COALESCE(a.did, b.did) AS did, COALESCE(a.account_id, b.account_id) AS account_id, COALESCE(online_time, 0) AS online_time, COALESCE(login_cnt, 0) AS login_cnt, IF(NOT b.app_id IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_active, COALESCE(a.package_name, b.package_name) AS package_name, COALESCE(a.store, b.store) AS store, IF(a.is_emulator = 1 OR b.is_emulator = 1, 1, 0) AS is_emulator, min_login_time, max_login_time FROM online_time AS a FULL JOIN login_cnt AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.did = b.did AND a.account_id = b.account_id AND a.package_name = b.package_name AND a.store = b.store) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwm_userprofile_msdk_device_active_di)) SELECT a.did, a.account_id, a.package_name, a.store, login_cnt AS active_cnt, IF(online_time < 0, 0, online_time) AS log_duration, IF(NOT b.active_0 IS NULL, ARRAY(active_0, active_1, active_2, active_3, active_4, active_5, active_6, active_7, active_8, active_9, active_10, active_11, active_12, active_13, active_14, active_15, active_16, active_17, active_18, active_19, active_20, active_21, active_22, active_23), ARRAY_REPEAT(0, 24)) AS active_hour_cnt, a.is_emulator, is_active, min_login_time AS first_login_time, max_login_time AS last_login_time, app_id FROM login_info AS a LEFT JOIN active_hour_cnt AS b ON a.did = b.did AND a.account_id = b.account_id AND a.package_name = b.package_name AND a.store = b.store

name: adbi.dim_userprofile_msdk_basic_device_di
sql_units: WITH base AS (SELECT did, package_name, is_emulator, os, os_version, network_type, system_language AS os_language, system_language, game_language, event_time, server_time, CASE WHEN event_time > 0 THEN DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE logymd END AS createdate, client_version, sdk_version, IF(idfa = 'unknown' OR idfa = '0000-0000' OR idfa = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', NULL, idfa) AS idfa, IF(idfv = 'unknown' OR idfv = '0000-0000' OR idfv = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', NULL, idfv) AS idfv, IF(gps_adid = 'unknown' OR gps_adid = '0000-0000' OR gps_adid = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', NULL, gps_adid) AS gps_adid, IF(android_id = 'unknown' OR android_id = '0000-0000' OR android_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', NULL, android_id) AS android_id, IF(gps_asid = 'unknown' OR gps_asid = '0000-0000' OR gps_asid = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', NULL, gps_asid) AS gps_asid, IF(drm_id = 'unknown' OR drm_id = '0000-0000' OR drm_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', NULL, drm_id) AS drm_id, is_root, app_version, app_id FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE logymd = '20260531' AND event IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'login' /* 以下为本次需求新增事件 */, 'logout', 'purchase_event') /* '__install_event__', */ /* '__launch_event__', */ /* 'role_login', */ /* 'role_register', */ /* 'create_filter' */ AND NOT did IS NULL AND did <> 'unknown'), result AS (SELECT did, package_name, FIRST_VALUE(is_emulator, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS is_emulator, FIRST_VALUE(os, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS os, FIRST_VALUE(os_version, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS os_version_origin, SPLIT(FIRST_VALUE(os_version, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time), '\\.')[0] AS os_version, FIRST_VALUE(network_type, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS network_type, LAST_VALUE(os_language, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS os_language, FIRST_VALUE(createdate, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS createdate, FIRST_VALUE(client_version, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS client_version, FIRST_VALUE(sdk_version, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS sdk_version, FIRST_VALUE(idfa, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS idfa, FIRST_VALUE(idfv, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS idfv, FIRST_VALUE(gps_adid, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS gps_adid, FIRST_VALUE(android_id, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS android_id, FIRST_VALUE(gps_asid, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS gps_asid, FIRST_VALUE(drm_id, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS drm_id, LAST_VALUE(is_root, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS is_root, FIRST_VALUE(app_version, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS app_version, LAST_VALUE(game_language, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, package_name ORDER BY event_time, server_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS game_language, app_id FROM base) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_userprofile_msdk_basic_device_di)) SELECT did, package_name, FIRST_VALUE(is_emulator) AS is_emulator, FIRST_VALUE(os) AS os, FIRST_VALUE(os_version_origin) AS os_version_origin, FIRST_VALUE(os_version) AS os_version, FIRST_VALUE(network_type) AS network_type, FIRST_VALUE(os_language) AS os_language, FIRST_VALUE(createdate) AS createdate, FIRST_VALUE(client_version) AS client_version, FIRST_VALUE(sdk_version) AS sdk_version, FIRST_VALUE(idfa) AS idfa, FIRST_VALUE(idfv) AS idfv, FIRST_VALUE(gps_adid) AS gps_adid, FIRST_VALUE(android_id) AS android_id, FIRST_VALUE(gps_asid) AS gps_asid, FIRST_VALUE(drm_id) AS drm_id, FIRST_VALUE(is_root) AS is_root, FIRST_VALUE(app_version) AS app_version, FIRST_VALUE(game_language) AS game_language, app_id FROM result GROUP BY did, app_id, package_name

name: adbi.dwm_userprofile_msdk_device_install_df
sql_units: WITH base_di AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, did, package_name ORDER BY last_install_time DESC) AS rn FROM adbi.dwm_userprofile_msdk_device_install_di WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND (NOT did IS NULL AND did <> 'unknown') /* AND ( */ /*     did NOT IN ('h3fLsM8AUai548BwBqLTBw==', 'zPN9mt5DqAsu90MtKySDNg==') */ /*     OR store = 'gp_global' */ /* ) */) WHERE rn = 1), base_df AS (SELECT * FROM adbi.dwm_userprofile_msdk_device_install_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND NOT did IS NULL AND did <> 'unknown') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwm_userprofile_msdk_device_install_df PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT COALESCE(a.did, b.did) AS did, COALESCE(a.store, b.store) AS store, COALESCE(a.package_name, b.package_name) AS package_name, COALESCE(IF(a.first_install_time_from_activity < b.first_install_time_from_activity, a.first_install_time_from_activity, COALESCE(b.first_install_time_from_activity, a.first_install_time_from_activity)), IF(a.first_install_time_from_event < b.first_install_time_from_event, a.first_install_time_from_event, COALESCE(b.first_install_time_from_event, a.first_install_time_from_event))) AS first_install_time /* 先activity再event */, COALESCE(IF(b.last_install_time_from_activity > a.last_install_time_from_activity, b.last_install_time_from_activity, COALESCE(a.last_install_time_from_activity, b.last_install_time_from_activity)), IF(b.last_install_time_from_event > a.last_install_time_from_event, b.last_install_time_from_event, COALESCE(a.last_install_time_from_event, b.last_install_time_from_event))) AS last_install_time, IF(a.first_uninstall_time < b.first_uninstall_time, a.first_uninstall_time, COALESCE(b.first_uninstall_time, a.first_uninstall_time)) AS first_uninstall_time, IF(b.last_uninstall_time > a.last_uninstall_time, b.last_uninstall_time, COALESCE(a.last_uninstall_time, b.last_uninstall_time)) AS last_uninstall_time, IF(a.first_install_time_from_activity < b.first_install_time_from_activity, a.first_install_time_from_activity, COALESCE(b.first_install_time_from_activity, a.first_install_time_from_activity)) AS first_install_time_from_activity, IF(b.last_install_time_from_activity > a.last_install_time_from_activity, b.last_install_time_from_activity, COALESCE(a.last_install_time_from_activity, b.last_install_time_from_activity)) AS last_install_time_from_activity, IF(a.first_install_time_from_event < b.first_install_time_from_event, a.first_install_time_from_event, COALESCE(b.first_install_time_from_event, a.first_install_time_from_event)) AS first_install_time_from_event, IF(b.last_install_time_from_event > a.last_install_time_from_event, b.last_install_time_from_event, COALESCE(a.last_install_time_from_event, b.last_install_time_from_event)) AS last_install_time_from_event, IF(a.first_uninstall_time_from_activity < b.first_uninstall_time_from_activity, a.first_uninstall_time_from_activity, COALESCE(b.first_uninstall_time_from_activity, a.first_uninstall_time_from_activity)) AS first_uninstall_time_from_activity, IF(b.last_uninstall_time_from_activity > a.last_uninstall_time_from_activity, b.last_uninstall_time_from_activity, COALESCE(a.last_uninstall_time_from_activity, b.last_uninstall_time_from_activity)) AS last_uninstall_time_from_activity, IF(a.first_uninstall_time_from_event < b.first_uninstall_time_from_event, a.first_uninstall_time_from_event, COALESCE(b.first_uninstall_time_from_event, a.first_uninstall_time_from_event)) AS first_uninstall_time_from_event, IF(b.last_uninstall_time_from_event > a.last_uninstall_time_from_event, b.last_uninstall_time_from_event, COALESCE(a.last_uninstall_time_from_event, b.last_uninstall_time_from_event)) AS last_uninstall_time_from_event, IF(b.last_activity_time > a.last_activity_time, b.last_activity_kind, COALESCE(a.last_activity_kind, b.last_activity_kind)) AS last_activity_kind, IF(b.last_activity_time > a.last_activity_time, b.last_activity_time, COALESCE(a.last_activity_time, b.last_activity_time)) AS last_activity_time, IF(b.last_activity_date > a.last_activity_date, b.last_activity_date, COALESCE(a.last_activity_date, b.last_activity_date)) AS last_activity_date, COALESCE(b.last_msdk_server_time, a.last_msdk_server_time) AS last_msdk_server_time, IF(b.last_activity_time > a.last_activity_time, b.uninstall_status, COALESCE(a.uninstall_status, b.uninstall_status)) AS uninstall_status, COALESCE(a.app_id, b.app_id) AS app_id FROM base_df AS a FULL JOIN base_di AS b ON a.did = b.did AND a.package_name = b.package_name AND a.app_id = b.app_id

name: adbi.dwm_userprofile_msdk_device_install_di
sql_units: WITH base AS (/* 非4020/4030/4040/4050 */ SELECT msdk_did AS msdk_did /* msdk不存在时，使用idfa/idfv等关联补齐 */, msdk_store, msdk_package_name, msdk_server_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') AS activity_kind, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.created_at') AS event_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.installed_at') AS installed_event_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.reinstalled_at') AS reinstalled_event_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.uninstalled_at') AS uninstalled_event_time, msdk_app_id, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, logymd FROM msdk_ods.msdk_adjust WHERE logymd = '20260531' AND msdk_app_id <> '4030' AND msdk_app_id <> '4040' AND msdk_app_id <> '4050' UNION ALL /* 4020 */ SELECT GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.customer_user_id') AS msdk_did /* msdk不存在时，使用idfa/idfv等关联补齐 */, msdk_store, msdk_package_name, msdk_server_time, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(event_time) AS event_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.conversion_type') AS activity_kind, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.install_time')) AS installed_event_time, NULL AS reinstalled_event_time, NULL AS uninstalled_event_time, msdk_app_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.idfa') AS idfa, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.idfv') AS idfv, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.advertising_id') AS gps_adid, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.android_id') AS android_id, logymd FROM msdk_ods.msdk_appsflyer WHERE logymd = '20260531'), basic_device AS (SELECT did, package_name, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, app_id FROM adbi.dim_userprofile_msdk_basic_device_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31'), remedy_did AS (SELECT msdk_did, msdk_store, msdk_package_name, activity_kind, msdk_app_id, msdk_server_time, event_time, installed_event_time, reinstalled_event_time, uninstalled_event_time, logymd FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msdk_app_id, msdk_package_name, msdk_did ORDER BY IF(reinstalled_event_time > 0, reinstalled_event_time, installed_event_time) DESC) AS rn FROM base WHERE NOT msdk_did IS NULL) AS a WHERE rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(b.did, c.did, d.did, e.did) AS msdk_did, msdk_store, msdk_package_name, activity_kind, msdk_app_id, msdk_server_time, event_time, installed_event_time, reinstalled_event_time, uninstalled_event_time, logymd FROM (SELECT * FROM base WHERE msdk_did IS NULL) AS a LEFT JOIN basic_device AS b ON a.idfa = b.idfa AND a.msdk_app_id = b.app_id AND a.msdk_package_name = b.package_name AND NOT b.idfa IS NULL AND b.idfa <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND b.idfa <> '0000-0000' AND b.idfa <> 'unknown' AND b.idfa <> 'null' AND b.idfa <> 'none' LEFT JOIN basic_device AS c ON a.idfv = c.idfv AND a.msdk_app_id = c.app_id AND a.msdk_package_name = c.package_name AND NOT c.idfv IS NULL AND c.idfv <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND c.idfv <> '0000-0000' AND c.idfv <> 'unknown' AND c.idfv <> 'null' AND c.idfv <> 'none' LEFT JOIN basic_device AS d ON a.gps_adid = d.gps_adid AND a.msdk_app_id = d.app_id AND a.msdk_package_name = d.package_name AND NOT d.gps_adid IS NULL AND d.gps_adid <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND d.gps_adid <> '0000-0000' AND d.gps_adid <> 'unknown' AND d.gps_adid <> 'null' AND d.gps_adid <> 'none' LEFT JOIN basic_device AS e ON a.android_id = e.android_id AND a.msdk_app_id = e.app_id AND a.msdk_package_name = e.package_name AND NOT e.android_id IS NULL AND e.android_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND e.android_id <> '0000-0000' AND e.android_id <> 'unknown' AND e.android_id <> 'null' AND e.android_id <> 'none') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwm_userprofile_msdk_device_install_di PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT a.msdk_did, a.msdk_store, a.msdk_package_name, COALESCE(first_install_time_from_activity, first_install_time_from_event) AS first_install_time, COALESCE(last_install_time_from_activity, last_install_time_from_event) AS last_install_time, COALESCE(first_uninstall_time_from_activity, first_uninstall_time_from_event) AS first_uninstall_time, COALESCE(last_uninstall_time_from_activity, last_uninstall_time_from_event) AS last_uninstall_time, first_install_time_from_activity, last_install_time_from_activity, first_install_time_from_event, last_install_time_from_event, first_uninstall_time_from_activity, last_uninstall_time_from_activity, first_uninstall_time_from_event, last_uninstall_time_from_event, b.activity_kind AS last_activity_kind, b.event_time AS last_activity_time, max_logymd AS last_activity_date, a.msdk_server_time AS last_msdk_server_time, CASE WHEN b.activity_kind = 'uninstall' THEN 1 WHEN first_install_time_from_activity IS NULL AND first_install_time_from_event IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 2 END AS uninstall_status, a.msdk_app_id FROM (SELECT msdk_did, msdk_store, msdk_package_name, msdk_app_id, MAX(IF(activity_kind IN ('install', 'reattribution_reinstall', 'reinstall', 'uninstall'), msdk_server_time, NULL)) AS msdk_server_time, MIN(IF(activity_kind IN ('install', 'reattribution_reinstall', 'reinstall'), event_time, NULL)) AS first_install_time_from_activity, MAX(IF(activity_kind IN ('install', 'reattribution_reinstall', 'reinstall'), event_time, NULL)) AS last_install_time_from_activity, MIN(IF(installed_event_time > 0, installed_event_time, reinstalled_event_time)) AS first_install_time_from_event, MAX(IF(reinstalled_event_time > 0, reinstalled_event_time, installed_event_time)) AS last_install_time_from_event, MIN(IF(activity_kind = 'uninstall', event_time, NULL)) AS first_uninstall_time_from_activity, MAX(IF(activity_kind = 'uninstall', event_time, NULL)) AS last_uninstall_time_from_activity, MIN(IF(uninstalled_event_time > 0, uninstalled_event_time, NULL)) AS first_uninstall_time_from_event, MAX(IF(uninstalled_event_time > 0, uninstalled_event_time, NULL)) AS last_uninstall_time_from_event, MAX(logymd) AS max_logymd FROM remedy_did GROUP BY msdk_did, msdk_store, msdk_package_name, msdk_app_id) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT msdk_did, msdk_store, msdk_package_name, activity_kind, msdk_app_id, msdk_server_time, event_time, installed_event_time, reinstalled_event_time, uninstalled_event_time, logymd FROM remedy_did WHERE activity_kind IN ('install', 'reattribution_reinstall', 'reinstall', 'uninstall') GROUP BY msdk_did, msdk_store, msdk_package_name, activity_kind, msdk_app_id, msdk_server_time, event_time, installed_event_time, reinstalled_event_time, uninstalled_event_time, logymd) AS b ON a.msdk_did = b.msdk_did AND a.msdk_store = b.msdk_store AND a.msdk_package_name = b.msdk_package_name AND a.msdk_server_time = b.msdk_server_time

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_pay_iap_di
sql_units: WITH dim_basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country, create_os AS os, first_network_name AS network, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-20', '2023-05-20', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0), pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN product_id LIKE '%sub_monthly_stamps%' THEN 1 /* '点券月订阅' */ WHEN product_id LIKE '%sub_weekly_stamps%' THEN 2 /* '点券周订阅' */ WHEN product_id LIKE '%skin\\_70%' OR product_id = 'smallcharge_mlbbvng_109000' THEN 3 /* '每月史诗礼包' */ WHEN product_id LIKE '%skin\\_69%' OR product_id = 'smallcharge_mlbbvng_22000' THEN 4 /* '每周精英礼包' */ WHEN product_id LIKE '%growthplan%' THEN 5 /* '启示通行证' */ WHEN product_id LIKE '%com.moonton.diamond_sub_weekly_diamond_1%' THEN 6 /* '钻石周卡订阅' */ WHEN product_id LIKE '%one_time%' THEN 7 /* '钻石周卡'   */ WHEN product_id NOT LIKE '%skin%' AND product_id NOT LIKE '%smallcharge%' THEN CASE base_diamond WHEN 5000 THEN 8 /* '5000钻' */ WHEN 2500 THEN 9 /* '2500钻' */ WHEN 1500 THEN 10 /* '1500钻' */ WHEN 1000 THEN 11 /* '1000钻' */ WHEN 500 THEN 12 /* '500钻' */ WHEN 250 THEN 13 /* '250钻' */ WHEN 150 THEN 14 /* '150钻' */ WHEN 50 THEN 15 /* '50钻' */ ELSE 16 /* '其它' */ END ELSE 16 /* '其它' */ END AS iap /* 15种游戏内付费产品 */ FROM mt_dwd.dwd_charge_order_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_sandbox = 0 /* 非沙盒支付 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE '%package%' /* 道具 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE '%headframe%' /* 头像框 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE '%star%' /* 星光 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE '%promotion%' /* 道具 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE '%zerodollarpurchase%' /* 零元购 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE '%customgift%' /* 订制礼包 */ AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 /* 非代币购买 */ AND /* AND     receipt_id > 100 -- 非刷单 */ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) /* 非刷单 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* --gp礼品卡，没收入 */), pay_di_role AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, iap FROM pay_di GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, iap), pay_di_acc AS (SELECT roleid, iap FROM pay_di GROUP BY roleid, iap) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_pay_iap_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT granularity_type, country, zoneid, os, network, iap, pay_cnt FROM (SELECT 'role' AS granularity_type, bsc.country, bsc.zoneid, bsc.os, bsc.network, pay.iap, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.roleid, pay.zoneid) AS pay_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM dim_basic_df WHERE zoneid < 57000) AS bsc LEFT JOIN pay_di_role AS pay ON bsc.roleid = pay.roleid AND bsc.zoneid = pay.zoneid GROUP BY bsc.country, bsc.zoneid, bsc.os, bsc.network, pay.iap UNION ALL SELECT 'account' AS granularity_type, bsc.country, -99999 AS zoneid, bsc.os, bsc.network, pay.iap, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.roleid) AS pay_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM dim_basic_df WHERE is_first_create = 1) AS bsc LEFT JOIN pay_di_acc AS pay ON bsc.roleid = pay.roleid GROUP BY bsc.country, bsc.os, bsc.network, pay.iap) AS t WHERE pay_cnt > 0

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_security_blackdevice_di
sql_units: WITH table_gm AS (SELECT CAST(SPLIT(cmd_param, ' ')[0] AS BIGINT) AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_gmcmd WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND cmd_name = 'ban_login' /* 封停账号的GM指令 */ AND cmd_ret = 0 /* 字段值为0时，表示指令成功执行 */ AND CAST(SPLIT(cmd_param, ' ')[1] AS BIGINT) >= 2592000 /* 外挂起封是30天 */ AND CAST(SPLIT(cmd_param, ' ')[2] AS BIGINT) = 1 /* ban_login的封停类型，1为外挂  */ GROUP BY CAST(SPLIT(cmd_param, ' ')[0] AS BIGINT), zoneid), table_bd AS (SELECT op_accountid AS roleid, op_zoneid AS zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_bgip_gpsdk_antiplugin WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND is_notpunish = 0 /* 字段值为0时，统计的是字节处罚指令，其他值是BGIP数据传输 */ AND punish_info_id = 1003 /* 字段值为1003时，表示字节封禁角色的处罚指令 */ AND ban_reason = 1 /* 字段值为1时，表示使用了游戏ban_login的类型1指令 */ AND operate_type = 1 /* 字段值为1时，代表封停 */ GROUP BY op_accountid, op_zoneid), table_active AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, deviceid, deviceid_md5 FROM (/* 数据清洗 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, deviceid, deviceid_md5, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn_desc FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-28' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30') AS a WHERE rn_desc = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_security_blackdevice_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT DISTINCT roleid_all.roleid AS roleid, roleid_all.zoneid AS zoneid, login_info.deviceid, login_info.deviceid_md5, 1 AS type FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM table_gm UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM table_bd) AS a GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS roleid_all LEFT JOIN table_active AS login_info ON roleid_all.roleid = login_info.roleid AND roleid_all.zoneid = login_info.zoneid

'设备指纹, 设备唯一识别',   */ /*     package_name           STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的游戏分包名, key', */ /*     is_emulator            INT        COMMENT 'Android平台，判断是否为模拟器，1表示模拟器，0为真实设备, 安装事件install_event首次归因',          STRING     COMMENT '设备型号, 安装事件install_event首次归因,统一小写', */ /*     os_version             STRING     COMMENT '操作系统版本, 安装事件install_event首次归因,统一小写', */ /*     network_type           STRING     COMMENT '设备网络状态, 安装事件install_event首次归因,统一小写', */ /*     os_language            STRING     COMMENT '操作系统语言, 安装事件install_event首次归因,统一小写', */ /*     createdate             STRING     COMMENT '设备创建日期, 首次归因日期, 美西时间, 格式: yyyy-MM-dd', */ /*     ip_country             STRING     COMMENT 'IP解析国家, 安装事件install_event首次归因client_ip通过geoip转化的国家 ,统一小写', */ /*     client_version         STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的热更版本（例如打补丁小版本）', */ /*     sdk_version            STRING     COMMENT '首次安装MSDK版本号', */ /*     idfa                   STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的IOS设备的IDFA', */ /*     idfv                   STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的IOS设备的IDFV', */ /*     gps_adid               STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的安卓设备的gps_adid', */ /*     android_id             STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的安卓设备的android_id', */ /*     imei                   STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的安卓设备的imei', */ /*     oaid                   STRING     COMMENT '首次安装的安卓设备的oaid（中国厂商）', */ /*     app_version            STRING     COMMENT '-', */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd, 美西日期', app_id INT COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key'); */ WITH install_user_reduce AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, app_id, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC, server_time ASC) AS row_num FROM (SELECT did, CAST(CASE WHEN app_id = 4500 THEN SUBSTRING(role_id, 0, 10) WHEN app_id = 4510 THEN SUBSTRING(role_id, 6, 10000000) ELSE role_id END AS BIGINT) AS account_id, package_name, is_emulator, IF(event_source = 2 AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip') <> '', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip'), client_ip) AS client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, system_language AS os_language, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS createdate, LOWER(COALESCE(TRIM(IF(event_source = 2 AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip') <> '' AND GEOIP(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip'), 1) <> '-', GEOIP(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip'), 1), IF(GEOIP(client_ip, 1) = '-', NULL, GEOIP(client_ip, 1)))), 'unknown')) AS ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_id, event_time, app_version, server_time, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(event_time / 1000 + 3600 * COALESCE(zone_offset, -8), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS createdate_local, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'login', 'logout', 'chargeMC') UNION ALL SELECT did, role_id AS account_id, package_name, 0 AS is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, 'unknown' AS network_type, 'unknown' AS os_language, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS createdate, ip_country, client_version, 'unknown' AS sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_id, event_time, 'unknown' AS app_version, server_time, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS createdate_local, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('purchase_event')) AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df AS b WHERE b.logymd = '2026-05-30' AND a.account_id = b.account_id AND a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.stage_id = b.stage_id)), install_user_reduce_mc AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, app_id, stage_id ORDER BY event_time ASC, server_time ASC) AS row_num FROM (SELECT did, role_id AS account_id, zone_id, package_name, is_emulator, IF(event_source = 2 AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip') <> '', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip'), client_ip) AS client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, system_language AS os_language, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS createdate, LOWER(COALESCE(TRIM(IF(event_source = 2 AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip') <> '' AND GEOIP(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip'), 1) <> '-', GEOIP(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.client_ip'), 1), IF(GEOIP(client_ip, 1) = '-', NULL, GEOIP(client_ip, 1)))), 'unknown')) AS ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_id, event_time, app_version, server_time, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(event_time / 1000 + 3600 * COALESCE(zone_offset, -8), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS createdate_local, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND app_id = 4280 AND event IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'login', 'logout', 'chargeMC') UNION ALL SELECT did, role_id AS account_id, zone_id, package_name, 0 AS is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, 'unknown' AS network_type, 'unknown' AS os_language, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS createdate, ip_country, client_version, 'unknown' AS sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_id, event_time, 'unknown' AS app_version, server_time, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS createdate_local, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('purchase_event') AND app_id = 4280) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_black_list_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS c ON a.account_id = c.roleid AND a.zone_id = c.zoneid WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df AS b WHERE b.logymd = '2026-05-30' AND a.account_id = b.account_id AND a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.stage_id = b.stage_id) AND c.roleid IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dim.dim_account_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT account_id, did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_version, event_time, createdate_local, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, app_id FROM install_user_reduce WHERE row_num = 1 AND NOT app_id IN (4310, 4280) UNION ALL SELECT account_id, did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_version, event_time, createdate_local, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, app_id FROM install_user_reduce_mc WHERE row_num = 1 AND app_id IN (4280)

name: etl.msdk_dim.dim_account_df
sql_units: /* T-2的全量设备信息union T-1的增量设备信息 */ WITH all_account AS (SELECT account_id, did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_version, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, step_action_info, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_name, adgroup_id, creative_id, creative_name, event_time, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, logymd, app_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND account_id <> 'unknown' UNION ALL SELECT account_id, did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_version, NULL AS first_media_source, NULL AS last_media_source, NULL AS first_ad_country, NULL AS last_ad_country, NULL AS first_mt_country, NULL AS last_mt_country, NULL AS step_action_info, NULL AS campaign_id, NULL AS campaign_name, NULL AS adgroup_name, NULL AS adgroup_id, NULL AS creative_id, NULL AS creative_name, event_time, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, logymd, app_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND account_id <> 'unknown'), ad_attribution /* 最新一天归因到的广告信息 */ AS (SELECT logymd, app_id, did, package_name, CASE WHEN createdate = logymd THEN ad_country END AS first_ad_country, ad_country AS last_ad_country, ad_country /* (已改)可以按照归因日期和创建日期比较小，得到first和last两个字段，media source同理，这样下面的join只保留t3，可以少一次，也就会少一次shffle */, CASE WHEN createdate = logymd THEN media_source END AS first_media_source, media_source AS last_media_source, media_source, createdate, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_name, adgroup_id, creative_id, creative_name, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di /* fuxinwang：应该改为dim_attribution_create_device_di表？都可以，如果用dim_attribution_create_device_di需要读取30天分区，用dim_attribution_device_di只用一天就行 */ WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND createdate >= '2026-05-02' AND createdate <= '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dim.dim_account_df PARTITION(logymd, app_id) SELECT account_id, did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, step_action_info, app_version, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_name, adgroup_id, creative_id, creative_name, event_time, CASE WHEN NOT event_time IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') ELSE '1970-01-01 00:00:00' END AS createtime, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, app_id FROM (SELECT t1.account_id, t1.did, t1.package_name, t1.is_emulator, t1.client_ip, t1.os, t1.model, t1.os_version, t1.network_type, t1.os_language, t1.createdate, t1.ip_country, t1.client_version, t1.sdk_version, t1.idfa, t1.idfv, t1.gps_adid, t1.android_id, t1.imei, t1.oaid, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, t2.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, IF((t1.last_media_source <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.last_media_source IS NULL), t1.last_media_source, COALESCE(t2.last_media_source, 'unknown')) AS last_media_source, COALESCE(t1.first_ad_country, t2.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, IF((t1.last_ad_country <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.last_ad_country IS NULL), t1.last_ad_country, COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, 'unknown')) AS last_ad_country, IF((t1.first_mt_country <> 'unknown' OR NOT t1.first_mt_country IS NULL), t1.first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_ad_country, t2.first_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown')) AS first_mt_country, IF((t1.last_ad_country <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.last_ad_country IS NULL), t1.last_ad_country, COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown')) AS last_mt_country, NULL AS step_action_info /* COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, */, t1.app_version, IF((t1.campaign_id <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.campaign_id IS NULL), t1.campaign_id, COALESCE(t2.campaign_id, 'unknown')) AS campaign_id, IF((t1.campaign_name <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.campaign_name IS NULL), t1.campaign_name, COALESCE(t2.campaign_name, 'unknown')) AS campaign_name, IF((t1.adgroup_name <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.adgroup_name IS NULL), t1.adgroup_name, COALESCE(t2.adgroup_name, 'unknown')) AS adgroup_name, IF((t1.adgroup_id <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.adgroup_id IS NULL), t1.adgroup_id, COALESCE(t2.adgroup_id, 'unknown')) AS adgroup_id, IF((t1.creative_id <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.creative_id IS NULL), t1.creative_id, COALESCE(t2.creative_id, 'unknown')) AS creative_id, IF((t1.creative_name <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.creative_name IS NULL), t1.creative_name, COALESCE(t2.creative_name, 'unknown')) AS creative_name, t1.event_time, t1.stage_id, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.app_id FROM all_account AS t1 LEFT JOIN ad_attribution AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.did = t2.did AND t1.stage_id = t2.stage_id /* AND     t1.package_name = t2.package_name */ WHERE t1.createdate BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT t1.account_id, t1.did, t1.package_name, t1.is_emulator, t1.client_ip, t1.os, t1.model, t1.os_version, t1.network_type, t1.os_language, t1.createdate, t1.ip_country, t1.client_version, t1.sdk_version, t1.idfa, t1.idfv, t1.gps_adid, t1.android_id, t1.imei, t1.oaid, t1.first_media_source, t1.last_media_source, t1.first_ad_country, t1.last_ad_country, t1.first_mt_country, t1.last_mt_country, t1.step_action_info, t1.app_version, t1.campaign_id, t1.campaign_name, t1.adgroup_name, t1.adgroup_id, t1.creative_id, t1.creative_name, t1.event_time, t1.stage_id, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.app_id FROM all_account AS t1 WHERE createdate < '2026-05-02') AS x

name: etl.msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_df
sql_units: /* CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_df ( */ /*     account_id                    STRING COMMENT '账号id, key', */ /*     did                           STRING COMMENT '首次设备指纹', */ /*     package_name                  STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名, key', */ /*     os                            STRING COMMENT '操作系统, key', */ /*     his_first_os_version          STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本, 历史首次', */ /*     his_last_os_version           STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本, 历史末次', */ /*     his_first_client_version      STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 历史首次', */ /*     his_last_client_version       STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 历史末次', */ /*     createdate                    STRING COMMENT '设备创角日期,美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd', */ /*     model                         STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 归因信息', */ /*     first_media_source            STRING COMMENT '首日广告归因渠道, 归因信息', */ /*     last_media_source             STRING COMMENT '最终广告归因渠道, 归因信息', */ /*     first_ad_country              STRING COMMENT '首日广告归因国家, 归因信息', */ /*     last_ad_country               STRING COMMENT '最终广告归因国家, 归因信息', */ /*     first_mt_country              STRING COMMENT '首日归因国家（优先填充first_ad_country，ip_country作为补充）', */ /*     last_mt_country               STRING COMMENT '最终归因国家（优先填充last_ad_country，ip_country作为补充）', */ /*     day_charge_amt_info           ARRAY<BIGINT> COMMENT '每日付费金额array列表', */ /*     total_charge_amt_info         ARRAY<BIGINT> COMMENT '历史累计付费金额array列表', */ /*     total_charge_cnt              INT COMMENT '历史累计付费总次数', */ /*     total_charge_amt              BIGINT COMMENT '历史累计付费金额（美分）', */ /*     his_first_charge_time         STRING COMMENT '历史首次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     his_last_charge_time          STRING COMMENT '历史末次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss' */ /* ) COMMENT '设备付费行为全量表格' PARTITIONED BY ( logymd STRING COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', app_id INT COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key' ) STORED AS PARQUET; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT t2.account_id, t2.did, t2.package_name, t2.os, t2.his_first_os_version, t2.his_last_os_version, t2.his_first_client_version, t2.his_last_client_version, t1.createdate /* fuxinwang：建议加上这个日期，计算ltv等付费指标需要从新增日期开始算，方便计算 */, COALESCE(t1.model, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.last_media_source, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_ad_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.last_ad_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.last_mt_country, 'unknown'), t2.day_charge_amt_info, t2.total_charge_amt_info, t2.total_charge_cnt, t2.total_charge_amt, t2.his_first_charge_time, t2.his_last_charge_time, t2.total_charge_cnt_info, T2.total_charge_actual_amt, T2.total_charge_actual_amt_info, t2.stage_id AS stage_id, t2.app_id AS app_id FROM (SELECT account_id, package_name, app_id AS appid, model, os, createdate, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t1 RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(his_df.account_id, di.account_id) AS account_id, COALESCE(his_df.did, di.did) AS did, COALESCE(his_df.app_id, di.app_id) AS app_id, COALESCE(his_df.os, di.os) AS os, COALESCE(his_df.package_name, di.package_name) AS package_name, COALESCE(his_df.his_first_os_version, di.day_first_os_version) AS his_first_os_version, COALESCE(di.day_last_os_version, his_df.his_last_os_version) AS his_last_os_version, COALESCE(his_df.his_first_client_version, di.day_first_client_version) AS his_first_client_version, COALESCE(di.day_last_client_version, his_df.his_last_client_version) AS his_last_client_version /* model之类的 ---需要从dim_attr里面获取       */, CASE WHEN SIZE(his_df.day_charge_amt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', his_df.day_charge_amt_info), ',', COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0)) END AS day_charge_amt_info /* -SPARK2.3.4 ARRAY方法比较局限，没必要写个array append之类udf，等SPARK3.0之后可换个更优雅的方式 */, CASE WHEN SIZE(his_df.total_charge_amt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', his_df.total_charge_amt_info), ',', COALESCE(his_df.total_charge_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(his_df.total_charge_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0)) END AS total_charge_amt_info, COALESCE(his_df.total_charge_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_cnt, 0) AS total_charge_cnt, COALESCE(his_df.total_charge_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_sum, 0) AS total_charge_amt, COALESCE(his_df.his_first_charge_time, di.day_first_charge_time) AS his_first_charge_time, COALESCE(di.day_last_charge_time, his_df.his_last_charge_time) AS his_last_charge_time, CASE WHEN SIZE(his_df.total_charge_cnt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', his_df.total_charge_cnt_info), ',', COALESCE(his_df.total_charge_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_cnt, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(his_df.total_charge_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_charge_cnt, 0)) END AS total_charge_cnt_info, COALESCE(his_df.total_charge_actual_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_actual_amt, 0) AS total_charge_actual_amt, CASE WHEN SIZE(his_df.total_charge_actual_amt_info) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', his_df.total_charge_actual_amt_info), ',', COALESCE(his_df.total_charge_actual_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_actual_amt, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<DECIMAL(38, 18)>) ELSE ARRAY(COALESCE(his_df.total_charge_actual_amt, 0) + COALESCE(di.day_actual_amt, 0)) END AS total_charge_actual_amt_info, COALESCE(his_df.stage_id, di.stage_id) AS stage_id FROM (SELECT did, app_id, account_id, package_name, os, his_first_os_version, his_last_os_version, his_first_client_version, his_last_client_version, model, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, day_charge_amt_info, total_charge_amt_info, total_charge_cnt, total_charge_amt, his_first_charge_time, his_last_charge_time, total_charge_cnt_info, total_charge_actual_amt, total_charge_actual_amt_info, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS his_df FULL JOIN (SELECT did, account_id, app_id, package_name, os, day_first_os_version, day_last_os_version, sql_units: WITH active_info AS (SELECT package_name, app_id, account_id FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_account_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY package_name, app_id, account_id), pay_info AS (SELECT charge_df.package_name, charge_df.app_id, account_id, SUM(COALESCE(total_charge_amt, 0)) AS total_charge_amt /* 'charge' tag, */ /* count(DISTINCT charge_df.did) metrics1, */, SUM(COALESCE(total_charge_cnt, 0)) AS total_charge_cnt FROM (SELECT account_id, package_name, app_id, os, total_charge_amt, total_charge_cnt FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_df WHERE logymd =
