appid AS app_id */ /*     FROM    msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df */ /*     WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /*     AND     if_first_role = 1 */ /*     GROUP BY */ /*             did, */ /*             package_name, */ /*             appid */ /* ), */ AS (SELECT basic.package_name, basic.app_id, basic.createdate, basic.first_mt_country, basic.first_media_source, basic.os, basic.client_version, basic.app_version, COUNT(basic.account_id) AS dnu, SUM(IF(NOT active_info.account_id IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS active_user_cnt, SUM(IF(NOT pay_info.account_id IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS charge_num, SUM(COALESCE(pay_info.total_charge_amt, 0)) AS total_charge_amt, SUM(COALESCE(pay_info.total_charge_cnt, 0)) AS total_charge_cnt, 0 AS new_first_role_did_cnt FROM (SELECT package_name, app_id, account_id, createdate, first_mt_country, first_media_source, os, client_version, app_version FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS basic LEFT JOIN active_info ON basic.account_id = active_info.account_id AND basic.package_name = active_info.package_name AND basic.app_id = active_info.app_id LEFT JOIN pay_info ON basic.account_id = pay_info.account_id AND basic.package_name = pay_info.package_name AND basic.app_id = pay_info.app_id /* LEFT JOIN */ /*         role_info */ /* ON      basic.account_id = role_info.account_id */ /* AND     basic.package_name = role_info.package_name */ /* AND     basic.app_id = role_info.app_id */ GROUP BY basic.package_name, basic.app_id, basic.createdate, basic.first_mt_country, basic.first_media_source, basic.os, basic.client_version, basic.app_version) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_ads.ads_ltv_account_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT COALESCE(di.package_name, df.package_name) AS package_name, COALESCE(di.createdate, df.createdate) AS createdate, COALESCE(di.first_mt_country, df.first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(di.first_media_source, df.first_media_source) AS first_media_source, COALESCE(di.os, df.os) AS os, COALESCE(di.client_version, df.client_version) AS client_version, COALESCE(di.dnu, df.dnu) AS dnu, CASE WHEN df.package_name IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.dnu) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) /* 昨日=null，表示一定是当天新增的数据，因此第一位一定等于dnu */ ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.active_info), ',', COALESCE(di.active_user_cnt, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS active_info, CASE WHEN df.package_name IS NULL AND NOT di.package_name IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.total_charge_amt) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.charge_info), ',', COALESCE(di.total_charge_amt, df.charge_info[SIZE(df.charge_info) - 1])), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS charge_info, CASE WHEN df.package_name IS NULL AND NOT di.package_name IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.charge_num) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.charge_num_info), ',', COALESCE(di.charge_num, df.charge_num_info[SIZE(df.charge_num_info) - 1])), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS charge_num_info, CASE WHEN df.package_name IS NULL AND NOT di.package_name IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.total_charge_cnt) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.charge_cnt_info), ',', COALESCE(di.total_charge_cnt, df.charge_cnt_info[SIZE(df.charge_cnt_info) - 1])), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS charge_cnt_info, COALESCE(di.new_first_role_did_cnt, COALESCE(df.new_first_role_did_cnt, 0)) AS new_first_role_did_cnt, COALESCE(di.app_version, df.app_version) AS app_version, COALESCE(df.app_id, di.app_id) AS app_id FROM modify_data_all AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT package_name, createdate, first_mt_country, first_media_source, os, client_version, dnu, active_info, charge_info, charge_num_info, charge_cnt_info, new_first_role_did_cnt, app_version, app_id FROM msdk_ads.ads_ltv_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df ON di.package_name = df.package_name AND di.createdate = df.createdate AND di.first_mt_country = df.first_mt_country AND di.first_media_source = df.first_media_source AND di.os = df.os AND di.app_id = df.app_id AND di.client_version = df.client_version AND di.app_version = df.app_version DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_pay_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jichun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-06-09 */ /* Description: 需求文档 https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/RSvUdD4iWo6HhvxzeAScQLg1nFe */ /* Update: helenma@moonton.com */ /* Update by: 2023-12-05 14:13:17.000 */ /* Description: 需求文档 https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/NyIBwqN5SiGxdOky5nncNQ4Znje */ /* 测试文档 https://moonton.feishu.cn/docx/UdnkdNauoouUnzx2ZgVcD7Pfnuc */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH date_list AS (/* 计算需要回刷的日期 */ SELECT p_date, DATE_ADD(p_date, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p_date ORDER BY p_date) - 1) * -1) AS logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p_date ORDER BY p_date) /* diffdays = datediff('2026-05-31', logymd) */ - 1 AS diffdays FROM (SELECT p_date FROM (SELECT REPEAT(CONCAT('2026-05-31', ','), 30) AS rep_date) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(rep_date, ',')) tbl AS p_date) WHERE p_date <> '') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_pay_di PARTITION(logymd) SELECT 'device' AS granularity_type, country, os, network, register_days, pay_grade, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt), 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay_amt > 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(is_active), 0) AS active_cnt, pay_level, is_first_pay, logymd FROM (SELECT LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', TRIM(country))) AS country /* 首次创号国 */, LOWER(TRIM(os)) AS os, LOWER(TRIM(network_name)) AS network, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.create_date) = 0 THEN '0' WHEN DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.create_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 29 THEN '1-29' WHEN DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.create_date) BETWEEN 30 AND 89 THEN '30-89' WHEN DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.create_date) BETWEEN 90 AND 359 THEN '90-359' ELSE '360+' END AS register_days, CASE WHEN (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 >= 0.99 AND (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 < 4.99 THEN '0.99' WHEN (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 >= 4.99 AND (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 < 9.99 THEN '4.99' WHEN (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 >= 9.99 THEN '9.99' ELSE '0' END AS pay_grade, CASE WHEN (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 > 0 AND (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 <= 0.3 THEN 1 WHEN (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 > 0.3 AND (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 <= 0.8 THEN 2 WHEN (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 > 0.8 AND (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 <= 1.5 THEN 3 WHEN (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 > 1.5 AND (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 <= 5 THEN 4 WHEN (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 > 5 AND (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 <= 10 THEN 5 WHEN (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 > 10 AND (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 <= 20 THEN 6 WHEN (pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0)) / 100 > 20 THEN 7 ELSE 0 END AS pay_level, CASE WHEN SIZE(pay_amt_info) = 1 AND COALESCE(pay_amt_info[b.diffdays], 0) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN SIZE(pay_amt_info) > 1 AND pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] > 0 AND COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_first_pay, pay_amt_info[b.diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[1 + b.diffdays], 0) AS pay_amt, IF(SUBSTRING(a.active_info, 1 + b.diffdays, 1) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_active, b.logymd FROM adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df AS a LEFT JOIN date_list AS b ON a.p_date = b.p_date WHERE a.p_date /* a.p_date = '2026-05-31'  */ /* 防止回朔7天前空跑,选择有数据的数据日期 */ = IF(DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, '2026-05-31') <= 6, '2026-05-31', DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, -3)) AND a.app_id = '1001' AND a.create_date <= b.logymd) AS t2 GROUP BY country, os, network, register_days, pay_grade, pay_level, is_first_pay, logymd

   0))                                                         AS is_pay_last_mn1         --是否上月付费 */ /* --          , MAX(IF(SUBSTR(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -2), 1, 7), 1, */ MONTH(CONCAT(t1.logmn, '-01'))) AS month_diff FROM t_charge AS t1 JOIN t_charge AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, log_mn), t_left AS (SELECT roleid, log_mn, month_diff FROM (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.logmn, t2.logmn AS log_mn, (YEAR(CONCAT(t2.logmn, '-01')) - YEAR(CONCAT(t1.logmn, '-01'))) * 12 + (MONTH(CONCAT(t2.logmn, '-01')) - MONTH(CONCAT(t1.logmn, '-01'))) AS month_diff name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_create_wi
sql_units: WITH date_list AS (/* 计算需要回刷的日期 */ SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-31' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-24' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-17' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-10' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-03' AS logymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_create_wi PARTITION(logymd) SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', DATE_ADD(t2.logymd, 6 * -1), t2.logymd) AS week_range /* BROADCAST(t2) */, 'device' AS granularity_type, t1.country, t1.os, t1.network, t1.new_type, COALESCE(SUM(IF(t1.create_date BETWEEN DATE_ADD(t2.logymd, 6 * -1) AND t2.logymd, 1, 0)), 0) AS register_cnt, COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS total_register_cnt /*	累计注册人数     */, t2.logymd FROM (SELECT muti.country, muti.os, muti.network, COALESCE(bas.new_type, -1) AS new_type, muti.p_date, muti.create_date FROM (SELECT device_id, LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', TRIM(country))) AS country /* 首次创号国 */, LOWER(TRIM(os)) AS os, LOWER(TRIM(network_name)) AS network, create_date, p_date FROM adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df /* 上游表只保留7天数据，每次获取最大分区数据 */ WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND app_id = '1001') AS muti LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT device_id, create_time, his_first_accountid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY create_time) AS rn FROM adbi.dim_device_account_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND app_id = '1001') WHERE rn = 1) AS dev ON muti.device_id = dev.device_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, new_type FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-09-01', '2022-09-01', '2026-05-31') AND is_first_create = 1) AS bas ON dev.his_first_accountid = bas.roleid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN date_list AS t2 ON t1.p_date = t2.p_date WHERE t1.create_date <= t2.logymd GROUP BY t1.country, t1.os, t1.network, t1.new_type, t2.logymd

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_active_wi
sql_units: WITH date_list AS (/* 计算需要回刷的日期 */ SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-31' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-24' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-17' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-10' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-03' AS logymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_active_wi PARTITION(logymd) SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', DATE_ADD(logymd, 6 * -1), logymd) AS week_range, 'device' AS granularity_type, country, os, network, register_days, is_pay, COALESCE(SUM(is_active), 0) AS active_cnt, logymd FROM (SELECT LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', TRIM(country))) AS country /* 首次创号国 */, LOWER(TRIM(os)) AS os, LOWER(TRIM(network_name)) AS network, create_date, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) = 0 THEN '0' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 29 THEN '1-29' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) BETWEEN 30 AND 89 THEN '30-89' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) BETWEEN 90 AND 359 THEN '90-359' ELSE '360+' END AS register_days, IF(pay_amt_info[diffdays] > 0, 1, 0) AS is_pay, IF(LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(active_info, 1 + diffdays, 7)) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_active, logymd FROM (SELECT a.country, a.os, a.network_name, a.create_date, a.pay_amt_info, SUBSTRING(a.active_info, 1, 35) AS active_info /* 截取35位 */, b.logymd, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', b.logymd) AS diffdays /* 数据日期与业务日期相差天数 */ FROM adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df AS a LEFT JOIN date_list AS b ON a.p_date = b.p_date WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND a.app_id = '1001' AND a.create_date <= b.logymd)) GROUP BY country, os, network, register_days, is_pay, logymd

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_active_moni
sql_units: WITH date_list AS (/* 计算需要回刷的日期 */ SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-31' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -1)) AS logymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_active_moni PARTITION(logymd) SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', DATE_FORMAT(logymd, 'yyyy-MM-01'), logymd) AS month_range, 'device' AS granularity_type, country, os, network, register_days, is_pay, COALESCE(SUM(is_active), 0) AS active_cnt, logymd FROM (SELECT LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', TRIM(country))) AS country /* 首次创号国 */, LOWER(TRIM(os)) AS os, LOWER(TRIM(network_name)) AS network, create_date, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) = 0 THEN '0' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 29 THEN '1-29' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) BETWEEN 30 AND 89 THEN '30-89' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) BETWEEN 90 AND 359 THEN '90-359' ELSE '360+' END AS register_days, IF(pay_amt_info[diffdays] > 0, 1, 0) AS is_pay, IF(LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(active_info, 1 + diffdays, DATEDIFF(logymd, DATE_FORMAT(logymd, 'yyyy-MM-01')) + 1)) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_active, logymd FROM (SELECT a.country, a.os, a.network_name, a.create_date, a.pay_amt_info, SUBSTRING(a.active_info, 1, 62) AS active_info /* 截取62位（最大的连续两个月为62天） */, b.logymd, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', b.logymd) AS diffdays /* 数据日期与业务日期相差天数 */ FROM adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df AS a LEFT JOIN date_list AS b ON a.p_date = b.p_date WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND a.app_id = '1001' AND a.create_date <= b.logymd)) GROUP BY country, os, network, register_days, is_pay, logymd

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_multi_behavior_account_df
sql_units: WITH dim_basic AS (SELECT roleid AS accountid, his_first_deviceid, CASE WHEN create_os = 'ios' THEN 1 WHEN create_os = 'android' THEN 2 WHEN create_os = 'emulator' THEN 3 ELSE -99999 END AS os_type, create_os AS os, SUBSTRING(his_first_active_time, 1, 10) AS his_first_active_date, create_os, create_channel, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, os_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, account_register_date, account_register_time, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, register_date, is_ai FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_first_create = 1), charge_df AS (SELECT roleid AS accountid, SUM(his_pay_cnt) AS pay_cnt_total, SUM(product_money) AS pay_amt_total, MIN(SUBSTRING(his_first_pay_time, 1, 10)) AS his_first_pay_date, SUM(his_before_tax_usd_amt) AS before_tax_usd_amt, SUM(his_pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS pay_actual_amt_total FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid), behavior_info AS (SELECT accountid, IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_cnt_total_array, CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)), 2), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>)), COALESCE(charge_cnt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS pay_cnt_total_array, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_amt_total_array, CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)), 2), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>)), COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS pay_amt_total_array, IF(LENGTH(active_info) > 0 AND '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(active_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(active_info))), COALESCE(active_info, '')) AS active_info, IF(SIZE(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array, CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array)), 2), ',') AS ARRAY<DECIMAL(38, 2)>)), COALESCE(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS before_tax_usd_amt_total_array, IF(SIZE(pay_actual_amt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(pay_actual_amt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(pay_actual_amt_total_array, CAST(SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_pay_moni
sql_units: WITH date_list AS (/* 计算需要回刷的日期 */ SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, '2026-05-31' AS logymd UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05-31' AS p_date, LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -1)) AS logymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_homepage_device_pay_moni PARTITION(logymd) SELECT CONCAT_WS('~', DATE_FORMAT(logymd, 'yyyy-MM-01'), logymd) AS month_range, 'device' AS granularity_type, country, os, network, register_days, pay_grade, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt), 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay_amt > 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(is_active), 0) AS active_cnt, logymd FROM (SELECT LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', TRIM(country))) AS country /* 首次创号国 */, LOWER(TRIM(os)) AS os, LOWER(TRIM(network_name)) AS network, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) = 0 THEN '0' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 29 THEN '1-29' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) BETWEEN 30 AND 89 THEN '30-89' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, create_date) BETWEEN 90 AND 359 THEN '90-359' ELSE '360+' END AS register_days, CASE WHEN (pay_amt_info[diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[diffdays + mon_days], 0)) / 100 >= 0.99 AND (pay_amt_info[diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[diffdays + mon_days], 0)) / 100 < 4.99 THEN '0.99' WHEN (pay_amt_info[diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[diffdays + mon_days], 0)) / 100 >= 4.99 AND (pay_amt_info[diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[diffdays + mon_days], 0)) / 100 < 9.99 THEN '4.99' WHEN (pay_amt_info[diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[diffdays + mon_days], 0)) / 100 >= 9.99 THEN '9.99' ELSE '0' END AS pay_grade, pay_amt_info[diffdays] - COALESCE(pay_amt_info[diffdays + mon_days], 0) AS pay_amt, IF(LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(active_info, 1 + diffdays, mon_days)) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_active, logymd FROM (SELECT a.country, a.os, a.network_name, a.create_date, a.pay_amt_info, SUBSTRING(a.active_info, 1, 62) AS active_info /* 截取62位（最大的连续两个月为62天） */, b.logymd, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', b.logymd) AS diffdays /* 数据日期与业务日期相差天数 */, DATEDIFF(b.logymd, DATE_FORMAT(b.logymd, 'yyyy-MM-01')) + 1 AS mon_days /* 本月天数 */ FROM adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df AS a LEFT JOIN date_list AS b ON a.p_date = b.p_date WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-31' AND a.app_id = '1001' AND a.create_date <= b.logymd)) GROUP BY country, os, network, register_days, pay_grade, logymd

name: mtai.dwm_ml_behavior_battle_account_zone_di
sql_units: WITH base AS (SELECT *, CAST(IF(score_map = '', NULL, STR_TO_MAP(score_map, ',', ':')) AS MAP<STRING, INT>) AS real_score_map, CAST(IF(hero_ban_cnt_list = '', NULL, STR_TO_MAP(hero_ban_cnt_list, ',', ':')) AS MAP<STRING, INT>) AS hero_ban_cnt, CAST(IF(hero_batle_cnt_list = '', NULL, STR_TO_MAP(hero_batle_cnt_list, ',', ':')) AS MAP<STRING, INT>) AS hero_battle_cnt, CAST(IF(map_battle_cnt_list = '', NULL, STR_TO_MAP(map_battle_cnt_list, ',', ':')) AS MAP<STRING, INT>) AS map_battle_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_fake_ai = 0 /* 剔除ai账号 */), battle_ods AS (SELECT zoneid, killnum, assistnum, deadnum, fake_ai, battleid, camp, select_road, ishook, battleresulttype, pvptype, accountid, accountid AS roleid, battletime, TIME, realpvptype, ismvp FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND fake_ai = 0 /* 剔除ai账号 */ AND pvptype <> 200 /* 剔除自定义 */), battle AS (/* 重复记录清洗 */ SELECT *, (COALESCE(killnum, 0) + COALESCE(assistnum, 0)) / (COALESCE(deadnum, 0) + 1) AS kda1, SUM(fake_ai) OVER (PARTITION BY battleid) AS ai_num, COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY battleid, camp, select_road) AS select_same_road_num /* 本队该分路有多少人选 */, COLLECT_SET(select_road) OVER (PARTITION BY battleid, camp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS team_select_roads /* 本队分路      */, SUM(ishook) OVER (PARTITION BY battleid, camp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS hook_num FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC, battleresulttype) AS row_id FROM battle_ods WHERE NOT pvptype IS NULL) AS t WHERE row_id = 1), battleenddata AS (SELECT battleid, zoneid, roleid, fightrate, matches_gold, matches_silver, matches_bronze, is_albuginea, score FROM (SELECT battleid, zoneid, accountid AS roleid, MAX(icamp) AS icamp, AVG(fightrate) / 100 AS fightrate, MAX(CASE WHEN medal_type = 2 THEN 1 END) AS matches_gold, MAX(CASE WHEN medal_type = 3 THEN 1 END) AS matches_silver, MAX(CASE WHEN medal_type = 4 THEN 1 END) AS matches_bronze, MAX(CASE WHEN noresnum > 0 THEN 1 END) AS is_albuginea, MAX(score) / 100 AS score FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(isbot, 0) = 0 /* update@20251216,isbot=1是ai自动上报了真实玩家的account_id和zoneid */ GROUP BY battleid, zoneid, accountid HAVING NOT (MAX(CASE WHEN medal_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND MAX(CASE WHEN medal_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND MAX(CASE WHEN medal_type = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1)) AS t), imbalance AS (SELECT * FROM db_bytedance.mlbb_imbalance_send_to_moonton_hi WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31'), match_base AS (SELECT success, matchtime, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, pvptype FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), role_match AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, COUNT(1) AS match_cnt, SUM(success) AS match_success_cnt, SUM(matchtime) AS match_time FROM match_base GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype), battle_merge AS (/* battle_end和imbalance表merge */ SELECT a.*, imbalance, COALESCE(b.is_balance, 0) AS is_balance, battleenddata.score AS battle_score FROM battle AS a LEFT JOIN imbalance AS b ON a.battleid = b.battle_id LEFT JOIN battleenddata ON a.battleid = battleenddata.battleid AND a.zoneid = battleenddata.zoneid AND a.roleid = battleenddata.roleid), role_battle AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, MAX(kda1) AS max_kda, MAX(battle_score) AS max_score, MAX(battletime) AS max_battle_duration, MAX(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 13, 18), 0, battletime)) AS max_entertainment_battle_duration, COUNT(CASE WHEN battletime > 1500 THEN 1 END) AS over_25mins_battle_cnt, COUNT(IF(ai_num > 0, NULL, 1)) AS human_battle_cnt, COUNT(IF(ishook = 0 AND hook_num > 0, 1, NULL)) AS teammate_afk_cnt /* 自己没挂机别人挂机 */, COUNT(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2) AND select_same_road_num > 1, 1, NULL)) AS own_road_conflict_cnt /* 本人分路冲突场次，只看匹配/排位 */, COUNT(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2) AND SIZE(team_select_roads) < 5, 1, NULL)) AS team_road_conflict_cnt /* 本人所在对路分路冲突场次，只看匹配/排位 */, SUM(is_balance) AS balance_battle_cnt /* 平衡对局数 */, COUNT(IF((camp = 1 AND imbalance > 0.25) OR (camp = 2 AND imbalance < -0.25), 1, NULL)) AS overrun_cnt /* 碾压局数 */, COUNT(IF((camp = 2 AND imbalance > 0.25) OR (camp = 1 AND imbalance < -0.25), 1, NULL)) AS be_overrun_cnt /* 被碾压局数 */ FROM battle_merge GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype), last_battle_detail AS (/* 获取用户最后一战的信息 */ /* pvptype限制在（1，2）中 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(realpvptype IN (58, 53, 30, 31, 44, 43, 51, 57), 1, 0) AS last_battle_is_warm, CASE WHEN is_balance = 1 THEN 0 WHEN (camp = 1 AND imbalance > 0.25) OR (camp = 2 AND imbalance < -0.25) THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS last_battle_balance, ishook AS last_battle_has_hook, battletime AS last_battle_duration, battle_score AS last_battle_score, ismvp AS last_battle_ismvp FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn FROM battle_merge WHERE pvptype IN (1, 2)) WHERE rn = 1), role_others AS (SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(a.pvptype, b.pvptype) AS pvptype, COALESCE(own_road_conflict_cnt, 0) AS own_road_conflict_cnt, COALESCE(team_road_conflict_cnt, 0) AS team_road_conflict_cnt, COALESCE(human_battle_cnt, 0) AS human_battle_cnt, COALESCE(teammate_afk_cnt, 0) AS teammate_afk_cnt, COALESCE(over_25mins_battle_cnt, 0) AS over_25mins_battle_cnt, COALESCE(balance_battle_cnt, 0) AS balance_battle_cnt, COALESCE(overrun_cnt, 0) AS overrun_cnt, COALESCE(be_overrun_cnt, 0) AS be_overrun_cnt, COALESCE(match_cnt, 0) AS match_cnt, COALESCE(match_success_cnt, 0) AS match_success_cnt, COALESCE(match_time, 0) AS match_time, COALESCE(max_kda, 0) AS max_kda, COALESCE(max_score, 0) AS max_score, COALESCE(max_battle_duration, 0) AS max_battle_duration, COALESCE(max_entertainment_battle_duration, 0) AS = 1) AS d ON a.roleid = d.roleid AND a.zoneid = d.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* rank */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(hook_cnt) AS hook_cnt, SUM(hook_duration) AS hook_duration, SUM(invalid_cnt) AS invalid_cnt, SUM(kda_total) AS kda_total, SUM(kill2_cnt) AS kill2_cnt, SUM(kill3_cnt) AS kill3_cnt, SUM(kill4_cnt) AS kill4_cnt, SUM(kill5_cnt) AS kill5_cnt, SUM(battle_duration) AS battle_duration, SUM(win_cnt) AS win_cnt, SUM(battle_cnt) AS battle_cnt, SUM(mvp_cnt) AS mvp_cnt, SUM(gold_cnt) AS gold_cnt, SUM(silver_cnt) AS silver_cnt, SUM(bronze_cnt) AS bronze_cnt, SUM(score_total) AS score_total, SUM(fightrate_total) AS fightrate_total, SUM(invalid_battle_cnt) AS invalid_battle_cnt, SUM(valid_battle_cnt) AS valid_battle_cnt, SUM(surrender_cnt) AS surrender_cnt, SUM(illegal_cnt) AS illegal_cnt, SUM(continuekill_cnt) AS continuekill_cnt, LONG_MERGE_MAP(COLLECT_LIST(MAP(realpvptype, IF(realpvptype IN (58, 53, 30, 31, 44, 43, 51, 57) AND pvptype IN (1, 2), battle_cnt, 0)))) AS warm_battle_cnt_map, MAX(max_conwin) AS max_conwin, MAX(max_conlose) AS max_conlose FROM base WHERE pvptype = 2 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS e ON a.roleid = e.roleid AND a.zoneid = e.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM role_others WHERE pvptype = 2) AS f ON a.roleid = f.roleid AND a.zoneid = f.zoneid LEFT JOIN last_battle_detail AS g ON a.roleid = g.roleid AND a.zoneid = g.zoneid

name: mt_dwd.dwd_leap_instance_di
sql_units:
/* leap instance 开始后，再调用tqs创建tqs作业(tqs create), 然后tqs排队(排tqs自己的队)，排上之后，开始execution(tqs表，progress，execution的start)， 然后提交到yarn */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jichun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-08-08 18:00:21.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH instance_di AS (SELECT id /*	实例 ID，自增主键 */, task_id /*	任务 ID */, FROM_UNIXTIME(task_time + 28800, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS task_time /*	任务业务时间 */, external_application_id /*	Executor 外部执行的ID, 主要指TCE pod ID */, external_sub_application_id /*	外部任务 ID（如 yarn application ID，TCE pod ID） */, IF(external_sub_application_id LIKE 'etl%', SPLIT(SPLIT(external_sub_application_id, '-')[0], '_')[1], external_sub_application_id) AS sub_application_id, name /*	实例名称 */, status /*	状态  30-成功  2-等待执行 */, CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN '初始化状态' WHEN status = 2 THEN '等待上游依赖' WHEN status = 3 THEN '等待到达执行时间' WHEN status = 4 THEN '等待任务分配QUOTA' WHEN status = 41 THEN '等待任务提交worker' WHEN status = 5 THEN '已提交' WHEN status = 6 THEN '执行器提交' WHEN status = 7 THEN '执行器等待' WHEN status = 9 THEN 'sensor等待被线程池调度' WHEN status = 10 THEN '运行中状态' WHEN status = 19 THEN '强制置为成功' WHEN status = 20 THEN '执行完成' WHEN status = 21 THEN '执行失败' WHEN status = 22 THEN 'OOM状态' WHEN status = 27 THEN '实例强制成功，触发下游成功' WHEN status = 30 THEN '成功之后触发下游' WHEN status = 31 THEN '超过最大重试次数/主动置失败' WHEN status = 32 THEN '任务失败，且状态与Manta强规则关联' WHEN status = 35 THEN '执行成功，且状态与Manta强规则关联' WHEN status = 36 THEN '执行成功，且状态与Manta强规则关联，并触发下游' WHEN status = 80 THEN '取消' WHEN status = 90 THEN '被动终止' WHEN status = 99 THEN '删除' WHEN status = -1 THEN '默认' WHEN status = -2 THEN '未就绪' ELSE status END AS status_name, trigger_id, conf, FROM_UNIXTIME(create_time + 28800) AS create_time /*	创建时间 */, FROM_UNIXTIME(schedule_run_time + 28800) AS schedule_run_time /*	设置开始时间 */, FROM_UNIXTIME(ready_time + 28800) AS ready_time /*	准备就绪时间 */, FROM_UNIXTIME(submit_time + 28800) AS submit_time /*	提交时间 */, FROM_UNIXTIME(start_time + 28800) AS start_time /*	实际开始时间 */, FROM_UNIXTIME(end_time + 28800) AS end_time /*	结束时间 */, FROM_UNIXTIME(update_time + 28800) AS update_time /*	更新时间  */, ROUND((end_time - start_time) / 60, 0) AS run_dur /* 任务运行时长 */, code FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY update_time DESC) AS rn FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__instance_hi WHERE date = '20260531') WHERE rn = 1), trigger_df AS (SELECT id, user_name, name, description, type AS trigger_type, CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN '例行' WHEN type = 10 THEN '重跑' WHEN type = 11 THEN '深度回溯' WHEN type = 16 THEN '分批深度回溯' WHEN type = 13 THEN '调试' WHEN type = 15 THEN '外部触发' WHEN type = 14 THEN '临时查询' ELSE '其他' END AS trigger_type_name, status, root_task_ids, including_root, FROM_UNIXTIME(start_time) AS start_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(end_time) AS end_time, max_parallelism, project_id, review_status, review_user_name, review_passed_user_name, review_message, FROM_UNIXTIME(create_time) AS create_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(update_time) AS update_time, date FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__instance_trigger_df WHERE date = '20260531'), task_info AS (SELECT a.id AS project_id, a.create_user_name AS project_create_user, a.owner_user_name AS project_owner_user, a.name AS project_name, a.`status` AS project_status, b.id AS folder_id, b.name AS folder_name, t.id AS task_id, t.name AS task_name, t.version AS task_version, t.priority AS task_priority, t.`status` AS task_status, t.template_id, t.queue, t.type AS task_type, t.type_group AS task_type_group, t.schedule_type, t.frequency, t.create_user_name AS task_create_user, t.owner_user_name AS task_owner_user, t.update_user_name AS task_update_user, t.deploy_user_name AS task_deploy_user, t.review_user_name AS task_review_user, FROM_UNIXTIME(t.create_time) AS task_create_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(t.effect_time) AS task_effect_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(t.expire_time) AS task_expire_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(t.update_time) AS task_update_time, t.update_message AS task_update_message FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__project_df AS a JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__folder_df AS b ON a.id = b.project_id JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__task_df AS t ON b.id = t.folder_id WHERE a.`date` = '20260531' AND b.`date` = '20260531' AND t.`date` = '20260531'), tqs_query_task /* tag_info AS ( */ /*     SELECT  a.id, */ /*             a.task_id, */ /*             a.tag_id, */ /*             b.name, */ /*             b.tag_group_id */ /*     FROM    mt_ods.dl_dorado__tag_task_mapping_df AS a */ /*     JOIN    mt_ods.dl_dorado__tag_df AS b */ /*     ON      a.tag_id = b.id */ /*     WHERE   a.date = '20260531' */ /*     AND     b.date = '20260531' */ /* ), */ AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, progress, REGEXP_EXTRACT(name, '_([0-9]+)_') AS task_id, date, REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(progress, '$.trackingUrl'), '/(application_[0-9]+_[0-9]+)/') AS application_id, SUBSTRING(GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(progress, '$.executionStage'), '$.startTime'), 1, 19) AS tqs_startTime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY end_time DESC) AS rn FROM mt_ods.dl_tqs_spark3__tqs_query_task_hi WHERE date IN ('20260531', '20260530')) AS t WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_leap_instance_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT ince.id /*	实例 ID，自增主键 */, ince.task_id /*	任务 ID */, ince.task_time /*	任务业务时间 */, ince.name /*	实例名称 */, ince.status /*	状态  30-成功  2-等待执行 */, ince.status_name, tak.task_owner_user, ince.create_time /*	创建时间 */, ince.schedule_run_time /*	设置开始时间 */, ince.submit_time /*	提交时间 */, ince.start_time /*	实际开始时间:leap instance */, ince.end_time /*	结束时间 */, ince.run_dur /* -运行时长: end_time - start_time */, tak.project_id /* 项目id    */, tak.project_name /* 项目名称 */, tak.task_type /* 任务类型 */, CASE WHEN tak.task_type = 101 THEN 'mysql2leap' WHEN tak.task_type = 201 THEN 'HQL' WHEN tak.task_type = 202 THEN 'shell' WHEN tak.task_type = 110 THEN 'hive2ch' WHEN tak.task_type = 126 THEN 'larksheet2hive' WHEN tak.task_type = 701 THEN 'spark' ELSE '其他' END AS task_type_name, tak.schedule_type /* * 
         126 :larksheet2hive
         101:mysql2leap
         201:HQL
         202：shell
         701：spark
         110:hive2ch
         */ /* 调度类型  1:手动调度 2：周期调度 3：临时查询 */, tak.frequency, trg.trigger_type, trg.trigger_type_name, COALESCE(que.application_id, ince.external_sub_application_id) AS application_id /*
         10:分钟级
         20:小时级
         30:天级
         40:周级
         50:月级
         60:实时
         */, ince.code, tqs_startTime AS tqs_start_time /*  tqs排自己队的时间，如果tqs资源不足，从start到execution就会有等待，如果资源充足，这俩时间差不了多少 */ FROM instance_di AS ince LEFT JOIN trigger_df AS trg ON ince.trigger_id = trg.id LEFT JOIN task_info AS tak ON ince.task_id = tak.task_id LEFT JOIN tqs_query_task AS que ON ince.sub_application_id = que.id

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_wk_diamond_3_3_df
sql_units: /* 玩家国家属性 */ /* MIN(country)和MAX(closing_date)旨在圈定既有国家又在周卡有效期内的玩家，例135959820 */ WITH role_basic AS (SELECT roleid, MIN(country) AS country, MAX(last_effective_date) AS charge_day, MAX(closing_date) AS closing_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_wk_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid), his_diamond_operate_info /* 钻石消耗类型 */ AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, COALESCE(b.nick_name, a.operate, 'unknown') AS operate_name FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond AS a LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_diamond_operate_mapping AS b ON LOWER(a.operate) = LOWER(b.operate) WHERE a.logymd >= '2023-01-25' AND a.logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND a.zoneid < 57000 AND b.logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2023-08-14', '2023-08-14', '2026-05-31') GROUP BY a.logymd, a.roleid, a.operate, b.nick_name), pay_role_info /* 订阅钻石周卡用户数 */ AS (SELECT 'day' AS date_type, '2026-05-31' AS date_detail, country, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS pay_role_cnt FROM role_basic WHERE closing_date >= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY country UNION ALL SELECT 'month' AS date_type, SUBSTRING(charge_day, 1, 7) AS date_detail, country, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS pay_role_cnt FROM role_basic GROUP BY date_detail, country), day_info /* 日粒度：周卡生效玩家-closing_date     */ AS (SELECT 'day' AS date_type, '2026-05-31' AS date_detail, a.country, COALESCE(b.operate_name, 'unknown') AS operate_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid) AS wk_diamond_operate_same_cnt FROM role_basic AS a LEFT JOIN his_diamond_operate_info AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE a.closing_date >= '2026-05-31' AND b.logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY a.country, b.operate_name), month_info /* 月粒度：月度购买过周卡玩家-last_effective_date=logymd */ AS (SELECT 'month' AS date_type, SUBSTRING(a.charge_day, 1, 7) AS date_detail, a.country, COALESCE(b.operate_name, 'unknown') AS operate_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid) AS wk_diamond_operate_same_cnt FROM role_basic AS a LEFT JOIN his_diamond_operate_info AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND SUBSTRING(a.charge_day, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(b.logymd, 1, 7) GROUP BY date_detail, a.country, b.operate_name) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_wk_diamond_3_3_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.country, a.operate_name, COALESCE(a.wk_diamond_operate_same_cnt, 0) AS wk_diamond_operate_same_cnt, COALESCE(b.pay_role_cnt, 0) AS pay_role_cnt, a.date_type, a.date_detail FROM day_info AS a LEFT JOIN pay_role_info AS b ON a.country = b.country AND a.date_type = b.date_type AND a.date_detail = b.date_detail WHERE b.date_type = 'day' UNION ALL SELECT a.country, a.operate_name, COALESCE(a.wk_diamond_operate_same_cnt, 0) AS wk_diamond_operate_same_cnt, COALESCE(b.pay_role_cnt, 0) AS pay_role_cnt, a.date_type, a.date_detail FROM month_info AS a LEFT JOIN pay_role_info AS b ON a.country = b.country AND a.date_type = b.date_type AND a.date_detail = b.date_detail WHERE b.date_type = 'month')

name: export_bytedance.gameserver_team_quit
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.gameserver_team_quit PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT TIME, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, LEVEL, createrole_country, teamid, teamname, memsize FROM (SELECT TIME, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, LEVEL, createrole_country, teamid, teamname, memsize, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_team_quit WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(createrole_country, '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')) AS md LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_account FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-07', '2022-05-07', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON md.roleid = adv_us.us_account WHERE adv_us.us_account IS NULL

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_battle_road_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH battle_di AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(day_last_exp_road_real_power = 0, NULL, day_last_exp_road_real_power) AS day_last_exp_road_real_power, IF(day_last_mid_road_real_power = 0, NULL, day_last_mid_road_real_power) AS day_last_mid_road_real_power, IF(day_last_roam_road_real_power = 0, NULL, day_last_roam_road_real_power) AS day_last_roam_road_real_power, IF(day_last_jungle_road_real_power = 0, NULL, day_last_jungle_road_real_power) AS day_last_jungle_road_real_power, IF(day_last_gold_road_real_power = 0, NULL, day_last_gold_road_real_power) AS day_last_gold_road_real_power, IF(day_last_match_power = 0, NULL, day_last_match_power) AS day_last_match_power, IF(day_last_real_power = 0, NULL, day_last_real_power) AS day_last_real_power, day_last_battle_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY day_last_battle_time DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2 AND logymd < '2023-11-07') WHERE rn = 1), power_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, day_last_match_power, day_last_real_power, day_last_gold_road_real_power, day_last_exp_road_real_power, day_last_mid_road_real_power, day_last_jungle_road_real_power, day_last_roam_road_real_power FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_road_power_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2023-11-07'), battle_hero_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(roam_road_cnt) AS roam_road_cnt, SUM(jungle_road_cnt) AS jungle_road_cnt, SUM(mid_road_cnt) AS mid_road_cnt, SUM(gold_road_cnt) AS gold_road_cnt, SUM(exp_road_cnt) AS exp_road_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_heroes_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), battle_road_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_match_power, his_last_real_power, his_last_gold_road_real_power, his_last_exp_road_real_power, his_last_mid_road_real_power, his_last_jungle_road_real_power, his_last_roam_road_real_power, his_gold_road_cnt, his_exp_road_cnt, his_mid_road_cnt, his_jungle_road_cnt, his_roam_road_cnt FROM mt_dm.dm_battle_road_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), role_zone_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM battle_di UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM battle_hero_di UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM battle_road_df UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM power_info) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_battle_road_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN his_last_match_power < 0 OR his_last_match_power > 20000 OR his_last_match_power IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE his_last_match_power END AS his_last_match_power, CASE WHEN his_last_real_power < 0 OR his_last_real_power > 20000 OR his_last_real_power IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE his_last_real_power END AS his_last_real_power, CASE WHEN his_last_gold_road_real_power < 0 OR his_last_gold_road_real_power > 20000 OR his_last_gold_road_real_power IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE his_last_gold_road_real_power END AS his_last_gold_road_real_power, CASE WHEN his_last_exp_road_real_power < 0 OR his_last_exp_road_real_power > 20000 OR his_last_exp_road_real_power IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE his_last_exp_road_real_power END AS his_last_exp_road_real_power, CASE WHEN his_last_mid_road_real_power < 0 OR his_last_mid_road_real_power > 20000 OR his_last_mid_road_real_power IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE his_last_mid_road_real_power END AS his_last_mid_road_real_power, CASE WHEN his_last_jungle_road_real_power < 0 OR his_last_jungle_road_real_power > 20000 OR his_last_jungle_road_real_power IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE his_last_jungle_road_real_power END AS his_last_jungle_road_real_power, CASE WHEN his_last_roam_road_real_power < 0 OR his_last_roam_road_real_power > 20000 OR his_last_roam_road_real_power IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE his_last_roam_road_real_power END AS his_last_roam_road_real_power, his_gold_road_cnt, his_exp_road_cnt, his_mid_road_cnt, his_jungle_road_cnt, his_roam_road_cnt FROM (SELECT COALESCE(bas.roleid, bat_di.roleid, her_di.roleid, road_df.roleid, po_if.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(bas.zoneid, bat_di.zoneid, her_di.zoneid, road_df.zoneid, po_if.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(po_if.day_last_match_power, bat_di.day_last_match_power, road_df.his_last_match_power, NULL) AS his_last_match_power, COALESCE(po_if.day_last_real_power, bat_di.day_last_real_power, road_df.his_last_real_power, NULL) AS his_last_real_power, COALESCE(po_if.day_last_gold_road_real_power, bat_di.day_last_gold_road_real_power, road_df.his_last_gold_road_real_power, NULL) AS his_last_gold_road_real_power, COALESCE(po_if.day_last_exp_road_real_power, bat_di.day_last_exp_road_real_power, road_df.his_last_exp_road_real_power, NULL) AS his_last_exp_road_real_power, COALESCE(po_if.day_last_mid_road_real_power, bat_di.day_last_mid_road_real_power, road_df.his_last_mid_road_real_power, NULL) AS his_last_mid_road_real_power, COALESCE(po_if.day_last_jungle_road_real_power, bat_di.day_last_jungle_road_real_power, road_df.his_last_jungle_road_real_power, NULL) AS his_last_jungle_road_real_power, COALESCE(po_if.day_last_roam_road_real_power, bat_di.day_last_roam_road_real_power, road_df.his_last_roam_road_real_power, NULL) AS his_last_roam_road_real_power, COALESCE(road_df.his_gold_road_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(her_di.gold_road_cnt, 0) AS his_gold_road_cnt, COALESCE(road_df.his_exp_road_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(her_di.exp_road_cnt, 0) AS his_exp_road_cnt, COALESCE(road_df.his_mid_road_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(her_di.mid_road_cnt, 0) AS his_mid_road_cnt, COALESCE(road_df.his_jungle_road_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(her_di.jungle_road_cnt, 0) AS his_jungle_road_cnt, COALESCE(road_df.his_roam_road_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(her_di.roam_road_cnt, 0) AS his_roam_road_cnt FROM role_zone_df AS bas LEFT JOIN battle_di AS bat_di ON bas.roleid = bat_di.roleid AND bas.zoneid = bat_di.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle_hero_di AS her_di ON bas.roleid = her_di.roleid AND bas.zoneid = her_di.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle_road_df AS road_df ON bas.roleid = road_df.roleid AND bas.zoneid = road_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN power_info AS po_if ON bas.roleid = po_if.roleid AND bas.zoneid = po_if.zoneid) AS t1

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_wk_basic_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH wk_charge_df AS (SELECT * FROM mt_dwm.dwm_wk_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), role_basic /* 玩家国家属性 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_first_create = 1), wk_charge_daily /* 当日订阅用户 */ AS (SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, COALESCE(a.country, 'unknown') AS country, MIN(b.logymd) AS s_logymd, MIN(b.time) AS s_time, CAST(COUNT(b.product_id) AS INT) AS subscription_cnt FROM role_basic AS a RIGHT JOIN mt_dwd.dwd_wk_role_zone_di AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE b.logymd >= '2023-01-25' AND b.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (product_id LIKE '%weekly_diamond%' OR product_id = 'com.moonton.diamond_vng_one_time_wk_diamond') GROUP BY b.roleid, b.zoneid, a.country), wk_charge_update /* 购买周卡用户 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, country, total_subscription_cnt, closing_time, closing_date, first_effective_date, first_subscription_cnt, last_effective_date, last_subscription_cnt, LAG(last_effective_date) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, country ORDER BY last_effective_date) AS last_second_effective_date, LAG(last_subscription_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, country ORDER BY last_effective_date) AS last_second_subscription_cnt FROM (SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, b.country, COALESCE(a.total_subscription_cnt, 0) + b.subscription_cnt AS total_subscription_cnt, IF(a.closing_time >= b.s_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.closing_time) + subscription_cnt * 7 * 24 * 3600), FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(b.s_time) + subscription_cnt * 7 * 24 * 3600)) AS closing_time, IF(a.closing_date >= b.s_logymd, CAST(DATE_ADD(a.closing_date, subscription_cnt * 7) AS STRING), CAST(DATE_ADD(b.s_logymd, subscription_cnt * 7) AS STRING)) AS closing_date, COALESCE(a.first_effective_date, b.s_logymd) AS first_effective_date, COALESCE(a.first_subscription_cnt, b.subscription_cnt) AS first_subscription_cnt, b.s_logymd AS last_effective_date, b.subscription_cnt AS last_subscription_cnt FROM wk_charge_df AS a RIGHT JOIN wk_charge_daily AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.country = b.country UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, country, total_subscription_cnt, closing_time, closing_date, first_effective_date, first_subscription_cnt, last_effective_date, last_subscription_cnt FROM wk_charge_df AS a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid FROM wk_charge_daily AS b WHERE a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid))) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_wk_basic_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT * FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, country, total_subscription_cnt, closing_time, closing_date, first_effective_date, first_subscription_cnt, last_effective_date, last_subscription_cnt, COALESCE(last_second_effective_date, last_effective_date, '2026-05-31') AS last_second_effective_date, COALESCE(last_second_subscription_cnt, last_subscription_cnt, 0) AS last_second_subscription_cnt FROM wk_charge_update WHERE last_effective_date = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL /* 未购买周卡用户 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, country, total_subscription_cnt, closing_time, closing_date, first_effective_date, first_subscription_cnt, last_effective_date, last_subscription_cnt, last_second_effective_date, last_second_subscription_cnt FROM wk_charge_df AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid FROM wk_charge_daily AS b WHERE a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid))

name: adbi.dim_account_gps_adid
sql_units: WITH accont_create AS (SELECT CAST(accountid AS STRING) AS accountid, account_name AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, gps_adid, 'create' AS behavior_type, os_type, '1001' AS app_id FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND TRIM(account_name) <> '' AND NOT account_name IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT CAST(accountid AS STRING) AS accountid, account_name AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, gps_adid, 'create' AS behavior_type, os_type, '2001' AS app_id FROM mh_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND TRIM(account_name) <> '' AND NOT account_name IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT CAST(accountid AS STRING) AS accountid, account_name AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, gps_adid, 'create' AS behavior_type, os_type, '3001' AS app_id FROM zgame_damai_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND TRIM(account_name) <> '' AND NOT account_name IS NULL), account_login AS (SELECT roleid AS accountid, deviceid AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, ad_id AS gps_adid, 'login' AS behavior_type, os_type, '1001' AS app_id FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(TRIM(deviceid), '') <> '' UNION ALL SELECT roleid AS accountid, device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, gps_adid, 'login' AS behavior_type, os_type, '3001' AS app_id FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_id), '') <> ''), account_charge AS (SELECT roleid AS accountid, device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, gps_adid, 'charge' AS behavior_type, os_type, '1001' AS app_id FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_id), '') <> '' UNION ALL SELECT roleid AS accountid, device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS create_time, gps_adid, 'charge' AS behavior_type, os_type, '3001' AS app_id FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(TRIM(device_id), '') <> ''), di AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.device_id, a.create_time, SUBSTRING(a.create_time, 1, 10) AS create_date, a.gps_adid, a.behavior_type, 'desc' AS time_type, a.is_normal, a.app_id, a.os_type FROM (SELECT b.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.app_id, b.accountid ORDER BY b.is_normal ASC, b.create_time DESC) AS desc_rn FROM (SELECT *, IF(gps_adid RLIKE '^[0-9a-zA-Z]{8}(-[0-9a-zA-Z]{4}){3}-[0-9a-zA-Z]{12}$' AND gps_adid <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 1, 2) AS is_normal FROM accont_create UNION SELECT *, IF(gps_adid RLIKE '^[0-9a-zA-Z]{8}(-[0-9a-zA-Z]{4}){3}-[0-9a-zA-Z]{12}$' AND gps_adid <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 1, 2) AS is_normal FROM account_login UNION SELECT *, IF(gps_adid RLIKE '^[0-9a-zA-Z]{8}(-[0-9a-zA-Z]{4}){3}-[0-9a-zA-Z]{12}$' AND gps_adid <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 1, 2) AS is_normal FROM account_charge) AS b) AS a WHERE a.desc_rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_account_gps_adid_out)) SELECT b.accountid, b.device_id, b.create_time, b.create_date, b.gps_adid, b.behavior_type, 'desc' AS time_type, b.app_id, b.os_type, CASE WHEN b.is_normal = 1 THEN '2026-05-31' ELSE CONCAT('2026-05-31', '_unnormal') END AS p_date FROM (SELECT a.accountid, a.device_id, a.create_time, a.create_date, a.gps_adid, a.behavior_type, a.os_type, a.is_normal, a.app_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.app_id, a.accountid ORDER BY a.is_normal ASC, a.create_time DESC) AS desc_rn FROM (SELECT accountid, device_id, create_time, create_date, gps_adid, behavior_type, os_type, 1 AS is_normal, app_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_account_gps_adid_in)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' UNION ALL SELECT accountid, device_id, create_time, create_date, gps_adid, behavior_type, os_type, 2 AS is_normal, app_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dim_account_gps_adid_in)) WHERE p_date = CONCAT('2026-05-30', '_unnormal') UNION ALL SELECT accountid, device_id, create_time, create_date, gps_adid, behavior_type, os_type, is_normal, app_id FROM di) AS a) AS b WHERE b.desc_rn = 1

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT main_data.roleid, main_data.zoneid, COALESCE(main_data.create_os, 'unknown') AS create_os, COALESCE(main_data.create_channel, 'unknown') AS create_channel, COALESCE(main_data.register_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS register_time, COALESCE(main_data.register_date, '1970-01-01') AS register_date, COALESCE(main_data.create_ip, 'unknown') AS create_ip, COALESCE(main_data.create_country, 'unknown') AS create_country, COALESCE(adj.first_ip_country, 'unknown') AS first_ip_country /* adjust的可能会有未归因到的，null 值处理下 */, COALESCE(adj.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(adj.last_ad_country, 'unknown') AS last_ad_country, COALESCE(adj.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(adj.last_mt_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, COALESCE(adj.first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, COALESCE(adj.last_network_name, 'unknown') AS last_network_name, COALESCE(adj.account_register_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS account_register_time, COALESCE(adj.account_register_date, '1970-01-01') AS account_register_date, COALESCE(adj.os, 'unknown') AS account_create_os, COALESCE(adj.adjust_campaign_id, 'unknown') AS adjust_campaign_id, COALESCE(adj.adjust_campaign_name, 'unknown') AS adjust_campaign_name, COALESCE(adj.adjust_adset_id, 'unknown') AS adjust_adset_id, COALESCE(adj.adjust_adset_name, 'unknown') AS adjust_adset_name, COALESCE(adj.adjust_creative_id, 'unknown') AS adjust_creative_id, COALESCE(adj.adjust_creative_name, 'unknown') AS adjust_creative_name, main_data.data_source FROM (SELECT new_role.roleid, new_role.zoneid, CASE WHEN new_role.os_type = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN new_role.os_type = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN new_role.os_type = 3 THEN 'pc' ELSE 'unknown' END AS create_os, new_role.ip AS create_ip, new_role.channel AS create_channel, LOWER(IF(TRIM(GEOIP(new_role.ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))) = '-', NULL, TRIM(GEOIP(new_role.ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))))) AS create_country, new_role.usercreateymd AS register_date, new_role.usercreatetime AS register_time, data_source FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, ip, channel, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, createrole_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, roleid ORDER BY `time` ASC) AS rn, 'create' AS data_source /* 来源表 */ FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_create_role AS new_role WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df AS b WHERE new_role.roleid = b.roleid AND new_role.zoneid = b.zoneid AND logymd = '2026-05-30') /* 创角表 */ /* 创角丢失部分 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, ip, channel, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, createrole_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, roleid ORDER BY rk_tb, `time` ASC) AS rn /* 优先取login的数据 */, data_source /* 来源表 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, ip, channel, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, `time`, createrole_country, 'login' AS data_source /* 来源哪个表 */, 1 AS rk_tb /* 表的排序 */ FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, ip, channel, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, `time`, createrole_country, 'charge' AS data_source, 2 AS rk_tb FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS new_role WHERE NOT EXISTS(/* 排除历史和今日创角部分 */ SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_create_role WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS b WHERE new_role.roleid = b.roleid AND new_role.zoneid = b.zoneid)) AS new_role WHERE new_role.rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT his.roleid, his.zoneid, IF(his.create_os = 'unknown', NULL, his.create_os) AS create_os, IF(his.create_ip = 'unknown', NULL, his.create_ip) AS create_ip, IF(his.create_channel = 'unknown', NULL, his.create_channel) AS create_channel, IF(his.create_country = 'unknown', NULL, his.create_country) AS create_country, IF(his.register_date = '1970-01-01', NULL, his.register_date) AS register_date, IF(his.register_time = '1970-01-01 00:00:00', NULL, his.register_time) AS register_date, data_source FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df AS his WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS main_data LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, account_register_time, account_register_date, os_type, os, his_first_deviceid, role_register_date, first_create_ip, first_ip_country, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, sql_units: WITH account_di AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.logymd, a.deviceid, a.device_name, a.os_type, CASE WHEN a.os_type = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN a.os_type = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN a.os_type = 3 THEN 'pc' device_name, os_type, `time`, COALESCE(TRIM(device), 'unknown') AS device, COALESCE(TRIM(ip), 'unknown') AS ip, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY `time`) AS rn FROM his_first_deviceid, IF(role_register_date = '1970-01-01', NULL, role_register_date) AS role_register_date, first_create_ip, first_ip_country, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, first_login_channel, his_first_device, his_first_ip FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_basic_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), role_di AS (SELECT roleid, client_ip, ip_country, role_register_date FROM (SELECT roleid, client_ip, logymd AS role_register_date, LOWER(IF(TRIM(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))) = '-', NULL, TRIM(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))))) AS ip_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY `time`, zoneid, client_ip) AS rn FROM (SELECT roleid, IF(`ip` IN ('-', ''), NULL, `ip`) AS client_ip, `time`, zoneid, logymd FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_create_role AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM account_df WHERE role_register_date <> '1970-01-01' /* 有创角日期，代表历史有过创角 */) AS b ON a.roleid = b.accountid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND b.accountid IS NULL /* 标识当日新增的role是首次新增，在历史没有出现过 */) AS t) AS tt WHERE rn = 1), login_auth_di AS (SELECT accountid, channel FROM (SELECT accountid, channel, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY `time`) AS rn FROM zgame_damai_ods.loginserver_login_auth WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t WHERE rn = 1), user_df AS (SELECT *, IF(account_register_date = role_register_date, first_ip_country, NULL) AS account_role_ip_country /* 账号创建日期=账号创建首个日期，保证回溯时国家不变 */ FROM (SELECT COALESCE(di.accountid, df.accountid) AS accountid, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.account_register_date ELSE di.logymd END AS account_register_date, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.account_register_time ELSE di.`time` END AS account_register_time, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.his_first_deviceid ELSE di.deviceid END AS his_first_deviceid, COALESCE(df.role_register_date, role_di.role_register_date, '1970-01-01') AS role_register_date, CASE WHEN NOT df.role_register_date IS NULL THEN df.first_create_ip ELSE COALESCE(role_di.client_ip, 'unknown') END AS first_create_ip /* 如果role_register_date 不为空，说明历史有创角，取df的 create_ip,ip_country */, CASE WHEN NOT df.role_register_date IS NULL THEN df.first_ip_country ELSE COALESCE(role_di.ip_country, 'unknown') END AS first_ip_country, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.os_type ELSE di.os_type END AS os_type, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.os ELSE di.os END AS os, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, ad_os_type, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.first_login_channel ELSE login_auth_di.channel END AS first_login_channel, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.his_first_device ELSE di.device END AS his_first_device, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.his_first_ip ELSE di.ip END AS his_first_ip FROM account_di AS di FULL JOIN account_df AS df ON di.accountid = df.accountid LEFT JOIN role_di ON COALESCE(di.accountid, df.accountid) = role_di.roleid LEFT JOIN login_auth_di ON COALESCE(di.accountid, df.accountid) = login_auth_di.accountid) AS a), adv AS (SELECT accountid, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, ad_os_type, NULL) AS ad_os_type, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, attr_logymd, NULL) AS attr_logymd, IF(logymd = attr_logymd, adjust_country, NULL) AS first_ad_country, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_country, NULL) AS last_ad_country, IF(logymd = attr_logymd, adjust_network_name, NULL) AS first_network_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_network_name, NULL) AS last_network_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, NULL) AS adjust_campaign_id, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_name, NULL) AS adjust_campaign_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_adset_name, NULL) AS adjust_adset_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_adset_id, NULL) AS adjust_adset_id, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_creative_name, NULL) AS adjust_creative_name, IF('2026-05-31' >= attr_logymd, adjust_creative_id, NULL) AS adjust_creative_id FROM (SELECT accountid, logymd, attr_logymd, os_type AS ad_os_type, IF(TRIM(adjust_campaign_id) IN ('-', ''), NULL, adjust_campaign_id) AS adjust_campaign_id, IF(TRIM(adjust_campaign_name) IN ('-', ''), NULL, adjust_campaign_name) AS adjust_campaign_name, IF(TRIM(adjust_adset_name) IN ('-', ''), NULL, adjust_adset_name) AS adjust_adset_name, IF(TRIM(adjust_adset_id) IN ('-', ''), NULL, adjust_adset_id) AS adjust_adset_id, IF(TRIM(adjust_creative_name) IN ('-', ''), NULL, adjust_creative_name) AS adjust_creative_name, IF(TRIM(adjust_creative_id) IN ('-', ''), NULL, adjust_creative_id) AS adjust_creative_id, IF(TRIM(adjust_country) IN ('-', ''), NULL, TRIM(adjust_country)) AS adjust_country, IF(TRIM(adjust_network_name) IN ('-', ''), NULL, TRIM(adjust_network_name)) AS adjust_network_name FROM mt_dwd.dwd_zgame_account_attribution_df WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-02')), result_info AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.account_register_time, a.account_register_date, a.his_first_deviceid, COALESCE(a.role_register_date, '1970-01-01') AS role_register_date, COALESCE(a.first_create_ip, 'unknown') AS first_create_ip, COALESCE(a.first_ad_country, adv.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(adv.last_ad_country, 'unknown') AS last_ad_country, COALESCE(a.first_ip_country, 'unknown') AS first_ip_country, COALESCE(a.first_mt_country, adv.first_ad_country, a.account_role_ip_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(adv.last_ad_country, a.first_ip_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, COALESCE(a.first_network_name, adv.first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, COALESCE(adv.last_network_name, 'unknown') AS last_network_name, a.os_type, a.os, adv.ad_os_type, IF(COALESCE(a.attr_logymd, 'unknown') = 'unknown', COALESCE(adv.attr_logymd, '1970-01-01'), a.attr_logymd) AS attr_logymd, COALESCE(adv.adjust_campaign_id, 'unknown') AS adjust_campaign_id, COALESCE(adv.adjust_campaign_name, 'unknown') AS adjust_campaign_name, COALESCE(adv.adjust_adset_name, name: etl.mt_ads.ads_zgame_active_lottery_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-10-09 11:40:27.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_ads.ads_zgame_active_lottery_di( */ /*     `regday_label` STRING COMMENT '活跃分段', */ /*     `active_role_num` INT COMMENT '活跃人数', */ /*     `lottery_role_num` INT COMMENT '抽奖人数', */ /*     `blue_lottery_role_num` INT COMMENT '蓝色抽奖人数', */ /*     `gold_lottery_role_num` INT COMMENT '金色抽奖人数', */ /*     `boss_lottery_role_num` INT COMMENT 'boss抽奖人数' */ /*     `blue_lottery_cnt` INT COMMENT '蓝色抽奖计数', */ /*     `gold_lottery_cnt` INT COMMENT '金色抽奖计数', */ /*     `boss_lottery_cnt` INT COMMENT 'boss抽奖计数' */ /* )COMMENT 'zgame-每日抽卡表-活跃分段' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '统计日期YYYY-MM-DD') STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_zgame_active_lottery_di'; */ WITH role_info AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 = 1 THEN '0_当天新增' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '1_2-3天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN '2_4-7天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN '3_8-14天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 15 AND 21 THEN '4_15-21天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 BETWEEN 22 AND 28 THEN '5_22-28天用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, usercreateymd) + 1 > 28 THEN '6_28天以上' END AS regday_label FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_inner_account_info_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE b.roleid IS NULL), charge_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN daily_pmt_cuml = 0 THEN '0_0$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 0 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 50 THEN '1_0-50$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 50 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 100 THEN '2_50-100$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 100 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 200 THEN '3_100-200$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 200 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 500 THEN '4_200-500$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 500 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 1000 THEN '5_500-1000$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 1000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 2000 THEN '6_1000-2000$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 2000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 5000 THEN '7_2000-5000$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 5000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 10000 THEN '8_5000-1w$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 10000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 20000 THEN '9_1w-2w$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 20000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 30000 THEN '91_2w-3w$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 30000 THEN '92_>3w$' END AS daily_cumpmt_label FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money / 100) AS daily_pmt_cuml FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a), active_info AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001), lottery_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(CAST(pool_id AS STRING), 1, 1) AS type, SUM(COALESCE(is_ten, 0)) AS cnt FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_lottery WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(CAST(pool_id AS STRING), 1, 1)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_zgame_active_lottery_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT regday_label, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS active_role_num, COUNT(DISTINCT l.roleid, l.zoneid) AS lottery_role_num, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(type = '2', CONCAT(l.roleid, '_', l.zoneid), NULL)) AS blue_lottery_role_num, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(type = '3', CONCAT(l.roleid, '_', l.zoneid), NULL)) AS gold_lottery_role_num, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(type = '4', CONCAT(l.roleid, '_', l.zoneid), NULL)) AS boss_lottery_role_num, SUM(IF(type = '2', cnt, 0)) AS blue_lottery_cnt, SUM(IF(type = '3', cnt, 0)) AS gold_lottery_cnt, SUM(IF(type = '4', cnt, 0)) AS boss_lottery_cnt FROM role_info AS r LEFT JOIN charge_info AS c ON r.roleid = c.roleid AND r.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN active_info AS a ON r.roleid = a.roleid AND r.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN lottery_info AS l ON r.roleid = l.roleid AND r.zoneid = l.zoneid GROUP BY regday_label

sql_units: WITH t_charge_df AS (SELECT roleid, CAST(SUM(his_pay_amt) / 100 AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS pay_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid), t_act_config AS (SELECT act_type, act_id, act_title, start_time, end_time FROM mt_dim.dim_activity_operate_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2023-09-06', '2023-09-06', act_id, act_title, start_time, end_time), t_continue_act_info /* 获取还在进行中的活动的资源消耗 */ AS (SELECT roleid, act_id, act_type, SUM(diamond_cons_amt) AS diamond_cons_amt, SUM(aurora_crystal_cons_amt) AS aurora_crystal_cons_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_activity_diamond_consumption_role_di WHERE logymd >= (SELECT MIN(SUBSTRING(start_time, 1, 10)) FROM t_act_config) AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND act_type IN (359, 589, 446) GROUP BY roleid, act_id, act_type), t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, MAX(first_mt_country) AS country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2022-05-08', PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT roleid, act_id, act_type, act_title, start_time, end_time, country, r_level, diamond_cons_amt, aurora_crystal_cons_amt FROM (SELECT * FROM t_td_act UNION ALL THEN '8_5000-1w$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 10000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 20000 THEN '9_1w-2w$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 20000 AND daily_pmt_cuml <= 30000 THEN '91_2w-3w$' WHEN daily_pmt_cuml > 30000 THEN '92_>3w$' END AS daily_cumpmt_label FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money / 100) AS daily_pmt_cuml FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a), active_info AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001), add_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(item_id = 4, add_num, 0)) AS add_diamond_total, SUM(IF(item_id = 4 AND op IN ('IAP_DeliverItem', 'StoreBuyWithTokens'), add_num, 0)) AS add_pay_diamond, SUM(IF(item_id = 4 AND NOT op IN ('IAP_DeliverItem', 'StoreBuyWithTokens'), add_num, 0)) AS add_free_diamond, SUM(IF(item_id = 8, add_num, 0)) AS add_blue_stone_total, SUM(IF(item_id = 8 AND op IN ('IAP_DeliverItem', 'StoreBuyWithTokens'), add_num, 0)) AS add_pay_blue_stone, SUM(IF(item_id = 8 AND NOT op IN ('IAP_DeliverItem', 'StoreBuyWithTokens'), add_num, 0)) AS add_free_blue_stone, SUM(IF(item_id IN (31, 22), add_num, 0)) AS add_gold_stone_total, SUM(IF(item_id = 31, add_num, 0)) AS add_pay_gold_stone, SUM(IF(item_id = 22, add_num, 0)) AS add_free_gold_stone FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001 AND item_id IN (4, 8, 22, 31) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), sub_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(item_id = 4, sub_num, 0)) AS decrease_diamond, SUM(IF(item_id = 8, sub_num, 0)) AS decrease_blue_stone, SUM(IF(item_id IN (31, 22), sub_num, 0)) AS decrease_gold_stone FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_sub_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001 AND item_id IN (4, 8, 22, 31) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), logout_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(item_id = 4, item_num, 0)) AS stock_diamond, SUM(IF(item_id = 8, item_num, 0)) AS stock_blue_stone, SUM(IF(item_id IN (22, 31), item_num, 0)) AS stock_gold_stone FROM (SELECT zoneid, logymd, roleid, TIME, CAST(SPLIT(item_info, '-')[0] AS INT) AS item_id, CAST(SPLIT(item_info, '-')[1] AS INT) AS item_num FROM (SELECT a.* FROM (SELECT zoneid, logymd, roleid, item_list, TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, logymd, roleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_logout_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 50001) AS a WHERE a.rn = 1) AS logout_item_last_record LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(item_list, '\\073')) AS item_info) AS a WHERE item_id IN (4, 8, 22, 31) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_zgame_active_resource_inventory_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT regday_label, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS active_cnt, SUM(ai.add_diamond_total) AS add_diamond_total, SUM(ai.add_pay_diamond) AS add_pay_diamond, SUM(ai.add_free_diamond) AS add_free_diamond, SUM(s.decrease_diamond) AS decrease_diamond, SUM(ai.add_blue_stone_total) AS add_blue_stone_total, SUM(ai.add_pay_blue_stone) AS add_pay_blue_stone, SUM(ai.add_free_blue_stone) AS add_free_blue_stone, SUM(s.decrease_blue_stone) AS decrease_blue_stone, SUM(ai.add_gold_stone_total) AS add_gold_stone_total, SUM(ai.add_pay_gold_stone) AS add_pay_gold_stone, SUM(ai.add_free_gold_stone) AS add_free_gold_stone, SUM(s.decrease_gold_stone) AS decrease_gold_stone, SUM(stock_diamond) AS stock_diamond, SUM(stock_blue_stone) AS stock_blue_stone, SUM(stock_gold_stone) AS stock_gold_stone FROM role_info AS r LEFT JOIN add_info AS ai ON r.roleid = ai.roleid AND r.zoneid = ai.zoneid LEFT JOIN active_info AS a ON r.roleid = a.roleid AND r.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN sub_info AS s ON r.roleid = s.roleid AND r.zoneid = s.zoneid LEFT JOIN logout_info AS l ON r.roleid = l.roleid AND r.zoneid = l.zoneid GROUP BY regday_label

sql_units: /* -----------用户机型等级及人数分布 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.t_tmp_wmz_ads_datawindbi_newbie_realpicturequality_retain_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.usercreateymd, first_network_name, c.area, c.upper, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.usercreateymd) AS user_period, a.os_type, a.device, a.brand, d.realpicturequality, new_type, g.newbie_tag AS kmeans, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS user_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(NOT f.roleid IS NULL, f.roleid || f.zoneid, NULL)) AS liucun_cnt FROM (/* 新手用户 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, os_type, SPLIT(device, '-')[0] AS device, SPLIT(device, ' ')[0] AS brand FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-18', '2026-05-02') AND usercreateymd = logymd AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, os_type, device) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, first_mt_country, first_network_name, new_type FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, register_date, first_mt_country, first_network_name, new_type) AS b /* ------统一国家口径first_mt_country */ ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT lower, country AS area, upper FROM mt_dim.dim_national_geographic_atlas_config) AS c /* ----国家中文 */ ON b.first_mt_country = c.lower LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, devicemodel, realpicturequality, AVG(devicefreememory) AS `剩余存储空间M` FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_configuration WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-18', '2026-05-02') GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, devicemodel, realpicturequality) AS d ON a.roleid = d.accountid AND a.zoneid = d.zoneid AND a.device = d.devicemodel AND a.logymd = d.logymd LEFT JOIN (/* 新手用户在今天留存情况，账号且设备一致 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, os_type, SPLIT(device, '-')[0] AS device FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, os_type, device) AS f ON a.roleid = f.roleid AND a.zoneid = f.zoneid AND a.device = f.device LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.label_1_new AS newbie_tag, '0' AS heroid_tag, a.label_1_get_days AS tag_datediff FROM ml_temp.new_cluster_label_df AS a /* 4.24修改 */ WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31') AS g ON a.roleid = g.roleid AND a.zoneid = g.zoneid GROUP BY a.logymd, a.usercreateymd, c.area, c.upper, user_period, a.os_type, a.device, a.brand, d.realpicturequality, first_network_name, new_type, g.newbie_tag

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_behavior_cockpit_role_di.mlbb
sql_units: WITH login_device AS (SELECT roleid, device, login_hour, SUM(login_cnt) AS login_cnt, SUM(day_pay_amount) AS day_pay_amount FROM (SELECT roleid, device, login_hour, login_cnt, 0 AS day_pay_amount FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_role_device_hours_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, device, 0 AS login_hour, 0 AS login_cnt, SUM(day_pay_amount) AS day_pay_amount /* 新charge表没有设备维度，暂时不用 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, device) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, device, login_hour), basic_info AS (SELECT roleid, account_register_date, register_date, create_os, CASE WHEN first_mt_country IS NULL OR first_mt_country IN ('_', '', 'unknown') THEN '_' ELSE first_mt_country END AS first_mt_country, first_network_name FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-05-06', '2022-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_first_create = 1 AND is_ai = 0), country_info AS (SELECT country_type, region, CASE WHEN country_code IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE country_code END AS country_code, utc_time_zone AS local_timezone, timezone_diff AS timezone_shift FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-10-01', '2023-10-01', '2026-05-31') GROUP BY country_type, region, CASE WHEN country_code IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE country_code END, utc_time_zone, timezone_diff) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_behavior_cockpit_role_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT ld.roleid, COALESCE(coif.country_code, '-') AS country, COALESCE(coif.country_type, '非重点国') AS country_type, COALESCE(coif.region, '未定义') AS country_area, COALESCE(coif.local_timezone, '-8') AS country_timezone, COALESCE(baif.account_register_date, register_date, '1970-01-01') AS account_create_date, CASE WHEN baif.first_network_name IS NULL OR LOWER(baif.first_network_name) IN ('organic', 'unknown') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_ad, COALESCE(baif.create_os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(baif.first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, ld.device, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(coif.timezone_shift, 0) + login_hour) >= 0 AND (COALESCE(coif.timezone_shift, 0) + login_hour) < 24 THEN (COALESCE(coif.timezone_shift, 0) + login_hour) WHEN (COALESCE(coif.timezone_shift, 0) + login_hour) < 0 THEN (COALESCE(coif.timezone_shift, 0) + login_hour) + 24 WHEN (COALESCE(coif.timezone_shift, 0) + login_hour) >= 24 THEN (COALESCE(coif.timezone_shift, 0) + login_hour) - 24 ELSE 0 END AS login_period, day_pay_amount AS pay_amt, COALESCE(login_cnt, 0) AS login_count FROM login_device AS ld JOIN basic_info AS baif ON ld.roleid = baif.roleid LEFT JOIN country_info AS coif ON coif.country_code = baif.first_mt_country
