name: etl.dwd.dwd_ai_feature_battleid_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH bt_end AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT bt_end.time, bt_end.accountid, bt_end.zoneid, bt_end.battleid, bt_end.pvptype, bt_end.realpvptype, bt_end.battletime, bt_end.wincamp, bt_end.heroid, bt_end.killnum, bt_end.deadnum, bt_end.assistnum, bt_end.timedelay, bt_end.maxdelay, bt_end.minfps, bt_end.avefps, bt_end.ishook, bt_end.reconnectnum, bt_end.herolvl, bt_end.blacknum, bt_end.skillid, bt_end.runeid, bt_end.runelevel, bt_end.conwin, bt_end.isvalid, bt_end.banhero, bt_end.uiskinid, bt_end.movelag, bt_end.skilllag, bt_end.getmoney, bt_end.ismvp, bt_end.select_road, bt_end.camp, bt_end.score, bt_end.mapid, bt_end.real_road, issurrender, bt_end.fake_ai, bt_end.bigranklvl, bt_end.isinvalidbattle, bt_end.minranklvl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, bt_end.pvptype, bt_end.realpvptype, battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC, bt_end.maxdelay DESC) AS rn /* maxdelay辅助排序字段 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS bt_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND bt_end.pvptype IN (1, 2, 4)) AS t1 WHERE rn = 1), bt_pfc AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, battleid, ping_variance FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, battleid, ping_variance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC, ping_variance DESC) AS rn /* ping_variance辅助排序字段 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance AS bt_pfc WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t2 WHERE rn = 1), bt_eend AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, mapid, roadsort, score, COALESCE(minranklevel, -1) AS minranklevel /* 字节侧保持一致 */, COALESCE(bigranklevel, -1) AS bigranklevel, COALESCE(rankstar, -1) AS rankstar FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, mapid, roadsort, score, minranklevel, bigranklevel, rankstar, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, realpvptype, battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC, roadsort DESC) AS rn /* ping_variance辅助排序字段 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata AS bt_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(isbot, 0) = 0) AS t1 WHERE rn = 1), battle_end_ai AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, battleid, MAX(battle_type) AS battle_type, MAX(battleai_type) AS battleai_type FROM mt_dwd.dwd_mode_list_battle_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 上报时间往后推8个小时 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, battleid), gm_eend AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, battleid, MAX(kill2) AS kill2_cnt, MAX(kill3) AS kill3_cnt, MAX(kill4) AS kill4_cnt, MAX(kill5) AS kill5_cnt, MAX(continuekill) AS continuekill FROM ml_ods.gameserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 上报时间往后推8个小时 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, battleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_ai_feature_battleid_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') /* 防止排序重复取max */ SELECT MAX(bt_end.time) AS TIME, bt_end.accountid AS roleid, bt_end.zoneid, bt_end.battleid, bt_end.pvptype, bt_end.realpvptype, MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.battletime, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.wincamp, -99999)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.heroid, -99999)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.killnum, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.deadnum, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.assistnum, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.timedelay, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.maxdelay, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.minfps, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.avefps, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_pfc.ping_variance, 0)) AS ping_variance, MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.ishook, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.reconnectnum, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.herolvl, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.blacknum, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.skillid, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.runeid, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.runelevel, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.conwin, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.isvalid, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.banhero, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.uiskinid, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.movelag, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.skilllag, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.getmoney, 0)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.ismvp, -99999)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.select_road, -99999)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.camp, -99999)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.score, bt_eend.score, -99999)), MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.mapid, bt_eend.mapid, -99999)) AS mapid, MAX(COALESCE(bt_eend.roadsort, -99999)) AS roadsort, MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.real_road, -99999)) AS real_road, MAX(CASE WHEN bt_eend.accountid IS NULL THEN -1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp = 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 1 AND bt_eend.rankstar = 9 THEN bigranklevel + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp = 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 2 AND bt_eend.rankstar = 21 THEN bigranklevel + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp = 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 3 AND bt_eend.rankstar = 37 THEN bigranklevel + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp = 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 4 AND bt_eend.rankstar = 62 THEN bigranklevel + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp = 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 5 AND bt_eend.rankstar = 87 THEN bigranklevel + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp = 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 6 AND bt_eend.rankstar = 112 THEN bigranklevel + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp <> 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 2 AND bt_eend.rankstar = 9 THEN bigranklevel - 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp <> 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 3 AND bt_eend.rankstar = 21 THEN bigranklevel - 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp <> 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 4 AND bt_eend.rankstar = 37 THEN bigranklevel - 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp <> 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 5 AND bt_eend.rankstar = 62 THEN bigranklevel - 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp <> 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 6 AND bt_eend.rankstar = 87 THEN bigranklevel - 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp <> 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 7 AND bt_eend.rankstar = 112 THEN bigranklevel - 1 ELSE bigranklevel END) AS settlement_big_rank_level, MAX(CASE WHEN bt_eend.accountid IS NULL THEN -1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp = 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 1 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (3, 6, 9) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp = 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 2 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (13, 17, 21) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp = 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 3 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (25, 29, 33, 37) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp = 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 4 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (42, 47, 52, 57, 62) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp = 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 5 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (67, 72, 77, 82, 87) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp = 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 6 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (92, 97, 102, 107, 112) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp = 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 7 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (121, 131, 141, 151, 161) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp <> 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 1 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (4, 7) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel - 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp <> 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 2 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (9, 13, 17) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel - 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp <> 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 3 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (21, 25, 29, 33) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel - 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp <> 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 4 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (37, 42, 47, 52, 57) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel - 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp <> 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 5 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (62, 67, 72, 77, 82) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel - 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp <> 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 6 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (87, 92, 97, 102, 107) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel - 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND bt_end.wincamp <> 1 AND bt_eend.bigranklevel = 7 AND bt_eend.rankstar IN (112, 122, 132, 142, 152, 162) THEN bt_eend.minranklevel - 1 ELSE minranklevel END) AS settlement_small_rank_level, MAX(CASE WHEN bt_eend.accountid IS NULL THEN -1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND wincamp = 1 THEN bt_eend.rankstar + 1 WHEN bt_end.pvptype = 2 AND wincamp <> 1 THEN GREATEST(bt_eend.rankstar - 1, 0) ELSE bt_eend.rankstar END) AS settlement_rank_star, MAX(CASE WHEN gm_eend.kill2_cnt > COALESCE(bt_end.killnum, 0) THEN 0 WHEN gm_eend.kill2_cnt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE gm_eend.kill2_cnt END) AS kill2_cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN gm_eend.kill3_cnt > COALESCE(bt_end.killnum, 0) THEN 0 WHEN gm_eend.kill3_cnt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE gm_eend.kill3_cnt END) AS kill3_cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN gm_eend.kill4_cnt > COALESCE(bt_end.killnum, 0) THEN 0 WHEN gm_eend.kill4_cnt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE gm_eend.kill4_cnt END) AS kill4_cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN gm_eend.kill5_cnt > COALESCE(bt_end.killnum, 0) THEN 0 WHEN gm_eend.kill5_cnt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE gm_eend.kill5_cnt END) AS kill5_cnt, MAX(battle_end_ai.battle_type) AS battle_type, MAX(battle_end_ai.battleai_type) AS battleai_type, MAX(bt_end.issurrender) AS issurrender, MAX(COALESCE(bt_end.fake_ai, 0)) AS fake_ai, MAX(bt_end.bigranklvl) AS bigranklvl, MAX(bt_end.isinvalidbattle) AS isinvalidbattle, MAX(bt_end.minranklvl) AS minranklvl, MAX(COALESCE(bsinf.first_mt_country, 'unknown')) AS first_mt_country FROM bt_end LEFT JOIN bt_pfc ON bt_end.accountid = bt_pfc.accountid AND bt_end.zoneid = bt_pfc.zoneid AND bt_end.battleid = bt_pfc.battleid LEFT JOIN bt_eend ON bt_end.accountid = bt_eend.accountid AND bt_end.zoneid = bt_eend.zoneid AND bt_end.battleid = bt_eend.battleid LEFT JOIN gm_eend ON bt_end.accountid = gm_eend.roleid AND bt_end.zoneid = gm_eend.zoneid AND bt_end.battleid = gm_eend.battleid LEFT JOIN battle_end_ai ON bt_end.accountid = battle_end_ai.roleid AND bt_end.zoneid = battle_end_ai.zoneid AND bt_end.battleid = battle_end_ai.battleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' >= '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31', '2024-01-01')) AS bsinf ON bt_end.accountid = bsinf.roleid AND bt_end.zoneid = bsinf.zoneid GROUP BY bt_end.accountid, bt_end.zoneid, bt_end.battleid, bt_end.pvptype, bt_end.realpvptype

name: adbi.ods_kol_tiktok_comment
sql_units: /* 为了解决presto无法读取数据问题 */ /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE `adbi`.`ods_kol_tiktok_comment_v2`( */ /*             `page_id` STRING COMMENT '主页ID', */ /*             `page_desc` STRING COMMENT '主页描述', */ /*             `page_title` STRING COMMENT '主页标题', */ /*             `video_id` STRING COMMENT '视频ID', */ /*             `video_desc` STRING COMMENT '视频描述', */ /*             `video_url` STRING COMMENT '视频URL', */ /*             `video_create_time` BIGINT COMMENT '视频创建时间', */ /*             `video_digg_count` BIGINT COMMENT '视频喜欢量', */ /*             `video_share_count` BIGINT COMMENT '分享量', */ /*             `video_play_count` BIGINT COMMENT '播放量', */ /*             `video_collect_count` BIGINT COMMENT '收集量', */ /*             `follower_count` BIGINT COMMENT '粉丝量', */ /*             `heart_count` BIGINT COMMENT '点赞量', */ /*             `comment_id` STRING COMMENT '评论ID', */ /*             `comment_digg_count` BIGINT COMMENT '评论喜欢量', */ /*             `comment_text` STRING COMMENT '评论内容', */ /*             `comment_create_time` BIGINT COMMENT '回复评论时间', */ /*             `reply_comment_total` BIGINT COMMENT '回复评论数量', */ /*             `comment_user_id` STRING COMMENT '评论用户ID', */ /*             `comment_user_name` STRING COMMENT '评论用户名称' */ /*         ) */ /*         PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` STRING COMMENT '分区') STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/ods/kol/ods_kol_tiktok_comment_v2'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.ods_kol_tiktok_comment_v2 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-06-01') SELECT page_id, page_desc, page_title, video_id, video_desc, video_url, video_create_time, video_digg_count, video_share_count, video_play_count, video_collect_count, follower_count, heart_count, comment_id, comment_digg_count, comment_text, comment_create_time, reply_comment_total, comment_user_id, comment_user_name, '1001' AS app_id FROM adbi.ods_kol_tiktok_comment WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01'

name: (近30日）新手教育特征di表dwd_wmz_newbie_education_di
sql_units: WITH newbie_t /* AND     zoneid < 57000 */ AS (/* 每日新增 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_country, create_os, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, new_type, register_date, DATEDIFF(a.logymd, register_date) + 1 AS register_days FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS a /* ml_leap.dim_basic_role_zone_df a */ WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND register_date BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND is_ai = 0), lvl AS (/* 新手等级信息 */ SELECT lvl.roleid, lvl.zoneid, MAX(lvl.cur_num) AS max_level FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_level AS lvl JOIN newbie_t AS t1 ON lvl.roleid = t1.roleid AND lvl.zoneid = t1.zoneid WHERE lvl.logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND lvl.logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY lvl.roleid, lvl.zoneid), tag /* AND     a.register_diff_date <= 30 */ AS (/* 标签 */ SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.label_1_new AS newbie_tag, '0' AS heroid_tag, a.label_1_get_days AS tag_datediff /* 4.24修改 */ FROM ml_temp.new_cluster_label_df AS a WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' /* dm_wmz_newbie_label_roleid_zoneid_df从23年12月27号开始  20240227 */), max_rank AS (/* 新手段位信息 */ SELECT t.roleid, t.zoneid, his_max_rank_id, his_max_minranklvl, his_max_bigranklvl, t2.his_first_achieve3_time_bigranklvl, t2.his_first_achieve4_time_bigranklvl, t2.his_first_achieve5_time_bigranklvl FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df AS t JOIN newbie_t AS t1 ON t.roleid = t1.roleid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, MAX(IF(new_bigranklvl = 3, TIME, NULL)) AS his_first_achieve3_time_bigranklvl, MAX(IF(new_bigranklvl = 4, TIME, NULL)) AS his_first_achieve4_time_bigranklvl, MAX(IF(new_bigranklvl = 5, TIME, NULL)) AS his_first_achieve5_time_bigranklvl FROM ml_ods.gameserver_rank_level AS a /* JOIN    newbie_t b */ /* ON      a.roleid = b.roleid */ /* AND     a.zoneid = b.zoneid */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND isfirst_biglvl = 1 GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS t2 ON t.roleid = t2.roleid AND t.zoneid = t2.zoneid WHERE t.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND t.pvptype = 2), bt /* AND ( */ /* 	substr(from_unixtime(usercreateymd),1,10) >='2023-01-01' */ /* 	OR usercreateymd IS NULL */ /* 	)-- 限制单机关足够，无需再限制注册时间 */ AS (SELECT battleid, accountid AS roleid, camp, zoneid, TIME, pvptype, realpvptype, battletime, LEAST(killnum, 50) AS killnum, -1 AS campkill, LEAST(deadnum, 50) AS deadnum, LEAST(assistnum, 50) AS assistnum, LEAST(getmoney, 30000) AS gold, LEAST(score, 3000) AS score, LEAST(wincamp, 1) AS iswin, -1 AS scorerank, ismvp, heroid, blacknum, bigranklvl, minranklvl, rankstar, LEVEL, CASE WHEN select_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN select_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN select_road = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN select_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN select_road = 5 THEN '金币路' ELSE '-1' END AS select_road, CASE WHEN real_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN real_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN real_road = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN real_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN real_road = 5 THEN '金币路' ELSE '-1' END AS real_road FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND usercreateymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' /* 极少数注册时间与basic df表不一致 */ UNION ALL SELECT battleid, accountid AS roleid, icamp AS camp, zoneid, TIME, battletype AS pvptype, realpvptype, battle_time AS battletime, LEAST(killnum, 50) AS killnum, LEAST(campkill, 200) AS campkill, LEAST(dead, 50) AS deadnum, LEAST(assist, 50) AS assistnum, LEAST(gold, 30000) AS gold, LEAST(score, 3000) AS score, LEAST(iswin, 1) AS iswin, scorerank, IF(medal_type IN (1, 5), 1, 0) AS ismvp, heroid, blacknum, bigranklevel AS bigranklvl, minranklevel AS minranklvl, rankstar, LEVEL, '-1' AS select_road, CASE WHEN roadsort IN (1, 5) THEN '金币路' WHEN roadsort IN (101, 105) THEN '经验路' WHEN roadsort IN (2) THEN '中路' WHEN roadsort IN (4) THEN '打野' WHEN roadsort = 3 OR roadsort >= 3000 THEN '游走' ELSE '-1' END AS real_road FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battletype IN (1) AND LENGTH(CAST(battleid AS STRING)) BETWEEN 10 AND 12), battle_detial_t AS (SELECT bt.time, bt.battleid, bt.roleid, bt.zoneid, IF(NOT t1.battleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_exist_battle_end_data, IF(NOT t2.battleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_exist_playerability_data, IF(NOT t3.battleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_exist_battle_analysis_data, IF(NOT t4.battleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_exist_battle_gameskill_data, IF(NOT t5.battle_id IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_exist_rookie_socre_data, bt.pvptype, bt.realpvptype, bt.battletime AS battle_time, bt.bigranklvl AS bigranklevel_before_battle, bt.minranklvl AS minranklevel_before_battle, bt.level AS level_before_battle, bt.heroid, bt.blacknum, t.skillid, bt.camp AS icamp, bt.iswin, bt.score, bt.killnum, bt.deadnum AS dead, bt.assistnum AS assist, t.deadnumbytower, t.campkill, bt.gold, t.atktower, t.hurtad, t.hurtap, t.hurtatk, t.hurtreal, t.team_atktower, t.team_dmg, t.team_dmg * t.hurtrate / 10000 AS hurt_all, t.team_hurt AS team_behurt, t.team_hurt * t.behurtrate / 10000 AS behurt_all, t.shenguiskill, t.lingzhuskill, -9999 AS delay_time_buy_equip, t1.select_road_std, t1.real_road_std AS real_road, CASE WHEN t1.real_road_std IS NULL OR t1.real_road_std IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t1.select_road_std = '-9999' OR t1.real_road_std = '-9999' THEN '-9999' WHEN t1.select_road_std = t1.real_road_std THEN '1' WHEN t1.select_road_std <> t1.real_road_std THEN '0' ELSE 'else' END AS if_pre_select_road_precise /* 枚举：null,-9999,0,1 */, t1.battlesvrid, t2.castskill, t2.operateskill, t2.skill_hero AS skill_hero_cnt, t2.act_m * (battle_time / 60) AS act_cnt, t2.act_c, t3.para30 AS get_tower_layer_gold, t3.para81 AS soldier_glod_6min, t3.para84 AS jungle_glod_6min, t3.para83 AS kill_assist_glod_6min, t3.para71 AS act_6min_cnt, t3.para72 AS act35_6min, t3.para73 AS act35, t3.controlrate AS controlrate, t3.slowrate AS slowrate, t3.para76 AS recall_cnt, t3.para9 AS success_use_recovery_skill_cnt, t4.buyequiptime, t4.buyequipcount, t4.guide_buyequipcount, t4.avgapm * (battle_time / 60) AS battle_actions, t4.maxapm, t5.old_rookie_point AS roookid_score_bgefore_battle, t5.new_rookie_point AS roookid_score_after_battle, t5.ai_difficult, bt.minranklvl AS minranklevel, bt.bigranklvl AS bigranklevel, bt.rankstar, t6.rankid, bt.scorerank AS scorerank_battleenddata, t1.ismvp AS ismvp_battle_end, t1.blacknum AS blacknum_battle_end, COALESCE(t7.bigjankper10min / 100, -1) AS bigjankper10min, COALESCE(bt.battletime / 600 * t7.bigjankper10min, -1) AS bigjankper, t1.score_rk, t1.timedelay, t1.stdping, t8.matchtime, t9.kill3, t9.kill4, t9.kill5, t1.isinvalidbattle FROM bt LEFT JOIN (/* 战斗数据主表battleenddata */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 以及一些异常对局 */) AS t ON bt.battleid = t.battleid AND bt.roleid = t.accountid AND bt.zoneid = t.zoneid AND t.rank_time_desc = 1 LEFT JOIN (/* 战斗信息表battle_end */ SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN select_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN select_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN select_road = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN select_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN select_road = 5 THEN '金币路' ELSE '-9999' END AS select_road_std, CASE WHEN real_road = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN real_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN real_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN real_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN real_road = 1 THEN '经验路' ELSE '-9999' END AS real_road_std, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY battleid, wincamp, TIME ORDER BY score DESC) AS score_rk /* score分排名 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */) AS t1 ON bt.roleid = t1.accountid AND bt.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND bt.battleid = t1.battleid AND t1.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */ LEFT JOIN (/* 玩家能力表playerability */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_playerability AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */) AS t2 ON bt.roleid = t2.accountid AND bt.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND bt.battleid = t2.battleid AND t2.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */ LEFT JOIN (/* 战斗分析表battle_analysis */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_battle_analysis AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */) AS t3 ON bt.roleid = t3.accountid AND bt.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND bt.battleid = t3.battleid AND t3.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */ LEFT JOIN (/* 战斗能力表gameskill */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_gameskill AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */) AS t4 ON bt.roleid = t4.accountid AND bt.zoneid = t4.zoneid AND bt.battleid = t4.battleid AND t4.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */ LEFT JOIN (/* 新手分表battle_rookie_point_change */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.battle_id ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_battle_rookie_point_change AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battle_id > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */) AS t5 ON bt.roleid = t5.roleid AND bt.zoneid = t5.zoneid AND bt.battleid = t5.battle_id AND t5.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT rankid, bigrank, minrank, ranklevel FROM mt_dim.dim_ranked_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_ranked_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS t6 ON bt.minranklvl = t6.minrank AND bt.bigranklvl = t6.bigrank AND bt.rankstar = t6.ranklevel LEFT JOIN (/* 战斗性能表 */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t7 ON CAST(bt.roleid AS STRING) = CAST(t7.accountid AS STRING) AND CAST(bt.zoneid AS STRING) = CAST(t7.zoneid AS STRING) AND CAST(bt.battleid AS STRING) = CAST(t7.battleid AS STRING) AND t7.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */ LEFT JOIN (/* 战斗性能表 */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' AND success = 1) AS t8 ON bt.roleid = t8.accountid AND bt.zoneid = t8.zoneid AND bt.battleid = t8.battleid AND t8.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */ LEFT JOIN (/* 战斗性能表 */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_battle_end AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31') AS t9 ON bt.roleid = t9.roleid AND bt.zoneid = t9.zoneid AND bt.battleid = t9.battleid AND t9.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */), battle_real_usercnt_t AS (/* 计算本场真人数 */ SELECT a.battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.accountid, a.zoneid) AS real_players_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battleid FROM battle_detial_t) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */ AND LENGTH(a.battleid) >= 17 /* 剔除battleid长度10~12客户端温暖关 */ AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY a.battleid), battle_real_usercnt_camp_t AS (/* 计算己方真人数 */ SELECT a.battleid, a.wincamp, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(fake_ai = 0, a.accountid || a.zoneid, NULL)) AS real_players_cnt, SUM(a.killnum) AS kill_camp, SUM(deadnum) AS dead_camp, SUM(getmoney) AS gold_camp FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battleid FROM battle_detial_t) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */ AND LENGTH(a.battleid) >= 17 /* 剔除battleid长度10~12客户端温暖关 */ /*     and     fake_ai = 0 */ GROUP BY a.battleid, a.wincamp), battle_end_agg_t AS (/* if_real_road_lack FROM (SELECT battleid, wincamp, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(select_road_std = '-9999', NULL, select_road_std)) AS select_road_unqiue_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(real_road_std = '-9999', NULL, real_road_std)) AS real_road_unqiue_cnt, LEAST(1, COUNT(IF(select_road_std = '-9999', NULL, select_road_std)) - COUNT(DISTINCT IF(select_road_std = '-9999', NULL, select_road_std))) AS if_pre_select_road_conflict /* 如果有-9999以外的重复分路为1，如无为0 */, LEAST(1, COUNT(IF(real_road_std = '-9999', NULL, real_road_std)) - COUNT(DISTINCT IF(real_road_std = '-9999', NULL, real_road_std))) AS if_real_road_conflict /* 如果有-9999以外的重复分路为1，如无为0 */ FROM (SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN select_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN select_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN select_road = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN select_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN select_road = 5 THEN '金币路' ELSE '-9999' END AS select_road_std, CASE WHEN real_road = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN real_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN real_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN real_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN real_road = 1 THEN '经验路' ELSE '-9999' END AS real_road_std, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battleid, iswin FROM battle_detial_t) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.wincamp = b.iswin WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */ AND LENGTH(a.battleid) >= 17 /* 剔除battleid长度10~12客户端温暖关 */) AS t1 WHERE rank_time_desc = 1 GROUP BY battleid, wincamp) AS a) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE lvl AS t1 /* 等级 */ ON t.roleid = t1.roleid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN tag AS t2 /* 新手标签 */ ON t.roleid = t2.roleid AND t.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN max_rank AS t3 /* 段位 */ ON t.roleid = name: etl.mt_ads.ads_realtime_recurring_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: fireyangshen@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-02-24 00:23:12.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 需求文档: https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/TUJbwzYCoiQDX4kagqGcCuBGnvg */ /* 自测文档: https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/PFEDwaxEliQ2LLkDZOAcG6CJnhc */ /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mt_ads`.`ads_realtime_recurring_di`( */ /*             `time` TIMESTAMP COMMENT '国家', */ /*             `roleid` BIGINT COMMENT 'roleid', */ /*             `zoneid` BIGINT COMMENT 'zoneid', */ /*             channel STRING COMMENT 'channel', */ /*             platform STRING COMMENT 'platform', */ /*             is_fake BIGINT COMMENT 'is_fake', */ /*             granularity_type STRING COMMENT '用户类型' */ /*         ) COMMENT '实时回流ADS表' */ /*         PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` STRING COMMENT '日期，yyyy-MM-dd') STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_realtime_recurring_di'; */ /* 依赖ml_ods */ /* 角色 */ WITH active_tbl AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, channel, IF(os_type = 1, 'ios', 'and') AS platform, channel IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test') AS is_fake, `time`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time` ASC, deviceid) AS rn /*  row_number() over(partition by roleid order by day_first_active_time asc,first_reconn asc,day_login_cnt desc,day_first_deviceid) */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY `time` ASC, deviceid) AS a_rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND usercreateymd < '2026-04-30'), r_recurring_tbl AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid /* FROM    ml_ods.gameserver_login */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd < '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-04-30' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), a_recurring_tbl AS (SELECT roleid FROM r_recurring_tbl GROUP BY roleid), account_tbl /* 账号回流 */ AS (SELECT a.time AS `time`, a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.channel, a.platform, a.is_fake, 'account' AS granularity_type FROM active_tbl AS a LEFT JOIN a_recurring_tbl AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE b.roleid IS NULL AND a.a_rn = 1), role_tbl /* 剩余角色回流 */ AS (SELECT a.time AS `time`, a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.channel, a.platform, a.is_fake, 'role' AS granularity_type FROM active_tbl AS a LEFT JOIN r_recurring_tbl AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN account_tbl AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid WHERE b.roleid IS NULL AND c.roleid IS NULL AND a.rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_realtime_recurring_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT `time`, roleid, zoneid, channel, platform, is_fake, granularity_type FROM (SELECT * FROM account_tbl UNION ALL SELECT * FROM role_tbl)

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_battle_hero_bigrank_di_teammate
sql_units: WITH hero_data_t AS (SELECT heroid, hero_name, CASE WHEN heroes = 1 THEN '坦克' WHEN heroes = 2 THEN '战士' WHEN heroes = 3 THEN '刺客' WHEN heroes = 4 THEN '法师' WHEN heroes = 5 THEN '射手' WHEN heroes = 6 THEN '辅助' WHEN heroes = -9999 THEN '' ELSE 'else' END || ',' || CASE WHEN sub_heroes = 1 THEN '坦克' WHEN sub_heroes = 2 THEN '战士' WHEN sub_heroes = 3 THEN '刺客' WHEN sub_heroes = 4 THEN '法师' WHEN sub_heroes = 5 THEN '射手' WHEN sub_heroes = 6 THEN '辅助' WHEN sub_heroes = -9999 THEN '' ELSE 'else' END AS heros_type, CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN position = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN position = 3 THEN '游走路' WHEN position = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN position = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN position = -9999 THEN '' ELSE 'else' END || ',' || CASE WHEN sub_position = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN sub_position = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN sub_position = 3 THEN '游走路' WHEN sub_position = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN sub_position = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN sub_position = -9999 THEN '' ELSE 'else' END AS position_type FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = IF(DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, '2026-05-31') >= 1, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, -1), '2026-05-31') GROUP BY heroid, hero_name, heros_type, position_type), hero_battle_detail_t AS (SELECT heroid, accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN t.battletime <= 360 THEN '6min-' WHEN t.battletime >= 361 AND battletime <= 480 THEN '6-8min' WHEN t.battletime >= 481 AND battletime <= 600 THEN '8-10min' WHEN t.battletime >= 601 AND battletime <= 720 THEN '10-12min' WHEN t.battletime >= 721 AND battletime <= 840 THEN '12-14min' WHEN t.battletime >= 841 AND battletime <= 960 THEN '14-16min' WHEN t.battletime >= 961 AND battletime <= 1080 THEN '16-18min' WHEN t.battletime >= 1081 AND battletime <= 1200 THEN '18-20min' WHEN t.battletime >= 1201 THEN '20min+' ELSE 'else times' END AS battle_time_type, CASE WHEN rankstar >= 162 THEN 9 WHEN rankstar >= 137 THEN 8 ELSE bigranklvl END AS bigranklvl, battleid, battletime, wincamp, t.banhero FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS t JOIN (SELECT battleid AS battleid_filter, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid) AS user_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS t WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (2) AND realpvptype IN (2, 59, 90) AND zoneid < 57000 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid) = 10) AS t1 ON t.battleid = t1.battleid_filter WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (2) AND realpvptype IN (2, 59, 90) AND zoneid < 57000 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND fake_ai = 0), match_hero_t AS (SELECT '同队' AS match_type, t.heroid AS main_heroid, t1.heroid AS sub_heroid, t2.bigranklvl, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.wincamp = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS win_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT t.battleid) AS battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '6min-' AND t.wincamp = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS 6min_win_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '6min-', t.battleid, NULL)) AS 6min_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '6-8min' AND t.wincamp = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS 6_8min_win_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '6-8min', t.battleid, NULL)) AS 6_8min_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '8-10min' AND t.wincamp = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS 8_10min_win_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '8-10min', t.battleid, NULL)) AS 8_10min_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '10-12min' AND t.wincamp = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS 10_12min_win_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '10-12min', t.battleid, NULL)) AS 10_12min_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '12-14min' AND t.wincamp = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS 12_14min_win_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '12-14min', t.battleid, NULL)) AS 12_14min_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '14-16min' AND t.wincamp = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS 14_16min_win_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '14-16min', t.battleid, NULL)) AS 14_16min_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '16-18min' AND t.wincamp = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS 16_18min_win_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '16-18min', t.battleid, NULL)) AS 16_18min_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '18-20min' AND t.wincamp = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS 18_20min_win_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '18-20min', t.battleid, NULL)) AS 18_20min_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '20min+' AND t.wincamp = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS 20min_win_battleid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.battle_time_type = '20min+', t.battleid, NULL)) AS 20min_battleid_cnt FROM hero_battle_detail_t AS t LEFT JOIN hero_battle_detail_t AS t1 /* 同队 */ ON t.battleid = t1.battleid AND t.wincamp = t1.wincamp AND t.heroid <> t1.heroid LEFT JOIN (SELECT battleid, MAX(bigranklvl) AS bigranklvl FROM hero_battle_detail_t GROUP BY battleid) AS t2 ON t.battleid = t2.battleid GROUP BY main_heroid, sub_heroid, t2.bigranklvl), ban_hero_info AS (SELECT banhero, bigranklvl, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battle_cnt FROM hero_battle_detail_t WHERE NOT banhero IS NULL GROUP BY banhero, bigranklvl), battle_hero_num AS (SELECT heroid, bigranklvl, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid, battleid) AS battle_num FROM hero_battle_detail_t GROUP BY heroid, bigranklvl) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_battle_hero_bigrank_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', match_type = '1') SELECT t.bigranklvl, t.main_heroid, t1.hero_name AS main_hero_name, t.sub_heroid, t2.hero_name AS sub_hero_name, t.battle_cnt, t.win_battle_cnt, 6min_battleid_cnt, 6min_win_battleid_cnt, 6_8min_battleid_cnt, 6_8min_win_battleid_cnt, 8_10min_battleid_cnt, 8_10min_win_battleid_cnt, 10_12min_battleid_cnt, 10_12min_win_battleid_cnt, 12_14min_battleid_cnt, 12_14min_win_battleid_cnt, 14_16min_battleid_cnt, 14_16min_win_battleid_cnt, 16_18min_battleid_cnt, 16_18min_win_battleid_cnt, 18_20min_battleid_cnt, 18_20min_win_battleid_cnt, 20min_battleid_cnt, 20min_win_battleid_cnt, COALESCE(hbi.battle_cnt, 0) AS main_hero_ban_cnt, COALESCE(hbn.battle_num, 0) AS battle_num FROM match_hero_t AS t LEFT JOIN hero_data_t AS t1 ON t.main_heroid = t1.heroid LEFT JOIN hero_data_t AS t2 ON t.sub_heroid = t2.heroid LEFT JOIN ban_hero_info AS hbi ON t.main_heroid = hbi.banhero AND t.bigranklvl = hbi.bigranklvl LEFT JOIN battle_hero_num AS hbn ON t.main_heroid = hbn.heroid AND t.bigranklvl = hbn.bigranklvl

name: adbi.ods_kol_twitter_comment
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.ods_kol_twitter_comment PARTITION(logymd = '2026-06-01') SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.account_name AS page_id, a.account_nickname AS page_name, a.account_tweet_id AS post_id, a.tweet_content AS post_message, a.up_time AS post_created_time, b.tweet_id AS comment_id, b.tweet_content AS comment_text, a.tweet_url AS permalink_url, b.like_count AS like_count, b.review_count AS comments_count, b.up_time AS comment_created_time, b.tweet_account_name AS comment_auther_name, CASE WHEN a.account_name IN ('MobileLegendsOL', 'MobileLegendsJP', 'MLBBBR', 'mlbblatam', 'MLBB_AR', 'MLBB_Turkiye', 'real_mlbbid') THEN '1001' WHEN a.account_name IN ('ACECRAFT_EN', 'ACECRAFT_KR', 'ACECRAFT_JP') THEN '4310' WHEN a.account_name IN ('SiruburaJP', 'SAB_KR_Official', 'SAB_EN_Official') THEN '4400' ELSE 'unknown' END AS app_id FROM (SELECT * FROM adbi.ods_kol_twitter_account_tweets WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' AND tweet_type = 'original') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM adbi.ods_kol_twitter_account_tweets WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01' AND tweet_type = 'reply') AS b ON a.account_tweet_id = b.account_tweet_id) WHERE NOT comment_id IS NULL

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_run_alarm_info_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT project_id, project_name, task_id, task_owner_user, alarm_rule_id, alarm_rule_name, description, source_type, source_task_id, receivers, alarm_type, alarm_channels, frequency, interval_time, interval_unit, avoid_disturb, ad_start, ad_end, status, create_user_name, create_time, update_time, alarm_item_id, alarm_item_type, CASE alarm_item_type WHEN 1 THEN '每一次运行失败' WHEN 2 THEN '运行成功' WHEN 3 THEN '运行耗时超过阈值' WHEN 4 THEN '重试结束仍失败' WHEN 5 THEN '第N次运行失败' WHEN 6 THEN '在设定的执行时间一段时间后未开始运行' WHEN 7 THEN '在设定的执行时间一段时间后未结束运行' WHEN 8 THEN '在设定的执行时间一段时间后未运行成功' WHEN 9 THEN '截止设定的北京时间未运行成功' ELSE '未知' END AS alarm_item_type_ch, alarm_item_params, CAST(CASE WHEN alarm_item_type IN (3, 6, 7, 8) THEN CONCAT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(alarm_item_params, '$.interval'), IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(alarm_item_params, '$.unit') = '1', 'min', 'h')) WHEN alarm_item_type = 5 THEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(alarm_item_params, '$.num') WHEN alarm_item_type = 9 THEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(alarm_item_params, '$.fixedTime') ELSE '' END AS STRING) AS alarm_item_detail, alarm_item_ctime, alarm_item_utime FROM (SELECT ar.id AS alarm_rule_id, ar.project_id, tdf.project_name, ar.name AS alarm_rule_name, ar.description, ar.source_type, ar.source_task_id, COALESCE(IF(ar.receivers = 'null', NULL, ar.receivers), '{}') AS receivers, ar.alarm_type, ar.alarm_channels, ar.frequency, ar.interval_time, ar.interval_unit, ar.avoid_disturb, ar.ad_start, ar.ad_end, ar.status, ar.create_user_name, ar.create_time, ar.update_time, ai.id AS alarm_item_id /*      , ai.alarm_rule_id */, ai.alarm_item_type, COALESCE(IF(ai.alarm_item_params = 'null', NULL, ai.alarm_item_params), '{}') AS alarm_item_params, ai.create_time AS alarm_item_ctime, ai.update_time AS alarm_item_utime /*      , rtdf.id as alarm_rule_task_id */, rtdf.task_id /*      , tdf.id */, tdf.task_owner_user FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__alarm_rule_df AS ar JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__alarm_item_df AS ai ON TRUE JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__alarm_rule_task_df AS rtdf ON TRUE JOIN mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_info_df AS tdf ON ar.id = ai.alarm_rule_id AND ai.alarm_rule_id = rtdf.alarm_rule_id AND rtdf.task_id = tdf.task_id WHERE ar.date = '20260531' AND ai.date = '20260531' AND rtdf.date = '20260531' AND tdf.logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t /* and ar.source_type in (1,2) -- 不看基线 */ /*     and ar.status=1 -- 只看开启的监控 */ /*     group by ai.alarm_rule_id */

  comments_num_total_1_30_interval1_list, */ /*         shares_total_1_30_interval1_list, */ /*         likes_total_1_30_interval1_list, */ /*         reactions_total_1_30_interval1_list, */ /*         video_avg_time_watched_total_1_30_interval1_list, */ /*         if(media_type = 'video',video_id,split(post_id, '_')[1]) AS match_id */ /* FROM    more_than_30_days */ WITH base AS (SELECT *, MAP(logymd, post_impressions_total) AS impressions_total_map, MAP(logymd, post_impressions_paid_total) AS impressions_paid_total_map, MAP(logymd, post_impressions_unique_total) AS impressions_unique_total_map, MAP(logymd, post_impressions_paid_unique_total) AS impressions_paid_unique_total_map, MAP(logymd, post_video_views_total) AS views_total_map, MAP(logymd, post_video_views_paid_total) AS views_paid_total_map, MAP(logymd, post_video_views_unique_total) AS views_unique_total_map, MAP(logymd, post_video_views_paid_unique_total) AS views_paid_unique_total_map, MAP(logymd, COALESCE(comments_num_total2, comments_num_total)) AS comments_num_total_map /* update@2024-08-02,开始拉取互动数数后，使用新的comment和share */, MAP(logymd, COALESCE(shares_total2, shares_total)) AS shares_total_map, MAP(logymd, post_reactions_by_type_total_total) AS likes_total_map /* update@2024-08-02 使用所有表情替换纯like */, MAP(logymd, COALESCE(post_activity_by_action_type_total, comments_num_total + shares_total + post_reactions_by_type_total_total)) AS reactions_total_map /* update@2024-08-02 post_activity_by_action_type_total有值的用post_activity_by_action_type_total，没值的用comments_num_total+shares_total+post_reactions_by_type_total_total */, MAP(logymd, post_video_avg_time_watched_total) AS avg_time_watched_total_map, MAP(logymd, post_media_view_total) AS post_media_view_total_map, MAP(logymd, post_video_retention_graph_total) AS full_video_watched_rate_total_map, IF('2026-04-02' < SUBSTRING(post_created_time, 1, 10), IF(SUBSTRING(post_created_time, 1, 10) <= '2026-05-31', SUBSTRING(post_created_time, 1, 10), '2026-05-31'), '2026-04-02') AS begin_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY post_id, page_id, manager_id ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn /* 取有数据的最后一天 */ FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_ods_kol_facebook_stats)) WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-02' AND '2026-05-31' AND ((SUBSTRING(post_created_time, 1, 10) <= logymd /* 只更新最近0-59天数据 */ AND SUBSTRING(post_created_time, 1, 10) >= '2026-04-02') OR (SUBSTRING(post_created_time, 1, 10) < '2023-12-20' AND logymd = '2026-05-31'))), last_day_result AS (/* 取最后一天的结果 */ SELECT * FROM base WHERE rn = 1), array_result AS (SELECT manager_id, page_id, post_id, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(impressions_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS impressions_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(impressions_paid_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS impressions_paid_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(impressions_unique_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS impressions_unique_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(impressions_paid_unique_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS impressions_paid_unique_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(views_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS views_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(views_paid_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS views_paid_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(views_unique_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS views_unique_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(views_paid_unique_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS views_paid_unique_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(comments_num_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS comments_num_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(shares_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS shares_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(likes_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS likes_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(reactions_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS reactions_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(avg_time_watched_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS avg_time_watched_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(post_media_view_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS pageviews_total_1_30_interval1_list, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(full_video_watched_rate_total_map), MIN(begin_date), 60) AS full_video_watched_rate_total_1_30_interval1_list FROM base GROUP BY manager_id, page_id, post_id), more_than_30_days AS (SELECT * FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_app_kol_post_stats_df)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND SUBSTRING(post_created_time, 1, 10) < '2026-04-02' /* 30天前创建的数据，不更新，只获取最新数据 */ AND platform = 'facebook') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_app_kol_post_stats_df)) SELECT a.manager_id, a.page_id, a.page_name, IF(SIZE(SPLIT(a.post_id, '_')) > 1, SPLIT(a.post_id, '_')[1], a.post_id) AS post_id, a.post_message, a.message_tags, a.is_hidden, a.post_created_time, a.permalink_url, a.media_type, a.video_length_str, a.video_length, a.video_id, IF(a.post_title = '-', '', a.post_title) AS post_title, impressions_total_1_30_interval1_list, impressions_paid_total_1_30_interval1_list, impressions_unique_total_1_30_interval1_list, impressions_paid_unique_total_1_30_interval1_list, views_total_1_30_interval1_list, views_paid_total_1_30_interval1_list, views_unique_total_1_30_interval1_list, views_paid_unique_total_1_30_interval1_list, comments_num_total_1_30_interval1_list, shares_total_1_30_interval1_list, likes_total_1_30_interval1_list, reactions_total_1_30_interval1_list, avg_time_watched_total_1_30_interval1_list, IF(media_type = 'video', video_id, SPLIT(a.post_id, '_')[1]) AS match_id /* 关联条件统一 */, NULL AS impression_sources, pageviews_total_1_30_interval1_list, full_video_watched_rate_total_1_30_interval1_list, NULL AS post_followers_total_1_30_interval1_list FROM last_day_result AS a JOIN , tb_name AS manta_tb_name --关联表名 */ /*          , monitor_name             --规则名称 */ /*          , monitor_type */ /*          , monitor_frequency */ /*          , rule_sql */ /*          , 0))                                 AS high_rule_timeout --强熔断质量监控报警最大超时（秒） */ FROM mt_ods.manta__watcher_quality_tasks_df WHERE `date` = '20260531' AND monitor_state = 'RUNNABLE'), t_mt_user AS IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-03-11', '2024-03-11', '2026-05-31')) AS t WHERE rn = 1 /* 对部门重复的人取唯一值 */), t_sla_task AS (SELECT table_name, task_id, sla_level, task_desc FROM mt_dwd.dwd_task_sla_df WHERE        t_lineage_info.task_id */, table_name, task_desc /*  , lineage_table_name */ /*  , lineage_task_id */, upstream_task_id, project_id /*      , t_task_info.task_id */, task_name, queue, t_task_info.task_name NOT LIKE '%impala2leap%' AND IF(task_type = 202 AND t_task_info.task_name NOT LIKE '%ods%', 1, 0) = 0 /* 排除掉shell任务 */), t_sla_task_all AS (/*         WHEN sla_level_id = 1 THEN 'P0' */ /*             ELSE 'unknown' END AS sla_level */ /*     FROM ( */ /*              SELECT upstream_task_id */ /*                   , MAX(CASE WHEN sla_level = 'P0' THEN 4 */ /*                              WHEN sla_level = 'P1' THEN 3 */ /*                              WHEN sla_level = 'P2' THEN 2 */ /*                              WHEN sla_level = 'P3' THEN 1 */ /*                              ELSE 0 END */ /*                  ) AS sla_level_id */ /*              FROM t_sla_task_info */ /*              GROUP BY upstream_task_id)  t */ SELECT task_id, CASE WHEN sla_level_id = 4 THEN 'P0' WHEN sla_level_id = 3 THEN 'P1' WHEN sla_level_id = 2 THEN 'P2' WHEN sla_level_id = 1 THEN 'P0' ELSE 'unknown' END AS sla_level, is_associate_sla,      , t_alarm.monitor_id */ /*      , t_alarm.monitor_name */, IF(alarm_form = 'webhook', 'webhook', COALESCE(t_alarm.monitor_receivers, 'unknown')) AS monitor_receivers, name: etl.msdk_ads.msdk_ads_gamebi_reten_ltv_df.device
sql_units: WITH active_info AS (SELECT app_id, did FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND did <> 'unknown' GROUP BY app_id, did), pay_info AS (SELECT charge_df.app_id, did, SUM(COALESCE(total_charge_amt, 0)) AS total_charge_amt FROM (SELECT did, app_id, total_charge_amt FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS charge_df GROUP BY charge_df.app_id, did), modify_data_all AS (SELECT basic.app_id, basic.createdate, basic.first_mt_country, basic.os, basic.stagename, basic.granularity_type, basic.appname, LOWER(first_network_name) AS first_network_name, COUNT(basic.did) AS dnu, SUM(IF(NOT active_info.did IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS active_user_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(pay_info.total_charge_amt, 0)) AS total_charge_amt FROM (SELECT ad.app_id, did, createdate, first_mt_country, os, stagename, appname, ad.first_media_source AS first_network_name, 'device' AS granularity_type FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_df AS ad JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT appname, stagename, CAST(stageid AS INT) AS app_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_app_info WHERE logymd = '20260531' AND is_online = 1) AS ap ON ap.app_id = ad.app_id WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND did <> 'unknown' AND os IN ('ios', 'android', 'unknown') AND createdate >= '2022-09-21') AS basic LEFT JOIN active_info ON basic.did = active_info.did AND basic.app_id = active_info.app_id LEFT JOIN pay_info ON basic.did = pay_info.did AND basic.app_id = pay_info.app_id GROUP BY basic.app_id, basic.createdate, basic.first_network_name, basic.os, basic.stagename, basic.appname, basic.granularity_type, basic.first_mt_country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_ads.msdk_ads_gamebi_reten_ltv_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname, stageid, granularity_type) /* device */ SELECT register_date, stagename, country, zoneid, os, first_network_name, amt_total_array, IF(SIZE(reten_cnt_arr) < 360, SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', reten_cnt_arr), RPAD('', (360 - SIZE(reten_cnt_arr)) * 2, ',0')), ','), reten_cnt_arr) AS reten_cnt, reten_cnt_arr, appname, stageid, granularity_type FROM (SELECT COALESCE(di.createdate, df.register_date) AS register_date, COALESCE(di.stagename, df.stagename) AS stagename, COALESCE(di.first_mt_country, df.country, 'unknown') AS country, -99999 AS zoneid, COALESCE(di.os, df.os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(LOWER(di.first_network_name), df.first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, ARRAY() AS amt_total_array, CASE WHEN df.stageid IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.dnu) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) /* 昨日=null，表示一定是当天新增的数据，因此第一位一定等于dnu */ ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.reten_cnt_arr), ',', COALESCE(di.active_user_cnt, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS reten_cnt_arr, COALESCE(di.appname, df.appname) AS appname, COALESCE(di.app_id, df.stageid) AS stageid, 'device' AS granularity_type FROM modify_data_all AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT register_date, stagename, country, zoneid, os, first_network_name, appname, stageid, granularity_type, reten_cnt_arr, reten_cnt FROM msdk_ads.msdk_ads_gamebi_reten_ltv_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND granularity_type = 'device') AS df ON di.createdate = df.register_date AND di.first_mt_country = df.country AND di.os = df.os AND di.app_id = df.stageid AND di.stagename = df.stagename AND di.appname = df.appname AND di.granularity_type = df.granularity_type AND di.first_network_name = df.first_network_name) AS t1

name: etl.msdk_ads.msdk_ads_gamebi_reten_ltv_df.role_zone
sql_units: WITH active_info AS (SELECT app_id, roleid, zoneid FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT roleid IS NULL AND NOT zoneid IS NULL GROUP BY app_id, roleid, zoneid), pay_info AS (SELECT pay_df.app_id, roleid, zoneid, SUM(COALESCE(total_pay_amt, 0)) AS total_charge_amt FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df AS pay_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT roleid IS NULL AND NOT zoneid IS NULL GROUP BY pay_df.app_id, roleid, zoneid), modify_data_all AS (SELECT basic.app_id, basic.createdate, COALESCE(basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, basic.os, basic.stagename, basic.granularity_type, basic.appname, basic.zoneid, COALESCE(LOWER(first_network_name), 'unknown') AS first_network_name, COUNT(basic.roleid, basic.zoneid) AS dnu, SUM(IF(NOT active_info.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS active_user_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(pay_info.total_charge_amt, 0)) AS total_charge_amt FROM (SELECT CAST(ad.appid AS INT) AS app_id, ad.roleid, ad.zoneid, createdate, first_mt_country, os, stagename, appname, ad.first_media_source AS first_network_name, 'role' AS granularity_type FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS ad JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT appname, stagename, CAST(stageid AS INT) AS app_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_app_info WHERE logymd = '20260531' AND is_online = 1) AS ap ON ap.app_id = ad.appid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT roleid IS NULL AND NOT zoneid IS NULL AND roleid <> '1740504972300378112' AND zoneid <> 'MSDK_ZoneId') AS basic LEFT JOIN active_info ON basic.roleid = active_info.roleid AND basic.zoneid = active_info.zoneid AND basic.app_id = active_info.app_id LEFT JOIN pay_info ON basic.roleid = pay_info.roleid AND basic.zoneid = pay_info.zoneid AND basic.app_id = pay_info.app_id GROUP BY basic.app_id, basic.createdate, basic.first_network_name, basic.os, basic.stagename, basic.appname, basic.zoneid, basic.granularity_type, basic.first_mt_country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_ads.msdk_ads_gamebi_reten_ltv_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname, stageid, granularity_type) /* device */ SELECT register_date, stagename, country, zoneid, os, first_network_name, amt_total_array, IF(SIZE(reten_cnt_arr) < 360, SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', reten_cnt_arr), RPAD('', (360 - SIZE(reten_cnt_arr)) * 2, ',0')), ','), reten_cnt_arr) AS reten_cnt, reten_cnt_arr, appname, stageid, granularity_type FROM (SELECT COALESCE(di.createdate, df.register_date) AS register_date, COALESCE(di.stagename, df.stagename) AS stagename, COALESCE(di.first_mt_country, df.country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(di.zoneid, df.zoneid, 'unknown') AS zoneid, COALESCE(di.os, df.os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(LOWER(di.first_network_name), df.first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, ARRAY() AS amt_total_array, CASE WHEN df.stageid IS NULL THEN CAST(ARRAY(di.dnu) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) /* 昨日=null，表示一定是当天新增的数据，因此第一位一定等于dnu */ ELSE CAST(SPLIT(CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', df.reten_cnt_arr), ',', COALESCE(di.active_user_cnt, 0)), ',') AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) END AS reten_cnt_arr, COALESCE(di.appname, df.appname) AS appname, COALESCE(di.app_id, df.stageid) AS stageid, 'role' AS granularity_type FROM modify_data_all AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT register_date, stagename, country, zoneid, os, first_network_name, appname, stageid, granularity_type, reten_cnt_arr, reten_cnt FROM msdk_ads.msdk_ads_gamebi_reten_ltv_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND granularity_type = 'role') AS df ON di.createdate = df.register_date AND di.first_mt_country = df.country AND di.os = df.os AND di.app_id = df.stageid AND di.stagename = df.stagename AND di.appname = df.appname AND di.granularity_type = df.granularity_type AND di.first_network_name = df.first_network_name AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid) AS t1

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_leap_task_monitor_standard_info_df

MAX(CASE WHEN monitor_type = '质量监控' AND alarm_form LIKE '%webhook%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_dqc_webhook /* 是否配置了质量监控为webhook */, MAX(CASE WHEN monitor_type = '运行监控' AND alarm_form LIKE '%webhook%' success_use_recovery_skill_cnt, t4.buyequiptime, t4.buyequipcount, t4.guide_buyequipcount, t4.avgapm * (battle_time / 60) AS battle_actions, t4.maxapm, t5.old_rookie_point AS roookid_score_bgefore_battle, t5.new_rookie_point AS roookid_score_after_battle, t5.ai_difficult, t.minranklevel, t.bigranklevel, t.rankstar, t6.rankid, t.scorerank AS scorerank_battleenddata, t1.ismvp AS ismvp_battle_end, t1.blacknum AS blacknum_battle_end, COALESCE(IF(t7.game_type IN (1, 5), t7.game_type, INT(t7.game_type + IF(t.iswin = 1, 0, 5))), -1) AS game_type, COALESCE(t8.kill3, -1) AS kill3, COALESCE(t8.kill4, -1) AS kill4, COALESCE(t8.kill5, -1) AS kill5 FROM (/* 战斗数据主表battleenddata */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 以及一些异常对局 */) AS t LEFT JOIN (/* 战斗信息表battle_end */ SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN select_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN select_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN select_road = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN select_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN select_road = 5 THEN '金币路' ELSE '-9999' END AS select_road_std, CASE WHEN real_road = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN real_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN real_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN real_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN real_road = 1 THEN '经验路' ELSE '-9999' END AS real_road_std, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */) AS t1 ON t.accountid = t1.accountid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t.battleid = t1.battleid AND t1.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */ LEFT JOIN (/* 玩家能力表playerability */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_playerability AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */) AS t2 ON t.accountid = t2.accountid AND t.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t.battleid = t2.battleid AND t2.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */ LEFT JOIN (/* 战斗分析表battle_analysis */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_battle_analysis AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */) AS t3 ON t.accountid = t3.accountid AND t.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND t.battleid = t3.battleid AND t3.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */ LEFT JOIN (/* 战斗能力表gameskill */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_gameskill AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */) AS t4 ON t.accountid = t4.accountid AND t.zoneid = t4.zoneid AND t.battleid = t4.battleid AND t4.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */ LEFT JOIN (/* 新手分表battle_rookie_point_change */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.battle_id ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_battle_rookie_point_change AS a JOIN newbie_t AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battle_id > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */) AS t5 ON t.accountid = t5.roleid AND t.zoneid = t5.zoneid AND t.battleid = t5.battle_id AND t5.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT rankid, bigrank, minrank, ranklevel FROM mt_dim.dim_ranked_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_ranked_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS t6 ON t.minranklevel = t6.minrank AND t.bigranklevel = t6.bigrank AND t.rankstar = t6.ranklevel LEFT JOIN ml_temp.dwm_mlbb_battle_game_type_di_yz AS t7 ON CAST(t.battleid AS STRING) = CAST(t7.battle_id AS STRING) AND t7.p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-06-01' LEFT JOIN (/* 战斗性能表 */ SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_battle_end AS a WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31') AS t8 ON t.accountid = t8.roleid AND t.zoneid = t8.zoneid AND t.battleid = t8.battleid AND t8.rank_time_desc = 1 /* 选择同一战斗人次的末次上报记录 */ WHERE t.rank_time_desc = 1), battle_real_usercnt_t AS (/* 计算本场真人数 */ SELECT a.battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.accountid, a.zoneid) AS real_players_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battleid FROM battle_detial_t) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */ AND LENGTH(a.battleid) >= 17 /* 剔除battleid长度10~12客户端温暖关 */ AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY a.battleid), battle_real_usercnt_camp_t AS (/* 计算己方真人数 */ SELECT a.battleid, a.wincamp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.accountid, a.zoneid) AS real_players_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battleid FROM battle_detial_t) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */ AND LENGTH(a.battleid) >= 17 /* 剔除battleid长度10~12客户端温暖关 */ AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY a.battleid, a.wincamp), battle_end_agg_t AS (/* 计算本场分路冲突情况 */ SELECT battleid, wincamp, if_pre_select_road_conflict, IF(select_road_unqiue_cnt = 5, 0, 1) AS if_pre_select_road_lack, if_real_road_conflict, IF(real_road_unqiue_cnt = 5, 0, 1) AS if_real_road_lack FROM (SELECT battleid, wincamp, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(select_road_std = '-9999', NULL, select_road_std)) AS select_road_unqiue_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(real_road_std = '-9999', NULL, real_road_std)) AS real_road_unqiue_cnt, LEAST(1, COUNT(IF(select_road_std = '-9999', NULL, select_road_std)) - COUNT(DISTINCT IF(select_road_std = '-9999', NULL, select_road_std))) AS if_pre_select_road_conflict /* 如果有-9999以外的重复分路为1，如无为0 */, LEAST(1, COUNT(IF(real_road_std = '-9999', NULL, real_road_std)) - COUNT(DISTINCT IF(real_road_std = '-9999', NULL, real_road_std))) AS if_real_road_conflict /* 如果有-9999以外的重复分路为1，如无为0 */ FROM (SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN select_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN select_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN select_road = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN select_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN select_road = 5 THEN '金币路' ELSE '-9999' END AS select_road_std, CASE WHEN real_road = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN real_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN real_road = 3 THEN '游走' WHEN real_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN real_road = 1 THEN '经验路' ELSE '-9999' END AS real_road_std, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rank_time_desc /* 对同一用户战斗去重 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT battleid, iswin FROM battle_detial_t) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.wincamp = b.iswin WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */ AND LENGTH(a.battleid) >= 17 /* 剔除battleid长度10~12客户端温暖关 */) AS t1 WHERE rank_time_desc = 1 GROUP BY battleid, wincamp) AS a) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.dwd_wmz_education_ab_battle_info_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t.roleid /* roleid */, t.zoneid /* zoneid */, t.create_country /* 创角国家 */, t.create_os /* 创角系统 */, t.first_ad_country /* 首次广告归因国家 */, t.last_ad_country /* 末次广告归因国家 */, t.new_type /* 新增类型 */, t2.newbie_tag /* 新手标签 */, t2.heroid_tag /* 标签英雄 */, t2.tag_datediff /* 创角后第N天打的标签 */, t.register_date /* 创角日期 */, t.register_days /* 注册天数 */, t1.max_level AS LEVEL /* 当天最高等级 */, t3.his_max_rank_id /* 截止当天最高段位id */, t3.his_max_minranklvl /* 截止当天最高小段位 */, t3.his_max_bigranklvl /* 截止当天最高大段位 */, t3.his_first_achieve3_time_bigranklvl /* 近30天第一次达到次大师的时间(rank_level) */, t3.his_first_achieve4_time_bigranklvl /* 近30天第一次达到次宗师的时间(rank_level) */, t3.his_first_achieve5_time_bigranklvl /* 近30天第一次达到次史诗的时间(rank_level) */, t4.time /* 战斗上报时间 */, t4.battleid /* battleid */, t4.if_exist_battle_end_data /* 在battle_end表中是否战斗数据 */, t4.if_exist_playerability_data /* 在playerability表中是否战斗数据 */, t4.if_exist_battle_analysis_data /* 在battle_analysis表中是否战斗数据 */, t4.if_exist_battle_gameskill_data /* 在battle_gameskill表中是否战斗数据 */, t4.if_exist_rookie_socre_data /* 在rookie_socre表中是否战斗数据 */, t4.pvptype /* pvptype */, t4.realpvptype /* realpvptype */, t4.battle_time /* 战斗时长 */, t6.if_pre_select_road_conflict /* 己方预选分路是否有冲突 */, t6.if_pre_select_road_lack /* 己方预选分路是否有空缺 */, t6.if_real_road_conflict /* 己方实际分路是否冲突 */, t6.if_real_road_lack /* 己方实际分路是否空缺 */, t4.battlesvrid /* battle组 */, t5.real_players_cnt /* 本场对局真人数 */, t4.bigranklevel_before_battle /* 战斗前大段位 */, t4.minranklevel_before_battle /* 战斗前小段位 */, t4.level_before_battle /* 战斗前等级 */, t4.heroid /* 英雄id */, t4.blacknum /* 开黑人数 */, t4.iswin /* 是否胜利 */, t4.icamp /* 阵营 */, t4.score /* score分 */, t4.killnum /* 击杀人数 */, t4.dead /* 死亡数 */, t4.assist /* 助攻数 */, t4.campkill /* 团战击杀人数 */, t4.gold /* 获得金钱 */, t4.if_pre_select_road_precise /* 本局是否分路准确 */, t4.real_road /* 本局实际分路 */, t4.get_tower_layer_gold /* 塔皮获取值 */, t4.atktower /* 对建筑伤害 */, t4.team_atktower /* 团队对建筑伤害 */, t4.hurt_all /* 对英雄伤害 */, t4.team_dmg /* 团队对英雄伤害 */, t4.behurt_all /* 承受英雄伤害 */, t4.team_behurt /* 团队承受英雄伤害 */, t4.soldier_glod_6min /* 前6min来自小兵经济 */, t4.jungle_glod_6min /* 前6min来自野怪经济 */, t4.kill_assist_glod_6min /* 前6min来自击杀/助攻经济 */, t4.delay_time_buy_equip /* 前Nmin装备购买延迟 */, t4.buyequiptime /* 购买装备总延迟 */, t4.buyequipcount /* 购买装备次数 */, t4.guide_buyequipcount /* 自动购买装备次数 */, t4.castskill /* 总释放技能次数 */, t4.operateskill /* 拖拽技能次数 */, t4.skill_hero_cnt /* 技能命中英雄次数 */, t4.battle_actions /* 通过分均计算总apm */, t4.maxapm /* 最大apm */, t4.act_cnt /* 普攻总次数 */, t4.act_6min_cnt /* 前6分钟普攻次数 */, t4.act35_6min /* 前6分钟远距离（大于3.5码）普攻次数 */, t4.act35 /* 远距离（大于3.5码）普攻次数 */, t4.act_c /* 释放普攻时，所有技能在冷却中的次数 */, t4.hurtad /* ad伤害 */, t4.hurtap /* ap伤害 */, t4.hurtatk /* 承受ad伤害 */, t4.hurtreal /* 承受ap伤害 */, t4.controlrate /* 硬控分数 */, t4.slowrate /* 减分分数 */, t4.shenguiskill /* 神龟击杀数（个人） */, t4.lingzhuskill /* 领主击杀数（个人） */, t4.recall_cnt /* 回城次数 */, t4.success_use_recovery_skill_cnt /* 成功使用回复次数 */, t4.roookid_score_bgefore_battle /* 新手分(前） */, t4.roookid_score_after_battle /* 新手分(后） */, t4.deadnumbytower /* 被防御塔击杀次数 */, t4.select_road_std /* 预选分路 */, t4.skillid /* 携带战场技能id */, t4.ai_difficult /* AI难度(battle_rookie_point_change表） */, t4.minranklevel /* 小段位 */, t4.bigranklevel /* 大段位 */, t4.rankstar /* 段位星数 */, t4.rankid /* 携带战场技能id */, t4.scorerank_battleenddata /* 己方socre分排名 */, t4.ismvp_battle_end /* 是否mvp */, t7.real_players_cnt AS camp_real_players_cnt /* 己方真人数 */, t8.real_players_cnt AS enemy_real_players_cnt /* 对方真人数 */, t4.blacknum_battle_end /* battle_end中开黑数 */, t4.game_type, t4.kill3, t4.kill4, t4.kill5 FROM newbie_t AS t LEFT JOIN lvl AS t1 /* 等级 */ ON t.roleid = t1.roleid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN tag AS t2 /* 新手标签 */ ON t.roleid = t2.roleid AND t.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN max_rank AS t3 /* 段位 */ ON t.roleid = t3.roleid AND t.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle_detial_t AS t4 /* 战斗明细 */ ON t.roleid = t4.accountid AND t.zoneid = t4.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle_real_usercnt_t AS t5 /* 真人数 */ ON t4.battleid = t5.battleid LEFT JOIN battle_end_agg_t AS t6 /* 分路冲突 */ ON t4.battleid = t6.battleid AND t4.iswin = t6.wincamp LEFT JOIN battle_real_usercnt_camp_t AS t7 /* 己方真人数 */ ON t4.battleid = t7.battleid AND t4.iswin = t7.wincamp LEFT JOIN battle_real_usercnt_camp_t AS t8 /* 敌方真人数 */ ON t4.battleid = t8.battleid AND t4.iswin = 1 - t8.wincamp

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_ban_role_zone_battle_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-04-19 14:18:26.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH bansuccess AS (SELECT op_zoneid AS zoneid, CAST(SPLIT(SPLIT(op_req_param, '\\073')[0], ':')[1] AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) AS accountid, logymd AS dt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_bgip_command_process WHERE command_name = 'PunishRole' AND app_id = '6571' AND SPLIT(SPLIT(op_req_param, '\\073')[1], ':')[1] = '1003' AND SPLIT(SPLIT(op_req_param, '\\073')[2], ':')[1] = '1' AND SPLIT(SPLIT(op_req_param, '\\073')[6], ':')[1] = '1' AND op_res_result = 'success' AND logymd = '2026-05-30' AND op_ret = 0 GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, logymd), t1 AS (SELECT IF(roleid IS NULL, CAST(SPLIT(cmd_param, ' ')[0] AS DECIMAL(20, 0)), roleid) AS roleid, zoneid, logymd AS dt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_gmcmd WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND cmd_name = 'ban_login' AND cmd_ret = 0 AND CAST(SPLIT(cmd_param, ' ')[2] AS BIGINT) = 1 AND CAST(SPLIT(cmd_param, ' ')[1] AS BIGINT) >= 157680000 GROUP BY IF(roleid IS NULL, CAST(SPLIT(cmd_param, ' ')[0] AS DECIMAL(20, 0)), roleid), zoneid, logymd), t2 AS (SELECT a.op_accountid AS roleid, a.op_zoneid AS zoneid, dt FROM (SELECT op_accountid, op_zoneid, risk_type, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_bgip_gpsdk_antiplugin WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND is_notpunish = 0 AND punish_info_id = 1003 AND operate_type = 1 AND ban_time = 946080000 GROUP BY op_accountid, op_zoneid, risk_type, logymd) AS a JOIN bansuccess AS b ON a.op_accountid = b.accountid AND a.op_zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.logymd = b.dt GROUP BY a.op_accountid, a.op_zoneid, dt) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.roleid_zoneid_blocked_list_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, dt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, dt FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, dt FROM t2) AS a

/* 第二部分 */ /* dt>='2020-03-12' and dt<'2022-08-25' */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_ban_role_zone_battle_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30', appid = 'mlbb') /* dt<'2018-03-18' 无战斗相关信息 */ SELECT tx.roleid, tx.zoneid, COALESCE(SUBSTRING(ty.time, 0, 19), CONCAT(tx.dt, ' 00:00:00')) AS TIME, device, createrole_country, client_ip, client_ver, battleid, logincountry, md5error, stampsize, pingstate1, pingstate2, ban_reason, COALESCE(ty.type, 0) AS type FROM (SELECT * FROM bi_test.roleid_zoneid_blocked_list_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS tx LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.roleid /* BROADCASTJOIN(t1) */, t1.zoneid, COALESCE(SUBSTRING(t2.time, 0, 19), CONCAT(dt, ' 00:00:00')) AS TIME, deviceinfo AS device, NULL AS createrole_country, ip AS client_ip, client_version AS client_ver, battleid AS battleid, NULL AS logincountry, NULL AS md5error, NULL AS stampsize, NULL AS pingstate1, NULL AS pingstate2, res_error AS ban_reason, 2 AS type FROM (SELECT * FROM bi_test.roleid_zoneid_blocked_list_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t1 JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, TIME, deviceinfo, ip, client_version, battleid, res_error FROM ml_ods.connserver_resource_diff WHERE logymd >= ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-30', -3) AND logymd <= '2026-05-30') AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid UNION ALL SELECT t1.roleid /* BROADCASTJOIN(t1) */, t1.zoneid, COALESCE(SUBSTRING(t2.time, 0, 19), CONCAT(dt, ' 00:00:00')) AS TIME, device, createrole_country, client_ip, client_version AS client_ver, battleid AS battleid, NULL AS logincountry, NULL AS md5error, NULL AS stampsize, NULL AS pingstate1, NULL AS pingstate2, res_error AS ban_reason, 1 AS type FROM (SELECT * FROM bi_test.roleid_zoneid_blocked_list_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t1 JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, TIME, device, createrole_country, client_ip, client_version, battleid, res_error FROM ml_ods.gameserver_server_resource_diff WHERE logymd >= ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-30', -3) AND logymd <= '2026-05-30') AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid UNION ALL SELECT t1.roleid /* BROADCASTJOIN(t1) */, t1.zoneid, COALESCE(SUBSTRING(t2.time, 0, 19), CONCAT(dt, ' 00:00:00')) AS TIME, clientdevice, createrole_country, clientip AS client_ip, clientversion AS client_ver, battleid AS battleid, logincountry AS logincountry, md5error AS md5error, stampsize, pingstate1, pingstate2, check_content AS ban_reason, 3 AS type FROM (SELECT * FROM bi_test.roleid_zoneid_blocked_list_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t1 JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, TIME, clientdevice, NULL AS createrole_country, clientip, clientversion, battleid, logincountry, md5error, stampsize, pingstate1, pingstate2, check_content FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_plugin_check WHERE logymd >= ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-30', -3) AND logymd <= '2026-05-30') AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid) AS ty ON ty.roleid = tx.roleid AND ty.zoneid = tx.zoneid
