sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: aprilgao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-08-02 16:07:15.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH mc_create /* mc创角新增 */ AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime /* 账号创建时间 */, usercreateymd /* 账号创建年月日 */, os_type /* 操作系统 */, channel /* 渠道 */, os_language /* 操作系统语言 */, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS ip_country /* 玩家的id地址解析的国家，因为上游T+1表这时候还没有，且上游国家归因到多层匹配处理，先用这个替代 */ FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_create_role /* 创角表 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 20000 AND is_vp = 0 AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime /* 账号创建时间 */, usercreateymd /* 账号创建年月日 */, os_type /* 操作系统 */, channel /* 渠道 */, os_language /* 操作系统语言 */, ip_country), mlbb_install AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_client_appinstall WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND LOWER(appname) = 'mlbb' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT DISTINCT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.usercreatetime /* 账号创建时间 */, t1.usercreateymd /* 账号创建年月日 */, t1.os_type /* 操作系统 */, t1.channel /* 渠道 */, t1.os_language /* 操作系统语言 */, t1.ip_country, CASE WHEN NOT t3.accountid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ml_install /* 是否安装了ML */ FROM mc_create AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN mlbb_install AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jichun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-08-07 11:21:13.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH holiday_social_events AS (SELECT event_date, event_type, country, subdivision_type, CONCAT_WS('&', COLLECT_SET(event_name)) AS event_name FROM (SELECT area_date AS event_date, '假期社会事件' AS event_type, CASE WHEN area IN ('印度尼西亚', '印尼') THEN 'id' WHEN area = '菲律宾' THEN 'ph' WHEN area = '缅甸' THEN 'mm' WHEN area = '马来西亚' THEN 'my' ELSE 'all' END AS country, event_type AS subdivision_type, concise_event AS event_name FROM ml_temp.lark2hive_area_event_ls WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND area IN ('印度尼西亚', '菲律宾', '缅甸', '马来西亚', '印尼')) GROUP BY event_date, event_type, country, subdivision_type), operational_activity_events AS (SELECT DISTINCT event_date, event_type, country, subdivision_type, event_name FROM (SELECT event_date, '运营活动' AS event_type, 'all' AS country, CONCAT_WS('：', actv_type, SPLIT(IF(event_name LIKE '%【%】%', REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_name, '【[^】]+】(?:【[^】]+】)*(.*)'), event_name), '\n')[0]) AS subdivision_type, event_name FROM (SELECT logymd, server_date AS event_date, '运营活动' AS event_type, 'all' AS country, CASE WHEN actv_type = '无信息' THEN actv_name WHEN actv_type LIKE '%-%' THEN SPLIT(actv_type, '-')[1] ELSE actv_type END AS actv_type, IF(NOT actv_title IS NULL AND actv_title <> '' AND LENGTH(actv_title) > 0, actv_title, actv_name) AS event_name FROM ml_temp.lark2hive_mlbb_biz_actv_ls WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND actv_level = 'S'))), version_season_events AS (SELECT event_date, event_type, country, subdivision_type, event_name FROM (SELECT beijing_date AS event_date, '版本赛季' AS event_type, 'all' AS country, CASE WHEN info_type IN ('版更', '版本') AND number_date IN ('版更日', '首日') THEN '版更' WHEN info_type = '赛季' AND number_date = '首日' THEN '赛季开始' WHEN info_type = '赛季' AND number_date = '结算日' THEN '赛季结算' ELSE 'unknown' END AS subdivision_type, concise_info AS event_name FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY beijing_date ORDER BY LENGTH(concise_info)) AS rn FROM ml_temp.lark2hive_mlbb_version_seaon_ls WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND number_date IN ('版更日', '首日', '结算日')) WHERE rn = 1) WHERE subdivision_type <> '版更' UNION ALL /* 版本临时表，后续考虑从飞书日历中走接口获取 */ SELECT event_date, event_type, country, subdivision_type, event_name FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_version_temp WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_calendar_event PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT event_date, event_type, country, subdivision_type, event_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_type, country, event_date, subdivision_type, event_name) AS event_id FROM (SELECT event_date, event_type, country, subdivision_type, event_name FROM holiday_social_events UNION ALL SELECT event_date, event_type, country, subdivision_type, event_name FROM operational_activity_events UNION ALL SELECT event_date, event_type, country, subdivision_type, event_name FROM version_season_events)

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: celiaye@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-08-08 11:00:08.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task <> 1 AND issurrender = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND pvptype = 2 AND fake_ai = 0 AND realpvptype IN (22, 96, 97, 2, 59, 90, 1) GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) = 10) AS a JOIN (SELECT b.battleid)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.celiaye_teamfight_nobattlescale PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* main.logymd, */ SELECT main.ranks, main.heroid, config.hero_name, config.heroes AS heroclass, main.road_sort, starttime, SUM(fightnum) AS fightnum /* battlescale, */ /* battlelocation, */, SUM(total.totalbattle) AS totalbattle, SUM(total_damage) AS total_damage, SUM(kill_num) AS kill_num, SUM(dead_num) AS dead_num, SUM(assist_num) AS assist_num, SUM(total_behurt) AS total_behurt, SUM(total_cure) AS total_cure, SUM(total_cure_self) AS total_cure_self, SUM(total_control) AS total_control, SUM(becontroltime) AS becontroltime, SUM(movedistance) AS movedistance FROM (SELECT logymd, ranks, heroid, road_sort, starttime /* battlescale, battlelocation, */, COUNT(DISTINCT a.battleid, a.fightid) AS fightnum, SUM(total_damage) AS total_damage, SUM(kill_num) AS kill_num, SUM(dead_num) AS dead_num, SUM(assist_num) AS assist_num, SUM(total_behurt) AS total_behurt, SUM(total_cure) AS total_cure, SUM(total_cure_self) AS total_cure_self, SUM(total_control) AS total_control, SUM(becontroltime) AS becontroltime, SUM(movedistance) AS movedistance FROM (SELECT logymd, battleid, fightid, heroid, CASE WHEN roadsort = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN roadsort = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN roadsort = 1 OR roadsort = 5 THEN '领主路' WHEN roadsort = 101 OR roadsort = 105 THEN '神龟路' WHEN roadsort = 0 THEN '未知' WHEN roadsort LIKE '3%' THEN '游走' END AS road_sort, CASE WHEN fightstart / 60000 BETWEEN 0 AND 2 THEN '1.[0-2min]' WHEN fightstart / 60000 <= 5 THEN '2.(2,5min]' WHEN fightstart / 60000 <= 8 THEN '3.(5,8min]' WHEN fightstart / 60000 <= 12 THEN '4.(8,12min]' WHEN fightstart / 60000 <= 18 THEN '5.(12,18min]' ELSE '6.18min+' END AS starttime, SPLIT(SPLIT(damage, '\\073')[1], ':')[1] AS total_damage /* CASE WHEN (fight_heronum_a = 1 AND fight_heronum_b = 1) OR (fight_heronum_a = 2 AND fight_heronum_b = 2) THEN 'a.小规模均势' */ /*     WHEN (icamp = 1 AND fight_heronum_a = 1 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 2 AND 3) OR (icamp = 2 AND fight_heronum_b = 1 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 2 AND 3) THEN 'b.小规模劣势' */ /*     WHEN (icamp = 2 AND fight_heronum_a = 1 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 2 AND 3) OR (icamp = 1 AND fight_heronum_b = 1 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 2 AND 3) THEN 'c.小规模优势' */ /*     WHEN (fight_heronum_a = 3 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 2 AND 4) OR (fight_heronum_b = 3 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 2 AND 4) THEN 'd.中规模均势' */ /*     WHEN (icamp = 1 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 4 AND 5) OR (icamp = 2 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 4 AND 5) THEN 'e.中规模劣势' */ /*     WHEN (icamp = 2 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 4 AND 5) OR (icamp = 1 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 4 AND 5) THEN 'f.中规模优势' */ /*     WHEN (fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 4 AND 5) AND (fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 4 AND 5) THEN 'g.大规模均势' */ /*     WHEN (icamp = 1 AND fight_heronum_a = 3 AND fight_heronum_b = 5) OR (icamp = 2 AND fight_heronum_b = 3 AND fight_heronum_a = 5) THEN 'h.大规模劣势' */ /*     WHEN (icamp = 2 AND fight_heronum_a = 3 AND fight_heronum_b = 5) OR (icamp = 1 AND fight_heronum_b = 3 AND fight_heronum_a = 5) THEN 'i.大规模优势' */ /*     ELSE 'j.其它' END AS battlescale, --团战规模 */ /* CASE WHEN isturretbattle = 1 THEN 'a.塔下or高地团' */ /*	 WHEN isturtlebattle = 1 THEN 'b.神龟团' */ /*	 WHEN islordbattle = 1 THEN 'c.领主团' */ /*	 ELSE 'd.其它团' END AS battlelocation, --团战发生位置 */, LENGTH(kills) - LENGTH(REPLACE(kills, ',', '')) AS kill_num, CASE WHEN endhp = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS dead_num, LENGTH(assists) - LENGTH(REPLACE(assists, ',', '')) AS assist_num, SPLIT(SPLIT(behurt, '\\073')[0], ':')[1] AS total_behurt, SPLIT(SPLIT(cure, '\\073')[0], ':')[1] AS total_cure, SPLIT(SPLIT(cure, '\\073')[1], ':')[1] AS total_cure_self, SPLIT(SPLIT(controlrate, '\\073')[0], ':')[1] AS total_control, becontroltime, movedistance FROM t WHERE dead_heronum_a + dead_heronum_b > 0) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT battleid, CASE WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 10 THEN '勇士' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 21 THEN '精英' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 37 THEN '大师' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 62 THEN '宗师' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 87 THEN 'a.史诗' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 112 THEN 'b.传奇' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 137 THEN 'c.神话' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 162 THEN 'd.百战神话' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 212 THEN 'e.荣耀神话' ELSE 'f.至尊神话' END AS ranks FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND battletype = 2 GROUP BY battleid) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY logymd, ranks, heroid, road_sort, starttime /* , battlescale, battlelocation */) AS main LEFT JOIN (/* 计算英雄总对局次数 */ SELECT logymd, d.ranks, heroid, CASE WHEN roadsort = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN roadsort = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN roadsort = 1 OR roadsort = 5 THEN '领主路' WHEN roadsort = 101 OR roadsort = 105 THEN '神龟路' WHEN roadsort = 0 THEN '未知' WHEN roadsort LIKE '3%' THEN '游走' END AS road_sort, COUNT(DISTINCT c.battleid) AS totalbattle FROM (SELECT * FROM t WHERE dead_heronum_a + dead_heronum_b > 0) AS c LEFT JOIN (SELECT battleid, CASE WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 10 THEN '勇士' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 21 THEN '精英' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 37 THEN '大师' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 62 THEN '宗师' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 87 THEN 'a.史诗' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 112 THEN 'b.传奇' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 137 THEN 'c.神话' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 162 THEN 'd.百战神话' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 212 THEN 'e.荣耀神话' ELSE 'f.至尊神话' END AS ranks FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND battletype = 2 GROUP BY battleid) AS d ON c.battleid = d.battleid GROUP BY logymd, d.ranks, heroid, road_sort) AS total ON main.logymd = total.logymd AND main.ranks = total.ranks AND main.heroid = total.heroid AND main.road_sort = total.road_sort LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_hero_config AS config /* 英雄配置表 */ ON main.heroid = config.heroid /* main.logymd, */ GROUP BY main.ranks, main.heroid, config.hero_name, config.heroes, main.road_sort, starttime /* ,battlescale */ /* ,battlelocation */

sql_units: WITH battle_intimacy /* HAVING  total_intimacy > 0 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.friend_role_id, a.friend_zone_id, SUM(IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL, intimacy, 0)) AS total_intimacy, SUM(intimacy) AS total_intimacy_undirected FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id, roomid, SUM(CASE WHEN battle_type = 2 THEN 6 WHEN battle_type = 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) AS intimacy /* 亲密度功能的计算方式 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_battle_with_friend WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id, roomid) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, invited_roleid AS friend_role_id, invited_zoneid AS friend_zone_id, roomid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_invite_room WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, invited_roleid, invited_zoneid, roomid UNION SELECT invite_roleid AS roleid, invite_zoneid AS zoneid, accountid AS friend_role_id /* accountid是被预约方 */, zoneid AS friend_zone_id, roomid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_preinvited WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND enterroom > 0 GROUP BY invite_roleid, invite_zoneid, accountid, zoneid, roomid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.friend_role_id = b.friend_role_id AND a.friend_zone_id = b.friend_zone_id AND a.roomid = b.roomid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.friend_role_id, a.friend_zone_id), gift_intimacy AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id, SUM(intimacy) AS total_intimacy FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, dst_roleid AS friend_role_id, dst_zoneid AS friend_zone_id, SUM(IF(gift_dia_val = 0, gift_num, gift_dia_val)) / 10 AS intimacy /* 免费礼物按1钻石计算 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_social_send_gift WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, dst_roleid, dst_zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id, SUM(imtimacy) AS intimacy FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_friend_intimacy WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND battle_type IN (9996, 9999) /* 9995和9998是收礼方 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_da.social_intimacy_role_wi PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(a.friend_role_id, b.friend_role_id) AS friend_role_id, COALESCE(a.friend_zone_id, b.friend_zone_id) AS friend_zone_id, CAST(MAX(COALESCE(a.total_intimacy, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS battle_intimacy, CAST(MAX(COALESCE(a.total_intimacy_undirected, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS battle_intimacy_undirected, CAST(MAX(COALESCE(b.total_intimacy, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS gift_intimacy FROM battle_intimacy AS a FULL OUTER JOIN gift_intimacy AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.friend_role_id = b.friend_role_id AND a.friend_zone_id = b.friend_zone_id GROUP BY COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid), COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid), COALESCE(a.friend_role_id, b.friend_role_id), COALESCE(a.friend_zone_id, b.friend_zone_id)

0) AS pay_cnt_period, COALESCE(b.online_time, 0) AS online_dur /*	当日玩家总在线时长(单位：s) */, 0 AS new_active_cnt /*	新用户活跃玩家数 */, 0 AS register_cnt_total /*	历史总注册玩家数 */, 0 AS lose_cnt_7ds /*	7日流失玩家数 */, 0 AS active_cnt_7ds /*	7日前DAU */, 0 AS lose_cnt_30ds /*	30日流失玩家数 */, 0 AS active_cnt_30ds /*	30日前DAU */, IF(LOWER(b.network) = 'organic', 1, 2) AS network_group, 1 AS user_type, 'unknown' AS channel, -99999 AS new_type, -99999 AS install_label, -99999 AS arcade_label, -99999 AS active_label, 0 AS recurring_cnt_14days, 0 AS nologin_cnt_14days, ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) AS recurring_14days_reten_cnt, 0 AS actual_pay_amt, NULL AS active_cnt_90days, NULL AS vaild_user_cnt, NULL AS vaild_user_online_dur, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, a.appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'daily' AS date_type FROM (SELECT country_code AS country, appname FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_country) /* 取最新 */ AND startdate <= '2026-05-31' AND NOT appname IN ('mlbb', 'zgame', 'mla', 'nova', 'mcgg_v2', 'wegame', 'mlbb_v2', 'wefly5', 'aoz') AND is_online = 1 AND definition_type = 0 GROUP BY country_code, appname) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(network, 'unknown') AS network, COALESCE(SUM(register_cnt), 0) AS register_cnt, 0 AS pure_register_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt), 0) AS active_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt_30days), 0) AS active_cnt_30days, COALESCE(SUM(pay_cnt), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt), 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate, logymd, appname, COALESCE(SUM(online_time), 0) AS online_time FROM (SELECT bd.app_id, ap.appname, COALESCE(LOWER(first_mt_country), 'unknown') AS country, bd.os, COALESCE(LOWER(first_network_name), 'unknown') AS network, SUM(IF(createdate = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS register_cnt, SUM(is_td) AS active_cnt, SUM(is_30d) AS active_cnt_30days, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.account_id) AS pay_cnt /* 付费人数 */, SUM(day_pay_amt) AS pay_amt, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, SUM(COALESCE(lout.online_time, 0)) AS online_time FROM (SELECT app_id, account_id, first_mt_country, os, first_media_source AS first_network_name, createdate FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-02-06' THEN NOT app_id IN (4200) ELSE NOT app_id IN (4460) END /* xgame */) AS bd LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, app_id, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_td, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_30d FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_account_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-02-06' THEN NOT app_id IN (4200) ELSE NOT app_id IN (4460) END /* xgame */ GROUP BY account_id, app_id) AS ad ON ad.app_id = bd.app_id AND ad.account_id = bd.account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT m__role_id AS roleid, '4460' AS app_id, LEAST(SUM(COALESCE(online_time, 0)), 24 * 60 * 60) AS online_time FROM xgame_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-02-06' GROUP BY m__role_id) AS lout ON ad.app_id = lout.app_id AND ad.account_id = lout.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, app_id, SUM(day_charge_sum) AS day_pay_amt FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-02-06' THEN NOT app_id IN (4200) ELSE NOT app_id IN (4460) END /* xgame */ GROUP BY account_id, app_id) AS pay ON bd.app_id = pay.app_id AND bd.account_id = pay.account_id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(appname) AS appname, stagename, stageid AS app_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_app_info WHERE logymd = IF('20260531' <= '20250106', '20250106', '20260531') AND CASE WHEN logymd >= '20260206' THEN NOT stageid IN (4200) ELSE NOT stageid IN (4460) END /* xgame */ AND is_online = 1) AS ap ON ap.app_id = bd.app_id GROUP BY bd.app_id, ap.appname, COALESCE(LOWER(first_mt_country), 'unknown'), bd.os, COALESCE(LOWER(first_network_name), 'unknown')) GROUP BY COALESCE(country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(os, 'unknown'), COALESCE(network, 'unknown'), logymd, appname) AS b ON a.country = b.country AND a.appname = b.appname

max_intimacy, MIN(CAST(intimacy AS BIGINT)) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid) AS min_intimacy FROM ml_temp.leavyliu_social_lost_friendlist_v2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'))) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE algo, roleid, zoneid, CONCAT(dest_roleid, ',', dest_zoneid) AS friend_key, CAST(intimacy_final AS DOUBLE) AS intimacy_final, CAST(back_score AS DOUBLE) AS back_score, CAST(final_score AS DOUBLE) AS      PARTITION BY */ /*                     roleid, */ /*                     zoneid */ /*             ORDER BY */ /*                     intimacy_final DESC, */ /*                     dest_roleid, */ name: 新手大盘战斗监控ads_wmz_newbie_whole_bt_di表
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_da.ads_wmz_newbie_whole_bt_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 冲突率、匹配时长、对局类型 */ SELECT a.bigranklvl, a.pvptype, a.realpvptype, a.battle_group, -1 AS if_5realplayer, c.real_players_cnt, b.season, b.season_first_date, b.season_end_date, zone_gp, SUM(battle_camp_cnt) AS battle_camp_cnt, SUM(`缺失阵营数`) AS lack_battle_camp_cnt, SUM(`分路合理阵营数`) AS correct_battle_camp_cnt, SUM(`冲突阵营数`) AS conflict_battle_camp_cnt, SUM(a.matchtime) AS matchtime, SUM(a.PlayNum) AS battle_user_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT a.battleid) AS battle_cnt /* percentile_approx(matchtime_median2, 0.5) AS matchtime_median, */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(INT(a.game_type) = 1, a.battleid, NULL)) AS game_type1 /* `跌宕局数` */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(INT(a.game_type) = 5, a.battleid, NULL)) AS game_type5 /* `均衡局数` */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(INT(a.game_type) = 2, a.battleid, NULL)) AS game_type2 /* `翻盘局数` */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(INT(a.game_type) = 3, a.battleid, NULL)) AS game_type3 /* `碾压局数` */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(INT(a.game_type) = 4, a.battleid, NULL)) AS game_type4 /* `小优局数` */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.game_type IS NULL, a.battleid, NULL)) AS null_game_type /* `无类型局数` */ FROM (SELECT logymd, pvptype, realpvptype, battle_group, game_type, t.battleid, zone_gp, MAX(bigranklvl) AS bigranklvl, MAX(PlayNum) AS camp_max_PlayNum, SUM(1) AS battle_camp_cnt, -1 AS `缺失阵营数`, SUM(IF(t1.if_correct_road = 1, 1, 0)) AS `分路合理阵营数`, SUM(IF(t1.if_conflict = 1, 1, 0)) AS `冲突阵营数`, SUM(t.matchtime) AS matchtime, SUM(PlayNum) AS PlayNum FROM (SELECT logymd, pvptype, realpvptype, battle_group, battleid, wincamp, game_type, zone_gp, MAX(bigranklvl) AS bigranklvl, SUM(PlayNum) AS PlayNum, SUM(matchtime) AS matchtime /*     percentile_approx(matchtime_median1, 0.5) AS matchtime_median2 */ FROM (SELECT t.logymd, t.pvptype, t.realpvptype, FLOOR(t.battlesvrid / 1000) AS battle_group, t.battleid, t.wincamp, t2.game_type /* 局势8分类（1跌宕2翻盘3碾压4小优5均衡7被翻盘8被碾压9小劣） */, t.real_road, IF(t.zoneid >= 57000, '测服', '正式服') AS zone_gp, MAX(t.bigranklvl) AS bigranklvl, MAX(t.bigranklvl) AS MaxBigRankLv, COUNT(DISTINCT t.accountid) AS PlayNum, SUM(t1.matchtime) AS matchtime /* percentile_approx(matchtime, 0.5) AS matchtime_median1 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.matchtime FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end AS a WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' /* 部分对局匹配与战斗结束日期存在一天误差 */ AND a.success = 1) AS t1 ON t.accountid = t1.accountid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t.battleid = t1.battleid LEFT JOIN ml_temp.dwm_mlbb_battle_game_type_di_yz AS t2 ON t1.battleid = t2.battle_id AND t2.p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-31' AND '2026-06-01' /* 当天战斗会出现在推迟一天的分区中 */ WHERE t.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     t.zoneid < 57000 */ t.pvptype IN (1, 2) AND t.os_type <> 0 AND t.fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY t.logymd, t.pvptype, t.realpvptype, battle_group, t.battleid, t.wincamp, t.real_road, game_type, zone_gp) AS a GROUP BY logymd, pvptype, realpvptype, battle_group, battleid, wincamp, game_type, zone_gp) AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT battleid, wincamp, LEAST(1, COUNT(IF(real_road <> 0, real_road, NULL)) - COUNT(DISTINCT IF(real_road <> 0, real_road, NULL))) AS if_conflict, IF(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(real_road <> 0, real_road, NULL)) = 5, 1, 0) AS if_correct_road FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) /* AND     os_type != 0  -- 计算分路冲突时考虑玩家与AI的冲突 */ /* AND     t.fake_ai = 0  -- 计算分路冲突时考虑玩家与AI的冲突 */ GROUP BY battleid, wincamp) AS t1 ON t.battleid = t1.battleid AND t.wincamp = t1.wincamp GROUP BY logymd, pvptype, realpvptype, battle_group, game_type, zone_gp, t.battleid) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT season, a.accountid, a.zoneid) AS real_players_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.battleid > 99999 /* 剔除battleid = 9999 的对局记录 */ AND LENGTH(a.battleid) >= 17 /* 剔除battleid长度10~12客户端温暖关 */ AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY a.battleid) AS c ON a.battleid = c.battleid GROUP BY a.bigranklvl, a.pvptype, a.realpvptype, a.battle_group, if_5realplayer, c.real_players_cnt, name: 英雄1v1情景TTD
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: celiaye@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-09-03 21:10:10.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_hero_battle_event WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND battleid IN (SELECT a.battleid FROM (SELECT battleid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND issurrender = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND pvptype = 2 AND fake_ai = 0 AND realpvptype IN (22, 96, 97, 2, 59, 90, 1) GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) = 10) AS a JOIN (SELECT battleid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_hero_battle_event WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT heroid) = 10) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid)), t2 AS (SELECT heroid, hero_name, CASE WHEN heroes = 1 THEN '1-坦克' WHEN heroes = 2 THEN '2-战士' WHEN heroes = 3 THEN '3-刺客' WHEN heroes = 4 THEN '4-法师' WHEN heroes = 5 THEN '5-射手' WHEN heroes = 6 THEN '6-辅助' ELSE '7-其它' END AS heroclass FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.celiaye_1v1_ttd PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT ranks, deadheroid, deadheroname, deadheroclass, heroid, hero_name, heroclass, CASE WHEN starttime BETWEEN 0 AND 2 THEN '1.[0-2min]' WHEN starttime <= 5 THEN '2.(2,5min]' WHEN starttime <= 8 THEN '3.(5,8min]' WHEN starttime <= 12 THEN '4.(8,12min]' WHEN starttime <= 18 THEN '5.(12,18min]' ELSE '6.18min+' END AS fighttime, SUM(fighttime) AS killtime, COUNT(*) AS num FROM (SELECT main.battleid, c.ranks, main.heroid, d.hero_name, d.heroclass AS heroclass, main.deadheroid, e.hero_name AS deadheroname, e.heroclass AS deadheroclass, main.fightstart / 60000 AS starttime, a.herofightend / 1000 - a.herofightstart / 1000 AS fighttime, a.starthp / a.startmaxhp AS hp FROM (SELECT *, REPLACE(kills, ',', '') AS deadheroid FROM t WHERE dead_heronum_a + dead_heronum_b > 0 AND fight_heronum_a = 1 AND fight_heronum_b = 1) AS main JOIN (SELECT * FROM t WHERE dead_heronum_a + dead_heronum_b > 0 AND fight_heronum_a = 1 AND fight_heronum_b = 1) AS a ON main.battleid = a.battleid AND main.fightid = a.fightid AND main.deadheroid = a.heroid LEFT JOIN (SELECT battleid, CASE WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 10 THEN '勇士' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 21 THEN '精英' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 37 THEN '大师' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 62 THEN '宗师' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 87 THEN 'a.史诗' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 112 THEN 'b.传奇' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 137 THEN 'c.神话' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 162 THEN 'd.百战神话' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 212 THEN 'e.荣耀神话' ELSE 'f.至尊神话' END AS ranks FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battletype = 2 GROUP BY battleid) AS c ON main.battleid = c.battleid LEFT JOIN t2 AS d ON main.heroid = d.heroid LEFT JOIN t2 AS e ON main.deadheroid = e.heroid) WHERE hp > 0.8 AND ranks IN ('a.史诗', 'b.传奇', 'c.神话', 'd.百战神话', 'e.荣耀神话', 'f.至尊神话') GROUP BY ranks, deadheroid, deadheroname, deadheroclass, heroid, hero_name, heroclass, CASE WHEN starttime BETWEEN 0 AND 2 THEN '1.[0-2min]' WHEN starttime <= 5 THEN '2.(2,5min]' WHEN starttime <= 8 THEN '3.(5,8min]' WHEN starttime <= 12 THEN '4.(8,12min]' WHEN starttime <= 18 THEN '5.(12,18min]' ELSE '6.18min+' END

sql_units:
/* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jichun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-09-09 21:36:41.000 */ /* Description: 经分英雄配置表 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH hero_total AS (/* 昨日存量英雄 */ SELECT heroid /*	英雄id（业务原生定义） */, hero_name /*	英雄名称 */, hero_order /*	英雄顺序（数仓应用定义ID） */, added_time /*	上架时间(预留字段) */ FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_hero_config WHERE logymd = /* 2024-09-07 为一次性写入的数据，后续需要改成自动化写入脚本 */ IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-09-07', '2024-09-07', '2026-05-30') UNION ALL /* 今日新增英雄 */ SELECT t1.heroid, t2.hero_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.get_time) + t4.hero_num AS hero_order, SUBSTRING(t1.get_time, 1, 19) AS added_time FROM (SELECT logymd, heroid, MIN(TIME) AS get_time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_hero WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND operate <> 'gm' /* 排除gm获取 */ AND time_len = 0 /* 永久英雄 */ GROUP BY logymd, heroid) AS t1 JOIN (/* 需要在svn获取的配置表中 */ SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.heroid = t2.heroid LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid /*	英雄id（业务原生定义） */, hero_name /*	英雄名称 */, hero_order /*	英雄顺序（数仓应用定义ID） */, added_time /*	上架时间(预留字段) */ FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_hero_config WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-09-07', '2024-09-07', '2026-05-30')) AS t3 ON t1.heroid = t3.heroid LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd, COUNT(*) AS hero_num FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_hero_config WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-09-07', '2024-09-07', '2026-05-30')) AS t4 ON t1.logymd = t4.logymd WHERE t3.heroid IS NULL /* 不在昨日的获取中 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_gamebi_hero_config PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT heroid /*	英雄id（业务原生定义） */, hero_name /*	英雄名称 */, hero_order /*	英雄顺序（数仓应用定义ID） */, added_time /*	上架时间(预留字段) */ FROM hero_total /* --2024-09-07 初始写入脚本
SELECT  a.resource_id as heroid,
        b.hero_name as hero_name,
        row_number() over(order by a.resource_id,a.his_first_get_time) AS hero_order,
        a.his_first_get_time as added_time --上架时间
FROM    (
            SELECT  resource_id,
                    resource_type,
                    MIN(his_first_get_time) AS his_first_get_time
            FROM    mt_dwm.dwm_resource_role_zone_df
            WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' AND resource_type = 'hero' 
            AND     zoneid < 57000 
            GROUP BY
                    resource_id,
                    resource_type
        ) a
JOIN
        (
            SELECT  heroid,
                    hero_name,
                    hero_en_name,
                    added_time
            FROM    mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df
            WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' 
            AND     heroid > 0 and heroid <= 125
            AND     hero_name not like '%新英雄%'
            AND     hero_name not like '%测试%'
        ) b
ON      a.resource_id = b.heroid
*/

logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-09-07', '2024-09-07', '2026-05-31')) AS b ON a.resource_id = b.skinid WHERE his_first_get_date <= '2026-05-31' /* 首次获取时间要小于当日 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_active_resoure_account_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', resource_type = 'skin') SELECT bas.roleid AS accountid, bas.country AS country, bas.os AS os, bas.network AS network, bas.register_date AS register_date /* 注册日期 */, COALESCE(pay.product_money, 0) AS his_pay_amt /* 历史付费金额 */, COALESCE(res.resource_id, -99999) AS resource_id FROM account_active_di AS act JOIN basic AS bas ON act.roleid = bas.roleid LEFT JOIN account_pay_df AS pay ON act.roleid = pay.roleid LEFT JOIN resource_df AS res ON act.roleid = res.roleid

name: kol标签计算

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_active_role_zone_did_df
sql_units: WITH active_role_zone AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_date, his_first_active_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_date, his_first_active_date), login_did_map_df AS (SELECT COALESCE(di.roleid, df.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(di.zoneid, df.zoneid) AS zoneid, CASE WHEN COALESCE(di.did_array, df.did_array) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN di.did_array IS NULL OR df.did_array IS NULL THEN COALESCE(di.did_array, df.did_array) ELSE ARRAY_UNION(di.did_array, df.did_array) END AS did_array FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COLLECT_SET(did) AS did_array FROM msdk_ods.moba_gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT did IS NULL AND NOT did IN ('', 'none', 'null', 'unknown', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', '0000-0000', '0000000000000000', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, did_array FROM mt_dim.dim_active_role_zone_did_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND NOT did_array IS NULL) AS df ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid), login_last_adid_di AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.ad_id AS last_adid, IF(NOT a.ad_id IS NULL, a.logymd, NULL) AS last_adid_change_date, IF(NOT a.ad_id IS NULL, a.adid_change_lead, NULL) AS last_adid_change_lead, IF(NOT a.ad_id IS NULL, a.`time`, NULL) AS last_adid_change_timestamp, a.logymd FROM (SELECT logymd, `time`, roleid, zoneid, ad_id, LEAD(ad_id, 1, NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd DESC, `time` DESC) AS adid_change_lead FROM msdk_ods.moba_gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT ad_id IS NULL AND NOT ad_id IN ('', 'none', 'null', 'unknown', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', '0000-0000', '0000000000000000', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000')) AS a WHERE (adid_change_lead <> ad_id OR adid_change_lead IS NULL)), login_last_adid_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, last_adid, last_adid_change_date FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, last_adid, last_adid_change_date, last_adid_change_lead_v2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd DESC, last_adid_change_timestamp DESC) AS active_rn FROM (SELECT *, LEAD(last_adid, 1, NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd DESC, last_adid_change_timestamp DESC) AS last_adid_change_lead_v2 FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, last_adid, last_adid_change_date, last_adid_change_timestamp, logymd FROM login_last_adid_di UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, last_adid, last_adid_change_date, last_adid_change_date AS last_adid_change_timestamp, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_active_role_zone_did_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND NOT last_adid IS NULL) AS t1) AS t2 WHERE (last_adid <> last_adid_change_lead_v2 OR last_adid_change_lead_v2 IS NULL)) AS t3 WHERE t3.active_rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_dim`.`dim_active_role_zone_did_df` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = '1001') SELECT aa.roleid, aa.zoneid, cc.did_array, bb.last_adid, aa.his_last_active_date AS last_active_date, bb.last_adid_change_date, aa.his_first_active_date AS first_active_date FROM active_role_zone AS aa LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, last_adid, last_adid_change_date FROM login_last_adid_df) AS bb ON aa.roleid = bb.roleid AND aa.zoneid = bb.zoneid LEFT JOIN login_did_map_df AS cc ON aa.roleid = cc.roleid AND aa.zoneid = cc.zoneid GROUP BY aa.roleid, aa.zoneid, cc.did_array, bb.last_adid, aa.his_last_active_date, bb.last_adid_change_date, aa.his_first_active_date

name: MC2_CBT2_新增用户adid_di表
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: aprilgao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-09-19 14:35:36.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH mc_create /* mc创角新增 */ AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime /* 账号创建时间 */, usercreateymd /* 账号创建年月日 */, os_type /* 操作系统 */, channel /* 渠道 */, os_language /* 操作系统语言 */, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS ip_country /* 玩家的id地址解析的国家，因为上游T+1表这时候还没有，且上游国家归因到多层匹配处理，先用这个替代 */ FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_create_role /* 创角表 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 20000 AND is_vp = 0 AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime /* 账号创建时间 */, usercreateymd /* 账号创建年月日 */, os_type /* 操作系统 */, channel /* 渠道 */, os_language /* 操作系统语言 */, ip_country), mc_create_login AS (SELECT t1.logymd, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.usercreatetime, t1.usercreateymd, t1.os_type, t1.channel, t1.os_language, t1.ip_country, t2.ad_id FROM mc_create AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, ad_id FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, ad_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME) AS rn FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login /* --新增 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd = usercreateymd AND fake_ai = 0 AND zoneid < 20000 AND NOT ad_id IN ('', 'none', 'null', 'unknown', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', '0000-0000', '0000000000000000', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000')) AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t2 /* ---mc首次登录 */ ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid), mlbb_install /* MLBB装机 */ AS (SELECT t1.logymd, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.usercreatetime, t1.usercreateymd, t1.os_type, t1.channel, t1.os_language, t1.ip_country, t1.ad_id, CASE WHEN NOT t2.accountid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ml_install FROM mc_create_login AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_client_appinstall WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND LOWER(appname) = 'mlbb' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid), ml_type /* 划分ML活跃、ML流失和MC纯新 */ AS (SELECT tb.logymd, tb.roleid, tb.zoneid, tb.usercreatetime, tb.usercreateymd, tb.os_type, tb.channel, tb.os_language, tb.ip_country, tb.ad_id, tb.ml_install, tb.ml_adid, tb.ml_did, tb.last_active_date, tb.ml_roleid, tb.ml_zoneid FROM (SELECT t1.logymd, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.usercreatetime, t1.usercreateymd, t1.os_type, t1.channel, t1.os_language, t1.ip_country, t1.ad_id, t1.ml_install, t2.last_adid AS ml_adid, t2.did_array AS ml_did, t2.last_active_date, t2.roleid AS ml_roleid, t2.zoneid AS ml_zoneid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.roleid, t1.zoneid ORDER BY t2.last_active_date DESC) AS rn FROM mlbb_install AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, did_array, last_adid, last_active_date FROM mt_dim.dim_active_role_zone_did_df /* ---到时候把表名填上 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, did_array, last_adid, last_active_date) AS t2 ON t1.ad_id = t2.last_adid) AS tb WHERE rn = 1), ml_type_v2 AS (SELECT t1.*, NULL AS user_type_old, NULL AS mcadid_old, NULL AS mladid_old FROM ml_type AS t1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_adidinfo_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.usercreatetime, t1.usercreateymd, t1.os_type, t1.channel, t1.os_language, t1.ip_country, t1.ad_id, t1.ml_install, t1.ml_adid, t1.ml_did, t1.last_active_date, t1.ml_roleid, t1.ml_zoneid, t1.user_type_old, t1.mcadid_old, t1.mladid_old, CASE WHEN ml_adid IS NULL THEN 'MC纯新' WHEN NOT ml_adid IS NULL AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', last_active_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 89 THEN 'ML活跃' WHEN NOT ml_adid IS NULL AND DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', last_active_date) >= 90 THEN 'ML流失' END AS user_type FROM ml_type_v2 AS t1

name: all_country_network_condition_daily
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: haowang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-09-20 16:28:49.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.all_country_network_condition_daily SELECT country, battle_num, sum_ping_times, sum_battletimes, new_good, sum_timedelay, sum_stdping, sum_movelag, sum_timedelay60, sum_movelag4, sum_stdping1900, net_sc, logymd FROM (SELECT GEOIP(clientip, 1) AS country, COUNT(*) AS battle_num, SUM(ping_times) AS sum_ping_times, SUM(battletime) AS sum_battletimes, SUM(CASE WHEN (ping120 + ping150 + ping200 + ping300 + ping500 + ping800) / ping_times <= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_good, SUM(timedelay) AS sum_timedelay, SUM(stdping) AS sum_stdping, SUM(movelag) AS sum_movelag, SUM(CASE WHEN timedelay > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_timedelay60, SUM(CASE WHEN movelag > 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_movelag4, SUM(CASE WHEN stdping > 1900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_stdping1900, SUM(IF(smallreconnect_num / (battletime / 600) <= 1, 1, 0) + IF(movelag / (battletime / 600) <= 4, 1, 0) + IF((ping80 / ping_times) >= 0.95, 1, 0)) AS net_sc, logymd FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE timedelay > 0 AND timedelay < 50000 AND maxdelay < 500000 AND timedelay <> 10000 AND ping_times <> 0 AND movelag < 10000 AND isvalid = 1 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) <> 57 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' /* and geoip(clientip,1)='ID' */ GROUP BY logymd, GEOIP(clientip, 1))

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_prod_hero_df
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_prod_hero_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT DISTINCT heroid, hero_name, hero_en_name, heroes AS career_id, CONCAT_WS(',', CASE WHEN heroes = 1 THEN '坦克' WHEN heroes = 2 THEN '战士' WHEN heroes = 3 THEN '刺客' WHEN heroes = 4 THEN '法师' WHEN heroes = 5 THEN '射手' WHEN heroes = 6 THEN '辅助' WHEN heroes = -9999 THEN NULL ELSE '其他' END, CASE WHEN sub_heroes = 1 THEN '坦克' WHEN sub_heroes = 2 THEN '战士' WHEN sub_heroes = 3 THEN '刺客' WHEN sub_heroes = 4 THEN '法师' WHEN sub_heroes = 5 THEN '射手' WHEN sub_heroes = 6 THEN '辅助' WHEN sub_heroes = -9999 THEN NULL ELSE '其他' END) AS career_name, position AS post_road_id, CONCAT_WS(',', CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN position = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN position = 3 THEN '游走路' WHEN position = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN position = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN position = -9999 THEN NULL ELSE '其他' END, CASE WHEN sub_position = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN sub_position = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN sub_position = 3 THEN '游走路' WHEN sub_position = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN sub_position = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN sub_position = -9999 THEN NULL ELSE '其他' END) AS post_road_name FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_competitor_account_di
sql_units: /* 忽略分区限制 */ WITH app_all_config AS (SELECT DISTINCT logymd, app_name, app_type FROM mt_dim.dim_competitor_config WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-02')), competitor_account_di AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, app_original_name, app_config_name AS app_name FROM mt_dwd.dwd_competitor_account_di WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-02') AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, app_original_name, app_config_name), active_di AS (/* 活跃人数 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, MAX(day_login_duration) AS day_login_duration FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-02') AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 GROUP BY logymd, roleid), dim_basic AS (/* 新增 */ SELECT roleid, register_date, new_type, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2022-09-01', '2022-09-01', '2026-05-31') AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 AND is_first_create = 1 /* 取首个创角的账号 */), recurring_di_role AS (/* 回流 */ SELECT logymd, roleid FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_active_pay_di WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-02') AND granularity_type = 'account' AND user_type = 'lose30d' /* 30日回流用户 */), battle AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, day_last_bigranklvl, CASE WHEN `battle_level` > 0 AND `battle_level` <= 10 THEN 1 WHEN `battle_level` > 10 AND `battle_level` <= 20 THEN 2 WHEN `battle_level` > 20 AND `battle_level` <= 30 THEN 3 WHEN `battle_level` > 30 AND `battle_level` <= 40 THEN 4 WHEN `battle_level` > 40 AND `battle_level` <= 50 THEN 5 WHEN `battle_level` > 50 AND `battle_level` <= 60 THEN 6 WHEN `battle_level` > 60 AND `battle_level` <= 70 THEN 7 WHEN `battle_level` > 70 AND `battle_level` <= 80 THEN 8 WHEN `battle_level` > 80 AND `battle_level` <= 90 THEN 9 WHEN `battle_level` > 90 AND `battle_level` <= 100 THEN 10 WHEN `battle_level` > 100 THEN 11 ELSE -99999 END AS battle_level_range FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, MAX(day_last_bigranklvl) AS day_last_bigranklvl, MAX(battle_level) AS battle_level FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-02') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 GROUP BY logymd, roleid)), behavior_info AS (SELECT roleid, BITMAP_MERGE(SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(logymd, '2026-05-31') + 1, 30)) AS active_info FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df) AND LOCATE(1, SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(logymd, '2026-05-31') + 1)) <= 30 /* 末次活跃在30天内 */ AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid), active_new_battle AS (/* 不看竞品的 */ SELECT t1.logymd, t1.roleid AS accountid, t1.player_type, COALESCE(t2.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, t4.day_login_duration, COALESCE(t5.day_last_bigranklvl, -99999) AS day_last_bigranklvl, COALESCE(t5.battle_level_range, -99999) AS battle_level_range, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', t1.logymd) > 0, SUBSTRING(t3.active_info, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', t1.logymd), 1), 0) AS is_active_2days, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', t1.logymd) - 5 > 0, SUBSTRING(t3.active_info, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', t1.logymd) - 5, 1), 0) AS is_active_7days, IF(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', t1.logymd) - 28 > 0, SUBSTRING(t3.active_info, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', t1.logymd) - 28, 1), 0) AS is_active_30days FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, 1 AS player_type /* 活跃 */ FROM active_di UNION ALL SELECT register_date AS logymd, roleid, 2 AS player_type /* 新增 */ FROM dim_basic AS bas WHERE bas.new_type <> 2 /* 排除模拟器新增 */ AND register_date IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-02') UNION ALL SELECT logymd, roleid, 3 AS player_type /* 回流 */ FROM recurring_di_role AS rec) AS t1 LEFT JOIN dim_basic AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid LEFT JOIN behavior_info AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid LEFT JOIN active_di AS t4 ON t1.roleid = t4.roleid AND t1.logymd = t4.logymd LEFT JOIN battle AS t5 ON t1.roleid = t5.roleid AND t1.logymd = t5.logymd), ads_compete AS (SELECT con.logymd, cpt.accountid /* 关联不上为null */, con.first_mt_country, con.player_type, con.day_last_bigranklvl, con.battle_level_range, con.app_type, con.app_name, IF(cpt.accountid IS NULL, 0, con.day_login_duration) AS day_login_duration, IF(cpt.accountid IS NULL, 0, con.is_active_2days) AS is_active_2days, IF(cpt.accountid IS NULL, 0, con.is_active_7days) AS is_active_7days, IF(cpt.accountid IS NULL, 0, con.is_active_30days) AS is_active_30days FROM (SELECT a.logymd, a.accountid, a.first_mt_country, a.player_type, a.day_last_bigranklvl, a.battle_level_range, c.app_type, c.app_name, a.day_login_duration, a.is_active_2days, a.is_active_7days, a.is_active_30days FROM active_new_battle AS a LEFT JOIN app_all_config AS c /* mlbb存在的维度，每个竞品也存在 */ ON a.logymd = c.logymd) AS con LEFT JOIN competitor_account_di AS cpt ON con.accountid = cpt.accountid AND con.logymd = cpt.logymd AND con.app_name = cpt.app_name) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_competitor_account_di PARTITION(logymd) SELECT tb1.app_type, tb1.app_name, tb1.first_mt_country, tb1.day_last_bigranklvl, tb1.player_type, tb1.battle_level_range, COALESCE(tb1.compet_day_login_duration, 0) AS compet_day_login_duration, COALESCE(tb1.compet_act_cnt, 0) AS compet_act_cnt, IF(tb1.logymd IN ('2026-05-31'), NULL, COALESCE(tb1.reten_cnt_2days, 0)) AS reten_cnt_2days, IF(tb1.logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30'), NULL, COALESCE(tb1.reten_cnt_7days, 0)) AS reten_cnt_7days, IF(tb1.logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-25'), NULL, COALESCE(tb1.reten_cnt_30days, 0)) AS reten_cnt_30days, COALESCE(tb2.compet_act_cnt, 0) AS mlbb_act_cnt, tb1.logymd FROM (SELECT logymd, app_type, app_name, first_mt_country, day_last_bigranklvl, player_type, battle_level_range, SUM(day_login_duration) AS compet_day_login_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS compet_act_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_active_2days = 1, accountid, NULL)) AS reten_cnt_2days, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_active_7days = 1, accountid, NULL)) AS reten_cnt_7days, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_active_30days = 1, accountid, NULL)) AS reten_cnt_30days FROM ads_compete GROUP BY logymd, app_type, app_name, first_mt_country, day_last_bigranklvl, player_type, battle_level_range UNION ALL SELECT logymd, 0 AS app_type, '大盘' AS app_name, first_mt_country, day_last_bigranklvl, player_type, battle_level_range, SUM(day_login_duration) AS compet_day_login_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS compet_act_cnt, SUM(is_active_2days) AS is_active_2days, SUM(is_active_7days) AS is_active_7days, SUM(is_active_30days) AS is_active_30days FROM active_new_battle GROUP BY logymd, first_mt_country, day_last_bigranklvl, player_type, battle_level_range) AS tb1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, first_mt_country, day_last_bigranklvl, player_type, battle_level_range, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS compet_act_cnt FROM active_new_battle GROUP BY logymd, first_mt_country, day_last_bigranklvl, player_type, battle_level_range) AS tb2 ON tb1.logymd = tb2.logymd AND tb1.first_mt_country = tb2.first_mt_country AND tb1.day_last_bigranklvl = tb2.day_last_bigranklvl AND tb1.player_type = tb2.player_type AND tb1.battle_level_range = tb2.battle_level_range

name: export_bytedance.db_bytedance.gameserver_act_exchange

name: 1_健康度_总和_w_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: achingzhu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-07-11 14:09:14.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH social_intimacy AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id, battle_intimacy, battle_intimacy_undirected, gift_intimacy FROM mt_da.social_intimacy_role_wi WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), battle_intimacy AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id, battle_intimacy AS pv FROM social_intimacy WHERE battle_intimacy > 0), battle_intimacy_undirected AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id, battle_intimacy_undirected AS pv FROM social_intimacy WHERE battle_intimacy_undirected > 0), battle_triangle AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT LEAST(a.friend_role_id, b.friend_role_id), GREATEST(a.friend_role_id, b.friend_role_id)) AS triangle_num FROM battle_intimacy_undirected AS a INNER JOIN battle_intimacy_undirected AS b ON a.friend_role_id = b.roleid AND a.friend_zone_id = b.zoneid AND a.roleid <> b.friend_role_id INNER JOIN battle_intimacy_undirected AS c ON b.friend_role_id = c.roleid AND b.friend_zone_id = c.zoneid AND a.roleid = c.friend_role_id AND a.zoneid = c.friend_zone_id GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid), gift_intimacy AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id, gift_intimacy AS pv FROM social_intimacy WHERE gift_intimacy > 0), gift_triangle AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT LEAST(a.friend_role_id, b.friend_role_id), GREATEST(a.friend_role_id, b.friend_role_id)) AS triangle_num FROM gift_intimacy AS a INNER JOIN gift_intimacy AS b ON a.friend_role_id = b.roleid AND a.friend_zone_id = b.zoneid AND a.roleid <> b.friend_role_id INNER JOIN gift_intimacy AS c ON b.friend_role_id = c.roleid AND b.friend_zone_id = c.zoneid AND a.roleid = c.friend_role_id AND a.zoneid = c.friend_zone_id GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_da.social_healthy_role_zone_wi PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(battle.roleid, gift.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(battle.zoneid, gift.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(battle_degree, 0) AS battle_degree, COALESCE(battle_strength, 0) AS battle_strength, COALESCE(battle_triangle, 0) AS battle_triangle, COALESCE(battle_degree_undirected, 0) AS battle_degree_undirected, COALESCE(battle_strength_undirected, 0) AS battle_strength_undirected, COALESCE(gift_degree, 0) AS gift_degree, COALESCE(gift_strength, 0) AS gift_strength, COALESCE(gift_triangle, 0) AS gift_triangle FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, battle_degree, battle_strength, triangle_num AS battle_triangle, battle_degree_undirected, battle_strength_undirected FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS battle_degree_undirected, SUM(pv) AS battle_strength_undirected FROM battle_intimacy_undirected GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN battle_triangle AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS battle_degree, SUM(pv) AS battle_strength FROM battle_intimacy GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid) AS battle FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, gift_degree, gift_strength, triangle_num AS gift_triangle FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS gift_degree, SUM(pv) AS gift_strength FROM gift_intimacy GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN gift_triangle AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) AS gift ON battle.roleid = gift.roleid AND battle.zoneid = gift.zoneid

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_battle_hero_bigrank_equid_di
sql_units: WITH hero_battle_equipid_detail AS (SELECT t.battleid, accountid, zoneid, heroid, pvptype, realpvptype, CASE WHEN real_road = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN real_road = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN real_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN real_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN real_road = 3 THEN '游走' ELSE '其他' END AS real_road, CASE WHEN rankstar >= 162 THEN 9 WHEN rankstar >= 137 THEN 8 ELSE bigranklvl END AS bigranklvl, rankstar, battletime, wincamp, t.banhero, runeid /* 徽记id */, CONCAT_WS(',', new_rune_skill1, new_rune_skill2, new_rune_skill3) AS new_rune_skill /* 徽记skill:0是有含义的，0代表这人没带徽记技能进场 */, skillid /* 战场技能id */, CONCAT_WS(',', CASE WHEN COALESCE(equip1, 0) > 0 AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(shoe_array, CAST(equip1 AS STRING)) = FALSE THEN equip1 END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(equip2, 0) > 0 AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(shoe_array, CAST(equip2 AS STRING)) = FALSE THEN equip2 END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(equip3, 0) > 0 AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(shoe_array, CAST(equip3 AS STRING)) = FALSE THEN equip3 END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(equip4, 0) > 0 AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(shoe_array, CAST(equip4 AS STRING)) = FALSE THEN equip4 END) AS equipid, t.real_road AS real_road_id FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS t JOIN (SELECT battleid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS t WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90) AND zoneid < 57000 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid) = 10) AS t1 ON t.battleid = t1.battleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd, COLLECT_SET(equip_id) AS shoe_array FROM mt_dim.dim_prod_item_equip_info WHERE logymd = IF(DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, '2026-05-31') >= 1, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, -1), '2026-05-31') AND is_shoe = 1) AS t2 ON t.logymd = t2.logymd WHERE t.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90) AND zoneid < 57000 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND fake_ai = 0 AND battletime >= 600 /* battletime>=10min */), hero_road_rank_equipid_rune_stat AS (SELECT t.heroid, t.pvptype, t.realpvptype, t.real_road, t.real_road_id, t1.bigranklvl, equipid, runeid, new_rune_skill, skillid, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.wincamp = 1, t.battleid, NULL)) AS win_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT t.battleid) AS battle_cnt FROM hero_battle_equipid_detail AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT battleid, MAX(bigranklvl) AS bigranklvl FROM hero_battle_equipid_detail GROUP BY battleid) AS t1 ON t.battleid = t1.battleid GROUP BY t.heroid, t.pvptype, t.realpvptype, t.real_road, t.real_road_id, t1.bigranklvl, equipid, runeid, new_rune_skill, skillid), hero_road_bigrank_stat AS (SELECT heroid, pvptype, realpvptype, real_road, real_road_id, bigranklvl, win_battle_cnt, battle_cnt, all_battle_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_hero_bigrank_pvp_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_battle_hero_bigrank_equid_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.heroid, b.hero_name, a.pvptype, a.realpvptype, a.real_road, a.bigranklvl, equipid, runeid, new_rune_skill, skillid, a.battle_cnt, a.win_battle_cnt, c.all_battle_cnt, c.battle_cnt AS road_battle_cnt, c.win_battle_cnt AS road_win_battle_cnt, a.real_road_id FROM hero_road_rank_equipid_rune_stat AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, hero_name FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY heroid, hero_name) AS b ON a.heroid = b.heroid LEFT JOIN hero_road_bigrank_stat AS c ON a.heroid = c.heroid AND a.pvptype = c.pvptype AND a.realpvptype = c.realpvptype AND a.real_road_id = c.real_road_id AND a.bigranklvl = c.bigranklvl

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_ai_battle_report_player_utc0_di
sql_units: WITH report_now AS (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid, t1.reported_roleid, t2.zoneid AS reported_zoneid, t2.pvptype, t1.report01, t1.report02, t1.report03, t1.report04, t1.report05, t1.report06 FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, battleid, reported_roleid, report01, report02, report03, report04, report05, report06 FROM ml_ods.gameserver_report_player_now_2024 WHERE logymd <= '2026-06-01' AND logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) + 28800, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd <= '2026-06-01' AND logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) + 28800, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2)) AS t2 ON t1.reported_roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.battleid = t2.battleid), report_judge AS (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid, t2.pvptype, t1.isreported, t1.report_type, t1.judge_type, t1.judge_score, t1.is_escape FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, battleid, isreported, report_type, judge_type, judge_score, is_escape FROM ml_ods.gameserver_report_player_judge_2024 WHERE logymd <= '2026-06-01' AND logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) + 28800, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd <= '2026-06-01' AND logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) + 28800, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2)) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t1.battleid = t2.battleid), report_player AS (SELECT t1.reporterid, t1.reporterzone, t1.bereporterid, t1.bereporterzone, t1.reporttype, t1.battleid, t2.pvptype, t1.issuccess, t1.is_confirmed, t1.is_confirmed_finally, t1.select_report_type FROM (SELECT reporterid, reporterzone, bereporterid, bereporterzone, reporttype, battleid, issuccess, is_confirmed, is_confirmed_finally, select_report_type FROM ml_ods.gameserver_report_player WHERE logymd <= '2026-06-01' AND logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) + 28800, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT battleid, pvptype FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd <= '2026-06-01' AND logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) + 28800, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) GROUP BY battleid, pvptype) AS t2 ON t1.battleid = t2.battleid), bereport_info /* 玩家被举报信息,相同类型举报，一场战斗中多人举报算多次 */ AS (SELECT reported_roleid AS roleid, reported_zoneid AS zoneid, pvptype, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report01 > 0 THEN CONCAT(battleid, '_', roleid, '_', zoneid) ELSE NULL END) AS reported_cheat_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report03 > 0 THEN CONCAT(battleid, '_', roleid, '_', zoneid) ELSE NULL END) AS reported_hook_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report02 > 0 THEN CONCAT(battleid, '_', roleid, '_', zoneid) ELSE NULL END) AS reported_abuse_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report04 > 0 THEN CONCAT(battleid, '_', roleid, '_', zoneid) ELSE NULL END) AS reported_feed_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report05 > 0 THEN CONCAT(battleid, '_', roleid, '_', zoneid) ELSE NULL END) AS reported_negative_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report06 > 0 THEN CONCAT(battleid, '_', roleid, '_', zoneid) ELSE NULL END) AS reported_disturb_cnt FROM report_now WHERE pvptype IN (1, 2) GROUP BY reported_roleid, reported_zoneid, pvptype), judge_info /* 相同类型举报判定一局一次 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report_type = 1 AND judge_type > 0 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS judged_cheat_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report_type = 3 AND judge_type > 0 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS judged_hook_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report_type = 2 AND judge_type > 0 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS judged_abuse_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report_type = 4 AND judge_type > 0 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS judged_feed_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report_type = 5 AND judge_type > 0 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS judged_negative_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report_type = 6 AND judge_type > 0 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS judged_disturb_cnt FROM report_judge WHERE pvptype IN (1, 2) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype), report_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report01 > 0 THEN CONCAT(battleid, '_', reported_roleid, '_', reported_zoneid) ELSE NULL END) AS report_cheat_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report03 > 0 THEN CONCAT(battleid, '_', reported_roleid, '_', reported_zoneid) ELSE NULL END) AS report_hook_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report02 > 0 THEN CONCAT(battleid, '_', reported_roleid, '_', reported_zoneid) ELSE NULL END) AS report_abuse_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report04 > 0 THEN CONCAT(battleid, '_', reported_roleid, '_', reported_zoneid) ELSE NULL END) AS report_feed_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report05 > 0 THEN CONCAT(battleid, '_', reported_roleid, '_', reported_zoneid) ELSE NULL END) AS report_negative_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN report06 > 0 THEN CONCAT(battleid, '_', reported_roleid, '_', reported_zoneid) ELSE NULL END) AS report_disturb_cnt FROM report_now WHERE pvptype IN (1, 2) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype), report_succ_info AS (SELECT rn.roleid, rn.zoneid, rn.pvptype, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rn.report01 > 0 AND rj.isreported = 1 AND rj.report_type = 1 AND rj.judge_type > 0 THEN CONCAT(rj.battleid, '_', rj.roleid) ELSE NULL END) AS report_cheat_suc_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rn.report03 > 0 AND rj.isreported = 1 AND rj.report_type = 3 AND rj.judge_type > 0 THEN CONCAT(rj.battleid, '_', rj.roleid) ELSE NULL END) AS report_hook_suc_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rn.report02 > 0 AND sql_units: /* WITH date_range AS ( */ /*   SELECT '2024-01-01' as start_date, '2026-05-31' as end_date */ /* ), */ /* months AS ( */ /*   SELECT add_months(start_date, s.i) as first_day_of_month */ /*   FROM date_range, ( */ /*     SELECT posexplode(split(space(12), ' ')) as (i, val) */ /*   ) s */ /*   WHERE add_months(start_date, s.i) <= end_date */ /* ),date_lst as ( */ /* SELECT */ /*   first_day_of_month, */ /*   date_sub(add_months(first_day_of_month, 1), 1) as last_day_of_month */ /* FROM months */ /* ) */ WITH date_range AS (SELECT CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date, CAST('2026-05-31' AS DATE) AS end_date), months AS (SELECT ADD_MONTHS(start_date, s.i) AS first_day_of_month FROM date_range LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(SPLIT(REPEAT(' ', CAST(MONTHS_BETWEEN(end_date, start_date) + 1 AS INT)), ' ') /* 扩展序列长度，确保覆盖所有可能的月份 */) s AS i, val WHERE ADD_MONTHS(start_date, s.i) /* 关键修改：生成的月份首日必须严格小于 end_date 所在月份的首日 */ < TRUNC(end_date, 'MM')), date_lst AS (SELECT first_day_of_month, LAST_DAY(first_day_of_month) AS last_day_of_month FROM months) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_public_opinion_keyword_gp_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT date_range /*	日期 */, game_name /*	游戏名称 */, game_id /*	包名，游戏id */, language_en /*	英文语言 */, language_zh /*	中文语言 */, star_level /*	评论星级 */, category1 /*	一级分类 */, category2 /*	二级分类 */, keyword /*	关键词-源语言，与英文翻译为1对多的关系 */, keyword_en /*	关键词-英文翻译 */, review_cnt /*	评论总数 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_public_opinion_keyword_gp_mf WHERE logymd IN (SELECT last_day_of_month FROM date_lst UNION SELECT '2026-05-31') AND logymd <= '2026-05-31'
