mt_dim.dim_basic_attribute_account_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT roleid AS accountid, gender AS sex, birthday AS born, age, occupation AS job, gt1, gt2 FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, gender /* 性别 */, birthday /* 生日 */, age /* 年龄 */, occupation /* 职业 */, gt1 /* 是否是高准低覆（1-是，0-否） */, gt2 /* 是否是中准中覆（1-是，0-否） */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY recycling_time DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT *, ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', t1.birthday_new) / 365, 0) AS age /* 生日折算年龄 */ FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN birthday IN ('2015+', '1980-') THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(birthday, 1, 4), '-', '01', '-', '01') ELSE birthday END AS birthday_new FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.logymd, b.logymd) AS logymd, COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(a.gt1, 0) AS gt1 /* 是否是高准低覆（1-是，0-否） */, COALESCE(b.gt2, 0) AS gt2 /* 是否是中准中覆（1-是，0-否） */, COALESCE(a.gender, b.gender) AS gender, COALESCE(a.birthday, b.birthday) AS birthday, COALESCE(a.occupation, b.occupation) AS occupation, COALESCE(a.recycling_time, b.recycling_time) AS recycling_time FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, 1 AS gt1, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer14, '$.2305150009') AS gender /* 性别 */, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer71, '$.2305150009') AS birthday /* 生日 */, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer16, '$.2305150009') AS occupation /* 职业 */, GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2305150009') AS recycling_time FROM dm_act_survey_role_zone_df WHERE NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2305150009') IS NULL AND age_cross_validation = 1 /* 生日年月与年龄段验证通过 */ AND zodiac_cross_validation = 1 /* 生日年月日与年龄段验证通过 */ AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer358, '$.2305150009') = '是' /* 甄别题答对 */ AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(finish_time, '$.2305150009') >= 10 /* 答题时间超过10s */) AS a FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, 1 AS gt2, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer14, '$.2305150009') AS gender, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer71, '$.2305150009') AS birthday, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer16, '$.2305150009') AS occupation /* 职业 */, GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2305150009') AS recycling_time FROM dm_act_survey_role_zone_df WHERE NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2305150009') IS NULL AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer358, '$.2305150009') = '是' AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(finish_time, '$.2305150009') >= 10 AND (total_recycling_cnt = female_q14_cnt OR female_q14_cnt = 0) UNION ALL SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, 1 AS gt2, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer14, '$.2302120004') AS gender, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer71, '$.2302120004') AS birthday, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer16, '$.2302120004') AS occupation /* 职业 */, GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2302120004') AS recycling_time FROM dm_act_survey_role_zone_df WHERE GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2305150009') IS NULL AND NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2302120004') IS NULL AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer246, '$.2302120004') = 3 AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(finish_time, '$.2302120004') >= 20 AND (total_recycling_cnt = female_q14_cnt OR female_q14_cnt = 0) UNION ALL SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, 1 AS gt2, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer14, '$.2205230026') AS gender, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer71, '$.2205230026') AS birthday, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer16, '$.2205230026') AS occupation /* 职业 */, GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2205230026') AS recycling_time FROM dm_act_survey_role_zone_df WHERE GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2305150009') IS NULL AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2302120004') IS NULL AND NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2205230026') IS NULL AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer246, '$.2205230026') = 3 AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(finish_time, '$.2205230026') >= 20 AND (total_recycling_cnt = female_q14_cnt OR female_q14_cnt = 0)) AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY COALESCE(a.logymd, b.logymd), COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid), COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid), COALESCE(a.gt1, 0), COALESCE(b.gt2, 0), COALESCE(a.gender, b.gender), COALESCE(a.birthday, b.birthday), COALESCE(a.occupation, b.occupation), COALESCE(a.recycling_time, b.recycling_time)) AS t) AS t1) AS t2 /* 问卷活动表 */ WHERE age > 6 /* 6岁及以下占比过大不符合认知，故排除 */) AS t3 WHERE rn = 1

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_abtest_role_zone_mapping_df
sql_units: /* ----huoshan---------------------------------- */ /* 获取当前信息----火山保持原状 */ /* 火山-增量进组数据 */ WITH abtest_info_di AS (SELECT accountid, old_zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, time /* MIN(time) `time` */ FROM (SELECT accountid, old_zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, time /* MIN(time) `time` */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, old_zoneid, param_name ORDER BY time ASC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.abtestserver_abtest_tag WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t1 WHERE rn = 1), his_data_info /* 火山-存量进组数据 */ AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, group, first_entry_time, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_abtest_role_zone_mapping_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND source = 'huoshan'), his_data_info_rank /* 火山-存量实验清单 */ AS (SELECT param_name, param_version, `group` FROM mt_dim.dim_abtest_role_zone_mapping_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND source = 'huoshan' GROUP BY param_name, param_version, `group`), di_df_param_version_merge /* 火山-所有实验清单 */ AS (SELECT param_version, param_name, param_version_rank, MAX(param_version_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) AS param_version_rank_max FROM (SELECT param_version, param_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY param_name ORDER BY param_version ASC) AS param_version_rank FROM (SELECT param_version, param_name FROM abtest_info_di GROUP BY param_version, param_name /* union 有去重逻辑 */ UNION SELECT param_version, param_name FROM his_data_info_rank GROUP BY param_version, param_name) AS t1) AS t2), abtest_info_new /* 增量数据剔除剔除历史玩家数据,一个玩家一个名称的AB实验只有一个version */ /* 火山-所有进组数据 */ AS (SELECT accountid, old_zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, time FROM (SELECT accountid, old_zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, time /* min(time) time */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, old_zoneid, param_name ORDER BY time ASC) AS rn FROM (SELECT aid.accountid, aid.old_zoneid, aid.param_name, aid.param_value, aid.param_version, aid.time FROM abtest_info_di AS aid LEFT JOIN his_data_info AS hdi ON aid.accountid = hdi.accountid AND aid.old_zoneid = hdi.zoneid AND aid.param_name = hdi.param_name AND aid.param_version = hdi.param_version WHERE hdi.accountid IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT accountid, zoneid AS old_zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, first_entry_time AS time FROM his_data_info) AS t1) AS t2 WHERE rn = 1), source_huoshan /* 火山-所有进组数据拼接UID */ AS (SELECT COALESCE(t2.uid, t3.uid), t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.param_name, t1.param_value, t1.param_version, t1.`group`, t1.first_entry_time, CASE WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(param_value, '[\\x{00A0}\\r\\n]', ''), '^\\uFEFF', ''), '[^\\x00-\\x7F]', '') RLIKE '\\{\\s*"group_tag"\\s*:\\s*"(control|test\\d*)"\\s*\\}' THEN 0 WHEN LOWER(param_name) LIKE '%_aimatch_%' OR LOWER(param_name) LIKE '%_draw%' THEN 1 ELSE 1 END AS is_valid FROM (SELECT ab_new.accountid, ab_new.old_zoneid AS zoneid, ab_new.param_name, ab_new.param_value, ab_new.param_version, GET_JSON_OBJECT(ab_new.param_value, '$.group_tag') AS `group` /* 和实时保持一致 */, ab_new.time AS first_entry_time FROM abtest_info_new AS ab_new LEFT JOIN di_df_param_version_merge AS ab_now ON ab_new.param_name = ab_now.param_name AND ab_new.param_version = ab_now.param_version) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, uid FROM mt_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' >= '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31', '2024-10-01') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, MIN(uid) AS uid FROM mt_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' >= '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31', '2024-10-01') AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid) AS t3 ON t1.accountid = t3.roleid), abtest_moonton_info_di /* ----moonton---------------------------------- */ /* moonton-增量进组数据 */ AS (SELECT accountid, old_zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, time /* MIN(time) `time` */ FROM (SELECT accountid, old_zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, time /* MIN(time) `time` */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, old_zoneid, param_name ORDER BY time ASC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t1 WHERE rn = 1), his_data_moonton_info /* moonton-存量进组数据 */ AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, group, first_entry_time, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_abtest_role_zone_mapping_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND source = 'moonton'), his_data_info_moonton_rank /* moonton-存量实验清单 */ AS (SELECT param_name, param_version, `group` FROM mt_dim.dim_abtest_role_zone_mapping_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND source = 'moonton' GROUP BY param_name, param_version, `group`), di_df_param_version_merge_moonton /* moonton-所有实验清单 */ AS (SELECT param_version, param_name, param_version_rank, MAX(param_version_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) AS param_version_rank_max FROM (SELECT param_version, param_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY param_name ORDER BY param_version ASC) AS param_version_rank FROM (SELECT param_version, param_name FROM abtest_moonton_info_di GROUP BY param_version, param_name UNION SELECT param_version, param_name FROM his_data_info_moonton_rank GROUP BY param_version, param_name) AS t1) AS t2), abtest_info_new_moonton /* 增量数据剔除剔除历史玩家数据,一个玩家一个名称的AB实验只有一个version */ /* moonton-所有进组数据 */ AS (SELECT accountid, old_zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, time FROM (SELECT accountid, old_zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, time /* min(time) time */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, old_zoneid, param_name ORDER BY time ASC) AS rn FROM (SELECT aid.accountid, aid.old_zoneid, aid.param_name, aid.param_value, aid.param_version, aid.time FROM abtest_moonton_info_di AS aid LEFT JOIN his_data_moonton_info AS hdi ON aid.accountid = hdi.accountid AND aid.old_zoneid = hdi.zoneid AND aid.param_name = hdi.param_name AND aid.param_version = hdi.param_version WHERE hdi.accountid IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT accountid, zoneid AS old_zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, first_entry_time AS time FROM his_data_moonton_info) AS t1) AS t2 WHERE rn = 1), source_moonton /* moonton-所有进组数据拼接UID */ AS (SELECT COALESCE(t2.uid, t3.uid), t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.param_name, t1.param_value, t1.param_version, t1.`group`, t1.first_entry_time, CASE WHEN param_value IN ('control', 'test', 'test1', 'test2', 'test3', 'test4', 'test5') THEN 0 WHEN param_value LIKE 'control%' THEN 0 WHEN param_value LIKE 'test%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_valid FROM (SELECT ab_new.accountid, ab_new.old_zoneid AS zoneid, ab_new.param_name, ab_new.param_value, ab_new.param_version, CASE WHEN ab_new.param_value IN ('control', 'test', 'test1', 'test2', 'test3', 'test4', 'test5') THEN param_value WHEN ab_new.param_value LIKE 'control%' THEN 'control' WHEN ab_new.param_value LIKE 'test%' THEN 'test' WHEN ab_list.param_group LIKE 'control%' THEN 'control' WHEN ab_list.param_group LIKE 'test%' THEN 'test' ELSE 'non-standard' END AS `group`, ab_new.time AS first_entry_time FROM abtest_info_new_moonton AS ab_new LEFT JOIN di_df_param_version_merge_moonton AS ab_now ON ab_new.param_name = ab_now.param_name AND ab_new.param_version = ab_now.param_version LEFT JOIN (/* 恒伟从智能服务那边获取的实验配置清单 */ /* replace 是和恒伟约定的口径 */ SELECT DISTINCT param_name, SPLIT(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(version, '-版本ID', ''), '对照组', 'control'), '测试组', 'test'), ':')[0] AS param_group, SPLIT(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(version, '-版本ID', ''), '对照组', 'control'), '测试组', 'test'), ':')[1] AS param_version FROM (SELECT param_name, status, EXPLODE(versions) AS version FROM (SELECT param_name, SPLIT(versions, ',') AS versions, status FROM mt_dim.dim_abtest_list_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS tmp0) AS tmp1) AS ab_list ON ab_new.param_name = ab_list.param_name AND ab_new.param_version = ab_list.param_version) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, uid FROM mt_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' >= '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31', '2024-10-01') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, MIN(uid) AS uid FROM mt_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' >= '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31', '2024-10-01') AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid) AS t3 ON t1.accountid = t3.roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_abtest_role_zone_mapping_df PARTITION(appid = 'mlbb', logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT *, 'moonton' AS source FROM source_moonton WHERE param_value <> '__MTTD_INTERNAL_LONG_OBSERVE_GROUP__' UNION ALL SELECT *, 'huoshan' AS source FROM source_huoshan WHERE param_value <> '__MTTD_INTERNAL_LONG_OBSERVE_GROUP__'

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_active_di
sql_units: WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(zoneid < 57000, 0, 1) AS is_test, first_mt_country AS country, create_os AS os, first_network_name AS network, IF(LOWER(first_network_name) = 'organic', 1, 2) AS network_group, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create, new_type /* new_type = 3  纯净新增 */, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS channel, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), active_di AS (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) /* AND     is_ai = 0 */ GROUP BY roleid), lose_active_di AS (SELECT roleid, active_label FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_active_pay_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND granularity_type = 'account57'), attribute_account_df AS (SELECT accountid, age, CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN '1' WHEN age BETWEEN 10 AND 14 THEN '2' WHEN age BETWEEN 15 AND 19 THEN '3' WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN '4' WHEN age BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN '5' WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN '6' WHEN age >= 35 THEN '7' END AS age_group /* 年龄段 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_attribute_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND gt2 = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_decismart_active_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, COALESCE(bas.country, 'unknown') AS country, 'unknown' AS os /* 预留字段 */, COALESCE(bas.network_group, -99999) AS network_group, 'unknown' AS network /* 预留字段 */, COALESCE(los.active_label, -99999) AS active_label, COALESCE(attr.age_group, -99999) AS age_group, COUNT(*) AS active_cnt FROM active_di AS act JOIN basic AS bas ON act.roleid = bas.roleid LEFT JOIN lose_active_di AS los ON act.roleid = los.roleid LEFT JOIN attribute_account_df AS attr ON act.roleid = attr.accountid GROUP BY COALESCE(bas.country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(los.active_label, -99999) /* NVL(bas.os, 'unknown'), */ /* NVL(bas.network, 'unknown'), */, COALESCE(attr.age_group, -99999), COALESCE(bas.network_group, -99999)

name: etl.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mlbb_account_monthly
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author                           date                            desc */ /* jichun@moonton.com                2024-10-20                      https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/PByZwozuhiHEsKkUew9cTVijn7c?sheet=af11f2 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT date_range /*	日期区间 */, country /*	国家 */, os /*	创角平台 */, network /*	首次广告归因渠道 */, register_cnt /*	新增玩家数 */, pure_register_cnt /*	纯净新增玩家数 */, active_cnt /*	活跃玩家数 */, active_cnt_30days /*	近30日活跃玩家数 */, pay_cnt /*	付费玩家数 */, pay_amt /*	付费金额(美分) */, active_pay_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且最近30天内充值过的玩家 */, active_register_pay_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且新增第30天且30天内充值过的玩家 */, active_register_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且新增第30天的玩家 */, recurring_cnt_30days /*	30日回流玩家数 */, nologin_cnt_30days /*	30日未登录玩家数 */, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 0 THEN SUBARRAY(register_reten_cnt, 0, 1) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 1 THEN SUBARRAY(register_reten_cnt, 0, 2) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN SUBARRAY(register_reten_cnt, 0, 3) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 6 AND 12 THEN SUBARRAY(register_reten_cnt, 0, 4) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 13 AND 28 THEN SUBARRAY(register_reten_cnt, 0, 5) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) >= 29 THEN SUBARRAY(register_reten_cnt, 0, 6) ELSE ARRAY(0) END AS register_reten_cnt /*	新增留存数组<1,2,3,7,14,30> */, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 0 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_reten_cnt, 0, 1) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 1 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_reten_cnt, 0, 2) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_reten_cnt, 0, 3) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 6 AND 12 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_reten_cnt, 0, 4) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 13 AND 28 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_reten_cnt, 0, 5) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) >= 29 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_reten_cnt, 0, 6) ELSE ARRAY(0) END AS recurring_reten_cnt /*	回流留存数组<1,2,3,7,14,30> */, pay_amt_exrate /*	汇率校准付费金额 */, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 0 THEN SUBARRAY(pure_reten_cnt, 0, 1) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 1 THEN SUBARRAY(pure_reten_cnt, 0, 2) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN SUBARRAY(pure_reten_cnt, 0, 3) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 6 AND 12 THEN SUBARRAY(pure_reten_cnt, 0, 4) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 13 AND 28 THEN SUBARRAY(pure_reten_cnt, 0, 5) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) >= 29 THEN SUBARRAY(pure_reten_cnt, 0, 6) ELSE ARRAY(0) END AS pure_reten_cnt /*	回流留存数组<1,2,3,7,14,30> */, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 0 THEN SUBARRAY(old_reten_cnt, 0, 1) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 1 THEN SUBARRAY(old_reten_cnt, 0, 2) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN SUBARRAY(old_reten_cnt, 0, 3) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 6 AND 12 THEN SUBARRAY(old_reten_cnt, 0, 4) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 13 AND 28 THEN SUBARRAY(old_reten_cnt, 0, 5) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) >= 29 THEN SUBARRAY(old_reten_cnt, 0, 6) ELSE ARRAY(0) END AS old_reten_cnt /*	回流留存数组<1,2,3,7,14,30> */, active_cnt_period, pay_cnt_period, online_dur /*	当日玩家总在线时长(单位：s) */, new_active_cnt /*	新用户活跃玩家数 */, 0 AS register_cnt_total /*	历史总注册玩家数 */, lose_cnt_7ds /*	7日流失玩家数 */, active_cnt_7ds /*	7日前DAU */, lose_cnt_30ds /*	30日流失玩家数 */, active_cnt_30ds /*	30日前DAU */, IF(LOWER(network) = 'organic', 1, 2) AS network_group, 1 AS user_type, 'unknown' AS channel, -99999 AS new_type, -99999 AS install_label, -99999 AS arcade_label, -99999 AS active_label, recurring_cnt_14days, nologin_cnt_14days, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 0 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_14days_reten_cnt, 0, 1) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) = 1 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_14days_reten_cnt, 0, 2) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_14days_reten_cnt, 0, 3) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 6 AND 12 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_14days_reten_cnt, 0, 4) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) BETWEEN 13 AND 28 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_14days_reten_cnt, 0, 5) WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', logymd) >= 29 THEN SUBARRAY(recurring_14days_reten_cnt, 0, 6) ELSE ARRAY(0) END AS recurring_14days_reten_cnt, actual_pay_amt, NULL AS active_cnt_90days, NULL AS vaild_user_cnt, NULL AS vaild_user_online_dur, logymd /*	日期分区(yyy-MM-dd) */, 'mlbb' AS appname /*	项目ID(mlbb,xgame) */, 'account' AS granularity_type /*	粒度类型(account,device) */, 'monthly' AS date_type /*	日期类型(daily,weekly,monthly) */ FROM (SELECT date_range, LAST_DAY(CONCAT(date_range, '-01')) AS logymd, COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(network, 'unknown') AS network, COALESCE(SUM(register_cnt), 0) AS register_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(pure_register_cnt), 0) AS pure_register_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt), 0) AS active_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt_30days), 0) AS active_cnt_30days, COALESCE(SUM(pay_cnt), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt), 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(active_pay_30d_cnt), 0) AS active_pay_30d_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(active_register_pay_30d_cnt), 0) AS active_register_pay_30d_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(active_register_30d_cnt), 0) AS active_register_30d_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(recurring_cnt_30days), 0) AS recurring_cnt_30days, COALESCE(SUM(nologin_cnt_30days), 0) AS nologin_cnt_30days, COALESCE(ARRAY_MERGE(register_reten_cnt), ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)) AS register_reten_cnt, name: etl.ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_cube_di_mlbb_account_monthly
sql_units: WITH daily_mid AS (SELECT date_range, grouping_name, SUBSTRING(date_range, 1, 7) AS date_month, definition_type, region, country, network, REPLACE(SPLIT(tbl.col, ':')[0], '"', '') AS item, SPLIT(tbl.col, ':')[1] AS quantity FROM (SELECT date_range, grouping_name, definition_type, region, country, network, REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(TO_JSON(indicator_map) AS STRING), '{', ''), '}', '') AS indicator_map FROM mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_cube_di_mid WHERE logymd BETWEEN SUBSTRING(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -2)), 1, 10) /* 获取两个月的月度数据 */ AND '2026-05-31' AND date_range BETWEEN SUBSTRING(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -2)), 1, 10) /* 获取两个月的月度数据 */ AND LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -1)) AND appname = 'mlbb' AND granularity_type = 'account' AND date_type = 'daily') LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(indicator_map, ',')) /* 分隔符如果是分号的话，替换成\073 */ tbl AS col) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT date_month AS date_range /*	日期区间 */, grouping_name /*	cube组合 */, definition_type /*	区域类型 */, region /*	区域 */, country /*	国家 */, network /*	首次广告归因渠道 */, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', item, quantity))), ',', ':') AS indicator_map, LAST_DAY(CONCAT(date_month, '-01')) AS logymd, 'mlbb' AS appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'monthly' AS date_type FROM (SELECT grouping_name, date_month, definition_type, region, country, network, item, SUM(quantity) AS quantity FROM (SELECT grouping_name, date_month, definition_type, region, country, network, item, COALESCE(PERCENTILE(quantity, 0.5), 0) AS quantity /* 月度中位数 */ FROM daily_mid WHERE item IN ('gamepackage_size', 'gamepackage_size_16g', 'gamepackage_size_32g', 'gamepackage_size_64g', 'gamepackage_size_64g_more') GROUP BY grouping_name, date_month, definition_type, region, country, network, item UNION ALL SELECT grouping_name, date_month, definition_type, region, country, network, item, quantity FROM (SELECT date_range, grouping_name, date_month, LAST_DAY(CONCAT(date_month, '-01')) AS last_day_month /* 月末最后一天 */, definition_type, region, country, network, item, quantity, MAX(date_range) OVER (PARTITION BY item, date_month) AS max_date /* 当前指标最大日期 */ FROM daily_mid WHERE NOT item IN ('gamepackage_size', 'gamepackage_size_16g', 'gamepackage_size_32g', 'gamepackage_size_64g', 'gamepackage_size_64g_more')) WHERE max_date = last_day_month AND item <> '') GROUP BY grouping_name, date_month, definition_type, region, country, network, item) GROUP BY date_month, grouping_name /*	cube组合 */, definition_type /*	区域类型 */, region /*	区域 */, country /*	国家 */, network

name: wxc_outbattle_info
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: michaelhe@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-11-11 11:51:37.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH daily_out_info AS (SELECT CASE WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 1001 AND 29999 THEN '正式服' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57030 THEN '测服1-30' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 57031 AND 57999 THEN '测服31+' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 59001 AND 59999 THEN '测服59' END AS zone_type, game_channel, realpicturequality, nowpicturequality, reportpoint, reportclasspoint, isdownload, SUBSTRING_INDEX(clientversion, '.', -2) AS clientversion, maincitytype, targetframe, CASE WHEN devicesystemmemory BETWEEN 0 AND 2000 THEN '<2G' WHEN devicesystemmemory BETWEEN 2001 AND 6000 THEN '2-6G' WHEN devicesystemmemory BETWEEN 6001 AND 999999 THEN '6+G' END AS memory_type, SUM(CAST(p1 AS INT)) AS avg_ttl_time, SUM(CAST(p2 AS INT)) AS avg_active_time, SUM(CAST(p3 AS INT)) AS avg_initview_time, SUM(CAST(p4 AS INT)) AS avg_load_time, SUM(avgfps) AS avg_fps, SUM(closeunity - openunity) AS memdiff_unity, SUM(closedusedmono - beforeopenusedmono) AS memdiff_usedmono, SUM(closedlua - beforeopenlua) AS memdiff_lua, SUM(openedpss - beforeopenpss) AS memdiff_openend_pss, SUM(closedpss - beforeopenpss) AS memdiff_closepss, COUNT(*) AS open_cnt, COUNT(CAST(p1 AS INT) < 300 OR NULL) AS ttl_time_sat_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid) AS open_distinct_user, COUNT(CAST(p1 AS INT) BETWEEN 0 AND 100 OR NULL) AS time_cnt_0_100, COUNT(CAST(p1 AS INT) BETWEEN 101 AND 300 OR NULL) AS time_cnt_101_300, COUNT(CAST(p1 AS INT) BETWEEN 301 AND 600 OR NULL) AS time_cnt_301_600, COUNT(CAST(p1 AS INT) BETWEEN 601 AND 800 OR NULL) AS time_cnt_601_800, COUNT(CAST(p1 AS INT) BETWEEN 801 AND 1000 OR NULL) AS time_cnt_801_1000, COUNT(CAST(p1 AS INT) >= 1001 OR NULL) AS time_cnt_1001_plus FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_outbattle_fluency WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((reportpoint = 'uiperformancerecord' AND p5 = 1) OR (reportpoint = 'modelpanel' AND p5 = 1) OR (reportpoint = 'LeilaRecord')) GROUP BY zone_type, game_channel, realpicturequality, nowpicturequality, reportpoint, reportclasspoint, isdownload, clientversion, maincitytype, targetframe, memory_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.wxc_outbattle_info PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT * FROM daily_out_info

name: wxc_outbattle_version
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: michaelhe@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-11-11 14:16:34.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH day_info AS (SELECT CASE WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 1001 AND 29999 THEN '正式服' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57030 THEN '测服1-30' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 57031 AND 57999 THEN '测服31+' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 59001 AND 59999 THEN '测服59' END AS zone_type, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid) AS day_active_player FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_outbattle_fluency WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((reportpoint = 'uiperformancerecord' AND p5 = 1) OR (reportpoint = 'modelpanel' AND p5 = 1) OR (reportpoint = 'LeilaRecord')) GROUP BY zone_type), daily_out_info AS (SELECT CASE WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 1001 AND 29999 THEN '正式服' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57030 THEN '测服1-30' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 57031 AND 57999 THEN '测服31+' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 59001 AND 59999 THEN '测服59' END AS zone_type, SUBSTRING_INDEX(clientversion, '.', -2) AS res_version, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid) AS use_player FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_outbattle_fluency WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((reportpoint = 'uiperformancerecord' AND p5 = 1) OR (reportpoint = 'modelpanel' AND p5 = 1) OR (reportpoint = 'LeilaRecord')) GROUP BY zone_type, res_version), rest AS (SELECT t1.zone_type AS zone_type, t1.res_version AS res_version, t2.day_active_player AS day_active_player, t1.use_player AS version_use_player, NULL AS max_frame_id FROM daily_out_info AS t1 LEFT JOIN day_info AS t2 ON t1.zone_type = t2.zone_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.wxc_outbattle_version PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT * FROM rest

name: wxc_outbattle_versiondiff
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: michaelhe@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-11-11 14:17:34.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH version_cnt AS (SELECT zone_type AS zonetype_a, res_version AS res_verion_a, 0 AS version_temp_id /* row_number() OVER ( */ /*     PARTITION BY */ /*             zone_type */ /*     ORDER BY */ /*             res_version */ /* ) as version_temp_id */ FROM ml_temp.wxc_outbattle_version WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND NOT res_version IS NULL GROUP BY zone_type, res_version), his_base AS (SELECT zone_type AS zone_type_a, res_version, LAST_VALUE(day_active_player) OVER (PARTITION BY zone_type, res_version ORDER BY logymd) AS day_active_player, LAST_VALUE(version_use_player) OVER (PARTITION BY zone_type, res_version ORDER BY logymd) AS version_use_player, LAST_VALUE(logymd) OVER (PARTITION BY zone_type, res_version ORDER BY logymd) AS logymd_a, MIN(CASE WHEN version_use_player / day_active_player >= 0.05 THEN logymd ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY zone_type, res_version) AS version_online_day, t2.version_temp_id FROM ml_temp.wxc_outbattle_version AS t1 LEFT JOIN version_cnt AS t2 ON t1.res_version = t2.res_verion_a AND t1.zone_type = t2.zonetype_a WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND NOT res_version IS NULL), real_version_info AS (SELECT zone_type_a, res_version, day_active_player, version_use_player, logymd_a, version_online_day, version_temp_id FROM his_base WHERE logymd_a = '2026-05-31' AND NOT version_online_day IS NULL GROUP BY zone_type_a, res_version, day_active_player, version_use_player, logymd_a, version_online_day, version_temp_id), day_wash_info AS (SELECT t1.zone_type, reportclasspoint, t1.clientversion, t2.version_temp_id, DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, t2.version_online_day) AS version_day, SUM(time_cnt_0_100 + time_cnt_101_300) / SUM(time_cnt_0_100 + time_cnt_101_300 + time_cnt_301_600 + time_cnt_601_800 + time_cnt_801_1000 + time_cnt_1001_plus) AS sat_300, SUM(time_cnt_0_100 + time_cnt_101_300 + time_cnt_301_600) / SUM(time_cnt_0_100 + time_cnt_101_300 + time_cnt_301_600 + time_cnt_601_800 + time_cnt_801_1000 + time_cnt_1001_plus) AS sat_600, SUM(time_cnt_1001_plus) / SUM(time_cnt_0_100 + time_cnt_101_300 + time_cnt_301_600 + time_cnt_601_800 + time_cnt_801_1000 + time_cnt_1001_plus) AS bad_1000, SUM(t1.avg_ttl_time) / SUM(t1.open_cnt) AS real_ttl_time FROM ml_temp.wxc_outbattle_info AS t1 LEFT JOIN real_version_info AS t2 ON t1.clientversion = t2.res_version AND t1.zone_type = t2.zone_type_a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.zone_type, reportclasspoint, t1.clientversion, t2.version_temp_id, version_day) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.wxc_outbattle_versiondiff PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT * FROM day_wash_info

'2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), account_pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN pay_amt / 100 >= 2000 THEN 6 /* '2000以上' */ WHEN pay_amt / 100 >= 200 THEN 5 /* '[200,2000)' */ WHEN pay_amt / 100 >= 20 THEN 4 /* '[20,200)' */ WHEN pay_amt / 100 >= 2 THEN 3 /* '[2,20)' */ WHEN pay_amt / 100 > 0 THEN 2 /* '(0,2)' */ ELSE 1 END AS pay_grade, pay_amt /* 历史付费金额 */, his_first_pay_date, his_last_pay_date FROM (SELECT roleid, SUM(his_before_tax_usd_amt) AS pay_amt /* SUM(product_money) AS pay_amt, */, SUBSTRING(MIN(his_first_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_first_pay_date, SUBSTRING(MAX(his_last_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_last_pay_date FROM (SELECT roleid, product_money, his_before_tax_usd_amt, his_first_pay_time, his_last_pay_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 /* 正式服 */ AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, product_money, before_tax_usd_amt, first_pay_time, last_pay_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd > '2025-01-03' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 AND zoneid >= 57000 /* 01-03号后加入测服 */) GROUP BY roleid)), dim_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 1 AS region_type, act_geo_continent AS region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 0 AS region_type, region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */), dim_basic_country AS (SELECT bas.roleid, bas.zoneid, bas.country, bas.network_group, bas.register_dur, bas.register_date, COALESCE(con.region_type, 'unknwon') AS region_type, COALESCE(con.region, 'unknwon') AS region, COALESCE(pay_df.pay_grade, 1) AS pay_grade, pay_df.his_first_pay_date, pay_df.his_last_pay_date FROM basic AS bas LEFT JOIN account_pay_df AS pay_df ON bas.roleid = pay_df.roleid LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con ON bas.country = con.country_code), active_all_account AS (SELECT roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) /* AND     is_ai = 0 */ GROUP BY roleid), account_pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, SUM(before_tax_usd_amt) AS pay_amt /* SUM(product_money) AS pay_amt, */, SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_decismart_pay_cube_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type, amt_type) SELECT SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT network_group IS NULL, 'network_group', NULL), IF(NOT pay_grade IS NULL, 'pay_grade', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT register_dur IS NULL, 'register_dur', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(network_group, -10000) AS network_group, COALESCE(register_dur, -10000) AS register_dur, COALESCE(pay_grade, -10000) AS pay_grade, COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(actual_pay_amt, 0) AS actual_pay_amt, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt, 0 AS first_pay_cnt, COALESCE(2usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 2usd_pay_cnt, 0 AS active_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_30d_cnt, 0 AS his_pay_active_cnt, 0 AS add_diamond_amt, 0 AS add_diamond_email_amt, 0 AS sub_diamond_amt, 0 AS sub_diamond_cnt, ARRAY() AS pay_channel_cnt, ARRAY() AS pay_channel_amt, ARRAY() AS pay_iap_cnt, ARRAY() AS pay_iap_amt, ARRAY() AS sub_diamond_operate_cnt, ARRAY() AS sub_diamond_operate_amt, COALESCE(1usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 1usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(5usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 5usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(10usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 10usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(20usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS 20usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(zeropointone_usd_pay_cnt, 0) AS zeropointone_usd_pay_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt_period, 0) AS active_cnt_period, '2026-05-31' AS logymd /*	日期分区(yyy-MM-dd) */, 'mlbb' AS appname /*	项目ID(mlbb,xgame) */, 'account' AS granularity_type /*	粒度类型(account,device) */, 'monthly' AS date_type /*	日期类型(daily,weekly,monthly) */, 'before_tax_amt' AS amt_type /*	金额类型(money,before_tax_amt) */ FROM (SELECT basc.region_type, basc.region, basc.country, basc.network_group, basc.register_dur, basc.pay_grade, SUM(pay_di.pay_amt) AS pay_amt /* 付费金额 */, SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS actual_pay_amt /* 实收金额 */, SUM(IF(NOT pay_di.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS pay_cnt /* 充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 200, 1, 0)) AS 2usd_pay_cnt /* 2美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 10, 1, 0)) AS zeropointone_usd_pay_cnt /* 0.1美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 100, 1, 0)) AS 1usd_pay_cnt /* 1美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 500, 1, 0)) AS 5usd_pay_cnt /* 5美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 1000, 1, 0)) AS 10usd_pay_cnt /* 10美金充值人数 */, SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt >= 2000, 1, 0)) AS 20usd_pay_cnt /* 20美金充值人数 */, SUM(active_days) AS active_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid) AS active_cnt_period FROM dim_basic_country AS basc LEFT JOIN active_all_account AS act ON basc.roleid = act.roleid LEFT JOIN account_pay_di AS pay_di ON basc.roleid = pay_di.roleid GROUP BY basc.region_type, CUBE (basc.region, basc.country, basc.network_group, basc.register_dur, basc.pay_grade))

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: achingzhu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-11-21 17:15:51.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH battle AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, pvptype, FLOOR(battlesvrid / 1000) AS battle_group, real_road, HOUR(TIME) AS active_hour, bigranklvl, LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4)), recent_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, bigranklvl, LEVEL FROM battle WHERE rn = 1), active_hour AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, active_hour, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS active_hour_order FROM battle GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, active_hour), battle_group AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, battle_group, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS battle_group_order FROM battle GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, battle_group), real_road AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, real_road, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS real_road_order FROM battle WHERE pvptype IN (1, 2) AND real_road BETWEEN 1 AND 5 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, real_road), headtype AS (SELECT target_roleid AS roleid, target_zoneid AS zoneid, MAX(target_headtype) AS headtype /* 时间排序太慢， 数据较稳定，用周max近似。 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_friendlistbtnclick WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY target_roleid, target_zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_da.social_koc_rec_recall_feature_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, MAX(COALESCE(a.bigranklvl, b.bigranklvl)) AS bigranklvl /* 赛季刷新 */, MAX(GREATEST(a.LEVEL, b.LEVEL)) AS LEVEL /* 递增 */, MAX(COALESCE(a.first_active_hour, b.first_active_hour)) AS first_active_hour, MAX(COALESCE(a.second_active_hour, IF(a.first_active_hour <> b.first_active_hour, b.first_active_hour, b.second_active_hour))) AS second_active_hour, MAX(COALESCE(a.first_battle_group, b.first_battle_group)) AS first_battle_group, MAX(COALESCE(a.second_battle_group, IF(a.first_battle_group <> b.first_battle_group, b.first_battle_group, b.second_battle_group))) AS second_battle_group, MAX(COALESCE(a.first_real_road, b.first_real_road)) AS first_real_road, MAX(COALESCE(a.second_real_road, IF(a.first_real_road <> b.first_real_road, b.first_real_road, b.second_real_road))) AS second_real_road, MAX(COALESCE(a.headtype, b.headtype)) AS headtype FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid, c.roleid, d.roleid, e.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid, c.zoneid, d.zoneid, e.zoneid) AS zoneid, MAX(bigranklvl) AS bigranklvl, MAX(LEVEL) AS LEVEL, MAX(IF(active_hour_order = 1, active_hour, NULL)) AS first_active_hour, MAX(IF(active_hour_order = 2, active_hour, NULL)) AS second_active_hour, MAX(IF(battle_group_order = 1, battle_group, NULL)) AS first_battle_group, MAX(IF(battle_group_order = 2, battle_group, NULL)) AS second_battle_group, MAX(IF(real_road_order = 1, real_road, NULL)) AS first_real_road, MAX(IF(real_road_order = 2, real_road, NULL)) AS second_real_road, MAX(COALESCE(headtype, NULL)) AS headtype FROM recent_info AS a FULL OUTER JOIN active_hour AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid FULL OUTER JOIN battle_group AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid FULL OUTER JOIN real_road AS d ON a.roleid = d.roleid AND a.zoneid = d.zoneid FULL OUTER JOIN headtype AS e ON a.roleid = e.roleid AND a.zoneid = e.zoneid WHERE active_hour_order <= 2 AND battle_group_order <= 2 AND real_road_order <= 2 GROUP BY COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid, c.roleid, d.roleid, e.roleid), COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid, c.zoneid, d.zoneid, e.zoneid)) AS a FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_da.social_koc_rec_recall_feature_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid), COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid)

register_date, is_first_create, new_type, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS channel, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), dim_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 1 AS region_type, act_geo_continent AS region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 0 AS region_type, region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */), dim_basic_country AS (SELECT bas.roleid, bas.zoneid, bas.country, bas.network, COALESCE(con.region_type, 'unknwon') AS region_type, COALESCE(con.region, 'unknwon') AS region FROM basic AS bas LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con ON bas.country = con.country_code), gamepackagesize_loadinggame AS (SELECT CASE WHEN totalstoragespace / 1024 <= 16 THEN 1 /* 'gamepackage_size_16g' */ WHEN totalstoragespace / 1024 > 16 AND totalstoragespace / 1024 <= 32 THEN 2 /* 'gamepackage_size_32g' */ WHEN totalstoragespace / 1024 > 32 AND totalstoragespace / 1024 <= 64 THEN 3 /* 'gamepackage_size_64g' */ WHEN totalstoragespace / 1024 > 64 AND totalstoragespace / 1024 <= 128 THEN 4 /* 'gamepackage_size_64g_more' */ WHEN totalstoragespace / 1024 > 128 THEN 5 /* 'gamepackage_size_128g_more' */ ELSE -99999 /* 'unknown' */ END AS model_storage /* 这个是手机储存空间 */, CASE WHEN gradingid IN (0, 5) THEN 1 /* '全量包' */ WHEN gradingid = 1 THEN 2 /* '1档包' */ WHEN gradingid = 2 THEN 3 /* '2档包' */ WHEN gradingid = 3 THEN 4 /* '3档包' */ WHEN gradingid = 4 THEN 5 /* '4档包' */ ELSE -1 /* '无信息' */ END AS package_grade /* 分档包类型,          */, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, gamepackagesize /* 包体大小 */ FROM ml_ods.reportserver_client_gamepackagesize_loadinggame WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2023-07-01') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_decismart_gamepackage_cube_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT model_storage IS NULL, 'model_storage', NULL), IF(NOT package_grade IS NULL, 'package_grade', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT zone IS NULL, 'zone', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name /* cube组合 */, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(zone, -10000) AS zone, COALESCE(model_storage, -10000) AS model_storage, COALESCE(package_grade, -10000) AS package_grade, avg_space, mid_space, 75mid_space FROM (SELECT basc.region_type, pac.zone, basc.region, basc.country, pac.model_storage, pac.package_grade, AVG(gamepackagesize) AS avg_space, PERCENTILE(gamepackagesize, 0.5) AS mid_space /* PERCENTILE(gamepackagesize, 0.25) AS 25_space, -- 包体大小25分位数  */ /* 包体大小中位数  这个是目标，其他指标仅做来参考 */, PERCENTILE(gamepackagesize, 0.75) AS 75mid_space /* 包体大小75分位数 */ /* PERCENTILE(gamepackagesize, 0.95) AS 95_space, -- 包体大小95分位数  */ FROM dim_basic_country AS basc JOIN gamepackagesize_loadinggame AS pac ON basc.roleid = pac.roleid GROUP BY basc.region_type, CUBE (pac.zone, basc.region, basc.country, pac.model_storage, pac.package_grade)) WHERE NOT avg_space IS NULL

sql_units: /* ALTER table `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_msdk_realtime_create` drop IF EXISTS PARTITION (logymd='2026-05-31'); */ WITH t_create AS (SELECT account_id, app_id, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, point, SUBSTRING(createtime, 1, 10) AS logymd FROM (SELECT account_id, first_mt_country, createtime, app_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, app_id ORDER BY createtime) AS rn, LEAST(287, (HOUR(createtime) * 3600 + MINUTE(createtime) * 60 + SECOND(createtime)) DIV 300) AS point FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-10-14', '2024-10-14', '2026-05-31') AND app_id IN (4200, 4280, 4310) AND SUBSTRING(createtime, 1, 10) = '2026-05-31') AS t WHERE rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, appid, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, point, createdate FROM (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country, createtime, appid, createdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, appid ORDER BY createtime) AS rn, LEAST(287, (HOUR(createtime) * 3600 + MINUTE(createtime) * 60 + SECOND(createtime)) DIV 300) AS point FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-10-14', '2024-10-14', '2026-05-31') AND /*  AND zoneid NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 */ /*  AND zoneid NOT BETWEEN  29000 AND 29999 */ /* AND ( */ /*         ( */ /*         appid = 4300 AND ('2026-05-31' >= '2025-03-27' and zoneid NOT BETWEEN 9995 AND 9999 AND zoneid NOT BETWEEN  29995 AND 29999) */ /*         ) */ /*     OR ( */ /*         appid = 4300 AND ('2026-05-31' between  '2024-09-18' AND '2024-11-01' and zoneid != 10005) */ /*         ) */ /*     OR  ( */ /*         appid = 4300 AND ('2026-05-31' between  '2024-11-02' AND '2025-03-26') */ /*         ) */ (appid = 4400 AND ('2026-05-31' >= '2025-06-25' AND createdate >= '2025-06-25') /* nova_ob */ AND (zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 /* 亚太 */ OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 /* 亚太 */ OR zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 /* 欧洲 */ OR zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 /* 美国 */) /* 限制区服 */)) AS t WHERE rn = 1 AND createdate = '2026-05-31'), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid, '2026-05-31' AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-04', '2025-01-04', '2026-05-31') AND /*   AND appid in (4200,4280,4310,4300) */ (appid IN (4200, 4280, 4310) /* noba cb appid 4300 */ OR ('2026-05-31' >= '2025-06-25' AND appid = 4400 /* ob之后有正式数据 */))) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_msdk_realtime_create` PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT point, country, '' AS network, point_cnt, SUM(point_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY appname, logymd, country ORDER BY point) AS day_cnt, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'daily' AS date_type FROM (SELECT t_incr.logymd, t_incr.point, t_incr.country /*   , COALESCE(t_create.point_cnt, 0)            AS point_cnt */ /*   , COALESCE(t_create.day_cnt, 0)              AS day_cnt */ /*   , count() */, t_incr.appname, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS point_cnt FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_create ON t_create.country = t_incr.country AND t_create.point = t_incr.point AND t_create.app_id = t_incr.appid GROUP BY t_incr.logymd, t_incr.point, t_incr.country, t_incr.appname) AS t1

Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adbi.dwm_kol_discord_comment ( */ /*     app_id STRING, */ /*     page_id STRING, */ /*     page_name STRING, */ /*     post_id STRING, */ /*     post_message STRING, */ /*     post_created_time STRING, */ /*     comment_id STRING, */ /*     comment_text STRING, */ /*     comment_created_time STRING, */ /*     comment_auther_name STRING, */ /*     permalink_url STRING, */ /*     like_count BIGINT, */ /*     oppose_count BIGINT, */ /*     other_emoji_count BIGINT, */ /*     comments_count BIGINT */ /* ) */ /*  PARTITIONED BY (`p_date` STRING COMMENT '分区') STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a:/moonton-warehouse/table/advertisement_bi/adbi/dwm_kol_discord_comment' */ WITH base_comment AS (SELECT a.app_id, a.page_id, page_name, comment_id, comment_text, comment_created_time, comment_auther_name, thumbs_down_count, thumbs_up_count, other_count, reference_message_id, CASE WHEN HOUR(comment_created_time) >= 9 THEN CAST(DATE_ADD(DATE(comment_created_time), 1) AS STRING) ELSE CAST(DATE(comment_created_time) AS STRING) END AS report_date FROM (SELECT app_id, channel_id AS page_id, channel_name AS page_name, id AS comment_id, IF(channel_id = '1144576945800097852', embed_description, content) AS comment_text, CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(`timestamp`, 1, 19), 'T', ' ')) + 8 * 3600) AS TIMESTAMP) AS comment_created_time, username AS comment_auther_name, thumbs_down_count, thumbs_up_count, other_count, reference_message_id FROM adbi.ods_kol_discord_comment WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01') AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT app_id, page_id FROM adbi.kol_media_config WHERE date = '20260531' AND is_analysis = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 AND media_type = 7) AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.page_id = b.page_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwm_kol_discord_comment PARTITION(p_date = '2026-06-01') /* 查询当天的数据 */ SELECT app_id, page_id, page_name, CONCAT(page_name, REPLACE('2026-05-31', '-', '')) AS post_id, CONCAT(page_name, REPLACE('2026-05-31', '-', '')) AS post_message, CONCAT('2026-05-31', ' 00:00:00') AS post_created_time, comment_id, comment_text, comment_created_time, comment_auther_name, CONCAT('https://discord.com/channels/758889614940307476/', page_id) AS permalink_url, a.thumbs_up_count AS like_count, a.thumbs_down_count AS oppose_count, a.other_count AS other_emoji_count, IF(b.reply_count IS NULL, 0, b.reply_count) AS comments_count FROM base_comment AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT reference_message_id, COUNT(DISTINCT comment_id) AS reply_count FROM base_comment WHERE reference_message_id <> '' GROUP BY reference_message_id) AS b ON a.comment_id = b.reference_message_id WHERE a.report_date = '2026-06-01' UNION ALL /* 查询当前周的数据 (上周周一到本周周一) */ SELECT app_id, page_id, page_name, CONCAT(page_name, REPLACE('2026-05-25', '-', ''), '~', REPLACE('2026-06-01', '-', ''), 'week') AS post_id, CONCAT(page_name, REPLACE('2026-05-25', '-', ''), '~', REPLACE('2026-06-01', '-', ''), 'week') AS post_message, CONCAT('2026-05-25', ' 00:00:00') AS post_created_time, comment_id, comment_text, comment_created_time, comment_auther_name, CONCAT('https://discord.com/channels/758889614940307476/', page_id) AS permalink_url, a.thumbs_up_count AS like_count, a.thumbs_down_count AS oppose_count, a.other_count AS other_emoji_count, IF(b.reply_count IS NULL, 0, b.reply_count) AS comments_count FROM base_comment AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT reference_message_id, COUNT(DISTINCT comment_id) AS reply_count FROM base_comment WHERE reference_message_id <> '' GROUP BY reference_message_id) AS b ON a.comment_id = b.reference_message_id WHERE a.report_date >= '2026-05-26' AND a.report_date <= '2026-06-01' AND DAYOFWEEK(CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE)) = 2 UNION ALL /* 查询当月的数据 (上月1号到本月1号) */ SELECT app_id, page_id, page_name, CONCAT(page_name, '2026', '05', 'month') AS post_id /* 使用 yyyyMM 格式的 post_id */, CONCAT(page_name, '2026', '05', 'month') AS post_message, CONCAT('2026-05-01', ' 00:00:00') AS post_created_time, comment_id, comment_text, comment_created_time, comment_auther_name, CONCAT('https://discord.com/channels/758889614940307476/', page_id) AS permalink_url, a.thumbs_up_count AS like_count, a.thumbs_down_count AS oppose_count, a.other_count AS other_emoji_count, IF(b.reply_count IS NULL, 0, b.reply_count) AS comments_count FROM base_comment AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT reference_message_id, COUNT(DISTINCT comment_id) AS reply_count FROM base_comment WHERE reference_message_id <> '' GROUP BY reference_message_id) AS b ON a.comment_id = b.reference_message_id WHERE a.report_date >= '2026-05-02' AND a.report_date <= '2026-06-01' AND DAY(CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE)) = 1

name: bytedance_export.mtpass_ods.roleserver_mt_pass_on_bind
sql_units: WITH basic_date_mlbb AS (SELECT time, app_id, app_zone_id, app_role_id, accountid, pre_accountid FROM mtpass_ods.roleserver_mt_pass_on_bind WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND app_id IN (666)), basic_date_mcgg AS (SELECT t1.time, t1.app_id, t1.app_zone_id, t1.app_role_id, t1.accountid, t1.pre_accountid, t2.app_zone_id AS app_zone_id_mlbb, t2.app_role_id AS app_role_id_mlbb FROM mtpass_ods.roleserver_mt_pass_on_bind AS t1 JOIN basic_date_mlbb AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.accountid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND t1.app_id IN (667)), data_total AS (SELECT time, app_id, app_zone_id, app_role_id, accountid, pre_accountid, app_zone_id AS app_zone_id_mlbb, app_role_id AS app_role_id_mlbb FROM basic_date_mlbb UNION ALL SELECT time, app_id, app_zone_id, app_role_id, accountid, pre_accountid, app_zone_id_mlbb, app_role_id_mlbb FROM basic_date_mcgg) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.roleserver_mt_pass_on_bind PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, app_id, app_zone_id, app_role_id, accountid, pre_accountid FROM (SELECT time, app_id, app_zone_id, app_role_id, accountid, pre_accountid, app_role_id_mlbb FROM data_total) AS main_data LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS us_account FROM mt_dim.dim_bd_senssitive_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-07', '2022-05-07', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb') AS adv_us ON main_data.app_role_id_mlbb = adv_us.us_account WHERE adv_us.us_account IS NULL

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_battle_satisfaction_degree_daily
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_decismart_battle_satisfaction_degree PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', date_type = 'daily') SELECT report_date AS data_range, CASE WHEN data_type = '总体' THEN 'over_all' WHEN data_type = '国家' THEN 'country' WHEN data_type = '模块分类' THEN 'model_type' ELSE NULL END AS data_type, t2.country_code AS country, period, data_content, score FROM (SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(report_date, 'yyyy/M/d'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS report_date, period, data_type, data_content, score FROM mt_dim.dim_battlefield_satisfaction_degree WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-12-11', '2024-12-11', '2026-05-31')) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-12-11', '2024-12-11', '2026-05-31')) AS t2 ON t1.data_content = t2.country_name

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: dylandu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-12-09 15:09:44.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* create table msdk_ods.did_check_field( */ /* topic string, */ /* os_type int, */ /* unnormal_idfa_rate decimal(7,6) comment '异常idfa占比', */ /* unnormal_idfv_rate decimal(7,6) comment '异常idfv占比', */ /* unnormal_adid_rate decimal(7,6) comment '异常adid占比', */ /* unnormal_asid_rate decimal(7,6) comment '异常asid占比', */ /* unnormal_android_rate decimal(7,6) comment '异常android占比', */ /* unnormal_drm_rate decimal(7,6) comment '异常drm占比', */ /* idfv_rate decimal(7,6) comment 'idfv中和idfa相同的idfv占比', */ /* asid_rate decimal(7,6)  comment 'asid中和adid相同的asid占比' */ /* ) */ /* Stored as parquet */ /* partitioned by(logymd String); */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_ods.did_check_field PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.topic, a.os_type, CASE WHEN a.os_type = 1 THEN a.unnormal_idfa_cnt / a.idfa_cnt ELSE 0.0 END AS unnormal_idfa_rate, CASE WHEN a.os_type = 1 THEN a.unnormal_idfv_cnt / a.idfv_cnt ELSE 0.0 END AS unnormal_idfv_rate, CASE WHEN a.os_type = 2 THEN a.unnormal_gps_adid_cnt / a.gps_adid_cnt ELSE 0.0 END AS unnormal_adid_rate, CASE WHEN a.os_type = 2 THEN a.unnormal_gps_asid_cnt / a.gps_asid_cnt ELSE 0.0 END AS unnormal_asid_rate, CASE WHEN a.os_type = 2 THEN a.unnormal_android_id_cnt / a.android_id_cnt ELSE 0.0 END AS unnormal_android_rate, CASE WHEN a.os_type = 2 THEN a.unnormal_drm_id_cnt / a.drm_id_cnt ELSE 0.0 END AS unnormal_drm_rate, CASE WHEN a.os_type = 1 THEN a.idfa_equals_idfv_cnt / a.idfv_cnt ELSE 0.0 END AS idfv_rate, CASE WHEN a.os_type = 2 THEN a.adid_equals_asid_cnt / a.gps_asid_cnt ELSE 0.0 END AS asid_rate FROM (SELECT '3001-charge' AS topic, ostype_login AS os_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ostype_login = 1 THEN idfa ELSE NULL END) AS idfa_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ostype_login = 1 AND NOT (idfa RLIKE '^[0-9a-zA-Z]{8}(-[0-9a-zA-Z]{4}){3}-[0-9a-zA-Z]{12}(_[0-9]{16})?$') THEN idfa ELSE NULL END) AS unnormal_idfa_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ostype_login = 1 THEN idfv ELSE NULL END) AS idfv_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ostype_login = 1 AND NOT (idfv RLIKE '^[0-9a-zA-Z]{8}(-[0-9a-zA-Z]{4}){3}-[0-9a-zA-Z]{12}$') THEN idfv ELSE NULL END) AS unnormal_idfv_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ostype_login = 2 THEN gps_adid ELSE NULL END) AS gps_adid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ostype_login = 2 AND NOT (gps_adid RLIKE '^[0-9a-zA-Z]{8}(-[0-9a-zA-Z]{4}){3}-[0-9a-zA-Z]{12}$') THEN gps_adid ELSE NULL END) AS unnormal_gps_adid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ostype_login = 2 THEN gps_asid ELSE NULL END) AS gps_asid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ostype_login = 2 AND NOT (gps_asid RLIKE '^[0-9a-zA-Z]{8}(-[0-9a-zA-Z]{4}){3}-[0-9a-zA-Z]{12}$') THEN gps_asid ELSE NULL END) AS unnormal_gps_asid_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ostype_login = 2 THEN android_id ELSE NULL END) AS android_id_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ostype_login = 2 AND NOT CASE WHEN ostype_login = 2 AND NOT (drm_id RLIKE '^[0-9a-zA-Z]{32}$') THEN drm_id ELSE NULL END) AS unnormal_drm_id_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ostype_login = 1 AND idfv RLIKE '^[0-9a-zA-Z]{8}(-[0-9a-zA-Z]{4}){3}-[0-9a-zA-Z]{12}(_[0-9]{16})?$' AND idfa = idfv THEN idfv ELSE NULL END) AS idfa_equals_idfv_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ostype_login = 2 AND gps_asid RLIKE name: mt_ads.mlbb_battle_geo_info_di
sql_units: WITH location2ltp AS (SELECT country_code, country, state, city, latitude, longitude FROM mt_ods.location2ltp WHERE logymd = '2024-12-01' AND city <> '-'), isp_asn AS (SELECT isp, asn FROM ml_temp.limited_dimension_focud WHERE logymd = LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('2026-05-30'), -1)) /* 该表为配置表，时间不需要写死，每次运行大于等于上个月最后一天即可 */ /* LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('2026-05-31'), -1)) */ GROUP BY isp, asn), focud_country AS (SELECT country FROM ml_temp.limited_dimension_focud WHERE logymd = LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('2026-05-30'), -1)) /* 该表为配置表，时间不需要写死，每次运行大于等于上个月最后一天即可 */ GROUP BY country), battle_end_tbl AS (SELECT logymd, GEOIP(clientip, 1) AS country, SPLIT(GEOIP(clientip, 3), ' / ')[1] AS state, SPLIT(GEOIP(clientip, 3), ' / ')[2] AS city, GEOIP(clientip, 5) AS isp, GEOIP(clientip, 10) AS asn, FLOOR(battlesvrid / 1000) AS battle_svr, SUM(ping_times) AS sum_pingtimes, SUM(battletime) AS sum_battletime, SUM(CASE WHEN (ping120 + ping150 + ping200 + ping300 + ping500 + ping800) / ping_times <= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_good, COUNT(1) AS battle_num FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' /* 该时间随意修改 */ AND timedelay > 0 AND timedelay < 50000 AND maxdelay < 500000 AND timedelay <> 10000 AND ping_times <> 0 AND movelag < 10000 AND isvalid = 1 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) <> 57 GROUP BY city, country, state, isp, asn, battle_svr, logymd), tbl AS (SELECT * FROM battle_end_tbl AS a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM isp_asn AS b WHERE a.isp = b.isp AND a.asn = b.asn) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM focud_country AS b WHERE a.country = b.country)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.mlbb_battle_geo_info_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT a.country AS country, a.state AS state, a.city AS city, a.isp AS isp, a.asn AS asn, a.battle_svr AS battle_svr, b.latitude AS latitude, b.longitude AS longitude, a.sum_pingtimes AS sum_pingtimes, a.sum_battletime AS sum_battletime, a.new_good AS new_good, a.battle_num AS battle_num FROM tbl AS a LEFT JOIN location2ltp AS b ON a.city = b.city AND a.country = b.country_code AND a.state = b.state

name: ml_temp.all_player_6_week_join
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_caowl@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-12-11 19:57:11.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.all_player_6_week_join PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT CONCAT('', CASE WHEN (WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) >= 53 OR WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) = 1) AND YEAR(h1.weeks) <> YEAR(DATE_ADD(h1.weeks, 7)) THEN YEAR(h1.weeks) + 1 ELSE YEAR(h1.weeks) END, '年第', CASE WHEN WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) < 10 THEN CONCAT('0', WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks)) ELSE WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) END, '周') AS weeks /* 周数 */, labels /* 段位 */, b.single_level /* 突围等级 */, COUNT(DISTINCT h1.roleid, h1.zoneid) AS wkd_nums /* 周活跃用户 */, COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid, b.zoneid) AS join_nums /* 全民赛事参与用户 */, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS win_nums /* 全民赛事获胜用户 */, SUM(cnt) AS match_cnt /* 全民赛事战斗次数 */, SUM(1_rank) AS 1_rank_cnt /* 单排次数 */, SUM(2_rank) AS 2_rank_cnt /* 双排次数 */, SUM(3_rank) AS 3_rank_cnt /* 三排次数 */, SUM(5_rank) AS 5_rank_cnt /* 五黑次数 */, SUM(0_miniteamrank) AS 0_miniteamrank_cnt /* 无战队成员战斗次数 */, SUM(1_miniteamrank) AS 1_miniteamrank_cnt /* 1战队成员战斗次数 */, SUM(2_miniteamrank) AS 2_miniteamrank_cnt /* 2战队成员战斗次数 */, SUM(3_miniteamrank) AS 3_miniteamrank_cnt /* 3战队成员战斗次数 */, SUM(4_miniteamrank) AS 4_miniteamrank_cnt /* 4战队成员战斗次数 */, SUM(5_miniteamrank) AS 5_miniteamrank_cnt /* 5战队战斗次数 */ FROM (/* 全量用户 */ SELECT NEXT_DAY(logymd, 'SUN') AS weeks, roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di /* roleid+zoneid不唯一 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND DAYOFWEEK(logymd) BETWEEN 6 AND 7 GROUP BY NEXT_DAY(logymd, 'SUN'), roleid, zoneid) AS h1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT NEXT_DAY(logymd, 'SUN') AS weeks, roleid, zoneid, MIN(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(team_info, CONCAT(roleid, ':', zoneid, ':'))[1], ':')[1], '\\073')[0]) AS single_level, COUNT(1) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN team_num = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 1_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN team_num = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 2_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN team_num = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 3_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN team_num = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 5_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN miniteamblacknum = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 0_miniteamrank, SUM(CASE WHEN miniteamblacknum = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 1_miniteamrank, SUM(CASE WHEN miniteamblacknum = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 2_miniteamrank, SUM(CASE WHEN miniteamblacknum = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 3_miniteamrank, SUM(CASE WHEN miniteamblacknum = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 4_miniteamrank, SUM(CASE WHEN miniteamblacknum = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 5_miniteamrank FROM ml_ods.gameserver_allplayer_single_battle_end /* roleid+zoneid 唯一,增量表 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY NEXT_DAY(logymd, 'SUN'), roleid, zoneid) AS b ON h1.roleid = b.roleid AND h1.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN his_last_rankstar < 10 THEN '1-勇士' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 21 THEN '2-精英' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 37 THEN '3-大师' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 62 THEN '4-宗师' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 87 THEN '5-史诗' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 112 THEN '6-传奇' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 137 THEN '7-神话' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 162 THEN '8-百战神话' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 212 THEN '9-荣耀神话' ELSE '10-至尊神话' END AS labels FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df /* roleid+zonid—+一个分区唯一 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype = 2 /* 排位 */) AS rank_last ON h1.roleid = rank_last.roleid AND h1.zoneid = rank_last.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT NEXT_DAY(logymd, 'SUN') AS weeks, roleid, zoneid, MAX(fight_times) AS fight_times, MAX(extra_fight_times) AS extra_fight_times FROM ml_ods.gameserver_allplayer_single_champion /* roleid+zoneid唯一，增量表 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY NEXT_DAY(logymd, 'SUN'), roleid, zoneid) AS a ON b.roleid = a.roleid AND b.zoneid = a.zoneid GROUP BY CONCAT('', CASE WHEN (WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) >= 53 OR WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) = 1) AND YEAR(h1.weeks) <> YEAR(DATE_ADD(h1.weeks, 7)) THEN YEAR(h1.weeks) + 1 ELSE YEAR(h1.weeks) END, '年第', CASE WHEN WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) < 10 THEN CONCAT('0', WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks)) ELSE WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) END, '周'), labels, single_level

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_decismart_battle_exp_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* 获取玩家最近的战斗场次数 */ WITH battle_info_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, is_fake_ai, pvptype, realpvptype, day_last_bigranklvl, day_last_minranklvl, SUM(battle_cnt) AS day_battle_cnt, SUM(battle_duration) AS day_battle_duration, SUM(win_cnt) AS day_win_cnt, SUM(black_cnt) AS day_black_cnt, SUM(black2_cnt) AS day_black2_cnt, SUM(black3_cnt) AS day_black3_cnt, SUM(black5_cnt) AS day_black5_cnt, SUM(invalid_battle_cnt) AS day_invalid_cnt, 0 AS day_surrender_cnt, SUM(illegal_cnt) AS day_illegal_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (zoneid DIV 1000) < 57 AND /* AND     nvl(is_fake_ai, 0) = 0 */ pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, day_last_bigranklvl, day_last_minranklvl, is_fake_ai), surr_info_di AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, day_last_bigranklvl, day_last_minranklvl, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS day_surrender_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, realpvptype, issurrender, isinvalidbattle, FIRST_VALUE(bigranklvl) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS day_last_bigranklvl, FIRST_VALUE(minranklvl) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS day_last_minranklvl FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND /* and fake_ai=0 */ zoneid < 57000) AS t1 name: etl.mt_ads.ads_mgbi_online_cube_di_account_mlbb_daily
sql_units: WITH real_country_online AS (SELECT div_time, country, SUM(real_online_num) AS online_num FROM (SELECT `TIME`, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`TIME`) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time, LOWER(country) AS country, zone_id, (COALESCE(online_num, 0) - COALESCE(vp_online_num, 0)) AS real_online_num /* 真实玩家在线人数 */, logymd FROM ml_ods.connserver_t_real_country_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zone_id < 57000) GROUP BY div_time, country), real_os_online AS (SELECT `TIME`, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`TIME`) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time /* 每5分钟记一次,间隔在五分钟内的，计入当前5分钟 */, zone_id DIV 1000 AS big_zone, CASE WHEN os_type = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN os_type = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN os_type = 3 THEN 'emulator' ELSE 'unknown' END AS os_type, (COALESCE(online_num, 0) - COALESCE(vp_online_num, 0)) AS online_num /* 真实玩家在线人数 */, logymd FROM ml_ods.connserver_t_real_os_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zone_id < 57000), dim_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 1 AS region_type, act_geo_continent AS region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 0 AS region_type, region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */), online_cube AS (/* 分国家和区域 */ SELECT region_type, region, country, NULL AS os_type, NULL AS big_zone, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, AVG(online_num) AS acu FROM (SELECT con.region_type, con.region, lin.country, lin.div_time, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_country_online AS lin LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con ON lin.country = con.country_code GROUP BY con.region_type, con.region, lin.country, lin.div_time, GROUPING SETS ((con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region, lin.country), (con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region), (con.region_type, lin.div_time, lin.country))) GROUP BY region_type, region, country /* ----总况 */ UNION ALL SELECT region_type AS region_type, NULL AS region, NULL AS country, os_type, big_zone, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, AVG(online_num) AS acu FROM (SELECT lin.div_time, 0 AS region_type, lin.os_type, lin.big_zone, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_os_online AS lin GROUP BY lin.div_time, CUBE (lin.os_type, lin.big_zone) UNION ALL SELECT lin.div_time, 1 AS region_type, lin.os_type, lin.big_zone, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_os_online AS lin GROUP BY lin.div_time, CUBE (lin.os_type, lin.big_zone)) GROUP BY region_type, os_type, big_zone) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_mgbi_online_cube_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT big_zone IS NULL, 'big_zone', NULL), IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT os_type IS NULL, 'os', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(big_zone, -10000) AS big_zone, COALESCE(os_type, 'all') AS os, COALESCE(pcu, 0) AS pcu, COALESCE(acu, 0) AS acu, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, 'mlbb' AS appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'daily' AS date_type FROM online_cube

AND diff_days < 539 THEN SUBARRAY(reten_cnt, 0, 187) WHEN diff_days >= 539 AND diff_days < 629 THEN SUBARRAY(reten_cnt, 0, 188) WHEN diff_days >= 629 AND diff_days < 719 THEN SUBARRAY(reten_cnt, 0, THEN SUBARRAY(reten_cnt, 0, 192) WHEN diff_days >= 989 AND diff_days < 1079 THEN SUBARRAY(reten_cnt, 0, 193) ELSE reten_cnt END AS reten_cnt_diff, CASE WHEN diff_days >= 0 AND diff_days < 179 THEN SUBARRAY(ltv, 0, diff_days + 1) WHEN diff_days >= 179 AND diff_days < 209 THEN SUBARRAY(ltv, 0, 180) WHEN diff_days >= 209 AND diff_days < 239 THEN SUBARRAY(ltv, 0, 181) WHEN diff_days >= 239 AND diff_days < 269 THEN SUBARRAY(ltv, 0, 182) WHEN diff_days >= 269 AND diff_days < 299 THEN SUBARRAY(ltv, 0, 183) WHEN diff_days >= 299 AND diff_days < 329 THEN SUBARRAY(ltv, 0, 184) WHEN diff_days >= 329 AND diff_days < 359 THEN SUBARRAY(ltv, 0, 185) WHEN diff_days >= 359 AND diff_days < 449 THEN SUBARRAY(ltv, 0, 186) WHEN diff_days >= 449 AND diff_days < 539 THEN SUBARRAY(ltv, 0, 187) WHEN granularity_type = 'account57')) GROUP BY register_date, country, os, channel, network

name: ml_temp.all_player_6_week_join_country
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_caowl@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-12-20 11:55:29.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.all_player_6_week_join_country PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT CONCAT('', CASE WHEN (WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) >= 53 OR WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) = 1) AND YEAR(h1.weeks) <> YEAR(DATE_ADD(h1.weeks, 7)) THEN YEAR(h1.weeks) + 1 ELSE YEAR(h1.weeks) END, '年第', CASE WHEN WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) < 10 THEN CONCAT('0', WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks)) ELSE WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) END, '周') AS weeks /* 周数 */, IF(h1.country IS NULL, 'unknown', h1.country) AS country /* 国家缩写 */, IF(d.country_name IS NULL, 'unknown', d.country_name) AS country_name /* 国家名称 */, labels /* 段位 */, b.single_level /* 突围等级 */, COUNT(DISTINCT h1.roleid, h1.zoneid) AS wkd_nums /* 周活跃用户 */, COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid, b.zoneid) AS join_nums /* 全民赛事参与用户 */, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS win_nums /* 全民赛事获胜用户 */, SUM(cnt) AS match_cnt /* 全民赛事战斗次数 */, SUM(1_rank) AS 1_rank_cnt /* 单排次数 */, SUM(2_rank) AS 2_rank_cnt /* 双排次数 */, SUM(3_rank) AS 3_rank_cnt /* 三排次数 */, SUM(5_rank) AS 5_rank_cnt /* 五黑次数 */, SUM(0_miniteamrank) AS 0_miniteamrank_cnt /* 无战队成员战斗次数 */, SUM(1_miniteamrank) AS 1_miniteamrank_cnt /* 1战队成员战斗次数 */, SUM(2_miniteamrank) AS 2_miniteamrank_cnt /* 2战队成员战斗次数 */, SUM(3_miniteamrank) AS 3_miniteamrank_cnt /* 3战队成员战斗次数 */, SUM(4_miniteamrank) AS 4_miniteamrank_cnt /* 4战队成员战斗次数 */, SUM(5_miniteamrank) AS 5_miniteamrank_cnt /* 5战队战斗次数 */ FROM (/* 全量用户 */ SELECT NEXT_DAY(logymd, 'SUN') AS weeks, MIN(UPPER(ip_country)) AS country, roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di /* roleid+zoneid不唯一 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND DAYOFWEEK(logymd) BETWEEN 6 AND 7 GROUP BY NEXT_DAY(logymd, 'SUN'), roleid /* upper(ip_country), */, zoneid) AS h1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT NEXT_DAY(logymd, 'SUN') AS weeks, roleid, zoneid, MIN(SPLIT(SPLIT(SPLIT(team_info, CONCAT(roleid, ':', zoneid, ':'))[1], ':')[1], '\\073')[0]) AS single_level, COUNT(1) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN team_num = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 1_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN team_num = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 2_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN team_num = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 3_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN team_num = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 5_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN miniteamblacknum = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 0_miniteamrank, SUM(CASE WHEN miniteamblacknum = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 1_miniteamrank, SUM(CASE WHEN miniteamblacknum = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 2_miniteamrank, SUM(CASE WHEN miniteamblacknum = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 3_miniteamrank, SUM(CASE WHEN miniteamblacknum = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 4_miniteamrank, SUM(CASE WHEN miniteamblacknum = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 5_miniteamrank FROM ml_ods.gameserver_allplayer_single_battle_end /* roleid+zoneid 唯一,增量表 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY NEXT_DAY(logymd, 'SUN'), roleid, zoneid) AS b ON h1.roleid = b.roleid AND h1.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN his_last_rankstar < 10 THEN '1-勇士' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 21 THEN '2-精英' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 37 THEN '3-大师' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 62 THEN '4-宗师' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 87 THEN '5-史诗' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 112 THEN '6-传奇' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 137 THEN '7-神话' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 162 THEN '8-百战神话' WHEN his_last_rankstar < 212 THEN '9-荣耀神话' ELSE '10-至尊神话' END AS labels FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_rank_role_zone_df /* roleid+zonid—+一个分区唯一 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND pvptype = 2 /* 排位 */) AS rank_last ON h1.roleid = rank_last.roleid AND h1.zoneid = rank_last.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT NEXT_DAY(logymd, 'SUN') AS weeks, roleid, zoneid, MAX(fight_times) AS fight_times, MAX(extra_fight_times) AS extra_fight_times FROM ml_ods.gameserver_allplayer_single_champion /* roleid+zoneid唯一，增量表 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY NEXT_DAY(logymd, 'SUN'), roleid, zoneid) AS a ON b.roleid = a.roleid AND b.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT UPPER(country_code) AS country, country_name FROM mt_dim.config_country) AS d ON h1.country = d.country GROUP BY CONCAT('', CASE WHEN (WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) >= 53 OR WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) = 1) AND YEAR(h1.weeks) <> YEAR(DATE_ADD(h1.weeks, 7)) THEN YEAR(h1.weeks) + 1 ELSE YEAR(h1.weeks) END, '年第', CASE WHEN WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) < 10 THEN CONCAT('0', WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks)) ELSE WEEKOFYEAR(h1.weeks) END, '周'), IF(h1.country IS NULL, 'unknown', h1.country), IF(d.country_name IS NULL, 'unknown', d.country_name), labels, single_level

name: dujie次数嵌套累加表
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_lidw@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-02-19 14:45:16.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH table1 AS (SELECT accountid, dujie_rank, COUNT(1) AS dujie_count FROM (SELECT accountid, logymd, time, battleid, bigranklvl, CASE WHEN bigranklvl = 1 AND rankstar = 9 THEN 1 /* 渡劫状态筛选 */ WHEN bigranklvl = 2 AND rankstar = 21 THEN 2 WHEN bigranklvl = 3 AND rankstar = 37 THEN 3 WHEN bigranklvl = 4 AND rankstar = 62 THEN 4 WHEN bigranklvl = 5 AND rankstar = 87 THEN 5 WHEN bigranklvl = 6 AND rankstar = 112 THEN 6 WHEN bigranklvl = 7 AND rankstar = 136 THEN 7 WHEN bigranklvl = 7 AND rankstar = 161 THEN 8 WHEN bigranklvl = 7 AND rankstar = 211 THEN 9 ELSE 0 END AS dujie_rank FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype = 2 AND fake_ai = 0) WHERE dujie_rank <> 0 GROUP BY accountid, dujie_rank) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.sdw_dujie_count_table2 SELECT COALESCE(a.accountid, b.accountid) AS accountid, COALESCE(a.dujie_rank, b.dujie_rank) AS dujie_rank, COALESCE(a.dujie_count, 0) + COALESCE(b.dujie_count, 0) AS dujie_count FROM ml_temp.sdw_dujie_count_table2 AS a FULL OUTER JOIN table1 AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.dujie_rank = b.dujie_rank
