name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_mlbb_realtime_create_all_servers_daily
sql_units: WITH t_create AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT roleid AS account_id, first_mt_country AS country, register_date AS logymd, LEAST(287, (HOUR(register_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(register_time) * 60 + SECOND(register_time)) DIV 300) AS point FROM (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country, account_register_time, account_register_date, register_date, register_time FROM `mt_dim`.`dim_basic_role_zone_df` WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-06', '2023-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND /* AND     zoneid < 57000 */ /* AND     appid = 'mlbb' */ zoneid < IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03', 57000, 999999) AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1 AND register_date = '2026-05-31') AS t2) AS t), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-12-23', '2024-12-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mlbb_synclog') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_mlbb_realtime_create_all_servers` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, '' AS network, COALESCE(t2.point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(t2.point_cnt, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS day_cnt FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN (SELECT point, country, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS point_cnt FROM t_create GROUP BY logymd, point, country HAVING point_cnt > 0) AS t2 ON t2.point = t_incr.point AND t2.country = t_incr.country

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_realtime_login_daily_mlbb
sql_units: WITH t_basic /* GROUP BY roleid */ AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country, is_ai /*              , MAX(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country */ FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-06', '2023-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND /*   AND zoneid < 57000 */ /*   AND zoneid < IF( '2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03',  57000 , 999999) */ /*   AND is_ai = 0 */ /*   AND is_first_create = 1 */ is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31'), t /* where nvl(is_ai,0) = 0 and t.roleid is not null */ AS (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login AS a LEFT JOIN (/* 剔除异常账号的创角 */ SELECT accountid /* 异常账号 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_abnormal_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-10-20', '2025-10-20', '2026-05-31') AND create_date <= '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.roleid = b.accountid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /*    AND zoneid < 57000 */ zoneid < IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03', 57000, 999999) AND b.accountid IS NULL /*    AND channel NOT IN ('and_bdvp', 'and_bdvp_test') */ GROUP BY logymd, roleid, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300)) AS t /*  LEFT JOIN t_basic */ RIGHT JOIN t_basic ON t.roleid = t_basic.roleid WHERE NOT t.roleid IS NULL), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-12-23', '2024-12-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mlbb_synclog'), t_login_base AS (SELECT logymd, point, country, SUM(point_cnt) AS point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT logymd, point, country, point_cnt, ct AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT logymd, point, country, 0 AS point_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS ct FROM (SELECT roleid, country, logymd, MIN(point) AS point FROM t GROUP BY roleid, country, logymd) AS t2 GROUP BY logymd, point, country) AS t3 UNION ALL SELECT logymd, point, country, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS point_cnt, 0 AS day_cnt FROM t GROUP BY logymd, point, country) AS t GROUP BY logymd, point, country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_login` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country, '' AS network, point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname ORDER BY point) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_login_base.point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt, COALESCE(t_login_base.day_cnt, 0) AS day_cnt, t_incr.appname FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_login_base ON t_incr.country = t_login_base.country AND t_incr.point = t_login_base.point) AS t1

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_mlbb_realtime_recurring_all_servers_daily
sql_units: WITH t_basic /*   AND zoneid < IF( '2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03',  57000 , 999999) */ /* AND  zoneid < 57000 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, is_first_create, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-20', '2023-05-20', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND /*   AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' */ is_first_create = 1 AND register_date < '2026-05-01'), t_active_30d AS (SELECT roleid, MAX(logymd) AS lyd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 30 * -1) AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1) AND /*   AND zoneid < 57000 */ zoneid < IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', 57000, 999999) GROUP BY roleid), t_active_di AS (SELECT roleid, logymd, LEAST(287, (HOUR(day_first_active_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(day_first_active_time) * 60 + SECOND(day_first_active_time)) DIV 300) AS point FROM (SELECT roleid, logymd, day_first_active_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY day_first_active_time) AS rn FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND /* AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 */ zoneid < IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03', 57000, 999999)) AS t WHERE rn = 1), t_real_active AS (SELECT roleid, logymd, point, first_mt_country AS country FROM (SELECT t_active_di.*, t_basic.register_date, t_basic.first_mt_country FROM t_basic JOIN t_active_di ON t_active_di.roleid = t_basic.roleid) AS t), t_recurr AS (SELECT logymd, point, country, SUM(is_recurr) AS point_cnt FROM (SELECT t_real_active.*, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(t_real_active.logymd, COALESCE(t_active_30d.lyd, '1970-01-01')) > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_recurr FROM t_real_active LEFT JOIN t_active_30d ON t_real_active.roleid = t_active_30d.roleid) AS t GROUP BY logymd, point, country HAVING point_cnt > 0), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appid, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-12-23', '2024-12-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mlbb_synclog') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_mlbb_realtime_recurring_all_servers` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country, '' AS network, point_cnt, SUM(point_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY point) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_recurr.point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_recurr ON t_incr.country = t_recurr.country AND t_incr.point = t_recurr.point) AS t1

name: etl.dim_gamebi_active_pay_di_account57
sql_units: WITH basic_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, create_os, first_network_name, is_first_create, new_type, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND is_first_create = 1), active_di_acc AS (SELECT logymd, roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY logymd, roleid), pay_acc AS (SELECT roleid FROM (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 /* 正式服 */ AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 UNION ALL SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd > '2025-01-03' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 AND zoneid >= 57000 /* 01-03号后加入测服 */) GROUP BY roleid), active_pay_acc AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_pay /* 历史是否付费 */ FROM active_di_acc AS a LEFT JOIN pay_acc AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid GROUP BY a.logymd, a.roleid, is_pay), id_df_acc AS (SELECT roleid, MAX(is_main) AS is_main /* 大小号 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_main_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid), active_info AS (SELECT roleid, MAX(IF(logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-05-17', 1, 0)) AS is_1_14d, MAX(IF(logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-05-01', 1, 0)) AS is_1_30d, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-05-24', logymd, NULL)) AS active_days, MAX(logymd) AS last_active_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= '2025-12-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_gamebi_active_pay_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', granularity_type = 'account57') SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(network, 'unknown') AS network, COALESCE(is_main, -1) AS is_main, COALESCE(user_type, -1) AS user_type, COALESCE(is_pay, -1) AS is_pay, COALESCE(active_label, -1) AS active_label, COALESCE(is_recurring_14days, 0) AS is_recurring_14days FROM (SELECT active_acc.roleid AS roleid, -99999 AS zoneid, basic_df.first_mt_country AS country, basic_df.create_os AS os, basic_df.first_network_name AS network, id_df.is_main, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(active_acc.logymd, basic_df.register_date) > 30 AND (act_info.is_1_30d IS NULL OR act_info.is_1_30d = 0) THEN 'lose30d' /* -当日活跃，切过去T-1~T-30日未活跃的玩家，回流玩家，且非T~T-30 新增玩家 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(active_acc.logymd, basic_df.register_date) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(active_acc.logymd, basic_df.register_date) < 30 THEN 'new' ELSE 'old' END AS user_type, active_acc.is_pay /* 历史是否付费 */, CASE WHEN basic_df.register_date = '2026-05-31' THEN 0 /* 当日新增 */ WHEN act_info.active_days BETWEEN 1 AND 2 OR (basic_df.register_date >= '2026-05-24' AND act_info.last_active_date IS NULL) THEN 1 /* 在T-1~T-7期间活跃天数1~2：周低活  存在极少量最近7天新的的用户，但是没有活跃，归为周地活 */ WHEN act_info.active_days BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 2 /* 在T-1~T-7期间活跃天数3~5：周中活 */ WHEN act_info.active_days BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN 3 /* 在T-1~T-7期间活跃天数6~7：周高活 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_date BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-23' THEN 4 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-8~T-14天内：7~14日回流 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-16' THEN 5 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-15~T-30天内：14~30日回流 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' THEN 6 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-31~T-60天内：30~60日回流 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2026-03-31' THEN 7 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-61~T-180天内：60~180日回流 */ ELSE 8 END AS active_label /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-181及以上：半年以上回流 */, IF(DATEDIFF(active_acc.logymd, basic_df.register_date) > 14 AND (act_info.is_1_14d IS NULL OR act_info.is_1_14d = 0), 1, 0) AS is_recurring_14days FROM active_pay_acc AS active_acc JOIN basic_df ON active_acc.roleid = basic_df.roleid LEFT JOIN id_df_acc AS id_df ON active_acc.roleid = id_df.roleid LEFT JOIN active_info AS act_info ON active_acc.roleid = act_info.roleid) AS t

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_zgame_behavior_info_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH t_basic AS (SELECT * FROM bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df_tmp WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), active_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, DATEARRAY_TO_BIT(COLLECT_SET(logymd), '2026-05-31') AS active_info FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, LOGYMD FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, LOGYMD UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, LOGYMD FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, LOGYMD UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, LOGYMD FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_fight_pve WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, LOGYMD) AS A GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS B GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), charge_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, DATEMAP_TO_BIT(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(charge_amt)), ',', ':'), '2026-05-31') AS charge_arr, DATEMAP_TO_SUMBIT(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(charge_amt)), ',', ':'), '2026-05-31') AS cum_charge_arr FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, CONCAT_WS(':', logymd, SUM(CAST(COALESCE(money, 0) AS BIGINT))) AS charge_amt FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND money > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_zgame_behavior_info_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, register_date, active_info, CAST(ARRAY_REVERSE(ARRAY_REVERSE(charge_arr)) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_arr, CAST(ARRAY_REVERSE(ARRAY_REVERSE(cum_charge_arr)) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS cum_charge_arr FROM t_basic AS t0 LEFT JOIN active_info AS t1 ON t1.roleid = t0.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t0.zoneid LEFT JOIN charge_info AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_solar_core_account_di_temp.mlbb
sql_units: /* set spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.initialPartitionNum=300; */ /* set spark.sql.adaptive.maxNumPostShufflePartitions=400; */ /* set spark.driver.memory=6g; */ /* set spark.sql.shuffle.partitions=300; */ /* with account_create as( */ /* SELECT */ /*     -- case when appid='mlbb' then 6571 */ /*     --      when appid='mla' then 4444 */ /*     -- end as app_id, */ /*     appid, */ /*     first_mt_country, */ /*     account_register_date, */ /*     accountid */ /* from mt_dim.dim_attr_account_df */ /* where logymd=if('2026-05-31'<'2022-05-06','2022-05-06','2026-05-31') */ /* and appid='mlbb' */ /* --and account_register_date in ('2026-05-30' ,'2026-05-25' ,'2026-05-18' ,'2026-05-02') */ /* ) */ WITH role_create /* and account_register_date in ('2026-05-30' ,'2026-05-25' ,'2026-05-18' ,'2026-05-02') */ AS (SELECT roleid, appid, zoneid, first_mt_country, is_first_create, is_pure, new_type, register_date /* account_register_date, */ /* accountid */ FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb'), active_info AS (SELECT 6571 AS app_id, multi_df.first_mt_country, COUNT(IF(multi_df.is_active = 1, 1, NULL)) AS dau, COUNT(IF(multi_df.is_active_7d = 1, 1, NULL)) AS wau, COUNT(IF(multi_df.is_active_30d = 1, 1, NULL)) AS mau, SUM(multi_df.day_login_duration) AS duration_cnt, SUM(IF(NOT acct.rid IS NULL, multi_df.total_pay_amount_7d, 0)) AS ltv7 FROM (SELECT beh_df.roleid, COALESCE(role_country.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, MAX(beh_df.is_active) AS is_active, MAX(IF(SUBSTRING(beh_df.his_last_active_time, 1, 10) >= '2026-05-25', 1, 0)) AS is_active_7d, MAX(IF(SUBSTRING(beh_df.his_last_active_time, 1, 10) >= '2026-05-02', 1, 0)) AS is_active_30d, SUM(IF(SUBSTRING(beh_df.his_last_active_time, 1, 10) = '2026-05-31', day_login_duration, 0)) AS day_login_duration, SUM(BIGINT(SPLIT(beh_df.amount_info, ',')[0]) - COALESCE(BIGINT(SPLIT(beh_df.amount_info, ',')[7]), 0)) AS total_pay_amount_7d /*    sum(if(logymd>='2022-05-01',total_pay_amount,amount_info[datediff('2022-05-01','2026-05-31')])) as total_pay_amount, */ /*    sum(case when logymd>='2022-05-01' then amount_info[0]-amount_info[dayofyear('2026-05-31')] */ /*             else amount_info[datediff('2022-05-01','2026-05-31')]-amount_info[dayofyear('2026-05-31')] */ /*        end）as total_pay_amount_year */ FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_behavior_role_zone_df AS beh_df LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid AS rid, first_mt_country FROM role_create WHERE appid = 'mlbb' AND is_first_create = 1) AS role_country ON beh_df.roleid = role_country.rid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((SUBSTRING(his_last_active_time, 1, 10) >= '2026-05-02' AND SUBSTRING(his_last_active_time, 1, 10) <= '2026-05-31') /* 最近30天活跃过的 */ OR (LOCATE('1', SUBSTRING(pay_info, 1, 7)) > 0) /* 最近7天付费过的 */) AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, COALESCE(role_country.first_mt_country, 'unknown')) AS multi_df LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid AS rid FROM role_create WHERE appid = 'mlbb' AND register_date = '2026-05-25' AND is_pure = 1 AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid) AS acct ON multi_df.roleid = acct.rid GROUP BY first_mt_country), pay_info AS (SELECT 6571 AS app_id, first_mt_country, COUNT(IF(day_pay_amount > 0, 1, NULL)) AS paid_user_cnt, SUM(day_pay_amount) AS pay_amt, SUM(total_pay_amount_year) AS year_pay_amt, SUM(total_pay_amount) AS total_pay_amt, SUM(day_pay_amount_exrate) AS pay_extra_amt, SUM(total_pay_amount_exrate_year) AS year_pay_extra_amt, SUM(total_pay_amount_exrate) AS total_pay_extra_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', day_pay_amount, 0)) AS day_pay_amount, SUM(IF(SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 4) >= SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 4), day_pay_amount, 0)) AS total_pay_amount_year, SUM(day_pay_amount) AS total_pay_amount, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', day_pay_amount_exrate, 0)) AS day_pay_amount_exrate, SUM(IF(SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 4) >= SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 4), day_pay_amount_exrate, 0)) AS total_pay_amount_exrate_year, SUM(day_pay_amount_exrate) AS total_pay_amount_exrate FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di AS pay LEFT JOIN (SELECT first_mt_country, roleid AS rid FROM role_create WHERE is_first_create = 1 AND appid = 'mlbb') AS attr ON pay.roleid = attr.rid WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown')) AS pay_di GROUP BY first_mt_country), retention_info AS (SELECT 6571 AS app_id, first_mt_country, SUM(IF(register_date = '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS new_retention_2d, SUM(IF(register_date = '2026-05-25', 1, 0)) AS new_retention_7d, SUM(IF(register_date = '2026-05-18', 1, 0)) AS new_retention_14d, SUM(IF(register_date = '2026-05-02', 1, 0)) AS new_retention_30d FROM (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_behavior_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_active = 1 /* or is_pay=1) */ AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, first_mt_country) AS active_di JOIN (SELECT roleid AS rid, register_date FROM role_create WHERE appid = 'mlbb' AND is_pure = 1 AND zoneid < 57000 AND register_date IN ('2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-18', '2026-05-02') GROUP BY roleid, register_date) AS rol ON active_di.roleid = rol.rid /* where acct.accountid is not null */ GROUP BY first_mt_country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_solar_core_account_di_temp PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT 6571 AS app_id, 'mlbb' AS app_name, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '2016-07-21') + 1 AS obt_date, COALESCE(rol.first_mt_country, active_info.first_mt_country, pay_info.first_mt_country, retention_info.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country_code, COALESCE(dnu, 0) AS dnu, COALESCE(dau, 0) AS dau, COALESCE(wau, 0) AS wau, COALESCE(mau, 0) AS mau, COALESCE(paid_user_cnt, 0) AS paid_user_cnt, 'USD' AS currency_type, COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(year_pay_amt, 0) AS year_pay_amt, COALESCE(total_pay_amt, 0) AS total_pay_amt, COALESCE(pay_extra_amt, 0) AS pay_extra_amt, COALESCE(year_pay_extra_amt, 0) AS year_pay_extra_amt, COALESCE(total_pay_extra_amt, 0) AS total_pay_extra_amt, COALESCE(duration_cnt, 0) AS duration_cnt, COALESCE(new_user_cnt_2d, 0) AS new_user_cnt_2d, COALESCE(new_user_cnt_7d, 0) AS new_user_cnt_7d, COALESCE(new_user_cnt_14d, 0) AS new_user_cnt_14d, COALESCE(new_user_cnt_30d, 0) AS new_user_cnt_30d, COALESCE(new_retention_2d, 0) AS new_retention_2d, COALESCE(new_retention_7d, 0) AS new_retention_7d, COALESCE(new_retention_14d, 0) AS new_retention_14d, COALESCE(new_retention_30d, 0) AS new_retention_30d, COALESCE(ltv7, 0) AS ltv7 /* ,'mlbb' as appid */ FROM (SELECT first_mt_country, COUNT(IF(register_date = '2026-05-31', roleid, NULL)) AS dnu, COUNT(IF(register_date = '2026-05-30', roleid, NULL)) AS new_user_cnt_2d, COUNT(IF(register_date = '2026-05-25', roleid, NULL)) AS new_user_cnt_7d, COUNT(IF(register_date = '2026-05-18', roleid, NULL)) AS new_user_cnt_14d, COUNT(IF(register_date = '2026-05-02', roleid, NULL)) AS new_user_cnt_30d FROM (SELECT first_mt_country, roleid, register_date FROM role_create WHERE appid = 'mlbb' AND is_pure = 1 AND zoneid < 57000 AND register_date IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-18', '2026-05-02') GROUP BY first_mt_country, roleid, register_date) AS ro GROUP BY first_mt_country) AS rol FULL JOIN active_info ON rol.first_mt_country = active_info.first_mt_country FULL JOIN pay_info ON COALESCE(rol.first_mt_country, active_info.first_mt_country) = pay_info.first_mt_country FULL JOIN retention_info ON COALESCE(rol.first_mt_country, active_info.first_mt_country, pay_info.first_mt_country) = retention_info.first_mt_country

name: 社交健康指标监控ads表ads_wmz_socail_health_indicators_wi
sql_units: WITH battle_with_friend AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id, COUNT(*) AS pv FROM ml_ods.gameserver_battle_with_friend WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' /* 跑一周 */ AND zoneid <= 57000 AND friend_zone_id <= 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, friend_role_id, friend_zone_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.ads_wmz_socail_health_indicators_wi PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT first_mt_country, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS wau /* wau */, COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid, b.zoneid) AS wbu /* 点数 */, SUM(friend_cnt) AS node_sum /* 边数 */, SUM(battle_cnt) AS edge_sum /* 边总权重 */, SUM(trangle_num) AS trangle_sum, SUM(cc_num) AS cc_num_sum /* 人均局部三角形数量 */ FROM (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' /* 跑一周 */ AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid <= 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = GREATEST('2026-05-31', '2024-12-31') /* 回溯历史数据 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country) AS country ON a.roleid = country.roleid AND a.zoneid = country.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT friend_role_id, friend_zone_id) AS friend_cnt, SUM(pv) AS battle_cnt FROM battle_with_friend GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.roleid <> b.friend_role_id AND a.roleid = c.friend_role_id AND a.zoneid = c.friend_zone_id THEN CONCAT(a.friend_role_id, b.friend_role_id) ELSE NULL END) / 2 AS trangle_num, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.roleid <> b.friend_role_id AND a.roleid = c.friend_role_id AND a.zoneid = c.friend_zone_id THEN CONCAT(a.friend_role_id, b.friend_role_id) ELSE NULL END) / (2 * COUNT(DISTINCT a.friend_role_id, a.friend_zone_id)) AS cc_num FROM battle_with_friend AS a LEFT JOIN battle_with_friend AS b ON a.friend_role_id = b.roleid AND a.friend_zone_id = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle_with_friend AS c ON b.friend_role_id = c.roleid AND b.friend_zone_id = c.zoneid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid GROUP BY first_mt_country

name: 商品上架数据
sql_units: WITH dailycoin AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, MAX(CASE WHEN event_ = 'login' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_event, MAX(coin) AS coin_max, MAX(diamond) AS diamond_max FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, MAX(curbattle_points) AS coin, MAX(curdiamond) AS diamond, 'login' AS event_ FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, MAX(cur_num) AS coin, NULL AS diamond, 'add' AS event_ FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_add_coin WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, NULL AS coin, MAX(cur_num) AS diamond, 'add' AS event_ FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_add_diamond WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd), old_item AS (SELECT zoneid, itemid, itemname, startlogymd, firstday_exposure, firstday_potential_coin, firstday_buyer, week_exposure, week_potential_coin, week_buyer, firstday_buy, week_buy, operate, zonetype FROM mcgg_temp.item_launchdata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND startlogymd <= '2026-05-24'), new_item_origin AS (SELECT itemid, itemname, startlogymd, coincost, diamondcost FROM mcgg_temp.item_launchmap AS a WHERE logymd = '20260531' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM old_item AS b WHERE a.itemid = b.itemid)), new_item /* , buyer_filter as */ /* ( */ /*     select itemid,zonetype,min(logymd) as startlogymd from */ /*     ( */ /*     select b.itemid,a.logymd,case when zoneid BETWEEN 1001 and 1999 then 1 else 2 end as  zonetype */ /*     ,count(distinct concat(a.roleid,a.zoneid) ) as cn */ /*     from mcgg_ods.gameserver_add_item a join */ /*     new_item_origin b on  a.item_id=b.itemid */ /*     where  a.logymd between '2026-05-25' and '2026-05-31' */ /*     group by b.itemid,a.logymd,zoneid */ /*     ) */ /*     where cn >=100 */ /*     group by itemid,zonetype */ /* ) */ AS (SELECT a.itemid, a.itemname, a.startlogymd, CAST(a.coincost AS INT) AS coincost, CAST(a.diamondcost AS INT) AS diamondcost FROM new_item_origin AS a), buyer /* 添加 zonetype */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, b.itemid, itemname, startlogymd, CASE WHEN moneytype = 300 THEN 'coin' WHEN moneytype = 301 THEN 'diamond' END AS operate, MAX(CASE WHEN a.logymd = b.startlogymd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firstday_buyer, MAX(CASE WHEN b.startlogymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(a.logymd, -6) AND a.logymd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firstweek_buyer, SUM(CASE WHEN a.logymd = b.startlogymd THEN itemnum ELSE 0 END) AS firstday_buy, SUM(CASE WHEN b.startlogymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(a.logymd, -6) AND a.logymd THEN itemnum ELSE 0 END) AS week_buy FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_shop_buy AS a JOIN new_item AS b ON a.logymd BETWEEN b.startlogymd AND DATE_ADD(b.startlogymd, 6) AND a.itemid = b.itemid AND a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN b.startlogymd AND DATE_ADD(b.startlogymd, 6) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, b.itemid, itemname, startlogymd, operate), buyinfo AS (SELECT zoneid, itemid, itemname, startlogymd, operate, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstday_buyer = 1 THEN roleid END) AS firstday_buyer, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstweek_buyer = 1 THEN roleid END) AS week_buyer, SUM(firstday_buy) AS firstday_buy, SUM(week_buy) AS week_buy FROM buyer GROUP BY zoneid, itemid, itemname, startlogymd, operate UNION ALL SELECT zoneid, itemid, itemname, startlogymd, 'duplicate' AS operate, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstday_buyer = 1 THEN roleid END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstday_buyer = 1 AND operate = 'diamond' THEN roleid END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstday_buyer = 1 AND operate = 'coin' THEN roleid END) AS firstday_buyer, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstweek_buyer = 1 THEN roleid END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstweek_buyer = 1 AND operate = 'diamond' THEN roleid END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstweek_buyer = 1 AND operate = 'coin' THEN roleid END) AS week_buyer, 0 AS firstday_buy, 0 AS week_buy FROM buyer WHERE operate IN ('diamond', 'coin') GROUP BY zoneid, itemid, itemname, startlogymd UNION ALL SELECT zoneid, itemid, itemname, startlogymd, 'duplicate_else' AS operate, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstday_buyer = 1 THEN roleid END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstday_buyer = 1 AND operate IN ('diamond', 'coin') THEN roleid END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstday_buyer = 1 AND operate = 'else' THEN roleid END) AS firstday_buyer, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstweek_buyer = 1 THEN roleid END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstweek_buyer = 1 AND operate IN ('diamond', 'coin') THEN roleid END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstweek_buyer = 1 AND operate = 'else' THEN roleid END) AS week_buyer, 0 AS firstday_buy, 0 AS week_buy FROM buyer GROUP BY zoneid, itemid, itemname, startlogymd), coin AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, itemid, itemname, startlogymd, MAX(CASE WHEN a.logymd = b.startlogymd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firstday_exposure, MAX(1) AS week_exposure, MAX(CASE WHEN a.logymd = b.startlogymd AND a.coin_max >= b.coincost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firstday_potential_coin, MAX(CASE WHEN a.coin_max >= b.coincost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS week_potential_coin, MAX(CASE WHEN a.logymd = b.startlogymd AND a.diamond_max >= b.diamondcost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firstday_potential_diamond, MAX(CASE WHEN a.diamond_max >= b.diamondcost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS week_potential_diamond FROM dailycoin AS a JOIN new_item AS b ON a.logymd BETWEEN b.startlogymd AND DATE_ADD(b.startlogymd, 6) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, itemid, itemname, startlogymd), coin_info AS (SELECT zoneid, itemid, itemname, startlogymd, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstday_exposure = 1 THEN roleid END) AS firstday_exposure, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN firstday_potential_coin = 1 THEN roleid '系统平台（ios:os_type=1，android:os_type=2，emulator:os_type=3，unknown:os_type=其他）', */ /*     `last_login_os` string COMMENT '系统平台（ios:os_type=1，android:os_type=2，emulator:os_type=3，unknown:os_type=其他）', */ /*     `first_device` string COMMENT '首次登陆设备型号', */ /*     `last_device` string COMMENT '末次登陆设备型号', */ /*     `first_ip` string COMMENT '首次登陆ip', */ /*     `last_ip` string COMMENT '末次登陆ip', */ /* string COMMENT '当天末次活跃时间(时分秒)', */ /*     `active_dur` bigint COMMENT '当天活跃时长', */ /*     `first_login_logymd` string COMMENT '-', */ /*     `first_pc_logymd` string COMMENT '-', */ /*     `is_pc_login` int COMMENT '-', */ /*     `last_os_type` int COMMENT '-', */ /*     `last_client_language` string COMMENT '-', */ /*     `last_os_language` string COMMENT '-' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` string COMMENT '-') STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://mt-dwm/table/dwm_zgame_active_role_zone_di'; */ WITH base_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(first_login_time) AS first_login_time, MIN(first_login_logymd) AS first_login_logymd, MAX(last_login_time) AS last_login_time FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(TIME) AS first_login_time, MIN(logymd) AS first_login_logymd, MAX(TIME) AS last_login_time FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(TIME) AS first_login_time, MIN(logymd) AS first_login_logymd, MAX(TIME) AS last_login_time FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(TIME) AS first_login_time, MIN(logymd) AS first_login_logymd, MAX(TIME) AS last_login_time FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(TIME) AS first_login_time, MIN(logymd) AS first_login_logymd, MAX(TIME) AS last_login_time FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_fight_pve WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dwm_zgame_active_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT base_info.roleid, base_info.zoneid, t_login.first_login_os, t_login.last_login_os, t_login.first_device, t_login.last_device, t_login.first_ip, t_login.last_ip, t_login.first_deviceid, t_login.last_deviceid, base_info.first_login_time, base_info.last_login_time, COALESCE(t_logout.active_dur, 0) AS active_dur, base_info.first_login_logymd, t_login.first_pc_logymd, t_login.is_pc_login, t_login.last_os_type, t_login.last_client_language, t_login.last_os_language FROM base_info LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN_BY(login_os, active_time) AS first_login_os, MAX_BY(login_os, active_time) AS last_login_os, MIN_BY(device, active_time) AS first_device, MAX_BY(device, active_time) AS last_device, MIN_BY(ip, active_time) AS first_ip, MAX_BY(ip, active_time) AS last_ip, MIN_BY(device_id, active_time) AS first_deviceid, MAX_BY(device_id, active_time) AS last_deviceid, MIN(active_time) AS first_active_time, MAX(active_time) AS last_active_time, MIN(IF(ostype_login = 3, logymd, NULL)) AS first_pc_logymd, MAX(IF(ostype_login = 3, 1, 0)) AS is_pc_login, MAX_BY(ostype_login, active_time) AS last_os_type, MAX_BY(client_language, active_time) AS last_client_language, MAX_BY(os_language, active_time) AS last_os_language FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN os_type = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN os_type = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN os_type = 3 THEN 'pc' WHEN os_type = 4 THEN 'emulator' ELSE 'unknown' END AS login_os, COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device, COALESCE(ip, 'unknown') AS ip, COALESCE(device_id, 'unknown') AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS active_time, ostype_login, os_type, logymd, client_language, os_language FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001))) AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t_login ON t_login.roleid = base_info.roleid AND t_login.zoneid = base_info.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(online_time) AS active_dur FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t_logout ON t_login.roleid = t_logout.roleid AND t_login.zoneid = t_logout.zoneid

-99999 THEN NULL ELSE his_min_stage_id_auto END AS his_min_stage_id_auto FROM mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_battle_pve_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_battle_pve_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(t_battle_di.roleid, t_battle_df.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(t_battle_di.zoneid, t_battle_df.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(t_battle_di.pve_type, t_battle_df.pve_type) AS pve_type, COALESCE(t_battle_df.his_first_stage_id, t_battle_di.first_stage_id, -99999) AS his_first_stage_id, COALESCE(t_battle_di.last_stage_id, t_battle_df.his_last_stage_id, -99999) AS his_last_stage_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(t_battle_df.his_max_stage_id, -99999) > COALESCE(t_battle_di.max_stage_id, -99999) THEN COALESCE(t_battle_df.his_max_stage_id, -99999) ELSE COALESCE(t_battle_di.max_stage_id, -99999) END AS his_max_stage_id, COALESCE(CASE WHEN t_battle_df.his_min_stage_id IS NULL THEN t_battle_di.min_stage_id WHEN NOT t_battle_df.his_min_stage_id IS NULL AND t_battle_di.min_stage_id IS NULL THEN t_battle_df.his_min_stage_id WHEN t_battle_di.min_stage_id < t_battle_df.his_min_stage_id THEN t_battle_di.min_stage_id ELSE t_battle_df.his_min_stage_id END, -99999) AS his_min_stage_id, GREATEST(t_battle_di.progress, t_battle_df.progress) AS progress, COALESCE(CASE WHEN t_battle_df.his_min_stage_id_auto IS NULL THEN t_battle_di.min_stage_id_auto WHEN NOT t_battle_df.his_min_stage_id_auto IS NULL AND t_battle_di.min_stage_id_auto IS NULL THEN t_battle_df.his_min_stage_id_auto WHEN t_battle_di.min_stage_id_auto < t_battle_df.his_min_stage_id_auto THEN t_battle_di.min_stage_id_auto ELSE t_battle_df.his_min_stage_id_auto END, -99999) AS his_min_stage_id FROM t_battle_di FULL JOIN t_battle_df ON t_battle_di.roleid = t_battle_df.roleid AND t_battle_di.zoneid = t_battle_df.zoneid AND t_battle_di.pve_type = t_battle_df.pve_type

COMMENT '账号id,key', */ /*     `zoneid` bigint COMMENT '区服id,key', */ /*     `hero_legend_add_num` bigint COMMENT '当日获得传说英雄个数', */ /*     `hero_legend_add_info` map < string, */ /*     bigint > COMMENT '当日获得传说英雄明细', */ /*     `item_add` map < string, */ /*     bigint > COMMENT '当日资源获得', */ /*     `item_sub` map < string, */ /*     bigint > COMMENT '当日资源消耗', */ /*     `item_iap_add` map < string, */ /*     bigint > COMMENT '当日资源付费获得', */ /*     `stamina` map < string, */ /*     bigint > COMMENT '当日体力消耗', */ /*     `day_item_add` map < string, */ /*     bigint > COMMENT '当天item净增' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` string COMMENT '日期,yyyy-MM-dd') */ /*     STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dwm/table/dwm_zgame_resource_role_zone_di'; */ WITH t_add_hero AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', baseid, num))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS hero_add_info, SUM(num) AS hero_add_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, baseid, COUNT(1) AS num FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_hero_add WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND hero_quality = 5 AND operate <> 'Hero_HeroReset' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, baseid) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_add_item AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', item_id, add_num))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS item_add, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', item_id, pay_add_num))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS item_iap_add FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, SUM(COALESCE(add_num, 0)) AS add_num, SUM(IF(op RLIKE 'IAP_DeliverItem|StoreBuyWithTokens', add_num, 0)) AS pay_add_num FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND (item_id IN (1, 4, 5, 8, 13, 17, 22, 31, 37, 1001, 2001, 3001, 13001, 14001, 15001, 13002, 14002, 15002, 18, 5001, 15017, 15018, 16001, 16002, 16003, 16100, 16101, 16102, 10004, 3502, 3508, 6057, 6056, 6055, 6054, 10001, 10002, 31011, 14, 10005, 28, 15, 25, 26, 4011, 4021, 213, 10006, 10007, 16007, 52) OR (item_id = 3 AND NOT op IN ('ChallengeReturn', 'ChallengeLogout'))) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id) AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_item_sub AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', item_id, sub_num))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS item_sub FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, SUM(COALESCE(sub_num, 0)) AS sub_num FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_sub_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND item_id IN (1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 13, 17, 22, 31, 37, 1001, 2001, 3001, 13001, 14001, 15001, 13002, 14002, 15002, 18, 5001, 15017, 15018, 16001, 16002, 16003, 16100, 16101, 16102, 10004, 3502, 3508, 6057, 6056, 6055, 6054, 10001, 10002, 31011, 14, 10005, 28, 15, 25, 26, 4011, 4021, 213, 10006, 10007, 16007, 52) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id) AS T GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_stamina AS (/* "总体力消耗: sum(cost_energy) */ /* 主线体力消耗: sum(case when ( */ /*     (floor(stage_id / 100000) in (10,11,12) and stage_id not in (1002006,1003007,1004004,1005004,1006004,1007008,1008004,1009017,1010008,1102006,1103007,1104004,1105004,1106004,1107008,1108004)) or */ /*     floor(stage_id / 1000) in (10006,10007,10008,20008) */ /*     ) then cost_energy end) */ /* 经验本体力消耗: sum(case when stage_id in (1002006,1003007,1004004,1005004,1006004,1007008,1008004,1009017,1010008) then cost_energy end) */ /* 金币本体力消耗: sum(case when stage_id in (1102006,1103007,1104004,1105004,1106004,1107008,1108004) then cost_energy end) */ /* 进阶本体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 1000) between 4001 and 4004 then cost_energy end) */ /* 装备本1体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 1000) = 4006 then cost_energy end) */ /* 装备本2体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 1000) = 4007 then cost_energy end) */ /* 装备本3体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 1000) = 4008 then cost_energy end) */ /* 装备地下城1体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 100) = 50090 then cost_energy end) */ /* 装备地下城2体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 100) = 50091 then cost_energy end) */ /* 神器本体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 1000) = 4009 then cost_energy end)" */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(MAP('total', total, 'campaign', campaign, 'exp', exp, 'coin', coin, 'promotion', promotion, 'gear_1', gear_1, 'gear_2', gear_2, 'gear_3', gear_3, 'dungeon_1', dungeon_1, 'dungeon_2', dungeon_2, 'artifact', artifact) AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS stamina FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(COALESCE(cost_energy, 0)) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN ((FLOOR(stage_id / 100000) IN (10, 11, 12) AND NOT stage_id IN (1002006, 1003007, 1004004, 1005004, 1006004, 1007008, 1008004, 1009017, 1010008, 1102006, 1103007, 1104004, 1105004, 1106004, 1107008, 1108004, 1011008)) OR FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) IN (10006, 10007, 10008, 20008)) THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS campaign, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_id IN (1002006, 1003007, 1004004, 1005004, 1006004, 1007008, 1008004, 1009017, 1010008, 1011008) THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS exp, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_id IN (1102006, 1103007, 1104004, 1105004, 1106004, 1107008, 1108004) THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS coin, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) BETWEEN 4001 AND 4004 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4006 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS gear_1, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4007 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS gear_2, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4008 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS gear_3, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 100) = 50090 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS dungeon_1, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 100) = 50091 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS dungeon_2, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4009 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS artifact FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_finish_challenge_stage WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t), item_balance_end AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', item_id, add_num))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS day_item_add FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, SUM(add_num) AS add_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, TIME, COALESCE(add_num, 0) AS add_num FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND (item_id IN (1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 13, 17, 22, 31, 37, 1001, 2001, 3001, 13001, 14001, 15001, 13002, 14002, 15002, 18, 5001, 15017, 15018, 16001, 16002, 16003, 16100, 16101, 16102, 10004, 3502, 3508, 6057, 6056, 6055, 6054, 10001, 10002, 31011, 14, 10005, 28, 15, 25, 26, 4011, 4021, 213, 10006, 10007, 16007, 52)) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, TIME, -COALESCE(sub_num, 0) AS add_num FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_sub_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND item_id IN (1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 13, 17, 22, 31, 37, 1001, 2001, 3001, 13001, 14001, 15001, 13002, 14002, 15002, 18, 5001, 15017, 15018, 16001, 16002, 16003, 16100, 16101, 16102, 10004, 3502, 3508, 6057, 6056, 6055, 6054, 10001, 10002, 31011, 14, 10005, 28, 15, 25, 26, 4011, 4021, 213, 10006, 10007, 16007, 52)) AS t0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), role_info AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM t_add_hero UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM t_add_item UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM t_item_sub UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM t_stamina UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM item_balance_end)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_resource_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, COALESCE(hero_add_num, 0) AS hero_legend_add_num, hero_add_info AS hero_legend_add_info, item_add, item_sub, item_iap_add, stamina, day_item_add FROM role_info AS t0 LEFT JOIN t_add_hero AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_add_item AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_item_sub AS t3 ON t0.roleid = t3.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_stamina AS t4 ON t0.roleid = t4.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t4.zoneid LEFT JOIN item_balance_end AS t5 ON t0.roleid = t5.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t5.zoneid

0) COMMENT '账号id,key', */ /*     `zoneid` bigint COMMENT '区服id,key', */ /*     `pve_type` string COMMENT 'pve战斗类型', */ /*     `first_stage_id` bigint COMMENT '首次stage_id', */ /*     `last_stage_id` (`logymd` string COMMENT '日期,yyyy-MM-dd')  STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://mt-dwm/table/dwm_zgame_battle_pve_role_zone_di'; */ WITH t_pve AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pve_type, MAX(CASE WHEN score > 0 THEN stage_id % 100 END) AS max_stage_id, MIN(CASE WHEN score > 0 THEN stage_id % 100 END) AS min_stage_id, MIN(CASE WHEN score = 3 THEN stage_id END) AS min_stage_id_auto, MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN stage_id END) AS first_stage_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN stage_id END) AS last_stage_id, MAX(CASE WHEN pve_type = '简单主线战役' AND score > 0 THEN CASE WHEN stage_id IN (1001061, 1001062) THEN 1001006 WHEN stage_id IN (1001091, 1001092) THEN 1001009 ELSE stage_id END WHEN pve_type = '困难主线战役' AND score > 0 THEN stage_id WHEN pve_type = '专家主线战役' AND score > 0 THEN stage_id WHEN pve_type = '经验本' AND score = 3 THEN stage_id WHEN pve_type = '金币本' AND score = 3 THEN stage_id WHEN pve_type = '坚韧纹章' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '近战纹章' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '射手纹章' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '法师纹章' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '装备本I' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '装备本II' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '装备本III' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '装备地下城I' AND score = 3 THEN CASE stage_id WHEN 5009001 THEN '01' WHEN 5009002 THEN '02' WHEN 5009003 THEN '04' WHEN 5009004 THEN '06' WHEN 5009005 THEN '07' WHEN 5009006 THEN '09' WHEN 5009007 THEN '03' WHEN 5009008 THEN '05' WHEN 5009009 THEN '08' WHEN 5009010 THEN '10' WHEN 5009017 THEN '11' WHEN 5009018 THEN '12' WHEN 5009019 THEN '13' END WHEN pve_type = '装备地下城II' AND score = 3 THEN CASE stage_id WHEN 5009101 THEN '01' WHEN 5009102 THEN '02' WHEN 5009103 THEN '04' WHEN 5009104 THEN '06' WHEN 5009105 THEN '08' WHEN 5009106 THEN '09' WHEN 5009107 THEN '03' WHEN 5009108 THEN '05' WHEN 5009109 THEN '07' WHEN 5009110 THEN '10' WHEN 5009111 THEN '11' WHEN 5009112 THEN '12' WHEN 5009113 THEN '13' END WHEN pve_type = '神器本' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '基础试炼' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '守望者试炼' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '噩梦试炼' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '北境试炼' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '诅咒试炼' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '炼狱试炼' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '贯星试炼' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '秘法试炼' AND score = 3 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '魔潮' AND score > 0 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%03d', CAST(stage_id % 1000 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '公会boss1' THEN CAST(PRINTF('%09d', CAST(clanboss_damage_dragon_blood AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '公会boss2' THEN CAST(PRINTF('%09d', CAST(clanboss_damage_dragon_blood AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '公会boss3' THEN CAST(PRINTF('%09d', CAST(clanboss_damage_dragon_blood AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '公会boss4' THEN CAST(PRINTF('%09d', CAST(clanboss_damage_dragon_blood AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '公会boss5' THEN CAST(PRINTF('%09d', CAST(clanboss_damage_dragon_blood AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '公会boss6' THEN CAST(PRINTF('%09d', CAST(clanboss_damage_dragon_blood AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '公会boss7' THEN CAST(PRINTF('%09d', CAST(clanboss_damage_dragon_blood AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '公会boss8' THEN CAST(PRINTF('%09d', CAST(clanboss_damage_dragon_blood AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '公会boss9' THEN CAST(PRINTF('%09d', CAST(clanboss_damage_dragon_blood AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '虚空裂隙' AND score > 0 THEN CONCAT(CASE FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) WHEN 4109 THEN 1 WHEN 4209 THEN 3 WHEN 4309 THEN 4 WHEN 4409 THEN 2 END, ':', CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(CASE FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) WHEN 4109 THEN 1 WHEN 4209 THEN 3 WHEN 4309 THEN 4 WHEN 4409 THEN 2 END * 100 + CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT) AS INT) % 100) AS STRING)) WHEN pve_type = '虚空裂隙终章' AND score > 0 THEN CAST(PRINTF('%02d', CAST(stage_id % 100 AS INT)) AS STRING) WHEN pve_type = '魔军远征_主线进度' AND score > 0 THEN stage_id WHEN pve_type = '魔军远征_挑战进度' AND score = 3 THEN stage_id ELSE 0 END /* CASE WHEN pve_type = '简单主线战役' AND score > 0 THEN IF(stage_id = 1001061, 1001006, stage_id) */) AS progress FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, stage_id /* 不存在null值 */, pve_type, score, clanboss_damage_dragon_blood, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, pve_type ORDER BY `time`) AS rn_asc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, pve_type ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn_desc FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, stage_id /* 不存在null值 */, score, clanboss_damage_dragon_blood, CASE WHEN (FLOOR(stage_id / 100000) = 10 AND NOT stage_id IN (1002006, 1003007, 1004004, 1005004, 1006004, 1007008, 1008004, 1009017, 1010008, 1011008)) THEN '简单主线战役' WHEN (FLOOR(stage_id / 100000) = 11 AND NOT stage_id IN (1102006, 1103007, 1104004, 1105004, 1106004, 1107008, 1108004)) THEN '困难主线战役' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 100000) = 12 AND score > 0 THEN '专家主线战役' WHEN stage_id IN (1002006, 1003007, 1004004, 1005004, 1006004, 1007008, 1008004, 1009017, 1010008, 1011008) THEN '经验本' WHEN stage_id IN (1102006, 1103007, 1104004, 1105004, 1106004, 1107008, 1108004) THEN '金币本' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4001 THEN '坚韧纹章' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4002 THEN '近战纹章' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4003 THEN '射手纹章' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4004 THEN '法师纹章' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4006 THEN '装备本I' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4007 THEN '装备本II' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4008 THEN '装备本III' WHEN (stage_id >= 5009001 AND stage_id <= 5009010) OR stage_id IN (5009017, 5009018, 5009019) THEN '装备地下城I' WHEN (stage_id >= 5009101 AND stage_id <= 5009110) OR stage_id IN (5009111, 5009112, 5009113) THEN '装备地下城II' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4009 THEN '神器本' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 9001 THEN '基础试炼' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 9101 THEN '守望者试炼' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 9102 THEN '噩梦试炼' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 9103 THEN '北境试炼' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 9104 THEN '诅咒试炼' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 9105 THEN '炼狱试炼' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 9106 THEN '贯星试炼' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 9107 THEN '秘法试炼' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 7001 THEN '魔潮' WHEN stage_id = 5001001 THEN '公会boss1' WHEN stage_id = 5001002 THEN '公会boss2' WHEN stage_id = 5001003 THEN '公会boss3' WHEN stage_id = 5001004 THEN '公会boss4' WHEN stage_id = 5001005 THEN '公会boss5' WHEN stage_id = 5001006 THEN '公会boss6' WHEN stage_id = 5001007 THEN '公会boss7' WHEN stage_id = 5001008 THEN '公会boss8' WHEN stage_id = 5001009 THEN '公会boss9' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) IN (4109, 4209, 4309, 4409) THEN '虚空裂隙' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) IN (4709) THEN '虚空裂隙终章' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) IN (6601, 6701) THEN '魔军远征_主线进度' WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 6801 THEN '魔军远征_挑战进度' ELSE 'unknown' END AS pve_type, `time` FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_fight_pve WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND NOT stage_id IN (5002001, 5002002, 5002003, 5002004)) AS t1) AS t3 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pve_type), t_union_boss AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pve_type, CAST(PRINTF('%09d', CAST(MAX(damage / 10000) AS INT)) AS STRING) AS progress FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN stage_id = 5002001 THEN '周公会boss1' WHEN stage_id = 5002002 THEN '周公会boss2' WHEN stage_id = 5002003 THEN '周公会boss3' WHEN stage_id = 5002004 THEN '周公会boss4' WHEN stage_id = 5002005 THEN '周公会boss5' WHEN stage_id = 5002006 THEN '周公会boss6' END AS pve_type, damage FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_union_week_boss_confirm_fight WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND stage_id IN (5002001, 5002002, 5002003, 5002004, 5002005, 5002006)) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pve_type), t_boss_rush AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pve_type, CAST(PRINTF('%09d', CAST(MAX(score) AS INT)) AS STRING) AS progress FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN boss_id = 5 THEN '魔焰君主' WHEN boss_id = 6 THEN '冰霜之主' WHEN boss_id = 7 THEN '征服者' WHEN boss_id = 8 THEN '荒沙巨灵' WHEN boss_id = 9 THEN '冥河之主' WHEN boss_id = 10 THEN '激浪之怒' WHEN boss_id = 11 THEN '黄金噩梦' WHEN boss_id = 12 THEN 'boss12' WHEN boss_id = 13 THEN 'boss13' END AS pve_type, score FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_boss_rush_update WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND (boss_id BETWEEN 5 AND 13)) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pve_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_battle_pve_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, pve_type, COALESCE(first_stage_id, -99999) AS first_stage_id, COALESCE(last_stage_id, -99999) AS last_stage_id, COALESCE(max_stage_id, -99999) AS max_stage_id, COALESCE(min_stage_id, -99999) AS min_stage_id, progress, COALESCE(min_stage_id_auto, -99999) AS min_stage_id_auto FROM t_pve UNION SELECT roleid, zoneid, pve_type, -99999 AS first_stage_id, -99999 AS last_stage_id, -99999 AS max_stage_id, -99999 AS min_stage_id, progress, -99999 AS min_stage_id_auto FROM t_union_boss UNION SELECT roleid, zoneid, pve_type, -99999 AS first_stage_id, -99999 AS last_stage_id, -99999 AS max_stage_id, -99999 AS min_stage_id, progress, -99999 AS min_stage_id_auto FROM t_boss_rush

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_battle_pvp_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-01-12 14:02:29.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `mt_dwm`.`dwm_zgame_battle_pvp_role_zone_di`( */ /*     `roleid` decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '账号id,key', */ /*     `zoneid` bigint COMMENT '区服id,key', */ /*     `first_pvp_rank` bigint COMMENT '当日首次结算后PVP段位', */ /*     `last_pvp_rank` bigint COMMENT '当日末次结算后PVP段位', */ /*     `max_pvp_rank` bigint COMMENT '当日最大结算后PVP段位', */ /*     `min_pvp_rank` bigint COMMENT '当日最小结算后PVP段位', */ /*     `arena_cnt` bigint COMMENT '当日竞技场次数，一个stage_id可以重复打', */ /*     `max_pvp_01` bigint COMMENT '-', */ /*     `max_pvp_02` bigint COMMENT '-', */ /*     `max_pvp_03` bigint COMMENT '-', */ /*     `day_final_score` bigint COMMENT '-', */ /*     `day_final_pvp_01` bigint COMMENT '-', */ /*     `day_final_pvp_02` bigint COMMENT '-', */ /*     `day_final_pvp_03` bigint COMMENT '-' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` string COMMENT '日期,yyyy-MM-dd') */ /*     STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dwm/table/dwm_zgame_battle_pvp_role_zone_di'; */ WITH t_pvp AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(cur_score) AS max_pvp_rank, MIN(cur_score) AS min_pvp_rank, MAX(first_pvp_rank) AS first_pvp_rank, MAX(last_pvp_rank) AS last_pvp_rank, COUNT(stage_id) AS arena_cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_id % 10 = 1 THEN cur_score ELSE NULL END) AS max_pvp_01, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_id % 10 = 2 THEN cur_score ELSE NULL END) AS max_pvp_02, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_id % 10 = 3 THEN cur_score ELSE NULL END) AS max_pvp_03, MAX_BY(cur_score, TIME) AS day_final_score, MAX_BY(cur_score, CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id % 10) = 1 THEN TIME ELSE NULL END) AS day_final_pvp_01, MAX_BY(cur_score, CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id % 10) = 2 THEN TIME ELSE NULL END) AS day_final_pvp_02, MAX_BY(cur_score, CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id % 10) = 3 THEN TIME ELSE NULL END) AS day_final_pvp_03 FROM (SELECT player_uid AS roleid, zone_id AS zoneid, cur_score /* 存在null值 */, stage_id /* 存在null值 */, TIME, FIRST_VALUE(cur_score) OVER (PARTITION BY player_uid, zone_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN cur_score IS NULL THEN '9999-99-99 00:00:00' ELSE `time` END) AS first_pvp_rank, FIRST_VALUE(cur_score) OVER (PARTITION BY player_uid, zone_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN cur_score IS NULL THEN '1970-01-01 00:00:00' ELSE `time` END DESC) AS last_pvp_rank FROM zgame_damai_ods.crossserver_basic_pvp_fight WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zone_id = 1 OR zone_id BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zone_id BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zone_id >= 70001)) AND FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 6001) AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_battle_pvp_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_pvp_rank, last_pvp_rank, max_pvp_rank, min_pvp_rank, arena_cnt, max_pvp_01, max_pvp_02, max_pvp_03, day_final_score, day_final_pvp_01, day_final_pvp_02, day_final_pvp_03 FROM t_pvp

v_2 AS hard_campaign, v_3 AS expert_campaign, CONCAT_WS(',', CONCAT_WS(':', 'exp', v_4), CONCAT_WS(':', 'coin', v_5)) AS resource_raid, CONCAT_WS(',', CONCAT_WS(':', 'endurance', v_6), CONCAT_WS(':', b.other_roleid AND a.other_zoneid = b.other_zoneid LEFT JOIN recurring_rate AS c ON a.other_roleid = c.other_roleid AND a.other_zoneid = c.other_zoneid LEFT JOIN pagerank AS d ON a.other_roleid = d.other_roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.leavyliu_friend_back_recommend_2 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS('\\073', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(rank_algo AS STRING), 3, '0'), ':', CONCAT(CONCAT(other_roleid, ',', other_zoneid), ',', CASE WHEN rank_algo <= 3 THEN 12 ELSE 11 END))))) AS friend_list_recomm FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, other_roleid, other_zoneid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY final_score DESC) AS rank_algo FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, other_roleid, other_zoneid, 1 / (1 + EXP(-(battle_intimacy * 7.38224437e-03 + gift_intimacy * 7.99384528e-02 + lose_level * -3.40739535e-02 + active_days * -4.13914134e-04 + lose_days * -1.66466036e-02 + lose_cnt * 1.91187654e-02 + register_days * 1.59134038e-05 + pagerank * -4.55336672e-01))) AS final_score FROM feature)) WHERE rank_algo <= 50 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid

sql_units: WITH real_country_online /*   msdk_ods.msdk_event ad */ /* JOIN    ( */ /*             SELECT  DISTINCT lower(appname) AS appname, */ /*                     stagename, */ /*                     CAST(stageid AS INT) AS app_id */ /*             FROM    msdk_dim.dim_app_info */ /*             WHERE   logymd = if('20260531' <= '20250106', '20250106','20260531') */ /*             AND     is_online = 1  AND lower(appname) = 'nova' */ /*             AND stageid =  4400 */ /*         ) AS ap */ /* ON      ap.app_id = ad.app_id */ /* WHERE   logymd = '20260531' */ /* AND     event IN('t_real_os_country_online', 't_real_os_online') */ /* AND     event IN( 't_real_os_online') */ /* AND     get_json_object(event_desc, '$.zone_id') NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 */ /* AND     get_json_object(event_desc, '$.zone_id') NOT BETWEEN 29000 AND 29999 */ /* AND     from_unixtime(get_json_object(event_desc, '$.time') - 8*3600,'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31' */ /* AND ( */ /*     GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') BETWEEN 20001 and 24999 --亚太 */ /* or GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') BETWEEN 25001 and 27999 --亚太 */ /* or GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') BETWEEN 10001 and 14999 --欧洲 */ /* or GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') BETWEEN 15001 and 17999 --美国 */ /* )    */ AS (SELECT event_time, 'nova' AS appname, 4400 AS app_id, 'nova' AS stagename, FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST((GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.time') - 8 * 3600) AS BIGINT) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time /* FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(event_time / 1000 AS BIGINT) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time, */, LOWER(IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.country') = '-', 'unknown', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.country'))) AS country, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.os_type') AS os_type, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.online_num') AS online_num, logymd FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (app_id = 4400 AND event IN ('t_real_os_online') AND FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST((GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.time') - 8 * 3600) AS BIGINT), 'yyyy-MM-dd') >= '2025-06-25' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST((GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.time') - 8 * 3600) AS BIGINT), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31' AND (GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 /* 亚太 */ OR GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 /* 亚太 */ OR GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 /* 欧洲 */ OR GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.zone_id') BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 /* 美国 */))), dim_country AS (SELECT country_code AS country, definition_type AS region_type, region, appname FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_country) /* 取最新 */ AND startdate <= '2026-05-31' AND appname = 'nova'), online_cube AS (/* 分国家和区域 */ SELECT appname, region_type, region, country, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, ROUND(SUM(online_num) / 288) AS acu FROM (SELECT con.appname, con.region_type, con.region, con.country, lin.div_time, COALESCE(SUM(online_num), 0) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM dim_country AS con LEFT JOIN real_country_online AS lin ON con.country = lin.country AND con.appname = lin.appname GROUP BY con.appname, con.region_type, con.region, con.country, lin.div_time, GROUPING SETS ((con.appname, con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region, con.country), (con.appname, con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region), (con.appname, con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.country))) GROUP BY appname, region_type, region, country /* ----总况 */ UNION ALL SELECT a.appname, a.region_type AS region_type, NULL AS region, NULL AS country, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, ROUND(SUM(online_num) / 288) AS acu FROM (SELECT DISTINCT appname, region_type FROM dim_country) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT lin.appname, lin.div_time, 0 AS region_type, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_country_online AS lin GROUP BY lin.appname, lin.div_time UNION ALL SELECT lin.appname, lin.div_time, 1 AS region_type, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_country_online AS lin GROUP BY lin.appname, lin.div_time) AS b ON a.appname = b.appname AND a.region_type = b.region_type GROUP BY a.appname, a.region_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, 'all' AS network, COALESCE(pcu, 0) AS pcu, COALESCE(acu, 0) AS acu, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, 'nova' AS appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'daily' AS date_type FROM online_cube
