DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.logymd) <= 14 THEN 'a.7-13' WHEN a.usercreateymd < a.logymd AND DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.logymd) > 14 AND DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.logymd) <= 30 THEN 'b.14-29' WHEN a.usercreateymd < a.logymd AND DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.logymd) > 30 AND DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.logymd) <= 60 THEN 'c.30-59' WHEN a.usercreateymd < a.logymd AND (DATEDIFF(a.logymd, b.logymd) > 60 OR b.roleid IS NULL) THEN 'd.60+' ELSE 'e.active' END) AS return_type, CASE WHEN c.channel IN ('and_mllobby', 'ios_mllobby') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_mllobby FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, logymd) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 61 * -1) AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1) AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND logymd >= '2024-08-06' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b /* --最后活跃日期 */ ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, channel FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, channel, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME ASC) AS rn FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000) WHERE rn = 1) AS c ON a.logymd = c.logymd AND a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.usercreateymd, CASE WHEN c.channel IN ('and_mllobby', 'ios_mllobby') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

name: 26乘26分路转移
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: zibohong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-02-24 19:27:55.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH pre_maxrank_last_season AS (/* -上个月的玩家，以上个月月底为准的上个赛季rank最大值 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, ss_max_minrank AS last_season_rank FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_season_role_zone_df WHERE logymd IN (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING(season_endtime, 1, 10) AS end_date /* --(上个月)的上个赛季结束时间 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_season_config_df WHERE INT(season) IN (SELECT INT(season) - 1 /* 找到跑的那天的赛季-1 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_season_config_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN season_starttime AND season_endtime AND logymd = LAST_DAY(CAST('2026-04-21' AS DATE)) /* 上个月结束日期 */) AND logymd = '2026-05-31') AND logymd > '2025-11-12'), pre_maxrank_this_season AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ss_max_minrank AS this_season_rank FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_season_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = LAST_DAY(CAST('2026-04-21' AS DATE))), pre_maxrank_combine AS (SELECT COALESCE(l.roleid, t.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(l.zoneid, t.zoneid) AS zoneid, GREATEST(COALESCE(l.last_season_rank, 0), COALESCE(t.this_season_rank, 0)) AS ranklvl_max FROM pre_maxrank_last_season AS l FULL OUTER JOIN pre_maxrank_this_season AS t ON l.roleid = t.roleid AND l.zoneid = t.zoneid), player_hero_usage_before /* 计算之前玩家的英雄使用情况和最高rank */ AS (SELECT tag.accountid, tag.zoneid, ranklvl_max, tag.road_tag FROM ml_temp.zibo_hong_mounth_player_road_tag_v3 AS tag JOIN pre_maxrank_combine AS pr ON roleid = accountid AND tag.zoneid = pr.zoneid WHERE tag.logymd = LAST_DAY(CAST('2026-04-16' AS DATE)) AND tag.road_tag <> 'unrequired' GROUP BY tag.accountid, tag.zoneid, ranklvl_max, tag.road_tag), after_maxrank_last_season /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */ AS (/* -下个月的玩家，以下个月月底为准的上个赛季rank最大值 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, ss_max_minrank AS last_season_rank FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_season_role_zone_df WHERE logymd IN (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING(season_endtime, 1, 10) AS end_date /* --(下个月)的上个赛季结束时间 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_season_config_df WHERE INT(season) IN (SELECT INT(season) - 1 /* 找到跑的那天的赛季-1 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_season_config_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN season_starttime AND season_endtime AND logymd = LAST_DAY(CAST('2026-05-31' AS DATE)) /* 下个月结束日期 */) AND logymd = '2026-05-31') AND logymd > '2025-11-12'), after_maxrank_this_season AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ss_max_minrank AS this_season_rank FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_season_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = LAST_DAY(CAST('2026-05-31' AS DATE))), after_maxrank_combine AS (SELECT COALESCE(l.roleid, t.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(l.zoneid, t.zoneid) AS zoneid, GREATEST(COALESCE(l.last_season_rank, 0), COALESCE(t.this_season_rank, 0)) AS ranklvl_max FROM after_maxrank_last_season AS l FULL OUTER JOIN after_maxrank_this_season AS t ON l.roleid = t.roleid AND l.zoneid = t.zoneid), player_hero_usage_after /* 计算之后玩家的英雄使用情况和最高rank */ AS (SELECT tag.accountid, tag.zoneid, ranklvl_max, tag.road_tag FROM ml_temp.zibo_hong_mounth_player_road_tag_v3 AS tag JOIN after_maxrank_combine AS pr ON roleid = accountid AND tag.zoneid = pr.zoneid WHERE tag.logymd = LAST_DAY(CAST('2026-05-31' AS DATE)) AND tag.road_tag <> 'unrequired' GROUP BY tag.accountid, tag.zoneid, ranklvl_max, tag.road_tag), p1_heroes /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */ AS (/* 玩家在之前时间段的分路标签 */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, ranklvl_max, road_tag AS road_tag_p1 FROM player_hero_usage_before), p2_heroes AS (/* 玩家在之后时间段的分路标签 */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, ranklvl_max, road_tag AS road_tag_p2 FROM player_hero_usage_after), matched_heroes /* 当玩家2个赛季都在的时候 */ AS (SELECT p1.accountid, p1.zoneid, p1.ranklvl_max, p2.road_tag_p2, p1.road_tag_p1 FROM p1_heroes AS p1 INNER JOIN p2_heroes AS p2 ON p1.accountid = p2.accountid AND p1.zoneid = p1.zoneid), p1_with_9999 /* 为没有 p2 记录的玩家补上 9999 */ AS (SELECT p1.accountid, p1.zoneid, p1.ranklvl_max, 9999 AS road_tag_p2, p1.road_tag_p1 FROM p1_heroes AS p1 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM p2_heroes AS p2 WHERE p1.accountid = p2.accountid AND p1.zoneid = p1.zoneid)), p2_with_9999 /* 为没有 p1 记录的玩家补上 9999 */ AS (SELECT p2.accountid, p2.zoneid, p2.ranklvl_max, p2.road_tag_p2, 9999 AS road_tag_p1 FROM p2_heroes AS p2 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM p1_heroes AS p1 WHERE p1.accountid = p2.accountid AND p1.zoneid = p1.zoneid)), combine_formation AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, ranklvl_max, road_tag_p2, road_tag_p1 FROM matched_heroes UNION ALL SELECT accountid, zoneid, ranklvl_max, road_tag_p2, road_tag_p1 FROM p1_with_9999 UNION ALL SELECT accountid, zoneid, ranklvl_max, road_tag_p2, road_tag_p1 FROM p2_with_9999 ORDER BY accountid, zoneid, road_tag_p2, road_tag_p1), payment_condition AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(his_pay_amt) AS total_payment FROM mt_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = LAST_DAY(CAST('2026-05-30' AS DATE)) /* 下个月结束日期 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), middle_condition AS (SELECT la.accountid, la.zoneid, la.ranklvl_max, la.road_tag_p2, la.road_tag_p1, COALESCE(r.total_payment, 0) AS total_payment FROM combine_formation AS la LEFT JOIN payment_condition AS r ON la.accountid = r.roleid AND la.zoneid = r.zoneid), labeled_table AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, road_tag_p1, road_tag_p2, ranklvl_max, total_payment, CASE WHEN ranklvl_max >= 31 THEN '荣耀神话' WHEN ranklvl_max >= 26 THEN '神话' WHEN ranklvl_max >= 21 THEN '传奇' WHEN ranklvl_max >= 16 THEN '史诗' ELSE 'lowrank' END AS rank_category, CASE WHEN total_payment > 999 THEN '付费用户' ELSE '普通用户' END AS if_payment FROM middle_condition), p1_to_p2 /* 2. 统计从 road_tag_p1 转移到 road_tag_p2 的玩家数量 */ AS (SELECT lt.road_tag_p1, lt.road_tag_p2, lt.rank_category, if_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid) AS p1tranp2_player_cnt FROM labeled_table AS lt GROUP BY lt.road_tag_p1, lt.road_tag_p2, lt.rank_category, lt.if_payment), s1_counts /* 3. 统计每个tag在第一赛季的玩家数量 */ AS (SELECT road_tag_p1 AS road_tag, rank_category, if_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid) AS s1_player_cnt FROM labeled_table GROUP BY road_tag_p1, rank_category, if_payment), s2_counts /* 4. 统计每个tag在第二赛季的玩家数量 */ AS (SELECT road_tag_p2 AS road_tag, rank_category, if_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid) AS s2_player_cnt FROM labeled_table GROUP BY road_tag_p2, rank_category, if_payment), final_result AS (SELECT p1_to_p2.rank_category, p1_to_p2.if_payment, p1_to_p2.road_tag_p1, p1_to_p2.road_tag_p2, p1_to_p2.p1tranp2_player_cnt, COALESCE(reverse_counts.p1tranp2_player_cnt, 0) AS p2tranp1_player_cnt /* 计算反向转移数量 */, COALESCE(s1_p1.s1_player_cnt, 0) AS s1p1_player_cnt /* 上个月 road_tag_p1 的玩家数量 */, COALESCE(s2_p1.s2_player_cnt, 0) AS s2p1_player_cnt /* 第二月 road_tag_p1 的玩家数量 */, COALESCE(s1_p2.s1_player_cnt, 0) AS s1p2_player_cnt /* 上个月 road_tag_p2 的玩家数量 */, COALESCE(s2_p2.s2_player_cnt, 0) AS s2p2_player_cnt /* 第二月 road_tag_p2 的玩家数量 */ FROM p1_to_p2 LEFT JOIN p1_to_p2 AS reverse_counts ON p1_to_p2.road_tag_p1 = reverse_counts.road_tag_p2 AND p1_to_p2.road_tag_p2 = reverse_counts.road_tag_p1 AND p1_to_p2.rank_category = reverse_counts.rank_category AND p1_to_p2.if_payment = reverse_counts.if_payment LEFT JOIN s1_counts AS s1_p1 ON p1_to_p2.road_tag_p1 = s1_p1.road_tag AND p1_to_p2.rank_category = s1_p1.rank_category AND p1_to_p2.if_payment = s1_p1.if_payment LEFT JOIN s2_counts AS s2_p1 ON p1_to_p2.road_tag_p1 = s2_p1.road_tag AND p1_to_p2.rank_category = s2_p1.rank_category AND p1_to_p2.if_payment = s2_p1.if_payment LEFT JOIN s1_counts AS s1_p2 ON p1_to_p2.road_tag_p2 = s1_p2.road_tag AND p1_to_p2.rank_category = s1_p2.rank_category AND p1_to_p2.if_payment = s1_p2.if_payment LEFT JOIN s2_counts AS s2_p2 ON p1_to_p2.road_tag_p2 = s2_p2.road_tag AND p1_to_p2.rank_category = s2_p2.rank_category AND p1_to_p2.if_payment = s2_p2.if_payment) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.zibo_26_26_mounth_tran_road_tag PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 下个版本结束日期 */ SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS('2026-05-31', -1), 'yyyyMM'), '_', DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyyMM')) AS month_combined /* ----下个月 */, rank_category, if_payment, road_tag_p1, road_tag_p2, p1tranp2_player_cnt, p2tranp1_player_cnt, s1p1_player_cnt /* 上个月 road_tag_p1 的玩家数量 */, s2p1_player_cnt /* 第二月 road_tag_p1 的玩家数量 */, s1p2_player_cnt /* 上个月 road_tag_p2 的玩家数量 */, s2p2_player_cnt /* 第二月 road_tag_p2 的玩家数量 */ FROM final_result

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_zgame_realtime_create_daily
sql_units: WITH t_create AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT accountid AS account_id, first_mt_country AS country, account_register_date AS logymd, LEAST(287, (HOUR(account_register_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(account_register_time) * 60 + SECOND(account_register_time)) DIV 300) AS point FROM (/*   SELECT roleid */ /*        , first_mt_country */ /*        , account_register_time */ /*        , account_register_date */ /*        , register_date */ /*        , register_time */ /*   FROM `bi_test`.`dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df_tmp` */ /*   WHERE logymd = IF( '2026-05-31' <= '2025-02-23', '2025-02-23',  '2026-05-31') */ /*     AND ( */ /*           (zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) */ /*           OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) */ /*           OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001) */ /*       ) */ /*     and account_register_date = '2026-05-31' */ SELECT first_mt_country, accountid, create_account_date AS account_register_date, create_account_time AS account_register_time FROM mt_dm.dm_zgame_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND create_account_date = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY first_mt_country, accountid, create_account_date, create_account_time) AS t2) AS t), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-02-01', '2025-02-01', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'zgame_synclog') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_create` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'zgame', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, '' AS network, COALESCE(t2.point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(t2.point_cnt, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS day_cnt FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN (SELECT point, country, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS point_cnt FROM t_create GROUP BY logymd, point, country HAVING point_cnt > 0) AS t2 ON t2.point = t_incr.point AND t2.country = t_incr.country

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_zgame_realtime_charge_daily
sql_units: WITH base_info AS (SELECT roleid, point, SUM(money) AS point_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, money, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND money > 0 AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001))) AS t GROUP BY roleid, point), t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country FROM bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df_tmp WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-02-23', '2025-02-23', '2026-05-31') GROUP BY roleid, first_mt_country), t_basic_pay AS (SELECT country, point, SUM(point_amt) AS point_amt FROM (SELECT t_basic.roleid, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, base_info.point, base_info.point_amt FROM base_info LEFT JOIN t_basic ON t_basic.roleid = base_info.roleid) AS t GROUP BY country, point), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-02-01', '2025-02-01', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'zgame_synclog') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_charge` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'zgame', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country, '' AS network, point_amt, SUM(point_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY point) AS day_amt FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_basic_pay.point_amt, 0) AS point_amt FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_basic_pay ON t_incr.country = t_basic_pay.country AND t_incr.point = t_basic_pay.point) AS t1

name: 印度注册ip信息ml_temp.ads_richardg_india_createip_info_df
sql_units: WITH new AS (/* 玩家注册日期-新增 */ SELECT register_date, first_network_name, GEOIP(create_ip, 1) AS ip_country, GEOIP(create_ip, 2) AS ip_region, roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, create_ip, first_network_name, register_date, zoneid, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE appid = 'mlbb' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (zoneid DIV 1000) < 57) WHERE GEOIP(create_ip, 1) = 'IN'), user_info AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.active_info, first_network_name, GEOIP(create_ip, 1) AS ip_country, GEOIP(create_ip, 2) AS ip_region, 1 AS sup_col, a.logymd FROM (SELECT SUBSTRING(active_info, 0, 35) AS active_info, roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (zoneid DIV 1000) < 57 AND SUBSTRING(active_info, 0, 35) LIKE '%1%') AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_ip, first_network_name FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_ip, first_network_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY register_time ASC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (zoneid DIV 1000) < 57 AND appid = 'mlbb' AND GEOIP(create_ip, 1) = 'IN') WHERE rn = 1) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid /* and a.roleid = '1804181694' */), tmp AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY skinid) AS index_num, 1 AS sup_col FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01'), active AS (/* 活跃位图拆分 */ SELECT roleid, ip_country, ip_region, a.logymd, a.active_info, first_network_name, index_num, DATE_ADD(a.logymd, (index_num - 1) * -1) AS current_day, SUBSTRING(a.active_info, INT(index_num), 1) AS active_status, a.zoneid FROM user_info AS a LEFT JOIN tmp AS b ON a.sup_col = b.sup_col AND index_num <= 35), active_user AS (/* 所有玩家活跃日期 */ SELECT roleid, ip_country, ip_region, first_network_name, current_day, zoneid, active_info, index_num, active_status FROM active WHERE active_status = '1'), pay_active /* -if pay or not */ AS (SELECT current_day, roleid, zoneid, first_network_name, ip_country, ip_region, IF(if_pay_active > 0, 1, 0) AS if_pay_active FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.ip_country, a.ip_region, a.current_day, a.first_network_name, a.zoneid, COUNT(b.roleid) AS if_pay_active FROM active_user AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, logymd, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND (zoneid DIV 1000) < 57 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.current_day >= logymd GROUP BY a.roleid, a.ip_country, a.ip_region, a.current_day, a.first_network_name, a.zoneid) AS m), pay AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid, first_network_name, GEOIP(create_ip, 1) AS ip_country, GEOIP(create_ip, 2) AS ip_region, SUM(money) AS money FROM (SELECT roleid, channel, money, a.os_type, money_new, a.logymd, a.client_ip, a.zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (zoneid DIV 1000) < 57) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_ip, first_network_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY register_time ASC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (zoneid DIV 1000) < 57 AND appid = 'mlbb' AND GEOIP(create_ip, 1) = 'IN') AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE GEOIP(create_ip, 1) = 'IN' AND rn = 1 GROUP BY first_network_name, ip_country, ip_region, a.logymd, a.roleid, a.zoneid), 30day_status /* roleid, */ /* ip_country, */ /* ip_region, */ /* first_network_name, */ /* current_day, */ /* zoneid, */ /* active_info, */ /* index_num */ AS (/* 当天活跃玩家前30天状态 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, ip_country, ip_region, first_network_name, current_day, active_info, index_num, SUBSTRING(active_info, index_num + 1, 30) AS recur_date FROM active_user), recurring AS (/* 所有回流玩家日期 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, ip_country, ip_region, first_network_name, current_day, CASE WHEN INT(LENGTH(recur_date)) = 30 AND recur_date NOT LIKE '%1%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_recur /* 1表示是当天回流玩家，0表示不是当天回流玩家 */ FROM 30day_status), 30day_active AS (SELECT current_day, roleid, zoneid, first_network_name, ip_country, ip_region, CASE WHEN active_status = '1' OR 29_day_status LIKE '%1%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_30day_active /* 1表示30天内活跃过，0表示没活跃 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ip_country, ip_region, first_network_name, current_day, active_info, index_num, active_status, SUBSTRING(active_info, index_num, 29) AS 29_day_status FROM active)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.ads_richardg_india_createip_info_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.current_day, a.ip_country, a.ip_region, a.first_network_name, COUNT(DISTINCT new.roleid) AS new_cnt, SUM(INT(active_status)) AS active_cnt, SUM(pay_active.if_pay_active) AS pay_active_cnt, COUNT(pay.roleid) AS pay_cnt, SUM(pay.money) AS money, SUM(if_recur) AS recurring_cnt, SUM(if_30day_active) AS 30day_active_cnt FROM active AS a LEFT JOIN new ON new.roleid = a.roleid AND new.zoneid = a.zoneid AND new.register_date = a.current_day AND new.ip_country = a.ip_country AND new.ip_region = a.ip_region AND new.first_network_name = a.first_network_name LEFT JOIN pay_active /* 单独计算非null的活跃付费 */ ON a.roleid = pay_active.roleid AND a.zoneid = pay_active.zoneid AND a.current_day = pay_active.current_day AND a.ip_country = pay_active.ip_country AND a.ip_region = pay_active.ip_region AND a.first_network_name = pay_active.first_network_name LEFT JOIN pay ON a.roleid = pay.roleid AND a.zoneid = pay.zoneid AND a.current_day = pay.logymd AND a.ip_country = pay.ip_country AND a.ip_region = pay.ip_region AND a.first_network_name = pay.first_network_name LEFT JOIN recurring /* 回流玩家计算if_recur的和 */ ON a.roleid = recurring.roleid AND a.zoneid = recurring.zoneid AND a.current_day = recurring.current_day AND a.ip_country = recurring.ip_country AND a.ip_region = recurring.ip_region AND a.first_network_name = recurring.first_network_name LEFT JOIN 30day_active /* 30天活跃计算if_30day_active的和 */ ON a.roleid = 30day_active.roleid AND a.zoneid = 30day_active.zoneid AND a.current_day = 30day_active.current_day AND a.ip_country = 30day_active.ip_country AND a.ip_region = 30day_active.ip_region AND a.first_network_name = 30day_active.first_network_name WHERE a.current_day = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY a.current_day, a.ip_country, a.ip_region, a.first_network_name

name: etl.mt_dwm.dwm_mcgg_charge_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: hengweiyan@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-03-10 16:17:30.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH raw_dwd AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.sub_pay_channel, a.bill_country, a.bill_currency, a.money, IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(a.`time`, 'yyyyMMddHHmmss'), '-', a.device_id), NULL) AS time_device_id, COALESCE(a.is_iap_token_buy, 0) AS is_iap_token_buy, COALESCE(a.is_sandbox, 0) AS is_sandbox, a.receipt_id, a.`time`, a.bill_amt, a.before_tax_amt, a.after_tax_amt, a.tax_amt, a.back_tax_amt, a.share_amt, a.fee_currency, a.fee_amt, a.actual_amt, a.base_diamond, a.extra_diamond, a.logymd, a.pay_channel, IF(pay_channel = 0, 'cashcard', a.game_pay_channel) AS pay_channel_name, a.currency_exchange_rate AS exchange_rate, a.fee_exchange_rate FROM (SELECT * FROM mt_dwd.dwd_mcgg_charge_order_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND bill_amt > 0 AND LOWER(product_id) NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%') AS a) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_mcgg_charge_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd) SELECT * FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pay_channel_name AS pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, bill_country AS country, bill_currency AS currency, COALESCE(MIN(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS first_pay_time, COALESCE(MAX(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_pay_time, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), bill_amt, 0)), 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), bill_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), before_tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS before_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), before_tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS before_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), after_tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS after_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), after_tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS after_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), back_tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS back_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), back_tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS back_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), share_amt, 0)), 0) AS share_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), share_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS share_usd_amt, COALESCE(fee_currency, 'unknown') AS fee_currency, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), fee_amt, 0)), 0) AS fee_amt, IF(fee_exchange_rate = 0, 0, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), fee_amt, 0)) / fee_exchange_rate, 0)) AS fee_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), actual_amt, 0)), 0) AS actual_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), actual_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), base_diamond, 0)), 0) AS pay_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS free_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), base_diamond + extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS get_diamond, COALESCE(MIN(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS first_token_time, COALESCE(MAX(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_token_time, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, bill_amt, 0)), 0) AS pay_token_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, bill_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_token_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_token_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, base_diamond, 0)), 0) AS pay_token_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS free_token_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, base_diamond + extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS get_token_diamond, COALESCE(MIN(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS first_sandbox_time, COALESCE(MAX(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_sandbox_time, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, bill_amt, 0)), 0) AS pay_sandbox_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, bill_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_sandbox_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_sandbox_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, base_diamond, 0)), 0) AS pay_sandbox_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS free_sandbox_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, base_diamond + extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS get_sandbox_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), money, 0)), 0) AS product_money, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, money, 0)), 0) AS product_token_money, COALESCE(SPLIT(MIN(time_device_id), '-')[1], 'unknown') AS first_pay_device_id, COALESCE(SPLIT(MAX(time_device_id), '-')[1], 'unknown') AS last_pay_device_id, logymd FROM raw_dwd GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pay_channel_name, sub_pay_channel, bill_country, bill_currency, logymd, exchange_rate, fee_exchange_rate, fee_currency, pay_channel) AS t WHERE before_tax_usd_amt > 0 OR pay_token_amt > 0 OR pay_sandbox_amt > 0

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_survey_qdes_project_seq_di
sql_units: WITH project AS (SELECT qdes_id, qdes_context_cn, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_qdes_project_config WHERE logymd /* logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2025-01-08', '2025-01-08', '2026-05-31') */ = '2026-05-31') */ = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 1 * -1)), answer AS (SELECT qdes_question_id, qdes_answer_id, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_qdes_answer_config WHERE logymd /* logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < project AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd LEFT JOIN answer AS c ON a.qdes_question_id = c.qdes_question_id), qdes_detail /* 问卷填答时间数据 */ AS (SELECT LOWER(a.project_id) AS project_id, a.begin_time, a.finish_time, a.id, b.qdes_question_id, b.qdes_type FROM adbi_ods.ods_xm_survey_respondent0 AS a INNER JOIN project_info AS b ON LOWER(a.project_id) = LOWER(b.qdes_id) WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY a.project_id, a.begin_time, a.finish_time, a.id, b.qdes_question_id, b.qdes_type), qdes_answer_info /* 问卷问题答案数据 */ AS (SELECT LOWER(a.project_id) AS project_id, a.answers, a.rid, a.created_dt, COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(custom_answers, '$.role_id'), GET_JSON_OBJECT(custom_answers, '$.custom_data__role_id')) AS roleid, COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(custom_answers, '$.zone_id'), GET_JSON_OBJECT(custom_answers, '$.custom_data__zone_id')) AS zoneid, a.seq, a.updated_dt FROM adbi_ods.ods_xm_survey_respondentdata0 AS a INNER JOIN project_info AS b ON LOWER(a.project_id) = LOWER(b.qdes_id) WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND LENGTH(a.answers) > 2), qdes_answer_info_new AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY project_id, roleid, zoneid ORDER BY created_dt ASC, name: MC2_分回合棋子胜率
sql_units: WITH ranktable AS (SELECT r.battleid, r.minranklvl AS rankid, r.accountid AS roleid, r.zoneid, CASE WHEN (realpvptype = 184 AND pvptype = 39) OR (realpvptype = 601 AND pvptype = 600) THEN 10001 WHEN (realpvptype = 185 AND pvptype = 39) OR (realpvptype IN (600, 602) AND pvptype = 600) THEN 10002 ELSE pvptype END AS pvptype FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS r WHERE r.logymd = '2026-05-31'), chessinfo_table AS (SELECT a.chessid, a.battleid, a.chessstarlevel, a.battleresult /* --0负1胜超时平局是3,2是空城平局 */, a.chessprice, a.accountid AS roleid, a.zoneid AS zoneid, (a.zoneid < 50000) AS servertype, FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) AS zone, a.round, COUNT(DISTINCT a.round) AS battlenum, CASE WHEN r.pvptype IN (10001, 10002) AND b.real_player_num = 4 THEN 1 WHEN b.real_player_num = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS all_real_player FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_MagicchessroundHeroInfo AS a JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, real_player_num FROM mcgg_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND success = 1) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid INNER JOIN ranktable AS r ON a.battleid = r.battleid AND a.accountid = r.roleid AND a.zoneid = r.zoneid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.battleresult <= 3 AND a.ai_accountid = a.accountid GROUP BY a.chessid, a.battleid, a.chessstarlevel, a.battleresult, a.chessprice, servertype, a.round, all_real_player, a.accountid, a.zoneid, zone), ntile_values AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY max_39_cupnum DESC) AS per_level, max_39_cupnum FROM mcgg_temp.selinasun_season_user_battle_summary_t0_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT max_39_cupnum IS NULL AND had_daily_bat = 1 /* 过滤掉 NULL 值 且 只看今日有排位行为的玩家的排行版分10pctil */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.selinasun_chess_round_winrate_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT c.chessid, COALESCE(t1.mname, 'unknown') AS mname, COALESCE(t1.quality, 'unknown') AS quality, c.chessstarlevel, c.chessprice, c.servertype, zone, c.round, c.all_real_player, per_level, CASE per_level WHEN 1 THEN '前1~10%' WHEN 2 THEN '前11~20%' WHEN 3 THEN '前21~30%' WHEN 4 THEN '前31~40%' WHEN 5 THEN '前41~50%' WHEN 6 THEN '前51~60%' WHEN 7 THEN '前61~70%' WHEN 8 THEN '前71~80%' WHEN 9 THEN '前81~90%' WHEN 10 THEN '前91~100%' END AS per_level_label, CASE WHEN r.rankid <= 2 THEN '勇士' WHEN r.rankid <= 5 THEN '精英' WHEN r.rankid <= 9 THEN '大师' WHEN r.rankid <= 16 THEN '宗师' WHEN r.rankid <= 25 THEN '史诗' WHEN r.rankid <= 35 THEN '传奇' ELSE CAST(r.rankid AS STRING) END AS ranklv, SUM(IF(c.battleresult = 1, 1, 0)) AS winnum, SUM(c.battlenum) AS battleallnum, r.pvptype FROM chessinfo_table AS c INNER JOIN ranktable AS r ON c.battleid = r.battleid AND c.roleid = r.roleid AND c.zoneid = r.zoneid LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_mchero_mcgg_config_df AS t1 ON c.chessid = t1.id AND c.servertype = t1.servertype AND r.pvptype = t1.pvptype AND t1.logymd = '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN ntile_values AS t3 ON c.roleid = t3.roleid AND c.zoneid = t3.zoneid WHERE c.round BETWEEN 1 AND 30 GROUP BY c.servertype, zone, c.chessid, c.chessstarlevel, c.chessprice, c.round, COALESCE(t1.mname, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t1.quality, 'unknown'), c.all_real_player, CASE WHEN r.rankid <= 2 THEN '勇士' WHEN r.rankid <= 5 THEN '精英' WHEN r.rankid <= 9 THEN '大师' WHEN r.rankid <= 16 THEN '宗师' WHEN r.rankid <= 25 THEN '史诗' WHEN r.rankid <= 35 THEN '传奇' ELSE CAST(r.rankid AS STRING) END, r.pvptype, per_level, per_level_label

name: MLMC双端赛季活跃did流转
sql_units: WITH current_season AS (SELECT CAST(seasonid AS INT) AS cur_season, (CAST(seasonid AS INT) - 1) AS last_season FROM mt_dim.dim_mcrankseason_config_df WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 1 * -1) AND '2026-05-30' BETWEEN SUBSTRING(seasonstarttime, 1, 10) AND SUBSTRING(seasonendtime, 1, 10) /* 此处是更新前2天的数据，因此没有挂依赖，因为前2天的数据已经产生了，还没产生的是前一天的 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_mlmc_season_active_retention_di PARTITION(start_date) SELECT a.season_id, a.end_date, c.update_date, a.country, a.user_tag, CASE WHEN a.active_type = 'active_both' THEN 'ML&MC均活跃' WHEN a.active_type = 'active_mc' THEN '仅MC活跃' WHEN a.active_type = 'active_ml' THEN '仅ML活跃' END AS last_season_tag, CASE WHEN b.active_type = 'active_both' THEN 'ML&MC均活跃' WHEN b.active_type = 'active_mc' THEN '仅MC活跃' WHEN b.active_type = 'active_ml' THEN '仅ML活跃' WHEN b.active_type IS NULL THEN '流失' END AS cur_season_tag, COUNT(a.did) AS cnt, a.start_date FROM (SELECT season_id, start_date, end_date, 1 AS tmp, country, active_type, user_tag, did FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_mlmc_season_active_user_di AS a JOIN current_season AS b ON a.season_id = b.last_season WHERE start_date BETWEEN '2025-11-12' AND '2026-05-30' /* --上一个赛季的用户 */) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT season_id, active_type, did, update_date FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_mlmc_season_active_user_di AS a JOIN current_season AS b ON a.season_id = b.cur_season WHERE start_date BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-30' /* --最新赛季的用户，新赛季可能超过90天 */) AS b ON a.did = b.did AND a.season_id = (b.season_id - 1) LEFT JOIN (SELECT update_date, 1 AS tmp FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_mlmc_season_active_user_di AS a JOIN current_season AS b ON a.season_id = b.cur_season WHERE start_date BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-30' /* --最新赛季的用户 */ GROUP BY update_date) AS c ON a.tmp = c.tmp GROUP BY a.season_id, a.start_date, a.end_date, c.update_date, a.country, a.user_tag, a.active_type, b.active_type

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_mlmc_season_active_retention_di PARTITION(start_date) SELECT NULL AS season_id, NULL AS end_date, NULL AS update_date, NULL AS country, NULL AS user_tag, NULL AS last_season_tag, NULL AS cur_season_tag, 0 AS cnt, '2026-05-30' AS start_date

sql_units: WITH basic AS (/* 基础信息表 */ SELECT * FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country, SUBSTRING(register_date, 1, 10) AS register_date, IF(os = 'unknown', '', os) AS register_os, IF(first_network_name = 'unknown', '', first_network_name) AS first_network_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY register_date) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2019-02-28' /* 限制上线日期 */) AS t WHERE rn = 1), active_di AS (/* 活跃增量表 */ SELECT roleid, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_td, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_7d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-18' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_14d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_30d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', login_duration, 0)) AS online_dur /* MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS is_1_7d, */ /* MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS is_1_14d, */ /* MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS is_1_30d, */, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-03' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_90d /* MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-24', 1, 0)) AS is_7ds, --7日前是否活跃 */ /* MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-01', 1, 0)) AS is_30ds --30日前是否活跃 */ /* 近90天是否活跃 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31', logymd, NULL)) AS activedays_7days /* 近7日活跃天数 */, SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31', login_duration, 0)) AS online_dur_7days FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-03' AND '2026-05-31' AND login_cnt > 0 /* 代表活跃 */ AND logymd >= '2019-02-28' /* 限制上线日期 */ GROUP BY roleid), pay_di AS (/* 支付全量表 */ SELECT roleid, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', charge_money, 0)) AS pay_amt /* SUM(if(logymd = '2026-05-31' , charge_cnt, 0)) AS charge_cnt, */, SUM(charge_money) AS his_pay_amt, SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-05-31', charge_money, 0)) AS year_pay_amt, SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31', charge_money, 0)) AS pay_amt_7days /* 近7日付费金额 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_pay_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2019-02-28' /* 限制上线日期 */ GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mla', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, COALESCE(bas.country, 'unknown') AS country, 'unknown' AS os, 'unknown' AS network, COALESCE(SUM(IF(bas.register_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)), 0) AS register_cnt, 0 AS pure_register_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(COALESCE(act_di.is_td, 0) = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(COALESCE(act_di.is_30d, 0) = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt_30days, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt > 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_di.pay_amt), 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS active_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_30d_cnt, 0 AS recurring_cnt_30days, 0 AS nologin_cnt_30days, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate, COALESCE(SUM(IF(COALESCE(act_di.is_td, 0) = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt_period, COALESCE(SUM(IF(pay_di.pay_amt > 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_cnt_period, SUM(COALESCE(act_di.online_dur, 0)) AS online_dur /*	当日玩家总在线时长(单位：s) */, 0 AS new_active_cnt /*	新用户活跃玩家数 */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(bas.register_date <= '2026-05-31', 1, 0)), 0) AS register_cnt_total /*	历史总注册玩家数 */, 0 AS lose_cnt_7ds /*	7日流失玩家数 */, 0 AS active_cnt_7ds /*	7日前DAU */, 0 AS lose_cnt_30ds /*	30日流失玩家数 */, 0 AS active_cnt_30ds /*	30日前DAU */, COALESCE(SUM(IF(COALESCE(act_di.is_7d, 0) = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt_7days /*	近7日活跃玩家数 */, SUM(COALESCE(year_pay_amt, 0)) AS year_pay_amt /*	本年累计付费金额 */, 0 AS year_before_tax_usd_amt /*	本年累计付费税率校准金额 */, SUM(COALESCE(his_pay_amt, 0)) AS his_pay_amt /*	历史累计付费金额 */, 0 AS his_before_tax_usd_amt /*	历史累计税率校准付费金额 */, 0 AS recurring_cnt_14days, 0 AS nologin_cnt_14days, 0 AS actual_pay_amt, 2 AS user_type, NULL AS channel, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act_di.is_90d = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt_90days, COALESCE(SUM(IF(act_di.is_td = 1 AND (act_di.activedays_7days >= 2 OR pay_amt_7days > 0), 1, 0)), 0) AS vaild_user_cnt, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(IF(act_di.is_td = 1 AND (act_di.activedays_7days >= 2 OR pay_amt_7days > 0), act_di.online_dur_7days, 0)) / LEAST(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '2019-02-28') + 1, 7), 0), 0) AS vaild_user_online_dur FROM basic AS bas LEFT JOIN active_di AS act_di ON bas.roleid = act_di.roleid LEFT JOIN pay_di AS pay_di ON bas.roleid = pay_di.roleid GROUP BY COALESCE(bas.country, 'unknown')

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_qmzhang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-03-20 15:23:46.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 自25年起与新经分【按国家查询】看板口径保持一致，经分和观星台月度DAU/新增/回流自2025-01-04起开始算测服 */ WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, register_date, create_os, first_mt_country, first_network_name FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1 /* 账号创建首个角色记录 */ GROUP BY roleid, register_date, create_os, first_mt_country, first_network_name) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.zqm_dau_flow_statistics_day_25 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT t1.create_os AS os_type /* 首次创角系统类型 */, t1.first_mt_country /* 首次创号国 */, t1.first_network_name /* 首次广告归因渠道 */, COALESCE(active_dau, 0) AS active_dau /* 日活跃用户数 */, COALESCE(new_dau, 0) AS new_dau /* 新增用户数 */, COALESCE(org_new_dau, 0) AS org_new_dau /* 自然新增用户数 */, COALESCE(put_new_dau, 0) AS put_new_dau /* 投放新增用户数 */, COALESCE(recur_dau, 0) AS recur_dau /* 30日流失用户数 */ FROM (SELECT create_os, first_mt_country, first_network_name FROM basic GROUP BY create_os, first_mt_country, first_network_name) AS t1 /* 所有维度组合 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT first_mt_country, first_network_name, create_os, SUM(IF(user_type = 'is_recurring', 1, 0)) AS recur_dau /* 30日回流人数 */ /* SUM(IF(user_type = 'old', 1, 0)) AS old_active_cnt, --老用户活跃人数 */ /* SUM(IF(user_type = 'new', 1, 0)) AS new_active_cnt --新用户活跃人数 */ FROM (SELECT t1.roleid, t2.first_mt_country, t2.first_network_name, create_os, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, t2.register_date) >= 30 AND t3.roleid IS NULL THEN 'is_recurring' /* 回流玩家 */ WHEN DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, t2.register_date) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(t1.logymd, t2.register_date) < 30 THEN 'new' ELSE 'old' END AS user_type FROM (SELECT roleid, logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND /* 2025-01-03及之前DAU口径为正式服，2025-01-04起为全服 */ IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid, logymd) AS t1 LEFT JOIN basic AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 30 * -1) AND logymd <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-30', 1 * -1) AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND /* 2025-01-03及之前DAU口径为正式服，2025-01-04起为全服 */ IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid) AS t3 /* 前30日活跃玩家 */ ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid) AS t GROUP BY first_mt_country, first_network_name, create_os) AS t2 /* 30日回流玩家数 */ ON t1.first_mt_country = t2.first_mt_country AND t1.create_os = t2.create_os AND t1.first_network_name = t2.first_network_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT first_mt_country, first_network_name, create_os, COUNT(1) AS new_dau, SUM(IF(first_network_name = 'organic', 1, 0)) AS org_new_dau /* 自然新增 */, SUM(IF(first_network_name <> 'organic', 1, 0)) AS put_new_dau /* 投放新增 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, create_os, first_mt_country, first_network_name FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND register_date = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1 /* 账号创建首个角色记录 */ AND /* 2025-01-03及之前DAU口径为正式服，2025-01-04起为全服 */ IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid, create_os, first_mt_country, first_network_name) AS t GROUP BY first_mt_country, first_network_name, create_os) AS t3 /* 新增玩家&自然新增 */ ON t1.first_mt_country = t3.first_mt_country AND t1.create_os = t3.create_os AND t1.first_network_name = t3.first_network_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT first_mt_country, first_network_name, create_os, COUNT(1) AS active_dau FROM (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND /* 2025-01-03及之前DAU口径为正式服，2025-01-04起为全服 */ IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN basic AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid GROUP BY first_mt_country, first_network_name, create_os) AS t4 /* 日活跃玩家 */ ON t1.first_mt_country = t4.first_mt_country AND t1.create_os = t4.create_os AND t1.first_network_name = t4.first_network_name

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_multi_decismart_core_df_mcgg
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jichun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-04-22 21:48:15.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, create_role_date AS create_date, CASE WHEN new_type = '模拟器新增' THEN 2 WHEN new_type = '纯净新增' THEN 3 WHEN new_type = '切号新增(被切号)' THEN 4 WHEN new_type = '灰产新增' THEN 6 ELSE -99999 END AS new_type, IF(first_mt_country = '' OR first_mt_country = '-' OR first_mt_country IS NULL, 'unknown', first_mt_country) AS country, IF(first_media_source = '' OR first_media_source = '-' OR first_media_source IS NULL, 'unknown', first_media_source) AS network, IF(LOWER(first_media_source) = 'organic', 1, 2) AS network_group, IF(create_role_os_name = '' OR create_role_os_name = '-' OR create_role_os_name IS NULL, 'unknown', create_role_os_name) AS create_os, IF(create_role_channel = '' OR create_role_channel = '-' OR create_role_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_role_channel) AS create_channel, IF(role_type = '' OR role_type = '-' OR role_type IS NULL, -99999, role_type) AS create_install_label, is_yl AS is_create_arcade FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df_decismart WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-05-01', '2025-05-01', '2026-05-31') AND is_first_create = 1 AND create_role_date <= '2026-05-31'), active_all_account_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(last_active_os = '' OR last_active_os = '-' OR last_active_os IS NULL, 'unknown', last_active_os) AS last_active_os, IF(his_last_channel = '' OR his_last_channel = '-' OR his_last_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', his_last_channel) AS last_active_channel, IF(day_ml_install = '' OR day_ml_install = '-' OR day_ml_install IS NULL, -99999, day_ml_install) AS last_active_install_label, his_last_active_time, his_last_active_date AS last_active_date FROM (SELECT *, IF(his_last_channel LIKE '%%ios_%%', 'ios', IF(his_last_channel LIKE '%%and_%%', 'android', his_last_os_name)) AS last_active_os, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY his_last_active_time DESC) AS rn FROM mcgg_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') WHERE rn = 1), active_all_account AS (SELECT roleid, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', day_yl_active, 0)) AS is_active_arcade, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_td, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_7d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-18' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_14d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_30d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS is_1_7d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS is_1_14d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30', 1, 0)) AS is_1_30d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', day_online_dur, 0)) AS online_dur, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-24', 1, 0)) AS is_7ds /* 7日前是否活跃 */, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-01', 1, 0)) AS is_30ds /* 30日前是否活跃 */ FROM mcgg_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid), account_pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', product_money, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', before_tax_usd_amt, 0)) AS pay_amt_exrate, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, 0)) AS actual_pay_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mcgg_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid), account_pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, SUBSTRING(MIN(his_first_pay_time), 1, 10) AS first_pay_date, SUBSTRING(MAX(his_last_pay_time), 1, 10) AS last_pay_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mcgg_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_multi_decismart_core_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mcgg', granularity_type = 'account') SELECT bas.roleid AS accountid /*	角色id,key */, -99999 AS zoneid /*	服务器,key */, 'unknown' AS deviceid /*	设备id */, bas.create_date /*	注册日期 */, bas.country /*	国家(归因国)（新增属性） */, bas.network /*	广告渠道（新增属性） */, bas.network_group /*	广告渠道分组（新增属性） */, bas.new_type /*	玩家新增类型（新增属性） */, bas.create_os /*	系统类型（新增属性） */, bas.create_channel /*	渠道（新增属性） */, bas.create_install_label /*	玩家安装类型标签（新增属性） */, COALESCE(act_df.last_active_os, bas.create_os) AS last_active_os /*	末次登录系统类型（活跃属性） */, COALESCE(act_df.last_active_channel, bas.create_channel) AS last_active_channel /*	末次登录渠道（活跃属性） */, COALESCE(act_df.last_active_install_label, bas.create_install_label) AS last_active_install_label /*	末次登录玩家安装类型标签（活跃属性） */, IF(act.is_td = 1, 1, 0) AS is_active /*	当日是否活跃(1:是，0:否) */, COALESCE(act.online_dur, 0) AS online_dur /*	当日在线时长 */, COALESCE(pay_di.pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt /*	充值金额(美分) */, COALESCE(pay_di.pay_amt_exrate, 0) AS pay_amt_exrate /*	汇率校准付费金额(美分) */, COALESCE(pay_di.actual_pay_amt, 0) AS actual_pay_amt /*	实收金额(美分) */, IF(act.is_td = 1 AND act.is_1_14d <> 1 AND bas.create_date < '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-31' >= DATE_ADD('2024-11-28', 14), 1, 0) AS is_recurring_14days, IF(act.is_td = 1 AND act.is_1_30d <> 1 AND bas.create_date < '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' >= DATE_ADD('2024-11-28', 30), 1, 0) AS is_recurring_30days /*	当日是否30日回流(1:是，0:否) */, COALESCE(act_df.last_active_date, '1970-01-01') AS last_active_date /*	末次活跃日期 */, COALESCE(pay_df.first_pay_date, '1970-01-01') AS first_pay_date /*	首次付费日期 */, COALESCE(pay_df.last_pay_date, '1970-01-01') AS last_pay_date /*	末次付费日期 */, COALESCE(bas.is_create_arcade, 0) AS is_create_arcade, COALESCE(act.is_active_arcade, 0) AS is_active_arcade, 1 AS is_first_create, 1 AS zone_type, 0 AS is_cur_bot, 0 AS is_init_bot, NULL AS his_pay_amt, NULL AS first_active_os, NULL AS first_active_channel, 0 AS is_active_7days, 0 AS is_active_30days, 0 AS year_pay_amt, 0 AS is_active_90days, 0 AS activedays_7days, 0 AS online_dur_7days, 0 AS pay_amt_7days FROM basic AS bas LEFT JOIN active_all_account AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid LEFT JOIN active_all_account_df AS act_df ON bas.roleid = act_df.roleid LEFT JOIN account_pay_di AS pay_di ON bas.roleid = pay_di.roleid LEFT JOIN account_pay_df AS pay_df ON bas.roleid = pay_df.roleid

name: MC2每日活跃用户付费指标
output_hint: MC2每日活跃用户付费指标
sql_units: WITH charge AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, SUM(money) AS pay_amt, SUM(IF(tag = 1, money, 0)) AS else_pay_amt, SUM(IF(tag = 2, money, 0)) AS yl_pay_amt FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, money, 1 AS tag FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND money > 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 /* 排除代币购买数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND is_sandbox = 0 /* 排除沙盒测试数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷苹果假冒卡 (有收入) 数据, 因为点卡的 receipt_id = 0 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* GP 礼品卡, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ UNION ALL SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, (cost_num * 100) AS money, 2 AS tag FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_act_mcoin_exchange WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND cost_num > 0) GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid), mobapay AS (/* mobapay订单 */ SELECT logymd, userid AS roleid, serverid AS zoneid, 'mobapay' AS type, SUM(price_usd) AS money FROM mtwb_ods.payserver_mobapay_order /* 西8时区 */ WHERE appid = 124526 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND status = 4 /* 成功 */ GROUP BY logymd, userid, serverid), no_mobapay AS (/* 三方非mobapay订单 ---原日志0时区 */ SELECT SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(create_time)) - INTERVAL '8' HOUR, 1, 10) AS logymd, user_id AS roleid, server_id AS zoneid /* server_id是区服id */, 'no_mobapay' AS type, SUM(usd_price_cent) AS money FROM (SELECT * FROM mt_ods.db_payment_order_payment_order_new_df /* -0时区 */ WHERE status = 4 /* 成功 */ AND app_id = 124526 /* 这个是指mcgg在支付的id */ AND SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(create_time)) - INTERVAL '8' HOUR, 1, 10) = '2026-05-31' /* 处理成西8时区 */) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_ods.db_payment_order_payment_order_detail_new_df) AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.order_id GROUP BY SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(create_time)) - INTERVAL '8' HOUR, 1, 10), user_id, server_id), third_pay AS (SELECT * FROM mobapay UNION ALL SELECT * FROM no_mobapay) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_daily_user_charge_di PARTITION(logymd) /* 先插入每日有游戏内付费的用户数据 */ SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.pay_amt, t0.yl_pay_amt, t0.else_pay_amt, t1.third_pay_amt, t1.mobapay_amt, t1.nomobapay_amt, (t0.pay_amt + COALESCE(t2.total_amt, 0)) AS total_amt, (t0.yl_pay_amt + COALESCE(t2.total_yl_amt, 0)) AS total_yl_amt, (t0.else_pay_amt + COALESCE(t2.total_else_amt, 0)) AS total_else_amt, (t1.third_pay_amt + COALESCE(t2.total_third_amt, 0)) AS total_third_amt, (t1.mobapay_amt + COALESCE(t2.total_mobapay_amt, 0)) AS total_mobapay_amt, (t1.nomobapay_amt + COALESCE(t2.total_nomobapay_amt, 0)) AS total_nomobapay_amt, (1 + COALESCE(t2.total_day_cnt, 0)) AS total_day_cnt, t0.logymd FROM charge AS t0 LEFT JOIN (/* -当日三方付费金额 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(money) AS third_pay_amt, SUM(IF(type IN ('mobapay'), money, 0)) AS mobapay_amt, SUM(IF(NOT type IN ('mobapay'), money, 0)) AS nomobapay_amt FROM third_pay WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t0.logymd = t1.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, total_amt, total_yl_amt, total_else_amt, total_third_amt, total_mobapay_amt, total_nomobapay_amt, total_day_cnt FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_user_charge_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t2.zoneid UNION ALL SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, 0 AS pay_amt, 0 AS yl_pay_amt, 0 AS else_pay_amt, t0.third_pay_amt, t0.mobapay_amt, t0.nomobapay_amt, t1.total_amt, t1.total_yl_amt, t1.total_else_amt, (third_pay_amt + COALESCE(t1.total_third_amt, 0)) AS total_third_amt, (mobapay_amt + COALESCE(t1.total_mobapay_amt, 0)) AS total_mobapay_amt, (nomobapay_amt + COALESCE(t1.total_nomobapay_amt, 0)) AS total_nomobapay_amt, t1.total_day_cnt, t0.logymd FROM (/* 处理当日没有游戏内付费，但是有三方充值的用户 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(money) AS third_pay_amt, SUM(IF(type IN ('mobapay'), money, 0)) AS mobapay_amt, SUM(IF(NOT type IN ('mobapay'), money, 0)) AS nomobapay_amt FROM third_pay AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM charge AS b WHERE a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS t0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, total_amt, total_yl_amt, total_else_amt, total_third_amt, total_mobapay_amt, total_nomobapay_amt, total_day_cnt FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_user_charge_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid

name: MC2全量用户付费指标
sql_units: /* 处理当日产生了三方数据的用户，然后将数据插入全量表 */ /* 处理当日的付费数据，包括当日付费，判断当日是否首次付费，以及首次付费用户的首笔订单 */ WITH payment_history AS (SELECT * FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_user_charge_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), daily_charge_detail AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, time, level, product_id, money, 1 AS tag FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND money > 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 /* 排除代币购买数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND is_sandbox = 0 /* 排除沙盒测试数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷苹果假冒卡 (有收入) 数据, 因为点卡的 receipt_id = 0 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* GP 礼品卡, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ UNION ALL SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, time, level, 'yl_exchange' AS product_id, (cost_num * 100) AS money, 2 AS tag FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_act_mcoin_exchange WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND cost_num > 0), daily_charge AS (/* ---当日产生过游戏内付费的用户 */ SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.logymd, CASE WHEN b.roleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_first_pay, SUM(a.money) AS pay_amt, SUM(IF(a.tag = 1, a.money, 0)) AS else_amt, SUM(IF(a.tag = 2, a.money, 0)) AS yl_amt FROM daily_charge_detail AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM payment_history WHERE total_amt > 0 /* 历史在游戏内付费过 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.logymd, CASE WHEN b.roleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), daily_first_order AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_order_product, first_order_amt, first_order_level FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, FIRST_VALUE(product_id) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time ASC) AS first_order_product, FIRST_VALUE(money) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time ASC) AS first_order_amt, FIRST_VALUE(level) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time ASC) AS first_order_level FROM daily_charge_detail AS a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM daily_charge WHERE if_first_pay = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b WHERE a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, first_order_product, first_order_amt, first_order_level), daily_mobapay AS (/* mobapay订单 */ SELECT logymd, userid AS roleid, serverid AS zoneid, 'mobapay' AS type, SUM(price_usd) AS money FROM mtwb_ods.payserver_mobapay_order /* 西8时区 */ WHERE appid = 124526 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND status = 4 /* 成功 */ GROUP BY logymd, userid, serverid), daily_no_mobapay AS (/* SELECT  --三方非mobapay订单 ---原日志0时区 */ /*     substring(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(create_time), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') - INTERVAL '8' hour,1,10) as logymd, */ /*     user_id as roleid,  */ /*     server_id as zoneid,--server_id是区服id */ /*     'no_mobapay' as type, */ /*     sum(usd_price_cent) as money */ /* from */ /* ( */ /*     select * */ /*     from mt_ods.db_payment_order_payment_order  ---0时区 */ /*     where status = 4 --成功 */ /*     and app_id = 124526 --这个是指mcgg在支付的id */ /*     and substring(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(create_time), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') - INTERVAL '8' hour,1,10) =  '2026-05-31' --处理成西8时区 */ /* )t1 */ /* left join ( */ /*     select * */ /*     from mt_ods.db_payment_order_payment_order_detail */ /* )t2 */ /* on t1.id = t2.order_id */ /* group by */ /*     substring(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(create_time), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') - INTERVAL '8' hour,1,10) , */ /*     user_id , */ /*     server_id */ SELECT logymd /* 三方非mobapay订单 ---原日志0时区 */, user_id AS roleid, server_id AS zoneid /* server_id是区服id */, 'no_mobapay' AS type, SUM(usd_price_cent) AS money FROM (SELECT id, user_id, server_id, create_time, DATE_FORMAT(TO_TIMESTAMP(create_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') - INTERVAL '8' HOUR, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS logymd FROM mt_ods.db_payment_order_payment_order_new_df /* -0时区 */ WHERE status = 4 /* 成功 */ AND app_id = 124526 /* 这个是指mcgg在支付的id */ AND DATE_FORMAT(TO_TIMESTAMP(create_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') - INTERVAL '8' HOUR, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(usd_price_cent) AS usd_price_cent FROM mt_ods.db_payment_order_payment_order_detail_new_df GROUP BY order_id) AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.order_id GROUP BY logymd, user_id, server_id), daily_third_pay AS (SELECT * FROM daily_mobapay UNION ALL SELECT * FROM daily_no_mobapay), charge_ingame AS (/* --表生成逻辑分为两部分：先处理当日在游戏内产生过付费的用户的最新指标，与前一日的合并 */ /* --再单独处理三方支付的数据，与前一日合并(这两部分必须分开独立处理,因为游戏内的付费和三方的付费时间，会不一致，很难拿哪个当左表) */ /* 处理当日首次付费的用户数据 */ SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.first_pay_date, t0.first_pay_amt, t1.first_order_product, t1.first_order_amt, t1.first_order_level, t0.first_pay_date AS last_pay_date, t0.first_pay_amt AS last_pay_amt, t0.first_pay_amt AS total_amt, t0.yl_amt AS total_yl_amt, t0.else_amt AS total_else_amt, t2.total_third_amt, t2.total_mobapay_amt, t2.total_nomobapay_amt, 1 AS total_day_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS first_pay_date, pay_amt AS first_pay_amt, else_amt, yl_amt FROM daily_charge WHERE if_first_pay = 1) AS t0 LEFT JOIN daily_first_order AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN payment_history AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t2.zoneid /* -注意这里也要加历史数据，防止用户之前有第三方付费 */ UNION ALL /* 处理当日付费，且非首次付费用户数据 */ SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t1.first_pay_date, t1.first_pay_amt, t1.first_order_product, t1.first_order_amt, t1.first_order_level, t0.logymd AS last_pay_date, t0.pay_amt AS last_pay_amt, (t0.pay_amt + t1.total_amt) AS total_amt, (t0.yl_amt + t1.total_yl_amt) AS total_yl_amt, (t0.else_amt + t1.total_else_amt) AS total_else_amt, t1.total_third_amt, t1.total_mobapay_amt, t1.total_nomobapay_amt, 1 + t1.total_day_cnt AS zoneid FROM daily_third_pay) AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid WHERE t1.roleid IS NULL /* 等价于 NOT EXISTS */

name: 分路弹性系数
sql_units: WITH binned_data AS (SELECT bigranklvl, real_road, WIDTH_BUCKET(LEAST(GREATEST(kda, 0), 100), 0, 100, 1) AS bucket, AVG(wincamp) AS win_rate /* 组内平均胜率 */, AVG(kda) AS avg_kda /* 组内平均经济 */ FROM ml_temp.celiaye_road_contribution_rawdata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND kda BETWEEN 0 AND 100 GROUP BY bigranklvl, real_road, WIDTH_BUCKET(LEAST(GREATEST(kda, 0), 100), 0, 100, 1)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.celiaye_road_contribution_elasticitycoefficient PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT bigranklvl, real_road, COVAR_POP(LN(avg_kda), win_rate) /* 弹性系数 = 协方差(ln(avg_money), win_rate) / 方差(ln(avg_money)) */ / VARIANCE_POP(LN(avg_kda)) AS elasticity FROM binned_data WHERE NOT avg_kda IS NULL GROUP BY bigranklvl, real_road

mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-03-23', '2025-03-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mla_synclog'), t /* ) t2 */ AS (/* select */ /*     * */ /* from ( SECOND(account_register_time)) DIV 300) point */ FROM (SELECT roleid AS account_id, zoneid, SUBSTRING(register_date, 1, 10) AS createdate, register_date AS account_register_time, first_mt_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY register_date) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-03-22', '2025-03-22', '2026-05-30')) AS t1 WHERE rn = 1 AND createdate IN ('2026-05-30', '2026-05-25')), t_login AS (/* SELECT */ /*       roleid as account_id */ /*      ,min_by(LEAST(287, (HOUR(first_active_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(first_active_time) * 60 + SECOND(first_active_time)) DIV 300), first_active_time) as point */ /*     --  ,LEAST(287, (HOUR(first_active_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(first_active_time) * 60 + SECOND(first_active_time)) DIV 300) as point */ /* FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mla_active_role_zone_di */ /* where logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /* GROUP BY roleid */ SELECT roleid AS account_id, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point FROM (/* 本表所有的ods role zone 全集，一般情况下login和logout等于全集，为防止遗漏，拼接上所有表 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY `time`) AS rn FROM mh_ods.gameserver_login /* 登录 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND reconn = 0) AS t WHERE rn = 1), t_register AS (SELECT country, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-30', account_id, NULL)) AS register_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-25', account_id, NULL)) AS register_cnt_7d FROM t GROUP BY country), t_create_base AS (SELECT point, country, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-30', t.account_id, NULL)) AS login_point_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-25', t.account_id, NULL)) AS login_point_cnt_7d FROM t JOIN t_login ON t.account_id = t_login.account_id GROUP BY point, country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_retention` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mla', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point /*  , 1 as zone_type */, country, 0 AS create_role_point_cnt, 0 AS login_point_cnt, register_cnt AS create_role_point_cnt, SUM(login_point_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname ORDER BY point) AS login_day_cnt, register_cnt_7d AS create_role_point_cnt_7d, SUM(login_point_cnt_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname ORDER BY point) AS login_day_cnt_7d FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_create_base.login_point_cnt, 0) AS login_point_cnt, COALESCE(t_create_base.login_point_cnt_7d, 0) AS login_point_cnt_7d, COALESCE(t_register.register_cnt, 0) AS register_cnt, COALESCE(t_register.register_cnt_7d, 0) AS register_cnt_7d, t_incr.appname FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_create_base ON t_incr.country = t_create_base.country AND t_incr.point = t_create_base.point LEFT JOIN t_register ON t_incr.country = t_register.country) AS t1

sql_units: WITH t_create AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT account_id, first_mt_country AS country, account_register_date AS logymd, LEAST(287, (HOUR(account_register_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(account_register_time) * 60 + SECOND(account_register_time)) DIV 300) AS point FROM (SELECT roleid AS account_id, zoneid, SUBSTRING(register_date, 1, 10) AS account_register_date, register_date AS account_register_time, first_mt_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY register_date) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t WHERE rn = 1 AND SUBSTRING(account_register_date, 1, 10) = '2026-05-31') AS t2), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-03-23', '2025-03-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mla_synclog') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_create` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mla', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, '' AS network, COALESCE(t2.point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(t2.point_cnt, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t_incr.country ORDER BY t_incr.point) AS day_cnt FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN (SELECT point, country, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS point_cnt FROM t_create GROUP BY logymd, point, country HAVING point_cnt > 0) AS t2 ON t2.point = t_incr.point AND t2.country = t_incr.country

sql_units: /* 任务运行时长	0.5	10	60 */ /* 扫描分区数	0.5	30	365 */ /* shuffle读取量(GB)	0.5	512	1024 */ /* shuffle写入量(GB)	0.5	512	1024 */ /* 输出文件数	0.5	400	2000 */ /* 输出文件大小	0.5	1024000	1024000000 */ /* 输出平均文件大小	0.5	256000	512000 */ WITH TASK_INFO AS (SELECT project_name, queue_name, application_id, startTime, endTime, task_id, task_name, is_completed, user_name, dp_name, trigger_type_name, duration, total_partitions_read, total_scan_files_size, total_files_scan, AVG(CASE metric_name WHEN '任务运行时长' THEN IF(duration <= threshold_green, 100, IF(duration >= threshold_red, 0, IF(duration > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 - ((duration - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 + ((threshold_ye - duration) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green)))))) WHEN 'shuffle读取量(GB)' THEN IF(shuffle_read_gb <= threshold_green, 100, IF(shuffle_read_gb >= threshold_red, 0, IF(shuffle_read_gb > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 - ((shuffle_read_gb - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 + ((threshold_ye - shuffle_read_gb) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green)))))) WHEN 'shuffle写入量(GB)' THEN IF(shuffle_write_gb <= threshold_green, 100, IF(shuffle_write_gb >= threshold_red, 0, IF(shuffle_write_gb > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 - ((shuffle_write_gb - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 + ((threshold_ye - shuffle_write_gb) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green)))))) WHEN '输出文件数' THEN IF(output_files_num <= threshold_green, 100, IF(output_files_num >= threshold_red, 0, IF(output_files_num > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 - ((output_files_num - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 + ((threshold_ye - output_files_num) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green)))))) WHEN '输出文件大小' THEN IF(output_files_size <= threshold_green, 100, IF(output_files_size >= threshold_red, 0, IF(output_files_size > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 - ((output_files_size - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 + ((threshold_ye - output_files_size) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green)))))) WHEN 'core资源' THEN IF(core_minute <= threshold_green, 100, IF(core_minute >= threshold_red, 0, IF(core_minute > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 - ((core_minute - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 + ((threshold_ye - core_minute) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green)))))) WHEN '输出平均文件大小' THEN IF(output_files_size * 1.0 / output_files_num BETWEEN threshold_green AND threshold_red, 100, 60) WHEN '扫描分区数' THEN IF(total_partitions_read <= threshold_green, 100, IF(total_partitions_read >= threshold_red, 0, IF(total_partitions_read > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), 60 - ((total_partitions_read - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye))), 60 + ((threshold_ye - total_partitions_read) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green)))))) WHEN 'core&memory比值' THEN IF(CAST(executor_core * 1.0 / executor_memory AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) BETWEEN threshold_red AND threshold_green, 100, 60) WHEN '失败task数' THEN IF(task_failed = 0, 100, 60) ELSE 0 END) AS health_score, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(CASE metric_name WHEN '任务运行时长' THEN IF(duration <= threshold_green, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), IF(duration >= threshold_red, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), IF(duration > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 - ((duration - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye)))), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 + ((threshold_ye - duration) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green))))))) WHEN 'shuffle读取量(GB)' THEN IF(shuffle_read_gb <= threshold_green, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), IF(shuffle_read_gb >= threshold_red, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), IF(shuffle_read_gb > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 - ((shuffle_read_gb - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye)))), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 + ((threshold_ye - shuffle_read_gb) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green))))))) WHEN 'shuffle写入量(GB)' THEN IF(shuffle_write_gb <= threshold_green, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), IF(shuffle_write_gb >= threshold_red, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), IF(shuffle_write_gb > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 - ((shuffle_write_gb - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye)))), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 + ((threshold_ye - shuffle_write_gb) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green))))))) WHEN '输出文件数' THEN IF(output_files_num <= threshold_green, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), IF(output_files_num >= threshold_red, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), IF(output_files_num > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 - ((output_files_num - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye)))), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 + ((threshold_ye - output_files_num) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green))))))) WHEN '输出文件大小' THEN IF(output_files_size <= threshold_green, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), IF(output_files_size >= threshold_red, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), IF(output_files_size > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 - ((output_files_size - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye)))), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 + ((threshold_ye - output_files_size) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green))))))) WHEN '输出平均文件大小' THEN IF(output_files_size * 1.0 / output_files_num BETWEEN threshold_green AND threshold_red, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60)) WHEN '扫描分区数' THEN IF(total_partitions_read <= threshold_green, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), IF(total_partitions_read >= threshold_red, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), IF(total_partitions_read > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 - ((total_partitions_read - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye)))), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 + ((threshold_ye - total_partitions_read) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green))))))) WHEN 'core&memory比值' THEN IF(CAST(executor_core * 1.0 / executor_memory AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) BETWEEN threshold_red AND threshold_green, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60)) WHEN '失败task数' THEN IF(task_failed = 0, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60)) WHEN 'core资源' THEN IF(core_minute <= threshold_green, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 100), IF(core_minute >= threshold_red, CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 0), IF(core_minute > CAST(threshold_ye AS INT), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 - ((core_minute - threshold_ye) * (60 / (threshold_red - threshold_ye)))), CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 60 + ((threshold_ye - core_minute) * (40 / (threshold_ye - threshold_green))))))) ELSE 0 END)), ',', ':') AS metric_info, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(CASE metric_name WHEN '任务运行时长' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, duration) WHEN 'shuffle读取量(GB)' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, shuffle_read_gb) WHEN 'shuffle写入量(GB)' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, shuffle_write_gb) WHEN '输出文件数' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, output_files_num) WHEN '输出文件大小' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, output_files_size) WHEN '输出平均文件大小' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, 'core&memory比值' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, CONCAT(executor_core, '_', executor_memory)) WHEN '失败task数' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, task_failed) WHEN 'core资源' THEN CONCAT_ELE(':', metric_name, core_minute) ELSE NULL END)), ',', ':') AS metric_detail FROM (SELECT project_name, queue_name, application_id, startTime, endTime, task_id, task_name, is_completed, user_name, dp_name, name: 正式服版开始结束日期每日更新
output_hint: 正式服版开始结束日期每日更新
sql_units: /* 插入/覆盖目标表 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: zibohong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-03-27 20:23:25.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH new_versions_basic AS (SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(clientversion, '.', 4), '.', -1) AS official_version, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid) AS playerid_num FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 替换为当天日期 */ AND zoneid < 20000 AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90) GROUP BY official_version), new_versions AS (SELECT official_version FROM new_versions_basic WHERE playerid_num > 100000 /* 去掉琐碎的版本 */), existing_versions /* 提取昨日已有的版本号 */ AS (SELECT official_version, start_time, over_time FROM ml_temp.zibohong_official_version WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' /* 替换为昨天的日期 */), merged_versions /* 合并新版本和旧版本 */ AS (SELECT COALESCE(nv.official_version, ev.official_version) AS official_version, CASE WHEN ev.official_version IS NULL THEN '2026-05-31' /* 新版本，start_time 为当天 */ ELSE ev.start_time /* 旧版本保留原始 start_time */ END AS start_time, CASE WHEN NOT nv.official_version IS NULL THEN '2026-05-31' /* 活跃版本，更新 over_time 为当天 */ ELSE ev.over_time /* 旧版本保留原始 over_time */ END AS over_time FROM new_versions AS nv FULL OUTER JOIN existing_versions AS ev ON nv.official_version = ev.official_version) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.zibohong_official_version PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 替换为当天日期 */ SELECT official_version, start_time, over_time FROM merged_versions /* --每天下午2:30更新，也就是大概3:00会出现昨天的分区 */

GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, season_id) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, season_id, SUM(IF(pvptype = 39, battle_cnt, 0)) AS battle_39, SUM(IF(pvptype = 301, battle_cnt, 0)) AS battle_301 FROM AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mcgg_temp.kyra_black_role_df AS h2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.roleid = h2.roleid AND a.zoneid = h2.zoneid) UNION ALL SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, COALESCE(b.before_rank_301, 0) AS before_rank, COALESCE(b.battle_301, 0) AS battle_cnt, a.daily_rank_301 AS daily_rank FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, season_id, 301 AS pvptype, MAX(new_rank_id) AS daily_rank_301 FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_duoplayer_rank_level WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND season_id IN (SELECT season_id FROM current_season) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, season_id) AS a LEFT JOIN battle_history AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE (b.roleid IS NULL OR b.before_rank_301 < a.daily_rank_301 OR b.before_rank_301 IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mcgg_temp.kyra_black_role_df AS h2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.roleid = h2.roleid AND a.zoneid = h2.zoneid)), daily_battle_39 AS (/* -统计有排位更新的用户，当日的排位对局都是第几把 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, 0 AS bigranklvl, new_rank_id AS minranklvl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME ASC) AS total_rk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, new_rank_id ORDER BY TIME ASC) AS rank_rk FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_magicchess_rank_level AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND season_id IN (SELECT season_id FROM current_season) AND EXISTS(SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM daily_user_list WHERE pvptype = 39) AS b WHERE a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)), battle_39_update AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, 39 AS pvptype, a.bigranklvl, a.minranklvl, (a.total_rk + COALESCE(b.battle_cnt, 0)) AS battle_cnt, 1 AS tmp FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, bigranklvl, minranklvl, total_rk FROM daily_battle_39 WHERE rank_rk = 1 /* 当日首次到达某个小段位 */) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM daily_user_list WHERE pvptype = 39) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE a.minranklvl > b.before_rank AND a.minranklvl <= b.daily_rank), daily_battle_301 AS (/* -统计有双人更新的用户，当日的双人对局都是第几把 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, 0 AS bigranklvl, new_rank_id AS minranklvl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME ASC) AS total_rk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, new_rank_id ORDER BY TIME ASC) AS rank_rk FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_duoplayer_rank_level AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND season_id IN (SELECT season_id FROM current_season) AND EXISTS(SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM daily_user_list WHERE pvptype = 301) AS b WHERE a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid)), battle_301_update AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, 301 AS pvptype, a.bigranklvl, a.minranklvl, (a.total_rk + COALESCE(b.battle_cnt, 0)) AS battle_cnt, 1 AS tmp FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, bigranklvl, minranklvl, total_rk FROM daily_battle_301 WHERE rank_rk = 1 /* 当日首次到达某个小段位 */) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM daily_user_list WHERE pvptype = 301) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE a.minranklvl > b.before_rank AND a.minranklvl <= b.daily_rank) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.sjlyu_season_ranklvl_up_detail_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, a.bigranklvl, a.minranklvl, a.battle_cnt, b.season_id, b.season_start, b.season_end, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', b.season_start) + 1 AS season_day FROM battle_39_update AS a LEFT JOIN current_season AS b ON a.tmp = b.tmp UNION ALL SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.pvptype, a.bigranklvl, a.minranklvl, a.battle_cnt, b.season_id, b.season_start, b.season_end, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', b.season_start) + 1 AS season_day FROM battle_301_update AS a LEFT JOIN current_season AS b ON a.tmp = b.tmp
