COMMENT '统计日期前第六天新增的用户数', */ /*             new_user_cnt_14d BIGINT COMMENT '统计日期前第十三天新增的用户数', */ /*             new_user_cnt_30d BIGINT COMMENT '统计日期前第二十九天新增的用户数', */ /*             new_retention_2d BIGINT COMMENT '统计日当天活跃用户在前一天的活跃人数（统计日算第一天）', */ /*             new_retention_7d BIGINT COMMENT '统计日当天活跃用户在前第七天的活跃人数（统计日算第一天）', */ /*             new_retention_14d BIGINT COMMENT '统计日当天活跃用户在前第十四天的活跃人数（统计日算第一天）', */ /*             new_retention_30d BIGINT COMMENT '统计日当天活跃用户在前第三十天的活跃人数（统计日算第一天）', */ /*             ltv7 BIGINT COMMENT '统计日当天活跃用户在前第七天的总付费金额（统计日算第一天）' */ /*         ) COMMENT 'solar驾驶舱报表' */ /*         PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd', appid STRING COMMENT '游戏id') STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://moonton-bytedance/solar/ads_solar_core_account_di_v1'; */ WITH basic AS (/* 基础信息表 */ SELECT * FROM (SELECT appid AS app_id, roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country AS country, os, first_media_source AS first_network_name, createdate, createtime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY appid, roleid ORDER BY createtime ASC) AS rn FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND createdate >= '2025-06-25' AND /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 */ /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 29000 AND 29999 */ /* AND     appid in (4110,4210,4300,4260) */ (appid = 4400 AND (zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999))) WHERE rn = 1 AND createdate = '2026-05-25'), pay_di AS (/* 支付全量表 */ SELECT roleid, app_id, SUM(day_pay_sum) AS ltv7 FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 */ /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 29000 AND 29999 */ /* AND     app_id IN (4110, 4210, 4300, 4260) */ (app_id = 4400 AND (zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999)) GROUP BY roleid, app_id), ltv AS (SELECT country, SUM(COALESCE(pay_di.ltv7, 0)) AS ltv7 FROM basic AS bas LEFT JOIN pay_di ON bas.roleid = pay_di.roleid GROUP BY bas.country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_solar_core_account_di_v1 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'nova') SELECT 760692 AS app_id /*	游戏ID */, 'nova_skystone' AS app_name /*	游戏名称 */, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '2025-06-25') + 1 AS obt_date /*	截止今日上线天数 */, COALESCE(a.country, 'unknown') AS country_code /*	首次创号国家编码 */, COALESCE(a.dnu, 0) AS dnu /*	历史首次活跃为统计日当日的用户数（当日新增账号） */, COALESCE(a.dau, 0) AS dau /*	统计日去重活跃帐号数(登录到游戏内) */, COALESCE(a.wau, 0) AS wau /*	统计周去重活跃帐号数(登录到游戏内) */, COALESCE(a.mau, 0) AS mau /*	统计月去重活跃帐号数(登录到游戏内) */, COALESCE(a.paid_user_cnt, 0) AS paid_user_cnt /*	统计日有付费行为的去重帐号数 */, 'USD' AS currency_type /*	本条数据中金额的币种 */, COALESCE(a.pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt /*	统计日累计付费金额(单位:美分) */, COALESCE(a.year_pay_amt, 0) AS year_pay_amt /*	统计日年初累计至今付费总金额(单位:美分) */, COALESCE(a.total_pay_amt, 0) AS total_pay_amt /*	游戏上线累计至统计日付费总金额(单位:美分) */, COALESCE(a.pay_extra_amt, 0) AS pay_extra_amt /*	统计日汇率校准累计付费金额(单位:美分) */, COALESCE(a.year_pay_extra_amt, 0) AS year_pay_extra_amt /*	统计日汇率校准年初累计至今付费总金额(单位:美分) */, COALESCE(a.total_pay_extra_amt, 0) AS total_pay_extra_amt /*	游戏上线累计至统计日汇率校准付费总金额(单位:美分) */, COALESCE(a.duration_cnt, 0) AS duration_cnt /*	统计日期所有用户的总在线时长 */, COALESCE(a.new_user_cnt_2d, 0) AS new_user_cnt_2d /*	昨日新增的用户数 */, COALESCE(a.new_user_cnt_7d, 0) AS new_user_cnt_7d /*	统计日期前第六天新增的用户数 */, COALESCE(a.new_user_cnt_14d, 0) AS new_user_cnt_14d /*	统计日期前第十三天新增的用户数 */, COALESCE(a.new_user_cnt_30d, 0) AS new_user_cnt_30d /*	统计日期前第二十九天新增的用户数 */, COALESCE(b.new_retention_2d, 0) AS new_retention_2d /*	统计日当天活跃用户在前一天的活跃人数（统计日算第一天） */, COALESCE(b.new_retention_7d, 0) AS new_retention_7d /*	统计日当天活跃用户在前第七天的活跃人数（统计日算第一天） */, COALESCE(b.new_retention_14d, 0) AS new_retention_14d /*	统计日当天活跃用户在前第十四天的活跃人数（统计日算第一天） */, COALESCE(b.new_retention_30d, 0) AS new_retention_30d /*	统计日当天活跃用户在前第三十天的活跃人数（统计日算第一天） */, COALESCE(c.ltv7, 0) AS ltv7 /*	统计日当天活跃用户在前第七天的总付费金额（统计日算第一天） */ FROM (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd, country, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', register_cnt, 0)) AS dnu, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', active_cnt, 0)) AS dau, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', active_cnt_7days, 0)) AS wau /* 新加字段 */, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', active_cnt_30days, 0)) AS mau, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', pay_cnt, 0)) AS paid_user_cnt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', pay_amt, 0)) AS pay_amt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', year_pay_amt, 0)) AS year_pay_amt /* 新加字段 */, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', his_pay_amt, 0)) AS total_pay_amt /* 新加字段 */, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', pay_amt_exrate, 0)) AS pay_extra_amt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', year_before_tax_usd_amt, 0)) AS year_pay_extra_amt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', his_before_tax_usd_amt, 0)) AS total_pay_extra_amt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', online_dur, 0)) AS duration_cnt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-30', register_cnt, 0)) AS new_user_cnt_2d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-25', register_cnt, 0)) AS new_user_cnt_7d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-18', register_cnt, 0)) AS new_user_cnt_14d, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-02', register_cnt, 0)) AS new_user_cnt_30d FROM mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid /* FROM    mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid */ WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND appname = 'nova' AND granularity_type = 'account' AND date_type = 'daily' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' GROUP BY country) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd, country, SUM(IF(date_range = '2026-05-30', register_reten_cnt[1], 0)) AS new_retention_2d, SUM(IF(date_range = '2026-05-25', register_reten_cnt[6], 0)) AS new_retention_7d, SUM(IF(date_range = '2026-05-18', register_reten_cnt[13], 0)) AS new_retention_14d, SUM(IF(date_range = '2026-05-02', register_reten_cnt[29], 0)) AS new_retention_30d /* SUM(IF(date_range = '2026-05-25', register_charge_amt[6], 0)) AS ltv7 */ /* SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-25', register_charge_amt[6], 0)) AS ltv7 */ FROM mt_ads.ads_decismart_reten_ltv_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-05-25', '2025-05-25', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'nova' AND granularity_type = 'account' AND date_type = 'daily' AND date_range IN ('2026-05-30', '2026-05-25', '2026-05-18', '2026-05-02') GROUP BY country) AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.country = b.country LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd, country, ltv.ltv7 FROM ltv) AS c ON a.logymd = c.logymd AND a.country = c.country

name: etl.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid_nova_account_daily
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'nova', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid PARTITION (logymd = '2026-05-31',appname = 'nova',granularity_type = 'account',date_type = 'daily') */ SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, COALESCE(a.country, b.country) AS country, COALESCE(b.os, 'NULL') AS os, COALESCE(b.network, 'NULL') AS network, COALESCE(register_cnt, 0) AS register_cnt, 0 AS pure_register_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt_30days, 0) AS active_cnt_30days, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS active_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_30d_cnt, 0 AS recurring_cnt_30days, 0 AS nologin_cnt_30days, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt_period, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt_period, COALESCE(day_login_duration, 0) AS online_dur /*	当日玩家总在线时长(单位：s) */, 0 AS new_active_cnt /*	新用户活跃玩家数 */, 0 AS register_cnt_total /*	历史总注册玩家数 */, 0 AS lose_cnt_7ds /*	7日流失玩家数 */, 0 AS active_cnt_7ds /*	7日前DAU */, 0 AS lose_cnt_30ds /*	30日流失玩家数 */, 0 AS active_cnt_30ds /*	30日前DAU */, COALESCE(active_cnt_7days, 0) AS active_cnt_7days, COALESCE(year_pay_amt, 0) AS year_pay_amt, 0 AS year_before_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(total_pay_amt, 0) AS his_pay_amt, 0 AS his_before_tax_usd_amt, 0 AS recurring_cnt_14days, 0 AS nologin_cnt_14days, 0 AS actual_pay_amt, 2 AS user_type, NULL AS channel, COALESCE(active_cnt_90days, 0) AS active_cnt_90days, COALESCE(vaild_user_cnt, 0) AS vaild_user_cnt, COALESCE(vaild_user_online_dur, 0) AS vaild_user_online_dur FROM (SELECT country_code AS country, appname FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_country) /* 取最新 */ AND startdate <= '2026-05-31' AND appname = 'nova' AND is_online = 1 AND definition_type = 0 GROUP BY country_code, appname) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(network, 'unknown') AS network, COALESCE(SUM(register_cnt), 0) AS register_cnt, 0 AS pure_register_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt), 0) AS active_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt_30days), 0) AS active_cnt_30days, COALESCE(SUM(pay_cnt), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt), 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt_7days), 0) AS active_cnt_7days, COALESCE(SUM(total_pay_amt), 0) AS total_pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(year_pay_amt), 0) AS year_pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(day_login_duration), 0) AS day_login_duration, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt_90days), 0) AS active_cnt_90days, COALESCE(SUM(vaild_user_cnt), 0) AS vaild_user_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(vaild_user_online_dur), 0) AS vaild_user_online_dur, logymd, appname FROM (SELECT bd.app_id, ap.appname, COALESCE(LOWER(first_mt_country), 'unknown') AS country, bd.os, COALESCE(LOWER(first_network_name), 'unknown') AS network, SUM(IF(createdate = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS register_cnt, SUM(is_td) AS active_cnt, SUM(is_30d) AS active_cnt_30days, SUM(pay_cnt) AS pay_cnt /* 付费人数 */, SUM(day_pay_amt) AS pay_amt, SUM(is_7d) AS active_cnt_7days, SUM(total_pay_amt) AS total_pay_amt, SUM(year_pay_amt) AS year_pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(online_time), 0) AS day_login_duration, COALESCE(SUM(IF(ad.is_90d = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS active_cnt_90days, COALESCE(SUM(IF(ad.is_td = 1 AND (ad.active_days_7days >= 2 OR pay.pay_amt_7days > 0), 1, 0)), 0) AS vaild_user_cnt, ROUND(SUM(IF(ad.is_td = 1 AND (ad.active_days_7days >= 2 OR pay.pay_amt_7days > 0), on_t.online_time_7days, 0)) / LEAST(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '2025-06-25') + 1, 7), 0) AS vaild_user_online_dur, '2026-05-31' AS logymd FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT app_id, account_id, first_mt_country, os, first_network_name, createdate, createtime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY tag ASC, createtime ASC) AS rn FROM (SELECT appid AS app_id, roleid AS account_id, first_mt_country, os, first_media_source AS first_network_name, createdate, createtime, 1 AS tag FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND createdate >= '2025-06-25' AND /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 */ /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 29000 AND 29999 */ /* AND     appid in (4110,4210,4300,4260) */ (appid = 4400 AND (zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999)) UNION ALL SELECT app_id, roleid AS account_id, 'unknown' AS first_mt_country, 'unknown' AS os, 'unknown' AS first_network_name, 'unknown' AS createdate, 'unknown' AS createtime, 2 AS tag FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND /* AND     (zoneid NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 */ /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 29000 AND 29999 */ /* AND     app_id in (4110,4210,4300,4260)) */ (app_id = 4400 AND (zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999)))) WHERE rn = 1) AS bd LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid AS account_id, app_id, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_td, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_30d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_7d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-03' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_90d /* SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', online_time, 0)) AS day_login_duration, */ /* 近90天是否活跃 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31', logymd, NULL)) AS active_days_7days /* 近7日活跃天数 */ FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-03-03' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND /* AND     (zoneid NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 */ /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 29000 AND 29999 */ /* AND     app_id in (4110,4210,4300,4260)) */ (app_id = 4400 AND (zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999)) GROUP BY roleid, app_id) AS ad ON ad.app_id = bd.app_id AND ad.account_id = bd.account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid AS account_id, app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', CONCAT_WS(',', app_id, roleid), NULL)) AS pay_cnt, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', day_pay_sum, 0)) AS day_pay_amt, SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31', day_pay_sum, 0)) AS pay_amt_7days FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-25' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 */ /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 29000 AND 29999 */ /* AND     app_id in (4110,4210,4300,4260) */ (app_id = 4400 AND (zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999)) GROUP BY roleid, app_id) AS pay ON bd.app_id = pay.app_id AND bd.account_id = pay.account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid AS account_id, app_id, SUM(day_pay_sum) AS total_pay_amt, SUM(IF(logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 4), '-01-01'), COALESCE(day_pay_sum, 0), 0)) AS year_pay_amt FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 9900 AND 9999 */ /* AND     zoneid NOT BETWEEN 29000 AND 29999 */ /* AND     app_id in (4110,4210,4300,4260) */ (app_id = 4400 AND (zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999)) GROUP BY roleid, app_id) AS pay_total ON bd.app_id = pay_total.app_id AND bd.account_id = pay_total.account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, roleid, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', online_time, 0)) AS online_time, SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31', online_time, 0)) AS online_time_7days FROM (SELECT app_id, role_id AS roleid, logymd, SUM(IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(`event_desc`, '$.online_time') >= 21600, 21600, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`event_desc`, '$.online_time'))) AS online_time WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) < 0 THEN '无信息' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) = 0 THEN '0' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) <= 6 THEN '[1,6]' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) <= 29 THEN '[7,29]' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) <= 89 THEN '[30,89]' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) <= 179 THEN '[90,179]' WHEN DATEDIFF(logymd, register_date) <= 359 THEN '[180,359]' WHEN pay_net_receipts_usd_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), gameserver_sub_diamond AS (/* 钻石消耗表 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond /* 所有购买通行证及乱斗的的角色及钻石花费其购买次数 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid), dim_country AS (SELECT country_code, country_name, act_geo_continent, region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_mc_pay_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT con.act_geo_continent /* 业务定义区域 */, con.region /* 实际地理区域 */, bas.first_mt_country AS country_code, con.country_name, COALESCE(SUM(chg.product_money) / 100, 0) AS product_money /* bas.zoneid, */ /* bas.register_date_diff, */ /* 大盘商品定价 */, COALESCE(SUM(chg.before_tax_usd_amt) / 100, 0) AS before_tax_usd_amt /* 大盘校准后 */, COALESCE(SUM(chg.pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) / 100, 0) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt /* 大盘实收 */, COALESCE(SUM(mc_sub_dia.sub_diamond), 0) AS mc_sub_diamond /* MC钻石消耗 */, COALESCE(SUM(sub_dia.sub_num), 0) AS sub_diamond /* 总钻石消耗 */ FROM dim_basic AS bas /* basic */ LEFT JOIN dwm_charge_di AS chg /* -付费表 */ ON bas.roleid = chg.roleid AND bas.zoneid = chg.zoneid LEFT JOIN mc_sub_diamond_tbl AS mc_sub_dia /* mc钻石消耗表 */ ON bas.roleid = mc_sub_dia.roleid AND bas.zoneid = mc_sub_dia.zoneid LEFT JOIN gameserver_sub_diamond AS sub_dia /* 钻石消耗 */ ON bas.roleid = sub_dia.roleid AND bas.zoneid = sub_dia.zoneid LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con /* 国家表 */ ON bas.first_mt_country = con.country_code GROUP BY bas.logymd, con.act_geo_continent /* 业务定义区域 */, con.region /* 实际地理区域 */, bas.first_mt_country, con.country_name /* bas.zoneid, */ /* bas.register_date_diff */

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: michaelzhou@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-06-22 12:41:46.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 用户来源 */ WITH t1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT t1.*, t2.pay_channel AS last_pay_channel FROM (SELECT UPPER(t1.createrole_country) AS createrole_country, CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mt' ELSE pay_channel END AS pay_channel, logymd, roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS pv, SUM(money / 100) AS money FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND t1.zoneid <= 57000 AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND /* AND  ( t1.pay_channel LIKE "%mt%") */ UPPER(t1.createrole_country) IN ('RU', 'ID', 'PH') GROUP BY UPPER(t1.createrole_country), CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mt' ELSE pay_channel END, logymd, roleid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.* FROM (SELECT createrole_country, pay_channel, roleid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT UPPER(t1.createrole_country) AS createrole_country, CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mt' ELSE pay_channel END AS pay_channel, roleid, MAX(time) AS time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd < '2026-05-31' AND t1.zoneid <= 57000 AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND /* AND  ( t1.pay_channel LIKE "%mt%") */ UPPER(t1.createrole_country) IN ('RU', 'ID', 'PH') GROUP BY UPPER(t1.createrole_country), CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mt' ELSE pay_channel END, roleid) AS t) AS t WHERE rank = 1) AS t2 ON t1.createrole_country = t2.createrole_country AND t1.roleid = t2.roleid) INSERT INTO ml_temp.user_pay_from PARTITION(date = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.createrole_country, t1.roleid, t1.pay_channel, t1.last_pay_channel, t1.logymd, CASE WHEN t3.first_time = t1.logymd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_all_new, CASE WHEN t2.first_time = t1.logymd AND t2.pay_channel = t1.pay_channel THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_channel_new, CASE WHEN t2.first_time < t1.logymd AND t2.pay_channel = t1.pay_channel THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_channel_old FROM t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.createrole_country, roleid, zoneid, pay_channel, MIN(logymd) AS first_time FROM (SELECT UPPER(t1.createrole_country) AS createrole_country, CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mt' ELSE pay_channel END AS pay_channel, roleid, t1.zoneid, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND t1.zoneid <= 57000 AND t1.is_iap_token_buy = 0 /* 排除虚拟代币数据，没收入 */ AND (t1.receipt_id > 100 OR t1.pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据，因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND /* AND  ( t1.pay_channel LIKE "%mt%") */ UPPER(t1.createrole_country) IN ('RU', 'ID', 'PH') GROUP BY UPPER(t1.createrole_country), CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mt' ELSE pay_channel END, roleid, t1.zoneid, logymd) AS t GROUP BY t.createrole_country, roleid, zoneid, pay_channel) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.createrole_country = t2.createrole_country LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.createrole_country, roleid, zoneid, MIN(logymd) AS first_time FROM (SELECT UPPER(t1.createrole_country) AS createrole_country, roleid, t1.zoneid, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND t1.zoneid <= 57000 AND t1.is_iap_token_buy = 0 /* 排除虚拟代币数据，没收入 */ AND (t1.receipt_id > 100 OR t1.pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据，因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND /* AND  ( t1.pay_channel LIKE "%mt%") */ UPPER(t1.createrole_country) IN ('RU', 'ID', 'PH') GROUP BY UPPER(t1.createrole_country), roleid, t1.zoneid, logymd) AS t GROUP BY t.createrole_country, roleid, zoneid) AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.createrole_country = t3.createrole_country GROUP BY t1.createrole_country, t1.roleid, t1.pay_channel, t1.last_pay_channel, t1.logymd, CASE WHEN t3.first_time = t1.logymd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t2.first_time = t1.logymd AND t2.pay_channel = t1.pay_channel THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t2.first_time < t1.logymd AND t2.pay_channel = t1.pay_channel THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UPPER(t1.createrole_country) AS createrole_country, CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mt' ELSE pay_channel END AS pay_channel, product_id, logymd, roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS pv, SUM(money / 100) AS money FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND t1.zoneid <= 57000 AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND /* AND  ( t1.pay_channel LIKE "%mt%") */ UPPER(t1.createrole_country) IN ('RU', 'ID', 'PH') GROUP BY UPPER(t1.createrole_country), CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mt' ELSE pay_channel END, product_id, logymd, roleid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.* FROM (SELECT createrole_country, pay_channel, roleid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT UPPER(t1.createrole_country) AS createrole_country, CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mt' ELSE pay_channel END AS pay_channel, roleid, MAX(time) AS time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd < '2026-05-31' AND t1.zoneid <= 57000 AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND /* AND  ( t1.pay_channel LIKE "%mt%") */ UPPER(t1.createrole_country) IN ('RU', 'ID', 'PH') GROUP BY UPPER(t1.createrole_country), CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mt' ELSE pay_channel END, roleid) AS t) AS t WHERE rank = 1) AS t2 ON t1.createrole_country = t2.createrole_country AND t1.roleid = t2.roleid) INSERT INTO ml_temp.user_pay_from_product PARTITION(date = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.createrole_country, t1.roleid, t1.pay_channel, t1.last_pay_channel, t1.product_id, t1.logymd, CASE WHEN t3.first_time = t1.logymd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_all_new, CASE WHEN t2.first_time = t1.logymd AND t2.pay_channel = t1.pay_channel THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_channel_new, CASE WHEN t2.first_time < t1.logymd AND t2.pay_channel = t1.pay_channel THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_channel_old FROM t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.createrole_country, roleid, zoneid, pay_channel, MIN(logymd) AS first_time FROM (SELECT UPPER(t1.createrole_country) AS createrole_country, CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mt' ELSE pay_channel END AS pay_channel, roleid, t1.zoneid, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND t1.zoneid <= 57000 AND t1.is_iap_token_buy = 0 /* 排除虚拟代币数据，没收入 */ AND (t1.receipt_id > 100 OR t1.pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据，因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND /* AND  ( t1.pay_channel LIKE "%mt%") */ UPPER(t1.createrole_country) IN ('RU', 'ID', 'PH') GROUP BY UPPER(t1.createrole_country), CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mt' ELSE pay_channel END, roleid, t1.zoneid, logymd) AS t GROUP BY t.createrole_country, roleid, zoneid, pay_channel) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.createrole_country = t2.createrole_country LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.createrole_country, roleid, zoneid, MIN(logymd) AS first_time FROM (SELECT UPPER(t1.createrole_country) AS createrole_country, roleid, t1.zoneid, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND t1.zoneid <= 57000 AND t1.is_iap_token_buy = 0 /* 排除虚拟代币数据，没收入 */ AND (t1.receipt_id > 100 OR t1.pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据，因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND /* AND  ( t1.pay_channel LIKE "%mt%") */ UPPER(t1.createrole_country) IN ('RU', 'ID', 'PH') GROUP BY UPPER(t1.createrole_country), roleid, t1.zoneid, logymd) AS t GROUP BY t.createrole_country, roleid, zoneid) AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.createrole_country = t3.createrole_country GROUP BY t1.createrole_country, t1.roleid, t1.pay_channel, t1.last_pay_channel, t1.product_id, t1.logymd, CASE WHEN t3.first_time = t1.logymd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t2.first_time = t1.logymd AND t2.pay_channel = t1.pay_channel THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t2.first_time < t1.logymd AND t2.pay_channel = t1.pay_channel THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

name: 例行_流量_样本逻辑
sql_units: WITH event_log AS (SELECT accountid AS r1, zoneid AS z1, showplayer_accountid AS r2, showplayer_zoneid AS z2, logymd, player_action, FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600) AS time /* time, */, FLOOR(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600) AS ts /* UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) AS ts, */, patchid /* lineid, */, CONCAT(sequenceid2, '-', CAST(patchid AS STRING)) AS seqid, MAX(is_highligh) AS hightag, MAX(showtaglist1) AS tag1, MAX(showtaglist2) AS tag2, MAX(showtaglist3) AS tag3, SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600), 12, 2) AS hh, SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600), 15, 2) AS mm, CASE WHEN DAYOFMONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600)) < 10 THEN 'up' WHEN DAYOFMONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600)) < 20 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'tail' END AS month_period, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600), 12, 2) < 12 THEN 'break' WHEN SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600), 12, 2) < 18 THEN 'noon' ELSE 'even' END AS day_period, GEOIP(MAX(ip), 1) AS country, GEOIP(MAX(ip), 1) AS states, GEOIP(MAX(ip), 3) AS city FROM ml_ods.connserver_social_recommendlistrecord /* 加上测服 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT player_action IS NULL AND NOT accountid IS NULL AND NOT showplayer_accountid IS NULL AND NOT zoneid IS NULL AND NOT showplayer_zoneid IS NULL GROUP BY sequenceid2, patchid, accountid, zoneid, showplayer_accountid, showplayer_zoneid, logymd, player_action), logout AS (/* 构造用户在线会话：登录时间 ~ 登出时间 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(TIME) - online_time) AS login_time /* 登录时间 = 登出时间戳 - 在线时长（转换为秒） */, TIME AS logout_time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mlbb_social_rec_v1_daily_sample_track PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, seqid, r1, z1, r2, z2, player_action, if_img_head_clk, if_follow, if_blk_shop, hightag, hh, mm, month_period, day_period, country, states, city, SUM(CAST(COALESCE(conf.score, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS final_score, COLLECT_LIST(conf.tagname) AS tagname_list, COLLECT_LIST(conf.tagid) AS tagid_list, IF(SUM(is_online) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_cis_online FROM (SELECT show.time, show.seqid, show.r1, show.z1, show.r2, show.z2, show.player_action, IF(NOT img_clk.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_img_head_clk, IF(NOT follow.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_follow, IF(NOT blk_shop.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_blk_shop, show.hightag, show.tag1, show.tag2, show.tag3, show.hh, show.mm, show.month_period, show.day_period, show.country, show.states, show.city, 1 AS joinid, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(show.time) >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(logout.login_time) AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(show.time) <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(logout.logout_time) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS is_online /* 登出时间 */ /* 判断行为时间是否在某个在线会话内 */ FROM (SELECT * FROM event_log WHERE player_action IN (1, 5, 6) AND NOT r2 IS NULL AND NOT z2 IS NULL AND NOT r1 IS NULL AND NOT r2 IS NULL) AS show LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM event_log WHERE player_action = 2 AND NOT r2 IS NULL AND NOT z2 IS NULL) AS img_clk ON show.r1 = img_clk.r1 AND show.z1 = img_clk.z1 AND show.r2 = img_clk.r2 AND show.z2 = img_clk.z2 AND show.time <= img_clk.time AND show.seqid = img_clk.seqid LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM event_log WHERE player_action = 3 AND NOT r2 IS NULL AND NOT z2 IS NULL) AS follow ON show.r1 = follow.r1 AND show.z1 = follow.z1 AND show.r2 = follow.r2 AND show.z2 = follow.z2 AND show.time <= follow.time AND show.seqid = follow.seqid LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM event_log WHERE player_action = 4 AND NOT r2 IS NULL AND NOT z2 IS NULL) AS blk_shop ON show.r1 = blk_shop.r1 AND show.z1 = blk_shop.z1 AND show.r2 = blk_shop.r2 AND show.z2 = blk_shop.z2 AND show.time <= blk_shop.time AND show.seqid = blk_shop.seqid LEFT JOIN logout ON show.r2 = logout.roleid AND show.z2 = logout.zoneid AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(show.time) >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(logout.login_time) AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(show.time) <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(logout.logout_time) GROUP BY show.time, show.seqid, show.r1, show.z1, show.r2, show.z2, show.player_action, IF(NOT img_clk.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0), IF(NOT follow.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0), IF(NOT blk_shop.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0), show.hightag, show.tag1, show.tag2, show.tag3, show.hh, show.mm, show.month_period, show.day_period, show.country, show.states, show.city) AS traffic LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, 1 AS joinid FROM mt_ai.social_ai_activate_config WHERE p_date = (SELECT MAX(p_date) FROM mt_ai.social_ai_activate_config WHERE NOT p_date IS NULL AND NOT act_id IS NULL) AND act_id = IF('2026-05-31' >= '2025-07-16', 'grey_v2', 'grey_v1') AND stype = 'value') AS conf ON traffic.joinid = conf.joinid AND (traffic.tag1 = conf.tagid OR traffic.tag2 = conf.tagid OR traffic.tag3 = conf.tagid) GROUP BY time, seqid, r1, z1, r2, z2, player_action, if_img_head_clk, if_follow, if_blk_shop, hightag, hh, mm, month_period, day_period, country, states, city

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: selinasun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-06-27 20:05:23.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 基于mcgg_temp.sjlyu_season_user_battle_summary_df的改版 抛出非t+0的依赖。为数值看板的前N%准备 */ WITH current_season AS (SELECT seasonid AS season_id, seasonstartymd AS season_start_ymd, seasonendymd AS season_end_ymd, SPLIT(seasonstarttime_config, '_')[1] AS season_starttime, CAST(CONCAT(seasonstartymd, ' ', SPLIT(seasonstarttime_config, '_')[1]) AS TIMESTAMP) AS season_start_ts, CAST(CONCAT(seasonendymd, ' ', SPLIT(seasonendtime_config, '_')[1]) AS TIMESTAMP) AS season_end_ts FROM mcgg_temp.selinasun_mcrankseason_larksheet_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND '2026-05-31' BETWEEN seasonstartymd AND seasonendymd), history_data AS (SELECT * FROM mcgg_temp.selinasun_season_user_battle_summary_t0_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND season_id IN (SELECT season_id FROM current_season)), battle_base /* battle 明细（带时间戳） */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, battletime, camprank, blacknum, CAST(TIME AS TIMESTAMP) AS battle_ts /* TODO: 替换成真实的 battle 结束/发生时间字段 */ FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND camprank <> 0), battle_with_season /* 给每场 battle 归属 season：落到哪个区间 */ AS (SELECT b.*, s.season_id FROM battle_base AS b JOIN new_rank_id, new_cupnum FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_duoplayer_rank_level WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND season_id IN (SELECT season_id FROM current_season)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, season_id, final_301_rank_id, final_301_cupnum), daily_active AS (SELECT t0.*, t1.battle_cnt, t1.battle_time AS bttime, t1.rank1_cnt, t1.rank2_cnt, t1.rank3_cnt, t1.rank4_cnt, t1.rank5_cnt, t1.rank6_cnt, '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t0 LEFT JOIN daily_battle AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, 1 AS tmp FROM current_season) AS t4 ON t0.tmp = t4.tmp /* ON      t4.season_id = t1.season_id */ LEFT JOIN daily_rank39 AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t4.season_id = t2.season_id LEFT JOIN daily_rank301 AS t3 ON t0.roleid = t3.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND t4.season_id = t3.season_id), special_user AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid FROM daily_battle AS a LEFT JOIN daily_active AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE b.roleid IS NULL GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid), total AS (/* ---拼接当日用户数据&本赛季历史数据，获得最新赛季历史全量 */ SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, COALESCE(t0.battle_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.battle_cnt, 0) AS battle_cnt, COALESCE(t0.bttime, 0) + COALESCE(t1.battle_time, 0) AS battle_time, COALESCE(t0.rank1_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.rank1_cnt, 0) AS rank1_cnt, COALESCE(t0.rank2_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.rank2_cnt, 0) AS rank2_cnt, COALESCE(t0.rank3_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.rank3_cnt, 0) AS rank3_cnt, COALESCE(t0.rank4_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.rank4_cnt, 0) daily_active AS t0 LEFT JOIN history_data AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t0.season_id = t1.season_id UNION ALL /* -单独处理一下rank_id丢的问题 */ SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, COALESCE(t0.battle_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.battle_cnt, 0) AS battle_cnt, COALESCE(t0.battle_time, 0) + COALESCE(t1.battle_time, 0) AS battle_time, COALESCE(t0.rank1_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t1.rank1_cnt, 0) 0) + COALESCE(t1.black_time, 0) AS black_time, COALESCE(t2.final_39_rank_id, t0.final_39_rank_id) AS final_39_rank_id, GREATEST(COALESCE(t2.max_39_rank_id, 0), COALESCE(t0.max_39_rank_id, 0)) AS max_39_rank_id, COALESCE(t2.final_39_cupnum, t0.final_39_cupnum) AS final_39_cupnum, GREATEST(COALESCE(t2.max_39_cupnum, 0), COALESCE(t0.max_39_cupnum, 0)) AS max_39_cupnum, AS t0 LEFT JOIN daily_battle AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, 1 AS tmp FROM current_season) AS t4 ON t0.tmp = t4.tmp LEFT JOIN daily_rank39 AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t4.season_id = t2.season_id LEFT JOIN daily_rank301 AS t3 ON t0.roleid = t3.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t3.zoneid AND t4.season_id = t3.season_id UNION ALL SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.battle_cnt, t0.battle_time, t0.rank1_cnt, t0.rank2_cnt, t0.rank3_cnt, t0.rank4_cnt, t0.rank5_cnt, t0.rank6_cnt, t0.rank7_cnt, t0.rank8_cnt, t0.black_cnt, 1000 AND 50000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND camprank <> 0 AND pvptype = 39 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid

name: new_is_install
sql_units: /* 设备+版本号出现在重装里面 */ WITH login_info AS (SELECT deviceid, client_ver, loginid, TIME /* 登录时间 */ FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' AND reconn = 0), login_with_next AS (SELECT deviceid, client_ver, loginid, TIME /* 登录时间 */, LEAD(loginid, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY deviceid, client_ver ORDER BY TIME) AS next_loginid, LEAD(TIME, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY deviceid, client_ver ORDER BY TIME) AS next_time FROM login_info), install_1 AS (SELECT l.deviceid, l.client_ver, next_time AS install_time FROM login_with_next AS l WHERE l.loginid > l.next_loginid /* 当前loginid大于下一个loginid --应该是下一次算是重装 */ AND next_loginid BETWEEN 2 AND 5 GROUP BY l.deviceid, l.client_ver, install_time), install_2 AS (SELECT deviceid, client_ver, time AS install_time FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' AND loginid = 1 AND SUBSTRING(TIME, 1, 19) <> SUBSTRING(usercreatetime, 1, 19) AND reconn = 0 /* -排掉切后台登录的数据，否则会导致有的用户一个loginid下，有多条登录记录，然后因为登录时间和创角时间不对齐，被认为重装 */ GROUP BY deviceid, client_ver, install_time), combined_data AS (SELECT deviceid, client_ver, install_time, 1 AS from_install_1, 0 AS from_install_2 FROM install_1 UNION ALL SELECT deviceid, client_ver, install_time, 0 AS from_install_1, 1 AS from_install_2 FROM install_2) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.amandapiao_new_is_install PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT deviceid, client_ver, CASE WHEN MAX(from_install_1) = 1 AND MAX(from_install_2) = 1 THEN 'both' WHEN MAX(from_install_1) = 1 AND MAX(from_install_2) = 0 THEN 'install_1_only' WHEN MAX(from_install_1) = 0 AND MAX(from_install_2) = 1 THEN 'install_2_only' ELSE 'unknown' END AS install_type, MIN(install_time) AS install_time FROM combined_data GROUP BY deviceid, client_ver

name: jaxzhong_白膜英雄_多表拼接
sql_units: /* ----观察用户补下载完成时刻，缺的英雄里面，有哪些已经下完，哪些没下完，然后下完英雄里有多少遇到白膜，没下完的多少遇到白膜。 */ WITH need_download_hero_choosedown AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, heroid, battleid, MAX(is_finish) AS is_finish, MAX(ip) AS ip, MAX(level) AS level, MAX(zoneid) AS zoneid, MAX(game_channel) AS game_channel, MAX(pvptype) AS aspvptype FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, SPLIT(reslostlist, ',') AS reslostlist, battleid, ip, level, game_channel, pvptype, CASE WHEN reslostnum = resdownnum THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_finish FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_choosedownrec WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS sub LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(reslostlist) exploded_table AS heroid WHERE NOT heroid IS NULL AND CAST(heroid AS STRING) <> '' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, heroid, battleid), downfinish_hero_choosedown AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, heroid, battleid, MAX(ip) AS ip, MAX(level) AS level, MAX(zoneid) AS zoneid, MAX(game_channel) AS game_channel, MAX(pvptype) AS aspvptype FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, SPLIT(resdownlist, ',') AS resdownlist, battleid, ip, level, game_channel, pvptype FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_choosedownrec WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS sub LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(resdownlist) exploded_table AS heroid WHERE NOT heroid IS NULL AND CAST(heroid AS STRING) <> '' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, heroid, battleid), nores_hero_bankres AS (SELECT a.*, b.skin_heroid AS heroid, c.hero_name, CONCAT_WS(',', battlebegin_hero) AS battlebegin_noreslist, IF(NOT COALESCE(heroskinid1, 'none') IN ('', 'none', 0) AND noresnum_battlebegin <> SIZE(ARRAY_DISTINCT(ARRAY_REMOVE(battlebegin_hero, 0))), noresnum_battlebegin - SIZE(ARRAY_DISTINCT(ARRAY_REMOVE(battlebegin_hero, 0))), 0) AS duplicate_heronum /* --该局重复白膜个数 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, skinid, battleid, MIN_BY(ip, time) AS ip, MIN_BY(level, time) AS level, MIN_BY(zoneid, time) AS zoneid, MIN(time) AS time, MIN_BY(game_channel, time) AS game_channel, MAX(battlebegin_hero) AS battlebegin_hero, MAX(battle_time) AS battle_time, MAX(heroskinid1) AS heroskinid1, MAX(noresnum_battlebegin) AS noresnum_battlebegin, MIN_BY(nores_num_end, time) AS nores_num_end /* -本局通过资源监测战斗结束时刻的白膜数量，用于和战斗前-战斗内补做核验 */, MIN_BY(bankrepair, time) AS bankrepair /* --本局修复的英雄白膜数量 */ FROM (SELECT *, ARRAY(COALESCE(heroskinid1, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid2, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid3, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid4, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid5, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid6, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid7, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid8, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid9, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid10, 0)) AS battlebegin_hero, IF(COALESCE(heroskinid1, 'none') IN ('', 'none', 0), 0, 1) + IF(COALESCE(heroskinid2, 'none') IN ('', 'none', 0), 0, 1) + IF(COALESCE(heroskinid3, 'none') IN ('', 'none', 0), 0, 1) + IF(COALESCE(heroskinid4, 'none') IN ('', 'none', 0), 0, 1) + IF(COALESCE(heroskinid5, 'none') IN ('', 'none', 0), 0, 1) + IF(COALESCE(heroskinid6, 'none') IN ('', 'none', 0), 0, 1) + IF(COALESCE(heroskinid7, 'none') IN ('', 'none', 0), 0, 1) + IF(COALESCE(heroskinid8, 'none') IN ('', 'none', 0), 0, 1) + IF(COALESCE(heroskinid9, 'none') IN ('', 'none', 0), 0, 1) + IF(COALESCE(heroskinid10, 'none') IN ('', 'none', 0), 0, 1) AS noresnum_battlebegin FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_bankres WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS sub LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(ARRAY(COALESCE(heroskinid1, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid2, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid3, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid4, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid5, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid6, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid7, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid8, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid9, 0), COALESCE(heroskinid10, 0))) exploded_table AS skinid WHERE NOT skinid IS NULL AND CAST(skinid AS STRING) <> '' /* --这个上报的都是白膜战斗，但是有很多战斗上报的英雄皮肤id是0，也就是拿不到白膜英雄，所以要注意 */ GROUP BY logymd, accountid, skinid, battleid) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT skinid, MAX(skin_heroid) AS skin_heroid FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config GROUP BY skinid) AS b ON a.skinid = b.skinid LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, MAX(hero_name) AS hero_name FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY heroid) AS c ON b.skin_heroid = c.heroid), battleend_noresheros AS (SELECT a.*, b.skin_heroid AS heroid, c.hero_name FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, skinid, battleid, MIN_BY(ip, time) AS ip, MIN_BY(level, time) AS level, MIN_BY(zoneid, time) AS zoneid, MIN(time) AS time, MIN_BY(game_channel, time) AS game_channel FROM (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_bankres WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS sub LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(nores_herolist_end, ',')) exploded_table AS skinid WHERE NOT skinid IS NULL AND CAST(skinid AS STRING) <> '' /* --这个上报的都是白膜战斗，但是有很多战斗上报的英雄皮肤id是0，也就是拿不到白膜英雄，所以要注意 */ GROUP BY logymd, accountid, skinid, battleid) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT skinid, MAX(skin_heroid) AS skin_heroid FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config GROUP BY skinid) AS b ON a.skinid = b.skinid LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, MAX(hero_name) AS hero_name FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY heroid) AS c ON b.skin_heroid = c.heroid), res_changetime /* -中间替换的皮肤 */ AS (SELECT a.*, b.skin_heroid AS heroid, c.hero_name FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, SPLIT(element1, '_')[0] AS skinid, battleid, MIN_BY(ip, time) AS ip, MIN_BY(level, time) AS level, MIN_BY(zoneid, time) AS zoneid, MIN(time) AS time, MIN_BY(game_channel, time) AS game_channel, MAX(CAST(SPLIT(element1, '_')[1] AS BIGINT)) AS fitst_changetime /* -皮肤首次被替换的时间 */, MAX(battle_time) AS battle_time FROM (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_bankres WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS sub LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(reschangetime, ',')) exploded_table AS element1 WHERE NOT element1 IS NULL AND CAST(element1 AS STRING) <> '' /* --这个上报的都是白膜战斗，但是有很多战斗上报的英雄皮肤id是0，也就是拿不到白膜英雄，所以要注意 */ GROUP BY logymd, accountid, SPLIT(element1, '_')[0], battleid) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT skinid, MAX(skin_heroid) AS skin_heroid FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config GROUP BY skinid) AS b ON a.skinid = b.skinid LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, MAX(hero_name) AS hero_name FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY heroid) AS c ON b.skin_heroid = c.heroid), nores_hero_bankres_reason /* -----基于老表判断白膜原因 */ AS (SELECT s1.logymd, s1.accountid, s1.battleid, s1.heroid, s1.skinid, s1.hero_name, s1.ip, s1.level, s1.zoneid, s1.time, s1.game_channel, s1.noresnum_battlebegin, s1.battlebegin_noreslist, s1.duplicate_heronum, s1.battle_time, 1 AS is_nores, IF(NOT s2.heroid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_need_download, IF(NOT s3.heroid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_finish_download, CASE WHEN s2.heroid IS NULL THEN '检测问题：未触发补下载' WHEN NOT s2.heroid IS NULL AND NOT s3.heroid IS NULL THEN '加载问题：下完了遇到白膜' WHEN NOT s2.heroid IS NULL AND s3.heroid IS NULL THEN '下载问题：未下完' END AS fail_reason_old /* --基于老表判断白膜原因 */, s1.bankrepair FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, CAST(heroid AS STRING) AS heroid, ip, level, zoneid, skinid, hero_name, time, game_channel, bankrepair, noresnum_battlebegin, battlebegin_noreslist, duplicate_heronum, battle_time /* --该局重复白膜个数 */ FROM nores_hero_bankres WHERE NOT heroid IS NULL AND CAST(heroid AS STRING) <> '' /* -在这里，白膜英雄id=0的被过滤掉了，因为用皮肤id关联不上英雄id，得到null然后被过滤了 */) AS s1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, CAST(heroid AS STRING) AS heroid, is_finish FROM need_download_hero_choosedown WHERE NOT heroid IS NULL AND CAST(heroid AS STRING) <> '') AS s2 ON s1.accountid = s2.accountid AND s1.battleid = s2.battleid AND s1.heroid = s2.heroid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, CAST(heroid AS STRING) AS heroid FROM downfinish_hero_choosedown WHERE NOT heroid IS NULL AND CAST(heroid AS STRING) <> '') AS s3 ON s1.accountid = s3.accountid AND s1.battleid = s3.battleid AND s1.heroid = s3.heroid), nores_hero_heroresdetail_reason /* -----基于新表判断白膜原因 */ AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.battleid, a.accountid, b.heroid, a.skinid, c.hero_name, MIN_BY(a.fail_reason, a.time) AS fail_reason_new /* -取当天该场战斗，该英雄遇到的首个白膜原因 */, MIN_BY(a.grading_id, a.time) AS grading_id, MIN_BY(a.zoneid, a.time) AS zoneid, MIN_BY(a.is_download_finish, a.time) AS is_download_finish, MIN_BY(a.is_originskin_finish, a.time) AS is_originskin_finish, MIN_BY(a.is_wifi, a.time) AS is_wifi, MIN_BY(a.real_picture_quality, a.time) AS real_picture_quality, MIN_BY(a.now_picture_quality, a.time) AS now_picture_quality, MIN_BY(a.total_disk_space, a.time) AS total_disk_space, MIN_BY(a.free_disk_space, a.time) AS free_disk_space, MIN_BY(a.recordcheck, a.time) AS recordcheck, MIN_BY(a.deviceid, a.time) AS deviceid, MIN_BY(a.game_channel, a.time) AS game_channel, MIN_BY(a.device_name, a.time) AS device_name, MIN_BY(a.level, a.time) AS level, MIN_BY(a.ip, a.time) AS ip, MIN_BY(a.client_version, a.time) AS client_version, MIN(time) AS time FROM (SELECT test.*, t1.array_idx, t1.array_element, SPLIT(t1.array_element, ',')[1] AS skinid, SPLIT(t1.array_element, ',')[2] AS fail_reason FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, client_version, time, grading_id, heroresdetail, zoneid, is_download_finish /* -增量是否完成 */, is_originskin_finish /* -白膜必备资源是否完成 */, is_wifi, real_picture_quality, now_picture_quality, total_disk_space, free_disk_space, recordcheck, deviceid, game_channel, device_name, level, ip, SPLIT(heroresdetail, '\\073') AS heroresdetail_array FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleheroresdetail WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-06-27') AS test LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(heroresdetail_array) t1 AS array_idx, array_element) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT skinid, MAX(skin_heroid) AS heroid FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config GROUP BY skinid) AS b ON a.skinid = b.skinid LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, MAX(hero_name) AS hero_name FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY heroid) AS c ON b.heroid = c.heroid WHERE NOT fail_reason IN (0, 24) GROUP BY a.logymd, a.battleid, a.accountid, b.heroid, a.skinid, c.hero_name), norse_battleenddata AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, 'none' AS skinid, 'none' AS heroid, 'none' AS hero_name, MIN_BY(battletype, time) AS pvptype, MIN_BY(realpvptype, time) AS realpvptype, MIN_BY(zoneid, time) AS zoneid, MIN_BY(level, time) AS level, MIN_BY(ip, time) AS ip, MIN_BY(game_channel, time) AS game_channel, MIN(time) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN noresnum BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN noresnum END) AS noresnum FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND noresnum > 0 AND COALESCE(isbot, 0) = 0 GROUP BY logymd, accountid, battleid, 'none', 'none', 'none'), total_nores_hero AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, skinid, heroid, hero_name, MAX(game_channel) AS game_channel FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, skinid, heroid, hero_name, game_channel FROM nores_hero_bankres_reason WHERE NOT skinid IS NULL AND CAST(skinid AS STRING) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, skinid, heroid, hero_name, game_channel FROM nores_hero_heroresdetail_reason WHERE NOT skinid IS NULL AND CAST(skinid AS STRING) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, skinid, heroid, hero_name, game_channel FROM norse_battleenddata UNION ALL SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, skinid, heroid, hero_name, game_channel FROM battleend_noresheros UNION ALL SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, skinid, heroid, hero_name, game_channel FROM res_changetime) AS xx GROUP BY logymd, accountid, battleid, skinid, heroid, hero_name), aihero AS (SELECT battleid, herodi AS heroid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (NOT os_type IN (1, 2) OR fake_ai <> 0) GROUP BY battleid, herodi), nores_hero_reason_join AS (SELECT s1.logymd, s1.accountid, s1.battleid, s1.game_channel, s1.skinid, s1.heroid, s1.hero_name, IF(NOT s2.skinid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_nores_hero_old /* --老表是否白膜 */, IF(NOT s3.skinid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_nores_hero_new /* --新表是否白膜 */, s2.ip AS ip_old, s2.level AS level_old, s2.zoneid AS zoneid_old, s2.fail_reason_old, s2.is_need_download, s2.is_finish_download, s2.time AS time_old, s2.bankrepair, s2.noresnum_battlebegin, s2.battlebegin_noreslist, s2.duplicate_heronum, s2.battle_time, s3.fail_reason_new /* -取当天该场战斗，该英雄遇到的首个白膜原因 */, s3.grading_id, s3.zoneid AS zoneid_new, s3.is_download_finish, s3.is_originskin_finish, s3.is_wifi, s3.real_picture_quality, s3.now_picture_quality, s3.total_disk_space, s3.free_disk_space, s3.recordcheck, s3.deviceid, s3.device_name, s3.level AS level_new, s3.client_version AS client_version_new, s3.time AS time_new, IF(NOT s4.heroid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_aihero, IF(NOT s5.battleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_nores_battle_battleenddata /* --enddata表里判断这场战斗是白膜 */, s5.noresnum AS noresnum_battleenddata /* --enddata表里的白膜英雄数 */, s5.pvptype AS pvptype_battleenddata, s5.realpvptype AS realpvptype_battleenddata, s5.zoneid AS zoneid_battleenddata, s5.level AS level_battleenddata, s5.ip AS ip_battleenddata, s5.game_channel AS game_channel_battleenddata, IF(NOT s6.skinid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_battleend_nores_hero /* -是否战斗结束时刻的白膜 */, IF(NOT s7.skinid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_change_nores_hero /* -是否战斗内替换的白膜 */, s7.fitst_changetime FROM total_nores_hero AS s1 LEFT JOIN nores_hero_bankres_reason AS s2 ON s1.logymd = s2.logymd AND s1.accountid = s2.accountid AND s1.battleid = s2.battleid AND s1.skinid = s2.skinid LEFT JOIN nores_hero_heroresdetail_reason AS s3 ON s1.logymd = s3.logymd AND s1.accountid = s3.accountid AND s1.battleid = s3.battleid AND s1.skinid = s3.skinid LEFT JOIN aihero AS s4 ON s1.battleid = s4.battleid AND s1.heroid = s4.heroid LEFT JOIN norse_battleenddata AS s5 ON s1.logymd = s5.logymd AND s1.battleid = s5.battleid AND s1.accountid = s5.accountid LEFT JOIN battleend_noresheros AS s6 ON s1.logymd = s6.logymd AND s1.battleid = s6.battleid AND s1.accountid = s6.accountid AND s1.skinid = s6.skinid LEFT JOIN res_changetime AS s7 ON s1.logymd = s7.logymd AND s1.battleid = s7.battleid AND s1.accountid = s7.accountid AND s1.skinid = s7.skinid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jaxzhong_battle_no_resource_hero_multi_table_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 覆盖写入 */ SELECT s1.accountid, s1.battleid, s1.heroid, s1.skinid, s1.hero_name, s1.is_nores_hero_old, s1.is_nores_hero_new, s1.ip_old, s1.level_old, s1.zoneid_old, s1.fail_reason_old, s1.is_need_download /* --该英雄是否触发补下载 */, s1.is_finish_download /* -该英雄是补下载完成 */, s1.time_old, s1.fail_reason_new, s1.grading_id, s1.zoneid_new, s1.is_download_finish /* --是否增量下载完成 */, s1.is_originskin_finish /* --是否原皮下载完成 */, s1.is_wifi, s1.real_picture_quality, s1.now_picture_quality, s1.total_disk_space, s1.free_disk_space, s1.recordcheck, s1.deviceid, s1.game_channel /* --三张表都能用的game channel字段 */, s1.device_name, s1.level_new, s1.client_version_new, s1.time_new, s5.client_version, s4.bigranklvl, s4.minranklvl, s4.battlesvrid, s5.clientip, s4.os_type, s4.battle_duration, s4.wincamp, s5.heroid AS self_hero, s4.blacknum, s7.pvptype, s4.wifi, s4.isinvalidbattle, s7.realpvptype, s4.battle_svr_ip, s5.channel, s5.realpicturequality, s5.nowpicturequality, s5.isdownload, s5.systemmemorysize, s5.freememory, s5.gameusediskspace, s5.freediskspace, s5.recmd_pic, s5.fixed_score, IF(NOT s6.battleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_new_battleloading, s1.is_aihero, s1.is_nores_battle_battleenddata /* --enddata表里判断这场战斗是白膜 */, s1.noresnum_battleenddata /* --enddata表里的白膜英雄数 */, s1.pvptype_battleenddata, s1.realpvptype_battleenddata, s1.zoneid_battleenddata, s1.level_battleenddata, s1.ip_battleenddata, s1.game_channel_battleenddata, s1.bankrepair, s1.noresnum_battlebegin, s1.battlebegin_noreslist, s1.duplicate_heronum, s1.battle_time, s1.is_battleend_nores_hero /* -是否战斗结束时刻的白膜 */, s1.is_change_nores_hero /* -是否战斗内替换的白膜 */, s1.fitst_changetime /* -战斗内替换白膜首次时间 */ FROM nores_hero_reason_join AS s1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid /* ,min_by(clientversion,time) as client_version */, MIN_BY(bigranklvl, time) AS bigranklvl, MIN_BY(minranklvl, time) AS minranklvl, MIN_BY(battlesvrid, time) AS battlesvrid /* ,min_by(clientip,time) as clientip */, MIN_BY(os_type, time) AS os_type, SUM(battletime) AS battle_duration, MIN_BY(wincamp, time) AS wincamp /* ,min_by(heroid,time) as heroid */, MIN_BY(blacknum, time) AS blacknum /* ,min_by(pvptype,time) as pvptype */, MIN_BY(wifi, time) AS wifi, MIN_BY(isinvalidbattle, time) AS isinvalidbattle /* ,min_by(realpvptype,time) as realpvptype */, MIN_BY(battle_svr_ip, time) AS battle_svr_ip /* ,min_by(channel,time) as channel */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, battleid) AS s4 ON s1.accountid = s4.accountid AND s1.battleid = s4.battleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, MIN_BY(client_version, time) AS client_version, MIN_BY(ip, time) AS clientip, MIN_BY(realpicturequality, time) AS realpicturequality, MIN_BY(nowpicturequality, time) AS nowpicturequality, MIN_BY(isdownload, time) AS isdownload, MIN_BY(systemmemorysize, time) AS systemmemorysize, MIN_BY(freememory, time) AS freememory, MIN_BY(gameusediskspace, time) AS gameusediskspace, MIN_BY(freediskspace, time) AS freediskspace, MIN_BY(recmd_pic, time) AS recmd_pic, MIN_BY(fixed_score, time) AS fixed_score, MIN_BY(game_channel, time) AS channel /* ,min_by(pvptype,time) as pvptype */ /* ,min_by(realpvptype,time) as realpvptype */, MIN_BY(heroid, time) AS heroid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, battleid) AS s5 ON s1.accountid = s5.accountid AND s1.battleid = s5.battleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid FROM ml_ods.connserver_battle_loading_choke WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND loadflag > 0 GROUP BY logymd, accountid, battleid) AS s6 /* --新battleloading的战斗标记 */ ON ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY battleid) AS s7 ON s1.battleid = s7.battleid

pre_mt_id, 'mla' AS app_id, t1.roleid AS role_id, t3.name AS name, NULL AS phone, t3.email AS email, NULL AS platforms, NULL AS ids, NULL AS names FROM mh_ods.gameserver_login AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT AS t3 ON t1.device_id = t3.account_name WHERE t1.logymd = '2026-05-31'), merge_sub_id AS (SELECT t1.one_id, COALESCE(t2.device_id, IF((t1.and_one_id = '' OR t1.and_one_id = 'none'), NULL, t1.and_one_id), CONCAT('and_', t1.device_unique_id, t1.android_id, t1.ad_id)) AS and_one_id, t1.device_unique_id, t1.android_id, t1.ad_id, t1.device_id, t1.build_serial, t1.mac_address, t1.mac_md5, t7.mt_id, t1.mt_one_id) AS mt_one_id, t1.mt_id, t1.pre_mt_id, t1.app_id, t1.role_id, t1.name, t1.phone, t1.email, t1.platforms, t1.ids, t1.names FROM init_data AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT android_id, android_id) AS t2 ON t1.android_id = t2.android_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT idfa, ARRAY_MIN(COLLECT_SET(device_id)) AS device_id FROM init_data WHERE NOT idfa IS NULL AND idfa <> '' AND idfa <> 'none' AND JOIN (SELECT ios_one_id, ARRAY_MIN(COLLECT_SET(mt_one_id)) AS mt_one_id FROM merge_sub_id WHERE NOT and_one_id IS NULL AND and_one_id <> '' AND and_one_id <> '0' AND NOT mt_one_id IS NULL AND mt_one_id <> '0' GROUP BY ios_one_id) AS t3 ON t1.ios_one_id = t3.ios_one_id

name: jaxzhong_ip与4G_Wifi映射
sql_units: WITH network_info /* 网络类型信息 */ AS (SELECT CASE WHEN iswifi = 'True' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_wifi, ip, GEOIP(ip, 5) AS net, COUNT(1) FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_loginloading_game WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' AND iswifi IN ('True', 'False') GROUP BY CASE WHEN iswifi = 'True' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ip, GEOIP(ip, 5)), ip_map_to_wifi AS (SELECT ip, MAX_BY(is_wifi, cnt) AS is_wifi FROM (SELECT is_wifi, ip, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM network_info GROUP BY is_wifi, ip) AS x1 GROUP BY ip), net_map_to_wifi AS (SELECT net, MAX_BY(is_wifi, cnt) AS is_wifi FROM (SELECT net, is_wifi, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM network_info GROUP BY net, is_wifi) AS x1 GROUP BY net) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jaxzhong_ip_net_map_to_wifi_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 覆盖写入 */ SELECT s1.ip, s1.net, s2.is_wifi AS ip_map_to_wifi /* -取ip地址最大数量是否wifi */, s3.is_wifi AS net_map_to_wifi /* -取net最大数量是否wifi */ FROM network_info AS s1 LEFT JOIN ip_map_to_wifi AS s2 ON s1.ip = s2.ip LEFT JOIN net_map_to_wifi AS s3 ON s1.net = s3.net

logymd = '2026-05-30' AND UPPER(appid) = 'MLBB') AS aa) AS a4 ON a2.roleid = a4.roleid AND a2.zoneid = a4.zoneid AND a2.logymd = a4.logymd GROUP BY a2.logymd, a4.paiwei_cnt_type /* a3.new_point, */, a4.max_rank) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.season_point_active_caowl PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.logymd AS dt, t1.max_rank, t1.paiwei_cnt_type, t0.new_point, t0.point_users /* 分成就积分玩家数 */, t1.all_users /* 总玩家数 */ FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t0 ON t1.logymd = t0.logymd AND t1.max_rank = t0.max_rank AND t1.paiwei_cnt_type = t0.paiwei_cnt_type

name: etl.mt_finance_prod.dim_payment_settlement_exchange_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: yajunfeng@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-07-03 14:49:14.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH latest_charge_mapping AS (SELECT DISTINCT pay_channel_id, charge_pay_channel FROM mt_finance_prod.dim_charge_channel_mapping_df WHERE logymd > '0' AND logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_finance_prod.dim_charge_channel_mapping_df WHERE logymd > '0')), latest_bill_mapping AS (SELECT DISTINCT charge_pay_channel, bill_pay_channel FROM mt_finance_prod.dim_bill_channel_mapping_df WHERE logymd > '0' AND logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_finance_prod.dim_bill_channel_mapping_df WHERE logymd > '0')), base_config AS (SELECT c.bill_pay_channel, a.benchmark_exchange_rate_type, a.benchmark_exchange_rate_n, a.fixed_exchange_rate, a.markup_exchange_rate FROM mt_dim.dim_deepgrow_billing_configuration_df AS a LEFT JOIN latest_charge_mapping AS b ON a.pay_channel_id = b.pay_channel_id LEFT JOIN latest_bill_mapping AS c ON b.charge_pay_channel = c.charge_pay_channel WHERE a.logymd > '0' AND a.logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_deepgrow_billing_configuration_df WHERE logymd > '0') AND NOT c.bill_pay_channel IS NULL), fixed_rate_detail AS (SELECT bill_pay_channel, benchmark_exchange_rate_type, benchmark_exchange_rate_n, fr.currency AS currency, fr.fixed_rate AS fixed_rate FROM base_config LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(FROM_JSON(COALESCE(fixed_exchange_rate, '[]'), 'array<struct<currency:string,fixed_rate:string>>')) t AS fr), markup_rate_detail AS (SELECT bill_pay_channel, benchmark_exchange_rate_type, benchmark_exchange_rate_n, mr.currency AS currency, mr.markup_rate AS markup_rate FROM base_config LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(FROM_JSON(COALESCE(markup_exchange_rate, '[]'), 'array<struct<currency:string,markup_rate:string>>')) t AS mr), merged_rate AS (SELECT COALESCE(f.bill_pay_channel, m.bill_pay_channel) AS bill_channel, COALESCE(f.currency, m.currency) AS currency, COALESCE(f.benchmark_exchange_rate_type, m.benchmark_exchange_rate_type) AS exchange_rate_type, COALESCE(f.benchmark_exchange_rate_n, m.benchmark_exchange_rate_n) AS benchmark_exchange_rate_n, f.fixed_rate, m.markup_rate FROM fixed_rate_detail AS f FULL OUTER JOIN markup_rate_detail AS m ON f.bill_pay_channel = m.bill_pay_channel AND f.currency = m.currency), normal_rows AS (SELECT bill_channel AS bill_channel, '-' AS bill_sub_channel, 'default' AS bill_logym, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS cycle_type, exchange_rate_type AS exchange_rate_type, '' AS service_date, currency AS currency, CASE WHEN exchange_rate_type = 5 THEN fixed_rate ELSE NULL END AS exchange, COALESCE(markup_rate, '0') AS service_point, '0.05' AS compare_threshold, CASE WHEN exchange_rate_type = 4 THEN benchmark_exchange_rate_n ELSE NULL END AS transaction_date_n FROM merged_rate WHERE NOT bill_channel IS NULL AND NOT currency IS NULL), default_rows AS (SELECT DISTINCT bill_pay_channel AS bill_channel, '-' AS bill_sub_channel, 'default' AS bill_logym, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS cycle_type, benchmark_exchange_rate_type AS exchange_rate_type, '' AS service_date, '-' AS currency, '1' AS exchange, '0' AS service_point, '0.05' AS compare_threshold, CASE WHEN benchmark_exchange_rate_type = 4 THEN benchmark_exchange_rate_n ELSE NULL END AS transaction_date_n FROM base_config WHERE NOT bill_pay_channel IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_finance_prod.dim_payment_settlement_exchange_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'deepgrow') SELECT * FROM normal_rows UNION ALL SELECT * FROM default_rows

name: etl.bi_test.dwd_charge_order_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: ethandong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-07-02 14:33:15.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* GP 无定价数据 */ WITH charge_gp_no_price AS (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND receipt_type = 2 AND COALESCE(localprice, 0) = 0 AND receipt_type = 72), charge_all /* charge 标准化数据 */ AS (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_type, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype /* 土耳其错误货币缩写纠正 / 塞拉利昂更换货币缩写 */, CASE WHEN UPPER(currency) IN ('TRI', 'TRY') THEN 'TRY' WHEN UPPER(currency) IN ('SLE', 'SLL') THEN 'SLE' ELSE UPPER(currency) END AS currency, CASE WHEN UPPER(local_currency) IN ('TRI', 'TRY') THEN 'TRY' WHEN UPPER(local_currency) IN ('SLE', 'SLL') THEN 'SLE' ELSE UPPER(local_currency) END AS local_currency, localprice, pay_channel, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, logymd FROM (/* 有定价的数据 */ SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_type, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, currency, localprice * 100 AS localprice, pay_channel, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (receipt_type <> 2 OR COALESCE(localprice, 0) > 0) AND receipt_type = 72 UNION ALL /* GP 规范无定价商品的价格和货币 */ SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, a.product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_type, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, COALESCE(b.currency, a.currency) AS currency, COALESCE(b.localprice * 100, a.localprice * 100) AS localprice, pay_channel, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, logymd FROM charge_gp_no_price AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, localprice, currency FROM (SELECT t1.product_id, t1.localprice, t1.currency, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.product_id ORDER BY time DESC, t1.currency ASC) AS rn FROM (SELECT time, product_id, localprice, currency FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd >= '2026-04-30' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND receipt_type = 2 AND COALESCE(localprice, 0) > 0 AND receipt_type = 72) AS t1 LEFT SEMI JOIN charge_gp_no_price AS t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id) AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS b ON a.product_id = b.product_id)), dim_charge_calibration_df /* 充值校准 start */ AS (SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, country_type, country, currency_type, currency, single_currency_muti_country_type, is_orderid_match FROM mt_dim.dim_charge_calibration_df AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_charge_calibration_df WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0'), receipt_mapping /* 渠道id Mapping */ AS (SELECT receipt_type, pay_channel, pay_channel_name FROM mt_dim.dim_receipt_mapping_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_receipt_mapping_di WHERE logymd > '0' AND appid = 'ml') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE appid = 'ml'), charge_raw AS (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel AS login_channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, COALESCE(flowid, 'unknown') AS flowid, a.receipt_type AS pay_channel, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, is_iap_token_buy, receipt_id, money, COALESCE(money_new, 0) AS money_new, device_id, product, COALESCE(operator, 'unknown') AS operator, COALESCE(interfacetype, 'unknown') AS interfacetype, a.logymd, IF(a.sub_pay_channel IS NULL OR a.sub_pay_channel = '', '-', a.sub_pay_channel) AS sub_pay_channel /* 默认本地价格和币种 */, IF(COALESCE(a.localprice, 0) > 0, a.currency, IF(COALESCE(local_price, 0) = 0, 'USD', COALESCE(local_currency, 'USD'))) AS currency, IF(COALESCE(a.localprice, 0) > 0, a.localprice, IF(COALESCE(local_price, 0) = 0, money, local_price)) AS localprice, IF(COALESCE(a.local_price, 0) > 0, a.local_currency, IF(COALESCE(localprice, 0) = 0, 'USD', COALESCE(a.currency, 'USD'))) AS local_currency, IF(COALESCE(a.local_price, 0) > 0, a.local_price, IF(COALESCE(localprice, 0) = 0, money, localprice)) AS local_price, COALESCE(first_channel_charge, 0) AS first_channel_charge, COALESCE(other_orderid, 'unknown') AS other_orderid, COALESCE(other_pay_orderid, 'unknown') AS other_pay_orderid, COALESCE(a.pay_channel, 'unknown') AS mix_pay_channel, COALESCE(b.pay_channel, 'unknown') AS calibration_pay_channel, COALESCE(b.pay_channel_name, 'unknown') AS pay_channel_name /* 渠道校准规则 */, COALESCE(c.single_currency_muti_country_type, d.single_currency_muti_country_type) AS single_currency_muti_country_type, COALESCE(c.sub_pay_channel, d.sub_pay_channel) AS calibration_sub_pay_channel, COALESCE(c.country_type, d.country_type) AS country_type, COALESCE(c.country, d.country) AS country_desc, COALESCE(c.currency_type, d.currency_type) AS currency_type, COALESCE(c.currency, d.currency) AS currency_desc FROM charge_all AS a LEFT JOIN receipt_mapping AS b ON a.receipt_type = b.pay_channel AND b.pay_channel <> 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM dim_charge_calibration_df WHERE sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS c ON LOWER(b.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(c.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(c.sub_pay_channel) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM dim_charge_calibration_df WHERE sub_pay_channel = '-') AS d ON LOWER(b.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(d.pay_channel)), currency_country_mapping /* 国家货币 Mapping */ AS (SELECT currency, country, country_name FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_country_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_country_di WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0' AND (currency <> 'EUR' OR (currency = 'EUR' AND country <> 'IT'))), charge_country_calibrated AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bill_country_tmp, '-') <> '-' THEN bill_country_tmp WHEN COALESCE(currency_country, '-') <> '-' THEN currency_country WHEN COALESCE(ip_country, '-') <> '-' THEN ip_country WHEN COALESCE(last_mt_country, '-') <> '-' THEN last_mt_country END AS bill_country FROM (SELECT a.* /* 不属于调整口径的渠道使用支付时的ip转换的国家作为支付国，货币与金额使用表中local_currency和local_price字段进行替换。 */, CASE WHEN a.logymd < '2021-12-01' THEN GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') WHEN country_type IS NULL THEN GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') WHEN single_currency_muti_country_type <> '-' AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT(UPPER(SPLIT(single_currency_muti_country_type, '\\+')[1]), ','), a.currency) AND LOWER(SPLIT(single_currency_muti_country_type, '\\+')[0]) = 'mt' THEN c.last_mt_country WHEN single_currency_muti_country_type <> '-' AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT(UPPER(SPLIT(single_currency_muti_country_type, '\\+')[1]), ','), a.currency) AND LOWER(SPLIT(single_currency_muti_country_type, '\\+')[0]) = 'ip' THEN GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') WHEN LOWER(country_type) = 'currency' THEN b.country WHEN LOWER(country_type) = 'clientip' THEN GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') ELSE LOWER(country_type) END AS bill_country_tmp, b.country AS currency_country, GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') AS ip_country, c.last_mt_country AS last_mt_country FROM charge_raw AS a LEFT JOIN currency_country_mapping AS b ON IF(UPPER(COALESCE(a.currency, '')) IN ('', 'APPC'), UPPER(a.local_currency), UPPER(a.currency)) = UPPER(b.currency) LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS c ON c.logymd = '{DATE}' AND c.appid = 'mlbb' AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.roleid = c.roleid)), timezone_mapping /* 时区 Mapping */ AS (SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 1, 1) = '-' THEN (CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 2, 2) AS INT) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 5, 2) AS INT) * 60) ELSE -1 * ((CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 1, 2) AS INT) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 4, 2) AS INT) * 60)) END AS timeoffset FROM mt_dim.dim_payment_channel_timezone_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_payment_channel_timezone_di WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0'), charge_calibrated AS (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, login_channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, a.pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, a.currency, localprice, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, a.sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, mix_pay_channel, logymd, LOWER(bill_country) AS bill_country, LOWER(ip_country) AS ip_country, pay_channel_name, CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN '2020-10-21' AND '2020-12-14' THEN 'USD' WHEN a.currency = 'APPC' THEN 'USD' WHEN logymd < '2021-12-01' THEN a.local_currency WHEN currency_type IS NULL THEN a.local_currency WHEN LOWER(currency_type) = 'currency' THEN a.currency WHEN LOWER(currency_type) = 'country' THEN COALESCE(b.currency, a.currency) ELSE UPPER(currency_type) END AS bill_currency, CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN '2020-10-21' AND '2020-12-14' THEN money WHEN a.currency = 'APPC' THEN IF(logymd < '2021-12-01', local_price, localprice) * 0.01 WHEN currency_type IS NULL THEN a.local_price ELSE IF(logymd < '2021-12-01', local_price, localprice) END AS bill_amt /* 当 timeoffset 匹配不到的时候 null 或 '' 或 -, 需要按照默认服务器时间处理: 需要再处理下 */, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.time) + COALESCE(c.timeoffset, 0)) AS local_time, c.timeoffset FROM charge_country_calibrated AS a LEFT JOIN currency_country_mapping AS b ON LOWER(a.bill_country) = LOWER(b.country) LEFT JOIN timezone_mapping AS c ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(c.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(c.sub_pay_channel)), charge_final /* 充值校准 end */ AS (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, login_channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, a.product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, a.pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, a.currency, localprice, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, a.sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, a.mix_pay_channel, a.logymd, a.bill_country, a.ip_country, pay_channel_name, bill_currency, COALESCE(b.change_amt, a.bill_amt) AS bill_amt, a.local_time FROM charge_calibrated AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_productmoney_change_df WHERE logymd > '0' AND logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_productmoney_change_df WHERE logymd > '0')) AS b ON a.local_time >= b.start_date AND a.local_time < b.end_date AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(TRIM(b.pay_channel)) AND LOWER(IF(COALESCE(a.sub_pay_channel, '') = '', '-', a.sub_pay_channel)) = LOWER(TRIM(b.sub_pay_channel)) AND LOWER(a.bill_country) = LOWER(TRIM(b.country)) AND LOWER(a.product_id) = LOWER(TRIM(b.product_id)) AND LOWER(a.bill_currency) = LOWER(TRIM(b.currency))), paychannel_rate /* 税率 */ AS (/* 如果出现重复，随机1条的结束日期置为当前日期，另一条为2016-01-01，而end_day为2016-01-01的那条不参与计算 */ /* 会通过charge.logymd<dim.end_day的方式剔除掉重复值 */ SELECT start_day, country, pay_channel, UPPER(sub_pay_channel) AS sub_pay_channel, rate, share, is_tax, is_pay_tax, is_back_tax, is_fuzzy_match, has_share_tax, LEAD(start_day, 1, '9999-12-31') OVER (PARTITION BY country, pay_channel, UPPER(sub_pay_channel) ORDER BY start_day) AS end_day FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_rate_di WHERE appid = 'ml' AND logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-08-01', '2024-08-01', '2026-05-31')), paychannel_fee /* 手续费 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT country, pay_channel, UPPER(sub_pay_channel) AS sub_pay_channel, fee_currency, fee_amt FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_fee_di WHERE appid = 'ml' AND logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-08-01', '2024-08-01', '2026-05-31')), currency_exchange /* 月度平均汇率，来源XE网站数据：https://xecdapi.xe.com */ AS (SELECT currency, CASE WHEN UPPER(currency) = 'MMK' THEN 1 / 0.000213995 ELSE exchange_rate END AS exchange_rate FROM (SELECT currency, AVG(exchange_rate) AS exchange_rate FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_exchange_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-30' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY currency)), web_funtap AS (/* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dwd_charge_order_di PARTITION(logymd) */ SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, login_channel, chargediamond, LOWER(createrole_country) AS createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, IF(COALESCE(operator, '') = '', 'unknown', operator) AS operator, IF(COALESCE(interfacetype, '') = '', 'unknown', interfacetype) AS interfacetype, currency, localprice, COALESCE(IF(DATE_FORMAT(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') <= '2020-04-10 03:52:39', 0, is_sandbox), 0) AS is_sandbox, iap_product_type, sub_pay_channel, COALESCE(IF(DATE_FORMAT(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') <= '2017-06-13 02:44:26', 0, is_iap_token_buy), 0) AS is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, bill_country, UPPER(bill_currency) AS bill_currency, COALESCE(exchange_rate, 0) AS currency_exchange_rate, bill_amt, before_tax_currency, COALESCE(before_tax_amt, 0) AS before_tax_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(after_tax_currency, 'unknown')) AS after_tax_currency, COALESCE(after_tax_amt, 0) AS after_tax_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(actual_currency, 'unknown')) AS actual_currency, COALESCE(actual_amt, 0) AS actual_amt, COALESCE(tax_rate, 0) AS tax_rate, UPPER(COALESCE(tax_currency, 'unknown')) AS tax_currency, IF(COALESCE(is_pay_tax, '否') = '是', plat_tax_amt, 0) AS tax_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(back_tax_currency, 'unknown')) AS back_tax_currency, IF(COALESCE(is_back_tax, '否') = '是', plat_tax_amt, 0) AS back_tax_amt, COALESCE(share_ratio, 0) AS share_ratio, UPPER(COALESCE(share_currency, 'unknown')) AS share_currency, COALESCE(share_amt, 0) AS share_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(fee_currency, 'unknown')) AS fee_currency, COALESCE(fee_amt, 0) AS fee_amt, COALESCE(fee_exchange_rate, 0) AS fee_exchange_rate, pay_channel_name AS game_pay_channel, mix_pay_channel, logymd FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN has_share_tax = '不含税' THEN after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate WHEN has_share_tax = '含税' THEN before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate WHEN has_share_tax = '净额' THEN (before_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate) / (1 + tax_rate) ELSE after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate END AS actual_amt /* 实收 */ FROM (SELECT *, before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt AS after_tax_amt /* 税后 */, CASE WHEN has_share_tax = '不含税' THEN (before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt) * share_ratio WHEN has_share_tax IN ('含税', '净额') THEN before_tax_amt * share_ratio ELSE (before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt) * share_ratio END AS share_amt /* 分成 */ FROM (SELECT *, COALESCE(fee_amt / fee_exchange_rate, 0) AS fee_usd_amt /* 手续费 */, CASE WHEN has_share_tax IN ('不含税', '含税') THEN COALESCE(before_tax_amt / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate, 0) WHEN has_share_tax = '净额' THEN COALESCE(((before_tax_amt * (1 - share_ratio) - COALESCE(fee_amt / fee_exchange_rate, 0) * exchange_rate) / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate), 0) ELSE COALESCE(before_tax_amt / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate, 0) END AS plat_tax_amt /* 税金 */ FROM (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, login_channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, a.pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, a.currency, localprice, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, a.sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, a.logymd, local_currency, name: 地图每日使用占比v2zibo_hong_map_use_condition_v4
sql_units: WITH require_player AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN zoneid < 57000 THEN 'official' ELSE 'test' END AS server_type, battleid, CASE WHEN rankstar <= 9 THEN '勇士' WHEN rankstar <= 21 THEN '精英' WHEN rankstar <= 37 THEN '大师' WHEN rankstar <= 62 THEN '宗师' WHEN rankstar <= 87 THEN '史诗' WHEN rankstar <= 112 AND minranklvl BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN '传奇' WHEN rankstar < 137 THEN '神话0-24星' WHEN rankstar < 162 THEN '神话25-49星' WHEN rankstar <= 212 THEN '神话50-100星' WHEN rankstar > 212 THEN '神话100星以上' ELSE 'none' END AS personal_rank_lvl /* 个人段位 */, CASE WHEN LEVEL BETWEEN 1 AND 8 THEN '1-8' WHEN LEVEL BETWEEN 9 AND 30 THEN '9-30' ELSE '30+' END AS personal_game_lvl, pvptype FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND fake_ai = 0), combo AS (SELECT rb.logymd, personal_rank_lvl, personal_game_lvl, pvptype, server_type, rb.SceneSelected, COUNT(DISTINCT rb.accountid, rb.zoneid, rb.battleid) AS nums, CASE WHEN SceneSelected RLIKE 'PVP_[0-9]+_' THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(SceneSelected, 'PVP_([0-9]+)_') WHEN SceneSelected RLIKE 'PVP_[0-9]+$' THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(SceneSelected, 'PVP_([0-9]+)$') ELSE NULL END AS scene_code, CASE WHEN SceneSelected LIKE '%_AS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_as, CASE WHEN SceneSelected LIKE '%high%' THEN 'high' WHEN SceneSelected LIKE '%extlow%' THEN 'extlow' WHEN SceneSelected LIKE '%low%' THEN 'low' ELSE 'NA' END AS strength_level, CASE WHEN SceneSelected LIKE '%add%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_add FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata AS rb JOIN require_player AS rp ON rp.accountid = rb.accountid AND rp.zoneid = rb.zoneid AND rb.battleid = rp.battleid JOIN (SELECT battleid, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS true_ucnt FROM require_player GROUP BY battleid HAVING true_ucnt = 10) AS true10 ON rb.battleid = true10.battleid /* 20251216由于battleenddata表ai会借真人accountid+zoneid上报，限制battle_end中10真人对局，需回溯到20251128 */ WHERE rb.logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY rb.logymd, rb.logymd, personal_rank_lvl, personal_game_lvl, pvptype, server_type, rb.SceneSelected, rb.SceneSelected) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.zibo_hong_map_use_condition_v4 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT server_type, personal_rank_lvl, personal_game_lvl, pvptype, sceneselected, nums, scene_code, has_as, strength_level, is_add FROM combo WHERE nums > 100
