String COMMENT '日期,yyyy-MM-dd') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ WITH create_info /* AND     mod(zoneid, 10000) <= 8000 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, m__did AS did, ip, logymd AS register_date, FROM_UNIXTIME(m__server_time / 1000 - 8 * 3600) AS register_time /* m__server_time 是时间戳类型: Leap FROM_UNIXTIME 函数是UTC-0, 需要转UTC-8 */, country AS createrole_country, create_channel, m__os AS os_type, 'create' AS create_type_name, 1 AS create_type, m__server_time FROM nova_ob_ods.create_role WHERE logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND logymd = '2026-05-31'), login_info /* --login */ /* AND     mod(zoneid, 10000) <= 8000 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ip, m__did AS did, SUBSTRING(usercreatetime, 0, 10) AS register_date, usercreatetime AS register_time, country AS createrole_country, create_channel, m__os AS os_type, 'login' AS create_type_name, 2 AS create_type, m__server_time FROM nova_ob_ods.login WHERE logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND logymd = '2026-05-31'), charge_info /* charge */ /* AND     mod(zoneid, 10000) <= 8000 */ AS (SELECT roleid AS roleid, zoneid AS zoneid, ip, m__did AS did, SUBSTRING(usercreatetime, 0, 10) AS register_date, usercreatetime AS register_time, createrole_country AS createrole_country, create_channel, m__os AS os_type, 'charge' AS create_type_name, 3 AS create_type, m__server_time FROM nova_ob_ods.charge WHERE logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND logymd = '2026-05-31'), result_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ip AS register_ip, LOWER(os_type) AS register_os, did AS register_did, register_time AS register_time, register_date AS register_date, create_channel AS register_channel, create_type_name AS register_source, LOWER(createrole_country) AS register_country FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_type_name, ip, os_type, did, register_time, register_date, create_channel, createrole_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY create_type, m__server_time, zoneid) AS rn FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, register_time, createrole_country, os_type, create_channel, did, ip, 'create' AS create_type_name, 1 AS create_type, m__server_time FROM create_info UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, register_time, createrole_country, os_type, create_channel, did, ip, 'login' AS create_type_name, 2 AS create_type, m__server_time FROM login_info UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, register_time, createrole_country, os_type, create_channel, did, ip, 'charge' AS create_type_name, 3 AS create_type, m__server_time FROM charge_info) AS t0) AS t1 WHERE rn = 1), basic_yd AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_ip, LOWER(register_os) AS register_os, register_did, register_time, register_date, register_channel, register_source, LOWER(register_country) AS register_country, is_cur_bot, is_init_bot, is_acc_cur_bot, is_acc_init_bot FROM mt_dim.dim_nova_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), bot_info AS (SELECT creates.roleid, creates.zoneid, MAX(IF(money_RMB > 0, 0, IF((ip_role_num >= 30 AND d.ip IS NULL) OR did_role_num >= 10, 1, 0))) AS is_cur_bot FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, m__did, ip, FROM_UNIXTIME(m__server_time / 1000 - 8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS register_date, country, create_channel, m__os AS os_type, COUNT(IF(TRIM(COALESCE(ip, '')) <> '', roleid, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY ip) AS ip_role_num, COUNT(IF(TRIM(COALESCE(m__did, '')) <> '', roleid, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY m__did) AS did_role_num FROM nova_ob_ods.create_role WHERE logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31') AS creates LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money / 100) AS money_RMB, 1 AS charge_role, COUNT(1) AS charge_num FROM nova_ob_ods.charge WHERE logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' /* AND     mod(zoneid, 10000) <= 8000 */ GROUP BY `roleid`, `zoneid`) AS c ON creates.roleid = c.roleid AND creates.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(white_ip) AS ip FROM mt_dim.dim_nova_white_list_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS d ON creates.ip = d.ip GROUP BY creates.roleid, creates.zoneid), acc_bot_info AS (SELECT creates.roleid, IF(SUM(money_RMB) > 0, 0, MAX(IF((ip_role_num >= 30 AND d.ip IS NULL) OR did_role_num >= 10, 1, 0))) AS is_acc_cur_bot FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, m__did, ip, FROM_UNIXTIME(m__server_time / 1000 - 8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS usercreateymd, country, create_channel, m__os AS os_type, COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY ip) AS ip_role_num, COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY m__did) AS did_role_num FROM nova_ob_ods.create_role WHERE logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31') AS creates LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money / 100) AS money_RMB, 1 AS charge_role, COUNT(1) AS charge_num FROM nova_ob_ods.charge WHERE logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' /* AND     FROM_UNIXTIME(m__server_time / 1000 -8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= '2026-05-31' */ GROUP BY `roleid`, `zoneid`) AS c ON creates.roleid = c.roleid AND creates.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(white_ip) AS ip FROM mt_dim.dim_nova_white_list_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS d ON creates.ip = d.ip GROUP BY creates.roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_nova_basic_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, register_ip, register_os, register_did, register_time, register_date, resiter_channel, register_source, register_country, COALESCE(t0.is_init_bot, t1.is_cur_bot) AS is_init_bot, COALESCE(t1.is_cur_bot, t0.is_cur_bot) AS is_cur_bot, FIRST_VALUE(COALESCE(t0.is_acc_init_bot, t2.is_acc_cur_bot, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.roleid ORDER BY register_time) AS is_acc_init_bot, IF(FIRST_VALUE(COALESCE(t0.is_acc_init_bot, t2.is_acc_cur_bot, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.roleid ORDER BY register_time) = 0, 0, COALESCE(t2.is_acc_cur_bot, t0.is_acc_cur_bot, 0)) AS is_acc_cur_bot FROM (SELECT COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(df.register_ip, di.register_ip, 'unknown') AS register_ip, COALESCE(df.register_os, di.register_os, 'unknown') AS register_os, COALESCE(df.register_did, di.register_did, 'unknown') AS register_did, COALESCE(df.register_time, di.register_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS register_time, COALESCE(df.register_date, di.register_date, '1970-01-01') AS register_date, COALESCE(df.register_channel, di.register_channel, 'unknown') AS resiter_channel, COALESCE(df.register_source, di.register_source, 'unknown') AS register_source, COALESCE(df.register_country, di.register_country, 'unknown') AS register_country, df.is_cur_bot AS is_cur_bot, df.is_init_bot AS is_init_bot, df.is_acc_cur_bot, df.is_acc_init_bot FROM (SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.register_ip, t0.register_os, t0.register_did, t0.register_time, t0.register_date, t0.register_channel, t0.register_source, t0.register_country FROM result_info AS t0) AS di FULL JOIN basic_yd AS df ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid) AS t0 LEFT JOIN bot_info AS t1 sql_units: /* CREATE TABLE `msdk_dwd`.`dwd_msdk_adjust_di_test`( */ /*     `server_time` string COMMENT '日志时间，回调接口收到归因数据时间', */ /*     `event_time` bigint COMMENT '事件发生时间', */ /*     `event_source` string COMMENT '事件来源', */ /*     `reporter_ip` string COMMENT '上报IP', */ /*     `msdk_store` string COMMENT 'msdk的商店', */ /*     `msdk_environment` string COMMENT 'msdk的环境', */ /*     `package_name` string COMMENT 'msdk包名', */ /*     `country_code` string COMMENT '国家代码', */ /*     `platform` string COMMENT '设备系统', */ /*     `media_source` string COMMENT '获得归因的媒体渠道', */ /*     `android_id` string COMMENT 'android唯一ID', */ /*     `gps_adid` string COMMENT '用户可重置的设备ID,又称GAID', */ /*     `idfa` string COMMENT 'IOS设备上的可重置广告ID', */ /*     `idfv` string COMMENT 'IOS提供的应用开发者标识符', */ /*     `adjust_id` string COMMENT '用户在其设备上安装应用时，由SDK生成的非重ID', */ /*     `oaid` string COMMENT '一些安卓设备上的用户可重置ID，通常作为GAID的替代', */ /*     `campaign_name` string COMMENT '广告系列名称', */ /*     `campaign_id` string COMMENT '广告系列id', */ /*     `adgroup_name` string COMMENT 'adgroup name', */ /*     `adgroup_id` string COMMENT 'adgroup id', */ /*     `others` string COMMENT 'JOSN字符串', */ /*     `event_name` string COMMENT '事件名称', */ /*     `os_name` string COMMENT '系统名称', */ /*     `creative_name` string COMMENT '-', */ /*     `creative_id` string COMMENT '-' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', */ /*     `msdk_app_id` string COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key' */ /* ) stored as parquet location 's3a://moonton-msdk/dwd/dwd_msdk_adjust_di' */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwd.dwd_msdk_adjust_di_test PARTITION(logymd, msdk_app_id) SELECT server_time, event_time, event_source, reporter_ip, msdk_store, msdk_environment, package_name, country_code, platform, media_source, IF(android_id IN ('', '0000000000000000'), NULL, android_id) AS android_id, IF(gps_adid IN ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', '0000-0000', 'none', '00000000-4000-8000-0000-000000000000'), NULL, gps_adid) AS gps_adid, IF(idfa IN ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', ''), NULL, idfa) AS idfa, IF(idfv IN (''), NULL, idfv) AS idfv, adjust_id, oaid, IF(campaign_name = '', NULL, campaign_name) AS campaign_name, IF(campaign_id = '', NULL, campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(adgroup_name = '', NULL, adgroup_name) AS adgroup_name, IF(adgroup_id = '', NULL, adgroup_id) AS adgroup_id, others, event_name, os_name, IF(LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name, NULL) AS creative_name, IF(LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id, NULL) AS creative_id, IF(LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name, NULL) AS fb_campaign_name, IF(LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id, NULL) AS fb_campaign_id, IF(LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', fb_install_referrer_campaign_name, NULL) AS fb_adgroup_name, IF(LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', fb_install_referrer_campaign_id, NULL) AS fb_adgroup_id, IF(fb_install_referrer = '', NULL, fb_install_referrer) AS fb_install_referrer, msdk_did, logymd, msdk_app_id FROM (SELECT msdk_server_time AS server_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.created_at') AS event_time, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.is_s2s') = '0', 'SDK', 'S2S') AS event_source, msdk_reporter_ip AS reporter_ip, msdk_store, msdk_environment, msdk_package_name AS package_name, network_name AS media_source, IF(creative_name RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', creative_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(creative_name, '(.*?)\\\\((.*?)\\\\)'))) AS creative_name, IF(creative_name RLIKE '^\\\\d+$', creative_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(creative_name, '(.*?)\\\\((.*?)\\\\)', 2))) AS creative_id, LOWER(country) AS country_code, LOWER(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.platform')) AS platform, android_id, gps_adid, idfa, idfv, IF(campaign_name RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', campaign_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\((.*?)\\\\)'))) AS campaign_name, IF(campaign_name RLIKE '^\\\\d+$' OR campaign_name RLIKE '^[a-z0-9]{32}$', campaign_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(campaign_name, '(.*?)\\\\((.*?)\\\\)', 2))) AS campaign_id, IF(adgroup_name RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', adgroup_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(adgroup_name, '(.*?)\\\\((.*?)\\\\)'))) AS adgroup_name, IF(adgroup_name RLIKE '^[0-9]+$', adgroup_name, TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(adgroup_name, '(.*?)\\\\((.*?)\\\\)', 2))) AS adgroup_id, adjust_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.oaid') AS oaid /* 测试数据木有,但是文档上有 */, others, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.event_name') AS event_name, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, msdk_app_id, os_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer') AS fb_install_referrer, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_id') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_name') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id') AS fb_install_referrer_campaign_group_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name') AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id') AS fb_install_referrer_adgroup_id, msdk_did, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msdk_message_md5 ORDER BY GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.created_at') ASC) AS rn FROM msdk_ods.msdk_adjust WHERE logymd = '20260531') WHERE rn = 1 DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: 好友点赞
sql_units: /* 好友点赞 */ WITH social_like AS (SELECT logymd, zoneid, roleid, other_roleid, other_zoneid, total_like, is_friend, intimacy_num, intimacy_type, master_type, create_role_time, login_days, gender, rank_level, level FROM (SELECT logymd, zoneid, roleid, other_roleid, other_zoneid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, roleid, other_roleid, other_zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn, total_like, is_friend, intimacy_num, intimacy_type, master_type, create_role_time, login_days, gender, rank_level, level FROM ml_ods.socialserver_social_like_role WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31') AS a WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.ml_social_features_social_like PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.zoneid, a.roleid, a.other_roleid, a.other_zoneid, b.total_like, b.is_friend, b.intimacy_num, b.intimacy_type, b.master_type, b.create_role_time, b.login_days, b.gender, b.rank_level, b.level, a.total_like, a.is_friend, a.intimacy_num, a.intimacy_type, a.master_type, a.create_role_time, a.login_days, a.gender, a.rank_level, a.level FROM social_like AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT zoneid, roleid, other_roleid, other_zoneid, total_like, is_friend, intimacy_num, intimacy_type, master_type, create_role_time, login_days, gender, rank_level, level FROM social_like WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.other_roleid = b.other_roleid AND a.other_zoneid = b.other_zoneid

roomleader), socialbehavior_30d /* 天维度数据进行聚合 */ AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, roomleader, SUM(likenum) AS likenum, SUM(belikednum) AS belikednum, SUM(reportnum) AS reportnum, SUM(bereportednum) AS bereportednum, SUM(playagain) AS playagain, SUM(joinplayagain) AS joinplayagain, SUM(islike1) AS islike1, SUM(beliked1) AS beliked1, SUM(dislike1) AS dislike1, SUM(bedisliked1) AS bedisliked1, likenum_sum_7d, SUM(belikednum) AS belikednum_sum_7d, SUM(reportnum) AS reportnum_sum_7d, SUM(bereportednum) AS bereportednum_sum_7d, SUM(playagain) AS playagain_sum_7d, SUM(joinplayagain) AS joinplayagain_sum_7d, SUM(islike1) AS islike1_sum_7d, SUM(beliked1) AS beliked1_sum_7d, SUM(dislike1) AS dislike1_sum_7d, SUM(bedisliked1) AS bedisliked1_sum_7d, SUM(report1) AS report1_sum_7d, `mt_ai`.`ml_social_features_client_battleend` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.zoneid, a.accountid, a.roomleader, COALESCE(likenum_sum_7d, 0), COALESCE(belikednum_sum_7d, 0), COALESCE(reportnum_sum_7d, 0), COALESCE(bereportednum_sum_7d, 0), COALESCE(playagain_sum_7d, 0), COALESCE(joinplayagain_sum_7d, 0), COALESCE(islike1_sum_7d, 0), COALESCE(beliked1_sum_7d, 0), name: etl.mt_dim.dim_third_party_mpass_account_df
sql_units: /* 拿到所有的mt_id */ WITH accountserver_account_bind AS (SELECT accountid, account_name, mt_id, pre_mt_id, appid, email, name, TIME FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_bind WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT mt_id IS NULL AND mt_id <> 0), accountserver_account_bind_tmp AS (/* 剔除解绑的 */ SELECT t1.accountid, t1.account_name, t1.email, t1.name FROM (SELECT accountid, account_name, email, name, time FROM (SELECT accountid, account_name, mt_id, pre_mt_id, appid, email, name, time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, account_name ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_bind WHERE logymd < '2025-03-19') AS t1 WHERE rn = 1) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT time, accountid, account_name, email, name FROM (SELECT accountid, account_name, mt_id, pre_mt_id, appid, email, name, time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, account_name ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_unbind WHERE logymd < '2025-03-19') AS t1 WHERE rn = 1) AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.accountid AND t1.account_name = t2.account_name WHERE (t1.time > t2.time OR t2.accountid IS NULL)), roleserver_mt_pass_on_bind AS (SELECT TIME, app_id, app_zone_id, app_role_id, accountid, pre_accountid FROM mtpass_ods.roleserver_mt_pass_on_bind WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND NOT accountid IS NULL AND accountid <> 0), his_data /* 取历史分区数据 */ AS (SELECT mt_id, pre_mt_id, bind_mt_name, bind_mt_phone, bind_mt_email, bind_fb_id, bind_fb_email, bind_fb_name, bind_gg_id, bind_gg_email, bind_gg_name, bind_gc_id, bind_gc_name, bind_apple_id, bind_apple_email, bind_apple_name, bind_tiktok_id, bind_tiktok_name, bind_vk_id, bind_vk_name, bind_wa_id, bind_wa_name, bind_tg_id, bind_tg_name, bind_mlbb_roleid, bind_mcgg_roleid, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_third_party_mpass_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), whole_mt_id /* 整个mt_id */ AS (SELECT mt_id, MAX(pre_mt_id) AS pre_mt_id FROM (SELECT mt_id, pre_mt_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mt_id ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT accountid AS mt_id, pre_accountid AS pre_mt_id, time FROM roleserver_mt_pass_on_bind WHERE NOT accountid IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT mt_id, pre_mt_id, time FROM accountserver_account_bind WHERE NOT mt_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT accountid AS mt_id, NULL AS pre_mt_id, time FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_create_account WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31') AS t1) AS t2 WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY mt_id), merge_now_his /* 新旧数据合并 */ AS (SELECT COALESCE(hd.mt_id, wm.mt_id) AS mt_id, GREATEST(COALESCE(wm.pre_mt_id, 0), COALESCE(hd.pre_mt_id, 0)) AS pre_mt_id, hd.bind_mt_name, hd.bind_mt_phone, hd.bind_mt_email, hd.bind_fb_id, hd.bind_fb_email, hd.bind_fb_name, hd.bind_gg_id, hd.bind_gg_email, hd.bind_gg_name, hd.bind_gc_id, hd.bind_gc_name, hd.bind_apple_id, hd.bind_apple_email, hd.bind_apple_name, hd.bind_tiktok_id AS bind_tt_id, hd.bind_tiktok_name AS bind_tt_name, hd.bind_vk_id, hd.bind_vk_name, hd.bind_wa_id, hd.bind_wa_name, hd.bind_tg_id, hd.bind_tg_name, hd.bind_mlbb_roleid AS bind_mlbb_role, hd.bind_mcgg_roleid AS bind_mc_role FROM his_data AS hd FULL JOIN whole_mt_id AS wm ON hd.mt_id = wm.mt_id), mt_account_name /* mt账号绑定和解绑 */ AS (SELECT accountid AS mt_id, account_name FROM (SELECT accountid, account_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT TIME, accountid, account_name, 1 AS flag FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_create_account WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT TIME, account_name, accountid, 2 AS flag FROM mtpass_ods.mtaccountserver_account_create_account WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t1) AS t2 WHERE rn = 1 AND NOT accountid IS NULL AND NOT account_name IS NULL), bind_mt_phone /* 电话绑定和解绑 */ AS (SELECT accountid, account_phone FROM (SELECT accountid, account_phone, src, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT TIME, accountid, account_phone, 'bind' AS src FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_bind_phone WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT accountid IS NULL AND account_phone <> '' UNION ALL SELECT TIME, accountid, new_phone AS account_phone, 'rebind' AS src FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_rebind_phone WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT accountid IS NULL AND new_phone <> '' UNION ALL SELECT TIME, accountid, account_phone, 'unbind' AS src FROM ml_ods.mtaccountserver_account_unbind_phone WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT accountid IS NULL AND account_phone <> '') AS t1) AS t2 WHERE rn = 1 AND src <> 'unbind' AND account_phone <> '' AND NOT account_phone IS NULL), bind_mt_email AS (SELECT accountid, email FROM (SELECT accountid, email, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT TIME, accountid, email name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_realtime_online_timezone_nova
sql_units: /* ALTER table `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_online` */ /*     drop IF EXISTS PARTITION (logymd='2026-05-31',appname='nova',granularity_type='account', date_type='timezone'); */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_online` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'nova', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'timezone') SELECT LEAST(287, (HOUR(`div_time`) * 3600 + MINUTE(`div_time`) * 60 + SECOND(`div_time`)) DIV 300) AS point, country, '' AS network, 'country' AS grouping_name, SUM(online_num) AS online_num FROM (SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(revise_server_time AS BIGINT) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time, country, os_type, online_num, SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(revise_server_time AS BIGINT) DIV 300 * 300), 1, 10) AS logymd FROM (SELECT zone_id, `time`, SUBSTRING(`time`, 1, 10) AS dt, m__event_time, m__server_time, online_num, os_type, CASE WHEN (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999) AND LOWER(country) IN ('hk', 'id', 'jp', 'kh', 'kr', 'mm', 'mo', 'my', 'ph', 'sg', 'th', 'tw', 'vn') THEN LOWER(country) WHEN (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999) THEN 'apac_unknown' WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 AND LOWER(country) IN ('us') THEN LOWER(country) WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 THEN 'us_unknown' WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 AND LOWER(country) IN ('de', 'es', 'fr', 'gb', 'it', 'pt') THEN LOWER(country) WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 THEN 'eu_unknown' END AS country, CASE WHEN (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999) THEN m__event_time / 1000 + 9 * 3600 ELSE m__event_time / 1000 - 8 * 3600 END AS revise_server_time, CASE WHEN (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999) THEN '+9' ELSE '-8' END AS timezone, m__zone_offset FROM nova_ob_ods.t_real_os_online WHERE logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' AND (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 /* 亚太 */ OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 /* 亚太   */ OR zone_id BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 /* 欧洲 */ OR zone_id BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 /* 美国 */)) AS t1 WHERE SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(revise_server_time AS BIGINT) DIV 300 * 300), 1, 10) = '2026-05-31') AS t2 GROUP BY LEAST(287, (HOUR(`div_time`) * 3600 + MINUTE(`div_time`) * 60 + SECOND(`div_time`)) DIV 300), country

name: jaxzhong_新手引导漏斗
sql_units: WITH register_user /* 核心主表：单roleid粒度（无重复） */ AS (SELECT roleid AS accountid, MIN(register_date) AS register_date, MIN_BY(zoneid, register_time) AS zoneid, MIN_BY(first_mt_country, register_time) AS create_country, MIN_BY(his_first_loginclient_version, register_time) AS clientversion, MIN_BY(create_ip, register_time) AS ip, MIN_BY(create_channel, register_time) AS channel, MIN_BY(create_device, register_time) AS device, MIN_BY(his_first_deviceid, register_time) AS deviceid, MIN_BY(create_os, register_time) AS os_type, MIN_BY(first_network_name, register_time) AS first_network_name, MIN_BY(last_network_name, register_time) AS last_network_name, MIN_BY(new_type, register_time) AS new_type, MIN_BY(adjust_campaign_name, register_time) AS adjust_campaign_name, MIN_BY(adjust_adset_name, register_time) AS adjust_adset_name, MIN_BY(adjust_creative_name, register_time) AS adjust_creative_name, MIN_BY(game_channel, register_time) AS game_channel, MIN_BY(data_source, register_time) AS data_source FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND register_date = logymd AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1 GROUP BY roleid), e1 /* 新手引导步骤 */ AS (SELECT a.accountid AS roleid, a.zoneid, a.stepid, a.sub_stepid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_newbie_guide AS a JOIN register_user AS t ON a.accountid = t.accountid AND a.zoneid = t.zoneid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND DATEDIFF(t.register_date, a.logymd) = 0 AND a.stepid IN (10999, 16999, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 1000, 1001, 1002, 1003) AND a.sub_stepid <> 0 GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.stepid, a.sub_stepid), bd /* 战斗数据 */ AS (SELECT bd.accountid AS roleid, bd.zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT bd.battleid) AS battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bd.battletype = 2 THEN bd.battleid END) AS pvp2_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata AS bd JOIN register_user AS t ON bd.accountid = t.accountid AND bd.zoneid = t.zoneid WHERE bd.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND DATEDIFF(t.register_date, bd.logymd) = 0 GROUP BY bd.accountid, bd.zoneid), jx /* 画质配置 */ AS (SELECT jx.accountid AS roleid, jx.zoneid, MIN_BY(COALESCE(realpicturequality, 0), jx.time) AS realpicturequality FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_configuration AS jx JOIN register_user AS t ON jx.accountid = t.accountid AND jx.zoneid = t.zoneid WHERE jx.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND DATEDIFF(t.register_date, jx.logymd) = 0 GROUP BY jx.accountid, jx.zoneid), th /* 新手选英雄 */ AS (SELECT p.accountid AS roleid, p.zoneid, MAX(p.heroid + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`) * 100000000) % 100000000 AS heroid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_latinnewpickhero AS p JOIN register_user AS t ON p.accountid = t.accountid AND p.zoneid = t.zoneid WHERE p.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND DATEDIFF(t.register_date, p.logymd) = 0 AND clickbutton_type = 1 GROUP BY p.accountid, p.zoneid), w /* 温暖关 */ AS (SELECT a.accountid AS roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN a.guidetype = 3 THEN '第一关' WHEN a.guidetype = 1 THEN '第二关' WHEN a.guidetype = 2 THEN '第三关' END AS guidetype_new, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.guidetype ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_warmbattle AS a JOIN register_user AS t ON a.accountid = t.accountid AND a.zoneid = t.zoneid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND DATEDIFF(t.register_date, a.logymd) = 0 AND a.guidetype IN (1, 2, 3)), w1 AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, guidetype_new FROM w WHERE rn = 1), new_label /* 集群标签 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(usercreateymd) AS usercreateymd, MAX(first_battle_info_new) AS first_battle_info_new, MAX(label_1_get_days) AS label_1_get_days, MAX(label_1_new) AS label_1_new, MAX(first_rank_info_new) AS first_rank_info_new, MAX(label_2_get_days) AS label_2_get_days, MAX(label_2_rank) AS label_2_rank, MAX(first_master_info_new) AS first_master_info_new, MAX(label_3_get_days) AS label_3_get_days, MAX(label_3_master) AS label_3_master, MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM ml_temp.new_cluster_label_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), dm_jax_newbie_di /* 新手看板标签 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(register_date) AS register_date, MAX(newbie_1_heroid) AS newbie_1_heroid, MAX(newbie_tag) AS newbie_tag, MAX(tot_bt_cnt) AS tot_bt_cnt, MAX(level) AS level, MAX(bigranklvl) AS bigranklvl, MAX(his_ol_dur) AS his_ol_dur, MAX(IF(roleid % 2 = 0, '偶数', '奇数')) AS is_odd FROM (SELECT *, IF(NOT single_first_heroid IS NULL OR NOT pvp_12_cnt IS NULL, 3, CEIL(COALESCE(newbie_1_heroid, 0) / 100000) + CEIL(COALESCE(newbie_2_heroid, 0) / 100000) + CEIL(COALESCE(newbie_3_heroid, 0) / 100000)) + COALESCE(single_battle_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(pvp_12_cnt, 0) AS tot_bt_cnt FROM ml_temp.dm_jax_newbie_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) AS a GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), outtable /* 最终聚合：仅按 roleid+zoneid 分组，其余全MAX() 防重复 */ AS (SELECT r.accountid /* 唯一主键：不聚合 */, r.zoneid, MAX(FLOOR(r.zoneid / 1000)) AS zone_id /* 所有非主键字段：全部 MAX() 聚合 */, MAX(r.register_date) AS register_date, MAX(r.create_country) AS create_country, MAX(r.clientversion) AS clientversion, MAX(r.ip) AS ip, MAX(r.channel) AS channel, MAX(r.device) AS device, MAX(r.deviceid) AS deviceid, MAX(r.os_type) AS os_type, MAX(r.first_network_name) AS first_network_name, MAX(r.last_network_name) AS last_network_name, MAX(r.new_type) AS new_type, MAX(r.adjust_campaign_name) AS adjust_campaign_name, MAX(r.adjust_adset_name) AS adjust_adset_name, MAX(r.adjust_creative_name) AS adjust_creative_name, MAX(r.game_channel) AS game_channel, MAX(r.data_source) AS data_source, MAX(COALESCE(jx.realpicturequality, 0)) AS realpicturequality, MAX(COALESCE(th.heroid, 0)) AS heroid, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 10999 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS name_start /* 新手引导步骤：MAX(1/0) → 1代表完成，自动去重 */, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 10999 AND e1.sub_stepid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS name_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 16999 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS hero_pick_start, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 16999 AND e1.sub_stepid = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS hero_pick_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 10999 AND e1.sub_stepid = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS tutorial1_load_start, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 10999 AND e1.sub_stepid = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS tutorial1_load_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN w1.guidetype_new = '第一关' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm1_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS transition12_start, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2 AND e1.sub_stepid = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS transition12_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 3 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS tutorial2_start, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN w1.guidetype_new = '第二关' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS tutorial2_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 4 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS level_unlock, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 4 AND e1.sub_stepid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS level_click_entry, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 4 AND e1.sub_stepid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS level_auto_start, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 4 AND e1.sub_stepid = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS level_close_tips, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 4 AND e1.sub_stepid = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS get_hero_reward, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 4 AND e1.sub_stepid = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS close_hero_ui, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 6 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS tutorial3_start, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN w1.guidetype_new = '第三关' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS tutorial3_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 1000 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm4_start, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 1000 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm4_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 1001 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm5_start, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 1001 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm5_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 1002 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm6_start, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 1002 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm6_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 1003 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm7_start, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 1003 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm7_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(bd.battle_cnt, 0) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm8_end /* 战斗达标标记 */, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(bd.battle_cnt, 0) >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm9_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(bd.pvp2_cnt, 0) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm10_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(bd.battle_cnt, 0) >= 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm11_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(bd.battle_cnt, 0) >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm12_end, MAX(COALESCE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(bd.battle_cnt, 0) >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS warm13_end, MAX(COALESCE(l.usercreateymd, '')) AS usercreateymd /* 集群标签 */, MAX(COALESCE(l.first_battle_info_new, '')) AS first_battle_info_new, MAX(COALESCE(l.label_1_get_days, 0)) AS label_1_get_days, MAX(COALESCE(l.label_1_new, '')) AS label_1_new, MAX(COALESCE(l.first_rank_info_new, '')) AS first_rank_info_new, MAX(COALESCE(l.label_2_get_days, 0)) AS label_2_get_days, MAX(COALESCE(l.label_2_rank, '')) AS label_2_rank, MAX(COALESCE(l.first_master_info_new, '')) AS first_master_info_new, MAX(COALESCE(l.label_3_get_days, 0)) AS label_3_get_days, MAX(COALESCE(l.label_3_master, '')) AS label_3_master, MAX(COALESCE(j.newbie_1_heroid, 0)) AS newbie_1_heroid /* 新手看板标签 */, MAX(COALESCE(j.newbie_tag, '')) AS newbie_tag, MAX(COALESCE(j.tot_bt_cnt, 0)) AS tot_bt_cnt, MAX(COALESCE(j.level, 0)) AS level, MAX(COALESCE(j.bigranklvl, 0)) AS bigranklvl, MAX(COALESCE(j.his_ol_dur, 0)) AS his_ol_dur, MAX(COALESCE(j.is_odd, '')) AS is_odd FROM register_user AS r LEFT JOIN e1 ON e1.roleid = r.accountid AND e1.zoneid = r.zoneid LEFT JOIN bd ON bd.roleid = r.accountid AND bd.zoneid = r.zoneid LEFT JOIN jx ON jx.roleid = r.accountid AND jx.zoneid = r.zoneid LEFT JOIN th ON th.roleid = r.accountid AND name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di_nova_account_timezone_sub_add_9
sql_units: WITH real_country_online AS (SELECT 'nova' AS appname, 4400 AS app_id, 'nova' AS stagename, FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(revise_server_time AS BIGINT) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time, country, os_type, online_num, SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(revise_server_time AS BIGINT) DIV 300 * 300), 1, 10) AS logymd FROM (SELECT zone_id, `time`, SUBSTRING(`time`, 1, 10) AS dt, m__event_time, m__server_time, online_num, os_type, CASE WHEN (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999) AND LOWER(country) IN ('hk', 'id', 'jp', 'kh', 'kr', 'mm', 'mo', 'my', 'ph', 'sg', 'th', 'tw', 'vn') THEN LOWER(country) WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 THEN 'apac_unknown' END AS country /* --美国 */ /* WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 AND lower(country) IN ('us') THEN lower(country) */ /* WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 THEN 'us_unknown' */ /* --欧洲 */ /* WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 AND lower(country) IN ('de', 'es', 'fr', 'gb', 'it', 'pt') THEN lower(country) */ /* WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 THEN 'eu_unknown' */, CASE WHEN (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999) THEN m__event_time / 1000 + 9 * 3600 END AS revise_server_time /* ELSE m__event_time / 1000 - 8 * 3600 */, CASE WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 THEN '+9' ELSE '-8' END AS timezone, m__zone_offset FROM nova_ob_ods.t_real_os_online WHERE logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' AND (zone_id BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 /* 亚太 */ OR zone_id BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 /* 亚太 sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_ygao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-08-28 17:49:27.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 6.好友陌生人开黑 */ WITH active AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), abtest_list AS (SELECT param_name, SUBSTRING(begin_time, 0, 10) AS begin_date, SUBSTRING(end_time, 0, 10) AS end_date FROM mt_dim.dim_abtest_list WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND param_name LIKE '%_social_recommend_v%'), group_tag AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, IF(old_zoneid < 57000, 'prod', 'test') AS env, logymd AS enter_date, a.param_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(param_value, '$.group_tag') AS group_tag, param_version FROM ml_ods.abtestserver_abtest_tag AS a JOIN abtest_list AS b ON a.param_name = b.param_name WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-30' AND '2026-05-31' AND a.logymd BETWEEN b.begin_date AND b.end_date UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, 'test' AS env, '2026-05-31' AS enter_date, 'test' AS param_name, 'test' AS group_tag, 'test' AS param_version FROM active WHERE zoneid >= 57000), active_user AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, env, enter_date, param_name, group_tag, param_version, IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_active, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(a.roleid, '-', a.zoneid)) FROM group_tag AS a LEFT JOIN active AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, env, enter_date, param_name, group_tag, param_version, is_active), battle AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(IF(blacknum > 1, 1, 0)) AS black_cnt, COUNT(1) AS battle_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, logymd), battle_with_friend AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS friend_black_cnt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_battle_with_friend WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.friend_stranger_black_battle_gaoy PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT env, param_name, group_tag, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(b.roleid, '-', b.zoneid)) AS battle_role_cnt /* 以下为人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(black_cnt > 0, CONCAT(b.roleid, '-', b.zoneid), NULL)) AS black_role_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(friend_black_cnt > 0, CONCAT(b.roleid, '-', b.zoneid), NULL)) AS friend_black_role_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(black_cnt > friend_black_cnt, CONCAT(b.roleid, '-', b.zoneid), NULL)) AS stranger_black_role_cnt /* 开黑次数大于与好友开黑次数，存在与陌生人开黑 */, SUM(battle_cnt) AS battle_cnt /* 以下为场次 */, SUM(black_cnt) AS black_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(friend_black_cnt, 0)) AS friend_black_cnt FROM active_user AS a LEFT JOIN battle AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle_with_friend AS c ON b.roleid = c.roleid AND b.zoneid = c.zoneid GROUP BY env, param_name, group_tag

is_other_change, */ /* nvl(s3.is_redownload,0) as is_redownload, */ /* nvl(s3.is_reinstall,0) as is_reinstall, */ /* nvl(s3.is_client_ver_change,0) as is_client_ver_change, */, CASE WHEN s7.downloadprocess IS NULL THEN '版更前一周未活跃' WHEN s7.downloadprocess = 1 THEN '版更前一周增量完成' WHEN s7.downloadprocess = 0 THEN '版更前一周增量未完成' END AS last_version_incre, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 < 0 THEN 'v00-异常数据' WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN 'v01-0-10min' WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 BETWEEN 10 AND 20 THEN 'v02-10-20min' WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN 'v03-20-30min' WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 BETWEEN 30 AND 60 THEN 'v04-30-60min' WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 BETWEEN 60 AND 90 THEN 'v05-60-90min' WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 > 90 THEN 'v06-90+min' END AS main_duration_type, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 0 THEN '0' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 1 THEN '1' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 2 THEN '2' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 3 THEN '3' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 4 THEN '4' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 5 THEN '5' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 6 THEN '6' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) >= 7 THEN '7+' END AS join_n, DATEDIFF(s1.logymd, s5.formal_start_date) AS version_n /* -当前是版本的第几天 */, COUNT(s1.accountid) AS dau, SUM(s1.finish_download_login) AS finish_download_login /* -登录表，全服,增量完成 */, SUM(s1.finish_download_login_formal) AS finish_download_login_formal /* -登录表，正式服，增量完成 */, SUM(s1.finish_download) AS finish_download /* -20M下载表，全服，增量完成 */, SUM(s1.finish_download_formal) AS finish_download_formal /* -20M下载表，正式服，增量完成 */, SUM(CASE WHEN s1.finish_download_login = 1 OR s1.finish_download = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_incre_finish /* --全服是否增量完成，补齐逻辑 */, SUM(CASE WHEN s1.finish_download_login = 1 OR s1.finish_download = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_incre_finish_formal /* -正式服是否增量完成，补齐逻辑 */, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT s8.deviceid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_client_ver_change_dau, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT s9.deviceid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_reinstall_dau, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT s10.deviceid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_redownload_dau FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, MIN_BY(day_first_deviceid, time) AS day_first_deviceid, MIN_BY(UPPER(ip_country), time) AS ip_country, MIN_BY(finish_download_login, time) AS finish_download_login, MIN_BY(finish_download_login_formal, time) AS finish_download_login_formal, MIN_BY(finish_download, time) AS finish_download, MIN_BY(finish_download_formal, time) AS finish_download_formal, MIN_BY(gradingid, time) AS gradingid, MIN_BY(noresnum, time) AS noresnum, MIN_BY(noresself, time) AS noresself, MIN_BY(nores_battlenum, time) AS nores_battlenum, MIN_BY(gamepackagesize, time) AS gamepackagesize, MIN_BY(gamepackagesize_type, time) AS gamepackagesize_type FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_device_label_group_channel_s3a_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, accountid) AS s1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid AS accountid, MIN_BY(usercreateymd, time) AS register_date, MIN_BY(zoneid, time) AS zone_id, MIN_BY(client_ver, time) AS first_client_ver, MIN_BY(loss_day, time) AS first_lossdays, MIN_BY(os_type, time) AS os_type, MIN_BY(channel, time) AS channel FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, roleid) AS s2 ON s1.accountid = s2.accountid AND s1.logymd = s2.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.deviceid FROM (SELECT version, MIN(start_date) AS start_date, MIN(end_date) AS end_date, MIN(start_datetime) AS start_datetime, MIN(end_datetime) AS end_datetime, MAX(1) AS sup FROM ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-31' AND start_date BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-31' /* -取今天跑数日期往前推14天内，看是否有开放增量预下载信息，如果有则有数据，如果没有则没数据，下面join后也肯定诶数据。 */ /* 不用担心取14天，因为大版更需要3个月，资源更新也得1个半月，不会取到两个版本信息。version */ GROUP BY version /* 一个version就一行数据，标记这个版本的预下载开放时间和结束时间，前提是预下载开放日期表必须及时维护到位 */) AS a /* -这个表就一行，笛卡尔积获取参数 */ JOIN (SELECT deviceid, time, 1 AS sup FROM ml_ods.connserver_resreport WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' /* -这样做，如果版更14天后就取不到数据，也即版更14天后我们不再关注用户是否预下载完成了 */ AND zoneid < 57000 /* -排除测服的增量预下载 */ AND issuccess = '1' /* -这条是增量预下载的最后一个20M，如果有则表示增量预下载完成，不需要再额外限定其他条件 */ AND downloadtype IN (2, 5) /* -预下载进度的判断，不需要再额外判断patch name */ GROUP BY deviceid, time, 1) AS b ON a.sup = b.sup AND b.time >= a.start_datetime AND b.time <= a.end_datetime GROUP BY b.deviceid) AS s4 /* --增量预下载完成 */ ON s1.day_first_deviceid = s4.deviceid LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.accountid, a.formal_start_date, SUM(b.login_duration) AS login_duration, MIN(b.log_date) AS join_date FROM (SELECT version, MAX_BY(start_date, logymd) AS start_date /* -预下载开放日期 */, MAX_BY(end_date, logymd) AS end_date /* -预下载结束日期 */, MAX_BY(start_datetime, logymd) AS start_datetime /* -预下载开放时间 */, MAX_BY(end_datetime, logymd) AS end_datetime /* -预下载结束时间 */, MAX_BY(formal_start_date, logymd) AS formal_start_date /* -版本发布日期 */, MAX(1) AS sup FROM ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY version /* 一个version就一行数据，标记这个版本的预下载开放时间和结束时间，前提是预下载开放日期表必须及时维护到位 */ HAVING MAX_BY(formal_start_date, logymd) BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-31' /* -取今天跑数日期往前推14天内，看是否有开放增量预下载信息，如果有则有数据，如果没有则没数据，下面join后也肯定诶数据。 */) AS a JOIN (SELECT SUBSTRING(day_first_active_time, 1, 10) AS log_date, roleid AS accountid, SUM(day_login_cnt) AS login_count, SUM(day_login_duration) AS login_duration, MIN(logymd) AS join_date, MAX(1) AS sup FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(day_first_active_time, 1, 10), roleid) AS b ON a.sup = b.sup AND b.log_date >= a.formal_start_date AND b.log_date <= DATE_ADD(a.formal_start_date, 14) /* -只取到版更前14天 */ GROUP BY b.accountid, a.formal_start_date) AS s5 /* --主城停留时长 */ ON s1.accountid = s5.accountid LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.accountid, SUM(battle_duration) AS battle_duration FROM (SELECT version, MAX_BY(start_date, logymd) AS start_date /* -预下载开放日期 */, MAX_BY(end_date, logymd) AS end_date /* -预下载结束日期 */, MAX_BY(start_datetime, logymd) AS start_datetime /* -预下载开放时间 */, MAX_BY(end_datetime, logymd) AS end_datetime /* -预下载结束时间 */, MAX_BY(formal_start_date, logymd) AS formal_start_date /* -版本发布日期 */, MAX(1) AS sup FROM ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY version /* 一个version就一行数据，标记这个版本的预下载开放时间和结束时间，前提是预下载开放日期表必须及时维护到位 */ HAVING MAX_BY(formal_start_date, logymd) BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-31' /* -取今天跑数日期往前推14天内，看是否有开放增量预下载信息，如果有则有数据，如果没有则没数据，下面join后也肯定诶数据。 */) AS a JOIN (SELECT SUBSTRING(day_first_battle_time, 1, 10) AS log_date, roleid AS accountid, SUM(battle_duration) AS battle_duration, MAX(1) AS sup FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(day_first_battle_time, 1, 10), roleid) AS b ON a.sup = b.sup AND b.log_date >= a.formal_start_date AND b.log_date <= DATE_ADD(a.formal_start_date, 14) /* -只取到版更前14天 */ GROUP BY b.accountid) AS s6 /* --战斗时长 */ ON s1.accountid = s6.accountid LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.device_id, MAX_BY(b.downloadprocess, time) AS downloadprocess FROM (SELECT version, MAX_BY(start_date, logymd) AS start_date /* -预下载开放日期 */, MAX_BY(end_date, logymd) AS end_date /* -预下载结束日期 */, MAX_BY(start_datetime, logymd) AS start_datetime /* -预下载开放时间 */, MAX_BY(end_datetime, logymd) AS end_datetime /* -预下载结束时间 */, MAX_BY(formal_start_date, logymd) AS formal_start_date /* -版本发布日期 */, MAX(1) AS sup FROM ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY version /* 一个version就一行数据，标记这个版本的预下载开放时间和结束时间，前提是预下载开放日期表必须及时维护到位 */ HAVING MAX_BY(formal_start_date, logymd) BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-31' /* -取今天跑数日期往前推14天内，看是否有开放增量预下载信息，如果有则有数据，如果没有则没数据，下面join后也肯定诶数据。 */) AS a JOIN (SELECT SUBSTRING(time, 1, 10) AS log_date, device_id, MAX_BY(downloadprocess, time) AS downloadprocess, MAX(time) AS time, MAX(1) AS sup FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_loginloading_game WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY SUBSTRING(time, 1, 10), device_id) AS b ON a.sup = b.sup AND b.log_date >= DATE_ADD(a.formal_start_date, 7 * -1) AND b.log_date <= DATE_ADD(a.formal_start_date, 1 * -1) /* -只取到版更前14天 */ GROUP BY b.device_id) AS s7 /* --上次版更是否增量完成 */ ON s1.day_first_deviceid = s7.device_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, deviceid FROM ml_temp.amandapiao_is_client_ver_change WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, deviceid) AS s8 /* -切版本 */ ON s1.day_first_deviceid = s8.deviceid AND s1.logymd = s8.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, deviceid FROM ml_temp.amandapiao_new_is_install WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, deviceid) AS s9 /* -重装 */ ON s1.day_first_deviceid = s9.deviceid AND s1.logymd = s9.logymd LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, deviceid FROM ml_temp.amandapiao_is_redownload WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, deviceid) AS s10 /* -重复下载 */ ON s1.day_first_deviceid = s10.deviceid AND s1.logymd = s10.logymd GROUP BY s1.gradingid, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(s2.logymd, s2.register_date) = 0 THEN 'v01-新用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(s2.logymd, s2.register_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 'v02-2~30' WHEN DATEDIFF(s2.logymd, s2.register_date) > 8 THEN 'V03-30+' ELSE '未知' END, s2.os_type, s2.channel, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(s2.logymd, s2.register_date) = 0 THEN 'v01-新用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(s2.logymd, s2.register_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 'v02-2~30' WHEN DATEDIFF(s2.logymd, s2.register_date) > 8 THEN 'V03-30+' ELSE '未知' END, UPPER(s1.ip_country), FLOOR(s2.zone_id / 1000), s2.first_client_ver, CASE WHEN s2.first_lossdays >= 30 THEN '回流用户' ELSE '非回流用户' END, CASE WHEN NOT s4.deviceid IS NULL THEN '增量预下载完成' ELSE '未完成' END /* nvl(s3.is_astc_change,0) , */ /* nvl(s3.is_veryhigh_change,0) , */ /* nvl(s3.is_other_change,0) , */ /* nvl(s3.is_redownload,0) , */ /* nvl(s3.is_reinstall,0) , */ /* nvl(s3.is_client_ver_change,0) , */, CASE WHEN s7.downloadprocess IS NULL THEN '版更前一周未活跃' WHEN s7.downloadprocess = 1 THEN '版更前一周增量完成' WHEN s7.downloadprocess = 0 THEN '版更前一周增量未完成' END, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 < 0 THEN 'v00-异常数据' WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN 'v01-0-10min' WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 BETWEEN 10 AND 20 THEN 'v02-10-20min' WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN 'v03-20-30min' WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 BETWEEN 30 AND 60 THEN 'v04-30-60min' WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 BETWEEN 60 AND 90 THEN 'v05-60-90min' WHEN (COALESCE(s5.login_duration, 0) - COALESCE(s6.battle_duration, 0)) / 60 > 90 THEN 'v06-90+min' END, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 0 THEN '0' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 1 THEN '1' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 2 THEN '2' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 3 THEN '3' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 4 THEN '4' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 5 THEN '5' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) = 6 THEN '6' WHEN DATEDIFF(s5.join_date, s5.formal_start_date) >= 7 THEN '7+' END, DATEDIFF(s1.logymd, s5.formal_start_date) /* -当前是版本的第几天 */

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE db_bytedance.wefly_ob_ods_login PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, c_logymd, loghms, roleid, zoneid, did, msdk_callback_info, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, login_ip, login_channel, login_sub_channel, create_country, account_name, chargecou, activedays, war_stage, total_payment, role_level, accountcreatetime, accountcreateymd, accountcreatehms, login_os_type, createrole_channel, alliance_id, alliance_level, other_info, channel, device, ostype_login, login_type, os_language, client_language, idfa, device_id, package_id, cert_sha1, cert_subject, ip, createrole_country, client_cpu, client_memory, client_version, create_role_num, is_first_role, highest_role_level, account_createymd, alibattle_power, deep_link, device_account_name, device_account_name_create_ymd, is_simulator, simulator_uid, simulator_brand, client_os_version, last_login_date, last_payment_date, payment_times, oaid, drmid, android_id, sub_channel, idfv, player_name, character_num, character_level_max, character_star_max, detected_quality_level FROM wefly_ob_ods.login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT LOWER(login_channel) IN ('ios_usa', 'and_usa') AND CAST(roleid AS STRING) NOT LIKE '2%' AND NOT UPPER(createrole_country) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') AND NOT UPPER(create_country) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI') AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(GEOIP(ip, 1, IF(SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) <= '202207', '202207', SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6))), '')) IN ('US', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')

name: accept_black_v2
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_ygao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-08-28 18:08:21.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 4.接受开黑复开黑战斗体验  */ WITH active AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), abtest_list AS (SELECT param_name, SUBSTRING(begin_time, 0, 10) AS begin_date, SUBSTRING(end_time, 0, 10) AS end_date FROM mt_dim.dim_abtest_list WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND param_name LIKE '%_social_recommend_v%'), group_tag AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, IF(old_zoneid < 57000, 'prod', 'test') AS env, logymd AS enter_date, a.param_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(param_value, '$.group_tag') AS group_tag, param_version FROM ml_ods.abtestserver_abtest_tag AS a JOIN abtest_list AS b ON a.param_name = b.param_name WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-30' AND '2026-05-31' AND a.logymd BETWEEN b.begin_date AND b.end_date UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, 'test' AS env, '2026-05-31' AS enter_date, 'test' AS param_name, 'test' AS group_tag, 'test' AS param_version FROM active WHERE zoneid >= 57000), active_user AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, env, enter_date, param_name, group_tag, param_version, IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_active, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(a.roleid, '-', a.zoneid)) FROM group_tag AS a LEFT JOIN active AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, env, enter_date, param_name, group_tag, param_version, is_active), invite AS (SELECT accountid AS invite_roleid, zoneid AS invite_zoneid, showplayer_accountid AS invited_roleid, showplayer_zoneid AS invited_zoneid, logymd FROM ml_ods.connserver_social_recommendlistrecord WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND player_action = 4), accept AS (SELECT invite_roleid, invite_zoneid, accountid AS invited_roleid, zoneid AS invited_zoneid, logymd FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_inviteshow WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND isaccept = 'accept'), match_end AS (SELECT logymd, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, roomid, blacknum, groupsel FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND blacknum > 1), match_success AS (SELECT a.roleid AS invite_roleid, a.zoneid AS invite_zoneid, b.roleid AS invited_roleid, b.zoneid AS invited_zoneid, MAX(a.groupsel) AS groupsel FROM match_end AS a INNER JOIN match_end AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.roomid = b.roomid AND a.roleid <> b.roleid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.roleid, b.zoneid), battle_end AS (SELECT logymd, battleid, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, roomid, blacknum, wincamp, ismvp, kda, score, bigranklvl, real_road, is_report_negative FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND blacknum > 1), black AS (SELECT a.roleid AS invite_roleid, a.zoneid AS invite_zoneid, b.roleid AS invited_roleid, b.zoneid AS invited_zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.battleid) AS black_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT a.logymd) AS black_days, AVG(a.wincamp) AS win_rate, AVG(a.ismvp) AS mvp_rate, AVG(a.kda) AS avg_kda, AVG(a.score) AS avg_score, AVG(IF(ABS(a.bigranklvl - b.bigranklvl) > 1, 1, 0)) AS rank_gap_rate, AVG(IF(a.real_road = b.real_road, 1, 0)) AS road_conflict_rate, AVG(a.is_report_negative) AS report_negative_rate FROM battle_end AS a INNER JOIN battle_end AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.roomid = b.roomid AND a.roleid <> b.roleid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.roleid, b.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.dm_friend_recommend_analysis_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT env, param_name, group_tag, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(a.roleid, '-', a.zoneid)) AS enter_role_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN CONCAT(a.roleid, '-', a.zoneid) END) AS active_role_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(b.invite_roleid, '-', b.invite_zoneid)) AS invite_role_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(b.invite_roleid, '-', b.invited_roleid)) AS invite_pair_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(c.invite_roleid, '-', c.invited_roleid)) AS accepte_pair_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(d.invite_roleid, '-', d.invited_roleid)) AS match_begin_pair_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN groupsel > 0 THEN CONCAT(d.invite_roleid, '-', d.invited_roleid) END) AS match_success_pair_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(e.invite_roleid, '-', e.invited_roleid)) AS black_pair_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(black_cnt > 1, CONCAT(e.invite_roleid, '-', e.invited_roleid), NULL)) AS reblack_cnt_pair_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(black_days > 1, CONCAT(e.invite_roleid, '-', e.invited_roleid), NULL)) AS reblack_days_pair_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(black_days > 2, CONCAT(e.invite_roleid, '-', e.invited_roleid), NULL)) AS effective_friend_pair_cnt, AVG(e.win_rate) AS avg_win_rate, AVG(e.mvp_rate) AS avg_mvp_rate, AVG(e.avg_kda) AS avg_kda, AVG(e.avg_score) AS avg_score, AVG(e.rank_gap_rate) AS avg_rank_gap_rate, AVG(e.report_negative_rate) AS avg_report_negative_rate, AVG(e.road_conflict_rate) AS avg_road_conflict_rate FROM active_user AS a LEFT JOIN invite AS b ON a.roleid = b.invite_roleid AND a.zoneid = b.invite_zoneid LEFT JOIN accept AS c ON b.invite_roleid = c.invite_roleid AND b.invite_zoneid = c.invite_zoneid AND b.invited_roleid = c.invited_roleid AND b.invited_zoneid = c.invited_zoneid AND b.logymd = c.logymd LEFT JOIN match_success AS d ON b.invite_roleid = d.invite_roleid AND b.invite_zoneid = d.invite_zoneid AND b.invited_roleid = d.invited_roleid AND b.invited_zoneid = login_hour_1, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_2, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_3, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_7, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_8, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_9, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_10, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_11, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_12, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_13, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_14, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_15, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 16 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_16, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 17 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_17, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_18, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 19 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_19, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_20, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_21, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 22 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_22, MAX(CASE WHEN mid_hour = 23 OR login_in_23hour > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_hour_23 FROM (SELECT t1.logout_time, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.online_time, t1.unixtime_logout, t1.unixtime_login, t1.login_time, HOUR(t1.login_time) AS login_hour, HOUR(t1.logout_time) AS logout_hour, CASE WHEN NOT t2.roleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS login_in_23hour, CASE WHEN TO_DATE(t1.login_time) < '2026-05-31' THEN 0 + i ELSE HOUR(t1.login_time) + i END AS mid_hour FROM (SELECT time AS logout_time, roleid, zoneid, online_time, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS') AS unixtime_logout, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS') - online_time AS unixtime_login, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS') - online_time) AS login_time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND HOUR(time) = 23) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(SPLIT(REPEAT(',', CASE WHEN HOUR(t1.logout_time) - HOUR(t1.login_time) < 0 THEN HOUR(t1.logout_time) - 0 ELSE HOUR(t1.logout_time) - HOUR(t1.login_time) END), ',')) pe AS i, x) AS t3 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t4) AS t5

name: 高光加局内其他播报
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: michaelhe@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-07-31 11:03:49.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH hero_config AS (SELECT heroid, hero_name, heroes FROM mt_ods.hero_config_cdn_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY heroid, hero_name, heroes), battle_info AS (SELECT bse.accountid, bse.zoneid, bse.battleid, bse.heroid, bse.real_road, bse.rankstar, CASE WHEN bse.rankstar < 37 THEN 'a.大师' WHEN bse.rankstar < 62 THEN 'b.宗师' WHEN bse.rankstar < 87 THEN 'c.史诗' WHEN bse.rankstar < 112 THEN 'd.传奇' WHEN bse.rankstar < 137 THEN 'e.神话' WHEN bse.rankstar < 162 THEN 'f.百战神话' WHEN bse.rankstar < 212 THEN 'g.荣耀神话' ELSE 'h.至尊神话' END AS ranks, gbe.kills, gbe.kill2, gbe.kill3, gbe.kill4, gbe.kill5, gbe.killtower, cbd.killover, cbd.shenguiskill, cbd.lingzhuskill FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS bse JOIN ml_ods.gameserver_battle_end AS gbe ON bse.accountid = gbe.roleid AND bse.zoneid = gbe.zoneid AND bse.battleid = gbe.battleid AND bse.pvptype = gbe.pvptype AND gbe.logymd = '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata AS cbd ON bse.accountid = cbd.accountid AND bse.zoneid = cbd.zoneid AND bse.battleid = cbd.battleid AND bse.pvptype = cbd.battletype AND cbd.logymd = '2026-05-31' WHERE bse.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND bse.zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 57999 AND bse.isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND bse.fake_ai = 0 AND bse.pvptype = 2 AND bse.realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90) AND bse.rankstar >= 38), ten_real_battles AS (SELECT battleid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND fake_ai = 0 AND pvptype = 2 AND realpvptype IN (1, 2, 59, 90) AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 56999 GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(*) = 10), battle_count AS (SELECT '测试服' AS zonetype, heroid, real_road, ranks, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS total_battle FROM battle_info WHERE zoneid BETWEEN 57000 AND 57999 GROUP BY heroid, real_road, ranks UNION ALL SELECT '正式服' AS zonetype, heroid, real_road, ranks, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS total_battle FROM battle_info WHERE zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 56999 AND battleid IN (SELECT battleid FROM ten_real_battles) GROUP BY heroid, real_road, ranks), trigger_events AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, trigger_id, trigger_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, tbl.col AS trigger_id, 1 AS trigger_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_highlight_triggered LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(SPLIT(highlighttriggered, CHR(59))) tbl AS c1_index, col WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 57999 UNION ALL SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, CASE WHEN tbl.col[0] = 'kill' THEN 205 WHEN tbl.col[0] = 'kill2' THEN 204 WHEN tbl.col[0] = 'kill3' THEN 203 WHEN tbl.col[0] = 'kill4' THEN 201 WHEN tbl.col[0] = 'kill5' THEN 200 WHEN tbl.col[0] = 'killtower' THEN 208 WHEN tbl.col[0] = 'shenguiskill' THEN 206 WHEN tbl.col[0] = 'lingzhuskill' THEN 207 ELSE 20000 END AS trigger_id, tbl.col[1] AS trigger_cnt FROM battle_info LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(ARRAY(ARRAY('kill', COALESCE(kills, 0) - COALESCE(kill2, 0) - COALESCE(kill3, 0) - COALESCE(kill4, 0) - COALESCE(kill5, 0)), ARRAY('kill2', COALESCE(kill2, 0)), ARRAY('kill3', COALESCE(kill3, 0)), ARRAY('kill4', COALESCE(kill4, 0)), ARRAY('kill5', COALESCE(kill5, 0)), ARRAY('killtower', COALESCE(killtower, 0)), ARRAY('killover', COALESCE(killover, 0)), ARRAY('shenguiskill', COALESCE(shenguiskill, 0)), ARRAY('lingzhuskill', COALESCE(lingzhuskill, 0)))) tbl AS col) AS t_all WHERE trigger_id >= 1), trigger_stats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN b.zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 56999 THEN '正式服' WHEN b.zoneid BETWEEN 57000 AND 57999 THEN '测试服' END AS zonetype, b.heroid, b.real_road, b.ranks, t.trigger_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.trigger_cnt > 0 THEN CONCAT_WS('_', b.battleid, t.trigger_id) END) AS trigger_battle, SUM(t.trigger_cnt) AS trigger_num FROM battle_info AS b JOIN trigger_events AS t ON b.accountid = t.accountid AND b.zoneid = t.zoneid AND b.battleid = t.battleid LEFT JOIN ten_real_battles AS trb ON b.battleid = trb.battleid WHERE t.trigger_cnt > 0 AND (b.zoneid BETWEEN 57000 AND 57999 OR (b.zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 56999 AND NOT trb.battleid IS NULL)) GROUP BY CASE WHEN b.zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 56999 THEN '正式服' WHEN b.zoneid BETWEEN 57000 AND 57999 THEN '测试服' END, b.heroid, b.real_road, b.ranks, t.trigger_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.mzx_highlight_with_notification PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT bc.zonetype, bc.heroid, hc.hero_name, hc.heroes, bc.real_road, bc.ranks, bc.total_battle, ts.trigger_id, ts.trigger_battle, ts.trigger_num FROM battle_count AS bc LEFT JOIN trigger_stats AS ts ON bc.zonetype = ts.zonetype AND bc.heroid = ts.heroid AND bc.real_road = ts.real_road AND bc.ranks = ts.ranks LEFT JOIN hero_config AS hc ON bc.heroid = hc.heroid

name: 玩家长周期网络情况_30天
output_hint: 玩家长周期网络情况_30天
sql_units: WITH t1 AS (SELECT nation, campany, num FROM (SELECT nation, campany, num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nation ORDER BY num DESC) AS rk FROM (SELECT GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS nation, GEOIP(client_ip, 5) AS campany, COUNT(roleid) AS num FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY nation, campany)) WHERE rk <= 10) INSERT INTO ml_temp.longterm_net_day30 SELECT nas, prs, cas, c.nation, c.pro, CASE WHEN NOT t1.campany IS NULL THEN t1.campany ELSE 'other' END AS campanies, if_old, SUM(IF(q1 >= 2 AND q2 >= 2 AND q3 >= 2 AND q4 >= 2, 1, 0)) AS score_net, COUNT(*) AS num, logymd FROM (SELECT *, CEIL(quat1_sc) AS q1, CEIL(quat2_sc) AS q2, CEIL(quat3_sc) AS q3, CEIL(quat4_sc) AS q4 FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, GEOIP(MAX(client_ip), 1) AS nation, GEOIP(MAX(client_ip), 2) AS pro, GEOIP(MAX(client_ip), 5) AS campany FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' /* and geoip(client_ip,1) = 'PH' */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS n INNER JOIN (SELECT FLOOR(battles / 5) * 5 AS bts, CASE WHEN max_star >= 63 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_old, a.accountid, a.zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT na) AS nas, COUNT(DISTINCT pr) AS prs, COUNT(DISTINCT ca) AS cas, PERCENTILE(IF(a.tl <= (b.battles / 4), self_net_score, NULL), 0.5) AS quat1_sc, PERCENTILE(IF(a.tl > (b.battles / 4) AND a.tl <= ((b.battles * 2) / 4), self_net_score, NULL), 0.5) AS quat2_sc, PERCENTILE(IF(a.tl > ((b.battles * 2) / 4) AND a.tl <= ((b.battles * 3) / 4), self_net_score, NULL), 0.5) AS quat3_sc, PERCENTILE(IF(a.tl > ((b.battles * 3) / 4), self_net_score, NULL), 0.5) AS quat4_sc, FLOOR(STDDEV(self_net_score) * 10) / 10 AS sc_std, MAX(lifetimes) AS lf_time /* if(a.tl<=(b.battles/40),) */ FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY z.accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time) AS tl, z.accountid, zoneid, DATEDIFF(z.logymd, z.usercreateymd) AS lifetimes, IF(smallreconnect_num / (battletime / 600) <= 1, 1, 0) + IF(movelag / (battletime / 600) <= 4, 1, 0) + IF((ping80 / ping_times) >= 0.95, 1, 0) AS self_net_score, GEOIP(z.clientip, 1) AS na, GEOIP(z.clientip, 2) AS pr, GEOIP(z.clientip, 5) AS ca FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS z WHERE z.logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-30' AND '2026-05-29' AND z.timedelay > 0 AND z.fake_ai = 0) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT z.accountid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS battles, MAX(history_maxrankstar) AS max_star FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS z WHERE z.logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-30' AND '2026-05-29' AND z.timedelay > 0 AND z.fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY z.accountid, zoneid) AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE battles > 4 GROUP BY bts, a.accountid, a.zoneid, if_old) AS m ON n.roleid = m.accountid AND n.zoneid = m.zoneid) AS c LEFT JOIN t1 ON c.nation = t1.nation AND c.campany = t1.campany GROUP BY nas, prs, cas, logymd, c.nation, c.pro, campanies, if_old

FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS z WHERE z.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-16' AND '2026-05-29' AND z.timedelay > 0 AND z.fake_ai = 0) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT z.accountid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS battles, MAX(history_maxrankstar) AS max_star FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS z WHERE z.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-16' AND '2026-05-29' AND z.timedelay > 0 AND z.fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY z.accountid, zoneid) AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE battles > 4 GROUP BY bts, a.accountid, a.zoneid, if_old) AS m ON n.roleid = m.accountid AND n.zoneid = m.zoneid) AS c LEFT JOIN t1 ON c.nation = t1.nation AND c.campany = t1.campany GROUP BY nas, prs, cas, logymd, c.nation, c.pro, campanies, if_old

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: ethandong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-07-31 15:49:12.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* create external table wefly_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_di */ /* ( */ /*   roleid decimal(20,0) comment '角色ID', */ /*   zoneid bigint comment '服务器key', */ /*   zone_type bigint comment '区服类型', */ /*   first_pay_time string comment '当天首次付费时间', */ /*   last_pay_time string comment '当天末次付费时间', */ /*   pay_amt bigint comment '付费金额(美分)', */ /*   pay_cnt bigint comment '付费次数' */ /* ) */ /* comment '角色付费增量表' */ /* partitioned by (logymd string comment '分区日期', appid string comment '项目ID') */ /* stored as parquet */ /* location 's3a://wefly-dw/table/dwm_charge_role_zone_di' */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE wefly_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'wefly') SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 0 AND 9999 THEN 0 WHEN zoneid > 9999 THEN 1 END AS zone_type, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, `TIME`, NULL)) AS first_pay_time, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, `TIME`, NULL)) AS last_pay_time, SUM(money) AS pay_amt, COUNT(1) AS pay_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, money, `TIME`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `TIME` DESC) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `TIME` ASC) AS rec_asc FROM wefly_ob_ods.charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid

sql_units:
/* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2022-05-10 21:02:52.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /*
CREATE TABLE `wefly_dw`.`dim_basic_role_zone_df`(
    `roleid` decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '角色id',
    `zoneid` bigint COMMENT '服务器id',
    `account_name` string COMMENT 'sdk账号或设备id',
    `did` string COMMENT 'did',
    `register_time` string COMMENT '角色创建时间',
    `register_date` string COMMENT '角色创建日期',
    `create_ip` string COMMENT '创角ip',
    `create_channel` string COMMENT '创角渠道',
    `create_sub_channel` string COMMENT '创角子渠道',
    `os_type` bigint COMMENT '创角系统类型',
    `os_name` string COMMENT '角色id',
    `create_country` string COMMENT '创角国家',
    `create_ip_country` string COMMENT '首次ip国家',
    `first_mt_country` string COMMENT '首次创角国家',
    `first_network_name` string COMMENT '首次广告渠道',
    `is_first_create` bigint COMMENT '是否账号下首个创角',
    `data_source` string COMMENT '创角数据来源',
    `zone_type` string COMMENT '区服类型',
    `is_cur_bot` bigint COMMENT '当前是否刷号',
    `is_init_bot` bigint COMMENT '创角时是否刷号',
    `is_formal_create` bigint COMMENT '是否账号下首个创角',
) PARTITIONED BY (
    `logymd` string COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd, 美西日期',
    `appid` int COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key'
) 
stored as parquet 
location 's3a://wefly-dw/table/dim_basic_role_zone_df'
*/ WITH install_user_reduce AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, did, register_time, register_date, create_ip, create_channel, create_sub_channel, os_type, CASE os_type WHEN 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN 2 THEN 'android' WHEN 3 THEN 'other' ELSE 'unknown' END AS os_name, create_country, create_ip_country, data_source, IF(zoneid > 9999, 1, 0) AS zone_type FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY source_order ASC, register_time ASC, zoneid ASC /* 同一时间创角的取区分小的 */) AS row_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, usercreateymd AS register_date, usercreatetime AS register_time, did, login_ip AS create_ip, login_channel AS create_channel, login_sub_channel AS create_sub_channel, login_os_type AS os_type, LOWER(createrole_country) AS create_country, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202508', '202508', '202605'))) AS create_ip_country, 'create' AS data_source, 1 AS source_order FROM wefly_ob_ods.create_role WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-08-27' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, usercreateymd AS register_date, usercreatetime AS register_time, did, login_ip AS create_ip, login_channel AS create_channel, login_sub_channel AS create_sub_channel, login_os_type AS os_type, LOWER(createrole_country) AS create_country, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202508', '202508', '202605'))) AS create_ip_country, 'login' AS data_source, 2 AS source_order FROM wefly_ob_ods.login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-08-27' AND (usercreateymd = '2026-05-31' OR usercreateymd < '2025-08-27') UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, usercreateymd AS register_date, usercreatetime AS register_time, did, login_ip AS create_ip, login_channel AS create_channel, login_sub_channel AS create_sub_channel, login_os_type AS os_type, LOWER(createrole_country) AS create_country, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202508', '202508', '202605'))) AS create_ip_country, 'charge' AS data_source, 3 AS source_order FROM wefly_ob_ods.charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-08-27' AND (usercreateymd = '2026-05-31' OR usercreateymd < '2025-08-27'))) WHERE row_num = 1), df_yd AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, did, register_time, register_date, create_ip, create_channel, create_sub_channel, os_type, os_name, create_country, first_mt_country, first_network_name, create_ip_country, data_source, is_first_create, zone_type, is_cur_bot, is_init_bot, is_acc_cur_bot, is_acc_init_bot FROM wefly_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), bot_info AS (SELECT creates.roleid, creates.zoneid, MAX(IF(money_amt > 0, 0, IF(ip_role_num >= 30 OR did_role_num >= 10, 1, 0))) AS is_cur_bot, COALESCE(SUM(money_amt), 0) AS pay_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, did, COUNT(IF(TRIM(COALESCE(create_ip, '')) <> '', roleid, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY register_date, create_ip) AS ip_role_num, COUNT(IF(TRIM(COALESCE(did, '')) <> '', roleid, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY register_date, did) AS did_role_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, did, create_ip, register_date FROM install_user_reduce UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, did, create_ip, register_date FROM df_yd)) AS creates LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid AS roleid, zoneid AS zoneid, SUM(money / 100) AS money_amt, 1 AS charge_role, COUNT(1) AS charge_num FROM wefly_ob_ods.charge WHERE logymd >= '2025-08-27' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS c ON creates.roleid = c.roleid AND creates.zoneid = c.zoneid GROUP BY creates.roleid, creates.zoneid), acc_bot_info AS (SELECT roleid, IF(MAX(is_cur_bot) = 1 AND SUM(pay_amt) = 0, 1, 0) AS is_acc_cur_bot FROM bot_info GROUP BY roleid), adjust_info AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT did, first_mt_country, first_media_source, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did ORDER BY first_mt_country) AS rn FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND app_id = 4310) AS A WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE wefly_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'wefly') SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.account_name, t0.did, SUBSTRING(t0.register_time, 1, 19) AS register_time, t0.register_date, t0.create_ip, t0.create_channel, t0.create_sub_channel, t0.os_type, t0.os_name, t0.create_country, t0.create_ip_country, t0.first_mt_country, t0.first_network_name, IF(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.roleid ORDER BY t0.register_time, t0.zoneid ASC) = 1, 1, 0) AS is_first_create, t0.data_source, t0.zone_type, COALESCE(t1.is_cur_bot, t0.is_cur_bot, 0) AS is_cur_bot, COALESCE(t0.is_init_bot, t1.is_cur_bot, 0) AS is_init_bot, IF(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.roleid ORDER BY t0.formal_ord DESC, t0.register_time ASC, t0.zoneid ASC) = 1 AND t0.formal_ord = 1, 1, 0) AS is_formal_first_create /* 是否正式服下首个创角 */, IF(FIRST_VALUE(COALESCE(t0.is_acc_init_bot, t2.is_acc_cur_bot, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.roleid ORDER BY register_time) = 0, 0, COALESCE(t2.is_acc_cur_bot, t0.is_acc_cur_bot, 0)) AS is_acc_cur_bot, FIRST_VALUE(COALESCE(t0.is_acc_init_bot, t2.is_acc_cur_bot, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.roleid ORDER BY register_time) AS is_acc_init_bot FROM (SELECT COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(df.account_name, di.account_name) AS account_name, COALESCE(df.did, di.did) AS did, COALESCE(df.register_time, di.register_time) AS register_time, COALESCE(df.register_date, di.register_date) AS register_date, COALESCE(df.create_ip, di.create_ip) AS create_ip, COALESCE(df.create_channel, di.create_channel) AS create_channel, COALESCE(df.create_sub_channel, di.create_sub_channel) AS create_sub_channel, COALESCE(df.os_type, di.os_type) AS os_type, COALESCE(df.os_name, di.os_name) AS os_name, COALESCE(df.create_country, di.create_country) AS create_country, COALESCE(df.create_ip_country, di.create_ip_country) AS create_ip_country, COALESCE(df.first_mt_country, di.first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(df.first_network_name, di.first_network_name) AS first_network_name, COALESCE(df.is_first_create, di.is_first_create, 1) AS is_first_create, COALESCE(df.data_source, di.data_source) AS data_source, COALESCE(df.zone_type, di.zone_type) AS zone_type, IF(COALESCE(df.zone_type, di.zone_type) = 1, 1, -99999) AS formal_ord, df.is_cur_bot, df.is_init_bot, df.is_acc_cur_bot, df.is_acc_init_bot FROM df_yd AS df FULL JOIN (SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.account_name, t0.did, t0.register_time, t0.register_date, t0.create_ip, t0.create_channel, t0.create_sub_channel, t0.os_type, t0.os_name, t0.create_country, t0.create_ip_country, t0.data_source, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source AS first_network_name, 1 AS is_first_create, t0.zone_type FROM install_user_reduce AS t0 LEFT JOIN adjust_info AS t1 ON t0.did = t1.did) AS di ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid) AS t0 LEFT JOIN bot_info AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN acc_bot_info AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.roleid
