name: mt_dm.dm_multi_decismart_info_df_wefly
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jichun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-08-04 16:33:14.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH basic_df AS (/* 基础信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, SUBSTRING(register_date, 1, 10) AS register_date FROM wefly_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), active_di AS (/* 活跃信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(online_dur, 0) AS ol_duration /* 当日有活跃，无在线时长的给默认值0 */, SUBSTRING(last_active_time, 1, 10) AS active_date FROM wefly_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(pay_cnt) AS charge_cnt, SUM(pay_amt) AS charge_amt, MAX(SUBSTRING(last_pay_time, 1, 10)) AS charge_date FROM wefly_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), behavior_df AS (/* 前一日 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, charge_info, charge_cnt_total_array, charge_amt_total_array, charge_amt_array, ol_dur_array, active_info, active_days_array, logymd, appname, granularity_type FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_decismart_info_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appname = 'wefly' AND granularity_type = 'role') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_multi_decismart_info_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'wefly', granularity_type = 'role') SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date /* 无注册日期给默认值 */, IF(LENGTH(charge_info) > 0 AND /* 只补齐有位图的，并且当日日期大于注册日的 */ '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(charge_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(charge_info))), COALESCE(charge_info, '') /* 可能存才有位图没有注册日期的， */) AS charge_info, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_cnt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_cnt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_cnt_total_array /* 付费次数位图,补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有付费用户） */, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_amt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_amt_total_array /* --累计付费金额位图,补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有付费用户） */, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_amt_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_amt_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_amt_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_amt_array /* --付费金额位图 */, CAST(IF(SIZE(ol_dur_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(ol_dur_array)) > 0, CONCAT(ol_dur_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(ol_dur_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(ol_dur_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS ol_dur_array /* --在线时长位图,补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有在线用户） */, IF(LENGTH(active_info) > 0 AND '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(active_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(active_info))), COALESCE(active_info, '')) AS active_info, CAST(IF(SIZE(active_days_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(active_days_array)) > 0, CONCAT(active_days_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(active_days_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(active_days_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS active_days_array /* 活跃天数位图补齐(array) */, zone_type FROM (SELECT td.roleid, td.zoneid, td.register_date, td.zone_type, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31', CONCAT('1', COALESCE(ld.charge_info, '')), IF(LENGTH(ld.charge_info) > 0, CONCAT('0', charge_info), '')) AS charge_info, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_cnt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_cnt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(charge_cnt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_cnt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_cnt, 0) + ld.charge_cnt_total_array[0])), ld.charge_cnt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_cnt_total_array, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_amt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_amt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.charge_amt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_amt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_amt, 0) + ld.charge_amt_total_array[0])), ld.charge_amt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_amt_total_array, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_amt_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_amt_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.charge_amt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_amt_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_amt, 0))), ld.charge_amt_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_amt_array, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.ol_dur_array IS NULL OR ld.ol_dur_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.ol_duration), IF(SIZE(ld.ol_dur_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.ol_duration, 0))), ld.ol_dur_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS ol_dur_array, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31', CONCAT('1', COALESCE(ld.active_info, '')), IF(LENGTH(ld.active_info) > 0, CONCAT('0', ld.active_info), '')) AS active_info, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.active_days_array IS NULL OR ld.active_days_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(1), IF(SIZE(ld.active_days_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(is_td_active + ld.active_days_array[0])), ld.active_days_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS active_days_array FROM (SELECT bas.roleid, bas.zoneid, bas.zone_type, bas.register_date, act.active_date, act.ol_duration, pay.charge_cnt, pay.charge_amt, pay.charge_date, IF(act.active_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_td_active FROM basic_df AS bas /* basic表 */ LEFT JOIN active_di AS act /* 活跃 */ ON bas.roleid = act.roleid AND bas.zoneid = act.zoneid LEFT JOIN pay_di AS pay /* 支付 */ ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid AND bas.zoneid = pay.zoneid) AS td LEFT JOIN (/* 前一日数据 */ SELECT * FROM behavior_df) AS ld ON td.roleid = ld.roleid AND td.zoneid = ld.zoneid) AS t

name: 4_adbi.dm_admkt_ad_cost_report_none_input_df
sql_units: WITH cost_report AS (/* 抓取 */ SELECT a.ad_account_id, a.report_date, a.media_source, a.campaign_id, a.campaign_name, a.adset_id, a.adset_name, a.ad_id, a.ad_name, a.app_id, a.app_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(a.os), '') = '', 'unknown', a.os) AS os, a.country, a.impression, a.click, a.cost, a.cost AS cost_align, b.ad_target FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwa_admkt_api_ad_cost_report_df)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.app_id, x.ad_account_id, x.ad_target, x.ad_platform_name FROM (SELECT app_id, ad_account_id, ad_target, ad_platform_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, ad_platform_name, ad_account_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rn FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_gms_ad_bi_ad_account)) WHERE date = '20260531') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1) AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.ad_account_id = b.ad_account_id AND a.media_source = b.ad_platform_name WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-31' /* 小渠道的消耗数据暂时只要6月2号之前的数据 */ UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ad_account_id, report_date, network AS media_source, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_id AS adset_id, adgroup_name AS adset_name, creative_id AS ad_id, creative_name AS ad_name, app_id, app_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(os_name), '') = '', 'unknown', os_name) AS os, country, NULL AS impression, NULL AS click, adjust_cost AS cost, adjust_cost AS cost_align, 1 AS ad_target FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_ods_adjust_cost_di)) WHERE logymd <= '2024-06-02' AND logymd >= '2023-11-06' /*  只要11月6号之后的数据 */ UNION ALL SELECT ad_account_id, report_date, media_source, campaign_id, campaign_name, adset_id, adset_name, ad_id, ad_name, app_id, app_name, os, country, NULL AS impression, NULL AS click, 0 AS cost, cost AS cost_align, ad_target FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwa_admkt_align_ad_cost_report_df)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31'), cost_report_agg AS (SELECT report_date AS data_date, app_id, MAX(ad_account_id) AS ad_account_id, MAX(ad_target) AS ad_target, LOWER(os) AS os, MAX(app_name) AS app_name, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country)) AS country, media_source, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_id), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adset_id), '') = '', 'unknown', adset_id) AS adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ad_id), '') = '', 'unknown', ad_id) AS ad_id, MAX(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_name), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_name)) AS campaign_name, MAX(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adset_name), '') = '', 'unknown', adset_name)) AS adset_name, MAX(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ad_name), '') = '', 'unknown', ad_name)) AS ad_name, SUM(impression) AS impression, SUM(click) AS click, SUM(cost) AS cost, SUM(cost_align) AS cost_align, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN impression ELSE 0 END) AS impression_new, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN click ELSE 0 END) AS click_new, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS cost_new, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN cost_align ELSE 0 END) AS cost_new_align, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 2 THEN impression ELSE 0 END) AS impression_back, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 2 THEN click ELSE 0 END) AS click_back, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 2 THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS cost_back, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 2 THEN cost_align ELSE 0 END) AS cost_back_align, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN impression ELSE 0 END) AS impression_promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN click ELSE 0 END) AS click_promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS cost_promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN cost_align ELSE 0 END) AS cost_promotion_align FROM cost_report WHERE report_date <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY report_date, app_id, LOWER(os), LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country)), media_source, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_id), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_id), IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adset_id), '') = '', 'unknown', adset_id), IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ad_id), '') = '', 'unknown', ad_id)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_admkt_ad_cost_report_none_input_df)) SELECT `data_date`, `ad_account_id`, `os`, `app_name`, `country`, `media_source`, `campaign_id`, `adset_id`, `ad_id`, `campaign_name`, `adset_name`, `ad_name`, `impression`, `click`, `cost`, `cost_align`, `impression_new`, `click_new`, `cost_new`, `cost_new_align`, `impression_back`, `click_back`, `cost_back`, `cost_back_align`, `impression_promotion`, `click_promotion`, `cost_promotion`, `cost_promotion_align`, `ad_target`, `app_id` FROM cost_report_agg AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT app_id AS app_id_des FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_gms_ad_bi_app)) WHERE p_date = '20260531' AND is_cn = 0) AS f ON a.app_id = f.app_id_des

sql_units: WITH ab_group AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.param_version, vid, param_name, big_rank, huoyue_tag, b.enter_date, CASE WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) = 57 THEN 'test' WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) < 57 THEN 'prod' END AS env FROM (SELECT t1.logymd, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, IF(NOT t2.roleid IS NULL AND NOT t2.zoneid IS NULL, t2.big_rank, 'other') AS big_rank, IF(NOT t3.roleid IS NULL AND NOT t3.zoneid IS NULL, t3.huoyue_tag, 'other') AS huoyue_tag FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-06-17' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'a.勇士' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 'b.精英' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 6 AND 9 THEN 'c.大师' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 10 AND 16 THEN 'd.宗师' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 17 AND 25 THEN 'e.史诗' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN 'f.传奇' WHEN final_rank_id = 36 THEN 'g.神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 37 THEN 'h.百战神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 38 THEN 'i.荣耀神话' END) AS big_rank, roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd) AS rn FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, new_rank_id AS final_rank_id, battleid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_magicchess_rank_level WHERE logymd >= '2025-07-10' /* 更新较晚，段位数据取前一天 */)) WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, huoyue_tag FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, huoyue_tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY p_date) AS rn FROM mt_ai.dm_ai_mcgg_huoyue_day_tag WHERE p_date >= '2025-07-10') WHERE rn = 1) AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid) AS a JOIN (SELECT MIN(logymd) AS enter_date, roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN param_version = MAX(param_version) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) THEN '实验组' WHEN param_version = MIN(param_version) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) THEN '对照组' END AS param_version, param_version AS vid, param_name FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-06-17' AND '2026-05-31' AND param_name LIKE '%aimatch%' AND param_version <> '' */, b.param_version, vid, param_name, big_rank, huoyue_tag, CASE WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) = 57 THEN 'test' WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) < 57 THEN 'prod' END), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-08-08 17:29:05.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_online_di`( */ /*     `point` bigint COMMENT '时间点(0,1,2,3...)', */ /*     `country` string COMMENT '国家(id,ph,mm,my...)', */ /*     `os` string COMMENT '操作系统', */ /*     `grouping_name` string COMMENT '存储维度，all/country', */ /*     `online_num` bigint COMMENT '在线玩家' */ /* ) COMMENT '观星台-在线数据，pcu,acu' PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区(yyy-MM-dd)', */ /*     `appname` string COMMENT '项目ID(mlbb,xgame,wefly)', */ /*     `granularity_type` string COMMENT '粒度类型(account,device)', */ /*     `date_type` string COMMENT '日期类型(daily,weekly,monthly)' */ /* ) ROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe' STORED AS parquet */ /* location's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_decismart_online_di' */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_online_di` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'wegame', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point, LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) = '' OR TRIM(country) = '-', 'unknown', TRIM(country))) AS country, CASE os_type WHEN 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN 2 THEN 'android' ELSE 'unknown' END AS os, 'all' AS grouping_name, SUM(online_num) AS online_num FROM wefly_ob_ods.t_real_os_country_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zone_id > 9999 /* AND zone_id < IF( '2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03',  57000 , 999999) */ GROUP BY LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300), LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) = '' OR TRIM(country) = '-', 'unknown', TRIM(country))), os_type

name: 回流用户以及活跃度标签

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_ygao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-08-08 17:27:17.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 用户标签划分： */ /* 1. 回流用户：近90天活跃用户，近30天未活跃用户(按进组时间来计算) */ /* 2. 活跃用户划分高中低活跃：按之前规则近7天活跃天数(按进组时间来计算) */ /* 3. 其他用户 */ WITH user_active_stats AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, param_version, param_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.logymd) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_90d_active, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -30) AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -1) THEN b.logymd END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_30d_active, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -7) AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -1) THEN b.logymd END) AS active_days_7d FROM (SELECT MIN(logymd) AS logymd, roleid, zoneid, param_version, param_name FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND param_name LIKE '%aimatch%' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, param_version, param_name UNION ALL SELECT MIN(logymd) AS logymd, accountid, old_zoneid, param_version, param_name FROM mcgg_ods.abtestserver_abtest_tag WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND param_name LIKE '%aimatch%' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, old_zoneid, param_version, param_name) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-02' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid /* AND     a.zoneid = b.zoneid */ GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, param_version, param_name) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_active_tag_info_gaoy PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, param_version, param_name, CASE WHEN has_90d_active = 1 AND has_30d_active = 0 THEN '回流用户' WHEN has_30d_active = 1 AND active_days_7d BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN '高活' WHEN has_30d_active = 1 AND active_days_7d BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '中活' WHEN has_30d_active = 1 AND active_days_7d BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '低活' ELSE '其他用户' END AS user_tag FROM user_active_stats

sql_units: /* --注意这个任务的不能和上游整包版本号集合一起回刷，因为依赖只能设计当天，但实际需要依赖从版更第一天至当天，这个没法实现，因此需要等上游全跑完了，才能刷下游 */ /* set spark.dynamicAllocation.maxExecutors=45; */ /* set spark.executor.cores=4; */ /* set spark.executor.memory=16g; */ /* set spark.executor.memoryOverhead=2048; */ /* set spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.initialPartitionNum=600; */ WITH last_big_version_date /* -距离数据日期最近的版本日期 */ AS (SELECT MAX(formal_start_date) AS big_version_date, MIN_BY(client_version, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', formal_start_date)) AS client_version, MIN_BY(version_pre3num, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', formal_start_date)) AS version_pre3num, MIN_BY(version_last2num, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', formal_start_date)) AS version_last2num, MAX(1) AS sup FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_full_update_version_list WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND formal_start_date <= '2026-05-31'), fullupdate_versionlist /* -全服版本日期之后的所有整包版本list */ AS (SELECT s1.client_version FROM (SELECT logymd, client_version, MAX(1) AS sup FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_full_update_version_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, client_version) AS s1 JOIN last_big_version_date AS s2 ON s1.sup = s2.sup AND s1.logymd >= s2.big_version_date /* -全服日期之后 */ GROUP BY s1.client_version), fullversion_first_date /* --找到整包版本的首次登录时刻， 以及对应的标签和appclickid，用来关联计算登录51步时长 */ AS (SELECT s1.accountid, s1.client_version, MIN(logymd) AS first_fullversion_update_date, MIN(time) AS time, MIN_BY(app_clickid, time) AS app_clickid, MIN_BY(ip, time) AS ip, MIN_BY(channel, time) AS channel, MIN_BY(os_type, time) AS os_type, MIN_BY(client_country, time) AS client_country, MIN_BY(zone_id, time) AS zone_id, MIN_BY(loginv2_start, time) AS loginv2_start, MIN_BY(login_auth, time) AS login_auth, MIN_BY(gameserver_login, time) AS gameserver_login, MIN_BY(gameserver_loginv2, time) AS gameserver_loginv2, MIN_BY(device_id, time) AS device_id FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, client_version, ip, channel, os_type, client_country, zone_id, time, loginv2_start, login_auth, gameserver_login, gameserver_loginv2, device_id, app_clickid, 1 AS sup FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_user_login_funnel1_fullversion_login_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND update_type = 'fullversion_user') AS s1 JOIN last_big_version_date AS s2 ON s1.sup = s2.sup AND s1.logymd >= s2.big_version_date /* -全服日期之后 */ GROUP BY s1.accountid, s1.client_version), table_union AS (SELECT accountid, client_version, time, app_clickid, ip, channel, os_type, client_country, zone_id, loginv2_start, login_auth, gameserver_login, gameserver_loginv2, device_id, 'fullversion_user' AS update_type FROM fullversion_first_date WHERE first_fullversion_update_date = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT accountid, client_version, time, app_clickid, ip, channel, os_type, client_country, zone_id, loginv2_start, login_auth, gameserver_login, gameserver_loginv2, device_id, 'hotupdate_user' AS update_type FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_user_login_funnel1_fullversion_login_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND update_type = 'hotupdate_user'), output_table AS (SELECT s1.*, s2.step_json, s2.step_reason_json, s3.logintime_end, s3.loginv2_end, s4.fullupdate_rk, s5.first_update_version, s5.first_update_version_time FROM table_union AS s1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, app_clickid, MAX(step_json) AS step_json, MAX(step_reason_json) AS step_reason_json FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_reportserver_client_loginv2_data_transform_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, app_clickid) AS s2 ON s1.accountid = s2.accountid AND s1.app_clickid = s2.app_clickid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, app_clickid, MAX(1) AS loginv2_end, MIN(time) AS time, MAX(logintime / 1000) AS logintime_end FROM ml_ods.reportserver_client_loginv2_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, app_clickid) AS s3 ON s1.accountid = s3.accountid AND s1.app_clickid = s3.app_clickid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, client_version, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY time ASC) AS fullupdate_rk /* --今天是整包版本的第几次更新 */ FROM fullversion_first_date) AS s4 ON s1.accountid = s4.accountid AND s1.client_version = s4.client_version LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, MIN_BY(client_version, time) AS first_update_version /* --用户首次参与整包更新的版本 */, MIN(time) AS first_update_version_time /* -用户首次参与整包更新时间 */ FROM fullversion_first_date GROUP BY accountid) AS s5 ON s1.accountid = s5.accountid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jaxzhong_today_fullversion_and_hot_update_user_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 覆盖写入 */ SELECT accountid, client_version, time, app_clickid, ip, channel, os_type, client_country, zone_id, loginv2_start, login_auth, gameserver_login, gameserver_loginv2, device_id, update_type, step_json, step_reason_json, logintime_end, loginv2_end, fullupdate_rk, first_update_version, first_update_version_time FROM output_table

name: jaxzhong_整包更新和热更新上游表
output_hint: jaxzhong_整包更新和热更新上游表
sql_units: WITH last_big_version_date /* -距离数据日期最近的版本日期 */ AS (SELECT MAX(formal_start_date) AS big_version_date, MIN_BY(client_version, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', formal_start_date)) AS client_version, MIN_BY(version_pre3num, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', formal_start_date)) AS version_pre3num, MIN_BY(version_last2num, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', formal_start_date)) AS version_last2num, MAX(1) AS sup FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_full_update_version_list WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND formal_start_date <= '2026-05-31'), fullupdate_versionlist /* -全服版本日期之后的所有整包版本list */ AS (SELECT s1.client_version FROM (SELECT logymd, client_version, MAX(1) AS sup FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_full_update_version_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, client_version) AS s1 JOIN last_big_version_date AS s2 ON s1.sup = s2.sup AND s1.logymd >= s2.big_version_date /* -全服日期之后 */ GROUP BY s1.client_version), user_main /* -当天使用整包版本登录的用户 */ AS (SELECT accountid, client_version, ip, channel, os_type, client_country, zone_id, time, loginv2_start, login_auth, gameserver_login, gameserver_loginv2, loginv2_start_pv, login_auth_pv, gameserver_login_pv, gameserver_loginv2_pv, total_start_pv, device_id, app_clickid, loginv2_start_time, login_auth_time, gameserver_login_time, gameserver_loginv2_time, CONCAT(SPLIT(client_version, '\\.')[0], '.', SPLIT(client_version, '\\.')[1], '.', SPLIT(client_version, '\\.')[2]) AS version1 /* -整包版本号，spark语法 */, CONCAT(SPLIT(client_version, '\\.')[3], '.', SPLIT(client_version, '\\.')[4]) AS version2 /* -资源版本号，spark语法 */, 1 AS sup FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_user_login_funnel1_all_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), fullversion_user /* -今日登录了整包版本号的用户，还需要在下游计算出用户首次使用整包版本号登录的用户，才是参与整包更新用户 */ AS (SELECT s1.accountid, s1.client_version, MIN(time) AS time, MIN_BY(channel, time) AS channel, MIN_BY(os_type, time) AS os_type, MIN_BY(client_country, time) AS client_country, MIN_BY(zone_id, time) AS zone_id, MIN_BY(ip, time) AS ip, MIN_BY(GEOIP(ip, 5), time) AS net, MIN_BY(device_id, time) AS device_id, MIN_BY(app_clickid, time) AS app_clickid, MAX(loginv2_start) AS loginv2_start, MAX(login_auth) AS login_auth, MAX(gameserver_login) AS gameserver_login, MAX(gameserver_loginv2) AS gameserver_loginv2 FROM user_main AS s1 WHERE client_version IN (SELECT client_version FROM fullupdate_versionlist) /* -这里不用分IOS和安卓，一个整包版本号，一定同时在安卓和IOS都是整包版本，不会出现安卓是IOS不是 */ GROUP BY s1.accountid, s1.client_version), hotupdate_user /* --只要今天用户登录的版本号低于全服版本的资源版本号，就是参与了热更新，这里可能包含切测服用户发生二次参与热更新 */ AS (SELECT s1.accountid, s1.client_version, MIN(time) AS time, MIN_BY(channel, time) AS channel, MIN_BY(os_type, time) AS os_type, MIN_BY(client_country, time) AS client_country, MIN_BY(zone_id, time) AS zone_id, MIN_BY(ip, time) AS ip, MIN_BY(GEOIP(ip, 5), time) AS net, MIN_BY(device_id, time) AS device_id, MIN_BY(app_clickid, time) AS app_clickid, MAX(loginv2_start) AS loginv2_start, MAX(login_auth) AS login_auth, MAX(gameserver_login) AS gameserver_login, MAX(gameserver_loginv2) AS gameserver_loginv2 FROM user_main AS s1 JOIN last_big_version_date AS s2 ON s1.sup = s2.sup /* -全服日期之后 */ WHERE s1.version2 < s2.version_last2num GROUP BY s1.accountid, s1.client_version) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jaxzhong_user_login_funnel1_fullversion_login_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 覆盖写入 */ SELECT accountid, client_version, ip, channel, os_type, client_country, zone_id, time, loginv2_start, login_auth, gameserver_login, gameserver_loginv2, device_id, 'fullversion_user' AS update_type, app_clickid FROM fullversion_user UNION ALL SELECT accountid, client_version, ip, channel, os_type, client_country, zone_id, time, loginv2_start, login_auth, gameserver_login, gameserver_loginv2, name: MC2_游廊流转标签
sql_units:
/* ========== 今天 LEFT JOIN 过去三天，生成组合标签 ========== */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: selinasun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-08-14 20:02:54.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 20250814：为检测游廊开启后流转 dau，1）游廊登录最近未登录独立端，2）游廊登录最近有登录独立段，3）独立端登录最近未登录游廊，4）独立端登录最近有登录游廊，5）独立端登录最近(不含当天)仅登录游廊，6）游廊登录最近(不含当天)仅登录独立端  7）当天同时登录游廊和独立端  2+4+7合并
 1. 当日新增 （只展示新增人数，具体渠道可以通过看板筛选器）
 2. 当日回流（区分回流当日登陆过 游廊/独立段/both，最终成3类）
 3. 当日持续活跃 （根据之前商量过的区分7类人，然后2+4+7合并，最终成5类） */ /* ========== 今天（2026-05-31） ========== */ WITH today_unioned AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd, channel, os_type, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS ip_country, TIME, 1 AS rk1 /* 登录优先 */ FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_vp = 0 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd, channel, os_type, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS ip_country, TIME, 2 AS rk1 /* 付费次之 */ FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND money > 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND is_sandbox = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%'), today_norm AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd, os_type, ip_country, TIME, rk1, CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(channel, '')) LIKE '%mllobby%' THEN 'mllobby' ELSE 'mcgg' END AS ch_norm FROM today_unioned), today_agg AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT ch_norm) AS ch_distinct, MAX(CASE WHEN ch_norm = 'mllobby' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_mllobby FROM today_norm GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), today_label AS (SELECT n.roleid, n.zoneid, CASE WHEN a.ch_distinct >= 2 THEN 'both' WHEN a.any_mllobby = 1 THEN 'mllobby' ELSE 'mcapp' END AS today_tag FROM today_norm AS n JOIN today_agg AS a ON a.roleid = n.roleid AND a.zoneid = n.zoneid GROUP BY n.roleid, n.zoneid, CASE WHEN a.ch_distinct >= 2 THEN 'both' WHEN a.any_mllobby = 1 THEN 'mllobby' ELSE 'mcapp' END), prev3d_unioned /* ========== 过去三天整体（不含今天）：[DATE-3, DATE-1] ========== */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd, channel, os_type, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS ip_country, TIME, 1 AS rk1 FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 3 * -1) AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1) AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_vp = 0 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, usercreateymd, channel, os_type, GEOIP(client_ip, 1) AS ip_country, TIME, 2 AS rk1 FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 3 * -1) AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1) AND money > 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND is_sandbox = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%'), prev3d_norm AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, TIME, rk1, CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(channel, '')) LIKE '%mllobby%' THEN 'mllobby' ELSE 'mcgg' END AS ch_norm FROM prev3d_unioned), prev3d_agg AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT ch_norm) AS ch_distinct, MAX(CASE WHEN ch_norm = 'mllobby' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_mllobby FROM prev3d_norm GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), prev3d_label AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN a.ch_distinct >= 2 THEN 'both' WHEN a.any_mllobby = 1 THEN 'mllobby' ELSE 'mcapp' END AS prev3d_tag FROM prev3d_agg AS a), usertype AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(CASE WHEN if_new = 1 THEN 'a.new' WHEN return_type IN ('c.30-59', 'd.60+') THEN 'b.return' ELSE 'c.active' END) AS usertype FROM mcgg_temp.vickyyu_return_4tag_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.selinasun_active_user_channeltag_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t.roleid, t.zoneid, usertype, t.today_tag AS today_channel_tag, COALESCE(p.prev3d_tag, 'na') AS prev3d_channel_tag, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.prev3d_tag, 'na'), '_', t.today_tag) AS combined_channel_tag FROM today_label AS t LEFT JOIN prev3d_label AS p ON p.roleid = t.roleid AND p.zoneid = t.zoneid LEFT JOIN usertype AS t1 ON t.roleid = t1.roleid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid

name: etl.ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_di_wefly_account_monthly
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jichun@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2024-07-23 22:39:53.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mt_ads`.`ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_di`( */ /*             `date_range` STRING COMMENT '日期区间', */ /*             `country` STRING COMMENT '国家', */ /*             `network` STRING COMMENT '首次广告归因渠道', */ /*             `indicator_map` STRING COMMENT '指标集合' */ /*         ) COMMENT '经分首页boss看板-cube指标' */ /*         PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*             `logymd` STRING COMMENT '日期分区(yyy-MM-dd)', */ /*             `appname` STRING COMMENT '项目ID(mlbb,xgame)', */ /*             `granularity_type` STRING COMMENT '粒度类型(account,device)', */ /*             `date_type` STRING COMMENT '日期类型(daily,weekly,monthly)' */ /*         ) STORED AS parquet location 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_di'; */ WITH monthly_mid AS (SELECT date_range, SUBSTRING(date_range, 1, 7) AS date_month, country, network, os, channel, user_type, SPLIT(tbl.col, ':')[0] AS item, SPLIT(tbl.col, ':')[1] AS quantity FROM (SELECT date_range, country, network, os, channel, user_type, REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(TO_JSON(indicator_map) AS STRING), '{', ''), '}', '') AS indicator_map FROM mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_di_mid WHERE logymd = LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND appname = 'wefly' AND granularity_type = 'account' AND date_type = 'monthly') LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(indicator_map, ',')) /* 分隔符如果是分号的话，替换成\073 */ tbl AS col) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT date_month AS date_range, country, network, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', item, quantity))), ',', ':') AS indicator_map, os AS os, channel AS channel, NULL AS network_group, NULL AS new_type, NULL AS install_label, NULL AS arcade_label, NULL AS active_label, user_type, LAST_DAY(CONCAT(date_month, '-01')) AS logymd, 'wegame' AS appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'monthly' AS date_type FROM (SELECT date_month, country, network, os, channel, user_type, REPLACE(item, '"', '') AS item, quantity FROM monthly_mid) GROUP BY date_month, country, network, os, channel, user_type

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_monitor_report_poc_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: niangangdeng@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-08-18 11:03:14.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_dm.dm_monitor_report_poc_di */ /* ( */ /*     region_id                   BIGINT          COMMENT '大区ID', */ /*     os_type                     STRING          COMMENT '操作系统类型', */ /*     metric_name                 STRING          COMMENT '指标名称', */ /*     upper_term                  BIGINT          COMMENT '指标分子', */ /*     lower_term                  BIGINT          COMMENT '指标分母' */ /* ) COMMENT '指标异动分析对象' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyyy-MM-dd') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dm/table/dm_monitor_report_poc_di'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_monitor_report_poc_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT region_id, os_type, '参战率' AS metric_name, SUM(is_engaged_battle) AS upper_term, SUM(1) AS lower_term FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.region_id, a.os_type, IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_engaged_battle FROM (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) AS region_id, CASE WHEN os_type = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN os_type = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN os_type = 3 THEN 'vp' ELSE 'other' END AS os_type FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT roleid IS NULL AND NOT zoneid IS NULL) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) AS tmp GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((region_id, os_type), (region_id), (os_type))

OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_event_time, FIRST_VALUE(client_ip) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_client_ip, FIRST_VALUE(client_ip) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_client_ip, FIRST_VALUE(model) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_model, FIRST_VALUE(model) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_model, FIRST_VALUE(os_version) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_os_version, FIRST_VALUE(os_version) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_os_version, FIRST_VALUE(network_type) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_network_type, FIRST_VALUE(network_type) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_network_type, FIRST_VALUE(system_language) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_os_language, FIRST_VALUE(system_language) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_os_language, FIRST_VALUE(ip_country) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_ip_country, FIRST_VALUE(ip_country) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_ip_country, FIRST_VALUE(client_version) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_client_version, FIRST_VALUE(client_version) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_client_version, FIRST_VALUE(sdk_version) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS first_sdk_version, FIRST_VALUE(sdk_version) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_sdk_version, FIRST_VALUE(level) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS last_level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(m__package_name)), 'unknown') AS package_name, COALESCE(m__did, 'unknown') AS did, COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(m__os)), 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(m__is_emulator, -1) AS is_emulator, COALESCE(m__os_version, 'unknown') AS os_version, COALESCE(m__system_language, 'unknown') AS os_language, COALESCE(m__role_id, 'unknown') AS account_id, COALESCE(m__role_id, 'unknown') AS role_id, COALESCE(m__zone_id, 'unknown') AS zone_id, time AS event_time, COALESCE(m__client_ip, 'unknown') AS client_ip, COALESCE(m__model, 'unknown') AS model, COALESCE(LOWER(m__network_type), 'unknown') AS network_type, COALESCE(m__system_language, 'unknown') AS system_language, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, 1)) AS ip_country, COALESCE(m__client_version, 'unknown') AS client_version, COALESCE(m__sdk_version, 'unknown') AS sdk_version, -99999 AS level, m__app_id AS app_id FROM wefly_ob_ods.login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd > '2025-08-26' AND m__zone_id > 9999) AS a) AS evt_log WHERE rn = 1) AS event_log LEFT JOIN (SELECT m__app_id AS app_id, a.roleid AS account_id /* package_name, */, SUM(COALESCE(online_time, 0)) AS online_time /* os, */ FROM wefly_ob_ods.logout AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND m__zone_id > 9999 AND logymd > '2025-08-26' GROUP BY m__app_id, roleid) AS ol_time ON event_log.app_id = ol_time.app_id AND /* AND     event_log.package_name = ol_time.package_name */ event_log.account_id = ol_time.account_id /* AND     event_log.os = ol_time.os */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT m__app_id AS app_id, roleid AS account_id, COUNT(1) AS login_cnt FROM wefly_ob_ods.login AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND m__zone_id > 9999 AND logymd > '2025-08-26' GROUP BY m__app_id, roleid) AS login_cnt ON event_log.app_id = login_cnt.app_id AND event_log.account_id = login_cnt.account_id

name: etl.msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_di_moba
sql_units: /*     ) */ /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_di ( */ /*     account_id                    STRING COMMENT '账号id, key', */ /*     did                           STRING COMMENT '应用的自定义设备指纹', */ /*     package_name                  STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名, key', */ /*     os                            STRING COMMENT '操作系统', */ /*     day_first_model               STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 首次', */ /*     day_last_model                STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 末次', */ /*     day_first_os_version          STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本,首次', */ /*     day_last_os_version           STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本, 末次', */ /*     day_first_client_version      STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 首次', */ /*     day_last_client_version       STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 末次', */ /*     day_first_charge_time         STRING COMMENT '当天首次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     day_last_charge_time          STRING COMMENT '当天末次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     day_charge_cnt                BIGINT COMMENT '当天累计付费次数', */ /*     day_charge_sum                BIGINT COMMENT '当天累计付费金额（美分）' */ /* -- ) COMMENT '设备付费行为增量表格' PARTITIONED BY ( logymd STRING COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', app_id INT COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key' ) STORED AS PARQUET; */ /* WITH pay_event_succeed AS ( */ /*     SELECT  role_id AS account_id, */ /*             did, */ /*             app_id, */ /*             package_name, */ /*             os, */ /*             model, */ /*             os_version, */ /*             client_version, */ /*             event_time, */ /*             price, */ /*             ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( */ /*                 PARTITION BY */ /*                         role_id, */ /*                         app_id */ /*                 ORDER BY */ /*                         event_time DESC */ /*             ) AS rec_desc, */ /*             ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( */ /*                 PARTITION BY */ /*                         role_id, */ /*                         app_id */ /*                 ORDER BY */ /*                         event_time ASC */ /*             ) AS rec_asc, */ /*             IF(logymd <= '2024-10-17' */ /*     AND     app_id = 4280, 1, 0) AS is_delete */ /*     FROM    msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di */ /*     WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /*     AND     event IN ('purchase_event', '__purchase_event__', '__purchase_deliver_event__') --投放重构充值接口__purchase_deliver_event__ 发货 __purchase_verify_event__ 校验 __purchase_refund_event__ 退款 */ /*             --   AND purchase_type = '1' --"支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test3. Promo4. Rewarded" */ /*     AND     purchase_type IN ('1', '3', '4') --"支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test 3. Promo4. Rewarded" */ /*     AND     step = 'STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER' --"表示支付流程到了第几步：校验STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_VERIFY发货STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER,暂时只有发货的步骤" */ /*     AND     result_code IN (22000, 13000) --未处理result_code: 21900 已处理 22000  订单参数异常 24900 服务器逻辑异常 25900 */ /*     AND     app_id <> 4280 */ WITH wefly_pay AS (SELECT roleid AS account_id, did, m__app_id AS app_id, LOWER(m__package_name) AS package_name, COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(m__os)), 'unknown') AS os, m__model AS model, m__os_version AS os_version, m__client_version AS client_version, m__event_time, money AS price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, m__app_id ORDER BY time DESC) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, m__app_id ORDER BY time ASC) AS rec_asc, 0 AS is_delete, time FROM wefly_ob_ods.charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid > 9999 AND logymd > '2025-08-26') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id = 4310) SELECT TRIM(t1.account_id), TRIM(t1.did) AS did, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.day_first_model, t1.day_last_model, t1.day_first_os_version, t1.day_last_os_version, t1.day_first_client_version, t1.day_last_client_version, t1.day_first_charge_time, t1.day_last_charge_time, t2.charge_cnt, t2.charge_sum, 0 AS actual_amt, '01' AS stage_id FROM (SELECT MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, did, NULL)) AS did, account_id, app_id, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, package_name, NULL)) AS package_name, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os, NULL)) AS os, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_first_model, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_last_model, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_first_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_last_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_first_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_last_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, time, NULL)) AS day_first_charge_time, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, time, NULL)) AS day_last_charge_time FROM wefly_pay WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY account_id, app_id) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT account_id, app_id, COUNT(1) AS charge_cnt, SUM(price) AS charge_sum FROM wefly_pay GROUP BY account_id, app_id) AS t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.app_id = t2.app_id

name: mtai_test.dwm_mcgg_behavior_commercial_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* ===================== 分区写入（INSERT OVERWRITE） ===================== */ /* ============================== CTEs ============================== */ WITH user_base /* 1) 活跃用户 + 期末余额/当日获得 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(SUM(chargediamond), 0) AS chargediamond, COALESCE(SUM(curdiamond), 0) AS curdiamond, COALESCE(SUM(curbattle_points), 0) AS curbattle_point /* 源字段名为 curbattle_points */, COALESCE(SUM(curticket), 0) AS curticket FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), daily_charge /* 2) 当日充值汇总（预聚合表） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(yl_pay_amt, 0) AS yl_pay_amt, COALESCE(else_pay_amt, 0) AS else_pay_amt, COALESCE(third_pay_amt, 0) AS third_pay_amt, COALESCE(mobapay_amt, 0) AS mobapay_amt, COALESCE(nomobapay_amt, 0) AS nomobapay_amt FROM mcgg_temp.sjlyu_daily_user_charge_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), purchase_counts /* 3) 充值次数（严格口径） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS pay_count FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND money > 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND is_sandbox = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), iap_by_type /* 4) IAP 产品类型：分组后拼装 map（使用 map_from_entries 生成数值型 map） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, iap_product_type, COUNT(1) AS purchase_count, CAST(SUM(money) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_amount FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND money > 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND is_sandbox = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' AND NOT iap_product_type IS NULL GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, iap_product_type), iap_purchase_maps AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(CAST(iap_product_type AS STRING), CAST(purchase_count AS BIGINT)))) AS iap_product_count_map, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(CAST(iap_product_type AS STRING), CAST(purchase_amount AS DOUBLE)))) AS iap_product_amt_map FROM iap_by_type GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), charge_by_channel /* 5) 充值渠道金额 map：两阶段（数值型 map） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pay_channel, CAST(SUM(money) AS DOUBLE) AS amt FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND money > 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND is_sandbox = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pay_channel), pay_channel_map AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(CAST(pay_channel AS STRING), CAST(amt AS DOUBLE)))) AS pay_channel_amt_map FROM charge_by_channel GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), sub_diamond_tagged /* 6) 钻石消耗：总量 + operate 分类 map（数值型 map） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN operate LIKE '%action_act_magicchessthemelottery%' THEN 'SP抽奖' WHEN operate IN ('action_act_mc2battlepass', 'action_act_mc2battlepass_upgrade', 'action_act_mc2battlepass_plus', 'action_act_mc2battlepasslevelup') THEN 'BP' WHEN operate = 'shop_buy' THEN '商城' WHEN operate = 'gift_buy' THEN '捆绑礼包' WHEN operate LIKE '%magicdraw%' THEN '常驻抽奖' ELSE '其他' END AS spend_category, sub_num FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000), diamond_spend_total AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num FROM sub_diamond_tagged GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), diamond_spend_by_cat AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, spend_category, SUM(sub_num) AS amt FROM sub_diamond_tagged GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, spend_category), diamond_spend_map AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(spend_category, CAST(amt AS BIGINT)))) AS sub_operate_map FROM diamond_spend_by_cat GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), shop_item_count /* 7) 商城：数量 + 货币类型 map（数值型 map） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(itemnum) AS shop_item_count FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_shop_buy WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), shop_by_moneytype AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, moneytype, CAST(SUM(moneynum) AS DOUBLE) AS amt FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_shop_buy WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND moneytype IN (300, 301, 302) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, moneytype), shop_moneytype_map AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(CAST(moneytype AS STRING), CAST(amt AS DOUBLE)))) AS shop_moneytype_amt_map FROM shop_by_moneytype GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), sp_draw /* 8) SP 抽奖：次数/钻石/券 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN record_type IN (1, 2, 11) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS themedraw_count /* 抽奖次数：仅记录抽行为（1单抽/2十连/11折扣十连） */, SUM(CASE WHEN costitem LIKE '%301-%' THEN CAST((CASE WHEN LOCATE('\\073', costitem) > 0 THEN SPLIT(SPLIT(costitem, '\\073')[1], '-')[1] ELSE SPLIT(costitem, '-')[1] END) AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END) AS themedraw_diamond_cost /* 钻石消耗（costitem 形如：'券ID-5\073301-100' 或 '301-100'） */, SUM(CASE WHEN costitem LIKE '%\\073%' THEN CAST(SPLIT(SPLIT(costitem, '\\073')[0], '-')[1] AS BIGINT) WHEN costitem NOT LIKE '%301-%' AND NOT costitem IS NULL THEN CAST(SPLIT(costitem, '-')[1] AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END) AS themedraw_ticket_cost /* 券/道具消耗（若存在前段） */ FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_act_themedraw WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), a_sp_draw_rt_cnt /* SP 抽奖：record_type 与 act_id 两个 map（数值型 map） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, record_type, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_act_themedraw WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, record_type), sp_draw_rt_map AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(CAST(record_type AS STRING), CAST(cnt AS BIGINT)))) AS themedraw_record_type_count_map FROM a_sp_draw_rt_cnt GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), a_sp_draw_act_cnt AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, act_id, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_act_themedraw WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, act_id), sp_draw_act_map AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(CAST(act_id AS STRING), CAST(cnt AS BIGINT)))) AS themedraw_by_act_count_map FROM a_sp_draw_act_cnt GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), magic_draw /* 9) 常驻抽奖：次数/钻石/券 + 兑换次数 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS magic_draw_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cost LIKE '%301:%' THEN CAST((CASE WHEN LOCATE('\\073', cost) > 0 THEN SPLIT(SPLIT(cost, '\\073')[1], ':')[1] ELSE SPLIT(cost, ':')[1] END) AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END) AS magic_draw_diamond_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN cost LIKE '%\\073%' THEN CAST(SPLIT(SPLIT(cost, '\\073')[0], ':')[1] AS BIGINT) WHEN cost NOT LIKE '301:%' AND NOT cost IS NULL THEN CAST(SPLIT(cost, ':')[1] AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END) AS magic_draw_ticket_cost FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_act_magic_draw_reward WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), magic_exchange AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS magic_draw_exchange_count FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_act_magic_draw_exchange WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), bp_clicks /* 10) BP 点击 */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, SUM(click_buybp_num) AS bp_click_buybp_count, SUM(click_buybpplus_num) AS bp_click_buybpplus_count, SUM(click_buylevel_num) AS bp_click_buylevel_count FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_mc2_battlepass_click WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), bp_browse /* 11) BP 曝光 */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS bp_browse_count FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_mc2_battlepass_browse WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), bp_activate /* 12) BP 激活与升级 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS bp_activation_count, COALESCE(SUM(cost_diamond), 0) AS bp_activation_diamond_cost FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_mc2_battlepass_active WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), bp_activate_cnt AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, active_type, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_mc2_battlepass_active WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, active_type), bp_activate_map AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(CAST(active_type AS STRING), CAST(cnt AS BIGINT)))) AS bp_activation_type_count_map FROM bp_activate_cnt GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), bp_upgrade AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS bp_plus_upgrade_count, COALESCE(SUM(cost_diamond), 0) AS bp_plus_upgrade_diamond_cost FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_mc2_battlepass_upgrade_plus WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), bp_exp /* 13) BP 经验与任务 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(add_exp) AS bp_exp_added_total, SUM(CASE WHEN operate = 1 THEN add_exp ELSE 0 END) AS bp_exp_added_by_diamond FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_mc2_battlepass_add_exp WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), bp_tasks AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bp_tasks_completed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bp_tasks_reward_claimed_count FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_mc2_battlepass_task_flow WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mtai_test.dwm_mcgg_behavior_commercial_role_zone_di PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT CAST(ub.roleid AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) AS roleid /* 与目标表类型严格对齐 */, CAST(ub.zoneid AS BIGINT) AS zoneid, ub.chargediamond /* 余额/获得 */, ub.curdiamond, ub.curbattle_point, ub.curticket, dc.pay_amt /* 充值 */, dc.yl_pay_amt, dc.else_pay_amt, dc.third_pay_amt, dc.mobapay_amt, dc.nomobapay_amt, pc.pay_count, iap.iap_product_count_map AS iap_product_count_map /* IAP/渠道 map（数值型 map） */, iap.iap_product_amt_map AS iap_product_amt_map, ch.pay_channel_amt_map AS pay_channel_amt_map, COALESCE(dst.sub_num, 0) AS sub_num /* 钻石消耗 */, dsm.sub_operate_map AS sub_operate_map, COALESCE(sic.shop_item_count, 0) AS shop_item_count /* 商城 */, smm.shop_moneytype_amt_map AS shop_moneytype_amt_map, COALESCE(sd.themedraw_count, 0) AS themedraw_count /* SP 抽奖 */, COALESCE(sd.themedraw_diamond_cost, 0) AS themedraw_diamond_cost, COALESCE(sd.themedraw_ticket_cost, 0) AS themedraw_ticket_cost, sdrm.themedraw_record_type_count_map AS themedraw_record_type_count_map, sdam.themedraw_by_act_count_map AS themedraw_by_act_count_map, COALESCE(md.magic_draw_count, 0) AS magic_draw_count /* 常驻抽奖 */, COALESCE(md.magic_draw_diamond_cost, 0) AS magic_draw_diamond_cost, COALESCE(md.magic_draw_ticket_cost, 0) AS magic_draw_ticket_cost, COALESCE(me.magic_draw_exchange_count, 0) AS magic_draw_exchange_count, COALESCE(bc.bp_click_buybp_count, 0) AS bp_click_buybp_count /* BP 交互 */, COALESCE(bc.bp_click_buybpplus_count, 0) AS bp_click_buybpplus_count, COALESCE(bc.bp_click_buylevel_count, 0) AS bp_click_buylevel_count, COALESCE(bb.bp_browse_count, 0) AS bp_browse_count, COALESCE(ba.bp_activation_count, 0) AS bp_activation_count /* BP 激活/升级 */, COALESCE(ba.bp_activation_diamond_cost, 0) AS bp_activation_diamond_cost, bam.bp_activation_type_count_map AS bp_activation_type_count_map, COALESCE(bu.bp_plus_upgrade_count, 0) AS bp_plus_upgrade_count, COALESCE(bu.bp_plus_upgrade_diamond_cost, 0) AS bp_plus_upgrade_diamond_cost, COALESCE(be.bp_exp_added_total, 0) AS bp_exp_added_total /* BP 经验与任务 */, COALESCE(be.bp_exp_added_by_diamond, 0) AS bp_exp_added_by_diamond, COALESCE(bt.bp_tasks_completed_count, 0) AS bp_tasks_completed_count, COALESCE(bt.bp_tasks_reward_claimed_count, 0) AS bp_tasks_reward_claimed_count FROM user_base AS ub LEFT JOIN daily_charge AS dc ON ub.roleid = dc.roleid AND ub.zoneid = dc.zoneid LEFT JOIN purchase_counts AS pc ON ub.roleid = pc.roleid AND ub.zoneid = pc.zoneid LEFT JOIN iap_purchase_maps AS iap ON ub.roleid = iap.roleid AND ub.zoneid = iap.zoneid LEFT JOIN pay_channel_map AS ch ON ub.roleid = ch.roleid AND ub.zoneid = ch.zoneid LEFT */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), recent_50_rank_battle /* 最近50场排位模式各分路场次 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN exp_road_lose_cnt + exp_road_win_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_exp_50bc, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN mid_road_lose_cnt + mid_road_win_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_mid_50bc, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN coin_road_lose_cnt + coin_road_win_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_coin_50bc, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN jungle_road_lose_cnt + jungle_road_win_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_jungle_50bc, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN roam_road_lose_cnt + roam_road_win_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_roam_50bc FROM (/* SELECT */ /*     roleid, */ /*     zoneid, */ /*     pvptype, */ /*     -- LENGTH(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ',')) - 计算包含逗号分隔符的完整字符串长度 */ /*     -- LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(..., '10', '')) - 计算删除所有'10'后的字符串长度 */ /*     -- 相减 - 得到被删除的字符数量（即所有'10'的总长度） */ /*     -- 除以2 - 因为每个'10'占用2个字符，所以除以2得到实际的数量 */ /*     (LENGTH(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ',')) - LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ','), '10', ''))) / 2 AS exp_road_lose_cnt, */ /*     (LENGTH(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ',')) - LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ','), '11', ''))) / 2 AS exp_road_win_cnt, */ /*     (LENGTH(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ',')) - LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ','), '20', ''))) / 2 AS mid_road_lose_cnt, */ /*     (LENGTH(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ',')) - LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ','), '21', ''))) / 2 AS mid_road_win_cnt, */ /*     (LENGTH(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ',')) - LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ','), '50', ''))) / 2 AS coin_road_lose_cnt, */ /*     (LENGTH(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ',')) - LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ','), '51', ''))) / 2 AS coin_road_win_cnt, */ /*     (LENGTH(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ',')) - LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ','), '40', ''))) / 2 AS jungle_road_lose_cnt, */ /*     (LENGTH(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ',')) - LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ','), '41', ''))) / 2 AS jungle_road_win_cnt, */ /*     (LENGTH(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ',')) - LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ','), '30', ''))) / 2 AS roam_road_lose_cnt, */ /*     (LENGTH(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ',')) - LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ARRAY_JOIN(battleroad_info, ','), '31', ''))) / 2 AS roam_road_win_cnt */ /* FROM mt_dwd.dwd_road_info_role_zone_di */ /* WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-01' and '2026-05-31' */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, SUM(CASE WHEN road_item = '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exp_road_lose_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN road_item = '11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exp_road_win_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN road_item = '20' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mid_road_lose_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN road_item = '21' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mid_road_win_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN road_item = '50' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coin_road_lose_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN road_item = '51' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coin_road_win_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN road_item = '40' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jungle_road_lose_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN road_item = '41' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jungle_road_win_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN road_item = '30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS roam_road_lose_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN road_item = '31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS roam_road_win_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, MAX(battleroad_info) AS battleroad_info FROM mt_dwd.dwd_road_info_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype) LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(battleroad_info) exploded_table AS road_item /* WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-21' AND '2026-05-31' */ /* where logymd = '2026-05-31' */ WHERE NOT road_item IS NULL /* 可选：过滤空值 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype) AS road_info GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), road_realpower /* 各分路realpower值 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_exp_road_real_power AS o_c_exp_realpower, his_last_mid_road_real_power AS o_c_mid_realpower, his_last_roam_road_real_power AS o_c_roam_realpower, his_last_jungle_road_real_power AS o_c_jungle_realpower, his_last_gold_road_real_power AS o_c_coin_realpower FROM mt_dm.dm_battle_road_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-07-15', '2023-07-15', '2026-05-31')), basic_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, is_win, battle_end_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, is_win ORDER BY battle_end_time) AS sub_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY battle_end_time) AS all_rn FROM mt_dwd.dwd_mode_list_battle_di WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 2 * -1) /* 最近3天 */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2), recent_3d_max_conwin /* 最近3天排位模式最大连胜次数 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN is_win = 1 THEN group_rn ELSE NULL END) AS o_c_rank_mode_max_conwin_3d FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, is_win, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, all_rn - sub_rn ORDER BY battle_end_time) AS group_rn FROM basic_info WHERE is_win = 1) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), recent_7d_rank_performance /* 最近7天排位模式MVP和超神场次 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN mvp_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS o_c_rank_mode_mvp_count_7d, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN continuekill_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS o_c_rank_mode_legendary_count_7d FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) /* 最近7天 */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), recent_3d_online_time /* 最近3天在线时长 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(day_login_duration) AS o_c_onlinetime_sum_3d FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 2 * -1) /* 最近3天 */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), custom_avatar_info /* 自定义头像信息 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN cur_avatar_type > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o_c_is_custom_face_image FROM mt_dwm.dwm_social_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mlbb_social_rec_v1_tag_base PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT ar.roleid, ar.zoneid, COALESCE(r50.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_jungle_50bc, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_jungle_50bc /* 最近50场排位模式各分路场次（按DDL顺序） */, COALESCE(r50.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_exp_50bc, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_exp_50bc, COALESCE(r50.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_coin_50bc, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_coin_50bc, COALESCE(r50.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_mid_50bc, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_mid_50bc, COALESCE(r50.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_roam_50bc, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_roam_50bc, COALESCE(rp.o_c_exp_realpower, 0) AS o_c_exp_realpower /* 各分路realpower值 */, COALESCE(rp.o_c_mid_realpower, 0) AS o_c_mid_realpower, COALESCE(rp.o_c_roam_realpower, 0) AS o_c_roam_realpower, COALESCE(rp.o_c_jungle_realpower, 0) AS o_c_jungle_realpower, COALESCE(rp.o_c_coin_realpower, 0) AS o_c_coin_realpower, COALESCE(rmc.o_c_rank_mode_max_conwin_3d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_max_conwin_3d /* 最近3天排位模式最大连胜次数 */, COALESCE(r7p.o_c_rank_mode_mvp_count_7d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_mvp_count_7d /* 最近7天排位模式MVP和超神场次 */, COALESCE(r7p.o_c_rank_mode_legendary_count_7d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_legendary_count_7d, COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_exp_7d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_exp_7d /* 最近7天排位模式战斗信息 */, COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_exp_7d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_exp_7d, COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_mid_7d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_mid_7d, COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_mid_7d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_mid_7d, COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_roam_7d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_roam_7d, COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_roam_7d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_roam_7d, COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_jungle_7d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_jungle_7d, COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_jungle_7d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_jungle_7d, COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_coin_7d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_coin_7d, COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_coin_7d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_coin_7d, COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_exp_7d, 0) /* 求和 */ + COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_mid_7d, 0) + COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_roam_7d, 0) + COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_jungle_7d, 0) + COALESCE(r7b.o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_coin_7d, 0) AS o_c_rank_mode_count_7d, COALESCE(ca.o_c_is_custom_face_image, 0) AS o_c_is_custom_face_image /* 自定义头像信息 */, COALESCE(r3o.o_c_onlinetime_sum_3d, 0) AS o_c_onlinetime_sum_3d /* 最近3天在线时长 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND /* 限制为当日活跃玩家 */ is_last_active = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS ar LEFT JOIN recent_50_rank_battle AS r50 ON ar.roleid = r50.roleid AND ar.zoneid = r50.zoneid LEFT JOIN road_realpower AS rp ON ar.roleid = rp.roleid AND ar.zoneid = rp.zoneid LEFT JOIN recent_3d_max_conwin AS rmc ON ar.roleid = rmc.roleid AND ar.zoneid = rmc.zoneid LEFT JOIN recent_7d_rank_battle AS r7b ON ar.roleid = r7b.roleid AND ar.zoneid = r7b.zoneid LEFT JOIN recent_7d_rank_performance AS r7p ON ar.roleid = r7p.roleid AND ar.zoneid = r7p.zoneid LEFT JOIN custom_avatar_info AS ca ON ar.roleid = ca.roleid AND ar.zoneid = ca.zoneid LEFT JOIN recent_3d_online_time AS r3o ON ar.roleid = r3o.roleid AND ar.zoneid = r3o.zoneid

DAYOFWEEK('2026-05-31')) % 7 - 3)), '-W', LPAD(CAST(WEEKOFYEAR('2026-05-31') AS STRING), 2, '0')) AS log_week /* 周的开始日期（周一） */, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', PMOD(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '1900-01-01') - 0, 7) * -1) AS week_start_date /* 周的结束日期（周日） */, DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', PMOD(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '1900-01-01') - 0, 7) * -1), 6) AS week_end_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_tz_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', PMOD(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '1900-01-01') - 0, 7) * -1) AND DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', PMOD(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '1900-01-01') - 0, 7) * -1), 6) AND timezone_type = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pay_channel_config, sub_pay_channel_config, pay_channel_type, pay_type, bill_country, currency, product_id, sub_pay_channel_config_source, CONCAT(YEAR(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', (8 - DAYOFWEEK('2026-05-31')) % 7 - 3)), '-W', LPAD(CAST(WEEKOFYEAR('2026-05-31') AS STRING), 2, '0')) /* 周的开始日期（周一） */, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', PMOD(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '1900-01-01') - 0, 7) * -1) /* 周的结束日期（周日） */, DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', PMOD(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '1900-01-01') - 0, 7) * -1), 6)), t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-01', '2025-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND is_first_create = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_finance_role_zone_tz_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type, timezone_type) SELECT t_charge.roleid, t_charge.zoneid, CASE WHEN zoneid < 57000 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS zone_type, log_week AS date_range, week_start_date AS date_range_start, week_end_date AS date_range_end, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, product_id, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, sub_pay_channel_source, pay_channel_type, pay_type, bill_country, t_charge.currency, product_money, actual_amt, actual_usd_amt, pay_amt, pay_usd_amt, week_end_date AS logymd, 'mlbb' AS appname, 'role' AS granularity_type, 'weekly' AS date_type, 0 AS timezone_type FROM t_charge LEFT JOIN t_basic ON t_charge.roleid = t_basic.roleid

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_monitor_dimension_cum_account_df
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_monitor_dimention_cum_account_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* * REPARTITION(50) */ SELECT COALESCE(df.accountid, di.accountid) AS accountid, COALESCE(di.realpicturequality, df.realpicturequality) AS realpicturequality, GREATEST(COALESCE(df.is_registered_mc, 0), COALESCE(di.is_registered_mc, 0)) AS is_registered_mc, GREATEST(COALESCE(df.is_installed_hok, 0), COALESCE(di.is_installed_hok, 0)) AS is_installed_hok FROM (SELECT * FROM mt_dm.dm_monitor_dimention_cum_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df FULL JOIN (SELECT t1.accountid, t2.realpicturequality AS realpicturequality, CASE WHEN NOT t3.accountid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_registered_mc, CASE WHEN NOT t4.accountid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_installed_hok FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (/* 机型品质 */ SELECT accountid, MAX_BY(realpicturequality, time) AS realpicturequality FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_configuration WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid) AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.accountid LEFT JOIN (/* 注册过MC */ SELECT roleid AS accountid FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ml_install = 1 GROUP BY roleid) AS t3 ON t1.accountid = t3.accountid LEFT JOIN (/* 安装过HOK */ SELECT accountid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_competitor_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2025-06-14', '2025-06-14', '2026-05-31') AND app_config_name LIKE '%Honor of Kings%' AND app_type = 1 GROUP BY accountid) AS t4 ON t1.accountid = t4.accountid) AS di ON df.accountid = di.accountid

name: aimatch实验留存数据_0820
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_ygao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-09-01 11:03:52.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH ab_group AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.param_version, vid, param_name, big_rank, b.enter_date, CASE WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) = 57 THEN 'test' WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) < 57 THEN 'prod' END AS env FROM (SELECT DISTINCT t1.logymd AS enter_date, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, CASE WHEN param_version = MAX(param_version) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) THEN '实验组' WHEN param_version = MIN(param_version) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) THEN '对照组' END AS param_version, param_version AS vid, param_name, big_rank FROM (SELECT DISTINCT logymd, roleid, zoneid, param_version, param_name FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-07-10' AND '2026-05-31' AND param_name LIKE '%aimatch%' AND param_version <> '' /* 0625实验存在空值 */ AND zoneid < 57000) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'a.勇士' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 'b.精英' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 6 AND 9 THEN 'c.大师' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 10 AND 16 THEN 'd.宗师' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 17 AND 25 THEN 'e.史诗' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN 'f.传奇' WHEN final_rank_id = 36 THEN 'g.神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 37 THEN 'h.百战神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 38 THEN 'i.荣耀神话' END) AS big_rank, roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_temp.daily_final_rank_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-07-10' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND season_id = 4 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t1.logymd = t2.logymd) AS b JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-08-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS a ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.logymd >= b.enter_date GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.enter_date /* 进组 */, b.param_version, vid, param_name, big_rank, CASE WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) = 57 THEN 'test' WHEN FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) < 57 THEN 'prod' END), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS active_date FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_ab_activity_retention_gaoy_0820 PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT param_name, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.enter_date) AS day_diff, a.param_version, a.vid, a.big_rank, a.env, c.user_tag, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid) AS total_users, COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid) AS retention_count FROM ab_group AS a LEFT JOIN active AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, user_tag, p_date, param_version FROM mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_active_tag_info_gaoy WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2025-07-10' AND '2026-05-31') AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.enter_date = c.p_date AND a.vid = c.param_version GROUP BY param_name, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.enter_date), a.param_version, a.vid, a.big_rank, a.env, c.user_tag

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_monitor_metric_fresh_battle_rate_di
sql_units: WITH top_network AS (SELECT day_first_network, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM (SELECT logymd, GEOIP(create_ip, 5) AS day_first_network, SUM(1) AS cnt FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND register_date = logymd AND is_pure = 1 AND is_ai = 0 AND NOT roleid IS NULL AND NOT zoneid IS NULL GROUP BY logymd, GEOIP(create_ip, 5)) AS tmp GROUP BY day_first_network HAVING avg_cnt >= 1000) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_monitor_metric_fresh_battle_rate_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT region_id, os, day_first_channel, his_first_country, day_first_network, realpicturequality, is_registered_mc, is_installed_hok, age_type, SUM(IF(NOT roleid2 IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS upper_term, SUM(1) AS lower_term FROM (SELECT COALESCE(c.region_id, 0) AS region_id, COALESCE(d.os, 'else') AS os, COALESCE(d.day_first_channel, 'else') AS day_first_channel, COALESCE(c.his_first_country, 'else') AS his_first_country, COALESCE(d.day_first_network, 'else') AS day_first_network, COALESCE(e.realpicturequality, 0) AS realpicturequality, COALESCE(e.is_registered_mc, 0) AS is_registered_mc, COALESCE(e.is_installed_hok, 0) AS is_installed_hok, COALESCE(f.age_type, 'else') AS age_type, a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.roleid AS roleid2 FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND register_date = '2026-05-31' AND is_pure = 1 AND is_ai = 0 AND NOT roleid IS NULL AND NOT zoneid IS NULL GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_warmbattle WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND guidetype = 3 /* 新手1关 */ GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 国家 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) AS region_id, CASE WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MM', 'MY', 'IN', 'RU', 'KH', 'TR', 'TH', 'UNKNOWN', 'BR', 'LA', 'MN', 'SG', 'PE', 'US', 'BO', 'UA', 'VN', 'NP', 'UZ', 'MX', 'KZ', 'AR', 'SA', 'EG', 'JP', 'DE', 'BY', 'CO') THEN UPPER(first_mt_country) ELSE 'else' END AS his_first_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 操作系统，登录渠道，供应商 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, os, CASE WHEN day_first_channel = 'and_cata_xiaomi' THEN 'and_catappult' /* 2025-03-19，and_cata_xiaomi的渠道合并计入了and_catappult */ WHEN day_first_channel IN ('and_usa', 'ios_usa', 'and_catappult', 'and_xiaomi_getapps', 'and_mlingp', 'and_taptap', 'and_huawei_ag', 'and_funtap', 'ios_usa_us', 'and_usa_us', 'ios_mlingp', 'ios_funtap', 'and_shareit_oppo') THEN day_first_channel ELSE 'else' END AS day_first_channel, COALESCE(t2.day_first_network, 'else') AS day_first_network FROM (SELECT *, GEOIP(day_first_ip, 5) AS day_first_network FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_first_active = 1) AS t1 LEFT JOIN top_network AS t2 ON t1.day_first_network = t2.day_first_network) AS d ON a.roleid = d.roleid AND a.zoneid = d.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 机型品质、注册过MC、安装过HOK */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN realpicturequality IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4) THEN realpicturequality ELSE 0 END AS realpicturequality, is_registered_mc, is_installed_hok FROM mt_dm.dm_monitor_dimention_cum_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS e ON a.roleid = e.roleid AND a.zoneid = e.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 年龄 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 9 THEN '[0,9]' WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 10 AND 14 THEN '[10,14]' WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 15 AND 19 THEN '[15,19]' WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN '[20,24]' WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN '[25,29]' WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN '[30,34]' WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) >= 35 THEN '[35,)' ELSE 'else' END AS age_type FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN birthday IN ('2015+', '1980-') THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(birthday, 1, 4), '-', '01', '-', '01') ELSE birthday END AS birthday_new FROM ml_temp.teemoyu_20240305_mc_guangzi_01 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (gt1 = 1 OR gt2 = 1)) AS tmp) AS f ON a.roleid = f.roleid AND a.zoneid = f.zoneid) AS tmp GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (() /* 0个维度：总合计 */ /* 0个维度：总合计 */, (region_id) /* 1个维度：每个单独维度的聚合 */, (os), (day_first_channel), (his_first_country), (day_first_network), (realpicturequality), (is_registered_mc), (is_installed_hok), (age_type), (region_id, os) /* 2个维度：所有可能的两两组合 */, (region_id, day_first_channel), (region_id, his_first_country), (region_id, day_first_network), (region_id, realpicturequality), (region_id, is_registered_mc), (region_id, is_installed_hok), (region_id, age_type), (os, day_first_channel), (os, his_first_country), (os, day_first_network), (os, realpicturequality), (os, is_registered_mc), (os, is_installed_hok), (os, age_type), (day_first_channel, his_first_country), (day_first_channel, day_first_network), (day_first_channel, realpicturequality), (day_first_channel, is_registered_mc), (day_first_channel, is_installed_hok), (day_first_channel, age_type), (his_first_country, day_first_network), (his_first_country, realpicturequality), (his_first_country, is_registered_mc), (his_first_country, is_installed_hok), (his_first_country, age_type), (day_first_network, realpicturequality), (day_first_network, is_registered_mc), (day_first_network, is_installed_hok), (day_first_network, age_type), (realpicturequality, is_registered_mc), (realpicturequality, is_installed_hok), (realpicturequality, age_type), (is_registered_mc, is_installed_hok), (is_registered_mc, age_type), (is_installed_hok, age_type))

sql_units: /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `mtai_test`.`dm_mcgg_behavior_active_account_zone_fd3_di`( */ /*     `accountid` decimal(20, 0) COMMENT 'accountid', */ /*     `zoneid` bigint COMMENT 'zoneid', */ bigint COMMENT '注册前3天资产转移活动点击总次数', */ /*     `fd3_active_assettransfer_complete_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前3天资产转移完成总次数', */ /*     `fd3_active_assettransfer_coin_claim_cnt` bigint COMMENT `fd3_active_maintab_click_map` map < string, */ /*     bigint > COMMENT '注册前3天主界面Tab点击分布汇总 Map', */ /*     `fd3_acquire_map_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前3天获得地图皮肤总次数', */ /* 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/ai/mtai_test/dm_mcgg_behavior_active_account_zone_fd3_di'; */ WITH reigster AS (/* 获取注册用户信息，这里需要根据实际的用户注册表调整 */ SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, create_role_date AS COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_sevenday_click_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_sevenday_click_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_sevenday_progress_claim_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_sevenday_progress_claim_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_firstcharge_view_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_firstcharge_view_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_firstcharge_click_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_firstcharge_click_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_firstcharge_active_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_firstcharge_active_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_firstcharge_claim_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_firstcharge_claim_cnt,
