COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_assettransfer_complete_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_assettransfer_complete_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_assettransfer_coin_claim_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_assettransfer_coin_claim_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_assettransfer_exchange_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_assettransfer_exchange_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_maintab_click_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_maintab_click_cnt, MAP_UTIL(active_maintab_click_map) /* Map类型字段的合并处理 */.merge_map AS fd3_active_maintab_click_map, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_map_cnt), 0) AS fd3_acquire_map_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_map_permanent_cnt), 0) AS fd3_acquire_map_permanent_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_cmdskin_cnt), 0) AS fd3_acquire_cmdskin_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_cmdskin_permanent_cnt), 0) AS fd3_acquire_cmdskin_permanent_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_cmdskin_diamond_cnt), 0) AS fd3_acquire_cmdskin_diamond_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_commander_cnt), 0) AS fd3_acquire_commander_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_commander_permanent_cnt), 0) AS fd3_acquire_commander_permanent_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_achieve_complete_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_achieve_complete_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_achieve_claim_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_achieve_claim_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_recmdlineup_view_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_recmdlineup_view_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_cmdroad_score_add_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_cmdroad_score_add_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_cmdroad_score_sub_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_cmdroad_score_sub_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_mainui_click_cnt), 0) AS fd3_active_mainui_click_cnt, MAP_UTIL(active_mainui_click_map) /* Map类型字段的合并处理 */.merge_map AS fd3_active_mainui_click_map, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.p_date) AS  be_liked_roleid */ /* FROM    mt_dm.dm_ai_feature_mlbb_event_log_battle_like_h */ /* WHERE   p_date >= '2026-05-24' */ /* AND     p_date <= '2026-05-31' */ /* AND     like_roleid > 0 */ /* AND first_active_time /* -取首次登录日期当做创角日期 */, MIN_BY(zoneid, time) AS first_zoneid, MIN_BY(client_ver, time) AS first_client_ver, MIN_BY(channel, time) AS first_channel, MIN_BY(os_type, time) AS time) AS last_country FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, CASE WHEN channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), day_first_label1 AS (SELECT accountid, CASE WHEN 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), day_first_label2 AS (SELECT accountid, CASE WHEN game_channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_lite, MIN_BY(devicetotalmemory, time) AS config_devicetotalmemory, MIN_BY(devicefreememory, time) AS config_devicefreememory, MIN_BY(fixed_score, time) AS config_fixed_score FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_configuration WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, CASE WHEN game_channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), today_battle AS (SELECT accountid, CASE WHEN channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_lite, MAX(CAST(level AS BIGINT)) AS today_max_battle_level, SUM(CASE WHEN ishook >= 1 THEN 1 END) AS today_hook_cnt, SUM(0) AS today_hook_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN isinvalidbattle >= 1 THEN 1 END) AS today_invalid_cnt, SUM(kda / 100) AS today_kda_total, SUM(battletime) AS today_battle_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN wincamp = 1 THEN 1 END) AS today_win_cnt, COUNT(1) AS today_battle_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN blacknum >= 2 THEN 1 END) AS today_black_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN issurrender >= 1 THEN 1 END) AS today_surrender_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN isinvalidbattle >= 1 THEN 1 END) AS today_invalid_battle_cnt FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2) /* -匹配排位 */ GROUP BY accountid, CASE WHEN channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), today_battle_net AS (SELECT accountid, CASE WHEN channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_lite, COUNT(1) AS battle_net_cnt, SUM(timedelay) AS ping_cnt /* -用户总战斗延迟 */, SUM(movelag) AS movelag_cnt /* -用户移动延迟次数 */, ping200 + ping300 + ping500 + ping800) / ping_times <= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS battle_net_ok /* -网络满足战斗场次 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND timedelay > 0 AND timedelay <> 10000 AND timedelay < 50000 AND maxdelay < 50000 AND movelag < 10000 AND zoneid < 57000 AND isvalid = 1 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) GROUP BY accountid, CASE WHEN channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), today_battle_performance AS (SELECT accountid, CASE WHEN channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_lite, MAX(ram) AS ram /* -手机运行内存 */, MAX(digital) AS digital /* -32位还是64位 */, MAX(recmd_pic) AS recmd_pic, MAX(isdownload) AS isdownload, MAX(device_score) AS device_score /* --设备评分 */, SUM(battle_cnt_performance) AS battle_cnt_performance, SUM(battleendtotalpss / 1024) AS battleendtotalpss /* -结束战斗时的占用内存总值 */, SUM(big_num2) AS big_num2 /* -大卡顿的战斗场次总数，注意他成了100防止有小数上报不了，实际200就是指一场战斗卡顿次数<=2次的就是表明满足，这场战斗没有大卡顿          */, SUM(CASE WHEN is_battery_clean_data = 1 THEN current_avg END) AS current_avg /* -平均电流 */, SUM(CASE WHEN is_battery_clean_data = 1 THEN battle_cnt_performance END) AS battle_cnt_current /* -用来算电流的战斗场次 */, SUM(fps) AS fps /* -场均帧率 */, SUM(input_delay) AS input_delay /* -触控延迟，一场战斗的均值 */, SUM(temp_rate) AS temp_rate /* 发热情况满足率,每10分钟发热小于0.6度即为战斗满足 */, SUM(bigjankper10min_cnt) AS bigjankper10min_cnt, SUM(temp_diff) AS temp_diff, SUM(battletime) AS battletime /* -单位秒 */, SUM(end_temp) AS end_temp /* -场均结束温度 */, SUM(start_temp) AS start_temp /* -场均起始温度 */ FROM ml_temp.jaxzhong_battle_performance_channel_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_pvptype_match = 1 AND is_fps_match = 1 AND is_nodownload_process = 1 AND is_performance1_clean_data = 1 AND is_quality_recommend = 1 GROUP BY accountid, CASE WHEN channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), today_pay AS (SELECT roleid AS accountid, CASE WHEN channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_lite, COALESCE(SUM(money), 0) AS pay_amount, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 0) AS pay_cnt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_sandbox = 0 AND money > 0 AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') GROUP BY roleid, CASE WHEN channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), today_duration AS (SELECT roleid AS accountid, CASE WHEN channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_lite, SUM(online_time) AS day_login_duration, COUNT(1) AS day_login_cnt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, CASE WHEN channel = 'and_usa_lite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), wide_feature AS (SELECT s1.accountid, s1.is_lite, s1.first_level, s1.first_active_time, s1.first_zoneid, s1.first_client_ver, s1.first_channel, s1.first_os_type, s1.first_ip, s1.first_country, s1.first_device, s1.first_deviceid, s1.first_android_id, s1.first_gpm_did, s1.first_idfa, s1.first_idfv, s1.first_mt_id, s1.first_pre_mt_id, s1.first_loss_day, s1.first_usercreateymd, s1.last_active_time, s1.last_zoneid, s1.last_client_ver, s1.last_channel, s1.last_os_type, s1.last_ip, s1.last_country, s2.first_bigranklvl, s2.first_minranklvl, s2.first_rank_elo, s2.first_rank_hide_elo, s2.first_rankstar, s3.config_devicetotalmemory, s3.config_devicefreememory, s3.config_fixed_score, s6.digital, s6.device_score, s6.ram, s6.isdownload, s6.recmd_pic, s6.battle_cnt_performance, s6.battleendtotalpss, s6.big_num2, s6.current_avg, s6.fps, s6.input_delay, s6.temp_rate, s6.bigjankper10min_cnt, s6.temp_diff, s6.battle_cnt_current, s6.battletime, s6.end_temp, s6.start_temp, s5.battle_net_cnt, s5.ping_cnt, s5.sklag_cnt, s5.stdping_cnt, s5.small_connect, s5.battle_net_ok, s5.movelag_cnt, s4.today_max_battle_level, s4.today_hook_cnt, s4.today_hook_duration, s4.today_invalid_cnt, s4.today_kda_total, s4.today_battle_duration, s4.today_win_cnt, s4.today_battle_cnt, s4.today_black_cnt, name: 分时段_高光触发_触发vb_highlight_trigger_hero_battletime
sql_units: /* 分时间段,高光触发 */ WITH hero_config AS (SELECT heroid, hero_name, heroes, position FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT heroid, hero_name, heroes, sub_position AS position FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT sub_position IS NULL), highlight_trigger AS (SELECT hlt.* FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, trigger_id, trigger_time FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_highlight_triggered LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(SPLIT(highlighttriggered, CHR(59))) AS c1_index, trigger_id LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(SPLIT(highlighttime, CHR(59))) AS c2_index, trigger_time WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 57999 AND c1_index = c2_index AND trigger_id <> '') AS hlt /* INNER JOIN */ /*         ( */ /*             SELECT  hl1.*, */ /*                     hl2.is_highlight */ /*             FROM    ( */ /*                         SELECT  * */ /*                         FROM    ml_temp.vb_highlight_config_temp_5 --高光配置表 */ /*                     ) hl1 */ /*             INNER JOIN */ /*                     ( */ /*                         SELECT  * */ /*                         FROM    ml_temp.vb_trigger_config_11_3 --区分高光_去重版 */ /*                     ) hl2 */ /*             ON      hl1.message_id = hl2.message_id */ /*         ) hl */ /* ON      hlt.trigger_id = hl.type */ INNER JOIN (/* 2026年3月11日21:39:00 更新配置表 */ /* 只保留有message_id 播报信息id的配置信息 */ SELECT DISTINCT id AS trigger_id FROM mt_dim.dim_highlightaction_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_highlightaction_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01' /* 由于配置更新较频繁，且需要回溯，每次只取最新分区 */ AND message_id > -9999 /* 剔除无用数据 */) AS hl ON hlt.trigger_id = hl.trigger_id), ten AS (SELECT battleid, COUNT(*) AS valid_num FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 164) AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 56999 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND fake_ai = 0 /* and bigranklvl >= 5 */ GROUP BY battleid), battle AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, real_road, pvptype, CASE WHEN rankstar < 37 THEN 'a.大师' WHEN rankstar < 62 THEN 'b.宗师' WHEN rankstar < 87 THEN 'c.史诗' WHEN rankstar < 112 THEN 'd.传奇' WHEN rankstar < 137 THEN 'e.神话' WHEN rankstar < 162 THEN 'f.百战神话' WHEN rankstar < 212 THEN 'g.荣耀神话' ELSE 'h.至尊神话' END AS ranks FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND fake_ai = 0 AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 164) AND zoneid BETWEEN 57000 AND 57999 AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND rankstar >= 38 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, real_road, pvptype, CASE WHEN rankstar < 37 THEN 'a.大师' WHEN rankstar < 62 THEN 'b.宗师' WHEN rankstar < 87 THEN 'c.史诗' WHEN rankstar < 112 THEN 'd.传奇' WHEN rankstar < 137 THEN 'e.神话' WHEN rankstar < 162 THEN 'f.百战神话' WHEN rankstar < 212 THEN 'g.荣耀神话' ELSE 'h.至尊神话' END UNION SELECT accountid, zoneid, a.battleid, heroid, real_road, pvptype, CASE WHEN rankstar < 37 THEN 'a.大师' WHEN rankstar < 62 THEN 'b.宗师' WHEN rankstar < 87 THEN 'c.史诗' WHEN rankstar < 112 THEN 'd.传奇' WHEN rankstar < 137 THEN 'e.神话' WHEN rankstar < 162 THEN 'f.百战神话' WHEN rankstar < 212 THEN 'g.荣耀神话' ELSE 'h.至尊神话' END AS ranks FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN ten AS t ON a.battleid = t.battleid WHERE a.isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND a.fake_ai = 0 AND a.pvptype IN (1, 2, 164) AND a.zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 56999 AND a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.rankstar >= 38 AND t.valid_num = 10 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, a.battleid, heroid, real_road, pvptype, CASE WHEN rankstar < 37 THEN 'a.大师' WHEN rankstar < 62 THEN 'b.宗师' WHEN rankstar < 87 THEN 'c.史诗' WHEN rankstar < 112 THEN 'd.传奇' WHEN rankstar < 137 THEN 'e.神话' WHEN rankstar < 162 THEN 'f.百战神话' WHEN rankstar < 212 THEN 'g.荣耀神话' ELSE 'h.至尊神话' END) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.vb_highlight_trigger_hero_battletime PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.zonetype, a.pvptype, a.heroid, c.hero_name, c.heroes, a.real_road, a.ranks, a.triggertime, a.trigger_id, a.trigger_battle, a.trigger_num FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN b.zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 56999 THEN '正式服' WHEN b.zoneid BETWEEN 57000 AND 57999 THEN '测试服' END AS zonetype, b.pvptype, b.heroid, b.real_road, b.ranks, trigger_id, CASE WHEN trigger_time / 60000 BETWEEN 0 AND 2 THEN '1.[0,2min]' WHEN trigger_time / 60000 <= 5 THEN '2.(2,5min]' WHEN trigger_time / 60000 <= 8 THEN '3.(5,8min]' WHEN trigger_time / 60000 <= 12 THEN '4.(8,12min]' WHEN trigger_time / 60000 <= 18 THEN '5.(12,18min]' ELSE '6.18min+' END AS triggertime, COUNT(DISTINCT b.battleid) AS trigger_battle, COUNT(*) AS trigger_num FROM battle AS b JOIN highlight_trigger AS h ON b.accountid = h.accountid AND b.zoneid = h.zoneid AND b.battleid = h.battleid WHERE h.trigger_id >= 1 GROUP BY CASE WHEN b.zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 56999 THEN '正式服' WHEN b.zoneid BETWEEN 57000 AND 57999 THEN '测试服' END, b.pvptype, b.heroid, b.real_road, b.ranks, trigger_id, CASE WHEN trigger_time / 60000 BETWEEN 0 AND 2 THEN '1.[0,2min]' WHEN name: 黑产名单全量表
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: kyrayang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-09-08 18:22:59.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH charge_daily AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND money > 0 AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 /* 排除代币购买数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND is_sandbox = 0 /* 排除沙盒测试数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷苹果假冒卡 (有收入) 数据, 因为点卡的 receipt_id = 0 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* GP 礼品卡, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_act_mcoin_exchange WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND cost_num > 0) AS t0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.kyra_black_role_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, black_type FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, black_type FROM mcgg_temp.kyra_black_role_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, black_type FROM mcgg_temp.kyra_black_role_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS h1 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM charge_daily AS h2 WHERE h1.roleid = h2.roleid AND h1.zoneid = h2.zoneid) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, black_type

sql_units: /* Step 5: 最终组合所有聚合结果，并计算衍生特征 */ /* 使用INSERT OVERWRITE，确保每次运行时都能生成最新的特征数据 */ /* V9 修复: 严格按照CREATE TABLE字段顺序排列SELECT字段 */ WITH registered_users /* Step 1: 确定要处理的用户群体 (3天前注册的用户) */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid AS accountid, zoneid, create_role_date AS register_date FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND create_role_date = '2026-05-29'), data_in_window /* Step 2: 筛选出这些用户在注册后3天内的所有战斗数据 */ AS (SELECT base.*, reg.register_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY base.zoneid, base.accountid ORDER BY base.p_date ASC) AS day_num_asc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY base.zoneid, base.accountid ORDER BY base.p_date DESC) AS day_num_desc FROM (SELECT * FROM mtai_test.dwm_mcgg_behavior_battle_account_zone_di AS a WHERE a.p_date BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31') AS base RIGHT JOIN registered_users AS reg ON base.accountid = reg.accountid AND base.zoneid = reg.zoneid), agg_bigint_maps /* Step 3: 对所有Map类型特征进行合并聚合 */ /* 3.1 聚合 `map<string, bigint>` 类型的特征 */ AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v))) AS battle_rank_distribution_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, CAST(SUM(v) AS BIGINT) AS v FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_rank_distribution_map) t AS k, v GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_pvptype_dist_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v))) AS battle_pvptype_distribution_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, CAST(SUM(v) AS BIGINT) AS v FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_pvptype_distribution_map) t AS k, v GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_commander_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v))) AS battle_commander_usage_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, CAST(SUM(v) AS BIGINT) AS v FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_commander_usage_map) t AS k, v GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_map_usage_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v))) AS battle_map_usage_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, CAST(SUM(v) AS BIGINT) AS v FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_map_usage_map) t AS k, v GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_synergy_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v))) AS battle_synergy_combination_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, CAST(SUM(v) AS BIGINT) AS v FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_synergy_combination_map) t AS k, v GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_win_count_pvptype_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v))) AS battle_win_count_pvptype_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, CAST(SUM(v) AS BIGINT) AS v FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_win_count_pvptype_map) t AS k, v GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_top4_count_pvptype_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v))) AS battle_top4_count_pvptype_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, CAST(SUM(v) AS BIGINT) AS v FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_top4_count_pvptype_map) t AS k, v GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_count_warmbattle_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v))) AS battle_count_warmbattle_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, CAST(SUM(v) AS BIGINT) AS v FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_count_warmbattle_map) t AS k, v GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_artifact_chosen_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v))) AS battle_artifact_chosen_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, CAST(SUM(v) AS BIGINT) AS v FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_artifact_chosen_map) t AS k, v GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_augment_chosen_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v))) AS battle_augment_chosen_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, CAST(SUM(v) AS BIGINT) AS v FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_augment_chosen_map) t AS k, v GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_battlerank_ratio_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v_avg))) AS battle_battlerank_ratio_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, SUM(v * battle_count) / SUM(battle_count) AS v_avg FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_battlerank_ratio_map) t AS k, v GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), exploded_gain_channel /* V8 Fix: Systematically refactor all map<string, double> aggregations */ /* Step 3.2.1: Create flattened intermediate tables for each map type */ AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, v, battle_count FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_avg_gain_channel_map) t AS k, v), exploded_3star_rate AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, v, battle_count FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_3star_hero_rate_by_cost_map) t AS k, v), exploded_round_for_3star AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, v, battle_count FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_avg_round_for_3star_by_cost_map) t AS k, v), exploded_hp_at_round AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, v, battle_count FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_avg_hp_at_round_map) t AS k, v), exploded_levelup_round AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, v, battle_count FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_avg_levelup_round_map) t AS k, v), exploded_rank_pvptype /* V8 Fix Continuation: Create flattened intermediate tables for the remaining pvptype maps */ AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, v, battle_count FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_avg_rank_pvptype_map) t AS k, v), exploded_duration_pvptype AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, v, battle_count FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_avg_duration_mins_pvptype_map) t AS k, v), exploded_rounds_pvptype AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, v, battle_count FROM data_in_window LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(battle_avg_rounds_pvptype_map) t AS k, v), agg_gain_channel_map /* Step 3.2.2: Aggregate from the clean, flattened tables */ AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v_avg))) AS battle_avg_gain_channel_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, SUM(v * battle_count) / SUM(battle_count) AS v_avg FROM exploded_gain_channel GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_3star_rate_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v_avg))) AS battle_3star_hero_rate_by_cost_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, SUM(v * battle_count) / SUM(battle_count) AS v_avg FROM exploded_3star_rate GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_round_for_3star_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v_avg))) AS battle_avg_round_for_3star_by_cost_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, SUM(v * battle_count) / SUM(battle_count) AS v_avg FROM exploded_round_for_3star GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_hp_at_round_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v_avg))) AS battle_avg_hp_at_round_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, SUM(v * battle_count) / SUM(battle_count) AS v_avg FROM exploded_hp_at_round GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_levelup_round_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v_avg))) AS battle_avg_levelup_round_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, SUM(v * battle_count) / SUM(battle_count) AS v_avg FROM exploded_levelup_round GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_rank_pvptype_map /* V8 Fix Continuation: Aggregate from the new flattened pvptype tables */ AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v_avg))) AS battle_avg_rank_pvptype_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, SUM(v * battle_count) / SUM(battle_count) AS v_avg FROM exploded_rank_pvptype GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_duration_pvptype_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v_avg))) AS battle_avg_duration_mins_pvptype_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, SUM(v * battle_count) / SUM(battle_count) AS v_avg FROM exploded_duration_pvptype GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), agg_rounds_pvptype_map AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k, v_avg))) AS battle_avg_rounds_pvptype_map FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, k, SUM(v * battle_count) / SUM(battle_count) AS v_avg FROM exploded_rounds_pvptype GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, k) AS sub GROUP BY zoneid, accountid), main_agg /* Step 4: 对数值类和简单特征进行聚合 */ AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, SUM(battle_count) AS battle_count_sum /* 求和 */, SUM(battle_win_count) AS battle_win_count_sum, SUM(battle_top4_count) AS battle_top4_count_sum, SUM(battle_surrender_count) AS battle_surrender_count_sum, SUM(COALESCE(battle_recommend_lineup_used_cnt, 0)) AS recommend_lineup_used_cnt_sum /* sql_units: /* 被击杀时间/被控制时长 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: celiaye@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-09-11 20:57:38.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_hero_battle_event WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 57999 AND dead_heronum_a + dead_heronum_b > 0 AND battleid IN (SELECT a.battleid FROM (SELECT battleid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND isinvalidbattle <> 1 AND issurrender = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND pvptype = 2 AND fake_ai = 0 AND realpvptype IN (22, 96, 97, 2, 59, 90, 1) GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) = 10) AS a JOIN (SELECT battleid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_hero_battle_event WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 57999 GROUP BY battleid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT heroid) = 10) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid)), t2 AS (SELECT heroid, hero_name, CASE WHEN heroes = 1 THEN '1-坦克' WHEN heroes = 2 THEN '2-战士' WHEN heroes = 3 THEN '3-刺客' WHEN heroes = 4 THEN '4-法师' WHEN heroes = 5 THEN '5-射手' WHEN heroes = 6 THEN '6-辅助' ELSE '7-其它' END AS heroclass FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.celiaye_nvn_controltime_all PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT zonetype, ranks, main.deadheroid, d.hero_name AS hero_name, d.heroclass AS heroclass, CONCAT_WS(',', controlhero) AS controlhero, starttime, battlescale, fighttime, becontroltime, num FROM (SELECT zonetype, ranks, a.deadheroid, controlhero, starttime, battlescale, SUM(fighttime) AS fighttime, SUM(becontroltime) AS becontroltime, COUNT(*) AS num FROM (SELECT battleid, fightid, heroid AS deadheroid, CASE WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 56999 THEN '正式服' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 57001 AND 57999 THEN '测服' END AS zonetype, CASE WHEN fightstart / 60000 <= 12 THEN '1.(0,12min]' WHEN fightstart / 60000 > 12 THEN '2.12min+' ELSE '其它' END AS starttime, CASE WHEN (fight_heronum_a = 1 AND fight_heronum_b = 1) OR (fight_heronum_a = 2 AND fight_heronum_b = 2) THEN 'a.小规模均势' WHEN (icamp = 1 AND fight_heronum_a = 1 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 2 AND 3) OR (icamp = 2 AND fight_heronum_b = 1 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 2 AND 3) THEN 'b.小规模劣势' WHEN (icamp = 2 AND fight_heronum_a = 1 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 2 AND 3) OR (icamp = 1 AND fight_heronum_b = 1 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 2 AND 3) THEN 'c.小规模优势' WHEN (fight_heronum_a = 3 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 2 AND 4) OR (fight_heronum_b = 3 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 2 AND 4) THEN 'd.中规模均势' WHEN (icamp = 1 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 4 AND 5) OR (icamp = 2 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 4 AND 5) THEN 'e.中规模劣势' WHEN (icamp = 2 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 4 AND 5) OR (icamp = 1 AND fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 4 AND 5) THEN 'f.中规模优势' WHEN (fight_heronum_a BETWEEN 4 AND 5) AND (fight_heronum_b BETWEEN 4 AND 5) THEN 'g.大规模均势' WHEN (icamp = 1 AND fight_heronum_a = 3 AND fight_heronum_b = 5) OR (icamp = 2 AND fight_heronum_b = 3 AND fight_heronum_a = 5) THEN 'h.大规模劣势' WHEN (icamp = 2 AND fight_heronum_a = 3 AND fight_heronum_b = 5) OR (icamp = 1 AND fight_heronum_b = 3 AND fight_heronum_a = 5) THEN 'i.大规模优势' ELSE 'j.其它' END AS battlescale /* 团战规模 */, herofightend / 1000 - herofightstart / 1000 AS fighttime, starthp / startmaxhp AS hp, becontroltime / 1000 AS becontroltime FROM t WHERE endhp = 0) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT battleid, fightid, becontrol, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(g.hero_name)) AS controlhero FROM (SELECT battleid, fightid, SPLIT(becontrolhero, ':')[0] AS becontrol, heroid FROM (SELECT battleid, fightid, heroid, controlrate, EXPLODE(SPLIT(SPLIT(controlrate, '\\073')[1], ',')) AS becontrolhero FROM t) ORDER BY battleid, fightid, becontrol, heroid ASC) AS f LEFT JOIN t2 AS g ON f.heroid = g.heroid WHERE becontrol < 200 GROUP BY battleid, fightid, becontrol) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.fightid = b.fightid AND a.deadheroid = b.becontrol LEFT JOIN (SELECT battleid, CASE WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 10 THEN '勇士' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 21 THEN '精英' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 37 THEN '大师' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 62 THEN '宗师' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 87 THEN 'a.史诗' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 112 THEN 'b.传奇' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 137 THEN 'c.神话' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 162 THEN 'd.百战神话' WHEN MAX(rankstar) < 212 THEN 'e.荣耀神话' ELSE 'f.至尊神话' END AS ranks FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1 AND 57999 AND battletype = 2 GROUP BY battleid) AS c ON a.battleid = c.battleid WHERE hp > 0.8 AND ranks IN ('a.史诗', 'b.传奇', 'c.神话', 'd.百战神话', 'e.荣耀神话', 'f.至尊神话') AND SIZE(controlhero) >= 2 GROUP BY zonetype, ranks, deadheroid, controlhero, starttime, battlescale) AS main LEFT JOIN t2 AS d ON main.deadheroid = d.heroid

name: match5活跃度标签
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_ygao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-09-15 14:47:43.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 用户标签划分： */ /* 1. 回流用户：近90天活跃用户，近30天未活跃用户(按进组时间来计算) */ /* 2. 活跃用户划分高中低活跃：按之前规则近7天活跃天数(按进组时间来计算) */ /* 3. 其他用户 */ WITH user_active_stats AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.logymd) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_90d_active, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -30) AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -1) THEN b.logymd END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_30d_active, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -7) AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -1) THEN b.logymd END) AS active_days_7d FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid AS roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-02' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mcgg_login_active_tag_info_gaoy PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN has_90d_active = 1 AND has_30d_active = 0 THEN '回流用户' WHEN has_30d_active = 1 AND active_days_7d BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN '高活' WHEN has_30d_active = 1 AND active_days_7d BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '中活' WHEN has_30d_active = 1 AND active_days_7d BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '低活' ELSE '其他用户' END AS user_tag FROM user_active_stats

CAST(COALESCE(fix_exchange, t2.exchange_rate) * (1 + service_point) AS DECIMAL(20, 8)) AS exchange_rate FROM exchange_config_injected AS t1 LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_currency_exchange_df AS t2 ON t1.currency = t2.currency AND t1.exchange_date = t2.logymd AND t2.logymd > '0'), usd_calculated AS (SELECT charge_orders.`time`, pay_time, local_ymd, NULL AS local_delivery_time, local_pay_time, NULL AS inferred_period, charge_orders.appid, charge_orders.gameid AS gameid, gamename, gamecode, charge_orders.`channel`, charge_orders.product_id, charge_orders.`money`, UPPER(charge_orders.currency), LOWER(charge_orders.sub_pay_channel) AS sub_pay_channel, charge_orders.other_orderid, LOWER(charge_orders.bill_country) AS bill_country, LOWER(`ip`) AS `ip`, UPPER(charge_orders.before_tax_currency) AS before_tax_currency, charge_orders.before_tax_amt, before_tax_amt / exchange_rate AS before_tax_usd_amt, UPPER(charge_orders.after_tax_currency) AS after_tax_currency, charge_orders.after_tax_amt, after_tax_amt / exchange_rate AS after_tax_usd_amt, UPPER(charge_orders.actual_currency) AS actual_currency, charge_orders.actual_amt, actual_amt / exchange_rate AS actual_usd_amt, UPPER(charge_orders.tax_currency) AS tax_currency, charge_orders.tax_amt, tax_amt / exchange_rate AS tax_usd_amt, UPPER(charge_orders.share_currency) AS share_currency, charge_orders.share_amt, share_amt / exchange_rate AS share_usd_amt, UPPER(charge_orders.fee_currency) AS fee_currency, charge_orders.fee_amt, fee_amt / exchange_rate AS fee_usd_amt, LOWER(charge_orders.game_pay_channel) AS game_pay_channel, charge_orders.pay_channel_code, charge_orders.game_revenue, game_revenue / exchange_rate AS game_usd_revenue, charge_orders.moonton_revenue, moonton_revenue / exchange_rate AS moonton_usd_revenue, charge_orders.third_part_revenue, third_part_revenue / exchange_rate AS third_part_usd_revenue, charge_orders.exchange_date, charge_orders.exchange_rate, user_reg_country, user_id, server_id, CASE WHEN fix.appid = 128314 AND LOWER(charge_orders.game_pay_channel) = 'mt_pipo' THEN charge_orders.`money` * 0.005 WHEN fix.appid = 128314 AND LOWER(charge_orders.game_pay_channel) <> 'mt_pipo' THEN charge_orders.`money` * fix.yield_rate WHEN NOT fix.appid IS NULL AND NOT fix.yield_rate IS NULL THEN charge_orders.`money` * fix.yield_rate ELSE moonton_revenue / exchange_rate END AS moonton_usd_revenue_temp, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS logymd FROM exchange_injected AS charge_orders LEFT JOIN fixed_yield AS fix ON charge_orders.gameid = CAST(fix.appid AS BIGINT) WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`), 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= '2026-05-31' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`), 'yyyy-MM-dd') >= '2026-05-24') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_finance_prod.dwd_charge_order_payment_new_createtime PARTITION(logymd) SELECT * FROM usd_calculated

name: 例行_流量_样本逻辑_曝光
output_hint: 例行_流量_样本逻辑_曝光
sql_units: WITH event_log AS (SELECT accountid AS r1, zoneid AS z1, showplayer_accountid AS r2, showplayer_zoneid AS z2, logymd, player_action, FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss') AS time /* time, */, FLOOR(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600) AS ts /* UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) AS ts, */, patchid /* lineid, */, sequenceid2, CONCAT(sequenceid2, '-', CAST(patchid AS STRING)) AS seqid, MAX(is_highligh) AS hightag, MAX(showtaglist1) AS tag1, MAX(showtaglist2) AS tag2, MAX(showtaglist3) AS tag3, SUBSTRING(logymd, 6, 2) AS mm /* substr(loghms, 0, 2) as hh, */, SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss'), 12, 2) AS hh, CASE WHEN DAYOFMONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss')) < 10 THEN 'up' WHEN DAYOFMONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss')) < 20 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'tail' END AS month_period, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss'), 12, 2) < 12 THEN 'break' WHEN SUBSTRING(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SPLIT(sequenceid2, '-')[2] AS BIGINT) / 1000 - 8 * 3600, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss'), 12, 2) < 18 THEN 'noon' ELSE 'even' END AS day_period, GEOIP(MAX(ip), 1) AS country, GEOIP(MAX(ip), 1) AS states, GEOIP(MAX(ip), 3) AS city FROM ml_ods.connserver_social_recommendlistrecord /* 加上测服 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     zoneid < 57000 */ NOT player_action IS NULL GROUP BY sequenceid2, patchid, accountid, zoneid, showplayer_accountid, showplayer_zoneid, logymd, player_action), event_exp_log AS (/* type含义： */ /* "0 = 其他 */ /* 1 = 登录 */ /* 2 = 非登录返回主界面 */ /* 3 = 手动刷新" */ SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, batch_id, type, time FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_social_recommendlistexposure WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND type > 0 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, batch_id, type, time), logout AS (/* 构造用户在线会话：登录时间 ~ 登出时间 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(TIME) - online_time) AS login_time /* 登录时间 = 登出时间戳 - 在线时长（转换为秒） */, TIME AS logout_time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mlbb_social_rec_v1_daily_sample_track_exposure PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, batch_id AS seqid, roleid AS r1, zoneid AS z1, r2, z2, player_action, if_img_head_clk, if_follow, if_blk_shop, hightag, hh, mm, month_period, day_period, country, states, city, SUM(CAST(COALESCE(conf.score, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS final_score, COLLECT_LIST(conf.tagname) AS tagname_list, COLLECT_LIST(conf.tagid) AS tagid_list, IF(SUM(is_online) > 0, 1, 0) AS is_cis_online FROM (SELECT show.time, show.batch_id, show.roleid, show.zoneid, clk_event.r2, clk_event.z2, clk_event.player_action, IF(NOT img_clk.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_img_head_clk, IF(NOT follow.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_follow, IF(NOT blk_shop.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_blk_shop, clk_event.hightag, clk_event.tag1, clk_event.tag2, clk_event.tag3, clk_event.hh, clk_event.mm, clk_event.month_period, clk_event.day_period, clk_event.country, clk_event.states, clk_event.city, 1 AS joinid, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(show.time) >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(logout.login_time) AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(show.time) <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(logout.logout_time) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS is_online /* 登出时间 */ /* 判断行为时间是否在某个在线会话内 */ FROM (SELECT * FROM event_exp_log) AS show LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM event_log WHERE player_action IN (1, 5)) AS clk_event ON show.batch_id = clk_event.sequenceid2 AND show.roleid = clk_event.r1 AND show.zoneid = clk_event.z1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM event_log WHERE player_action = 2) AS img_clk ON show.batch_id = img_clk.sequenceid2 AND show.roleid = img_clk.r1 AND show.zoneid = img_clk.z1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM event_log WHERE player_action = 3) AS follow ON show.batch_id = follow.sequenceid2 AND show.roleid = follow.r1 AND show.zoneid = follow.z1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM event_log WHERE player_action = 4) AS blk_shop ON show.batch_id = blk_shop.sequenceid2 AND show.roleid = blk_shop.r1 AND show.zoneid = blk_shop.z1 LEFT JOIN logout ON clk_event.r2 = logout.roleid AND clk_event.z2 = logout.zoneid AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(clk_event.time) >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(logout.login_time) AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(clk_event.time) <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(logout.logout_time) GROUP BY show.time, show.batch_id, show.roleid, show.zoneid, clk_event.r2, clk_event.z2, clk_event.player_action, IF(NOT img_clk.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0), IF(NOT follow.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0), IF(NOT blk_shop.r1 IS NULL, 1, 0), clk_event.hightag, clk_event.tag1, clk_event.tag2, clk_event.tag3, clk_event.hh, clk_event.mm, clk_event.month_period, clk_event.day_period, clk_event.country, clk_event.states, clk_event.city) AS traffic LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, 1 AS joinid FROM mt_ai.social_ai_activate_config WHERE p_date = (SELECT MAX(p_date) FROM mt_ai.social_ai_activate_config WHERE NOT p_date IS NULL AND NOT act_id IS NULL) AND act_id = IF('2026-05-31' >= '2025-07-16', 'grey_v2', 'grey_v1') AND stype = 'value') AS conf ON traffic.joinid = conf.joinid AND (traffic.tag1 = conf.tagid OR traffic.tag2 = conf.tagid OR traffic.tag3 = conf.tagid) GROUP BY time, seqid, r1, z1, r2, z2, player_action, if_img_head_clk, if_follow, if_blk_shop, hightag, hh, mm, month_period, day_period, country, states, city

name: 扩量前实验区和非实验区留存基础数据_20250905_进组
output_hint: 扩量前实验区和非实验区留存基础数据_20250905_进组
sql_units: WITH ab_group AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.big_rank, b.enter_date, param_version FROM (SELECT t1.enter_date, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, big_rank, param_version FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN matchid = 5 AND pvptype IN (39) AND realmatchtype IN (51, 59, 90) AND groupsel IN (31) THEN '实验组' ELSE '对照组' END AS param_version, MIN(logymd) AS enter_date FROM mcgg_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd >= '2025-09-05' AND groupsel IN (31, 32) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN matchid = 5 AND pvptype IN (39) AND realmatchtype IN (51, 59, 90) AND groupsel IN (31) THEN '实验组' ELSE '对照组' END) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'a.勇士' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 'b.精英' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 6 AND 9 THEN 'c.大师' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 10 AND 16 THEN 'd.宗师' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 17 AND 25 THEN 'e.史诗' WHEN final_rank_id BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN 'f.传奇' WHEN final_rank_id = 36 THEN 'g.神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 37 THEN 'h.百战神话' WHEN final_rank_id = 38 THEN 'i.荣耀神话' END) AS big_rank, roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_temp.daily_final_rank_df WHERE logymd >= '2025-09-05' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 AND season_id = 4 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t1.enter_date = t2.logymd) AS b JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2025-09-05' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS a ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.logymd >= b.enter_date GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.big_rank, b.enter_date, param_version), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, logymd AS active_date FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ai`.`mcgg_aimatch_abtest_expand_activity_retention_before_table_enter_20250905` PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.enter_date) AS day_diff, a.big_rank, c.user_tag, param_version, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid) AS total_users, COUNT(DISTINCT b.roleid) AS retention_count FROM ab_group AS a LEFT JOIN active AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, user_tag, p_date FROM mt_ai.mcgg_login_active_tag_info_gaoy WHERE p_date >= '2025-09-05' AND p_date <= '2026-05-31') AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.enter_date = c.p_date GROUP BY DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', a.enter_date), a.big_rank, c.user_tag, param_version

name: etl.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid_mcgg_v2_account_monthly
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author                           date                            desc */ /* jichun@moonton.com                2024-07-03                      https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/PByZwozuhiHEsKkUew9cTVijn7c?sheet=af11f2 */ /* -- ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mt_ads`.`ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid`( */ /*             `date_range`                  STRING          COMMENT '日期区间', */ /*             `country`                     STRING          COMMENT '国家', */ /*             `os`                          STRING          COMMENT '创角平台', */ /*             `network`                     STRING          COMMENT '首次广告归因渠道', */ /*             `register_cnt`                BIGINT          COMMENT '新增玩家数', */ /*             `pure_register_cnt`           BIGINT          COMMENT '纯净新增玩家数', */ /*             `active_cnt`                  BIGINT          COMMENT '活跃玩家数', */ /*             `active_cnt_30days`           BIGINT          COMMENT '近30日活跃玩家数', */ /*             `pay_cnt`                     BIGINT          COMMENT '付费玩家数', `active_register_pay_30d_cnt` BIGINT          COMMENT '今日活跃且新增第30天且30天内充值过的玩家', */ /*             `active_register_30d_cnt`     BIGINT          COMMENT '今日活跃且新增第30天的玩家', */ /*             `recurring_cnt_30days`        BIGINT          COMMENT '30日回流玩家数', */ /*             `nologin_cnt_30days`          BIGINT          COMMENT '30日未登录玩家数', */ /*             `pay_amt_exrate`              DECIMAL(38, 18) COMMENT '汇率校准付费金额', */ /*             `active_cnt_period`           BIGINT          COMMENT '活跃用户数(周期内去重)', */ /*             `pay_cnt_period`              BIGINT          COMMENT '付费用户数(周期内去重)' */ /*         ) COMMENT '经分首页boss看板-一级指标' */ /*         PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*             `logymd` STRING COMMENT '日期分区(yyy-MM-dd)', */ /*             `appname` STRING COMMENT '项目ID(mlbb,xgame)', */ /*             `granularity_type` STRING COMMENT '粒度类型(account,device)', */ /*             `date_type` STRING COMMENT '日期类型(daily,weekly,monthly)' */ /*         ) STORED AS parquet location 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid'; */ WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, create_role_date AS register_date, CASE WHEN new_type = '模拟器新增' THEN 2 WHEN new_type = '纯净新增' THEN 3 WHEN new_type = '切号新增(被切号)' THEN 4 WHEN new_type = '灰产新增' THEN 6 ELSE -99999 END AS new_type, IF(first_mt_country = '' OR first_mt_country = '-' OR first_mt_country IS NULL, 'unknown', first_mt_country) AS country, IF(first_media_source = '' OR first_media_source = '-' OR first_media_source IS NULL, 'unknown', first_media_source) AS network, IF(LOWER(first_media_source) = 'organic', 1, 2) AS network_group, IF(create_role_os_name = '' OR create_role_os_name = '-' OR create_role_os_name IS NULL, 'unknown', create_role_os_name) AS create_os, IF(create_role_channel = '' OR create_role_channel = '-' OR create_role_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_role_channel) AS create_channel, IF(role_type = '' OR role_type = '-' OR role_type IS NULL, -99999, role_type) AS create_install_label FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-04-20', '2025-04-20', '2026-05-31') AND is_first_create = 1 AND create_role_date <= '2026-05-31'), active_all_account AS (SELECT roleid FROM mcgg_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' GROUP BY roleid), account_pay_di AS (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mcgg_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid), res_period AS (SELECT COALESCE(bas.country, 'unknown') AS country, 'unknown' AS os, 'unknown' AS network, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.roleid) AS pay_cnt_period, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid) AS active_cnt_period FROM basic AS bas LEFT JOIN account_pay_di AS pay ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid LEFT JOIN active_all_account AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid GROUP BY COALESCE(bas.country, 'unknown')), daily_tbl AS (SELECT country /*	国家 */, os /*	创角平台 */, network /*	首次广告归因渠道 */, SUM(register_cnt) AS register_cnt /*	新增玩家数 */, SUM(pure_register_cnt) AS pure_register_cnt /*	纯净新增玩家数 */, SUM(active_cnt) AS active_cnt /*	活跃玩家数 */, SUM(active_cnt_30days) AS active_cnt_30days /*	近30日活跃玩家数 */, SUM(pay_cnt) AS pay_cnt /*	付费玩家数 */, SUM(pay_amt) AS pay_amt /*	付费金额(美分) */, SUM(active_pay_30d_cnt) AS active_pay_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且最近30天内充值过的玩家 */, SUM(active_register_pay_30d_cnt) AS active_register_pay_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且新增第30天且30天内充值过的玩家 */, SUM(active_register_30d_cnt) AS active_register_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且新增第30天的玩家 */, SUM(recurring_cnt_30days) AS recurring_cnt_30days /*	30日回流玩家数 */, SUM(nologin_cnt_30days) AS nologin_cnt_30days /*	30日未登录玩家数 */, SUM(pay_amt_exrate) AS pay_amt_exrate /*	汇率校准付费金额 */, SUM(recurring_cnt_14days) AS recurring_cnt_14days /*	14日回流玩家数 */, SUM(nologin_cnt_14days) AS nologin_cnt_14days /*	14日未登录玩家数 */, SUM(online_dur) AS online_dur, SUM(new_active_cnt) AS new_active_cnt, SUM(lose_cnt_7ds) AS lose_cnt_7ds, SUM(active_cnt_7ds) AS active_cnt_7ds, SUM(lose_cnt_30ds) AS lose_cnt_30ds, SUM(active_cnt_30ds) AS active_cnt_30ds, SUM(active_cnt_7days) AS active_cnt_7days, SUM(actual_pay_amt) AS actual_pay_amt FROM mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mcgg_v2' AND logymd >= '2024-11-28' AND granularity_type = 'account' AND date_type = 'daily' GROUP BY country /*	国家 */, os /*	创角平台 */, network /*	首次广告归因渠道 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AS date_range, dai.country, dai.os, dai.network, dai.register_cnt, dai.pure_register_cnt, dai.active_cnt, dai.active_cnt_30days, dai.pay_cnt, dai.pay_amt, dai.active_pay_30d_cnt, dai.active_register_pay_30d_cnt, dai.active_register_30d_cnt, dai.recurring_cnt_30days, dai.nologin_cnt_30days, dai.pay_amt_exrate, COALESCE(per.active_cnt_period, 0) AS active_cnt_period, COALESCE(per.pay_cnt_period, 0) AS pay_cnt_period, COALESCE(dai.online_dur, 0) AS online_dur /*	当日玩家总在线时长(单位：s) */, COALESCE(dai.new_active_cnt, 0) AS new_active_cnt /*	新用户活跃玩家数 */, 0 AS register_cnt_total /*	历史总注册玩家数 */, COALESCE(dai.lose_cnt_7ds, 0) AS lose_cnt_7ds /*	7日流失玩家数 */, COALESCE(dai.active_cnt_7ds, 0) AS active_cnt_7ds /*	7日前DAU */, COALESCE(dai.lose_cnt_30ds, 0) AS lose_cnt_30ds /*	30日流失玩家数 */, COALESCE(dai.active_cnt_30ds, 0) AS active_cnt_30ds /*	30日前DAU */, COALESCE(dai.active_cnt_7days, 0) AS active_cnt_7days, 0 AS year_pay_amt, 0 AS year_before_tax_usd_amt, 0 AS his_pay_amt, 0 AS his_before_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(dai.recurring_cnt_14days, 0) AS recurring_cnt_14days, COALESCE(dai.nologin_cnt_14days, 0) AS nologin_cnt_14days, COALESCE(dai.actual_pay_amt, 0) AS actual_pay_amt, 2 AS user_type, NULL AS channel, 0 AS active_cnt_90days, 0 AS vaild_user_cnt, 0 AS vaild_user_online_dur, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS logymd, 'mcgg_v2' AS appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'monthly' AS date_type FROM daily_tbl AS dai LEFT JOIN res_period AS per ON dai.country = per.country AND dai.os = per.os AND dai.network = per.network

'历史累计税率校准付费金额', */ /*     `recurring_cnt_14days` bigint COMMENT '14日回流玩家数', */ /*     `nologin_cnt_14days` bigint COMMENT '14日未登录玩家数', */ /*     `actual_pay_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '实收金额(单位:美分)', */ /*     `user_type` bigint COMMENT '用户类型，1：刷号，2：非刷号' */ /* ) COMMENT '经分首页boss看板-一级指标中间ads表' PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区(yyy-MM-dd)', */ /*     `appname` string COMMENT '项目ID(mlbb,xgame)', */ /*     `granularity_type` string COMMENT '粒度类型(account,device)', */ /*     `date_type` string COMMENT '日期类型(daily,weekly,monthly)' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS parquet */ /* location 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid'; */ WITH zgame_feature_df AS (SELECT *, accountid AS roleid, first_mt_country AS country FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY create_role_date) AS rn FROM mt_dm.dm_zgame_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND create_account_date <= '2026-05-31') WHERE rn = 1), account_pay_di AS (/* 支付 */ SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_zgame_pay_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND logymd >= '2023-07-01' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid), active_all_account AS (SELECT roleid FROM bi_test.dwm_zgame_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') GROUP BY roleid), res_period AS (SELECT COALESCE(bas.country, 'unknown') AS country, 'unknown' AS os, 'unknown' AS network, 1 AS user_type, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.roleid) AS pay_cnt_period, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid) AS active_cnt_period FROM zgame_feature_df AS bas LEFT JOIN account_pay_di AS pay ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid LEFT JOIN active_all_account AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid GROUP BY COALESCE(bas.country, 'unknown') UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(bas.country, 'unknown') AS country, 'unknown' AS os, 'unknown' AS network, 2 AS user_type, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.roleid) AS pay_cnt_period, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid) AS active_cnt_period FROM zgame_feature_df AS bas LEFT JOIN account_pay_di AS pay ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid LEFT JOIN active_all_account AS act ON bas.roleid = act.roleid WHERE is_cur_bot = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(bas.country, 'unknown')), daily_tbl AS (SELECT country /*	国家 */, os /*	创角平台 */, network /*	首次广告归因渠道 */, user_type, SUM(register_cnt) AS register_cnt /*	新增玩家数 */, SUM(pure_register_cnt) AS pure_register_cnt /*	纯净新增玩家数 */, SUM(active_cnt) AS active_pay_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且最近30天内充值过的玩家 */, SUM(active_register_pay_30d_cnt) AS active_register_pay_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且新增第30天且30天内充值过的玩家 */, SUM(active_register_30d_cnt) AS active_register_30d_cnt /*	今日活跃且新增第30天的玩家 */, SUM(recurring_cnt_30days) AS recurring_cnt_30days /*	30日回流玩家数 */, SUM(nologin_cnt_30days) AS nologin_cnt_30days /*	30日未登录玩家数 */, SUM(pay_amt_exrate) AS pay_amt_exrate /*	汇率校准付费金额 */, SUM(recurring_cnt_14days) AS recurring_cnt_14days /*	14日回流玩家数 */, SUM(nologin_cnt_14days) AS nologin_cnt_14days /*	14日未登录玩家数 */, SUM(online_dur) AS online_dur, SUM(new_active_cnt) AS new_active_cnt, SUM(lose_cnt_7ds) AS lose_cnt_7ds, SUM(active_cnt_7ds) AS active_cnt_7ds, SUM(lose_cnt_30ds) AS lose_cnt_30ds, SUM(active_cnt_30ds) AS active_cnt_30ds, SUM(active_cnt_7days) AS active_cnt_7days, SUM(actual_pay_amt) AS actual_pay_amt, SUM(vaild_user_cnt) AS vaild_user_cnt, SUM(vaild_user_online_dur) AS vaild_user_online_dur FROM mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND appname = 'zgame' AND granularity_type = 'account' AND date_type = 'daily' GROUP BY country /*	国家 */, os /*	创角平台 */, network, user_type /*	首次广告归因渠道 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di_mid PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type) SELECT SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AS date_range, dai.country, dai.os, dai.network, dai.register_cnt, dai.pure_register_cnt, dai.active_cnt, dai.active_cnt_30days, dai.pay_cnt, dai.pay_amt, dai.active_pay_30d_cnt, dai.active_register_pay_30d_cnt, dai.active_register_30d_cnt, dai.recurring_cnt_30days, dai.nologin_cnt_30days, dai.pay_amt_exrate, COALESCE(active_cnt_period, 0) AS active_cnt_period, COALESCE(pay_cnt_period, 0) AS pay_cnt_period, COALESCE(dai.online_dur, 0) AS online_dur /*	当日玩家总在线时长(单位：s) */, COALESCE(dai.new_active_cnt, 0) AS new_active_cnt /*	新用户活跃玩家数 */, 0 AS register_cnt_total /*	历史总注册玩家数 */, COALESCE(dai.lose_cnt_7ds, 0) AS lose_cnt_7ds /*	7日流失玩家数 */, COALESCE(dai.active_cnt_7ds, 0) AS active_cnt_7ds /*	7日前DAU */, COALESCE(dai.lose_cnt_30ds, 0) AS lose_cnt_30ds /*	30日流失玩家数 */, COALESCE(dai.active_cnt_30ds, 0) AS active_cnt_30ds /*	30日前DAU */, COALESCE(dai.active_cnt_7days, 0) AS active_cnt_7days, 0 AS year_pay_amt, 0 AS year_before_tax_usd_amt, 0 AS his_pay_amt, 0 AS his_before_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(dai.recurring_cnt_14days, 0) AS recurring_cnt_14days, COALESCE(dai.nologin_cnt_14days, 0) AS nologin_cnt_14days, COALESCE(dai.actual_pay_amt, 0) AS actual_pay_amt, dai.user_type, NULL AS channel, 0 AS active_cnt_90days, vaild_user_cnt, vaild_user_online_dur, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS logymd, 'zgame' AS appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'monthly' AS date_type FROM daily_tbl AS dai LEFT JOIN res_period AS per ON dai.country = per.country AND dai.os = per.os AND dai.network = per.network AND dai.user_type = per.user_type

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE nova_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_offset_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'nova', zone_region) SELECT COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(df.zone_type, di.zone_type) AS zone_type, COALESCE(df.zone_offset, di.zone_offset) AS zone_offset, COALESCE(df.his_first_active_date, SUBSTRING(di.first_login_time_offset, 1, 10)) AS his_first_active_date, COALESCE(SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time_offset, 1, 10), df.his_last_active_date) AS his_last_active_date, COALESCE(df.his_first_active_time, di.first_login_time_offset) AS his_first_active_time, COALESCE(di.last_login_time_offset, df.his_last_active_time) AS his_last_active_time, COALESCE(di.last_login_channel, df.his_last_channel) AS his_last_channel, COALESCE(di.last_sub_channel, df.his_last_sub_channel) AS his_last_sub_channel, COALESCE(di.last_login_ip, df.his_last_login_ip) AS his_last_login_ip, COALESCE(di.last_ip_country, df.his_last_ip_country) AS his_last_ip_country, COALESCE(di.last_ip_location, df.his_last_ip_location) AS his_last_ip_location, COALESCE(di.last_os_type, df.his_last_os_type) AS his_last_os_type, COALESCE(di.last_os_name, df.his_last_os_name) AS his_last_os_name, COALESCE(di.last_os_language, df.his_last_os_language) AS his_last_os_language, COALESCE(di.last_os_version, df.his_last_os_version) AS his_last_os_version, COALESCE(di.last_client_language, df.his_last_client_language) AS his_last_client_language, COALESCE(di.last_client_version, df.his_last_client_version) AS his_last_client_version, COALESCE(di.last_device_id, df.his_last_device_id) AS his_last_device_id, COALESCE(di.last_device_model, df.his_last_device_model) AS his_last_device_model, COALESCE(di.last_did, df.his_last_did) AS his_last_did, COALESCE(di.last_role_level, df.his_last_role_level) AS his_last_role_level, COALESCE(IF(di.max_role_level >= COALESCE(df.his_max_role_level, 0), di.max_role_level, NULL), df.his_max_role_level) AS his_max_role_level, COALESCE(di.last_alliance_id, df.his_last_alliance_id) AS his_last_alliance_id /* IF(NVL(di.max_role_level,0)>=NVL(df.his_max_role_level,0), di.max_role_level, df.his_max_role_level) AS his_max_role_level, */, COALESCE(di.last_alliance_name, df.his_last_alliance_name) AS his_last_alliance_name, COALESCE(di.last_alliance_level, df.his_last_alliance_level) AS his_last_alliance_level, COALESCE(di.last_war_stage, df.his_last_war_stage) AS his_last_war_stage, COALESCE(di.last_diamond_free, df.his_last_diamond_free) AS his_last_diamond_free, COALESCE(di.last_diamond_paid, df.his_last_diamond_paid) AS his_last_diamond_paid, COALESCE(di.last_gacha_token_normal, df.his_last_gacha_token_normal) AS his_last_gacha_token_normal, COALESCE(di.last_gacha_token_up, df.his_last_gacha_token_up) AS his_last_gacha_token_up, COALESCE(di.last_voucher, df.his_last_voucher) AS his_last_voucher, COALESCE(di.last_inherit_level, df.his_last_inherit_level) AS his_last_inherit_level, COALESCE(IF(di.max_inherit_level >= COALESCE(df.his_max_inherit_level, 0), di.max_inherit_level, NULL), df.his_max_inherit_level) AS his_max_inherit_level, COALESCE(di.last_active_score, df.his_last_active_score) AS his_last_active_score, COALESCE(di.last_power, df.his_last_power) AS his_last_power, CASE WHEN df.roleid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN di.roleid IS NULL THEN df.his_last_active_second_date WHEN NOT di.roleid IS NULL AND df.his_last_active_second_date IS NULL THEN df.his_last_active_date WHEN NOT df.roleid IS NULL AND NOT di.roleid IS NULL AND SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time_offset, 1, 10) > df.his_last_active_date THEN df.his_last_active_date WHEN NOT df.roleid IS NULL AND SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time_offset, 1, 10) < df.his_last_active_date THEN IF(SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time_offset, 1, 10) > COALESCE(df.his_last_active_second_date, '1970-01-01'), SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time_offset, 1, 10), df.his_last_active_second_date) ELSE df.his_last_active_second_date END AS his_last_active_second_date, COALESCE(di.active_days, df.total_active_days) AS total_active_days, COALESCE(df.total_login_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(di.login_cnt, 0) AS total_login_cnt, COALESCE(df.total_online_dur, 0) + COALESCE(di.online_duration, 0) AS total_online_dur, NULL AS his_active_days, IF(COALESCE(di.login_cnt, 0) > 0, 1, 0) + COALESCE(df.his_active_days_cnt, 0) AS his_active_days_cnt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 THEN 'apac' WHEN COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 THEN 'eu' WHEN COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 THEN 'us' ELSE CASE WHEN COALESCE(df.zone_offset, di.zone_offset) = -8 THEN 'us' WHEN COALESCE(df.zone_offset, di.zone_offset) = 9 THEN 'apac' END END AS zone_region FROM (SELECT * FROM nova_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_offset_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' /* 数据从2025-08-07开始 */ AND appid = 'nova' AND zone_offset = STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_offset))) AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM nova_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_offset_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND appid = 'nova' AND zone_offset = STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_offset))) AS df ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid

name: old_redownload
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.amandapiao_old_redownload_data PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT CASE WHEN FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) = 57 THEN '测服' WHEN FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) < 57 THEN '正式服' END AS zone_type, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid) AS user_count /* issuccess_info_array, */ FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, COLLECT_SET(issuccess) AS issuccess_set, COLLECT_LIST(issuccess) AS issuccess_list, ARRAYDISTINCT(CAST(issuccess_info AS ARRAY<STRING>)) AS issuccess_info_array FROM (/* --先对用户的档位变化情况做一个排序 */ SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, client_ver, issuccess, COLLECT_LIST(issuccess) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, client_ver ORDER BY time, startup_time ASC rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND UNBOUNDED following) AS issuccess_info FROM ml_ods.connserver_resreport AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND   client_ver like '%905.2%' */ NOT downloadtype IN (2, 5, 40, 30) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT logymd, accountid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_configuration AS b WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_first_afterinstall = 1 AND a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.logymd = b.logymd GROUP BY logymd, accountid) /* -重复安装 */ AND EXISTS(SELECT logymd, accountid FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, COUNT(DISTINCT game_channel) AS channel_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_moduledownload WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, accountid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT game_channel) = 1) AS d WHERE a.accountid = d.accountid AND a.logymd = d.logymd) AND EXISTS(SELECT logymd, roleid FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT deviceid) AS deviceid_cnt FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, roleid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT deviceid) = 1) AS f WHERE a.accountid = f.roleid AND a.logymd = f.logymd) AND EXISTS(SELECT logymd, accountid FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, COUNT(DISTINCT gradingnum_id) AS grading_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_moduledownload WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, accountid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gradingnum_id) = 1) AS g WHERE a.accountid = g.accountid AND a.logymd = g.logymd) GROUP BY logymd, accountid, time, startup_time, zoneid, client_ver, issuccess) GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, issuccess, issuccess_info) AS a WHERE issuccess_info_array <> ARRAY('0', '1') AND issuccess_info_array <> ARRAY('0') AND issuccess_info_array <> ARRAY('1') /* - OR (issuccess_info_array  NOT IN array('0'))  OR ( issuccess_info_array  NOT IN array('1'))) */ GROUP BY zone_type

sql_units: WITH t_charge AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, product_id, pay_channel_config AS pay_channel, sub_pay_channel_config AS sub_pay_channel, sub_pay_channel_config_source AS sub_pay_channel_source, pay_channel_type, pay_type, bill_country /* 账单国家 */, currency /* 币种 */, logymd, SUM(product_money) AS product_money /* 定价流水 */, SUM(pay_net_receipts_amt) AS actual_amt /* 本币实收 */, SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS actual_usd_amt /* 美金实收 */, SUM(pay_amt) AS pay_amt, SUM(pay_usd_amt) AS pay_usd_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_mcgg_charge_role_zone_tz_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND timezone_type = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pay_channel_config, sub_pay_channel_config, sub_pay_channel_config_source, pay_channel_type, pay_type, bill_country, currency, logymd, product_id), t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, create_role_date AS create_date, IF(first_mt_country = '' OR first_mt_country = '-' OR first_mt_country IS NULL, 'unknown', first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df_decismart WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-09-01', '2025-09-01', '2026-05-31') AND is_first_create = 1 AND create_role_date <= '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_finance_role_zone_tz_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mcgg_v2', granularity_type = 'role', date_type = 'daily', timezone_type = 0) SELECT t_charge.roleid, t_charge.zoneid, 0 AS zone_type, logymd AS date_range, logymd AS date_range_start, logymd AS date_range_end, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, product_id, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, sub_pay_channel_source, pay_channel_type, pay_type, bill_country, t_charge.currency, product_money, actual_amt, actual_usd_amt, pay_amt, pay_usd_amt FROM t_charge LEFT JOIN t_basic ON t_charge.roleid = t_basic.roleid

is_acc_cur_bot, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', t0.create_date) AS create_days_cnt /* COALESCE(t0.is_init_bot, t1.is_cur_bot,0) AS is_init_bot, */ /* COALESCE(t1.is_cur_bot, t0.is_cur_bot,0) AS is_cur_bot, */ /* first_value(COALESCE(t0.is_acc_init_bot, t1.is_acc_init_bot,0)) over(partition by t0.roleid order by create_time)  AS is_acc_init_bot, */ /* IF(first_value(COALESCE(t1.is_acc_cur_bot, t0.is_acc_cur_bot,0)) over(partition by t0.roleid order by create_time) = 0, 0,COALESCE(t1.is_acc_cur_bot, t0.is_acc_cur_bot,0)) AS is_acc_cur_bot, */, CASE WHEN t0.zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR t0.zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 THEN 'apac' WHEN t0.zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 THEN 'eu' WHEN t0.zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 THEN 'us' ELSE CASE WHEN t0.zone_offset = -8 THEN 'us' WHEN t0.zone_offset = 9 THEN 'apac' END END AS zone_region FROM (SELECT COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(df.zone_type, di.zone_type) AS zone_type, COALESCE(df.create_did, di.create_did) AS create_did, COALESCE(df.account_name, di.account_name) AS account_name, COALESCE(df.create_time, di.create_time) AS create_time, COALESCE(df.create_date, di.create_date) AS create_date, COALESCE(df.zone_offset, di.zone_offset) AS zone_offset, COALESCE(df.create_date_offset, di.create_date_offset) AS create_date_offset, COALESCE(df.create_time_offset, di.create_time_offset) AS create_time_offset, COALESCE(df.create_logtime_offset, di.create_logtime_offset) AS create_logtime_offset, COALESCE(df.create_os_type, di.create_os_type, -99999) AS create_os_type, COALESCE(df.create_os_name, di.create_os_name, 'unknown') AS create_os_name, COALESCE(df.create_os_version, di.create_os_version, 'unknown') AS create_os_version, COALESCE(df.create_client_version, di.create_client_version, 'unknown') AS create_client_version, COALESCE(df.create_model, di.create_model, 'unknown') AS create_model, COALESCE(df.create_ip, di.create_ip, 'unknown') AS create_ip, COALESCE(df.create_country, di.create_country, 'unknown') AS create_country, COALESCE(df.createrole_country, di.createrole_country, 'unknown') AS createrole_country, COALESCE(df.create_channel_code, di.create_channel_code, 'unknown') AS create_channel_code, COALESCE(df.create_channel, di.create_channel, 'unknown') AS create_channel, COALESCE(df.create_sub_channel_code, di.create_sub_channel_code, 'unknown') AS create_sub_channel_code, COALESCE(df.create_sub_channel_name, di.create_sub_channel_name, 'unknown') AS create_sub_channel_name, COALESCE(df.is_emulator, di.is_emulator) AS is_emulator, COALESCE(df.data_source, di.data_source) AS data_source, IF(COALESCE(df.zone_type, di.zone_type) = 1, 1, -99999) AS formal_ord /* df.is_cur_bot, */ /* df.is_init_bot, */ /* df.is_acc_cur_bot, */ /* df.is_acc_init_bot */ FROM df_his AS df FULL JOIN role_create_login_charge_di AS di ON df.roleid = di.roleid AND df.zoneid = di.zoneid) AS t0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, is_init_bot, is_cur_bot, is_acc_init_bot, is_acc_cur_bot FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df_timezone WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND region IN (STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_region)))) AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(roleid AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) AS roleid, CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) AS zoneid, first_ad_country, first_mt_country FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 4400) AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t2.zoneid

name: mt_dim.dim_finance_currency_info_df_monthly
sql_units: WITH t_currency_rate AS (SELECT appname, currency, currency_name, CAST(AVG(currency_exchange_rate) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) AS currency_exchange_rate /* 月度平均汇率 */, CAST(AVG(db_exchange_rate) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) AS db_exchange_rate FROM mt_dm.dim_finance_currency_info_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND date_type = 'daily' AND appname IN ('mlbb', 'mcgg_v2') GROUP BY appname, currency, currency_name) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dim_finance_currency_info_df PARTITION(logymd, appname, date_type) SELECT SUBSTRING(LAST_DAY('2026-05-31'), 1, 7) AS date_range, currency, currency_name, currency_exchange_rate, db_exchange_rate, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS logymd, appname, 'weekly' AS date_type FROM t_currency_rate

name: 假量筛选_创建信息
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: crystalmei@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-09-22 16:58:16.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* insert overwrite  TABLE ml_temp.mc_fake_role_create_v1 */ /* PARTITION (logymd = '2026-05-31') */ /* SELECT  accountid */ /* FROM    ml_ods.accountserver_account_create ac */ /* WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /* AND     os_build LIKE '%AP1%'; */ WITH abnormal AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.accountid FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create AS a WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.os_build IS NULL /* 1、该账号在account_create时的os_build is NULL */ GROUP BY a.logymd, a.accountid), users AS (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS a WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.is_ai = 0 AND a.is_first_create = 1 AND a.register_date = '2026-05-31'), change_name /* 2、该账号无起名或切号行为 */ AS (SELECT roleid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_change_name WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid), account_rebind AS (SELECT old_accountid AS roleid FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_rebind WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY old_accountid), error_message /* 3、该账号在客户端加密参数解析失败 */ AS (SELECT roleid FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, spingstamp['error_message'] AS error_message FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, PKCS_DECRPTY(spingstamp, CAST(roleid AS BIGINT)) AS spingstamp FROM ml_ods.gameserver_gameserver_login_plugin_check WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31')) AS aa WHERE error_message = 'E_Decrypt' GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.mc_fake_role_create_v1 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.accountid FROM abnormal AS a LEFT JOIN users AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid LEFT JOIN change_name AS c ON a.accountid = c.roleid LEFT JOIN account_rebind AS d ON a.accountid = d.roleid LEFT JOIN error_message AS f ON a.accountid = f.roleid WHERE NOT b.roleid IS NULL AND c.roleid IS NULL AND d.roleid IS NULL AND NOT f.roleid IS NULL GROUP BY a.accountid UNION ALL SELECT accountid FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create AS a WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.os_build LIKE '%AP1%' /* 异常特征 */

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.mc_fake_quantity_users_create PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, statdate, first_network_name FROM ml_temp.mc_fake_role_create_v1 AS rc LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, register_date AS statdate, first_network_name FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     register_date >= '2026-04-01' */ appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1) AS rzd ON rc.accountid = rzd.roleid WHERE rc.logymd = '2026-05-31'

mt_dwd.dwd_game_guide_role_zone_di WHERE logymd > '2026-05-24' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2 GROUP BY heroid, mmr_new) AS t1), heroid_highligth_detail AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE 0)), 0) AS after_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), after_tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS after_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), back_tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS back_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), back_tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS back_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), share_amt, 0)), 0) AS share_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), share_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS share_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), fee_amt, 0)), 0) AS fee_amt, IF(fee_exchange_rate = 0, 0, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), fee_amt, 0)) / fee_exchange_rate, 0)) AS fee_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), actual_amt, 0)), 0) AS actual_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), actual_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), base_diamond, 0)), 0) AS pay_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS free_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), base_diamond + extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS get_diamond, COALESCE(MIN(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS first_token_time, COALESCE(MAX(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_token_time, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, bill_amt, 0)), 0) AS pay_token_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, bill_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_token_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_token_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, base_diamond, 0)), 0) AS pay_token_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS free_token_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, base_diamond + extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS get_token_diamond, COALESCE(MIN(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS first_sandbox_time, COALESCE(MAX(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_sandbox_time, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, bill_amt, 0)), 0) AS pay_sandbox_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, bill_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_sandbox_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_sandbox_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, base_diamond, 0)), 0) AS pay_sandbox_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS free_sandbox_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, base_diamond + extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS get_sandbox_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), money, 0)), 0) AS product_money, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, money, 0)), 0) AS product_token_money, COALESCE(SPLIT(MIN(time_device_id), '-')[1], 'unknown') AS first_pay_device_id, COALESCE(SPLIT(MAX(time_device_id), '-')[1], 'unknown') AS last_pay_device_id FROM raw_dwd GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pay_channel_name, sub_pay_channel, bill_country, bill_currency, logymd, mt_dim.dim_currency_country_di */ /*             WHERE   logymd <= IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-09-01', '2025-09-01', '2026-05-31') */ /*         ) */ /* UNION ALL */ /* SELECT  'unknown' AS country, */ parent_config_name, pay_channel AS config_id, pay_channel_name AS config_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pay_channel_type ORDER BY product_money DESC) AS config_order, '支付渠道' AS config_desc FROM pay_channel, pay_channel_name, sub_pay_channel, sub_pay_channel_id, SUM(product_money) AS product_money FROM mcgg_pay_channel GROUP BY pay_channel, pay_channel_name, sub_pay_channel, parent_config_id, */ /* 'unknown' AS parent_config_name, */, CONCAT(d1.country_name, '(', LOWER(d1.country), ')') AS parent_config_name, d1.currency AS config_id, CONCAT(d1.currency_name, '(', COALESCE(t2.country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(t2.country_name, '其他') AS country_name FROM (SELECT currency, currency_name FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_exchange_df WHERE logymd <= IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-09-01', '2025-09-01', '2026-05-31') AND currency <> 'unknown' GROUP BY currency, currency_name) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT currency, tp.country, tq.country_name FROM (SELECT DISTINCT currency, name: mt_dm.dm_finance_role_zone_tz_di_daily_billtime_mlbb
sql_units: WITH t_charge AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, product_id, pay_channel_config AS pay_channel, sub_pay_channel_config AS sub_pay_channel, sub_pay_channel_config_source AS sub_pay_channel_source, pay_channel_type, pay_type, bill_country /* 账单国家 */, currency /* 币种 */, logymd, SUM(product_money) AS product_money /* 定价流水 */, SUM(pay_net_receipts_amt) AS actual_amt /* 本币实收 */, SUM(pay_net_receipts_usd_amt) AS actual_usd_amt /* 美金实收 */, SUM(pay_amt) AS pay_amt, SUM(pay_usd_amt) AS pay_usd_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_tz_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND timezone_type = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pay_channel_config, sub_pay_channel_config, pay_channel_type, pay_type, bill_country, currency, logymd, product_id, sub_pay_channel_config_source), t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-01-01', '2025-01-01', '2026-05-30') AND is_first_create = 1 AND register_date <= '2026-05-30') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_finance_role_zone_tz_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'role', date_type = 'daily', timezone_type = 1) SELECT t_charge.roleid, t_charge.zoneid, CASE WHEN zoneid < 57000 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS zone_type, logymd AS date_range, logymd AS date_range_start, logymd AS date_range_end, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, product_id, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, sub_pay_channel_source, pay_channel_type, pay_type, bill_country, t_charge.currency, product_money, actual_amt, actual_usd_amt, pay_amt, pay_usd_amt FROM t_charge LEFT JOIN t_basic ON t_charge.roleid = t_basic.roleid
