name: etl.mt_dm.dm_finance_user_channel_tz_di_daily_mlbb
sql_units: WITH last_pay_channel AS (SELECT pay.logymd, pay.pay_channel, pay.pay_channel_config_config AS pay_channel_config, pay.roleid, COALESCE(lt.pay_channel, 'unknown') AS last_pay_channel /* 后端要求不能为空，给NULL值一个定义 */, COALESCE(lt.pay_channel_config, 'unknown') AS last_pay_channel_config FROM (SELECT pay_channel_config AS pay_channel, CASE WHEN pay_channel_config = 'mobapay' THEN 'mp' WHEN pay_channel_config = 'web_coda' THEN 'coda' WHEN pay_channel_config = 'web_unipin' THEN 'unipin' WHEN pay_channel_config = 'web_pag' THEN 'web_pag' WHEN pay_channel_config = 'ios_usa' THEN 'ios' WHEN pay_channel_config = 'and_usa' THEN 'gp' ELSE 'other' END AS pay_channel_config_config, roleid, logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_tz_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND timezone_type = 0 AND zoneid <= 57000 GROUP BY pay_channel_config, roleid, logymd) AS pay LEFT JOIN (/* 上笔订单渠道 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, pay_channel, CASE WHEN pay_channel = 'mobapay' THEN 'mp' WHEN pay_channel = 'web_coda' THEN 'coda' WHEN pay_channel = 'web_unipin' THEN 'unipin' WHEN pay_channel = 'web_pag' THEN 'web_pag' WHEN pay_channel = 'ios_usa' THEN 'ios' WHEN pay_channel = 'and_usa' THEN 'gp' ELSE 'other' END AS pay_channel_config FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, roleid ORDER BY his_last_pay_time DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mobapay' ELSE COALESCE(pay_channel, 'unknown') END AS pay_channel, his_last_pay_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid <= 57000)) WHERE rn = 1) AS lt ON pay.roleid = lt.roleid), pay_channel_user_first_date /* 分渠道首次支付日期 */ AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mobapay' ELSE COALESCE(pay_channel, 'unknown') END AS pay_channel, MIN(SUBSTRING(his_first_pay_time, 1, 10)) AS his_first_pay_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid <= 57000 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mobapay' ELSE COALESCE(pay_channel, 'unknown') END), user_first_date /* 首次支付日期 */ AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, MIN(SUBSTRING(his_first_pay_time, 1, 10)) AS his_first_pay_date FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid <= 57000 GROUP BY logymd, roleid), user_type /* 用户类型：0-破冰新客 1-渠道新客 2-老客 */ AS (SELECT t1.logymd, t1.roleid, t1.pay_channel, t1.pay_channel_config, t1.last_pay_channel, t1.last_pay_channel_config, CASE WHEN t2.his_first_pay_date = t1.logymd THEN 0 WHEN t3.his_first_pay_date = t1.logymd THEN 1 WHEN t3.his_first_pay_date < t1.logymd THEN 2 END AS user_type FROM last_pay_channel AS t1 LEFT JOIN user_first_date AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.logymd = t2.logymd LEFT JOIN pay_channel_user_first_date AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.pay_channel = t3.pay_channel AND t1.logymd = t3.logymd), future_14_to_go /* 未来14天复购渠道(取第一笔) */ AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, pay_channel_config, CASE WHEN pay_channel_config = 'mobapay' THEN 'mp' WHEN pay_channel_config = 'web_coda' THEN 'coda' WHEN pay_channel_config = 'web_unipin' THEN 'unipin' WHEN pay_channel_config = 'web_pag' THEN 'web_pag' WHEN pay_channel_config = 'ios_usa' THEN 'ios' WHEN pay_channel_config = 'and_usa' THEN 'gp' ELSE 'other' END AS pay_channel_config_config FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, pay_channel_config, first_pay_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, roleid ORDER BY first_pay_time ASC, pay_channel_config) AS rn FROM (SELECT t1.logymd, t2.roleid, t2.pay_channel_config, t2.first_pay_time FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(DATE('2026-05-17'), DATE('2026-05-30'))) AS logymd) AS t1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, pay_channel_config, first_pay_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_tz_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-18' AND '2026-05-31' AND timezone_type = 0 AND zoneid <= 57000) AS t2 WHERE t1.logymd < t2.logymd)) WHERE rn = 1), user_type_and_to_go /* 更新过去15天分区复购标签 */ AS (SELECT t1.logymd, t1.roleid, t1.pay_channel, t1.pay_channel_config, t1.last_pay_channel_yd, t1.last_pay_channel_yd_config, t1.pay_user_type, COALESCE(t2.pay_channel_config, 'unknown') AS first_recall_pay_channel /* 后端要求不能为空，给NULL值一个定义 */, COALESCE(t2.pay_channel_config_config, 'unknown') AS first_recall_pay_channel_config FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, pay_channel, last_pay_channel AS last_pay_channel_yd, user_type AS pay_user_type, pay_channel_config, last_pay_channel_config AS last_pay_channel_yd_config FROM user_type UNION ALL SELECT logymd, roleid, pay_channel, last_pay_channel_yd, pay_user_type, pay_channel_config, last_pay_channel_yd_config FROM mt_dm.dm_finance_user_channel_tz_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-30') AS t1 LEFT JOIN future_14_to_go AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd AND t1.roleid = t2.roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_finance_user_channel_tz_di PARTITION(logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type, timezone_type) SELECT t1.logymd AS date_range, t1.roleid, -99999 AS zoneid, COALESCE(t2.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, t1.pay_channel, t1.pay_user_type, t1.last_pay_channel_yd, t1.first_recall_pay_channel, t1.pay_channel_config, t1.last_pay_channel_yd_config, t1.first_recall_pay_channel_config, t1.logymd, 'mlbb' AS appname, 'role' AS granularity_type, 'daily' AS date_type, 0 AS timezone_type FROM user_type_and_to_go AS t1 LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t2.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND t2.is_first_create = 1

COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(df.zone_type, di.zone_type) AS zone_type, COALESCE(df.zone_offset, di.zone_offset) AS zone_offset, COALESCE(df.his_first_active_date, SUBSTRING(di.first_login_time_offset, 1, 10)) AS his_first_active_date, COALESCE(SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time_offset, 1, 10), df.his_last_active_date) AS his_last_active_date, COALESCE(di.last_login_channel, df.his_last_channel) AS his_last_channel, COALESCE(di.last_sub_channel, df.his_last_sub_channel) AS his_last_sub_channel, COALESCE(di.last_login_ip, df.his_last_login_ip) AS his_last_login_ip, COALESCE(di.last_ip_country, df.his_last_ip_country) AS his_last_ip_country, COALESCE(di.last_ip_location, df.his_last_ip_location) AS his_last_ip_location, COALESCE(di.last_os_type, df.his_last_os_type) AS his_last_os_type, COALESCE(di.last_os_name, df.his_last_os_name) AS his_last_os_name, COALESCE(di.last_os_language, df.his_last_os_language) AS his_last_os_language, COALESCE(di.last_os_version, df.his_last_os_version) AS his_last_os_version, COALESCE(di.last_client_language, df.his_last_client_language) AS his_last_client_language, COALESCE(di.last_client_version, df.his_last_client_version) AS his_last_client_version, COALESCE(di.last_device_id, df.his_last_device_id) AS his_last_device_id, COALESCE(di.last_device_model, df.his_last_device_model) AS his_last_device_model, COALESCE(di.last_did, df.his_last_did) AS his_last_did, COALESCE(di.last_role_level, df.his_last_role_level) AS his_last_role_level, COALESCE(IF(di.max_role_level >= COALESCE(df.his_max_role_level, 0), di.max_role_level, NULL), df.his_max_role_level) AS his_max_role_level, COALESCE(di.last_alliance_id, df.his_last_alliance_id) AS his_last_alliance_id /* IF(NVL(di.max_role_level,0)>=NVL(df.his_max_role_level,0), di.max_role_level, df.his_max_role_level) AS his_max_role_level, */, COALESCE(di.last_alliance_name, df.his_last_alliance_name) AS his_last_alliance_name, COALESCE(di.last_alliance_level, df.his_last_alliance_level) AS his_last_alliance_level, COALESCE(di.last_war_stage, df.his_last_war_stage) AS his_last_war_stage, COALESCE(di.last_diamond_free, df.his_last_diamond_free) AS his_last_diamond_free, COALESCE(di.last_diamond_paid, df.his_last_diamond_paid) AS his_last_diamond_paid, COALESCE(di.last_gacha_token_normal, df.his_last_gacha_token_normal) AS his_last_gacha_token_normal, COALESCE(di.last_gacha_token_up, df.his_last_gacha_token_up) AS his_last_gacha_token_up, COALESCE(di.last_voucher, df.his_last_voucher) AS his_last_voucher, COALESCE(di.last_inherit_level, df.his_last_inherit_level) AS his_last_inherit_level, COALESCE(IF(di.max_inherit_level >= COALESCE(df.his_max_inherit_level, 0), di.max_inherit_level, NULL), df.his_max_inherit_level) AS his_max_inherit_level, COALESCE(di.last_active_score, df.his_last_active_score) AS his_last_active_score, COALESCE(di.last_power, df.his_last_power) AS his_last_power, CASE WHEN df.roleid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN di.roleid IS NULL THEN df.his_last_active_second_date WHEN NOT di.roleid IS NULL AND df.his_last_active_second_date IS NULL THEN df.his_last_active_date WHEN NOT df.roleid IS NULL AND NOT di.roleid IS NULL AND SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time_offset, 1, 10) > df.his_last_active_date THEN df.his_last_active_date WHEN NOT df.roleid IS NULL AND SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time_offset, 1, 10) < df.his_last_active_date THEN IF(SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time_offset, 1, 10) > COALESCE(df.his_last_active_second_date, '1970-01-01'), SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time_offset, 1, 10), df.his_last_active_second_date) ELSE df.his_last_active_second_date END AS his_last_active_second_date, COALESCE(di.active_days, df.total_active_days) AS total_active_days, COALESCE(df.total_login_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(di.login_cnt, 0) AS total_login_cnt, COALESCE(df.total_online_dur, 0) + COALESCE(di.online_duration, 0) AS total_online_dur, NULL AS his_active_days, IF(COALESCE(di.login_cnt, 0) > 0, 1, 0) + COALESCE(df.his_active_days_cnt, 0) AS his_active_days_cnt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 THEN 'apac' WHEN COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 THEN 'eu' WHEN COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 THEN 'us' ELSE CASE WHEN COALESCE(df.zone_offset, di.zone_offset) = -8 THEN 'us' WHEN COALESCE(df.zone_offset, di.zone_offset) = 9 THEN 'apac' END END AS zone_region FROM (SELECT * FROM nova_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_offset_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' /* 数据从2025-08-07开始 */ AND appid = 'nova' AND zone_offset = STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_offset))) AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM nova_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_offset_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2025-06-25' AND appid = 'nova' AND zone_offset = STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_offset))) AS df ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid

sql_units: WITH t_currency_rate AS (SELECT appname, currency, currency_name, CAST(AVG(currency_exchange_rate) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) AS currency_exchange_rate /* 月度平均汇率 */, CAST(AVG(db_exchange_rate) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) AS db_exchange_rate FROM mt_dm.dim_finance_currency_info_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' AND date_type = 'daily' AND appname IN ('mlbb', 'mcgg_v2') GROUP BY appname, currency, currency_name) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dim_finance_currency_info_df PARTITION(logymd, appname, date_type) SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', (8 - DAYOFWEEK('2026-05-31')) % 7 - 3)), '-W', LPAD(CAST(WEEKOFYEAR('2026-05-31') AS STRING), 2, '0')) AS date_range, currency, currency_name, currency_exchange_rate, db_exchange_rate, DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', PMOD(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', '1900-01-01') - 0, 7) * -1), 6) AS logymd, appname, 'weekly' AS date_type FROM t_currency_rate

his_last_charge_logymd) >= 360 THEN '4、1年内无付费' ELSE 'else' END AS his_last_charge_logymd_type, first_act_logymd /* his_last_charge_logymd, */, first_charge_logymd, IF(NOT sub2.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS if_sub_diamond, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS ucnt FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN his_charge_amt >= 2000 THEN '7、[2000,)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 200 THEN '6、[200,2000)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 20 THEN '5、[20,200)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 10 THEN '4、[10,20)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 5 THEN '3、[5,10)' WHEN his_charge_amt >= 2 THEN '2、[2,5)' WHEN his_charge_amt > 0 THEN '1、(0,2)' ELSE '8、0' END AS his_r_label, his_last_charge_logymd, register_date, CASE WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MY', 'MM', 'RU', 'TR', 'IN', 'VN', 'TH') THEN UPPER(first_mt_country) WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('PE', 'BO') THEN UPPER(first_mt_country) WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('HK') THEN 'HK' ELSE 'else' END AS first_mt_country, DATEDIFF(SUBSTRING(a.logymd, 1, 7) || '-01', register_date) AS register_days, MIN(a.logymd) AS first_act_logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(logymd) AS his_last_charge_logymd, SUM(money / 100) AS his_charge_amt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE logymd <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', DAY('2026-05-31') * -1) /* 截止上月末的历史R级 */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND /* 20260526 剔除所有沙盒 */ /* AND     ( */ /*             pay_channel NOT IN ('and_huawei_ag', 'and_xiaomi_getapps') */ /*             OR is_sandbox = 0 */ /*         ) */ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据,因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS his_charge ON a.roleid = his_charge.roleid AND a.zoneid = his_charge.zoneid LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS bc ON a.roleid = bc.roleid AND a.zoneid = bc.zoneid AND bc.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND bc.appid = 'mlbb' WHERE SUBSTRING(a.logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND a.zoneid <= 57000 AND a.logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND a.is_ai = 0 GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, his_r_label, register_date, first_mt_country, register_days, his_last_charge_logymd) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(logymd) AS first_charge_logymd, MIN(TIME) AS charge_min_time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND a.zoneid < 57000 AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND /* 20260526 剔除所有沙盒 */ /* AND     ( */ /*             pay_channel NOT IN ('and_huawei_ag', 'and_xiaomi_getapps') */ /*             OR is_sandbox = 0 */ /*         ) */ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据,因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS charge ON a.roleid = charge.roleid AND a.zoneid = charge.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, TRIM(a.operate) AS operate, TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME ASC) AS time_rk FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid AS cg_roleid, zoneid AS cg_zoneid, MIN(TIME) AS charge_min_time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND a.zoneid < 57000 AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND /* 20260526 剔除所有沙盒 */ /* AND     ( */ /*             pay_channel NOT IN ('and_huawei_ag', 'and_xiaomi_getapps') */ /*             OR is_sandbox = 0 */ /*         ) */ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据,因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS charge ON a.roleid = cg_roleid AND a.zoneid = cg_zoneid AND a.time > charge_min_time WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND a.zoneid < 57000 AND LOWER(operate) <> 'gm' /* 剔除gm 20260529 */) AS sub ON a.roleid = sub.roleid AND a.zoneid = sub.zoneid AND sub.time_rk = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, TIME, MIN_BY(itemid, TIME) AS itemid, MIN_BY(shopid, TIME) AS shopid, MIN_BY(gift_item_info, TIME) AS gift_item_info /* IF(buysource IN (6, 14, 1, 24, 31, 5), buysource, -9999) buysource */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_shop_buy WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND zoneid < 57000 AND moneytype = 301 AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, TIME) AS shop_b ON a.roleid = shop_b.roleid AND a.zoneid = shop_b.zoneid AND sub.time = shop_b.time LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS shop_cf ON IF(shop_b.itemid = 0, SPLIT(gift_item_info, ':')[0], shop_b.itemid) = shop_cf.item_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, CASE WHEN quality = 1 THEN 'B级' WHEN quality = 2 THEN 'A级' WHEN quality = 3 THEN 'A+级' WHEN quality = 4 THEN 'S级' ELSE 'else' END AS skin_lvl FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS skin_cf ON shop_cf.item_id = skin_cf.skinid LEFT JOIN (SELECT operate AS operate2, nick_name, type AS op_type FROM ml_temp.temp_operate_config WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM ml_temp.temp_operate_config WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS op_cf ON TRIM(operate) = TRIM(op_cf.operate2) LEFT JOIN (SELECT logym, skinid, skin_name, skin_type AS skin_type_cf FROM ml_temp.ads_larsheet_leap_ml_shop_newskin_config_di WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM ml_temp.ads_larsheet_leap_ml_shop_newskin_config_di WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS month_skin_type /* 根据配置表获取对应皮肤信息 */ ON item_type = 6 AND shop_cf.item_id = month_skin_type.skinid AND SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(month_skin_type.logym, 1, 7) LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond AS a WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND a.zoneid < 57000 AND LOWER(operate) <> 'gm' /* 剔除gm 20260529 */) AS sub2 ON a.roleid = sub2.roleid AND a.zoneid = sub2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT accountid /* 异常新增账号 */ FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-08-15' AND '2026-05-31' /* 最新日期 */ AND (os_build /* abnormal1 条件 */ LIKE '%AP1%' OR /* abnormal2 条件 */ (os_build IS NULL AND (device_name IN ('OnePlus 11', 'Galaxy S21', 'Redmi Note 12') OR app_click_id IN (56, 185))))) AS abnormal_t ON a.roleid = abnormal_t.accountid WHERE abnormal_t.accountid IS NULL GROUP BY logym, first_mt_country, his_r_label, register_days_type, age_type, pay_sub_operate, pay_sub_operate_name, pay_sub_op_type, shop_item_type, skin_type, skin_lvl, shop_item_type_name, item_name2, shopid2, his_last_charge_logymd_type, first_act_logymd, first_charge_logymd, if_sub_diamond

sql_units: /* -- 聚合Map字段 */ /* */ /* 创建用户注册前三天充值付费汇总数据 */ /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE `mtai_test`.`dm_mcgg_behavior_commercial_account_zone_fd7_di`( */ /*             `fd7_accountid` DECIMAL(20, 0) COMMENT '账号ID（roleid）', */ /*             `fd7_zoneid` BIGINT COMMENT '大区ID', */ /*             `fd7_register_date` STRING COMMENT '注册日期（首次出现日期）', */ /*             `fd7_total_pay_amt` DOUBLE COMMENT '前7天总充值金额', */ /*             `fd7_total_pay_count` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天总充值次数', */ /*             `fd7_final_curdiamond` BIGINT COMMENT '第7天钻石余额', */ /*             `fd7_final_curbattle_point` BIGINT COMMENT '第7天战令点余额', */ /*             `fd7_final_curticket` BIGINT COMMENT '第7天抽券余额', */ /*             `fd7_pay_days` INT COMMENT '前7天内有充值行为的天数(1-7)', */ /*             `fd7_first_pay_date` STRING COMMENT '首次充值日期（方便查看）', */ /*             `fd7_first_pay_day` INT COMMENT '首次充值日,1-7,1代表注册首日', */ /*             `fd7_first_pay_amt` DOUBLE COMMENT '首次充值日期对应的当日充值金额', */ /*             `fd7_yl_pay_amt` DOUBLE COMMENT '银联充值金额', */ /*             `fd7_else_pay_amt` DOUBLE COMMENT '其他渠道充值金额', */ /*             `fd7_third_pay_amt` DOUBLE COMMENT '第三方充值金额', */ /*             `fd7_mobapay_amt` DOUBLE COMMENT 'moba渠道充值金额', */ /*             `fd7_nomobapay_amt` DOUBLE COMMENT '非moba渠道充值金额', */ /*             `fd7_iap_product_count_map` MAP <STRING, BIGINT> COMMENT 'IAP类型->购买次数（7天汇总）', */ /*             `fd7_iap_product_amt_map` MAP <STRING, DOUBLE> COMMENT 'IAP类型->充值金额（7天汇总）', */ /*             `fd7_pay_channel_amt_map` MAP <STRING, DOUBLE> COMMENT '充值渠道->金额（7天汇总）', */ /*             `fd7_total_chargediamond` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天获得钻石总量', */ /*             `fd7_total_sub_diamond` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天钻石消耗总量', */ /*             `fd7_sub_operate_map` MAP <STRING, BIGINT> COMMENT '消耗分类->金额（7天汇总）', */ /*             `fd7_total_shop_item_count` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天商城购买道具数量', */ /*             `fd7_shop_moneytype_amt_map` MAP <STRING, DOUBLE> COMMENT '货币类型->消费金额（7天汇总）', */ /*             `fd7_total_themedraw_count` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天SP抽奖次数', */ /*             `fd7_total_themedraw_diamond_cost` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天SP抽奖钻石消耗', */ /*             `fd7_total_themedraw_ticket_cost` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天SP抽奖券消耗', */ /*             `fd7_themedraw_record_type_count_map` MAP <STRING, BIGINT> COMMENT 'record_type->次数', */ /*             `fd7_themedraw_by_act_count_map` MAP <STRING, BIGINT> COMMENT 'act_id->次数', */ /*             `fd7_total_magic_draw_count` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天常驻抽奖次数', */ /*             `fd7_total_magic_draw_diamond_cost` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天常驻抽奖钻石消耗', */ /*             `fd7_total_magic_draw_ticket_cost` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天常驻抽奖券消耗', */ /*             `fd7_total_magic_draw_exchange_count` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天常驻抽奖兑换次数', */ /*             `fd7_total_bp_activation_count` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天BP激活次数', */ /*             `fd7_total_bp_activation_diamond_cost` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天BP激活钻石消耗', */ /*             `fd7_bp_activation_type_count_map` MAP <STRING, BIGINT> COMMENT '前7天BP 激活类型->次数', */ /*             `fd7_total_bp_plus_upgrade_count` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天BP+升级次数', */ /*             `fd7_total_bp_plus_upgrade_diamond_cost` BIGINT COMMENT '前7天BP+升级钻石消耗', */ /*             `fd7_pay_amt_list` DOUBLE COMMENT 'fd7每日充值金额', */ /*             `fd7_pay_cnt_list` BIGINT COMMENT 'fd7每日充值次数' */ /*         ) */ /*         PARTITIONED BY (`p_date` STRING COMMENT '数据日期分区yyyy-MM-dd') stored AS parquet location 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/ai/mtai_test/dm_mcgg_behavior_commercial_account_zone_fd7_di'; */ WITH reigster AS (/* 获取注册用户信息，这里需要根据实际的用户注册表调整 */ SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, create_role_date AS register_date FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df /* 假设的用户注册表，需要替换为实际表名 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND create_role_date = DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) /* 只处理3天前的数据 */ AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000), fd3_commercial AS (/* 最近3日活跃数据 */ SELECT *, DATEDIFF(p_date, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1)) + 1 AS day_index /* 1,2,3代表D1,D2,D3 */, MAP(p_date, pay_amt) AS pay_amt_map, MAP(p_date, pay_count) AS pay_cnt_map, MAP(p_date, SUM(pay_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY p_date)) AS total_pay_amt_map, MAP(p_date, SUM(pay_count) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY p_date)) AS total_pay_cnt_map FROM mtai_test.dwm_mcgg_behavior_commercial_role_zone_di WHERE p_date >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) /* 取足够的历史数据 */ AND p_date <= '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mtai_test.dm_mcgg_behavior_commercial_account_zone_fd7_di PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-25') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.register_date, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(pay_amt, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_pay_amt /* 总体付费统计 */, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(pay_count, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_pay_count, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN day_index = 7 THEN curdiamond END), 0) AS fd7_final_curdiamond, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN day_index = 7 THEN curbattle_point END), 0) AS fd7_final_curbattle_point, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN day_index = 7 THEN curticket END), 0) AS fd7_final_curticket, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pay_count > 0 THEN p_date END), 0) AS fd7_pay_days, COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN pay_count > 0 THEN p_date END), 0) AS fd7_first_pay_date, COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN pay_count > 0 THEN day_index END), 0) AS fd7_first_pay_day, COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN day_index = 1 THEN COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) END), SUM(CASE WHEN day_index = 2 THEN COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) END), SUM(CASE WHEN day_index = 3 THEN COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) END), SUM(CASE WHEN day_index = 4 THEN COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) END), SUM(CASE WHEN day_index = 5 THEN COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) END), SUM(CASE WHEN day_index = 6 THEN COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) END), SUM(CASE WHEN day_index = 7 THEN COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) END)), 0) AS fd7_first_pay_amt /* 计算首次充值金额 */, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(yl_pay_amt, 0)), 0) AS fd7_yl_pay_amt /* 渠道付费分布 */, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(else_pay_amt, 0)), 0) AS fd7_else_pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(third_pay_amt, 0)), 0) AS fd7_third_pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(mobapay_amt, 0)), 0) AS fd7_mobapay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(nomobapay_amt, 0)), 0) AS fd7_nomobapay_amt, MAP_UTIL(iap_product_count_map).merge_map AS fd7_iap_product_count_map, MAP_UTIL(iap_product_amt_map).merge_map AS fd7_iap_product_amt_map, MAP_UTIL(pay_channel_amt_map).merge_map AS fd7_pay_channel_amt_map, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(chargediamond, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_chargediamond /* 钻石相关 */, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(sub_num, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_sub_diamond, MAP_UTIL(sub_operate_map).merge_map AS fd7_sub_operate_map, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(shop_item_count, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_shop_item_count /* 消费行为 */, MAP_UTIL(shop_moneytype_amt_map).merge_map AS fd7_shop_moneytype_amt_map, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(themedraw_count, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_themedraw_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(themedraw_diamond_cost, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_themedraw_diamond_cost, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(themedraw_ticket_cost, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_themedraw_ticket_cost, MAP_UTIL(themedraw_record_type_count_map).merge_map AS fd7_themedraw_record_type_count_map, MAP_UTIL(themedraw_by_act_count_map).merge_map AS fd7_themedraw_by_act_count_map, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(magic_draw_count, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_magic_draw_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(magic_draw_diamond_cost, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_magic_draw_diamond_cost, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(magic_draw_ticket_cost, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_magic_draw_ticket_cost, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(magic_draw_exchange_count, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_magic_draw_exchange_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(bp_activation_count, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_bp_activation_count /* BP系统 */, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(bp_activation_diamond_cost, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_bp_activation_diamond_cost, MAP_UTIL(bp_activation_type_count_map).merge_map AS fd7_bp_activation_type_count_map, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(bp_plus_upgrade_count, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_bp_plus_upgrade_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(bp_plus_upgrade_diamond_cost, 0)), 0) AS fd7_total_bp_plus_upgrade_diamond_cost, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(pay_amt_map), '2026-05-25', 7) AS fd7_pay_amt_list /* 分日统计 */, BUILD_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(pay_cnt_map), '2026-05-25', 7) AS fd7_pay_cnt_list FROM reigster AS a LEFT JOIN fd3_commercial AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.register_date

sql_units: /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `mtai_test`.`dm_mcgg_behavior_active_account_zone_fd7_di`( */ /*     `accountid` decimal(20, 0) COMMENT 'accountid', */ /*     `zoneid` bigint COMMENT 'zoneid', */ /*     `register_date` string COMMENT '注册日期', */ /*     `fd7_max_level` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天最高等级', */ /*     `fd7_active_weeklydiamond_view_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天钻石周卡曝光总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_weeklydiamond_buy_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天钻石周卡购买成功总次数', */ /*     `fd7_newer_activity_pageview_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天新手活动曝光总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_signin_view_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天签到活动曝光总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_signin_click_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天签到活动按钮点击总次数', */ /*     `fd7_max_active_newerlogin_max_click_id` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天最大连续签到次数', */ /*     `fd7_max_active_signin_reward_claim_max_day_num` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天签到活动奖励最大天数', */ /*     `fd7_active_sevenday_view_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天七日目标活动曝光总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_sevenday_click_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天七日目标活动点击总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_sevenday_progress_claim_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天七日目标进度奖励领取总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_firstcharge_view_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天首充活动曝光总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_firstcharge_click_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天首充活动点击总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_firstcharge_active_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天首充/续充奖励激活总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_firstcharge_claim_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天首充/续充奖励领取总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_assettransfer_view_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天资产转移活动曝光总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_assettransfer_click_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天资产转移活动点击总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_assettransfer_complete_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天资产转移完成总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_assettransfer_coin_claim_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天资产转移兑币领取总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_assettransfer_exchange_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天资产转移道具兑换总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_maintab_click_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天主界面Tab点击总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_maintab_click_map` map < string, */ /*     bigint > COMMENT '注册前7天主界面Tab点击分布汇总 Map', */ /*     `fd7_acquire_map_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天获得地图皮肤总次数', */ /*     `fd7_acquire_map_permanent_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天获得永久地图皮肤总次数', */ /*     `fd7_acquire_cmdskin_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天获得指挥官皮肤总次数', */ /*     `fd7_acquire_cmdskin_permanent_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天获得永久指挥官皮肤总次数', */ /*     `fd7_acquire_cmdskin_diamond_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天花费钻石获得指挥官皮肤总次数', */ /*     `fd7_acquire_commander_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天获得指挥官总次数', */ /*     `fd7_acquire_commander_permanent_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天获得永久指挥官总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_achieve_complete_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天完成成就总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_achieve_claim_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天领取成就积分总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_recmdlineup_view_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天查看推荐阵容总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_cmdroad_score_add_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天指挥官星途积分增加总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_cmdroad_score_sub_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天指挥官星途积分减少总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_mainui_click_cnt` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天主界面UI点击总次数', */ /*     `fd7_active_mainui_click_map` map < string, */ /*     bigint > COMMENT '注册前7天主界面UI点击分布汇总 Map', */ /*     `fd7_active_days` bigint COMMENT '注册前7天活跃天数' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY (`p_date` string COMMENT '统计日期') */ /* stored as parquet */ /* location 's7a://moonton-warehouse/table/ai/mtai_test/dm_mcgg_behavior_active_account_zone_fd7_di'; */ WITH reigster AS (/* 获取注册用户信息，这里需要根据实际的用户注册表调整 */ SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, create_role_date AS register_date FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df /* 假设的用户注册表，需要替换为实际表名 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND create_role_date = DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) /* 只处理7天前的数据 */ AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000 /* 剔除测服数据 */), fd7 AS (/* 最近7日活跃数据 */ SELECT * FROM mtai_test.dwm_mcgg_behavior_active_account_zone_di WHERE p_date >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) /* 取足够的历史数据 */ AND p_date <= '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mtai_test.dm_mcgg_behavior_active_account_zone_fd7_di PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-25') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.register_date, COALESCE(MAX(t2.level), 0) AS fd7_max_level /* 最高等级 */, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_weeklydiamond_view_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_weeklydiamond_view_cnt /* 各种活动指标的累计值 */, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_weeklydiamond_buy_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_weeklydiamond_buy_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.newer_activity_pageview_cnt), 0) AS fd7_newer_activity_pageview_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_signin_view_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_signin_view_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_signin_click_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_signin_click_cnt, COALESCE(MAX(t2.active_newerlogin_max_click_id), 0) AS fd7_max_active_newerlogin_max_click_id, COALESCE(MAX(t2.active_signin_reward_claim_max_day_num), 0) AS fd7_max_active_signin_reward_claim_max_day_num, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_sevenday_view_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_sevenday_view_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_sevenday_click_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_sevenday_click_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_sevenday_progress_claim_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_sevenday_progress_claim_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_firstcharge_view_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_firstcharge_view_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_firstcharge_click_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_firstcharge_click_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_firstcharge_active_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_firstcharge_active_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_firstcharge_claim_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_firstcharge_claim_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_assettransfer_view_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_assettransfer_view_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_assettransfer_click_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_assettransfer_click_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_assettransfer_complete_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_assettransfer_complete_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_assettransfer_coin_claim_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_assettransfer_coin_claim_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_assettransfer_exchange_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_assettransfer_exchange_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_maintab_click_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_maintab_click_cnt, MAP_UTIL(active_maintab_click_map) /* Map类型字段的合并处理 */.merge_map AS fd7_active_maintab_click_map, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_map_cnt), 0) AS fd7_acquire_map_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_map_permanent_cnt), 0) AS fd7_acquire_map_permanent_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_cmdskin_cnt), 0) AS fd7_acquire_cmdskin_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_cmdskin_permanent_cnt), 0) AS fd7_acquire_cmdskin_permanent_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_cmdskin_diamond_cnt), 0) AS fd7_acquire_cmdskin_diamond_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_commander_cnt), 0) AS fd7_acquire_commander_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.acquire_commander_permanent_cnt), 0) AS fd7_acquire_commander_permanent_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_achieve_complete_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_achieve_complete_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_achieve_claim_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_achieve_claim_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_recmdlineup_view_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_recmdlineup_view_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_cmdroad_score_add_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_cmdroad_score_add_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_cmdroad_score_sub_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_cmdroad_score_sub_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.active_mainui_click_cnt), 0) AS fd7_active_mainui_click_cnt, MAP_UTIL(active_mainui_click_map) /* Map类型字段的合并处理 */.merge_map AS fd7_active_mainui_click_map, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.p_date) AS fd7_active_days /* 活跃天数 */ FROM reigster AS t1 LEFT JOIN fd7 AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid GROUP BY t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.register_date

name: data_trans.mt_ai.connserver_client_highlight_triggered_utc0
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.connserver_client_highlight_triggered_utc0 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) + 8 * 3600) AS time, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) + 8 * 3600, 'HH:mm:ss') AS loghms, ip, zoneid, accountid, level, startup_time, game_channel, battleid, highlighttriggered, highlightparamlist, highlighttriggereduid, highlightlikeduid, highlighttime, highlightzan, isbroadcast, allid, allid_time, allid_true FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_highlight_triggered WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' AND time >= CAST(CONCAT('2026-05-30', ' 16:00:00') AS TIMESTAMP) AND time < CAST(CONCAT('2026-05-31', ' 16:00:00') AS TIMESTAMP)

COMMENT '角色ID', */ /*     `zoneid` bigint COMMENT '分区ID', */ /*     `pay_channel` string COMMENT '支付渠道', */ /*     `sub_pay_channel` string COMMENT '支付子渠道', */ /*     `bill_country` string COMMENT '账单国家', */ /*     `currency` string COMMENT '支付币种', */ /*     `fee_currency` string COMMENT '渠道手续费币种', */ /*     `product_id` string COMMENT '商品ID', */ /*     `first_pay_time` string COMMENT */ /*     `after_tax_usd_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '分成前金额(单位：美分)', */ /*     `tax_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '渠道代缴税金金额(对应币种)', */ /*     `tax_usd_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '渠道代缴税金金额(单位：美分)', /*     `share_usd_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '渠道分成金额(单位：美分)', */ /*     `fee_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '渠道手续费金额(对应手续费币种)', */ /*     `fee_usd_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '渠道手续费金额(单位：美分)', */ /*     `pay_net_receipts_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '当天真实实收金额(对应币种)', */ /*     `pay_net_receipts_usd_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '当天真实实收金额(单位：美分)', */ /*     `pay_cnt` bigint COMMENT '当天真实付费次数', */ /*     `pay_diamond` bigint COMMENT '当天真实充值获得钻石数', */ /*     `free_diamond` bigint COMMENT '当天真实充值免费获得钻石数', */ /*     `get_diamond` bigint COMMENT '当天真实充值获得钻石数(充值获得+充值免费获得)', */ /*     `first_token_time` string COMMENT '当天首次代币交易时间(时分秒)', */ /*     `last_token_time` string COMMENT '当天末次代币交易时间(时分秒)', */ /*     `pay_token_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '当天代币交易金额(对应币种)', */ /*     `pay_token_usd_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '当天代币交易金额(单位：美分)', */ /*     `pay_token_cnt` bigint COMMENT '当天代币交易次数', */ /*     `pay_token_diamond` bigint COMMENT '当天代币交易获得钻石数', */ /*     `free_token_diamond` bigint COMMENT '当天代币交易免费获得钻石数', */ /*     `get_token_diamond` bigint COMMENT '当天代币交易获得钻石数(代币交易+代币交易免费获得)', */ /*     `first_sandbox_time` string COMMENT '当天首次沙盒交易时间(时分秒)', */ /*     `last_sandbox_time` string COMMENT '当天末次沙盒交易时间(时分秒)', */ /*     `pay_sandbox_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '当天沙盒交易金额(对应币种)', */ /*     `pay_sandbox_usd_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '当天沙盒交易金额(单位：美分)', */ /*     `pay_sandbox_cnt` bigint COMMENT '当天沙盒交易次数', */ /*     `pay_sandbox_diamond` bigint COMMENT '当天沙盒交易获得钻石数', */ /*     `free_sandbox_diamond` bigint COMMENT '当天沙盒交易免费获得钻石数', */ /*     `get_sandbox_diamond` bigint COMMENT '当天沙盒交易获得钻石数(代币交易+代币交易免费获得)', */ /*     `product_money` bigint COMMENT '当天真实充值商品定价金额', */ /*     `product_token_money` bigint COMMENT '当天代币充值商品定价金额', */ /*     `first_pay_device_id` string COMMENT '当天首次真实付费设备ID', */ /*     `last_pay_device_id` string COMMENT '当天末次真实付费设备ID', */ /*     `pay_channel_config` string COMMENT '付费渠道配置', */ /*     `sub_pay_channel_config` string COMMENT '付费子渠道配置', */ /*     `pay_channel_type` bigint COMMENT '付费渠道类型，三方渠道 or 官方渠道', */ /*     `pay_type` bigint COMMENT '支付方式', */ /*     `sub_pay_channel_config_source` string COMMENT '付费子渠道配置原始值' */ /* ) COMMENT 'mlbb充值汇总表-增量' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区yyyy-MM-dd', */ /*     `timezone_type` bigint COMMENT '时区类型：0-服务器时区，1-账单时区' */ /* ) */ /* stored as parquet */ /* location 's3a://mt-dwm/table/dwm_charge_role_zone_tz_di' */ WITH raw_dwd AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.sub_pay_channel, a.bill_country, a.bill_currency, a.money, IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR a.pay_channel = 0), CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(a.`time`, 'yyyyMMddHHmmss'), '-', a.device_id), NULL) AS time_device_id, COALESCE(a.is_iap_token_buy, 0) AS is_iap_token_buy, COALESCE(a.is_sandbox, 0) AS is_sandbox, a.receipt_id, a.`time`, a.bill_amt, a.before_tax_amt, a.after_tax_amt, a.tax_amt, a.back_tax_amt, a.share_amt, a.fee_currency, a.fee_amt, a.actual_amt, a.base_diamond, a.extra_diamond, a.logymd, a.pay_channel, IF(a.pay_channel = 0, 'cashcard', a.game_pay_channel) AS pay_channel_name, a.currency_exchange_rate AS exchange_rate, a.fee_exchange_rate, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.`time`) + COALESCE(b.timeoffset, 0)) AS local_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.`time`) + COALESCE(b.timeoffset, 0), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS local_date, product_id FROM (SELECT * /* FROM    mt_dwd.dwd_charge_order_di */ FROM bi_test.dwd_charge_order_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31' AND bill_amt > 0 AND LOWER(product_id) NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(timeoffset, 1, 1) = '-' THEN (CAST(SUBSTRING(timeoffset, 2, 2) AS INT) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(timeoffset, 5, 2) AS INT) * 60) ELSE -1 * ((CAST(SUBSTRING(timeoffset, 1, 2) AS INT) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(timeoffset, 4, 2) AS INT) * 60)) END AS timeoffset FROM mt_dim.dim_payment_channel_timezone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS b ON LOWER(a.game_pay_channel) = LOWER(b.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(b.sub_pay_channel) WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.`time`) + COALESCE(b.timeoffset, 0), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-30') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_tz_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30', timezone_type = 1) SELECT roleid, zoneid /*  , pay_channel_id */, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, COALESCE(bill_country, 'unknown') AS bill_country, currency, fee_currency, product_id, first_pay_time, last_pay_time, pay_amt, pay_usd_amt, before_tax_amt, before_tax_usd_amt, after_tax_amt, after_tax_usd_amt, tax_amt, tax_usd_amt, back_tax_amt, back_tax_usd_amt, share_amt, share_usd_amt, fee_amt, fee_usd_amt, actual_amt, pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, pay_cnt, pay_diamond, free_diamond, get_diamond, first_token_time, last_token_time, pay_token_amt, pay_token_usd_amt, pay_token_cnt, pay_token_diamond, free_token_diamond, get_token_diamond, first_sandbox_time, last_sandbox_time, pay_sandbox_amt, pay_sandbox_usd_amt, pay_sandbox_cnt, pay_sandbox_diamond, free_sandbox_diamond, get_sandbox_diamond, product_money, product_token_money, first_pay_device_id, last_pay_device_id, pay_channel_config, CONCAT_WS('||', pay_channel_type, pay_channel_config, CASE WHEN pay_channel_config = 'unknown' THEN 'unknown' ELSE sub_pay_channel END) AS sub_pay_channel_config, pay_channel_type, pay_type, CASE WHEN pay_channel_config = 'unknown' THEN 'unknown' ELSE sub_pay_channel END AS sub_pay_channel_config_source FROM (SELECT *, COALESCE(CASE WHEN LOWER(pay_channel) LIKE '%mt%' THEN 'mobapay' ELSE pay_channel END, 'unknown') AS pay_channel_config, CASE WHEN pay_channel LIKE '%ios%' OR pay_channel LIKE '%and%' THEN 2 /* '端内渠道' */ ELSE 1 /* '三方渠道' */ END AS pay_channel_type /* 渠道类型 */, 0 AS pay_type /* 支付类型 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pay_channel_name AS pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, bill_country, bill_currency AS currency, COALESCE(fee_currency, 'unknown') AS fee_currency, product_id, COALESCE(MIN(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS first_pay_time, COALESCE(MAX(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_pay_time, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), bill_amt, 0)), 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), bill_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), before_tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS before_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), before_tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS before_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), after_tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS after_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), after_tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS after_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), back_tax_amt, 0)), 0) AS back_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), back_tax_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS back_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), share_amt, 0)), 0) AS share_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), share_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS share_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), fee_amt, 0)), 0) AS fee_amt /* COALESCE(fee_currency, 'unknown') fee_currency, */, IF(fee_exchange_rate = 0, 0, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), fee_amt, 0)) / fee_exchange_rate, 0)) AS fee_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), actual_amt, 0)), 0) AS actual_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), actual_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), base_diamond, 0)), 0) AS pay_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS free_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), base_diamond + extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS get_diamond, COALESCE(MIN(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS first_token_time, COALESCE(MAX(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_token_time, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, bill_amt, 0)), 0) AS pay_token_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, bill_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_token_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_token_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, base_diamond, 0)), 0) AS pay_token_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS free_token_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, base_diamond + extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS get_token_diamond, COALESCE(MIN(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS first_sandbox_time, COALESCE(MAX(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, TIME, NULL)), CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_sandbox_time, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, bill_amt, 0)), 0) AS pay_sandbox_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, bill_amt, 0)) / exchange_rate, 0) AS pay_sandbox_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, 1, 0)), 0) AS pay_sandbox_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, base_diamond, 0)), 0) AS pay_sandbox_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS free_sandbox_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_sandbox <> 0, base_diamond + extra_diamond, 0)), 0) AS get_sandbox_diamond, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0), money, 0)), 0) AS product_money, COALESCE(SUM(IF(is_iap_token_buy = 1, money, 0)), 0) AS product_token_money, COALESCE(SPLIT(MIN(time_device_id), '-')[1], 'unknown') AS first_pay_device_id, COALESCE(SPLIT(MAX(time_device_id), '-')[1], 'unknown') AS last_pay_device_id FROM raw_dwd GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pay_channel_name, sub_pay_channel, bill_country, bill_currency, logymd, exchange_rate, fee_exchange_rate, fee_currency, pay_channel, product_id) AS t1 WHERE before_tax_usd_amt > 0 OR pay_token_amt > 0 OR pay_sandbox_amt > 0) AS t2

name: etl.nova_dw.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df_us_utc8
sql_units: WITH basic_df AS (/* 基础信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, zone_region, create_date_offset AS register_date FROM nova_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_offset_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zone_offset = STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_offset))), active_di AS (/* 活跃信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, COALESCE(online_duration, 0) AS online_duration /* 当日有活跃，无在线时长的给默认值0 */, SUBSTRING(last_login_time_offset, 1, 10) AS active_date FROM nova_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_offset_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zone_offset = STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_offset))), pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(pay_cnt) AS charge_cnt, SUM(pay_amt) AS charge_amt, MAX(SUBSTRING(last_pay_time_offset, 1, 10)) AS charge_date FROM nova_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_offset_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zone_offset = STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_offset)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_bitmap AS (/* 前一日 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_offset, create_date, charge_info, charge_cnt_total_array, charge_amt_total_array, charge_amt_array, online_dur_array, active_info, active_days_array, logymd, appid, zone_region FROM nova_dw.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'nova' AND zone_offset = STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_offset))) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE nova_dw.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'nova', zone_region) SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, register_date AS create_date /* 无注册日期给默认值 */, IF(LENGTH(active_info) > 0 AND '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(active_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(active_info))), COALESCE(active_info, '')) AS active_info, IF(LENGTH(charge_info) > 0 AND /* 只补齐有位图的，并且当日日期大于注册日的 */ '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(charge_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(charge_info))), COALESCE(charge_info, '') /* 可能存在有位图没有注册日期的 */) AS charge_info, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_amt_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_amt_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_amt_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_amt_array /* 2、付费金额位图 */, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_cnt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_cnt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_cnt_total_array /* 2、累计付费次数位图: 补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有付费用户） */, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_amt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_amt_total_array /* 3、累计付费金额位图: 补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有付费用户） */, CAST(IF(SIZE(online_dur_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(online_dur_array)) > 0, CONCAT(online_dur_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(online_dur_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(online_dur_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS online_dur_array /* --在线时长位图,补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有在线用户） */, CAST(IF(SIZE(active_days_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(active_days_array)) > 0, CONCAT(active_days_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(active_days_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(active_days_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS active_days_array /* 活跃天数位图补齐(array) */, CASE WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 THEN 'apac' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 THEN 'eu' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 THEN 'us' ELSE CASE WHEN zone_offset = -8 THEN 'us' WHEN zone_offset = 9 THEN 'apac' END END AS zone_region FROM (SELECT td.roleid, td.zoneid, td.register_date, td.zone_type, td.zone_offset, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31', CONCAT('1', COALESCE(ld.active_info, '')), IF(LENGTH(ld.active_info) > 0, CONCAT('0', ld.active_info), '')) AS active_info, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31', CONCAT('1', COALESCE(ld.charge_info, '')), IF(LENGTH(ld.charge_info) > 0, CONCAT('0', charge_info), '')) AS charge_info, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_amt_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_amt_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.charge_amt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_amt_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_amt, 0))), ld.charge_amt_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_amt_array, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_cnt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_cnt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(charge_cnt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_cnt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_cnt, 0) + ld.charge_cnt_total_array[0])), ld.charge_cnt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_cnt_total_array, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_amt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_amt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.charge_amt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_amt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_amt, 0) + ld.charge_amt_total_array[0])), ld.charge_amt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_amt_total_array, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.online_dur_array IS NULL OR ld.online_dur_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.online_duration), IF(SIZE(ld.online_dur_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.online_duration, 0))), ld.online_dur_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS online_dur_array, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.active_days_array IS NULL OR ld.active_days_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(1), IF(SIZE(ld.active_days_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(is_td_active + ld.active_days_array[0])), ld.active_days_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS active_days_array FROM (SELECT bas.roleid, bas.zoneid, bas.zone_type, bas.zone_offset, bas.register_date, act.active_date, act.online_duration, pay.charge_cnt, pay.charge_amt, pay.charge_date, IF(act.active_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_td_active, bas.zone_region FROM basic_df AS bas /* basic表 */ LEFT JOIN active_di AS act /* 活跃 */ ON bas.roleid = act.roleid AND bas.zoneid = act.zoneid LEFT JOIN pay_di AS pay /* 支付 */ ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid AND bas.zoneid = pay.zoneid) AS td LEFT JOIN t_bitmap AS ld /* 前一日 */ ON td.roleid = ld.roleid AND td.zoneid = ld.zoneid) AS t

1 AS lose_cnt, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', (LENGTH(lose_active_info) - 1) * -1) AS lose_date /* 最近流失日期 */, IF(SUBSTRING(lose_active_info, 0, 1) = '1', 1, 0) AS is_recurring, IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 0, 1) = '1', 1, 0) AS is_active FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, zone_region, create_date, active_days_array, charge_amt_total_array, active_info, REGEXP_EXTRACT(active_info, '((^[1][0]{7,}1)|(^[0]{6,}1))') AS lose_active_info /* 第一部分：(^[1][0]{7,}1) , 代表 第一部分匹配的是：以字符'1'开头，然后紧跟至少7个'0'，然后再以一个'1'结尾的字符串 */ /* 第二部分：(^[0]{6,}1) , 代表 字符串以至少6个'0'开头，然后一个'1' */ FROM nova_dw.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'nova' AND zone_offset = STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_offset))) AS t), active_lose_recurring AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, zone_region, create_date, lose_size /* active_info, */ /* lose_active_info, */ /* active_days_array, */ /* charge_amt_total_array, */, active_days_array[0] AS active_days, lose_size - (2 - IF(is_recurring = 1, 0, 1)) AS lose_days, lose_cnt, lose_date, is_recurring, CASE WHEN is_recurring = 1 THEN '2026-05-31' END AS recurring_date, IF(is_recurring = 1 AND lose_size > 7 AND SUBSTRING(lose_active_info, LENGTH(lose_active_info) - 7, 7) = REPEAT('0', 7), 1, 0) AS is_recurring_7days, IF(is_recurring = 1 AND lose_size > 14 AND SUBSTRING(lose_active_info, LENGTH(lose_active_info) - 14, 14) = REPEAT('0', 14), 1, 0) AS is_recurring_14days, IF(is_recurring = 1 AND lose_size > 30 AND SUBSTRING(lose_active_info, LENGTH(lose_active_info) - 30, 30) = REPEAT('0', 30), 1, 0) AS is_recurring_30days, IF(SIZE(active_days_array) > 7, active_days_array[SIZE(active_days_array) - 7], active_days_array[0]) AS active_days_reg_7days, IF(SIZE(active_days_array) > 30, active_days_array[SIZE(active_days_array) - 30], active_days_array[0]) AS active_days_reg_30days, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 7, charge_amt_total_array[SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) - 7], charge_amt_total_array[0]) AS pay_amt_reg_7days, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 14, charge_amt_total_array[SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) - 14], charge_amt_total_array[0]) AS pay_amt_reg_14days, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 30, charge_amt_total_array[SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) - 30], charge_amt_total_array[0]) AS pay_amt_reg_30days, CASE WHEN active_size >= 2 AND SUBSTRING(active_info, active_size - 1, 1) = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_reg_lose_2d /* 自定义逻辑：创角日期+1未登录 */, CASE WHEN active_size >= 3 AND SUBSTRING(active_info, active_size - 2, 1) = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_reg_lose_3d, CASE WHEN active_size >= 7 AND SUBSTRING(active_info, active_size - 29, 1) = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_reg_lose_30d /* 自定义逻辑：创角日期+29未登录 */ FROM lose_info) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE nova_dw.dm_active_lose_recurring_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'nova', zone_region) SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, create_date, active_days, IF(lose_days > 0, lose_days, 0) AS lose_days, lose_cnt, lose_date, is_recurring, recurring_date, is_recurring_7days, is_recurring_14days, is_recurring_30days, active_days_reg_7days, active_days_reg_30days, pay_amt_reg_7days, pay_amt_reg_14days, pay_amt_reg_30days, is_reg_lose_2d, is_reg_lose_3d, is_reg_lose_7d, is_reg_lose_14d, is_reg_lose_30d, zone_region FROM active_lose_recurring /* -- --  排除流失天数超过2年并且非回流的数据 */ /* WHERE */ /*     (if(is_recurring=1,0,1) + lose_size - 2 <= 730 OR (is_recurring = 1)) */

a.max_damage_taken_heroid IS NULL THEN b.max_damage_taken_time WHEN b.max_damage_taken_heroid IS NULL THEN a.max_damage_taken_time WHEN COALESCE(a.max_damage_taken, 0) > COALESCE(b.max_damage_taken, 0) THEN a.max_damage_taken_time ELSE b.max_damage_taken_time END AS max_damage_taken_time, CASE WHEN a.max_damage_taken_heroid IS NULL THEN b.max_damage_taken_battleid WHEN b.max_damage_taken_heroid IS NULL THEN a.max_damage_taken_battleid WHEN COALESCE(a.max_damage_taken, 0) > COALESCE(b.max_damage_taken, 0) THEN a.max_damage_taken_battleid ELSE b.max_damage_taken_battleid END AS max_damage_taken_battleid, CASE WHEN a.max_gold_heroid IS NULL THEN b.max_gold_heroid WHEN b.max_gold_heroid IS NULL THEN a.max_gold_heroid WHEN COALESCE(a.max_gold, 0) > COALESCE(b.max_gold, 0) THEN a.max_gold_heroid ELSE b.max_gold_heroid END AS max_gold_heroid /* 最高金钱 */, CASE WHEN a.max_gold_heroid IS NULL THEN b.max_gold WHEN b.max_gold_heroid IS NULL THEN a.max_gold WHEN COALESCE(a.max_gold, 0) > COALESCE(b.max_gold, 0) THEN a.max_gold ELSE b.max_gold END AS max_gold, CASE WHEN a.max_gold_heroid IS NULL THEN b.max_gold_time WHEN b.max_gold_heroid IS NULL THEN a.max_gold_time WHEN COALESCE(a.max_gold, 0) > COALESCE(b.max_gold, 0) THEN a.max_gold_time ELSE b.max_gold_time END AS max_gold_time, CASE WHEN a.max_gold_heroid IS NULL THEN b.max_gold_battleid WHEN b.max_gold_heroid IS NULL THEN a.max_gold_battleid WHEN COALESCE(a.max_gold, 0) > COALESCE(b.max_gold, 0) THEN a.max_gold_battleid ELSE b.max_gold_battleid END AS max_gold_battleid, CASE WHEN a.max_tower_damage_heroid IS NULL THEN b.max_tower_damage_heroid WHEN b.max_tower_damage_heroid IS NULL THEN a.max_tower_damage_heroid WHEN COALESCE(a.max_tower_damage, 0) > COALESCE(b.max_tower_damage, 0) THEN a.max_tower_damage_heroid ELSE b.max_tower_damage_heroid END AS max_tower_damage_heroid /* 最高塔伤 */, CASE WHEN a.max_tower_damage_heroid IS NULL THEN b.max_tower_damage WHEN b.max_tower_damage_heroid IS NULL THEN a.max_tower_damage WHEN COALESCE(a.max_tower_damage, 0) > COALESCE(b.max_tower_damage, 0) THEN a.max_tower_damage ELSE b.max_tower_damage END AS max_tower_damage, CASE WHEN a.max_tower_damage_heroid IS NULL THEN b.max_tower_damage_time WHEN b.max_tower_damage_heroid IS NULL THEN a.max_tower_damage_time WHEN COALESCE(a.max_tower_damage, 0) > COALESCE(b.max_tower_damage, 0) THEN a.max_tower_damage_time ELSE b.max_tower_damage_time END AS max_tower_damage_time, CASE WHEN a.max_tower_damage_heroid IS NULL THEN b.max_tower_damage_battleid WHEN b.max_tower_damage_heroid IS NULL THEN a.max_tower_damage_battleid WHEN COALESCE(a.max_tower_damage, 0) > COALESCE(b.max_tower_damage, 0) THEN a.max_tower_damage_battleid ELSE b.max_tower_damage_battleid END AS max_tower_damage_battleid, COALESCE(a.total_have_score_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(b.total_have_score_cnt, 0) FROM battle_info_di AS a FULL JOIN his_battle AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid

name: etl.bi_test.dim_basic_device_df_test4280
sql_units: /* T-2的全量设备信息union T-1的增量设备信息 */ WITH all_device AS (SELECT did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_version, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, step_action_info, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_name, adgroup_id, creative_id, creative_name, logymd, app_id FROM bi_test.dim_basic_device_df_test4280 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND did <> 'unknown' AND app_id = 4280 UNION ALL SELECT did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_version, NULL AS first_media_source, NULL AS last_media_source, NULL AS first_ad_country, NULL AS last_ad_country, NULL AS first_mt_country, NULL AS last_mt_country, NULL AS step_action_info, NULL AS campaign_id, NULL AS campaign_name, NULL AS adgroup_name, NULL AS adgroup_id, NULL AS creative_id, NULL AS creative_name, logymd, app_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND did <> 'unknown' AND app_id = 4280), ad_attribution /* 最新一天归因到的广告信息 */ AS (SELECT logymd, app_id, did, package_name, CASE WHEN createdate = logymd THEN ad_country END AS first_ad_country, ad_country AS last_ad_country, ad_country /* (已改)可以按照归因日期和创建日期比较小，得到first和last两个字段，media source同理，这样下面的join只保留t3，可以少一次，也就会少一次shffle */, CASE WHEN createdate = logymd THEN media_source END AS first_media_source, media_source AS last_media_source, media_source, createdate, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_name, adgroup_id, creative_id, creative_name FROM bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di_test4280 /* fuxinwang：应该改为dim_attribution_create_device_di表？都可以，如果用dim_attribution_create_device_di需要读取30天分区，用dim_attribution_device_di只用一天就行 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), step_did_info /* ,package_name */ AS (SELECT did, app_id, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(step_action_id)) AS step_action_info /* package_name, */ FROM (SELECT did, appid AS app_id, package_name, CONCAT(step_id, '-', action_name) AS step_action_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_step_action_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 4280 AND NOT CONCAT(step_id, '-', action_name) IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT did, app_id, package_name, step_action_id FROM all_device LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(step_action_info, ',')) a AS step_action_id WHERE NOT step_action_id IS NULL AND step_action_id <> '') AS info GROUP BY did, app_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_basic_device_df_test4280 PARTITION(logymd, app_id) /* * repartition(10) */ SELECT did, package_name, is_emulator, client_ip, os, model, os_version, network_type, os_language, createdate, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, first_media_source, last_media_source, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, step_action_info, app_version, campaign_id, campaign_name, adgroup_name, adgroup_id, creative_id, creative_name, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, app_id FROM (SELECT t1.did, t1.package_name, t1.is_emulator, t1.client_ip, t1.os, t1.model, t1.os_version, t1.network_type, t1.os_language, t1.createdate, t1.ip_country, t1.client_version, t1.sdk_version, t1.idfa, t1.idfv, t1.gps_adid, t1.android_id, t1.imei, t1.oaid, COALESCE(t1.first_media_source, t2.first_media_source, 'unknown') AS first_media_source, IF((t1.last_media_source <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.last_media_source IS NULL), t1.last_media_source, COALESCE(t2.last_media_source, 'unknown')) AS last_media_source, COALESCE(t1.first_ad_country, t2.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, IF((t1.last_ad_country <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.last_ad_country IS NULL), t1.last_ad_country, COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, 'unknown')) AS last_ad_country, IF((t1.first_mt_country <> 'unknown' OR NOT t1.first_mt_country IS NULL), t1.first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_ad_country, t2.first_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown')) AS first_mt_country, IF((t1.last_ad_country <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.last_ad_country IS NULL), t1.last_ad_country, COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown')) AS last_mt_country, t3.step_action_info /* COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, */, t1.app_version, IF((t1.campaign_id <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.campaign_id IS NULL), t1.campaign_id, COALESCE(t2.campaign_id, 'unknown')) AS campaign_id, IF((t1.campaign_name <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.campaign_name IS NULL), t1.campaign_name, COALESCE(t2.campaign_name, 'unknown')) AS campaign_name, IF((t1.adgroup_name <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.adgroup_name IS NULL), t1.adgroup_name, COALESCE(t2.adgroup_name, 'unknown')) AS adgroup_name, IF((t1.adgroup_id <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.adgroup_id IS NULL), t1.adgroup_id, COALESCE(t2.adgroup_id, 'unknown')) AS adgroup_id, IF((t1.creative_id <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.creative_id IS NULL), t1.creative_id, COALESCE(t2.creative_id, 'unknown')) AS creative_id, IF((t1.creative_name <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.creative_name IS NULL), t1.creative_name, COALESCE(t2.creative_name, 'unknown')) AS creative_name, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.app_id FROM all_device AS t1 LEFT JOIN ad_attribution AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.did = t2.did /* AND     t1.package_name = t2.package_name */ LEFT JOIN step_did_info AS t3 ON t1.app_id = t3.app_id AND t1.did = t3.did /* AND     t1.package_name = t3.package_name */ WHERE t1.createdate BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT t1.did, t1.package_name, t1.is_emulator, t1.client_ip, t1.os, t1.model, t1.os_version, t1.network_type, t1.os_language, t1.createdate, t1.ip_country, t1.client_version, t1.sdk_version, t1.idfa, t1.idfv, t1.gps_adid, t1.android_id, t1.imei, t1.oaid, t1.first_media_source, t1.last_media_source, t1.first_ad_country, t1.last_ad_country, t1.first_mt_country, t1.last_mt_country, t1.step_action_info, t1.app_version, t1.campaign_id, t1.campaign_name, t1.adgroup_name, t1.adgroup_id, t1.creative_id, t1.creative_name, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t1.app_id FROM all_device AS t1 WHERE createdate < '2026-05-02') AS x

name: etl.bi_test.dim_attribution_create_device_di_test4280
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_attribution_create_device_di_test4280 PARTITION(logymd, app_id) SELECT did /* 设备指纹, 设备唯一识别, key */, package_name /* 首次安装的游戏分包名, key */, os /* mmp归因操作系统,af_install近30天归因 */, ad_country /* mmp归因国家,af_install近30天归因 */, media_source /* 归因广告渠道,af_install近30天归因 */, campaign_id /* 归因广告系列ID,af_install近30天归因 */, adgroup_id /* 归因广告组ID,af_install近30天归因 */, creative_id /* 归因广告创意ID,af_install近30天归因 */, campaign_name /* 归因广告系列名称,af_install近30天归因 */, adgroup_name /* 归因广告组名称,af_install近30天归因 */, creative_name /* 归因广告创意名称,af_install近30天归因 */, gps_adid /* 归因安卓设备的gps_adid,af_install近30天归因 */, android_id /* 归因安卓设备的android_id,af_install近30天归因 */, oaid /* 归因安卓设备的oaid（中国厂商）,af_install近30天归因 */, idfa /* 归因IOS设备的IDFA,af_install近30天归因 */, idfv /* 归因IOS设备的IDFV,af_install近30天归因 */, mmp_id /* 归因MMP的设备唯一ID,af_install近30天归因 */, logymd AS attr_date /* 归因日期yyyy-MM-dd */, attr_time /* 归因时间 */, attr_source /* 归因属性来源 */, createdate AS logymd /* 设备新增日期 */, app_id /* 应用唯一ID, key */ FROM bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di_test4280 WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND createdate <= '2026-05-31' AND createdate >= '2026-05-02' DISTRIBUTE BY createdate

name: etl.bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di_test4280
sql_units: WITH new_device_install AS (/* 1、这个需要按照logymd、app_id、package_name、did对设备唯一标志进行归因处理吗 */ /* 这个上游加工的时候会保证logymd、app_id、package_name、did的唯一，为了防止上游质量问题，容错，这边也可以加上唯一过滤 */ SELECT logymd, app_id, package_name, did, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, os FROM (SELECT logymd, app_id, package_name, did, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, os, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, app_id, did ORDER BY logymd) AS rn FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND app_id = 4280 AND NOT (idfa = 'unknown' AND idfv = 'unknown' AND android_id = 'unknown' AND gps_adid = 'unknown' AND COALESCE(did, 'unknown') = 'unknown') /* fuxinwang：去除潜在的脏数据 */) WHERE rn = 1), af_install AS (/* 老数据，2024-10-31之后已经不再更新 */ SELECT package_name, msdk_app_id AS app_id, event_time AS create_time, server_time, platform AS os, country_code AS country_code, media_source AS media_source, af_c_id AS campaign_id, af_adset_id AS adgroup_id, af_ad_id AS creative_id, campaign AS campaign_name, af_adset AS adgroup_name, af_ad AS creative_name, advertising_id AS gps_adid, android_id AS android_id, country_code AS ad_country, oaid AS oaid, idfa AS idfa, idfv AS idfv, appsflyer_id AS mmp_id, NULL AS msdk_did, 0 AS click_time, logymd FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_msdk_appsflyer_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event_name = 'install' UNION ALL /* 新数据，2022-08-15开始 */ SELECT package_name, msdk_app_id AS app_id, event_time AS create_time, server_time, os_name AS os, country_code, IF(media_source = 'Unattributed', IF(COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', 'Facebook Installs', 'Unattributed'), media_source) AS media_source, CASE WHEN media_source_type = 1 THEN fb_campaign_id WHEN media_source_type = 2 THEN campaign_id ELSE campaign_id END AS campaign_id, CASE WHEN media_source_type = 1 THEN fb_adgroup_id WHEN media_source_type = 2 THEN NULL ELSE adgroup_id END AS adgroup_id, creative_id, CASE WHEN media_source_type = 1 THEN fb_campaign_name WHEN media_source_type = 2 THEN campaign_name ELSE campaign_name END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN media_source_type = 1 THEN fb_adgroup_name WHEN media_source_type = 2 THEN NULL ELSE adgroup_name END AS adgroup_name, creative_name, gps_adid, android_id, country_code AS ad_country, oaid AS oaid, idfa AS idfa, idfv AS idfv, adjust_id AS mmp_id, msdk_did, COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.click_time'), 0) AS click_time, logymd FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '' THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%applovin%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS media_source_type FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_msdk_adjust_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND msdk_app_id = 4280 AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') IN ('install')) AS t0), af_install_idfa /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'ios' -- 已知BUG: 正确逻辑是先用os过滤，再用idfa匹配 */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, idfa ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS idfa_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(idfa, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_idfv /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'ios' */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, idfv ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS idfv_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(idfv, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_gps_adid /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'android' */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, gps_adid ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS gps_adid_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(gps_adid, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_android_id /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'android' */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, android_id ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS android_id_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(android_id, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_msdk_did AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, msdk_did ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS msdk_did_rn FROM af_install WHERE logymd >= '2025-06-26' /* PC 归因从2025-06-26开始 */ AND COALESCE(msdk_did, 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AND LOWER(os) = 'windows' /* windows */), his_attr_did AS (SELECT did, APP_ID FROM bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di_test4280 WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY did, APP_ID) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di_test4280 PARTITION(logymd, app_id) /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di PARTITION (logymd, app_id) -- 测试表 */ SELECT t1.did, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN 'ios_1' WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN 'ios_2' WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN 'android_1' WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN 'android_2' WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN 'pc_1' END AS attr_source, COALESCE(t2.create_time, t3.create_time, t4.create_time, t5.create_time, t7.create_time) AS event_time /* 是触发事件的时间 20220606 */, COALESCE(t2.server_time, t3.server_time, t4.server_time, t5.server_time, t7.server_time) AS attr_time /* server time是归因时间 20220606 */, t1.package_name, COALESCE(t2.os, t3.os, t4.os, t5.os, t7.os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(t2.ad_country, t3.ad_country, t4.ad_country, t5.ad_country, t7.ad_country, 'unknown') AS ad_country, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN t2.media_source WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN t3.media_source WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN t4.media_source WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN t5.media_source WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN t7.media_source ELSE 'unknown' END AS media_source /* COALESCE(t2.media_source, t3.media_source, t4.media_source, t5.media_source, 'unknown') AS media_source, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.campaign_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.campaign_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.campaign_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.campaign_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.campaign_id, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS campaign_id /* COALESCE(t2.campaign_id, t3.campaign_id, t4.campaign_id, t5.campaign_id, 'unknown') AS campaign_id, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.adgroup_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.adgroup_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.adgroup_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.adgroup_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.adgroup_id, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS adgroup_id /* COALESCE(t2.adgroup_id, t3.adgroup_id, t4.adgroup_id, t5.adgroup_id, 'unknown') AS adgroup_id, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.creative_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.creative_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.creative_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.creative_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.creative_id, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS creative_id /* COALESCE(t2.creative_id, t3.creative_id, t4.creative_id, t5.creative_id, 'unknown') AS creative_id, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.campaign_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.campaign_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.campaign_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.campaign_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.campaign_name, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS campaign_name /* COALESCE( */ /*     t2.campaign_name, */ /*     t3.campaign_name, */ /*     t4.campaign_name, */ /*     t5.campaign_name, */ /*     'unknown' */ /* ) AS campaign_name, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.adgroup_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.adgroup_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.adgroup_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.adgroup_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.adgroup_name, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS adgroup_name /* COALESCE(t2.adgroup_name, t3.adgroup_name, t4.adgroup_name, t5.adgroup_name, 'unknown') AS adgroup_name, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.creative_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.creative_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN END AS creative_name /* COALESCE( */ /*     t2.creative_name, */ /*     t3.creative_name, */ /*     t4.creative_name, */ /*     t5.creative_name, */ /*     'unknown' */ /* ) AS creative_name, */, COALESCE(t2.gps_adid, t3.gps_adid, t4.gps_adid, t5.gps_adid, t7.gps_adid, 'unknown') AS gps_adid, COALESCE(t2.android_id, t3.android_id, t4.android_id, t5.android_id, t7.android_id, 'unknown') AS android_id, COALESCE(t2.oaid, t3.oaid, t4.oaid, t5.oaid, t7.oaid, 'unknown') AS oaid, COALESCE(t2.idfa, t3.idfa, t4.idfa, t5.idfa, t7.idfa, 'unknown') AS idfa, COALESCE(t2.idfv, t3.idfv, t4.idfv, t5.idfv, t7.idfv, 'unknown') AS idfv, COALESCE(t2.mmp_id, t3.mmp_id, t4.mmp_id, t5.mmp_id, t7.mmp_id, 'unknown') AS mmp_id, t1.logymd AS createdate /* fuxinwang：和basic df表字段对齐命名，设备创建时间统一命名createdate */, '2026-05-31' AS logymd /* COALESCE(t2.logymd, t3.logymd, t4.logymd, t5.logymd, 'unknown') AS logymd, */ /* 20220606 */, t1.app_id FROM new_device_install AS t1 /* 5、这个表应该是以归因时间分区，如果X设备一直没有归因到，应该不会放在当日分区 */ /* new_device_install 是用户基础信息增量表格，每日新增的设备会放在里面 */ LEFT JOIN af_install_idfa AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.idfa = t2.idfa AND t2.idfa_rn = 1 AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'ios' /* ios */ AND LOWER(t2.os) = 'ios' /* ios */ LEFT JOIN af_install_idfv AS t3 ON t1.app_id = t3.app_id AND t1.idfv = t3.idfv AND t3.idfv_rn = 1 AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'ios' /* ios */ AND LOWER(t3.os) = 'ios' /* ios */ LEFT JOIN af_install_gps_adid AS t4 ON t1.app_id = t4.app_id AND t1.gps_adid = t4.gps_adid AND t4.gps_adid_rn = 1 AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'android' /* android */ AND LOWER(t4.os) = 'android' /* android */ LEFT JOIN af_install_android_id AS t5 ON t1.app_id = t5.app_id AND t1.android_id = t5.android_id AND t5.android_id_rn = 1 AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'android' /* android */ AND LOWER(t5.os) = 'android' /* android */ LEFT JOIN his_attr_did AS t6 ON t1.did = t6.did AND t1.app_id = t6.app_id LEFT JOIN af_install_msdk_did AS t7 ON t1.app_id = t7.app_id AND t1.did = t7.msdk_did AND t7.msdk_did_rn = 1 AND LOWER(TRIM(t7.msdk_did)) <> 'unknown' AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'windows' /* windows */ AND LOWER(t7.os) = 'windows' /* windows */ WHERE COALESCE(t2.logymd, t3.logymd, t4.logymd, t5.logymd, t7.logymd, 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AND t6.did IS NULL DISTRIBUTE BY logymd, app_id

creative_id, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.campaign_name, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.campaign_name, 'unknown') END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN
