COALESCE(a.creative_name, 'unknown') END AS creative_name, a.gps_adid /* COALESCE(c.campaign_id, a.campaign_id, 'unknown') campaign_id, */ /* COALESCE(c.adgroup_id, a.adgroup_id, 'unknown') adgroup_id, */ /* COALESCE(c.creative_id, a.creative_id, 'unknown') creative_id, */ /* COALESCE(c.campaign_name, a.campaign_name, 'unknown') campaign_name, */ /* COALESCE(c.adgroup_name, a.adgroup_name, 'unknown') adgroup_name, */ /* COALESCE(c.creative_name, a.creative_name, 'unknown') creative_name, */, a.android_id, a.oaid, a.idfa, a.idfv, a.adjust_id AS mmp_id, '2026-05-31' AS createdate /* fuxinwang：和basic df表字段对齐命名，设备创建时间统一命名createdate */, '2026-05-31' AS logymd /* COALESCE(t2.logymd, t3.logymd, t4.logymd, t5.logymd, 'unknown') AS logymd, */ /* 20220606 */, a.app_id FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT did, app_id, package_name, event_time, server_time, os, gps_adid, android_id, oaid, idfa, idfv, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adjust_id') AS adjust_id, os, COALESCE(IF(TRIM((GEOIP(client_ip, 1))) = '-', NULL, LOWER(GEOIP(client_ip, 1))), 'unknown') AS country, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.network_name') AS media_source, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name') RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS campaign_name, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name') RLIKE '^\\\\d+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)', 2))) AS campaign_id, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name') RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS adgroup_name, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name') RLIKE '^\\\\d+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)', 2))) AS adgroup_id, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative') RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS creative_name, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative') RLIKE '^\\\\d+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)', 2))) AS creative_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, server_time DESC) AS rn FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event WHERE event = '__adjust_callback__' AND logymd = '20260531' AND app_id = 4280 AND NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.network_name') IS NULL AND NOT did IS NULL) AS x WHERE rn = 1) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msdk_app_id, adjust_id ORDER BY event_time, server_time) AS adjust_id_rn FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_msdk_adjust_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND msdk_app_id = 4280 AND NOT adjust_id IS NULL AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') IN ('install')) AS x WHERE adjust_id_rn = 1) AS c ON a.adjust_id = c.adjust_id AND a.app_id = c.msdk_app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT did, APP_ID /* FROM    msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di */ FROM bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di_test4280 /* WHERE   logymd <=  '2026-05-30' or (attr_source<>'callback' and logymd='2026-05-31') */ WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY did, APP_ID) AS d ON a.did = d.did AND a.app_id = d.app_id WHERE d.did IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT * FROM bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di_test4280 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' name: 玩家英雄池流转
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: celiaye@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-10-11 17:57:12.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH t AS (SELECT logymd, zoneid, roleid, heroid, today_battle_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_heroes_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-09-04' AND '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND pvptype = 2 AND is_fake_ai = 0) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.celiaye_heropool_analysis PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.zoneid, a.roleid, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT a.heroid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heronum_270, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT b.heroid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heronum_90, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT c.heroid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heronum_30, SUM(CASE WHEN 270_battle_cnt >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heronum_270_5, SUM(CASE WHEN 90_battle_cnt >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heronum_90_5, SUM(CASE WHEN 30_battle_cnt >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heronum_30_5, CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN NOT a.heroid IS NULL THEN a.heroid END))) AS herolist_270, CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN NOT b.heroid IS NULL THEN b.heroid END))) AS herolist_90, CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN NOT c.heroid IS NULL THEN c.heroid END))) AS herolist_30, CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN 270_battle_cnt >= 5 THEN a.heroid END))) AS herolist_270_5, CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN 90_battle_cnt >= 5 THEN b.heroid END))) AS herolist_90_5, CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN 30_battle_cnt >= 5 THEN c.heroid END))) AS herolist_30_5 FROM (SELECT zoneid, roleid, heroid, SUM(today_battle_cnt) AS 270_battle_cnt FROM t WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-09-04' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY zoneid, roleid, heroid) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT zoneid, roleid, heroid, SUM(today_battle_cnt) AS 90_battle_cnt FROM t WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-03' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY zoneid, roleid, heroid) AS b ON a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.heroid = b.heroid LEFT JOIN (SELECT zoneid, roleid, heroid, SUM(today_battle_cnt) AS 30_battle_cnt FROM t WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY zoneid, roleid, heroid) AS c ON a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.heroid = c.heroid GROUP BY a.zoneid, a.roleid

sql_units: WITH gameserver_login AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, deviceid AS device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS TIME, os_type, ad_id AS gps_adid, android_id, idfa, idfv, gps_asid, fake_ai, CONCAT('gps_adid_', ad_id) AS dev_gps_adid, CONCAT('android_id_', android_id) AS dev_android_id, CONCAT('idfa_', idfa) AS dev_idfa, CONCAT('idfv_', idfv) AS dev_idfv, CONCAT('gps_asid_', gps_asid) AS dev_gps_asid, channel, mt_id, pre_mt_id, 'login' AS event_name FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, device_id, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS TIME, os_type, gps_adid, android_id, idfa, idfv, gps_asid, -99999 AS fake_ai, CONCAT('gps_adid_', gps_adid) AS dev_gps_adid, CONCAT('android_id_', android_id) AS dev_android_id, CONCAT('idfa_', idfa) AS dev_idfa, CONCAT('idfv_', idfv) AS dev_idfv, CONCAT('gps_asid_', gps_asid) AS dev_gps_asid, channel, mt_id, pre_mt_id, 'charge' AS event_name FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), dim_did AS (SELECT *, CONCAT_WS('_', dev_type, dev) AS devid FROM msdk_ods.dim_did WHERE p_date = (SELECT MAX(p_date) FROM msdk_ods.dim_did WHERE p_date >= '2025-11-15')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_id_event_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb', event_name) SELECT act.TIME, act.roleid, act.zoneid, act.fake_ai, act.os_type, act.device_id, act.android_id, act.gps_adid, act.idfa, act.idfv, act.gps_asid, act.mt_id, act.pre_mt_id, COALESCE(fa.did, fv.did, gpsid.did, andid.did, gasid.did, NULL) AS did, act.event_name FROM gameserver_login AS act LEFT JOIN dim_did AS fa ON act.dev_idfa = fa.devid LEFT JOIN dim_did AS fv ON act.dev_idfv = fv.devid LEFT JOIN dim_did AS gpsid ON act.dev_gps_adid = gpsid.devid LEFT JOIN dim_did AS andid ON act.dev_android_id = andid.devid LEFT JOIN dim_did AS gasid ON act.dev_gps_asid = gasid.devid

fee_usd_amt - back_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS after_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_usd_amt - share_usd_amt - fee_usd_amt) / SUM(pay_usd_amt), 0) AS before_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_usd_amt - share_usd_amt - fee_usd_amt - back_tax_usd_amt) / SUM(pay_usd_amt), 0) AS after_back_tax_net_receipts_rate FROM (SELECT *, '2026-05-31' AS log_range_start, '2026-05-31' AS log_range_end, 'day' AS log_type FROM dwm_raw WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT *, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', WEEKDAY('2026-05-31') * -1) AS log_range_start, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', (WEEKDAY('2026-05-31') - 6) * -1) AS log_range_end, 'week' AS log_type FROM dwm_raw WHERE cur_week UNION ALL SELECT *, CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 0, 7), '-01') AS log_range_start, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS log_range_end, 'month' AS log_type FROM dwm_raw WHERE cur_month) GROUP BY pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, bill_country, currency, log_range_start, log_range_end, log_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_fsgame_finance_di PARTITION(appid, logymd, log_type) SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, 'unknown' AS first_mt_country, bill_country, currency, log_range, pay_cnt, product_money, pay_amt, pay_usd_amt, before_tax_amt, before_tax_usd_amt, after_tax_amt, after_tax_usd_amt, tax_amt, tax_usd_amt, back_tax_amt, back_tax_usd_amt, share_amt, share_usd_amt, fee_usd_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, after_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, after_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, after_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, 'fsgame' AS appid, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, log_type FROM log_type_raw

name: 预下载增量周活跃
sql_units: /* 然后插入数据 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.amandapiao_da_zl_predownload_weekly_stats PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT version, diff_days, diff_date, start_date, start_datetime, end_date, end_datetime, os_type, zone_type, channel_type, client_ver_last_two_parts, COUNT(1) AS dau, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_qualified = 1 THEN 1 END) AS qualified_uv, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_parti = 1 THEN 1 END) AS parti_uv, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_success = 1 THEN 1 END) AS success_uv FROM (SELECT a.deviceid, a.version, a.diff_days, a.diff_date, a.start_date, a.start_datetime, a.end_date, a.end_datetime, os_type, zone_type, channel_type, client_ver_last_two_parts, MAX(IF(NOT b.deviceid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS is_qualified /* 是否满足预下载条件 */, MAX(IF(NOT c.deviceid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS is_parti /* 是否参与预下载 */, MAX(IF(NOT f.deviceid IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS is_success /* 是否完成预下载 */ FROM (SELECT b.deviceid /* 符合条件的登录第几天的设备 */, a.version, a.diff_days /* 开始第几天 */, a.diff_date /* 开始第几天对应日期 */, a.start_date, a.start_datetime, a.end_date, a.end_datetime, MIN_BY(op_type, login_time) AS os_type, MIN_BY(FLOOR(zoneid / 1000), login_time) AS zone_type, MIN_BY(channel, login_time) AS channel_type, MIN_BY(REGEXP_EXTRACT(client_version, '([^.]+\\.[^.]+)$'), login_time) AS client_ver_last_two_parts FROM (/* 预下载第几天 */ SELECT version, start_date, end_date, start_datetime, end_datetime, diff_days, diff_date, active_start_date FROM ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-31' AND diff_date = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY version, start_date, end_date, start_datetime, end_datetime, diff_days, diff_date, active_start_date) AS a JOIN (/* 登录设备 登录前14天的情况 */ SELECT device_id AS deviceid, `time` AS login_time, op_type, zoneid, channel, client_version FROM ml_ods.reportserver_client_loginv2_end WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-17' /* - 每次都前7天 保证覆盖到数据 */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) AS b ON b.login_time >= a.active_start_date /* 登录用户开始时间往后移一个小时，排除重连带来的问题 */ AND b.login_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.end_datetime) - 3600) /* 登录用结束时间往后移一个小时，排除重连带来的问题 */ GROUP BY b.deviceid, a.version, a.diff_days, a.diff_date, a.start_date, a.start_datetime, a.end_date, a.end_datetime) AS a LEFT JOIN (/* 满足符合增量下载的玩家（累计统计） */ /* ( */ /*     SELECT  DISTINCT b.deviceid */ /*     FROM    ( */ /*                 SELECT  version, */ /*                         start_date, */ /*                         end_date, */ /*                         start_datetime, */ /*                         end_datetime */ /*                 FROM    ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy */ /*                 WHERE   diff_date = '2026-05-31' */ /*                 AND     logymd >= '2026-05-31' */ /*                 LIMIT   1 */ /*             ) d */ /*     INNER JOIN */ /*             ( */ /*                 SELECT  DISTINCT r.device_id AS deviceid */ /*                 FROM    ml_ods.connserver_client_loginloading_game r */ /*                 INNER JOIN */ /*                         ( */ /*                             SELECT  start_date, */ /*                                     end_date, */ /*                                     start_datetime, */ /*                                     end_datetime */ /*                             FROM    ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy */ /*                             WHERE   diff_date = '2026-05-31' */ /*                             AND     logymd >= '2026-05-31' */ /*                             LIMIT   1 */ /*                         ) d */ /*                 ON      r.logymd >= d.start_date -- 移到ON条件中 */ /*                 AND     r.logymd <= '2026-05-31' */ /*                 AND     r.iswifi = 'True' */ /*                 AND     r.LEVEL > 8 */ /*                 AND     r.downloadprocess = 1 */ /*                 AND     r.`time` >= d.start_datetime */ /*                 AND     r.`time` <= d.end_datetime */ /*             ) b */ /*     ON      1 = 1 */ /* ) b */ SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS deviceid FROM (/* 获取预下载时间范围 */ /* 预下载第几天 */ SELECT version, start_date, end_date, start_datetime, end_datetime, diff_days, diff_date, active_start_date FROM ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-31' AND diff_date = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY version, start_date, end_date, start_datetime, end_datetime, diff_days, diff_date, active_start_date) AS a INNER JOIN (/* 直接筛选已完成增量下载的设备 */ SELECT r.device_id, r.`time` AS login_time FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_loginloading_game AS r CROSS JOIN (SELECT start_date, end_date, start_datetime, end_datetime FROM ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy WHERE diff_date = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-31' LIMIT 1) AS d WHERE r.logymd >= d.start_date AND r.logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND r.iswifi = 'True' AND r.level > 8 AND r.downloadprocess = 1 AND r.`time` >= d.start_datetime AND r.`time` <= d.end_datetime) AS b ON b.login_time >= a.active_start_date /* 预下载时间范围内 */ AND b.login_time <= a.end_datetime) AS b ON a.deviceid = b.deviceid LEFT JOIN (/* 参与预下载的人（累计统计） */ SELECT DISTINCT deviceid FROM ml_ods.connserver_resreport AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT version, start_date, end_date, start_datetime, end_datetime FROM ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy WHERE diff_date = '2026-05-31' /* 距离预下载的时间 */ AND logymd >= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY version, start_date, end_date, start_datetime, end_datetime) AS d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.logymd >= d.start_date /* 从预下载开始日期累计 */ AND r.logymd <= '2026-05-31' /* 到当前日期 */ AND r.`time` >= start_datetime AND r.`time` <= end_datetime AND r.zoneid BETWEEN 1001 AND 57000 AND r.downloadtype IN (2, 5) /* 预下载 */ AND r.download_errortype IN (11, 12, 0, 6) /* 预下载开始、进行、完成 */) AS c ON a.deviceid = c.deviceid LEFT JOIN (/* 预下载完成的人（累计统计） */ SELECT DISTINCT deviceid FROM ml_ods.connserver_resreport AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT version, start_date, end_date, start_datetime, end_datetime FROM ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy WHERE diff_date = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY version, start_date, end_date, start_datetime, end_datetime) AS d ON 1 = 1 WHERE r.logymd >= d.start_date /* 从预下载开始日期累计 */ AND r.logymd <= '2026-05-31' /* 到当前日期 */ AND r.`time` >= start_datetime AND r.`time` <= end_datetime AND r.zoneid BETWEEN 1001 AND 57000 AND r.downloadtype IN (2, 5) /* 预下载 */ AND r.download_errortype IN (6) /* 预下载完成 */) AS f ON a.deviceid = f.deviceid GROUP BY a.deviceid, a.version, a.diff_days, a.diff_date, a.start_date, a.start_datetime, a.end_date, a.end_datetime, os_type, zone_type, channel_type, client_ver_last_two_parts) GROUP BY version, diff_days, diff_date, start_date, start_datetime, end_date, end_datetime, os_type, zone_type, channel_type, client_ver_last_two_parts

name: mt_temp.dwd_uplift_road_match_mid
sql_units: WITH extracted_data AS (SELECT accountid, rank_road_match_final_road, battleid, SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(predict_score, '$.roleRoadTendencyVec'), '\\[|\\]', ''), '\\s+', ''), ',') AS str_tendency_vec FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2 AND rank_road_match_final_road > 0), exploded_data AS (SELECT accountid, rank_road_match_final_road, battleid, str_tendency_vec, pos, CAST(element AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM extracted_data LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(str_tendency_vec) exploded_table AS pos, element), main AS (SELECT accountid, rank_road_match_final_road, battleid, str_tendency_vec, COLLECT_LIST(value) AS tendency_vec, ROUND(MAX(value), 4) AS max_tendency_value, MAX(CASE WHEN pos = 0 THEN value END) AS first1, MAX(CASE WHEN pos = 1 THEN value END) AS first2, MAX(CASE WHEN pos = 2 THEN value END) AS first3, MAX(CASE WHEN pos = 3 THEN value END) AS first4, MAX(CASE WHEN pos = 4 THEN value END) AS first5 FROM exploded_data GROUP BY accountid, rank_road_match_final_road, str_tendency_vec, battleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.dwd_uplift_road_match_mid PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.accountid, MAX_BY(conwins, time) AS last_conwin /* first_value(b.conwins) OVER(PARTITION BY a.accountid order by time DESC) as last_conwin, */, MAX(CASE WHEN conwins >= 0 THEN conwins ELSE 0 END) AS wins, MIN(CASE WHEN conwins < 0 THEN conwins ELSE 0 END) AS lose, COUNT(1) AS cnt, SUM(if_wish_road) AS wish_cnt, SUM(wincamp) AS wincamp_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, battleid, CASE WHEN rank_road_match_final_road = 1 AND first1 >= max_tendency_value * 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN rank_road_match_final_road = 2 AND first2 >= max_tendency_value * 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN rank_road_match_final_road = 3 AND first3 >= max_tendency_value * 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN rank_road_match_final_road = 4 AND first4 >= max_tendency_value * 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN rank_road_match_final_road = 5 AND first5 >= max_tendency_value * 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_wish_road FROM main) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT accountid, battleid, time, wincamp, CASE WHEN conwin >= 0 AND wincamp = 1 THEN conwin + 1 WHEN conwin >= 0 AND wincamp = 0 THEN -1 WHEN conwin < 0 AND wincamp = 1 THEN 1 WHEN conwin < 0 AND wincamp = 0 THEN conwin - 1 ELSE 0 END AS conwins FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2) AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY a.accountid

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_hsu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-11-03 15:24:05.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH date_teamrank AS (SELECT battleid, accountid, zoneid, SPLIT(team_info_tagteam, ',')[0] AS team_id, CASE WHEN SPLIT(team_info_tagteam, ',')[1] = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SPLIT(team_info_tagteam, ',')[1] END AS team_rank FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ailevel = 0 AND ai_accountid = accountid AND pvptype = 301), ntile_values AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY max_39_cupnum DESC) AS per_level, max_39_cupnum FROM mcgg_temp.selinasun_season_user_battle_summary_t0_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT max_39_cupnum IS NULL AND had_daily_bat = 1 /* 过滤掉 NULL 值 且 只看今日有排位行为的玩家的排行版分10pctil */), finak_rank AS (SELECT a.battleid, a.accountid, a.zoneid, camprank FROM date_teamrank AS a JOIN (SELECT team_id, MAX(team_rank) AS camprank FROM date_teamrank GROUP BY team_id) AS b ON a.team_id = b.team_id GROUP BY a.battleid, a.accountid, a.zoneid, camprank), battle_info AS (SELECT t1.logymd, t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, CASE WHEN t1.zoneid < 50000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS servertype, t1.battleid, t1.camprank, t2.maggicchess_rankid, t2.real_player_num, t2.ranklv, t1.pvptype /* -匹配 排位筛选项 */ FROM (SELECT e1.logymd, e1.accountid, e1.zoneid, e1.battleid, CAST(COALESCE(e2.camprank, e1.camprank) AS INT) AS camprank, CASE WHEN (e1.realpvptype = 184 AND e1.pvptype = 39) OR (e1.realpvptype = 601 AND e1.pvptype = 600) THEN 10001 WHEN (e1.realpvptype = 185 AND e1.pvptype = 39) OR (e1.realpvptype IN (600, 602) AND e1.pvptype = 600) THEN 10002 ELSE e1.pvptype END AS pvptype FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS e1 LEFT JOIN finak_rank AS e2 ON e1.battleid = e2.battleid AND e1.accountid = e2.accountid AND e1.zoneid = e2.zoneid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 20000 */ /* AND     pvptype IN (39, 170) */ fake_ai = 0 AND isvalid = 1 AND e1.camprank <> 0 GROUP BY e1.logymd, e1.accountid, e1.zoneid, e1.battleid, COALESCE(e2.camprank, e1.camprank), CASE WHEN (e1.realpvptype = 184 AND e1.pvptype = 39) OR (e1.realpvptype = 601 AND e1.pvptype = 600) THEN 10001 WHEN (e1.realpvptype = 185 AND e1.pvptype = 39) OR (e1.realpvptype IN (600, 602) AND e1.pvptype = 600) THEN 10002 ELSE e1.pvptype END) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT battleid, accountid, zoneid, maggicchess_rankid, real_player_num, matchtime, CASE WHEN maggicchess_rankid >= 1 AND maggicchess_rankid <= 2 THEN '勇士' WHEN maggicchess_rankid >= 3 AND maggicchess_rankid <= 5 THEN '精英' WHEN maggicchess_rankid >= 6 AND maggicchess_rankid <= 9 THEN '大师' WHEN maggicchess_rankid >= 10 AND maggicchess_rankid <= 16 THEN '宗师' WHEN maggicchess_rankid >= 17 AND maggicchess_rankid <= 25 THEN '史诗' WHEN maggicchess_rankid >= 26 AND maggicchess_rankid <= 35 THEN '传奇' ELSE CAST(maggicchess_rankid AS STRING) END AS ranklv FROM mcgg_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     pvptype IN (39, 170) */ success = 1 /* AND     zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 20000 */ GROUP BY battleid, accountid, zoneid, maggicchess_rankid, bigranklvl, real_player_num, matchtime) AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t1.battleid = t2.battleid), autochess AS (SELECT t1.*, t2.heroid, t2.hero_star, t2.skillid, IF(real_player_num = 8, 1, 0) AS all_real_player, t2.is_zero_line, t2.top1_rel, t2.top2_rel, t2.top1_rel_num, t2.top2_rel_num, t2.m1, t2.m2, t2.m3, teamvalue, top3_rel, top4_rel, top3_rel_num, top4_rel_num FROM battle_info AS t1 JOIN (SELECT battleid, accountid, zoneid, heroid, hero_star, skillid, teamvalue, reachdefencerelation, is_zero_line, m1, m2, m3, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN rel_id END) AS top1_rel, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN rel_num END) AS top1_rel_num, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN rel_id END) AS top2_rel, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN rel_num END) AS top2_rel_num, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN rel_id END) AS top3_rel, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN rel_num END) AS top3_rel_num, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN rel_id END) AS top4_rel, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN rel_num END) AS top4_rel_num FROM (SELECT battleid, accountid, zoneid, heroid, hero_star, skillid, teamvalue, reachdefencerelation, CASE WHEN SIZE(SPLIT(reachdefencerelation, '\\073')) - 1 >= 9 AND SPLIT(SPLIT(reachdefencerelation, '58:')[1], '\\073')[0] = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_zero_line, SPLIT(magiccrystal, '\\073')[0] AS m1, SPLIT(magiccrystal, '\\073')[1] AS m2, SPLIT(magiccrystal, '\\073')[2] AS m3, SPLIT(reachdefencerelation2, ':')[0] AS rel_id, SPLIT(reachdefencerelation2, ':')[1] AS rel_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY battleid, accountid, zoneid ORDER BY CAST(SPLIT(reachdefencerelation2, ':')[1] AS INT) DESC, CAST(SPLIT(reachdefencerelation2, ':')[0] AS INT) ASC) AS rn FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(reachdefencerelation, '\\073')) b AS reachdefencerelation2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 20000 */ ailevel = 0 AND accountid = ai_accountid AND NOT SPLIT(reachdefencerelation2, ':')[0] IS NULL AND NOT SPLIT(reachdefencerelation2, ':')[1] IS NULL AND battleid <> 0) GROUP BY battleid, accountid, zoneid, heroid, hero_star, skillid, teamvalue, reachdefencerelation, is_zero_line, m1, m2, m3) AS t2 ON t1.battleid = t2.battleid AND t1.accountid = t2.accountid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid JOIN (SELECT battleid FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battlerank > 0 AND ailevel = 0 AND battle_round >= 10 /* -有效对局局数筛选 */ AND battle_round <= 30 GROUP BY battleid) AS t3 ON t1.battleid = t3.battleid), hero_c AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN zoneid < 50000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS servertype, battleid, chess_id, chess_star, chess_damage, pvptype FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, SPLIT(chessinfo2, ',')[0] AS chess_id, SPLIT(chessinfo2, ',')[1] AS chess_star, SPLIT(chessinfo2, ',')[2] AS chess_damage, SPLIT(chessinfo2, ',')[4] AS chess_getdmg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY CAST(SPLIT(chessinfo2, ',')[2] AS INT) DESC) AS rn FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(chessinfo, '\\073')) b AS chessinfo2 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ailevel = 0 AND battleid <> 0 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, chessinfo2, pvptype) WHERE rn = 1), hero_t AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN zoneid < 50000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS servertype, battleid, chess_id, chess_star, chess_damage, pvptype FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, pvptype, SPLIT(chessinfo2, ',')[0] AS chess_id, SPLIT(chessinfo2, ',')[1] AS chess_star, SPLIT(chessinfo2, ',')[2] AS chess_damage, SPLIT(chessinfo2, ',')[4] AS chess_getdmg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY name: etl.nova_dw.dm_active_lose_recurring_role_zone_utc8_df
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: helenma@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-11-05 14:49:19.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nova_dw.dm_active_lose_recurring_role_zone_utc8_df */ /* ( */ /*     roleid                     DECIMAL(20, 0)     COMMENT '角色id,key', */ /*     zoneid                     BIGINT             COMMENT '服务器,key', */ /*     zone_type                  STRING             COMMENT '区服类型 (0测试服、1正式服)', */ /*     zone_offset                BIGINT             COMMENT '时区', */ /*     create_date                STRING             COMMENT '角色注册日期(role+zone)', */ /*     active_days                BIGINT             COMMENT '活跃天数', */ /*     lose_days                  BIGINT             COMMENT '流失天数 (满7日才算)', */ /*     lose_cnt                   BIGINT             COMMENT '第几次流失(满7日才算)', */ /*     lose_date                  STRING             COMMENT '流失日期 (满7日才算)', */ /*     is_recurring               BIGINT             COMMENT '是否回流 (满7日才算)', */ /*     recurring_date             STRING             COMMENT '回流日期 (满7日才算)', */ /*     is_recurring_7days         BIGINT             COMMENT '是否7日回流 (满7日才算)', */ /*     is_recurring_14days        BIGINT             COMMENT '是否14日回流 (满7日才算)', */ /*     is_recurring_30days        BIGINT             COMMENT '是否30日回流 (满7日才算)', */ /*     active_days_reg_7days       BIGINT            COMMENT '创角后7天内活跃天数', */ /*     active_days_reg_30days      BIGINT            COMMENT '创角后30天内活跃天数', */ /*     pay_amt_reg_7days           BIGINT            COMMENT '创角后7天付费金额', */ /*     pay_amt_reg_14days          BIGINT            COMMENT '创角后14天付费金额', */ /*     pay_amt_reg_30days          BIGINT            COMMENT '创角后30天付费金额', */ /*     is_reg_lose_2d             BIGINT             COMMENT '是否次日创角流失(创角日期+1未登录)', */ /*     is_reg_lose_3d             BIGINT             COMMENT '是否3日创角流失(创角日期+2未登录)', */ /*     is_reg_lose_7d             BIGINT             COMMENT '是否7日创角流失(创角日期+6未登录)', */ /*     is_reg_lose_14d            BIGINT             COMMENT '是否14日创角流失(创角日期+13未登录)', */ /*     is_reg_lose_30d            BIGINT             COMMENT '是否30日创角流失(创角日期+29未登录)' */ /* ) COMMENT '角色流失回流数据-角色粒度UTC8' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     logymd STRING COMMENT '日期,yyyy-MM-dd', */ /*     appid STRING  COMMENT 'nova' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://nova-dw/table/dm_active_lose_recurring_role_zone_utc8_df'; */ WITH lose_info /* WHERE */ /*     AND  length(lose_active_info) >= 8  -- 常规逻辑：流失需要限定满7日, NOVA有定制逻辑 */ AS (/* 目前还处于流失状态+当天回流的用户 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, create_date, active_days_array, charge_amt_total_array, active_info, lose_active_info, LENGTH(active_info) AS active_size /* 总观测天数 */, LENGTH(lose_active_info) AS lose_size, SIZE(SPLIT(active_info, '[0]{7,}')) /* 将流失信息分割成不同流失周期 */ /* split(active_info,'[0]{7,}') AS lose_cycles_array, */ /* 最近流失周期 */ /* element_at(split(active_info, '[0]{7,}'), -1) as current_cycle, */ /* 流失周期数量 */ - 1 AS lose_cnt, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', (LENGTH(lose_active_info) - 1) * -1) AS lose_date /* 最近流失日期 */, IF(SUBSTRING(lose_active_info, 0, 1) = '1', 1, 0) AS is_recurring, IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 0, 1) = '1', 1, 0) AS is_active FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, create_date, active_days_array, charge_amt_total_array, active_info, REGEXP_EXTRACT(active_info, '((^[1][0]{7,}1)|(^[0]{6,}1))') AS lose_active_info /* 第一部分：(^[1][0]{7,}1) , 代表 第一部分匹配的是：以字符'1'开头，然后紧跟至少7个'0'，然后再以一个'1'结尾的字符串 */ /* 第二部分：(^[0]{6,}1) , 代表 字符串以至少6个'0'开头，然后一个'1' */ FROM nova_dw.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_utc8_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'nova') AS t), active_lose_recurring AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, create_date, lose_size /* active_info, */ /* lose_active_info, */ /* active_days_array, */ /* charge_amt_total_array, */, active_days_array[0] AS active_days, lose_size - (2 - IF(is_recurring = 1, 0, 1)) AS lose_days, lose_cnt, lose_date, is_recurring, CASE WHEN is_recurring = 1 THEN '2026-05-31' END AS recurring_date, IF(is_recurring = 1 AND lose_size > 7 AND SUBSTRING(lose_active_info, LENGTH(lose_active_info) - 7, 7) = REPEAT('0', 7), 1, 0) AS is_recurring_7days, IF(is_recurring = 1 AND lose_size > 14 AND SUBSTRING(lose_active_info, LENGTH(lose_active_info) - 14, 14) = REPEAT('0', 14), 1, 0) AS is_recurring_14days, IF(is_recurring = 1 AND lose_size > 30 AND SUBSTRING(lose_active_info, LENGTH(lose_active_info) - 30, 30) = REPEAT('0', 30), 1, 0) AS is_recurring_30days, IF(SIZE(active_days_array) > 7, active_days_array[SIZE(active_days_array) - 7], active_days_array[0]) AS active_days_reg_7days, IF(SIZE(active_days_array) > 30, active_days_array[SIZE(active_days_array) - 30], active_days_array[0]) AS active_days_reg_30days, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 7, charge_amt_total_array[SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) - 7], charge_amt_total_array[0]) AS pay_amt_reg_7days, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 14, charge_amt_total_array[SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) - 14], charge_amt_total_array[0]) AS pay_amt_reg_14days, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 30, charge_amt_total_array[SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) - 30], charge_amt_total_array[0]) AS pay_amt_reg_30days, CASE WHEN active_size >= 2 AND SUBSTRING(active_info, active_size - 1, 1) = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_reg_lose_2d /* 自定义逻辑：创角日期+1未登录 */, CASE WHEN active_size >= 3 AND SUBSTRING(active_info, active_size - 2, 1) = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_reg_lose_3d, CASE WHEN active_size >= 7 AND SUBSTRING(active_info, active_size - 6, 1) = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_reg_lose_7d, CASE WHEN active_size >= 14 AND SUBSTRING(active_info, active_size - 13, 1) = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_reg_lose_14d, CASE WHEN active_size >= 30 AND SUBSTRING(active_info, active_size - 29, 1) = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_reg_lose_30d /* 自定义逻辑：创角日期+29未登录 */ FROM lose_info) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE nova_dw.dm_active_lose_recurring_role_zone_utc8_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'nova') SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, create_date, active_days, IF(lose_days > 0, lose_days, 0) AS lose_days, lose_cnt, lose_date, is_recurring, recurring_date, is_recurring_7days, is_recurring_14days, is_recurring_30days, active_days_reg_7days, active_days_reg_30days, pay_amt_reg_7days, pay_amt_reg_14days, pay_amt_reg_30days, is_reg_lose_2d, is_reg_lose_3d, is_reg_lose_7d, is_reg_lose_14d, is_reg_lose_30d FROM active_lose_recurring /* -- --  排除流失天数超过2年并且非回流的数据 */ /* WHERE */ /*     (if(is_recurring=1,0,1) + lose_size - 2 <= 730 OR (is_recurring = 1)) */

name: 付费突破_MAU大盘表
sql_units: WITH mau AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(logymd, 0, 7) AS logymd_month FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= '2026-04-30' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND MONTH(logymd) = MONTH('2026-05-31') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(logymd, 0, 7)), b AS (SELECT * FROM ml_temp.leolv_month_pay_mi WHERE logymd_month >= '2017-01-01') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.leolv_mau_pay_break_mi PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.logymd_month, b.charge_num_fenceng, b.is_breakthrough_tier_sticky, b.same_tier_rank, b.rn_gap_since_prev_first_break, b.appear_cnt_before_break, MAX(CAST(c.charge_num_fenceng AS FLOAT)) AS max_fenceng_before FROM mau AS a LEFT JOIN b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.logymd_month = b.logymd_month LEFT JOIN b AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.logymd_month > c.logymd_month GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.logymd_month, b.charge_num_fenceng, b.is_breakthrough_tier_sticky, b.same_tier_rank, b.rn_gap_since_prev_first_break, b.appear_cnt_before_break

name: ml_temp.mlbb_month_active_user_cwl
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.mlbb_month_active_user_cwl PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* mlbb月活人数 */ SELECT TO_DATE(month_dt, 'yyyy/MM/dd') AS month_dt, country, CAST(active_users AS BIGINT) AS active_users FROM ml_temp.mlbb_month_active_06_11 WHERE logymd = '20251130' UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', logymd), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS month_dt, CASE WHEN country IS NULL THEN '未知' ELSE country END AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid) AS active_users FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, MIN(UPPER(ip_country)) AS country FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND UPPER(appid) = 'MLBB' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', logymd), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), CASE WHEN country IS NULL THEN '未知' ELSE country END

name: 新预下载看板1
sql_units: WITH bangeng AS (SELECT version, start_date, end_date, formal_start_date, formal_start_datetime FROM ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY version, start_date, end_date, formal_start_date, formal_start_datetime, logymd), version_days AS (SELECT version, formal_start_date, day_date, CAST(post_diff_days AS INT) AS post_diff_days FROM ml_temp.amandapiao_post_update_days WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* AND     day_date <= '2026-05-31' */ /* AND     version = '2.1.18.2'  -- 比如 'v2.1.0' */ day_date = '2026-05-31' /* 每天只跑当天的数据 */ GROUP BY version, formal_start_date, day_date, CAST(post_diff_days AS INT)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.amandapiao_cumulated_players_daily_label PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT vd.version, vd.post_diff_days, vd.day_date, gl.deviceid, MIN_BY(os_type, TIME) AS os_type, MIN_BY(FLOOR(zoneid / 1000), TIME) AS zone_type, MIN_BY(channel, TIME) AS channel_type, MIN_BY(REGEXP_EXTRACT(client_ver, '([^.]+\\.[^.]+)$'), TIME) AS client_ver_last_two_parts FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di AS gl INNER JOIN version_days AS vd ON gl.logymd BETWEEN vd.formal_start_date AND vd.day_date AND gl.logymd = vd.day_date WHERE gl.logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY vd.version, vd.post_diff_days, vd.day_date, gl.deviceid

name: 战略_分国家mau_mpu
sql_units: WITH basic /*   AND   first_mt_country in ('id', 'ph', 'mm', 'my', 'mn', 'uz', 'ua', 'kz', 'by', 'kg', 'az', 'md', 'tj', 'am', 'ru') */ AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country AS country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05' <= '2025-01', LAST_DAY('2025-01-01'), LAST_DAY('2026-05-01')) AND register_date <= LAST_DAY('2026-05-01') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), login AS (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = '2026-05' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid), charge AS (SELECT roleid, SUM(product_money) AS pay_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = '2026-05' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) AND product_money > 0 GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `bi_test`.`strategy_mau_mpu` PARTITION(dt, appname) SELECT country, COUNT(DISTINCT login.roleid) AS mau, COUNT(DISTINCT charge.roleid) AS mpu, SUM(pay_amt) AS pay_amt, '2026-05' AS dt, 'mlbb' AS appname FROM basic LEFT JOIN login ON basic.roleid = login.roleid LEFT JOIN charge ON basic.roleid = charge.roleid GROUP BY basic.country /* order by mau desc */

name: 月付费突破与维持
sql_units: WITH month_list AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(logymd, 0, 7) AS logymd_month, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(logymd, 0, 7)) AS rn FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(logymd, 0, 7)), month_pay AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, a.logymd_month, rn, charge_num, CASE WHEN charge_num IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN charge_num < 0.99 THEN 0.01 WHEN charge_num < 1.98 THEN 1 WHEN charge_num < 5 * 0.99 THEN 2 WHEN charge_num < 10 * 0.99 THEN 5 WHEN charge_num < 20 * 0.99 THEN 10 WHEN charge_num < 50 * 0.99 THEN 20 WHEN charge_num >= 50 * 0.99 THEN 50 ELSE 0 END AS charge_num_fenceng FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(logymd, 0, 7) AS logymd_month, SUM(money / 100) AS charge_num FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND a.zoneid < 57000 AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND /* AND     is_sandbox = 0 --排除沙盒测试数据,没收入	*/ /* AND  (pay_channel NOT IN ('and_huawei_ag','and_xiaomi_getapps') OR is_sandbox = 0)		*/ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据,因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。			*/ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡,没收入			*/ AND a.product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 			*/ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(logymd, 0, 7)) AS a LEFT JOIN month_list AS b ON a.logymd_month = b.logymd_month), base AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd_month, rn, charge_num_fenceng, CASE WHEN charge_num_fenceng >= MAX(charge_num_fenceng) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_breakthrough, CASE WHEN charge_num_fenceng > 0 AND charge_num_fenceng > COALESCE(MAX(charge_num_fenceng) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), -1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_first_breakthrough, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, charge_num_fenceng ORDER BY logymd_month) AS same_tier_rank FROM month_pay), aug AS (SELECT b.*, MIN(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid) AS min_rn, MAX(CASE WHEN is_first_breakthrough = 1 THEN rn END) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_break_rn, MAX(charge_num_fenceng) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_max_fenceng_till_prev FROM base AS b), tiers AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, charge_num_fenceng AS tier FROM base), first_break AS (SELECT t.roleid, t.zoneid, t.tier, MIN(b.logymd_month) AS first_broken_month FROM tiers AS t JOIN base AS b ON b.roleid = t.roleid AND b.zoneid = t.zoneid AND b.charge_num_fenceng > t.tier GROUP BY t.roleid, t.zoneid, t.tier), tier_count_before_break AS (SELECT t.roleid, t.zoneid, t.tier AS charge_num_fenceng, SUM(CASE WHEN fb.first_broken_month IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN b.logymd_month < fb.first_broken_month THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS appear_cnt_before_break, MIN(fb.first_broken_month) AS first_broken_month FROM tiers AS t JOIN base AS b ON b.roleid = t.roleid AND b.zoneid = t.zoneid AND b.charge_num_fenceng = t.tier LEFT JOIN first_break AS fb ON fb.roleid = t.roleid AND fb.zoneid = t.zoneid AND fb.tier = t.tier GROUP BY t.roleid, t.zoneid, t.tier), aug2 AS (SELECT a.*, MAX(CASE WHEN is_first_breakthrough = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, charge_num_fenceng ORDER BY logymd_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS is_breakthrough_tier_sticky, LAG(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, charge_num_fenceng ORDER BY logymd_month) AS prev_same_tier_rn, COALESCE(LAG(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, charge_num_fenceng ORDER BY logymd_month), a.prev_break_rn, a.min_rn) AS prev_rn_for_gap FROM aug AS a) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.leolv_month_pay_mi PARTITION(logymd_month) SELECT a2.roleid, a2.zoneid, a2.charge_num_fenceng, CASE WHEN a2.charge_num_fenceng = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a2.is_breakthrough_tier_sticky END AS is_breakthrough_tier_sticky, a2.same_tier_rank, CASE WHEN a2.is_first_breakthrough = 1 AND COALESCE(a2.prev_max_fenceng_till_prev, 0) = 0 THEN a2.rn - a2.prev_rn_for_gap WHEN a2.is_first_breakthrough = 1 THEN a2.rn - a2.prev_rn_for_gap - 1 WHEN a2.is_breakthrough_tier_sticky = 1 THEN a2.rn - a2.prev_rn_for_gap - 1 ELSE NULL END AS rn_gap_since_prev_first_break, CASE WHEN tcb.appear_cnt_before_break = 0 THEN NULL ELSE tcb.appear_cnt_before_break END AS appear_cnt_before_break, a2.logymd_month FROM aug2 AS a2 LEFT JOIN tier_count_before_break AS tcb ON tcb.roleid = a2.roleid AND tcb.zoneid = a2.zoneid AND tcb.charge_num_fenceng = a2.charge_num_fenceng ORDER BY a2.logymd_month

COMMENT '支付币种', */ /*     `log_range` string COMMENT '日期范围', */ /*     `pay_role_cnt` bigint COMMENT '支付角色数', */ /*     `his_first_pay_user_cnt` bigint COMMENT '历史首次充值角色数', */ /*     `get_diamond` bigint COMMENT '游戏货币充值数', */ /*     `pay_cnt` bigint COMMENT '真实付费次数', */ /*     `product_money` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '真实充值商品定价金额', */ /*     `pay_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '真实付费金额(对应币种)', */ /*    `tax_usd_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '渠道代缴税金金额(单位：美分)', */ /*     `back_tax_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '补缴税金金额(对应币种)', */ /*     `back_tax_usd_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '补缴税金金额(单位：美分)', */ /*     `share_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '渠道分成金额(对应币种)', */ /*     `share_usd_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '渠道分成金额(单位：美分)', */ /*     `fee_usd_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '渠道手续费金额(单位：美分)', */ /*     `before_back_tax_net_receipts_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '补缴前实收金额(对应币种)', */ /*     `before_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '补缴前实收金额(单位：美分)', */ /*     `after_back_tax_net_receipts_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '补缴后实收金额(对应币种)', */ /*     `after_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '补缴后实收金额(单位：美分)', */ /*     `before_back_tax_net_receipts_rate` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '实收率(补缴前)', */ /*     `after_back_tax_net_receipts_rate` decimal(38, 18) COMMENT '实收率(补缴后)', */ /*     `active_role_cnt` bigint COMMENT '活跃角色数(注册国家粒度)', */ /*     `active_pay_role_cnt` bigint COMMENT '活跃付费角色数(注册国家粒度)' */ /* ) COMMENT '经营指标表' PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `appid` string COMMENT 'appid', */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区', */ /*     `log_type` string COMMENT '日期维度' */ /* ) */ /* stored as parquet */ /* location 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_fsgame_finance_di' */ WITH dwm_raw AS (SELECT charge.*, COALESCE(basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(pay_channel, 'unknown') AS pay_channel, COALESCE(sub_pay_channel, 'unknown') AS sub_pay_channel, COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS bill_country, COALESCE(currency, 'unknown') AS currency, product_id, first_pay_time, last_pay_time, pay_amt, pay_usd_amt, before_tax_amt, before_tax_usd_amt, after_tax_amt, after_tax_usd_amt, tax_amt, tax_usd_amt, back_tax_amt, back_tax_usd_amt, share_amt, share_usd_amt, fee_amt, fee_usd_amt, pay_net_receipts_amt, pay_net_receipts_usd_amt, pay_cnt, product_money, logymd, logymd >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 0, 7), '-01') AS cur_month, logymd >= CAST(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', WEEKDAY('2026-05-31') * -1) AS STRING) AS cur_week FROM mt_dwm.dwm_nova_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= LEAST(CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 0, 7), '-01'), CAST(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', WEEKDAY('2026-05-31') * -1) AS STRING))) AS charge LEFT JOIN msdk_dim.dim_account_df AS basic ON charge.roleid = basic.account_id AND basic.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND basic.app_id = 4400), log_type_raw AS (SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, first_mt_country, bill_country, currency, CONCAT(log_range_start, '~', log_range_end) AS log_range, log_type, COALESCE(SUM(pay_cnt), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(product_money), 0) AS product_money, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt), 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_usd_amt), 0) AS pay_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(before_tax_amt), 0) AS before_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(before_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS before_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_amt), 0) AS after_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS after_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(tax_amt), 0) AS tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(tax_usd_amt), 0) AS tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(back_tax_amt), 0) AS back_tax_amt, COALESCE(SUM(back_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS back_tax_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(share_amt), 0) AS share_amt, COALESCE(SUM(share_usd_amt), 0) AS share_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(fee_usd_amt), 0) AS fee_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_amt), 0) AS before_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_usd_amt - share_usd_amt - fee_usd_amt), 0) AS before_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_amt - back_tax_amt), 0) AS after_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_usd_amt - share_usd_amt - fee_usd_amt - back_tax_usd_amt), 0) AS after_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_usd_amt - share_usd_amt - fee_usd_amt) / SUM(pay_usd_amt), 0) AS before_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, COALESCE(SUM(after_tax_usd_amt - share_usd_amt - fee_usd_amt - back_tax_usd_amt) / SUM(pay_usd_amt), 0) AS after_back_tax_net_receipts_rate FROM (SELECT *, '2026-05-31' AS log_range_start, '2026-05-31' AS log_range_end, 'day' AS log_type FROM dwm_raw WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT *, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', WEEKDAY('2026-05-31') * -1) AS log_range_start, DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', (WEEKDAY('2026-05-31') - 6) * -1) AS log_range_end, 'week' AS log_type FROM dwm_raw WHERE cur_week UNION ALL SELECT *, CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 0, 7), '-01') AS log_range_start, LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AS log_range_end, 'month' AS log_type FROM dwm_raw WHERE cur_month) GROUP BY pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, first_mt_country, bill_country, currency, log_range_start, log_range_end, log_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_nova_finance_di PARTITION(logymd, appid, log_type) SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, first_mt_country, bill_country, currency, log_range, pay_cnt, product_money, pay_amt, pay_usd_amt, before_tax_amt, before_tax_usd_amt, after_tax_amt, after_tax_usd_amt, tax_amt, tax_usd_amt, back_tax_amt, back_tax_usd_amt, share_amt, share_usd_amt, fee_usd_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, after_back_tax_net_receipts_amt, after_back_tax_net_receipts_usd_amt, before_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, after_back_tax_net_receipts_rate, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, 'nova' AS appid, log_type FROM log_type_raw

'wa%') AS a WHERE rn = 1), waid_device_account_df AS (SELECT waid, roleid FROM (SELECT waid, relate_roleid AS roleid /* device_id   AS deviceid, */ FROM account_bind_ext UNION ALL SELECT waid, roleid /* cur_deviceid AS deviceid, */ FROM account_bind_d) AS t1 GROUP BY waid, roleid), behavior_feature AS (SELECT t_basic.roleid, t_basic.zoneid, MAX(t_active.his_last_active_ip) AS his_last_active_ip, his_last_active_level FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, his_first_os_language FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_ai = 0 AND appid = 'mlbb') AS t_basic LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_time, his_last_active_ip, his_last_active_level FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb') AS t_active ON accountid) AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.accountid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t4 ON t1.roleid = t4.roleid AND name: 周活流转roleid粒度
sql_units: /* 今年每周活跃用户分层X下周活跃分层对应的人数和总活跃天数，（最好区分新增） */ /* 今年每周活跃用户分层X下周活跃分层对应的人数和总活跃天数，（最好区分新增）2025-01-12 */ /* 跨年周所属年份归于周一所在年份 */ WITH act_t AS (SELECT a.roleid, CASE WHEN WEEKOFYEAR(logymd) >= 50 AND MONTH(logymd) = 1 THEN YEAR(logymd) - 1 /* 1月之后的50+算作上年周 */ WHEN WEEKOFYEAR(logymd) = 1 AND MONTH(logymd) = 12 THEN YEAR(logymd) + 1 /* 12月   的第一周算作下一年 */ ELSE YEAR(logymd) END AS year_id, CASE WHEN WEEKOFYEAR(DATE_ADD(logymd, 7)) >= 50 AND MONTH(DATE_ADD(logymd, 7)) = 1 THEN YEAR(DATE_ADD(logymd, 7)) - 1 /* 1月之后的50+算作上年周 */ WHEN WEEKOFYEAR(DATE_ADD(logymd, 7)) = 1 AND MONTH(DATE_ADD(logymd, 7)) = 12 THEN YEAR(DATE_ADD(logymd, 7)) + 1 /* 12月的第一周算作下一年 */ ELSE YEAR(DATE_ADD(logymd, 7)) END AS next_year_id, WEEKOFYEAR(logymd) AS weeknum_id, WEEKOFYEAR(DATE_ADD(logymd, 7)) AS next_weeknum_id, FLOOR(DATEDIFF(LOGYMD, '2010-01-04') / 7) AS his_week_id_2010, FLOOR(DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(LOGYMD, 7), '2010-01-04') / 7) AS his_next_week_id_2010, MAX(IF(b.roleid_min_register_date < DATE_ADD(SUBSTRING(DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', logymd), 1, 10), 30 * -1), 1, 0)) AS is_recent_30d_new_user, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, MIN(register_date) AS roleid_min_register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 /* 剔除测服注册的账号 */ GROUP BY roleid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 13 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY a.roleid, year_id, next_year_id, weeknum_id, next_weeknum_id, his_week_id_2010, his_next_week_id_2010) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.richardguo_week_active_transfer PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.year_id, a.weeknum_id, a.is_recent_30d_new_user, CASE WHEN a.active_days >= 6 THEN '3.高活' WHEN a.active_days >= 3 THEN '2.中活' WHEN a.active_days >= 1 THEN '1.低活' ELSE '0.无活跃' /* 上周无活跃本周活跃用 */ END AS current_week_active_level, a.active_days AS current_week_active_days, b.year_id AS next_year_id, COALESCE(b.weeknum_id, a.next_weeknum_id) AS next_weeknum_id, CASE WHEN b.active_days >= 6 THEN '3.高活' WHEN b.active_days >= 3 THEN '2.中活' WHEN b.active_days >= 1 THEN '1.低活' ELSE '0.无活跃' /* 上周无活跃本周活跃用 */ END AS next_week_active_level, b.active_days AS next_week_active_days, CASE WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MY', 'MM', 'RU', 'TR', 'IN', 'VN', 'TH') THEN UPPER(first_mt_country) WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('PE', 'BO') THEN '拉美PE+BO' WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('HK') THEN 'HK' ELSE 'else' END AS first_mt_country2 /* 取主要国家 */, COALESCE(a.active_days, 0) AS current_week_total_active_days, COALESCE(b.active_days, 0) AS next_week_total_active_days FROM act_t AS a LEFT JOIN act_t AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.his_next_week_id_2010 = b.his_week_id_2010 LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS bf ON a.roleid = bf.roleid AND bf.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND bf.appid = 'mlbb' WHERE a.weeknum_id = WEEKOFYEAR(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 8 * -1)) GROUP BY a.roleid, a.year_id, a.weeknum_id, a.is_recent_30d_new_user, CASE WHEN a.active_days >= 6 THEN '3.高活' WHEN a.active_days >= 3 THEN '2.中活' WHEN a.active_days >= 1 THEN '1.低活' ELSE '0.无活跃' /* 上周无活跃本周活跃用 */ END, a.active_days, b.year_id, COALESCE(b.weeknum_id, a.next_weeknum_id), CASE WHEN b.active_days >= 6 THEN '3.高活' WHEN b.active_days >= 3 THEN '2.中活' WHEN b.active_days >= 1 THEN '1.低活' ELSE '0.无活跃' /* 上周无活跃本周活跃用 */ END, b.active_days, CASE WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MY', 'MM', 'RU', 'TR', 'IN', 'VN', 'TH') THEN UPPER(first_mt_country) WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('PE', 'BO') THEN '拉美PE+BO' WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('HK') THEN 'HK' ELSE 'else' END /* 取主要国家 */, COALESCE(a.active_days, 0), COALESCE(b.active_days, 0) /* where a.weeknum_id in (50,51,52,53,1,2) */

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: niangangdeng@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-08-18 11:03:14.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_dm.dm_monitor_metric_battle_loading_di */ /* ( */ /*     region_id	        bigint  COMMENT '大区', */ /*     battle_group_id	    bigint  COMMENT '战斗组', */ /*     os	                string  COMMENT '操作系统', */ /*     his_first_country	string  COMMENT '国家', */ /*     realpicturequality	bigint  COMMENT '机型品质', */ /*     pvptype	            bigint  COMMENT '战斗类型', */ /*     device	            string  COMMENT '设备型号', */ /*     upper_term          BIGINT  COMMENT '分子', */ /*     lower_term          BIGINT  COMMENT '分母' */ /* ) COMMENT '指标异动分析对象' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyyy-MM-dd') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dm/table/dm_monitor_metric_battle_loading_di'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_monitor_metric_battle_loading_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT region_id, battle_group_id, os, his_first_country, realpicturequality, pvptype, device, SUM(CASE WHEN flag <> 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upper_term, SUM(1) AS lower_term FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, COALESCE(c.region_id, 0) AS region_id, COALESCE(a.battle_group_id, 0) AS battle_group_id, COALESCE(c.os, 'else') AS os, COALESCE(c.his_first_country, 'else') AS his_first_country, COALESCE(c.realpicturequality, 0) AS realpicturequality, COALESCE(a.pvptype, 0) AS pvptype, COALESCE(b.device, 'else') AS device, flag FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, FLOOR(battlesvrid / 1000) AS battle_group_id, pvptype, device, flag FROM ml_ods.connserver_battle_loading_choke AS b WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND CAST(battleid AS BIGINT) > 1000000000000 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND herotype = 0) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT device FROM (SELECT device, COUNT(DISTINCT accountid, zoneid) AS cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_battle_loading_choke WHERE logymd = '2026-05-28' GROUP BY device) AS tmp ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 50) AS b ON a.device = b.device LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, FLOOR(t1.zoneid / 1000) AS region_id, t2.os AS os, t1.first_mt_country AS his_first_country, t3.realpicturequality AS realpicturequality FROM (/* 国家 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MM', 'MY', 'IN', 'RU', 'KH', 'TR', 'TH', 'UNKNOWN', 'BR', 'LA', 'MN', 'SG', 'PE', 'US', 'BO', 'UA', 'VN', 'NP', 'UZ', 'MX', 'KZ', 'AR', 'SA', 'EG', 'JP', 'DE', 'BY', 'CO') THEN UPPER(first_mt_country) ELSE 'else' END AS first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (/* 操作系统 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, os FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_first_active = 1) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 机型品质 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, realpicturequality FROM mt_dim.dim_monitor_role_zone_realpicturequality_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid) AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid) AS tmp GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (() /* 0个维度：总合计 */ /* 0个维度：总合计 */, (region_id) /* 1个维度：每个单独维度的聚合 */, (battle_group_id), (os), (his_first_country), (realpicturequality), (pvptype), (device), (region_id, battle_group_id) /* 2个维度：所有可能的两两组合 */, (region_id, os), (region_id, his_first_country), (region_id, realpicturequality), (region_id, pvptype), (region_id, device), (battle_group_id, os), (battle_group_id, his_first_country), (battle_group_id, realpicturequality), (battle_group_id, pvptype), (battle_group_id, device), (os, his_first_country), (os, realpicturequality), (os, pvptype), (os, device), (his_first_country, realpicturequality), (his_first_country, pvptype), (his_first_country, device), (realpicturequality, pvptype), (realpicturequality, device), (pvptype, device))

name: 不合理阵容lineup表_败方
sql_units: WITH all_date AS (SELECT * FROM mcgg_temp.susu_tmp_unreasonable_lineup_all_data_defeat_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), go_dim AS (SELECT servertype, id, skillname, level FROM mt_dim.dim_mcsupercrystalkey_mcgg_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 若需要 fallback 日期，请在调度端提前计算 dim_date */), go_expl AS (SELECT t.*, ex.mid FROM all_date AS t LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(ARRAY(m1, m2, m3)) ex AS mid WHERE NOT ex.mid IS NULL), hero_dim /* 3) 指挥官（hero） */ /* 维表预过滤：按分区读且 commandertype = 1 */ AS (SELECT id, mname, servertype FROM mt_dim.dim_mchero_mcgg_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND commandertype = 1), chess_dim /* 4) 棋子：join 三张表（all_date, hero dim, chess round） */ AS (SELECT id AS hero_id, mname, quality, servertype, pvptype FROM mt_dim.dim_mchero_mcgg_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), chess_round AS (SELECT logymd, zoneid, accountid, battleid, round, chessid, chessprice, chessstarlevel FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundheroinfo WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), rel_dim /* 5) 羁绊（relations） */ AS (SELECT relationid, mrelationattach, servertype, pvptype FROM mt_dim.dim_relationskilltip_mcgg_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.susu_tmp_unreasonable_lineup_defeat_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.servertype, t1.real_player, t1.max_rank, t1.pvptype, 'GoGo卡牌' AS lineup, t2.skillname AS name, t1.round AS round, t2.level AS level, COUNT(DISTINCT STRUCT(t1.battleid, t1.round, t1.accountid, t1.zoneid)) AS total_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN unreasonable_rv1 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreasonable_rv1_count, SUM(CASE WHEN unreasonable_rv2 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreasonable_rv2_count FROM go_expl AS t1 JOIN go_dim AS t2 ON t1.servertype = t2.servertype AND t1.mid = t2.id GROUP BY t1.servertype, t1.real_player, t1.max_rank, t1.pvptype, t2.skillname, t1.round, t2.level UNION ALL SELECT t1.servertype, t1.real_player, t1.max_rank, t1.pvptype, '指挥官' AS lineup, t2.mname AS name, NULL AS round, NULL AS level, COUNT(DISTINCT STRUCT(t1.battleid, t1.round, t1.accountid, t1.zoneid)) AS total_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN unreasonable_rv1 = 1 AND t1.heroid = t2.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreasonable_rv1_count, SUM(CASE WHEN unreasonable_rv2 = 1 AND t1.heroid = t2.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreasonable_rv2_count FROM all_date AS t1 JOIN hero_dim AS t2 ON t1.servertype = t2.servertype AND t1.heroid = t2.id GROUP BY t1.servertype, t1.real_player, t1.max_rank, t1.pvptype, t2.mname UNION ALL SELECT t1.servertype, t1.real_player, t1.max_rank, t1.pvptype, '棋子' AS lineup, t2.mname AS name, t3.chessprice AS round, t3.chessstarlevel AS level, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(t1.battleid, t1.round, t1.accountid, t1.zoneid)) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN unreasonable_rv1 = 1 AND t3.chessid = t2.hero_id THEN CONCAT(t1.battleid, t1.round, t1.accountid, t1.zoneid) END) AS unreasonable_rv1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN unreasonable_rv2 = 1 AND t3.chessid = t2.hero_id THEN CONCAT(t1.battleid, t1.round, t1.accountid, t1.zoneid) END) AS unreasonable_rv2_count FROM all_date AS t1 JOIN chess_dim AS t2 ON t1.servertype = t2.servertype AND t1.pvptype = t2.pvptype JOIN chess_round AS t3 ON t3.battleid = t1.battleid AND t3.round = t1.round AND t3.accountid = t1.accountid AND t3.zoneid = t1.zoneid AND t3.chessid = t2.hero_id GROUP BY t1.servertype, t1.real_player, t1.max_rank, t1.pvptype, t2.mname, t3.chessprice, t3.chessstarlevel UNION ALL SELECT t1.servertype, t1.real_player, t1.max_rank, t1.pvptype, '羁绊' AS lineup, t2.mrelationattach AS name, t1.round AS round, NULL AS level, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(t1.battleid, t1.round, t1.accountid, t1.zoneid)) AS total_cnt /* (区分维度标签)总回合数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN unreasonable_rv1 = 1 AND (t1.top1_rel = t2.relationid OR t1.top2_rel = t2.relationid) THEN CONCAT(t1.battleid, t1.round, t1.accountid, t1.zoneid) END) AS unreasonable_rv1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN unreasonable_rv2 = 1 AND (t1.top1_rel = t2.relationid OR t1.top2_rel = t2.relationid) THEN CONCAT(t1.battleid, t1.round, t1.accountid, t1.zoneid) END) AS unreasonable_rv2_count FROM all_date AS t1 JOIN rel_dim AS t2 ON t1.servertype = t2.servertype AND t1.pvptype = t2.pvptype GROUP BY t1.servertype, t1.real_player, t1.max_rank, t1.pvptype, t2.mrelationattach, t1.round
