name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_exp_match_warm_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_decismart_exp_match_warm_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 干预局融合四期匹配V5 */ SELECT y.season, y.days_index, matchid, use_bytedance_ai, pvptype, realpvptype_begin, realpvptype_end, blacknum, groupsel, matchranklvl, matchminlvl, success, interventionreason, mt_enter_sadness_type, room_is_architecture_integration, room_is_pre_enter_aisadness, cal_sadness_in_aimatch, tracenum, changenum, createrole_country FROM (SELECT logymd, matchid, use_bytedance_ai, pvptype, realpvptype_begin, realpvptype_end, blacknum, groupsel, matchranklvl, matchminlvl, success, interventionreason, mt_enter_sadness_type, room_is_architecture_integration, room_is_pre_enter_aisadness, cal_sadness_in_aimatch, createrole_country, COUNT(DISTINCT a.mt_traceid) AS tracenum, SUM(changenum) AS changenum FROM (SELECT logymd, mt_traceid, real_match_type AS realpvptype_end, groupsel, success, interventionreason, mt_enter_sadness_type, room_is_architecture_integration, room_is_pre_enter_aisadness, cal_sadness_in_aimatch, UPPER(createrole_country) AS createrole_country FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 164, 188) AND reenter_num = 0 GROUP BY logymd, mt_traceid, realpvptype_end, groupsel, success, interventionreason, mt_enter_sadness_type, room_is_architecture_integration, room_is_pre_enter_aisadness, cal_sadness_in_aimatch, UPPER(createrole_country)) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT mt_traceid, matchid, use_bytedance_ai, pvptype, real_match_type AS realpvptype_begin, blacknum, MAX(bigranklvl) AS matchranklvl, MAX(minranklvl) AS matchminlvl FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_begin WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 164, 188) AND reenter_num = 0 GROUP BY mt_traceid, matchid, use_bytedance_ai, pvptype, realpvptype_begin, blacknum) AS b ON a.mt_traceid = b.mt_traceid LEFT JOIN (SELECT mt_traceid, COUNT(DISTINCT mt_traceid) AS changenum FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_pool_change WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 164, 188) GROUP BY mt_traceid) AS c ON a.mt_traceid = c.mt_traceid GROUP BY logymd, matchid, use_bytedance_ai, pvptype, realpvptype_begin, realpvptype_end, blacknum, groupsel, matchranklvl, matchminlvl, success, interventionreason, mt_enter_sadness_type, room_is_architecture_integration, room_is_pre_enter_aisadness, cal_sadness_in_aimatch, createrole_country) AS x LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd, season, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', SUBSTRING(season_starttime, 1, 10)) + 1 AS days_index FROM mt_dim.dim_season_config WHERE '2026-05-31' >= SUBSTRING(season_starttime, 1, 10) AND '2026-05-31' <= SUBSTRING(season_endtime, 1, 10) GROUP BY logymd, season, days_index) AS y ON x.logymd = y.logymd GROUP BY y.season, y.days_index, matchid, use_bytedance_ai, pvptype, realpvptype_begin, realpvptype_end, blacknum, groupsel, matchranklvl, matchminlvl, success, interventionreason, mt_enter_sadness_type, room_is_architecture_integration, room_is_pre_enter_aisadness, cal_sadness_in_aimatch, tracenum, changenum, createrole_country

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_multi_active_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH active_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(IF(rn_desc = 1, day_last_os_language, NULL)) AS last_os_language, MAX(IF(rn_desc = 1, last_client_language, NULL)) AS last_client_language, MAX(IF(rn_desc = 1, last_os_version, NULL)) AS last_os_version, MAX(IF(rn_desc = 1, last_loginclient_version, NULL)) AS last_loginclient_version, MAX(IF(rn_desc = 1, day_last_channel, NULL)) AS last_channel /* 当日末次登录渠道 */, MAX(IF(rn_desc = 1, LEVEL, NULL)) AS last_level, SUM(day_login_cnt) AS login_cnt /* 登录次数 */, SUM(day_login_duration) AS online_dur /* 登录时长 */, MAX(CASE WHEN first_login_teamid + last_login_teamid > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_team /* 是否拥有战队  */, MAX(IF(rn_asc = 1, first_client_language, NULL)) AS first_client_language, MAX(IF(rn_asc = 1, day_first_os_language, NULL)) AS first_os_language, MAX(IF(rn_asc = 1, day_first_channel, NULL)) AS first_channel /* 当日末次登录渠道 */, MAX(IF(rn_asc = 1, first_loginclient_version, NULL)) AS first_loginclient_version, MAX(IF(rn_asc = 1, first_os_version, NULL)) AS first_os_version, MAX(IF(rn_asc = 1, min_level, NULL)) AS first_level /* 玩家等级正常只会增加，不会减小(最小即首次、最大即末次) */, MIN(day_first_active_time) AS first_active_time FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY day_first_active_time ASC, day_login_duration DESC, is_first_active DESC) AS rn_asc /* 因为存在同一时间重复上报，day_login_duration 和 is_first_active 是为了跑数据的每次取数的幂等 */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY day_last_active_time DESC, day_login_duration DESC, is_last_active DESC) AS rn_desc FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* （保存历史全部分区） */) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), basic_df_account AS (SELECT roleid, COALESCE(first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(last_ad_country, 'unknown') AS last_ad_country, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, first_network_name, IF(LOWER(first_network_name) = 'organic', 1, 0) AS is_organic FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31'), basic_df AS (/* 角色基础信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_time AS create_time, register_date AS create_date, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 AS create_days /* 注册天数 */, create_os, new_type, create_country, is_ai, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS create_channel, create_device FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31')), pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(MIN(his_first_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_first_pay_date, SUBSTRING(MAX(his_last_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_last_pay_date, SUM(product_money) AS charge_amt_total /* 历史累计付费金额 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df /* 付费全量表 （保存历史全部分区） */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), pay_di AS (/* 付费di */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', product_money, 0)) AS charge_amt, SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', product_money, 0)) AS charge_amt_30days, SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-03' AND '2026-05-31', product_money, 0)) AS charge_amt_90days FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di /* （保存历史全部分区） */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-03' AND '2026-05-31' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), currency_di AS (/* 钻石消耗&获取 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(IF(currency_type = 'diamond' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND change_reason = 'get_diamond', currency_change_num, 0)) AS add_diamond_amt, SUM(IF(currency_type = 'diamond' AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31' AND change_reason = 'get_diamond', currency_change_num, 0)) AS add_diamond_amt_30days, SUM(IF(currency_type = 'diamond' AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-03' AND '2026-05-31' AND change_reason = 'get_diamond', currency_change_num, 0)) AS add_diamond_amt_90days, SUM(IF(currency_type = 'diamond' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND change_reason = 'consume_diamond', currency_change_num, 0)) AS sub_diamond_amt, SUM(IF(currency_type = 'diamond' AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31' AND change_reason = 'consume_diamond', currency_change_num, 0)) AS sub_diamond_amt_30days, SUM(IF(currency_type = 'diamond' AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-03' AND '2026-05-31' AND change_reason = 'consume_diamond', currency_change_num, 0)) AS sub_diamond_amt_90days FROM mt_dwm.dwm_currency_role_zone_di /* （保存历史全部分区） */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-03' AND '2026-05-31' AND currency_type = 'diamond' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), battle_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4), day_max_bigranklvl, -99999)) AS day_max_bigranklvl, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4), day_max_minranklvl, -99999)) AS day_max_minranklvl, SUM(IF(pvptype = 1 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', battle_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype1_battle_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype = 2 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', battle_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype2_battle_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype = 4 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', battle_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype4_battle_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND logymd = '2026-05-31', battle_cnt, 0)) AS 5v5_battle_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype = 1 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', battle_duration, 0)) AS pvptype1_battle_dur, SUM(IF(pvptype = 2 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', battle_duration, 0)) AS pvptype2_battle_dur, SUM(IF(pvptype = 4 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', battle_duration, 0)) AS pvptype4_battle_dur, SUM(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND logymd = '2026-05-31', battle_duration, 0)) AS 5v5_battle_dur, SUM(IF(pvptype = 1 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', win_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype1_win_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype = 2 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', win_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype2_win_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype = 4 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', win_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype4_win_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND logymd = '2026-05-31', win_cnt, 0)) AS 5v5_win_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype = 1 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', black_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype1_black_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype = 2 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', black_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype2_black_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype = 4 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', black_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype4_black_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND logymd = '2026-05-31', black_cnt, 0)) AS 5v5_black_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype = 1 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', mvp_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype1_mvp_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype = 2 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', mvp_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype2_mvp_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype = 4 AND logymd = '2026-05-31', mvp_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype4_mvp_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND logymd = '2026-05-31', mvp_cnt, 0)) AS 5v5_mvp_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype = 1 AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30', battle_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype1_battle_cnt_before30d, SUM(IF(pvptype = 2 AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30', battle_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype2_battle_cnt_before30d, SUM(IF(pvptype = 4 AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30', battle_cnt, 0)) AS pvptype4_battle_cnt_before30d, SUM(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30', battle_cnt, 0)) AS 5v5_battle_cnt_before30d, SUM(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND logymd = '2026-05-31', use_wifi_cnt, 0)) AS 5v5_use_wifi_cnt, SUM(IF(pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND logymd = '2026-05-31', use_network_cnt, 0)) AS 5v5_use_network_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di /* （保存历史全部分区） */ WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-01' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), attribute_di AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, sex, born, age, job, gt1, gt2 FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_attribute_account_df /* （保存历史全部分区） */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND gt2 = 1), active_info /* recurring_di AS ( */ /*     --回流 */ /*     SELECT  roleid, */ /*             zoneid, */ /*             IF(lose_days >= 30, 1, 0) AS is_recurring_30days, */ /*             IF(lose_days >= 14, 1, 0) AS is_recurring_14days */ /*     FROM    mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_role_zone_di --（保存历史全部分区） */ /*     WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /*     AND     appid = 'mlbb' */ /*     AND     recurring_date = logymd */ /* ), */ AS (/* INSTR('010101', '1') = 2 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, 2, 7), '0', '')) AS active_days_before7d, name: 单回合棋子最高击杀数
output_hint: 单回合棋子最高击杀数
sql_units: /* 单回合棋子最高击杀数 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_ygao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-12-26 11:29:29.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH hero_info AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, enemyaccountid, battleid, round, time, chessid, chessstarlevel, chesskillnum, chessdeathtime, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundheroinfo WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_max_chesskillnum_gaoy PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAX(CASE WHEN rn1 = 1 THEN max_chess_num ELSE NULL END) AS last_battle_max_chess_num, MAX(CASE WHEN rn2 = 1 THEN max_chess_num ELSE NULL END) AS first_battle_max_chess_num, AVG(max_chess_num) AS avg_chess_num FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY max_time DESC) AS rn1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY max_time) AS rn2, max_chess_num FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, MAX(time) AS max_time, MAX(chess_num) AS max_chess_num FROM (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.round, time, COUNT(b.chessid) AS chess_num FROM (SELECT accountid, enemyaccountid, zoneid, battleid, round, time FROM hero_info GROUP BY accountid, enemyaccountid, zoneid, battleid, round, time) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, chessid, chessdeathtime FROM hero_info) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.round = b.round AND a.enemyaccountid = b.accountid WHERE NOT b.chessdeathtime IS NULL AND b.chessdeathtime <> '' GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.round, time) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid)) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid

name: 指挥官
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_ygao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-12-25 21:09:40.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH user_battle_rank AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, camprank, CASE WHEN camprank BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN '1' WHEN camprank BETWEEN 5 AND 8 THEN '0' END AS win_flag, time, commander_id, logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS battle_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time) AS battle_rn2 FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype = 39 AND camprank > 0), season_time AS (SELECT seasonid, CONCAT_WS(' ', SPLIT(seasonstarttime, '_')) AS starttime, CONCAT_WS(' ', SPLIT(seasonendtime, '_')) AS endtime, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_mcrankseason_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND '2026-05-31' BETWEEN seasonstarttime AND seasonendtime), used_commander AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, commander_id FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS a JOIN season_time AS b ON a.time BETWEEN b.starttime AND b.endtime WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-02' AND '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype = 39 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, commander_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_commander_first_gaoy PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, MAX(IF(b.commander_id IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS is_commander_first_use, MAX(CASE WHEN b.commander_id IS NULL THEN win_flag ELSE NULL END) AS is_first_use_commander_win FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, a.commander_id, battleid, win_flag FROM user_battle_rank AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a LEFT JOIN used_commander AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.commander_id = b.commander_id GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid

IN (10, 11), 1, 0)) AS is_fetter10_fetter11, MAX(IF(ralationid = 58 AND fetter_cnt >= 2, 1, 0)) AS is_relation_zero_active, COUNT(DISTINCT ralationid) AS relation_num FROM fetter_info GROUP BY name: 对局名次.阵容战力
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_ygao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-12-25 20:50:28.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH user_battle_rank AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, camprank, CASE WHEN camprank BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN '1' WHEN camprank BETWEEN 5 AND 8 THEN '0' END AS win_flag, time, commander_id, logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS battle_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time) AS battle_rn2 FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype = 39 AND camprank > 0), recent3_win_lose /* 最近3局胜负序列/最近2局对局名次 */ AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(',', is_rn3_win, is_rn2_win, is_rn1_win) AS recent3_win_lose, CONCAT_WS(',', rank_rn2, rank_rn1) AS recent2_rank FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN battle_rn = 3 THEN win_flag END) AS is_rn3_win, MAX(CASE WHEN battle_rn = 2 THEN win_flag END) AS is_rn2_win, MAX(CASE WHEN battle_rn = 1 THEN win_flag END) AS is_rn1_win, MAX(CASE WHEN battle_rn = 2 THEN camprank END) AS rank_rn2, MAX(CASE WHEN battle_rn = 1 THEN camprank END) AS rank_rn1 FROM user_battle_rank WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battle_rn <= 3 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid)), non_champ_cnt /* 不吃鸡局数/当日首局单局名次/当日最后一局单局名次 */ AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN camprank BETWEEN 2 AND 8 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS non_champ_cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN battle_rn2 = 1 THEN camprank ELSE NULL END) AS first_battle_rank, MAX(CASE WHEN battle_rn = 1 THEN camprank ELSE NULL END) AS last_battle_rank FROM user_battle_rank WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), dps_value AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN rn1 = 1 THEN dpsvalue ELSE NULL END) AS last_battle_dpsvalue, MAX(CASE WHEN rn2 = 1 THEN dpsvalue ELSE NULL END) AS first_battle_dpsvalue, AVG(dpsvalue) AS avg_dpsvalue FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time) AS rn2, dpsvalue FROM mcgg_ods.connserver_autochessenddatanew WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 39 AND zoneid < 57000 AND battlerank > 0 AND battleid <> 0 AND ailevel = 0 AND accountid = ai_accountid) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_battle_rank_dps_value_gaoy PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, recent3_win_lose, recent2_rank, non_champ_cnt, first_battle_rank, last_battle_rank, last_battle_dpsvalue, first_battle_dpsvalue, avg_dpsvalue FROM recent3_win_lose AS a LEFT JOIN non_champ_cnt AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN dps_value AS c ON a.accountid = c.accountid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid

sql_units: WITH user_battle_rank AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, camprank, CASE WHEN camprank BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN '1' WHEN camprank BETWEEN 5 AND 8 THEN '0' END AS win_flag, time, '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) AS a JOIN (SELECT battleid FROM user_battle_rank GROUP BY battleid) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid), hero_info AS (SELECT a.zoneid, a.accountid, enemyaccountid, a.battleid, round, time, chessid, chessstarlevel, chesskillnum, chessdeathtime, rn FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, enemyaccountid, battleid, round, time, chessid, chessstarlevel, chesskillnum, chessdeathtime, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundheroinfo WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) AS a JOIN (SELECT battleid FROM user_battle_rank GROUP BY battleid) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid), high_quality_round AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN rn1 = 1 THEN high_quality_round1 ELSE NULL END) AS last_battle_high_quality_round1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn2 = 1 THEN high_quality_round1 ELSE NULL END) AS first_battle_high_quality_round1, AVG(high_quality_round1) AS avg_high_quality_round1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn1 = 1 THEN high_quality_round2 ELSE NULL END) AS last_battle_high_quality_round2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn2 = 1 THEN high_quality_round2 ELSE NULL END) AS first_battle_high_quality_round2, AVG(high_quality_round2) AS avg_high_quality_round2 FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY max_time DESC) AS rn1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY max_time) AS rn2, high_quality_round1, high_quality_round2 FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, MAX(time) AS max_time, SUM(IF(rate <= 0.3, 1, 0)) AS high_quality_round1, SUM(IF(rate > 0 AND rate <= 0.3, 1, 0)) AS high_quality_round2 FROM (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.round, time, SUM(IF(chessdeathtime = '', 1, 0)) AS left_cnt, MAX(round_population) AS population_cnt, SUM(IF(chessdeathtime = '', 1, 0)) / MAX(round_population) AS rate FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, time, round_population FROM round_info GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, time, round_population) AS a JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, chessid, chessdeathtime FROM hero_info GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, chessid, chessdeathtime) AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.round = b.round GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, a.round, time) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid)) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_high_quality_round_gaoy PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT accountid, zoneid, last_battle_high_quality_round1, first_battle_high_quality_round1, avg_high_quality_round1, last_battle_high_quality_round2, first_battle_high_quality_round2, avg_high_quality_round2 FROM high_quality_round

sql_units: WITH user_battle_rank AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, camprank, CASE WHEN camprank BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN '1' WHEN camprank BETWEEN 5 AND 8 THEN '0' END AS win_flag, time, commander_id, logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS battle_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time) AS battle_rn2 FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype = 39 AND camprank > 0), round_info AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, rn, reachrelation, a.battleid, enemyaccountid, time, logymd, round, hpvalue, battleresult, round_population, relationdetail FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY round DESC) AS rn, reachrelation, battleid, enemyaccountid, time, logymd, round, hpvalue, battleresult, round_population, relationdetail FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundinfo WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND ailevel = 0) AS a JOIN (SELECT battleid FROM user_battle_rank GROUP BY battleid) AS b ON a.battleid = b.battleid), fetter_info AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(split_part, -1) AS fetter_cnt, SPLIT(split_part, ':')[0] AS relationid, battleid, time, logymd, round FROM round_info AS a LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(reachrelation, '\\073')) tmp AS split_part WHERE rn = 1 AND split_part <> ''), fetter_detail AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, time, SPLIT(SPLIT(relationdetail, '\\073')[0], ',')[1] AS relation1, SPLIT(SPLIT(relationdetail, '\\073')[1], ',')[1] AS relation2, SPLIT(SPLIT(relationdetail, '\\073')[2], ',')[1] AS relation3, SPLIT(SPLIT(relationdetail, '\\073')[3], ',')[1] AS relation4, SPLIT(SPLIT(relationdetail, '\\073')[0], ',')[2] AS layer1, SPLIT(SPLIT(relationdetail, '\\073')[1], ',')[2] AS layer2, SPLIT(SPLIT(relationdetail, '\\073')[2], ',')[2] AS layer3, SPLIT(SPLIT(relationdetail, '\\073')[3], ',')[2] AS layer4 FROM round_info WHERE rn = 1), believer_layer AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN rn1 = 1 THEN believer_layer ELSE NULL END) AS last_battle_believer_layer, MAX(CASE WHEN rn2 = 1 THEN believer_layer ELSE NULL END) AS first_battle_believer_layer, AVG(believer_layer) AS avg_believer_layer FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time) AS rn2, CASE WHEN relation1 = 55 THEN layer1 WHEN relation2 = 55 THEN layer2 WHEN relation3 = 55 THEN layer3 WHEN relation4 = 55 THEN layer4 ELSE NULL END AS believer_layer FROM fetter_detail WHERE (relation1 = 55 OR relation2 = 55 OR relation3 = 55 OR relation4 = 55)) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), seasong_layer AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN rn1 = 1 THEN seasong_layer ELSE NULL END) AS last_battle_seasong_layer, MAX(CASE WHEN rn2 = 1 THEN seasong_layer ELSE NULL END) AS first_battle_seasong_layer, AVG(seasong_layer) AS avg_seasong_layer FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time) AS rn2, CASE WHEN relation1 = 59 THEN layer1 WHEN relation2 = 59 THEN layer2 WHEN relation3 = 59 THEN layer3 WHEN relation4 = 59 THEN layer4 ELSE NULL END AS seasong_layer FROM fetter_detail WHERE (relation1 = 59 OR relation2 = 59 OR relation3 = 59 OR relation4 = 59)) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), shadow_army /* 51 暗影佣兵 */ AS (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd, accountid, zoneid, last_battle_shadow_army, first_battle_shadow_army, avg_shadow_army FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN rn1 = 1 THEN shadow_army ELSE NULL END) AS last_battle_shadow_army, MAX(CASE WHEN rn2 = 1 THEN shadow_army ELSE NULL END) AS first_battle_shadow_army, AVG(shadow_army) AS avg_shadow_army FROM (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.accountid, a.zoneid ORDER BY time) AS rn2, CASE WHEN relation1 = 51 THEN layer1 WHEN relation2 = 51 THEN layer2 WHEN relation3 = 51 THEN layer3 WHEN relation4 = 51 THEN layer4 ELSE NULL END AS shadow_army FROM fetter_detail AS a JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid FROM fetter_info WHERE relationid = 51 AND fetter_cnt >= 4 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, battleid) AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.battleid = b.battleid WHERE (relation1 = 51 OR relation2 = 51 OR relation3 = 51 OR relation4 = 51)) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid)), percentile_num AS (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd, PERCENTILE(last_battle_shadow_army, 0.3) AS last_p30, PERCENTILE(last_battle_shadow_army, 0.7) AS last_p70, PERCENTILE(first_battle_shadow_army, 0.3) AS first_p30, PERCENTILE(first_battle_shadow_army, 0.7) AS first_p70, PERCENTILE(avg_shadow_army, 0.3) AS avg_p30, PERCENTILE(avg_shadow_army, 0.7) AS avg_p70 FROM shadow_army) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_fetter_layer_gaoy PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN last_battle_believer_layer = 999 THEN '[999]' WHEN last_battle_believer_layer >= 700 THEN '[700,998)' WHEN last_battle_believer_layer >= 500 THEN '[500,700)' WHEN last_battle_believer_layer >= 300 THEN '[300,500)' WHEN last_battle_believer_layer >= 0 THEN '[0,300)' ELSE NULL END AS last_battle_believer_layer_scope, CASE WHEN first_battle_believer_layer = 999 THEN '[999]' WHEN first_battle_believer_layer >= 700 THEN '[700,998)' WHEN first_battle_believer_layer >= 500 THEN '[500,700)' WHEN first_battle_believer_layer >= 300 THEN '[300,500)' WHEN first_battle_believer_layer >= 0 THEN '[0,300)' ELSE NULL END AS first_battle_believer_layer_scope, CASE WHEN avg_believer_layer = 999 THEN '[999]' WHEN avg_believer_layer >= 700 THEN '[700,998)' WHEN avg_believer_layer >= 500 THEN '[500,700)' WHEN avg_believer_layer >= 300 THEN '[300,500)' WHEN avg_believer_layer >= 0 THEN '[0,300)' ELSE NULL END AS avg_believer_layer_scope, CASE WHEN last_battle_seasong_layer BETWEEN 70 AND 99 THEN '[70,99]' WHEN last_battle_seasong_layer >= 30 THEN '[30,70)' WHEN last_battle_seasong_layer >= 0 THEN '[0,30)' ELSE NULL END AS last_battle_seasong_layer_scope, CASE WHEN first_battle_seasong_layer BETWEEN 70 AND 99 THEN '[70,99]' WHEN first_battle_seasong_layer >= 30 THEN '[30,70)' WHEN first_battle_seasong_layer >= 0 THEN '[0,30)' ELSE NULL END AS first_battle_seasong_layer_scope, CASE WHEN avg_seasong_layer BETWEEN 70 AND 99 THEN '[70,99]' WHEN avg_seasong_layer >= 30 THEN '[30,70)' WHEN avg_seasong_layer >= 0 THEN '[0,30)' ELSE NULL END AS avg_seasong_layer_scope, CASE WHEN last_battle_shadow_army >= last_p70 THEN CONCAT('[', last_p70, '+)') WHEN last_battle_shadow_army >= last_p30 THEN CONCAT('[', last_p30, ',', last_p70, ')') WHEN last_battle_shadow_army >= 0 THEN CONCAT('[0,', last_p30, ')') ELSE NULL END AS last_battle_shadow_army_scope, CASE WHEN first_battle_shadow_army >= first_p70 THEN CONCAT('[', first_p70, '+)') WHEN first_battle_shadow_army >= first_p30 THEN CONCAT('[', first_p30, ',', first_p70, ')') WHEN first_battle_shadow_army >= 0 THEN CONCAT('[0,', first_p30, ')') ELSE NULL END AS first_battle_shadow_army_scope, CASE WHEN avg_shadow_army >= avg_p70 THEN CONCAT('[', avg_p70, '+)') WHEN avg_shadow_army >= avg_p30 THEN CONCAT('[', avg_p30, ',', avg_p70, ')') WHEN avg_shadow_army >= 0 THEN CONCAT('[0,', avg_p30, ')') ELSE NULL END AS avg_shadow_army_scope FROM (SELECT c.accountid, c.zoneid, a.last_battle_believer_layer, a.first_battle_believer_layer, a.avg_believer_layer, b.last_battle_seasong_layer, b.first_battle_seasong_layer, b.avg_seasong_layer, d.last_battle_shadow_army, d.first_battle_shadow_army, d.avg_shadow_army, f.last_p30, f.last_p70, f.first_p30, f.first_p70, f.avg_p30, f.avg_p70 FROM user_battle_rank AS c LEFT JOIN believer_layer AS a ON c.accountid = a.accountid AND c.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN seasong_layer AS b ON c.accountid = b.accountid AND c.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN shadow_army AS d ON c.accountid = d.accountid AND c.zoneid = d.zoneid LEFT JOIN percentile_num AS f ON d.logymd = f.logymd)

name: 回合胜负序列
sql_units: WITH user_battle_rank AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, camprank, CASE WHEN camprank BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN '1' WHEN camprank BETWEEN 5 AND 8 THEN '0' END AS win_flag, time, commander_id, logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS battle_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time) AS battle_rn2 FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND pvptype = 39 AND camprank > 0), round_info AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY round DESC) AS rn, reachrelation, battleid, enemyaccountid, time, logymd, round, hpvalue, battleresult, round_population, relationdetail FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundinfo WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND ailevel = 0), round_info2 AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY round DESC) AS rn, hpvalue, battleresult FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, time, hpvalue, battleresult FROM round_info UNION ALL SELECT b.accountid, b.zoneid, b.battleid, b.round, b.time, b.hpvalue, b.battleresult FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, time, hpvalue, battleresult FROM round_info) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, round, time, hpvalue, battleresult FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundinfo WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000) AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY b.accountid, b.zoneid, b.battleid, b.round, b.time, b.hpvalue, b.battleresult)), round_data AS (SELECT a.zoneid, a.accountid, a.battleid, round, b.time, rn, battleresult, hpvalue, camprank FROM round_info2 AS a JOIN user_battle_rank AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.battleid = b.battleid), battle_sequence AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, battleid, camprank, time, MAX(win_loss_sequence) AS win_loss_sequence, MAX(hp_sequence) AS hp_sequence, MAX(total_rounds) AS total_rounds FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, battleid, camprank, time, COLLECT_LIST(CAST(battleresult AS STRING)) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY round ASC) AS win_loss_sequence, COLLECT_LIST(CAST(hpvalue AS STRING)) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY round ASC) AS hp_sequence, CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN round ELSE NULL END AS total_rounds FROM round_data) GROUP BY zoneid, accountid, battleid, camprank, time), round_with_cumulative AS (SELECT rd.zoneid, rd.accountid, rd.battleid, rd.round, rd.time, rd.battleresult, rd.hpvalue, bs.win_loss_sequence, bs.hp_sequence, bs.total_rounds, rd.camprank, SUM(CASE WHEN rd.battleresult = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.zoneid, rd.accountid, rd.battleid ORDER BY rd.round ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_win, AVG(rd.round) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.zoneid, rd.accountid, rd.battleid) AS avg_round, AVG(rd.hpvalue) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.zoneid, rd.accountid, rd.battleid) AS avg_hp FROM round_data AS rd INNER JOIN battle_sequence AS bs ON rd.zoneid = bs.zoneid AND rd.accountid = bs.accountid AND rd.battleid = bs.battleid), battle_slope_components AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, battleid, round, time, win_loss_sequence, hp_sequence, total_rounds, cumulative_win, hpvalue, avg_round, avg_hp, camprank, AVG(cumulative_win) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid, battleid) AS avg_cumulative_win, (round - AVG(round) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid, battleid)) AS x_diff, (cumulative_win - AVG(cumulative_win) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid, battleid)) AS y_diff_win, (hpvalue - AVG(hpvalue) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid, battleid)) AS y_diff_hp FROM round_with_cumulative), battle_slope_calculation AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, battleid, win_loss_sequence, hp_sequence, total_rounds, camprank, time, CASE WHEN total_rounds > 1 THEN (SUM(x_diff * y_diff_win) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid, battleid)) / NULLIF(SUM(POWER(x_diff, 2)) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid, battleid), 0) ELSE NULL END AS win_loss_slope, CASE WHEN total_rounds > 1 THEN (SUM(x_diff * y_diff_hp) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid, battleid)) / NULLIF(SUM(POWER(x_diff, 2)) OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid, battleid), 0) ELSE NULL END AS hp_slope FROM battle_slope_components WHERE round = total_rounds), battle_pattern /* 趋势判断 */ AS (SELECT zoneid, accountid, battleid, time, win_loss_sequence, hp_sequence, total_rounds, win_loss_slope, hp_slope, camprank, CASE WHEN win_loss_slope > 0.1 THEN '上升趋势' WHEN win_loss_slope BETWEEN 0 AND 0.1 THEN '下降趋势' ELSE '平稳趋势' END AS win_loss_trend, CASE WHEN hp_slope < -2 THEN '血量快速下降' WHEN hp_slope < -0.5 THEN '血量缓慢下降' WHEN hp_slope < 0.5 THEN '血量平稳' WHEN hp_slope >= 0.5 THEN '血量上升' END AS hp_trend FROM battle_slope_calculation) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_battle_slope_gaoy PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT zoneid, accountid, MAX(CASE WHEN rn1 = 1 THEN win_loss_slope ELSE NULL END) AS last_battle_win_loss_slope, MAX(CASE WHEN rn1 = 1 THEN hp_slope ELSE NULL END) AS last_battle_hp_slope, MAX(CASE WHEN rn1 = 1 THEN win_loss_trend ELSE NULL END) AS last_battle_win_loss_trend, MAX(CASE WHEN rn1 = 1 THEN hp_trend ELSE NULL END) AS last_battle_hp_trend, MAX(CASE WHEN rn2 = 1 THEN win_loss_slope ELSE NULL END) AS first_battle_win_loss_slope, MAX(CASE WHEN rn2 = 1 THEN hp_slope ELSE NULL END) AS first_battle_hp_slope, MAX(CASE WHEN rn2 = 1 THEN win_loss_trend ELSE NULL END) AS first_battle_win_loss_trend, MAX(CASE WHEN rn2 = 1 THEN hp_trend ELSE NULL END) AS first_battle_hp_trend FROM (SELECT zoneid, accountid, battleid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zoneid, accountid ORDER BY time) AS rn2, win_loss_slope, hp_slope, win_loss_trend, hp_trend FROM battle_pattern) GROUP BY zoneid, accountid

Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 创建用户留存明细表 */ /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mcgg_temp.terry_user_retention_detail ( */ /*     roleid BIGINT COMMENT '角色ID', */ /*     zoneid INT COMMENT '区服ID', */ /*     user_type INT COMMENT  '用户类型：1-近30日新增用户 2-近30日回流用户 3-活跃老用户', */ /*     user_type_desc STRING COMMENT '用户类型描述', */ /*     is_retained_day1 INT COMMENT '次日是否留存：1-是 0-否', */ /*     is_retained_day6 INT COMMENT '7日是否留存：1-是 0-否' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT '用户留存明细表-用户粒度' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING) */ /* STORED AS parquet */ /* LOCATION 's3a://moonton-hadoop/user/terry/terry_user_retention_detail' */ WITH user_type_tag /* 1. 用户类型标记（新增/回流/活跃） */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN if_new = 1 THEN 1 /* 新增用户 */ WHEN return_type IN ('c.30-59', 'd.60+') THEN 2 /* 回流用户 */ ELSE 3 /* 其他（不应该出现，但保险起见） */ END AS user_type FROM mcgg_temp.vickyyu_return_4tag_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-25', 29 * -1) AND '2026-05-25' AND (if_new = 1 OR return_type IN ('c.30-59', 'd.60+'))), base_users /* 2. 基准日所有活跃用户（带类型标签） */ /* AND a.zoneid < 57000 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.roleid, a.logymd, a.zoneid, COALESCE(u.user_type, 3) AS user_type /* 没有标签的默认为3（普通活跃） */ FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login AS a LEFT JOIN user_type_tag AS u ON a.roleid = u.roleid AND a.zoneid = u.zoneid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-25'), retention_day1 /* 3. 次日留存数据 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD('2026-05-25', 1)), retention_day6 /* 4. 7日留存数据 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD('2026-05-25', 6)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.terry_user_retention_detail PARTITION(logymd) /* 5. 用户粒度明细表 */ SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, b.user_type, CASE b.user_type WHEN 1 THEN '新增用户' WHEN 2 THEN '回流用户' WHEN 3 THEN '活跃老用户' END AS user_type_desc, IF(NOT r1.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_retained_day1, IF(NOT r6.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_retained_day6, b.logymd /* 动态分区字段必须放在最后 */ FROM base_users AS b LEFT JOIN retention_day1 AS r1 ON b.roleid = r1.roleid LEFT JOIN retention_day6 AS r6 ON b.roleid = r6.roleid ORDER BY sql_units: WITH t1 AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, post_id ORDER BY like_count DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT *, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(post_created_time, 1, 19), 'T', ' ') /* 这里其实不用replace，无T */) + (8 /* 提取时区偏移小时部分（如-07） */ /* cast(substr(video_published_at, 20, 3) AS INT) * -1 + */ /* 这里啥也没有，相当于+0000 */) * 3600 /* 转为秒数 */) AS post_beijing_time /* 最终北京时间 = 原始时间 + (时区偏移绝对值 + 8小时) */, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(comment_created_time, 1, 19), 'T', ' ') /* 这里其实不用replace，无T */) + (8 /* 提取时区偏移小时部分（如-07） */ /* cast(substr(comment_published_at, 20, 3) AS INT) * -1 + */ /* 这里啥也没有，相当于+0000 */) * 3600 /* 转为秒数 */) AS comment_beijing_time FROM adbi.ods_kol_twitter_comment WHERE logymd = '2026-06-01') WHERE TO_DATE(post_beijing_time) >= DATE_ADD(logymd, 7 * -1) AND TO_DATE(post_beijing_time) <= DATE_ADD(logymd, 1 * -1) AND TO_DATE(comment_beijing_time) = DATE_ADD(logymd, 1 * -1)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwm_sentiment_official_twitter_di PARTITION(p_date = '2026-06-01', app_id) /* 静态指定分区值（dt=日期，region=地区） */ /* 目标分区表名 */ (SELECT `page_id`, `page_name`, `post_id`, `post_message`, `post_created_time`, `comment_id`, `comment_text`, `permalink_url`, `like_count`, `comments_count`, `comment_created_time`, `comment_auther_name`, `rn`, `page_type`, `comment_cnt`, comment_beijing_time, app_id FROM (SELECT t1.*, t2.page_type, t3.comment_cnt FROM t1 /* 目前twitter只有1001 */ LEFT JOIN (/* app_id配置表 */ SELECT app_id, page_id, MAX(page_type) AS page_type FROM adbi.kol_media_config WHERE date >= '1970-01-01' AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY app_id, page_id) AS t2 ON t1.page_id = t2.page_id AND t1.app_id = t2.app_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, COUNT(comment_id) AS comment_cnt /* 帖子评论数量 */ FROM t1 GROUP BY post_id) AS t3 ON t1.post_id = t3.post_id) WHERE rn <= 300 /* 筛选点赞数前300的评论 */)

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: niangangdeng@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-07-22 21:07:14.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE mcgg_dim.dim_abtest_role_zone_mapping_di( */ /*     uid                 string          COMMENT '用户唯1id', */ /*     accountid           decimal(20, 0)  COMMENT '账号id key', */ /*     zoneid              bigint          COMMENT '区服ID key', */ /*     param_name          string          COMMENT '实验名 key', */ /*     param_value         string          COMMENT '分组参数信息', */ /*     param_version       string          COMMENT '实验分组版本', */ /*     param_version_array array<string>   COMMENT 'param_version数组', */ /*     param_version_min   string          COMMENT 'param_version最小值', */ /*     first_entry_time    string          COMMENT '首次进组时间', */ /*     is_aitest           string          COMMENT '非标是1，正常是0', */ /*     source              string          COMMENT '数据源: huoshan, moonton', */ /*     appid               string          COMMENT '游戏ID: mcgg' */ /* ) COMMENT 'abtest用户用户进组映射全量表' PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* location 's3a://moonton-mcgg/table/mcgg_dim/dim_abtest_role_zone_mapping_di' */ WITH base_data AS (SELECT time, accountid, zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, source, appid, CASE WHEN source = 'moonton' AND param_value IN ('control', 'test', 'test1', 'test2', 'test3', 'test4', 'test5', 'test6', 'test7', 'test8', 'test9') THEN 0 WHEN source = 'huoshan' AND param_value LIKE '%}' AND LENGTH(REPLACE(param_value, '{', '')) = LENGTH(REPLACE(param_value, '}', '')) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_aitest FROM (SELECT time, accountid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, 'huoshan' AS source, 'mcgg' AS appid FROM mcgg_ods.abtestserver_abtest_tag /* 火山 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(old_zoneid, 0) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT time, accountid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, 'moonton' AS source, 'mcgg' AS appid FROM mcgg_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag /* 自建 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(old_zoneid, 0) > 0) AS tmp) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_dim.dim_abtest_role_zone_mapping_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(t2.uid, t3.uid) AS uid, t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.param_name, t1.param_value, t1.param_version, t5.param_version_array /* 计算火山的group：control、test、test1、test2、test3、test4、test5....test9 */, t5.param_version_min /* 计算火山的group */, t4.first_entry_time, t1.is_aitest, t1.source, t1.appid FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, source, appid, is_aitest FROM base_data GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, param_name, param_value, param_version, source, appid, is_aitest) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, uid FROM mcgg_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-07-01', '2025-07-01', '2026-05-31')) AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, MIN(uid) AS uid FROM mcgg_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-07-01', '2025-07-01', '2026-05-31') GROUP BY roleid) AS t3 ON t1.accountid = t3.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, param_name, MIN(time) AS first_entry_time FROM base_data GROUP BY accountid, param_name) AS t4 ON t1.accountid = t4.accountid AND t1.param_name = t4.param_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT param_name, COLLECT_SET(param_version) AS param_version_array, MIN(param_version) AS param_version_min FROM base_data GROUP BY param_name) AS t5 ON t1.param_name = t5.param_name

sql_units: WITH real_country_online AS (SELECT div_time, IF(country = '' OR country IS NULL OR country = '-', 'unknown', country) AS country, SUM(real_online_num) AS online_num, zone_group FROM (SELECT `TIME`, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`TIME`) DIV 300 * 300) AS div_time, LOWER(country_type) AS country, zone_id, COALESCE(online_num, 0) AS real_online_num /* 真实玩家在线人数 */, logymd, CASE WHEN FLOOR(zone_id / 10000) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN '1' /* 大推服 */ WHEN FLOOR(zone_id / 10000) = 7 THEN '2' ELSE 'unknown' END AS zone_group FROM zgame_damai_ods.connserver_t_real_country_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zone_id = 1 OR zone_id BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zone_id BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zone_id >= 70001))) GROUP BY div_time, IF(country = '' OR country IS NULL OR country = '-', 'unknown', country), zone_group), dim_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 1 AS region_type, act_geo_continent AS region FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_country) /* 取最新 */ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 0 AS region_type, region FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_zgame_country) /* 取最新 */), online_cube AS (/* 分国家和区域 */ SELECT region_type, region, country, zone_group, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, AVG(online_num) AS acu FROM (SELECT con.region_type, con.region, lin.country, lin.div_time, lin.zone_group, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_country_online AS lin LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con ON name: 新手等级达成率对比
sql_units: /* 对比新手看板 */ WITH dm_jax_newbie_di AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN register_date = '2026-05-24' THEN 'last_week' WHEN register_date = '2026-05-31' THEN 'this_week' END AS week_type FROM ml_temp.dm_jax_newbie_di AS a WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-24') AND zoneid < 50000 AND register_days = 1 AND register_date = logymd AND new_type = 3), tb_base AS (SELECT t.logymd, FLOOR((t.zoneid) / 1000) AS zone /* 大区 */, t.create_country /* 国家 */, CASE WHEN last_network_name = 'organic' THEN '自然新增' WHEN last_network_name = 'unknown' OR last_network_name IS NULL THEN '未知归因' ELSE '非自然新增' END AS last_network_type0 /* 是否自然量 */, last_network_name /* 广告来源 */, game_channel /* 商店渠道 */, week_type, t0.his_first_loginclient_version, t0.create_device, CASE WHEN FLOOR(score_1 / 100) >= 20 THEN 20 ELSE FLOOR(score_1 / 100) END AS score1_type, CASE WHEN NOT t1.roleid IS NULL THEN param_name ELSE '0' END AS is_abtest, COUNT(1) AS user_cnt, SUM(IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, 1) = 1, 1, 0)) AS new_cnt /* 当天活跃用户数，不能计算次留 */, SUM(IF(t.level >= 0, 1, 0)) AS level0_user_cnt, SUM(IF(t.level >= 1, 1, 0)) AS level1_user_cnt, SUM(IF(t.level >= 2, 1, 0)) AS level2_user_cnt /* 怀疑无3级以下用户 */, SUM(IF(t.level >= 3, 1, 0)) AS level3_user_cnt, SUM(IF(t.level >= 4, 1, 0)) AS level4_user_cnt, SUM(IF(t.level >= 5, 1, 0)) AS level5_user_cnt, SUM(IF(t.level >= 6, 1, 0)) AS level6_user_cnt, SUM(IF(t.level >= 7, 1, 0)) AS level7_user_cnt, SUM(IF(t.level >= 8, 1, 0)) AS level8_user_cnt, SUM(IF(t.level > 8, 1, 0)) AS level_over8_user_cnt FROM dm_jax_newbie_di AS t /* 主表 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, his_first_loginclient_version, create_device FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-24') AND register_date IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-24') GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, his_first_loginclient_version, create_device) AS t0 /* 补充维度 */ ON t.logymd = t0.logymd AND t.roleid = t0.roleid AND t.zoneid = t0.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, MAX(param_name) AS param_name FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, param_name FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-24') GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, param_name UNION SELECT logymd, accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, param_name FROM ml_ods.abtestserver_abtest_tag WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-05-24') GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, param_name) AS t00 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS t1 ON t.logymd = t1.logymd AND t.roleid = t1.roleid AND t.zoneid = t1.zoneid GROUP BY t.logymd, zone, t.create_country, last_network_type0, last_network_name, game_channel, week_type, his_first_loginclient_version, create_device, score1_type, is_abtest), tb_last AS (SELECT CASE WHEN NOT a.zone IS NULL THEN a.zone ELSE b.zone END AS zone, CASE WHEN NOT a.create_country IS NULL THEN a.create_country ELSE b.create_country END AS create_country, CASE WHEN NOT a.last_network_type0 IS NULL THEN a.last_network_type0 ELSE b.last_network_type0 END AS last_network_type0, CASE WHEN NOT a.last_network_name IS NULL THEN a.last_network_name ELSE b.last_network_name END AS last_network_name, CASE WHEN NOT a.game_channel IS NULL THEN a.game_channel ELSE b.game_channel END AS game_channel, CASE WHEN NOT a.his_first_loginclient_version IS NULL THEN a.his_first_loginclient_version ELSE b.his_first_loginclient_version END AS client_version, CASE WHEN NOT a.create_device IS NULL THEN a.create_device ELSE b.create_device END AS create_device, CASE WHEN NOT a.score1_type IS NULL THEN a.score1_type ELSE b.score1_type END AS score1_type, CASE WHEN NOT a.is_abtest IS NULL THEN a.is_abtest ELSE b.is_abtest END AS is_abtest, SUM(a.user_cnt) OVER () AS this_week_total_user /* 总人数 */, SUM(a.level2_user_cnt) OVER () AS this_week_totallv2_user, SUM(a.level4_user_cnt) OVER () AS this_week_totallv4_user, SUM(a.level8_user_cnt) OVER () AS this_week_totallv8_user, SUM(b.user_cnt) OVER () AS last_week_total_user, SUM(b.level2_user_cnt) OVER () AS last_week_totallv2_user, SUM(b.level4_user_cnt) OVER () AS last_week_totallv4_user, SUM(b.level8_user_cnt) OVER () AS last_week_totallv8_user, SUM(b.level_over8_user_cnt) OVER () AS last_week_totaloverlv8_user, SUM(a.user_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN NOT a.zone IS NULL THEN a.zone ELSE b.zone END) AS this_week_zone_user /* 分区总人数 */, SUM(a.level2_user_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN NOT a.zone IS NULL THEN a.zone ELSE b.zone END) AS this_week_zonelv2_user, SUM(a.level4_user_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN NOT a.zone IS NULL THEN a.zone ELSE b.zone END) AS this_week_zonelv4_user, SUM(a.level8_user_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN NOT a.zone IS NULL THEN a.zone ELSE b.zone END) AS this_week_zonelv8_user, SUM(b.user_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN NOT a.zone IS NULL THEN a.zone ELSE b.zone END) AS last_week_zone_user, SUM(b.level2_user_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN NOT a.zone IS NULL THEN a.zone ELSE b.zone END) AS last_week_zonelv2_user, SUM(b.level4_user_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN NOT a.zone IS NULL THEN a.zone ELSE b.zone END) AS last_week_zonelv4_user, SUM(b.level8_user_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN NOT a.zone IS NULL THEN a.zone ELSE b.zone END) AS last_week_zonelv8_user, a.user_cnt AS this_week_user_cnt /* a.active_logymd as this_week_active_logymd, */ /* a.register_date as this_week_date, */ /* a.week_type as this_week_type, */, a.level2_user_cnt AS this_week_level2_user_cnt, a.level4_user_cnt AS this_week_level4_user_cnt, a.level8_user_cnt AS this_week_level8_user_cnt, b.user_cnt AS last_week_user_cnt /* b.active_logymd as last_week_active_logymd, */ /* -- b.register_date as last_week_date, */ /* b.week_type as last_week_type, */, b.level2_user_cnt AS last_week_level2_user_cnt, b.level4_user_cnt AS last_week_level4_user_cnt, b.level8_user_cnt AS last_week_level8_user_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM tb_base WHERE week_type = 'this_week') AS a FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM tb_base WHERE week_type = 'last_week') AS b ON a.zone = b.zone AND a.create_country = b.create_country AND a.last_network_type0 = b.last_network_type0 AND a.last_network_name = b.last_network_name AND a.game_channel = b.game_channel AND a.his_first_loginclient_version = b.his_first_loginclient_version AND a.create_device = b.create_device AND a.score1_type = b.score1_type AND a.is_abtest = b.is_abtest) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.kyra_mlbb_newuser_level PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT zone, create_country, last_network_type0, last_network_name, game_channel, client_version, create_device, score1_type, is_abtest, this_week_total_user, this_week_totallv2_user, this_week_totallv4_user, this_week_totallv8_user, last_week_total_user, last_week_totallv2_user, last_week_totallv4_user, last_week_totallv8_user, last_week_totaloverlv8_user, this_week_zone_user, this_week_zonelv2_user, this_week_zonelv4_user, this_week_zonelv8_user, last_week_zone_user, last_week_zonelv2_user, last_week_zonelv4_user, last_week_zonelv8_user, this_week_user_cnt, this_week_level2_user_cnt, this_week_level4_user_cnt, this_week_level8_user_cnt, last_week_user_cnt, last_week_level2_user_cnt, last_week_level4_user_cnt, last_week_level8_user_cnt FROM tb_last

YEAR(register_date)) * 12 + CAST(SUBSTRING(logymd_month, 6, 2) AS INT) - MONTH(register_date)) BETWEEN 0 AND 23 GROUP BY logymd) AS wfb ON bu.logymd = wfb.logymd UNION ALL /* 50美金档 */ SELECT charge_num_fenceng, con_users, wf_con_users FROM (SELECT logymd, charge_num_fenceng, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS con_users FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, logymd_month, COALESCE(charge_num_fenceng, -1) AS charge_num_fenceng FROM ml_temp.leolv_mau_pay_break_mi WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(charge_num_fenceng, -1) = 50 AND COALESCE(charge_num_fenceng, -1) = COALESCE(max_fenceng_before, -1) AND zoneid < 57000) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_ai = 0) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE ((CAST(SUBSTRING(logymd_month, 0, 4) AS INT) - YEAR(register_date)) * 12 + CAST(SUBSTRING(logymd_month, 6, 2) AS INT) - MONTH(register_date)) BETWEEN 0 AND 29 GROUP BY logymd, charge_num_fenceng) AS bu LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS wf_con_users FROM (SELECT logymd, logymd_month, roleid, zoneid FROM ml_temp.leolv_mau_pay_break_mi WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(max_fenceng_before, -1) = 50) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_ai = 0) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE ((CAST(SUBSTRING(logymd_month, 0, 4) AS INT) - YEAR(register_date)) * 12 + CAST(SUBSTRING(logymd_month, 6, 2) AS INT) - MONTH(register_date)) BETWEEN 0 AND 29 GROUP BY logymd) AS wfb ON bu.logymd = wfb.logymd

sql_units: WITH device_account_df AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(a.bind_wa_id, 4) AS waid /* bind_mlbb_roleid, */ /* b.device_id, */ /* a.bind_wa_id, */ /* b.accountid, */ /* c.device_id, */, COALESCE(c.accountid, a.bind_mlbb_roleid) AS relate_roleid FROM (SELECT bind_mlbb_roleid, bind_wa_id FROM mt_dim.dim_third_party_mpass_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND LOWER(bind_wa_id) LIKE 'wa%' AND NOT bind_mlbb_roleid IS NULL AND NOT bind_wa_id IS NULL) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT device_id, accountid FROM adbi.dim_device_account_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND NOT device_id IN ('', 'none', 'null', 'unknown', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', '0000-0000', '0000000000000000', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000') AND NOT device_id IS NULL) AS b ON a.bind_mlbb_roleid = b.accountid LEFT JOIN (SELECT device_id, accountid FROM adbi.dim_device_account_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND NOT device_id IN ('', 'none', 'null', 'unknown', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', '0000-0000', '0000000000000000', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000') AND NOT device_id IS NULL) AS c ON b.device_id = c.device_id GROUP BY SUBSTRING(a.bind_wa_id, 4), COALESCE(c.accountid, a.bind_mlbb_roleid)), account_bind_hi AS (SELECT roleid, waid FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, SUBSTRING(account_name, 4) AS waid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY TIME DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_bind WHERE logymd <= '2026-06-01' AND logymd > '1970-01-01' AND /* ((logymd >= '2026-06-01' AND HOUR(`time`) <=  22) OR logymd = '2026-05-31') */ LOWER(account_name) LIKE 'wa%') AS a WHERE rn = 1), waid_device_account_df_hi AS (SELECT waid, roleid FROM (SELECT waid, relate_roleid AS roleid /* device_id   AS deviceid, */ FROM device_account_df UNION ALL SELECT waid, roleid /* cur_deviceid AS deviceid, */ FROM account_bind_hi) AS t1 GROUP BY waid, roleid), role_zone_login_hi AS (SELECT COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(di.last_active_time, df.his_last_active_time) AS his_last_active_time /* 算当天 */, COALESCE(di.last_1d_active_time, df.his_last_active_time) AS his_last_1d_active_time /* 剔除当天：前一个登录日期 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN total_rn = 1 THEN `time` END) AS last_active_time, MAX(CASE WHEN logymd_rn = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(`time`, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31' THEN `time` END) AS last_1d_active_time /* 最新登录日期-前一个登录日期（同日期继续往前找，不可用同一日期） */ /* time 是时间戳类型: Leap FROM_UNIXTIME 函数是UTC-0, 需要转UTC-8 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, `time`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY `time` DESC, client_ip, os_type, device) AS total_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, logymd ORDER BY `time` DESC, client_ip, os_type, device) AS logymd_rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd /* ((logymd >= '2026-06-01' AND HOUR(`time`) <=  22 ) */ /* OR logymd = '2026-05-31') */ BETWEEN '2026-05-31' AND '2026-06-01') WHERE total_rn = 1 OR logymd_rn = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid), role_zone_basic_df_hi AS (SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(di.role_register_date, df.role_register_date) AS role_register_date, COALESCE(di.account_register_date, df_acc.account_register_date) AS account_register_date FROM (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.role_register_date, t2.logymd AS account_register_date FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(usercreateymd) AS role_register_date FROM ml_ods.gameserver_create_role WHERE logymd /* (logymd >= '2026-06-01' AND HOUR(`time`) <=  22 ) */ /* OR logymd = '2026-05-31' */ BETWEEN '2026-05-31' AND '2026-06-01' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, MIN(logymd) AS logymd FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd /* (logymd >= '2026-06-01' AND HOUR(`time`) <=  22 ) */ /* OR logymd = '2026-05-31' */ BETWEEN '2026-05-31' AND '2026-06-01' GROUP BY accountid) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.accountid) AS di FULL JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date AS role_register_date /* account_register_date */ FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, COALESCE(MIN(account_register_date), MIN(register_date)) AS account_register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY roleid) AS df_acc ON COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) = df_acc.roleid), change_name_hi AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, cur_name, change_time FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, cur_name, DATE_FORMAT(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS change_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_change_name WHERE logymd /* (logymd >= '2026-06-01' AND HOUR(`time`) <=  22 ) */ /* OR logymd = '2026-05-31' */ BETWEEN '2026-05-31' AND '2026-06-01') WHERE rn = 1), change_name_df_hi AS (SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(b.cur_name, a.cur_name) AS cur_name, COALESCE(b.change_time, a.change_time) AS change_time FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, cur_name, change_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_role_zone_change_name_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS a FULL JOIN change_name_hi AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_mkt_operation_launch_whatsapp_hi PARTITION(logymd = '2026-06-01', hour = 22) SELECT a.waid, a.roleid /* a.deviceid, */, b.zoneid, c.his_last_active_time, b.role_register_date, b.account_register_date, DATEDIFF('2026-06-01', c.his_last_1d_active_time) AS lose_days, d.cur_name FROM waid_device_account_df_hi AS a JOIN role_zone_basic_df_hi AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid LEFT JOIN role_zone_login_hi AS c ON b.roleid = c.roleid AND b.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN change_name_df_hi AS d ON b.roleid = d.roleid AND b.zoneid = d.zoneid

1) <= 12 AND war_stage >= 10605 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS stage10605_d12, CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', usercreateymd) + 1) <= 14 AND war_stage >= 10704 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS stage10704_d14, CASE WHEN name: 2.dim_vp_ab_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: achingzhu@moonton.com */ /* Description: VP AB分组（V1~V3通用，滚动30天去重） */ /* Changes from V3: */ /*   1. 左表改为「当日互关」：被VP回关 + 回关了VP（排除VP单向主动关注） */ /*   2. 关联不到VP对局的实验组独立标记为「实验组_无对局」 */ /*   3. 滚动30天去重：以首次进实验组为准（对照组→实验组允许升级） */ /*   4. vp_create_date 仅记录不过滤 */ /*   5. exp_name 按日期自动判定 V1~V3 */ /*   6. 所有字段取确定性单行（ROW_NUMBER），而非 MAX/MIN 聚合 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 近两天对局 */ WITH battle AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, blacknum, wincamp /* 0=失败 1=胜利（同阵营=同胜负） */, fake_ai, channel, createrole_country FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000), vp_ids /* VP标识 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, createrole_country FROM mt_da.dim_vp_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000), treatment_src /* 当日互关事件（is_focused=1 即回关） */ /* A: 被VP回关（VP是actor） B: 玩家回关VP（玩家是actor，dest是VP） */ AS (/* A: 被VP回关（VP是actor，关联vp_ids取创角日期和国家） */ SELECT f.dest_roleid AS roleid, f.dest_zone AS zoneid, '实验组_RP主动' AS ab_group, v.usercreateymd AS vp_create_date, v.createrole_country AS vp_country FROM ml_ods.gameserver_friend_focus_player AS f INNER JOIN vp_ids AS v ON f.roleid = v.roleid AND f.zoneid = v.zoneid WHERE f.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND f.zoneid < 57000 AND f.is_delete = 0 AND f.is_focused = 1 AND f.channel = 'and_mtvp_P4t53llkT' UNION ALL /* B: 回关了VP（玩家是actor，dest是VP） */ SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, '实验组_VP主动' AS ab_group, v.usercreateymd AS vp_create_date, v.createrole_country AS vp_country FROM ml_ods.gameserver_friend_focus_player AS f INNER JOIN vp_ids AS v ON f.dest_roleid = v.roleid AND f.dest_zone = v.zoneid WHERE f.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND f.zoneid < 57000 AND f.is_delete = 0 AND f.is_focused = 1 AND f.channel <> 'and_mtvp_P4t53llkT'), treatment_raw /* 同一玩家同时被VP回关 + 回关VP → 优先取被VP回关 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ab_group, vp_create_date, vp_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY CASE WHEN ab_group = '实验组_RP主动' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS rn FROM treatment_src), treatment AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ab_group, vp_create_date, vp_country FROM treatment_raw WHERE rn = 1), vp_battle_raw /* VP参与的对局及VP胜负（每场对局取一个VP记录） */ AS (SELECT battleid, wincamp AS vp_wincamp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY battleid ORDER BY roleid DESC /* 多VP时优先取最新VP */) AS rn FROM battle WHERE fake_ai = 2 AND channel = 'and_mtvp_P4t53llkT'), vp_battle AS (SELECT battleid, vp_wincamp FROM vp_battle_raw WHERE rn = 1), treatment_camp_raw /* 实验组玩家在VP对局中的阵营与胜负（每个阵营取一条treatment记录） */ AS (SELECT a.battleid, a.wincamp /* 被关注玩家的胜负 */, v.vp_wincamp /* VP的胜负 */, b.vp_create_date, b.vp_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.battleid, a.wincamp ORDER BY b.vp_create_date DESC) AS rn FROM battle AS a INNER JOIN treatment AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid INNER JOIN vp_battle AS v ON a.battleid = v.battleid WHERE a.fake_ai = 0), treatment_camp AS (SELECT battleid, wincamp, vp_wincamp, vp_create_date, vp_country FROM treatment_camp_raw WHERE rn = 1), enter_group_raw /* 与实验组同阵营的全部真人玩家 → 取首场VP对局信息 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, tc.vp_country AS createrole_country, tc.vp_create_date, a.blacknum AS black_num, a.wincamp AS is_win, IF(a.wincamp = tc.vp_wincamp, 1, 0) AS is_same_camp_as_vp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.roleid, a.zoneid ORDER BY a.battleid /* 取最早的VP对局 */) AS rn FROM battle AS a INNER JOIN treatment_camp AS tc ON a.battleid = tc.battleid AND a.wincamp = tc.wincamp WHERE a.fake_ai = 0), enter_group AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, createrole_country, vp_create_date, black_num, is_win, is_same_camp_as_vp FROM enter_group_raw WHERE rn = 1), already_in /* 滚动30天历史：标记是否曾进入实验组（仅在同一 exp_name 内部去重） */ /* （布尔聚合：只需判断"是否存在实验组记录"，非选行场景，保留 MAX） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(IF(ab_group <> '对照组', 1, 0)) AS was_treatment FROM mt_da.dim_vp_ab_di WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 30 * -1) AND logymd < '2026-05-31' AND exp_name = CASE WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2026-03-09' THEN '长期放量' WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2026-01-15' THEN 'V3' WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2025-10-20' THEN 'V2' WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2025-09-27' THEN 'V1' END GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_da.dim_vp_ab_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 实验组：当天与VP互关 且 近30天未进过实验组 */ /* 有VP对局 → 保留原ab_group；无VP对局 → 实验组_无对局 */ SELECT t.roleid, t.zoneid, CASE WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2026-03-09' THEN '长期放量' WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2026-01-15' THEN 'V3' WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2025-10-20' THEN 'V2' WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2025-09-27' THEN 'V1' END AS exp_name, CASE WHEN e.roleid IS NULL THEN '实验组_其他来源' ELSE t.ab_group END AS ab_group, t.vp_create_date, t.vp_country AS createrole_country, e.black_num, e.is_win, e.is_same_camp_as_vp FROM treatment AS t LEFT JOIN enter_group AS e ON t.roleid = e.roleid AND t.zoneid = e.zoneid LEFT JOIN already_in AS h ON t.roleid = h.roleid AND t.zoneid = h.zoneid WHERE h.roleid IS NULL /* 历史无记录 → 新玩家，直接进 */ OR h.was_treatment = 0 /* 历史只当过对照组 → 允许升级为实验组 */ UNION ALL /* 对照组：与实验组同阵营但未与VP互关 且 近30天未进过任何组 */ SELECT c.roleid, c.zoneid, CASE WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2026-03-09' THEN '长期放量' WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2026-01-15' THEN 'V3' WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2025-10-20' THEN 'V2' WHEN '2026-05-31' >= '2025-09-27' THEN 'V1' END AS exp_name, '对照组' AS ab_group, c.vp_create_date, c.createrole_country, c.black_num, c.is_win, c.is_same_camp_as_vp FROM enter_group AS c LEFT JOIN treatment AS t ON c.roleid = t.roleid AND c.zoneid = t.zoneid LEFT JOIN already_in AS h ON c.roleid = h.roleid AND c.zoneid = h.zoneid WHERE t.roleid IS NULL /* 今天没与VP互关（排除今日实验组） */ AND h.roleid IS NULL /* 近30天完全没进过组 */ /* ab_group 枚举值： */ /*   实验组_被VP回关  （VP回关了玩家，有VP对局） */ /*   实验组_回关VP    （玩家回关了VP，有VP对局） */ /*   实验组_无对局    （与VP互关但近两天无VP对局记录） */ /*   对照组 */ /* 表结构变更（需提前执行）： */ /* ALTER TABLE mt_da.dim_vp_ab_di ADD COLUMNS ( */ /*     createrole_country STRING COMMENT '创角国家', */ /*     black_num INT COMMENT '进组对局房型', */ /*     is_win INT COMMENT '进组对局是否胜利（0失败1胜利）', */ /*     is_same_camp_as_vp INT COMMENT '进组时是否与VP同阵营（0对面1同阵营）' */ /* ); */ /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_da.dim_vp_ab_di ( */ /*     roleid DECIMAL(20,0) COMMENT '角色ID', */ /*     zoneid BIGINT COMMENT '区服ID', */ /*     exp_name STRING COMMENT 'VP伪ab实验名', */ /*     ab_group STRING COMMENT '实验分组：实验组_被VP回关/实验组_回关VP/实验组_无对局/对照组' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT 'VP实验统一表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '分区日期') */ /* ROW FORMAT SERDE */ /*     'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe' */ /* STORED AS INPUTFORMAT */ /*     'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.MapredParquetInputFormat' */ /* OUTPUTFORMAT */ /*     'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.MapredParquetOutputFormat'; */

1, war_stage, NULL)) AS war_stage, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, role_level, NULL)) AS role_level, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS last_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, WHEN 2 THEN 'android' WHEN 3 THEN 'other' ELSE 'unknown' END AS os_name, create_country, create_ip_country, data_source, IF(zoneid >= 10000, 1, 0) AS zone_type FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY source_order ASC, register_time ASC, zoneid ASC /* 同一时间创角的取区分小的 */) AS row_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, usercreateymd AS register_date, usercreatetime AS register_time, did, login_ip AS create_ip, login_channel AS create_channel, login_sub_channel AS create_sub_channel, login_os_type AS os_type, LOWER(createrole_country) AS '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, usercreateymd AS register_date, usercreatetime AS register_time, did, login_ip AS create_ip, login_channel AS create_channel, create_ip_country, 'login' AS data_source, 2 AS source_order FROM w2_cbt1_260122.login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, usercreateymd AS register_date, usercreatetime AS register_time, did, login_ip AS create_ip, login_channel AS create_channel, login_sub_channel AS create_sub_channel, login_os_type AS os_type, LOWER(createrole_country) AS create_country, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202508', '202508', '202605'))) AS create_ip_country, 'charge' AS data_source, 3 AS source_order FROM w2_cbt1_260122.charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31')) WHERE row_num = 1), df_yd AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, did, register_time, register_date, create_ip, create_channel, create_sub_channel, os_type, os_name, create_country, first_mt_country, first_network_name, create_ip_country, data_source, is_first_create, zone_type, is_cur_bot, is_init_bot FROM wefly2_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE wefly2_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'wefly2') SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.account_name, t0.did, SUBSTRING(t0.register_time, 1, 19) AS register_time, t0.register_date, t0.create_ip, t0.create_channel, t0.create_sub_channel, t0.os_type, t0.os_name, t0.create_country, t0.create_ip_country, t0.first_mt_country, t0.first_network_name, IF(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.roleid ORDER BY t0.register_time, t0.zoneid ASC) = 1, 1, 0) AS is_first_create, t0.data_source, t0.zone_type, 0 AS is_cur_bot, 0 AS is_init_bot, IF(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.roleid ORDER BY t0.formal_ord DESC, t0.register_time ASC, t0.zoneid ASC) = 1 AND t0.formal_ord = 1, 1, 0) AS is_formal_first_create /* 是否正式服下首个创角   */ FROM (SELECT COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(df.account_name, di.account_name) AS account_name, COALESCE(df.did, di.did) AS did, COALESCE(df.register_time, di.register_time) AS register_time, COALESCE(df.register_date, di.register_date) AS register_date, COALESCE(df.create_ip, di.create_ip) AS create_ip, COALESCE(df.create_channel, di.create_channel) AS create_channel, COALESCE(df.create_sub_channel, di.create_sub_channel) AS create_sub_channel, COALESCE(df.os_type, di.os_type) AS os_type, COALESCE(df.os_name, di.os_name) AS os_name, COALESCE(df.create_country, di.create_country) AS create_country, COALESCE(df.create_ip_country, di.create_ip_country) AS create_ip_country, COALESCE(df.first_mt_country, di.first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(df.first_network_name, di.first_network_name) AS first_network_name, COALESCE(df.is_first_create, di.is_first_create, 1) AS is_first_create, COALESCE(df.data_source, di.data_source) AS data_source, COALESCE(df.zone_type, di.zone_type) AS zone_type, IF(COALESCE(df.zone_type, di.zone_type) = 1, 1, -99999) AS formal_ord, df.is_cur_bot, df.is_init_bot FROM df_yd AS df FULL JOIN (SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.account_name, t0.did, t0.register_time, t0.register_date, t0.create_ip, t0.create_channel, t0.create_sub_channel, t0.os_type, t0.os_name, t0.create_country, t0.create_ip_country, t0.data_source, 'unknown' AS first_mt_country, 'unknown' AS first_network_name, 1 AS is_first_create, t0.zone_type FROM install_user_reduce AS t0) AS di ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid) AS t0

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwd_wefly_cpe_feature_level_di PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') /* 静态指定分区值（dt=日期） */ /* 目标分区表名 */ (SELECT m__did, m__idfa, m__idfv, m__android_id, m__gps_adid, m__role_id, create_country, usercreateymd, role_level, CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', usercreateymd) + 1) <= 1 AND role_level >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS level10_d1, CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', usercreateymd) + 1) <= 2 AND role_level >= 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS level13_d2, CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', usercreateymd) + 1) <= 3 AND role_level >= 16 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS level16_d3, CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', usercreateymd) + 1) <= 5 AND role_level >= 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS level20_d5, CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', usercreateymd) + 1) <= 7 AND role_level >= 22 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS level22_d7 FROM (/* 按照每日末条event记录进行判定 */ SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m__did, m__role_id ORDER BY m__event_time DESC) AS rn FROM wefly_ob_ods.add_level WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 14号去处理13号的分区 */ AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', usercreateymd) + 1) <= 7 AND m__package_name <> 'com.vizta.weflyam' /* 排除美国包 */) WHERE rn = 1))

name: dwm_team_size_active_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: achingzhu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-01-19 16:08:36.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 统计所有战队活跃奖励每周进度及战队人数分布 */ /* 数据源：ml_ods.gameserver_team_weekly_active */ WITH team_active AS (SELECT roleid /* 角色ID */, zoneid /* 分区ID */, teamid /* 战队ID */, newactive /* 个人本周活跃度 */, newtotalactive /* 本周总活跃度 */, leader_id /* 队长id */, leader_zone /* 队长区服 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_team_weekly_active WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT teamid IS NULL AND teamid > 0), team_mem /* 战队人数表（取每个战队任一成员的memsize即可） */ AS (SELECT teamid, MAX(memsize) AS team_size /* 战队人数 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_team_weekly_mem WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT teamid IS NULL AND teamid > 0 GROUP BY teamid), vp_dim /* VP账号维表（当天快照） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_da.dim_vp_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_da.team_active_vp_stats_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t.teamid, tm.team_size /* 战队人数 */, MAX(t.newtotalactive) AS team_total_active /* 战队本周总活跃度 */, CASE WHEN MAX(t.newtotalactive) >= 15000 THEN 4 WHEN MAX(t.newtotalactive) >= 7500 THEN 3 WHEN MAX(t.newtotalactive) >= 3000 THEN 2 WHEN MAX(t.newtotalactive) >= 1500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS team_active_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.roleid IS NULL THEN t.roleid END) AS real_count /* 真人活跃度（非VP成员） */ /* 真人人数 */, SUM(CASE WHEN v.roleid IS NULL THEN t.newactive ELSE 0 END) AS real_active /* 真人贡献活跃度 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT v.roleid IS NULL THEN t.roleid END) AS vp_count /* VP活跃度 */ /* VP人数 */, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT v.roleid IS NULL THEN t.newactive ELSE 0 END) AS vp_active /* VP贡献活跃度 */, MAX(CASE WHEN v.roleid = t.leader_id AND v.zoneid = t.leader_zone THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS leader_is_vp /* 队长是否VP（队长roleid=leader_id且zoneid=leader_zone，再判断是否在vp_dim中） */ FROM team_active AS t LEFT JOIN team_mem AS tm ON t.teamid = tm.teamid LEFT JOIN vp_dim AS v ON t.roleid = v.roleid AND t.zoneid = v.zoneid GROUP BY t.teamid, tm.team_size

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_web_page_performance_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT project, event_name, CASE WHEN event_name = '__fp__' THEN 'fp' WHEN event_name = '__fsp__' THEN 'fsp' WHEN event_name = '__domComplete__' THEN 'domComplete' ELSE event_name END AS perf_type /* 提取性能类型 */, COUNT(1) AS sample_cnt /* 计算性能指标 */, AVG(performance_data) AS perf_avg, APPROX_PERCENTILE(performance_data, 0.5) AS perf_p50, APPROX_PERCENTILE(performance_data, 0.75) AS perf_p75, APPROX_PERCENTILE(performance_data, 0.9) AS perf_p90 FROM (SELECT project, logymd, GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.event_name') AS event_name, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.parameter.data') AS DOUBLE) AS performance_data FROM mtwb_ods.webreportserver_track_event WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.event_name') IN ('__fp__', '__fsp__', '__domComplete__') AND NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.parameter.data') IS NULL AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.parameter.data') <> '') AS t WHERE NOT performance_data IS NULL GROUP BY project, event_name

name: 每天的淘汰玩家人数
sql_units: WITH round_info AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY round DESC) AS rn, reachrelation, battleid, enemyaccountid, time, logymd, round, hpvalue, battleresult, round_population, relationdetail FROM mcgg_ods.battleserver_client_magicchessroundinfo WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mcgg_aimatch_beated_players PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.battleid) AS batcnt, COUNT(DISTINCT b.accountid) AS defeated_player_num FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, enemyaccountid, round, time, battleresult FROM round_info) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, enemyaccountid, round, battleresult, hpvalue FROM round_info) AS b ON a.enemyaccountid = b.accountid AND a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.round = b.round WHERE a.battleresult = 1 AND b.battleresult = 0 AND b.hpvalue = 0 GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid

name: 泛刷号识别
sql_units: /* with sample as ( */ /* select */ /*     accountid, */ /*     create_account_date, */ /*     create_account_ip ip, */ /*     create_account_device device, */ /*     create_account_os_type os_type, */ /*     min_by(normal_campaign_init, create_account_time) stage */ /* from zgame_dm.dm_zgame_behavior_feature_role_zone_df */ /* -- where logymd <= '2026-01-20' */ /* where logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /* and create_account_date = logymd */ /* group by accountid, create_account_date, create_account_ip, create_account_device, create_account_os_type */ /* ), */ WITH sample AS (SELECT a.*, COALESCE(b.normal_campaign_init, 0) AS stage FROM (SELECT accountid, logymd AS create_account_date, ip, device, os_type FROM zgame_dwd.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_id IN (1001061, 1001062) THEN 1001006 WHEN stage_id IN (1001091, 1001092) THEN 1001009 ELSE stage_id END) AS normal_campaign_init FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_fight_pve WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND FLOOR(stage_id / 100000) = 10 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.create_account_date = b.logymd), feature_ip_device /* ip的设备特征 */ AS (SELECT create_account_date, ip, COUNT(*) AS ip_device_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS ip_cnt, ROUND(SUM(IF(rn <= 3, cnt, 0)) * 1.00000 / SUM(cnt), 6) AS ip_top_3_device_prop FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY create_account_date, ip ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT create_account_date, ip, device, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sample AS a GROUP BY create_account_date, ip, device) AS a1) AS a GROUP BY create_account_date, ip), feature_ip_stage /* ip的关卡特征 */ AS (SELECT create_account_date, ip, COUNT(*) AS ip_stage_cnt, ROUND(SUM(IF(rn <= 3, cnt, 0)) * 1.000000 / SUM(cnt), 6) AS ip_top_3_stage_prop FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY create_account_date, ip ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT create_account_date, ip, stage, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sample AS a GROUP BY create_account_date, ip, stage) AS a1) AS a GROUP BY create_account_date, ip), feature_device_stage /* 设备的关卡特征 */ AS (SELECT create_account_date, device, COUNT(*) AS device_stage_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS device_cnt, ROUND(SUM(IF(rn <= 3, cnt, 0)) * 1.000000 / SUM(cnt), 6) AS device_top_3_stage_prop FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY create_account_date, device ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT create_account_date, device, stage, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sample AS a GROUP BY create_account_date, device, stage) AS a1) AS a GROUP BY create_account_date, device) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE zg_temp.bot_user_detection PARTITION(create_account_date) SELECT a.accountid, a.ip, a.device, a.os_type, a.stage, ip_cnt, device_cnt, ip_top_3_device_prop, ip_top_3_stage_prop, device_top_3_stage_prop, IF(ip_cnt >= 5 AND ip_top_3_device_prop > 0.8, 1, 0) AS deter_1, IF(ip_cnt >= 5 AND ip_top_3_stage_prop > 0.8, 1, 0) AS deter_2, IF(device_cnt >= 10 AND device_top_3_stage_prop > 0.8, 1, 0) AS deter_3, CASE WHEN ip_cnt >= 5 AND ip_top_3_device_prop > 0.8 THEN 1 WHEN ip_cnt >= 5 AND ip_top_3_stage_prop > 0.8 THEN 1 WHEN device_cnt >= 10 AND device_top_3_stage_prop > 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS deter, a.create_account_date FROM sample AS a LEFT JOIN feature_ip_device AS b ON a.ip = b.ip AND a.create_account_date = b.create_account_date LEFT JOIN feature_ip_stage AS c ON a.ip = c.ip AND a.create_account_date = c.create_account_date LEFT JOIN feature_device_stage AS d ON a.device = d.device AND a.create_account_date = d.create_account_date
