sql_units: WITH union_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX_BY(region_id, TIME) AS region_id, MAX_BY(union_id, TIME) AS union_id, MAX_BY(union_name, time) AS union_name FROM (SELECT logymd, TIME, union_id, union_name, region_id, SPLIT(joinner, '-')[1] AS roleid, SPLIT(joinner, '-')[0] AS zoneid FROM zgame_dwd.unionserver_union_join WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND NOT (CAST(SPLIT(joinner, '-')[0] AS BIGINT) >= 70001 AND logymd < '2024-03-27') UNION ALL SELECT logymd, TIME, NULL AS union_id, NULL AS union_name, region_id, SPLIT(quiter, '-')[1] AS roleid, SPLIT(quiter, '-')[0] AS zoneid FROM zgame_dwd.unionserver_union_quit WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND NOT (CAST(SPLIT(quiter, '-')[0] AS BIGINT) >= 70001 AND logymd < '2024-03-27')) AS a GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), level_info AS (SELECT union_id, region_id, MAX_BY(union_level, TIME) AS union_level FROM zgame_dwd.unionserver_union_recal WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY union_id, region_id), division_info AS (SELECT union_id, region_id, MAX_BY(division, TIME) AS union_division FROM zgame_dwd.unionserver_gvg_match_settle WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY union_id, region_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE zgame_dwm.dwm_zgame_union_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, t0.union_id, union_level, union_division, union_name, t0.region_id AS union_region_id FROM union_info AS t0 LEFT JOIN level_info AS t1 ON t0.union_id = t1.union_id AND t0.region_id = t1.region_id LEFT JOIN division_info AS t2 ON t0.union_id = t2.union_id AND t0.region_id = t2.region_id

name: etl.zgame_dwm.dwm_zgame_resource_role_zone_df
sql_units: WITH hero_legend_gallery AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.baseid, a.hero_quality, COALESCE(awakening_star, 0) AS awakening_star FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, baseid, hero_quality FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_hero_add WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND hero_quality IN (4, 5) AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND operate <> 'Hero_HeroReset' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, baseid, hero_quality) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, hero_basid, MAX(cur_unlock_num) AS awakening_star FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_add_hero_awakening WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, hero_basid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.baseid = b.hero_basid), soldier_info AS (SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(a.soldier_id, b.soldier_id) AS soldier_id, COALESCE(a.max_level, 1) AS max_level FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, soldier_id, MAX(cur_level) AS max_level FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_soldier_up_level WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) /* and soldier_id is not null */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, soldier_id) AS a FULL JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(soldier_id AS BIGINT) AS soldier_id FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, soldier_id FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_add_soldier LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(soldier_list, ',')) AS soldier_id WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001))) AS b_1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, soldier_id) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND a.soldier_id = b.soldier_id WHERE NOT COALESCE(a.soldier_id, b.soldier_id) IS NULL), role_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAP_MERGE(day_item_add) AS item_balance_end FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, day_item_add FROM zgame_dwm.dwm_zgame_resource_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_balance_end FROM zgame_dwm.dwm_zgame_resource_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS a GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE zgame_dwm.dwm_zgame_resource_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, hero_legend_gallery, hero_eipc_gallery, item_balance_end, demon_soldier_gallery FROM role_info AS t0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', baseid, awakening_star))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS hero_eipc_gallery FROM hero_legend_gallery WHERE hero_quality = 4 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 ON t1.roleid = t0.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t0.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', baseid, awakening_star))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS hero_legend_gallery FROM hero_legend_gallery WHERE hero_quality = 5 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t2 ON t2.roleid = t0.roleid AND t2.zoneid = t0.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', soldier_id, COALESCE(max_level, 0)))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS demon_soldier_gallery FROM soldier_info GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t3 ON t3.roleid = t0.roleid AND t3.zoneid = t0.zoneid

name: etl.zgame_dim.dim_zgame_basic_account_df
sql_units: WITH os_info AS (SELECT roleid, logymd FROM zgame_dwd.t_client_performance_systeminfo WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd <= '2023-08-24' GROUP BY roleid, logymd HAVING MIN_BY(mulator, TIME) = 1), device_info AS (SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.device_level, b.device_level) AS device_level FROM (SELECT roleid, MIN_BY(quality_category_default, TIME) AS device_level FROM zgame_dwd.t_client_performance_systeminfo WHERE logymd <= '2023-12-03' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND mulator = 0 GROUP BY roleid) AS a FULL JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, MIN_BY(quality_category_default, TIME) AS device_level FROM zgame_dwd.reportserver_hardware WHERE logymd > '2023-12-03' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND simulator = 0 GROUP BY roleid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid), email_info AS (SELECT accountid, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(email)) AS email FROM zgame_dwd.accountserver_account_bind WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND NOT email IS NULL AND email <> '' GROUP BY accountid), account_di AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.logymd, a.deviceid, a.device_name, IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL, 4, a.os_type) AS os_type, CASE WHEN IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL, 4, a.os_type) = 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL, 4, a.os_type) = 2 THEN 'android' WHEN IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL, 4, a.os_type) = 3 THEN 'pc' WHEN IF(NOT b.roleid IS NULL, 4, a.os_type) = 4 THEN 'emulator' ELSE 'unknown' END AS os, a.`time`, a.device, a.ip, CASE WHEN a.logymd >= '2026-01-21' THEN IF(LOWER(ip_country) = '-', NULL, LOWER(ip_country)) END AS account_ip_country, c.device_level AS create_device_level, create_account_channel, create_account_client_version FROM (SELECT accountid, logymd, TRIM(account_name) AS deviceid, COALESCE(TRIM(device_name), 'unknown') AS device_name, os_type, `time`, TRIM(device) AS device, TRIM(ip) AS ip, TRIM(GEOIP(TRIM(ip), 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))) AS ip_country, TRIM(channel) AS create_account_channel, TRIM(client_version) AS create_account_client_version, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY `time`) AS rn FROM zgame_dwd.accountserver_account_create AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a LEFT JOIN os_info AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.logymd = b.logymd LEFT JOIN device_info AS c ON a.accountid = c.roleid WHERE a.rn = 1), account_df AS (SELECT accountid, account_register_time, account_register_date, os_type, os, his_first_deviceid, IF(role_register_date = '1970-01-01', NULL, role_register_date) AS role_register_date, first_create_ip, first_ip_country, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, first_mt_country, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, ad_os_type, attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_adset_name, adjust_creative_id, adjust_creative_name, first_login_channel, his_first_device, his_first_ip, region_id, create_account_channel, create_device_level, first_adjust_id, last_adjust_id,    mt_dim.dim_zgame_basic_account_df */ FROM zgame_dim.dim_zgame_basic_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), role_di AS (SELECT roleid, client_ip, ip_country, role_register_date FROM (SELECT roleid, client_ip, logymd AS role_register_date, LOWER(IF(TRIM(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))) = '-', NULL, TRIM(GEOIP(client_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))))) AS ip_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY `time`, zoneid, client_ip) AS rn FROM (SELECT roleid, IF(`ip` IN ('-', ''), NULL, `ip`) AS client_ip, `time`, zoneid, logymd FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_create_role AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM account_df WHERE role_register_date <> '1970-01-01' /* 有创角日期，代表历史有过创角 */) AS b ON a.roleid = b.accountid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND b.accountid IS NULL /* 标识当日新增的role是首次新增，在历史没有出现过 */) AS t) AS tt WHERE rn = 1), login_auth_di AS (SELECT accountid, channel, region_id, os_type, account_name, device, ip, client_version FROM (SELECT accountid, channel, FLOOR(zoneid / 10000) AS region_id, os_type, account_name, device, ip, client_version, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY `time`) AS rn FROM zgame_dwd.loginserver_login_auth WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t WHERE rn = 1), user_df AS (SELECT *, IF(account_register_date = role_register_date, first_ip_country, NULL) AS account_role_ip_country /* 账号创建日期=账号创建首个日期，保证回溯时国家不变 */ FROM (SELECT COALESCE(di.accountid, df.accountid) AS accountid, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.account_register_date ELSE di.logymd END AS account_register_date, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.account_register_time ELSE di.`time` END AS account_register_time, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.his_first_deviceid ELSE COALESCE(di.deviceid, login_auth_di.account_name) END AS his_first_deviceid, COALESCE(df.role_register_date, role_di.role_register_date, '1970-01-01') AS role_register_date, CASE WHEN NOT df.role_register_date IS NULL THEN df.first_create_ip ELSE COALESCE(role_di.client_ip, 'unknown') END AS first_create_ip /* 如果role_register_date 不为空，说明历史有创角，取df的 create_ip,ip_country */, CASE WHEN NOT df.role_register_date IS NULL THEN df.first_ip_country ELSE COALESCE(role_di.ip_country, 'unknown') END AS first_ip_country, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.os_type ELSE COALESCE(di.os_type, login_auth_di.os_type) END AS os_type, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.os ELSE di.os END AS os, first_ad_country, last_ad_country, ad_os_type, COALESCE(df.first_mt_country, di.account_ip_country) AS first_mt_country /* 2026-01-21开始，country = 创号IP解析 */ /* 2026-01-21之前，country = 归因国家 */, last_mt_country, first_network_name, last_network_name, attr_logymd, adjust_campaign_id, adjust_campaign_name, adjust_adset_name, adjust_adset_id, adjust_creative_name, adjust_creative_id, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.first_login_channel ELSE login_auth_di.channel END AS first_login_channel, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.his_first_device ELSE COALESCE(di.device, login_auth_di.device) END AS his_first_device, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.his_first_ip ELSE COALESCE(di.ip, login_auth_di.ip) END AS his_first_ip, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.region_id ELSE login_auth_di.region_id END AS region_id, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.create_account_channel ELSE di.create_account_channel END AS create_account_channel, CASE WHEN NOT df.accountid IS NULL THEN df.create_device_level ELSE di.create_device_level END AS create_device_level, first_adjust_id, last_adjust_id, first_adjust_campaign_name, first_adjust_campaign_id, first_adjust_adset_name, first_adjust_adset_id, first_adjust_creative_name, first_adjust_creative_id, COALESCE(df.create_account_client_version, di.create_account_client_version, login_auth_di.client_version) AS create_account_client_version FROM account_di AS di FULL JOIN account_df AS df ON di.accountid = df.accountid LEFT JOIN role_di ON COALESCE(di.accountid, df.accountid) = role_di.roleid LEFT JOIN login_auth_di ON COALESCE(di.accountid, df.accountid) = login_auth_di.accountid) AS a), result_info AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.account_register_time, a.account_register_date, a.his_first_deviceid, COALESCE(a.role_register_date, '1970-01-01') AS role_register_date, COALESCE(a.first_create_ip, 'unknown') AS first_create_ip, COALESCE(a.first_ad_country, adv.first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(adv.last_ad_country, 'unknown') AS last_ad_country, COALESCE(a.first_ip_country, 'unknown') AS first_ip_country, COALESCE(a.first_mt_country, adv.first_mt_country, a.account_role_ip_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(adv.last_mt_country, a.first_ip_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, COALESCE(a.first_network_name, adv.first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, COALESCE(adv.last_network_name, 'unknown') AS last_network_name, a.os_type, a.os, adv.ad_os_type, IF(COALESCE(a.attr_logymd, 'unknown') = 'unknown', COALESCE(adv.attr_logymd, '1970-01-01'), a.attr_logymd) AS attr_logymd, COALESCE(adv.adjust_campaign_id, 'unknown') AS adjust_campaign_id, COALESCE(adv.adjust_campaign_name, 'unknown') AS adjust_campaign_name, COALESCE(adv.adjust_adset_name, 'unknown') AS adjust_adset_name, COALESCE(adv.adjust_adset_id, 'unknown') AS adjust_adset_id, COALESCE(adv.adjust_creative_name, 'unknown') AS adjust_creative_name, COALESCE(adv.adjust_creative_id, 'unknown') AS adjust_creative_id, a.first_login_channel, a.his_first_device, a.his_first_ip, a.region_id, a.create_account_channel, a.create_device_level, COALESCE(a.first_adjust_id, adv.first_adjust_id, 'unknown') AS first_adjust_id, COALESCE(adv.last_adjust_id, 'unknown') AS last_adjust_id, COALESCE(a.first_adjust_campaign_name, adv.first_adjust_campaign_name, 'unknown') AS first_adjust_campaign_name, COALESCE(a.first_adjust_campaign_id, adv.first_adjust_campaign_id, 'unknown') AS first_adjust_campaign_id, COALESCE(a.first_adjust_adset_name, adv.first_adjust_adset_name, 'unknown') AS first_adjust_adset_name, COALESCE(a.first_adjust_adset_id, adv.first_adjust_adset_id, 'unknown') AS first_adjust_adset_id, COALESCE(a.first_adjust_creative_name, adv.first_adjust_creative_name, 'unknown') AS first_adjust_creative_name, COALESCE(a.first_adjust_creative_id, adv.first_adjust_creative_id, 'unknown') AS first_adjust_creative_id, a.create_account_client_version FROM user_df AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bi_test.dim_zgame_basic_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS adv ON a.accountid = adv.accountid WHERE a.account_register_date >= '2026-05-02' AND a.account_register_date <= '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT accountid, account_register_time, name: etl.zgame_dwm.dwm_zgame_resource_role_zone_di
sql_units: WITH t_add_hero AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', baseid, num))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS hero_add_info, SUM(num) AS hero_add_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, baseid, COUNT(1) AS num FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_hero_add WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND hero_quality = 5 AND operate <> 'Hero_HeroReset' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, baseid) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_add_item AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', item_id, add_num))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS item_add, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', item_id, pay_add_num))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS item_iap_add FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, SUM(COALESCE(add_num, 0)) AS add_num, SUM(IF(op RLIKE 'IAP_DeliverItem|StoreBuyWithTokens', add_num, 0)) AS pay_add_num FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND (item_id IN (1, 4, 5, 8, 13, 17, 22, 31, 37, 1001, 2001, 3001, 13001, 14001, 15001, 13002, 14002, 15002, 18, 5001, 15017, 15018, 16001, 16002, 16003, 16100, 16101, 16102, 10004, 3502, 3508, 6057, 6056, 6055, 6054, 10001, 10002, 31011, 14, 10005, 28, 15, 25, 26, 4011, 4021, 213, 10006, 10007, 16007, 52) OR (item_id = 3 AND NOT op IN ('ChallengeReturn', 'ChallengeLogout'))) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id) AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_item_sub AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', item_id, sub_num))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS item_sub FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, SUM(COALESCE(sub_num, 0)) AS sub_num FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_sub_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND item_id IN (1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 13, 17, 22, 31, 37, 1001, 2001, 3001, 13001, 14001, 15001, 13002, 14002, 15002, 18, 5001, 15017, 15018, 16001, 16002, 16003, 16100, 16101, 16102, 10004, 3502, 3508, 6057, 6056, 6055, 6054, 10001, 10002, 31011, 14, 10005, 28, 15, 25, 26, 4011, 4021, 213, 10006, 10007, 16007, 52) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id) AS T GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_stamina AS (/* "总体力消耗: sum(cost_energy) */ /* 主线体力消耗: sum(case when ( */ /*     (floor(stage_id / 100000) in (10,11,12) and stage_id not in (1002006,1003007,1004004,1005004,1006004,1007008,1008004,1009017,1010008,1102006,1103007,1104004,1105004,1106004,1107008,1108004)) or */ /*     floor(stage_id / 1000) in (10006,10007,10008,20008) */ /*     ) then cost_energy end) */ /* 经验本体力消耗: sum(case when stage_id in (1002006,1003007,1004004,1005004,1006004,1007008,1008004,1009017,1010008) then cost_energy end) */ /* 金币本体力消耗: sum(case when stage_id in (1102006,1103007,1104004,1105004,1106004,1107008,1108004) then cost_energy end) */ /* 进阶本体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 1000) between 4001 and 4004 then cost_energy end) */ /* 装备本1体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 1000) = 4006 then cost_energy end) */ /* 装备本2体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 1000) = 4007 then cost_energy end) */ /* 装备本3体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 1000) = 4008 then cost_energy end) */ /* 装备地下城1体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 100) = 50090 then cost_energy end) */ /* 装备地下城2体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 100) = 50091 then cost_energy end) */ /* 神器本体力消耗: sum(case when (floor(stage_id / 1000) = 4009 then cost_energy end)" */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(MAP('total', total, 'campaign', campaign, 'exp', exp, 'coin', coin, 'promotion', promotion, 'gear_1', gear_1, 'gear_2', gear_2, 'gear_3', gear_3, 'dungeon_1', dungeon_1, 'dungeon_2', dungeon_2, 'artifact', artifact) AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS stamina FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(COALESCE(cost_energy, 0)) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN ((FLOOR(stage_id / 100000) IN (10, 11, 12) AND NOT stage_id IN (1002006, 1003007, 1004004, 1005004, 1006004, 1007008, 1008004, 1009017, 1010008, 1102006, 1103007, 1104004, 1105004, 1106004, 1107008, 1108004, 1011008)) OR FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) IN (10006, 10007, 10008, 20008)) THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS campaign, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_id IN (1002006, 1003007, 1004004, 1005004, 1006004, 1007008, 1008004, 1009017, 1010008, 1011008) THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS exp, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_id IN (1102006, 1103007, 1104004, 1105004, 1106004, 1107008, 1108004) THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS coin, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) BETWEEN 4001 AND 4004 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4006 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS gear_1, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4007 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS gear_2, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4008 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS gear_3, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 100) = 50090 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS dungeon_1, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 100) = 50091 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS dungeon_2, SUM(CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 4009 THEN COALESCE(cost_energy, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS artifact FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_finish_challenge_stage WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t), item_balance_end AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS(':', item_id, add_num))), ',', ':') AS MAP<STRING, BIGINT>) AS day_item_add FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, SUM(add_num) AS add_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, TIME, COALESCE(add_num, 0) AS add_num FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND (item_id IN (1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 13, 17, 22, 31, 37, 1001, 2001, 3001, 13001, 14001, 15001, 13002, 14002, 15002, 18, 5001, 15017, 15018, 16001, 16002, 16003, 16100, 16101, 16102, 10004, 3502, 3508, 6057, 6056, 6055, 6054, 10001, 10002, 31011, 14, 10005, 28, 15, 25, 26, 4011, 4021, 213, 10006, 10007, 16007, 52)) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, TIME, -COALESCE(sub_num, 0) AS add_num FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_sub_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND item_id IN (1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 13, 17, 22, 31, 37, 1001, 2001, 3001, 13001, 14001, 15001, 13002, 14002, 15002, 18, 5001, 15017, 15018, 16001, 16002, 16003, 16100, 16101, 16102, 10004, 3502, 3508, 6057, 6056, 6055, 6054, 10001, 10002, 31011, 14, 10005, 28, 15, 25, 26, 4011, 4021, 213, 10006, 10007, 16007, 52)) AS t0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), role_info AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM t_add_hero UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM t_add_item UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM t_item_sub UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM t_stamina UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM item_balance_end)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE zgame_dwm.dwm_zgame_resource_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, COALESCE(hero_add_num, 0) AS hero_legend_add_num, hero_add_info AS hero_legend_add_info, item_add, item_sub, item_iap_add, stamina, day_item_add FROM role_info AS t0 LEFT JOIN t_add_hero AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_add_item AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_item_sub AS t3 ON t0.roleid = t3.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT JOIN t_stamina AS t4 ON t0.roleid = t4.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t4.zoneid LEFT JOIN item_balance_end AS t5 ON t0.roleid = t5.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t5.zoneid

name: etl.zgame_dwm.dwm_zgame_battle_pvp_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-01-12 14:02:29.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `mt_dwm`.`dwm_zgame_battle_pvp_role_zone_di`( */ /*     `roleid` decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '账号id,key', */ /*     `zoneid` bigint COMMENT '区服id,key', */ /*     `first_pvp_rank` bigint COMMENT '当日首次结算后PVP段位', */ /*     `last_pvp_rank` bigint COMMENT '当日末次结算后PVP段位', */ /*     `max_pvp_rank` bigint COMMENT '当日最大结算后PVP段位', */ /*     `min_pvp_rank` bigint COMMENT '当日最小结算后PVP段位', */ /*     `arena_cnt` bigint COMMENT '当日竞技场次数，一个stage_id可以重复打', */ /*     `max_pvp_01` bigint COMMENT '-', */ /*     `max_pvp_02` bigint COMMENT '-', */ /*     `max_pvp_03` bigint COMMENT '-', */ /*     `day_final_score` bigint COMMENT '-', */ /*     `day_final_pvp_01` bigint COMMENT '-', */ /*     `day_final_pvp_02` bigint COMMENT '-', */ /*     `day_final_pvp_03` bigint COMMENT '-' */ /* ) PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` string COMMENT '日期,yyyy-MM-dd') */ /*     STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dwm/table/dwm_zgame_battle_pvp_role_zone_di'; */ WITH t_pvp AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(cur_score) AS max_pvp_rank, MIN(cur_score) AS min_pvp_rank, MAX(first_pvp_rank) AS first_pvp_rank, MAX(last_pvp_rank) AS last_pvp_rank, COUNT(stage_id) AS arena_cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_id % 10 = 1 THEN cur_score ELSE NULL END) AS max_pvp_01, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_id % 10 = 2 THEN cur_score ELSE NULL END) AS max_pvp_02, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_id % 10 = 3 THEN cur_score ELSE NULL END) AS max_pvp_03, MAX_BY(cur_score, TIME) AS day_final_score, MAX_BY(cur_score, CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id % 10) = 1 THEN TIME ELSE NULL END) AS day_final_pvp_01, MAX_BY(cur_score, CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id % 10) = 2 THEN TIME ELSE NULL END) AS day_final_pvp_02, MAX_BY(cur_score, CASE WHEN FLOOR(stage_id % 10) = 3 THEN TIME ELSE NULL END) AS day_final_pvp_03 FROM (SELECT player_uid AS roleid, zone_id AS zoneid, cur_score /* 存在null值 */, stage_id /* 存在null值 */, TIME, FIRST_VALUE(cur_score) OVER (PARTITION BY player_uid, zone_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN cur_score IS NULL THEN '9999-99-99 00:00:00' ELSE `time` END) AS first_pvp_rank, FIRST_VALUE(cur_score) OVER (PARTITION BY player_uid, zone_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN cur_score IS NULL THEN '1970-01-01 00:00:00' ELSE `time` END DESC) AS last_pvp_rank FROM zgame_dwd.crossserver_basic_pvp_fight WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zone_id = 1 OR zone_id BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zone_id BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zone_id >= 70001)) AND FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 6001) AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE zgame_dwm.dwm_zgame_battle_pvp_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_pvp_rank, last_pvp_rank, max_pvp_rank, min_pvp_rank, arena_cnt, max_pvp_01, max_pvp_02, max_pvp_03, day_final_score, day_final_pvp_01, day_final_pvp_02, day_final_pvp_03 FROM t_pvp

name: etl.zgame_dim.dim_zgame_item_num_df
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-05-30 12:34:27.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_dim.dim_zgame_item_num_df */ /* ( */ /*     roleid                       DECIMAL(20, 0) COMMENT '角色id', */ /*     zoneid                       BIGINT COMMENT '分区id', */ /* item_id BIGINT COMMENT 'itemid', */ /* cur_num BIGINT COMMENT '当前数量' */ /* ) */ /*     PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd' ) */ /*     STORED AS PARQUET */ /*     LOCATION 's3a://mt-dim/table/dim_zgame_item_num_df'; */ WITH data_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, MAX_BY(cur_num, TIME) AS cur_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, TIME, COALESCE(cur_num, 0) AS cur_num FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND (item_id IN (1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 13, 17, 22, 31, 37, 1001, 2001, 3001, 13001, 14001, 15001, 13002, 14002, 15002, 18, 5001, 15017, 15018, 16001, 16002, 16003, 16100, 16101, 16102, 10004, 3502, 3508, 6057, 6056, 6055, 6054, 10001, 10002, 31011, 14, 10005, 28, 15, 25, 26, 4011, 4021, 213, 10006, 10007, 16007, 52)) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, TIME, COALESCE(cur_num, 0) AS cur_num FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_sub_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001)) AND item_id IN (1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 13, 17, 22, 31, 37, 1001, 2001, 3001, 13001, 14001, 15001, 13002, 14002, 15002, 18, 5001, 15017, 15018, 16001, 16002, 16003, 16100, 16101, 16102, 10004, 3502, 3508, 6057, 6056, 6055, 6054, 10001, 10002, 31011, 14, 10005, 28, 15, 25, 26, 4011, 4021, 213, 10006, 10007, 16007, 52)) AS t0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE zgame_dim.dim_zgame_item_num_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(di.roleid, df.roleid), COALESCE(di.zoneid, df.zoneid), COALESCE(di.item_id, df.item_id), COALESCE(di.cur_num, df.cur_num) FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, cur_num FROM zgame_dim.dim_zgame_item_num_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df FULL JOIN data_info AS di ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid AND di.item_id = df.item_id

name: etl.zgame_dwm.dwm_zgame_pay_role_zone_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE zgame_dwm.dwm_zgame_pay_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, receipt_type, sub_pay_channel, MIN(first_pay_time) AS first_pay_time, MAX(last_pay_time) AS last_pay_time, SUM(pay_amt) AS pay_amt, SUM(pay_cnt) AS pay_cnt, SUM(pay_amt_official) AS pay_amt_official, SUM(pay_amt_particular) AS pay_amt_particular, STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(product_type, ':', pay_amt))), ',', ':') AS pay_type_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, receipt_type, sub_pay_channel, product_type, MIN(`time`) AS first_pay_time, MAX(`time`) AS last_pay_time, SUM(money) AS pay_amt, COUNT(1) AS pay_cnt, SUM(pay_amt_official) AS pay_amt_official, SUM(pay_amt_particular) AS pay_amt_particular FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(receipt_type, -99999) AS receipt_type, COALESCE(TRIM(sub_pay_channel), '') AS sub_pay_channel /* 有空字符串存在，所以如果出现null都统一归到空字符串 */, COALESCE(TRIM(product_type), '') AS product_type /* 有空字符串存在，所以如果出现null都统一归到空字符串 */, money, `time`, CASE WHEN platform = 'moonton' AND product_type <> 'W币' THEN money ELSE 0 END AS pay_amt_official, CASE WHEN NOT (platform = 'moonton' AND product_type <> 'W币') OR platform IS NULL OR product_type IS NULL THEN money ELSE 0 END AS pay_amt_particular /* 如果有空无法判断则归到非官方上 */ FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND money > 0) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, receipt_type, sub_pay_channel, product_type) AS t2 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, receipt_type, sub_pay_channel

name: old_redownload_ratio
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: amandapiao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-02-03 14:16:27.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ml_temp.amandapiao_combined_redownload_data_ratio; */ /* CREATE  EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ml_temp.amandapiao_combined_redownload_data_ratio ( */ /*                 `channel` STRING COMMENT '渠道', */ /*                 `createrole_country` STRING COMMENT '创建角色国家', */ /*                 `zone` STRING COMMENT '区域', */ /*                 `client_root_ver` STRING COMMENT '母包版本号', */ /*                 `login_cnt` INT COMMENT 'login_cnt', */ /*                 `redownload_cnt` INT COMMENT 'redownload_cnt' */ /*         ) */ /*         PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` STRING COMMENT '日期') STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3a://moonton-hadoop/user/amandapiao/amandapiao_combined_redownload_data_ratio'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.amandapiao_combined_redownload_data_ratio PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT channel, createrole_country, zone, client_root_ver, COUNT(DISTINCT a.deviceid) AS login_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.is_redownload = 1 THEN a.deviceid END) AS redownload_cnt FROM (SELECT deviceid, client_ver, channel, createrole_country, FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) AS zone, SUBSTRING_INDEX(client_ver, '.', 3) AS client_root_ver, MIN(time) AS start_time, MAX(time) AS end_time FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY deviceid, client_ver, channel, createrole_country, zone, client_root_ver) AS a /* 如果是is_redownload = 1的就是重复下载用户 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT deviceid, client_ver, MAX(is_redownload) AS is_redownload FROM ml_temp.amandapiao_is_redownload WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY deviceid, client_ver) AS b ON a.deviceid = b.deviceid AND a.client_ver = b.client_ver GROUP BY channel, createrole_country, zone, client_root_ver

name: new_is_install1
sql_units: /* 最终查询结果 */ /* 设备+版本号出现在重装里面 */ WITH device_stats AS (/* 设备登录统计：统计过去7天每个设备的UUID数量和登录次数 */ SELECT deviceid, client_ver, COUNT(DISTINCT app_uuid) AS uuid_count, COUNT(*) AS login_count FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY deviceid, client_ver), uuid_reinstall AS (/* UUID重装用户：过去7天内使用多个UUID的设备 */ SELECT deviceid, client_ver, '重装用户' AS user_type, 'uuid_reinstall' AS reinstall_source FROM device_stats WHERE uuid_count > 1 GROUP BY deviceid, client_ver), APK_reinstall AS (/* APK重装用户：当天发生APK重装的设备 */ SELECT device_id AS deviceid, client_ver, '重装用户' AS user_type, 'apk_reinstall' AS reinstall_source FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_reinstallapkdata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND reinstall_type = 1 GROUP BY device_id, client_ver), all_reinstall_users AS (/* 合并所有重装用户（去重） */ SELECT deviceid, client_ver, user_type, reinstall_source FROM uuid_reinstall UNION ALL SELECT deviceid, client_ver, user_type, reinstall_source FROM APK_reinstall), player_info AS (/* 获取玩家基本信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_first_deviceid AS deviceid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2022-05-08', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, his_first_deviceid, register_date), final_result AS (/* 最终结果：重装用户排除新增用户 */ SELECT r.deviceid, r.reinstall_source, r.client_ver, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', p.register_date) = 0 THEN '新增用户' WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', p.register_date) <= 29 THEN '新用户' WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', p.register_date) >= 30 THEN '老用户' ELSE '无信息' END AS user_type FROM all_reinstall_users AS r LEFT JOIN player_info AS p ON r.deviceid = p.deviceid WHERE DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', p.register_date) <> 0 /* 排除新增用户 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.amandapiao_new_is_install1 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT deviceid, client_ver, reinstall_source FROM final_result GROUP BY deviceid, client_ver, reinstall_source

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_mcgg_productmoney_change_df
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: helenma@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-02-28 23:06:07.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* create external table if not exists mt_dim.dim_mcgg_productmoney_change_df */ /* ( */ /*     `start_date` string COMMENT '生效起始时间', */ /*     `end_date` string COMMENT '生效结束时间', */ /*     `pay_channel` string COMMENT '支付渠道', */ /*     `sub_pay_channel` string COMMENT '支付子渠道', */ /*     `country` string COMMENT '支付国家', */ /*     `ip_country` string COMMENT '用户ip国家', */ /*     `product_id` string COMMENT '商品id', */ /*     `currency` string COMMENT '支付货币类型', */ /*     `original_amt` string COMMENT '调价前商品价格（分）', */ /*     `change_amt` string COMMENT '调价后商品价格（分）' */ /* ) */ /* comment 'mcgg商品价格配置表' */ /* partitioned by (logymd string comment '日期分区', appid string comment '游戏ID') */ /* stored as parquet */ /* location 's3a://mt-dim/table/dim_mcgg_productmoney_change_df' */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_mcgg_productmoney_change_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mcgg') SELECT CONCAT(start_date, ' 00:00:00') AS start_date, CONCAT(COALESCE(end_date, lead_start_date, '9999-12-31'), ' 00:00:00') AS end_date, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, country, ip_country, product_id, currency, original_amt, change_amt FROM (SELECT start_date, NULLIF(end_date, '') AS end_date, LEAD(start_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(pay_channel), LOWER(sub_pay_channel), LOWER(country), ip_country, LOWER(product_id), LOWER(currency) ORDER BY start_date) AS lead_start_date, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, country, ip_country, product_id, currency, original_amt, change_amt FROM mt_dim.dim_productmoney_change WHERE LOWER(appid) = 'mcgg')

name: zgame_event_5_etl
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: ziggszhu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-02-04 14:36:47.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH ip_counts AS (SELECT ip, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS event_cnt, 1 AS join_key /* 【关键】造一个假列，用于后续关联 */ FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 70001 GROUP BY ip), total_uv AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS total_cnt, 1 AS join_key /* 【关键】造一个同样的假列 */ FROM zgame_damai_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid >= 70001) INSERT INTO mtsec_biz.ads_monitor_stat PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT '5' AS event_id, t1.ip AS dim_value, t1.event_cnt AS event_cnt, 'null' AS stat_hour, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS update_time, 'null' AS comment, ROUND((CAST(t1.event_cnt AS DOUBLE) / t2.total_cnt), 5) AS ratio FROM ip_counts AS t1 JOIN total_uv AS t2 ON t1.join_key = t2.join_key /* 【关键】使用标准的等值连接，骗过优化器 */ ORDER BY t1.event_cnt DESC LIMIT 100

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_mlbb_realtime_batch_data_di-离线回补
sql_units: WITH network AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(t2.first_mt_country) IN ('', '-') OR t2.first_mt_country IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE LOWER(t2.first_mt_country) END AS createrole_country, LEAST(5, (HOUR(t1.TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(t1.TIME) * 60 + SECOND(t1.TIME)) DIV 14400) AS point /* 每4小时一个point */, SUM(CASE WHEN ((t1.ping120 + t1.ping150 + t1.ping200 + t1.ping300 + t1.ping500 + t1.ping800) / t1.ping_times) <= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stdping_cnt, SUM(1) AS battle_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2022-01-01' /* 最早有数日期 */ AND timedelay > 0 AND timedelay <> 10000 AND timedelay < 50000 AND maxdelay < 50000 AND movelag < 10000 AND isvalid = 1 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND zoneid < 57000) AS t1 LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t2.logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') GROUP BY CASE WHEN TRIM(t2.first_mt_country) IN ('', '-') OR t2.first_mt_country IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE LOWER(t2.first_mt_country) END, LEAST(5, (HOUR(t1.TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(t1.TIME) * 60 + SECOND(t1.TIME)) DIV 14400)), match AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(t2.first_mt_country) IN ('', '-') OR t2.first_mt_country IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE LOWER(t2.first_mt_country) END AS createrole_country, LEAST(5, (HOUR(t1.TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(t1.TIME) * 60 + SECOND(t1.TIME)) DIV 14400) AS point /* 每4小时一个point */, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND t1.quit_reason <> 15 THEN t1.success ELSE 0 END) AS successcnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND t1.quit_reason <> 15 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS battlecnt FROM (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2023-12-20' /* 最早有数日期 */ AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND zoneid < 57000) AS t1 LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t2.logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') GROUP BY CASE WHEN TRIM(t2.first_mt_country) IN ('', '-') OR t2.first_mt_country IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE LOWER(t2.first_mt_country) END, LEAST(5, (HOUR(t1.TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(t1.TIME) * 60 + SECOND(t1.TIME)) DIV 14400)), network_dim AS (SELECT t1.createrole_country, t2.point FROM (SELECT createrole_country FROM network GROUP BY createrole_country) AS t1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(0, 5)) AS point) AS t2), match_dim AS (SELECT t1.createrole_country, t2.point FROM (SELECT createrole_country FROM match GROUP BY createrole_country) AS t1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(0, 5)) AS point) AS t2), dim_biqi AS (SELECT t1.createrole_country, t1.point, COALESCE(t2.stdping_cnt, 0) AS network_fz_point_cnt, COALESCE(t2.battle_cnt, 0) AS network_fm_point_cnt FROM network_dim AS t1 LEFT JOIN network AS t2 ON t1.createrole_country = t2.createrole_country AND t1.point = t2.point), dim_biqi_2 AS (SELECT t1.createrole_country, t1.point, COALESCE(t2.successcnt, 0) AS match_fz_point_cnt, COALESCE(t2.battlecnt, 0) AS match_fm_point_cnt FROM match_dim AS t1 LEFT JOIN match AS t2 ON t1.createrole_country = t2.createrole_country AND t1.point = t2.point), us_network AS (SELECT LEAST(5, (HOUR(date_range) * 3600 + MINUTE(date_range) * 60 + SECOND(date_range)) DIV 14400) AS point /* 每4小时一个point */, SUM(nework_num) AS nework_num, SUM(nework_den) AS nework_den FROM mt_ads.ads_network_info_us_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-01-16' GROUP BY LEAST(5, (HOUR(date_range) * 3600 + MINUTE(date_range) * 60 + SECOND(date_range)) DIV 14400)), us_match AS (SELECT LEAST(5, (HOUR(date_range) * 3600 + MINUTE(date_range) * 60 + SECOND(date_range)) DIV 14400) AS point /* 每4小时一个point */, SUM(match_num) AS match_num, SUM(match_den) AS match_den FROM mt_ads.ads_match_info_us_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-01-16' GROUP BY LEAST(5, (HOUR(date_range) * 3600 + MINUTE(date_range) * 60 + SECOND(date_range)) DIV 14400)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_mlbb_realtime_batch_data_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT event, point, 1 AS zone_type, country, point_cnt, day_cnt FROM (/* 非美区网络满足率 */ SELECT createrole_country AS country, point, 'network_fz' AS event, network_fz_point_cnt AS point_cnt, 0 AS day_cnt FROM dim_biqi UNION ALL SELECT createrole_country AS country, point, 'network_fm' AS event, network_fm_point_cnt AS point_cnt, 0 AS day_cnt FROM dim_biqi UNION ALL /* 美区回传网络满足率 */ SELECT 'us_compliance' AS country, point, 'network_fz' AS event, nework_num AS point_cnt, 0 AS day_cnt FROM us_network UNION ALL SELECT 'us_compliance' AS country, point, 'network_fm' AS event, nework_den AS point_cnt, 0 AS day_cnt FROM us_network UNION ALL /* 非美区匹配成功率 */ SELECT createrole_country AS country, point, 'match_fz' AS event, match_fz_point_cnt AS point_cnt, 0 AS day_cnt FROM dim_biqi_2 UNION ALL SELECT createrole_country AS country, point, 'match_fm' AS event, match_fm_point_cnt AS point_cnt, 0 AS day_cnt FROM dim_biqi_2 UNION ALL /* 美区回传匹配成功率 */ SELECT 'us_compliance' AS country, point, 'match_fz' AS event, match_num AS point_cnt, 0 AS day_cnt FROM us_match UNION ALL SELECT 'us_compliance' AS country, point, 'match_fm' AS event, match_den AS point_cnt, 0 AS day_cnt FROM us_match)

create_date >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -180) AND create_date <= '2026-05-30' UNION ALL SELECT d.device_id, d.create_date, MAX(IF(d.day_diff <= 1, d.active_level, -1)) AS active_level_d1, device_id, create_date FROM adbi.device_level_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-30' AND create_date >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -180) AND create_date <= '2026-05-30' UNION ALL SELECT device_id, create_date FROM adbi.dm_sdk_device_multi_behavior_ug_df WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND app_id = '1001' AND create_date = '2026-05-31') AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT accountid, account_name AS device_id FROM country, COALESCE(b.os, 'NULL') AS os, COALESCE(b.network, 'NULL') AS network, COALESCE(register_cnt, 0) AS register_cnt, 0 AS pure_register_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt_30days, 0) AS active_cnt_30days, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(pay_amt, 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS active_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_pay_30d_cnt, 0 AS active_register_30d_cnt, 0 AS recurring_cnt_30days, 0 AS nologin_cnt_30days, ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) AS register_reten_cnt, ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) AS recurring_reten_cnt, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate, ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) AS pure_reten_cnt, ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) AS old_reten_cnt, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt_period, COALESCE(pay_cnt, 0) AS pay_cnt_period, b.online_time AS online_dur /*	当日玩家总在线时长(单位：s) */, 0 AS new_active_cnt /*	新用户活跃玩家数 */, 0 AS register_cnt_total /*	历史总注册玩家数 */, 0 AS lose_cnt_7ds /*	7日流失玩家数 */, 0 AS active_cnt_7ds /*	7日前DAU */, 0 AS lose_cnt_30ds /*	30日流失玩家数 */, 0 AS active_cnt_30ds /*	30日前DAU */, IF(LOWER(b.network) = 'organic', 1, 2) AS network_group, 1 AS user_type, 'unknown' AS channel, -99999 AS new_type, -99999 AS install_label, -99999 AS arcade_label, -99999 AS active_label, 0 AS recurring_cnt_14days, 0 AS nologin_cnt_14days, ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) AS recurring_14days_reten_cnt, 0 AS actual_pay_amt, NULL AS active_cnt_90days, NULL AS vaild_user_cnt, NULL AS vaild_user_online_dur, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, a.appname, 'account' AS granularity_type, 'daily' AS date_type FROM (SELECT country_code AS country, appname FROM bi_test.dim_gamebi_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM bi_test.dim_gamebi_country) /* 取最新 */ AND startdate <= '2026-05-31' AND NOT appname IN ('mlbb', 'zgame', 'mla', 'nova', 'mcgg_v2', 'wegame') AND is_online = 1 AND definition_type = 0 GROUP BY country_code, appname) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(network, 'unknown') AS network, COALESCE(SUM(register_cnt), 0) AS register_cnt, 0 AS pure_register_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt), 0) AS active_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(active_cnt_30days), 0) AS active_cnt_30days, COALESCE(SUM(pay_cnt), 0) AS pay_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt), 0) AS pay_amt, 0 AS pay_amt_exrate, logymd, appname, COALESCE(SUM(online_time), 0) AS online_time FROM (SELECT bd.app_id, ap.appname, COALESCE(LOWER(first_mt_country), 'unknown') AS country, bd.os, COALESCE(LOWER(first_network_name), 'unknown') AS network, SUM(IF(createdate = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS register_cnt, SUM(is_td) AS active_cnt, SUM(is_30d) AS active_cnt_30days, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.account_id) AS pay_cnt /* 付费人数 */, SUM(day_pay_amt) AS pay_amt, '2026-05-31' AS logymd, SUM(COALESCE(lout.online_time, 0)) AS online_time FROM (SELECT app_id, account_id, first_mt_country, os, first_media_source AS first_network_name, createdate FROM msdk_dim.dim_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-02-06' THEN NOT app_id IN (4200) ELSE NOT app_id IN (4460) END /* xgame */) AS bd LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, app_id, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_td, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-02' AND '2026-05-31', 1, 0)) AS is_30d FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_active_account_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-02-06' THEN NOT app_id IN (4200) ELSE NOT app_id IN (4460) END /* xgame */ GROUP BY account_id, app_id) AS ad ON ad.app_id = bd.app_id AND ad.account_id = bd.account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT m__role_id AS roleid, '4460' AS app_id, LEAST(SUM(COALESCE(online_time, 0)), 24 * 60 * 60) AS online_time FROM xgame_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY m__role_id) AS lout ON ad.app_id = lout.app_id AND ad.account_id = lout.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, app_id, SUM(day_charge_sum) AS day_pay_amt FROM msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-02-06' THEN NOT app_id IN (4200) ELSE NOT app_id IN (4460) END /* xgame */ GROUP BY account_id, app_id) AS pay ON bd.app_id = pay.app_id AND bd.account_id = pay.account_id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(appname) AS appname, stagename, stageid AS app_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_app_info WHERE logymd = IF('20260531' <= '20250106', '20250106', '20260531') AND CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-02-06' THEN NOT stageid IN (4200) ELSE NOT stageid IN (4460) END /* xgame */ AND is_online = 1) AS ap ON ap.app_id = bd.app_id GROUP BY bd.app_id, ap.appname, COALESCE(LOWER(first_mt_country), 'unknown'), bd.os, COALESCE(LOWER(first_network_name), 'unknown')) GROUP BY COALESCE(country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(os, 'unknown'), COALESCE(network, 'unknown'), logymd, appname) AS b ON a.country = b.country AND a.appname = b.appname

name: etl.msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_di_msdk
sql_units: /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_di ( */ /*     did                           STRING COMMENT '应用的自定义设备指纹, key', */ /*     package_name                  STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名, key', */ /*     os                            STRING COMMENT '操作系统, key', */ /*     day_first_model               STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 首次', */ /*     day_last_model                STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 末次', */ /*     day_first_os_version          STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本,首次', */ /*     day_last_os_version           STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本, 末次', */ /*     day_first_client_version      STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 首次', */ /*     day_last_client_version       STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 末次', */ /*     day_first_charge_time         STRING COMMENT '当天首次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     day_last_charge_time          STRING COMMENT '当天末次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     day_charge_cnt                BIGINT COMMENT '当天累计付费次数', */ /*     day_charge_sum                BIGINT COMMENT '当天累计付费金额（美分）' */ /* ) COMMENT '设备付费行为增量表格' PARTITIONED BY ( logymd STRING COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', app_id INT COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key' ) STORED AS PARQUET; */ WITH xgame_pay AS (SELECT msdk_did AS did, 4460 AS app_id, COALESCE(LOWER(m__package_name), 'unknown') AS package_name, COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(m__os_type)), 'unknown') AS os, m__model AS model, m__os_version AS os_version, m__client_version AS client_version, m__server_time, COALESCE(price, 0) AS price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did ORDER BY time DESC) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did ORDER BY time ASC) AS rec_asc, 0 AS is_delete, time FROM xgame_ods.gameserver_purchase_event WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_device_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id = 4460) SELECT t1.did, t1.package_name, t1.os, t1.day_first_model, t1.day_last_model, t1.day_first_os_version, t1.day_last_os_version, t1.day_first_client_version, t1.day_last_client_version, t1.day_first_charge_time, t1.day_last_charge_time, t2.charge_cnt, t2.charge_sum, 0 AS actual_amt, '01' AS stage_id FROM (SELECT did, app_id, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, package_name, NULL)) AS package_name, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os, NULL)) AS os, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_first_model, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_last_model, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_first_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_last_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_first_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_last_client_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, time, NULL)) AS day_first_charge_time, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, time, NULL)) AS day_last_charge_time FROM xgame_pay WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY did, app_id) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT did, app_id, COUNT(1) AS charge_cnt, SUM(price) AS charge_sum FROM xgame_pay GROUP BY did, app_id) AS t2 ON t1.did = t2.did AND t1.app_id = t2.app_id

name: leap_instance_yarn_detail
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: huiyaoye@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-12-08 11:49:12.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH instance_di AS (SELECT id AS instance_id, task_id, name, CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN '初始化状态' WHEN status = 2 THEN '等待上游依赖' WHEN status = 3 THEN '等待到达执行时间' WHEN status = 4 THEN '等待任务分配QUOTA' WHEN status = 41 THEN '等待任务提交worker' WHEN status = 5 THEN '已提交' WHEN status = 6 THEN '执行器提交' WHEN status = 7 THEN '执行器等待' WHEN status = 9 THEN 'sensor等待被线程池调度' WHEN status = 10 THEN '运行中状态' WHEN status = 19 THEN '强制置为成功' WHEN status = 20 THEN '执行完成' WHEN status = 21 THEN '执行失败' WHEN status = 22 THEN 'OOM状态' WHEN status = 27 THEN '实例强制成功，触发下游成功' WHEN status = 30 THEN '成功之后触发下游' WHEN status = 31 THEN '超过最大重试次数/主动置失败' WHEN status = 32 THEN '任务失败，且状态与Manta强规则关联' WHEN status = 35 THEN '执行成功，且状态与Manta强规则关联' WHEN status = 36 THEN '执行成功，且状态与Manta强规则关联，并触发下游' WHEN status = 80 THEN '取消' WHEN status = 90 THEN '被动终止' WHEN status = 99 THEN '删除' WHEN status = -1 THEN '默认' WHEN status = -2 THEN '未就绪' ELSE status END AS status_name, submit_time AS leap_submit_time, start_time AS leap_start_time, task_time AS leap_task_time /* 业务时间 */, external_sub_application_id /*	外部任务 ID（如 yarn application ID，TCE pod ID） */, end_time AS leap_end_time, IF(external_sub_application_id LIKE 'etl%', SPLIT(SPLIT(external_sub_application_id, '-')[0], '_')[1], external_sub_application_id) AS sub_application_id, code, conf FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__instance_hi WHERE date = '20260531' AND NOT end_time IS NULL), task_info AS (SELECT a.name AS project_name, CASE WHEN t.type = 101 THEN 'mysql2leap' WHEN t.type = 201 THEN 'HQL' WHEN t.type = 202 THEN 'shell' WHEN t.type = 110 THEN 'hive2ch' WHEN t.type = 126 THEN 'larksheet2hive' WHEN t.type = 701 THEN 'spark' ELSE '其他' END AS task_type_name, t.owner_user_name AS owner_user_name, t.id AS id, SPLIT(t.owner_user_name, '@')[0] AS userid, t.cron_expression AS cron_expression, CASE WHEN t.schedule_type = 1 THEN '手动调度' WHEN t.schedule_type = 2 THEN '周期调度' WHEN t.schedule_type = 3 THEN '临时查询' ELSE '其他' END AS schedule_type /* 调度类型  1:手动调度 2：周期调度 3：临时查询 */, CASE WHEN t.status = 1 THEN 'INIT' WHEN t.status = 2 THEN 'RUNNABLE' WHEN t.status = 3 THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN t.status = 4 THEN 'DELETED' ELSE '其他' END AS task_status /* 任务状态（1:INIT，2:RUNNABLE，3:CLOSED，4:DELETED) */ FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__project_df AS a JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__folder_df AS b ON a.id = b.project_id JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__task_df AS t ON b.id = t.folder_id WHERE a.`date` = '20260531' AND b.`date` = '20260531' AND t.`date` = '20260531'), tqs_query_task AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, progress, name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(name, '_([0-9]+)_') AS task_id /* 一定能取到 */, date, REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(progress, '$.trackingUrl'), '/(application_[0-9]+_[0-9]+)/') AS application_id /* 可能没有，解析失败、没权限，spark 任务没有启动 */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY end_time DESC) AS rn FROM mt_ods.dl_tqs_spark3__tqs_query_task_hi WHERE date >= '20260526' AND date <= '20260605') AS t WHERE rn = 1), yarn_info AS (SELECT yarn_id, yarn_name, ts, application_type, elapsed_time AS yarn_elapsed_time /* yarn 运行的时间 */, started_time AS yarn_started_time /* yarn 开始时间 */, finished_time AS yarn_finished_time /* yarn 结束时间 由于30秒采集一次，大致上 结束时间 - 开始时间 = 运行的时间 */, memory_seconds /* 总资源消耗 */, vcore_seconds, queue, running_containers, state AS yarn_state /* RUNNING FINISHED ACCEPTED */, user AS yarn_user FROM (SELECT *, id AS yarn_id, name AS yarn_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id, state ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM mt_ods.yarn_app_info_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-26' AND logymd <= '2026-06-05') AS t WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_leap_yarn_instance_detail_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT instance_id, task_id, name, status_name, FROM_UNIXTIME(leap_task_time + 8 * 60 * 60) AS leap_task_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(leap_submit_time + 8 * 60 * 60) AS leap_submit_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(leap_start_time + 8 * 60 * 60) AS leap_start_time /* leap_submit_time, -- leap 提交时间 */, external_sub_application_id /* leap_start_time, -- Leap 实际开始时间 */, sub_application_id, FROM_UNIXTIME(leap_end_time + 8 * 60 * 60) AS leap_end_time, project_name /* leap_end_time, -- Leap结束时间 */, task_type_name, owner_user_name, userid, cron_expression, schedule_type, task_status, tqs_query_id, tqs_query_name /* progress, -- 暂时不加，主要取 tqs start */, application_id, final_application_id, tbl_a.code, tbl_a.conf, tqs_start_time, yarn_name, FROM_UNIXTIME(ts + 8 * 60 * 60) AS yarn_collection_time, application_type AS yarn_application_type, yarn_elapsed_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(yarn_started_time / 1000 + 8 * 60 * 60) AS yarn_started_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(IF(yarn_finished_time = 0, NULL, yarn_finished_time) / 1000 + 8 * 60 * 60) AS yarn_finished_time, memory_seconds, vcore_seconds, queue AS yarn_queue, running_containers, yarn_state, yarn_user FROM (SELECT *, COALESCE(application_id, external_sub_application_id) AS final_application_id, SUBSTRING(REPLACE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(progress, '$.executionStage.startTime'), 'T', ' '), 1, 19) AS tqs_start_time FROM (SELECT instance_di.instance_id, instance_di.task_id, instance_di.name, instance_di.status_name, instance_di.leap_submit_time, instance_di.leap_start_time, instance_di.external_sub_application_id, instance_di.sub_application_id, instance_di.leap_end_time, instance_di.leap_task_time, instance_di.code, instance_di.conf, task_info.project_name, task_info.task_type_name, task_info.owner_user_name, task_info.userid /* task_info.id, */, task_info.cron_expression, task_info.schedule_type, task_info.task_status, tqs_query_task.id AS tqs_query_id, tqs_query_task.progress, tqs_query_task.name AS tqs_query_name, tqs_query_task.application_id /* tqs_query_task.task_id, */ FROM instance_di LEFT JOIN task_info ON instance_di.task_id = task_info.id LEFT JOIN tqs_query_task ON instance_di.sub_application_id = tqs_query_task.id)) AS tbl_a LEFT JOIN yarn_info ON tbl_a.final_application_id = yarn_info.yarn_id

*/ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_act_bingo_reward_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.roleid /* ========== 主键维度 ========== */, t1.zoneid, t1.act_id, t1.reward_id, t1.reward_num, t1.play_cnt, t2.first_mt_country /* ========== 预关联维度 ========== */, t3.country_name, t1.one_reward_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, act_id, reward_id, SUM(reward_num) AS reward_num, MAX(play_cnt) AS play_cnt, SUM(IF(reward_num = 1, 1, 0)) AS one_reward_num FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_2022ball WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, act_id, reward_id) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT country_code, country_name FROM (SELECT LOWER(country_code) AS country_code, country_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(country_code) ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t3 ON LOWER(t2.first_mt_country) = t3.country_code

name: jaxzhong_getping表行转列
sql_units: /* set spark.dynamicAllocation.maxExecutors=30; */ /* set spark.executor.cores=4; */ /* set spark.executor.memory=16g; */ /* set spark.executor.memoryOverhead=2048; */ /* set spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.initialPartitionNum=360; */ /* --构建临时表，用户可以去grouplist，以及每个group下的网络特征 */ /* 第一步：解析change_group_list，取最后一个非空组并炸开 */ WITH change_group_exploded AS (SELECT logymd, time, roleid, zoneid, getping_id, group_type, client_ip, tabid, change_reason, detailed_ping_data, TRIM(REVERSE(SPLIT(change_group_list, '\\073'))[CASE WHEN REVERSE(SPLIT(change_group_list, '\\073'))[0] = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END]) AS last_group /* 提取最后一个非空组 */, change_group_list FROM ml_ods.pingserver_getpingv3_change WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND isscore = 1), group_score_exploded /* 炸开最后一个组的机房列表 */ AS (SELECT logymd, time, roleid, zoneid, getping_id, group_type, client_ip, tabid, change_reason, detailed_ping_data, change_group_list, CAST(SPLIT(group_score, ':')[0] AS INT) AS groupid /* 提取机房ID */, CAST(SPLIT(group_score, ':')[1] AS INT) AS total_score /* 提取综合得分 */, score_rank /* --group的得分排序 */ FROM change_group_exploded LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(SPLIT(last_group, ',')) t AS score_rank, group_score WHERE group_score <> '' AND NOT group_score IS NULL AND SPLIT(group_score, ':')[0] <> ''), ping_data_exploded /* 第二步：解析detailed_ping_data并炸开 */ AS (SELECT roleid, getping_id, CAST(SPLIT(ping_item, ':')[0] AS INT) AS groupid /* 提取机房ID */, CAST(SPLIT(SPLIT(ping_item, ':')[1], '-')[0] AS INT) AS ping_median /* 提取ping中位数 */, CAST(SPLIT(SPLIT(ping_item, ':')[1], '-')[1] AS INT) AS ping_mean /* 提取ping均值 */, CAST(SPLIT(SPLIT(ping_item, ':')[1], '-')[2] AS INT) AS ping_stddev_100 /* 提取ping标准差*100 */, CAST(SPLIT(SPLIT(ping_item, ':')[1], '-')[3] AS INT) AS packet_loss_rate /* 提取丢包率 */, CAST(SPLIT(SPLIT(ping_item, ':')[1], '-')[4] AS INT) AS high_latency_rate /* 提取高延迟率 */ FROM ml_ods.pingserver_getpingv3_change LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(detailed_ping_data, '\\073')) t AS ping_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND isscore = 1 AND ping_item <> '' AND NOT ping_item IS NULL), output_tabel /* 第三步：关联两个炸开后的表 */ AS (SELECT gse.logymd, gse.time, gse.roleid AS accountid, gse.zoneid AS zoneid, gse.getping_id, gse.group_type, gse.client_ip, gse.tabid, gse.change_reason, gse.detailed_ping_data, gse.change_group_list, gse.groupid, gse.score_rank /* --得分排序 */, gse.total_score /* -综合得分 */, pde.ping_median /* -ping中位数 */, pde.ping_mean /* --ping均值 */, pde.ping_stddev_100 /* -ping方差乘以100 */, pde.packet_loss_rate /* -丢包率 */, pde.high_latency_rate /* --高延迟率 */ FROM group_score_exploded AS gse LEFT JOIN ping_data_exploded AS pde ON gse.roleid = pde.roleid AND gse.getping_id = pde.getping_id AND gse.groupid = pde.groupid WHERE NOT gse.total_score IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jaxzhong_getping_network_quality_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 覆盖写入 */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, getping_id, group_type, client_ip, tabid, change_reason, detailed_ping_data, groupid, score_rank /* --得分排序 */, total_score /* -综合得分 */, ping_median /* -ping中位数 */, ping_mean /* --ping均值 */, ping_stddev_100 /* -ping方差乘以100 */, packet_loss_rate /* -丢包率 */, high_latency_rate /* --高延迟率 */, time, change_group_list FROM output_tabel

sql_units: WITH add_agg AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, SUM(add_num) AS add_qty, COUNT(1) AS add_cnt, MIN(logymd) AS first_add_dt, MAX(logymd) AS last_add_dt, MAX(STRUCT(TIME, cur_num)).cur_num AS last_add_cur_num, MAX(TIME) AS last_add_time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND operate <> 'gm' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id), sub_agg AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_qty, COUNT(1) AS sub_cnt, MIN(logymd) AS first_sub_dt, MAX(logymd) AS last_sub_dt, MAX(STRUCT(TIME, cur_num)).cur_num AS last_sub_cur_num, MAX(TIME) AS last_sub_time FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_item WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND operate <> 'gm' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_item_chg_role_zone_mi PARTITION(logym = '2026-05') SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, s.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, s.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(a.item_id, s.item_id) AS item_id, COALESCE(a.add_qty, 0) AS add_qty, COALESCE(a.add_cnt, 0) AS add_cnt, COALESCE(s.sub_qty, 0) AS sub_qty, COALESCE(s.sub_cnt, 0) AS sub_cnt, a.first_add_dt, s.first_sub_dt, a.last_add_dt, s.last_sub_dt, CASE WHEN a.last_add_time IS NULL THEN s.last_sub_cur_num WHEN s.last_sub_time IS NULL THEN a.last_add_cur_num WHEN a.last_add_time >= s.last_sub_time THEN a.last_add_cur_num ELSE s.last_sub_cur_num END AS eom_cur_num FROM add_agg AS a FULL OUTER JOIN sub_agg AS s ON a.roleid = s.roleid AND a.zoneid = s.zoneid AND a.item_id = s.item_id

*/ /* 清洗每日增量数据 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_public_opinion_keyword_gp_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT t1.package_name, t1.app_version_code, t1.app_version_name, t1.reviewer_language, t1.device, t1.review_submit_date_and_time, t1.review_submit_millis_since_epoch, t1.review_last_update_date_and_time, t1.review_last_update_millis_since_epoch, CAST(TRIM(t1.star_rating) AS BIGINT) AS star_rating, t1.review_title, t1.review_text, t1.developer_reply_date_and_time, t1.developer_reply_millis_since_epoch, t1.developer_reply_text, t1.review_link, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.device, t1.review_last_update_millis_since_epoch, t1.review_text) AS review_id, SUBSTRING(t1.review_last_update_date_and_time, 1, 10) AS source_logymd FROM (SELECT * FROM mt_ods.ods_public_opinion_keyword_gp_mf WHERE log_month >= SUBSTRING('20260430', 1, 6) AND log_month <= SUBSTRING('20260531', 1, 6) AND log_month >= '202601' AND SUBSTRING(review_last_update_date_and_time, 1, 10) <= '2026-05-31') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dwd.dwd_public_opinion_keyword_gp_di WHERE logymd >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-04-30', 1, 7), '-01') AND logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND logymd >= '2026-01-01') AS t2 ON COALESCE(t1.package_name, 'NULL_VALUE') = COALESCE(t2.package_name, 'NULL_VALUE') AND COALESCE(t1.app_version_code, 'NULL_VALUE') = COALESCE(t2.app_version_code, 'NULL_VALUE') AND COALESCE(t1.device, 'NULL_VALUE') = COALESCE(t2.device, 'NULL_VALUE') AND COALESCE(t1.review_text, 'NULL_VALUE') = COALESCE(t2.review_text, 'NULL_VALUE') AND COALESCE(t1.review_last_update_date_and_time, 'NULL_VALUE') = COALESCE(t2.review_last_update_date_and_time, 'NULL_VALUE') WHERE NOT t1.review_last_update_date_and_time IS NULL AND t2.package_name IS NULL AND t2.app_version_code IS NULL AND t2.device IS NULL AND t2.review_text IS NULL AND t2.review_last_update_date_and_time IS NULL

name: adjust_data_point
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: yandiqin@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-05 10:53:43.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adbi.adjust_data_points_usage_total ( */ /*     day STRING COMMENT '日期', */ /*     daily_usage BIGINT COMMENT '当日消耗', */ /*     cumulative_usage BIGINT COMMENT '累计消耗', */ /*     remaining_balance BIGINT COMMENT '剩余余额', */ /*     rem_pct DOUBLE COMMENT '剩余百分比', */ /*     days_remaining BIGINT COMMENT '剩余天数', */ /*     daily_allowance_int BIGINT COMMENT '剩余天均可用点数' */ /* ) COMMENT 'Adjust数据点消耗追踪表' PARTITIONED BY (p_date STRING COMMENT '报告日期分区') STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/advertisement_bi/adbi/adjust_data_points_usage_total'; */ WITH daily_agg AS (SELECT DAY, CAST(SUM((CASE WHEN network IN ('Google Ads ACI', 'Google Organic Search', 'Facebook Installs', 'Instagram Installs', 'Google Ads (Ad Spend)', 'Facebook (Ad Spend)') THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(impressions, 0) END) + COALESCE(clicks, 0) + COALESCE(sessions, 0) + COALESCE(events, 0)) AS BIGINT) AS daily_data_points FROM adbi.adjust_data_points_usage WHERE logymd >= '2026-02-11' GROUP BY DAY), running_metrics AS (SELECT DAY, daily_data_points, SUM(daily_data_points) OVER (ORDER BY DAY ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_usage, CAST(138453731545 AS BIGINT) AS base_balance FROM daily_agg) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.adjust_data_points_usage_total PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT CAST(DAY AS STRING) AS DAY /* 1. day */, CAST(daily_data_points AS BIGINT) AS daily_usage /* 2. daily_usage */, CAST(cum_usage AS BIGINT) AS cumulative_usage /* 3. cumulative_usage */, CAST((base_balance - cum_usage) AS BIGINT) AS remaining_balance /* 4. remaining_balance */, CAST(ROUND((base_balance - cum_usage) / 138453731545 * 100, 4) AS DOUBLE) AS rem_pct /* 5. rem_pct */, CAST(DATEDIFF(CAST('2026-09-25' AS DATE), CAST(DAY AS DATE)) AS BIGINT) AS days_remaining /* 6. days_remaining */, CAST(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CAST('2026-09-25' AS DATE), CAST(DAY AS DATE)) > 0 THEN (base_balance - cum_usage) / DATEDIFF(CAST('2026-09-25' AS DATE), CAST(DAY AS DATE)) ELSE 0 END AS BIGINT) AS daily_allowance_int /* 7. daily_allowance_int */ FROM running_metrics

name: adbi.dwa_admkt_align_ad_cost_report_df
sql_units: WITH adjust_new_user AS (SELECT app_id, media_source, country, data_date, os, campaign_id, adset_id, ad_id, campaign_name, adset_name, ad_name, did_new_user FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_app_mmp_delivery_adjust_report_df)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND did_new_user > 0), adjust_new_user_agg AS (SELECT app_id, media_source, country, data_date, SUM(did_new_user) AS did_new_user FROM adjust_new_user GROUP BY app_id, media_source, country, data_date), cpi_cost_config AS (SELECT a.*, IF(a.day_limit IS NULL, cpi_bid, LEAST(a.day_limit / b.did_new_user, cpi_bid)) AS cpi_bid_new FROM (SELECT app_id, media_source, country, data_date, cpi_bid, day_limit, ad_target, id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, media_source, country, data_date ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(ARRAY_DATE(start_date, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(end_date), '') = '' OR end_date > '2026-05-31', '2026-05-31', end_date), FALSE)) AS data_date, app_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(media_source), '') = '', 'unknown', MAPPING('media_source', media_source)) AS media_source, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country)) AS country, IF(cost_type IS NULL, 1, cost_type) AS ad_target, CAST(cpi_bid AS DOUBLE) AS cpi_bid, IF(day_limit = CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10, 2)), NULL, CAST(day_limit AS DOUBLE)) AS day_limit, updated_at, id FROM adbi.gms_ad_bi_cpi_bid_info WHERE pdate = '20260531' AND is_deleted = 0 AND (COALESCE(TRIM(end_date), '') = '' OR start_date <= end_date) AND start_date <= '2026-05-31' AND cpi_bid <> CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10, 2)))) AS a JOIN adjust_new_user_agg AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.media_source = b.media_source AND a.data_date = b.data_date AND a.country = b.country WHERE a.rn = 1), cost_deduction_config AS (SELECT app_id, media_source, country, data_date, id, ad_target, -cost_deduction / IF(COALESCE(did_new_user_in_id, 0) = 0, dates_in_id, did_new_user_in_id) AS cost_deduction_avg, IF(COALESCE(did_new_user_in_id, 0) = 0, 0, 1) AS exist_adjust_user FROM (SELECT a.app_id, a.media_source, a.country, a.data_date, cost_deduction, ad_target, id, SUM(did_new_user) OVER (PARTITION BY id) AS did_new_user_in_id, COUNT(a.data_date) OVER (PARTITION BY id) AS dates_in_id FROM (SELECT app_id, media_source, country, data_date, cost_deduction, ad_target, id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, media_source, country, data_date ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(ARRAY_DATE(start_date, end_date, FALSE)) AS data_date, app_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(media_source), '') = '', 'unknown', MAPPING('media_source', media_source)) AS media_source, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country)) AS country, IF(cost_type IS NULL, 1, cost_type) AS ad_target, CAST(cost_deduction AS DOUBLE) AS cost_deduction, updated_at, id FROM adbi.gms_ad_bi_cost_deduction_info WHERE pdate = '20260531' AND is_deleted = 0 AND start_date <= end_date AND COALESCE(cost_deduction, 0) <> 0 AND start_date <= '2026-05-31')) AS a LEFT JOIN adjust_new_user_agg AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.media_source = b.media_source AND a.data_date = b.data_date AND a.country = b.country WHERE a.rn = 1)), cost_df AS (SELECT a.app_id, a.media_source, a.country, a.data_date AS report_date, os, campaign_id, adset_id, ad_id, campaign_name, adset_name, ad_name, a.did_new_user * b.cpi_bid_new AS cost, b.ad_target, '1' AS align_type, id AS config_id FROM adjust_new_user AS a JOIN cpi_cost_config AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.media_source = b.media_source AND a.data_date = b.data_date AND a.country = b.country UNION ALL SELECT a.app_id, a.media_source, a.country, a.data_date AS report_date, a.os, campaign_id, adset_id, ad_id, campaign_name, adset_name, ad_name, a.did_new_user * b.cost_deduction_avg AS cost, b.ad_target, '2' AS align_type, id AS config_id FROM adjust_new_user AS a JOIN cost_deduction_config AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.media_source = b.media_source AND a.data_date = b.data_date AND a.country = b.country AND exist_adjust_user = 1 UNION ALL SELECT app_id, media_source, country, data_date AS report_date, 'unknown' AS os, '' AS campaign_id, '' AS adset_id, '' AS ad_id, NULL AS campaign_name, NULL AS adset_name, NULL AS ad_name, cost_deduction_avg AS cost, ad_target, '3' AS align_type, id AS config_id FROM cost_deduction_config WHERE exist_adjust_user = 0) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(out_table)) SELECT align_type, report_date, app_id, NULL AS app_name, media_source, country, os, NULL AS ad_account_id, campaign_id, campaign_name, adset_id, adset_name, ad_id, ad_name, cost, ad_target, config_id FROM cost_df

devicemode, isfiwi, bytescore, subtype, upload, download, loginid, logymd, SPLIT(f1.part, '-')[0] AS source_type, CAST(SPLIT(f1.part, '-')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS traffic_bytes, '上行流量' AS source_field, '' AND NOT SPLIT(f1.part, '-')[0] IS NULL AND CAST(SPLIT(f1.part, '-')[1] AS DOUBLE) <> 0), reportinfo_exploded_download AS (SELECT time, loghms, ip, zoneid, accountid, level, startup_time, game_channel, stage, battleid, reportindex, reportinfo, deviceid, devicemode, isfiwi, bytescore, subtype, upload, download, loginid, logymd, SPLIT(f1.part, '-')[0] AS source_type, CAST(SPLIT(f1.part, '-')[2] AS DOUBLE) AS traffic_bytes, '下行流量' AS source_field, '协议流量' AS traffic_type /* reportinfo对应netinfo类型 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_nettraffic_monitor LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(reportinfo, ',')) f1 AS part WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND f1.part <> '' AND NOT SPLIT(f1.part, '-')[0] IS NULL AND CAST(SPLIT(f1.part, '-')[2] AS DOUBLE) <> 0), download_exploded AS (SELECT time, loghms, ip, ':')[0] AS source_type, CAST(SPLIT(f2.part, ':')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS traffic_bytes, '下行流量' AS source_field, '增量流量' AS traffic_type /* download对应下载类型 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_nettraffic_monitor LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(download, ',')) f2 AS part WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND f2.part <> '' AND NOT SPLIT(f2.part, ':')[0] IS NULL AND CAST(SPLIT(f2.part, ':')[1] AS DOUBLE) <> 0), upload_exploded AS (SELECT time, loghms, ip, zoneid, accountid, level, startup_time, game_channel, stage, battleid, reportindex, reportinfo, deviceid, devicemode, isfiwi, bytescore, subtype, upload, download, loginid, logymd, SPLIT(f3.part, ':')[0] AS source_type, CAST(SPLIT(f3.part, ':')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS traffic_bytes, '上行流量' AS source_field, '增量流量' AS traffic_type /* upload对应上传类型 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_nettraffic_monitor LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(upload, ',')) f3 AS part WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND f3.part <> '' AND NOT SPLIT(f3.part, ':')[0] IS NULL AND CAST(SPLIT(f3.part, ':')[1] AS DOUBLE) <> 0), combined_data AS (/* 合并所有explode结果 */ SELECT * FROM reportinfo_exploded_upload UNION ALL SELECT * FROM reportinfo_exploded_download UNION ALL SELECT * FROM download_exploded UNION ALL SELECT * FROM upload_exploded), union_traffic_data AS (SELECT CAST(time AS STRING) AS time, loghms, ip, CAST(zoneid AS STRING) AS zoneid, CAST(accountid AS STRING) AS accountid, CAST(level AS STRING) AS level, CAST(startup_time AS STRING) AS startup_time, game_channel, stage, CAST(battleid AS STRING) AS battleid, CAST(reportindex AS STRING) AS reportindex, reportinfo, deviceid, devicemode, CAST(isfiwi AS STRING) AS isfiwi, bytescore, CAST(subtype AS STRING) AS subtype, upload, download, CAST(loginid AS STRING) AS loginid, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time) AS timestamp_user, source_type, SUM(traffic_bytes) / 1024 / 1024 AS traffic_byte_mb, source_field, traffic_type FROM combined_data AS all_data WHERE NOT traffic_bytes IS NULL GROUP BY time, loghms, ip, zoneid, accountid, level, startup_time, game_channel, stage, battleid, reportindex, reportinfo, deviceid, devicemode, isfiwi, bytescore, subtype, upload, download, loginid, source_type, source_field,
