name: 03_赛季特征数据
sql_units: /* ============================================================ */ /* 赛季日历表：2022年起每日对应赛季阶段及阶段内天数 */ /* 目标表：mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_season_daily_v1 */ /* 分区字段：logymd */ /* ============================================================ */ /* Step 1: 建表（首次执行） */ /* drop table if exists mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_season_daily_v1; */ /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_season_daily_v1 ( */ /*     data_date       string  comment '日期', */ /*     season          STRING  COMMENT '赛季名称', */ /*     season_phase    STRING  COMMENT '赛季阶段：赛季初/赛季中/赛季末', */ /*     phase_day       INT     COMMENT '当前阶段第几天（从1开始）', */ /*     season_day      INT     COMMENT '赛季整体第几天（从1开始）', */ /*     phase_start     STRING  COMMENT '当前阶段开始日期', */ /*     phase_end       STRING  COMMENT '当前阶段结束日期' */ /* ) */ /* PARTITIONED by (`logymd` STRING) */ /* stored as parquet LOCATION "s3a://moonton-hadoop/user/crystal/crystal_tmp_season_daily_v1" */ /* Step 2: 写入数据 */ WITH date_series /* 2a. 生成 2022-01-01 至今每一天 */ AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS logymd FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(TO_DATE('2022-01-01'), ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, 12))) AS dt) AS t), season_config /* 2b. 读取最新赛季配置（取最新分区，避免重复） */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT season, SUBSTRING(season_starttime, 1, 10) AS season_start /* 取日期部分（兼容 'yyyy-MM-dd' 和 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss' 两种格式） */, SUBSTRING(season_endtime, 1, 10) AS season_end, SUBSTRING(season_first_starttime, 1, 10) AS first_start, SUBSTRING(season_first_endtime, 1, 10) AS first_end, SUBSTRING(season_mid_starttime, 1, 10) AS mid_start, SUBSTRING(season_mid_endtime, 1, 10) AS mid_end, SUBSTRING(season_last_starttime, 1, 10) AS last_start, SUBSTRING(season_last_endtime, 1, 10) AS last_end FROM mt_dim.dim_season_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), daily_season /* 2c. 每日 JOIN 赛季配置，计算阶段及天数 */ AS (SELECT d.logymd AS data_date, s.season, CASE WHEN d.logymd BETWEEN s.first_start AND s.first_end THEN '赛季初' WHEN d.logymd BETWEEN s.mid_start AND s.mid_end THEN '赛季中' WHEN d.logymd BETWEEN s.last_start AND s.last_end THEN '赛季末' END AS season_phase /* 赛季阶段 */, CASE WHEN d.logymd BETWEEN s.first_start AND s.first_end THEN DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(d.logymd), TO_DATE(s.first_start)) + 1 WHEN d.logymd BETWEEN s.mid_start AND s.mid_end THEN DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(d.logymd), TO_DATE(s.mid_start)) + 1 WHEN d.logymd BETWEEN s.last_start AND s.last_end THEN DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(d.logymd), TO_DATE(s.last_start)) + 1 END AS phase_day /* 当前阶段第几天 */, DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(d.logymd), TO_DATE(s.season_start)) /* 赛季整体第几天 */ + 1 AS season_day, CASE WHEN d.logymd BETWEEN s.first_start AND s.first_end THEN s.first_start WHEN d.logymd BETWEEN s.mid_start AND s.mid_end THEN s.mid_start WHEN d.logymd BETWEEN s.last_start AND s.last_end THEN s.last_start END AS phase_start /* 阶段起止日期（方便下游使用） */, CASE WHEN d.logymd BETWEEN s.first_start AND s.first_end THEN s.first_end WHEN d.logymd BETWEEN s.mid_start AND s.mid_end THEN s.mid_end WHEN d.logymd BETWEEN s.last_start AND s.last_end THEN s.last_end END AS phase_end FROM date_series AS d /* 先限定在赛季周期内，再精确匹配阶段 */ INNER JOIN season_config AS s ON d.logymd BETWEEN s.season_start AND s.season_end /* 只保留落在三个阶段之一的日期（排除赛季间隔期） */ WHERE d.logymd BETWEEN s.first_start AND s.first_end OR d.logymd BETWEEN s.mid_start AND s.mid_end OR d.logymd BETWEEN s.last_start AND s.last_end) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_season_daily_v1 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT data_date, season, season_phase, phase_day, season_day, phase_start, phase_end FROM daily_season ORDER BY data_date

name: 【llm_input】VP识破_创表
sql_units: /* 写入 */ /* 清洗逻辑 */ /* 将1|或者2|统一替换为"" */ WITH clean AS (SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE(content, '[12]\\|', '') AS text, CASE WHEN chat_scene = 1 THEN 'friend' WHEN chat_scene = 2 THEN 'room' WHEN chat_scene = 3 THEN 'team' ELSE chat_scene END AS chat_name, * FROM ml_ods.vpagentserver_vp_game_visible_chat WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND chat_scene IN (1, 2)), chat AS (SELECT * FROM clean WHERE text <> '' AND NOT (text RLIKE /* 去除送礼 */ '[x×X]\\s*\\d+' OR text RLIKE /* 去除战绩播报 */ '\\d+/\\d+/\\d+' OR text RLIKE /* 去除纯表情 */ '^(#\\d+[ ,]*)+$' OR text RLIKE /* 去除纯快捷语 */ '^\\s*\\d{5,6}(,\\s*\\d{5,6})*\\s*$')), room AS (SELECT DISTINCT roomid, speaker FROM ml_ods.vpagentserver_vp_game_visible_chat WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND chat_scene = 2) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.vp_game_visible_chat_dialogue PARTITION(logymd, env) SELECT SPLIT(tag, '_')[0] AS vp_roleid, SPLIT(tag, '_')[1] AS vp_zoneid /* 待调整 */, SPLIT(tag, '_')[2] AS rp_roleid, 0 AS rp_zoneid /* 待调整 */, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT('"[', loghms, '][', chat_name, '] ', speaker, ': ', text, '"')))) AS texts, logymd AS chat_logymd, logymd, IF(zone < 57, 'prod', 'test') AS env FROM (SELECT * FROM (/* VP房间发言 */ SELECT CONCAT(chat.vp_roleid, '_', chat.vp_zoneid, '_', room.speaker) AS tag /* 待调整 */, text, chat_name, loghms, vp_roleid, chat.speaker, time, FLOOR(vp_zoneid / 1000) AS zone, logymd FROM chat INNER JOIN room ON chat.speaker = chat.vp_roleid AND chat.roomid = room.roomid AND chat.vp_roleid <> room.speaker UNION ALL /* 非 VP房间发言 */ SELECT CASE WHEN target <> 0 AND speaker <> vp_roleid THEN CONCAT(vp_roleid, '_', vp_zoneid, '_', speaker) /* 私聊 */ WHEN target <> 0 AND speaker = vp_roleid THEN CONCAT(vp_roleid, '_', vp_zoneid, '_', target) /* 私聊 */ WHEN target = 0 AND speaker <> vp_roleid THEN CONCAT(vp_roleid, '_', vp_zoneid, '_', speaker) /* 房间 */ END AS tag, text, chat_name, loghms, vp_roleid, speaker, time, FLOOR(vp_zoneid / 1000) AS zone, logymd FROM chat) ORDER BY tag, time ASC) GROUP BY tag, IF(zone < 57, 'prod', 'test'), logymd

name: 01_mcgg_dau_data
sql_units: /* ================================================================= */ /* MCGG DAU 数据临时表 */ /* 维度: logymd × (全球 + 分国家 + 新增 + 留存) */ /* 源表: mcgg_ods.gameserver_login / mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_df */ /* 过滤: zoneid 1000~20000 / fake_ai=0 / is_vp=0 */ /* 变量: ${START_DATE} / ${END_DATE} 由调用方替换（默认截止昨天） */ /* ================================================================= */ /* ================================================================ */ /* Table 1: 全球每日 DAU */ /* ================================================================ */ /* DROP TABLE IF EXISTS mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_mcgg_dau_global; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_mcgg_dau_global /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* AS */ SELECT logymd AS data_date, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid) AS dau FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 20000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_vp = 0 GROUP BY logymd ORDER BY logymd

/* DROP TABLE IF EXISTS mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_mcgg_dau_country; */ /* CREATE TABLE mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_mcgg_dau_country */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* AS */ /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_mcgg_dau_country ( */ /*     data_date  STRING   COMMENT '数据日期', */ /*     country    STRING   COMMENT '国家（小写，unknown 表示未知）', */ /*     dau        BIGINT   COMMENT '日活用户数（去重 roleid+zoneid）' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT 'MCGG 分国家日活用户数' */ /* stored as parquet LOCATION "s3a://moonton-hadoop/user/crystal/crystal_tmp_mcgg_dau_country" */ /* ; */ /* ================================================================ */ /* Table 2: 分国家每日 DAU */ /* 国家映射来自 aprilgao_mc2_newuser_df 最新分区（全量快照） */ /* ================================================================ */ WITH user_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, LOWER(COALESCE(ip_country, 'unknown')) AS country FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), daily_login AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 20000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_vp = 0 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_mcgg_dau_country SELECT dl.logymd AS data_date, COALESCE(uc.country, 'unknown') AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT dl.roleid, dl.zoneid) AS dau FROM daily_login AS dl LEFT JOIN user_country AS uc ON dl.roleid = uc.roleid AND dl.zoneid = uc.zoneid GROUP BY dl.logymd, COALESCE(uc.country, 'unknown') ORDER BY dl.logymd, country

/* ================================================================ */ /* Table 3: 分国家每日新增用户 */ /* ================================================================ */ /* DROP TABLE IF EXISTS mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_mcgg_new_users; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_mcgg_new_users /* as */ SELECT usercreateymd AS register_date, LOWER(COALESCE(ip_country, 'unknown')) AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid) AS new_users FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY usercreateymd, LOWER(COALESCE(ip_country, 'unknown')) ORDER BY register_date, country

/* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_mcgg_retention ( */ /*     reg_date   STRING    COMMENT '注册日期', */ /*     country    STRING    COMMENT '国家（小写）', */ /*     new_cnt    BIGINT    COMMENT '新增用户数', */ /*     d1_cnt     BIGINT    COMMENT 'D1 留存人数', */ /*     d3_cnt     BIGINT    COMMENT 'D3 留存人数', */ /*     d7_cnt     BIGINT    COMMENT 'D7 留存人数', */ /*     d14_cnt    BIGINT    COMMENT 'D14 留存人数', */ /*     d30_cnt    BIGINT    COMMENT 'D30 留存人数', */ /*     d1_rate    DOUBLE    COMMENT 'D1 留存率', */ /*     d3_rate    DOUBLE    COMMENT 'D3 留存率', */ /*     d7_rate    DOUBLE    COMMENT 'D7 留存率', */ /*     d14_rate   DOUBLE    COMMENT 'D14 留存率', */ /*     d30_rate   DOUBLE    COMMENT 'D30 留存率' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT 'MCGG 分国家新用户留存汇总（临时表）' */ /* stored as parquet LOCATION "s3a://moonton-hadoop/user/crystal/crystal_tmp_mcgg_retention" */ /* ; */ /* ================================================================ */ /* Table 4: N 日留存率（D1/D3/D7/D14/D30） */ /* 注册窗口: [END_DATE-90, END_DATE-30]，保留 30 天观察期确保 D30 完整 */ /* ================================================================ */ /* DROP TABLE IF EXISTS mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_mcgg_retention; */ /* CREATE TABLE mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_mcgg_retention */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* AS */ WITH new_users AS (SELECT usercreateymd AS reg_date, roleid, zoneid, LOWER(COALESCE(ip_country, 'unknown')) AS country FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc2_newuser_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), login_activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND zoneid BETWEEN 1000 AND 20000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND is_vp = 0) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.crystal_tmp_mcgg_retention SELECT nu.reg_date, nu.country, COUNT(DISTINCT nu.roleid, nu.zoneid) AS new_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(la.logymd, nu.reg_date) = 1 THEN CONCAT(nu.roleid, '_', nu.zoneid) END) AS d1_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(la.logymd, nu.reg_date) = 3 THEN CONCAT(nu.roleid, '_', nu.zoneid) END) AS d3_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(la.logymd, nu.reg_date) = 7 THEN CONCAT(nu.roleid, '_', nu.zoneid) END) AS d7_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(la.logymd, nu.reg_date) = 14 THEN CONCAT(nu.roleid, '_', nu.zoneid) END) AS d14_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(la.logymd, nu.reg_date) = 30 THEN CONCAT(nu.roleid, '_', nu.zoneid) END) AS d30_cnt, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(la.logymd, nu.reg_date) = 1 THEN CONCAT(nu.roleid, '_', nu.zoneid) END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT nu.roleid, nu.zoneid), 0), 4) AS d1_rate, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(la.logymd, nu.reg_date) = 3 THEN CONCAT(nu.roleid, '_', nu.zoneid) END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT nu.roleid, nu.zoneid), 0), 4) AS d3_rate, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(la.logymd, nu.reg_date) = 7 THEN CONCAT(nu.roleid, '_', nu.zoneid) END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT nu.roleid, nu.zoneid), 0), 4) AS d7_rate, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(la.logymd, nu.reg_date) = 14 THEN CONCAT(nu.roleid, '_', nu.zoneid) END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT nu.roleid, nu.zoneid), 0), 4) AS d14_rate, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(la.logymd, nu.reg_date) = 30 THEN CONCAT(nu.roleid, '_', nu.zoneid) END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT nu.roleid, nu.zoneid), 0), 4) AS d30_rate FROM new_users AS nu LEFT JOIN login_activity AS la ON nu.roleid = la.roleid AND nu.zoneid = la.zoneid AND DATEDIFF(la.logymd, nu.reg_date) IN (1, 3, 7, 14, 30) GROUP BY nu.reg_date, nu.country ORDER BY nu.reg_date, nu.country

name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_mcgg_charge_order_di_test
sql_units: WITH paychannel_rate AS (/* -- 正式表 */ /* SELECT */ /*     DISTINCT */ /*     start_day, country, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, rate, share, is_tax, is_pay_tax, is_back_tax, is_fuzzy_match, has_share_tax */ /*     , LEAD(start_day, 1, CURRENT_DATE()) OVER(PARTITION BY country, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel ORDER BY start_day) AS end_day */ /* FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_rate_di d1 */ /* WHERE  logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2025-03-03', '2025-03-03', '2026-05-31') */ /* AND   TRIM(LOWER(appid)) = 'mcgg' */ /* 上线前回刷 */ SELECT DISTINCT start_day, TRIM(LOWER(country)) AS country, TRIM(LOWER(pay_channel)) AS pay_channel, TRIM(LOWER(sub_pay_channel)) AS sub_pay_channel, rate, share, is_tax, is_pay_tax, is_back_tax, is_fuzzy_match, has_share_tax, LEAD(TRIM(start_day), 1, '9999-12-31') OVER (PARTITION BY TRIM(LOWER(country)), TRIM(LOWER(pay_channel)), TRIM(LOWER(sub_pay_channel)) ORDER BY TRIM(start_day)) AS end_day FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_rate_di AS d1 WHERE d1.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mcgg'), paychannel_fee /* 渠道手续费: 跨游戏项目不通用, 人工运维 */ AS (/* -- 正式表 */ /* SELECT country, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, fee_currency, fee_amt */ /* FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_fee_di */ /* WHERE appid = 'mcgg' AND logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2025-03-03', '2025-03-03', '2026-05-31') */ /* 上线前回刷 */ SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(LOWER(country)) AS country, TRIM(LOWER(pay_channel)) AS pay_channel, TRIM(LOWER(sub_pay_channel)) AS sub_pay_channel, TRIM(UPPER(fee_currency)) AS fee_currency, fee_amt FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_fee_di AS d1 WHERE d1.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mcgg'), productmoney_change /* 商品价格调整配置： */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, country, ip_country, product_id, currency, original_amt, change_amt, start_date, end_date FROM mt_dim.dim_mcgg_productmoney_change_df WHERE logymd > '0' AND logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_mcgg_productmoney_change_df WHERE logymd > '0' AND TRIM(LOWER(appid)) = 'mcgg') AND TRIM(LOWER(appid)) = 'mcgg'), charge_country_calibrated /* ODS支付订单流水: 充值校准 bill currency、bill_amt 校准 */ AS (SELECT `time`, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, sex, device, os_type, createrole_country, client_ip, channel, product_id, base_diamond, chargediamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_id, product, device_id, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, is_iap_token_buy, operator, interfacetype, a.currency, localprice, money, local_currency, local_price, money_new, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, logymd, mix_pay_channel, bill_country, game_pay_channel AS pay_channel_name, bill_currency, bill_amt, currency_exchange_rate AS exchange_rate, fee_exchange_rate FROM mt_dwd.dwd_mcgg_charge_order_di AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), charge_final /* 充值校准: 商品价格调整 end */ AS (SELECT `time`, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, sex, device, os_type, createrole_country, client_ip, channel, a.product_id, base_diamond, chargediamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_id, product, device_id, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, is_iap_token_buy, operator, interfacetype, a.currency, localprice, money, local_currency, local_price, money_new, a.pay_channel, a.sub_pay_channel, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, a.logymd, a.mix_pay_channel, a.bill_country, pay_channel_name, bill_currency, COALESCE(b.change_amt, a.bill_amt) AS bill_amt, exchange_rate, fee_exchange_rate FROM charge_country_calibrated AS a LEFT JOIN productmoney_change AS b ON DATE_FORMAT(a.time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') >= b.start_date AND DATE_FORMAT(a.time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') < b.end_date AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(b.pay_channel) AND LOWER(IF(COALESCE(a.sub_pay_channel, '') = '', '-', a.sub_pay_channel)) = LOWER(b.sub_pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.bill_country) = LOWER(b.country) AND LOWER(a.product_id) = LOWER(b.product_id) AND LOWER(a.bill_currency) = LOWER(b.currency)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_mcgg_charge_order_di_test PARTITION(logymd) SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel AS login_channel, chargediamond, LOWER(createrole_country) AS createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product /* 默认值 */, IF(COALESCE(operator, '') = '', 'unknown', operator) AS operator, IF(COALESCE(interfacetype, '') = '', 'unknown', interfacetype) AS interfacetype, currency, localprice, COALESCE(is_sandbox, 0) AS is_sandbox /* MCGG不需要判断这个逻辑，仅保留字段 */, iap_product_type, sub_pay_channel, COALESCE(IF(DATE_FORMAT(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') <= '2017-06-13 02:44:26', 0, is_iap_token_buy), 0) AS is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, bill_country, UPPER(bill_currency) AS bill_currency, COALESCE(exchange_rate, 0) AS currency_exchange_rate, bill_amt, before_tax_currency, COALESCE(before_tax_amt, 0) AS before_tax_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(after_tax_currency, 'unknown')) AS after_tax_currency, COALESCE(after_tax_amt, 0) AS after_tax_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(actual_currency, 'unknown')) AS actual_currency, COALESCE(actual_amt, 0) AS actual_amt, COALESCE(tax_rate, 0) AS tax_rate, UPPER(COALESCE(tax_currency, 'unknown')) AS tax_currency, IF(COALESCE(is_pay_tax, '否') = '是', plat_tax_amt, 0) AS tax_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(back_tax_currency, 'unknown')) AS back_tax_currency, IF(COALESCE(is_back_tax, '否') = '是', plat_tax_amt, 0) AS back_tax_amt, COALESCE(share_ratio, 0) AS share_ratio, UPPER(COALESCE(share_currency, 'unknown')) AS share_currency, COALESCE(share_amt, 0) AS share_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(fee_currency, 'unknown')) AS fee_currency, COALESCE(fee_amt, 0) AS fee_amt, COALESCE(fee_exchange_rate, 0) AS fee_exchange_rate, pay_channel_name AS game_pay_channel, mix_pay_channel, logymd FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN has_share_tax = '不含税' THEN after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate WHEN has_share_tax = '含税' THEN before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate WHEN has_share_tax = '净额' THEN (before_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate) / (1 + tax_rate) ELSE after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate END AS actual_amt /* 实收 */ FROM (SELECT *, before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt AS after_tax_amt /* 税后 */, CASE WHEN has_share_tax = '不含税' THEN (before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt) * share_ratio WHEN has_share_tax IN ('含税', '净额') THEN before_tax_amt * share_ratio ELSE (before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt) * share_ratio END AS share_amt /* 分成 */ FROM (SELECT *, COALESCE(fee_amt / fee_exchange_rate, 0) AS fee_usd_amt /* 手续费 */, CASE WHEN has_share_tax IN ('不含税', '含税') THEN COALESCE(before_tax_amt / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate, 0) WHEN has_share_tax = '净额' THEN COALESCE(((before_tax_amt * (1 - share_ratio) - COALESCE(fee_amt / fee_exchange_rate, 0) * exchange_rate) / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate), 0) ELSE COALESCE(before_tax_amt / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate, 0) END AS plat_tax_amt /* 税金 */ FROM (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, a.pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, a.currency, localprice, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, a.sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, a.logymd, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, mix_pay_channel, bill_currency, bill_country, bill_amt, pay_channel_name /* , IF(bill_currency = 'USD' */ /*         , CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(38,18)) */ /*         , CASE WHEN b.exchange_rate IS NULL AND bill_currency = 'BAM' THEN CAST(1 / 0.558454 AS DECIMAL(38, 18))   */ /*             WHEN b.exchange_rate IS NULL AND bill_currency = 'SLE' THEN CAST(1 / 0.0466810 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) */ /*             WHEN b.exchange_rate IS NULL AND bill_currency = 'HKR' THEN CAST(1 / 0.143622 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) */ /*             ELSE CAST(b.exchange_rate AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) END */ /* ) AS exchange_rate                                                                                      -- 最开始不是XE的，之前用的没有这三个货币，做了兜底机制，可以再看看有就可以去掉（仅HKR保留） */ /* , IF(COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency, '') = 'USD' */ /*         , CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) */ /*         , CASE WHEN k.exchange_rate IS NULL AND COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency, '') = 'BAM' THEN CAST(1 / 0.558454 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) */ /*             WHEN k.exchange_rate IS NULL AND COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency, '') = 'SLE' THEN CAST(1 / 0.0466810 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) */ /*             WHEN k.exchange_rate IS NULL AND COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency, '') = 'HKR' THEN CAST(1 / 0.143622 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) */ /*             ELSE CAST(k.exchange_rate AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) END */ /* ) AS fee_exchange_rate */, a.fee_exchange_rate, a.exchange_rate, CAST(COALESCE(c.rate, d.rate, e.rate, f.rate, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) AS tax_rate, CAST(COALESCE(c.share, d.share, e.share, f.share, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) AS share_ratio, COALESCE(c.is_tax, d.is_tax, e.is_tax, f.is_tax) AS is_tax, COALESCE(c.is_pay_tax, d.is_pay_tax, e.is_pay_tax, f.is_pay_tax) AS is_pay_tax, COALESCE(c.is_back_tax, d.is_back_tax, e.is_back_tax, f.is_back_tax) AS is_back_tax, COALESCE(c.has_share_tax, d.has_share_tax, e.has_share_tax, f.has_share_tax) AS has_share_tax, COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency) AS fee_currency, IF((LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = 'ph_dragonpay_gcash' AND LOWER(a.product_id) IN ('diamond_codashopphp_dragonpay_gcash_10', 'diamond_codashopphp_dragonpay_gcash_20')) OR (a.pay_channel = 81 AND UPPER(a.sub_pay_channel) = 'CODA_SHOP_PH_GCASH_EWALLET' AND LOWER(a.product_id) IN ('com.moonton.diamond_mt_ph_5_mt_ph3rdpayment', 'com.moonton.diamond_mt_ph_10_mt_ph3rdpayment', 'com.moonton.diamond_mt_ph_20_mt_ph3rdpayment')), 0, CAST(COALESCE(g.fee_amt, h.fee_amt, i.fee_amt, j.fee_amt, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) * 100) AS fee_amt /* 保留：低档位商品不收取手续费，否则金额是负的（后续如果发现MCGG有 actualamont 有负值 ，有可能需要在这里加判断） */, bill_currency AS before_tax_currency, bill_currency AS after_tax_currency, bill_currency AS actual_currency, bill_currency AS tax_currency, bill_currency AS back_tax_currency, bill_currency AS share_currency /* 税前 */, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.is_tax, d.is_tax, e.is_tax, f.is_tax) = '是' THEN CAST(bill_amt AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) ELSE CAST(bill_amt AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) * (1 + CAST(COALESCE(c.rate, d.rate, e.rate, f.rate, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18))) END AS before_tax_amt /* 这个记得是0/1，是这里需要确认下，账单的 vs 支付的 */ FROM charge_final AS a /* LEFT JOIN currency_exchange b */ /* ON UPPER(a.bill_currency) = UPPER(b.currency) */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_rate WHERE country <> '-' AND sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS c ON a.bill_country = LOWER(c.country) AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(c.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(c.sub_pay_channel) AND a.logymd >= c.start_day AND a.logymd < c.end_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_rate WHERE country = '-' AND sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS d ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(d.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(d.sub_pay_channel) AND a.logymd >= d.start_day AND a.logymd < d.end_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_rate WHERE country <> '-' AND sub_pay_channel = '-') AS e ON a.bill_country = LOWER(e.country) AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(e.pay_channel) AND a.logymd >= e.start_day AND a.logymd < e.end_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_rate WHERE country = '-' AND sub_pay_channel = '-') AS f ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(f.pay_channel) AND a.logymd >= f.start_day AND a.logymd < f.end_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_fee WHERE country <> '-' AND sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS g ON a.bill_country = LOWER(g.country) AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(g.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(g.sub_pay_channel) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_fee WHERE country = '-' AND sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS h ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(h.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(h.sub_pay_channel) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_fee WHERE country <> '-' AND sub_pay_channel = '-') AS i ON a.bill_country = LOWER(i.country) AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(i.pay_channel) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_fee WHERE country = '-' AND sub_pay_channel = '-') AS j ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(j.pay_channel)) AS t) AS t1) AS t2) AS t3

name: 平均活跃天数
sql_units: WITH tag_info AS (SELECT MIN(logymd) AS logymd, accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, param_version, param_name FROM mcgg_ods.abtestserver_abtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND param_name LIKE '%aimatch%' AND param_version <> '' GROUP BY accountid, old_zoneid, param_version, param_name), match_end AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, groupsel, logymd, param_version, strategy_label FROM mcgg_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000), all_player AS (SELECT c.param_name, c.param_version, c.vid, a.roleid, a.login_logymd, a.battle_logymd, min_logymd, MAX(big_rank) AS big_rank FROM (/* 主表 */ SELECT DISTINCT roleid, login_logymd, big_rank, battle_logymd FROM mcgg_temp.mcgg_aimatch_online_ab_active_battle_gaoy WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31') AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN param_version = MAX(param_version) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) THEN '实验组' WHEN param_version = MIN(param_version) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name) THEN '对照组' END AS param_version, param_version AS vid, param_name, MIN(logymd) AS min_logymd FROM (SELECT DISTINCT logymd, roleid, zoneid, param_version, param_name FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-05-31' AND param_name LIKE '%aimatch%' AND param_version <> '' /* 0625实验存在空值 */ AND zoneid < 57000 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT logymd, roleid, zoneid, param_version, param_name FROM tag_info) AS a GROUP BY roleid, param_version, param_name) AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.login_logymd >= c.min_logymd JOIN (SELECT accountid, zoneid, param_version FROM (SELECT a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.param_version, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS ttcnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(groupsel = 24, battleid, NULL)) AS battle24_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(groupsel = 24, battleid, NULL)) / COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS rate FROM match_end AS a JOIN tag_info AS b ON a.accountid = b.roleid AND a.param_version = b.param_version AND a.logymd >= b.logymd GROUP BY a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.param_version) WHERE rate >= STRUCT(STRUCT(rate))) AS d ON c.roleid = d.accountid AND c.vid = d.param_version GROUP BY c.param_name, c.param_version, c.vid, a.roleid, a.login_logymd, a.battle_logymd, min_logymd), active_battle AS (SELECT vid, a.roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.login_logymd) AS login_days, COUNT(DISTINCT a.battle_logymd) AS battle_days FROM all_player AS a GROUP BY a.roleid, vid), active_battle_14d_ago /* 同一个人分到了不同的实验组 */ AS (SELECT vid, a.roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT b.login_logymd) AS active_days_14d_ago, COUNT(DISTINCT b.battle_logymd) AS battle_days_14d_ago FROM (SELECT DISTINCT vid, roleid, min_logymd FROM all_player) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, login_logymd, battle_logymd FROM mcgg_temp.mcgg_aimatch_online_ab_active_battle_gaoy WHERE p_date BETWEEN '2026-02-06' AND '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid WHERE b.login_logymd >= DATE_ADD(min_logymd, 14 * -1) AND b.login_logymd < min_logymd GROUP BY a.roleid, vid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.mcgg_strategy_ab_activities PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.vid, a.param_name, a.param_version, big_rank, strategy_label, `login_days`, `battle_days`, COALESCE(`active_days_14d_ago`, 0) AS active_days_14d_ago, COALESCE(`battle_days_14d_ago`, 0) AS battle_days_14d_ago FROM all_player AS a LEFT JOIN active_battle AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.vid = b.vid LEFT JOIN active_battle_14d_ago AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.vid = c.vid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, logymd, param_version, MAX(strategy_label) AS strategy_label FROM match_end GROUP BY accountid, logymd, param_version) AS d ON a.roleid = d.roleid AND a.min_logymd = d.logymd AND a.vid = d.param_version GROUP BY a.roleid, a.vid, a.param_name, a.param_version, big_rank, strategy_label, `login_days`, `battle_days`, `active_days_14d_ago`, `battle_days_14d_ago`

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_mlbb_shop_buy_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: helenma@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-18 11:23:56.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_shop_buy_role_zone_di ( */ /*     roleid DECIMAL(20,0) COMMENT '角色ID', */ /*     zoneid BIGINT COMMENT '区服ID', */ /*     shop_id BIGINT COMMENT '商城ID', */ /*     shop_name STRING COMMENT '商城名称', */ /*     item_id BIGINT COMMENT '道具ID', */ /*     item_name STRING COMMENT '道具名称', */ /*     item_num BIGINT COMMENT '购买道具数量', */ /*     money_num BIGINT COMMENT '消费金额', */ /*     first_mt_country STRING COMMENT '国家代码', */ /*     country_name STRING COMMENT '国家名称' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT '活动商店购买明细表（角色+shop+item粒度）' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dm/table/dm_mlbb_shop_buy_role_zone_di'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_shop_buy_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.shop_id, t3.shop_name, t1.item_id, t4.item_name, SUM(t1.item_num) AS item_num /* ========== 业务指标 ========== */, SUM(t1.money_num) AS money_num, t1.first_mt_country, t2.country_name, SUM(t1.fake_diamond_cnt) AS fake_diamond_cnt /* ⬅ 新增 */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_shop_role_zone_item_di AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT country_code, country_name FROM (SELECT LOWER(country_code) AS country_code, country_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(country_code) ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t2 ON LOWER(t1.first_mt_country) = t2.country_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT item_id AS shop_id, item_name AS shop_name FROM (SELECT item_id, item_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t3 ON LOWER(t1.shop_id) = LOWER(t3.shop_id) LEFT JOIN (SELECT item_id, item_name FROM (SELECT item_id, item_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t4 ON LOWER(t1.item_id) = LOWER(t4.item_id) WHERE t1.logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.shop_id, t3.shop_name, t1.item_id, t4.item_name, t1.first_mt_country, t2.country_name

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_mlbb_resource_item_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: helenma@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-18 11:23:56.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_resource_item_role_zone_di ( */ /*     roleid DECIMAL(20,0) COMMENT '角色ID', */ /*     zoneid BIGINT COMMENT '区服ID', */ /*     item_id INT COMMENT '道具ID', */ /*     item_name STRING COMMENT '道具名称', */ /*     operate STRING COMMENT '资源渠道来源：部分来源于operate大活动ID', */ /*     add_num BIGINT COMMENT '道具获取数量', */ /*     sub_num BIGINT COMMENT '道具消耗数量', */ /*     first_mt_country STRING COMMENT '国家代码', */ /*     country_name STRING COMMENT '国家名称' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT '活动中小资源(代币、兑换券、道具等)的获取和消耗明细表（角色+item粒度）' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dm/table/dm_mlbb_resource_item_role_zone_di'; */ WITH resource_item_add_sub AS (/* 合并道具获取和消耗 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, operate, SUM(add_num) AS add_num, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num FROM (/* 道具获取 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, operate, SUM(add_num) AS add_num, 0 AS sub_num FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id, operate UNION ALL /* 道具消耗 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, operate, 0 AS add_num, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id, operate) AS combined GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id, operate) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_resource_item_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.roleid /* ========== 主键维度 ========== */, t1.zoneid, t1.item_id, t4.item_name, t1.operate, t1.add_num /* ========== 业务指标 ========== */, t1.sub_num, t3.first_mt_country /* ========== 预关联维度 ========== */, t2.country_name FROM resource_item_add_sub AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT country_code, country_name FROM (SELECT LOWER(country_code) AS country_code, country_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(country_code) ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t2 ON LOWER(t3.first_mt_country) = t2.country_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT item_id, item_name FROM (SELECT item_id, item_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t4 ON t1.item_id = t4.item_id

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_mlbb_currcy_diamond_role_zone_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: helenma@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-18 11:23:56.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_currcy_diamond_role_zone_di ( */ /*     roleid DECIMAL(20,0) COMMENT '角色ID', */ /*     zoneid BIGINT COMMENT '区服ID', */ /*     first_mt_country STRING COMMENT '国家代码', */ /*     country_name STRING COMMENT '国家名称', */ /*     operate STRING COMMENT '操作来源', */ /*     add_num BIGINT COMMENT '当日钻石增加数量', */ /*     sub_num BIGINT COMMENT '当日钻石减少数量', */ /*     neg_num BIGINT COMMENT '扣成负的数量', */ /*     exchange_rate DOUBLE COMMENT '钻石美元汇率' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT '活动钻石消耗明细表（角色粒度）' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dm/table/dm_mlbb_currcy_diamond_role_zone_di'; */ WITH resource_item_add_sub AS (/* 合并道具获取和消耗 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, operate, SUM(add_num) AS add_num, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num, SUM(neg_num) AS neg_num FROM (/* 道具获取 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, operate, SUM(add_num) AS add_num, 0 AS sub_num, 0 AS neg_num FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_diamond WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, operate UNION ALL /* 道具消耗 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, operate, 0 AS add_num, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num, SUM(neg_num) AS neg_num FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, operate) AS combined GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid, operate) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_currcy_diamond_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.roleid /* ========== 主键维度 ========== */, t1.zoneid, t3.first_mt_country /* ========== 预关联维度 ========== */, t2.country_name, t1.operate, t1.add_num /* ========== 业务指标 ========== */, t1.sub_num, t1.neg_num, t4.diamond_rate AS exchange_rate FROM resource_item_add_sub AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT country_code, country_name FROM (SELECT LOWER(country_code) AS country_code, country_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(country_code) ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t2 ON LOWER(t3.first_mt_country) = t2.country_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(use_year AS BIGINT) AS use_year, CAST(diamond_rate AS DOUBLE) AS diamond_rate FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_exchange_diamond_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2026-03-18', '2026-03-18', '2026-05-31')) AS t4 ON YEAR(t1.logymd) = t4.use_year

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: helenma@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-18 11:23:56.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_resource_skin_role_zone_di ( */ /*     roleid DECIMAL(20,0) COMMENT '角色ID', */ /*     zoneid BIGINT COMMENT '区服ID', */ /*     skin_id BIGINT COMMENT '皮肤', */ /*     skin_name STRING COMMENT '皮肤名称', */ /*     time_len INT COMMENT '0 永久/限时标识', */ /*     operate STRING COMMENT '大活动', */ /*     first_mt_country STRING COMMENT '国家代码', */ /*     country_name STRING COMMENT '国家名称' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT '玩家活动大奖皮肤获得明细表（角色+皮肤粒度）' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dm/table/dm_mlbb_resource_skin_role_zone_di'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_resource_skin_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.skin_id, t4.skin_name, t1.time_len, t1.operate, t3.first_mt_country, t2.country_name FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, skinid AS skin_id, operate, MAX(time_len) AS time_len /* 永久皮肤time_len=0 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_skin WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT skinid IS NULL AND NOT operate IS NULL AND operate <> '' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, skinid, operate) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT country_code, country_name FROM (SELECT LOWER(country_code) AS country_code, country_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(country_code) ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t2 ON LOWER(t3.first_mt_country) = t2.country_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT item_id AS skin_id, item_name AS skin_name FROM (SELECT item_id, item_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t4 ON t1.skin_id = t4.skin_id

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: helenma@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-18 11:23:56.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_act_skinnum_role_zone_di ( */ /*     roleid              DECIMAL(20,0)   COMMENT '角色ID', */ /*     zoneid              BIGINT           COMMENT '区服ID', */ /*     act_id              BIGINT           COMMENT '子活动ID', */ /*     operate             STRING           COMMENT '大活动标识', */ /*     tag_type            BIGINT           COMMENT '铭牌颜色', */ /*     tag_id              BIGINT           COMMENT '铭牌编号ID', */ /*     first_mt_country    STRING           COMMENT '国家代码', */ /*     country_name        STRING           COMMENT '国家名称' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT '活动铭牌编号明细表（角色+act_id+tag_id粒度），仅446活动有' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dm/table/dm_mlbb_act_skinnum_role_zone_di'; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_act_skinnum_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.roleid /* ========== 主键维度 ========== */, t1.zoneid, t1.act_id, t1.operate, t1.tag_type, t1.tag_id, t2.first_mt_country /* ========== 预关联维度 ========== */, t3.country_name FROM (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, act_id, operate, tag_type, tag_num AS tag_id FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_skinnum_tag WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT country_code, country_name FROM (SELECT LOWER(country_code) AS country_code, country_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(country_code) ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t3 ON LOWER(t2.first_mt_country) = t3.country_code

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_mlbb_act_exchange_gift_role_zone_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_act_exchange_gift_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', source_type) SELECT t1.roleid /* ========== 主键维度 ========== */, t1.zoneid, t1.act_id, t1.item_id, t4.item_name, t1.exchange_item_id, t1.exchange_item, t1.is_gift, t2.first_mt_country /* ========== 预关联维度 ========== */, t3.country_name, t1.exchange_cnt, t1.source_type FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, act_id, exchange_itemid AS exchange_item_id, exchange_item, is_gift, SPLIT(exchange_item, ':')[0] AS item_id, 'surprise_exchange' AS source_type, SUM(CAST(SPLIT(exchange_item, ':')[1] AS BIGINT)) AS exchange_cnt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_surprise_exchange WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, act_id, exchange_itemid, exchange_item, is_gift UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, act_id, exchange_itemid AS exchange_item_id, exchange_item, 0 AS is_gift, SPLIT(exchange_item, ':')[0] AS item_id, 'collection_exchange' AS source_type, COUNT(1) AS exchange_cnt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_collection_exchange WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, act_id, exchange_itemid, exchange_item, is_gift) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT country_code, country_name FROM (SELECT LOWER(country_code) AS country_code, country_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(country_code) ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t3 ON LOWER(t2.first_mt_country) = t3.country_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT item_id, item_name FROM (SELECT item_id, item_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t4 ON t1.item_id = t4.item_id

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: helenma@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-18 11:23:56.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `mt_dm`.`dm_mlbb_act_surprise_lottery_role_zone_di`( */ /*     `roleid` decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '角色ID', */ /*     `zoneid` bigint COMMENT '区服ID', */ /*     `act_id` bigint COMMENT '子活动ID', */ /*     `subtype` bigint COMMENT '子类型：仅SNK二期source_type=snkdraw_data需要用到', */ /*     `cost_fakediamond` bigint COMMENT '当日抽奖消耗假钻数_仅活动类型(446、589)，NULL代表不存在这个字段', */ /*     `total_draw_num` bigint COMMENT '总抽奖次数', */ /*     `draw_num` bigint COMMENT '当日抽奖次数', */ /*     `one_draw_num` bigint COMMENT '当日单抽次数', */ /*     `ten_draw_num` bigint COMMENT '当日十连抽次数', */ /*     `first_mt_country` string COMMENT '国家代码:关联维度表 mt_dim.dim_country.country_code', */ /*     `country_name` string COMMENT '国家名称:关联维度表 mt_dim.dim_country.country_name', */ /*     `bonus` bigint COMMENT '是否祈愿抽奖：仅仅是446活动的功能，NULL代表不存在这个字段', */ /*     `quality` bigint COMMENT '奖励品质' */ /* ) COMMENT '活动玩家抽奖行为明细表（角色+act_id+subtype粒度）' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     `logymd` string COMMENT '日期分区', */ /*     `source_type` string COMMENT 'act_surpriselottery、act_twodimension_draw、act_transformer_bingo_draw、act_snk_draw' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dm/table/dm_mlbb_act_surprise_lottery_role_zone_di'; */ WITH activity_snkdraw_data AS (/* 区分进入 SNK 或 ORO 的玩家 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(subtype) AS draw_type, MAX(act_id) AS act_id FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, subtype, NULL AS act_id FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_activity_snkdraw_data WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND subtype IN (1, 2) UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, 1 AS subtype, act_id FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_snk_draw WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), act_snk_draw AS (/* 每个玩家在活动期间的最大累计抽数 */ SELECT roleid, MAX(act_id) AS act_id, MAX(total_draw_times) AS total_draw_num, SUM(draw_times) AS draw_num, SUM(IF(draw_times = 1, 1, 0)) AS one_draw_num, SUM(IF(draw_times = 10, 1, 0)) AS ten_draw_num FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_snk_draw WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_act_surprise_lottery_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', source_type) SELECT t1.roleid /* ========== 主键维度 ========== */, t1.zoneid, act_id, draw_type AS subtype, cost_fakediamond, total_draw_num, draw_num, one_draw_num, ten_draw_num, t2.first_mt_country, t3.country_name, t1.bonus, t1.qulity AS quality, source_type /* ！动态分区字段。新增字段要放这个前面 */ FROM (/* 常规抽奖活动 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, act_id, NULL AS draw_type, bonus, qulity, SUM(CASE WHEN cost_fakediamond <> 0 THEN cost_fakediamond ELSE 0 END) AS cost_fakediamond, MAX(total_draw_num) AS total_draw_num, SUM(draw_num) AS draw_num, SUM(IF(draw_num = 1, 1, 0)) AS one_draw_num, SUM(IF(draw_num = 10, 1, 0)) AS ten_draw_num, 'act_surpriselottery' AS source_type FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_surpriselottery WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, act_id, bonus, qulity /* 两期二次元和SNK一期 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, act_id, NULL AS draw_type, NULL AS bonus, qulity, 0 AS cost_fakediamond, MAX(total_draw_num) AS total_draw_num, SUM(draw_num) AS draw_num, SUM(IF(draw_num = 1, 1, 0)) AS one_draw_num, SUM(IF(draw_num = 10, 1, 0)) AS ten_draw_num, 'act_twodimension_draw' AS source_type FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_twodimension_draw WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, act_id, qulity /* HELLOKETTY抽奖 */ UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, act_id, NULL AS draw_type, NULL AS bonus, qulity, 0 AS cost_fakediamond, MAX(total_draw_num) AS total_draw_num, SUM(draw_num) AS draw_num, SUM(IF(draw_num = 1, 1, 0)) AS one_draw_num, SUM(IF(draw_num = 10, 1, 0)) AS ten_draw_num, 'act_transformer_bingo_draw' AS source_type FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_transformer_bingo_draw WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, act_id, qulity /* SNK二期 */ UNION ALL SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, COALESCE(t1.act_id, t2.act_id) AS act_id, t1.draw_type, NULL AS bonus, NULL AS qulity, 0 AS cost_fakediamond, t2.total_draw_num, t2.draw_num, t2.one_draw_num, t2.ten_draw_num, 'act_snk_draw' AS source_type FROM activity_snkdraw_data AS t1 LEFT JOIN act_snk_draw AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT country_code, country_name FROM (SELECT LOWER(country_code) AS country_code, country_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(country_code) ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS t3 ON LOWER(t2.first_mt_country) = t3.country_code

name: 拍卖行上架di
sql_units: /* UNION ALL */ /* SELECT  DISTINCT operate, */ /*         operate_name */ /* FROM    mt_dim.dim_currency_operate_config --游戏钻石金币operate配置表 */ /* WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-30' */ WITH auctionhouse_item_config /* 可交易物品配置表 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT itemid, CASE WHEN itemid BETWEEN 503000 AND 503003 THEN '龙晶' WHEN itemid BETWEEN 503004 AND 503999 THEN '小资源' WHEN itemid BETWEEN 504000 AND 504999 THEN '道具' WHEN itemid BETWEEN 505000 AND 505999 THEN '皮肤' ELSE '其他' END AS auctionhouse_item_config_item_type, changeitemid, itemname FROM mt_dim.auction_house_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), dim_item_config_df /* 物品道具配置表 */ AS (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd > '2026-01-30') AND logymd > '2026-01-30'), operate_config /* opoeratep配置 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT operate, nick_name AS operate_nick_name, type AS operate_type FROM ml_temp.temp_operate_config /* 各收入操作中文映射 */ WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM ml_temp.temp_operate_config WHERE logymd > '2026-01-30') AND logymd > '2026-01-30') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.teemoyu_auctionhouse_list_status_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.auction_zoneid /* 上架人 */, a.auction_roleid, buyer_zoneid /* 购买人 */, buyer_roleid, a.auction_id /* 交易id */, CASE WHEN a.item_id BETWEEN 503000 AND 505999 THEN '非绑定' ELSE '绑定' END AS bound_item_type /* 是否绑定 */, CASE WHEN a.item_id BETWEEN 503000 AND 503003 THEN '龙晶' WHEN f.auctionhouse_item_config_item_type = '龙晶' THEN '龙晶' /* 可交易物品配置表所对应的上游礼包来源（从哪里开出来的） */ WHEN a.item_id BETWEEN 503004 AND 503999 THEN '小资源' WHEN f.auctionhouse_item_config_item_type = '小资源' THEN '小资源' /* 可交易物品配置表所对应的上游礼包来源（从哪里开出来的） */ WHEN a.item_id BETWEEN 504000 AND 504999 THEN '道具' WHEN f.auctionhouse_item_config_item_type = '道具' THEN '道具' /* 可交易物品配置表所对应的上游礼包来源（从哪里开出来的） */ WHEN a.item_id BETWEEN 505000 AND 505999 THEN '皮肤' WHEN f.auctionhouse_item_config_item_type = '皮肤' THEN '皮肤' /* 可交易物品配置表所对应的上游礼包来源（从哪里开出来的） */ ELSE '其他' END AS auctionhouse_item_type /* 非绑定/绑定道具分类 */, CASE WHEN a.item_id BETWEEN 503000 AND 505999 THEN d2.itemname ELSE d.item_name END AS item_name /* 道具中文名 */, d.item_type, a.item_id, CASE WHEN result_mode = 1 THEN '一口价' WHEN result_mode = 2 THEN '竞拍成功' WHEN result_mode = 3 THEN '流拍' WHEN NOT c.auction_id IS NULL THEN '下架' ELSE '在挂' END AS current_status /* 订单目前的状态 */, COALESCE(result_price, 0) AS result_price /* 成交价格,只有竞拍'一口价'和 '竞拍成功'会有 */, a.logymd AS up_logymd /* 订单上架日期 */, CASE WHEN NOT b.logymd IS NULL THEN b.logymd WHEN NOT c.logymd IS NULL THEN c.logymd ELSE NULL END AS down_logymd /* 订单成交或下架日期,若还在挂则是null,结合current_status判断 */, list_fee /* 手续费（上架费） */, CASE WHEN NOT b.already_list_time IS NULL THEN b.already_list_time WHEN NOT c.already_list_time IS NULL THEN c.already_list_time ELSE NULL END AS delist_dur /* 订单成交或下架用时,若还在挂则是null,结合current_status判断 */, a.item_num AS item_num /* 物品数量 */, a.auction_regionid AS auction_regionid /* 交易大区 */, CASE WHEN bid.bid_price >= a.buyout_price THEN bid.bid_price WHEN bid.bid_price < a.buyout_price THEN a.buyout_price WHEN bid.bid_price IS NULL THEN GREATEST(a.bid_price, a.buyout_price) END AS market_price /* --市值，只有订单状态是'在挂'才有市值 */, CASE WHEN NOT if_ep_auction.roleid IS NULL AND NOT if_ep_buy.roleid IS NULL THEN '买卖双方均为员工' WHEN NOT if_ep_auction.roleid IS NULL THEN '卖家为员工' WHEN NOT if_ep_buy.roleid IS NULL THEN '买家为员工' WHEN a.auction_zoneid < 57000 THEN '正式服' WHEN a.auction_zoneid > 57000 THEN '测试服' ELSE '无' END AS employee_type, CASE WHEN UPPER(auction_ct.create_country) IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MM', 'MY', 'IN', 'KH', 'TH', 'RU', 'TR', 'LA', 'BR', 'PE', 'SG', 'MN', 'NP', 'UZ', 'BO', 'VN', 'MX', 'UA') THEN UPPER(auction_ct.create_country) ELSE 'others' END AS auction_create_country /* 卖方国家 */, CASE WHEN UPPER(buyer_ct.create_country) IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MM', 'MY', 'IN', 'KH', 'TH', 'RU', 'TR', 'LA', 'BR', 'PE', 'SG', 'MN', 'NP', 'UZ', 'BO', 'VN', 'MX', 'UA') THEN UPPER(buyer_ct.create_country) ELSE 'others' END AS buyer_create_country /* 买方国家 */, COALESCE(result_buyer.commission_diamond, 0) AS commission_diamond /* 系统手续费钻石（成交后扣的手续费） */ FROM (SELECT auction_zoneid, auction_roleid, auction_id, auction_regionid, list_fee, item_id, list_mode, bid_price, buyout_price, item_num, TIME, logymd FROM ml_ods.auctionserver_auctionhouse_list /* 上架 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT auction_zoneid, auction_roleid, auction_id, item_num, item_id, result_mode, result_price, already_list_time, TIME, buyer_zoneid, buyer_roleid, logymd FROM ml_ods.auctionserver_auctionhouse_result /* 交易结果 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.auction_zoneid = b.auction_zoneid AND a.auction_roleid = b.auction_roleid AND a.auction_id = b.auction_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT auction_zoneid, auction_roleid, auction_id, item_num, already_list_time, delist_fee_id, delist_fee_num, TIME, logymd FROM ml_ods.auctionserver_auctionhouse_delist WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31') AS c ON a.auction_zoneid = c.auction_zoneid AND a.auction_roleid = c.auction_roleid AND a.auction_id = c.auction_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT auction_zoneid, auction_roleid, auction_id, auction_regionid, item_id, MAX(bid_price) AS bid_price FROM ml_ods.auctionserver_auctionhouse_bid WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY auction_zoneid, auction_roleid, auction_id, auction_regionid, item_id) AS bid ON a.auction_zoneid = bid.auction_zoneid AND a.auction_roleid = bid.auction_roleid AND a.auction_id = bid.auction_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT seller_zone_id, seller_role_id, auction_id, SUM(COALESCE(commission_diamond, 0)) AS commission_diamond FROM ml_ods.gameserver_auctionhouse_result_buyer WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-29' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY seller_zone_id, seller_role_id, auction_id) AS result_buyer /* 拍卖行购买成功，取系统手续费 */ ON a.auction_zoneid = result_buyer.seller_zone_id AND a.auction_roleid = result_buyer.seller_role_id AND a.auction_id = result_buyer.auction_id LEFT JOIN dim_item_config_df AS d /* 物品道具配置表 */ ON a.item_id = d.item_id LEFT JOIN auctionhouse_item_config AS f /* 可交易物品配置表 */ ON a.item_id = f.changeitemid LEFT JOIN auctionhouse_item_config AS d2 /* 可交易物品配置表 取礼包对应中文名 */ ON a.item_id = d2.itemid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.mlbb_employee_benefits_detail WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS if_ep_auction ON a.auction_zoneid = if_ep_auction.zoneid AND a.auction_roleid = if_ep_auction.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.mlbb_employee_benefits_detail WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS if_ep_buy ON b.buyer_zoneid = if_ep_buy.zoneid AND b.buyer_roleid = if_ep_buy.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, create_country) AS auction_ct ON a.auction_zoneid = auction_ct.zoneid AND a.auction_roleid = auction_ct.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, create_country) AS buyer_ct ON b.buyer_zoneid = buyer_ct.zoneid AND b.buyer_roleid = buyer_ct.roleid

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_caowl@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-19 13:16:01.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.rankcnt_wincnt_season_realroad_caowl PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 日活最新段位玩家每个分路在每个段位的赛季胜率分位数（任意分路达到10场以上才计算大盘分路胜率）分位数范围0.3-0.7，每日调度 */ SELECT a2.battle_season_id /* 赛季id */, CASE WHEN a2.zoneid < 57000 THEN '正式服' WHEN a2.zoneid >= 57000 THEN '测试服' ELSE '未知' END AS zone_type, a2.accountid /* 玩家id */, a2.zoneid /* 玩家区服id */, a2.real_road_std /* 分路 */, a3.cur_rankstars /* 赛季当前当天大段位 */, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.battleid) AS battle_cnt /* 战斗场次 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wincamp = 1 THEN a2.battleid ELSE NULL END) AS win_cnt /* 胜利场次 */ FROM (/* 活跃用户 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(UPPER(ip_country)) AS country FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND UPPER(appid) = 'MLBB' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a1 INNER JOIN (/* 玩家赛季分路胜率,段位需要取每天最新的段位 */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, battle_season_id /* 赛季id */, CASE WHEN real_road = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN real_road = 1 THEN '经验路' WHEN real_road = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN real_road = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN real_road = 3 THEN '游走' ELSE '其他' END AS real_road_std /* 分路 */, battleid /* 战斗id, */, wincamp /* rankstar,--排位赛星数 */ FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2 /* 限制排位 */ AND fake_ai = 0 /* 排除AI */ AND isinvalidbattle = 0 /* 非流局 */) AS a2 ON a1.roleid = a2.accountid AND a1.zoneid = a2.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 段位需要取每天最新的段位 */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN rankstar < 10 THEN '1-勇士' WHEN rankstar < 21 THEN '2-精英' WHEN rankstar < 37 THEN '3-大师' WHEN rankstar < 62 THEN '4-宗师' WHEN rankstar < 87 THEN '5-史诗' WHEN rankstar < 112 THEN '6-传奇' WHEN rankstar < 137 THEN '7-神话' WHEN rankstar < 162 THEN '8-百战神话' WHEN rankstar < 212 THEN '9-荣耀神话' WHEN rankstar >= 212 THEN '10-至尊神话' ELSE '未知' END /* rankstar */ AS cur_rankstars /* 玩家每天最新段位  */ FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, rankstar /* 每场战斗得排位赛星数  */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2 /* 限制排位 */ AND fake_ai = 0 /* 排除AI */ AND isinvalidbattle = 0 /* 非流局 */) WHERE rn = 1) AS a3 ON a3.accountid = a2.accountid AND a3.zoneid = a2.zoneid GROUP BY a2.battle_season_id /* 赛季id */, a2.accountid /* 玩家id */, a2.zoneid /* 玩家区服id */, a2.real_road_std /* 分路 */, a3.cur_rankstars, CASE WHEN a2.zoneid < 57000 THEN '正式服' WHEN a2.zoneid >= 57000 THEN '测试服' ELSE '未知' END

name: ml_temp.winrate_season_realroad_caowl
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_caowl@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-20 14:58:04.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 分分路分段位胜率分位数(0.3-0.7) */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.winrate_season_realroad_caowl PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT battle_season_id, real_road, cur_rankstar, ROUND(PERCENTILE(win_rt, 0.3), 0) AS p3 /*    percentile(win_rt,array(0.3,0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7)) as p_data */, ROUND(PERCENTILE(win_rt, 0.4), 0) AS p4, ROUND(PERCENTILE(win_rt, 0.5), 0) AS p5, ROUND(PERCENTILE(win_rt, 0.6), 0) AS p6, ROUND(PERCENTILE(win_rt, 0.7), 0) AS p7 FROM (SELECT battle_season_id /* 赛季 */, zone_type, accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN real_road_std = '金币路' THEN 5 WHEN real_road_std = '经验路' THEN 1 WHEN real_road_std = '中路' THEN 2 WHEN real_road_std = '打野' THEN 4 WHEN real_road_std = '游走' THEN 3 ELSE 99 END AS real_road /* 分路 */, CASE WHEN cur_rankstars = '1-勇士' THEN 1 WHEN cur_rankstars = '2-精英' THEN 2 WHEN cur_rankstars = '3-大师' THEN 3 WHEN cur_rankstars = '4-宗师' THEN 4 WHEN cur_rankstars = '5-史诗' THEN 5 WHEN cur_rankstars = '6-传奇' THEN 6 WHEN cur_rankstars = '7-神话' THEN 7 WHEN cur_rankstars = '8-百战神话' THEN 8 WHEN cur_rankstars = '9-荣耀神话' THEN 9 WHEN cur_rankstars = '10-至尊神话' THEN 10 ELSE 99 END AS cur_rankstar /* 最新段位 */, battle_cnt /* 战斗场次 */, win_cnt /* 胜利场次 */, ROUND(win_cnt / NULLIF(battle_cnt, 0), 4) * 10000 AS win_rt /* 胜率   */ FROM ml_temp.rankcnt_wincnt_season_realroad_caowl04 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zone_type = '正式服' AND battle_cnt >= 10 /* 过滤掉赛季分路场次小于10场的分路数据 */) GROUP BY battle_season_id, real_road, cur_rankstar

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: niangangdeng@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-20 19:37:05.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_dm.dm_mlbb_public_opinion_info_di */ /* ( */ /*     `package_name`                          string COMMENT '包名', */ /*     `app_version_code`                      string COMMENT '版本代码', */ /*     `app_version_name`                      string COMMENT '版本名称', */ /*     `device`                                string COMMENT '设备', */ /*     `comment_language`                      string COMMENT '评论语种', */ /*     `comment_create_datetime`               string COMMENT '提交时间', */ /*     `comment_create_timestamp`              string COMMENT '提交时间戳', */ /*     `comment_last_update_datetime`          string COMMENT '最后更新时间', */ /*     `comment_last_update_timestamp`         string COMMENT '最后更新时间戳', */ /*     `comment_rating`                        string COMMENT '评分', */ /*     `comment_title`                         string            string COMMENT '评论中文', */ /*     `comment_category1`                     string COMMENT '话题分类1', */ /*     `comment_category2`                     string COMMENT '话题分类2', */ /*     `comment_topic_id`                      string COMMENT '话题ID', */ /*     `comment_topic`                         string COMMENT '话题', */ /*     `comment_topic_type`                    bigint COMMENT '话题类型，0-存量，1=新增', */ /*     `comment_sentiment`                     string COMMENT '情绪分类', */ /*     `comment_sentiment_confidence`          bigint COMMENT '情绪置信度', */ /*     `quality_score`                         float  COMMENT '质量分', */ /*     `like_count`                            bigint COMMENT '点赞数', */ /*     `replay_count`                          bigint COMMENT '回复数', */ /* '数据来源', */ /*     `text_type`                             string COMMENT '数据类型' */ /* ) */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dm/table/dm_mlbb_public_opinion_info_di' */ /* 清洗每日增量数据 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_public_opinion_info_di PARTITION(logymd) SELECT tmp1.package_name, tmp1.app_version_code, tmp1.app_version_name, tmp1.device, tmp1.reviewer_language AS comment_language, tmp1.review_submit_date_and_time AS comment_create_datetime, tmp1.review_submit_millis_since_epoch AS comment_create_timestamp, tmp1.review_last_update_date_and_time AS comment_last_update_datetime, tmp1.review_last_update_millis_since_epoch AS comment_last_update_timestamp, tmp1.star_rating AS comment_rating, tmp1.review_title AS comment_title, tmp1.review_text AS comment_text, tmp1.review_link AS comment_link, tmp1.txt_cn AS comment_text_cn, tmp1.category AS comment_category1, tmp1.category AS comment_category2, COALESCE(tmp2.topic_id, tmp1.topic_id) AS comment_topic_id, tmp1.topic AS comment_topic, CASE WHEN tmp2.topic_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS comment_topic_type, tmp1.sentiment AS comment_sentiment, tmp1.confidence AS comment_sentiment_confidence, tmp1.quality_score AS quality_score /* 质量分 */, tmp1.like_count AS like_count /* 点赞 */, tmp1.replay_count AS replay_count /* 回复 */, tmp1.share_count AS share_count /* 分享 */, 'Google Play' AS channel /* 渠道 */, 'official' AS datasource /* 数据来源：第三发、官方 */, 'comment' AS text_type /* 数据类型：comment */, tmp1.logymd FROM (SELECT t1.package_name, t1.app_version_code, t1.app_version_name, t1.reviewer_language, t1.device, t1.review_submit_date_and_time, t1.review_submit_millis_since_epoch, t1.review_last_update_date_and_time, t1.review_last_update_millis_since_epoch, t1.star_rating, t1.review_title, t1.review_text, t1.review_link, t2.txt_cn, t2.category, t2.topic, t2.sentiment, t2.confidence, COALESCE(t3.quality_score, 0.0) AS quality_score, NULL AS like_count, t1.replay_count, NULL AS share_count, 'Google Play' AS channel /* 渠道 */, 'official' AS datasource /* 数据来源：第三发、官方 */, 'comment' AS text_type /* 数据类型：comment */, t1.source_logymd AS logymd, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.source_logymd ORDER BY t2.category, t2.topic) + CAST(20260531 AS BIGINT) * 1000000 AS topic_id FROM (SELECT package_name, app_version_code, app_version_name, reviewer_language, device, review_submit_date_and_time, review_submit_millis_since_epoch, review_last_update_date_and_time, review_last_update_millis_since_epoch, star_rating, review_title, review_text, developer_reply_date_and_time, developer_reply_millis_since_epoch, developer_reply_text, review_link, review_id, source_logymd, logymd, SUM(1) AS replay_count FROM mt_dwd.dwd_public_opinion_keyword_gp_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-21' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY package_name, app_version_code, app_version_name, reviewer_language, device, review_submit_date_and_time, review_submit_millis_since_epoch, review_last_update_date_and_time, review_last_update_millis_since_epoch, star_rating, review_title, review_text, developer_reply_date_and_time, developer_reply_millis_since_epoch, developer_reply_text, review_link, review_id, source_logymd, logymd) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, txt_cn, sentiment, confidence, CASE WHEN similarity > 0.5 THEN matched_category ELSE llm_category END AS category, CASE WHEN similarity > 0.5 THEN matched_topic ELSE llm_topic END AS topic, similarity, logymd FROM (SELECT c0 AS id, c1 AS txt_cn, c2 AS sentiment, c3 AS confidence, c4 AS llm_category, c5 AS llm_topic, c6 AS matched_category, c7 AS matched_topic, c8 AS similarity, logymd FROM mt_dwd.dwd_mlbb_public_opinion_analysis_step_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-21' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND step = 'result') AS temp) AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd AND t1.review_id = t2.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dwd.dwd_public_opinion_quality_score_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-21' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND NOT review_id IS NULL AND NOT review_text IS NULL) AS t3 ON t1.logymd = t3.logymd AND t1.review_id = t3.review_id WHERE t1.source_logymd >= '2026-05-21' AND t1.source_logymd <= '2026-05-31') AS tmp1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT MIN(topic_id) AS topic_id, category_l1 AS category, topic_name AS topic, DATE_FORMAT(TO_DATE(logymd, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_public_opinion_topic_df_stg WHERE logymd >= '20260521' AND logymd <= '20260531' AND is_enabled = 1 GROUP BY category_l1, topic_name, DATE_FORMAT(TO_DATE(logymd, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS tmp2 ON tmp1.logymd = tmp2.logymd AND tmp1.category = tmp2.category AND tmp1.topic = tmp2.topic DISTRIBUTE BY (logymd)
