name: dws_instance_info_di
sql_units: /* ============================================================ */ /* INSERT INTO mt_ads.dws_instance_info_di */ /* 调度参数：2026-05-31 = 目标分区日期 */ /* */ /* 处理逻辑说明： */ /* 1. 去重：过滤 YARN 中间状态（RUNNING/ACCEPTED），每个 instance_id 保留最终态最新一条 */ /* 2. engine：HQL 从 conf 解析（spark/spark3/presto），spark 的 python2.7 为噪音直接用 task_type_name */ /* 3. instance_type：scheduled / backfill（lag>3天）/ manual / adhoc_presto / adhoc_spark */ /* 4. biz_date：周期调度=数据日（leap_task_time），其余=NULL */ /* 5. is_success：status_name LIKE '%成功%' 则为1，其余为0 */ /* 6. duration：leap_end - leap_start（实际执行） */ /*    perceived：leap_end - leap_submit（用户端到端） */ /*    queue：yarn_started - leap_submit（YARN排队，仅HQL/spark有值） */ /* 7. backfill_lag_days / is_backfill：非周期调度返回 NULL */ /* 8. has_code：LENGTH(code) > 10 则为1 */ /* ============================================================ */ WITH base AS (/* Step 1：过滤中间状态，每个 instance_id 保留最终态的最新一条 */ SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY instance_id ORDER BY yarn_collection_time DESC, leap_end_time DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dwd.dwd_leap_yarn_instance_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* 过滤中间状态 */ (NOT yarn_state IN ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED') OR yarn_state IS NULL)), cleaned AS (/* Step 2：派生 engine */ /* HQL 从 conf 解析（spark/spark3/presto） */ /* spark 的 conf 返回 python2.7 为噪音，直接用 task_type_name */ /* 其余 conf 均为 NULL，直接用 task_type_name */ SELECT *, CASE WHEN task_type_name = 'HQL' THEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(conf, '$.configuration.operator.parameter.engineType') ELSE task_type_name END AS engine_derived FROM base WHERE rn = 1 AND /* 过滤被删除的实例 */ (status_name <> '删除' OR status_name IS NULL)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.dws_instance_info_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT instance_id /* ===== 实例标识 ===== */, task_id, name AS task_name, owner_user_name, userid, project_name, cron_expression, schedule_type /* ===== 分类维度 ===== */, CASE WHEN schedule_type = '手动调度' THEN 'manual' WHEN schedule_type = '临时查询' AND engine_derived = 'presto' THEN 'adhoc_presto' WHEN schedule_type = '临时查询' THEN 'adhoc_spark' WHEN schedule_type = '周期调度' AND DATEDIFF(DATE(leap_start_time), DATE(leap_task_time)) > 3 THEN 'backfill' ELSE 'scheduled' END AS instance_type, task_type_name, engine_derived AS engine, status_name /* ===== 执行状态 ===== */, CASE WHEN status_name LIKE '%成功%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_success, yarn_state, final_application_id, tqs_query_id, CASE WHEN schedule_type = '周期调度' THEN leap_task_time ELSE NULL /* 仅周期调度有业务日期语义，其余一律 NULL */ END AS biz_date /* ===== 时间字段 ===== */, leap_submit_time, leap_start_time, leap_end_time, CASE WHEN NOT leap_end_time IS NULL AND NOT leap_start_time IS NULL THEN GREATEST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(leap_end_time) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(leap_start_time), 0) END AS duration_sec /* ===== 耗时指标 ===== */ /* duration：leap_end - leap_start（Leap 侧实际运行时长） */, CASE WHEN NOT leap_end_time IS NULL AND NOT leap_start_time IS NULL THEN GREATEST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(leap_end_time) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(leap_start_time), 0) / 60.0 END AS duration_min, CASE WHEN NOT leap_end_time IS NULL AND NOT leap_submit_time IS NULL THEN GREATEST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(leap_end_time) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(leap_submit_time), 0) END AS perceived_sec /* perceived：leap_end - leap_submit（用户端到端等待） */, CASE WHEN NOT leap_end_time IS NULL AND NOT leap_submit_time IS NULL THEN GREATEST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(leap_end_time) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(leap_submit_time), 0) / 60.0 END AS perceived_min, CASE WHEN NOT yarn_started_time IS NULL AND NOT leap_submit_time IS NULL THEN GREATEST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(yarn_started_time) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(leap_submit_time), 0) END AS queue_sec /* queue：yarn_started - leap_submit（YARN 排队等待，仅 HQL/spark 有值） */, CASE WHEN schedule_type = '周期调度' THEN DATEDIFF(DATE(leap_start_time), DATE(leap_task_time)) END AS backfill_lag_days /* ===== 回刷标识（非周期调度返回 NULL）===== */, CASE WHEN schedule_type = '周期调度' AND DATEDIFF(DATE(leap_start_time), DATE(leap_task_time)) > 3 THEN 1 WHEN schedule_type = '周期调度' THEN 0 END AS is_backfill, yarn_queue /* ===== YARN 资源 ===== */, yarn_elapsed_time, memory_seconds, vcore_seconds, CASE WHEN LENGTH(code) > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_code /* ===== 代码文本 ===== */, code FROM cleaned

name: dwm_battle_hero_usage_role_zone_pvptype_df
sql_units: /* P007 战斗域中间层：玩家历史英雄使用场次（自依赖日快照） */ /* 粒度：roleid + zoneid + pvptype + logymd */ /* 逻辑：base = DWM(T-1) ∪ hero_history(T) */ /*       DWM(T) = base LEFT JOIN battle_end(T) */ /*       join 到 → hero_data 合并今日战斗；join 不到 → 原样不变 */ /* D0（2026-02-12）：DWM(T-1) 为空，base = hero_history + 当日 battle_end */ WITH base AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, hero_data, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, LEVEL, lastlogindate FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_hero_usage_role_zone_pvptype_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(roleid AS BIGINT) AS roleid, CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) AS zoneid, CAST(pvptype AS BIGINT) AS pvptype, hero_data, CAST(usercreatetime AS BIGINT) AS usercreatetime, usercreateymd, CAST(LEVEL AS BIGINT) AS LEVEL, '2026-05-31' AS lastlogindate FROM ml_ods.gameserver_hero_history WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT zoneid BETWEEN 57000 AND 57999), incr AS (SELECT CAST(t1.accountid AS BIGINT) AS roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.pvptype, CAST(t1.heroid AS STRING) AS heroid, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(t1.level) AS LEVEL FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, pvptype, heroid, LEVEL FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT zoneid BETWEEN 57000 AND 57999) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM base) AS t2 ON CAST(t1.accountid AS BIGINT) = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid GROUP BY t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.pvptype, t1.heroid), merged /* hero_data 是字符串，需要展开 → 合并今日战斗 → 拼回 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(heroid || ':' || CAST(cnt AS STRING))) AS hero_data FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, heroid, SUM(cnt) AS cnt FROM (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.pvptype, SPLIT(kv, ':')[0] AS heroid, CAST(SPLIT(kv, ':')[1] AS BIGINT) AS cnt FROM base AS t1 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM incr) AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(SPLIT(NULLIF(t1.hero_data, ''), ',')) t AS kv WHERE kv <> '' UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, pvptype, heroid, cnt FROM incr) AS t3 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype, heroid) AS t4 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, pvptype) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_battle_hero_usage_role_zone_pvptype_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.pvptype, COALESCE(t2.hero_data, t1.hero_data) AS hero_data, t1.usercreatetime, t1.usercreateymd, COALESCE(t3.level, t1.level) AS LEVEL, IF(NOT t3.roleid IS NULL, '2026-05-31', t1.lastlogindate) AS lastlogindate FROM base AS t1 LEFT JOIN merged AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t1.pvptype = t2.pvptype LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(LEVEL) AS LEVEL FROM incr GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_tgame_basic_role_zone_df
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-07-04 16:23:00.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_dim.dim_tgame_basic_role_zone_df ( */ /*     roleid Decimal(20,0) COMMENT '角色id', */ /*     zoneid BIGINT COMMENT '区服id', */ /*     register_ip STRING COMMENT '注册ip', */ /*     register_os STRING COMMENT '注册os', */ /*     register_did STRING COMMENT '注册did', */ /*     register_time STRING COMMENT '注册时间', */ /*     register_date STRING COMMENT '注册日期', */ /*     register_channel STRING COMMENT '注册渠道', */ /*     register_source STRING COMMENT '创角来源', */ /*     register_country STRING COMMENT '创角国家', */ /*     is_init_bot BIGINT COMMENT '是否初始刷号', */ /*     is_cur_bot BIGINT COMMENT '是否当前刷号', */ /*     is_acc_init_bot BIGINT COMMENT '是否账号初始刷号', */ /*     is_acc_cur_bot  BIGINT COMMENT '是否账号当前刷号' */ /* ) */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd String COMMENT '日期,yyyy-MM-dd') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-dim/table/dim_tgame_basic_role_zone_df' ; */ /* CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_dim.dim_nova_white_list_df ( */ /*     white_ip STRING COMMENT '注册ip白名单' */ /* ) */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd String COMMENT '日期,yyyy-MM-dd') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ WITH create_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, m__did AS did, ip, logymd AS register_date, SUBSTRING(TIME, 0, 13) AS register_time, createrole_country, channel AS create_channel, LOWER(m__os_type) AS os_type, 'create' AS create_type_name, 1 AS create_type, TIME AS m__server_time FROM tgame_ods.gameserver_create_role WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-04-10'), result_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, ip AS register_ip, LOWER(os_type) AS register_os, did AS register_did, register_time AS register_time, register_date AS register_date, create_channel AS register_channel, create_type_name AS register_source, LOWER(createrole_country) AS register_country FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_type_name, ip, os_type, did, register_time, register_date, create_channel, createrole_country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY create_type, m__server_time, zoneid) AS rn FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, register_time, createrole_country, os_type, create_channel, did, ip, 'create' AS create_type_name, 1 AS create_type, m__server_time FROM create_info) AS t0) AS t1 WHERE rn = 1), basic_yd AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_ip, LOWER(register_os) AS register_os, register_did, register_time, register_date, register_channel, register_source, LOWER(register_country) AS register_country, is_cur_bot, is_init_bot, is_acc_cur_bot, is_acc_init_bot FROM mt_dim.dim_tgame_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND register_date >= '2026-04-10' AND logymd >= '2026-04-10') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_tgame_basic_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(df.register_ip, di.register_ip, 'unknown') AS register_ip, COALESCE(df.register_os, di.register_os, 'unknown') AS register_os, COALESCE(df.register_did, di.register_did, 'unknown') AS register_did, COALESCE(df.register_time, di.register_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS register_time, COALESCE(df.register_date, di.register_date, '1970-01-01') AS register_date, COALESCE(df.register_channel, di.register_channel, 'unknown') AS resiter_channel, COALESCE(df.register_source, di.register_source, 'unknown') AS register_source, COALESCE(df.register_country, di.register_country, 'unknown') AS register_country, df.is_cur_bot AS is_cur_bot, df.is_init_bot AS is_init_bot, df.is_acc_cur_bot, df.is_acc_init_bot FROM (SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.register_ip, t0.register_os, t0.register_did, t0.register_time, t0.register_date, t0.register_channel, t0.register_source, t0.register_country FROM result_info AS t0) AS di FULL JOIN basic_yd AS df ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid

name: 自然周日历_每日增量更新
output_hint: 自然周日历_每日增量更新
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_hsu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-27 19:29:33.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT INTO mcgg_temp.dim_week_calendar_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(logymd), '-W', LPAD(WEEKOFYEAR(logymd), 2, '0')) AS week_id, DATE_ADD(logymd, CAST(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(logymd) = 1 THEN 6 /* 周日：往前推6天到周一 */ ELSE DAYOFWEEK(logymd) - 2 /* 其他日期：正常转换 */ END AS INT) * -1) AS week_start_date, DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(logymd, CAST(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(logymd) = 1 THEN 6 ELSE DAYOFWEEK(logymd) - 2 END AS INT) * -1), 6) AS week_end_date, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(logymd) = 1 THEN 7 /* 周日 -> 7 */ ELSE DAYOFWEEK(logymd) - 1 /* 周一~周六 -> 1~6 */ END AS weekday_num, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(logymd) = 1 THEN '周日' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(logymd) = 2 THEN '周一' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(logymd) = 3 THEN '周二' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(logymd) = 4 THEN '周三' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(logymd) = 5 THEN '周四' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(logymd) = 6 THEN '周五' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(logymd) = 7 THEN '周六' END AS weekday_desc, IF(YEAR(logymd) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND WEEKOFYEAR(logymd) = WEEKOFYEAR(CURRENT_DATE), 1, 0) AS is_current_week, IF(DAYOFWEEK(logymd) = 1 AND logymd <= CURRENT_DATE, 1, 0) AS is_complete_week FROM (SELECT DISTINCT logymd FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t ORDER BY logymd DESC

name: etl.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di_tgame_account_daily
sql_units: WITH real_country_online AS (SELECT day_point, country, SUM(real_online_num) AS online_num FROM (SELECT `TIME`, day_point AS day_point, LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', country)) AS country, zone_id, COALESCE(online_num, 0) AS real_online_num /* 真实玩家在线人数 */, logymd FROM tgame_ods.connserver_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND country <> '' AND NOT country IS NULL AND logymd >= '2026-04-10') GROUP BY day_point, country), dim_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 1 AS region_type, act_geo_continent AS region FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_country) /* 取最新 */ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 0 AS region_type, region FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_country) /* 取最新 */), online_cube AS (/* 分国家和区域 */ SELECT region_type, region, country, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, AVG(online_num) AS acu FROM (SELECT con.region_type, con.region, lin.country, lin.day_point, SUM(online_num) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM real_country_online AS lin LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con ON lin.country = con.country_code GROUP BY con.region_type, con.region, lin.country, lin.day_point, GROUPING SETS ((con.region_type, lin.day_point, con.region, lin.country), (con.region_type, lin.day_point, con.region), (con.region_type, lin.day_point, lin.country), (con.region_type, lin.day_point))) GROUP BY region_type, region, country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'tgame', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, 'all' AS network, COALESCE(ROUND(pcu, 0), 0) AS pcu, COALESCE(ROUND(acu, 0), 0) AS acu FROM online_cube

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_mcgg_v2_realtime_charge_cnt_daily
sql_units: WITH t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, IF(first_mt_country = '' OR first_mt_country = '-' OR first_mt_country IS NULL, 'unknown', first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-04-20', '2025-04-20', '2026-05-31') AND is_first_create = 1), t_pay AS (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(t_basic.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country FROM (SELECT logymd, money, roleid, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY `time`) AS rn FROM mcgg_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR receipt_type = 0) AND money <> 0 AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%') AS t RIGHT JOIN t_basic ON t.roleid = t_basic.roleid), t_incr AS (SELECT point, country, appname, appid FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-04-23', '2025-04-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mcgg_v2_synclog'), t_charge_base AS (SELECT point, country, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS point_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(rn = 1, roleid, NULL)) AS day_cnt FROM t_pay GROUP BY point, country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_charge_cnt` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mcgg_v2', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country, '' AS network, point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname ORDER BY point) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, COALESCE(t_charge_base.point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt, COALESCE(t_charge_base.day_cnt, 0) AS day_cnt, t_incr.appname FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_charge_base ON t_incr.country = t_charge_base.country AND t_incr.point = t_charge_base.point) AS t1

100 ELSE 0 END) AS 180d_mt_money FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS t1 WHERE t1.logymd > '2026-05-31' AND t1.zoneid <= 57000 AND (t1.receipt_id > 100 OR t1.pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据，因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入 */ AND UPPER(t1.createrole_country) IN ('RU', 'ID', 'PH') GROUP BY UPPER(t1.createrole_country), roleid, zoneid) AS t4 ON t1.roleid = t4.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t4.zoneid AND t1.createrole_country = t4.createrole_country LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS t5 ON t1.roleid = t5.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t5.zoneid AND t5.logymd = '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN logymd = '2026-05-31' THEN chargediamond END) AS chargediamond, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-01' THEN logymd END) AS 30d_act, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-03-02' THEN logymd END) AS 90d_act FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-03-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t6 ON t1.roleid = t6.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t6.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN logymd = '2026-05-31' THEN day_max_bigranklvl END) AS day_last_bigranklvl, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-01' THEN battle_duration END) AS 30d_batt_dua, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-03-02' THEN battle_duration END) AS 90d_batt_dua, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-01' THEN battle_cnt END) AS 30d_batt, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-03-02' THEN battle_cnt END) AS 90d_batt, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-05-01' THEN win_cnt END) AS 30d_win_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN logymd >= '2026-03-02' THEN win_cnt END) AS 90d_win_cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-03-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t7 ON t1.roleid = t7.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t7.zoneid WHERE t1.mt_money = 0

name: etl.ads_decimart_score_net_cube_di_mid
sql_units: WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, create_os AS os, COALESCE(first_network_name, 'unknown') AS network, account_register_date, register_date, is_first_create, new_type, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS channel, logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), dim_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 1 AS region_type, act_geo_continent AS region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 0 AS region_type, region FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_country) /* 取最新 */), dim_basic_country AS (SELECT bas.roleid, bas.zoneid, bas.country, bas.network, COALESCE(con.region_type, 'unknwon') AS region_type, COALESCE(con.region, 'unknwon') AS region FROM basic AS bas LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con ON bas.country = con.country_code), score_net_info AS (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL), IF(NOT zone IS NULL, 'zone', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, COALESCE(zone, '-10000') AS zone, score_net, num FROM (SELECT region_type, region, country, zone, SUM(IF(q1 >= 2 AND q2 >= 2 AND q3 >= 2 AND q4 >= 2, 1, 0)) AS score_net, COUNT(*) AS num FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN n.zoneid < 57000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zone, region_type, region, country, CEIL(quat1_sc) AS q1, CEIL(quat2_sc) AS q2, CEIL(quat3_sc) AS q3, CEIL(quat4_sc) AS q4 FROM dim_basic_country AS bas JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS n ON bas.roleid = n.roleid AND bas.zoneid = n.zoneid INNER JOIN (SELECT FLOOR(battles / 5) * 5 AS bts, a.accountid, a.zoneid, PERCENTILE(IF(a.tl <= (b.battles / 4), self_net_score, NULL), 0.5) AS quat1_sc, PERCENTILE(IF(a.tl > (b.battles / 4) AND a.tl <= ((b.battles * 2) / 4), self_net_score, NULL), 0.5) AS quat2_sc, PERCENTILE(IF(a.tl > ((b.battles * 2) / 4) AND a.tl <= ((b.battles * 3) / 4), self_net_score, NULL), 0.5) AS quat3_sc, PERCENTILE(IF(a.tl > ((b.battles * 3) / 4), self_net_score, NULL), 0.5) AS quat4_sc, FLOOR(STDDEV(self_net_score) * 10) / 10 AS sc_std, MAX(lifetimes) AS lf_time FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY z.accountid, zoneid ORDER BY TIME) AS tl, z.accountid, zoneid, DATEDIFF(z.logymd, z.usercreateymd) AS lifetimes, IF(smallreconnect_num / (battletime / 600) <= 1, 1, 0) + IF(movelag / (battletime / 600) <= 4, 1, 0) + IF((ping80 / ping_times) >= 0.95, 1, 0) AS self_net_score /* 网络质量评分 */, GEOIP(z.clientip, 1) AS na, GEOIP(z.clientip, 2) AS pr, GEOIP(z.clientip, 5) AS ca FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS z WHERE z.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' /* 过去30天 */ AND z.timedelay > 0 AND z.fake_ai = 0) AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT z.accountid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS battles FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end AS z WHERE z.logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND z.timedelay > 0 AND z.fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY z.accountid, zoneid) AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE battles > 4 GROUP BY bts, a.accountid, a.zoneid) AS m ON n.roleid = m.accountid AND n.zoneid = m.zoneid) AS y GROUP BY region_type, CUBE (region, country, zone)) AS z) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_decimart_score_net_cube_di_mid PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT date_range, grouping_name, definition_type, region, country, zone, score_net AS score_net, num AS network_stdping_cnt_30d FROM score_net_info

name: etl.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di_wefly5_account_daily
sql_units: WITH real_country_online AS (SELECT day_point AS day_point, IF(country IS NULL OR TRIM(country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', LOWER(country)) AS country, SUM(COALESCE(online_num, 0)) AS online_num FROM w5_ods.t_real_os_country_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-04-01' AND zone_id > 10000 GROUP BY day_point, IF(country IS NULL OR TRIM(country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', LOWER(country))), dim_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 1 AS region_type, act_geo_continent AS region FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_country) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_code, 0 AS region_type, region FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_country WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_mla_country)), online_cube AS (SELECT region_type, region, country, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, AVG(online_num) AS acu FROM (SELECT con.region_type, con.region, lin.country, lin.day_point, SUM(online_num) AS online_num FROM real_country_online AS lin LEFT JOIN dim_country AS con ON lin.country = con.country_code GROUP BY con.region_type, con.region, lin.country, lin.day_point, GROUPING SETS ((con.region_type, lin.day_point, con.region, lin.country), (con.region_type, lin.day_point, con.region), (con.region_type, lin.day_point, lin.country), (con.region_type, lin.day_point))) GROUP BY region_type, region, country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'wefly5', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, 'all' AS network, COALESCE(ROUND(pcu, 0), 0) AS pcu, COALESCE(ROUND(acu, 0), 0) AS acu FROM online_cube

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_deepgrow_pay_channel_info_df
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: ethandong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-04-08 18:01:52.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_deepgrow_pay_channel_info_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.name') AS name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.logo') AS logo, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.code') AS code, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.caption') AS caption, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.params') AS params, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.passive') AS passive, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.mbp_id') AS mbp_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.version') AS version, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.create_time') AS create_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.update_time') AS update_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.create_uid') AS create_uid, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.update_uid') AS update_uid, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.is_deleted') AS is_deleted, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.billing_configuration_id') AS billing_configuration_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.pay_subject_ids') AS pay_subject_ids FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY update_time DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT `after`, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.id') AS id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(`after`, '$.update_time') AS update_time, op FROM `mt_ods`.`ods_mobapay_cdc` AS `mobapay_cdc` WHERE `mobapay_cdc`.`source` = 'db_payment_pay_config.pay_channel' AND NOT `mobapay_cdc`.`after` IS NULL)) WHERE rn = 1 AND op <> 'd'

name: 新手30到59天特征信息
sql_units: /* -注： 0 - 3天的玩家最近15天的活跃时长、玩家最近15天的战斗场复用玩家活跃时长及玩家战斗场次数， 但之后记得更改！！！！ */ /* VN放量 */ /* -- 玩家活跃时长 */ /* -- 玩家好友数量 */ WITH rz AS (SELECT rz.roleid, rz.zoneid, register_date, SUM(day_login_duration) AS active_duration, MAX(social_friendnum) AS social_friendnum FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE register_date BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, register_date) AS rz LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, day_login_duration, social_friendnum, logymd, LEVEL FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31') AS f ON f.roleid = rz.roleid AND f.zoneid = rz.zoneid AND f.logymd BETWEEN rz.register_date AND DATE_ADD(rz.register_date, 59) WHERE rz.register_date <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 59 * -1) GROUP BY rz.roleid, rz.zoneid, register_date HAVING MAX(LEVEL) >= 5), charge_base AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, logymd, money, usercreateymd FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, money, usercreateymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 30) AND DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 59) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') AND money <> 0 AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%') AS a JOIN rz ON a.roleid = rz.roleid AND a.zoneid = rz.zoneid), charge_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(*) AS charge_cnt, SUM(money) / 100 AS charge_sum, MAX(money) / 100 AS charge_max FROM charge_base GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), diamond_use /* 充值次数 */ /* 累计充值金额 */ /* 每次充值单次付费金额 */ /* 最高单次充值金额 */ /* 玩家最近充值日的日付费金额 */ /* 耗钻大表 */ AS (SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, operate, sub_num, TIME FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, sub_num, operate, TIME FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 30) AND DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 59) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND NOT operate IN ('gm')) AS f JOIN rz ON f.roleid = rz.roleid AND f.zoneid = rz.zoneid), purchase_by_shop AS (SELECT b.roleid, b.zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN shop_cf.item_type = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shop_buy_skin_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN shop_cf.item_type = 6 THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS skin_num, SUM(CASE WHEN shop_cf.item_type = 5 THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS hero_num FROM diamond_use AS b JOIN ml_ods.gameserver_shop_buy AS shop ON b.roleid = shop.roleid AND b.zoneid = shop.zoneid AND b.time = shop.time AND shop.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(shop.usercreateymd, 30) AND DATE_ADD(shop.usercreateymd, 59) AND shop.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01') AS shop_cf ON IF(shop.itemid = 0, SPLIT(gift_item_info, ':')[0], shop.itemid) = shop_cf.item_id WHERE NOT shop.time IS NULL AND shop_cf.item_type <> 10 GROUP BY b.roleid, b.zoneid), shop_buy /* - 玩家消耗钻石明细 */ /* - 玩家商城直购获得的皮肤数 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, gift_buy_num, star_num, skin_num, hero_num, draw_cost, sub_num, shop_buy_skin_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN operate = 'gift_buy' THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS gift_buy_num, SUM(CASE WHEN operate = 'action_act_newplayerstarvip' OR operate = 'action_act_starlightvip' THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS star_num, SUM(CASE WHEN operate LIKE '%draw%' THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS draw_cost, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num FROM diamond_use GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN purchase_by_shop AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid), fake_diamond_get /* -- 玩家拥有的假钻数量 */ AS (SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, SUM(add_num) AS fk_diamond FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, add_num, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 30) AND DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 59) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND NOT operate IN ('gm') AND item_id = 30109) AS f JOIN rz ON f.roleid = rz.roleid AND f.zoneid = rz.zoneid GROUP BY f.roleid, f.zoneid), skin_have /* - 玩家获得的永久皮肤数 */ /* - 玩家拥有永久A+皮个数 */ AS (SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, COUNT(skinid) AS skin_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN skin_quality = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS a_plus_skin_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, skinid, logymd, skin_quality FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_skin WHERE time_len = 0 AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 30) AND DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 59) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31') AS f JOIN rz ON f.roleid = rz.roleid AND f.zoneid = rz.zoneid GROUP BY f.roleid, f.zoneid), battle_info /* -- 玩家战斗场次数 */ /* -- 玩家组队场次数 */ AS (SELECT rz.roleid, rz.zoneid, COUNT(1) AS battle_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN blacknum > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS black_battle_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, blacknum, logymd FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 30) AND DATE_ADD(usercreateymd, 59) AND logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 89 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2)) AS f JOIN rz ON f.accountid = rz.roleid AND f.zoneid = rz.zoneid GROUP BY rz.roleid, rz.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.richardguo_vn_30_59_player PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT rz.roleid, rz.zoneid, COALESCE(charge_cnt, 0) AS charge_cnt /* 充值次数 */, COALESCE(charge_sum, 0) AS charge_sum /* 累计充值金额 */, COALESCE(charge_max, 0) AS charge_max /* 最高单次充值金额 */, COALESCE(sub_num, 0) AS sub_num /* 消耗钻石数 */, COALESCE(draw_cost, 0) AS draw_cost /* 抽奖消耗钻石数 */, COALESCE(active_duration, 0) AS active_duration /* 活跃时长 */, COALESCE(social_friendnum, 0) AS social_friendnum /* 好友数量 */, COALESCE(battle_cnt, 0) AS battle_cnt /* 战斗场次数 */, COALESCE(black_battle_cnt, 0) AS black_battle_cnt /* 组队场次数 */, COALESCE(shop_buy_skin_cnt, 0) AS shop_buy_skin_cnt /* 商城直购获得皮肤数 */, COALESCE(skin_cnt, 0) AS skin_cnt /* 获得的永久皮肤数 */, COALESCE(a_plus_skin_cnt, 0) AS a_plus_skin_cnt /* 永久A+皮肤数 */, COALESCE(fk_diamond, 0) AS fk_diamond /* 拥有的假钻数量 */, COALESCE(gift_buy_num, 0) AS gift_buy_num /* 礼包消耗钻石数 */, COALESCE(star_num, 0) AS star_num /* 星光消耗钻石数 */, COALESCE(skin_num, 0) AS skin_num /* 直购皮肤消耗钻石数 */, COALESCE(hero_num, 0) AS hero_num /* 英雄购买消耗钻石数 */ FROM rz LEFT JOIN charge_info AS a ON rz.roleid = a.roleid AND rz.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN shop_buy AS b ON rz.roleid = b.roleid AND rz.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN fake_diamond_get AS c ON rz.roleid = c.roleid AND rz.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN skin_have AS d ON rz.roleid = d.roleid AND rz.zoneid = d.zoneid LEFT JOIN battle_info AS f ON rz.roleid = f.roleid AND rz.zoneid = f.zoneid

name: dwd_rum_event_di
sql_units: /* -- 防止动态分区残留：重跑前先清掉整个 logymd 分区 */ /* ALTER TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_rum_event_di DROP IF EXISTS PARTITION (logymd = '2026-05-31'); */ WITH base AS (SELECT e.project AS project /* 原始列 */, COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.namespace'), 'unknown') AS team, e.did AS did, e.uuid AS uuid, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.session_id') AS session_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.body, '$.page_view_id') AS page_view_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.sdk_version') AS sdk_version, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.project_version') AS project_version, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.env') AS env, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.url') AS url, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.ua') AS ua, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.phone_brand') AS phone_brand, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.browser_brand') AS browser_brand, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.browser_version') AS browser_version, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.os_platform') AS os_platform, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.os_version') AS os_version, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.screen_width') AS INT) AS screen_width, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.screen_height') AS INT) AS screen_height, e.ip AS ip, e.time AS event_time, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.extra') AS extra, e.meta_event AS meta_event, GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.event_name') AS event_name, e.properties AS raw_properties FROM mtwb_ods.webreportserver_track_event AS e WHERE e.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND /* sdk_version >= 0.13.6（含 -beta 系列；按 major.minor.patch 三段补零比对，规避字符串比对 bug） */ NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.sdk_version') IS NULL AND CONCAT(LPAD(SPLIT(SPLIT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.sdk_version'), '-')[0], '\\.')[0], 4, '0'), '.', LPAD(SPLIT(SPLIT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.sdk_version'), '-')[0], '\\.')[1], 4, '0'), '.', LPAD(SPLIT(SPLIT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.properties, '$.property.sdk_version'), '-')[0], '\\.')[2], 4, '0')) >= '0000.0013.0006'), pv /* === 1. pageview 子类 === */ AS (SELECT project, team, did, uuid, session_id, page_view_id, sdk_version, project_version, env, url, ua, phone_brand, browser_brand, browser_version, os_platform, os_version, screen_width, screen_height, ip, event_time, extra, event_name, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS metric_name, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS metric_value, GET_JSON_OBJECT(raw_properties, '$.parameter.referUrl') AS pv_refer_url, GET_JSON_OBJECT(raw_properties, '$.parameter.url') AS pv_url, GET_JSON_OBJECT(raw_properties, '$.parameter.title') AS pv_title, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS api_type, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS api_method, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS api_domain, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS api_path, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS api_url, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS api_parameters, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS api_request_headers, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS api_request_body, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS api_response_headers, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS api_response_body, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS api_status, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS api_status_text, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS api_duration, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS api_start_time, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS api_end_time, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS api_is_slow, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS resource_url, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS resource_initiator_type, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS resource_protocol, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS resource_duration, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS resource_start_time, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS resource_transfer_size, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS resource_encoded_body_size, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS resource_decoded_body_size, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS resource_delivery_type, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS resource_time_offset, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS resource_is_slow, 'pageview' AS event_subtype FROM base WHERE meta_event = '__built_in_tracks__' AND event_name = '__navigation_timing__' AND NOT m.metric_val_str IS NULL), web_perf_union AS (SELECT project, team, did, uuid, session_id, page_view_id, sdk_version, project_version, env, url, ua, phone_brand, SUM(d.crash_inbattle_launch_cnt) AS crash_inbattle_launch_pv /* 分子：战中崩溃启动次数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.has_crash IN (0, 1) THEN a.accountid END) AS launch_user_uv, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.has_crash = 1 THEN a.accountid END) AS crash_user_uv /* 分子：崩溃用户数（当天至少有一次崩溃） */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.has_crash_inbattle IN (0, 1) THEN a.accountid END) AS launch_inbattle_uv, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.has_crash_inbattle = 1 THEN a.accountid END) AS crash_inbattle_user_uv /* 分子：战中崩溃用户数 */, SUM(l.sum_selftime) AS sum_selftime /* 战斗内加载 */, SUM(l.sum_loadtime) AS sum_loadtime, SUM(l.sample_cnt) AS sample_cnt, user_type, SUM(lognum) AS lognum, SUM(upload_num) AS upload_num, SUM(download_num) AS download_num FROM lite_info AS lI /* dau表 */ LEFT JOIN device_label AS b /* 各种标签 */ ON lI.accountid = b.accountid LEFT JOIN user_type AS u ON lI.accountid = u.accountid LEFT JOIN performance AS a /* 找到这些玩家的性能表现 */ ON lI.accountid = a.accountid LEFT JOIN performance2 AS h ON lI.accountid = h.accountid LEFT JOIN performance3 AS p ON lI.accountid = p.accountid LEFT JOIN user_nores AS c ON lI.accountid = c.accountid LEFT JOIN numerator AS d ON lI.accountid = d.accountid LEFT JOIN user_login_funnel AS g ON lI.accountid = g.accountid LEFT JOIN checking_time AS f ON lI.accountid = f.accountid LEFT JOIN step_39 AS s ON lI.accountid = s.accountid LEFT JOIN battle_loading AS l ON lI.accountid = l.accountid LEFT JOIN network_flow AS nf ON lI.accountid = nf.accountid GROUP BY is_lite, first_country, CASE WHEN is_lite = 1 THEN '只登录了lite包的用户' ELSE '其他用户' END, zone, first_client_ver, device_type, ram_type, config_devicemodel, nowpicturequality, ram, digital, device_score, user_type, isdownload, first_level, finish_download

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_realtime_basic_charge_daily_w5
sql_units: WITH t_basic AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT roleid, register_time, zoneid, logymd, register_date, register_channel AS channel, register_country AS country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY register_time) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_wefly5_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-04-22') AS t1 WHERE rn = 1 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31'), t_pay /* HAVING point_amt > 0 */ AS (SELECT t.logymd, t.point, COALESCE(t_basic.country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(t_basic.channel, 'unknown') AS channel, SUM(t.money) AS point_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT t.roleid) AS point_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.rn = 1, t.roleid, NULL)) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT logymd, money, roleid, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY `time`) AS rn FROM w5_ods.charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid > 10000) AS t LEFT JOIN t_basic ON t.roleid = t_basic.roleid GROUP BY t.logymd, t.point, COALESCE(t_basic.country, 'unknown'), COALESCE(t_basic.channel, 'unknown')), t_incr AS (SELECT point, channel, country, 'wefly5' AS appname FROM (SELECT DISTINCT point, 1 AS join_key FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-04-23', '2025-04-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mcgg_v2_synclog') AS t1 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT channel, country, 1 AS join_key FROM t_pay) AS t2 ON t1.join_key = t2.join_key) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_basic_charge` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'wefly5', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country, channel, COALESCE(point_amt, 0) AS point_amt, COALESCE(day_amt, 0) AS day_amt, COALESCE(point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt, COALESCE(day_cnt, 0) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT point, country, channel, point_amt, SUM(point_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY country, channel, appname ORDER BY point) AS day_amt, point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY country, channel, appname ORDER BY point) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, t_incr.channel, COALESCE(t_pay.point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt, COALESCE(t_pay.day_cnt, 0) AS day_cnt, COALESCE(t_pay.point_amt, 0) AS point_amt, t_incr.appname FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_pay ON t_incr.country = t_pay.country AND t_incr.channel = t_pay.channel AND t_incr.point = t_pay.point) AS t1) AS t2

name: fakeai_tail5_history_part1
sql_units: /* 目标人群 + 创角日期 尾号5 + fake_ai，2025-01-01以来活跃 */ WITH target_users AS (/* fake_ai = 0，真人尾号5 */ SELECT c.roleid, c.zoneid, c.usercreateymd, 0 AS fake_ai FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_first_active_date AS usercreateymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 最新日期 */ AND his_last_active_date >= '2025-01-01' AND roleid % 10 = 5 /* 尾号为5 */ AND zoneid < 57000 /* 排除测试服 */) AS c JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 最新日期 */ AND is_ai = 0 AND zoneid < 57000 /* 排除测试服 */) AS d ON c.roleid = d.roleid AND c.zoneid = d.zoneid UNION /* fake_ai = 1 */ SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.usercreateymd, 1 AS fake_ai FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_first_active_date AS usercreateymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND his_last_active_date >= '2025-01-01' AND zoneid < 57000) AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_ai = 1 AND zoneid < 57000) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid), yesterday /* 昨日历史 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, heroid, usercreateymd, fake_ai, his_pvp1_battle_cnt, his_pvp1_win_cnt, his_pvp2_battle_cnt, his_pvp2_win_cnt, his_pvp4_battle_cnt, his_pvp4_win_cnt, his_hero_battle_cnt, his_hero_win_cnt, his_hero_max_mmr FROM ml_temp.fakeai_tail5_user_hero_history_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), today_hero /* 当日新增数据（英雄维度） */ AS (SELECT u.roleid, u.zoneid, d.heroid, u.fake_ai, u.usercreateymd, SUM(CASE WHEN d.pvptype = 1 THEN d.today_battle_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS his_pvp1_battle_cnt /* 模式维度 */, SUM(CASE WHEN d.pvptype = 1 THEN d.win_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS his_pvp1_win_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN d.pvptype = 2 THEN d.today_battle_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS his_pvp2_battle_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN d.pvptype = 2 THEN d.win_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS his_pvp2_win_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN d.pvptype = 4 THEN d.today_battle_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS his_pvp4_battle_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN d.pvptype = 4 THEN d.win_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS his_pvp4_win_cnt, SUM(d.today_battle_cnt) AS his_hero_battle_cnt /* 英雄整体 */, SUM(d.win_cnt) AS his_hero_win_cnt, MAX(d.max_mmr) AS his_hero_max_mmr FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_heroes_role_zone_di AS d JOIN target_users AS u ON d.roleid = u.roleid AND d.zoneid = u.zoneid WHERE d.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND d.pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) GROUP BY u.roleid, u.zoneid, d.heroid, u.fake_ai, u.usercreateymd), merged_history /* 合并昨天历史 + 今天增量 */ AS (SELECT COALESCE(y.roleid, t.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(y.zoneid, t.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(y.usercreateymd, t.usercreateymd) AS usercreateymd, COALESCE(y.fake_ai, t.fake_ai) AS fake_ai, COALESCE(y.heroid, t.heroid) AS heroid, COALESCE(y.his_pvp1_battle_cnt, 0) /* 模式维度累加 */ + COALESCE(t.his_pvp1_battle_cnt, 0) AS pvp1_battle_cnt, COALESCE(y.his_pvp1_win_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t.his_pvp1_win_cnt, 0) AS pvp1_win_cnt, COALESCE(y.his_pvp2_battle_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t.his_pvp2_battle_cnt, 0) AS pvp2_battle_cnt, COALESCE(y.his_pvp2_win_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t.his_pvp2_win_cnt, 0) AS pvp2_win_cnt, COALESCE(y.his_pvp4_battle_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t.his_pvp4_battle_cnt, 0) AS pvp4_battle_cnt, COALESCE(y.his_pvp4_win_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t.his_pvp4_win_cnt, 0) AS pvp4_win_cnt, COALESCE(y.his_hero_battle_cnt, 0) /* 英雄整体维度累加 */ + COALESCE(t.his_hero_battle_cnt, 0) AS hero_battle_cnt, COALESCE(y.his_hero_win_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(t.his_hero_win_cnt, 0) AS hero_win_cnt, GREATEST(COALESCE(y.his_hero_max_mmr, 0), COALESCE(t.his_hero_max_mmr, 0)) AS hero_max_mmr /* 历史最高MMR */ FROM yesterday AS y FULL OUTER JOIN today_hero AS t ON y.roleid = t.roleid AND y.zoneid = t.zoneid AND y.heroid = t.heroid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.fakeai_tail5_user_hero_history_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, fake_ai, heroid, pvp1_battle_cnt, pvp1_win_cnt, pvp2_battle_cnt, pvp2_win_cnt, pvp4_battle_cnt, pvp4_win_cnt, hero_battle_cnt, hero_win_cnt, hero_max_mmr FROM merged_history

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_caowl@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-04-16 22:53:44.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.country_registdt_active_remian_caowl02 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') /* 分日分国家分注册时长活跃玩家 */ SELECT a1.logymd AS active_date /* 活跃日期 */, a1.country /* 国家 */, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(a1.logymd, a2.register_role_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN '00.近3个月' WHEN DATEDIFF(a1.logymd, a2.register_role_date) BETWEEN 91 AND 360 THEN '01.3个月-1年' WHEN DATEDIFF(a1.logymd, a2.register_role_date) BETWEEN 361 AND 1080 THEN '02.1年-3年' WHEN DATEDIFF(a1.logymd, a2.register_role_date) > 1081 THEN '03.3年及以上' ELSE '未知' END AS register_date /* a2.register_role_date, --注册时间 */ /* 注册时长 */, a1.roleid, a1.zoneid FROM (/* 每日分国家活跃用户 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, MIN(UPPER(ip_country)) AS country FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 AND UPPER(appid) = 'MLBB' AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS a1 LEFT JOIN (/* 玩家注册时长 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_role_date FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000) AS a2 ON a1.roleid = a2.roleid AND a1.zoneid = a2.zoneid

name: fakeai_tail5_part1_plus_part2
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_ztyi@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-04-17 15:08:28.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 历史英雄维度（截至当日的全历史） */ WITH history_hero AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, fake_ai, heroid, his_pvp1_battle_cnt, his_pvp1_win_cnt, his_pvp2_battle_cnt, his_pvp2_win_cnt, his_pvp4_battle_cnt, his_pvp4_win_cnt, his_hero_battle_cnt, his_hero_win_cnt, his_hero_max_mmr FROM ml_temp.fakeai_tail5_user_hero_history_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), season_hero_raw /*  当前赛季：英雄+模式维度（hero 粒度） */ AS (SELECT season_id, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, fake_ai, heroid, season_pvp1_hero_battle_cnt /* 英雄维度赛季字段 */, season_pvp1_hero_win_cnt, season_pvp2_hero_battle_cnt, season_pvp2_hero_win_cnt, season_pvp4_hero_battle_cnt, season_pvp4_hero_win_cnt, season_hero_battle_cnt, season_hero_win_cnt, season_hero_max_mmr, season_hero_cur_mmr FROM ml_temp.fakeai_tail5_user_hero_season_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), season_user_raw /* 当前赛季：用户维度（按用户聚合） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(season_id) AS season_id, MAX(usercreateymd) AS usercreateymd, MAX(fake_ai) AS fake_ai, MAX(season_pvp1_battle_cnt) AS season_pvp1_battle_cnt, MAX(season_pvp1_win_cnt) AS season_pvp1_win_cnt, MAX(season_pvp2_battle_cnt) AS season_pvp2_battle_cnt, MAX(season_pvp2_win_cnt) AS season_pvp2_win_cnt, MAX(season_pvp4_battle_cnt) AS season_pvp4_battle_cnt, MAX(season_pvp4_win_cnt) AS season_pvp4_win_cnt FROM ml_temp.fakeai_tail5_user_hero_season_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), full_hero /* hero 粒度 FULL JOIN 历史 & 赛季英雄（只负责英雄维度） */ AS (SELECT COALESCE(s.roleid, h.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(s.zoneid, h.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(s.usercreateymd, h.usercreateymd) AS usercreateymd, COALESCE(s.fake_ai, h.fake_ai) AS fake_ai, COALESCE(s.heroid, h.heroid) AS heroid, COALESCE(h.his_pvp1_battle_cnt, 0) AS his_pvp1_battle_cnt /* 历史字段：没有就补 0 */, COALESCE(h.his_pvp1_win_cnt, 0) AS his_pvp1_win_cnt, COALESCE(h.his_pvp2_battle_cnt, 0) AS his_pvp2_battle_cnt, COALESCE(h.his_pvp2_win_cnt, 0) AS his_pvp2_win_cnt, COALESCE(h.his_pvp4_battle_cnt, 0) AS his_pvp4_battle_cnt, COALESCE(h.his_pvp4_win_cnt, 0) AS his_pvp4_win_cnt, COALESCE(h.his_hero_battle_cnt, 0) AS his_hero_battle_cnt, COALESCE(h.his_hero_win_cnt, 0) AS his_hero_win_cnt, COALESCE(h.his_hero_max_mmr, 0) AS his_hero_max_mmr, COALESCE(s.season_pvp1_hero_battle_cnt, 0) AS season_pvp1_hero_battle_cnt /* 英雄维度赛季字段：没在本赛季用过这个 hero，就全是 0 */, COALESCE(s.season_pvp1_hero_win_cnt, 0) AS season_pvp1_hero_win_cnt, COALESCE(s.season_pvp2_hero_battle_cnt, 0) AS season_pvp2_hero_battle_cnt, COALESCE(s.season_pvp2_hero_win_cnt, 0) AS season_pvp2_hero_win_cnt, COALESCE(s.season_pvp4_hero_battle_cnt, 0) AS season_pvp4_hero_battle_cnt, COALESCE(s.season_pvp4_hero_win_cnt, 0) AS season_pvp4_hero_win_cnt, COALESCE(s.season_hero_battle_cnt, 0) AS season_hero_battle_cnt, COALESCE(s.season_hero_win_cnt, 0) AS season_hero_win_cnt, COALESCE(s.season_hero_max_mmr, 0) AS season_hero_max_mmr, COALESCE(s.season_hero_cur_mmr, 0) AS season_hero_cur_mmr FROM history_hero AS h FULL OUTER JOIN season_hero_raw AS s ON h.roleid = s.roleid AND h.zoneid = s.zoneid AND h.heroid = s.heroid), final_profile /*  按用户维度回灌赛季“用户整体”统计 */ AS (SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, COALESCE(u.usercreateymd, f.usercreateymd) AS usercreateymd /* usercreateymd / fake_ai 优先用用户赛季表，如果这个用户本赛季没出现，就用历史里的 */, COALESCE(u.fake_ai, f.fake_ai) AS fake_ai, f.heroid, f.his_pvp1_battle_cnt /* 历史信息 */, f.his_pvp1_win_cnt, f.his_pvp2_battle_cnt, f.his_pvp2_win_cnt, f.his_pvp4_battle_cnt, f.his_pvp4_win_cnt, f.his_hero_battle_cnt, f.his_hero_win_cnt, f.his_hero_max_mmr, u.season_id /* 当前赛季ID（该用户只要在赛季内有任何对局，就有值；否则为 NULL） */, COALESCE(u.season_pvp1_battle_cnt, 0) AS season_pvp1_battle_cnt /* 用户维度赛季模式统计（和 hero 是否出现无关，只取决于用户有没有打本赛季） */, COALESCE(u.season_pvp1_win_cnt, 0) AS season_pvp1_win_cnt, COALESCE(u.season_pvp2_battle_cnt, 0) AS season_pvp2_battle_cnt, COALESCE(u.season_pvp2_win_cnt, 0) AS season_pvp2_win_cnt, COALESCE(u.season_pvp4_battle_cnt, 0) AS season_pvp4_battle_cnt, COALESCE(u.season_pvp4_win_cnt, 0) AS season_pvp4_win_cnt, f.season_pvp1_hero_battle_cnt /* 英雄维度赛季指标（某 hero 本赛季没用就为 0） */, f.season_pvp1_hero_win_cnt, f.season_pvp2_hero_battle_cnt, f.season_pvp2_hero_win_cnt, f.season_pvp4_hero_battle_cnt, f.season_pvp4_hero_win_cnt, f.season_hero_battle_cnt, f.season_hero_win_cnt, f.season_hero_max_mmr, f.season_hero_cur_mmr FROM full_hero AS f sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_caowl@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-04-17 21:25:14.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* ⚠️ 引擎：SPARK_SQL（from_json / explode 在 Presto 不可用） */ /* ⚠️ 执行前先 SHOW PARTITIONS mt_dm.dm_behavior_season_role_zone_df */ /*    将下方三个分区日期替换为实际存在的分区日期 */ /*      再上赛季：'2025-12-17' */ /*      上赛季  ：'2026-03-10' */ /*      本赛季  ：'2026-04-05' */ WITH t0 AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, MIN(logymd) AS enter_dt, CASE WHEN param_version = '10750' THEN '对照组' ELSE '实验组' END AS group_label FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-25' AND '2026-03-31' AND param_name = '60_SeasonHeroPool_2' AND param_version IN ('10750', '10751', '10752', '10753') AND old_zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY accountid, old_zoneid, CASE WHEN param_version = '10750' THEN '对照组' ELSE '实验组' END), t1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT accountid, old_zoneid FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE param_value = '__MTTD_INTERNAL_LONG_OBSERVE_GROUP__' AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-04-02' AND old_zoneid < 57000), t2 AS (SELECT t0.enter_dt, t0.group_label, t0.roleid, t0.zoneid FROM t0 LEFT JOIN t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.accountid AND t0.zoneid = t1.old_zoneid WHERE t1.accountid IS NULL AND t1.old_zoneid IS NULL), prev_prev_ss_exploded /* 再上赛季快照（单一 logymd） */ AS (SELECT t2.group_label, t2.roleid, t2.zoneid, hero_id, CAST(hero_cnt AS BIGINT) AS hero_cnt FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_season_role_zone_df AS d INNER JOIN t2 ON d.roleid = t2.roleid AND d.zoneid = t2.zoneid LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(FROM_JSON(d.ss_hero_cnt_json, 'map<string,bigint>')) ht AS hero_id, hero_cnt WHERE d.logymd = '2025-12-17' /* 再上赛季实际分区 */ AND NOT d.ss_hero_cnt_json IS NULL AND d.ss_hero_cnt_json <> ''), last_ss_exploded /* 上赛季快照（单一 logymd） */ AS (SELECT t2.group_label, t2.roleid, t2.zoneid, hero_id, CAST(hero_cnt AS BIGINT) AS hero_cnt FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_season_role_zone_df AS d INNER JOIN t2 ON d.roleid = t2.roleid AND d.zoneid = t2.zoneid LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(FROM_JSON(d.ss_hero_cnt_json, 'map<string,bigint>')) ht AS hero_id, hero_cnt WHERE d.logymd = '2026-03-10' /* 上赛季实际分区 */ AND NOT d.ss_hero_cnt_json IS NULL AND d.ss_hero_cnt_json <> ''), t3 /* t3 as  */ /* (--赛季配置表 */ /* SELECT */ /*         CAST(season AS BIGINT)              AS cur_season_id, */ /*         SUBSTR(season_starttime, 1, 10)     AS season_start, */ /*         SUBSTR(season_endtime,   1, 10)     AS season_end */ /*     FROM mt_dim.dim_season_config_df */ /*     WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-10', '2023-05-10', '2026-05-31') */ /*     AND SUBSTR(season_starttime, 1, 10) <= '2026-05-30' */ /*     AND '2026-05-30' <= SUBSTR(season_endtime, 1, 10) */ /* ) */ /* , */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(ss_max_rankstar) AS max_rankstar /* 玩家进组当天的近3赛季最高段位 */ FROM (SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, f.ss_max_rankstar FROM t2 AS u INNER JOIN mt_dm.dm_behavior_season_role_zone_df AS f ON u.roleid = f.roleid AND u.zoneid = f.zoneid WHERE f.logymd IN ('2025-12-17', '2026-03-10') /* 静态分区，平台可识别 */ AND UPPER(f.appid) = 'MLBB' AND f.zoneid < 57000 UNION ALL SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, f.ss_max_rankstar FROM t2 AS u INNER JOIN mt_dm.dm_behavior_season_role_zone_df AS f ON u.roleid = f.roleid AND u.zoneid = f.zoneid AND u.enter_dt = f.logymd /* 动态精确匹配进组当天 */ WHERE f.logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-25' AND '2026-03-31' /* 静态谓词覆盖实验窗口 */ AND UPPER(f.appid) = 'MLBB' AND f.zoneid < 57000) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), cur_ss_exploded /* 本赛季快照（单一 logymd） */ AS (SELECT t2.group_label, t2.roleid, t2.zoneid, hero_id, CAST(hero_cnt AS BIGINT) AS hero_cnt FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_season_role_zone_df AS d INNER JOIN t2 ON d.roleid = t2.roleid AND d.zoneid = t2.zoneid LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(FROM_JSON(d.ss_hero_cnt_json, 'map<string,bigint>')) ht AS hero_id, hero_cnt WHERE d.logymd = /* 本赛季实际分区 */ IF('2026-05-30' <= '2020-03-21', '2020-03-21', '2026-05-30') AND NOT d.ss_hero_cnt_json IS NULL AND d.ss_hero_cnt_json <> ''), metric_two_prev /* 指标1：上赛季+再上赛季，单赛季 ≥5 场的去重英雄数（每玩家） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) AS two_prev_ss_hero_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, hero_id FROM prev_prev_ss_exploded WHERE hero_cnt >= 5 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, hero_id FROM last_ss_exploded WHERE hero_cnt >= 5) AS combined GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), metric_three_ss /* 指标2：上赛季+再上赛季+本赛季，单赛季 ≥5 场的去重英雄数（每玩家） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) AS three_ss_hero_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, hero_id FROM prev_prev_ss_exploded WHERE hero_cnt >= 5 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, hero_id FROM last_ss_exploded WHERE hero_cnt >= 5 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, hero_id FROM cur_ss_exploded WHERE hero_cnt >= 5) AS combined GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.season_rankstar_winrate_caowl PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t2.group_label, CASE WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 10 THEN '1-勇士' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 21 THEN '2-精英' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 37 THEN '3-大师' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 62 THEN '4-宗师' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 87 THEN '5-史诗' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 112 THEN '6-传奇' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 137 THEN '7-神话' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 162 THEN '8-百战神话' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 212 THEN '9-荣耀神话' WHEN t3.max_rankstar >= 212 THEN '10-至尊神话' ELSE '未知' END AS max_rankstar /* t3.max_rankstar,--近3赛季最高段位 */, COUNT(1) AS player_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(m1.two_prev_ss_hero_cnt, 0)) AS avg_two_prev_ss_hero_cnt /* 上赛季+再上赛季去重英雄数均值 */, SUM(COALESCE(m2.three_ss_hero_cnt, 0)) AS avg_three_ss_hero_cnt /* 上赛季+再上赛季+本赛季去重英雄数均值 */ FROM t2 LEFT JOIN metric_two_prev AS m1 ON t2.roleid = m1.roleid AND t2.zoneid = m1.zoneid LEFT JOIN metric_three_ss AS m2 ON t2.roleid = m2.roleid AND t2.zoneid = m2.zoneid LEFT JOIN t3 ON t2.roleid = t3.roleid AND t2.zoneid = t3.zoneid GROUP BY t2.group_label, CASE WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 10 THEN '1-勇士' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 21 THEN '2-精英' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 37 THEN '3-大师' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 62 THEN '4-宗师' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 87 THEN '5-史诗' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 112 THEN '6-传奇' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 137 THEN '7-神话' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 162 THEN '8-百战神话' WHEN t3.max_rankstar < 212 THEN '9-荣耀神话' WHEN t3.max_rankstar >= 212 THEN '10-至尊神话' ELSE '未知' END ORDER BY t2.group_label

a.stepid, a.sub_stepid, t.usercreateymd, param_value FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_newbie_guide AS a JOIN rz AS t ON a.accountid = t.roleid AND a.zoneid = t.zoneid AND DATEDIFF(t.usercreateymd, a.logymd) <= 13 WHERE a.logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-29' AND '2026-05-31' AND a.usercreateymd >= '2026-01-29' AND a.stepid = 2015 AND a.sub_stepid IN (1, 8, 10, 11, 13, 15, 23, 27, 32, 33, 34, 39)), jx AS (SELECT rz.roleid, rz.zoneid, MIN(realpicturequality + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`) * 100000000) % 100000000 AS realpicturequality FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_configuration AS jx JOIN rz ON rz.roleid = jx.accountid AND rz.zoneid = jx.zoneid AND DATEDIFF(jx.logymd, rz.usercreateymd) = 0 WHERE jx.logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-29' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY rz.roleid, rz.zoneid), gpu AS (SELECT rz.roleid, rz.zoneid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_bytebench_score AS gpu JOIN rz ON rz.roleid = gpu.accountid AND rz.zoneid = gpu.zoneid AND DATEDIFF(gpu.logymd, rz.usercreateymd) = 0 WHERE gpu.logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-29' AND '2026-05-31' AND gpumodel IN ('Mali-G610', 'meow', 'adreno', 'mali', 'mtk', 'powervr', 'Mali-G76') GROUP BY rz.roleid, rz.zoneid), th AS (SELECT rz.roleid, rz.zoneid, MAX(p.heroid + UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`) * 100000000) % 100000000 AS heroid FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_latinnewpickhero AS p JOIN rz ON rz.roleid = p.accountid AND rz.zoneid = p.zoneid AND DATEDIFF(p.logymd, rz.usercreateymd) = 0 WHERE p.logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-29' AND '2026-05-31' AND clickbutton_type = 1 GROUP BY rz.roleid, rz.zoneid), result AS (SELECT a.param_value /* -------- 维度字段 -------- */, UPPER(a.createrole_country) AS createrole_country, jx.realpicturequality, a.usercreateymd, CASE WHEN th.heroid = 18 THEN '射手' WHEN th.heroid = 38 THEN '法师' WHEN th.heroid = 36 THEN '法师' WHEN th.heroid = 85 THEN '战士' ELSE '首日未上报' END AS heroid, IF(gpu.roleid IS NULL, '正常', '异常') AS is_gpu, a.param_name, a.zoneid, a.his_first_loginclient_version, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_trigger_users /* -------- 防御塔教学人数 -------- */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_intro_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 8 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_attack_any_target_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 10 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_kill_three_minion_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 11 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_cannon_appear_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 13 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_kill_cannon_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 15 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_bamon_born_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 23 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_kill_soldier_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 27 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_kill_bamon_dias_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 32 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_camera_move_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 33 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_watch_outer_born_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 34 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_camera_back_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 39 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_destroy_outer_users, COUNT(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_trigger_cnt /* -------- 防御塔教学次数 -------- */, COUNT(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 1 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_intro_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 8 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_attack_any_target_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 10 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_kill_three_minion_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 11 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_cannon_appear_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 13 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_kill_cannon_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 15 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_bamon_born_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 23 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_kill_soldier_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 27 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_kill_bamon_dias_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 32 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_camera_move_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 33 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_watch_outer_born_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 34 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_camera_back_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN e1.stepid = 2015 AND e1.sub_stepid = 39 THEN a.roleid END) AS tower_destroy_outer_cnt, COUNT(a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS cnt FROM rz AS a LEFT JOIN e1 ON e1.roleid = a.roleid AND e1.zoneid = a.zoneid LEFT JOIN jx ON jx.roleid = a.roleid AND roleid, tag, logymd, COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, channel, tag_num FROM (SELECT roleid, 'create' AS tag, channel, country, logymd, 0 AS tag_num FROM (SELECT roleid, channel, country, logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY server_time) AS rn FROM t_create) AS t WHERE rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, 'login' AS tag, channel, country, logymd, 0 AS tag_num FROM t_login sql_units: /* 第一步：基础数据清洗（空值补0） */ WITH base_data /*  AND zoneid >= 57000 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_max_conwin_3d, 0) AS max_conwin_3d, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_mvp_count_7d, 0) AS mvp_count_7d, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_legendary_count_7d, 0) AS legendary_count_7d, COALESCE(o_c_jungle_realpower, 0) AS jungle_rp, COALESCE(o_c_exp_realpower, 0) AS exp_rp, COALESCE(o_c_coin_realpower, 0) AS coin_rp, COALESCE(o_c_mid_realpower, 0) AS mid_rp, COALESCE(o_c_roam_realpower, 0) AS roam_rp, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_jungle_7d, 0) AS cnt_jungle_7d, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_exp_7d, 0) AS cnt_exp_7d, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_coin_7d, 0) AS cnt_coin_7d, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_mid_7d, 0) AS cnt_mid_7d, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_roam_7d, 0) AS cnt_roam_7d, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_jungle_7d, 0) AS win_jungle_7d, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_exp_7d, 0) AS win_exp_7d, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_coin_7d, 0) AS win_coin_7d, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_mid_7d, 0) AS win_mid_7d, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_win_count_roam_7d, 0) AS win_roam_7d, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_jungle_50bc, 0) AS cnt_jungle_50, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_exp_50bc, 0) AS cnt_exp_50, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_coin_50bc, 0) AS cnt_coin_50, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_mid_50bc, 0) AS cnt_mid_50, COALESCE(o_c_rank_mode_battle_count_roam_50bc, 0) AS cnt_roam_50 FROM mt_ai.mlbb_social_rec_v1_tag_base WHERE p_date = '2026-05-29'), ranked /* 第二步：计算分路排名 + 胜率 */ AS (SELECT *, (IF(jungle_rp >= exp_rp, 0, 1) + IF(jungle_rp >= coin_rp, 0, 1) + IF(jungle_rp >= mid_rp, 0, 1) + IF(jungle_rp >= roam_rp, 0, 1) + 1) AS jungle_rank, (IF(exp_rp >= jungle_rp, 0, 1) + IF(exp_rp >= coin_rp, 0, 1) + IF(exp_rp >= mid_rp, 0, 1) + IF(exp_rp >= roam_rp, 0, 1) + 1) AS exp_rank, (IF(coin_rp >= jungle_rp, 0, 1) + IF(coin_rp >= exp_rp, 0, 1) + IF(coin_rp >= mid_rp, 0, 1) + IF(coin_rp >= roam_rp, 0, 1) + 1) AS coin_rank, (IF(mid_rp >= jungle_rp, 0, 1) + IF(mid_rp >= exp_rp, 0, 1) + IF(mid_rp >= coin_rp, 0, 1) + IF(mid_rp >= roam_rp, 0, 1) + 1) AS mid_rank, (IF(roam_rp >= jungle_rp, 0, 1) + IF(roam_rp >= exp_rp, 0, 1) + IF(roam_rp >= coin_rp, 0, 1) + IF(roam_rp >= mid_rp, 0, 1) + 1) AS roam_rank, IF(cnt_jungle_7d > 0, win_jungle_7d * 100.0 / cnt_jungle_7d, 0) AS pct_jungle, IF(cnt_exp_7d > 0, win_exp_7d * 100.0 / cnt_exp_7d, 0) AS pct_exp, IF(cnt_coin_7d > 0, win_coin_7d * 100.0 / cnt_coin_7d, 0) AS pct_coin, IF(cnt_mid_7d > 0, win_mid_7d * 100.0 / cnt_mid_7d, 0) AS pct_mid, IF(cnt_roam_7d > 0, win_roam_7d * 100.0 / cnt_roam_7d, 0) AS pct_roam FROM base_data), tag_gen /* 第三步：逐一生成标签（不使用FILTER） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, IF(max_conwin_3d > 5, 1101, NULL) AS tag1, IF(mvp_count_7d > 30, 1102, NULL) AS tag2, IF(legendary_count_7d > 30, 1103, NULL) AS tag3, IF(jungle_rank <= 2 AND cnt_jungle_7d > 20 AND pct_jungle > 66, 1104, NULL) AS tag4, IF(exp_rank <= 2 AND cnt_exp_7d > 20 AND pct_exp > 66, 1105, NULL) AS tag5, IF(coin_rank <= 2 AND cnt_coin_7d > 20 AND pct_coin > 66, 1106, NULL) AS tag6, IF(mid_rank <= 2 AND cnt_mid_7d > 20 AND pct_mid > 66, 1107, NULL) AS tag7, IF(roam_rank <= 2 AND cnt_roam_7d > 20 AND pct_roam > 66, 1108, NULL) AS tag8, IF(cnt_jungle_50 >= 20, 1109, NULL) AS tag9, IF(cnt_exp_50 >= 20, 1110, NULL) AS tag10, IF(cnt_coin_50 >= 20, 1111, NULL) AS tag11, IF(cnt_mid_50 >= 20, 1112, NULL) AS tag12, IF(cnt_roam_50 >= 20, 1113, NULL) AS tag13 FROM ranked), tag_array /* 第四步：把所有有效标签拼成数组（自动去掉NULL，兼容所有引擎） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', tag1, tag2, tag3, tag4, tag5, tag6, tag7, tag8, tag9, tag10, tag11, tag12, tag13), ',') AS tag_arr FROM tag_gen), toptags /* 第五步：排序 + 取出前6个标签，不足补1114 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(CAST(tag_arr[0] AS INT), 1114) AS social_tag0, COALESCE(CAST(tag_arr[1] AS INT), 1114) AS social_tag1, COALESCE(CAST(tag_arr[2] AS INT), 1114) AS social_tag2, COALESCE(CAST(tag_arr[3] AS INT), 1114) AS social_tag3, COALESCE(CAST(tag_arr[4] AS INT), 1114) AS social_tag4, COALESCE(CAST(tag_arr[5] AS INT), 1114) AS social_tag5 FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SORT_ARRAY(tag_arr) AS tag_arr FROM tag_array) AS t), social_rec /* -- 最终输出 */ /* SELECT * FROM toptags limit 100; */ /* and zoneid >= 57000 */ AS (SELECT accountid AS role1, zoneid AS zone1, showplayer_accountid AS role2, showplayer_zoneid AS zone2, showtaglist1, showtaglist2, showtaglist3 FROM ml_ods.connserver_social_recommendlistrecord WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ai.mlbb_social_rec_v1_tag_conflict_check PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT *, CASE WHEN (self_tag0 = 1104 AND other_tag0 IN (1104, 1109)) /* 检查 self_tag0 */ OR (self_tag0 = 1109 AND other_tag0 IN (1109, 1104)) OR (self_tag0 = 1105 AND other_tag0 IN (1105, 1110)) OR (self_tag0 = 1110 AND other_tag0 IN (1110, 1105)) OR (self_tag0 = 1106 AND other_tag0 IN (1106, 1111)) OR (self_tag0 = 1111 AND other_tag0 IN (1111, 1106)) OR (self_tag0 = 1107 AND other_tag0 IN (1107, 1112)) OR (self_tag0 = 1112 AND other_tag0 IN (1112, 1107)) OR (self_tag0 = 1108 AND other_tag0 IN (1108, 1113)) OR (self_tag0 = 1113 AND other_tag0 IN (1113, 1108)) OR (self_tag1 = 1104 AND other_tag0 IN (1104, 1109)) /* 检查 self_tag1 */ OR (self_tag1 = 1109 AND other_tag0 IN (1109, 1104)) OR (self_tag1 = 1105 AND other_tag0 IN (1105, 1110)) OR (self_tag1 = 1110 AND other_tag0 IN (1110, 1105)) OR (self_tag1 = 1106 AND other_tag0 IN (1106, 1111)) OR (self_tag1 = 1111 AND other_tag0 IN (1111, 1106)) OR (self_tag1 = 1107 AND other_tag0 IN (1107, 1112)) OR (self_tag1 = 1112 AND other_tag0 IN (1112, 1107)) OR (self_tag1 = 1108 AND other_tag0 IN (1108, 1113)) OR (self_tag1 = 1113 AND other_tag0 IN (1113, 1108)) OR (other_tag0 = 1104 AND self_tag0 IN (1104, 1109)) /* 检查 other_tag0 */ OR (other_tag0 = 1109 AND self_tag0 IN (1109, 1104)) OR (other_tag0 = 1105 AND self_tag0 IN (1105, 1110)) OR (other_tag0 = 1110 AND self_tag0 IN (1110, 1105)) OR (other_tag0 = 1106 AND self_tag0 IN (1106, 1111)) OR (other_tag0 = 1111 AND self_tag0 IN (1111, 1106)) OR (other_tag0 = 1107 AND self_tag0 IN (1107, 1112)) OR (other_tag0 = 1112 AND self_tag0 IN (1112, 1107)) OR (other_tag0 = 1108 AND self_tag0 IN (1108, 1113)) OR (other_tag0 = 1113 AND self_tag0 IN (1113, 1108)) OR (other_tag1 = 1104 AND self_tag0 IN (1104, 1109)) /* 检查 other_tag1 */ OR (other_tag1 = 1109 AND self_tag0 IN (1109, 1104)) OR (other_tag1 = 1105 AND self_tag0 IN (1105, 1110)) OR (other_tag1 = 1110 AND self_tag0 IN (1110, 1105)) OR (other_tag1 = 1106 AND self_tag0 IN (1106, 1111)) OR (other_tag1 = 1111 AND self_tag0 IN (1111, 1106)) OR (other_tag1 = 1107 AND self_tag0 IN (1107, 1112)) OR (other_tag1 = 1112 AND self_tag0 IN (1112, 1107)) OR (other_tag1 = 1108 AND self_tag0 IN (1108, 1113)) OR (other_tag1 = 1113 AND self_tag0 IN (1113, 1108)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_tag_conflict /* ============================================== */ /* 【冲突判断】self_tag 前两个 与 other_tag 前两个 是否存在冲突 */ /* 规则：只要有一对冲突，就标记为冲突（1=冲突，0=不冲突） */ /* ============================================== */ /* 1=冲突，0=不冲突 */, CASE WHEN NOT showtaglist1 = other_tag0 AND NOT showtaglist2 = other_tag1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS show_tag_inconsistent /* ============================================== */ /* 【离在线一致性判断】showtaglist 前两位 与 other_tag 前两位 是否完全一致 */ /* 1=一致，0=不一致 */ /* ============================================== */ FROM (SELECT rec.role1, rec.role2, rec.zone1, rec.zone2, CASE WHEN rec.zone1 < 57000 THEN 'test' ELSE 'prod' END AS env, rec.showtaglist1, rec.showtaglist2, rec.showtaglist3, trs.social_tag0 AS self_tag0 /* 现在（修复） */, trs.social_tag1 AS self_tag1, trs.social_tag2 AS self_tag2, cis.social_tag0 AS other_tag0, cis.social_tag1 AS other_tag1, cis.social_tag2 AS other_tag2 FROM social_rec AS rec LEFT JOIN toptags AS trs ON rec.role1 = trs.roleid AND rec.zone1 = trs.zoneid LEFT JOIN toptags AS cis ON rec.role2 = cis.roleid AND rec.zone2 = cis.zoneid WHERE NOT trs.social_tag0 IS NULL)

Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH instance_di AS (SELECT id AS instance_id, task_id, name, CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN '初始化状态' WHEN status = 2 THEN '等待上游依赖' WHEN status = 3 THEN '等待到达执行时间' WHEN status = 4 THEN '等待任务分配QUOTA' WHEN status = 41 THEN '等待任务提交worker' WHEN status = 5 THEN '已提交' WHEN status = 6 THEN '执行器提交' WHEN status = 7 THEN '执行器等待' WHEN status = 9 THEN 'sensor等待被线程池调度' WHEN status = 10 THEN '运行中状态' WHEN status = 19 THEN '强制置为成功' WHEN status = 20 THEN '执行完成' WHEN status = 21 THEN '执行失败' WHEN status = 22 THEN 'OOM状态' WHEN status = 27 THEN '实例强制成功，触发下游成功' WHEN status = 30 THEN '成功之后触发下游' WHEN status = 31 THEN '超过最大重试次数/主动置失败' WHEN status = 32 THEN '任务失败，且状态与Manta强规则关联' WHEN status = 35 THEN '执行成功，且状态与Manta强规则关联' WHEN status = 36 THEN '执行成功，且状态与Manta强规则关联，并触发下游' WHEN status = 80 THEN '取消' WHEN status = 90 THEN '被动终止' WHEN status = 99 THEN '删除' WHEN status = -1 THEN '默认' WHEN status = -2 THEN '未就绪' ELSE status END AS status_name, submit_time AS leap_submit_time, start_time AS leap_start_time, task_time AS leap_task_time, external_sub_application_id, end_time AS leap_end_time, IF(external_sub_application_id LIKE 'etl%', SPLIT(SPLIT(external_sub_application_id, '-')[0], '_')[1], external_sub_application_id) AS sub_application_id, code, conf FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__instance_hi WHERE date >= '20260529' AND date <= '20260602' AND NOT end_time IS NULL), task_info AS (SELECT a.name AS project_name, CASE WHEN t.type = 101 THEN 'mysql2leap' WHEN t.type = 201 THEN 'HQL' WHEN t.type = 202 THEN 'shell' WHEN t.type = 110 THEN 'hive2ch' WHEN t.type = 126 THEN 'larksheet2hive' WHEN t.type = 701 THEN 'spark' ELSE '其他' END AS task_type_name, t.owner_user_name, t.id, SPLIT(t.owner_user_name, '@')[0] AS userid, t.cron_expression, CASE WHEN t.schedule_type = 1 THEN '手动调度' WHEN t.schedule_type = 2 THEN '周期调度' WHEN t.schedule_type = 3 THEN '临时查询' ELSE '其他' END AS schedule_type, CASE WHEN t.status = 1 THEN 'INIT' WHEN t.status = 2 THEN 'RUNNABLE' WHEN t.status = 3 THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN t.status = 4 THEN 'DELETED' ELSE '其他' END AS task_status FROM mt_ods.dl_dorado__project_df AS a JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__folder_df AS b ON a.id = b.project_id JOIN mt_ods.dl_dorado__task_df AS t ON b.id = t.folder_id WHERE a.date = '20260531' AND b.date = '20260531' AND t.date = '20260531'), tqs_query_task AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, progress, name, REGEXP_EXTRACT(name, '_([0-9]+)_') AS task_id, date, REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(progress, '$.trackingUrl'), '/(application_[0-9]+_[0-9]+)/') AS application_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY end_time DESC) AS rn FROM mt_ods.dl_tqs_spark3__tqs_query_task_hi WHERE date >= '20260526' AND date <= '20260605') AS t WHERE rn = 1), yarn_info AS (SELECT yarn_id, yarn_name, ts, application_type, elapsed_time AS yarn_elapsed_time, started_time AS yarn_started_time, finished_time AS yarn_finished_time, memory_seconds, vcore_seconds, queue, running_containers, state AS yarn_state, user AS yarn_user FROM (SELECT *, id AS yarn_id, name AS yarn_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id, state ORDER BY ts ASC) AS rn FROM mt_ods.yarn_app_info_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-26' AND logymd <= '2026-06-05') AS t WHERE rn = 1), new_app /* 新增表 CTE（按实际表名和过滤条件调整） */ AS (SELECT app_id, start_time, end_time, file_size, hdfs_path, spark_properties, stage_metrics, task_metrics, sql_metrics, executor_added, executor_removed, yarn_start_time, yarn_end_time, yarn_collect_time FROM mt_ods.spark_app_info_di /* 替换为真实表名 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 若有分区请加上过滤条件 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_spark_yarn_instance_detail_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT new_app.app_id /* 新表字段（按需保留） */, new_app.start_time, new_app.end_time, new_app.file_size, new_app.hdfs_path, new_app.spark_properties, new_app.stage_metrics, new_app.task_metrics, new_app.sql_metrics, new_app.executor_added, new_app.executor_removed, instance_id /* 原有字段（来自实例组合） */, task_id, name, status_name, FROM_UNIXTIME(leap_task_time + 8 * 60 * 60) AS leap_task_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(leap_submit_time + 8 * 60 * 60) AS leap_submit_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(leap_start_time + 8 * 60 * 60) AS leap_start_time, external_sub_application_id, sub_application_id, FROM_UNIXTIME(leap_end_time + 8 * 60 * 60) AS leap_end_time, project_name, task_type_name, owner_user_name, userid, cron_expression, schedule_type, task_status, tqs_query_id, tqs_query_name, application_id, final_application_id, code, conf, tqs_start_time, yarn_name, FROM_UNIXTIME(ts + 8 * 60 * 60) AS yarn_collection_time, application_type AS yarn_application_type, yarn_elapsed_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(yarn_started_time / 1000 + 8 * 60 * 60) AS yarn_started_time, FROM_UNIXTIME(IF(yarn_finished_time = 0, NULL, yarn_finished_time) / 1000 + 8 * 60 * 60) AS yarn_finished_time, memory_seconds, vcore_seconds, queue AS yarn_queue, running_containers, yarn_state, yarn_user FROM new_app LEFT JOIN (/* 原有 tbl_a 子查询 */ SELECT *, COALESCE(application_id, external_sub_application_id) AS final_application_id, SUBSTRING(REPLACE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(progress, '$.executionStage.startTime'), 'T', ' '), 1, 19) AS tqs_start_time FROM (SELECT instance_di.instance_id, instance_di.task_id, instance_di.name, instance_di.status_name, instance_di.leap_submit_time, instance_di.leap_start_time, instance_di.external_sub_application_id, instance_di.sub_application_id, task_info.cron_expression, task_info.schedule_type, task_info.task_status, tqs_query_task.id AS tqs_query_id, tqs_query_task.progress, tqs_query_task.name AS tqs_query_name, tqs_query_task.application_id FROM instance_di LEFT JOIN task_info ON instance_di.task_id = task_info.id LEFT JOIN tqs_query_task ON instance_di.sub_application_id = tqs_query_task.id)) AS tbl_a ON new_app.app_id = tbl_a.final_application_id LEFT JOIN yarn_info ON new_app.app_id = yarn_info.yarn_id

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: yudongzhang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-04-21 15:30:13.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 【周活流转情况】 */ WITH t_infos AS (SELECT monday_curweek /* 本周一 */, monday_lastweek /* 上周一 */, user_type_lastweek /* 上周活跃用户分层 */, user_type_curweek /* 本周活跃用户分层 */, CASE WHEN NOT country IS NULL THEN country ELSE '未知' END AS first_mt_country /* 首次创号国（固定属性） */, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid) AS week_active_users /* 周活用户数 */ FROM (SELECT COALESCE(t1.roleid, t2.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(t1.zoneid, t2.zoneid) AS zoneid, '2026-05-25' AS monday_curweek /* 本周一 */, '2026-05-18' AS monday_lastweek /* 上周一 */, CASE WHEN t1.active_days >= 6 THEN '高活' WHEN t1.active_days >= 3 THEN '中活' WHEN t1.active_days >= 1 THEN '低活' ELSE '无活跃' /* 上周无活跃本周活跃用户 */ END AS user_type_lastweek /* 上周活跃用户分层 */, CASE WHEN t2.active_days >= 6 THEN '高活' WHEN t2.active_days >= 3 THEN '中活' WHEN t2.active_days >= 1 THEN '低活' ELSE '无活跃' /* 上周活跃本周流失用户 */ END AS user_type_curweek /* 本周活跃用户分层 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(logymd) AS active_days /* 玩家周活跃天数 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-18' AND '2026-05-24' /* 上周 */ AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid < 57000 /* 排除测服 */ AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) <> 21 /* 排除21大区MC */ AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t1 /* 上周活跃用户 */ FULL JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(logymd) AS active_days /* 玩家周活跃天数 */ FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31' /* 本周 */ AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid < 57000 /* 排除测服 */ AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) <> 21 /* 排除21大区MC */ AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS t2 /* 本周活跃用户 */ ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2026-04-19', '2022-05-08', '2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid < 57000 /* 排除测服 */ AND FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) <> 21 /* 排除21大区MC */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, LOWER(first_mt_country)) AS t3 ON t1.roleid = t3.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT lower, country FROM mt_dim.dim_national_geographic_atlas_config) AS t4 ON t3.first_mt_country = t4.lower GROUP BY monday_curweek /* 本周一 */, monday_lastweek /* 上周一 */, user_type_lastweek /* 上周活跃用户分层 */, user_type_curweek /* 本周活跃用户分层 */, CASE WHEN NOT country IS NULL THEN country ELSE '未知' END) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.yudongzhang_dau_trend_analysis_secondary_indicators_combine_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', indicator_name = 'week_active_type_change') SELECT first_mt_country, monday_curweek AS d1, CONCAT(user_type_lastweek, '_', user_type_curweek) AS d2, week_active_users / total_user_cnt AS change_rate, total_user_cnt, 0 AS sampling FROM (SELECT first_mt_country, monday_curweek, monday_lastweek, user_type_lastweek, user_type_curweek, week_active_users, SUM(week_active_users) OVER (PARTITION BY first_mt_country, monday_curweek, monday_lastweek, user_type_lastweek) AS total_user_cnt /* 分母：上周各活跃类型的周活用户数 */ FROM t_infos) AS a
