'2026-05-25')), t_login AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd, roleid AS account_id, zoneid AS zoneid, `time`, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY `time`) AS rn FROM aoz_ods.login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT zoneid BETWEEN 19000 AND 19999) AS t1 WHERE rn = 1), t_register AS (SELECT country, channel, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-30', account_id, NULL)) AS register_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-29', account_id, NULL)) AS register_cnt_3d, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-25', account_id, NULL)) AS register_cnt_7d FROM t_basic GROUP BY country, channel), t_create_base AS (SELECT point, country, channel, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-30', t_basic.account_id, NULL)) AS login_point_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-29', t_basic.account_id, NULL)) AS login_point_cnt_3d, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(createdate = '2026-05-25', t_basic.account_id, NULL)) AS login_point_cnt_7d FROM t_basic JOIN t_login ON t_basic.account_id = t_login.account_id GROUP BY point, country, channel), t_incr AS (SELECT point, channel, country, 'aoz' AS appname FROM (SELECT DISTINCT point, 1 AS join_key FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-04-23', '2025-04-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = ARRAY(create_role_point_cnt, create_role_point_cnt_3d, NULL, NULL, NULL, create_role_point_cnt_7d) AS register_cnt_arr, ARRAY(login_day_cnt, login_day_cnt_3d, NULL, NULL, NULL, login_day_cnt_7d) AS retention_cnt_arr FROM (SELECT point, country, channel, register_cnt AS create_role_point_cnt, SUM(login_point_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname, channel ORDER BY point) AS login_day_cnt, register_cnt_3d AS create_role_point_cnt_3d, SUM(login_point_cnt_3d) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname, channel ORDER BY point) AS login_day_cnt_3d, register_cnt_7d AS create_role_point_cnt_7d, SUM(login_point_cnt_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname, channel ORDER BY point) AS login_day_cnt_7d FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, t_incr.channel, COALESCE(t_create_base.login_point_cnt, 0) AS login_point_cnt, COALESCE(t_create_base.login_point_cnt_3d, 0) AS login_point_cnt_3d, COALESCE(t_create_base.login_point_cnt_7d, 0) AS login_point_cnt_7d, LEFT JOIN t_create_base ON t_incr.country = t_create_base.country AND t_incr.point = t_create_base.point AND t_incr.channel = t_create_base.channel LEFT JOIN t_register ON t_incr.country = CBE / CBA 加 ROW_NUMBER 去重 + WHERE 改 NOT IN (0,1,2,9999) */ /*      根因: 上游 ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata / connserver_battle_analysis */ /*            在 2026-03-10 之前有重复上报 (dup_ratio ~1.6, max_dup=151 在 */ /*            battleid=9999 单机关教学占位), 多源 LEFT JOIN 叠乘致 DWD 输出 */ /*            10x 膨胀 (实测 02-15 行数 3.13B vs 主键数 297M) */ /*   2. MME / PE 加 ROW_NUMBER 兜底 (实测重复极低, 防御性) */ /*   3. 启用 Celeborn RSS (远程 shuffle) 砍 spill 灾难 */ /*   4. shuffle.partitions 512 → 1024, advisoryPartitionSize 128MB, */ /*      skewJoin enabled, autoBroadcastJoinThreshold 200MB */ /*   5. 最终 SELECT 加 BROADCAST(t5,t6) hint, 砍 dim/skin_level shuffle */ /*   6. CBE 单机关补全 UNION 分支: fake_ai/isinvalidbattle/isvalid NULL → 字面值 */ /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */ /* v3.9.1 主要变更: */ /*   7. CBE 单机关补全 UNION 段加 ROW_NUMBER 去重 */ /*      根因: v3.9 出表后 dup_ratio=1.054, 100% 残留在 single_battle 类 */ /*            (实测 3-09 classic single=1: 16M rows / 1.6M pk → dup 9.889x) */ /*            v3.9 给 cbe_full (PVP 段) 加了 ROW_NUMBER, 但 UNION ALL 单机关分支没加 */ /*            业务方 CBE 重复上传同样污染单机关教学战斗 */ /*      影响范围: 仅 CBE 单机关 UNION 段 (~2GB shuffle), 其他 CTE 不动 */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* SET 全部由"超大数据量-rss"项目模板托管 (Celeborn / AQE / executor 资源) */ /* ============================================================================ */ WITH user_battle_base /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* t1: 主战斗源 = BE 全量 UNION ALL CBE 单机关补全 (含去重) */ /*     单机关口径: battletype=1 AND length(battleid) BETWEEN 10 AND 13 */ /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (/* BE 主体 (实测无 dup, 不去重) */ SELECT battleid, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, mapid, `time`, battletime, battlesvrid, battle_season_id, camp, wincamp, issurrender, rankstar, bigranklvl, minranklvl, conwin, history_maxrankstar, real_road, select_road, heroid, herolvl, banhero, runeid, runelevel, new_runeid, new_rune_skill1, new_rune_skill2, new_rune_skill3, skillid, uiskinid, killnum, deadnum, assistnum, herohurt, towerhurt, behourt AS behurt, getmoney, ismvp, score, gradetype, elo, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, createrole_country, clientversion AS client_version, fake_ai, isinvalidbattle, isvalid, blacknum, ishook, ishavehero, equip1, equip2, equip3, equip4, equip5, equip6 FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL /* CBE 单机关补全 (BE 无此类数据) */ /* v3.9.1: 加 ROW_NUMBER 去重 (单机关 dup ~10x, 业务方重复上传) */ SELECT battleid, roleid, zoneid, pvptype, realpvptype, mapid, `time`, battletime, battlesvrid, battle_season_id, camp, wincamp, issurrender, rankstar, bigranklvl, minranklvl, conwin, history_maxrankstar, real_road, select_road, heroid, herolvl, banhero, runeid, runelevel, new_runeid, new_rune_skill1, new_rune_skill2, new_rune_skill3, skillid, uiskinid, killnum, deadnum, assistnum, herohurt, towerhurt, behurt, getmoney, ismvp, score, gradetype, elo, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, createrole_country, client_version, fake_ai, isinvalidbattle, isvalid, blacknum, ishook, ishavehero, equip1, equip2, equip3, equip4, equip5, equip6 FROM (SELECT battleid, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battletype AS pvptype, realpvptype, mapid, `time`, battle_time AS battletime, NULL AS battlesvrid, NULL AS battle_season_id, icamp AS camp, IF(iswin = 1, icamp, IF(icamp = 1, 2, 1)) AS wincamp, NULL AS issurrender, rankstar, bigranklevel AS bigranklvl, minranklevel AS minranklvl, NULL AS conwin, NULL AS history_maxrankstar, CASE WHEN roadsort IN (1, 5) THEN 5 WHEN roadsort IN (101, 105) THEN 1 WHEN roadsort = 2 THEN 2 WHEN roadsort = 4 THEN 4 WHEN roadsort = 3 OR roadsort >= 3000 THEN 3 ELSE NULL END AS real_road, NULL AS select_road, heroid, NULL AS herolvl, NULL AS banhero, NULL AS runeid, NULL AS runelevel, NULL AS new_runeid, NULL AS new_rune_skill1, NULL AS new_rune_skill2, NULL AS new_rune_skill3, skillid, NULL AS uiskinid, killnum, dead AS deadnum, assist AS assistnum, NULL AS herohurt, NULL AS towerhurt, NULL AS behurt, gold AS getmoney, IF(medal_type IN (1, 5), 1, 0) AS ismvp, score, NULL AS gradetype, elo AS elo, NULL AS usercreatetime, FROM_UNIXTIME(usercreateymd, 'yyyyMMdd') AS usercreateymd, NULL AS createrole_country, NULL AS client_version, 0 AS fake_ai, 0 AS isinvalidbattle, 1 AS isvalid, NULL AS blacknum, NULL AS ishook, NULL AS ishavehero, NULL AS equip1, NULL AS equip2, NULL AS equip3, NULL AS equip4, NULL AS equip5, NULL AS equip6, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY battleid, accountid, zoneid ORDER BY battle_time DESC) AS _rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND battletype = 1 AND LENGTH(CAST(battleid AS STRING)) BETWEEN 10 AND 13) AS s WHERE s._rn = 1), cbe_full /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* t2: CBE 全量 (玩家粒度) - 提供主表扩展字段 + extra_info 多个子字段 */ /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT battleid, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, curehero, atktower, fightrate, deadnumbytower, level6min, level12min, `level`, hurtrate, towerhurtrate, behurtrate, `6mingold` AS gold_6min, `12mingold` AS gold_12min, noresnum, noresself, isdownloadover AS isdownload, ai_difficult, reconnectnum, relinknum, restartnum, hurtap, hurtad, hurtreal, movedistance, killminions, lingzhuskill, shenguiskill, heroshield, selfshield, cureself, suffercontrolrate, sufferslowrate, total_equip_value, atksignal, aggregatesignal, retreatsignal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY battleid, accountid, zoneid ORDER BY battle_time DESC) AS _rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT battleid IN (0, 1, 2, 9999)) AS dedup WHERE _rn = 1), gbe_extra /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* t3: GBE 多杀 + 英雄使用次数 + 皮肤标志 + 限时英雄 */ /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT battleid, roleid, zoneid, kill3, kill4, kill5, rankuseherotimes, classic5v5useherotimes, is_freetry, has_use_skin, is_permanent_skin FROM ml_ods.gameserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), mme_match /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* t4: MME 匹配 + realpower */ /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT battleid, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, matchtime, real_player_num, reputation, rank_road_match_road, rank_road_match_final_road, realpower, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY battleid, accountid, zoneid ORDER BY matchtime DESC) AS _rn FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE (logymd = '2026-05-31' OR (logymd = DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1) AND `time` >= CONCAT(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1), ' 22:00:00'))) AND battleid > 0) AS dedup WHERE _rn = 1), dim_skin /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* t5: 皮肤维表 dim_skin_config_df */ /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT skinid AS skin_id, quality AS skin_quality, skin_name, collect_quality FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), skin_level_business /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* t6: 皮肤业务等级 (leolv 临时表 _20260311_v2) */ /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT skinid AS skin_id, skinlevel AS skin_level FROM ml_temp.leolv_skin_level_20260311_v2), drz_user /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* t7: 用户标签 DRZ */ /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, new_type, first_mt_country, create_country, create_os, create_channel, first_network_name, last_network_name FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), pe_perf /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* t8: PE 客户端性能表 */ /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST(battleid AS BIGINT) AS battleid, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, avgfps, bigjankper10min, jankper10min, realpicturequality, nowpicturequality, temperature, freememory, systemmemorysize, pssmemory AS memory_pss_total, battleendtotalpss, freediskspace, gameusediskspace, devicemodel, operatingsystem AS os, client_version, game_channel AS channel, unityversion, ping_variance, medianping, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(battleid AS BIGINT), accountid, zoneid ORDER BY medianping DESC, avgfps DESC) AS _rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battleend_performance WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT battleid IN ('0', '1', '2', '9999') AND NOT battleid IS NULL) AS dedup WHERE _rn = 1), cba_series /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* t9: CBA 战斗时序 + 控制类指标 */ /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT battleid, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, goldn, NULL AS expn, deadtime, leveltime, controlrate, slowrate, yeguaigold, shibinggold, para31 AS orange_buff_cnt, para32 AS purple_buff_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY battleid, accountid, zoneid ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS _rn FROM ml_ods.connserver_battle_analysis WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT battleid IN (0, 1, 2, 9999)) AS dedup WHERE _rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_battle_details_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', pvp_category) SELECT t1.battleid, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.pvptype, t1.realpvptype, t1.mapid, t1.`time`, t1.battletime, t1.battlesvrid, t1.battle_season_id, t1.camp, t1.wincamp, t1.issurrender, CASE WHEN CAST(t1.battleid AS STRING) IN ('0', '1', '2', '9999') THEN 1 WHEN t1.pvptype = 1 AND LENGTH(CAST(t1.battleid AS STRING)) BETWEEN 10 AND 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_offline_single_battle, t1.rankstar, t1.bigranklvl, t1.minranklvl, t1.conwin, t1.history_maxrankstar, t1.real_road, t1.select_road, t1.heroid, t1.herolvl, t1.banhero, t3.rankuseherotimes, t6.skin_level, t5.collect_quality, t3.has_use_skin, t3.is_permanent_skin, t1.killnum, t1.deadnum, t1.assistnum, t1.ismvp, t1.herohurt, t1.towerhurt, t1.behurt, t2.hurtrate, t2.towerhurtrate, t2.behurtrate, t1.getmoney, t1.score, t1.gradetype, t2.fightrate, t2.curehero, t2.level6min, t2.level12min, t2.atktower, t2.deadnumbytower, t9.deadtime, t2.gold_6min, t2.gold_12min, t9.goldn, t9.expn, t3.kill3, t3.kill4, t3.kill5, t4.matchtime, t4.real_player_num, t4.reputation, t1.elo, t4.rank_road_match_road, t4.rank_road_match_final_road, t4.realpower, t1.usercreateymd, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', t1.ishavehero, TO_JSON(STRUCT(t2.noresnum, t2.noresself, t2.isdownload, t2.ai_difficult, t2.reconnectnum, t2.relinknum, t2.restartnum, t8.ping_variance, t8.medianping, t8.avgfps, t8.bigjankper10min, t8.jankper10min, t8.realpicturequality, t8.nowpicturequality, t8.temperature, t8.freememory, t8.systemmemorysize, t8.memory_pss_total, t8.battleendtotalpss, t8.freediskspace, t8.gameusediskspace, t8.devicemodel, t8.os, t8.client_version, t8.channel, t8.unityversion, t2.hurtap, t2.hurtad, t2.hurtreal, t2.movedistance, t2.killminions, t2.lingzhuskill, t2.shenguiskill, t2.heroshield, t2.selfshield, t2.cureself, t2.suffercontrolrate, t2.sufferslowrate, t2.total_equip_value, t2.atksignal, t2.aggregatesignal, t2.retreatsignal, ARRAY(t1.equip1, t1.equip2, t1.equip3, t1.equip4, t1.equip5, t1.equip6), t9.leveltime, t9.controlrate, t9.slowrate, t9.yeguaigold, t9.shibinggold, t9.orange_buff_cnt, t9.purple_buff_cnt)) AS extra_info, CASE WHEN t1.pvptype = 2 THEN 'ranked' WHEN t1.zoneid = t7.zoneid LEFT JOIN pe_perf AS t8 ON t1.battleid = t8.battleid AND t1.roleid = t8.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t8.zoneid LEFT JOIN cba_series AS t9 ON t1.battleid = t9.battleid AND t1.roleid = name: dwm_battle_summary_di
sql_units: /* ============================================================================ */ WITH dwd_player /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* dwd_player: DWD 玩家粒度 (camp IN (1,2) 排除异常) */ /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT battleid, camp, pvp_category, pvptype, realpvptype, mapid, battletime, wincamp, real_player_num, fake_ai, killnum, herohurt, towerhurt, behurt, getmoney FROM mt_dwd.dwd_battle_details_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND camp IN (1, 2)), battle_global /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* battle_global: battle 全局聚合 (每 battle 一行) */ /*   供 battle_camp 行重复读取 全局字段 */ /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT battleid, pvp_category, MAX(pvptype) AS pvptype, MAX(realpvptype) AS realpvptype, MAX(mapid) AS mapid, MAX(battletime) AS battletime, MAX(wincamp) AS winner_camp, COUNT(*) AS total_players, MAX(real_player_num) AS real_player_num, SUM(IF(fake_ai = 1, 1, 0)) AS ai_count, IF(COUNT(*) < 10, 1, 0) AS has_missing_player FROM dwd_player GROUP BY battleid, pvp_category), battle_camp /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* battle_camp: battle x camp 粒度聚合 (每局 2 行) */ /* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ AS (SELECT battleid, camp, pvp_category, SUM(IF(fake_ai = 0, 1, 0)) AS player_count, SUM(COALESCE(killnum, 0)) AS total_kills, SUM(COALESCE(herohurt, 0)) AS total_herohurt, SUM(COALESCE(towerhurt, 0)) AS total_towerhurt, SUM(COALESCE(behurt, 0)) AS total_behurt, SUM(COALESCE(getmoney, 0)) AS total_getmoney FROM dwd_player GROUP BY battleid, camp, pvp_category) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwm_battle_summary_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', pvp_category) /* [主键] */ SELECT bc.battleid, bc.camp, bg.pvptype /* [对局] 全局维度 (每行重复) */, bg.realpvptype, bg.mapid, bg.battletime, bg.winner_camp, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS game_type /* TODO 待接入 ml_temp.dwm_mlbb_battle_game_type_di_yz */, bg.total_players /* [人数] 全局维度 */, bg.real_player_num, bg.ai_count, bg.has_missing_player, bc.player_count /* [阵营聚合] */, bc.total_kills, bc.total_herohurt, bc.total_towerhurt, bc.total_behurt, bc.total_getmoney, bc.pvp_category FROM battle_camp AS bc JOIN battle_global AS bg ON bc.battleid = bg.battleid

NEW: Tier 2 JSON 提取（row-level transform） */, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(m.extra_info, '$.hurtad') AS BIGINT) AS hurtad_v, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(m.extra_info, '$.hurtreal') AS BIGINT) AS hurtreal_v, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(m.extra_info, '$.jankper10min') AS DOUBLE) AS jankper10min_v, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(m.extra_info, '$.avgfps') AS DOUBLE) AS avgfps_v, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(m.extra_info, name: rum_ads_performance_di
sql_units: WITH periods AS (SELECT period FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(ARRAY(1, 3, 5, 7, 15, 30)) AS period) AS t1), perf_base AS (SELECT t1.period, t2.team, t2.metric_name, t2.metric_value FROM periods AS t1 JOIN mt_dwd.dwd_rum_event_di AS t2 ON t2.event_subtype = 'web_perf' AND NOT t2.metric_value IS NULL AND t2.logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', (t1.period - 1) * -1) AND t2.logymd <= '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_rum_performance_di PARTITION(pdate = '2026-05-31') SELECT period, COALESCE(team, 'ALL') AS team, metric_name AS performance_type, PERCENTILE_APPROX(metric_value, 0.75) AS p75, PERCENTILE_APPROX(metric_value, 0.90) AS p90, AVG(metric_value) AS avg FROM perf_base GROUP BY period, metric_name, team, GROUPING SETS ((period, metric_name, team), (period, metric_name))

name: rum_ads_category_di
sql_units: WITH periods AS (SELECT period FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(ARRAY(1, 3, 5, 7, 15, 30)) AS period) AS t1), pv_base AS (SELECT t1.period, t2.team, t2.uuid, t2.page_view_id, t2.phone_brand, t2.browser_brand, t2.browser_version, t2.os_platform, t2.os_version FROM periods AS t1 JOIN mt_dwd.dwd_rum_event_di AS t2 ON t2.event_subtype = 'pageview' AND t2.logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', (t1.period - 1) * -1) AND t2.logymd <= '2026-05-31'), unpivot /* 把 5 种 category 维度展开为长格式 */ AS (SELECT period, team, uuid, page_view_id, m.cat_type, m.cat_value FROM pv_base LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(MAP('phone_brand', phone_brand, 'browser_brand', browser_brand, 'browser_version', browser_version, 'os_platform', os_platform, 'os_version', os_version)) m AS cat_type, cat_value WHERE NOT m.cat_value IS NULL AND m.cat_value <> '') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_rum_category_di PARTITION(pdate = '2026-05-31') SELECT period, COALESCE(team, 'ALL') AS team, cat_type AS category_type, cat_value AS category_value, COUNT(DISTINCT page_view_id) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS uv FROM unpivot GROUP BY period, cat_type, cat_value, team, GROUPING SETS ((period, cat_type, cat_value, team), (period, cat_type, cat_value))

sql_units: WITH t_basic AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT roleid, register_time, zoneid, logymd, register_date, register_channel AS channel, register_country AS country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY register_time) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_wefly5_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t1 WHERE rn = 1 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31'), t_ods AS (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logymd, t.roleid, `time`, COALESCE(t_basic.country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(t_basic.channel, 'unknown') AS channel, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.roleid ORDER BY `time` ASC) AS rn FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, TIME FROM w5_ods.login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid > 10000) AS t LEFT JOIN t_basic ON t.roleid = t_basic.roleid), t_incr AS (SELECT point, channel, country, 'wefly5' AS appname FROM (SELECT DISTINCT point, 1 AS join_key FROM mt_dim.dim_decismart_app_country_info_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-04-23', '2025-04-23', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mcgg_v2_synclog') AS t1 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT channel, country, 1 AS join_key FROM t_ods) AS t2 ON t1.join_key = t2.join_key), t_login_base AS (SELECT point, country, channel, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid) AS point_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(rn = 1, roleid, NULL)) AS day_cnt FROM t_ods GROUP BY point, country, channel) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_basic_login` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'wefly5', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country, channel, point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY country, appname, channel ORDER BY point) AS day_cnt FROM (SELECT t_incr.point, t_incr.country, t_incr.channel, COALESCE(t_login_base.point_cnt, 0) AS point_cnt, COALESCE(t_login_base.day_cnt, 0) AS day_cnt, t_incr.appname FROM t_incr LEFT JOIN t_login_base ON t_incr.country = t_login_base.country AND t_incr.channel = t_login_base.channel AND t_incr.point = t_login_base.point) AS t1

name: adbi.dm_steam_wishlist_country_df
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: willemwang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-01-31 18:16:23.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adbi.dm_steam_wishlist_country_df ( */ /*     app_id                   STRING          COMMENT '游戏ID', */ /*     data_date               STRING          COMMENT '数据日期', */ /*     country_code            STRING          COMMENT '国家代码', */ /*     country_name            STRING          COMMENT '国家名称', */ /*     region                  STRING          COMMENT '地区', */ /*     -- 当日指标 */ /*     net_adds                BIGINT          COMMENT '当日净添加数(wishlist_adds - wishlist_deletes)', */ /*     wishlist_adds           BIGINT          COMMENT '当日添加数', */ /*     wishlist_deletes        BIGINT          COMMENT '当日删除数', */ /*     -- 累计指标 */ /*     cumulative_net_adds     BIGINT          COMMENT '上线以来累计净添加数', */ /*     -- 其他行为指标 */ /*     wishlist_purchases      BIGINT          COMMENT '愿望单购买数', */ /*     wishlist_gifts          BIGINT          COMMENT '愿望单礼物数', */ /*     wishlist_adds_windows   BIGINT          COMMENT 'Windows平台添加数', */ /*     wishlist_adds_mac       BIGINT          COMMENT 'Mac平台添加数', */ /*     wishlist_adds_linux     BIGINT          COMMENT 'Linux平台添加数' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT 'Steam愿望单国家维度每日全量表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     p_date STRING COMMENT '分区日期' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/advertisement_bi/adbi/dm_steam_wishlist_country_df'; */ /* MSCK REPAIR TABLE adbi.ods_steam_wishlist_country_summary; */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dm_steam_wishlist_country_df PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT IF(appid = '3720420', '4530', 'unknown') AS app_id, date AS data_date, country_code, country_name, region, SUM(wishlist_adds) /* 净添加数（当日） */ - SUM(wishlist_deletes) AS net_adds, SUM(wishlist_adds) AS wishlist_adds /* 添加数（当日） */, SUM(wishlist_deletes) AS wishlist_deletes /* 删除数（当日） */, SUM(SUM(wishlist_adds) - SUM(wishlist_deletes)) OVER (PARTITION BY appid ORDER BY date) AS cumulative_net_adds /* 累计净添加数（截止当日，按国家各自累积） */, SUM(wishlist_purchases) AS wishlist_purchases, SUM(wishlist_gifts) AS wishlist_gifts, SUM(wishlist_adds_windows) AS wishlist_adds_windows, SUM(wishlist_adds_mac) AS wishlist_adds_mac, SUM(wishlist_adds_linux) AS wishlist_adds_linux FROM adbi.ods_steam_wishlist_country_summary WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY appid, date, country_code, country_name, region

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_lhyan@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-04-24 15:47:29.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH month_charge AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money * 1.00 / 100) AS month_charge_amt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* --receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据,因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND money <> 0 /* --gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), pre_month_charge AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(his_charge_amt) AS his_charge_amt FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) AS logym, SUM(money * 1.00 / 100) AS his_charge_amt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE logymd <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', DAY('2026-05-31') * -1) /* 截止上月末的历史R级 */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据,因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7)) AS a GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), ads_wmz_monthly_charge_tier AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN b.month_charge_amt > 0 AND b.month_charge_amt < 0.99 THEN '1、(0,0.99)' WHEN b.month_charge_amt >= 0.99 AND b.month_charge_amt < 1.98 THEN '2、[0.99,1.98)' WHEN b.month_charge_amt >= 1.98 AND b.month_charge_amt < 4.95 THEN '3、[1.98,4.95)' WHEN b.month_charge_amt >= 4.95 AND b.month_charge_amt < 9.90 THEN '4、[4.95,9.90)' WHEN b.month_charge_amt >= 9.90 AND b.month_charge_amt < 19.80 THEN '5、[9.90,19.80)' WHEN b.month_charge_amt >= 19.80 AND b.month_charge_amt < 49.50 THEN '6、[19.80,49.50)' WHEN b.month_charge_amt >= 49.50 THEN '7、[49.50,)' ELSE '0.未充值' END AS month_r_label, CASE WHEN c.his_charge_amt > 0 AND c.his_charge_amt < 0.99 THEN '1、(0,0.99)' WHEN c.his_charge_amt >= 0.99 AND c.his_charge_amt < 1.98 THEN '2、[0.99,1.98)' WHEN c.his_charge_amt >= 1.98 AND c.his_charge_amt < 4.95 THEN '3、[1.98,4.95)' WHEN c.his_charge_amt >= 4.95 AND c.his_charge_amt < 9.90 THEN '4、[4.95,9.90)' WHEN c.his_charge_amt >= 9.90 AND c.his_charge_amt < 19.80 THEN '5、[9.90,19.80)' WHEN c.his_charge_amt >= 19.80 AND c.his_charge_amt < 49.50 THEN '6、[19.80,49.50)' WHEN c.his_charge_amt >= 49.50 THEN '7、[49.50,)' ELSE '0.未充值' END AS pre_month_r_label, DATEDIFF(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) || '-01', register_date) AS register_days, register_date FROM (/* 当月活跃用户去重（排除 AI、测试服、异常账号，口径与 ads_wmz_per_month_charge_rate_ana_df 一致） */ SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di AS a WHERE SUBSTRING(a.logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND a.logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND a.zoneid <= 57000 AND a.is_ai = 0 GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN month_charge AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN pre_month_charge AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 用户基本属性数据 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS bc WHERE bc.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND bc.appid = 'mlbb') AS bc ON a.roleid = bc.roleid AND a.zoneid = bc.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 异常账号 */ SELECT DISTINCT accountid FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-08-15' AND '2026-05-31' AND (os_build LIKE '%AP1%' OR (os_build IS NULL AND (device_name IN ('OnePlus 11', 'Galaxy S21', 'Redmi Note 12') OR app_click_id IN (56, 185))))) AS abnormal_t ON a.roleid = abnormal_t.accountid WHERE abnormal_t.accountid IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.ads_wmz_monthly_charge_tier_mi PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AS logym, month_r_label /* 当月付费档位 */, pre_month_r_label /* 历史最高单月付费档位（截至上月末） */, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(register_date, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) THEN '0.本月新增' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1.1~30' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '2.31~90' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 91 AND 365 THEN '3.91~365' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 366 AND 365 * 3 THEN '4.1~3年' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 365 * 3 + 1 AND 365 * 5 THEN '5.3~5年' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 365 * 5 + 1 AND 365 * 99 THEN '6.5年+' ELSE 'else' END AS register_days_type, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid) AS user_cnt FROM ads_wmz_monthly_charge_tier GROUP BY month_r_label, pre_month_r_label, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(register_date, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) THEN '0.本月新增' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1.1~30' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '2.31~90' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 91 AND 365 THEN '3.91~365' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 366 AND 365 * 3 THEN '4.1~3年' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 365 * 3 + 1 AND 365 * 5 THEN '5.3~5年' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 365 * 5 + 1 AND 365 * 99 THEN '6.5年+' ELSE 'else' END ORDER BY month_r_label, pre_month_r_label, register_days_type

b.zoneid LEFT JOIN pre_month_charge AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 用户基本属性数据 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS bc WHERE bc.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND bc.appid = 'mlbb') AS bc ON a.roleid = bc.roleid AND a.zoneid = bc.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 异常账号 */ SELECT DISTINCT accountid FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-08-15' AND '2026-05-31' AND (os_build LIKE '%AP1%' OR (os_build IS NULL AND (device_name IN ('OnePlus 11', 'Galaxy S21', 'Redmi Note 12') '2026-05-31') SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logym, month_r_label /* 当月付费档位 */, pre_month_r_label /* 历史最高单月付费档位（截至上月末） */, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(register_date, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) THEN '0.本月新增' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1.1~30' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '2.31~90' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 91 AND 365 THEN '3.91~365' WHEN register_days BETWEEN 366 AND name: bangbang_item_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: jingwang2@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-02-12 14:57:12.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ml_temp.act_surprisecard_reward_stat_di ( */ /*     `time_point`            TIMESTAMP     COMMENT '统计时间点(每半小时)', */ /*     `server_type`           STRING        COMMENT '区服类型(正式服/测试服)', */ /*     `reward`                STRING        COMMENT '原始奖励字符串', */ /*     `quality_id`            BIGINT        COMMENT '品质ID', */ /*     `itemid`                BIGINT        COMMENT '物品ID', */ /*     `item_name`             STRING        COMMENT '物品名称', */ /*     `description`           STRING        COMMENT '物品描述', */ /*     `card_itemid`           BIGINT        COMMENT '卡片物品ID', */ /*     `max_get_time`          TIMESTAMP     COMMENT '该时段内最后一条记录的时间', */ /*     `cnt_current`           BIGINT        COMMENT '当前半小时内该物品产出次数', */ /*     `itemid_cnt_cumulative` BIGINT        COMMENT '累计-该物品产出次数', */ /*     `itemid_num_cumulative` BIGINT        COMMENT '累计-该物品产出数量', */ /*     `quality_cnt_cumulative` BIGINT       COMMENT '累计-该品质总产出次数', */ /*     `all_cumulative`        BIGINT        COMMENT '累计-该区服总产出次数' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT '惊喜卡活动奖励产出监控表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` STRING COMMENT '日期分区') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET; */ /* 惊喜翻牌-半小时级监控 (包含当前半小时产出 + 当天累计产出) */ WITH user_card AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, FLOOR(a.zoneid / 1000) AS zone, CASE WHEN a.zoneid < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END AS `区服`, createrole_country, logymd, usercreateymd, quality_id, reward, CAST(COALESCE(SPLIT(reward, ':')[0], 0) AS BIGINT) AS itemid, CAST(COALESCE(SPLIT(reward, ':')[1], 0) AS INT) AS item_num, card_itemid, time, FROM_UNIXTIME((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(REPLACE(time, 'T', ' '), 'Z', '')) DIV 1800) * 1800) AS time_point FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_surprisecard_reward AS a /* WHERE   logymd = '2026-06-01'  -- 每次调度都扫描天全量数据 */ WHERE logymd = SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 23:00:00') - 17 * 3600) AS STRING), 1, 10) AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(REPLACE(time, 'T', ' '), 'Z', '')) < (FLOOR((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) - 9 * 3600) / 1800) * 1800) /* 取完整更新时间 */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.act_surprisecard_reward_stat_di PARTITION(logymd) SELECT a.time_point, `区服` AS server_type, reward, quality_id /* split(reward,) */, a.itemid, it.item_name /* 建议从维度表拿名字 */, it.description, card_itemid, MAX(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(REPLACE(time, 'T', ' '), 'Z', '')))) AS max_get_time, COUNT(1) AS cnt_current /* 含义：这半小时内的产出量 */, SUM(COUNT(1)) OVER (PARTITION BY `区服`, a.itemid, card_itemid ORDER BY a.time_point) AS itemid_cnt_cumulative, SUM(SUM(item_num)) OVER (PARTITION BY `区服`, a.itemid, card_itemid ORDER BY a.time_point) AS itemid_num_cumulative, SUM(COUNT(1)) OVER (PARTITION BY `区服`, a.quality_id, card_itemid ORDER BY a.time_point) AS quality_cnt_cumulative, SUM(COUNT(1)) OVER (PARTITION BY `区服`, card_itemid ORDER BY a.time_point) AS all_cumulative, a.logymd FROM user_card AS a LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_item_config_df AS it ON it.item_id = a.itemid AND it.logymd = SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-06-01 23:00:00') - (17 + 24) * 3600) AS name: etl.mt_ads.ads_decismart_item_interactive_effects_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: weidai@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-04-27 16:05:22.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* ============================================================ */ /* 模块三：互动特效使用详情 */ /* ============================================================ */ /* ------------------------------------------------------------ */ /* DDL：mt_ads.ads_decismart_item_interactive_effects_di */ /* 互动特效使用天表 */ /* ODS 主表：ml_ods.gameserver_add_item（item_id 范围 66000-67999） */ /* 好友数据：ml_ods.gameserver_chuochuo_use（is_friend 字段） */ /* 分区：logymd / appname / granularity_type / date_type */ /* ------------------------------------------------------------ */ /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_ads.ads_decismart_item_interactive_effects_di ( */ /*     country                  STRING  COMMENT '国家区域', */ /*     item_id                  BIGINT  COMMENT '道具id', */ /*     scene_type               BIGINT  COMMENT '物品场景', */ /*     use_item_cnt             BIGINT  COMMENT '道具使用次数', */ /*     use_user_cnt             BIGINT  COMMENT '道具使用人数', */ /*     friends_use_item_cnt     BIGINT  COMMENT '好友使用次数', */ /*     nonfriends_use_item_cnt  BIGINT  COMMENT '非好友使用次数' */ /* ) */ /* COMMENT '互动特效使用天表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     logymd           STRING COMMENT '日期分区, yyyy-MM-dd', */ /*     appname          STRING COMMENT '项目ID (mlbb, xgame)', */ /*     granularity_type STRING COMMENT '粒度类型 (account, device)', */ /*     date_type        STRING COMMENT '日期类型 (daily, weekly, monthly)' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS parquet */ /* LOCATION 's3a://mt-ads/table/ads_decismart_item_interactive_effects_di' ; */ /* ------------------------------------------------------------ */ /* DML：mt_ads.ads_decismart_item_interactive_effects_di */ /* 主表：ml_ods.gameserver_add_item（发放道具日志，item_id 66000-67999 = 互动特效） */ /* 好友维度：LEFT JOIN ml_ods.gameserver_chuochuo_use（按 roleid+item_id+logymd 关联） */ /* country：来自 mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df */ /* 品质：来自 mt_dim.dim_item_config_df，NULL 时填 -99999 */ /* 排除测服：参考建模文档"统一排除测服" */ /* ------------------------------------------------------------ */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_decismart_item_interactive_effects_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') /* 汇总行：scene_type=-1，grouping_name='(all)' */ SELECT COALESCE(r.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, c.chuochuo_id AS item_id, -1 AS scene_type, COUNT(1) AS use_item_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT c.roleid) AS use_user_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_friend = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS friends_use_item_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_friend = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonfriends_use_item_cnt, '(all)' AS grouping_name FROM ml_ods.gameserver_chuochuo_use AS c LEFT JOIN ml_ods.gameserver_add_item AS a ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.item_id = c.chuochuo_id AND c.logymd = '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN (SELECT first_mt_country, roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_first_create = 1) AS r ON a.roleid = r.roleid AND a.zoneid = r.zoneid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.item_id BETWEEN 66000 AND 67999 AND a.zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY COALESCE(r.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), c.chuochuo_id UNION ALL /* 明细行：按 scene_type 拆分，grouping_name='(scene_type)' */ SELECT COALESCE(r.first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS country, c.chuochuo_id AS item_id, CASE WHEN c.scene_type IN (1, 2, 3) THEN c.scene_type ELSE -99999 END AS scene_type, COUNT(1) AS use_item_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT c.roleid) AS use_user_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_friend = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS friends_use_item_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_friend = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonfriends_use_item_cnt, '(scene_type)' AS grouping_name FROM ml_ods.gameserver_chuochuo_use AS c LEFT JOIN ml_ods.gameserver_add_item AS a ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.item_id = c.chuochuo_id AND c.logymd = '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN (SELECT first_mt_country, roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_first_create = 1) AS r ON a.roleid = r.roleid AND a.zoneid = r.zoneid WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.item_id BETWEEN 66000 AND 67999 AND a.zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY COALESCE(r.first_mt_country, 'unknown'), c.chuochuo_id, CASE WHEN c.scene_type IN (1, 2, 3) THEN c.scene_type ELSE -99999 END

sql_units: WITH source AS (SELECT report_date, report_hour, manager_id, account_id, media_source, campaign_id, campaign_name, ad_set_id, ad_set_name, ad_id, ad_name, app_id, app_name, os_name, country, impression_total, impression_increased, click_total, click_increased, cost_total, cost_increased, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(report_date, ' ', LPAD(CAST(report_hour AS STRING), 2, '0'), ':00:00'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) + 8 * 3600) AS ts_utc0, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(report_date, ' ', LPAD(CAST(report_hour AS STRING), 2, '0'), ':00:00'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) + 16 * 3600) AS ts_utc8, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(report_date, ' ', LPAD(CAST(report_hour AS STRING), 2, '0'), ':00:00'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) + 17 * 3600) AS ts_utc9 FROM adbi.moonton_ads_report_dis WHERE report_date <= '2026-05-31' AND report_date >= '2025-08-26') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwa_admkt_ad_cost_report_df_utc8 PARTITION(p_date = '2026-05-31') SELECT report_date, ad_account_id, media_source, campaign_id, campaign_name, adset_id, adset_name, ad_id, ad_name, app_id, app_name, os_name, country, SUM(impression_increased) AS impression, SUM(click_increased) AS click, SUM(cost_increased) AS cost FROM (SELECT manager_id, account_id AS ad_account_id, campaign_id, campaign_name, ad_set_id AS adset_id, ad_set_name AS adset_name, ad_id, ad_name, app_id, app_name, os_name, LOWER(country) AS country, impression_total, impression_increased, click_total, click_increased, cost_total, cost_increased, DATE_FORMAT(ts_utc8, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS report_date, CAST(HOUR(ts_utc8) AS STRING) AS report_hour, media_source FROM source) WHERE report_date <= '2026-05-31' AND report_date >= '2025-08-27' GROUP BY report_date, ad_account_id, media_source, campaign_id, campaign_name, adset_id, adset_name, ad_id, ad_name, app_id, app_name, os_name, country

sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_decismart_item_cofing_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT item_id, item_name, item_quality, item_type, item_type_name /* ,funnel_type */, CASE WHEN item_type IN (4, 6, 11, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18) THEN 1 WHEN item_type IN (1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 12) THEN 2 WHEN item_type IN (9, 19) THEN 3 WHEN item_type = 10 THEN 4 ELSE -99999 END AS funnel_type, distribution_type, distribution_channel, is_release_item, is_personalization_item, item_id_type /* ,is_effect_id */ FROM (SELECT item_id, item_name, item_quality, CASE WHEN item_id BETWEEN 19000 AND 19999 THEN 1 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 2100001 AND 2100100 THEN 2 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 62000 AND 63999 THEN 3 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 64000 AND 64999 THEN 4 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 566 AND 590 THEN 5 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 66000 AND 67999 THEN 6 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 27001 AND 27499 THEN 7 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 27500 AND 27999 THEN 8 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 23101 AND 23299 THEN 9 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 1000 AND 3999 OR item_id BETWEEN 100110 AND 399930 THEN 10 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 40200 AND 44999 THEN 11 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 519900 AND 519999 THEN 12 /* 载具 */ WHEN (item_id BETWEEN 510000 AND 519999 OR item_id BETWEEN 519999 AND 520339) THEN 13 /* 战场特效 */ WHEN item_id BETWEEN 50011 AND 59999 OR item_id BETWEEN 70001 AND 79999 THEN 14 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 506000 AND 507999 THEN 15 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 32001 AND 32999 THEN 16 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 500001 AND 500999 THEN 17 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 68000 AND 68999 THEN 18 WHEN item_id BETWEEN 600000 AND 699999999 THEN 19 ELSE -99999 END AS item_type, CASE WHEN item_id BETWEEN 19000 AND 19999 THEN '头像框' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 2100001 AND 2100100 THEN '聊天气泡' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 62000 AND 63999 THEN '组队战旗' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 64000 AND 64999 THEN '载入特效' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 566 AND 590 THEN '昵称底板' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 66000 AND 67999 THEN '互动特效' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 27001 AND 27499 THEN '主页背景' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 27500 AND 27999 THEN '个人名片' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 23101 AND 23299 THEN '礼物' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 1000 AND 3999 OR item_id BETWEEN 100110 AND 399930 THEN '灵动幻彩' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 40200 AND 44999 THEN '战场表情' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 519900 AND 519999 THEN '载具' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 510000 AND 520339 THEN '战场特效' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 50011 AND 59999 OR item_id BETWEEN 70001 AND 79999 THEN '圣像&高级圣像' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 506000 AND 507999 THEN '战场涂鸦（3天）' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 32001 AND 32999 THEN '个性动作' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 500001 AND 500999 THEN '语音包' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 68000 AND 68999 THEN '星彩按键' WHEN item_id BETWEEN 600000 AND 699999999 THEN '染色皮肤' ELSE '其他' END AS item_type_name /* ,CASE */ /*     -- 1：解锁-装备-使用全链路 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 64000 AND 64999 THEN 1      -- 载入特效 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 66000 AND 67999 THEN 1      -- 互动特效 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 40200 AND 44999 THEN 1      -- 战场表情 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 50011 AND 59999 */ /*       OR item_id BETWEEN 70001 AND 79999 THEN 1      -- 圣像&高级圣象 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 506000 AND 507999 THEN 1    -- 战场涂鸦（3天） */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 32001 AND 32999 THEN 1      -- 个性动作 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 500001 AND 500999 THEN 1    -- 语音包 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 68000 AND 68999 THEN 1      -- 星彩按钮 */ /*     -- 2：仅有解锁-装备链路 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 19000 AND 19999 THEN 2      -- 头像框 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 2100001 AND 2100100 THEN 2   -- 聊天气泡 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 62000 AND 63999 THEN 2      -- 组队战旗 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 566 AND 590 THEN 2          -- 昵称底板 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 27001 AND 27499 THEN 2      -- 主页背景 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 27500 AND 27999 THEN 2      -- 个人名片 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 519900 AND 519999 THEN 2    -- 载具，优先于战场特效重叠段 */ /*     -- 1：战场特效，放在载具后面，避免 519900-519999 被算成战场特效 */ /*     WHEN (item_id BETWEEN 510000 AND 519999 OR item_id BETWEEN 519999 AND 520339) THEN 1    -- 战场特效 */ /*     -- 3：仅有解锁-使用链路 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 23101 AND 23299 THEN 3      -- 礼物 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 600000 AND 699999999 THEN 3 -- 染色皮肤 */ /*     -- 4：仅可解锁 */ /*     -- WHEN item_id BETWEEN 508810 AND 509999 THEN 4    -- 灵动幻彩 */ /*     WHEN item_id BETWEEN 1000 AND 3999  or  item_id BETWEEN 100110 AND 399930 THEN 4  -- 灵动幻彩 */ /*     ELSE -99999 */ /* END AS funnel_type */, distribution_type, distribution_channel, is_release_item, CASE WHEN item_id BETWEEN 19000 AND 19999 OR item_id BETWEEN 2100001 AND 2100100 OR item_id BETWEEN 62000 AND 63999 OR item_id BETWEEN 64000 AND 64999 OR item_id BETWEEN 566 AND 590 OR item_id BETWEEN 66000 AND 67999 OR item_id BETWEEN 27001 AND 27499 OR item_id BETWEEN 27500 AND 27999 OR item_id BETWEEN 23101 AND 23299 OR item_id /* item_id BETWEEN 508810 AND 509999  OR */ BETWEEN 1000 AND 3999 OR item_id BETWEEN 100110 AND 399930 OR item_id BETWEEN 40200 AND 44999 OR item_id /* 排除战场特效和载具 */ /* item_id BETWEEN 519900 AND 519999  OR */ /* item_id BETWEEN 510000 AND 520339  OR */ BETWEEN 50011 AND 59999 OR item_id BETWEEN 70001 AND 79999 OR item_id BETWEEN 506000 AND 507999 OR item_id BETWEEN 32001 AND 32999 OR item_id BETWEEN 500001 AND 500999 OR item_id BETWEEN 68000 AND 68999 OR item_id BETWEEN 600000 AND 699999999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_personalization_item, 'item_id' AS item_id_type /* ,0 as is_effect_id */ FROM (SELECT item_id, item_name, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(distribution_type)) AS distribution_type, item_quality, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(distribution_channel)) AS distribution_channel, is_release_item FROM (SELECT COALESCE(t1.item_id, t2.item_id) AS item_id /* 道具id */, IF(TRIM(COALESCE(t1.item_name, t2.item_name, '其他')) = '', '其他', COALESCE(t1.item_name, t2.item_name, '其他')) AS item_name /* 道具名称 */, COALESCE(t1.distribution_type, '其他') AS distribution_type /* 投放形式 */, COALESCE(t2.item_quality, -99999) AS item_quality /* 道具品质 */, IF(TRIM(COALESCE(t1.distribution_channel, t2.item_description, '其他')) = '', '其他', COALESCE(t1.distribution_channel, t2.item_description, '其他')) AS distribution_channel /* 投放渠道 */ /* ,coalesce(t1.item_type, t2.item_type) as item_type    --道具类型 */, IF(NOT t1.item_id IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_release_item /* 是否上新资源 */ FROM (SELECT item_id /* 道具id */, item_name /* 道具名称            */, distribution_type /* 投放形式 */, distribution_channel /* 投放渠道 */ /* ,item_type_name       --道具类型名称 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_release_item_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2026-04-20', '2026-04-20', '2026-05-31')) AS t1 FULL JOIN (SELECT item_id, item_name, quality AS item_quality, item_type, description AS item_description FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2026-04-20', '2026-04-20', '2026-05-31')) AS t2 ON t1.item_id = t2.item_id) AS t3 GROUP BY item_id, item_name, item_quality, is_release_item) AS t4 UNION ALL /* 战场特效+载具 */ SELECT id AS item_id /* 等同于effect_id */, mname AS item_name, quality AS item_quality, 13 AS item_type, '战场特效' AS item_type_name /* ,1         as funnel_type */, IF(TRIM(mdescr1) = '', '其他', mdescr1) AS distribution_type, IF(TRIM(mdescr2) = '', '其他', mdescr2) AS distribution_channel, 0 AS is_release_item, 1 AS is_personalization_item, 'effect_id' AS item_id_type /* ,1 as is_effect_id */ FROM mt_dim.dim_battle_effect_config_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2026-04-20', '2026-04-20', '2026-05-31')) AS t4 WHERE (is_release_item = 1 OR is_personalization_item = 1)

name: rule_3001
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: ziggszhu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-11 19:29:52.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT INTO mtsec_biz.ads_risk_portrait_detail PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT DISTINCT 'wefly' AS app, 3001 AS tag_id, CAST(roleid AS BIGINT) AS roleid, CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) AS zoneid, login_ip AS ip, usercreateymd AS usercreateymd, CAST(role_level AS BIGINT) AS LEVEL, m__model AS device, CAST(login_os_type AS BIGINT) AS os_type, m__idfa AS idfa, m__did AS device_id, m__android_id AS android_id, CONCAT('【战斗伤害异常】', '客户端伤害:', REGEXP_EXTRACT(server_fail_reason, '客户端伤害:(\\d+)超过'), ' | 服务端范围:', REGEXP_EXTRACT(server_fail_reason, '误差范围:(\\d+)-(\\d+)'), '~', REGEXP_EXTRACT(server_fail_reason, '误差范围:(\\d+)-(\\d+)', 2), ' | 超出倍数:', CAST(ROUND(CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(server_fail_reason, '客户端伤害:(\\d+)超过') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(server_fail_reason, '误差范围:(\\d+)-(\\d+)', 2) AS DOUBLE), 0), 2) AS STRING), 'x') AS COMMENT, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS update_time FROM wefly_ob_ods.battle_verify_cheat WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND server_fail_reason LIKE '%客户端伤害%' AND NOT REGEXP_EXTRACT(server_fail_reason, '误差范围:(\\d+)-(\\d+)', 2) IN ('0', '') AND ROUND(CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(server_fail_reason, '客户端伤害:(\\d+)超过') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(server_fail_reason, '误差范围:(\\d+)-(\\d+)', 2) AS DOUBLE), 0), 2) >= 5

name: ml_temp.test_group_collection3_caowl
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_caowl@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-04-30 17:02:16.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH info_level AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(INT(CEIL(info_level / 5))) AS big_l FROM ml_ods.gameserver_collection_info WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-30' AND '2026-05-30' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.test_group_collection3_caowl PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT big_l, a.logymd AS zhuce_day, b.logymd AS ret_day, DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) AS n_ret, label, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS dau, SUM(login_dur) AS login_dur, SUM(charge_dollars) AS charge_dollars, SUM(sub_num_diamond) AS sub_num_diamond FROM (/* 灰度信息 */ SELECT DISTINCT logymd, roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN param_version = '3233' THEN 'control' WHEN param_version = '3234' THEN 'test_1' WHEN param_version = '3235' THEN 'test_2' ELSE '未知' END AS label FROM ml_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE param_name = '60.2_Collection3' AND param_version IN ('3233', '3234', '3235') AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-30' AND '2026-05-30' /* 进组日期2026.04.07 */) AS a LEFT JOIN info_level ON a.roleid = info_level.roleid AND a.zoneid = info_level.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, SUM(online_time) AS login_dur FROM ml_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, SUM(money) / 100 AS charge_dollars FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 /* 排除代币购买数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND /*        AND is_sandbox = 0 -- 排除沙盒测试数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) AND /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷苹果假冒卡 (有收入) 数据, 因为点卡的 receipt_id = 0 */ NOT money IN (0) /* GP 礼品卡, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* GP 礼品卡, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS p ON b.logymd = p.logymd AND b.roleid = p.roleid AND b.zoneid = p.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 钻石消耗 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num_diamond FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 记得改最新日期 */ AND NOT operate IN ('gm') AND zoneid < 57000 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_diamond AS b WHERE b.logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND b.operate IN ('receive_mail_attach') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) /* 把福利名单去了 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS q ON b.logymd = q.logymd AND b.roleid = q.roleid AND b.zoneid = q.zoneid WHERE DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) >= 0 GROUP BY big_l, a.logymd, b.logymd, DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd), label

name: etl.ads_decismart_primary_cube_di_mlbb_account_daily
sql_units: WITH charge_df AS (SELECT roleid, CASE WHEN pay_amt / 100 >= 2000 THEN 6 /* '2000以上' */ WHEN pay_amt / 100 >= 200 THEN 5 /* '[200,2000)' */ WHEN pay_amt / 100 >= 20 THEN 4 /* '[20,200)' */ WHEN pay_amt / 100 >= 2 THEN 3 /* '[2,20)' */ WHEN pay_amt / 100 > 0 THEN 2 /* '(0,2)' */ ELSE 1 END AS pay_grade, pay_amt /* 历史付费金额 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, SUM(product_money) AS pay_amt /* SUM(product_money) AS pay_amt, */ FROM (SELECT roleid, product_money FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 /* 正式服 */ AND product_money > 0 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, product_money FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd > '2025-01-03' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND product_money > 0 AND zoneid >= 57000 /* 01-03号后加入测服 */) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid)), basic AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country AS country, is_ai FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-01-01', '2023-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND is_first_create = 1 AND is_ai = 0), active_info AS (SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03', 57000, 999999)), dim_info AS (SELECT basic.roleid AS roleid, basic.country AS country, COALESCE(charge_df.pay_grade, 1) AS pay_grade, IF(NOT active_info.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_active FROM basic LEFT JOIN charge_df ON basic.roleid = charge_df.roleid LEFT JOIN active_info ON basic.roleid = active_info.roleid), dim_info_active AS (SELECT country AS country, pay_grade AS pay_grade, SUM(is_active) AS active_cnt FROM dim_info GROUP BY country, pay_grade, GROUPING SETS ((country, pay_grade), (country), (pay_grade)) /* ----总况 */ UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS country, NULL AS pay_grade, SUM(is_active) FROM dim_info) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_decismart_primary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT pay_grade IS NULL, 'pay_grade', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, 'all' AS definition_type, 'all' AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, 'all' AS network, COALESCE(pay_grade, 'all') AS pay_grade, COALESCE(active_cnt, 0) AS active_cnt FROM dim_info_active

name: adbi_dwm_active_device_tz_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: carldong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-19 14:34:51.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adbi.dwm_active_device_tz_di ( */ /*             did STRING COMMENT '设备指纹,key', */ /*             login_cnt array<int> COMMENT '登录次数', */ /*             online_time array<int> COMMENT '在线时长', */ /*             day_first_login_time array<STRING> COMMENT '当天首次活跃时间, 格式： yyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', */ /*             stage_id STRING COMMENT 'stage_id' */ /*         ) COMMENT '设备活跃增量表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     logymd string comment '日期分区yyyy-MM-dd', */ /*     app_id string comment '应用唯一id' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/advertisement_bi/adbi/dwm_active_device_tz_di' */ WITH evt_log AS (SELECT did, app_id, stage_id, ARRAY(TO_DATE(MIN(event_time)), TO_DATE(MIN(event_time + INTERVAL '8' HOUR)), TO_DATE(MIN(event_time + INTERVAL '16' HOUR)), TO_DATE(MIN(event_time + INTERVAL '17' HOUR))) AS first_event_time, ARRAY(MAX(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '0' HOUR) <> '2026-05-31', NULL, TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '0' HOUR))), MAX(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '8' HOUR) <> '2026-05-31', NULL, TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '8' HOUR))), MAX(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '16' HOUR) <> '2026-05-31', NULL, TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '16' HOUR))), MAX(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '17' HOUR) <> '2026-05-31', NULL, TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '17' HOUR)))) AS p_date_event_date, ARRAY(MIN(HOUR(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '0' HOUR) <> '2026-05-31', NULL, event_time + INTERVAL '0' HOUR))), MIN(HOUR(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '8' HOUR) <> '2026-05-31', NULL, event_time + INTERVAL '8' HOUR))), MIN(HOUR(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '16' HOUR) <> '2026-05-31', NULL, event_time + INTERVAL '16' HOUR))), MIN(HOUR(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '17' HOUR) <> '2026-05-31', NULL, event_time + INTERVAL '17' HOUR)))) AS p_date_event_hour, ARRAY(TO_DATE(MAX(event_time)), MAX(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '8' HOUR) > '2026-05-31', NULL, TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '8' HOUR))), MAX(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '16' HOUR) > '2026-05-31', NULL, TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '16' HOUR))), MAX(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '17' HOUR) > '2026-05-31', NULL, TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '17' HOUR)))) AS last_event_time FROM (SELECT COALESCE(LOWER(m__package_name), 'unknown') AS package_name, m__did AS did, COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(m__os)), 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(m__is_emulator, -1) AS is_emulator, COALESCE(m__os_version, 'unknown') AS os_version, COALESCE(m__system_language, 'unknown') AS os_language, COALESCE(m__role_id, 'unknown') AS account_id, COALESCE(m__role_id, 'unknown') AS role_id, COALESCE(m__zone_id, 'unknown') AS zone_id, SUBSTRING(time, 0, 19) AS event_time, COALESCE(m__client_ip, 'unknown') AS client_ip, COALESCE(m__model, 'unknown') AS model, COALESCE(LOWER(m__network_type), 'unknown') AS network_type, COALESCE(m__system_language, 'unknown') AS system_language, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, 1)) AS ip_country, COALESCE(m__client_version, 'unknown') AS client_version, COALESCE(m__sdk_version, 'unknown') AS sdk_version, -99999 AS level, '01' AS stage_id, m__app_id AS app_id FROM wefly_ob_ods.login WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND zoneid > 9999 AND logymd >= '2025-08-26' UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(LOWER(m__package_name), 'unknown') AS package_name, m__did AS did, COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(m__os)), 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(m__is_emulator, -1) AS is_emulator, COALESCE(m__os_version, 'unknown') AS os_version, COALESCE(m__system_language, 'unknown') AS os_language, COALESCE(m__role_id, 'unknown') AS account_id, COALESCE(m__role_id, 'unknown') AS role_id, COALESCE(m__zone_id, 'unknown') AS zone_id, SUBSTRING(time, 0, 19) AS event_time, COALESCE(m__client_ip, 'unknown') AS client_ip, COALESCE(m__model, 'unknown') AS model, COALESCE(LOWER(m__network_type), 'unknown') AS network_type, COALESCE(m__system_language, 'unknown') AS system_language, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, 1)) AS ip_country, COALESCE(m__client_version, 'unknown') AS client_version, COALESCE(m__sdk_version, 'unknown') AS sdk_version, -99999 AS level, '01' AS stage_id, m__app_id AS app_id FROM wefly_ob_ods.logout WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND zoneid > 9999 AND logymd >= '2025-08-26' UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(LOWER(m__package_name), 'unknown') AS package_name, m__did AS did, COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(m__os)), 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(m__is_emulator, -1) AS is_emulator, COALESCE(m__os_version, 'unknown') AS os_version, COALESCE(m__system_language, 'unknown') AS os_language, COALESCE(m__role_id, 'unknown') AS account_id, COALESCE(m__role_id, 'unknown') AS role_id, COALESCE(m__zone_id, 'unknown') AS zone_id, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(COALESCE((m__server_time), 0) / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS event_time, COALESCE(m__client_ip, 'unknown') AS client_ip, COALESCE(m__model, 'unknown') AS model, COALESCE(LOWER(m__network_type), 'unknown') AS network_type, COALESCE(m__system_language, 'unknown') AS system_language, LOWER(GEOIP(m__client_ip, 1)) AS ip_country, COALESCE(m__client_version, 'unknown') AS client_version, COALESCE(m__sdk_version, 'unknown') AS sdk_version, -99999 AS level, '01' AS stage_id, m__app_id AS app_id FROM wefly_ob_ods.__launch_event__ STRING COMMENT '归因IOS设备的IDFV,af_install近30天归因', */ /*   `mmp_id` STRING COMMENT '归因MMP的设备唯一ID,af_install近30天归因', */ /*   `createdate` STRING COMMENT '设备新增日期', */ /*   `stage_id` STRING COMMENT 'stage_id' */ /* ) */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING, app_id STRING) */ /* stored as parquet */ /* location 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/advertisement_bi/adbi/dim_attribution_device_di' */ WITH new_device_install AS (/* 1、这个需要按照logymd、app_id、package_name、did对设备唯一标志进行归因处理吗 */ /* 这个上游加工的时候会保证logymd、app_id、package_name、did的唯一，为了防止上游质量问题，容错，这边也可以加上唯一过滤 */ SELECT logymd, app_id, package_name,
