gps_adid = 'unknown' AND COALESCE(did, 'unknown') = 'unknown') /* fuxinwang：去除潜在的脏数据 */) WHERE rn = 1), af_install AS (/* 老数据，2024-10-31之后已经不再更新 */ /* select  package_name, */ /*         msdk_app_id AS app_id, */ /*         event_time AS create_time, */ /*         server_time, */ /*         platform AS os, */ /*         country_code AS country_code, */ /*         media_source AS media_source, */ /*         af_c_id AS campaign_id, */ /*         af_adset_id AS adgroup_id, */ /*         af_ad_id AS creative_id, */ /*         campaign AS campaign_name, */ /*         af_adset AS adgroup_name, */ /*         af_ad AS creative_name, */ /*         advertising_id AS gps_adid, */ /*         android_id AS android_id, */ /*         country_code AS ad_country, */ /*         oaid AS oaid, */ /*         idfa AS idfa, */ /*         idfv AS idfv, */ /*         appsflyer_id AS mmp_id, */ /*         null as msdk_did, */ /*         0 as click_time, */ /*         '01' as stage_id, */ /*         logymd */ /* from msdk_dwd.dwd_msdk_appsflyer_di */ /* WHERE   logymd = '2026-06-01' */ /* AND     event_name = 'install' */ /* union all */ /* 新数据，2022-08-15开始 */ SELECT package_name, msdk_app_id AS app_id, event_time AS create_time, server_time, os_name AS os, country_code, IF(media_source = 'Unattributed', IF(COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', 'Facebook Installs', 'Unattributed'), media_source) AS media_source, CASE WHEN media_source_type = 1 THEN fb_campaign_id WHEN media_source_type = 2 THEN campaign_id ELSE campaign_id END AS campaign_id, CASE WHEN media_source_type = 1 THEN fb_adgroup_id WHEN media_source_type = 2 THEN NULL ELSE adgroup_id END AS adgroup_id, creative_id, CASE WHEN media_source_type = 1 THEN fb_campaign_name WHEN media_source_type = 2 THEN campaign_name ELSE campaign_name END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN media_source_type = 1 THEN fb_adgroup_name WHEN media_source_type = 2 THEN NULL ELSE adgroup_name END AS adgroup_name, creative_name, gps_adid, android_id, country_code AS ad_country, oaid AS oaid, idfa AS idfa, idfv AS idfv, adjust_id AS mmp_id, msdk_did, COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.click_time'), 0) AS click_time, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, logymd FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '' THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%applovin%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS media_source_type FROM adbi.dwd_msdk_adjust_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') IN ('install')) AS t0), af_install_idfa /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'ios' -- 已知BUG: 正确逻辑是先用os过滤，再用idfa匹配 */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, stage_id, idfa ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS idfa_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(idfa, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_idfv /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'ios' */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, stage_id, idfv ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS idfv_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(idfv, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_gps_adid /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'android' */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, stage_id, gps_adid ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS gps_adid_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(gps_adid, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_android_id /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'android' */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, stage_id, android_id ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS android_id_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(android_id, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_msdk_did AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, stage_id, msdk_did ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS msdk_did_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(msdk_did, 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AND LOWER(os) = 'windows' /* windows */), his_attr_did AS (SELECT did, APP_ID, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY did, APP_ID, COALESCE(stage_id, '01')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dim_attribution_device_di PARTITION(logymd, app_id) /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di PARTITION (logymd, app_id) -- 测试表 */ SELECT t1.did, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN 'ios_1' WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN 'ios_2' WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN 'android_1' WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN 'android_2' WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN 'pc_1' END AS attr_source, COALESCE(t2.create_time, t3.create_time, t4.create_time, t5.create_time, t7.create_time) AS event_time /* 是触发事件的时间 20220606 */, COALESCE(t2.server_time, t3.server_time, t4.server_time, t5.server_time, t7.server_time) AS attr_time /* server time是归因时间 20220606 */, t1.package_name, COALESCE(t2.os, t3.os, t4.os, t5.os, t7.os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(t2.ad_country, t3.ad_country, t4.ad_country, t5.ad_country, t7.ad_country, 'unknown') AS ad_country, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN t2.media_source WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN t3.media_source WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN t4.media_source WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN t5.media_source WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN t7.media_source ELSE 'unknown' END AS media_source /* COALESCE(t2.media_source, t3.media_source, t4.media_source, t5.media_source, 'unknown') AS media_source, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.campaign_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.campaign_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.campaign_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.campaign_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.campaign_id, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS campaign_id /* COALESCE(t2.campaign_id, t3.campaign_id, t4.campaign_id, t5.campaign_id, 'unknown') AS campaign_id, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.adgroup_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.adgroup_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.adgroup_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.adgroup_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.adgroup_id, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS adgroup_id /* COALESCE(t2.adgroup_id, t3.adgroup_id, t4.adgroup_id, t5.adgroup_id, 'unknown') AS adgroup_id, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.creative_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.creative_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.creative_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.creative_id, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.creative_id, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS creative_id /* COALESCE(t2.creative_id, t3.creative_id, t4.creative_id, t5.creative_id, 'unknown') AS creative_id, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.campaign_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.campaign_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.campaign_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.campaign_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.campaign_name, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS campaign_name /* COALESCE( */ /*     t2.campaign_name, */ /*     t3.campaign_name, */ /*     t4.campaign_name, */ /*     t5.campaign_name, */ /*     'unknown' */ /* ) AS campaign_name, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.adgroup_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.adgroup_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.adgroup_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.adgroup_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.adgroup_name, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS adgroup_name /* COALESCE(t2.adgroup_name, t3.adgroup_name, t4.adgroup_name, t5.adgroup_name, 'unknown') AS adgroup_name, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.creative_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t3.creative_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t4.creative_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t5.creative_name, 'unknown') WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t7.creative_name, 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS creative_name /* COALESCE( */ /*     t2.creative_name, */ /*     t3.creative_name, */ /*     t4.creative_name, */ /*     t5.creative_name, */ /*     'unknown' */ /* ) AS creative_name, */, COALESCE(t2.gps_adid, t3.gps_adid, t4.gps_adid, t5.gps_adid, t7.gps_adid, 'unknown') AS gps_adid, COALESCE(t2.android_id, t3.android_id, t4.android_id, t5.android_id, t7.android_id, 'unknown') AS android_id, COALESCE(t2.oaid, t3.oaid, t4.oaid, t5.oaid, t7.oaid, 'unknown') AS oaid, COALESCE(t2.idfa, t3.idfa, t4.idfa, t5.idfa, t7.idfa, 'unknown') AS idfa, COALESCE(t2.idfv, t3.idfv, t4.idfv, t5.idfv, t7.idfv, 'unknown') AS idfv, COALESCE(t2.mmp_id, t3.mmp_id, t4.mmp_id, t5.mmp_id, t7.mmp_id, 'unknown') AS mmp_id, t1.logymd AS createdate /* fuxinwang：和basic df表字段对齐命名，设备创建时间统一命名createdate */, COALESCE(t1.stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, '2026-05-31' AS logymd /* COALESCE(t2.logymd, t3.logymd, t4.logymd, t5.logymd, 'unknown') AS logymd, */ /* 20220606 */, t1.app_id FROM new_device_install AS t1 /* 5、这个表应该是以归因时间分区，如果X设备一直没有归因到，应该不会放在当日分区 */ /* new_device_install 是用户基础信息增量表格，每日新增的设备会放在里面 */ LEFT JOIN af_install_idfa AS t2 ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.idfa = t2.idfa AND t1.stage_id = t2.stage_id AND t2.idfa_rn = 1 AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'ios' /* ios */ AND LOWER(t2.os) = 'ios' /* ios */ LEFT JOIN af_install_idfv AS t3 ON t1.app_id = t3.app_id AND t1.idfv = t3.idfv AND t1.stage_id = t3.stage_id AND t3.idfv_rn = 1 AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'ios' /* ios */ AND LOWER(t3.os) = 'ios' /* ios */ LEFT JOIN af_install_gps_adid AS t4 ON t1.app_id = t4.app_id AND t1.gps_adid = t4.gps_adid AND t1.stage_id = t4.stage_id AND t4.gps_adid_rn = 1 AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'android' /* android */ AND LOWER(t4.os) = 'android' /* android */ LEFT JOIN af_install_android_id AS t5 ON t1.app_id = t5.app_id AND t1.android_id = t5.android_id AND t1.stage_id = t5.stage_id AND t5.android_id_rn = 1 AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'android' /* android */ AND LOWER(t5.os) = 'android' /* android */ LEFT JOIN his_attr_did AS t6 ON t1.did = t6.did AND t1.app_id = t6.app_id AND t1.stage_id = t6.stage_id LEFT JOIN af_install_msdk_did AS t7 ON t1.app_id = t7.app_id AND t1.did = t7.msdk_did AND t1.stage_id = t7.stage_id AND t7.msdk_did_rn = 1 AND LOWER(TRIM(t7.msdk_did)) <> 'unknown' AND LOWER(t1.os) = 'windows' /* windows */ AND LOWER(t7.os) = 'windows' /* windows */ WHERE COALESCE(t2.logymd, t3.logymd, t4.logymd, t5.logymd, t7.logymd, 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AND t6.did IS NULL DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dim_attribution_device_di PARTITION(logymd, app_id) SELECT a.did, 'callback' AS attr_source, a.event_time /* 是触发事件的时间 20220606 */, a.server_time AS attr_time /* server time是归因时间 20220606 */, a.package_name, os, country AS ad_country, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.media_source, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.media_source, 'unknown') END AS media_source, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.campaign_id, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.campaign_id, 'unknown') END AS campaign_id /* COALESCE(c.media_source, a.media_source, 'unknown') AS media_source, */, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.adgroup_id, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.adgroup_id, 'unknown') END AS adgroup_id, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.creative_id, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.creative_id, 'unknown') END AS creative_id, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.campaign_name, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.campaign_name, 'unknown') END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.adgroup_name, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.adgroup_name, 'unknown') END AS adgroup_name, CASE WHEN NOT c.adjust_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(c.creative_name, 'unknown') ELSE COALESCE(a.creative_name, 'unknown') END AS creative_name, a.gps_adid /* COALESCE(c.campaign_id, a.campaign_id, 'unknown') campaign_id, */ /* COALESCE(c.adgroup_id, a.adgroup_id, 'unknown') adgroup_id, */ /* COALESCE(c.creative_id, a.creative_id, 'unknown') creative_id, */ /* COALESCE(c.campaign_name, a.campaign_name, 'unknown') campaign_name, */ /* COALESCE(c.adgroup_name, a.adgroup_name, 'unknown') adgroup_name, */ /* COALESCE(c.creative_name, a.creative_name, 'unknown') creative_name, */, a.android_id, a.oaid, a.idfa, a.idfv, a.adjust_id AS mmp_id, '2026-05-31' AS createdate /* fuxinwang：和basic df表字段对齐命名，设备创建时间统一命名createdate */, COALESCE(a.stage_id, '01') AS stage_id /* COALESCE(t2.logymd, t3.logymd, t4.logymd, t5.logymd, 'unknown') AS logymd, */, '2026-05-31' AS logymd /* 20220606 */, a.app_id FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT did, app_id, package_name, event_time, server_time, os, gps_adid, android_id, oaid, idfa, idfv, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adjust_id') AS adjust_id, os, COALESCE(IF(TRIM((GEOIP(client_ip, 1))) = '-', NULL, LOWER(GEOIP(client_ip, 1))), 'unknown') AS country, GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.network_name') AS media_source, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name') RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS campaign_name, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name') RLIKE '^\\\\d+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.campaign_name'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)', 2))) AS campaign_id, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name') RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS adgroup_name, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name') RLIKE '^\\\\d+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.adgroup_name'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)', 2))) AS adgroup_id, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative') RLIKE '^\\\\D+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)'))) AS creative_name, IF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative') RLIKE '^\\\\d+$', GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative'), TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.creative'), '(.*?)\\\\((\\\\d+)\\\\)', 2))) AS creative_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') ORDER BY event_time DESC, server_time DESC) AS rn, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_ods.msdk_event AS me LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id AS black_id FROM adbi.timezone_appid_blacklist WHERE NOT app_id IN ('4510', '4500', '4530')) AS blk ON me.app_id = blk.black_id WHERE event = '__adjust_callback__' AND logymd = '20260531' AND NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.network_name') IS NULL AND NOT did IS NULL AND blk.black_id IS NULL) AS x WHERE rn = 1) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msdk_app_id, adjust_id, stage_id ORDER BY event_time, server_time) AS adjust_id_rn FROM adbi.dwd_msdk_adjust_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND NOT adjust_id IS NULL AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') IN ('install')) AS x WHERE adjust_id_rn = 1) AS c ON a.adjust_id = c.adjust_id AND a.app_id = c.msdk_app_id AND a.stage_id = c.stage_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT did, APP_ID, stage_id FROM (SELECT did, APP_ID, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di AS dadi LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id AS black_id FROM adbi.timezone_appid_blacklist WHERE NOT app_id IN ('4510', '4500', '4530')) AS blk ON dadi.app_id = blk.black_id WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-30' AND blk.black_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT did, APP_ID, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id /* FROM    msdk_dim.dim_attribution_device_di */ FROM adbi.dim_attribution_device_di /* WHERE   logymd <=  '2026-05-31' or (attr_source<>'callback' and logymd='2026-06-01') */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS attr_device_di GROUP BY did, APP_ID, stage_id) AS d ON a.did = d.did AND a.app_id = d.app_id AND a.stage_id = d.stage_id WHERE d.did IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT * FROM adbi.dim_attribution_device_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* union all */ /* select * from bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di */ /* where logymd =  '2026-06-01' */

name: adbi_dm_msdk_device_active_tz_df_daily
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_msdk_device_active_df_out)) SELECT did, his_first_active_date, active_info, total_active_days, stage_id, app_id FROM (SELECT COALESCE(df.did, di.did) AS did, COALESCE(df.app_id, di.app_id) AS app_id, COALESCE(df.his_first_active_date, di.day_first_active_date) AS his_first_active_date, ARRAY(ADD_BIT_TO_RIGHT(COALESCE(active_info[0], ARRAY()), IF(di.login_cnt[0] > 0, 1, 0)), IF(TO_DATE(COALESCE(df.his_first_active_date[1], di.day_first_active_date[1])) > '2026-05-31', ARRAY(), ADD_BIT_TO_RIGHT(COALESCE(active_info[1], ARRAY()), IF(di.login_cnt[1] > 0, 1, 0))), IF(TO_DATE(COALESCE(df.his_first_active_date[2], di.day_first_active_date[2])) > '2026-05-31', ARRAY(), ADD_BIT_TO_RIGHT(COALESCE(active_info[2], ARRAY()), IF(di.login_cnt[2] > 0, 1, 0))), IF(TO_DATE(COALESCE(df.his_first_active_date[3], di.day_first_active_date[3])) > '2026-05-31', ARRAY(), ADD_BIT_TO_RIGHT(COALESCE(active_info[3], ARRAY()), IF(di.login_cnt[3] > 0, 1, 0)))) AS active_info, ARRAY(COALESCE(df.total_active_days[0], 0) + IF(di.login_cnt[0] > 0, 1, 0), COALESCE(df.total_active_days[1], 0) + IF(di.login_cnt[1] > 0, 1, 0), COALESCE(df.total_active_days[2], 0) + IF(di.login_cnt[2] > 0, 1, 0), COALESCE(df.total_active_days[3], 0) + IF(di.login_cnt[3] > 0, 1, 0)) AS total_active_days, COALESCE(df.stage_id, di.stage_id) AS stage_id FROM (/* 前一天历史全量活跃数据 */ SELECT did, app_id, his_first_active_date, active_info, total_active_days, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_msdk_device_active_df_in)) WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS df FULL JOIN (/* 当日新增活跃数据 */ SELECT did, app_id, day_first_login_time AS day_first_active_date, login_cnt, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id FROM adbi.dwm_active_device_tz_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS di ON df.did = di.did AND df.app_id = di.app_id AND df.stage_id = di.stage_id) AS act DISTRIBUTE BY app_id, CAST(RAND() * 11 AS INT)

name: mt_dwd.dwd_decismart_audit_log_di
sql_units: /* ============================================================ */ /* TASK014：观星台审计日志数据底表需求 */ /* DML：mt_dwd.dwd_decismart_audit_log_di */ /* 需求文档：https://moonton.feishu.cn/wiki/ImTEwd9XciEp5Xk10Q3cig2SnVh */ /* 上游主表：mtwb_ods.webreportserver_track_event */ /* 分区变量：$[yyyy-MM-dd-1] */ /* TODO: */ /*   1. 确认部门负责人 ODS 表名，并替换 dept_leader_dim CTE。 */ /*   2. 确认国家维表表名与字段，并替换 country_dim CTE。 */ /*   3. 确认指标配置表表名与字段，并替换 measure_dim CTE。 */ /*   4. 确认是否需要按 event_name 白名单过滤审计日志事件。 */ /* ============================================================ */ WITH base AS (SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`time`)) AS event_time, did, GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.extra.user_nick_name') AS user_nick, GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.extra.user_name') AS user_name, meta_event, GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.event_name') AS event_name, GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.parameter.requestBody'), '$.projectId') AS project_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.parameter.requestBody') AS request_body, GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.parameter.path') AS path, GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.property.browser_brand') AS browser_brand, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.parameter.time') AS DOUBLE) / 1000.0 AS request_duration, GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.parameter.requestBody'), '$.filters') AS filters, GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.parameter.requestBody'), '$.measures') AS measure, CASE WHEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.event_name') = 'download_button' THEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(properties, '$.parameter.requestBody'), '$.download_title') ELSE NULL END AS download_title, properties FROM mtwb_ods.webreportserver_track_event WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((NOT meta_event IN ('__built_in_tracks__') AND project = '2917530') OR (NOT meta_event IN ('__built_in_tracks__') AND project = '2750638'))), filter_exploded AS (SELECT b.event_time, b.did, b.user_nick, b.user_name, b.meta_event, b.event_name, b.project_id, b.request_body, b.path, b.browser_brand, b.request_duration, b.filters, b.measure, b.download_title, b.properties, filter_json_str FROM base AS b LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(FROM_JSON(b.filters, 'array<string>')) filter_tbl AS filter_json_str), filter_pivot AS (SELECT event_time, did, user_nick, user_name, meta_event, event_name, project_id, request_body, path, browser_brand, request_duration, filters, measure, download_title, properties, MAX(CASE WHEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(filter_json_str, '$.col') = 'country' AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(filter_json_str, '$.operator') = '=' THEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(filter_json_str, '$.values[0]') WHEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(filter_json_str, '$.col') = 'country' AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(filter_json_str, '$.operator') = 'in' THEN CONCAT_WS(',', FROM_JSON(GET_JSON_OBJECT(filter_json_str, '$.values'), 'array<string>')) WHEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(filter_json_str, '$.col') = 'country' THEN '无' ELSE NULL END) AS query_country, MAX(CASE WHEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(filter_json_str, '$.col') = 'logymd' AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(filter_json_str, '$.operator') = 'between' THEN CASE WHEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(filter_json_str, '$.values[0]') RLIKE '^\\$\\{DATE\\}$' THEN TO_DATE('2026-05-31') WHEN GET_JSON_OBJECT(filter_json_str, '$.values[0]') RLIKE '^\\$\\{DATE-[0-9]+\\}$' THEN DATE_ADD(TO_DATE('2026-05-31'), CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(filter_json_str, '$.values[0]'), Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH charge_base /* 截至目前付费金额和时间 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, TIME, money FROM */ AND money <> 0 /* gp 礼品卡，无收入 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡，无收入 */), month_charge /* 当月充值 + 当月首次充值时间 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money / 100.0) AS month_charge_amt, MIN(logymd) AS first_charge_logymd, MIN(TIME) AS charge_min_time FROM charge_base WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), pre_month_charge /* 截至上月末，历史单月最高充值 + 历史最近充值日期 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(monthly_amt) AS max_monthly_amt /* 历史单月最高（pre_month_r_label） */, MAX(his_last_charge_logymd) AS his_last_charge_logymd /* 历史最近一次充值日期 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) AS logym, SUM(money / 100.0) AS monthly_amt, MAX(logymd) AS his_last_charge_logymd FROM charge_base WHERE logymd <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', DAY('2026-05-31') * -1) /* 截至上月末 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7)) AS m GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), prev_login /* 截止上月末最后登入日期 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(his_last_active_time, 0, 10) AS prev_login_logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', DAY('2026-05-31') * -1) AND zoneid <= 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(his_last_active_time, 0, 10)), sub_base /* 当月耗钻行为 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, TIME, TRIM(operate) AS operate FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000), sub_first /* 破冰：当月首次充值后的第一笔耗钻 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, operate, TIME FROM (SELECT s.roleid, s.zoneid, s.operate, s.TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.roleid, s.zoneid ORDER BY s.TIME ASC) AS time_rk FROM sub_base AS s JOIN month_charge AS mc ON s.roleid = mc.roleid AND s.zoneid = mc.zoneid AND s.TIME > mc.charge_min_time) AS ranked WHERE time_rk = 1), shop_buy_first /* 2.4 破冰耗钻同一时间对应的商城购买 */ AS (SELECT sb.roleid, sb.zoneid, sb.TIME, MIN_BY(sb.itemid, sb.TIME) AS itemid, MIN_BY(sb.shopid, sb.TIME) AS shopid, MIN_BY(sb.gift_item_info, sb.TIME) AS gift_item_info FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, TIME, itemid, shopid, gift_item_info FROM ml_ods.gameserver_shop_buy WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND moneytype = 301) AS sb JOIN sub_first AS sf ON sb.roleid = sf.roleid AND sb.zoneid = sf.zoneid AND sb.TIME = sf.TIME GROUP BY sb.roleid, sb.zoneid, sb.TIME), abnormal_account /* 异常账号（用于剔除） */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT accountid FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-08-15' AND '2026-05-31' AND (os_build LIKE '%AP1%' OR (os_build IS NULL AND (device_name IN ('OnePlus 11', 'Galaxy S21', 'Redmi Note 12') OR app_click_id IN (56, 185))))), basic_role /* 用户基础属性（注册日期、首次创号国） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb'), skin_cf /* 1.8 皮肤配置：品质等级 */ AS (SELECT skinid, quality, CASE WHEN quality = 1 THEN 'B级' WHEN quality = 2 THEN 'A级' WHEN quality = 3 THEN 'A+级' WHEN quality = 4 THEN 'S级' ELSE 'else' END AS skin_lvl FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01'), month_skin_type /* 月度新品皮肤类型（仅取本月配置） */ AS (SELECT skinid, skin_type AS skin_type_cf FROM ml_temp.ads_larsheet_leap_ml_shop_newskin_config_di WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM ml_temp.ads_larsheet_leap_ml_shop_newskin_config_di WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01' pmc.his_last_charge_logymd) >= 360 THEN '4、1年内无付费' ELSE 'else' END AS his_last_charge_logymd_type /* ------ 历史末次充值间隔分层（his_last_charge_logymd 来自 pre_month_charge） -------- */, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', br.register_date) <= 30 THEN '新用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(m.first_act_logymd, pl.prev_login_logymd) > 30 THEN '回流用户' ELSE '老用户' END AS user_status_type /* ------ 用户状态分层：新 / 老 / 回流（优先级：新 > 回流 > 老） -------- */, m.first_act_logymd, mc.first_charge_logymd, CASE WHEN NOT sa.roleid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS if_sub_diamond FROM (/* 当月月活，首次活跃日期 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(logymd) AS first_act_logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid <= 57000 AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS m LEFT JOIN basic_role AS br ON m.roleid = br.roleid AND m.zoneid = br.zoneid LEFT JOIN month_charge AS mc ON m.roleid = mc.roleid AND m.zoneid = mc.zoneid LEFT JOIN pre_month_charge AS pmc ON m.roleid = pmc.roleid AND m.zoneid = pmc.zoneid LEFT JOIN prev_login AS pl ON m.roleid = pl.roleid AND m.zoneid = pl.zoneid LEFT JOIN sub_first AS sf ON m.roleid = sf.roleid AND m.zoneid = sf.zoneid LEFT JOIN shop_buy_first AS sbf ON m.roleid = sbf.roleid AND m.zoneid = sbf.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid FROM sub_base) AS sa ON m.roleid = sa.roleid AND m.zoneid = sa.zoneid LEFT JOIN op_cf AS oc ON sf.operate = oc.operate LEFT JOIN item_cf AS ic ON IF(sbf.itemid = 0, SPLIT(sbf.gift_item_info, ':')[0], sbf.itemid) = ic.item_id LEFT JOIN skin_cf AS sc ON ic.item_id = sc.skinid LEFT JOIN month_skin_type AS mst ON ic.item_type = 6 AND ic.item_id = mst.skinid LEFT JOIN abnormal_account AS aa ON m.roleid = aa.accountid WHERE aa.accountid IS NULL /* 排除异常账号 */), agg /* ============================================================ */ /* 4) 维度聚合（保留 ana_df 全部分类维度） */ /* ============================================================ */ AS (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS logym, first_mt_country, month_r_label /* 当月付费档位 */, pre_month_r_label /* 历史最高单月付费档位 */, register_days_type /* 注册年份分层 */, user_status_type /* 用户状态：新/老/回流 */, age_type, pay_sub_operate /* 破冰操作 */, pay_sub_operate_origin_name /* 破冰操作原始映射名称 */, pay_sub_op_origin_type /* 破冰操作原始映射类型 */, shop_item_origin_type /* 破冰商城原始物品类型 */, skin_type, skin_lvl, shop_item_type_name /* 破冰商城物品类型展示名 */, item_origin_name2, shopid2, his_last_charge_logymd_type, first_act_logymd, first_charge_logymd, if_sub_diamond, COUNT(DISTINCT roleid, zoneid) AS ucnt FROM user_wide GROUP BY first_mt_country, month_r_label /* 当月付费档位 */, pre_month_r_label /* 历史最高单月付费档位 */, register_days_type /* 注册年份分层 */, user_status_type /* 用户状态：新/老/回流 */, age_type, pay_sub_operate /* 破冰操作 */, pay_sub_operate_origin_name /* 破冰操作原始映射名称 */, pay_sub_op_origin_type /* 破冰操作原始映射类型 */, shop_item_origin_type /* 破冰商城原始物品类型 */, skin_type, skin_lvl, shop_item_type_name /* 破冰商城物品类型展示名 */, item_origin_name2, shopid2, his_last_charge_logymd_type, first_act_logymd, first_charge_logymd, if_sub_diamond) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.ads_ylh_monthly_charge_stl_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.logym, a.first_mt_country, a.month_r_label, a.pre_month_r_label, a.register_days_type, a.user_status_type, a.age_type, a.pay_sub_operate, a.pay_sub_operate_origin_name, a.pay_sub_op_origin_type, a.shop_item_origin_type, a.skin_type, a.skin_lvl, a.shop_item_type_name, a.item_origin_name2, a.shopid2, a.his_last_charge_logymd_type, a.first_act_logymd, a.first_charge_logymd, a.if_sub_diamond, COALESCE(b.operate_name, '未知') AS operate_new /* ------ operate 维度（dim_shop_operate_config_df） -------- */, b.nick_name AS operate_name_new, COALESCE(b.type2, a.pay_sub_operate) AS pay_sub_op_type_new, COALESCE(b.nick_name2, '未知') AS operate_nick_name2, b.type3 AS operate_type3, b.type1 AS operate_type1, COALESCE(b.type4, '未知') AS operate_type4, COALESCE(c.operate_name, '未知') AS shopid_match /* ------ shopid 维度（tmp_bussiness_shop_config） -------- */, c.nick_name AS shop_nick_name, c.nick_name2 AS shop_nick_name2, c.type2 AS shop_type2, c.type3 AS shop_type3, COALESCE(c.type1, '未知') AS shop_type1, COALESCE(c.type4, '未知') AS shop_type4, COALESCE(c.nick_name, b.nick_name) AS unified_nick_name /* ------ 【新规则】统一映射 -------- */ /*   有 shopid（shopid2 <> '其他' 且 c 命中）→ 取 c.nick_name(2) */ /*   COALESCE 同时覆盖 c 缺失（shopid 没有命中配置）的兜底 */, COALESCE(c.nick_name2, b.nick_name2) AS unified_nick_name2, CASE WHEN b.nick_name IN ('皮肤赠送', '以旧换新系统', '礼物赠送') THEN '【聚合】商城非核心' WHEN b.nick_name IN ('星座抽奖', '魔力轮', '黎明召唤', '新品系统', '好运抽奖') THEN '【聚合】商城常驻抽奖' WHEN a.pay_sub_operate IN ('action_act_newmagicdraw') THEN '【聚合】商城常驻抽奖' WHEN COALESCE(b.type2, a.pay_sub_operate) IN ('常驻系统', '新手', '星光', '回流') THEN '【聚合】' || COALESCE(b.type2, a.pay_sub_operate) WHEN c.type4 = '【聚合】商城皮肤相关直售' THEN '【聚合】商城皮肤直售' WHEN c.type4 = '【聚合】商城非皮肤相关直售' THEN '【聚合】商城非皮肤直售' WHEN b.nick_name IN ('商城购买', '礼包购买') AND 1 = 99 THEN '当月商城新增内容' /* 限时模块占位 */ WHEN COALESCE(b.type2, a.pay_sub_operate) IN ('M赛', '小资源抽奖', '赛事活动', '皮肤PASS', '限时抽奖', '限时活动') THEN '【聚合】限时活动' WHEN b.nick_name = '未充值' THEN ' 月付费率' WHEN b.nick_name = '充值未耗钻' THEN '充值未耗钻' WHEN a.pay_sub_operate IN ('action_act_newbiedraw2025_2511200434', 'action_act_newbiedraw2025_2511200435', 'action_act_newbiedraw2025_2512300332') THEN '【聚合】新手' WHEN a.pay_sub_operate IN ('action_act_flowbackskinfree') THEN '【聚合】回流' WHEN a.pay_sub_operate IN ('action_act_collectiondraw', 'action_act_commondraw2023_2509250032', 'action_act_commondraw2023_2512092218', 'action_act_exclusivedeals', 'action_act_mgame_pass', 'action_act_skinflashsale1', 'action_act_collectiondraw_loverday', 'action_act_ramadandraw') THEN '【聚合】限时活动' WHEN a.pay_sub_operate IN ('activity_firstpay') THEN '【聚合】常驻系统' ELSE '其他' END AS pay_sub_operate_name_agg /* ------ 聚合大类（沿用 渗透率看板数据集.sql 口径） -------- */, a.ucnt, d.logym_total_ucnts /* ------ 月大盘人数 -------- */ FROM agg AS a LEFT JOIN shop_operate_config AS b ON TRIM(a.pay_sub_operate) = TRIM(b.operate_name) LEFT JOIN bussiness_shop_config AS c ON TRIM(a.shopid2) = TRIM(c.operate_name) LEFT JOIN (SELECT logym, SUM(ucnt) AS logym_total_ucnts FROM agg WHERE register_days_type <> 'else' GROUP BY logym) AS d ON a.logym = d.logym UNION ALL /* ============================================================ */ /* 5) 历史月份：从 _mi 直接读，不重复计算 */ /* ============================================================ */ SELECT logym, first_mt_country, month_r_label, pre_month_r_label, register_days_type, user_status_type, age_type, pay_sub_operate, pay_sub_operate_origin_name, pay_sub_op_origin_type, shop_item_origin_type, skin_type, skin_lvl, shop_item_type_name, item_origin_name2, shopid2, his_last_charge_logymd_type, first_act_logymd, first_charge_logymd, if_sub_diamond, operate_new, operate_name_new, pay_sub_op_type_new, operate_nick_name2, operate_type3, operate_type1, operate_type4, shopid_match, shop_nick_name, shop_nick_name2, shop_type2, shop_type3, shop_type1, shop_type4, unified_nick_name, unified_nick_name2, pay_sub_operate_name_agg, ucnt, logym_total_ucnts FROM ml_temp.ads_ylh_monthly_charge_stl_mi WHERE logymd < SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7)

============================================================ */ AS (SELECT sb.roleid, sb.zoneid, CASE WHEN REPLACE(cfg.type2, '商城-', '') = '皮肤' THEN CASE sk.skinlevel WHEN 'SP' THEN 'SP皮' WHEN 'A' THEN 'A皮和B皮' WHEN 'B' THEN 'A皮和B皮' WHEN 'A+' THEN 'A+皮' WHEN 'S+' THEN 'S+皮' WHEN 'S' THEN 'S皮' WHEN 'Luckybox' THEN '典藏皮' WHEN 'Collector' THEN '典藏皮' WHEN 'collector' THEN '典藏皮' WHEN 'Collectoryhzg' THEN '典藏皮' WHEN 'yearstar' THEN '典藏皮' ELSE '其他' END WHEN REPLACE(cfg.type2, '商城-', '') = '英雄' THEN '英雄' WHEN REPLACE(cfg.type2, '商城-', '') = '道具' THEN '道具' WHEN REPLACE(cfg.type2, '商城-', '') IN ('圣像', '表情', '个性动作', '英雄语音', '战队播报', '互动特效', '灵动幻彩', '局内特效', '个性按键') THEN '小资源' WHEN REPLACE(cfg.type2, '商城-', '') = 'M赛赛季通行证' THEN 'S皮' WHEN REPLACE(cfg.type2, '商城-', '') = '常规礼包' THEN '常规礼包' ELSE '其他' /* 含 cfg 未匹配（NULL）和其余 type2 一律归"其他" */ END AS cur_resource_type FROM ml_ods.gameserver_shop_buy AS sb LEFT JOIN ml_temp.tmp_bussiness_shop_config AS cfg ON sb.shopid = cfg.operate_name AND cfg.logymd = '2026-05-05' /* 最近分区 */ LEFT JOIN ml_temp.leolv_skin_level_20260311_v2 AS sk ON sb.itemid = sk.skinid WHERE sb.logymd >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), '-01') AND sb.logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND sb.moneytype = 301 /* 仅保留钻石支付（排除现金/绑钻/其他货币） */ AND sb.zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY sb.roleid, sb.zoneid, CASE WHEN REPLACE(cfg.type2, '商城-', '') = '皮肤' THEN CASE sk.skinlevel WHEN 'SP' THEN 'SP皮' WHEN 'A' THEN 'A皮和B皮' WHEN 'B' THEN 'A皮和B皮' WHEN 'A+' THEN 'A+皮' WHEN 'S+' THEN 'S+皮' WHEN 'S' THEN 'S皮' WHEN 'Luckybox' THEN '典藏皮' WHEN 'Collector' THEN '典藏皮' WHEN 'collector' THEN '典藏皮' WHEN 'Collectoryhzg' THEN '典藏皮' WHEN 'yearstar' THEN '典藏皮' ELSE '其他' END WHEN REPLACE(cfg.type2, '商城-', '') = '英雄' THEN '英雄' WHEN REPLACE(cfg.type2, '商城-', '') = '道具' THEN '道具' WHEN REPLACE(cfg.type2, '商城-', '') IN ('圣像', '表情', '个性动作', '英雄语音', '战队播报', '互动特效', '灵动幻彩', '局内特效', '个性按键') THEN '小资源' WHEN REPLACE(cfg.type2, '商城-', '') = 'M赛赛季通行证' THEN 'S皮' WHEN REPLACE(cfg.type2, '商城-', '') = '常规礼包' THEN '常规礼包' ELSE '其他' /* 含 cfg 未匹配（NULL）和其余 type2 一律归"其他" */ END), monthly_consume /* ============================================================ */ /* 5) 双流 UNION ALL → 4 月耗钻明细（用户, 资源类别） */ /* ============================================================ */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, cur_resource_type FROM non_shop_consume UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, cur_resource_type FROM shop_buy_consume), consume_with_tier /* ============================================================ */ /* 6) 关联档位（LEFT JOIN：保留无付费用户 → '0_未付费'） */ /* ============================================================ */ AS (SELECT u.roleid, u.zoneid, c.cur_resource_type, CASE WHEN u.history_maxpay_mi = -1 THEN '0_未付费' WHEN u.history_maxpay_mi = 0 THEN '1_0.01美金' WHEN u.history_maxpay_mi = 1 THEN '2_1美金' WHEN u.history_maxpay_mi = 2 THEN '3_2美金' WHEN u.history_maxpay_mi = 5 THEN '4_5美金' WHEN u.history_maxpay_mi = 10 THEN '5_10美金' WHEN u.history_maxpay_mi = 20 THEN '6_20美金' WHEN u.history_maxpay_mi = 50 THEN '7_50美金' ELSE NULL END AS pay_tier FROM user_cum_pay AS u LEFT JOIN monthly_consume AS c ON u.roleid = c.roleid AND u.zoneid = c.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.leolv_resource_type_payrate_mi PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT pay_tier, cur_resource_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(CAST(roleid AS STRING), '_', CAST(zoneid AS STRING))) AS user_cnt FROM consume_with_tier GROUP BY pay_tier, cur_resource_type UNION ALL SELECT pay_tier, '__total__' AS cur_resource_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(CAST(roleid AS STRING), '_', CAST(zoneid AS STRING))) AS user_cnt FROM consume_with_tier GROUP BY pay_tier ORDER BY pay_tier, cur_resource_type

role_id, COALESCE(m__zone_id, 'unknown') AS zone_id, SUBSTRING(time, 0, 19) AS event_time, COALESCE(m__client_ip, 'unknown') AS client_ip, COALESCE(m__model, 'unknown') AS model, */ WITH result_tbl AS (SELECT country, os, channel, network_group, new_type, install_label, CAST(MAP('actual_pay_amt', actual_pay_amt, 'pay_amt', pay_amt) AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>) AS indicator_map FROM (SELECT a.country, a.os, a.channel, a.network_group, a.new_type, a.install_label, COALESCE(SUM(b.pay_amt), 0) AS pay_amt, COALESCE(SUM(b.actual_pay_amt), 0) AS actual_pay_amt FROM (SELECT country, last_active_os AS os, last_active_channel AS channel, network_group, new_type, last_active_install_label AS install_label, accountid FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_decismart_core_df_test WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appname = 'mcgg' AND granularity_type = 'account') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, SUM(pay_amt) AS pay_amt, SUM(actual_pay_amt) AS actual_pay_amt /* 活跃天数 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_decismart_core_df_test WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND appname = 'mcgg' AND granularity_type = 'account' GROUP BY accountid) AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid GROUP BY a.country, a.os, a.channel, a.network_group, a.new_type, a.install_label)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads_pre.ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mcgg_v2', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'monthly') SELECT SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AS date_range, res.country, 'unknown' AS network, MAP_CONCAT(COALESCE(res.indicator_map, CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>))) AS indicator_map, res.os, res.channel, res.network_group, res.new_type, res.install_label, -99999 AS arcade_label, -99999 AS active_label, NULL AS user_type, NULL AS zone_group FROM result_tbl AS res

adset_name, COALESCE(a.ad_name, b.ad_name) AS ad_name, a.did_new_user, a.retention_2_30_interval1_list, a.retention_45_180_interval15_list, a.revenue_amount_1_30_interval1_list, b.retention_2_30_interval1_list_back, b.retention_45_180_interval15_list_back, b.revenue_amount_1_30_interval1_list_back, b.revenue_amount_45_180_interval15_list_back, name: etl.w5_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_df
sql_units:
/* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: maoyancai */ /* Create by: 2026-05-11 20:47:14.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: 移除刷号识别逻辑(bot_info / acc_bot_info CTE)， */ /*         is_cur_bot / is_init_bot / is_acc_cur_bot / is_acc_init_bot */ /*         统一固定为 0；DDL 不变以避免下游表结构 broken。 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /*
  CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE `w5_dw`.`dim_basic_role_zone_df`(
      `roleid` decimal(20, 0) COMMENT '角色id',
      `zoneid` bigint COMMENT '服务器id',
      `account_name` string COMMENT 'sdk账号或设备id',
      `did` string COMMENT 'did',
      `register_time` string COMMENT '角色创建时间',
      `register_date` string COMMENT '角色创建日期',
      `create_ip` string COMMENT '创角ip',
      `create_channel` string COMMENT '创角渠道',
      `create_sub_channel` string COMMENT '创角子渠道',
      `os_type` bigint COMMENT '创角系统类型',
      `os_name` string COMMENT '角色id',
      `create_country` string COMMENT '创角国家',
      `create_ip_country` string COMMENT '首次ip国家',
      `first_mt_country` string COMMENT '首次创角国家',
      `first_network_name` string COMMENT '首次广告渠道',
      `is_first_create` bigint COMMENT '是否账号下首个创角',
      `data_source` string COMMENT '创角数据来源',
      `zone_type` string COMMENT '区服类型',
      `is_cur_bot` bigint COMMENT '角色当前是否刷号（业务已下线，恒为 0）',
      `is_init_bot` bigint COMMENT '创角时是否刷号（业务已下线，恒为 0）',
      `is_formal_first_create` bigint COMMENT '是否账号下正式服首个创角',
      `is_acc_cur_bot` bigint COMMENT '账号当前是否刷号（业务已下线，恒为 0）',
      `is_acc_init_bot` bigint COMMENT '账号初始是否刷号（业务已下线，恒为 0）'
  ) PARTITIONED BY (
      `logymd` string COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd, 美西日期',
      `appid` string COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key'
  )
  STORED AS PARQUET
  LOCATION 's3a://wefly5-dw/table/dim_basic_role_zone_df'
  */ WITH install_user_reduce AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, did, register_time, register_date, create_ip, create_channel, create_sub_channel, os_type, CASE os_type WHEN 1 THEN 'ios' WHEN 2 THEN 'android' WHEN 3 THEN 'other' ELSE 'unknown' END AS os_name, create_country, create_ip_country, data_source, IF(zoneid > 9999, 1, 0) AS zone_type FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY source_order ASC, register_time ASC, zoneid ASC /* 同一时间创角的取区分小的 */) AS row_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, usercreateymd AS register_date, usercreatetime AS register_time, did, login_ip AS create_ip, CASE WHEN LOWER(login_channel) = 'and_gb' THEN 'and_gb' WHEN LOWER(login_channel) = 'ios_gb' THEN 'ios_gb' ELSE 'unknown' END AS create_channel, login_sub_channel AS create_sub_channel, login_os_type AS os_type, IF(createrole_country IS NULL OR TRIM(createrole_country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', LOWER(createrole_country)) AS create_country, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202508', '202508', '202605'))) AS create_ip_country, 'create' AS data_source, 1 AS source_order FROM w5_ods.create_role WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-04-22' AND zoneid > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, usercreateymd AS register_date, usercreatetime AS register_time, did, login_ip AS create_ip, CASE WHEN LOWER(login_channel) = 'and_gb' THEN 'and_gb' WHEN LOWER(login_channel) = 'ios_gb' THEN 'ios_gb' ELSE 'unknown' END AS create_channel, login_sub_channel AS create_sub_channel, login_os_type AS os_type, IF(createrole_country IS NULL OR TRIM(createrole_country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', LOWER(createrole_country)) AS create_country, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202508', '202508', '202605'))) AS create_ip_country, 'login' AS data_source, 2 AS source_order FROM w5_ods.login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-04-22' AND zoneid > 10000 AND (usercreateymd = '2026-05-31' OR usercreateymd < '2026-04-22') UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, usercreateymd AS register_date, usercreatetime AS register_time, did, login_ip AS create_ip, CASE WHEN LOWER(login_channel) = 'and_gb' THEN 'and_gb' WHEN LOWER(login_channel) = 'ios_gb' THEN 'ios_gb' ELSE 'unknown' END AS create_channel, login_sub_channel AS create_sub_channel, login_os_type AS os_type, IF(createrole_country IS NULL OR TRIM(createrole_country) IN ('-', ''), 'unknown', LOWER(createrole_country)) AS create_country, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202508', '202508', '202605'))) AS create_ip_country, 'charge' AS data_source, 3 AS source_order FROM w5_ods.charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-04-22' AND zoneid > 10000 AND (usercreateymd = '2026-05-31' OR usercreateymd < '2026-04-22'))) WHERE row_num = 1), df_yd AS (/* 不再读取刷号字段（is_cur_bot/is_init_bot/is_acc_cur_bot/is_acc_init_bot） */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, did, register_time, register_date, create_ip, create_channel, create_sub_channel, os_type, os_name, create_country, first_mt_country, first_network_name, create_ip_country, data_source, is_first_create, zone_type FROM w5_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND zoneid > 10000), adjust_info /* bot_info / acc_bot_info CTE 已移除（业务不再需要刷号识别，省算力） */ AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT did, first_mt_country, first_media_source, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY did ORDER BY first_mt_country) AS rn FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND app_id = 4500) AS A WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE w5_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'wefly5') SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.account_name, t0.did, SUBSTRING(t0.register_time, 1, 19) AS register_time, t0.register_date, t0.create_ip, t0.create_channel, t0.create_sub_channel, t0.os_type, t0.os_name, t0.create_country, t0.create_ip_country, t0.first_mt_country, t0.first_network_name, IF(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.roleid ORDER BY t0.register_time, t0.zoneid ASC) = 1, 1, 0) AS is_first_create, t0.data_source, t0.zone_type, 0 AS is_cur_bot /* 业务不再需要刷号识别，固定为 0 */, 0 AS is_init_bot /* 业务不再需要刷号识别，固定为 0 */, IF(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.roleid ORDER BY t0.formal_ord DESC, t0.register_time ASC, t0.zoneid ASC) = 1 AND t0.formal_ord = 1, 1, 0) AS is_formal_first_create, 0 AS is_acc_cur_bot /* 是否正式服下首个创角 */ /* 业务不再需要刷号识别，固定为 0 */, 0 AS is_acc_init_bot /* 业务不再需要刷号识别，固定为 0 */ FROM (SELECT COALESCE(df.roleid, di.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(df.zoneid, di.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(df.account_name, di.account_name) AS account_name, COALESCE(df.did, di.did) AS did, COALESCE(df.register_time, di.register_time) AS register_time, COALESCE(df.register_date, di.register_date) AS register_date, COALESCE(df.create_ip, di.create_ip) AS create_ip, COALESCE(df.create_channel, di.create_channel) AS create_channel, COALESCE(df.create_sub_channel, di.create_sub_channel) AS create_sub_channel, COALESCE(df.os_type, di.os_type) AS os_type, COALESCE(df.os_name, di.os_name) AS os_name, COALESCE(df.create_country, di.create_country) AS create_country, COALESCE(df.create_ip_country, di.create_ip_country) AS create_ip_country, COALESCE(df.first_mt_country, di.first_mt_country) AS first_mt_country, COALESCE(df.first_network_name, di.first_network_name) AS first_network_name, COALESCE(df.is_first_create, di.is_first_create, 1) AS is_first_create, COALESCE(df.data_source, di.data_source) AS data_source, COALESCE(df.zone_type, di.zone_type) AS zone_type, IF(COALESCE(df.zone_type, di.zone_type) = 1, 1, -99999) AS formal_ord /* 已删除：df.is_cur_bot / df.is_init_bot / df.is_acc_cur_bot / df.is_acc_init_bot */ FROM df_yd AS df FULL JOIN (SELECT t0.roleid, t0.zoneid, t0.account_name, t0.did, t0.register_time, t0.register_date, t0.create_ip, t0.create_channel, t0.create_sub_channel, t0.os_type, t0.os_name, t0.create_country, t0.create_ip_country, t0.data_source, t1.first_mt_country, t1.first_media_source AS first_network_name, 1 AS is_first_create, t0.zone_type FROM install_user_reduce AS t0 LEFT JOIN adjust_info AS t1 ON t0.did = t1.did) AS di ON di.roleid = df.roleid AND di.zoneid = df.zoneid) AS t0 /* 已删除：LEFT JOIN bot_info AS t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.roleid AND t0.zoneid = t1.zoneid */ /* 已删除：LEFT JOIN acc_bot_info AS t2 ON t0.roleid = t2.roleid */

'unknown' END AS login_channel, LOWER(login_sub_channel) AS login_sub_channel, login_ip, device, device_id, os_language, client_os_version, client_language, client_version, war_stage, activedays, his_last_os_type /*	历史末次登录系统类型 */, his_last_os_name /*	历史末次登录系统类型名称 */, his_last_channel /*	历史末次登录渠道 */, his_last_login_ip /*	历史末次登录ip */, his_last_ip_country /*	历史末次登录国家 */, his_last_os_language /*	历史末次系统语言 */, his_last_os_version /*	历史末次登录系统版本 */, his_last_device_model /*	历史末次登录设备型号 */, his_last_device_id /*	历史末次登录设备id */, his_last_client_language /*	历史末次登录客户端语言 */, activedays /*	累计活跃天数(取自login activedays末次) */, cur_war_stage /*	当前战役进度 */, cur_role_level /*		当前玩家等级 */ FROM w5_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly5'), charge_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_first_pay_time, his_last_pay_time, his_pay_amt FROM w5_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly5'), role_zone_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, charge_info, charge_cnt_total_array, charge_amt_total_array, charge_amt_array, ol_dur_array, active_info, active_days_array FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_decismart_info_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appname = 'wefly5' AND granularity_type = 'role') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE w5_dw.dm_info_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT bas.roleid /*	账号id,key */, bas.zoneid /*	服务器,key */, bas.zone_type /*	区分类型(1:正式服， 0：测服) */, bas.register_date /*	注册日期（yyyy-mm-dd） */, bas.os_name AS register_os /*	创角时系统类型（ios,android,other） */, bas.is_init_bot /*	创角时是否刷号（1：正常玩家，0：刷号） */, bas.is_cur_bot /*	当前是否刷号（1：正常玩家，0：刷号） */, bas.is_first_create /*	是否账号下首次创角 */, bas.first_mt_country, bas.first_network_name, bas.create_country, bas.create_channel /*	创角渠道 */, act_df.cur_war_stage /*	当前战役进度 */, act_df.activedays AS activedays_total /*	累计活跃天数 */, act_df.his_last_channel AS last_active_channel /*	末次活跃渠道 */, SUBSTRING(act_df.his_last_active_time, 1, 10) AS last_active_date /*	末次活跃日期 */, COALESCE(chg_df.his_pay_amt, 0) AS charge_amt_total /*	累计付费金额 */, COALESCE(SUBSTRING(chg_df.his_first_pay_time, 1, 10), '') AS first_charge_date /*	首次付费日期 */, COALESCE(SUBSTRING(chg_df.his_last_pay_time, 1, 10), '') AS last_charge_date /*	末次付费日期 */, ifo.charge_info /*	付费：充值位图，充值：1，未充值：0，左侧是最近日期，右侧是注册日期 */, ifo.charge_cnt_total_array /*	付费：累计充值次数位图，从左到右，左侧是最近日期累计总充值次数，右侧是注册日期，未充值补0 */, ifo.charge_amt_total_array /*	付费：累计充值金额位图，从左到右，左侧是最近日期累计总充值金额，右侧是注册日期，未充值补0 */, ifo.charge_amt_array /*	付费金额位图，从左到右，左侧是最近日期累计总充值金额，右侧是注册日期，未充值补0 */, ifo.ol_dur_array /*	活跃：在线时长位图，从左到右，左侧是最近日期在线时长，右侧是注册日期，未登录补0 */, ifo.active_info /*	活跃：活跃位图，活跃：1，未活跃：0，左侧是最近日期，右侧是注册日期 */, ifo.active_days_array /*	活跃：活跃天数累计位图：从左到右，左侧是最近日期，右侧是注册日期 */, bas.account_name, bas.did FROM dim_basic AS bas LEFT JOIN active_df AS act_df ON bas.roleid = act_df.roleid AND bas.zoneid = act_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN charge_df AS chg_df ON bas.roleid = chg_df.roleid AND bas.zoneid = chg_df.zoneid LEFT JOIN role_zone_df AS ifo ON bas.roleid = ifo.roleid AND bas.zoneid = ifo.zoneid

name: AOZ基础数据中间表
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: parkerchen@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-13 15:01:42.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* ALTER TABLE nova2_temp.aoz_active_role_zone_info */ /* DROP IF EXISTS PARTITION (logymd = '2026-05-31' ) */ /* select * from nova2_temp.aoz_active_role_zone_info */ /* where logymd = '2026-05-18' */ /* limit 100 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE nova2_temp.aoz_active_role_zone_info PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.did, a.account_name, a.accountid, a.usercreateymd, a.accountcreateymd, a.createrole_channel, a.createrole_country, a.createrole_os_type, a.os_language, a.client_language, a.detected_quality_level, a.ip, a.activedays, COALESCE(charge.chargecou, a.chargecou) AS chargecou, a.total_payment, COALESCE(finish_t.day_mainstage, a.war_stage) AS war_stage, COALESCE(level_t.day_level, a.level) AS role_level, a.last_login_date, a.last_payment_date, a.payment_times, a.player_name, onlinetime.roleid AS day_online_roleid, onlinetime.day_online_time, charge.roleid AS day_charge_roleid, charge.day_charge, charge.day_charge_num, charge.new_first_payment_date, IF(start_t.day_start_mainstagenum > 0, a.roleid, NULL) AS day_mainstage_roleid, start_t.day_start_mainstage, start_t.day_start_mainstagenum, finish_t.day_mainstagenum, finish_t.day_success_mainstagenum, IF(start_t.day_start_difficultstagenum > 0, a.roleid, NULL) AS day_difficultmainstage_roleid, start_t.day_start_difficultstage, start_t.day_start_difficultstagenum, finish_t.day_difficultstagenum, finish_t.day_success_difficultmainstagenum, IF(start_t.day_start_endlessstagenum > 0, a.roleid, NULL) AS day_endlessstage_roleid, start_t.day_start_endlessstage, start_t.day_start_endlessstagenum, finish_t.day_endlessstagenum, finish_t.day_success_endlessstagenum, energy.day_sub_energy, energy.day_idle_sub_energy, sub_special_t.day_sub_diamond, sub_special_t.day_gacha_sub_diamond, sub_special_t.day_shop_sub_diamond, add_special_t.day_add_diamond, add_special_t.day_act_add_diamond, add_special_t.day_iap_add_diamond, key_add.day_1050_add, key_add.day_1051_add, gacha_t.roleid AS gacha_roleid, gacha_t.day_gacha1_cnt, gacha_t.day_gacha2_cnt, add_special_t.day_coin_add_num, sub_special_t.day_coin_subnum FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, did, account_name, SUBSTRING(roleid, 14, 5) AS accountid, usercreateymd, accountcreateymd, createrole_channel, createrole_country, createrole_os_type, os_language, client_language, detected_quality_level, ip, activedays, chargecou, total_payment, war_stage, level, last_login_date, last_payment_date, payment_times, player_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid, logymd ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS ar, logymd FROM aoz_ods.login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid NOT LIKE '19%') AS login0 WHERE ar = 1) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(FLOOR(online_time / 60)) AS day_online_time FROM aoz_ods.logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid NOT LIKE '19%' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS onlinetime ON a.roleid = onlinetime.roleid AND a.zoneid = onlinetime.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money / 100) AS day_charge, COUNT(1) AS day_charge_num, MAX(chargecou) AS chargecou, MAX(IF(chargecou = money, logymd, NULL)) AS new_first_payment_date FROM aoz_ods.charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid NOT LIKE '19%' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS charge ON a.roleid = charge.roleid AND a.zoneid = charge.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(cur_num) AS day_level FROM aoz_ods.add_level WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid NOT LIKE '19%' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS level_t ON a.roleid = level_t.roleid AND a.zoneid = level_t.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1 AND stagesubtype = 1 THEN stage_id END) AS day_start_mainstage, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1 AND stagesubtype = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_start_mainstagenum, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1 AND stagesubtype = 3 THEN stage_id END) AS day_start_difficultstage, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1 AND stagesubtype = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_start_difficultstagenum, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 3 AND stagesubtype = 1 THEN stage_id END) AS day_start_endlessstage, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_type = 3 AND stagesubtype = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_start_endlessstagenum FROM aoz_ods.start_challenge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid NOT LIKE '19%' AND ((stage_type = 1 AND stagesubtype IN (1, 3)) OR (stage_type = 3 AND stagesubtype = 1)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS start_t ON a.roleid = start_t.roleid AND a.zoneid = start_t.zoneid /* 关卡结束 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1 AND stagesubtype = 1 AND ispass = 1 THEN stage_id WHEN stage_type = 1 AND stagesubtype = 1 THEN war_stage END) AS day_mainstage, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1 AND stagesubtype = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_mainstagenum, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1 AND stagesubtype = 1 AND ispass = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_success_mainstagenum, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1 AND stagesubtype = 3 AND ispass = 1 THEN stage_id END) AS day_difficultstage, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1 AND stagesubtype = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_difficultstagenum, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1 AND stagesubtype = 3 AND ispass = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_success_difficultmainstagenum, MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 3 AND stagesubtype = 1 AND ispass = 1 THEN stage_id END) AS day_endlessstage, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_type = 3 AND stagesubtype = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_endlessstagenum, SUM(CASE WHEN stage_type = 3 AND stagesubtype = 1 AND ispass = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_success_endlessstagenum FROM aoz_ods.finish_challenge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid NOT LIKE '19%' AND ((stage_type = 1 AND stagesubtype IN (1, 3)) OR (stage_type = 3 AND stagesubtype = 1)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS finish_t ON a.roleid = finish_t.roleid AND a.zoneid = finish_t.zoneid /* 体力消耗 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(sub_num) AS day_sub_energy, SUM(IF(action_type = 'afk_instant_reward', sub_num, 0)) AS day_idle_sub_energy FROM aoz_ods.sub_energy WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid NOT LIKE '19%' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS energy ON a.roleid = energy.roleid AND a.zoneid = energy.zoneid /* 水晶果实和流浪金币消耗 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 101 THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_sub_diamond, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 101 AND operate RLIKE 'gacha' THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_gacha_sub_diamond, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 101 AND operate = 'shop_buy' THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_shop_sub_diamond, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 999 THEN sub_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_coin_subnum FROM aoz_ods.sub_special_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid NOT LIKE '19%' AND item_id IN (101, 999) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS sub_special_t ON a.roleid = sub_special_t.roleid AND a.zoneid = sub_special_t.zoneid /* 水晶果实和流浪金币增加 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 101 THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_add_diamond, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 101 AND operate RLIKE 'act_' THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_act_add_diamond, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 101 AND operate RLIKE 'iap' THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_iap_add_diamond, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 999 THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_coin_add_num FROM aoz_ods.add_special_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid NOT LIKE '19%' AND item_id IN (101, 999) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS add_special_t ON a.roleid = add_special_t.roleid AND a.zoneid = add_special_t.zoneid /* 钥匙（萌芽之钥/希望之钥） */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 1050 THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_1050_add, SUM(CASE WHEN item_id = 1051 THEN add_num ELSE 0 END) AS day_1051_add FROM aoz_ods.add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid NOT LIKE '19%' AND item_id IN (1050, 1051) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS key_add ON a.roleid = key_add.roleid AND a.zoneid = key_add.zoneid /* 纹章抽奖 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(CASE WHEN gacha_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_gacha1_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN gacha_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_gacha2_cnt FROM aoz_ods.gacha WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid NOT LIKE '19%' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS gacha_t ON a.roleid = gacha_t.roleid AND a.zoneid = gacha_t.zoneid

name: etl.ml_dwd.dwd_mlbb_customer_aihelp_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: niangangdeng@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-13 12:09:55.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_dwd.dwd_mlbb_customer_aihelp_di */ /* ( */ /*     logymd_bj       string  COMMENT '', */ /*     category4       string  COMMENT '', */ /*     category1       string  COMMENT '', */ /*     served_by       int     COMMENT '', */ /*     cnt             bigint  COMMENT '', */ /*     total_cnt       bigint  COMMENT '', */ /*     rate            double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_cnt_1       double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_take_1      double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_cnt_3       double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_take_3      double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_cnt_w0      double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_take_w0     double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_cnt_w1      double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_take_w1     double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_cnt_m1      double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_take_m1     double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_cnt_m3      double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_take_m3     double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_cnt_m6      double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_take_m6     double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_cnt_m12     double  COMMENT '', */ /*     avg_take_m12    double  COMMENT '' */ /* ) */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3n://mt-dwd/table/dwd_mlbb_customer_aihelp_di'; */ /* 客诉四级标签日告警 */ WITH tb1 AS (SELECT logymd_bj, category4, category1, CASE WHEN served_by IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE served_by END AS served_by, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM (SELECT ticket_id, create_ymd /* 服务器时间 */, SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(create_time / 1000 AS STRING) + 8 * 60 * 60) AS STRING), 1, 10) AS logymd_bj, category4 /* 四级标签 */, served_by, category1 FROM mt_dwd.stg_customer_aihelp_data_mlbb_di /* 天更新 */ WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' /* 历史至今全量客诉 */ GROUP BY ticket_id, create_ymd, SUBSTRING(CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(create_time / 1000 AS STRING) + 8 * 60 * 60) AS STRING), 1, 10), category4, served_by, category1) GROUP BY logymd_bj, category4, category1, CASE WHEN served_by IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE served_by END), tb2 /* 每一天的占比及客单数量 */ AS (SELECT a.logymd_bj, a.category4, a.category1, a.served_by, a.cnt, b.total_cnt, ROUND(a.cnt / b.total_cnt, 4) AS rate FROM (SELECT logymd_bj, category4, category1, served_by, cnt FROM tb1) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd_bj, served_by, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM tb1 GROUP BY logymd_bj, served_by) AS b ON a.logymd_bj = b.logymd_bj AND a.served_by = b.served_by) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_mlbb_customer_aihelp_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.logymd_bj, a.category4, a.category1, a.served_by, a.cnt, a.total_cnt, a.rate, avg_cnt_1, avg_take_1, b.avg_cnt_3, b.avg_take_3, avg_cnt_w0, avg_take_w0, avg_cnt_w1, avg_take_w1, avg_cnt_m1, avg_take_m1, avg_cnt_m3, avg_take_m3, avg_cnt_m6, avg_take_m6, avg_cnt_m12, avg_take_m12 FROM (SELECT logymd_bj, category4, category1, served_by, cnt, total_cnt, rate FROM tb2 WHERE logymd_bj = '2026-05-31') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS t, category4, category1, served_by, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt_1, AVG(rate) AS avg_take_1 FROM tb2 WHERE logymd_bj = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY category4, category1, served_by) AS l /* 前一天均值 */ ON a.logymd_bj = l.t AND a.category4 = l.category4 AND a.category1 = l.category1 AND a.served_by = l.served_by LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS t, category4, category1, served_by, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt_3, AVG(rate) AS avg_take_3 FROM tb2 WHERE logymd_bj BETWEEN '2026-05-28' AND '2026-05-30' GROUP BY category4, category1, served_by) AS b /* 前三天均值 */ ON a.logymd_bj = b.t AND a.category1 = b.category1 AND a.category4 = b.category4 AND a.served_by = b.served_by LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS t, category4, category1, served_by, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt_w0, AVG(rate) AS avg_take_w0 FROM tb2 WHERE logymd_bj BETWEEN '2026-05-24' AND '2026-05-30' AND WEEKOFYEAR(logymd_bj) = WEEKOFYEAR('2026-05-31') GROUP BY category4, category1, served_by) AS c /* 本周日均值（排除当天） */ ON a.logymd_bj = c.t AND a.category1 = c.category1 AND a.category4 = c.category4 AND a.served_by = c.served_by LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS t, category4, category1, served_by, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt_w1, AVG(rate) AS avg_take_w1 FROM tb2 WHERE logymd_bj BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-30' AND WEEKOFYEAR(logymd_bj) = WEEKOFYEAR(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 7 * -1)) GROUP BY category4, category1, served_by) AS d /* 前一周日均值 */ ON a.logymd_bj = d.t AND a.category1 = d.category1 AND a.category4 = d.category4 AND a.served_by = d.served_by LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS t, category4, category1, served_by, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt_m1, AVG(rate) AS avg_take_m1 FROM tb2 WHERE logymd_bj BETWEEN '2026-03-27' AND '2026-05-30' AND SUBSTRING(logymd_bj, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(DATE_ADD(CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), '-01'), 1 * -1), 1, 7) GROUP BY category4, category1, served_by) AS f /* 前一个月日均值 */ ON a.logymd_bj = f.t AND a.category1 = f.category1 AND a.category4 = f.category4 AND a.served_by = f.served_by LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS t, category4, category1, served_by, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt_m3, AVG(rate) AS avg_take_m3 FROM tb2 WHERE logymd_bj BETWEEN '2026-01-21' AND '2026-05-30' AND SUBSTRING(logymd_bj, 1, 7) <= SUBSTRING(DATE_ADD(CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), '-01'), 1 * -1), 1, 7) AND SUBSTRING(logymd_bj, 1, 7) >= SUBSTRING(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 100 * -1), 1, 7) GROUP BY category4, category1, served_by) AS g /* 前三个月日均值 */ ON a.logymd_bj = g.t AND a.category1 = g.category1 AND a.category4 = g.category4 AND a.served_by = g.served_by LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS t, category4, category1, served_by, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt_m6, AVG(rate) AS avg_take_m6 FROM tb2 WHERE logymd_bj BETWEEN '2025-10-23' AND '2026-05-30' AND SUBSTRING(logymd_bj, 1, 7) <= SUBSTRING(DATE_ADD(CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), '-01'), 1 * -1), 1, 7) AND SUBSTRING(logymd_bj, 1, 7) >= SUBSTRING(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 190 * -1), 1, 7) GROUP BY category4, category1, served_by) AS h /* 前六个月日均值 */ ON a.logymd_bj = h.t AND a.category1 = h.category1 AND a.category4 = h.category4 AND a.served_by = h.served_by LEFT JOIN (SELECT '2026-05-31' AS t, category4, category1, served_by, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt_m12, AVG(rate) AS avg_take_m12 FROM tb2 WHERE logymd_bj BETWEEN '2025-04-26' AND '2026-05-30' AND SUBSTRING(logymd_bj, 1, 7) <= SUBSTRING(DATE_ADD(CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), '-01'), 1 * -1), 1, 7) AND SUBSTRING(logymd_bj, 1, 7) >= SUBSTRING(DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 370 * -1), 1, 7) GROUP BY category4, category1, served_by) AS j /* 前十二个月日均值 */ ON a.logymd_bj = j.t AND a.category1 = j.category1 AND a.category4 = j.category4 AND a.served_by = j.served_by

name: adbi.dm_admkt_ad_cost_report_none_input_df_utc8
sql_units: WITH cost_report AS (/* 过滤小时任务没有拉取的渠道 */ SELECT a.ad_account_id, a.report_date, a.media_source, a.campaign_id, a.campaign_name, a.adset_id, a.adset_name, a.ad_id, a.ad_name, a.app_id, STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwa_admkt_api_ad_cost_report_df)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.app_id, x.ad_account_id, x.ad_target, x.ad_platform_name FROM (SELECT app_id, ad_account_id, ad_target, ad_platform_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, ad_platform_name, ad_account_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rn FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_gms_ad_bi_ad_account)) WHERE date = '20260530') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1) AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.ad_account_id = b.ad_account_id AND a.media_source = b.ad_platform_name WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-30' AND a.media_source IN ('Snapchat Installs', 'Mintegral') /* 小时没有拉取 */ AND a.report_date >= '2025-08-27' /* 只需要4310上线之后的数据 */ UNION ALL /* 小时任务消耗 */ SELECT a.ad_account_id, a.report_date, a.media_source, a.campaign_id, a.campaign_name, a.adset_id, a.adset_name, a.ad_id, a.ad_name, a.app_id, a.app_name, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(a.os), '') = '', 'unknown', a.os) AS os, a.country, a.impression, a.click, a.cost, a.cost AS cost_align, b.ad_target FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwa_admkt_ad_cost_report_df_utc8)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.app_id, x.ad_account_id, x.ad_target, x.ad_platform_name FROM (SELECT app_id, ad_account_id, ad_target, ad_platform_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, ad_platform_name, ad_account_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rn FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_gms_ad_bi_ad_account)) WHERE date = '20260530') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1) AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.ad_account_id = b.ad_account_id AND a.media_source = b.ad_platform_name WHERE a.p_date = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT ad_account_id, report_date, media_source, campaign_id, campaign_name, adset_id, adset_name, ad_id, ad_name, app_id, app_name, os, country, NULL AS impression, NULL AS click, 0 AS cost, cost AS cost_align, ad_target FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwa_admkt_align_ad_cost_report_df_utc8)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31'), cost_report_agg AS (SELECT report_date AS data_date, app_id, MAX(ad_account_id) AS ad_account_id, MAX(ad_target) AS ad_target, LOWER(os) AS os, MAX(app_name) AS app_name, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country)) AS country, media_source, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_id), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adset_id), '') = '', 'unknown', adset_id) AS adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ad_id), '') = '', 'unknown', ad_id) AS ad_id, MAX(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_name), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_name)) AS campaign_name, MAX(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adset_name), '') = '', 'unknown', adset_name)) AS adset_name, MAX(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ad_name), '') = '', 'unknown', ad_name)) AS ad_name, SUM(impression) AS impression, SUM(click) AS click, SUM(cost) AS cost, SUM(cost_align) AS cost_align, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN impression ELSE 0 END) AS impression_new, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN click ELSE 0 END) AS click_new, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS cost_new, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN cost_align ELSE 0 END) AS cost_new_align, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 2 THEN impression ELSE 0 END) AS impression_back, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 2 THEN click ELSE 0 END) AS click_back, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 2 THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS cost_back, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 2 THEN cost_align ELSE 0 END) AS cost_back_align, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN impression ELSE 0 END) AS impression_promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN click ELSE 0 END) AS click_promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS cost_promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN cost_align ELSE 0 END) AS cost_promotion_align FROM cost_report WHERE report_date <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY report_date, app_id, LOWER(os), LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country)), media_source, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_id), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_id), IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adset_id), '') = '', 'unknown', adset_id), IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ad_id), '') = '', 'unknown', ad_id)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_admkt_ad_cost_report_none_input_df_utc8)) SELECT `data_date`, `ad_account_id`, `os`, `app_name`, `country`, `media_source`, `campaign_id`, `adset_id`, `ad_id`, `campaign_name`, `adset_name`, `ad_name`, `impression`, `click`, `cost`, `cost_align`, `impression_new`, `click_new`, `cost_new`, `cost_new_align`, `impression_back`, `click_back`, `cost_back`, `cost_back_align`, `impression_promotion`, `click_promotion`, `cost_promotion`, `cost_promotion_align`, `ad_target`, `app_id` FROM cost_report_agg AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT app_id AS app_id_des FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_gms_ad_bi_app)) WHERE p_date = '20260530' AND is_cn = 0) AS f ON a.app_id = f.app_id_des

name: 回流专项_区域健康度_layer1
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: aprilgao@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-14 19:06:45.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.aprilgao_role_month_state PARTITION(`logymd` = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.role_id, a.zoneid, LOWER(a.country) AS country, a.active_days, 1 AS is_active, a.is_new, b.prev_login_dt, b.gap_days, CASE WHEN a.is_new = 0 AND b.gap_days BETWEEN 30 AND 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_returned_30_180, CASE WHEN a.is_new = 0 AND b.gap_days > 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_returned_180_plus, CASE WHEN a.is_new = 0 AND b.gap_days >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_returned, CASE WHEN a.is_new = 0 AND (b.gap_days IS NULL OR b.gap_days < 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_active_old FROM (/* ===================================================== */ /* 子查询 a: 当月活跃聚合 (角色级 GROUP BY) */ /* ===================================================== */ SELECT roleid AS role_id, zoneid, MAX(first_mt_country) AS country /* 取一个稳定值,防归因字段月内波动拆行 */, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days, MAX(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(create_date, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_new FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-31' AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid > 0 AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN (/* ===================================================== */ /* 子查询 b: 上月末快照取 his_last_active_time → gap_days */ /* his_last_active_time 是 varchar 含时分秒,需 substr 取日期部分 */ /* ===================================================== */ SELECT roleid AS role_id, zoneid, SUBSTRING(his_last_active_time, 1, 10) AS prev_login_dt, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', SUBSTRING(his_last_active_time, 1, 10)) AS gap_days FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_retention_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1) AND appid = 'mlbb' AND zoneid > 0 AND zoneid < 57000) AS b ON a.role_id = b.role_id AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid
