name: etl.mt_dwd.dwd_charge_order_di_fix
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: hengweiyan@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-02-15 11:09:03.000 */ /* DESCription: */ /* Update: Task Update DESCription */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 2025-12-15      jichun      增加is_real_charge是否真实付费字段，用于获取真实付费明细，数据回溯通过手动脚本etl.mt_finance.dwd_charge_order_di_jichun回溯 */ /* GP 无定价数据 */ WITH charge_gp_no_price AS (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND receipt_type = 2 AND COALESCE(localprice, 0) = 0), charge_all /* charge 标准化数据 */ AS (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_type, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype /* 土耳其错误货币缩写纠正 / 塞拉利昂更换货币缩写 */, CASE WHEN UPPER(currency) IN ('TRI', 'TRY') THEN 'TRY' WHEN UPPER(currency) IN ('SLE', 'SLL') THEN 'SLE' ELSE UPPER(currency) END AS currency, CASE WHEN UPPER(local_currency) IN ('TRI', 'TRY') THEN 'TRY' WHEN UPPER(local_currency) IN ('SLE', 'SLL') THEN 'SLE' ELSE UPPER(local_currency) END AS local_currency, localprice, pay_channel, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, logymd FROM (/* 有定价的数据 */ SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_type, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, currency, CASE WHEN receipt_type = 72 THEN localprice * 100 ELSE localprice END AS localprice, pay_channel, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (receipt_type <> 2 OR COALESCE(localprice, 0) > 0) UNION ALL /* GP 规范无定价商品的价格和货币 */ SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, a.product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, receipt_type, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, COALESCE(b.currency, a.currency) AS currency, COALESCE(b.localprice, a.localprice) AS localprice, pay_channel, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, logymd FROM charge_gp_no_price AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, localprice, currency FROM (SELECT t1.product_id, t1.localprice, t1.currency, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.product_id ORDER BY time DESC, t1.currency ASC) AS rn FROM (SELECT time, product_id, localprice, currency FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd >= '2026-04-30' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND receipt_type = 2 AND COALESCE(localprice, 0) > 0) AS t1 LEFT SEMI JOIN charge_gp_no_price AS t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id) AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS b ON a.product_id = b.product_id)), dim_charge_calibration_df /* 充值校准 start */ AS (SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, country_type, country, currency_type, currency, single_currency_muti_country_type, is_orderid_match FROM mt_dim.dim_charge_calibration_df AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_charge_calibration_df WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0'), receipt_mapping /* 渠道id Mapping */ AS (SELECT receipt_type, pay_channel, pay_channel_name FROM mt_dim.dim_receipt_mapping_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_receipt_mapping_di WHERE logymd > '0' AND appid = 'ml') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE appid = 'ml'), charge_raw AS (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, channel AS login_channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, COALESCE(flowid, 'unknown') AS flowid, a.receipt_type AS pay_channel, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, is_iap_token_buy, receipt_id, money, COALESCE(money_new, 0) AS money_new, device_id, product, COALESCE(operator, 'unknown') AS operator, COALESCE(interfacetype, 'unknown') AS interfacetype, a.logymd, IF(a.sub_pay_channel IS NULL OR a.sub_pay_channel = '', '-', a.sub_pay_channel) AS sub_pay_channel /* 默认本地价格和币种 */, IF(COALESCE(a.localprice, 0) > 0, a.currency, IF(COALESCE(local_price, 0) = 0, 'USD', COALESCE(local_currency, 'USD'))) AS currency, IF(COALESCE(a.localprice, 0) > 0, a.localprice, IF(COALESCE(local_price, 0) = 0, money, local_price)) AS localprice, IF(COALESCE(a.local_price, 0) > 0, a.local_currency, IF(COALESCE(localprice, 0) = 0, 'USD', COALESCE(a.currency, 'USD'))) AS local_currency, IF(COALESCE(a.local_price, 0) > 0, a.local_price, IF(COALESCE(localprice, 0) = 0, money, localprice)) AS local_price, COALESCE(first_channel_charge, 0) AS first_channel_charge, COALESCE(other_orderid, 'unknown') AS other_orderid, COALESCE(other_pay_orderid, 'unknown') AS other_pay_orderid, COALESCE(a.pay_channel, 'unknown') AS mix_pay_channel, COALESCE(b.pay_channel, 'unknown') AS calibration_pay_channel, COALESCE(b.pay_channel_name, 'unknown') AS pay_channel_name /* 渠道校准规则 */, COALESCE(c.single_currency_muti_country_type, d.single_currency_muti_country_type) AS single_currency_muti_country_type, COALESCE(c.sub_pay_channel, d.sub_pay_channel) AS calibration_sub_pay_channel, COALESCE(c.country_type, d.country_type) AS country_type, COALESCE(c.country, d.country) AS country_desc, COALESCE(c.currency_type, d.currency_type) AS currency_type, COALESCE(c.currency, d.currency) AS currency_desc FROM charge_all AS a LEFT JOIN receipt_mapping AS b ON a.receipt_type = b.pay_channel AND b.pay_channel <> 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM dim_charge_calibration_df WHERE sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS c ON LOWER(b.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(c.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(c.sub_pay_channel) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM dim_charge_calibration_df WHERE sub_pay_channel = '-') AS d ON LOWER(b.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(d.pay_channel)), currency_country_mapping /* 国家货币 Mapping */ AS (SELECT currency, country, country_name FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_country_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_country_di WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0' AND (currency <> 'EUR' OR (currency = 'EUR' AND country <> 'IT'))), charge_country_calibrated AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bill_country_tmp, '-') <> '-' THEN bill_country_tmp WHEN COALESCE(currency_country, '-') <> '-' THEN currency_country WHEN COALESCE(ip_country, '-') <> '-' THEN ip_country WHEN COALESCE(last_mt_country, '-') <> '-' THEN last_mt_country END AS bill_country FROM (SELECT a.* /* 不属于调整口径的渠道使用支付时的ip转换的国家作为支付国，货币与金额使用表中local_currency和local_price字段进行替换。 */, CASE WHEN a.logymd < '2021-12-01' THEN GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') WHEN country_type IS NULL THEN GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') WHEN single_currency_muti_country_type <> '-' AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT(UPPER(SPLIT(single_currency_muti_country_type, '\\+')[1]), ','), a.currency) AND LOWER(SPLIT(single_currency_muti_country_type, '\\+')[0]) = 'mt' THEN c.last_mt_country WHEN single_currency_muti_country_type <> '-' AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT(UPPER(SPLIT(single_currency_muti_country_type, '\\+')[1]), ','), a.currency) AND LOWER(SPLIT(single_currency_muti_country_type, '\\+')[0]) = 'ip' THEN GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') WHEN LOWER(country_type) = 'currency' THEN b.country WHEN LOWER(country_type) = 'clientip' THEN GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') ELSE LOWER(country_type) END AS bill_country_tmp, b.country AS currency_country, GEOIP(a.client_ip, 1, '202605') AS ip_country, c.last_mt_country AS last_mt_country FROM charge_raw AS a LEFT JOIN currency_country_mapping AS b ON IF(UPPER(COALESCE(a.currency, '')) IN ('', 'APPC'), UPPER(a.local_currency), UPPER(a.currency)) = UPPER(b.currency) LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS c ON c.logymd = '{DATE}' AND c.appid = 'mlbb' AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid AND a.roleid = c.roleid)), timezone_mapping /* 时区 Mapping */ AS (SELECT pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 1, 1) = '-' THEN (CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 2, 2) AS INT) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 5, 2) AS INT) * 60) ELSE -1 * ((CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 1, 2) AS INT) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(d1.timeoffset, 4, 2) AS INT) * 60)) END AS timeoffset FROM mt_dim.dim_payment_channel_timezone_di AS d1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_payment_channel_timezone_di WHERE logymd > '0') AS d2 ON d1.logymd = d2.logymd WHERE d1.logymd > '0'), charge_calibrated AS (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, login_channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, a.pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, a.currency, localprice, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, a.sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, mix_pay_channel, logymd, LOWER(bill_country) AS bill_country, LOWER(ip_country) AS ip_country, pay_channel_name, CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN '2020-10-21' AND '2020-12-14' THEN 'USD' WHEN a.currency = 'APPC' THEN 'USD' WHEN logymd < '2021-12-01' THEN a.local_currency WHEN currency_type IS NULL THEN a.local_currency WHEN LOWER(currency_type) = 'currency' THEN a.currency WHEN LOWER(currency_type) = 'country' THEN COALESCE(b.currency, a.currency) ELSE UPPER(currency_type) END AS bill_currency, CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN '2020-10-21' AND '2020-12-14' THEN money WHEN a.currency = 'APPC' THEN IF(logymd < '2021-12-01', local_price, localprice) * 0.01 WHEN currency_type IS NULL THEN a.local_price ELSE IF(logymd < '2021-12-01', local_price, localprice) END AS bill_amt /* 当 timeoffset 匹配不到的时候 null 或 '' 或 -, 需要按照默认服务器时间处理: 需要再处理下 */, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.time) + COALESCE(c.timeoffset, 0)) AS local_time, c.timeoffset FROM charge_country_calibrated AS a LEFT JOIN currency_country_mapping AS b ON LOWER(a.bill_country) = LOWER(b.country) LEFT JOIN timezone_mapping AS c ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(c.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(c.sub_pay_channel)), charge_final /* 充值校准 end */ AS (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, login_channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, a.product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, a.pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, a.currency, localprice, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, a.sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, a.mix_pay_channel, a.logymd, a.bill_country, a.ip_country, pay_channel_name, bill_currency, COALESCE(b.change_amt, a.bill_amt) AS bill_amt, a.local_time FROM charge_calibrated AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM mt_dim.dim_productmoney_change_df WHERE logymd > '0' AND logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_productmoney_change_df WHERE logymd > '0')) AS b ON a.local_time >= b.start_date AND a.local_time < b.end_date AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(TRIM(b.pay_channel)) AND LOWER(IF(COALESCE(a.sub_pay_channel, '') = '', '-', a.sub_pay_channel)) = LOWER(TRIM(b.sub_pay_channel)) AND LOWER(a.bill_country) = LOWER(TRIM(b.country)) AND LOWER(a.product_id) = LOWER(TRIM(b.product_id)) AND LOWER(a.bill_currency) = LOWER(TRIM(b.currency))), paychannel_rate /* 税率 */ AS (/* 如果出现重复，随机1条的结束日期置为当前日期，另一条为2016-01-01，而end_day为2016-01-01的那条不参与计算 */ /* 会通过charge.logymd<dim.end_day的方式剔除掉重复值 */ SELECT start_day, country, pay_channel, UPPER(sub_pay_channel) AS sub_pay_channel, rate, share, is_tax, is_pay_tax, is_back_tax, is_fuzzy_match, has_share_tax, LEAD(start_day, 1, '9999-12-31') OVER (PARTITION BY country, pay_channel, UPPER(sub_pay_channel) ORDER BY start_day) AS end_day FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_rate_di WHERE appid = 'ml' AND logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-08-01', '2024-08-01', '2026-05-31')), paychannel_fee /* 手续费 */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT country, pay_channel, UPPER(sub_pay_channel) AS sub_pay_channel, fee_currency, fee_amt FROM mt_dim.dim_paychannel_fee_di WHERE appid = 'ml' AND logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-08-01', '2024-08-01', '2026-05-31')), currency_exchange /* 月度平均汇率，来源XE网站数据：https://xecdapi.xe.com */ AS (SELECT currency, AVG(exchange_rate) AS exchange_rate FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_exchange_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-30' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY currency) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_charge_order_di_fix PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, login_channel, chargediamond, LOWER(createrole_country) AS createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, IF(COALESCE(operator, '') = '', 'unknown', operator) AS operator, IF(COALESCE(interfacetype, '') = '', 'unknown', interfacetype) AS interfacetype, currency, localprice, COALESCE(IF(DATE_FORMAT(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') <= '2020-04-10 03:52:39', 0, is_sandbox), 0) AS is_sandbox, iap_product_type, sub_pay_channel, COALESCE(IF(DATE_FORMAT(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') <= '2017-06-13 02:44:26', 0, is_iap_token_buy), 0) AS is_iap_token_buy, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, bill_country, UPPER(bill_currency) AS bill_currency, CASE WHEN UPPER(bill_currency) = 'MMK' THEN 1 / 0.000213995 ELSE COALESCE(exchange_rate, 0) END AS currency_exchange_rate, bill_amt, before_tax_currency, COALESCE(before_tax_amt, 0) AS before_tax_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(after_tax_currency, 'unknown')) AS after_tax_currency, COALESCE(after_tax_amt, 0) AS after_tax_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(actual_currency, 'unknown')) AS actual_currency, COALESCE(actual_amt, 0) AS actual_amt, COALESCE(tax_rate, 0) AS tax_rate, UPPER(COALESCE(tax_currency, 'unknown')) AS tax_currency, IF(COALESCE(is_pay_tax, '否') = '是', plat_tax_amt, 0) AS tax_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(back_tax_currency, 'unknown')) AS back_tax_currency, IF(COALESCE(is_back_tax, '否') = '是', plat_tax_amt, 0) AS back_tax_amt, COALESCE(share_ratio, 0) AS share_ratio, UPPER(COALESCE(share_currency, 'unknown')) AS share_currency, COALESCE(share_amt, 0) AS share_amt, UPPER(COALESCE(fee_currency, 'unknown')) AS fee_currency, COALESCE(fee_amt, 0) AS fee_amt, CASE WHEN UPPER(fee_currency) = 'MMK' THEN 1 / 0.000213995 ELSE COALESCE(fee_exchange_rate, 0) END AS fee_exchange_rate, pay_channel_name AS game_pay_channel, mix_pay_channel, IF(COALESCE(IF(DATE_FORMAT(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') <= '2017-06-13 02:44:26', 0, is_iap_token_buy), 0) = 0 /* 排除虚拟代币数据，没收入（一定要排除）目前正式服不存在，条件可不加 */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡，没收入（一定要排除） */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%', 1, 0) AS is_real_charge FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN has_share_tax = '不含税' THEN after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate WHEN has_share_tax = '含税' THEN before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate WHEN has_share_tax = '净额' THEN (before_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate) / (1 + tax_rate) ELSE after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate END AS actual_amt /* 实收 */ FROM (SELECT *, before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt AS after_tax_amt /* 税后 */, CASE WHEN has_share_tax = '不含税' THEN (before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt) * share_ratio WHEN has_share_tax IN ('含税', '净额') THEN before_tax_amt * share_ratio ELSE (before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt) * share_ratio END AS share_amt /* 分成 */ FROM (SELECT *, COALESCE(fee_amt / fee_exchange_rate, 0) AS fee_usd_amt /* 手续费 */, CASE WHEN has_share_tax IN ('不含税', '含税') THEN COALESCE(before_tax_amt / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate, 0) WHEN has_share_tax = '净额' THEN COALESCE(((before_tax_amt * (1 - share_ratio) - COALESCE(fee_amt / fee_exchange_rate, 0) * exchange_rate) / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate), 0) ELSE COALESCE(before_tax_amt / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate, 0) END AS plat_tax_amt /* 税金 */ FROM (SELECT time, loghms, roleid, zoneid, usercreatetime, usercreateymd, usercreatehms, level, activedays, device, os_type, login_channel, chargediamond, createrole_country, client_ip, sex, curdiamond, curbattle_points, curticket, product_id, base_diamond, extra_diamond, first_diamond, rcvtime, verifytime, flowid, a.pay_channel, receipt_id, money, device_id, product, operator, interfacetype, a.currency, localprice, is_sandbox, iap_product_type, a.sub_pay_channel, is_iap_token_buy, a.logymd, local_currency, local_price, money_new, first_channel_charge, other_orderid, other_pay_orderid, mix_pay_channel, bill_currency, bill_country, bill_amt, pay_channel_name, IF(bill_currency = 'USD', CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)), CASE WHEN b.exchange_rate IS NULL AND bill_currency = 'BAM' THEN CAST(1 / 0.558454 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) WHEN b.exchange_rate IS NULL AND bill_currency = 'SLE' THEN CAST(1 / 0.0466810 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) WHEN b.exchange_rate IS NULL AND bill_currency = 'HKR' THEN CAST(1 / 0.143622 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) ELSE CAST(b.exchange_rate AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) END) AS exchange_rate, IF(COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency, '') = 'USD', CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)), CASE WHEN k.exchange_rate IS NULL AND COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency, '') = 'BAM' THEN CAST(1 / 0.558454 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) WHEN k.exchange_rate IS NULL AND COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency, '') = 'SLE' THEN CAST(1 / 0.0466810 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) WHEN k.exchange_rate IS NULL AND COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency, '') = 'HKR' THEN CAST(1 / 0.143622 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) ELSE CAST(k.exchange_rate AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) END) AS fee_exchange_rate, CAST(COALESCE(c.rate, d.rate, e.rate, f.rate, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) AS tax_rate, CAST(COALESCE(c.share, d.share, e.share, f.share, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) AS share_ratio, COALESCE(c.is_tax, d.is_tax, e.is_tax, f.is_tax) AS is_tax, COALESCE(c.is_pay_tax, d.is_pay_tax, e.is_pay_tax, f.is_pay_tax) AS is_pay_tax, COALESCE(c.is_back_tax, d.is_back_tax, e.is_back_tax, f.is_back_tax) AS is_back_tax, COALESCE(c.has_share_tax, d.has_share_tax, e.has_share_tax, f.has_share_tax) AS has_share_tax, COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency) AS fee_currency, IF(LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = 'ph_dragonpay_gcash' AND LOWER(a.product_id) IN ('diamond_codashopphp_dragonpay_gcash_10'), 0, CAST(COALESCE(g.fee_amt, h.fee_amt, i.fee_amt, j.fee_amt, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) * 100) AS fee_amt, bill_currency AS before_tax_currency, bill_currency AS after_tax_currency, bill_currency AS actual_currency, bill_currency AS tax_currency, bill_currency AS back_tax_currency, bill_currency AS share_currency /* 税前 */, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.is_tax, d.is_tax, e.is_tax, f.is_tax) = '是' THEN CAST(bill_amt AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) ELSE CAST(bill_amt AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) * (1 + CAST(COALESCE(c.rate, d.rate, e.rate, f.rate, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18))) END AS before_tax_amt FROM charge_final AS a LEFT JOIN currency_exchange AS b ON UPPER(a.bill_currency) = UPPER(b.currency) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_rate WHERE country <> '-' AND sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS c ON a.bill_country = LOWER(c.country) AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(c.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(c.sub_pay_channel) AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) >= c.start_day AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) < c.end_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_rate WHERE country = '-' AND sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS d ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(d.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(d.sub_pay_channel) AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) >= d.start_day AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) < d.end_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_rate WHERE country <> '-' AND sub_pay_channel = '-') AS e ON a.bill_country = LOWER(e.country) AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(e.pay_channel) AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) >= e.start_day AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) < e.end_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_rate WHERE country = '-' AND sub_pay_channel = '-') AS f ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(f.pay_channel) AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) >= f.start_day AND TO_DATE(a.local_time) < f.end_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_fee WHERE country <> '-' AND sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS g ON a.bill_country = LOWER(g.country) AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(g.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(g.sub_pay_channel) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_fee WHERE country = '-' AND sub_pay_channel <> '-') AS h ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(h.pay_channel) AND LOWER(a.sub_pay_channel) = LOWER(h.sub_pay_channel) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_fee WHERE country <> '-' AND sub_pay_channel = '-') AS i ON a.bill_country = LOWER(i.country) AND LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(i.pay_channel) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM paychannel_fee WHERE country = '-' AND sub_pay_channel = '-') AS j ON LOWER(a.pay_channel_name) = LOWER(j.pay_channel) LEFT JOIN currency_exchange AS k ON UPPER(COALESCE(g.fee_currency, h.fee_currency, i.fee_currency, j.fee_currency)) = UPPER(k.currency)) AS t) AS t1) AS t2) AS t3

name: mt_dwd.dwd_decismart_realtime_login_detail_mlbb
sql_units: WITH t_basic AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country, is_ai FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-05-06', '2023-05-06', '2026-05-31') AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1 AND register_date <= '2026-05-31'), t_login /*   AND zoneid < IF( '2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03',  57000 , 999999) */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, (zoneid DIV 1000) AS big_zoneid, os_type, channel, LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point, CAST(`time` AS STRING) AS `time`, fake_ai, usercreateymd, client_ip, logymd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), t_exclude /* ) b */ /* ON      a.roleid = b.accountid */ AS (/*  LEFT JOIN */ /*     ( */ /* 剔除异常账号的创角 */ SELECT accountid /* 异常账号 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_abnormal_account_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-10-20', '2025-10-20', '2026-05-31') AND create_date <= '2026-05-31') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_decismart_realtime_login_detail PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT t_login.roleid, t_login.zoneid, t_login.big_zoneid, t_basic.first_mt_country AS country /* case when t_login.os_type in (1,2,3) then  os_type else -99999 end AS   os , */ /* case when nvl(trim(t_login.channel),'') in ('', '-') then 'unknown' else t_login.channel end as channel, */, CASE WHEN t_login.os_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS os, CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(t_login.channel), '') IN ('', '-') THEN 'unknown' ELSE t_login.channel END AS channel, t_login.point, t_login.`time`, t_login.fake_ai, t_login.usercreateymd, t_login.client_ip FROM t_login JOIN t_basic ON t_login.roleid = t_basic.roleid LEFT JOIN t_exclude ON t_login.roleid = t_exclude.accountid /* 剔除黑产 */ WHERE t_exclude.accountid IS NULL

name: 罐子信息整理
sql_units: /* 配置一个非分区临时表，储存年龄信息，包含填写问卷日期 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.yudongzhang_guanzi_gt2_combine_with_recycling_date SELECT tt.roleid, tt.zoneid, gender, birthday, age, CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN '[7,9]' WHEN age BETWEEN 10 AND 14 THEN '[10,14]' WHEN age BETWEEN 15 AND 19 THEN '[15,19]' WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN '[20,24]' WHEN age BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN '[25,29]' WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN '[30,34]' WHEN age >= 35 THEN '[35,)' END AS age_group, occupation, recycling_date, first_mt_country, register_date FROM (SELECT t1.logymd, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.gender /* 性别 */, t1.birthday /* 生日 */, ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', t1.birthday_new) / 365, 0) AS age /* 生日折算年龄（不可直接用logymd，因logymd为写死的日期，凡小于写死日期的都一样） */, t1.occupation /* 职业 */, t1.gt1, t1.gt2, recycling_date FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, gender, birthday, gt1, gt2, CASE WHEN birthday IN ('2015+', '1980-') THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(birthday, 1, 4), '-', '01', '-', '01') ELSE birthday END AS birthday_new, occupation, recycling_date FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.logymd, b.logymd) AS logymd, COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(a.gt1, 0) AS gt1 /* 是否是高准低覆（1-是，0-否） */, COALESCE(b.gt2, 0) AS gt2 /* 是否是中准中覆（1-是，0-否） */, COALESCE(a.gender, b.gender) AS gender, COALESCE(a.birthday, b.birthday) AS birthday /* a表有96%是b表的子集，故优先取a表的字段 */, COALESCE(a.occupation, 0) AS occupation, COALESCE(a.recycling_date, b.recycling_date) AS recycling_date /* 回收日期 */ FROM (/* 2305150009问卷 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, 1 AS gt1, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer14, '$.2305150009') AS gender /* 性别 */, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer71, '$.2305150009') AS birthday /* 生日 */, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer16, '$.2305150009') AS occupation /* 职业 */, SUBSTRING(GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2305150009'), 1, 10) AS recycling_date /* 回收日期 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_act_survey_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-10-29', '2024-10-29', '2026-05-31') AND NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2305150009') IS NULL AND age_cross_validation = 1 /* 生日年月与年龄段验证通过 */ AND zodiac_cross_validation = 1 /* 生日年月日与年龄段验证通过 */ AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer358, '$.2305150009') = '是' /* 甄别题答对 */ AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(finish_time, '$.2305150009') >= 10 /* 答题时间超过10s */) AS a /* gt2 */ FULL OUTER JOIN (/* 2305150009问卷 */ SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, 1 AS gt2, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer14, '$.2305150009') AS gender, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer71, '$.2305150009') AS birthday, SUBSTRING(GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2305150009'), 1, 10) AS recycling_date /* 回收日期 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_act_survey_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-10-29', '2024-10-29', '2026-05-31') AND NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2305150009') IS NULL AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer358, '$.2305150009') = '是' AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(finish_time, '$.2305150009') >= 10 AND (total_recycling_cnt = female_q14_cnt OR female_q14_cnt = 0) UNION ALL SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, 1 AS gt2, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer14, '$.2302120004') AS gender, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer71, '$.2302120004') AS birthday, SUBSTRING(GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2302120004'), 1, 10) AS recycling_date /* 回收日期 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_act_survey_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-10-29', '2024-10-29', '2026-05-31') AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2305150009') IS NULL AND NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2302120004') IS NULL AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer246, '$.2302120004') = 3 AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(finish_time, '$.2302120004') >= 20 AND (total_recycling_cnt = female_q14_cnt OR female_q14_cnt = 0) UNION ALL SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, 1 AS gt2, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer14, '$.2205230026') AS gender, GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer71, '$.2205230026') AS birthday, SUBSTRING(GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2205230026'), 1, 10) AS recycling_date /* 回收日期 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_act_survey_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' < '2024-10-29', '2024-10-29', '2026-05-31') AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2305150009') IS NULL AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2302120004') IS NULL AND NOT GET_JSON_OBJECT(recycling_time, '$.2205230026') IS NULL AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(answer246, '$.2205230026') = 3 AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(finish_time, '$.2205230026') >= 20 AND (total_recycling_cnt = female_q14_cnt OR female_q14_cnt = 0)) AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd AND a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY COALESCE(a.logymd, b.logymd), COALESCE(a.roleid, b.roleid), COALESCE(a.zoneid, b.zoneid), COALESCE(a.gt1, 0), COALESCE(b.gt2, 0), COALESCE(a.gender, b.gender), COALESCE(a.birthday, b.birthday), COALESCE(a.occupation, 0), COALESCE(a.recycling_date, b.recycling_date) /* 回收日期 */) AS t) AS t1 /* 问卷活动表 */ GROUP BY t1.logymd, t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.gender /* 性别 */, t1.birthday /* 生日 */, age /* 生日折算年龄 */, t1.occupation /* 职业 */, t1.gt1, t1.gt2, recycling_date) AS tt JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) AS b ON tt.roleid = b.roleid AND tt.zoneid = b.zoneid WHERE age > 6 /* 6岁及以下用户占比异常高（gt2），故排除 */ AND gt2 = 1

name: AOZ新战斗表
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: parkerchen@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-19 21:42:37.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE nova2_temp.aoz_challenge_register7days_new_info PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT `time`, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, login_channel, createrole_country, chargecou, activedays, war_stage, total_payment, level, fight_uid, stage_id, power, stage_type, is_first_challenge, f_time, f_roleid, ispass, cost_time, is_first, star, stagesubtype FROM (SELECT logymd, `time`, roleid, zoneid, usercreateymd, login_channel, createrole_country, chargecou, activedays, war_stage, total_payment, level, fight_uid, stage_id, power, stage_type, stagesubtype, is_first_challenge FROM aoz_ods.start_challenge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT `time` AS f_time, roleid AS f_roleid, zoneid AS f_zoneid, fight_uid AS f_uid, stage_id AS f_stage, logymd AS f_logymd, ispass, cost_time, is_first, star FROM aoz_ods.finish_challenge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS b ON a.roleid = b.f_roleid AND a.zoneid = b.f_zoneid AND a.fight_uid = b.f_uid AND b.f_logymd = a.logymd

name: mc创角商业化活动点击
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_lhyan@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-20 14:31:32.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH current_activity /* ML染色活动配置表 */ AS (SELECT activity_id, start_date, end_date, CAST(p AS INT) AS param FROM mcgg_temp.susu_activitybolocksystem_mltomc_larksheet_df AS t0 LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(SPLIT(param, ',')) lv AS p WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), ml_dye AS (/* 过去 7 天商业活动点击的染色行为 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31' AND flag = '商业活动点击', 1, 0)) AS active_activity_today, MAX(IF(flag = '商业活动点击', 1, 0)) AS active_activity_7d, MIN(logymd) AS first_dye_date, MAX(logymd) AS last_dye_date FROM (/* --商业活动点击 */ SELECT t0.logymd, accountid AS roleid, zoneid, '商业活动点击' AS flag FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_activityblocksystem_click AS t0 JOIN current_activity AS t1 ON CAST(t0.activity_id AS STRING) = CAST(t1.activity_id AS STRING) AND t0.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND /* param 为空=全量/param 不为空=仅保留命中的参数 */ (t1.param IS NULL OR TRIM(t1.param) = '' OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT(t1.param, ','), CAST(t1.param AS STRING))) WHERE t0.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 6 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND click_event = 1 AND zoneid < 57000) AS t GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.yanlh_mcgg_newplayer_active_activity PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.update_ml_roleid, COALESCE(m.active_activity_today, 0) AS in_active354_today, COALESCE(m.active_activity_7d, 0) AS in354_active_7d, first_dye_date, last_dye_date FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, update_ml_roleid FROM mcgg_temp.aprilgao_mc_ml_roleid_match WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND usercreateymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, update_ml_roleid) AS a LEFT JOIN ml_dye AS m ON a.update_ml_roleid = m.roleid

name: adbi_dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di
sql_units: WITH event_log AS (SELECT `event`, event_time, event_uuid, client_ip, server_time, event_source, app_name, package_name, role_id, zone_id, account_id, `level`, user_create_time, current_diamond, store, product_id, sub_product_id, flow_id, order_id, add_time, verify_time, deliver_time, verify_retries, deliver_retries, receipt_type, price, currency, local_price, is_subscription, start_time, expire_time, step, queue_id, result_code, result_message, pay_channel, pay_channel_sub, purchase_type, environment, os, os_version, idfa, idfv, android_id, imei, build_serial, mac, gps_adid, gps_asid, oaid, model, client_version, did, logymd, `hour`, app_id, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_uuid, order_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) AS row_num FROM msdk_ods.msdk_charge AS mc LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id AS black_id FROM adbi.timezone_appid_blacklist WHERE NOT app_id IN ('4510', '4500', '4530')) AS blk ON mc.app_id = blk.black_id WHERE ((logymd = '20260530' AND `hour` >= '23') OR (logymd = '20260531') OR (logymd = '20260601' AND `hour` <= '02')) AND DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8')) = DATE('2026-05-31') AND (NOT `event` IS NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(`event`)) > 1) /* event不需要为空字符或为空, 理论上在msdk上报的时候控制好了的 */ AND NOT event_source IS NULL /* --事件上报来源, NULL默认为未知上报 */ AND blk.black_id IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT `event`, event_time, event_uuid, COALESCE(client_ip, 'unknown') AS client_ip, COALESCE(IF(TRIM((GEOIP(client_ip, 1))) = '-', NULL, LOWER(GEOIP(client_ip, 1))), 'unknown') AS ip_country, COALESCE(server_time, 0) AS server_time, COALESCE(event_source, 'unknown') AS event_source, COALESCE(app_name, 'unknown') AS app_name, COALESCE(package_name, 'unknown') AS package_name, CAST(role_id AS STRING) AS role_id, CAST(zone_id AS STRING) AS zone_id, CAST(account_id AS STRING) AS account_id, COALESCE(`level`, 0), COALESCE(user_create_time, 0) AS user_create_time, COALESCE(current_diamond, 0) AS current_diamond, COALESCE(store, 'unknown') AS store, COALESCE(product_id, 'unknown') AS product_id, COALESCE(sub_product_id, 'unknown'), COALESCE(flow_id, 'unknown'), COALESCE(order_id, 'unknown'), COALESCE(add_time, 0) AS add_time, COALESCE(verify_time, 0) AS verify_time, COALESCE(deliver_time, 0) AS deliver_time, COALESCE(verify_retries, 0) AS verify_retries, COALESCE(deliver_retries, 0) AS deliver_retries, COALESCE(receipt_type, 0) AS receipt_type, COALESCE(price, 0) AS price, currency, COALESCE(local_price, '0') AS local_price, COALESCE(is_subscription, 0) AS is_subscription, COALESCE(start_time, 0) AS start_time, COALESCE(expire_time, 0) AS expire_time, COALESCE(step, 'unknown') AS step, COALESCE(queue_id, -99999) AS queue_id, COALESCE(result_code, -99999) AS result_code, COALESCE(result_message, 'unknown') AS result_message, COALESCE(LOWER(pay_channel), 'unknown') AS pay_channel, COALESCE(LOWER(pay_channel_sub), 'unknown') AS pay_channel_sub, COALESCE(purchase_type, 'unknown') AS purchase_type, COALESCE(environment, 'unknown') AS environment, COALESCE(LOWER(os), 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(os_version, 'unknown') AS os_version, COALESCE(idfa, 'unknown') AS idfa, COALESCE(idfv, 'unknown') AS idfv, COALESCE(android_id, 'unknown') AS android_id, COALESCE(imei, 'unknown') AS imei, COALESCE(build_serial, 'unknown') AS build_serial, COALESCE(mac, 'unknown') AS mac, COALESCE(gps_adid, 'unknown') AS gps_adid, COALESCE(gps_asid, 'unknown') AS gps_asid, COALESCE(oaid, 'unknown') AS oaid, COALESCE(model, 'unknown') AS model, COALESCE(client_version, 'unknown') AS client_version, COALESCE(did, 'unknown') AS did, stage_id, app_id FROM event_log WHERE row_num = 1 DISTRIBUTE BY RAND()

name: 竞技场周战斗数据（结算段位）
output_hint: 竞技场周战斗数据（结算段位）
sql_units: WITH crossserver_basic_pvp_match AS (SELECT time, player_uid, zone_id, logymd, score FROM zgame_damai_ods.crossserver_basic_pvp_match WHERE (logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31') AND (((zone_id = 1 OR zone_id BETWEEN 19001 AND 69999) AND logymd <= '2026-01-20') OR zone_id >= 70001) UNION ALL SELECT CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.time') AS TIMESTAMP) AS time, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.player_uid') AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) AS player_uid, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.zone_id') AS BIGINT) AS zone_id, GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.logymd') AS logymd, CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.score') AS BIGINT) AS score FROM zgame_dwd.dwd_zgame_events_di WHERE (logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31') AND logymd >= '2026-01-21' AND event = 'crossserver_basic_pvp_match' AND (CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.zone_id') AS BIGINT) = 1 OR CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(params, '$.zone_id') AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 19001 AND 69999)), env_schedule /* 每天的环境排期 */ AS (SELECT logymd, MAX_BY(stage_type, cnt) AS stage_type FROM (SELECT logymd, stage_id % 10 AS stage_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM zgame_dwd.crossserver_basic_pvp_fight WHERE (logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31') AND (zone_id = 1 OR zone_id >= 19001) AND (FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 6001) GROUP BY logymd, stage_type) AS a GROUP BY logymd), update_info /* 每人在每个环境的刷新次数信息 */ AS (SELECT a.player_uid, a.zone_id, b.stage_type, SUM(a.update_cnt) AS update_cnt FROM (SELECT player_uid, zone_id, logymd, COUNT(*) AS update_cnt FROM crossserver_basic_pvp_match GROUP BY player_uid, zone_id, logymd) AS a JOIN env_schedule AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd GROUP BY a.player_uid, a.zone_id, b.stage_type), buy_ticket /* 每人在每个环境的购票次数 */ AS (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.stage_type, SUM(add_num) AS add_num FROM (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, SUM(add_num) AS add_num FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_add_item WHERE (logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31') AND (zoneid = 1 OR zoneid >= 19001) AND item_id = 14 AND op = 'BuyBasicPvpTicket' GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS a JOIN env_schedule AS b ON a.logymd = b.logymd GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, b.stage_type), final_tier_info /* 每人的结算段位 */ AS (SELECT 1 AS col, player_uid, zone_id, CASE WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999 THEN '正式服' WHEN zone_id >= 70001 THEN '亚太服' ELSE '先锋服' END AS zonetype, region_id, CASE WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 900 AND 909 THEN 1 WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 910 AND 929 THEN 2 WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 930 AND 959 THEN 3 WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 960 AND 999 THEN 4 WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 1000 AND 1049 THEN 5 WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 1050 AND 1109 THEN 6 WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 1110 AND 1189 THEN 7 WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 1190 AND 1289 THEN 8 WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 1290 AND 1409 THEN 9 WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 1410 AND 1559 THEN 10 WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 1560 AND 1739 THEN 11 WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 1740 AND 1949 THEN 12 WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 1950 AND 2099 THEN 13 WHEN MAX_BY(cur_score, time) BETWEEN 2100 AND 9999 THEN 14 END AS final_tier FROM zgame_dwd.crossserver_basic_pvp_fight WHERE (logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31') AND (zone_id = 1 OR zone_id >= 19001) GROUP BY player_uid, zone_id, zonetype, region_id), pvp_fight /* 每人的战斗明细数据 */ AS (SELECT player_uid, zone_id, stage_id % 10 AS stage_type, is_human, is_initiative, CASE WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.4 THEN '40~%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.35 THEN '35~40%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.30 THEN '30~35%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.25 THEN '25~30%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.20 THEN '20~25%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.15 THEN '15~20%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.10 THEN '10~15%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.05 THEN '05~10%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.00 THEN '00~05%' ELSE NULL END AS power_diff_group, IF(auto_fight_type IS NULL, auto_mode, auto_fight_type) AS auto_type, player_rank, SUM(opponent_power) AS total_opponent_power, COUNT(*) AS fight_cnt FROM (SELECT *, ABS((opponent_power - team_power) / opponent_power) AS power_diff_rate FROM zgame_dwd.crossserver_basic_pvp_fight WHERE (logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31') AND (FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 6001) AND (zone_id = 1 OR zone_id >= 19001)) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT fight_uid, auto_mode FROM zgame_damai_ods.reportserver_fight WHERE (logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31') AND (FLOOR(copy_id / 1000) = 6001) AND (zoneid = 1 OR zoneid >= 19001)) AS b ON a.fight_uid = b.fight_uid GROUP BY player_uid, zone_id, stage_type, is_human, is_initiative, power_diff_group, auto_type, player_rank), index_struct /* 表索引结构 */ AS (SELECT zonetype, region_id, final_tier, num, stage_type, is_human, is_initiative, power_diff_group, player_rank, auto_type FROM (SELECT 1 AS col, zonetype, region_id, final_tier, COUNT(*) AS num FROM final_tier_info GROUP BY zonetype, region_id, final_tier) AS a JOIN (SELECT 1 AS col, stage_type, is_human, is_initiative, power_diff_group, player_rank, auto_type FROM pvp_fight GROUP BY stage_type, is_human, is_initiative, power_diff_group, player_rank, auto_type) AS b ON a.col = b.col) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE zg_temp.pvp_weekly_settlement PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT '2026-05-25' AS start_date, '2026-05-31' AS end_date, m.zonetype, m.region_id, m.final_tier, m.num, m.stage_type, m.is_human, m.is_initiative, m.power_diff_group, m.player_rank, m.auto_type, n.total_update_cnt, o.total_ticket_add_num, p.total_opponent_power, p.fight_cnt FROM index_struct AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT zonetype, region_id, final_tier, stage_type, SUM(update_cnt) AS total_update_cnt FROM final_tier_info AS a JOIN update_info AS b ON a.player_uid = b.player_uid AND a.zone_id = b.zone_id GROUP BY zonetype, region_id, final_tier, stage_type) AS n ON (m.zonetype = n.zonetype AND m.region_id = n.region_id AND m.final_tier = n.final_tier AND m.stage_type = n.stage_type) LEFT JOIN (SELECT zonetype, region_id, final_tier, stage_type, SUM(add_num) AS total_ticket_add_num FROM final_tier_info AS a JOIN buy_ticket AS b ON a.player_uid = b.roleid AND a.zone_id = b.zoneid GROUP BY zonetype, region_id, final_tier, stage_type) AS o ON (m.zonetype = o.zonetype AND m.region_id = o.region_id AND m.final_tier = o.final_tier AND m.stage_type = o.stage_type) LEFT JOIN (SELECT zonetype, region_id, final_tier, stage_type, is_human, is_initiative, power_diff_group, player_rank, auto_type, SUM(total_opponent_power) AS total_opponent_power, SUM(fight_cnt) AS fight_cnt FROM pvp_fight AS a JOIN final_tier_info AS b ON a.player_uid = b.player_uid AND a.zone_id = b.zone_id GROUP BY zonetype, region_id, final_tier, stage_type, is_human, is_initiative, power_diff_group, player_rank, auto_type) AS p ON (m.zonetype = p.zonetype AND m.region_id = p.region_id AND m.final_tier = p.final_tier AND m.stage_type = p.stage_type AND m.is_human = p.is_human AND m.is_initiative = p.is_initiative AND m.power_diff_group = p.power_diff_group AND m.player_rank = p.player_rank AND m.auto_type = p.auto_type)

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_mlbb_shop_buy_role_zone_v2_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_shop_buy_role_zone_v2_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.shopid AS shop_id, a.itemid AS item_id, a.giftid AS gift_id, COUNT(*) AS buy_cnt, SUM(a.itemnum) AS item_num, SUM(a.moneynum) AS money_num, SUM(IF(a.moneytype = 301, a.moneynum, 0)) AS sub_diamond_num, a.moneytype, a.buysource, CASE WHEN NOT a.discouponid IS NULL AND a.discouponid <> 0 AND fd.fake_diamond_id IS NULL THEN a.discouponid ELSE NULL END AS coupons_id, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT a.discouponid IS NULL AND a.discouponid <> 0 AND fd.fake_diamond_id IS NULL THEN a.discoupon_num ELSE 0 END) AS coupons_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT fd.fake_diamond_id IS NULL THEN a.discoupon_num ELSE 0 END) AS fake_diamond_cnt, b.item_type AS item_category, CAST(h.collect_quality AS INT) AS skin_quality, CASE CAST(h.collect_quality AS INT) WHEN 0 THEN '默认' WHEN 1 THEN '精英' WHEN 2 THEN '活动限定' WHEN 3 THEN '史诗' WHEN 4 THEN '传说' WHEN 5 THEN 'IP联动' WHEN 6 THEN '神话' ELSE NULL END AS skin_quality_name, d.first_mt_country, c.country_name, COALESCE(r.r_level, '非付费') AS r_level FROM ml_ods.gameserver_shop_buy AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS d ON a.roleid = d.roleid AND a.zoneid = d.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT country_code, country_name FROM (SELECT LOWER(country_code) AS country_code, country_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(country_code) ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS c ON LOWER(d.first_mt_country) = c.country_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, r_level FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_rlevel_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS r ON a.roleid = r.roleid LEFT JOIN (SELECT item_id, item_type FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.itemid = b.item_id LEFT JOIN (/* type=0 主皮肤 + type=1 染色皮变体（195条）均有有效 collect_quality；MAX 去重防 fan-out */ SELECT CAST(id AS BIGINT) AS skin_id, MAX(CAST(collect_quality AS INT)) AS collect_quality FROM mizar_temp.dim_herocostume_df_v2 WHERE CAST(type AS STRING) IN ('0', '1') GROUP BY CAST(id AS BIGINT)) AS h ON a.itemid = h.skin_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT item_id AS fake_diamond_id FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND item_type = 46) AS fd ON a.discouponid = fd.fake_diamond_id WHERE a.logymd = '2026-05-31' AND a.zoneid < 57000 AND NOT a.buysource IN (0, 56) AND (a.itemid <> 0 OR a.giftid <> 0) GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.shopid, a.itemid, a.giftid, a.moneytype, a.buysource, CASE WHEN NOT a.discouponid IS NULL AND a.discouponid <> 0 AND fd.fake_diamond_id IS NULL THEN a.discouponid ELSE NULL END /* coupons_id（粒度键） */, b.item_type /* 以下为函数依赖属性，GROUP BY 仅为 SQL 语法要求 */, h.collect_quality, d.first_mt_country /* fd.fake_diamond_id 已移除（隐式粒度分裂，fake_diamond_cnt SUM 已正确） */, c.country_name, r.r_level

sql_units: WITH events AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, 'ENTER' AS action_type, uitype, CAST(TRIM(s) AS BIGINT) AS shop_id FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_act_shopcommond LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(param, ',')) t AS s WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND type = 1 AND param <> '' UNION ALL SELECT accountid, zoneid, 'CLICK' AS action_type, uitype, CAST(param AS BIGINT) FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_act_shopcommond WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND type = 2 AND param <> '' UNION ALL SELECT accountid, zoneid, 'BANNER_VIEW' AS action_type, uitype, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_act_shopcommond WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND type = 3 UNION ALL SELECT accountid, zoneid, 'BANNER_CLICK' AS action_type, uitype, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_act_shopcommond WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND type = 4) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_shop_recommend_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT e.accountid, e.zoneid, e.action_type, e.uitype, e.shop_id, d.first_mt_country, c.country_name, COALESCE(r.r_level, '非付费') AS r_level FROM events AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS d ON e.accountid = d.roleid AND e.zoneid = d.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT country_code, country_name FROM (SELECT LOWER(country_code) AS country_code, country_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(country_code) ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS c ON LOWER(d.first_mt_country) = c.country_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, r_level FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_rlevel_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS r ON e.accountid = r.roleid

name: adbi_dwm_active_device_tz_di_msdk
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: carldong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-19 14:34:51.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adbi.dwm_active_device_tz_di ( */ /*             did STRING COMMENT '设备指纹,key', */ /*             login_cnt array<int> COMMENT '登录次数', */ /*             online_time array<int> COMMENT '在线时长', */ /*             day_first_login_time array<STRING> COMMENT '当天首次活跃时间, 格式： yyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', */ /*             stage_id STRING COMMENT 'stage_id' */ /*         ) COMMENT '设备活跃增量表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     logymd string comment '日期分区yyyy-MM-dd', */ /*     app_id string comment '应用唯一id' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/advertisement_bi/adbi/dwm_active_device_tz_di' */ WITH evt_log AS (SELECT did, app_id, stage_id, ARRAY(MIN(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')), MIN(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+0'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')), MIN(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')), MIN(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+9'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) AS first_event_time, ARRAY(MAX(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') <> '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))), MAX(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+0'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') <> '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+0'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))), MAX(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') <> '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))), MAX(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+9'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') <> '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+9'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')))) AS p_date_event_date, ARRAY(MIN(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') <> '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT-8'), 'HH'))), MIN(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+0'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') <> '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+0'), 'HH'))), MIN(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') <> '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+8'), 'HH'))), MIN(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+9'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') <> '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+9'), 'HH')))) AS p_date_event_hour, ARRAY(MAX(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')), MAX(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+0'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') > '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+0'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))), MAX(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') > '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))), MAX(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+9'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') > '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+9'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')))) AS last_event_time FROM (SELECT package_name, did, os, is_emulator, os_version, system_language AS os_language, account_id, role_id, zone_id, event_time / 1000 AS event_time, client_ip, model, network_type, system_language, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, IF(event = 'logout', level, -99999) AS level, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, app_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id AS black_id FROM adbi.timezone_appid_blacklist WHERE NOT app_id IN ('4510', '4500', '4530')) AS blk ON a.app_id = blk.black_id WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND `event` IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'login', 'logout') AND blk.black_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT package_name, did, os, 0 AS is_emulator, os_version, 'unknown' AS os_language, account_id, role_id, zone_id, event_time / 1000 AS event_time, client_ip, model, 'unknown' AS network_type, 'unknown' AS system_language, ip_country, client_version, 'unknown' AS sdk_version, -99999 AS level, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, app_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id AS black_id FROM adbi.timezone_appid_blacklist WHERE NOT app_id IN ('4510', '4500', '4530')) AS blk ON a.app_id = blk.black_id WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND event IN ('purchase_event') AND blk.black_id IS NULL) AS a GROUP BY did, app_id, stage_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwm_active_device_tz_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT event_log.did AS did, COALESCE(login_cnt.login_cnt, ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0)), COALESCE(ol_time.online_time, ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0)), COALESCE(day_first_login_time, ARRAY('1970-01-01', '1970-01-01', '1970-01-01', '1970-01-01')), event_log.stage_id AS stage_id, COALESCE(p_date_event_hour, ARRAY('0', '0', '0', '0')), p_date_event_date, event_log.app_id AS app_id FROM (SELECT did, stage_id, first_event_time AS day_first_login_time, p_date_event_hour, p_date_event_date, app_id FROM evt_log) AS event_log LEFT JOIN (SELECT m__app_id AS app_id, did AS did, '01' AS stage_id, ARRAY(SUM(IF(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(time, 0, 19)) = '2026-05-31', online_time, 0)), SUM(IF(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(time, 0, 19) + INTERVAL '8' HOUR) = '2026-05-31', online_time, 0)), SUM(IF(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(time, 0, 19) + INTERVAL '16' HOUR) = '2026-05-31', online_time, 0)), SUM(IF(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(time, 0, 19) + INTERVAL '17' HOUR) = '2026-05-31', online_time, 0))) AS online_time FROM wefly_ob_ods.logout AS a WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND zoneid > 9999 AND logymd >= '2025-08-26' GROUP BY m__app_id, did) AS ol_time ON event_log.app_id = ol_time.app_id AND /* AND     event_log.package_name = ol_time.package_name */ event_log.did = ol_time.did AND event_log.stage_id = ol_time.stage_id /* AND     event_log.os = ol_time.os */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id AS app_id, stage_id, did AS did, ARRAY(COUNT(IF(last_event_time[0] = '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)), COUNT(IF(last_event_time[1] = '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)), COUNT(IF(last_event_time[2] = '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)), COUNT(IF(last_event_time[3] = '2026-05-31', 1, NULL))) AS login_cnt /* , array( COUNT(if(TO_DATE(substr(time,0,19)) = '2026-06-01' , 1 , null)) */ /* , COUNT(if(TO_DATE(substr(time,0,19) + INTERVAL '8' HOUR) = '2026-06-01' , 1 , null)) */ /* , COUNT(if(TO_DATE(substr(time,0,19) + INTERVAL '16' HOUR) = '2026-06-01' , 1 , null)) */ /* , COUNT(if(TO_DATE(substr(time,0,19) + INTERVAL '17' HOUR) = '2026-06-01' , 1 , null)) */ /* ) login_cnt */ FROM evt_log AS a GROUP BY app_id, stage_id, did) AS login_cnt ON event_log.app_id = login_cnt.app_id AND event_log.did = login_cnt.did AND event_log.stage_id = login_cnt.stage_id WHERE event_log.app_id <> 4310

name: dim_basic_device_tz_di_msdk

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: crystalmei@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-21 16:42:21.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* formal: MLBB 宽松假量用户数 / 新增用户数 / 假量占比 */ /* 参数说明： */ /* ${fake_logymd}       = ml_temp.mc_fake_quantity_users_total_06 最新 logymd 分区 */ /* ${role_snapshot_dt} = mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df 最新单日快照分区 */ /* ${start_date}       = 统计起始日期，如 '2026-05-01' */ WITH fake_base AS (SELECT statdate, UPPER(first_mt_country) AS country, COALESCE(first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, roleid AS roleid, zoneid AS zoneid FROM ml_temp.mc_fake_quantity_users_total_06 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), latest_stat AS (/* 假量表一个分区是全量数据，因此最新分区内 max(statdate) 即最新业务日期 */ SELECT MAX(statdate) AS latest_statdate FROM fake_base), fake_daily AS (SELECT statdate, country, first_network_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(roleid, '_', zoneid)) AS fake_user_cnt FROM fake_base GROUP BY statdate, country, first_network_name), new_daily AS (SELECT r.register_date AS statdate, UPPER(r.first_mt_country) AS country, COALESCE(r.first_network_name, 'unknown') AS first_network_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(CAST(r.roleid AS STRING), '_', CAST(r.zoneid AS STRING))) AS new_user_cnt FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS r CROSS JOIN latest_stat AS d WHERE r.logymd = '2026-05-30' AND r.appid = 'mlbb' AND r.is_ai = 0 AND r.zoneid < 57000 AND r.is_first_create = 1 AND r.register_date >= DATE_ADD(d.latest_statdate, 2 * -1) AND r.register_date <= d.latest_statdate GROUP BY r.register_date, UPPER(r.first_mt_country), COALESCE(r.first_network_name, 'unknown')) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.mc_fake_quantity_users_rate_06_v1 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT n.statdate, n.country, n.first_network_name, n.new_user_cnt, COALESCE(f.fake_user_cnt, 0) AS fake_user_cnt, ROUND(COALESCE(f.fake_user_cnt, 0) * 1.0000 / NULLIF(n.new_user_cnt, 0), 4) AS fake_user_rate FROM new_daily AS n LEFT JOIN fake_daily AS f ON n.statdate = f.statdate AND n.country = f.country AND n.first_network_name = f.first_network_name ORDER BY n.statdate, n.country, n.first_network_name

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: crystalmei@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-21 20:03:26.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH max_statdate AS (SELECT MAX(statdate) AS max_statdate FROM ml_temp.mc_fake_quantity_users_rate_06_v1 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), n AS (SELECT t.* FROM ml_temp.mc_fake_quantity_users_rate_06_v1 AS t JOIN max_statdate AS m ON t.statdate = m.max_statdate WHERE t.logymd = '2026-05-30'), f AS (SELECT t.* FROM ml_temp.mc_fake_quantity_users_rate_06_v1 AS t JOIN max_statdate AS m ON t.statdate = DATE_ADD(m.max_statdate, 1 * -1) WHERE t.logymd = '2026-05-30') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.mc_fake_quantity_users_rate_06_v2 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT n.statdate, n.country, n.first_network_name, n.new_user_cnt, n.fake_user_cnt, n.fake_user_rate, ROUND(n.fake_user_rate / f.fake_user_rate, 4) AS fake_user_rate_with_previous FROM n LEFT JOIN f ON DATE_ADD(n.statdate, 1 * -1) = f.statdate AND n.country = f.country AND n.first_network_name = f.first_network_name ORDER BY n.statdate, n.country, n.first_network_name

name: 分存钻分位数的充值耗钻存钻数据
output_hint: 分存钻分位数的充值耗钻存钻数据
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: leolv1@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-25 12:08:18.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* ============================================================================ */ /* 2026-04 活跃玩家 × 历史档位 × 存钻分位桶（4 桶）+ 钻石获取/充值性价比 */ /* 新增列： */ /*   add_total / add_avg_per_user：当月获取钻石总数 / 人均获取钻石（含充值送+活动+任务+系统赠送） */ /*   diamond_per_usd：获取钻石总数 / 充值金额(USD) — "每 1 美金获得的钻石量" */ /* ============================================================================ */ WITH month_active_tier AS (SELECT CAST(roleid AS STRING) AS roleid, CAST(zoneid AS STRING) AS zoneid, CASE WHEN COALESCE(max_fenceng_before, -1) = -1 THEN '0_未付费' WHEN COALESCE(max_fenceng_before, -1) = 0 THEN '1_0.01美金' WHEN COALESCE(max_fenceng_before, -1) = 1 THEN '2_1美金' WHEN COALESCE(max_fenceng_before, -1) = 2 THEN '3_2美金' WHEN COALESCE(max_fenceng_before, -1) = 5 THEN '4_5美金' WHEN COALESCE(max_fenceng_before, -1) = 10 THEN '5_10美金' WHEN COALESCE(max_fenceng_before, -1) = 20 THEN '6_20美金' WHEN COALESCE(max_fenceng_before, -1) = 50 THEN '7_50美金' ELSE '8_其他(100+)' END AS pay_tier FROM ml_temp.leolv_mau_pay_break_mi WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000), first_login_diamond AS (SELECT CAST(roleid AS STRING) AS roleid, CAST(zoneid AS STRING) AS zoneid, curdiamond AS first_login_diamond FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, curdiamond, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY logymd ASC, time ASC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_login WHERE logymd >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), '-01') AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) AS t WHERE rn = 1), month_charge AS (SELECT CAST(roleid AS STRING) AS roleid, CAST(zoneid AS STRING) AS zoneid, SUM(money) / 100.0 AS charge_amt_usd FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), '-01') AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') AND NOT money IN (0) AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), month_add /* 当月获取钻石（全来源：充值送 + 系统赠送 + 活动 + 任务，排 GM） */ AS (SELECT CAST(roleid AS STRING) AS roleid, CAST(zoneid AS STRING) AS zoneid, SUM(add_num) AS add_amt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_diamond WHERE logymd >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), '-01') AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND operate <> 'gm' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), month_consume AS (SELECT CAST(roleid AS STRING) AS roleid, CAST(zoneid AS STRING) AS zoneid, SUM(sub_num) AS consume_amt FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE logymd >= CONCAT(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7), '-01') AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND operate <> 'gm' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), user_wide AS (SELECT a.pay_tier, a.roleid, a.zoneid, COALESCE(fld.first_login_diamond, 0) AS first_login_diamond, COALESCE(c.charge_amt_usd, 0) AS charge_amt_usd, IF(NOT c.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS has_charge, COALESCE(ad.add_amt, 0) AS add_amt, IF(NOT ad.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS has_add, COALESCE(s.consume_amt, 0) AS consume_amt, IF(NOT s.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS has_consume FROM month_active_tier AS a LEFT JOIN first_login_diamond AS fld ON a.roleid = fld.roleid AND a.zoneid = fld.zoneid LEFT JOIN month_charge AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN month_add AS ad ON a.roleid = ad.roleid AND a.zoneid = ad.zoneid LEFT JOIN month_consume AS s ON a.roleid = s.roleid AND a.zoneid = s.zoneid), tier_thresholds AS (SELECT pay_tier, PERCENTILE_APPROX(first_login_diamond, 0.5) AS p50, PERCENTILE_APPROX(first_login_diamond, 0.9) AS p90, PERCENTILE_APPROX(first_login_diamond, 0.95) AS p95 FROM user_wide GROUP BY pay_tier), user_bucketed AS (SELECT u.*, CASE WHEN u.first_login_diamond <= t.p50 THEN '1_bottom_50%' WHEN u.first_login_diamond <= t.p90 THEN '2_(50%, 90%]' WHEN u.first_login_diamond <= t.p95 THEN '3_top_10_5%' ELSE '4_top_5%' END AS diamond_bucket FROM user_wide AS u LEFT JOIN tier_thresholds AS t ON u.pay_tier = t.pay_tier) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.leolv_diamond_bucket_charge_diamond_cost_mi PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT pay_tier, diamond_bucket, COUNT(*) AS active_users /* 活跃 + 首登存钻 */, ROUND(AVG(first_login_diamond), 0) AS avg_first_login_diamond, SUM(has_charge) AS charge_users /* 充值 */, ROUND(SUM(has_charge) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS charge_rate, ROUND(SUM(charge_amt_usd), 2) AS charge_total_usd, ROUND(SUM(charge_amt_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(has_charge), 0), 2) AS charge_avg_per_user_usd, SUM(add_amt) AS add_total /* 钻石获取（全来源） */, ROUND(SUM(add_amt) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(has_add), 0), 0) AS add_avg_per_user, ROUND(SUM(add_amt) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(charge_amt_usd), 0), 2) AS diamond_per_usd /* 1 美金获得的钻石量（钻/充值金额；含充值送+活动+任务的所有钻石） */, SUM(has_consume) AS consume_users /* 耗钻 */, ROUND(SUM(has_consume) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS consume_rate, SUM(consume_amt) AS consume_total, ROUND(SUM(consume_amt) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(has_consume), 0), 0) AS consume_avg_per_user FROM user_bucketed GROUP BY pay_tier, diamond_bucket ORDER BY pay_tier, diamond_bucket

sql_units: /* -- init */ /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_dim`.`dim_decismart_realtime_monitor_battle_group_config_df` PARTITION (logymd='2026-05-22') */ /* select / *+ repartition(1) * / */ /*     distinct nvl(BIGINT(floor(battleserid/1000)), -99999) as battle_group */ /* from ml_ods.connserver_client_battle_reconnect */ /* where logymd between '2022-01-01' and  '2026-05-22' */ /* ; */ /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_dim`.`dim_decismart_realtime_monitor_battle_group_config_df` PARTITION (logymd='2026-05-22') */ /* SELECT / *+ repartition(1) * / */ /*     battle_group */ /* FROM `mt_dim`.`dim_decismart_realtime_monitor_battle_group_config_df` */ /* WHERE logymd = '2022-05-22' */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_dim`.`dim_decismart_realtime_monitor_battle_group_config_df` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT DISTINCT battle_group FROM (SELECT COALESCE(BIGINT(FLOOR(battleserid / 1000)), -99999) AS battle_group FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battle_reconnect WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd > '2022-05-22' UNION ALL SELECT battle_group FROM `mt_dim`.`dim_decismart_realtime_monitor_battle_group_config_df` WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2022-05-22', '2022-05-22', '2026-05-30')) AS t1

name: 20260525.adbi.dwa_admkt_align_ad_cost_report_df
sql_units: WITH adjust_new_user AS (SELECT app_id, media_source, country, data_date, os, campaign_id, adset_id, ad_id, campaign_name, adset_name, ad_name, did_new_user FROM STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_app_mmp_delivery_adjust_report_df)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31' AND did_new_user > 0), adjust_new_user_agg AS (SELECT app_id, media_source, country, data_date, SUM(did_new_user) AS did_new_user FROM adjust_new_user GROUP BY app_id, media_source, country, data_date), cpi_cost_config AS (SELECT a.*, IF(a.day_limit IS NULL, cpi_bid, LEAST(a.day_limit / b.did_new_user, cpi_bid)) AS cpi_bid_new FROM (SELECT app_id, media_source, country, data_date, cpi_bid, day_limit, ad_target, id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, media_source, country, data_date ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(ARRAY_DATE(start_date, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(end_date), '') = '' OR end_date > '2026-05-31', '2026-05-31', end_date), FALSE)) AS data_date, app_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(media_source), '') = '', 'unknown', MAPPING('media_source', media_source)) AS media_source, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country)) AS country, IF(cost_type IS NULL, 1, cost_type) AS ad_target, CAST(cpi_bid AS DOUBLE) AS cpi_bid, IF(day_limit = CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10, 2)), NULL, CAST(day_limit AS DOUBLE)) AS day_limit, updated_at, id FROM adbi_test.gms_ad_bi_cpi_bid_info WHERE pdate = '20260531' AND is_deleted = 0 AND (COALESCE(TRIM(end_date), '') = '' OR start_date <= end_date) AND start_date <= '2026-05-31' AND cpi_bid <> CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10, 2)))) AS a JOIN adjust_new_user_agg AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.media_source = b.media_source AND a.data_date = b.data_date AND a.country = b.country WHERE a.rn = 1), cost_deduction_config AS (SELECT app_id, media_source, country, data_date, id, ad_target, -cost_deduction / IF(COALESCE(did_new_user_in_id, 0) = 0, dates_in_id, did_new_user_in_id) AS cost_deduction_avg, IF(COALESCE(did_new_user_in_id, 0) = 0, 0, 1) AS exist_adjust_user FROM (SELECT a.app_id, a.media_source, a.country, a.data_date, cost_deduction, ad_target, id, SUM(did_new_user) OVER (PARTITION BY id) AS did_new_user_in_id, COUNT(a.data_date) OVER (PARTITION BY id) AS dates_in_id FROM (SELECT app_id, media_source, country, data_date, cost_deduction, ad_target, id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, media_source, country, data_date ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT EXPLODE(ARRAY_DATE(start_date, end_date, FALSE)) AS data_date, app_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(media_source), '') = '', 'unknown', MAPPING('media_source', media_source)) AS media_source, LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', country)) AS country, IF(cost_type IS NULL, 1, cost_type) AS ad_target, CAST(cost_deduction AS DOUBLE) AS cost_deduction, updated_at, id FROM adbi_test.gms_ad_bi_cost_deduction_info WHERE pdate = '20260531' AND is_deleted = 0 AND start_date <= end_date AND COALESCE(cost_deduction, 0) <> 0 AND start_date <= '2026-05-31')) AS a LEFT JOIN adjust_new_user_agg AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.media_source = b.media_source AND a.data_date = b.data_date AND a.country = b.country WHERE a.rn = 1)), cost_df AS (SELECT a.app_id, a.media_source, a.country, a.data_date AS report_date, os, campaign_id, adset_id, ad_id, campaign_name, adset_name, ad_name, a.did_new_user * b.cpi_bid_new AS cost, b.ad_target, '1' AS align_type, id AS config_id FROM adjust_new_user AS a JOIN cpi_cost_config AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.media_source = b.media_source AND a.data_date = b.data_date AND a.country = b.country UNION ALL SELECT a.app_id, a.media_source, a.country, a.data_date AS report_date, a.os, campaign_id, adset_id, ad_id, campaign_name, adset_name, ad_name, a.did_new_user * b.cost_deduction_avg AS cost, b.ad_target, '2' AS align_type, id AS config_id FROM adjust_new_user AS a JOIN cost_deduction_config AS b ON a.app_id = b.app_id AND a.media_source = b.media_source AND a.data_date = b.data_date AND a.country = b.country AND exist_adjust_user = 1 UNION ALL SELECT app_id, media_source, country, data_date AS report_date, 'unknown' AS os, '' AS campaign_id, '' AS adset_id, '' AS ad_id, NULL AS campaign_name, NULL AS adset_name, NULL AS ad_name, cost_deduction_avg AS cost, ad_target, '3' AS align_type, id AS config_id FROM cost_deduction_config WHERE exist_adjust_user = 0) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(out_table)) SELECT align_type, report_date, app_id, NULL AS app_name, media_source, country, os, NULL AS ad_account_id, campaign_id, campaign_name, adset_id, adset_name, ad_id, ad_name, cost, ad_target, config_id FROM cost_df
