ml_temp.teemoyu_auctionhouse_add_item_df_20260310_01 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND bound_item_type = '非绑定' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), sub_gift AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_tradeable_total FROM ml_temp.teemoyu_auctionhouse_sub_item_df_20260310_01 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND bound_item_type = '非绑定' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), auction_list AS (SELECT auction_roleid, auction_zoneid, COUNT(1) AS list_cnt FROM ml_ods.auctionserver_auctionhouse_list WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY auction_roleid, auction_zoneid), auction_bid AS (SELECT bid_roleid, bid_zoneid, COUNT(1) AS bid_buynow_total, SUM(CASE WHEN is_fix_price_buy = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bid_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN is_fix_price_buy = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS buynow_click_cnt FROM ml_ods.auctionserver_auctionhouse_bid WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY bid_roleid, bid_zoneid), auction_buy_success AS (SELECT buyer_role_id, buyer_zone_id, COUNT(1) AS buy_success_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN is_buyout = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS buynow_success_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN is_buyout = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bid_win_cnt, SUM(bid_price) AS buy_diamond_cost FROM ml_ods.gameserver_auctionhouse_result_buyer WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY buyer_role_id, buyer_zone_id), auction_sell_earn AS (SELECT seller_role_id, seller_zone_id, SUM(add_diamond) AS sell_diamond_earn, SUM(commission_diamond) AS sell_commission FROM ml_ods.gameserver_auctionhouse_result_seller WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY seller_role_id, seller_zone_id), auction_delist AS (SELECT auction_roleid, auction_zoneid, COUNT(1) AS delist_cnt FROM ml_ods.auctionserver_auctionhouse_delist WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY auction_roleid, auction_zoneid), auction_client AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, COUNT(1) AS client_click_total, SUM(CASE WHEN btn IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entry_from_shop, SUM(CASE WHEN btn IN ('6', '7') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entry_from_bag, SUM(CASE WHEN btn = '8' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entry_from_outbid, SUM(CASE WHEN btn = '9' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tab_buy_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN btn = '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tab_sell_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN btn = '11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tab_trading_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN btn = '12' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_item_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN btn = '13' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_list_btn, SUM(CASE WHEN btn = '14' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirm_list_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN btn = '15' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancel_prelist, SUM(CASE WHEN btn = '16' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_delist_cnt FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_auctionhouse_new WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid, zoneid), crystal_skin AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT skinid) AS crystal_skin_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT skinid) * 4 AS crystal_slot_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN collect_quality = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS crystal_skin_q1_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN collect_quality = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS crystal_skin_q3_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN collect_quality = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS crystal_skin_q4_cnt, SUM(CASE collect_quality WHEN 1 THEN 4 * 1 WHEN 3 THEN 4 * 2 WHEN 4 THEN 4 * 5 ELSE 0 END) AS crystal_demand_total FROM ml_temp.crystal_add_skin_df_20260310_01 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND if_crystal_skin = 1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), item_own_raw AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, auction_item_list, dragon_crystal_list, CASE WHEN auction_item_list IS NULL OR auction_item_list = '' THEN 0 ELSE SIZE(SPLIT(auction_item_list, CHR(59))) END AS auction_item_type_cnt, CASE WHEN dragon_crystal_list IS NULL OR dragon_crystal_list = '' THEN 0 ELSE SIZE(SPLIT(dragon_crystal_list, CHR(59))) END AS dragon_crystal_type_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY time ASC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.gameserver_auctionhouse_item_own WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), item_own AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, auction_item_list, dragon_crystal_list, auction_item_type_cnt, dragon_crystal_type_cnt FROM item_own_raw WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.teemoyu_auctionhouse_dau_di_20260526_01 PARTITION(logymd) SELECT dau.roleid, dau.zoneid, dau.register_date, dau.retention_create, dau.first_mt_country, dau.if_return30, dau.lose_days, dau.money_all_sum, dau.money_30_sum, dau.sub_diamond_30_sum, dau.active_label, dau.active_days_7, dau.active_days_30, dau.day_login_cnt, dau.day_login_duration, dau.his_max_bigranklvl, dau.day_5v5_max_bigranklvl, dau.level_level, dau.battle_cnt, dau.pvptype1_battle_cnt, dau.pvptype2_battle_cnt, COALESCE(ag.add_tradeable_total, 0) AS add_tradeable_total, COALESCE(sg.sub_tradeable_total, 0) AS sub_tradeable_total, COALESCE(ag.add_tradeable_total, 0) - COALESCE(sg.sub_tradeable_total, 0) AS hold_tradeable_net, COALESCE(al.list_cnt, 0) AS list_cnt, COALESCE(ab.bid_cnt, 0) AS bid_cnt, COALESCE(ab.buynow_click_cnt, 0) AS buynow_click_cnt, COALESCE(ab.bid_buynow_total, 0) AS bid_buynow_total, COALESCE(bs.buy_success_cnt, 0) AS buy_success_cnt, COALESCE(bs.buynow_success_cnt, 0) AS buynow_success_cnt, COALESCE(bs.bid_win_cnt, 0) AS bid_win_cnt, COALESCE(bs.buy_diamond_cost, 0) AS buy_diamond_cost, COALESCE(ad.delist_cnt, 0) AS delist_cnt, COALESCE(se.sell_diamond_earn, 0) AS sell_diamond_earn, COALESCE(se.sell_commission, 0) AS sell_commission, COALESCE(ac.client_click_total, 0) AS client_click_total, COALESCE(ac.entry_from_shop, 0) AS entry_from_shop, COALESCE(ac.entry_from_bag, 0) AS entry_from_bag, COALESCE(ac.entry_from_outbid, 0) AS entry_from_outbid, COALESCE(ac.tab_buy_cnt, 0) AS tab_buy_cnt, COALESCE(ac.tab_sell_cnt, 0) AS tab_sell_cnt, COALESCE(ac.tab_trading_cnt, 0) AS tab_trading_cnt, COALESCE(ac.click_item_cnt, 0) AS click_item_cnt, COALESCE(ac.click_list_btn, 0) AS click_list_btn, COALESCE(ac.confirm_list_cnt, 0) AS confirm_list_cnt, COALESCE(ac.cancel_prelist, 0) AS cancel_prelist, COALESCE(ac.fail_delist_cnt, 0) AS fail_delist_cnt, COALESCE(cs.crystal_skin_cnt, 0) AS crystal_skin_cnt, COALESCE(cs.crystal_slot_cnt, 0) AS crystal_slot_cnt, COALESCE(cs.crystal_skin_q1_cnt, 0) AS crystal_skin_q1_cnt, COALESCE(cs.crystal_skin_q3_cnt, 0) AS crystal_skin_q3_cnt, COALESCE(cs.crystal_skin_q4_cnt, 0) AS crystal_skin_q4_cnt, COALESCE(cs.crystal_demand_total, 0) AS crystal_demand_total, io.auction_item_list, io.dragon_crystal_list, COALESCE(io.auction_item_type_cnt, 0) AS auction_item_type_cnt, COALESCE(io.dragon_crystal_type_cnt, 0) AS dragon_crystal_type_cnt, dau.logymd FROM dau LEFT JOIN add_gift AS ag ON dau.roleid = ag.roleid AND dau.zoneid = ag.zoneid LEFT JOIN sub_gift AS sg ON dau.roleid = sg.roleid AND dau.zoneid = sg.zoneid LEFT JOIN auction_list AS al ON dau.roleid = CAST(al.auction_roleid AS BIGINT) AND dau.zoneid = al.auction_zoneid LEFT JOIN auction_bid AS ab ON dau.roleid = CAST(ab.bid_roleid AS BIGINT) AND dau.zoneid = ab.bid_zoneid LEFT JOIN auction_buy_success AS bs ON dau.roleid = CAST(bs.buyer_role_id AS BIGINT) AND dau.zoneid = bs.buyer_zone_id LEFT JOIN auction_sell_earn AS se ON dau.roleid = CAST(se.seller_role_id AS BIGINT) AND dau.zoneid = se.seller_zone_id LEFT JOIN auction_delist AS ad ON dau.roleid = CAST(ad.auction_roleid AS BIGINT) AND dau.zoneid = ad.auction_zoneid LEFT JOIN auction_client AS ac ON dau.roleid = ac.accountid AND dau.zoneid = ac.zoneid LEFT JOIN crystal_skin AS cs ON dau.roleid = cs.roleid AND dau.zoneid = cs.zoneid LEFT JOIN item_own AS io ON dau.roleid = io.roleid AND dau.zoneid = io.zoneid

name: ml_temp.season_herogroup_test_cwl
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_caowl@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-25 21:01:44.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 赛季英雄池实验组玩家上两个赛季未玩而本赛季有新玩英雄,但又未签约的玩家及其占比、最终保存玩家明细信息 */ /* 上述玩家本赛季新玩的英雄id及场次、被推荐的英雄明细 */ WITH t0 AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, MIN(logymd) AS enter_dt, CASE WHEN param_version = '10750' THEN '对照组' ELSE '实验组' END AS group_label FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-25' AND '2026-03-31' AND param_name = '60_SeasonHeroPool_2' AND param_version IN ('10750', '10751', '10752', '10753') AND old_zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY accountid, old_zoneid, CASE WHEN param_version = '10750' THEN '对照组' ELSE '实验组' END), t1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT accountid, old_zoneid FROM ml_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE param_value = '__MTTD_INTERNAL_LONG_OBSERVE_GROUP__' AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-04-02' AND old_zoneid < 57000), t2 AS (SELECT t0.group_label /* t0.enter_dt, */, t0.roleid, t0.zoneid FROM t0 LEFT JOIN t1 ON t0.roleid = t1.accountid AND t0.zoneid = t1.old_zoneid WHERE t1.accountid IS NULL AND t1.old_zoneid IS NULL AND t0.group_label = '实验组'), t3 AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, hero_id /* 使用英雄 */, SUM(hero_cnt) AS use_herocnt FROM ml_temp.total_season_hero_used_caowl WHERE logymd IN ('2025-12-18', '2026-03-11') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, hero_id), t4 AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, hero_id, SUM(hero_cnt) AS hero_cnt FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_season_role_zone_df AS a /* df表最早只有2020年3月的数据 */ LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(FROM_JSON(ss_hero_cnt_json, 'map<string,bigint>')) ht AS hero_id, hero_cnt /* 本赛季使用各个英雄的场次（1,2,4） */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND UPPER(appid) = 'MLBB' AND zoneid < 57000 AND NOT ss_hero_cnt_json IS NULL AND ss_hero_cnt_json <> '' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, hero_id), t5 /* having sum(t4.hero_cnt)>=5 --过滤出使用场次达到5场以上的玩家及对应新增的英雄id */ AS (SELECT t4.roleid, t4.zoneid, t4.hero_id /* 新英雄 ID（本赛季首次使用） */, SUM(t4.hero_cnt) AS hero_usecnt /* -- 本赛季在该新英雄上的使用场次 */ FROM t2 INNER JOIN t4 ON t2.roleid = t4.roleid AND t2.zoneid = t4.zoneid LEFT JOIN t3 ON t4.hero_id = t3.hero_id AND t4.roleid = t3.roleid AND t4.zoneid = t3.zoneid WHERE t3.hero_id IS NULL AND t4.hero_cnt >= 5 GROUP BY t4.roleid, t4.zoneid, t4.hero_id), t6 /* ,hero_id */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid /* ,hero_id --签约英雄 */ /* , sign_seq --签约序号 */ /* ,sign_count --签约剩余次数 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_season_hero_pool_sign WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-24' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND season_id = 40 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t7 AS (/* 本赛季新增使用场次达到5场且赛季英雄池未签约英雄的玩家 */ SELECT t5.roleid, t5.zoneid, t5.hero_id /* 本赛季新增使用场次达到5场英雄 */, t5.hero_usecnt /* 该英雄的使用场次 */ FROM t5 LEFT JOIN t6 ON t5.roleid = t6.roleid AND t5.zoneid = t6.zoneid /* and t5.hero_id=t6.hero_id */ WHERE t6.roleid IS NULL AND t6.zoneid IS NULL /* 过滤签约赛季英雄池的玩家 */), t8 AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, recommend_heroid /* 推荐英雄id */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, recommend_hero_list /* 推荐英雄列表 */ FROM ml_ods.gameserver_season_hero_pool_recommend WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-24' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND season_id = 40) LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(recommend_hero_list, ',')) temp AS recommend_heroid GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, recommend_heroid), t9 /* ,hero_id */ AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid /* ,hero_id */ /* ,1 AS do_reach */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_seasonalheropool_click WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-24' AND '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.season_herogroup_test_cwl PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t7.roleid /* 本赛季使用新英雄但未签约玩家id */, t7.zoneid /* 本赛季使用新英雄但未签约玩家区服id */, t7.hero_id /* 玩家本赛季使用超过5场的新英雄 */, t7.hero_usecnt /* 新英雄使用场次 */, CASE WHEN NOT t8.recommend_heroid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_recommend /* 该新英雄是否在赛季英雄池的推荐列表中 */, COLLECT_SET(t3.hero_id) AS heroid /* 该玩家前2个赛季使用的英雄id,已去重 */, CASE WHEN t9.roleid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_click /* 玩家是否点击赛季英雄池界面 */ FROM t7 LEFT JOIN t8 ON t8.roleid = t7.roleid AND t8.zoneid = t7.zoneid AND t7.hero_id = t8.recommend_heroid LEFT JOIN t3 ON t7.roleid = t3.roleid AND t7.zoneid = t3.zoneid LEFT JOIN t9 ON t7.roleid = t9.roleid AND t7.zoneid = t9.zoneid /* and t7.hero_id=t9.hero_id */ WHERE NOT t3.hero_id IS NULL /* 过滤了前2个赛季没玩过的本赛季新增玩家 */ GROUP BY t7.roleid /* 本赛季使用新英雄但未签约玩家id */, t7.zoneid /* 本赛季使用新英雄但未签约玩家区服id */, t7.hero_id /* 玩家本赛季使用超过5场的新英雄 */, t7.hero_usecnt /* 新英雄使用场次 */, CASE WHEN NOT t8.recommend_heroid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t9.roleid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_bwei@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-27 14:37:55.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* ============================================================= */ /* 互动特效事件宽表 · 单日 INSERT */ /* 占位：2026-05-30 分区日期 yyyy-MM-dd */ /* ============================================================= */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.vb_chuochuo_event_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT e.roleid, e.zoneid, e.item_id, e.event_type, e.operate, e.scene_type, e.scene_name, e.battle_state, e.event_cnt, e.total_num, e.before_hold_sum, p.first_mt_country AS country /* 画像 */, p.born, p.last_client_language_cn, p.charge_amt_total, CASE WHEN p.charge_amt_total IS NULL OR p.charge_amt_total = 0 THEN 'free' WHEN p.charge_amt_total >= 200000 THEN '超R' WHEN p.charge_amt_total >= 20000 THEN '大R' WHEN p.charge_amt_total >= 2000 THEN '中R' WHEN p.charge_amt_total >= 200 THEN '中小R' ELSE '小R' END AS r_level, p.pvptype1_battle_cnt, p.pvptype2_battle_cnt, p.pvptype4_battle_cnt, p.`5v5_battle_cnt` AS battle_cnt_5v5, p.pvptype1_black_cnt, p.pvptype2_black_cnt, p.pvptype4_black_cnt, p.`5v5_black_cnt` AS black_cnt_5v5, p.first_fixed_score, p.first_devicefreememory, p.first_nowpicturequality, p.first_realpicturequality, p.first_client_memory, p.first_devicetotalmemory FROM (/* 获取事件 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(item_id AS BIGINT) AS item_id, 'get' AS event_type, operate, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS scene_type, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS scene_name, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS battle_state, COUNT(1) AS event_cnt, SUM(add_num) AS total_num, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS before_hold_sum FROM mt_dm.dm_mlbb_resource_item_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND item_id BETWEEN 66000 AND 66021 AND add_num > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id, operate UNION ALL /* 消耗事件 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(chuochuo_id AS BIGINT) AS item_id, 'use' AS event_type, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS operate, scene_type, CASE scene_type WHEN 1 THEN '房间' WHEN 2 THEN 'BP' WHEN 3 THEN 'loading' ELSE '其他' END AS scene_name, battle_state, COUNT(1) AS event_cnt, COUNT(1) AS total_num, SUM(before_chuochuo_num) AS before_hold_sum FROM ml_ods.gameserver_chuochuo_use WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND chuochuo_id BETWEEN 66000 AND 66021 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, chuochuo_id, scene_type, battle_state) AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country, born, last_client_language_cn, charge_amt_total, pvptype1_battle_cnt, pvptype2_battle_cnt, pvptype4_battle_cnt, `5v5_battle_cnt`, pvptype1_black_cnt, pvptype2_black_cnt, pvptype4_black_cnt, `5v5_black_cnt`, first_fixed_score, first_devicefreememory, first_nowpicturequality, first_realpicturequality, first_client_memory, first_devicetotalmemory FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS p ON e.roleid = p.roleid AND e.zoneid = p.zoneid

name: etl.nova_dw.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df_ap_utc9
sql_units: WITH basic_df AS (/* 基础信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, zone_region, create_date_offset AS register_date FROM nova_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_offset_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zone_offset = STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_offset))), active_di AS (/* 活跃信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, COALESCE(online_duration, 0) AS online_duration /* 当日有活跃，无在线时长的给默认值0 */, SUBSTRING(last_login_time_offset, 1, 10) AS active_date FROM nova_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_offset_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zone_offset = STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_offset))), pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(pay_cnt) AS charge_cnt, SUM(pay_amt) AS charge_amt, MAX(SUBSTRING(last_pay_time_offset, 1, 10)) AS charge_date FROM nova_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_offset_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zone_offset = STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_offset)) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_bitmap AS (/* 前一日 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_offset, create_date, charge_info, charge_cnt_total_array, charge_amt_total_array, charge_amt_array, online_dur_array, active_info, active_days_array, logymd, appid, zone_region FROM nova_dw.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'nova' AND zone_offset = STRUCT(STRUCT(zone_offset))) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE nova_dw.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'nova', zone_region) SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, register_date AS create_date /* 无注册日期给默认值 */, IF(LENGTH(active_info) > 0 AND '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(active_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(active_info))), COALESCE(active_info, '')) AS active_info, IF(LENGTH(charge_info) > 0 AND /* 只补齐有位图的，并且当日日期大于注册日的 */ '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(charge_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(charge_info))), COALESCE(charge_info, '') /* 可能存在有位图没有注册日期的 */) AS charge_info, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_amt_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_amt_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_amt_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_amt_array /* 2、付费金额位图 */, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_cnt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_cnt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_cnt_total_array /* 2、累计付费次数位图: 补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有付费用户） */, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_amt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_amt_total_array /* 3、累计付费金额位图: 补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有付费用户） */, CAST(IF(SIZE(online_dur_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(online_dur_array)) > 0, CONCAT(online_dur_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(online_dur_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(online_dur_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS online_dur_array /* --在线时长位图,补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有在线用户） */, CAST(IF(SIZE(active_days_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(active_days_array)) > 0, CONCAT(active_days_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(active_days_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(active_days_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS active_days_array /* 活跃天数位图补齐(array) */, CASE WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 THEN 'apac' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 THEN 'eu' WHEN zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 THEN 'us' ELSE CASE WHEN zone_offset = -8 THEN 'us' WHEN zone_offset = 9 THEN 'apac' END END AS zone_region FROM (SELECT td.roleid, td.zoneid, td.register_date, td.zone_type, td.zone_offset, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31', CONCAT('1', COALESCE(ld.active_info, '')), IF(LENGTH(ld.active_info) > 0, CONCAT('0', ld.active_info), '')) AS active_info, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31', CONCAT('1', COALESCE(ld.charge_info, '')), IF(LENGTH(ld.charge_info) > 0, CONCAT('0', charge_info), '')) AS charge_info, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_amt_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_amt_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.charge_amt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_amt_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_amt, 0))), ld.charge_amt_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_amt_array, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_cnt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_cnt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(charge_cnt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_cnt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_cnt, 0) + ld.charge_cnt_total_array[0])), ld.charge_cnt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_cnt_total_array, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_amt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_amt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.charge_amt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_amt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_amt, 0) + ld.charge_amt_total_array[0])), ld.charge_amt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_amt_total_array, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.online_dur_array IS NULL OR ld.online_dur_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.online_duration), IF(SIZE(ld.online_dur_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.online_duration, 0))), ld.online_dur_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS online_dur_array, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.active_days_array IS NULL OR ld.active_days_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(1), IF(SIZE(ld.active_days_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(is_td_active + ld.active_days_array[0])), ld.active_days_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS active_days_array FROM (SELECT bas.roleid, bas.zoneid, bas.zone_type, bas.zone_offset, bas.register_date, act.active_date, act.online_duration, pay.charge_cnt, pay.charge_amt, pay.charge_date, IF(act.active_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_td_active, bas.zone_region FROM basic_df AS bas /* basic表 */ LEFT JOIN active_di AS act /* 活跃 */ ON bas.roleid = act.roleid AND bas.zoneid = act.zoneid LEFT JOIN pay_di AS pay /* 支付 */ ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid AND bas.zoneid = pay.zoneid) AS td LEFT JOIN t_bitmap AS ld /* 前一日 */ ON td.roleid = ld.roleid AND td.zoneid = ld.zoneid) AS t

sql_units: WITH battle_info AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, heroid, battleid, wincamp, ismvp, battletime, score, mmr_new, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY heroid ORDER BY mmr_new DESC, time DESC) AS hero_rank, COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY heroid) AS total_num FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, heroid, battleid, wincamp, ismvp, battletime, score, mmr_new, time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dwd.dwd_game_guide_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2) AS t1 WHERE rn = 1), mmr_info /* mmr取最近一周末次战斗的情况 */ /* 本周内所有玩家英雄末次战斗对应mmr值在本周内所有玩家英雄末次战斗池中的排名 */ AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, heroid, mmr_new, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY heroid ORDER BY mmr_new DESC, time DESC) AS hero_rank, COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY heroid) AS total_num FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, heroid, mmr_new, time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dwd.dwd_game_guide_role_zone_di WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd > '2026-05-25' AND pvptype = 2) AS t1 WHERE rn = 1) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwm.dwm_game_guide_role_zone_hero_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.heroid, SUM(total_battle_cnt) AS total_battle_cnt, SUM(total_win_cnt) AS total_win_cnt, SUM(total_mvp_cnt) AS total_win_cnt, SUM(total_battle_time) AS total_battle_time, SUM(total_score) AS total_score, MAX(m1.hero_rank) AS hero_mmr_rank, MAX(m1.mmr_new) AS mmr, MAX(m1.total_num) AS total_hero_cnt FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, heroid, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS total_battle_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wincamp = 1 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS total_win_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ismvp = 1 THEN battleid ELSE NULL END) AS total_mvp_cnt, SUM(battletime) AS total_battle_time, SUM(score) AS total_score /* max(m1.hero_rank)  hero_mmr_rank, */ /* max(m1.mmr_new)  mmr, */ /* max(m1.total_num) total_hero_cnt */ FROM battle_info GROUP BY accountid, zoneid, heroid UNION ALL SELECT accountid, zoneid, heroid, total_battle_cnt, total_win_cnt, total_mvp_cnt, total_battle_time, total_score /* hero_mmr_rank, */ /* mmr, */ /* total_hero_cnt */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_game_guide_role_zone_hero_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t1 LEFT JOIN mmr_info AS m1 ON t1.accountid = m1.accountid AND t1.zoneid = m1.zoneid AND t1.heroid = m1.heroid GROUP BY t1.accountid, t1.zoneid, t1.heroid

AS BIGINT) AS zone_type, basic.zone_offset, CASE WHEN basic.zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 27999 AND UPPER(TRIM(basic.createrole_country)) IN ('HK', 'TW', 'MO') THEN '4.港澳台' WHEN basic.zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 27999 AND UPPER(TRIM(basic.createrole_country)) IN ('JP') THEN '1.日本' WHEN basic.zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 27999 AND UPPER(TRIM(basic.createrole_country)) IN ('KR') THEN '2.韩国' WHEN basic.zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 THEN '3.美国' WHEN basic.zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 27999 AND UPPER(TRIM(basic.createrole_country)) IN ('ID', 'MY', 'SG', 'TH') THEN '5.东南亚' WHEN basic.zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 AND UPPER(TRIM(basic.createrole_country)) IN ('DE', 'IE', 'FR', 'GB', 'FI', 'AU', 'CA', 'CH', 'HU', 'RO', 'IT', 'ES', 'AE', 'QA', 'KW', 'SA') THEN '6.欧洲' ELSE '8.其他' END AS zone_group, CASE WHEN basic.zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 THEN '亚太' WHEN basic.zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 THEN '亚太' WHEN basic.zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 THEN '欧洲' WHEN basic.zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 THEN '美国' ELSE CASE WHEN basic.zone_offset = -8 THEN 'us' WHEN basic.zone_offset = 9 THEN 'apac' END END AS country_group, basic.create_time /* ==================== 注册创角信息 ==================== */, /* basic.create_media_department AS create_channel_group, */, basic.createrole_country, basic.is_first_create, COALESCE(active.his_last_role_level, charge.his_last_role_level) AS his_last_role_level /* ==================== 角色状态信息 ==================== */, active.his_last_inherit_level, active.his_last_active_score, CASE WHEN charge.total_pay_amt_usd * 1.0 / 100 BETWEEN 0.01 AND 4.63 THEN 'v1(0.01-4.63)' WHEN charge.total_pay_amt_usd * 1.0 / 100 BETWEEN 4.64 AND 46.30 THEN 'v2(4.64-46.30)' WHEN charge.total_pay_amt_usd * 1.0 / 100 BETWEEN 46.30 AND 154.32 THEN 'v3(46.31-154.32)' WHEN charge.total_pay_amt_usd * 1.0 / 100 BETWEEN 154.33 AND 492.96 THEN 'v4(154.33-492.96)' WHEN charge.total_pay_amt_usd * 1.0 / 100 BETWEEN 492.97 AND 1543.21 THEN 'v5(492.97-1543.21)' WHEN charge.total_pay_amt_usd * 1.0 / 100 BETWEEN 1543.22 AND 3086.42 THEN 'v6(1543.22-3086.42)' WHEN charge.total_pay_amt_usd * 1.0 / 100 BETWEEN 3086.43 AND 7716.05 THEN 'v7(3086.43-7716.05)' WHEN charge.total_pay_amt_usd * 1.0 / 100 BETWEEN 7716.06 AND 15432.10 THEN 'v8(7716.06-15432.10)' WHEN charge.total_pay_amt_usd * 1.0 / 100 BETWEEN 15432.11 AND 77160.49 THEN 'v9(15432.11-77160.49)' WHEN charge.total_pay_amt_usd * 1.0 / 100 > 77160.49 THEN 'v10(77160.5+)' ELSE 'v0' END AS his_pay_amt_level /* 海外用美金来计算 */, CAST(active.his_last_alliance_id AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) AS his_last_alliance_id, active.his_last_alliance_name, COALESCE(alliance.alliance_pay_amt, 0) AS total_alliance_pay_amt, active.his_last_diamond_free /* ==================== 资产存量信息 ==================== */, active.his_last_diamond_paid, active.his_last_gacha_token_normal, active.his_last_gacha_token_up, active.his_last_voucher, active.his_last_login_ip /* ==================== 设备与登录信息 ==================== */, active.his_last_os_version, active.his_last_client_version, active.his_last_device_model AS his_last_device, active.his_last_device_id AS his_last_deviceid, active.his_last_channel AS his_last_login_channel, active.his_first_active_date /* ==================== 历史累计指标 ==================== */, active.his_last_active_date, active.his_last_active_time, active.his_last_active_second_date, SUBSTRING(charge.his_first_pay_time, 1, 10) AS his_first_pay_date, SUBSTRING(charge.his_last_pay_time, 1, 10) AS his_last_pay_date, active.total_login_cnt, active.his_active_days_cnt AS total_active_days, active.total_online_dur, charge.total_pay_amt_usd AS total_pay_amt, period.is_active_1d /* ==================== 当日行为指标 ==================== */, period.login_cnt_1d, period.online_dur_1d, period.is_pay_1d, period.pay_cnt_1d, period.pay_amt_1d, period.is_active_7d /* ==================== 多周期活跃、付费指标 ==================== */, period.active_days_7d, period.active_days_30d, period.pay_amt_7d, period.pay_amt_14d, period.pay_amt_30d, lose.active_days_reg_7days AS active_days_reg_7d, lose.active_days_reg_30days AS active_days_reg_30d, lose.pay_amt_reg_7days AS pay_amt_reg_7d, lose.pay_amt_reg_14days AS pay_amt_reg_14d, lose.pay_amt_reg_30days AS pay_amt_reg_30d, lose.is_recurring_7days, lose.is_recurring_14days, lose.is_recurring_30days, lose.is_reg_lose_2d, lose.is_reg_lose_3d, lose.is_reg_lose_7d, lose.is_reg_lose_14d, lose.is_reg_lose_30d, basic.is_cur_bot /* ==================== 其他标识 ==================== */, IF(NOT inner_role.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_inner, CASE WHEN basic.zoneid BETWEEN 20001 AND 24999 OR basic.zoneid BETWEEN 25001 AND 27999 THEN 'apac' WHEN basic.zoneid BETWEEN 10001 AND 14999 THEN 'eu' WHEN basic.zoneid BETWEEN 15001 AND 17999 THEN 'us' ELSE CASE WHEN basic.zone_offset = -8 THEN 'us' WHEN basic.zone_offset = 9 THEN 'apac' END END AS zone_region FROM nova_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_df AS charge ON basic.roleid = charge.roleid AND basic.zoneid = charge.zoneid AND charge.logymd = '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN nova_dw.dwm_role_zone_behavior_agg_di AS period ON basic.roleid = period.roleid AND basic.zoneid = period.zoneid AND period.logymd = '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN nova_dw.dm_active_lose_recurring_role_zone_utc8_df AS lose ON basic.roleid = lose.roleid AND basic.zoneid = lose.zoneid AND lose.logymd = '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN inner_role AS inner_role ON basic.roleid = inner_role.roleid AND basic.zoneid = inner_role.zoneid LEFT JOIN alliance_pay_amt AS alliance ON active.his_last_alliance_id = alliance.alliance_id AND COALESCE(active.his_last_alliance_id, 0) > 0 WHERE basic.logymd = '2026-05-31'

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: ethandong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-10-21 15:05:01.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mt_dwd.dwd_fsgame_charge_order_di ( */ /*     `event_time` string COMMENT '日志发生的时间 内容格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', */ /*     `game_id` int COMMENT '游戏APPid，巴清传的APPid是791000364', */ /*     `area_id` int COMMENT '大区的ID，本字段的值为不可重复，否则在星空后台展示会出现问题。注意，即使是不同channel_id下属，本字段的值也不可以重复。', */ /*     `group_id` int COMMENT '大区之下的服的ID 如只有分区没有分服的游戏字段内容可以填0', */ /*     `mid` string COMMENT '渠道唯一用户账号id，即G家SDK账号，也称为美娱账号meiyu_ID，可以通过G家SDK获取到。', */ /*     `character_id` string COMMENT '系统自动生成的玩家角色ID', */ /*     `character_name` string COMMENT '用户填写的角色名', */ /*     `character_level` int COMMENT '玩家角色当前的等级', */ /*     `character_stage` int COMMENT '玩家角色主线关卡id', */ /*     `character_chapter` int COMMENT '玩家角色主线关卡章节', */ /*     `character_season` int COMMENT '玩家角色主线关卡难度', */ /*     `channel_id` string COMMENT '一级渠道id，盛大游戏官方包的值为A1，其他联运渠道和CPS渠道各有值，值为字母和数字的组合，可以通过G家SDK获取到。', */ /*     `sub_channel_id` string COMMENT '二级渠道id。原作为channel_id=A1的情况下，用于对盛大游戏官方包下属的CPS渠道包进行标识，但因技保中心打CPS渠道包的设定，CPS渠道包的标识只能打到channel_id字段。本字段目前无用，可传值为数字0', */ /*     `platform` int COMMENT '所属平台 android=1、iOS=2、H5=3、PC模拟器=4', */ /*     `device_id` string COMMENT '设备id Android=IMEI-androidid、 iOS=idfv首尾交换(G＋标准)。可以通过G家SDK获取到。', */ /*     `ce` int COMMENT '玩家角色的角色综合战力数值', */ /*     `openid` int COMMENT '玩家的账号ID，这个ID是CP独立用来对用户的标识', */ /*     `create_tick` int COMMENT '角色创建时间', */ /*     `world_id` int COMMENT '大区的ID', */ /*     `test_type` int COMMENT 'ABTest的显示类型', */ /*     `client_ver` string COMMENT '客户端整包版本号', */ /*     `res_ver` string COMMENT '客户端patch版本号', */ /*     `country` string COMMENT '国家', */ /*     `city` string COMMENT '城市', */ /*     `language` string COMMENT '语言', */ /*     `m__account_id` string COMMENT '账号ID', */ /*     `m__distinct_id` string COMMENT '唯一账号ID', */ /*     `m__type` string COMMENT '类型', */ /*     `m__time` string COMMENT '事件时间(原始时间)', */ /*     `m__event_name` string COMMENT '事件名称', */ /*     `m__lib` string COMMENT '#lib', */ /*     `m__lib_version` string COMMENT '#lib_version', */ /*     `m__log_time` string COMMENT '日志时间(-8时区)', */ /*     `m__msg_id` string COMMENT '消息ID', */ /*     `zone_code` int COMMENT '时区', */ /*     `ip` string COMMENT '用户登录ip', */ /*     `product_id` string COMMENT '产品ID', */ /*     `product_name` string COMMENT '产品名称', */ /*     `product_num` int COMMENT '产品数量', */ /*     `order_id` string COMMENT '订单号', */ /*     `amount` int COMMENT '数量', */ /*     `channel_order_id` string COMMENT '渠道订单号', */ /*     `channel` string COMMENT '渠道', */ /*     `cost_money` int COMMENT '实际消耗金钱', */ /*     `original_money` int COMMENT '原价消耗金钱', */ /*     `status` int COMMENT '充值状态', */ /*     `recharge_id` int COMMENT '充值ID', */ /*     `viplv` int COMMENT '大会员等级', */ /*     `pay_mode` int COMMENT '充值方式', */ /*     `sel_id` string COMMENT '选择的ID列表', */ /*     `m__properties` int COMMENT 'properties冗余字段', */ /*     `properties` string COMMENT 'properties冗余字段', */ /*     `environment` string COMMENT '环境', */ /*     `idx` string COMMENT 'idx', */ /*     `login_ip` string COMMENT '登录ip', */ /*     `project_id` string COMMENT '项目id', */ /*     bill_country string comment '账单国家', */ /*     bill_currency string comment '账单货币', */ /*     currency_exchange_rate decimal(38,18) comment '账单货币汇率', */ /*     bill_amt decimal(38,18) comment '账单金额', */ /*     before_tax_currency string comment '税前原始币种', */ /*     before_tax_amt decimal(38,18) comment '税前原始金额', */ /*     after_tax_currency string comment '分成前币种（税后流水币)', */ /*     after_tax_amt decimal(38,18) comment '分成前金额（税后流水）', */ /*     actual_currency string comment '实收原始币种', */ /*     actual_amt decimal(38,18) comment '实收原始金额', */ /*     tax_rate decimal(38,18) comment '渠道税率(代缴)', */ /*     tax_currency string comment '渠道税金币种(代缴)', */ /*     tax_amt decimal(38,18) comment '渠道税金金额(代缴)', */ /*     back_tax_currency string comment '补缴税金币种', */ /*     back_tax_amt decimal(38,18) comment '补缴税金金额', */ /*     share_ratio decimal(38,18) comment '渠道分成比例', */ /*     share_currency string comment '渠道分成币种', */ /*     share_amt decimal(38,18) comment '渠道分成金额', */ /*     fee_currency string comment '渠道手续费币种', */ /*     fee_amt decimal(38,18) comment '渠道手续费金额', */ /*     fee_exchange_rate decimal(38,18) comment '渠道手续费汇率', */ /*     game_pay_channel string comment '游戏支付渠道' */ /* ) COMMENT '手办团充值明细表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (`logymd` string COMMENT '分区日期') */ /* stored as parquet */ /* location 's3a://mt-dwd/table/dwd_fsgame_charge_order_di' */ /* 税率和分成 */ WITH paychannel_rate AS (SELECT start_day, pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, country, share, rate, is_tax, is_pay_tax, is_back_tax, has_share_tax, LEAD(start_day, 1, '9999-12-31') OVER (PARTITION BY pay_channel, sub_pay_channel, country ORDER BY start_day) AS end_day /* lead拼接后面的行 */ FROM mt_dim.dim_fsgame_paychannel_rate_di AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_fsgame_paychannel_rate_di WHERE logymd > '0') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd WHERE t1.logymd > '0'), currency_exchange /* 汇率 */ AS (SELECT currency, AVG(exchange_rate) AS exchange_rate FROM mt_dim.dim_currency_exchange_df WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-04-30' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY currency), country_2_map /* 国家二字码映射 */ AS (SELECT t1.country_code_2, t1.country_en, t1.country_alias_en, t1.country_alias_en2 FROM mt_dim.dim_fsgame_country_mapping_df AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_fsgame_country_mapping_df WHERE logymd > '0') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd WHERE t1.logymd > '0'), product_price /* 商品定价 */ AS (SELECT t1.product_id, t1.money FROM mt_dim.dim_fsgame_product_price_di AS t1 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dim.dim_fsgame_product_price_di WHERE logymd > '0') AS t2 ON t1.logymd = t2.logymd WHERE t1.logymd > '0'), charge_origin AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT event_time, game_id, area_id, group_id, mid, character_id, character_name, character_level, character_stage, character_chapter, character_season, channel_id, sub_channel_id, platform, device_id, ce, openid, create_tick, world_id, test_type, client_ver, res_ver, country, city, language, m__account_id, m__distinct_id, m__type, m__time, m__event_name, m__lib, m__lib_version, m__log_time, m__msg_id, zone_code, ip, product_id, product_name, product_num, order_id, amount, channel_order_id, channel, cost_money, original_money, status, recharge_id, viplv, pay_mode, sel_id, m__properties, properties, environment, idx, login_ip, project_id, logymd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY event_time ASC, m__event_name DESC) AS rn FROM fsgame_ods.xg_recharge_glog WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND status = 3 /* 支付成功 */) WHERE rn = 1), channel_handle_raw AS (SELECT event_time, game_id, area_id, group_id, mid, character_id, character_name, character_level, character_stage, character_chapter, character_season, COALESCE(IF(LOWER(channel_id_login) = 'pro', 'ios', channel_id_login), 'unknown') AS channel_id /* 替换为login中的channel_id */, sub_channel_id, platform, device_id, ce, openid, create_tick, world_id, test_type, client_ver, res_ver, COALESCE(country_login, 'unknown') AS country /* 替换为login中的country */, city, language, m__account_id, m__distinct_id, m__type, m__time, m__event_name, m__lib, m__lib_version, m__log_time, m__msg_id, zone_code, ip, product_id, product_name, product_num, order_id, amount, channel_order_id, channel, cost_money, original_money, status, recharge_id, viplv, pay_mode, sel_id, m__properties, properties, environment, idx, login_ip, project_id, logymd FROM (SELECT t1.*, t2.channel_id_login, t2.country_login FROM (SELECT * FROM charge_origin WHERE (channel_id = 'default' OR TRIM(channel_id) = '' OR channel_id IS NULL OR country = 'default' OR TRIM(country) = '' OR country IS NULL)) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT charge.order_id, CASE WHEN (charge.channel_id = 'default' OR TRIM(charge.channel_id) = '' OR charge.channel_id IS NULL) THEN IF(li.channel_id = 'default' OR TRIM(li.channel_id) = '' OR li.channel_id IS NULL, 'unknown', li.channel_id) ELSE NULL END AS channel_id_login, CASE WHEN (charge.country = 'default' OR TRIM(charge.country) = '' OR charge.country IS NULL) THEN IF(li.country = 'default' OR TRIM(li.country) = '' OR li.country IS NULL, 'unknown', li.country) ELSE NULL END AS country_login, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY charge.order_id ORDER BY li.m__log_time DESC, li.channel_id DESC, li.country DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT character_id, area_id, channel_id, m__log_time, country FROM fsgame_ods.xg_character_login_glog WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' /* 取当天和前一天的登录埋点，防止charge的channel_id兜底不上有效值 */ GROUP BY character_id, area_id, channel_id, m__log_time, country) AS li INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM charge_origin WHERE (channel_id = 'default' OR TRIM(channel_id) = '' OR channel_id IS NULL OR country = 'default' OR TRIM(country) = '' OR country IS NULL)) AS charge ON li.character_id = charge.character_id AND li.area_id = charge.area_id WHERE charge.m__log_time >= li.m__log_time) AS t2 ON t1.order_id = t2.order_id AND t2.rn = 1) UNION ALL SELECT event_time, game_id, area_id, group_id, mid, character_id, character_name, character_level, character_stage, character_chapter, character_season, IF(LOWER(channel_id) = 'pro', 'ios', channel_id) AS channel_id, sub_channel_id, platform, device_id, ce, openid, create_tick, world_id, test_type, client_ver, res_ver, country, city, language, m__account_id, m__distinct_id, m__type, m__time, m__event_name, m__lib, m__lib_version, m__log_time, m__msg_id, zone_code, ip, product_id, product_name, product_num, order_id, amount, channel_order_id, channel, cost_money, original_money, status, recharge_id, viplv, pay_mode, sel_id, m__properties, properties, environment, idx, login_ip, project_id, logymd FROM charge_origin WHERE channel_id <> 'default' AND TRIM(channel_id) <> '' AND NOT channel_id IS NULL AND country <> 'default' AND TRIM(country) <> '' AND NOT country IS NULL), bill_currency_raw AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN project_id = 'ta_event_28' THEN 'CNY' WHEN project_id = 'ta_event_23' THEN 'USD' WHEN project_id = '795970' THEN 'TWD' WHEN project_id = '795969' THEN 'USD' WHEN project_id = '795968' THEN 'KRW' WHEN project_id = '793233' THEN 'USD' ELSE 'unknown' END AS bill_currency, CASE WHEN project_id = 'ta_event_28' THEN cost_money / 10 ELSE cost_money END AS bill_amt FROM channel_handle_raw), bill_country_raw AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN (bill_currency = 'CNY' OR bill_currency = 'USD') AND country <> 'unknown' THEN t2.country_code_2 /* 根据上报的country转化对应的国家二字码 */ WHEN bill_currency = 'CNY' AND country = 'unknown' THEN 'CN' WHEN bill_currency = 'USD' AND country = 'unknown' THEN 'US' WHEN bill_currency = 'TWD' THEN 'TW' WHEN bill_currency = 'KRW' THEN 'KR' ELSE 'unknown' END AS bill_country FROM bill_currency_raw AS t1 LEFT JOIN country_2_map AS t2 ON UPPER(t1.country) = UPPER(t2.country_en) OR UPPER(t1.country) = UPPER(t2.country_alias_en) OR UPPER(t1.country) = UPPER(t2.country_alias_en2)), tax_fee_join AS (SELECT a.*, IF(UPPER(a.bill_currency) = 'USD', 1, CASE WHEN b.exchange_rate IS NULL AND UPPER(a.bill_currency) = 'BAM' THEN CAST(1 / 0.558454 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) WHEN b.exchange_rate IS NULL AND UPPER(a.bill_currency) = 'SLE' THEN CAST(1 / 0.0466810 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) WHEN b.exchange_rate IS NULL AND UPPER(a.bill_currency) = 'HKR' THEN CAST(1 / 0.143622 AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) ELSE CAST(b.exchange_rate AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) END) AS exchange_rate /* 汇率 */, 0 AS fee_exchange_rate /* 手续费配置 */, CAST(COALESCE(c.rate, d.rate, e.rate, f.rate, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) AS tax_rate, CAST(COALESCE(c.share, d.share, e.share, f.share, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) AS share_ratio, COALESCE(c.is_tax, d.is_tax, e.is_tax, f.is_tax) AS is_tax, COALESCE(c.is_pay_tax, d.is_pay_tax, e.is_pay_tax, f.is_pay_tax) AS is_pay_tax, COALESCE(c.is_back_tax, d.is_back_tax, e.is_back_tax, f.is_back_tax) AS is_back_tax, COALESCE(c.has_share_tax, d.has_share_tax, e.has_share_tax, f.has_share_tax) AS has_share_tax, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.is_tax, d.is_tax, e.is_tax, f.is_tax) = '是' THEN CAST(a.bill_amt AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) ELSE CAST(a.bill_amt AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) * (1 + CAST(COALESCE(c.rate, d.rate, e.rate, f.rate, 0) AS DECIMAL(38, 18))) END AS before_tax_amt, 'unknown' AS fee_currency /* 手续费配置 */, 0 AS fee_amt /* 手续费配置 */, bill_currency AS before_tax_currency, bill_currency AS after_tax_currency, bill_currency AS actual_currency, bill_currency AS tax_currency, bill_currency AS back_tax_currency, bill_currency AS share_currency FROM bill_country_raw AS a LEFT JOIN currency_exchange AS b ON UPPER(a.bill_currency) = UPPER(b.currency) LEFT JOIN paychannel_rate AS c ON UPPER(a.channel_id) = UPPER(c.pay_channel) AND UPPER(a.sub_channel_id) = UPPER(c.sub_pay_channel) AND UPPER(a.bill_country) = UPPER(c.country) AND TO_DATE(a.m__log_time) >= c.start_day AND TO_DATE(a.m__log_time) < c.end_day AND c.sub_pay_channel <> '-' AND c.country <> '-' LEFT JOIN paychannel_rate AS d ON UPPER(a.channel_id) = UPPER(d.pay_channel) AND UPPER(a.sub_channel_id) = UPPER(d.sub_pay_channel) AND /* and upper(a.bill_country) = upper(d.country) */ TO_DATE(a.m__log_time) >= d.start_day AND TO_DATE(a.m__log_time) < d.end_day AND d.sub_pay_channel <> '-' AND d.country = '-' LEFT JOIN paychannel_rate AS e ON UPPER(a.channel_id) = UPPER(e.pay_channel) AND /* and upper(a.sub_channel_id) = upper(e.sub_pay_channel) */ UPPER(a.bill_country) = UPPER(e.country) AND TO_DATE(a.m__log_time) >= e.start_day AND TO_DATE(a.m__log_time) < e.end_day AND e.sub_pay_channel = '-' AND e.country <> '-' LEFT JOIN paychannel_rate AS f ON UPPER(a.channel_id) = UPPER(f.pay_channel) AND /* and upper(a.sub_channel_id) = upper(f.sub_pay_channel) */ /* and upper(a.bill_country) = upper(f.country) */ TO_DATE(a.m__log_time) >= f.start_day AND TO_DATE(a.m__log_time) < f.end_day AND f.sub_pay_channel = '-' AND f.country = '-'), tax_amt_cal AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(fee_amt / fee_exchange_rate, 0) AS fee_usd_amt /* 手续费 */, CASE WHEN has_share_tax IN ('不含税', '含税') THEN COALESCE(before_tax_amt / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate, 0) WHEN has_share_tax = '净额' THEN COALESCE(((before_tax_amt * (1 - share_ratio) - COALESCE(fee_amt / fee_exchange_rate, 0) * exchange_rate) / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate), 0) ELSE COALESCE(before_tax_amt / (1 + tax_rate) * tax_rate, 0) END AS plat_tax_amt /* 税金 */ FROM tax_fee_join), after_amt_cal AS (SELECT *, before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt AS after_tax_amt /* 税后 */, CASE WHEN has_share_tax = '不含税' THEN (before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt) * share_ratio WHEN has_share_tax IN ('含税', '净额') THEN before_tax_amt * share_ratio ELSE (before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt) * share_ratio END AS share_amt /* 分成 */ FROM tax_amt_cal), actual_amt_cal AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN has_share_tax = '不含税' THEN after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate WHEN has_share_tax = '含税' THEN before_tax_amt - plat_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate WHEN has_share_tax = '净额' THEN (before_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate) / (1 + tax_rate) ELSE after_tax_amt - share_amt - fee_usd_amt * exchange_rate END AS actual_amt /* 实收 */ FROM after_amt_cal), money_cal AS (SELECT t1.*, CASE WHEN NOT t2.product_id IS NULL THEN CAST(t2.money AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) ELSE t1.before_tax_amt / COALESCE(t1.exchange_rate, 0) END AS money /* 商品定价(美分) */ FROM actual_amt_cal AS t1 LEFT JOIN product_price AS t2 ON LOWER(t1.product_id) = LOWER(t2.product_id)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_fsgame_charge_order_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT event_time, game_id, area_id, group_id, mid, character_id, character_name, character_level, character_stage, character_chapter, character_season, channel_id, sub_channel_id, platform, device_id, ce, openid, create_tick, world_id, test_type, client_ver, res_ver, country, city, language, m__account_id, m__distinct_id, m__type, m__time, m__event_name, m__lib, m__lib_version, m__log_time, m__msg_id, zone_code, ip, product_id, product_name, product_num, order_id, amount, channel_order_id, channel, cost_money, original_money, status, recharge_id, viplv, pay_mode, sel_id, m__properties, properties, environment, idx, login_ip, project_id, UPPER(bill_country) AS bill_country, UPPER(bill_currency) AS bill_currency, COALESCE(exchange_rate, 0) AS currency_exchange_rate /* 汇率为0合适吗 */, bill_amt, UPPER(before_tax_currency) AS before_tax_currency, before_tax_amt, UPPER(after_tax_currency) AS after_tax_currency, after_tax_amt, UPPER(actual_currency) AS actual_currency, actual_amt, tax_rate, UPPER(tax_currency) AS tax_currency, IF(COALESCE(is_pay_tax, '否') = '是', plat_tax_amt, 0) AS tax_amt, UPPER(back_tax_currency) AS back_tax_currency, IF(COALESCE(is_back_tax, '否') = '是', plat_tax_amt, 0) AS back_tax_amt, share_ratio, UPPER(share_currency) AS share_currency, COALESCE(share_amt, 0) AS share_amt, UPPER(fee_currency) AS fee_currency, COALESCE(fee_amt, 0) AS fee_amt, fee_exchange_rate, channel_id AS game_pay_channel, money FROM money_cal

t1.first_mt_country IS NULL), t1.first_mt_country, COALESCE(t1.first_ad_country, t2.first_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown')) AS first_mt_country, IF((t1.last_ad_country <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.last_ad_country IS NULL), t1.last_ad_country, COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown')) AS last_mt_country, t3.step_action_info /* COALESCE(t2.last_ad_country, t1.ip_country, 'unknown') AS last_mt_country, */, t1.app_version, IF((t1.campaign_id <> 'unknown' AND NOT t1.campaign_id IS NULL), t1.campaign_id, COALESCE(t2.campaign_id, 'unknown')) AS campaign_id, BY logymd) AS rn FROM msdk_dim.dim_basic_device_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-02' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND NOT (idfa = 'unknown' AND idfv = 'unknown' AND android_id = 'unknown' AND gps_adid = 'unknown' AND COALESCE(did, 'unknown') = 'unknown') /* fuxinwang：去除潜在的脏数据 */) WHERE rn = 1), af_install AS (/* 老数据，2024-10-31之后已经不再更新 */ SELECT package_name, msdk_app_id AS app_id, event_time AS package_name, msdk_app_id AS app_id, event_time AS create_time, server_time, os_name AS os, country_code, IF(media_source = 'Unattributed', IF(COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '', 'Facebook media_source_type = 2 THEN campaign_name ELSE campaign_name END AS campaign_name, CASE WHEN media_source_type = 1 THEN fb_adgroup_name WHEN media_source_type = 2 THEN NULL ELSE adgroup_name END AS adgroup_name, creative_name, gps_adid, android_id, country_code AS ad_country, oaid AS oaid, idfa AS idfa, idfv AS idfv, adjust_id AS mmp_id, msdk_did, COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.click_time'), 0) AS click_time, logymd FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN LOWER(media_source) = 'unattributed' AND COALESCE(TRIM(fb_install_referrer), '') <> '' THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(media_source) LIKE '%applovin%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS media_source_type FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_msdk_adjust_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND GET_JSON_OBJECT(others, '$.activity_kind') IN ('install')) AS t0), af_install_idfa /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'ios' -- 已知BUG: 正确逻辑是先用os过滤，再用idfa匹配 */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, idfa ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS idfa_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(idfa, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_idfv /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'ios' */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, idfv ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS idfv_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(idfv, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_gps_adid /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'android' */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, gps_adid ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS gps_adid_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(gps_adid, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_android_id /* AND     LOWER(os) = 'android' */ AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, android_id ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS android_id_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(android_id, 'unknown') <> 'unknown'), af_install_msdk_did AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, msdk_did ORDER BY create_time, server_time, click_time) AS msdk_did_rn FROM af_install WHERE COALESCE(msdk_did, 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AND LOWER(os) = 'windows' /* windows */), his_attr_did AS (SELECT did, APP_ID FROM bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di_test20251023 WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-30' GROUP BY did, APP_ID) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di_test20251023 PARTITION(logymd, app_id) /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE bi_test.dim_attribution_device_di PARTITION (logymd, app_id) -- 测试表 */ SELECT t1.did, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN 'ios_1' WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN 'ios_2' WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN 'android_1' WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN 'android_2' WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN 'pc_1' END AS attr_source, COALESCE(t2.create_time, t3.create_time, t4.create_time, t5.create_time, t7.create_time) AS event_time /* 是触发事件的时间 20220606 */, COALESCE(t2.server_time, t3.server_time, t4.server_time, t5.server_time, t7.server_time) AS attr_time /* server time是归因时间 20220606 */, t1.package_name, COALESCE(t2.os, t3.os, t4.os, t5.os, t7.os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(t2.ad_country, t3.ad_country, t4.ad_country, t5.ad_country, t7.ad_country, 'unknown') AS ad_country, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN t2.media_source WHEN NOT t3.idfv IS NULL THEN t3.media_source WHEN NOT t4.gps_adid IS NULL THEN t4.media_source WHEN NOT t5.android_id IS NULL THEN t5.media_source WHEN NOT t7.msdk_did IS NULL THEN t7.media_source ELSE 'unknown' END AS media_source /* COALESCE(t2.media_source, t3.media_source, t4.media_source, t5.media_source, 'unknown') AS media_source, */, CASE WHEN NOT t2.idfa IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t2.campaign_id, 'unknown') WHEN = 3, 1, 0)) AS is_download_start, MAX(IF(execute_type = 2 AND execute_result = 1, 1, 0)) AS is_download_finish, MAX(IF(execute_type = 3 AND execute_result = 3, 1, 0)) AS is_unzip_start, MAX(IF(execute_type = 3 AND execute_result = 1, 1, 0)) AS is_unzip_finish, MAX(IF(execute_type = 4 AND execute_result = 3, 1, 0)) AS is_combine_start, MAX(IF(execute_type = 4 AND execute_result = 1, 1, 0)) AS is_combine_finish, MAX(IF(execute_type = 5 AND execute_result = 3, 1, 0)) AS is_verify_start, MAX(IF(execute_type = 5 AND execute_result = 1, 1, 0)) AS is_verify_finish, MAX(IF(execute_type = 6, 1, 0)) AS is_finish, MAX(IF(execute_type = 15 AND execute_result = 3, 1, 0)) AS is_predownload_config_start, MAX(IF(execute_type = 15 AND execute_result = 1, 1, 0)) AS is_predownload_config_finish, MAX(IF(execute_type = 16 AND execute_result = 3, 1, 0)) AS is_generateresList_start, MAX(IF(execute_type = 16 AND execute_result = 1, 1, 0)) AS is_generateresList_finish, MAX(IF(execute_type = 17 AND execute_result = 3, 1, 0)) AS is_downloadcoreres_start, MAX(IF(execute_type = 17 AND execute_result = 1, 1, 0)) AS is_downloadcoreres_finish, MAX(IF(execute_type = 13 AND execute_result = 3, 1, 0)) AS is_back_donwload_start, MAX(IF(execute_type = 14, 1, 0)) AS is_back_finish FROM (SELECT b.deviceid /* b.loginid, */ /* b.accountid, */, a.version, a.diff_days, a.diff_date, a.start_date, a.start_datetime, a.end_date, a.end_datetime, MIN_BY(op_type, TIME) AS os_type, MIN_BY(FLOOR(zoneid / 1000), TIME) AS zone_type, MIN_BY(channel, TIME) AS channel_type, MIN_BY(REGEXP_EXTRACT(client_version, '([^.]+\\.[^.]+)$'), TIME) AS client_ver_last_two_parts FROM (SELECT version, start_date, end_date, start_datetime, end_datetime, diff_days, diff_date, active_start_date FROM ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-31' AND diff_date = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY version, start_date, end_date, start_datetime, end_datetime, diff_days, diff_date, active_start_date) AS a JOIN (SELECT device_id AS deviceid, TIME, op_type, zoneid, channel, client_version /* from ml_ods.gameserver_login    -- 把登录的表换成end表 */ FROM ml_ods.reportserver_client_loginv2_end WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-24' /* - 每次都前7天 保证覆盖到数据   */ AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND /* and op_type = 2 --限制安卓用户 */ LOWER(device_id) NOT LIKE '%ios%' /* 有些苹果设备被定义成了安卓系统 */ AND zoneid < 57000 AND LEVEL > 3 /* 限制过了教学观的用户 */) AS b ON b.time >= a.active_start_date AND b.time <= a.end_datetime GROUP BY b.deviceid /* b.loginid, */ /* b.accountid, */, a.version, a.diff_days, a.diff_date, a.start_date, a.start_datetime, a.end_date, a.end_datetime) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT deviceid /* b.accountid, */ /* b.loginid, */, b.execute_type, b.execute_result FROM (SELECT version, start_date, end_date, start_datetime, end_datetime, diff_days, diff_date, active_start_date FROM ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-31' AND diff_date = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY version, start_date, end_date, start_datetime, end_datetime, diff_days, diff_date, active_start_date) AS a JOIN (/* 计算设备设备的完成考虑 */ SELECT deviceid /* accountid, */ /* login_cnt loginid, */, execute_type, execute_result, TIME FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_ingameupdate WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-24' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND action_type = 2 AND zoneid < 57000) AS b ON b.time >= a.active_start_date AND b.time <= a.end_datetime GROUP BY deviceid /* b.accountid, */ /* b.loginid, */, b.execute_type, b.execute_result) AS b ON a.deviceid = b.deviceid GROUP BY a.deviceid, a.version, a.diff_days, a.diff_date, a.start_date, a.start_datetime, a.end_date, a.end_datetime, os_type, zone_type, channel_type, client_ver_last_two_parts) GROUP BY version, diff_days, diff_date, start_date, start_datetime, end_date, end_datetime, os_type, zone_type, channel_type, client_ver_last_two_parts

name: 不合理阵容alldata表_败方
sql_units: /* 输出：日期，pvptype，正式服/测服，battleid,round,accountid,zoneid,回合胜利/失败,算法1不合理对局标签,算法2不合理对局标签,指挥官，GoGo卡牌，第n羁绊，装备 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_hsu@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2025-11-26 14:48:10.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM mcgg_temp.susu_tmp_unreasonable_lineup_base_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), paired /* 2-2.取对局下回合失败方战斗力数据 */ AS (SELECT a.logymd, a.battleid, a.round, a.zoneid AS self_zone, a.accountid AS self_accountid, b.zoneid AS enmey_zone, b.accountid AS enemy_accountid, a.roundvalue1 AS self_rv1 /* 算法1双方战力 */, b.roundvalue1 AS enemy_rv1, a.roundvalue2 AS self_rv2 /* 算法2双方战力 */, b.roundvalue2 AS enemy_rv2, a.battleresult AS self_result /* 对局结果 */ FROM base AS a JOIN base AS b /* 排除NULL值：野怪boss */ ON a.battleid = b.battleid AND a.round = b.round AND a.enemyaccountid = b.accountid AND a.enemyaccountid <> 0 AND NOT a.enemyaccountid IS NULL WHERE a.battleresult /* 只筛选回合对局的失败方:战斗结果（0负1胜2空城平3互入超时平） */ = 0 AND /* 排除双方战力为0的情况 */ a.roundvalue1 <> 0 AND b.roundvalue1 <> 0 AND a.roundvalue2 <> 0 AND b.roundvalue2 <> 0 GROUP BY a.logymd, a.battleid, a.round, a.zoneid, a.accountid, b.zoneid, b.accountid, a.roundvalue1, b.roundvalue1, a.roundvalue2, b.roundvalue2, a.battleresult), unreasonable_rv /* 2-3.给判断条件返回是否为不合理对局，unreasonable_rv1/unreasonable_rv2是则返回1，否则返回0 */ AS (SELECT logymd, battleid, round, self_accountid, self_zone, self_result, enemy_accountid, CASE WHEN (self_rv1 * 1.0 / enemy_rv1) > 1.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unreasonable_rv1 /* ① roundvalue1： A/B */ /* 判定 roundvalue1 是否不合理回合 */ /* 条件：A/B > 1.3 AND  A失败（battleresult = 0） */, CASE WHEN (self_rv1 * 1.0 / enemy_rv1) > 2.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unreasonable_rv2 /* ② roundvalue2： A/B > 2.0 AND  A失败（battleresult = 0） */ FROM paired), all_data /* 3. 所有对局数据left JOIN 不合理对局标签+含AI对局 */ AS (SELECT t0.battleid /* 战斗ID回合用户IDzoneid */, t0.round, t0.accountid, t0.zoneid, CASE WHEN t0.zoneid < 50000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS servertype /* 服务器 */, t0.pvptype /* pvptype,大段位,是否含AI */, t0.max_rank, t0.real_player, t0.heroid /* 指挥官 */, t0.top1_rel /* 羁绊：前2羁绊	*/, t0.top2_rel, t0.gogo_m1 AS m1 /* GoGo卡牌 */, t0.gogo_m2 AS m2, t0.gogo_m3 AS m3, t0.battleresult /* 是否回合胜利 */, t1.unreasonable_rv1 /* 判断是否为不合理回合：是1，否0 */, t1.unreasonable_rv2 FROM base AS t0 LEFT JOIN unreasonable_rv AS t1 ON t0.battleid = t1.battleid AND t0.round = t1.round AND t0.accountid = t1.self_accountid AND t0.zoneid = t1.self_zone WHERE t0.battleresult /* 只筛选回合对局的失败方:战斗结果（0负1胜2空城平3互入超时平） */ = 0 AND (t1.unreasonable_rv1 = 1 OR t1.unreasonable_rv2 = 1) GROUP BY t0.battleid, t0.round, t0.accountid, t0.zoneid, servertype, t0.pvptype /* pvptype,大段位,是否含AI */, t0.max_rank, t0.real_player, t0.heroid /* 指挥官 */, t0.top1_rel /* 羁绊：前2羁绊	*/, t0.top2_rel, t0.gogo_m1 /* GoGo卡牌 */, t0.gogo_m2, t0.gogo_m3, t0.battleresult /* 是否回合胜利 */, t1.unreasonable_rv1 /* 判断是否为不合理回合：是1，否0 */, t1.unreasonable_rv2) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_temp.susu_tmp_unreasonable_lineup_all_data_defeat_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT battleid /* 战斗ID回合用户IDzoneid */, round, accountid, zoneid, servertype, pvptype, max_rank, real_player, heroid /* 指挥官 */, top1_rel /* 羁绊：前2羁绊	*/, top2_rel, m1 /* GoGo卡牌 */, m2, m3, battleresult /* 是否回合胜利 */, unreasonable_rv1 /* 判断是否为不合理回合：是1，否0 */, unreasonable_rv2 FROM all_data GROUP BY battleid, round, accountid, zoneid, servertype, pvptype, max_rank, real_player, heroid /* 指挥官 */, top1_rel /* 羁绊：前2羁绊	*/, top2_rel, m1 /* GoGo卡牌 */, m2, m3, battleresult /* 是否回合胜利 */, unreasonable_rv1 /* 判断是否为不合理回合：是1，否0 */, unreasonable_rv2

NOT df.roleid IS NULL AND NOT di.roleid IS NULL AND SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time, 1, 10) > df.his_last_active_date THEN df.his_last_active_date WHEN NOT df.roleid IS NULL AND SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time, 1, 10) < df.his_last_active_date THEN IF(SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time, 1, 10) > COALESCE(df.his_last_active_second_date, '1970-01-01'), SUBSTRING(di.last_login_time, 1, 10), df.his_last_active_second_date) ELSE df.his_last_active_second_date END AS his_last_active_second_date, COALESCE(di.active_days, df.total_active_days) AS total_active_days, (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY m__event_time DESC, m__server_time DESC, alliance_id) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid, zoneid ORDER BY m__event_time ASC, m__server_time ASC, purchase_type IN ('1', '3', '4') /* "支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test 3. Promo4. Rewarded" */) AS charge_di GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, IF(zoneid % 10000 <= 8000, 1, 0)

name: etl.nova_dw.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_utc8_df
sql_units: WITH basic_df AS (/* 基础信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, create_date AS register_date FROM nova_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), active_di AS (/* 活跃信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, COALESCE(online_duration, 0) AS online_duration /* 当日有活跃，无在线时长的给默认值0 */, SUBSTRING(last_login_time, 1, 10) AS active_date FROM nova_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(pay_cnt) AS charge_cnt, SUM(pay_amt) AS charge_amt, MAX(SUBSTRING(last_pay_time, 1, 10)) AS charge_date FROM nova_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), t_bitmap AS (/* 前一日 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_offset, create_date, charge_info, charge_cnt_total_array, charge_amt_total_array, charge_amt_array, online_dur_array, active_info, active_days_array, logymd, appid FROM nova_dw.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_utc8_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'nova') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE nova_dw.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_utc8_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'nova') SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, zone_offset, register_date AS create_date /* 无注册日期给默认值 */, IF(LENGTH(active_info) > 0 AND '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(active_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(active_info))), COALESCE(active_info, '')) AS active_info, IF(LENGTH(charge_info) > 0 AND /* 只补齐有位图的，并且当日日期大于注册日的 */ '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(charge_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(charge_info))), COALESCE(charge_info, '') /* 可能存在有位图没有注册日期的 */) AS charge_info, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_amt_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_amt_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_amt_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_amt_array /* 2、付费金额位图 */, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_cnt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_cnt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_cnt_total_array /* 2、累计付费次数位图: 补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有付费用户） */, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_amt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_amt_total_array /* 3、累计付费金额位图: 补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有付费用户） */, CAST(IF(SIZE(online_dur_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(online_dur_array)) > 0, CONCAT(online_dur_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(online_dur_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(online_dur_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS online_dur_array /* --在线时长位图,补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有在线用户） */, CAST(IF(SIZE(active_days_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(active_days_array)) > 0, CONCAT(active_days_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(active_days_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(active_days_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS active_days_array /* 活跃天数位图补齐(array) */ FROM (SELECT td.roleid, td.zoneid, td.register_date, td.zone_type, td.zone_offset, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31', CONCAT('1', COALESCE(ld.active_info, '')), IF(LENGTH(ld.active_info) > 0, CONCAT('0', ld.active_info), '')) AS active_info, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31', CONCAT('1', COALESCE(ld.charge_info, '')), IF(LENGTH(ld.charge_info) > 0, CONCAT('0', charge_info), '')) AS charge_info, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_amt_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_amt_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.charge_amt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_amt_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_amt, 0))), ld.charge_amt_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_amt_array, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_cnt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_cnt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(charge_cnt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_cnt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_cnt, 0) + ld.charge_cnt_total_array[0])), ld.charge_cnt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_cnt_total_array, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_amt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_amt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.charge_amt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_amt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_amt, 0) + ld.charge_amt_total_array[0])), ld.charge_amt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_amt_total_array, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.online_dur_array IS NULL OR ld.online_dur_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.online_duration), IF(SIZE(ld.online_dur_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.online_duration, 0))), ld.online_dur_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS online_dur_array, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.active_days_array IS NULL OR ld.active_days_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(1), IF(SIZE(ld.active_days_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(is_td_active + ld.active_days_array[0])), ld.active_days_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS active_days_array FROM (SELECT bas.roleid, bas.zoneid, bas.zone_type, bas.zone_offset, bas.register_date, act.active_date, act.online_duration, pay.charge_cnt, pay.charge_amt, pay.charge_date, IF(act.active_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_td_active FROM basic_df AS bas /* basic表 */ LEFT JOIN active_di AS act /* 活跃 */ ON bas.roleid = act.roleid AND bas.zoneid = act.zoneid LEFT JOIN pay_di AS pay /* 支付 */ ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid AND bas.zoneid = pay.zoneid) AS td LEFT JOIN t_bitmap AS ld /* 前一日 */ ON td.roleid = ld.roleid AND td.zoneid = ld.zoneid) AS t

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_game_guide_match_highlights_detail_battleid_df
sql_units: WITH bigrank AS (SELECT bigranklvl, score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bigranklvl ORDER BY score DESC) AS rn, COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY bigranklvl) AS score_total FROM (SELECT bigranklvl, score FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2 GROUP BY bigranklvl, score) AS t1), his_battle_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, highest_kills_battleid, highest_kills_role_list, highest_damage_battleid, highest_damage_role_list, highest_assists_battleid, highest_assists_role_list, highest_score_battleid, highest_score_role_list, highest_damage_taken_battleid, highest_damage_taken_role_list, highest_gold_battleid, highest_gold_role_list, highest_tower_damage_battleid, highest_tower_damage_role_list FROM mt_dm.dm_game_guide_match_highlights_detail_battleid_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), battle_info AS (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.battleid, t1.heroid, t1.killnum, t1.deadnum, t1.assistnum, t1.real_road, t1.score, t1.ismvp, t1.wincamp, t1.time, t1.herolvl, t1.battletime /* ,t1.mmr_new */, t1.fake_ai, t1.equip1, t1.equip2, t1.equip3, t1.equip4, t1.equip5, t1.equip6, t1.equip7, camp, herohurt, bigranklvl, SUM(killnum) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.battleid, t1.camp) AS total_killnum, SUM(herohurt) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.battleid, t1.camp) AS total_herohurt FROM (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, battleid, heroid, killnum, deadnum, assistnum, score, ismvp, wincamp, time, herolvl, battletime, fake_ai, equip1, equip2, equip3, equip4, equip5, equip6, equip7, camp, herohurt, bigranklvl /* ,mmr_new */, real_road, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, zoneid, battleid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2) AS t1 WHERE rn = 1), battle_list AS (SELECT battleid, TO_JSON(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(camp, heroid, roleid, zoneid, killnum, deadnum, assistnum, COALESCE(ROUND((killnum + assistnum) / total_killnum, 4), 0), herohurt, COALESCE(ROUND(herohurt / total_herohurt, 4), 0), t1.score, ismvp, ARRAY(equip1, equip2, equip3, equip4, equip5, equip6, equip7), ROUND(1 - t2.rn / t2.score_total, 4), UNIX_TIMESTAMP(time), battletime, total_killnum, wincamp, herolvl, fake_ai, real_road))) AS role_list FROM battle_info AS t1 LEFT JOIN bigrank AS t2 ON t1.bigranklvl = t2.bigranklvl AND t1.score = t2.score GROUP BY battleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_game_guide_match_highlights_detail_battleid_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', data_type = 'full') SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.highest_kills_battleid, COALESCE(t2.role_list, t10.highest_kills_role_list) AS highest_kills_role_list, t1.highest_damage_battleid, COALESCE(t3.role_list, t10.highest_damage_role_list) AS highest_damage_role_list, t1.highest_assists_battleid, COALESCE(t4.role_list, t10.highest_assists_role_list) AS highest_assists_role_list, t1.highest_score_battleid, COALESCE(t5.role_list, t10.highest_score_role_list) AS highest_score_role_list, t1.highest_damage_taken_battleid, COALESCE(t6.role_list, t10.highest_damage_taken_role_list) AS highest_damage_taken_role_list, t1.highest_gold_battleid, COALESCE(t7.role_list, t10.highest_gold_role_list) AS highest_gold_role_list, t1.highest_tower_damage_battleid, COALESCE(t8.role_list, t10.highest_tower_damage_role_list) AS highest_tower_damage_role_list FROM mt_dm.dm_game_guide_match_highlight_details_role_zone_df AS t1 LEFT JOIN battle_list AS t2 ON t1.highest_kills_battleid = t2.battleid LEFT JOIN battle_list AS t3 ON t1.highest_damage_battleid = t3.battleid LEFT JOIN battle_list AS t4 ON t1.highest_assists_battleid = t4.battleid LEFT JOIN battle_list AS t5 ON t1.highest_score_battleid = t5.battleid LEFT JOIN battle_list AS t6 ON t1.highest_damage_taken_battleid = t6.battleid LEFT JOIN battle_list AS t7 ON t1.highest_gold_battleid = t7.battleid LEFT JOIN battle_list AS t8 ON t1.highest_tower_damage_battleid = t8.battleid LEFT JOIN his_battle_info AS t10 ON t1.roleid = t10.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t10.zoneid WHERE t1.logymd = '2026-05-31'

sql_units: /* WITH bangeng AS ( */ /*     SELECT  version, */ /*             start_date, */ /*             end_date, */ /*             formal_start_date, */ /*             formal_start_datetime */ /*     FROM    ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy */ /*     WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /*     GROUP BY */ /*             version, */ /*             start_date, */ /*             end_date, */ /*             formal_start_date, */ /*             formal_start_datetime, */ /*             logymd */ /* ), */ /* -- 预下载信息保持不变 */ /* --相当于也是给deviceid+version一个标签 */ /* all_predownload AS ( */ /*     SELECT  */ /*         bd.deviceid, */ /*         a.version, */ /*         MAX(bd.is_zl_predownload_finish) AS is_zl_predownload_finish, */ /*         MAX(bd.is_finish) AS is_finish, */ /*         MAX(bd.is_downloadcoreres_finish) AS is_downloadcoreres_finish */ /*     FROM    ml_temp.amandapiao_device_behavior_daily bd */ /*     INNER JOIN ( */ /*         SELECT  version, start_date, end_date */ /*         FROM    bangeng */ /*     ) a ON bd.logymd BETWEEN a.start_date AND a.end_date */ /*     WHERE   bd.logymd <= '2026-05-31' */ /*     GROUP BY bd.deviceid, a.version */ /* ) */ /* -- 直接从中间表读取，避免复杂计算 */ /* INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.amandapiao_version_post_predownload_status PARTITION (logymd = '2026-05-31') */ /* SELECT  */ /*     cp.version, */ /*     cp.post_diff_days, */ /*     cp.day_date, */ /*     cp.os_type, */ /*     cp.zone_type, */ /*     cp.channel_type, */ /*     cp.client_ver_last_two_parts, */ /*     COUNT(DISTINCT cp.deviceid) AS cumulative_device_count, */ /*     COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ap.is_zl_predownload_finish = 1 THEN cp.deviceid END) AS zl_predownload_finish_count, */ /*     COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ap.is_finish = 1 THEN cp.deviceid END) AS rgb_finish_count, */ /*     COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ap.is_downloadcoreres_finish = 1 THEN cp.deviceid END) AS downloadcoreres_finish_count */ /* FROM    ml_temp.amandapiao_cumulated_players_daily_label cp  -- 直接使用中间表 */ /* LEFT JOIN all_predownload ap */ /*     ON cp.deviceid = ap.deviceid AND cp.version = ap.version */ /* WHERE   cp.logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /* GROUP BY */ /*     cp.version, */ /*     cp.post_diff_days, */ /*     cp.day_date, */ /*     cp.os_type, */ /*     cp.zone_type, */ /*     cp.channel_type, */ /*     cp.client_ver_last_two_parts; */ WITH bangeng AS (SELECT version, start_date, end_date, formal_start_date, formal_start_datetime FROM ml_temp.predownload_datetime_v2_zxy WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY version, start_date, end_date, formal_start_date, formal_start_datetime, logymd), version_days AS (SELECT version, formal_start_date, day_date, CAST(post_diff_days AS INT) AS post_diff_days FROM ml_temp.amandapiao_post_update_days WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND day_date <= '2026-05-31' AND /* AND version = '1.9.90' */ day_date = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY version, formal_start_date, day_date, CAST(post_diff_days AS INT)), all_predownload /* 预下载标签 */ AS (SELECT bd.deviceid, a.version, MAX(bd.is_zl_predownload_finish) AS is_zl_predownload_finish, MAX(bd.is_finish) AS is_finish, MAX(bd.is_downloadcoreres_finish) AS is_downloadcoreres_finish FROM ml_temp.amandapiao_device_behavior_daily AS bd INNER JOIN (SELECT version, start_date, end_date FROM bangeng) AS a ON bd.logymd BETWEEN a.start_date AND a.end_date WHERE bd.logymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY bd.deviceid, a.version), first_login_label AS (SELECT cp.version, cp.deviceid, MIN(cp.logymd) AS first_login_date, MIN_BY(cp.post_diff_days, cp.logymd) AS first_post_diff_days, MIN_BY(cp.os_type, cp.logymd) AS os_type, MIN_BY(cp.zone_type, cp.logymd) AS zone_type, MIN_BY(cp.channel_type, cp.logymd) AS channel_type, MIN_BY(cp.client_ver_last_two_parts, cp.logymd) AS client_ver_last_two_parts FROM ml_temp.amandapiao_cumulated_players_daily_label AS cp WHERE cp.logymd <= '2026-05-31' /* and cp.day_date BETWEEN vd.formal_start_date AND vd.day_date */ GROUP BY cp.version, cp.deviceid), cumulative_devices /* 累计设备计算 */ AS (SELECT fl.version, vd.post_diff_days, vd.day_date, fl.os_type, fl.zone_type, fl.channel_type, fl.client_ver_last_two_parts, fl.deviceid, ap.is_zl_predownload_finish, ap.is_finish, ap.is_downloadcoreres_finish FROM first_login_label AS fl INNER JOIN version_days AS vd ON fl.version = vd.version INNER JOIN ml_temp.amandapiao_cumulated_players_daily_label AS cp /* 版更后每一天的登录数据 */ ON fl.version = cp.version AND fl.deviceid = cp.deviceid AND cp.day_date <= vd.day_date /* 关键：设备在目标日期之前登录过 */ AND cp.logymd <= '2026-05-31' LEFT JOIN all_predownload AS ap ON fl.deviceid = ap.deviceid AND fl.version = ap.version) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.amandapiao_version_post_predownload_status PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT version, post_diff_days, day_date, os_type, zone_type, channel_type, client_ver_last_two_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT deviceid) AS cumulative_device_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_zl_predownload_finish = 1 THEN deviceid END) AS zl_predownload_finish_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_finish = 1 THEN deviceid END) AS rgb_finish_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_downloadcoreres_finish = 1 THEN deviceid END) AS downloadcoreres_finish_count FROM cumulative_devices GROUP BY version, post_diff_days, day_date, os_type, zone_type, channel_type, client_ver_last_two_parts

 STRING          comment '装备信息', */ /*     hero_list               STRING          comment '英雄信息', */ /*     cur_hero                STRING          comment '当前英雄信息', */ /*     manual_list   STRING          comment '改造', */ /*     remain_diamonds         BIGINT          comment '剩余钻石', */ /*     remain_coin             BIGINT          comment '剩余金币', */ /*     remain_energy   STRING          comment '装备的僚机的养成', */ /*     gallery_wingman         STRING          comment '图鉴僚机', */ /*     gallery_clue            STRING          comment '图鉴线索', */ /*     gallery_monster         STRING          comment '图鉴怪物', */ /*     remain_item1            STRING          comment '道具日志1', */ /*     remain_item2            STRING          comment '道具日志2', */ /*     remain_item3            STRING          comment '道具日志3', */ /*     total_payment           BIGINT          comment '累计付费（带M券）', */ /*     ace_card_suit           STRING          comment '闪卡套装', */ /*     ace_card_num            STRING          comment '闪卡数', */ /*     last_challenge_power    BIGINT          comment '玩家战力', */ /*     player_name             STRING          comment '玩家名字', */ /*     day_sub_energy_num      BIGINT          comment '每日体力消耗', */ /*     day_add_diamond_num     BIGINT          comment '每日钻石获得', */ /*     day_sub_diamond_num     BIGINT          comment '每日钻石消耗', */ /*     day_item111_num         BIGINT          comment '普通招募券获得', */ /*     day_item120_num         BIGINT          comment '高级招募券获得', */ /*     day_add_coin_num        BIGINT          comment '每日日金币获得', */ /* /*     day_wingman_gacha_num   BIGINT          comment '僚机招募次数', */ /*     day_main_num            BIGINT          comment '主线挑战次数', */ /*     day_win_main_num        BIGINT          comment '主线胜利次数', BIGINT          comment '万象挑战-当日挑战-扫荡', */ /*     day_worldboss_num       BIGINT          comment '天外来敌-当日挑战', */ /*     day_boss_damage         BIGINT          comment '天外来敌-当日挑战-伤害值', */ /*     day_side_stage_num      BIGINT          comment '角色外传-挑战次数', */ /*     side_stageid            BIGINT          comment '角色外传-挑战进度', */ /*     day_tempustrek_num      BIGINT          comment '时光迷途-次数',
