*/ WITH t1 AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY video_id ORDER BY like_count DESC) AS rn, CASE WHEN query IN ('mlbb', 'mobile legends') THEN '1001' WHEN query IN ('watcherofrealms') THEN '3001' WHEN query IN ('magic chess go go', 'mcgg') THEN '4280' WHEN query IN ('silver and blood') THEN '4400' WHEN query IN ('acecraft') THEN '4310' ELSE NULL END AS app_id /* appid映射逻辑 */ FROM (SELECT *, FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(video_create_time AS BIGINT) + 8 * 3600) AS post_beijing_time /* 最终北京时间 = 原始时间 + (时区偏移绝对值 + 8小时) */, FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(comment_published_at AS BIGINT) + 8 * 3600) AS comment_beijing_time FROM adbi.dwd_sentiment_public_tiktok_di WHERE p_date = '2026-06-01' AND query IN ('silver and blood')) WHERE TO_DATE(post_beijing_time) >= DATE_ADD(p_date, 7 * -1) AND TO_DATE(post_beijing_time) <= DATE_ADD(p_date, 1 * -1) /* 筛选帖子创建日期（最近7天） */ AND TO_DATE(comment_beijing_time) = DATE_ADD(p_date, 1 * -1) /* 筛选评论创建日期（最近1天） */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwm_sentiment_public_tiktok_di PARTITION(p_date = '2026-06-01', app_id = '4400') /* 静态指定分区值（dt=日期，region=地区） */ /* 目标分区表名 */ (SELECT `video_id`, `description`, `video_create_time`, `author_id`, `author_unique_id`, `play_count`, `like_count`, `comment_count`, `share_count`, `collect_count`, `video_url`, `query`, `comment_id`, `comment_author`, `comment_text`, `comment_like_count`, `comment_published_at`, `comment_reply_count`, `comment_cnt`, `comment_beijing_time` FROM (SELECT t2.*, t3.comment_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE app_id = '4400' /* 筛选appid，目前这里没有config配置表 */) AS t2 LEFT JOIN (SELECT video_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_cnt /* 帖子评论数量 */ FROM t1 GROUP BY video_id) AS t3 ON t2.video_id = t3.video_id) WHERE comment_cnt >= 30 /* 筛选评论数大于等于30的帖子 */ AND rn <= 300 /* 筛选点赞数前300的评论 */)

WITH t1 AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY video_id ORDER BY like_count DESC) AS rn, CASE WHEN query IN ('mlbb', 'mobile legends') THEN '1001' WHEN query IN ('watcherofrealms') THEN '3001' WHEN query IN ('magic chess go go', 'mcgg') THEN '4280' WHEN query IN ('silver and blood') THEN '4400' WHEN query IN ('acecraft') THEN '4310' ELSE NULL END AS app_id /* appid映射逻辑 */ FROM (SELECT *, FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(video_create_time AS BIGINT) + 8 * 3600) AS post_beijing_time /* 最终北京时间 = 原始时间 + (时区偏移绝对值 + 8小时) */, FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(comment_published_at AS BIGINT) + 8 * 3600) AS comment_beijing_time FROM adbi.dwd_sentiment_public_tiktok_di WHERE p_date = '2026-06-01' AND NOT query IN ('silver and blood')) WHERE TO_DATE(post_beijing_time) >= DATE_ADD(p_date, 7 * -1) AND TO_DATE(post_beijing_time) <= DATE_ADD(p_date, 1 * -1) /* 筛选帖子创建日期（最近7天） */ AND TO_DATE(comment_beijing_time) = DATE_ADD(p_date, 1 * -1) /* 筛选评论创建日期（最近1天） */) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwm_sentiment_public_tiktok_di PARTITION(p_date = '2026-06-01', app_id) /* 静态指定分区值（dt=日期，region=地区） */ /* 目标分区表名 */ (SELECT `video_id`, `description`, `video_create_time`, `author_id`, `author_unique_id`, `play_count`, `like_count`, `comment_count`, `share_count`, `collect_count`, `video_url`, `query`, `comment_id`, `comment_author`, `comment_text`, `comment_like_count`, `comment_published_at`, `comment_reply_count`, `comment_cnt`, `comment_beijing_time`, app_id FROM (SELECT t2.*, t3.comment_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE app_id IN ('1001', '3001', '4280', '4310') /* 筛选appid，目前这里没有config配置表 */) AS t2 LEFT JOIN (SELECT video_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_cnt /* 帖子评论数量 */ FROM t1 GROUP BY video_id) AS t3 ON t2.video_id = t3.video_id) WHERE comment_cnt >= 20 /* 筛选评论数大于等于20的帖子 */ AND rn <= 300 /* 筛选点赞数前300的评论 */)

'2023-07-01', '2023-07-01', '2026-05-31') AND create_account_date <= '2026-05-31') AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid, MIN(COALESCE(is_cur_bot, 0)) AS is_cur_bot, MAX(COALESCE(is_active, 0)) AS is_active, SUM(COALESCE(charge_amount, 0)) AS charge_amount, SUM(COALESCE(cum_charge_amount, 0)) AS cum_charge_amount FROM mt_dm.dm_zgame_behavior_feature_role_zone_df /* 宽表已剔除测试服 */ WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-07-01', '2023-07-01', '2026-05-31') AND create_account_date <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid) AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.accountid WHERE t1.rn = 1), t_active_di AS (SELECT roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days FROM bi_test.dwm_zgame_active_role_zone_di /* 已剔除测试服 */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01') AND LAST_DAY('2026-05-31') AND logymd >= '2023-07-01' GROUP BY roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads_pre.ads_gamebi_roger_secondary_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'zgame', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'monthly') /* 全量数据 */ SELECT SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AS date_range, COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(network, 'unknown') AS network, CAST(MAP('avg_active_cnt', COALESCE(avg_active_cnt, 0), 'mau', COALESCE(mau, 0)) AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>) AS indicator_map, COALESCE(os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(channel, 'unknown') AS channel, -99999 AS network_group, -99999 AS new_type, -99999 AS install_label, -99999 AS arcade_label, -99999 AS active_label, 1 AS user_type, COALESCE(zone_group, 'unknown') AS zone_group FROM (SELECT basic.country, basic.os, basic.channel, basic.network, basic.zone_group, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid) AS mau, COALESCE(SUM(act.active_days) / (CASE WHEN SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) = '2023-07' THEN (DATEDIFF(LAST_DAY('2026-05-31'), '2023-07-01') + 1) ELSE (DATEDIFF(LAST_DAY('2026-05-31'), DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01')) + 1) END), 0) AS avg_active_cnt /* 日均活跃天数 */ FROM basic LEFT JOIN t_active_di AS act ON basic.accountid = act.roleid GROUP BY basic.country, basic.os, basic.channel, basic.network, basic.zone_group) UNION ALL /* 剔除刷号数据 */ SELECT SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AS date_range, COALESCE(country, 'unknown') AS country, COALESCE(network, 'unknown') AS network, CAST(MAP('avg_active_cnt', COALESCE(avg_active_cnt, 0), 'mau', COALESCE(mau, 0)) AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>) AS indicator_map, COALESCE(os, 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(channel, 'unknown') AS channel, -99999 AS network_group, -99999 AS new_type, -99999 AS install_label, -99999 AS arcade_label, -99999 AS active_label, 1 AS user_type, COALESCE(zone_group, 'unknown') AS zone_group FROM (SELECT basic.country, basic.os, basic.channel, basic.network, basic.zone_group, COUNT(DISTINCT act.roleid) AS mau, COALESCE(SUM(act.active_days) / (CASE WHEN SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) = '2023-07' THEN (DATEDIFF(LAST_DAY('2026-05-31'), '2023-07-01') + 1) ELSE (DATEDIFF(LAST_DAY('2026-05-31'), DATE_FORMAT('2026-05-31', 'yyyy-MM-01')) + 1) END), 0) AS avg_active_cnt /* 日均活跃天数 */ FROM basic LEFT JOIN t_active_di AS act ON basic.accountid = act.roleid WHERE basic.is_cur_bot = 0 GROUP BY basic.country, basic.os, basic.channel, basic.network, basic.zone_group)

name: etl.mcgg_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df
sql_units: /* 关联取玩家全局排序 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: theoguo@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2023-02-08 14:27:30.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* date   owner  comment */ /* 2025-08-19 theo 新增abtest相关账号 初始化到2025-08-15 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  external TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mcgg_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df ( */ /*     roleid  DECIMAL(20, 0)  COMMENT '账号id', */ /*     zoneid  BIGINT          COMMENT '区服id', */ /*     uid     DECIMAL(20, 0)  COMMENT '角色唯一id' */ /* ) COMMENT 'dm账号映射uid表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* location 's3a://moonton-mcgg/table/mcgg_dm/dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df' */ /* 初始日期为2023-01-01 */ WITH his_data AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, uid FROM mcgg_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-07-01', '2025-07-01', '2026-05-30')), new_user /* 取出新增用户并排序 */ AS (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, t1.register_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY '2026-05-31' ORDER BY roleid, zoneid) AS rn_sort, '2026-05-31' AS max_key FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.register_time FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(register_time) AS register_time FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, create_role_time AS register_time FROM mcgg_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' UNION ALL SELECT accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, time AS register_time FROM mcgg_ods.abtestserver_abtest_tag WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(old_zoneid, 0) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT accountid AS roleid, old_zoneid AS zoneid, time AS register_time FROM mcgg_ods.mtabtestserver_mtabtest_tag WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(old_zoneid, 0) > 0) AS t1 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN his_data AS hd ON a.roleid = hd.roleid AND a.zoneid = hd.zoneid WHERE hd.roleid IS NULL) AS t1), max_uid /* 取出历史最大uid */ AS (SELECT MAX(uid) AS max_uid, '2026-05-31' AS max_key FROM his_data) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mcgg_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT roleid, zoneid, uid FROM his_data UNION ALL SELECT nu.roleid, nu.zoneid, COALESCE(mu.max_uid, 0) + nu.rn_sort FROM new_user AS nu LEFT JOIN max_uid AS mu ON nu.max_key = mu.max_key

name: jaxzhong_皮肤白膜率
sql_units: /* ----观察用户补下载完成时刻，缺的英雄里面，有哪些已经下完，哪些没下完，然后下完英雄里有多少遇到白膜，没下完的多少遇到白膜。 */ /* set spark.dynamicAllocation.maxExecutors=30; */ /* set spark.executors.cores=4; */ /* set spark.executor.memory=14g; */ /* set spark.executor.memoryOverHead=2048; */ /* set spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.initialPartitionNum=300; */ WITH skin_nores_explode AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, level, game_channel, os_type, device, device_id, total_disk_space_kb, grading_id, real_picture_quality, now_picture_quality, login_id, client_version, big_rank, small_rank, battle_id, pvp_type, black_num, team_ai_num, enemy_ai_num, realpvptype, skinid, hit_expected_skinid_list, expected_module_available, 'self' AS skin_type FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, level, game_channel, os_type, device, device_id, total_disk_space_kb, grading_id, real_picture_quality, now_picture_quality, login_id, client_version, big_rank, small_rank, battle_id, pvp_type, black_num, team_ai_num, enemy_ai_num, realpvptype, SPLIT(self_nores_skin_id, ',') AS self_nores_skin_id, hit_expected_skinid_list, expected_module_available FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_skin_nores WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS sub LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(self_nores_skin_id) exploded_table AS skinid WHERE NOT skinid IS NULL AND CAST(skinid AS STRING) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, level, game_channel, os_type, device, device_id, total_disk_space_kb, grading_id, real_picture_quality, now_picture_quality, login_id, client_version, big_rank, small_rank, battle_id, pvp_type, black_num, team_ai_num, enemy_ai_num, realpvptype, skinid, hit_expected_skinid_list, expected_module_available, 'team' AS skin_type FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, level, game_channel, os_type, device, device_id, total_disk_space_kb, grading_id, real_picture_quality, now_picture_quality, login_id, client_version, big_rank, small_rank, battle_id, pvp_type, black_num, team_ai_num, enemy_ai_num, realpvptype, SPLIT(team_nores_skinid_list, ',') AS team_nores_skinid_list, hit_expected_skinid_list, expected_module_available FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_skin_nores WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS sub LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(team_nores_skinid_list) exploded_table AS skinid WHERE NOT skinid IS NULL AND CAST(skinid AS STRING) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, level, game_channel, os_type, device, device_id, total_disk_space_kb, grading_id, real_picture_quality, now_picture_quality, login_id, client_version, big_rank, small_rank, battle_id, pvp_type, black_num, team_ai_num, enemy_ai_num, realpvptype, skinid, hit_expected_skinid_list, expected_module_available, 'enemy' AS skin_type FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, level, game_channel, os_type, device, device_id, total_disk_space_kb, grading_id, real_picture_quality, now_picture_quality, login_id, client_version, big_rank, small_rank, battle_id, pvp_type, black_num, team_ai_num, enemy_ai_num, realpvptype, SPLIT(enemy_nores_skinid_list, ',') AS enemy_nores_skinid_list, hit_expected_skinid_list, expected_module_available FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_skin_nores WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS sub LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(enemy_nores_skinid_list) exploded_table AS skinid WHERE NOT skinid IS NULL AND CAST(skinid AS STRING) <> ''), regular_skinid_list /* --预期不下载的皮肤id */ AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battle_id, skinid FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battle_id, SPLIT(regular_skinid_list, ',') AS regular_skinid_list, hit_expected_skinid_list, expected_module_available FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_skin_nores WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS sub LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(regular_skinid_list) exploded_table AS skinid WHERE NOT skinid IS NULL AND CAST(skinid AS STRING) <> '' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, battle_id, skinid), ai_skinid_list /* --AI用户的皮肤id */ AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battle_id, skinid FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battle_id, SPLIT(ai_nores_skinid_list, ',') AS ai_nores_skinid_list, hit_expected_skinid_list, expected_module_available FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_skin_nores WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS sub LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(ai_nores_skinid_list) exploded_table AS skinid WHERE NOT skinid IS NULL AND CAST(skinid AS STRING) <> '' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, battle_id, skinid), hit_expected_skinid_list /* --处于下载队列的皮肤id */ AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battle_id, skinid FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battle_id, SPLIT(hit_expected_skinid_list, ',') AS hit_expected_skinid_list FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_skin_nores WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS sub LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(hit_expected_skinid_list) exploded_table AS skinid WHERE NOT skinid IS NULL AND CAST(skinid AS STRING) <> '' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, battle_id, skinid), expected_module_available /* --下载完成的皮肤id */ AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battle_id, skinid FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, zoneid, battle_id, SPLIT(expected_module_available, ',') AS expected_module_available FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_skin_nores WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS sub LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(expected_module_available) exploded_table AS skinid WHERE NOT skinid IS NULL AND CAST(skinid AS STRING) <> '' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, zoneid, battle_id, skinid), black_roomid_and_skin AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, zoneid, MAX(IF(black_room_id > 0, black_room_id, roomid)) AS roomid, MAX(uiskinid) AS uiskinid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY logymd, accountid, battleid, zoneid), use_rtc AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN voiceontype IN (1, 2, 0) THEN voiceontype ELSE 0 END) AS voiceontype, MAX(CASE WHEN voiceontype IN (1, 2, 0) THEN voicetotaltime / 60 ELSE 0 END) AS voicetotaltime /* --收听时长，分钟 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND COALESCE(isbot, 0) = 0 GROUP BY logymd, accountid, battleid, zoneid), use_rtc_time AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, battleid, zoneid, SUM(usedtime) / 60 AS daily_usedtime /* -单位分钟 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_voiceon WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND voiceontype = 3 AND usedtime > 0 AND usedtime < 20000 GROUP BY logymd, accountid, battleid, zoneid), output_table AS (SELECT s1.accountid, s1.zoneid, s1.level, s1.game_channel, s1.os_type, s1.device, s1.device_id, s1.total_disk_space_kb, s1.grading_id, s1.real_picture_quality, s1.now_picture_quality, s1.login_id, s1.client_version, s1.big_rank, s1.small_rank, s1.battle_id, s1.pvp_type, s1.black_num, s1.team_ai_num, s1.enemy_ai_num, s1.realpvptype, s1.skinid, s1.hit_expected_skinid_list, s1.expected_module_available, s1.skin_type /* --自身，队友，敌人 */, IF(NOT s2.skinid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_regular_skinid /* --预期不下载(低档包皮肤不下载) */, IF(NOT s3.skinid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_ai_skinid /* --AI皮肤id */, IF(NOT s4.skinid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_selfdown_skinid /* --命中个性化下载 */, IF(NOT s5.skinid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_available_skinid /* --个性化下载已下载完成 */, xx1.skin_heroid, xx1.skin_quality, xx1.skin_value, xx1.skin_name, xx1.added_time, xx2.hero_name, xx2.hero_en_name, xx2.position, xx2.hero_type, xx2.sub_position, xx2.heroic_difficulty, s6.roomid /* -用户所属的房间id */, s7.accountid AS skin_nores_userid /* -- 皮肤白膜是哪个用户,如果是自身皮肤白膜，则accountid=skin_nores_userid */, s7.roomid AS skin_nores_roomid /* -- 看到皮肤白膜的用户对应的roomid，如果和自己的roomid相同则表明是一起开黑 */, s8.voiceontype, s8.voicetotaltime, s9.daily_usedtime AS rtc_time_minute FROM skin_nores_explode AS s1 LEFT JOIN regular_skinid_list AS s2 ON s1.logymd = s2.logymd AND s1.accountid = s2.accountid AND s1.zoneid = s2.zoneid AND s1.battle_id = s2.battle_id AND s1.skinid = s2.skinid LEFT JOIN ai_skinid_list AS s3 ON s1.logymd = s3.logymd AND s1.accountid = s3.accountid AND s1.zoneid = s3.zoneid AND s1.battle_id = s3.battle_id AND s1.skinid = s3.skinid LEFT JOIN hit_expected_skinid_list AS s4 ON s1.logymd = s4.logymd AND s1.accountid = s4.accountid AND s1.zoneid = s4.zoneid AND s1.battle_id = s4.battle_id AND s1.skinid = s4.skinid LEFT JOIN expected_module_available AS s5 ON s1.logymd = s5.logymd AND s1.accountid = s5.accountid AND s1.zoneid = s5.zoneid AND s1.battle_id = s5.battle_id AND s1.skinid = s5.skinid LEFT JOIN black_roomid_and_skin AS s6 ON s1.logymd = s6.logymd AND s1.accountid = s6.accountid AND s1.zoneid = s6.zoneid AND s1.battle_id = s6.battleid /* --带上用户的room id标签 */ LEFT JOIN black_roomid_and_skin AS s7 ON s1.logymd = s7.logymd AND s1.zoneid = s7.zoneid AND s1.battle_id = s7.battleid AND s1.skinid = s7.uiskinid /* --带上用户遇到的所有皮肤白膜用户对应的roomid标签，用来算是否开黑的皮肤白膜 */ LEFT JOIN use_rtc AS s8 ON s1.logymd = s8.logymd AND s1.zoneid = s8.zoneid AND s1.battle_id = s8.battleid AND s1.accountid = s8.accountid /* -计算自身的语音使用时长 */ LEFT JOIN use_rtc_time AS s9 ON s1.logymd = s9.logymd AND s1.zoneid = s9.zoneid AND s1.battle_id = s9.battleid AND s1.accountid = s9.accountid /* -计算自身的语音使用时长 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT skinid, MAX(skin_heroid) AS skin_heroid, MAX(quality) AS skin_quality, MAX(value) AS skin_value, MAX(skin_name) AS skin_name, MAX(added_time) AS added_time FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config GROUP BY skinid) AS xx1 ON s1.skinid = xx1.skinid LEFT JOIN (SELECT heroid, MAX(hero_name) AS hero_name, MAX(hero_en_name) AS hero_en_name, MAX(position) AS position, MAX(heroes) AS hero_type, MAX(sub_position) AS sub_position, MAX(heroic_difficulty) AS heroic_difficulty FROM mt_dim.dim_hero_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY heroid) AS xx2 ON xx1.skin_heroid = xx2.heroid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jaxzhong_skin_nores_detail_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 覆盖写入 */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, level, game_channel, os_type, device, device_id, total_disk_space_kb, grading_id, real_picture_quality, now_picture_quality, login_id, client_version, big_rank, small_rank, battle_id, pvp_type, black_num, team_ai_num, enemy_ai_num, realpvptype, skinid, hit_expected_skinid_list, expected_module_available, skin_type /* --自身，队友，敌人 */, is_regular_skinid /* --预期不下载(低档包皮肤不下载) */, is_ai_skinid /* --AI皮肤id */, is_selfdown_skinid /* --命中个性化下载 */, is_available_skinid /* --个性化下载已下载完成 */, skin_heroid, skin_quality, skin_value, skin_name, added_time, hero_name, hero_en_name, position, hero_type, sub_position, heroic_difficulty, roomid /* -用户所属的房间id */, skin_nores_userid /* -- 皮肤白膜是哪个用户,如果是自身皮肤白膜，则accountid=skin_nores_userid */, skin_nores_roomid /* -- 看到皮肤白膜的用户对应的roomid，如果和自己的roomid相同则表明是一起开黑 */, voiceontype, voicetotaltime, rtc_time_minute FROM output_table

name: 20260108_30日未登录玩家
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: tiffanyzou@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-01-08 16:35:17.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tiffanyzou_20260108_dormant_users_30day PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT b.roleid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS b LEFT JOIN (/* 过去30天活跃记录检查 */ SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-30' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0) AS c ON b.roleid = c.roleid WHERE b.logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 最新一天的全量用户 */ AND b.appid = 'mlbb' AND b.is_ai = 0 AND b.register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND b.is_first_create = 1 AND DATEDIFF(b.logymd, b.register_date) >= 30 /* 注册≥30天 */ AND c.roleid IS NULL /* 过去30天无活跃 */ GROUP BY b.roleid

name: ml_temp.daily_highlight_triggered_di
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_caowl@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-01-07 19:24:53.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.daily_highlight_triggered_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT logymd AS dt, a.roleid, a.zoneid, label, battleid, 1_nums, 2_nums, 3_nums, 4_nums, 5_nums, 1_nums + 2_nums + 3_nums + 4_nums + 5_nums AS total_nums FROM (/* 赛季成就灰度人群 */ SELECT DISTINCT roleid, zoneid, IF(param_value = '{"group_tag":"control"}', 'control', 'test') AS label FROM ml_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE param_name = '90_SeasonAchieve' AND param_version IN ('2003', '2004') AND logymd BETWEEN '2025-06-18' AND '2025-06-23') AS a JOIN (/* 排位对局信息以及触发高光的次数 */ SELECT logymd, a.accountid, a.zoneid, a.battleid, ranks, road_sort, COALESCE(lingzhuskill, 0) + COALESCE(shenguiskill, 0) + COALESCE(kills, 0) + COALESCE(killtower, 0) AS 1_nums /* 100 高光+普通播报汇总 */, COALESCE(kill2, 0) AS 2_nums /* 200 高光+普通播报汇总 */, COALESCE(3_nums, 0) + COALESCE(kill3, 0) + COALESCE(kills_desc, 0) AS 3_nums /* 300 高光+普通播报汇总 */, COALESCE(4_nums, 0) + COALESCE(kill4, 0) AS 4_nums /* 400 高光+普通播报汇总 */, COALESCE(5_nums, 0) + COALESCE(kill5, 0) AS 5_nums /* 500 高光+普通播报汇总 */ FROM (/* 对局的段位和分路，排位对局 */ SELECT logymd, battleid, accountid, zoneid, CASE WHEN rankstar < 37 THEN 'a.大师' WHEN rankstar < 62 THEN 'b.宗师' WHEN rankstar < 87 THEN 'c.史诗' WHEN rankstar < 112 THEN 'd.传奇' WHEN rankstar < 137 THEN 'e.神话' WHEN rankstar < 162 THEN 'f.百战神话' WHEN rankstar < 212 THEN 'g.荣耀神话' ELSE 'h.至尊神话' END AS ranks, CASE WHEN roadsort = 4 THEN '打野' WHEN roadsort = 2 THEN '中路' WHEN roadsort = 1 OR roadsort = 5 THEN '金币路' WHEN roadsort = 101 OR roadsort = 105 THEN '经验路' WHEN roadsort = 0 THEN '未知' WHEN roadsort LIKE '3%' THEN '游走' END AS road_sort, lingzhuskill /* 100 领主播报 */, shenguiskill /* 100 神龟播报 */ FROM ml_ods.connserver_battleenddata WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 20000 AND battletype = 2) AS a LEFT JOIN (/* 对局不同热度高光触发次数 */ SELECT accountid, zoneid, battleid, COUNT(trigger_id) AS total_nums, COUNT(CASE WHEN trigger_id IN (1001) THEN trigger_id ELSE NULL END) AS 1_nums, COUNT(CASE WHEN trigger_id IN (1001) THEN trigger_id ELSE NULL END) AS 2_nums, COUNT(CASE WHEN trigger_id IN (9, 12, 18, 101, 103, 104, 110, 115, 116) THEN trigger_id ELSE NULL END) AS 3_nums, COUNT(CASE WHEN trigger_id IN (8, 11, 17, 100, 102, 107, 113, 114, 117, 119) THEN trigger_id ELSE NULL END) AS 4_nums, COUNT(CASE WHEN trigger_id IN (7, 10, 16, 118, 120, 6) THEN trigger_id ELSE NULL END) AS 5_nums FROM (SELECT DISTINCT `TIME`, accountid, zoneid, battleid, tbl.col AS trigger_id FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_highlight_triggered LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(SPLIT(highlighttriggered, CHR(59))) tbl AS c1_index, col WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 20000 AND tbl.col IN (6, 7, 8, 9, name: 新手等级达成贡献度
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: kyrayang@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-01-16 21:42:36.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 比率因素（这个组自身达成率的变化带来的影响）= 两周本维度平均人数占比 ×（本周本维度达成率 − 上周本维度达成率） */ /* 结构因素（人数占比结构迁移带来的影响）=（本周占比 − 上周占比）×（两周当前维度平均达成率 − 两周整体平均达成率） */ /* 各维度影响度（比率因素+结构因素=总变化值）=（各维度比率因素+各维度结构因素）/总变化 */ WITH gx1 AS (SELECT zone, '国家' AS weidu, create_country AS weidu_value, COALESCE(SUM(this_week_user_cnt) / MAX(this_week_zone_user), 0) AS this_week_user_cnt_ratio /* 本周用户占比 */, COALESCE(SUM(this_week_user_cnt), 0) AS this_week_user_cnt /* 本周新增用户数 */, COALESCE(SUM(last_week_user_cnt) / MAX(last_week_zone_user), 0) AS last_week_user_cnt_ratio /* 上周用户占比 */, COALESCE(SUM(last_week_user_cnt), 0) AS last_week_user_cnt /* 上周新增用户数 */, COALESCE(SUM(this_week_user_cnt) / MAX(this_week_zone_user), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(last_week_user_cnt) / MAX(last_week_zone_user), 0) AS newuser_ratio_diff /* 用户占比diff */, SUM(COALESCE(this_week_user_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(last_week_user_cnt, 0)) / MAX(COALESCE(this_week_zone_user, 0) + COALESCE(last_week_zone_user, 0)) AS avg_newuser_ratio /* 平均用户占比 */, COALESCE(SUM(this_week_level2_user_cnt) / SUM(this_week_user_cnt), 0) AS this_week_get2_rate /* 本周2级达成率 */, COALESCE(SUM(last_week_level2_user_cnt) / SUM(last_week_user_cnt), 0) AS last_week_get2_rate /* 上周2级达成率 */, COALESCE(SUM(this_week_level2_user_cnt) / SUM(this_week_user_cnt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(last_week_level2_user_cnt) / SUM(last_week_user_cnt), 0) AS get2_rate_diff /* 2级达成率diff */, (COALESCE(SUM(this_week_level2_user_cnt) / SUM(this_week_user_cnt), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(last_week_level2_user_cnt) / SUM(last_week_user_cnt), 0)) / 2 AS avg_get2_rate /* 平均2级达成率 */, MAX(COALESCE(this_week_zonelv2_user, 0) + COALESCE(last_week_zonelv2_user, 0)) / MAX(COALESCE(this_week_zone_user, 0) + COALESCE(last_week_zone_user, 0)) AS total_get2_rate /* 整体2级达成率 */, COALESCE(SUM(this_week_level4_user_cnt) / SUM(this_week_user_cnt), 0) AS this_week_get4_rate /* 本周4级达成率 */, COALESCE(SUM(last_week_level4_user_cnt) / SUM(last_week_user_cnt), 0) AS last_week_get4_rate /* 上周4级达成率 */, COALESCE(SUM(this_week_level4_user_cnt) / SUM(this_week_user_cnt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(last_week_level4_user_cnt) / SUM(last_week_user_cnt), 0) AS get4_rate_diff /* 4级达成率diff */, (COALESCE(SUM(this_week_level4_user_cnt) / SUM(this_week_user_cnt), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(last_week_level4_user_cnt) / SUM(last_week_user_cnt), 0)) / 2 AS avg_get4_rate /* 平均4级达成率 */, MAX(COALESCE(this_week_zonelv4_user, 0) + COALESCE(last_week_zonelv4_user, 0)) / MAX(COALESCE(this_week_zone_user, 0) + COALESCE(last_week_zone_user, 0)) AS total_get4_rate /* 整体4级达成率 */, COALESCE(SUM(this_week_level8_user_cnt) / SUM(this_week_user_cnt), 0) AS this_week_get8_rate /* 本周8级达成率 */, COALESCE(SUM(last_week_level8_user_cnt) / SUM(last_week_user_cnt), 0) AS last_week_get8_rate /* 上周8级达成率 */, COALESCE(SUM(this_week_level8_user_cnt) / SUM(this_week_user_cnt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(last_week_level2_user_cnt) / SUM(last_week_user_cnt), 0) AS get2_rate_diff /* 2级达成率diff */, (COALESCE(SUM(this_week_level2_user_cnt) / SUM(this_week_user_cnt), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(last_week_level2_user_cnt) / SUM(last_week_user_cnt), 0)) / 2 AS avg_get2_rate /* 平均2级达成率 */, MAX(COALESCE(this_week_zonelv2_user, 0) + COALESCE(last_week_zonelv2_user, 0)) / MAX(COALESCE(this_week_zone_user, 0) + COALESCE(last_week_zone_user, 0)) AS total_get2_rate /* 整体2级达成率 */, COALESCE(SUM(this_week_level4_user_cnt) / SUM(this_week_user_cnt), 0) AS this_week_get4_rate /* 本周4级达成率 */, COALESCE(SUM(last_week_level4_user_cnt) / SUM(last_week_user_cnt), 0) AS last_week_get4_rate /* 上周4级达成率 */, COALESCE(SUM(this_week_level4_user_cnt) / SUM(this_week_user_cnt), 0) - total_get8_rate) AS struct_degree8 /* 结构因素 */ FROM gx1) AS a1 JOIN (SELECT zone, weidu, SUM(rate_degree2 + struct_degree2) AS total_degree2, SUM(rate_degree4 + struct_degree4) AS total_degree4, SUM(rate_degree8 + struct_degree8) AS total_degree8 FROM (SELECT zone, weidu, weidu_value, this_week_user_cnt_ratio, this_week_user_cnt, last_week_user_cnt_ratio, last_week_user_cnt, newuser_ratio_diff, avg_newuser_ratio, this_week_get2_rate, last_week_get2_rate, get2_rate_diff, avg_get2_rate, total_get2_rate, get2_rate_diff * avg_newuser_ratio AS rate_degree2 /* 比例因素 */, newuser_ratio_diff * (avg_get2_rate - name: is_redownload_installed_with_label
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.amandapiao_combined_redownload_installed_data PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.deviceid, a.client_ver, channel, createrole_country, zone, client_root_ver, CASE WHEN is_downloaded_installed_cnt = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_downloaded_installed_cnt, CASE WHEN is_downloaded_not_installed_cnt = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_downloaded_not_installed_cnt, CASE WHEN is_contains_module1_cnt = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_contains_module1_cnt, start_time, end_time FROM (SELECT deviceid, client_ver, channel, createrole_country, FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) AS zone, SUBSTRING_INDEX(client_ver, '.', 3) AS client_root_ver, MIN(time) AS start_time, MAX(time) AS end_time FROM mt_dwd.dwd_login_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY deviceid, client_ver, channel, createrole_country, zone, client_root_ver) AS a /* 如果是is_redownload = 1的就是重复下载用户 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT deviceid, client_ver, MAX(is_downloaded_installed_cnt) AS is_downloaded_installed_cnt, MAX(is_downloaded_not_installed_cnt) AS is_downloaded_not_installed_cnt, MAX(is_contains_module1_cnt) AS is_contains_module1_cnt FROM ml_temp.amandapiao_is_redownload_installed WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY deviceid, client_ver) AS b ON a.deviceid = b.deviceid AND a.client_ver = b.client_ver

name: etl.zgame_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df
sql_units: /* 关联取玩家全局排序 */ /* 初始日期为2025-05-27 */ WITH his_data AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, uid FROM zgame_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-30' <= '2025-05-27', '2025-05-27', '2026-05-30') AND appid = 'zgame'), new_user /* 取出新增用户并排序 */ AS (SELECT t1.roleid, t1.zoneid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY roleid, zoneid) AS rn_sort, '2026-05-31' AS max_key FROM (SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.roleid, b.accountid) AS roleid, a.zoneid AS zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM zgame_dim.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS a FULL JOIN (SELECT accountid FROM zgame_dim.dim_zgame_basic_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND account_register_date <= '2026-05-31') AS b ON a.roleid = b.accountid) AS a LEFT JOIN his_data AS hd ON a.roleid = hd.roleid AND COALESCE(a.zoneid, -1) = COALESCE(hd.zoneid, -1) WHERE hd.roleid IS NULL GROUP BY a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS t1), max_uid /* 取出历史最大uid */ AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(uid), 0) AS max_uid, '2026-05-31' AS max_key FROM his_data) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE zgame_dm.dm_uid_mapping_role_zone_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'zgame') SELECT roleid, zoneid, uid FROM his_data UNION ALL SELECT nu.roleid, nu.zoneid, mu.max_uid + nu.rn_sort FROM new_user AS nu LEFT JOIN max_uid AS mu ON nu.max_key = mu.max_key

name: 挂机用户1_7_15_30留存
sql_units: /*  D1 / D7 / D30 留存结果 */ /* --  写入 */ /* CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ml_temp.isafk_retention ( */ /*             zone_group        INT, -- 大区 */ /*             afk_30d_level     STRING, -- 过去30天挂机等级：未登录 / 0次 / 1次 / 2-5次 / 6-9次 / 10次及以上 */ /*             is_afk_today      STRING, -- 当天是否挂机 */ /*             user_cnt          BIGINT, -- 当天用户数 */ /*             d1_retained       BIGINT, -- D1 留存人数 */ /*             d7_retained       BIGINT, -- D7 留存人数 */ /*             d15_retained      BIGINT, -- D15 留存人数 */ /*             d30_retained      BIGINT, -- D30 留存人数 */ /*             d1_retained_rate  DOUBLE, -- D1 留存率（%） */ /*             d7_retained_rate  DOUBLE, -- D7 留存率（%） */ /*             d15_retained_rate DOUBLE, -- D15 留存率（%） */ /*             d30_retained_rate DOUBLE --  D30 留存率（%） */ /*         ) */ /*         PARTITIONED BY (date STRING) STORED AS PARQUET; */ /* 过去30天（不含当天）的挂机天数 */ WITH afk_30d AS (SELECT accountid AS role_id, FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) AS zone_group, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS afk_days_30d FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 30 * -1) AND DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 1 * -1) AND pvptype = 2 AND zoneid < 57000 AND fake_ai = 0 AND ishook = 1 GROUP BY accountid, FLOOR(zoneid / 1000)), user_tag_daily /* 当天玩家标签：是否挂机 + 过去30天挂机等级 */ AS (SELECT d.DATE, d.role_id, d.zone_group, CASE WHEN d.ishook_today = 1 THEN '当天挂机' ELSE '当天非挂机' END AS is_afk_today, CASE WHEN a.role_id IS NULL THEN '未登录' /* 30天内没对战 */ WHEN COALESCE(a.afk_days_30d, 0) = 0 THEN '0次' /* 30天内有对战，但无挂机 */ WHEN COALESCE(a.afk_days_30d, 0) = 1 THEN '1次' WHEN COALESCE(a.afk_days_30d, 0) BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5次' WHEN COALESCE(a.afk_days_30d, 0) BETWEEN 6 AND 9 THEN '6-9次' ELSE '10次及以上' END AS afk_30d_level FROM (/* 当天玩家标签（首日） */ SELECT '2026-05-31' AS DATE, accountid AS role_id, FLOOR(zoneid / 1000) AS zone_group, MAX(ishook) AS ishook_today FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype = 2 AND zoneid < 57000 AND fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY accountid, FLOOR(zoneid / 1000)) AS d LEFT JOIN afk_30d AS a ON d.role_id = a.role_id AND d.zone_group = a.zone_group), active_or_battle_checkpoints /* 未来+1/+6/+14/+29 的登录行为 */ AS (SELECT logymd, roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-06-01', '2026-06-06', '2026-06-14', '2026-06-29') AND zoneid < 57001 GROUP BY logymd, roleid UNION SELECT logymd, roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd IN ('2026-05-31', '2026-06-01', '2026-06-06', '2026-06-14', '2026-06-29') AND zoneid < 57001 GROUP BY logymd, roleid), user_retention_data /* 用户在对应日期的留存 */ AS (SELECT u.DATE AS first_date, u.role_id, u.zone_group, u.is_afk_today, u.afk_30d_level, l.logymd AS activity_date, DATEDIFF(l.logymd, u.DATE) AS days_after_first FROM user_tag_daily AS u LEFT JOIN active_or_battle_checkpoints AS l ON u.role_id = l.roleid AND DATEDIFF(l.logymd, u.DATE) IN (0, 1, 6, 14, 29)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.isafk_retention PARTITION(DATE = '2026-05-31') SELECT zone_group, afk_30d_level, is_afk_today, COUNT(DISTINCT role_id) AS user_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN days_after_first = 1 THEN role_id END) AS d1_retained /* 留存人数 */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN days_after_first = 6 THEN role_id END) AS d7_retained, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN days_after_first = 14 THEN role_id END) AS d15_retained, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN days_after_first = 29 THEN role_id END) AS d30_retained, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN days_after_first = 1 THEN role_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT role_id), 2) AS d1_retained_rate /* 留存率 */, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN days_after_first = 6 THEN role_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT role_id), 2) AS d7_retained_rate, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN days_after_first = 14 THEN role_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT role_id), 2) AS d15_retained_rate, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN days_after_first = 29 THEN role_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT role_id), 2) AS d30_retained_rate FROM user_retention_data GROUP BY first_date, zone_group, afk_30d_level, is_afk_today

19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001))) AS a WHERE rn = 1) AS bind_info ON main_data.roleid = bind_info.roleid AND main_data.zoneid = bind_info.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(LEVEL) AS max_level FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_add_level WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN level_info.roleid AND main_data.zoneid = level_info.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX_BY(cur_name, TIME) AS role_name FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_change_name WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND main_data.roleid = name_info.roleid AND main_data.zoneid = name_info.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, channel, region_id, os_type, account_name, device, ip, client_version, ip_country FROM (SELECT accountid, channel, FLOOR(zoneid / 10000) AS region_id, zoneid, os_type, account_name, device, ip, LOWER(IF(TRIM(GEOIP(ip, 1, IF('202605' < '202207', '202207', '202605'))) = zgame_dwd.loginserver_login_auth WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND ((zoneid = 1 OR zoneid BETWEEN 19001 AND 50000) OR (logymd >= '2023-07-13' AND zoneid BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999) OR (logymd >= '2024-03-27' AND zoneid >= 70001))) AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS login_auth ON main_data.roleid = login_auth.roleid AND main_data.zoneid = login_auth.zoneid) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM zgame_dim.dim_zgame_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30') AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid

'2026-05-31') AS cum_charge_arr FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, CONCAT_WS(':', logymd, SUM(CAST(COALESCE(money, 0) AS BIGINT))) AS charge_amt FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd <= WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY deviceid, client_ver) AS b ON a.deviceid = b.deviceid AND a.client_ver = b.client_ver LEFT JOIN (SELECT deviceid, client_ver, MAX(CASE WHEN reason = 'astc_reason' sql_units: /*     ) */ /* CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msdk_dwm.dwm_pay_account_di ( */ /*     account_id                    STRING COMMENT '账号id, key', */ /*     did                           STRING COMMENT '应用的自定义设备指纹', */ /*     package_name                  STRING COMMENT '游戏分包名, key', */ /*     os                            STRING COMMENT '操作系统', */ /*     day_first_model               STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 首次', */ /*     day_last_model                STRING COMMENT '手机设备型号, 末次', */ /*     day_first_os_version          STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本,首次', */ /*     day_last_os_version           STRING COMMENT '操作系统版本, 末次', */ /*     day_first_client_version      STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 首次', */ /*     day_last_client_version       STRING COMMENT '游戏客户端版本, 末次', */ /*     day_first_charge_time         STRING COMMENT '当天首次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     day_last_charge_time          STRING COMMENT '当天末次付费时间, 美西时间, 格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss', */ /*     day_charge_cnt                BIGINT COMMENT '当天累计付费次数', */ /*     day_charge_sum                BIGINT COMMENT '当天累计付费金额（美分）' */ /* -- ) COMMENT '设备付费行为增量表格' PARTITIONED BY ( logymd STRING COMMENT '事件发生日期分区yyy-MM-dd', app_id INT COMMENT '应用唯一ID, key' ) STORED AS PARQUET; */ /* WITH pay_event_succeed AS ( */ /*     SELECT  role_id AS account_id, */ /*             did, */ /*             app_id, */ /*             package_name, */ /*             os, */ /*             model, */ /*             os_version, */ /*             client_version, */ /*             event_time, */ /*             price, */ /*             ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( */ /*                 PARTITION BY */ /*                         role_id, */ /*                         app_id */ /*                 ORDER BY */ /*                         event_time DESC */ /*             ) AS rec_desc, */ /*             ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( */ /*                 PARTITION BY */ /*                         role_id, */ /*                         app_id */ /*                 ORDER BY */ /*                         event_time ASC */ /*             ) AS rec_asc, */ /*             IF(logymd <= '2024-10-17' */ /*     AND     app_id = 4280, 1, 0) AS is_delete */ /*     FROM    msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di */ /*     WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /*     AND     event IN ('purchase_event', '__purchase_event__', '__purchase_deliver_event__') --投放重构充值接口__purchase_deliver_event__ 发货 __purchase_verify_event__ 校验 __purchase_refund_event__ 退款 */ /*             --   AND purchase_type = '1' --"支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test3. Promo4. Rewarded" */ /*     AND     purchase_type IN ('1', '3', '4') --"支付类型：1. 正常支付 2. Test 3. Promo4. Rewarded" */ /*     AND     step = 'STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER' --"表示支付流程到了第几步：校验STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_VERIFY发货STEP_RECEIPT_STEP_DELIVER,暂时只有发货的步骤" */ /*     AND     result_code IN (22000, 13000) --未处理result_code: 21900 已处理 22000  订单参数异常 24900 服务器逻辑异常 25900 */ /*     AND     app_id <> 4280 */ WITH xgame_pay AS (SELECT roleid AS account_id, did, 4460 AS app_id, LOWER(m__package_name) AS package_name, COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(m__os_type)), 'unknown') AS os, m__model AS model, m__os_version AS os_version, m__client_version AS client_version, m__server_time AS m__event_time, price AS price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rec_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY time ASC) AS rec_asc, 0 AS is_delete, time FROM t1.day_first_charge_time, t1.day_last_charge_time, t2.charge_cnt, t2.charge_sum, 0 AS actual_amt, '01' AS stage_id FROM (SELECT MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, did, NULL)) AS did, account_id, app_id, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, package_name, NULL)) AS package_name, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os, NULL)) AS os, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_first_model, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, model, NULL)) AS day_last_model, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_first_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_desc = 1, os_version, NULL)) AS day_last_os_version, MAX(IF(rec_asc = 1, client_version, NULL)) AS day_last_charge_time FROM xgame_pay WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY account_id, app_id) AS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT account_id, app_id, COUNT(1) AS charge_cnt, SUM(price) AS charge_sum FROM xgame_pay GROUP BY account_id, app_id) AS t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.app_id = t2.app_id

name: ml_temp.test_group_collection2_caowl
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: v_caowl@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-02-09 11:42:54.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* 充值 */ WITH group_feature AS (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN activedays_7days = 0 THEN '00.0天' WHEN activedays_7days BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '01.1-2' WHEN activedays_7days BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '02.3-5' WHEN activedays_7days BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN '03.6-7' ELSE '其他' END AS activedays_7days, CASE WHEN his_charge_amt_total IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN his_charge_amt_total = 0 THEN '00.0充值' WHEN his_charge_amt_total / 100 < 2 THEN '01.(0,2]' WHEN his_charge_amt_total / 100 < 20 THEN '02.[2,20)' WHEN his_charge_amt_total / 100 < 200 THEN '03.[20,200)' WHEN his_charge_amt_total / 100 < 2000 THEN '04.[200,2000)' ELSE '05.2000+' END AS charge_type FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_feature_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-02-04' AND UPPER(appid) = 'MLBB' AND zoneid < 57000), info_level AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MIN(INT(CEIL(info_level / 5))) AS big_l FROM ml_ods.gameserver_collection_info WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-04' AND '2026-02-10' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.test_group_collection2_caowl PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT activedays_7days, charge_type, big_l, a.logymd AS zhuce_day, b.logymd AS ret_day, DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) AS n_ret, label, COUNT(DISTINCT a.roleid, a.zoneid) AS dau, SUM(login_dur) AS login_dur, SUM(charge_dollars) AS charge_dollars, SUM(sub_num_diamond) AS sub_num_diamond FROM (/* 灰度信息 */ SELECT DISTINCT logymd, roleid, zoneid, IF(param_value = '{"group_tag":"control"}', 'control', 'test') AS label FROM ml_ods.gameserver_abtest_param WHERE param_name = '40.2_Collection2' AND param_version IN ('2933', '2934') AND logymd BETWEEN '2026-02-05' AND '2026-03-06' /* 进组日期2026.02.05 */) AS a LEFT JOIN group_feature ON a.roleid = group_feature.roleid AND a.zoneid = group_feature.zoneid LEFT JOIN info_level ON a.roleid = info_level.roleid AND a.zoneid = info_level.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, SUM(online_time) AS login_dur FROM ml_ods.gameserver_logout WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT logymd, roleid, zoneid, SUM(money) / 100 AS charge_dollars FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND is_iap_token_buy = 0 /* 排除代币购买数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND /*        AND is_sandbox = 0 -- 排除沙盒测试数据, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel = 0) AND /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷苹果假冒卡 (有收入) 数据, 因为点卡的 receipt_id = 0 */ NOT money IN (0) /* GP 礼品卡, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* GP 礼品卡, 没收入 (一定要排除) */ GROUP BY logymd, roleid, zoneid) AS p ON b.logymd = p.logymd AND b.roleid = p.roleid AND b.zoneid = p.zoneid LEFT JOIN (/* 钻石消耗 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, SUM(sub_num) AS sub_num_diamond FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond AS a WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 记得改最新日期 */ AND NOT operate IN ('gm') AND zoneid < 57000 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_diamond AS b WHERE b.logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid AND b.operate IN ('receive_mail_attach') GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) /* 把福利名单去了 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, logymd) AS q ON b.logymd = q.logymd AND b.roleid = q.roleid AND b.zoneid = q.zoneid WHERE DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd) >= 0 GROUP BY activedays_7days, charge_type, big_l, a.logymd, b.logymd, DATEDIFF(b.logymd, a.logymd), label

name: etl.mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di_xgame_account_daily
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: ethandong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-02-08 15:11:46.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH real_country_online AS (SELECT day_point AS div_time, CASE WHEN TRIM(country) IN ('', '-') OR country IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE LOWER(country) END AS country, online_num, vp_online_num FROM xgame_ods.connserver_t_real_os_country_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), dim_country AS (SELECT country_code AS country, definition_type AS region_type, region, appname FROM mt_dim.dim_gamebi_country WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2026-02-07', '2026-02-07', '2026-05-31') AND appname = 'xgame'), online_cube AS (SELECT region_type, region, country, MAX(online_num) AS pcu, ROUND(SUM(online_num) / 288) AS acu FROM (SELECT con.region_type, con.region, con.country, lin.div_time, SUM(COALESCE(online_num, 0) - COALESCE(vp_online_num, 0)) AS online_num /* 在线人数 */ FROM dim_country AS con LEFT JOIN real_country_online AS lin ON con.country = lin.country GROUP BY con.region_type, con.region, con.country, lin.div_time, GROUPING SETS ((con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region, con.country), (con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.region), (con.region_type, lin.div_time, con.country), (con.region_type, lin.div_time))) GROUP BY region_type, region, country) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'xgame', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT '2026-05-31' AS date_range, CONCAT('(', CONCAT_WS(',', IF(NOT country IS NULL, 'country', NULL), IF(NOT region IS NULL, 'region', NULL)), ')') AS grouping_name, region_type AS definition_type, COALESCE(region, 'all') AS region, COALESCE(country, 'all') AS country, 'all' AS network, COALESCE(pcu, 0) AS pcu, COALESCE(acu, 0) AS acu FROM online_cube

name: 资源产销及库存
sql_units: /* 上一日道具库存明细 */ WITH last_item_balance_detail AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CAST(SPLIT(item_map, '-')[0] AS BIGINT) AS item_id, CAST(SPLIT(item_map, '-')[1] AS BIGINT) AS item_num FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_map FROM zg_temp.item_balance_history LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(item_balance, ',')) tmp AS item_map WHERE logymd = '2026-05-29') AS a), recent_item_add_and_sub /* 当日道具产销 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, SUM(IF(event_name = 'add', num, 0)) AS add_num, SUM(IF(event_name = 'add' AND op RLIKE 'IAP_DeliverItem|StoreBuyWithTokens', num, 0)) AS paid_add_num, SUM(IF(event_name = 'sub', num, 0)) AS sub_num, MAX_BY(cur_num, time) AS cur_num FROM (SELECT time, op, roleid, zoneid, item_id, 'add' AS event_name, add_num AS num, cur_num FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_add_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND (zoneid = 1 OR zoneid >= 19001) UNION ALL SELECT time, op, roleid, zoneid, item_id, 'sub' AS event_name, sub_num AS num, cur_num FROM zgame_dwd.gameserver_sub_item WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND (zoneid = 1 OR zoneid >= 19001)) AS a GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, item_id), recent_item_balance_detail /* 当日库存明细 */ AS (SELECT COALESCE(n.roleid, m.roleid) AS roleid, COALESCE(n.zoneid, m.zoneid) AS zoneid, COALESCE(n.item_id, m.item_id) AS item_id, COALESCE(n.cur_num, m.item_num) AS item_num, COALESCE(n.add_num, 0) AS add_num, COALESCE(n.paid_add_num, 0) AS paid_add_num, COALESCE(n.sub_num, 0) AS sub_num FROM last_item_balance_detail AS m FULL JOIN recent_item_add_and_sub AS n ON m.roleid = n.roleid AND m.zoneid = n.zoneid AND m.item_id = n.item_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE zg_temp.item_balance_history PARTITION(logymd) SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, item_balance, item_add, item_paid_add, item_sub, '2026-05-30' AS logymd FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM recent_item_balance_detail GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT_WS('-', CAST(item_id AS STRING), CAST(item_num AS STRING)))) AS item_balance FROM recent_item_balance_detail WHERE item_num > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT_WS('-', CAST(item_id AS STRING), CAST(add_num AS STRING)))) AS item_add FROM recent_item_balance_detail WHERE add_num > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS c ON a.roleid = c.roleid AND a.zoneid = c.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT_WS('-', CAST(item_id AS STRING), CAST(paid_add_num AS STRING)))) AS item_paid_add FROM recent_item_balance_detail WHERE paid_add_num > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS d ON a.roleid = d.roleid AND a.zoneid = d.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT_WS('-', CAST(item_id AS STRING), CAST(sub_num AS STRING)))) AS item_sub FROM recent_item_balance_detail WHERE sub_num > 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS e ON a.roleid = e.roleid AND a.zoneid = e.zoneid /* -- 初始化作业 */ /* with item_balance_detail as ( */ /* select roleid, zoneid, item_id, max_by(cur_num, time) cur_num */ /* from ( */ /*     select time, roleid, zoneid, item_id, name: 20260306泰国活动分析战斗数据
sql_units: /* 2. INSERT 语句放在最后 */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: tiffanyzou@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-06 19:18:57.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH target_user_pool AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, UPPER(first_mt_country) AS country, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS b WHERE logymd = '2026-02-16' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND zoneid < 57000 AND first_mt_country IN ('ID', 'id', 'th', 'TH', 'RU', 'ru') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create AS ab WHERE ab.logymd BETWEEN '2025-03-20' AND '2026-02-16' AND b.roleid = ab.accountid AND (ab.os_build LIKE '%AP1%' OR (ab.os_build IS NULL AND ab.account_name LIKE '%mt%')))), active_summary AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2026-01-14' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_active_p1, MAX(CASE WHEN logymd BETWEEN '2026-01-15' AND '2026-02-16' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_active_p2 FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2026-02-16' AND (appid = 'mlbb' OR appid IS NULL) AND roleid IN (SELECT roleid FROM target_user_pool) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), user_tag_logic AS (SELECT t.roleid, t.zoneid, t.country, CASE WHEN t.register_date < '2025-11-01' AND COALESCE(a.is_active_p1, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(a.is_active_p2, 0) = 1 THEN '回流玩家' WHEN t.register_date < '2025-08-01' THEN '非回流老玩家_180' WHEN t.register_date >= '2025-08-01' AND t.register_date < '2025-11-01' THEN '非回流老玩家_90_180' ELSE '其他' END AS user_tag FROM target_user_pool AS t LEFT JOIN active_summary AS a ON t.roleid = a.roleid AND t.zoneid = a.zoneid), battle_summary AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT battleid) AS battle_cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN blacknum = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_black FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND fake_ai = 0 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) AND accountid IN (SELECT roleid FROM target_user_pool) GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.tiffanyzou_20260306_battle_eventanalysis_01 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT t.country, t.user_tag, COUNT(DISTINCT ba.roleid) AS group_dau, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ba.has_black = 1 THEN ba.roleid END) AS black_user_cnt, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ba.has_black = 1 THEN ba.roleid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT ba.roleid), 4) AS black_rate, SUM(ba.battle_cnt) AS total_battles, ROUND(SUM(ba.battle_cnt) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ba.roleid), 4) AS avg_battle_cnt_per_user FROM battle_summary AS ba JOIN user_tag_logic AS t ON ba.roleid = t.roleid AND ba.zoneid = t.zoneid GROUP BY t.country, t.user_tag

sql_units: WITH match_end AS (SELECT accountid, pvptype, logymd, battleid FROM ml_ods.matchserver_match_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4)), battle_end AS (SELECT accountid, pvptype, battleid FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND pvptype IN (1, 2, 4)), main AS (SELECT a.accountid, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.pvptype = 4 THEN b.battleid END) AS pvp4_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.battleid) AS play_count, MIN(CASE WHEN a.pvptype = 4 THEN a.logymd END) AS pvp4match_logymd FROM match_end AS a LEFT JOIN battle_end AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid AND a.battleid = b.battleid GROUP BY a.accountid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.pvp4_matchdate_count_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT accountid, SUM(pvp4_count) AS pvp4_count, SUM(play_count) AS play_count, MIN(pvp4match_logymd) AS pvp4match_logymd FROM (SELECT accountid, pvp4_count, play_count, pvp4match_logymd FROM (SELECT accountid, pvp4_count, play_count, pvp4match_logymd FROM main) UNION ALL (SELECT accountid, pvp4_count, play_count, pvp4match_logymd FROM ml_temp.pvp4_matchdate_count_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30')) GROUP BY accountid

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_multi_active_account_di
sql_units: WITH account_df AS (/* 数据作为主表 */ SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM (SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) UNION ALL SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) UNION ALL SELECT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_currency_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND currency_type = 'diamond' UNION ALL SELECT roleid FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1)), active_di AS (SELECT roleid, SUM(day_login_cnt) AS login_cnt /* 登录次数 */, SUM(day_login_duration) AS online_dur /* 登录时长 */ /* MAX(CASE WHEN first_login_teamid + last_login_teamid > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS if_team --是否拥有战队  */ FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* （保存历史全部分区） */ AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid), active_df AS (SELECT roleid, MAX_BY(his_last_active_os_language, his_last_active_time) AS last_os_language, MAX_BY(his_last_active_client_language, his_last_active_time) AS last_client_language, MAX_BY(his_last_active_os_ver, his_last_active_time) AS last_os_version, MAX_BY(his_last_active_client_ver, his_last_active_time) AS last_loginclient_version, MAX_BY(his_last_active_channel, his_last_active_time) AS last_channel /* 当日末次登录渠道 */, MAX_BY(his_last_active_level, his_last_active_time) AS last_level FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* （保存历史全部分区） */ GROUP BY roleid), basic_df_account AS (SELECT roleid, COALESCE(first_ad_country, 'unknown') AS first_ad_country, COALESCE(last_ad_country, 'unknown') AS last_ad_country, COALESCE(first_mt_country, 'unknown') AS first_mt_country, first_network_name, IF(LOWER(first_network_name) = 'organic', 1, 0) AS is_organic, register_time AS create_time, register_date AS create_date, DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 AS create_days /* 注册天数 */, create_os, new_type, create_country, is_ai, IF(create_channel = '' OR create_channel IS NULL, 'unknown', create_channel) AS create_channel, create_device, account_register_time, account_register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND register_date <= '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND is_ai = 0 AND is_first_create = 1), pay_di AS (/* SELECT  roleid, */ /*         SUBSTR(MIN(his_first_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_first_pay_date, */ /*         SUBSTR(MAX(his_last_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_last_pay_date, */ /*         SUM(product_money) AS charge_amt_total  --历史累计付费金额 */ /* FROM    mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df  --付费全量表 （保存历史全部分区） */ /* WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /* AND     his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 */ /* GROUP BY */ /*         roleid */ SELECT roleid, SUM(IF(logymd = '2026-05-31', product_money, 0)) AS charge_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 AND IF(logymd <= '2025-01-03', zoneid < 57000, zoneid > 0) GROUP BY roleid), pay_df AS (SELECT roleid, charge_amt_total /* 历史付费金额 */, his_first_pay_date, his_last_pay_date FROM (SELECT roleid, SUM(product_money) AS charge_amt_total, SUBSTRING(MIN(his_first_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_first_pay_date /* SUM(his_before_tax_usd_amt) AS pay_amt, */, SUBSTRING(MAX(his_last_pay_time), 1, 10) AS his_last_pay_date FROM (SELECT roleid, product_money, his_before_tax_usd_amt, his_first_pay_time, his_last_pay_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid DIV 1000 < 57 /* 正式服 */ AND his_before_tax_usd_amt > 0 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, product_money, before_tax_usd_amt, first_pay_time, last_pay_time FROM mt_dwm.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd > '2025-01-03' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND before_tax_usd_amt > 0 AND zoneid >= 57000 /* 01-03号后加入测服 */) GROUP BY roleid)), currency_di AS (/* 钻石消耗&获取 */ SELECT roleid, SUM(IF(currency_type = 'diamond' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND change_reason = 'get_diamond', currency_change_num, 0)) AS add_diamond_amt, SUM(IF(currency_type = 'diamond' AND logymd = '2026-05-31' AND change_reason = 'consume_diamond', currency_change_num, 0)) AS sub_diamond_amt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_currency_role_zone_di /* （保存历史全部分区） */ WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2026-03-03' AND '2026-05-31' AND currency_type = 'diamond' AND zoneid < 57000 GROUP BY roleid), attribute_di AS (SELECT accountid AS roleid, sex, born, age, job, gt1, gt2 FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_attribute_account_df /* （保存历史全部分区） */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb' AND gt2 = 1), active_info /* recurring_di AS ( */ /*     --回流 */ /*     SELECT  roleid, */ /*             zoneid, */ /*             IF(lose_days >= 30, 1, 0) AS is_recurring_30days, */ /*             IF(lose_days >= 14, 1, 0) AS is_recurring_14days */ /*     FROM    mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_role_zone_di --（保存历史全部分区） */ /*     WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' */ /*     AND     appid = 'mlbb' */ /*     AND     recurring_date = logymd */ /* ), */ AS (/* INSTR('010101', '1') = 2 */ SELECT roleid, LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, 2, 7), '0', '')) AS active_days_before7d, LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, 2, 30), '0', '')) AS active_days_before30d, IF(LOCATE('1', SUBSTRING(active_info, 2)) = 0, '1970-01-01', DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', LOCATE('1', SUBSTRING(active_info, 2)) * -1)) AS last_active_second_date /* 除当天外的末次活跃日期 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, BITMAP_MERGE(SUBSTRING(active_info, DATEDIFF(logymd, '2026-05-31') + 1)) AS active_info /* 从指定位置往前取数 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_role_zone_df) GROUP BY roleid) AS a WHERE SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, 1) = 1 /* 限制当日活跃玩家 */), competitor_di AS (/* 竞品数据 */ SELECT accountid, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(app_config_name)) AS gameapp_overlap_name FROM mt_dwd.dwd_competitor_account_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND app_type = 1 GROUP BY accountid), competitor_df AS (SELECT accountid, COLLECT_LIST(app_config_name) AS his_socialapp_name_array, TO_JSON(STR_TO_MAP(CONCAT_WS('moaml', COLLECT_SET(CONCAT_WS('mtml', app_config_name, app_first_install_ymd))), 'moaml', 'mtml')) AS his_gameapp_firstoverlap_date_json FROM (SELECT accountid, app_type, app_config_name, MIN(app_first_install_ymd) AS app_first_install_ymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_competitor_account_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) AS logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_competitor_account_df WHERE logymd >= '2025-12-01' /* 取最新日期数据 */) AND app_type = 1 GROUP BY accountid, app_type, app_config_name) WHERE app_first_install_ymd <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY accountid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_multi_active_account_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appid = 'mlbb') SELECT acc_df.roleid AS accountid /* BROADCAST(lan_cfg) */, bas.create_time, bas.create_date, bas.create_days /* 创角天数 */, bas.create_os, IF(bas.create_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_new, IF(NOT act_di.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_login, IF(pay_di.charge_amt > 0, 1, 0) AS is_charge, bas.new_type, bas.first_mt_country, bas.first_ad_country, bas.last_ad_country, bas.create_country, bas.create_channel, bas.first_network_name, bas.is_organic, COALESCE(attr_di.sex, 'unknown') AS sex, COALESCE(attr_di.age, -99999) AS age, COALESCE(attr_di.born, '1970-01-01') AS born, COALESCE(attr_di.job, 'unknown') AS job, act_df.last_client_language, COALESCE(lan_cfg.language_cn, '其他') AS last_client_language_cn, act_df.last_os_language, act_df.last_channel, act_df.last_loginclient_version, act_df.last_os_version, act_df.last_level, COALESCE(act_di.login_cnt, 0) AS login_cnt, COALESCE(act_di.online_dur, 0) AS online_dur, CASE WHEN bas.create_date = '2026-05-31' THEN 0 /* 当日新增 */ WHEN act_info.active_days_before7d BETWEEN 1 AND 2 OR (bas.create_date >= '2026-05-24' AND act_info.last_active_second_date = '1970-01-01') THEN 1 /* 在T-1~T-7期间活跃天数1~2：周低活  存在极少量最近7天新的的用户，但是没有活跃，归为周低活 */ WHEN act_info.active_days_before7d BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 2 /* 在T-1~T-7期间活跃天数3~5：周中活 */ WHEN act_info.active_days_before7d BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN 3 /* 在T-1~T-7期间活跃天数6~7：周高活 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_second_date BETWEEN '2026-05-17' AND '2026-05-23' THEN 4 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-8~T-14天内：7~14日回流 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_second_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-16' THEN 5 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-15~T-30天内：14~30日回流 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_second_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' THEN 6 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-31~T-60天内：30~60日回流 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_second_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2026-03-31' THEN 7 /* T日前最近一次活跃日期在T-61~T-180天内：60~180日回流 */ WHEN act_info.last_active_second_date <= '2025-12-01' THEN 8 ELSE -99999 END AS active_label, COALESCE(act_info.last_active_second_date, '1970-01-01') AS last_active_second_date, IF(act_info.last_active_second_date <= '2026-05-16' AND act_info.last_active_second_date <> '1970-01-01' AND NOT act_info.last_active_second_date IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_recurring_14days, IF(act_info.last_active_second_date <= '2026-04-30' AND act_info.last_active_second_date <> '1970-01-01' AND NOT act_info.last_active_second_date IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_recurring_30days, IF(NOT pay_df.roleid IS NULL, 1, 0) AS is_his_charge, COALESCE(pay_di.charge_amt, 0) AS charge_amt, COALESCE(pay_df.charge_amt_total, 0) AS charge_amt_total, COALESCE(cur_di.add_diamond_amt, 0) AS add_diamond_amt, COALESCE(cur_di.sub_diamond_amt, 0) AS sub_diamond_amt, COALESCE(cpt_di.gameapp_overlap_name, '') AS gameapp_overlap_name, COALESCE(cpt_df.his_gameapp_firstoverlap_date_json, '{}') AS his_gameapp_firstoverlap_date_json FROM account_df AS acc_df JOIN basic_df_account AS bas ON acc_df.roleid = bas.roleid LEFT JOIN active_di AS act_di ON acc_df.roleid = act_di.roleid LEFT JOIN active_df AS act_df ON acc_df.roleid = act_df.roleid LEFT JOIN attribute_di AS attr_di ON acc_df.roleid = attr_di.roleid LEFT JOIN active_info AS act_info ON acc_df.roleid = act_info.roleid LEFT JOIN pay_di AS pay_di ON acc_df.roleid = pay_di.roleid LEFT JOIN pay_df AS pay_df ON acc_df.roleid = pay_df.roleid LEFT JOIN currency_di AS cur_di ON acc_df.roleid = cur_di.roleid LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_language_config AS lan_cfg ON act_df.last_client_language = lan_cfg.language_id LEFT JOIN competitor_di AS cpt_di ON acc_df.roleid = cpt_di.accountid LEFT JOIN competitor_df AS cpt_df ON acc_df.roleid = cpt_df.accountid

name: as抽奖特征
sql_units: WITH pay AS (/* 付费，过去180天，付费>0，当前钻石数量为0的用户 */ SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge AS a WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 179 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND is_sandbox = 0 /* 排除沙盒测试数据,没收入 */ AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* receipt_id 限制用来排除盗刷并保留点卡（有收入）数据,因为点卡的 receipt_id 为 0。 */ AND NOT money IN (0) /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ AND a.product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡,没收入 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_own_diamond FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND his_last_active_own_diamond = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_own_diamond) AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.as_draw_label PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, CASE WHEN ABS(HASH(CONCAT(a.roleid, a.zoneid, 'as')) % 10) = 5 THEN 'high' WHEN NOT b.roleid IS NULL THEN 'invalid' WHEN active_30 BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'low' WHEN active_30 BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 'middle' WHEN active_30 BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END AS as_label FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_30 FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 29 * -1) AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS a LEFT JOIN pay AS b ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid

name: 02_dau特征数据
sql_units: /* DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ml_temp.crystal_tmp_dau_feature_country; */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: crystalmei@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-03-13 15:00:42.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ /* ============================================================ */ /* DAU 预估特征表（含时间/活动/赛季特征） */ /* ============================================================ */ /* 维度: data_date × country */ /* 源表: ml_temp.crystal_tmp_decismart_daily_kpi_wide (3年日数据) */ /* 外部表: lark2hive_mlbb_biz_actv_ls / lark2hive_mlbb_version_seaon_ls */ /* 注: adbi.global_holiday_infor 无权限，holiday 字段暂置空 */ /* ============================================================ */ WITH base AS (SELECT logymd AS data_date, country, dau FROM ml_temp.crystal_tmp_decismart_daily_kpi_wide), event_agg /* ── 活动特征（按 server_date 展开，每行=活动的某一天） ── */ AS (SELECT server_date AS ev_date, MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(number_date, '(\\d+)') AS INT) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_event_day1, 1 AS is_event_ongoing FROM ml_temp.lark2hive_mlbb_biz_actv_ls WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY server_date), season_agg /* ── 赛季特征（按 beijing_date 展开） ── */ AS (SELECT beijing_date AS ss_date, MAX(CASE WHEN info_type = '赛季' AND CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(number_date, '(\\d+)') AS INT) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_season_start, MAX(CASE WHEN info_type = '赛季' THEN CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(number_date, '(\\d+)') AS INT) ELSE NULL END) AS season_day_index, MAX(CASE WHEN info_type = '版更' AND CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(number_date, '(\\d+)') AS INT) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_patch_day FROM ml_temp.lark2hive_mlbb_version_seaon_ls WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' GROUP BY beijing_date), joined /* ── 合并维度特征 ── */ AS (SELECT b.data_date, b.country, b.dau, CAST(DAYOFWEEK(b.data_date) AS INT) AS dow /* 时间特征 */, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(b.data_date) IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend, CAST(WEEKOFYEAR(b.data_date) AS INT) AS week_of_year, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(LAST_DAY(b.data_date), b.data_date) <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_month_end, 0 AS is_holiday /* 节假日（无权限，暂置空） */, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS holiday_type, COALESCE(e.is_event_day1, 0) AS is_event_day1 /* 活动 */, COALESCE(e.is_event_ongoing, 0) AS is_event_ongoing, COALESCE(s.is_season_start, 0) AS is_season_start /* 赛季 */, s.season_day_index, COALESCE(s.is_patch_day, 0) AS is_patch_day FROM base AS b LEFT JOIN event_agg AS e ON b.data_date = e.ev_date LEFT JOIN season_agg AS s ON b.data_date = s.ss_date) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.crystal_tmp_dau_feature_country /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* ── 最终输出：维度特征 + DAU窗口特征 ── */ SELECT j.data_date, j.country, j.dau, j.dow /* 时间 */, j.is_weekend, j.week_of_year, j.is_month_end, j.is_holiday /* 活动/赛季/节假日 */, j.holiday_type, j.is_event_day1, j.is_event_ongoing, j.is_season_start, j.season_day_index, j.is_patch_day, j.dau AS dau_avg_1d /* DAU窗口均值 (1/3/7/14/28/56/168天) */, AVG(j.dau) OVER w3 AS dau_avg_3d, AVG(j.dau) OVER w7 AS dau_avg_7d, AVG(j.dau) OVER w14 AS dau_avg_14d, AVG(j.dau) OVER w28 AS dau_avg_28d, AVG(j.dau) OVER w56 AS dau_avg_56d, AVG(j.dau) OVER w168 AS dau_avg_168d, SUM(j.dau) OVER w3 AS dau_sum_3d /* DAU窗口总和 */, SUM(j.dau) OVER w7 AS dau_sum_7d, SUM(j.dau) OVER w28 AS dau_sum_28d, STDDEV_POP(j.dau) OVER w7 AS dau_std_7d /* DAU波动 */, STDDEV_POP(j.dau) OVER w28 AS dau_std_28d, LAG(j.dau, 1) OVER w AS dau_lag_1 /* lag 精确值 */, LAG(j.dau, 3) OVER w AS dau_lag_3, LAG(j.dau, 7) OVER w AS dau_lag_7, LAG(j.dau, 14) OVER w AS dau_lag_14, LAG(j.dau, 28) OVER w AS dau_lag_28, (j.dau - LAG(j.dau, 1) OVER w) /* 环比 */ * 1.0 / NULLIF(LAG(j.dau, 1) OVER w, 0) AS dau_chg_1d, (j.dau - LAG(j.dau, 7) OVER w) * 1.0 / NULLIF(LAG(j.dau, 7) OVER w, 0) AS dau_chg_7d, LEAD(j.dau, 1) OVER w AS label_dau_t1 /* T+1 标签 */ FROM joined AS j WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY j.country ORDER BY j.data_date), w3 AS (PARTITION BY j.country ORDER BY j.data_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w7 AS (PARTITION BY j.country ORDER BY j.data_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w14 AS (PARTITION BY j.country ORDER BY j.data_date ROWS BETWEEN 13 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w28 AS (PARTITION BY j.country ORDER BY j.data_date ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w56 AS (PARTITION BY j.country ORDER BY j.data_date ROWS BETWEEN 55 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w168 AS (PARTITION BY j.country ORDER BY j.data_date ROWS BETWEEN 167 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
