sql_units: WITH ouptable AS (SELECT accountid, zoneid, SUM(battles_30d) AS total_games, MAX(prev_hero_1) AS prev_hero_1, MAX(prev_hero_2) AS prev_hero_2, MAX(prev_hero_3) AS prev_hero_3, MAX_BY(conwin, time) AS conwin, CONCAT('{', CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(json1)), '}') AS hero_battle_30d_json, CONCAT('{', CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(json2)), '}') AS hero_perf_30d_json, CONCAT('{', CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(json3)), '}') AS hero_battle_7d_json, CONCAT('{', CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_LIST(json4)), '}') AS hero_perf_7d_json FROM (/* 第三层：拼接JSON片段（字段已全部生成） */ SELECT accountid, heroid, zoneid, conwin, time, rn, battles_30d, prev_hero_1, prev_hero_2, prev_hero_3, CONCAT('"', heroid, '":{', '"battles_30d":"', COALESCE(battles_30d, 0), '",', '"battles_wins_30d":"', COALESCE(battles_wins_30d, 0), '",', '"battles_winrate_30d":"', COALESCE(battles_winrate_30d, 0), '",', '"h_avg_kda_30d":"', COALESCE(h_avg_kda_30d, 0), '",', '"h_avg_herohurt_30d":"', COALESCE(h_avg_herohurt_30d, 0), '",', '"h_avg_kill_30d":"', COALESCE(h_avg_kill_30d, 0), '",', '"h_avg_dead_30d":"', COALESCE(h_avg_dead_30d, 0), '"', '}') AS json1 /* JSON1 30天战斗 */, CONCAT('"', heroid, '":{', '"h_avg_money_30d":"', COALESCE(h_avg_money_30d, 0), '",', '"h_mvp_cnt_30d":"', COALESCE(h_mvp_cnt_30d, 0), '",', '"h_mvp_rate_30d":"', COALESCE(h_mvp_rate_30d, 0), '",', '"h_avg_score_30d":"', COALESCE(h_avg_score_30d, 0), '",', '"h_max_herolvl":"', COALESCE(h_max_herolvl, 0), '",', '"h_last_played_dt":"', COALESCE(h_last_played_dt, ''), '",', '"h_solo_games_30d":"', COALESCE(h_solo_games_30d, 0), '"', '}') AS json2 /* JSON2 30天表现 【已修复双引号】 */, CONCAT('"', heroid, '":{', '"battles_7d":"', COALESCE(battles_7d, 0), '",', '"battles_wins_7d":"', COALESCE(battles_wins_7d, 0), '",', '"battles_winrate_7d":"', COALESCE(battles_winrate_7d, 0), '",', '"h_avg_kda_7d":"', COALESCE(h_avg_kda_7d, 0), '",', '"h_avg_herohurt_7d":"', COALESCE(h_avg_herohurt_7d, 0), '",', '"h_avg_kill_7d":"', COALESCE(h_avg_kill_7d, 0), '",', '"h_avg_dead_7d":"', COALESCE(h_avg_dead_7d, 0), '"', '}') AS json3 /* JSON3 7天战斗 【已修复双引号】 */, CONCAT('"', heroid, '":{', '"h_mvp_rate_7d":"', COALESCE(h_mvp_rate_7d, 0), '",', '"h_solo_games_7d":"', COALESCE(h_solo_games_7d, 0), '",', '"h_party_games_7d":"', COALESCE(h_party_games_7d, 0), '",', '"conwin":"', COALESCE(conwin, 0), '",', '"prev_hero_1":"', COALESCE(prev_hero_1, ''), '",', '"prev_hero_2":"', COALESCE(prev_hero_2, ''), '",', '"prev_hero_3":"', COALESCE(prev_hero_3, ''), '"', '}') AS json4 /* JSON4 剩余字段 【已修复双引号】 */ FROM (/* 第二层：计算所有指标（完整字段） */ SELECT accountid, heroid, zoneid, MAX(rn) AS rn, CAST(MIN(time) AS STRING) AS time, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS battles_30d, CAST(SUM(IF(camp = wincamp, 1, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS battles_wins_30d, CAST(ROUND(SUM(IF(camp = wincamp, 1, 0)) / COUNT(*), 4) AS DOUBLE) AS battles_winrate_30d, CAST(ROUND(AVG(kda), 2) AS DOUBLE) AS h_avg_kda_30d, CAST(ROUND(AVG(herohurt), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS h_avg_herohurt_30d, CAST(ROUND(AVG(killnum), 2) AS DOUBLE) AS h_avg_kill_30d, CAST(ROUND(AVG(deadnum), 2) AS DOUBLE) AS h_avg_dead_30d, CAST(ROUND(AVG(getmoney), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS h_avg_money_30d, CAST(SUM(ismvp) AS DOUBLE) AS h_mvp_cnt_30d, CAST(ROUND(SUM(ismvp) / COUNT(*), 4) AS DOUBLE) AS h_mvp_rate_30d, CAST(ROUND(AVG(score), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS h_avg_score_30d, CAST(MAX(herolvl) AS DOUBLE) AS h_max_herolvl, MAX(logymd) AS h_last_played_dt, CAST(SUM(IF(blacknum = 1, 1, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS h_solo_games_30d, CAST(SUM(IF(blacknum > 1, 1, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS h_party_games_30d, CAST(ROUND(SUM(IF(blacknum = 1, 1, 0)) / COUNT(*), 4) AS DOUBLE) AS h_solo_rate_30d, CAST(ROUND(SUM(IF(blacknum > 1, 1, 0)) / COUNT(*), 4) AS DOUBLE) AS h_party_rate_30d, MAX(IF(rn = 1, heroid, NULL)) AS prev_hero_1, MAX(IF(rn = 2, heroid, NULL)) AS prev_hero_2, MAX(IF(rn = 3, heroid, NULL)) AS prev_hero_3, MAX(IF(rn_win = 1 AND camp = wincamp, heroid, NULL)) AS prev_win_hero_1, MAX(IF(rn_win = 2 AND camp = wincamp, heroid, NULL)) AS prev_win_hero_2, MAX(IF(rn_win = 3 AND camp = wincamp, heroid, NULL)) AS prev_win_hero_3, CAST(MAX_BY(conwin, time) AS DOUBLE) AS conwin, CAST(COUNT(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)) AS DOUBLE) AS battles_7d, CAST(SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31' AND camp = wincamp, 1, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS battles_wins_7d, CAST(ROUND(SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31' AND camp = wincamp, 1, 0)) / NULLIF(COUNT(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)), 0), 4) AS DOUBLE) AS battles_winrate_7d, CAST(ROUND(AVG(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', kda, NULL)), 2) AS DOUBLE) AS h_avg_kda_7d, CAST(ROUND(AVG(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', herohurt, NULL)), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS h_avg_herohurt_7d, CAST(ROUND(AVG(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', killnum, NULL)), 2) AS DOUBLE) AS h_avg_kill_7d, CAST(ROUND(AVG(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', deadnum, NULL)), 2) AS DOUBLE) AS h_avg_dead_7d, CAST(ROUND(AVG(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', getmoney, NULL)), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS h_avg_money_7d, CAST(SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', ismvp, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS h_mvp_cnt_7d, CAST(ROUND(SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', ismvp, 0)) / NULLIF(COUNT(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)), 0), 4) AS DOUBLE) AS h_mvp_rate_7d, CAST(ROUND(AVG(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', score, NULL)), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS h_avg_score_7d, CAST(MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', herolvl, NULL)) AS DOUBLE) AS h_max_herolvl_7d, MAX(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', logymd, NULL)) AS h_last_played_dt_7d, CAST(SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31' AND blacknum = 1, 1, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS h_solo_games_7d, CAST(SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31' AND blacknum > 1, 1, 0)) AS DOUBLE) AS h_party_games_7d, CAST(ROUND(SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31' AND blacknum = 1, 1, 0)) / NULLIF(COUNT(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)), 0), 4) AS DOUBLE) AS h_solo_rate_7d, CAST(ROUND(SUM(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31' AND blacknum > 1, 1, 0)) / NULLIF(COUNT(IF(logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)), 0), 4) AS DOUBLE) AS h_party_rate_7d FROM (/* 第一层：原始数据 + 窗口函数 */ SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accountid, IF(camp = wincamp, 1, 0) ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn_win FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -30) AND '2026-05-31' AND isvalid = 1 AND IsInvalidBattle = 0 AND fake_ai = 0 AND pvptype IN (1, 2)) AS x1 GROUP BY accountid, heroid, zoneid) AS t2) AS t3 GROUP BY accountid, zoneid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.hero_skin_predic_30day_json_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT s1.accountid, s1.hero_battle_30d_json, s1.hero_perf_30d_json, s1.hero_battle_7d_json, s1.hero_perf_7d_json, s1.zoneid, s1.total_games, s1.conwin, s1.prev_hero_1, s1.prev_hero_2, s1.prev_hero_3 FROM ouptable AS s1 JOIN (SELECT roleid AS accountid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid) AS s2 ON s1.accountid = s2.accountid AND s1.zoneid = s2.zoneid

name: 月付费渗透情况
sql_units: /* ============================================================ */ /* 6) 最终 SELECT：拼接 operate 维度 + shopid 维度 + 统一映射 + 大类聚合 */ /* ============================================================ */ WITH charge_base /* 截至目前付费金额和时间 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, TIME, money FROM ml_ods.gameserver_charge WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND IF(logymd < '2020-04-21', 0, is_iap_token_buy) = 0 AND (receipt_id > 100 OR pay_channel <> '0') /* 排除盗刷，保留点卡（receipt_id=0） */ AND money <> 0 /* gp 礼品卡，无收入 */ AND product_id NOT LIKE 'com.moonton.%promotion%' /* gp 礼品卡，无收入 */), month_charge /* 当月充值 + 当月首次充值时间 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(money / 100.0) AS month_charge_amt, MIN(logymd) AS first_charge_logymd, MIN(TIME) AS charge_min_time FROM charge_base WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), pre_month_charge /* 截至上月末，历史单月最高充值 + 历史最近充值日期 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, MAX(monthly_amt) AS max_monthly_amt /* 历史单月最高（pre_month_r_label） */, MAX(his_last_charge_logymd) AS his_last_charge_logymd /* 历史最近一次充值日期 */ FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) AS logym, SUM(money / 100.0) AS monthly_amt, MAX(logymd) AS his_last_charge_logymd FROM charge_base WHERE logymd <= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', DAY('2026-05-31') * -1) /* 截至上月末 */ GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7)) AS m GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), prev_login /* 截止上月末最后登入日期 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_date AS prev_login_logymd FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', DAY('2026-05-31') * -1) AND zoneid <= 57000 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, his_last_active_date), sub_base /* 当月耗钻行为 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, logymd, TIME, TRIM(operate) AS operate FROM ml_ods.gameserver_sub_diamond WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000), sub_first /* 破冰：当月首次充值后的第一笔耗钻 */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, operate, TIME FROM (SELECT s.roleid, s.zoneid, s.operate, s.TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.roleid, s.zoneid ORDER BY s.TIME ASC) AS time_rk FROM sub_base AS s JOIN month_charge AS mc ON s.roleid = mc.roleid AND s.zoneid = mc.zoneid AND s.TIME > mc.charge_min_time) AS ranked WHERE time_rk = 1), shop_buy_first /* 2.4 破冰耗钻同一时间对应的商城购买 */ AS (SELECT sb.roleid, sb.zoneid, sb.TIME, MIN_BY(sb.itemid, sb.TIME) AS itemid, MIN_BY(sb.shopid, sb.TIME) AS shopid, MIN_BY(sb.gift_item_info, sb.TIME) AS gift_item_info FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, TIME, itemid, shopid, gift_item_info FROM ml_ods.gameserver_shop_buy WHERE SUBSTRING(logymd, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 AND moneytype = 301) AS sb JOIN sub_first AS sf ON sb.roleid = sf.roleid AND sb.zoneid = sf.zoneid AND sb.TIME = sf.TIME GROUP BY sb.roleid, sb.zoneid, sb.TIME), abnormal_account /* 异常账号（用于剔除） */ AS (SELECT DISTINCT accountid FROM ml_ods.accountserver_account_create WHERE logymd BETWEEN '2025-08-15' AND '2026-05-31' AND (os_build LIKE '%AP1%' OR (os_build IS NULL AND (device_name IN ('OnePlus 11', 'Galaxy S21', 'Redmi Note 12') OR app_click_id IN (56, 185))))), basic_role /* 用户基础属性（注册日期、首次创号国） */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'mlbb'), skin_cf /* 1.8 皮肤配置：品质等级 */ AS (SELECT skinid, quality, CASE WHEN quality = 1 THEN 'B级' WHEN quality = 2 THEN 'A级' WHEN quality = 3 THEN 'A+级' WHEN quality = 4 THEN 'S级' ELSE 'else' END AS skin_lvl FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_skin_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01'), month_skin_type /* 月度新品皮肤类型（仅取本月配置） */ AS (SELECT skinid, skin_type AS skin_type_cf FROM ml_temp.ads_larsheet_leap_ml_shop_newskin_config_di WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM ml_temp.ads_larsheet_leap_ml_shop_newskin_config_di WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01' AND SUBSTRING(logym, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7)), op_cf /*  operate 原始映射（与原来代码一致，未改动，方便溯源） */ AS (SELECT TRIM(operate) AS operate, nick_name, type AS op_type FROM ml_temp.temp_operate_config WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM ml_temp.temp_operate_config WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01'), item_cf /* 物品配置 */ AS (SELECT item_id, item_type, item_name FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd > '2000-01-01') AND logymd > '2000-01-01'), shop_operate_config /* 202605新映射配置：operate 维度 */ AS (SELECT type, operate_name, itemid, nick_name, skintype, nick_name2, type2, type3, type1, type4 FROM ml_temp.dim_shop_operate_config_df WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM ml_temp.dim_shop_operate_config_df WHERE logymd > '2026-04-15') AND logymd >= '2026-04-15'), bussiness_shop_config /* 202605新映射配置：shopid 维度 */ AS (SELECT type, operate_name, itemid, nick_name, skintype, nick_name2, type2, type3, type1, type4 FROM ml_temp.tmp_bussiness_shop_config WHERE logymd = (SELECT MAX(logymd) FROM ml_temp.tmp_bussiness_shop_config WHERE logymd > '2026-04-15') AND logymd >= '2026-04-15'), user_wide AS (SELECT m.roleid, m.zoneid, CASE WHEN UPPER(br.first_mt_country) IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MY', 'MM', 'RU', 'TR', 'IN', 'VN', 'TH') THEN UPPER(br.first_mt_country) WHEN UPPER(br.first_mt_country) IN ('PE', 'BO') THEN UPPER(br.first_mt_country) WHEN UPPER(br.first_mt_country) = 'HK' THEN 'HK' ELSE 'else' END AS first_mt_country /* ------ 国家 -------- */, CASE WHEN mc.month_charge_amt > 0 AND mc.month_charge_amt < 0.99 THEN '0.01美金' WHEN mc.month_charge_amt >= 0.99 AND mc.month_charge_amt < 1.98 THEN '1美金' WHEN mc.month_charge_amt >= 1.98 AND mc.month_charge_amt < 4.95 THEN '2美金' WHEN mc.month_charge_amt >= 4.95 AND mc.month_charge_amt < 9.90 THEN '5美金' WHEN mc.month_charge_amt >= 9.90 AND mc.month_charge_amt < 19.80 THEN '10美金' WHEN mc.month_charge_amt >= 19.80 AND mc.month_charge_amt < 49.50 THEN '20美金' WHEN mc.month_charge_amt >= 49.50 THEN '50美金' ELSE '0美金' END AS month_r_label /* ------ 当月付费档位（month_r_label） -------- */, CASE WHEN pmc.max_monthly_amt > 0 AND pmc.max_monthly_amt < 0.99 THEN '0.01美金' WHEN pmc.max_monthly_amt >= 0.99 AND pmc.max_monthly_amt < 1.98 THEN '1美金' WHEN pmc.max_monthly_amt >= 1.98 AND pmc.max_monthly_amt < 4.95 THEN '2美金' WHEN pmc.max_monthly_amt >= 4.95 AND pmc.max_monthly_amt < 9.90 THEN '5美金' WHEN pmc.max_monthly_amt >= 9.90 AND pmc.max_monthly_amt < 19.80 THEN '10美金' WHEN pmc.max_monthly_amt >= 19.80 AND pmc.max_monthly_amt < 49.50 THEN '20美金' WHEN pmc.max_monthly_amt >= 49.50 THEN '50美金' ELSE '0美金' END AS pre_month_r_label /* ------ 历史最高单月付费档位（pre_month_r_label） -------- */, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(br.register_date, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) THEN '0.本月新增' WHEN DATEDIFF(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) || '-01', br.register_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1.1~30' WHEN DATEDIFF(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) || '-01', br.register_date) BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '2.31~90' WHEN DATEDIFF(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) || '-01', br.register_date) BETWEEN 91 AND 365 THEN '3.91~365' WHEN DATEDIFF(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) || '-01', br.register_date) BETWEEN 366 AND 365 * 3 THEN '4.1~3年' WHEN DATEDIFF(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) || '-01', br.register_date) BETWEEN 365 * 3 + 1 AND 365 * 5 THEN '5.3~5年' WHEN DATEDIFF(SUBSTRING('2026-05-31', 1, 7) || '-01', br.register_date) BETWEEN 365 * 5 + 1 AND 365 * 99 THEN '6.5年+' ELSE 'else' END AS register_days_type /* ------ 注册年份分层 -------- */, -99999 AS age_type /* 占位 */, CASE WHEN mc.month_charge_amt IS NULL THEN '未充值' WHEN sf.operate IS NULL THEN '充值未耗钻' ELSE sf.operate END AS pay_sub_operate /* ------ 破冰渠道三件套（基础映射来自 op_cf = temp_operate_config） -------- */, CASE WHEN mc.month_charge_amt IS NULL THEN '未充值' WHEN sf.operate IS NULL THEN '充值未耗钻' ELSE oc.nick_name END AS pay_sub_operate_origin_name, CASE WHEN mc.month_charge_amt IS NULL THEN '未充值' WHEN sf.operate IS NULL THEN '充值未耗钻' ELSE COALESCE(oc.op_type, sf.operate) END AS pay_sub_op_origin_type, CASE WHEN ic.item_type IN (6, 14, 1, 24, 31, 5) THEN ic.item_type WHEN NOT sbf.itemid IS NULL AND NOT ic.item_type IS NULL THEN ic.item_type WHEN NOT sbf.itemid IS NULL AND ic.item_type IS NULL THEN 'item_type 为空' ELSE '非商城购买' END AS shop_item_origin_type /* ------ 商城物品类型 -------- */, CASE WHEN NOT mst.skin_type_cf IS NULL THEN mst.skin_type_cf WHEN ic.item_type = 6 AND NOT sc.quality IS NULL THEN sc.skin_lvl WHEN ic.item_type = 6 AND sc.skin_lvl IS NULL THEN '无品质' ELSE 'else' END AS skin_type /* ------ 皮肤类型 / 品质 -------- */, sc.skin_lvl, CASE WHEN ic.item_type = 1 THEN '1.为道具' WHEN ic.item_type = 2 THEN '2.为装备' WHEN ic.item_type = 3 THEN '3.为徽记' WHEN ic.item_type = 4 THEN '4.为材料' WHEN ic.item_type = 5 THEN '5.英雄' WHEN ic.item_type = 6 THEN '6.皮肤' WHEN ic.item_type = 7 THEN '7.徽记套装' WHEN ic.item_type = 8 THEN '8.徽记套装碎片' WHEN ic.item_type = 9 THEN '9.拼图道具' WHEN ic.item_type = 10 THEN '10.直播礼物' WHEN ic.item_type = 11 THEN '11.英雄打折券' WHEN ic.item_type = 12 THEN '12.皮肤打折券' WHEN ic.item_type = 13 THEN '13.头像框' WHEN ic.item_type = 14 THEN '14.抽奖礼包' WHEN ic.item_type = 15 THEN '15.万圣节糖果' WHEN ic.item_type = 16 THEN '16.线下赛勋章' WHEN ic.item_type = 21 THEN '21.排位保护卡' WHEN ic.item_type = 23 THEN '23.赛季通行证徽章' WHEN ic.item_type = 24 THEN '24.战场永久表情' WHEN ic.item_type = 25 THEN '25.点券周卡' WHEN ic.item_type = 26 THEN '26.点券月卡' WHEN ic.item_type = 27 THEN '27.英雄防御塔' WHEN ic.item_type = 28 THEN '28.染色皮肤' WHEN ic.item_type = 29 THEN '29.抵扣券' WHEN ic.item_type = 30 THEN WHEN a.pay_sub_operate IN ('action_act_flowbackskinfree') THEN '【聚合】回流' WHEN a.pay_sub_operate IN ('action_act_collectiondraw', 'action_act_commondraw2023_2509250032', Update Description */ /* -- ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adbi.dwm_active_account_tz_di ( */ /*             account_id STRING COMMENT '设备指纹,key', */ /*             login_cnt array<int> COMMENT '登录次数', */ /*             online_time array<int> COMMENT '在线时长', */ /*             day_first_login_time array<STRING> COMMENT '当天首次活跃时间, 格式： yyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', */ /*             stage_id STRING */ /*         ) COMMENT '设备活跃增量表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     logymd string comment '日期分区yyyy-MM-dd', */ /*     app_id string comment '应用唯一id' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/advertisement_bi/adbi/dwm_active_account_tz_di' */ WITH evt_log AS (SELECT account_id, stage_id, app_id, ARRAY(TO_DATE(MIN(event_time)), TO_DATE(MIN(event_time + INTERVAL '8' HOUR)), TO_DATE(MIN(event_time + INTERVAL '16' HOUR)), TO_DATE(MIN(event_time + INTERVAL '17' HOUR))) AS first_event_time, ARRAY(TO_DATE(MAX(event_time)), MAX(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '8' HOUR) > '2026-05-31', NULL, TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '8' HOUR))), MAX(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '16' HOUR) > '2026-05-31', NULL, TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '16' HOUR))), MAX(IF(TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '17' HOUR) > '2026-05-31', NULL, TO_DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '17' HOUR)))) AS last_event_time FROM (SELECT COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(m__package_name)), 'unknown') AS package_name, COALESCE(m__did, 'unknown') AS did, COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(m__os)), 'unknown') AS os, COALESCE(m__is_emulator, -1) AS is_emulator, COALESCE(m__os_version, 'unknown') AS os_version, COALESCE(m__system_language, 'unknown') AS os_language, COALESCE(m__role_id, 'unknown') AS account_id, COALESCE(m__role_id, 'unknown') AS role_id, COALESCE(m__zone_id, 'unknown') AS zone_id, SUBSTRING(time, 0, 19) AS event_time, COALESCE(m__client_ip, 'unknown') AS client_ip, COALESCE(m__model, 'unknown') AS model, COALESCE(LOWER(m__network_type), 'unknown') AS network_type, COALESCE(m__system_language, 'unknown') AS system_language, LOWER(GEOIP(login_ip, 1)) AS ip_country, COALESCE(m__client_version, 'unknown') AS client_version, COALESCE(m__sdk_version, 'unknown') AS sdk_version, -99999 AS level, '01' AS stage_id, m__app_id AS app_id FROM wefly_ob_ods.login WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND logymd > '2025-08-26' AND m__zone_id > 9999) AS a GROUP BY account_id, app_id, stage_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwm_active_account_tz_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id = 4310) SELECT event_log.account_id AS account_id, COALESCE(login_cnt.login_cnt, ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0)) AS login_cnt, COALESCE(ol_time.online_time, ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0)) AS online_time, COALESCE(first_event_time, ARRAY('1970-01-01', '1970-01-01', '1970-01-01', '1970-01-01')) AS day_first_login_time, event_log.stage_id AS stage_id FROM evt_log AS event_log LEFT JOIN (SELECT m__app_id AS app_id, '01' AS stage_id, a.roleid AS account_id, ARRAY(SUM(IF(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(time, 0, 19)) = '2026-05-31', online_time, 0)), SUM(IF(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(time, 0, 19) + INTERVAL '8' HOUR) = '2026-05-31', online_time, 0)), SUM(IF(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(time, 0, 19) + INTERVAL '16' HOUR) = '2026-05-31', online_time, 0)), SUM(IF(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(time, 0, 19) + INTERVAL '17' HOUR) = '2026-05-31', online_time, 0))) AS online_time /* os, */ FROM wefly_ob_ods.logout AS a WHERE logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2026-05-30' AND m__zone_id > 9999 AND logymd > '2025-08-26' GROUP BY m__app_id, roleid) AS ol_time ON event_log.app_id = ol_time.app_id AND /* AND     event_log.package_name = ol_time.package_name */ event_log.account_id = ol_time.account_id AND event_log.stage_id = ol_time.stage_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id AS app_id, stage_id, account_id, ARRAY(COUNT(IF(last_event_time[0] = '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)), COUNT(IF(last_event_time[1] = '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)), COUNT(IF(last_event_time[2] = '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)), COUNT(IF(last_event_time[3] = '2026-05-31', 1, NULL))) AS login_cnt FROM evt_log AS a GROUP BY app_id, stage_id, account_id) AS login_cnt ON STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dwa_admkt_align_ad_cost_report_df_utc9)) WHERE p_date = '2026-05-31'), cost_report_agg AS (SELECT report_date AS data_date, app_id, MAX(ad_account_id) AS ad_account_id, '', 'unknown', campaign_id) AS campaign_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adset_id), '') = '', 'unknown', adset_id) AS adset_id, IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ad_id), '') = '', 'unknown', ad_id) AS ad_id, MAX(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(campaign_name), '') = '', 'unknown', campaign_name)) AS campaign_name, MAX(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(adset_name), '') = '', 'unknown', adset_name)) AS adset_name, MAX(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(ad_name), '') = '', 'unknown', ad_name)) AS ad_name, SUM(impression) AS impression, SUM(click) AS click, SUM(cost) AS cost, SUM(cost_align) AS cost_align, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN impression ELSE 0 END) AS impression_new, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN click ELSE 0 END) AS click_new, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 1 THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS cost_new, SUM(CASE WHEN 0 END) AS impression_promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN click ELSE 0 END) AS click_promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS cost_promotion, SUM(CASE WHEN ad_target = 3 THEN cost_align ELSE 0 END) AS cost_promotion_align FROM cost_report WHERE report_date <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY report_date, app_id, LOWER(os), LOWER(IF(COALESCE(TRIM(country), '') = '', 'unknown', ad_id)) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE STRUCT(STRUCT(adbi_dm_admkt_ad_cost_report_none_input_df_utc9)) SELECT `data_date`, `ad_account_id`, `os`, `app_name`, `country`, `media_source`, `campaign_id`, name: mt_dm.dm_multi_decismart_info_df_wefly5
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: maoyancai */ /* Create by: 2026-05-12 16:43:18.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH basic_df AS (/* 基础信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, zone_type, SUBSTRING(register_date, 1, 10) AS register_date FROM w5_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), active_di AS (/* 活跃信息 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, COALESCE(online_dur, 0) AS ol_duration /* 当日有活跃，无在线时长的给默认值0 */, SUBSTRING(last_active_time, 1, 10) AS active_date FROM w5_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'), pay_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(pay_cnt) AS charge_cnt, SUM(pay_amt) AS charge_amt, MAX(SUBSTRING(last_pay_time, 1, 10)) AS charge_date FROM w5_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), behavior_df AS (/* 前一日 */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date, charge_info, charge_cnt_total_array, charge_amt_total_array, charge_amt_array, ol_dur_array, active_info, active_days_array, logymd, appname, granularity_type FROM mt_dm.dm_multi_decismart_info_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND appname = 'wefly5' AND granularity_type = 'role') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_multi_decismart_info_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'wefly5', granularity_type = 'role') SELECT roleid, zoneid, register_date /* 无注册日期给默认值 */, IF(LENGTH(charge_info) > 0 AND /* 只补齐有位图的，并且当日日期大于注册日的 */ '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(charge_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(charge_info))), COALESCE(charge_info, '') /* 可能存才有位图没有注册日期的， */) AS charge_info, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_cnt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_cnt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_cnt_total_array /* 付费次数位图,补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有付费用户） */, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_amt_total_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_total_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_amt_total_array /* --累计付费金额位图,补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有付费用户） */, CAST(IF(SIZE(charge_amt_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_array)) > 0, CONCAT(charge_amt_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(charge_amt_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(charge_amt_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS charge_amt_array /* --付费金额位图 */, CAST(IF(SIZE(ol_dur_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(ol_dur_array)) > 0, CONCAT(ol_dur_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(ol_dur_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(ol_dur_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS ol_dur_array /* --在线时长位图,补齐注册日期差值（仅历史有在线用户） */, IF(LENGTH(active_info) > 0 AND '2026-05-31' >= COALESCE(register_date, '9999-12-31'), CONCAT(active_info, REPEAT('0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - LENGTH(active_info))), COALESCE(active_info, '')) AS active_info, CAST(IF(SIZE(active_days_array) > 0 AND (DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(active_days_array)) > 0, CONCAT(active_days_array, SPLIT(SUBSTRING(REPEAT(',0', DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) + 1 - SIZE(active_days_array)), 2), ',')), COALESCE(active_days_array, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<BIGINT>) AS active_days_array /* 活跃天数位图补齐(array) */, zone_type FROM (SELECT td.roleid, td.zoneid, td.register_date, td.zone_type, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31', CONCAT('1', COALESCE(ld.charge_info, '')), IF(LENGTH(ld.charge_info) > 0, CONCAT('0', charge_info), '')) AS charge_info, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_cnt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_cnt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(charge_cnt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_cnt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_cnt, 0) + ld.charge_cnt_total_array[0])), ld.charge_cnt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_cnt_total_array, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_amt_total_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_amt_total_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.charge_amt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_amt_total_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_amt, 0) + ld.charge_amt_total_array[0])), ld.charge_amt_total_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_amt_total_array, IF(td.charge_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.charge_amt_array IS NULL OR ld.charge_amt_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.charge_amt), IF(SIZE(ld.charge_amt_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.charge_amt, 0))), ld.charge_amt_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS charge_amt_array, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.ol_dur_array IS NULL OR ld.ol_dur_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(td.ol_duration), IF(SIZE(ld.ol_dur_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(COALESCE(td.ol_duration, 0))), ld.ol_dur_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS ol_dur_array, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31', CONCAT('1', COALESCE(ld.active_info, '')), IF(LENGTH(ld.active_info) > 0, CONCAT('0', ld.active_info), '')) AS active_info, IF(td.active_date = '2026-05-31' AND (ld.active_days_array IS NULL OR ld.active_days_array = ARRAY()), ARRAY(1), IF(SIZE(ld.active_days_array) > 0, SPLIT(CONCAT_WS(',', ARRAY(BIGINT(is_td_active + ld.active_days_array[0])), ld.active_days_array), ','), ARRAY())) AS active_days_array FROM (SELECT bas.roleid, bas.zoneid, bas.zone_type, bas.register_date, act.active_date, act.ol_duration, pay.charge_cnt, pay.charge_amt, pay.charge_date, IF(act.active_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_td_active FROM basic_df AS bas /* basic表 */ LEFT JOIN active_di AS act /* 活跃 */ ON bas.roleid = act.roleid AND bas.zoneid = act.zoneid LEFT JOIN pay_di AS pay /* 支付 */ ON bas.roleid = pay.roleid AND bas.zoneid = pay.zoneid) AS td LEFT JOIN (/* 前一日数据 */ SELECT * FROM behavior_df) AS ld ON td.roleid = ld.roleid AND td.zoneid = ld.zoneid) AS t

sql_units: WITH dim_basic AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, account_name, did, register_time, register_date, create_ip, create_channel, create_sub_channel, os_name, create_country, SPLIT(LOWER(GEOIP(create_ip, 3, IF('202605' < '202508', '202508', '202605'))), ' / ')[1] AS create_province /* ↓ 新增：从 create_ip 经 geoip 解析省份和城市                                                                                               */, SPLIT(LOWER(GEOIP(create_ip, 3, IF('202605' < '202508', '202508', '202605'))), ' / ')[2] AS create_city, create_ip_country /* ↑ 新增结束                                                                                                                                 */, first_mt_country, first_network_name, is_first_create, CAST(zone_type AS BIGINT) AS zone_type, is_cur_bot, is_init_bot FROM w5_dw.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly5'), active_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, login_cnt, online_dur FROM w5_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly5'), active_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_last_os_name, his_last_channel, his_last_sub_channel /* ↑ 新增：上游已补充该字段                                                                                           */, his_last_login_ip, his_last_os_language, his_last_os_version, his_last_device_model, his_last_device_id, his_last_client_language, his_last_client_version, activedays, cur_war_stage FROM w5_dw.dwm_active_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly5'), charge_di AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, pay_amt, pay_cnt FROM w5_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly5'), charge_df AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, his_first_pay_time, his_pay_amt, his_pay_cnt FROM w5_dw.dwm_charge_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appid = 'wefly5'), role_zone_info AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM_ARRAY(ol_dur_array, 0, 6) AS online_dur_7days, SUM_ARRAY(ol_dur_array, 0, 29) AS online_dur_30days, IF(SIZE(ol_dur_array) <= 7, SUM_ARRAY(ol_dur_array, 0, SIZE(ol_dur_array)), SUM_ARRAY(ol_dur_array, SIZE(ol_dur_array) - 7, SIZE(ol_dur_array) - 1)) AS online_dur_resgister_7days, IF(SIZE(ol_dur_array) <= 30, SUM_ARRAY(ol_dur_array, 0, 29), SUM_ARRAY(ol_dur_array, SIZE(ol_dur_array) - 30, SIZE(ol_dur_array) - 1)) AS online_dur_register_30days, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, 0, 7), '0', '')) AS activedays_7days, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, 0, 30), '0', '')) AS activedays_30days, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, -7, 7), '0', '')) AS activedays_register_7days, LENGTH(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(active_info, -30, 30), '0', '')) AS activedays_register_30days, (charge_cnt_total_array[0] - COALESCE(charge_cnt_total_array[7], 0)) AS charge_cnt_7days, (charge_cnt_total_array[0] - COALESCE(charge_cnt_total_array[30], 0)) AS charge_cnt_30days, IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) <= 7, charge_cnt_total_array[0], charge_cnt_total_array[SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) - 7]) AS charge_cnt_register_7days, IF(SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) <= 30, charge_cnt_total_array[0], charge_cnt_total_array[SIZE(charge_cnt_total_array) - 30]) AS charge_cnt_register_30days, (charge_amt_total_array[0] - COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array[7], 0)) AS charge_amt_7days, (charge_amt_total_array[0] - COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array[30], 0)) AS charge_amt_30days, (charge_amt_total_array[0] - COALESCE(charge_amt_total_array[90], 0)) AS charge_amt_90days, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) <= 7, charge_amt_total_array[0], charge_amt_total_array[SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) - 7]) AS charge_amt_register_7days, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) <= 30, charge_amt_total_array[0], charge_amt_total_array[SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) - 30]) AS charge_amt_register_30days, IF(SIZE(charge_amt_total_array) <= 90, charge_amt_total_array[0], name: 20260518全服日度汇总表
sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: arunaa@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-18 11:35:00.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH battle_active_user /* S1  战斗活跃人群：(server_type, roleid, zoneid) 去重，框定"当日有过对局"的用户 */ /*     dwm_battle_role_zone_di 多维度行 (os/realpvptype/ip_country) 在此压到用户级 */ AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END AS server_type, roleid, zoneid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END, roleid, zoneid), active_online /* S2  在线时长按用户级聚合：dwm_active 多维度行 (os/ip_country/device) 压到 (roleid, zoneid) */ AS (SELECT roleid, zoneid, SUM(day_login_duration) AS duration_online FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_ai = 0 GROUP BY roleid, zoneid), battle_active_agg /* S3  按 server_type 汇总：战斗活跃 DAU + 战斗活跃用户的在线时长 */ /*     LEFT JOIN 兜底：理论上有战斗的用户必有登录，但防 active 缺失导致 DAU 丢失 */ AS (SELECT b.server_type, COUNT(1) AS total_dau, SUM(COALESCE(a.duration_online, 0)) AS total_online_sec FROM battle_active_user AS b LEFT JOIN active_online AS a ON a.roleid = b.roleid AND a.zoneid = b.zoneid GROUP BY b.server_type), battle_5v5_agg /* S4  全服 5V5 时长（独立从战斗表聚合，含非模式用户的排位/经典时长） */ AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END AS server_type, SUM(battle_duration) AS total_5v5_sec FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_fake_ai = 0 AND pvptype IN (1, 2) GROUP BY CASE WHEN CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END), mode_sec_agg /* S5  全服模式时长（复用模式用户表，已含全部模式用户） */ AS (SELECT server_type, SUM(duration_mode) AS total_mode_sec_all FROM ml_temp.aruna_ads_mode_user_daily_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY server_type), battle_total_agg /* S6  全 pvptype 战斗总时长 + 场次 */ AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END AS server_type, SUM(battle_duration) AS total_battle_sec, SUM(battle_cnt) AS total_battle_num FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND is_fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN CAST(zoneid AS BIGINT) < 57000 THEN '正式服' ELSE '测试服' END) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.aruna_ads_server_daily_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.server_type, a.total_dau, a.total_online_sec, COALESCE(b.total_5v5_sec, 0) AS total_5v5_sec, COALESCE(m.total_mode_sec_all, 0) AS total_mode_sec_all, COALESCE(t.total_battle_sec, 0) AS total_battle_sec, COALESCE(t.total_battle_num, 0) AS total_battle_num FROM battle_active_agg AS a LEFT JOIN battle_5v5_agg AS b ON b.server_type = a.server_type LEFT JOIN mode_sec_agg AS m ON m.server_type = a.server_type LEFT JOIN battle_total_agg AS t ON t.server_type = a.server_type

name: jaxzhong_流量信息汇总表
sql_units: WITH net_statis_start /* 找统计起始点 */ AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, time, zoneid, ip, deviceid, loginid, gradingid, isfirstreboot, game_channel, CAST(getmobilerxkb AS DOUBLE) / 1024 AS upload_M /* 上行流量累计M */, CAST(getmobiletxkb AS DOUBLE) / 1024 AS download_M /* 下行流量累计M */, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, accountid ORDER BY time ASC) AS rk FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_network_stats WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND isfirstreboot = 1), network_series_join /* 合并起始点+非起始点数据，计算窗口字段 */ AS (SELECT *, LAG(rk1, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, accountid ORDER BY time ASC) AS rk2 FROM (SELECT *, MAX(rk) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, accountid ORDER BY time) AS rk1 FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, time, zoneid, ip, deviceid, loginid, gradingid, isfirstreboot, game_channel, CAST(getmobilerxkb AS DOUBLE) / 1024 AS upload_M, CAST(getmobiletxkb AS DOUBLE) / 1024 AS download_M, NULL AS rk FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_network_stats WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND isfirstreboot <> 1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM net_statis_start) AS s2) AS s3), network_series_join_complete /* -把正确的同一次开机用rk字段标记出来 */ AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, time, zoneid, ip, deviceid, loginid, gradingid, isfirstreboot, game_channel, upload_M, download_M, COALESCE(IF(rk = rk1, rk2, rk1), 0) AS rk /* --要把重启这一次日志算作上一次开机期间的最后一条 */ FROM network_series_join), part1_noreboot_user /* --没重启用户当日的流量消耗 */ AS (SELECT logymd, accountid, lognum, rk, upload_M_start, upload_M_end, download_M_start, download_M_end, game_channel, gradingid, deviceid, zoneid, ip, loginid, CASE WHEN rk = 0 AND lognum = 1 THEN 0 /* --如果第一条开机的日志数=1，说明没法作diff，不统计 */ WHEN rk >= 1 AND lognum = 1 THEN COALESCE(upload_M_end, 0) /* --如果非第1条开机，且日志数=1，此时不需要做diff，直接求和 */ ELSE COALESCE(upload_M_end, 0) - COALESCE(upload_M_start, 0) END AS upload_M, CASE WHEN rk = 0 AND lognum = 1 THEN 0 /* --如果第一条开机的日志数=1，说明没法作diff，不统计 */ WHEN rk >= 1 AND lognum = 1 THEN COALESCE(download_M_end, 0) /* --如果非第1条开机，且日志数=1，此时不需要做diff，直接求和 */ ELSE COALESCE(download_M_end, 0) - COALESCE(download_M_start, 0) END AS download_M FROM (SELECT logymd, accountid, rk, MIN_BY(upload_M, time) AS upload_M_start, MAX_BY(upload_M, time) AS upload_M_end, MIN_BY(download_M, time) AS download_M_start, MAX_BY(download_M, time) AS download_M_end, COUNT(1) AS lognum, MIN_BY(game_channel, time) AS game_channel, MIN_BY(gradingid, time) AS gradingid, MIN_BY(deviceid, time) AS deviceid, MIN_BY(zoneid, time) AS zoneid, MIN_BY(ip, time) AS ip, MIN_BY(loginid, time) AS loginid FROM network_series_join_complete AS s1 GROUP BY logymd, accountid, rk) AS t) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.jaxzhong_user_network_flow_summary_detail_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* 最终明细数据写入分区表 */ SELECT accountid, lognum, rk, upload_M_start AS upload_num_start, upload_M_end AS upload_num_end, download_M_start AS download_num_start, download_M_end AS download_num_end, game_channel, gradingid, deviceid, zoneid, ip, loginid, upload_M AS upload_num, download_M AS download_num FROM part1_noreboot_user WHERE upload_M > 0

1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS createdate, ip_country, client_version, 'unknown' AS sdk_version, idfa, idfv, gps_adid, android_id, imei, oaid, app_id, event_time, 'unknown' AS SDK 3.0版本没有这个功能 1.已解决  2.未解决 3.未确认', */ /*     `source` string COMMENT '"客诉来源 android、ios、web、mail、facebook、wechat、wechatgame、 vk、twitter"', */ /*     `evaluater_time` bigint COMMENT '玩家评价时间', */ /*     `evaluater_ymd` string COMMENT '玩家评价日期', */ /*     `close_time` bigint COMMENT '关单时间', */ /*     `close_ymd` string COMMENT '关单日期', */ /*     `category1` string COMMENT '客诉一级分类', */ /*     `category2` string COMMENT '客诉二级分类', */ /*     `category3` string COMMENT '客诉三级分类', */ /*     `category4` string COMMENT '客诉四级分类', */ /*     `evaluater_message` string COMMENT '评价内容', */ /*     `message_list` array < string > COMMENT '客诉消息列表', */ /*     `tag` string COMMENT 'tag', */ /*     `time_flag` string COMMENT '入库时间', */ /*     `assign_record_list` array < string > COMMENT '分配记录列表', */ /*     `sentiment` string COMMENT '玩家情绪', */ /*     `note_list` array < string > COMMENT '客诉备注列表', */ /*     `served_by` int COMMENT '接待客服类型' */ /* ) */ /* PARTITIONED BY (logymd STRING COMMENT '日期分区yyy-MM-dd') */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3n://mt-dwd/table/stg_customer_aihelp_data_mlbb_di' */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.stg_customer_aihelp_data_mlbb_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') /* * repartition(1) */ SELECT ticket_id, tags, user_id, status, language, server_id, country_code, starindex, custom_data, device_info, login_region, create_role_region, create_time, create_ymd, userdisplayname, customer_true_name, customer_name, is_user_resolve, source, evaluater_time, evaluater_ymd, close_time, close_ymd, category1, category2, category3, category4, evaluater_message, message_list, tag, time_flag, assign_record_list, sentiment, note_list, served_by FROM mt_ods.customer_aihelp_data_mlbb WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31'

name: mt_dwd.dwd_decismart_netinfoping_811_mlbb
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_decismart_realtime_netinfoping PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT accountid, zoneid, big_zoneid, IF(TRIM(country) IN ('', '-') OR country IS NULL, 'unknown', LOWER(country)) AS copuntry, IF(TRIM(operator) IN ('', '-') OR operator IS NULL, 'unknown', operator) AS operator, IF(TRIM(province) IN ('', '-', '- / -') OR province IS NULL, 'unknown', province) AS province, errortype, point, time FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, (zoneid DIV 1000) AS big_zoneid, GEOIP(`ip`, 1, IF('202605' <= '202201', '202201', '202605')) AS country, GEOIP(`ip`, 5, IF('202605' <= '202201', '202201', '202605')) AS operator, GEOIP(`ip`, 2, IF('202605' <= '202201', '202201', '202605')) AS province, errortype, LEAST(287, (HOUR(time) * 3600 + MINUTE(time) * 60 + SECOND(time)) DIV 300) AS point, time FROM ml_ods.reportserver_netinfoping WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND errortype IN (811, 812, 711, 712)) AS t1

name: 乱斗英雄随机标签特征
output_hint: 乱斗英雄随机标签特征
sql_units: WITH battle_base AS (/* 原来三个 CTE 合并为一次扫描 */ /* collect_set(CASE WHEN pvptype=2 THEN ...) 自动忽略 NULL，等价于带 pvptype=2 过滤 */ SELECT zoneid, roleid, CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN heroid END))) AS rank_hero_ids, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN last_bigranklvl END) BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN '0-5' WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN last_bigranklvl END) = 6 THEN '6' WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN pvptype = 2 THEN last_bigranklvl END) = 7 THEN '7' ELSE '0-5' END AS rank_tier FROM mt_dwm.dwm_battle_heroes_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -29) AND '2026-05-31' AND is_fake_ai = 0 GROUP BY zoneid, roleid), feat1_buy_hero AS (SELECT zoneid, roleid, CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(heroid))) AS buy_hero_ids FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_hero WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31' AND time_len = 0 GROUP BY zoneid, roleid), feat2_skin_hero AS (SELECT s.zoneid, s.roleid, CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(sc.skin_heroid))) AS skin_hero_ids FROM ml_ods.gameserver_add_skin AS s JOIN mt_dim.dim_skin_config AS sc ON s.skinid = sc.skinid WHERE s.logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', -6) AND '2026-05-31' AND s.time_len = 0 AND sc.quality > 2 GROUP BY s.zoneid, s.roleid), transfer_matrix AS (SELECT rank_tier, heroid_out, heroid_in, out_pred_transfertimes_ratio FROM ml_temp.celiaye_hero_transfer_matrix_rank), user_heroes_exploded AS (SELECT b.zoneid, b.roleid, b.rank_tier, CAST(hero_col AS INT) AS heroid_out FROM battle_base AS b LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(b.rank_hero_ids, ',')) tmp AS hero_col WHERE b.rank_hero_ids <> ''), hero_transfer_scores AS (SELECT u.zoneid, u.roleid, t.heroid_in, SUM(t.out_pred_transfertimes_ratio) AS transfer_score FROM user_heroes_exploded AS u JOIN transfer_matrix AS t ON u.rank_tier = t.rank_tier AND u.heroid_out = t.heroid_out GROUP BY u.zoneid, u.roleid, t.heroid_in), hero_transfer_ranked AS (SELECT s.zoneid, s.roleid, s.heroid_in, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.zoneid, s.roleid ORDER BY s.transfer_score DESC) AS rn FROM hero_transfer_scores AS s JOIN battle_base AS b ON s.zoneid = b.zoneid AND s.roleid = b.roleid WHERE NOT ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT(COALESCE(b.rank_hero_ids, ''), ','), CAST(s.heroid_in AS STRING)) AND NOT s.heroid_in IN (888, 999)), feat4_recommend AS (SELECT zoneid, roleid, REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT_WS(',', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(rn AS STRING), 2, '0'), '_', CAST(heroid_in AS STRING))))), '\\d{2}_', '') AS recommend_hero_ids FROM hero_transfer_ranked WHERE rn <= 20 GROUP BY zoneid, roleid) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.celiaye_roam_hero_random_recommendation_official PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT b.zoneid, b.roleid, COALESCE(f1.buy_hero_ids, '') AS buy_hero_ids, COALESCE(f2.skin_hero_ids, '') AS skin_hero_ids, COALESCE(b.rank_hero_ids, '') AS rank_hero_ids, COALESCE(f4.recommend_hero_ids, '') AS recommend_hero_ids FROM battle_base AS b LEFT JOIN feat1_buy_hero AS f1 ON b.zoneid = f1.zoneid AND b.roleid = f1.roleid LEFT JOIN feat2_skin_hero AS f2 ON b.zoneid = f2.zoneid AND b.roleid = f2.roleid LEFT JOIN feat4_recommend AS f4 ON b.zoneid = f4.zoneid AND b.roleid = f4.roleid

name: mt_dwd.dwd_decismart_battle_reconnect_911_mlbb
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dwd.dwd_decismart_realtime_battle_reconnect PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT accountid, zoneid, big_zoneid, IF(TRIM(country) IN ('', '-') OR country IS NULL, 'unknown', LOWER(country)) AS copuntry, IF(TRIM(operator) IN ('', '-') OR operator IS NULL, 'unknown', operator) AS operator, IF(TRIM(province) IN ('', '-', '- / -') OR province IS NULL, 'unknown', province) AS province, battle_group, point, time FROM (SELECT accountid, zoneid, (zoneid DIV 1000) AS big_zoneid, GEOIP(`ip`, 1, IF('202605' <= '202201', '202201', '202605')) AS country, GEOIP(`ip`, 5, IF('202605' <= '202201', '202201', '202605')) AS operator, GEOIP(`ip`, 2, IF('202605' <= '202201', '202201', '202605')) AS province, COALESCE(BIGINT(FLOOR(battleserid / 1000)), -99999) AS battle_group, LEAST(287, (HOUR(time) * 3600 + MINUTE(time) * 60 + SECOND(time)) DIV 300) AS point, time FROM ml_ods.connserver_client_battle_reconnect WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t1

name: 竞技场周战斗数据（即时段位）
output_hint: 竞技场周战斗数据（即时段位）
sql_units: WITH pvp_fight AS (SELECT CASE WHEN zone_id BETWEEN 50001 AND 69999 THEN '正式服' WHEN zone_id >= 70001 THEN '亚太服' ELSE '先锋服' END AS zonetype, region_id, stage_id % 10 AS stage_type, before_tier AS tier, is_human, is_initiative, CASE WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.4 THEN '40~%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.35 THEN '35~40%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.30 THEN '30~35%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.25 THEN '25~30%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.20 THEN '20~25%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.15 THEN '15~20%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.10 THEN '10~15%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.05 THEN '05~10%' WHEN power_diff_rate >= 0.00 THEN '00~05%' ELSE NULL END AS power_diff_group, IF(auto_fight_type IS NULL, auto_mode, auto_fight_type) AS auto_type, player_rank, SUM(opponent_power) AS total_opponent_power, COUNT(*) AS fight_cnt FROM (SELECT *, ABS((opponent_power - team_power) / opponent_power) AS power_diff_rate FROM zgame_dwd.crossserver_basic_pvp_fight WHERE (logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31') AND (FLOOR(stage_id / 1000) = 6001) AND (zone_id = 1 OR zone_id >= 19001)) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT fight_uid, auto_mode FROM zgame_damai_ods.reportserver_fight WHERE (logymd BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-05-31') AND (FLOOR(copy_id / 1000) = 6001) AND (zoneid = 1 OR zoneid >= 19001)) AS b ON a.fight_uid = b.fight_uid GROUP BY zonetype, region_id, stage_type, tier, is_human, is_initiative, power_diff_group, player_rank, auto_type) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE zg_temp.pvp_weekly_prompt PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT '2026-05-25' AS start_date, '2026-05-31' AS end_date, zonetype, region_id, stage_type, tier, is_human, is_initiative, power_diff_group, player_rank, auto_type, total_opponent_power, fight_cnt FROM pvp_fight

name: mt_ads.ads_decismart_realtime_secondary_cube_di
sql_units: /* , */ /* dim_biqi_2 as ( */ /*     select t1.createrole_country, */ /*         t1.point, */ /*         nvl(t2.successcnt,0) as match_fz_point_cnt, */ /*         nvl(t2.battlecnt,0) as match_fm_point_cnt */ /*     from match_dim t1 */ /*     left join match t2 */ /*         on t1.createrole_country = t2.createrole_country */ /*         and t1.point = t2.point */ /* ) */ /* , */ /* us_network as ( */ /*         select LEAST(5, (HOUR(date_range) * 3600 + MINUTE(date_range) * 60 + SECOND(date_range)) DIV 14400) point, -- 每4小时一个point */ /*             sum(nework_num) as nework_num, */ /*             sum(nework_den) as nework_den */ /*         from mt_ads.ads_network_info_us_di */ /*         where logymd = '2026-05-31' and logymd >= '2026-01-16' */ /*         group by LEAST(5, (HOUR(date_range) * 3600 + MINUTE(date_range) * 60 + SECOND(date_range)) DIV 14400) */ /* ), */ /* us_match as ( */ /*         select LEAST(5, (HOUR(date_range) * 3600 + MINUTE(date_range) * 60 + SECOND(date_range)) DIV 14400) point, -- 每4小时一个point */ /*             sum(match_num) as match_num, */ /*             sum(match_den) as match_den */ /*         from mt_ads.ads_match_info_us_di */ /*         where logymd = '2026-05-31' and logymd >= '2026-01-16' */ /*         group by LEAST(5, (HOUR(date_range) * 3600 + MINUTE(date_range) * 60 + SECOND(date_range)) DIV 14400) */ /* ) */ WITH network AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(t2.first_mt_country) IN ('', '-') OR t2.first_mt_country IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE LOWER(t2.first_mt_country) END AS createrole_country, LEAST(287, (HOUR(t1.TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(t1.TIME) * 60 + SECOND(t1.TIME)) DIV 300) AS point /* 每4小时一个point */, SUM(CASE WHEN ((t1.ping120 + t1.ping150 + t1.ping200 + t1.ping300 + t1.ping500 + t1.ping800) / t1.ping_times) <= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stdping_cnt, SUM(1) AS battle_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM ml_ods.battleserver_battle_end WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND logymd >= '2022-01-01' /* 最早有数日期 */ AND timedelay > 0 AND timedelay <> 10000 AND timedelay < 50000 AND maxdelay < 50000 AND movelag < 10000 AND isvalid = 1 AND pvptype IN (1, 2)) AS t1 LEFT JOIN mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.roleid AND t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid AND t2.logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') GROUP BY CASE WHEN TRIM(t2.first_mt_country) IN ('', '-') OR t2.first_mt_country IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE LOWER(t2.first_mt_country) END, LEAST(287, (HOUR(t1.TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(t1.TIME) * 60 + SECOND(t1.TIME)) DIV 300)), network_dim /* , */ /* match as ( */ /*     select case when trim(t2.first_mt_country) in ('', '-') or t2.first_mt_country is null */ /*                  then 'unknown' */ /*                  else lower(t2.first_mt_country) */ /*            end AS createrole_country, */ /*            LEAST(287, (HOUR(t1.TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(t1.TIME) * 60 + SECOND(t1.TIME)) DIV 300) as  point, -- 每4小时一个point */ /*            SUM( */ /*                 CASE WHEN t1.pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND t1.quit_reason <> 15 THEN t1.success */ /*                     ELSE 0 */ /*                 END */ /*             ) AS successcnt, */ /*            count( */ /*                 CASE WHEN t1.pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND t1.quit_reason <> 15 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END */ /*             ) AS battlecnt */ /*     from ( */ /*         select * */ /*         from ml_ods.matchserver_match_end */ /*         WHERE   logymd = '2026-05-31' and logymd >= '2023-12-20' -- 最早有数日期 */ /*         AND     pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) */ /*         -- AND     zoneid < 57000 */ /*     ) t1 */ /*     left join mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df t2 */ /*         on t1.accountid = t2.roleid */ /*         and t1.zoneid = t2.zoneid */ /*         and t2.logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2026-05-31') */ /*     GROUP BY */ /*             case when trim(t2.first_mt_country) in ('', '-') or t2.first_mt_country is null */ /*                  then 'unknown' */ /*                  else lower(t2.first_mt_country) */ /*             end, */ /*             LEAST(287, (HOUR(t1.TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(t1.TIME) * 60 + SECOND(t1.TIME)) DIV 300) */ /* ) */ AS (SELECT t1.createrole_country, t2.point FROM (SELECT createrole_country FROM network GROUP BY createrole_country) AS t1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(0, 287)) AS point) AS t2), dim_biqi /* , */ /* match_dim as ( */ /*     select t1.createrole_country, */ /*            t2.point */ /*     from ( */ /*         select  createrole_country */ /*         FROM    match */ /*         group by createrole_country */ /*     ) t1 */ /*     cross join ( */ /*         SELECT explode( */ /*             sequence(0, 287) */ /*         ) AS point */ /*     ) t2 */ /* ) */ AS (SELECT t1.createrole_country, t1.point, COALESCE(t2.stdping_cnt, 0) AS network_fz_point_cnt, COALESCE(t2.battle_cnt, 0) AS network_fm_point_cnt FROM network_dim AS t1 LEFT JOIN network AS t2 ON t1.createrole_country = t2.createrole_country AND t1.point = t2.point) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_ads.ads_decismart_realtime_secondary_cube_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country AS country, NULL AS network, NULL AS os, NULL AS channel, network_map AS indicator_map /* map_concat( */ /*     NVL(network_map, CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>)), */ /*     NVL(match_auth_map,CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>)) */ /* ) AS indicator_map */ FROM (SELECT country, point, CAST(MAP('network_stdping_cnt', network_fz_point_cnt, 'network_battle_cnt', network_fm_point_cnt) AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>) AS network_map /* ,CAST(MAP() AS MAP<STRING, DECIMAL(38, 18)>) as match_auth_map */ FROM (/* 非美区网络满足率 */ SELECT createrole_country AS country, point, network_fz_point_cnt, network_fm_point_cnt FROM dim_biqi) AS t1) AS t2 WHERE SIZE(network_map) > 0

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_mlbb_shop_give_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_shop_give_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT a.roleid, a.zoneid, a.item_id, n.item_name, a.give_type, a.gift_type, a.cost_diamond, CAST(h.collect_quality AS INT) AS skin_quality, CASE CAST(h.collect_quality AS INT) WHEN 0 THEN '默认' WHEN 1 THEN '精英' WHEN 2 THEN '活动限定' WHEN 3 THEN '史诗' WHEN 4 THEN '传说' WHEN 5 THEN 'IP联动' WHEN 6 THEN '神话' ELSE NULL END AS skin_quality_name, d.first_mt_country, c.country_name, COALESCE(r.r_level, '非付费') AS r_level FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, cost_diamond, 'SKIN' AS give_type, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS gift_type FROM ml_ods.gameserver_give_skin WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000 UNION ALL SELECT roleid, zoneid, item_id, cost_diamond, 'GIFT' AS give_type, gift_type FROM ml_ods.gameserver_give_gift WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND zoneid < 57000) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS d ON a.roleid = d.roleid AND a.zoneid = d.zoneid LEFT JOIN (SELECT country_code, country_name FROM (SELECT LOWER(country_code) AS country_code, country_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(country_code) ORDER BY logymd DESC) AS rn FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE logymd > '0') AS t WHERE rn = 1) AS c ON LOWER(d.first_mt_country) = c.country_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, r_level FROM mt_dim.dim_mlbb_rlevel_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS r ON a.roleid = r.roleid LEFT JOIN (/* type=0 主皮肤 + type=1 染色皮变体（195条）均有有效 collect_quality；MAX 去重防 fan-out */ SELECT CAST(id AS BIGINT) AS skin_id, MAX(CAST(collect_quality AS INT)) AS collect_quality FROM mizar_temp.dim_herocostume_df_v2 WHERE CAST(type AS STRING) IN ('0', '1') GROUP BY CAST(id AS BIGINT)) AS h ON a.item_id = h.skin_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT item_id, item_name FROM mt_dim.dim_item_config_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS n ON a.item_id = n.item_id

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_monitor_metric_dau_v2_di
sql_units: WITH top_network AS (SELECT day_first_network, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM (SELECT logymd, GEOIP(day_first_ip, 5) AS day_first_network, SUM(1) AS cnt FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= '2026-05-01' AND logymd <= '2026-05-31' AND is_ai = 0 AND NOT roleid IS NULL AND NOT zoneid IS NULL GROUP BY logymd, GEOIP(day_first_ip, 5)) AS tmp GROUP BY day_first_network HAVING avg_cnt >= 1000) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_monitor_metric_dau_v2_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT region_id, os, day_first_channel, his_first_country, day_first_network, realpicturequality, is_registered_mc, is_installed_hok, age_type, tag_group_1, tag_group_2, tag_group_3, SUM(is_active) AS dau, SUM(is_reten) AS retained_users, SUM(is_new) AS new_users, SUM(is_back) AS returning_users, SUM(pay_amt_pre_tax) AS pay_amt_pre_tax, SUM(pay_amt_post_tax) AS pay_amt_post_tax FROM (SELECT COALESCE(b.region_id, 0) AS region_id, COALESCE(b.os, 'else') AS os, COALESCE(b.day_first_channel, 'else') AS day_first_channel, COALESCE(b.his_first_country, 'else') AS his_first_country, COALESCE(b.day_first_network, 'else') AS day_first_network, COALESCE(b.realpicturequality, 0) AS realpicturequality, COALESCE(b.is_registered_mc, 0) AS is_registered_mc, COALESCE(b.is_installed_hok, 0) AS is_installed_hok, COALESCE(b.age_type, 'else') AS age_type, COALESCE(b.tag_group_1, 0) AS tag_group_1, COALESCE(b.tag_group_2, '0_[0, 30]') AS tag_group_2, COALESCE(b.tag_group_3, '1_周低活') AS tag_group_3, a.is_active, a.is_reten, a.is_new, a.is_back, a.pay_amt_pre_tax, a.pay_amt_post_tax FROM (SELECT accountid, IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, 1) = '1', 1, 0) AS is_active, IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, 2) = '11', 1, 0) AS is_reten, IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, 1) = '1' AND register_date = '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_new, IF(SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, 2) = '10' AND register_date < '2026-05-31', 1, 0) AS is_back, COALESCE(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array[0], 0) - COALESCE(before_tax_usd_amt_total_array[1], 0) AS pay_amt_pre_tax, COALESCE(pay_actual_amt_total_array[0], 0) - COALESCE(pay_actual_amt_total_array[1], 0) AS pay_amt_post_tax FROM mt_dm.dm_behavior_info_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND SUBSTRING(active_info, 1, 1) = '1') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.accountid, t1.region_id, t2.os AS os, t2.day_first_channel AS day_first_channel, t1.first_mt_country AS his_first_country, t2.day_first_network AS day_first_network, t3.realpicturequality AS realpicturequality, t3.is_registered_mc AS is_registered_mc, t3.is_installed_hok AS is_installed_hok, t4.age_type, t6.tag_group_1, t1.tag_group_2, t5.tag_group_3 FROM (/* 国家、注册时长 */ SELECT accountid, region_id, CASE WHEN UPPER(first_mt_country) IN ('ID', 'PH', 'MM', 'MY', 'IN', 'RU', 'KH', 'TR', 'TH', 'UNKNOWN', 'BR', 'LA', 'MN', 'SG', 'PE', 'US', 'BO', 'UA', 'VN', 'NP', 'UZ', 'MX', 'KZ', 'AR', 'SA', 'EG', 'JP', 'DE', 'BY', 'CO') THEN UPPER(first_mt_country) ELSE 'else' END AS first_mt_country, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 30 THEN '0_[0, 30]' WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 90 THEN '1_[31, 90]' WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 180 THEN '2_[91, 180]' WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 365 THEN '3_[181, 365]' WHEN DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', register_date) < 1095 THEN '4_[366, 1095]' ELSE '5_1095+' END AS tag_group_2 /* 注册日期差 */ FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, MIN_BY(FLOOR(zoneid / 1000), register_time) AS region_id, MIN_BY(first_mt_country, register_time) AS first_mt_country, MIN(register_date) AS register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid) AS tmp) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (/* 操作系统，登录渠道，供应商 */ SELECT roleid AS accountid, MIN_BY(os, day_first_active_time) AS os, MIN_BY(day_first_channel, day_first_active_time) AS day_first_channel, MIN_BY(day_first_network, day_first_active_time) AS day_first_network FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, os, CASE WHEN day_first_channel = 'and_cata_xiaomi' THEN 'and_catappult' /* 2025-03-19，and_cata_xiaomi的渠道合并计入了and_catappult */ WHEN day_first_channel IN ('and_usa', 'ios_usa', 'and_catappult', 'and_xiaomi_getapps', 'and_mlingp', 'and_taptap', 'and_huawei_ag', 'and_funtap', 'ios_usa_us', 'and_usa_us', 'ios_mlingp', 'ios_funtap', 'and_shareit_oppo') THEN day_first_channel ELSE 'else' END AS day_first_channel, COALESCE(t2.day_first_network, 'else') AS day_first_network, day_first_active_time FROM (SELECT *, GEOIP(day_first_ip, 5) AS day_first_network FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t1 LEFT JOIN top_network AS t2 ON t1.day_first_network = t2.day_first_network) AS tmp GROUP BY roleid) AS t2 ON t1.accountid = t2.accountid LEFT JOIN (/* 机型品质、注册过MC、安装过HOK */ SELECT accountid, CASE WHEN realpicturequality IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4) THEN realpicturequality ELSE 0 END AS realpicturequality, is_registered_mc, is_installed_hok FROM mt_dm.dm_monitor_dimention_cum_account_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS t3 ON t1.accountid = t3.accountid LEFT JOIN (/* 年龄 */ SELECT accountid, CASE WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 9 THEN '[0,9]' WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 10 AND 14 THEN '[10,14]' WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 15 AND 19 THEN '[15,19]' WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN '[20,24]' WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN '[25,29]' WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN '[30,34]' WHEN ROUND(DATEDIFF('2026-05-31', birthday_new) / 365, 0) >= 35 THEN '[35,)' ELSE 'else' END AS age_type FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, MAX(CASE WHEN birthday IN ('2015+', '1980-') THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(birthday, 1, 4), '-', '01', '-', '01') ELSE birthday END) AS birthday_new FROM ml_temp.teemoyu_20240305_mc_guangzi_01 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND (gt1 = 1 OR gt2 = 1) GROUP BY roleid) AS tmp) AS t4 ON t1.accountid = t4.accountid LEFT JOIN (/* 活跃档位 */ SELECT roleid AS accountid, CASE WHEN active_days >= 6 THEN '3_周高活' WHEN active_days >= 3 THEN '2_周中活' WHEN active_days >= 1 THEN '1_周低活' ELSE '0_周流失' END AS tag_group_3 FROM (SELECT roleid, COUNT(DISTINCT logymd) AS active_days FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd >= DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 7 * -1) AND logymd < '2026-05-31' /* 不含当日活跃 */ /* AND     zoneid < 57000 2025年1月10日修改为包含57测服 */ GROUP BY roleid) AS temp) AS t5 ON t1.accountid = t5.accountid LEFT JOIN (/* 用户类型 */ SELECT COALESCE(tt1.accountid, tt2.accountid) AS accountid, CASE WHEN NOT tt2.accountid IS NULL THEN 2 /* 回流用户 */ WHEN NOT tt1.accountid IS NULL THEN 1 /* 新增用户 */ ELSE 0 /* 持续活跃用户 */ END AS tag_group_1 FROM (/* 新增用户 */ SELECT accountid FROM (SELECT roleid AS accountid, MIN(register_date) AS register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid) AS tmp WHERE register_date = '2026-05-31') AS tt1 FULL JOIN (/* 回流用户 */ SELECT DISTINCT roleid AS accountid /* 流失>=30 and 回流 */ FROM mt_dm.dm_lose_recurring_core_role_zone_di /* 最早的分区是21.1.2 */ WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND lose_days >= 30 /* 流失30天以上 */ AND recurring_date = logymd /* 回流 */) AS tt2 ON tt1.accountid = tt2.accountid) AS t6 ON t1.accountid = t6.accountid) AS b ON a.accountid = b.accountid) AS tmp GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (() /* 0个维度：总合计 */ /* 0个维度：总合计 */, (region_id) /* 1个维度：每个单独维度的聚合 */, (os), (day_first_channel), (his_first_country), (day_first_network), (realpicturequality), (is_registered_mc), (is_installed_hok), (age_type), (tag_group_1), (tag_group_2), (tag_group_3), (region_id, os) /* 2个维度：所有可能的两两组合 */, (region_id, day_first_channel), (region_id, his_first_country), (region_id, day_first_network), (region_id, realpicturequality), (region_id, is_registered_mc), (region_id, is_installed_hok), (region_id, age_type), (region_id, tag_group_1), (region_id, tag_group_2), (region_id, tag_group_3), (os, day_first_channel), (os, his_first_country), (os, day_first_network), (os, realpicturequality), (os, is_registered_mc), (os, is_installed_hok), (os, age_type), (os, tag_group_1), (os, tag_group_2), (os, tag_group_3), (day_first_channel, his_first_country), (day_first_channel, day_first_network), (day_first_channel, realpicturequality), (day_first_channel, is_registered_mc), (day_first_channel, is_installed_hok), (day_first_channel, age_type), (day_first_channel, tag_group_1), (day_first_channel, tag_group_2), (day_first_channel, tag_group_3), (his_first_country, day_first_network), (his_first_country, realpicturequality), (his_first_country, is_registered_mc), (his_first_country, is_installed_hok), (his_first_country, age_type), (his_first_country, tag_group_1), (his_first_country, tag_group_2), (his_first_country, tag_group_3), (day_first_network, realpicturequality), (day_first_network, is_registered_mc), (day_first_network, is_installed_hok), (day_first_network, age_type), (day_first_network, tag_group_1), (day_first_network, tag_group_2), (day_first_network, tag_group_3), (realpicturequality, is_registered_mc), (realpicturequality, is_installed_hok), (realpicturequality, age_type), (realpicturequality, tag_group_1), (realpicturequality, tag_group_2), (realpicturequality, tag_group_3), (is_registered_mc, is_installed_hok), (is_registered_mc, age_type), (is_registered_mc, tag_group_1), (is_registered_mc, tag_group_2), (is_registered_mc, tag_group_3), (is_installed_hok, age_type), (is_installed_hok, tag_group_1), (is_installed_hok, tag_group_2), (is_installed_hok, tag_group_3), (tag_group_1, tag_group_2), (tag_group_1, tag_group_3), (tag_group_2, tag_group_3))

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: crystalmei@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-05-21 20:02:43.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* ******************************************************************** */ WITH max_statdate AS (SELECT MAX(statdate) AS max_statdate FROM ml_temp.mc_fake_quantity_users_rate_09_v1 WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30'), n AS (SELECT t.* FROM ml_temp.mc_fake_quantity_users_rate_09_v1 AS t JOIN max_statdate AS m ON t.statdate = m.max_statdate WHERE t.logymd = '2026-05-30'), f AS (SELECT t.* FROM ml_temp.mc_fake_quantity_users_rate_09_v1 AS t JOIN max_statdate AS m ON t.statdate = DATE_ADD(m.max_statdate, 1 * -1) WHERE t.logymd = '2026-05-30') INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.mc_fake_quantity_users_rate_09_v2 PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-30') SELECT n.statdate, n.country, n.first_network_name, n.new_user_cnt, n.fake_user_cnt, n.fake_user_rate, ROUND(n.fake_user_rate / f.fake_user_rate, 4) AS fake_user_rate_with_previous FROM n LEFT JOIN f ON DATE_ADD(n.statdate, 1 * -1) = f.statdate AND n.country = f.country AND n.first_network_name = f.first_network_name ORDER BY n.statdate, n.country, n.first_network_name

sql_units: /* ******************************************************************** */ /* Author: carldong@moonton.com */ /* Create by: 2026-04-28 10:45:59.000 */ /* Description: */ /* Update: Task Update Description */ /* -- ******************************************************************** */ /* CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adbi.dwm_active_account_tz_di ( */ /*             account_id STRING COMMENT '设备指纹,key', */ /*             login_cnt array<int> COMMENT '登录次数', */ /*             online_time array<int> COMMENT '在线时长', */ /*             day_first_login_time array<STRING> COMMENT '当天首次活跃时间, 格式： yyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', */ /*             stage_id STRING */ /*         ) COMMENT '设备活跃增量表' */ /* PARTITIONED BY ( */ /*     logymd string comment '日期分区yyyy-MM-dd', */ /*     app_id string comment '应用唯一id' */ /* ) */ /* STORED AS PARQUET */ /* LOCATION 's3a://moonton-warehouse/table/advertisement_bi/adbi/dwm_active_account_tz_di' */ WITH event_log AS (SELECT account_id, app_id, stage_id, ARRAY(MIN(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')), MIN(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+0'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')), MIN(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')), MIN(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+9'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) AS first_event_time, ARRAY(MAX(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')), MAX(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+0'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') > '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+0'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))), MAX(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') > '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))), MAX(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+9'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') > '2026-05-31', NULL, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time), 'GMT+9'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')))) AS last_event_time FROM (SELECT package_name, did, CAST(CASE WHEN app_id = 4500 THEN SUBSTRING(role_id, 0, 10) WHEN app_id = 4510 THEN SUBSTRING(role_id, 6, 10000000) ELSE role_id END AS BIGINT) AS account_id, os, is_emulator, os_version, system_language AS os_language, role_id /* account_id, */, zone_id, event_time / 1000 AS event_time, client_ip, model, network_type, system_language, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, IF(event = 'logout', level, -99999) AS level, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, app_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id AS black_id FROM adbi.timezone_appid_blacklist WHERE NOT app_id IN ('4510', '4500', '4530')) AS blk ON a.app_id = blk.black_id WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND `event` IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'login', 'logout') AND blk.black_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT package_name, did, role_id AS account_id, os, 0 AS is_emulator, os_version, 'unknown' AS os_language, role_id /* account_id, */, zone_id, event_time / 1000 AS event_time, client_ip, model, 'unknown' AS network_type, 'unknown' AS system_language, ip_country, client_version, 'unknown' AS sdk_version, -99999 AS level, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, app_id FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id AS black_id FROM adbi.timezone_appid_blacklist WHERE NOT app_id IN ('4510', '4500', '4530')) AS blk ON a.app_id = blk.black_id WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND event IN ('purchase_event') AND blk.black_id IS NULL UNION ALL /* 分时区 */ SELECT package_name, did, CAST(CASE WHEN app_id = 4500 THEN SUBSTRING(role_id, 0, 10) WHEN app_id = 4510 THEN SUBSTRING(role_id, 6, 10000000) ELSE role_id END AS BIGINT) AS account_id, os, is_emulator, os_version, system_language AS os_language, role_id /* account_id, */, zone_id, event_time / 1000 AS event_time, client_ip, model, network_type, system_language, ip_country, client_version, sdk_version, IF(event = 'logout', level, -99999) AS level, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, app_id FROM adbi.dwd_event_log_detail_di AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id AS black_id FROM adbi.timezone_appid_blacklist WHERE NOT app_id IN ('4510', '4500', '4530')) AS blk ON a.app_id = blk.black_id WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND `event` IN ('__install_event__', '__launch_event__', 'role_login', 'role_register', 'create_filter', 'login', 'logout') AND blk.black_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT package_name, did, role_id AS account_id, os, 0 AS is_emulator, os_version, 'unknown' AS os_language, role_id /* account_id, */, zone_id, event_time / 1000 AS event_time, client_ip, model, 'unknown' AS network_type, 'unknown' AS system_language, ip_country, client_version, 'unknown' AS sdk_version, -99999 AS level, COALESCE(stage_id, '01') AS stage_id, app_id FROM adbi.dwd_pay_event_log_detail_di AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id AS black_id FROM adbi.timezone_appid_blacklist WHERE NOT app_id IN ('4510', '4500', '4530')) AS blk ON a.app_id = blk.black_id WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND event IN ('purchase_event') AND blk.black_id IS NULL) AS a GROUP BY account_id, app_id, stage_id) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE adbi.dwm_active_account_tz_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', app_id) SELECT event_log.account_id AS account_id, COALESCE(login_cnt.login_cnt, ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0)) AS login_cnt, COALESCE(ol_time.online_time, ARRAY(0, 0, 0, 0)) AS online_time, COALESCE(first_event_time, ARRAY('1970-01-01', '1970-01-01', '1970-01-01', '1970-01-01')) AS day_first_login_time, event_log.stage_id AS stage_id, event_log.app_id FROM event_log LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, role_id AS account_id /* package_name, */, stage_id, ARRAY(SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT-8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31', COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.ol_time'), 0), 0)), SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT+0'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31', COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.ol_time'), 0), 0)), SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT+8'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31', COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.ol_time'), 0), 0)), SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_TIMESTAMP(event_time / 1000), 'GMT+9'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = '2026-05-31', COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(event_desc, '$.ol_time'), 0), 0))) AS online_time /* SUM(nvl(get_json_object(event_desc,'$.ol_time'), 0)) AS online_time */ FROM (SELECT app_id, role_id, stage_id, event_time, event_desc FROM msdk_dwd.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-30' AND `event` IN ('__online_time__') UNION ALL SELECT app_id, role_id, stage_id, event_time, event_desc FROM adbi.dwd_event_log_detail_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND `event` IN ('__online_time__')) AS a GROUP BY app_id, role_id, stage_id) AS ol_time ON event_log.app_id = ol_time.app_id AND event_log.account_id = ol_time.account_id AND event_log.stage_id = ol_time.stage_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id, account_id /* package_name, */, stage_id, ARRAY(COUNT(IF(last_event_time[0] = '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)), COUNT(IF(last_event_time[1] = '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)), COUNT(IF(last_event_time[2] = '2026-05-31', 1, NULL)), COUNT(IF(last_event_time[3] = '2026-05-31', 1, NULL))) AS login_cnt /* os, */ FROM event_log GROUP BY app_id, stage_id, account_id) AS login_cnt ON event_log.app_id = login_cnt.app_id AND /* AND     event_log.package_name = login_cnt.package_name */ event_log.account_id = login_cnt.account_id AND event_log.stage_id = login_cnt.stage_id /* AND     event_log.os = login_cnt.os */ WHERE event_log.app_id <> 4310

name: mt_dwd.dwd_decismart_zone_online_mlbb
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_ads`.`ads_decismart_realtime_zone_online` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT point, country, os, (zone_id DIV 1000) AS big_zoneid, zone_id AS zone_id, grouping_name, COALESCE(SUM(online_num), 0) AS online_num FROM (/* 分国家 */ SELECT LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point, LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) = '' OR TRIM(country) = '-', 'unknown', TRIM(country))) AS country, IF(os_type = 1, 1, 2) AS os, zone_id, 'country' AS grouping_name, SUM(online_num - vp_online_num) AS online_num FROM ml_ods.connserver_t_real_os_country_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /*   AND zone_id < IF( '2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03',  57000 , 999999) */ GROUP BY LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300), LOWER(IF(TRIM(country) = '' OR TRIM(country) = '-', 'unknown', TRIM(country))), IF(os_type = 1, 1, 2), zone_id /* 全量 */ UNION ALL SELECT LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) AS point, 'unknown' AS country /* , LOWER(IF(TRIM(nvl(country,'')) = '' OR TRIM(country) = '-' , 'unknown' , TRIM(country)))  AS  country */, IF(os_type = 1, 1, 2) AS os, zone_id, 'all' AS grouping_name, SUM(online_num - vp_online_num) AS online_num FROM ml_ods.connserver_t_real_os_online WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* AND zone_id < IF( '2026-05-31' <= '2025-01-03',  57000 , 999999) */ GROUP BY LEAST(287, (HOUR(TIME) * 3600 + MINUTE(TIME) * 60 + SECOND(TIME)) DIV 300) /* ,LOWER(IF(TRIM(nvl(country,'')) = '' OR TRIM(country) = '-' , 'unknown' , TRIM(country))) */, IF(os_type = 1, 1, 2), zone_id) AS t1 GROUP BY point, country, os, zone_id, grouping_name

name: mt_dwd.dwd_decismart_realtime_recurring_detail_mlbb
sql_units: WITH basic AS (SELECT roleid, first_mt_country AS country, is_ai, register_date FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2023-01-01', '2023-01-01', '2026-05-31') AND is_first_create = 1 AND is_ai = 0 AND register_date < '2026-05-01' /* 排除近31天新增用户 */), active_info AS (SELECT t1.* FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(channel), '') IN ('', '-') THEN 'unknown' ELSE channel END AS channel, CASE WHEN os = 'ios' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS os /* when os = 'and' then 2 */ /* when os = 'emulator' then 3 */ /* when os = 'unknown' then -99999 */ /* else -99999 */, LEAST(287, (HOUR(day_first_active_time) * 3600 + MINUTE(day_first_active_time) * 60 + SECOND(day_first_active_time)) DIV 300) AS point /* 每5分钟一个point */, day_first_active_time AS `time` FROM (SELECT roleid, zoneid, day_first_channel AS channel, os, day_first_active_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roleid ORDER BY day_first_active_time) AS rn FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' /* 含当天30天是否回流，所以是29+往前推30天来判断 */ AND appid = 'mlbb') AS ti WHERE rn = 1) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT roleid FROM mt_dwm.dwm_active_role_zone_di WHERE logymd BETWEEN DATE_ADD('2026-05-31', 30 * -1) AND '2026-05-30' /* 含当天30天是否回流，所以是29+往前推30天来判断 */ AND appid = 'mlbb') AS t2 ON t1.roleid = t2.roleid WHERE t2.roleid IS NULL) INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE `mt_dwd`.`dwd_decismart_realtime_recurring_detail` PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', appname = 'mlbb', granularity_type = 'account', date_type = 'daily') SELECT active_info.roleid, active_info.zoneid, (active_info.zoneid DIV 1000) AS big_zoneid, basic.country AS country, active_info.os, active_info.channel, active_info.point, active_info.time FROM basic JOIN active_info ON basic.roleid = active_info.roleid

name: etl.mt_dm.dm_mlbb_act_socialteam_role_zone_di
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dm.dm_mlbb_act_socialteam_role_zone_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT f.roleid, f.zoneid, f.act_id, f.oper_type, f.reward_index, f.teamid, 'action_act_socialteam' AS operate, f.event_cnt, f.team_size, c.first_mt_country FROM (/* ODS 先聚合到 dm 粒度，压缩行数后再 JOIN dim（减少 shuffle 量） */ SELECT roleid, zoneid, act_id, oper_type, reward_index, teamid, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt, MAX(team_size) AS team_size FROM ml_ods.gameserver_act_social_team WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' GROUP BY roleid, zoneid, act_id, oper_type, reward_index, teamid) AS f /* dim_basic_role_zone_df 每日滚动型 → logymd='2026-05-31' */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT roleid, zoneid, first_mt_country FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31') AS c ON f.roleid = c.roleid AND f.zoneid = c.zoneid

name: etl.mt_dim.dim_descimart_basic_config_df_mlbb
sql_units: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mt_dim.dim_decismart_basic_config_df PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31') SELECT big_zoneid, country, CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(channel, '')) IN ('', '-') THEN 'unknown' ELSE channel END AS channel, IF(TRIM(COALESCE(operator, '')) IN ('', '-'), 'unknown', operator) AS operator /* ,case when operator is null then 'unknown' else operator end as operator */, CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(province, '')) IN ('', '-', '- / -') THEN 'unknown' ELSE province END AS province /* ,case when province is null  then 'unknown' else province end as province */ /* ,case when trim(nvl(province,'')) in ('', '-') then  '- / -' end as province */ /*    when trim(nvl(province,'')) in ('', '-', '-/-') then 'unknown / unknown' */ /*    when split(trim(nvl(province,'')),'/')[0] != '-' and  split(trim(nvl(province,'')),'/')[1] = '-' */ /* as province */, COUNT(1) AS user_cnt FROM (SELECT roleid, (zoneid DIV 1000) AS big_zoneid, first_mt_country AS country, create_channel AS channel, GEOIP(`create_ip`, 5, IF('202605' <= '202201', '202201', '202605')) AS operator, GEOIP(`create_ip`, 2, IF('202605' <= '202201', '202201', '202605')) AS province /* ,COUNT(1) AS cnt */ FROM mt_dim.dim_basic_role_zone_df WHERE logymd = IF('2026-05-31' <= '2025-09-01', '2025-09-01', '2026-05-31')) AS t1 GROUP BY big_zoneid, country, CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(channel, '')) IN ('', '-') THEN 'unknown' ELSE channel END, IF(TRIM(COALESCE(operator, '')) IN ('', '-'), 'unknown', operator), CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(province, '')) IN ('', '-', '- / -') THEN 'unknown' ELSE province END /* , if(trim(province) in ('', '-', '-/-'), 'unknown / unknown', province) */ /* ,case when operator is null  then 'unknown' else operator end */ /* ,case when province is null  then 'unknown' else province end */

sql_units: /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */ /* 2. 匹配 — 匹配成功率 */ /*    源表：mt_ads.ads_decismart_country_social_battle_exp_di_mlbb_view */ /*    口径：sum(successcnt_match_time_fm) / sum(battlecnt_match_time_fm) */ /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */ /* [迁移 SQL] — 增加 pvptype 作为 d1 下钻维度（1=匹配 / 2=排位 / 4=乱斗 等），big_ranklevel 作为 d2 下钻维度（大段位） */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ml_temp.yudongzhang_dau_trend_analysis_secondary_indicators_combine_di PARTITION(logymd = '2026-05-31', indicator_name = 'match_success_rate') SELECT LOWER(country) AS country, CAST(pvptype AS STRING) AS d1 /* 玩法类型 */, big_ranklevel AS d2, SUM(successcnt_match_time_fm) / SUM(battlecnt_match_time_fm) AS match_success_rate, SUM(battlecnt_match_time_fm) AS cnt_sample, 0 AS sampling /* 全量数据 */ FROM mt_ads.ads_decismart_country_social_battle_exp_di_mlbb_view WHERE logymd = '2026-05-31' AND appname = 'mlbb' AND date_type = 'daily' AND granularity_type = 'role' /* 角色粒度 */ AND zone = 1 /* 正式服 */ GROUP BY LOWER(country), CAST(pvptype AS STRING), big_ranklevel
